CHAPTER.VERS: Ha t'a yichb’anel, ha Dios ixb’o’an satcha’anh yet' lum lum.

Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi' malaj stzolal yaj jun yol yib'anhk’inal tik, tzinan yilji. Tonhej panhan ek' ha ha' t'a yib'anh lu'um. K'ik'olinak yilji masanil t'a yib'anh ha', haxo Yespíritu Dios tzek' t'a yib'anh ha' chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan Dios icha tik: Ayokab' sakil k'inal, xchi. Icha chi' b'ian ix sakb'i k'inal.
Ix yilan Dios to wach' jun sakil k'inal chi', ix spojanel sakil k'inal chi' t'a skal k’ik’ k’inal.
Ha sakil k'inal chi', k'ualil ix sb'iejkan yuj, haxo k’ik’ k’inal chi', t'ak'walil ix sb'iejkani. Ix k'ik'b'iemi, ix sakb'i, ix ek'el jun b'ab'el k'u.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan Dios icha tik: Ayokab' junok tas skan t'a yib'anh sat lu'um tik yik spojan snanhal ha ha', xchi.
Icha chi' b'ian, ha Dios ixb’o’an jun chi'. Cha makan ix ajkanel ha ha' chi' yuj: Jun makan ha' ix kan t'a sat lum tik, junxo makan ha' ix k'ekan t'a yib'anh. Ichaton chi' ix aji.
Ha jun ix kan chi' “satcha’anh” ix sb'iejkani. Ix k'ik'b'ixiemi, ix sakb'ixi, ix ek' schab'il k'ual.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan Dios icha tik: Junxonhejokab' tz'aj ha ha' ay t'a yalanh satcha’anh yik scheklajkan lum lum t'a taquinhal, xchi. Ichaton chi' ix aji.
Ha b'aj ix cheklajkan stak'inhal chi', “luum” ix sb'iejkani, haxo ha ha' junnhej ix aj chi', “mar” ix sb'iejkan ha'. Axo ix yilan Dios chi', te wach' ix aji.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan icha tik: Pak'okab' anh ank'ultak t'a sat lum lum yet' te te' syak' sat. Ha t'a sat te' chi' yet' anh ank'ultak chi', ata' ay yinhatil ato syala' tas makanhil, xchi. Ichaton chi' ix aji.
Ichaton chi' ix aj spak' anh ank'ultak t'a sat lum lum tik, aton anh ank'ultak yet' te te' syak' sat ato syala' tas inhatil. Axo ix yilan Dios te wach' ix aji.
Ix k'ik'b'ixiemi ix sakb'ixi, ix ek' yoxil k'ual.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan Dios icha tik: Ayokab' juntzanh sakil k'inal t'a satcha’anh yik syak' sakil k'inal t'a sat lu'um tik, yik sch'oxanel k'ualil yet' t'ak'walil, yik scheklaj junjun k'u, junjun ab'il yet' juntzanh tiempoal, xchi. Ichaton chi' ix aji.

Ha Dios ixb’o’an chab' niwak sakil k'inal. Ha jun niwan sk'ak'al ix och yopisio t'a k'ualil, haxo jun quennhej sk'ak'al ix och yopisio t'ak'walil, aton k'u yet' k'een uj. Ix sb'oanpax masanil k'een k'anal.
Ix yak'anoch juntzanh sakil k'inal chi' t'a satcha’anh yik syak' yok t'a sat lu'um tik
t'a k'ualil yet' t'ak'walil yuj spojanpaxel sakil k'inal t'a k’ik’ k’inal. Ix yilan Dios chi' te wach' ix aji.
Ix k'ik'b'ixiemi, ix sakb'ixi, ix ek' schanhil k'ual.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalanxi Dios icha tik: Pitzwokab' nok' nok', nok' ay t'a yol ha ha' yet' masanil makanhil nok' much tzek' jenhenhok, xchi.
Ix sb'oan nok' niwak nok' Dios chi', nok' ay t'a yol ha' mar yet' masanil makanhil nok' nok' ay t'a yol ha' chi' yet' masanil makanhil nok' much. Axo ix yilani te wach' ix aji.

Ix yak'an swach'k'olal t'a yib'anh nok' nok' chi', ix yalan icha tik: Yune'ejokab' sb'a nok', q'uib'okab' sb'isul nok', b'ud'jokab'el yol ha' mar yuj nok'. Anhejtona' nok' much, q'uib'okab' sb'isul nok' t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, xchi.
Ix k'ik'b'ixiemi, ix sakb'ixi, ix ek' yoil k'ual.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan Dios icha tik: Pitzwokab' chaanh masanil makan nok' nok' t'a sat lu'um tik, nok' molb'etzal nok', nok' k'ultaquil nok' yet' nok' tzek' nhernhonok ma tzek' jachjon t'a sat lu'um, xchi. Ichaton chi' ix aji, ix sb'oan masanil makanhil nok' nok' ay t'a sat lu'um tik. Ix yilani, te wach' ix aji.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan Dios icha tik: Ha tiknaik ko b'oek anima icha onh tik yik wach' tz'och heb' yajalil t'a yib'anh nok' chay ay t'a yol ha' mar, t'a yib'anh masanil nok' much, t'a yib'anh nok' molb'etzal nok', t'a yib'anh nok' k'ultaquil nok' yet' pax t'a yib'anh nok' tzek' nhernhonok ma tzek' jachjon t'a sat lu'um tik, xchi.
Ichato chi' ix b'oji heb' anima chi' yuj Dios, icha wal Dios chi' ix aj heb'. Ix b'ojikan winh winak yet' ix ix yuj.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'an swach'k'olal Dios t'a yib'anh heb'. Ix yalan t'a heb' icha tik: Aljokab' eyuninal, q'uib'okab' he b'isul, b'ud'jokab'el sat lum lum tik eyuuj, ochanhek yajalil t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik. Ochanhec yajalil t'a yib'anh nok' chay ay t'a yoltak ha ha', t'a yib'anh nok' much sjenhwi yet' t'a yib'anh masanil nok' tzek' nhernhonok ma tzek' jachjon t'a sat lum tik, xchi.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalanxi t'a heb' anima chi' icha tik: Ha in swak' masanil makanhil anh ank'ultak ay yinhatil yet' masanil te te' syak' sat he lo'o yik syak' yip t'a he niwanil.

Masanil nok' molb'etzal nok', nok' k'ultaquil nok', nok' tzek' nhernhonok ma tzek' jachjon t'a sat lu'um yet' nok' much, a in swak' anh ank'ultak yet' xiltak te te' swaelok nok', xchi. Icha chi' ix aji.
Ix yilanoch Dios, te wach' ix aj masanil tas ix sb'o'o. Ix k'ik'b'ixiemi, ix sakb'ixi, ix ek' swaquil k'ual.
D'a waque' k'ual ix sb'o satcha’anh Dios, lum lum yet' masanil tastak ay t'ay. Axo t'a yuquil k'ual, ix och waan smunlaji.
Ix sik'anel jun yuquil k'ual chi' Dios, to yiknhej tz'ajkani, yik tz'ochkan swach'ilok heb' anima, yujto ha t'a jun k'u chi' ix b'oelk'och masanil tas ix sb'o chi'.
Aton yab'ixal tas ix aj sb'o satcha’anh yet' lum lum tik. Ayic ix sb'oan satcha’anh Jehová Dios yet' lum lum tik,
mantalaj junok te te' ma junok anh ank'ultak sq'uib'i, yujto mantalaj nhab' syak' t'a yib'anh lu'um yuj Jehová. Mantalaj pax mach smunlaj t'a sat lu'um.
Tonhej xob'ank'eul ha ha' t'a sat lu'um yik sch'ayxi lu'um.
Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', ix sb'o jun anima Jehová Dios. Ha spokokal lum lum ix yak'lab'ej sb'oani. Ixlajwi chi', haxo yik' ix spuoch t'a yol snhi'. Icha chi' ix aj spitzwi winh anima chi'.
Ix yawej juntzanh awb'en te' Jehová Dios t'a jun lugar skuch Edén, t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u. Ata' ix yak'kanoch winh winak ix sb'o chi'.

Ix yak'an q'uib' masanil te te' te wach' yilji, manhxo jantakok swach'il sat te' syak'a', te wach' sloji. Ha t'a snanhal jun awb'en te' chi', ay jun te' tz'ak'an k 'inal, ay pax junxo te' tz'ak'an nachajel b'aj ay wach'il yet' chukal.
Ha t'a Edén chi', sk'eul jun ha ha' tz'ak'anoch yal masanil te' awb'en te' chi'. Axo tz'el ha' t'a Edén chi', chanhe' tz'aj yel sk'ab' ha'.
Ha jun ha' b'ab'el, Pisón sb'i ha', aton ha' tzek' oyoyok t'a yol lum skuch Hawila b'aj ay k'een oro.
Ha k'een oro ay t'a jun lugar chi', te wach' k'een. Ay pax juntzanh te te' ay stzatajil te sumumi sjab'. Ay pax juntzanh k'een k'een skuchan ónike te karo stojol.
Axo ha' schab'il, Gihón sb'i ha'. Aton ha' tzek' oyoyok t'a yol lum skuchan Cus.
Axo ha' yoxil, Tigris sb'i ha'. Aton ha' tzek' oyoyok t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a lum Asiria. Axo ha' schanhil, aton ha' Éufrates.
Ix yak'ankan winh winak Jehová Dios t'a skal te' awb'en te' t'a Edén chi' yik smunlaj winh yik stanhwanpax winh.
Ix yalan Dios t'a winh icha tik: --Syal a lo'an sat te te' tik smasanil.
Axo pax te' tz'ak'an nachajel b'aj ay wach'il yet' chukal, manh a lo sat te'. Tato ol a lo sat te' chi', t'a wal yel ol ach chamok, xchi Dios t'a winh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová Dios icha tik: Manh wach'ok yajek' winh winak tik sch'okoj. Ol in b'o junok yetb'eyum winh to smoj wal skolwaj yet'ok, xchi.

Masanil nok' nok' ix sb'o Dios t'a sat lum tik, nok' k'ultaquil nok' yet' masanil nok' much, ix ik'jib'at nok' yuj Dios t'a winh winak chi' yik say sb'i junjun nok' winh. Ha sb'i junjun nok' ix say winh, aton ix sb'iejkan nok'.
Ix say sb'i masanil nok' winh, nok' k'ultaquil nok', nok' much yet' nok' molb'etzal nok'. Palta malaj junok nok' t'a skal nok' chi' tz'akan tz'aj skolwaj yet' winh.
Axo Dios ix ak'ankot jun niwan wayanh t'a winh. Ayic chamnak el winh sway chi', ix ik'jielta jun sb'aquil skostil winh yuj Dios. Ixlajwi chi' ix smakanxi b'aj ix yik'elta jun b'ak chi'.
Aton sb'aquil skostil winh chi' ix b'oji ixal yuj Dios. Ixlajwi chi', ix ak'jikanoch ix t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Adán chi' yuj Dios.
Axo yik ix yilanoch ix winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: --Aton wal jun tik wal yel in b'aquil, in b'ak'chil, yujto a t'ayin ix elta yuj Dios. Yuj chi' “Ix” ol sb'iejkani, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' a winh winak, ol yaktejkan smam snun winh yik junxonhej tz'ajkan winh yet' ix yetb'eyum, junxonhej niwanil tz'ajkan heb' schawanhil.
Malaj spichul heb' schawanhil, palta max q'uixwilaj heb' t'ay junjun.

Ha nok' chan, yelxo wal te jelan nok' t'a yichanh masanil nok' k'ultaquil nok' ix sb'o Jehová Dios. Ix yalan nok' t'a ix ix: --¿Tom yel ix yal Dios to max yal he loan sat masanil te' awb'en te' tik? xchi nok'.
Ix tak'wi ix t'a nok' icha tik: --Masanil te' syal ko loan sat,
anhej jun te' ay t'a snanhal te' awb'en te' tik, ix yal Dios to max yal-laj ko loan sat te', ma ko yamani, yik wach' max onh chami, xchi ix.
Ix tak'wi nok' chan chi' t'a ix: --Tonhej syal Dios chi'. Manh ol ex chamlaj.
Palta yojtak Dios, ayik ol he loan sat te' chi', ol tz'akwok he pensar, lajan ol ex ajkan yet'ok, ol nachajel wach'il yet' chukal eyuuj, xchi nok' t'a ix.

Axo ix yilanoch sat te' chi' ix, te wach' am sloji, te wach' yiljiochi, ix snib'anoch ix, yik wach' stz'akwiel spensar ix snaani. Yuj chi' ix sb'ixanelta jun sat te' chi' ix, ix sloan ix. Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'anpax ix t'a winh yetb'eyum chi', ix sloanpax te' winh yet' ix.
Ha t'a jun rato chi', ix nachajel yuj heb', ix yilanoch sb'a heb' to b'eranel heb', yuj chi' a xil te' higo ix smol heb', ix stz'isan heb' spichulok, yik tz'och t'a snanhal heb'.
Axo ix yab'an winh winak chi' yet' ix ix chi' to wan yek' Jehová Dios t'a skal te awb'en te' chi' t'a yemxok'ualil, yik sikxo k'u, ix el lemnaj heb' sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'ay t'a skal te awb'en te' chi'.
Axo ix awtaj winh yuj Jehová Dios: --Ach Adán, ¿b'ajtil ayach eq'ui? xchi.
Ix tak'wi winh: --Ina wajek' tik, ix wab'i to wan ek' t'a skal te' awb'en te' tik, ix in xiwb'ati yujto b'eran in eli, yuj chi' ix in k'ub'ejel in b'a, xchi winh.
Ix sk'anb'an Dios t'a winh: --¿Mach ix alan t'ayach to b'eran ach eli? Tope ix a lo sat te te', te' ix wal t'ayach to max yal-laj a loani, xchi t'a winh.
Ix tak'wixi winh icha tik: --Ha ix ix, ix ak' wetb'eyumok, a ix, ix ak'an te' t'ayin, yuj chi' ix in lo te', xchi winh.
Ix sk'anb'an Dios t'a ix: --¿Tas yuj icha chi' ix a k'ulej? xchi. Ix tak'wi ix: --Ha nok' chan in ak'an musansatil, yuj chi' ix in lo te', xchi ix.

Yuj chi' ix yalan Jehová Dios t'a nok' chan chi': --Yujto icha tik ix a k'ulej, yuj chi' tzach in katab'ejkan t'a skal masanil nok' molb'etzal nok' yet' nok' k'ultaquil nok'. D'a junelnhej a yalanh a k'ool ol nherwok. Ha spokokal lum lum ol a lo'o.
Ol wak'kanoch ajk'olal t'a a kal yet' ix ix tik yet' masanil inhtilal yet' pax yinhtilal ix. Ha yinhtilal ix chi' ol mak'anpoj a jolom. Ha ach xo, ol a chi yich yok yinhtilal ix chi', xchi Jehová.

Ix yalanxi Dios t'a ix icha tik: --Ol wak' a yaelal ayik yab'ix ach, haxo yik ol aljok une', ol wak'an niwtaj a yaelal chi'. Wach'chom ay yaelal ol ila', ol a nib'ejnhejoch winh etb'eyum. Ha winh ol och ajalok, xchi Dios.

Ix yalanpax Jehová Dios t'a winhaj Adán chi' icha tik: --Yujto ix a k'anab'ajej ix etb'eyum tik a loan sat te te' ix wala' to max a lo'o, a tiknaik jun, uuj tzin katab'ejkan lum lum tik, yuj chi' t'a skal yaelal ol ach waok yakb'an ayach ek' t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik.
Ol q'uib'chaanh te' q'uiix yet' anh ank'ultak ay sq'uixal t'a sat lum lum tik. Ha yuj juntzanh awal inhat ol ik'an yek' tiempo eyuuj.
Ol el alil a munlaji, icha chi' ol aj a wa'i masanto ol ach meltzajxok och luumal. Yujto t'a lum ix ach koti, lum ach taxoni, yuj chi' ol ach meltzajxok och luumal, xchi Jehová t'a winh.
Ewa ix yak' winhaj Adán sb'iok ix yetb'eyum chi', yujto t'a ix, ix pitzwi masanil anima.
Ha stz'umal nok' nok' ix sb'o Jehová Dios spichulok winh winak yet' ix yetb'eyum, ix yak'anoch spichulok heb'.

Ix yalan Jehová Dios: Ha tiknaik, icha onh tik, icha chi' ix aj heb' anima. Tzaxo nachajel yuj heb' b'aj ay wach'il yet' chukal. Yuj chi' ay smay sloan sat te te' heb', aton te' tz'ak'an k 'inal yik pitzannhej heb' t'a masanil tiempo, xchi Dios.
Yuj chi' ix pechjielta heb' t'a Edén chi' yuj Jehová, ix ochkan winhaj Adán chi' smunlaj t'a sat lu'um b'aj ix kot sniwanil.

Ixlajwi yelkankot heb', ix ak'jikanoch juntzanh querubín yuj Jehová t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u yet' jun k'een espada tz'ititi yel sk'ak'al yek' oyoyok, yik manhxa junok mach syal yochi yik sloan sat te te' tz'ak'an k 'inal chi'.
Ix yil-lan sb'a winhaj Adán yet' ix Ewa, ix och ix yab'ixal. Ix alji jun yune' ix, ix yak'an ix skuch Caín. Axo ix yalan ix: Toxo ix ja jun in winak unin yujto a Jehová ix och wed'ok, xchi ix.
Ixlajwi chi', ix aljipax winhaj Abel yuk'tak winhaj Caín. Ha winhaj Abel chi', moloj kalnel ix sk'ulej winh, haxo pax winhaj Caín chi', ix munlaj winh t'a sat lum lum.
Ix ek' junok tiempoal, ay jun k'u ix yik'b'at silab' winhaj Caín t'a Jehová, aton tas ix yik' winh t'a smunlajel.
Ix yik'anpaxb'at silab' winhaj Abel chi' t'a yichanh Jehová, aton nok' b'ab'el yune' kalnel, nok' te b'ak'uech. Ix stzalaj Jehová yet' winh yet' silab' ix yak' chi'.
Palta maj tzalajlaj Jehová yet' winhaj Caín yet' pax silab'. Yuj chi', ix te chichon sk'ol winh, te ow ix aj sat winh.
Axo ix yalan Jehová t'a winh icha tik: ¿Tas yuj ste chichon a k'ool, te owxonhej a sat?

Tato wach' tza k'ulej, tzalajk'olal am ayach eq'ui, palta to chuk ix a k'ulej, yuj chi' a a chukal chi', ayxonhejoch t'a ib'anh yik tzach em t'a chukal yuj, palta tzato yal skan chukal chi' t'a yalanh uuj, xchi Dios.
Ay jun k'u, a winhaj Caín ix awtan winhaj Abel yik sb'at heb' b'eyelek'. Ayic ayek' heb' b'aj ix k'och chi', ix b'at juknaj winhaj Caín t'a winh yuk'tak chi', ix smak'anchamok.
Ixlajwi chi', ix sk'anb'an Jehová t'a winhaj Caín chi': --¿B'ajtil ay winh uk'tak aj Abel? xchi t'a winh. Axo ix tak'wi winh: --Manh wojtakoklaj. ¿Tom yilumal winh waji? xchi winh.
Ix yalanpax Jehová t'a winh: --¿Tas yuj icha chi' ix a k'ulej? Ha schiq'uil winh uk'tak ix em t'a sat lum tik uuj, ichato syal sb'a t'ayin to tzin b'o yaj ed'ok.
Ha tiknaik, katab'il achxo, swik'kanel opisio t'a sat lum lum tik, aton lum ix uk'anem schiq'uil winh uk'tak ix a mak'cham chi'.
Ayic ol ach munlaj t'a sat lu'um, malaj jab'ok tas ol ik'a', tonhej ol ixtej a b'a, tonhej ol ach komon b'eyek' t'a sat lu'um, xchi Dios t'a winh.
Ix tak'wi winh icha tik: --Te niwan jun yaelal skotkan tik t'a wib'anh, manh ol techajlaj wuuj.
Ina ix ik'el wopisio t'a sat lum tik, ix in ik'anel t'a ichanh t'a junelnhej, toxonhej ol in komon b'eyek'ok. Yalxonhej mach ol in chalaj in b'a yet'ok, ol in smak'chamok, xchi winh d'ha Dios.

Axo ix tak'wi Jehová: --Maay. Tato ay junok mach ol ach mak'anchamok, a jun chi', uquel ol ek' spak t'ay, xchi t'a winh. Ix yak'anoch Jehová jun yechel winhaj Caín chi', yik wach' tato ay mach schalaj sb'a winh yet'ok, max mak'jicham winh yuj.
Ixlajwi chi', ix el winhaj Caín b'aj ix lolon heb' chi', ix b'at kajnaj winh t'a jun lugar skuch Nod, t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a Edén.
Ix yil-lan sb'a winhaj Caín yet' ix yetb'eyum, ix och ix yab'ixal. Ix alji jun yune' ix, Enoc ix sb'iej. Ix sb'oan jun chonhab' winhaj Caín chi', haxo sb'i yuninal winh chi' ix yak'och sb'iok.
Ha winhaj Enoc smam winhaj Irad. Axo winhaj Irad smam winhaj Mehujael, haxo winhaj Mehujael smam winhaj Metusael, haxo winhaj Metusael smam winhaj Lamec.
Ha winhaj Lamec chi', chawanh ix aj yetb'eyum winh. Ay jun ix skuch Ada, haxo junxo ix skuch Zila.
Ha ix Ada chi', ix alji jun swinak unin ix, Jabal ix sb'iej. Aton winh ix b'ab'laj b'eyek' yet' spat mantiado yik smolan nok' snok'.
Ha winhaj Jabal chi', ay jun yuk'tak winh skuchan Jubal. Ha winh ix b'ab'laj ak'an te' arpa yet' spu'an flauta.
Axo ix Zila chi', ix aljipax jun yune' ix, winak unin, Tubal-kaín ix sb'iej. B'oum k'een ix aj winh. Ay tas ix sb'o winh t'a k'een bronke yet' t'a k'een hierro. Ay jun ix yanab' winh skuchan Naama.
Ay junel ix yal winhaj Lamec t'a heb' ix yetb'eyum icha tik: Ex wetb'eyum, ach Ada yet' ach Zila, ab'ek tas ol wala': Ix in mak'cham jun winh quelem, yujto in lajwi smak'an winh.
Tato uquel spaktzitaj yik winhaj Caín, ok in xom a in tik, 77-el ol paktzitaj t'a heb' tzin tzuntzani, xchi winh.

Axo winhaj Adán ix alji junxo yuninal winh yet' ix Ewa. Set ix sb'iej yuj ix snun chi'. Ix yalan ix icha tik: Ha Dios ix ak'an junxo wune' tik sk'exulok winhaj Abel mak'b'ilcham yuj winhaj Caín, xchi ix.
Axo winhaj Set chi', ix alji jun yuninal winh, Enós ix yak' winh sb'iok. Atax t'a jun pekti’ chi', ix schael yich yalan sb'a heb' anima t'a Jehová.
Aton yab'ixal heb' yinhtilal winhaj Adán tik t'a stzolal. Ayic ix b'oji heb' anima yuj Dios, icha Dios ix aj heb'.
Ix b'oji winh winak yet' pax ix ix, ix yak'anpax swach'k'olal t'a yib'anh heb'. Atax t'a jun k'u chi' ayik ix b'ojiel heb' yuj, anima ix sb'iejkan heb' yuj.
Ha winhaj Adán chi', 130 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix alji junxo yuninal winh skuchan Set, lajan ix aj yet' smam chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', 800 ab'ilto ix yil winhaj Adán chi'. Ayto yuninal winh yet' yisil winh ix alji.
930 ab'il ix yil winh, ix cham winh b'ian.
Ha winhaj Set chi', 105 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix alji jun yuninal winh skuchan Enós.
Ixlajwi chi', 807 ab'ilto ix yil winh, ayto yuninal winh yet' yisil winh ix alji.
912 ab'il ix yil winh, ix cham winh b'ian.
Ha winhaj Enós chi', 90 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix alji jun yuninal winh skuchan Cainán.
Ixlajwi chi', 815 ab'ilto ix yil winh, ayto yuninal winh yet' yisil winh ix alji.
905 ab'il ix yil winh, ix cham winh b'ian.
Ha winhaj Cainán chi', 70 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix alji jun yuninal winh skuchan Mahalalel.
Ixlajwi chi', 840 ab'ilto ix yil winh, ayto yuninal winh yet' yisil winh ix alji.
910 ab'il ix yil winh, ix cham winh b'ian.
Ha winhaj Mahalalel chi', 65 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix alji jun yuninal winh skuchan Jared.
Ixlajwi chi', 830 ab'ilto ix yil winh, ayto yuninal winh yet' yisil winh ix alji.
895 ab'il ix yil winh, ix cham winh b'ian.
Ha winhaj Jared chi', 162 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix alji jun yuninal winh skuchan Enoc.
Ixlajwi chi', 800 ab'ilto ix yil winh, ayto yuninal winh yet' yisil winh ix alji.
962 ab'il ix yil winh, ix cham winh b'ian.
Ha winhaj Enoc chi', 65 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix alji jun yuninal winh skuchan Matusalén.
Yictax ix alji yuninal winh chi', 300 ab'il ix sk'anab'ajej Dios winh. D'a jun pekti’ chi', ayto yuninal winh yet' yisil winh ix alji.
365 ab'il ix yil winh.
Ix sb'eyb'alej wal winh icha snib'ej Dios, yuj chi' ay jun k'u ix satem winh, yujto ha Dios ix ik'anb'at winh yet'ok.
Ha winhaj Matusalén chi', 187 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix alji jun yuninal winh skuchan Lamec.
Ixlajwi chi' 782 ab'ilto ix yil winh, ayto yuninal winh yet' yisil winh ix alji.
969 ab'il ix yil winh, ix cham winh b'ian.
Ha winhaj Lamec chi', 182 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix alji jun yuninal winh.
Noé ix sb'iej yuj winh yujto ix yal winh: Ha Jehová ix katab'an lum lum tik, yuj chi' te ya ko munlaj t'a sat lu'um, palta a winh unin tik ol ak'an sniwanil ko k'ool, xchi winhaj Lamec chi'.
Ayic toxo ix alji winhaj Noé chi', 595 ab'ilto ix yil winhaj Lamec chi', ayto yuninal winh yet' yisil winh ix alji.
777 ab'il ix yil winh, ix cham winh b'ian.
Ha winhaj Noé chi', 500 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix syamanoch yalji heb' yuninal winh, aton winhaj Sem, winhaj Cam yet' winhaj Jafet.
Ayic ix te q'uib' sb'isul heb' anima t'a sat lu'um tik, ay pax yisil heb' winh winak ix alji.
Axo heb' winh yuninal Dios, ayik ix yilan heb' ix yisil heb' anima chi' heb' winh, te wach' yilji heb' ix, ix laj sik'lan heb' winh machtak heb' ix syik' heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix yal Jehová: Manhxo ol wak' sk'inal heb' anima tik yuj spital. Chamelb'a anima yaj heb', yuj chi' axonhej 120 ab'il olto ek' heb' t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, xchi.
Ayic ix b'eykot tiempo, ix yik'lan sb'a heb' winh yuninal Dios yet' heb' ix yisil heb' anima chi', haxo yuninal heb' skuch Nefilim. Ha heb' chi' te tek'an heb', te b'inajnak heb' t'a pekatax chi'.
Ix yilan Jehová to yelk'olal sq'uib' schukal heb' anima t'a sat lu'um tik, to axonhej tas malaj swach'il ayek' t'a spensar heb'.
Yuj chi' ix yala': Octom maj in b'olaj juntzanh anima tik. Te ya swab' yuj heb'.

Ol in satel juntzanh anima ix in b'o t'a sat lu'um tik yet' pax nok' molb'etzal nok', nok' k'ultaquil nok' yet' nok' tzek' nhernhonok ma tzek' jachjon t'a sat lu'um yet' pax nok' much. Ste tak wal in k'ool yujto ix in b'o masanil juntzanh tik, xchi Dios.
Anhej wal winhaj Noé wach' t'a yichanh Jehová.

Aton yab'ixal winhaj Noé tik: Ha winhaj Noé chi', te wach' ix yutej sb'a winh t'a yichanh Dios, anhej winh wach' spensar t'a skal heb' anima t'a jun pekti’ chi'. Ix sb'eyb'alej winh icha snib'ej Dios.
Ay oxwanh yuninal winh, aton winhaj Sem, winhaj Cam yet' winhaj Jafet.
Axo heb' anima, ix te chukb'i heb' t'a yichanh Dios, komonxonhej syixtej yetanimail heb', smil-lajcham sb'a heb'.
Ix yilan Dios to masanil anima ix te juwieli, axonhej ixtoj anima sk'ulej heb'.
Yuj chi' ix yal Dios t'a winhaj Noé chi': Toxo ix in na' to ol in satel masanil anima tik. Yujto axonhej ixtoj anima sk'ulej heb', yuj chi' ol in satel heb' yet' masanil yol yib'anhk’inal tik.

Ha tiknaik, tza b'o junok te' niwan barko. Ha te te' ay stzatajil, a te' tzak'och ste'alok te'. Macquiltac tzutej yool te', wach' tzutej ak'anoch tzataj chi' b'aj snub'laj sb'a te'. Tzak'och t'a spatik yet' t'a yool, yik wach' malaj b'aj ol och ha' t'a yol te'.
135 metro tzutej sk'atul te', 22 metro yet' nanhalxo tzutej sat te', 13 metro yet' nanhalxo steel te'.
Oxe' piso tzutej te'. Axo t'a sjajk'ek'och te', ata' skan jakan smasanil, nanhal metro tz'ajkan schaanhil, skanpax junok spuertail t'a junok pak'anh.
Yujto ol wak'kot jun owal ha' yik smukan sat lu'um tik, ol b'ud'jokkanel yuj ha', haxo satel jantak tas syik' yik' t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik.
Anhej ed'ok tzin b'okan jun in trato tik. Ha t'a yol te' niwan barko chi' ol ach ochkan yet' ix etb'eyum, heb' uninal yet' pax heb' ix alib'.
Ol ochpax nok' nok' eyed'ok, junjun mojanh nok' t'a junjun makan ay t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, yik wach' ol kolchajkan nok' eyed'ok.
Chatacwanh nok' t'a junjun makan tz'ochkani: Nok' much, nok' molb'etzal nok', nok' k'ultaquil nok' yet' nok' tzek' nhernhonok ma tzek' jachjon t'a sat lu'um, yik wach' manh ol satel nok'.
Ol a molankanoch jantak tas ol wajok, yik wach' ay tas tze wa yet' tas swa nok', xchi Dios t'a winhaj Noé chi'.
Ix sk'anab'ajan winhaj Noé chi' masanil tas ix yal Dios.

Axo yik ix k'och sk'ual sjawi jun owal ha' mukwajum chi', ix yalan Jehová Dios t'a winhaj Noé chi' icha tik: Ochanh t'a yol te' niwan barko tik yet' ix etb'eyum, heb' uninal yet' heb' ix alib', yujto a achnhej ix a k'anab'ajej t'ayin t'a skal masanil heb' anima t'a jun pekti’ tik.
Ik'och uk mojanhok nok' nok' syal yoch silab'ok snhuschaji, haxo pax masanil nok' komon nok', junjunnhej mojanh nok' tz'ochi.
Ik'paxoch uk mojanhok junjun makan nok' much, yik wach' max lajwiel yinhtilal nok'.
Yic wal ukub'ix tiknaik, ol wak'em nhab'. Chawinac k'u, chawinak ak'wal ol yak'a'. Icha chi' ol aj in satanel masanil tas ix wak' pitzwok t'a sat lum tik, xchi Jehová t'a winh.
Ichaton chi' ix aj sk'anab'ajan winhaj Noé masanil tas ix yal Jehová chi' t'ay.
Ayic ix ja jun owal ha' mukwajum chi', 600 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Noé chi'.
Ix ochkan winh t'a yol te' niwan barko chi' yet' ix yetb'eyum, heb' yuninal yet' heb' ix yalib', yik skolchaj heb' t'a jun owal ha' mukwajum chi'.
Ix ochpax nok' nok': Nok' syal yoch silab'il snhusji, nok' komon nok', nok' much yet' nok' tzek' nhernhonok ma tzek' jachjon t'a sat lu'um.
Junjun mojanh ix aj sjawi nok' yik tz'och nok' t'a yol barko chi' yet' winh, icha ix aj yalan Dios t'a winh.
Axo t'a yuquil k'ual chi' ix jawi seknaj jun owal ha' mukwajum chi' t'a sat lu'um.
Ha wal stz'akwi 600 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Noé chi', yik 17 yoch schab'il ujal, ix k'eul d'inhnaj ha' niwak ha' t'a yol lu'um, ix kotpax seknaj ha' niwak ha' t'a satcha’anh.
40 k'ual, 40 ak'wal ix yak' nhab' t'a sat lu'um tik.

Ha t'a sk'ual skot nhab' chi', ata' ochnakkan winhaj Noé t'a yol te' barko yet' oxwanh heb' yuninal winh, aton winhaj Sem, winhaj Cam yet' winhaj Jafet yet' ix yetb'eyum winh yet' oxwanh heb' ix yalib' winh.
Ayxo och masanil makanhil nok' nok' yet' winh, nok' molb'etzal nok', nok' k'ultaquil nok', nok' tzek' nhernhonok ma tzek' jachjon t'a sat lu'um yet' pax nok' much.
Masanil nok' nok' syik' yik', chatakwanhil ix aj sjawi nok' t'a winhaj Noé chi' yik tz'ochkan nok' t'a yol te' barko chi',
jun nok' smam, jun nok' snun. Icha chi' ix aj yoch masanil makanhil nok', icha ix aj yalan Dios t'a winhaj Noé chi'. Ixlajwi chi', a wal Jehová ix makankan spuertail te' niwan barko chi'.
Chawinac k'ualxo sk'e sib'ib'ok ha ha' chi', ix kuchjichanh te' barko chi' yuj ha'.
Ix mukchaj jantak niwak witz yuj ha'.
Ix k'enhej ha', ay am uqueok metro ix ek' ha' t'a yib'anh lum niwak witz.

Ichaton chi' ix aj scham masanil anima ay t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik yet' masanil nok' nok', nok' much, nok' molb'etzal nok', nok' k'ultaquil nok' yet' nok' tzek' nhernhonok ma tzek' jachjon t'a sat lu'um.
Masanil tastak syik' yik' t'a sat lu'um tik, pilan ix chameli.
Axonhej winhaj Noé yet' heb' ayoch yet' t'a yol te' barko chi' yet' nok' nok' ix kolchaji. Axo anima smasanil, ix satel heb'.
Oye' ujal ix kan panhan ha' t'a yib'anh lu'um.
Yujto naan winhaj Noé chi' yuj Dios yet' masanil nok' nok' ayoch yet' winh t'a yol te' barko chi', yuj chi' ix ak'jikot jun ik' te ow yuj Dios t'a yib'anh ha ha' chi', yik wach' stupem ha'.
Ix makchaj masanil sjaj ha ha', ha' sk'eul t'a yol lu'um yet' jantak ha' niwak ha' skot sequekok t'a satcha’anh. Ix och waan yak'an nhab'.
Oye' ujal ix kan ha', ix och ijan stupxiem ha', k'ojank'olal ix tupem ha'.
17 k'ualxo yoch yuquil uj, ix kan b'akhnaj te niwan barko chi' t'a sjolom jun lum witz t'a yol yik Ararat.
Numumi yem ha ha' chi'. Ha t'a b'ab'el k'ual yik lajunhexo ujal, chequelxo sjolom lum niwak witz.
Axo yik ix ek' 40 k'ualxo, ix sjakan te' wentena winhaj Noé b'ob'il yuj t'a te' barko chi'.
Ix yaktanelta jun nok' joj winh, ix ek' jenhenhok nok' stanhwan stupem ha' t'a sat lu'um.
Ix yaktanpaxelta jun nok' uch winh yik syil nok' tato taquinhxo sat lu'um.

Axo nok' uch chi', ix k'ochxi nok' t'a te' barko chi', yujto malaj b'aj syal skan waan nok'. Te sib'anto ek' ha' t'a sat lu'um chi'. Ix yak'anelta sk'ab' winh yik schaanxioch nok' winh t'a yol te' barko chi'.
Ixto stanhwej uquexo k'ual winhaj Noé chi', ix yak'anelta nok' uch chi' winh junelxo.
Numumixo sq'uik'b'i ix k'ochxi nok', nhak'b'ilxo jun te' xil oliwo yaxxo yuj nok'. Icha chi' ix aj yojtakanel winh to wan stakji sat lu'um.
Uqueto k'u ix stanhwej winh, ichato chi' ix sjakanelta nok' winh junelxo, palta majxo k'ochxoklaj nok'.
601 ab'ilxo sk'inal winhaj Noé chi', ayik ix takjixi lum lum chi'. Ayic b'ab'el k'u yoch b'ab'el uj ix yik'anel yib'anh te' barko chi' winh, haxo ix yilan winh to taquinhxo lu'um.
Axo t'a 27-xo k'ual yoch yik schab'il ujal, te taquinhxo lu'um.
Axo ix yalan Dios t'a winh:
Elanhcot t'a yol te' barko yet' ix etb'eyum yet' heb' uninal yet' heb' ix alib'.

Tzik'anelta masanil makanhil nok' nok' ayoch ed'ok: Nok' much, nok' molb'etzal nok', nok' k'ultaquil nok', nok' tzek' nhernhonok ma tzek' jachjon t'a sat lu'um. Unewokab' nok' yik sb'ud'jixi sat lu'um tik yuj nok', xchi Dios.
Ixlajwi chi', ix elta winhaj Noé chi' yet' ix yetb'eyum yet' heb' yuninal yet' heb' ix yalib' t'a yol te' barko chi'.
Ix elixta nok' nok' chi' smasanil t'a junjun makan.

Ixlajwi chi', ix sb'oan jun altar winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Ix yik'ankot nok' molb'etzal nok' winh yet' nok' much, aton nok' smoj yoch silab'il d'ha Dios. D'a junjun makan nok' chi' ix yik'kanel junjun nok' winh snhustz'a silab'ok t'a yichanh Jehová.

Te wach' sjab' nok' silab' chi' ix yab' Jehová. Yuj chi' ix yalan icha tik: Manhxo ol in katab'ej lum lum tik yuj smul heb' anima, yujto yiktax unin anima heb', anhej chukal snib'ej heb' sk'ulej. Manhxa b'ak'uinh ol in satel masanil tas pitzan, icha ix wutej t'a junel tik.

Yakb'an ayto ek' yol yib'anhk’inal tik, ol awchaj sat awal inhat, ol molchajpax sat. Ay stiempoal k'ak', ay stiempoal siik. Ay stiempoal nhab'il k 'inal, ay stiempoal waresma. Ay k'ualil, ay pax t'ak'walil, xchi Jehová.
Ix lolon Dios t'a winhaj Noé yet' t'a heb' yuninal winh, ix yalani to ol yak' syaxil t'a yib'anh heb'. Ix yalan icha tik: Tzijtumokab' eyuninal tz'alji, b'ud'jokab' yol yib'anhk’inal tik yuj heb'.
Masanil nok' nok' ay t'a sat lu'um tik yet' nok' much yet' nok' ay t'a yol ha' mar ol xiw nok' t'ayex. Masanil juntzanh nok' tik skan nok' t'a yol he k'ab'.
Ha tiknaik syal he chi'an masanil nok' nok' tik. Ha in swak' nok' t'ayex icha ix aj wak'an anh itaj he chi'a.
Palta ay jun tas manh ol yal-laj he chi'ani, aton nok' chib'ej syuk' schiq'uil, yujto ha t'a schiq'uil nok' chi' ay sk'inal.
Ha in ol in ch'olb'itej heb' anima smilancham junok yetanimail. Ha nok' nok' smilancham anima, ol miljokpaxcham nok'.
Ha mach smilancham yetanimail, anima pax ol milanchamok, yujto a ex anima ex tik, icha onh tik, icha chi' ex kutej ko b'oani.
Tzijtumokab' eyuninal tz'alji, b'ud'jokab'el yol yib'anhk’inal tik eyuuj, xchi Dios.
Ix yalanpax Dios t'a winhaj Noé yet' t'a heb' yuninal icha tik:
Ha tiknaik, swak'kan jun in trato tik eyed'ok yet' masanil heb' eyinhtilal,
yet' masanil nok' nok' ix elta eyed'ok t'a yol te' barko tik: Nok' much, nok' molb'etzal nok', nok' k'ultaquil nok' yet' masanil nok' nok' ay t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik.

Ha jun in trato ol wak' eyed'ok tik, manhxo ol in k'exa'. Manhxo ol in satel anima yet' nok' nok' yuj junok owal ha' mukwajum. Manhxo ol jax jun owal ha' mukwajum yik satxiel sat lu'um tik, icha jun ix ek' tik.
Aton yechel in trato tik swak'kan eyed'ok yet' masanil nok' nok' t'a masanil k 'inal.
Swak'och jun chakpan t'a kal asun, a jun chi', aton yechel in trato yet' yol yib'anhk’inal tik.
Ayic swak'ankot asun haxo scheklaj jun chakpan chi' t'a skal,
ata' tzin nakot in trato ix wak' eyed'ok yet' nok' nok', yuj chi' manhxo ol ex in satel yuj junok owal ha' mukwajum.
Ayic swilan jun chakpan chi', tzin naankoti to ay jun in trato ix wak' t'a junelnhej eyed'ok yet' masanil nok' nok' ay t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik.
Aton yechel in trato tik ix in b'o eyed'ok yet' jantak nok' nok', xchi Dios t'a winhaj Noé chi'.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Noé ix elta t'a yol te' barko yet'ok: Aton winhaj Sem, winhaj Cam yet' winhaj Jafet. Ay jun yuninal winhaj Cam chi' skuchan Canaán.
Ha heb' tik yuninal heb' winhaj Noé, haxo t'a yinhtilal heb' ix pitzwielta jantak chonhab' ay t'a sat lu'um tik.
Ha winhaj Noé ix munlaj winh t'a sat lu'um. Ha te' uwa ix sb'ab'laj awej winh.
Ay jun k'u ix yuk' yal sat te' uwa chi' winh, ix k'e t'a sjolom winh, ix satel sk'ool winh yuj. Ix squichel spichul winh, ix kan pak'jab' winh t'a yol smantiado.
Axo ix yilan winhaj Cam, smam winhaj Canaán to b'eranel winhaj Noé chi', wan stzetzan winh smam winh chi' ayik ix yalan winh yab' heb' yuk'tak chi' schawanhil.

Ayic ix yab'an heb' yuk'tak winh chi', ix yak'ankot jun k'apak sábana heb' t'a sjolom sjenhjab'. Ix b'eyb'at heb' t'a spatik, ix ochk'och heb' b'aj ay smam chi', ix spichan winh heb' t'a k'apak sábana chi'. Ch'ok b'aj k'elanb'at heb' yik wach' max yil sniwanil smam heb' chi'.
Axo yik ix nachajxi sk'ol winhaj Noé chi', ix yab'an winh tas ix yutej sb'a winhaj Cam chi', aton winh schab'il yuninal.
Yuj chi' ix yalan winh icha tik: Tzin katab'ejkan winhaj Canaán. Chekab' emnaquil ol ajkan winh t'a heb' yuk'tak, xchi winh.
Ix yalanxi winh icha tik: Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová ko Diosal t'a yib'anh winhaj Sem, haxo winhaj Canaán tz'ochkan schekab'ok winh.
Niwanokab' tz'ajkan slum winhaj Jafet yuj Dios. Cajnajokab' Dios t'a skal yinhtilal winhaj Sem, haxo winhaj Canaán tz'ochkan schekab'ok winhaj Jafet chi', xchi winh.
Ayic ix lajwi yek' jun owal ha' mukwajum chi', 350 ab'ilto ix ek' winhaj Noé chi',
yuj chi' 950 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix cham winh.
Ha yab'ixal heb' yinhtilal winhaj Noé tik: Aton winhaj Sem, winhaj Cam yet' winhaj Jafet. Ayic ix lajwi yek' jun owal ha' mukwajum chi', ix laj alji yuninal heb'.
Ha sb'i heb' yuninal winhaj Jafet: Aton winhaj Gomer, winhaj Magog, winhaj Madai, winhaj Javán, winhaj Tubal, winhaj Mesec yet' winhaj Tiras.
Ha sb'i heb' yuninal winhaj Gomer: Aton winhaj Askenaz, winhaj Rifat yet' winhaj Togarma.
Ha sb'i heb' yuninal winhaj Javán: Aton winhaj Elisa, winhaj Tarsis, winhaj Quitim yet' winhaj Dodanim.
Aton heb' tik yinhtilal winhaj Jafet. Ix kajnaj heb' t'a stitak ha' mar, junjun makan yinhtilal heb' yet' smakb'en yet' sti' syala'.
Ha sb'i heb' yuninal winhaj Cam: Aton winhaj Cus, winhaj Mizraim, winhaj Fut yet' winhaj Canaán.
Ha sb'i heb' yuninal winhaj Cus: Aton winhaj Seba, winhaj Hawila, winhaj Sabta, winhaj Raama yet' winhaj Sabteca. Ha sb'i heb' yuninal winhaj Raama: Aton winhaj Seba yet' winhaj Dedán.
Ha winhaj Cus ay yuninal winhaj Nimrod. Ha winhaj Nimrod chi' b'ab'el ix och yajalil t'a skal heb' chonhab'.
Te julum nok' winh t'a yichanh Jehová, yuj chi' ay jun lolonel t'a skal heb' anima tz'alan icha tik: Lajan winh icha winhaj Nimrod, winh te julum nok' t'a yol sat Jehová, xchi jun lolonel chi'.
Ha t'a sb'ab'elal, yajal yaj winhaj Nimrod t'a yib'anh Babel, Erec, Acad yet' Calne. Ha t'a yol smakb'en Sinar ata' ay juntzanh chonhab' chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winh t'a Asiria. Ata' ix sb'o chanhexo niwak chonhab' winh: Aton chonhab' Níniwe, Rehobot, Cala
yet' Resén, aton jun chonhab' ay t'a skal Níniwe yet' Cala. Ha chanhe' chonhab' chi', junxonhej niwan chonhab'il ix aji.
Axo t'a winhaj Mizraim ix kot heb' Ludim, heb' Anamim, heb' Lehabim, heb' Naftuhim,
heb' Patrusim, heb' Casluhim yet' heb' Caftorim. Ha t'a heb' chi' ix kot heb' filisteo.
Ha winhaj Canaán smam winhaj Sidón yet' winhaj Het. Ha winhaj Sidón chi', b'ab'el unin winh.
Ha winhaj Canaán chi' smam icham heb' jebuseo, heb' amorreo, heb' gergeseo,
heb' heweo, heb' arakeo, heb' sineo,
heb' arwadeo, heb' zemareo, heb' amateo. Ayic ix b'ey tiempo ix saklemkanb'at heb' kananeo chi'.

Ha sluum heb', tzato k'och t'a smojonal Sidón masanto t'a stojolal Gerar, masanto t'a Gaza. Skumlajxib'at lu'um t'a yol smakb'en chonhab' Sodoma, Gomorra, Adma yet' Zeboim masanto sk'och lum t'a chonhab' Lasa.
Ata' ix kajnaj heb' yinhtilal winhaj Cam, junjun makan yinhtilal heb' t'a yol smakb'en yet' sti' syala'.
Axo pax winhaj Sem, winh b'ab'el winak t'a winhaj Jafet, ay pax yuninal winh. Ha onh masanil onh tik, yinhtilal onh winhaj Heber, kotnak onh t'a yinhtilal winhaj Sem.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Sem chi', aton winhaj Elam, winhaj Asur, winhaj Arfaxad, winhaj Lud yet' winhaj Aram.
Axo heb' yuninal winhaj Aram, aton winhaj Uz, winhaj Hul, winhaj Geter yet' winhaj Mas.
Ha winhaj Arfaxad ay yuninal winhaj Sala, haxo winhaj Sala chi' ay yuninal winhaj Heber.
Axo winhaj Heber chi', chawanh yuninal winh, Peleg sb'i jun winh. Ha t'a yol stiempoal winh tik ix pukaxkanb'at heb' anima t'a sat lum lum tik. Axo junxo winh skuchan Joctán.
Ha winhaj Joctán chi' ay yuninal winhaj Almodad, winhaj Selef, winhaj Hazar-mawet, winhaj Jera,
winhaj Adoram, winhaj Uzal, winhaj Dicla,
winhaj Obal, winhaj Abimael, winhaj Seba,
winhaj Ofir, winhaj Hawila yet' winhaj Jobab. Masanil heb' tik, a winhaj Joctán ay yuninal heb'.
Ix kajnaj heb' t'a lum skot t'a Mesa, masanto sk'och t'a Sefar t'a tzalquixtak t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u.
Ata' ix kajnaj heb' yinhtilal winhaj Sem, junjun makan yinhtilal heb' t'a yol smakb'en yet' sti' syala'.

Masanil juntzanh anima tik, a heb' yuninal winhaj Noé ay yinhtilal heb', junjun makan yinhtilal heb' yet' smakb'en. Ayic ix lajwi yek' jun owal ha' mukwajum chi', ix saklemkanb'at heb'. Ha t'a heb' tik ix pitzwi juntzanh nakión ay t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik.

Ha t'a peka', ayik toxo ix ek' jun owal ha' mukwajum chi', junnhej ti'al syal heb' anima. Ayic wan sb'at heb' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, ix k'och kajan heb' t'a jun niwan ak'lik t'a yol yik Sinar. Ata' ix kajnaj heb'.

Ay jun k'u ix yal-laj yab' heb' icha tik: Co b'oek lum ladrillo, sko mukan chakb'ok lu'um, xchi heb'. Ha lum ix yak'lab'ej heb' sk'exulok k'een k'een. Axo spixul lu'um, ay jun sk'eta t'a yol lu'um, te tat, haxo stakji, te tzatz tz'aji, asfalto sb'i, a jun chi' ix yak'lab'ej heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: Kaq'ek quip ko b'oek junok ko niwan chonhab'. Sco b'oanekpax junok niwan torre, te chaanh tz'ajk'e t'a satcha’anh yik wach' tzonh te b'inaji. Junxonhej skutej ko b'a, manh ol onh saklemb'at t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, xchi heb' winh.
Axo Jehová ix emul yil jun chonhab' yet' jun torre wan sb'oan heb' chi'.
Ix yalan icha tik: Ix el yich jun munlajel yuj heb' anima tik. Malaj tas skachanoch waan heb' winh yik sb'oan heb' tas nab'il yuj, yujto junnhej chonhab'il yaj heb', junnhej ti' syal heb'.
Ha tiknaik, konh emek t'a skal heb' yik sko somchitan sti' heb', yik wach' manhxo ol nachajel yuj heb' tastak syal junjun, xchi Jehová chi'.
Icha chi' ix aj saklemkanb'at heb' yuj Jehová t'a sat lu'um tik. Ix yaktan heb' sb'oan jun chonhab' chi'.
Aton ta' ix somchajkanb'at sti' heb' anima chi' yuj Jehová. Yuj chi' ix saklemkanb'at heb' t'a smasanil yol yib'anhk’inal tik. Yuj chi' Babel ix sb'iejkan jun chonhab' chi'.
Aton yab'ixal winhaj Sem tik: Schab'ilxo ab'il yek'b'at jun owal ha' mukwajum chi', ayik 100 ab'ilxo sk'inal winhaj Sem, ix alji jun yuninal winh skuchan Arfaxad.
Ixlajwi chi', 500 ab'ilto ix yil winh, ayto yuninal winh yet' yisil winh ix alji.
35 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Arfaxad chi' ayik ix alji jun yuninal winh skuchan Sala.
Ixlajwi chi', 403 ab'ilto ix yil winh, ayto yuninal winh yet' yisil winh ix alji.
30 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Sala chi' ayik ix alji jun yuninal winh skuchan Heber.
Ixlajwi chi', 403 ab'ilto ix yil winh, ayto yuninal winh yet' yisil winh ix alji.
34 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Heber chi' ayik ix alji jun yuninal winh skuchan Peleg.
Ixlajwi chi', 430 ab'ilto ix yil winh, ayto yuninal winh yet' yisil winh ix alji.
30 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Peleg chi' ayik ix alji jun yuninal winh skuchan Reu.
Ixlajwi chi', 209 ab'ilto ix yil winh, ayto yuninal winh yet' yisil winh ix alji.
32 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Reu chi' ayik ix alji jun yuninal winh skuchan Serug.
Ixlajwi chi', 207 ab'ilto ix yil winh, ayto yuninal winh yet' yisil winh ix alji.
30 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Serug chi' ayik ix alji jun yuninal winh skuchan Nacor.
Ixlajwi chi' 200 ab'ilto ix yil winh, ayto yuninal winh yet' yisil winh ix alji.
29 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Nacor chi' ayik ix alji jun yuninal winh skuchan Taré.
Ixlajwi chi', 119 ab'ilto ix yil winh, ayto yuninal winh yet' yisil winh ix alji.
70 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Taré chi' ayik ix alji jun yuninal winh skuchan Abram. Ixlajwi chi', ix alji winhaj Nacor yet' winhaj Harán, aton heb' oxwanh yuninal winhaj Taré chi'.
Aton yab'ixal winhaj Taré tik: Aton winh smam winhaj Abram, winhaj Nacor yet' winhaj Harán. Ha winhaj Harán chi' smam winhaj Lot.
Ix cham winhaj Harán chi' t'a chonhab' Ur t'a yol yik Caldea, ayik mantzak cham winhaj Taré chi'. Ha b'aj aljinak winh chi', ata' chamnakpax winh.
Ix yik'lan sb'a winhaj Abram yet' ix Sarai. Axo winhaj Nacor ix yik'laj sb'a yet' ix Milca, yisil winhaj Harán, snulej sb'a ix yet' ix Isca.
Ha ix Sarai chi' max unewilaj ix.

Ix el winhaj Taré chi' t'a chonhab' Ur t'a yol yik Caldea, yik skotkan winh t'a yol yik Canaán yalani. Ix yik'ankot winh yuninal winh yet'ok, aton winhaj Abram yet' pax winhaj Lot, aton yixchiquin winh yuninal winhaj Harán chamnak. Ix yik'paxkot ix yalib' winh, aton ix Sarai. Axo yik ix jawi heb' t'a chonhab' Harán, ix kajnajkan heb' ta'.
Ha t'a Harán chi' ix cham winhaj Taré chi'. 205 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix cham winh.
Ayxotax yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Abram icha tik: Actejkan a lum tik yet' jantak heb' ay uj a b'a yet'ok yet' heb' ayek' t'a spat a mam, ol ach b'at t'a jun lu'um ol in ch'ox t'ayach.
Ha inhtilal ol och niwak nakional wuuj, ol in ch'oxan in wach'k'olal t'ayach. Yelxo wal niwan ol aj a b'inaji, uuj ol scha wach'k'olal masanil heb' anima.

Ol wak' in wach'k'olal t'a heb' wach' syutej sb'a t'ayach, ol in katab'ejpax heb' chuk syutej sb'a. Uujnhej ol wak' in wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh masanil heb' anima t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, xchi Jehová chi'.

Yuj chi' ix el winhaj Abram t'a yol yik Harán chi', icha ajnak yalankan Jehová t'a winh. 75 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix el winh t'a yol yik Harán chi'. Ix yik'ankot ix yetb'eyum winh yet'ok, aton ix Sarai. Ix yik'paxkot winhaj Lot winh, aton winh yunin winh yuk'tak winh chamnak. Ix yik'paxkot heb' schekab' winh yet' jantak tas ix aj t'a winh ayik ix ek' winh t'a Harán chi'. Icha chi' ix aj sja winh t'a yol yik Canaán.
Ix kotnhej winh t'a yol yik Canaán chi' masanto ix jawi winh t'a Siquem b'aj ay jun te' ji t'a yol yik More. Ha jun te' chi' chajul yuj heb' kananeo kajan ta'.

Ata' ix sch'ox sb'a Jehová t'a winhaj Abram chi', ix yalan t'a winh icha tik: Masanil jun lu'um tik ol wak' t'a heb' inhtilal, xchi t'a winh. Yuj chi' ix sb'o jun altar winhaj Abram chi' t'a yichanh Jehová, yujto ata' ix sch'ox sb'ha t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winh t'a tzalquixtak t'a snanhal chonhab' Betel yet' chonhab' Hai. Ata' ix sb'ok'e smantiado winh. Ha chonhab' Betel chi', ha t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u ay. Ata' ix sb'o junxo altar winh yik syal sb'a winh t'a Jehová.
Ixlajwi chi' k'ojank'olal ix kotxi winh masanto ix jawi winh t'a yol yik Neguev.
Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', ix ja jun niwan wejel t'a jun lugar b'aj ayek' winhaj Abram chi'. Yuj chi' ix b'at kajan winh jun pekti’ t'a Egipto.
Ayic wan sk'och winh t'a Egipto chi', ix yalan winh t'a ix yetb'eyum chi' aton ix Sarai: Ha tiknaik ay jun tas tzin na'a: Ha ach tik te wach' ilji.
Yuj chi' ayik ol ach yilan heb' winh aj Egipto tik, ol am yal heb' winh icha tik: Ha ix tik yetb'eyum ton wal winh tik ix, yuj chi' ko milekcham winh yik skan ix qued'ok, xcham heb' winh.
Yuj chi' swal t'ayach to wanab' ach alani, yik wach' xajan ol in aj yuj heb' winh, manh ol in smilcham heb' winh uuj, xchi winh t'a ix.
Ayic ix k'och winh t'a Egipto chi', ix yilanoch heb' winh kajan ta' to a ix Sarai chi' te wach' yilji ix.
Ix yilanpax heb' ay yopisio yet' winh rey to te wach' yilji ix, ix b'at yalan heb' winh t'a winh rey chi'. Yuj chi' ix yik'anb'at ix heb' winh t'a spat winh rey chi'.

Yuj ix Sarai chi', te xajan ix aj winhaj Abram yuj winh rey chi'. Tzijtum nok' kalnel, nok' wakax, nok' mam b'uru yet' nok' snun yet' nok' kamello ix siaj t'a winh yuj winh rey chi'. Ay pax heb' winh winak yet' heb' ix ix, ix ak'ji schekab'ok winh.
Palta yujnhej ix, tzijtum yaelal ix jawi t'a yib'anh winh rey yet' heb' kajan yet' winh t'a spat yuj Jehová.
Yuj chi' ix schek winh rey chi' awtajkot winhaj Abram chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: ¿Tas yuj icha tik tzin utej? ¿Tas yuj maj al t'ayin tato etb'eyum ix tik?
Ina ix ala' to anab' ix, yuj chi' ix in na to tz'och ix wetb'eyumok. Ha tiknaik jun, ik'b'at ix, ixiquek, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a heb' schekab' to tz'ik'jiel winhaj Abram t'a yol smakb'en Egipto chi' yet' ix yetb'eyum yet' masanil tas ay t'a winh.
Ayic ix el winhaj Abram yet' ix yetb'eyum t'a Egipto chi' yet' masanil tas ay t'a winh, ix meltzaj heb' t'a yol yik Neguev. Ix meltzajpax winhaj Lot yet' heb'.
Ha winhaj Abram chi', te b'eyumxo winh, ay k'een oro, k'een plata yet' jantak nok' nok' t'a winh.
Ix elxi winh t'a Neguev chi'. k'ojank'olal ix k'ochxi winh t'a yol yik Betel b'aj ek'nak t'a sb'ab'elal, aton t'a skal Betel yet' Hai.
Ata' b'ob'ilkan jun altar yuj winh t'a yalanhtaxo. Ata' ix yalxi sb'a winh t'a Jehová.
Ha winhaj Lot chi' junnhej tzek' winh yet' winhaj Abram chi'. Tzijtum pax nok' skalnel winh yet' nok' swakax. Tzijtum pax heb' schekab' winh.
Maxtzac yab'laj lugar b'aj swa nok' snok' heb' chi' yujto te tzijtum nok'. Yuj chi', maxtzak yal-laj junnhej tzek' heb'.

Ha heb' winh stanhwumal nok' smolb'etz nok' winhaj Abram chi', syak' owal heb' yet' heb' winh stanhwumal nok' yik winhaj Lot chi'. Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', aytoek' kajan heb' kananeo yet' heb' ferezeo ta'.

Ay jun k'ual ix yal winhaj Abram t'a winhaj Lot chi' icha tik: Ina ayto kuj ko b'a, manh wach'ok tato skak' owal, wach'chom a heb' stanhwumal nok' ko molb'etzal nok' tik, manh wach'ok tato syak' owal heb'.

Masanil jun lugar tik kolan yaji. Syal a sik'lani b'ajtil tzach kani, yik wach' sko poj ko b'a. Tato tzach elkan t'a yelk'och chi', a inxo tzin ochkan t'a yochk'och chi'. Tato tzach ochkan t'a yochk'och chi' jun, a inxo tzin elkan t'a yelk'och chi', xchi winhaj Abram chi' t'a winh.

Ix b'at t'anhan winhaj Lot chi' t'a jun niwan ak'lik ay t'a sti' ha' Jordán masanto sk'och t'a chonhab' Zoar. Te yax sat jun ak'lik chi' yuj ha ha' chi', lajan yilji icha jun awb'en te' b'ob'il yuj Jehová, icha yilji yol yik Egipto ix yil winh. Ayic ix sb'oan strato winhaj Abram yet' winhaj Lot chi', manto satel-laj chonhab' Sodoma yet' Gomorra yuj Jehová.
Ha jun ak'lik t'a sti' ha' Jordán chi' ix sik'kanel winhaj Lot chi', ix b'at kajnaj winh t'a stojolal b'aj sja k'u. Icha chi' ix aj spojlan sb'a winhaj Abram yet' winhaj Lot chi'.
Yuj chi' ix kan winhaj Abram t'a yol smakb'en Canaán, haxo pax winhaj Lot chi', ix kajnaj winh t'a skal juntzanh chonhab' t'a yak'likal sti' ha' Jordán, t'a slak'anil chonhab' Sodoma.
Ha t'a jun chonhab' chi', te chuk sb'eyb'al heb' anima, manh jantakok chukal sk'ulej heb' t'a yichanh Jehová.
Ayic toxo ix b'at winhaj Lot chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Abram chi' icha tik: Ha tiknaik ilb'at t'a ichanh, t'a a patik yet' t'a a tz'eytak.
Masanil juntzanh lu'um wan ilanb'at chi', swak' t'ayach t'a junelnhej yet' t'a heb' inhtilal.
Icha wal spokokal lum lum, malaj mach syal sb'isani, icha chi' ol aj inhtilal.
Ha tiknaik k'eanh waan yik tza b'eytzitan yok jun lum tik yet' sk'atul, yujto swak' jun lu'um tik t'ayach, xchi Jehová t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'anchaanh skampamento winhaj Abram chi', ix b'at kajnaj winh t'a slak'anil juntzanh te' ji t'a yol smakb'en jun winh skuch Mamre t'a slak'anil chonhab' Hebrón. Ix sb'oan jun altar winh b'aj syal sb'ha t'a Jehová.

Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', ix yak' owal cha makan heb' winh rey. Jun makan heb' winh: Aton winhaj Amrafel sreyal Sinar, winhaj Arioc sreyal Elasar, winhaj Quedorlaomer sreyal Elam yet' winhaj Tidal sreyal Goim. Junxo makan heb': Aton winhaj Bera sreyal Sodoma, winhaj Birsa sreyal Gomorra, winhaj Sinab sreyal Adma, winhaj Semeber sreyal Zeboim yet' winh sreyal Bela, aton jun chonhab' Zoar tiknaik.
Ha owanh heb' winh rey chi' ix slajtiej sb'a heb' winh, junxonhej ix yutej soldado heb' winh t'a jun ak'lik skuch Sidim b'aj ay ha' mar Muerto tiknaik.
Ha heb' winh rey chi', slajchawilxo ab'il yajoch heb' winh t'a yalanh smandar winhaj rey Quedorlaomer. Axo ix ek' junxo ab'il majxo yak'laj k'een tumin heb' winh syak'taxon t'a winh.

Yuj chi' t'a junxo ab'il ix b'at winh rey chi' yet' oxwanhxo heb' winh rey ayoch yet'ok t'a yol yik Astarot Karnaim. Ata' ix ak'ji ganar heb' refaíta yuj heb' winh. Ix ak'jipax ganar heb' zuzita yuj heb' winh t'a yol yik Ham. Ix ak'jipax ganar heb' winh emita yuj heb' winh t'a yol yik Sawe-quiriataim.
Ix ak'jipax ganar heb' horeo yuj heb' winh t'a jun tzalan skuch Seir, ix pechji heb' masanto t'a jun ak'lik Parán, t'a slak'anil jun lum taquinh lu'um.

Ayic ix meltzajxi winhaj rey Quedorlaomer yet' heb' winh ayoch yet'ok, ix jawi heb' winh t'a En-mispat, anheja' jun lugar chi' skuchanpax Cades. Ix satel masanil tas ay t'a yol yik heb' amalekita yuj heb' winh yet' tas ay t'a heb' amorreo ay t'a yol yik Hazezon-tamar.

Axo owanh heb' winh rey, aton winh yik Sodoma, winh yik Gomorra, winh yik Adma, winh yik Zeboim yet' winh yik Bela, ix b'at heb' winh t'a ak'lik Sidim. Ata' ix yak' owal heb' winh yet' chanhwanhxo heb' winh rey chi', aton winhaj Quedorlaomer, winhaj Tidal, winhaj Amrafel yet' winhaj Arioc.

Ha t'a yak'likal Sidim chi', tzijtum b'ajtak sk'eta jun asfalto te tzayayi. Yuj chi' ayik ix b'at winh sreyal Sodoma yet' winh yik Gomorra elelal, ay heb' soldado heb' ix b'atkan t'a skal asfalto chi', ay juntzanhxo heb' ix b'atkan elelal t'a jolomtak witz.
Ha chanhwanh heb' winh rey ix ak'an ganar chi', ix b'at heb' winh yik'elta masanil tas swaji yet' masanil tas te ay stojol t'a Sodoma yet' t'a Gomorra chi', ix b'at heb' winh b'ian.
Ha winhaj Lot, sk'ab' yok winhaj Abram, kajan t'a Sodoma chi', ix ik'jib'at winh yuj heb' winh yet' masanil tas ay t'ay.

Palta ay jun winh ixto yak' ganar yeli, ix b'at yalan winh t'a winhaj Abram winh hebreo to ix ik'jib'at winhaj Lot chi'. Ha winhaj Abram chi' kajan winh t'a slak'anil juntzanh te' ji t'a yol smakb'en winhaj Mamre winh amorreo, yuk'tak sb'a yet' winhaj Escol yet' winhaj Aner. Ha heb' chi' wach' yak'an heb' yet' winhaj Abram chi'.

Ayic ix yab'an winhaj Abram to ix ik'jib'at winhaj Lot chi', ix smolb'an masanil heb' schekab' winh k'ayb'ab'il t'a owal, aton heb' ix alji t'a yol skuenta winh, 318 heb' smasanil. Ix b'at heb' t'a spatik heb' chanhwanh rey chi' masanto b'aj ay chonhab' Dan tiknaik, ata' ix yamchaj heb' yuj heb'.

Axo t'ak'walil ix spojanb'at masanil heb' swinak winhaj Abram chi', ix och heb' winh yak' owal yet' chanhwanh heb' winh rey chi'. Ix pechji heb' winh yuj heb' winh, masanto t'a Hoba t'a yichanhb'at chonhab' Damasco ix k'och heb' winh.
Ix yik'anxiek' winhaj Abram jantak tastak ix yik'ek' heb' chi', ix ek'xikan winhaj Lot yet' masanil tas ay t'ay yet' pax heb' ix ix yet' juntzanhxo heb' ix ik'jib'at yuj heb' winh rey chi'.

Ayic toxo ix ak'ji ganar winhaj rey Quedorlaomer yet' heb' winh rey ayoch yet'ok yuj winhaj Abram chi', ix meltzajxi winh yet' heb' ix kolchajkan chi' yuj. Axo winh sreyal Sodoma ix elta t'a yol b'e scha winh t'a jun ch'olan skuch Sawe, Ch'olan yik heb' Rey sb'i paxi.
Ha winhaj Melquisedec, sreyal Salem, sakerdoteal Dios Axonhej Niwan Yelk'ochi, a winh ix ak'an ixim pan yet' wino t'a winhaj Abram chi'.
Ix yalan wach' lolonel winh t'a yib'anh winh icha tik: Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Dios t'a ib'anh, aton Dios Axonhej Niwan Yelk'ochi, aton ixb’o’an satcha’anh yet' sat lu'um.

Aljokab' wach' lolonel d'ha Dios ix ak'anoch heb' ajk'ol t'a yol a k'ab', xchi winh t'a winhaj Abram chi'. Ixlajwi chi', a jantak tastak ix yik'ek' winhaj Abram t'a heb' winh rey chi', ix yak'an sdiezmoal winh t'a winhaj Melquisedec chi'.
Axo ix yalan winh sreyal Sodoma t'a winhaj Abram chi' icha tik: --Anhej heb' anima tzak' meltzaj t'ayin, haxo masanil tastak, kanokab' t'ayach, xchi winh.
Axo ix yalan winhaj Abram chi' icha tik: --Toxo ix wak' in ti' t'a Jehová, aton Dios Axonhej Niwan Yelk'ochi, jun ixb’o’an satcha’anh yet' yol yib'anhk’inal tik,
to malaj jab'ok tas skan t'ayin, malaj wal jab'ok ch'al ma junok ch'anhal xanhab' skan t'ayin, yik wach' manh ol ala' to uuj tzin och b'eyumal.

Malaj jab'ok tas ix b'at wik'ek' tik tzin nib'ej skan t'ayin, anhej tas ix swa heb' in chekab'. Axo heb' ajun wed' tik, aton winhaj Aner, winhaj Escol yet' winhaj Mamre, a heb' winh tik, schaokab' yik heb' winh.
Ixlajwi juntzanh chi', ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Abram icha t'a wayichal, ix yalan icha tik: --Ach Abram manh ach xiwok, a in ol ach in kolo', te niwan spak ol wak' t'ayach, xchi t'a winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Abram icha tik: --Ach Jehová Vajalil, ¿tas wal yopisio jun spak chi' wuuj? Ojtac wal to malaj junok wuninal ix ak'a' yik ata' swak'xikan jantak tas ay t'ayin, yuj chi' a junok in chekab' ol chaankan masanil tas ay t'ayin, aton winhaj Eliezer aj Damasco, a winh sat yaj t'a heb' in chekab' smasanil, xchi winh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winh: --Maay, ha t'a junok uninal ol kanok, manhoklaj t'a winh komon anima chi' ol kanok, xchi t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix ik'jielta winh yuj Dios t'a sti' smantiado, ix yalan t'a winh icha tik: --Q'ueanh k'elan t'a satcha’anh. B'isto juntzanh k'anal chi' naik, tato syal a b'isani. Ichaton chi' ol aj sb'isul heb' inhtilal, xchi t'a winh.
Ix yak'och winhaj Abram chi' t'a sk'ool tas ix yal Jehová chi', yuj chi' wach' ix kan winh t'a yichanh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: --Ha in ton Jehová in ach wik'elta t'a chonhab' Ur t'a yol yik Caldea yik swak' jun lu'um tik t'ayach yik tziquej, xchi t'a winh.
--Palta ach Jehová Vajalil, ¿tas wal tz'aj wojtakaneli tato swiquejkan jun lu'um tik? xchi winhaj Abram chi'.

Ix yalanxi Jehová: --Ik'kot junok nok' kob'es wakax t'ayin yet' junok nok' chiwa yet' junok nok' ch'ak kalnel, oxe' ab'il sk'inal junjun nok'. Tzik'anpaxkot junok nok' kuwajte' yet' junok nok' paramuch, xchi t'a winh.

Ix yik'kankot juntzanh nok' nok' chi' winh t'a yichanh Jehová chi', ix lajwi chi' ix schapojan snanhal junjun nok' winh. Jilip nok' ix kan t'a stz'ey jilipxo nok'. Axo nok' much chi', maj schapojejlaj snanhal nok' winh.
Tz'em nok' ostok t'a yib'anh nok', haxo winhaj Abram chi' spechan nok'.
Ayic wanxo sq'uik'b'i, ix te sat sk'ol winhaj Abram chi' swayi, ix ja jun niwan xiwelal t'a yib'anh winh yuj jun niwan k’ik’ k’inal.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan Jehová t'a winh: --Yowalil tzojtaquejeli to a heb' inhtilal, ol b'atkan kajan heb' t'a junokxo ch'ok chonhab'il, ol ochkan heb' chekab'ok, chanhe' kiento ab'il ol ixtaj heb'.
Palta a in ol wak'och yaelal t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' b'aj ayoch heb' chekab'ok chi'. Slajwi chi', ol elta heb' yet' jantak sb'eyumal.
Palta a ach tik junk'olal ol aj a chami ayik ol ach och icham winaquil.
Chanh makanhxo inhtilal ix eq'ui, ichato chi' ol meltzajxikot heb' t'a tik, yujto manto tz'akwok schukal heb' amorreo t'a tik, xchi Jehová.
Ayic t'ak'walilxo, ix sch'oxan sb'a jun k'ak' kulkon sk'ei, b'akaqui sk'e stab'il. Tz'ek' t'a skal nok' nok' chapoj yaj chi'.

Aton t'a jun ak'wal chi' ix sb'o strato Jehová yet' winhaj Abram chi', ix yalan icha tik: --Ha jun lu'um tik ol wak' t'a heb' inhtilal, schakot lum t'a jun smelemal ha' t'a yik Egipto, masanto t'ha ha' Éufrates,
aton sluum heb' keneo, heb' kenezeo, heb' kadmoneo,
heb' hitita, heb' ferezeo, heb' refaíta,
heb' amorreo, heb' kananeo, heb' gergeseo yet' heb' jebuseo, xchi t'a winh.
Ha ix Sarai, yetb'eyum winhaj Abram, max unewilaj ix, palta ay jun ix skriada ix manb'il yuj, aton ix Agar, ix aj Egipto.

Ix yalan ix Sarai t'a winh yetb'eyum chi' icha tik: --Ina malaj wune' syak' Jehová, yuj chi' tzin tewi t'ayach to tzach way yet' ix in kriada tik, talaj tz'alji junok yune' ix yik tz'och wuneok, xchi ix. Ix sk'anab'ajan winhaj Abram tas ix yal ix chi'.
Slajunhilxo ab'il ayek' heb' t'a Canaán, ix yak'anoch ix skriada ix chi' t'a yol sk'ab' winh yetb'eyum chi', yik tz'och ix schab'ilok yetb'eyum winh.
Ayic ix way winhaj Abram yet' ix Agar chi', ix skuchkanoch yune' ix. Axo ix yab'an ix to yet'nakxo yune' ix, ix spatikanel ix Sarai chi' ix, manhxalaj tz'och ix t'a ix.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan ix Sarai t'a winhaj Abram chi' icha tik: --Uujnhej emnaquil tzin yutejkan ix in kriada tik. Tik pax ix wak' ix etb'eyumok, haxo tiknaik yujto ix yab' ix to yet'nakxo yune' ix, tzin spatikanel ix. Wach' tzonh sch'olb'itej Jehová, ¿tom a ach ay a mul, mato a in? xchi ix Sarai chi'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Abram chi' icha tik: --Ha ix a kriada tik, yol a k'ab' ayoch ix. Ha ach tza na' tas tzutej ix, xchi winh t'a ix. Yuj chi' ix och ix Sarai ajk'olal t'a ix masanto ix elta ix.
Palta haxo Yángel Jehová ix schalaj sb'a yet' ix t'a tzinan lu'um t'a slak'anil jun ha ha' b'aj sb'atkan sb'eal Sur t'a yol yik Egipto.
Ix sk'anb'an t'a ix icha tik: --Ach Agar, skriada ix Sarai, ¿b'ajtil a petoj? ¿b'ajtil tzach b'ati? xchi t'a ix. --To tzin el t'a ix Sarai, ix in patrona, xchi ix.
Ix yalan Yángel Jehová chi' t'a ix icha tik: --Meltzajanh t'a ix a patrona chi', emnaquil tzutej a b'ha t'a ix, xchi t'a ix.
Ix yalanpax Yángel Jehová chi': Ol wik'chaanh sb'isul inhtilal, malaj mach ol yal sb'isani.
Ayxo unin ed'nak, yuj chi' ayik ol aljok jun une' chi', Ismael ol ak' sb'iej, yujto ix yab' Jehová ok' yuj a kusk'olal.

Icha nok' nok' te itz'at ol aj jun une' chi', icha junok nok' kaltakte'al b'uru. Ol yak' owal winh yet' heb' anima, ol yak'anpax owal heb' anima yet' winh. Ol kajnaj winh b'aj syak' snib'ej, wach'chom max schalaj sk'ol heb' ayto yuj sb'a chi' yet'ok, xchi jun ángel chi'.
Yujto ix lolon ix Agar chi' yet' Jehová, yuj chi' icha tik ix yak' ix sb'iok Jehová chi': Ha Dios Tzin ilani. Ix yalan ix icha tik: Toton wal yel ix wil Dios tzin ilani, xchi ix.
Ha ha' uk'b'ila' yik Dios Pitzan, Jun Tzin Ilani, icha chi' ix yak' ix sb'iok jun ha' uk'b'ila' chi'. Ha t'a skal Cades yet' Bered, ata' ay ha'. Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzajxi ix b'aj aytaxoneq'ui.
Ix alji jun yune' ix Agar yet' winhaj Abram chi'. Ismael ix yak' winh sb'iej.
86 ab'ilxo sk'inal winhaj Abram chi' ayik ix alji winhaj Ismael chi'.
Ayic 99 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Abram ix sch'oxanxi sb'a Jehová t'a winh, ix yalan icha tik: --Ha in ton Dios in, syal wuj masanil, wach'nhej tzutej a b'ha t'a wichanh.
Ol wak' jun in trato ed'ok, tzijtum inhtilal ol elok, xchi.
Ixlajwi chi' ix em nhojan winhaj Abram chi' t'a sat lu'um yakb'an wan slolon Dios yet' winh. Ix yalan icha tik:
--Aton jun in trato tik ol wak' ed'ok: Ol ach och smam yichamok tzijtumal nakión.
Manhxo ol a kuch Abram, palta Abraham xo ol a b'iej, yujto ol ach wak'och smam yichamok tzijtumal nakión.
Tzijtum ol aj wik'anchaanh sb'isul inhtilal, tzijtum nakión ol pitzwok yuj heb'. Ha t'a skal inhtilal chi', ay heb' rey ol elta.
Ha jun in trato swak' ed'ok tik yet' masanil heb' inhtilal chi' to a Diosal in, sDiosal in pax heb' inhtilal chi' t'a junelnhej.
Ha tiknaik paxyalwum ach t'a lum Canaán tik, palta masanil lu'um tik ol wak' iquej yet' heb' inhtilal t'a junelnhej, sDiosal in pax heb', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Dios t'a winh: --Ha achxo tik, k'anab'ajej jun in trato tik, yowalil sk'anab'ajej pax heb' inhtilal chi' ayik ol b'eynhejb'at tiempo.
Ha jun in trato wan in b'oan tik eyed'ok to yowalil tze k'anab'ajej. Masanil heb' winak unin, ochokab' yechel sniwanil heb'.
Yuj chi' ik'jokab'el stz'umal sjolom swinaquil heb' he winak unin. Ha jun chi' yechel in trato yaj eyed'ok.

Yukub'ixial yaj junjun winak unin tz'och jun yechel chi' t'a heb', wach'chom eyuninal ma yuninal heb' he chekab'. Yowalil tz'ak'jipaxoch jun yechel chi' t'a heb' he chekab', heb' manb'il t'a ch'ok chonhab'il. Yowalil tz'och jun yechel chi' t'ayex, max yal yek'b'ati. Icha chi' b'ian, a jun in trato tik eyed'ok niwan chequel ol aj t'a he niwanil t'a junelnhej.
Yalnhej mach junok winak to malaj jun yechel chi' t'ay, yowalil tzeyik'el t'a he kal, yujto max sk'anab'ajej in trato ix wak' eyed'ok, xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalanxi Dios t'a winhaj Abraham chi' icha tik: --Ayic ol b'eyb'at tiempo tik, manhxo Sarai-ok ol sb'iej ix etb'eyum, palta Sara ol sb'iej ix.

Ol wak' in wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh ix, ol aljok junok uninal yet' ix. Val yel ol wak' in wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh ix. Nunab'il ol aj ix t'a tzijtumal nakión. Tzijtum heb' winh sreyal chonhab' ol elta t'a skal yinhtilal ix chi', xchi.

Ayic ix yab'an jun chi' winhaj Abraham chi', ix em nhojan winh t'a sat lu'um, ix och ijan winh stzewaji, ix och ijan winh snaub'tanhani: ¿Tom olto aljok wuninal? kien ab'ilxo in k 'inal, 90 ab'ilxo sk'inal ix Sara, ¿tom olto wal aljok yune' ix? xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh d'ha Dios icha tik: --Tzin k'an t'ayach, tzok el wal t'a a k'ool tzak' sk'inal winhaj Ismael tik yik wach' ol elk'och winh, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi Dios chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Toxo ix wal t'ayach to ol aljok junok uninal yet' ix Sara. Isaac ol ak' sb'iej, aton yet' winh ol wak'elk'och jun in trato tik t'a masanil k 'inal yet' heb' yinhtilal winh.

Ha pax winhaj Ismael jun, toxo ix wab' tas ix ala', ol wak' in wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh winh, yuj chi' tzijtum ol aj yinhtilal winh. Ol q'uib'chaanh sb'isul yinhtilal winh. Ha t'a skal yinhtilal winh chi', ol elta lajchawanh heb' niwak yajal. Ha yinhtilal winh chi', niwak nakión ol ajok.
Palta a in trato ix wak' ed'ok, ol wak'elk'och yet' winhaj Isaac winh uninal ol aljok t'a ix Sara t'a junxo ab'il icha tiempo tik, xchi Jehová.
Ayic ix lajwi slolon Dios yet' winh, ix paxk'ei.

Aton t'a jun k'u chi' ix schek winhaj Abraham ak'jioch jun yechel chi' t'a winhaj Ismael yet' t'a masanil heb' winh schekab' winh, heb' aljinak t'a yol skuenta winh yet' masanil heb' winh manb'il yuj winh yet' masanil heb' kajan yet' winh. Ix ak'jioch yechel heb' smasanil, icha ix aj yalan Dios t'a winh.
Ha winhaj Abraham chi', 99 ab'il sk'inal winh, haxo winhaj Ismael 13 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix ak'jioch jun yechel chi' t'a heb' winh.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi' ix ak'jioch jun yechel chi' t'a heb' winh schawanhil
yet' t'a masanil heb' winh ayek' yet' winhaj Abraham chi', heb' schekab' winh aljinak t'a yol skuenta yet' heb' manb'il yuj winh t'a juntzanhxo ch'ok chonhab'il.
Ixlajwi chi' ix sch'oxanxi sb'a Jehová t'a winhaj Abraham t'a slak'anil juntzanh te' ji t'a yol yik winhaj Mamre. Chimk'ualil am wal k'ojanelta winh t'a sti' smantiado.
Axo ix yilan winh, linhjab' ek' oxwanh winak t'a yichanhb'at winh. Ayic ix yilan heb' chi' winh, ix b'at lemnaj winh schakot heb', ix emk'och nhojnaj winh t'a sat lum t'a yichanh heb'.
Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ach mamin, tato wach' in tzila', tzin tewi t'ayach to manh b'enhejok tzex eq'ui.
Tanhwejec, b'at wala' yik tz'ik'chajkot jab'ok ha ha' yik tze b'iquel eyok, tzeyik'an eyip t'a yich te te' tik.
Yakb'an ayex ek' t'a in tz'ey tik, tzin b'at wik'kot jab'ok tas ol he wa', yik wach' tz'och eyip, ichato chi' ol ex b'atxok, xchi winh t'a heb'. --Ixic an, xchi heb' t'a winh.
Ix ochb'at lemnaj winh t'a yol smantiado. Ix yalan winh t'a ix Sara icha tik: --Lem, ik'kot junok koxtal ixim harina te wach', tza b'oan jantakok pan staji t'a kal tzak'ak', xchi winh t'a ix.
Ix b'at lemnaj winh b'aj ay nok' swakax, ix b'at yik'ankot jun nok' quelem wakax winh te wach', ix yak'an nok' winh t'a jun winh schekab' yik sb'o nok' winh t'a elanhchamel yik schichaj nok'.

Ix yik'ankot mantequilla winh yet' lech yet' nok' chib'ej ix b'ochaj chi', ix yik'anb'at winh t'a yichanh heb' yik swa heb'. Yakb'an wan swa heb' chi', ix och tek'tek' winh t'a stz'ey heb' t'a yich te te' chi'.
Ix sk'anb'an heb' t'a winh icha tik: --¿B'ajtil ayek' ix Sara ix etb'eyum? xchi heb'. --Ayoch ix t'a yol ko mantiado tik, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Ix yalan junok heb' icha tik: --Yab' icha tik junab', swak'anxi a paxyal, ata' ol aljok junok yune' ix etb'eyum tik, winak unin, xchi t'a winh. Yakb'an a ix Sara chi' wan smaklan yab' ix tas syala', ayek' ix t'a sti' smantiado heb' t'a spatik winhaj Abraham chi'.
Ha winhaj Abraham yet' ix Sara chi' te ichamtak animaxo heb'. Ha ix Sara chi' pekatax manhxalaj yechel unin syil ix,

yuj chi' tonhej ix tzewaj ix t'a yol sk'ool. Ayic ix yab'an ix yalji jun chi', ix snaan ix icha tik: ¿Tasto wal ol aj in nib'anoch jun tik, ina te chichim inxo, te ichamxo pax winh wetb'eyum? xchi ix.
Yuj chi' ix yalan Jehová t'a winh icha tik: --¿Tas yuj tonhej stzewaj ix etb'eyum chi'? ¿Tzam sna' ix yujto chichimxo ix maxtzak yal yalji junok yune' ix?
¿Tom ay tas ajaltak t'ayin tze na'a? Yab' icha tik junab', tzin jax junelxo, swak'anxi a paxyal. Ata' ol aljok jun yune' ix Sara chi', winak unin, xchi Jehová.
Ayic ix yab'an jun chi' ix Sara chi', ix te xiw ix, ix yalan ix icha tik: --Malaj in tzin tzewaji, xchi ix. Axo ix tak'wi Jehová t'a ix icha tik: --Vojtak to ix ach tzewaji, xchi.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at heb' oxwanh chi' t'a sb'eal Sodoma. Ix b'at winhaj Abraham yet' heb' yik stak'lankan sb'a heb' yet' winh.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Max yal-laj in k'ub'anel t'a winhaj Abraham tik tas toxo ol in k'ulej.
Ina to a winh ol och smam yichamok jun niwan nakión te tek'an ol ajok. Toxo ix wak' in ti' to yuj winh ol scha' in wach'k'olal masanil nakión t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik.

Ha in ix in sik'elta winh, yik wach' syalel in cheknab'il winh t'a masanil yuninal yet' heb' kajan yet'ok, yik wach' sk'anab'ajej heb' sb'eyb'alan masanil tas wach' yet' tojolal, yik wach' swak'elk'och jantak in lolonel ix wal t'a winh, xchi Jehová.
Yuj chi' ix yalan t'a winhaj Abraham chi' icha tik: --Masanil anima ay t'a Sodoma yet' t'a Gomorra, yalxonhej b'aj te chuk yel spekal heb', axonhej wal chukal sk'ulej heb'.
Ha tiknaik, tik tzin b'at wila'', tato yel axonhej chukal chi' sk'ulej heb' icha tz'aj yalchaj chi' t'ayin yik ol wojtaquejeli tas yaji, xchi Jehová chi'.
Ay chawanh heb' b'enhej ix b'atkan t'a Sodoma, haxo winhaj Abraham chi' ix lolonkan winh yet' Jehová.
Ix snitzanb'at jab'xo sb'a winh t'a stz'ey Jehová chi', ix sk'anb'an winh icha tik: ¿Tom ol a satel heb' anima malaj smul yet' heb' ay smul?
Q'uinalok ay 50-ok heb' wach' t'a jun chonhab' chi', ¿tom ol a satel heb'? ¿tom manh ol ak' niwank'olal yuj heb' 50 malaj smul chi'?

Manh ol yal utan icha chi'. Tato tza satel heb' malaj smul yet' heb' ay smul chi', ichato lajan smul heb' smasanil syal chi'. Manh utej icha chi'. Ha ach tik Juez ach t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, ¿tokwal ol a k'ulej junok tas manh tojolok? xchi winh t'ay.
Ix tak'wi Jehová t'a winh icha tik: --Tato ay 50-ok heb' wach' t'a chonhab' Sodoma chi', yuj heb' swak' niwank'olal masanil heb' kajan t'a jun chonhab' chi', xchi.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Abraham chi' icha tik: --Ak' niwank'olal t'ayin ach Vajalil yuj tas swal tik t'ayach, yujto a in tik, anima innhej.

Q'uinalok ayxonhej owanhok max tz'akwi 50 anima wach', ¿tom yujxonhej owanh chi', tza satel jun chonhab' chi' smasanil? xchi winh. Ix tak'wixi Jehová icha tik: --Tato ay 45-ok heb' wach', max in satel-laj jun chonhab' chi', xchi.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Abraham chi' icha tik: --Q'uinalok anhej 40-ok heb' wach', xchi winh. --Yuj heb' 40 chi', manh ol in satel-laj jun chonhab' chi', xchi Jehová.

Ix yalanxi winhaj Abraham chi' icha tik: --Ach Vajalil tzin tewi t'ayach, mokab' kot owal swalan t'ayach. Q'uinalok anhej 30-ok heb' wach' tz'ilchaj uuj, xchi winh. Ix tak'wixi Jehová chi' icha tik: --Ha yuj heb' 30 chi', ol wak' niwank'olal jun chonhab' chi', xchi.

Axo winhaj Abraham chi' ix ochnhej ijan winh yalani: --Mamin Vajalil, tzin tewi wal t'ayach, ¿tas tzutej ta axonhej 20-ok heb' wach'? xchi winh. Ix tak'wixi Jehová chi' icha tik: --Ha yuj heb' 20 chi', manh ol in satel-laj jun chonhab' chi', xchi.

Ix yalanxi winhaj Abraham chi': --Ak'wal niwank'olal t'ayin ach Vajalil, mokab' kot owal t'ayin, axonhej junel tik tzin tewi t'ayach, manhxa tas ol wala': ¿Tas tzutej, q'uinalok tato axonhej lajunhwanhok heb' wach' sb'eyb'al tz'ilchaj uuj? xchi winh. Ix yalanxi Jehová chi' icha tik: --Q'uinalok ay lajunhwanhok heb' wach' sb'eyb'al, manh ol in satel-laj jun chonhab' chi', xchi.
Axo ix lajwi slolon heb' chi', ix b'at Jehová, ix smeltzajkan winhaj Abraham chi' t'a smantiado.

Ayic wanxo sq'uik'b'i ix k'och chawanh heb' ángel chi' t'a chonhab' Sodoma. Ha winhaj Lot k'ojanek' winh t'a spuertail chonhab' chi'. Ix yilan winh to wan sja heb', ix k'e waan winh b'at schakot heb'. Ix em nhojnaj winh t'a yichanh heb'.

Ix yalan winh: --Ex mamin, tzin tewi t'ayex, koyek wed' t'a in pat. Ay ha ha' b'aj ol he b'iquel eyok, ay pax b'aj wach' ol ex kan t'a jun ak'wal tik, haxo k'ik'an spet ex b'ati, xchi winh t'a heb'. Ix tak'wi heb' icha tik: --Yuj wal Dios t'ayach, palta a onh tik ol onh kan t'a kalle tik, a tik ol onh wayok, xchi heb'.
Palta ix och wal tean winhaj Lot chi' t'a heb', masanto ix b'at heb' t'a spat winh chi'. Axo ix k'och heb', ix sb'oan ixim pan winh malaj yich swa heb', ix wa heb' sik'lab'il.
Ayic mantzak way heb', ix k'och masanil heb' winh winak kajan chi' ta', ix oymaj heb' winh t'a spatiktak spat winhaj Lot chi'.

Ix och ijan heb' winh yawajoch t'a winhaj Lot chi', ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --¿B'ajtil ayek' juntzanh heb' winh winak ix jakan t'a a pat tik t'a jun ak'wal tik? Ik'elta heb' winh t'ayonh yik squixtej heb', xchi heb' winh.
Ayic ix yab'an juntzanh lolonel winhaj Lot chi', ix elta winh yil heb' winh. Wach' ix yutej winh smakankanelta te' puerta chi' t'a spatik.
Ix yalan winh: --Ex wetanimail, tzin tewi t'ayex to manh he k'ulej jun chukal chi'.

Ay chawanh heb' ix wisil kob'estak, mantalaj winak tzek' t'a spatik heb' ix, syal wik'anelta heb' ix t'ayex yik tze k'ulej icha he gana chi' yet' heb' ix. Palta a yet' heb' winh tik, max yal-laj, yujto tonhej ix jakan heb' winh t'a in pat tik, xchi winh t'a heb' winh.

Ix yalan heb' winh: --Manh ak'och a b'a, elanh t'a quichanh. Ha ach tik ch'ok chonhab'il ach, ¿tom a ach ijan tzala'? Ha tiknaik ek'b'al ol ach quixtej t'a yichanh heb' winh, xchi heb' winh. Ix och ijan heb' winh yekanel winhaj Lot chi' yik sk'och heb' winh t'a te' puerta chi', yik smak'anpoj te' heb' snaani.
Palta a chawanh heb' ángel chi', ix yak'elta sk'ab' heb' yik tz'ik'jioch winhaj Lot chi' yuj heb' t'a yol pat chi', ix smakanelta te' puerta chi' heb'.
Ix yak'an k'ik'yatax heb' anima ayek' t'a patik pat chi' heb', heb' icham winak yet' heb' kelemtak, ix te k'unb'i heb' sayanek' sti' te' pat chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan heb' chawanh chi' t'a winhaj Lot: --Tato ayto heb' ay uj a b'a yet'ok t'a tik, heb' winh uninal, heb' ix isil, heb' a nhi', ma heb' a k'ab'ok, ik'el heb' t'a tik.
Yujto ol ko satel jun chonhab' tik. Yujto ix te' k'ek'och schukal heb' t'a yichanh Jehová, yuj chi' onh schekkoti yik tzul ko satel juntzanh anima tik, xchi heb' ángel chi'.

Yuj chi', ix b'at winhaj Lot chi' yal t'a heb' winh d'inhan yik'lan sb'a yet' heb' ix yisil chi', ix yalan winh: --Pilec eyip, konh elek, yujto a jun chonhab' tik ol satel yuj Jehová, xchi winh t'a heb'. Palta maj schalaj yab' heb' tas ix yal winhaj Lot chi'. Tonhej spukhan winh snaan heb'.

Palta haxo yik wanxo sakb'i, ix yalan heb' ángel chi' t'a winhaj Lot chi': --Pil ip tato max yal a k'ol tzach satel yet' jun chonhab' tik. Ik'b'at ix etb'eyum tik yet' heb' ix isil tik schawanhil, xchi heb' t'a winh.

Palta a winhaj Lot chi', max spil-laj yip winh yeli. Yuj chi' a heb' ángel chi' ix quetzan sk'ab' heb' schanhwanhil, yik tz'ik'jiel heb', yujto tz'ok' sk'ol Jehová t'a heb'. Icha chi' ix aj yik'jiel winhaj Lot yet' ix yetb'eyum yet' heb' ix yisil t'a yol chonhab' chi'.

Ayic toxo ix el heb' t'a stiel chonhab' chi', ix yalan junok heb' ángel chi' t'a heb': --Yelk'olal tzex b'ati, manh ex meltzajkot k'elan t'a he patik. Manh ex och waan he b'ey t'a jun ak'lik tik, k'eanhek t'a jolomtak witz, tato max yal he k'ol tzex sateli, xchi t'a heb'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Lot chi': --Maay mamin, yuj wal Dios t'ayex.
Te niwanxo he wach'k'olal ix he ch'ox t'ayin, ina ix in eyik'elta yik max in chami. Palta max yal-laj in b'atkan t'a jolomtak witz chi', tekan tzin yamchajk'och yuj jun yaelal chi', tzin chami.
Ha t'a slak'anil tik ay jun yune' chonhab', tzam yal in b'atkan t'ay. ¿Tom max yala' tzin he chab'at ta' yik tzin kol in b'a? Val yel yunenhej jun chonhab' chi', xchi winhaj Lot chi'.
Ix yalan jun ángel chi': --Toxo ix wab'i, yik'okab' icha tzal chi'. Manh ol in satel jun chonhab' ix al chi'.
Elanhchamel he b'ati, yujto malaj tas syal in b'oani ta maxto ex k'och ta', xchi jun ángel chi'. Yuj chi' Zoar ix sb'iejkan jun chonhab' chi'.
Ayic wan sjawi k'u ix k'och winhaj Lot chi' t'a jun chonhab' chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'ankot k'ak' Jehová yet' azufre t'a satcha’anh t'a yib'anh chonhab' Sodoma yet' Gomorra chi'.
Ix satel juntzanh chonhab' chi' yet' masanil heb' kajan t'ay yet' masanil jun niwan ak'lik chi' yet' tas sq'uib' t'ay.
Ha ix yetb'eyum winhaj Lot chi', najat tzak'anto skot ix, ix meltzajxikanb'at k'elan ix t'a spatik. Ata' ix ochkan ix atz'amil.
Axo t'a yewial slolon winhaj Abraham yet' Jehová, t'a q'uinhib'alil, ix b'at winh b'aj lolon heb' chi'.
Axo ix yilan winh to a Sodoma yet' Gomorra yet' masanil jun ak'lik chi', b'akaquixonhej sk'e stab'il icha sk'e stab'il junok niwan horno.

Ayic ix satjiel juntzanh chonhab' chi' yuj Dios t'a jun niwan ak'lik b'aj ix ek' kajan winhaj Lot chi', ix snaankot Dios tas ix sk'an winhaj Abraham, yuj chi' ix kolchaj winhaj Lot chi' t'a skal jun niwan yaelal chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix xiw winhaj Lot skajnaj t'a chonhab' Zoar chi', yuj chi' ix k'ekan winh t'a jolomtak witz yet' heb' ix yisil schawanhil, ix kajnaj heb' t'a yol jun k'een nhak'een.
Ay jun k'ual ix yal ix b'ab'el ix t'a ix snulej: --Ha winh ko mam tik, te ichamxo winh, malaj junok winak t'a jun lugar tik syal quik'lan ko b'a yet'ok icha sb'eyb'al heb' anima.
Yuj chi' kak' yuk' anh winh ko mam tik, yik ol onh way yet' winh, yik wach' ol kan yinhtilal winh qued'ok, xchi ix.

Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi', ix yak' anh heb' ix yuk' winh, ix k'e anh t'a sjolom winh. Yuj chi' a ix b'ab'el ix, ix way yet' winh. Maj yab' winh janik' ix way ix yet'ok, maj yab'pax winh janik' ix k'exwan ix t'a stz'ey.

Axo t'a junxo k'u ix yalan ix b'ab'el chi' t'a ix snulej chi': --Ha q'uiq'ui t'ak'wal ix in way yet' winh ko mam tik, haxo tiknaik kak'xi anh yuk' winh yik wach' tzach way yet' winh yik ol kan yinhtilal winh qued' ko chawanhil, xchi ix.

Yuj chi' t'a jun ak'wal chi', ix yak'anxi anh heb' ix yuk' winh smam chi', haxo ix schab'il chi' ix way yet' winh. Palta a winhaj Lot chi', maj yab' winh janik' ix way ix yet'ok, maj yab'pax winh janik' ix k'exwan ix.
Icha chi' ix aj yochkan heb' ix yisil winh chi' schawanhil yab'ixal yuj.
Ha ix b'ab'el, ix alji yune' ix, Moab ix yak' ix sb'iej, aton winh aykan yinhtilal heb' moabita tiknaik.
Ix aljipax yune' ix schab'il chi', Ben-ammi, ix yak' ix sb'iej, aton winh aykan yinhtilal heb' amonita tiknaik.
Ix el winhaj Abraham chi' t'a yol yik winhaj Mamre, ix b'atkan kajan winh t'a yol yik Neguev t'a jun chonhab' skuch Gerar. Ha t'a skal Cades yet' Shur, ata' ay Gerar chi'.
Ayic ayek' winh ta', ix yal winh to manh yetb'eyumok ix Sara winh, yanab' ix winh yalani. Ha winhaj Abimelec sreyal Gerar chi', ix schek winh ik'chajkot ix Sara chi' yik tz'och ix yetb'eyumok yalani.
Ay jun ak'wal, ix lolon Dios t'a winh rey chi' t'a swayich icha tik: Ol ach chamok, yujto a ix ix, ix ik'kot etb'eyumok alani, ay yetb'eyum ix, xchi t'a winh.
Palta manto waylaj winh yet' ix Sara chi', yuj chi' ix yalan winh: Mamin, malaj in mul, ¿tom tzin a satel yet' in chonhab' tik?
Yujto a winhaj Abraham chi' ix alan t'ayin to yanab' ix winh. Ix yalanpax ix t'ayin: In nulej winh, xchi ix. Ha in tik ix in k'ulej t'a smasanil in k'ool, manhok chukal naan wuuj, xchi winh rey chi'.
Ix tak'wi Dios t'a winh: Vojtak to ix a k'ulej jun tik t'a stojolal, yuj chi' maj in cha a yam ix, yik wach' max och a mul t'ayin.

Ha tiknaik, ak' meltzaj ix t'a winh yetb'eyum chi', yujto in chekab' yaj winh. Syal slesalwi winh uuj yik max ach chami. Palta tato max ak' meltzaj ix jun, wal yel ol ach chamok, ol champax jantak heb' kajan ed'ok, xchi Dios t'a winh.
Axo ix q'uinhib'i, ix k'e waan winh rey chi', ix yawtankot masanil heb' schekab' winh, ix yalan winh t'a heb' tas ix swayichej chi'. Ayic ix yab'an jun chi' heb', ix te xiw heb'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix schekan winh rey chi' awtaj winhaj Abraham chi', ix yalan winh: --¿Tas yuj icha tik ix in utej? ¿Tas in mul t'ayach, yuj chi' ijan tzik'kot jun niwan mul tik t'a wib'anh yet' t'a yib'anh jantak heb' in chonhab' tik? Manh wach'ok ix in utej.
¿Tas ix a na' yuj chi' icha tik ix a k'ulej? xchi winh rey chi'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Abraham chi' t'a winh: --Ha in naani to ha t'a jun lugar tik malaj mach xiw d'ha Dios. Q'uinalok ay mach tzin mak'ancham yuj ix wetb'eyum tik in naani.
Val yel wanab' ix, yisil ix winh in mam, palta ch'ok snun ix, yuj chi' ix yal wik'lan in b'a yet' ix.
Ayic ix yalan Dios to tzin el t'a spat winh in mam, ix in k'anan pawor t'a ix to sch'ox swach'k'olal ix t'ayin, yuj chi' yalnhej b'aj tzonh eq'ui, syal ix to wanab' ix, xchi winhaj Abraham chi'.
Ix yak'anxi meltzaj ix Sara chi' winh t'a winhaj Abraham chi'. Ix ak'jipax nok' kalnel, nok' wakax, heb' winh chekab' yet' heb' ix chekab' t'a winh yuj winh rey chi'.
Ix yalanxi winh rey chi' t'a winh: --Ina in makb'en tik, syal a sik'lani b'ajtil syal a kajnaji, xchi winh rey chi' t'a winh.

Ix yalanpax winh rey chi' t'a ix Sara: --Ix wak' mil siklo k'een plata t'a winh a nulej tik, yik tz'och spakok t'ayach, yik sko ch'oxaneli to malaj a mul ix ochi, yik wach' malaj mach syal yalan chukal t'a a patik, xchi winh t'a ix.

Ixlajwi chi' ix lesalwi winhaj Abraham chi' d'ha Dios yuj winhaj Abimelec chi'. Yuj chi' ix yik'xiel skatab' Dios chi' t'a yib'anh winh yet' ix yetb'eyum yet' heb' ix schekab' winh, yik tz'aljixi yune' heb' ix.
Yujto yujnhej ix Sara chi', manhxa junok heb' ix ayek' t'a spat winhaj Abimelec chi' ixto unewi junok tiempoal yuj Jehová.
Icha ix aj yalan Jehová Dios t'a ix Sara to ol aljok junok yune' ix, icha chi' ix aj yelk'ochi.
Ix skuchoch yune' ix, ix alji ayik te icham winakxo winhaj Abraham chi'. Ix alji jun swinak unin ix, icha wal stiempoal alb'ilkan yuj Dios.
Isaac ix sb'iej yuj winhaj Abraham chi'.
Yukub'ixial yalji winh unin chi', ix ak'jioch yechel strato Dios t'a sniwanil winh yuj winhaj Abraham chi' icha yaj yalan Dios t'a winh.
Cien ab'ilxo sk'inal winhaj Abraham chi' ayik ix alji winhaj Isaac.
Ix yalan ix Sara icha tik: Ix in yak' tzewaj ko Mam Dios. Masanil heb' tz'ab'ani to ay wune', ol tzewajpax heb' wed'ok.
¿Toc ay heb' anima ix alan t'a winhaj Abraham, tato olto wak' chunok unin? Palta ixto alji wune' yet' winh wach'chom icham winakxo winh, xchi ix Sara chi'.
Ix q'uib' winhaj Isaac, ix el winh t'a yim, yuj chi' ix yak'och jun niwan q'uinh winhaj Abraham chi'.
Axo ix yilan ix Sara to a jun yuninal winhaj Abraham yet' ix Agar, ix aj Egipto, sb'uchwaj t'a winhaj Isaac chi'.

Yuj chi' ix ak'ji sk'ol winhaj Abraham yuj ix Sara chi', ix yalan ix: Pechb'at ix kriada tik yet' winh yune' tik, yujto malaj in gana ol yik' yik winh t'a tastak ol ak'kan t'a winh wune' aj Isaac tik, xchi ix.
Ha jun lolonel tik te ya ix och t'a winhaj Abraham chi', yujto yuninal pax winhaj Ismael chi' winh.

Axo Dios ix alan t'a winh: Manh ach kus yuj winh unin tik yet' pax ix a kriada tik. k'anab'ajejnhej tas syal ix Sara chi', yujto ha t'a winhaj Isaac tik ol b'eynhejb'at jantak inhtilal, icha ix aj walan t'ayach.
Ha pax winh yune' ix kriada chi' jun, a in ol in b'o jun niwan nakión t'a yinhtilal winh yujto uninal pax winh, xchi Dios.

Axo t'a junxo k'u te ak'walto, ix yik'ankot wael winhaj Abraham chi' yet' jun nok' tz'uum yet'tal ha' b'ut'an, ix yak'an winh skuch ix Agar chi', ix ak'jipax winh yune' ix t'a yol sk'ab', ix tak'ajb'at heb' yuj winh. Ix b'at ix, ix satb'eyek' ix t'a jun tzinan lu'um t'a yol yik Beerseba.
Ayic ix lajwi ha ha' t'a yol nok' tz'um chi', ix yaktankan winh yune' ix chi' t'a yich jun te' yune' te'.
Najattac ix b'at ix, ix em k'ojan ix, yik wach' max yil ix scham winh yune' chi' snaani. Ayic ix em k'ojan ix chi', ix k'e sjaj winh yoq'ui.

Ix yab'an Dios yok' winh, ato t'a satcha’anh ix lolonemta yángel Dios t'a ix Agar chi', ix yalani: Ach Agar, ¿tas tzach ik'ani? Manh ach xiwok, ha Dios toxo ix ab'an yel yaw winh une' chi' yok' b'aj ix aktejkan chi'.
Ixic b'at il winh, tzik'ank'e wan winh, tza montan winh, yujto a yet' yinhtilal winh ol in b'o jun niwan nakión, xchi.
Axo Dios ix ak'an yil jun sjaj ha ha' ix Agar chi', ix b'at ix, ix yak'an b'ud'jok nok' tz'uum chi' ix t'ha ha', ix yak'an ha' ix yuk' winh yune' chi'.
Ha Dios ix och yet' winhaj Ismael chi', ix q'uib' winh. Ix kannhej winh t'a jun tzinan lum t'a yol yik Parán. Te julum nok' ix aj winh. Axo ix snun winh ix sayan jun ix aj Egipto yik'a'.

Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', ix jawi winhaj Abimelec t'a winhaj Abraham, ajun winhaj Ficol yajal yaj t'a heb' soldado yet' winh. Ix yalan winhaj Abimelec t'a winhaj Abraham chi' icha tik: --Ix quila' to ha Dios aynhejoch ed'ok t'a masanil tas tza k'ulej.

Yuj chi' ak' a ti' t'ayin t'a yichanh Dios t'a jun lugar tik, to manh ol ak' chukal t'ayin, t'a heb' wuninal yet' pax t'a heb' winhtilal. Tzak'an a ti' to wach'nhej ol utej a b'a t'ayin, icha ix wutej in b'a t'ayach. Icha pax chi' ol utej a b'ha t'a heb' anima kajan t'a jun chonhab' b'aj janak ach kajan tik, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Abraham chi': --Swak' in ti'.
Palta ay jun ha' uk'b'ila' in chek joychajnak ix yik'ek' heb' winh a chekab', xchi winh t'a winh.
Ix tak'wixi winhaj Abimelec chi': --Val yel manh wojtakok tas yaj jun chi', malaj tas tzal t'ayin, ato tiknaik swab'i. Mach am ix k'ulan jun chi', xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yik'ankot nok' kalnel winhaj Abraham chi' yet' nok' wakax, ix yak'an nok' winh t'a winhaj Abimelec chi'. Ha t'a jun k'u chi' ix sb'okan jun strato heb' chi' schawanhil.
Ha winhaj Abraham chi' ix yik'elta ukwanh nok' kob'estak kalnel winh t'a skal nok' skalnel.
Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'an winhaj Abimelec chi': --¿Tas yuj tzik'elta nok' kalnel chi'? xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Abraham chi' icha tik: --Cha nok' t'ayin, a nok' sch'oxani to a in in joynak jun ha' uk'b'ila' tik, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' Beerseba ix sb'iejkan jun lugar chi', yujto ata' ix yak'kan sti' heb' t'ay junjun.
Icha chi' ix aj sb'oankan jun strato heb' t'a Beerseba chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzaj winhaj Abimelec yet' winhaj Ficol t'a schonhab', aton schonhab' heb' filisteo.
