Yic wal ayoch ix t'a ilk'olal yuj yab'an syail, haxo ix wetz'wajum ix alani: Manh ach xiwok, toxo ix alji junxo a winak unin, xchi ix.
Palta ayik wanxo scham ix yuj jun unin chi', ix sayankan sb'i ix, Ben-oni ix sb'iejkani. Axo winhaj Jacob chi' jun, Benjamín ix yak' winh sb'iej.
Ata' ix chamkan ix Raquel chi'. Ix mukchajkan ix t'a sb'eal Efrata, aton jun lugar chi' skuch Belén tiknaik.
Ix sb'oank'e linhan jun kimiento winhaj Jacob t'a yib'anh b'aj ix mukchaj sniwanil ix chi', aton jun chi' sch'oxankan b'ajtil mukan ix.
Ix b'atnhej winhaj Israel chi', ix sb'oan skampamento winh t'a yichanhb'at Torre yik Edar.

Yakb'an kajan ek' heb' t'a jun lugar chi', haxo winhaj Rubén, yuninal winhaj Israel chi' ix way winh yet' ix Bilha, schab'il yetb'eyum winh smam chi'. Ix yab' winhaj Israel chi' tas ix sk'ulej winh yunin chi'. Lajchawanh heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jacob chi':
Ha heb' winh yuninal winh yet' ix Lea: Aton winhaj Rubén, winh b'ab'el unin, winhaj Simeón, winhaj Leví, winhaj Judá, winhaj Isacar yet' winhaj Zabulón.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winh yet' ix Raquel: Aton winhaj José yet' winhaj Benjamín.
Axo heb' yuninal winh yet' ix Bilha, ix skriada ix Raquel: Aton winhaj Dan yet' winhaj Neftalí.
Axo pax heb' yuninal winh yet' ix Zilpa, ix skriada ix Lea: Aton winhaj Gad yet' winhaj Aser. Aton heb' tik yuninal winhaj Jacob ix alji t'a Padán-aram.
Ix b'at winhaj Jacob yil winh smam, aton winhaj Isaac, kajan t'a lum Mamre, t'a chonhab' Arba, Hebrón pax sb'i. Ata' ek'nak winhaj Abraham yet' winhaj Isaac chi'.
180 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Isaac chi' ayik ix cham winh.
Te ichamxo winh, haxo winhaj Esaú yet' winhaj Jacob, aton heb' winh yuninal winh, a heb' winh ix mukankan winh.
Aton yab'ixal yinhtilal winhaj Esaú, Edom pax sb'i.
Ix yik'laj sb'a winhaj Esaú yet' heb' ix aj Canaán: Aton yet' ix Ada, yisil winhaj Elón hitita yet' pax ix Aholibama yisil winhaj Aná, yixchiquin winhaj Zibeón heweo.
Ix yik'anpax ix Basemat winh, ix yisil winhaj Ismael. Ay jun winh snulej ix Basemat chi' skuchan Nebaiot.
Ha yune' ix Ada yet' winhaj Esaú, aton winhaj Elifaz. Axo pax ix Basemat ix alji yune' ix, aton winhaj Reuel.
Axo pax ix Aholibama ix alji heb' yune' ix: Aton winhaj Jeús, winhaj Jaalam yet' winhaj Coré. Aton heb' yuninal winhaj Esaú tik ix aj t'a yol yik Canaán, ayik kajantoek' winh ta'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'anb'at heb' ix yetb'eyum winhaj Esaú chi' yet' heb' yuninal yet' masanil heb' kajanek' yet'ok. Ix b'at heb' t'a junxo lugar, yik tz'el winh t'a stz'ey winhaj Jacob, winh yuk'tak. Ix yik'anel masanil nok' smolb'etzal nok' winh t'a Canaán chi'.
Yujto tzijtumxo tas ay t'a heb' winh schawanhil, yuj chi' max yal-laj junnhej tz'aj heb' winh, yujto max yab'laj lum lum b'aj swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Esaú chi', ix b'at kajnaj winh t'a tzalquixtak t'a yol yik Seir.
Aton tik yab'ixal heb' yinhtilal winhaj Esaú, aton heb' smam yicham heb' winh edomita, heb' winh ix kajnajek' t'a tzalquixtak t'a Seir.
Aton sb'i heb' yinhtilal winhaj Esaú: Vinhaj Elifaz, yune' ix Ada, winhaj Reuel yune' ix Basemat.
Aton heb' tik yuninal winhaj Elifaz: Vinhaj Temán, winhaj Omar, winhaj Zefo, winhaj Gatam yet' winhaj Cenaz.
Ay jun ix schab'il yetb'eyum winhaj Elifaz chi', Timna sb'i ix. Ix alji jun yune' ix, Amalec ix yak' ix sb'iej. Aton heb' tik yixchiquin ix Ada, ix yetb'eyum winhaj Esaú.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Reuel: Vinhaj Nahat, winhaj Zera, winhaj Sama yet' winhaj Miza, aton heb' tik yixchiquin ix Basemat, junxo ix yetb'eyum winhaj Esaú.
Aholibama sb'i junxo ix yetb'eyum winhaj Esaú chi', haxo heb' yune' ix aton winhaj Jeús, winhaj Jaalam yet' winhaj Coré. Ha ix Aholibama chi' yisil ix winhaj Aná, yixchiquin winhaj Zibeón.

Ha heb' yajalil chonhab' ix el t'a skal yinhtilal winhaj Esaú, aton heb' tik: Ha heb' ix el t'a yinhtilal winhaj Elifaz, b'ab'el yuninal winhaj Esaú: Aton winhaj Temán, winhaj Omar, winhaj Zefo, winhaj Cenaz,
winhaj Coré, winhaj Gatam yet' winhaj Amalec. Ha juntzanh heb' winh yajal tik ix el t'a yinhtilal winhaj Elifaz t'a yol yik Edom. Masanil juntzanh heb' winh tik, yixchiquin heb' winh ix Ada.

Ha t'a skal heb' yuninal winhaj Reuel yuninal winhaj Esaú, a heb' ix och yajalilok chonhab': Aton winhaj Nahat, winhaj Zera, winhaj Sama yet' winhaj Miza. Ha heb' yajal tik ix el t'a yinhtilal winhaj Reuel t'a yol yik Edom. Masanil juntzanh heb' winh tik, yixchiquin heb' winh ix Basemat yetb'eyum winhaj Esaú.
Ha heb' yune' ix Aholibama yisil winhaj Aná, yetb'eyum winhaj Esaú, ix och yajalilok chonhab': Aton winhaj Jeús, winhaj Jaalam yet' winhaj Coré.
Masanil juntzanh heb' winh yajal tik, yinhtilal heb' winhaj Esaú.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Seir horeo, a heb' kajan t'a jun lugar chi' ayik manto k'och winhaj Esaú: Aton winhaj Lotán, winhaj Sobal, winhaj Zibeón, winhaj Aná,
winhaj Disón, winhaj Ezer yet' winhaj Disán. Aton heb' tik yajalil chonhab' t'a skal heb' horeo, heb' yinhtilal Seir, t'a yol yik Edom.
Axo heb' yuninal winhaj Lotán, aton heb' tik: Vinhaj Hori yet' winhaj Hemam. Timna sb'i ix yanab' winhaj Lotán chi'.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Sobal, aton heb' tik: Vinhaj Alván, winhaj Manahat, winhaj Ebal, winhaj Sefo yet' winhaj Onam.
Eb' yuninal winhaj Zibeón, aton winhaj Aja yet' winhaj Aná. Ayic ix stanhwan nok' sb'uru winh smam winhaj Aná chi' t'a tzinan lu'um, ix ilchaj jun sjaj ha ha' yuj winh.
Axo winhaj Aná chi', ay jun yuninal winh skuchan Disón, ay pax jun ix yisil winh skuchan Aholibama.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Disón, aton heb' tik: Vinhaj Hemdán, winhaj Esbán, winhaj Itrán yet' winhaj Querán.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Ezer, aton heb' tik: Vinhaj Bilhán, winhaj Zaaván yet' winhaj Acán.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Disán, aton winhaj Uz yet' winhaj Arán.
Ha heb' yajalil chonhab' t'a skal heb' horeo t'a yol yik Seir, aton heb' tik: Vinhaj Lotán, winhaj Sobal, winhaj Zibeón, winhaj Aná, winhaj Disón, winhaj Ezer yet' winhaj Disán.
Aton heb' winh tik ix yak' yajalil t'a Edom, ayik mantalaj sreyal heb' israel.
Ha winhaj Bela, yuninal winhaj Beor aj Dinaba, ix yak' reyal winh t'a Edom.
Ayic ix cham winh, ix ochkan winhaj Jobab yuninal winhaj Zera aj Bosra reyal sk'exulok winh.
Ayic ix cham winhaj Jobab chi', haxo winhaj Husam aj Temán, ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.
Ayic ix cham winhaj Husam chi', haxo winhaj Hadad yuninal winhaj Bedad aj chonhab' Awit ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh. Aton winh ix ak'an ganar heb' aj Madián t'a yol yik Moab.
Ayic ix cham winhaj Hadad chi', haxo winhaj Samla aj Masreca ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.
Ayic ix cham winhaj Samla chi', haxo winhaj Saúl aj chonhab' Rehobot ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh. Ha jun chonhab' Rehobot chi', ha t'a sti' ha' niwan Éufrates ay.
Ayic ix cham winhaj Saúl chi', haxo winhaj Baal-hanán yuninal winhaj Acbor ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.
Ayic ix cham winhaj Baal-hanán chi', haxo winhaj Hadad aj Pau ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh. Axo ix yetb'eyum winhaj Hadad chi', Mehetabel sb'i ix, yune' ix ix Matred, yixchiquin winhaj Mezaab.

Aton sb'i heb' yajalil chonhab' ix el t'a yinhtilal winhaj Esaú tik: Vinhaj Timna, winhaj Alwa, winhaj Jetet, winhaj Aholibama, winhaj Ela, winhaj Pinón, winhaj Cenaz, winhaj Temán, winhaj Mibzar, winhaj Magdiel yet' winhaj Iram. Anhejtona' a sb'i heb' ix och t'a junjun lugar b'aj ix ek' heb'. Ha winhaj Esaú chi' Edom pax sb'i winh, aton smam yicham heb' edomita.
Ha winhaj Jacob ix kannhej kajan winh t'a Canaán b'aj ek'nak kajan smam.

Aton yab'ixal winhaj Jacob tik. Ha winhaj José yuninal winhaj Jacob, 17 ab'il sk'inal winh, tanhwoj kalnel syak' winh yet' heb' winh yuk'tak. Ha heb' winh yuk'tak winh chi', aton heb' winh yune' ix Bilha yet' ix Zilpa, heb' ix chab'il yetb'eyum winhaj Jacob. Ha winhaj José chi' tz'ik'ankot ab'ix t'a winh smam tato manh wach'ok syutej sb'a heb' winh yuk'tak winh chi'.
Te xajan winhaj José chi' yuj winh smam t'a yichanh juntzanhxo heb' winh yuk'tak chi', yujto yolxo yichamwinaquil ix alji winh. Yuj chi' ix sb'o jun spichul winh, tz'ib'iltak yilji.
Ha ix yilan juntzanhxo heb' winh yuk'tak winh chi' to yelxo wal te xajan winhaj José chi' yuj winh smam chi', ix te chichon sk'ol heb' winh t'a winh, te chuk slolon heb' winh t'a winh.

Ay jun swayich winhaj José chi' ix ochi, ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh yuk'tak chi' icha tik: --Ab'ek wal in wayich. Ix in wayichej to wan ko jochwi trigo, junjun onh qued' junjun manoja quiko'. D'a jun rato chi' ix k'e linhan ixim wiko' yet' ixim eyik chi', haxo ixim eyik chi' ix em nhojan ixim t'a spatik yichanh ixim wik chi', xchi winh. Ix tak'wi heb' winh yuk'tak winh chi' icha tik: --¿Am syalelk'och jun tzal chi' to ol ach och ko reyalok? ¿A ach am ol ala' tas ol ko k'ulej? xchi heb' winh. Ix te kot yowal heb' winh yuj swayich winh ix yal chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix och junxo swayich winhaj José chi', ix yalanxi winh t'a heb' winh yuk'tak chi' icha tik: --Ay wal junxo in wayich ix ochi. Ha t'a jun in wayich chi' ix wila'', to a k'u yet' k'een uj yet' uxluche' k'anal ix em nhojan t'ayin, xchi winh.

Ayic ix yalan swayich winh chi' t'a winh smam yet' t'a heb' winh yuk'tak chi', ix kot yowal winh smam winh chi, ix yalan winh t'a winh icha tik: --¿Tas syalelk'och jun a wayich chi? ¿Tom ol in em nhojan yet' ix a nun yet' heb' winh uk'tak tik t'a ichanh? xchi winh.
Icha chi' ix aj sk'e waan schichonk'olal heb' winh yuk'tak winh chi' t'a spatik, palta haxo winh smam winh chi', ix snaub'tanhej wal winh tas wal syalelk'och jun swayich winh chi'.
Ay jun k'ual ix b'at heb' winh yuk'tak winhaj José chi' t'a Siquem say b'aj wach' swa nok' skalnel winh smam heb' winh chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Israel t'a winhaj José chi' icha tik: --Ha tiknaik a heb' winh uk'tak, ha t'a Siquem ayek' heb' winh tanhwoj kalnel, tzin nib'ej tzach b'at il heb' winh, xchi winh. --Inye, ol in b'atok, xchi winhaj José chi'.

--Wach' jun, ixik, yik wach' tzila' chajtil yaj heb' winh yet' nok' kalnel chi', tzul alan wab'i, xchi winh smam winh chi'. D'a sch'olanil lum Hebrón ayek' winhaj José chi' ayik ix chekjib'at winh yuj winh smam. Axo yik ix k'och winh t'a yol yik Siquem,
ix ek'chaj winh sayek' heb' winh yuk'tak chi' ta'. Ay jun winh winak ix schalaj sb'a winh yet'ok, ix sk'anb'an winh winak chi' icha tik: --¿Tas tzek' a saya'? xchi winh t'a winhaj José chi'.
--To tzin ek' in say heb' winh wuk'tak. ¿Maj am ila' b'ajtil stanhwej nok' kalnel heb' winh? xchi winhaj José chi'.

--Toxo ix b'at heb' winh t'a tik. Ix wab' yalan heb' winh: Wach' tzonh b'at t'a Dotán, xchi heb' winh ix wab'i, xchi winh winak chi'. Ix b'atnhej winhaj José chi', ix ilchaj heb' winh yuk'tak winh chi' yuj t'a Dotán chi'.
Ayic ix yilanb'at winh heb' winh t'a najat, ayto wal sk'och winh t'a heb' winh, ix slajtian sb'a heb' winh tas syutej heb' winh smilancham winh.
Ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --Ina sja winh swayichani.

Co milekcham winh, ol ko julankanb'at winh t'a yol junok jul, ol kalani to a am junok nok' nok' chium anima ix chianb'at winh. Ol quilan b'ian tas ol aj yelk'och juntzanh swayich winh chi', xchi heb' winh.
Ayic ix yab'an juntzanh lolonel chi' winhaj Rubén, ix snaan winh tas wach' syutej skolanel winhaj José chi' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: --Maay, manh ko milekchamlaj winh.

Mokab' och schamel winh chi' ko mulok. Anhejto skak'em winh t'a yol junok yet'tal ha' joyb'il t'a tzinan lum tik. Mokab'a junok onh tz'och ko k'ab' t'a winh, xchi winh. Ix yal jun lolonel chi' winhaj Rubén chi', yujto snib'ej winh skolkan winhaj José chi', yik wach' syak' meltzaj winh winh t'a winh smam.
Axo ix k'och winhaj José b'aj ayek' heb' winh yuk'tak chi', elanhchamel ix tzak'jikot winh yuj heb' winh. Ix yik'anel spichul winh heb' winh ayochi, aton jun tz'ib'iltak yilji.
Ixlajwi chi' ix ak'jiem winh yuj heb' t'a yol jun yet'tal ha' jul yich, malaj ha ha' t'a yool.

Ixlajwi chi' ix em k'ojan heb' winh wael. Yakb'an chi' jun, ix yilan heb' winh skot jun nhilanh heb' winh ismaelita ix kot t'a Galaad. Ha perfume, bálsamo yet' mirra ayoch yib'anh skamello heb' winh, sb'at heb' winh schonh t'a Egipto.
Ix yalan winhaj Judá t'a heb' yuk'tak chi' icha tik: --¿Tas skak' ganar sko milancham winh kuk'tak tik, sko k'ub'aneli to maj quila' b'aj ix cham winh?
Wach' ama to sko chonhb'at winh t'a heb' winh ismaelita wan sja tik. Mokab' ko milcham winh yujto kuk'tak ko b'a yet' winh, xchi winh. Ix schaan sk'ol heb' winh chi' tas ix yal winhaj Judá chi'.

Axo yik ix ek' heb' winh aj Madián chi', elanhchamel ix ik'chajk'eta winhaj José t'a yol jun jul chi', ix schonhanb'at winh heb' winh t'a heb' winh chonhwajum chi'. 20 siklo plata ix yak' heb' winh t'a heb' winh stojolok. Icha chi' ix aj yik'chajb'at winhaj José chi' t'a Egipto.
Ayic ix jax winhaj Rubén chi', ix b'at winh yil t'a sti' jun jul chi', manhxalaj winhaj José chi' ayeq'ui. Ix snhik'chitanb'at sjaj spichul winh yuj skusk'olal.
Ix b'at lemnaj winh t'a heb' winh yuk'tak chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: --Manhxo ayoquem winh kuk'tak t'a jun jul chi'. ¿Tas wach' tzin k'ulej tiknaik? xchi winh.
Ha t'a jun rato chi', ix smilancham jun nok' yune' chiwa heb' winh. Ix yik'anelta schiq'uil nok' heb' winh, ix sb'onhanoch heb' winh t'a spichul winhaj José chi'.
Ix yak'anb'at jun pichul chi' heb' winh t'a winh smam, ix yalanb'at heb' winh icha tik: Ix ilchaj jun pichul tik kuuj, ilnab'i talaj a spichul winh uninal, xchib'at heb' winh.

Ayic ix yilan winhaj Jacob, to aton spichul winhaj José, ix yalan winh icha tik: Ay... aton wal spichul winh wuninal tik. Ay am wal junok nok' schi'an anima ix tzilchitanb'at winh, ix schianb'at wuninal, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix snhik'chitanel spichul winh, ix yak'anoch jun pichul winh yik kusk'olal. Te niwan tiempo ix ok' winh yuj winh yunin chi'.

Masanil heb' yuninal winh yet' heb' ix yisil winh, ix yak'lej heb' yak'an sniwanil sk'ol winh, palta max yal-laj sk'ol winh tz'ak'ji sniwanil sk'ool. Tz'ok'nhej winh yuj winh yuninal chi'. Ix yalan winh icha tik: Ol te kusnhej wal in k'ool yuj winh wuninal masanto ol in b'at b'aj ayek' winh t'a skal heb' chamnak, xchi winh.
Axo heb' winh aj Madián chi', ayik ix k'och heb' winh t'a Egipto chi', ix schonhanxib'at winhaj José chi' heb' winh t'a winhaj Potifar, yajal heb' stanhwan winh rey t'a Egipto chi'.
Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', a winhaj Judá ix spojel sb'a winh t'a heb' yuk'tak, ix b'at kajnaj winh t'a slak'anil jun winh winak skuchan Hira, aj chonhab' Adulam.
Ata' ix yiloch ix yisil jun winh aj Canaán skuchan Súa winh, ix yik'lan sb'a winh yet' ix.
Ix skuchanoch yune' ix. Ayic ix alji yune' ix chi', Er ix sb'iej.
Ixlajwi chi' ix skuchanxioch yune' ix. Ayic ix alji yune' ix chi', Onán ix yak' ix sb'iej.
Ix skuchanoch junxo yune' ix. Ayic ix alji, Sela ix yak' ix sb'iej. Ha t'a Quezib ayek' winhaj Judá chi' ayik ix alji winh unin chi'.
Axo yik ix quelemax winhaj Er b'ab'el unin chi', ix sayji yetb'eyum winh yuj winhaj Judá chi', ix yik'an ix Tamar winh.
Te chuk ix yutej sb'a winhaj Er chi' t'a yichanh Jehová, yuj chi' ix cham winh yuj.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Judá t'a winhaj Onán icha tik: --Ik'laj a b'a yet' ix yetb'eyum winh uk'tak chamnak, tza k'anab'ajej ko ley, ichato yinhtilal winh uk'tak chi' ol elkan uuj yet' ix, xchi winhaj Judá chi'.

Palta yojtak winhaj Onán chi' to a unin ol aljok chi', manh yikok winh ol aj yet' ix smu' chi', yuj chi' juntak el sway winh yet' ix, haxo yinhatil winh syak'kanem winh t'a sat lu'um yik max och ix yab'ixal, yik wach' max elkanlaj yinhtilal winh yuk'tak winh chi' snaani.
Ha tas ix sk'ulej winh chi', chuk t'a sat Jehová, yuj chi' ix cham winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Judá t'a ix yalib' chi' icha tik: --Ha tiknaik wach' tzach paxkan yet' a mam a nun. Malaj junokxo winak wach' tzik'a'. Ato yik ol k'och sk'inal winhaj Sela wuninal, ichato chi' ol yal ik'an a b'a yet' winh, xchi winhaj Judá chi'. Tonhej ix yal winh icha chi', q'uinalok schampax winhaj Sela chi' snaan winh, icha ix aj scham chawanh heb' winh yuk'tak. Icha chi' ix aj sb'at ix Tamar yik skajnaj ix yet' smam snun.

Pecatax chi' ix cham ix yetb'eyum winhaj Judá chi', ix yisil winhaj Súa. Ixlajwi yek'b'at skusk'olal winh, ix b'at winh t'a chonhab' Timnat b'aj wan sjoxchajel xil nok' skalnel, haxo jun winh yamigo winh skuchan Hira ix b'at yuk'lewok.
Axo yik ix yab'an spekal ix Tamar to wan sb'at winhaj Judá t'a Timnat yil sjoxchajel nok' skalnel,

t'a elanhchamel ix yik'el spichul ix, aton k'apak syak'och heb' ix chamnak yetb'eyum. Ix yak'anoch jun smusil sat ix, yik wach' malaj mach snaaneli tato a ix. Ix em k'ojan ix t'a stiel chonhab' b'aj sk'och sb'eal chonhab' Enaim, t'a sb'eal Timnat chi'. Ix sk'ulej jun tik ix, yujto ix nachajel yuj ix to a winhaj Sela ix q'uib'el winh, palta maxto yik'laj sb'a winh yet' ix.
Ayic ix yilanb'at ix winhaj Judá chi', ix snaan winh to ajmul ix jun ix chi', yujto musab'il sat ix.

Ix el winhaj Judá chi' t'a yol b'e, ix b'at winh yilb'at ix. Manh yojtakok winh tato a ix yalib' winh. Ix yalan winh t'a ix icha tik: --¿Max am yal a k'ool tzin way ed'ok? xchi winh. --Tato syal in k'ool ¿tas junok tzak' t'ayin? xchi ix.
--Ol wak'kot junok yune' a chiwa, xchi winh t'a ix. --Tzam yala', anhej tato ay junok tas tzak'kan t'ayin tiknaik. Ayic sjawi nok' in yune' chiwa chi', swak'anxi meltzaj t'ayach, xchi ix.

--¿Tas pax tza nib'ej swak'kan t'ayach? xchi winhaj Judá chi'. --Ak'kan a sello yet' sch'anhal yet' a k'okoch ed'nak, xchi ix. --Syala', kanokab'i, xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix way winh yet' ix, ix skuchankanoch yune' ix.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at ix, ix yik'anel smusil sat ix chi', ix yak'anxioch sk'apak ix syak'och heb' ix chamnak yetb'eyum.

Ayic ix k'och winhaj Judá b'aj ayek' nok' skalnel chi', ix schekankot winh yamigo winh, aton winh aj Adulam, ix b'at yak'ankan nok' yune' chiwa chi' winh t'a ix ix chi' yik syik'paxta tas aykan chi' t'a ix yuj winhaj Judá chi' yalani, palta majxo ilchajlaj ix yuj winh schekab' win chi'.

Ix sk'anb'anek' winh t'a heb' aj chonhab' chi' icha tik: --¿B'ajtil ay jun ix ajmul ix t'a tik, jun ix tz'emnhej k'ojan t'a sti' sb'eal Enaim tik? xchi winh chekab' chi'. --Malaj junok ix ajmul ix t'a tik, xchi heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzajxi winh t'a winhaj Judá chi', ix yalan winh: --Majxo ilchajlaj ix wuuj, ix yal heb' winh ayek' chi' ta' to malaj junok ix ajmul ix b'aj ay heb' chi', xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Judá icha tik: --Canokab' ix yet' juntzanh chi', yik wach' max el ko q'uixwelal. Ix in k'anab'ajej, ix wak'anb'at nok' yune' chiwa, anhej to majxo ilchaj ix uuj, xchi winh.

Yoxil xom ujal chi', ix b'at alchaj t'a winhaj Judá icha tik: --Ha ix Tamar, ix alib', ay am mach ix sk'umej ix, yuj chi' yab'ixxo ix tiknaik, xchi heb' winh t'a winh. Ix yalan winh: --Ik'equel ix t'a stiel chonhab' yik tze nhusantz'a ix, xchi winh.

Ayic wan yik'jielta ix yuj heb' winh, ix yak'anb'at schekab' ix t'a winhaj Judá chi', ix yalan icha tik: Ha winh ay yik juntzanh swak'b'at tik, aton winh ay yik unin wed'nak tik. B'eyk'olej mach ay yik jun sello yet' sch'anhal tik yet' jun k'okoch tik, xchib'at ix t'a winh.

Ayic ix yilanoch winhaj Judá to yik masanil juntzanh chi' winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: Ha ix ix chi' wach' tas ix sk'ulej ix. Ha in chuk tas ix in k'ulej. Ay in mul. Maj wak'laj yik' sb'a ix yet' winh wuninal aj Sela, xchi winh. Yuj chi' maj nhusjitz'alaj ix. Majxo waylaj winh yet' ix junelxo.
Axo ix b'o sk'ol ix Tamar chi', tiox heb' unin ix alji chi'.
Ayic wan yalji heb' unin chi', ayik ix elul sk'ab' jun b'ab'el, ix spixanoch jab' chak ch'al ix wetz'wajum t'a sjaj sk'ab' jun unin chi', ix yalan ix: Aton jun b'ab'el tik, xchi ix.
Palta ix yik'anxioch sk'ab' jun nene' chi', haxo junxo yuk'tak chi' ix alji sb'ab'elal, yuj chi' Fares ix sb'iej yuj ix wetz'wajum chi'. Ix yalan ix: ¿Tas yuj ix a b'ab'laj equejelta a b'a? xchi ix.
Ixlajwi chi' ix alji winh nene' ayoch anh chak ch'al chi' t'a sjaj sk'ab', Zara ix sb'iej yuj ix.

Ayic ix k'och winhaj José yuj heb' winh ismaelita t'a Egipto chi', ay jun winh skuch Potifar ix mananel winh. Ha jun winh chi', niwan yopisio winh t'a winh sreyal Egipto, yajal yaj winh t'a heb' soldado stanhwan winh rey chi'.
Ha Jehová ayoch yet' winhaj José chi', te wach'nhej yajek' winh t'a spat winh spatrón chi'.
Ix nachajel yuj winh spatrón winh chi' to ay wal och Jehová yet' winh, wach'nhej tz'elk'och winh t'a smasanil.
Yuj chi', te wach'nhej winhaj José t'a yichanh winh spatrón chi'. Ix yak'och winh winh stanhwumalok spat yet' masanil tastak ay t'ay.

Yictax ix yak'anoch winh winhaj Potifar chi' stanhwumalok spat chi', ix yak' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a yib'anh winhaj Potifar chi' yet' masanil tas ay t'a winh. Yujnhej winhaj José chi' ix k'echaanh swach'k'olal t'a spat winh yet' t'a najateli.

Ix kannhej winhaj José chi' stanhwumalok smasanil, yuj chi' manhxalaj tas ix sna' winhaj Potifar chi', palta anhej tas tz'aj sb'o swael winh syila'. Te wach' yilji winhaj José chi', te wach' pax sniwanil winh smasanil.
Ix ek' jab'ok tiempoal, haxo ix yetb'eyum winhaj Potifar chi', ix te kan snib'ej ix t'a winhaj José chi'. Ix yalan ix t'a winh icha tik: --Octom wal syal a k'ool tzach way wed'ok, xchi ix.

Te maj schalaj sk'ol winhaj José tas ix yal ix chi'. Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Maay, ojtak ach tik to ix in yak'och winh etb'eyum stanhwumalok masanil stastak t'a tik. Ina manhxo jab'ok tas sna' winh yuj masanil stastak yakb'an ay in eq'ui.

Malaj junokxo mach niwan yelk'och t'a wichanh t'a jun pat tik. Masanil tastak ayoch t'a yol in k'ab', anhej t'ayach a ach tik, max yal-laj wak'anoch in k'ab', yujto yetb'eyum ach winh in patrón, ¿tom ol yal in k'ulan jun niwan chukal, yik tz'och in mul t'a sat Dios? xchi winh.
Ix ochnhej ijan ix stewioch t'a winh. Junjun k'u syal ix to sway winh yet' ix, palta junelnhej max ochlaj t'a sk'ol winh sway yet' ix, max yalpaxlaj sk'ol winh sk'och b'aj ayek' ix.
Ay jun k'u ix och winhaj José chi' t'a yol pat yik smunlaji, malaj junokxo mach ayeq'ui, anhej ix.

Axo ta' ix och tzuktzuk ix t'a spichul winh, ix yalan ix icha tik: --Vayanh wed'ok, xchi ix. Axo ix yab'an jun chi' winh, ix spich'anel sb'a winh t'a yol sk'ab' ix. Ix elta lemnaj winh t'a ti pat, haxo spichul winh ix kan t'a yol sk'ab' ix.
Ayic ix yilan ix to ix el lemnaj winh, ix kan spichul winh t'a yol sk'ab' ix,

ix el yaw ix, ix yawtankot heb' munlajwum ix t'a slak'anil pat chi', ix yalan ix: --Ilec wal jun winh hebreo ix yik'kot winh wetb'eyum tik. Ha winh tik, snib'ej winh tzin yixtej. Ix ochul lemnaj winh t'a yol pat tik, snib'ej winh sway wed'ok, palta chaanh ix el waw.
Ayic ix yab'an winh yel waw chi', ix el lemnaj winh, axonhej spichul winh ix kani, xchi ix.
Ix sik'ankan jun spichul winh chi' ix masanto ix jax winh spatrón winh chi' t'a spat.
Ix yalan ix icha ix aj yalan t'a sb'ab'elal chi': --Ha winh hebreo ix ik'kot chekab'ok tik, ix ochul winh t'a yol in kuarto, snib'ej winh ix way wed'ok.
Palta te chaanh ix el waw, yuj chi' ix el lemnaj winh, axonhej spichul winh ix yaktejkan t'a tik.
Icha wal chi' ix in yutej jun winh a chekab' tik, xchi ix. Axo winh spatrón winhaj José chi', ix te kot yowal winh sik'lab'il ayik ix yab'an winh tas ix yal ix yetb'eyum chi'.
Ix schekan yamjok winhaj José chi' winh, ix yalan winh to tz'och winh t'a preso b'aj ayoch juntzanh heb' winh t'a preso yuj winh rey.
Palta aynhejoch Jehová yet' winhaj José chi', ix sch'oxnhej swach'k'olal t'a winh. Yuj chi' te wach' ix elk'och winh t'a yol sat winh tanhwum preso chi'.
Axo winh tanhwum preso chi' ix ak'anoch winh stanhwumalok heb' yetpresowumal chi'. Ix ak'jipaxoch winh yilumalok tastak ix sb'o heb' t'a preso chi'.
Ha winh stanhwumal preso chi', manhxalaj tas sna winh, masanil tas aykanoch t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj José chi' yuj winh. Yujto aynhejoch Jehová yet' winh, yuj chi' wach'nhej ix elk'och smasanil.

Ixlajwi chi', ay chawanh winak ix och preso: Ha jun winh, yajal yaj winh t'a heb' winh tz'ak'an swino winh rey, haxo junxo winh, yajal yaj winh t'a heb' winh b'oum pan swa winh rey chi'. Ay smul heb' winh ix och t'a winh rey chi'.
Yuj chi' ix kot yowal winh t'a heb' winh.
Ix yalan winh rey to tz'ak'jioch heb' winh t'a preso t'a spat winh yajal t'a heb' soldado stanhwan winh, aton ta' aypaxoch winhaj José t'a preso.
Anheja' t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj José chi' ix kan heb' winh chawanh smunlajwum winh rey chi' yuj winh yajal preso chi' yik a winh tz'ak'an serwil heb' winh. Ix kan heb' winh jun pekti’ t'a preso chi'.
Axo t'a jun ak'wal ix och swayich heb' winh chawanh chi', junjun wayich chi' ay syalelk'ochi.
Axo ix sakb'i ix k'och winhaj José yil heb' winh. Ix yilan winh to te ayoch heb' winh t'a ilk'olal.
Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb' winh: --¿Tas yuj te kuseltak yilji he sat? xchi winh t'a heb' winh.

--Ay wal ko wayich ix och t'a jun ak'wal tik, palta malaj mach t'a tik tz'alan t'ayonh tas syalelk'ochi, xchi heb' winh. --¿Tom manhok Dios syal yalani tas syalelk'och wayich? Alec t'ayin tas ix he wayichej chi', xchi winhaj José chi'.
Yuj chi' a winh yajal yaj t'a heb' winh tz'ak'an swino winh rey, ix och ijan winh yalan swayich chi' t'a winhaj José icha tik: --Ha t'a in wayich, ix wil jun te' uwa,
ay oxe' sk'ab' te'. Ix wil sk'eta swol, ix yak'an xumaquil, haxo xumaquil chi', ix och b'uyan sat, te q'uinhxo.
Ha ix wilani to yamb'ilk'e skopa winh rey wuuj, ix wik'ankot sat te' uwa chi', ix in pitz'anem yal t'a yol skopa winh rey chi', ix wak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' winh, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj José t'a winh icha tik: --Ichaton tik syalelk'och a wayich chi': Ha oxe' sk'ab' te' uwa ix il chi', oxe' k'ual syala'.
Ayic chab'ej tiknaik ol sb'eyk'olej a mul winh rey chi'. Ol lajwok chi' ol ach yak'anxioch winh t'a a munlajel, ol ak'xi skopa winh chi' icha t'a yalanhtaxo.
Ayic ol elk'och jun swal tik, tzin a naankot t'a winh rey chi', yik wach' tzin elpax t'a yol preso tik. Ok'okab' a k'ol t'ayin.
Ha in tik ichato elk'ab'il in kot t'a skal heb' winh hebreo. Manh in mojok ay in och t'a preso tik, yujto malaj jab'ok tas chuk ix in k'ulej, xchi winhaj José chi'.

Ayic ix yab'an winh yajalil heb' winh sb'oan ixim pan to a winhaj José wach' ix aj yalanel swayich winh chi' winh, ix yalanpax winh icha tik: --Ha in tik ix in wayichej to ayk'e oxe' mooch ixim pan t'a in jolom.

Ha t'a yol jun yune' mooch t'a jun yoxil ayk'e t'a in jolom chi', tzijtum makanhil ixim pan ayem t'a yool yik swa winh rey, palta haxo nok' much ix jawi ix stzok'ank'eta ixim nok' t'a yol te' mooch chi', xchi winh.
Ix yalanxi winhaj José t'a winh icha tik: --Ha tas syalelk'och a wayich chi', aton tik: Ha oxe' mooch chi' sch'oxkot oxe' k'ual.

Yuj chi' yik chab'ej tiknaik, ol sb'eyk'olej winh rey tas yaj a mul. Slajwi chi' ol schekan winh ik'chajel a jolom, a a niwanil ol ak'jokk'e t'a schon jun te te', haxo nok' ostok ol ja schib'at a niwanil chi', xchi winhaj José chi' t'a winh.

Schab'jial wal yalan swayich heb' winh chawanh chi' winhaj José chi', ix yak'an sq'uinhal yab'ilal winh rey. Ix yawtankot winh masanil heb' winh niwak winak ayoch yajalil yet'ok. D'a yichanh heb' winh niwak yajal chi' ix chekji ik'chajelta heb' winh chawanh ayoch t'a preso chi'.
Ha winh tz'ak'an swino winh rey, ix ak'chajxioch winh t'a smunlajel.
Axo winh yajal yaj t'a heb' sb'oan ixim pan, ix yal winh rey to smiljicham winh icha wal ix aj yalan winhaj José.
Palta majxo nachajkot winhaj José yuj winh tz'ak'an swino winh rey chi'.
Axo yik toxo ix ek'b'at chab' ab'il, ay jun ak'wal ix och swayich winh rey. Ix yil winh to linhanek' winh t'a sti' ha' niwan Nilo.
Ha t'a yol ha' chi', ix k'eul ukwanh nok' wakax te wach', te b'ak'uech, swa nok' t'a sti' ha' chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix k'eul ukwanhxo nok' wakax te chuklaj yilji, te b'ak, ix b'at nok' t'a slak'anil nok' b'ak'uech chi'.
Ix och ijan nok' b'ak chi' schianb'at nok' b'ak'uech chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix el swayanh winh rey chi'.
Ix wayxib'at winh. Axo ix yilan winh to ay jun pitanh ixim trigo ix q'uib'i, uque' wal ix aj sjolom ixim, te wach', b'ut'an wal yuj sat.
Ix yilanpax winh t'a spatiktak ixim b'ab'el chi', ix elpaxkot uquexo jolom trigo te malaj sat, nab'a pach'uch'tak, malaj jab'ok swach'il.
Ha uque' jolom trigo te pach'uch'tak chi', ha' ix k'uxanb'at ixim uque' te ay sat chi'. Axo yik ix el swayanh winh rey chi', ix nachajel yuj winh to wan swayichan winh.

Axo ix sakb'i, te taknaquel sk'ol winh yuj swayich chi'. Ix schekan winh awtajkot masanil heb' syal snaan el lolonel t'a Egipto yet' heb' te yojtak yalani. Ix och ijan winh rey chi' yalan swayich chi' t'a heb', palta malaj junok heb' syal yalani tas syalelk'och swayich winh chi'.
Yuj chi' haxo winh yajal yaj t'a heb' tz'ak'an swino winh rey chi' ix alan t'a winh icha tik: --Ato wal tiknaik sja t'a in k'ool to ay jun in paltail ix wak'ochi.
Ayic ix kot owal t'ayin yet' winh yajal heb' b'oum pan, ix onh ak'och t'a yol sk'ab' winh yajal heb' tzach tanhwani, ix onh ochkan t'a preso.
Ay jun ak'wal ix och ko wayich ko chawanhil, junjun ko wayich chi' ay syalelk'ochi.
Ata' ayek' jun winh quelem hebreo, schekab'ejnak winh yajal heb' winh tzach tanhwan chi'. Ix kalan ko wayich chi' t'a winh. Te wach' ix yutej winh yalan tas syalelk'och ko wayich chi'.
Icha wal ix aj yalan winh chi', icha chi' ix aj yelk'ochi. Ina ix in ochxi t'a in munlajel, haxo junxo winh wed'nak chi, ix ak'jik'e d'unhan sniwanil winh, xchi winh yak'umal swino winh rey chi'.

Ixlajwi yab'an jun ab'ix winh rey chi', ix schekan winh ik'jielta winhaj José t'a yol preso. Elanhchamel ix b'at ik'chajelta winh, ix yak'an joxchajel sb'a winh, ix sk'exanel spichul winh, ix b'at winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi'.

Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Ay wal jun in wayich. Malaj junok heb' winh ay t'a tik snachajel yuj tas syalelk'ochi. Ix wab' spekal tob' snachajel uuj tas syalelk'och wayich, xchi winh rey chi' t'a winh.
--Ha jun chi' manh yolok wik snachajel wuuj, palta ha Dios ol alanok tas tz'elk'och a wayich chi' yik tz'och a wach'ilok, xchi winhaj José chi'.
Ix och ijan winh rey yalan swayich t'a winhaj José chi' icha tik: --Ha ix wilani to linhan in ek' t'a sti' ha' Nilo.
D'a yol ha' chi' ix k'eul ukwanh nok' wakax te wach', te b'ak'uech. Ix waek' nok' t'a stitak ha' chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix k'epaxul ukwanhxo nok' te b'ak, chuklaj yilji nok'. Manta b'aj swil junok wakax chuklaj yilji icha nok' chi' t'a Egipto tik.
Ha ukwanh nok' b'ak chi', a nok' ix chianb'at ukwanh nok' b'ak'uech b'ab'el ix k'eul chi'.
Ayic ix lajwiel nok' b'ak'uech schianb'at nok' b'ak chi', anheja' b'ak ix ajkan nok', maj b'ak'uechb'oklaj jab'ok nok'. Ixlajwi chi', ix el in wayanh.
Ix kotxi in wayanh, ix in wayichanxi. Ix wilani, ay jun pitanh ixim trigo uque' wal sjolom ix yak'a', te b'ut'an yuj sat.
Ixlajwi chi' ix elpaxul uquexo sjolom, palta tonhej pach'uch'tak, malaj sat.

Axo ixim chi' ix k'uxanb'at ixim wach' ay sat chi'. Ix wal in wayich tik t'a heb' winh snachajel yuj yalani, palta malaj wal junok heb' winh syal snachajel yuj tas syalelk'ochi, xchi winh rey chi' t'a winh.
Ix yalan winhaj José chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, a chab' a wayich chi', junnhej tas syalelk'ochi. Ha Dios ix ak'an a wayichej tas nab'il yuj.
Ha wal syalelk'och nok' ukwanh wakax b'ak'uech chi', uque' ab'il sch'oxo'. Anheja' uque' sjolom ixim trigo te wach' chi', anhejtona' chi' syala'.
Ha pax ukwanh nok' wakax te b'ak, chuklaj yilji ix k'eul chi', anheja' uque' ab'il pax sch'oxo'. Anheja' ixim jolom trigo te pach'uch'tak, malaj jab'ok sat, uque' ab'il wejel syalelk'ochi.
Ha tas ix wal t'ayach tik, ichaton chi' syalelk'och a wayich chi'. Ha Dios ix ak'an a wayichej tas nab'ilxo yuj.
Ol ja uque' ab'il, te wach' ol aj sat awb'en t'a Egipto tik.

Ol lajwok chi', ol ja uque' ab'il wejel. Ayic chi' manhxa mach ol naankot jantak sat awb'en ix yak' sobre t'a Egipto tik ayik yek'nak uque' t'a yalanhtaxo, yujto a wejel chi' ol ixtankanb'at jun chonhab' tik.
Te niwan wejel ol yutej sb'a. Manhxalaj b'aj ol cheklaj jab'okxo tas ix yak' sobre t'a jun pekti’ wach' ix ek' chi'.
Chael wal ix aj yoch a wayich chi' yik wach' snachajel uj sik'lab'il to nab'ilxo yuj Dios to ol elk'och t'a elanhchamel.
Yuj chi, wach' tato tza say junok winak te jelan, te ay spensar. Tzak'anoch winh yajalil t'a yol nakión tik.

Tza sayanpax jaywanhokxo heb' winh ol och yajalil, sb'at heb' winh t'a masanil yol nakión yik tzek' heb' winh smol chab' almul t'a junjun quintal awb'en tz'el t'a sat lu'um chi' t'a junjun ab'il, masanto slajwi uque' ab'il ol ste ak'ej sat awb'en chi'.
Masanil jantak syak' sobre smolb'an heb' winh chi', syak'kan heb' winh t'a yol a k'ab', sik'chajkanb'at t'a junjun chonhab' t'a yol yik Egipto tik, yik wach' ay tas swa heb' anima.
Masanil tas ol sik'chajkanb'at chi', ha' ol swa heb' anima ayik ol ja uque' ab'il wejel chi', yik wach' max ixtaxel jun chonhab' tik yuj wejel, xchi winhaj José chi'.
Ha jun ix yal winhaj José chi', ix scha sk'ol winh rey yet' masanil heb' ayoch yajalil yet'ok.
Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a heb' icha tik: --Ma chequel tato ay b'aj ol chax junokxo winak kuuj to ayoch Yespíritu Dios yet'ok icha wal jun winh tik, xchi winh rey chi'.
Ix yalan winh t'a winhaj José chi' icha tik: --Malaj mach jelan, malaj mach ay spensar icha ach tik, yujto ha Dios tz'ak'an ojtaquejel masanil juntzanh tik.
Ha ach ol ach ochkan yajalil t'a in despacho tik. Masanil anima ol k'anab'ajan tas ol ala'. Ha inxonhej niwan welk'och t'a ichanh, yujto rey in.
Ha in tzach wak'och gobernadoral t'a masanil yol yik Egipto tik, xchi winh.

Ayic ix yalan jun lolonel chi' winh, ix yik'anel skolk'ab' winh ayoch t'a sk'ab' b'aj ayoch sello, ix yak'anoch winh t'a sk'ab' winhaj José chi'. Ix schekan winh rey chi' ak'jioch spichul winhaj José chi' to a lino te wach'. Tz'ak'jioch junok kadena nab'a oro t'a sjaj winh.

Ix chekchajk'e winh t'a yol karruaje, aton jun schab'il yik winh rey chi', ix schekan winh to schekjiel heb' anima t'a yol b'e ayik tzek' winhaj José chi'. Icha chi' ix aj yochkan winhaj José chi' gobernadoral yet' yilumalok masanil chonhab' Egipto chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh rey t'a winhaj José chi' icha tik: --Ha in tik rey in, palta malaj junok mach syal yalan t'a yol chonhab' tik, tato manhok ach tzala', xchi winh.

Zafnat-panea ix yak' winh rey sb'iej winhaj José chi', ix yak'an winh rey chi' yik'laj sb'a winh yet' ix Asenat, yisil jun winh Potifera sb'i, sakerdote yaj winh t'a yol chonhab' On. 30 ab'il sk'inal winhaj José chi' ayik ix ik'jib'at winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix elta winhaj José chi' t'a yichanh winh rey chi', ix b'at winh t'a yol masanil chonhab' t'a yol yik Egipto chi'.
Ha t'a uque' ab'il, manh jantakok sat masanil awb'en ix yak'a'.
Masanil ixim trigo ix yak' sobre t'a uque' ab'il chi', ix sik'chajb'at ixim t'a junjun chonhab' yuj winhaj José chi'.
Icha yarenail sti' ha' mar, icha wal chi' yilji ixim trigo ix molchaj yuj winh. Te niwanxo ixim trigo chi', yuj chi' majxo echtajlaj ixim, maxtzak yal-laj sb'ischaji.
Ayic manto el yich jun niwan wejel chi', chawanhxo yuninal winhaj José yet' ix Asenat chi'.
Ha winh b'ab'el unin, Manasés ix yak' winh sb'iej, ix yalan winh: Ha Dios ix ak'an sat t'a in k'ol masanil syaelal ix ek'b'at t'a wib'anh yet' in kusk'olal yuj heb' ayto wuj in b'a yet'ok, xchi winh.
Axo jun winh schab'il unin, Efraín ix yak' winh sb'iej, ix yalan winh: Ha Dios ix ak'an swach'k'olal t'ayin t'a jun lugar b'aj ix wab' syaelal tik, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi yek' uque' ab'il ayik manh jantakok swach'il ix aj sat awb'en t'a Egipto,
ix schaanel yich uque' ab'il wejel chi', icha ix aj yalan winhaj José. Ix japax niwan wejel t'a yol masanil nakión t'a slak'anil chi'. Axo t'a masanil yol smakb'en Egipto ay tas swa heb' anima.

Axo yik ix em wejel chi', tzijtum heb' aj Egipto chi' sk'och t'a winh rey k'anb'oj trigo. Syalan winh rey chi' t'a heb': Ixiquec t'a winhaj José. Masanil tas syal winh a tze k'anab'ajej, xchi winh t'a heb'.
Masanil yol yik Egipto chi' ayem wejel, yuj chi' ix jakwi masanil yet'tal b'aj sik'an ixim trigo yuj winhaj José chi', ix chonhji ixim t'a heb' aj Egipto chi'.
Masanil juntzanhxo nakión ix ja manoj trigo t'a winh yujto masanil b'aj ay wejel, manhxalaj tas swa heb' anima.
Ha winhaj Jacob kajan winh t'a Canaán, ix yab' spekal winh to te ay ixim trigo t'a Egipto. Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a heb' winh yuninal icha tik: ¿Tas tze k'ulej, tonhej tzeyil-lajoch he b'a?
Ix wab' spekal to te ay ixim trigo t'a Egipto. Ixiquec he man tas sko wa yik wach' max onh cham yuj wejel, xchi winh.
Yuj chi', ix b'at lajunhwanh yuk'tak winhaj José manoj trigo t'a Egipto chi'.
Axo winhaj Benjamín, yuk'tak winhaj José chi', maj chajib'atlaj winh yuj winhaj Jacob chi', yujto ix sna' winh: Ay talaj tas tz'ik'an winh wuninal tik, xchi winh.
Tzijtum juntzanhxo heb' winh manum trigo ix b'at yet' heb' winh yuninal winhaj Israel chi', yujto t'a masanil yol yik Canaán chi', ix te em wejel.

Ha winhaj José yajal yaj t'a yol yik Egipto chi', a winh tz'ak'anelta ixim trigo t'a heb' manwajum sk'och chi'. Ayic ix k'och heb' yuk'tak winh chi' t'a yichanh, ix em nhojjab' heb' winh t'a sat lu'um.

D'a jun rato chi, ix yiloch heb' yuk'tak winhaj José chi', palta haxo ix yutej sb'a winh ichato manh yojtakok winh, ow ix yutej winh slolon t'a heb' winh: --¿B'ajtil ix ex kot a ex tik? xchi winh. --Aj Canaán onh, to tzonh jawi manoj trigo, xchi heb' winh.
Wach'chom a winhaj José chi' yojtak winh to yuk'tak sb'a winh yet' heb' winh, haxo pax heb' winh jun, maj nachajel-laj yuj heb' winh.

Ichato chi' ix snaankot winhaj José tas ix swayichej t'a yib'anh heb' winh t'a yalanhtaxo. Ix yalan winh: --Ha ex tik tonhej tzul onh eyileli, tonhej tzex jawi eyila' tato ay b'aj syal yochul heb' ajk'ol t'a yol jun chonhab' tik, xchi winh.
--Maay mamin, a onh a chekab' onh tik, manoj trigonhej tzonh jawi.
Ha onh tik junnhej ko mam, kuk'taknhej ko b'a, wach'nhej ko pensar, malaj b'aj tonhej tzek' quileli, xchi heb' winh.
--Val yel a ex tik tonhej tzex ja eyilb'ati ta sekojtak tz'ochul heb' ajk'ol t'a tik, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi heb' winh icha tik: --Maay mamin, a onh a chekab' onh tik, lajchawanh onh, kuk'taknhej ko b'a, junnhej ko mam, kajan onh t'a Canaán. Ha winh kuk'tak tzak'an unin, aykan winh yet' winh ko mam chi', ay junxo winh, manhxo ayok ek'laj winh, xchi heb'.
--Val yel swala', a ex tik tonhej tzex ja eyileli tas yaj t'a tik.
Ol to yal sb'a tas ol aj jun tik: Tzin lok sb'i winh rey to manh ol ex aktajelok tato manh ol eyik'kot winh eyuk'tak tzak'an unin chi'.

Ha tiknaik tzex b'at junok ex eyik' winh, a exxo tik ol ex kannhej preso t'a tik, yik wach' squila' tato yel tzeyala'. Tato tonhej tzeyala', toxo ix in lok sb'i winh rey to tonhej tzul onh eyileli, xchi winhaj José chi.
Ix och heb' winh preso yuj winh. Ato t'a schab'jial chi' ix yalan winhaj José chi' t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Ha in tik tzin xiw d'ha Dios. Tato tze k'anab'ajej jun tas swal tik, tzex kolchajkani.
Tato yel wach' ex, junxonhej ex tzex kan t'a yol preso tik, tzex b'at he masanil t'a he chonhab' chi', tzeyik'anb'at ixim trigo swa heb' ix eyetb'eyum yet' eyuninal wan scham yuj wejel chi'.
Slajwi chi', tzeyik'ankot winh eyuk'tak tzak'an unin chi'. Ichato chi' ol wilani tato yel tzeyala', manh ol ex chamlaj, xchi winhaj José chi'. Ichokab' ta', xchi heb' winh.

Ix yalan heb' winh t'ay junjun icha tik: --Ha yuj tas kutejnak winh kuk'tak, yuj chi' sja jun yaelal tik t'a quib'anh. Val yel te chuk kutejnak ko b'ha t'a winh, manh ko chanakok kab'i ayik stewinak winh t'ayonh to tz'ok' ko k'ol t'a winh, wach'chom quilnak to te kusnak winh, xchi heb' winh.

Ix yalanpax winhaj Rubén t'a heb' winh yuk'tak chi' icha tik: --Valnac t'ayex to max eyutej he b'ha t'a winh icha chi', palta manh he chanakok eyab'i tas walnak chi'. Ha tiknaik, tik wal skot t'a quib'anh yuj schamel winh, xchi winh.
Maj nachajel yuj heb' winh tato wan yab'an winhaj José tas syal heb' winh chi', yujto t'a sti' heb' aj Egipto slolon winh, anhej to ay junok mach tz'alaneli tas syal winh.
Ix el winhaj José chi' t'a stz'ey heb' winh, ix och ijan winh yoq'ui. Ix jax winh, ix lolonxi winh yet' heb' winh. Ix yik'anel winhaj Simeón winh, t'a yichanh heb' winh ix tzek'chajkan winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj José chi' to tz'ak'ji b'ud'jok skoxtal heb' winh, ix ak'jiem k'een stumin heb' winh t'a yol sti' skoxtal chi', ix ak'jib'at swael heb' winh yik yol sb'e. Icha chi' ix sk'ulej winh yet' heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'anoch yikatz nok' sb'uru heb' winh, ix paxta heb' winh b'ian.

Axo ix k'och heb' winh b'aj ol wayok, ix sjakan skoxtal junok heb' winh yik syik'ank'eta chab'ok strigo nok' sb'uru winh chi' yalani. Axo ix yilan winh to ayem k'een tumin t'a yol sti' skoxtal, k'een ix yak'lab'ej heb' winh smanan ixim strigo chi'.

Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh yuk'tak chi' icha tik: --Ileknab'i, ix ak'jixi meltzaj k'een in tumin. Ay wal em k'een t'a yol sti' in koxtal tik, xchi winh. Masanil heb' winh ix ib'xik'e yuj xiwelal, ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --¿Tas yuj icha tik tzonh yutej Dios? xchi heb' winh.
Axo yik ix jax heb' winh t'a yol yik Canaán chi', ix yalan heb' winh t'a winh smam tastak ix ek' t'a yib'anh. Ix yalan heb' winh icha tik:
--Ha winh ayoch yajalil t'a jun chonhab' chi', te ow ix yutej winh slolon t'ayonh. Ix yalan winh to tonhej onh xid' quilelta tas yaj schonhab' chi'.
Ix kalani to wach' onh, manh chukok ko pensar tzonh eq'ui, malaj b'aj tonhej tzek' quilel tas yaj heb'.
Ix kalani to lajchawanh ko b'eyi, junnhej ko mam, jun winh kuk'tak manhxo ayoquek'laj, haxo winh tzak'an unin, aykan winh yet' winh ko mam t'a Canaán, xko chi t'a winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: Tato yel wach' ex, kanokab' junok winh eyuk'tak t'a tik, tzeyik'anb'at jab'ok ixim trigo t'a heb' ix eyetb'eyum yet' t'a eyuninal wan scham yuj wejel chi'.

Slajwi chi', tzeyik'ankot junxo winh eyuk'tak tzak'an unin chi' wil t'a tik. Ichato chi' ol wojtakaneli to manh chukok he pensar syal chi'. Masanto sjawi junxo winh eyuk'tak tzak'an unin chi', ol in jakanelta winh eyuk'tak ix kan t'a preso tik, yik icha chi' libre ex he b'eyeq'ui, xchi winh, xchi heb' winh.

Axo ix sjakan skoxtal heb' winh chi', ix yilan heb' winh to ayem junjun yunetak mukuk tumin yol sti' koxtal chi', aton k'een tumin chi' ix yak'lab'ej heb' winh smanan ixim trigo. Ix ak'chajxi meltzaj k'een. Ix te xiw chaanh heb' winh, ix te xiwpax winh smam heb' winh chi.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Te chuk tzeyutej he b'a t'ayin. Manhxo junok wuninal skan eyuuj. Vinhaj José, manhxo ayoquek'laj winh, winhaj Simeón, ix kan winh t'a preso, he gana tzeyik'paxb'at winhaj Benjamín. Ha mach tz'ab'an syail, a in toni, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Rubén t'a winh smam chi' icha tik: --Manh ach xiw mamin. Ak'b'at winh kuk'tak tzak'an unin tik qued'ok. Ha in swak' in b'a yuj winh, tato manhxo ol jax winh wuuj, wach'chom tza mak'cham chawanh wuninal tik yuj winh, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Jacob chi' icha tik: --Manh ol b'atlaj winh wuninal tik eyed'ok, axonhej winh ayek' wed'ok. Ina winh yuk'tak winh, chamnakxo winh, talaj ay tas tz'ik'anpax junxo winh tik t'a yol b'e, tik a ex wal tzeyak'och he mul yik tzin cham yuj kuselal, xchi winhaj Jacob chi'.
Te ow yak'an wejel t'a yol schonhab' heb' winh.
Ix lajwiel ixim trigo xid' yik' heb' winh chi' swaan winhaj Jacob yet' yuninal, ix yalanxi winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Ixiquecxi t'a Egipto, b'at manek jab'okxo tas sko wa''a, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Judá icha tik: --Te jichan ix yutej winh schonhan ixim trigo chi' yalani: Tato max eyik'kot winh eyuk'tak tzak'an unin chi', manhxo ol eyil in sat t'a tik, xchi winh.
Yuj wal chi', tato sb'at winh kuk'tak tik qued'ok, tzonh b'at manoj trigo chi'.
Tato max a chab'at winh qued' jun, manhxo ol onh b'atlaj, icha ix aj yalan winh chonhum trigo chi': Tato max eyik'kot winh eyuk'tak tzak'an unin chi', manhxo ex jawoklaj t'a wichanh, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Israel chi' icha tik: --¿Tas yuj ix eyal t'a jun winh chi' to ay junokxo eyuk'tak? Tzin eyak' wal och t'a ilk'olal, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi heb' winh icha tik: --Ix sk'anb'ej winh tastak kaji, mach ayonh yinhtilal. Ix sk'anb'anpax winh tato aytoek' ko mam, tato aytopax kuk'tak. Yuj chi' ix kal t'a winh to aytoek' ko mam, aytopax junxo kuk'tak. ¿Tocwal kojtak tato ol yal winh to squik'b'at winh kuk'tak tik? xchi heb' winh.

Ix yalanxi winhaj Judá t'a winh smam chi': --Tato max yal a k'ol tzonh cham yuj wejel ko masanil, chab'at winh kuk'tak tik qued'ok. Ha in tzin tek'b'ej in b'a in tanhwan winh, tato icha chi', tik tzonh b'at t'a elanhchamel.
Ha in tzin tek'b'ej in b'a tato ay tas tz'ik'an winh, tato manhxo ol ja winh wuuj, te chuk ol in kan t'a a sat.
Tato maj ek' ko tiempo t'a tik, toxo ix kak' chaelok naik, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winh smam heb' winh chi' icha tik: --Tato manhxa tas wach' skutej, yik'okab' icha tzeyal chi', ixiquek. Ik'ekb'at jab'ok he silab' t'a winh. Ha juntzanh tas wach' sq'uib' t'a tik, ha' tzeyik'b'ati: Aton bálsamo, nok' yalchab', perfume, mirra, te' nuekes yet' te' almendras.
Ik'ekb'at he tumin yik tze manan ixim trigo chi', tzeyik'anxib'at k'een tumin ix yak' meltzaj heb' winh t'ayex t'a sti' he koxtal chi', tekan tonhej ix sat sk'ol heb' winh, yuj chi' ayem k'een.
Ik'ekb'at winh eyuk'tak tik, tzex b'atxi eyil winh yajal chi'.

Ha Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil, ha' ol och t'a spensar winh yik ol aktajel winh eyuk'tak aj Simeón. Wach' ol aj smeltzajkot winhaj Benjamín tik eyed'ok. Ha inxo tik, tato tzin kan manh uninal, in kanokab'i, ¿tasto wal ol wutej? xchi winh smam heb' winh chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'anem silab' heb' winh chi' t'a yol skoxtal yet' k'een tumin. Ix yik'anb'at winhaj Benjamín heb' winh, ix b'atxi heb' winh t'a Egipto chi'. Axo yik ix k'och heb' winh t'a yichanh winhaj José,

ix yilan winh to ajun winhaj Benjamín chi'. Ix yalan winh t'a winh yilumal spat icha tik: --Ik'b'at juntzanh heb' winh tik t'a in pat, tzak'an miljokcham junok nok' wakax, yik sb'o junok wael, to ol wa heb' winh wed'ok t'a chimk'ualil tik, xchi winhaj José chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix ik'jib'at heb' winh yuj winh ilum pat chi', ix sk'anab'ajan winh tas ix yal winhaj José chi'.

Ix te xiw chaanh heb' winh yujto ix ik'chajb'at heb' winh t'a spat winh, ix yal-lan yab' heb' winh icha tik: --Chuc tas sna winh t'a quib'anh. Tekan yuj k'een tumin ix yak' meltzaj heb' winh t'ayonh, yuj chi' tzonh ik'chajkot t'a tik. Tekan ol onh yak'och winh schekab'ok yet' nok' ko chej tik, xchi heb' winh.
Yuj chi', ayik ix k'och heb' winh t'a spuertail pat chi', ix och tean heb' winh t'a winh yilumal te' chi'.
Ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --Mamin, ina a onh tik, ix onh ulek' manoj trigo junel,

haxo yik ix onh meltzaji, ix onh way t'a yol b'e. Ayic ix ko jakan ko koxtal, ix quilani tz'akan yajem k'een tumin t'a sti' ko koxtal chi', aton k'een ix ko k'ana' ayik ix ko manan ixim ko trigo. Ix quik'anxi meltzaj k'een tumin chi' tiknaik, tz'akan ol kutej kak'anxi k'een t'ayach.
Manh kojtakok mach ix ak'anem k'een t'a yol sti' ko koxtal chi'. Ch'ok ix quik'paxkot k'een stojol ixim ol ko man chi' tiknaik, xchi heb' winh.

Ix yalan winh chi' icha tik: --Manh eyak' pensar yuj jun chi'. Manh ex xiwok. Ha sDiosal he mam yet' ex paxi, a ix ak'anem k'een t'a sti' he koxtal chi'. Ha in ix in cha k'een tumin ix eyak' stojolok ixim he trigo ix eyik' chi', xchi winh t'a heb' winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix ik'jielta winhaj Simeón t'a yol preso yuj winh yilumal chi', ix elul winh b'aj ayek' heb' yuk'tak chi'.
Ix ik'chajb'at heb' winh smasanil yuj winh t'a spat winhaj José chi', ix yak'an ha ha' winh yik sb'iquel yok heb' winh, ix ak'jipax yanh schej heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'ank'eta silab' heb' winh t'a yol skoxtal ol yak' t'a winhaj José ayik ol k'och winh t'a chimk'ualil chi', yujto yojtakxo heb' winh to ol wa heb' winh yet' winh.
Axo ix k'och winhaj José chi', ix yak'an silab' heb' winh chi' t'a winh, ix em nhojjab' heb' winh t'a sat lum t'a yichanh winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb' winh tato wach'nhej sk'ol heb' winh, ix yalan winh: --¿Janik' sk'ol winh he mam, winh te ichamxo ix eyal t'ayin? ¿Pitzan tom winh? xchi winh t'a heb' winh.
Ix em nhojan heb' winh, ix yalan heb' winh: --Ha winh ko mam chi', aytoek' winh, wach'to sk'ol winh, xchi heb' winh.

Axo ix yilanoch winhaj Benjamín winh, aton winh junnhej snun winh yet'ok, ix yalan winh: --¿A am winh eyuk'tak tzak'an unin ix eyal tik t'ayin? xchi winh. --Aton winh, xchi heb' winh. --Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Dios t'a ib'anh, xchi winh t'a winhaj Benjamín chi'.
Ixlajwi yalan jun chi' winh, ix te sat wal sk'ol winh yilan winh yuk'tak chi'. Ix och pitz'an t'a spixan winh, ijan wal ix ok' winh. Elanhchamel ix b'at lemnaj winh t'a yol skuarto yik sb'at ok' ta'.
Axo yik ix ek'b'at skusk'olal winh chi', ix sb'ikanel sat winh, ix elta winh, ix yalan winh t'a heb' schekab': Ik'equelta ko wael chi' chinaik, xchi winh.

Jun smexa winhaj José chi' sch'okojil. Ch'ok junxo mexa b'aj ix och heb' winh yuk'tak winh chi', ch'ok pax junxo mexa b'aj swa heb' winh aj Egipto chi', aton heb' swataxon yet' winhaj José chi', yujto a heb' winh aj Egipto chi' ay yowalil tato junnhej swa heb' winh yet' heb' winh hebreo chi'.

Ha heb' winh yuk'tak winhaj José chi', t'a stzolal ix aj yak'jiem k'ojan heb' winh yuj winh schekab' winhaj José chi', ato syala' jantak sk'inal junjun heb' winh, yujto icha chi' ix aj yalan winhaj José chi'. Vinh b'ab'el masanto winh tzak'an unin. Toxonhej ste sat sk'ol heb' winh yil-lanoch sb'a.

Ha wael ay t'a smexa winhaj José chi', ha' ix ak'ji t'a heb' winh. Axo pax t'a winhaj Benjamín chi', oye'to makan ek'b'al yik winh ix ak'ji t'a yichanh yik juntzanhxo heb' winh chi'. Ichato chi' ix wa heb' winh, ix yuk'an wino heb' winh t'a tzalajk'olal.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj José t'a winh yilumal spat: --Ak' b'ud'jok skoxtal heb' winh tik t'a ixim trigo, yalnhej jantak syal yik'anb'at heb' winh. Tzak'anpaxem k'een tumin t'a yol sti' skoxtal junjun heb' winh, aton k'een b'aj sman ixim trigo chi' heb' winh.
Tzak'anpaxem k'een in kopa plata yet' k'een tumin t'a yol sti' skoxtal winh tzak'an unin, xchi winh. Ix sk'anab'ajan winh tas ix yal winhaj José chi'.
Ayic ix ja kopnaj yok k'u t'a q'uinhib'alil, ix chaji meltzaj heb' winh yet' nok' schej t'a schonhab'.

Quenanto wal sb'at heb' winh, ix yalan winhaj José t'a winh yilumal spat chi' icha tik: --Ixic tzak'an yuj heb' winh chi'. Ayic syamchaj heb' winh uuj, tzalani: ¿Tas yuj a swach'k'olal winh in patrón, chukxo tzeyutej he paktzitankani? ¿Tas yuj ix eyelk'ejkot skopa winh, aton jun nab'a plata,
jun skopa winh b'aj syuk' swino, sk'ananpax winh yik snaanel junok lolonel? Te chuk ix eyutej he b'a a ex tik, xa chi t'a heb' winh, xchi winhaj José chi'.
Ix b'at winh yilumal spat winhaj José chi' b'ian. Axo yik ix yamchaj heb' winh yuj winh, ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha ix aj yalan winhaj José chi'.
Ix tak'wi heb' winh t'a winh: --Mamin, ¿tas yuj icha chi' tzutej alan t'ayonh? ¿Tom malaj ko pensar, yuj chi' ol quelk'ejkot junok tasi?
Ina ato t'a Canaán kajan onh. D'a sb'ab'el, a k'een tumin ix cheklaj t'a sti' ko koxtal, ix quik'xikot k'een. ¿Tom ato wal junok plata ma oro yik winh a patrón chi' ol quelk'ejkot t'a spat?
Ha junok onh b'aj scheklajelta k'een kopa chi' t'a yol skoxtal, wach' tato smiljichamok, a onhxo ko masanil, tzonh ochkan a chekab'ok, xchi heb' winh.
Ix tak'wi winh icha tik: --Yik'okab' icha tzeyal chi', palta anhej winh b'aj ol ilchajelta jun kopa chi' wuuj, a winh chi' ol ochkan in chekab'ok. Ha exxo tik, he masanil libre ex, xchi winh.
D'a elanhchamel ix yak'em skoxtal heb' winh chi' smasanil, ix stijan sti' heb' winh.

Ix sayan yil masanil yoltak koxtal chi' winh. D'a stzolal ix say yil winh, ix sb'ab'laj sayej yil yik winh b'ab'el winak winh masanto t'a winh tzak'an unin. Axo t'a yol yik winh tzak'an unin chi' ix k'eta k'een kopa chi', aton winhaj Benjamín.
Ix och ijan heb' winh snhik'chitan spichul yuj skusk'olal. Ix yak'anxioch yikatz nok' sb'uru heb' winh chi', ix meltzajxi heb' winh t'a spatik.
Ayto ek' winhaj José chi' t'a spat, ix k'och winhaj Judá yet' heb' yuk'tak chi', ix em nhojan heb' winh t'a sat lu'um t'a yichanh winh.
Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --¿Tas yuj icha chi' tzeyutej he b'a? ¿Tom manh eyojtakok to a junok winak ay yopisio icha in tik, syal snachajel junok tas yuj? xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Judá icha tik: --Mamin, ¿tasto wal ol aj ko tak'wi t'ayach? ¿Tasto ol kutok quilanoch ko b'a tato wach' onh kalani? Ay ko mul t'a yichanh ko Mam Dios, tik ayonh ek' t'a ichanh. Syal tzonh och a chekab'ok yet' winh b'aj ix ilchajelta k'een kopa chi', xchi winh.
Ix yalanxi winhaj José chi' icha tik: --Maay, anhej winh b'aj ix ilchajelta k'een in kopa chi', anhej winh skan in chekab'ok. Ha exxo tik, meltzajanhek t'a junk'olal b'aj ay winh he mam, xchi winh.

Ix snitz wal b'at sb'a winhaj Judá t'a stz'ey winhaj José chi', ix yalan winh: --Mamin, tzok el wal t'a a k'ool swalan t'ayach tas in pensar. Tzin tewi t'ayach, mokab' kot owal t'ayin, wach'chom icha ach winh rey.
Ha ach wal ix a k'anb'ej t'ayonh tato aytoek' winh ko mam a onh tik, tato aytopax junokxo kuk'tak.

Yuj chi', ix kalan t'ayach to aytoek' winh ko mam, anhejto te icham winakxo winh. Ha junxo winh kuk'tak tzak'an unin, t'a yicham winaquilxo winh ko mam chi' ix alji winh. Axo junxo winh junnhej snun winh yet'ok, chamnakxo winh, yuj chi' te xajan winh yuj winh ko mam chi', yujto axonhej winh.
Ha ach ix ala' to squik'kot winh, yik tzojtaquejel winh.
Ix kalan t'ayach to max yal sk'ol winh ko mam chi' tz'elta winh t'a stz'ey, yujto ijanxo scham winh yuj kusk'olal yalani tato tz'el winh t'a stz'ey winh.
Palta ix alpax t'ayonh tato max quik'kot winh, maxtzak yal ko jax t'a ichanh alani.
Ayic ix onh k'och t'a ko pat chi', ix kalan t'a winh ko mam chi' tas ix aj alan t'ayonh.
Axo winh ix alan t'ayonh to tzonh kotxi manoj trigo.
Ix kalan t'a winh icha tik: Max onh b'atlaj tato max quik'b'at winh kuk'tak tzak'an unin tik, yujto tato max b'at winh qued'ok, maxtzak yal-laj ko k'och t'a yichanh winh yajal chi', xko chi.
Ix yalan winh ko mam chi' t'ayonh: Eyojtak to chawannhej wuninal ix wil yet' ix wetb'eyum chamnak.
Jun winh junelnhej b'atnakkani, manhxa b'aj ix wil sat winh, ay am wal junok nok' nok' chium anima chi'annakb'at winh.
Tato tzeyik'xib'at junxo winh tik, tato ay pax tas tz'ik'an winh, eyuj am wal tzin cham yuj kusk'olal, xchi winh t'ayonh.
Yuj chi', icha wal to sk'inal winh ko mam chi' yajoch winh wuk'tak tik. Tato manhxo ol meltzaj winh qued'ok
ol cham winh ko mam yuj kusk'olal, a onh tik tz'och ko mul.
Ha in ix in tek'b'ej in b'a yuj winh t'a winh in mam chi', ix walani: Tato manhxo ol jax winh wuuj, te chuk tzin kan t'a yol a sat t'a junelnhej, xin chi t'a winh in mam chi'.
Yuj wal chi' tzin tewi t'ayach, tato syala', a in tzin kan sk'exulok winh wuk'tak tik a chekab'ok. Yuj chi' tzaktejel winh, spax winh yet' heb' winh wuk'tak tik.
Tato maay jun, ¿tasto wal ol aj in b'at wil winh in mam chi', tato manhok jun winh wed'ok? Manh jab'ok syal in k'ol swil skusk'olal winh in mam tato icha chi' tzuji, xchi winhaj Judá chi'.

Majxo techaj yuj winhaj José chi', ijanxo tz'ok'k'e winh t'a yichanh masanil heb' winh smunlajwum, yuj chi' te chaanh ix yal winh: Elanhec t'a tik, xchi winh. Yuj chi' manhxo junok heb' winh munlajwum chi' ix kan ta, ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh yuk'tak chi' to yuk'tak sb'a winh yet' heb' winh.
Ichato chi', ix ok'wal winh sik'lab'il. Masanil heb' winh aj Egipto ix ab'ani. Ix k'och spekal jun chi' t'a spalakio winh rey.

Ix yalan winhaj José chi' t'a heb' winh yuk'tak chi' icha tik: --Ha in ton tik José in, kuk'tak ko b'a. ¿Yel am wal to pitzanto winh ko mam chi'? xchi winh. Ix te xiw chaanh heb' yuk'tak winh chi' t'a yichanh. Majxo yal-laj slolon heb' winh yuj xiwelal.

Ix yalan winhaj José chi: --Swal t'ayex tiknaik, nitzekkot he b'ha t'a in tz'ey tik, xchi winh. Axo yik ix snitzanb'at sb'a heb' winh, ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Ha in ton José in, wuk'tak in b'a eyed'ok. Ha in ton tik he chonhnak in kot t'a heb' winh ismaelita chonhwajum t'a Egipto tik.

Palta mokab' chab'ax he k'ool, mokab' kot eyowal t'ayex junjun ex yuj b'aj in he chonhnakkot chi'. Spensar Dios yaj jun chi' yik tzin b'ab'lajkot t'a eyichanh, yik tzijtum anima skolchaji, yuj chi' icha chi' ix aji.
Schab'ilto ab'il yel yich wejel t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik. Oye'to ab'il ol yak'a', manh ol yak' sat awal inhat, wach'chom ay mach ol awanok, palta malaj jab'ok sat ol yak'a'.
B'ab'el ix in chekjikot yuj Dios yik ol ex in kolkan t'a jun niwan wejel tik, yik wach' max satel eyinhtilal t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik.

Yuj chi' ha Dios chekannak in kot t'a jun lugar tik, manhoquexlaj eyak'nak in koti. Ha Dios ix in ak'anochi yik swak' sna winh rey, yik tzin ochpax yajalil t'a masanil tas ay t'a spat winh yet' t'a masanil yol yik Egipto tik.

Ha tiknaik pilek eyip, ixik alek t'a winh ko mam chi' icha tik: Icha tik ix aj yalan winhaj José uninal: Ha Dios ix in ak'anoch yajalil t'a yol yik Egipto tik, yuj chi' kotanh t'a elanhchamel, yik tzul in ilan t'a tik.
Ha t'a lum Gosén ol ach kajnajok yik wach' t'a in lak'anil ol ach aj yet' masanil heb' uninal, heb' iachiquin yet' nok' a molb'etzal nok' yet' masanil tastak ay t'ayach.

Ol wak'an a wael yet' masanil heb' winh wuk'tak yet' masanil heb' ayek' ed'ok, yujto oye'to ab'il ol yak' jun wejel tik. Yuj chi' manh ol ach och mheb'ail yet' masanil heb' ayek' ed'ok, xchi winh, xe chi t'a winh ko mam chi'.
Testigo yaj winh wuk'tak aj Benjamín tik yet' ex pax tik, to a in wal swal jun lolonel tik.

Alec t'a winh ko mam chi' to a in tik te niwan welk'och t'a yol yik Egipto tik. Tzeyalan t'a winh yuj masanil tastak ix eyil t'a tik. Yuj chi' ixiquek eyik'kot winh ko mam chi' t'a elanhchamel, xchi winhaj José chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at lak'naj winhaj José chi' t'a winhaj Benjamín chi', ix och ijan winh yoq'ui. Anhejtona' ix ok'pax winhaj Benjamín chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix stz'ub'anelta sti' heb' winh yuk'tak winh chi' smasanil. Ayic lak'lak' och winh t'a heb' winh, ix och ijan winh yoq'ui. Ixlajwi juntzanh chi', ix stek'b'an sb'a heb' winh slolon yet' winh.

Ix k'och spekal t'a spalakio winh rey to yuk'tak sb'a winhaj José yet' heb' winh ix k'och chi'. Ix te tzalaj winh rey chi' yet' masanil heb' ayoch t'a yopisio yet' winh t'a spalakio chi' ayik ix yab'an heb'.
Ix yalan winh rey t'a winhaj José chi' icha tik: --Al t'a heb' winh uk'tak chi', yak'okab'och yikatz nok' schej heb' winh yik smeltzaj heb' winh t'a Canaán chi'.
Syik'ankot yetb'eyum heb' winh yet' heb' yuninal yet' winh a mam chi' t'ayin. Ha lum lum te wach' t'a Egipto tik ol wak' t'a winh.
Al t'a heb' winh to syik'b'at karreta heb' winh t'a tik, yik wach' syik'kot yetb'eyum heb' winh yet' heb' yuninal yet' winh a mam chi'.
Mokab' yak' pensar heb' winh yuj tastak ay tiknaik, yujto a tas wach' ay t'a Egipto tik, ha' ol wak' t'a heb' winh, xchi winh rey chi'.
Icha chi' ix yutej heb' winh yuninal winhaj Israel chi'. Axo winhaj José chi' ix ak'an karreta chi' t'a heb' winh yet' tastak swa heb' t'a yol b'e icha ix yutej winh rey yalani.
Ix ak'jipax pichul ak'to t'a heb' winh yik tz'och sk'ex k'apakok heb' winh. Axo t'a winhaj Benjamín, 300 siklo plata ix ak'ji, ix ak'jipax oye' mojanh spichul winh.

Ix yak'anb'at lajunhwanh nok' b'uru winhaj José chi' t'a winh smam. Te al ix ajb'at nok' yuj masanil tas wach' ay t'a Egipto chi'. Ix b'atpax lajunhwanhxo nok' nun b'uru ix ik'anb'at ixim trigo yet' ixim pan yik swa winh t'a yol b'e yik skoti.
Ayic ix stak'anb'at heb' yuk'tak winhaj José chi', ix yalan winh: --Mokab' eyak' owal t'a yoltak b'e, xchi winh.
Ix el heb' winh t'a Egipto chi', ix k'och heb' winh t'a Canaán b'aj ay winh smam chi'.
Axo ix yalan heb' winh t'a winh smam chi' to pitzanto winhaj José, to ayoch winh schab'il yajalil t'a Egipto. Ix te sat sk'ol winh yab'ani, maj schalaj winh tas ix yal heb' winh.
Palta ichato ix pitzwixi winh ayik ix yab'an masanil tas ix yalkot winhaj José chi', ix yilanpaxoch jantak karreta ix yak'kot winh yik tz'ik'jib'at winh.
Ichato chi' ix yalan winh: k'okb'ilnhej ix wab'i to pitzanto winh wuninal chi'. Ol b'at wil winh yakb'an manto in chami, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj Jacob yet' masanil heb' yiko' yet' masanil tastak ay t'ay. Ayic ix k'och winh t'a Beerseba, ix snhusan silab' winh t'a sDiosal, aton sDiosal winh smam winh.
Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi', ix lolon Dios t'a winh t'a swayich, ix awtaj winh yuj: --Jacob, xchi. Ix tak'wi winh: --Oy, ina wajek' tik Mamin, xchi winh.
Ix yalan Dios t'a winh icha tik: --Ha in ton a Diosal in yet' winh a mam, manh ach xiw a b'at t'a Egipto chi'. Yakb'an ayex ek' ta' ol in b'o jun niwan chonhab' t'a inhtilal.

Ol in b'atnhej ed'ok t'a Egipto chi', haxo yik ol k'och stiempoal, ol in ochnhej yet' heb' inhtilal ayik ol meltzajxikot heb' t'a jun lugar tik. Axo yik ol ach chamok, a winh uninal aj José chi', ayek' winh t'a a tz'ey, xchi Dios t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix ak'jik'e winh yuj heb' winh yuninal t'a yol karreta ix yak'kot winh sreyal Egipto chi'. Ix yak'anpaxk'e heb' unin yet' heb' ix yetb'eyum heb' winh. Ichato chi' ix el heb' winh t'a Beerseba chi'.
Ix kot heb' winh t'a Egipto, ix yik'ankot nok' skalnel heb' winh yet' nok' swakax yet' masanil tastak ix yik' heb' winh t'a Canaán chi'.
Ix yik'ankot masanil heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jacob chi' yet' heb' ix yisil yet' heb' yixchiquin.

Ha heb' yinhtilal winh yet' ix Lea ix kot yet'ok t'a Egipto, 33 heb' t'a smasanil, ayoch heb' winak yet' heb' ix ix sb'isulok. Ha heb' yuninal winh yet' ix, aton heb' tik: Vinhaj Rubén, aton winh b'ab'el unin, winhaj Simeón, winhaj Leví, winhaj Judá, winhaj Isacar, winhaj Zabulón yet' ix Dina. Ha heb' tik ix alji ayik ayek' winh t'a Padán-aram. Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Rubén: Aton winhaj Hanoc, winhaj Falú, winhaj Hezrón yet' winhaj Carmi. Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Simeón: Aton winhaj Jemuel, winhaj Jamín, winhaj Ohad, winhaj Jaquín, winhaj Zohar yet' winhaj Saúl, winh yune' jun ix aj Canaán. Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Leví: Aton winhaj Gersón, winhaj Coat yet' winhaj Merari. Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Judá: Aton winhaj Er, winhaj Onán, winhaj Sela, winhaj Fares yet' winhaj Zara. (Ha winhaj Er yet' winhaj Onán chi', chamnakxo heb' winh t'a Canaán). Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Fares chi', aton winhaj Hezrón yet' winhaj Hamul. Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Isacar: Aton winhaj Tola, winhaj Fúa, winhaj Job yet' winhaj Simrón. Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Zabulón: Aton winhaj Sered, winhaj Elón yet' winhaj Jahleel.

Ha heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jacob chi' yet' ix Zilpa, 16 heb' t'a smasanil. Ha ix Zilpa chi', aton ix skriada ix Lea ix ak'ji yuj winh sman, aton winhaj Labán. Ha heb' yuninal winh yet' ix, aton heb' tik: Vinhaj Gad yet' winhaj Aser. Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Gad: Aton winhaj Zifión, winhaj Hagui, winhaj Ezbón, winhaj Suni, winhaj Eri, winhaj Arodi yet' winhaj Areli. Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Aser: Aton winhaj Imna, winhaj Isúa, winhaj Isúi, winhaj Bería yet' ix yanab' heb' winh skuchan Sera. Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Bería chi', aton winhaj Heber yet' winhaj Malquiel.

Ha heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jacob chi' yet' ix Raquel, 14 heb' t'a smasanil. Ha heb' yuninal winh yet' ix: Aton winhaj José yet' winhaj Benjamín. Ha heb' yuninal winhaj José chi' yet' ix Asenat yisil winhaj Potifera sakerdote t'a chonhab' On: Aton winhaj Manasés yet' winhaj Efraín, aton heb' ix alji t'a Egipto. Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Benjamín chi': Aton winhaj Bela, winhaj Bequer, winhaj Asbel, winhaj Gera, winhaj Naamán, winhaj Ehi, winhaj Ros, winhaj Mupim, winhaj Hupim yet' winhaj Ard.

Ha heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jacob chi' yet' ix Bilha, ukwanh heb'. Ha ix Bilha chi', aton ix skriada ix Raquel ix ak'ji yuj winhaj Labán. Ha heb' yuninal winh yet' ix, aton heb' tik: Vinhaj Dan yet' winhaj Neftalí. Ha yuninal winhaj Dan chi', anhej winhaj Husim. Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Neftalí chi': Aton winhaj Jahzeel, winhaj Guni, winhaj Jezer yet' winhaj Silem.
66 heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jacob chi' t'a smasanil, aton heb' tik ajun yet' winh ayik ix k'och winh t'a Egipto. Aton wal heb' tik yinhtilal winh, ch'ok pax heb' ix alib'al.
Ch'ok pax yaj winhaj José yet' chawanh heb' yuninal ix alji t'a Egipto chi', yuj chi' 70 sb'isul winhaj Jacob chi' yet' heb' yinhtilal ayik ayxoek' winh ta'.
Ix b'ab'lajb'at winhaj Judá yuj winhaj Jacob chi', yik sb'at winh yal yab' winhaj José chi' to skot winh chawal t'a yol yik Gosén. Axo yik ix k'och heb' t'a Gosén chi',

ix schekan winhaj José chi' ak'chaj lista skarruaje yik b'at schaan winh smam winh t'a Gosén chi'. Ayic ix k'och winh t'a yichanh winh smam chi', ix och lak'naj winh t'a winh. Te junip ix em nhojan winh yok' t'a sjolom sjenhjab' winh smam chi'.
Axo ix yalan winh smam winh chi' icha tik: --Ha tiknaik, tik wal ix wilxioch a sat, tik wal pitzan achto, junk'olalxo ol in cham tiknaik, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj José chi' t'a heb' winh yuk'tak yet' t'a masanil heb' ayek' yet' winh smam winh chi': --Tik tzin b'at wal t'a winh rey: Masanil heb' winh wuk'tak yet' masanil heb' yinhtilal winh in mam ay t'a Canaán, toxo ix ja heb' wed'ok.
Yed'nak masanil nok' skalnel heb', nok' swakax yet' masanil tas ay t'a heb', yujto a smunlajel heb' aton moloj kalnel yet' moloj wakax, xin chama.
Yuj chi', ayik ol ex awtajb'at yuj winh rey chi', ol sk'anb'an winh t'ayex tas b'aj tzex munlaji,

tzeyalani to moloj kalnel yet' moloj wakax tze k'ulej. Anhej nok' kalnel ko molb'etz yaji yiktax onh kotoch uninal icha wal heb' ko mam quicham, xe chi. Yuj chi' ol ex kan t'a lum Gosén tik, yujto a heb' winh aj Egipto tik ay yowalil tato junnhej tz'aj heb' winh yet' heb' winh molum kalnel, xchi winhaj José chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj José yal t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: Ha winh in mam yet' heb' winh wuk'tak toxo ix jawi heb' winh t'a Gosén. Ix kot heb' winh t'a Canaán, yet'nak nok' skalnel heb' yet' nok' swakax yet' masanil tas ay t'a heb', xchi winh.
Sik'b'ilxoel owanh heb' winh yuk'tak winh chi' yuj yik sb'at heb' winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi' yik tz'ojtakajel heb' winh yuj winh.
Ix sk'anb'an winh rey chi' t'a heb' winh icha tik: --¿Tas munlajelal syal eyuuj? xchi winh. Ix yalan heb' winh: --Mamin, a onh a chekab' onh tik, molum kalnel onh icha heb' ko mam quicham.

Ix onh ja t'a jun lugar tik yujto ha t'a Canaán b'aj kajan onh te ay wejel, manhxa b'aj wach' swa nok' ko kalnel, yuj chi' tzonh tewi t'ayach, komonok scha a k'ol tzonh kajnaj t'a lum Gosén, xchi heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winhaj José: --Yakb'an ix ja winh a mam yet' heb' winh uk'tak ed'ok,

wach' tz'ajkan heb' winh t'a tik. Ak' lum Gosén chi' t'a heb' winh. Ha wal lu'um chi' te wach' t'a yol yik Egipto tik, syal skajnaj heb' winh ta'. Tato ay heb' winh uk'tak chi' te jelan t'a iloj nok' chi', syal tzak'och heb' winh yilumalok nok' in molb'etzal nok', xchi winh rey chi'.
Ix yik'anpaxb'at winh smam winhaj José t'a yichanh winh rey chi', yik wach' tz'ojtakajel winh yuj winh. Ichato chi' ix yak'an stzatzil sk'ol winh rey chi' winhaj Jacob chi'.
Ix sk'anb'an winh rey chi' t'a winh: --¿Jayexo ab'il a k 'inal? xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Jacob chi' icha tik: --Quenanto in k 'inal, anhejanto 130 ab'il, tonhej tzin b'eyeq'ui, palta t'a yataquil ix aj yek'b'at janik' tiempoal tik wuuj. Manto k'ochlaj in k 'inal icha wal ix aj yab'ilal heb' in mam wicham, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan wach' lolonel winh t'a yib'anh winh rey chi', ix elixta winh t'a yol sdespacho winh.
Ichato chi', ix yak'an lum lum te wach' winhaj José t'a winh smam yet' t'a heb' yuk'tak t'a yol yik Egipto chi', aton lum ay t'a slak'anil chonhab' Ramesés, icha ix yutej winh rey chi' yalani.
Aynhejoch winhaj José chi' yak'an swael heb', ato syala' jantak sb'isul junjun heb'.
Ix te em wejel t'a masanil yol yik Egipto chi' yet' t'a yol yik Canaán, manhxalaj ixim trigo, junlajanxonhej wan scham heb' anima yuj wejel.
Masanil k'een stumin heb' aj Egipto yet' heb' aj Canaán chi', ix b'at yak'kan heb' yuj ixim trigo. Masanil k'een ix sik'b'at winhaj José t'a yol sdespacho winh rey.

Axo yik ix lajwiel k'een tumin t'a Egipto yet' t'a Canaán chi', ix b'at yalan heb' winh aj Egipto chi' t'a winhaj José icha tik: --Ha tiknaik mamin, na'a tas tzonh aji. Toxo ix lajwib'at k'een ko tumin, ak' tas sko wa''a, yik wach' max onh chami, xchi heb' winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj José t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Tato manhxa k'een he tumin chi', ik'ekkot nok' he molb'etzal nok', syal wak'an ixim he trigo sk'exulok nok', xchi winh.
Yuj chi', ha t'a jun ab'il chi', ix yak' nok' schej heb' winh, nok' skalnel heb' winh, nok' swakax heb' winh yet' nok' sb'uru heb' winh sk'exulok ixim trigo chi'.

Ha yuj nok' molb'etzal nok' ix ek' jun ab'il chi', palta anheja' ay wejel. Ix b'at yalanxi heb' winh t'a winhaj José chi': --Max yal-laj ko k'ub'anel t'ayach mamin, manhxalaj k'een ko tumin, manhxa paxlaj nok' ko molb'etzal nok', ikxo nok' smasanil. Manhxa tas syal kak'an t'ayach, axonhej to skak'och ko b'a yet' ko lu'um t'a yol a k'ab'.

Colwajanh t'ayonh, yik wach' max onh chami, max kanlaj ko lu'um tik t'a ichnhejta'. Wach' tzonh a manel yet' lu'um, tzonh kannhej schekab'ok winh rey, syiquejkanel lum lum winh b'aj tzonh munlaj chi'. Anhej to tzak' ixim trigo ko wa''a yet' inhat skawej t'a sat lu'um, yik max onh chami, yik max kanpax tzinan lu'um, xchi heb' winh t'a winhaj José chi'.

Icha chi' ix yutej winhaj José smanankanel masanil lum lum t'a heb' winh aj Egipto chi' yik tz'ochkan lum yikok winh rey. Yuj jun niwan wejel chi', ix schonhkanel sb'a heb' yet' sluum chi'. Masanil heb' ix ochkan schekab'ok winh rey chi'.
Anhej sluum heb' sakerdote maj smanel-laj winhaj José chi', yujto tz'ak'ji strigo heb' swa yuj winh rey chi', yuj chi' malaj slum heb' winh chi' ix schonheli.
Ix yalan winhaj José chi' t'a heb' anima icha tik: --Ha tiknaik yik exxo winh rey yet' lum he lu'um, yujto ix ex in mankaneli. Ik'ekb'at ixim inhat, yik tzeyawej ixim.

Ato syala' jantak tzeyik' t'a lu'um, tzeyak'an chab' almul t'a junjun quintal t'a winh rey, haxo t'a ixim wajxaque' almul, ata' ol elta ixim inhat ol eyawej, anhejtona' ata' ol elta ixim ol he wa yet' eyuninal yet' masanil mach ayek' eyed'ok, xchi winh.
Yuj chi', ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --Te wach' a pensar mamin, uuj manh ol onh chamok. Ha tiknaik, tik tzonh ochkan schekab'ok winh rey chi', xchi heb' winh.

Ichaton chi' ix yutej winhaj José yak'an jun ley chi', chab' almul yik winh rey t'a junjun quintal syak' heb' anima kajan t'a masanil yol yik Egipto chi'. Icha chi' ix ajkan jun ley chi'. Anhej heb' winh sakerdote max ak'anlaj stojol chi', yujto maj schonhel-laj slum heb' t'a winh rey chi'.
Masanil heb' yinhtilal winhaj Israel, ix kan heb' t'a Egipto, ix smakkan lum lum heb' t'a Gosén. Ata' ix te q'uib'chaanh sb'isul heb'.
17 ab'il ix ek' winhaj Israel t'a Egipto chi', yuj chi', 147 ab'il sk'inal winh.

Ayic toxo wal scham winh syab'i, ix schekan winh awtajkot winhaj José. Ix yalan winh t'a winh icha tik: --Tato xajan in wal uuj, ak'och a k'ab' t'a yalanh in xub' tik, tzak'an a ti' t'a yichanh Dios to ol a k'anab'ajej tas ol wal tik. Tzin tewi t'ayach to manh ol in a muk t'a Egipto tik,
ha t'a stz'ey b'aj mukan heb' in mam wicham, ata' tzeyik'b'at in niwanil tik, tze mukanem b'aj mukan heb' chi', xchi winh. --Icha chi' ol wutej mamin, xchi winhaj José chi'.
Ix yalanxi winh to syak' sti' winhaj José chi' d'ha Dios, ix yak'an sti' winh chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix em nhojan winhaj Israel chi' t'a sjolom sch'at, ix yak'an yuj diosal winh d'ha Dios.

Ix ek' jab'ok stiempoal, ix alchaj t'a winhaj José chi' to penaxoay winh smam winh. Yuj chi' ix b'at winh yil winh, ix yik'anb'at heb' yuninal winh schawanhil yet'ok, aton winhaj Manasés yet' winhaj Efraín.
Ayic ix alchaj t'a winhaj Israel to toxo ix ja winhaj José chi' yila', ix yak' pural sb'a winh sk'e k'ojan t'a sti' sch'at.
Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ha Dios Syal Yuj Masanil, ha' ix sch'ox sb'a t'ayin t'a chonhab' Luz, t'a yol yik Canaán. Ata' ix yal wach' lolonel t'a wib'anh, ix yalan icha tik:

Ab' jun, tzijtum sb'isul inhtilal ol wak'a'. Ha jantak inhtilal, tzijtum nakión ol ajelk'ochok. Ol wak'anpax jun lu'um tik t'ayach yet' t'a masanil heb' inhtilal chi', ol eyiquej lum t'a junelnhej, xchi Dios chi'.

Yuj chi', a wal chawanh uninal ix alji t'a Egipto tik ayik manto in jawok, aton winhaj Manasés yet' winhaj Efraín, wiktaxon yaj heb' winh, icha wuninal tz'ajkan heb' winh, icha wal yaj winhaj Rubén yet' winhaj Simeón.
Ha jantakto heb' uninal toto ol aljok, ikxo ol aj heb', ha t'a smakb'en chawanh heb' yuk'tak heb' tik ol yik' yik heb'.
Ayic in meltzajnak t'a Padán-aram, chamnakkan ix a nun t'a Canaán ayik manto in jawilaj t'a Efrata. Ha t'a sb'eal Efrata chi' ix in mukkan ix, xchi winh. (Ha jun lugar chi' Belén sb'i tiknaik.)
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at k'elan winhaj Israel chi' t'a heb' winh chawanh yuninal winhaj José chi', ix sk'anb'an winh icha tik: --Ha heb' winh tik, ¿mach heb' winh? xchi winh.

--Ha heb' winh wuninal ix yak' Dios t'ayin t'a Egipto tik, xchi winhaj José chi'. Ixlajwi chi, ix yalan winh smam winh chi': --Elokab' t'a a k'ool, snitzokab'kot sb'a heb' winh t'a in tz'ey tik yik wach' ol walkan wach' lolonel t'a yib'anh heb' winh, xchi winh.

Yujto te icham winakxo winhaj Israel chi', maxtzak yal-laj yilan winh. Yuj chi' ix nitzchajkot heb' winh yuj winhaj José chi' t'a stz'ey winh. Ix och lak'lak' winh t'a heb' winh, ix tz'ub'jielta sti' heb' winh yuj winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh t'a winhaj José icha tik: --Te maxtzak in nalaj tato olto ach wila''. Tik wal manhok achnhej tzato ach wila'', palta ix el t'a sk'ol Dios to ixto wal wiloch heb' winh uninal tik, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'anelta heb' winh winhaj José chi' t'a skal yok winh smam chi', ix em nhojan winh t'a yichanh winh smam chi.

Ix yik'anxib'at heb' winh yuninal winh chi': Ha winhaj Efraín t'a swach' winh, haxo winhaj Manasés t'a sk'exanh winh. Ix yik'anb'at heb' winh b'aj ay winh smam chi'. Yuj chi' a winhaj Efraín chi' ix kan t'a sk'exanh winhaj Israel chi', haxo winhaj Manasés ix kan t'a swach' winh.

Ayic ix yak'anb'at sk'ab' winh chi' t'a yib'anh heb' winh, kulus ix yutejb'at sk'ab' winh chi' t'a yib'anh heb' winh. Yuj chi', a swach' winh ix k'och t'a yib'anh winhaj Efraín chi', haxo sk'exanh winh ix k'och t'a yib'anh winhaj Manasés chi', wach'chom b'ab'el winak winhaj Manasés chi'.

Ix yalan wach' lolonel winh t'a yib'anh winhaj José chi', icha tik: Ha Dios aton jun ix k'anab'ajaj yuj winh in mam icham aj Abraham yet' winh in mam aj Isaac, ha' tzin tanhwani yiktax ix in alji yet' pax ix in b'eynhejkoti.

Ha jun yángel Dios ix in kolan t'a syaelal. Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Dios t'a yib'anh heb' winh chawanh tik, yujokab' heb' winh tzin nachajkoti, nachajokab'paxkot winh in mam icham aj Abraham yet' winh in mam aj Isaac. Tzijtum ol aj sb'isul yinhtilal heb' winh chawanh tik t'a sat lum lum b'aj ol kajnajok, xchi winhaj Israel chi'.

Max schalaj sk'ol winhaj José chi' to ha t'a yib'anh winhaj Efraín chi' ix yak'k'e swach' k'ab' winh smam chi'. Yuj chi' ix yak'lej winh yik'anel swach' k'ab' winh smam chi' t'a yib'anh winhaj Efraín chi', ix yak'ank'e winh t'a yib'anh winhaj Manasés yalani.
Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Maay mamin, manh ichokta' tzutej, ha t'a winh b'ab'el tik, ata' tzak'k'e a wach' k'ab', xchi winh.

Maj yal-laj sk'ol winh smam winh chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: --Vojtakxo ach wuninal. Ha winh tik, niwan chonhab' ol aj yelk'och winh t'a b'ak'uinh, palta a winh tzak'an tik yelxo wal niwan ol aj yelk'och winh t'a winh b'ab'el tik, haxo yinhtilal winh, tzijtum nakión ol ajelk'ochok, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan wach' lolonel winh t'a yib'anh heb' schawanhil: --Icha tik ol aj he b'inaj yuj heb' he k'ab' eyok t'a b'ak'uinh ayik ol snib'ej heb' yalan wach' lolonel t'a yib'anh junok anima: Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Dios t'a ib'anh, icha ix aj yak'an t'a winhaj Efraín yet' t'a winhaj Manasés, xcham heb', xchi winhaj Israel chi'. Ha t'a aloj wach' lolonel chi', b'ab'el ix yak' b'inaj winhaj Efraín chi' winh t'a yichanh winhaj Manasés chi'.

D'a elanhchamel ix yalanxi winh t'a winhaj José chi': --Ach wuninal, a in tik toxo ol in chamok, palta aynhejoch Dios eyed'ok, aynhejpaxoch yet' heb' eyinhtilal. Ha ol ex ik'an meltzaj t'a slum ko mam quicham.
Swak' junxo makan makb'en t'ayach ek'to t'a yichanh yik heb' uk'tak, aton lum pak'an ix wik'kanek' t'a heb' amorreo t'a skal owal, xchi winhaj Israel chi' t'a winhaj José chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yawtankot heb' yuninal winhaj Jacob chi' smasanil, ix yalan winh: Ex wuninal, nitzekkot he b'ha t'a in tz'ey. Ab'ek tas ol ex aj t'a yik b'ak'uinh:
Nitzeccot he b'ha t'a in tz'ey, ol walan t'ayex. Ab'ek tas ol wal a in Israel he mam in tik:
Ach Rubén, a ach ton in b'ab'el unin ach, sch'oxel sb'a wip t'ayach. Ha ach tik toxonton ay a may, niwan elk'och t'a yichanh heb' uk'tak.
Ha tiknaik, manhxalaj ol aj elk'ochi, yujto lajan ach icha junok eluma', yujto q'uixweltak ix in utej t'a in waynub' ayik ix ach way yet' ix schab'il wetb'eyum.
Ha ach tik ach Simeón yet' ach tik Leví, eyuk'tak he b'a, a eyamk'ab' yik owal ix eyak'lab'ej ayik ix he k'ulan chukal.
Junelnhej malaj in gana tzin k'och b'aj tz'och he molchajel, yujto ayik ix kot oynaj ix eyila', ix he milcham anima. Ina ayik ix kot eyowal ix he mak'q'uichaj yok nok' mam wakax.
Kotokab'kan katab' t'a eyib'anh yuj yowal he jolom chi', ina manh jab'ok tz'ok' he k'ool. Yuj chi' ol ex in saklemejkanb'at t'a skal heb' eyetchonhab' Israel.
Ach wuninal Judá, ol alchaj wal wach' lolonel t'ayach yuj heb' uk'tak tik. Ol ach och b'inb'in t'a sjaj heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach. Ol em nhojjab' heb' uk'tak tik t'ayach.

Lajan ach wal icha junok nok' quelem choj, ayik slajwi schianb'at junok nok' nok' ix smila', spaxta t'a snhak'een. Tz'em nhojan, tz'em kutzan t'a sat lum. Icha wal junok niwaquil choj, ¿mach wal junok ol stek'b'ej sb'a ach stzuntzani?
Malaj mach syal yik'anek' sniwanil elk'ochi. Malaj mach syal yik'anek' a k'okoch t'a yol a k'ab', masanto ol ja jun Mach ay yiko', jun mach to masanil nakión ol k'anab'ajanok.
Ol yetzb'anoch sb'uru t'a jun yib' te' uwa yelxo wal wach', ol sjuk'an spichul t'a yal uwa.
Ha yol sat, te k'ik' yilji t'a yichanh wino, haxo k'een ye, yelxo wal te sak t'a yichanh nok' lech.
Ha achxo tik ach Zabulón, ha t'a sti' ha' mar b'aj sk'och te' barko ol ach kajnajok. Ha stz'akanhil lum a lu'um, ol k'och t'a Sidón.
Ha achxo tik ach Isacar, lajan ach icha junok nok' b'uru kuchum ikatz syik' yip t'a yol makte'.
Ayic ol ilanochi to te wach' junok lugar, wach' ol ik' ip ta', tzak'anoch yich a patik t'a yalanh ikatz, manhxalaj tas tzala' tzach ochxonhejkan chekab'ok.
Ha achxo tik ach Dan, a ach wal ol a ch'olb'itej a chonhab' icha wal smojal tz'aj sch'olb'itaj junok makan heb' etisraelal.
Ha ach tik, lajan tzutej a b'a icha wal junok nok' ajawchan tzek' b'ak'ak'ok t'a ti b'e, to schiji yok nok' chej yuj nok', yuj chi' sjulkanel nok' mach ayk'e t'a yib'anh.
Mamin Jehová tzin tanhwej in a kolani.
Ha achxo tik ach Gad, sk'och heb' ajk'ol yak' owal ed'ok, palta slajwub'alxo ol ak' ganar heb'.
Ha achxo tik ach Aser, ol yak'nhej sobre tas ol a wa''a. Ol ak'anpax tas ol swa heb' winh rey.
Ha achxo tik ach Neftalí, libre aj icha junok nok' kob'es k'ultaquil chej. Ha wal wach' pensaril ol ala'.
Ha achxo tik ach José, lajan ach wal icha junok te te' ay t'a sti' junok ha ha', ste el k'uyan, manh jantakok sat syak'a', sk'axpajek' sk'ab' t'a yib'anh smakte'al.
Te ajk'ol syutej sb'a heb' anima t'ayach, sjulwaj heb' yet' sjul-lab' t'ayach, tz'och wal ijan heb' ach stzuntzani.
Ha ach tik, te ay wal yip a k'ab', te wach' yaj a jul-lab' yuj wal yip in Diosal Syalnhej yuj, aton Vilumal yet' in Kolumal a in Israel in tik,

yuj wal yip in Diosal, aton ol ach kolanok. Ha Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil ol yak' swach'k'olal t'a ib'anh, aton nhab' skot t'a satcha’anh yet' syaxil sat lum lum. Yuj swach'k'olal ol q'uib' sb'isul heb' uninal yet' nok' a molb'etzal nok'.

Ach José, masanil juntzanh wach' lolonel swalkan tik t'a ib'anh a in a mam in tik, yelxo wal te niwan yelk'och t'a yichanh wach' lolonel ix yalkan in mam t'a wib'anh, yelxo wal niwan t'a yichanh juntzanh witz aytax ek' t'a peka'. Ha masanil juntzanh tik swalkan t'a ib'anh, to sik'b'ilachkanel t'a skal heb' winh uk'tak tik.

Ha achxo tik ach Benjamín, lajan ach wal icha junok nok' oques te ow. Ayic wan sakb'i k 'inal schianb'at schib'ej nok' smila', ayik k'ik'b'alilxo spukanb'at tas tz'ilchaj yuj, xchi winhaj Israel chi'.

Aton wal stzolal heb' lajchawanh yuninal winhaj Israel tik. Masanil juntzanh lolonel tik ix yal winh ayik ix yalankanel wach' lolonel winh t'a yib'anh junjun heb' winh yuninal chi', icha wal smojal tas ol aj junjun heb'.
