Ach Jehová, Rey ach t'a masanil tiempo, xchi heb' israel t'a sb'it.

Ayic ix kot skarruaje winh sreyal Egipto yet' juntzanh heb' ed'jinak nok' chej t'a yol ha' mar, ix mukjikanem heb' t'a yol ha' yuj spoder Jehová. Axo pax heb' israel jun, yelxo wal wach' ix aj yek' heb' t'a yol jun b'e taquinh t'a snanhal ha'.
Yuj chi', a ix María schekab' Dios, yanab' winhaj Aarón, ix yik'k'e jun spandereta ix. Masanil heb' ix yetisraelal ix yet'nakk'e spandereta heb' ix, ix k'e cheneljok heb' ix yet' ix.
Ix b'itan ix María t'a yichanh heb' ix icha tik: Co b'itejek sb'i Jehová, yujto te satub'tak ix aj yak'an ganar owal. Ix mukchajkan nok' chej t'a yol ha' mar yet' heb' winh ed'jinak nok', xchi ix.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'anel heb' israel winhaj Moisés t'a sti' ha' Chacchac Mar chi', ix kot heb' t'a taquinh lu'um yik Shur. Oxe' k'ual ix b'ey heb', malaj b'aj ix ilchaj ha ha' yuj heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix jawi heb' t'a jun skuch Mara. Ay jun ha' ta', palta maj yal-laj yuk'an ha' heb' yujto yelxo wal te k'a' ha', yuj chi' Mara ix sb'iejkan jun lugar chi' yuj heb'.
Ix och ijan heb' anima chi' schichon sk'ol t'a spatik winhaj Moisés chi', ix laj yalan heb': ¿Tas ol kuk' tiknaik? xchi heb'.

Yuj chi', ix sk'anan skolwal Jehová winhaj Moisés chi'. Axo Jehová chi' ix ch'oxan jun te te' t'a winh, ix yak'anem te' winh t'a yol ha', ix b'o ha' yuj te'. Ata' ix yak' jun sley Jehová t'a heb' israel, yik syila' tato sk'anab'ajej heb'.

Ix yalan Jehová: Tato tze k'anab'ajej tas swal a in Jehová in tik, tze k'ulan tas syal in cheknab'il yet' masanil in k'ayb'ub'al, manh ol wak'kotlaj ilya t'a eyib'anh icha juntzanh ix wak'kot t'a yib'anh heb' aj Egipto, yujto a in Jehová in tzex wanhtej, xchi.
Ixlajwi chi', ix jawi heb' t'a Elim b'aj ay lajchawe' sjaj ha ha' yet' 70 te' palma. Ata' ix sb'ok'e skampamento heb' t'a stitak ha ha' chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix el heb' israel t'a Elim chi', ix jawi heb' t'a tzinan lum yik Sin, t'a skal Elim yet' Sinaí. Ha t'a jun k'u chi' nanhal schab'il ujalxo yelta heb' t'a Egipto.
Ayic ayek' heb' ta', masanil heb' ix alub'tanhan t'a spatik winhaj Moisés yet' t'a spatik winhaj Aarón.

Ix yalan heb' icha tik: --Comonoc ix el t'a sk'ol Dios to ha t'a Egipto onh chamkani. Ata' tzonh em k'ojan t'a stz'ey lum chenal chib'ej, tzonh wa'i, masanto tzonh te b'ud'ji. Palta a exxo tik ix onh eyik'kot t'a taquinh lu'um tik yik tzonh cham ko masanil yuj wejel, xchi heb'.

Yuj chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Ha t'a satcha’anh ol wak'kot tas ol he wa''a. Junjun k'u ol b'at he molank'e tas ol he wa''a, yuj chi' ol wila'' tato ol he k'anab'ajej in cheknab'il, mato maay.
Axo t'a swaquil k'ual, tze molankank'e yik chab'ok k'ual, tze b'oankan yik jun k'u chi' yet' yik yuquil k'ual, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalan winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón chi' t'a heb' chonhab': --Ha t'a jun yemk'ualil tik ol eyojtaquejeli to yel a Jehová ix ex ik'anelta t'a Egipto.
Axo t'a q'uinhib'alil ol eyilan stziquiquial, yujto ix yab'i tas ix eyutej he lolon t'a spatik. Palta a onh tik, ¿tok ay quelk'ochi, yuj chi' tzeyal ko pekal? xchi heb' winh.

Ix yalanpax winhaj Moisés chi': --Ha t'a yemk'ualil tik ol yak' nok' chib'ej Jehová he chi'a. Axo t'a junjun q'uinhib'alil, ol yak'an he wael ato syala' jantak tze wa''a, yujto ix yab'i tas tzeyalub'tanhej t'a spatik. Wach'chom t'a ko patik tzeyalub'tanhej eyalani, palta malaj quelk'och a onh tik. Val yel ha t'a spatik Jehová tzeyalub'tanhej, xchi winh.
Ha t'a jun rato chi' ix yal winhaj Moisés chi' t'a winhaj Aarón: --Al t'a heb' smasanil to snitzkot sb'a heb' t'a yichanh Jehová, yujto ix yab'i tas ix yalub'tanhej heb', xchi winh.
Ha wal yik wan slolon winhaj Aarón t'a heb' yetisraelal chi', ix yilanb'at heb' t'a tzinan lu'um, ix sch'oxank'e sb'a stziquiquial Jehová t'a skal jun topanh asun.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi':

--Ix wab' wal tas ix yal heb' israel tik t'a in patik. Yuj chi' al t'a heb' to a tiknaik t'a k'ik'b'alil, ol wak' nok' schib'ej heb', haxo sq'uinhib'i k'ik'an swak' tas swa heb', masanto sb'ud'ji wal sk'ol heb'. Icha chi' ol aj yojtakanel heb' to a in ton Jehová he Diosal in, xchi Jehová.
Ha t'a jun yemk'ualil chi', ix jawi nhilnaj nok' ub', ix majel b'aj ay skampamento heb' yuj nok'. Axo t'a q'uinhib'alil t'a junxo k'u, ix em yal ak'wal t'a spatiktak skampamento heb' chi'.
Ayic ix takji yal ak'wal chi', ay juntzanh tas te kotak ix kan t'a sat lu'um, icha k'een cheew yilji.
Manh yojtakok juntzanh chi' heb'. Ayic ix yilanoch heb', ix yal-lan heb' t'ay junjun: ¿Tastaxlaj juntzanh tik? xchi heb'. Ix yalan winhaj Moisés: --Aton he wael syak' Jehová tik.
Aton jun cheknab'il ix yak' tik: Syal he molanchaanh t'a junjun k'u, icha jantak tz'och eyuj yuj jaywanh ex t'a yol he pat. Ik'ekk'e junjunok echlab' yik junjun anima, xchi winh.
Ichaton chi' ix yutej heb' anima chi'. Ay mach niwan ix molank'ei, ay pax mach quennhej.
Ato a yechlab'il ix ak'chaji, maj yak' sobre t'a heb' niwan ix molank'ei, anheja' k'okb'il ix yab'pax t'a heb' quennhej ix molank'ei. Junjun mach ix smolk'e jantak swa t'a junjun k'u.
Ix yalan winhaj Moisés t'a heb': --Max yal-laj he molankan yik he k'ik'an, xchi winh.

Ay mach maj k'anab'ajanlaj tas ix yal winh, ix smolankan jab'okxo yik swa heb' k'ik'an yalani. Ha tas ix smolkan heb' chi', ix och ha'ayaxok, ix k'e sjab' t'a junxo k'u, yuj chi' ix kot yowal winhaj Moisés chi' t'a heb' maj k'anab'ajan chi'.
Junjun q'uinhib'alil smolank'e heb' jantak swa t'a jun k'u chi', haxo yik sja yok k'u tz'ulaxb'ati.

Axo t'a swaquil k'ual, junjunto echlab' sobreal syik'k'e heb' yik swa junjun heb', syalelk'ochi to chab'chab' echlab' yik junjun heb'. Axo heb' ayoch yajalil t'a skal heb' anima chi', ix b'at yal heb' t'a winhaj Moisés.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winh: --Ha jun chi' a Jehová ix alani, yujto a k'ik'an sk'ual ik'oj ip. Ha jun ik'oj ip chi' sk'ual yik tz'ik'jichaanh Jehová. Tze tz'anhkan tas stz'anhchaji yik tze wa k'ik'an, tze mayankan tas smaychaji, tze sik'ankan yik he k'ik'an chi', xchi winh.
Ix sk'anab'ajan heb' anima tas ix yal winhaj Moisés chi'. Ix sik'ankanb'at masanil tas swa heb' t'a junxo k'u. Maj ixtaxb'atok, maj ochpax ha'ayaxok.

Axo t'a junxo k'u, ix yalan winhaj Moisés chi': --Vaec he wael kan eyuj ewi, yujto sk'ual ik'oj ip tiknaik, tze k'anab'ajej eyik'anchaanh Jehová. Ha t'a jun k'ual tik, malaj jab'ok tas tze wa chi' tz'ilchaj eyuj t'a spatiktak kampamento tik.
Yujto anhej t'a waque' k'u t'a yol semana syal he molan tas tze wa''a, haxo t'a yuquil k'ual, manhxalaj tas sjawi, yujto sk'ual ik'oj ip, xchi winh.
Palta ay heb' ix b'at sayan yik t'a yuquil k'ual chi', palta malaj jab'ok tas ix ilchaj yuj heb'.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Yelxo wal max he k'anab'ajej, ¿tom ol ex ochnhej ijan he tenanek' in cheknab'il yet' in k'ayb'ub'al?

Naec wal sik'lab'il, a in Jehová in swala' to yowalil tze k'anab'ajej sk'ual ik'oj ip. Yuj chi' ha t'a swaquil k'ual, swak' wael t'a chab' k'ual, yuj chi' ha t'a jun k'ual chi', wach'nhej eyajek' t'a yol b'ajtak ayex, malaj mach sb'at munlajel, xchi t'a winh.
Ichaton chi' ix aji, ix yik'an yip heb' anima t'a yuquil k'ual chi'.
Maná ix yak' heb' israel skuch juntzanh wael ix smol chi'. Sacsac yilji icha wal sat anh kulantro. Te chi' swaji, icha ixim k'oxox pan ayoch yalchab' t'ay.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Moisés: --Ix yal Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Sik'ekb'at junok echlab' maná, yik ol yil heb' eyuninal t'a b'ak'uinh. Ol yil he wael heb' ix wak' he wa t'a lum tzinan lu'um tik, ayik ix ex wik'anelta t'a Egipto, xchi Jehová, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.

Yuj chi', ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Aarón: --Ik'kot junok chen, tzak'anem junok echlab' maná t'a yool icha yalan Jehová. Slajwi chi', tza sik'ankanb'at t'a yichanh Jehová chi', yik wach' ol yil heb' quinhtilal, xchi winh.
Icha ix yutej Jehová yalan t'a winhaj Moisés chi', icha chi' ix yutej winhaj Aarón, ix sik'ankanb'at winh t'a stz'ey k'een k'een b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkan strato Jehová.
D'a 40 ab'il ix swa maná heb' israel, masanto ix k'och heb' t'a lum kajnub'al t'a smojonal Canaán.
Ha jun echlab' chi', Gomer sb'i, ay am nanhalok yoxil litro ha ha' tz'em t'a yool.
Masanil heb' israel ix el t'a lum tzinan lu'um yik Sin, k'ojank'olal ix aj sb'ey heb', ato syal tas tz'aj sch'oxan Jehová. Ixlajwi chi', ix jawi heb' t'a Refidim, palta malaj ha ha' ta'.
Yuj chi' ix kotxi yowal heb' t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Ha tiknaik, ak' ha ha' kuk'ej, xchi heb'. --¿Tas yuj skot eyowal t'ayin? ¿Tas yuj tzeyak' prowal Jehová? xchi winh.

Palta haxo heb' chonhab' yelk'olal scham heb' yuj taquinhtial, yuj chi' ix k'e yaw heb' t'a winhaj Moisés chi', ix yalan heb': --¿Tas yuj ix onh ik'elta t'a Egipto? ¿Tom yuj ko cham yuj taquinhtial yet' heb' kuninal yet' pax nok' ko molb'etzal nok'? xchi heb'.
Yuj chi' ix tewi winhaj Moisés chi' t'a Jehová icha tik: --Mamin, ¿tas wal swutej heb' anima tik? Ijan wal tzin sjulk'enej heb', xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi Jehová t'a winh: --Ha tiknaik, b'ab'lajanh t'a yichanh heb' anima chi', tzik'anb'at jaywanhok heb' yichamtak winaquil chonhab' chi' ed'ok. Tzik'anpaxb'at te' a k'okoch, te' ak'lab'ejnak a mak'an sat ha' Nilo.

Ha in ol in b'ab'laj t'a ichanh t'a k'een tenam t'a Horeb, haxo ol ach k'och ta', tza mak'an sat k'een yet' te' a k'okoch chi', ol elul ha' t'a sat k'een, ol yuk'an ha' heb' anima chi', xchi t'a winh. Icha chi' ix yutej winhaj Moisés chi' t'a yichanh heb' yichamtak winaquil chonhab' Israel.

Meriba ix yak' winh sb'iej jun lugar chi', yujto chuk ix yal heb' t'a spatik winh. Masah pax ix yak' winh sb'iej, yujto ix yak' prowal Jehová heb', ix yalan heb': Mato wal ayek' Jehová t'a ko kal, mato maay, xchi heb'.
Ayic ayek' heb' israel t'a Refidim chi', ata' ix k'och heb' amalekita yak' owal yet' heb'.

Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Moisés t'a winhaj Josué: --Sik'el jantakok heb' ko soldado yik sb'at heb' yak' owal yet' heb' amalekita. Ha k'ik'an tzin b'at t'a chon tzalan, wed'nak te' k'okoch, te' syak'lab'ej Dios, xchi winh.
Ix sk'anab'ajan winhaj Josué chi', ix b'at yak'an owal winh yet' heb' amalekita chi'. Axo winhaj Moisés chi' yet' winhaj Aarón yet' pax winhaj Hur, ix b'at heb' winh t'a chon tzalan chi'.
Ha syik'ank'e sk'ab' winhaj Moisés t'a chaanh, skan heb' amalekita t'a yalanh yuj heb' israel. Axo syik'anxiem sk'ab' winh, ijan skan heb' winh israel t'a yalanh.

Palta ste k'unb'i sk'ab' winh sb'at jekan, yuj chi' ix say jun k'een k'een winhaj Aarón yet' winhaj Hur chi'. Ha t'a yib'anh k'een ix em k'ojan winhaj Moisés chi', haxo heb' winh ix yamank'e sk'ab' winh chi', junjun heb' winh t'a stz'eytak winh masanto ix b'at k'u.
Icha chi' ix aj yak'an lajwok heb' amalekita winhaj Josué chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Tz'ib'chajokab'kan jun ab'ix tik yik ol nachajkotok. Tzalanpax t'a winhaj Josué chi' to a in ol in satel masanil heb' amalekita t'a junelnhej, manhxa b'aj ol nachajkot heb', xchi t'a winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix sb'oank'e jun altar winhaj Moisés chi', ix yak'an winh sb'iej icha tik: Ha Jehová b'ab'el kuuj t'a owal.
Ix yalan winh icha tik: Yujto ix yik'chaanh sk'ab' heb' yinhtilal winhaj Amalec yak'an owal yet' Jehová, yuj chi' ol yak'nhej owal Jehová yet' heb' aj Amalec t'a masanil tiempo, xchi winh.
Ha winhaj Jetro, snhi' winhaj Moisés, sakerdote yaj t'a Madián. Ix yab' winh jantak tas ix sk'ulej Dios yet' winhaj Moisés yet' pax chonhab' Israel, ayik ix ik'jielta heb' yuj t'a Egipto.
Ha winhaj Moisés chi', yak'nak meltzaj ix yetb'eyum winh, aton ix Séfora yet' chawanh yuninal winh t'a winhaj Jetro chi'. Ix chaji heb' yuj winhaj Jetro chi'.
(Ha winh sb'ab'el unin winhaj Moisés chi', Gersón sb'i winh, yujto ix yal winh: Tonhej tzin b'eyek' t'a skal heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, xchi winh.
Axo winh schab'il skuch Eliezer, yujto ix yal winh: Aynhejoch sDiosal in mam wed'ok, a ix in kolanel t'a k'een yespada winh sreyal Egipto, xchi winh.)

Axo ix yab'an winhaj Jetro to ha t'a tzinan lu'um ay skampamento winhaj Moisés chi', t'a yich witz b'aj sch'ox sb'ha Dios. Ata' ix b'at winhaj Jetro chi' yil winh yet'nak ix Séfora yetb'eyum winhaj Moisés chi' winh. Yed'nakpax heb' yuninal winhaj Moisés chi' winh.
Ix yalanb'at winh t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Ha in Jetro a nhi' in tik, wan in k'och ach wila'', ajun ix etb'eyum wed'ok yet' pax heb' winh eyuninal schawanhil, xchib'at winh.

D'a elanhchamel ix elta winhaj Moisés scha winh snhi' chi', ix em nhojan winh t'a yichanh winh, ix stz'ub'anelta sti' winh. Ixlajwi yak'lan stzatzil sk'ol heb', ix och heb' t'a yol smantiado winhaj Moisés chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Moisés chi' t'a winh snhi' chi' tas ix utaj winh sreyal Egipto yet' masanil heb' aj Egipto yuj Jehová ayik ix skolanel heb' chonhab' israel. Ix yalanpax winh yuj jantak yaelal ix yil yet' heb' anima chi' t'a yoltak b'e yet' tas ix aj skolji heb' yuj Jehová.
Ix te tzalaj sk'ol winhaj Jetro chi', a ix yab'an skolwal Dios winh t'a chonhab' Israel, ayik ix skolanelta heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' aj Egipto.
Ix yalan winh: --Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová, aton ix ex kolanel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' aj Egipto yet' t'a yol sk'ab' winh rey, ix ex yik'anelta t'a yalanh smandar heb'.

Ha tiknaik sik'lab'il wal snachajel wuuj to a Jehová yelxo wal ek'al t'a yib'anh juntzanhxo Dios, yujto ix ex koljiel yuj t'a yol sk'ab' heb' aj Egipto, wach'chom ix ste ik'ejchaanh sb'a heb' t'a yichanh, xchi winhaj Jetro chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix snhusan jun nok' silab' winhaj Jetro chi' d'ha Dios, ix yak'anpax juntzanhxo silab' winh t'ay. Ix ja winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yichamtak winaquil chonhab' b'aj ayek' winh snhi' winhaj Moisés chi', ix wa heb' t'a yichanh Jehová.
Axo t'a junxo k'ual, ix em k'ojan winhaj Moisés, ix och ijan winh sch'olb'itan tastak yaj yowal heb' chonhab'. Pilan k'u ayek' heb' anima chi' t'a yichanh winh.

Ayic ix yilan winhaj Jetro yuj tas syutej winhaj Moisés sb'oan yaj yowal heb' anima chi', ix yalan winh t'a winh: --¿Tas yuj icha chi' tzutej heb' anima tik? ¿Tas yuj a achnhej tza b'o yaj yowal heb' smasanil? Ay heb' tonhej tzek' tiempo t'ay, pilan k'u stanhwej heb', xchi winhaj Jetro chi'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Moisés chi': --Sjawi heb' anima tik t'ayin yik tzin k'anb'an d'ha Dios yuj heb'.
Ayic syak'an owal heb' sjawipax heb' t'ayin, tzin ch'olb'itan mach tzek' t'a yib'anh yet' mach yel syala', slajwi chi' swalan scheknab'il yet' sk'ayb'ub'al Dios t'a heb', xchi winh.
Ix yalan winh snhi' winh chi': --Manh wach'ok icha tzutej chi'.
Tzach te k'unb'i, ste k'unb'ipax heb' anima tik. Yelxo tzek' yib'anh a munlaji, anhejtona' manh ol ach tzak'wanpaxlaj a ch'okoj.
Ab' tas ol wal t'ayach, ha Dios ol kolwaj ed'ok. Ha ach tzach och t'a yichanh Dios yuj heb' anima, tzalan t'ay yuj tastak sk'ulej heb'.
Wach' to tza k'ayb'ej heb' t'a sley Jehová, tzalani tas ol aj sb'eyb'at heb' yet' tas ol sk'ulej heb'.

Ha jun tas wach' tza k'ulej tiknaik to tza sik'el jaywanhok heb' winh ay xiwk'olal d'ha Dios, heb' winh jelan spensar, heb' winh tojol spensar, heb' winh manh komonok sk'ananel tumin t'a anima. Tzak'anoch yopisio heb' winh t'a yib'anh junjunok makan anima. Ay heb' winh tzak'och yajalilok t'a junok mil anima, ay pax heb' winh tzak'och yajalilok t'a junok kien, ay pax heb' winh anhej t'a junok 50 b'aj tzak'ochi, ay pax heb' winh anhej t'a lajunhwanhok b'aj tzak'ochi.

Ha heb' winh tik ol b'oan yaj yowal heb' anima. Tato quennhej yaj yowal anima chi', sb'o'okab' yaj heb' winh. Tato niwan yaj jun, yik'okab'kot heb' t'a ichanh. Tato icha chi' ol utej, ol kolwaj jab'ok heb' yik'anel jun munlajel tik t'a ib'anh.

Tato tza k'anab'ajej a k'ulan jun tik, tato schapax sk'ol Dios to icha chi' ol ajok, icha chi' ol aj stechaj uuj. Anhejtona' heb' anima tik ol meltzaj heb' t'a tzalajk'olal t'a yet'tal junjun, xchi winhaj Jetro chi'.
Ix sk'anab'ajan winhaj Moisés tas ix yal winh snhi' chi'.

Yuj chi' ix sik'anel heb' te ay spensar winh, heb' jelan t'a skal heb' yetchonhab', ix yak'anoch yopisio heb' winh t'a yib'anh junjun mil anima, t'a yib'anh kien, t'a yib'anh 50 yet' t'a yib'anh lajunhwaanh.
Ha heb' winh chi' aynhejoch t'a yib'anh sch'olb'itan yaj heb' anima. Ha owal te niwan yaji, tz'ik'chajb'at t'a yichanh winhaj Moisés chi'. Axo pax owal quennhej yaj jun, a heb' winh sb'oan yaji.
Ix stak'lankan sb'a winhaj Jetro yet' winhaj Moisés chi', ix pax winh t'a schonhab'.
Ha wal stz'akwi yoxil ujal yel heb' israel t'a Egipto, ix ja heb' t'a taquinh lu'um b'aj ay lum Sinaí,
spetoj heb' t'a Refidim. Ha ix ja heb' ta' ix sb'oan skampamento heb' t'a yich witz Sinaí.
Ix awtajk'e winhaj Moisés yuj Jehová Dios t'a jolom witz chi' yik slolon yet' winh. Ix yalan icha tik: --Al juntzanh lolonel tik t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jacob, aton heb' etisraelal:
Scham wal eyilan tas ix wutej heb' anima t'a Egipto yet' tas ix wutej ex wik'anelta, ayik ex wik'ankot b'aj ayex ek' tik. Ichato yib'anh sk'axil nok' niwak ch'akb'a ayexk'ei ayik ix ex ja t'a tik.
Tato te k'anab'ajum tzeyutej he b'a t'ayin, tze k'anab'ajan in trato, in chonhab' ex toni, sik'b'il ex el wuj t'a skal juntzanhxo chonhab'. Vic jun yol yib'anhk’inal tik smasanil,
palta a exxo tik, jun chonhab'il sakerdote tzex ajkani yik tzin eyak'an serwil, jun chonhab' anima to wiknhej yaji, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix emixta winhaj Moisés t'a jolom witz Sinaí chi', ix yawtankot heb' yichamtak winaquil chonhab' winh. Ix och ijan winh yalan tas ix yal Jehová chi'.
Masanil heb' israel ix tak'wi icha tik: --Masanil tas schek Jehová ko k'ulej, ol ko k'ulejnhej, xchi heb'. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at yalanxi winhaj Moisés t'a Jehová tas ix yal heb' chonhab' chi'.

Ix yalanxi Jehová chi' t'a winh: --Ha tiknaik, ol in ch'ox in b'a t'ayach t'a skal jun niwan k'ik'al asun, ol in lolon ed'ok, yik wach' ol yab' heb' anima, ol ach yak'anoch heb' t'a sk'ool t'a masanil tiempo, xchi. Ix yalanxi winhaj Moisés chi' t'a Jehová tas ix yutej yalan heb' chonhab' chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová: --Ixic, tzal t'a heb' anima to sakb'itej sb'a heb' tiknaik yet' k'ik'an, sjuk'anel spichul heb' yujto ol och heb' ejmelal t'a wichanh.
Axo chab'ej tzin emuli, tzin ch'oxan in b'ha t'a masanil chonhab' t'a jolom witz Sinaí.

Tzak'em yechel t'a yichtak witz tik, tzalan t'a heb' to niwanokab' yelk'och jun witz tik t'a yol sat heb'. Max yal-laj sk'eta heb' t'ay, max yal ste jawi heb' t'a stz'ey, tato ay junok mach sjawi t'a stz'ey, yowalil schami.

Malaj mach syal smak'ancham jun anima chi' yet' sk'ab'. Sjulk'enaj chami, ma sjuljicham yet' jul-lab'. Taxonhej anima ma junok nok' nok', tojolnhej schami. Ato ol puchaj sch'aak nok' kalnel, ichato chi' syal snitzankot sb'a heb' anima t'a slak'anil lum witz tik, xchi Jehová.
Ixlajwi chi', ix paxta winhaj Moisés t'a jolom witz chi', ix ul yalan winh t'a heb' israel chi' to sakb'itej sb'a heb', sjuk'anpaxel spichul heb'.
Ix yalan winhaj Moisés chi' t'a heb': --Ha tiknaik sakb'itejek he b'a, yujto tzex och ejmelal t'a Jehová chab'ej. Manhxo ex way yet' heb' ix eyetb'eyum t'a chab' k'ual tik, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Axo ix sakb'i t'a schab'jial, ix ek' kopnaj lheb'lon, ix mak'waj k'u, ay jun niwan asun k'ik' t'a jolom witz chi'. Ixlajwi chi, ix yab'an heb' anima te chaanh ix ok' jun k'een trompeta t'a jolom witz chi'. Masanil heb' anima ayek' t'a yol kampamento chi', ix xiwk'e heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'anb'at masanil heb' anima winhaj Moisés chi' t'a spatiquel kampamento chi', ix b'at schaan Dios heb', ix kan oyan heb' t'a slak'anil yich lum witz chi'.
Ix te k'e stab'il lum witzal Sinaí chi', ix emul Jehová t'a skal jun niwan k'ak'. Icha wal sk'e stab'il junok horno, icha wal chi' sk'e stab'il, ix te ib'xik'e jun witz chi'.
Axo k'een trompeta chi', juntak el spuji k'een, ste k'echaanh sjaj k'een. Aton ta' ix lolon winhaj Moisés yet' Jehová. Te chaanh syutej tak'wok sb'a Jehová chi' t'a winh.
Ha wal t'a schaanhil sjolom lum witz chi', ata' ix emul Jehová, ix yalan t'a winhaj Moisés chi' to sk'e winh b'aj ayek' chi', yuj chi' ix k'e winh.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winh: --Ha tiknaik emanh t'a yich witz chi', b'at alan t'a heb' anima to max ek'ta heb' in yil b'aj aykanem jun yechel, haxo talaj tz'aji, tzijtum heb' schami.
Anheja' heb' sakerdote tz'ochtaxon t'a in lak'anil, yowalil sakb'itej sb'a heb'. Tato maay, haxo talaj tz'aji, swach' satel heb', xchi t'a winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Moisés chi' t'ay: --Ha heb' chonhab' chi', max yal-laj sk'eta heb' t'a lum witz tik, yujto a ach ix ala' to tz'em yechel b'aj syal sjawi heb' yuj sch'oxani to niwan yelk'ochi, xchi winh.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winh icha tik: --Emanhxi, haxo tzach k'euli ed'nakokab' winhaj Aarón. Axo heb' sakerdote yet' masanil heb' chonhab', max k'axpajek'talaj heb' b'aj aykanem yechel chi' uuj, yik max jawi heb' b'aj ayinek' tik, tato maay, xim miltachamlaj heb', xchi Jehová.
Ix emta winhaj Moisés chi', ix ul yalan winh t'a heb' chonhab' tas ix yal Jehová chi'.
Ix lolon Dios t'a heb' israel, ix yalan t'a heb' icha tik:
Ha in ton Jehová he Diosal in, ix ex wik'elta t'a yol yik Egipto b'aj ayex och chekab'ok, b'aj manh eyikok he b'a.
Malajokab' junokxo Dios b'aj tzex och ejmelal, palta anhejokab' t'ayin.
Manh he b'o yechel junok tas he diosalok, junok tas ay t'a satcha’anh, tas ay t'a sat lu'um tik, ma tastak ay t'a yoltak ha ha'.

Manh ex em nhojan t'ay, manh eyak'paxem he b'a t'ay, yujto a in Jehová he Diosal in, ste kot wowal t'ayex tato tzex och ejmelal t'a junokxo tasi. Ol wak'och syaelal heb' mamab'il malaj welk'och t'ay. Ol wak'anpax yaelal t'a yib'anh yuninal heb', yixchiquin heb' yet' yinhtilal heb'.
Axo heb' tzin xajanani, heb' sk'anab'ajan in cheknab'il, ol in xajanej heb' yet' heb' yinhtilal heb' yik ol b'eynhejb'atok.
Manh komonok tze lok in b'i a in Jehová he Diosal in tik, ma tzeyak' b'inaj in b'i t'a junok tas t'a ichnhej ta', yujto ol wak' yaelal t'a mach icha chi' sk'ulej.
Niwanokab' yelk'och sk'ual ik'oj ip t'ayex yuj in eyik'anchaanh.
Vaque' k'ual tzex munlaj t'a he munlajel,

haxo t'a yuquil k'ual, sk'ual ik'oj ip. Ha jun k'u chi' wik yaji. Manh ex munlaj t'a jun k'u chi' yet' heb' eyuninal, heb' eyisil, ma heb' winh he chekab', ma heb' ix he chekab', ma nok' he molb'etzal nok', nok' smunlaji, ma heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal, mokab' munlaj heb'.

Yujto a in Jehová in tik, t'a waque' k'ual ix in b'o satcha’anh yet' sat lu'um yet' ha' mar yet' masanil tastak ay t'ay. Axo t'a yuquil k'ual, ix och waan in munlaji, yuj chi' a jun yuquil k'ual chi' wik yaji, yuj yochpax he wach'ilok.
Ayokab' yelk'och he mam he nun t'a he sat, yik wach' snajatb'i he k 'inal t'a sat lum lum ol wak' t'ayex.
Manh he milcham heb' eyetanimail.
Manh ex em ajmulal t'a yol sk'ab' eyetb'eyum junjun ex.
Manh ex elk'anok.
Manh he nak'e lolonel t'a spatik heb' eyetanimail.

Manh he nib'ejoch spat heb' eyetanimail. Manh he nib'ejpaxoch ix yetb'eyum heb', winh schekab' heb', ma ix schekab' heb', nok' swakax heb', nok' sb'uru heb', ma junokxo tas ay t'a heb' eyetanimail chi', manh he nib'ejochi, xchi Jehová.

Masanil heb' israel ix yab' wal heb' smak'waj k'u. Ix yilan heb' yek' kopoljok k'ak', ix yab'anpax heb' te chaanh ix puji jun k'een trompeta. Ix yilan wal heb' sk'e stab'il lum witzal Sinaí, ix ib'xik'e heb' yuj xiwelal, ix snitzanel sb'a heb'.
Yuj chi' ix yal heb' t'a winhaj Moisés: --Ha ach tzach lolon t'ayonh. Ol ko k'anab'ajan tas ol yal Jehová Dios chi' t'ayach. Mocxob' lolon t'ayonh, tato maay, ol onh chamok, xchi heb' anima chi'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Moisés chi': --Manh ex xiwok, tonhej tzulek' Dios chi' yik tzex yak'an prowal, yik wach' aynhej he xiwk'olal t'ay, yik manh ol ochnhej he mul, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' a heb' chonhab' chi', najat ayel heb', haxo winhaj Moisés chi' ix snitzb'at sb'a winh t'a slak'anil jun asun k'ik' b'aj ayek' Dios chi'.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': Al juntzanh lolonel tik smasanil t'a heb' etisraelal: Ha ex tik ix eyila' chajtil ix wutej in lolonemta t'ayex t'a satcha’anh.
Manh he b'o k'een oro ma k'een plata he diosalok yik b'aj tzex och ejmelal, icha tz'aj eyak'anem he b'a t'ayin.

B'oek junok altar t'ayin, nab'a lu'um tzeyak'och t'ay, yik b'aj tze nhustz'a nok' kalnel, ma nok' wakax tzeyak' silab'il t'ayin, ma b'aj tze nhustz'a ofrenda yik he junk'olal wed'ok. Yalnhej b'aj ol in ch'ox t'ayex yik tzex och ejmelal t'ayin, ata' ol wak' in wach'k'olal t'a eyib'anh.
Tato a k'een k'een tzeyak'och t'a junok altar chi', manh he tzeylaj k'een, tato tzeyak'och k'een tzeyb'il chi', manh wach'ok t'a yol in sat.
Ha jun altar tze b'o chi', manh eyak'och sk'oochal b'aj tzex k'ei, yik wach' max ilji he niwanil, xa chi t'a heb', xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': Ha juntzanh ley tik ol al t'a heb' etchonhab' yik sk'anab'ajej heb':

Tato ay junok winh eyetchonhab' tze mana' yik tz'och he chekab'ok, anhej waque' ab'il smunlaj winh eyed'ok, haxo t'a yuquil ab'il tzeyak'anel winh t'a libre, yikxo sb'a winh. Malaj tumin syak' winh yik tzeyak'anel winh t'a libre chi'.
Tato sch'okojilnhej winh k'ochnak t'ayex, anheja' sch'okojil winh sb'ati. Tato ay ix yetb'eyum winh yet'nak jun, anheja' syik'b'at ix winh yet'ok.
Tato a ex ix he man winh chi', a ex ix eyak'och yetb'eyum winh, skan ix ix chi' yet' heb' unin eyed'ok, sch'okoj winh sb'ati.
Tato syal winh chekab' chi' jun: Malaj in gana tzin el t'a libre yujto xajan winh in patrón yet' ix wetb'eyum yet' pax heb' wuninal wuuj, tato xchi winh,

tzeyik'b'at winh t'a yichanh heb' yajal. Tz'och linhan winh t'a smarkoal spuertail sdespacho heb' winh yajal chi', tzeyolan schiquin winh t'a k'een ol-lab', tz'ochkan yechel winh to skan winh eyed'ok t'a junelnhej.
Tato ay junok mach schonhel yisil t'a chekab'ok, max yal-laj yak'jiel heb' ix t'a libre ichok heb' winh winak.

Tato a winh spatrón ix chi' maj chaanlaj sk'ol yoch ix yetb'eyumok icha yaj strato heb' yujto malaj snib'ej winh t'a ix, syal smanjixiel ix yuj junok sk'ab'yok. Wach'chom malaj snib'ej winh patrón chi' syik'laj sb'a yet' ix, palta max yal-laj schonhan ix winh t'a junok ch'ok chonhab'il.
Tato a winh patrón chi' smanan ix yik tz'och ix yetb'eyumok junok yuninal, ichaokab' yisil syutej ix.
Palta tato a winh spatrón ix chi' tz'ik'an ix yetb'eyumok, syik'an junokxo ix winh, mokab' emnaquil tz'aj ix b'ab'el chi', palta yowalil syak' swael ix winh yet' spichul ix, swaypax winh yet' ix.
Tato max sk'anab'ajej winh yak'an oxe' tastak tik, tz'aktajel ix, manhxa pax tas stup ix yik tz'aktajeli.
Ha mach smilancham junok anima, yowalil smiljipaxchamok.
Palta tato manh sk'anok sk'ol ix milwaji, tato stiempoalxo scham jun anima chi', a in Jehová in ol wal t'ayex b'aj ol b'at sk'ub'ejel sb'a jun mach ix milancham anima chi'.
Palta a mach scham wal snaani smilancham yetanimail, wach'chom b'aj ay waltar sb'at skol sb'a, tz'ik'chajelta, smiljichamok.
Ha mach smak'an smam ma snun, yowalil schami.
Tato ay mach tz'elk'anb'at junok anima, tato toxo ix schonhb'ati, ma aytoek' yet'ok, ayik syamchaj jun elk'um anima chi', yowalil schami.
Ha mach sb'ajan smam snun, mak'jokab' chamok.
Tato ay chawanhok syak' owal, tato ay junok winh slajwi yuj junxo winh chi', taxonhej k'een syak'lab'ej winh, ma yet' sk'ab', anhejto max chami, palta te niwan ix aj yab'an syail,
haxo t'a jayeok k'ual tzaxo yal yek'xi yet' sk'okoch. Ha winh smak'waj chi', yowalil stup winh b'aj tz'anhtaj winh slajwi chi' yet' pax sk'u winh, palta max ak'jiochlaj chamel t'a yib'anh winh.
Tato ay junok winh patrón smak'an schekab' yet' te te', taxonhej winak ma ix, haxo tz'aji schami, yowalil tz'och chamel t'a yib'anh winh.
Palta tato tzato ek' jun chekab' chi' chab' oxeokxo k'ual, ichato chi' schami, maxtzak ak'jiochlaj chamel t'a yib'anh winh patrón chi', yujto yik yaj jun schekab' chi'.

Tato ay chawanhok winak wan yak'an owal, syamchajk'och junok ix ix to yab'ixxo t'a skal owal chi' yuj heb', tz'el unin chi' t'a spatik ix, palta malaj jab'ok tz'ik'an ix, a winh tz'och smul chi' stupan jantak sk'an winh yetb'eyum ix, anhejton pax ha', ato syala' tas tz'aj sch'olb'itaj yuj heb' winh juez.
Palta tato ay tas tz'ik'an ix jun, ato syala' tas tz'ik'an ix chi', icha pax chi' tz'utajpax winh tz'och smul chi'. Tato scham ix, schampax winh.
Tato tz'ixtax yol sat ix, ma k'een ye ix, ma sk'ab' ix, ma yok ix,
ta stz'a ix, ma slajwi ix, ma tonhej syaxla' sniwanil ix, anheja' icha wal tz'utaj ix chi', icha wal chi' tz'utajpax winh winak chi'.
Tato ay junok mach smak'anpoj yol sat junok winh schekab', ma junok ix schekab', tz'aktajel winh chekab' ma ix chekab' sk'exulok jun yol sat ix poj chi'.
Tato ay junok mach smak'anel k'een ye junok schekab', tz'aktajel jun chekab' chi' sk'exulok k'een ye chi'.
Tato ay junok nok' toro stekancham junok anima, yowalil sjuljicham nok', max chijilaj schib'ejal nok', palta malaj tas tz'och t'a yib'anh winh yajal nok' chi'.
Palta tato yojtak winh yajal nok' chi' to owtaxon nok' t'a anima, max yetzb'anpax nok' winh, tato stekjicham junok anima yuj nok', yowalil sjuljicham nok', schampax winh yajal nok' chi'.
Tato schaji tupchaj jun chamel chi', stup winh yajal nok' chi', ato syala' jantak sk'an heb' aj chamnak chi', tato icha chi' maxtzak chamlaj winh.
Aton wal juntzanh ley tik tz'och yopisio tato ay junok uninab'il ma isilab'il stekjicham yuj nok' wakax.
Tato a junok winh chekab', ma junok ix chekab' stekjicham yuj nok', yowalil tz'ak'chaj 30 siklo k'een plata t'a winh spatrón jun chekab' chi', sjuljipaxcham nok' wakax chi'.
Q'uinalok ay junok mach max smakchej sti' ha' yuk'lab' ha', ma sjoy junok olan, max smakchejpax sti', sb'at junok nok' wakax, ma junok nok' b'uru t'a yool,
yowalil stup winh ay yik jun olan chi' t'a winh aj nok' chi', skan nok' ix cham chi' t'a winh ay yik olan chi'.

Tato ay junok nok' storo junok mach stekancham nok' storo junokxo, yowalil schonhjiel nok' ix tekwaj chi', spukanek' k'een stojol nok' chi' heb' t'a spatik. Anheja' spukpaxek' nok' ix tekjicham chi' heb'.
Tato yojtakxo winh ay yik nok' ix tekwaj chi' to toxonton ow nok', max stanhwanpax nok' winh, yowalil syak' junokxo nok' winh sk'exulok nok' ix cham chi', skan nok' chamnak chi' t'a winh.

Tato ay junok mach tz'elk'an junok nok' wakax, ma junok nok' kalnel, yik smilcham nok', ma yik schonhb'at nok', tato syamchaj winh t'a yelk'al chi', owanhxo sk'exul nok' wakax chi' syak' winh. Tato kalnel nok' jun, chanhwanhxo pax sk'exul nok' syak' winh.

Ha junok mach tz'elk'ani, yowalil stup tas syelk'ej chi'. Tato malaj stumin jun elk'um chi', yowalil schonhchajeli, haxo t'a stojol b'aj schonhchaj chi', ata' stup tas syelk'ej chi'. Tato tz'ilchaj nok' nok' elk'ab'il chi', yowalil stupchaj nok', chawanhxo tz'aj stupchaj nok', taxonhej junok nok' wakax, ma junok nok' b'uru, ma junok nok' kalnel. Tato tz'ilchaj junok elk'um t'ak'walil, wan yoch t'a junok pat yik syelk'an junok tas, tato smak'jicham yuj winh aj pat chi', malaj tz'aji. Max ochlaj t'a spatik winh smilwaj chi'. Tato t'a k'ualil tzuji jun, tz'och t'a spatik winh smilwaj chi'.

Tato ay junok mach stanhwan wa nok' smolb'etzal nok' t'a sluum, palta haxo t'a skal yawb'en te' junokxo mach sk'och nok' wael chi', yowalil syak' sk'exul mach ay yik nok' chi'. Ha wal sat yawb'en te wach' syak' sk'exulok.

Tato ay junok mach wan snhusan spatan, tz'el k'ak' yuj, stz'ab'at strigo junok mach, wach'chom molb'ab'ilxo ixim, mato manto jochchajlaj ixim, a mach tz'aktanel k'ak' chi', yowalil stup smasanil tas tz'ab'at chi'.

Tato ay junok mach syak'b'at stumin, ma junokxo tas ay stojol sik'b'at junokxo, haxo tz'aji tz'elk'ajelta t'a yol spat winh sik'jinak chi', tato tz'ilchaj winh elk'um chi', cha makanhxo tz'aj yak'an sk'exul winh.
Tato max yamchaj winh elk'um chi' jun, tz'ik'chajb'at winh aj pat chi' t'a yichanh winh juez yik tz'ilji tato manhok winh ix yaman k'een tumin chi', ma juntzanh tastak tz'ak'ji sik'kanb'at winh chi'.

Tato ay junok anima smakk'e junok tas yikok: Nok' wakax, nok' kalnel, nok' b'uru, ma junok pichul, ma junokxo tas tonhej satb'ati, syalan junokxo to yiko', tz'ik'chajb'at heb' chawanh chi' t'a yichanh heb' juez. Ha jun mach tz'esan chi', yowalil chab' tz'aj yak'an sk'exul t'a mach ay yik chi'.

Tato ay junok mach tonhej syak'kan ab'enal junok nok' b'uru, ma junok nok' wakax, ma junok nok' kalnel, ma yalnhej tas molb'etzal nok' t'a junokxo mach, haxo tz'aji, a nok' nok' chi' scham nok', ma slajwi nok', ma tz'elk'ajb'at nok'. Tato malaj mach tz'ilani,

syak' sti' winh anima chi' t'a yichanh Jehová yet' t'a yichanh winh ay yik nok' nok' chi' to manhok winh ix yaman nok'. Axo winh ay yik nok' chi' schaan yab' tas ix yal winh chi', yuj chi' max stuplaj nok' winh.
Palta tato k'elanoch winh tz'elk'ajb'at nok', yowalil stup winh t'a winh yajal nok' chi'.
Tato schijib'at nok' yuj nok' choj, ma yuj nok' oques, yowalil syik'kot jab'okxo nok' winh, yik wach' syil winh yajal nok' chi'. Tato icha chi', max stuplaj nok' winh.
Tato ay junok mach sk'anan junok nok' nok' smajnej: Nok' chej, nok' wakax, talaj scham nok', ma slajwi nok', palta max yil-laj winh yajal nok' chi', yowalil stup nok' mach ix majnan chi'.
Palta tato k'elanoch winh yajal nok' chi' scham nok', max stuplaj nok' winh smajnan nok' chi', yujto strato heb' yaji, anhej smajananub'al nok' syak' winh.

Q'uinalok ay junok winak tz'ak'an musansatil junok ix kob'es mantalaj b'aj ay strato, sway winh yet' ix, yowalil syak' k'een tumin winh yik stojolok ix t'a smam ix, ichataxon b'eyb'al. Yowalil syik' ix winh.
Tato max yal sk'ol smam ix to syik' jun winh chi' ix, palta yowalil syak' k'een tumin winh t'a smam ix ix chi', ichataxon sb'eyb'al heb' anima a smojk'aj heb' ix kob'estak.
Masanil heb' ajb'aal, yowalil scham heb'.
Tato ay mach smulan yet' nok' nok', yowalil schami.
Tato ay mach syak' silab' t'a komon Dios, to manhok t'ayin a in Jehová in tik syak'a', yowalil smak'jichamok.
Manh eyixtej heb' anima ch'ok chonhab'il tonhej ayek' t'a he kal, yujto ex ek'pax t'a ch'ok chonhab'il t'a Egipto.
Manh eyixtej heb' ix chamnakxo yetb'eyum, ma heb' unin manhxalaj smam.
Tato tzeyixtej heb', a t'ayin ol yal sb'a heb', ol wab' tas syal heb' chi' t'ayin.
Ol kot wowal t'ayex, ol ex wik'anb'at t'a junok owal. Icha chi' ol aj ex wak'anchamok. Yuj wal chi', a heb' ix eyetb'eyum skan heb' ix t'a manh etb'eyumal, skanpax heb' eyuninal t'a mheb'ail.
Tato tzeyak' k'een tumin majanil t'a junok eyetchonhab' meb'a' anima, manh he k'an yune' k'een t'ay icha syutej sb'a heb' tz'ak'antaxon k'een majanil.
Tato syak'kan junok spichul, yujto smajnej k'een tumin chi', tzeyak' meltzaj t'ay a tz'emxikan k'u,
talaj anhej jun spichul chi' syak'och yuj siik, anhej syak'och t'ak'walil. Yuj chi', tato syal sb'a t'ayin, t'a elanhchamel tzin kolwaj t'ay, yujto a in tik elanhchamel tz'ok' in k'ol t'a anima.
Manh eyal chukal lolonel t'a spatik heb' juez, ma t'a spatik winh yajal he chonhab'.
Mokab' najtilax eyik'ankot eyofrenda t'ayin, aton sb'ab'el sat eyawb'en. Ha heb' he b'ab'el winak unin tzeyak' heb' t'ayin.
Icha chi' tz'ajpax nok' b'ab'el yune' nok' he wakax yet' nok' he kalnel. Skan uqueok k'ual nok' yet' snun, haxo t'a swajxaquil k'ual yalji nok', tzeyak'an nok' t'ayin.
Vic eyaj a ex tik. Yuj chi' manh he chi' schib'ejal nok' nok' milb'ilcham yuj nok' k'ultaquil nok', palta ha t'a nok' tz'i' tzeyak' nok'.
Manh eyal esal lolonel t'a spatik heb' eyetanimail. Manh junnhejok tzeyutej he b'a yet' junok mach chuk spensar yik tzeyak'anoch he b'a testigoal t'a tas manh yelok.
Manh eyak'och he b'a yet' heb' sk'ulan chukal. Manh eyak'och he b'a testigoal t'a es yet' heb' anima sk'ulan chukal.
Wach'chom meb'a' junok anima, palta tato ay smul, manh eyak' och he b'a yet'ok.
Tato a junok winh ayoch ajk'olal t'ayex ay junok nok' swakax, ma nok' sb'uru satnakb'ati, tz'ilchaj nok' eyuuj, ik'ekb'at nok' t'a winh.
Yowalil tzex kolwaj t'a mach schichonoch sk'ol t'ayex. Tato tzeyila' to stelwi nok' sb'uru t'a yalanh yikatz, tzeyik'k'e waan nok' yet'ok.
Tato ay junok anima meb'a' snib'ej sch'olb'itaj yaj yowal, manh he tenek' t'ay.
Manh he cha junok esal lolonel t'a spatik junok anima. Manh eyak'och chamel t'a yib'anh junok anima malaj smul, yujto a in ol wak' spak t'a mach icha chi' sk'ulej.
Manh he cha k'een tumin t'a elk'altak yik tze b'oan yaj junok owal, yujto a yuj k'een tumin chi' tzeyak' musansatil he b'a, tze k'exankan tas tojol t'a tas manh tojolok.
Manh eyixtej anima ch'ok chonhab'il, yujto a ex tik najtil ix ex ek' t'a ch'ok chonhab'il t'a Egipto. Eyojtakxo syaelal tz'utaj anima t'a ch'ok chonhab'il.
Vaque' ab'il tzex munlaj t'a sat lum lum, tze molank'e sat tas tzeyawej.

Axo t'a yuquil ab'il, tzeyaktankan lu'um. Ha jantakto tastak sq'uib'k'e t'a sat lu'um, yikxo heb' meb'a' ayek' t'a yol he chonhab' chi' yet' nok' k'ultaquil nok'. Wach'chom te' eyuwa ma te' eyoliwo, manhxo he mesa'.

Vaque' k'ualnhej tzex munlaji, haxo t'a yuquil k'ual tzeyik'an eyip. Yed' pax nok' he wakax, nok' he b'uru yet' heb' he chekab' tz'alji t'a yol he kuenta yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il smunlaj eyed'ok syik'pax yip.
k'anab'ajejek masanil tas ix wal tik t'ayex. Manh eyal he b'ha t'a juntzanh komon Dios, manh he lokpax sb'i.
Oxel tzeyak'och q'uinh t'a yol junjun ab'il yik tzin eyik'anchaanh.

Ha t'a uj Abib tzeyak'och sq'uinhal ixim pan malaj yich, icha ix wutej walan t'ayex. D'a uque' k'ual tze wa ixim pan malaj yich, yujto ha t'a jun uj chi' ix ex elta t'a Egipto. Malajokab' junok mach sja t'a wichanh tato malaj jab'ok yofrenda yet'nak.
Tzeyak'anpaxoch q'uinh ayik tz'elul sb'ab'el sat tas tzeyawej. Anheja' tzeyak'anpaxoch junxo q'uinh ayik slajwikank'e masanil sat tastak tzeyawej chi'.
Ha in Jehová he Yajalil in tik swala' to ha t'a oxe' q'uinh chi' yowalil sjawi masanil heb' winh winak t'a wichanh.
Ayic tzeyak'an nok' nok' silab'il t'ayin, manh eyak'laj schiq'uil nok' yet' ixim pan ayb'at yich. Manh he sik'b'at xepual nok' silab' chi' t'a junokxo k'ual.
Ha wal sb'ab'el sat eyawb'en wach' tz'el t'a sat lum lum, ha' tzeyik'b'at t'a in kajnub', a in Jehová he Diosal in swala'. Manh he tz'anh nok' yunetak chiwa t'a skal yal yim snun.
Ol in chekb'at jun wángel t'a eyichanh yik wach' tzex tanhwaj yuj t'a yoltak b'e, ol ex yik'anb'at t'a jun lugar b'aj wach'xo yaj wuuj, b'aj ol ex ajok.
Scham wal eyilani, manh he pitej he b'a t'ay, palta tze k'anab'ajej tas syala'. Ichato ha' ol munlaj in k'exulok, manh ol ex yak'laj niwank'olal tato manh ol he k'anab'ajej t'ay.
Tato tze k'anab'ajej t'ay, tze k'ulan tas syal t'a in k'exulok, ol in och ajk'olal t'a mach ayoch ajk'olal t'ayex. Ol in och tek'tek' t'a yichanh mach snib'ej stek'b'ej sb'ha t'a eyichanh.
Ha jun wángel chi' ol b'ab'laj t'a eyichanh. Ol ex yik'anb'at t'a sat lum sluum heb' amorreo, heb' hitita, heb' ferezeo, heb' kananeo, heb' heweo yet' heb' jebuseo. Junelnhej ol in satkanel heb'.

Manh ex em nhojan t'a yichanh sdiosal juntzanh chonhab' chi'. Manh ex empax kuman t'ay, manh he b'eyb'alej sb'eyb'al heb' chonhab' chi' t'a eyik'anchaanh sdiosal heb'. Ha tas smoj tze k'ulej, to tze mak'poj sdiosal heb' chi' yet' masanil k'een k'een ayoch t'ay.
Ha innhej Jehová he Diosal in b'aj tzeyak'em he b'a. Tato icha chi' tzeyutej he b'a, ol wak' tas tze wa''a yet' tas tzeyuk'ej. Najat pax ol wik'el ilya t'a he kal.
Najat pax ol wutok he k 'inal. Ha t'a yol junjun he chonhab'il chi', malaj junok ix ix tonhej ol el yune', manh junok heb' ix to manh ol unewok.
Ol wak' xiwk'e sk'ol heb' anima tzex chakani. Ol wak' somchaj spensar heb' chonhab' tzeyak' owal yet'ok yet' masanil heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayex, ol el lemnaj heb' t'ayex.
Ol wak' somchaj sk'ol heb' eyajk'ool yuj xiwelal ayik manto ex k'ochlaj, yuj chi' ol el lemnaj heb' heweo, heb' kananeo yet' pax heb' hitita t'ayex.
Manh junoknhej ab'il ol aj wik'anel heb' t'a eyichanh, yik wach' max ixtaxb'at lum lum yik manh ol te q'uib'pax sb'isul nok' k'ultaquil nok' tz'ak'an chukal t'ayex.
k'ojank'olalnhej ol aj wik'anel heb' anima chi' t'a sat lu'um, masanto ayik ol q'uib' he b'isul, yik tze makan lum masanil.

Toxo ix wak'kanem stz'akanhil b'aj ol ek' lum he lu'um chi'. Schael yich b'aj ay ha' Chacchac Mar, masanto sk'och t'ha ha' Éufrates, sb'atxonhej t'ha ha' mar Mediterráneo, masanto t'a taquinh lu'um. Ol wak'anoch heb' kajan t'a sat lu'um chi' t'a yol he k'ab'. Ha exxo ol he pechel heb' t'a sat lu'um chi'.
Manh wal he b'o junok he trato yet' heb', manh ex ochpax ejmelal t'a sdiosal heb'.

Manhxo pax he chakan heb' t'a yol he chonhab', yik wach' max ex skuchb'ej heb' he k'ulan chukal t'ayin. Tato tzeyak'em he b'ha t'a sdiosal heb' chi', a ex wal tzeyixtejb'at he b'a syal chi', xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --Tzach k'eta t'a lum witz b'aj ayinek' tik yet' winhaj Aarón, winhaj Nadab yet' winhaj Abiú yet' pax 70-ok heb' yichamtak winaquil he chonhab'. Ha heb' chi' najatto skan heb' yak'em sb'a t'ayin.
Ha achxonhej syal a k'eul t'a in tz'ey, haxo pax heb' winh chi', max yal-laj sk'eta heb' winh yet' pax heb' chonhab' max yal-laj sk'eta heb' ed'ok, xchi t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix emixta winhaj Moisés chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' anima tas leyal ix yak' Jehová yet' tas ix yutej yalani. Axo masanil heb' anima chi', junnhej ix aj stak'wi heb'. --Masanil tas ix yal Jehová chi', ol ko k'anab'ajej, xchi heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix stz'ib'an winhaj Moisés masanil tas ix yal Jehová. Axo ix sakb'inaj t'a junxo k'u, ix k'e waan winh, ix sb'oan jun altar winh t'a yich witz chi', ix yak'ank'e linhan lajchawe' k'een k'een winh. Ha junjun k'een k'een chi', junjun makan yinhtilal Israel sch'ox k'een.

D'a elanhchamel ix schekan juntzanh heb' winh kelemtak winak winhaj Moisés chi' yik smilan nok' toro heb' silab'ok yik stz'ha t'a smasanil yet' juntzanhxo silab' yik sch'oxan sjunk'olal heb' yet' Jehová.
Axo winhaj Moisés chi' ix chaan nanhal schiq'uil nok', ix yak'anem winh t'a yol juntzanh yet'tal, haxo nanhalxo, ix stzikanoch winh t'a altar chi'.

Ix yik'ank'e winh b'aj tz'ib'ab'il strato Dios, ix yawtan winh t'a skal heb' chonhab'. Ixlajwi yawtan winh, ix yalan heb' chonhab' chi' icha tik: --Masanil tas syal Jehová, ol ko k'anab'ajej, xchi heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'ankot schiq'uil nok' winh, aton ix yak'kanem winh t'a yol juntzanh yet'tal chi', ix stzikanb'at winh t'a yib'anh heb' anima chi'. Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ha jun chik' tik sch'oxani to tz'ochkan yopisio jun strato Jehová ix sb'o qued'ok tik, aton masanil tas ix yal t'ayonh, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix k'ex winh t'a lum witzal Sinaí chi'. Ajun winhaj Aarón, winhaj Nadab, winhaj Abiú yet' pax 70 heb' yichamtak winaquil chonhab' ix k'e yet' winh.
Ata' ix yil sDiosal heb' winh. Ha t'a yalanh yok, toxonhej skopopi icha k'een zafiro te wach' yilji, icha syaxil satcha’anh.
Malaj tas ix utaj heb' winh yuj yipalil Dios. Ix yil Dios heb' winh, ix wa heb' winh, ix yuk'an ha' heb' winh t'a yichanh.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --Q'ueanhkot t'a jolom witz b'aj ayinek' tik, tza tanhwan ta', ata' ol wak' chab' k'een k'een t'ayach, aton k'een b'aj tz'ib'ab'iloch juntzanh cheknab'il wuuj, yik tz'och he k'ayb'ub'alok, xchi t'a winh.
Ix k'e winhaj Moisés t'a lum witz chi' yet' winhaj Josué winh skolwaj yet' winh.

Ayic manto b'atlaj winh, ix yalan winh t'a heb' yichamtak winaquil chonhab' chi': --Cananhec t'a tik masanto ol onh emxulok. Ayek' winhaj Aarón yet' winhaj Hur eyed'ok. Tato ay tas he gana sb'oi, a heb' winh tik ol b'oan t'ayex, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix k'e heb' winh schawanhil. D'a elanhchamel ix och moynaj jun asun t'a lum witz chi'.
Axo stziquiquial Jehová ix jawi t'a yib'anh lum witzal Sinaí chi', waque' wal k'ual ix och oyan asun t'a lu'um. Axo t'a yuquil k'ual ix awtajk'e winhaj Moisés yuj Jehová t'a skal asun chi'.
Ix sch'ox sb'a stziquiquial Jehová t'a skal jun asun t'a lum witz chi', t'a yichanh heb' chonhab'. Ha stziquiquial chi', lajan yilji icha junok k'ak' te ow stz'ab'at smasanil yuj.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj Moisés t'a skal jun asun chi'. Ix k'e winh t'a slajwub'alxo sjolom lum witz chi'. 40 k'ual yet' 40 ak'wal ix kan winh ta'.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al t'a heb' etisraelal to syak' junok ofrenda heb' t'ayin. Ha jun ofrenda chi', tz'ik'jichaanh t'a skal heb' to tz'el wal t'a sk'ol yak'ani.
Ha tastak ol ik'chajk'e waan chi', aton juntzanh tik: Q'uen oro, k'een plata, k'een bronke,
anh ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak, anh ch'al yaxmaquinak, anh chak ch'al, anh ch'al lino yelxo wal wach', xil nok' chiwa ch'alb'il,
stz'umal nok' ch'ak kalnel uk'nak yet' chakchak, nok' tz'uum te' lab'ab'i, pax te' akakia,
akeite sk'anji t'a kandil, perfume, yakeiteal sat te' oliwo sk'anji ayik sik'chajkanoch junok mach, ma junok tas wikok, inkienso suk'uq'ui sjab',
k'een kornalina yet' juntzanhxo k'een k'een te wach' yilji tz'och t'a k'apak schaleka winh sat sakerdote yet' t'a k'apak ayoch t'a snhi' sk'ol spichul winh.
Tze b'oan junok in kajnub', yik wach' tzin kajnaj t'a he kal.
Palta a b'aj ol in ek' kajan chi' yet' masanil tastak ol k'anchaj t'a yool, yowalil ol he b'o icha wal yaj yechel ol in ch'ox t'ayach.
B'ookab' junok kaxa, a te' akakia tz'och t'ay. Jun metro yet' 10 kentímetro tz'aj sk'atul, 70 kentímetro tz'aj sat, 70 kentímetro pax tz'aj schaanhil.
Tz'och k'een oro te wach' t'a yool yet' t'a spatik, tz'och k'een t'a stitak t'a yib'anh b'aj tzalank'ei.
Sb'opax chanheok k'een argolla nab'a oro, tz'och t'a yok schanhil, chab' t'a junjun pak'anh.
Sb'ochajpaxoch sb'akhlab'il. Ha te' akakia tz'ochi, tz'ochpax k'een oro t'a spatik te'.
Tz'ekchajek' te' t'a yol juntzanh k'een argolla tz'och t'a spak'ultak te' kaxa chi', aton yet' juntzanh te' chi' syal sb'akhjik'e te' kaxa chi'.
Skan te' t'a yol k'een argolla ayoch t'a te' kaxa chi', maxtzak ik'chajel-laj te'.
Ha t'a yol te' kaxa chi' tzak'kanem k'een k'een b'aj ayoch in trato ol wak' t'ayach.

Sb'ochajpax smakul te' kaxa chi'. Aton t'a smakul te' chi' stzikjiek' chik' yik tz'ak'ji tup mul. Ha k'een oro te wach' tz'och t'ay, jun metro yet' 10 kentímetro tz'aj sk'atul, 70 kentímetro tz'aj sat.
Axo t'a chab' stitak jun smakul chi', tz'och junjun yechel querubín, nab'a oro tz'aji, stenjib'o t'a k'een martillo.
Ha jun smakul chi' yet' juntzanh yechel querubín chi', junnhej tz'aji. Junjun juntzanh querubín chi' skan t'a junjun sti' jun smakul chi'.
D'anhd'umb'a tz'aj juntzanh querubín chi', tz'em k'elan t'a yib'anh jun smakul te' kaxa chi'. Axo sk'axil, syil-laj sb'a snhi' t'a yib'anh smakul chi'.
Ha k'een k'een b'aj ayoch in trato ol wak' chi' t'ayach, ha t'a yol te' kaxa chi' ol ak'kanem k'een, ichato chi' tzak'anoch smakul te' chi'.
Ha t'a skal juntzanh yechel querubín ay t'a yib'anh smakul te' kaxa chi', ata' ol in ch'ox in b'a t'ayach, ol wak' ojtaquejel smasanil cheknab'il ol wak' a k'anab'ajej yet' heb' etisraelal.
Sb'ochajpax junok te' mexa, a te' akakia b'aj sb'o te'. 90 kentímetro tz'aj sk'atul, 45 tz'aj sat, 65 tz'aj steel.
Tz'och k'een oro t'a te', sb'opax junok nab'a oro tzek' oyan t'a spatik te' yok schanhil.
Sb'opaxk'e stitak te', tzek' oyan t'a yib'anh, uque' kentímetro sk'ei, tz'och k'een oro t'ay.
Sb'opax chanheok argolla nab'a oro tz'och t'a schiquintak schanhil.
Ha t'a slak'anil b'aj ayem stitak chi', ata' tz'och juntzanh k'een argolla chi'. Ha t'a yol k'een argolla chi' tzek' sb'akhlab'il te', yik syal yik'chajb'at te' mexa chi'.
Ha te' sb'akhlab'il te' mexa chi', ha t'a te' akakia b'aj sb'o te', tz'ochpax k'een oro t'a te'.
Sb'opax plato, niwak kuchara, xalu yet' uk'ab' b'aj schaji ofrenda ha' yaji. Nab'a oro tz'och t'a juntzanh tik smasanil.
Sb'ojiem jun mexa chi' t'a wichanh, tz'em ixim pan wik yaj t'a yib'anh.

Sb'ochajpax junok sb'akhnub'al kandil, nab'a oro tz'aji. Ha t'a k'een martillo stenchaj b'o'ok. Ha sk'ojnub' b'aj tz'em b'akhan yet' ste'al yet' pax skopail, icha sfloral tz'ajochi, junnhej yaman tz'aji.
Ha t'a stz'eytak, oxox sk'ab' tz'elta.
Ha t'a junjun sk'ab' tz'elta t'a jun ste'al chi', yowalil ay oxe' sfloral icha sfloral te' almendro.
Anheja' t'a jun ste'al chi', ay chanhe' sfloral icha sfloral te' almendro chi'.
Ha t'a yalanh b'aj ayelta junjun sk'ab' chi', skan junjun sfloral.
Ha juntzanh sfloral yet' sk'ab' chi', junnhej tz'aj yet' jun sb'akhnub'al chi', nab'a oro tz'aji, stenjib'o t'a k'een martillo.
Sb'ochajpax uque' kandil, tz'ak'chajem t'a yet'tal yik syak' sakil k'inal t'a yichanh.
Ha k'een syamlab'il b'aj tz'ik'chajel stanhil k'apak b'aj tz'och sk'ak'al yet' k'een splatoal, nab'a oro tz'aji.
Tz'och oxeok arroba oro t'a jun b'akhnub' kandil chi' yet' syamk'ab'il.
Scham wal ilani to icha yaj yechel tzin ch'ox t'ayach t'a jolom witz tik, icha chi' tz'aj sb'oi.

Tza b'oanpax in kajnub' t'a lajunheok jenhan k'apak k'apak nab'a lino b'ayb'il te wach'. Sb'ojioch yechel querubín t'a k'apak yuj junok mach jelan sb'oani. Ha t'a anh ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak, anh ch'al yaxmaquinak yet' t'a anh chak ch'al sb'ojioch yechel querubín chi'.
Masanil juntzanh k'apak chi', lajan tz'aji: 12 metro yet' nanhalxo tz'aj steel, chab' metro tz'aj sat.
Slajwi chi' stz'ischaj syam sb'a oyeok jenhan k'apak, junxonhej tz'aji. Anheja' icha chi' tz'ajpax oyexo k'apak chi'. Chab' jenhan tz'ajkan k'apak.
Tz'ochpax xoyjab' ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak syamnub'ok t'a jun pak'anhok sti' jun jenhan k'apak b'ab'el. Anheja' icha chi' tz'ajpax junxo jenhan k'apak schab'il chi'.
Ha t'a k'apak b'ab'el jenhan yet' pax t'a k'apak schab'il, yowalil sb'ochajoch xoyjab' 50-ok juntzanh ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak chi', yik wach' junxonhej tz'aj schalan sb'a k'apak schab'il.
Sb'opax 50-ok syamnub'al nab'a oro, yik syal syamlan sb'a k'apak schab'il jenhan, icha chi' tz'aj sb'oel junok jenhan tz'och t'a yib'anh in kajnub'.
Sb'ochajpax uxluche'ok jenhan xil nok' chiwa jalb'il yik sb'at t'a yib'anh k'apak ayoch t'a yib'anh in kajnub' chi'.
Masanil juntzanh chi', lajannhej tz'aji, 13 metro yet' nanhalxo tz'aj steel, haxo sat chab' metro tz'aji.
Slajwi chi', stz'ischaj syam sb'a oyeok jenhan, junnhej jenhan tz'ajkani. Stz'ischajpax syam sb'a waquexo jenhan chi'. Ha jun swaquil jenhan, nanhal spakchajemta t'a yichanh mantiado chi'.
Sb'ochajoch xoyjab' 50-ok syamnub'al t'a jun pak'anhok stitak jun b'ab'el jenhan, tz'ochpax 50-ok syamnub'al t'a jun pak'anhok sti' t'a jun schab'il jenhan.
Sb'opax 50-ok syamnub'al nab'a bronke, yik syal syamlan sb'a schab'il jenhan, yik junxonhej jenhan tz'ajkani.
Yujto uxluche' jenhan yaj xil nok' chiwa chi', yuj chi' ayto nanhalxo jenhan tz'emkan pakan t'a spatik yet' t'a yichanh.
Ha jun chi', ek'to jun metro steel t'a yichanh k'apak yalanh, nanhal metro ek'to t'a junjun stitak, yik smuschaj stitak k'apak aykan t'a yalanh chi'.
Sb'ojipax stz'umal nok' kalnel uk'nak t'a chakchak, yik sk'e t'a yib'anh jun jenhan xil nok' chiwa chi' yet' junokxo makan tz'uum te' lab'ab'i yik tz'och t'a yib'anh jun chi'.
Sb'ochajpax juntzanh te' marko yik tz'och t'a spatik in kajnub', linhan tz'ajoch junjun te'. Masanil te', a te' akakia b'aj tz'elta te'.
Nanhal yoil metro tz'aj steel junjun te', 65 kentímetro tz'aj sat te'.
Skan chab'chab'ok yok te' b'aj tz'em linhan. Lajannhej tz'ajkan skal. Icha chi' tz'aj te' tz'och t'a spatik in kajnub' chi' smasanil.
Ayic sb'oel te' chi', 20 te' tz'och t'a stojolal sur,
sb'ojiem 40 sb'akhnub' yich te' nab'a plata tz'aji, chab'chab' tz'ajkan t'a yalanh junjun te', junjun t'a junjun yok te'.
Icha chi' tz'ajpax junxo pak'anh t'a stojolal norte, 20 pax te' sb'ojiochi.
Anheja' 40 sb'akhnub' yich te' sb'oji, nab'a plata tz'aji, chab'chab' tz'emkan t'a yich junjun te'.
Axo t'a junxo pak'anh yol schiquin t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, waque' te' sb'ojiochi.
Sb'opax chab'okxo te', junjun te' tz'och t'a junjun yesquinail jun pak'anh chi'.
Ha chab' te' marko chi', nub'ub'i tz'aj te', t'a yich masanto sk'ek'och b'aj syil-laj sb'a yuj junok argolla, aton te' chi' tz'och t'a chab' yesquinail t'a jun pak'anh chi'.
Ha yuj chab'xo te' chi', wajxaque' tz'aj te' marko chi' t'a smasanil yet' 16 sb'akhnub' yich te'. Chab'chab' sb'akhnub' yich junjun te'.
Sb'ochajpax oyeok te' regla tz'och t'a spatik te' marko t'a junok pak'anh in kajnub'. Ha te' akakia sb'ochaj reglail chi'.
Sb'ochajpax oyeok te' tz'och t'a junxo pak'anh. Anhejtona' sb'ochaj oyeok te' tz'och t'a jun pak'anh t'a spatik, t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u.
Ha te' regla tzek' t'a snanhal te' marko chi', sb'at te' t'a jun schiquin masanto sk'axpajek'k'och te' t'a junxo schiquin.
Slajwi chi', tz'och k'een oro t'a spatiktak te' marko chi', tz'ochpax k'een argolla nab'a oro b'aj tzek' te' regla chi'. Tz'ochpax k'een oro t'a te' regla chi'.
Sb'ochajk'e in kajnub' icha yaj yechel tzin ch'ox t'ayach t'a jolom witz tik.

Sb'ochajpax junok k'apak kortina nab'a lino b'ayb'il. Sb'ojioch yechel querubín t'a k'apak yuj junok mach jelan sb'oani. Ha t'a anh k'ik'mutz'inak ch'al, anh ch'al yaxmaquinak yet' pax anh chak ch'al sb'ojioch yechel querubín chi'.

Slajwi chi', sk'e lokan k'apak t'a chanhe' te' oy ayk'e k'een gancho nab'a oro t'a schon. Ha te' oy chi' a te' akakia, yowalil tz'ochpax k'een oro t'a spatik te', tz'empax te' t'a yib'anh chanhe' sb'akhnub' yich nab'a plata.

Ha jun k'apak kortina chi' smakan snanhal jun lugar skuch Vic Yaji yet' junxo lugar skuch Ha Innhej Ay Vico'. Sk'e lokan k'apak t'a yalanh b'aj ayoch k'een syamnub'al nab'a oro ayoch t'a yib'anh, haxo t'a spatikoch k'apak kortina chi' tz'ak'chajoch te' skaxail trato.
Slajwi chi', tza makan te' skaxail trato yet' smakul, tz'ochkan te' t'a jun lugar skuch Ha Innhej Ay Vico'.
Ha t'a yichanhelta k'apak kortina chi', ha t'a ko wach' skan te' mexa yik ixim pan. Axo pax t'a ko k'exanh skan jun b'akhnub' kandil, k'elk'umb'a tz'aj yet' te' mexa chi'.
Axo t'a sti' in kajnub' chi', ata' sb'ojioch junok k'apak kortina nab'a lino b'ayb'il. Yed' anh k'ik'mutz'inak ch'al, anh ch'al yaxmaquinak, anh chak ch'al sb'ochaj yelwanub' yuj junok jelan sb'oani.

Sb'opax oye' te' oy t'a te' akakia, tz'och k'een oro t'a spatik te'. Anhejtona' tz'ochpax k'een gancho nab'a oro t'a schon te' yik wach' sk'e lokan k'apak kortina chi'. Sb'ojipaxem oye' b'akhnub' yich nab'a bronke b'aj tz'em te' oy chi'.
Sb'ochajpax junok altar t'a te' chemte' nab'a akakia, lajannhej tz'aj yechel schanhil pak'anh. Chab' metro yet' 25 kentímetro tz'aj junjun pak'anh, jun metro yet' 25 kentímetro tz'aj schaanhil.
Sb'ochajk'e junjun sch'aak t'a junjun schiquintak. Ha juntzanh sch'aak chi' yaman tz'aj yet' jun altar chi', spichchaj te' t'a k'een bronke.
Masanil jantak syamk'ab'il altar chi', nab'a bronkeokabi: Aton yet'tal b'aj tz'ik'chajel k'een tik'aq'uil taanh, k'een pala, k'een niwak uk'ab', k'een tenedor yet' pax yet'tal b'aj tz'em te tzak'ak'.
Sb'opax junok k'een malla nab'a bronke, tz'ochpax junjun argolla bronke t'a junjun yesquinail k'een.
Tz'elk'och k'een yesquinail chi' t'a spatiktak jun altar chi' t'a yalanh jun oyanoch t'a stitak. Ha k'een malla chi', t'a snanhal jun altar chi' sb'ojiem k'een.
Sb'opax juntzanhok sb'akhlab'il jun altar chi'. Ha te' akakia tz'ochi, tz'ochpax bronke t'a spatik te'.
Ha te' sb'akhlab'il chi', yowalil tzek' te' t'a yol k'een argolla ayoch t'a schab'il pak'anh yik wach' sb'akhjib'ati.
Ha jun altar chi', olan tz'ajkan yool, icha yechel ix in ch'ox t'ayach t'a jolom witz tik.

Sb'ochajpax k'apak kortina lino te wach' b'ayb'il, yik tz'och oyan smakulok yamaq'uil ay t'a spatiktak in kajnub' chi'. Ha t'a jun pak'anh t'a stojolal sur, 45 metro tz'ajb'at d'inhan k'apak kortina chi'.
Tz'och 20 te' oy, 20 pax sb'akhnub'al yich nab'a bronke, haxo t'a schon junjun te' oy chi', tz'em jun k'een nab'a plata ayoch juntzanh argolla t'ay.

Icha pax chi' t'a stojolal norte, yowalil tz'ochpax k'apak kortina t'a sk'atul chi' smasanil. 45 metro tz'aji, 20 pax te' yoyal tz'ochi yet' 20 sb'akhnub'al yich nab'a bronke, tz'em jun k'een nab'a plata, ayoch juntzanh argolla t'ay t'a schon junjun te' oy chi'.
Axo t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, a k'apak kortina tz'och t'ay, 22 metro yet' nanhalxo tz'aj sat yet' lajunhe' yoyal yet' pax lajunhe' sb'akhnub'al yich.
Axo pax t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a jun amak' chi', 22 metro yet' nanhalxo sat. Tz'ochpax k'apak kortina t'ay.
Ha t'a jun pak'anh sti' amak' chi', ay uque' metro k'apak kortina tz'ochi yet' oxe' yoyal yet' pax oxe' sb'akhnub'al yich.
Anheja' t'a junxo pak'anh sti', ay pax uque' metro k'apak kortina tz'ochi, ay oxe' oy yet' oxe' sb'akhnub'al yich.

Axo t'a sti' amak' chi', ata' sb'ojioch junok k'apak kortina nab'a lino b'ayb'il, nanhal sb'alunhil metro sat k'apak. Sb'oji yelwanub' k'apak yuj junok jelan sb'oani. Ha t'a anh k'ik'mutz'inak ch'al, anh ch'al yaxmaquinak, anh chak ch'al sb'ochaj yelwanub' chi'.
Masanil te' oy t'a spatik yichanh amak' chi', tz'em k'een k'een nab'a plata ayoch argolla t'ay t'a schon te'. Axo pax sb'akhnub'al yich te', nab'a bronke.

Ha jun amak' chi', 45 metro sk'atul, 22 metro yet' nanhalxo sat, lajannhej schapak'anhil. Axo pax k'apak kortina ayk'e t'a chaanh, chab' metro yet' 25 kentímetro steel k'apak. Ha k'apak kortina chi', aton lino wach' b'ayb'il. Axo sb'akhnub' yich te oy chi', nab'a bronke.
Masanil yestakail in kajnub' chi' yet' estaka ayoch t'a amak' chi', nab'a bronke tz'aji.
Al t'a heb' etisraelal to syik'kot akeite heb', aton akeite wach' tz'el t'a sat te' oliwo, yik wach' aynhej yakeiteal juntzanh kandil.

Ha winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal ayoch t'a yib'anh sb'oanoch sk'ak'al kandil chi', yik wach' kopanel sk'ak'al t'a wichanh tzek' ak'wal t'a yol mantiado b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'ha t'a yichanhelta k'apak kortina ayoch yenhulok te' skaxail in trato. Ha jun tik, junelnhej ley tz'ajkan t'a he kal a ex israel ex tik yet' pax t'a heb' eyinhtilal.

Ix yalanpax Jehová icha tik: Avtej winh uk'tak aj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal, aton winhaj Nadab, winhaj Abiú, winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Itamar. Tza sik'el heb' winh t'a skal heb' etisraelal, yik wach' tz'och heb' winh sakerdoteal t'ayin.
Sb'ochaj spichul winh uk'tak aj Aarón. Aton junok pichul yiknhej yopisio winh yaji, yik wach' tz'aj yilji winh, yik scheklajpaxeli to niwan yelk'och winh.
Al t'a heb' te ay sjelanil, aton juntzanh heb' ix wak' sjelanil t'a b'o'oj k'apak, yik sb'oan spichul winhaj Aarón chi' heb', yik ol och winh sakerdoteal t'ayin.

Ha juntzanh pichul sb'o chi', aton juntzanh tik: Ha k'apak smakul snhi' sk'ool yet' k'apak chaleka. Sb'opax jun pichul jukan yet' junxo pichul yelxo wal te jukan ol och t'a yool, tz'och yelwanub'. Sb'opax sk'oxal sjolom sb'ak'chajochi yet' stzek'ul snanhal. Yuj chi', b'ochajokab' pichul to yiknhej yopisio winhaj Aarón chi'. Sb'ochajpax spichul heb' yuninal winh chi', yik wach' tz'och heb' t'a yopisio t'a sakerdoteal t'ayin.
Ayic sb'ochaj juntzanh pichul chi', tz'och anh lino b'ayb'il, yowalil tz'och k'een oro icha ch'al t'a skal yet' lana chak ch'al.
Ha jun chaleka chi', a anh lino b'ayb'il sb'ochaj yuj junok jelan sch'alwi, tz'och oro icha ch'al t'a skal yet' lana ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak, yaxmaquinak yet' chakchak.
Tz'ek' b'ak'an sk'ab' t'a sjolom sjenhjab' yik syil-laj sb'a k'apak yichanh yet' k'apak spatik.

Sb'opax jun stzek'ul yik stzek'jioch jun chaleka chi', junnhej tz'aj yet'ok. Ha jun stzek'ul chi', a anh lino b'ayb'il b'aj sb'oji. Tz'och k'een oro icha ch'al t'a skal yet' lana ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak, yaxmaquinak yet' chakchak.
Tzak' b'o chab'ok kotak pachanh k'een kornalina te wach'. Ha t'a k'een tz'och sb'i heb' yuninal winhaj Israel.
Stzolal tz'aj yochi icha ix aj yalji heb', waque' tz'och t'a junjun k'een.
Ha mach tz'ak'anoch juntzanh b'i chi' t'a k'een, aton junok toxonton smunlaj t'a b'o'oj k'een, te wach' tz'aj sb'oi. Icha yajoch sletrail junok sello, icha wal chi' tz'ajoch b'i chi' t'a k'een.

Ha t'a k'apak sjolom sjenhjab' jun chaleka chi' tz'ak'jioch k'een. Ha yopisio juntzanh k'een chi' yik snachajkot heb' yinhtilal Israel. Icha chi' tz'aj yik'anek' sb'i heb' israel chi' winhaj Aarón t'a sjolom sjenhjab' ayik tz'ochk'och winh t'a wichanh yik tzin naankot heb'.
Sb'ochajpax chab' syamlab'il k'een chi', nab'a oro tz'och t'ay.
Sb'ochajpax chab' kadena nab'a oro k'otzotzi tz'aj spach'uch'aji, tz'och t'a juntzanh syamlab'il chi'.

Axo k'apak yik snhi' sk'ool, tz'och yopisio yik snachajel tas in gana, lajan wal tzutej icha wal tz'aj sb'o chaleka chi'. Ha anh lino b'ayb'il tz'och t'ay, aton anh b'ob'il yuj junok jelan sch'alwi. Tz'och k'een oro icha ch'al t'a skal yet' lana ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak, yaxmaquinak yet' chakchak.
Cha pakanh tz'aji, lajannhej sat stitak schanhil, 22 kentímetro junjun stitak chi'.
Tz'och k'een k'een te' wach' yilji t'a k'apak snhi' sk'ool chi', chanh tzol tz'ajoch k'een. Ha t'a b'ab'el tzol, tz'och junok k'een rubí, junok k'een krisólito yet' junok k'een esmeralda.
Axo t'a schab'il tzol, tz'och junok k'een granate, junok k'een zafiro yet' junok k'een jade.
Axo pax t'a yoxil tzol, tz'och junok k'een jakinto, junok k'een ágata yet' junok k'een amatista.
Axo pax t'a schanhil tzol, tz'och junok k'een topakio, junok k'een kornalina yet' pax junok k'een jaspe. Masanil juntzanh k'een chi', oronhej syamlab'il tz'ochi.

Yowalil lajchawe' juntzanh k'een chi' sb'oi, yujto lajchawe' sb'i heb' yinhtilal Israel. Ha t'a junjun k'een k'een chi', ata' tz'och sb'i junjun makan heb', icha yajoch sletrail junok sello, icha wal chi' tz'aj yoch b'i chi' t'a k'een.
Ha juntzanh k'een kadena oro pach'uch'ab'il toxo ix b'inaji, aton k'een tz'och yopisio t'a k'apak snhi' sk'ool.
Sb'ochajpax chab' argolla nab'a oro, tz'och t'a chab' schiquin k'apak snhi' sk'ol chi' t'a yib'anh.
Tz'och k'een kadena oro chi' schab'il t'a chab' argolla chi'.
Tz'och chab' snhi' k'een kadena chi' t'a k'een syamlab'il k'een k'een ayoch t'a sjolom sjenhjab' k'apak chaleka, yik skan k'apak snhi' sk'ol chi' t'a yichanh.
Sb'opax chab' argolla nab'a oro, tz'och t'a chab' schiquin k'apak smakul snhi' sk'ol chi' t'a yalanh, junnhej skan yet' jun chaleka chi'.

Sb'ochajpax chab' argolla oro, tz'och t'a snhitak k'apak tzek' t'a sjolom sjenhjab' k'apak chaleka t'a yichanh. Junnhej skan k'een yet' b'aj tz'emk'och stz'isul sti' k'apak chi', palta t'a yib'anhk'eta b'aj tzek' stzek'ul snanhal k'apak chaleka, aton jun tzek'ul te wach' yilji.

Icha chi' schalan sb'a k'een argolla yik k'apak snhi' sk'ool yet' k'een yik k'apak chaleka chi'. Ha junok anh ch'al pach'uch'ab'il k'ik'mutz'inak tz'och sch'anhalok yik syam sb'a, yik wach' a k'apak snhi' sk'ol chi' skan t'a yib'anhk'eta stzek'ul snanhal k'apak chaleka chi', yik max yaktej sb'a k'apak.

Yuj chi', ayik tz'och winhaj Aarón chi' t'a yol in kajnub' t'a wichanh yet'nak sb'i heb' yinhtilal Israel winh, yik tzin nakot heb' t'a masanil tiempo, yujto ayoch sb'i heb' t'a k'apak smakul snhi' sk'ool. Ha yopisio k'apak smakul snhi' sk'ol chi', yik tz'ojtakajeli tas snib'ej in k'ool.

Tzak'paxoch k'een Urim yet' k'een Tumim t'a yol k'apak smakul snhi' sk'ol chi', yuj chi' yet'nak k'een winhaj Aarón t'a snhi' sk'ool ayik tz'och winh t'a wichanh. Icha chi' tz'aj yik'anb'at juntzanh chi' winh t'a wichanh, yik syal snachajeli tas snib'ej in k'ool sk'ulej heb' etchonhab'.
Ha junok k'apak pichul jukan k'ik'mutz'inak, a tzak' b'ojok, yik ol yak'och winhaj Aarón chi' t'a yol k'apak chaleka.
Skan yolanil t'a snanhal b'aj sk'e sjolom winh. Ha t'a stitak b'aj tz'olji sjaj k'apak chi', ata' tz'och junok k'apak stz'ulilok sti', yik wach' max nhik'chaji.

Ha jun k'apak pichul jukan k'ik'mutz'inak chi', tz'och yelwanub' k'apak t'a masanil stitak t'a yoktak. Icha sat te' granado yilji yelwanub' k'apak stitak tz'och chi'. Sb'oji yelwanub' k'apak chi' t'a lana ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak yet' lana ch'al yaxmaquinak yet' pax lana ch'al chakchak. Tz'ochpax yunetak kampana nab'a oro t'a skal yechel sat te' granado t'a smasanil stitak chi'.

Ayic tz'och winhaj Aarón t'a wichanh t'a in kajnub', yowalil ayoch jun k'apak chi' yuj winh yik sk'anh juntzanh yunetak kampana ayoch t'a stitak k'apak chi', ayik tz'och winh yet' pax yik tz'elta winh, yik wach' max cham winh.
Tzak'an b'ojok junok k'een oro jaylechinak yelwanub'ok, tz'och juntzanh lolonel tik t'a k'een, icha junok sello: Yicnhej Jehová Yaji, xchi.
Tz'och jun k'een oro jaylechinak chi' t'a snanhal sat sk'ox winhaj Aarón chi', stzek'chajoch k'een yet' junok ch'al b'ayb'il k'ik'mutz'inak.

Yed'nakokab'nhej k'een winhaj Aarón t'a snanhal sat yik tzin cha yofrenda heb' etchonhab' syak' t'ayin a in Jehová in tik, wach'chom manh ichaok t'a smojal syutej heb' yak'ani, palta yuj jun k'een chi', tzin cha yofrenda heb' chi'.

Tzak' b'ojok junokxo k'apak pichul yelxo wal te jukan. Ha lino wach' tz'och t'ay, lino pax junok k'ox b'ayb'il sb'oi. Anheja' k'apak tzek'ul, wach' tz'aj yochpax stz'ib'ul k'apak yuj junok jelan stz'isani.
Tzak'pax b'ojok spichul heb' yuninal winhaj Aarón chi', aton sjukan pichul heb', stzek'ul heb' yet' sk'ox heb'. Yic wach' yilji heb', yik niwan pax yelk'och heb'.
Icha chi' tzutej ak'anoch spichul winh uk'tak aj Aarón chi' yet' heb' yuninal. Slajwi chi' tzak'ank'e akeite t'a sjolom heb', yik tz'ochkan yopisio heb' t'a sakerdoteal t'ayin.
Tzak'anpax b'ojok yol swex heb', tz'emk'och t'a xub' heb', sk'epaxk'och t'a snanhal heb', yik wach' tz'aj smuschaj sniwanil heb'. Lino k'apak tz'och t'a yol swex heb' chi'

Syak'och k'apak yolwex chi' winhaj Aarón chi' yet' heb' yuninal ayik tz'och heb' t'a yol mantiado b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, ma ayik tz'och heb' t'a slak'anil altar t'a yol mantiado chi' ayik ayoch heb' t'a yopisio, yik wach' max och smul heb' yik max cham heb'. Ha jun tik, ley tz'ajkan t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a yinhtilal t'a masanil tiempo.

Ix yalanxi Jehová: Ayic schaanel yich yopisio winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal t'a sakerdoteal t'ayin, aton juntzanh tik tza b'o yuj heb': Tzik'kot junok nok' quelem wakax yet' chawanhok nok' ch'ak kalnel malaj jab'ok spaltail.
Yed' ixim harina yik trigo te wach', malaj yich sb'at t'a skal, aton t'a ixim tzak' b'ojok ixim pan yet' k'oxox pan kalab'il yet' akeite yet' pax k'oxox pan jay sb'onhchajoch akeite t'ay.
Slajwi chi' tz'em ixim t'a yol junok yune' mooch, tzik'anb'at t'a in kajnub' yet' nok' quelem wakax yet' pax chawanh nok' ch'ak kalnel chi'.
Slajwi chi', tzik'anb'at winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal t'a yichanh mantiado b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a. Ata' sb'iquel sb'a heb'.

Slajwi chi', tzik'anpaxb'at k'apak pichul yik sakerdoteal. Tzak'anoch k'apak t'a winhaj Aarón chi', aton k'apak pichul yelxo wal te jukan yet' junxo k'apak jukan, k'apak chaleka yet' k'apak smakul snhi' sk'ool, tzak'anoch stzek'ul snanhal jun chaleka chi'.
Slajwi chi', tza b'ak'anoch sk'ox winh t'a sjolom. Ha t'a snanhal sat sk'ox winh chi' tzak'och jun oro jay lechinak, aton sch'oxan yechel to wik yaj winh.
Slajwi chi' tzik'ankot akeite sk'anchaji ayik sik'chajel junok mach tz'ochkan wikok. Tzak'ank'e t'a sjolom winhaj Aarón chi' yik tz'ochkan winh sakerdoteal.
Slajwi chi', sjapax heb' yuninal winh chi' t'a a tz'ey, tzak'anoch spichul heb' jukan.
Tza b'oanoch stzek'ul winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal, tza b'oank'e sk'ox heb'. Ichaton chi' tz'aj yochkan yopisio heb' t'a masanil tiempo.
Slajwi chi', tzik'anb'at nok' quelem wakax t'a yichanh mantiado b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, yik wach' syak'k'e sk'ab' winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal t'a sjolom nok'.
Ha t'a yichanh mantiado chi' tza milcham nok' t'a wichanh.
Tzik'ank'eta jab'ok schiq'uil nok' yet' yiximal a k'ab', tza sukanoch t'a sch'ak altar ayk'e t'a schiquintak, haxo masanil chik' skan chi', tza tob'kanek' t'a yichtak altar chi'.
Axo masanil xepu' ayoch t'a sch'anhtza' nok' yet' t'a yib'anh seyub' nok' yet' pax t'a stut nok', tz'ik'eli tza nhusantz'ha t'a yib'anh altar.
Axo nok' chib'ej chi' yet' stz'umal nok', stza' nok', masanil juntzanh chi' tza nhustz'ha t'a spatiquel kampamento, yujto a jun nok' chi' silab' yaj yik tz'ak'ji tup mul.
Slajwi chi', tzik'ankot junok nok' ch'ak kalnel, syak'ank'e sk'ab' winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal chi' t'a sjolom nok'.
Tza milancham nok', tza tzikanoch schiq'uil nok' t'a schanhil pak'anh altar.
Slajwi chi', tza kotak xikanb'at nok', smaxchajel nok' yol sk'ool, nok' yok, junnhej tz'aj yet' nok' kotak xikab'il chi' yet' pax nok' sjolom.
Tza nhusantz'a nok' silab'il t'a yib'anh altar t'a wichanh yuj wik'jichaanh, aton jun silab' snhusjitz'a smasanil, sumumi sjab' swab'i.
Slajwi chi', tzik'ankot junxo nok' kalnel, syak'ank'e sk'ab' winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal t'a sjolom nok',

tza milancham nok'. Tzik'ank'e jab'ok schiq'uil nok', tza sukanek' t'a sjayil schiquin winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal. Aton t'a schiquin heb' t'a swach'. Tza sukpaxek' jab'ok t'a smam sk'ab' heb' yet' t'a smam yok heb' t'a swach'. Slajwi chi' tza tzikankanem masanil schiq'uil nok' ch'ak kalnel chi' t'a spatiktak altar chi'.

Axo schiq'uil nok' kalnel ayoch t'a yib'anh altar chi' tzik'k'e jab'ok, tza tzikanb'at t'a yib'anh winhaj Aarón yet' t'a spichul winh yet' t'a yib'anh heb' yuninal winh yet' pax t'a spatiktak spichul heb'. Icha pax chi' tz'utaj akeite sk'anchaji yik sik'chaj junok mach tz'ochkan wikok. Icha wal chi' tz'aj sik'chajkanel winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal yet' spichul heb'.

Slajwi chi', tzik'anel xepu' ayoch t'a snhe nok' ch'ak kalnel chi', t'a nok' sch'anhtza' yet' t'a yib'anh seyub' nok', tzik'anpaxkot chab' nok' stut yet' pax xepu' ayoch t'ay yet' pax nok' sb'ak'chil xub' t'a swach' yujto a jun nok' ch'ak kalnel chi', aton nok' sk'anchaji yik tz'ochkan heb' sakerdote t'a yopisio.
Tzik'anpaxk'eta ixim pan malaj yich, aton ixim ayem t'a yol mooch t'a wichanh, junok ixim pan setan setan yaji, junok ixim kalab'il yet' akeite yet' junok ixim k'oxox.
Masanil juntzanh chi' tzak'och t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yuninal, sb'akhchajoch t'a wichanh.

Slajwi chi', tzik'anek' t'a yol sk'ab' heb', tza nhusantz'ha t'a yib'anh altar chi'. Junnhej tz'aj stz'a yet' nok' ch'ak kalnel wan stz'a silab'il, sumumi sjab' swab'i. Snhusjitz'a jun ofrenda chi' yuj wik'jichaanh.
Ha nok' ch'ak kalnel sk'anchaji ayik tz'och winhaj Aarón t'a yopisio, tzik'kanel snhi' sk'ol nok'. Tza b'akhank'e t'a wichanh a in Jehová in tik, yujto ik tz'ajkan jun makan nok' chib'ej chi'.
Tza pojanel nok' snhi' sk'ol yet' nok' xub' ix a b'akhk'e t'a wichanh, aton yik nok' ix och yopisio ayik ix ochkan winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal t'a sakerdoteal.
Ha chab' makan nok' chib'ej chi', yik winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal tz'ajkani, aton ofrenda syak' heb' eyetisraelal. Aton chab' makan nok' chi' syak' heb' t'ayin yofrendaok yik junk'olal.

Ha spichul winhaj Aarón syak'och t'a yopisio, skannhej t'a heb' yinhtilal winh. Ha junok yinhtilal winh skan t'a yopisio, ayik tz'och t'a yol mantiado b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, yuj in yak'an serwil t'a yol jun lugar Ha Innhej Ay Vico', anhej juntzanh pichul chi' syak'och heb' t'a uque' k'ual ayik tz'ochkan heb' sakerdoteal.
Tzik'anpaxb'at nok' kalnel ix b'inaji yik tz'ochkan yopisio heb'. Ha t'a jun lugar sik'b'ilpaxeli, ata' tza tz'anh nok'.
Ha winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal schi'an nok' chib'ej chi', swaanpax juntzanh ixim pan ayem t'a yol jun yune' mooch chi' t'a yichanh mantiado b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a.

Aton heb' schi'an nok' ix ak'ji yik tz'ak'ji tup schukal heb', aton yik ix sik'chajel heb' yet' schaankan yopisio heb' t'a sakerdoteal, palta malaj junok ch'ok animail syal schi'an juntzanh chi', yujto wik yaji.
Tato ayto nok' chib'ej chi' yet' ixim pan chi' skan t'a jun k'u chi', tza nhuskantz'aok. Malaj junokxo mach syal schi'ani ma swaani, yujto wik yaji.
Masanil juntzanh tik tza b'o t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yuninal icha wal tz'aj walan t'ayach tik. Uque' k'ual syik' yuj ak'ankanoch yopisio heb' chi'.
Junjun nok' quelem wakax tzak' silab'il t'a junjun k'u, yik tz'ak'ji lajwok smul heb'. Icha chi' tz'aj a sakb'itan altar t'a wichanh, tza sukanpaxoch akeite t'a yib'anh yik tz'ochkan yopisio.

Uque' k'ual tzak' silab' t'a yib'anh altar chi', yik tz'ak'ji lajwok mul. Icha wal chi' tz'aj yochkan jun altar chi' wikok, tz'och t'a yopisio. Yalnhej tastak tz'och tennaj t'a jun altar chi', wikxo tz'ajkani.
Junjun k'u yowalil snhusji chawanh nok' kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal silab'il t'a yib'anh altar.
Jun nok' tza nhustz'ha t'a q'uinhib'alil, junxo nok' tza nhustz'ha t'a yemk'ualil.
Tzak' chanheok libra harina te wach' yet' nok' stz'ha t'a q'uinhib'alil chi', tza kalej ixim harina chi' yet' junok litro akeite yik sat te' oliwo, tza sekanem junok litro wino ofrendail.
Anheja' icha chi' tzutejpax junxo nok' kalnel chi' t'a yemk'ualil, ixim harina yet' wino ofrendail. Ha juntzanh ofrenda snhusjitz'a chi', te sumumi sjab' swab'i.
Ha juntzanh silab' chi', ol snhusnhejtz'a heb' t'a wichanh t'a masanil tiempo t'a stojolal sti' mantiado b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, ayik tzin lolon eyed'ok.
Ata' ol in ch'ox in b'ha t'a heb' etisraelal, yuj chi' wik ol ajkan jun mantiado chi', yuj in tziquiquial.
Ha in wal tzin sik'kanoch jun mantiado chi' wikok yet' yaltaril. Tzin sik'paxkanel winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal chi' yik tz'ochkan heb' sakerdoteal t'ayin.
Ol in kajnaj t'a skal heb' etisraelal, yujto he Diosal in.
Icha wal chi' ol aj snachajel yuj heb' to a in ton Jehová in sDiosal in heb' ed'ok, a in ix ex wik'elta t'a Egipto yik tzin kajnaj t'a he kal, a in Jehová he Diosal in tik, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová: Ak' b'ojok junok altar b'aj stz'a inkienso. Ha te' akakia tz'och t'ay.
Ha sk'atul 45 kentímetro tz'aji, 45 kentímetro tz'ajpax sat, haxo steel, 90 kentímetro tz'aji. Anheja' sb'ok'e sch'ak altar chi' t'a junjun schiquintak, yaman tz'aj yet' altar chi'.
Tz'och k'een oro yelxo wal wach' t'a altar chi': D'a yib'anh yet' t'a spatiktak schanhil pak'anh yet' t'a sch'aak chi', sk'epax tzalan k'een oro chi' t'a yib'anh stitak.
Ha t'a yalanh stitak chi', ata' tz'och chab'chab'ok argolla nab'a oro t'a schab'il pak'anh. Ha t'a yool chi' tzek' te' sb'akhlab'il yik syal sb'akhchaji.
Ha te' b'akhlab' chi', a te' akakia tz'ochi, tz'och k'een oro t'a spatik te'.
Tzak'em jun altar chi' t'a yichanhelta k'apak kortina ayoch yenhulok skaxail in trato, aton te' kaxa ay smakul b'aj tz'ak'ji tup mul. Ata' ol in ch'ox in b'a t'ayex.
Ha winhaj Aarón ol nhusantz'a inkienso sumumi sjab' t'a yib'anh altar chi', junjun q'uinhib'alil ayik sb'ochajoch kandil.
Snhusanpax winh a tz'emxikan k'u, aton t'a yorail yoch sk'ak'al kandil. Ha jun tik ol ujoknhej t'a wichanh ayik ol b'eynhejb'at tiempo.
Malaj junok komon inkienso ol nhusjoktz'ha t'a yib'anh jun altar chi', malaj pax junok silab', ofrenda t'a ixim trigo, ma ofrenda t'a yik sekchajem wino ol snhuschaj t'ay.

Anhej junel t'a yol ab'il stzikoch chik' winhaj Aarón t'a sch'ak altar chi', aton schiq'uil nok' silab' smiljicham yuj yak'ji lajwok mul. Junjun ab'il tzuji jun tik t'a masanil tiempo. Ha jun altar chi', wik yaji, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Ayic ol ik'anchaanh sb'isul heb' etchonhab' israel chi', junjun heb' ol stup t'ayin yuj sk'inal, yik malaj junok ilya te ow ol jawok t'a yib'anh heb' to scham heb' yuj, yuj b'aj sb'ischaj chi'.
Masanil heb' stz'ib'chaj chi', yowalil nanhal siklo k'een plata syak' heb' yik stupan heb' t'ayin, icha k'een siklo sk'anchaj t'a in kajnub', aton 20 gera.
Masanil heb' stz'ib'chaj sb'i chi', aton heb' 20 ab'il sk'inal sb'eynhejb'ati, aton heb' chi' tz'ak'an jun b'aj stupchaj chi' t'ayin.
Ayic stupan heb' chi' t'ayin yuj sk'inal, wach'chom heb' b'eyum, ma heb' meb'a' lajannhej tz'aj yak'an heb'. Nanhal siklo syak' junjun heb'.

Ichato chi' smolchaj masanil k'een plata syak' heb' anima chi' stojolok yuj sk'inal. Ha t'a mantiado b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a tz'och yopisio k'een. Ha yuj chi', ol ex in nakoti, aton yuj tas tzeyak' yuj he k 'inal chi', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:

Ak' b'ojok junok k'een niwan palangana yet' sb'akhnub' yich, nab'a bronke tz'aji. Ha t'a skal snanhal altar yet' mantiado b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a skan k'een. Sb'ud'chaj k'een yet' ha ha'. Ata' syik'k'eta ha' winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal yik sb'ikan sk'ab' heb' yet' yok.
Ayic tz'och heb' t'a yol mantiado, ma ayik sk'och heb' t'a altar yik snhusan yofrenda t'a wichanh, yowalil sb'ik sk'ab' heb' yet' yok, yik max cham heb'.
Ha jun tik, ley tz'ajkan t'a yib'anh winhaj Aarón yet' yinhtilal, ayik ol b'eynhejb'at tiempo, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Sik'chajokab'el juntzanhok awb'en te' manhxo jantakok swach'il sjab': Lajchaweoc libra stzatajil te' mirra te wach', waqueok libra kanela, waqueok libra te' kálamo yelxo wal wach',

yet' pax lajchaweok libra te' kasia. Ha echlab' sk'anchaj t'a juntzanh chi', aton icha echlab' sk'anchaj t'a in kajnub'. Scalaj juntzanh chi' yet' nanhalok schanhil litro akeite yik te' oliwo, icha wal tz'aj sb'oan junok b'oum perfume. Icha chi' tz'aj a b'oan akeite sk'anchaji a sik'chajel junok mach ma junok tas to wik tz'ajkani.
Succhajoch akeite chi' t'a mantiado b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, t'a te' kaxa yik trato,
t'a te' mexa yet' t'a syamk'ab'il t'a sb'akhnub' kandil yet' syamk'ab'il, t'a altar yik inkienso,
t'a altar b'aj stz'a silab' yet' syamk'ab'il yet' pax t'a jun k'een niwan palangana yet' sb'akhnub'al.
Icha chi' tz'aj a sik'ankanoch masanil juntzanh chi' yik wach' wik tz'ajkani. Masanil tastak tz'och tennaj t'ay, wikxo tz'ajkani.
Ha jun akeite chi' tza sukpaxoch t'a winhaj Aarón yet' pax t'a heb' yuninal winh. Icha chi' tz'aj sik'chajkanoch heb' sakerdoteal t'ayin.
Tzalan t'a masanil heb' etisraelal: Ayic ol b'eynhejb'at tiempo, aton jun akeite tik ol k'anchaj t'a tastak to wik ol ajkanok.
Manh komonok sukchajoch t'a junok komon anima. Manh komonok sb'oji junokxo makan akeite lajan yet' jun tik. Ha jun tik wik tz'ajkani, yuj chi' manh komonok tze yama'.
Tato ay junok mach sb'oan junokxo makan akeite lajan yet' jun tik, ma sukoch t'a junok komon anima, a jun chi' yowalil tz'ik'jikanel t'a skal heb' yetchonhab', xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb'.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: Ik'chajokab'kot masanil juntzanh tastak chi', lajannhej ol aj yechlab'il: Stzatajil te' estakte, sjoxal nok' mik' skuch uña, stzatajil te' gálbano te wach' sjab' yet' pax stzatajil te' inkienso yelxo wal te wach'.
Ha yet' juntzanh chi' tzak' b'ojok inkienso. Wach' tz'aj skalaji, icha wal tz'aj sb'oji yuj junok b'oum perfume. Wach' tz'aj sb'at yatz'amil, malajokab' spaltail, yujto wik yaji.
Chok' tz'aj stenjipoj jab'ok, tzak'anoch t'a yol mantiado t'a yichanh te' skaxail in trato b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a t'ayex. Ha jun inkienso chi', niwanokab' yelk'och t'a yol he sat.
Manh he b'o junokxo icha wal jun ix he b'o tik. Tze nakoti to a innhej ay wiko'.
Tato ay junokxo mach sb'oan t'a yol yiko', yik syab' sjab', a jun chi' tojolnhej yik'jikanel t'a skal heb' yetchonhab', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Ab'i, ha t'a skal yinhtilal winhaj Judá ix in sik'kanel winhaj Bezaleel, yuninal winhaj Uri, yixchiquin winhaj Hur.
Toxo ix wak'och Vespíritu t'a winh, yik jelan snaanel winh, yik ol yal sb'oank'e yalnhej tastak winh.
Ol snaanelta winh sb'oan yechel jantak munlajel ol b'o'ok, icha t'a k'een oro, t'a k'een plata yet' t'a k'een bronke,
yet' pax sb'oan k'een k'een winh wach' yilji, sb'oan te te' t'a yalnhej tas munlajelal.

Axo winhaj Aholiab, yuninal winhaj Ahisamac, yinhtilal winhaj Dan, a winh ol kolwaj yet' winhaj Bezaleel chi'. Masanil heb' aytaxon sjelanil, ix in wach' ak'ej sjelanil heb' yik a heb' ol b'oan masanil tastak swal tik t'ayach:
Aton k'apak mantiado b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, te' skaxail in trato yet' smakul b'aj tz'ak'ji tup mul, masanil syamk'ab'il t'a yol mantiado chi',
te' mexa yet' jantak syamk'ab'il, jun sb'akhnub' kandil nab'a oro yet' syamk'ab'il, jun altar b'aj snhuschaj inkienso,
jun altar b'aj stz'a silab' yet' syamk'ab'il, jun niwan palangana yet' sb'akhnub' yich,
k'apak pichul jalb'il niwan yelk'ochi, aton spichul winhaj sakerdote Aarón yet' pax spichul heb' yuninal winh, aton pichul sk'an heb' t'a yopisio.

Sb'opax akeite heb' sk'anchaji ayik tz'ochkan junok mach, ma junok tas wikok. Sb'opax inkienso manhxo jantakok swach'il sk'anchaj t'a in kajnub'. Ha juntzanh chi', yowalil sb'o heb' icha wal ix aj walan t'ayach, xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi':

Al t'a heb' etchonhab' to yowalil sk'anab'ajej jun sk'ual ik'oj ip heb', yujto wik yaji. Yujto a jun k'u chi' yechel in trato yajkanoch t'a ko kal eyed'ok t'a masanil tiempo yik wach' tzeyojtaquejeli to a in Jehová in tik ix ex in sik'kanel wikok.
Niwanokab' yelk'och jun sk'ual ik'oj ip chi' t'a yol he sat. Ha mach max k'anab'ajan jun k'ual ik'oj ip chi', yowalil schami. Yalnhej mach smunlaj t'a jun k'u chi', yowalil schami.
Vaquenhej k'ual tzex munlaji, haxo t'a yuquil k'ual, sk'ual ik'oj ip, wiknhej yaji. Yalnhej mach smunlaj t'a jun k'u chi', tojolnhej schami.

Yuj chi', yowalil tze k'anab'ajej jun k'ual ik'oj ip chi'. Ha jun chi' yechel in trato tz'ajkan t'a masanil tiempo t'a ko kal eyed'ok, yujto a in Jehová in t'a waque' k'ual in b'onak satcha’anh yet' sat lu'um tik, haxo t'a yuquil k'ual wochnak waan in munlaji, wik'annak wip, xchi Jehová.
