Ayic ix lajwi slolon Jehová yet' winhaj Moisés t'a jolom witz Sinaí, ix yak'an chab' pachanh k'een t'a winh, b'aj tz'ib'ab'iloch strato, to a wal Dios ix tz'ib'ani.

Axo yik ix yilan heb' chonhab' israel to a winhaj Moisés chi' anheja' max emxul-laj winh b'aj ayek' heb' chi', ix smolb'an sb'a heb' smasanil, ix yalan heb' t'a winhaj Aarón: --Ha tiknaik, ko gana to tza b'o juntzanhok ko diosal tzonh kuchb'ani, yujto a winhaj Moisés, winh ix onh ik'anelta t'a Egipto, manh kojtakok tas ix ik'an winh, xchi heb' chonhab' chi'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Aarón chi' t'a heb': --Ha tiknaik, molb'ejekkot masanil k'een uchiquin nab'a oro yik heb' ix eyetb'eyum yet' yik heb' eyuninal, heb' ix eyisil, tzeyik'ankot t'ayin, xchi winh.
Masanil anima ix yik'el yuchiquin, ix yik'ankot heb' t'a winhaj Aarón chi'.

Ix schaanek' winh, ix yak'an ulax k'een winh t'a skal te' k'ak', ix yak'anem winh t'a yol jun smoldeal, ix b'o jun yechel jun quelem wakax. Ix ochnhej ijan winh swach' b'oan jun yechel wakax chi'. Ix yalan heb' chonhab' chi' smasanil: --Ex quetchonhab' israel, a jun ko diosal tik ix onh ik'anelta t'a Egipto, xchi heb'.
Ayic ix yilan jun chi' winhaj Aarón chi', ix sb'oank'e jun altar winh t'a yichanh jun yechel wakax chi', te chaanh ix yal winh: --Ha k'ik'an skak'och junok niwan q'uinh t'a yichanh Jehová, xchi winh.

Axo ix q'uinhib'i t'a junxo k'u, ix smolb'an sb'a anima smasanil, ix snhusan juntzanh silab' heb' yet' silab' yik junk'olal. Ixlajwi chi' ix em k'ojjab' heb', ix wa heb', ix yuk'an ha' heb'. Ixlajwi chi', ix k'e b'ulnaj heb' schanhalwi yet' sk'ulan chukal t'a yichanh sdiosal chi'.
Yuj chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Ixic, emanhxi yujto a heb' a chonhab' ix ik'elta t'a Egipto, toxo ix sjuel sb'a heb'.

Yelxo wal t'a elanhchamel ix yik'el sb'a heb' t'a tas ix wala'. D'a elanhchamel ix sb'o jun yechel quelem wakax heb', syak'anem sb'a heb' ejmelal t'ay. Syak'an silab' heb', syalan heb': Ex quetchonhab' israel, a wal jun ko diosal tik ix onh ik'anelta t'a Egipto, xchi heb'.
Toxo ix wila'' to a juntzanh anima tik, yelxo wal pit spensar heb'.
Ha tiknaik manhxo ach tewok t'ayin yuj heb', skot wal wowal t'a juntzanh anima tik. Ol in satel heb' smasanil, anhej ed'ok ol in b'o jun niwan nakión yet' heb' inhtilal, xchi t'a winh.

Axo winhaj Moisés chi', ix och ijan winh sk'anan niwank'olal t'a Jehová sDiosal yuj heb' schonhab', ix yalan winh: --Mamin Jehová, ¿tas wal yuj skot yowal a k'ol t'a yib'anh a chonhab' to a ach ix ik'elta t'a Egipto yet' ipalil?

¿Tas wal yuj ol a cha ach yal heb' aj Egipto chukal? Ol am yal heb' icha tik: Tob'an chuk spensar Dios t'a heb', yuj chi' ix yik'el heb' t'a tik, sb'at smilancham heb' t'a jolomtak witz, satjiel heb' yuj t'a sat lum lum tik, xcham heb'. Yuj chi' komonok max te kot yowal a k'ol t'a yib'anh heb', mokab' ak'och yaelal t'a yib'anh heb'.

Comonoc tza nakot heb' a chekab', aton winhaj Abraham, winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Israel. Ha loknak a b'i ak'annak a ti' t'a heb', alannak icha tik: Ol wik'chaanh he b'isul yet' eyuninal. Lajan ol aj sb'isul heb' icha k'een k'anal t'a satcha’anh. Anheja' jun lum lum tik, toxo ix wala' to ol wak' t'a eyinhtilal t'a masanil tiempo, xa chinak t'a heb', xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Yuj chi' ix snaan Jehová to manhxo ol satel-laj schonhab' chi'.
Ix meltzajemta winhaj Moisés t'a jolom witz chi', yet'nakxo chab' pachanh k'een winh b'aj tz'ib'ab'iloch cheknab'il yuj Jehová, t'a schab'il pak'anh k'een.
Ha wal Jehová ixb’o’an k'een k'een chi' schab'il, ix stz'ib'anoch letra chi' t'a k'een.
Axo yik ix yab'an winhaj Josué yel yaw heb' anima, ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Ha wal skab'an yel yaw heb' anima chi', icha wal to ayoch owal t'a yol kampamento, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Moisés chi': --Ha juntzanh aw tz'och skab' chi', manh awok yik tzalajk'olal yik tz'ak'ji ganar junok owal, manh awokpax yik kusk'olal yik tz'ak'ji ganar anima yuj heb' ajk'ool, palta b'it tz'och swab'i, xchi winh.

Axo yik ix jawi winhaj Moisés chi' t'a slak'anil kampamento chi', ix yilanoch jun yechel quelem wakax chi' winh, haxo heb' anima wan schanhalwi heb'. Ix te kot yowal winh, ix syumanel k'een k'een b'aj tz'ib'ab'iloch cheknab'il chi' winh, yuj chi' ix pojb'at k'een t'a yich witz chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at stzak'anelta jun yechel wakax chi' winh, ix syumanoch winh t'a skal k'ak'. Ixlajwi chi' ix smak'anpoj winh, chok'xonhej ix aji, ix yak'anem winh t'a skal ha ha', ix schekan winh yuk' heb' anima chi'.
Ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Aarón chi': --¿Tas yuj ach montaj yuj juntzanh anima tik ix a kuchb'an heb' sk'ulan jun niwan chukal tik? xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Aarón chi': --Mamin, mokab' kot owal t'ayin, ojtak wal sik'lab'il to a jun chonhab' tik, sgananhej heb' sk'ulan chukal.
Ha heb' ix alan t'ayin: B'o junok ko diosal tzonh kuchb'ani, yujto a winhaj Moisés ix onh ik'anelta t'a Egipto, ma chequel tas ix ik'an winh, max jaxlaj winh, xchi heb' t'ayin.

Yuj chi' ix walan t'a heb': Machtac ex ay k'een oro t'ayex, ma k'een uchiquin, ik'equeli, tzeyik'ankoti, xin chi t'a heb'. Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'ankot heb' t'ayin, ix wak'an ulax t'a kal k'ak', haxo ix aji ix komon elta jun yechel wakax tik, xchi winh t'a winh.

Ix nachajel yuj winhaj Moisés chi' to a heb' anima chi', b'ekanxonhej sk'ol heb' yak'an q'uixwelal sb'ha t'a yichanh heb' chonhab' ayoch ajk'olal t'a heb', haxo winhaj Aarón chi' maj skachoch waan jab'ok heb' winh.

Yuj wal chi' ix och tek'tek' winhaj Moisés chi' t'a sti' kampamento chi', ix yalan winh: --Ha tiknaik a mach syal sk'ol syak'och sb'ha t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová, kotokab' t'a in tz'ey tik, xchi winh. Masanil heb' yetlewitail winh, ix snitzkot sb'a heb' t'a stz'ey winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalanpax winh t'a heb': --Ix schek Jehová ko Diosal wal t'ayex to junjun ex tzeyik'b'at eyespada, tzex b'at t'a kampamento, tzex ek' t'a kaltak mantiado, tze milancham heb' eyuk'tak, heb' eyamigo yet' heb' kajan t'a he lak'anil, xchi Jehová, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix sk'anab'ajej cheknab'il heb' winh lewita ix yak' winh. Yuj chi', ay am oxeok mil anima ix smilcham heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalanxi winhaj Moisés chi': --Ha tiknaik ix eyak'och he b'ha t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová, ina to a ex ix he milcham eyuninal yet' eyuk'tak. Yuj wal chi', ol yak' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a eyib'anh, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Axo t'a junxo k'u, ix yalan winhaj Moisés chi' t'a heb' anima: --Te niwan he mul ix ochi. Ha tiknaik tik tzin b'atxi t'a jolom witz b'aj ayek' Jehová. Ata' ol in lolon yet'ok, talaj ol yak' lajwok he mul chi' t'a eyib'anh, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winh t'a jolom witz b'aj ayek' Jehová chi'. Ix yalan winh: --Val yel Mamin, te niwan smul jun chonhab' tik ix och t'a ichanh, ix sb'o jun sdiosal heb' oro yik syak'em sb'a heb' t'ay.

Yuj wal chi' tzin tewi t'ayach to tzak' lajwok smul heb' chi'. Tato max ak' niwank'olal smul heb' chi' jun, tza suksat in b'i t'a yol ch'anh libro b'aj tz'ib'ab'il sb'i heb' to ikxo yaji, xchi winh t'a Jehová.
Axo ix tak'wi Jehová chi' t'a winh: --Ha heb' tz'och smul t'ayin, aton heb' chi' tzin suksat sb'i t'a yol ch'anh libro chi'.
Yuj chi' ixik, tzik'anb'at heb' chonhab' chi' t'a jun lugar ix wal t'ayach. Ha jun wángel ol b'ab'laj eyuuj, palta ol k'och sk'ual yik ol wak'anoch syaelal heb' anima tik yuj smul, xchi.
Ixlajwi chi', a Jehová ix ak'ankot jun niwan ilya to smilwaj t'a yib'anh heb' chonhab' israel chi', yujto ix yak'och sb'a heb' sb'oan jun yechel wakax, aton jun ix sb'o winhaj Aarón chi'.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Ha tiknaik elanh t'a tik yet' heb' chonhab' ix ik'elta t'a Egipto, tzik'anb'at heb' t'a sat lum lum walnak t'a winhaj Abraham, t'a winhaj Isaac yet' t'a winhaj Jacob to ol wak' t'a yinhtilal heb' winh.

Ha in ol in chek b'ab'laj jun wángel t'a eyichanh. A' ol ex kuchb'anb'atok. Ha juntzanh chonhab'il anima, aton heb' kananeo, heb' amorreo, heb' hitita, heb' ferezeo, heb' heweo yet' heb' jebuseo, ol wik'el heb' t'a sat lu'um chi'.
Ixiquec t'a jun lum te yax sat chi', palta manh ol in b'atlaj t'a he kal, yujto te pit ex, ay smay tzex in satel t'a yoltak b'e, xchi Jehová.
Ayic ix yab'an heb' anima jun lolonel kuseltak yalji chi', ix och heb' t'a ilk'olal, manhxalaj mach ix yak'och yuchiquin yet' stonh.

Yujto a Jehová ix alan t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Al t'a heb' etisraelal tik: Ha ex tik te pit ex. Tato tzin k'och t'a he kal junok rato, ay smay tzex in sateli. Ha tiknaik ik'equel eyuchiquin chi' yet' he tonh t'a he jaj chi', ol wilani tas ol ex wutok, xa chi, xchi t'a winh.
Yuj wal chi', atax ix el heb' t'a yich witz Horeb, manhxo junok heb' ix yak'och stonh yet' yuchiquin.

Ix yak' b'ochajk'e jun mantiado winhaj Moisés t'a stib'at kampamento. Ix yak'an winh skuch jun mantiado chi': D'a B'aj Sch'ox Sb'a Jehová. Tato ay junok mach sb'at sk'anb'ej junok tas t'a Jehová, yowalil sb'at t'a jun mantiado chi'.
Ayic sb'at winhaj Moisés t'a mantiado chi', tz'elta linhan heb' anima smasanil t'a stitak smantiado, sb'at k'elan heb' t'a winh masanto tz'ochkan winh t'a yol mantiado chi'.
Ayic tz'och winh, tz'emul moynaj jun asun t'a sti' mantiado chi' yakb'an slolon Jehová yet' winh.
Ha syilan heb' anima chi' yemul moynaj jun asun chi', tz'em nhojan heb' smasanil ejmelal t'a Jehová.

Q'uelk'umb'a wal tz'aj Jehová slolon yet' winhaj Moisés chi', icha wal tz'aj ko lolon yet' junok ko wach'k'ool. Slajwi slolon winh yet' Jehová chi', sjax winh t'a kampamento. Palta haxo winh skolwaj yet' winhaj Moisés chi', aton winhaj Josué quelem winak, yuninal winhaj Nun, skannhej winh t'a yol mantiado chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Moisés chi' t'a Jehová: --Mamin Jehová, a ach ix al t'ayin to a in tzin kuchb'ej jun a chonhab' tik, palta maj al-laj t'ayin mach ol a chek kolwaj wed'ok. Ix alani to ojtak in to ay a tzalajk'olal wed'ok alani.

Yuj chi', tato yel icha chi', ak' wojtaquejeli tas nab'il uuj, yik cham tzach wojtaquejeli, ol wak'annhej tzalajb'ok a k'ool. Ojtac wal to a jun chonhab' tzak'kanoch t'a yol in k'ab' tik to a chonhab' yaji, xchi winh.
--Ha in wal lak'an ol in b'at ed'ok, ol ex wak' kajnaj t'a junk'olal t'a lum lum chi', xchi Jehová t'a winh.
Yuj wal chi', ix tak'wi winhaj Moisés chi': --Yel wal Mamin, tato max ach b'at qued'ok, wach' to max onh ik'el t'a tik.

Tato max ach b'at qued' tiknaik, ¿tas wal tz'aj yojtakajeli, tato ay a tzalajk'olal wed'ok yet' t'a heb' a chonhab' tik? Tato ayachnhejoch qued'ok jun, ol cheklajelok to a chonhab' ton kaji, sik'b'il onh el uuj t'a skal masanil chonhab', xchi winh.
--Ha juntzanh lolonel tzal tik ol in k'ulej, yujto te ay in tzalajk'olal ed'ok, wojtak wal a pensar sik'lab'il, xchi Jehová t'a winh.
--Mamin, tzin tewi wal t'ayach to tza ch'ox sniwanil elk'och t'ayin, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi Jehová t'a winh: --Masanil in wach'k'olal ol in ch'ox t'ayach. Ha wal t'a ichanh ol walel in wach'il to a in ton Jehová in, ol wak' in wach'k'olal t'a heb' b'aj syal in k'ol swak'a', ol ok' in k'ool t'a heb' b'aj syal in k'ool.
Palta swal t'ayach to manh ol yal-laj och k'elan t'a in sat, yujto malaj junok mach syal yilan in sat. Tato tz'och k'elan junok mach t'ayin, elanhchamel schami.
Ina t'a in lak'anil ay jun lugar b'aj ol yal a k'ekan linhan t'a yib'anh jun niwan k'een.
Ayic ol ek'b'at in tziquiquial ta', ol ach wak'anoch t'a yol spojelal k'een k'een chi', ol ach in makchankanoch yet' in k'ab' yakb'an tzin ek'kanb'ati.
Ayic ol lajwok wek'kani, ol wik'anel in k'ab', axonhej in patik ol yal ilani, haxo in sat manh wal jab'ok ol yal ilani, xchi Jehová.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Ha tiknaik a achxo ol a tzey chab'ok k'een k'een, icha wal k'een ix wak' t'ayach t'a sb'ab'elal, aton k'een ix a mak'pojok. Ol in tz'ib'anxioch t'a k'een, icha wal tas ix in tz'ib'ejoch t'a k'een b'ab'el chi'.
Tza b'oan a b'ha t'a q'uinhib'alil k'ik'an, tzach jawi t'a wichanh t'a jolom witz tik.
Malaj junok mach syal sk'eta ed'ok, malaj junok mach syal yek' t'a spatiktak lum witz tik. Max yalpaxlaj yek' nok' kalnel yet' nok' wakax wael t'a yichtak lu'um, xchi t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi, ix stzeyan chab' k'een k'een winh icha k'een ix scha' t'a sb'ab'elal t'a Jehová. Axo t'a q'uinhib'alil t'a junxo k'u, ix yik'anb'at k'een winh, ix b'at winh t'a jolom witz Sinaí, icha wal ix yutej Jehová yalan t'a winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix emul Jehová t'a stz'ey winh t'a skal asun t'a jolom witz chi', ix yalan sb'i t'a winh.

Ix ek'b'at Jehová t'a yichanh winh, te chaanh ix yal icha tik: --Ha in ton Jehová in. Jehová in b'i. Te wach' in k'ool, tz'ok' in k'ol t'a anima. Manh elanhchamelok skot wowal. Te niwan tzin xajanej heb' anima, swak'nhejelk'och tas swala'.

Ha tas wach' walnakkan t'a heb' he mam eyicham, ol wak'nhejelk'och t'ayex a ex yinhtilexkan heb' tik t'a masanil tiempo. Swak'an niwank'olal he chukal he mul yet' he pital. Palta max ek'b'atlaj wak'an syaelal junok mach yuj smul b'aj junelnhej pit syutej sb'a t'ayin, swak'nhejkan yaelal t'a yib'anh yuninal yet' yixchiquin, masanto t'a schanhil makan yinhtilal, xchi Jehová.
D'a elanhchamel ix em nhojan winhaj Moisés chi', ix emk'och snanhal sat winh t'a sat lu'um t'a yichanh Jehová chi', ix yalan winh icha tik:

--Mamin Vajalil, tato yel tzach tzalaj wed'ok, tzach b'atnhej qued'ok, wach'chom a jun chonhab' tik te pit, palta ak' niwank'olal ko chukal tz'och t'a ichanh, tzonh a chaankan a chonhab'ok, xchi winh.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Chaab' tas ol wala': Ha tiknaik, tzin b'okan jun in trato tik t'a yichanh masanil heb' etchonhab'. Ol in b'o tastak te satub'tak to mantalaj b'aj tzuji t'a junokxo nakión t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik. Ol yil masanil heb' etchonhab' heb' ajun tik ed'ok tastak ol in k'ulej eyuuj, to satub'tak yilji.
k'anab'ajejek masanil tas swalkan tik t'ayex. Ha in ol wik'el heb' amorreo, heb' kananeo, heb' hitita, heb' ferezeo, heb' heweo yet' heb' jebuseo t'a eyichanh.
Ayic ol ex k'och t'a sat lum lum chi', malajokab' b'ak'uinh tze b'o junok he trato yet' heb' anima ta'. Tato skan heb' t'a he kal, yel ol ex yixtejel heb'.
Ha wal tas ol he k'ulej to ol he mak'poj yaltar heb' yet' yechel sdiosal heb'. Tze ch'akanel te te' yechel sdiosal heb' skuchan Asera.
Manh ex lesalwok t'a junok komon Dios, yujto a in Jehová in, yelxo wal te ow in t'a juntzanh chi'. Yelxo wal ste kot wowal t'ayex tato tzex och ejmelal t'a junok ch'ok diosal.

Manh he b'olaj junok he trato yet' heb' anima ayek' t'a sat lum chi'. Tato tze b'o he trato chi' yet' heb' haxo yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a sdiosal chi', syak'an silab' heb' t'ay, tzex yawtej heb', tze waan tas syak' heb' silab'ok chi'.

Talaj syik'laj sb'a yisil heb' yet' heb' eyuninal, haxo yik tz'em nhojan heb' ix t'a sdiosal chi', skuchb'ajem nhojan heb' eyuninal chi' yuj heb' ix t'a juntzanh komon Dios chi'. Tato icha chi' manhxalaj tz'aj welk'och t'a yol sat heb' eyuninal chi'.
Manh he b'o junok he diosal yet' k'een k'een sb'ochaj t'a molde.

Tze yak'och q'uinh yik ixim pan malaj yich. Uque' k'ual tze wa jun pan chi', icha wal ix aj wak'an he k'ayb'ej. Ha stiempoal, chequel yajkani, aton uj Abib, yujto ha t'a jun uj chi' elnaquexkot t'a Egipto.
Masanil heb' b'ab'el winak unin, wik yaj heb'. Vicpax sb'ab'el yune' nok' he wakax, yune' nok' he kalnel yet' yune' nok' he chiwa tato winak.

Axo pax sb'ab'el yune' nok' he b'uru, syal yak'ji junok yune' kalnel sk'exulok nok'. Tato malaj junok sk'exul nok' tzeyak'a', yowalil smak'ji q'uichaj sjaj nok'. Anheja' pax yuj he b'ab'el winak unin, yowalil tzeyak' junok nok' yune' kalnel sk'exulok. Malaj junok mach sja t'ayin t'a q'uinh tato malaj jab'ok yofrenda yet'nak.
D'a waque' k'ual tzex munlaji, haxo t'a yuquil k'ual tzeyik'an eyip, wach'chom stiempoal munlajel, ma stiempoal smolchajk'e sat eyawb'en, yowalil tzeyik' eyip.
Tzeyak'och q'uinh yik sb'ab'el sat ixim he trigo sk'anb'i, aton q'uinh Pentecostés. Tzeyak'anpaxoch junxo q'uinh yik slajwik'e ixim yik lajwub' ab'il.
Masanil heb' winak, yowalil oxel sjawi heb' t'a wichanh t'a yol junjun ab'il t'a juntzanh q'uinh tik, a in Jehová he Diosal in tik swala'.
Ol wik'el masanil juntzanhxo nakión t'a eyichanh, ol wak' lewanb'ok he lu'um. Malaj mach syal yik'anek' lum he lu'um chi', yakb'an ayek' heb' winak t'a wichanh oxel t'a yol ab'il.

Ayic tzeyak'an he silab' t'ayin, manh eyak' schiq'uil nok' nok' yet' ixim pan ayb'at yich t'a skal. Ha nok' silab' yik jun q'uinh yik tze naankoti ayik ex wik'annaquelta t'a Egipto, tato ayto nok' skani, manh he sik'kanb'at t'a junxo k'u.
Ha sb'ab'el sat eyawb'en yowalil tzeyik'kot t'a in kajnub'. Manh he tz'anh nok' yunetak chiwa t'a skal yal yim snun, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': Tz'ib'ej masanil juntzanh lolonel tik, yujto a ayoch yichb’anelok in trato ix wak' ed'ok yet' pax heb' etchonhab', xchi.

Ha winhaj Moisés chi', 40 k'ual yet' 40 ak'wal ix ek' winh yet' Jehová t'a jolom witz Sinaí. Malaj wal jab'ok tas ix swa winh, malaj pax jab'ok tas ix yuk'ej winh t'a jun pekti’ chi'. Ix stz'ib'anoch slolonelal strato Jehová yet' heb' chonhab' israel t'a k'een k'een, aton lajunhe' cheknab'il.

Ixlajwi chi, ix emixta winhaj Moisés chi' t'a jolom witz Sinaí chi', yet'nakxopax chab' pachanh k'een k'een winh, aton k'een b'aj tz'ib'ab'iloch cheknab'il chi'. Manh yojtakok winh tato toxonhej sweei yilji sat, yujto ix lolon winh yet' Jehová.
Axo ix yilan winhaj Aarón yet' masanil heb' yetchonhab' to toxonhej sweei yilji sat winh, ix te xiwk'e heb' smasanil sk'och t'a stz'ey winh.
Ix yawtankot heb' anima chi' winh, ichato chi' ix snitzanoch sb'a winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yichamtak winaquil chonhab' t'a stz'ey winh, ix lolon winh t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix snitzankot sb'a masanil heb' chonhab', ix och ijan winh yalan masanil cheknab'il ix yak' Jehová t'a winh, aton juntzanh ix b'at schaemta winh t'a jolom witz Sinaí chi'.
Ha ix lajwi slolon winh t'a heb' anima chi', ix smakan sat winh t'a jun k'apak.
Axo yik tz'och winh yik slolon yet' Jehová, syik'el jun k'apak chi' winh. Axo tz'elxul winh, syalanxi winh t'a heb' chonhab' tas cheknab'ilal schek Jehová chi' yal t'a heb'.

Ayic wan slolon winh t'a heb' chi', syilan heb' to weei yilji sat winh. Slajwi yalan scheknab'il Jehová winh t'a heb', smakanxi sat winh t'a jun k'apak chi'. Ato yik tz'och winh lolonel t'a yichanh Jehová, syik'anxiel winh.
Ix smolb'ankot masanil heb' chonhab' israel winhaj Moisés chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' icha tik: Ix yak' juntzanh cheknab'il tik Jehová t'ayin, to ol he k'anab'ajej.
Vaque' k'ual tzex munlaji, haxo yuquil k'ual, yikxo Jehová yaji. E masanil t'a jun k'u chi' tzeyik' eyip, tzeyik'anchaanh Jehová. Ha mach smunlaj t'a jun k'u chi' yowalil schami.
Wach'chom he k'ak', max yal-laj eyak'anoch t'a jun k'ual chi' yalnhej b'aj kajan ex, xchi winh.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Moisés chi' t'a masanil heb' chonhab' israel icha tik: Ha juntzanh tik ix yal Jehová:
Tzeyak' junok ofrenda t'ay. Ha mach tz'el wal t'a sk'ol yak'ani, syal yik'ankot k'een oro, k'een plata yet' k'een bronke,
anh ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak, anh yaxmaquinak, anh chak ch'al, anh lino te wach' yet' xil nok' chiwa b'ayb'il.
Syalpax eyik'ankot stz'umal nok' ch'ak kalnel uk'nak yet' chakchak, nok' tz'uum te lab'ab'i yet' pax te' akakia.
Tzeyik'paxkot yakeiteal sat te' oliwo tz'em t'a yol kandil, perfume sb'at t'a skal akeite tz'ak'jioch t'a junok tz'ochkan yikok Jehová, sb'atpax t'a skal inkienso suk'uq'ui sjab'.
Tzeyik'paxkot k'een kornalina yet' juntzanh k'een k'een yelxo wal wach' yilji tz'och yelwanub'ok schaleka winh sat sakerdote, tz'ochpax yelwanub' jun smakul snhi' sk'ool winh.
Masanil heb' winh winak jelan sb'oan tastak wach' yilji, kotokab' heb' winh, yik sb'oan tas heb' winh ix schek Jehová sb'oi:
Aton mantiado skajnub' Jehová yet' pax juntzanh tz'och t'a yib'anh yet' pax sganchoal, smarkoal, sreglail, yoyal yet' sb'akhnub'al yich.
Sb'opax te' skaxail trato, sreglail tz'och sb'akhlab'ilok, smakul b'aj tz'ak'ji tup mul, junok kortina tz'och smakulok,
te' mexa yet' regla tz'och sb'akhlab'ilok yet' pax syamk'ab'il, ixim pan tz'ak'jioch t'a yichanh Jehová.
Sb'opax sb'akhnub'al kandil yet' masanil syamk'ab'il yet' pax uque' kandil yet' akeite tz'em t'a yol juntzanh kandil chi'.
Sb'ojipax altar yik inkienso, regla tz'och sb'akhlab'ilok, akeite sk'anchaji yik tz'och t'a junok tz'ochkan yikok Jehová, inkienso suk'uq'ui sjab', k'apak kortina yik smakul sti' skajnub' Jehová.
Sb'opax junok altar b'aj stz'a silab', smallail jun altar chi' nab'a bronke yet' sreglail yet' masanil syamk'ab'il. Sb'o jun palangana yet' sb'akhnub'al.
Sb'opax k'apak kortina tzek' oyan t'a spatik yamaq'uil skajnub' Jehová chi' yet' yoyal yet' pax sb'akhnub'al yich yet' k'apak kortina tz'och smakulok sti' amak' chi'.
Sb'o yestakail yet' sch'anhal syamanem t'a spatiktak jun skajnub' Jehová chi' yet' t'a yamaq'uil.

Sb'opax k'apak pichul jalb'il syak'och heb' sakerdote t'a yol skajnub' Jehová. Aton pichul syak'och winhaj sakerdote Aarón to yiknhej yopisio winh yaji yet' pax spichul heb' yuninal winh, aton syak'och heb' a tz'och heb' t'a yopisio, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ixlajwi yalan masanil juntzanh chi' winhaj Moisés chi', ix b'at heb' smasanil t'a yoltak smantiado.
Ha heb' ix el wal t'a sk'ool, ix laj yak' silab' heb' yik sb'oji skajnub' Jehová, aton b'aj sch'ox sb'a yet' masanil tas tz'och yopisio yet' k'apak pichul yik yopisio heb' sakerdote.

Ix laj jawi heb' winh winak yet' heb' ix ix yet' silab' t'a Jehová, ato syala' jantak ix el t'a sk'ol heb' yak'ani, ix ul yak'an heb' t'a winhaj Moisés chi'. Ix yik'ankot k'een yelwanub' pichul heb', k'een kolk'ab', k'een tonh, k'een uchiquin yet' juntzanhokxo nab'a oro. Ix yak'an heb' t'a Jehová.

Masanil heb' ay ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak t'ay, ch'al yaxmaquinak, chak ch'al, lino te wach', xil nok' chiwa b'ayb'il, stz'umal nok' ch'ak kalnel uk'nak yet' chakchak yet' pax nok' tz'uum te lab'ab'i, ix laj yik'kot heb' t'a Jehová.
Ay pax mach ix el t'a sk'ool yik'ankot k'een plata yet' k'een bronke yofrendaok t'a Jehová. Ha heb' ay te' akakia t'ay, ix yik'paxkot te' heb', yik sk'anchaj te' t'a skajnub' Dios.
Axo heb' ix ix syal sb'oan anh ch'al, ix yik'kot ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak heb' ix, ch'al yaxmaquinak, chak ch'al yet' lino te wach'.
Ay heb' ix ix jelan ix el wal t'a sk'ool, ix och ijan heb' ix sb'oan xil nok' chiwa t'a ch'alil.

Axo heb' yichamtak winaquil chonhab', ix yik'kot k'een kornalina heb' yet' pax juntzanhxo k'een k'een te wach' yik tz'och yelwanub'ok schaleka winh sat sakerdote yet' yochpax yelwanub'ok jun smakul snhi' sk'ool winh.
Ix yik'paxkot perfume heb', akeite sk'anchaj t'a kandil, akeite sk'anchaj t'a junok tz'ochkan yikok Jehová yet' inkienso suk'uq'ui sjab'.
Masanil heb' chonhab' israel, heb' winh winak yet' heb' ix ix to ix el wal t'a sk'ool, ix yak' skolwal heb' t'a masanil jun munlajel ix yal Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yal winhaj Moisés t'a masanil heb' yetchonhab': Ha Jehová toxo ix sik'anel winhaj Bezaleel, yuninal winhaj Uri, yixchiquin winhaj Hur, t'a yinhtilal Judá.
Ix yak'anoch Yespíritu Dios chi' t'a winh yik syak'an sjelanil spensar winh yet' yojtakanel winh yik syalpax snachajel yuj winh
sb'oan yechel tas sb'o'o, icha t'a k'een oro, k'een plata yet' k'een bronke.
Ix ak'jipax sjelanil winh yik sb'oanpax k'een k'een yelxo wal wach', yik sb'oanpaxem yechel te te' yelxo wal wach' tz'aji yet' yoch yelwanub' te'.
Ix yak'an sjelanil Jehová t'a winh yet' t'a winhaj Aholiab, yuninal winhaj Ahisamac, t'a yinhtilal Dan, yik sk'ayb'an juntzanhxo heb' skolwaj yet' heb'.

Ix ak'ji sjelanil heb' yuj Jehová, yik sb'oan masanil tastak heb' to yelxo wal wach' yilji: Yic sb'oan yechel, yik sb'oanoch yelwanub' yet' anh ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak, anh ch'al yaxmaquinak, anh chak ch'al yet' lino ch'al te wach'. Ix ak'ji sjelanil heb' sb'oan junok tas wach' yet' sch'oxan yechel junokxo yalnhej tas munlajelal.

Yuj chi' a winhaj Bezaleel, winhaj Aholiab yet' pax juntzanhxo heb' winh winak ix ak'ji sjelanil yuj Jehová sb'oan tastak wach' yilji, a heb' winh ol b'oan masanil tas tz'och yopisio t'a skajnub' Jehová icha ix aj yalani, xchi winhaj Moisés.

Axo winhaj Moisés ix awtankot winhaj Bezaleel yet' winhaj Aholiab chi' yet' pax masanil heb' winh ix ak'ji sjelanil spensar yuj Jehová yik sb'oan yalnhej tastak wach' yilji, aton heb' tz'el t'a sk'ol skolwaj t'a jun munlajel chi'.

Ha heb' winh chi' ix chaan masanil ofrenda ix yik'kot heb' chonhab' israel t'a winhaj Moisés, yik tz'el yich munlajel yuj sb'o skajnub' Dios. Axo heb' tz'el wal t'a sk'ol yak'an yofrenda, junjun q'uinhib'al syik'ankot yofrenda heb' chi'.
Axo heb' winh munlajwum chi', ix yaktejkan smunlajel heb' winh, ix b'at heb' winh yal t'a winhaj Moisés chi':
Toxo ix ek' yib'anh yik'ankot yofrenda heb' anima, manh ol lajwoklaj masanil tas ix yik'kot heb' tik t'a munlajel ix yal Jehová to sb'oi, xchi heb' winh.

Ayic ix yab'an winhaj Moisés to icha chi', ix yalanel winh t'a skal anima t'a kampamento to maxtzak yik'kotlaj yofrenda heb' yuj sb'o skajnub' Dios. Icha chi' ix aj swanaj yik'ankot yofrenda heb' chi',
yujto toxo ix tz'akwi jantak tas ol och t'a skajnub' Dios, aytopax tas olto kanok.

Ha t'a skal heb' munlajwum chi', ata' ay heb' jelan spensar sb'oank'e skajnub' Dios. Lajunhe' jenhan k'apak lino b'ayb'il sch'alil ix sb'o heb'. D'a anh ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak, anh ch'al yaxmaquinak yet' pax anh chak ch'al ix sb'o'okh yechel querubín heb' t'a junjun jenhan lino chi'.
Ha junjun jenhan chi', 12 metro steel yet' nanhalxo, chab' metro sat. Lajannhej ix aj yechel smasanil.
Oye' jenhan k'apak ix tz'ischaj yam sb'a yik junxonhej jenhan tz'aji. Anheja' icha chi' ix aj stz'ischaj syam sb'a oyexo jenhan.
Ixlajwi chi', ix tz'ischajoch xoyjab' anh k'ik'mutz'inak ch'al t'a sti' k'apak b'ab'el jenhan chi' yik syamnub'alok. Anheja' icha chi' ix aj yochpax t'a sti' junxo schab'il jenhan chi'.
Ix och xoyjab' 50 k'ik'mutz'inak ch'al t'a jun pak'anh sti', junjun jenhan k'apak lajannhej ix aj schalan sb'a k'apak.
Ix b'opax 50 k'een syamnub'al nab'a oro yik syal yil-lan sb'a k'apak chab' jenhan chi' yik wach' junxonhej tz'ajkan k'apak.
Ix b'oxi uxluche' jenhan xil nok' chiwa, yik a tz'och t'a yib'anh skajnub' Dios.
Ay 13 metro steel yet' nanhalxo yet' chab' metro sat. Lajannhej ix aj yechel smasanil.
Ix tz'ischaj yam sb'a oye' jenhan yik junxonhej tz'aji. Ix tz'ischajpax syam sb'a waquexo, yik junxonhej pax jenhan tz'aji.
Ix och xoyjab' 50 syamnub'al t'a jun pak'anh sti' jun b'ab'el jenhan. Ix ochpax 50 syamnub'al t'a sti' junxo schab'il jenhan chi'.
Ix b'opax 50 syamnub' nab'a bronke, yik syil-laj sb'a chab' jenhan chi', yik junxonhej jenhan tz'aji.

Ix b'ojipax stz'umal nok' ch'ak kalnel uk'nak yet' chakchak, yik tz'em t'a yib'anh jun jenhan xil nok' chiwa chi' yet' junxo makan tz'uum te lab'ab'i yik tz'em t'a yib'anh jun jenhan stz'umal nok' ch'ak kalnel chi'.
Ix sb'opax juntzanh te' marko heb', yik tz'och t'a spatik skajnub' Dios, linhan tz'ajoch junjun te'. Masanil te', a te' akakia b'aj ix el te'.
Nanhal yoil metro steel junjun te' marko chi', haxo slewanil sat te', 70 kentímetro.
Ix kan chab'chab' yok junjun te' marko chi' yik tz'em linhan. Lajannhej ix ajkan skal yok te' chi'. Icha chi' ix aj te' marko chi' smasanil tz'och t'a spatik skajnub' Dios chi'.
Ay 20 te' ix sb'o heb' yik tz'och t'a stojolal sur.
Ix b'oji 40 k'een plata sb'akhnub'ok yich te' 20 chi' yuj heb', chab'chab' k'een t'a yich junjun te', junjun k'een t'a junjun yok te'.
Anhejtona' ix b'oji 20-xo te' marko chi' yik tz'och t'a jun pak'anhxo, aton t'a stojolal norte.
Anheja' 40 k'een plata ix b'o sb'akhnub'ok yich te', yik chab'chab' k'een tz'och t'a yich junjun te'.
Axo yik jun pak'anh yol schiquin t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, waque' te' marko chi' ix b'oji.
Ix sb'opax chab' te' marko chi' heb' yik tz'och te' t'a junjun yesquinail jun pak'anh chi'.
Ha chab' te' marko chi', nub'ub'i ix aj te', t'a yich masanto sk'ek'och b'aj syil-laj sb'a yuj junok argolla, aton te' chi' ix och t'a chab' yesquinail.
Vajxaque' te' marko ix b'oi yik tz'och t'a jun schiquin chi' yet' 16 sb'akhnub'al yich nab'a plata, chab'chab' sb'akhnub'al yich junjun te'.
Ix sb'oanpax oye' te' regla heb' t'a te' akakia, te' tz'och t'a spatik te' marko t'a junok pak'anh kajnub' chi'.
Oye' pax te' yik tz'och t'a junxo pak'anh yet' oye' pax te' yik tz'och t'a junxo pak'anh t'a yol schiquin t'a spatik, t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u.
Ha te' regla tz'och chi', ha t'a snanhal te' marko chi' tzek' junok te' masanto sk'axpajek'k'och te' t'a junxo schiquin.
Ix och k'een oro t'a spatiktak te' marko chi'. Ix b'opax k'een argolla nab'a oro b'aj tzek' te' regla chi'. Ix ochpax k'een oro t'a spatiktak te' regla chi'.

Ix sb'opax jun k'apak kortina heb' yet' anh lino. Ix b'ojioch yechel querubín t'a k'apak yuj junok jelan sb'oani. Ha t'a anh ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak, anh yaxmaquinak yet' anh chak ch'al ix b'ojioch yechel querubín chi'.

Ix sb'oan chanhe' te oy heb' t'a te' akakia, ix yak'och k'een oro heb' t'a spatik te'. Ix b'opax chanhe' sb'akhnub'al yich te', nab'a plata ix aji. Ix yak'anoch k'een gancho nab'a oro heb' t'a schon te' yik sk'e lokan k'apak kortina chi'.

Ix sb'oanpax jun k'apak kortina heb' yik tz'och smakulok mantiado chi'. Ha jun k'apak kortina chi' t'a anh lino ch'al ix sb'o heb'. Yed' anh ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak, anh ch'al yaxmaquinak yet' anh chak ch'al, ix b'ochajoch stz'ib'ul yuj junok jelan sb'oani.
Ix b'ojipax oye' te' oy, ix em k'een oro t'a schon te' yet' pax sganchoal. Ix b'opax oye' sb'akhnub'al yich te', nab'a bronke ix aji.
Ix sb'oan te' skaxail strato Dios winhaj Bezaleel. Ha te' akakia ix och t'ay. Jun metro yet' 10 kentímetro ix aj sk'atul, 70 kentímetro ix aj sat. Anheja' 70 kentímetro ix ajpax schaanhil.
Ix och k'een oro t'a yool yet' t'a spatik yet' t'a stitak tzalank'ei.
Ix b'opax chanhe' argolla nab'a oro tz'och t'a yok schanhil, chab'chab' t'a junjun pak'anh.
Ix b'opax juntzanh te sb'akhlab'il t'a te' akakia, ix ochpax k'een oro t'a spatiktak te'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix ekchajek' te' t'a yol k'een argolla chi', yik wach' syal sb'akhchaj te'.
Ix b'opax jun smakul nab'a oro b'aj tz'ak'ji tup mul, jun metro yet' 10 kentímetro sk'atul, 70 kentímetro sat.
Ay chab' yechel querubín nab'a oro tenb'il t'a k'een martillo ix och t'a yib'anh jun smakul chi'.
Junnhej ix aj jun smakul chi' yet' chab' yechel querubín chi', junjun ix kan t'a stitak jun smakul chi',
t'anhd'umb'a ix aji. Ix em k'elan juntzanh querubín chi' t'a yib'anh smakul te' skaxail trato chi', haxo sk'axil, syil-laj sb'a snhi' t'a yib'anh, ichato yenhul yaji.
Ix sb'opax jun te' mexa winhaj Bezaleel chi'. Anheja' te' akakia ix och t'a te'. 90 kentímetro ix aj sk'atul, 45 kentímetro ix aj sat, 70 ix ajk'e steel.
Ix och k'een oro t'a te', ix b'opax jun tzek' oyan t'a spatik yok te' schanhil, nab'a oro ix aji.
Ix b'opax k'e stitak ix ek' oyan t'a yib'anh, uque' kentímetro ix ajk'ei, ix och oro t'ay.
Ix b'opax chanhe' argolla nab'a oro, ix och t'a te' yok schanhil t'a yesquinail.
Ix och juntzanh argolla chi' t'a slak'anil b'aj ayem stitak chi'. Ha t'a yol juntzanh chi' ix ek' te' sb'akhlab'il yik syal yik'chajb'at te' mexa chi'.
Ha te' sb'akhlab'il chi', aton te' akakia, ix ochpax k'een oro t'a spatiktak te'.
Ix b'ochajpax syamk'ab'il nab'a oro sk'anchaj t'a jun mexa chi', aton juntzanh tik: Q'uen plato, niwak kuchara, xalu yet' uk'ab' b'aj schaji ofrenda ha' yaji.
Ix sb'opax jun sb'akhnub' kandil winhaj Bezaleel chi', nab'a oro ix aji, ix tenchaj t'a k'een martillo. Ha sk'ojnub' b'aj tz'em b'akhan, ste'al yet' skopail icha sfloral, junnhej yaman ix aji.
Oxox sk'ab' ix elta t'a stz'eytak.
Junjun juntzanh sk'ab' ayelta t'a ste'al chi', ay oxe' sfloral icha yik te' almendro.
Ha jun ste'al chi', ay pax chanhe' sfloral icha yik te' almendro chi'.
Ha t'a yalanh b'aj ayelta chab'chab' sk'ab' chi', ay junjun sfloral.
Ha juntzanh sfloral yet' sk'ab' chi', junnhej ix aj yet' sb'akhnub'al chi'. Ha jun chi', nab'a oro ix aji, tenb'il t'a k'een martillo.
Ix b'opax uque' kandil, anhejtona' ix b'opax k'een k'een tz'ik'anel stanhil k'apak b'aj tz'och sk'ak'al yet' splatoal. Nab'a oro ix aj smasanil.
Ha jantak k'een oro ix och t'a jun b'akhnub' kandil chi' yet' syamk'ab'il, oxe' arroba ix ochi.

Ix sb'oanpax jun altar yik inkienso winhaj Bezaleel chi' t'a te' akakia. Lajannhej ix aj t'a schanhil pak'anh, 45 kentímetro ix aji, haxo pax steel, 90 kentímetro ix ajk'ei. Ix b'opax juntzanh sch'aak t'a junjun yesquinail, yaman ix aj yet' jun altar chi'.
Ix och k'een oro yelxo wal wach' t'a yib'anh yet' t'a spatiktak schanhil pak'anh yet' t'a sch'aak chi'. Ix k'epax tzalan k'een oro chi' t'a yib'anh stitak.
Ha t'a yalanh stitak chi', ata' ix och chab'chab' argolla nab'a oro t'a schab'il pak'anh. Ix ek' te' sb'akhlab'il t'a yool yik syal sb'akhchaji.
Ha te' sb'akhlab'il ix och chi', aton te' akakia, ix ochpax k'een oro t'a te'.
Ix b'ojipax akeite sk'anchaji yik sik'chajel junok mach, ma junok tas tz'ochkan yikok Dios. Ix b'opax inkienso te wach', icha tz'aj sb'oan heb' b'oum perfume.

Ix sb'oanpax jun altar winhaj Bezaleel chi', aton jun b'aj stz'a silab'. D'a te' akakia ix sb'o winh. Lajannhej ix aj yechel schanhil pak'anh, chab' metro yet' 25 kentímetro junjun pak'anh. Jun metro yet' 25 kentímetro ix ajk'e schaanhil.
Ix b'ojipaxk'e chanhe' sch'aak t'a schiquintak schanhil, yaman ix aj yet' jun altar chi'. Ix pichchaj te' t'a k'een bronke.
Masanil syamk'ab'il jun altar chi', nab'a bronke ix aji: Aton yet'tal b'aj tz'ik'chajel k'een taanh, k'een pala, k'een niwak uk'ab', k'een tenedor yet' yet'tal te' tzak'ak'.
Ix b'ojipax jun k'een malla nab'a bronke, ix ak'jioch k'een t'a yalanh sti' t'a yool. D'a snanhal jun altar chi' ix och k'een.
Ix b'opax chanhe' argolla nab'a bronke, ix och t'a junjun yesquinail k'een malla chi'. Ix elk'och k'een t'a spatik jun altar chi', ha t'a yol k'een tzek' te' sb'akhlab'il.
Ix b'opax sb'akhlab'il jun altar chi' t'a te' akakia, ix ochpax k'een bronke t'a spatiktak te'.
Ix ekchajek' te' t'a yol k'een argolla ayoch t'a stz'eytak jun altar chi' yik syal sb'akhchaji. Ha jun altar chi', chemte' ix och t'ay, ix kan yolanil t'a yool.
Ha yet' k'een nen nab'a bronke sk'an heb' ix ix ayoch yilumalok sti' k'apak mantiado, a yet' k'een ix sb'o jun niwan palangana winhaj Bezaleel yet' sb'akhnub'al yich.
Ix sb'opax k'apak kortina winhaj Bezaleel yik tz'och smakulok spatiktak amak' t'a skajnub' Dios. Ha t'a stojolal sur, ix och 45 metro k'apak kortina chi', aton ch'al lino b'ayb'il ayoch t'a k'apak.
Ix b'opax 20 yoyal yet' 20 pax sb'akhnub'al yich nab'a bronke. Axo t'a schon te' ix em juntzanh k'een k'een nab'a plata yet' yargollail.
Ix b'opax k'apak kortina yik stojolal norte, 45 metro k'apak yet' 20 oy yet' pax sb'akhnub'al yich nab'a bronke yet' k'een ayem t'a schon yoyal nab'a plata yet' yargollail.
Ix b'opax k'apak kortina yik stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, 22 metro yet' nanhalxo sat k'apak yet' lajunhe' yoyal yet' pax sb'akhnub'al yich yet' k'een ayem t'a schon yoyal nab'a plata yet' yargollail.
Anhejtona' t'a stojolal b'aj sk'eul k'u, 22 metro yet' nanhalxo sat, ix b'opax k'apak kortina yik tz'och t'ay.
Ha t'a jun pak'anh b'aj tzonh ochi, ay uque' metro k'apak kortina ayochi yet' oxe' yoyal yet' pax sb'akhnub'al yich.
Axo pax t'a junxo pak'anh, ay pax uque' metro k'apak yet' oxe' yoyal yet' pax sb'akhnub'al yich.
Masanil juntzanh k'apak kortina chi', ch'al lino b'ayb'il ayoch t'a k'apak.
Masanil pax sb'akhnub'al yich oy chi', nab'a bronke ix aji. Axo k'een ayem t'a schon oy chi' nab'a plata yet' yargollail.

Ha k'apak kortina ix och smakulok sti' amak' chi', nanhal sb'alunhil metro sat k'apak, haxo steel k'apak, chab' metro yet' 25 kentímetro. B'ob'ilpaxoch yelwanub' k'apak, jalb'il t'a anh ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak, anh ch'al yaxmaquinak, anh chak ch'al yet' pax lino ch'al b'ayb'il. Lajannhej yet' masanil k'apak ayoch t'a amak'.
Ay chanhe' yoyal yet' chanhe' sb'akhnub'al yich nab'a bronke, haxo k'een ayem t'a schon yoyal, nab'a plata yet' yargollail.
Masanil yestakail skajnub' Dios chi' yet' yik k'apak kortina ayoch t'a spatiktak amak', nab'a bronke.

Ix yalanxi winhaj Moisés chi' to sb'o slistail jantak k'een oro, k'een plata yet' k'een bronke ix och t'a skajnub' Jehová, aton b'aj sik'chaj skaxail trato. Ha heb' lewita ixb’o’an slistail chi'. Ha winhaj Itamar yuninal winhaj Aarón ix kuchb'an heb'.
Ha winhaj Bezaleel, yuninal winhaj Uri, yixchiquin winhaj Hur, yinhtilal Judá ixb’o’an masanil tastak ix yal Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés to sb'oi.

Axo winhaj Aholiab yuninal winhaj Ahisamac, yinhtilal Dan ix kolwaj yet' winhaj Bezaleel chi'. Ha winhaj Aholiab chi' tenum k'een winh, jalum k'apak winh, syalpax sb'oanoch yelwanub' yet' anh ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak winh, anh ch'al yaxmaquinak, anh chak ch'al yet' anh lino ch'al te wach'.
Masanil k'een oro ix k'anchaji yik ix b'o skajnub' Dios, t'a ofrendail ix aj smoljiem k'een. Ha k'een oro chi', 21 quintal yet' 95 libraxo k'een, icha yalil k'een echlab' sk'anchaj t'a skajnub' Dios.
Axo k'een plata ix molchajemi, a ix ik'chajk'e waan sb'isul heb' anima, 75 quintal yet' chab'xo arroba k'een, icha yalil k'een echlab' sk'anchaj t'a skajnub' Dios.
Masanil heb' winak ix tz'ib'chaji, heb' 20 ab'ilxo sk'inal, 603 mil yet' 550 heb' t'a smasanil. Junjun heb' chi' nanhal siklo plata ix yak' heb', icha yalil k'een echlab' sk'anchaj t'a skajnub' Dios.

Ha k'een plata ix och t'a sb'akhnub'al yich smarkoal yet' sb'akhnub'ok yoyal b'aj tz'och k'apak kortina, 75 quintal k'een t'a smasanil. Masanil juntzanh k'een plata chi' ix och t'a kien sb'akhnub'al chi', syalelk'ochi 75 libra ix och t'a junjun.
Ha yet' chab'xo arroba plata chi' ix sb'o k'een gancho winhaj Bezaleel ix och t'a te' oy yet' smakul sjolom oy chi' yet' k'een argolla.
Masanil k'een bronke ix ak'chaj ofrendail t'a Jehová, ay am 53 quintal yet' lajunhexo libra k'een.

Ha t'a k'een bronke chi' ix b'o sb'akhnub'al yich yoyal b'aj ix kan sti' mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'ha Dios. Anhejtona' t'a k'een ix b'o jun altar nab'a bronke yet' pax smallail. Nab'a bronke smasanil syamk'ab'il jun altar chi',
yet' pax sb'akhnub'al yich yoyal smakul spatiktak amak' yet' yestakail oyanoch t'a skajnub' Dios yet' yestakail spatiktak yamaq'uil kajnub' chi'.

Ha spichul heb' winh sakerdote sk'an t'a yopisio t'a skajnub' Dios, jalb'il t'a lana ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak, t'a ch'al yaxmaquinak yet' t'a chak ch'al. Ix b'opax spichul winhaj Aarón yiknhej yopisio yaji, icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés.
Ayic ix b'o schaleka winhaj Aarón chi', ix och oro ch'al t'ay, lana ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak, yaxmaquinak, chakchak yet' anh lino ch'al b'ayb'il.
Ix sten k'een oro heb', te jay ix aji. Ixlajwi chi' ix skotak polan k'een heb', icha anh ch'al ix aj k'een yik syal sjalanb'at heb' t'a skal juntzanhxo ch'al chi', aton sb'oji yuj heb' wach' sb'oani.
Ix sb'oan k'apak tzek' b'ak'an heb' t'a sjolom sjenhjab' jun chaleka chi', yik schalaj sb'a k'apak yichanh yet' k'apak spatik.

Ix sb'oanoch jun tzek'ul heb' t'a jun chaleka chi', anhejpaxa' ix och oro ch'al t'ay, lana ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak, yaxmaquinak yet' chakchak yet' pax anh lino ch'al b'ayb'il, icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés.
Ix yak'anoch k'een kornalina heb' t'a syamnub'al nab'a oro. Ayoch sb'i heb' yuninal winhaj Israel t'a k'een, icha yajoch sletrail junok sello.
Ix yak'anoch k'een winhaj Bezaleel t'a sjolom sjenhjab' jun chaleka chi', yik snajikot heb' yuninal winhaj Israel chi', icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés.

Axo pax k'apak smakul snhi' sk'ol winh, ix b'ojioch stz'ib'ul yuj junok jelan sb'oani, icha yik k'apak chaleka: Ayoch oro ch'al t'ay yet' lana ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak, yaxmaquinak, chakchak yet' pax lino ch'al b'ayb'il.
Cha pakanh ix aji, lajannhej ix aj stitak schanhil ayik pakb'ilxo. 22 kentímetro junjun stitak chi'.
Ha jun chi', chanh tzol ix aj yoch k'een k'een te wach' yilji t'ay. Ha t'a jun b'ab'el tzol, ayoch k'een rubí, k'een krisólito yet' k'een esmeralda.
Axo t'a schab'il tzol, ayoch k'een granate, k'een zafiro yet' k'een jade.
Axo t'a yoxil tzol, ayoch k'een jakinto, k'een ágata yet' k'een amatista.
Axo t'a schanhil tzol, ayoch k'een topakio, k'een kornalina yet' k'een jaspe. Axo k'een oro ayoch syamlab'ilok juntzanh k'een chi'.
Lajchawe' k'een, aton lajchawe' sb'i heb' yuninal winhaj Israel. Junjun sb'i heb' lajchawanh chi' ayoch t'a k'een, icha yajoch sletrail junok sello.
Ha t'a k'apak smakul snhi' sk'ol chi' ix b'ojioch juntzanh kadena nab'a oro pach'uch'ab'il.
Ix b'ojipax chab' syamlab'il t'a k'een oro yet' chab' argolla nab'a oro. Ix och chab' argolla chi' t'a chab' schiquin k'apak smakul snhi' sk'ol chi' t'a yib'anh.
Ix ochpax chab' kadena oro t'a chab' argolla chi'.
Ha snhi' chab' kadena chi' ix och t'a chab' syamlab'il nab'a oro, ix och t'a chab' sjolom sjenhjab' k'apak chaleka t'a yichanh.
Ix b'opax chab'xo argolla nab'a oro, ix och t'a yol chab' schiquin k'apak smakul snhi' sk'ol chi' t'a yalanh, junnhej ix aj yet' k'apak chaleka.

Ix b'oji chab'xo argolla nab'a oro, ix och t'a snhitak k'apak tzek' t'a sjolom sjenhjab' k'apak chaleka, tz'emk'och t'a yichanh. Junnhej ix kan yet' b'aj tz'emk'och stz'isul yet' t'a yib'anhk'eta b'aj tzek' stzek'ul k'apak chaleka chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', junxonhej ix ajem k'een argolla ayoch t'a k'apak yet' k'een ayoch t'a k'apak smakul snhi' sk'ol chi'. Ix tzek'chaj syam sb'a k'een t'a lana ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak, yik wach' a k'apak smakul snhi' sk'ol chi' skan t'a yib'anhk'e jun tzek'ul ayoch t'a k'apak chaleka chi', yik wach' max yaktej sb'a k'apak. Ix b'o icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés.
Ha jun k'apak pichul jukan ayoch t'a yol k'apak chaleka chi', ix jalchaj b'o k'apak yet' ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak.
Ix kan yolanil sjaj k'apak t'a snanhal, ix och stz'ulil sti' t'a sjaj chi' yik max nhik'chaji.
Ix och yelwanub' k'apak t'a stitak t'a yoktak, icha yechel sat te' granado, ix b'oji yet' lana ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak, yaxmaquinak, chakchak yet' pax lino ch'al b'ayb'il.
Ix b'ochajpax yunetak kampana, nab'a oro ix aji. Ix och t'a skal yechel sat te' granado ayoch t'a yoktak k'apak pichul chi',

syalelk'ochi, jun yechel sat te' granado chi', jun yune' kampana, t'a stzolal ix ajochi, icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés. Aton k'apak pichul jukan chi' sk'an winhaj Aarón ayik tz'och winh t'a yopisio.
Ha k'apak spichul winhaj Aarón yelxo wal te jukan k'apak yet' k'apak yik heb' yuninal winh, nab'a lino ch'al jalb'il yuj junok jalum k'apak, a ix och t'ay.
Anheja' ix b'ojipax k'apak k'ox sb'ak'chaji yet' pax juntzanhxo sk'oxal yet' k'apak yolwex. Lino ch'al b'ayb'il ix och t'a juntzanh chi' smasanil.

Anheja' t'a jun tzek'ul, lino ch'al b'ayb'il ix och t'ay, ix b'ojioch yelwanub' yuj junok jelan sb'oani. D'a anh lana ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak, yaxmaquinak yet' chakchak ix b'ojioch yelwanub' chi', icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés.
Ix sb'oanpax jun yelwanub' nab'a oro heb', sch'oxnab'il yopisio t'a sat sakerdoteal, ix och juntzanh lolonel tik t'ay icha sello: Yicnhej Jehová yaji, xchi.
Ixlajwi chi', ix och jun lana ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak t'ay, yik syal stzek'jioch jun yelwanub' chi' t'a snanhal sat k'apak k'ox sb'ak'chajochi, icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés.
Icha chi' ix aj sb'ochajk'e skajnub' Dios b'aj sch'ox sb'a. Icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi', icha wal chi' ix aj sb'oan heb' israel chi'.
Masanil syamk'ab'il skajnub' Dios ix yik'kot heb' t'a winhaj Moisés chi', aton tik: Syamnub'al, smarkoal, sreglail, yoyal yet' pax sb'akhlab'il yich.
k'apak k'apak tz'och t'a yib'anh, nok' tz'umal kalnel uk'nak t'a chakchak, nok' tz'uum te lab'ab'i yet' pax jun k'apak kortina tz'och smakulok te' skaxail trato.
Ix yik'anpaxkot te' kaxa chi' heb' yet' te' regla tz'och sb'akhlab'ilok yet' smakul b'aj tz'ak'ji tup mul,
te' mexa yet' syamk'ab'il yet' ixim pan tz'och t'a yichanh Jehová.
Ix yik'anpaxkot jun sb'akhnub' kandil nab'a oro heb' yet' pax kandil ayoch t'a yib'anh t'a stzolal yet' masanil syamk'ab'il yet' akeite yik tz'och sk'ak'al kandil chi'.

Ix yik'anpaxkot jun altar nab'a oro heb' yet' pax akeite sk'anchaji ayik sik'chajel junok mach, ma junok tas tz'ochkan yikok Dios yet' inkienso suk'uq'ui sjab', jun k'apak kortina yik smakul sti' mantiado,
jun altar bronke yet' smallail to bronke paxi, sreglail tz'och sb'akhlab'ilok, syamk'ab'il, jun palangana yet' pax sb'akhnub' yich.

Ix yik'anpaxkot k'apak kortina heb', aton k'apak tz'och t'a spatiktak amak' yet' yoyal yet' pax sb'akhnub' yich, k'apak kortina tz'och t'a sti' amak' yet' pax sch'anhal, yestakail t'a spatiktak amak' chi' yet' masanil yamk'ab' sk'anchaj t'a skajnub' Jehová b'aj sch'ox sb'a.

Ix yik'anpaxkot k'apak pichul heb', aton k'apak sk'an heb' sakerdote t'a yopisio t'a yol skajnub' Dios, aton pichul yik yopisio winhaj sakerdote Aarón yet' spichul heb' yuninal winh syak'och t'a yopisio chi'.
Masanil ix sb'o heb' israel icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés.
Ayic ix yilan winhaj Moisés chi' to icha chi' ix aj sb'oel yuj heb', ix yalan wach' lolonel winh t'a yib'anh heb'.
Ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés, ix yalan t'a winh icha tik:
D'a b'ab'el k'ual yik b'ab'el uj, ata' sb'ok'e in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a.
Slajwi chi', tz'ak'chajoch te' skaxail trato t'a yool chi', tz'ak'chajoch k'apak kortina smakulok.
Tz'ak'chajpaxoch te' mexa yet' tas tz'em t'a yib'anh yet' sb'akhnub' kandil, tz'ochpax sk'ak'al kandil chi'.
Ha t'a yichanh skaxail trato tz'och altar oro b'aj stz'a inkienso, slokb'ajk'e k'apak kortina t'a sti' mantiado chi'.
Sb'ochajpaxem jun altar b'aj stz'a silab' t'a yichanhelta sti' mantiado chi'.
Tz'ak'chajem jun niwan palangana t'a skal mantiado yet' altar, tz'ak'ji b'ud'jok yet' ha ha'.
Slajwi chi', sb'ochajoch k'apak kortina smakulok spatiktak yamaq'uil, haxo k'apak tz'och t'a sti' yamaq'uil chi' sk'epax lokan k'apak.

Tzik'ankot akeite sk'anchaji a sik'chajel junok mach, ma junok tas. Tza sekanem t'a yib'anh in kajnub' yet' t'a masanil tastak ayoch t'a yool. Icha chi' tz'aj yochkan masanil syamk'ab'il t'a yopisio, yik wach' wikxo tz'ajkani.
Tza sekanpaxem akeite chi' t'a yib'anh altar b'aj stz'a silab' yet' masanil syamk'ab'il. Icha chi' tz'aj yochkan t'a yopisio, yuj chi' a jun altar chi' wikxo tz'ajkani.
Tza sekanpaxem akeite chi' t'a yib'anh jun niwan palangana yet' sb'akhnub'al yich yik wach' wikxo tz'ajkani.
Slajwi chi', tzik'anb'at winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal t'a sti' mantiado chi', tza chekan sb'ik sb'a heb' ta'.
Slajwi chi', tzak'anoch spichul winhaj Aarón chi' yik yopisio. Tzak'anoch akeite t'a winh yik tz'ochkan yopisio winh t'a sakerdoteal t'ayin.
Sjapax heb' yuninal winh chi' t'a a tz'ey, tzak'anoch spichul heb'.

Tzak'anpaxoch akeite t'a heb' icha tzutej winhaj Aarón chi', yik wach' tz'ochkan heb' sakerdoteal t'ayin. Tz'ak'jioch akeite chi' t'a heb' yik skan jun opisio chi' t'a yol sk'ab' heb', ol b'eynhejb'at t'a yinhtilal heb' t'a masanil tiempo, xchi Jehová.
Icha ix aj yalan Jehová, icha wal chi' ix aj sb'oan winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ayic ix schaanel yich yik schab'il ab'il yelta heb' t'a Egipto, t'a wal sb'ab'el k'ual yik b'ab'el uj ix b'ojik'e skajnub' Dios.
Ix yalan winhaj Moisés chi' to tz'ak'jiem k'een sb'akhnub'al yich, ix ak'jiem te' marko t'a yib'anh k'een, ix ak'jipaxoch sreglail, ix ik'jik'e waan te' oy t'a yib'anh sb'akhnub'al ayxoem chi'.
Ix ak'jib'at jenhan k'apak mantiado t'a yib'anh skajnub' Dios chi', ix ak'jib'at juntzanhxo t'a yib'anh mantiado icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.

Ixlajwi chi, ix yak'anem chab' pachanh k'een k'een winhaj Moisés chi' t'a yol skaxail trato, aton k'een b'aj tz'ib'ab'iloch lajunhe' cheknab'il. Ix yak'anoch te' sb'akhlab'il te' kaxa chi' winh, ix yak'anpaxem smakul te' winh, aton b'aj tz'ak'ji tup mul.
Ixlajwi chi', ix ik'jib'at te' t'a yol skajnub' Dios, ix ak'jioch k'apak kortina t'a snanhal yol skajnub' chi', yik tz'och smakulok te' kaxa chi', icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winh.
Ix ak'jipaxoch te' mexa t'a ko wach' t'a yol mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'ha Dios.
Wach' ix aj yak'jiem ixim pan t'a sat te' mexa t'a yichanh Jehová, icha ix aj yalan t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix ak'jipaxoch k'een sb'akhnub' kandil t'a ko k'exanh t'a yichanh mexa t'a yol mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'ha Dios.
Ix ak'jioch sk'ak'al kandil t'a yichanh Jehová, icha ix aj yalan t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix ak'jipaxoch altar oro t'a yichanhelta k'apak kortina chi'.
Ix snhusantz'a inkienso winhaj Moisés chi' t'a yib'anh altar chi', icha ix aj yalan Jehová.
Ixlajwi chi', ix ak'chajoch k'apak kortina smakulok b'aj tz'och heb' sakerdote t'a yol kajnub' chi'.
Ix ak'chajem altar b'aj snhusjitz'a silab' t'a yichanhelta sti' mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová. Ixlajwi chi' ix snhusantz'a nok' silab' winhaj Moisés chi' yet' ixim harina icha ix aj yalan Jehová.
Ix ak'jioch k'een niwan palangana t'a skal mantiado yet' altar. Ix ak'ji b'ud'jok k'een t'a ha ha' yik sb'ik sk'ab' heb' yet' yok.
Ha t'a ha ha' chi' ix sb'ik sk'ab' winhaj Moisés chi' yet' yok. Anheja' pax winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal sb'ik sk'ab' heb' yet' yok,
ayik tz'och heb' t'a yol mantiado. Sb'ikpax sk'ab' heb' yet' yok chi' ayik tz'och heb' t'a altar, icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.

D'a slajwub'alxo ix b'ochajoch yamaq'uil spatik yichanh skajnub' Dios yet' altar. Ixlajwi chi' ix ak'chajoch k'apak k'apak smakulok t'a sti' amak' chi'. Icha wal chi' ix aj sb'okanel masanil tas ix alchaj t'a winhaj Moisés chi' yuj Jehová.
Ayic ix lajwi sb'oel smasanil, ix emul asun t'a yib'anh mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová, ix em stziquiquial t'a yib'anh skajnub' chi' yet' t'a yool.
Yuj chi' maj yal-laj yoch winhaj Moisés t'a yool chi', yujto ayek' jun asun chi' t'a yib'anh, makb'il yool chi' yuj stziquiquial Jehová.
Ayic sk'e waan asun chi' t'a yib'anh skajnub' Jehová chi' syik'ank'e waan smantiado heb' israel, sb'eyb'at heb'.
Tato max k'e waan asun chi' jun, max yik'k'elaj waan skampamento heb', ato sk'e waan ichato chi' sb'at heb'.
Yalnhej b'ajtil ayek' heb' israel t'a yol b'e, syil wal jun asun chi' heb' t'a yib'anh skajnub' Jehová t'a k'ualil, haxo t'ak'walil ayoch sk'ak'al asun chi' syil heb'.
Ix awtaj winhaj Moisés yuj Jehová t'a yol mantiado, ix schekan yal juntzanh cheknab'il winh t'a heb' yetisraelal.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: Tato ay junok ex tzeyik'kot junok nok' nok' yik snhuschajtz'a smasanil silab'il t'a Jehová, ha t'a skal nok' he wakax, t'a skal nok' he kalnel ma t'a skal nok' he chiwa, ata' tzeyik'kot nok'.

Tato wakax nok' tze nhustz'a silab'il chi', yowalil a junok nok' toro malaj spaltail tzeyik'koti. Ha jun silab' stz'ai, a jun chi' to stz'ab'at nok' nok' chi' smasanil. Ha t'a yichanh mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová, ata' tzeyak'och silab' chi' yik wach' schaji yuj Jehová.
Yowalil tzeyak'k'e he k'ab' t'a sjolom nok', yik schaji nok' yuj yak'ji lajwok he mul.

Ha mach ay yik nok' chi', a smilancham nok' t'a yichanh Jehová, haxo heb' sakerdote yuninal winhaj Aarón tz'ik'ankot schiq'uil nok', stzikanoch heb' t'a schanhil pak'anh jun altar ayek' t'a yichanh mantiado.
Anheja' winh ay yik nok' chi' spatz'anel nok', schok' xikanb'at nok' winh.
Axo heb' sakerdote yuninal winhaj Aarón chi', syak'k'e te' k'atzitz heb' t'a yib'anh te' tzak'ak' t'a altar chi' yik sk'e sk'ak'al.
Tz'ak'jik'e nok' chib'ej kotak xikab'il chi' t'a yib'anh te' k'atzitz chi' yet' nok' sjolom yet' nok' xepu' tz'ik'jiel t'a nok' yol sk'ool.

Ha mach tz'ak'an nok' silab' chi', yowalil a smaxan nok' yol sk'ool, sb'ikanel nok' yok, haxo winh sakerdote snhusantz'a jun silab' chi' smasanil t'a yib'anh altar. Suk'uq'ui sjab' jun silab' stz'a chi' syab' Jehová.
Tato kalnel, ma chiwa nok' tzeyak' silab'il chi', yowalil ch'aak nok', malajokab' jab'ok spaltail nok'.

Ha t'a stojolal norte t'a jun altar chi', ata' smiljicham nok' yuj mach tz'ak'an nok' chi' t'a yichanh Jehová. Axo heb' yuninal winhaj Aarón chi' stzikanoch schiq'uil nok' t'a schanhil pak'anh jun altar chi'.
Slajwi chi' slaj kotak xikajb'at nok', haxo winh sakerdote tz'ak'ank'e nok' kotak xikab'ilxo yaj chi' t'a yib'anh k'ak' t'a yib'anh altar yet' nok' sjolom yet' nok' xepu' tz'el t'a nok' yol sk'ool.

Axo jun mach tz'ak'an nok' silab' chi', yowalil a smaxan nok' yol sk'ool, sb'ikanpaxel nok' yok, haxo winh sakerdote snhusantz'a smasanil t'a yib'anh altar. Suk'uq'ui sjab' jun silab' stz'a chi' syab' Jehová.
Tato much nok' silab' snhusjitz'a smasanil t'a yichanh Jehová, yowalil a junok nok' paramuch yalnhej tas makanhil.
Ha winh sakerdote tz'ik'ankot nok' silab' chi' t'a altar, stok'anel sjolom nok' winh, snhusjitz'a nok'. Axo schiq'uil nok', stzikoch winh t'a spak'ul altar.
Tz'ik'jielta masanil yooch nok' yet' tas ay t'a yool, syumjikanb'at t'a stz'eyb'at altar t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, aton b'aj smolchaj k'een tik'aq'uil taanh.

Slajwi chi' syamji sk'axil nok' yik sjekchitanb'at jab'ok nok' winh, palta max chab'axlaj snanhal nok', snhusantz'a nok' winh sakerdote t'a yib'anh te' k'atzitz ayk'e t'a yib'anh altar chi'. Suk'uq'ui sjab' jun silab' stz'a chi' syab' Jehová.
Tato ay junok ex tzeyik'kot ixim harina ofrendail t'a Jehová, a wal ixim harina te wach' tzeyik'koti. Ha t'a yib'anh ixim chi' tzeyak'em akeite yet' inkienso,

tzeyik'ankot t'a heb' sakerdote yinhtilal winhaj Aarón. Ha junok heb' sakerdote ayoch t'a yopisio tz'ik'ank'e junok b'echanh ixim harina yet' akeite yet' pax masanil inkienso. Slajwi chi' snhusjitz'a jun silab' chi' t'a yib'anh altar, yuj sch'oxchaji to ha' silab' chi' yik Jehová yaji. Suk'uq'ui sjab' jun ofrenda chi' syab' Jehová.
Axo jab'okxo jun ofrenda chi' yikxo heb' winh sakerdote yaji. Niwan yelk'ochi, yujto yetb'eyum sb'a yet' jun silab' snhusjitz'ha t'a yichanh Jehová.

Ha tz'ak'ji junok ofrenda k'anb'inak t'a yol horno, aokab' ixim harina te wach', malaj yich sb'at t'a skal. Syal pim tz'aj sb'oji, skalaj yet' akeite, syalpax yoch t'a k'oxoxal to malaj yich, sukchajek' akeite t'ay.
Tato a jun ofrenda chi' mayb'il t'a yol xalten, aokab' ixim harina yelxo wal te wach', kalab'il yet' akeite, palta mokab'a yich ayb'ati.
Scotac xepchitaji, slajwi chi' tz'och akeite t'ay, yujto ofrenda t'a tas swaji.
Tato tzeyak' junok ofrenda tajinak t'a skal akeite, aokab' yet' ixim harina te wach', kalab'il yet' akeite tzeyak'a'.
Ayic toxo ix b'oel jun ofrenda chi', tzeyik'ankot t'a Jehová, tzeyak'an t'a winh sakerdote, haxo winh tz'ik'anb'at t'a altar.
Ata' snhustz'a jab'ok jun ofrenda chi' winh yik ch'oxnab'il to a ofrenda chi' yik Jehová yaji. Suk'uq'ui sjab' jun silab' chi' syab' Jehová.
Axo jab'okxo jun ofrenda chi', yik heb' sakerdote tz'ajkani. Niwan yelk'ochi, yujto yetb'eyum sb'a yet' juntzanh ofrenda snhusjitz'ha t'a yichanh Jehová.
Masanil juntzanh ofrenda tzeyak' t'a Jehová t'a tastak swaji, malajokab' yich ayb'at t'a skal. Max yal-laj snhusjitz'a tas silab'il t'a yichanh Jehová tato ayb'at yich pan, ma nok' yalchab' t'a skal.

Syal eyak'an ixim pan ayb'at yich t'a skal yet' tas ayb'at nok' yalchab' t'a skal t'a ofrendail a tz'ak'ji b'ab'el sat awb'en, palta max nhusjitz'alaj t'a yib'anh altar silab'il b'aj stz'a silab' suk'uq'ui sjab' syab' Jehová.

Masanil ofrenda tzeyak' t'a tas swaji, yowalil sb'at yatz'amil, malaj junok ofrenda chi' to max b'at yatz'amil, yujto a atz'am atz'am chi' sch'oxanel ko trato yet' ko Diosal. Yuj chi' masanil ofrenda tzeyak' t'a tas swaji chi', aynhejokab'och yatz'amil.
Tato tzeyak' junok ofrenda t'a Jehová t'a sb'ab'el sat eyawb'en, yowalil a jayeok jolom trigo sk'anb'i t'a skal k'ak', yaxto wal swuchchajeli.
Ha t'a yib'anh jun ofrenda chi', tzeyak'och akeite yet' inkienso, yujto a ofrenda chi' a ixim trigo, ma ixim kebada.
Ha junok winh sakerdote snhusantz'a jab'ok ixim wuchb'ilel chi' yet' akeite yet' pax masanil inkienso. Ha jab'ok chi' sch'oxani to a ofrenda chi' yik Jehová yaji.

Tato ay junok ex tzeyak' junok snun he wakax, ma junok nok' toro silab'ok yik tze ch'oxani to ay he junk'olal yet' Jehová, yowalil tzeyik'kot nok' t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha jun nok' nok' chi' yowalil malaj jab'ok spaltail nok'.

Ayic tzeyak'an junok ofrenda chi', tzeyik'b'at nok' t'a yichanh mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová. Ata' tzeyak'k'e he k'ab' t'a sjolom nok', slajwi chi' tze milancham nok'. Axo junok heb' winh sakerdote stzikanoch schiq'uil nok' t'a schanhil pak'anh altar.

Tato ay junok ex tzeyak' junok nok' silab' yik junk'olal, tzeyik'el junok makan t'a nok' silab' chi', yik snhusjitz'ha t'a yichanh Jehová, aton juntzanh tik tzeyik'eli: Masanil xepu' ayoch t'a nok' yol sk'ool,
chab' stut nok' yet' xepual, xepu' ayoch t'a spatiktak sb'aquil yich spatik nok' yet' xepu' ayoch t'a yib'anh seyub' nok'.
Axo junok heb' winh sakerdote snhusantz'a masanil juntzanh chi' silab'il t'a yib'anh junxo silab' wan stz'ha t'a yib'anh te' k'atzitz t'a yib'anh altar, suk'uq'ui sjab' syab' Jehová.
Tato tzeyak' junok nok' kalnel ma junok nok' chiwa t'a Jehová silab'il yik tze ch'oxan he junk'olal yet'ok, syal eyak'an nok' ch'aak ma nok' snun, anhej tato malaj jab'ok spaltail nok'.
Ayic tzeyak'an nok' kalnel chi' silab'il t'a yichanh Jehová,
tzeyak'k'e he k'ab' t'a sjolom nok'. Slajwi chi' tze milancham nok' t'a yichanh mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová. Axo junok heb' winh sakerdote stzikanoch schiq'uil nok' t'a schanhil pak'anh altar.

Ha junok mach ex tzeyak' junok nok' silab' chi', tzeyik'el junok makan t'a nok' yik snhusjitz'ha t'a yichanh Jehová, aton juntzanh tik tz'ik'jieli: Xepual snhe nok', wach' tz'aj yik'jiel smasanil yet' xepu' ayoch t'a nok' yol sk'ool,
stut nok' yet' pax xepu' ayoch t'ay, xepu' ayoch t'a yich spatik nok' yet' xepu' ayoch t'a yib'anh seyub' nok', junnhej tz'aj yik'jiel yet' nok' stut chi'.
Slajwi chi', haxo winh sakerdote snhusantz'a juntzanh chi' smasanil silab'ok t'a yichanh Jehová to icha junok wael yaji.
Tato chiwa nok' tzeyak' he silab'ok chi', tzeyik'kot nok' t'a yichanh Jehová.
Axo mach ex tzeyak' nok' chi', tzeyak'k'e he k'ab' t'a sjolom nok', tze milancham nok' t'a yichanh mantiado. Axo heb' winh sakerdote stzikanoch schiq'uil nok' t'a schanhil pak'anh altar.

Ha ex mach ex tzeyak' junok nok' silab' chi', tzeyik'el junok makan t'a nok', yik snhusjitz'ha t'a yichanh Jehová, aton juntzanh tik: Masanil xepu' ayoch t'a nok' yol sk'ool, t'a spatiktak sb'aquil yich spatik nok' yet' xepu' ayoch t'a spatik seyub' nok' yet' stut nok' schab'il yet' xepual.
Axo winh sakerdote snhusantz'a juntzanh chi' smasanil t'a yib'anh altar, icha junok wael snhusjitz'aok, suk'uq'ui sjab' syab' Jehová. Masanil xepual nok' yik Jehová yaji.
Manh he chi xepu' yet' pax schiq'uil nok'. Ha jun tik ley tz'ajkan t'ayex t'a junelnhej yet' t'a eyinhtilal, yalnhej b'ajtil ayex eq'ui, xa chi, xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' to syal juntzanh cheknab'il tik winh t'a heb' yetisraelal. Yuj chi' ix yal winh icha tik:
Tato ay mach tz'och smul, manh sk'anok sk'ool, sk'ulan tastak ay yowalil, ato ha' syal scheknab'il Jehová, yowalil sk'anab'ajej masanil juntzanh tastak ol wal tik:

Tato a winh sat sakerdote tz'och smul ayik ayoch winh t'a yopisio, a smul winh chi' tz'empax t'a yib'anh heb' chonhab', yowalil syak' junok nok' quelem wakax winh silab'ok t'a Jehová yuj smul chi'. Ha nok' wakax syak' winh chi', a nok' malaj jab'ok spaltail.
Syik'ankot nok' winh t'a yichanh mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová. Syak'ank'e sk'ab' winh t'a sjolom nok', smilancham nok' winh t'a yichanh Jehová.
Ha winh tz'ik'ankot jab'ok schiq'uil nok' syik'anoch winh t'a yol mantiado chi'.
Syak'em yiximal sk'ab' winh t'a skal schiq'uil nok' chi'. Uquel stziquem winh t'a yichanh Jehová t'a yichanhelta k'apak kortina ayoch b'aj ay lugar Anhej Jehová Ay Yico'.

Sukanoch jab'ok schiq'uil nok' chi' winh t'a sch'ak altar yik inkienso ayoch t'a yichanh Jehová t'a yol mantiado. Axo masanil chik' tzato kan chi', sekkanem winh t'a yichtak yok altar b'aj snhusjitz'a silab', aton jun ayem t'a yichanh mantiado chi'.
Slajwi chi' tz'ik'jiel masanil xepu' t'a nok' yol sk'ool,
yet' chab' stut nok' yet' xepual yet' pax masanil xepual sb'aquil yich spatik nok' yet' xepu' ayoch t'a yib'anh seyub' nok',
icha wal tz'aj yik'jiel t'a nok' wakax tz'ak'ji silab'ok yik sch'oxan junk'olal yet' Dios. Slajwi chi', snhusjitz'ha t'a yib'anh altar.
Axo nok' stz'umal, nok' sb'ak'chil, nok' sjolom, nok' xub', nok' yok, masanil nok' yol sk'ool yet' masanil sch'anhtza' nok',

syalelk'ochi masanil nok' silab' chi', tz'ik'jiel t'a junok lugar to wach' yaj t'a spatiquel kampamento, aton b'aj sekchajtaxonel k'een tik'aq'uil taanh. Ata' snhusjitz'a nok' t'a yib'anh te' k'atzitz.
Tato ko masanil a onh chonhab' israel onh tik tz'och ko mul, manh sk'anok ko k'ool, malaj pax junok onh snachajel kuuj to manh ichok yalan scheknab'il Jehová ix ko k'ulej, yuj chi' tz'och ko mul,

ayik squilankot ko b'a to ix och ko mul, yowalil skak' junok nok' quelem wakax silab'il ko masanil yik tz'ak'ji tup ko mul chi' t'a quib'anh. Squik'anb'at nok' t'a yichanh mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová.
Ata' syak'k'e sk'ab' heb' yichamtak winaquil chonhab' t'a sjolom nok' t'a yichanh Jehová, smiljicham nok' ta'.
Axo winh sat sakerdote tz'ik'ankot jab'ok schiq'uil nok' chi' t'a yol junok yet'tal syik'anoch winh t'a yol mantiado,
slab'anem yiximal sk'ab' winh t'a skal schiq'uil nok' chi' stzikanem uquelok winh t'a yichanh Jehová t'a yichanhelta k'apak kortina.

Sucanek' jab'ok schiq'uil nok' chi' winh t'a sch'ak altar b'aj stz'a inkienso, aton ayek' t'a yichanh Jehová t'a yol mantiado chi'. Axo jantakto schiq'uil nok' tzato kani, stob'jikanek' t'a yich yok altar b'aj snhusjitz'a silab', aton jun ayek' t'a yichanh mantiado chi'.
Slajwi chi' tz'ik'jiel masanil xepual nok' silab' chi', snhusjitz'ha t'a yib'anh altar.

Syalelk'ochi, to icha wal tz'aj nok' quelem wakax syak' winh sat sakerdote yuj smul icha chi' tz'ajpax nok' tz'ak'ji chi' yuj smul heb' anima smasanil. Icha chi' syutej winh sat sakerdote chi' sb'oan silab' yuj slajwikanel ko mul t'a quib'anh a onh tik.

Slajwi chi' tz'ik'jiel nok' silab' chi' t'a spatiquel kampamento. Ata' snhusjitz'a nok', icha wal tz'utaj nok' b'ab'el quelem wakax chi', yujto a jun silab' chi' tz'ak'ji yuj yak'ji lajwok ko mul ko masanil.
Tato ay junok winh yajal tz'och smul, manh sk'anok sk'ol winh yik sk'ulan tastak to manh ichokta' yalan scheknab'il Jehová,
ayik snachajel yuj winh to ix och smul winh, yowalil syik'kot junok nok' mam chiwa winh silab'il yuj smul ix och chi'. Ha nok' syik'kot winh chi' a nok' malaj jab'ok spaltail.
Syak'k'e sk'ab' winh t'a sjolom nok', smilancham nok' winh t'a yichanh Jehová, aton b'aj smiljitaxon nok' nok' snhusjitz'a silab'il, yujto silab' yuj smul winh yaj nok'.
Axo junok winh sakerdote tz'ik'ankot schiq'uil nok' silab' chi', sukanoch winh t'a sch'ak altar b'aj snhusjitz'a silab', haxo jantakto chik' skani, stob'ankanek' winh t'a yich yok altar chi'.

Snhusjitz'a smasanil xepual nok' t'a yib'anh altar, icha wal tz'aj silab' tz'ak'ji yuj sch'oxji junk'olal yet' Dios. Icha chi' syutej winh sakerdote sb'oan jun silab' chi' yik tz'ak'ji tup smul jun winh yajal t'a chonhab' chi'.
Tato ay junok komon anima tz'och smul, manh sk'anok sk'ool yik sk'ulan tastak to manh ichokta' yalan scheknab'il Jehová,
ayik snachajel yuj to ix och smul, yowalil syik'kot junok nok' nun chiwa silab'il yuj smul ix och chi'. Ha nok' syik'kot chi', a nok' malaj jab'ok spaltail.
Syak'k'e sk'ab' t'a sjolom nok', slajwi chi' smilancham nok' b'aj smiljitaxoncham nok' nok' snhusjitz'a silab'il.
Axo junok winh sakerdote tz'ik'ankot schiq'uil nok', sukanoch winh t'a sch'ak altar b'aj snhusjitz'a silab', haxo jantakto schiq'uil nok' skani, stob'ankanek' winh t'a yich yok altar chi'.

Slajwi chi' tz'ik'jiel masanil xepual nok' silab' chi', icha wal tz'aj yik'jiel yik nok' silab' tz'ak'ji yuj sch'oxan sjunk'olal yet' Dios. Snhusjitz'a xepual nok' chi' silab'il t'a yichanh Jehová to suk'uq'ui sjab'. Icha chi' syutej winh sakerdote sb'oan jun silab' chi' yik tz'ak'ji tup smul jun anima chi'.
Tato a nok' kalnel syik'kot jun mach tz'ak'an jun silab' chi', a junok nok' snun malaj jab'ok spaltail syik'koti.
Yowalil syak'k'e sk'ab' t'a sjolom nok' kalnel chi', smilancham nok' b'aj smiljitaxoncham nok' nok' snhusjitz'aok.
Axo junok winh sakerdote tz'ik'ankot schiq'uil nok', sukanoch winh t'a sch'ak altar b'aj snhusjitz'a silab', haxo jantakto schiq'uil nok' skani, stob'kanek' winh t'a yich yok altar chi'.

Slajwi chi' tz'ik'jiel masanil xepual nok' silab' chi', icha wal tz'aj yik'jiel yik nok' silab' tz'ak'ji yuj sch'oxan sjunk'olal yet' Dios. Snhusjitz'a xepual nok' chi' t'a yib'anh altar, t'a yib'anh juntzanhxo silab' to stz'ataxon t'a yichanh Jehová. Icha chi' syutej jun winh sakerdote sb'oan jun silab' chi' yik tz'ak'ji tup smul jun anima chi'.

Q'uinalok ay junok mach tz'awtaj yuj yalani ma yak'an testigoal sb'ha t'a junok tas ix yila', ma ix yab'i, palta tato max yalelta yuj tas ix yil chi', ma tas ix yab' chi', a jun chi' tz'och smulok skannhej t'a yib'anh.

Anhejtona' tato ay junok mach syaman junok tas manh wach'ok icha yalan ley, tz'och smul. Q'uinalok suquek' sb'ha t'a sniwanil junok chamnak nok', wach'chom kaltakte'al nok', ma molb'etzal nok', ma junok nok' tzek' nhernhonok, a junok mach icha chi' sk'ulej, manh wach'ok tz'aji. Tz'och smul, wach'chom max yab'i tato ix suquek' sb'ha t'a nok' chamnak nok' chi'.
Q'uinalok ay mach syaman junok tas tz'el t'a anima, manh wach'ok tz'ajkan yuj icha yalan ley, max nachajel yuj t'a jun rato chi', palta ayik snachajel yuj, tz'och jun chi' smulok.

Q'uinalok ay junok mach syak' sti' t'a yalxonhej tas lolonelal t'a elanhchamel, tato max cham wal snaani syak'an sti' chi', max yak'elk'och tas ix yal chi', palta ayik snachajel yuj, toxo ix och juntzanh chi' smulok.
Ha mach tz'och junok smul t'a juntzanh tastak tik, yowalil scha smulok,
syak'an junok nok' nun kalnel silab'ok yuj smul ix och chi', ma junok nok' nun chiwa. Ha jun silab' chi', snhustz'a winh sakerdote yik slajwikanel smul jun anima chi'.

Tato malaj stumin jun anima chi' b'aj sman junok nok' kalnel, ma junok nok' chiwa chi', yowalil syik'kot chawanhok nok' paramuch, yalnhej tas makanhil t'a yichanh Jehová yuj smul ix och chi'. Jun nok' tz'och yuj smul chi', junokxo nok' snhusjitz'a smasanil silab'il.
B'ab'el snhusjitz'a nok' tz'ak'ji yuj smul chi' yuj winh sakerdote, tonhej sch'umjiel sjaj nok', palta max el-laj t'a junelnhej.
Slajwi chi', sukjioch jab'ok schiq'uil nok' t'a spatiktak altar, haxo jantakto schiq'uil nok' skani, tz'ak'jikanoch t'a yich yok altar chi', yujto silab' yuj mul yaji.
Axo junxo nok' schab'il chi', snhusjitz'a nok' icha sleyal. Icha chi' tz'aj sb'oan silab' winh sakerdote yuj slajwikan smul jun anima chi'.
Tato malaj stumin jun anima chi' b'aj sman chawanhok nok' paramuch chi', yowalil syik'kot chanheok libra ixim harina te wach', max b'atlaj akeite yet' inkienso t'a skal, yujto ofrenda yuj mul yaji.

Yowalil syik'kot t'a winh sakerdote, haxo winh tz'ik'ankot junok b'echanh ixim harina chi' yik stz'ha t'a yib'anh altar yuj sch'oxaneli to masanil jun ofrenda chi' yik Jehová yaji. Snhusjitz'ha t'a altar t'a yib'anh juntzanhxo ofrenda wan stz'ha t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha jun ofrenda chi' yuj mul tz'ak'ji.

Icha chi' tz'aj sb'oan jun silab' chi' junok winh sakerdote yuj slajwikanel smul jun anima chi'. Ha jantakto skani, yikxo winh sakerdote chi', icha sk'ulej yet' juntzanh wael tz'ak'ji t'a ofrendail, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix schek Jehová yal winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:

Q'uinalok ay junok mach max ik'ankot tastak yiktaxon Jehová yaji, wach'chom manh sk'anok sk'ool tz'och smul. Ha jun anima chi' yowalil syik'kot junok nok' ch'ak kalnel malaj jab'ok spaltail, syak'an nok' silab'il t'a Jehová yuj smul chi'. Yowalil snaji jantak stojol nok' ch'ak kalnel chi' t'a k'een plata, icha k'een sk'anchaj t'a skajnub' Dios.

Ha jun anima chi' yowalil stup tastak yiktaxon Jehová yaj maj yik'kot chi', syak'an jab'okxo stojol t'a yib'anh juntzanh toxo ix yak' chi' t'a winh sakerdote yet' nok' kalnel tz'ak'ji t'a silab'il yuj smul chi'. Icha chi' tz'aj sb'oan silab' jun winh sakerdote yuj slajwikanel smul jun anima chi'.
Q'uinalok ay junok mach tz'och smul t'a cheknab'il ix yak' Jehová wach'chom manh sk'anok sk'ool, a jun chi' ayxo och smulok.

Yuj chi' syik'kot junok silab' t'a junok heb' winh sakerdote yik stupan smul chi'. Syik'kot junok nok' ch'ak kalnel malaj jab'ok spaltail. Ha winh sakerdote chi' snaani to k'okb'il syab' stojol nok' chi' t'a icha wal stojol tas stupchaj chi', anheja' winh sb'oan jun silab' chi'. Icha chi' tz'aj slajwikanel smul ix och chi'.
Aton silab' yuj stupchaj smul chi', yujto a jun anima chi' ay smul t'a yichanh Jehová, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix schek Jehová yal winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Q'uinalok ay junok mach tz'och smul t'a yichanh Jehová, yik syixtan yetanimail t'a junok tas skan ab'enal t'ay, ma syelk'ej junok tasi, mato tonhej sk'ub'ejeli,

mato sik' junok tasi stek'b'an sb'a yalani to malaj tas syila', ma stek'b'an sb'a yalan junok tas manh yelok, ma sk'ulej junokxo chukal sk'ulej heb' anima icha juntzanh tik, yowalil syak' junok silab'.

Axo yik snachaji to ay smul t'a junok juntzanh tik, yowalil syak'xi masanil stojol t'a mach ay yiko', syak'an jab'okxo stojol t'a yib'anh juntzanh toxo ix yak' chi' t'a mach ay yiko'. Syak'anpax junok silab' t'a Jehová yuj smul tz'och chi'.
Ha silab' syak' chi', aton junok nok' ch'ak kalnel malaj jab'ok spaltail, ma a tumin icha stojol junok nok' ch'ak kalnel chi' tz'ak'ji t'a winh sakerdote.
Axo winh tz'ak'anoch jun silab' chi' t'a yichanh Jehová yuj smul jun anima ix och chi', haxo jun mul chi' slajwikanel t'a yib'anh, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix schek Jehová yal winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:

Al t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yuninal yuj tas tz'aj yak'ji jun silab' to snhusjitz'a smasanil t'a junjun yemk'ualil. Ha nok' nok' snhusjitz'a smasanil t'a silab'il chi', yowalil ayk'e nok' t'a yib'anh k'ak' tzek' ak'wal yik stz'ab'at nok'.

Axo t'a junxo q'uinhib'alil, a junok winh sakerdote yowalil syak'och junok spichul winh te wach' yet' yol swex to lino. Slajwi chi', smolank'e stanhil nok' nok' ix nhusjitz'ha t'a yib'anh altar chi' winh, syak'anem winh t'a stz'eyb'at altar chi'.
Slajwi chi', sk'exanel spichul winh chi', sb'at yak'ankan stanhil nok' silab' chi' winh t'a jun lugar sik'b'ilel t'a spatiquel kampamento.

Ha jun k'ak' ayoch t'a yib'anh altar chi', aynhejokab'och masanil tiempo, malajokab' b'ak'uinh stupi. Yowalil tz'ak'jioch te' k'atzitz yuj heb' sakerdote t'a junjun q'uinhib'alil, aton t'a yib'anh k'ak' chi' tz'ak'jik'e nok' silab' stz'ha t'a junjun q'uinhib'alil. Ata' stz'apax xepual nok' silab' yik junk'olal.
Ha juntzanhxo cheknab'il tz'alji tik, aton tas tz'aj yak'ji tas swaji t'a ofrendail: Ha winh sakerdote tz'ak'an t'a Jehová t'a yichanh altar,

syik'ankot junok b'echanh ixim harina yet' akeite, junnhej tz'ajb'at yet' masanil inkienso yik ofrenda chi', stz'a b'aj stz'ataxon ofrenda, yuj sch'oxani to a masanil jun ofrenda chi' yik Jehová yaji, te suk'uq'ui sjab' syab'i.

Axo jantakto ofrenda chi' skani, sb'olchaji, malaj yich pan sb'at t'a skal. Swa heb' winh sakerdote t'a junok lugar to yik Jehová yaji, aton t'a yamaq'uil mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová. Ha juntzanh ofrenda chi', yiknhej Jehová yaji, icha yaj silab' yuj yak'ji lajwok mul, icha pax yaj silab' yuj stupchaj mul. Ix yak'kan juntzanh ofrenda tik Jehová t'a heb' sakerdote t'a skal juntzanh ofrenda tz'ak'ji t'ay to snhusjitz'ha t'a yib'anh altar.

Ha sleyal jun ofrenda chi' ol kannhej t'a masanil tiempo. Ha ofrenda to yik Jehová yaji, snhusjitz'aok, syalnhej swaan masanil heb' winak t'a yinhtilal winhaj Aarón. Yalnhej tastak tz'och tennaj t'a juntzanh ofrenda chi' yik Jehová tz'ajkani, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix chekji yal winhaj Moisés chi' yuj Jehová icha tik:

Aton jun ofrenda tik yowalil syak' winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal t'a Jehová, t'a sk'ual sik'chajoch heb' t'a sakerdoteal: Chanhe' libra ixim harina te wach', yujto ofrenda tz'ak'ji t'a tas swaji. Nanhal tz'ak'ji t'a q'uinhib'alil, haxo nanhalxo, ha t'a yemk'ualil tz'ak'ji t'a jun k'u chi'.
Ha t'a yol junok xalten sb'oji jun ofrenda chi', wach' tz'aj sk'anb'i t'a skal akeite, slajwi chi' spojchaji, tz'ak'ji t'a ofrendail to suk'uq'ui sjab' syab' Jehová.
Icha chi' ol yutejnhej junjun yinhtilal winhaj Aarón ol laj ochnhej sk'exulok t'a sakerdoteal. Yicnhej Jehová yaj jun ofrenda chi', yuj chi' snhusjitz'a smasanil t'a yichanh.
Masanil ofrenda syak' heb' sakerdote t'a tas swaji, yowalil snhusjitz'a smasanil. Malaj junok mach syal swaani, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi', ix yalani:

Al masanil juntzanh k'ayb'ub'al tik t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yuninal, yuj tas tz'aj snhusjitz'a silab' yuj yak'ji tup mul: Ha junok nok' silab' tz'ak'ji yuj mul chi', yowalil smiljicham nok' t'a yichanh Jehová, t'a jun lugar b'ajtaxon smiljicham nok' snhusjitz'aok. Ha jun silab' chi' yik Jehová yaji.
Ha winh sakerdote tz'ak'an jun silab' yuj yak'ji tup mul chi', syal schi'an winh t'a jun lugar yik Jehová yaji, aton t'a yamaq'uil mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová.
Yalnhej tastak tz'och tennaj t'a nok' chib'ej chi' yik Jehová tz'ajkani. Tato tz'och tzitnaj schiq'uil nok' t'a junok pichul, yowalil sjuk'jiel t'a junok lugar to yik Jehová yaji.
Anheja' lum chen b'aj stz'anhji nok' silab' chi', yowalil smak'jipoj lu'um, palta ta ha t'a yol junok chen bronke stz'anhji, anhej to snhikjiel smikal, wach' tz'aj sb'ikchaji.
Ha jun silab' chi' yik Jehová yaji. Yalnhej mach junok winak t'a yinhtilal heb' sakerdote syal schi'ani.
Palta tato tz'ik'jikot schiq'uil t'a yol mantiado t'a jun lugar to yik Jehová yaji, yuj yak'ji tup mul, max yal-laj schiji nok'. Ha jun silab' chi' yowalil snhusjitz'a smasanil.
Yic Jehová yaj silab' tz'ak'ji yuj stupchaj mul. Aton wal cheknab'il yuj tas tz'aj yak'ji tik:
Ha junok nok' nok' tz'ak'ji yuj stupchaj mul, yowalil smiljicham nok' b'aj schamtaxon nok' snhusjitz'aok, haxo schiq'uil nok' stzikjioch t'a schanhil pak'anh altar.
Tz'ak'ji masanil xepual nok', aton xepu' ayoch t'a nok' snhe, t'a nok' yol sk'ool,
yet' nok' stut schab'il yet' xepu' ayoch t'a yich spatik nok' yet' pax xepu' ayoch t'a yib'anh seyub' nok', junnhej tz'aj yel yet' nok' stut chi'.
Axo junok heb' sakerdote snhusantz'a juntzanh chi' t'a yib'anh altar silab'il to snhusjitz'ha t'a yichanh Jehová yuj stojolok mul.
Yalnhej mach heb' winak t'a yinhtilal heb' sakerdote syal schi'an jun silab' chi', palta anhej t'a jun lugar to yik Jehová yaji, yujto a jun chi' niwan yelk'ochi.
Ha cheknab'il yuj silab' yik stupchaj mul, lajannhej yet' yik silab' tz'ak'ji yuj mul. Ha nok' chib'ej yik juntzanh silab' chi', skan yikok winh sakerdote ix ak'anoch t'a yichanh Jehová.
Anhejton pax ha' stz'umal jun nok' silab' stz'a syak' heb' anima chi', yik winh sakerdote chi' tz'ajkani.
Icha pax chi' masanil ofrenda sk'anb'i t'a horno, ma t'a yol xalten, ma staji t'a yoltak niwak chen, yiknhej jun winh sakerdote tz'ak'anoch jun ofrenda chi' t'a yichanh Jehová.

Icha chi' tz'aj yak'ji masanil ofrenda tz'ak'ji t'a tas swaji, icha ixim trigo jaxb'il kalab'il yet' akeite, mato k'anb'inak. Ha juntzanh chi' yiknhej heb' yinhtilal winhaj Aarón, lajannhej tz'aj spukanek' heb' t'a spatik.
Aton wal sleyal tas tz'aj yak'ji silab' t'a yichanh Jehová sch'oxan junk'olal yet'ok:

Tato a junok nok' silab' chi' tz'ak'ji yuj ak'oj yuj diosal, tz'ak'jipax ixim pan malaj yich, skalaj yet' akeite yet' k'oxox pan tz'och akeite t'ay to malaj pax yich yet' juntzanh pan b'ob'il t'a ixim harina te wach' kalab'il yet' akeite.
Ha yet' jun silab' chi', tz'ak'jipax ixim pan ay yich.
Tz'ik'jiel junok pan, tz'ak'jioch t'a yichanh Jehová. Slajwi chi' skan jun pan chi' t'a yol sk'ab' winh sakerdote, aton winh stzikanem schiq'uil nok' silab' chi'.
Ha nok' nok' tz'ak'ji silab'il yik sch'oxan junk'olal yet' Dios yuj ak'oj yuj diosal, ha t'a jun k'ual tz'ak'ji nok' chi' schijikanb'ati, manhxa jab'ok nok' sik'jikanb'at t'a junxo k'u.
Ha pax tato a jun silab' tz'ak'ji yujto yak'nak sti' mach yak'ani, ma tonhej tz'el t'a sk'ol yak'ani, a juntzanh chi' schiji t'a jun k'ual chi', tato ayto nok' skani, syal schiji t'a junxo k'u.
Palta tato ayto nok' t'a schab'jial, ata' yowalil snhusjitz'a nok'.

Tato ay mach schi'an jun nok' silab' chi' t'a schab'jial, a jun silab' chi' maxtzak chajilaj, maxtzak ochpaxlaj yopisio. Ha jun chi' manh wach'ok tz'ajkan t'a yol sat Jehová. Yuj chi' a mach schi'an jun chi', skan jun mul chi' t'a yib'anh.

Tato ay nok' chib'ej yik junok silab' tik tz'och tennaj t'a junok tas manh wach'ok yaj icha yalan ley, maxtzak yal-laj schiji nok', palta to snhusjitz'a nok'. Ha mach wach' yaj icha yalan ley, syal schi'an juntzanh silab' chi'.

Ha junok anima manh wach'ok yaj icha yalan ley, yujto ix syam junok tas to manh wach'ok, wach'chom t'a anima skoti, ma junok nok' nok', ma junokxo tas manh wach'ok, tato a jun anima chi' schi'anpax nok' silab' yik junk'olal to yik Jehová yaji, a jun anima chi', manhxaokab' yalan yik t'a ko kal, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al masanil juntzanh tik t'a heb' etchonhab': Max yal-laj he chi'an xepual nok' nok', nok' wakax, nok' kalnel, ma nok' chiwa,
yet' pax xepual nok' nok' tonhej syak'cham sb'a, ma nok' smiljicham yuj nok' kaltakte'al nok'. Syal sk'anchaj t'a junokxo tasi, palta max yal-laj schiji.
Yalnhej mach schi'an xepual nok' nok' to syal snhusjitz'ha t'a ofrendail t'a Jehová, manhxaokab' yalan yik t'a ko kal.
Yalnhej b'ajtil ayex eq'ui, max yal tze chi' schiq'uil nok' nok', aton nok' niwak nok' yet' nok' much.
Ha junok anima schi'an schiq'uil nok' nok' chi', manhxaokab' yalan yik t'a ko kal, xa chi, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al jun cheknab'il tik t'a heb' etchonhab': Ha junok mach tz'ak'an junok silab' yik sch'oxan sjunk'olal yet' Jehová, yowalil syik'kot t'a yichanh.
Ha tz'ik'ankot jab'ok nok' snhusjitz'ha t'a yichanh, aton xepual nok' yet' nok' snhi' sk'ool. Ha nok' snhisk'ol chi' sb'akhchajoch t'a yichanh Jehová.
Ha nok' xepu' chi' snhusjitz'ha t'a altar yuj junok sakerdote, haxo nok' snhi' sk'ool, yik winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal yaj nok'.
Ha xub' nok' silab' chi' t'a swach' yik winh sakerdote tz'ak'an schiq'uil nok' yet' xepual nok' t'a silab'il yuj junk'olal.

Ha nok' snhi' sk'ool sb'akhchajek' t'a yichanh Jehová yet' nok' xub' t'a swach', a Jehová chi' tz'ak'an nok' t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yinhtilal t'a masanil tiempo. Ha juntzanh chi' yiknhej heb' yaj t'a nok' silab' yik junk'olal syak' heb' israel chi'.
Ha t'a nok' silab' snhusjitz'ha t'a yichanh Jehová, yak'nak nok' snhi' sk'ool yet' nok' xub' t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yinhtilal, atax t'a sk'ual a ix sik'chajkanoch heb' t'a sakerdoteal.
Atax t'a jun k'u chi' yalnakkani to yowalil tz'ak'ji juntzanh chi' t'a heb'. Ha jun cheknab'il tik, yowalil sko k'anab'ajej t'a masanil tiempo yet' heb' quinhtilal t'a b'ak'uinh.

Ichaton tik sleyal masanil juntzanh silab' tz'ak'ji d'ha Dios: Aton silab' snhusjitz'a smasanil, ofrenda tz'ak'ji t'a tas swaji, silab' tz'ak'ji yuj mul yet' pax yuj stupchaj mul yet' junok mach tz'ochkan yikok Dios yet' silab' sch'oxan junk'olal yet' Dios.
Ha juntzanh ley tik ix yak' Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés t'a jolom witz Sinaí t'a tzinan lu'um, aton wal t'a jun k'u chi' ix alchaji, to ol yak' silab' heb' israel t'a Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:

Ik'kot winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal, tzik'anpaxkot spichul heb' syak'och t'a yopisio t'a sakerdoteal. Tzik'paxkot akeite sk'anchaji a sik'chajkanoch heb' t'a yopisio chi'. Tzik'paxkot junok nok' quelem wakax ol ak'chaj silab'il yuj mul yet' chawanhok nok' ch'ak kalnel yet' junok yune' mooch ixim pan malaj yich.
Tza molb'an heb' etchonhab' smasanil t'a sti' mantiado b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, xchi t'a winh.
Ix sk'anab'ajej winhaj Moisés chi' icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová, ix molchaj anima smasanil t'a sti' mantiado chi'.
Ix yalan winh t'a heb' icha tik: Aton juntzanh tik ix yal Jehová to ol ko k'ulej, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh to snitzkot sb'a winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal t'a stz'ey. Ix b'ikjiel heb' yuj winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix ak'jioch skamix winhaj Aarón chi' yet' stzek'ul yuj winh yet' pax k'apak pichul jukan, k'apak chaleka yet' k'apak stzek'ul tz'isb'iloch yelwanub'.
Axo t'a spatik k'apak chi', ix yak'paxoch jun k'apak smakul snhisk'ol winh, ha t'a yol k'apak chi' ix yak'och k'een Urim winh yet' k'een Tumim.

Ixlajwi chi' ix ak'jik'e sk'ox winh, aton jun k'apak ix b'ak'jioch t'a sjolom winh. Axo t'a snanhal sat winh, ix ak'jioch jun k'een yelwanub' nab'a oro, aton sch'oxani to sik'b'iloch winh t'a sakerdoteal, icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová.
