Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'anchaanh akeite winhaj Moisés chi', aton sk'anchaji a sik'chajoch junok mach, ma junok tas tz'ochkan yikok Jehová. Ix stzikanem winh t'a yib'anh skajnub' Jehová yet' t'a yib'anh masanil tastak ayoch t'a yool chi'. Icha wal chi' ix aj yochkan masanil tastak chi' yikok Jehová.
Anheja' jun akeite chi', ix tzikjiem uquel t'a yib'anh altar yet' t'a yib'anh masanil syamk'ab'il, t'a yib'anh jun niwan palangana yet' sb'akhnub' yich. Icha chi' ix aj yochkan yikok Jehová.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'anpaxk'e akeite winhaj Moisés t'a sjolom winhaj Aarón yuj yochkan winh yikok Jehová.
Ix yik'anpaxkot heb' yuninal winhaj Aarón chi' winh t'a stz'ey. Ix ak'jioch spichul heb' jukan, stzek'ul heb' yet' sk'ox heb' yuj winh, icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'ankot nok' quelem wakax winh, nok' ol och t'a silab'il yuj mul. Ha winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal, ix yak'k'e sk'ab' heb' t'a sjolom nok'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix smilancham nok' winh. Ix yik'anb'at schiq'uil nok' winh, ix sukanoch winh yet' yiximal sk'ab' t'a sch'ak altar ayk'e t'a schiquintak schanhil, yik wach' chab'il yuj Dios. Axo jantakto chik' ixto kan chi', ix stob'kanem winh t'a yichtak altar chi'. Icha chi' ix aj yochkan yikok Jehová, yik wach' slajwikanel chukal ta'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'anelta masanil xepual nok' winh ayoch t'a nok' yol sk'ool yet' t'a yib'anh seyub' nok', nok' stut schab'il yet' xepual ayoch t'ay. Masanil juntzanh chi' ix snhustz'a winh t'a yib'anh altar.
Axo jantakto nok' wakax chi' ix kani, aton stz'umal nok' yet' sb'ak'chil nok' yet' sch'anhtza' nok', ix ak'chajkanoch sk'ak'al t'a spatiquelta kampamento, icha ix aj yalan Jehová.
Ix yak'anpax ik'jokkot nok' kalnel winh snhusjitz'a smasanil silab'il. Axo winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal chi', ix yak'k'e sk'ab' heb' t'a sjolom nok'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix smilancham nok' winhaj Moisés chi', ix stzikanoch schiq'uil nok' winh t'a schanhil pak'anh altar.
Ix skotak xiquej nok' winh, ix snhusantz'a sjolom nok' winh yet' nok' chok' yaj chi' yet' sxepual nok'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix smaxan nok' yol sk'ool winh yet' nok' yok. Ix snhusantz'a nok' winh smasanil silab'il t'a yib'anh altar. Ha jun ofrenda chi' te suk'uq'ui sjab' ix yab' Jehová, icha wal ix aj yalani.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'an ik'jokkot junxo nok' ch'ak kalnel winh yik sk'anchaji yik tz'ochkan heb' t'a yopisio. Axo winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal chi', ix yak'k'e sk'ab' heb' t'a sjolom nok'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix smilancham nok' winh, ix yik'anb'at jab'ok schiq'uil nok' winh, ix sukanoch winh t'a sjayil schiquin winhaj Aarón t'a swach', t'a smam sk'ab' winh t'a swach' yet' t'a yiximal smam yok winh t'a swach'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh to snitzkot sb'a heb' yuninal winhaj Aarón chi' t'a stz'ey, ix yak'anpaxoch schiq'uil nok' chi' winh t'a sjayil schiquin heb' t'a swach' yet' t'a smam sk'ab' heb' t'a swach' yet' t'a yiximal smam yok heb' t'a swach'. Ixlajwi chi' ix stzikanoch winh jantakto chik' ixto kan t'a schanhil pak'anh altar.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'anelta xepu' winh ayoch t'a nok' snhe yet' ayoch t'a nok' yol sk'ool, xepu' ayoch t'a yib'anh seyub' nok' yet' nok' stut schab'il yet' xepu' ayoch t'ay yet' nok' xub' t'a swach'.

Ix yik'ankot jun yune' mooch ixim pan winh malaj yich, ix yak'och winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Ix yik'ank'eta jun ixim pan chi' winh t'a yol mooch chi' yet' junxo ixim kalab'il yet' akeite yet' jun ixim k'oxox b'ob'il t'a ixim harina, ix yak'ank'e winh t'a yib'anh nok' xepu' chi' yet' t'a yib'anh nok' xub' t'a swach'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'an masanil juntzanh tik winh t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal, yik sb'akhanek' heb' t'a yichanh Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'anpaxek' masanil juntzanh chi' winh t'a yol sk'ab' heb', ix snhusantz'a winh smasanil t'a yib'anh altar yet' nok' silab' ix nhusjitz'ha t'a yichanh Jehová, yuj sik'chajoch heb' t'a yopisio. Te suk'uq'ui sjab' ix yab' Jehová.
Ix yik'anpaxkot snhisk'ol nok' kalnel winh ix ak'ji yuj sik'chajkanoch heb' t'a yopisio. Ix sb'akhanoch heb' t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha jun chi' ix yik'kan winhaj Moisés chi' icha ix aj yalan Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'ankot akeite winh yet' chik' ayek' t'a yib'anh altar. Ix stzikank'e winh t'a yib'anh winhaj Aarón yet' t'a spichul. Ix tzikanpaxk'e winh t'a yib'anh heb' yuninal winhaj Aarón chi' yet' t'a spichul heb'. Icha chi' ix aj yochkan heb' yikok Jehová yet' spichul smasanil.

Ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yuninal chi': Tz'anhjokab' nok' chib'ej t'a yichanh mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová. Ata' tze chi nok' yet' ixim pan ayem t'a yol jun yune' mooch, aton ixim ix ak'ji yik tzex ochkan t'a eyopisio. Icha ix aj walani: Ha winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal ol swa jun wael tik heb', xin chi, ix walani.
Ha jantakto manh ol lajwok nok' chib'ej chi' yet' ixim pan chi' eyuuj, ol he nhuskantz'aok.
Ha t'a yichanh k'apak mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová, anhej ta' tzex aj uqueok k'ual masanto sk'och sk'ual eyochkan t'a eyopisio.
Ha tiknaik toxo ix b'o icha wal ix aj schekan Jehová ko k'ulej yik slajwikanel he mul.

Yuj chi' ha t'a yichanh mantiado, ata' tzex kan uqueok k'ual yet' uqueok ak'wal. Tze k'anab'ajan masanil juntzanh scheknab'il Jehová yik wach' max ex chami, yujto icha chi' ix aj yalan Jehová chi' t'ayin, xchi winh t'a heb'.
Icha chi' ix aj sk'anab'ajan winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal masanil tas ix schek Jehová yal winhaj Moisés chi' t'a heb'.
D'a yewial slajwi uque' k'ual yochkan winhaj Aarón t'a yopisio chi', ix awtaj winh yet' heb' yuninal yet' heb' yichamtak winaquil chonhab' yuj winhaj Moisés.

Ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Aarón chi': Ik'kot junok nok' quelem wakax yik tz'och nok' silab'il yuj a mul yet' junok nok' ch'ak kalnel, aton nok' malaj jab'ok spaltail. Tza nhustz'a smasanil silab'il uuj, tzak'och nok' t'a yichanh Jehová.

Alpax t'a heb' quetisraelal to syik'kot junok nok' mam chiwa heb' silab'il yuj smul. Syik'anpaxkot junok nok' quelem wakax heb' yet' junok nok' kalnel, yuj snhusjitz'a nok' smasanil silab'il, jun ab'il sk'inal junjun nok', malajokab' jab'ok spaltail nok'.

Syik'anpaxkot junok nok' wakax heb' yet' junok nok' ch'ak kalnel smiljicham t'a yichanh Jehová silab'il yik sch'oxan sjunk'olal heb' yet'ok. Syik'anpaxkot junok ofrenda heb' t'a tas swaji, kalab'il yet' akeite, yujto ol sch'ox sb'a Jehová t'ayex tiknaik, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yik'ankot heb' t'a yichanh mantiado masanil tastak ix chekji yik'kot yuj winhaj Moisés chi'. Masanil chonhab' ix jawi molan, ix och linhjab' heb' t'a yichanh Jehová.
Axo ix yalan winhaj Moisés chi' t'a heb' icha tik: Aton wal juntzanh tik schek Jehová he k'ulej yik wach' ol sch'ox wal stziquiquial t'ayex, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalanxi winh t'a winhaj Aarón chi': Nitzcot a b'ha t'a slak'anil altar tik, tzak'an nok' nok' silab'ok yuj a mul yet' nok' silab' snhusjitz'a smasanil. Icha chi' ol aj yak'ji lajwok a mul. Tzak'anpax nok' silab' yuj yak'ji lajwok ko mul a onh israel onh tik, icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix jawi winhaj Aarón t'a slak'anil altar chi', ix smilancham nok' quelem wakax ix yak' winh silab'il yuj smul chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix japax heb' yuninal winh yet' schiq'uil nok' silab' chi', ix yak'anem yiximal sk'ab' winh t'a skal chik' chi', ix sukanoch winh t'a sch'ak altar chi'. Axo jab'okxo chik' ixto kan chi', ix sekkanem winh t'a yich altar chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix snhusantz'a smasanil xepual nok' winh t'a yib'anh altar yet' pax stut nok' yet' xepual ayoch t'a yib'anh seyub' nok', aton nok' silab' yuj mul, icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Axo pax sb'ak'chil nok' yet' stz'umal, ix nhusjitz'ha t'a spatiquel kampamento.
Ix smilanpaxcham nok' silab' winhaj Aarón chi', nok' snhusjitz'a smasanil, haxo heb' yuninal winh ix ik'ankot schiq'uil nok', ix stzikanoch winh t'a schanhil pak'anh altar.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'anpaxkot sjolom nok' heb' yet' nok' ix xikchajb'at chi', ix snhusantz'a winh t'a yib'anh altar chi'.
Ix maxchaj nok' yol sk'ool yet' nok' yok, ix snhusanpaxtz'a winh t'a yib'anh altar chi', t'a yib'anh nok' wanxo stz'a chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an silab' winh yuj heb' yetchonhab'. Ix yik'ankot nok' chiwa winh, aton nok' silab' tz'ak'ji yuj smul heb' yetchonhab' chi'. Ix smilancham nok' winh, ix yak'an nok' winh silab'il icha ix yutej yak'an nok' b'ab'el chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an junxo nok' silab' winh to stz'a smasanil icha sleyal.
Ix yak'anpax ofrenda winh t'a tas swaji. Ix yik'b'at jun b'echanh ixim harina winh, ix snhusantz'a winh t'a yib'anh altar yet' silab' snhusjitz'ha t'a junjun q'uinhib'alil.

Ix yak'anpax nok' wakax winh yet' nok' ch'ak kalnel ix yik'kot heb' yetchonhab' chi' silab'il yuj sch'oxan sjunk'olal heb' yet' Dios. Ha heb' yuninal winh ix ik'ankot schiq'uil nok', haxo winh ix tzikanoch t'a schanhil pak'anh altar chi'.
Ix yak'anpax xepual nok' wakax heb' yet' xepual nok' ch'ak kalnel chi', aton xepu' ayoch t'a snhe nok', t'a nok' yol sk'ool yet' t'a nok' stut yet' xepu' ayoch t'a yib'anh seyub' nok'.
Junnhej ix aj nok' xepu' chi' yet' nok' snhi' sk'ool. Axo winhaj Aarón ix nhusantz'a nok' xepual chi' t'a yib'anh altar.
Axo pax nok' snhisk'ol chi' yet' nok' xub' t'a swach', tonhej ix b'akhjiek' t'a yichanh Jehová, icha ix aj yalan winhaj Moisés chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'anchaanh sk'ab' winhaj Aarón chi', ix yalan wach' lolonel winh t'a yib'anh heb' yetchonhab' chi'. Ayic toxo ix lajwi snhusantz'a silab' winh yuj mul yet' silab' snhusjitz'a smasanil yet' silab' yik sch'oxan sjunk'olal yet' Dios, ix emixta winh b'aj ay altar chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix och winhaj Moisés yet' winh t'a mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová. Axo ix elta heb' winh, ix yalan wach' lolonel heb' winh t'a yib'anh heb' yetchonhab' chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix sch'oxan stziquiquial Jehová t'a masanil heb' israel chi'.

Ix elta k'ak' t'a yichanh Jehová chi', ix snhusantz'a nok' silab' yet' xepual nok' ayk'e t'a yib'anh altar, ix tz'ab'at smasanil. Ha ix yilan masanil jun chi' heb' chonhab' chi', ix el yaw heb' t'a tzalajk'olal, ix em nhojjab' heb', ix emk'och snanhal sat heb' t'a sat lu'um.

Ha winhaj Nadab yet' winhaj Abiú, heb' winh yuninal winhaj Aarón, ix yik'kot junjun chaynub' yik inkienso heb' winh, ix yak'anoch sk'ak'al heb' winh, ix yak'anpaxem inkienso heb' winh t'a yib'anh, ix yak'anoch heb' winh t'a yichanh Jehová, to manhoklaj ix alani.
Yuj chi' ix elta k'ak' t'a yichanh Jehová chi' t'a heb' winh, ix tz'ab'at heb' winh, ix cham heb' winh t'a yichanh Jehová chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Moisés chi' t'a winhaj Aarón: --Aton jun tik syalelk'och slolonel Jehová ix yala': Ha yuj heb' tzin ak'an serwil, ol in ch'ox in b'a, to Ha inxonhej ochi. Ha t'a masanil in chonhab' ol in ch'ox in tziquiquial, xchi Jehová, xchi winh. Ix em numnaj winhaj Aarón chi', manhxalaj tas ix yal winh.

Ixlajwi chi', haxo winhaj Moisés chi' ix awtan winhaj Misael yet' winhaj Elzafán, heb' yuninal winhaj Uziel yicham winhaj Aarón chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh: --Nitzeccot he b'a a ex tik t'a sti' mantiado b'aj ayek' sniwanil heb' he k'ab' eyok chi', ik'equel heb' t'a spatiquel kampamento, xchi winh.

Ix jawi heb' winh, ix yik'anel heb' chamnak chi' heb' winh t'a spatiquel kampamento icha ix aj yalan winhaj Moisés chi'. Aytooch spichul heb' chamnak chi' t'ay, aton k'apak sk'antaxon heb' t'a yopisio.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Moisés t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a chawanhxo heb' yuninal winh, aton winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Itamar: --Manh eyik'el he k'ox ayk'e t'a he jolom, manh he nhik'chitejb'at he pichul yuj he ch'oxanel he kusk'olal. Axo talaj tz'aji, tzex champaxi, haxo skot yowal sk'ol Jehová t'a quib'anh ko masanil a onh israel onh tik. Palta a masanil heb' quetchonhab' tik syal yok' sk'ol heb' yuj mach ix satel Jehová yet' k'ak'.

Manh ex elpax t'a yichanh mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová yik wach' manh ol ex chamok, a ex tik sik'b'il ex eli, ak'b'iloch akeite to yik Jehová t'ayex, xchi winh. Icha wal ix aj yalan winhaj Moisés chi', icha chi' ix sk'ulej heb'.
Ix yalanpax Jehová t'a winhaj Aarón chi' icha tik:

--Ayic ol ach och a ach tik, ma heb' uninal t'a yol mantiado b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, manh eyuk' wino, ma tastak pajb'inakxo, haxo talaj tz'aji tzex chami. Ha jun tik ley tz'ajkan t'a he kal t'a masanil tiempo.
Manh he k'ulej juntzanh chi' yujto yowalil snachajel eyuuj, tastak wach' icha yalan ley yet' tastak manh wach'ok.
Yowalil tze k'ayb'ejpax heb' eyetchonhab' t'a juntzanh ley ix in chek yal winhaj Moisés t'ayex tik, xchi t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalanpax winhaj Moisés chi' t'a winhaj Aarón yet' pax t'a heb' yuninal winh, aton winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Itamar: --Ik'ekkot ixim harina ixto kan t'a ofrenda ix tz'ha t'a yichanh Jehová, tze b'oan ixim pan malaj yich t'a yichanh altar, yujto a jun ofrenda chi' yik Jehová yaji.
Tze waan t'a junok lugar to yik Jehová yaji, yujto a ofrenda snhusjitz'ha t'a yichanh Jehová ik yaj yet' heb' uninal. Aton juntzanh tik ix alji t'ayin.

Axo pax nok' snhisk'ol sb'akhchajek' t'a yichanh Jehová yet' nok' xub', tz'ik'chajel nok', a juntzanh chi' eyiktaxon yaji. Tza chi yet' heb' uninal yet' heb' isil t'a junok lugar to wach' yaji icha syal ley, yujto a juntzanh chi' eyiktaxon yaj t'a silab' sch'oxan sjunk'olal heb' quetchonhab' yet' Dios.

Yujto a nok' xub' tz'ik'jiel chi' yet' nok' snhisk'ol sb'akhjiek' t'a yichanh Jehová, junnhej tz'aj yak'ji yet' nok' xepu' snhusjitz'aok. Ha cha makan nok' chi', ik yet' heb' uninal t'a masanil tiempo icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'ayin, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.

Ix sk'anb'anpax winhaj Moisés chi' yuj nok' chiwa ix ak'ji silab'il yuj mul. Axo ix yalan heb' winh to toxo ix snhustz'a nok' heb' winh. Yuj chi' ix kot yowal winh t'a winhaj Eleazar yet' t'a winhaj Itamar, ix yalan winh icha tik:

--¿Tas yuj maj he chi nok' silab' t'a yamaq'uil skajnub' Jehová? Ha jun makan silab' chi', yik Jehová yaji, yuj chi' ix ak'ji t'ayex, yuj he chi'an nok', yik tz'ik'jiel smul heb' molanek' t'a yichanh Jehová.
Yujto a schiq'uil nok' silab' chi', maj ik'jib'at t'a yol skajnub' Jehová, yuj chi' yowalil to ix he chi nok' t'a yamaq'uil chi', icha ix aj walan t'ayex, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Aarón icha tik: --Ha tiknaik ix yak' silab' heb' yuj smul yet' silab' to stz'a smasanil, wach'chom icha chi', palta ina wal tas ix jawi t'a wib'anh. Tato ix in chi nok' silab' ix ak'ji yuj mul chi', ¿tom chab'il in yuj Jehová tza na'? xchi winhaj Aarón chi'.
Ayic ix yab'an winhaj Moisés icha chi', ix schaan sk'ol winh.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón icha tik:
Alec t'a masanil heb' eyetchonhab' to ha t'a skal masanil nok' nok' ay t'a sat lu'um tik, aton juntzanh nok' tik syal he chi'ani:
Nok' sjax yanh cha xechanh yech.

Palta a juntzanhxo nok' ol wal tik, manh ol yal-laj he chi'an nok', wach'chom sjax yanh nok', palta manh cha xechanhok yech nok': Nok' kamello sjax yanh nok', palta manh cha xechanhok yech nok', a nok' chi' max yal-laj he chi'an nok'.
Yed' pax nok' tejón, sjax yanh nok', palta tzijtum yech nok', a nok' chi' max yal-laj he chi'an nok'.
Yed' pax nok' niwak chich, sjax yanh nok', palta tzijtum yech nok', yuj chi' max yal-laj he chi'an nok'.
Yed' pax nok' chitam, wach'chom cha xechanh yech nok', palta max sjaxpax swael nok', yuj chi' max yal-laj he chi'an nok'.
Max yal he chi'an juntzanh nok' nok' chi', max yalpax eyaman nok' ayik toxo ix cham nok', yowalil tze na'a to manh wach'ok nok' icha yalan ley.
Axo pax nok' ay t'a yoltak ha ha', nok' ay t'a yol ha' mar, ma t'a yoltak a niwak ha', syal he chi'an nok' ay sk'axil yet' stuminal spatik.
Axo pax nok' malaj sk'axil, malaj pax stuminal spatik, max yal-laj he chi'an nok'. Ha nok' chi' yajb'entak nok', wach'chom ha t'a yol ha' mar ma t'a yoltak ha' ay nok'.
Yujto yajb'entak nok', manh he chi nok', manh eyampax nok' chamnakxo.
Masanil nok' malaj sk'axil yet' stuminal spatik ay t'a yoltak ha', yajb'entakokab' yaj nok' t'a yol he sat.
Anheja' pax t'a skal nok' much, manh ol yal-laj he chi'an juntzanh nok' ol wal tik, yujto manh wach'ok nok': Icha nok' d'iw, nok' wakawok, nok' ch'akb'a yik ha ha',
nok' xulem, nok' milano yet' masanil makanhil nok' xulem chi',
yet' masanil makanhil nok' joj,
nok' awestruz, nok' niwak tonton, nok' xalunhe yet' masanil makanhil nok' ch'akb'a,
nok' kujub', nok' kormorán, nok' ibis,
nok' pech, nok' julum chay, nok' ostok,
nok' kigüeña yet' masanil makanhil nok' garza yet' nok' abubilla yet' nok' sotz'.
Anhejtona' pax masanil nok' kotak nok' tzek' jenhenhok t'a jun petanhil sb'ey t'a sat lu'um, yajb'entakokab' nok' t'a yol he sat.
Axo pax tato a nok' ay yip yok sk'e tz'itnajok, wach'chom sjenhwi nok', sb'eypax nok' t'a sat lu'um, syal schiji nok'.
Ha t'a skal nok' chi' syal he chi'an smasanil makanhil nok' k'ulub', nok' niwak k'ulub' yet' nok' chil.
Axo masanil juntzanhxo nok' kotaquil nok' tzek' jenhenhok, ma tzek' t'a sat lu'um tik, yowalil tzeyaj nok'.

Tato tze yam juntzanh nok' nok' swal tik ayik chamnakxo nok', manh wach'ok tzex ajkani icha yalan ley, masanto sq'uik'b'iemi. Masanil nok' nok' ay yech palta manh chaxechanhoklaj, max sjaxpax yanh, a juntzanh nok' chi' nachajokab' el eyuuj to manh wach'ok nok'. Yalnhej tas nok'al to chanhe' yok palta tzijtum yech mokab' wach'ok nok' t'a yol he sat. Yuj chi' yalnhej mach syaman junok nok' nok' chi' tato chamnakxo nok', manh wach'ok tz'ajkani, icha yalan ley. Icha pax chi' junok mach tz'ik'anchaanh nok' chamnak nok' chi', yowalil sjuk'el spichul, palta manto wach'ok tz'ajkani masanto sq'uik'b'iemi. Manh wach'ok juntzanh nok' chi' icha yalan ley.

Axo masanil nok' nok' tzek' t'a sat lu'um, nachajokab' el eyuuj to max yal schiji juntzanh nok' tik: Icha nok' k'uxum boton, nok' ch'oow, nok' k'ok'on yet' masanil makanhil nok' pajtza' yet' masanil makanhil nok' tzek' nhernhonok ma tzek' jachjonok: Aton nok' ayin, nok' lagarto, nok' patix yet' nok' tzalajk'ab'.

Ha t'a skal masanil nok' nok', a juntzanh nok' tik, nachajokab' el eyuuj to manh wach'ok nok' icha yalan ley, yuj chi' yalnhej mach syaman nok' ayik toxo ix cham nok', manh wach'ok tz'ajkani masanto sq'uik'b'iemi.

Q'uinalok ay junok tas b'aj tz'em nok' chamnak nok' chi', a jun chi', manh wach'ok tz'ajkani, icha yalan ley: Wach'chom a junok te te', junok pichul, junok tz'uum, junok koxtal, ma junok yamk'ab' yik munlajel, tato tz'em junok nok' chamnak nok' chi' t'a yib'anh, yowalil slab'chajem t'a skal ha ha'. Palta manto wach'ok tz'ajkani, masanto sq'uik'b'iemi, ichato chi' wach' tz'ajkani.
Tato tz'em junok nok' nok' chi' t'a yol junok lum chen ayik toxo ix cham nok', a tas ayem t'a yol lum chi', manh wach'ok tz'ajkani, haxo jun chen chi', yowalil smak'jipoj lu'um.
Yalnhej tas chib'il wailal yet' yal ayem t'a yol jun chen chi', ma uk'em, manh wach'ok tz'ajkani.

Yuj chi' tato tz'em junok nok' chamnak nok' chi' t'a yib'anh junok tasi, manh wach'ok tz'ajkani, wach'chom a junok horno, ma junok yet'tal b'aj tz'och k'ak', yowalil spojjieli. Ha jun yamk'ab' chi' manhxo wach'ok icha yalan ley, yuj chi' manhxo wach'ok pax t'a yol he sat.
Palta a sjaj ha ha', ma ha' uk'b'ila' wach'chom tz'em nok' chamnak nok' t'a yol ha', wach'nhej yaj ha', anhej jun mach tz'ik'ank'eta nok' chamnak nok' chi' t'a yol ha' manh wach'ok tz'ajkani.
Q'uinalok tz'em junok nok' chamnak nok' chi' t'a yib'anh junok makan inhat tz'awchaji, a jun makan inhat chi' max ixtaxel-laj.
Palta tato a jun makan inhat lab'anxo, tz'em junok chamnak nok' chi' t'a yib'anh, a juntzanh inhat chi' manhxo wach'ok tz'ajkani.
Q'uinalok scham junok nok' nok' to schiji, a mach syaman nok', manh wach'ok tz'ajkani masanto sq'uik'b'ikanemi.

Ha mach schi'an sb'ak'chil nok' chamnak nok' chi' yowalil sjuk'el spichul, manh wach'ok tz'ajkani masanto sq'uik'b'ikanemi. Ha mach tz'ik'anelta junok chamnak nok' chi' yowalil sjuk'el spichul, manh wach'ok tz'ajkani masanto sq'uik'b'iemi.
Manh he chi juntzanh nok' nok' snherwi, ma sjachwi t'a sat lu'um, yujto manh wach'ok nok'.

Masanil nok' nok' snherwi, ma sjachwi t'a sat lu'um, wach'chom nok' sb'ey yet' schanhil yok, ma nok' tzijtum yok, masanil juntzanh nok' chi' manh wach'ok nok' icha yalan ley, yuj chi' manh he chi nok'.
Manh he juel he b'a a ex tik yuj nok' nok' manh wach'ok chi', yujto manh wach'ok tzex ajkan yuj nok'.
Ha in ton Jehová he Diosal in, yuj chi' b'esequel he b'ha t'a juntzanh manh wach'ok chi', yujto wach' innhej, yuj chi' te max yal eyixtanb'at he b'a yet' juntzanh nok' chi'.
Ha in Jehová in, ix ex wik'elta t'a Egipto, he Diosal in, yuj chi' te wach'okab'nhej tzeyutej he b'a yujto wach' innhej.
Aton wal masanil juntzanh cheknab'il tik t'a masanil nok' nok', nok' much yet' masanil nok' nok' ay t'a yoltak ha ha' yet' masanil nok' tzek' jachachok t'a sat lu'um tik, swal t'ayex
yik wach' snachajel eyuuj b'ajtil ay nok' wach' syal schiji yet' nok' manh wach'ok max yal schiji, xchi Jehová, xe chi.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés icha tik:
Al masanil juntzanh tik t'a heb' etisraelal: Tato a junok ix ix tz'aj junok swinak unin, yowalil uque' k'ual manh sakok yaj ix icha sleyal, ichataxon yik syilan sb'islab' uj ix t'a juntak el.
D'a wal yukub'ixial yaj jun winak unin chi', tz'ak'ji kirkunkidar.

Axo pax ix nunab'il chi', 33 k'ualto manh wach'ok tz'ajkan ix, ichato wanto sakb'itan sb'a ix, max yal-laj syaman junok tas ix to wik yaji, max yalpax sb'at ix b'aj ay in kajnub' ayik manto tz'akwok juntzanh k'ual chi'.
Palta tato ix unin tz'aj jun, 14 k'ual tz'eq'ui ayik manto sakok yaj ix, ichataxon tz'aj t'a sb'islab' uj t'a juntak el, slajwi chi' 66 k'ual skan ix yik sakb'itan sb'a.

Ayic stz'akwi juntzanh k'ual yik sakb'itan sb'a ix yuj yune' ix alji chi', wach'chom winak unin ma ix unin, yowalil syik'kot junok nok' quelem kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal ix silab'il yet' junok nok' yalnhej makanhil paramuch, syak' ix silab'il yuj yak'ji tup smul. Ha juntzanh chi' tz'ak'ji t'a junok winh sakerdote t'a yichanh mantiado.
Axo jun winh sakerdote chi' tz'ak'an t'ayin silab'il yik wach' tz'ak'ji tup smul ix. Icha chi' tz'aj sakb'ixikan ix. Aton juntzanh sleyal tik ayik tz'alji winak unin, ma ix unin.

Palta tato a ix nunab'il chi' malaj junok nok' skalnel chi' syal yak'ani, syik'kot chawanhok nok' paramuch ix yalnhej tas makanhil, jun nok' stz'a silab'il, jun nok' tz'ak'ji silab'il yuj yak'ji tup mul. Axo junok winh sakerdote tz'ak'an silab'il yik wach' tz'ak'ji tup smul ix. Icha chi' tz'aj sakb'ixikan ix, xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón:

Tato ay junok anima smalk'e sniwanil, ma sk'e wochjab', ma chak sulinak tz'aj yilji sniwanil, talaj lepra jun yab'il chi', yowalil tz'ik'jikot t'a winhaj Aarón, ma t'a juntzanhokxo heb' sakerdote yinhtilal winh.

Axo winh sakerdote chi' tz'ilan jun yab'il chi'. Tato a xiil b'aj ay jun yab'il chi', sakxo, ma niwan chequel to manhoknhej t'a stz'umal ay jun yab'il chi', palta julxo yich, a jun yab'il chi' lepraxo. Ayic toxo ix ilji jun anima chi' yuj winh sakerdote, a winh tz'alani to maxtzak yal-laj yajek' jun anima chi' t'a skal yetanimail.
Tato sakxo yilji stz'umal b'aj ay jun yab'il chi', palta to anhej t'a stz'umal ayochi, manh sakok pax xiil chi' ta', yowalil smakchaj jun anima chi' yuj winh sakerdote chi' uqueok k'ual.
Axo slajwi uque' k'ual chi', sayjixi iljok jun anima chi'. Tato a jun yab'il chi' anheja' max b'eyb'ati, smakchajxi uqueokxo k'ual.

Ayic slajwi uquexo k'ual chi', sayjixi iljok jun anima chi' yuj winh sakerdote chi'. Tato a jun yab'il chi' wanxo sateli, maxtzak b'eyb'at t'a stz'umal jun anima chi', ichato chi' syalan winh sakerdote chi' to manh lepraok tz'ik'ani, komon yab'ilnhej. Slajwi chi' sjuk'anel spichul jun penaay chi', wach'xo tz'ajxikani.
Palta tato a jun yab'il t'a sniwanil junok anima chi' sb'at lheb'heb'ok, wach'chom toxo ix yal winh sakerdote to manh lepraok, yowalil skotxi t'a winh sakerdote chi' yik sayanxi yil winh.
Tato a syilan winh sakerdote chi' to wan sb'at lheb'heb'ok jun yab'il chi', syal winh to a jun yab'il chi' lepra toni.
Tato ay junok anima ay lepra t'ay, yowalil tz'ik'jikot t'a winh sakerdote.
Ha winh sakerdote chi' tz'ilani tato wan smalk'ei, sakxo yilji sat chi', wanxo pax sakb'i xiil t'a sat chi', chequelxo sb'ak'chil.

Tato icha chi', aton jun chi' skuchan lepra, kotak skal sch'oxank'e sb'ha t'a stz'umal chi', yuj chi' syalan winh sakerdote chi' to maxtzak yal-laj yajek' t'a skal heb' yetanimail. Manhxo yowalilok smakchaj t'a uqueokxo k'ual.
Tato elanhchamel sb'at lheb'naj jun yab'il chi', smajel sniwanil chi' yuj, ato ha' tz'aj yilanoch winh sakerdote chi',
ayik slajwi yilan winh, tato toxo ix majel sniwanil chi', sakxonhej yilji jun anima chi', syalan winh to manhxalaj smay.
Tato ay junok k'ual scheklajk'e sb'ak'chil t'a skal jun yab'il chi', maxtzak yal-laj yajek' jun anima chi' t'a skal heb' yetanimail.
Axo winh sakerdote tz'ilan jun yab'il chi', tato ay b'aj tz'el tochnaj stz'umal ichnhej ta', syalan winh to lepra tz'ik'ani, maxtzak yal-laj yajek' t'a skal heb' yetanimail.
Palta tato sakb'ixiel b'aj ix el tochnaj chi', yowalil skot jun anima chi' t'a winh sakerdote,
yik wach' say yil winh. Ha winh sakerdote chi' tz'ilani tato sakxo yilji jun yab'il chi', syalan winh to manhxalaj smay jun yab'il chi'.
Tato ay mach ayk'e junok yab'il mal t'ay, stakjixiemi,
haxo t'a sat chi' smali, sak yilji, ma chak sulinak yilji, a jun chi' yowalil skot t'a yichanh winh sakerdote.

Axo winh sakerdote chi' tz'ilani, tato manhoknhej t'a stz'umal ayoch jun yab'il chi', tato sakxo xiil t'a sat jun yab'il chi', a winh tz'alani to lepra jun yab'il chi', yuj chi' maxtzak yal-laj yajek' jun anima chi' t'a skal heb' yetanimail.
Tato syil winh sakerdote chi', to max sakb'ilaj xiil b'aj ay sat chi' to t'a satnhej stz'umal ayochi, wanxo stakji, a jun anima chi' yowalil smakchaj uqueok k'ual.

Ayic slajwi uque' k'ual chi', tato yelk'olalnhej sb'at lheb'heb'ok jun yab'il chi' t'a stz'umal jun anima chi', syalan winh sakerdote chi' to lepra tz'ik'ani, maxtzak yal-laj yajek' t'a skal heb' yetanimail.
Palta tato max b'at lheb'heb'ok jun yab'il chi', syalelk'ochi to anhej sjech'al aykani, syalan winh sakerdote chi' to manhxalaj smay jun yab'il chi'.

Q'uinalok ay junok mach ay yaxk'ha t'a sniwanil, tato scheklaj sb'ak'chil jun anima b'aj ay yaxk'a chi', haxo t'a sb'ak'chil chi' scheklajpaxk'e junok setanh saksak, ma chak sulinak to sb'at lheb'heb'ok.

Ha winh sakerdote tz'ilani, tato a xiil wanxo sakb'i, wanxo sb'at yich jun setanh b'aj ay sat chi', tato icha chi', lepra ix cheklajk'e b'aj ay yaxk'a chi', haxo winh sakerdote chi' tz'alani to maxtzak yal-laj yajek' jun anima chi' t'a skal heb' yetanimail.
Tato a syilan winh sakerdote to malaj junok xil wan sakb'ieli, to manh wanok sb'at yich jun yab'il chi', palta to wan stakjiemi, yowalil smakchaj jun anima chi' t'a uqueok k'ual.
Slajwi chi', sayanxi yil winh sakerdote chi', tato toxo ix b'at lheb'heb'ok t'a sniwanil jun anima chi', syalan winh to lepra tz'ik'ani, maxtzak yal-laj yajek' t'a skal heb' yetanimail.
Palta tato a b'aj setquixtak chi', waanochi, wanxo sb'oxi, tonhej smal yuj b'aj stz'ai, syalan winh sakerdote chi' to a jun yab'il chi' malaj smay, anhej sjech'al b'aj stz'a chi' skani.
Tato ha t'a junok winak ma t'a junok ix ix sk'e yab'il yaxk'ha t'a sjolom, ma t'a yuk'ti',
a winh sakerdote yowalil sayan yil jun chi'. Tato a jun yab'il chi' wan sb'at yich, mato wan sk'anb'iel xiil yuj, syalan winh sakerdote chi' to lepra jun ayoch chi' t'a jun anima chi'.
Palta tato max b'atlaj yich jun yab'il chi', manh k'ik'ok wal xiil b'aj ay yab'il chi', yowalil smakchaj jun anima chi' uqueok k'ual.
Axo slajwi uque' k'ual chi', sayanxi yil winh sakerdote chi', maxtzak b'atlaj lheb'heb'ok jun yab'il chi', malaj yich, max k'anb'iel-laj xiil,
syalan winh to sjoxjiel stitak yab'il, palta max joxjiel-laj t'a sat yab'il, smakchaj uqueokxo k'ual jun anima chi'.

Axo yik toxo ix ek'b'at uquexo k'ual chi', sayanxi yil winh sakerdote chi'. Tato max b'at lheb'heb'ok, max b'at yich yuj, syalan winh to malaj smay jun yab'il chi', anhej to sjuk'el spichul jun anima chi', wach' tz'ajxikani.
Palta tato ayik toxo ix alchaji to wach' sk'ol jun anima chi', sb'atxi lheb'heb'ok jun yab'il chi',
yowalil sayxi yil winh sakerdote chi'. Tato a jun yab'il chi' wan sb'at lheb'heb'ok t'a stz'umal, manh yowalilok k'an yilji xiil, lepra tz'ik'ani.
Palta tato wanxo stakji, k'ik' skotxi xiil, a winh sakerdote chi' tz'alani to wach'xo sk'ol jun anima chi'.
Tato a junok winak ma junok ix ix setquixtak saksak t'a stz'umal,
a winh sakerdote tz'ilan stz'umal chi', tato saktak wal yilji, palta manh kopopioklaj, komon yab'il tz'ik'an jun anima chi' syal chi', malaj smay.
Tato ay junok winak sk'ajb'anel xil sjolom ma anhej t'a snanhal sat sk'ajb'anel xiil, manhxalaj xiil skani, a jun chi' malaj smay.

Palta tato sk'e junok yab'il yaxk'a b'aj manhxalaj xiil chi', yowalil syil winh sakerdote. Tato chak sulinak yilji jun yaxk'a chi' icha yab'il lepra, aton lepra ayoch t'ay. Syalan winh sakerdote chi' to a jun anima chi', maxtzak yal-laj yajek' t'a skal yetanimail yuj jun yab'il chi'.

Ha mach penaay yuj lepra, yowalil a pichul nhik'chimtak syak'ochi, malaj smusil sjolom syak'k'ei, smusan nanhalok sat. Tato sb'at t'a skal anima, tz'el yaw, syalan icha tik: Elanhec, chuk waji, chuk waji, xchi.
Ayic ayoch jun yab'il chi' t'ay, yowalil sch'okoj tz'aj t'a spatiquel kampamento.
Ayic k'ustumtak yilji junok pichul lana, ma lino,
yalnhej tas makanhil, pach'uch'ab'il, ma jalb'il, ma junok tz'uum to yamk'ab' yaji,

tato yaax yilji, ma chakchak yilji juntzanh sk'ustumtaquil chi', aton jun makan to tz'el lheb'heb'ok. Ha jun chi' yowalil sch'oxji t'a winh sakerdote yik syilan jun setanh sk'ustumtaquil chi' winh, smakchaj jun chi' uqueok k'ual.

Axo slajwi uque' k'ual chi', tz'iljixi. Tato toxo ix b'at lheb'heb'ok t'a jun pichul chi', ma t'a junok tz'um sk'anji chi', a jun chi' aton juntzanh k'ustumtak tz'el lheb'heb'ok, a juntzanh yamk'ab' chi' ay smay.
Yalnhej tas yamk'ab'il to ayxo jun chi' t'ay, yowalil snhusjitz'a smasanil, yujto a jun chi' tzijtum tas syixtejb'ati.
Palta tato ayik syilan winh sakerdote chi' to max b'eylaj juntzanh sk'ustumtaquil chi',
syalan winh to sjuk'chajel jun yamk'ab' chi', smakchajkan uqueokxo k'ual.

Ayic toxo ix juk'chajel jun yamk'ab' chi', ichato chi' syilanxi winh sakerdote chi'. Tato max k'exmaj yilji jun setanh sk'ustumtaquil chi', wach'chom max el lheb'heb'ok, yowalil snhusjitz'aok, wach'chom a jun sk'ustumtaquil chi' ayoch t'a spatik ma t'a yool, yujto yelxo ay smay jun chi'.
Tato a syilan winh sakerdote chi' ayik toxo ix juk'chajel chi', wanxo satel jun sk'ustumtaquil chi', slod'chajel b'aj ayoch chi'.
Palta tato scheklajxik'e sk'ustumtaquil jun chi', yowalil snhusjitz'aok.
Ha juntzanh tastak b'aj satel juntzanh k'ustumtak chi' ayik sjuk'chajeli, yowalil sjuk'chajel junelxo, icha chi' syal sk'anchajxi.

Aton juntzanh cheknab'il tik t'a k'ustum tz'och t'a junok pichul pach'uch'ab'il, ma jalb'il, lana, ma lino, ma junok tz'uum. Icha chi' tz'aj scheklajkaneli tato wach' yaji, mato manh wach'ok yaji, xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón chi'.
Ix schek Jehová yal juntzanh ley tik winhaj Moisés, ix yalani:

Aton wal jun ley tik sk'anab'ajej junok anima ek'nak lepra t'ay: Ayic snaani to ix b'oxi sk'ool, yowalil syawtej winh sakerdote t'a spatiquel kampamento chi' yik syilan winh tato manhxa lepra chi' t'ay. Tato syil winh sakerdote chi' to toxo ix el jun yab'il chi', schekan winh ik'chajkot chawanhok nok' much t'a spitzanil, aton nok' wach' icha yalan ley. Scotpax jab'ok te' k'ute', lana ch'al k'ik' schaquil yet' te' hisopo.
Schekan miljokcham junok nok' much chi' winh sakerdote t'a yib'anh ha ha' ayem t'a yol junok lum chen, aton ha' skot b'aj sk'eul sjaj junok ha ha'.
Slajwi chi' tz'ik'jikot junxo nok' much chi' t'a spitzanil, te' k'ute' yet' lana ch'al k'ik' schaquil yet' te' hisopo, slab'chajem t'a skal schiq'uil nok' chamnakxo chi' kalan yet' ha ha'.
Uquel stzikjioch t'a jun mach b'aj ek'nak jun yab'il chi', syalan winh sakerdote chi' to wach'xo jun anima chi'. Axo nok' much pitzan chi' tz'aktajkanel nok'.

Ha jun mach tz'ilji to wach'xo, yowalil sjuk'el spichul, sb'ikanpaxel sb'a, sjoxanel xil sjolom smasanil, yik wach'xonhej tz'ajkani. Ichato chi' syalxo yoch t'a yol kampamento, palta uqueto k'ual skan ichnhej ta', maxto yal-laj yoch t'a yol b'aj kajantaxoni.

Axo t'a yuquil k'ual chi', wach' tz'aj sjoxjiel sjolom. Wach' tz'aj sjoxanel xil sti' yet' sk'u sat yet' pax masanil xil ay t'a sniwanil, sjuk'anel spichul, sb'ikanpaxel sb'a. Icha chi' tz'aj sb'oxikani.

Axo t'a junxo k'u, syik'ankot chawanhok nok' kelemtak kalnel yet' junok nok' kob'es kalnel, jun ab'il sk'inal junjun nok', malaj jab'ok spaltail nok'. Scotpax nanhal yuquil libra ixim harina te wach' kalab'il yet' akeite, tz'ak'ji ofrendail yet' pax oxeok oktawo akeite.
Axo winh sakerdote chi' schekanoch linhan jun anima yet' yofrenda chi' t'a yichanh Jehová t'a stielxo skajnub' b'aj sch'ox sb'a.
Slajwi chi', tz'ik'jikot jun nok' quelem kalnel chi' yet' akeite, sb'akhchajb'at t'a yichanh Jehová silab'il yuj smul jun anima chi'.

Ha b'aj schamtaxon nok' tz'ak'ji silab'il yuj mul yet' nok' silab' stz'a smasanil, ata' smiljicham nok' quelem kalnel chi', yujto a nok' tz'ak'ji yuj mul, yik winh sakerdote tz'ajkan nok', icha nok' tz'ak'ji yuj stupkanel mul, a juntzanh tik yik Jehová yaji.

Slajwi chi' a winh sakerdote chi' tz'ik'ankot jab'ok schiq'uil nok' silab' yuj mul, sukanoch winh t'a sjayil schiquin t'a swach' jun mach sb'oxi sk'ol chi', t'a smam sk'ab' t'a swach' yet' t'a yiximal smam yok t'a swach'.
Syik'anpaxkot jab'ok akeite winh sakerdote chi', sekanem winh t'a yol sk'ab' t'a sk'exanh,
slab'anem jun sb'ab'el yiximal sk'ab' winh t'a swach' t'a skal akeite, stziquem uquelok akeite chi' winh t'a yichanh Jehová.

Ha akeite tzato kan t'a sk'ab' winh sakerdote chi', sukoch winh t'a jun anima ix b'oxi sk'ool chi', anheja' t'a sjayil schiquin t'a swach', t'a smam sk'ab' t'a swach' yet' pax t'a yiximal smam yok t'a swach', aton b'aj ayxo och schiq'uil nok' silab' yuj smul.
Axo jab'okxo akeite tz'ak'jikank'e t'a sjolom jun anima chi'. Icha chi' tz'aj stupkan smul t'a yichanh Jehová.

Slajwi chi' syak'anpax nok' silab' winh sakerdote chi', aton nok' silab' yuj yak'ji tup mul. Icha chi' tz'aj stupkanel smul jun anima chi'. Slajwi chi', smiljicham nok' kalnel stz'a smasanil silab'il.
Junnhej tz'aj yak'jik'e nok' t'a yib'anh altar yet' ofrenda tz'ak'ji t'a tas swaji. Icha wal chi' tz'aj stupkanel smul jun anima chi' t'a yichanh Jehová, sb'oxikani.

Tato meb'a' jun anima b'aj ix ek' jun yab'il chi', malaj stumin yik syak' nok' silab' sk'anchaj chi', anhej junok nok' quelem kalnel syik'koti yik sb'akhchajoch silab'il t'a yichanh Jehová yuj smul, chab'nhej libra ixim harina te wach' kalab'il yet' akeite syak'a' yet' oxeok oktawo akeite.
Syik'paxkot chawanhok nok' paramuch yalnhej tas makanhil, ato ha' jantak stzak'wan smanani. Jun nok' tz'ak'ji silab'il yuj yak'ji tup smul, jun nok' snhusjitz'aok.
Ha t'a swajxaquil k'ual syik'ankot masanil juntzanh tik jun anima chi' t'a winh sakerdote yik sakb'ikaneli. Ha juntzanh tik tz'ak'jioch t'a yichanh Jehová t'a stielxo skajnub' b'aj sch'ox sb'a.
Slajwi chi' syik'ankot jun nok' kalnel winh sakerdote yet' akeite chi', sb'akhanek' winh t'a yichanh Jehová t'a silab'il yuj yak'ji tup smul jun anima chi'.

Smilancham nok' quelem kalnel chi' winh, syik'ank'e jab'ok schiq'uil nok' winh, sukanoch winh t'a sjayil schiquin jun anima chi' t'a swach', t'a smam sk'ab' t'a swach' yet' t'a yiximal smam yok t'a swach'.
Slajwi chi' syak'ank'e jab'ok akeite chi' winh t'a yol sk'ab' t'a sk'exanh.
Yed' sb'ab'el yiximal sk'ab' winh t'a swach', stzikanem uquelok akeite ayem t'a yol sk'ab' winh chi' t'a yichanh Jehová.
Syak'paxoch jab'ok akeite chi' winh t'a schiquin jun anima chi' t'a swach', t'a smam sk'ab' t'a swach' yet' t'a yiximal smam yok t'a swach', aton b'aj toxo ix och schiq'uil nok' silab' chi'.
Axo jab'okxo akeite chi' skani, syak'k'e winh sakerdote chi' t'a sjolom jun anima chi', yik stupkanel smul t'a yichanh Jehová.
Slajwi chi', smilancham nok' paramuch chi' winh sakerdote chi' schawanhil.

Ha junok nok' paramuch chi' tz'ak'ji silab'il yuj yak'ji tup mul, haxo junxo nok' snhusjitz'aok yet' pax ixim harina tz'ak'jipax t'a ofrendail. Icha chi' tz'aj stupkan smul jun anima ix b'oxi chi' t'a yichanh Jehová.
Aton sleyalil tik t'a junok mach ix ek' lepra t'ay, yik tz'alchaji to ix sakb'ixikani tato max tzak'wan yak'an juntzanh silab' icha wal sleyalil, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón:
Ayic ayexxo ek' t'a lum Canaán, aton lum ol wak' eyikok, talaj swak'b'at junok tas k'ustak yilji tz'el lheb'heb'ok t'a yol he pat ta',
a mach ay yik te' pat chi' yowalil skot t'a junok winh sakerdote syalani: Ay juntzanh k'ustumtak yilji wan yel lheb'heb'ok t'a yol in pat, xchama.

Ayic manto och winh sakerdote t'a yol pat chi', yowalil syal winh to tz'elta masanil tastak ay t'a yol te', yik wach' max kan juntzanh k'ael chi' t'a yol pat tato syal winh sakerdote chi' to manh wach'ok yaj jun pat chi'. Slajwi chi' tz'och winh yil tas yilji jun k'ustum tz'el lheb'heb'ok chi'.
Tato ayik syilanoch winh to ha t'a sattak pat chi' ay juntzanh niwak k'ustum lheb'quiltak, yaax yilji, ma chak yilji, yelk'olal to sb'at t'a yol sattak pat chi',
haxo tz'elxita winh t'a yol te' pat chi', syalan winh to smakchajkan te' uqueok k'ual.
Ayic slajwi uque' k'ual chi', sb'atxi winh sakerdote chi' yila'. Tato toxo ix te b'at lheb'heb'ok jun sk'ustumtaquil chi' t'a sattak pat chi',
yowalil syal winh sakerdote chi' to slipjielta masanil k'een k'een b'aj toxo ix och juntzanh lheb'quiltak chi', b'at yumchajkan t'a junok lugar manh wach'ok t'a stiel chonhab'.
Syalanpax winh to sjoschajel masanil sattak yol te' pat chi', haxo masanil spokokal tz'el t'a yool chi', sb'at yumchajkan t'a junok lugar manh wach'ok t'a stiel chonhab'.
Ch'okxo k'een k'een tz'ochpaxkan sk'exulok k'een tz'ik'chajelta chi', ch'okxo lum lum tz'ochpax t'a sattak yol pat chi'.
Tato scheklajxik'e juntzanh k'ustum lheb'quiltak chi' ayik toxo ix ik'jiel k'een k'een chi' yet' toxo ix joschajel sattak pat chi', toxo ix ochpaxkan sk'exul,
sb'at yilanxi winh sakerdote chi'. Tato toxo ix el lheb'heb'ok jun sk'ustumtaquil chi', manhxo wach'ok tz'ajkan jun pat chi'.
Yuj chi', a jun pat chi' yowalil spojchajemi. Masanil te te', k'een k'een yet' lum lum ayoch t'a jun pat chi', b'at ak'jikan t'a junok lugar to manh wach'ok t'a stiel chonhab'.
Yalnhej mach tz'och t'a yol jun pat chi' t'a uque' k'ual ayik toxo ix yal winh sakerdote to smakchajkani, manh wach'ok tz'ajkani icha yalan ley, masanto t'a sq'uik'b'ikanemi.
Yalnhej mach swa'i, ma sway t'a jun pat chi', yowalil sjuk'el spichul.
Palta tato ayik tz'och winh sakerdote yil jun pat chi', syilan winh to a juntzanh lheb'quiltak chi' max b'eyb'ati yiktax ix b'ojikan yol te' pat chi', syal winh to wach'xo jun pat chi'.
Yic sakb'ixikan te' pat chi', tz'ik'jikot chawanhok nok' much yet' jab'ok te' k'ute' yet' lana ch'al k'ik' schaquil yet' te' hisopo.
Smilancham junok nok' much chi' winh sakerdote t'a yib'anh ha ha' ayem t'a yol jun lum chen, aton ha' skot b'aj sk'eul sjaj junok ha ha'.

Slajwi chi' syik'anb'at te' k'ute' chi' winh yet' te' hisopo yet' lana ch'al k'ik' schaquil yet' junxo nok' much pitzanto, slab'anem winh t'a skal ha ha' kalanxo yaj yet' schiq'uil nok' much ix miljicham chi' t'a yol lum chen chi'. Uquel stzikoch winh t'a te' pat chi'.
Icha chi' tz'aj sakb'ixikan jun te' pat chi' yuj schiq'uil nok' much chi' yet' ha ha' sk'eul sjaj, yuj nok' much pitzanto, yuj te' k'ute', yuj te' hisopo yet' lana ch'al k'ik' schaquil.
Slajwi chi', tz'aktajkanb'at jun nok' much pitzan chi' t'a stiel chonhab'. Icha chi' tz'aj sk'anab'ajaj sleyalil t'a junok pat, wach' tz'ajkani, xchi Jehová.

Aton juntzanh cheknab'il tik t'a yib'anh lepra smalk'ei, mato t'a yaxk'ail, mato t'a lheb'quiltak saksak yilji, mato t'a juntzanh k'ustumtak t'a pichul yet' t'a spatiktak te' pat. Icha chi' tz'aj snachajel tastak to manh wach'ok yet' tastak to wach'. Aton t'a tik slajwikan cheknab'il t'a juntzanh tik.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón

to syal masanil juntzanh cheknab'il tik heb' winh t'a heb' yetisraelal. Yuj chi' ix yalan heb' icha tik: Tato ay junok winak ay junok yab'il t'a sniwanil, yuj chi' ay tas tz'el t'a swinaquil, a jun chi' manh wach'ok yaji icha yalan ley.
Wach'chom tz'elnhej juntzanh chi', ma ay b'aj tz'och waan jayeok k'ual tz'elxi, manh wach'ok yaji, icha yalan ley.
Yalnhej tas waynub'al b'aj sway winh winak chi', ma yalnhej tas k'ojnub'al b'aj tz'em k'ojan winh, manh wach'ok tz'ajkani.
Yalnhej mach syaman swaynub' jun winak chi', yowalil sjuk'el spichul sb'ikanpaxel sb'a, palta manh wach'ok tz'ajkani masanto sq'uik'b'iemi.
Yalnhej mach tz'em k'ojan b'aj ix em k'ojan jun winak chi', yowalil sjuk'el spichul, sb'ikanpaxel sb'a, palta manh wach'ok tz'ajkani masanto sq'uik'b'iemi.
Yalnhej mach syaman junok winak ay tas tz'el t'ay, yowalil sjuk'el spichul, sb'ikanpaxel sb'a, palta manh wach'ok yaji masanto sq'uik'b'iemi.

Tato a junok winak ay tas tz'el t'ay chi', stzub'anoch t'a junokxo anima, a jun anima b'aj ix och stzub' chi', yowalil sjuk'el spichul, sb'ikanpaxel sb'a, palta manh wach'ok tz'ajkani masanto sq'uik'b'iemi.
Tato a jun winak ay tas tz'el t'ay chi' sk'e t'a yib'anh chej, a stz'um nok' chi' manh wach'ok tz'ajkani.

Yalnhej mach syaman junok tas b'aj tz'em k'ojan jun winak to ay tas tz'el t'ay chi', manh wach'ok tz'ajkani masanto sq'uik'b'iemi. Yalnhej mach tz'ik'anb'at junok juntzanh tastak chi', yowalil sjuk' spichul, sb'ikanpaxel sb'a, palta manh wach'ok tz'ajkani, icha yalan ley masanto sq'uik'b'iemi.

Tato a jun winak ay tas tz'el t'ay chi', max sb'iklaj sk'ab' syaman junokxo mach, a jun ix yamji yuj chi', yowalil sjuk'el spichul, sb'ikanpaxel sb'a, palta manh wach'ok tz'ajkani masanto sq'uik'b'iemi.
Tato ay junok chen syam jun winak ay tas tz'el t'ay chi', yowalil smak'jipoj jun chen chi'. Tato a junok te te' yamk'ab' yaj syam jun winak chi', tonhej sb'ikchajel te'.

Tato sb'oxi sk'ol jun winak chi, manhxa tas tz'el t'ay, yowalil stanhwej uqueok k'ual, ichato chi' skanxi wach'il t'a yichanh ley. Slajwi chi' sjuk'anel spichul, sb'ikanel sb'ha t'a ha ha' sk'eul sjaj. Icha chi' tz'aj sb'oxikani, icha yalan ley.
Axo t'a swajxaquil k'ual, yowalil syik'kot chawanhok nok' paramuch yalnhej tas makanhil, skot t'a yichanh Jehová sk'och t'a stielxo skajnub' b'aj sch'ox sb'a, syak'an nok' t'a junok winh sakerdote.

Jun nok' syak' winh sakerdote chi' silab'il yuj yak'ji tup smul jun anima chi', haxo junxo nok' snhusjitz'aok. Ha winh sakerdote chi' tz'ak'anoch masanil juntzanh chi' t'a yichanh Jehová, yik sakb'ixikan jun winak ek'nak jun yaelal chi' t'ay.
Tato a junok winak tonhej tz'el yinhatil, yowalil sb'iquel sb'a, palta manh wach'ok tz'ajkani, icha yalan ley, masanto sq'uik'b'iemi.
Yalnhej tas k'apaquil ma tz'uum b'aj ix och yinhatil jun winak chi', yowalil sjuk'jieli, manh wach'ok tz'ajkani, icha yalan ley masanto sq'uik'b'iemi.
Tato a junok winh winak yet' junok ix ix ay tas sk'ulej, yowalil sb'iquel sb'a heb', palta manh wach'ok tz'ajkan heb', icha yalan ley masanto sq'uik'b'iemi.
Tato a junok ix ix ayoch t'a stiempoal sb'islab' uj, manh wach'oklaj yaj ix t'a uqueok k'ual. Yalnhej mach syaman ix, manh wach'ok tz'ajkani, icha yalan ley masanto sq'uik'b'iemi.
Yalnhej tas waynub'al b'aj tzek' jichan ix ayik ayoch ix t'a stiempoal chi', ma yalnhej tas k'ojnub'al b'aj tz'em k'ojan ix, manh wach'oklaj tz'ajkani.

Yalnhej mach syaman b'aj ix ek' jichan ix chi', ma syaman junok tas b'aj tz'em k'ojan ix, manh wach'oklaj tz'ajkani. Yowalil sjuk'el spichul, sb'ikanel sb'a, palta manh wach'ok tz'ajkani masanto sq'uik'b'iemi.
Tato ay junok winh winak sway yet' ix, sb'onhchaj winh yuj tas tz'el chi' t'a ix, manh wach'oklaj tz'ajkan winh t'a uque' k'ual, anhejtona' manh wach'ok tz'ajkan waynub' b'aj sway winh winak chi'.
Tato ay junok ix ix tz'ilan uj t'a manh stiempoalok, mato te niwan tiempo syak' ix yilani, a jun ix chi' manh wach'ok tz'ajkan ix ayik ayto tas tz'el chi' t'a ix, icha wal to aytooch ix t'a yilan uj.
Yalnhej tas waynub'al b'aj sway ix, ma k'ojnub' b'aj tz'em k'ojan ix ayik ayto tas tz'el chi' t'a ix, manh wach'ok tz'ajkan juntzanh chi', ichato ayoch ix t'a sb'islab' uj chi'.
Yalnhej mach syaman juntzanh tastak chi', manh wach'oklaj tz'ajkani, yowalil sjuk'el spichul, sb'ikanpaxel sb'a, palta manh wach'ok tz'ajkani masanto sq'uik'b'iemi.
Ayic swanaj yilan uj ix chi', uque' k'ual stanhwej ix, slajwi chi' sb'oxikan ix, icha yalan ley.
Axo t'a swajxaquil k'ual, syik'ankot chawanhok nok' paramuch ix yalnhej tas makanhil, syik'ankot ix t'a junok winh sakerdote, t'a stielxo skajnub' b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová.

Jun nok' syak' winh sakerdote chi' silab'il yuj yak'ji tup smul ix, haxo junxo nok' snhusjitz'a nok'. Icha chi' tz'aj yak'anoch jun silab' chi' winh sakerdote chi' t'a yichanh Jehová yik tz'ak'ji tup smul ix, yuj tas ix el t'ay.
Icha chi' tz'aj ko sakb'itan ko b'a a onh israel onh tik t'a tas tzonh ik'ani, yik max quixtejel skajnub' Jehová ayek' t'a ko kal tik, tato maay tzonh chami, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Aton juntzanh cheknab'il tik t'a heb' winak ay tas tz'el t'ay, ma tonhej tz'el yinhatil, yuj chi' manh wach'ok tz'ajkan yuj

yet' t'a heb' ix ix ayoch t'a sb'islab' uj. Ha juntzanh cheknab'il tik, yowalil sk'anab'ajaj yuj heb' ay syaelal icha chi', winak, ma ix. Tz'ochpax jun ley chi' t'a yib'anh junok winak sway yet' ix ix to manh wach'ok yaji, icha yalan ley.
Ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés ayik ix lajwi scham chawanh heb' yuninal winhaj Aarón, yujto ix skomon nitzejb'at sb'a heb' t'a slak'anil Jehová,

ix yalan t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: Al t'a winh uk'tak aj Aarón to max komon och winh t'a yol in kajnub' t'a jun lugar Vicnhej Yaji, aton jun lugar ay t'a spatikoch k'apak kortina. Max yal-laj skomon k'och winh b'aj ay smakul b'aj tz'ak'ji tup mul, aton smakul te' skaxail in trato, yik max cham winh, yujto a in ol in ch'ox in b'ha t'a skal asun t'a yib'anh smakul skaxail in trato chi'.
Ayic tz'och winhaj Aarón t'a yol jun lugar chi', yowalil syik'kot junok nok' quelem wakax winh yik tz'och silab'ok yuj smul yet' junok nok' ch'ak kalnel snhusjitz'a smasanil.

Syak'och spichul winh nab'a lino, aton spichul winh jukan, yol swex winh, k'apak stzek'ul snanhal winh yet' sb'ak'ul sjolom winh. Ha juntzanh pichul chi' te niwan yelk'ochi, yuj chi' b'ab'el sb'iquel sb'a winh ichato chi' syak'anoch winh.
Axo heb' eyetisraelal syik'kot chawanhok nok' mam chiwa heb' yik tz'ak'ji nok' silab'il yuj smul heb', syik'paxkot junok nok' ch'ak kalnel heb' yik snhusjitz'aok.
Syik'ankot nok' quelem wakax chi' winhaj Aarón chi' yik tz'och nok' silab'ok yuj smul. Ha jun nok' chi' yik nok' winh, yuj yak'ji tup smul winh yet' masanil heb' ayek' t'a yol spat.
Slajwi chi' syik'anpaxkot chawanh nok' mam chiwa chi' winh t'a yichanh in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a.
Syak'anoch suerte winh t'a yib'anh nok' chiwa chi' schawanhil: Jun nok' tz'ak'ji silab'ok t'ayin, haxo junxo nok', tz'ak'chajkanoch mul t'a yib'anh nok', spechchajkanb'at nok' t'a tzinan lu'um.
Ha nok' tz'em suerte t'a yib'anh to wiko', syik'kot nok' winhaj Aarón chi' silab'ok yik stupkanel smul heb' israel.
Axo junxo nok' chiwa chi', t'a spitzanil nok' tz'och t'a wichanh, tz'ak'jikanoch mul t'a yib'anh nok', tz'aktajkanb'at nok' t'a tzinan lu'um syik'ankanb'at smul heb' israel chi' nok'.
Ayic listaxo yaj juntzanh tik smasanil, smilancham nok' quelem wakax winhaj Aarón chi', syak'an nok' winh silab'il yik tz'ak'ji tup smul yet' smul masanil heb' ayek' yet' winh t'a yol spat.

Slajwi chi', syik'ankot jun chaynub' yik inkienso winh, b'ut'an yet' stzak'aq'uil altar ay t'a wichanh yet' cha b'echanhok inkienso suk'uq'ui sjab', syik'anoch winh t'a yoloch k'apak kortina ayoch t'a snanhal in kajnub'.
Syak'anem inkienso chi' winh t'a yib'anh tzak'ak' t'a wichanh, haxo t'a yib'anh smakul b'aj tz'ak'ji tup mul, aton smakul skaxail in trato, tz'och moyan stab'il inkienso chi' yik wach' max cham winh.

Syik'ankot jab'ok schiq'uil nok' quelem wakax chi' winh, slab'anem yiximal sk'ab' winh t'a skal chik' chi', stzikanb'at winh t'a yib'anh smakul kaxa chi' b'aj tz'ochk'och winh chi', uquel stzikoch chik' chi' winh t'a yichanh smakul chi'.

Slajwi chi', tz'elxita winh, smilancham nok' chiwa winh, aton nok' tz'och silab'il yuj smul heb' israel, syik'anoch schiq'uil nok' winh t'a yoloch k'apak kortina chi', stzikanpaxem schiq'uil nok' chi' winh t'a yib'anh smakul kaxa chi' yet' t'a yichanh, icha syutej schiq'uil nok' quelem wakax winh t'a sb'ab'elal.

Icha wal chi' syutej winhaj Aarón chi' sakb'itan jun lugar Vicnhej Yaji yuj yalxonhej tas chukal yet' spitalil heb' israel tik. Icha chi' ol aj sakb'ikan masanil in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, aton jun ayek' eyed'ok t'a skal chukal tze k'ulej.

Malaj junok mach ayek' t'a yol in kajnub' yakb'an ayoch winhaj Aarón chi' t'a jun lugar Vicnhej Yaji yik syak'an silab' winh yik stup smul yet' smul masanil heb' ayek' yet' winh t'a yol spat yet' smul heb' chonhab' masanil.

Slajwi yelxita winh, sakb'itan altar winh ayek' t'a wichanh, aton b'aj snhusjitz'a silab', syik'anelta jab'ok schiq'uil nok' wakax chi' winh yet' jab'ok yik nok' mam chiwa, syak'anoch winh t'a sch'ak altar ay t'a schiquin schanhil.
Stzikanoch uquel schiq'uil nok' nok' chi' winh yet' yiximal sk'ab' t'a yib'anh altar chi', icha chi' tz'aj sakb'itan altar chi' winh yuj he mul a ex israel ex tik.
Slajwi sakb'ikan jun lugar Vicnhej Yaji, in kajnub' yet' pax altar yuj winh, schekan winh ik'jokkot nok' mam chiwa pitzan chi'.

Slajwi chi', syak'anb'at sk'ab' winh schab'il t'a sjolom nok', tz'och ijan winh yalanem smul yet' spitalil heb' yetchonhab' t'a yib'anh nok'. Icha chi' tz'aj skan smul heb' t'a yib'anh nok'. Axo jun winh sik'b'ilxoel b'at ak'ankan nok' t'a tzinan lu'um b'aj te najat.
Stijankanb'at nok' winh ta', satkanb'at nok' t'a taquinh lum chi'. Icha chi' tz'aj yik'jikanb'at smul chonhab' Israel yuj nok', aton b'aj manhxalaj anima tz'eq'ui.

Slajwi chi' tz'ochixta winhaj Aarón t'a yol in kajnub' yik sk'exanel spichul winh ayochi, k'apak nab'a lino, k'apak ayoch yuj winh a tz'ochta t'a yol jun lugar to Vicnhej Yaji, syak'ankan k'apak winh ta'.

Anheja' t'a yol in kajnub' chi' sb'iquel sb'a winh, syak'anoch spichul winh syak'taxonoch t'a yopisio. Slajwi chi', snhusantz'a silab' winh, aton yik winh yet' silab' yik heb' israel chi' smasanil. Icha chi' tz'aj stupkanel smul winh yet' yik heb' yetchonhab' chi'.
Ha jantak xepual nok' silab' yuj mul, snhusjipaxtz'ha t'a yib'anh altar.
Axo winh b'at ak'ankan nok' mam chiwa t'a taquinh lum chi', ayik sjax winh, sjuk'el spichul winh, sb'ikanpaxel sb'a winh. Ichato chi' syal yochta winh t'a yol kampamento.

Ha nok' quelem wakax yet' nok' mam chiwa smiljicham silab'il yuj stupkanel mul, aton nok' tz'ik'jikot schiq'uil t'a yol jun lugar to Vicnhej Yaji, tz'ik'jikanb'at sniwanil nok' t'a spatiquel kampamento. Ata' snhusjitz'a nok' yet' stz'umal yet' masanil sniwanil.
Ha winh snhusantz'a nok' chi', yowalil sjuk'el spichul winh, sb'ikanpaxel sb'a winh, ichato chi' syal yochta winh t'a yol kampamento.

Ha jun tik ley tz'ajkan t'a he kal t'a masanil tiempo ex israel ex, ma heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal. Ha t'a slajunhil k'ual t'a yuquil uj, tzex och t'a tzek'ojk'olal, malaj mach smunlaj t'a jun k'ual chi',
yujto a jun k'ual chi', sk'ual yak'ji silab' yuj he mul yik wach' stupkanel he mul t'a wichanh.
Ha jun k'ual chi', sk'ual ik'oj ip tz'ajkani yet' tzek'ojk'olal, ley tz'ajkan t'a he kal t'a masanil tiempo.

Ha yuj chi' a ol cham winh sat sakerdote, haxo junok heb' yuninal winh tz'ochkan sk'exulok. Tz'ak'chajk'e akeite t'a sjolom, tz'ak'jipax silab' yuj yochkan yopisio, syak'anoch spichul te niwan yelk'ochi.
Ha tz'ak'an silab' yik sakb'itan jun lugar to Vicnhej Yaji, in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a yet' altar. Syak'anpax silab' yik stup smul heb' sakerdote yet' ex israel ex tik.

Ha jun tik ley tz'ajkan t'a he kal t'a masanil tiempo. Junel tz'ak'ji silab' tik t'a yol junjun ab'il yik slajwiel he mul a ex chonhab' israel ex tik, xchi Jehová. Icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová, icha chi' ix yutej winhaj Moisés chi' yalani.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yuninal yet' t'a masanil heb' etchonhab' to in cheknab'il juntzanhxo tik:
Yalnhej mach smilancham junok nok' wakax, junok nok' kalnel, ma junok nok' chiwa silab'ok t'a spatiquel kampamento, ma t'a yool,
palta max yik'kotlaj nok' t'a stielxo in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, yowalil manhxa yalan yik t'a he kal. Ha jun chi' skotkan t'a yib'anh, yujto tonhej stob'kanem schiq'uil nok' ta'.

Icha chi' tz'aj walani yik mantzak he komon milej nok' nok' silab'il t'a spatiquel kampamento, palta to tzeyik'kot nok' t'a stiel in kajnub', haxo junok winh sakerdote tz'ak'anoch nok' silab'il yik junk'olal t'a wichanh.
Ha winh sakerdote chi' stzikanoch schiq'uil nok' t'a spatiktak altar t'a wichanh, aton t'a stielxo in kajnub', snhustz'a xepual nok' winh t'a wichanh, suk'uq'ui sjab' swab'i.
Manhxa b'ak'uinh tzeyak' junokxo silab' t'a heb' enemigo, aton juntzanh b'aj ochnak ex ejmelal. Yujnhej juntzanh chi' ex juwiel t'a wichanh. Ha jun tik ley tz'ajkan t'a he kal t'a masanil tiempo.
Yalnhej mach heb' eyetisraelal, ma ch'ok chonhab'il kajanek' t'a he kal, tato syak' junok silab' stz'ai, ma yalnhej tas silab'il,
palta to max yik'kotlaj t'a stielxo in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a yik tz'ak'ji t'ayin, a jun anima chi', manhxa yalan yik t'a he kal.
Te ay wal yowal in k'ol t'a yalnhej mach eyetisraelal ma junok ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal schi'an schiq'uil nok' nok'. Ha in wal ol in och ajk'olal t'ay, ol in satanel t'a he kal.

Yujto masanil nok' nok' yet' anima, a yuj schiq'uil pitzan, yuj chi' ix wala' to stob'jioch schiq'uil nok' t'a spatiktak altar yik slajwikanel mul. Yujto ha t'a schiq'uil nok' chi' ay sk'inal yuj chi' syal yak'an tup mul chi'.
Yuj chi' swal t'ayex israel ex tik to malaj junok ex, ma heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan t'a he kal syal chi'an schiq'uil nok' nok'.
Yalnhej mach ex ma heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan t'a he kal syamchaj junok nok' nok' yuj, ma junok nok' much, aton nok' toxonton schiji, yowalil syik'kanel schiq'uil nok', smukankan yet' lum lum.
Yujto a chik' chi' ik'an pitzan nok', yuj chi' swal t'ayex to max yal-laj schiji nok' chib'ej aytooch schiq'uil. Yalnhej mach schi'ani, satjiel t'a he kal.

Yalnhej mach ex, ma ch'ok chonhab'il schi'an nok' chib'ej to tonhej schami, mato smiljicham yuj junok nok' chium nok', yowalil sjuk'el spichul, sb'ikanel sb'a, palta manh wach'ok tz'ajkani masanto sq'uik'b'iemi.
Palta tato max sjuk'el spichul, mato max sb'iquel sb'a, skannhej smul chi' t'a yib'anh, xa chi, xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al juntzanh cheknab'il tik smasanil t'a heb' etisraelal: Ha in Jehová he Diosal in.
Manh he b'eyb'alej sb'eyb'al heb' aj Egipto, aton jun chonhab' b'aj ek'nak ex kajan. Manh he b'eyb'alejpax sb'eyb'al heb' aj Canaán, aton b'aj wan ex wik'anb'ati.
k'anab'ajejek in cheknab'il, tze k'anab'ajan he b'eyb'alan in k'ayb'ub'al. Ha in ton Jehová he Diosal in swala'.
B'eyb'alejek in cheknab'il yet' in k'ayb'ub'al. Ha mach ol k'anab'ajanok, ol schanhej sk'inal yuj. Ha in ton Jehová in swala'.
Malajokab' junok winh winak smulan yet' junok ix ix to ayto yuj sb'a yet'ok. Ha inton Jehová in swala'.
Malajokab' junok mach syak' q'uixwelal smam, smulan yet' snun, yelxo wal te chuk yujto snun ton wal.
Malajokab' junok winh winak smulan yet' ix yetb'eyum smam yik max yak' q'uixwelal smam chi'.
Malajokab' junok winh winak smulan yet' yanab': Yanab' yuj smam, ma yuj snun, wach'chom t'a yol spat aljinak ix, mato ch'ok b'aj aljinak, manh smojok smulan yet' ix.
Malajokab' junok winh winak syak' q'uixwelal sb'a smulan yet' ix yixchiquin, yixchiquin yuj yuninal, ma yuj yisil. Max yal-laj smulan yet'ok.
Malajokab' junok winh winak smulan yet' ix yune' ix yisil smam, yisil wal smam chi', schab'il yanab' yaj ix, max yal-laj smulan yet' ix.
Malajokab' junok winh winak smulan yet' ix yanab' smam, yujto ha' och smam chi' yet' ix.
Malajokab' junok winh winak smulan yet' ix snulej ix snun, yujto ha' och ix snun winh chi' yet' ix.
Malajokab' junok winh winak syak' q'uixwelal yuk'tak smam smulan yet' ix yetb'eyum winh, yujto ichato ayto yuj sb'a yet' ix.
Malajokab' junok winh winak smulan yet' ix yalib', yujto yetb'eyum ix winh yuninal winh, max yal-laj smulan winh yet' ix.
Malajokab' junok winh winak syak' q'uixwelal yuk'tak yuj smulan yet' ix yetb'eyum winh yuk'tak chi'.

Tato ay junok winh winak tz'ik'an junok ix ix, max yal-laj smulan winh yet' ix yune' ix, to schab'il yisil yaj ix. Max yalpaxlaj smulan winh yet' ix yixchiquin ix, yixchiquin yuj junok winh yune' ix, ma yuj junok ix yune' ix. Yelxo wal te chuk icha chi', yujto yiknhej ix yaj heb' chi'.
Malajokab' junok winh winak syik'k'e snulej yetb'eyum, max yal-laj yik'ani yakb'an pitzanto ix yetb'eyum chi', yik wach' max och ajk'olal t'a skal heb' ix.
Malajokab' junok winh winak ay tas sk'ulej yet' junok ix ix ayik ayoch ix t'a stiempoal yik sb'isan uj.
Malajokab' junok winh winak smulan yet' ix yetb'eyum junokxo winak, manh wach'ok skan heb' t'a yichanh ley.
Malajokab' junok winh winak snhusantz'a junok yuninal silab'ok t'a jun komon Dios skuchan Moloc. Tato sk'ulej icha chi', malaj welk'och t'a yol sat. Ha in Jehová in swal tik.
Malajokab' junok winh winak smulan yet' junok yetwinaquil, icha sk'ulej yet' junok ix ix, a jun chi' te yajb'entak.
Malajokab' junok winh winak smulan yet' nok' nok', malajokab' junok mach syixtejb'at sb'ha t'a icha chi'. Malajokab' pax junok ix ix smulan yet' junok nok' nok', yujto yelxo wal manhxo smojok.
Malajokab' mach syixtejb'at sb'a yet' juntzanh tik, yujto ha t'a smasanil juntzanh tik, syixtejb'at sb'a juntzanh anima ol wik'el t'a eyichanh tik.
Yuj juntzanh chi', manhxo pax wach'ok yaj sluum heb', wan wak'an yowalil t'a heb', wan wak'an satjokpaxel heb' t'a sluum chi'.

Masanil juntzanh chi', sb'eyb'alej juntzanh anima kajan t'a jun lu'um chi', ayik manto ex k'och kajan a ex tik. Yuj chi' yelxo wal manh wach'ok yaj jun lu'um chi' yuj heb'. Palta a ex israel ex tik yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan t'a he kal, yowalil tze b'eyb'alej, tze k'anab'ajanpax in cheknab'il tik. Manh he k'ulej masanil juntzanh tastak manh wach'ok sk'ulej heb' chi', yik wach' max ex satjipax el a ex tik t'a jun lu'um chi'.
Ha mach sb'eyb'alan juntzanh tastak yajb'entak chi', yowalil satjiel t'a he kal.

Yuj wal chi' b'eyb'alejek in cheknab'il, manh he b'eyb'alej juntzanh b'eyb'al yajb'entak chi', aton juntzanh sb'eyb'alaji ayik manto ex k'ochlaj ta', manh eyixtejb'at he b'ha t'a icha chi'. Ha in Jehová he Diosal in swala', xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al masanil juntzanh lolonel tik t'a heb' etisraelal: Wach'nhej tzeyutej he b'a, yujto a in Jehová in tik wach' innhej.
k'anab'ajejek he mam he nun. Tze k'anab'ajej sleyal juntzanh sk'ual ik'oj ip to wik yaji. Ha in ton Jehová he Diosal in swala'.
Manh eyak'och he pensar t'a juntzanh yechel komon Dios, manh he b'opaxk'e k'een k'een he diosalok. Ha in ton Jehová he Diosal in swala'.
Ayic tzeyak'an silab' yik he junk'olal wed'ok, tze k'anab'ajej wal icha sleyal, yuj chi' ol in cha t'ayex.
Ha nok' schib'ejal nok' tzeyak' silab'il chi', tze chi nok' t'a sk'ual chi' yet' t'a junxo k'u. Tato ayto nok' skan t'a schab'jial, snhuschajtz'a nok'.
Tato tzato he chi nok' t'a schab'jial chi', chukxo t'a yol in sat, maxtzak in chalaj silab' chi' t'ayex.
Ha mach schi'an nok' t'a schab'jial chi', max tuplaj smul chi' t'a yib'anh, yujto komon ix yutej tastak to wik yaji. Ha jun mach chi', manhxalaj yalan yik t'a he kal.
Ayic tze molank'e sat tas tzeyawej t'a he lu'um, manh pilanok tzeyutej he molank'e t'a stitak, manh ex ek' t'anhanh he sik'ank'e ixim jolom trigo skan eyuuj.

Ayic tze molan sat te' uwa, manh ex meltzaj he say eyil t'a schaelal, manh he sik'k'e sat sk'ajb'anemi. Ha juntzanh chi' kanokab'i, yikxo heb' meb'a' yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il yaji. Ha in ton Jehová he Diosal in swala'.
Manh ex elk'anok, manh eyal esal lolonel, manh eyak' musansatil heb' eyetanimail.
Manh he lok in b'i t'a es. Tato icha chi' tze k'ulej ichato malaj welk'och t'ayex. Ha in ton Jehová in swala'.
Manh komonok tzeyixtej heb' eyetanimail, manh he tok'ek' tastak ay t'a heb'. Manh eyala' to ato k'ik'an tze tup sk'u heb' winh he munlajwum smunlaj tiknaik.
Manh he b'aj heb' chakanh, manh eyak'em tas t'a yol sb'e heb' max uji yilani, palta ayokab' welk'och t'a yol he sat. Ha in ton Jehová in swala'.
Manh he b'o tas manh tojolok ayik tze b'oan yaj junok lolonel. Manh eyak'och he b'a yet' heb' meb'a', manh eyak'paxoch he b'a yet' heb' niwak yelk'ochi. Te tojolnhej tzeyutej he b'oanel tas yaj heb'.
Manh ex alwok pekal t'a skal heb' eyetchonhab'. Manh he nachaanh esal lolonel t'a yib'anh junok eyetanimail yik smiljichamok. Ha in ton Jehová in swala'.
Mokab' chichonoch he k'ol t'a junok eyetanimail, palta wach' to tze kacha' tzeyak'an srazón yik wach' max kotkan t'a eyib'anh yet'ok.
Manh he pak he b'a, mokab' chichonnhejoch he k'ol t'a heb' eyetchonhab'. Tze xajanej heb' ay t'a spatik schiquin he pat icha tzeyutej he ya ilan he b'a. Ha in ton Jehová in swala'.

k'anab'ajejek juntzanh in cheknab'il tik. Manh he cha tajnok nok' he molb'etzal nok' yet' junokxo nok' nok' ch'ok yinhtilal. Manh he som eyinhat tzeyawej t'a he lu'um. Manh eyak'och k'apak pichul soman sch'alil yet' junokxo makan anh ch'al.

Tato ay junok ix schekab' junok mach ayxo strato yet' junokxo winh winak, palta tato ay junokxo winh smulan yet' ix, tz'ak'ji yowalil t'a heb' schawanhil. Max miljichamlaj heb', yujto mantzak tupji yik tz'el ix t'a libre.
Ha winh smulan yet' ix chi', yowalil syik'kot junok nok' ch'ak kalnel winh silab'il yuj smul chi' t'a stielxo in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a.
Smiljicham nok', haxo junok winh sakerdote tz'ak'anoch nok' t'a wichanh, yuj stupchaj smul winh chi'.
Ayic ol ex k'och t'a lum Canaán, ol eyawan masanil makanhil te awb'en te' syak' sat. Oxe' ab'il max eyamlaj junok sat te' chi' yik tze loani, yujto ay yowalil t'a yol in sat.
Axo t'a schanhil ab'il, masanil sat te' syak' chi', tzeyak' masanil t'ayin ofrendail yuj eyak'an yuj diosal, yujto wik yaj te' sat chi'.
Axo t'a yoil ab'il, eyikxo yaj sat te' chi' yik tze lo'o. Tato ol he k'anab'ajej sleyal tik, yelxo wal ol yak' sat te'. Ha in ton Jehová he Diosal in swala'.
Manh he chi nok' chib'ej to max el schiq'uil. Manh eyak'och he b'a he naanel tas tzuji, manh eyak'paxoch he b'ha t'a ajchumal.
Manh setansetanok tz'aj sjoxjiel xil he jolom, manh he joxpaxel xil he sat.
Manh eyak' echnaj he b'a yuj kusk'olal yuj junok chamnak, manh eyak'och yechel junok tas t'a he niwanil. Ha in ton Jehová in swala'.
Manh eyak' q'uixwelal ix eyisil, tzeyak'anoch ix ajmul ixal t'a stemplo juntzanh komon Dios, yik wach' max ixtaxel sb'eyb'al heb' anima, yik max ixtaxpaxel he chonhab' yuj ajmulal.
Yowalil tze k'anab'ajej sleyal juntzanh sk'ual ik'oj ip to wik yaji. Ayokab' yelk'och in kajnub' t'a yol he sat. Ha in Jehová in swala'.
Manh ex b'at he k'anb'ej he b'ha t'a heb' ajchum, ma t'a heb' sk'uman spixan heb' chamnak yalani, yik wach' max eyixtejb'at he b'a. Ha in Jehová he Diosal in swala'.
Q'ueanhek linhan t'a yichanh heb' ichamtak anima, niwanokab' yelk'och heb' t'a yol he sat. Ayokab'pax welk'och t'a yol he sat. Ha in ton Jehová in swala'.
Manh eyixtej junok anima ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal.

Xajan tzeyutej heb', ichato eyetchonhab' heb'. Ya'ilejek heb', icha tz'aj eya'ilan he b'a. Tze nakoti to a ex tik najtil ek'nak ex t'a ch'ok chonhab'il t'a yol yik Egipto. Ha in ton Jehová he Diosal in swala'.
Manh eyixtej heb' anima t'a tas tze chonho', tz'akanokab' eyechlab' tzeyak'lab'ej, icha he ch'anh ayik tzeyechtan he lu'um ma juntzanhxo echlab' tze k'ana'.
Ha he libra yet' eyalmul tze k'ana', tz'akanokab'i. Ha in ton Jehová he Diosal in ix ex wik'elta t'a Egipto, a in swala'.
Yuj wal chi', yowalil tze k'anab'ajej in b'eyb'al yet' masanil in cheknab'il tik. Ha in ton Jehová in swala', xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:

Al masanil juntzanh cheknab'il tik t'a heb' etisraelal: Yalnhej mach ex, ma heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan t'a he kal tz'ak'an junok yuninal silab'il t'a komon Dios skuchan Moloc, a jun chi' yowalil sjulk'enajcham yuj heb' yetchonhab'.
Scotpax wowal t'a jun anima chi', tzin satel t'a skal heb' yetchonhab', yujto ix yixtejb'at in kajnub', ix in spatikaneli, yujto syak' yuninal silab'il t'a jun komon Dios chi'.
Tato a heb' yetchonhab' tonhej syilochi, max sjulk'enejcham jun anima chi' heb',

a in wal ol wak' yowalil t'a jun anima chi', t'a yetb'eyum, t'a yuninal yet' t'a masanil heb' kajan yet' t'a yol spat. Ol in satel heb' t'a skal heb' yetchonhab' yet' heb' syak'em sb'ha t'a komon Dios Moloc chi' yet'ok.

Tato ay mach sb'at sk'anb'ej sb'ha t'a heb' ajb'aal, ma t'a heb' sk'uman spixan heb' chamnak yalani, sk'anab'ajan tas syal heb' chi', ol wak' yowalil t'a jun anima chi', ol in satel t'a skal yetchonhab'.
Junelnhej tzeyak'och he b'ha t'a yol in k'ab', wach'nhej tzeyutej he b'a, yujto a in Jehová in tik, he Diosal in.
Ha wal in b'eyb'al tze b'eyb'alej, tze k'anab'ajani, yujto a in Jehová in tzex wak'och wikok.
Yalnhej mach sb'aj smam snun yowalil schami, a wal tz'ik'ankot schamel chi' t'a yib'anh.
Tato ay junok winh winak smulan yet' ix yetb'eyum junok yetanimail, yowalil scham jun winak chi' yet' jun ix ix chi'.
Tato ay junok winh winak smulan yet' ix yetb'eyum smam, syak' q'uixwelal smam chi'. Ha jun winak chi' yowalil schami, schampax ix ix chi', a wal heb' tz'ik'ankot schamel t'a yib'anh.
Tato ay junok winh winak smulan yet' ix yalib', yowalil scham heb' schawanhil, yujto yelxo wal te chuk sk'ulej heb'. Ha wal heb' tz'ik'ankot schamel t'a yib'anh.
Tato ay junok winh winak smulan yet' yetwinaquil, icha sk'ulej yet' junok ix ix, yowalil scham heb' schawanhil. Ha wal heb' tz'ik'ankot schamel t'a yib'anh, yujto yajb'entak tas sk'ulej heb' chi'.

Tato ay junok winh winak tz'ik'an junok ix ix, syik'anpaxk'e snun ix ix chi' winh, te chuk tas sk'ulej heb' chi', yuj chi' a jun winh winak chi' yet' chawanh heb' ix ix chi', snhusjitz'a heb'. Yuj chi' manhxa b'aj ol b'inaj jun b'eyb'al chi' t'a he kal.
Tato ay junok winh winak smulan yet' junok nok' nok', a winh chi' yowalil scham winh, schampax nok' nok' chi'.
Tato ay pax junok ix ix smulan yet' junok nok' nok', a jun ix chi' yowalil scham ix, schampax jun nok' nok' chi'. Ha wal tz'ik'ankot schamel t'a yib'anh.

Tato ay junok winh winak syik' yanab' yetb'eyumok, yanab' yuj smam ma yanab' yuj snun, a chawanh heb' chi', t'a wal yichanh heb' yetchonhab' heb' satjieli, yujto a mach smulan yet' yanab', yelxo wal q'uixwelal tas sk'ulej heb' chi', yuj chi' a mach icha chi' sk'ulej, a smul chi' skotkan t'a yib'anh.

Tato ay junok winh winak ay tas sk'ulej yet' junok ix ix ayik ayoch ix sb'isan uj, malaj yelk'och t'a yol sat winh tas tz'ik'an ix chi', b'ekanpax sk'ol ix sch'oxanel syaelal chi', yuj chi' manhxaokab' yalan yik heb' schawanhil t'a he kal.
Malajokab' junok winh winak smulan yet' yanab' smam, ma yet' snulej snun, yujto syak' sq'uixwelal winh mach ayto yuj sb'a yet'ok. Ha yuj smul heb' chi' skot t'a yib'anh schawanhil.

Tato ay junok winh winak smulan yet' ix yetb'eyum winh yuk'tak smam ma winh snulej snun, syak' wal q'uixwelal jun yicham chi', a yuj smul heb' chi' skot t'a yib'anh schawanhil, yuj chi' smiljicham heb', malaj yinhtilal heb' skani.
Tato ay junok winh winak smulan yet' ix yetb'eyum winh yuk'tak, syak' q'uixwelal winh yuk'tak winh chi', a jun chi' yajb'entak, yuj chi' smiljicham heb', malaj yinhtilal heb' skani.
B'eyb'alejek in b'eyb'al, tze k'anab'ajan masanil in cheknab'il tik yik wach' manh ol ex in satel t'a lum lum b'aj ol ex k'och kajan chi'.
Manh he b'eyb'alej sb'eyb'al heb' anima ol wik'el t'a eyichanh chi'. Ha heb' chi', sb'eyb'alej masanil juntzanh chukal tik heb', yuj chi' tzin chaquel heb'.
Ha in wal ix wak' in ti' to ol wak' eyiquejkan slum heb' chi' he makb'enok, lum te yax sat. Ha in Jehová he Diosal in, ex in sik'naquelta t'a skal juntzanhxo chonhab'.

Yuj chi' yowalil ay sk'exanhil nok' nok' wach' yet' nok' manh wach'ok t'a yol he sat yet' t'a skal nok' much wach' yet' nok' manh wach'ok. Yuj chi' manh he juel he b'ha t'a wichanh yuj he chi'an nok' nok' manh wach'ok chi', nok' much, nok' snherwi, ma nok' sjachwi t'a sat lum tik, aton nok' ix wala' to manh wach'ok.
Palta yowalil wach' tzeyutej he b'ha t'a wichanh, yujto wach' innhej a in tik. Ha in Jehová in tik ix ex in sik'eli, to ch'ok eyel t'a yichanh juntzanhxo chonhab', yik wach' in chonhab' tzex aji.

Tato ay junok winh winak ma junok ix ix t'a he kal sk'uman spixan heb' chamnak yalani, yowalil sjulk'enajchamok. Ha wal tz'ik'ankot schamel chi' t'a yib'anh, xchi Jehová, xa chi, xchi t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: Al t'a heb' sakerdote, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Aarón, mokab' k'och heb' t'a stz'ey junok chamnak yik manh chukok skan heb' t'a yichanh ley, wach'chom ayto yuj sb'a heb' yet' jun chamnak chi'.
Anhej tato a snun, ma smam, ma junok yuninal, ma junok yisil, ma junok yuk'tak,
ma junok yanab' heb' kob'es ayek' kajan yet'ok, a schami, syal sk'och heb' t'a stz'ey jun chamnak chi'.
Palta max yal-laj sk'och heb' t'a stz'ey junok chamnak sk'ab' yok ix yetb'eyum heb'.
Mokab' sjoxel xil sjolom heb', mokab' sjoxpaxel xil sti' heb', mokab' yak'pax echnaj sniwanil heb' yuj schamel junok anima.

Palta wach'nhejokab' syutej sb'a heb' yujto wiknhej yaj heb'. Mokab' chukok in b'inaj yuj heb', yujto a heb' snhusantz'a silab', syak'an ixim pan heb' ofrendail t'ayin, yuj chi' yowalil wach'nhejokab' syutej sb'a heb'.
Max yalpaxlaj yik'an junok ix ajmul ix heb', ma junok ix ix ayxo winak ix ek' t'ay, ma junok ix ix spuknak sb'a yet' yetb'eyum, yujto sik'b'ilel heb' yik tz'ochkan wikok.
Ch'okokab' yel heb' t'a yol he sat, yujto a heb' tz'ak'anoch ixim pan ofrendail t'a wichanh, yujto a in Jehová in wach' innhej, a in ix in sik'kanel heb' yik wach' tz'ajkan heb'.
Tato ay junok heb' ix yisil junok heb' sakerdote chi' tz'och t'a ajmul ixal, syak' q'uixwelal smam ix chi', yowalil snhusjitz'a ix.

Ha winh sat sakerdote ix ik'jik'echaanh t'a skal heb' yuk'tak ayik ix ak'jik'e akeite t'a sjolom, ayik ix ak'chajoch spichul winh te niwan yelk'ochi, max yal-laj toxonhej sb'at tzikan xil sjolom winh, max yalpaxlaj snhik'anb'at spichul winh yuj sch'oxanel skusk'olal.
Max yalpaxlaj sk'och winh b'aj ayek' junok chamnak, wach'chom smam, ma snun yik max yixtejb'at sb'a winh.

Ha yuj schamel heb' chi' max yal-laj yel winh t'a in kajnub', max yalpaxlaj to syixtejb'at in kajnub' chi' winh, yujto ix ak'jioch akeite t'a winh yik sik'chajkaneli, yik tz'ochkan wikok. Ha in Jehová in swala'.
Ha winh sat sakerdote, a junok ix kob'es mantalaj winak tzek' t'ay, a ix syik' winh.

Max yal-laj yik'lan sb'a winh yet' junok ix chamnakxo yetb'eyum, ma yet' junok ix spuknak sb'a yet' yetb'eyum, ma yet' junok ix ayxo winak tzek' t'ay, ma yet' junok ix ajmul ix. Palta yowalil a junok ix kob'es ix syik' winh, junok ix yetchonhab' winh,
yik manh malajok tz'aj yelk'och heb' yuninal winh t'a skal heb' yetchonhab', yujto a in Jehová in ix in sik'kanel winh, xchi Jehová, t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al t'a winhaj Aarón: Ticnaic yet' t'a masanil tiempo, malaj junok heb' yinhtilal winh ay palta t'a sniwanil ol yal yak'an yofrenda heb' yetchonhab' t'ayin.

Yuj chi' yel wal malaj junok ay spaltail sniwanil chi' ol yal yoch t'a jun opisio chi': Aton heb' max yal yilani, heb' tz'em sb'eyi, heb' palta snhi' ma schiquin, heb' q'uichajnak xub' ma sk'ab', heb' nhojanemi sb'eyi, heb' tzapan steel yujto nenetak yok heb' yet' sk'ab', heb' ayoch yaax t'a yol sat, heb' aykan sjech'al junok yab'il t'ay, heb' ay yaxk'ha t'a sniwanil yet' heb' mak'b'ilpoj snholob' sk'een.
Malaj junok heb' yinhtilal winhaj Aarón chi' ay palta t'a sniwanil syal yoch t'a wichanh yet' silab' to snhusjitz'aok. Tato ay palta t'a sniwanil chi', max yal-laj yak'an ofrenda t'ayin.
Syal swaan juntzanh ofrenda chi' heb' yet' masanil juntzanh tastak to wik yaji,

palta max yal-laj yoch heb' t'a in kajnub', ma sk'och heb' t'a stz'ey altar, yik max yixtejb'at in kajnub' chi' heb', yujto a in Jehová in, wik yaj juntzanh tastak chi', xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Yuj chi' masanil juntzanh tik ix yal winhaj Moisés t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yuninal winh yet' t'a masanil heb' yetisraelal.
Ix lolonxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi', ix yalani:
Al t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yinhtilal to sya'ilej wal sb'a heb' yet' ofrenda syak' heb' eyetisraelal t'ayin, yik manh chukok tz'aj in b'inaj yuj heb'. Ha in wal Jehová in swala'.

Al t'a heb' to a tiknaik yet' t'a masanil tiempo, yalnhej mach junok yinhtilal heb' tz'ik'ankot juntzanh silab' t'a wichanh, aton juntzanh syak' heb' eyetisraelal t'ayin, tato manh wach'ok yaj jun tz'ik'ankot jun silab' chi' icha yalan ley, yowalil tz'ik'jiel t'a yopisio t'a wichanh. Ha in wal Jehová in swala'.

Malaj pax junok yinhtilal winhaj Aarón chi' syal swaan tastak to wik yaji tato ay lepra t'ay, ma ay tas tz'el t'a swinaquil, palta ato yik wach'xo yaji icha yalan ley, ichato chi' syal swaani. Tato syam junok tas to manh wach'ok, junok chamnak, ma junok winak tz'el yinhatil, manh wach'ok tz'ajkani.
Manh wach'ok tz'ajkani tato syam junok nok' nok' manh wach'ok t'a yichanh ley, ma syam junok anima manh wach'ok pax yaj yuj yalnhej tasi.
Tato manh wach'ok yaji, max yal-laj swaan junok tas to wik yaji, masanto sb'iquel sb'a.
Ato yik tz'em k'u, wach'xo yaji. Ichato chi' tzaxo yal swaan masanil tas to wik yaji yujto yiktaxon yaji.

Ha heb' yinhtilal winhaj Aarón chi' max yal-laj schi'an schib'ejal junok nok' nok' heb', aton nok' tonhej schami, ma nok' scham yuj nok' kaltakte'al nok', yik manh chukok skan heb'. Ha in Jehová in swala'.

Al t'a heb' to sk'anab'ajej in cheknab'il heb', yik max och smul heb', yik max champax heb'. Tato malaj yelk'och in cheknab'il chi' t'a yol sat heb', skot juntzanh tik t'a yib'anh heb', yujto a in Jehová in ix in sik'kanel heb'.
Malaj mach syal swaan tastak to wik yaji tato malaj yuj sb'a yet' heb' winh sakerdote. Eb' tonhej ayek' posado t'a heb', ma heb' tonhej smunlaj t'a heb', max yal-laj swaan heb'.
Tato ay junok schekab' junok winh sakerdote manb'il yuj, mato ay pax heb' tz'alji t'a yol skuenta winh, a heb' chi' syal swaan heb' masanil tas to wik yaji.
Tato a ix yisil junok winh sakerdote syik' junok winak ch'ok yel t'a skal heb' sakerdote, maxtzak yal-laj swaan juntzanh ofrenda chi' ix, aton juntzanh tz'ak'ji t'a heb' winh sakerdote chi'.

Palta tato chamnakxo winh yetb'eyum ix, mato spuknak sb'a ix yet' winh yetb'eyum chi', malaj pax junok yune' ix, meltzajnak ix yik skajnajxi ix yet' winh smam chi', ichataxon ayik kob'esto ix, syal swaan swael winh smam ix chi'. Axo pax juntzanhxo heb' manh yinhtilok heb' sakerdote, max yal-laj swaan heb'.

Tato ay junok mach komonnhej schi'an nok' chib'ej to wik yaji, tato manh yojtakok to wik yaji, yowalil syak' sk'exul t'a jun winh sakerdote chi', syak'an jab'okxo t'a yib'anh jun ix yak' sk'exul chi'.
Palta a heb' winh sakerdote yowalil manh komonok scha' heb' winh chijok tastak syak' heb' eyetchonhab' t'ayin.

Tato ay junok mach komonnhej schi'an nok' chib'ej wik yaj chi', manh tonhejok syiloch winh sakerdote chi', palta yowalil a jun ix chi'an nok' chi', syak' nok' silab' yik spakok jun smul chi', yujto a in Jehová in ix in sik'kanel juntzanh nok' chib'ej chi' wikok, xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi':

Al t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yuninal yet' t'a masanil heb' eyetisraelal masanil juntzanh tik: Tato ay ex, ma heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan t'a he kal, tzeyak' junok nok' nok' yik snhusjitz'a silab'il t'ayin, wach'chom yuj b'aj ix eyak' he ti' eyak'ani, mato tonhej tz'el t'a he k'ol eyak'ani,
yowalil a junok nok' smam malaj jab'ok spaltail tzeyak'a' yik wach' tzin cha jun silab' chi'. Ha junok nok' toro, ma junok nok' ch'ak kalnel, ma junok nok' mam chiwa tzeyak'a',
palta manhok junok nok' ayoch syab'il. Tato ya'ay nok', max in chalaj nok'.

Yalnhej mach ex tzeyak' junok silab' yik junk'olal t'ayin, wach'chom yuj b'aj ix eyak' he ti' eyak'ani, ma tonhej tz'el t'a he k'ol eyak'ani, yowalil a junok nok' wakax, ma junok nok' kalnel, ma junok nok' chiwa, malaj spaltail tzeyak'a', yik wach' tzin cha t'ayex.

Manh eyak' junok nok' nok' penaay t'ayin, icha nok' malaj yol sat, nok' lajwinak, nok' q'uiich, nok' elnak junok makan sniwanil, ma ay syaxk'ail, ma junok yab'il t'ay. Ha juntzanh nok' icha chi', max yal-laj snhusjitz'a nok' t'a waltar.

Ha mach ex tz'el t'a he k'ol eyak'an junok nok' silab' t'ayin, a junok nok' wakax, ma junok nok' kalnel syal eyak'ani, wach'chom manh lajanok steel yok nok'. Palta tato a junok silab' ix eyak' he ti' eyak'ani, max in chalaj nok' icha chi' yaji.
Ha junok nok' lajwinak sk'een, ma pojnak, ma ik'b'ilel sk'een nok' chi', max yal-laj eyak'an nok' silab'il t'ayin. Manh he b'eyb'alej eyak'an juntzanh nok' chi' silab'il t'ayin.
Manh he cha juntzanh nok' nok' icha chi' t'a heb' ch'ok chonhab'il yik tz'och silab'il t'ayin, yujto manh tz'akanok yaj nok', max in chapaxlaj nok', xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová chi' t'a winh:

Ayic tz'alji junok nok' yune' wakax, ma junok nok' yune' kalnel, ma junok nok' yune' chiwa, uque' k'ual yowalil skan nok' yet' snun, haxo t'a swajxaquil k'ual, tzaxo yal snhusjitz'a nok' silab'il t'a wichanh.
Max yal-laj junnhej k'ual tz'aj smiljicham junok nok' snun yet' nok' yune'.
Tato tz'ak'ji junok silab' t'ayin yuj ak'oj yuj diosal, ujokab' icha t'a sleyal yik wach' tzin cha'a.
Anhejtona', tze chib'at nok' t'a jun k'ual chi', max yal-laj skan nok' t'a junokxo k'u. Ha in Jehová in swala'.
B'eyb'alejek in cheknab'il, tze k'anab'ajanpaxi. Ha in Jehová in swala'.
Mokab' chukok tz'aj in b'inaj eyuuj, palta to tzin eyik'chaanh, yujto a in wal ix ex in sik'kaneli,
ix ex wik'anelta t'a Egipto yik tzin och he Diosaloc. Ha in Jehová in swala', xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi':
Al t'a heb' etisraelal to a in swal icha tik: Ha juntzanh q'uinh tik, walnakkani to wiknhej yaji, aton yik tze molb'an he b'a yik tzin eyik'anchaanh.
Vaque' k'ual tzex munlaji, haxo t'a yuquil k'ual manhxa junok tas tze k'ulej. Tzeyik' eyip, tze molb'an he b'a eyoch ejmelal t'ayin yalnhej b'aj ayex eq'ui. Aton jun k'ual ik'oj ip chi' wiknhej yaji.
Aton juntzanh q'uinh tik niwan yelk'ochi yuj in eyik'anchaanh ayik tze molb'an he b'a eyoch ejmelal t'a sk'ual walnakkani.
Ha q'uinh yik tze naankoti ayik ex wik'anelta t'a Egipto, tz'el yich t'a yemk'ualil t'a 14 yoch b'ab'el uj. Aton jun q'uinh chi' tzeyak'ochi yik tzin eyik'anchaanh.
Axo t'a 15 yoch jun uj chi', tzeyak'anpaxoch q'uinh yik ixim pan malaj yich yuj in eyik'anchaanh. Uque' k'ual anhej ixim pan malaj yich tze wa''a.
Ha wal t'a sb'ab'el k'ual chi', tze molb'anoch he b'a ejmelal t'a wichanh. Malaj junok makan munlajel tze b'o t'a jun chi'.
Ha t'a uque' k'ual chi', tze nhusnhejtz'a silab' t'ayin. Ha t'a yuquil k'ual tze molb'anoch he b'a ejmelal t'ayin. Malaj junok makan munlajel tze b'o'o, xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalanpax Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi':

Al t'a heb' etisraelal icha tik: Ayic ayexxo ek' t'a sat lum lum ol wak' chi' t'ayex, ayik ol he chaanel yich he jochan ixim he trigo, a jun b'ab'el manoja tze joch chi', tzeyik'kot t'a heb' winh sakerdote.
Axo t'a junxo k'u ayik slajwikanek' sk'ual ik'oj ip, syak'an heb' sakerdote chi' ofrendail tas tzeyak' chi', sb'akhanochta heb' t'a wichanh, yik wach' tzin cha t'ayex.
Ha t'a sk'ual tzeyak' ixim he trigo chi' ofrendail t'ayin, ata' tze nhuspaxtz'a junok nok' kalnel silab'il t'a wichanh, nok' jun ab'il sk'inal, mokab'a jab'ok spaltail nok'.

Tzeyik'anpaxkot lajunheok libra ixim harina te wach' kalab'il yet' akeite, yik stz'a ofrendail to suk'uq'ui sjab' swab'i. Tzeyak'anpax junok litro wino ofrendail, sekjiem t'a yib'anh juntzanh ofrenda chi'.
