Ha ixim ak' trigo sjochchaj chi', max yal-laj he waan ixim t'a panil. Max yalpaxlaj he b'olan ixim he k'uxu', ma eyax k'uxani, masanto t'a jun sk'ual a tzeyak'an ixim b'ab'el manoja ofrendail t'ayin he Diosal in. Ha jun tik ley tz'ajkan t'ayex t'a masanil tiempo yalnhej b'aj ayex eq'ui.
Axo t'a junxo k'u ayik toxo ix lajwikanek' sk'ual ik'oj ip, ayik tzeyik'ankot jun manoja ixim trigo ofrendail, aton t'a jun k'u chi' tze b'is uque' semana.
Axo t'a junxo k'u, ma t'a 50 k'ual yik toxo ix tz'akwi uque' k'ual ik'oj ip chi', ata' tzeyak'pax junokxo ofrenda t'a ixim trigo chi' t'ayin.

Tzeyik'kot chab'ok ixim pan ofrendail ichataxon ixim eyik tze wa''a. Vajxaque' libra ixim harina te wach' tz'och t'a junjun ixim, ayokab' b'at yich t'a skal ixim. Ha ixim pan chi' sb'akhjioch ixim t'a wichanh ofrendail t'a ixim b'ab'el tz'eluli yalnhej b'aj kajan ex eq'ui.

Yed' ixim pan chi', syak' ukwanhok nok' kelemtak kalnel heb' eyetchonhab', jun ab'il sk'inal junjun nok' yet' jun nok' quelem wakax yet' pax chawanhok nok' ch'ak kalnel. Malajokab' jab'ok spaltail juntzanh nok' nok' chi'. Ha nok' chi' snhusjitz'a smasanil t'ayin Jehová in tik, junnhej tz'aj stz'a yet' ixim eyofrenda trigo yet' pax ofrenda t'a wino. Ha jun ofrenda stz'a chi' suk'uq'ui sjab' swab'i.
Tzeyak'anpax junok nok' mam chiwa silab'il yuj stupkanel he mul. Tzeyak'anpax chawanhok nok' kalnel junjun ab'il sk'inal ofrendail yuj he ch'oxanel he junk'olal wed'ok.
Ha winh sakerdote sb'akhanoch chawanh nok' kalnel t'a wichanh a in Jehová in tik yet' ixim pan ix b'o t'a ixim trigo ix b'ab'laj jochchaji, a jun ofrenda chi' wik yaji, skan t'a winh sakerdote chi'.

Ha t'a sk'ual jun q'uinh chi' malaj junok makan munlajel syal he b'oani. Tze molb'anoch he b'a eyoch ejmelal t'ayin. Ha jun tik ley tz'ajkan t'a he kal yet' t'a skal eyinhtilal t'a masanil tiempo yalnhej b'ajtil ayex eq'ui.

Ayic sk'och stiempoal he jochan ixim he trigo, manh he sik'k'e ixim skan t'a skal yok yet' ixim ay t'a stitak, yujto a juntzanh chi' yik heb' meb'a' yaji yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal. Ha in Jehová he Diosal in swala', xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalanpax Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al t'a heb' etchonhab' icha tik: Ha t'a sb'ab'el k'ual yik yuquil uj, tzeyik' eyip, tze molb'anoch he b'a ejmelal t'ayin, spuji k'een trompeta yik tze naankot in wach'k'olal.
Yowalil tze nhustz'a junok nok' silab' t'ayin. Malaj junok ex tzex munlaj t'a jun k'u chi', xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalanpax Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:

Ha t'a slajunhil k'ual yoch yuquil uj, aton t'a sk'ual yik tz'ak'jikan lajwok he mul, tze molb'ejoch he b'a ejmelal t'ayin. Tzex ochpax t'a tzek'ojk'olal, tze nhusantz'a ofrenda silab'il t'ayin a in Jehová in tik.
Manh ex munlaj t'a jun k'u chi', yujto a wal t'a jun k'u chi' stupkanel he mul t'a wichanh a in Jehová he Diosal in tik.
Tato ay junok mach max k'anab'ajan yoch t'a tzek'ojk'olal t'a jun k'u chi', yowalil satjiel t'a he kal.
Anhejtona', yalnhej mach smunlaj t'a jun k'u chi', tzin sateli.
Malaj junok mach smunlaj t'a junok yalnhej tas munlajelal t'a jun k'u chi'. Ha jun tik ley tz'ajkan t'a he kal yet' t'a skal heb' eyinhtilal t'a masanil tiempo yalnhej b'ajtil ayex eq'ui.
Ha jun k'u chi', aton wal yik tzeyik'an eyip, yik tzex ochpax t'a tzek'ojk'olal, tz'el yich t'a wal sb'alunhil k'ual yoch uj t'a k'ik'b'alil, masanto t'a k'ik'b'alil t'a junxo k'u, xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalanpax Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al t'a heb' etchonhab': Ayic 15 yoch yuquil uj, tze chaan uque' k'ual sq'uinhal chinama yuj in eyik'anchaanh.
Tze molb'anoch he b'a ejmelal t'a b'ab'el k'u. Ha t'a jun k'ual chi', malaj junok mach smunlaji.
Ha t'a uque' k'ual chi', junjun k'u tze nhusantz'a silab' t'ayin, haxo t'a swajxaquil k'ual, tze molb'anoch he b'a ejmelal, tze nhusantz'a silab', yujto in q'uinh yaji, malaj junok mach smunlaji.

(Aton t'a juntzanh q'uinh tik tzin eyik'chaanh a in Jehová in tik. Tze molb'anoch he b'a ejmelal, tze nhusantz'a silab'. Ay silab' snhusjitz'aok yet' ofrenda t'a tas swaji. Tz'ak'jipax wino silab'il yet' ofrendail. Junjun makan juntzanh silab' tik tz'ak'ji, ato ha' sk'ual alb'ilkani.

Ch'ok yel juntzanh silab' chi' t'a yichanh juntzanh tz'ak'ji t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip walnak. Ch'ok yel juntzanh silab' chi' t'a yichanh silab' tz'ak'jitaxoni. Ch'ok yel pax t'a yichanh he silab' tzeyak' he ti' eyak'ani yet' t'a eyofrenda tz'el t'a he k'ol eyak'an t'ayin a in Jehová in tik.)

Axo t'a 15-xo yoch yuquil uj, ayik toxo ix molchaj sat awb'en tz'el t'a sat lum lum, tzeyak'anoch sq'uinhal t'a wichanh t'a uque' k'ual. Ha b'ab'el k'u, sk'ual ik'oj ip, anhejtona' pax t'a yukub'ixial.

Ha t'a b'ab'el k'u chi', tzeyik'kot sattak te te' te wach', xiltak apak', sk'ab' te' tak'u ay t'a titak ha' yet' sk'ab' juntzanhxo te' k'ayum xiil yik tzeyak'anoch q'uinh yik chinama. Icha wal chi' tz'aj eyak'an tzalajb'ok he k'ol t'a uque' k'ual chi' t'a wichanh a in Jehová he Diosal in tik.
D'a yuquil uj t'a junjun ab'il, tzeyak'anoch jun q'uinh chi' t'a uque' k'ual yuj in eyik'anchaanh. Ha jun tik ley tz'ajkan t'a he kal yet' t'a skal heb' eyinhtilal t'a masanil tiempo.
Ha t'a uque' k'ual chi', he masanil a ex israel ex tik, yowalil tzex kajnaj t'a yoltak chinama,
yik wach' syojtaquejnhejel heb' eyinhtilal b'ak'uinh to ha t'a yoltak chinama ix ex kajnaji ayik ix ex wik'anelta t'a Egipto. Ha in Jehová he Diosal in swala', xchi t'a winh.
Icha wal chi' ix aj yak'an winhaj Moisés yojtakanel heb' chonhab' israel juntzanh niwak q'uinh tz'ochi yuj yik'jichaanh Jehová.
Ix yalanpax Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi':
Al t'a heb' etisraelal to syik'kot akeite heb' t'ayach, aton akeite te wach' yik sat te' oliwo yik wach' aynhejoch sk'ak'al kandil.

Axo winhaj Aarón sb'oanoch sk'ak'al, yik wach' aynhejoch sk'ak'al tzek' ak'wal t'a wichanh b'aj ay in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, t'a yichanhelta k'apak kortina b'aj ay skaxail in trato. Ha jun tik ley tz'ajkan t'ayex t'a masanil tiempo.
Wach' tz'aj sb'ojioch juntzanh kandil chi' t'a wichanh t'a yib'anh sb'akhnub'al nab'a oro.
Tzeyik'kot ixim harina te wach', sb'o lajchaweok ixim pan, chanhe' libra ixim harina tz'och t'a junjun ixim.
Slajwi chi' tz'ak'chajk'e ixim t'a sat jun mexa nab'a oro t'a wichanh, cha tzol tz'ajk'e latz'an ixim, waktak ixim t'a junjun latz'an.
Tzak'anpaxem inkienso te wach' t'a yib'anh junjun latz'an ixim pan chi'. Ha inkienso chi' snhusjitz'ha t'a wichanh, yik sch'oxani to wik yaj ixim pan chi'.
D'a junjun k'ual ik'oj ip tz'ak'jiem ixim pan chi' t'a wichanh, yuj sk'anab'ajan heb' etchonhab' israel in trato eyed'ok t'a masanil tiempo. Yowalil a ixim q'uixin tz'ak'jiemi.

Axo juntzanh ixim pan tz'ik'jiel chi', yik winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yinhtilal yaj ixim t'a masanil tiempo. Ha heb' chi' swaan ixim pan chi' t'a junok lugar to wik yaji, yujto te niwan yelk'och ixim t'a skal juntzanhxo silab' yiktaxon heb' sakerdote tz'ik'jiel t'a juntzanh ofrenda snhusjitz'ha t'a wichanh, xchi Jehová chi'.

Ay jun winh aljinak t'a skal heb' israel chi', israel snun winh, haxo smam winh aj Egipto. Selomit sb'i ix snun winh chi', yisil winhaj Dibri, yinhtilal Dan. Ha jun winh chi' ix yak' owal winh yet' jun winh mero wal israel t'a kampamento. Ha t'a jun owal chi', a winh yune' ix israel chi' ix och smul winh yujto ix yal chuk winh t'a sb'i Jehová, yuj chi' ix ik'jikot winh t'a yichanh winhaj Moisés.
Ix tanhwaj winh masanto ix yal Jehová tas yowalil tz'utaj winh.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Ik'equelta winh chuk ix alan chi' t'a yol kampamento, haxo masanil heb' ix ab'an tas ix yal winh chi', yak'okab'k'e sk'ab' heb' t'a sjolom winh, haxo masanil heb' chonhab' sjulk'enancham winh.

Al juntzanh tik t'a heb' etisraelal: Ha mach tz'alan chuk t'a in b'i a in Jehová he Diosal in tik, tz'och smul, yowalil scham yuj smul chi'. Masanil heb' yetchonhab' sjulanchamok. Wach'chom ch'ok chonhab'il, ma eyetchonhab', tato syal chuk t'a in b'i, yowalil tz'och chamel t'a yib'anh.
Ha mach smak'ancham junok yetanimail, yowalil tz'ochpax chamel t'a yib'anh.
Ha mach smak'ancham nok' smolb'etzal nok' junokxo mach, yowalil anheja' nok' nok' chi' tz'ak'jipax sk'exulok.
Ha mach smak'an junok yetanimail, tato tz'echnaj yuj, icha tas syutej chi', icha chi' tz'utajpaxi.

Tato sq'uichaj yuj, yowalil smak'jipax q'uichajok. Tato tz'elta yol sat yuj, yowalil tz'elpaxkot yiko', tato tz'el ye junok mach chi' yuj, yowalil tz'elpax yiko'. Icha wal tas syutej junok anima chi', icha pax chi' tz'utajxi.
Ha mach smak'ancham nok' smolb'etzal nok' junokxo anima, yowalil syak' sk'exul nok'. Palta a mach smak'ancham junok yetanimail, a jun chi' yowalil schami.
Anheja' jun ley tik tz'och yopisio t'a heb' ch'ok chonhab'il yet' t'a heb' chonhab' israel. Ha in Jehová he Diosal in swala', xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.

Icha chi' ix aj yalan juntzanh chi' winhaj Moisés t'a heb' yetisraelal, yuj chi' ix ik'jielta winh ix alan chuk t'a sb'i Jehová chi' yuj heb' t'a spatiquel kampamento. Ata' ix julk'enajcham winh. Ix sk'anab'ajej heb' sk'ulan icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' t'a lum switzal Sinaí icha tik:
Al masanil juntzanh tik t'a heb' etisraelal: Ayic ayexxo ek' t'a sat lum lum ol wak' t'ayex chi', yowalil ol yik' yip lu'um, yik tzin eyik'chaanh a in Jehová in tik.
Anhej waque' ab'il tzex munlaj t'a sat he lu'um, haxo t'a waque' ab'il chi' syal he mesan te' eyuwa, tze molan sat.
Axo t'a yuquil ab'il, yowalil skan lum yik' yip sat yuj in eyik'anchaanh. Malaj jab'ok tas tzeyawej t'a jun ab'il chi', max yal-laj he mesan te' eyuwa.
Max yal-laj he jochank'e waan ixim trigo munil sq'uib'i, ayik toxo ix ek' stiempoal jochoj trigo. Max yalpaxlaj he molan sat te' eyuwa chi' to maj he mesa', yujto syik' yip lum t'a jun ab'il chi'.

Masanil tastak sq'uib' t'a sat lum t'a jun ab'il yik syik' yip lum chi', syal he waani, syalpax swaan heb' anima eyed'ok, aton heb' winh he chekab', heb' ix he chekab' yet' heb' smunlaj eyed'ok yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal,
yet' pax nok' he molb'etzal nok' yet' nok' kaltakte'al nok' ay t'a jun lugar chi'. Yuj chi', masanil tas sq'uib' t'a sat lum t'a jun ab'il chi', ha' ol he wa yet' nok' nok' chi'.
Uquel sb'ischaj t'a uktak ab'il. Ha uque' ab'il chi' sb'ischaj t'a uquel, tz'elk'och t'a 49 ab'il.
Axo t'a slajunhilxo k'ual yoch yuquil uj, aton jun k'u ayik tz'ak'ji tup mul, ata' spuji k'een trompeta t'a masanil yol he chonhab'.

Axo ab'il 50, a yab'ilal yoch q'uinh yik tz'el masanil tas t'a libre. Ha t'a jun ab'il chi' tz'alchajel yuj yel anima masanil t'a libre t'a yol he chonhab', aton heb' schonhnak sb'a chekab'wumal, yik wach' spaxta heb' smasanil t'a skal sk'ab' yok. Anhejtona' heb' schonhnaquel sluum skanxi lum yikok heb'.

Axo jun ab'il 50 chi' eyik yaj a ex tik, yuj eyel t'a libre. Ha t'a jun ab'il chi', malaj tas tzeyawej, max he jochk'elaj waan ixim trigo tonhej sq'uib'chaanh t'a ichnhej ta'. Manh he mes te' eyuwa, manh he molpax sat te'.
Niwanokab' yelk'och jun ab'il chi' t'a yol he sat. Ha tastak munil syak' t'a lum lum chi' tze wa''a.
Ayic sk'och jun ab'il chi', junjun ex tze chaxi he lum he chonhnaquel chi'.
Yuj chi', tato ayex tze chonho', ma tze man he lum t'a junok eyetanimail, manh he na' eyak' ganar t'a spatik jun lum chi' junjun ex.

Ha mach smanan chi', yowalil stupu', ato syala' jantak tiempoal ix ek'b'at yab'ilal yoch q'uinh yik tz'el tas t'a libre chi'. Axo mach schonhwaj chi', yowalil scha stojol lu'um, ato syala' jayeto ab'il ol molchaj sat tas awab'il yik ol jax junxo ab'il yik tz'el tas t'a libre chi'.

Ato syala', tato niwanto yab'ilal ol molchaj sat awb'en chi', icha chi' ol aj stupchaj t'ay. Tato quenxonhej yab'ilal jun, quenxonhej pax stojol lum ol ak'chaj t'ay, yujto a sat awb'en chi' schonhchaji, ato syala' jayeto ab'il smolchaji.
Manh he komon sayej chajtil tz'aj eyak'an ganar t'a spatik heb' eyetanimail. Palta tze ch'oxeli to ay welk'och t'a yol he sat, yujto a in ton Jehová he Diosal in.
Scham wal he k'anab'ajan in cheknab'il yet' he b'eyb'alan in b'eyb'al tik. Tato ol he k'anab'ajej, junk'olal ol ex ek' t'a sat lum lum chi'.
Te wach' ol aj sat tas ol eyawej t'a lu'um. Tzalajk'olal ol ex kajnaj t'a sat lu'um, ol eyab'lej sat tas ol eyawej chi' masanto ol ex b'ud'jok.
Talaj ol eyala': ¿Tasto ol kab'lej t'a yuquil ab'il chi', tato manh ol onh awalwok, tato manh ol yalpax ko molan sat tas awab'il chi'? ta xe chi.
Manh eyak' pensar, yujto ol wak'em in wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh tas tzeyawej t'a swaquil ab'il chi'. Ol ste ak'ej sat, yuj chi' a jun chi' k'okb'il syab' eyab'lan t'a oxeok ab'il,
yuj chi' ol eyab'lej sat tas tzeyawej ol he molkan chi', yakb'an tzex awwi t'a swajxaquil ab'il. Olto eyab'lej tas molb'ab'il chi' eyuj yakb'an tz'elul sat tas tzeyawej t'a sb'alunhil ab'il.
Ha lum lum chi', max yal-laj he chonhanel lum t'a junelnhej, yujto wik lu'um. Ha ex tik tonhej paxyalwum eyaj t'a sat lu'um, majan lum eyaj t'ayin.
Tato ay junok mach schonhel sluum, syal smananxiel slum chi' tato syal yuj.
Tato ay junok eyetchonhab' slajwiel masanil tas ay t'ay, yuj chi' schonhb'at slum t'a junokxo, a junok te ayto yuj sb'a yet' jun schonhan slum chi' syal smananxiel jun lum chi' b'aj schonhnak chi'.
Palta tato ay junok mach manhxalaj junok sk'ab' yok syal smananel sluum chi', tato smolchaj stumin sch'okoj, syal smananxiel sluum chi'.

Anhej to snaji, jantakxo stiempoal schonhanel lu'um, syak'anxi meltzaj jantak k'een tumin t'a winh manjinak lu'um chi', ato syala' jantakto tiempo ayik ol ja jun ab'il yik tz'och q'uinh yel tastak t'a libre, syik'anxi slum chi'.

Palta tato max aj k'een tumin chi' yuj yik smananxiel smakb'en chi', a lum sluum chi' skannhej lum t'a yol sk'ab' jun mach ix manan el chi', masanto sk'och junxo yab'ilal yoch q'uinh yik tz'el tas t'a libre. Ato ta' librexo lu'um, syik'anxikan lum winh ix chonhan chi'.
Tato ay mach schonhan junok spat t'a yol niwak chonhab' ayoch smuroal, syal smananxieli ayik manto el-laj yab'ilal schonhaneli.

Palta tato maxto yal-laj smananel jun pat chi' ayik manto k'och jun ab'il chi', a jun pat chi', skanxonhej t'a winh ix manan chi' t'a junelnhej yet' t'a heb' yinhtilal. Maxtzac yal-laj yaktajel t'a yab'ilal q'uinh yik tz'el tas t'a libre.
Ha pax te' pat b'aj manh ayokoch smuroal chonhab', lajannhej ichok komon lu'um. Syal smanjixieli, ma yaktajel t'a yab'ilal q'uinh chi'.
Axo heb' lewita, syal smananxiel spat heb' t'a yalnhej tas tiempoal wach'chom ay t'a yol smuroal schonhab' heb'.

Tato ay junok lewita max yal-laj smananxiel spat t'a yol smakb'en schonhab', haxo yik sjax yab'ilal yoch q'uinh chi', syal yik'anxikan spat chi', yujto a heb' lewita chi' anhej spat heb' ayoch smakb'enok t'a yoltak he chonhab'.
Ha lum lum b'aj swa skalnel heb' lewita t'a spatiktak chonhab' chi', max yal-laj schonhanel heb', yujto swalab' skalnel heb' yajkan yuj schonhab'.

Tato ay junok heb' eyetchonhab' kajan t'a he lak'anil manhxalaj jab'ok tas ay t'ay, yowalil tzex kolwaj t'ay yik wach' aynhejek' t'a he kal, icha tz'aj he kolwaj t'a junok ch'ok chonhab'il sb'eyek' t'a he kal.
Manh he k'an yune' he tumin, ma stupil tastak ix eyak' majanil t'a jun eyetchonhab' chi'. Anhej to tze ch'oxo' to ay welk'och t'a yol he sat, yik wach' aynhejek' jun eyetchonhab' chi' eyed'ok.
Manh he k'an yune' k'een tumin tzeyak' majanil t'a jun eyetchonhab' chi', manh he mak'paxk'e stojol wael uk'el tzeyak' sk'exa'.
Yujto a in Jehová he Diosal in swala', a in ix ex wik'elta t'a Egipto yik swak' lum Canaán t'ayex yik tzin och he Diosaloc.
Tato ay junok eyetchonhab' ayek' eyed'ok, manhxa jab'ok tas ay t'ay, yuj chi' schonh sb'a t'ayex, manh eyutok icha junok he chekab' ch'ok chonhab'il,
palta ichaokab' junok munlajwum tzeyutej, ma icha junok tonhej sb'eyeq'ui. Syal smunlaj eyed'ok masanto sjax yab'ilal yoch q'uinh yik tz'el tas t'a libre.
Slajwi chi, tzaxo yal yel yet' yuninal t'a yol he pat, spax t'a skal heb' sk'ab' yok b'aj aytaxon sluum.
Yujto a ex tik, in chekab' eyaji. Ha in ix ex wik'elta t'a Egipto, yuj chi' manh smojok to tzex chonhchajel t'a chekab'wumal.
Manh te yajalok tzeyutej he b'ha t'a heb' eyetisraelal schonh sb'a t'ayex. Anhej to ayokab' welk'och t'a yol he sat a in he Diosal in tik.
Tato he gana tze man he chekab', winak ma ix, syal he manan t'a skal juntzanhxo nakión t'a he lak'anil.
Syalpax he manan heb' ch'ok nakional ayek' t'a he kal, ma yuninal heb' ix alji t'a he kal, syal he manan heb' eyikok t'a junelnhej.
Axo yik tzex chami skan heb' yikok heb' eyuninal. Syal yoch heb' chi' schekab'ok heb', palta malaj junok eyetisraelal tik syal eyak'anoch he b'a yajalil t'a yib'anh, yujto eyetchonhab' heb'.

Tato ay junok ch'ok chonhab'il, ma junok anima ayek' t'a he kal tik tz'och b'eyumal, haxo junok eyetchonhab' junnhej kajan yet'ok tz'och mheb'ail, schonhan sb'ha t'a jun ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a slak'anil chi', ma t'a junokxo ayto yuj sb'a yet' jun ch'ok chonhab'il chi',
syal smananxiel sb'a, mato smanjiel yuj junok sk'ab' yok,
ma yuj junok to ayto yuj sb'a yet'ok. Tato tzaxo techaj yuj jun, syal smananel sb'a sch'okojil.

Syik' skuenta heb' t'a yab'ilal ayik ix schonhanel sb'a chi', masanto sjax yab'ilal q'uinh yik tz'el tas t'a libre. Ha stojol tz'ak'ji, ato syala' jantakxo yab'ilal chi'. Icha chi' tz'aj yik'anpax skuenta jantak tumin tz'och t'a spatik smunlajel, icha stojol sk'u heb' munlajwum.
Tato ayto sk'ochxi yab'ilal chi' jun, smananxiel sb'a, syak'an meltzaj jab'okxo k'een tumin, ato syala' jantak ix scha'a ayik ix schonhanel sb'a chi'.
Palta tato quenxonhej tiempo sk'och yab'ilal yik q'uinh chi', axonhej jab'xo chi' stupu'.
Lajanokab' tz'utaj icha junok heb' smunlaj t'a yab'ilal t'a junok patrón, icha pax chi' tz'utaj yuj jun ch'ok chonhab'il chi'. Manh he cha ixtaj jun eyetchonhab' chi' t'a eyichanh.
Tato max yal smananel sb'a jun, haxo yik sk'och yab'ilal q'uinh chi', ata' tz'aktajel yet' heb' yuninal.
Yujto in chekab' eyaj a ex israel ex tik, a in wal ix ex wik'elta t'a Egipto. Ha in ton Jehová he Diosal in swala', xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.

Ix yalanpax Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' yik syal winh t'a heb' yetchonhab' icha tik: Manh he b'o yechel juntzanh komon Dios he diosalok. Manh he molb'ejk'e k'een k'een tz'alji maksejal, ma k'een k'een tzeyb'il ayoch juntzanh icha yechel t'ay. Manh ex em nhojan ejmelal t'ay, yujto a in ton Jehová he Diosal in.
Ha sk'ual ik'oj ip ix wal t'ayex, niwanokab' yelk'och t'a yol he sat. Niwanokab' pax yelk'och in kajnub' t'a yol he sat, a in wal Jehová in swala'.
Tato ol he b'eyb'alejnhej in k'ayb'ub'al, tze k'anab'ajan in cheknab'il,
ol wak'b'at nhab' t'a stiempoal, haxo yak'an sat te' eyawb'en te' yet' tas awab'il t'a lum lum chi'.

Vanto he tek'an ixim he trigo, toxo pax ix q'uinhb'i sat eyuwa. Vanto he molan sat te' eyuwa chi', toxo ix japax stiempo yawchaj trigo junelxo, yuj chi' ol ex waok, masanto ol ex b'ud'jok. Ol eyak' wal tzalajb'ok he k'ol t'a yol he makb'en.
Te wach'xonhej ol ex ajek' ta'. Ol ex way t'a junk'olal, malaj mach ol ex xib'tanok. Ol ex in kol t'a nok' chium nok' yet' t'a owal.
Ol el lemnaj heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayex, yuj eyespada ol cham heb', ol kan teljab' heb' t'a eyichanh.
Ha t'a owanhok ex, ol el lemnaj 100-ok heb' ajk'ol chi'. Axo t'a junok 100 ex, ol el lemnaj 10 milok heb'. Ha heb' ajk'ol chi' ol cham heb' t'a eyichanh yuj eyespada.
Te wach'k'olal ol aj ex wilanochi. Ol wik' wal chaanh he b'isul, ol wak'elk'och in trato eyed'ok.
Vanto he waan ixim trigo molb'ilkan eyuj yiktax junab'i, ol he b'esankanel ixim yik ol he latz'anpaxoch ixim ak'to chi'.
Ol in kajnajnhej eyed'ok, manh ol ex in chaquel-laj.
Ol in ajnhejek' t'a he kal. Ha in he Diosal in, a exxo tik in chonhab' eyaji.

Ha in Jehová he Diosal in, ix ex wik'elta t'a Egipto, yik wach' max ex kannhej chekab'ok ta'. Ha in ix wik'el jun munlajel manhxo jantakok syail ayoch t'a eyib'anh. Yuj wal chi' manhxo nhojanok ex emi tzex b'eyeq'ui.
Palta tato a ex tik manh ol he k'anab'ajej, manh ol he b'eyb'alej in cheknab'il,
tato ol he patiquejel in b'eyb'al tik, tato malaj yelk'och juntzanh in cheknab'il tik t'ayex, tzeyixtanb'at in trato ix in b'o eyed'ok,

a in pax tik, aton juntzanh tik ol in k'ulej eyed'ok: Ol wak'b'at xiwk'olal t'a eyib'anh. Ol wak'b'at juntzanh yab'il manhxa yanhal yet' k'ak'al yab'il ol kot t'ayex syixtan yol he sat, ol pax yip he niwanil. Nab'axonhej ol eyawej tastak, yujto a heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayex ol waanb'at sat tas tzeyawej chi'.
Ol in och ajk'olal t'ayex, ol ex satel yuj heb' eyajk'ol chi'. Ol ex kan t'a yalanh yuj heb'. Toxonhej ol ex el lemnajok, wach'chom malaj mach tzex pechani.
Tato anheja' max in he k'anab'ajej, wach'chom toxo ix jawi juntzanh tik t'a eyib'anh, masnhej ol k'echaanh eyaelal wuj yuj he mul.
Ol wak' lajwoquem eyak'umtaquil. Manhxo ol yak'laj nhab', yuj chi' manhxa tas ol yal sq'uib' t'a sat lum he lum chi'.
Nab'axonhej ol eyixtej he b'a he munlaji, manhxalaj tas ol q'uib' t'a sat lum lum chi'. Manhxo ol yak'pax sat te' eyawb'en te'.
Tato te pit ol eyutej he b'a t'ayin, manh ol in he k'anab'ajejnhej, ol te k'echaanh yaelal t'a eyib'anh wuuj, ato syala' jantak he mul.
Ol wak'b'at nok' chium nok' t'a he kal, ol schianb'at eyuninal nok' yet' nok' he molb'etzal nok', haxo yemta he b'isul chi' yuj nok', yuj chi' manhxa mach ol b'eyek' t'a yoltak b'e.
Tato anheja' max he na he b'a yuj juntzanh chi', pitnhej tzeyutej he b'a t'ayin,
a in xo, te niwan yaelal ol wak'b'at t'a eyib'anh yuj he mul chi'.

Ol wak'b'at owal t'ayex eyaelalok, yuj in pakan t'ayex yujto max he k'anab'ajej in trato. Toxonhej ol ex b'at lemnaj he kol he b'ha t'a he chonhab', palta ata' ol wak'b'at k'ak'al yab'il, icha chi' ol aj he kan t'a yalanh yuj heb' winh eyajk'ol chi'.
Ayic ol wik'anemta yel he wael, lajunhwanh wal heb' ix ix, junnhej ol sb'o swael t'a junok k'ak'. Axonhej t'a echlab'il ol aj yek' he wael chi' t'a he patik. Ol ex waok, palta manh ol ex b'ud'joklaj.
Wach'chom ix eyil juntzanh yaelal chi', palta tato anheja' max he na he b'a, anheja' tze pitejnhej he b'a,
a in pax tik ol wak' yowalil t'ayex yet' wal yowal in k'ool. Masnhej ol k'echaanh eyaelal wuuj yuj he mul.
Ichato wal chi' ol he chianb'at heb' eyuninal yet' heb' eyisil.

Ol in pojem juntzanh lugar b'aj tzex och ejmelal t'a he diosal, ol in mak'poj eyaltar yik inkienso. Ol in molb'ejk'e b'ulan he niwanil t'a yib'anh juntzanh he diosal manh pitzanok chi', yujto ol ex in chaqueli.
Ol laj in jukanb'at he chonhab' yet' spatil he diosal chi'. Manhxo ol in tzalaj yuj suk'uq'uial sjab' he silab'.
Ol wak' lajwoquem he chonhab' chi', haxo heb' ajk'ol ol jakan kajan t'ay, ol sat sk'ol heb' yilan jun chi'.
Ol ex wak'an saklem t'a skal masanil nakión. Tzak'an wespada t'a he patik ol ex b'atok. Ha he chonhab' chi', kuseltak ol ajkanok, xiwk'olaltak ol aj sjuwikanb'ati.

Ichato wal chi' wach' ol aj skan lum sch'okojil t'a masanil tiempo ayik ayextoek' t'a juntzanhxo nakión ayoch ajk'olal t'ayex chi'. Icha wal chi' ol aj yik'ankan yip lu'um, icha stiempoal to maj yik' yip lum eyuj t'a yalanhtaxo ayik ayex ek' kajan ta'.

Ha heb' eyinhtilal pitzanto b'aj ay slugar heb' eyajk'ol chi', ol wak' wal och xiwk'olal t'a yib'anh heb'. Ol el lemnaj heb' ayik ol yab'an heb' yem k'otnaj junok te' xil te'. Ol el heb' ichato ay junok mach tzak'anoch yet' espada t'a spatik heb'. Toxonhej ol komon telwok heb', wach'chom malaj mach spechan heb'.
Ol komon telwokb'at junjun heb', ichato wan yel heb' t'a owal, wach'chom malaj mach spechan heb'. Manhxalaj junok heb' ol to stek'b'ej sb'ha t'a yichanh heb' ajk'ool.
Ol lajwoquem heb' t'a skaltak juntzanh nakión chi', ichato a slugar heb' ajk'ol chi' ol satanel heb'.
Ha mach t'a skal heb' eyinhtilal pitzantokanek' t'a schonhab' heb' eyajk'ol chi', ata' ol cham heb' yujnhej schukal, yuj pax smul heb' smam yicham heb'.

Ayic toxo ix in och ajk'olal t'ayex chi', ayik toxo pax ex wak'kanb'at t'a schonhab' heb' eyajk'ool, yujto ix he pitej he b'a t'ayin, tato ata' sna sb'a sk'ol heb' eyinhtilal b'aj ix spitej sb'a heb' chi' t'ayin, tato syak'em sb'a heb' t'a wichanh yik syalank'eta smul heb' yet' he mul a ex tik,
tato icha chi', ol in naankot in trato wak'nak to ol wak' lum lum t'a winhaj Jacob, t'a winhaj Isaac yet' t'a winhaj Abraham.

Palta ha t'a yalanhto chi', ol ex el t'a sat he lu'um chi'. Ol kan tzinan lu'um, ol yik'an yip lu'um ayik manh ex ayok ek' ta'. Tz'akan ol aj he tupan el he mul, yujto ix he patiquejel in b'eyb'al yet' in cheknab'il.

Wach'chom icha chi' tzex wutej, ayik ayek' heb' eyinhtilal t'a schonhab' heb' yajk'ol heb' chi', manh ol in patiquejel-laj heb'. Manh ol in satel-laj heb' yik manh ol lajwoquek' in trato ix wak' yet' heb' yujto a in Jehová in, sDiosal in heb'.

Axo ol ajok to yuj swach'ilok heb', ol in nakot in trato ix in b'o eyed'ok ayik ix ex wik'anelta t'a Egipto. D'a wal yichanh juntzanhxo chonhab' ix ex wik'elta, yik wach' tzin och he Diosaloc. Ha in ton Jehová in swala', xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Aton juntzanh b'eyb'al tik, cheknab'il yet' k'ayb'ub'al ix yak' Jehová t'a jolom witz Sinaí t'a winhaj Moisés yik sk'anab'ajan heb' chonhab' israel.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al juntzanh tik t'a heb' etisraelal: Tato ay mach tz'ak'an sti' yak'an junok anima t'ayin Jehová in tik, palta snib'ej smananel jun anima chi', yowalil syak' stojol, stupu' icha yalan jun lista tik,
icha echlab' sk'anchaj t'a in kajnub': Ha heb' 20 ab'il sk'inal masanto t'a 60 ab'il, tato winak, yowalil tz'ak'ji 50 siklo k'een plata stojolok. Tato ix, 30 siklo plata syak'a'.
Axo yuj heb' oye' ab'il sk'inal masanto t'a 20, tato winak, 20 siklo k'een plata syak'a'. Tato ix jun, 10 siklo k'een syak'a'.
Axo yuj heb' unin jun ujal sk'inal masanto t'a oye' ab'il, tato winak, oye' siklo k'een plata syak'a'. Tato ix jun, oxe' siklo k'een syak'a'.
Axo yuj heb' icham anima ek'xo t'a 60 ab'il, tato winak, 15 siklo k'een plata syak'a', tato ix jun, 10 siklo k'een syak'a'.
Tato ay junok anima yelxo wal meb'a' jun, max yal-laj yak'an icha sb'isul k'een to chequel yaj chi', tz'ik'chajkot t'a yichanh junok winh sakerdote, snaji jantak wal syal yak'ani.
Axo pax yuj nok' nok' to tz'ak'jitaxon silab'il t'ayin, masanil nok' tz'ak'ji t'ayin chi', chequel tz'ajkan nok'.
Max yal-laj sk'exji nok' yet' junokxo nok', wach'chom wach' nok', ma chuktak wal nok'. Palta tato sk'exji nok', a nok' sk'exul chi', skanxonhej nok' yet' nok' chequeltaxon yaj chi'.
Axo pax yuj junok nok' nok' manh wach'oktaxon yoch silab'il t'ayin jun, a nok' chi' tz'ik'jikot t'a junok winh sakerdote,

yik wach' snaji jantak stojol nok', ato syala' chajtil yilji nok'. Icha stojol nok' ix naji yuj winh sakerdote chi', ichanhej chi' tz'ajkan stojol nok' yik schonhchaj yuj yochkan stojol nok' yikok in kajnub'.
Tato anheja' mach ay yik nok' chi' snib'ej smananpaxel nok' jun, yowalil syak' stojol nok' nab'ilxo chi', syak'an jab'okxo más t'a yib'anh stojol nok' chi'.
Tato ay mach syak' spat t'ayin, tato wach' yaji, mato chuktak wal yaji, a junok winh sakerdote snaani jantak wal stojol. Icha chi' tz'ajkan stojol chi' t'a junelnhej.
Palta tato a mach ay yik jun pat chi' snib'ej smananeli, yowalil syak' jab'okxo más t'a yib'anh icha stojol ix najikan chi', ichato chi' syik'anxi spat chi'.

Tato ay junok mach syak' junok makan sluum t'ayin, a stojol lum lum chi' snaji, ato ha' jantak sat tas tz'el t'a sat lu'um. Tato b'alunhe' arroba ixim kebada tz'elta t'a lu'um, 50 siklo plata stojol lu'um.
Tato tz'ak'ji lum lum chi' t'a yol yab'ilal yoch q'uinh yik tz'el tas t'a libre, skanxonhej stojol lum icha ix aj snajikan chi'.

Palta tato ayik toxo ix lajwiek' jun ab'il chi' tz'ak'ji lu'um, a winh sakerdote syal snaani jantak k'een plata syal yak'ji. Tz'ik'jiemta jab'ok stojol lu'um, ato syala' jayeto ab'il yik ol jax junxo ab'il q'uinh chi'.
Tato a junok mach ix yak' slum chi' t'ayin, snib'ej smananpaxeli, yowalil syak' jab'okxo más t'a yib'anh icha stojol nab'ilkani. Ichato chi' syal yik'anxikan sluum chi'.
Tato max smanel lum mach ix ak'an chi', palta to schonhb'at lum t'a junokxo anima, tato icha chi', maxtzak yal smananxiel lu'um.
Ayic skan lum lum chi' t'a libre t'a yab'ilal he chaan q'uinh yik tz'el tas t'a libre, a jun lum chi', wik tz'ajkan lu'um, haxo heb' sakerdote smakb'enankan lu'um.
Tato ay mach syak' sti' yak'an junok lum lum t'ayin to manb'il yuj, manh smakb'enoktaxon yaji,

a junok winh sakerdote snaan stojol yet' jun anima chi' masanto sjax yab'ilal q'uinh yik tz'el tas t'a libre. Ha t'a jun k'u chi' syak' stojol lum jun anima chi', ato ha' jantak ix aj snaji, tz'ochkan k'een tumin chi' wikok.
Axo yik sjax jun ab'il chi', smeltzajxi lum t'a mach ix chonhan chi', syalelk'ochi aton jun mach aytaxon yik lu'um.
Ha stojol junok tas sna heb' sakerdote stupchaj icha k'een tumin sk'anchaj b'aj ay in kajnub'. 20 geras yalil junjun siklo k'een plata.
Ha sb'ab'el yune' nok' wakax, ma nok' kalnel, ma nok' chiwa, wiktaxon yaj a in Jehová in tik. Malaj mach syal yak'an juntzanh nok' chi' yofrendaok t'ayin yujto a sb'ab'el yune' nok' wiktaxon yaji.

Tato a sb'ab'el yune' junok nok' to manh wach'ok icha yalan ley, syal smanjixiel nok' yuj mach tz'ak'an chi', ato syal jantak stojol nok' ix naji, syak' jab'okxo más t'a yib'anh icha stojol chi'. Tato manhok mach ay yik nok' chi' smananeli, anheja' icha stojol nok' nab'ilxo chi', syal schonhjiel yuj heb' sakerdote.

Yalnhej tas tz'ak'ji t'ayin t'a junelnhej, junok anima, ma junok nok' molb'etzal nok', ma junok lum lum to smakb'entaxon yaj jun mach tz'ak'an chi', ma junokxo tasi, max yal-laj schonhchaji, max yalpax smanjiel yuj mach ix ak'ani. Vicxo yaj t'a junelnhej.
Axo pax junok anima toxonton ayoch chamel t'a yib'anh, max yal-laj smanjieli. Ha jun anima chi' yowalil tz'ochxonhej chamel chi' t'a yib'anh.
Ha sdiezmoal sat masanil tas tz'awchaj t'a sat lum lum tik, wach'chom sat ixim, ma sat te te', wiktaxon yaji.
Tato ay junok mach snib'ej smananel jun diezmo chi', yowalil syak' jab'okxo más t'a yib'anh icha stojol chi'.
Jun t'a lajlajunhwanh nok' wakax, ma nok' kalnel, ma nok' chiwa, aton nok' chi' skan t'a diezmoal t'ayin tato wach' nok', ma ay spaltail nok'.

Max yal-laj sik'laj nok', ma sk'exchaj nok' yet' junokxo nok' ch'ok yeli. Tato ay mach snib'ej sk'exan nok', a nok' b'ab'el chi' yet' pax nok' tz'ak'ji sk'exulok nok' chi', skanxonhej nok' schawanhil. Max yalpaxlaj smanjiel nok', xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ha t'a jolom witz Sinaí ix yak' juntzanh cheknab'il tik Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi', yik chonhab' Israel yaji.

Ha t'a b'ab'el k'ual, t'a schab'il uj yik schab'il ab'il yelta heb' israel t'a Egipto, ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés t'a tzinan lum Sinaí, aton b'aj ay skajnub' Jehová Dios b'aj sch'ox sb'a. Ix yalan icha tik:
Ik'chaanh sb'isul heb' winak t'a skal heb' etchonhab' israel, ato syal junjun makan yaj heb' aton heb' ayto yuj sb'a, yik wach' tz'ilji jantak heb' yet' tastak sb'i heb'.
Sb'ischaj heb' 20 ab'il sk'inal, sb'eynhejb'ati, aton heb' smoj wal sb'at t'a owal, tz'ak'chajoch heb' t'a makquiltaquil. Colwajokab' winhaj Aarón ed'ok,
yet' pax junjun yajalil junjun inhtilal.

Aton sb'i juntzanh heb' yajal yowalil skolwaj ed'ok tik: Ha t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj Rubén, aton winhaj Elisur yuninal winhaj Sedeur. Ha t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj Simeón, aton winhaj Selumiel yuninal winhaj Zurisadai. Ha t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj Judá, aton winhaj Naasón yuninal winhaj Aminadab. Ha t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj Isacar, aton winhaj Natanael yuninal winhaj Zuar. Ha t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj Zabulón, aton winhaj Eliab yuninal winhaj Helón. Ha t'a heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj José, ha t'a heb' yik winhaj Efraín, aton winhaj Elisama yuninal winhaj Amiud, ha t'a heb' yik winhaj Manasés, aton winhaj Gamaliel yuninal winhaj Pedasur. Ha t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj Benjamín, aton winhaj Abidán yuninal winhaj Gedeoni. Ha t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj Dan, aton winhaj Ahiezer yuninal winhaj Amisadai. Ha t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj Aser, aton winhaj Pagiel yuninal winhaj Ocrán. Ha t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj Gad, aton winhaj Eliasaf yuninal winhaj Deuel. Ha t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj Neftalí, aton winhaj Ahira yuninal winhaj Enán, xchi Dios.
Aton juntzanh heb' yajal tik ix sik'chajel t'a skal masanil yinhtilal Israel.

Ha t'a b'ab'el k'ual t'a schab'il ujal yik jun ab'il chi', ix smolb'ej juntzanh heb' winh tik winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón, to satil tz'ajkan heb' winh yuj Dios. Anheja' ix molb'ajpax masanil heb' chonhab'. Icha chi' ix aj yik'jichaanh sb'isul heb' israel. D'a stzolal ix aj stz'ib'chaj sb'i heb', aton heb' 20 ab'il sk'inal, sb'eynhejb'ati, ato ha' smakanhil t'a junjun inhtilal,
icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés. Ha t'a tzinan lu'um t'a Sinaí ix ik'jichaanh sb'isul heb' chi'.

Ha t'a junjun inhtilal, t'a junjun makquiltaquil, ix ik'jichaanh sb'isul heb' chi'. Ix tz'ib'chaj sb'i heb' yet' sb'isul heb' winak tz'akanxo yab'ilal t'a 20 ab'il, yuj chi' aton wal ix aj yelk'och tik: Ha t'a yinhtilal winhaj Rubén, aton sb'ab'el yuninal winhaj Israel, 46 mil 500 heb' winak smoj sb'at t'a owal.
Ha t'a yinhtilal winhaj Simeón, ay 59 mil 300.
Ha t'a yinhtilal winhaj Gad, ay 45 mil 650.
Ha t'a yinhtilal winhaj Judá, ay 74 mil 600.
Ha t'a yinhtilal winhaj Isacar, ay 54 mil 400.
Ha t'a yinhtilal winhaj Zabulón, ay 57 mil 400.
Axo t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj José: Ay 40 mil 500 t'a yinhtilal winhaj Efraín, ay pax 32 mil 200 t'a yinhtilal winhaj Manasés.
Ha t'a yinhtilal winhaj Benjamín, ay 35 mil 400.
Ha t'a yinhtilal winhaj Dan, ay 62 mil 700.
Ha t'a yinhtilal winhaj Aser, ay 41 mil 500.
Ha t'a yinhtilal winhaj Neftalí, ay 53 mil 400.
Aton ix aj yelk'och juntzanh sb'isul ix yik'chaanh winhaj Moisés tik, winhaj Aarón yet' lajchawanhxo heb' yajal yaj t'a skal heb' israel t'a junjun inhtilal.
Ix k'e waan juntzanh sb'isul chi' t'a junjun inhtilal, t'a junjun makquiltaquil. Ha heb' israel, 20 ab'il sk'inal sb'eynhejb'ati, aton heb' chi' smoj sb'at t'a owal.
Ha t'a smasanil ay 603 mil 550 heb'.
Ha yinhtilal winhaj Leví, maj ak'jiochlaj heb' sb'isulok,
yujto a Jehová ix alan t'a winhaj Moisés:
Ayic ol ik'ank'e waan sb'isul chonhab' Israel tik, manh ol ak'ochlaj yinhtilal winhaj Leví sb'isulok.

Yujto a ex yinhtilalexkan winhaj Leví chi', ol ex och yak'umalok serwil in kajnub' b'aj ayek' skaxail in trato yet' masanil syamk'ab'il. Anheja' ex ol eyik'nhej b'ey in kajnub' chi' yet' masanil syamk'ab'il. Yowalil ol ex ajnhej kajan t'a spatik yichanh in kajnub' chi'.
Ayic tz'ik'jib'at t'a juntak el, a ex tze xuyemi, tze b'oanpaxk'e b'aj sk'och chi'. Yalnhej mach junok anima manh lewitaok sjawi t'a slak'anil jun in kajnub' chi', tojolnhej schami.
Axo masanil juntzanhxo yinhtilal Israel ol kajnaj icha t'a stzolal, junjun heb' ol aj t'a skampamento, t'a yalanh sbandera.
Ha exxo pax yinhtilal ex kan winhaj Leví chi' jun, ha t'a spatik yichanh in kajnub' ol ex ajok. Ha ex ol he tanhwej, yik wach' max kot wowal t'a in chonhab' Israel, xchi Jehová.
Ix sk'anab'ajej heb' israel sk'ulan icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón icha tik:

Ayic sb'oank'e skampamento heb' israel t'a junok lugar, junjun tz'aj t'a yalanh sbandera yet' junjun makquiltaquil, yowalil najattak wal tz'ajel heb' t'a spatik yichanh mantiado, aton b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a.

Ha t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, ata' tz'aj skampamento oxe' inhtilal ed'jinak sbandera yinhtilal Judá. Ha heb' soldado yik yinhtilal Judá chi', a winhaj Naasón yuninal winhaj Aminadab ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Ato ha' yalan sb'isul, ay 74 mil 600 heb' soldado.
Junnhej tz'aj skampamento yinhtilal Isacar yet' heb'. Ha winhaj Natanael yuninal winhaj Zuar ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Ato ha' yalan sb'isul, ay 54 mil 400 heb' soldado.
Ata' tz'ajpax skampamento yinhtilal Zabulón. Ha winhaj Eliab, yuninal winhaj Helón ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Ato ha' yalan sb'isul, ay 57 mil 400 heb' soldado.
Yuj chi' a b'aj ay skampamento yinhtilal Judá chi', ay 186 mil 400 heb' soldado, aton heb' b'ab'el sb'at t'a yichanh heb' chonhab' israel.
Axo t'a stojolal sur, ata' tz'aj skampamento oxe' inhtilal ed'jinak sbandera yinhtilal Rubén. Ha heb' soldado yik yinhtilal Rubén chi', a winhaj Elisur yuninal winhaj Sedeur ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Ato ha' yalan sb'isul, ay 46 mil 500 heb' soldado.
Junnhej tz'aj skampamento yinhtilal Simeón yet' heb'. Ha winhaj Selumiel yuninal winhaj Zurisadai ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Ato ha' yalan sb'isul, ay 59 mil 300 heb' soldado.
Ata' tz'ajpax skampamento yinhtilal Gad yet' heb'. Ha winhaj Eliasaf yuninal winhaj Reuel ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Ato ha' yalan sb'isul, ay 45 mil 650 heb' soldado.
Yuj chi' a b'aj ay skampamento yinhtilal Rubén chi', ay 151 mil 450 heb' soldado, aton heb' sb'ey t'a yik schab'il makan.

Sb'atpax heb' lewita t'a skal chanhe' kampamento. Ha heb' ed'jinak smantiadoal b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a. Ha chanhe' kampamento chi', t'a stzolal tz'aj sb'eyi icha tas yajek' heb' t'a skampamento, junjun heb' t'a yalanhtak sbandera.

Axo t'a stojolal b'aj sb'at k'u, ata' tz'aj skampamento oxe' inhtilal ed'jinak sbandera yinhtilal Efraín. Ha heb' soldado t'a yinhtilal Efraín chi', a winhaj Elisama yuninal winhaj Amiud ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Ato ha' yalan sb'isul, ay 40 mil 500 heb' soldado.
Junnhej tz'aj yinhtilal Manasés yet' heb'. Ha winhaj Gamaliel yuninal winhaj Pedasur ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Ato ha' yalan sb'isul, ay 32 mil 200 heb' soldado.
Ata' tz'ajpax skampamento yinhtilal Benjamín. Ha winhaj Abidán yuninal winhaj Gedeoni ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Ato ha' yalan sb'isul, ay 35 mil 400 heb' soldado.
Yuj chi' a b'aj ay skampamento yinhtilal Efraín chi', ay 108 mil 100 soldado, aton heb' sb'ey t'a yoxil makan.
Axo t'a stojolal norte, ata' tz'aj skampamento oxexo inhtilal ed'jinak sbandera yinhtilal Dan. Ha heb' soldado t'a yinhtilal Dan chi', a winhaj Ahiezer yuninal winhaj Amisadai ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Ato ha' yalan sb'isul, ay 62 mil 700 heb' soldado.
Junnhej tz'aj skampamento yinhtilal Aser yet' heb'. Ha winhaj Pagiel yuninal winhaj Ocrán ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Ato ha' yalan sb'isul, ay 41 mil 500 heb' soldado.
Ata' tz'ajpax skampamento yinhtilal Neftalí yet' heb'. Ha winhaj Ahira yuninal winhaj Enán ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Ato ha' yalan sb'isul, ay 53 mil 400 heb' soldado.
Yuj chi' a b'aj ay skampamento yinhtilal Dan chi', ay 157 mil 600 heb' soldado. Aton heb' sb'eyb'at t'a spatik sbandera yinhtilal Dan chi', aton heb' tzak'anto sb'ati, xchi Jehová.
Ha sb'isul heb' israel, ay 603 mil 550 heb' soldado t'a smasanil.
Palta maj och heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Leví sb'isulok, icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix sk'ulej heb' israel icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová. Junnhej ix aj heb' t'a yalanhtak sbandera, ix b'eyb'at heb' t'a stzolal, ato syal junjun makquiltaquil.
Aton heb' yinhtilal winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yinhtilal winhaj Moisés tik, ayik ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' t'a jolom witz Sinaí.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Aarón chi': Vinhaj Nadab b'ab'el winak, winhaj Abiú, winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Itamar.
Ha heb' chanhwanh tik, ix sik'jiel heb', ix ochkan yopisio heb' sakerdoteal.

Palta a winhaj Nadab yet' winhaj Abiú chi', ix cham heb' winh t'a yichanh Jehová t'a tzinan lum Sinaí, yujto ix yak'och jun k'ak' heb' winh icha ofrenda t'a yichanh Jehová to manh smojok. Mantalaj yuninal heb' ta', yuj chi' axonhej winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Itamar ix munlaj sakerdoteal t'a yalanh smandar winhaj Aarón aton smam heb'.
Ix lolonxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi', ix yalan icha tik:
Avtej masanil heb' winh winak t'a yinhtilal Leví, yik skolwaj heb' yet' winhaj sakerdote Aarón icha ol yal winh.

Ha heb' chi' ayoch yopisio t'a yichanh winhaj Aarón chi' yet' t'a yichanh chonhab' t'a mantiado b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a. Stanhwanpax masanil yamk'ab' yik mantiado chi' heb'. Icha chi' tz'aj yak'ji serwil masanil chonhab' Israel yuj heb' t'a masanil munlajel b'aj ay in kajnub'.
Ik'chajokab'el heb' lewita t'a skal heb' eyetchonhab' smasanil yik wach' syak' serwil winhaj Aarón heb' yet' t'a masanil yinhtilal winh.
Anhej t'a yib'anh winh yet' yinhtilal tz'ochkan yopisio yak'an sakerdoteal. Tato ay junok mach manh yinhtilok winh chi' syekoch sb'ha t'a jun opisio chi', yowalil schami, xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Toxo ix ex in sik'kanel a ex lewita ex tik sk'exulok junjun heb' b'ab'el winak unin t'a skal heb' etisraelal, yuj chi' wik eyaji.

Ayic ix wak'ancham masanil heb' b'ab'el winak unin t'a Egipto, ix wak'kan sb'ab'el winak unin heb' etisraelal yik tz'ochkan wikok, icha pax chi' nok' b'ab'el yune' nok' he molb'etzal nok' wik yaji. Ha in Jehová in swala', xchi t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' t'a tzinan lu'um Sinaí, ix yalani:
Ik'k'e waan sb'isul heb' etlewitail, icha junjun makquiltaquil, masanil heb' winak t'a he kal. Tza chael yich t'a heb' jun ujal sk'inal sb'eynhejb'ati, xchi Jehová.
Yuj chi' ix yik'chaanh sb'isul heb' winhaj Moisés chi', icha ix aj yalan Jehová.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Leví: Aton winhaj Gersón, winhaj Coat yet' winhaj Merari.
Axo heb' yuninal winhaj Gersón chi': Aton winhaj Libni yet' winhaj Simei, aton heb' winh tik sb'inajnhej t'a yinhtilal.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Coat: Aton winhaj Amram, winhaj Izhar, winhaj Hebrón yet' winhaj Uziel, aton heb' winh tik sb'inajnhej t'a yinhtilal.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Merari: Aton winhaj Mahli yet' winhaj Musi, aton heb' winh tik sb'inajnhej t'a yinhtilal. Ha heb' winh tik, yajal yaj heb' winh t'a junjun makan yinhtilalkan winhaj Leví.
Ha heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Gersón, cha makan yaj heb', aton heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Libni yet' heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Simei.
Ha sb'isul heb' winak t'a smasanil, ix chajiel yich t'a heb' jun ujal sk'inal sb'eynhejb'ati, ay 7 mil 500.
Masanil heb' tik, ha t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, t'a spatik skajnub' Jehová tz'aj skampamento heb'.
Ha pax mach yajal yaj t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj Gersón, aton winhaj Eliasaf yuninal winhaj Lael.
Aton heb' tz'ilan juntzanh smakul yib'anh skajnub' Jehová b'aj sch'ox sb'a yet' k'apak kortina ayoch t'a sti' skajnub' chi',
k'apak skortinail amak' oyanoch t'a spatik skajnub' Jehová yet' b'aj ay altar, k'apak kortina ayoch t'a sti' amak' chi' yet' sch'anhal ayoch t'a spatik syamk'ab'il.
Ha heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Coat, chanh makan yaj heb': Aton heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Amram, heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Izhar, heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Hebrón yet' heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Uziel.
Ha sb'isul masanil heb' winak ix schael yich t'a heb' jun ujal sk'inal sb'eynhejb'ati, ay 8 mil 600 heb', aton heb' tz'ilan skajnub' Jehová.
Masanil heb' tik, ha t'a stz'eyel skajnub' Jehová t'a stojolal sur tz'aj skampamento heb'.
Ha yajalil juntzanh heb', aton winhaj Elizafán yuninal winhaj Uziel.
Aton heb' tik tz'ilan te' skaxail trato, te' mexa, sb'akhnub' kandil, chab' altar yet' masanil jantak syamk'ab'il sk'anchaj t'a yol skajnub' Jehová yet' pax k'apak kortina ayoch t'a yool.
Ha jun sat yajal yajoch t'a skal heb' lewita chi', aton winhaj Eleazar yuninal winhaj sakerdote Aarón, a winh tz'ilan masanil heb' smunlaj t'a skajnub' Jehová.
Ha heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Merari, cha makan yaj heb', aton heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Mahli yet' heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Musi.
Ha sb'isul masanil heb' winak, tz'el yich t'a heb' jun ujal sk'inal sb'eynhejb'ati, ay 6 mil 200 heb'.
Ha yajalil heb', aton winhaj Zuriel yuninal winhaj Abihail. Tz'aj skampamento heb' t'a stz'eyel skajnub' Jehová t'a stojolal norte.
Aton heb' tik tz'ilan te' smarkoal, sreglail, yoyal, sb'akhnub'al, masanil syamk'ab'il,
yet' pax yoyal oyanoch t'a spatiktak amak', sb'akhnub'al, yestakail yet' masanil sch'anhal.

Axo pax t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a yichanhb'at skajnub' Jehová tz'aj skampamento winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal winhaj Aarón chi', aton heb' tz'ak'wi serwil t'a yol skajnub' Jehová chi' yuj swach'ilok heb' israel. Tato ay junok mach sk'och t'a slak'anil kajnub' chi' to manh yopisiook yaji, tojolnhej schami.

Ayic ix yik'anchaanh sb'isul heb' lewita winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón t'a stzolal icha ix aj yalan Jehová, a sb'isul heb' winak t'a smasanil, ay 22 mil, tz'el yich t'a heb' jun ujal sk'inal sb'eynhejb'ati.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: Ik'chaanh sb'isul yet' sb'i heb' b'ab'el winak unin t'a skal heb' etchonhab', tz'el yich t'a heb' jun ujal sk'inal sb'eynhejb'ati.

Ha heb' lewita tik, wik yaj heb' sk'exulok heb' b'ab'el unin chi'. Anheja' wikpax tz'ajkan masanil nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' sk'exulok nok' sb'ab'el yune' nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' israel tik. Ha in ton Jehová in swala', xchi t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix ik'jichaanh sb'isul masanil heb' b'ab'el winak unin t'a skal chonhab' Israel yuj winhaj Moisés chi', icha ix aj yalan Jehová.
Masanil heb' winak unin jun ujal sk'inal sb'eynhejb'ati, ay 22 mil 273 heb'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:

Ak'kanoch heb' lewita tik sk'exulok heb' b'ab'el winak unin t'a skal chonhab' Israel. Anheja' pax nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' tz'ochkan sk'exulok nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' yetisraelal, yujto wik yaj heb' lewita tik. Ha in ton Jehová in swala'.

Palta ek'al sb'isul heb' b'ab'el unin t'a chonhab' Israel t'a yichanh heb' lewita chi', yuj chi' ha t'a junjun heb' 273 b'ab'el unin syak' sobre chi', tza k'an oyeok siklo k'een plata, icha jantak yalil k'een sk'anchaj t'a in kajnub', aton 20 geras yalil.
Tzak'an juntzanh k'een tumin chi' t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yuninal, aton tz'och sk'exulok heb' b'ab'el unin syak' sobre chi', xchi Jehová.
Icha chi' ix aj smolank'e k'een tumin winhaj Moisés ix och sk'exulok heb' b'ab'el unin t'a skal chonhab' Israel syak' sobre chi'.
Ix molchaj mil 365 siklo k'een plata, icha jantak yalil k'een sk'anchaj t'a skajnub' Jehová.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an k'een winhaj Moisés t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yuninal, icha ix aj yalan Jehová.
Ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón, ix yalan icha tik:
Ik'k'e waan sb'isul heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Coat t'a stzolal t'a skal heb' lewita,
aton heb' 30 ab'il sk'inal sk'och t'a 50. Aton heb' tik smoj wal smunlaj t'a in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a.
Ha smunlajel heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Coat chi', to a juntzanh tastak wiknhej yaji, a stanhwej heb', aton juntzanh tik:
Ayic sb'atxi heb' chonhab', a ach ach Aarón yet' heb' uninal, tzeyik'el k'apak kortina ayoch smakulok jun Lugar Vicnhej Yaji, tze musan te' skaxail in trato t'a k'apak.
Axo t'a yib'anh tzeyak'b'at jun tz'uum te lab'ab'i smusilok. Axo t'a yib'anh jun chi' tzeyak'b'at jun k'apak k'ik'mutz'inak, tzeyak'anoch te' b'akhlab' yik tz'ik'jib'ati.

Tzeyak'anpaxb'at jun k'apak k'ik'mutz'inak k'apak t'a sat mexa ay t'a wichanh, haxo t'a yib'anh jun chi' tzeyak'em k'een plato, juntzanh k'een niwak kuchara, uk'ab' yet' juntzanh xalual wino tz'ak'ji t'a ofrendail yet' ixim pan tz'ak'jitaxoni.
Ha t'a yib'anh masanil juntzanh chi' tzeyak'b'at jun chakchak k'apak, tze musan t'a jun tz'uum te lab'ab'i chi', tzeyak'anpaxoch te' b'akhlab' yik tz'ik'jib'ati.

Tzeyik'anpaxkot junxo k'ik'mutz'inak k'apak, tze musan jun sb'akhnub' kandil yet' juntzanh kandil chi', k'een k'een tz'ik'anel staanhil k'apak k'apak b'aj tz'och sk'ak'al kandil yet' platillo yet' masanil yet'tal sk'anchaj yet' akeite.
Masanil juntzanh chi' tze musej t'a jun nok' tz'uum te lab'ab'i, tzeyak'ank'e t'a yib'anh te b'akhlab'.
Tzeyak'anpaxb'at junxo k'ik'mutz'inak k'apak t'a yib'anh altar nab'a oro. Tze pichan t'a juntzanh nok' tz'uum lab'ab'i, tzeyak'anpaxoch ste'al yik sb'akhchaji.

Tze molanpax k'e waan masanil yamk'ab' sk'anchaj t'a yol in kajnub', tze pichanoch t'a yol jun k'ik'mutz'inak k'apak, tzeyak'anoch juntzanhxo nok' tz'uum lab'ab'i t'ay, tzeyak'ank'e t'a yib'anh te b'akhlab'.
Yowalil tzeyik'el jantak k'een taanh kalan yet' xepu' stz'ha t'a altar, slajwi chi' tze musan altar chi' t'a jun k'apak k'apak yaxmaquinak.

Axo t'a yib'anh tz'ak'jib'at masanil tastak sk'anchaj t'a altar chi': Aton yet'tal tzak'ak' yet' juntzanh k'een tenedor, k'een pala, k'een niwak uk'ab' yet' juntzanhxo yalnhej tas yamk'ab'il. Ha t'a yib'anh masanil juntzanh chi' tz'ak'jib'at nok' tz'uum te lab'ab'i, tzeyak'anpaxoch te te' yik sb'akhchaji.

Ayic slajwi he pichan masanil juntzanh tastak niwan yelk'och chi', wach'xo yaji yik tz'ik'jib'ati, skot heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Coat yik syik'anb'at heb'. Masanil juntzanh tastak to wik yaj chi', max yal-laj syaman heb' yik max cham heb' yuj. Masanil jantak syamk'ab'il yik in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, a heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Coat yowalil tz'ik'anb'ati.

Ha winhaj Eleazar, winh uninal a ach sakerdote Aarón, a winh tz'ilan tas yaj akeite yik kandil, inkienso wach' sjab', ofrenda yik ixim trigo to yowalil tz'ak'ji t'ayin yet' akeite sk'anchaji a sik'chajel junok mach, ma junok tas tz'ochkan wikok. Ha winh stanhwan in kajnub' yet' masanil syamk'ab'il, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón chi' icha tik:
Mokab' satel heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Coat t'a skal heb' eyetlewitail.

Yic max jawi chamel t'a yib'anh heb', yuj syaman heb' tastak to wiknhej yaji, yowalil tze b'eyb'alej juntzanh tik: Ach Aarón yet' heb' uninal, yowalil tzex och yet' heb' t'a yol in kajnub'. Ha ex tzeyal t'a heb' tastak syik'b'at junjun heb'.
Yuj chi', max och heb' junok rato yil tastak to wik yaji, yik max cham heb' yuj, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Ik'chaanh sb'isul heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Gersón t'a stzolal,
aton heb' 30 ab'il sk'inal sk'och t'a 50, aton heb' smoj wal smunlaj t'a in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a.
Aton smunlajel heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Gersón tik t'a mantiado chi':
Ha heb' yowalil tz'ik'anb'at k'apak smakul yib'anh in kajnub' yet' chab'xo jenhan smakul yib'anh, nok' tz'um lab'ab'i ayoch smakulok yib'anh, k'apak kortina ayoch t'a smakulok sti',

k'apak kortina ayoch t'a spatiktak yamaq'uil in kajnub' b'aj ay altar, k'apak kortina ayoch b'aj ay sti' yamaq'uil chi' yet' syamk'ab'il yet' jantak sch'anhal ayochi yik tz'och t'a yopisio. Ha heb' ayoch t'a yib'anh yilan juntzanh ix b'inaj tik.

Ha winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal, a heb' skuchb'an masanil heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Gersón chi' t'a munlajel sk'ulej yet' yik'anb'at tastak heb' to tz'ik'jib'ati. Ha heb' tik sch'oxan tastak syik'b'at junjun heb'.

Aton wal yopisio heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Gersón tik ayik smunlaj heb' t'a in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a. Sk'anab'ajejokab' masanil tas syal winhaj Itamar heb', aton winh yuninal winhaj sakerdote Aarón.
Ik'chaanh sb'isul heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Merari t'a stzolal,
aton heb' 30 ab'il sk'inal sk'och t'a 50, aton heb' smoj wal smunlaj t'a in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a.
Ha smunlajel heb', aton yik'anb'at masanil ste'al mantiado chi' heb', aton smarkoal, sreglail, yoyal yet' sb'akhnub'al,
masanil yoyal oyanoch t'a spatiktak yamaq'uil in kajnub', sb'akhnub'al yich, yestakail, sch'anhal yet' masanil syamk'ab'il sk'anchaji. Ha ex tzeyala' tastak yowalil syik'b'at junjun heb'.
Ha jun munlajel tik skan t'a yol sk'ab' heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Merari. Ha winhaj Itamar yuninal winhaj sakerdote Aarón, a winh tz'alani tas sk'ulej heb', xchi Jehová.

Ha winhaj Moisés, winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yajalil chonhab', a heb' ix ik'anchaanh sb'isul heb' lewita smoj wal smunlaj t'a skajnub' Jehová b'aj sch'ox sb'a, aton heb' 30 ab'il sk'inal sk'och t'a 50. Aton heb' tik: Eb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Coat, winhaj Gersón yet' winhaj Merari. D'a stzolal ix ik'jichaanh sb'isul heb' icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'. Ha heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Coat, icha stzolal, ay 2 mil 750 heb' t'a smasanil. Ha heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Gersón, icha stzolal, ay 2 mil 630 heb' t'a smasanil. Ha heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Merari, icha stzolal, ay 3 mil 200 heb' t'a smasanil. Axo sb'isul heb' lewita chi' ix yik'chanh winhaj Moisés, winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yajal yaji, icha syal stzolal, aton heb' 30 ab'il sk'inal sk'och t'a 50 to smoj wal smunlaj t'a skajnub' Jehová b'aj sch'ox sb'a, ay 8 mil 580 heb' t'a smasanil.
Ha jun sb'isul tik, ix ik'chajk'e waan, ix alchaj t'a junjun heb' tastak sk'ulej yet' tastak syik'b'ati, icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al t'a masanil heb' etisraelal to a heb' anima penaay yuj lepra, heb' tz'el yinhatil yuj junok ilya ayoch t'ay, ma heb' syaman junok chamnak, yowalil tz'ik'jiel heb' t'a spatiquel kampamento.
Masanil juntzanh anima chi', tz'ik'jiel heb', heb' winh winak ma heb' ix ix, yik malaj tas manh wach'ok t'a yol kampamento b'aj ayinek' eyed'ok, xchi t'a winh.
Ix sk'anab'ajej heb' israel yik'anelta juntzanh heb' anima chi', icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al juntzanh tik t'a heb' etchonhab': Tato ay junok winak, ma junok ix ix max in k'anab'ajani, syixtan yetanimail, wan yoch smul.
Yowalil syojtaquejel spaltail chi'. Anhejtona', yowalil syak'xi sk'exul tastak ix yixtejb'at chi', syak'an jab'okxo t'a yib'anh stojol juntzanh chi'.

Tato toxo ix cham jun mach ix ixtajb'at tastak ay t'ay chi', manhxa pax junok ayto yuj sb'a smoj schaan sk'exul junok tas chi', a jun chi', tz'ochkan wikok, haxo t'a yol sk'ab' heb' sakerdote skani. Anhejtona' syak'anpax junok nok' ch'ak kalnel silab'il yik tz'ak'ji tup smul ix och chi'.
Masanil ofrenda syak' heb' etisraelal t'ayin, tz'ik'jib'at t'a heb' sakerdote. Ha juntzanh chi', yik heb' sakerdote chi' yaji.
Masanil tastak syak' junok etisraelal t'ayin, tato tz'ak'ji t'a junok winh sakerdote, yik winh tz'ajkani, xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés
to syal juntzanh tik winh t'a heb' yetisraelal: Talaj ay junok winak sna t'a spatik ix yetb'eyum to ay smul ix say t'a yol sk'ab',

to smulan ix yet' junok winak, palta max nachajel-laj yuj winh tato toxo ix mulan ix, yujto max yal ix, malaj pax junok mach ix ilan smulan ix. Mato ay pax junok winak tonhej snaank'e icha chi' t'a spatik ix yetb'eyum chi', wach'chom malaj smul ix syak'och t'a yol sk'ab' winh.

Ha t'a cha makan lolonel icha chi', a winh winak chi', syal yik'anb'at ix yetb'eyum winh t'a yichanh junok winh sakerdote. Syak'an chanheok libra ixim harina kebada winh ofrendail yuj ix, palta max sekjiemlaj akeite t'a yib'anh ixim, max ak'jipaxlaj inkienso yet' ixim, yujto a jun ofrenda chi', ofrenda yik k'ak'alk'olal, yopisio yik scheklajelta mul.
Axo winh sakerdote chi' tz'alani to snitzkot sb'a ix ix chi', tz'ik'jioch ix t'a wichanh a in Jehová in tik.

Elanhchamel syik'kot jab'ok ha ha' winh sakerdote chi' t'a yol junok lum uk'ab', aton ha ha' wiknhej yaji. Syik'anpaxk'e jab'ok pokok winh, aton lum ay t'a in kajnub', syak'anb'at winh t'a skal ha ha' chi'.

Tz'och linhan ix ix chi' yuj winh sakerdote chi' t'a wichanh a in Jehová in tik, syik'anel sk'ox ix, tz'ak'jipaxoch jun ofrenda yuj k'ak'alk'olal chi' t'a yol sk'ab' ix. Axo winh sakerdote chi' ed'jinakk'e ha ha' k'a' tz'ik'ankot yaelal,

schekan winh yak' sti' ix. Syalan winh t'a ix icha tik: Tato yel maj ach mulan yet' junokxo winak t'a yol sk'ab' winh etb'eyum tik, malaj tas ol ach ik'anok a ol uk'anem jun ha ha' k'a' ed'jinak yaelal tik.
Palta tato ix ach mulan yet' junokxo winh winak jun, ix och a mul t'a yol sk'ab' winh etb'eyum,
a Jehová ol ach ak'ankanoch ch'oxnab'ilok t'a yichanh heb' etchonhab'. Ol ach b'inaj yuj heb' t'a chukal, ol malk'e a k'ool, ol takjok yib' a xub'.
Aton wal jun yaelal chi' ol jawok t'a ib'anh a ol uk'anem jun ha ha' tik, yujto ha ha' ed'jinak yaelal, xcham winh sakerdote chi' t'a ix. Axo stak'wi ix ix chi': Ujokab' icha chi', xcham ix.
Ha juntzanh katab' chi', tz'ib'chajokab'kan yuj winh sakerdote. Slajwi chi' sb'ikanel winh yet' ha ha' k'a' tz'em t'a yol uk'ab' chi'.
Slajwi chi' syuk'anem ha' ix ix chi', haxo yik slajwi yuk'an ha' ix, skotkan yaelal t'a yib'anh ix.
Schaanek' ixim harina kebada ofrenda yuj k'ak'alk'olal winh sakerdote chi' t'a yol sk'ab' ix. Ha jun ofrenda chi' sb'akhoch winh sakerdote chi' t'a wichanh a in Jehová in tik.
Syik'ank'e jun wotzok jun ofrenda winh sakerdote chi', snhusantz'a winh t'a yib'anh altar yuj sch'oxankot masanil jun ofrenda chi'. Ayic toxo ix yuk'ej ha ha' k'a' chi' ix,

tato ay smul ix t'a yol sk'ab' winh yetb'eyum chi', skot yaelal t'a yib'anh ix yuj ha ha' syuk'em chi'. Smalk'e sk'ool ix, stakji yib' xub' ix, tz'ochkan ix ch'oxnab'ilok yet' sb'inaj t'a chukal t'a skal chonhab' chi'.
Palta tato yel malaj jab'ok smul ix, malaj jab'ok tas tz'ik'an ix, yuj chi' scheklajeli to malaj smul ix, syalnhej yalji yune' ix.
Aton jun ley tik tz'och t'a yib'anh ix ix smulan t'a yol sk'ab' winh yetb'eyum, yuj chi' tz'och winh yetb'eyum ix chi' t'a k'ak'alk'olal.

Tato ay junok winak tonhej tzek' t'a yib'anh yak'an k'ak'alk'olal t'a ix yetb'eyum, a jun winak chi' yowalil syik'kot ix yetb'eyum winh chi' t'a wichanh a in Jehová in tik, yik sb'oan winh sakerdote chi' masanil tas syal jun ley tik.
Tato yel ay smul ix ix chi', ha t'a yib'anh ix skan smul chi'. Axo t'a yib'anh winh winak chi' malaj tas skani, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al juntzanh tik t'a heb' etchonhab': Tato ay junok winak ma junok ix ix syak' sti' yak'anoch sb'ha t'a yol in k'ab' t'a nazareoal,

maxtzak yal-laj yuk'an wino, ma yuk'an junokxo tas to pajb'inak. Maxtzac yalpax yuk'an wino ochnak winagreal, ma winagre pajb'inak. Max yalpax yuk'an yal sat uwa, ma sloan sat, ma sloan sat t'a taquinhal.
Ha t'a jantak tiempo ix yak' sti' chi', manh wal jab'ok syal yab'lan masanil tastak tz'el t'a te' uwa, wach'chom sk'enal ma stz'umal.
Max yalpax sjoxanel xil sjolom masanto slajwi jantak tiempo ix yak' sti' chi' t'ayin, schanhej q'uib' xil sjolom yujto wik yaj a in Jehová in tik.
Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', max yal-laj sk'och t'a stz'ey junok chamnak,
wach'chom a smam, ma snun schami, ma junok yuk'tak, ma junok yanab', palta max yal-laj sk'och t'a stz'ey yik wach' max kan t'a chukal icha yalan ley. Yowalil wach'nhej yaji yujto wik yaji.
Ha t'a masanil tiempo b'aj ix yak' sti' chi', junelnhej wiknhej yaji.

Talaj ay junok mach junnhej ayek' yet'ok schami, a xil sjolom to wik yaj chi', manhxo wach'ok tz'ajkan icha yalan ley. Yuj chi' ayik slajwi yek'b'at uqueok k'ual ayik sb'oxikan icha yalan ley, ichato chi' sjoxjiel xil sjolom chi'.
Axo t'a yukub'ixial, syik'anb'at chawanhok nok' paramuch yalnhej tas makanhil t'a junok winh sakerdote t'a yichanh in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a.

Ha winh sakerdote chi' tz'ak'an junok nok' chi' silab'il yuj smul jun anima chi'. Axo junxo nok' snhusjitz'a nok' smasanil silab'il. Icha chi' tz'aj yak'ji tup smul yuj b'aj ix cham jun anima chi' t'a stz'ey. Ha t'a jun k'u chi', a xil sjolom sq'uib'xi, wik tz'ajxikani.

Tz'elxi yich jun pekti’ b'aj ix yak' sti' t'ayin. Ha jantak tiempo ix ek'b'at t'a yalanhtax chi', maxtzak ochlaj sb'isulok, yujto a xil sjolom wik yaji, ix ixtaxeli. Anhejtona' yowalil syik'paxb'at junok nok' kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal silab'il t'a wichanh a in Jehová in tik yuj stupan tas ix sk'ulej chi'.
Ayic slajwi jantak tiempoal ix yak' sti' jun anima chi', yowalil sb'at t'a sti' in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a.

Ata' syak'och jun silab' t'a wichanh, snhusjitz'a smasanil, aton junok nok' quelem kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal, malaj jab'ok spaltail. Anheja' syak'pax junok nok' nun kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal, malaj jab'ok spaltail. Ha jun chi' silab' yaj yuj yak'ji tup mul. Tz'ak'ji junok nok' ch'ak kalnel malaj jab'ok spaltail silab'il yik junk'olal.

Anhejtona', yowalil syak' junok yune' mooch ixim pan malaj yich, a ixim harina te wach' ayoch t'ay kalab'il yet' akeite. Syak'pax ixim k'oxox pan malaj yich, ayoch akeite t'ay. Junnhej tz'aj yak'an yet' yofrenda t'a ixim trigo yet' wino d'inhantaxon yak'ani.
Ha junok winh sakerdote tz'ak'anoch jun silab' yuj mul chi' t'a wichanh a in Jehová in yet' silab' to snhusjitz'a smasanil.
Syak'anpax nok' kalnel silab'il yik junk'olal. Junnhej tz'aj yak'an yet' ixim pan malaj yich chi'. Syak'anpax ofrenda t'a ixim trigo yet' pax wino.

Ha jun ix yak' sti' t'a nazareoal chi', sjoxchajel xil sjolom. Ha t'a yichanh in kajnub' sjoxchajeli. Smolk'e xil sjolom ayoch ch'oxnab'ilok to wik yaji, snhusjitz'ha t'a kal k'ak', aton k'ak' b'aj stz'a silab' yik junk'olal.

Ayic slajwi sjoxjiel xil sjolom chi', a winh sakerdote tz'ik'ank'e sjenhjab' nok' kalnel tajinakxo chi' yet' jun ixim pan malaj yich ayem t'a yol jun yune' mooch chi' yet' pax jun ixim k'oxox pan malaj yich, syak'anoch winh masanil t'a yol sk'ab' jun ix yak'och sb'a nazareoal chi'.

Slajwi chi', sb'akhanoch juntzanh chi' winh sakerdote chi' t'a wichanh a in Jehová in tik. Ha juntzanh chi' sik'b'ilel wikok, yik heb' sakerdote chi' yaji yet' pax snhisk'ol nok' sb'akhchajoch t'a wichanh, xub' nok' to sik'chajkaneli, yik winh sakerdote chi' yaji. Ayic toxo ix lajwi masanil juntzanh chi', a jun yak'nakoch sb'a nazareoal chi', tzaxo yal yuk'an wino.

Aton juntzanh cheknab'il tik t'a heb' nazareo: Tato ay junok nazareo chi' syak' sti' yak'an junok ofrenda ek'to t'a yichanhtaxon sleyal, yowalil sk'anab'ajej sk'ulan icha b'aj ix yak' sti' chi', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yuninal, ayik syalan wach' lolonel heb' t'a yib'anh heb' eyetisraelal, syal heb' icha tik:
Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a eyib'anh, tzex stanhwani.
Ex yilokab'och Jehová t'a tzalajk'olal, sch'oxokab' swach'k'olal t'ayex.
Xajanokab' tzex yiloch Jehová, yak'okab' junk'olal t'ayex, xchiokab' heb'.
Icha chi' ol yutej heb' in yak'an b'inaj t'a yib'anh heb' etisraelal. Ha inxo ol wak' in wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh heb', xchi t'a winh.
Ayic ix lajwi sb'oank'e skajnub' Jehová winhaj Moisés, ix yak'anoch akeite winh t'ay yet' t'a masanil syamk'ab'il yet' t'a yib'anh altar yet' syamk'ab'il.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi' a heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun inhtilal, aton heb' kolwajnak yik'anchaanh sb'isul heb' winak,

ix yak' yofrenda heb' t'a Jehová: Vaque' karreta ayk'e yenhul yib'anh yet' lajchawanh nok' mam wakax smunlaj ix yak' heb'. Syalelk'ochi, junjun karreta t'a chatakwanh heb' yajal chi', junjun pax nok' wakax chi' t'a junjun heb'. Masanil juntzanh chi' ix yak'och heb' t'a yichanh skajnub' Jehová.
Yuj chi' ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi':

Cha juntzanh karreta yet' juntzanh nok' wakax smunlaj chi', tzak'an t'a heb' lewita yik sk'an heb' t'a munlajel t'a in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, icha tastak munlajelal sk'ulej junjun heb', xchi t'a winh.
Ix schaan juntzanh karreta chi' winh, ix schaanpax nok' wakax smunlaj chi' winh, ix spojanek' winh t'a skal heb' lewita.
Ha t'a heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Gersón, chab' karreta yet' chanhwanh nok' wakax chi' ix yak' winh, icha syal smunlajel heb'.
Axo t'a heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Merari, chanhe' karreta yet' wajxakwanh nok' wakax chi' ix yak' winh, icha syal smunlajel heb' b'aj skuchb'aj yuj winhaj Itamar yuninal winhaj sakerdote Aarón.
Axo t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj Coat, malaj karreta, malaj pax nok' wakax ix ak'ji, yujto a heb' sb'akhanb'at masanil yamk'ab' yik skajnub' Jehová t'a sjolom sjenhjab'.
Ayic ix ak'jikanoch yopisio altar, ix yik'b'at yofrenda heb' yajal t'a junjun inhtilal t'a yichanh altar chi'.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': Ha t'a junjun k'u ch'okch'ok heb' yajal t'a junjun inhtilal ol yik'kot yofrenda yuj yochkan yopisio altar, xchi.

Ha t'a b'ab'el k'u, ix yik'ankot yofrenda winhaj Naasón yuninal winhaj Aminadab, yajal t'a yinhtilal Judá. D'a schab'il k'ual, ix yik'ankot yik winhaj Natanael yuninal winhaj Zuar, yajal t'a yinhtilal Isacar. D'a yoxil k'ual, ix yik'ankot yik winhaj Eliab yuninal winhaj Helón, yajal t'a yinhtilal Zabulón. D'a schanhil k'ual, ix yik'ankot yik winhaj Elisur yuninal winhaj Sedeur, yajal t'a yinhtilal Rubén. D'a yoil k'ual, ix yik'ankot yik winhaj Selumiel yuninal winhaj Zurisadai, yajal t'a yinhtilal Simeón. D'a swaquil k'ual, ix yik'ankot yik winhaj Eliasaf yuninal winhaj Deuel, yajal t'a yinhtilal Gad. D'a yuquil k'ual, ix yik'ankot yik winhaj Elisama yuninal winhaj Amiud, yajal t'a yinhtilal Efraín. D'a swajxaquil k'ual, ix yik'ankot yik winhaj Gamaliel yuninal winhaj Pedasur, yajal t'a yinhtilal Manasés. D'a sb'alunhil k'ual, ix yik'ankot yik winhaj Abidán yuninal winhaj Gedeoni, yajal t'a yinhtilal Benjamín. D'a slajunhil k'ual, ix yik'ankot yik winhaj Ahiezer yuninal winhaj Amisadai, yajal t'a yinhtilal Dan. D'a yuxluchil k'ual, ix yik'ankot yik winhaj Pagiel yuninal winhaj Ocrán, yajal t'a yinhtilal Aser. Axo t'a slajchawil k'ual, ix yik'ankot yik winhaj Ahira yuninal winhaj Enán, yajal t'a yinhtilal Neftalí. Lajannhej yofrenda junjun heb' winh ix yik'koti. Aton junjun plato nab'a plata, 130 siklo yalil junjun yet' pax junjun k'een niwak uk'ab' nab'a plata, 70 siklo yalil junjun, icha echlab' sk'anchaj t'a skajnub' Jehová. Ha juntzanh yet'tal chi' te b'ut'an yuj ixim harina te wach' kalab'il yet' akeite, aton syak' heb' t'a ofrendail. Ix yak'anpax junjun k'een niwak kuchara nab'a oro heb', 10 siklo yalil junjun, b'ut'an yet' inkienso. Ix yak'anpax junjun nok' quelem wakax heb', junjun nok' ch'ak kalnel, junjun nok' quelem kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal yik snhusjitz'ha t'a silab'il. Ix yak'anpax junjun nok' mam chiwa heb' yik tz'och silab'il yuj mul. Stzak'anilxo ix yak' silab' yik junk'olal heb', chawanh nok' toro, owanh nok' ch'ak kalnel, owanh nok' mam chiwa yet' pax owanh nok' kelemtak kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal ix yak' junjun heb'.

Masanil ofrenda ix yak' heb' yajal yaj t'a yinhtilalkan Israel, ayik ix ochkan yopisio altar, aton juntzanh tik: Lajchawe' k'een plato nab'a plata, lajchawe' uk'ab' nab'a plata yet' lajchawe' niwak kuchara nab'a oro.
Junjun plato chi' 130 siklo yalil, junjun uk'ab' 70 siklo yalil, yuj chi' a k'een plata chi' t'a smasanil, ay 2 mil 400 siklo yalil, icha echlab' sk'anchaj t'a skajnub' Jehová.
Ay pax lajchawe' k'een niwak kuchara nab'a oro b'ut'an yuj inkienso, 10 siklo yalil junjun, icha echlab' sk'anchaj t'a skajnub' Jehová. Ha k'een oro t'a smasanil, ay 120 siklo k'een.

Ha sb'isul masanil nok' nok' ix nhusjitz'a silab'il chi', aton tik: Lajchawanh nok' kelemtak wakax, lajchawanh nok' ch'ak kalnel, lajchawanh nok' kelemtak kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal, aynhej ixim trigo tz'ak'ji ofrendail yet'ok yet' pax lajchawanh nok' mam chiwa tz'ak'ji silab'il yuj mul.

Axo pax nok' nok' ix ak'ji silab'il yuj junk'olal, 24 nok' toro t'a smasanil, 60 nok' ch'ak kalnel, 60 nok' mam chiwa yet' 60 nok' kelemtak kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal. Aton masanil juntzanh ofrenda chi' ix ak'chaji ayik ix ochkan yopisio altar ayik toxo ix ochkan yikok Jehová.

Ayic tz'och winhaj Moisés chi' t'a skajnub' Jehová b'aj sch'ox sb'a yik slolon winh yet' Jehová chi', syab' wal winh slolon Jehová yet'ok t'a snanhal chab' yechel querubín ayoch t'a yib'anh b'aj tz'ak'ji tup mul, aton smakul skaxail trato.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al t'a winhaj Aarón to ayik ol yak'anoch sk'ak'al uque' kandil winh, ha t'a yichanh sb'akhnub' kandil chi' syak' yok, xchi t'a winh.
Ix sk'anab'ajej winhaj Aarón chi' sb'oanoch sk'ak'al juntzanh kandil chi' yik syak'an yok t'a yichanh, icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.

Ha jun b'akhnub' kandil chi' nab'a oro, tenb'il t'a k'een martillo, sb'at t'a yich masanto t'a sfloral t'a schon. Ix b'oji jun b'akhnub' kandil chi' icha wal yechel ix sch'ox Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Ik'kanel heb' lewita t'a skal heb' eyetisraelal tik, tza sakb'itan heb' icha yalan ley.
Icha tik ol aj a sakb'itan heb': Tza tzikoch ha ha' t'a heb' yik sakb'ikan heb', sjoxjiel masanil xil sniwanil heb'. Slajwi chi', sjuk'an spichul heb'. Icha chi' tz'aj sakb'ikan heb'.
Elanhchamel tzik'kot junok nok' quelem wakax yet' junok echlab' ixim harina te wach', kalab'il yet' akeite tz'ak'ji ofrendail t'a ixim trigo. Tz'ak'jipax junokxo nok' quelem wakax silab'il yuj mul.
Tzalan t'a heb' lewita to sja heb' smasanil t'a slak'anil kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, tza molb'anpax masanil heb' eyetisraelal.
Ha heb' lewita chi' tz'och heb' t'a wichanh. Axo ta' ol yak'k'e sk'ab' heb' eyetchonhab' t'a sjolom heb'.
Ha winhaj Aarón ol ak'anoch heb' lewita chi' t'a wichanh a in Jehová in tik yofrendaok heb' eyetisraelal chi'. Icha chi' ol aj skan heb' in yak'an serwil.

Slajwi chi', syak'ank'e sk'ab' heb' lewita chi' t'a sjolom chawanh nok' kelemtak wakax chi'. Jun nok' tz'ak'ji silab'il yuj yak'ji tup mul, haxo junxo nok' snhusjitz'a smasanil silab'il t'ayin. Icha chi' tz'aj stupkanel smul heb'.
Slajwi chi' tzak'anoch heb' t'a yichanh winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal yuj yak'jikan heb' t'ayin.
Icha chi' ol utok ik'ankanel heb' t'a skal heb' eyetisraelal yik tz'ochkan heb' wikok.
Ayic toxo ix lajwi sakb'ikan heb' icha yalan ley yet' yak'jikanoch heb' t'a yol in k'ab', tzaxo yal sja heb' t'a in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a yik smunlaji.
Aton heb' tik wik tz'ajkan t'a junelnhej t'a skal heb' eyetisraelal sk'exulok heb' b'ab'el winak unin.

Yujto wik yaj masanil sb'ab'el winak yune' heb' ix eyetchonhab' tz'alji yet' pax sb'ab'el yune' nok' he molb'etzal nok' tato winak nok'. Ayic ix in milancham masanil heb' b'ab'el unin t'a Egipto, ata' ix wak'kan masanil heb' b'ab'el winak unin yik tz'ochkan heb' wikok.
Yuj chi' a heb' lewita tik tzin cha sk'exulok heb' b'ab'el unin chi' tiknaik.

Ha in ix in sik'kanel heb' lewita tik t'a he kal a ex israel ex tik. Ix wak' heb' t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yuninal winh yik a heb' tzin ak'an serwil he k'exulok t'a in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a yuj wak'an tup he mul t'a eyib'anh. Ha heb' sja t'a wichanh he k'exulok yik max ex chami tato tzex ja t'a stz'ey in kajnub', xchi Jehová.
Icha chi' ix aj sk'anab'ajan winhaj Moisés, winhaj Aarón yet' masanil heb' israel masanil tas ix yal Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' yuj heb' lewita.
Ix sakb'itan sb'a heb' lewita chi', ix sjuk'anel spichul heb', haxo winhaj Aarón ix ak'anoch heb' t'a yichanh Jehová t'a ofrendail. Ix yak'anpax silab' winh yik stupkanel smul heb'.

Ayic ix lajwi juntzanh chi' smasanil, ix och heb' lewita chi' b'aj ay skajnub' Jehová b'aj sch'ox sb'a yik smunlaj heb' ta'. Ha winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal skuchb'an heb'. Icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi', icha chi' ix aj sk'anab'ajan heb' sk'ulan yet' heb' lewita chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Ol och heb' lewita t'a yopisio t'a in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, ayik 25 ab'ilxo sk'inal heb'.
Axo yik slajwi 50 ab'il sk'inal heb', tz'el heb' t'a yopisio t'a junelnhej.

Ayic sk'och sk'inal heb' t'a icha chi', syal skolwaj heb' yet' heb' smunlaj t'a mantiado chi', palta maxtzak munlaj heb' t'a smunlajel ichataxon ix sk'ulej. Icha chi' tzutej ak'anoch heb' lewita t'a smunlajel, xchi t'a winh.
Ayic ix lajwi yab'ilal yelta heb' israel t'a Egipto, yik b'ab'el uj t'a yol schab'il ab'il, ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' t'a tzinan lum Sinaí icha tik:
Al t'a heb' etchonhab' israel to syak'och q'uinh heb' yik snaankot heb' ayik yelnak heb' t'a libre ichataxon sk'ual to chequel yajkani.
Tzeyak'och jun q'uinh chi' t'a jun k'u chi' ayik wanxo yem k'u, aton yik 14 yoch jun uj tik, tze k'anab'ajan masanil icha yajkan t'a sleyal, xchi t'a winh.
Ichato chi' ix yalan winhaj Moisés t'a heb' yetisraelal to tz'och jun q'uinh chi'.
Ix yak'och jun q'uinh chi' heb' t'a yemk'ualil t'a 14 yoch jun uj chi' t'a tzinan lum Sinaí, icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.

Palta ha t'a skal heb' chi', ay juntzanh heb' winh manh wach'ok yaj icha yalan ley, yujto ix syam junok chamnak heb' winh, maj yal-laj yak'anoch q'uinh heb' winh t'a jun k'ual chi'. Yuj chi' ix k'och heb' winh t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón t'a jun k'u chi' yik sk'anb'an heb' winh.

Ix yalan heb' t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --Ha onh tik ix ko yam jun chamnak, yuj chi' manh wach'ok kaj icha yalan ley. ¿Tocwal manh ol chajok kak' kofrenda t'a Jehová t'a jun k'u tik yet' masanil heb' quetchonhab'? xchi heb' winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --Tanhwejec, ol wab' tas xchi Jehová eyuuj, xchi winh.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: Al juntzanh tik t'a heb' etisraelal.

E masanil a ex tik yet' heb' eyinhtilal, yowalil tzeyak'och jun q'uinh tik yik tze naankoti ayik wik'annak ex el t'a libre a in Jehová in tik. Ha mach manh wach'ok yaj icha yalan ley, yujto ix syam junok chamnak, ma heb' najat ayb'at t'a junok b'aj schek sb'a,
ol xo yak'och q'uinh heb' t'a 14 yoch schab'il uj t'a yemk'ualil. Yowalil schi nok' silab' heb' yet' anh itaj k'a' yet' ixim pan malaj yich.
Malaj jab'okxo nok' skan yuj heb' t'a junxo k'ual, max smak'poj sb'aquil nok' heb'. Icha ix aj walani, icha wal chi' tz'aj eyak'anoch q'uinh chi'.

Palta tato ay mach max ak'anoch jun q'uinh chi', wach'chom wach' yaj icha yalan ley, mato manh ayokb'at t'a junok b'aj schek sb'a, manhxaokab' yalan yik t'a he kal, yujto maj yak' yofrenda t'ayin t'a jun k'u to chequel yajkan chi', skan smul chi' t'a yib'anh.

Tato ay heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan t'a he kal, snib'ej heb' syak'och jun q'uinh chi' eyed'ok yik tzin yik'anchaanh, yowalil sk'anab'ajej heb' icha sleyal ix wala'. Ha ley ix wak' he k'anab'ajej chi', ha' sk'anab'ajej pax heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan chi' t'a he kal, xchi t'a winh.
Ha t'a sk'ual ayik ix b'ojik'e skajnub' Jehová, syalelk'ochi aton Mantiado yik trato, ix och jun asun t'a yib'anh. Ayic ix emkan k'u, lajan ix aj yilji icha k'ak', masanto ix sakb'i t'a junxo k'u.
Ichanhej chi' ix aji. Aynhejoch jun asun chi' t'a yib'anh kajnub' chi' a tzek' k'u, haxo t'ak'walil ichato ayoch sk'ak'al jun asun chi'.
Ayic sk'e waan jun asun chi' t'a yib'anh kajnub' chi', sb'eyb'at heb' israel chi'. Axo b'aj tz'ochxi waan, ata' sb'oxik'e skampamento heb'.
Ha Jehová sch'oxan t'a heb' tato sb'eyb'at heb', mato tz'och waan heb'. Ha b'aj tz'och waan jun asun chi' t'a yib'anh skajnub' Jehová, ata' skannhej heb'.
Tato niwan tiempo tz'och waan jun asun chi', sk'anab'ajej heb' t'a Jehová skan ta'.
Tato jun chab'nhej k'ual tzek' jun asun chi' jun, icha chi' sk'ulejpax heb', slajwi chi' sb'eypaxb'at heb', icha tz'aj sch'oxan Jehová t'a heb'.
Ay b'aj junnhej ak'wal tzek' jun asun chi', haxo t'a q'uinhib'alil sb'atxi, icha chi' tz'aj sb'eyxib'at heb'. Tato t'a k'ualil ma t'ak'walil sb'at jun asun chi', sb'atpax heb'.
Tato skannhej waan jun asun chi' t'a yib'anh skajnub' Jehová chab'ok k'ual, ma junok ujal, ma junok ab'il, ata' skannhej heb', max b'atlaj heb'. Tato sb'atxi jun asun chi', sb'atxi heb'.
Masanto ha' Jehová tz'alani, tz'och waan heb'. Anheja' tz'alanpaxi, sb'atxi heb'. Ix sk'anab'ajejnhej heb' t'a Jehová, icha ix aj yalan t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix lolonxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi', ix yalan icha tik:
B'ochajokab' chab'ok k'een trompeta nab'a plata, stenchaj t'a k'een martillo. Ha juntzanh k'een trompeta chi' spukhaji a tze molb'an heb' anima, ayik tzex b'eypaxb'ati.
Ha spuji chab' k'een trompeta chi', masanil chonhab' sja molan t'a ichanh b'aj ay in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a.
Palta tato junnhej k'een spuji, anhej heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun makanhil inhtilal smolb'ej sb'a.
Tato junip syak' spuji k'een trompeta chi', sk'e waan kampamento ay t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u b'aj ay in kajnub' syal chi'.
Axo yik spukhaj k'een t'a schaelal sb'at heb' ayek' t'a stojolal sur. Yuj chi' a spukhaj k'een trompeta t'a icha chi', ch'oxnab'il yaji ayik sb'eyb'at heb' chonhab'.
Tato manh junipok syak' spukhaj k'een, syalelk'ochi to tonhej smolb'aj anima.
Ha mach spu'an k'een trompeta chi', aton heb' sakerdote yinhtil winhaj Aarón. Ha jun tik ley tz'ajkan t'ayex t'a masanil tiempo.

Tato ay heb' ajk'ol sjawi yak' owal t'ayex t'a yol he makb'en, tzex el eyak' owal chi' yet' heb', elanhchamel spukhaj k'een trompeta, yik tzex in nakot a in Jehová he Diosal in tik, tzex in kolanel t'a heb' ajk'ol chi'.

Axo t'a sk'ual ay he tzalajk'olal, icha t'a sk'ual q'uinh, ma t'a yik tz'alji k'een uj, tze pu'an k'een trompeta chi' yik tzeyak'an silab' stz'ai, ma silab' yik junk'olal. Icha chi' tzex in nakoti. Ha in ton Jehová he Diosal in tik swala', xchi t'a winh.
Ayic 20 yoch schab'il uj yik schab'il ab'il yelta chonhab' Israel t'a Egipto, ix k'e waan jun asun t'a yib'anh kajnub' yik trato.
Ichato chi' ix el heb' israel t'a tzinan lum yik Sinaí, k'ojank'olal ix b'eykot heb' masanto ix jawi heb' t'a tzinan lum yik Parán, yujto ata' ix och waan jun asun chi'.
Sb'ab'elalto sb'ey heb' tik t'a stzolal icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés.
B'ab'el heb' soldado ed'jinak sbandera yinhtilal Judá. Ha winhaj Naasón yuninal winhaj Aminadab ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Axo t'a yichanh heb' soldado yik yinhtilal Isacar, ata' ayoch winhaj Natanael yuninal winhaj Zuar.
Ha winhaj Eliab yuninal winhaj Helón ayoch t'a yichanh heb' soldado yik yinhtilal Zabulón.
Ixlajwi chi', ix xuyank'e waan skajnub' Jehová heb', haxo heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Gersón yet' heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Merari ix ik'anb'ati, yujto a heb' ayoch t'a yib'anh yik'anb'eyok.
Ichato chi' ix kot heb' soldado ed'jinak sbandera yinhtilal Rubén. Ha winhaj Elisur yuninal winhaj Sedeur ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Ha winhaj Selumiel yuninal winhaj Zurisadai ayoch t'a yichanh heb' soldado t'a yinhtilal Simeón.
Ha winhaj Eliasaf yuninal winhaj Deuel ayoch t'a yichanh heb' soldado t'a yinhtilal Gad.
Tzak'anto skotpax heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Coat. Ha heb' ed'jinak masanil syamk'ab'il skajnub' Jehová. Axo ix k'och heb', toxo ix b'ojik'e skajnub' Jehová chi'.
Ichato chi' ix kot heb' soldado ed'jinak sbandera yinhtilal Efraín. Ha winhaj Elisama yuninal winhaj Amiud ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Ha winhaj Gamaliel yuninal winhaj Pedasur ayoch t'a yichanh heb' soldado t'a yinhtilal Manasés.
Ha winhaj Abidán yuninal winhaj Gedeoni ayoch t'a yichanh heb' soldado t'a yinhtilal Benjamín.

Slajwub'alxo masanil juntzanh soldado chi', ix kot heb' ed'jinak sbandera yinhtilal Dan. Aton heb' stanhwan heb' chonhab' t'a spatik chi'. Ha winhaj Ahiezer yuninal winhaj Amisadai ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Ha winhaj Pagiel yuninal winhaj Ocrán ayoch t'a yichanh heb' soldado t'a yinhtilal Aser.
Axo winhaj Ahira yuninal winhaj Enán ayoch t'a yichanh heb' soldado t'a yinhtilal Neftalí.
Icha chi' tz'aj stzolan sb'a heb' israel ayik sb'eyb'at heb'.

Ay jun k'ual, ix yal winhaj Moisés t'a winh sb'aluch, aton winhaj Hobab yuninal winhaj Ragüel aj Madián, winh snhi' winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --Ha onh tik wan ko b'at t'a jun lu'um ix yak' sti' Jehová yak'an t'ayonh. Conh qued'ok, wach' ol ach quila', yujto ix yak' sti' Jehová onh syailani, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Palta ix yalan winhaj Hobab chi' icha tik: --Maay, a in tik ol in paxkan t'a in chonhab', b'aj ay masanil heb' in k'ab' wok, xchi winh.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Moisés chi' t'a winh: --Manh onh aktejkani, yujto a ach tik ojtak yek' masanil juntzanh lugar b'aj wach' koch waan t'a tzinan lu'um tik, a ach ol onh a kuchb'ej.
Tato tzach b'at qued'ok, a tastak wach' ol yak' Jehová t'ayonh, ol kak'pax iko', xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix el heb' t'a Sinaí, aton jun tzalan b'aj ix sch'ox sb'a Jehová. Oxe' k'ual ix b'ey heb'. B'ab'el te' skaxail strato Jehová yuj heb', a sch'oxan junok b'aj wach' syik' yip heb'.
Ayic sb'eyb'at heb', tz'och jun asun yik Jehová t'a yib'anh heb' t'a k'ualil.

Ayic tz'ik'jib'at te' kaxa chi' syalan winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: Q'ueanh wan Mamin Jehová. Pech saklem heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach. Ha heb' malaj snib'ej t'ayach, elokab' lemnaj heb' t'a ichanh, xchi winh.
Ayic tz'och waan te' kaxa chi', syalanxi winh icha tik: Emanhcot Mamin Jehová, ajanh t'a ko kal a onh israel manhxo jantakok onh tik, manhxo onh b'ischajb'enok, xchi winh.

Ay jun k'u ix och ijan heb' israel yalan chukal lolonel t'a Jehová yuj yaelal tzek' t'a yib'anh heb'. Ha ix yab'an juntzanh lolonel chi' Jehová chi', ix te kot yowal t'a heb', ix yak'kot jun niwan k'ak' t'a skal heb', ix tz'ab'at heb' kajan t'a stitaquel kampamento chi'.
Ix k'e yaw heb' chonhab' t'a winhaj Moisés chi', ix sk'anan skolwal winh heb'. Axo winh ix k'anan t'a Jehová, ix tup jun k'ak' chi'.
Yuj chi' Tabera ix skuchkan jun lugar chi', yujto ata' ix yak' pitzwok jun k'ak' chi' Jehová t'a skal heb'.

Tzijtum heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayxo och t'a skal heb' israel. Ha jun makan anima chi', anhej wael naan yuj heb'. Ajun pax heb' israel ix alub'tanhani, ix ok'k'e heb', ix yalan heb' icha tik: Comonoc wal ay mach tz'ak'an jab'ok nok' chib'ej ko chi'a.
Sco nawalkoti to te ay nok' chay max ko manlaj ix ko chi' t'a Egipto. Ay pax anh pepino, te' melón, anh puerro, anh kebolla yet' anh axux, masanil juntzanh chi' ix kab'lej.
Axo pax t'a tik, te manhxa jab'ok tas skab'lej, toxonhej squixtej ko k'ool ko waan jun maná tik, xchi heb'.
