(Ha juntzanh maná chi', lajan yilji icha sat anh kulantro, k'an yilji icha stzatajil te' taj.

Axo sjab', lajan icha sjab' ixim k'oxox pan sb'o yet' akeite. Ha tz'em yal ak'wal, tz'emkan maná chi' t'a skampamento heb'. Ayic sakb'i tz'elta heb' anima chi' smol yiko', sjaxan chojok heb', sb'oan heb' icha tz'aj sb'o ixim pan t'a horno. Ay b'aj stenpoj heb', stz'anhan heb'.)
Ix yab' winhaj Moisés yok' masanil heb' israel t'a sti' smantiado junjun. Ix te kot yowal Jehová, anheja' ix te ja schab'k'olal winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalan winh t'a Jehová icha tik: --¿Tas yuj tzak' wil yaelal a in a chekab' in tik? ¿Tas wal yowal a k'ol t'a in patik, yuj chi' tzak' jun chonhab' tik in tanhwej?
Tocwal mamab'il nunab'il waji, yuj chi' tzala' to tzin chelb'at heb' icha junok nene' unin t'a sat lum lum alnakkan t'a heb' ko mam quicham.
¿B'ajtil sb'at wik' nok' chib'ej swak' schi juntzanh anima tik? Tz'ok' wal heb', tzul yalan heb' t'ayin: Ak'kot nok' chib'ej yik sko chi'a, xchi heb'.
Maxtzac yal-laj in tak'wanoch t'a wib'anh wik'anb'at jun chonhab' tik. Icha junok ikatz te al, icha wal chi' yaj swab'i.
Tato ol ak'nhej jun yaelal tik t'ayin, wach' ama tzin ak' chamok. Tato xajan in uuj jun, iq'uinel t'a skal tzijtum yaelal tik, xchi winh.

Ix yalan Jehová chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Molb'ej 70-ok heb' yichamtak winaquil chonhab', heb' winh niwak yelk'och t'a skal heb' anima tzila', tzik'ankot heb' winh t'a sti' in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, tzin a tanhwan ta' yet' heb' winh.

Axo yik ol in k'ochok, ol in lolon ed'ok. Ol wik'el jab'ok espíritu ayoch t'ayach, ol wak'anoch t'a heb' winh, yik wach' ol kolwaj heb' winh yilan heb' anima tik ed'ok, yik manh a ch'okojok ol il heb'.

Slajwi chi', tzalan t'a heb' anima chi' to sb'o sb'a heb', yujto a k'ik'an schi nok' chib'ej heb' ix sk'an chi'. Toxo ix wab' yok' heb', ix wab'an yalan heb': Comonoc ay jab'ok chib'ej sko chi'a. Te wach'nhej kajek' t'a Egipto, xchi heb'. Yuj chi' ol wak' nok' schib'ej heb' chi'.
Manh junnhejok k'ual, manh chab'ok k'ual, manh oyeok k'ual, manh lajunheok k'ual, manh junq'uinhok,

palta jun ujal ol schi nok' chib'ej chi' heb'. Ol schi nok' heb' masanto ol xej heb' yuj nok'. Ol laj ja nok' t'a yoltak snhi' heb', masanto ol syaj nok' heb'. Yujto emnaquiltak ix in yutej heb' a in Jehová in ayinek' t'a he kal. Tz'ok' heb' t'a wichanh syalan heb': ¿Tas yuj ix onh ik'elta t'a Egipto? xchi heb', xchi t'a winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --Mamin Jehová, a heb' anima wed'nak tik, ay 600 mil heb' winak stiempoal yoch soldadoal. Ch'ok pax yaj heb' ix ix yet' heb' kotak unin, tzalani to jun ujal ol ak' nok' chib'ej ko chi'a.

¿B'ajtil ol kot jantakok nok' kalnel yet' jantakok nok' wakax sko milchamok yik syab' schi'an juntzanh anima tik? Yed' pax kak'an nok' chay schi heb', wach'chom slajwik'eta nok' smasanil t'a yol ha' mar, anhejtona' max yab'laj nok', xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi Jehová chi' t'a winh icha tik: --¿Am a naani to jab'nhej in poder? Ha tiknaik ol ila' tato ol elk'och icha swal tik, mato maay, xchi t'a winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix elta winhaj Moisés yal t'a skal heb' anima tas ix yal Jehová. Ix smolb'an 70 heb' yichamtak winaquil chonhab' winh, ix och oyan heb' winh t'a spatiktak skajnub' Dios yuj winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix emul Jehová t'a skal asun, ix lolon yet' winhaj Moisés chi'. Ata' ix ik'jiel jab'ok espíritu ayoch t'a winh yuj Jehová, ix yak'anoch t'a heb' winh 70 ichamtak winak chi'. Ata' ix och ijan heb' winh slolon icha heb' yalumalel slolonel Dios, palta anhej junel chi' ix lolon heb' winh icha chi'.

Ay chawanh heb' winh ayoch sb'isulok heb' winh 70 chi', jun winh skuch Eldad, haxo junxo winh skuchan Medad. Ha heb' winh chawanh chi', ix kan heb' winh t'a kampamento, maj b'atlaj heb' winh t'a skajnub' Dios. Ajun pax heb' winh ix chaan espíritu chi', ix och ijan heb' winh yalanel slolonel Dios t'a kampamento chi'.

Axo ix yab'an jun winh quelem, ix b'at lemnaj winh yal t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --Ha winhaj Eldad yet' winhaj Medad, wan slolon heb' winh b'aj ay kampamento, ichato yalumalel slolonel Dios heb' winh, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' a winhaj Josué yuninal winhaj Nun, winh skolwaj yiktax t'a squelemal yet' winhaj Moisés chi', ix yal winh icha tik: --Mamin Moisés, a tiknaik alb'ati to skachjioch waan heb' winh chi' sloloni, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --¿Tom a gana a innhej niwan welk'och t'a skal heb' anima tik? Comonoc tz'el t'a sk'ol Jehová to syak' Yespíritu t'a masanil anima tik yik wach' tz'ochkan heb' schekab'ok, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix meltzaj winh yet' heb' yichamtak winaquil chonhab' b'aj ay kampamento chi'.

Junanto wal rato chi' ix kot jun ik' te ow t'a yol ha' mar yuj Jehová, haxo jun ik' chi' ix ik'ankot nok' tzijtumal much skuchan ub'. Ix em nok' t'a yol kampamento yet' t'a spatiktak, ay am junok k'ual stek'nab'il spatiktak kampamento chi' b'aj ix k'och k'aman yem nok'. Junxonhej am wal metro schaanhil tzek' jenhenhok nok' t'a yib'anh lu'um.

Masanil t'a jun k'u chi' yet' masanil jun ak'wal yet' masanil t'a junxo k'u ix syam nok' heb' anima chi'. Ha mach quennhej nok' ix yamchaj yuj, aynhejam lajunheok b'ulanh nok' ix syama'. Masanil heb' anima ix och ijan sb'oan nok', ix yak'an takjok nok' heb' t'a spatiktak kampamento chi'.
Ayic wan schi'an nok' ub' chi' heb', ix kot yowal sk'ol Jehová t'a heb', ix yak'ankot jun yaelal t'a yib'anh heb'. Te niwan heb' ix chami.
Yuj chi' ix skuchkan jun lugar chi' Quibrot-hataawa, yujto ata' ix mukchajkan heb' pek'chib'ej chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix el heb' t'a Quibrot-hataawa chi', ix b'at heb', ix k'och heb' t'a jun lugar skuch Hazerot. Ata' ix kajnajkan heb' jun pekti’.
Ix och ijan ix María yet' winhaj Aarón yalan spekal winhaj Moisés, yujto yik'nak jun ix kusita winh yetb'eyumok.
Anheja' ix yalanpax heb': Tocwal anhej t'a winhaj Moisés chi' slolon Jehová. Slolonpax t'ayonh, xchi heb'. Palta ix yab' Jehová tas ix yal heb' chi'.
D'a wal yel, anhej winhaj Moisés te emnaquil syutej sb'ha t'a skal heb' anima t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik.

Yuj chi', elanhchamel ix yal Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés, t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a ix María chi' icha tik: Cotanhec eyoxwanhil t'a sti' in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, xchi. Yuj chi' ix k'och heb' yoxwanhil.
Ixlajwi chi' ix emul Jehová t'a skal jun niwan asun, ix och moyan t'a sti' skajnub' chi', ix awtaj winhaj Aarón yet' ix María chi' yuj. Axo ix k'och heb' t'a yichanh, ix yalan icha tik:
Ab'ek wal tas ol wala': Ayic swak'ankot junok in chekab' t'a he kal, a in tzin ch'ox in b'a t'ay, tzin lolonpax t'a wayichal t'ay.
Axo pax yet' winh in chekab' aj Moisés tik, manh ichokta' swutej, yujto anhej winh k'anab'ajum syutej sb'ha t'a skal heb' wik yaji.

Q'uelk'umb'a tzin aj yet' winh tzin loloni, te jichichi tz'aj in loloni yet' in yilan winh. Tato k'elk'umb'a tz'aj in sat in lolon yet' winh ¿tas wal yuj tze tek'b'ej he b'a eyalan spekal winh? xchi t'a heb'.
Ix te kot yowal Jehová t'a heb', ix lajwi chi' ix b'ati.
Ayic ix k'e waan asun chi' t'a yib'anh skajnub' Dios, haxo ix María chi' sakwequinak yilji sniwanil ix yuj lepra. Ix och k'elan winhaj Aarón chi' t'a ix, ix yilan winh to ayxo och lepra t'a ix.
Yuj chi' ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: Mamin, ak' wal niwank'olal t'ayonh, yujto yuj ko manh pensaril ix och ko mul.
Comonoc tz'el t'a a k'ol max kan ix icha junok nene' unin chamnakxo ayik tz'alji, ixtaxnakxob'at sniwanil, xchi winhaj Aarón chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix och ijan winhaj Moisés chi' yalan t'a Jehová: Mamin, tzin tewi t'ayach to tzik'el jun ilya tik t'a ix wanab' tik, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi Jehová chi' t'a winh: Q'uinalok tato a smam ix stzub'anoch t'a sat, ¿tom max kan ix q'uixwelal uqueok k'ual? Ocxom yuj jun smul ix ix och tik, yowalil tz'el ix uqueok k'ual t'a spatiquel kampamento. Slajwi chi', schajixioch ix, xchi t'a winh.
Yuj chi' uque' k'ual ix ik'jiel ix María chi' t'a spatiquel kampamento chi'. Ayic ayelta ix t'a spatiquel kampamento chi', maj b'eyb'atlaj heb' chonhab' chi'.
Axo yik ix ochxi ix t'a yol kampamento chi', ix el heb' chonhab' chi' t'a Hazerot, ix b'at heb' t'a tzinan lu'um t'a yol yik Parán.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Ak'b'at jaywanhok heb' winh winak, yik sb'at heb' winh yil lum Canaán, lum ol wak' t'ayex. Tza sik'el junjunok heb' winh yajal yaj t'a junjun inhtilal, tza chekanb'at heb' winh, xchi t'a winh.

Ix sk'anab'ajej winhaj Moisés cheknab'il ix yal Jehová chi'. Ix schekb'at heb' winh ix sik'el winh chi', ix el heb' winh t'a tzinan lum t'a yol yik Parán, ix b'at heb' winh yila' tas yilji lum Canaán chi'. Yajal yaj heb' winh smasanil t'a skal heb' yetisraelal.
Icha tik sb'i heb' winh yet' tastak yinhtilal:

Ha winhaj Samúa yuninal winhaj Zacur, t'a yinhtilal Rubén. Ha winhaj Safat yuninal winhaj Horí, t'a yinhtilal Simeón. Ha winhaj Caleb yuninal winhaj Jefone, t'a yinhtilal Judá. Ha winhaj Igal yuninal winhaj José, t'a yinhtilal Isacar. Ha winhaj Oseas yuninal winhaj Nun, t'a yinhtilal Efraín. Ha winhaj Palti yuninal winhaj Rafú, t'a yinhtilal Benjamín. Ha winhaj Gadiel yuninal winhaj Sodi, t'a yinhtilal Zabulón. Ha winhaj Gadi yuninal winhaj Susi, t'a yinhtilal José, syalelk'ochi t'a yinhtilal Manasés. Ha winhaj Amiel yuninal winhaj Gemali, t'a yinhtilal Dan. Ha winhaj Setur yuninal winhaj Micael, t'a yinhtilal Aser. Ha winhaj Nahbi yuninal winhaj Vapsi, t'a yinhtilal Neftalí. Ha winhaj Geuel yuninal winhaj Maqui, t'a yinhtilal Gad.
Aton sb'i heb' winh ix schekb'at winhaj Moisés yil lum Canaán. (Ix k'exwi sb'i winhaj Oseas yuninal winhaj Nun yuj winhaj Moisés chi', Josué ix sb'iejkan winh yuj winh.)
Ayic ix yak'anb'at heb' winh ilum lu'um winhaj Moisés chi' t'a Canaán, ix yal winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Ixiquec, ha t'a Neguev tzex b'ati, tzex k'ek'och t'a tzalquixtak,
tzeyilani tas yilji lu'um. Tzeyilanpaxi tas yilji anima kajan ta', tek'an am heb' mato maay. Scham eyilanpaxi, tzijtum am heb' mato jaywannhej heb'.
Tzeyilani, yoltak am mantiado kajan heb' anima chi' mato oyanoch muro t'a spatik schonhab' heb'. Tato wach' lu'um mato maay,

tato yax sat lu'um mato taquinh. Tzeyilani tato ay ste'al lu'um. Tzeyak' eyip eyik'ankot sat tas awab'il t'a sat lu'um chi', tzeyik'kot jab'ok quila', xchi winh t'a heb' winh. Ha t'a stiempoal sb'ab'el sat te' uwa, ata' ix xid'ek' heb' winh chi'.
Ix el heb' winh t'a lum tzinan lum yik Zin masanto ix k'och heb' winh t'a Rehob t'a slak'anil Hamat.

Ix k'ek'och heb' winh t'a Neguev masanto ix k'och heb' winh t'a Hebrón. Ata' ay schonhab' winhaj Ahimán, winhaj Sesai yet' winhaj Talmai, yinhtilalkan winhaj Anac. Ha chonhab' Hebrón chi', uquexo ab'il sb'oi ayik sb'onak chonhab' Zoán t'a Egipto.

Ayic ix k'och heb' winh t'a jun ch'olan skuch Escol, ata' ix xiquel jun k'ojlab' sat te' uwa heb' winh, ix stzek'anoch heb' winh t'a jun te te'. Chawanh heb' winh ix ik'ankoti, ix yak'ank'e heb' winh t'a sjolom sjenhjab'. Ix yik'anpaxkot sat te' granado heb' winh yet' sat te' higo.
Escol ix skuchkan jun ch'olan chi', yujto ata' ix xiquel jun k'ojlab' sat te' uwa chi' heb' winh ilum lu'um chi'.
Ixlajwi yilan lum lum chi' heb' winh t'a 40 k'ual, ix meltzaj heb' winh

t'a Cades, t'a tzinan lum t'a yol yik Parán. Ata' ayek' winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón yet' masanil heb' yetisraelal heb' winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix och ijan heb' winh yalani chajtil yilji lum lum chi', ix sch'oxan sat te' awb'en te' ix yik'kot heb' winh chi' t'a lu'um.
Ix yalan heb' winh t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --Toxo ix b'at quil lum lum ix ala', wal yel te wach' lu'um, te yax sat lu'um, ina sat tastak tz'el t'a sat lum tik.

Palta a heb' anima kajan ta' te tek'an heb', yelxo wal niwak chonhab' yilji schonhab' heb'. Ayoch smuroal spatiktak schonhab' heb' chi'. Anhejtona' ix quilpax heb' winh winak te chaanh steel, aton heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Anac.

Ha heb' amalekita kajan t'a sat lum Neguev, haxo t'a siquil lum yet' t'a tzalquixtak, ata' kajan heb' hitita yet' heb' jebuseo yet' pax heb' amorreo. Axo pax t'a stitak ha ha' mar yet' t'a stitak ha' Jordán, a heb' kananeo kajan t'ay, xchi heb' winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Caleb t'a masanil heb' israel linhanoch t'a yichanh winhaj Moisés chi' to numan tz'aj heb', ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ha tiknaik koyek, quikxo yaj lu'um. Ol elnhej heb' winh chi' kuuj, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi juntzanh heb' winh ix xid'ek' chi' icha tik: --Manh ol yal-laj kak'an owal yet' heb' chonhab' chi' yujto te tek'an heb' t'a quichanh, xchi heb' winh.

Ix yalan heb' winh t'a skal heb' chonhab' israel chi' to a jun lum lum ix b'at yil heb' winh chi' chuklaj lu'um. Ix yalanpax heb' winh: --Ha lum xid' quil chi', scham anima yuj lu'um. Masanil heb' anima ix quil ta', te niwak winaknhej heb'.

Ix quilanpax heb' te chaanh steel, heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Anac. Ha tzonh och linhan t'a stz'ey heb', lajan tzonh ajkan ichok nok' chil t'a skal yok heb'. Anheja' icha chi' tzonh yutej yilanpaxoch heb', xchi heb' winh.
Ha ix yab'an juntzanh chi' heb' israel, ix k'e yaw heb' smasanil, ok'elnhej yaj heb' ix ek' jun ak'wal chi'.
Ix laj k'e nhilnaj heb' yalan chukal lolonel t'a winhaj Moisés chi' yet' t'a winhaj Aarón, ix yalan heb' icha tik: Wach' am wal tato ha t'a Egipto onh chamkani, ma jun t'a tzinan lum tik tzonh chami.

¿Tas yuj tzonh yik'b'at Jehová t'a jun lum lum chi', a am yuj ko cham t'a skal owal ta', yik skan heb' ix quetb'eyum yet' heb' kuninal t'a yol sk'ab' heb' kajan ta'? Yelxom wal wach' tato tzonh meltzaj t'a Egipto, xchi heb' israel chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix och ijan heb' smol alan icha tik: Co say junok mach tzonh kuchb'an meltzaj t'a Egipto, xchi heb'.
Yuj chi' ix em nhojan winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón t'a sat lum t'a yichanh heb' anima chi' smasanil.
Axo pax winhaj Josué yuninal winhaj Nun yet' winhaj Caleb yuninal winhaj Jefone, aton heb' winh ix xid'ek' iloj lu'um chi', ix snhik'chitejel spichul heb' winh yuj sch'oxanel skusk'olal.
Ix yalan heb' winh t'a heb' anima smasanil icha tik: --Ha lum lum ix b'at quil chi', te wach' lu'um.
Te yax sat lu'um. Tato tz'el t'a sk'ol Jehová skolwaj qued'ok, ol quik'nhej lu'um, ha' ol ak'an lum t'ayonh.

Yuj wal chi', manh eyik'el he b'ha t'a spatik Jehová, manh ex xiw t'a heb' anima ay t'a jun lu'um chi'. Icha ko waan junok pan, icha chi' ol aj ko satanel heb'. ¿Toc ay mach ol kolan heb' t'ayonh? Ha onhxo pax tik ayoch Jehová qued'ok. Manh ex xiw t'a heb', xchi heb' winh.

Yuj chi' a heb' anima chi' ix yal heb' to sjulk'enej heb' winh chawanh chi' heb'. D'a wal jun rato chi', t'a yichanh heb' chonhab' smasanil, ix sch'ox sb'a Jehová yet' stziquiquial t'a sti' skajnub' b'aj sch'ox sb'a.

Ix yalan t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --¿B'aq'uinh ol yaktej juntzanh anima tik in spatikaneli? ¿B'aq'uinh ol yaktej heb' in schab'k'olani, tik wal syil heb' jantak tas satub'tak ix in ch'ox t'a skal heb'?
Ha tiknaik ol wak'kot junok niwan ilya t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik yik sateli. Ha t'ayach ol el junok chonhab' wuuj to yelxo niwan, te tek'an ol aj t'a yichanh heb' chonhab' tik, xchi t'a winh.
Palta ix tak'wi winhaj Moisés chi' t'a Jehová icha tik: --Yojtak wal heb' aj Egipto jantak a poder ayik ix elta heb' chonhab' tik t'a skal heb'. Ayic ol yab'an heb' to tza satel heb' a chonhab' tik,

ol yalan a pekal heb' t'a heb' anima ay t'a yol yik Canaán. Ha heb' chi', ix yab'pax heb' to a ach Jehová ach tik, ayach ek' t'a ko kal, k'elk'umb'a tzach aj qued'ok tzach loloni. Ayachnhej ek' t'a skal jun asun ayek' t'a quib'anh. D'a k'ualil ayachoch t'a skal jun niwan topanh asun chi', tzach b'eynhej t'a quichanh. Axo t'ak'walil, t'a skal jun niwan k'ak' ayachochi, tzach b'eynhej t'a quichanh a onh a chonhab' onh tik. Masanil juntzanh tik ix yab' spekal heb' aj Canaán chi',
palta tato junelnhej tza satel heb' a chonhab' tik, icha tz'aj satel junok anima, haxo heb' anima ol ab'an spekal, tzijtum tas ol yal heb'. Olam yal heb' icha tik:
Maj yal-laj yik'jioch heb' anima yuj Jehová t'a sat lum b'aj ix yak' sti' yak'an t'a heb', yuj chi' ix satjiel heb' yuj t'a tzinan lu'um, xcham heb'.
Yuj chi', a tiknaik Mamin Jehová, tzin tewi t'ayach to tza ch'ox a poder, icha b'aj ix ak' a ti', ix alani

to max kotlaj owal t'a elanhchamel, te xajan heb' anima uuj, tz'ak'an niwank'olal smul heb' chuk yet' heb' pit. Palta max ek'b'atlaj ak'an syaelal junok mach yuj smul b'aj junelnhej pit syutej sb'a t'ayach, tzak'nhejkan yaelal t'a yib'anh yuninal yet' yixchiquin, masanto t'a schanhil makan yinhtilal.

Ak' niwank'olal smul juntzanh anima tik, icha wal a niwan wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh heb', icha ix aj ak'an niwank'olal heb' yiktax onh el t'a Egipto masanto ix onh ja t'a tzinan lum tik, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix tak'wi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --Ujokab'i, swak' niwank'olal smul heb' anima tik icha wal alan chi'.
Palta swak'och in b'a testigoal yet' in poder te niwan yelk'ochi to chequel t'a masanil yol yib'anhk’inal,

wach'chom a jantak heb' tik ix yil in poder heb' yet' juntzanh tas satub'tak ix in b'o t'a Egipto yet' t'a tzinan lum tik, palta ma chequel jayelalxo in yak'an prowal heb', max sk'anab'ajejnhej heb' tas swala'.
Yuj chi' manh ol k'ochlaj heb' t'a lum ix wak' in ti' wak'an t'a smam yicham heb'. Malaj junok heb' tzin patikanel tik ol k'och t'a sat lu'um.
Palta anhej winh in chekab' aj Caleb ol k'och t'a sat lu'um chi', yujto k'anab'ajum winh t'ayin, wach'nhej spensar winh. Ha winh ol makb'enan lum yet' heb' yuninal, aton lum ix xid' yil winh chi'.
kajan heb' amalekita yet' heb' kananeo t'a ch'olquixtak t'a lak'an tik, yuj chi' k'ik'an tzex meltzaji. Axo t'a tzinan lum t'a stojolalb'at ha' Chacchac Mar tzex b'ati, xchi Jehová chi'.
Ix yalanxi t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón icha tik:
--¿Jantacto tiempo ol techaj juntzanh anima malaj swach'il spensar tik wuuj? Ix wab' yalan in pekal heb'.
Ixiquec, alek t'a heb' icha tik: Ha in Jehová in, ix wak' in ti' to ol elk'och icha ix aj wab'an eyalan chi'.

Masanil heb' winh winak ek'xo sk'inal t'a 20 ab'il, heb' winh ix ik'jik'e waan slistail, aton heb' winh ix alan chuk t'a in patik, ol cham heb' winh. Ol kan k'otjab' sb'aquil heb' t'a tzinan lu'um tik.

Anhej winhaj Caleb yuninal winhaj Jefone yet' winhaj Josué yuninal winhaj Nun, ol och t'a lum lum ix wak' in ti' wak'an chi' t'ayex. Ha exxo he masanil, mach ex to chuk tas ix eyal t'a in patik, manh ol ex ochlaj t'a lu'um.
Ha heb' eyuninal ix eyala' to ol ochkan heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ool, a heb' ol wak'och t'a lum lum maj schalaj he k'ol chi'. Ol yak' tzalajb'ok sk'ol heb' ta'.
Ha exxo pax tik jun, ol kan he niwanil t'a tzinan lu'um tik.

Ha heb' eyuninal tik, 40 ab'il ol ek' heb' tanhwoj kalnel t'a tzinan lu'um tik, icha chi' ol aj stupanel he mul chi' heb', aton b'aj ix in he patiquejel chi', masanto ol ex chamkan t'a tik he masanil.

D'a 40 k'ual ix eyila' tas yilji lum xid' eyil chi', yuj chi' 40 ab'il ol och yaelal t'a eyib'anh, syalelk'ochi junjun ab'il t'a junjun k'u. Icha chi' ol aj eyojtakkaneli to swak' syaelal heb' tz'och ajk'olal t'ayin.
Ha in Jehová in tik swala', icha chi' ol wutok t'ayex. Yujto ix he molb'ejoch he b'a ajk'olal t'ayin, yuj chi' ha t'a tzinan lum tik ol ex satkanelok, xchi Jehová t'a heb' winh.
Ha heb' winh ix xid'ek' iloj lum yuj winhaj Moisés chi', chuknhej ix aj yalan heb' winh tas yaj lu'um, yuj chi' ix b'uchwaj heb' anima t'a Jehová.

Axo Jehová ix ak'ankot jun ilya t'a yib'anh heb' winh ilum lu'um chi', yuj chi' ix cham heb' winh. Axonhej winhaj Josué yuninal winhaj Nun yet' winhaj Caleb yuninal winhaj Jefone maj chamlaj yuj jun ilya chi'.
Ayic ix yalan winhaj Moisés t'a heb' israel tas ix yal Jehová, masanil heb' ix kusk'e sk'ool.

Axo ix sakb'i t'a junxo k'u, ix pet k'e waan heb', ix snaan heb' to sb'at heb' yak' owal yet' heb' anima kajan t'a tzalquixtak. Yuj chi' ix yal heb' t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --Ha tiknaik, wal yel koyek t'a sat lum b'aj ix yak' sti' Jehová to ol yak' t'ayonh. Yeltoni ix och ko mul, xchi heb'.
Ix yalan winh t'a heb' icha tik: --¿Tas yuj tze tenek' tas ix yal Jehová? Ha jun tas tze na chi', manh wach'ok ol elk'ochok.
Manh ex b'atok, yujto manh ol ochlaj Jehová eyed'ok, ol ex ak'jok ganar yuj heb' ajk'ool.

Maklab'ilexxo yuj heb' amalekita yet' heb' kananeo, to ol yak' owal heb' eyed'ok. Ol ex smilcham heb' yujto ix eyik'el he pensar t'a Jehová, yuj chi' manhxo ayokochlaj eyed'ok, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Palta ix spitejnhej sb'a heb', ix b'at heb' t'a tzalquixtak. Axo te' skaxail strato Jehová yet' winhaj Moisés chi', maj eltalaj t'a yol kampamento.

Ayic ix b'at heb' winh chi', maklab'il sk'ek'och heb' winh yuj heb' amalekita yet' heb' kananeo, yuj chi' ix yak' owal heb'. Axo ix aji, ix ak'ji ganar heb' israel, ix pechchaj heb' masanto t'a Horma.
Ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi', ix yalan icha tik:
Al juntzanh tik t'a heb' etisraelal: Ayic ol ex k'och t'a lum lum ol wak' t'ayex yik tzex kajnaj t'ay,

tato ayex tze nhustz'a junok nok' wakax, ma junok nok' kalnel, ma junok nok' chiwa silab'il, mato yik tze k'anab'ajan b'aj tzeyak' he ti' eyak'ani, ma tonhej tz'el t'a he k'ool, ma yuj junok q'uinh yuj chi' tzeyak'a', yowalil tzeyak'pax chab'ok libra harina te wach' kalab'il yet' junok litro akeite yet' silab' chi'. Ha jun silab' chi' te suk'uq'ui sjab' swab' a in Jehová in tik.
Ha yet' juntzanh silab' toxo ix wal chi' tzeyak' junok litro wino ofrendail yet' junjun nok' kalnel chi'.
Tato a junok nok' ch'ak kalnel tzeyak' silab'il, tzeyak'pax wajxaqueok libra harina skalaj yet' junok litro akeite yet' jab'okxo,
ek'topax jun litro wino tzeyak' yet'ok. Te suk'uq'ui sjab' jun ofrenda chi' swab'i.
Tato a junok nok' quelem wakax tzeyak' silab'il to stz'ai, ma silab'il yik tze k'anab'ajej b'aj tzeyak' he ti', ma silab'il yik junk'olal,
tzeyak'pax lajchaweok libra harina, chab'ok litro akeite
yet' pax chab'ok litro wino ofrendail yet'ok. Ha jun ofrenda chi' suk'uq'ui sjab' swab' a in Jehová in tik.
Aton juntzanh tik yowalil tzeyak' yet' junjun nok' wakax chi', ma yet' junjun nok' ch'ak kalnel, ma yet' junjun nok' yunetak kalnel, ma yet' junjun nok' yunetak chiwa.
Icha sb'isul nok' tzeyak' silab'il chi', icha pax chi' sb'isul juntzanhxo ofrenda chi' tzeyak' yet'ok.
E masanil a ex israel ex tik, yowalil tze k'anab'ajej juntzanh ley tik smasanil ayik tze nhusantz'a eyofrenda suk'uq'ui sjab' swab' a in Jehová in tik.

Tato ay junok ch'ok chonhab'il tonhej sb'eyek' t'a he kal, mato kajan eyed'ok, tato snib'ej snhusantz'a junok silab' to suk'uq'ui sjab' swab'i, yowalil sk'anab'ajej masanil sleyal icha tze k'anab'ajej a ex tik.

Ha jun ley chi' tz'och yopisio eyuuj yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan eyed' chi'. Ha jun ley chi' ol b'eynhejb'at t'a he kal t'a masanil tiempo. Ha ex tik yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, lajan eyelk'och t'a yol in sat a in Jehová in tik.
Junnhej ley eyik yaj yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il chi', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al juntzanh tik smasanil t'a heb' etisraelal: Ayic kajanexxo ek' t'a lum b'aj ol ex wik'b'ati,
a ixim trigo syak' t'a lum lum chi' ol he wa''a, yowalil tzeyik'kanel jab'ok ixim t'a ofrendail yik tzeyak' t'ayin,
icha tz'aj yak'chaj ixim sb'ab'laj tek'jieli, icha chi' tz'aj eyak'an ixim t'ayin. Anhejtona' tzeyak'pax jun b'ab'el pan sb'o t'a ixim harina yik ixim ak' trigo chi' ofrendail t'ayin.
Ha jun makan ofrenda chi' ol eyak'nhej t'ayin a in Jehová in tik t'a masanil tiempo.
Talaj sb'at satk'olal eyuj he k'ulan junok cheknab'il ix wal t'a winhaj Moisés tik t'a sb'ab'elal,
yuj chi' maxtzak he k'anab'ajej yet' pax heb' eyinhtilal ayik ol b'eynhejb'atok, aton tik ol he k'ulej:

Tato ay junok cheknab'il sb'at satk'olal eyuj he k'ulan he masanil, yowalil snhusjitz'a junok nok' quelem wakax eyuj he masanil t'a silab'il to suk'uq'ui sjab' swab' a in Jehová in tik yet' ixim trigo yet' wino tzeyak'taxon ofrendail yet' silab' chi', icha t'a sleyal. Tzeyak'an junok nok' mam chiwa silab'il yuj yak'ji tup he mul.

Axo junok winh sakerdote sb'oan jun chi' eyuj he masanil ichataxon t'a sleyal yik stupkanel he mul t'a eyib'anh. Ha in ton swak' tupel he mul chi' yujto manh sk'anok he k'ool tze k'ulani, yujto ix eyak'pax silab' yuj he mul.
Ha yuj he silab' chi', stupkanel he mul chi' t'a eyib'anh a ex israel ex tik yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal, yujto he masanil ix och he mul.
Palta tato junnhej anima tz'och smul, yuj sb'at satk'olal yuj sk'anab'ajan junok cheknab'il, a yuj smul chi', yowalil syak' junok nok' kob'es chiwa jun ab'il sk'inal silab'il.
Axo junok winh sakerdote tz'ak'anoch jun silab' chi' t'a wichanh ichataxon t'a sleyal yuj smul jun anima ix och chi', ayik toxo ix ak'chaj jun silab' chi', stupkanel smul jun anima chi' t'a yib'anh.
Anheja' jun ley chi' tz'och yopisio eyuuj yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal, ayik tz'och he mul to manh sk'anok he k'ool.

Palta tato ay mach tz'och smul to sk'an sk'ool, wach'chom eyetchonhab', ma junok ch'ok chonhab'il, a t'ayin Jehová in tik tz'och smul yuj spitalil. Yuj chi' manhxaokab' yalan yik jun anima chi' t'a he kal.
Yujto ix spatiquejel in lolonel, ix stenanek' in cheknab'il, yuj chi' manhxaokab' yalan yik t'a he kal t'a junelnhej, xchi Jehová.
Ayic ayek' heb' israel t'a tzinan lu'um, ay jun winh israel chi' wan yek' k'atzitz t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip ix yilan heb'.
Ix ik'jib'at winh t'a yichanh winhaj Moisés, t'a yichanh winhaj Aarón yet' t'a yichanh masanil heb' chonhab' yuj heb' ix ilan chi'.
Ix tanhwaj winh yuj heb' yujto manto chequelok tas ol utaj winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: Ha jun winh tik yowalil ol cham winh. Masanil heb' chonhab' tik sjulk'enan winh t'a spatiquel kampamento, xchi t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix yik'el winh heb' t'a spatiquel kampamento chi'. Ata' ix sjulk'enejcham winh heb' icha ix aj yalan Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:

Al juntzanh tik t'a heb' etisraelal: Ha ex tik yet' heb' eyinhtilal, yowalilokab' tz'och yelwanub' stitak he pichul. Ha juntzanh yelwanub' tz'och chi', a anh ch'al tzek'b'il topan, stz'ischajoch t'a he pichul chi' yet' anh ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak.

Ayic ol eyilanoch juntzanh yelwanub' chi', ol he naankot masanil cheknab'il ix wala' to yowalil tze k'anab'ajej, yik wach' manh ol ex kuchb'ajb'at t'a juntzanh tas malaj swach'il yuj he pensar, ma yuj tas he gana t'a yol eyiko'.
Icha wal chi' ol aj he naankot in cheknab'il, ol he k'anab'ajani. Icha chi' ol aj eyak'anoch he b'a t'ayin to wik ex, a in he Diosal in.
Ha in Jehová he Diosal in ix ex wik'elta t'a Egipto yik tzin och he Diosaloc, yuj chi' swal juntzanh tik t'ayex, xchi t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.

Ha winhaj Coré yuninal winhaj Izhar yinhtilalkan winhaj Coat, t'a yinhtilal Leví yet' oxwanhxo heb' t'a yinhtilal Rubén, aton winhaj Datán, winhaj Abiram yuninal heb' winhaj Eliab yet' pax winhaj On yuninal winhaj Pelet, ix meltzajoch heb' winh ajk'olal t'a winhaj Moisés. Ix stek'b'ej sb'a heb' winh smolb'an 250-xo heb' yetisraelal. Ha heb' winh ix yak'och sb'a chi', yajalil chonhab' yaj heb' winh, ayoch heb' winh sb'isulok heb' winh tz'ak'an slajtial junok lolonel t'a yol chonhab' chi'.

Masanil heb' winh chi' ix smolb'ej sb'a, ix b'at heb' winh yil winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón, ix yalan heb' winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --k'okb'ilxo eyik'anchaanh he b'a, yujto ko masanil onh a onh tik, yikxo Jehová kaji, aypaxek' t'a ko kal ko masanil. ¿Tas yuj tzeyak'och he b'a yajalil t'a quib'anh a onh schonhab' onh Jehová tik? xchi heb' winh.
Ha ix yab'an juntzanh chi' winhaj Moisés chi', ix em nhojan winh t'a sat lu'um.

Ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Coré yet' t'a masanil heb' winh tzak'anoch yuj winh chi' icha tik: --Ato k'ik'an sch'ox Jehová t'ayonh mach heb' yiko'. Anhej heb' sik'b'ilel yuj ol yal yoch t'a stz'ey yak'an serwil t'a altar.

Ha t'a q'uinhib'alil k'ik'an, tzeyik'kot he chaynub' yik inkienso, tzeyak'anem tzak'ak' t'a yool yet' inkienso, tzeyak'anoch t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha mach sik'kanel Jehová chi', aton jun chi' sik'b'iltaxonel yuj. k'okb'ilxo eyik'anchaanh he b'a a ex ex wetlewitail tik, xchi winh.
Ix yalanxi winh t'a winhaj Coré chi' icha tik: --Ha ex ex wetlewitail tik, ab'ek tas ol wala':
¿Tom te jab'nhej yelk'och jun tik he naani, sik'b'il ex el yuj ko Diosal t'a skal heb' quetchonhab', ix ex yak'anoch t'a slak'anil yik tze tanhwej skajnub' yet' eyak'an serwil heb' eyetchonhab'?
Ix el t'a sk'ool Jehová to tzex och t'a slak'anil, haxo tiknaik he gana tzex ochxonhej sakerdoteal.

Val yel a winhaj Aarón malaj yelk'och winh, ¿tas yuj tzeyal chukal lolonel t'a spatik winh yet' masanil heb' ajun eyed' tik? Ha t'a Jehová chuk tzex loloni ayik tzeyalan chuk t'a spatik winhaj Aarón chi', xchi winh.
D'a elanhchamel ix schek winhaj Moisés chi' b'at ik'jokkot winhaj Datán yet' winhaj Abiram yuninal winhaj Eliab, palta ix yalankot heb' winh chi' icha tik: --Max onh b'atlaj.
¿Tom jab'nhej tas tzonh utej? Ix onh ik'elta t'a Egipto b'aj te wach', manh jantakok tas ay t'a sat lu'um, ix onh ik'ankoti yik tzonh cham t'a tik. Ha gana to tzak'och a b'a yajalil t'a tik.

Ha ach tik manhok t'a junok lum lum te ay tas t'a sat b'aj ix onh ik'koti, malaj jab'ok ko lu'um tzak'a yik skawej jab'ok ko uwa. ¿Tom te quistal onh tzila'? Actejxo onh ak'an musansatil. Manh ol onh b'atlaj kab' tas tzal chi', xchi heb' winh.

Yuj chi', ix te kot yowal winhaj Moisés chi', ix yalan winh t'a Jehová icha tik: --Manh a cha yofrenda heb' winh chi'. Ha in tik, te malaj tas swutej heb' winh, malaj junok sb'uru heb' winh swik'eq'ui, xchi winh t'a Jehová.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalanxi winh t'a winhaj Coré chi' icha tik: --Ha ach tik a k'ik'an tzach och t'a yichanh Jehová yet' heb' winh 250 ajun ed'ok. Anheja' pax winhaj Aarón, sk'ochpax winh ta'.

Ha ach tik yet' winhaj Aarón chi', tzeyik'b'at he chaynub' yik inkienso, tzeyak'anem inkienso t'a yool. Anheja' icha chi' syutejpax heb' winh ajun eyed'ok tik, tzeyak'anoch t'a yichanh Jehová, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.

Axo t'a junxo k'u chi', ix yik'ankot schaynub' heb' winh chi', ix yak'anem tzak'ak' heb' winh t'a yool yet' inkienso. Ix smolb'anoch sb'a heb' winh t'a stz'ey winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón t'a sti' kajnub' b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová.

Ha winhaj Coré chi' toxo ix smolb'ejoch heb' winh ajun yet'ok chi' t'a sti' skajnub' Dios, aton heb' winh ayxo och ajk'olal t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón chi'. D'a wal jun rato chi' ix sch'oxan stziquiquial Jehová t'a yichanh heb' chonhab' chi' smasanil.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón chi' icha tik:
--B'esequel he b'ha t'a skal juntzanh anima tik. D'a jun rato tik ol in satel heb', xchi.
Yuj chi' ix em nhojjab' heb' winh t'a sat lu'um, ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --Mamin, yajal aj t'a sk'inal masanil anima, ¿tom tza satel masanil heb' anima tik yuj smul junok? xchi heb' winh.
Ix tak'wi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi':
--Ha tiknaik al t'a masanil heb' molanek' tik to sb'esel sb'a heb' smasanil t'a spatiktak smantiado winhaj Coré, winhaj Datán yet' winhaj Abiram, xchi t'a winh.
Ix k'e waan winhaj Moisés chi', ix b'at winh b'aj ayek' winhaj Datán yet' winhaj Abiram chi', ix b'at masanil heb' yichamtak winaquil heb' israel yet' winh.

Ix yalan winh t'a masanil heb' chonhab' chi' icha tik: --B'esequel he b'ha t'a smantiado jun makan heb' anima chuk spensar tik. Malaj junok tas ay t'a heb' tzeyama', tato maay, ol ex cham yuj syaelal smul heb', xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix sb'esel sb'a heb' anima smasanil t'a spatiktak smantiado winhaj Coré, winhaj Datán yet' winhaj Abiram chi'. Ha winhaj Datán yet' winhaj Abiram chi', ix elta linhan heb' winh t'a sti' smantiado yet' heb' ix yetb'eyum yet' heb' yuninal.
Ix och ijan winhaj Moisés yalan icha tik: --Icha tik ol aj eyojtakkaneli to a Jehová schekan in k'ulej masanil juntzanh tik, manh yolok wik tzin k'ulej.
Tato ilya tz'ik'an scham heb' tik, ichataxon tz'aj scham anima, syalelk'ochi to manhok Jehová tzin ak'anoch t'a jun opisio tik.

Palta tato ay junok tas to mantalaj b'aj tzuji ol sk'ulej Jehová, ol spoj sb'a lum lum tik, haxo heb' anima tik pitzanto heb' ol b'atkan heb' t'a yol lu'um yet' masanil tas ay t'ay. Tato icha chi' ol aj scham heb', ol eyojtaquejeli to ix spatiquejel Jehová heb', xchi winh.
Ayic ix lajwi yalan juntzanh chi' winhaj Moisés chi', ix pax lewnaj lum lum t'a yalanh heb' winh chi'.
Ix emkan heb' winh t'a yol lu'um yet' yalyuninal smasanil. Icha wal chi' ix aj satel masanil heb' junnhej ix aj spensar yet' winhaj Coré chi' yet' masanil tastak ay t'a heb'.

Pitzan heb' anima chi' smasanil ix b'atkan heb' t'a yol lu'um chi' yet' masanil tastak ay t'a heb'. Ixlajwi chi', ix snub'anxi sb'a lu'um. Icha chi' ix aj satkanel jun makan anima chi' t'a skal heb' yetisraelal.
Ayic ix yab'an heb' anima oyanek' t'a spatiktak chi', ix el yaw heb', ix b'at heb' elelal, ix yalan heb': Mokab' b'atpax lewnaj lum t'a kalanh a onh tik, xchi heb'.
Anheja' ix yak'paxkot k'ak' Jehová yik ix tz'apaxb'at heb' 250 ix nhusan inkienso, aton heb' ix yak'och sb'a yet' winhaj Coré, winhaj Datán yet' winhaj Abiram chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:

Al t'a winhaj Eleazar yuninal winhaj Aarón to syik'elta juntzanh schaynub' yik inkienso heb' winh ix tz'ab'at chi' winh, aton juntzanh nab'a bronke. Slajwi chi' najat sb'at winh stob'kanel tzak'ak' ayem t'a yool.

Ha schaynub' yik inkienso juntzanh anima ix cham yuj smul tik, wikxo ix ajkani, yujto ix k'anchaji a ix yak'an inkienso heb' t'ayin. Yuj chi', a juntzanh yamk'ab' chi' tze b'ooch t'a laminail yik tz'och smusilok altar, yik wach' ayik syilanoch heb' israel, snaankot heb' tas ix aj scham heb' yuj schukal, xchi Jehová.

Ix smolb'ankot masanil chaynub' yik inkienso nab'a bronke winhaj sakerdote Eleazar chi', aton juntzanh ix sk'an heb' ix tz'ab'at yuj k'ak' chi', ix yalan winh to tz'ak'ji ulaxok, sb'oji t'a laminail yik tz'och smusilok altar.

Ha jun tik ix kani yik snaankot heb' israel yet' yojtakanel heb' to anhej heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Aarón syal yoch t'a yichanh altar yik snhusan inkienso heb' t'a yichanh Jehová. Tato ay junokxo komonnhej sk'ulej icha chi', scham icha ix aj scham winhaj Coré yet' heb' ajun yet'ok. Icha wal ix yutej Jehová yalan t'a winhaj Moisés, icha chi' ix sk'ulej winhaj Eleazar chi'.
Axo t'a junxo k'u, masanil heb' israel ix och ijan yawaj chaanh t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón, ix yalan heb' icha tik: --Ha ex tik, ix he milcham heb' schonhab' Jehová, xchi heb'.

Ayic wan smolb'an sb'a heb' chonhab' smasanil t'a spatik winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón chi', ix b'at k'elan heb' t'a skajnub' Dios. D'a wal jun rato chi' ix och moynaj asun t'a skajnub' chi', ix sch'oxan stziquiquial Jehová.
Yuj chi', ix snitzanb'at sb'a winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón t'a yichanh kajnub' chi'.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi':
--Elanhec t'a stz'ey juntzanh anima tik, yujto ha t'a jun rato tik ol in satel heb' t'a junelnhej, xchi. Ixnhej wal yab' heb' winh icha chi', ix em nhojjab' heb' winh t'a sat lu'um.

Ix yalan winhaj Moisés t'a winhaj Aarón chi' icha tik: --Ik'kot a chaynub' yik inkienso, tzak'an b'ud'jok yet' tzak'ak' ayek' t'a yib'anh altar. Tzak'anpaxem inkienso t'a yool, tzach b'at t'a skal heb' anima t'a elanhchamel. Tza k'anan niwank'olal yuj smul heb', yujto toxo ix kot yowal Jehová. Toxo ix ja ilya yik scham anima smasanil, xchi winh.

Ix sk'anab'ajan winhaj Aarón chi', elanhchamel ix b'at lemnaj winh t'a skal heb' anima b'aj ayek' molan chi'. Ha yuj jun ilya ix yak'kot Jehová chi' toxo ix yamchajoch scham anima. D'a wal jun rato chi', ix yak'anem inkienso winh yik tz'ak'ji niwank'olal heb' anima chi' yuj Jehová.
Ix och winh t'a skal heb' anima toxo ix chami yet' heb' pitzanto. Ichato chi' ix och waan jun ilya chi'.
Ha t'a jun rato chi', 14 mil 700 heb' anima ix chami. Ch'ok pax yaj juntzanh heb' toxo ix cham yet' winhaj Coré yuj schukal.
Ato yik ix och waan scham anima chi', ix meltzaj winhaj Aarón b'aj ayek' winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al t'a heb' winh yajalil chonhab' t'a junjun inhtilal to syik'kot junjunok sk'okoch heb' winh, syalelk'ochi to lajchawe' te' skot t'a smasanil, tz'och sb'i junjun heb' winh t'a te' sk'okoch chi'.
Ha te' yik yinhtilal Leví, a sb'i winhaj Aarón tz'och t'a te', yujto junjun sk'okoch heb' winh yajalil junjun inhtilal ol kotok.
Tzak'kanoch te' t'a yichanh skaxail trato ay t'a yol in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a.
Ata' ol wak' wolan sk'okoch mach syal in k'ool to ol in sik'kaneli, yuj chi' ol och waan heb' anima tik yalan he pekal, xchi Jehová chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Moisés t'a heb' winh yajalil chonhab' t'a junjun inhtilal. Ix yak'an sk'okoch junjun heb' winh t'a winh, lajchawe' te' t'a smasanil. Aypaxoch te' yik winhaj Aarón chi' t'a skal te'.
Ix yak'anoch te' k'okoch chi' winhaj Moisés chi' t'a yichanh Jehová t'a yol kajnub' yik trato.
Axo t'a junxo q'uinhib'alil ix k'och winh ta', ix yilanoch te' sk'okoch winhaj Aarón chi' winh t'a yik yinhtilal Leví, toxo ix elta swol te', ayxo xumaquil yet' pax sat, q'uinhxo te' almendro chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'anelta te' k'okoch chi' winh t'a yichanh Jehová, ix sch'oxan te' winh t'a masanil heb' yetisraelal. Axo ix lajwi yilan te' heb', ix yak'anxi junjun te' yik heb' winh chi' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winh icha tik: Ak'kanoch te' sk'okoch winhaj Aarón t'a yichanh skaxail trato. Sik'kanb'at te' ta' yik snakot juntzanh anima te pit tik. Yuj chi' ol yaktej heb' yalan chukal lolonel t'ayin yik max cham heb', xchi t'a winh.
Ix sk'anab'ajej winhaj Moisés sk'ulan masanil tas ix yal Jehová chi'.
Axo ix yalan heb' chonhab' chi' t'a winh icha tik: Junelnhej chamnak onhxo el ko masanil.
Tato jichan scham masanil heb' snitzkot sb'ha t'a skajnub' Jehová, ol onh cham ko masanil syal chi', xchi heb'.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Aarón icha tik: Tato tz'och junok palta t'a in kajnub', a yaelal sja yuj jun chi', ha t'a ib'anh yet' heb' uninal yet' t'a yib'anh heb' etlewitail sjawi. Palta a junok paltail t'a eyopisio t'a sakerdoteal, anhej t'a ib'anh yet' heb' uninal sjawi yaelal yuj jun chi'.
Tzik'kot heb' etlewitail yik skolwaj heb' ed'ok ayik ayachoch yet' heb' uninal t'a eyopisio t'a yol in kajnub' yik trato.

Aton heb' smunlaj ed'ok t'a in kajnub' chi', palta chequelnhej yaj yopisio heb'. Max yal-laj sjawi heb' t'a slak'anil altar, max yalpaxlaj syaman syamk'ab'il in kajnub' chi' heb' yik wach' max cham heb' yet' ex pax tik.
Ajun heb' smunlaj eyed'ok, palta a ex tzeyala' tas sk'ulej heb' ayik sb'oan masanil smunlajel heb' t'a in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a. Malaj junokxo komon anima syal sja t'a he lak'anil.
Ha exnhej tik ayoch t'a eyib'anh he b'oan masanil munlajel t'a in kajnub' yet' t'a altar yik manhxo ol kot wowal t'a masanil heb' etchonhab'.
Ha in ix wik'kanel heb' etlewitail t'a skal masanil heb' etisraelal. Ix wak'an heb' t'ayex yik smunlaj heb' eyed'ok t'a in kajnub'.

Palta a achnhej yet' heb' uninal tzil munlajel b'aj ay altar yet' t'a spatikoch k'apak kortina. Ha juntzanh opisio chi' ix wala' to a exnhej tik tzeyila', yujto a in ix wak' eyopisio. Tato ay junok mach manh ayokoch sakerdoteal t'a yib'anh snitzanoch sb'ha t'a slak'anil juntzanh yamk'ab' chi', a jun chi' tojolnhej schami, xchi Jehová.

Ix yalanpax Jehová t'a winhaj Aarón chi' icha tik: Ha in swak' opisio a chaan masanil juntzanh ofrenda tz'ak'ji t'ayin yuj heb' etisraelal tik. Masanil tas syik'kot heb' chi' t'ayin, ik tz'ajkan yet' heb' uninal. Ha jun tik ley tz'ajkan t'a he kal t'a masanil tiempo.
Masanil ofrenda tz'ak'ji t'ayin, a in swak' t'ayach yet' t'a heb' uninal, aton juntzanh max tz'alaj: Ofrenda yik ixim trigo, silab' yuj yak'ji tup mul yet' silab' yuj stupchaj mul.
Masanil heb' winak t'a he kal tik, syal schi'an juntzanh silab' chi' heb', anhej t'a junok lugar wik yaji, ata' schi heb'. Yowalil tze na'a to wik yaj juntzanh silab' chi'.

Swak'pax t'ayach yet' t'a ix etb'eyum yet' t'a heb' uninal juntzanh ofrenda syik'kot heb' etisraelal t'ayin, aton juntzanh sb'akhchajoch t'a wichanh. Ha jun ley tik skan t'a masanil tiempo, yalnhej mach heb' ayek' kajan eyed'ok to wach' yaj icha yalan ley, syalnhej schi'an heb'.
Ha sb'ab'el sat tastak tz'awchaji aton syik'kot heb' etisraelal t'ayin t'a junjun ab'il, swak'kanpax t'ayach: Aton akeite te wach', wino te wach' yet' ixim trigo te wach',
yet' pax sb'ab'el sat masanil te' awb'en te' syik'kot heb' t'ayin. Ha juntzanh chi' ik yaj yet' masanil heb' ayek' kajan ed'ok. Tato wach' yaj heb' icha yalan ley, syal swaan heb'.
Masanil ofrenda syak' heb' etisraelal t'ayin, iknhej yaji.

Masanil heb' sb'ab'el winak unin heb' etisraelal yet' pax sb'ab'el yune' nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' syak' t'ayin, iknhejpax yaji. Palta a yuj heb' b'ab'el winak unin chi' yet' sb'ab'el yune' nok' nok' max ochtaxon silab'il, yowalil tz'ak'ji k'een tumin sk'exulok.
Ayic junxo ujal yalji, tz'ak'ji k'een tumin chi' sk'exulok. Ha yuj heb' unin chi', oye' siklo k'een plata tz'ak'ji, icha k'een sk'anchaj t'a in kajnub', 20 geras yalil.

Palta manh a cha ak'jok tumin sk'exulok sb'ab'el yune' nok' wakax, nok' kalnel yet' nok' chiwa, yujto a juntzanh nok' chi', wik yaj nok'. Yowalil tze milcham nok', tze tzikanoch schiq'uil nok' t'a altar, haxo xepual nok' tze nhustz'aok yik tz'och t'a ofrendail to suk'uq'ui sjab' swab'i.
Ic tz'ajkan masanil schib'ejal nok' chi', icha ix aj wak'an schib'ejal juntzanhxo nok' silab' t'ayach, aton nok' snhi' sk'ool sb'akhchajk'e t'a yichanh altar yet' sb'ak'chil xub' nok' t'a swach'.

Masanil yofrenda heb' etisraelal syik'eli to wik yaji, swak' t'ayach yet' t'a ix etb'eyum yet' t'a heb' uninal. Ha jun tik, ley tz'ajkan t'a masanil tiempo, a in tzin b'okan eyed'ok yet' masanil eyinhtilal, xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Aarón chi': Ha ach tik malaj lum lum ol a makb'enej t'a skal heb' etisraelal tik, yujto a in tik icha a makb'en waji.
Ha heb' lewita, a masanil sdiezmoal sat yawb'en heb' eyetisraelal, a ix wak' smakb'enej heb'. Aton ayoch stojolok masanil smunlajel heb' t'a kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a.
Axo masanil juntzanhxo heb' etisraelal, max yal komonnhej sjawi heb' t'a slak'anil kajnub' chi'. Tato icha chi' sk'ulej heb', tz'ochkan chamel t'a yib'anh heb' yuj smul chi'.

Yuj chi' anhej heb' lewita ay yalan yik yilan masanil tas yik in kajnub' chi'. Tato tz'och junok spaltail heb' t'a smunlajel chi', anhej t'a yib'anh heb' skotkan yaelal. Ha jun tik ley tz'ajkan t'a masanil tiempo. Ha heb' lewita malaj slum heb' ol scha t'a skal heb' eyetisraelal.
Yic heb' yaj masanil sdiezmoal tas syawej heb' eyetisraelal syak' t'ayin a in Jehová in tik. Yuj chi' ix wala' to malaj slum heb' ol scha'a, xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés icha tik:

Al t'a masanil heb' lewita to a in Jehová in swal icha tik: Ayic ol he chaan masanil sdiezmo heb' eyetisraelal, yowalil tzeyik'paxkanel sdiezmoal yik tzeyak'an t'ayin, yujto a juntzanh chi' ayoch he makb'enok.
Ha jun diezmo tzeyak' chi', icha sdiezmoal sat smunlajel heb' eyetisraelal syak'a'.
Ha t'a diezmo tze cha t'a heb' eyetisraelal chi', ata' tzeyik'paxel eyofrenda tzeyak' t'ayin. Ha t'a winhaj sakerdote Aarón tzeyak'a'.
Yuj chi' masanil tastak tz'ak'ji t'ayex, yowalil tzeyik'kanel junok makan t'ay, tzeyak'an t'ayin. Ha jun makan tzeyak' t'ayin chi', yowalil aton wal swach'il.
Ayic toxo ix eyik'kanel swach'il to wik yaj chi', haxo jantakto skani, eyikxo tz'ajkani ichato a ex ay he munlajel.
Syalxo he waan yet' eyal eyuninal yalxonhej b'aj kajan ex. E tojol yaj yuj b'aj tzex munlaj t'a in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a.

Ayic toxo ix eyik'kanel jun makan te wach' chi' t'ayin, tzaxo yal he waan jantakto skan chi', malaj he mul tz'och yuj he waani. Ha t'a icha chi', max eyixtejb'atlaj yofrenda heb' eyetisraelal to wik yaji. Yuj chi' maxtzak jawilaj chamel t'a eyib'anh, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón icha tik:
Ha in Jehová in swak' jun cheknab'il tik. Alec t'a heb' eyetchonhab' to syik'kot junok nok' kob'es chakchak wakax heb' malaj jab'ok spaltail, manto junelok smunlaji.
Ha ex tik tzeyak' nok' t'a winhaj sakerdote Eleazar. Tz'ik'jiel nok' t'a spatiquel kampamento, haxo winhaj Eleazar chi' schekan miljokcham nok' t'a yichanh.
Syik'ank'e schiq'uil nok' winh yet' yiximal sk'ab', stzikanb'at uquelok winh t'a stojolal in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a.
Slajwi chi', snhusjitz'a nok' wakax chi' smasanil t'a yichanh winh, stz'umal nok', sb'ak'chil nok', schiq'uil nok' yet' yol sk'ool nok'.
Yakb'an wan stz'a nok' chi' syik'anpaxk'e te' k'ute' winh sakerdote chi' yet' junok sk'ab' te' hisopo yet' nok' chakchak lana, syak'anoch winh smasanil t'a yol k'ak' b'aj wan stz'a nok' chi'.
Slajwi chi, sjuk'anel spichul winh, sb'ikanpaxel sb'a winh, tz'ochxi winh t'a yol kampamento chi', wach'chom manto wach'ok yaj winh icha yalan ley masanto t'a yemk'ualil.
Axo winh ix nhusantz'a nok' wakax chi', sjuk'paxel spichul winh, sb'ikanpaxel sb'a winh, palta manto wach'ok yaj winh icha yalan ley masanto t'a yemk'ualil.

Axo junokxo winh winak wach' yaj icha yalan ley, ha' winh smolank'e staanhil nok' wakax chi', sik'anb'at winh t'a junok lugar to wach' yaj t'a spatiquel kampamento. Ha juntzanh taanh chi' sk'an heb' eyetisraelal ayik sb'oan ha ha' heb' sk'anchaji yik sakb'itaj heb' icha yalan ley. Masanil juntzanh tik sk'ulaji yik syik'anel mul.

Ha mach ix molank'e juntzanh taanh chi', yowalil sjuk'el spichul, sb'ikanpaxel sb'a, palta manto wach'ok yaj icha yalan ley masanto t'a yemk'ualil. Ha jun ley tik skannhej t'a junelnhej, tz'och yopisio eyuuj a ex israel ex tik yet' yuj heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal.
Ha mach syaman sniwanil junok chamnak, manh wach'ok yaj t'a uque' k'ual icha yalan ley.

Ha t'a schab'jial syaman junok chamnak chi' yet' t'a swak'jial, yowalil sakb'itej sb'a yet' ha ha' sk'anchaji yik sakb'i icha yalan ley, ichato chi' wach' tz'ajkani. Tato max sakb'itej sb'ha t'a schab'jial yet' t'a swak'jial, manto wach'ok syal chi'.

Yuj chi' a junok mach syaman junok chamnak, tato max sakb'itej sb'a, a jun chi' syixtejel in kajnub'. Yuj chi' yowalil manhxa yalan yik t'a he kal t'a junelnhej, yujto maj tzikjioch ha ha' chi' t'ay, yuj chi' manh wach'ok yaj icha yalan ley.
Aton juntzanh sleyal tik t'a junok mach scham b'aj ay skajnub': Yalnhej mach tz'och ta', ma junok ayek' ta', manh wach'ok tz'ajkan t'a uque' k'ual.
Masanil chen to manh wach'ok yaj smakji, manhxo wach'ok tz'ajkani.

Axo mach syaman junok chamnak t'a stiel chonhab', taxonhej mak'b'ilchamok, ma tonhej scham ichataxon tz'aj scham anima, mato syam sb'aquil junok chamnak, ma junok b'aj smukchaj heb' chamnak, a jun chi' manh wach'ok yaj t'a uque' k'ual.
Ha yuj masanil juntzanh chi' tz'ik'chajk'e jab'ok staanhil nok' wakax tz'anak yuj yik'anel mul, tz'ak'chajem t'a yol junok yet'tal, tz'ak'jiem ha ha' t'a yib'anh, aton ha' sk'eul sjaj.

Axo junok winh winak wach' yaj icha yalan ley, a winh tz'ik'ank'e junok sk'ab' te' hisopo, slab'anem winh t'a skal ha ha' chi', stzikanoch winh t'a yib'anh jun kajnub' chi' yet' masanil tas ay t'a yool yet' t'a yib'anh heb' anima ayek' ta', anhejtona' stzikanpaxb'at winh t'a yib'anh mach ix yaman sb'aquil chamnak, ma junok b'aj smukchaj heb' chamnak chi', ma sniwanil junok anima mak'b'ilchamok, ma junok tonhej ix cham ichataxon tz'aj scham anima.

Ha jun anima wach' yaj chi', ha' stzikanb'at ha ha' chi' t'a yib'anh heb' manh wach'ok yaj chi' t'a schab'jial yet' t'a swak'jial. Slajwi chi', ha t'a swak'jial chi', sjuk'anel spichul heb', sb'ikanpaxel sb'a heb' yik sakb'ikan heb'. Icha chi' wach'xo tz'ajkan heb' t'a yemk'ualil.

Tato ay junok anima max sakb'itej sb'a icha yalan ley, manhxaokab' yalan yik t'a he kal t'a junelnhej yujto syixtejb'at in kajnub'. Yujto maj tzikjioch ha ha' t'ay yik sakb'i, yuj chi' manh wach'oknhej yaji.
Ha jun ley tik skannhej t'a junelnhej: Ha mach stzikanoch ha ha' chi' t'a junokxo, yowalil sjuk'el spichul. Ha mach syaman ha ha' tz'ak'an sakb'ok junok mach chi', wach'xo tz'ajkan t'a yemk'ualil.
Masanil mach syamji yuj junok anima manh wach'ok yaji, ma junok syaman junok anima manh wach'ok yaji, a jun chi' manh wach'ok tz'ajkan icha yalan ley masanto t'a yemk'ualil, xchi Jehová.
Ha t'a b'ab'el uj, ix k'och heb' israel t'a tzinan lu'um skuch Zin. Ix aj heb' jun pekti’ t'a yol yik Cades. Ata' ix cham ix María yanab' winhaj Moisés, ix mukchajkanem ix ta'.
Yujto te malaj ha ha' syuk' heb' israel chi', yuj chi' ix k'e yaw heb' smasanil t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón.
Ix yalan heb' t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --Octom onh chamkan yet' heb' quetchonhab' ix chamkan yuj Jehová.
¿Tas yuj ix onh eyik'kot t'a taquinh lu'um tik? ¿Tom he gana tzonh champax a onh tik yet' nok' ko molb'etzal nok'?

¿Tas yuj ix onh eyik'elta t'a yol yik Egipto, ix onh eyik'ankot t'a jun lugar manhxo jantakok schukal tik? Ha t'a tik max yak'laj ixim trigo, te' higo, te' uwa, te' granado, malaj pax jab'ok ha ha' syal kuk'ani, xchi heb'.

Ayic ix yab'an juntzanh lolonel chi' winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón chi', ix snitzanel sb'a heb' winh, ix b'at heb' winh t'a sti' skajnub' Jehová. Ata' ix b'at em nhojan heb' winh t'a sat lu'um. Axo t'a jun rato chi' ix sch'ox sb'a stziquiquial Jehová t'a slak'anil heb' winh.
Ix yalan Jehová chi' t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:

--Ik'b'at te' a k'okoch, tzalan t'a winh uk'tak aj Aarón chi' to tz'och winh ed'ok yik tze molanb'at heb' anima, tzex b'at b'aj ay jun k'een niwan tenam. D'a yichanh heb' tzal t'a k'een to tz'elta ha ha' t'a sat k'een, haxo t'a yichanh masanil heb' anima chi' ol elul ha', ol yuk'an ha' heb' yet' nok' smolb'etzal nok' chi', xchi Jehová.
Ix yik'anelta te k'okoch winhaj Moisés t'a yichanh Jehová icha ix aj yalani.

Ix smolb'anb'at heb' anima chi' heb' winh t'a yichanh k'een tenam chi'. Ix yalan winhaj Moisés chi' t'a heb' icha tik: --Ab'ek, a ex to te pit ex tik: ¿Yowalil am wal squik'elta ha ha' t'a sat k'een tenam tik, skak'an ha' eyuk'ej? xchi winh.

Ixlajwi yalan winh icha chi', ix yik'anchaanh sk'ab' winh, ix spajanoch chael te' sk'okoch winh t'a sat k'een tenam chi', ix elul chulnaj ha ha' chi'. Ix yuk'an ha' heb' yet' nok' smolb'etzal nok' chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón chi' icha tik: --Yujto a ex tik max in eyak' wal och t'a he k'ool, maj he ch'ox t'a yichanh heb' eyetchonhab' tik to Ha inxonhej Ochi, yuj chi' manhok exlaj ol eyik'och heb' anima tik t'a sat lum lum chi' b'aj ix wala' to ol wak' t'ayex, xchi t'a heb' winh.
Meriba ix sb'iejkan jun lugar chi', yujto ata' ix yalub'tanhej heb' israel t'a spatik Jehová. Ix sch'oxan Jehová chi' to Axonhej Ochi.

Ayic ayek' winhaj Moisés t'a Cades, ix schekanb'at jaywanh heb' winh winak winh t'a winh sreyal Edom yik b'at yalan heb' winh icha tik: Ha onh israel onh tik, ayto kuj ko b'a ed'ok, skalb'at t'ayach: Ojtac jantak syail ix quil t'a Egipto.

Anhejtona' ojtakpaxi tas aj sk'ochnakkan heb' ko mam quicham ta' t'a peka'. Axo t'a slajwub'alxo tik, ix yak' wal och yaelal heb' winh aj Egipto chi' t'a yib'anh heb' ko mam quicham yet' t'a quib'anh.
Yuj chi' ix ko k'an skolwal Jehová qued'ok. Ix yab' yel kaw, yuj chi' ix yak'ankot yángel yik ix onh yik'anelta t'a Egipto chi'. Ha tiknaik ayonh ek' t'a chonhab' Cades b'aj ay smojonal a makb'en.

Yuj chi' skal t'ayach, tope wal tz'el t'a a k'ool tzonh a chaek' t'a yol a makb'en tik. Manh ol onh ek'laj t'a skal yawb'en heb' anima ay t'a yol a makb'en tik. Malaj ha ha' t'a eyuk'b'il ha' ol kuk'ej. Anhej t'a yol niwan b'e ol onh b'atok. Malaj b'aj ol onh el b'esnaj t'a yol niwan b'e chi' masanto ol onh k'axpajek' t'a yol a nakión tik, xchib'at winhaj Moisés chi'.

Ix tak'wi winh sreyal Edom chi' icha tik: --Manh ex k'axpajek' t'a yol in nakión tik. Tato ol ex ek' t'a yib'anh, ol ex k'axpajek'ok, ol in elb'at t'a he patik yet' heb' in soldado, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Ix yalanpax heb' israel chi' icha tik: --Maay, a onh tik anhej t'a yol niwan b'e ol onh b'atok. Tato ay b'aj ol kuk'ej ha ha' yet' nok' ko molb'etzal nok' t'a eyuk'lab'a, ol ko tup t'ayach. Anhej wal to ko gana tzonh k'axpajek' t'a a lugar tik t'a wach'il, xchib'at heb'.

Ix tak'wixi winh sreyal Edom chi' icha tik: --Malaj permiso he k'axpajeq'ui, xchi winh. Ix b'at winh yet' masanil heb' soldado smak heb' israel chi'. Yed'nak syamk'ab' heb' soldado chi' yik owal, te tek'anpax heb'.
Yuj chi' ix say junxo b'e heb' israel b'aj ix b'ati.
Masanil heb' israel ix el heb' t'a Cades, ix kot heb' t'a stojolal lum witzal Hor t'a sat smojonal Edom.
Ata' ix yal Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yuj winhaj Aarón icha tik:

Ha tiknaik, toxo ol cham winhaj Aarón, manh ol k'ochlaj winh t'a sat lum ix wala' to ol wak' t'ayex, yujto a ex tik he chawanhil ix he pitej he b'ha t'a in cheknab'il ix wak' t'ayex t'a sti' ha' Meriba.
Ha tiknaik, ik'b'at winhaj Aarón chi' yet' winh yuninal skuch Eleazar t'a jolom witz Hor chi'.
Ata' ol ik'el spichul winhaj Aarón chi' sk'an t'a sakerdoteal, tzak'ankanoch t'a winhaj Eleazar chi', yujto a winhaj Aarón chi' ol cham winh ta', xchi t'a winh.
Ix sk'anab'ajan winhaj Moisés tas ix yal Jehová chi', t'a wal yichanh masanil anima ix ik'jib'at winhaj Aarón yet' winhaj Eleazar chi' yuj winh t'a jolom witz Hor chi'.

Ata' ix yik'el spichul winhaj Aarón chi' winh, ix yak'anoch winh t'a winhaj Eleazar t'a jolom witz chi'. Ata' ix chamkan winhaj Aarón chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix emixta winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Eleazar chi'.
Axo ix yab'an masanil heb' israel to toxo ix cham winhaj Aarón chi', jun ujal ix och heb' t'a kusk'olal yuj winh.

Ayic ix yab'an winh sreyal heb' kananeo ay t'a Arad t'a yol yik Neguev to wan skot heb' israel t'a yol b'e sk'och t'a Atarim, ix elta winh yak' owal yet' heb'. Ay heb' ix yamchaj yuj winh ix yik'anb'at heb' winh t'a preso.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an sti' heb' israel t'a Jehová, ix yalan heb' icha tik: Tato ol ach kolwaj qued'ok yik skak'an ganar jun nakión chi', ol ko satkanel junjun chonhab' t'a yol smakb'en chi' t'a junelnhej, xchi heb'.

Ix sk'anab'ajej Jehová skolwaj icha ix aj sk'anan heb' chi', yuj chi' ix yak' ganar heb' kananeo chi' heb'. Ix satkanel heb' kananeo chi' smasanil yet' schonhab'il, yuj chi' Horma ix sb'iejkan jun lugar chi'.

Ix el heb' israel t'a yich witz Hor chi', ix ek' heb' t'a b'e tzek' t'ha ha' Chacchac Mar. Najat ix ek' yoy sb'a heb' yujto maj k'axpajek' heb' t'a lum Edom. Ayic ayoch heb' t'a yol b'e chi', ix chab'axk'e sk'ool heb',

ix kot yowal heb' d'ha Dios yet' t'a winhaj Moisés. Ix yalan heb' icha tik: --¿Tas yuj ix onh ik'elta t'a Egipto? ¿Tom yuj ko cham yuj wejel t'a taquinh lu'um tik? Malaj tas sko wa''a, malaj pax tas skuk'ej. Maxtzac techaj ko waan juntzanh chukal wael tik, xchi heb'.
Yuj wal chi' ix ak'jikot juntzanh nok' chan te ow yuj Jehová, yik schiji heb' anima chi' yuj nok'. Tzijtum heb' israel chi' ix cham yuj nok'.

Ayic ix yilan heb' icha chi', ix b'at yalan heb' t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --Toxo ix och ko mul a onh tik, ix kal chukal lolonel t'a Jehová yet' t'ayach. Ha tiknaik k'an t'a Jehová to syik'el nok' chan tik t'a ko kal, xchi heb'. Ix sk'anan winhaj Moisés chi' t'a Jehová to syak' niwank'olal t'a yib'anh heb' anima chi'.

Ix yalan Jehová chi' t'a winh icha tik: --B'o junok yechel chan t'a k'een bronke icha yilji juntzanh nok' chi', tzak'ank'e t'a schon junok te te' chaanh steel, yik wach' ayik schiji heb' anima yuj nok' chan chi', tato sk'e k'elan heb' t'a jun yechel chan chi', maxtzak chamlaj heb' yuj nok', xchi t'a winh.

Ix sb'oan jun yechel chan nab'a bronke winhaj Moisés chi', ix yak'ank'e winh t'a schon jun te te'. Yuj chi' yalnhej mach schiji yuj nok' chan chi', sk'e k'elan heb' t'a jun yechel chan chi', sb'oxikan heb'.
Ix b'eynhejkot heb' israel, ix jawi heb' t'a Obot.
Ix elpax heb' t'a Obot chi', ix b'eynhejkot heb' t'a yichanh, ix jawi heb' t'a Ije-abarim t'a tzinan lu'um t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a yol yik Moab.
Ix kotnhej heb', ix jawi heb' t'a jun ha' eluma' skuch Zered.

Ix b'eynhejkot heb', ix jawi heb' t'a sk'axepalb'at jun ha ha' skuch Arnón. Ha jun ha ha' chi' tzek' t'a tzinan lum t'a yol yik heb' amorreo. Aton jun ha' chi' ayoch mojonal yuj heb' Moab yet' heb' amorreo chi'.
Aton juntzanh lugar chi' sb'inaj b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkan yab'ixal owal yik Jehová, b'aj syal icha tik: Onh ek'ta t'a chonhab' Vaheb t'a yol yik Sufá, t'a yoltak ha' Arnón.
Ha jun pak'an t'a stitak ha ha' chi' ayoch smojonalok yik Moab, sk'och t'a chonhab' Ar, xchi.

Ix el heb' t'ha ha' Arnón chi', ix kotnhej heb' masanto ix jawi heb' t'a Beer. Aton ta' ay jun ha' uk'b'ila' b'aj ix yal Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés icha tik: Molb'ej masanil anima, a in ol wak' ha ha' yuk'ej heb', xchi t'a winh.
Aton t'a jun pekti’ chi' ix b'itan heb' israel icha tik: Ix k'eul ha ha' b'aj molan. Q'ueokab'kot b'urnaj ha ha'. To ol onh b'itanek yuj ha ha' ix k'eul b'urnaj tik.

Ha heb' winh yajal ix joyank'eta ha' yet' sk'okoch. Ha heb' winh niwak yajal t'a yol schonhab', a yet' sk'okoch heb' winh ix sjakk'eta ha ha', xchi heb' t'a sb'it chi'. Ix b'eynhejkot heb' t'a tzinan lu'um masanto ix jawi heb' t'a Matana.
Ix el heb' t'a Matana chi', ix jawi heb' t'a Nahaliel. Ix el heb' t'a Nahaliel chi', ix jawi heb' t'a Bamot.
Ix el heb' t'a Bamot chi', ix jawi heb' t'a jun ch'olan ay t'a yol yik Moab, t'a stojolal lum niwak witz t'a yol yik Pisga, aton ta' niwan chequel lum tzinan lu'um.
Ix yak'b'at schekab' heb' israel t'a winhaj Sehón sreyal heb' amorreo, ix yalanb'at heb' icha tik:

¿Tom max onh a chaek' t'a yol a makb'en? Malaj jab'ok tas ol ek' ko lob'at t'a skal eyawb'en yet' t'a skal eyuwa, manh ol kuk' ha ha' t'a eyuk'b'il ha', anhej t'a yol niwan b'e ol onh ek'ok, xchi heb' chekab' chi'.

Maj scha sk'ol winhaj Sehón chi' yek' heb' israel t'a yol smakb'en chi'. Anhej to ix smolb'ej masanil heb' soldado winh, ix elta winh yak' owal yet' heb' t'a tzinan lu'um, t'a Jahaza ix yak' owal heb'.

Ix yak'an owal heb' israel chi' yet' heb', ix ak'ji ganar winhaj Sehón yet' heb' soldado yuj heb'. Ix ik'jiek' lum sluum heb' chi' yuj heb' israel chi'. Sb'atnhej t'a sti' ha' Arnón, masanto sk'och t'a sti' ha' Jaboc, masanto b'aj tzek' smojonal sluum heb' amonita. Ha jun lu'um chi' te wach' yaj smakchaj yuj heb' amonita chi'.
Icha chi' ix aj yochkan slum heb' amorreo yikok heb' israel chi'. Ix kajnaj heb' israel t'a chonhab' Hesbón yet' t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' ay t'a spatiktak.

Ha Hesbón chi', aton jun chonhab' b'aj ek'nak winhaj Sehón sreyal heb' amorreo. Ha winhaj Sehón chi' ix yak'nhej owal winh yet' heb' winh sreyal Moab t'a yalanhtaxo. Ix ik'jiek' jun makan slum heb' yuj winh sk'ochnhej t'ha ha' Arnón.
Yuj chi' ix yal heb' slolon t'a poesía icha tik: Cotanhec t'a Hesbón, aton t'a schonhab' winhaj rey Sehón. B'oekxik'e t'a schaelal, wach' tzeyutej he b'oanoch smuroal.
Ato t'a Hesbón, t'a schonhab' winhaj rey Sehón ix kot heb' ix nhusantz'a chonhab' Ar t'a yol yik Moab yet' heb' niwak yajal yaj t'a jun chonhab' t'a pak'an t'a yib'anhk'e ha' Arnón.

Ex aj Moab, ob'iltak ex. Toxo ix ex lajwiel ex schonhab' Dios Quemos. Aton jun he diosal chi' maj yal-laj skolwaji, yuj chi' ix el lemnaj heb' soldado smasanil, axonhej heb' ix ix, ix kan t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj rey Sehón.
Toxo ix lajwiel yipalil chonhab' Hesbón. Ix satel heb' ay t'a chonhab' Dibón masanto ix satel heb' ay t'a Nofa yet' pax Medeba, xchi jun poesía chi'.
Icha chi' ix aj yik'ankan lum lum heb' israel makb'il yuj heb' amorreo.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'anb'at schekab' winhaj Moisés t'a chonhab' Jazer yik sb'eytzitej heb' tas yaji. Ix ak'ji ganar jun chonhab' chi' yuj heb' israel yet' masanil juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a spatiktak. Ix pechjiel masanil heb' kajan ta' yuj heb', aton heb' amorreo.
Ix meltzaj heb', ix b'at heb' t'a stojolal lum Basán, palta ix elta winhaj Og sreyal Basán chi' yet' masanil heb' soldado yak' owal yet' heb' t'a Edrei.

Yuj chi' ix yal Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: Manh ex xiw t'a winhaj Og chi', a in ol wak'och winh yet' heb' soldado yet' smakb'en tik t'a yol he k'ab'. Icha ix eyutej winhaj Sehón sreyal heb' amorreo ay t'a Hesbón, icha chi' ol eyutejpax winhaj Og tik, xchi t'a winh.
Icha chi' ix aj scham winhaj Og yet' yuninal yet' masanil heb' soldado yuj heb' israel, manhxo junok heb' ix kani. Ix ochkan sluum heb' yikok heb' israel chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'eynhejkot heb' israel chi', ix sb'oank'e skampamento heb' t'a lum ak'lik yik Moab t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'ha ha' Jordán t'a satkot Jericó.
Ix yab'an winhaj Balac sreyal Moab yuninal winhaj Zipor, tas ix utaj heb' amorreo yuj heb' israel.
Yuj chi' ix xiwchaanh winh yet' heb' anima ay t'a Moab chi', yujto ix yil winh to te tzijtum heb' israel chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yal heb' anima ay t'a Moab chi' t'a heb' yichamtak winaquil chonhab' Madián icha tik: Masanil juntzanh anima tik, ol onh satel heb' t'a ko lu'um tik. Icha tz'aj slajwiel anh ank'ultak yuj nok' wakax, icha chi' ol onh yutok heb', xchi heb'.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj Balac chi' to sb'at kot jun winh syaloch sb'a jelanil skuchan Balaam, yuninal winhaj Beor, kajan t'a Petor t'a sti' ha' niwan Éufrates t'a skal heb' yetchonhab'. Ix schekanb'at heb' yichamtak winaquil chonhab' winhaj Balac chi', yik sb'at yal heb' t'a winhaj Balaam chi' icha tik: Ha t'a Egipto ix kot jun niwan chonhab'il anima, toxo ix majel sat lum lum tik yuj heb', toxo ix jawi heb' t'a ko tz'ey.

Yuj chi' kotanh t'a elanhchamel yik tzul a katab'an heb', yujto yelxo niwan sb'isul heb' t'a quichanh. Tato icha chi' tope ol yal wak'an ganar heb' yik tzin pechanel heb' t'a ko lum tik, yujto wojtak to a a katab' yet' a wach' lolonel tzala', tz'elnhejk'ochi, xchib'at winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at heb' yichamtak winaquil chonhab' Moab yet' heb' yichamtak winaquil Madián b'aj ayek' winhaj Balaam chi'. Te niwan k'een tumin ix yik'b'at heb' yik stupan skatab' winh chi' heb'. Ix yalan scheknab'il heb' ix yalb'at winhaj Balac chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Balaam chi' t'a heb' icha tik: --Ha tiknaik, kananhek t'a tik, ato syal tas ol yal Jehová t'ayin t'a jun ak'wal tik, ichato chi' swak'an spak he lolonel chi' k'ik'an, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix kan heb' ichamtak winak chi' yet' winhaj Balaam chi' t'a jun ak'wal chi'.
Ix sch'oxan sb'ha Dios t'a winh, ix sk'anb'an t'a winh icha tik: --¿Mach juntzanh anima ayek' chi' t'ayach? xchi.
Ix tak'wi winh: --Chekab' yaj heb' yuj winhaj Balac sreyal Moab yuninal winhaj Zipor, tzul yal heb' t'ayin,

tob' ay jun chonhab'il anima ix kot t'a Egipto. Tob' toxo ix majel sat lum lum yuj heb'. Snib'ej winhaj Balac chi' to tzin b'at t'a schonhab' winh chi', yik sb'at in katab'ej jun chonhab'il anima chi', yik wach' syal spechanel heb' winh t'a yol smakb'en chi' yalani, xchi winh d'ha Dios chi'.
Ix yalan Dios chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Manh ach b'at yet' heb' yik sb'at a katab'ej jun chonhab'il anima chi', yujto a in wal ix wal wach' lolonel t'a heb', xchi t'a winh.

Axo ix q'uinhib'i t'a junxo k'u, ix k'e wan winhaj Balaam chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' schekab' winhaj Balac chi' icha tik: --Ha tiknaik, meltzajanhek t'a he chonhab' yujto toxo ix yal Jehová to max yal-laj in b'at eyed'ok, xchi winh.
Ix meltzaj heb' t'a schonhab' b'aj ay winhaj Balac chi', ix yalan heb' t'a winh icha tik: --Maj stak'kotlaj sb'a winhaj Balaam chi' qued'ok, xchi heb'.
Maj schalaj yab' winhaj Balac chi', yuj chi' ix chekjib'at juntzanhxo heb' más niwak yopisio t'a yichanh heb' ix xid'ek' chi', ek'topax sb'isul heb' ix b'ati.

Yuj chi' ix b'atxi heb' yil winhaj Balaam chi', ix yalan heb' t'a winh icha tik: --Ix onh schekkot winhaj Balac yuninal winhaj Zipor t'ayach, syalan winh t'ayach icha tik: Malajokab' mach tzach kachanoch waan a koti,
yujto ol ach wik' wal chaanh, ol wak'an masanil tas ol a k'ana', anhej to tza k'anab'ajej a kot a katab'ej juntzanh anima tik, xchi winh, xchi heb'.

Ix tak'wipax winhaj Balaam chi' icha tik: --Wach'chom b'ud'jinak yol spalakio winh yuj k'een oro, ma yuj k'een plata, syak'an winh smasanil t'ayin, max yal-laj in k'ulan tas skot t'a in pensar in tenanek' tas syal Jehová in Diosal.
Tato syal he kanpax t'a jun ak'wal tik, ol wab' tas ol yutok Jehová yalanxi t'ayin, xchi winh.

Ix sch'oxanpax sb'a Jehová t'a winh t'ak'walil chi', ix yalan t'a winh: --Yakb'an to ix jax heb' winh ach yik'b'ati, ixik yet' heb' winh, palta anhej wal tas ol wal t'ayach, anhej b'at ala', xchi t'a winh.
Axo yik ix q'uinhib'i, ix k'e waan winhaj Balaam chi', ix yak'anoch stz'um nok' snun b'uru winh, ix b'at winh yet' heb' winh yichamtak winaquil Moab chi'.

Ix k'e winh t'a yib'anh nok' sb'uru chi', ix b'at chawanh heb' schekab' winh yet'ok. Axo Jehová ix kot yowal t'a winh yujto ix b'at winh. Axo yángel Jehová chi' ix och tek'tek' t'a yol b'e yik smakan b'e chi'.

Axo ix yilan nok' b'uru chi' to linhanoch jun yángel Jehová t'a nanhal yol b'e, yet'nak jun espada, ix b'atkan nok' t'a kaltak te'. Ix syamanoch winhaj Balaam chi' smak'an nok', yik tz'ochxi nok' t'a yol b'e chi'.
Ix ochxi linhan jun ángel chi' b'aj lot'an b'e t'a skal te' uwa, latz'b'ilk'e k'een k'een smaktealok te' t'a titak b'e chi'.

Axo ix yilanxi nok' to linhanek' jun ángel chi' t'a nanhal yol b'e chi', ix snhikanek' sb'a nok' t'a k'een k'een ayoch t'a titak b'e chi'. Ix nhikjiek' yok winhaj Balaam chi' yuj nok' t'a k'een, ix ste mak'anxi nok' winh.
Ix el yángel Jehová chi' ta', ix snitzanb'at sb'ha t'a yichanhb'ati, ix ochxi linhan b'aj te lot'an b'e, b'aj maxtzak yal yelkan junok mach t'a titak b'e a schalan sb'a yet' junokxo mach.

Ix yilanxi nok' b'uru chi' to linhanek' jun ángel chi' t'a nanhal yol b'e chi', toxonhej ix em lachnaj nok' t'a yalanh winhaj Balaam chi', yuj chi' ix kot yowal winh t'a nok', ix och ijan winh smak'an nok' yet' sk'okoch.
Ha wal t'a jun rato chi' ix lolonk'e nok' yuj Jehová, ix yalan nok' t'a winh icha tik: --¿Tas ix ach wutej? Yoxelalxo in a mak'ani, xchi nok'.
--Yujto yelxo wal tzin ixtej swab'i. Ayoc wal ek' junok k'een espada t'a tik, wal tiknaik tzach in tekchamok, xchi winh t'a nok'.
Ix tak'wi nok' t'a winh icha tik: --Ha in tik a chejintaxoni, tzach k'enhej t'a wib'anh ayik tzach b'eyeq'ui, ojtak to malaj junelok icha tik tzach wutej, xchi nok'. --I' yel toni, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' haxo Jehová ix ak'an yil jun ángel chi' winh, ayek' t'a nanhal yol b'e chi', ayoch k'een espada t'a yol sk'ab'. Ixnhej wal yil jun ángel chi' winh, ix em nhojan winh t'a yichanh.
Ix yalan jun ángel chi' t'a winh icha tik: --¿Tas yuj oxel ix a mak' nok' a b'uru tik? Ha in ix in och t'a ichanh ix in makan a b'e, yujto ix kot wowal yujto ix ach kot yet' juntzanh anima tik.

Anhej nok' b'uru tik ix in ilani, oxel ix elkan nok' t'a yol b'e. Tato maj sb'esel sb'a nok' t'a yol b'e chi', toxom ix ach cham wuj tiknaik, a pax nok' b'uru tik maj am chamlaj nok', xchi jun ángel chi' t'a winh.
Ix yalan winh t'a yángel Jehová chi' icha tik: --Ix och in mul t'ayach, manh wojtakok tato a ach tza mak in b'e tik, yuj chi' tato max scha a k'ol tzin b'ati, syal in meltzaji, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi jun ángel chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Syal a b'at yet' heb' anima tik, palta anhej wal tas ol wal t'ayach, anhej ol ala', xchi t'a winh. Yuj chi' ix b'atnhej winh yet' heb' schekab' winhaj Balac chi'.
Axo ix yab'an winhaj Balac to wan sk'och winhaj Balaam chi', ix kot winh scha winh t'a yol b'e t'a jun chonhab' ay t'a yol yik Moab, t'a sti' ha ha' skuch Arnón, satxo smojonal ay.
Ix yalan winhaj Balac chi' icha tik: --Yelk'olal wal ach wawtej, ¿tas yuj ijan maj a tak'kotlaj a b'a? Tekan ix a na' to manh ol in tzak'wan wak'an jantak tas tza nib'ej, xchi winh t'a winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Balaam chi' icha tik: --Manh ak' pensar, ayinxo eq'ui, palta max yal-laj walani tastak tzin nib'ej swala', anhej tastak schek Dios wala', anhej ol wala', xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winh yet' winhaj Balac chi' t'a chonhab' Quiriat-huzot.
Ata' ix schek winhaj Balac chi' miljokcham nok' wakax yet' nok' kalnel yik schi winhaj Balaam chi' yet' pax heb' ichamtak winak schekab' winhaj Balac chi'.
Axo t'a junxo k'u, ix ik'jib'at winhaj Balaam yuj winhaj Balac chi' t'a jolom witz skuch Bamot-baal, ata' syal yilanb'at janik'ok skampamento heb' israel heb' winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Balaam t'a winhaj Balac chi' icha tik: --Chec b'ochajk'e uqueok altar t'a tik, tza chekan ik'chajkot ukwanhok nok' kelemtak wakax yet' ukwanhok nok' ch'ak kalnel, xchi winh.
Ix sk'anab'ajej winhaj Balac tas ix yal winh chi', ix smol ak'an juntzanh silab' chi' heb' winh schawanhil, jun nok' quelem wakax yet' jun nok' ch'ak kalnel t'a junjun altar.

Ix yalanxi winhaj Balaam chi' t'a winhaj Balac chi' icha tik: --Cananh t'a stz'ey juntzanh silab' tik, ol b'at wila'' tato sjawi Jehová yik slolon wed'ok, ol lajwok chi' ol walan t'ayach tas wal ol aj yalan t'ayin, xchi winh. Ix b'at winh t'a jun niwan witz malaj ste'al.
Ata' ix sch'ox sb'a Jehová t'a winh, ix yalan winh t'ay icha tik: --Ix in b'ok'e uque' altar, ix wak'ankank'e junjun nok' wakax yet' junjun nok' ch'ak kalnel t'a yib'anh junjun, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan Jehová chi' tas ol aj slolon winh. Ix yalan icha tik: --Meltzajanh b'aj ayek' winhaj Balac chi', tzalan tas ix wal tik t'ayach, xchi t'a winh.
Ix meltzaj winh, ix k'ochxi winh b'aj aykan linhan winhaj Balac yet' heb' yichamtak winaquil Moab t'a stz'ey silab' chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix och ijan winh yalan icha tik: Ayinek' t'a jun witz t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a yol yik Aram, ayik ix in yawtankot winhaj Balac sreyal Moab. Cotanh, tza katab'an heb' israel. Alcan chukal lolonel t'a yib'anh yinhtilal winhaj Jacob chi', xchib'at winh.
Palta, ¿tas wal tz'aj in katab'an anima to manhok Dios skatab'ani? ¿Tas wal tz'aj wak'an chukal tato manhok Jehová tz'ak'an chukal t'ay?

Te wach' wilanb'at jun chonhab' chi' ayik ayink'e t'a schon jun k'een k'een tik. Te wach' wilanb'at t'a jolom witz b'aj ayinek' tik. Ha jun chonhab' chi' ch'ok yajeli, max somb'atlaj sb'ha t'a skal juntzanhxo chonhab'.

Lajanxo sb'isul jun chonhab' chi' icha spokokal lum lum, ¿tokwal ay mach stzak'wan sb'isan nanhalok heb'? Comonoc wal a in tzin cham t'a junk'olal icha juntzanh anima to wach' spensar chi', xchi winh t'a yichanh heb' winh chi'.

Ayic ix yab'an juntzanh lolonel chi' winhaj Balac chi', ix och ijan winh yalanoch t'a sat winhaj Balaam chi' icha tik: --¿Tas aji? Ha yuj a katab'an heb' ayoch ajk'olal tik t'ayin, yuj chi' ach wik'koti, palta haxo wach' lolonel tzalkan t'a yib'anh heb', xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Balaam chi' icha tik: --Yowalil a tas schek Jehová wala', a swala', xchi winh.
Palta ix ochnhej ijan winhaj Balac chi' yalan icha tik: --Conh wed' t'a junokxo lugar, b'aj janik'nhej syal quilan t'a stitak skampamento heb', a wal ta' ol a katab'ej heb' in k'ana', xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix ik'jib'at winhaj Balaam yuj winhaj Balac chi' t'a jun jakan t'a sjolom lum witz Pisga. Ata' ix schek winh b'ochajxik'e uque' altar, ix yak'anxi nok' wakax yet' nok' ch'ak kalnel chi' winh silab'il, junjun nok' t'a junjun altar.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Balaam chi' t'a winhaj Balac chi' icha tik: --Cananh t'a stz'ey altar tik, yakb'an b'at in lolon yet' Jehová, xchi winh.
Ix sch'oxanxi sb'a Jehová chi' t'a winh, ix yalani tas ol yutok winh yalani. --Meltzajanh b'aj ayek' winhaj Balac chi', tzalan icha tz'aj walan tik t'ayach, xchi t'a winh.
Ix meltzaj winh b'aj aykan winhaj Balac yet' heb' ay yopisio aj Moab t'a stz'ey silab' chi', ix sk'anb'an winhaj Balac chi' t'a winh icha tik: --¿Tas ix aj yalan Jehová chi' t'ayach? xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix och ijan winh yalan icha tik:

Ach Balac yuninal winhaj Zipor, scham wal ab'an tas ol wala': Ha Dios manh lajanok icha anima. Max yesejlaj, max ek'b'atlaj tas syala'. Tato ay junok tas syala', tz'elnhejk'ochi. Tato ay junok tas syaltej, syak'nhej.
Ix yal Jehová t'ayin to swal wach' lolonel t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik. Tato icha chi' tz'aj yalani, max yal-laj in k'exani.
Malaj junok yaelal syil Jehová to ol jawok t'a yib'anh chonhab' Israel. Te wach' yik heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Jacob. Ha Jehová sDiosal heb', a ayoch sreyalok heb', aynhejpaxek' t'a skal heb'.
Ha Jehová ix ik'anelta heb' t'a Egipto. Ha Jehová ayoch yipok sk'ol heb', icha nok' owal wakax a sch'aak ayoch yipok sk'ool.

Ha t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj Jacob malaj yelk'och heb' naumel lolonel, malaj pax yelk'och heb' ajb'aal. Ha tiknaik yowalil tz'alchaj t'a chonhab' Israel icha tik: Tzijtum tas satub'takxonhej yoch ix sk'ulej Jehová t'ay, xchiokab'i.

Ha jun chonhab' tik syik'chaanh sb'a ichok nok' choj te ay smay. Ayic toxo ix och sat nok' t'a junok schib'ej, max och waan nok' spechani masanto syamchaji syuk'an schiq'uil nok', icha chi' yaj heb', xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Balac chi' icha tik: --Tato max yal a katab'an jun chonhab' tik, mokab' alpaxkan wach' lolonel t'a yib'anh, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Balaam chi' icha tik: --¿Tom maj wal t'ayach jun, to a tas ol schek Jehová wala', aton yowalil swala'? xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalanxi winhaj Balac chi' icha tik: --Cotanh, ol ach wik'b'at t'a junokxo lugar, talaj ata' ol scha' sk'ol Dios a katab'an heb' israel chi', xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix ik'jib'at winh yuj winhaj Balac chi' t'a jolom witz Peor, b'aj te chequel quilan masanil tzinan lu'um.

Ayic ayek' heb' winh ta', ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Balac chi' icha tik: --Chec b'ochajk'e uqueokxo altar t'a tik in k'ana', tza chekan miljokcham ukwanhok nok' kelemtak wakax yet' ukwanhok nok' ch'ak kalnel, xchi winh.
Ix schekan winhaj Balac b'ojok uquexo altar chi' yik snhusjitz'a juntzanh nok' chi' t'a yib'anh.

Axo yik ix nachajel yuj winhaj Balaam to scha sk'ol Jehová ayik syalan wach' lolonel winh t'a yib'anh heb' israel, majxo b'atlaj winh sk'anb'ej yab' icha ix yutej t'a sb'ab'elal, anhej to ix b'at k'elan winh t'a tzinan lu'um chi'.
Axo ix yilanb'at chonhab' Israel winh, t'a stzolal yaj junjun inhtilal heb' yet' skampamento, ix och Yespíritu Dios t'a winh,
yuj chi' ix och ijan winh yalan icha tik: Aton in lolonel a in Balaam in tik, yuninal in winhaj Beor, jichichi tz'aj wilani.
Swab' tas syal Dios. Icha wayichal tz'aj wilan Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil. Tzin ek' jichan, palta jakan in sat, te wach' wilani.
Ex israel yinhtilalkan winhaj Jacob, te wach' yilji he mantiado. Te wach' quilanb'at he kampamento.

Icha wal yaj stzolal te' palma, icha wal chi' eyiljib'ati. Icha wal sb'at tzololok junok tas tz'awchaj t'a sti' junok ha ha', icha wal chi' eyajemi. Icha te' áloes awab'il yuj Jehová, ma icha wal yaj te' k'ute' t'a sti' ha ha'.

Ha b'aj ayek' chonhab' Israel chi', manhxo jantakok ha ha'. Wach'nhej yuk'an ha' heb' yet' yak'anoch yalil tas syawej heb'. Ha sreyal heb' te ay smay t'a yichanh winhaj rey Agag. Te niwan yaj smakb'en sreyal heb'.

Ha Jehová ix ik'anelta heb' t'a Egipto. Ha Jehová ayoch yipok sk'ool heb', icha nok' owal wakax a sch'aak ayoch yipok sk'ool. Ha chonhab' Israel ol satanel heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ay. Ol smak'poj sb'aquil heb' yajk'ol heb' chi'. Ol k'axpajek' sjul-lab' heb' t'a sniwanil heb' yajk'ol chi'.

Lajan wal heb' icha junok nok' choj jichanek' swayi, malaj mach stek'b'ej sb'a stzuntzani. Ex israel, alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'a mach tz'alan wach' lolonel t'ayex, katab'ajokab' mach tzex katab'ani, xchi winh.

Ayic ix yab'an juntzanh lolonel chi' winhaj Balac chi', ix te kot yowal winh sik'lab'il, ix smuch'an jun sk'ab' winh ix schuk'anoch winh t'a yol junxo sk'ab' yuj yowal chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ha yuj a katab'an heb' ajk'ol yajoch tik t'ayin ix ach wawtejkoti, haxo tiknaik yoxelalxo alan wach' lolonel t'a yib'anh heb'.
Te wach' ama tzach meltzaj t'a a pat t'a elanhchamel. Toxo ix wala' to niwan tas ol wak' t'ayach, ol ach wik'anchaanh, palta max schalaj sk'ol Jehová to icha chi' tz'aji, xchi winhaj Balac chi'.
Ix tak'wixi winhaj Balaam chi' icha tik: --Jichan ix aj walan t'a heb' a chekab':

Wach'chom b'ut'an a palakio yuj k'een oro, ma yuj k'een plata, tzak'an k'een t'ayin, palta max yal-laj in k'exan tas syal Jehová, max yal-laj wak'an wach'k'olal, ma in katab'an b'aj skot t'a in k'ol in k'ulani, yujto a tas schek Jehová wala', aton yowalil swala'.
Wach' ol in meltzaj t'a in chonhab'. Anhej, ayik mantzak in b'ati, swalkan t'ayach tas ol utaj a chonhab' tik yuj jun chonhab'il anima chi' t'a b'ak'uinh, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix och ijan winh yalan icha tik: Aton in lolonel a in Balaam in tik, yuninal in winhaj Beor, jichichi tz'aj wilani.

Swab' tas syal Dios Ek'to t'a yib'anh Smasanil, wojtak tas yaj spensar, swilanpax icha wayichal. Ha Dios Syal yuj Smasanil chi' tz'ak'an wojtaquejeli. Tzin ek' jichan, palta jakan in sat, te wach'nhej wilani.

Ay jun mach najatto ay, palta syal wilanb'ati. Ay jun rey ol cheklajk'e t'a skal heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jacob, tziquiqui yilji icha k'een k'anal. Ha jun rey chi' ol yak' yajalil t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Israel. A' ol satanel chonhab' Moab, a pax ol satanel heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Set.
Ol kan chonhab' Edom t'a yalanh yuj, ol ochkan lum Seir chi' yikok. Ha chonhab' Israel ol yik' yip.
Ha t'a skal heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Jacob ol elta jun mach ol och Yajalil. A' ol satanel jantakto mach ol kan t'a yol jun chonhab' chi', xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yilanb'at chonhab' Amalec winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: Ha chonhab' Amalec yelxo ay smay t'a yichanh juntzanhxo chonhab', palta ol satel t'a junelnhej, xchi winh.
Ix b'at k'elan winh t'a schonhab' heb' quenita, ix yalan winh icha tik: Ex quenita, wach'chom te ay smay he chonhab' yik skolan sb'a, wach'chom t'a schontak k'een niwak tenam tzeyak'k'e he pat,
palta ol satkanel he chonhab' chi', a jantak exto ol ex kanok, ol ex yik'kanb'at heb' winh asirio schekab'ok, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalanxi winh icha tik: Ay, ¿tokwal ayto mach ol kanok ayik ol sk'ulan juntzanh tik Dios?
Ay te' barko ol kot t'a Chipre, ol ja t'a sti' ha' mar yik tzul yixtan chonhab' Asiria yet' chonhab' Heber, palta ol satjokpaxel heb' aj Chipre chi', xchi winh.
Ixlajwi yalan juntzanh tik winh, ix meltzaj winh t'a schonhab', haxo winhaj Balac ix meltzajxikan winh b'aj kajan.
Ayic ayek' heb' israel t'a Sitim, tzijtum heb' winh winak ix mulan yet' heb' ix moabita.

Ix montajb'at heb' winh yuj heb' ix b'aj tz'och sq'uinhal sdiosal. Ix schi'an nok' chib'ej heb' winh israel chi', nok' silab'ej heb' ix t'a sdiosal chi'. Ix ochpax heb' winh ejmelal t'a sdiosal heb' ix chi'.
Icha chi' ix aj skuchb'ajb'at heb' winh yoch ejmelal t'a jun yechel skuch Baal, sdiosal chonhab' Peor, yuj chi' ix te kot yowal Jehová t'a chonhab' Israel chi',

ix yalan t'a winhaj Moisés icha tik: --Molb'ej masanil heb' ix kuchb'anb'at heb' anima tik t'a juntzanh chukal chi', wal t'a wichanh yet' t'a yichanh heb' etchonhab' tza d'unhb'ejk'e heb'. Icha chi' ol aj sikb'iem yowal in k'ol t'a chonhab' Israel tik, xchi t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj Moisés t'a heb' yajalil chonhab' chi' icha tik: --Junjun ex t'a eyinhtilal tze milcham heb' winh ix b'at och ejmelal t'a Baal, xchi winh.

Junanto rato chi' ix ek'b'at jun winh israel yet' jun ix aj Madián wan yik'anb'at ix winh t'a smantiado. Ix ek'b'at winh t'a slak'anil skajnub' Jehová t'a yichanh winhaj Moisés yet' heb' anima molaneq'ui yik tz'ok' heb' t'a yichanh Jehová.

Ayic ix yilan winhaj Finees yuninal winhaj Eleazar, yixchiquinkan winhaj Aarón winh b'ab'el sat sakerdote, ix k'e waan winh t'a skal heb' anima ayek' molan chi'. Ix yik'ankot slanza winh, ix b'at tzak'an winh yuj jun winh israel yet' ix aj Madián chi',

masanto ix k'och winh t'a yol smantiado winh. Ix stekan k'axpaj k'een lanza chi' winh t'a yol sk'ol winh israel yet' ix aj Madián chi'. Icha chi' ix aj yoch waan scham anima yuj jun ilya ix yak'kot Jehová t'a skal heb' israel chi'.
Ay 24 mil anima ix cham yuj jun ilya chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:

--Ha winhaj Finees ix ak'an sikb'ok yowal in k'ool, ix lajwi wowal t'a yib'anh chonhab' Israel tik, yapax ix yab' winh wed'ok yujto ix sna winh to a innhej niwan welk'ochi, yuj chi', tato manh ichokta ix sk'ulej winh, masanil am heb' anima tik ix sateli.

Yuj chi' al t'a winh icha tik: Yujto ya ix ab' wed'ok, yujto ix a na' to a innhej niwan welk'ochi, yuj chi' ix ak' sikb'oquem yowal in k'ol t'a yib'anh heb' anima tik, yuj chi' ol in b'o in trato ed'ok yet' masanil heb' inhtilal, ol ochkan heb' sakerdoteal t'a masanil tiempo, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a winh, xchi t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ha jun winh ix cham yet' ix aj Madián yuj winhaj Finees chi', Zimri sb'i winh, yuninal winhaj Salu, yajal yaj t'a skal yinhtilal Simeón.
Axo pax ix ix, ix cham chi', Cozbi sb'i ix, yisil ix winhaj Zur, yajal yaj t'a jun makan anima t'a Madián.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
--Hak'ek owal yet' heb' aj Madián, tze satanel heb',

yujto ix ex och t'a yol sk'ab' yaelal yuj heb' ayik ix ex yik'anb'at heb' eyoch ejmelal t'a sdiosal t'a Peor.
