Naeccoti tas ix ex yutej ix Cozbi, aton ix yisil jun winh yajal yaj t'a heb', yuj chi' ix tekjicham ix t'a k'een lanza, ayik ix wak'anb'at ilya t'a he kal, yujto tzijtum mach ix och ejmelal t'a sdiosal heb', xchi t'a winh.
Ayic ix lajwiek' jun ilya to scham anima chi' yuj, ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Eleazar sat sakerdote yuninal winhaj Aarón:
--Ik'ekchaanh sb'isul heb' israel t'a junjun makanhil yaj heb', tz'el yich t'a heb' 20 ab'il sk'inal stiempo wal sb'at t'a owal, xchi t'a heb' winh.
Ix smolb'an masanil heb' winak winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Eleazar t'a yak'likal Moab, t'a sti' ha' Jordán, t'a yichanhkot Jericó,
yik stz'ib'chaj masanil heb' 20 ab'il sk'inal sb'eynhejb'ati, icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'. Aton masanil heb' ix elta t'a Egipto:

Ha heb' yinhtilalkan Rubén sb'ab'el yuninal winhaj Israel, ay 43 mil 730 heb' winak t'a smasanil. Ha sb'i heb' yuninal winh sb'inajkan t'a junjun makan yinhtilal, aton tik: Vinhaj Enoc, winhaj Falú, winhaj Ezrón yet' winhaj Carmi.
Ha winhaj Falú chi' ay yuninal winhaj Eliab,

haxo pax winhaj Eliab ay yuninal winhaj Nemuel, winhaj Datán yet' winhaj Abiram, yichamtak winaquil chonhab' yaj heb'. Aton heb' junnhej ajnak slajti' yet' winhaj Coré. Meltzajnacoch heb' ajk'olal t'a Jehová, t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón.

Palta paxnak lewnaj lum lum, emnakkan heb' chawanh chi' t'a yol lum yet' winhaj Coré. Masanil heb' ochnak tzak'an yuj winhaj Coré chi' chamnak heb', aton heb' 250 chamnak yuj jun k'ak'. Ha juntzanh heb' chi' ochnak ch'oxnab'ilok t'a heb' israel smasanil.
Axo pax heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Coré chi', maj satel-laj heb'.

Axo pax heb' yinhtilalkan Simeón, ay 22 mil 200 heb' winak t'a smasanil. Ha sb'i heb' yuninal winh sb'inajkan t'a junjun makan yinhtilal, aton tik: Vinhaj Nemuel, winhaj Jamín, winhaj Jaquín, winhaj Zera yet' winhaj Saúl.

Ha heb' yinhtilalkan Gad, ay 40 mil 500 heb' winak t'a smasanil. Ha sb'i heb' yuninal winh sb'inajkan t'a junjun makan yinhtilal, aton tik: Vinhaj Zefón, winhaj Hagui, winhaj Suni, winhaj Ozni, winhaj Eri, winhaj Arod yet' winhaj Areli.

Ha heb' yinhtilal Judá, ay 76 mil 500 heb' winak t'a smasanil. Ha sb'i heb' yuninal winh sb'inajkan t'a junjun makan yinhtilal, aton tik: Vinhaj Sela, winhaj Fares yet' winhaj Zera. Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Fares sb'inajkan t'a yinhtilal: Vinhaj Hezrón yet' winhaj Hamul. Ha pax heb' yuninal winhaj Judá ix cham t'a lum Canaán aton winhaj Er yet' winhaj Onán.

Ha heb' yinhtilalkan Isacar, ay 64 mil 300 heb' winak t'a smasanil. Ha sb'i heb' yuninal winh sb'inajkan t'a junjun makan yinhtilal, aton tik: Vinhaj Tola, winhaj Fúa, winhaj Jasub yet' winhaj Simrón.
Ha heb' yinhtilalkan Zabulón, ay 60 mil 500 heb' winak t'a smasanil. Ha sb'i heb' yuninal winh sb'inajkan t'a junjun makan yinhtilal, aton tik: Vinhaj Sered, winhaj Elón yet' winhaj Jahleel.

Axo pax t'a yinhtilalkan José, chab' inhtilal yaj heb', aton yik Manasés yet' yik Efraín. Ha heb' yinhtilalkan Manasés chi', ay 52 mil 700 heb' winak t'a smasanil. Ha heb' sb'inajkan t'a skal junjun makan yinhtilal winh: Aton winhaj Maquir yet' winhaj Galaad yuninal winhaj Maquir chi' yet' pax heb' yuninal winhaj Galaad chi', aton winhaj Jezer, winhaj Helec, winhaj Asriel, winhaj Siquem, winhaj Semida yet' winhaj Hefer. (Ha winhaj Zelofehad yuninal winhaj Hefer, malaj yuninal winh, anhej heb' ix yisil winh ay: Aton ix Maala, ix Noa, ix Hogla, ix Milca yet' ix Tirsa.)

Axo heb' yinhtilalkan Efraín, ay 32 mil 500 heb' winak t'a smasanil. Ha sb'i heb' yuninal winh sb'inajkan t'a junjun makan yinhtilal, aton tik: Vinhaj Sutela, winhaj Bequer yet' winhaj Tahán. Ay jun yuninal winhaj Sutela chi' sb'inajkan t'a yinhtilal, aton winhaj Erán.

Ha heb' yinhtilalkan Benjamín, ay 45 mil 600 heb' winak t'a smasanil. Ha sb'i heb' yuninal winh sb'inajkan t'a junjun makan yinhtilal, aton tik: Vinhaj Bela, winhaj Asbel, winhaj Ahiram, winhaj Sufam yet' winhaj Hufam. Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Bela sb'inajkan t'a yinhtilal, aton winhaj Ard yet' winhaj Naamán.
Ha pax heb' yinhtilalkan Dan, ay 64 mil 400 heb' winak t'a smasanil. Ha winh sb'inajkan t'a yinhtilal, aton winhaj Suham.

Axo pax yinhtilalkan Aser, ay 53 mil 400 heb' winak t'a smasanil. Ha sb'i heb' yuninal winh sb'inajkan t'a junjun makan yinhtilal, aton tik: Vinhaj Imna, winhaj Isúi yet' winhaj Bería. Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Bería chi' sb'inajkan t'a yinhtilal: Aton winhaj Heber yet' winhaj Malquiel. (Ha winhaj Aser chi' ay jun ix yisil winh skuchan Sera).

Ha heb' yinhtilalkan Neftalí, ay 45 mil 400 heb' winak t'a smasanil. Ha sb'i heb' yuninal winh sb'inajkan t'a junjun makan yinhtilal, aton tik: Vinhaj Jahzeel, winhaj Guni, winhaj Jezer yet' winhaj Silem.
Yuj chi' a sb'isul masanil heb' winak yik chonhab' Israel, ay 601 mil 730 heb' t'a smasanil.
Ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés, ix yalan icha tik:
Pukchajokab'ek' lum lum t'a skal junjun inhtilal ato syala' jantak sb'isul junjun ix k'e waan.
D'a suerteal tz'aj spukchajek' lu'um t'a heb'. Niwan lum tzak' t'a heb' niwan sb'isul, quennhej lum tzak' t'a heb' quennhej sb'isul, xchi t'a winh.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Leví sb'inajkan t'a yinhtilal: Vinhaj Gersón, winhaj Coat yet' winhaj Merari.

Ha heb' yixchiquin winhaj Leví chi' sb'inajkan t'a yinhtilal: Vinhaj Libni, winhaj Hebrón, winhaj Mahli, winhaj Musi yet' winhaj Coré, aton heb' winh tik yinhtilalkan winhaj Leví. Ha winhaj Coat chi', aton winh smam winhaj Amram.

Ha winhaj Amram chi' ix yik' sb'a yet' jun ix yinhtilalkan winhaj Leví chi', aton ix skuchan Jocabed. Ayic ayek' winhaj Leví chi' t'a Egipto ix alji ix. Ha winhaj Amram yet' ix Jocabed chi', aton heb' smam snun winhaj Aarón, winhaj Moisés yet' ix María.
Axo heb' yuninal winhaj Aarón, aton winhaj Nadab, winhaj Abiú, winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Itamar.
Ha winhaj Nadab yet' winhaj Abiú chi', ix cham heb' winh yujto ix yak'och jun k'ak' heb' winh manh smojok icha ofrenda t'a yichanh Jehová.

Masanil heb' winak t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj Leví, aton heb' jun ujal sk'inal sb'eynhejb'ati, ay 23 mil heb'. Ha heb' tik manh ayokoch heb' sb'isulok juntzanhxo heb' yetisraelal, yujto a heb' lewita tik malaj smakb'en heb' ol scha'a, ayik ol k'och heb' t'a lum Canaán.
Icha wal chi' ix aj yelk'och sb'isul heb' israel ix ik'jichaanh yuj winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj sakerdote Eleazar t'a ak'lik t'a yol yik Moab, t'a sti' ha' Jordán t'a yichanhkot Jericó.
Masanil heb' chi', malaj junok heb' ix b'isji yuj winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón ayik ix yik'anchaanh sb'isul heb' winh t'a sb'ab'elal t'a tzinan lu'um Sinaí,
yujto ix yal Jehová to ol cham heb' t'a tzinan lu'um chi'. Manhxa junok heb' chi' ix kani, axonhej winhaj Caleb yuninal winhaj Jefone yet' winhaj Josué yuninal winhaj Nun ix kani.

Ay jun winh t'a yinhtilal Manasés skuch Zelofehad. Aton stzolal smam yicham winh tik: Vinhaj Hefer, winhaj Galaad, winhaj Maquir, winhaj Manasés yet' winhaj José. Ha winhaj Zelofehad chi' ay owanh heb' ix yisil winh: Aton ix Maala, ix Noa, ix Hogla, ix Milca yet' ix Tirsa.

Ha owanh heb' ix snulej sb'a tik, ix b'at heb' ix b'aj ay kajnub' b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová. Ix yalan heb' ix t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj sakerdote Eleazar yet' t'a masanil heb' yajalil chonhab' icha tik:

Ha winh ko mam a onh tik, ix cham winh t'a tzinan lu'um, palta manh lokanoklaj winh yet' heb' yik winhaj Coré ix meltzajoch ajk'olal t'a Jehová. Ha winh ko mam chi' yujnhej smul winh t'a yol yiko' ix cham winh, malaj junok yuninal winh ix kani.

Palta manh smojok satkanel sb'i winh t'a slistail quinhtilal, yujnhej to malaj junok yuninal winh ix kani. Yuj chi' ol eyak' junok makan ko lu'um t'a skal yik heb' winh yuk'tak winh ko mam chi', xchi heb' ix.
Ix yalan winhaj Moisés masanil tas ix yal heb' ix ix chi' t'a Jehová.
Ix tak'wi Jehová chi' t'a winh icha tik:
Ha heb' ix yisil winhaj Zelofehad chi', yel syal heb' ix. Ol ak' junok makan sluum heb' ix t'a skal yik heb' winh yuk'tak winh smam heb' ix chi', haxo heb' ix ol ik'ankan smakb'en winh smam chi'.
Alpax t'a heb' etisraelal: Tato ay mach schami, malaj junok yuninal winak skani, a smakb'en syal skan t'a heb' ix yisil.
Palta tato malaj junok yisil chi', ha t'a junok yuk'tak skan smakb'en chi'.
Tato malaj junok yuk'tak chi' jun, ha t'a heb' yuk'tak smam skan smakb'en chi'.
Tato a smam chi' malaj pax yuk'tak, ha t'a junok sk'ab' yok, ata' skan smakb'en chi'. Ha jun tik ley tz'ajkan t'a skal chonhab' Israel, icha tz'aj walan tik t'ayach, xchi Jehová chi' t'a winh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --Q'ueanh t'a jolom witz Abarim, tzilankanb'at lum ol wak' t'a heb' etchonhab' tik.
Anhej slajwi ilanb'at lu'um, ol ach chamok, icha wal ix aj scham winh uk'tak aj Aarón,

yujto maj in he k'anab'ajej, maj in eyik'chaanh t'a tzinan lum yik Zin, ayik ix kot yowal heb' anima t'ayin. Maj he k'anab'ajej he ch'oxanel t'a yichanh heb' eyetchonhab' to Ha inxonhej Ochi ayik ix k'e yaw heb' sk'anan ha ha' yuk'ej, xchi t'a winh. (Ix uji jun chi' b'aj ay ha ha' skuch Meriba t'a Cades, t'a lum tzinan lu'um yik Zin.)
Ix yalan winhaj Moisés t'a Jehová chi' icha tik:
--Mamin Jehová, a ach tzak' sk'inal masanil anima. Ha tiknaik ak'och a sat t'a junok mach tz'och yajalilok a chonhab',
yik skuchb'ejb'at heb' yik sb'atnhej heb', yik max satek' heb' icha nok' kalnel malaj stanhwumal, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi Jehová chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Te ay wal och Vespíritu t'a winhaj Josué yuninal winhaj Nun, yuj chi' ak'b'at a k'ab' t'a sjolom winh.
D'a wal yichanh winhaj sat sakerdote Eleazar yet' t'a yichanh masanil heb' anima, tzak'ankanoch yopisio winh.
Ak'kanoch jab'ok opisio chi' t'a yib'anh winh, yik wach' ol sk'anab'ajej masanil heb' anima tas ol yal winh.

Ha t'a winhaj Eleazar ol yal winh, haxo winhaj Eleazar chi' ol k'anb'an t'ayin yuj winh. Ha inxo Jehová in tik ol wal yet' k'een Urim tas ol yutej sb'a winh. Axo winh ol alan t'a heb' chonhab' chi' tas ol aj heb', xchi Jehová chi'.

Yuj chi' ix ik'jib'at winhaj Josué chi' yuj winhaj Moisés t'a yichanh winhaj sakerdote Eleazar yet' t'a yichanh masanil heb' chonhab'. Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'anb'at sk'ab' winhaj Moisés chi' t'a sjolom winhaj Josué chi', ix yak'ankan yopisio winh, icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al jun cheknab'il tik t'a heb' etchonhab' chi': Ha t'a stiempoal chequel yajkani, sk'anab'ajej heb' yak'an juntzanh ofrenda snhusjitz'a silab'il t'ayin, te suk'uq'ui sjab' swab'i, xchi t'a winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Moisés chi' t'a heb' yetchonhab' chi' yuj juntzanh ofrenda yowalil snhustz'a heb' yuj yik'jichaanh Jehová. Junjun k'u snhusjitz'a chatakwanh nok' kelemtak kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal, malaj jab'ok spaltail. Jun nok' snhusjitz'ha t'a q'uinhib'alil, haxo junxo nok' t'a yemk'ualil. Yowalil tz'ak'ji chanhe' libra ixim harina te wach', skalaj yet' junok litro akeite yik sat te' oliwo ofrendail yet' junjun nok'. Tz'ak'jipax junjun litro wino yet' junjun nok' kalnel chi', sekchajem b'aj ay skajnub' Jehová yuj yik'jichaanh. Ha t'a lum witzal Sinaí ix schek Jehová ak'jok juntzanh silab' tik t'a junjun k'u, aton ofrenda suk'uq'ui sjab' syab' Jehová.

Ha t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip, yowalil syak' chawanhokxo nok' kelemtak kalnel heb', aton nok' jun ab'il sk'inal, malaj jab'ok spaltail yet' wajxaque' libra ixim harina te wach' kalab'il yet' akeite t'a ofrendail t'a ixim trigo. Tz'ak'jipax wino yet'ok, ichataxon tz'aj yak'ji.
Masanil juntzanh silab' chi' tz'ak'ji t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip, palta ch'ok yel t'a yichanh silab' tz'ak'jitaxon t'a junjun k'u yet' pax wino tz'ak'jitaxon yet'ok.

Ha t'a b'ab'el k'ual yik junjun uj tzeyak' chawanh nok' kelemtak wakax silab'il yet' jun nok' ch'ak kalnel yet' ukwanh nok' kelemtak kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal. Masanil nok' tik, mokab'a jab'ok spaltail nok'.

Ha yet' junjun nok' wakax chi' tzeyak' lajchaweok libra ixim harina te wach', tze kalan yet' akeite. Axo yet' nok' ch'ak kalnel chi' tzeyak' wajxaqueok libra ixim harina te wach', kalab'il yet' akeite.
Axo yet' junjun nok' kelemtak kalnel chi', chanhe' libra ixim harina te wach' kalab'il yet' akeite tzeyak'a'. Aton jun ofrenda snhusjitz'a chi', suk'uq'ui sjab' syab' Jehová.

Axo wino tz'ak'jitaxon t'a ofrendail, chab' litro tz'ak'ji yet' junjun nok' wakax chi', nanhal schab'il litro t'a jun nok' ch'ak kalnel chi', junjun litro t'a junjun nok' kelemtak kalnel chi'. Aton juntzanh ofrenda chi' yowalil tz'ak'ji t'a junjun uj t'a yol ab'il.
Ha yet' silab' snhusjitz'a chi', tz'ak'jipax junok nok' mam chiwa t'a Jehová silab'il yuj mul yet' wino tz'ak'jitaxon yet'ok.
D'a 14 yoch b'ab'el uj t'a yol ab'il, ata' tz'och q'uinh yik tze naankoti ayik eyelnak libre yuj Jehová.
Axo t'a 15 yoch uj chi', ata' tz'och uque' k'ual q'uinh, aton ta' swaji ixim pan malaj yich.
Ha t'a b'ab'el k'u t'a uque' k'ual chi' tz'och jun niwan molanil yuj eyoch ejmelal. Ha t'a jun k'u chi', malaj junok makan munlajel tze k'ulej.
Chawanh nok' kelemtak wakax tz'ak'ji silab'il, jun nok' ch'ak kalnel yet' ukwanh nok' kelemtak kalnel junjun ab'il sk'inal. Masanil nok' chi', malajokab' jab'ok spaltail nok'.

Ha yet' juntzanh silab' chi' tz'ak'ji juntzanhxo ofrenda tz'ak'jitaxon yet'ok, ixim harina kalab'il yet' akeite, tz'ak'ji icha tik: Lajchawe' libra ixim yet' junjun nok' wakax chi', wajxaque' libra ixim yet' jun nok' ch'ak kalnel chi',
chanhe' libra ixim yet' junjun nok' kelemtak kalnel chi'.
Tz'ak'jipax junok nok' mam chiwa silab'il yuj mul yik stupkanel he mul t'a eyib'anh.
Masanil juntzanh chi' tz'ak'ji yet' jun silab' snhusjitz'ha t'a q'uinhib'alil t'a junjun k'u.

Icha chi' tz'aj t'a junjun k'u t'a uque' k'ual q'uinh chi'. Snhusjitz'a juntzanh ofrenda chi', suk'uq'ui sjab' syab' Jehová. Palta ch'ok pax yaj silab' tz'ak'jitaxon t'a junjun k'u yet' pax wino tz'ak'jitaxon yet'ok.
Axo t'a yuquil k'ual, tz'ochpax junxo niwan molanil yuj eyoch ejmelal. Ha t'a jun k'u chi', malaj junok makan munlajel tze k'ulej.

Ayic toxo ix ek'b'at uque' semana yek' q'uinh yik tze naankot eyelnak libre yuj Jehová, tzeyak'an eyofrenda yuj sb'ab'el sat eyawb'en tze molo'. Tze molb'ej he b'a he masanil yuj eyoch ejmelal t'a Jehová, malaj junok makan munlajel tze k'ulej.
Tzeyak'pax junok silab' te wach' t'a Jehová suk'uq'ui sjab' syab'i: Chawanh nok' kelemtak wakax, junok nok' ch'ak kalnel, ukwanhok nok' kelemtak kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal,
yet' ixim harina te wach' kalab'il yet' akeite tz'ak'jitaxoni, lajchawe' libra ixim yet' junjun nok' wakax chi', wajxaque' libra ixim yet' jun nok' ch'ak kalnel chi',
chanhe' libra ixim yet' junjun nok' kelemtak kalnel chi'.
Tzeyak'anpax junok nok' mam chiwa silab'il yuj he mul.
Ha yet' juntzanh silab' chi' tz'ak'jinhej ofrenda t'a ixim harina yet' wino. Tzeyak'anpax silab' tz'ak'jitaxon t'a junjun k'u. Masanil nok' tz'ak'ji chi', yowalil malaj jab'ok spaltail nok'.
Ha t'a b'ab'el k'ual yik yuquil uj, tze molb'ej he b'a yik tzex och ejmelal. Ha t'a jun k'ual chi' malaj junok mach smunlaji. Ha jun k'ual chi', sk'ual yik spuji k'een trompeta.

Tze nhusantz'a juntzanh silab' suk'uq'ui sjab' syab' Jehová: Jun nok' quelem wakax, junok nok' ch'ak kalnel yet' ukwanh nok' kelemtak kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal. Masanil juntzanh nok' nok' chi', malajokab' jab'ok spaltail nok'.
Tzeyak'anpax ixim harina kalab'il yet' akeite tz'ak'jitaxon yet'ok, lajchawe' libra ixim yet' jun nok' wakax chi', wajxaque' libra ixim yet' jun nok' ch'ak kalnel chi',
chanhe' libra ixim yet' junjun nok' kelemtak kalnel chi'.
Tz'ak'jipax junok nok' mam chiwa silab'il yik stupkanel he mul t'a eyib'anh.

Tz'ak'jipax silab' tz'ak'jitaxon t'a junjun uj yet' pax silab' tz'ak'jitaxon t'a junjun k'u yet' ixim harina yet' wino tz'ak'jitaxoni, icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová. Ha juntzanh chi' aton ofrenda snhusji, te suk'uq'ui sjab' syab' Jehová.
D'a slajunhil k'ual yoch yuquil uj chi', tze molb'anpax he b'a yuj eyoch ejmelal, tzex och t'a tzek'ojk'olal t'a jun k'u chi', malaj junok makan munlajel tze k'ulej.

Tze nhusantz'a juntzanh silab' suk'uq'ui sjab' syab' Jehová, jun nok' quelem wakax, jun nok' ch'ak kalnel yet' ukwanh nok' kelemtak kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal. Masanil juntzanh nok' nok' chi' malajokab' jab'ok spaltail nok'.
Tzeyak'anpax ixim harina te wach', kalab'il yet' akeite yet'ok, lajchawe' libra ixim yet' jun nok' wakax chi', wajxaque' libra ixim yet' jun nok' ch'ak kalnel chi',
chanhe' libra ixim yet' junjun nok' kelemtak kalnel chi'.
Tzeyak'anpax junok nok' mam chiwa silab'il yuj yak'ji tup he mul. Tzeyak'anpax silab' tz'ak'ji t'a sk'ual yak'ji tup mul yet' pax silab' tz'ak'jitaxon t'a junjun k'u, ixim harina yet' pax wino.
Anheja' t'a 15 k'ual yoch yuquil uj tze molb'ej he b'a eyoch ejmelal. Ha t'a jun k'u chi', malaj junok makan munlajel tze k'ulej. Uque' k'ual tzeyak'och q'uinh yuj eyik'anchaanh Jehová.

Ha t'a junjun k'ual q'uinh chi' tze nhusantz'a juntzanh nok' nok' t'a silab'il, te suk'uq'ui sjab' syab' Jehová: Chawanh nok' ch'ak kalnel yet' 14-ok nok' kelemtak kalnel junjun ab'il sk'inal. Masanil juntzanh nok' nok' chi' malajokab' jab'ok spaltail nok'. Yed' pax ixim harina kalab'il yet' akeite tz'ak'ji ofrendail: Vajxaque' libra ixim yet' junjun nok' ch'ak kalnel chi', chanhe' libra ixim yet' junjun nok' kelemtak kalnel chi'. Tzeyak'anpax junok nok' mam chiwa silab'il yuj yak'ji tup he mul yet' pax silab' tz'ak'jitaxon t'a junjun k'u yet' pax ixim harina yet' wino tz'ak'jitaxon yet'ok t'a ofrendail. Ha yet' juntzanh nok' nok' chi', tzeyak'pax 13-ok nok' kelemtak wakax t'a b'ab'el k'u, 12-ok nok' t'a schab'il k'ual, 11-ok nok' t'a yoxil k'ual, 10-ok nok' t'a schanhil k'ual, b'alunhwanhok nok' t'a yoil k'ual, wajxakwanhok nok' t'a swaquil k'ual, ukwanhok nok' t'a yuquil k'ual. Ha yet' junjun nok' kelemtak wakax chi' tz'ak'ji lajchaweok libra ixim harina wach', kalab'il yet' akeite. Stz'a juntzanh nok' chi' silab'il, te suk'uq'ui sjab' syab' Jehová.
Axo t'a swajxaquil k'ual, tze molb'anoch he b'a eyoch ejmelal. Malaj munlajel tze k'ulej t'a jun k'ual chi'.

Tze nhusantz'a junok nok' quelem wakax silab'il te suk'uq'ui sjab' syab' Jehová yet' junok nok' ch'ak kalnel yet' ukwanhok nok' kelemtak kalnel junjun ab'il sk'inal. Masanil juntzanh nok' nok' chi' malajokab' spaltail nok'.
Anhejtona' tzeyak'anpax ixim harina ofrendail yet' wino yet' nok' wakax chi', nok' ch'ak kalnel chi' yet' pax nok' kelemtak kalnel chi' icha yalan ley.
Tzeyak'an junok nok' mam chiwa silab'il yuj yak'ji tup he mul yet' pax silab' tz'ak'jitaxon t'a junjun k'u yet' ixim harina yet' wino tz'ak'jitaxon yet'ok t'a ofrendail.

Aton juntzanh silab' tik yowalil tzeyak' t'a Jehová t'a juntzanh q'uinh to chequel yaj sk'ual. Ha yet' juntzanh tik syal eyak'anpax ofrenda to ix eyak' he ti' eyak'ani, ma junok ofrenda tonhej tz'el t'a he k'ol eyak'ani. Syal eyak'an silab' to stz'ai, ixim harina, ma wino t'a ofrendail, ma silab' yik junk'olal.
Icha wal chi' ix aj yalan winhaj Moisés t'a heb' israel masanil tas ix yal Jehová t'a winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Moisés t'a heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun yinhtilal Israel icha tik:
Ix yal Jehová tato ay junok winh winak syak' sti' yak'an junok tas t'a Jehová, mato syak' sti' t'a junok tas ol sk'ulej, yowalil sk'anab'ajej sk'ulan tas ix yal chi'. Max yal sk'exan tas ix yal chi'.
Tato a junok ix kob'es aytoek' yet' smam, syak' sti' yak'an junok tas t'a Jehová, mato syak' sti' t'a junok tas manh ol sk'ulej,
tato malaj tas syal winh smam ix chi' ayik syab'an winh to ay sti' ix ix yak'a', yowalil sk'anab'ajej ix sk'ulan b'aj ix yak' sti' chi'.

Palta tato ha' winh smam ix chi' tz'ak'an yowalil ayik syab'an winh to ay sti' ix ix yak'a', tato icha chi', manhxo yowalilok sk'ulej ix b'aj ix yak' sti' chi'. Maxtzac ak'jilaj pural ix yuj Jehová b'aj ix yak' sti' chi'.
Tato ay junok ix ix syak' sti' t'a Jehová wach'chom ix cham wal snaani, ma jun elanhchamel ix yal ix to sk'ulej junok tasi, slajwi yak'an sti' ix chi' tz'och yetb'eyum ix,
tato ayik syab'an winh yetb'eyum ix b'aj ix yak' sti' chi', malajnhej tas syal winh yuj, yowalil sk'anab'ajej ix b'aj ix yak' sti' chi'.
Palta tato ayik syab'an winh yetb'eyum ix chi' jun, malaj snib'ej winh, manh yowalilok sk'anab'ajej ix b'aj ix yak' sti' chi', max ak'jipaxlaj pural ix yuj Jehová sk'anab'ajani.
Tato a heb' ix chamnak yetb'eyum, ma heb' ix spuknak sb'a yet' yetb'eyum syak' sti' t'a junok tas t'a Jehová, yowalil sk'anab'ajej heb' ix.
Tato a junok ix ix ay yetb'eyum syak' sti' sk'ulan junok tasi, mato syak' sti' t'a junok tas manh ol sk'ulej,
tato ayik syab'an winh yetb'eyum ix chi', malajnhej tas syal winh, a ix chi' yowalil sk'anab'ajej ix b'aj ix yak' sti' chi'.
Palta tato ayik syab'an winh yetb'eyum ix chi', tato malaj snib'ej winh, manh yowalilok sk'anab'ajej ix sk'ulan b'aj ix yak' sti' chi'. Max ak'jilaj pural ix yuj Jehová sk'ulani.
Ha winh etb'eyumab'il chi', syal yalan winh tato syal sk'anab'ajan ix b'aj ix yak' sti' chi' mato maay.
Tato ayxo jun chab'ok k'ual yab'an jun chi' winh, malajnhejpax tas syal winh, yowalil sk'anab'ajej ix sk'ulan b'aj ix yak' sti' chi'.
Tato ayik toxo ix ek' tiempo, ichato chi' syalan winh to max sk'anab'ajej ix, haxo t'a yib'anh winh skan smul ix b'aj maj sk'anab'ajej sti' ix syak' chi', xchi Jehová, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Aton juntzanh ley ix yal Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yuj tas wal tz'aj winh winak yet' ix yetb'eyum, ma heb' winh mamab'il yet' heb' ix yisil kob'esto aytoek' yet'ok, tato syak' sti' heb' ix t'a Jehová.
Ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés, ix yalan icha tik:
Al t'a heb' etisraelal to spak sb'a heb' t'a heb' aj Madián, slajwi chi' ol ach chamok, xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Moisés chi' t'a heb' yetchonhab' chi' icha tik: --Hak'ek lista he b'a jaywanhok ex t'a owal, tze satanel heb' aj Madián yuj spaktzitaj schukal heb' t'a Jehová.
Junjun inhtilal, mil winak syak'b'at t'a owal, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix sik'jiel mil heb' soldado t'a junjun inhtilal. Ay 12 mil heb' t'a smasanil, yet'nakxok'e syamk'ab' junjun heb' yik owal.

Ichaton chi' ix aj schekjib'at heb' t'a owal yuj winhaj Moisés. Ix b'atpax winhaj Finees, yuninal winhaj sakerdote Eleazar yet' heb'. Ha winh ed'jinak juntzanh yamk'ab' to yik Dios yaji yet' k'een trompeta spuji yik tz'och heb' yak' owal.
Ix yak'an owal heb' yet' heb' madianita icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'. Ix smilancham masanil heb' winh winak heb'.
D'a skal heb' ix cham chi', ix cham winhaj Ewi, winhaj Requem, winhaj Zur, winhaj Hur yet' winhaj Reba, aton owanh heb' winh yajal t'a Madián. Ix champax winhaj Balaam yuninal winhaj Beor.
Ix ik'jikot masanil heb' ix ix aj Madián preso yuj heb' israel yet' masanil heb' skotak unin heb', nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' yet' masanil tastak ay t'a heb'.
Ix nhusjitz'a schonhab' heb' yet' skampamento heb' yuj heb' israel chi'.
Masanil ix yik'ek' heb' soldadoal israel chi', heb' anima yet' masanil nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb',

ix yik'kot heb', ix yak'an heb' t'a winhaj Moisés, t'a winhaj sakerdote Eleazar yet' pax t'a heb' yetchonhab' heb'. Ha t'a yak'likal Moab t'a sti' ha' Jordán t'a yichanh Jericó ayek' skampamento heb'.
Ix elta winhaj Moisés, winhaj sakerdote Eleazar yet' masanil heb' yichamtak winaquil chonhab' scha heb' t'a spatiquel kampamento chi'.
Palta haxo winhaj Moisés ix kot yowal winh t'a heb' ayoch yajalil t'a junjun mil yet' t'a junjun kien heb' soldado ix meltzaj t'a owal chi'.
Ix yalan winh t'a heb' icha tik: --¿Tas yuj maj he milcham juntzanh heb' ix ix tik?

Ha yuj tas ix yal winhaj Balaam, a wal heb' ix ix tik ix ik'anb'at heb' quetisraelal t'a ajmulal. Ix och smul heb' t'a Jehová yuj yoch heb' ejmelal t'a komon Dios Baal t'a Peor. Yuj chi' tzijtum heb' ix cham yuj jun ilya.
Ha tiknaik milekcham masanil heb' winak unin yet' masanil heb' ix ix to ayxo winak ix ek' t'a spatik.
Axo heb' ix kob'estak mantalaj winak tzek' t'a spatik, manh he milcham heb' ix, kanokab' heb' ix eyed'ok.

E masanil mach ex ix he milcham anima, ma ix eyam junok chamnak, kananhek uqueok k'ual t'a spatiquel kampamento. Ha ex tik yet' heb' preso yaj eyuuj, yowalil tze b'iquel he b'ha t'a schab'jial yet' t'a swak'jial.
Tze juk'anel he pichul yet' masanil tastak b'ob'il t'a nok' tz'uum, ma t'a xil nok' chiwa yet' t'a te te', xchi winh t'a heb'.
Ix yalan winhaj sakerdote Eleazar t'a masanil heb' ix xid'ek' t'a owal chi' icha tik: --Aton jun ley ix yak' Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés tik:

Ha masanil tastak to max tz'a yuj k'ak', icha k'een oro, k'een plata, k'een bronke, k'een hierro, k'een estaño, ma k'een plomo, yowalil tzek' t'a kal k'ak', slajwi chi' tze b'ikanel t'a ha ha' sakb'itan tastak tz'och wikok. Ha pax tastak to stz'ab'at jun, anhej yet' ha ha' chi' tze sakb'itej.
Axo t'a swak'jial, yowalil tze juk'el he pichul, icha chi' tz'aj he sakb'ikaneli. Ichato chi' syal eyoch t'a yol kampamento, xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés, xchi winhaj Eleazar chi'.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Ha winhaj sakerdote Eleazar yet' heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun makanhil heb' chonhab', ol och heb' ed'ok yik tze b'is heb' anima yet' masanil nok' nok' ix yik'kot heb' t'a chonhab' Madián.
Cha makan tzeyutej. Tze pojanek' junok makan t'a skal heb' soldado ix xid'ek' t'a owal chi', haxo junxo makan, spojchajek' t'a skal heb' anima.
Ha t'a junjun makan syik' heb' soldado chi', junjun wik tzeyik'el t'a junjun 500 anima, t'a junjun 500 nok' nok', wach'chom nok' wakax, nok' b'uru, nok' kalnel ma nok' chiwa.
Ha t'a winhaj sakerdote Eleazar tzak' juntzanh chi' icha ofrenda t'ayin.

Ha t'a nanhalxo yik heb' anima chi', junjun tzeyik'el t'a junjun 50 heb' anima yet' t'a junjun 50 nok' nok', wach'chom nok' wakax, nok' b'uru, nok' kalnel, ma nok' chiwa ma yet' yalnhej tas molb'etzal nok'. Tzeyak' juntzanh nok' nok' chi' t'a heb' lewita aton heb' yilumal in kajnub', xchi t'a winh.
Ix sk'anab'ajej winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj sakerdote Eleazar icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová chi'.
Aton slistail masanil tastak ix yik'kot heb' soldado tik, ch'ok pax tastak ix yik' junjun heb': 675 mil nok' kalnel, 72 mil nok' wakax, 61 mil nok' b'uru yet' 32 mil heb' ix kob'estak.
Yuj chi' nanhal wal juntzanh chi' ix yik' heb' soldado. 337 mil 500 nok' kalnel ix yik' heb'.
Ha t'a juntzanh nok' chi', 675 nok' ix yak' heb' t'a Jehová.
Ha t'a 36 mil nok' wakax yik heb' soldado, ix ak'ji 72 nok' t'a Jehová.
Ha t'a 30 mil 500 nok' b'uru yik heb' soldado, ix ak'ji 61 nok' t'a Jehová.
Ha t'a heb' ix 16 mil kob'estak yik heb' soldado, ix ak'ji 32 heb' ix t'a Jehová.
Masanil juntzanh chi' ix yak' winhaj Moisés t'a winhaj sakerdote Eleazar, aton tas to yiktaxon Jehová yaji, icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová.
Icha wal sb'isul ix yik' heb' soldado chi', icha chi' ix yak' winhaj Moisés t'a heb' anima chi': 337 mil 500 nok' kalnel, 36 mil nok' wakax, 30 mil 500 nok' b'uru yet' 16 mil heb' ix kob'estak.

Ha t'a nanhalxo chi', junjun ix yik'el winhaj Moisés t'a junjun 50. Lajannhej ix yutejpax heb' anima winh yet' nok' nok'. Ix yak'an winh t'a heb' lewita smunlaj t'a skajnub' Jehová, icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová chi'.
Axo heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun mil yet' t'a junjun kien heb' soldado chi', ix b'at heb' yal t'a winhaj Moisés.
Ix yalan heb' icha tik: Ha onh tik ix ko b'is heb' soldado ayoch t'a yol ko k'ab', malaj junok heb' ix satb'ati, tz'akannhej heb'.

Yed'nak masanil k'een oro ix ilchaj yuj heb', k'een brazaletes, pulseras, kolk'ab', uchiquin yet' juntzanhxo k'een k'een wach' yilji. Ha juntzanh tik skak' t'a Jehová, yujto ix kolwaj qued'ok, yuj chi' ix onh meltzaj ko masanil, xchi heb'.
Ix schaan masanil k'een oro chi' winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Eleazar t'a heb', aton masanil k'een oro ayoch yelwanub'ok sniwanil heb'.
Masanil k'een oro ix yak' heb' yajal chi', oxe' quintal yet' 68 libra yalil k'een.
Junjun soldado aynhej jab'jab'ok tastak ix yik'a', aton tastak ix yik' heb' t'a heb' ajk'ol chi'.

Axo winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Eleazar chi' ix chaan k'een oro ix yik'kot heb' yajal soldado chi'. Ix yik'anb'at k'een heb' winh t'a skajnub' Jehová b'aj sch'ox sb'a, yik wach' snachajkot heb' israel yuj Jehová chi'.
Ha heb' yinhtilal Rubén yet' heb' yik Gad manhxo jantakok nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'. Ayic ix yilan heb' to a lum skuchan Jazer yet' Galaad, te wach' lum yik smolji nok' nok',
ix b'at heb' yil winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj sakerdote Eleazar yet' pax heb' yajalil chonhab'. Ix yalan heb' icha tik t'a heb':

--Ilec wal lum makb'il yuj juntzanh chonhab' tik: Aton Atarot, Dibón, Jazer, Nimra, Hesbón, Eleale, Sebam, Nebo yet' Beón, te wach' swa masanil nok' molb'etzal nok' t'a juntzanh lum lum tik. Yuj skolwal Jehová ix quik'kanek' lu'um yik tz'ochkan lum quikok a onh israel onh tik. Eyojtakpaxi to ay juntzanh nok' nok' tik molb'il kuuj.
Yuj chi' tato wach' tze na'a, aq'ek juntzanh lum tik t'ayonh, yik max onh ek'kan t'a sk'axepal ha' Jordán, xchi heb'.
Ix yalan winhaj Moisés chi' t'a heb': --¿Tom he gana tzex kan t'a tik yakb'an sb'at heb' quetchonhab' t'a owal?
¿Tas yuj tzeyak' chab'axk'e sk'ol heb' quetchonhab' yik max ek' heb' t'a jun lum yalnak Jehová to ol yak' t'a heb'?
Icha wal tik yutej sb'a heb' ko mam quicham ayik in chekanb'at heb' yil lu'um ayik ayonhek' t'a Cades-barnea.
k'och heb' yil jun lu'um chi' masanto t'a sch'olanil ha' Escol. Slajwi chi' yak'an chab'axk'e sk'ol heb' quetisraelal heb' yik max och heb' t'a lum yak'nak sti' Jehová yak'an t'ayonh.
Yuj wal chi' kot yowal sk'ol Jehová t'a jun k'u chi', yuj chi' yak' sti' to

a heb' anima 20 ab'il sk'inal sb'eynhejb'ati ayik yelnakkot heb' t'a Egipto, manh ol yil-laj lum heb', lum yak'nak sti' yak'an t'a heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Abraham, winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Jacob, yujto manh smasanilok sk'ol heb' och tzak'an yuj tas yala'.
Anhej winhaj Caleb yuninal winhaj Jefone yinhtilal winhaj Cenaz yet' winhaj Josué yuninal winhaj Nun, ol och t'a lu'um, aton heb' winh k'anab'ajan t'a smasanil sk'ool tas yal Jehová chi'.
Cot yowal Jehová chi' t'ayonh, yuj chi' 40 ab'il onh ek' t'a tzinan lum yuj, masanto ix satel masanil heb' maj k'anab'ajani, manhxo junok heb' ix kani.
Ha exxo tik, ex yinhtilal anima pit, he gana tze b'eyb'alej sb'eyb'al heb' ko mam quicham chi' yik tze tzuntzanxikot yowal sk'ol Jehová t'a quib'anh.
Tato malaj he gana tzex och tzak'an yuj Jehová chi', ol ex yaktejkan t'a jun tzinan lu'um tik yet' masanil jun chonhab' tik. Eyuuj wal ol onh satelok, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.

Yuj chi', ix snitzanb'at sb'a heb' t'a stz'ey winhaj Moisés chi', ix yalan heb' icha tik: --Ha wal tas ko gana, to sko b'ok'e smakte' nok' ko kalnel yet' nok' ko wakax t'a tik yet' chonhab' yik heb' ix quetb'eyum yet' kuninal.

Ha onhxo tik ol kak' lista ko b'ha t'a owal. Ol onh b'ab'laj t'a yichanh heb' quetchonhab' tik masanto ol yal quik'anb'at heb' t'a lum lum chi'. Axo heb' ix quetb'eyum yet' heb' kuninal ol kan heb' t'a chonhab' ayoch smuroal tik t'a junk'olal, yik wach' malaj tas tz'utaj heb' yuj heb' anima kajan t'a juntzanh chonhab' tik.
Masanto ol yal skan heb' quetchonhab' tik t'a sat sluum ichato chi' ol onh meltzajxikot t'a ko pat tik.
Yujto a lum ay t'a jun k'axep tik quik tz'ajkan lu'um, aton t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u tik, yuj chi' ha t'a sk'axepalek' ha' Jordán chi' manh ol ko chalaj lum ko lu'um chi' a onh tik, xchi heb'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Moisés chi' t'a heb': --Syal eyik'ankan lu'um tato tz'elk'och icha wal tas tzeyal chi', ol eyak'nhej owal icha syal Jehová.
Tato he masanil a ex tik eyed'nak eyamk'ab' yik owal ol ex ek' t'ha ha' Jordán icha syal Jehová chi', tzex kannhej ta' masanto syal yel heb' ajk'ol chi' eyuuj.

Ayic toxo ix eyik'kanek' lum lum chi' yuj Jehová, ayik toxo pax ix ak'ji ganar heb' anima ta', ichato chi' ol ex meltzajok. Icha chi' ol aj he k'anab'ajan b'aj tzeyak' he ti' t'a Jehová yet' t'a heb' eyetchonhab' tik.
Palta tato max he k'ulej icha chi' jun, a wal ta' ol eyila' to ix och he mul t'a Jehová, ol k'och sk'ual ol yak'anoch yaelal t'a eyib'anh yuj he mul chi'.
B'oekk'e he chonhab' yuj heb' ix eyetb'eyum yet' heb' eyuninal, tze b'oan smakte' nok' he kalnel chi', tze k'anab'ajan masanil tas tzeyal chi', xchi winhaj Moisés chi' t'a heb'.
Ix tak'wi heb' yinhtilalkan Rubén yet' heb' yinhtilalkan Gad icha tik: --Ha onh a chekab' onh tik, ol ko k'anab'ajej masanil tas ix al chi'.
Ha heb' ix quetb'eyum yet' heb' ko kotak unin yet' masanil nok' ko molb'etzal nok', ol kan t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a Galaad tik.
Ha onhxo tik jun, ol onh b'at t'a owal b'aj ol yal sk'ol Jehová, icha wal alan chi', xchi heb'.
Ix yalan winhaj Moisés t'a winhaj sat sakerdote Eleazar yet' t'a winhaj Josué yuninal winhaj Nun yet' t'a masanil heb' yajalil chonhab' t'a junjun makan yinhtilal Israel icha tik:

--Tato masanil heb' winak t'a yinhtilal Gad yet' t'a yik Rubén lista yaj yak'an owal, ol ek' heb' eyed'ok t'a yol ha' Jordán icha yalan Jehová, masanto ol eyik' lum lum chi', ichato chi' tzeyak'an lum Galaad tik smakb'enok heb'.
Tato max b'at heb' t'a owal chi' eyed'ok jun, ha t'a lum Canaán chi' ol yik' smakb'en heb' eyed'ok, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix tak'wixi heb' yinhtilalkan Gad yet' heb' yik Rubén chi' icha tik: --Ol ko k'ulejnhej masanil tastak schek Jehová ko k'ulej.
Qued'nak ko yamk'ab' yik owal ol onh ek' t'a Canaán chi' icha syal Jehová, palta quik tz'ajkan lum lum t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u tik, xchi heb'.

Yuj chi' ha t'a heb' yinhtilalkan Gad yet' t'a heb' yik Rubén yet' t'a nanhalxo heb' yinhtilalkan Manasés yuninal winhaj José, ix yak' lu'um winhaj Moisés chi', aton lum yik winhaj Sehón sreyal heb' amorreo, lum yik winhaj Og sreyal Basán yet' jantak chonhab' makb'il yuj yet' jantak smakb'en ay t'a spatiktak.
Axo heb' yinhtilalkan Gad ix laj sb'oxik'e chonhab' Dibón heb' yet' Atarot, Aroer,
Atarot-sofán, Jazer, Jogbeha,
Bet-nimra yet' Bet-arán. Ix yak'anoch smuroal heb', ix sb'oanpax smakte' skalnel heb'.
Axo pax heb' yinhtilalkan Rubén, ix sb'oxik'e chonhab' Hesbón heb', Eleale, Quiriataim,
Nebo, Baal-meón yet' Sibma. Ix sk'exan sb'i juntzanh chonhab' ix sb'oxik'e heb' chi'.
Axo pax heb' yinhtilal Maquir yuninal Manasés, ix ik'anpaxkan lum ay t'a Galaad. Ix yak' ganar heb' spechanel heb' amorreo ta'.
Icha chi' ix aj yak'an lum Galaad winhaj Moisés t'a heb' yinhtilal Maquir, yuj chi' ix kajnaj heb' ta'.
Axo pax winhaj Jair yinhtilalkan Manasés, ix yak' ganar juntzanh skampamento heb' amorreo heb', ix yak'an skuch heb' Hawot-jair.
Axo jun winh skuchan Noba yet' juntzanhxo heb' ajun yet'ok, ix yak' ganar heb' aj Kenat heb' yet' juntzanhxo chonhab' ayoch t'a yol smakb'en. Ix yak'an winh skuch Noba.
Icha tik aj sb'eykot heb' israel, ayik yelta tzololok heb' t'a Egipto. Ha winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón kuchb'an heb'.
Icha tas ix yal Jehová, ix stz'ib'ejkan winhaj Moisés tastak sb'i juntzanh lugar b'ajtak ix laj sb'o skampamento heb', b'ajtak ix laj ek' heb'. Icha tik aj quelta, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.

Ha onh israel onh tik, onh elta t'a Ramesés t'a yol yik Egipto t'a 15 yoch b'ab'el uj t'a yol ab'il. Aton t'a jun ak'wal chi' sch'oxel Jehová to malaj yelk'och juntzanh sdiosal heb' aj Egipto chi', miljipaxcham masanil heb' sb'ab'el winak unin heb' yuj Jehová chi'. Yakb'an wan smukankan schamnak heb' chi', quelta t'a yichanh heb' smasanil. Te ayxo quip, te k'ak'xo ko k'ool.
Ayic quel t'a Ramesés chi', ko jawi t'a Sucot.
Quelxi t'a Sucot chi', ko jawi t'a Etam t'a stitak tzinan lu'um.
Co k'exb'eankot ko b'ha t'a Pi-hahirot ay t'a stojolal b'aj sja k'u t'a Baal-zefón, koch waan ta' t'a yichanh Migdol.
Quelxi t'a Pi-hahirot chi', ko k'axpajek' t'ha ha' mar, ko jawi t'a tzinan lu'um. Oxe' k'ual b'ey onh t'a taquinh lum yik Etam ko jawi t'a Mara.
Quelxi t'a Mara chi', ko jawi t'a Elim b'aj ay lajchawe' sjaj ha ha', ay pax 70 te' palma ta'. Ata' ochonh waan.
Quelxi t'a Elim chi', ko jawi t'a slak'anil ha' Chacchac Mar.
Quelxi t'ha ha' Chacchac Mar chi', ko jawi t'a tzinan lum Zin.

Ayic quel t'a tzinan lum Zin chi', quek'ta t'a Dofca, t'a Alús yet' t'a Refidim, b'aj malaj ha ha' kuk'ej. Quek'pax t'a tzinan lum Sinaí, t'a Quibrot-hataawa, t'a Hazerot, t'a Ritma, t'a Rimón-peres, t'a Limna, t'a Rissa, t'a Ceelata, t'a witz Sefer, t'a Harada, t'a Macelot, t'a Tahat, t'a Tara, t'a Mitca, t'a Hasmona, t'a Moserot, t'a Bene-jaakán, t'a Hor b'aj ay witzal Gidgad, t'a Jotbata, t'a Abrona, t'a Ezión-geber yet' t'a tzinan lum Zin aton Cades.
Quelxi t'a Cades chi' ko jawi t'a switzal Hor t'a smojonal Edom.

Ato ha' aj yalan Jehová, k'e winhaj sakerdote Aarón t'a jolom witz Hor chi'. Ata' chamnakkan winh. Cham winh t'a sb'ab'el k'u yik yoil uj ayik 40 ab'il schajiel yich sb'ischaj sk'ual yiktax quelnakta t'a Egipto.
Ay 123 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Aarón chi' ayik schamnak winh.
Ha winh sreyal kananeo aj Arad kajan t'a Neguev t'a yol yik Canaán, yab'nak wal spekal winh tas ajnak ko jawi t'a jun lugar chi'.
Quelxi t'a witzal Hor chi', quek' t'a Zalmona, t'a Punón, t'a Obot yet' t'a Ije-abarim t'a smojonal yik Moab.
Quelxi t'a Dibón-gad, quek' t'a Almón-diblataim yet' t'a switzaltak yik Abarim, t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a Nebo.
Quelxi t'a switzaltak yik Abarim chi', ko jawi t'a yak'likal Moab t'a sti' ha' Jordán t'a yichanh Jericó.
Ha ko kampamento t'a sti' ha' Jordán chi' b'atnhej t'a Bet-jesimot masanto t'a Abel-sitim, t'a yak'likal Moab chi'.
Ha t'a yak'likal Moab t'a sti' ha' Jordán, t'a yichanh Jericó, ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés, ix yalan icha tik:
Al juntzanh tik t'a heb' etchonhab': Ha wal ol ex ek' t'ha ha' Jordán ayik ol ex och t'a lum Canaán chi',

tze pechel masanil heb' anima kajan t'a juntzanh nakión chi'. Tze mak'anpoj masanil juntzanh yechel b'ob'il yuj heb', b'aj syal sb'a, aton k'een komon k'een tzeyb'il yuj heb', ma k'een k'een b'ob'il t'a yol molde. Tze mak'anpoj juntzanh tas ay t'a juntzanh lugar chaanh b'aj tz'och heb' ejmelal.
Ayic ol eyak'an ganar juntzanh nakión chi', tze b'oanem kajan he b'a ta', yujto a in swak' t'ayex yik tzex kajnaj t'ay.

Palta yowalil t'a suerteal tz'aj he pojanek' lu'um, t'a skal junjun makan, jun yik junjun inhtilal. Ha junok makan niwan sb'isul, niwan lu'um tz'ak'ji t'ay. Axo pax junok quennhej sb'isul, quennhej pax lu'um tz'ak'ji t'ay. Junjun makan skan b'aj syal suerte.
Ayic ol ex kajnaj ta', tato manh ol he pechel masanil heb' anima kajan t'a lu'um chi', ol ex yixtej heb' icha junok k'alem sb'at t'a yol he sat, ma icha junok te' q'uiix sb'at t'a yol he b'ak'chil.
Ol jawok t'a eyib'anh wuuj tas d'inhantaxon sja t'a yib'anh heb', xchi Jehová chi' t'a winh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al juntzanh cheknab'il tik t'a heb' etisraelal. Toxo wal ol ex och t'a lum Canaán chi', eyik ol aj lu'um. Aton smojonal lu'um tik:
Ha smojonal lum t'a sur tzek' t'a tzinan lu'um Zin t'a stitak lum yik Edom. Schael yich t'a stojolal sur t'ha ha' mar Muerto.
Sk'enhej t'a sur chi' masanto t'a yich lum witz Acrabim, tzek'nhejk'och t'a Zin masanto sk'och t'a Cades-barnea. Slajwi chi', sb'atnhejpax t'a Hasar-adar, masanto sk'och t'a Asmón.
Sb'atxi t'a Asmón chi' masanto sk'och t'ha ha' eluma' yik Egipto, slajwikank'och t'ha ha' mar Mediterráneo.
Ha smojonal t'a stojolal b'aj sb'at k'u, aton ha' mar Mediterráneo chi'.
Axo smojonal t'a norte, schael t'ha ha' mar Mediterráneo chi' masanto sk'och t'a jolom witz Hor.
Tz'elxi t'a jolom witz Hor chi' masanto b'aj tz'ochk'och sb'eal chonhab' Hamat, masanto t'a Zedad.
Sb'at t'a Zedad chi', tzek' t'a Zifrón masanto sk'och t'a Hazar-enán.
Axo smojonal t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, schael t'a Hazar-enán masanto sk'och t'a Sefam.
Tz'elxi t'a Sefam chi', masanto sk'och t'a Ribla t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a Aín. Slajwi chi' tz'emnhej jun mojon chi' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'ha ha' nhajab' Cineret,
sb'atnhej t'ha ha' Jordán masanto sk'och t'ha ha' mar Muerto. Ha masanil juntzanh chi', aton smojonal lum he lu'um chi', xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb', xchi t'a winh.

Ix yal juntzanh cheknab'il tik winhaj Moisés t'a heb' israel: Aton jun lu'um tik ol he pojek' t'a he patik, aton lum ix yal Jehová to ol pojchajek' t'a skal heb' nanhal slajunhil eyinhtilal, yujto toxo ix schakan smakb'en nanhal yoxil inhtilal,

aton heb' yinhtilal Rubén yet' heb' yik Gad yet' nanhalxo heb' yik Manasés. Toxo ix scha lum yik heb', aton lum ay t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'ha ha' Jordán t'a yichanh Jericó, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Ha heb' ol pojanek' lum lum chi' t'a he kal, aton winh sakerdote Eleazar yet' winhaj Josué yuninal winhaj Nun.
Palta yowalil tzeyawtej junjunok heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun eyinhtilal ayik spojchajek' lu'um chi'.
Aton heb' winh tik yowalil ol awtajok: Ha t'a yinhtilal Judá, a winhaj Caleb yuninal winhaj Jefone.
Axo t'a yinhtilal Simeón, a winhaj Semuel yuninal winhaj Amiud.
Axo t'a yinhtilal Benjamín, a winhaj Elidad yuninal winhaj Quislón.
Axo t'a yinhtilal Dan, a winhaj Buqui yuninal winhaj Jogli, aton winh yajal yaji.
Axo t'a yinhtilal Manasés yuninal winhaj José, a winhaj Haniel yuninal winhaj Efod, aton winh yajal yaji.
Axo t'a yinhtilal Efraín yuninal pax winhaj José chi', a winhaj Kemuel yuninal winhaj Siftán, aton winh yajal yaji.
Axo t'a yinhtilal Zabulón, a winhaj Elizafán yuninal winhaj Parnac, aton winh yajal yaji.
Axo t'a yinhtilal Isacar, a winhaj Paltiel yuninal winhaj Azán, aton winh yajal yaji.
Axo t'a yinhtilal Aser, a winhaj Ahiud yuninal winhaj Selomi, aton winh yajal yaji.
Axo t'a yinhtilal Neftalí, a winhaj Pedael yuninal winhaj Amiud, aton winh yajal yaji, xchi t'a winh.
Aton juntzanh heb' winh tik ix schek Jehová spojek' lum Canaán t'a skal heb' yinhtilalkan Israel.
Ix lolonxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' t'a yak'likal Moab, t'a sti' ha' Jordán t'a yichanh Jericó, ix yalan icha tik:

Al t'a heb' etisraelal, ha t'a lum sluum heb' ol scha chi', ata' ol yak' jayeok chonhab' heb' t'a heb' lewita b'aj ol kajnajok yet' pax lum kolan t'a spatik yichanh junjun chonhab' chi' b'aj ol wa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' lewita chi'.
Ha t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi' ol kajnaj heb', haxo t'a spatik yichanh ol wa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.
Ha lum kolan t'a spatik yichanh juntzanh schonhab' heb' ol ak'jok chi', ayokab' 450 metro tz'el t'a spatiktak.
Masanil jun lum chi', ay 900 metro t'a junjun pak'anh, lajannhej tz'aj sat t'a schanhil pak'anh. Axo t'a snanhal yol sk'ol lu'um, ata' aykan junjun chonhab' chi'.
Ha t'a skal juntzanh chonhab' tz'ak'ji t'a heb' lewita chi', ayokab' waqueok chonhab' b'aj syal b'at skolan sb'a junok mach smak'ancham junok anima. Ch'ok pax tzeyak' 42-okxo chonhab' t'a heb'.
Ha t'a masanil, yowalil tz'ak'ji 48 chonhab' t'a heb' lewita chi' yet' slumal t'a spatiktak b'aj swa smolb'etzal nok' heb'.

Ha t'a lum smakb'en heb' yetisraelal heb' lewita chi', ata' tz'elta juntzanh chonhab' tz'ak'ji t'a heb'. Yuj chi' junjun inhtilal syak' jayeok juntzanh chonhab' chi'. Ha juntzanh eyinhtilal niwak sluum, tzijtum chonhab' syak' heb' t'a heb' lewita chi', haxo juntzanh eyinhtilal quennhej sluum, quennhej chonhab' syak' heb' t'a heb', xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al jun tik t'a heb' etisraelal: Ayic ol ex k'axpajek' t'ha ha' Jordán, ol ex och chonhab'il t'a sat lum Canaán chi'.
Ol he sik'el jayeok chonhab' b'aj ol yal skolan sb'a junok mach smak'ancham junok anima tato manh sk'anok sk'ool sk'ulani.
Ata' skol sb'a jun chi', wach'chom sayjiek' yuj junok mach ayto yuj sb'a yet' jun ix cham chi', max yal-laj schami, tato maxto k'anb'aj t'ay yuj heb' yajal yaj t'a chonhab' chi'.
Ha juntzanh chonhab' b'aj skol sb'a heb' chi', waque' chonhab'il ol yil sb'a:
Oxe' skan t'a sk'axepalek'ta ha' Jordán tik, oxe' pax skan t'a Canaán chi'.

Ha t'a waque' chonhab' chi', ata' skol sb'a heb' anima smak'ancham junok anima, aton heb' eyetisraelal yet' heb' manh eyetchonhab'ok ayek' kajan t'a he kal, ma heb' tonhej tzek' posado. Ata' skol sb'a heb' tato manh sk'anok sk'ol heb' smak'ancham anima chi' heb'.

Tato ay junok mach smak'an junok anima yet' junok k'een yamk'ab' yik owal, ma yet' junok yaxk'een, ma yet' junok te te', talaj scham jun anima chi' yuj, a jun smak'waj chi', mak'umcham anima toni, yowalil smak'jipax chamok.
Ha junok ayto yuj sb'a yet' winh ix cham chi', ha' smak'anpaxcham winh ix mak'ancham jun anima chi' ayik schalan sb'a yet'ok.
Q'uinalok ay junok mach tz'ekanb'at pok'naj junok anima yujto schichonoch sk'ol t'ay, ma syekanb'at junok tas t'a yib'anh yuj yajk'olal,

mato smak'a' yujto yajk'ol sb'a heb', haxo tz'aji scham jun anima chi', yowalil smak'jipaxcham jun ix mak'waj chi', yujto mak'umcham anima. Yuj chi' a junok ayto yuj sb'a yet' winh ix cham chi', a smak'anpaxcham jun mach smilwaj chi'.
Palta q'uinalok ay junok mach tz'ekan telwok junok anima, manh sk'anok sk'ool, tato malaj owal t'a skal heb', ma jun, syekanb'at junok tas t'a yib'anh,
anhejtona' tato maj yilpaxi, sjulanb'at junok k'een haxo t'a junok anima sk'och k'een, scham yuj, manh yajk'olok sb'a heb', manh yujok yak'an chukal t'ay yuj chi' icha chi' tz'aji.

Tato icha chi', sb'at skol sb'a jun anima chi' t'a junok chonhab' b'aj skol sb'a heb' anima chi'. Axo heb' anima b'aj snib'ej skol sb'a chi', a heb' tz'ik'anb'at b'aj ix och jun chamel chi'. Axo heb' anima kajan b'aj ix och chamel chi', a heb' sch'olb'itan jun ay smul chi' yet' jun ayto yuj sb'a yet' jun ix cham chi', icha yalan sleyal t'a yib'anh heb'.

Ha heb' yichamtak winaquil chonhab' b'aj ix b'at skol sb'a jun ix mak'ancham jun anima chi', a heb' skolan t'a yol sk'ab' winh ayto yuj sb'a yet' jun ix cham chi'. Axo heb' tz'ik'anxib'at t'a chonhab' b'aj ix xid'ek' skol sb'a chi'. Ha jun chi' skannhej ta' masanto scham winh sat sakerdote sik'b'iloch t'a jun pekti’ chi'.
Palta tato tz'el t'a spatiquel chonhab' b'aj ayek' skol sb'a chi',
tz'ilchajelta yuj jun mach ayto yuj sb'a yet' jun smak'nakcham chi', smak'jicham yuj jun tz'ilanelta chi', a jun smilwaj chi' max ochlaj smul.
Yuj chi' yowalil aynhejokab'ek' t'a yol chonhab' chi' masanto scham winh sat sakerdote, ichato chi' syal spax t'a schonhab'.
Ha juntzanh tik ley tz'ajkan t'a he kal yet' t'a skal heb' eyinhtilal, yalnhej b'ajtil ol ex kajnajok.
Tato ay chawanhok, ma oxwanhok testigo t'a spatik junok mach smak'ancham junok anima, a jun chi' ay sleyal schami. Tato junnhej testigo jun, max yal-laj schami.
Max yal-laj schaji k'een tumin tato toxo ix och t'a yib'anh junok mach to ix smak'cham junok anima, yowalil schami.
Max yal-laj schaji k'een tumin t'a junok smak'ancham junok anima yuj yel libre t'a chonhab' b'aj ayek' skol sb'a chi', yik spax t'a schonhab' ayik manto cham winh sat sakerdote.

Manh eyixtejb'at lum lum b'aj ol ex kajnaj chi' yuj schiq'uil anima smak'jichamok. Yuj chi' tato ay chik' tz'em t'a sat lu'um, malaj junok tas syal yak'an tupok, anhej to scham jun ix mak'ancham anima chi'.
Yuj chi', manh eyixtejb'at sat lum lum b'aj ol ex kajnaj chi', yujto a in Jehová in ayinek' t'a he kal a ex israel ex tik t'a sat lum lum chi', xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.

Ha heb' yichamtak winaquil yaj t'a heb' yinhtilalkan Galaad, aton heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Maquir yuninal winhaj Manasés, yuninalkan winhaj José, ix ja heb' t'a yichanh winhaj Moisés yet' heb' yajalil chonhab', ix yalan heb' icha tik:

--Ach mamin Moisés, a Jehová ix alani to ol a pojek' lum lum t'a ko kal a onh yinhtilal onh Israel tik ato syala' b'aj ol quik' junjun onh. Ix yalanpaxi to a jun makan lum d'inhan ol yik' winhaj Zelofehad winh kuk'tak chamnak, syal yak'ji lum t'a heb' ix yisil winh.

Palta q'uinalok a heb' ix chi' tz'ik'an heb' winh winak t'a junokxo inhtilal heb' quetisraelal, yuj chi' a lum chi' tzam el lum t'a yol smakb'en quinhtilal tik, axom yek' lum t'a yol smakb'en yinhtilal heb' winh syik' heb' ix chi'.
Slajwi chi', axom yik sk'och yab'ilal yoch q'uinh yik tz'el tastak t'a libre, tzam kanxonhej slum heb' ix chi' t'a yol smakb'en junxo inhtilal chi', tz'elkan lum t'a yol ko makb'en tik, xchi heb'.
Ix yalan winhaj Moisés t'a heb' icha ix aj yalan Jehová: --Ha heb' winh yinhtilalkan José, yel tas syal heb' winh.
Yuj chi' a heb' ix yisil winhaj Zelofehad syal yik'an heb' ix yalnhej mach b'aj skan snib'ej, anhej to junnhejokab' yinhtilal heb' winh yet' heb' ix.
Yujto a junjun makan lum ol yik'kan junjun yinhtilal heb' israel chi', max yal-laj yik'jiek' lum yuj junokxo inhtilal heb', palta yowalil junjun inhtilal yet' sluum ol yik'kani.

Tato ay junok ix ix yalxonhej tas inhtilal ay lum smakb'en ix aykani, yowalil to a junok winh winak anheja' yinhtilal ix chi' syik'a'. Icha chi' tz'aj yajek' junjun heb' t'a yol smakb'en ol schakan smam.
Max yal-laj sb'at slum junok inhtilal t'a junokxo inhtilal. Junjun yinhtilal heb' israel skannhej yet' smakb'en ol scha'a.

Yuj chi', a heb' ix yisil winhaj Zelofehad chi': Aton ix Maala, ix Tirsa, ix Hogla, ix Milca yet' ix Noa, ix sk'anab'ajej heb' ix sk'ulan icha ix yal Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'. Yuj chi' a heb' winh ayto yuj sb'a yet' smam heb' ix, a heb' winh ix yik' heb' ix,
aton heb' yinhtilalkan Manasés yuninal winhaj José. Icha chi' ix aj skannhej smakb'en heb' ix t'a yol smakb'en yinhtilal b'aj kotnak smam heb' ix chi'.
Aton wal juntzanh ley yet' cheknab'il tik ix yak'kan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yuj yalchaj t'a heb' israel, ayik ayek' heb' t'a yak'likal Moab, t'a sti' ha' Jordán t'a yichanh Jericó.

Ha juntzanh lolonel tik ix yal winhaj Moisés t'a heb' yetisraelal ayik ayek' heb' t'a yol yik Moab, t'a slak'anil jun chonhab' Zuf t'a tzinan lu'um t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'ha ha' Jordán, aton t'a lum Arabá, aton lum ay t'a yichanh ha' Chacchac Mar. Ayek' heb' t'a snanhal chonhab' Parán yet' juntzanhxo chonhab' tik, aton Tofel, Labán, Hazerot yet' Dizahab. Ayic toxo ix satjiel chawanh heb' rey yuj winhaj Moisés yet' heb' soldado Israel, aton winhaj Sehón sreyal heb' amorreo kajan t'a Hesbón yet' winhaj Og sreyal Basán kajan t'a Astarot yet' t'a Edrei, ata' yal winhaj Moisés chi' tas schek Jehová yal winh t'a heb'. Uxluche' k'ual stek'nab'il t'a lum witz Horeb, sb'at t'a switzal Seir masanto sk'och t'a Cades-barnea. Wach'chom icha chi', palta ha t'a b'ab'el k'u yik yuxluchil uj yik stz'akwi 40 ab'il yelta heb' t'a Egipto, aton ta' ix yal winhaj Moisés tas syalelk'och juntzanh cheknab'il yalnak Jehová t'a winh yuj heb' schonhab'. Ix yalan winh icha tik:
Ha Jehová ko Diosal lolonnak t'ayonh t'a lum witz Horeb, yalannak icha tik: Niwanxo tiempo eyajek' t'a yichtak jun witz tik.

Ha tiknaik, ixiquekxi, tzex b'atkan t'a lum switzal yik heb' amorreo yet' t'a masanil yol smakb'en heb' t'a Arabá, t'a tzalquixtak, t'a ch'olquixtak, t'a Neguev yet' t'a stitak ha' mar, t'a lum yik heb' Cananeo yet' t'a masanil yoltak yik Líbano masanto t'ha ha' niwan Éufrates,

yujto toxo ix wak' lum lum chi' t'a yol he k'ab'. Ochanhec kajan t'ay yujto wak'nak in ti' wak'an lum t'a heb' he mam eyicham, aton winhaj Abraham, winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Jacob yet' t'ayex yinhtilal ex heb', xchi Jehová t'ayonh.
Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi' walnak t'ayex: Manh ol yal-laj ex wilan in ch'okoj.
Tzijtum kuninal ix ak'ji yuj Jehová ko Diosal, yuj chi' a wal tiknaik, te niwan chonhab'xo onh aji, lajanxo ko b'isul icha k'een k'anal ay t'a satcha’anh to manh b'ischajb'enok.
Aokab' Jehová ko Diosal, sDiosal pax heb' ko mam quicham, a tz'ak'an q'uib' ko b'isul t'a smilalxo, ek'b'al t'a yichanh icha ko b'isul tiknaik. Yak'okab' wal swach'k'olal, icha wal ix aj yak'an sti'.
Yuj chi' max yal-laj wuj in ch'okoj ex wilani yet' in b'oanel masanil owal yet' chaklajb'ail ay t'a he kal.
Yuj chi', sik'equel heb' winh te ay sjelanil t'a skal junjun inhtilal, aton heb' aj pensar, heb' ojtakab'ilxo to syal yuj, a juntzanh heb' chi' ol wak'och eyajalilok, xin chi.
Axo he tak'wi: Scha ko k'ool masanil tas ix a na' chi', xe chi.

Icha chi' aj in sik'anel t'a skal junjun eyinhtilal heb' winh ay spensar, niwan yelk'ochi, wak'anoch yopisio heb' winh yoch eyajalilok: Ay heb' winh wak'och yajalil t'a mil anima, t'a kien, t'a kinkuenta yet' t'a lajunhwanh, slaj och heb' winh yajalil chi' t'a yinhtilal.

Anhejtona' wak'an juntzanh cheknab'il tik t'a heb' eyajalil chi': Tzeyila' tato ay owal ma telajb'ail sk'e waan t'a skal heb' quetchonhab', tato ay tas ay t'a skal chawanhok heb', mato ay tas ay t'a skal junok yet' junok ch'ok chonhab'il, wach'nhej tzeyutej he b'oan yaj t'a heb' t'a stojolal.

Ayic tze b'oan yaj t'a heb', malajokab' sk'exanhil heb' t'a yol he sat. Lajannhej tzeyutej t'a heb' emnaquiltak yet' t'a heb' niwak yelk'ochi. Mokab'a junok b'aj tzex xiwi, yujto a jun eyopisio chi', manh eyikok, yujto ak'b'il t'ayex yuj Dios. Tato ay wal tas te niwan yaj jun, tzeyik'kot t'ayin, a inxo ol in b'o yaj t'a heb', xin chi t'a heb'.
Ata' walnak masanil t'a heb' tastak yowalil sk'ulej heb'.

Ayic quel t'a lum witz Horeb, ko d'inhb'anb'at t'a tzalquixtak t'a yol yik heb' amorreo, yuj ko k'anab'ajan tas syal Jehová ko Diosal. Te ay smay eyila' ayik onh ek'nhej t'a jun niwan tzinan lum chi', masanto onh k'och t'a Cades-barnea.
Ata' wal t'ayex to toxo onh k'och t'a tzalquixtak t'a yol yik heb' amorreo, aton jun chi' ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayonh.
Ochanhec an, iq'ek ek' lu'um, kajnajanhek ta', icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'ayonh, aton ko Diosal yet' heb' ko mam quicham. Manh ex xiwok, mokab' chab'axk'e he k'ool, xin chi.

Ha exxo tik ul eyal t'ayin: Te wach' ama tato ay jaywanhok onh tzonh b'ab'laj b'ati yik tzonh b'at quil juntzanh chonhab' chi', tzonh paxta yik tzul kalani tas b'eal b'aj ol onh b'atok yet' tas chonhab'il b'aj ol onh ochok, xe chi.
Ha tas eyal chi', wach' wab'i. Yuj chi' in sik'el lajchawanh winak t'a he kal, junjun t'a junjun inhtilal.
Aton heb' chi' b'at t'a tzalquixtak, sk'och heb' t'a sch'olanil Escol, yek'chaj heb' t'a juntzanh lugar chi' smasanil.
Slajwi chi' yik'ankot heb' jab'ok sat tas awab'il t'a jun lu'um chi' t'ayonh. Ha yuj tas yal heb' chi', yuj chi' nachajel kuuj to te wach' lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayonh.
Ha exxo tik, maj yal he k'ol ex b'at t'a jun lu'um chi', palta to he tenek' tas yal Jehová ko Diosal.
Axo b'aj ayex ek' chi', ex och ijan eyalan icha tik: Ha Jehová malaj snib'ej t'ayonh, yuj chi' onh yik'elta t'a Egipto yujnhej onh yak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' amorreo, yik tzonh satanel heb'.

Axo tiknaik jun, ¿b'ajtil ol onh b'atok? Ha heb' quetchonhab' tz'alani to ata' ay heb' winh winak te tek'an, niwak winak, chaanh steel heb' winh t'a quichanh, niwak chonhab' juntzanh schonhab' heb', te chaanh yajoch smuroal spatiktak. Ix yilanpax juntzanh niwak winak yinhtilal winhaj Anac heb'. Ha yuj masanil juntzanh chi', junelnhej ix chab'axk'e ko k'ool, xe chi.
Ichato chi' in tak'wi: Manh ex xiw yuj juntzanh chi'.
Ha Jehová ko Diosal ol b'ab'laj t'a quichanh, ha' ol ak'an owal kuuj, icha wal tas ix aj quilan tas ix sk'ulej kuuj t'a Egipto,
yet' t'a tzinan lu'um. Yed' wal yipal onh yik'ankot t'a yoltak b'e t'a tzinan lum chi', masanto ix yal ko jawi t'a tik, icha wal junok mamab'il to sya'ilej yal yuninal, xin chi.
Palta a ex tik maj eyak'och Jehová ko Diosal t'a he k'ool.
Ha wal Jehová chi' b'ab'el t'a quichanh. Ha t'ak'walil syak' sakil k'inal t'ayonh icha junok k'ak', haxo t'a k'ualil, sch'oxpax yet' jun asun b'aj tzonh b'ati yet' b'aj tzonh och waan.
Ayic yab'an Jehová tas eyal chi', te kot yowal, yak'an sti' icha tik:
Malaj wal junok juntzanh winak te chuk spensar tik ol ilan lum lum wak'nak in ti' wak'an t'a he mam eyicham.
Anhej winhaj Caleb yuninal winhaj Jefone ol ilan lu'um, yuj chi' ha t'a winh yet' yinhtilal ol wak' lum xid' eyil chi', yujto ix sk'anab'ajej winh yet' smasanil sk'ol tas ix wala', xchi Jehová chi'.
Eyuj wal a ex tik, yuj chi' kotpax yowal Jehová t'ayin, yalan t'ayin icha tik: Manh ol ach ochpaxlaj t'a lu'um a ach tik.
Ha winhaj Josué yuninal winhaj Nun skolwaj ed'ok, a winh ol och a k'exulok. Yuj chi' iptzitej winh yujto a winh ol ak'an jun lu'um chi' t'a heb' etisraelal tik, xchi t'ayin. Yalanpax t'ayex icha tik:

Wach'chom a ex tik tzeyak'och t'a he k'ool to ol ochkan heb' eyuninal chekab'ok t'a heb' ajk'ool, palta a heb' eyuninal mantalaj spensar chi', ol och heb' t'a jun lu'um chi'. Ha in ol wak' lum smakb'enok heb'.
Yakb'an manto elk'ochlaj, meltzajanhek t'a tzinan lu'um, tzex b'atkan junelxo t'a b'e sk'och t'ha ha' Chacchac Mar, xchi Jehová chi' t'ayin.

Ha ex tik, eyal t'ayin icha tik: Ix och ko mul t'a Jehová ko Diosal, palta a tiknaik jun, koyek, kaq'ek quip icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová t'ayonh, xe chi. Eyik'anb'at eyamk'ab' yik owal, a he naani to sekojtak ol aj eyik'an lum tzalquixtak chi'.

Palta a Jehová alani to swal t'ayex: Manh eyak' owal, manh he tek'b'ej he b'ha t'a heb' ajk'ool, haxo talaj tz'aji tzex yak'an ganar heb', yujto manh ol in b'atlaj eyed'ok, xchi Jehová, xa chi, xchi t'ayin.
Vak' juntzanh chi' eyojtaquejeli, palta a ex tik maj he chalaj eyab'i. Axo aji, he tenek' tas yal Jehová chi', eyak'an icha he gana, k'e ex t'a tzalquixtak chi'.
Yuj chi' a heb' amorreo kajan ta', elta heb' t'ayex icha nok' nok'al chab', masanto yal ex yak'an ganar heb' t'a Seir, k'ochnhej heb' t'a Horma.
Axo yik ex meltzaj jun, och ex ijan eyok' t'a yichanh Jehová, palta majxo tak'woklaj t'ayex.
Yuj chi' te niwan tiempoal onh ek' t'a yol smakb'en Cades chi'.
Slajwi chi', ko b'at t'a tzinan lu'um, t'a b'e sk'och t'ha ha' Chacchac Mar, icha wal aj yalan Jehová t'ayin. Te niwan tiempoal onh ek' t'a tzalquixtak t'a yol yik Seir.
Slajwi chi', yalan Jehová t'ayin:
Te niwan tiempo ex ek' oyoyok t'a lum tzalquixtak tik. Ixiquecxi tiknaik t'a stojolal norte.

Al juntzanh cheknab'il tik t'a heb' etchonhab' to ha t'a yol yik heb' he k'ab' eyok ol ex ek'ok, aton heb' yinhtilal winhaj Esaú, heb' kajan t'a Seir. Ha heb' chi' ol xiw heb' t'ayex. Anhej jun, tze tanhwej wal he b'a,
mokab' eyak' owal yet' heb', yujto malaj jab'ok slum heb' ol wak' t'ayex, yujto masanil lum tzalquixtak t'a yol yik Seir chi', yiknhej lum heb' yinhtilal winhaj Esaú chi'. Ha in wak'nak lum t'a heb'.
Yuj chi' ol he man masanil tas ol he wa t'a heb', ol he tup ha ha' ol eyuk'ej, xchi t'ayin.

Ha Jehová ko Diosal chi' yak'nak wal swach'k'olal t'a quib'anh t'a masanil tas ko k'ulej. Ha t'a jun 40 ab'il tik, aynhejoch qued'ok, tzonh stanhwejnhej b'aj tzonh ek' t'a jun niwan tzinan lu'um tik. Malaj b'aj ix yak' palta tas t'ayonh yuj.

Icha chi' aj ko kotnhej t'a stitak sluum heb' ko k'ab' kok, aton heb' yinhtilal winhaj Esaú kajan t'a Seir. Onh kotkan t'a b'e tzek' t'a Arabá, skot t'a Elat yet' t'a Ezión-geber. Co meltzajpax t'a b'e tzek' t'a tzinan lum t'a yol yik Moab.

Axo yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Manh he tzuntzej heb' moabita, yinhtilal winhaj Lot. Manh eyak' owal yet' heb', yujto malaj jab'ok slum heb' t'a yol smakb'en ol wak' t'ayex. Ha in wak'nak masanil smakb'en winhaj Ar t'a heb', xchi t'ayin.
(Ata' kajan heb' emita t'a peka'. Te niwan chonhab' yaj heb', chaanh steel heb', lajan wal heb' icha heb' yinhtilal winhaj Anac.
Refaíta heb', icha heb' yinhtilal winhaj Anac chi', palta emita tz'aj yalan heb' moabita chi' t'a heb'.

Ha t'a masanil smakb'en Seir, ata' ek'nak kajan heb' horeo. Axo heb' yinhtilal winhaj Esaú pechannaquel heb', satanel heb', haxo heb' kajnajnak t'a slum heb' chi', icha ix ko k'ulej a onh israel onh tik t'a lum lum ix yak' Jehová t'ayonh.)
Axo aj jun, yalan Jehová: Ixiquec tiknaik, tzex ek' t'a yol ha' taquinh melem skuchan Zered, xchi, yuj chi' onh ek' ta'.

Atax t'a yik onh ek' t'a Cades-barnea, masanto pax t'a jun k'u onh ek'ta t'a yol ha' taquinh melem Zered chi', atax ta' ix ek' 38 ab'il, yuj chi' a masanil heb' winh quetchonhab' stiempo sb'at t'a owal ayik quelta t'a Egipto, toxo ix cham heb' icha ajnak yak'an sti' Jehová.
Ha yowal sk'ol Jehová chi' ix kot t'a yib'anh heb', yuj chi' ix cham heb' smasanil.
Ayic manhxalaj junok juntzanh heb' winh winak chi',
yalan Jehová t'ayin:
Ha tiknaik ek'anhekb'at t'a smojonal yik Moab t'a chonhab' Ar.

Palta ayik tze chalan he b'a yet' heb' amonita, heb' yinhtilal pax winhaj Lot, manh he tzuntzej heb', manh eyak' owal yet' heb', yujto malaj jab'ok he makb'en ol wak' ta', yujto wak'nakxo jun lu'um chi' smakb'enok heb', xchi t'ayin.
(Anhejtona', a jun lu'um chi' yik heb' refaíta t'a peka', yujto ek'nak kajan heb' ta', aton heb' skuchan zomzomeo yuj heb' amonita t'a peka'.

Ha jun chi', te niwan chonhab', tzijtum anima ay t'ay, te chaanh steel heb' icha heb' yinhtilal winhaj Anac. Ha Jehová ak'annak satel heb' yuj heb' amonita chi'. Ha heb' amonita chi' pechannaquel heb', skajnajnakkan heb' ta'.
Lajan wal ajnak icha ajnak heb' yinhtilal winhaj Esaú, ayik sk'ochnak heb' t'a lum Seir. Ha Jehová ak'annak satel heb' horeo, skannakxonhej heb' yinhtilal winhaj Esaú t'a slum heb' chi'.
Icha pax chi' ajnak heb' aweo ayek' kajan t'a slak'anil Gaza. Ha heb' chi' satnaquel heb' t'a junelnhej yuj heb' filisteo kotnak t'a Caftor. Icha chi' ajnak skajnajkan heb' filisteo chi' ta'.)

Yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ixiquec, tzex k'axpajek' t'ha ha' taquinh melem Arnón, ol wak'och heb' amorreo t'a yol he k'ab' yet' winhaj Sehón, kajan t'a Hesbón, aton winh sreyal heb'. Hak'ek owal yet' heb', tzeyik'anek' sluum heb'.
Ha wal tiknaik tz'el yich wak'anoch junjun chonhab' t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik t'a xiwk'olal t'ayex. Ayic ol yab'an he pekal heb', ol ib'xok'e heb', axonhej xiwelal ol och t'a heb', xchi Jehová chi'.
Ha t'a tzinan lu'um yik Cademot, ata' in chekkot juntzanh chekab' t'a winhaj Sehón, aton winh rey kajan t'a Hesbón, yik wach' syal juntzanh tik heb' t'a wach'ilal t'a winh:
Sco nib'ej tzonh ek' t'a yol a makb'en, anhej t'a yol niwan b'e ol onh ek'ok, malaj b'aj ol onh komon b'atkan t'a yol a chonhab' chi'.
Ol ko tup tas ol kab'lej yet' ha ha' ol kuk'ej. Anhej to sko k'an t'ayach to tzonh ek' t'a yol a makb'en chi',

masanto ol yal ko k'axpaj t'ha ha' Jordán, ol onh k'och t'a lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayonh, icha ix onh yutej schaan ek'ta heb' yinhtilal winhaj Esaú kajan t'a Seir yet' heb' moabita kajanpax t'a Ar, xin chikot t'a winh.

Palta a winhaj Sehón chi', maj yal-laj sk'ol winh onh scha ek'ta t'a yol smakb'en chi', yujto a Jehová ko Diosal ix ak'an sk'ulej winh yik malaj snib'ej winh, yik skan heb' t'a yol ko k'ab', icha chi' ix aji.
Yuj chi' yal Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ha wal t'a jun rato tik swak'och winhaj Sehón yet' smakb'en t'a yol he k'ab'. Ochanhec tiknaik t'a yol smakb'en tik, yik tz'ochkan eyikok, xchi t'ayin.
Ix elta winhaj Sehón chi' onh scha yet' masanil soldado, yik syak' owal heb' qued'ok t'a Jahaza.
Axo Jehová ko Diosal ix ak'anoch winh t'a yol ko k'ab'. Ix ko satanel winh yet' yuninal yet' masanil schonhab'.

Masanil junjun chonhab' t'a yol smakb'en winh ix ak'jioch t'a yol ko k'ab', ix ko satankanel t'a junelnhej. Ix ko milcham heb' smasanil yet' heb' ix ix yet' masanil unin. Manhxo junok pitzan ix kan kuuj.
Anhej juntzanh tastak ix quik'kani, aton masanil nok' nok' yet' juntzanh tas ix ilchaj kuuj t'a juntzanh chonhab' ix ko satel chi'.

Ix quiquej slum heb' chi' smasanil, skotnhej t'a Aroer ay t'a spanhanil stitak ha' Arnón masanto t'a Galaad yet' masanil juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a sch'olanil ha' Arnón chi'. Manhxalaj mach ix stek'b'ej sb'ha t'a quichanh, yujto a Jehová ko Diosal ix ak'anoch heb' t'a yol ko k'ab'.
Palta a onh tik, maj onh ochlaj t'a schonhab' heb' amonita ay t'a tzalquixtak, ma pax t'a sti' ha' Jaboc, icha wal ix yutej yalan Jehová t'ayonh.
Ixlajwi chi', ch'okxo junxo b'e ix quik'a', ix onh b'atkan t'a Basán, palta a winhaj Og, sreyal jun chonhab' chi', ix elta winh yet' smasanil soldado yak' owal qued'ok t'a Edrei.

Yuj chi', ix yalan Jehová t'ayin: Manh ex xiwok, yujto a jun winh chi' yet' soldado yet' schonhab' toxo ix wak'och t'a yol he k'ab' yik tze sataneli, icha ix eyutej winhaj Sehón sreyal heb' amorreo kajan t'a Hesbón, xchi t'ayin.
Icha chi' ix yutej Jehová ko Diosal yak'an winhaj Og chi' yet' schonhab' t'a yol ko k'ab'. Ix ko milancham heb' smasanil, manhxalaj junok pitzan ix kan kuuj.
Ix kak'anpax ganar masanil junjun chonhab' t'a yol smakb'en winh. Manhxa junok maj kak' ganar, syalelk'ochi, masanil yol yik Argob t'a yol smakb'en winhaj Og t'a Basán, 60 chonhab' chi' smasanil.
Masanil juntzanh chonhab' chi', te chaanh yajoch smuroal, spuertail yet' k'een k'een k'atanoch syamnub'alok spuertail chi'. Tzijtum pax chonhab' malaj smuroal ix ko sateli.
Masanil juntzanh chi' ix ko sateli, icha ix ko k'ulej yet' winhaj Sehón sreyal Hesbón. Yuj chi' ix ko satel masanil heb' winh winak yet' heb' ix ix yet' masanil heb' unin.
Axonhej nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' kajk'ol chi' yet' masanil tastak ay t'a heb' ix quik'kani.

Icha wal chi' ix aj yak'ji slum heb' amorreo t'a yol ko k'ab' t'a jun pekti’ chi', aton heb' kajan t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'ha ha' Jordán, sb'atnhej t'ha ha' taquinh melem Arnón, masanto sk'och t'a switzal Hermón.
(Ha jun witz chi' Sirión sb'i yuj heb' aj Sidón, haxo heb' amorreo, Senir sb'i yuj heb'.)
Masanil juntzanh chonhab' t'a yol smakb'en winhaj Og t'a Basán, ix kak' ganar, aton juntzanh chonhab' t'a lum panhan, masanil t'a yol yik Galaad yet' Basán, masanto t'a Salca yet' Edrei.

(Axonhej winhaj rey Og yinhtilal heb' anima chanh steel aykan t'a jun lugar chi'. Ha skaxail winh yik smuquil, nab'a k'een. Chanhe' wal metro steel, quenxonhej manh chab'ok metro sat, chequelto t'a chonhab' Rabá t'a yol yik heb' amonita.)

Ha lum lum ix ko makkan t'a jun pekti’ chi', ix wak' lum yikok heb' junjun chonhab'il t'a yinhtilalkan Rubén yet' t'a heb' yinhtilalkan Gad, aton lum skotnhej t'a Aroer, t'a stitak ha' taquinh melem Arnón, masanto sjawi t'a snanhal switzal lum Galaad.
Axo janik'xo lum Galaad chi' jun, masanil lum Basán, aton smakb'en winhaj Og t'a yalanhtaxo yet' pax lum Argob, ojtakab'il to slum heb' refaíta. Ha lum chi' ix wak' t'a nanhal yinhtilalkan Manasés.
(Ha winhaj Jair, yinhtilal Manasés chi' ix ik'ankan lum Argob, masanto t'a smojonal lum Gesur yet' Maaca. Ix yak'anoch sb'i winh t'a Basán chi', yuj chi' Hawot-Jair ix sb'iejnhejkani.)
Ha t'a winhaj Maquir ix wak' lum Galaad chi'.

Axo t'a yinhtilalkan Rubén yet' t'a yik Gad ix wak' lum ay t'a snanhal Galaad yet' ha' taquinh melem Arnón. Ha t'a snanhal yol ch'olan ay smojonal, masanto sk'och t'ha ha' taquinh melem Jaboc, aton t'a smojonal yik heb' amonita.

Ha smojonal b'aj tz'em k'u, aton ha' Jordán, sk'ochnhej t'ha ha' nhajab' Cineret, masanto sk'och t'ha ha' mar yik Arabá, aton ha' mar Muerto, aton t'a yich switzal Pisga, t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'ha ha' mar Muerto chi'.

Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', ix wak' juntzanh cheknab'il tik t'a heb' yinhtilalkan Rubén, t'a heb' yik Gad yet' t'a nanhalxo heb' yinhtilalkan Manasés. Ix walan icha tik: Ha Jehová ko Diosal ix ak'an jun lu'um tik he makb'enok. Axo masanil heb' winh winak syal yak'an owal t'a he kal, b'ab'lajokab' heb' winh t'a yichanh heb' quetisraelal tik.
Axonhej heb' ix eyetb'eyum yet' heb' eyuninal skan t'a he chonhab' ix wak' chi' yet' nok' he molb'etzal nok'. Vojtak to tzijtum nok' nok' molb'il eyuuj.

Colwajanhec yet' heb' quetisraelal, masanto ol yik'kan lum lum heb' ol yak' Jehová, aton t'a sk'axepalek' ha' Jordán tik. Aton wal yik ol yak'an sjunk'olal Jehová t'a heb', icha ix yutej yak'an t'ayex tik, ichato chi' ol yal he paxta t'a he lum ix wak' tik, xin chi t'a heb'.
Ha t'a winhaj Josué ix wak' jun cheknab'il tik: Ix quil wal tastak ix sk'ulej Jehová ko Diosal yet' chawanh rey tik. Icha chi' ol yutok t'a masanil heb' rey t'a yoltak smakb'en b'aj ol ach ek'nhej.
Manh ach xiwok, yujto a Jehová ko Diosal ol ak'an owal kuuj, xin chi t'a winh.
Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi' ix in tewi t'a Jehová, ix walan icha tik:

Mamin Jehová, a ach ix a chael yich a ch'oxani to te niwan elk'ochi, ix a ch'oxan a poder t'ayin a chekab' in tik. Malaj junokxo Dios t'a satcha’anh, ma t'a sat lu'um tik syal sk'ulan tastak satub'tak icha tza k'ulej tik.
Yuj chi' tzin tewi t'ayach to tzin a chaek' t'a junxo sk'axepalek' ha' Jordán, yujto tzin nib'ej swil jun tzalquixtak manhxo jantakok swach'il yet' switzaltak Líbano, xin chi.
Palta eyujnhej ix kot yowal Jehová chi' t'ayin. Maj schalaj yab' tas ix in k'an chi' t'ay, palta ix yal t'ayin icha tik: k'okb'ilxo chi', manhxo al jun lolonel chi' t'ayin.
Anhej tzach k'e t'a jolom witz Pisga, scham wal ilankanb'at lum t'a norte, t'a sur, b'aj sjawi k'u yet' b'aj tz'em k'u, yujto manhxo ol ach k'axpajek' t'ha ha' Jordán chi'.
Yuj chi' tza k'ayb'ej wal winhaj Josué sik'lab'il, yujto a winh ol kuchb'an in chonhab' tik. Ha winh ol pojanek' jun lum tzilkanb'at tik, xchi Jehová chi' t'ayin.
Icha chi' ix aj ko kan t'a ch'olan t'a yichanh Bet-peor.

Ha tiknaik jun, ex wetchonhab' Israel, ab'ek wal cheknab'il yet' b'eyb'al ol wal t'ayex, yik tze k'anab'ajej yet' he b'eyb'alani, yik wach' ol yal eyoch t'a sat lum lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayex, sDiosal pax heb' ko mam quicham. Ol ex kajnajkan ta'.
Manh ol eyak'och stz'akub' juntzanh lolonel ol wal tik t'ayex, ma ol eyik'eli, palta to ol he k'anab'ajej scheknab'il Jehová ko Diosal icha wal tz'aj walan tik t'ayex.
Eyilnac wal tas utajnak heb' ochnak ejmelal t'a jun Dios Baal yik Peor, wal t'a eyichanh satjinaquel heb' yuj Jehová.
Ha exxo pax tik ochnak ex tzak'an yuj Jehová, ina pitzan exto.
Scham wal eyab'ankani to a k'ayb'ub'al yet' cheknab'il yik Jehová ko Diosal swalkanel t'ayex, yik wach' ol he b'eyb'alej ayik ol he chaan lum lum chi' he makb'enok.

Scham wal he k'anab'ajan juntzanh cheknab'il tik, yik ol cheklajel t'a yichanh juntzanh nakión to te jelan ex. Ayic ol yab'an juntzanh cheknab'il tze k'anab'ajej tik heb', ol yalan heb' icha tik: Yelton wal te jelan jun chonhab' tik, niwan nakión ton wal, xcham heb'.
Malaj junokxo niwan nakión ayek' sdiosal yet'ok, icha wal yajek' Jehová ko Diosal t'a ko kal tik, skolwaj qued'ok ayik tzonh awaj t'ay.
Malaj junokxo nakión ay sk'ayb'ub'al yet' scheknab'il tojol yaj icha jun k'ayb'ub'al swalkanel t'ayex tik tiknaik.

Yuj chi', k'anab'ajejek, sik'ekkan t'a he pensar, yik wach' max b'at satk'olal eyuuj t'a tas ix eyila', manh eyik'el juntzanh tik t'a he pensar yakb'an pitzan ex, tzeyalkan t'a heb' eyuninal yet' t'a heb' eyi he chiquin.

Naeccot t'a yik jun k'u ayik ayonhek' t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal t'a lum witz Horeb, ayik yalannak t'ayin icha tik: Molb'ej heb' etchonhab' smasanil yik wach' ol wak' yojtaquejel in lolonel heb', ol sk'ayb'ankan heb', yik wach' ay welk'och t'a yol sat heb' yakb'an pitzan heb' t'a sat lum tik yet' sk'ayb'ankan yuninal heb', xchi Jehová chi' t'ayin.
Ayic ayonhek' t'a yich lum witz chi', haxo t'a lu'um sk'e wal k'ak' yet' sk'e topan stab'il t'a chaanh, k'ik'xonhej yilji satcha’anh yuj.
Lolonnac Jehová t'ayonh t'a kal k'ak' chi'. Kab'nak wal yoch sjaj sloloni, palta maj quilochlaj jab'ok.
Ayic yalannakkan strato qued'ok, yalnak to sko k'anab'ajej lajunhe' cheknab'il stz'ib'ejnakoch t'a chab' pachanh k'een k'een.
Yalannacpax Jehová t'ayin to tzex in k'ayb'ej t'a scheknab'il yet' t'a sk'ayb'ub'al chi', yik wach' tze k'anab'ajej he b'eyb'alan t'a sat lum lum ol he makb'enej t'a sk'axepalek' ha' Jordán chi'.
Ayic slolonnak Jehová t'ayonh t'a lum witz Horeb chi', ha t'a jun k'u chi', malaj junok tas eyil t'a kal k'ak' chi'.
Naec wal koti yik max eyixtejb'at he b'a he b'oank'e junok yechel tas he diosalok, yechel junok winak, ma yechel junok ix ix,
ma yechel nok' nok' ay t'a sat lu'um tik, ma yechel nok' much,
ma yechel junok nok' tzek' nhererok, ma tzek' jachjon t'a sat lu'um tik, ma yechel nok' chay, ma junokxo nok' ay t'a yol ha ha'.

Anhejtona' ayik tzex k'e k'elan t'a satcha’anh tzeyilank'e k'u, k'een uj yet' jantak k'een k'anal yet' masanil tastak ay t'a satchanh chi', tzeyil wal he b'a, yik max och t'a he pensar to tzex och ejmelal t'ay, ma tzeyalan he b'a t'ay, yujto a Jehová Dios ixb’o’an masanil juntzanh chi' yik tz'och yopisio t'a masanil chonhab' ay t'a sat lu'um tik.

Palta a Jehová onh ik'annaquelta t'a chonhab' Egipto b'aj manh jantakok syaelal b'aj ayonh ochi, ichato ayonh och t'a skal junok niwan k'ak' b'aj tz'ulax k'een k'een. Onh yik'elta yik wach' tzonh och schonhab'ok, ichaton kaj tiknaik.
Cotnac yowal Jehová chi' t'ayin eyuuj. Yalannac to manhxo ol in ek' t'a sk'axepal ha' Jordán, manhxo ol in k'och t'a sat lum lum manh jantakok swach'il ol yak' he makb'enok chi'.
Yuj chi', ha t'a tik ol in chamok, manhxo ol in k'axpajek'laj t'ha ha' Jordán chi'. Ha exxo tik, ol ex k'axpajek'ok, ol ex kajnaj t'a lum lum manh jantakok swach'il chi'.
B'at ta wal strato Jehová ko Diosal satk'olal eyuuj, aton strato ix yak' qued'ok. Malajokab' junok yechel tze b'o'o, yik tzeyaloch he diosalok, yujto ay yowalil yuj Jehová.
Scot yowal Jehová t'a mach tz'och ejmelal t'a junokxo tasi. Ha wal yowal sk'ol lajan icha te' k'ak' stz'ab'at masanil tastak yuj.

Ha tiknaik toxo ol ex k'och kajan t'a jun lu'um chi', palta ayik niwanxo tiempo ayex ek' ta', ayik ayxo eyuninal yet' eyi he chiquin, tzeyil wal he b'a, xe yixtejtab'atlaj he b'a tze b'oank'e junok yechel he diosalok, tzeyak'anoch he mul t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal. Tato icha chi', ol he tzuntzejkot yowal sk'ool ko Diosal chi'.

Swak'kanoch satcha’anh yet' sat lu'um tik testigoal, tato icha chi' ol he k'ulej, t'a wal elanhchamel ol ex satel t'a junelnhej. Manhxo niwanok tiempo ol ex ek' t'a sat lu'um chi', aton lum ay t'a sk'axepal ha' Jordán chi'.
Axo jaywanhok ex olto ex kanok, ol ex saklemkanb'at t'a juntzanhxo ch'ok nakional, ata' ol ex yak'kanb'at Jehová.

Ata' ol eyak'em he b'ha t'a juntzanh komon Dios b'ob'il yuj heb' anima t'a te te' yet' t'a k'een k'een, max yal-laj yilani, max yab'laj, max yal-laj swaan junok tasi, max yab'paxlaj jab'ok sjab' junok tas.
Palta tato t'a skal eyaelal chi' sna sb'a he k'ool, tze naankoti to anhej t'a Jehová ko Diosal smoj eyak'anem he b'a, tato tzeyalxi he b'a t'ay, tze k'anab'ajan t'a smasanil he k'ool, tato icha chi',
manh ol ex yaktejkanlaj. Manh ol ex satjiel yuj t'a junelnhej, manh ol b'at satk'olal strato yak'nak yet' heb' ko mam quicham, yujto aynhej yok'elk'olal.

Naeccot juntzanh tiempoal ek'nakb'at t'a peka', atax sb'oannak heb' anima ko Mam Dios t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, b'at he k'anb'an b'aj sk'och k'aman yol yib'anhk’inal tik, tato ayxo b'aj ix uji, ma ayxo b'aj ix ab'chaj junok tas te niwan yelk'och icha jun tzuji t'a ko kal tik.
Malaj junokxo chonhab' ix ab'an yoch sjaj ko Mam Dios, yik slolonelta t'a kal k'ak', icha wal aj kab'an a onh tik, palta maj onh champaxlaj.

Malaj junokxo Dios sik'anelta junok chonhab' t'a skal junokxo chonhab' icha wal ajnak onh yik'anelta Jehová t'a Egipto yuj ko wach'ilok. Quilnac wal ayik sch'oxan jantak spoder yak'an owal kuuj, sch'oxannak juntzanh tas satub'tak yilji yet' yaelal yet' xiwk'olal ayik onh yik'anelta t'a Egipto chi'.
Ha juntzanh chi' ch'oxji wal quila', yik skojtaquej wal eli to malaj junokxo Dios, anhejton wal Jehová.
Ato t'a satcha’anh kab'nak wal sloloni, onh sk'ayb'ani. Axo t'a sat lum tik, sch'oxnak niwak k'ak' t'ayonh, kab'annak wal slolonelta t'a kal k'ak' chi'.
Ha wal Jehová xajanannak heb' ko mam quicham, yuj chi' onh sik'nakkanel a onh yinhtil onh kan heb'. Slajwi chi' onh yik'anelta t'a Egipto, aynhej och qued'ok yet' wal spoder.
Van satanel juntzanh niwak chonhab' te ek'to yip t'ayonh yik squiquejkan slum heb' chi', icha wal wan yuji tiknaik.
Yuj chi', kanokab' t'a he pensar to anhej Jehová Dios yaj t'a satcha’anh yet' t'a sat lu'um tik, malaj junokxo.

Yuj chi' k'anab'ajejek sk'ayb'ub'al yet' scheknab'il swalkanel t'ayex t'a jun k'u tik, yik wach' ol aj yek' tiempo eyuuj yet' heb' eyinhtilal. Ol najatb'ok he k 'inal t'a sat lum lum ix yak' Jehová t'ayex t'a junelnhej, xchi winhaj Moisés t'a heb' chonhab' israel.
Ix sik'anel oxe' chonhab' winhaj Moisés t'a sk'axepalek' ha' Jordán t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u.
Ata' syal skolan sb'a junok mach smak'ancham junok yetanimail to manh sk'anok sk'ool, malaj b'aj syak' owal yet'ok t'a yalanhtaxo. Ha jun chi', syal skolan sb'ha t'a junjunok juntzanh chonhab' chi'.

Ha juntzanh chonhab' chi', aton Beser t'a yak'likal tzinan lu'um makb'il yuj heb' yinhtilalkan Rubén, Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad, makb'il yuj heb' yinhtilalkan Gad. Axo junxo, aton Golán, ay t'a yol yik Basán, makb'il yuj heb' yinhtilalkan Manasés.
(Aton wal juntzanh cheknab'il tik ix yal winhaj Moisés t'a heb' yetchonhab'. Ha jantak k'ayb'ub'al, kachnab'il yet' cheknab'il tik ix yal winh t'a heb' atax yelnakkot heb' t'a Egipto.

Ix yal juntzanh tik winh ayik aytoek' heb' t'a ak'lik t'a yichanh chonhab' Bet-peor, t'a slak'anil sti' ha' Jordán, t'a lum makb'il yuj winhaj Sehón sreyal heb' amorreo. Ha winhaj Sehón chi', ha t'a chonhab' Hesbón ek'nak winh. Ak'b'il ganar winh yuj winhaj Moisés chi' yet' heb' yetchonhab' ayik ayxo yelta heb' t'a Egipto.

Icha chi' ix aj skan heb' israel t'a lum smakb'en winhaj Sehón chi' yet' t'a lum makb'il yuj winhaj Og sreyal Basán t'a yalanhtaxo. Ha heb' tik sreyal heb' amorreo t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'ha ha' Jordán.
Ha lu'um chi' sb'atnhej lum t'a chonhab' Aroer t'a stitak ha' Arnón, masanto t'a niwan witz Sirión, anheja' skuchanpax Hermón.
Masanil smakb'en heb' chi', aton panhan ay t'a sti' ha' Jordán t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, masanto sk'och lum t'ha ha' mar Muerto, aton t'a yich lum witz Pisga.)

Ix smolb'an masanil heb' yetisraelal winhaj Moisés, ix yalan winh t'a heb': Ex wetchonhab', ab'ek wal tiknaik, ol walkan juntzanh kachnab'il yet' cheknab'il t'ayex, yik scham wal he k'ayb'ani yet' he b'eyb'alani.
Ha Jehová ko Diosal yak'nak jun strato qued'ok t'a lum witz skuchan Horeb.
Manhoknhej yet' heb' ko mam quicham yak'nak strato chi', palta yak'nakpax qued'ok ko masanil a onh molan onh ek' tik.
Ha wal Jehová lolonnak t'ayonh t'a jolom witz chi', kab'nak wal tas yal chi' ayik slolonelta t'a kal k'ak'.
Ha in kan in t'a he nanhal yet' Jehová chi' yik swal t'ayex tas syala', yujto ex xiwk'e t'a jun k'ak' chi', maj ex k'e t'a jolom witz chi', yalan Jehová chi' icha tik:
Ha in Jehová he Diosal in, ex wik'elta t'a Egipto b'aj ayex och chekab'ok, manh eyikok he b'a.
Malajokab' junokxo Dios b'aj tzex och ejmelal, palta anhejokab' t'ayin.
Malajokab' junok yechel junok tas tze b'ooch he diosalok, tas ay t'a satcha’anh, tas ay t'a sat lum tik, ma tastak ay t'a yoltak ha ha'.

Manh ex em nhojan t'ay, manh eyak'em he b'a t'ay, yujto a in Jehová he Diosal in, ste kot wowal t'ayex tato tzex och ejmelal t'a junokxo tasi. Ol wak'och syaelal heb' mamab'il malaj welk'och t'ay, ol wak'anpax yaelal t'a yib'anh yuninal heb', yixchiquin heb' yet' yinhtilal heb'.
Axo heb' tzin xajanani, sk'anab'ajan in cheknab'il, ol in xajanej heb' yet' yinhtilal yik ol b'eynhejb'atok.
Manh komonok tze lok in b'i a in Jehová he Diosal in tik, ma tzeyak' b'inaj in b'i t'a junok tas t'a ichnhej ta', yujto ol wak' yaelal t'a mach icha chi' sk'ulej.
Niwanokab' yelk'och sk'ual ik'oj ip t'ayex yuj in eyik'anchaanh, icha ix aj walankan t'ayex.
Vaque' k'ual tzex munlaj t'a he munlajel.

Axo t'a yuquil k'ual, sk'ual ik'oj ip, wik yaji. Manh ex munlaj t'a jun k'u chi', ma heb' eyuninal, heb' ix eyisil, heb' winh he chekab', ma heb' ix he chekab', nok' he wakax, nok' he chej, ma junokxo nok' he molb'etzal nok', ma heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal, palta masanil heb' syik' yip eyed'ok.
Naeccoti to ek'naquex chekab'wumal t'a Egipto. Ha inxo Jehová he Diosal in tik wik'naquexelta yet' in poder. Yuj chi' swala' to tze k'anab'ajej sk'ual ik'oj ip.
Ayokab' yelk'och he mam he nun t'a he sat, icha wal ix aj walan t'ayex, yik wach' ol najatb'ok he k 'inal, yik wach' ol ex ajek' t'a sat lum lum ol wak' chi' t'ayex.
Manh he milcham heb' eyetanimail.
Manh ex em ajmulal t'a yol sk'ab' eyetb'eyum junjun ex.
Manh ex elk'anok.
Manh he nak'e lolonel t'a spatik heb' eyetanimail.

Manh he nib'ejoch ix yetb'eyum junokxo mach, spat, sluum, heb' winh schekab', heb' ix schekab', nok' swakax, nok' sb'uru, ma junokxo tas ay t'a heb' eyetanimail chi', manh he nib'ejochi, xchi Jehová t'ayonh.

Aton wal juntzanh cheknab'il tik te chaanh ajnak yalanelta Jehová t'a skal jun niwan k'ik'al asun ayoch sk'ak'al, ayik molan onh ek' ko masanil t'a yich lum witz chi'. Anhej wal juntzanh cheknab'il tik yalnak, ichato chi' stz'ib'anoch t'a chab' pachanh k'een k'een, yak'an t'ayin.

Palta a exxo tik, ayik eyab'an yoch jun jaj chi' t'a skal k’ik’ k’inal chi', eyilan sk'e nhilnhon k'ak' t'a lum witz chi', masanil ex yajal eyaj t'a junjun eyinhtilal tik yet' heb' yichamtak winaquil chonhab', ex jawi eyal t'ayin icha tik:

Val yel, a Jehová ko Diosal ix sch'ox wal stziquiquial yet' yipalil t'ayonh, ix kab' wal slolon t'a skal k'ak'. Ha tiknaik toxo ix nachaj wal el kuuj tob'an syal slolon Dios t'ayonh anima onh tik, palta ina maj onh chamlaj.
¿Tas yuj sko b'ek ko b'a ko cham yuj jun k'ak' to ayxo smay chi'? Tato ol kab' wal yoch sjaj Jehová ko Diosal junelxo, ol onh chamok.
Malaj wal junok anima syal yab'an yoch sjaj jun Dios pitzan t'a skal k'ak' icha ix kab' a onh tik, yujto ay schamelal.
