Yuj chi' ix yalan winh: Ha t'a yalanhtaxo, ix wik'el yiximal smam sk'ab' yet' yiximal smam yok 70 heb' winh rey, ix wak'an sik'k'e sk'ajiltak wael heb' winh t'a yalanh in mexa. Palta haxo tiknaik jun, lajan wal tzin yutej Dios icha wutejnak heb' winh chi', xchi winh. Ix yik'anb'at winh heb' israel chi' t'a Jerusalén, haxo ta' ix cham winh.
Ha heb' yinhtilal Judá ix och heb' yak' owal t'a chonhab' Jerusalén, ix yak'an ganar heb'. Ix xikancham masanil anima heb', ix snhusantz'a jun chonhab' chi' heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix laj empax heb' yak' owal yet' heb' kananeo, heb' kajan t'a tzalquixtak, t'a yol smakb'en Neguev yet' t'a ak'liktak.
Ix yak'anpax owal heb' yet' heb' kananeo t'a chonhab' Hebrón, aton Quiriat-arba t'a peka', ix miljikancham winhaj Sesai, winhaj Ahimán yet' winhaj Talmai yuj heb'.
Elanhchamel ix och heb' yak' owal t'a chonhab' Debir, aton Quiriat-sefer t'a peka'.

Ay jun winh yajal yaj t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Judá skuchan Caleb. Ix yal winh icha tik: Ha junok mach ol b'at yak' owal yet' heb' kajan t'a Quiriat-sefer, tato ol yak' ganar yik'an jun chonhab' chi', ol wak' ix Acsa ix wisil yetb'eyumok, xchi winh.
Axo winhaj Otoniel yuninal winhaj Cenaz slajwub' yuk'tak winhaj Caleb chi' ix ak'an ganar jun chonhab' chi', yuj chi' ix yak' ix yisil winhaj Caleb chi' yetb'eyumok winh.

Axo yik ix lajwi yik'lan sb'a heb' chi', ix yalan winhaj Otoniel chi' t'a ix Acsa chi' to sk'an sluum ix t'a winh smam chi'. Yuj chi' ix emta ix t'a yib'anh nok' b'uru, ix sk'anb'an winh smam ix chi' t'ay icha tik: --¿Tas tza nib'ej? xchi winh t'a ix.

Ix yalan ix: --Ina to ix ak' lum taquinh lu'um t'ayin t'a Neguev, yuj chi' elok wal t'a a k'ool tzak' lum yax sat t'ayin, lum b'aj ay sjaj ha ha', xchi ix. Yuj chi' ix yak' junokxo lum winh t'a ix, ay sjaj ha ha' t'a lu'um t'a sjolomtak yet' junokxo ha' t'a syoptak lu'um.

Ha heb' yinhtilal winhaj Hobab winh quenita, aton winh snhi' winhaj Moisés, ix el heb' t'a schonhab'il te' Palma, ix b'at heb' yet' heb' yinhtilal Judá, ix b'at kajnaj heb' t'a skal heb' anima kajan t'a tzinan lum t'a yol smakb'en Judá t'a Neguev, t'a slak'anil chonhab' Arad.
Axo heb' yinhtilal Judá yet' heb' yik Simeón, ix yak' owal heb' yet' heb' kananeo kajan t'a Sefat. Ix satel jun chonhab' chi' heb' t'a junelnhej, yuj chi' Horma ix sb'iejkan yuj heb'.
Ix yik'anpax chonhab' Gaza heb', Askalón yet' Ecrón yet' slumal t'a spatiktak.

Yujto ayoch Jehová yet' heb' yinhtilal Judá chi', yuj chi' ix yak' ganar heb' kajan t'a tzalquixtak heb', palta maj yal-laj spechanel heb' anima kajan t'a ak'liktak heb', yujto a heb' chi', ay sk'een karruaje heb' yik owal.
Ix ak'ji lum Hebrón t'a winhaj Caleb icha ajnak yalankan winhaj Moisés. Ha winhaj Caleb chi' ix ak'an ganar yik'anel oxwanh heb' yuninal winhaj Anac.
Axo pax heb' yinhtilal Benjamín jun, maj yal-laj yik'anel heb' jebuseo heb' t'a Jerusalén, yuj chi' junnhej ix kan kajan heb' yet' heb' t'a Jerusalén chi'.
Ha heb' yinhtilal José, ix yak' lista sb'a heb' sb'at yak' owal t'a chonhab' Betel, aton Luz t'a peka'. Ayic ix schekanb'at heb' ilum lum heb' ta', a Jehová ix kolwaj yet' heb'.

Ha heb' ilum lu'um chi', ix yil heb' yelta jun winh winak t'a chonhab' chi', ix yalan heb' t'a winh: Tato ol onh a ch'ox t'a tas ol aj koch t'a yol chonhab' tik, malaj tas ol ach kutej, xchi heb' t'a winh.

Axo jun winh chi' ix ch'oxani tas tz'aj yoch heb' t'a jun chonhab' chi'. Yuj chi' ix kot heb' soldado yinhtilal José, ix xikancham masanil heb' anima heb' ayek' kajan ta', palta a jun winh ix ch'oxan heb' chi', maj miljichamlaj winh yuj heb' yet' masanil heb' kajan yet' winh t'a yol spat.
Ha jun winh chi', ix b'atkan winh t'a slum heb' hitita, ix sb'oank'e jun chonhab' winh ta', Luz ix yak' winh sb'iej. Ix ochnhejkan jun b'i chi' t'a jun chonhab' chi'.

Ha heb' yinhtilal Manasés, maj yal-laj spechanel juntzanh anima tik heb': Eb' aj Bet-seán, heb' aj Taanac, heb' aj Dor, heb' aj Ibleam yet' heb' aj Meguido yet' pax yaldeail juntzanh chonhab' chi'. Yuj chi' ix kannhej kajan heb' kananeo chi' ta'.
Palta haxo yik ix yik'an yip heb' israel chi', ix yak'an pural heb' kananeo chi' heb' yochkan smunlajwumok. Maj pechjiel-laj heb' t'a junelnhej yuj heb'.
Anheja' pax heb' yinhtilal Efraín, maj spechel-laj heb' kananeo heb' kajan t'a Gezer, yuj chi' a heb' kananeo chi', ix kannhej kajan heb' t'a skal heb'.

Anheja' heb' yinhtilal Zabulón, maj spechel-laj heb' kananeo heb' kajan t'a Quitrón yet' t'a Nahalal. Yuj chi' ix kannhej kajan heb' kananeo chi' t'a skal heb', palta ix ak'ji pural heb' yochkan smunlajwumok heb' yinhtilal Zabulón chi'.

Anheja' heb' yinhtilal Aser, maj spechel-laj heb' kananeo heb' kajan t'a Aco, t'a Sidón, t'a Ahlab, t'a Aczib, t'a Helba, t'a Afec yet' t'a Rehob. Yuj chi' ix kannhej kajan heb' yinhtilal Aser chi' t'a skal heb' kananeo chi'.

Anheja' pax heb' yinhtilal Neftalí, maj spechel-laj heb' kananeo heb' kajan t'a Bet-semes yet' t'a Bet-anat, yuj chi' ix kannhej kajan heb' t'a skal heb' kananeo chi', palta ix ak'ji pural heb' kananeo chi' yochkan smunlajwumok heb'.
Ha heb' amorreo kajan t'a lum ak'liktak, maj chajiochlaj heb' yinhtilal Dan yuj heb', yuj chi' ix kannhej heb' yinhtilal Dan chi' t'a lum tzalquixtak.

Icha chi' ix aj skannhej kajan heb' amorreo chi' t'a yich witz Heres, t'a Ajalón yet' t'a Saalbim, palta haxo yik ix yik'an yip heb' yinhtilal José, ix yak' pural heb' amorreo chi' heb' yochkan smunlajwumok.
Ha smojonal slum heb' amorreo chi', sb'atnhej t'a spak'anil yik Acrabim, masanto sk'och t'a Sela, sb'atnhej t'a yib'anhk'e chi'.

Ha t'a Boquim ix sch'ox sb'a Yángel Jehová, ix kot t'a Gilgal, ix yalan t'a heb' chonhab' israel icha tik: Ha in ex wik'elta t'a Egipto, ex wik'ankot t'a sat lum lum wak'nak in ti' wak'an t'a heb' he mam eyicham. Valannac to malaj b'ak'uinh ol satel jun in trato wak' eyed' tik,

anhej to malajokab' he trato tze b'o yet' heb' anima kajan t'a sat lum lum b'aj kajan ex ek' tik, tze satanel yaltar heb' b'aj slesalwi, xin chi, palta a ex tik, maj he k'anab'ajej tas walnak chi'. ¿Tas yuj pit ix eyutej he b'a?

Yuj chi' swalkan t'ayex to manh ol wik'el-laj juntzanh chonhab' tik t'a he kal. Ol ochnhejkan heb' ajk'olal t'ayex, haxo sdiosal heb' ol ex juanelok, ichato ol ex kan t'a junok yaal, xchi Yángel Jehová chi'.
Ayic ix lajwi slolon Yángel Jehová chi', masanil heb' chonhab', te chaanh ix el yaw heb' yoq'ui,
yuj chi' Boquim ix sb'iejkan jun lugar chi'. Axo ta' ix yak' silab' heb' t'a Jehová.
Atax yik stak'lannakkan sb'a winhaj Josué yet' heb' chonhab' israel chi', ata' b'atnakkan junjun heb' t'a smakb'en chab'ilxo yuj.

Ha heb' israel chi', ix sk'anab'ajej heb' tas ix yal Jehová yakb'an aytoek' winhaj Josué chi' yet' heb' yichamtak winaquil chonhab' tzak'anto chamnak yuj winh, aton heb' ix ilan tastak satub'tak ix sb'o Jehová yuj swach'ilok heb' israel chi'.
Ayxo 110 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Josué schekab' Jehová, ayik ix cham winh.
Ha t'a sluum winh t'a Timnat-sera t'a snorteal switzal Gaas t'a tzalquixtak t'a yol yik Efraín, ata' ix mukji winh.
Ix champax heb' israel ix ek' yet' winhaj Josué chi', haxo heb' toto ix alji, manhxo yojtakok Jehová heb', maj yil-laj heb' tastak satub'tak sb'onak Jehová yuj swach'ilok heb'.
Yuj chi' axonhej chukal ix sk'ulej heb' t'a yichanh Jehová. Ix och heb' ejmelal t'a komon Dios skuchan Baal.

Ix spatiquejkanel Jehová heb', aton sDiosal smam yicham heb', jun ik'annaquelta heb' t'a Egipto. Ix och heb' ejmelal t'a sdiosal heb' anima kajan t'a slak'anil heb' chi'. Ix ste tzuntzejkot yowal sk'ol Jehová chi' heb',
yujto ix patikajkanel yuj heb', haxo t'a juntzanh komon Dios Baal yet' Astarot ix yak'em sb'a heb'.

Yuj chi' ix te kot yowal sk'ol Jehová t'a heb', ix ak'jioch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ool, ix elk'ajb'at tastak ay t'a heb', majxo yal-laj skolan sb'a heb' t'a heb' ajk'ol ay t'a slak'anil heb' chi'.
Ayic sb'at heb' israel chi' yak' owal yet' heb' ajk'ol chi', haxo Jehová tz'ak'anoch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' yajk'ol chi', icha ajnak yalani. Yuj chi' te ilb'ajk'ol tz'utaj heb'.
Juntaquel skan heb' israel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' yajk'ol chi', ste ixtaj wal heb' yuj heb', yuj chi' haxo Jehová tz'ak'anoch juntzanh heb' skolumal heb' yik skoljiel heb' t'a heb' ajk'ol chi'.

Wach'chom icha chi', palta manh wal jab'ok sk'anab'ajej heb' skolumal heb' chi', maxtzak sk'anab'ajej Jehová heb'. Anhej t'a komon Dios tz'och heb' ejmelal. Ha heb' smam yicham heb', sk'anab'ajejnak scheknab'il Jehová heb', haxo pax heb', ix yaktejkan sb'eyb'al heb' smam yicham heb' chi'.

Juntaquel tz'el yaw heb' yuj yab'an syail yuj heb' yajk'ool chi', haxo Jehová tz'ok' sk'ol t'a heb', syak'anoch juntzanh heb' skolwaj yet' heb'. Ayic pitzanto heb' skolumal heb' chi', ayoch Jehová yet' heb', skoljiel heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' yajk'ool chi'.

Ayic scham junjun heb' skolumal heb' chi', sk'ulanxi chukal heb', ek'b'alxo te chuk sk'ulej heb' chi' t'a yichanh sb'eyb'al heb' smam yicham, tz'ochpax heb' ejmelal t'a komon Dios. Max yaktejkan chukal b'eyb'al chi' heb', pit syutej sb'a heb' t'a Jehová.
Yuj chi' ste kot yowal sk'ol Jehová chi' t'a heb', snaan icha tik: Ha juntzanh anima tik, manh wal jab'ok sk'anab'ajej in trato heb', aton wak'nak yet' smam yicham heb'.
Ha yuj chi' jun, manhxo ol wik'el juntzanhxo heb' anima t'a skal heb', aton heb' ixto kan yuj winhaj Josué ayik ix cham winh.
Ol kannhej heb' yuj wak'an prowal spensar heb' israel tik, tato tz'och tzak'an heb' wuuj, icha sk'ulejnak heb' smam yicham heb', mato maay, xchi.
Yuj chi', a jantak heb' anima ayek' t'a skal heb' israel chi', aton heb' majxo yak'och Jehová t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Josué, majxo ik'jiel-laj heb' yuj Jehová chi'.
Ay juntzanhxo chonhab' ixto kan yuj Jehová t'a lum Canaán, yik wach' tz'ak'ji prowal heb' israel, aton heb' manto alji ayik ix och owal ayik ix ak'ji ganar lum Canaán chi'.
Ix kan juntzanh chonhab' chi' yuj Jehová yik wach' sk'ayb'ej sb'a heb' t'a owal, aton heb' manto ak'anlaj junelok owal chi'.

Oye' chonhab'il heb' filisteo ixto kani yet' masanil heb' kananeo, heb' sidonio yet' heb' heweo, aton heb' ek'nak kajan t'a tzalquixtak t'a Líbano, sb'atnhej t'a jolom witz Baal-hermón, masanto sk'och t'a Hamat.
Ha yuj juntzanh heb' chi', ix ak'ji prowal heb' israel yuj Jehová, yik wach' syila' tato sk'anab'ajej masanil cheknab'il heb' scheknak yal winhaj Moisés t'a heb' smam yicham heb'.
Icha chi' ix aj yek' kajan heb' israel t'a skal heb' kananeo, heb' hitita, heb' amorreo, heb' ferezeo, heb' heweo yet' t'a skal heb' jebuseo.
Axo yuninal yet' yisil heb' israel chi', ix yik'lajk'e sb'a heb' yet' yuninal yet' yisil heb' anima chi'. Ix och heb' ejmelal t'a sdiosal heb' chi'.
Te chuk tas sk'ulej heb' israel t'a yichanh Jehová Dios, ix b'atkan satk'olal yuj heb', axonhej t'a yechel Baal yet' t'a yechel Asera tz'och heb' ejmelal.
Yuj chi' ix kot yowal sk'ol Jehová chi' t'a heb', ix ak'jioch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Kusan-risataim, sreyal Mesopotamia. Vajxaque' ab'il ix kan heb' t'a yalanh smandar winh.

Ichato chi' ix awaj heb' t'a Jehová. Axo Jehová chi' ix och yet' winhaj Otoniel, yuj chi' a winh ix och yajalil yik skolanel heb'. Ha winhaj Otoniel chi' yuninal winhaj Cenaz, slajwub'alxo yuk'tak winhaj Caleb.
Ha Yespíritu Jehová ix och yet' winh, yuj chi' a winh ix och yajalok heb' israel chi'. Ix b'at winh t'a owal, haxo Jehová ix och yet' winh, yuj chi' ix yak' ganar winhaj Kusan-risataim chi' winh.
Ichato chi' ix kan heb' israel t'a junk'olal t'a 40 ab'il, masanto ix cham winhaj Otoniel chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix ochxi ijan heb' israel sk'ulan chukal t'a yichanh Jehová, yuj chi' haxo Jehová chi' ix ik'anchaanh winhaj Eglón sreyal Moab t'a yib'anh heb'.
Junnhej ix yutej spensar winhaj Eglón chi' yet' heb' amonita yet' pax heb' amalekita, ix och heb' yak' owal yet' heb' israel chi', ix yik'anek' schonhab'il te' Palma heb', aton Jericó.
Ha heb' israel chi', 18 ab'il ix kan heb' t'a yalanh smandar winhaj Eglón chi',

masanto ix awaj heb' t'a Jehová. Ichato chi' ix ak'jioch junxo skolumal heb' yuj Jehová chi', aton winhaj Aod yuninal winhaj Gera, t'a yinhtilal Benjamín, a sk'exank'ab' winh smunlaji. Ix schekb'at winhaj Aod chi' heb' israel chi' b'at yak'kan k'een tumin t'a winhaj Eglón, aton k'een yowalil syak' heb' t'a winh.
Ix sb'oan jun k'een skuchilub' winh, ayk'e ye k'een t'a schab'il pak'anh, nanhal am metro steel k'een. Ix stzek'anoch k'een winh t'a snanhal t'a swach' t'a yol spichul.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'anb'at k'een tumin chi' winh t'a winhaj Eglón chi'. Ha jun winh rey chi' te b'ak'uech yaj nayan winh.
Ayic toxo ix lajwi yak'ankan k'een tumin chi' winh, ix elta winh yet' heb' ajun yet'ok.

Palta ayik ix k'och winh b'aj ay juntzanh yechel komon Dios t'a slak'anil Gilgal, ix b'atxi winh t'a winhaj Eglón chi', ix yalan winh t'a winh icha tik: --Mamin rey, ay wal jun lolonel ol wal t'ayach, palta t'a k'ub'eltak ol wala', xchi winh. Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a smasanil heb' ayoch t'a yopisio yet'ok to sb'esel sb'a heb' yik skan heb' sch'okoj.

Yuj chi' axonhej heb' winh schawanhil ix kani, k'ojanem winh rey t'a yol jun kuarto siklab'inak yool t'a chaanh. Ix k'och winhaj Aod chi' t'a slak'anil winh, ix yalan winh t'a winh: --Ha tas wed'nak ol wal chi' t'ayach, ha Dios schekan wala', xchi winh. Ayic ix yab'an winhaj Eglón icha chi', ix k'e linhan winh,

ix yak'anb'at sk'exank'ab' winhaj Aod chi', yik syik'ank'eta k'een skuchilub' winh t'a stojolal swach' k'ab'. Ix stipank'axpaj k'een winh yet' yok k'een t'a sk'ol winhaj Eglón chi'. Yuj sb'ak'echal winhaj Eglón chi', ix kan ch'apnaj k'een b'aj ix och chi', yuj chi' majxo yik'eltalaj k'een winhaj Aod chi', ix elta usnaj yol sch'anhtza' winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix smakankan te' puerta chi' winh, ix yak'ankanoch sk'ab' te' winh, ix paxta winh.
Ayic toxo ix paxta winh, ix jawi heb' winh stanhwan winh rey chi', ix yilan heb' winh to makan te' puerta chi'. Ha snaan heb' winh to wan stzaji winh yuj chi' ix smak te' puerta chi' winh.

Junip ix stanhwej heb' winh, yujto max eltalaj winh rey chi', yuj chi' ix somchajk'e sk'ol heb' winh. Ix yik'ankot sllaweal puerta chi' heb' winh, ix sjakan heb' winh, haxo ix yilan heb' winh pak'jab'xo ek' winh scham t'a sat lu'um.
Yakb'an tzek' tiempo t'a heb' winh icha chi', haxo winhaj Aod toxo ix el lemnaj winh. Toxo ix ek'ta winh b'aj ay juntzanh yechel komon Dios t'a Gilgal, ix kot winh elelal t'a yol yik Seirat.
Axo ix jawi winh t'a tzalquixtak t'a yol yik Efraín, ix spu'an nok' ch'aak winh yik smolb'an heb' yetisraelal. Junxonhej ix aj yem heb' t'a jolom witz chi', b'ab'el winhaj Aod chi' yuj heb'.

Ix yalan winh t'a heb': Ochanhec tzak'an wuuj, yujto a heb' moabita ajk'ol t'ayonh, toxo ix ak'jioch heb' t'a yol ko k'ab' yuj Jehová, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix b'at heb' yet' winh, ix k'och heb' smak t'a sjayil sti' ha' Jordán b'aj tzek' heb' aj Moab chi', yuj chi' manhxa junok mach ix scha k'axpaj heb'.
Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', 10 mil heb' moabita chi' ix smilcham heb', aton juntzanh heb' soldado te tek'an, manhxo junok heb' ix eli.
Icha chi' ix aj yak'ji ganar heb' aj Moab yuj heb' israel chi'. Ixlajwi chi', 80 ab'il ix kan heb' israel chi' t'a junk'olal.

Axo ix lajwi yek' winhaj Aod chi', haxo winhaj Samgar yuninal winhaj Anat ix kolwaji. Ix smilcham 600 heb' filisteo winh yet' jun te te' stekjioch t'a nok' wakax, yuj chi' ix koljipax heb' israel chi' yuj winh.
Ayic ayxo scham winhaj Aod, ix meltzajxib'at heb' israel t'a chukal, yuj chi' ix stzuntzejxikot yowal sk'ol Jehová heb'.
Ix ak'jioch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Jabín, sreyal heb' kananeo kajan t'a chonhab' Hazor yuj Jehová chi'. Ha winh yajalil heb' soldado winh rey chi', aton winhaj Sísara, kajan t'a Haroset-goim.

Ay 900 skarruaje winhaj Jabín chi', ayoch k'een hierro t'a spatiktak. 20 ab'il ix kan heb' israel t'a yalanh smandar winh, ix te ixtaj heb' yuj winh. Yuj wal chi' ix tewi heb' t'a Jehová, yik skolwaj t'a heb'.
Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', ay jun ix ix schekab' Jehová skuchan Débora, yetb'eyum ix winhaj Lapidot, a ix sb'oan yaj yowal heb' yetisraelal.

Tz'emnhej k'ojan ix t'a yich jun te' palma t'a tzalquixtak t'a yol yik Efraín, t'a snanhal Ramá yet' Betel. Ata' xid'ek' heb' chonhab' chi' sb'o yaj yowal t'a ix. Yuj chi' ix ak'jikan skuch te' palma chi', Spalma ix Débora.

Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', ay jun winh winak skuchan Barac yuninal winhaj Abinoam kajan t'a Cedes, t'a yol yik heb' yinhtilal Neftalí. Ix awtaj winh yuj ix Débora chi', ix yalan ix t'a winh: --Ha Jehová ko Diosal tz'alan t'ayach icha tik: Molb'ej 10 milok heb' soldado t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Neftalí yet' t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Zabulón, tzik'anb'at heb' t'a lum switzal Tabor.

Ha in ol in montejkot winhaj Sísara, yajalil heb' soldado winhaj Jabín t'a sti' a Cisón, yik syak'an owal winh ed'ok. Ol yik'kot skarruaje winh yet' heb' soldado. Ha inxo ol wak'och heb' t'a yol a k'ab', xchi Jehová t'ayach, xchi ix Débora chi'.
Ix yalan winhaj Barac chi' icha tik: Ol in b'atok, tato tzach b'at wed'ok. Tato max ach b'at wed' jun, manh ol in b'atlaj, xchi winh t'a ix.

Ix tak'wi ix: Ol in b'atok, palta jun, manhok ach ol ach b'inaj yuj ak'an ganar jun owal chi', yujto t'a yol sk'ab' jun ix ix ol yak'och winhaj Sísara chi' Jehová, xchi ix. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at ix yet' winhaj Barac chi' t'a Cedes.
Ata' ix smolb'ej 10 mil heb' soldado winhaj Barac chi' t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Zabulón yet' t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Neftalí. Ix k'e heb' t'a switzal Tabor chi', ajun pax ix Débora chi' yet' heb'.

Ha t'a Cedes t'a slak'anil jun te' mach' t'a Zaanaim, ata' ay skampamento jun winh quenita skuchan Heber, yik'naquel sb'a winh t'a skal heb' yetchonhab', aton heb' yinhtilal winhaj Hobab snhi' winhaj Moisés t'a peka'.
Ayic ix yab'an winhaj Sísara to toxo ix k'ek'och winhaj Barac t'a switzal Tabor,
ix smolb'an 900 skarruaje winh, ayoch hierro t'ay. Ix smolb'anpax masanil heb' soldado winh. Ix el winh yet' heb' soldado chi' t'a Haroset-goim, ix k'och heb' t'a sti' ha' Cisón.

Ix yalan ix Débora t'a winhaj Barac chi' yet' heb' soldado icha tik: --Emanhec, b'ab'elxo Jehová eyuuj, ha' ol ak'anoch winhaj Sísara t'a yol he k'ab' tiknaik, xchi ix. Ix emta winhaj Barac yet' 10 mil heb' soldado t'a switzal Tabor chi'.

Ayic ix syamanoch owal winhaj Barac chi', a Jehová ix ak'an somchajb'at heb' soldado winhaj Sísara yet' heb' ed'jinak masanil skarruaje chi' yuj jun niwan xiwelal. Yuj chi' ix laj smilcham heb' winhaj Barac yet' heb' soldado chi'. Axo winhaj Sísara chi', ix emta winh t'a yol skarruaje, ix el lemnaj winh.

Ix och winhaj Barac yet' heb' soldado t'a spatik heb' soldado winhaj Sísara chi' yet' skarruaje heb', masanto ix k'och heb' t'a Haroset-goim. Ha t'a jun k'u chi', manhxo junok soldado winhaj Sísara ixto kani, ix cham heb' smasanil.

Ha winhaj Heber yet' heb' sk'ab' yok, wach' yak'an heb' yet' winhaj Jabín sreyal Hazor chi'. Yuj chi' ata' ix b'at winhaj Sísara chi' skol sb'a. Ix k'och winh t'a smantiado ix Jael yetb'eyum winhaj Heber chi'.

Ix elta ix scha winh, ix yalan ix t'a winh icha tik: --Ochanh mamin, manh ach xiwok, xchi ix. Ix och winhaj Sísara chi' t'a yol smantiado ix chi', ix yik'anelta jun sábana ix, ix slich'anb'at ix t'a yib'anh winh yik sk'ub'anel winh ix.
Ixlajwi chi', ix sk'anan ha' winh yuk' t'a ix, yujto wan stakji sti' winh. Elanhchamel ix yik'el smakul jun tz'uum ix b'aj sik'an lech, ix yak'an ix yuk'ej winh. Ix musajxi winh yuj ix.

Ix yalan winh t'a ix icha tik: --Cananh t'a sti' mantiado tik. Tato ay mach sjawi sk'anb'ej yab' t'ayach: ¿Malaj junok mach ix jawi skol sb'a t'ayach? ta xchi, tzalani to malaj mach, xchi winh t'a ix.

Ix sat k'ol winhaj Sísara chi' swayi, yujto ix te k'unb'i winh sb'eyi. Axo ix Jael chi' ix ik'ankot jun te' yestakail mantiado yet' jun te' mak'lab'. Te chamnak el winh swayi, k'ojank'olal ix k'och ix t'a stz'ey winh, ix smak'anb'at te' estaka chi' ix t'a yib'schiquin winh, ix k'axpaj em te', ix emk'och te' t'a yol lu'um. Icha chi' ix aj scham winhaj Sísara chi' yuj ix.

Ayic ix k'och winhaj Barac say winhaj Sísara chi', elanhchamel ix elta lemnaj ix scha winh, ix yalan ix: --Ochanh, ul ila' mach wan a sayan chi', xchi ix t'a winh. Axo ix ochk'och winhaj Barac t'a yol smantiado ix chi', ix yilan winh to chamnakxo winhaj Sísara chi', mak'b'ilb'at te' estaka chi' t'a sjolom winh.
Icha chi' ix aj yak'jioch winhaj Jabín sreyal heb' kananeo t'a yol sk'ab' heb' israel yuj Dios.
Ix ochnhej ijan heb' israel yak'an owal yet' winhaj Jabín yet' soldado, masanto ix satel heb' smasanil.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ix sb'itej jun b'it ix Débora yet' winhaj Barac yuninal winhaj Abinoam, ix yalan heb' icha tik:
Conh b'itanek ko masanil t'a Jehová, yujto t'a wal yel ay heb' yajalil israel stek'b'ej sb'ha t'a owal, ay pax soldado t'a ko chonhab' tik b'ekan sk'ol sb'at t'a owal chi'.
Ex rey, ab'ek tas ol kal t'ayex. Ex yajal, ab'ek ko b'itan t'a Jehová. To sko b'itej ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik.
Mamin Jehová, ayik ach el t'a Seir, yik ach kot ak' owal t'a Edom, ix te ib'xi wal lum lum, ix ak'anpaxkot nhab'.
Mamin Jehová ko Diosal, ix te ib'xik'e lum witz t'a ichanh, ix ib'xipaxk'e lum witzal Sinaí.
Ha t'a stiempoal winhaj Samgar yuninal winhaj Anat yet' t'a stiempoal ix Jael, manhxalaj mach sb'eyek' t'a niwak b'e, axonhej t'a k'ex b'e k'ub'eltak yeq'ui, ata' tzek' heb'.
Masanil munlajel najat ayeli, ix kan tzinan. Ato yik ix in k'e waan a in Débora in tik, ix in och nunab'ilal t'a chonhab'.

Ha wal ta' ix sayek' juntzanh komon Dios heb' quetchonhab', yik syak'em sb'a heb' t'ay. Yuj chi' ix jawi heb' tz'ak'an owal t'a spuertailtak ko chonhab'. Malaj smaklab'il jul-lab', malaj pax lanza ix ilchaj t'a skal 40 mil soldado quetisraelal.
Ha in pensar, icha wal to ajun yet' heb' yajalil in chonhab' yet' heb' chonhab' b'ekan sk'ol sb'at t'a owal chi'. Calec wach' lolonel t'a Jehová.
Ex niwak winak tzex k'e t'a yib'anh nok' saksak b'uru te wach' stz'aam ayk'ei, alek tas ix sk'ulej Jehová. Alecpax a ex tzex b'eyi.

Ha ex ayex ek' b'ajtak ay a uk'b'ila', najatokab' sb'at sjaj he son yet' he platillo yuj eyik'anchaanh Jehová, yujto toxo ix satjiel heb' kajk'ool yuj, yujto ix kolwajpax t'a heb' munlajwum ayik ix yak'an owal heb', ix yak'an ganar heb'. Ichato chi' ix yal ko meltzaj emta a onh schonhab' onh Jehová t'a ko chonhab'.
Ach Débora, kuchb'ej heb' anima t'a b'it. Ha achxo pax ach Barac yuninal winhaj Abinoam, ixik, a heb' ix yamchaj uuj t'a owal, ik'b'at heb'.
Ix emul heb' yajalil chonhab' yak' owal. Ix emul heb' soldado Jehová yak' owal yet' heb' soldado te tek'an.

Ix empaxul heb' yinhtilal Efraín, ix kot heb' b'aj ek'nak heb' amalekita. B'ab'el ix emul heb' yinhtilal Benjamín yuj heb'. Ix empaxul heb' yajalil heb' soldado t'a yinhtilal Maquir yet' heb' yajal pax yaj t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Zabulón.

Yed' pax heb' yajal yaj t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Isacar ix kolwaj heb' yet' ix Débora. Ix kolwajpax heb' yet' winhaj Barac. Yelk'olal te tzak'anoch heb' yuj winh ayik ix emk'och heb' t'a ch'olan. Palta ay chab'k'olal t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Rubén.
¿Tas yuj ix kan heb' b'aj makan nok' kalnel t'a yol smakte', syab'an heb' yawtaj nok' kalnel chi' yuj heb' stanhwumal? Val yel ha t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Rubén ay chab'k'olal.

Axo pax heb' aj Galaad, ix kan heb' t'a sk'axepalek' ha' Jordán. Axo heb' yinhtilal Dan, ix kan heb' t'a stz'ey b'aj ay te' barko, anheja' pax heb' yinhtilal Aser, ix kan heb' t'a sti' ha' mar, majxo el jab'ok heb' b'aj sjawi te' barko.
Axo heb' yinhtilal Zabulón yet' heb' yinhtilal Neftalí, ix sb'ekxonhej sb'a heb' scham t'a owal.
Ix jawi heb' winh sreyal heb' kananeo t'a Taanac, t'a slak'anil sti' ha' Meguido, ix jawi heb' yik syak'an owal heb' yalani, palta malaj k'een plata yet' b'eyumal ix yik' heb'.
Ato t'a satcha’anh b'aj sb'ey k'een k'anal, ato ta' ix kot tas ix ak'an owal yet' winhaj Sísara.
Ha ha' Cisón aytaxon t'a peka', ak'um owal ha', ha ha' ix kuchanb'at heb'. Kaq'ek quip ko b'atek t'a quichanh.
Ix k'anh wal yem yok nok' chej ayik ix b'at lemnaj nok' t'a owal.

Ix yalan Yángel Jehová: Cotokab' yowal sk'ol Jehová t'a yib'anh chonhab' Meroz yet' t'a yib'anh heb' kajan ta'. Kotokab'kan t'a yib'anh heb' yujto maj kolwaj heb' yet' Jehová, maj kolwaj heb' yak'an owal yet' heb' soldado te tek'an, xchi.
Te wach' yik ix Jael yetb'eyum winhaj Heber keneo t'a yichanh masanil heb' ix ix. Wach' yik ix t'a yichanh masanil heb' ix ix kajan t'a yoltak mantiado.
Ayic ix sk'anan ha' winhaj Sísara yuk'ej t'a ix, haxo lech te wach' ix yak' ix yuk'ej winh. Ha lech ix yak' ix yuk'ej winh t'a yol jun yet'tal te wach' yilji.
Ix yik'ank'e jun te' estaka ix t'a sk'exank'ab', ix yik'anpaxk'e jun te' mak'lab' ix t'a swach'k'ab'. Ix poj sb'aquil sjolom winh, ix smak'an k'axpaj te' ix t'a yib'schiquin winh.
Toxonhej ix ek' b'alb'on winh t'a yichanh ix yuj syail. Anheja' ta' ix chamkan winh.

Ha ix snun winhaj Sísara chi', ayik ix elta t'anhan ix t'a swentenail spat, te kusnak sk'ol ix. Ix yalan ix: ¿Tas yuj tzek' tiempo sjawi winh wune' yet' skarruaje? ¿Tas yuj maxto kab' sk'anh yok nok' schej winh stok'an skarruaje chi'? xchi ix.
Ha tas wan snaan ix snun winh chi', anheja' chi' ix yalpax juntzanh heb' ix ix te ay spensar ayek' yet' ix. Ix yalan heb' ix icha tik:

Tekan wan spukanek' heb' winh jantak tas ix yik'kanek' t'a owal chi'. Van am sik'lan junjunok heb' ix ix heb' winh yik syik'a', ma chatakwanhok heb' ix. Axo winhaj Sísara chi' yet' heb' soldado, wan am sik'lan k'apak pichul heb' te wach', k'apak te wach' yajoch yelwanub' t'a junjun pak'anh, yik wach' ol yak'och heb' t'a sjaj, yujto ix yak' ganar owal chi' heb', xchi heb' ix.

Mamin Jehová, ichokab' chi' tz'aj satel heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach. Axo heb' tzach xajanani, lajanokab' heb' icha skopopial yok k'u, xchi ix Débora yet' winhaj Barac t'a sb'it chi'. Ayic ix lajwikan jun owal chi', 40 ab'il manhxalaj owal.
Ixlajwi chi', ix scha k'ulanxi chukal heb' israel chi' t'a yichanh Jehová. Yuj chi' uque' ab'il ix ak'jioch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' madianita yuj.
Ix och wal heb' t'a syaelal yuj heb' madianita chi'. Ix laj say heb' b'ajtak sk'ub'ejel sb'ha t'a lum witz, t'a yoltak k'een nhak'een yet' b'aj max yal sk'och anima. Ata' ix laj kajnaj heb'.
Ayic q'uinhxo sat yawb'en heb' israel chi', haxo heb' madianita chi', heb' amalekita yet' juntzanhxo heb' skot yet' heb' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, sjawi heb' yak' owal yet' heb'.

Sb'at sb'oank'e skampamento heb' t'a sat slum heb' israel chi', satanel heb' masanil tas awab'il yuj heb' israel chi', masanto t'a smojonal chonhab' Gaza. Manhxa jab'ok tas swa heb' skan yuj heb' ajk'ol chi', syik'anpaxb'at nok' kalnel heb', nok' wakax yet' nok' b'uru.

Yujto yet'nak smolb'etzal nok' heb' sk'och heb' t'a sat sluum heb' israel chi', yuj chi', masanil tas ay t'a sat lu'um, pilan slajwieli. Manh b'ischajb'enok heb' yet' nok' skamello chi', icha wal nok' k'ulub'. Slajwikanel tastak ay t'a sat lu'um b'ajtak tzek' heb' chi'.
Icha wal chi' ix aj skan heb' israel mheb'ail yuj tas tz'utaj yuj heb' madianita chi'. Yuj chi' ix tewi heb' t'a Jehová yik skolwaj t'a heb'.
Yuj chi' haxo Jehová ix ak'ankot jun schekab' t'a heb' israel chi', ix yalan icha tik: Ha Jehová ko Diosal tz'alan icha tik: Ha in wik'nak ex elta t'a Egipto b'aj ayex och chekab'il.
Manhoknhej t'a yol sk'ab' heb' aj Egipto in kolnak ex elta, palta ex in kolpax t'a heb' ix ex ixtani, ix wik'el heb' t'a eyichanh, ix wak'ankan lum sluum heb' t'ayex.

Ix wal t'ayex to a inton Jehová he Diosal in. Ix walanpaxi to max yal-laj eyak'anem he b'ha t'a juntzanh sdiosal heb' amorreo ay t'a lum lum b'aj ayex ek' tik, palta maj he k'anab'ajej tas ix wala', xchi Jehová, xchi jun schekab' chi'.

D'a jun pekti’ chi' ix emul Yángel Jehová, ix em k'ojan t'a yich jun te' mach' t'a Ofra, t'a yol yik winhaj Joás yinhtilal Abiezer. Ay jun winh yuninal winhaj Joás chi' skuchan Gedeón. Ha winhaj Gedeón chi', wan stek'anel ixim strigo winh t'a yol jun b'aj stek'chajel yal te' uwa, yik sk'ub'ejel ixim winh t'a heb' madianita chi'.
Ata' ix sch'ox sb'a Yángel Jehová t'a winh, ix yalan t'a winh icha tik: --Ach winak tek'an. Ha Jehová ayoch ed'ok, xchi t'a winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Gedeón chi': --Mamin, ak' in niwank'olal yuj tas ol wala'. Tato ayoch Jehová qued'ok, ¿tas yuj sjawi juntzanh tik t'a quib'anh? ¿B'ajtil ay juntzanh tas satub'tak yilji yalnakkan heb' ko mam quicham t'ayonh, ayik yalannak heb' to a Jehová ik'annaquelta heb' t'a Egipto? Palta haxo tiknaik, onh yaktejkan ko ch'okoj, onh yak'ankanoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' madianita, xchi winh t'ay.
Ix och k'elan Jehová chi' t'a winh, ix yalani: --Ha in tzach in chekb'ati, ol wak'nhej ip yik tza kolanel heb' etchonhab' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' madianita chi', xchi t'a winh.

Ix tak'wi winh icha tik: --Ay Mamin, ak' wal niwank'olal t'ayin junelxo. ¿Tas wal ol aj in kolan heb' wetchonhab' tik? Yujto a in tik yet' heb' ayto wuj in b'a yet'ok te meb'a' onh t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Manasés. Slajwub' unin in t'a skal heb' wuk'tak, xchi winh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winh icha tik: --Ayinoch ed'ok, yuj chi' ol ak' ganar heb' madianita chi'. Icha wal tz'aj yak'ji ganar junok anima sch'okoj, icha chi' ol aj ak'an ganar heb', xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalanxi winh t'ay: --Mamin, tato wach' in t'a yol a sat, ch'ox junok yechel wila'' yik wach' snachajel wuuj to schekab' ach Dios.
Tzin tewi t'ayach to max ach el t'a tik, ol wik'kot junok in silab' t'ayach, xchi winh. Ix tak'wi Jehová chi': --Ayinnhej ek' t'a tik masanto ol ach jaxok, xchi.

Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winhaj Gedeón sb'o jun nok' yune' chiwa, ix sb'oanpax ixim pan winh t'a jun echlab' ixim harina, malaj yich pan ix yak'b'at winh t'a skal. Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'anem nok' chib'ej chi' winh t'a yol jun te' mooch, haxo t'a yol jun lum chen ix yak'em yalil nok' winh. Ix yik'ankot masanil juntzanh chi' winh t'a yichanh Ángel chi' t'a yich jun te' mach' chi'.

Ix yalan Yángel Jehová chi' icha tik: Hak'uem nok' chib'ej yet' ixim pan chi' t'a yib'anh jun k'een k'een tik, tza tob'anem yal nok' chi' t'a yib'anh, xchi. Ix sk'anab'ajan winh masanil tas ix yal chi'.

Axo Yángel Jehová chi', ix stenoch snhi' sk'okoch t'a juntzanh chi', ix k'eul k'ak' t'a yol k'een niwan k'een chi', ix tz'ab'at nok' chib'ej yet' ixim pan chi'. Val t'a yichanh winh ix satem Yángel Jehová chi'.

Ayic ix yilan jun chi' winh, ix nachajel yuj winh to Yángel Jehová jun ix lolon chi' yet' winh. Yuj chi' ix yalan winh icha tik: --Mamin Jehová, k'elk'umb'a wal ix aj in lolon yet' Ángel ix a chekkoti, xchi winh.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winh icha tik: --Manh ach xiwok, manh ol ach chamlaj, xchi t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix sb'oank'e jun altar winh ta' yik syik'anchaanh Jehová winh. Ix yak'ankan winh sb'iej: Ha Jehová ak'um junk'olal. Ha jun altar chi' ix kannhej t'a Ofra t'a yol smakb'en heb' yinhtilal Abiezer.

Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi', ix yal Jehová t'a winhaj Gedeón chi': --Ik'elta nok' schab'il mam wakax t'a skal nok' swakax winh a mam, nok' uque' ab'il sk'inal. Tza mak'an wekchaj yaltaril komon Dios Baal b'ob'ilk'e yuj winh a mam chi', tza ch'akanpaxel jun te te' yechel komon Dios Asera t'a stz'ey altar chi'.

Ha t'a sjolom k'een niwan k'een chaanh ayk'ei, ata' tza b'ok'e junok altar t'ayin Jehová a Diosal in tik. Wach' tzutej a latz'ank'e k'een. Axo te te' ix a ch'aquel chi', a te' tzak'och sk'atzitzalok. Slajwi chi' tza milancham nok' wakax chi', tza nhusantz'a nok' silab'il t'a yib'anh, xchi t'a winh.

Yuj chi' ix b'at winh, ix yik'anb'at lajunhwanh schekab' winh, ix sk'anab'ajan winh icha ix aj yalan Jehová chi'. Palta ix xiw winh sb'oan t'a k'ualil yuj heb' sk'ab' yok winh smam. Ix xiwpax winh t'a heb' anima kajan t'a chonhab' chi', yuj chi' t'ak'walil ix laj sb'o juntzanh chi' winh.

Axo ix q'uinhib'i t'a junxo k'u, ayik ix k'e waan heb' anima t'a jun chonhab' chi', ix yilan heb' to toxo ix mak'ji wekchaj altar yik Baal chi', ix yilanpax heb' to toxo ix ch'akjiel te' yechel Asera t'a stz'ey altar chi'. Ix yab'anpax heb' to ay jun nok' wakax ix nhusjitz'a silab'il t'a yib'anh jun altar toto ix b'o chi'.

Ix sk'anb'anek' heb': --¿Mach ixb’o’an juntzanh tik? xchi heb'. Ix laj sk'anb'anek' yab' heb', haxo ix yab'an heb' to a winhaj Gedeón yuninal winhaj Joás ix b'oani. Yuj chi' ix yal heb' t'a winhaj Joás chi' icha tik:
--Ik'elta winh uninal chi', ol ko milcham winh. ¿Tas yuj ix smak'wekchaj altar yik Baal winh, ix sch'akanpaxel te' yechel Asera winh t'a stz'ey chi'? xchi heb' anima chi'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Joás t'a masanil heb' anima oyanoch t'a spatik chi' icha tik: --¿Tom tze kol jun komon Dios skuchan Baal chi', tzeyak'an yowalil? Tato icha chi', chamokab' jun mach skolan Baal chi' t'a q'uinhib'alil tik. Tato yel Dios jun Baal chi', yak'okab' yowalil t'a mach ix mak'an wekchaj jun yaltar chi', xchi winh.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi', Jerobaal ix sb'iejkan winhaj Gedeón chi', yujto ix yal heb' anima chi' icha tik: Yak'okab' owal jun Baal chi' yet' winh, yujto ix smak' wekchaj yaltar winh, xchi heb'.

Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' madianita, heb' amalekita yet' heb' kajan t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, ix k'axpajek'ta heb' t'a yol ha' Jordán, ix sb'oank'e skampamento heb' t'a yak'likal Jezreel.
Axo Yespíritu Jehová ix och t'a winhaj Gedeón chi'. Ayic ix spu'an jun nok' sch'aak winh, ix smolb'an sb'a heb' yinhtilal Abiezer, aton heb' sk'ab' yok winh.
Ix yak'anpaxb'at schekab' winh yawtejkot heb' yinhtilal Manasés, heb' yinhtilal Aser, heb' yinhtilal Zabulón yet' heb' yik Neftalí, yuj chi' ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' yet' winh.
Ix yalan winh d'ha Dios icha tik: Tato t'a wal yel a in tzin ak'lab'ej a kolan heb' wetisraelal tik, icha wal ix aj alani, ch'ox junok yechel t'ayin.

Ha tiknaik ol wak'kanem junok nok' tz'umal kalnel t'a sat tek'lab' trigo. Axo t'a q'uinhib'alil k'ik'an, tato te' ch'ayan nok' tz'um chi' yuj yal ak'wal, haxo pax t'a sat lum t'a spatik yichanh nok', taquinh, ol wojtaquejeli to yel a in ol in ak'lab'ej a kolanel heb' wetchonhab' tik, icha ix aj alani, xchi winh.
Icha wal ix aj yalan winh chi', icha chi' ix aji. Ayic ix k'e waan winh t'a q'uinhib'alil, ix spitz'anel nok' tz'uum chi' winh, jun uk'ab' ha' ix el t'a nok'.

Ix yalanxi winh d'ha Dios: Mamin, mokab' kot yowal a k'ol t'ayin, ol in k'an junxo ch'oxnab'il t'ayach. Ha t'a junelxo tik, a sat lum sch'ayxi yuj yal ak'wal chi', haxo pax nok' tz'uum chi', mokab' ch'ayxok nok', xchi winh.
Icha wal ix aj yalan winh chi', icha chi' ix yutej Dios t'a junxo ak'wal chi'. Ayic ix sakb'i, te taquinh nok' tz'uum chi', haxo pax sat lu'um, te ch'ayan yuj yal ak'wal.

Ha winhaj Jerobaal, aton winhaj Gedeón, te ak'walto ix k'e waan winh yet' jantak heb' winh winak ayxo och yet'ok. Ha t'a sjaj ha' melem skuch Harod ix b'at sb'ok'e skampamento heb' winh. Axo pax heb' madianita, ha t'a stojolal norte t'a yak'likal yich lum witz More, ata' ayek' skampamento heb'.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Gedeón chi' icha tik: Te tzijtum heb' winh winak tik ed'nak. Tato swak'och heb' madianita t'a yol he k'ab' tiknaik, axom ol eyalani to yuj he jelanil ix eyak' ganar heb'.

Yuj chi' al t'a heb' winh soldado smasanil, tato ay mach xiw sb'at t'a owal chi', meltzajokab' t'a switzal Galaad tik, spax t'a spat, xchi t'a winh. Yuj chi' 22 mil heb' winh ix paxta, 10 milxonhej heb' winh ix kani.
Ix yalanxi Jehová: Anheja' tzijtumto heb' winh soldado tik. Ik'b'at heb' winh yuk'ej ha' t'a sti' ha' melem. Ata' ol wil heb' winh, a in xo ol wala' machtak ol kan ed'ok, xchi t'a winh.

Ix yik'anb'at heb' winh ixto kan chi' winhaj Gedeón yuk'ej ha' t'a sti' ha' melem chi'. Ix yalan Jehová: Masanil mach sb'echank'eta ha' t'a yol sk'ab' yuk'ej, ch'ok tzik'kanel t'a skal heb' winh tz'em kuman syuk'an ha', xchi t'a winh.
Ha heb' winh ix b'echank'eta ha' t'a yol sk'ab', ix yuk'ani, 300 heb' winh, haxo jantakxo heb' winh jun, ix em kuman heb' winh ix yuk'an ha' heb' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Gedeón chi': k'okb'il heb' winh 300 chi' ol in k'ana' yik ol eyak'an ganar heb' madianita chi'. Axo pax heb' winh ix em kuman yuk'an ha ha' chi' jun, paxokab' heb' winh t'a spat, xchi t'a winh.

Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Gedeón chi' to smeltzaj heb' winh t'a spat. Axo winh ix ik'ankanek' swael heb' winh yet' nok' sch'aak heb' winh spu'u. Axonhej heb' winh 300 ix sik'jikanel chi' ix kan yet' winh. Ha skampamento heb' winh, ayek' t'a jolom witz t'a yib'anh b'aj ay skampamento heb' madianita chi'.
Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi', ix yal Jehová t'a winhaj Gedeón chi': Q'ueanh waan, ixik, emanh ak' owal yet' heb' madianita chi', yujto ol wak'och heb' t'a yol a k'ab'.
Tato tzach xiw a b'ati, emokab' winh a chekab' aj Fura ed'ok t'a skampamento heb' chi',

ol he maklan eyab'i tas wan yalan heb', yuj chi' manh ol ach xiw och t'a owal chi', xchi t'a winh. Yuj chi' ix emk'och winh yet' winh schekab' chi' t'ak'walil b'aj ayel heb' stanhwan skampamento heb' madianita chi', yik smaklan yab' heb' winh tas syal heb'.

Ha heb' madianita chi' yet' heb' amalekita yet' heb' ix kot t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, ix majel sat lum ak'lik chi' yuj heb', ichok nok' k'ulub'. Manhxo b'ischajb'enok jantak nok' kamello yet'nak heb', icha wal yarenail t'a sti' ha' mar.

Ayic ix k'och winhaj Gedeón chi' b'aj ayek' heb' wan stanhwan skampamento heb' chi', ix yab'an winh yalan swayich jun winh soldado t'a junxo winh icha tik. --Ix in wayichej to ay jun ixim pan kebada ix kot b'alb'on t'a sat witz tik. Ix emul ixim t'a yol ko kampamento tik, ix och pok'naj ixim t'a jun mantiado, ix em lanhnaj yuj ixim, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi junxo winh chi' icha tik: --Ha jun ixim pan chi' syalelk'ochi to a winhaj Gedeón yuninal winhaj Joás yet' heb' soldado israel ol onh ak'an ganar. Yujto ha Dios ol onh ak'anoch ko masanil t'a yol sk'ab' heb', xchi winh.

Ayic ix yab'an winhaj Gedeón tas ix yutej yalan jun wayich chi' heb' winh, ix em kuman winh t'a yichanh Jehová, ix yak'an yuj diosal winh t'ay. Ixlajwi chi', ix k'exta winh t'a skampamento, ix yalan winh: --Koyec, yujto toxo ix yak'och heb' madianita Jehová t'a yol ko k'ab', xchi winh.

Ox makan ix yutej 300 heb' winh soldado chi' winh. Junjun nok' ch'aak ix yak' winh t'a junjun heb' winh soldado chi' yik spu nok' heb' winh, ix yak'anpax junjun chen winh t'a heb' winh, ayem staj heb' winh ayoch sk'ak'al t'a yol chen chi'.
Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Ayic ol in k'och t'a junxo stib'at skampamento heb' kajk'ol chi', tzeyil wal tas ol in k'ulej, icha pax chi' ol he k'ulejpax a ex tik.

Ha ol eyab'an in pu'an nok' ch'aak tik yet' heb' tzak'anoch wuuj, ol he pu'anpax nok' eyik he masanil t'a spatiktak kampamento chi', ol ex awajok. Ol eyalan icha tik: Kaq'ek owal yuj Jehová yet' winhaj Gedeón, xe chi, xchi winh.

Ayic ix k'och winhaj Gedeón chi' yet' 100 heb' winh soldado ajun yet'ok t'a junxo stib'at skampamento heb' madianita chi' t'a chimilak'wal, ato wal sk'exlan sb'a heb' b'ab'el ayel stanhwej kampamento chi'. Ha wal ta' ix spu sch'aak heb' winh yik winhaj Gedeón chi', ix smak'anpaxpoj schen heb' winh yet'nak.

Junnhej ix aj spu'an sch'ak heb' winh yet'nak t'a swach' k'ab' yox makanhil, junnhej pax ix aj smak'anpoj schen heb' winh, haxo sk'ab' heb' winh t'a sk'exanh ix tz'ikanchaanh staj, chaanh ix awaj heb' winh: Kaq'ek owal yuj Jehová yet' winhaj Gedeón, xchi heb' winh.
Ix kannhej tek'tek' heb' winh t'a spatik kampamento chi'. Axo heb' ajk'ol chi', yelk'olalxonhej ix b'at heb' elelal, ix el yaw heb' yuj xiwelal.

Ayic ix spu'an nok' sch'aak 300 heb' winh israel chi', haxo Jehová ix ak'an somchajb'at spensar heb' ajk'ol chi'. Munil a heb' ix laj smil-lajcham sb'a. Ay pax heb' ix el lemnajok, ix b'at heb' t'a Bet-sita t'a stojolal Zerera, masanto ix k'och heb' t'a smojonal Abel-mehola t'a slak'anil Tabat.
Ixlajwi chi', ix smolb'an sb'a heb' yinhtilal Neftalí yet' heb' yinhtilal Aser yet' masanil heb' yik Manasés, ix b'at heb' t'a spatik heb' madianita chi'.

Axo winhaj Gedeón chi', ix schekb'at yalumal winh t'a heb' yinhtilal Efraín kajan t'a tzalquixtak, to sb'at heb' smak t'a elanhchamel t'a sjayil sti' ha' Jordán t'a Bet-bara, yakb'an manto k'och heb' ajk'ol chi'. Ix sk'anab'ajej heb' sb'ati.

Ix yamchaj chawanh heb' winh sat yajal yaj t'a heb' madianita chi' yuj heb', jun winh skuch Oreb, junxo winh skuchan Zeeb. Ha winhaj Oreb chi', ix miljicham winh b'aj ay jun k'een tenam, aton k'een ix skuchkan Oreb. Axo winhaj Zeeb chi', ix cham winh b'aj ay jun tek'lab'el yal uwa, yuj chi' Zeeb ix sb'iejkan jun chi'. Ix b'atnhej heb' yinhtilal Efraín chi' t'a spatik heb' madianita chi', ix yik'ankot sjolom winhaj Oreb chi' heb' yet' yik winhaj Zeeb chi' t'a winhaj Gedeón chi' t'a sti' ha' Jordán chi'.

Masanil heb' yinhtilal Efraín ix kot yowal t'a winhaj Gedeón chi', ix yalan heb' icha tik: ¿Tas yuj maj onh awtej yik tzonh b'at ed' t'a owal yet' heb' madianita chi'? xchi heb'. Te ya ix yal heb' t'a winh.

Palta ix tak'wi winh t'a heb' icha tik: --¿Tom tze na' to ek'b'al yelk'och tas ix ko k'ulej t'a sb'ab'elal a onh yinhtil onh winhaj Abiezer tik t'a yichanh tas ix he k'ulej t'a slajwub'alxo a ex yinhtilal Efraín ex tik?

Ha Dios ix ak'anoch heb' yajalil heb' madianita t'a yol he k'ab' a ex tik, aton winhaj Oreb yet' winhaj Zeeb. Malaj yelk'och tas ix in k'ulej a in tik t'a yichanh tas niwan yelk'och ix he k'ulej chi' a ex tik, xchi winh. Ayic ix yab'an heb' tas ix yal winh chi', ix sikb'iem yowal sk'ol heb' chi'.

Ix emk'och winhaj Gedeón yet' 300 heb' winh soldado t'a sti' ha' Jordán, wach'chom te k'unb'inakxo heb' winh, palta ixto b'atnhej tzak'an heb' winh t'a spatik heb' ajk'ol chi', masanto ix k'axpajek' heb' winh t'ha ha'.

Ayic ix k'och heb' winh t'a Sucot, ix yalan winhaj Gedeón chi' t'a heb' kajan ta' icha tik: --Comonoc tz'el t'a he k'ool, tzeyak' jab'ok tas swa heb' winh ajun wed' tik, yujto tz'el yip heb' winh yuj wejel, yujto ayonh och t'a spatik winhaj Zeba yet' winhaj Zalmuna, aton heb' winh sreyal heb' madianita, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi heb' yajalil chonhab' chi' t'a winh icha tik: --¿Tom toxo ix yamchaj winhaj Zeba yet' winhaj Zalmuna chi' eyuuj, yuj chi' skak' wa heb' winh a soldado tik? xchi heb'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Gedeón chi': --Ayic ol ak'jokoch winhaj Zeba yet' winhaj Zalmuna chi' t'a yol ko k'ab' yuj Jehová, ayik ol onh jax t'a tik, ol ko mak'el tzililjok he chib'ejal t'a he patik t'a te' q'uiix ol quik'kot t'a taquinh lu'um, xchi winh.

Ix el heb' winh t'a jun chonhab' chi', ix k'och heb' winh t'a Peniel, ix sk'ananpax swael heb' winh soldado winhaj Gedeón chi' ta', palta icha ix aj yalan heb' aj Sucot, icha pax chi' ix aj yalan heb' aj Peniel chi' t'a winh.
Ix yalanxi winh icha tik: --Ayic ol onh meltzaj t'a junk'olal, ol ko mak'em weknaj jun kuartel b'aj tze kol he b'a tik, xchi winh.
Axo t'a Carcor ayek' winhaj Zeba yet' winhaj Zalmuna chi', 15 milto heb' soldado madianita ayek' yet' heb' winh. Axonhej heb' chi', yujto 120 mil heb' toxo ix chami.
Ix k'och winhaj Gedeón yet' heb' soldado t'a spatik heb' ajk'ol chi' t'a stitak tzinan lum t'a yichanhb'at Noba yet' t'a Jogbeha. Satk'olal yaj heb' soldado madianita chi' ix k'och heb'.

Axo pax winhaj Zeba yet' winhaj Zalmuna chi', ix b'at heb' winh elelal, palta ix och winhaj Gedeón chi' t'a spatik heb' winh, masanto ix yamchaj heb' winh yuj winh, haxo heb' soldado heb' winh, ix saklemkanb'at heb' yuj xiwelal.
Axo yik ix paxta winhaj Gedeón yet' heb' soldado chi' t'a owal, ix ek' heb' t'a xachanil lum switzal Heres.
Ata' ix yamchaj jun winh quelem aj Sucot yuj heb', ix sk'anb'an heb' t'a winh tastak sb'i heb' yajal yaj t'a Sucot chi'. Axo winh quelem chi' ix tz'ib'an sb'i junjun heb', 77 heb' t'a smasanil.

Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winhaj Gedeón t'a Sucot chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' anima ta' icha tik: --¿Tzam he nakot tas aj in he b'uchani? Eyalani: ¿Tom toxo ix yamchaj winhaj Zeba yet' winhaj Zalmuna chi' eyuuj, yuj chi' skak' wa heb' winh a soldado k'unb'inak ay swejel tik? xe chi. Ha tiknaik jun, ina heb' winh tik, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'ankot te' q'uiix winh, te' ix yik'kot heb' t'a taquinh lu'um, ix smak'an heb' yajalil chonhab' Sucot chi' winh t'a te'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'atpax heb' winh t'a Peniel, ix smak'anem weknaj jun kuartel heb' winh, aton b'aj skol sb'a heb' soldado, ix smilancham masanil heb' winh winak heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix sk'anb'an winhaj Gedeón t'a winhaj Zeba yet' t'a winhaj Zalmuna chi' icha tik: --¿Chajtil yilji heb' winh ix he milcham t'a Tabor? xchi winh t'a heb' winh. Ix tak'wi heb' winh: --Icha wal ilji tik, icha chi' yilji heb' winh. Icha yilji heb' winh yajal, icha chi' yilji heb' winh, xchi heb' winh.

Ayic ix yab'an winhaj Gedeón chi' icha chi', ix yalan winh: --Ha heb' winh chi', wuk'tak heb' winh, junnhej in nun yet' heb' winh. Yuj chi' swal t'a yichanh Jehová, tato maj he milcham he winh wuk'tak chi', max am ex in milpaxcham tiknaik, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Jeter b'ab'el yunin icha tik: --Lemach, milcham heb' winh tik, xchi winh. Yune' quelemto winhaj Jeter chi', yuj chi' ix xiw winh yik'ank'eta k'een yespada yik smilancham heb' winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Zeba yet' winhaj Zalmuna t'a winhaj Gedeón chi' icha tik: --Cotanh ach tik, a ach lak'an tzonh a milchamok, yujto ojtakab'ilxo to max ach xiwi, ak'um owal ach paxi, xchi heb' winh. Ix k'e juknaj winhaj Gedeón chi', ix smilancham chawanh heb' winh rey chi' winh. Axo juntzanh k'een k'een ayoch yelwanub'ok sjaj nok' skamello heb' winh, ix yik'el k'een winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan heb' yetisraelal winh chi' t'ay: --Ha ach ix onh a kolel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' madianita, yuj chi' a ach yet' heb' inhtilal ol ex ochkan kajalilok, xchi heb'.
Ix tak'wi winh t'a heb' icha tik: --Manh ol in ochlaj eyajalilok, manh ol ochpaxlaj heb' wuninal, palta a Jehová Kajal yaji.

Anhej jun tzin k'an t'ayex to tzeyak' k'een uchiquin t'ayin, aton k'een ix eyik'ek' t'a heb' madianita, xchi winh. Yed'nak juntzanh k'een uchiquin nab'a oro heb' ajk'ol chi', yujto icha chi' sb'eyb'al heb' kajan t'a tzinan lu'um.

Yuj chi' ix slich'anem jun k'apak k'apak heb', ix yak'anem k'een uchiquin chi' heb' t'a yib'anh k'apak. Ix yalan heb' t'a winh icha tik: --Ina k'een tik, t'a wal smasanil ko k'ool skak' k'een t'ayach, xchi heb'.

Ha jantak k'een oro ayoch t'a k'een uchiquin chi', ay am 40 libraok yalil k'een. Ch'ok pax yaj juntzanhxo k'een k'een wach' yilji yet' yelwanub' yet' k'apak spichul heb' winh sreyal madianita yet' pax k'een k'een ayoch yelwanub'ok sjaj nok' skamello heb' winh.

Ha yet' juntzanh k'een chi' ix sb'o jun yechel winhaj Gedeón chi', ix yak'ankan winh t'a schonhab' skuch Ofra. Ix spatiquejel Jehová heb' israel, haxo t'a jun yechel chi' sk'anb'ej sb'a heb'. Yuj chi' ix kotkan t'a yib'anh winhaj Gedeón chi' yet' yinhtilal.
Ix kan heb' madianita t'a yalanh smandar heb' israel chi', majxo yal-laj skolan sb'a heb'. 40 ab'il manhxalaj owal, junk'olal ix aj heb' israel chi' ayik ayek' winhaj Gedeón chi' yet' heb'.
Ayic ix lajwi owal chi', ix pax winhaj Jerobaal, aton winhaj Gedeón yuninal winhaj Joás chi' t'a spat.
Tzijtum heb' winh yuninal winh, 70 heb' winh t'a smasanil, yujto tzijtum heb' ix ix, ix yik' winh.
Ay pax junxo ix aj Siquem ix yik' winh, ay jun yune' ix ix alji yet' winh. Abimelec ix yak' winh sb'iej jun yunin chi'.
Ayic ix cham winhaj Gedeón yuninal winhaj Joás chi', te icham winakxo winh. Ix mukji winh b'aj mukankan winh smam winh t'a Ofra, b'aj ay heb' yinhtilal Abiezer.
Ayic ayxo scham winhaj Gedeón chi', a heb' israel chi', ix spatiquejxiel Jehová heb', ix ochxi heb' ejmelal t'a komon Dios skuchan Baal-berit.
Ix b'atkan Jehová sDiosal heb' satk'olal yuj, wach'chom a ix kolan heb' t'a heb' t'a juntzanh nakión ajk'ol oyanoch t'a spatik yichanh heb'.
Malaj jab'ok tas wach' ix yak' heb' spakok t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Gedeón chi' yuj tas ix sk'ulej winh yuj swach'ilok heb'.
Ha winhaj Abimelec yuninal winhaj Jerobaal, ix b'at winh t'a Siquem lolonel yet' heb' sk'ab' yok ix snun, ix yalan winh t'a heb':

--Ha tiknaik swal t'ayex to wach' tze montej heb' eyetchonhab' t'a Siquem tik, tze k'anb'an t'a heb' icha tik: ¿Wach'am tzeyab'i to a 70 heb' yuninal winhaj Jerobaal syak' yajalil t'a quib'anh, mato wach' to junnhej winh tz'och kajalilok? xe chi t'a heb'. Naeccoti to a innhej ay wuj in b'a eyed'ok, xchi winh.

Ha heb' ayto yuj sb'a chi' yet' winh, ix syamoch heb' yalan t'a heb' yetchonhab' t'a Siquem chi' to a winhaj Abimelec chi' tz'och yajalil t'a skal heb'. Ix scha sk'ol heb' chonhab' chi' icha chi', yujto ayto yuj sb'a heb' yet' winh.

Yuj chi' ix yik'elta 70 siklo k'een plata heb' t'a yol stemplo komon Dios skuchan Baal-berit, ix yak'an k'een heb' t'a winhaj Abimelec chi'. Ha yet' k'een ix stup juntzanh heb' winh jaragana winak winh yik tz'och heb' winh yet' winh. Te chuk juntzanh heb' winh winak chi'.

Yuj chi' ix b'at heb' winh yet' winh t'a Ofra, b'aj ek'nak winh smam winh. Ata' ix smilcham 70 heb' yuk'tak winh t'a yib'anh jun k'een k'een. Axonhej winhaj Jotam ix kolchajkani, yujto ix sk'ub'ejkanel sb'a winh, aton winh slajwub' yuninal winhaj Jerobaal chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix smolb'an sb'a heb' aj Siquem yet' heb' aj Bet-milo t'a yich jun te' mach' t'a Siquem chi', b'aj ay jun k'een k'een niwan yelk'och t'a heb'. Ata' ix yak'och winhaj Abimelec heb' yajalil.

Ayic ix alchaj jun chi' t'a winhaj Jotam chi', ix k'e winh t'a jun tzalan t'a spak'ul lum witzal Gerizim, te chaanh ix awajemta winh yik wach' masanil mach tz'ab'ani, ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ex aj Siquem, maklejek eyab' jun ab'ix ol wal tik yik wach' ol yab' Dios tas ol eyala'.
Ha junel, masanil ab' te te' ix snib'ej yak'och junok yajalil. Yuj chi' ix ab' yal te' t'a te' oliwo to tz'och te' yajalilok te' smasanil.
Ix ab' tak'wi te' oliwo chi', ix yalan te': Maay, tato tzin och eyajalilok he masanil, maxtzak am wak'laj akeite sk'anchaj yuj yik'jichaanh Dios, ma yik sk'anpax heb' anima, xchab' te'.
Ixlajwi chi', ab' yalanpax te' smasanil t'a te' higo yik tz'och te' yajalil.
Ix ab' yalanpax te' higo chi': Maay, tato tzin och eyajalilok he masanil, maxtzak am wak' in sat te chi' sloji, xchab' te'.
Ix ab' yalanpax te' t'a te' uwa to tz'och te' yajalil.
Ix ab' yalanpax te' uwa chi': Maay, tato tzin och eyajalilok he masanil, tzam waktej wak'an wino tz'ak'an tzalajb'ok sk'ol Dios yet' heb' anima, xchab' te'.
Slajwub'alxo ix ab' yalan te' t'a te' q'uiix to tz'och te' yajalil.

Ix ab' yalan te' q'uiix chi' to syal yoch te' yajalilok te te' chi' smasanil. Ix ab' yalan te': Tato yel t'a smasanil he k'ol tzin eyak'och eyajalilok, ochanhek t'a yalanh wenhul tik he masanil. Tato max yal he k'ol tzin och eyajalilok jun, elokab'kot jun niwan k'ak' t'ayin yik stz'akanb'at te' k'ute' t'a Líbano, xchab' te' q'uiix chi'.
Ha tiknaik jun, tzin k'anb'ej t'ayex: ¿Tom yel wal wach' ix he k'ulej, yuj chi' ix eyak'och winhaj Abimelec chi' eyajalilok? ¿Tom smoj wal icha chi' tzeyutej yinhtilal winhaj Jerobaal chi' tiknaik?
Ix sb'ek sb'a winh in mam chi' scham eyuuj ayik ex skolanelta winh t'a yol sk'ab' heb' madianita.

Ha exxo tik, tas xom wal eyaji, yuj chi' tzex meltzajoch ajk'olal t'a yinhtilal winh in mam chi'. Ix he milcham 70 yuninal winh t'a jun k'een k'een, haxo winhaj Abimelec yune' jun ix schekab' winh in mam chi' ix eyak'och eyajalilok, anhej am yujto ayto eyuj he b'a yet' winh yuj snun.
Swalan t'ayex tiknaik: Tato wach' tze k'ulej t'a xilb'a in mam yet' t'a heb' yinhtilal, tzalajk'olalokab' eyaj yet' winhaj Abimelec chi', wach'nhejokab' ol aj yelk'och winh t'a he kal.

Tato manh wach'ok jun, elokab'kot junok niwan k'ak' t'a winhaj Abimelec chi', yik tzex tz'ab'at ex aj Siquem yet' ex aj Bet-milo. Axo t'ayex tz'elpaxkot junok k'ak', yik stz'apaxb'at winhaj Abimelec chi', xchi winhaj Jotam chi'.
Ixlajwi yalan juntzanh chi' winhaj Jotam chi', el lemnaj winh, ix b'at kajnajkan winh t'a Beer, yujto xiw winh t'a winhaj Abimelec winh yuk'tak chi'.
Oxe' ab'il ix yak' yajalil winhaj Abimelec t'a yib'anh chonhab' Israel chi'.
Axo Dios ix ak'anoch jun ajk'olal t'a skal winh yet' heb' aj Siquem chi', ix meltzajoch heb' ajk'olal t'a winh.
Icha chi' ix aj yak'ji spak t'a winh yuj schamel 70 heb' winh yuk'tak smilnakchamok. Ix ak'jipax spak t'a heb' aj Siquem chi', yujto ix yak'och sb'a heb' yet' winhaj Abimelec chi' t'a schukal chi'.

Ha heb' aj Siquem chi', ay heb' sb'at sk'ub'ejel sb'ha t'a titak b'e t'a spak'ultak lum witz, tz'elta heb' t'a heb' anima tzek' t'a yol b'e tzek' t'a slak'anil chonhab' chi' yik tz'elk'an heb'. Ix alji yab' winhaj Abimelec to icha chi' sk'ulej heb'.
Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', ix k'och jun winh skuchan Gaal yuninal winhaj Ebed yet' heb' sk'ab' yok t'a Siquem chi', wach' ix kan winh t'a yol sat heb' anima ta'.

Ayic q'uinhxo te' uwa, tz'el heb' t'a spatiquel chonhab', yik smolan te' heb', sb'oan wino heb'. Ix yak'anoch jun q'uinh heb', ix och ijan heb' swa'i yet' yuk'wi anh heb' t'a yol stemplo sdiosal. Ha wal ta' te chuk ix yal heb' t'a spatik winhaj Abimelec chi'.

Ix och ijan winhaj Gaal chi' yalani: ¿Mach jun winhaj Abimelec chi' yalani, yuj chi' tzonh yak' mandar winh? Ha winh chi', yuninal winh winhaj Jerobaal, haxo pax winhaj Zebul schekab' winh. Ha heb' winh chi' malaj yelk'och heb' winh. Ha onh pax aj Siquem onh tik, ¿tas yuj tonhej skak' ko b'ha t'a winh? ¿Tom ol onh ochnhej schekab'ok heb' winh? Co naekkot tiknaik to a winh ko mam quicham, aton winhaj Hamor, winh b'oannakk'e chonhab' Siquem tik, yuj chi' quik'equel ko b'ha t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Abimelec chi'.
A... tato a in eyajalil in, toxom ix in satel winhaj Abimelec chi', tzam wal t'a winh: Molb'ej heb' a soldado skak'an owal, xin chama, xchi winh.
Ayic ix yab'an winhaj Zebul, yajal t'a Siquem chi' tas ix yal winhaj Gaal chi', ix te kot yowal winh.
Elanhchamel ix yalb'at winh t'a winhaj Abimelec t'a elk'altak icha tik: Ix jawi winhaj Gaal yuninal winhaj Ebed yet' heb' yuk'tak t'a tik, wan yak'an sk'ol heb' anima heb' winh t'a a patik.
Yuj chi' kotanh yet' heb' a soldado t'ak'walil, tze k'ub'anel he b'ha t'a titak chonhab' tik.
Axo yik toxo sakb'i, tzex och eyak' owal t'a chonhab' tik, haxo yik tz'elta winhaj Gaal chi' yak' owal ed'ok yet' heb' soldado, ol xo ila' tas ol utej winh, xchib'at winhaj Zebul chi'.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Abimelec t'ak'walil yet' heb' soldado. Chanh makan ix aj sk'ub'anel sb'a heb' t'a spatiktak chonhab' Siquem chi'.
Ayic wan yelta winhaj Gaal t'a spuertail chonhab' chi', ix eltapax winhaj Abimelec yet' heb' soldado b'aj k'ub'anel chi'.

Ayic ix yilan winhaj Gaal chi', ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Zebul icha tik: --Iltonab'i, masanil t'a sattak witz tz'emul heb' soldado, xchi winh. --Maay, a yenhul lum witz tzal animail chi' a ach tik, xchi winhaj Zebul chi'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Gaal chi': --Anhejtona' ay heb' wan yemta t'a tzalan skuchan Smuxuc Lum Luum. Van yempaxul heb' soldado t'a sb'eal b'aj nab'a ji yik heb' naumel lolonel, xchi winh.

Ix yalanxi winhaj Zebul chi' t'a winh icha tik: --B'ajtil ay a lolonel ix laj al chi' tiknaik. Ix ala' to malaj yelk'och winhaj Abimelec yik tzonh och schekab'ok winh. Ha tiknaik chi' sjawi heb' soldado ix a b'uch chi', ixik chinaik, yik tzak' owal yet' heb', xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix och winhaj Gaal skuchb'an heb' anima t'a Siquem, ix b'at yak'an owal heb' yet' winhaj Abimelec yet' heb' soldado.

Axo winhaj Abimelec chi' ix och t'a spatik winhaj Gaal yet' heb' ayoch yet'ok. Maj techajlaj skolan sb'a winhaj Gaal chi', ix och lemnaj winh skol sb'ha t'a yol chonhab' chi'. Tzijtum mach ix cham t'a stiel chonhab' chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix meltzaj winhaj Abimelec chi' t'a chonhab' Aruma. Axo winhaj Zebul chi' ix pechanel winhaj Gaal yet' heb' sk'ab' yok t'a Siquem chi' t'a junelnhej.
Axo t'a junxo k'u, ix b'at heb' aj Siquem chi' munlajel, ix yab'an winhaj Abimelec chi',

yuj chi' ox makan ix yutej heb' soldado winh, ix sk'ub'anel sb'a heb' t'a kaltak te'. Ayic ix yilan heb' soldado chi' yelul heb' anima t'a spuertail chonhab', ix elta heb' b'aj k'ub'an chi', ix yak'an owal heb' yet' heb'.

D'a jun rato chi', ix b'at winhaj Abimelec yet' jun makan heb' soldado smakkan spuertail chonhab' chi'. Palta haxo cha makanhxo heb' jun, ix yak' owal heb' yet' heb' anima ix elta munlajel t'a spatiktak chonhab' Siquem chi'.

Pilan k'u ix yak' owal winhaj Abimelec chi', masanto ix yak' ganar winh satanel jun chonhab' chi'. Ix smilcham masanil anima winh, ix smak'em weknaj jun chonhab' chi' winh, ix sekankanem atz'am atz'am winh t'a yib'anh.
Ayic ix yab'an heb' anima t'a kuartel b'aj skol sb'a heb' t'a Siquem tas ix ajkan Siquem chi' yuj winhaj Abimelec chi', ix b'at heb' sk'ub'ejel sb'ha t'a yol stemplo komon Dios skuch El-berit.
Ayic ix yab'an winhaj Abimelec to ata' k'ub'anel heb' anima chi',

ix b'at winh yet' masanil heb' soldado t'a jun witz skuchan Salmón. Ix yik'anb'at jun k'een ch'akab' winh, ix sch'akanel jun sk'ab' jun te te' winh, ix yak'ank'e te' winh t'a sjolom sjenhjab'. Ix yalan winh t'a masanil heb' anima to icha pax chi' syutej heb' t'a elanhchamel.

Yuj chi' masanil anima ix ch'akanel junjun sk'ab' te te'. Ix och tzak'an heb' yuj winh masanto ix k'och heb' t'a templo chi'. Ix smolb'ankanoch sk'ab'tak te te' chi' heb' t'a spatik b'aj k'ub'anel heb' anima chi'. Ix yak'anoch sk'ak'al te' heb', yuj chi' ix cham masanil heb' anima ayek' chi' ta'. Ay am milok heb' winh winak yet' heb' ix ix, ix chami.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj Abimelec chi' yet' heb' winh soldado yak' owal t'a chonhab' Tebes. Elanhchamel ix yoy sb'a heb' t'a spatik chonhab' chi', ix yak'an ganar heb'.

Ha t'a snanhal yol jun chonhab' chi', ata' ay jun kuartel b'aj skol sb'a heb' anima ayik ay owal. Ata' ix b'at heb' anima sk'ub'ejel sb'a. Te wach' ix yutej heb' smakan spuertail, ix k'e heb' t'a yib'anh.
Ix k'och lemnaj winhaj Abimelec chi' t'a spuertail chi' yik syak'anoch sk'ak'al winh yalani.
Axo jun ix ix ayk'e t'a yib'anh kuartel chi' ix aktanemta jun k'een k'een yik molino. k'okb'il wal t'a sjolom winhaj Abimelec chi' ix em k'een, ix apchaj winh yuj k'een.

Elanhchamel ix yal winh t'a jun winh skuchumal syamk'ab' yik owal: Ik'kot k'een espada, milinchamok, malaj in gana ol alchajok to a junok ix ix, ix in milani, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix yik'kot k'een yespada winh chi', ix stekanoch k'een winh t'a winhaj Abimelec chi', ix cham winh.
Ayic ix yilan heb' soldado to toxo ix cham winh, ix meltzaj heb' t'a spat junjun.
Icha chi' ix yutej Dios yak'an spak t'a winhaj Abimelec chi' yuj chukal sk'ulejnak t'a winh smam, ayik smilannakcham 70 heb' winh yuk'tak winh.
Anheja' icha chi' ix ajpax yak'ji spak t'a heb' anima t'a Siquem chi' yuj schukal, ix elk'och skatab' winhaj Jotam yuninal winhaj Jerobaal t'a yib'anh heb'.

Ayic toxo ix cham winhaj Abimelec, ay jun winh t'a yinhtilal Isacar skuchan Tola yuninal winhaj Fúa, yixchiquin winhaj Dodo. Ha winhaj Tola chi' ix kolwaj winh t'a heb' yetisraelal. Ha t'a chonhab' Samir t'a tzalquixtak t'a yol yik Efraín kajan winh.
Ha winhaj Tola chi', 23 ab'il ix yak' yajalil winh t'a skal heb' yetisraelal, masanto ayik ix cham winh. Ha t'a Samir chi' ix mukji winh.
Ixlajwi chi', haxo winhaj Jair aj Galaad, ix ak'an yajalil, 22 ab'il ix yak' yajalil chi' winh t'a skal heb' yetisraelal.

Ha winhaj Jair chi', 30 heb' winh yuninal winh, yib'annhej nok' b'uru tzek' junjun heb' winh yuninal winh chi'. Ay junjun schonhab' heb' winh t'a yol smakb'en Galaad chi'. Ha yuj 30 schonhab' heb' winh chi', ix b'inajkan icha tik: Ha juntzanh schonhab' winhaj Jair, xchi.
Ayic ix cham winhaj Jair chi', ha t'a chonhab' Camón ix mukji winh.

Ix cha ochxi ijan heb' israel sk'ulan chukal t'a yichanh Jehová. Ix laj yak'em sb'a heb' t'a juntzanh yechel Baal yet' Astarot. Ix yak'paxem sb'a heb' t'a sdiosal heb' aj Siria, heb' aj Sidón, heb' aj Moab, heb' aj Amón yet' t'a sdiosal heb' filisteo. Icha wal chi' ix aj yaktankan Jehová Dios heb', majxo ochlaj heb' ejmelal t'ay.
Yuj chi' ix kot yowal sk'ol Jehová chi' t'a heb', ix ak'jioch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' filisteo yet' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' amonita. Ha t'a jun ab'il chi', ix ak'ji ganar heb' yuj heb' ajk'ol chi'.
Ay 18 ab'il ix kan heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ol chi'. Ix ste ak'ej wal chukal heb' ajk'ol chi' t'a heb' israel kajan t'a Galaad t'a sk'axepalek' ha' Jordán t'a sluumkan heb' amorreo.
Ix k'axpajpaxek' heb' amonita chi' t'ha ha' Jordán yak' owal yet' heb' yinhtilal Judá yet' heb' yinhtilal Benjamín yet' pax heb' yinhtilal Efraín. Ix yilan heb' israel to yelk'olal wal tz'ixtaj heb'.
Ichato chi' ix sk'anan skolwal Jehová heb' yet'ok, ix yalan heb' icha tik: Ach ko Diosal, ix och wal ko mul t'ayach, ix ach kaktejkani, axonhej t'a Baal ix kak'em ko b'a, xchi heb'.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a heb' icha tik: Yixtejnac ex heb' aj Egipto, heb' amorreo, heb' amonita, heb' filisteo,
heb' sidonio, heb' amalekita yet' pax heb' madianita, haxo yik ex awaj t'ayin, ex in kolani.
Wach'chom ix ex in kolo', palta ix in eyaktejkani, haxo t'a juntzanh komon Dios ix eyak'em he b'a, yuj chi' a tiknaik, manhxo ol in kolwajlaj t'ayex.
Ixiquec k'anek skolwal juntzanh Dios ix he nib'ej chi'. Aokab' skolwaj eyed'ok ayik tzex k'och ijan t'a schukal icha tik, xchi t'a heb'.
Yuj chi' ix tak'wi heb' t'a Jehová chi' icha tik: D'a wal yel ix och ko mul t'ayach, palta a tiknaik syal tza b'o tas a gana t'a ko patik, palta anhej to tzonh a kolo', xchi heb'.
Ix smak'anpoj jantak sdiosal heb' ch'ok chonhab'il heb', haxo t'a Jehová ix ochxi heb' ejmelal. Yuj chi' maj techaj yuj Jehová chi', ix te kus yilanoch syaelal heb' chi'.
Ix smolb'an sb'a heb' amonita t'a Galaad, haxo pax heb' israel jun, ix smolb'ejpax sb'a heb' t'a Mizpa.
Ha heb' yajal t'a skal masanil heb' israel kajan t'a Galaad chi' ix alani: Ha junok mach tzonh kuchb'an t'a owal t'a heb' amonita, ha' ol ochkan kajalilok t'a Galaad tik, xchi heb'.
Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', ay jun winh skuchan Jefté kajan t'a yol yik Galaad. Te jelan winh t'a owal. Ha winhaj Jefté chi' yune' winh jun ix ajmul ix yet' jun winh skuchan Galaad.

Axo pax ix yetb'eyum winhaj Galaad chi' jun, ay pax heb' winh yune' ix. Ayic ix q'uib'k'e heb' winh chi', ix pechjiel winhaj Jefté chi' yuj heb' winh t'a te' pat chi'. Ix yalan heb' winh to malaj yalan yik winh ta' yujto ch'ok snun winh.

Icha chi' ix aj yel winhaj Jefté t'a heb' yuk'tak chi', ix b'atkan winh t'a yol yik Tob. Ata' ix smolb'ej jun nhilanh heb' winh winak winh. Tonhej ayek' juntzanh heb' winh chi', max munlajlaj jab'ok heb' winh. Ha heb' winh chi' ix och yet' winhaj Jefté chi', haxo elk'al ix yak' heb' winh.
Ix ek' jun pekti’, ix k'och heb' amonita yak' owal yet' heb' israel chi'.
Yuj chi', a heb' yajal t'a Galaad chi' ix schek heb' to b'at kot winhaj Jefté t'a yol yik Tob.
Ix yalanb'at heb' icha tik: --Cotanh t'a tik, ko gana to a ach tzach och kajalilok yik tzak'an owal yet' heb' amonita, xchi heb'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Jefté chi' icha tik: --Ha ex tik ix eyak' chukal t'ayin, ix eyak' pural in he pechanel t'a spat winh in mam, yuj chi' ¿tas yuj tzex jawi in he sayek' tiknaik ayik ayex och t'a syaelal? xchi winh.

--Toton yujto tzonh k'och wal t'a syaelal chi', yuj chi' tzonh jawi ach quila'. Co gana wal to tzach b'at qued'ok, a ach ol ak' owal yet' heb' amonita chi', a ach ol ach och kajalilok t'a ko masanil kajan onh t'a Galaad tik, xchi heb' t'a winh.
--Tato he gana tzin meltzaji yik swak' owal yet' heb' amonita chi', anhejtona' tato ol och Jehová wed'ok ayik ol wak'an ganar heb', ¿yel am wal ol in och eyajalilok chi'? xchi winh t'a heb'.
Axo heb' winh yajal chi' ix alanxi icha tik: --Ha Jehová skak'och ko testigook to ol ko k'ulej icha tzal chi', xchi heb'.
Ichato chi' ix b'at winhaj Jefté chi' yet' heb', ix yak'anoch winh heb' yajalilok. Ha t'a Mizpa ix yalxi winhaj Jefté t'a yichanh Jehová tas ix yal t'a heb' chekab' chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix schekanb'at juntzanh heb' schekab' winh sk'anb'ej t'a winh sreyal Amón icha tik: ¿Tas yuj aykot eyowal t'ayonh, yuj chi' tzex jawi eyak' owal qued'ok? xchib'at winh.

Ix spakan winh sreyal heb' amonita chi' icha tik: Ayic he kotnak a ex israel ex tik t'a Egipto, he jawinak t'a tik, he tok'ek' lum ko lu'um, sb'atnhej t'ha ha' Arnón masanto sk'och t'ha ha' Jaboc yet' t'ha ha' Jordán. Ha tiknaik jun, ak'ekxi lu'um t'ayonh t'a ak'ank'olal, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix schekanb'at juntzanhxo heb' schekab' winhaj Jefté chi' t'a winh sreyal heb' amonita chi',
yik b'at yalanxi heb' icha tik: Icha wal tik ix aj spakan winhaj Jefté: Ha onh israel onh tik, malaj lum he lu'um chi' quik'nak eq'ui, malaj pax lum yik heb' moabita quik'nak eq'ui.
Ayic yelnakkot heb' ko mam quicham t'a Egipto chi', ha t'a tzinan lum kotnak heb', masanto jawi heb' t'ha ha' Chacchac Mar, sjawipax heb' t'a Cades.

Schekannaccot juntzanh heb' schekab' heb' t'a winh sreyal Edom to schaek' heb' winh t'a yol smakb'en, palta maj chajiek'talaj heb' yuj winh. Anheja' yalanpax heb' t'a winh sreyal Moab to schaek' heb' winh t'a yol smakb'en, palta anheja' maj yalpax sk'ol winh schaek'ta heb'. Yuj chi' kannhej heb' t'a Cades chi'.

Slajwi chi' yek'nhej heb' t'a taquinh lu'um, yoyankot sb'a heb' t'a spatiktak smakb'en heb' Edom yet' t'a spatiktak yik heb' Moab chi', masanto jawi heb' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a Moab chi'. Axo ta' och waan heb', kan heb' t'a junxo sk'axepalb'at ha' Arnón. Palta maj k'axpajek'talaj heb', yujto ata' tz'el yich lum yik heb' Moab chi'.
Yuj chi' yak'b'at schekab' heb' t'a winhaj Sehón sreyal heb' amorreo, kajan t'a Hesbón. Yalcot heb' t'a winh to schaek' heb' winh t'a yol smakb'en, yik sk'och heb' t'a lum sluum.

Palta maj schalaj yab' winh, maj chajiek'talaj heb' yuj winh t'a yol smakb'en chi'. Anhej to smolb'ej masanil heb' soldado winh, sb'oank'e skampamento heb' t'a Jahaza, yak'annak owal winh yet' heb' ko mam quicham chi'.

Palta haxo Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, a ak'anoch winhaj Sehón yet' masanil heb' anima t'a schonhab' chi' t'a yol sk'ab' heb', yuj chi' ak'ji ganar winh yuj heb'. Icha chi' aj yik'annakkan slum heb' amorreo chi' heb' t'a jun chonhab' chi'.
Yik'annakkan masanil lum sluum heb' amorreo chi' heb', skotnhej t'ha ha' Arnón masanto sjawi t'ha ha' Jaboc. Scotpax t'a taquinh lu'um masanto t'ha ha' Jordán.
Ha lum sluum heb' amorreo yik'naquek' Jehová yak'annakkan t'a heb' ko mam quicham chi', ¿tom he gana tze tok'xiek' lum t'ayonh tiknaik?
Q'uinalok a Quemos he diosal tz'ak'an jab'ok tas t'ayex he makb'enok, ¿tom max he cha eyikok jun? Icha pax chi' kaj a onh tik, a tas syak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayonh, a chi' ko makb'en yaji.

¿Tom tza na' to te ek'alto alan ik t'a jun lu'um tik t'a yichanh winhaj Balac yuninal winhaj Zipor, sreyal Moab? Ha winh chi' manh yak'nakoklaj owal winh yet' heb' ko mam quicham chi' yuj jun lu'um tik.

Ayxo 300 ab'il ko kajnaj t'a Hesbón, t'a Aroer yet' t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a slak'anil yet' t'a smasanil juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a stitak ha' Arnón. ¿Tas yuj ato tiknaik tzeyak' yowalil t'ayonh yuj jun lu'um tik?

Ha in tik, malaj junok tas chuk tzin k'ulej t'ayach. Palta a ach tik, chuk tas tza k'ulej, tzach jawi ak' owal qued'ok. Palta jun, a Jehová wan onh yilani, ha' ol ch'olb'itan tas kaj eyed'ok, xchib'at winhaj Jefté chi'.
Wach'chom icha chi' ix yalb'at winhaj Jefté chi', palta maj schalaj yab' winh rey chi'.

Ix och Yespíritu Jehová t'a winhaj Jefté chi', ix ek' winh t'a yol yik Galaad yet' t'a yol yik Manasés, masanto ix k'och winh t'a Mizpa t'a yol yik Galaad chi', yik smolb'an heb' soldado winh yik sb'at yak'an owal heb' yet' heb' amonita chi'.
Ha winhaj Jefté chi', ix yak' sti' winh t'a Jehová icha tik: Tato ol ak'och heb' amonita t'a yol in k'ab',
a mach ol b'ab'laj elta in scha t'a sti' in pat, ayik ol in jax t'a owal tik, ol in nhus silab'il t'ayach, xchi winh.
Ix b'at winhaj Jefté chi' yet' heb' soldado yak' owal yet' heb' amonita chi'. Yuj skolwal Jehová ix yak' ganar winhaj Jefté chi'.
Tzijtum heb' ajk'ol chi' ix cham yuj heb', 20 chonhab' ix yak' ganar heb' t'a skal Aroer, t'a Minit yet' t'a Abel-queramim. Icha wal chi' ix aj yak'ji ganar heb' amonita yuj heb' israel chi'.
Axo yik ix jax winhaj Jefté t'a spat t'a Mizpa, a jun pitanh ix yisil winh ix elta ul scha'a, wan schanhalwi ix, wan stzinhan pandereta ix ayik ix elta ix chi'. Anhej ix, malaj junok yuninal winh.

Ha wal yik ix elta ix chi', ix snhik'chitanb'at spichul winh yuj skusk'olal, ix yalan winh: --Ay... ach wisil. Swab' wal syail uuj. Ix ik' wal kot jun yaelal tik t'a wib'anh, yujto ix wak' in ti' t'a Jehová, yuj chi' a tiknaik, yowalil ol in k'anab'ajej tas ix wal chi', xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi ix t'a winh: --Mamin, tato ix ak' a ti' ak'an junok tas t'a Jehová chi', k'ulej t'ayin icha ix aj ak'an a ti' chi', yujto toxo ix ak'jioch heb' ajk'ol chi' t'a yol a k'ab' yuj Jehová chi'.
Anhej jun tzin k'an t'ayach to tzak' chab'okxo ujal t'ayin yik b'at in b'eyek' yet' heb' ix wetkob'estaquil t'a jolomtak witz, yik tzin ok' yet' heb' ix ta', yujto manh ol ochlaj wetb'eyum, xchi ix.
Ix yak' chab'xo ujal chi' winhaj Jefté chi' t'a ix. Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', ix b'at ix t'a jolomtak witz yet' heb' ix chi', ix ok' ix, yujto junelnhej manh ol ochlaj yetb'eyum ix.
Ixlajwi chab' ujal chi', ix paxta ix b'aj ay winh smam chi'. Ix yak'anelk'och winhaj Jefté b'aj ix yak' sti' t'a Jehová chi'. Maj ochlaj yetb'eyum ix yisil winh chi' masanto ix cham ix.
Ix ochkan jun chi' sb'eyb'alok heb' israel chi', junjun ab'il smolb'an sb'a heb' ix kob'estak, chanhe' k'ual tz'ok' heb' ix, yuj snajikot ix yisil winhaj Jefté chi'.

Ix smolb'an sb'a masanil heb' winh winak t'a yinhtilal Efraín, ix sk'axpitan ha' Jordán heb' winh t'a stojolalb'at chonhab' Zafón. Ix yalan heb' winh t'a winhaj Jefté chi' icha tik: --¿Tas yuj maj al t'ayonh ayik ach b'at t'a owal yet' heb' amonita? Tato ix al t'ayonh, ix am onh b'at ed'ok. Ha tiknaik ol ach ko nhustz'ha t'a yol a pat tik, xchi heb' winh t'a winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Jefté chi' t'a heb' winh: --Ha in tik yet' heb' wetchonhab', ay jun niwan owal t'a ko kal yet' heb' amonita chi'. Ix ex wawtej, palta maj ex jawoklaj onh he kolo'.

Yujto ix wila'' to maj ex jawoklaj onh he kolo', yuj chi' ix in b'ek in b'a in cham t'a owal chi'. Ix wak'an owal yet' heb' amonita chi'. Ix kak' ganar heb' yujto a Jehová ix ak'anoch heb' t'a yol ko k'ab'. Yuj chi' ¿tas yuj tzex jawi eyak' owal t'ayin tiknaik? xchi winh.

Ix b'uchji heb' aj Galaad yuj heb' aj Efraín chi', ix yalan heb' icha tik: Ha ex tik, t'a ko kal elnak ex yet' t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Manasés, xchi heb'. Yuj chi' masanil heb' anima kajan t'a Galaad chi', ix smolb'ej heb' winhaj Jefté chi', ix yak'an owal heb' yet' heb' yinhtilal Efraín chi', ix ak'ji ganar heb' yuj winh.

Ha heb' aj Galaad chi', ix och heb' smak t'a sjayil sti' ha' Jordán, yuj chi' a heb' yinhtilal Efraín chi' tz'el lemnajok yik sk'axpaj heb' t'ha ha' Jordán chi', sk'anb'an heb' aj Galaad chi' t'a heb' tato yinhtilal Efraín heb'. Maay, tato xchi heb',

syalan heb' aj Galaad chi' t'a heb' icha tik: “Xibolet”, xe chi anh, xchi heb'. Tato “Sibolet” xchi heb', syalelk'ochi to yinhtilal Efraín heb', yujto manh wach'ok tz'aj yalan heb'. Icha chi' tz'aj syamchajelta heb', smiljicham heb' t'a sti' ha' Jordán chi' yuj heb' aj Galaad chi'. 42 mil wal heb' winak t'a yinhtilal Efraín ix cham ta'.
Vaque' ab'il ix och winhaj Jefté yajalil t'a skal heb' yetisraelal. Axo ix cham winh, ix mukji winh t'a schonhab' t'a yol yik Galaad.
Ayic ayxo scham winhaj Jefté chi', ix och winhaj Ibzán aj Belén yajalilok heb' yetisraelal chi'.

Ha winh chi', 30 heb' yuninal winh yet' 30 heb' ix yisil winh. Ix och yetb'eyum heb' ix yisil winh chi' t'a skal heb' manhxalaj yuj sb'a yet'ok. Anheja' pax heb' yuninal winh chi', a heb' ix manhxalaj yuj sb'a heb' winh yet'ok ix yik'a'. Ha winhaj Ibzán chi', uque' ab'il ix yak' yajalil winh t'a skal heb' yetisraelal chi'.
Ayic ix cham winh, ha t'a Belén ix mukji winh.
Ixlajwi chi', haxo winhaj Elón t'a yinhtilal Zabulón ix ak'an yajalil t'a skal heb' yetisraelal chi'. Lajunhe' ab'il ix yak' yajalil chi' winh.
Ayic ix cham winh, ix mukji winh t'a Ajalón t'a smakb'en heb' yinhtilal Zabulón chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', haxo winhaj Abdón yuninal winhaj Hilel aj Piratón ix ak'an yajalil t'a skal heb' yetisraelal chi'.
Vajxaque' ab'il ix yak' yajalil chi' winh. 40 yuninal winh yet' 30 yixchiquin winh. Junjun heb' winh chi', sk'e heb' winh t'a yib'anh nok' b'uru.
Ayic ix cham winh, ix mukji winh t'a Piratón, t'a yol smakb'en heb' yinhtilal Efraín t'a tzalquixtak t'a yol yik heb' Amalec.
Ix ochxi smul heb' israel t'a yichanh Jehová, yuj chi' 40 ab'il ix ak'jioch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' filisteo yuj.
Ha t'a chonhab' Zora, t'a yol smakb'en heb' yinhtilal Dan, ay jun winh skuchan Manoa. Ha ix yetb'eyum winh, malaj yune' ix, yujto max unewilaj ix.
Ix sch'ox sb'a Yángel Jehová t'a ix, ix yalani: --Ha ach tik wal yel malajtaxon junok une' ix il sat. Palta a tiknaik, ol a kuchkanoch une', ol aljok jun a winak unin.
Ayic ol b'eyb'at tik, manhxo uk'laj wino, manhxo uk'paxlaj junok tas pajb'inak. Manhxo a chipaxlaj tas ay yowalil t'a yichanh ley.
Ayic ol aljok jun une' chi', manh ol joxjiel-laj xil sjolom, yujto nazareo ol ajok, yujto yik Dios yaji ayik manto aljok. A' ol chaanel yich ex skolanel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' filisteo, xchi t'a ix.

Ix b'at ix b'aj ayek' winh yetb'eyum, ix yalan ix t'a winh: Ay jun schekab' Dios ix ulek' b'aj ayin eq'ui. Ix te sat in k'ool yuj, icha wal to Yángel Dios ix wila''. Maj in k'anb'ejlaj t'ay b'ajtil ix koti, maj yalpaxlaj sb'i t'ayin.

Anhej to ix yal t'ayin, tob' ol aljok junok wune'. Ix yalani to manhxo ol wuk'laj wino yet' junokxo tas pajb'inak yet' junok tas to ay yowalil ko chi'an t'a yichanh ley. Axob' jun unin chi', tob' yik Dios yaji ayik ol aljok chi', masanto ol chamok, xchi ix.

Yuj chi' ix lesalwi winhaj Manoa chi' t'a Jehová icha tik: Mamin, elok wal t'a a k'ool to tza chekxikot a chekab' chi' t'ayonh, yik wach' ol yal t'ayonh tas wal ol ko k'ulej yet' jun unin ol aljok chi', xchi winh.
Ix yab' Dios tas ix sk'an winh chi', ix sch'oxanxi sb'a Yángel Jehová chi' t'a ix yetb'eyum winh chi' ayik wan yik'an yip ix t'a kal munlajel, palta manh ayoquek'laj winhaj Manoa chi' ta' yet' ix.
Elanhchamel ix b'at lemnaj ix yal t'a winh: --Lemach, yujto ix sch'oxxi sb'a jun chekab' t'ayin, jun ul lolon t'ayin t'a junel, xchi ix.

Ix kot lemnaj winhaj Manoa chi', ix b'at winh yet' ix yetb'eyum chi', ix k'och winh b'aj ayek' Yángel Jehová chi', ix sk'anb'an winh t'ay: --¿Tom a ach tik ul ach ek' lolonel t'a ix wetb'eyum tik t'a junel? xchi winh t'ay. --I', a in toni, xchi t'a winh.
Ix sk'anb'anxi winh t'ay: --Ayic ol elk'och tas ix al chi', ¿tas wal ol kutej quilan q'uib' winh unin chi' yet' tas yopisio winh? xchi winh t'ay.
Ix tak'wi Yángel Jehová chi': --Yowalil sk'anab'ajej ix etb'eyum tik tas ix wala':

Jantacnhej tas skot t'a sat te' uwa, manhxo ol slolaj ix. Mokab' yuk' wino ix yet' junokxo tas pajb'inak, ma tas ay yowalil schiji t'a yichanh ley. Ha tas ix wal chi' t'a ix, yowalil sk'anab'ajej ix, xchi t'a winh.

Ha winhaj Manoa chi', manh yojtakok winh tato Yángel Jehová jun chi', yuj chi' ix yal winh: --Swal t'ayach, komonok tz'el t'a a k'ool tzonh a tanhwej, tik b'at ko b'o junok nok' yune' chiwa a chi'a, xchi winh t'ay. Ix tak'wi jun Ángel chi': --Wach'chom tzin kan eyed'ok, palta manh ol in walaj. Syal eyak'an nok' chi' silab'il t'a Jehová, xchi.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Manoa chi' t'ay icha tik: --Alcan a b'i t'ayonh yik wach' ayik tz'elk'och tas ix ul alkan tik t'ayonh, ol kak' yuj diosal t'ayach, xchi winh t'ay.
Ix tak'wi Ángel chi' t'a winh: --¿Tas yuj tze k'anb'ej in b'i chi'? Ha jun chi' te satub'tak yochi, xchi.

Ix yik'ankot nok' chiwa winhaj Manoa chi' yet' juntzanh ixim sat trigo t'a ofrendail. Ix snhusantz'a silab' winh t'a Jehová t'a yib'anh jun k'een k'een. Ixlajwi chi', ix sch'oxan jun milagro Jehová t'a yichanh winh yet' ix yetb'eyum chi'.
Ayic ix k'e nhilnaj k'ak' t'a yib'anh altar chi', ix och Yángel Jehová chi' t'a skal k'ak' chi', ix paxk'ei. Ayic ix yilan heb' icha chi', ix em kumnaj heb', ix em nhojan heb' t'a sat lu'um.
Ichato chi' ix nachajel yuj winhaj Manoa chi' to Yángel Jehová jun chi'. Majxo sch'oxlaj sb'a junelxo t'a winh yet' t'a ix yetb'eyum winh chi'.
Ix yalan winh t'a ix yetb'eyum chi' icha tik: --Ha tiknaik t'a wal yel ol onh chamok, yujto ix quil wal och Dios, xchi winh t'a ix.
Ix tak'wi ix t'a winh icha tik: --Tato snib'ej Jehová to tzonh chami, maj am scha ko silab' ix kak' t'ay yet' kofrenda, maj am sch'ox juntzanh tik quila', maj am yal juntzanh tik t'ayonh, xchi ix.
Ayic ix alji yune' ix chi', Sansón ix yak' ix sb'iej. Ix q'uib' winh unin chi', ix yak' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a yib'anh winh.
Ix schaanel yich sch'oxan sb'a Yespíritu Jehová t'a winh ayik ayek' winh t'a skampamento heb' yinhtilal Dan, t'a skal chonhab' Zora yet' Estaol.
Ha t'a junel, ix em winhaj Sansón t'a yol jun schonhab' heb' filisteo skuchan Timnat, ix kan snib'ej winh t'a jun ix kob'es ta'.

Axo yik ix jax winh t'a spat, ix yalan winh t'a winh smam yet' t'a ix snun icha tik: --Ay jun ix kob'es ix wil t'a Timnat t'a skal heb' ix filistea, ix kan in gana t'a ix, yuj chi' swal t'ayex to b'at he k'an ix wik'a', xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi smam snun winh chi', ix yalan heb' icha tik: --¿Tas yuj ha t'a skal heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ol b'at a say ix etb'eyum? ¿Tom manhxa junok ix ix wach' ik'an t'a skal heb' ayto kuj ko b'a yet'ok, mato t'a skal heb' quetchonhab' tik? xchi heb' t'a winh. Ix tak'wi winh icha tik: --Ha wal jun ix chi' in gana. Ha ix b'at he k'an wik'a', xchi winh.
Te manh yojtakok heb' smam snun winh chi' tas spensar Jehová, to wan snaan tas ol aj yel yich junok owal yet' heb' filisteo chi', yujto ayoch heb' israel t'a yalanh smandar heb' t'a jun pekti’ chi'.

Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Sansón yet' heb' smam snun t'a chonhab' Timnat chi'. Ayic ix ek' heb' t'a jun makan te' uwa awab'il yuj heb' aj Timnat chi', ix elta jun nok' quelem choj t'a winhaj Sansón chi', tz'el yaw nok' skot nok' t'a winh.

D'a wal jun rato chi', ix och Yespíritu Jehová t'a winh, ix te och yip winh, malaj wal jab'ok tas yet'nak winh yet' wal sk'ab' winh ix sjekchitanb'at jun nok' choj chi', icha tz'aj sjekchitajb'at junok yune' chiwa. Maj yal-laj winh t'a smam snun tas ix sk'ulej chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix k'och heb' t'a chonhab' Timnat chi', ix lolon winh yet' ix kob'es chi', ix kannhej snib'ej winh t'a ix.

Axo yik ix ek'b'at jaye' k'ual, ayik wan sb'at winhaj Sansón yik ol nupnaj yet' ix filistea chi', ix ek' winh b'aj ix smilcham nok' choj chi'. Axo ix k'och winh, ix yilan winh, ayxo och jun nok' chab' t'a yol sjoyumteal sb'aquil nok', te b'ut'an yool chi' yuj yal nok' chab' chi'.

Ix yik'anelta nok' winh, ix sloan winh, ix b'at winh. Axo ix k'och winh t'a spatik smam snun chi', ix yak'an nok' yalchab' chi' winh slo heb'. Maj yal-laj winh t'a heb' tato ha t'a yol sjoyumteal sb'aquil nok' choj ix yik'elta nok' yalchab' chi' winh.
Ix emk'och smam snun winh chi' t'a spat ix kob'es chi', ix yak'anoch jun q'uinh yik nupnajel winhaj Sansón chi', ichataxon sb'eyb'al heb' winh kelemtak t'a jun chonhab' chi'.
Ayic ix yilan winhaj Sansón heb' winh filisteo chi', ix yawtankot 30 heb' winh kelemtak heb' winh yik syil q'uinh nupnajel chi' heb' winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Sansón t'a heb' winh kelemtak chi' icha tik: --Ay jun lolonel ol wal t'ayex, a exxo ol he na'a tas syalelk'ochi: Tato ha t'a uque' k'ual q'uinh tik ol eyal tas syalelk'ochi, ol wak' junjunok he pichul nab'a lino yet' junjunok he pichul yik q'uinh.

Tato manh ol nachajel eyuj jun, a ex ol eyak' junjunok k'apak nab'a lino chi' t'ayin yet' junjunok mojanh in pichul yik q'uinh, xchi winh. Ix tak'wi heb' winh t'a winh icha tik: --Al naik kab' an, ol kab'i tas jun lolonel chi', xchi heb' winh.

Ix yalan winh icha tik: Ha t'a junok chiwajum, ata' ix elta tas tz'uk'chaji. Ha t'a jun te ay yip, ata' ix elta tas te chi', xchi winh. Axo t'a yoxil k'ual q'uinh chi', maj yal-laj spakan jun lolonel chi' heb' winh kelemtak chi'.

Yuj chi' haxo t'a schanhil k'ual, ix yalan heb' winh t'a ix yetb'eyum winhaj Sansón chi' icha tik: --Montej ab' t'a winh etb'eyum chi' tas syalelk'och jun lolonel ix yal winh t'ayonh, slajwi chi' tzalan t'ayonh. Tato maay, ol ach ko nhustz'a yet' a mam a nun yet' masanil mach ayek' t'a yol a pat tik. Ichato tonhej tzonh eyawtejkot t'a tik, yik tze k'ananek' tas ay t'ayonh, xchi heb' winh t'a ix.

Ixlajwi chi', wan yok' ix, ix b'at yalan ix t'a winhaj Sansón chi': --Tzin a chak a ach tik. Max in a xajanejlaj. Ix al jun a lolonel yik snael heb' winh wetchonhab', palta manh wal jab'ok tzal t'ayin tas syalelk'ochi, xchi ix t'a winh. Ix tak'wi winh t'a ix icha tik: --Max waltax t'a in mam in nun, atob' wal t'ayach ol wala', xchi winh.
Ix och wal ijan ix yok' t'a winh t'a uque' k'ual chi', yuj chi' haxo t'a yuquil k'ual chi', ix yalan winh t'a ix tas syalelk'ochi. Ixnhej lajwi yab'an ix, ix b'at yalan ix t'a heb' yetchonhab' chi'.
