Ha tiknaik tzeyak' b'ojok junok te' ak' karreta, tzeyik'ankot chawanhok nok' wakax ay yune', mantalaj b'aj tz'och te' yugo t'a sjaj nok', tze tzek'anoch te' yugo chi' t'a nok' schawanhil, tzeyak'anoch te' karreta chi' t'a te' yugo chi'. Manh he chab'at yune' nok' chi' yet'ok, tze makkan nok' t'a yol smakte'.

Slajwi chi', tzeyak'ank'e te' kaxa chi' t'a yol karreta chi', tzeyak'anem juntzanh oro chi' t'a yol junok kajón, tzeyak'ank'e t'a stz'ey te' kaxa chi', aton juntzanh chi' tzeyak'b'at stojolok he mul chi'. Slajwi chi', tzeyaktanb'at nok' wakax chi' yet' te' karreta chi' sch'okoj.

Tzeyilani tato ha t'a sb'eal Bet-semes ol b'at nok', tato icha chi' a Jehová sDiosal heb' israel tzonh ixtani. Tato ch'ok b'eal b'aj ol b'at nok' jun, manhok Jehová tz'ak'ankot jun yaelal tik t'ayonh, komon yaelalnhej am tzonh ik'ani, xchi heb' sakerdote chi'.
Icha chi' ix yutej heb' filisteo chi', a chawanh nok' wakax ay yune' ix yik'kot heb', ix smakankan nok' yune' chi' heb' t'a yol makte', ix stzek'anoch te' karreta chi' heb' t'a nok'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'ank'e te' skaxail strato Jehová chi' heb' yet' jun te' kajón b'aj ayem oro icha yechel nok' ch'oow yet' yechel quisk'oy chi'.

Ix yaktanel nok' wakax chi' heb', ix b'at nok' t'a sb'eal Bet-semes, tz'ok' nok' sb'at nok'. Manh wal jab'ok tz'elkan nok' t'a titak b'e chi'. Najat tzak'anto sb'at heb' filisteo chi' t'a spatik nok' yik syilan heb', masanto ix k'och heb' t'a smojonal Bet-semes chi'.
Ay heb' aj Bet-semes wan sjochwi trigo ayek' t'a jun ch'olan. Ayic ix yilan heb' to wan sjawi te' skaxail strato Jehová. Ix te tzalajk'e heb'.

Ha t'a jun ak'lik yik winhaj Josué, t'a yol yik Bet-semes chi' ix jawi te' karreta chi'. Ata' ix wanaj nok' wakax chi'. Ay jun k'een niwan k'een ta', haxo heb' lewita ix ik'anemta te' kaxa yik Jehová yet' te kajón b'aj ayem tastak chi'. Ix yak'ank'e te' heb' t'a yib'anh jun k'een niwan k'een chi'. Ix och ijan heb' xikanb'at te' karreta chi' k'atzitzal, ix snhusantz'a nok' wakax chi' heb' silab'il t'a Jehová.
Ix yil owanh heb' yajalil heb' filisteo, tas ix yutej heb' chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzaj heb' t'a chonhab' Ecrón t'a jun k'u chi'.
Ha oye' oro yechel jun yaelal ix yak'kot heb' filisteo chi' yuj stojolok smul t'a yichanh Jehová, junjun yik juntzanh chonhab' tik, aton Asdod, Gaza, Askalón, Gat yet' Ecrón.

Axo sb'isul oro yechel nok' ch'oow, lajan sb'isul icha sb'isul schonhab' heb' yajalil filisteo chi', aton chonhab' ayoch smuroal yet' yaldeail. Ha k'een niwan k'een t'a sat slum winhaj Josué b'aj ix ak'jik'e te' skaxail strato Jehová t'a Bet-semes chi', aynhejek' k'een.
Ix cham 70 winak aj Bet-semes chi' yuj Jehová, yujto ix say yil yol te' kaxa chi' heb'. Axo masanil heb' anima, ix ok' heb', yujto ix och chamel yuj Jehová.
Yuj chi' ix yal heb' anima ay ta': Malaj mach syal stek'b'an sb'ha t'a yichanh Jehová, yujto ay smay. ¿B'aj wal skak'b'at skaxail strato yik tz'elkan t'a ko tz'ey tik? xchi heb'.
Ix yak'anb'at schekab' heb' t'a Quiriat-jearim, ix yalan heb': Ix yak' meltzaj te' skaxail strato Jehová heb' filisteo, yuj chi' ik'ekk'e te', xchi heb'.

Ix k'och heb' aj Quiriat-jearim yik'kot te' skaxail strato Jehová chi', ix yak'anoch te' heb' t'a yol spat winhaj Abinadab ay t'a jun tzalan. Ix sik'jiel winhaj Eleazar yuninal winhaj Abinadab chi' yuj heb', yik stanhwan te' winh.
Ay am junok 20 ab'il ix kan te' skaxail strato Jehová t'a Quiriat-jearim chi'. Masanil heb' israel skus sk'ool, snib'ej heb' skolwaj Jehová yet'ok.

Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Samuel t'a heb': Tato t'a smasanil he k'ool, tzex meltzaj t'a Jehová, yowalil tzeyik'elta juntzanh sdiosal heb' ch'ok chonhab'il t'a he kal yet' yechel Astarot, tzeyak'anoch he b'ha t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová yik anhej tzeyak' serwil. Tato icha chi', ha' ol ex kolan t'a yol sk'ab' heb' filisteo.
Yuj chi' ix yik'elta juntzanh komon Dios chi' heb', aton yechel Baal yet' Astarot, axonhej t'a Jehová ix och heb' ejmelal.
Ix yalan winhaj Samuel chi' to smolb'ej sb'a masanil heb' chonhab' israel t'a Mizpa, yik stewi winh t'a Jehová yuj heb'.

Yuj chi' ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' ta'. Ha t'a jun k'u chi' ix yik'k'eta ha ha' heb', ix sekanem ha' heb' t'a sat lum t'a yichanh Jehová, ix och heb' smasanil t'a tzek'ojk'olal, ix yalan heb' icha tik: Ix och ko mul t'a yichanh Jehová. (Ha t'a Mizpa chi' ix sch'olb'itej heb' yetchonhab' winhaj Samuel chi'.)

Ayic ix yab'an heb' filisteo to ayek' molan heb' israel t'a Mizpa chi', ix smolb'anpax sb'a heb', yik skot heb' yak' owal yet' heb' israel chi'. Axo yik ix yab'an heb' israel icha chi', ix xiwk'e heb'.
Ix yalan heb' t'a winhaj Samuel chi': Manh aktej a tewi t'a Jehová to tzonh skol t'a heb' filisteo tik, xchi heb'.

Elanhchamel ix yik'kot jun nok' yune' kalnel tzato chuni winhaj Samuel chi', ix snhusantz'a nok' winh smasanil silab'il t'a Jehová, ix och ijan winh sk'anan skolwal. Elanhchamel ix tak'wi Jehová t'a winh.

Ayic wan yak'an silab' chi' winh, a heb' filisteo wan sjawi heb' yak' owal yet' heb' israel chi', haxo Jehová te chaanh ix ak'an mak'waj k'u t'a yichanh heb' filisteo chi', yuj chi' ix xiwk'e heb', ix el lemnaj heb' t'a heb' israel chi'.
Ix elta heb' israel t'a Mizpa chi', ix och heb' t'a spatik heb' filisteo chi'. Tzijtum heb' filisteo chi' ix cham yuj heb', masanto ix k'och heb' t'a yichanhb'at Bet-kar.

Ixlajwi chi', ix sayan jun k'een k'een winhaj Samuel chi', ix yak'anem k'een winh t'a skal Mizpa yet' Sen. Eben-ezer ix yak' winh sb'iej, ix yalan winh: Masanto tiknaik ix kolwajnhej Jehová qued'ok, xchi winh.

Ha t'a jun k'u chi' ix ak'ji ganar heb' filisteo yuj heb' israel chi'. Yuj chi' manhxa junelokxo ix och heb' t'a yol slugar heb' israel yak' owal. Yakb'an pitzanto winhaj Samuel chi', aynhejoch Jehová xib'tan heb' filisteo chi'.

Ha juntzanh chonhab' yet' smakb'en heb' yik'naquek' heb' filisteo chi', schab'at t'a Ecrón, masanto sk'och t'a Gat, ix yik'xikanek' heb' israel chi'. Axo heb' amorreo, malaj owal t'a skal heb' yet' heb' israel chi'.
Ix yak' yajalil winhaj Samuel t'a chonhab' Israel chi' masanto ix cham winh.
Junjun ab'il xid'ek' winh t'a Betel, t'a Gilgal yet' t'a Mizpa, yuj sch'olb'itan winh tas yaj heb' anima t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi'.
Slajwi chi', smeltzaj winh t'a Ramá, b'aj kajantaxoni. Ata' sch'olb'itejpax heb' yetchonhab' winh. Ix sb'oank'e jun altar yik Jehová winh ta'.
Ayic ix ichamax winhaj Samuel chi', ix yak'anoch chawanh heb' winh yuninal winh yajalilok heb' chonhab' chi'.
Joel sb'i jun winh b'ab'el, haxo junxo winh, Abías sb'i winh. Ix yak' yajalil heb' winh t'a Beerseba.

Palta manhok sb'eyb'al winh smam heb' winh chi' ix sb'eyb'alej. Ha wal t'a k'een tumin ix yak'och spensar heb' winh. Scha k'een heb' winh t'a elk'altak, malaj swach'il syutej heb' winh sch'olb'itan yaj heb' anima.
Yuj chi' ix smolb'ej sb'a masanil heb' yichamtak winaquil chonhab', ix b'at heb' yil winhaj Samuel chi' t'a Ramá.

Ix yalan heb' winh: Ha ach tik, te icham winak achxo, haxo heb' winh uninal, manh ichaok ix utej a b'a syutej sb'a heb' winh, te chuk syutej sb'a heb' winh. Yuj chi' to tza sayoch junok ko reyal yik tzonh skuchb'an icha yaj juntzanhxo nakión, xchi heb' winh.
Maj schalaj sk'ol winhaj Samuel chi' ayik ix yab'an winh to snib'ej junok sreyal heb' yik skuchb'aj heb'. Yuj chi' ix lesalwi winh t'a Jehová.
Ix tak'wi Jehová chi' t'a winh: k'anab'ajej masanil tas sk'an heb' chonhab' chi', yujto manhok ach tzach spatiquejel heb', palta a in, yujto manhxa snib'ej heb' swak' yajalil t'a yib'anh.
Atax yik wik'annaquelta heb' t'a Egipto, tz'ochnhej heb' ejmelal t'a komon Dios, malaj welk'och t'a heb'. Icha wal ix in yutej heb', icha wal chi' tzach yutej heb' tiknaik.
Yuj chi', k'anab'ajej tas syal heb'. Palta yowalil tzak' yojtaquejel heb' tastak ol utaj heb' yuj jun sreyal ol och chi', xchi t'a winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' ix k'anan sreyal chi', icha ix aj yalan Jehová chi'.

Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Icha wal tik ol ex yutok jun winh he reyal ol yak' yajalil t'a he kal chi': Ol smolb'ej masanil heb' eyuninal winh, ay heb' ol yak'och winh t'a yol karruaje yik owal, ay heb' ol k'e t'a yib'anh chej yik sb'at t'a owal, ay pax heb' ol ochkan stanhwumalok winh.

Ay heb' ol yak'och winh yajalil t'a junjun nhilanh soldado. Ay pax heb' ol och munlajel t'a sluum winh, ol ochpax heb' jochoj trigo. Ay pax heb' ol och b'o'oj yamk'ab' yik owal yet' t'a b'o'oj tastak tz'och t'a karruaje yik owal.
Ol yik'anb'at heb' ix eyisil winh t'a spat. Ay heb' ix ol och b'o'oj perfume, ma b'o'oj wael yet' t'a b'o'oj pan.
Ol stok'ek' swach'il lum he lu'um winh yet' tas awab'il eyuuj, te' uwa yet' te' oliwo, ol yak'an winh t'a heb' ayoch yajalil yet'ok.
Ha tas tzeyawej, ol yik'el sdiezmoal winh yet' he wino, ol yak'an winh t'a heb' ayoch yajalil yet'ok yet' t'a heb' schekab' chi'.
Ol yik'anpaxek' heb' he chekab' winh yet' heb' ix he chekab'. Ol yik'anpaxek' nok' he wakax winh yet' nok' he b'uru te wach', ol yak'anoch winh t'a smunlajel.
Anheja' ol yik'paxek' sdiezmoal nok' he kalnel winh, ol eyak'an serwil winh.
Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', olto eyal he b'ha t'a Jehová yuj tas ol ex utaj yuj winh he reyal ol he sik'och chi', palta manhxo ol kolwaj eyed'ok, xchi winhaj Samuel chi'.
Palta maj schalaj yab' heb' chonhab' tas ix yal winh chi'. Ix tak'wi heb' icha tik: --Malaj yelk'och juntzanh chi', anhej to tz'och junok ko reyal.
Co gana lajan tzonh aj icha juntzanhxo nakión, ko gana to ay junok ko reyal tz'ak'an yajalil t'a ko kal, tzonh skuchb'anpax t'a owal, xchi heb'.
Ayic ix yab'an winh tas ix yal heb' anima chi', ix yalanxi winh t'a Jehová.

Ix tak'wi Jehová chi' t'a winh icha tik: --k'anab'ajej tas syal heb' chi', ak'och junok sreyal heb', xchi t'a winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb': Meltzajanhec t'a he chonhab' b'ela, xchi winh.

Ha t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Benjamín, ay jun winh winak skuchan Cis, yuninal winhaj Abiel, yixchiquin winhaj Zeror. Ha winhaj Zeror chi' yuninal winhaj Becorat, yixchiquin winhaj Afía. Niwan yelk'och winhaj Cis chi' t'a heb' anima.

Ay jun yuninal winh skuchan Saúl, te wach' sniwanil. Ha t'a skal masanil heb' israel, malaj junok wach' yilji t'a yichanh winhaj Saúl chi', te chaanh steel winh. Ha masanil heb' winak t'a Israel, anhej t'a sjolom sjenhjab' winh sk'ek'och heb'.

Ay jun k'u ix satb'at juntzanh nok' sb'uru winhaj Cis chi'. Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a winh yuninal chi': --Ak' lista a b'a, sb'at a sayan nok' b'uru chi', ik'b'at junok heb' winh ko chekab' ed'ok, xchi winh.

Ix b'at winhaj Saúl chi', ix k'axpajb'at winh t'a skal lum tzalquixtak t'a yol yik Efraín, ix ek' winh t'a yol yik Salisa. Maj chaxlaj nok' b'uru chi' yuj winh. Ix ek'pax winh t'a yol smakb'en Saalim yet' t'a yol yik Benjamín, palta malaj nok'.
Axo ix k'och winh t'a yol smakb'en Zuf, ix yalan winh t'a winh schekab' chi': --Conh meltzaj t'a tik, haxo ta tz'aji, swach' och winh in mam t'a ilk'olal kuuj t'a yichanh nok' b'uru chi', xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winh chekab' chi': --Ha t'a yol jun chonhab' tik ay jun winh schekab' Dios, te niwan yelk'och winh t'a heb' anima, masanil tas syal winh, tz'elnhejk'ochi. B'at quila', ol yal winh tas b'eal ol quik'a', xchi winh.
--Conh an, anhej to malaj jab'ok tas squik'b'at t'a winh, malaj junok ixim pan ay t'a yol ko pa. Malaj jab'ok tas ol kak' t'a winh, ¿tas wal ol quik'b'ati? xchi winhaj Saúl chi'.
Ix tak'wi winh chekab' chi': --Ay jab' tumin plata wed'nak, ol kak' k'een t'a winh schekab' Jehová chi', yik ol yal winh tas ol onh ajok, xchi winh.

(Ha t'a peka' chi', tato ay junok israel snib'ej sk'anb'ej yab' srazón d'ha Dios syalan icha tik: B'at quil jun winh syal yilan chi', xchi heb'. Ha winh tz'alji schekab'ok Dios chi' tiknaik, ha t'a peka', a winh syal yilan junok tas ol ujok, sb'i winh yuj heb'.)
--Wach' jun, b'at quila', xchi winhaj Saúl chi'. Ix b'at heb' winh schawanhil b'aj ayek' winh schekab' Dios chi'.

Ayic wan sk'e heb' winh t'a switzal chonhab' chi', ix schalan sb'a heb' winh yet' juntzanh heb' ix kob'estak wan sb'at ik'oj ha', ix sk'anb'an heb' winh t'a heb' ix icha tik: --¿Ay am ek' winh schekab' Dios syal yilan tas ol ujok? xchi heb' winh.

Ix tak'wi heb' ix: --Ayek' winh t'a eyichanhb'at chi', palta tato tze pil wal jab'okxo eyip olto ilchaj winh eyuuj. Toto wal sjawi winh t'a yol chonhab' tik yujto ay q'uinh ol och t'a tzalan b'aj tz'och ejmelal.

Anhej tzex k'ochi tze sayanek' winh t'a kal chonhab' chi', yakb'an manto b'at winh b'aj tz'och ejmelal chi' b'aj tanhwab'il yuj heb' anima. Masanto ol k'och winh, ichato chi' ol yalan wach' lolonel winh t'a yib'anh silab', haxo swa winh yet' heb' anima awtab'il chi'. Yuj chi' ixiquek wal tiknaik, k'okb'ilto ol eyil winh, xchi heb' ix.
Ix b'at heb' winh b'ian, haxo yik wan sk'och heb' winh t'a yol chonhab' chi', k'okb'il wal ix schalaj sb'a heb' winh yet' winhaj Samuel chi', wan sb'at winh t'a jun tzalan b'aj ol och ejmelal chi'.
K'ik'anokto sk'och winhaj Saúl, ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Samuel chi':

Ha k'ik'an yab' icha tik, swak'kot jun winh winak t'ayach, ha t'a yol yik Benjamín skot winh. Tzak'k'e akeite t'a sjolom winh, a winh ol och yajalil t'a chonhab' Israel tik. Ha winh ol kolan in chonhab' tik t'a yol sk'ab' heb' filisteo, yujto toxo ix kus in k'ol yuj b'aj ix tewi heb' t'ayin, xchi t'a winh.
Ayic ix yilan winhaj Saúl winhaj Samuel chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winh: Aton winh tik wal t'ayach ewi, a winh ol och yajalilok in chonhab', xchi t'a winh.
Ha t'a spuertail chonhab' chi', ata' ix schalaj sb'a heb' winh, ix yalan winhaj Saúl t'a winhaj Samuel chi': --Al t'ayin mamin, b'ajtil ay spat winh schekab' Dios syal yilan tas ol ujok, xchi winh.
--Ha in toni. Conh wed'ok, b'ab'lajanh. Ol ach wa wed' b'aj wan in b'at chi'. Ato k'ik'an swal t'ayach tas a gana tza k'anb'ej chi', slajwi chi' tzach paxi.

Ha yuj nok' b'uru ix satb'at t'ayach yiktax oxji, manh ak' pensar yuj nok', toxo ix chax nok'. Palta ay jun mach te nib'ab'il yuj heb' quetchonhab' israel tik, a ach toni yet' heb' a k'ab' ok, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Saúl chi': --Ha in tik, yinhtilal in Benjamín, yelxo wal jaywannhej ko b'isul t'a quinhtilal chi' t'a skal masanil heb' quetisraelal. Anheja' heb' sk'ab' yok in mam chi', malaj quelk'och t'a skal heb' quinhtilal chi'. ¿Tas wal yuj tzal juntzanh tik t'ayin? xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix ik'jib'at winh yet' winh schekab' yuj winhaj Samuel chi' t'a yol jun kuarto, ix ak'ji jun k'ojnub' te niwan yelk'och t'a heb' winh t'a skal heb' winh awtab'il wael chi', ay am junok 30 heb' winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Samuel chi' t'a jun winh ilum wael t'a kokina icha tik: --Ik'kot nok' chib'ej ix wal t'ayach to ch'ok tzik'kaneli, xchi winh.

Elanhchamel ix yik'kot jun nok' xub' winh, ix yak'an winh t'a winhaj Saúl chi'. Ix yalan winhaj Samuel chi' t'a winhaj Saúl chi': --Ha jun chib'ej tik ik'b'ilxokaneli, chi'a. Ha jun tik to naanxotax wuuj, ix in chek ik'jikaneli, ayik ix in chekan b'ojok jun q'uinh tik, xchi winh. Junnhej ix wa winhaj Saúl yet' winhaj Samuel chi' t'a jun k'u chi'.
Ayic ix emixta heb' winh ta', ix emul heb' winh t'a yol chonhab' chi', ix lolon winhaj Samuel yet' winhaj Saúl chi' t'a spanhanil yib'anh pat.

Axo ix sakb'i t'a junxo k'u, ix awtaj winhaj Saúl yuj winhaj Samuel chi', ix yalan winh t'a winh icha tik: --Q'ueanh waan tzach b'ati, xchi winh. Ix k'e waan winh b'ian. Ixlajwi chi', ix el heb' winh t'a yol kalle.

Axo ix emk'och heb' winh t'a titak chonhab', ix yalan winhaj Samuel chi' t'a winhaj Saúl chi': --Al t'a winh a chekab' tik to sb'ab'lajb'at winh, tzach kan jab'okxo, yujto ol wal tas ix schek Jehová wal t'ayach, xchi winh. Ix schekan b'ab'laj winh schekab' winhaj Saúl chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'ankot jun yet'tal akeite winhaj Samuel chi', ix stob'ank'e akeite chi' winh t'a sjolom winhaj Saúl chi', ix stz'ub'anelta sti' winh, ix yalan winh: --Ha Jehová tzach sik'anel tiknaik yik tzach och yajalil t'a yib'anh schonhab'.

Ayic ol ko pukan ko b'a tik, ol a chalan a b'a yet' chawanh heb' winh winak t'a slak'anil b'aj mukan ix Raquel t'a chonhab' Selsa t'a yol yik Benjamín. Ha heb' winh chi' ol alan t'ayach to toxo ix chax nok' a b'uru tza saya', manhxo ayok och winh a mam t'a kusk'olal yuj nok', haxo pax uuj a ach tik syak' pensar winh yuj tas ol aj a chaxi.

Ayto wal jab'xo a k'och t'a te' ji t'a Tabor, ay oxwanh heb' winh winak ol a cha ta', wan sb'at heb' winh t'a Betel yik tz'och heb' winh ejmelal t'a Jehová ta'. Ay jun winh, oxwanh chiwa yet'nak winh, haxo junxo winh oxe' ixim pan yet'nak winh, haxo junxo winh, yet'nak jun tz'uum winh b'ut'an t'a wino.
Ol yak'an stzatzil a k'ol heb' winh, ol yak'an chab'ok ixim pan chi' heb' winh t'ayach, ol a cha ixim t'a heb' winh.

Slajwi chi', ol ach k'ek'och t'a chonhab' Gabaa, b'aj tz'ochtaxon ejmelal t'a Jehová, ata' ay jun yet'tal jun makan heb' filisteo. Ayic ol ach och t'a yol chonhab' chi', ol ilan jaywanh heb' winh schekab' Jehová wan yemuli, syalan slolonel Dios heb' winh, b'ab'el heb' winh wan yak'anoch salterio, pandereta, flauta yet' arpa.
Axo t'a jun rato chi', ol och Yespíritu Jehová t'ayach, icha heb' winh chi' ol ach ajok, ol k'exmaj a pensar.
Ayic ol ilani to icha chi' aji, a tas wach' ol ab'i, a ol a k'ulej, yujto ha Dios ol och ed'ok.

Slajwi chi', tzach b'ab'lajk'och t'a Gilgal. Ata' ol ko chalaj ko b'a, ol in nhusantz'a silab' yet' pax silab' yik junk'olal yet' Jehová. Uque' k'ual ol in a tanhwej ta', ato yik ol in k'ochok. Ichato chi' ol walan t'ayach tas ol a k'ulej, xchi winhaj Samuel chi'.
Ixnhej wal lajwi yalankan quil ko b'a winhaj Saúl t'a winhaj Samuel chi', ix k'exji spensar winh yuj Dios, yuj chi' a wal t'a jun k'u chi' ix elk'och juntzanh tas ix yal winhaj Samuel chi'.

Axo ix k'och winhaj Saúl chi' t'a Gabaa yet' winh schekab' chi', ix elta heb' winh schekab' Jehová icha ix aj yalan winhaj Samuel chi', ix chaji winh yuj heb' winh. Ha wal t'a jun rato chi', ix och Yespíritu Dios t'a winhaj Saúl, ix och ijan winh yalan slolonel Dios t'a skal heb' winh.

Ha mach ojtannak winhaj Saúl chi' t'a yalanhtaxo, ayik ix yilan heb' yoch winh ejmelal, ix yilanpax heb' to ix k'exmaj winh icha juntzanhxo heb' winh schekab' Jehová, ix yalan heb': ¿Tas tz'ik'an winh yuninal winhaj Cis tik? ¿Tom ipan winh schekab' Jehová yaji? xchi heb'.
Ay jun winh aj Gabaa chi' ix alani: ¿Mach smam juntzanhxo heb' winh chekab' tik jun? xchi winh. Ata' ix elkankot jun slolonel heb' anima: ¿Tom ipan winhaj Saúl tik schekab' Dios? xchi heb'.
Ixlajwi yek'b'at juntzanh chi', ix k'ek'och winhaj Saúl chi' t'a tzalan b'aj tz'och ejmelal.

Ix sk'anb'an jun winh yuk'tak smam winh t'ay yet' t'a winh schekab' winh yet'nak chi': --¿B'ajtil ix ex xid'eq'ui? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Saúl chi': --Ix onh xid'ek' ko say nok' b'uru, palta maj chaxlaj nok' kuuj, yuj chi' onh b'atkan ko k'anb'ej t'a winhaj Samuel, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winh yuk'tak winh smam winh chi': --Tzoc wal el t'a he k'ool, tzeyal t'ayin, tas ix yal winhaj Samuel chi' t'ayex, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Saúl chi': --Wach' ix yutej winh yalani. Ix yal winh to toxo ix chax nok' b'uru chi', xchi winh. Malaj jab'ok tas ix yal winh yuj tas ix yal winhaj Samuel t'ay to ol och reyal.
Ixlajwi yek'b'at jaye' k'ual, ix smolb'an heb' israel winhaj Samuel t'a Mizpa t'a yichanh Jehová.

Ix yalan winh t'a heb': --Ix yal Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik: Ha in ix ex wik'elta t'a Egipto, ix ex in kolelta t'a yol sk'ab' heb' aj Egipto chi' yet' t'a yol sk'ab' juntzanhxo chonhab' ix ex ixtani, xchi Dios chi'.

Palta haxo tiknaik tze patiquejel ko Diosal ix onh ik'anelta b'aj ix onh ek' t'a syaelal yet' t'a kusk'olal chi'. Ix he patiquejkaneli, ix ex och ijan he k'anan junok ko reyal yuj yak'an yajalil t'a quib'anh. Yuj chi' jun, tzex och t'a yichanh Jehová, t'a junjun inhtilal yet' t'a junjun makanhil tz'aj eyochi.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh to snitzkot sb'a heb' yajalil junjun inhtilal heb' israel, haxo t'a yib'anh heb' yinhtilal Benjamín ix em sorteo.

Ix yalanpax winh to snitzkot sb'a heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun makan yinhtilal Benjamín chi', haxo wal t'a yib'anh yinhtilal winhaj Matri ix emi. Ix yalanxi winh to snitzkot sb'a yinhtilal winhaj Matri chi', haxo wal t'a yib'anh winhaj Saúl yuninal winhaj Cis ix emi. Ix sayjiek' winh yuj heb', palta maj ilchajlaj winh.
Yuj chi', ix sk'anb'an heb' t'a Jehová tato ayek' winh ta'. Ix yalani to ayek' winh, to ix sk'ub'ejel sb'a winh t'a skal juntzanh spa heb'.
Ix b'at sayjielta winh yuj heb' b'aj k'ub'anel chi'. Axo yik ix sch'oxan sb'a winh t'a skal heb' anima chi', ix ilji to a heb' te chaanh steel, anhej t'a sjolom sjenhjab' winh sk'ek'och heb'.

Ix yalan winhaj Samuel t'a heb' anima chi': --Ilecnab' wal winh ko reyal ix sik'och Jehová tik, malaj junok winak t'a ko kal tik syal slajb'an sb'a yet' winh, xchi winh. Ix k'e nhilnaj heb' yalani: --Niwanokab' yelk'och winh ko reyal, xchi heb' smasanil.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Samuel chi' sleyal yik rey t'a heb' chonhab' israel. Ix stz'ib'ejkan winh, ix yak'anoch winh t'a yol skajnub' Jehová. Ixlajwi chi', ix stak'lankan sb'a heb', ix pax heb' t'a spat.
Ichapax chi' winhaj Saúl, ix pax winh t'a spat t'a Gabaa. Ay pax juntzanh heb' winh winak te jelan t'a owal ix b'at yet' winh, yujto ix lolon Dios t'a spensar heb' yik sb'at heb' yet' winh.

Palta ay juntzanh winak b'uchumtak ix alan icha tik: ¿Tas ol yutok jun winh tik onh skolani? xchi heb' winh. Emnaquil ix yutej winhaj Saúl chi' heb' winh, malaj tas ix siej heb' winh t'a winh. Palta malaj tas ix yal winh t'a heb' winh.

Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', ix kot winhaj Nahas sreyal heb' Amón yet' soldado yak' owal t'a chonhab' Jabes t'a yol yik Galaad, ix oymaj heb' t'a spatik. Ix yalanb'at heb' aj Jabes chi' t'a winhaj Nahas chi': --Tato tzak' junok a trato qued'ok, ol kak'och ko b'ha t'a yol a k'ab', xchi heb'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Nahas sreyal heb' amonita chi', ix yalan winh: --Tzin b'o in trato chi' eyed'ok, tato syal he k'ol swik'elta junok yol he sat junjun ex t'a he wach', yik tz'el sq'uixwelal heb' eyetisraelal, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Ix tak'wi heb' yajalil chonhab', ix yalan heb': --Tato icha chi', tzak' uqueokxo k'ual ko permiso, ol kak'b'at ko chekab' t'a masanil heb' quetisraelal, tato malaj mach ol jawok onh skolo', ol kak'anoch ko b'ha t'a yol a k'ab', xchi heb'.
Ayic ix k'och heb' chekab' chi' t'a Gabaa schonhab' winhaj Saúl, ix yalan scheknab'il heb' t'a heb' anima ta'. Axo masanil heb' anima, ix laj ok'k'e heb'.

Ha wal t'a jun rato chi', ix k'och winhaj Saúl, spetoj winh t'a smunlajel, makb'il juntzanh nok' wakax smunlaj yuj winh, ix sk'anb'an winh: --¿Tas tz'ik'an heb' anima tik yuj chi' tz'ok' heb'? xchi winh. Ix yalan heb' anima chi' masanil tas ix ul yal heb' chekab' ix kot t'a Jabes chi'.
Ayic ix yab'an winhaj Saúl chi' icha chi', elanhchamel ix och Yespíritu Dios t'a winh, ha' ix ak'an yip winh, ix kot yowal winh sik'lab'il.

Ix schok' xikanb'at chawanh nok' wakax chi' winh, ix yalan winh to tz'ik'jib'at nok' chib'ej chi' yik sch'oxji nok' t'a masanil yol smakb'en israel. Ha heb' tz'ik'anb'at nok' chi' syal heb' icha tik: Icha tik ol utaj nok' swakax mach max yal sk'ool sb'at t'a owal yet' winhaj Saúl yet' pax winhaj Samuel, xchi heb'. Ix jawi jun niwan xiwelal t'a heb' anima yuj Jehová, junxonhej ix yutej sb'a heb' smasanil, ix jawi heb' yak'och sb'a yet' winhaj Saúl chi'.
Ayic ix sb'isan jantak heb' anima tzak'anoch yuj winhaj Saúl chi' t'a Bezec, ay 30 mil heb' ix kot t'a yinhtilal Judá yet' 300 mil heb' ix kot t'a juntzanhxo yinhtilal Israel.

Ata' ix yal winhaj Saúl chi' t'a heb' chekab' ix kot t'a Jabes chi': --Alec t'a heb' eyetchonhab' to a k'ik'an t'a k'ek'ualil, toxo ix ko kol heb', xchi winh. Ix b'at heb' chekab' chi' yal t'a heb' yetchonhab' chi' to a k'ik'an skolchaj heb'. Ix te tzalajk'e heb'.
Ix yalanb'at heb' t'a winhaj Nahas icha tik: --Ato k'ik'an b'at kak'och ko b'ha t'a yol he k'ab', tze naani tas tzonh eyutej, xchib'at heb'.

Axo t'a junxo k'u, k'ik'to wal, ix spojanek' heb' soldado winhaj Saúl chi', ox poj ix yutej heb' winh. Ayto wal sakb'i, ix k'och lemnaj heb' t'a yol skampamento heb' amonita chi', ix och ijan heb' smilancham heb' masanto t'a k'ek'ualil. Axo heb' maj chamok, ix saklemkanb'at heb', malaj b'aj junnhej ix kan chawanhok heb'.
Ix yalan heb' anima chi' t'a winhaj Samuel: --¿Machtac heb' ix alani to manh smojok yoch winhaj Saúl ko reyalok? Ik'ekkot heb' t'a tik, ol ko milcham heb', xchi heb'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Saúl chi': --Maay, ha t'a jun k'u tik, malaj junok quetchonhab' syal schami, yujto a Jehová ix onh kolani, xchi winh.
Ix yalanpax winhaj Samuel chi' t'a heb' anima smasanil: --Koyec t'a Gilgal, yik b'at ko wach' ak'ejkanoch winhaj Saúl tik ko reyalok, xchi winh.

Yuj chi', ix b'at heb' anima chi' smasanil, ix smolb'anoch sb'a heb' t'a yichanh Jehová ta'. Ix swach' ak'ankanoch winhaj Saúl chi' heb' t'a reyal. Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an silab' heb' yik junk'olal t'a yichanh Jehová. Axo heb' chonhab' yet' winhaj Saúl ix te tzalaj heb'.

Ha wal t'a jun rato chi', ix yalankan winhaj Samuel chi' t'a masanil heb' chonhab' israel: --Tik wal tzeyilkani to ix in k'anab'ajej tas ix he k'an t'ayin, yuj chi' ix wak'kanoch jun winh ko reyal tik.

Aton jun winh tik ko reyal, a winh ol ex kuchb'anok. Ileknab'i, icham winak inxo, sakxo xil in jolom, haxo heb' winh wuninal ayoch heb' winh eyed'ok. Ha in ix ex in kuchb'ej yiktax quelem in, masanto tiknaik.

Ayinek' t'a eyichanh tiknaik. Tato ay mach ix wik'ek' junok nok' swakax, ma junok nok' sb'uru, mato ay mach b'aj ix wak' chukal, mato ay junok tas ix in cha t'ayex in montub'alok t'a elk'altak, alek t'a yichanh Jehová yet' t'a yichanh winh ko reyal ix sik'el tik. Tato icha chi', syal in tupan tiknaik, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalan heb' chonhab' chi' icha tik: --Malaj junelok ix ak' chukal t'ayonh, malaj b'aj ix a cha junok tas a montub'alok, xchi heb'.
--Ha Jehová yet' winh ix sik'och ko reyalok tik, testigo tz'ajkan heb' to malaj in mul ix och t'ayex, xchi winhaj Samuel chi'. --Maay, malaj tasi, xchi heb' anima chi'.
Ix yalanpax winh t'a masanil heb' yetisraelal chi': --Ha Jehová sik'annaquel winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón ayik yik'annaquelta heb' ko mam quicham t'a Egipto.
Yuj chi', scham wal eyab'an tas ol wal tiknaik t'a yichanh Jehová, yuj tas wach' sk'ulejnak kuuj yet' yuj heb' ko mam quicham chi'.

Ayic sk'ochnak winhaj Jacob yet' masanil yal yuninal t'a Egipto, te ya utajnak heb' yuj heb' anima ay ta'. Yalannac sb'a heb' t'a Jehová yik skolji heb' yuj. Axo Jehová chi' ak'anb'at winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón yik sb'at yik'anelta heb' ko mam quicham chi' heb' winh ta'. Ak'jinakkan kajan heb' t'a tik yuj heb' winh.

Palta ix b'at Jehová ko Diosal satk'olal yuj heb', yuj chi' kotak skal ix ak'jioch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ool yuj. Ay jun pekti’ ix ak'jioch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Sísara, yajal yaj t'a heb' soldado yik chonhab' Hazor. Ix ak'jipaxoch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' filisteo yet' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' winh sreyal Moab. Junjun makan heb' chi', ix yak' owal heb' yet' heb' ko mam quicham.

Yuj chi', juntak el tz'ak'jioch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' chi', syalanxi sb'a heb' t'a Jehová, syalan heb': Mamin, ix och wal ko mul t'ayach, yujto ix ach kaktejkani, haxo Baal yet' Astarot skak' serwil. Ha tiknaik jun, kolonh t'a yol sk'ab' heb' kajk'ool, a achxonhej ol ach kak' serwil, xchi heb'.
Yuj chi' ix ak'jikot winhaj Jerobaal, winhaj Barac, winhaj Jefté yet' in tik yuj Jehová, yik tzex kolji t'a yol sk'ab' heb' eyajk'ool, yuj chi' syal eyaj t'a junk'olal.
Ayic ix eyilani to skot winhaj Nahas sreyal heb' amonita yak' owal qued'ok, ix he k'anan junok he reyal t'ayin, yik tz'och yajalil t'a ko kal, wach'chom a Jehová ko Diosal ko reyal yaji.
Ha tiknaik ina winh he reyal ix he k'an tik. Toxo ix ak'jioch winh rey t'a ko kal yuj Jehová.

Ha tiknaik, tze na' sik'lab'il to tze k'anab'ajej Jehová tzeyak'an serwil, manh he pitej he b'a t'ay. Tato ol he k'anab'ajej icha snib'ej Jehová ko Diosal, tato tze k'anab'ajej winh he reyal tik, wach'nhej ol aj he b'eyb'ati.
Tato pit ol eyutej he b'ha t'a tas syal Jehová jun, tato max he k'anab'ajej, ol yak'och yaelal t'a eyib'anh icha ix utaj heb' ko mam quicham.
Ha tiknaik, maklejek eyila', yujto ol sch'ox Jehová junok tas satub'tak yilji t'a eyichanh.

Ha tiknaik stiempoal sjochchaj ixim trigo, manh stiempoalok yak'an nhab'. Palta ol in k'an t'a Jehová to ol mak'waj k'u, ol yak'ankot nhab'. Icha chi' ol aj snachajel eyuuj to chuk ix he k'ulej t'a yichanh Jehová chi', ayik ix he k'anan jun winh rey tik, xchi winhaj Samuel chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix sk'anan winhaj Samuel chi' t'a Jehová to skot nhab'. Val t'a jun rato chi' ix mak'waj k'u ix kot nhab' chi', yuj chi' masanil anima ix xiw t'a Jehová yet' t'a winhaj Samuel chi'.
Yuj chi' masanil heb' ix alan t'a winhaj Samuel chi' icha tik: --k'an t'a Jehová ko Diosal yik max onh chami, yujto ix te wach' och ko mul yuj b'aj ix ko k'an ko reyal tik, xchi heb' t'a winh.
Ix tak'wi winh: --Wach'chom chuk tas ix he k'ulej chi', palta manh ex xiwok. Ayic ol b'eynhejb'at tik, manhxo eyik'el he b'ha t'a Jehová, axonhej tzeyak' serwil t'a smasanil he k'ool.
Manh eyaktejkan Jehová yik tzex och tzak'an yuj juntzanh komon Dios malaj yelk'ochi, yujto malaj jab'ok tas syak' t'ayonh, max yalpax onh skolani.
Ha Jehová manh ol ex yaktejkan he ch'okoj, yik manh ol alchaj chukal t'ay, yujto snib'ej tzex och schonhab'ok.
Colwajnhejokab' Jehová wed'ok yik tzin lesalwinhej eyuuj yik max och in mul t'ay. Palta to ol ex in k'ayb'ej t'a stojolal.
Anhej to tze k'anab'ajej, tzeyak'an serwil Jehová t'a smasanil he k'ool, tze naankot jantak tas wach' ix sk'ulej kuuj.
Palta tato ol he k'ulejnhej chukal, ol ex satjoquel yet' he reyal tik yuj Jehová, xchi winh t'a heb'.
Te tek'an wal winhaj Saúl ayik ix och winh reyal t'a chonhab' Israel. Ayic ix lajwi schab'il ab'il yoch winh reyal chi',

ix sik'anel oxe' mil soldado winh t'a skal heb' israel. Chab' mil ix kan yet' winh t'a Micmas t'a tzalquixtak t'a slak'anil Betel. Axo junxo mil heb' ix kan yet' winhaj Jonatán yuninal winh t'a Gabaa t'a yol yik heb' yinhtilal Benjamín. Axo juntzanhxo heb' ix kani, ix chekji pax heb' yuj winh t'a spat.

Axo winhaj Jonatán chi' ix satanel jun makan heb' soldado filisteo t'a Geba. Ix yab' jun chi' heb' filisteo, yuj chi' elanhchamel ix schek winhaj Saúl to spuji k'een trompeta t'a yol smakb'en Israel yik smolb'an sb'a heb' winh soldado.

Masanil heb' israel ix ab'ani to toxo ix satel jun skampamento heb' filisteo yuj winhaj Saúl chi', ix yab'anpax heb' to aykot yowal heb' filisteo chi' t'a heb'. Yuj chi', t'a elanhchamel ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' soldado israel yet' winhaj Saúl chi' t'a Gilgal.

Anheja' heb' filisteo chi', ix smolb'ejpax sb'a heb' yik syak'an owal heb' yet' heb' israel chi'. Ay oxe' mil skarruaje heb' yik owal, waque' mil heb' soldado ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej, tzijtum pax heb' sb'eyi, manhxo b'ischajb'enok heb'. Ix b'at heb' t'a Micmas, ix sb'oan skampamento heb' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a Bet-awén.

Ayic ix yilan heb' israel to max techaj yak'an owal heb' yet' heb' filisteo chi', ix xiwk'e heb'. Ix b'at heb' sk'ub'ejel sb'ha t'a yoltak k'een nhak'een, t'a skaltak wayumtak, t'a sattak k'een tenam, t'a yoltak juntzanh jul yik ha ha' yet' t'a yoltak k'een xab'.

Ay pax heb' ix k'axpajek' t'ha ha' Jordán, ix b'at heb' t'a yol yik Gad yet' t'a Galaad. Axo winhaj Saúl chi' jun, ix b'atkan winh t'a Gilgal. Masanil heb' soldado winh yet'nak, toxonhej sluklon heb' yuj xiwelal.

Ha winhaj Saúl chi', uque' k'ual ix kan winh t'a Gilgal yik stanhwan winh sk'och winhaj Samuel, yujto icha chi' yaj yalankan winh. Palta haxo ix aji, maj k'ochlaj winh t'a Gilgal chi', yuj chi' wanxo yaktajkan winhaj Saúl chi' yuj heb' soldado.
Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Saúl chi': --Ik'ekkot nok' silab' ol nhusjoktz'aok yet' silab' yik junk'olal yet' Jehová, xchi winh. Axo winh ix komon nhusantz'a nok' silab' chi'.
Ayic wan slajwi snhusan silab' chi' winh, ix k'och winhaj Samuel chi'. Ayic ix yab'an winhaj Saúl chi' to sk'och winh, ix elta winh scha winh yik syak'an stzatzil sk'ool winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Samuel chi': --¿Tas ix a k'ulej tik? xchi winh. --Ix wila'' to wan in yaktankan heb' anima tik, a achxo max ach jalaj icha yaj sk'ual alankani, haxo heb' winh filisteo toxonhej lekanek' heb' winh t'a Micmas.
Yuj chi' ix in na'a, q'uinalok sja heb' winh yak' owal t'ayin t'a Gilgal tik, manto in k'anpax skolwal Jehová, yuj chi' ix wak' pural in b'a wak'an jun silab' tik, xchi winhaj Saúl chi'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Samuel chi': --Yuj a manh pensaril ix a k'ulan jun tik. Octom to ix a k'anab'ajej tas ix yal Jehová ko Diosal t'ayach, tato icha chi', ix am yala' to tzach kan reyal t'a skal heb' israel t'a junelnhej.
Ocxo jun, manhxo ol najtilax opisio. Ol say Jehová mach junok sk'anab'ajan tas snib'ej, a ol och yajalil t'a schonhab', yujto ix a tenek' tas ix yala'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix el winhaj Samuel t'a Gilgal chi', ix pax winh. Ha jantakto heb' anima tzak'an t'a spatik winhaj Saúl chi', ix b'at heb' t'a owal. Ix el heb' t'a Gilgal chi', ix b'atkan heb' t'a Gabaa t'a yol yik Benjamín. Ata' ix sb'is winhaj Saúl chi' jantakto heb' soldado tzak'an yuj, 600 to syil sb'a heb'.
Ajun pax winhaj Jonatán winh yuninal winh yet'nak yet' heb' soldado. Ha t'a Gabaa chi' ix kan heb', haxo pax heb' filisteo, ha t'a Micmas ay skampamento heb'.
Ox makan ix yutej sb'a heb' filisteo chi', ix b'at yik'anelta sk'ael heb' israel heb'. Jun makan heb' ix b'atkan t'a sb'eal Ofra t'a yol yik Sual.
Axo junxo makan heb' ix b'atkan t'a Bet-horón, haxo heb' yoxil makan, ix b'atkan heb' t'a pak'an t'a sch'olanil Zeboim b'aj schab'at tzinan lu'um.
Masanil t'a yol smakb'en Israel, malaj junok heb' b'oum k'een ix chaji sb'o k'een yuj heb' filisteo, yujto malaj snib'ej heb' sb'o k'een espada yet' lanza heb' israel chi'.
Ayic tz'el ye k'een syamk'ab' heb' israel chi', ha t'a heb' filisteo xid'ek' heb' snhik ye k'een sk'een chi', icha k'een arado, k'een asaron, k'een ch'akab' yet' k'een jochlab' trigo.
Chab' plata sk'an heb' filisteo chi' yuj snhikjik'e ye k'een arado yet' k'een asaron. Jun sk'an heb' yik sk'e ye junok k'een ch'akab' yet' junok k'een teklab' wakax.
Yuj chi', malaj junok heb' soldado israel ed'jinak yespada, ma slanza, anhej winhaj Saúl yet' winhaj Jonatán ed'jinak yiko' ayik ix och owal chi'.
Axo jun makan heb' soldado heb' filisteo, makb'il b'aj lot'an yuj heb', aton b'aj tzek' sb'eal Micmas.

Ay jun k'ual ix yal winhaj Jonatán winh yuninal winhaj Saúl chi' t'a winh ed'jinak syamk'ab' yik owal: --Conh ek' t'a junxo k'axep chi', ol onh k'och b'aj ayek' heb' filisteo chi', xchi winh. Maj yal-laj winhaj Jonatán chi' t'a winh smam chi'.
Axo winhaj Saúl chi', ha t'a slak'anil Gabaa ay skampamento winh, t'a yich jun te' granado b'aj stek'ji ixim trigo, 600 heb' soldado ajun yet' winh.

Ajun winhaj Ahías yuninal winhaj Ahitob yet'nak winh. Ayoch schaleka winh yik sakerdoteal. Ha winhaj Ahitob chi' yuk'tak sb'a winh yet' winhaj Icabod. Ha winhaj Finees smam heb' winh, yixchiquin heb' winh winhaj Elí, aton winh ak'annak sakerdoteal t'a Silo. Manh yojtakok winhaj Saúl yet' heb' soldado tato ix b'at winhaj Jonatán chi'.

Ha winhaj Jonatán chi', ayoch t'a spensar winh sk'axpajek' t'a skampamento heb' filisteo chi'. Ay jun k'een tenam skuch Boses t'a yichanh Micmas t'a stojolal norte, haxo junxo k'een skuch Sene ay t'a yichanh Gabaa t'a stojolal sur. Ay jun niwan ch'olan t'a skal k'een schab'il.

Ix yalan winhaj Jonatán chi' t'a winh ed'jinak syamk'ab' chi': --Ha tiknaik konh em t'a sat k'een tik yik tzonh k'ek'och t'a skampamento heb' ch'ok chonhab'il chi'. Tope wal ol kolwaj Jehová qued'ok. Manh ajaltakoklaj skolwaj qued'ok tato syal sk'ool, wach'chom manh niwanok ko b'eyi, xchi winh.
--Ichokab' ta' tato wach' tz'aj tza na', anhej to tzak'an in och uj b'aj tzach b'ati, xchi winh schekab' winh chi'.
Ix yalan winhaj Jonatán chi': --Conh an, ayik ol onh emk'och t'a yol ch'olan chi', ol ko ch'oxan ko b'ha t'a heb'.
Tato ol yal heb' t'ayonh, tanhwejek ta', tato xchi heb', manh ol onh k'elaj t'a b'aj ayek' heb' chi'.
Tato ol yal heb' jun, k'eanhekkot t'a tik, tato xchi heb', ol onh k'eok. Icha chi' ol aj sch'oxan Jehová t'ayonh to ol yak'och heb' t'a yol ko k'ab', xchi winh.
Axo yik ix sch'oxan sb'a heb', ix yalan heb' filisteo chi': Ilecnab' wal yelta heb' hebreo t'a yoltak olan b'ajtak k'ub'an, xchi heb'.

Ha wal t'a jun rato chi' ix awajemta heb' t'a winhaj Jonatán yet' t'a winh yet'nak winh chi': --Lemec, k'eanhekkot t'a tik, ay jun tas ol kal eyab'i, xchi heb' filisteo chi'. Axo ix yalan winhaj Jonatán t'a winh ajun yet' chi': --Ol ach k'enhej tzak'an wuuj, yujto a tiknaik ol yak'och heb' filisteo tik Jehová t'a yol ko k'ab' a onh israel onh tik, xchi winh.

Ix k'e machaljok heb' winh. Axo yik ix k'ek'och heb' winh, ix syamanoch winhaj Jonatán chi' smilancham heb' filisteo chi', haxo winh ed'jinak syamk'ab' winh chi' ix wach' milancham heb' maj cham sik'lab'il.
Ha t'a jun b'ab'el owal chi', ay am junok 20 heb' ix smilcham heb' winh, ay am junok chanhe' ch'anhil b'aj ix cham heb' chi'.

Masanil heb' filisteo ayek' t'a yol skampamento yet' heb' tonhej sakleminak yajeli yet' heb' najat ayel stanhwej yet' pax heb' ayb'at yik'elta sk'ael heb' israel chi', ix jawi jun niwan xiwk'olal t'a yib'anh heb'. Ix ek'pax jun niwan quixkab', yuj chi' ix te xiwk'e heb'.
Axo pax heb' ayoch smaklej yuj winhaj Saúl chi' t'a Gabaa t'a yol yik Benjamín, ix yilan heb' to ix k'e somnaj heb' filisteo chi' smasanil, wan saklempax heb'.

Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Saúl chi' t'a heb' soldado icha tik: --Sayec eyil heb' soldado, ol cheklajok machtak malaj, xchi winh. Axo ix cheklaji to a winhaj Jonatán malaj yet' winh tz'ik'an syamk'ab' winh.
Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi' ayek' te' skaxail strato Jehová t'a skal heb' israel, yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Saúl chi' t'a winhaj Ahías: --Ik'kot te' skaxail strato Jehová yik sko k'anb'ej t'ay, xchi winh.
Yakb'an wan slolon winh yet' winh sakerdote chi', ix te wach' somchajk'e heb' filisteo chi', yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a winh sakerdote chi': --Actej, manhxo ol ko k'anb'ej t'a Jehová chi', xchi winh.

Ha wal t'a jun rato chi' ix smolb'ej masanil heb' soldado winhaj Saúl chi', ix b'at heb' b'aj ayoch owal chi'. Axo yik ix k'och heb', ix yilan heb' to toxo ix te k'e somnaj heb' filisteo chi', wan smil-lancham sb'a heb'.
Ay juntzanh heb' israel ayxo tiempo yajek' yet' heb' filisteo chi', ayik ix yilan heb' tas wan yuji chi', ix och heb' yet' winhaj Saúl yet' winhaj Jonatán chi'.
Ayic ix yab'anpax heb' israel ix b'at sk'ub'ejel sb'ha t'a lum tzalquixtak t'a yol yik Efraín, to wan yel heb' filisteo chi', ix kot heb', ix och heb' t'a spatik heb'.
Ix och heb' t'a spatik heb' filisteo chi', masanto t'a yichanhb'at Bet-awén, icha chi' ix aj skolan chonhab' Israel Jehová t'a jun k'u chi'.

Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ix te el yip heb' israel chi', yujto malaj junok heb' ix wa yuj tas ix yal winhaj Saúl icha tik: katab'ajokab' mach swa t'a jun k'ik'b'alil tik, ayik mantzak wik'el yowal in k'ol t'a heb' ajk'ol tik, xchi winh.
Ayic ix k'och heb' soldado t'a jun kaltak te', te ay nok' yal chab' ay t'a sat lu'um,
icha yel yok ha ha', icha wal chi' sb'ey nok' yal chab' chi', palta malaj wal junok heb' ix yal yuk'an jab'ok nok', yujto ix xiw heb' t'a tas ix yal winhaj Saúl chi'.
Ha winhaj Jonatán maj yab'laj jun lolonel chi' winh, yuj chi' ix slab'ejem jun te te' winh yet'nak t'a skal nok' yalchab' chi', ix yak'anoch winh t'a sti', ix te och yip winh yuj jab' chi'.

Ix yalan jun winh soldado t'a winh: --Ha winh a mam ix yal winh t'ayonh icha tik: Tato ay junok mach ay jab'ok tas syab'lej, katab'ajokab'kani, yuj chi' lajanxonhej yel quip ko masanil, xchi jun winh soldado chi'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Jonatán chi': --Ha winh in mam chi', te chuk tas syik'kot winh t'a yib'anh ko chonhab' tik. Ha in tik, ix wab' wal yoch wip yuj jab' nok' yalchab' ix wab'lej tik.
Ocxom masanil heb' soldado tik, tato ix swa jab'ok tas ix quik'kanek' t'a heb' ajk'ol chi' heb', ek'tom wal te niwan heb' filisteo chi' ix cham kuuj, xchi winh.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ix och heb' israel t'a spatik heb' filisteo chi'. Ix syamoch heb' smilancham heb' t'a Micmas, masanto ix k'och heb' t'a Ajalón. Ix te el yip heb' israel chi'.
Yuj chi', a jantak tas ix yik'ek' heb' t'a heb' ajk'ol chi', aton nok' wakax, nok' kalnel yet' nok' yunetak wakax, ix smilcham nok' heb' t'a sat lu'um, ix schi'an nok' heb' yet' schiq'uil.

Ay heb' ix b'at alan t'a winhaj Saúl icha tik: --Van yoch smul heb' soldado t'a yichanh Jehová, wan schi'an nok' chib'ej heb' yet' schiq'uil, xchi heb'. Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj Saúl chi' icha tik: --Ix och he mul t'a yichanh Jehová. Yuj chi' b'alekkot junok k'een niwan k'een chi' t'a tik tiknaik.

Pucokab' ab'ix t'a skal heb' anima, syik'kot junjunok nok' swakax heb', ma junok skalnel heb', smilancham nok' heb' schi'a, mokab' schilaj nok' heb' yet' schiq'uil yik max och smul heb' t'a yichanh Jehová, xchi winh. Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi', junjun heb' ix ik'ankot junjun swakax, ma skalnel, ix smilancham nok' heb' schi'a.
Ix sb'oan jun altar winhaj Saúl chi' ta'. Ha jun tik b'ab'el altar ix sb'ok'e winh t'a yichanh Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' soldado icha tik: --Koyec kak'ekxi owal yet' heb' filisteo t'a jun ak'wal tik, ol quik'anek' masanil tastak ay t'a heb', masanto yik ol sakb'ok, ol ko milcham heb' smasanil, manhxa junok pitzan ol kanok, xchi winh. Ix yalan heb' smasanil icha tik: --Yik'okab' icha tas tzal chi', xchi heb'. Palta ix yalan winh sakerdote icha tik: --Ayic manto onh b'atek, wach' ta sko k'anb'ej d'ha Dios, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'an winhaj Saúl chi' d'ha Dios: --¿Tom tzonh b'atxi kak' owal yet' heb' filisteo? ¿Ol am ak'och heb' t'a yol ko k'ab'? xchi winh. Palta maj tak'woklaj Jehová chi' t'a winh t'a jun ak'wal chi'.
Yuj chi' ix yalan winh icha tik: Masanil ex yajal ex, nitzekkot he b'ha t'a tik, ol ko k'anb'ani, mach ix och smul tiknaik.

Yujto swak' in ti' t'a Jehová ko Kolumal a onh israel onh tik, wach'chom a winh wuninal aj Jonatán ix och smul, syal scham winh, xchi winhaj Saúl chi'. Malaj junok heb' t'a skal heb' soldado ix tak'wi.
Yuj chi', ix yalanxi winh t'a heb' smasanil icha tik: --Cananhec he masanil t'a tik, ch'ok ol in kan a in tik yet' winh wuninal aj Jonatán, xchi winh. --Ha achnhej tzala, xchi heb' soldado chi'.

Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Mamin Jehová ach ko Diosal, ¿tas yuj max ach tak'wi t'a winh a chekab' tik? Ha tiknaik ayik ol och sorteo, tato a k'een Urim tz'elta, syalelk'ochi to a in, ma a winh wuninal aj Jonatán ix och smul, palta tato a k'een Tumim tz'elta, syalelk'ochi to a heb' a chonhab' Israel tik ix och smul, xchi winh. Axo ix aji, ha t'a yib'anh winhaj Jonatán yet' t'a winhaj Saúl ix emi, haxo heb' chonhab', ix kolchajkanel heb'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Saúl chi' icha tik: --Axo tiknaik jun, axonhej t'a wib'anh yet' winh wuninal tik tz'och sorteo, xchi winh. Axo ix aj jun, ha t'a yib'anh winhaj Jonatán chi' ix emi.

Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a winhaj Jonatán chi' icha tik: --Al t'ayin tas ix a k'ulej, xchi winh. Ix yalan winhaj Jonatán chi': --Val yel ix wab'lej jab' nok' yalchab', tonhej ix in lab'ejem jun te te' t'a skal nok', ix in lek'ani, yuj chi' ina in tik chamok in okab'i, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Saúl chi' icha tik: --Yak'okab' och junok niwan yaelal Dios t'a wib'anh tato max ach chami, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi heb' anima smasanil: --Tocwal ol ko cha cham winhaj Jonatán tik, yujto a yuj winh, onh kolchaj a onh israel onh tik. Manh smojok icha chi'. Yojtak Jehová ko Diosal. Val yel malaj junok xil sjolom winhaj Jonatán tik ol em t'a sat lu'um. Yujto a tas toxo ix elk'och tiknaik, ha Dios ix kolwaj qued'ok, xchi heb'. Icha chi' ix aj skolchajkanel winhaj Jonatán chi' yuj heb' yetchonhab', yuj chi' majxo chamlaj winh.
Ixlajwi chi', majxo b'atlaj winhaj Saúl yet' heb' soldado spech heb' filisteo chi', yuj chi' ix laj meltzaj heb' filisteo chi' t'a schonhab'.

Atax yik ix ochkan winhaj Saúl sreyalok chonhab' Israel, ix syamanoch winh yak'an owal yet' juntzanh chonhab' ajk'ool oyanoch t'a spatiktak winh, aton heb' aj Moab, heb' aj Amón, heb' aj Edom, heb' winh sreyal Soba yet' heb' filisteo. Ix yak'nhej ganar winh b'ajtak ix yak' owal.
Ha t'a junel ix smolb'ej masanil soldado winh, ix yak'an owal winh yet' heb' amalek. Icha chi' ix aj skolanel heb' israel winh t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ol tz'elk'an tastak ay t'a heb' israel chi'.
Ay oxwanh yuninal winhaj Saúl chi', aton winhaj Jonatán, winhaj Isúi yet' pax winhaj Malquisúa. Ay pax chawanh yisil winh, jun ix skuch Merab, aton ix b'ab'el, haxo ix schab'il, skuch Mical.
Ha ix yetb'eyum winhaj Saúl chi' Ahinoam sb'i ix, yisil ix winhaj Ahimaas. Axo winh sat yajalil heb' soldado winh, Abner sb'i winh, yuninal winhaj Ner yicham winhaj Saúl chi'.
Ha winhaj Cis smam winhaj Saúl chi' yet' winhaj Ner smam winhaj Abner, yuninal heb' winh winhaj Abiel.

Yakb'an ayoch winhaj Saúl chi' reyal t'a skal heb' yetisraelal, ix yak'nhej owal winh yet' heb' filisteo. Yuj chi' a heb' kelemtak jelan, te ay pax yip, ix och heb' t'a soldadoal yuj winhaj Saúl chi'.
Ay jun k'ual ix yal winhaj Samuel t'a winhaj Saúl icha tik: --Ha Jehová ix in chekani ayik ix ach in sik'ankanoch reyal t'a Israel aton schonhab'. Yuj chi' cha ab' tas syal Jehová t'ayach.
Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik: Ol wak'och yaelal t'a yib'anh heb' amalekita yujto yak'nak owal heb' yet' heb' israel ayik skotnak heb' t'a Egipto.

Yuj chi' ol ach b'at ak' owal yet' heb', tza satel heb' yet' tastak ay t'a heb', malaj junok makan b'aj tz'ok' a k'ool. Tza milcham masanil heb' winak, heb' ix ix, heb' unin yet' heb' ato yalji yet' pax nok' wakax, nok' kalnel, nok' kamello yet' nok' b'uru, tza satel smasanil, xchi Jehová, xchi winh t'a winh.
Ix smolb'ej heb' soldado winhaj Saúl chi', ix sayan yil heb' winh t'a Telaim. Ay 10 mil heb' soldado t'a yinhtilal Judá yet' 200 mil heb' yik juntzanhxo yinhtilal Israel.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj Saúl chi' t'a chonhab' Amalec, ix b'at sk'ub'anel sb'a winh yet' heb' soldado t'a yol jun taquinh melem.

Ix yalanb'at winh t'a heb' quenita: --Elanhec t'a skal heb' amalekita, yik manh ol ex in satel yet' heb', yujto ok'nak he k'ool t'a heb' quetisraelal ayik sjawinak heb' t'a tik, ayik spetoj heb' t'a Egipto, xchib'at winh t'a heb'. Elanhchamel ix yik'el sb'a heb' quenita chi' t'a skal heb' amalekita chi'.

Ix k'och winhaj Saúl chi' yak' owal yet' heb' amalekita chi', ix schaanel yich winh t'a Hawila, masanto ix k'och winh t'a Shur t'a smojonalxo Egipto t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u. Ix ak'ji ganar heb' amalekita chi' yuj heb'.
Ix syamankot winhaj Agag heb', aton winh sreyal heb' amalekita chi'. Pitzan winh ix syaman winh heb'. Axo masanil juntzanhxo heb' amalekita, ix miljicham heb'.

Palta a winhaj Saúl chi' yet' heb' soldado, maj smilchamlaj winhaj Agag chi' heb'. Maj smilpaxchamlaj nok' wakax heb' te wach', nok' kalnel, nok' yunetak wakax te b'ak'uech, nok' yunetak kalnel yet' juntzanhokxo tastak te ay stojol. Axo masanil tas malaj wal yelk'ochi, ix satel heb' smasanil.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Samuel icha tik:

Scus in k'ool yujto ix wak'och winhaj Saúl tik reyal, yujto tzin spatiquejkanel winh, maj sk'anab'ajej winh tas ix wala', xchi t'a winh. Ix kus sk'ool winhaj Samuel, yuj chi' pilan ak'wal ix lesalwi winh t'a Jehová.

Axo t'a junxo q'uinhib'alil, te ak'walto ix b'at winh yil winhaj Saúl chi'. Palta haxo ix alchaj t'a winh to ix b'at winhaj Saúl chi' t'a Carmel. Ata' ix sb'ok'e jun monumento winh yuj yik'anchaanh sb'a. Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winh t'a Gilgal.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Samuel chi' ta'. Axo ix k'och winh, ix yalan winhaj Saúl chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a ib'anh. Toxo ix in k'anab'ajej tas ix yala', xchi winh.
--¿Tas yaj nok' kalnel yet' nok' wakax swab' yok' chi'? xchi winhaj Samuel chi'.

--Ha t'a chonhab' Amalec ix kot nok', yujto a wal nok' kalnel te wach' ix yik'kot heb' soldado yet' nok' wakax yik ol och silab'il t'a Jehová ko Diosal. Axo masanil juntzanhxo, ix ko sateli, xchi winh.
--Numan tzach aji. Ol wal t'ayach tas ix yal Jehová t'ayin t'a q'uiq'ui t'ak'wal, xchi winhaj Samuel chi'. --Al an, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Samuel chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Ha t'a yalanhtaxo malaj elk'och a naani, palta ach och yajalil t'a masanil yinhtilal Israel. Ha Jehová ix ach ak'anoch sreyalok ko chonhab' tik.
Ach schekanpaxb'at a satel juntzanh heb' amalekita malaj swach'il tas sk'ulej yet' masanil tastak ay t'a heb'.
¿Tas yuj maj a k'anab'ajej tas ix yal Jehová t'ayach, ina to ix ik'kot tastak t'a heb' ajk'ol chi'? Te chuk tas ix a k'ulej t'a yichanh Jehová, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Saúl chi': --Maay, ix in k'anab'ajej tas ix yala', ix in xid'eq'ui, ix in k'anab'ajej tas ix schek in k'ulej. Ix wik'kot winhaj Agag sreyal heb' amalekita chi', ix in satanel masanil heb' anima ta'.

Axo heb' soldado ix ik'ankot nok' skalnel heb' yet' nok' wakax wach' t'a skal nok' to yowalil satjieli. Ix yik'ankot nok' heb', yik tz'ak'chaj nok' silab'il t'a Jehová ko Diosal t'a Gilgal tik, xchi winh.

Ix yalanxi winhaj Samuel chi': Ste stzalaj Jehová tato sko k'anab'ajej tas syala', t'a yichanh juntzanh silab' sko nhustz'a t'ay. Yel xo te wach' tato sko cha kab' tas syala', t'a yichanh pax sko nhustz'a xepual nok' kalnel t'ay.

Tato sko pitej ko b'ha t'a Jehová, lajan ko mul icha smul heb' naumel lolonel. Tato squik'chaanh ko b'a, max ko k'anab'ajej tas syala', lajan wal ko mul icha smul heb' tz'em kuman t'a komon Dios. Yujto ix a patiquejel tas ix yal Jehová, yuj chi' ol ach spatiquejpaxel yet' a reyal tik, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Saúl chi', ix yalan winh: --Yel toni, ix och in mul, maj in k'anab'ajej tas ix yal Jehová yet' tas ix al t'ayin, yujto ix in xiw t'a heb' soldado ajun wed'ok, ix in cha wab' tas ix yal heb'.
Elokab' t'a a k'ool to tzin ak' niwank'olal yuj in mul ix ochi, meltzajanh wed'ok tzonh och ejmelal t'a yichanh Jehová, xchi winh.
--Manh ol in meltzajlaj ed'ok, yujto ix a patiquejel tas ix yal Jehová, yuj chi' ol ach yik'el t'a reyal t'a ko chonhab' Israel tik, xchi winhaj Samuel chi'.
Axo yik ix meltzaj winhaj Samuel chi' yalani, ix och yub'naj winhaj Saúl chi' t'a sti' spichul winh, ix nhik'chaj yuj winh.

Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Samuel chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Icha wal ix utej a nhik'chitan in pichul tik, icha chi' ol yutej Jehová yik'anel opisio t'a reyal t'a yol a k'ab', ol yak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' junxo quetchonhab' ek'to wach' t'a ichanh.
Yowalil ol elk'och jun tik, yujto a Jehová squik'chaanh a onh israel onh tik, malaj b'aj syesej, malaj b'aj sk'ex spensar ichok anima, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Saúl chi' --Yeltoni ix och in mul, palta elokab' t'a a k'ol tzach meltzaj wed'ok yik ay welk'och t'a yichanh heb' yajalil ko chonhab' yet' t'a yichanh heb' quetchonhab' smasanil. Meltzajanh wed'ok, tzonh och ejmelal t'a Jehová ko Diosal, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix meltzaj winhaj Samuel chi' yet' winh, ix och winhaj Saúl chi' ejmelal t'a yichanh Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Samuel chi': --Ik'ekkot winhaj Agag sreyal heb' Amalec chi' t'a wichanh, xchi winh. Ix te tzalaj winhaj Agag chi' ayik ix jawi winh t'a yichanh winhaj Samuel chi', manhxo ol chamlaj winh snaani.

Ix yalan winhaj Samuel chi' t'a winh: --Yuj k'een espada tik tzijtum heb' ix ix, ix kan t'a manh uneal. Icha wal ix ajkan heb' ix chi', icha chi' ol aj skan ix a nun, xchi winh. Maj yak' niwank'olal winh, ix skotakxikanb'at winhaj Agag chi' winh t'a yichanh Jehová t'a Gilgal chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzaj winh t'a Ramá, ix meltzajpax winhaj Saúl t'a spat t'a Gabaa.
Ayic pitzanto winhaj Samuel chi', majxo b'atlaj winh yil winhaj Saúl chi', palta skus winh yuj winh. Ix kuspax Jehová yujto ix yak'och winhaj Saúl sreyalok Israel.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Samuel chi' icha tik: --¿B'aq'uinh ol aktej a kus yuj winhaj Saúl chi'? Maxtzac yal in k'ool to ol yak'nhej yajalil winh t'a chonhab' Israel tik. Ha tiknaik, ak' b'ud'jok nok' a ch'aak yet' akeite, tzach b'at t'a spat winhaj Isaí t'a Belén, yujto toxo ix in sik'el jun winh yuninal winh yik tz'och reyal sk'exulok winhaj Saúl chi', xchi t'a winh.

--¿Tas wal tz'aj in b'ati? Ta syab' jun tik winhaj Saúl chi', tzam in smilcham winh, xchi winhaj Samuel chi'. Ix tak'wi Jehová chi' t'a winh: --Ik'b'at junok nok' kob'es wakax tzach b'ati, tzalani to ak'oj silab' t'a Jehová tzach k'ochi.
Slajwi chi' tzawtan winhaj Isaí chi' yik schi'an nok' silab' chi' winh. Ata' ol wal t'ayach tas ol a k'ulej. Ha mach ol in ch'ox t'ayach, tza sik'kaneli, tzak'ank'e akeite t'a sjolom, xchi t'a winh.

Ix sk'anab'ajan winh tas ix yal Jehová chi'. Ayic ix k'och winh t'a Belén, ix ul chaji winh t'a xiwk'olal yuj heb' yichamtak winaquil chonhab' chi', elanhchamel ix sk'anb'ej heb' t'a winh: --¿Tas tzul a k'ulej mamin? ¿Vach' am tas tzul a k'ulej? xchi heb' t'a winh.

--I', tzin jawi wak' jun silab' t'a Jehová. B'oek he b'a icha yalan ley, ol ex b'at wed'ok yik sko chi'an jun silab' tik, xchi winh. Ix yalanpax winh t'a winhaj Isaí yet' t'a heb' winh yuninal to sb'o sb'a heb' winh icha yalan ley yik schi'an nok' silab' chi' heb' yet' winh.
Ayic ix k'och winhaj Isaí yet' heb' winh yuninal chi', elanhchamel ix yiloch winhaj Eliab winhaj Samuel chi', ix snaan winh: Tekan a jun winh tik ix sik'el Jehová, xchi winh.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a winh: Manh ach och k'elan chajtil yilji jun winh tik, manh iloch steel winh, yujto manhoklaj winh tik. Ha heb' anima, a chajtil yilji heb' anima, a syiloch heb', palta a in xo tik, a spensar heb' swilochi, xchi t'a winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'ankot junxo winh yuninal winhaj Isaí chi' skuchan Abinadab t'a yichanh winh, palta ix yalanxi winh: Manhoklaj junxo winh tik sik'b'ilel yuj Jehová, xchi winh.
Ix yik'ankot junxo winh yuninal winhaj Isaí chi' skuchan Sama t'a yichanh winh, ix yalanxi winh: --Manhoklaj junxo winh tik ix sik'el Jehová, xchi winh.
Ix ek'chaj heb' winh yuninal winhaj Isaí chi' yukwanhil t'a yichanh winh. Malaj junok heb' winh tik ix sik'el Jehová, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'an winh t'a winhaj Isaí chi': --¿Tom anhej heb' winh uninal tik? xchi winh. --Ayto junxo winh tzak'an unin, aykanb'at winh tanhwoj kalnel, xchi winhaj Isaí chi'. --Ak'b'at yik'umal winh an, tato max ja winh, manh ol onh walaj, xchi winhaj Samuel chi'.

Ix schekanb'at yik'umal junxo winh yuninal winhaj Isaí chi'. Axo ix jawi winh, ix yilanoch winhaj Samuel chi', chakpulinak yilji winh, te wiwo yilji yol sat winh, te wach' sniwanil winh. Ha wal t'a jun rato chi' ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Samuel chi': --Aton winh tik, ak'k'e akeite t'a sjolom winh, xchi.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'ankot nok' sch'aak winhaj Samuel chi', aton b'aj ayem akeite. D'a yichanh heb' winh yuk'tak winh chi' smasanil ix yak'k'e akeite winhaj Samuel chi' t'a sjolom winh. Ha winh chi' Dawid sb'i winh. Atax t'a jun k'u chi' ix och Yespíritu Jehová t'a winh. Axo yik ix lajwi swa heb', ix meltzajxi winhaj Samuel chi' t'a Ramá.
Ix yik'el Yespíritu Jehová t'a winhaj Saúl, haxo jun espíritu chuk ix ak'jikanoch t'a winh, ste ixtaj wal winh yuj.
Yuj chi' ix yal heb' winh schekab' winh: --Mamin rey, a tas tzach ik'ani tekan a junok espíritu chuk ix ak'jioch t'ayach yuj Dios yik tzach yixtani.

Yuj chi' schaokab' a k'ool, tzonh b'at a onh a chekab' onh tik ko say junok winh syal schalan te' arpa, yik wach' a tzach yixtan jun espíritu chi', schalan te' arpa chi' winh, icha chi' tz'aj sb'oxi a k'ool, xchi heb' winh.
--Ixiquec an, a junok winh te jelan schalan te' tzeyik'koti, xchi winhaj Saúl chi'.

Ix yalan jun winh yetb'eyum heb' winh ayek' chi' icha tik: --Ay wal jun winh wojtak a in tik, yuninal winh winhaj Isaí aj Belén, te wach' schalan te' arpa chi' winh, anhejtona' te wach' winh t'a owal. Te ay spensar winh sloloni, wach' yiljipax sniwanil winh. Ayoch Jehová yet' winh squila', xchi winh.
Yuj chi', ix yak'b'at schekab' winhaj Saúl t'a winhaj Isaí chi', ix yalanb'at winh: Ak'kot winh uninal aj Dawid t'ayin, winh stanhwan nok' a kalnel, xchib'at winh.

Ix sk'anab'ajej winhaj Isaí chi', ix yak'ankot winhaj Dawid chi' winh t'a winhaj Saúl chi'. Ix yak'ankot jun nok' b'uru winh yet' winh, kuchb'il jun ikatzil pan yuj nok' yet' jun tz'uum ayem wino t'a yool yet' pax jun nok' yune' chiwa.
Ayic ix jawi winhaj Dawid t'a winhaj Saúl chi', ix ochkan winh schekab'ok winh. Te xajan ix aj winh, ix yak'anoch winh winhaj Saúl chi' yik'umalok syamk'ab' yik owal.

Ix yak'anb'at jun schekab' winhaj Saúl chi' t'a winhaj Isaí, smam winhaj Dawid chi', ix yalanb'at winh icha tik: Elokab' t'a a k'ool to skan winhaj Dawid tik wed'ok, yujto te wach' winh t'ayin swila', xchib'at winh.

Ayic tz'ixtaj winhaj Saúl chi' yuj jun espíritu chuk ayoch chi' t'ay, tz'och ijan winhaj Dawid chi' schalan te' arpa chi'. Ayic syab'an jun chi' winhaj Saúl chi', tz'el jun espíritu chuk chi' t'a winh, wach' tz'ajxi sk'ol winh syab'i.
Ay jun k'u, ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' filisteo t'a Soco, t'a yol yik Judá, yik syak'an owal heb' yet' heb' israel. Ix sb'o skampamento heb' t'a Efes-damim, t'a snanhal Soco chi' yet' Azeca.
Anhejtona' pax winhaj Saúl, ix smolb'ejpax sb'a winh yet' heb' yetisraelal t'a sch'olanil Ela, yik smakan sat heb' filisteo chi' heb'.
Ayek' heb' filisteo chi' t'a jun tzalan, haxo t'a junxo tzalan ayek' heb' israel chi'. Ay jun ch'olan aykan t'a snanhal heb'.
Ix elta jun winh soldado t'a skal heb' filisteo chi', te niwan yelk'och winh t'a skal heb', te chaanh steel winh, ay am oxeok metro steel winh, Goliat sb'i winh, aj chonhab' Gat winh.
Ha t'a sjolom winh ayk'e jun k'een xumpil nab'a bronke, haxo pax t'a snhi' sk'ol winh ayoch jun k'een koraza nab'a bronke paxi. Ay am oyeok arroba yalil jun k'een koraza chi'.
Aypaxoch k'een bronke t'a sat spenek winh, yet'nak k'een kotak lanza winh t'a yich spatik.
Axo ste'al yok k'een slanza winh yet'nak chi', te niwan spatik, haxo k'een hierro ayoch t'a snhi', ek'to 13 libra yalil. Axo t'a yichanh winh b'ab'el sb'at winh ed'jinak smaklab' jul-lab'.

Sjawi tek'tek' winh t'a yichanh heb' soldado israel, te chaanh tz'awajk'eta winh, syalan winh: --¿Tas yuj t'a stzolal tzex komon ajelta eyak'an owal? Ha in tik filisteo in, a exxo soldado ex winhaj Saúl. Ha tiknaik, sik'equelta junok winak t'a he kal chi', yik tz'emta winh yak' owal wed'ok.
Tato stechaj yak'an owal wed'ok, tato tzin smilchamok, a onh tik ol onh ochkan he chekab'ok, palta tato a in tzin milcham jun winh chi' jun, a exxo tzex ochkan ko chekab'ok.
Tato ay junok winak t'a he kal a ex israel ex tik skot yak' owal wed' tiknaik, kotokab'i, ol kak'an owal, xchi winh filisteo chi'.
Ayic ix yab'an winhaj Saúl yet' masanil heb' soldado tas ix yal winh chi', ix te tak sk'ol heb' yuj xiwelal.
Ha t'a yol stiempoal winhaj Saúl chi', ay jun winh t'a Belén t'a yol yik Judá skuchan Isaí, te icham winakxo winh, wajxakwanh yuninal winh. Ha t'a skal heb' winh chi' ay jun winh skuchan Dawid.
Ay oxwanh yuninal winhaj Isaí chi' ayoch soldadoal yuj winhaj Saúl chi', a winhaj Eliab b'ab'el, schab'il winhaj Abinadab, yoxil winhaj Sama. Slajwub' uninxo winhaj Dawid chi'.
Ha winhaj Dawid chi', ay b'aj xid'ek' winh b'aj ay winhaj Saúl chi', smeltzajxi winh t'a Belén yik sb'at stanhwan nok' skalnel winh smam winh chi'.
Ha winh filisteo chi', junjun q'uinhib'alil yet' junjun yemk'ualil ayul winh sb'uchan heb' israel chi'. 40 k'ual ix sk'ulej winh icha chi'.
Ay jun k'u ix yal winhaj Isaí chi' t'a winhaj Dawid chi': --Ik'b'at ox almulok ixim trigo tik yet' lajunheok ixim pan, b'at ilan heb' winh uk'tak chi'.
Tzik'anb'at lajunheok nok' queso t'a winh yajalil heb' winh uk'tak chi'. Tzilani tato wach' sk'ol heb' winh uk'tak chi'. Tzik'ankot junok tas sch'oxnab'ilok tato yel wach' sk'ol heb' winh, xchi winh.
Ha t'a sch'olanil Ela ayek' winhaj Saúl yet' heb' yuk'tak winhaj Dawid chi' yet' masanil heb' soldado israel yik syak' owal heb' yet' heb' filisteo chi'.

Ayic ix sakb'inaj t'a junxo k'u, ix yak'ankan nok' skalnel winhaj Dawid chi' t'a junxo stanhwumal, ix b'at winh, ix yik'anb'at tastak ix schek winh smam winh chi' yik'b'ati. Ayic ix k'och winh t'a skampamento heb' soldado israel chi', wanxo sb'at heb' yak' owal chi', wan yel yaw heb' sb'at heb'.
Ix sb'oanoch tzolan sb'a heb', anheja' ichapax chi' ix yutej sb'a heb' filisteo chi'.
D'a elanhchamel ix yak'kan tastak yet'nak winhaj Dawid chi' ab'enal t'a junok heb' stanhwan skampamento heb', ix b'at winh b'aj tzolanoch heb' chi', ix sk'anb'an winh tas yaj heb' winh yuk'tak chi'.

Ayic wan slolon winh yet' heb', ix elixta winh filisteo aj chonhab' Gat chi', winh niwan yelk'och t'a skal heb' yetfilisteoal chi', ix syamanxioch winh sb'uchan heb' israel chi' icha t'a junjun k'u. Ix yab' winhaj Dawid chi' masanil tas ix yal winh chi'.
Ayic ix yilan winh filisteo chi' heb' israel chi', ix te xiwk'e heb', ix el lemnaj heb' t'a winh.

Ay heb' ix alani: Ina winh ix elta t'a skal heb' filisteo chi', sb'uchwaj winh t'ayonh a onh israel onh tik. Ix yal winh rey, tato ay mach syak' ganar smilancham jun winak tik, te niwan b'eyumal ol yak' winh t'ay, syak'anpax ix yisil winh yetb'eyumok, haxo heb' sk'ab' yok maxtzak stuplaj heb' t'a winh rey chi', xchi heb'.

Ix sk'anb'an winhaj Dawid t'a heb' ayek' t'a stz'ey: --¿Tas tz'ak'ji t'a junok mach tz'ak'an ganar smilancham winh filisteo chi', yik syaktej winh onh sb'uchani? ¿Tas yaj jun winh ch'ok chonhab'il chi', yuj chi' sb'uchwaj winh t'a heb' soldado yik Dios Pitzan? xchi winh.
Ix yalanxi heb' icha ix yutej yalan t'a sb'ab'elal tas tz'ak'ji t'a junok mach smilancham jun winh ajk'ol chi'.

Ayic wan sk'anb'an winhaj Dawid chi' t'a heb' ix alan chi', ix yab'an winhaj Eliab winh yuk'tak winh, ix te kot yowal winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: --¿Tas tzul a k'ulej t'a tik? ¿Mach ix ak'kan yil jaywanh nok' a kalnel t'a tzinan lu'um chi'? Vojtak to niwan elk'och a naani, palta chuk a pensar, tonhej tzul il tas tz'aj yoch owal tik, xchi winh.
--¿Tom ay tas wan ex wutan jun? ¿Tom ay yowalil in k'anb'ani? xchi winhaj Dawid chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at sk'anb'an winh t'a junxo winh. Anheja' icha chi' ix yutej junxo winh chi' yalan t'a winh.
Axo heb' ix ab'an tas ix yal winhaj Dawid chi', ix b'at heb' yal t'a winhaj Saúl chi', yuj chi' ix awtaj winhaj Dawid chi' yuj winh.
Ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Saúl chi': --Mamin, mokab' chab'ax a k'ool yuj jun winh filisteo chi'. Ol in b'at a in a chekab' in tik, ol wak' owal yet' winh, xchi winh.
--Max yal-laj a b'at ak' owal yet' jun winh filisteo chi', yujto quelem unin ach, palta a jun winh chi', toxonton ak'um owal winh yiktax ix kotoch winh quelemal, xchi winhaj Saúl chi'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Dawid chi' icha tik: --Ha in a chekab' in tik, ayik tzin tanhwan nok' skalnel winh in mam, ay b'aj sjawi nok' choj, ma nok' oso yik tzul yik'anb'at nok' kalnel chi' nok',
tzin b'at t'a spatik nok', tzin tok'anek' nok' kalnel chi' t'a nok'. Tato skot nok' t'ayin, tzin och yub'naj t'a yalanh sti' nok', tzin milancham nok'.
Yuj chi', taxonhej a junok nok' choj, ma junok nok' oso, schamnhej nok' wuuj. Icha chi' ol wutej jun winh ch'ok chonhab'il chi'. ¿Tas yuj sb'uchwaj winh t'a heb' soldado yik Dios Pitzan?

Ha Jehová tzin kolan t'a nok' choj yet' t'a nok' oso chi', anheja' ol in kolan t'a jun winh filisteo chi', xchi winh. Ix yalan winhaj Saúl chi' t'a winh: --Ixic an, aokab' Jehová ol och ed'ok, xchi winh.

Elanhchamel ix yik'el spichul winhaj Saúl yik owal ayoch yuj, ix schekan winh ak'jokoch t'a winhaj Dawid chi'. Ix ak'jik'e jun k'een xumpil nab'a bronke t'a sjolom winh, ix ak'jipaxoch jun k'een koraza t'a snhi' sk'ol winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'anoch jachan k'een espada winh t'a snanhal, ix yak'lan winh sb'eyi. Maj yal-laj sb'ey winh yet'ok, yujto manh k'ajanok winh. Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a winhaj Saúl chi'. --Max yal-laj in b'ey yet' juntzanh tik, manh in k'ajanoklaj yet'ok, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix yik'el masanil juntzanh chi' winh t'ay, ix b'at winh b'ian.

Anhej jun te' sk'okoch winh ix yik'a', ix sik'ank'e oye' k'olan k'een k'een winh t'a sti' ha ha', ix yak'anem k'een winh t'a yol jun syune' pa, yet'nak jun ch'anh mejmeech winh, ix snitzanb'at sb'a winh t'a slak'anil jun winh filisteo chi'.
Anheja' jun winh filisteo chi', ix snitzkot sb'a winh t'a slak'anil winhaj Dawid chi', b'ab'el jun winh ed'jinak smaklab' jul-lab' winh yuj.
Ayic ix iljikot winhaj Dawid chi' yuj jun winh filisteo chi', ix yilan winh to te wach' yilji sniwanil winh, palta malaj yelk'och winh t'a winh, yujto quelem unin winh.
Ix yalan winh icha tik t'a winhaj Dawid chi': --¿Tom tz'i' in tzila' yuj chi' tzach kot t'ayin yet' te' a te' chi'? xchi winh. Ix syamanoch winh skatab'an winhaj Dawid chi' t'a sb'i sdiosal.
Ix yalan winh: --Cotanh t'a tik, ol wak' a chib'ejal schib'at nok' ostok yet' nok' chium nok', xchi winh t'a winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Dawid chi' icha tik: --Ha ach tik tzach kot ak' owal wed'ok yet' k'een espada yet' k'een a lanza yet' pax k'een a kotak lanza. Ha inxo tik tzin jawi wak' owal ed'ok yet' spoder Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, aton ko Diosal a onh soldado israel onh tik, aton malaj yelk'och alani.

Ha tiknaik, a Jehová ol ach ak'anoch t'a yol in k'ab'. Ol ach in milchamok, ol in xikanel a jolom. Ol wak'anpax sniwanil heb' etchonhab' tik schib'at nok' ostok yet' nok' chium nok'. Icha chi' ol aj yojtakanel masanil anima t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik to a ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, Dios t'a wal yel.

Masanil heb' anima molanek' tik, ol nachajel yuj heb' to manhok k'een espada, manhok k'een lanza syak'lab'ej Jehová yik skolanel heb' schonhab'. Ha jun owal tik yik Jehová, ha' ol ex ak'anoch t'a yol ko k'ab', xchi winh t'a winh.
Ix kot winh filisteo chi' t'a yichanh winhaj Dawid chi', anheja' winhaj Dawid chi' elanhchamel ix b'atpax winh t'a yichanh winh.

Ix yak'anemb'at sk'ab' winhaj Dawid chi' t'a yol spa, ix yik'ank'eta jun k'een k'een winh, ix yak'anoch k'een winh t'a yol smejmeech chi', ix sjulan k'een winh. Ha wal t'a snanhal sat winh filisteo chi' ix och k'een, ix kan ch'apnaj k'een t'a snanhal sat winh chi', ix telwi winh, lachan ix aj winh t'a sat lu'um.
Icha chi' ix aj yak'ji ganar winh yuj winhaj Dawid chi'. Anhej yet' jun k'olan k'een k'een yet' jun ch'anh mejmeech ix milji winh yuj winh. Malaj yespada winhaj Dawid chi',

yuj chi' ix b'at lemnaj winh b'aj ayek' winh filisteo chi', ix yik'ank'eta k'een yespada winh winh t'a yol yatut. Ha yet' k'een ix xiquel sjolom winh filisteo chi' winh. Ayic ix yilan heb' filisteo to toxo ix cham jun winh niwan yelk'och t'a skal heb' chi', ix el lemnaj heb'.

Axo yik ix yilan heb' soldado Israel yet' heb' yik Judá, ix el yaw heb', ix b'at heb' t'a spatik heb' filisteo chi', masanto ix k'och heb' t'a sti' chonhab' Ecrón. D'a masanil yoltak b'e sb'atnhej t'a Saaraim, sk'och t'a Gat yet' t'a Ecrón chi', toxonhej teltumb'a ix ajkan sniwanil heb' soldado filisteo schami.
Ixlajwi sb'at tzak'an heb' israel t'a spatik heb' filisteo t'a juntzanh lugar chi', ix meltzaj heb' yik'elta masanil tastak ay t'a yol skampamento heb' filisteo chi'.
Ix yik'ank'e sjolom jun filisteo chi' winhaj Dawid chi', ix yik'anb'at winh t'a Jerusalén. Ix yik'anpaxel k'een syamk'ab' winh filisteo chi' winh, ix yak'anoch k'een winh t'a yol smantiado.
Ayic ix yilan winhaj Saúl sb'at winhaj Dawid yak' owal yet' winh filisteo chi', ix sk'anb'an winh t'a winhaj Abner, yajalil heb' soldado: --Abner, ¿mach smam jun winh quelem tik? xchi winh.
Mamin rey, manh wojtakoklaj, xchi winhaj Abner chi'. --Skan t'a yol a k'ab' a k'anb'ani mach ay yik winh, xchi winh rey chi'.
Ayic wan smeltzaj winhaj Dawid chi', ayik toxo ix chamkan winh filisteo chi' yuj winh, yet'nak sjolom winh chi' winh, haxo winhaj Abner ix ik'anb'at winh t'a winhaj Saúl chi'.
Ix sk'anb'an winhaj Saúl chi' t'a winh: --Ach quelem, ¿mach a mam? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Dawid chi': --Yuninal in winhaj Isaí, winh a chekab' kajan t'a Belén, xchi winh.
Ayic ix lajwi slolon winhaj Dawid yet' winhaj Saúl chi', haxo winhaj Jonatán yuninal winhaj Saúl chi', te wach' ix yil winhaj Dawid chi' winh icha wal syutej syailan sb'a.
Anheja' winhaj Saúl chi', ha t'a jun k'u chi', ix yak'kanoch yopisio winhaj Dawid chi' winh, majxo yak'laj meltzaj winh winh t'a spat smam.
Ix yak' sti' winhaj Jonatán t'a winhaj Dawid chi' to wach' ol yil-laj sb'a heb' winh t'a masanil tiempo, yujto te xajan winhaj Dawid chi' yuj winh.
Ix yik'anpaxel masanil spichul winhaj Jonatán yik owal ayoch yuj, ix yak'an winh t'a winhaj Dawid chi' yet' k'een yespada, jul-lab' yet' kincho ayoch t'a snanhal winh.

Masanil b'aj ix chekji winhaj Dawid yuj winhaj Saúl chi' t'a owal, te wach'nhej ix elk'och winh, yuj chi' ix ak'jioch winh yajalil t'a jun makan heb' soldado. Yuj chi' ix te tzalaj heb' soldado yet' heb' ayoch yopisio yuj winhaj Saúl chi'.

Ayic ix jax heb' soldado smasanil t'a owal, ayik toxo ix chamkan winh filisteo yuj winhaj Dawid chi', ix laj elta heb' ix ix t'a junjun chonhab' yik schaan heb' ix sjawi winhaj rey Saúl chi'. Sk'e chennaj heb' ix tz'elta heb' ix, stzinhan k'een spandereta heb' ix yet' k'een splatillo.
Van sb'itan heb' ix tz'elta heb' ix, syalan heb' ix icha tik: Smilal heb' ajk'ool ix smilcham winhaj Saúl. Lajlajunh miltak ix smilcham winhaj Dawid, xchi heb' ix.

Ha jun chi', te ya ix och ix yab' winhaj Saúl chi', yuj chi' ix chichonk'e sk'ool winh, ix yalan winh: --Ste ik'jiwalchaanh winhaj Dawid t'a wichanh, yuj chi' syal heb' ix ix tik to lajlajunh miltak ix smilcham winh, a inxo tik jayenhej mil ix in milchamok. Jab'xonhej wal yoch winh tik reyal in k'exulok, xchi spensar winh chi'.
Atax ta' ix ochkan chi'an sk'ol winh t'a winhaj Dawid chi'.

Axo t'a junxo k'u, ix och jun espíritu chuk yuj Jehová t'a winhaj Saúl chi', ix och lokoax winh t'a sdespacho, ix och ijan winhaj Dawid schalan te' arpa, ichataxon sk'ulej, yet'k'e jun k'een lanza winhaj Saúl chi'.

Ix kot wal numnaj t'a sjolom winh ix yila', ix sjulanoch k'een slanza winh chi' t'a winhaj Dawid chi', yik tz'ochkan ch'apnaj winh yet' k'een t'a sat pat chi' snaan winh, palta chael ix skol sb'a winhaj Dawid chi'.
Ix xiwk'e winhaj Saúl t'a winhaj Dawid chi', yujto a Jehová ayoch yet' winhaj Dawid chi', haxo pax yet' winh jun, manhxo ayok ochlaj Jehová chi'.

Yuj chi', manhxook t'a spat winh chi' ix munlaj winhaj Dawid chi', palta to ix yik'el winh winh t'a stz'ey. Ix yak'anoch winh winh yajalil t'a jun mil heb' soldado, aton winh ed'jinak heb' ayik ix xid'ek' heb' t'a owal.
Yalnhej b'aj ix ek' winhaj Dawid chi', wach'nhej tz'aj yelk'ochi, yujto a Jehová ayoch yet' winh.
Yuj chi' ix te wach' xiw winhaj Saúl chi' t'a winh.
Masanil heb' israel yet' heb' aj Judá, te xajan winhaj Dawid chi' yuj heb'. Ste tzalaj heb' yet' winh yujto a winh skuchb'an heb' t'a owal.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Saúl t'a winhaj Dawid chi': --Swak' ix b'ab'el wisil skuchan Merab etb'eyumok, anhej to jelannhej tzutej a b'ha t'a owal, tzak'an owal kuj a onh schonhab' onh Jehová tik, xchi winh. Ix sna winhaj Saúl icha chi' yujto malaj snib'ej winh yoch smul smilan winhaj Dawid chi', wach' ama tato a heb' filisteo smilan winh snaan winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Dawid chi': --Mamin rey, malaj jab'ok welk'ochi, manh niwanoklaj yelk'och in mam yet' heb' in k'ab' wok t'a skal heb' quetisraelal yik tzin och a nhi'ok, xchi winh.
Axo yik ix k'och stiempoal yak'an ix yisil winhaj Saúl chi' yetb'eyumok winh, aton ix Merab, haxo t'a winhaj Adriel aj Mehola ix yak' ix winh.
Axo junxo ix yisil winh skuchan Mical, te ay snib'ej ix t'a winhaj Dawid chi'. Ayic ix yab'an winhaj Saúl chi' icha chi', te wach' ix yab' winh.

Yuj chi' ix snaan winh to ol yak' junxo ix yisil winh chi' yetb'eyumok winhaj Dawid chi', yik wach' yuj ix ol miljokcham winhaj Dawid chi' yuj heb' filisteo. Ix yalan winhaj Saúl t'a winhaj Dawid t'a schaelal: --Ha tiknaik, wal yel ol ach och in nhi'ok, xchi winh.

Ix stz'akan yal winh t'a heb' winh ayoch t'a yopisio yuj: --Tzex lolon yet' winhaj Dawid he ch'okoj, tzeyalan t'a winh icha tik: Ha winh rey, tzach ste xajanej winh, tzach ko xajanejpax a onh tik. Yuj chi' ach ochokab' snhi'ok winh rey chi', xe chi t'a winh, xchi winhaj Saúl chi'.

Ix b'at heb' winh ay yopisio chi' yal juntzanh chi' t'a winhaj Dawid chi', ix tak'wi winh t'a heb' icha tik: --Am he naani to sekojtak woch snhi'ok winh rey chi', ina to meb'a' in, malaj jab'ok welk'ochi, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at heb' schekab' winhaj Saúl chi' yal t'ay, tas ix aj yalan winhaj Dawid chi'.

Ix yalanxi winhaj Saúl chi' t'a heb' ay yopisio chi': --Alec t'a winh, max stuplaj ix wisil tik winh icha sb'eyb'al heb' anima, anhej syik'kot 100-ok sjolom swinaquil heb' winh filisteo winh t'ayin. Icha chi' tz'aj in pakan in b'ha t'a heb' wajk'ol chi', xe chi t'a winh, xchi winh rey chi'. Icha chi' ix yutej winh rey chi' yalani yik smiljicham winhaj Dawid chi' yuj heb' filisteo chi'.
Ix b'atxi heb' ay yopisio chi' yal t'a winhaj Dawid chi'. Ix schaan sk'ol winh yoch snhi'ok winh rey chi'. Ayic manto k'ochlaj sk'ual,

ix b'at winhaj Dawid chi' yet' heb' soldado, ix smilancham 200 heb' winh filisteo winh. Tz'akan ix yik'kot sjolom swinaquil heb' winh winh t'a winhaj Saúl chi' yik tz'ochkan winh snhi'ok winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an ix Mical yisil winhaj Saúl chi' yetb'eyumok winh.
Ix nachajel yuj winhaj Saúl chi', ix yilan winh to a Jehová ayoch yet' winhaj Dawid chi', ix yilanpax winh to te xajan winh yuj ix Mical chi',
yuj chi' ix te wach' xiwk'e winh t'a winh, ix te wach' och winh ajk'olal t'a winh.

Ha heb' filisteo ix te ochnhej heb' yak' owal yet' heb' israel, palta a winhaj Dawid chi', te jelan winh t'a owal t'a yichanh juntzanhxo heb' yetyajalil soldado winhaj Saúl t'a juntak el, yuj chi' ix te b'inaj winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Saúl t'a winhaj Jonatán yet' t'a heb' ay yopisio to smilcham winhaj Dawid heb'. Palta te xajan winhaj Dawid chi' yuj winhaj Jonatán chi',
yuj chi' ix yalan winh t'a winh icha tik: --Van snaan winh in mam ach smilchamok. Yuj chi' te lista tzutej a b'a k'ik'an, tza k'ub'ejel a b'ha t'a junok b'aj te k'ub'eltak.
Yujto a k'ik'an chi', tzin b'at yet' winh in mam chi' t'a slak'anil b'aj ayach ek' chi', swalan t'a winh uuj, tzaxo wal t'ayach tas tz'aj yalan winh, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Jonatán t'a winh smam chi' yuj tastak wach' sk'ulej winhaj Dawid chi' icha tik: --Mamin, manh wach'ok tato tzach och ajk'olal t'a winhaj Dawid a chekab', yujto malaj b'aj tz'och smul winh t'ayach, yujto niwan tas wach' ix ik' t'a spatik winh.

Ix ila' to ix sb'ek sb'a winh schami ayik ix smilancham winh filisteo winh, icha chi' ix aj skolchaj ko chonhab' tik yuj Jehová. Ha jun chi' ix il wal. Ix ach te tzalaji. ¿Tas yuj tza na' a milcham winh, ina to malaj jab'ok smul winh t'ayach? xchi winh.
Ix scha yab' winhaj Saúl chi' tas ix yal winhaj Jonatán chi', ix yalan winh: --Tik swak' kan in ti' t'a yichanh Jehová to manh ol in milcham winh, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix awtaj winhaj Dawid chi' yuj winhaj Jonatán chi', ix yalan winh tas ix aj yalan winh smam chi' t'ay. Ix yik'anb'at winhaj Dawid chi' winh t'a yichanh winh smam chi', ix ochxi winh t'a yopisio t'a stz'ey winhaj Saúl chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix ochxi owal junelxo yet' heb' filisteo, ix elixta winhaj Dawid chi' yak' owal yet' heb', te niwan heb' ix smilcham winh, yuj chi' ix el lemnaj heb' t'a winh.

Axo pax winhaj Saúl chi', ix ochxi jun espíritu chuk t'a winh yuj Jehová. k'ojanem winh t'a yol spat, yet'nakk'e k'een slanza winh, haxo winhaj Dawid chi' wan schalan te' arpa winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi'.

Ix yik'anchaanh k'een slanza winh rey chi', ix sjulanoch k'een winh t'a winhaj Dawid yik tz'ochkan ch'apan winh t'a sat pat chi' yuj k'een yalani, palta ix skol sb'a winhaj Dawid chi', yuj chi' ix b'atkan ch'apan k'een lanza chi' t'a sat pat chi'. Ix el lemnaj winhaj Dawid t'a jun ak'wal chi', ix b'at winh t'a spat.

Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi', ix yal winhaj Saúl chi' to sb'at och stanhwumal winhaj Dawid chi' t'a spat, yik wach' haxo t'a junxo q'uinhib'alil, b'at miljokcham winh. Axo ix Mical yetb'eyum winh ix alan t'ay: --Tato manh ol a kol a b'ha t'a jun ak'wal tik, k'ik'an chamnak achxo, xchi ix.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'anelta jun ch'anh lasu ix t'a jun wentena, ata' ix emta winhaj Dawid chi' yik skolan sb'a.

Ix yik'ankot jun sdiosal ix, ix yak'anek' jichan ix t'a sat sch'at winhaj Dawid chi'. Ix yak'anoch juntzanh xil nok' chiwa ix jalb'il t'a sjolom jun sdiosal chi', ix yak'anb'at jun sábana ix t'a yib'anh.
Ayic ix yak'anb'at heb' schekab' winhaj Saúl b'at syam winhaj Dawid chi', ix yalan ix Mical to penaay winh.
Ix schekanxib'at heb' schekab' winhaj Saúl chi', ix yalan winh: --Ik'ekkot winh t'a sat sch'at chi' t'a tik, a in ol in milcham winh, xchi winh.
Ix och heb' t'a yol spat winhaj Dawid chi' yik syilan heb', tikni anhej jun yechel jichanek' t'a sat ch'at chi', ayoch jun xil chiwa sk'anh jolomok. Ix b'at yalan heb' t'a winhaj Saúl chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Saúl chi' t'a ix Mical chi': --¿Tas yuj tzin ixtej, tza kolanel jun winh wajk'ol chi'? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi ix: --Yujto ix yal winh t'ayin: Ol ach in milchamok tato max in a chaeli, xchi winh, xchi ix.

Icha chi' ix aj skolchaj winhaj Dawid chi'. Ix b'at skolan sb'a winh b'aj ay winhaj Samuel t'a Ramá. Ix yalan winh t'a winh tas ix utaj yuj winhaj Saúl chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winhaj Samuel chi' yet' winh t'a Naiot yik b'at kajnaj heb' winh ta'.
Ayic ix yab'an winhaj Saúl chi' to ha t'a Naiot t'a yol yik Ramá ayek' winhaj Dawid chi',

ix yak'anb'at schekab' winh yik b'at ik'jokkot winh. Ayic ix k'och heb' chekab' chi', ix yilan juntzanh heb' schekab' Jehová heb', wan sb'itan heb' yuj Yespíritu Dios, haxo winhaj Samuel chi' skuchb'an heb'. Ha t'a jun rato chi', ix och Yespíritu Dios t'a heb' schekab' winhaj Saúl chi', ix och heb' t'a skal heb', ix b'itan heb'.
Ayic ix yab'an jun chi' winhaj Saúl chi', ix yak'anb'at junxo makan heb' schekab' winh. Anheja' ix ochpax heb' t'a skal heb' wan sb'itan chi'.

Yuj chi', a wal winhaj Saúl chi' ix b'at ilanok, haxo yik ix k'och winh t'a jun niwan uk'b'ila' ay t'a Secú, ix sk'anb'an winh b'ajtil ayek' winhaj Samuel yet' winhaj Dawid. Ay mach ix alan t'a winh to ato t'a Naiot t'a yol yik Ramá ayek' heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winh ta'. Elanhchamel ix ochpax Yespíritu Dios t'a winh, yakb'an wan sb'ey winh, ix och ijan winh sb'itani masanto ix k'och winh t'a Naiot chi'.

Ix yik'anel spichul winh yik sreyal, komon animaxonhej ix yutej sb'a winh t'a yichanh winhaj Samuel chi' ayik ix b'itan winh chi'. Ichaxonhej chi' ix yutej sb'a winh ix ek' k'u yet' ix ek' ak'wal. Ha yuj jun chi' ix elta jun lolonel tz'alji: Ipan pax winhaj Saúl ayoch t'a skal heb' schekab' Dios, xchi.

Ix el lemnaj winhaj Dawid t'a Naiot t'a yol yik Ramá, ix b'at yilan winhaj Jonatán winh, yik syal winh t'a winh: --¿Tas wal in mul? ¿Tom ay wal junok in mul te chuk ix in k'ulej t'a winh a mam, yuj chi' tzin sayek' winh yik tzin smilanchamok? xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Jonatán chi': --Manh jab'ok, manh ol ach chamlaj. Scham a naani to a masanil tas sk'ulej winh in mam chi', syalnhej winh t'ayin, wach'chom niwan yelk'ochi, ma quennhej. ¿Tom ijan manh ol yal winh t'ayin yuj jun tik? Maay amlaj, xchi winh.

Ix och ijan winhaj Dawid chi' yalani: --Yojtak winh a mam chi' to te wach' kak'ani, yuj chi' max yal-laj winh t'ayach, max yal-laj sk'ol winh tzojtaquejeli, yik max ach kusi. Palta yojtakxo Jehová to ayxo och chamel t'a wib'anh, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Jonatán chi': --Tato ay junok b'aj syal ach in kolani, al t'ayin, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Dawid chi': --Ha k'ik'an tz'och q'uinh yuj yalji k'een uj, yowalil tzin em k'ojan in wa t'a stz'ey winh rey chi'. Elokab' t'a a k'ool tzin k'ub'ejkanel in b'ha t'a kaltak te' tik, masanto t'a yemk'ualil chab'ej.
Tato tzin sk'anb'ej winh a mam chi', tzal t'a winh to a t'ayach ix in k'ana' to tzin b'atkan t'a Belén in chonhab', yujto a masanil heb' in k'ab' wok ol ak'anoch q'uinh ichataxon t'a junjun ab'il.
Yik'okab' tas tzal chi', tato xchi winh, wach' wik syal chi'. Tato skot yowal winh jun, syalelk'ochi to naanxo yuj winh in smilanchamok.

Ina to toxo ix kak' ko ti' t'a yichanh Jehová to wach' kak'ani, yuj chi' tzin k'an jun tik t'ayach. Palta tato yel ay in mul, syal in a milanchamok, manh yowalilok tzin ik'b'at t'a yichanh winh a mam chi', xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Jonatán chi': --Manh a na icha chi', tato ix wab' spekal to snib'ej winh in mam chi' tzach smilchamok, toxom ix wal t'ayach, xchi winh t'a winh.
--¿Mach pax ol alan t'ayin, tato chuk ol aj stak'wok winh t'ayach? xchi winhaj Dawid chi'.
Ix yalan winhaj Jonatán chi': --Conh wed'ok, konh el t'a spatiquel chonhab' tik, xchi winh. Ix b'at heb' winh schawanhil.
