Ayic ix k'och heb' winh b'aj manhxalaj anima, ix yalan winhaj Jonatán chi': --Yojtak Jehová ko Diosal to yel swala'. Ha k'ik'an, ma chab'ej yab' icha tik, tzin k'anb'ej t'a winh in mam chi', tas nab'il yuj winh. Tato wach' tas sna' winh t'a a patik, swalkot ab'i.

Tato chuk spensar winh t'a a patik jun, aokab' Jehová ol ak'an in yaelal tato max wal t'ayach yuj tas ol aj a kolan a b'a. Axo tiknaik, kolwajokab' Jehová ed'ok icha ix aj skolwaj yet' winh in mam chi'.
Ha tiknaik, tato pitzaninto ol ach ochkan reyal, tzin k'an t'ayach to ol ok' a k'ool t'ayin icha yok'elk'olal Jehová t'ayach, manh ol in a milchamlaj.
Tato toxo in cham jun, tzin k'an t'ayach to tza nakot winhtilal t'a masanil tiempo. Ayic ol satjiel heb' ajk'ol yuj Jehová, mokab' satel in b'inaj t'a a makb'en, xchi winh.

Icha chi' ix aj sb'oankan strato winhaj Jonatán chi' yet' winhaj Dawid chi', ol b'eynhejb'at t'a skal yinhtilal winhaj Dawid chi'. Ix yalan winhaj Jonatán chi' icha tik: Aokab' Jehová tz'ak'an a yaelal tato manh ol elk'och tas skalkan tik, xchi winh.
Yujto te xajan winhaj Dawid chi' yuj winhaj Jonatán chi', yuj chi' ix yal winh to swach' b'oejxikan jun strato heb' winh chi'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Jonatán chi': --K'ik'an tz'och q'uinh yuj yalji k'een uj, scheklaji to malaj ach yujto sekan tz'ajkan b'aj tzach em k'ojan.
Palta haxo chab'ej t'a yemk'ualil, sb'at a k'ub'ejel a b'a b'aj a k'ub'ejnaquel a b'a junel. Tza tanhwej t'a slak'anil k'een k'een skuch Ezel.
Tzin julb'at oxeok in jul-lab' ta', ichato ay junok mach b'aj wan in julwajb'ati.

Slajwi chi', swalan t'a winh in chekab': Ixic b'at ik'kot in jul-lab' chi', xin cham t'a winh. Tato swal t'a winh icha tik: Ha t'a yichanhkot tik ay, ik'kot te', ta xin chi, tzach kot t'a junk'olal, malaj tas ol ach ik'an syal chi'. Toxo ix wak' in ti' t'a yichanh Jehová to icha chi' ol wutej.
Palta tato swal jun: Ha jun in jul-lab' chi', najatto ay t'a ichanhb'at chi', tato xin chi t'a winh, tzach b'at t'a najat a kol a b'a yujto a Jehová tzach chekanb'ati.
Ha pax t'a ko ti' ix kalkan tik jun, a Jehová testigo tz'ajkan t'ay to junelnhej skalkani, xchi winh t'a winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix sk'ub'anel sb'a winhaj Dawid chi' t'a kaltak te'. Ayic ix chajiel yich yik tz'och q'uinh yuj yalji k'een uj, ix em k'ojan winhaj rey Saúl swa'i.

Ha t'a sat pat ix em k'ojan winh t'a b'ajtaxon tz'em k'ojan. Ha t'a yichanh winh ix em k'ojan winhaj Jonatán, haxo t'a stz'ey winh ix em k'ojan winhaj Abner, haxo pax xila winhaj Dawid, malaj mach ix em k'ojan t'ay.

Ha t'a b'ab'el k'u, malaj tas ix yal winhaj Saúl chi', yujto ix sna winh icha tik: Tekan ay junok tas manh wach'ok ix sk'ulej winhaj Dawid chi', maj am yal sb'oan sb'a winh icha yalan ley t'a ayokto, xchi winh t'a spensar chi'.

Schab'ilxo k'ual yajoch q'uinh chi', kolannhej xila winhaj Dawid chi', malaj mach tz'em k'ojan t'ay. Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'ej winhaj Saúl t'a winhaj Jonatán icha tik: --¿Tas yuj maj jawi winh yuninal winhaj Isaí chi' wael tiknaik yet' ewi? xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Jonatán chi': --Ha winhaj Dawid chi' alan t'ayin ewi,

tob' masanil heb' sk'ab' yok winh snaan q'uinh yik silab' t'a schonhab', yuj chi' ix awtajb'at winh yuj jun winh yuk'tak. Yal winh t'ayin icha tik: Tato wach' in t'a a sat, cha in b'at wak' tzalajb'ok in k'ool yet' heb' wuk'tak chi', xchi winh. Yuj chi' max jawilaj winh wael t'a a mexa tik, xchi winh.

Ayic ix yab'an winh rey icha chi', ix kot yowal winh t'a winhaj Jonatán chi', ix yalan winh: --Mitz' unin ach, b'ajam sik'b'il ach. Vojtak to wach' ak'an yet' winh yuninal winhaj Isaí chi', yik q'uixwelal tzach ajkan yet' ix a nun.

¿Tom max nachajel jab'ok uuj to yakb'an pitzan winh yuninal winhaj Isaí chi', manh ol ach och reyal yet' pax heb' inhtilal? Ha tiknaik, ak'b'at sayumal winh, tzik'ankot winh t'ayin, ol in milancham winh, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Jonatán chi' icha tik: --¿Tas yuj ol cham winh? ¿Tom ay junok tas chuk ix sk'ulej winh, yuj chi' icha chi' tzala'? xchi winh.

Ayic ix yab'an jun chi' winhaj Saúl chi', ix sjulanb'at jun k'een slanza winh t'a winhaj Jonatán chi' yik smilancham winh. Icha chi' ix aj snachajel yuj winhaj Jonatán chi' to ha' winh smam winh chi', snib'ej winh smilcham winhaj Dawid chi'.

Ix kot yowal winhaj Jonatán chi', ix k'e juknaj winh, ix elta winh. Majxo walaj winh yet' heb' winh t'a schab'il k'ual chi', yujto ix kus winh yuj winhaj Dawid chi', yujto te chuk tas ix yal winhaj Saúl chi' ix yab' winh.
D'a wal sakb'inaj t'a junxo k'u, ix b'at winh yil winhaj Dawid chi', icha yaj yalankan heb' winh, tzak'anoch jun winh quelem unin yuj winh.

Ix yalan winh t'a winh quelem chi': --Elanhchamel ol b'at ik'kot in jul-lab' ol in julb'at tik, xchi winh. Ix b'at winh quelem chi' b'ian. Ha wal sb'at winh chi', ix julwajb'at winhaj Jonatán chi' t'a yichanhb'at winh.

Ayic ix k'och winh b'aj ix em jul-lab' chi', te chaanh ix awaj winhaj Jonatán chi' icha tik: --Yel a k'ool, manh ach och waan, ato t'a ichanhb'at ix k'ochi, xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix yalanxi winh: --Yelk'olal a b'ati, manh ach och waan, xchi winh. Ix sik'ank'e jul-lab' chi' winh quelem chi', ix yik'ankot winh.
Palta maj nachajel-laj jab'ok yuj winh tas ix sk'ulej winhaj Jonatán chi', anhej winh ojtannak yet' winhaj Dawid tas yaj jun slolonel chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an sjul-lab' winhaj Jonatán chi' t'a winh quelem chi', ix schekan meltzaj winh winh t'a chonhab'.

Ixnhej b'atkan winh quelem chi', ix elkankot winhaj Dawid t'a spatik k'een k'een. Ixnhej elta winh chi', oxel ix em nhojan winh t'a yichanh winhaj Jonatán chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix stz'ub'lanelta sti' heb' winh, ix ok' heb' winh schawanhil, ix sik'sik'an wal winhaj Dawid chi' yoq'ui.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Jonatán chi' t'a winh: --Ixic, junk'olal a b'ati yujto a ko ti' ix kak' ko chawanhil, t'a yichanh Jehová ix kala'. Ix ko k'an t'a Jehová chi' to aynhejokab'och qued'ok ko chawanhil yet' heb' quinhtilal yik tz'elkank'och b'aj ix kak' ko ti', yik wach'nhej pax kak'ani yet' heb' quinhtilal, xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'atkan winhaj Dawid chi', haxo winhaj Jonatán chi' ix meltzajkankot winh t'a chonhab'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'atkan winhaj Dawid chi' t'a chonhab' Nob, ix ek' winh t'a winhaj sakerdote Ahimelec. Ix xiwk'e winh sakerdote chi' ayik ix ul schaan winhaj Dawid chi' winh, ix yalan winh t'a winh: --¿Tas yuj a achnhej tzach jawi, malaj junok mach ed'nak? xchi winh t'a winhaj Dawid chi'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Dawid chi': --Atoni, yujto ay tas ix schek winh rey ul in k'ulej, palta snib'ej winh to malaj mach tz'ojtakaneli, haxo pax heb' winh ajun wed' jun, ix wal t'a heb' winh b'ajtil ol wil-lajxi in b'a yet' heb' winh.
Ha tiknaik, ¿ay am jab'ok tas sko wa t'ayach? Ak' oyeok ko pan, ma yalnhej tas ayek' t'ayach, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winh sakerdote chi': --Malaj ixim komon pan ayeq'ui. Ay ixim, palta a ixim tz'ak'jioch t'a yichanh Jehová. Syal wak'an ixim t'ayach, tato wach' yaj heb' winh ajun chi' ed'ok, tato maj way heb' winh yet' heb' ix ix, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Dawid chi' icha tik: --Ayxotax skan heb' ix kuuj, chab'jitax onh koti. Wach'chom yel, manh yikok Jehová jun ko cheknab'il tik, palta yiktax onh koti, wach'xo yaj heb' winh wed'nak chi' icha yalan ley, yuj chi' yel wach'xo yaj heb' winh tiknaik, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an ixim pan yik Dios winh sakerdote chi' t'a winh. Malaj junokxo makan ixim pan ay t'a yol sk'ab' winh sakerdote chi', anhej ixim toxo ix ik'jiel t'a yichanh Dios t'a sat mexa yik tz'ochixpaxkan ixim k'ak'to sk'exulok.

Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ayek' jun winh schekab' winhaj Saúl t'a slak'anil skajnub' Dios, yujto ay tas ayoch t'a yib'anh winh. Ha jun winh chi', edomita winh, Doeg sb'i winh, yajal yaj winh t'a skal heb' stanhwumal skalnel winhaj Saúl chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Dawid chi' t'a winhaj Ahimelec chi' icha tik: --¿Ay am junok k'een lanza, ma junok k'een espada ayek' t'ayach? Yujto t'a elanhchamel xonhej ix aj in chekjikot yuj winh rey chi', yuj chi' majxo yal wik'ankot k'een wespada, ma junokxo k'een yamk'ab', xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winh sakerdote chi': --Ha t'a tik ayek' k'een yespada winhaj Goliat, winh filisteo a milnakcham t'a sch'olanil yik Ela. Ha t'a tik ayek' k'een, pichanoch jun k'apak t'a k'een, ayek' k'een t'a spatik k'apak chaleka. Syal ik'anb'at k'een. Tato max scha a k'ol k'een jun, manhxalaj junokxo k'een ay t'ayin, xchi winh t'a winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Dawid chi', ix yalan winh: --Malaj junokxo k'een lajan yet' jun k'een chi'. Ak' k'een t'ayin, xchi winh.
Anheja' t'a jun k'u chi' ix b'atnhej winhaj Dawid chi' sk'ub'ejel sb'ha t'a winhaj Saúl chi', ix k'och winh t'a chonhab' Gat b'aj rey winhaj Aquis.

Axo heb' schekab' winhaj Aquis chi' ix alan icha tik: --Ha jun winh tik aton winhaj Dawid, icha rey yaj winh t'a Israel. Aton winh sb'itaj yuj heb' ix ix ayik sk'e chennaj heb' ix, syalan heb' ix icha tik: Smilal heb' ajk'ol ix smilcham winhaj Saúl. Lajlajunh miltak ix smilcham winhaj Dawid, xchi heb' ix, xchi heb'.
Ix cham wal yab'an juntzanh lolonel chi' winhaj Dawid chi', yuj chi' ix xiw winh t'a winhaj Aquis chi'.
D'a yichanh heb' ix k'exwi yilji winhaj Dawid chi', ix yesanoch sb'a winh quistalil, komonxonhej stz'ib'ej ch'akan spatiktak puerta winh, tz'emta jililok yal sti' winh t'a xil sti'.
Ix yalan winhaj Aquis chi' t'a heb' schekab' chi': --Tato ix eyila' to quistal jun winak tik, ¿tas yuj ix eyik'kot winh t'ayin?
¿Tocwal malaj heb' quistal t'a tik, yuj chi' ix eyik'kot junxo winh tik yik tzul yak' squistalil winh chi' t'a yol in pat tik? xchi winh.

Ix elxi winhaj Dawid chi' ta', ix b'at sk'ub'anel sb'a winh t'a jun k'een nhak'een t'a yol yik Adulam. Ayic ix yab'an heb' winh yuk'tak winh yet' heb' sk'ab' yok winh b'aj ayek' winh, ix b'at heb' winh sk'ub'ejel sb'a yet' winh.
Ix k'ochpax heb' tz'ixtaxi, masanil heb' ay sb'ok yet' heb' ay schab'k'olal. Ha winhaj Dawid chi' ix och yajalilok heb'. Ay am junok 400 heb' winh winak t'a smasanil.

Spetoj winhaj Dawid t'a Adulam chi', ix k'ochkan winh t'a Mizpa, t'a yol yik Moab. Ix yalan winh t'a winh sreyal Moab chi' icha tik: --Tzin tewi t'ayach to skan winh in mam yet' ix in nun ed'ok masanto ol wil tas ol in yutej Dios, xchi winh.
Icha chi' ix aj yik'anb'at smam snun winh chi' t'a yichanh winh sreyal Moab chi'. Ha yet' winh ix aj heb' yakb'an ayek' winhaj Dawid chi' skol sb'ha t'a jolomtak witz.

Axo winhaj Gad, schekab' Dios ix alan t'a winhaj Dawid chi' icha tik: --Manh ach kan t'a tik yuj a kolan a b'a, palta meltzajanh t'a yol yik Judá, xchi winh. Icha chi' ix aj sb'at winhaj Dawid, masanto ix k'och winh t'a jun kaltak te' t'a yol yik Haret.

Ay jun k'ual, k'ojanem winhaj Saúl t'a yich jun te' tamarisko t'a jolom witz t'a Gabaa, lak'b'ilk'e k'een slanza winh yuj, oyanoch heb' yajalil soldado t'a spatik winh. Ata' ix yab' winh to ix cheklaj b'aj ayek' winhaj Dawid yet' heb' soldado.

Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a heb' soldado oyanoch t'a spatik chi': --Ex wetchonhab' yinhtilal Benjamín, ab'ek tas ol wala': ¿Tom tzeyak'och t'a he k'ool to a winh yuninal winhaj Isaí chi' ol ak'an he lu'um yet' te' eyuwa? ¿Tom he masanil ol ex och t'a komandanteal yet' t'a kapitanil yuj winh?

Yuj chi' he masanilxonhej a ex ayex ek' tik tzex och ajk'olal t'ayin. Malaj mach tz'alan t'ayin, tato a winh wuninal toxo ix yak' strato winh yet' winh yuninal winhaj Isaí chi'. Malaj junok ex ayex ek' tik tzex och jab'ok ilk'olal wuuj. Malaj junok ex tzeyal t'ayin tato toxo ix och winh wuninal chi' yak'an sk'ol jun in chekab', yik tz'och ajk'olal t'ayin in smilan icha sk'ulej tiknaik, xchi winhaj Saúl chi'.

Aypaxoch winhaj Doeg aj Edom t'a skal heb' schekab' winhaj Saúl chi', yuj chi' ix tak'wi winh icha tik: --Ix wil winh yuninal winhaj Isaí chi' ayik ix b'atkan winh t'a Nob, ix k'och winh t'a winhaj Ahimelec yuninal winhaj Ahitob.
Ha winhaj Ahimelec chi', ix sk'anb'ej winh t'a Jehová yuj winhaj Dawid chi', ix ak'ji swael winh yuj winh. Ix yak'anpax k'een yespada winhaj Goliat winh filisteo winh t'a winh, xchi winhaj Doeg chi'.

Yuj chi' ix schekan winh rey chi' awtaj winhaj sakerdote Ahimelec chi' yet' masanil heb' winh sakerdote ay t'a Nob chi', aton heb' winh sk'ab' yokto sb'a yet' winhaj Ahimelec chi'. Ayic ix k'och heb' winh smasanil t'a yichanh winh rey chi',
ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Ahimelec chi': --Ach yuninal winhaj Ahitob, ab' tas ol wala', xchi winh. --Ayinek' t'a yol a k'ab' mamin rey, xchi winhaj Ahimelec chi'.

Ix sk'anb'an winhaj Saúl chi' t'a winh icha tik: --¿Tas yuj ayach och ajk'olal t'ayin yet' winh yuninal winhaj Isaí chi'? Ix ak' swael winh, ix ak'anpax jun k'een espada t'a winh, ix a k'anb'an d'ha Dios yuj winh, yik tz'och winh ajk'olal t'ayin yik tzin smilani, ichaton sk'ulej winh tiknaik, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Ahimelec chi' t'a winh rey chi': --Mamin rey, ¿mach junok t'a skal heb' a chekab' sk'anab'ajej wal icha winhaj Dawid, anhejtona' to a nhi' pax winh, yajal pax yaj winh t'a skal heb' a tanhwumal, te niwan pax yelk'och winh t'a a palakio?

¿Tocwal b'ab'elto tzin k'anb'ej d'ha Dios yuj winh? Mamin rey, malaj b'aj tzin och ajk'olal t'ayach, yuj chi' mokab'a tas tza na' t'a in patik yet' t'a spatik heb' in k'ab' wok, yujto manh wojtakok jab'ok tas yaj jun lolonel tik, xchi winh.
Palta t'a yelk'olal ix yal winh rey chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Anhejto tzak'och t'a a k'ool to ol ach cham yet' masanil heb' a k'ab' ok tik, xchi winh.

Ha wal t'a jun rato chi' ix schekan heb' stanhwumal winh rey chi', ix yalan winh: --Mileccham masanil heb' winh sakerdote yik Jehová tik, yujto ayoch heb' winh yet' winhaj Dawid chi'. Yojtak heb' winh to tz'el winh elelal t'ayin, palta maj yal-laj heb' winh wab'i, xchi winh. Palta a heb' soldado stanhwumal winh rey chi', maj yal-laj sk'ol heb' ix smilcham heb' winh sakerdote yik Jehová chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yal winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Doeg chi': --Milcham heb' winh a ach tik, xchi winh. Ix och ijan winhaj Doeg chi' smilancham heb' winh sakerdote chi'. Ha t'a jun k'u chi', 85 heb' winak tz'ak'anoch k'apak chaleka nab'a lino ix smilcham winhaj Doeg chi'.

D'a elanhchamel, ix ochpax winh t'a yol chonhab' Nob, aton schonhab' heb' winh sakerdote chi', a yet' k'een espada ix smilcham masanil heb' winak winh, heb' ix ix, heb' unin yet' heb' ato yalji. Ix smilpaxcham nok' wakax winh, nok' b'uru yet' nok' kalnel.
Palta ay jun winh yuninal winhaj Ahimelec, skuchan Abiatar, ix yak' ganar winh yel lemnaj b'aj wan yoch chamel chi', ix b'atkan winh b'aj ayek' winhaj Dawid.
A' winh ix alan t'a winhaj Dawid chi' to a masanil heb' winh sakerdote yik Jehová, toxo ix miljicham heb' winh yuj tas ix yal winhaj Saúl.

Ix yalan winhaj Dawid chi': --Ha jun chi' wojtaktaxoni, yujto ha t'a yik chi' ix wila'' to ayek' winhaj Doeg ta', yuj chi' ix in na'a to a winh ol alan t'a winhaj Saúl chi'. Ha tiknaik, wuuj ix cham masanil heb' a k'ab' ok chi',
palta jun, kananh wed' t'a tik. Manh ach xiwok, yujto a winh ayoch ajk'olal chi' t'ayach, aypaxoch winh ajk'olal t'ayin, palta wach' aj wed' t'a tik, xchi winh.
Ay jun k'ual ix och heb' filisteo yak' owal t'a chonhab' Keila, ix elk'ajb'at strigo heb' toto wal ix stek'eli, yuj chi' ayik ix yalan jun tik heb' t'a winhaj Dawid,

ix b'at sk'anb'an yab' winh t'a Jehová icha tik: --¿Tzam in a chab'at wak' owal yet' juntzanh filisteo chi'? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi Jehová: --Ixic ak' owal, tza kolankanel chonhab' Keila tik, xchi t'a winh.

Axo heb' winh ajun yet' winhaj Dawid chi', ix yal heb' t'a winh icha tik: --Ina to t'a xiwk'olal ayonhek' t'a Judá tik, okxom wal to tzonh b'at kak' owal yet' heb' filisteo t'a chonhab' Keila, xchi heb'.
Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'ejxi winh t'a Jehová. Ix tak'wixi t'a winh, ix yalani: --Ixic t'a chonhab' Keila chi'. Ha in ol wak'och heb' filisteo chi' t'a yol a k'ab', xchi.

Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Dawid chi' yet' heb' soldado ajun yet'ok t'a chonhab' Keila chi'. Ata' ix yak' owal heb' yet' heb' filisteo chi'. Ix ak'ji ganar heb' yuj heb', yuj chi' ix yik'kanek' smolb'etzal nok' heb' smasanil. Icha chi' ix aj skolchajkanel heb' kajan t'a Keila chi'.
Ha winhaj Abiatar yuninal winhaj Ahimelec, winh ix el lemnajok, ix k'och winh b'aj ayek' winhaj Dawid t'a chonhab' Keila chi', yet'nak jun chaleka winh.

Ix alchaj t'a winhaj Saúl to ha t'a chonhab' Keila ayek' winhaj Dawid chi'. Ix snaan winh icha tik: Ha tiknaik toxo ix ak'jioch winhaj Dawid chi' t'a yol in k'ab' yuj Dios, yujto toxo ix b'at smakb'ejkanoch sb'a winh t'a yol jun chonhab' to te wach' yajoch spuertail smakchaji, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yawtan masanil heb' soldado winh, yik sb'at oymitaj winhaj Dawid chi' yet' heb' soldado t'a Keila yuj heb' yalani.
Palta ix yojtaquejel winhaj Dawid chi' to wan skot winhaj Saúl yak' owal yet' winh, yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a winhaj sakerdote Abiatar to syik'kot k'apak chaleka winh yik sk'anb'ej heb' t'a Jehová.
Ix yalan winhaj Dawid chi' icha tik: --Mamin Jehová, ko Diosal ach a onh israel onh tik, a in a chekab' in tik ix wab'i to a winhaj Saúl wan snaan winh ul satel chonhab' Keila tik wuuj.

¿Ol am jawok winh icha ix aj wab'ani? ¿Ol am in yak'och heb' kajan t'a chonhab' Keila tik t'a yol sk'ab' winh? Tzin tewi t'ayach Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, to tzal t'ayin, xchi winh. Ix yalan Jehová chi': --Ha winhaj Saúl chi' wan skot winh, xchi.

Ix sk'anb'anxi winhaj Dawid chi' t'a Jehová chi': --¿Ol am in yak'och heb' aj chonhab' Keila tik yet' heb' in soldado t'a yol sk'ab' winh? xchi winh. Ix yalanxi Jehová chi': --I', ol ex yak'och heb', xchi.

Yuj chi' ix el winhaj Dawid yet' heb' soldado chi', ay am junok 600 heb'. Ch'okch'ok b'aj ayek' heb' t'a juntak el. Ayic ix k'ochxi yab'ixal t'a winhaj Saúl chi' to toxo ix el heb' t'a chonhab' Keila chi', majxo b'atlaj winh ta'.

Yuj chi' ix aj winhaj Dawid chi' t'a juntzanh k'een nhak'een t'a siquil lu'um t'a yol yik Zif. Wach'chom ix saychajek' winh yuj winhaj Saúl chi' t'a junjun k'u, palta maj ak'jilaj winh yuj Dios t'a yol sk'ab' winh.
Ayic ix yab'an spekal winhaj Dawid chi' to anheja' sayjiek' winh yuj winhaj Saúl chi' yik smilanchamok, ix kanxonhej winh t'a Hores, t'a tzinan lu'um t'a yol yik Zif chi'.
Ay jun k'ual ix b'at winhaj Jonatán yil winhaj Dawid t'a Hores chi'. Ix ak'ji stek'anil winhaj Dawid chi' yuj winh yik syak'anoch Dios winh yipok sk'ool.

Ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Dawid chi' icha tik: --Manh ach xiwok, yujto manh ol ach ilchajlaj yuj winh in mam chi'. Yujto a ach tik, ol ach ochnhej ko reyalok a onh israel onh tik, a inxo ol in och t'a schab'il yajalil t'ayach. Ha jun tik yojtakxopax winh in mam chi', xchi winh.
Ix snaanxikot strato heb' winh schawanhil t'a yichanh Jehová. Ixlajwi chi', ix meltzajxi winhaj Jonatán chi' t'a spat, haxo pax winhaj Dawid chi', ix kannhej winh t'a Hores chi'.

Axo heb' kajan t'a Zif chi' ix b'at alan t'a winhaj Saúl t'a Gabaa, ix yalan heb': --Ha winhaj Dawid, ayek' winh sk'ub'ejel sb'ha t'a yol ko makb'en, t'a juntzanh k'een nhak'een t'a switzal Haquila, t'a Hores, t'a stojolal sur t'a chonhab' Jesimón.
Yuj chi' mamin rey, tato syal a k'ool tzach b'at ta', syal tzach b'ati, ol ko ch'ox winh t'ayach, xchi heb'.
Ix yalan winhaj Saúl chi' t'a heb': --Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a eyib'anh, yujto tz'ok' he k'ool t'ayin.
Ha tiknaik, swal t'ayex to b'at eyil wal b'ajwaltil ayek' winh, mach ix ilani, yujto swab'i tob' te jelan winh skolan sb'a.

Tzeyil wal sik'lab'il b'aj wal sk'ub'ejel sb'a winh chi', tzul eyalanxi t'ayin t'a sjichanil, icha chi' ol aj in b'at eyed'ok. Tato yel ayek' winh ta', ol b'at in sayek' winh t'a skal masanil yol yik Judá, xchi winh.

Ix b'ab'laj pax heb' aj Zif chi' t'a schonhab', haxo winhaj Saúl chi' tzak'anto ix b'at winh yet' heb' soldado. Axo pax winhaj Dawid chi', ayek' winh yet' heb' winh ajun yet'ok t'a Maón, t'a tzinan lu'um, t'a ak'lik t'a stojolal sur t'a chonhab' Jesimón.

Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Saúl chi' yet' heb' soldado say winh. Ayic ix alji jun tik t'a winhaj Dawid chi', ix emta winh t'a sattak k'een, ix kannhej winh t'a lum Maón t'a tzinan lu'um chi'. Yuj chi' a ix yab'an winhaj Saúl chi' icha chi', ix b'at winh sayek' winh ta'.

Ha t'a jun spak'ul jun witz chi', ata' sb'at winhaj Saúl yet' soldado. Axo t'a junxo spatik lu'um, ata' sb'atpax winhaj Dawid yet' heb' soldado ajun yet'ok yik syak' yip heb' yel t'a winhaj Saúl chi'. Palta toxo ix oyjichaanh winhaj Dawid yet' heb' ajun yet' winh yuj winhaj Saúl yet' heb' soldado chi' yik syamji heb'.
Elanhchamel ix k'och jun winh chekab' t'a winhaj Saúl chi', ix yalan winh: --Mamin rey, meltzajanh t'a elanhchamel, yujto a heb' filisteo toxo ix och heb' t'a yol ko chonhab', xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Saúl chi' yak' owal yet' heb' filisteo chi'. Icha chi' ix aj yoch waan winh spechan b'eyek' winhaj Dawid chi'. Atax ta' ix skuchkan jun sat k'een chi' icha tik: Sat k'een b'aj ix spoj sb'a b'e.
Icha chi' ix aj sb'atkan winhaj Dawid chi' sk'ub'ejel sb'ha t'a yoltak k'een nhak'een t'a yol yik En-gadi.
Ayic ix lajwi yak'an owal winhaj Saúl yet' heb' filisteo chi', ix alji t'a winh to ha t'a tzinan lu'um t'a En-gadi ayek' winhaj Dawid chi'.

Yuj chi' oxe' mil heb' soldado te jelan t'a skal heb' israel ix sik'el winhaj Saúl chi', yik sb'at heb' sayek' winhaj Dawid chi' yet' heb' ajun yet' winh t'a sattak k'een k'een b'aj ay nok' k'ultaquil chiwa.

Ayic ix k'och winhaj Saúl yet' heb' soldado t'a juntzanh te' makte' kalnel t'a ti' b'e, ix och winh chuljel t'a yol jun k'een nhak'een ay t'a slak'anil chi'. Manh yojtakoklaj winh tato ata' ayek' winhaj Dawid yet' heb' soldado t'a yichochk'och k'een chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yal heb' winh ajun yet' winhaj Dawid chi': --Ha tiknaik ix elk'och tas ix yal Jehová to syak'och winh ajk'ool t'a yol a k'ab'. Ha ach tza na'a tas tzutej, xchi heb' winh t'a winh. Ix k'e waan winh, te k'ojank'olal ix kot winh, ix spolanel jab' sti' sjukan pichul winhaj Saúl chi' winh.
Ixlajwi yutan winh icha chi', ix kuspaxk'e sk'ool winh.
Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh ajun yet'ok chi' icha tik: --Aokab' Jehová max chaan in milcham winh in reyal tik, yujto ha' sik'annakoch winh reyal, xchi winh.

Icha chi' ix yutej winhaj Dawid chi' skachan heb' winh ajun yet'ok chi'. Maj yal-laj winh to ay tz'utaj winhaj Saúl chi' yuj heb' winh, tonhej ix yiloch heb' winh ix elixta winh t'a yol k'een nhak'een chi', ix b'atxikan winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix elta winhaj Dawid chi' t'a spatik winh, ix awajb'at winh: --Mamin rey, xchib'at winh. Axo ix meltzajb'at k'elan winhaj Saúl chi' t'a spatik, ix em nhojnaj winhaj Dawid chi', ix yalan winh:
--Mamin, ¿tas yuj tza cha ab' t'a heb' anima tz'alani to chuk tas tzin say t'a a patik?

Na'eli to a tiknaik a Jehová ix ach ak'anoch t'a yol in k'ab' t'a yol k'een nhak'een tik. Ha heb' winh ajun wed'ok, ix yal heb' winh to tzach in milchamok, palta maj yal-laj in k'ool. Ix in na' to rey ach, a Jehová sik'annak ach och reyal.

Mamin, iltonab' jab' sti' a jukan pichul wed'nak tik. Te sekojtak ix aj ach in milanchamok tato ix yal in k'ool. Yuj chi' ha t'a jun tik syal snachajel uuj to malaj tas chuk tzin na' t'a a patik, malaj b'aj ix wik'chaanh in b'a t'ayach. Palta ¿tas yuj tzin a sayeq'ui yik tzin a milancham alani?
Ha tiknaik, onh b'eyk'olajokab' ko chawanhil yuj Jehová Dios, mach tojol spensar, aokab' tz'ak'an spak t'ayach yuj tas tzin utej. Ha inxo tik jun, manh ol wak'och in k'ab' ach in milanchamok.
Ay jun lolonel syal heb' anima t'a peka' icha tik: Ha t'a heb' chuk, ata' skot chukal, xchi. Yuj chi' mamin rey, malaj b'ak'uinh ol wak'och in k'ab' t'ayach.
Mamin rey, natonab'i to a ach tik sreyal ach Israel. Ha inxo wan in a sayanek' tik, tokwal ay jab'ok welk'ochi. Lajan in wal icha nok' chamnak tz'i', ma icha wal nok' k'ak.
Yuj chi' aokab' Jehová tzonh b'eyk'olan ko chawanhil, mach onh ay ko mul. Aokab' tz'ilan tas tzin utej tik, tzin skolanel t'ayach, xchi winh.
Axo ix lajwi slolon winhaj Dawid chi', ix yalan winhaj Saúl chi': --Ach Dawid, ¿tom a ach tzach lolon chi' ma? xchi winh. Ix ok'k'e winh.
Ix yalan winh: --Ha ach tik te tojol a pensar. Te wach' ix utej a paktzitan in chuk pensaril t'ayach.
Ha wal tiknaik tza ch'oxeli to wach' tzutej a pensar t'ayin. Ix in yak'waloch Jehová t'a yol a k'ab', palta maj in a milchamlaj.
Val yel, malaj junok mach tato tz'ilchaj junok yajk'ol yuj, malaj tas syutej. Ha Jehová ol paktzitan t'ayach yuj jun a wach'k'olal tik t'ayin.
Ix nachajel wuj tiknaik to a ach wal ol ach och reyal, yuj chi' a opisio t'a yib'anh ko chonhab' tik, malaj mach ol yal yik'anek' t'a yol a k'ab'.
Ak'kan a ti' t'ayin tiknaik t'a yichanh Jehová to manh ol a satel-laj winhtilal yet' heb' ayto wuj in b'a yet'ok, palta to ol in b'inajnhejkanok, xchi winh.

Ix yak'an sti' winhaj Dawid chi' yuj tas ix yal winh chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix pax winhaj Saúl chi' t'a spalakio, haxo pax winhaj Dawid chi' yet' heb' winh ajun yet'ok, ix ochixkan heb' winh t'a yoltak k'een nhak'een chi'.

Ix cham winhaj Samuel, ix smolb'an sb'a masanil heb' israel. Ix te' ok' heb' yuj schamel winh chi'. Ha t'a schonhab' winh t'a Ramá ix mukchaji. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'atkan winhaj Dawid t'a tzinan lu'um t'a yol yik Parán.
Ha t'a chonhab' Maón, ay jun winh te b'eyum, oxe' mil nok' skalnel winh, jun mil nok' schiwa winh. Ay sluum winh t'a slak'anil chonhab' Carmel, ata' sjoxel nok' skalnel winh chi'.
Ha jun winh chi', Nabal sb'i winh, yinhtilal winhaj Caleb, junelnhej te chuk spensar winh. Axo pax ix yetb'eyum winh, Abigail sb'i ix. Ha jun ix chi', te wach' yilji ix, te ay pax spensar ix.
Ayic ayek' winhaj Dawid chi' t'a tzinan lu'um, ix yab'an winh to a winhaj Nabal chi' ayek' winh sjoxel nok' skalnel t'a Carmel chi'.
Yuj chi' ix schekb'at lajunhwanh heb' winh schekab' winh yik b'at ak'ji stzatzil sk'ol winhaj Nabal chi',
b'at yalpax juntzanh lolonel tik heb' winh t'a winh: Syal winhaj Dawid: Junk'olalokab' ajek' yet' masanil heb' kajan ed'ok t'a yol a pat yet' masanil tas ay t'ayach.

Ix wab'i to ayach ek' a joxanel nok' a kalnel. Ojtacpaxi to a heb' a tanhwum kalnel aynhejek' heb' qued'ok t'a Carmel tik. Ayic ayek' heb' qued'ok t'a tik, malaj jab'ok tas ix ik'an heb', malaj pax jab'ok tas ix quik'ek' t'a heb'.

Syal a k'anb'an juntzanh chi' t'a heb' a chekab' chi'. Ha heb' ol alan t'ayach chajtil to yel. D'a wal sk'ual jun a q'uinh tzonh jawi, yuj chi' stewi winhaj Dawid t'ayach to tzonh a cha t'a wach'il, tzak'an t'ayonh tastak ay t'ayach. Ak'paxkot yik winhaj Dawid a wach'k'ool, xchikot winhaj Dawid t'ayach, xe chi, xchi winh.

Ayic ix k'och heb' winh schekab' winhaj Dawid chi' t'a winhaj Nabal chi', ix yalan heb' winh masanil tas ix yalkot winhaj Dawid chi', ix lajwi chi' ix kan heb' winh stanhwej spak ol yal winhaj Nabal chi'.
Palta ix yalan winhaj Nabal chi' icha tik: --¿Tas yaj winhaj Dawid yuninal winhaj Isaí chi'? Ha tiknaik manh jantakok winak tz'el t'a heb' yajal, icha chi' yaj jun winh chi'.
Max yal-laj wak'an swael yuk'el yet' schib'ej heb' in joxum kalnel tik t'a heb' anima manh wojtakok, manh wojtakokpaxi b'aj skoti, xchi winh.
Icha chi' ix aj smeltzajxi heb' winh schekab' winhaj Dawid chi'. Ayic ix k'och heb' winh t'a winh, ix yalan heb' winh masanil tas ix yal winhaj Nabal chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Dawid chi' t'a masanil heb' winh ajun yet'ok: --E masanil, iq'ek k'een eyespada, xchi winh. Masanil heb' winh swinak winh chi', ix yak'och yespada heb' winh t'a snanhal, icha ix yutej yik winh chi'. Chanhe' kiento heb' winh winak chi' ix b'at yet' winh, haxo chab' kientoxo heb' winh jun, ix kan heb' winh stanhwej sk'ael heb' winh.

Axo ix aj jun, ay junok heb' winh schekab' winhaj Nabal ix b'at alan t'a ix Abigail ix yetb'eyum winhaj Nabal chi' icha tik: --Ato t'a lum tzinan lu'um ix schekkot juntzanh heb' winh schekab' winhaj Dawid t'a winh in patrón tik, yik ix ul ak'ji stzatzil sk'ol winh yuj heb' winh, palta te chuk ix yutej winh slolon t'a heb' winh.

Palta jun, a juntzanh heb' winh chi', wach'nhej ix yutej sb'a heb' winh t'ayonh ayik ix onh ek'nhej tanhwoj kalnel b'aj ayek' heb' winh chi'. Maj onh stzuntzej jab'ok heb' winh, malaj jab'ok tas ix yik'ek' heb' winh t'ayonh.
k'ual t'ak'wal ix onh stanhwej heb' winh ta' yakb'an sko tanhwej nok' kalnel chi'.

Palta icha wal winh in patrón tik, toton wal junelnhej chuk winh, max yal-laj ko lolon yet' winh. Na' a ach tik, tzilan tas tza k'ulej, yujto t'a wal yel ay wal tas manh wach'ok ol ja t'a quib'anh yet' winh, xchi jun winh chekab' chi'.

Elanhchamel ix yal ix Abigail chi' to tz'ik'chajkot chab'ok kiento pan, chab'ok tz'uum b'ut'an yuj wino, owanhok nok' kalnel tonhej b'olb'il yet' oyeok arroba ixim trigo k'anb'inak, kien b'uyanhok sat uwa takjinak yet' pax junok kien quechanh te' higo takjinak yaman yaji. Ixlajwi chi' ix ak'jioch t'a yib'anh juntzanh nok' b'uru.
Ix yalan ix t'a heb' schekab' chi': --B'ab'lajanhek, tzak'anto ol in b'at eyuuj, xchi ix. Malaj tas ix yal ix t'a winh yetb'eyum chi'.

Ix k'e ix t'a yib'anh jun nok' b'uru, ix em ix t'a jun utzin b'e tz'em t'a jun ch'olan. Axo ix yilan ix to wan yemul winhaj Dawid t'a yichanh ix yet' heb' winh ajun yet'ok, yuj chi' ix b'at ix scha winh.

Ix yal winhaj Dawid chi' t'a heb' winh ajun chi' yet'ok icha tik: Nab'anhej ko tanhwejnak nok' smolb'etzal nok' winhaj Nabal chi' t'a tzinan lu'um. Malaj wal jab'ok tas quik'nak ek' t'a winh, palta ko tanhwejnhejnak nok' skalnel winh chi'. Te chuklaj syutej winh spaktzitan ko wach' pensaril chi'.
Yuj chi' swala': Aokab' Dios tz'ak'anoch in yaelal tato pitzanto winhaj Nabal chi', ma junokxo winak t'a skal heb' sk'ab' yok winh k'ik'an yab' icha tik.
Ayic ix yilanb'at winhaj Dawid ix Abigail chi', ix emta ix t'a yib'anh nok' b'uru chi', ix em nhojan ix t'a sat lu'um.
Elanhchamel ix em nhojnaj ix t'a yichanh winh, ix yalan ix: --Ha chukal ix sk'ulej winh wetb'eyum, kotokab' t'a wib'anh. Tzin tewi t'ayach to tzin a cha lolon jab'ok, tzab'an tas ol wala'.

Manh ak'och winhaj Nabal chi' t'a a k'ool. Ha jun winh chi', quistal winh, smojton wal sk'ulan winh icha sb'i chi'. Malaj spensar winh, yuj chi' anhej chukal pensar syal winh. Ha in pax a chekab' in tik, maj wil-laj heb' winh a chekab' ix a chekb'ati.

Palta jun, a Jehová ix ach kachan wanajok ayik d'inhan a milancham anima yuj a paktzitan schukal heb' t'a a patik. Elokab' t'a sk'ol Jehová to a heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach yet' heb' snib'ej tzach ixtani, kotokab' t'a yib'anh heb' icha wal tz'aj skot t'a yib'anh winhaj Nabal chi'.
Axo tiknaik jun, tzin tewi t'ayach to a jab' silab' swik'kot tik t'ayach, tza pukb'at t'a heb' winh a chekab' ajun tik ed'ok.
Tzak'an niwank'olal t'a in patik a in a chekab' in tik. Val yel a Jehová ol ochnhej ed'ok t'a opisio yet' heb' inhtilal, ina to yuj Jehová tzak' owal, malaj chukal pax tza k'ulej.

Wach'chom ay mach tzach pechan b'eyek'ok, snib'ej heb' tzach smilchamok, malaj tas ol ach ik'anok, yujto k'ub'ab'il ach el yuj Jehová ko Diosal. Axo pax heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach jun, a Jehová ol julanel heb' icha junok mach sjulanel junok k'een k'een yet' junok mejmeech.

Yujto tza cha ab' tas swala', yuj chi' ayik ol elk'och masanil tas wach' ix yal Jehová t'a ib'anh, ol ach tzalajok ayik ol a naankoti to maj ak'och a k'ab' a milancham heb' malaj smul ayik ijan ix ak'anek' a pak t'a heb' chuk ix yutej sb'a t'ayach. Ayic ol ach yik'anchaanh Jehová yet' opisio, tzin a nakot a in a chekab' in tik, xchi ix t'a winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Dawid chi' t'a ix icha tik: --Aljokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik to ha' ix ach chekankot ul in a cha'a.
Yak'okab'pax swach'k'olal t'a ib'anh yujto te wach' a pensar, yujto a ach tzin a kach wanajok yik max in milcham anima yik swak'anek' in pak t'a heb'.

Palta a tiknaik, swak' in ti' t'ayach t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal, aton jun in kachanoch waan wak'an chukal t'ayach, tato maj a pil ip a kot ul in a cha'a, k'ik'an manhxo pitzanok winhaj Nabal, manhxa pax junok winak t'a yinhtilal winh tzato kani, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix schaanek' winh masanil tastak yet'nak ix chi', ix yalan winh: --Wach' tzach meltzaj t'a a pat t'a tzalajk'olal. Tik wal scham ilani to ix wab' tas ix ala', tzin k'anab'ajan tas ix a k'ana'.

Ayic ix meltzaj ix Abigail chi' b'aj ayek' winhaj Nabal chi', ix yilan ix to ayoch jun q'uinh yuj winh icha sq'uinh heb' winh rey. Te chamnak winh yuj anh, ste tzalaj winh, yuj chi' malaj tas ix yal ix t'a winh, ato t'a junxo k'u.
Ayic ix q'uinhib'i t'a junxo k'u chi', ayik toxo ix el anh t'a sat winhaj Nabal chi', ix yalan ix tas ix uji, yuj chi' ix och jun yab'il t'a yol sjolom winh, ix sikb'iel sniwanil winh yuj.
Lajunhe' k'ual ix och jun yab'il chi' t'a winh, ix cham winh yuj Jehová.

Ayic ix yab'an winhaj Dawid to toxo ix cham winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: --Aljokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová yujto toxo ix yak'ek' in pak t'a winhaj Nabal yuj tas ix in yutej winh. Ha Jehová chi' ix in kachanoch waan yuj tas chuk ijan ix in k'ulej. Anheja' ix ak'ankot yaelal t'a yib'anh winhaj Nabal chi' yuj schukal, xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'anb'at schekab' winh t'a ix Abigail yik b'at yal heb' winh to snib'ej winh syik' ix.
Ayic ix k'och heb' winh chekab' chi' t'a ix t'a Carmel, ix yalan heb' winh: --Ha winhaj Dawid ix onh chekankot t'ayach, to snib'ej winh tzach och yetb'eyumok, xchi heb' winh t'a ix.
Ix em nhojan ix, ix yalan ix: --Ha in tik schekab' in winh, te b'ekan in k'ol in b'ikan yok heb' schekab' winh, tato icha chi' syal winh t'ayin, xchi ix.

Ayic ix lajwi yalan ix icha chi', ix sb'oan sb'a ix elanhchamel, ix kot owanh heb' ix schekab' ix yet'ok, ix k'e ix t'a yib'anh jun nok' b'uru, ix och tzak'an ix yuj heb' winh schekab' winhaj Dawid chi'. Icha chi' ix aj yik'an ix winhaj Dawid chi'.
Ix yik'anpax ix Ahinoam winh, aton jun ix aj Jezreel. Ha heb' ix chawanh chi' ix och yetb'eyumok winh.
Yujto a winhaj Saúl, toxo ix yak' ix yisil winh ix Mical t'a winhaj Palti, yuninal winhaj Lais aj Galim. Ha ix Mical chi', aton ix yetb'eyumtaxon winhaj Dawid chi'.

Ha heb' kajan t'a Zif ix b'at alan t'a winhaj Saúl t'a Gabaa icha tik: Ha winhaj Dawid ayek' winh sk'ub'ejel sb'ha t'a jolom witz yik Haquila, t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a yichanhb'at chonhab' Jesimón, xchi heb'.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Saúl yet' oxe' mil heb' soldado yik Israel te jelan. Ix b'at heb' t'a tzinan lu'um t'a yol yik Zif chi', yik sayek' winhaj Dawid chi' heb'.
Ix sb'oank'e skampamento heb' t'a tzalan Haquila chi' t'a ti b'e, haxo winhaj Dawid chi' ayek' winh t'a tzinan lu'um chi'. Ix yab'an winh to wan sayjiek' winh yuj winhaj Saúl ta'.
Yuj chi' ix schekb'at jaywanh yilumal winh yik sb'at yilan heb' tato yel to ayxo ek' winhaj Saúl chi'.

Ayic ix lajwi yab'an winhaj Dawid chi', ix b'at winh b'aj ayek' winhaj Saúl chi' t'ak'walil, ix cham wal yilan winh b'aj sway winh yet' winhaj Abner yuninal winhaj Ner, aton winh yajal yaj t'a heb' soldado. Axo ix yilan winh to ha t'a snanhal yol kampamento chi', ata' sway winh, oyanoch heb' soldado t'a spatiktak winh.

Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a winhaj Ahimelec hitita yet' t'a winhaj Abisai yuk'tak winhaj Joab, heb' winh yune' ix Sarwia icha tik: --¿Mach b'ekan sk'ol sb'at wed'ok b'aj ayek' winhaj Saúl t'a yol skampamento chi'? xchi winh. --Ha in tik ol in b'at ed'ok, xchi winhaj Abisai chi'.

Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi', ix b'at winhaj Dawid yet' winhaj Abisai chi' t'a kampamento chi'. Ha winhaj Saúl chi' chamnak el winh swayi. Ha t'a sjolomtak winh, ata' tipankanem k'een slanza winh t'a yol lu'um. Axo pax winhaj Abner yet' masanil heb' soldado, waynak heb' t'a stz'eytak winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Abisai chi' t'a winhaj Dawid chi': --Ha wal tiknaik toxo ix yak'och jun winh ajk'ool tik Dios t'a yol a k'ab'. Ak' in permiso tzin milcham winh. Ha k'een slanza winh tik tzin tipem t'a sk'ool masanto tz'emk'och k'een t'a yol lu'um, junnhej swak' t'a winh, scham winh t'a junelnhej, xchi winh.
Palta ix tak'wi winhaj Dawid chi', ix yalan winh: --Manh a milcham winh, yujto yalnhej mach smilancham winh rey sik'b'ilel yuj Jehová, yowalil sjawi yaelal t'a yib'anh.
Ha in tik swak' in ti' d'ha Dios to aokab' ol ik'anel sk'inal winh ayik ol k'och stiempoal scham winh, mato t'a skal owal ol cham winh.
Aokab' Jehová max chaan in milcham winh rey sik'b'ilel yuj. Anhej to tzik'kot k'een slanza winh ayek' t'a sjolomtak chi' yet' jun yet'tal ha ha' chi', tzonh b'ati, xchi winh.

Icha chi' ix aj yik'ankot k'een lanza chi' winhaj Dawid chi' yet' jun yet'tal ha ha' ayek' t'a sjolomtak winhaj Saúl chi', ix kot heb' winh. Malaj mach ix ilani, malaj mach ix ab'ani, malaj mach ix el swayanh. Masanil heb' chamnak el swayi yujto a Jehová ix ak'ankot jun niwan wayanh t'a yib'anh heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix ek' winhaj Dawid chi' t'a junxo sk'axepal jun ch'olan, ix k'e winh t'a sjolom jun lum witz, najat ix aj skal heb'.

Te chaanh ix awaj winh t'a winhaj Abner yet' t'a heb' soldado winh rey chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: --Abner, tak'wan t'ayin, xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Abner chi' icha tik: --¿Mach ach, yuj chi' tzach awaj t'a winh rey tik? xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Dawid chi' icha tik: --Ab'i malaj mach syal slajb'an sb'a ed'ok t'a skal heb' quetisraelal tik jun. Tato icha chi', ¿tas yuj max a tanhwej winh rey kajalil chi'? Ay jun winh ix xid'ek' ta' ix snib'ej smilcham winh.

Ha tas ix a k'ulej chi' manh wach'ok. Ha in tik swal t'a yichanh Jehová to he moj wal tzex cham he masanil, yujto max he tanhwej winh rey sik'b'ilel yuj Jehová. Say ila' b'ajtil ayek' k'een slanza winh yet' jun yet'tal ha ha' ayek' t'a sjolomtak winh, ol ilani tato ol chax uuj, xchi winh.
Ayic ix yab'an sjaj winhaj Dawid chi' winhaj Saúl, ix awaj chaanh winh: --Ach Dawid, ¿tom a ach tzach lolon chi' ma? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Dawid chi' icha tik: --I', mamin, a in toni.
Palta mamin rey, ¿tas wal yuj tzin a pechb'eyek'ok? ¿Tas chukal ix in k'ulej t'ayach? ¿Tas in mul ix och t'ayach?

Tzin tewi t'ayach to tza cha ab' tas ol wala': Tato a Jehová ix ach ak'anoch ajk'olal t'ayin, komonok wal tz'el t'a sk'ool schaan junok silab' yik tzin yak'an niwank'olal. Palta tato anima ay yik jun tik jun, aokab' Jehová skatab'ani. Yujto ix in spechel heb' t'a in makb'en t'a jun lum lum to yik Jehová yaji, icha wal to tzin spechkanb'at heb' yik swak'an serwil juntzanh komon Dios.

Comonoc manh najatok ayin el t'a yichanh Jehová ayik tzin chami. Palta mamin rey, ¿tas yuj tzach elta ul in a sayeq'ui? Ha in tik malaj welk'och icha junok nok' k'ak. Tzin a pechan b'eyek' t'a jolomtak witz tik icha mach sayan junok nok' ub', palta malaj b'ak'uinh syamchaj nok' yuj, xchi winh.

Ichato chi' ix yalan winhaj Saúl chi': --Ach Dawid, swojtaquejel tiknaik ma to a in ix och in mul. Icha junok malaj spensar, icha chi' swutej in b'a, te chuk tzin k'ulej t'ayach. Yuj chi', meltzajanh. Manhxo ol wak'laj chukal t'ayach, yujto ha t'a jun k'u tik ix a ch'oxeli to ay welk'och t'a yol a sat, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wixi winhaj Dawid chi': --Mamin rey, ina yajek' k'een a lanza t'a tik, kotokab' junok heb' winh a soldado chi' ul yik' k'een.

Ha Jehová tz'ak'an spak t'ayonh junjun onh ato syala' tato tojol skutej ko b'a icha t'a smojal. Wach'chom a tiknaik, ix ach yak'och t'a yol in k'ab', palta malaj in gana ix wak'och in k'ab' t'ayach, yujto a Jehová ach sik'anoch reyal.
Icha ix aj tiknaik, te niwan elk'och t'a yol in sat, ichaton wal chi' in gana to ay pax welk'och t'a yol sat Jehová. Aokab' Jehová chi' tzin kolanel t'a masanil yaelal sjawi t'a wib'anh, xchi winh.

Ix yalanxi winhaj Saúl chi' icha tik: --Ach Dawid, yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a ib'anh ma. Swojtaquejeli to niwak yelk'och tas ol a k'ulej, wach'nhej ol ach ajelk'ochok, xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix pax winhaj Saúl chi' t'a spalakio, haxo winhaj Dawid chi' ix b'atxikan winh.

Ix snaan winhaj Dawid icha tik: Ol in smilnhejcham winhaj Saúl chi', yuj chi' a tiknaik ol in b'atkan t'a schonhab' heb' filisteo yik wach' maxtzak in sayji yuj winh t'a yol ko makb'en tik. Icha chi' ol aj in kolchajel t'a yol sk'ab' winh, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winh yet' waque' kiento heb' winh winak ajun yet'ok, yik b'at yak'och sb'a heb' winh schekab'ok winhaj Aquis sreyal Gat yuninal winhaj Maoc.

Ix kajnaj heb' winh yet' winhaj Aquis t'a Gat chi', junjun heb' winh yet' yetb'eyum yet' pax yuninal. Ha winhaj Dawid chi', ix yik'b'at heb' ix yetb'eyum winh schawanhil, aton ix Ahinoam aj Jezreel yet' ix Abigail ix yetb'eyumkan winh xilb'a Nabal, aj Carmel.
Ayic ix yab'an winhaj Saúl to toxo ix b'atkan winhaj Dawid chi' elelal t'a Gat, ix yaktan winh sayanek' winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Dawid chi' t'a winhaj Aquis chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, tzin tewi t'ayach komonok tz'el t'a a k'ool, tzak' jab'ok b'aj tzonh aj t'a junok yune' chonhab' t'a yol a makb'en tik. Manh smojok tzin aj ed'ok t'a jun a chonhab' b'aj ayach tik, xchi winh.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ix yak' chonhab' Siclag winhaj Aquis chi' t'a winh. Yuj chi' a chonhab' Siclag chi' ix kannhej t'a yol yik heb' winh sreyal Judá.
Jun ab'il yet' chanhe' ujal ix ek' winhaj Dawid chi' t'a yol smakb'en heb' filisteo chi'.

Ha heb' aj Gesur, heb' aj Gezer yet' heb' amalekita, niwanxo tiempo sk'och kajan heb' t'a jun lum lum t'a skal Shur yet' Egipto. Ha winhaj Dawid chi' yet' heb' ajun yet'ok kotak skal ix b'at heb' yak' owal t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi'.

Smilcham heb' anima heb' ta', manhxo junok winak ma ix skani. Syik'anpaxkot nok' wakax heb', nok' kalnel, nok' b'uru, nok' kamello yet' pax pichul. Slajwi chi' smeltzajxikot heb' b'aj ayek' winhaj Aquis.

Sk'anb'an winhaj Aquis chi' t'a winh: --¿B'ajtil ach xid'ek' ak' owal chi' tiknaik? xchi winh. Syalan winhaj Dawid chi': Aton t'a sur yik Judá yet' t'a sur yik Jerameel, mato t'a sur yol smakb'en heb' keneo, xchi winh.

Manhxa heb' winh winak, ma heb' ix ix pitzanto skan yuj winhaj Dawid chi', yuj chi' junelnhej manhxa mach b'at alan t'a Gat tas sk'ulej winh chi'. Ha jantak tiempoal ix ek' kajan winh t'a smakb'en heb' filisteo chi', ichanhej chi' ix sk'ulej winh.

Ha winhaj Aquis chi', ix yak'och winhaj Dawid chi' winh yipok sk'ool, ix snaan winh: Ha heb' yetisraelal winhaj Dawid tik wan smeltzajoch heb' ajk'olal t'a winh, yuj chi' ol kanxonhej winh in yak' serwil, xchi winh.

Ha t'a juntzanh k'ual chi', ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' soldado filisteo yik syak'an owal heb' yet' heb' israel. Ix yalan winhaj Aquis chi' t'a winhaj Dawid icha tik: --Ha ach tik yowalil ol ach b'at wed' t'a owal yet' heb' ajun ed'ok, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Dawid chi' t'a winh: --Ichokab'ta' mamin rey, a tiknaik ol ila' tastak syal wuuj a in a chekab' in tik, xchi winh. Ix yalanxi winh t'a winhaj Dawid chi': --Tzach wak'kanoch in tanhwumalok t'a junelnhej, xchi winh.

Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', chamnakxo winhaj Samuel, masanil heb' israel ok'nak yuj winh. Ha t'a Ramá schonhab' winh, ata' mukb'il winh. Axo winhaj Saúl spechnaquel heb' ajchum winh yet' heb' tz'awtan spixan heb' chamnak t'a skal chonhab' Israel chi'.
Ayic ix lajwi smolb'an sb'a heb' filisteo chi', ix b'at heb' sb'ok'e skampamento t'a Sunem. Anheja' ix smolb'anpax masanil heb' israel winhaj Saúl t'a Gilboa.
Ayic ix yilanb'at skampamento heb' filisteo winhaj Saúl chi', ix somchaj spensar winh, ix xiwb'at winh.
Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'ej winh t'a Jehová, palta maj tak'woklaj t'a winh t'a wayichal, ma t'a heb' sakerdote, ma t'a heb' schekab' Dios.

Ayic ix yilan winh to chuk yaji, ix yalan winh t'a heb' schekab' icha tik: --Sayec junok ix ix syal sk'uman spixan chamnak, yik wach' ha t'a ix ol in k'anb'ej in b'a, xchi winh. Ix tak'wi heb' winh ay yopisio yet' winh: --Ha t'a Endor, ay jun ix syal sk'uman spixan heb' chamnak chi', xchi heb' winh t'a winh.

Ix sk'exanel spichul winhaj Saúl chi' yik sreyal, haxo yik heb' komon anima ix yak'och winh. Ix yik'anb'at chawanhxo soldado winh yet'ok, ix b'at winh t'ak'walil yik sb'at sk'anb'ej sb'a winh t'a jun ix ix chi', ix yalan winh t'a ix: --Tzin tewi t'ayach to in gana tzawtej spixan jun mach ol wal tik, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi ix t'a winh: --Ojtac tas ix utaj heb' ajchum yuj winhaj Saúl yet' heb' sk'uman spixan heb' chamnak, ix pechjiel heb' t'a yol chonhab' tik yuj winh. ¿Tas yuj tza say tas tz'aji yik tzin miljichamok? xchi ix.
Ix yak'an sti' winhaj Saúl chi': --Swak' in ti' t'a yichanh Jehová to malaj tas ol ach ik'anok, xchi winh.
--¿Mach b'an jun ol wawtej chi' alani? xchi ix. --Aton spixan winhaj Samuel chamnakxo tzawtej in k'ana', xchi winh.
D'a wal jun rato chi' ix yilan winhaj Samuel jun ix ix chi', te chaanh ix el yaw ix yuj xiwelal, ix yalan ix t'a winhaj Saúl chi':

--¿Tas yuj tzin ak' musansatil? Tob'an a ach Saúl ach, xchi ix t'a winh. --Ix tak'wi winhaj Saúl chi' icha tik: --Manh ach xiwok, ¿tas jun ix il chi'? xchi winh. --Ay jun pixan chamnak swil sk'eul t'a yol lu'um, xchi ix.

--¿Chajtil yilji? xchi winh. --Ha jun winh winak te ichamxo, ay jun k'apak spichul winh te jukan ayoch yuj, xchi ix. Ix snaanel winh to a winhaj Samuel ix sch'ox sb'a, yuj chi' ix em nhojan winh t'a sat lu'um.

Ix yalan winhaj Samuel chi' t'a winh: --¿Tas yuj tzin ixtej, tzin awtankoti? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Saúl chi': --Ix ach wawtej yik tzal t'ayin tas tzin k'ulej, yujto te xiwnak in, ayxo ek' heb' filisteo yak' owal wed'ok, manhxo ayokochlaj Dios wed'ok, maxtzak tak'wilaj t'a tas swala', manhxo jab'ok stak'wi ayik tzin k'anb'an t'a heb' schekab', wach'chom t'a wayichal, xchi winh t'a winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Samuel chi' icha tik: --Tato max tak'wi Jehová chi' t'ayach, ¿tas yuj a t'ayin tza k'anb'ej? Yujto toxo ix och Jehová ajk'olal t'ayach, yuj chi' ix ach yaktejkani.
Vanxo yelk'och tas scheknak Jehová wal t'ayach to toxo ix yik'ek' opisio t'a reyal, haxo t'a winhaj Dawid ix yak'kani.
Yujto maj a k'anab'ajej a satanel heb' amalekita ayik yalan Jehová t'ayach, yuj chi' ix ach yaktejkani.

Manhoknhej chi', palta to ol ach yak'och Jehová yet' pax heb' a soldado t'a yol sk'ab' heb' filisteo chi', yuj chi' a k'ik'an tzach cham yet' heb' uninal, tzach jawi t'a yet'tal heb' chamnak b'aj ayinek' tik, yujto a Jehová ol ach ak'anoch yet' heb' a soldado t'a yol sk'ab' heb' filisteo chi', xchi winh.

Ayic ix yab'an winhaj Saúl chi' icha chi', ix telwi winh, ix b'at wal lian winh t'a sat lu'um. Ix te xiw winh yuj tas ix yal winhaj Samuel chi'. Ix te el yip winh yujto maj walaj winh t'a jun k'u chi' yet' t'a jun ak'wal yik ix b'at winh t'a yoltak b'e.

Yuj chi' ayik ix yilan jun ix ix chi' to ix te somchaj spensar winh, ix k'och ix t'a stz'ey winh, ix yalan ix: --Ha in a chekab' in tik masanil tas ix ala' ix in k'anab'ajej, wach'chom ay smay in cham yuj tas ix in k'ulej tik.
Yuj chi' ab' tas swal tik: Ol wak' jab'ok tas ol a wa''a yik wach' ol ochxok jab'ok ip tzach b'ati, xchi ix t'a winh.

Maj yal-laj sk'ol winh ix wa'i, palta haxo heb' winh schekab' winh ajun yet'ok yet' jun ix ix chi', a heb' ix ak'an pural winh swa'i. Ichato chi' ix k'e wan winh, ix em k'ojan winh t'a sti' jun ch'at.
Yakb'an chi' ix smilancham jun nok' yune' wakax ix te b'ak'uech, ix sb'oan nok' ix yet' pax ixim pan malaj yich.
Ix yik'anb'at wael chi' ix t'a winhaj Saúl chi' yet' t'a heb' winh schekab' winh ajun yet'ok, ix lajwi swa heb' winh, ix meltzaj heb' winh.
Ayic mantzak b'at heb' soldado filisteo t'a Sunem, molanxoek' heb' t'a Afec, haxo heb' israel ayek' heb' t'a sjaj ha ha' yik Jezreel.

Ayic ix awtaj slistail masanil heb' soldado filisteo yuj heb' winh yajalil, ix b'ischaj heb' t'a kientoal yet' t'a smilal, haxo pax winhaj Dawid yet' heb' soldado, tzak'anoch heb' t'a spatik winhaj Aquis.

Ha heb' winh yajalil heb' soldado filisteo chi', ix sk'anb'ej heb' t'a winhaj Aquis chi': --¿Tas yaj juntzanh heb' hebreo ayek' t'a ko kal tik? xchi heb' winh. Ix tak'wi winh t'a heb' winh: --Aton winhaj Dawid tik schekab' winhaj Saúl, sreyal heb' israel. Palta ayxo yajek' winh wed'ok. Atax yik sjawinak winh, malaj jab'ok spaltail winh swila', xchi winh.

Palta ix kot yowal heb' winh yajal chi' t'a winh rey chi', ix yalan heb' winh: --Al t'a heb' to smelzajkan heb' t'a schonhab' ix ak' chi', max b'atlaj heb' qued'ok t'a owal, haxo talaj tz'aji a t'ayonh smeltzajoch heb' ajk'olal t'a skal owal chi'. Q'uinalok sna winhaj Dawid tik skanxi wach'il t'a winhaj Saúl, smilancham heb' ko soldado tik winh.

Yujto a winhaj Dawid tik b'itajnak yuj heb' ix ix, ayik sk'enak chennaj heb' ix, yalannak heb' ix icha tik: Smilal heb' soldado ix smilcham winhaj Saúl. Lajlajunh mil ix smilcham winhaj Dawid, xchi heb' ix.

Yuj chi' ix awtajkot winhaj Dawid chi' yuj winhaj Aquis chi', ix yalan winh: --Syil Jehová to te wach' a pensar. Ix scha wal in k'ool a b'eyb'al ayik ach ek'nhej wed'ok. Malaj jab'ok a paltail ix wila'' yiktax ach jawi t'a tik, masanto tiknaik. Palta a heb' wetyajalil tik, max schalaj sk'ol heb' tzach b'at qued' t'a owal.
Yuj chi', meltzajanh t'a tzalajk'olal, yik wach' manh chukok syab' heb' uuj, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Dawid chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, ¿tas ix in k'ulej? ¿Tas ix il t'ayin t'a jun pekti’ ayinek' ed' tik, yuj chi' max yal in b'at wak' owal t'a mach ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach? xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Aquis chi', ix yalan winh: --Vojtak wal to te wach' ach, lajan ach icha junok yángel Dios, palta a heb' wetyajalil tik, toxo ix yal heb' to max yal och t'a ko kal t'a owal.
Yuj chi' ayik sakb'i k'ik'an tzach meltzaj yet' heb' a soldado, aton heb' schekab' winh ajalil. Tzex b'at t'a q'uinhib'alil, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ha t'a junxo q'uinhib'alil chi', ix meltzaj winhaj Dawid chi' yet' heb' soldado t'a schonhab' heb' ak'b'il. Axo heb' filisteo chi' ix k'ekan heb' t'a Jezreel.

Axo t'a schab'jial chi', ix k'ochxi winhaj Dawid chi' yet' heb' soldado t'a Siclag. Axo ix yilan heb' toxo ix elk'ajb'at masanil tastak ay t'a yol yik Neguev yet' t'a Siclag yuj heb' amalekita. Ix snhuskantz'a chonhab' Siclag chi' heb'.
Ix ik'jib'at heb' ix ix, heb' unin yet' heb' icham anima ayek' ta' yuj heb', palta malaj junok mach ix smilcham heb'.
Ayic ix k'och winhaj Dawid yet' heb' soldado chi', ix yilan heb' to toxo ix tz'ab'at schonhab' heb' chi', toxo ix ik'jib'at heb' ix yetb'eyum heb' yet' yuninal heb' t'a preso.
Yuj chi' ix te ok' heb', masanto ix el yip heb' yoq'ui.
Ix ik'jib'at chawanh heb' ix yetb'eyum winhaj Dawid chi' yuj heb' amalekita chi', aton ix Ahinoam aj Jezreel yet' ix Abigail yetb'eyumkan winh xilb'a Nabal aj Carmel.

Ix te och winhaj Dawid chi' t'a ilk'olal, yujto ijan sjulk'enajcham winh yuj heb' soldado chi'. Masanil heb' te chab'xo sk'ol yuj tas ix utaj heb' yuninal heb' chi', palta haxo winhaj Dawid chi', ix yak'wal och spensar winh t'a Jehová sDiosal.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh t'a winhaj sakerdote Abiatar yuninal winhaj Ahimelec: --Ak' pawor, ik'kot k'apak chaleka t'ayin, xchi winh. Ix yik'ankot k'apak winhaj Abiatar chi'.

Ix sk'anb'an winhaj Dawid chi' t'a Jehová icha tik: --¿Smoj am wal in b'at t'a spatik juntzanh heb' winh elk'um chi'? ¿Ol am wal yamchaj heb' winh wuuj? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi Jehová chi' t'a winh: --Ixic, ol yamchaj heb' winh uuj, ol ik'anxikanek' masanil heb' ix yik'b'at heb' winh chi', xchi t'a winh.
Ha wal t'a jun rato chi', ix b'at winhaj Dawid yet' waque' kiento heb' soldado yet'nak chi', ix k'och heb' t'ha ha' eluma' skuchan Besor.
Ata' ix k'unb'ikan chab' kiento heb' soldado, majxo yal-laj sk'axpitan ha' heb', haxo chanhe' kiento heb' jun, ix b'atnhej heb' yet' winhaj Dawid chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yilan jun winh aj Egipto heb' t'a yol b'e, ix yik'anb'at winh heb' t'a winhaj Dawid chi', ix yak'an wa winh heb', ix yak'an ha ha' heb' yuk' winh.

Ix yak'anpax jab' taquinh higo heb' b'ob'il icha wail t'a winh yet' pax chab' b'uyanh sat uwa takjinak. Ayic ix lajwi swa jun winh aj Egipto chi', ix och wal yip winh ix yab'i, yujto schab'jialxo skan swa winh, ma yuk'an ha' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix sk'anb'an winhaj Dawid chi' t'a winh: --¿Mach a patrón? ¿B'ajtil kajan ach? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winh: --Ha in tik aj Egipto in, schekab' in jun winh amalekita, palta ix in penaayaxkani, yuj chi' chab'jitax in yaktejkan winh wajal chi'.
Yujto ix onh xid'ek' quelk'ej tastak t'a Neguev t'a yol yik heb' kereteo, t'a heb' aj Judá yet' pax t'a Caleb. Anhejtona' ix kak'kanoch sk'ak'al chonhab' Siclag, xchi winh.

--¿Tzam in ik'b'at t'a juntzanh heb' winh elk'um chi'? xchi winhaj Dawid chi' t'a winh. Ix tak'wi winh: --Syal ach wik'anb'ati tato tzak' a ti' t'a yichanh Dios to max in a milchamok, max in ak'paxoch t'a yol sk'ab' winh in patrón chi', xchi winh.

Icha chi' ix aj yik'jib'at winhaj Dawid chi' yuj winh b'aj ayek' heb' elk'um chi'. Sacleminac yajek' heb' ta', wan swa heb', wan yuk'anpax anh heb'. Ayoch q'uinh yuj heb' yuj tas ix b'at yelk'ej heb' t'a yol yik heb' filisteo yet' t'a yol smakb'en Judá chi'.

Icha chi' ix aj sk'och winhaj Dawid chi' b'aj ayek' heb' chi'. Axo t'a junxo k'u ayik mantzak sakb'i, ix syamanoch winh yak'an owal yet' heb' masanto ix em k'u. Manhxo junok heb' ix kani, axonhej chanhe' kiento heb' kelemtak ix k'e t'a yib'anh skamello, ix b'at heb' elelal.
Masanil tastak ix yelk'ejkot heb' chi', ix yik'xikanek' winhaj Dawid chi'. Icha chi' ix aj yik'anpaxkanek' heb' ix yetb'eyum winh schawanhil.
Malaj junok anima ix yik'b'at heb' amalekita chi' to maj ek'xikan yuj winhaj Dawid chi': Eb' winh winak, heb' ix ix yet' heb' unin, masanil tastak ix yik'xikanek' winh.
Ix yik'anpaxkanek' nok' kalnel winh yet' nok' wakax smasanil. Yuj chi' a heb' makjinak nok' nok' chi' ix alani: Ina wal tas ix yik'kanek' winhaj Dawid, xchi heb'.

Ayic ix jax heb' t'a sti' ha' Besor b'aj aykan chab' kiento heb' soldado ix k'unb'ikani, ix elta heb' ul scha winhaj Dawid yet' heb' ix xid'ek' yet' winh. Axo ix jawi winh t'a heb' jun, ix yak'an stzatzil sk'ol heb' winh.

Palta ay heb' soldado winh yet'nak chi' te chuk spensar. Yuj chi' ix yal heb' to a heb' maj xid'ek' yet' heb' t'a owal chi', manh smojok tz'ak'ji t'a heb' tastak ix b'at yik'xiek' heb' chi', anhej heb' ix yetb'eyum heb' yet' yuninal heb' syik'xikani, sb'at heb' b'ian, xchi heb' ix xid'ek' chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Dawid chi' t'a heb' icha tik: --Manh eyutok he b'a icha chi', yujto a Jehová ix ak'an t'ayonh. Ha ix onh tanhwani. Ha pax ix ak'anoch juntzanh heb' elk'um ix onh ixtan chi' t'a yol ko k'ab'.
¿Tom ay mach ol chaan yab' jun he pensar chi'? Icha wal yik heb' ix xid'ek' t'a owal ol yik'a', icha pax chi' yik heb' ix kan yil ko k'ael tik ol yik'a', lajannhej ol ek'ok, xchi winh.
(Atax ta' ix ochnhejkan jun chi' leyal t'a skal heb' israel.)

Ayic ix k'och winhaj Dawid chi' t'a chonhab' Siclag, ix schekanb'at heb' schekab' winh t'a heb' yichamtak winaquil Judá, aton heb' yamigo winh, yuj yak'anb'at winh jab'ok tastak ix b'at yik'ek' chi', yuj chi' icha ix aj yalan winh chi', icha chi' ix aj yalan heb' chekab' chi', ix yalan heb' icha tik: Ina jab' tas ix b'at wik'kanek' t'a heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'a Jehová swak'b'at tik t'ayex, xchikot winhaj Dawid, xchi heb'.

Ix yak'b'at juntzanh silab' chi' winh t'a heb' kajan t'a Betel, t'a Ramot t'a yol yik Neguev, t'a Jatir, t'a Aroer, t'a Sifmot, t'a Estemoa, t'a Racal, t'a juntzanh schonhab'kan winhaj Jerameel, t'a juntzanh schonhab' heb' keneo, t'a Horma, t'a Corasán, t'a Atac, t'a Hebrón yet' t'a masanil lugar b'aj ek'nak winh skol sb'a yet' heb' soldado.
Ix och heb' filisteo yak' owal yet' heb' israel, ix el lemnaj heb' israel chi', tzijtum heb' ix cham t'a Gilboa.
Ix b'atnhej heb' filisteo t'a spatik winhaj Saúl yet' heb' yuninal. Ix cham heb' yuninal winh chi', aton winhaj Jonatán, winhaj Abinadab yet' winhaj Malquisúa.
Ix te och wal owal chi' b'aj ayek' winhaj Saúl chi', haxo ix aji, ix yamchaj winh yuj sjul-lab' heb' filisteo chi', yuj chi' ix te xiw winh.

Ix yalan winh t'a winh ed'jinak syamk'ab': --Ik'k'eta k'een espada chi' tzin a tekanchamok, yik wach' a juntzanh ch'ok chonhab'il tik, manh ol in sb'uch heb' ayik ol in smilancham heb', xchi winhaj Saúl chi'. Palta ix te xiw winh ed'jinak syamk'ab' winh chi', maj stak'laj winh stekancham winh. Yuj chi' ix syumb'at nhojnaj sb'a winh t'a yib'anh k'een yespada, ix cham winh.
Ayic ix yilan winh ed'jinak syamk'ab' winh chi' to toxo ix cham winh, ix smilanpaxcham sb'a winh icha ix aj smilancham sb'a winhaj Saúl chi'.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi' ix cham winhaj Saúl, heb' yuninal winh yoxwanhil, winh ed'jinak syamk'ab' winh chi' yet' masanil heb' israel yet'nak winh.

Ayic ix yab'an heb' israel ayek' t'a sk'axepalb'at yak'likal Jezreel yet' pax heb' kajan t'a sk'axepalb'at ha' Jordán to toxo ix el lemnaj heb' soldado, toxo ix champax winhaj Saúl yet' heb' yuninal yoxwanhil, ix b'at heb' elelal, ix yaktejkan schonhab' heb'. Axo heb' filisteo ix k'ochkan kajan ta'.

Axo t'a junxo k'u, ix b'at heb' filisteo chi' yik'kot masanil tastak ay t'a heb' israel ix cham t'a owal chi', ix yilan heb' to b'alankan winhaj Saúl yet' heb' yuninal yoxwanhil t'a skal jantak heb' soldado chamnakxo t'a lum witz Gilboa.
Yuj chi' ix xiquel sjolom winh heb', ix yik'anpaxel k'een syamk'ab' winh heb' yik owal. Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'anb'at yab'ixal heb' t'a junjun schonhab' heb' filisteo yet' t'a spatil sdiosal heb'.
Ix yik'anb'at syamk'ab' winhaj Saúl chi' heb' t'a spatil sdiosal skuch Astarot, ix stzek'ankank'e jachan sniwanil winh chi' heb' yet' yik heb' yuninal winh t'a smuroal chonhab' Bet-sán.
Ayic ix yab'an heb' aj Jabes t'a yol yik Galaad to ix lokb'ajkank'e sniwanil winhaj Saúl chi' yuj heb' filisteo ta',
masanil heb' soldado te tek'an, pilan ak'wal ix b'ey heb', ix k'och heb' b'aj aykan sniwanil heb' chamnak chi', ix yik'ankot heb' t'a Jabes. Axo ta' ix snhustz'a heb'.
Axo sb'aquil heb', ha t'a yich jun te te' t'a Jabes chi' ix mukchajkani. Uque' k'ual ix och heb' aj Jabes chi' t'a tzek'ojk'olal yuj heb' chamnak chi'.

Ayic ix ak'ji ganar heb' amalekita yuj winhaj Dawid, ix meltzaj winh t'a Siclag. Axo t'a schab'jial sk'ochxi winh ta', ix k'och jun winh quelem spetoj t'a skampamento winhaj Saúl, toxo ix snhik'chitejb'at spichul winh ayochi, aypaxk'e lum lum t'a skal xil sjolom winh, yik sch'oxanel winh to ay skusk'olal winh. Axo ix k'och winh t'a yichanh winhaj Dawid chi', ix em nhojan winh.
Ix sk'anb'an winhaj Dawid chi' t'a winh: --¿B'ajtil ach koti? xchi winh. --Toxonhej ix in el lemnaj t'a skampamento heb' etisraelal, xchi winh.

--¿Tas ix uji jun? Al jab'ok wab'i, xchi winhaj Dawid chi'. --Ix ak'ji ganar heb' etisraelal chi'. Ay heb' ixto elkani, ay heb' ix chami. Ix champax winhaj Saúl yet' winh yuninal, aton winhaj Jonatán, xchi winh.
--¿Tas ix aj ojtakaneli tato ix cham winhaj Saúl yet' winh yuninal chi'? xchi winhaj Dawid chi'.

Ix tak'wi winh: --Q'uinh wal ayinek' t'a witzal Gilboa, ix wilani to toxonhej nhojanem winhaj Saúl chi' t'a yib'anh k'een slanza. Tzak'anxo wal sk'och heb' ajk'ol chi' t'a spatik winh yet' skarruaje heb' yik owal yet' heb' ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej.
Ha t'a jun rato chi', ix b'at k'elnaj winh t'a spatik, ix in yilanb'at winh, ix in yawtankot winh. --Tik ayin mamin, xin chi t'a winh.
Ix sk'anb'an winh t'ayin b'ajtil in koti. Ix walan t'a winh to amalekita in.
Ix yalanxi winh t'ayin to tzin nitzb'at in b'ha t'a stz'ey, tzin milancham winh t'a junelnhej yalani. Moc chi' pitzanto winh, palta toxo ix och pitz'an syail t'a sk'ool winh.

Yuj chi' ix in nitzb'at in b'ha t'a stz'ey winh, ix in wach' milancham winh yik max ste ab'ej syail, yujto ix wila'' to toxowal scham winh, yujto toxo ix em winh t'a yib'anh snhi' k'een slanza chi'. Ayic ix lajwi scham winh chi', ix wik'anel skorona winh t'a sjolom yet' brazalete ayoch t'a sk'ab' winh, ix wik'ankot t'ayach mamin, xchi winh.
Ayic ix yab'an winhaj Dawid chi' icha chi', ix snhik'chitanb'at spichul winh yuj kusk'olal yet' heb' ajun yet'ok.

Ix te ok' heb' yuj schamel winhaj Saúl yet' winh yuninal chi', aton winhaj Jonatán, yujto toxo ix ak'ji ganar heb' soldado israel schonhab' Jehová yuj heb' filisteo. Majxo walaj heb' yuj kusk'olal masanto ix em k'u.

Ixlajwi chi' ix sk'anb'an winhaj Dawid t'a winh quelem ix ik'ankot ab'ix chi': --¿B'ajtil aljinak ach? xchi winh. --Ha in tik yuninal in jun winh amalekita ayek' kajan t'a he kal tik, xchi winh quelem chi'.
--¿Tas yuj ix a tek'b'ej a b'a a milancham winh sik'b'ilel yuj Jehová chi'? xchi winhaj Dawid chi'.
Ix lajwinhej chi', ix yawtankot jun soldado winhaj Dawid chi': --Milcham jun winak tik, xchi winh. Val chi' ix miljicham winh quelem chi'.
Ayic wan smiljicham winh chi', ix yalan winhaj Dawid chi': --Ha ach ay a mul yuj chi' tzach chami. Ha ach ix alelta a mul chi' to ix a milcham winh rey sik'b'iloch yuj Jehová, xchi winh.
Ix sb'itej jun b'it tik winhaj Dawid yuj kusk'olal yuj schamel winhaj Saúl yet' winhaj Jonatán.
Ha jun b'it tik, ix chekji sk'ayb'ej masanil heb' aj Judá yuj winh. Ix stz'ib'chajpaxkan t'a yol ch'anh slibro winhaj Jaser:
Ex wetisraelal, ob'iltak ix aj yak'ji ganar sb'inajnaquil ko chonhab' t'a witzal Gilboa. Ay... tas wal yuj ix ak'ji ganar heb' niwak winak yaj t'a ko kal.

Manh eyal yab' heb' aj chonhab' Gat tas ix uji, manh eyalel t'a yoltak skalleal Askalón, yik wach' max tzalaj heb' ix filistea, yik wach' max k'e chennaj heb' ix ch'ok chonhab'il chi' yuj tzalajk'olal.

Manhxookab' em nhab' yet' yal ak'wal t'a yib'anh witzal Gilboa chi', yik maxtzak q'uib' tas tz'ak'ji t'a ofrendail, yujto ata' ix laj tek'jikan smaklab' jul-lab' heb' winh soldado yik Israel te tek'an. Ata' ix satel skopopial yilji smaklab' jul-lab' winhaj Saúl.

Juntaquel ix meltzaj winhaj Saúl yet' winhaj Jonatán t'a owal, chik'tak, ma xepu'tak k'een yespada heb' winh yet' sjul-lab'. Malaj b'aj smeltzaj heb' winh t'a ichnhejta', a heb' ajk'ol niwak yelk'ochi, a heb' smilcham heb' winh.
Ach Saúl yet' ach Jonatán, te nib'ab'il ex. Junnhej eyaji ayik pitzan ex, junnhej pax ix aj he chami. Te jelan he b'ey t'a yichanh nok' ch'akb'a. Te ay eyip t'a yichanh nok' choj.
Ex ix aj Israel, ok'anhek yuj winhaj Saúl. Ix eyak'och k'apak pichul chakchak yet' pax lino te wach' yuj winh, ix yak'an oro winh yelwanub'ok he pichul.
Ay... tas wal ix aj yak'ji ganar heb' niwak winak t'a owal. Ix miljicham winhaj Jonatán t'a jolomtak witz.
Ach wuk'tak aj Jonatán, tzin te kus uuj. Manhxa yalb'anil jantak a wach'il ix ak' t'ayin. Ha wal b'aj in a xajanejnak, ek'to t'a yichanh b'aj tzonh xajanej heb' ix ix.
Ay... tas ix aj scham heb' winh soldado te tek'an. Masanil syamk'ab' heb' winh ak'um owal ix satkaneli, xchi winhaj Dawid chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix sk'anb'an winhaj Dawid t'a Jehová icha tik: --¿Tom syal in k'exk'och t'a yol junok chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi Jehová chi' t'a winh: --Syala', xchi. Ix sk'anb'anpax winh: --¿Mach junok chonhab' b'aj syal in k'ochi? xchi winh. --Ha t'a chonhab' Hebrón syal a k'ochi, xchi Jehová chi'.
Yuj chi', ata' ix b'at winhaj Dawid chi' yet' heb' ix yetb'eyum schawanhil, aton ix Ahinoam aj Jezreel yet' ix Abigail yetb'eyumkan winhaj xilb'a Nabal, aj Carmel.
Ix yik'anpaxb'at heb' winh ayek' yet' winh yet' yetb'eyum junjun heb' yet' yal yuninal heb'. Ix kajnaj heb' t'a Hebrón yet' t'a yaldeail.

Ixlajwi chi', ix k'och heb' yichamtak winaquil yinhtilal Judá t'a winhaj Dawid chi', ix yak'ankanoch winh heb' sreyalok. Ix yab'an winhaj Dawid to a heb' aj Jabes t'a yol yik Galaad ix mukan winhaj Saúl,
yuj chi' ix yak'b'at juntzanh heb' schekab' winh, yik b'at yal heb' t'a heb' icha tik: Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová t'ayex yuj tastak wach' ix he k'ulej yujto ix he muk winhaj Saúl ko reyal.
Ha tiknaik aokab' Jehová tz'ok' sk'ool t'ayex, tzex xajanani, anhejtona' pax in a in tik, wach' ol wutej in b'a t'ayex yuj tas ix he k'ulej chi'.
Yuj chi', aq'ek eyip, tek'an tzeyutej he b'a, wach'chom ix cham winhaj Saúl ko reyal chi', palta a masanil heb' yinhtilal Judá ix in ak'anoch sreyalok, xchib'at winhaj Dawid chi'.
Axo ix aji, a winhaj Abner yuninal winhaj Ner, yajalil masanil heb' soldado winhaj Saúl, a winh ix ik'anb'at winhaj Is-boset yuninal winhaj Saúl chi' t'a Mahanaim.
Ata' ix yak'kanoch winh sreyalok juntzanh chonhab' tik: Aton Galaad, Gesuri, Jezreel, Efraín, Benjamín yet' juntzanhxo chonhab' yik Israel.

Ha winhaj Is-boset chi', 40 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal t'a chonhab' Israel chi', chab' ab'il ix yak' reyal chi' winh, palta haxo heb' yinhtilal Judá, a winhaj Dawid ayxo och sreyalok heb'.
Nanhal swajxaquil ab'il ix yak' reyal winhaj Dawid chi' t'a heb' yinhtilal Judá t'a chonhab' Hebrón.
Icha tik ix aj yoch owal. Ha winhaj Abner chi', ix el winh t'a Mahanaim, ix b'atkan winh t'a Gabaón yet' heb' soldado yik winhaj Is-boset.

Axo winhaj Joab yune' ix Sarwia, ix el winh yet' heb' soldado winhaj Dawid t'a Hebrón, ix schalaj sb'a winh yet' winhaj Abner b'aj smolb'ej sb'a ha ha' t'a yik Gabaón. Ha chab' makan heb' soldado chi', ix k'och heb' t'a ha ha' chi', junjun makan heb' ix kan t'a junjun sk'axepal ha'.
Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Abner t'a winhaj Joab chi' icha tik: --Elokab'kot jaywanhok heb' winh kelemtak yak' owal t'a quichanh tik, xchi winh. --Ichokab'ta', xchi winhaj Joab chi'.

Yuj chi' ix elta heb' winh, lajannhej sb'isul yik junjun heb' winh ix elta, lajchawanh heb' winh t'a yinhtilal Benjamín ayoch yet' winhaj Is-boset chi', lajchawanh pax heb' winh yik winhaj Dawid chi' ix elta.

Junjun heb' winh ix syam sjolom heb' yajk'ol heb' winh chi', ix stiplanoch k'een yespada heb' winh t'a skostil junjun, yuj chi' junnhej ix aj scham heb' winh smasanil. Yuj chi' “Teklajb'ail” ix sb'iejkan jun lugar chi', ha t'a yol yik Gabaón chi' ay.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi', te niwan ix aj yoch owal yuj heb' winh. Ix ak'ji ganar winhaj Abner yet' heb' soldado yuj heb' soldado winhaj Dawid chi'.
Ata' ayoch oxwanh heb' winh yune' ix Sarwia, aton winhaj Joab, winhaj Abisai yet' winhaj Asael. Ha winhaj Asael chi' te jelan sb'ey winh icha nok' k'ultaquil chej.
Ix och jinhan winh t'a spatik winhaj Abner, majxo yal-laj yel winhaj Abner chi'.
Ayic ix yilanb'at winh t'a spatik, ix yalan winh: --Mato a ach Asael ach chi', xchi winh. --Ha in toni, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Abner chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Actej in a pechani, aokab' junok heb' winh quelem tik tza yama', tzik'ankan masanil tastak yet'nak, xchi winh t'a winh. Palta haxo winhaj Asael chi' jun, maj yal-laj sk'ol winh syaktej spechan winh.

Ix yalanxi winhaj Abner chi' t'a winh junelxo: --Actej in a pechani, ¿mato tzin ak' wal pural yik tzach in milanchamok? Tato icha chi', ¿tas ol aj in sat in k'och t'a yichanh winh uk'tak aj Joab? xchi winh.

Palta a winhaj Asael chi', maj yaktej winh spechan winh, yuj chi' haxo yok slanza winhaj Abner chi' ix stipkot t'a spatik, a wal t'a sk'ool winhaj Asael chi' ix ochi, ix k'axpajelk'och te' t'a yich spatik winh. Ix telwi winh, ix cham winh. Masanil mach sk'och t'a jun lugar b'aj ix cham winh chi' tz'och wan heb' yila'.

Axo winhaj Joab yet' winhaj Abisai ix b'atnhej heb' winh t'a spatik winhaj Abner chi'. Ayic wanxo yem k'u, ix k'och heb' winh t'a sjolom lum witz Amma, ay t'a yichanh Gía, aton b'aj sb'atkan sb'eal juntzanh tzinan lu'um t'a Gabaón.
Ata' ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' yinhtilal Benjamín yet' winhaj Abner chi', junxonhej ix yutej sb'a heb' smasanil t'a jun tzalan.

Axo winhaj Abner chi' ix awaj t'a winhaj Joab icha tik: --¿Tom manh ol aktej a milancham anima tik? ¿Tom max a na' jab'ok to anhej chukal syik'kot jun tik t'a quib'anh? ¿Janik' ol al t'a heb' a soldado to tz'och waan heb' spechan heb' yetchonhab'? xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Joab chi' icha tik: --Syil wal Dios, q'uinalok maj ach awajok, ix am onh b'atnhej t'a he patik masanto t'a q'uinhib'alil k'ik'an, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Joab chi' to spuji nok' ch'aak, yuj chi' ix och waan masanil heb' soldado yik winhaj Dawid spechan heb' yik Israel chi'.
Axo winhaj Abner chi' yet' heb' soldado pilan ak'wal ix b'ey heb' t'a spanhanil Arabá, ix k'axpajek' heb' t'ha ha' Jordán yet' t'a yol yik Bitrón masanto ix k'och heb' t'a Mahanaim.

Axo pax winhaj Joab chi', ix och waan winh spechan winhaj Abner chi'. Ichato chi' ix smolb'an heb' soldado winh smasanil, ix yawtan slistail heb' winh, haxo ix aji to ay 19 heb' soldado yik winhaj Dawid chi' ix chami, ix champax winhaj Asael.
Palta haxo heb' soldado yik Benjamín yet'nak winhaj Abner, 360 heb' ix cham yuj heb' soldado yik winhaj Dawid chi'.

Ha winhaj Joab yet' masanil heb' soldado, pilan ak'wal ix b'ey heb', ayxoek' heb' t'a Hebrón ix q'uinhib'i. Ayic wan smeltzaj heb', ix ek' heb' yik' sniwanil winhaj Asael chi'. Ha b'aj mukan smam winh t'a chonhab' Belén, ata' ix mukji winh.

Ha heb' soldado ayoch yet' winh yuninal winhaj Saúl chi', najtil ix yak' owal heb' yet' heb' ayoch yet' winhaj Dawid, palta jab'jab'il ix el yip heb', haxo pax heb' yik winhaj Dawid chi' ix te tek'k'aj heb'.

Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Dawid ix alji t'a Hebrón, aton sb'i heb' tik t'a stzolal: Vinhaj Amnón yune' ix Ahinoam aj Jezreel, winhaj Quileab, yune' ix Abigail, ix yetb'eyumkan winhaj xilb'a Nabal, aj Carmel, winhaj Absalón yune' ix Maaca yisil winhaj Talmai sreyal Gesur, winhaj Adonías yune' ix Haguit, winhaj Sefatías yune' ix Abital yet' winhaj Itream yune' ix Egla. Aton sb'i heb' ix yetb'eyum winhaj Dawid tik yet' heb' yuninal ix alji ayik ayek' winh t'a Hebrón.
Ayic aynhej och owal t'a skal heb' yik winhaj Dawid yet' heb' ayoch yet' heb' yinhtilal winhaj Saúl, haxo winhaj Abner chi' ix ste ik'ej yipok winh t'a skal heb' yik winhaj Saúl chi'.

Ha winhaj Saúl chi', aykan jun ix yetb'eyum winh skuchan Rizpa, yisil winhaj Aja. Ay jun k'u ix yal winhaj Is-boset t'a winhaj Abner chi': --¿Tas yuj ix ach way yet' ix yetb'eyumkan winh in mam? xchi winh t'a winh.

Yujto ix yal jun chi' winhaj Is-boset chi' t'a winhaj Abner chi', yuj chi' ix te kot yowal winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: --¿Tom tz'i' in tzila', tokwal wan wak'anoch in b'a yet' heb' ajk'ol yik Judá tik? Ha in tik, te wach'nhej ix wutej in b'ha t'a heb' ayto yuj sb'a yet' winh a mam yet' t'a heb' wach' yak'an yet' winh, maj ach wak'paxoch t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Dawid, haxo tiknaik tzak'an yowalil t'ayin yuj jun ix ix chi'.

Ha Jehová ix yak' sti' t'a winhaj Dawid to tz'ik'jiek' opisio t'a winhaj Saúl yet' pax t'a heb' yinhtilal, tz'ochkan winhaj Dawid chi' reyal t'a Israel yet' t'a Judá, skotnhej t'a chonhab' Dan masanto t'a Beerseba. Cotokab' yowal sk'ol Jehová t'a wib'anh tato max wak' wip yelk'och tas ix yal chi', xchi winh.
Majxo yal-laj yalan junok b'elanh lolonel winhaj Is-boset t'a winhaj Abner chi', yujto xiwnak winh t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix schekanb'at juntzanh schekab' winhaj Abner chi' yal t'a winhaj Dawid icha tik: ¿Tom manhok in ay wopisio t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik? Ha tiknaik ko b'o junok ko trato yik tzin och ed'ok, yik wach' masanil heb' quetchonhab' tz'och heb' ed'ok, xchib'at winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Dawid chi': Syal in b'oan in trato chi' ed'ok, palta ay jun tas yowalil tzojtaquejeli: Max yal-laj a jawi t'a wichanh tato manh ed'nakok ix wetb'eyum, ix Mical yisilkan winhaj xilb'a Saúl, xchib'at winh.

Ix schekanpaxb'at heb' schekab' winhaj Dawid chi' t'a winhaj Is-boset, ix yalan winh icha tik: Ak'kot ix Mical, ix wetb'eyum, aton ix wik'nak yik wak'annak jun kiento sjolom swinaquil heb' winh filisteo yuj stojolok ix t'a winh smam, xchib'at winh.
Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Is-boset chi' to tz'ik'jiek' ix t'a winh yetb'eyum, aton winhaj Paltiel, yuninal winhaj Lais.
Ha winhaj Paltiel chi', ix b'at tzak'an winh yuj ix, ix och ijan winh yoq'ui, masanto ix k'och winh t'a Bahurim. Ata' ix yal winhaj Abner chi' t'a winh to smeltzaj winh, yuj chi' ix meltzajkan winh.
Yakb'an chi', ix laj lolon winhaj Abner yet' heb' yichamtak winaquil Israel, ix yalan winh t'a heb' icha tik: Ayxo stiempoal ix he na' a ex tik to a winhaj Dawid tz'och he reyalok.

Ha tiknaik jun, toxo ix k'och stiempoal yik tz'och winh, yujto yalnakkan Jehová yuj winh schekab' chi', to a winh ol kolan schonhab' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' filisteo yet' t'a yol sk'ab' masanil juntzanh heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayonh, xchi winh.

Ix lolonpax winh yet' masanil heb' yetchonhab' aj Benjamín, ix lajwi chi', ix b'at winh t'a Hebrón yik slolon winh yet' winhaj Dawid yuj tas ix yal heb' yetisraelal heb' yet' tas ix yal masanil heb' yetchonhab' heb' aj Benjamín chi'.
Ix k'och winh yet' 20 heb' soldado t'a Hebrón b'aj ayek' winhaj Dawid chi'. Ix schekan b'ojok jun niwan wael winhaj Dawid chi' yuj winhaj Abner yet' pax yuj heb' ajun yet' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Abner chi' t'a winhaj Dawid chi' icha tik: --Ha tiknaik mamin rey, yowalil tzin b'at in molb'ej masanil heb' quetisraelal, yik sb'oan junok trato heb' ed'ok, icha wal chi' ol aj ak'an reyal icha wal tas tza nib'ej, xchi winh. --Ixic an, xchi winhaj Dawid chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix yalankan quilkob'a winhaj Abner chi', ix b'at winh t'a tzalajk'olal.

Ato wal sb'at winhaj Abner chi', ix k'och winhaj Joab yet' heb' soldado winhaj Dawid, spetoj heb' t'a owal. Te tzijtum tastak yet'nak heb', aton tas ix laj yik'ek' heb' t'a heb' yajk'ool. Ayic ix k'och winhaj Joab yet' masanil heb' soldado ajun yet'ok, ix alji t'a winh to a winhaj Abner chi', ix ulek' winh lolonel yet' winh rey chi', toxo ix meltzaj winh t'a tzalajk'olal.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj Joab chi' t'a winh rey chi', ix yalan winh: --Mamin rey, ¿tas yuj icha chi' ix a k'ulej? Yujto a winhaj Abner ix ulek' t'ayach, ix a chaanxib'at winh t'a tzalajk'olal.
Mamin rey ¿tom manh ojtakok to a winhaj Abner chi' tonhej tzul smusej a sat winh yik syil winh tas tza k'ulej yet' tas aji? xchi winh.

Ixnhej lajwi slolon winh yet' winh rey chi', ix schekan winh b'at saychaj winhaj Abner chi' t'a elk'altak, ato b'aj ay ha' uk'b'ila' yik Sira, ata' ix meltzaj winh yuj heb', palta manh yojtakoklaj winhaj Dawid chi' tas yaji.

Ayic ix jax winhaj Abner chi' t'a Hebrón, haxo winhaj Joab chi' ix chaan winh sjawi t'a spatiquel chonhab' chi', ix ik'jib'at winh yuj winh t'a stz'eyb'at sti' jun chonhab' chi', yik slolon heb' winh ta' sch'okoj. Ata' ix stipoch yespada winhaj Joab chi' t'a sk'ol winh, ix cham winh, yik syak'anek' spak winh yuk'tak winhaj Joab chi'.
Ayic ix yab'an jun chi' winhaj Dawid, ix yalan winh: Syil Jehová to a in tik yet' masanil heb' in chekab' malaj kalan quik t'a schamel winhaj Abner chi'.

Kotokab'kan jun tik t'a yib'anh winhaj Joab yet' t'a yib'anh heb' yinhtilal winh yet' heb' sk'ab' yok. Ha t'a skal heb', ayokab' mach ol yab' syail yuj tas tz'el t'a sniwanil, ayokab' mach ol penaayax yuj lepra, ayokab'pax mach tz'em sb'eyi, ayokab' mach smiljichamok yet' mach scham yuj wejel, xchi winh rey chi'.
Ha winhaj Joab chi' yet' winhaj Abisai ix milancham winhaj Abner chi', yujto ayik ix och owal t'a Gabaón, a winhaj Abner chi' ix milancham winhaj Asael, winh yuk'tak heb' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh rey t'a winhaj Joab chi' yet' t'a masanil heb' ajun yet' winh to snhik'chitejel spichul heb', yik tz'och heb' t'a kusk'olal yuj schamel winhaj Abner chi'. Ix och tzak'an winh rey chi' t'a spatik mach ix b'akhanb'at sniwanil winh chi'.
Ha t'a Hebrón ix smuk sniwanil winh chi' heb'. Ix ok' winh rey chi' b'aj ix mukchaj winhaj Abner chi', ix ok'pax masanil heb' anima ajun yet' winh.
Yuj chi' ix sb'itej jun b'it yik kusk'olal winh rey chi': Ach Abner ¿tas yuj icha chi' ix aj a chami? Icha tz'aj scham heb' sk'ulan chukal ix aj a chami.

Tocwal tzek'b'il a k'ab', ma tzek'b'il ok t'a k'een kadena. Icha wal tz'aj scham junok mach t'a yol sk'ab' heb' anima te chuk sb'eyb'al, icha chi' ix aj a chami, xchi winhaj Dawid chi'. Axo heb' anima chi', ix ok'pax heb' yuj schamel winhaj Abner chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan heb' t'a winhaj Dawid chi' to swa jab'ok winh yakb'an manto em k'u, palta ix yak' sti' winh t'a yichanh Dios: --Aokab' Dios tz'ak'anoch yaelal t'a wib'anh tato swab'lej jab'ok wael ma junokxo tasi ayik manto em k'u, xchi winh.
Masanil anima ayek' ta', ix nachajel jun chi' yuj heb', ix scha wal sk'ol heb', yujto masanil tas sk'ulej winhaj Dawid chi' scha sk'ol heb' anima smasanil.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ix nachajel yuj heb' israel chi' smasanil to a winhaj rey Dawid chi', manh lokanoklaj winh t'a schamel winhaj Abner chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a masanil heb' schekab': --Ojtaquejequeli to a tiknaik ix cham jun winh sat yajal t'a ko kal a onh israel onh tik.
Yuj chi' wach'chom ha Dios ix in sik'anoch reyal, palta ste el wip swab' yuj schuk spensaril heb' winh yune' ix Sarwia. Aokab' Jehová ol ak'an spak t'a jun mach ix k'ulan chukal tik, xchi winh.
Ayic ix yab'an winhaj Is-boset yuninal winhaj Saúl to toxo ix cham winhaj Abner t'a Hebrón, ix te xiw winh. Ix te somchajpaxk'e masanil heb' yetisraelal winh yet'ok.

Ay chawanh heb' winh schekab' winhaj Is-boset chi', yajal yaj heb' winh t'a jun nhilanh heb' soldado elk'um. Ay jun winh skuch Baana, haxo junxo winh skuch Recab. Ha winhaj Rimón kajan t'a Beerot t'a slak'anil b'aj tzek' smakb'en heb' yik Benjamín ay yuninal heb' winh. (Ha heb' yinhtilal heb' anima kajan t'a Beerot chi', yinhtilal heb' winhaj Benjamín.
Anhejto b'atnakkan heb' t'a Gitaim, tonhej komon ayek' heb' ta', icha ch'ok chonhab'il yaj heb'.)

(Ha winhaj Jonatán yuninal winhaj Saúl ay jun yuninal winh kannak skuch Mefi-boset. Ha jun winh chi', manh wach'ok yok winh schab'il, yujto ayik oye'anto ab'il sk'inal winh, ix jawi yab'ixal tas ix uji t'a Jezreel to toxo ix cham winhaj Saúl yet' winhaj Jonatán. Yuj chi' ix cheljib'at winh yuj jun ix tz'ilan q'uib'ok, ix b'at heb' elelal yalani. Yujto ix spil yip ix yeli, ix yaktanel winh ix, yuj chi' icha chi' ix aj yixtaxkan yok winh chi'.)
Axo ix aji to a winhaj Recab yet' winhaj Baana chi', ix b'at heb' winh t'a spat winhaj Is-boset ayik te ow k'ak' t'a chimk'ualil. Vaynac winh t'a sch'at yik syik' jab'ok yip.

Axo ix stanhwumal spuertail spat winh, wan schaywi trigo ix, ix wayb'at ix. Val t'a jun rato chi', ix och lemnaj winhaj Recab yet' winh yuk'tak chi' b'aj waynak winhaj Is-boset chi', malaj junok mach ix ilani.

Ayic ix och heb' winh t'a yol pat chi', ix yilan heb' winh to jichanek' winhaj Is-boset chi' sway t'a sch'at. Yuj chi' ix stekcham winh heb' winh, ix xikanel sjolom winh heb' winh, ix yik'anb'at heb' winh yet'ok. Pilan ak'wal ix b'ey heb' winh b'aj sb'at sb'eal Arabá

yik sb'at yak'an heb' winh t'a winhaj rey Dawid t'a Hebrón. Ix yalan heb' winh t'a winh icha tik: --Mamin rey, ix quik'kot sjolom winhaj Is-boset yuninal winhaj Saúl, winh ochnak ajk'olal t'ayach, snib'ejnak winh ach smilchamok. Palta a tiknaik ix el t'a sk'ol Jehová yik tza pakan a b'ha t'a winhaj Saúl yet' t'a yinhtilal, xchi heb' winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj rey Dawid chi' t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Syil Jehová, aton ix in kolanel t'a masanil tas ay smay ix ja t'a wib'anh

to ayik ix jawi jun winh winak t'a Siclag yik ix yik'ankot wach' ab'ix winh t'ayin yalani, yuj schamel winhaj Saúl, ix wak'an yamjok winh, ix wak'an miljokcham winh. Aton spak chi' ix wak' t'a winh yuj jun wach' ab'ix ix yik'kot chi' t'ayin.

Ocxom wal t'ayex a ex tik, smoj ton wal swak' spak t'ayex, yujto ix he milcham winh winak malaj smul yakb'an waynak winh t'a spat. Yuj chi' ol ex in satel t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik. Manhxa b'ak'uinh ol ex b'inaj jab'ok, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix schekan winh rey chi' miljicham heb' winh. Ix xikjiel sk'ab' heb' winh yet' yok yuj heb' soldado, ix k'e lokan sniwanil heb' winh b'aj ay yet'tal ha ha' t'a Hebrón chi'. Axo sjolom winhaj Is-boset chi', ix yik'b'at heb' soldado, ix smukan heb' b'aj mukan winhaj Abner, t'a Hebrón chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix jawi masanil heb' yinhtilal Israel t'a winhaj Dawid t'a Hebrón. Ix yalan heb' t'a winh icha tik: Ha onh tik te ayto kuj ko b'a ed'ok.
D'a yalanhtaxo ayik aytooch winhaj Saúl ko reyalok, a ach onh a kuchb'ejnak t'a owal. Anheja' pax Jehová alannak t'ayach to a ach ol onh a kuchb'ej yet' och ko reyalok, xchi heb'.

Yakb'an ayek' heb' ta', haxo heb' yichamtak winaquil chonhab' Israel ix lolon yet' winhaj Dawid chi' yik sb'oankan strato winh yet' heb' t'a yichanh Jehová. Ixlajwi chi', ix ak'jikank'e akeite t'a sjolom winh yik sik'jikanoch winh sreyalok masanil heb' israel.
Ayic ix schaanel yich winh yak'an reyal, 30 ab'il sk'inal winh. 40 ab'il ix yak' reyal chi' winh.
Nanhal swajxaquil ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a yib'anh heb' aj Judá t'a Hebrón. Ixlajwi chi', 33 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a masanil heb' israel yet' t'a heb' aj Judá t'a Jerusalén.

Ay jun k'u ix b'at winhaj rey Dawid chi' yet' heb' soldado yak' owal yet' heb' jebuseo ay t'a Jerusalén. Ix sna' heb' jebuseo chi' to max yal-laj yoch winhaj Dawid chi' t'a yol schonhab' heb' chi', yuj chi' ix yal heb' t'a winh icha tik: k'okb'ilnhej heb' max uji yilani yet' heb' tz'em sb'eyi, a heb' max ach chaan ochta t'a tik, xchi heb'.
Wach'chom icha chi' ix yal heb', palta ix yak' ganar chonhab' Sion winh rey chi', yuj chi' schonhab' winhaj Dawid ix sb'iejkani.

Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ix yal winhaj Dawid t'a heb' soldado: Ha mach sb'ab'lajoch yak' owal yet' heb' jebuseo tik, ochokab' t'a sb'e ha ha' tz'ochk'och t'a yol chonhab' chi', smilancham masanil heb' max uji yilan yet' heb' tz'em sb'eyi.
