Ha wal juntzanh heb' chi', tzin yaj heb', xchi winh. Ata' elnakkankot jun lolonel tz'alji: Ha heb' max uji yilani yet' heb' tz'em sb'eyi, max yal-laj yoch heb' t'a yol spalakio winh rey, xchi.

Ixlajwi chi', ix kajnaj winhaj Dawid chi' t'a kuartel ay t'a jun chonhab' chi', ix yak'an skuch winh Schonhab' Vinhaj Dawid, ix laj sb'oank'e juntzanhxo pat winh t'a spatiktak, ix schael yich b'aj ix mukchaj jun ch'olan.
Ha Jehová Dios Yajal t'a Smasanil, a ayoch yet' winhaj Dawid chi', yuj chi' te niwan ix aj sb'inaj winh.

Ha winhaj Hiram sreyal Tiro, ix schekkot heb' smunlajwum winh t'a winhaj Dawid, aton heb' nhikum te' yet' heb' mak'umpoj k'een, ix yik'anpaxkot te' k'ute' heb', yik sb'oank'e spat winhaj Dawid chi' heb'.
Icha chi' ix aj snachajel yuj winhaj Dawid chi' to a Jehová ix ak'ankanoch winh reyal, yik te niwan tz'aj sb'inaj schonhab' Jehová chi', yujto te xajan yuj.
Ayic ix el winhaj Dawid chi' t'a Hebrón, ix jawi winh t'a Jerusalén, ix kajnaj winh ta'. Ayto juntzanhxo heb' ix ix, ix yik' winh, yuj chi' tzijtumto yal yuninal winh ix alji.

Ha heb' yuninal winh ix alji t'a Jerusalén chi', aton heb' tik: Vinhaj Samúa, winhaj Sobab, winhaj Natán, winhaj Salomón, winhaj Ibhar, winhaj Elisúa, winhaj Nefeg, winhaj Jafía, winhaj Elisama, winhaj Eliada yet' winhaj Elifelet.

Ayic ix yab'an heb' filisteo to toxo ix och winhaj Dawid sreyalok Israel, ix kot heb' masanil yak' owal yet' winh, palta ayik ix yab'an winh, ix em winh b'aj ay juntzanh k'een niwak tenam yik wach' syak' owal chi' winh.
Ha heb' filisteo chi' ix k'och heb' t'a spanhanil Refaim, ix sb'oank'e skampamento heb' ta'.

Ix sk'anb'an winhaj Dawid chi' t'a Jehová icha tik: --¿Tzam yal wak'an owal yet' heb' filisteo chi'? ¿Ol am ak'och heb' t'a yol in k'ab'? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi Jehová chi': --Ixic, ak' owal yet' heb'. Ha in ol wak'och heb' t'a yol a k'ab', xchi t'a winh.

Ix k'och winh yet' heb' soldado b'aj ayek' heb' filisteo chi'. Ata' ix ak'ji ganar heb' yuj winh. Yuj chi' ix yal winh: Ha Jehová ix jakanb'at jun b'e t'a wichanh t'a skal heb' wajk'ol tik, icha wal tz'aj sb'at nhepnaj junok ha' eluma', xchi winh. Yuj chi' Baal-perazim ix sb'iejkan jun lugar chi'.
Ayic ix el lemnaj heb' filisteo chi', ix laj yaktejkan sdiosal heb', haxo winhaj Dawid chi' yet' heb' soldado ix ik'ankoti.
Ix jaxpax heb' filisteo chi' t'a spanhanil Refaim chi'.

Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'ejxi winhaj Dawid chi' t'a Jehová. Ix tak'wixi Jehová chi' t'a winh: --Manh ach k'och t'a sat heb', palta to ha t'a spatiktak heb' ol ach kotok. Ha b'aj ay juntzanh te' bálsamo tzach koti.

Ayic ol ab'an sk'anh jun icha sk'anh yek' anima t'a skaltak sk'ab' te te' chi', elanhchamel tza yamoch ak'an owal yet' heb', yujto a jun chi' sch'oxani to a in ol in b'ab'laj uuj, yik ol in satanel heb' filisteo chi', xchi Jehová.
Ix sk'anab'ajej winhaj rey Dawid chi' tas ix yal Jehová. Yuj chi' ix yak' ganar heb' filisteo chi' winh, ix el yich spechan heb' winh t'a Geba masanto t'a Gezer.
Ix smolb'anxi heb' soldado winhaj Dawid, a heb' te jelan t'a skal heb' israel, ay 30 mil heb'.
Ix b'at heb' t'a Baala t'a yol yik Judá yik b'at yik'ankot te' skaxail strato Jehová Dios heb', aton te kaxa b'aj sb'inaj Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, aton ayek' t'a yib'anh heb' querubín.

Ha t'a yol spat winhaj Abinadab ay t'a jun tzalan, ata' ayek' te kaxa chi'. Ha t'a yib'anh jun te' karreta ak'to, ata' ix yik'kot te' kaxa chi' heb'. Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Abinadab, aton winhaj Uza yet' winhaj Ahío, a heb' skuchb'an b'ey nok' wakax nherjinak te' karreta b'aj ayk'e te' kaxa chi', a winhaj Ahío b'ab'el sb'at yuj te'.

Axo winhaj Dawid yet' masanil heb' chonhab', wal t'a smasanil sk'ol heb' ix b'itan t'a tzalajk'olal, ix k'e cheneljok heb' t'a yichanh Jehová wan yoch te' arpa yet' salterio, panderas, kastañuelas yet' platillo.
Ayic ix jawi heb' yet' skaxail strato Dios t'a stek'lab' trigo winhaj Nacón, ijan ix telwi nok' wakax ed'jinak te' karreta chi', yuj chi' haxo winhaj Uza chi' ix yaman te' kaxa chi'.
Yuj chi' ix kot yowal Jehová t'a winh, yujto ix syam te' kaxa chi' winh. Ata' ix chamkan winh t'a stz'ey te' chi'.
Ix kot yowal winhaj Dawid chi' yujto ix cham winhaj Uza chi' yuj Jehová. Yuj chi' Pérez-uza ix sb'iejkan jun lugar chi' yuj winh. Anheja' icha chi' tiknaik.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ix xiwkank'e winhaj rey Dawid chi' t'a Jehová. Yuj chi' ix yal winh icha tik: Wach' am maxtzak wik'b'at te' skaxail strato Jehová tik b'aj kajan in, xchi winh.
Majxo yal-laj sk'ol winhaj Dawid chi' ix yik'kot te' kaxa chi' t'a schonhab'. Yuj chi' ix yal winh to tz'ik'jib'at te' t'a spat winhaj Obed-edom aj Gat.
Oxe' ujal ix kan te' ta'. Ix yak'wal swach'k'olal Jehová t'a yib'anh winhaj Obed-edom chi' yet' heb' kajan yet' winh.

Ayic ix yab'an winhaj rey Dawid chi' to yuj te' skaxail strato Jehová, ix yak' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a yib'anh winhaj Obed-edom chi' yet' heb' kajan yet' winh yet' masanil tastak ay t'a winh, yuj chi' ix b'at yik'anxikot te' winhaj Dawid chi'. Yed' wal tzalajk'olalil ix yik'kot te' winh t'a yol schonhab'.
Ayic jay b'ekanto skot heb' ed'jinak te' kaxa chi', ix yak'an jun nok' mam wakax winhaj Dawid chi' yet' jun nok' quelem wakax b'ak'uech silab'il t'a Jehová.
Ayoch jun chaleka nab'a lino yik sakerdote yuj winhaj Dawid chi', ix k'e chennaj winh yuj tzalajk'olal yet' smasanil sk'ool t'a yichanh Jehová.

Icha chi' ix sk'ulej winh yet' masanil chonhab' Israel. Niwan q'uinh ix yutej heb' ayik ix yik'ankot te' skaxail trato chi' heb' t'a Jerusalén, tz'el yaw heb', spu'an k'een trompeta heb' t'a tzalajk'olal.

Ayic ix jawi te' skaxail trato chi' t'a schonhab' winhaj Dawid chi', t'anhanelta ix Mical yisilkan winhaj Saúl t'a swentena. Ix yilan ix to a winhaj Dawid chi' sk'e chennaj winh t'a yichanh Jehová, yuj chi' ix chab'axk'e sk'ol ix t'a winh.

Axo yik ix jawi te' skaxail trato chi' yuj heb', ix sb'oanoch te' heb' t'a yol jun mantiado b'ob'il yuj winhaj Dawid chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh to snhusjitz'a silab' yet' pax silab' yik junk'olal yet' Jehová.
Ayic ix lajwi yak'ji juntzanh silab' chi', ix yalan wach' lolonel winhaj Dawid chi' t'a yib'anh chonhab' Israel t'a sb'i Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil.

Ix yak'an junjun ixim pan winh yet' jab'jab' b'olb'il chib'ej yet' junjun quechanh taquinh sat uwa t'a masanil heb' chonhab', aton t'a heb' winh winak yet' t'a heb' ix ix. Ixlajwi chi', ix laj pax heb' t'a spat.

Ayic ix pax winhaj rey Dawid chi' t'a spat yik syalan wach' lolonel winh t'a yib'anh heb' kajan t'a spat chi', ix elta ix Mical chi' scha winh, ix yalan ix t'a winh icha tik: --Ha tiknaik ach sreyal chonhab' Israel, te wach'xo wal ix utej a ch'oxanel a b'a b'ian. Ix a ch'oxk'ab'ejel a b'ha t'a sat heb' ix schekab' heb' winh etyajalil. Te q'uixwelal ix utej a b'a icha junok komon anima, xchi ix t'a winh.

Ix tak'wi winh icha tik: --Val yel ix in k'e chennaj yuj tzalajk'olal t'a yichanh Jehová, aton ix in sik'anoch yajalilok schonhab' sk'exulok winh a mam yet' pax sk'exulok heb' a k'ab' ok. Yuj chi' ol in k'enhej chennaj yuj tzalajk'olal t'a yichanh Jehová.
Syalpax in wach' ik'anemta in b'a, swach' el in q'uixwelal icha tzal chi', palta a heb' ix ix tzal chi', niwan ol in ajelk'och t'a sat heb' ix, xchi winhaj Dawid chi'.
Ha ix Mical chi', malaj junok yune' ix aljinak.
Ayic ix kanxonhej winhaj rey Dawid chi' t'a spalakio. Ayic toxo ix yak'och junk'olal Jehová t'a skal heb' israel yet' heb' ajk'ol yajoch t'a heb',
ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Natán schekab' Jehová: --Tik tzila' to nab'a k'ute' ayoch t'a in palakio tik, haxo pax te' skaxail strato Dios jun, ha t'a yol jun mantiado ayoch te', xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Natán chi': --Ujokab' icha tas tza na'a, yujto a Jehová aynhejoch ed'ok, xchi winh.
Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi', ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Natán chi' icha tik:
Ixic, b'at al t'a winh in chekab' winhaj Dawid, tzalani to a in Jehová in swal icha tik: Manhok achlaj ol a b'ok'e junok templo b'aj ol in aj chi'.
Atax yik ix wik'anelta heb' he mam eyicham t'a Egipto masanto tiknaik, malaj b'aj ix in aj t'a yol junok pat, anhej t'a yoltak mantiado in eq'ui.

B'ajtaktil ix in ek'nhej yet' heb' in chonhab', malaj b'aj ix in k'an t'a junok heb' ayoch yajalil chonhab' chi' wuuj, tas yuj max sb'o junok in kajnub' heb', nab'a k'ute' tz'och t'ay, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a winh rey chi'.
Tzalanpax t'a winh icha tik: Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil swala': Ha in ix ach wik'el t'a tanhwoj kalnel, ix ach wak'anoch yajalok in chonhab' Israel.
Yalnhej b'ajtil tzach eq'ui ayinnhej och ed'ok. Ix in satel masanil heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach, ol ach wak' b'inaj icha heb' niwak winak t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik.

Anhejtona' ix in sik'elta jun lum tik b'aj tzex kajnajkan a ex in chonhab' ex tik. Ha tik ol ex kannhej kajan t'a junelnhej. Manhxa mach ol ex xib'tanok, manhxo ol ex tzuntzaj yuj heb' eyajk'ool icha ix ex yutej heb' t'a sb'ab'elal,
ayik ix wak'anoch heb' ix ex kuchb'ani. Ha in ol in satel masanil heb' eyajk'ool. Swak'anpax ojtaquejeli to ol wak'nhejkan opisio t'a heb' inhtilal.
Ayic ol lajwok ek' a k 'inal, ayik mukb'il achxo, ol wak'och junok uninal reyal a k'exulok, tek'tek' wal ol wutej yopisio chi'.
A' ol b'oank'e in kajnub' b'aj ol in b'inajok. Ol wak'annhejkan yopisio chi' t'a heb' yinhtilal t'a masanil tiempo.
Ha in ol in och smamok, haxo ol och wuninalok. Tato ay b'aj ol och spitalil t'ayin, ol wak'och syaelal icha syutej junok mamab'il smak'an yuninal.
Palta manh jab'ok ol waktejkan in xajanani, manh ichaok wutejnak waktankan in xajanan winhaj Saúl, wik'naquel winh t'a yopisio, yik ach och sk'exulok winh.
Ha in ol wak'nhejkan opisio tik t'a heb' inhtilal t'a masanil tiempo, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a winh, xchi t'a winhaj Natán chi'.
Icha ix aj yalan Jehová, icha wal chi' ix aj yalan winhaj Natán t'a winhaj rey Dawid chi'.

Yuj chi' ix och winhaj Dawid chi' t'a yichanh Jehová, ix em k'ojan winh ix lesalwi winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: Mamin Jehová Vajalil, ¿tas wal jab'ok welk'och yet' heb' in mam wicham, yuj chi' ix ak' jun niwan opisio tik t'ayin?
Mamin Jehová, tas wal waj a in tik t'ayach yuj chi' ix ala' tas ol aj yelk'och winhtilal t'a b'ak'uinh. Ha tas tzutej a b'a tik t'ayin, manh ichaok chi' syutej sb'a heb' anima.
Mamin Jehová Vajalil, manhxa tas syal walan t'ayach. Ha ach tik ojtak tas yaj in pensar a in a chekab' in tik.
Masanil juntzanh lolonel satub'tak tik, a ach ix ak' wojtaquejeli, icha tas ix el t'a a k'ool.
Mamin Jehová, malaj junokxo mach lajan ed'ok. Ha achnhej toni, malaj junokxo Dios skab' spekal icha ach tik.

Ha pax a chonhab' Israel tik jun, malaj junokxo chonhab' lajan yet'ok. Yujto axonhej jun chonhab' tik t'a sat lum tik ix a kolkanel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ool yik tz'ochkan a chonhab'ok. Yed' a poder yet' tastak satub'tak a b'onak, ik'naquelta heb' ko mam quicham t'a Egipto, a satannaquel juntzanh chonhab' yet' sdiosal t'a yichanh heb' yik niwan tz'ajelk'och a b'i.
Yujto a ach ix onh ak'och a chonhab'ok t'a junelnhej, yuj chi' a ach ix ach ochkan ko Diosaloc.
Mamin Jehová, a tiknaik jun, elokab'k'och tas ix al t'ayin a in a chekab' in tik yet' t'a masanil winhtilal. Ichokab' chi' tz'aj yelk'och tas ix ala',

yik wach' tzach b'inaj t'a masanil tiempo, yik ol yal heb' anima to a ach Jehová Dios ach, Yajal ach t'a yib'anh Smasanil, a achton ko Diosal ach a onh israel onh tik. Anheja' icha chi' ol aj yochnhej winhtilal reyal t'a ichanh.
Mamin Jehová, Yajal ach t'a Smasanil, ko Diosal ach, a ach wal tzak' wojtaquejeli to ol ochkan winhtilal t'a yajalil. Yuj chi' tzin tek'b'ej in b'a in k'anan jun tik t'ayach.
Ha ach tik Mamin Jehová, Dios ach, a tas tzala' yelnhej, yelxo wal te wach' tas ix ak' a ti' ak'an t'ayin.

Elokab' t'a a k'ool ak'an a wach'k'olal t'a winhtilal yik stek'b'ejnhej sb'a heb' t'a ichanh. Mamin Jehová, a ach ix alkan jun tik, yuj chi' a yuj a wach'k'olal, wach' ol ajkan winhtilal t'a masanil tiempo, xchi winh t'a Jehová chi'.
Ha winhaj rey Dawid yet' heb' soldado ix yak' ganar heb' filisteo heb', yuj chi' ix kan heb' t'a yalanh smandar winh.

Ix ak'jipax ganar heb' moabita yuj winh. Ix schekanem latz'an heb' winh smasanil t'a sat lu'um, ix yechtan heb' winh yet' jun ch'anh ch'anh. Ha jantak mach skan t'a yol chab' ch'anhil, schami, haxo mach skan t'a yol yik yoxil ch'anhil jun, max chamlaj. Icha chi' ix aj skan heb' moabita chi' t'a yalanh smandar winhaj rey Dawid chi'. Ix chekji yak' tumin heb' t'a junjun ab'il yuj winh.
Anheja' winhaj rey Dawid chi' ix ak'an ganar winhaj Hadad-ezer, ayik wan sb'at winh stok'xikanek' smakb'en b'aj ay ha' niwan Éufrates. Ha winhaj Hadad-ezer chi' yuninal winh winhaj Rehob sreyal Soba.

Ha winhaj rey Dawid chi' ix yaman mil 700 heb' soldado winhaj Hadad-ezer chi', aton heb' ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej yet' 20 mil heb' sb'ey t'a yok. Ix yik'anb'at heb' winh t'a preso. Ix stzepan sch'anhal yok nok' chej ed'jinak karruaje chi' winh, axonhej nok' snheran 100 karruaje ix yaktejkan winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix jawi heb' sirio ay t'a yol yik Damasco yik skolwaj yet' winhaj Hadad-ezer chi', palta ix ak'jipax ganar heb' yuj winhaj rey Dawid chi', 22 mil heb' ix cham yuj winh.

Elanhchamel ix yak'och heb' soldado winhaj rey Dawid chi' t'a yol yik Damasco chi', icha chi' ix aj skan heb' sirio chi' t'a yalanh smandar winh. Ix chekji yak' tumin heb' t'a junjun ab'il. Ha Jehová ix och yet' winh, yuj chi' yalnhej b'aj ix b'at winh yak' owal, ix yak'nhej ganar winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'anpaxkanek' juntzanh maklab' jul-lab' winhaj rey Dawid chi' t'a heb' soldado winhaj Hadad-ezer chi', ayoch oro t'ay, ix yik'ankot winh t'a Jerusalén.
Anhejtona' te niwan pax k'een bronke ix yik'kanek' winh t'a chonhab' Beta yet' t'a Berotai, aton juntzanh chonhab' chi' ay t'a yol smakb'en winhaj Hadad-ezer chi'.
Axo pax winhaj Toi, sreyal Hamat, ayik ix yab'an winh tas ix aj slajwiel masanil heb' soldado winhaj Hadad-ezer yuj winhaj Dawid chi',

ix schekanb'at jun yuninal winh skuchan Joram t'a winh. Ix yak'anpaxb'at k'een plata winh, k'een oro yet' k'een bronke, yuj yak'an stzatzil sk'ol winhaj Dawid chi' winh. Ix yalanpaxb'at wach' lolonel winh t'a winh yujto ix ak'ji ganar winhaj Hadad-ezer yuj winh, yujto yak'nak owal winhaj Toi chi' yet' winhaj Hadad-ezer chi'.
Ha masanil juntzanh k'een ix scha' winhaj Dawid t'a winhaj Toi chi', ix yak'pax k'een winh t'a Jehová yet' k'een oro yet' k'een plata kotnak t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' yak'nak ganar winh:
Aton t'a Edom, t'a Moab, t'a heb' amonita, t'a heb' filisteo, t'a heb' amalekita yet' k'een ix yik'kanek' winh ayik ix yak'an owal winh yet' winhaj Hadad-ezer.
Ix te b'inaj wal winhaj rey Dawid chi' sik'lab'il ayik ix meltzajxi winh t'a owal yet' heb' edomita, 18 mil heb' ix cham yuj winh t'a jun Spanhanil Atz'am Atz'am.

Elanhchamel ix yak'och heb' soldado winhaj Dawid chi' stanhwej Edom. Masanil heb' aj Edom chi', ix kan heb' t'a yalanh smandar winh. Ha Jehová ix ochnhej yet' winh t'a owal chi', yuj chi' yalnhej b'ajtil sb'at winh yak' owal, syak'nhej ganar winh.
Ha winhaj Dawid chi', ix yak' reyal winh t'a masanil heb' chonhab' israel t'a stojolal yet' t'a swach'ilal.
Ha heb' ix ak'an yajalil yet' winh, aton heb' tik: Vinhaj Joab yune' ix Sarwia, yajal winh t'a heb' soldado smasanil, winhaj Josafat yuninal winhaj Ahilud, tz'ib'um yaj winh t'a winh rey chi'.
Vinhaj Sadoc yuninal winhaj Ahitob yet' winhaj Ahimelec yuninal winhaj Abiatar, sat sakerdote yaj heb' winh. Axo winhaj Seraías stz'ib'an yab'ixal tastak sk'ulej winh rey chi' t'a stzolal.
Axo pax winhaj Benaía yuninal winhaj Joiada, yajal yaj winh t'a heb' soldado stanhwan winh rey chi', aton heb' kereteo yet' heb' peleteo, haxo heb' yuninal winhaj rey Dawid chi', sat yajal yaj heb'.
Ix sk'anb'anek' winhaj rey Dawid chi' tato ayto junokxo yinhtilal winhaj Saúl ixto kani, yik syak'an swach'k'olal winh t'ay yuj swach'k'olal winhaj Jonatán yak'nak t'a winh.

Ay jun winh schekab' winhaj Saúl skuch Siba, ix awtajkot winh t'a yichanh winhaj rey Dawid chi'. Axo yik ix jawi winh, ix sk'anb'an winh rey chi' t'a winh icha tik: --¿A ach am tik tza kuch Siba? xchi winh t'a winh. --I', a in ton mamin rey, xchi winh.

Ix sk'anb'an winh rey chi' t'a winh icha tik: --¿Manhxa am wal junok yinhtilal winhaj Saúl ayeq'ui, yik tzin ch'ox in wach'k'olal t'ay icha ix wutej wak'an in ti' t'a yichanh Jehová? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Siba chi': --Aytocan jun winh yuninal winhaj Jonatán, chuklaj yok winh schab'il, xchi winh.
--¿B'ajtil ay winh? xchi winhaj Dawid chi'. --Ha t'a spat winhaj Maquir yuninal winhaj Amiel t'a Lodebar, ata' ayek' winh, xchi winhaj Siba chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj rey Dawid chi' to b'at ik'jikot winhaj Mefi-boset yuninal winhaj Jonatán chi' winh yixchiquin winhaj Saúl chi'. Ayic ix jawi winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi', ix em nhojan winh t'a sat lu'um. Ix yalan winhaj Dawid chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Mefi-boset, xchi winh. --Tik ayin mamin rey, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Dawid chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Manh ach xiwok, wach' ol wutej in b'a t'ayach yuj b'aj xajan yilnak in winhaj Jonatán winh a mam. Ol wak'xikan masanil lum sluum winh a mam icham aj Saúl t'ayach. Ol ach wanhej wed' t'a in mexa, xchi winh.
Ix em nhojan winhaj Mefi-boset chi', ix yalan winh: --Mamin rey, ¿tas wal yuj tz'ok' a k'ol t'ayin? Ha in a chekab' in tik lajan in icha junok nok' chamnak tz'i', xchi winh.

Ix awtajxi winhaj Siba yuj winh rey chi', aton winh schekab'kan winhaj Saúl, ix yalan winh t'a winh icha tik: --Tik wal swak'xikan masanil tastak yik winh a patrón yet' yuninal t'a winh yixchiquin winh tik.

Ha ach tik yet' masanil heb' uninal yet' masanil heb' a chekab', ol ex munlaj t'a sat lum sluum winh chi'. Masanil tas ol el t'a sat lu'um, tza molb'ej t'a yol junok spatil, yik wach' tz'och yopisio yuj heb' yuninal winhaj Mefi-boset tik, palta haxo winh jun, ol wanhej winh wed'ok, xchi winh rey chi' t'a winh. Olajunhwanh yuninal winhaj Siba chi', 20 heb' schekab' winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Siba chi' t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: --Masanil tas tza chek in k'ulej tik, ol in k'anab'ajej, xchi winh. Ha winhaj Mefi-boset chi', junjun k'u swa winh yet' winh rey chi', icha wal yuninal winh ix yutej winh.
Ay jun yuninal winhaj Mefi-boset chi' yuneto skuchan Micaía. Masanil mach ayek' t'a spat winhaj Siba chi', schekab' winhaj Mefi-boset chi' yaj heb'.
Ha winhaj Mefi-boset chi', chuklaj yok winh schab'il, ha t'a Jerusalén ayek' winh yujto ata' swa winh yet' winhaj rey Dawid chi'.
Ayic toxo ix ek' jun pekti’, ix cham winhaj Nahas, sreyal heb' amonita, haxo winh yuninal winh skuchan Hanún ix ochkan reyal.

Ix sna' winhaj rey Dawid chi' to yowalil sch'ox swach'k'olal winh t'a winhaj Hanún chi', yujto sch'oxnak swach'k'olal winh smam winh t'a winh. Yuj chi' ix schekb'at juntzanh schekab' winh t'a winhaj Hanún chi' yik syak'an sniwanil sk'ool winh yuj schamel smam chi'. Palta ayik ix k'och heb' chekab' t'a schonhab' heb' amonita chi',

a heb' winh yajal yaj t'a chonhab' chi', ix yal heb' winh t'a winhaj Hanún chi': Mamin rey, ¿tom tzak'och t'a a k'ool to niwan yelk'och winh a mam chi' t'a yol sat winhaj rey Dawid chi', yuj chi' ix schekkot juntzanh winak tik winh yik syak' sniwanil a k'ool heb'? Maay. Ix chekjikot heb' yuj winh yik tzul yil heb' tas yaj ko chonhab' tik, yik tzul satanel heb', xchi heb' t'a winh.

Yuj chi', ix schekan winhaj Hanún chi' yamjok heb' schekab' winhaj rey Dawid chi', ix joxjiel xil sti' heb' t'a jun pak'anh spak'ul sti', ix poljiel yoktak sti' spichul heb' masanto ix k'eul t'a sti' syoop heb', ix lajwi chi' ix schekan pax heb' winh.

Ayic ix yab'an winhaj rey Dawid chi' tas ix aj heb', ix chekjib'at schaumal heb' yuj winh, yujto te q'uixwelal ix utaj heb', ix alji t'a heb' to skan heb' t'a Jericó masanto sq'uib'xi xil sti' heb' chi', ichato chi' syal smeltzaj pax ta heb'.

Axo heb' amonita chi', ix nachajel yuj heb' to chuk ix kan heb' t'a winhaj rey Dawid chi', yuj chi' 20 mil heb' soldado yik Siria t'a yol yik Bet-rehob yet' t'a yol yik Soba ix stup heb'. Ix kotpax mil heb' soldado winh sreyal Maaca yet' 12 mil heb' soldado aj Is-tob.
Axo ix yab'an jun chi' winhaj rey Dawid chi', ix schekanb'at winhaj Joab winh yet' heb' soldado chi'.
Ix elta heb' amonita chi' t'a sti' schonhab', ix sb'oanoch sb'a heb' t'a owal ta', haxo heb' soldado ix tupji yik skot yak' owal chi', najat ix sb'opaxem sb'a heb' t'a stiel chonhab' chi'.

Ayic ix yilan winhaj Joab chi' to ay jun makan heb' soldado t'a yichanh winh, ay pax junxo makan heb' t'a spatik winh, ix sik'anel heb' soldado winh, aton heb' te jelan t'a owal, yik syak'an owal heb' yet' heb' sirio chi'.
Axo juntzanhxo heb' soldado, ix yak'och winh t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Abisai winh yuk'tak winh, yik sb'at heb' yak' owal yet' heb' amonita chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Joab chi' t'a winh yuk'tak chi' icha tik: Tato a heb' sirio chi' wan in yak'an ganar, tzach kot in a kolo'. Tato a heb' amonita chi' wan ach yak'an ganar jun, a inxo ol in b'at ach in kolo'.
Cak' quip, ko tek'b'ej ko b'a yuj ko kolan ko chonhab' a onh schonhab' onh ko Diosal tik. Elokab'k'och tas wach' snib'ej Jehová, xchi winhaj Joab chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj Joab chi' yet' heb' soldado yak' owal yet' heb' sirio chi', haxo ix aji, ix el lemnaj heb' t'a yichanh winh.

Ayic ix yilan heb' amonita to toxo ix el lemnaj heb' sirio chi', ix elpax lemnaj heb' t'a yichanh winhaj Abisai, ix och heb' skol sb'ha t'a yol schonhab' chi'. Yuj chi' ix och waan winhaj Joab chi' yak'an owal yet' heb' amonita chi', ix meltzajkot winh t'a Jerusalén.
Ayic ix yilan heb' sirio chi' to ix ak'ji ganar heb' yuj heb' israel, ix smolb'anxi sb'a heb'.

Ix awtajkot heb' sirio chi' yuj winhaj rey Hadad-ezer, aton heb' ay t'a junxo sk'axepalek' ha' Éufrates, ix k'och heb' t'a chonhab' Helam. Ha winhaj Sobac b'ab'el t'a yichanh heb', aton winh yajal t'a heb' soldado yik winhaj rey Hadad-ezer chi'.

Palta ix alchajpax juntzanh tik t'a winhaj rey Dawid, yuj chi' ix smolb'ej masanil heb' soldado yik Israel winh, ix ek' heb' t'a sk'axepal ha' Jordán, ix k'och heb' t'a Helam. Ata' ix stek'b'ej sb'a heb' sirio chi' yak'an owal yet' heb' israel chi'.

Axo ix aji, ix el lemnaj heb' sirio chi' t'a yichanh winhaj rey Dawid chi' yet' heb' israel. 40 mil soldado ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej yet' pax 700 heb' ayoch t'a yol karruaje ix smilcham heb' soldado yik Israel chi'. Ix champax winhaj Sobac yajalil heb' soldado sirio yuj heb'.

Ayic ix yilan masanil heb' rey ayoch yet' winhaj rey Hadad-ezer chi' to toxo ix ak'ji ganar heb' yuj heb' israel chi', ix yak'anoch sb'a heb' t'a junk'olal yet' heb' israel chi', yuj chi' ix kanxonhej heb' t'a yalanh smandar winhaj rey Dawid chi'. Atax ta' ix xiwkank'e heb' sirio chi', majxo yak'xiochlaj sb'a heb' skolwaj yet' heb' amonita chi'.

Ha t'a junxo ab'il, t'a stiempoal sb'at heb' rey t'a owal, ix chekjib'at winhaj Joab yuj winhaj rey Dawid yet' masanil heb' yajalil heb' soldado yet' masanil heb' soldado israel t'a owal. Ix satanel heb' amonita heb', ix yoyan sb'a heb' t'a spatik chonhab' Rabá. Maj b'atlaj winh rey chi' yet' heb', ix kan winh t'a Jerusalén.

Ha t'a jun yemk'ualil, ix k'e waan winhaj rey Dawid chi' t'a sat sch'at, ix k'e winh matz'anel t'a spanhanil yib'anh spat. Ayic ayek' winh ta', ix yilanb'at jun ix ix winh, wan sb'ikan sb'a ix, te wach' yilji ix ix yil winh.
Elanhchamel ix schekb'at winh k'anb'ajek'ok mach jun ix ix chi', haxo ix alchaj t'a winh to a ix Betsabé yisil winhaj Eliam, yetb'eyum winhaj Urías heteo.
Elanhchamel ix schekb'at schekab' winh yik b'at ik'jokkot ix, ix way winh yet' ix. Ixlajwi chi', ix sakb'itan sb'a ix, ix pax ix t'a spat.
Axo ix aji, ix skuchkanoch yune' ix, yuj chi' elanhchamel ix yalb'at ix yab' winhaj rey Dawid chi'.
Ayic ix yab'an winh icha chi', ix yalanb'at winh t'a winhaj Joab to spaxta winhaj Urías chi' t'a owal. Ix sk'anab'ajan winhaj Joab tas ix yal winh chi'.
Axo ix jawi winhaj Urías sch'ox sb'ha t'a yichanh winh rey chi', ix sk'anb'an winh tato wach' sk'ol winhaj Joab yet' heb' soldado, chajtil pax yak'an owal.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Urías chi' icha tik: Ixic, b'at ik' ip, tzach way t'a a pat, xchi winh t'a winh. Ixnhej wal elta winh t'a yol spalakio winh rey chi', ix b'at ak'jikan swael winh, te wach' icha swael winh rey.
Palta maj b'atlaj winh t'a spat chi'. Ix waykan winh yet' heb' soldado stanhwan palakio chi'.

Axo t'a junxo k'u, ix alji t'a winh rey chi' to maj b'at waylaj winhaj Urías chi' t'a spat t'a jun ak'wal chi'. Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'ej winh rey chi' t'a winh: --¿Tas yuj maj xid' ach way t'a a pat, ina to ayxotax a b'atkani? xchi winh rey chi' t'a winh.

Ix tak'wi winh: --Max yal-laj in komon b'at t'a in pat yik tzin wa'i, tzin waypax yet' ix wetb'eyum yakb'an a te' skaxail strato Jehová yet' heb' wetsoldadoal yik Israel yet' heb' yik Judá, a te' xiltak te' ayk'e t'a yib'anh heb', icha pax chi' winh wajalil winhaj Joab yet' heb' yetyajalil, ha t'a ak'lik b'aj sway heb'. Mamin rey, max yal-laj in k'ol to wach' b'aj ol in wayok, xchi winhaj Urías chi'.
Ix yalan winhaj Dawid chi' t'a winh: --Cananh t'a junxo ak'wal tik, haxo k'ik'an tzach b'ati, xchi winh t'a winh. Ichato chi' ix kan winhaj Urías chi' t'a junxo ak'wal chi' t'a Jerusalén.

Ix yawtej winh winh rey chi' wael yet'ok, ix yak'an wino winh yuk'ej winh. Ix k'e t'a sjolom winhaj Urías chi', palta manh yujok chi' ix b'at winh wayanh t'a spat chi', ata' ix wayxikan winh yet' heb' soldado junelxo.
Axo ix q'uinhib'i t'a junxo k'u, ix stz'ib'anb'at jun karta winhaj rey Dawid chi' t'a winhaj Joab, ix schekan winh yik'b'at ch'anh winhaj Urías chi'.
Ix yalanb'at winh t'a ch'anh icha tik: Tzak'och winhaj Urías tik t'a yichanh b'aj te ow yak'an owal, tzex el t'a stz'ey winh yik wach' scham winh, xchib'at winh.
Yuj chi', ayik ix yoyan sb'a winhaj Joab chi' yet' heb' soldado t'a spatik jun chonhab' chi', a b'aj ayek' heb' ajk'ol te jelan, ata' ix ak'jioch winhaj Urías chi' yuj winhaj Joab chi'.

Axo yik ix elta heb' ajk'ol chi' t'a yol schonhab', ix yak'an owal heb' yet' heb' soldado winhaj Joab chi'. Ay jaywanh heb' soldado winhaj Dawid chi' ix chami, ha t'a skal heb' ix cham winhaj Urías chi'.
Ix yak'ankot jun winh schekab' winhaj Joab chi' t'a winhaj rey Dawid yik syalani chajtil ix aj yoch owal chi'.
Ix yalan winh t'a winh schekab' chi': Ayic slajwi alan t'a winh rey tas ix aj yoch owal tik,
talaj skot yowal winh, syalan winh: ¿Tas yuj ix ex te och t'a tz'ey jun chonhab' chi'? ¿Tom manh eyojtakok to a heb' ayk'e t'a yib'anh muro syal yaktanemta junok tas heb' t'a eyib'anh?

¿Tom manh eyojtakok yab'ixal jun ix ix t'a Tebes, ix yaktejemta jun k'een k'een yik molino ix t'a sjolom winhaj Abimelec yuninal winhaj Jerobaal? ¿Tas yuj ix he te nitzejoch he b'a? ta xchi winh, tzalani to ix champax winhaj Urías heteo, xchi winhaj Joab chi'.
Ix kot jun winh chekab' chi', ix jawi winh t'a yichanh winhaj rey Dawid chi', ix yalan winh masanil tas ix yalkot winhaj Joab chi'.

Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Te ow ix aj yelta heb' ajk'ol chi' t'ayonh. Ijan wal ix onh yak' ganar heb', palta ix ko tek'b'ej ko b'a ko pechan meltzaj heb', masanto ix ochxikan heb' t'a yol schonhab' chi'.
Ha t'a yib'anh muro ix julwajkot heb' winh ajk'ol chi' t'a heb' a chekab', yuj chi' ix cham jaywanh heb' winh soldado, ix champax winhaj Urías heteo, xchi jun winh chekab' chi'.

Ix yalan winh rey t'a jun winh chekab' chi': --Al t'a winhaj Joab chi' to max kuslaj winh yuj jun chi'. Toxonton icha chi' t'a owal tik, ay mach schami. Yak'okab' yip winh yak'an owal t'a jun chonhab' chi', masanto syal satel heb' anima chi' yuj winh, xa chi t'a winh. Icha chi' tz'aj iptzitan winhaj Joab chi', xchi winhaj rey Dawid chi' t'a jun winh chekab' chi'.
Ayic ix yab'an ix yetb'eyum winhaj Urías to toxo ix cham winh yetb'eyum ix chi', ix och ix t'a kusk'olal yuj winh.

Ayic ix lajwi yek' skusk'olal ix, icha sb'eyb'al heb', ix b'at chekchaj ik'jikot ix t'a spat yuj winhaj rey Dawid chi', ix och ix yetb'eyumok winh. Ix alji jun yune' ix. Palta a jun tas ix sk'ulej winh chi', maj schalaj sk'ol Jehová.

Axo Jehová ix chekankot winhaj Natán t'a winhaj Dawid chi'. Ayic ix k'och winh t'a yichanh winh, ix yalan jun ab'ix tik winh t'a winh: --Ha t'a jun chonhab', ay chawanh heb' winh winak: Ay jun winh te b'eyum, ay pax junxo winh te meb'a'.
Ha winh b'eyum chi', te ay nok' skalnel winh yet' nok' swakax.

Axo pax winh meb'a' chi' jun, junnhej pitanh tzun skalnel winh manb'il yuj. A' winh ix q'uib'tzitan nok'. Ha t'a yol spat winh ix q'uib' nok' yet' heb' yuninal. Ha tas swa winh, tas yuk' winh, a chi' swa nok', syuk' nok'. Schelway nok' winh, te xajan nok' yuj winh. Ichato yisil nok' winh.

Ay jun k'u, ay jun winh tonhej sb'eyeq'ui, ix ek' winh yak' spaxyal winh b'eyum chi'. Ha winh b'eyum chi', maj syamlaj junok nok' skalnel winh, ma junok nok' swakax winh yik syak'an schi winh paxyalwum chi', te ya yel nok' yuj winh. Axo jun pitanh nok' yik winh meb'a' chi' ix b'at yak' ik'jokkot winh. Ha nok' ix yak' winh schi jun winh paxyalwum chi', xchi winhaj Natán chi' t'a winhaj rey Dawid chi'.
Ix kot wal yowal winhaj rey Dawid chi', ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Natán chi': --D'a yichanh Jehová Dios swala', a jun winh icha chi' ix sk'ulej, smoj wal scham winh.
Yowalil syak' chanhwanhok nok' winh sk'exulok nok' yune' kalnel chi', yujto a jun winh winak chi' malaj wal jab'ok yok'elk'olal winh t'a yetanimail, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Natán chi': --Ha jun winh chi', a ach toni. Icha tik yalan Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik t'ayach: Ha in ix ach in sik'och sreyalok Israel, ix ach in kolanel t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Saúl.
Ix wak' spat yet' heb' ix yetb'eyum winh ajalil chi' t'ayach, ix ach wak'anoch sreyalok chonhab' Israel yet' Judá. Tato jab'nhej juntzanh chi' tzab'i, tzato yal wak'an nanhalokxo t'ayach.
¿Tas yuj ix a patiquejel in cheknab'il, ix a k'ulej tas to max scha in k'ool? Ix a milcham winhaj Urías heteo yet' k'een yespada heb' amonita. Ix ik'ankan ix yetb'eyum winh chi'.
Yuj chi' aynhej mach ol miljokcham t'a skal inhtilal, yujto ix in a patiquejeli, ix ik'ankan ix yetb'eyum winhaj Urías heteo.

Ha in Jehová in swala': Ol wak'och yaelal t'a ib'anh. Ha yaelal chi', ha t'a skal heb' uninal ol elta, t'a wal ichanh ol wik'elta heb' ix etb'eyum, ol wak'an heb' ix t'a junok winh uninal, ol way winh yet' heb' ix t'a k'ualil t'a yichanh anima.
Ha ach tik, elk'altak ix a k'ulej, a inxo tik, t'a wal sakil k'inal t'a k'ualil ol in ch'oxel t'a yichanh chonhab' Israel, xchi Jehová, xchi winhaj Natán chi'.

Ix schaan smulok winhaj rey Dawid t'a yichanh winhaj Natán chi', ix yalan winh: --D'a wal yel, ix och in mul t'a Jehová, xchi winh. Ix yalanpax winhaj Natán chi': --Yel ton tzala', palta ix ak'ji lajwok a mul chi' yuj Jehová, yuj chi' manhxo ol ach chamlaj.
Palta a yuj tas ix a k'ulej chi', tz'alji chukal lolonel t'a Jehová yuj heb' ajk'ol yajoch t'ay, yuj chi' ol cham jun uninal toto ix alji chi', xchi winhaj Natán chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix pax winhaj Natán chi' t'a spat. Axo Jehová, ix ak'anoch syaelal jun yuninal winhaj Dawid chi' yet' ix yetb'eyumkan winhaj Urías chi'.
Yuj chi', ix och ijan winh sk'anan t'a Jehová to sb'oxi sk'ol winh unin chi'. Ix och winh t'a tzek'ojk'olal, ix kannhej telan winh t'a sat lu'um t'a junjun ak'wal.

Ha jantak heb' winh yichamtak winaquil chonhab' smunlaj yet' winh, tz'och ijan heb' winh stewi to sk'e waan winh t'a sat lum chi', palta maxtzak yal-laj sk'ol winh, max b'at walaj winh yet' heb' winh.

Axo t'a yuquil k'ual syamchaj winh unin chi' yuj ilya chi', ix chami. Ix te xiw heb' winh smunlajum winh rey chi' yalan t'ay, yujto sna heb': Ina ayik pitzanto winh unin chi', maj scha yab' winh tas ix kala', okxom wal tiknaik. Tato skal t'a winh to toxo ix chami, tas am ol sk'ulok winh, xchi heb' winh.

Ix yab'an winhaj rey Dawid chi' ayik sajson heb' winh sloloni, ix snaanel winh to toxo ix cham winh unin chi', yuj chi' ix sk'anb'an winh: --¿Tom toxo ix chami? xchi winh. --Toxo ix cham mamin rey, xchi heb' winh.

Ayic ix yab'an winh icha chi', ix k'e waan winh t'a sat lu'um chi', ix sb'ikanel sb'a winh, ix yak'ank'e yanhal xil sjolom winh, ix sk'exanel spichul winh, ix och winh ejmelal t'a yol skajnub' Jehová. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at sk'anan wa sb'a winh t'a yol spat.

Ix sk'anb'an heb' winh smunlajwum winh chi' t'ay: --Mamin rey, ¿tas wal yuj icha tik tza k'ulej? Ayic pitzanto jun uninal chi', manh jab'ok syal a k'ol tzach wa'i, tzach ok' yuj. Axo tiknaik toxo ix chami, tzach k'e waan, tzach wa'i, xchi heb' winh t'a winh.
Ix tak'wi winh t'a heb' winh: --Ayic pitzanto winh unin chi', tzin och t'a tzek'ojk'olal, tzin oq'ui, a in naani talaj tzato ok' sk'ol Jehová t'ayin.
Axo pax tiknaik, ¿tasto wal yuj tzin och t'a tzek'ojk'olal? ¿Tom olto pitzwok winh? Manhxa b'ak'uinh ol jax winh t'ayin, anhej to a in ol in b'at b'aj ix k'och winh chi', xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an sniwanil sk'ol ix Betsabé winhaj Dawid chi', ix way winh yet' ix, ix skuchanoch yune' ix. Ix alji junxo yune' ix, Salomón ix yak' ix b'iej. Te xajan ix aj jun unin chi' yuj Jehová.
Ix schekanb'at winhaj Natán Jehová yal t'a winhaj rey Dawid chi' to xajan jun unin chi' yuj. Yuj chi' Jedidías ix sb'iej jun unin chi' yuj Jehová.
Yakb'an chi', a winhaj Joab ix ak'an owal yet' heb' amonita t'a Rabá. Ayic wanxo yak'an ganar winh yoch t'a yol jun chonhab' chi',
ix yalankot winh t'a winhaj rey Dawid chi' icha tik: Vanxo woch t'a yol chonhab' Rabá. Ha jun kuartel b'aj ay heb' stanhwan ha ha' sk'anchaj t'a chonhab' tik, ayxo och t'a yol in k'ab'.

Yuj chi', mamin rey, molb'ej masanil heb' soldado aykan ed'ok, tzach kot yet' heb' ak' owal t'a jun chonhab' tik yik tzak'an ganar. Q'uinalok a in swak' ganar jun chonhab' tik, a in am tzin b'inajkan t'ay, xchikot winhaj Joab chi'.
Ix smolb'an masanil heb' soldado winh rey chi', ix b'at winh yak' owal t'a chonhab' Rabá chi'. Ix yak'an ganar winh yik'ankani.

Ix yik'anek' skorona winh sreyal heb' amonita chi' winh. Ix yak'ank'e heb' t'a sjolom winh. Ay jun k'een k'een te karo stojol ayoch t'ay. Ha jun korona chi', te al, ay am oxeok arroba yalil. Tzijtumto pax tastak te ay stojol ix yik'ek' winhaj Dawid chi' t'a jun chonhab' chi'.

Axo heb' anima ixto kani, ix ik'jielta heb' yuj winh, ix ak'jioch heb' t'a munlajel ya, icha t'a k'een sierra, k'een piocha yet' pax k'een ch'akab'. Ix ak'jipaxoch heb' t'a mukoj ladrillo t'a horno. Anheja' icha pax chi' ix aj masanil heb' ay t'a juntzanhxo schonhab' heb' amonita yuj winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix meltzaj winh yet' masanil heb' soldado t'a Jerusalén.

Ha winhaj Absalón yuninal winhaj rey Dawid, ay jun ix yanab' winh skuch Tamar, te wach' yilji ix. Axo ix aji, a winhaj Amnón yuninal pax winhaj rey Dawid chi', ix te kan snib'ej winh t'a ix Tamar schab'il yanab', yuj chi' ix te chukb'i sk'ol winh yuj snaub'tanhan ix. Te ayoch yilumal ix yujto kob'esto ix, yuj chi' ix sna winhaj Amnón chi' to ajaltak sk'uman ix winh.
Palta ay jun winh yamigo winh skuchan Jonadab, yuninal winhaj Simea yuk'tak winhaj Dawid chi', te jelan winh t'a chukal.

Ay jun k'u ix sk'anb'ej winh t'a winhaj Amnón chi': --Ach yuninal rey, ¿tas tzach ik'ani? ¿Tas yuj junjun k'u tzach te tz'onb'i yuj kusk'olal? Al t'ayin tas tzach ik'ani, xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Amnón chi': --Ste kan wal in gana t'a ix Tamar, yanab' winh schab'il wuk'tak aj Absalón, xchi winh.

Axo ix yalan winhaj Jonadab chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Ha tiknaik, ek'anh jichan t'a a ch'at, tza tz'akan penaayax a b'a. Ayic ol jawok winh a mam ach yila', tzal t'a winh icha tik: Tzin tewi t'ayach to tza chekkot ix Tamar ix wanab', yik syak' jab'ok in wael ix, aokab' ix sb'oani, yik wach' ol wila'', ol in waani, ol in chaan t'a ix, xa chi t'a winh, xchi winh.

Ix ek' jichan winhaj Amnón chi' t'a sch'at, ix stz'akan penaayax sb'a winh. Ayic ix k'och winh rey chi' yil winh, ix yal winh icha tik: --Tzin tewi t'ayach to skot ix wanab' Tamar t'a tik, sb'oan chab'ok in pan ix, tzul yak'ankan ix t'ayin, xchi winh t'a winh rey chi'.
Yuj chi' ix chekjib'at ix yuj winhaj rey Dawid chi', ix yalan winh t'a ix: --Ixic t'a spat winhaj Amnón a nulej, b'at a b'oan jab'ok tas swa winh, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix b'at ix Tamar t'a spat winh snulej chi', haxo ix k'och ix, jichan ek' winh. Q'uelanoch winh t'a ix, ix sb'oan ixim pan chi' ix.

Ix yak'an k'anb'ok ixim ix t'a yol xalten, ix yik'anelta ix t'a yol xalten chi', palta haxo winhaj Amnón chi' maj yal-laj sk'ol winh ix wa'i, ix yalan winh: Elanhec t'a tik he masanil, xchi winh. Ix elta heb', manhxalaj junok mach ix kani.

Ayic toxo ix elta heb' chi' smasanil t'a patik pat chi', ix yalan winh t'a ix Tamar chi' icha tik: --Ik'kot in wael chi' b'aj tzin way tik, xchi winh t'a ix. Ix yik'anb'at ixim pan chi' ix t'a winh snulej chi' t'a sch'at.
Axo yik ix k'och ix t'a stz'ey winh yet' swael chi', ix och lak'naj winh t'a ix, ix yalan winh: --Cotanh ach wanab', wayanh wed'ok, xchi winh t'a ix.
Ix tak'wi ix t'a winh: --Maay ach in nulej, manh in ak' pural, yujto a jun tik manh smojok yuji t'a ko kal a onh israel onh tik, te q'uixwelal ol aj jun tik.

Nato nab'i ¿tas ol in k'ulej yuj jun in q'uixwelal tik? Anhejtona' a ach tik icha junok quistal ol ach ajkan t'a skal ko chonhab' tik. Ha tiknaik, swal t'ayach to tzal t'a winh rey, a winh ol in ak'an t'ayach etb'eyumok, xchi ix.
Palta majxo schalaj yab' winh tas ix yal ix chi'. Yujto te ay yip winh t'a yichanh ix, yuj chi' ix yak'an pural ix winh yixtani.

Ayic ix lajwi yixtan ix winh, te chuklaj ix aj yilanoch ix winh, t'a yichanh ix aj skan snib'ej winh t'a ix t'a sb'ab'elal, yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a ix icha tik: --Q'ueanh waan, elanh t'a tik t'a elanhchamel, xchi winh t'a ix.
Palta ix tak'wi ix: --Maay ach in nulej, tato tzin a pechel t'a tik tiknaik, yelxo te chuk t'a yichanh tas ix in utej tik, xchi ix. Palta majxo schalaj yab' winh.
Axo ix aji, ix yawtankot winh schekab' winh, ix yalan winh: --Pechel jun ix ix tik t'a tik, wach' tzutej a makan te' pat chi', xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix pechjielta ix yuj winh schekab' winh chi', wach' ix yutej winh smakan sti' te' pat chi'. Ha ix Tamar chi', ayoch jun spichul ix te wach' yuj, aton syak'och heb' ix kob'estak yisil rey.
Ix yak'ank'e k'een tik'aq'uil taanh ix t'a sjolom, ix snhik'chitanb'at spichul ix ayoch yuj, ix yak'anoch sk'ab' ix t'a sat, te chaanh ix ok' ix sb'at t'a yoltak b'e.

Ix sk'anb'an winh snulej ix skuchan Absalón t'ay: --¿Tom ach yixtej winh a nulej aj Amnón chi'? Tato icha chi' ach wanab', emanh numan b'ela. Mokab' ach te ok' yuj ilk'olal yuj jun chi', yujto a nulej winh, xchi winh t'a ix. Yuj chi' ix kan ix t'a spat winh snulej chi'. Te kusk'olal ix ajkan ix.
Ayic ix yab'an winhaj rey Dawid masanil tas ix uji chi', ix kot wal yowal winh sik'lab'il.
Axo winhaj Absalón chi', malaj tas ix yal winh t'a winhaj Amnón chi', wach'chom ste chichon sk'ol winh t'a winh yuj b'aj ix ixtaj ix yanab' chi'.

Schab'ilxo ab'il chi', a heb' winh schekab' winhaj Absalón chi', sjoxwi kalnel heb' winh t'a Baal-hazor, t'a slak'anil schonhab' heb' aj Efraín. Ix yawtan masanil heb' winh yuninal winh rey chi' winhaj Absalón chi' t'a jun niwan wael.

Ix b'at yalan winh t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, a tiknaik a heb' winh in chekab' wan sjoxan nok' in kalnel heb' winh. Tzin nib'ej, tzach b'at wed'ok yet' masanil heb' etyajalil, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winh rey chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Maay ach wuninal, max yal-laj ko b'at ko masanil ed'ok. Tekan niwan tas b'at ko lajeli, xchi winh. Ix och wal tean winhaj Absalón chi' t'a winh, palta maj yal-laj sk'ol winh ix b'ati, anhej wach' lolonel ix yal winh t'a winh.

Ix yalanxi winhaj Absalón chi': --Tato wal yel max yal-laj a b'ati, elokab' t'a a k'ol a chaanb'at winh wuk'tak aj Amnón wed'ok, xchi winh. --¿Tas yuj tza nib'ej sb'at winh uk'tak aj Amnón chi' ed'ok? xchi winhaj rey Dawid chi' t'a winh.
Ix och wal tean winhaj Absalón chi' t'a winh, yuj chi' ix schekb'at winhaj Amnón chi' winh yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh yuk'tak.

Ayic mantzak ochlaj wael chi', ix yalan winhaj Absalón chi' t'a heb' winh schekab': Scham wal eyilani ayik toxo ix k'e anh t'a sjolom winhaj Amnón chi', ol walan t'ayex to tze milcham winh. Manh ex xiwok, yujto a in swala', yuj chi' tze tek'b'ej he b'a he milancham winh, xchi winh.

Ix sk'anab'ajej heb' winh tas ix yal winh, ix smilcham winhaj Amnón chi' heb' winh. Ayic ix yilan masanil heb' winh yuninal winh rey chi', ix k'e somnaj heb' winh, ix laj k'e heb' winh t'a yib'anh nok' smula, ix b'at heb' winh elelal.
Ayic ayto och heb' winh t'a yol b'e, ix k'och spekal t'a winhaj rey Dawid to toxo ix cham masanil heb' yuninal winh yuj winhaj Absalón, manhxo junok heb' winh ixto kani.

Yuj chi' ix k'e juknaj winh, ix snhik'chitanb'at spichul winh, ix sjulanek' telan sb'a winh t'a sat lu'um yuj kusk'olal. Axo masanil heb' yetyajalil winh ayek' yet'ok, ix snhik'chitejpaxb'at spichul heb'.

Palta a winhaj Jonadab yuninal winhaj Simea, yuk'tak winhaj rey Dawid chi', ix yal winh t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, manh a na' icha chi'. Maj chamlaj heb' winh uninal chi' smasanil, anhej winhaj Amnón ix chami, yujto icha chi' ix aj snaan winhaj Absalón t'a spatik winh, yiktax ix yixtan ix Tamar winh.
Yuj chi' manh a na' to masanil heb' winh uninal ix chami, palta anhej winhaj Amnón ix chami, xchi winh.

Yakb'an chi' ix b'at winhaj Absalón chi' elelal. Ay jun winh quelem ayk'e t'a yib'anh smuroal chonhab' chi' yik smaklani, ix k'e k'elnaj winh, ix yilan winh to ay juntzanh anima tz'emta t'a pak'an t'a sat witz t'a sb'eal Horonaim, yuj chi' ix yalb'at winh t'a winh rey chi'.
Ix yalan winhaj Jonadab t'a winh rey chi': --Mamin rey, wan sjawi heb' winh uninal icha ix aj walan a in a chekab' in tik, xchi winh.
Ato wal slajwi yalan winhaj Jonadab chi' ix k'och heb' winh yuninal winh rey chi'. Ayic ix k'och heb' winh, ix k'e sjaj heb' winh yoq'ui, ix te ok'pax winh rey chi' yet' heb' yetyajalil.

Axo winhaj Absalón chi', ix b'atkan winh elelal. Ha t'a winhaj Talmai yuninal winhaj Amiud sreyal Gesur ix k'ochkan winh. Oxe' ab'il ix kan winh ta'. Axo pax winhaj rey Dawid chi', junjun k'u ix ok' winh yuj schamel winh yuninal.
Ayic toxo ix ek'b'at skusk'olal winh chi' jun, snib'ej winh sb'at yil winhaj Absalón chi'.
Ha winhaj Joab yune' ix Sarwia yojtak winh to ste kus winh rey yuj winhaj Absalón.

Yuj chi' ix b'at schek winh ik'jokkot jun ix ix te jelan spensar kajan t'a Tecoa. Ix yalan winh t'a ix icha tik: Tz'ak kus wal a b'a, tzak'anoch pichul yik kusk'olal. Manh ak'och perfume t'ayach. Icha wal junok ix ix to ayxo syamanoch yok' yuj junok chamnak, icha chi' tzutej a b'a.
Slajwi chi' ol alan t'a yichanh winh rey tas ol wal tik t'ayach, xchi winh t'a ix. Ix yalan winhaj Joab chi' tas ol yutok ix yalani.
Ix b'at ix t'a yichanh winh rey chi', ix em nhojan ix t'a sat lu'um yuj sch'oxanel yemnaquilal ix t'a winh, ix yalan ix: --Mamin rey, kolwajanh wed'ok, xchi ix.
--¿Tas tzach ik'ani? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi ix: --Mamin rey, a in tik chamnakxo winh wetb'eyum.
Anhej chawanh wune' ay. Ay junel ix yak' owal heb' winh t'a kaltak te'. Yujto malaj mach ix pojan heb' winh, yuj chi' ay jun winh ix miljicham yuj winh yuk'tak chi'.

Axo tiknaik masanil heb' in k'ab' wok smeltzajoch ajk'olal t'ayin, snib'ej heb' swak'och winh ix milancham winh yuk'tak chi' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' yik smilancham winh heb' yuj schamel winh yuk'tak chi'. Icha chi' snib'ej heb' yik satkanel winh ay yalan yik yik'ankan smakb'en smam chi'. Tato icha chi', manhxa mach swak'och yipok in k'ool, tzam satel masanil yinhtilal winh wetb'eyum, manhxa am b'aj sb'inajkan winh, xchi ix.
Ix tak'wi winh rey chi' t'a ix icha tik: --Paxanh t'a a pat, ol xo wila'' tas ol wutej in kolwaj t'ayach, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi ix t'a winh icha tik: --Ach mamin rey, a smul winh wune' chi', emokab' t'a wib'anh yet' t'a yib'anh masanil heb' in k'ab' wok, palta mokab' t'a ib'anh yet' t'a yib'anh a makb'en tz'emi, xchi ix.
Ix tak'wixi winh rey chi' t'a ix: --Ha mach snib'ej tzach ixtan chi', ik'kot t'ayin t'a tik yik wach' manhxo ol ach stzuntzok, xchi winh.

Palta ix ochnhej tean ix t'a winh rey chi': --Tzin tewi t'ayach mamin rey, to tzak' a ti' t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal to a jun in k'ab' wok snib'ej yak'anek' spak schamel winh wune' chi', mokab' smilcham junxo wune' chi', yik max te jawi kuselal t'a wib'anh, xchi ix. Ix tak'wi winh rey chi': --Swak' in ti' t'a yichanh Jehová to malaj jab'ok tas ol ik'an winh une' chi', xchi winh.
Ix ochxi ijan ix yalan icha tik: --Mamin rey, elokab' t'a a k'ol to tza cha ab' jun b'elanh lolonel ol wal t'ayach, xchi ix. --Ala', xchi winh t'a ix.

Ix yalan ix icha tik: --Mamin rey, ¿tom manh wanok ak'an chukal t'a schonhab' Dios? Ayic ix alani to tza b'o yaj tas tz'aj winh wune', wan a ch'oxaneli to manh tojolok a pensar yujto maxtzak a cha meltzaj winh uninal aykanb'at elelal t'a junxo ch'ok chonhab'il.

Yujto ko masanil ol onh chamok. Lajan onh icha ha ha' stob'b'at t'a sat lu'um, maxtzak yal ko molank'ei, palta ha Dios manh komonok syik'el ko k 'inal, a tas sk'ulej to say tas tz'aj smeltzajxikot heb' najat aykanb'ati.
Ha tiknaik mamin rey, in jawi ul wal juntzanh tik t'ayach, yuj heb' anima tzin xib'tan chi'. Yuj chi' ix in koti yik tzin lolon t'a ichanh, q'uinalok tza cha ab' tas tzin k'an tik mamin rey
to tzin a kol t'a mach snib'ej tzin satanel yet' heb' wune' t'a sat lum lum ix yak' Dios ko makb'enok tik.

Ha in a chekab' waj tik, ol in tanhwej tas ol aj a pakan t'ayin yik wach' manhxa tas ol in na'a, yujto a ach tik mamin rey, ojtak wal a ch'olb'itan tas yaji, tato wach', mato chuklaj, lajan ach icha junok ángel yik Dios. Aokab' Jehová ko Diosal ayoch ed'ok, mamin rey, xchi ix.
Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a ix: --Ha tiknaik ay tas ol in k'anb'ej t'ayach. Malaj tas ol a k'ub'ejel t'ayin, xchi winh. --Al an mamin rey, xchi ix.

Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'ej winh rey chi' t'a ix icha tik: --¿Tom manhok winhaj Joab ixb’o’an al jun tik? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi ix: --Ichaton chi' mamin rey, ix a naeli. Ha winh a chekab' chi' ix in chekankoti, a winh ix alanpax t'ayin tastak tzul wal tik t'ayach.

Ix sna juntzanh tik winh yik tope sk'exwi a pensar t'a winh uninal aj Absalón. Palta a ach tik mamin rey, te aj pensar ach, lajan ach icha wal junok yángel Dios, ojtak masanil tastak tzuji t'a yol a makb'en tik, xchi ix.
Yuj chi' ix awtaj winhaj Joab chi' yuj winh rey chi': --Toxo ix in na'a, elokab'k'och icha tas tza nib'ej chi'. Ixic, b'at ik' meltzaj winhaj quelem Absalón chi', xchi winh rey chi' t'a winh.

Yuj chi' ix em nhojan winhaj Joab chi' t'a yichanh winh rey chi' t'a sat lu'um, yuj sch'oxanel winh to niwan yelk'och winh rey chi' t'a sat winh. Ix yalan wach' lolonel winh t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: --Ha tiknaik mamin rey, ix nachajel wuuj to ay welk'och t'ayach, yujto ix a cha ab' tas tzin nib'ej ix wal t'ayach, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj Joab chi' t'a chonhab' Gesur yik b'at yik'anxikot winhaj Absalón chi' winh, yik sjax winh t'a Jerusalén.

Palta ix yalan winh rey to b'enhej sk'ochkan winh t'a spat, max jalaj winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi'. Icha chi' ix aj sk'ochkan winhaj Absalón chi' t'a spat chi', maj k'ochlaj winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi'.
Ha t'a skal masanil heb' israel, malaj junok winak wach' yilji icha yilji winhaj Absalón chi'. Te b'inajnak winh yuj swach'il yilji chi', malaj jab'ok palta t'a sniwanil winh.
Junelnhej sjoxjiel xil sjolom winh t'a junjun ab'il, ayik ste alb'i syab' winh. Ha xil sjolom winh chi', ek'to chanhe' libra yalil, icha yechlab' heb' rey sk'ana'.
Ay oxwanh yuninal winh yet' jun yisil. Ha ix yisil winh chi', Tamar sb'i ix, te wach' yilji ix.
Schab'ilxo ab'il sjax winhaj Absalón chi' t'a Jerusalén, palta anheja' max yal-laj sk'och winh t'a yichanh winh rey.

Yuj chi', ix awtaj winhaj Joab chi' yuj winh yik tz'ik'jib'at winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi', palta maj kotlaj winhaj Joab chi'. Ix yawtanxi winhaj Joab chi' winh t'a schaelal, palta anheja' maj kotlaj winh.

Axo ix aji, ix schekanb'at heb' schekab' winhaj Absalón chi', ix yalan winh: --Ixiquec b'aj ay smunlajel winhaj Joab t'a slak'anil sti' wiko', aton b'aj awab'il ixim kebada yuj winh, tze nhusantz'a tas awab'il chi' yuj winh, xchi winh. Ix b'at heb' schekab' winh chi', ix b'at snhusantz'a tas awab'il chi' heb'.
Ix b'at winhaj Joab t'a spat winhaj Absalón chi', ix yalan winh: --¿Tas yuj ix a chekb'at heb' a chekab' snhustz'a tas awab'il wuuj? xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Absalón chi' t'a winh: --Ix ach wawtej, yik sb'at a k'anb'ej t'a winh rey tas yuj ix b'at in kot t'a chonhab' Gesur. Te wach' ama, tato ix in kanxonhej ta'. In gana swil winh rey chi'. Tato ay in mul, syal in smilancham winh, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Joab yal t'a winh rey tas ix yal winhaj Absalón chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix awtaj winhaj Absalón yuj winh rey chi'. Ayic ix k'och winh, ix em nhojan winh t'a sat lu'um t'a yichanh winh rey chi', ix chaji winh yuj winh rey chi', ix stz'ub'an sti' winh yuninal winh chi'.
Ayic ix ek' jun pekti’, ix aj jun skarruaje winhaj Absalón stok'ji yuj nok' chej, ix sayan 50 heb' soldado winh yik stanhwaj winh yuj heb'.

Ak'walto sk'e waan winh t'a junjun k'u, tz'aj linhan winh t'a yol b'e sk'och t'a spuertail chonhab'. Yalnhej mach sjawi t'a winh rey yik sb'oan yaj yowal, syamjioch wan heb' yuj winh, sk'anb'an winh t'a heb' tas chonhab'il heb'. Ayic syalan heb' tas chonhab'il heb', mach ay yinhtilal heb',
syalan winh t'a heb' icha tik: Wach'ton tas tzul he b'o tik, smoj ton sb'o yaj t'ayex, palta malaj mach sb'oan yuj winh rey chi', xchi winh t'a heb'.
Syalanpax winh icha tik: Oc in wal tzin ak'jioch juezal t'a jun chonhab' tik, ayik tzex jawi t'ayin he b'o yaj eyowal, elanhchamel am tzin b'o t'ayex, xchi winh t'a heb'.
Ay junxo tas syutej heb' anima chi' winh, ayik wanto sk'och heb' t'a winh, ayik manto em nhojan heb' t'a yichanh winh, tz'och lak'naj winh t'a heb', stz'ub'anelta sti' heb' winh.
Ichanhej chi' ix yutej masanil heb' yetisraelal winh sk'och t'a winh rey yik sb'o yaj yowal. Icha chi' ix aj smontaj heb' anima chi' yuj winh.

Chanhe' ab'il ix sk'ulej winh icha chi', ix lajwi chi', ix yalan winh t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, tzin k'an t'ayach to tzin a chab'at t'a Hebrón, yik wach' tzin k'anab'ajej in ti' wak'nak t'a Jehová.
Ayic ayinto ek' t'a Gesur t'a yol yik Siria, wak'nak in ti' t'a Jehová, walannak t'ay, tato tz'el t'a sk'ool to tzin meltzaj t'a Jerusalén, yowalil ol wak' junok in silab' t'ay, xchi winh.
--Ixic t'a junk'olal, xchi winhaj rey Dawid chi'. Yuj chi' ix b'at winh t'a Hebrón chi'.

Ayic ix k'och winh ta', ix yak'anb'at schekab' winh t'a elk'altak t'a junjun yinhtilal heb' israel yik tz'alji t'a heb' to ayik ol yab'an heb' yok' nok' ch'aak, syalan heb' to toxo ix och winhaj Absalón reyal t'a Hebrón.
Chab' kiento heb' winh aj Jerusalén ix yik'b'at winh yet'ok. Ha heb' chi' malaj jab'ok tas yojtak heb' tas wan snaan winh.

Ayic wan yak'an silab' chi' winh, ix schekan winh b'at ik'jokkot winhaj Ahitofel t'a schonhab', aton Gilo. Ak'um razón yaj winh t'a winhaj Dawid. Ha jun tas ix sna winhaj Absalón chi' wan yoch yip yujto ix q'uib' sb'isul heb' anima ix och yet' winh.
Ay jun chekab' ix jawi yal t'a winh rey chi', ix yalan icha tik: Niwanxo heb' quetisraelal ayxo och yet' winhaj Absalón, xchi.

Yuj chi', ix yal winh rey chi' t'a masanil heb' yajal yaj yet' winh t'a Jerusalén chi': --Koyec, konh elek t'a winhaj Absalón chi'. Tato maay, manhxo ol yal-laj ko kolan ko b'ha t'a winh. Co pilek quip yik manhxo ol onh yamchaj yuj winh yik tzonh smilancham yet' masanil anima t'a yol chonhab' tik, xchi winh rey chi'.
Ix tak'wi heb' t'a winh: --Mamin rey, ol ko k'anab'ajej tas tzala', xchi heb'.

Icha chi' ix aj yel winhaj rey Dawid chi' t'a sti' chonhab', heb' ix yetb'eyum winh, heb' yuninal winh yet' pax heb' yetyajalil winh. Axonhej lajunhwanh heb' ix schab'il yetb'eyum winh ix kan stanhwej spat.
Ayic toxo ix el winh yet' masanil heb' anima chi', ix och waan heb' t'a stielxo chonhab'.

Masanil heb' yetyajalil winh, ix k'och heb' t'a stz'ey winh. Axo pax heb' soldado stanhwan winh, aton heb' kereteo yet' heb' peleteo, t'a stzolal ix b'at heb' t'a yichanh winh yet' waque' kiento heb' soldado kotnak yet' winh t'a Gat.
Ix yalan winhaj rey Dawid chi' t'a winhaj Itai aj chonhab' Gat: --¿Tas yuj ipan ach tzach b'at qued'ok? Meltzajanh, wach' tzach kan yet' junxo winh rey ol och chi', yujto ch'ok chonhab'il ach.

Toto janak ach, max yal-laj ach wak'an pural a b'at qued'ok, yujto a in tik manh wojtakok b'ajtil ol in k'ochok. Wach' tzach meltzaji, ik'b'at heb' winh etchonhab' tik ed'ok. Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a eyib'anh t'a masanil tiempo, xchi winh rey chi'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Itai chi': --Mamin rey, swak' in ti' t'a yichanh Dios yet' t'a ichanh, yalnhej b'aj ol ach k'ochok, taxonhej tzonh chami, mato wach' tzonh aji, ol in b'atnhej ed'ok a in a chekab' in tik, xchi winh.
--Ichokab'ta', koyek, b'ab'lajanhek, xchi winhaj Dawid chi'. Yuj chi' ix b'atnhej winhaj Itai chi' yet' heb' ajun yet' winh rey chi'. Ajun heb' yuninal winh rey chi' yet' heb' ix yetb'eyum winh.
Masanil anima, ayik ix yilan heb' sb'at winh rey chi' yet' heb' soldado, ix te ok' heb' sik'lab'il. Ix ek' heb' anima wan yel chi' t'a yol ha' Cedrón, ix b'at heb' t'a sb'eal lum lum kuseltakxo.

Ajun pax winhaj Sadoc yet' winhaj Abiatar yet' heb' lewita. Yed'nak te' skaxail strato Dios heb'. Ix yak'an em te' kaxa chi' heb' masanto ix yal slajwib'at heb' anima ix b'at yet' winh rey chi' t'a yol chonhab' chi'.
Ix yalan winh rey t'a winhaj Sadoc chi' icha tik: --Ik'ekxioch te' kaxa t'a yol chonhab' tik. Tato ol och Jehová wed'ok, ol in meltzajxok, ol wilanxioch te' yet' skajnub' Jehová.
Tato maxtzak tzalaj wed' jun, ujokab' icha wal tas snib'ej t'ayin, xchi winhaj Dawid chi'.

Ix yalanxi winh rey chi' t'a winhaj sakerdote Sadoc chi': --Ach schekab' Dios, meltzajanh t'a junk'olal yet' winhaj Abiatar yet' chawanh heb' eyuninal tik, winhaj Ahimaas, winh iko' yet' winhaj Jonatán winh yik winhaj Abiatar.
Ha inxo tik, ol in kan t'a spanhanil lum b'aj te kuseltakxo tik, masanto ol ja spekal t'ayin eyuuj, xchi winh rey chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix meltzaj winhaj sakerdote Sadoc yet' winhaj Abiatar t'a chonhab' Jerusalén chi', yet'nak te' skaxail strato Jehová heb' winh, ix k'ochxikan heb' winh ta'.

Ix k'e winhaj Dawid chi' yet' heb' ajun yet' winh t'a lum tzalan Oliwo, wan yok' winh sik'lab'il, malaj xanhab' winh ayochi, pichb'il sjolom winh yuj kusk'olal. Icha ix yutej sb'a winh rey chi', icha chi' ix yutejpax sb'a heb' ajun yet' winh chi'.
Ix alji t'a winh rey chi' to a winhaj Ahitofel ayxo och winh yet' winhaj Absalón, yuj chi' ix sk'an winh t'a Jehová yik max elk'och tas nab'il yuj winhaj Ahitofel chi'.

Ayic ix k'ek'och winh rey chi' t'a tzalan Oliwo, b'aj tz'och ejmelal d'ha Dios, ix jawi jun winh yamigo winh, aton winhaj Husai yinhtilal arquita. Ix jawi winh scha winh rey chi', nhik'chimtakxonhej spichul winh, ayk'e lum pokok t'a sjolom winh.
Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Tato tzach b'at wed'ok, tonhej tzin kan t'a spatik uuj.

Palta te wach' tato tzach meltzaj t'a Jerusalén tzalan t'a winhaj Absalón icha tik: Mamin rey, a in tik tzin kan a chekab'ok icha ix aj woch schekab'ok winh a mam, tato xa chi. Icha chi' ol aj och wed'ok yik max elk'och tas nab'il yuj winhaj Ahitofel chi'.
Ata' ix kan winhaj sakerdote Sadoc yet' winhaj Abiatar chi'. Masanil tas ol ab' yalji t'a yol palakio chi', elanhchamel tzalb'at yab' heb' winh.

Ata' ay pax winhaj Ahimaas yet' winhaj Jonatán yuninal heb' winh chawanh chi'. Masanil tas tzab'i, ha t'a heb' winh tzalb'ati, haxo heb' winh ol alankot t'ayin, xchi winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Husai chi'.
Yuj chi' ix meltzaj winhaj Husai t'a Jerusalén chi'. Ayic ix k'och winh, wan wal yoch winhaj Absalón t'a yol chonhab' chi'.

Ayic ix b'at pilnaj winhaj rey Dawid chi' t'a sjolom lum tzalan chi', ix jawi winhaj Siba schekab' winhaj Mefi-boset scha winh. Yed'nak chawanh nok' b'uru winh. Ayoch stz'um nok', ayoch 200 ixim pan t'a yib'anh nok', 100 b'uyanh taquinh sat uwa, 100 quechanh taquinh sat higo yaman yaji yet' jun tz'uum yet'tal wino b'ut'an.

Ix sk'anb'an winh rey chi' t'a winh: --¿Tas juntzanh ed'nak chi'? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Siba chi': --Mamin rey, a nok' b'uru tik ol kuchan heb' al uninal. Axo ixim pan yet' sat te te' sloji tik, yik heb' a soldado yaji, haxo pax wino tik ol yuk'ej heb' sk'unb'i sb'ey b'aj kuseltakxo tik, xchi winh.

--¿B'ajtil ay winhaj Mefi-boset yixchiquin winh ajalil aj Saúl tiknaik? xchi winh rey chi'. --Ix kan winh t'a Jerusalén, yujto ix sna' winh talaj tz'och winh reyal icha ix sk'ulej smam icham yuj heb' israel, xchi winhaj Siba chi'.

--Tato icha chi', a tiknaik a masanil tastak ay t'a winhaj Mefi-boset chi', ol iquejkani, xchi winh rey chi'. --Mamin rey, ay in t'a yalanh a mandar, wach'okab' tzin kan t'a yol a sat, xchi winhaj Siba chi'.
Ayic ix k'och winhaj rey Dawid t'a Bahurim, ix elta jun winh skuchan Simei yuninal winhaj Gera, ayto yuj sb'a yet' winhaj rey Saúl chamnak.
Ix och ijan winh sb'ajwaj t'a winhaj rey Dawid chi', ix julwajpaxkot winh t'a winh yet' t'a heb' yajal ajun yet' winh rey chi'. Oyanoch heb' soldado yet' heb' anima t'a spatik winh rey chi'.
Ix yalan winhaj Simei chi' icha tik: --Jachel a b'ha t'a tik, ach milum anima.

Ha tiknaik wan a chaan spak yuj Jehová yuj jantak heb' yinhtilal winhaj Saúl a milnakchamok yik tzach ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh. Ha tiknaik toxo ix yak'och opisio Jehová t'a yol sk'ab' winh uninal aj Absalón. Ix jawi t'a ib'anh tiknaik yujto te milum ach anima, xchi winh t'a winh rey chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Abisai yune' ix Sarwia t'a winhaj rey Dawid chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, ¿tas yuj sb'ajwajkot jun winh icha nok' chamnak tz'i' tik t'ayach? Cha in b'ati, b'at in xiquel sjolom winh, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winh rey chi': --Malaj eyalan eyik t'a jun winh tik a ex yune' ex ix Sarwia tik. Tato tzin sb'aj winh, a am Jehová tz'ak'an yal winh. Tato icha chi', malaj mach syal skachanoch waan winh, xchi winh rey chi'.

Ix b'at k'elan winh t'a winhaj Abisai yet' t'a heb' ayoch yet' winh yajalil, ix yalan winh: --Inatax a wal winh wuninal snib'ej tzin milanchamok, okxom wal jun winh yinhtilal Benjamín tik. In sb'ajokab' winh, tekan a Jehová tz'ak'an yal winh.
Talaj ol in snakot Dios yuj in kusk'olal tik, haxo ol ajok to ol yak' swach'k'olal t'a wib'anh sk'exulok tas tz'alji tik t'ayin, xchi winh.

Ix b'atxi winhaj Dawid chi' yet' masanil heb' ajun yet'ok, anheja' ix b'atpax winhaj Simei chi' t'a spak'ul lum witz chi', ix b'ajwajxikot winh, ix sjulankot k'een k'een winh t'a skal heb', ix slanhankot lum pokok winh t'a heb'.
Ayic ix k'och winhaj Dawid chi' t'a sti' ha' Jordán yet' masanil heb' ajun yet' chi', te k'unb'inakxo heb', yuj chi' ix yik' yip heb' ta'.
Axo winhaj Absalón yet' masanil heb' ajun pax yet'ok yet' winhaj Ahitofel, ix och heb' t'a yol chonhab' Jerusalén.
Axo winhaj Husai arquita yamigo winhaj Dawid, ix elta winh scha winhaj Absalón chi', te chaanh ix awaj winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: --Niwanokab' elk'och mamin rey, ach ik'jokab' chaanh, xchi winh.
Ix sk'anb'an winhaj Absalón chi': --¿Tom icha chi' tz'aj a naan t'a spatik winh amigo chi'? ¿Tas yuj maj ach b'at yet' winh? xchi winh t'a winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Husai chi': --Maay, manh smojok tzin b'at yet' winh. Ha mach sik'b'ilel yuj Jehová, sik'b'ilpaxel yuj heb' chonhab' israel, a yet' ol in kanok.
Anhejtona' ay mach smoj swak' serwil, ol wak' serwil winh yuninal winh wamigo chi'. Icha ix aj wak'an serwil winh a mam, icha wal chi' ol aj ach wak'anxi serwil, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Absalón chi' t'a winhaj Ahitofel: --¿Tas tza na' a ach tik, tas ol ko k'ulej? xchi winh t'a winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Ahitofel chi': --Ha tas tza k'ulej tiknaik to tzach way yet' heb' ix schab'il yetb'eyum winh a mam aykan stanhwej spat, yik wach' snachajel yuj masanil heb' israel tik to tzach chakjikanel yuj winh a mam chi', haxo masanil heb' ayoch ed' tik ol ach yak'och heb' yipok sk'ool, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix sb'oank'e jun mantiado heb' t'a spanhanil palakio, ata' ix way winhaj Absalón chi' yet' heb' ix schab'il yetb'eyum smam chi'. D'a yichanh masanil heb' chonhab' chi' ix way winh yet' heb' ix.

Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', ayik sk'anchaj razón t'a winhaj Ahitofel chi' ichato a d'ha Dios wan sk'anb'an heb', yuj chi' a tas ix yal winh, ix yak'och winhaj rey Dawid yipok sk'ool. Anheja' icha pax chi' ix sk'ulej winhaj Absalón chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Ahitofel t'a winhaj Absalón chi': --Comonoc syal a k'ol tzin sik'el 12 milok heb' soldado, tzin b'at t'a spatik winhaj Dawid t'a jun ak'wal tik,
yakb'an malaj yip winh yuj k'unb'elal, ol in k'ochok. Ol in xib'tej masanil heb' ajun yet' winh, masanil heb' ol el lemnaj t'a stz'ey winh. Malaj junok mach ol in milchamok, anhej winh rey chi'.
Icha chi' ol aj yoch heb' anima smasanil ed'ok, yujto junnhej mach yowalil smiljichamok, haxo masanil heb' anima chi', ol och heb' t'a junk'olal ed'ok, xchi winhaj Ahitofel chi'.
Ix scha sk'ol jun pensar chi' winhaj Absalón chi' yet' masanil heb' yichamtak winaquil chonhab'.
Ix yalan winhaj Absalón chi' to tz'awtaj winhaj Husai arquita, yik syal winh tas sna' winh t'a yib'anh jun tik.

Axo ix k'och winhaj Husai chi', ix yalan winhaj Absalón chi' tas ix aj snaan winhaj Ahitofel chi'. Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a winh: --¿Vach' am sko k'ulej icha syal winh tik, mato maay? ¿Tas tz'aj a naani? xchi winh t'a winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Husai chi': --Ha tas ix sna' winhaj Ahitofel t'a junel tik, manh wach'oklaj.

Ha ach tik ojtak wal to ha' winh a mam te jelan winh t'a owal yet' masanil heb' winh ajun yet' winh. Ha tiknaik te ay am kot yowal winh yet' heb' winh, icha junok nok' nun oso tz'ik'jiek' yune', icha chi' yaj heb' winh. Anhejtona' pax winh a mam chi' te k'aynak winh yak'an owal, manhoklaj t'a skal heb' anima chi' ayek' winh t'a jun ak'wal tik.

Ha tiknaik, b'aj am sk'ub'ejel sb'a winh t'a junok nhak'een, ma t'a junokxo b'aj t'a chi'. Anhejtona', tato t'a jun b'ab'el owal tik scham jaywanhok heb' a soldado, axom wal yel spekal chi' to toxo ix ak'ji ganar heb' a soldado.

Yuj chi' wach'chom ay heb' winh max xiwtaxon icha nok' niwak choj, palta yowalil schab'axk'e sk'ol heb' winh t'a icha chi', yujto masanil heb' quetchonhab' ojtannak to te jelan winh a mam chi' t'a owal yet' heb' yet'nak winh chi'.

Ha jun tas swal t'ayach tiknaik to sb'at ko molb'ejkot masanil heb' quetisraelal yik tz'och heb' ed'ok, skot t'a Dan masanto t'a Beerseba. Ha heb' chi' manhxo b'ischajb'enok heb' icha yarenail sti' ha' mar, a achxo tza kuchb'ej heb' t'a owal.

Slajwi chi', tzonh b'at kak' owal yet' winh a mam yalnhej b'ajtil ayeq'ui, tzonh em t'a yib'anh winh icha yem yal ak'wal t'a yib'anh masanil anh ank'ultak. Manhxa junok heb' ayek' yet' winh chi' skani.

Wach'chom sk'ub'ejel sb'a heb' t'a junok chonhab' yalani, palta ko masanil a onh israel onh tik squik' ko lasu sko nherankot jun chonhab' chi' yet' jantak k'een k'een ayoch t'ay, squekankanb'at juynaj t'a yoltak ch'olan, manhxa junok k'een k'een skan ta', xchi winhaj Husai chi'.

Ix scha sk'ol winhaj Absalón yet' masanil heb' ichamtak winak tas ix yal winhaj Husai chi' t'a yichanh tas ix yal winhaj Ahitofel chi', wach'chom wach' ix sna' winh chi'. Ix scha sk'ol jun tik heb' yujto a Jehová ix ak'an sna heb' yik max elk'och tas ix sna winhaj Ahitofel chi'. Icha chi' ix aji yik skot t'a yib'anh winhaj Absalón chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at yalan winhaj Husai chi' t'a winhaj sakerdote Sadoc yet' t'a winhaj Abiatar tas ix yal winhaj Ahitofel t'a winhaj Absalón chi' yet' t'a heb' ichamtak winak. Ix yalanpax winh tas ix aj yalani, yik b'at yal heb' yab' winhaj rey Dawid t'a elanhchamel to max kanlaj heb' t'a lum tzinan lu'um chi' palta to tzek'kan heb' t'a junxo sk'axepal ha' Jordán yik wach' max miljicham heb'.

Axo pax winhaj Jonatán yet' winhaj Ahimaas ato b'aj sk'eul sjaj ha' Rogel t'a stitaquel chonhab', ata' ayek' heb' winh yik wach' malaj mach tz'ilan yek' heb' winh t'a yol chonhab' chi'. Axo jun ix chekab', ix b'at alan t'a heb' winh t'a elk'altak tas yaji. Ixnhej wal yab' heb' winh, ix b'at heb' winh yal t'a winhaj rey Dawid chi'.

Palta ay jun winh quelem unin ix ilan heb' winh, haxo winh ix b'at alan t'a winhaj Absalón chi', palta ix snael heb' winh schawanhil, yuj chi' ix b'at heb' winh t'a spat jun winh kajan t'a Bahurim, t'a slak'anil chi'. Elanhchamel ix sk'ub'ejel sb'a heb' winh t'a yol jun olan ay t'a yamaq'uil jun pat chi'.
Ha ix yetb'eyum winh aj pat chi', ix slich'b'at jun k'apak ix t'a yib'anh jun olan chi', ix sekanem ixim trigo ix t'a yib'anh yik max cheklaji.

Axo ix k'och heb' winh schekab' winhaj Absalón chi', ix sk'anb'an heb' winh t'a ix: --¿B'ajtil ix k'och winhaj Ahimaas yet' winhaj Jonatán t'a tik? xchi heb' winh. Ix tak'wi ix icha tik: --Ato wal yek'b'at heb' winh tik. Van am wal sk'och heb' winh t'a sti' ha ha' chi', xchi ix. Ix komon b'at tzak'an heb' winh t'a spatik heb' winh chawanh chi' yalani, palta maj ilchajlaj heb' winh yuj heb' winh, yuj chi' ix meltzaj heb' winh t'a Jerusalén.

Ayic toxo ix meltzajxikan heb' winh chi', ix k'exta heb' winh chawanh chi' t'a yol jun olan chi', ix b'at yalan heb' winh t'a winhaj rey Dawid to sk'axpaj winh t'ha ha' Jordán yet' masanil heb' ajun yet' winh chi', yujto toxo ix ak'ji sk'ol winhaj Absalón yuj winhaj Ahitofel yik skot heb' winh yak' owal yet' heb'.

Ayic ix yab'an jun chi' winhaj rey Dawid chi', ix k'e waan winh yet' masanil heb' ajun yet' chi', elanhchamel ix k'axpajek' heb' t'a yol ha' Jordán chi'. Axo ix q'uinhib'i t'a junxo k'u, manhxalaj junok mach ayek' t'a sk'axepal ek'ta ha' chi'.

Ayic ix yilan winhaj Ahitofel chi' to maj ochlaj yopisio tas ix yal winh, ix yak'anoch stz'um schej winh, ix pax winh t'a spat t'a schonhab' b'aj aljinak. Masanil tastak ay t'a winh, ix sb'okan yumal winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix sd'unhb'ank'e sb'a winh, ix cham winh. Icha chi' ix aj scham winhaj Ahitofel chi', ix mukchaj winh b'aj mukan smam.
Ix k'och winhaj rey Dawid chi' t'a Mahanaim, haxo winhaj Absalón ix b'at winh t'a spatik winh, ix k'axpajpax winh t'ha ha' Jordán yet' masanil heb' soldado israel.

Ix yak'och winhaj Amasa winhaj Absalón chi' yajalok heb' soldado sk'exulok winhaj Joab. Ha winhaj Amasa chi' yuninal winh jun winh ismaelita skuchan Itra, yik'lajnak sb'a winh yet' jun ix skuchan Abigail yune' ix Nahas snulej ix Sarwia, snun winhaj Joab.
Ix sb'ok'e skampamento winhaj Absalón chi' yet' heb' soldado t'a yol yik Galaad.

Ayic ix k'och winhaj Dawid chi' t'a Mahanaim, ix jawi jaywanh heb' winh winak t'a winh, aton winhaj Sobi yune' ix Nahas aj Rabá t'a yol yik Amón, winhaj Maquir yuninal winhaj Amiel aj Lo-debar yet' winhaj Barzilai aj Rogelim t'a yol yik Galaad.
Ha juntzanh heb' winh chi', yet'nak alanh heb' winh yet' palangana, lum chen, ixim trigo, ixim kebada, ixim harina yet' ixim trigo mayb'il, anh awastut, anh lenteja,

yet'nakpax nok' yal chab' heb' winh, nok' queso, nok' krema yet' pax nok' kalnel. Masanil juntzanh chi' ix yik'b'at heb' winh yab'lej winhaj rey Dawid yet' masanil heb' ajun yet' winh. Yujto spetoj winh yet' masanil heb' anima chi' t'a tzinan lu'um, yuj chi' ix sna heb' winh icha tik: Tekan k'unb'inak yaj heb', tzam takjilaj sti' heb', tzam ochpaxlaj swejel heb', xchi heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix spojan snanhal masanil heb' soldado winhaj rey Dawid chi', ix yak'anoch yajalil junjun mil yet' junjun kien soldado winh.

Ox makan ix aj spojanb'at heb' soldado chi' winh. Ha winhaj Joab ix och yajalil t'a jun makan, haxo t'a junxo makan, a winhaj Abisai yuk'tak winhaj Joab chi' ix ochi. Axo junxo makan jun, a winhaj Itai aj Gat ix och yajalil t'ay. Ix yalan winhaj rey Dawid chi' t'a masanil heb' soldado icha tik: --Ol in b'at eyed'ok t'a owal chi', xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi heb' winh: --Maay mamin rey, max yal-laj a b'ati, yujto a heb' ajk'ol chi' a ach tzach sayek' heb', a onh pax tik ta tzonh kolchaji, ma tzonh cham nanhalok yuj heb', malaj quelk'ochi, palta a ach tik ek'b'al sniwanil elk'och t'a yichanh 10 milok onh a onh tik. Yuj chi' wach' tzach kan t'a yol chonhab' tik. Tato ay b'aj ijan tzonh ak'ji ganar, b'at onh a kolo', xchi heb' winh.
--Ichokab'ta', ol in k'anab'ajej tas tzeyal chi', xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix elul linhan winh t'a jun niwan spuertail chonhab' chi' yik syilan winh yelta heb' soldado t'a makquiltaquil t'a stzolal.

Ix cham wal yalan winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Joab, t'a winhaj Abisai yet' t'a winhaj Itai, aton heb' sat yaj t'a heb' soldado chi', ix yal winh icha tik: Yujto ay welk'och t'a he sat, yuj chi' malajokab' tas tz'utaj winhaj Absalón. Masanil heb' soldado ix ab'an tas ix yal winh chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at heb' smasanil t'a owal yet' heb' ayoch yet' winhaj Absalón chi'. Ix schalaj sb'a heb' t'a skaltak te te' t'a yol yik Efraín.
Ix ak'ji ganar heb' soldado winhaj Absalón chi' yuj heb' soldado winh rey chi'. Te niwan heb' ix cham t'a jun k'u chi', 20 mil heb' ix chami.
Ha t'a skaltak te te' chi' ix och owal, te niwan anima ix cham yuj satb'at t'a kaltak te' chi' t'a yichanh heb' ix xikjicham t'a k'een espada.

Ayk'e winhaj Absalón chi' t'a yib'anh jun nok' smula. Ayic ix schalan sb'a winh yet' heb' soldado winhaj rey Dawid chi', ix meltzaj winh t'a spatik. Axo ix aji, ha t'a yalanh sk'ab' jun te' mach' ix ek' nhiknaj nok'. Ix kan nhak'naj sjolom winh t'a skal xachul te' sk'ab' chi', ix kan lokan winh, haxo nok' chej chi' ix b'atnhej nok'.
k'okb'il wal ay jun winh soldado ix ilani, ix b'at yalan winh t'a winhaj Joab icha tik: --Locankan winhaj Absalón t'a skal sk'ab' jun te' mach' ix wila'', xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Joab chi' t'a winh: --Tato ix il icha chi', ¿tas yuj maj a wach' milejcham winh? Tato icha chi', yowalil swak' spak t'ayach, swak'an lajunheok kiklo plata t'ayach yet' jun niwan tzek'ul, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winh icha tik: --Wach'chom tzak' junok mil k'een plata chi' t'ayin, max wak'och in k'ab' t'a winh yuninal winh rey chi', yujto ix kab' wal tas ix yutej winh yalankot t'ayach, t'a winhaj Abisai yet' t'a winhaj Itai to malaj tas tz'utaj winhaj Absalón chi'.
Anhejtona' tato ix in milcham winh, tzam kotnhej t'a wib'anh yujto malaj junok tas k'ub'eltak t'a winh rey chi', ¿tom tzato in a kolo'? xchi winh soldado chi'.

--Nab'anhej swik'ek' tiempo ed'ok, xchi winhaj Joab chi'. Ix yik'anb'at oxe' k'een yunetak lanza winh, ix b'at stekanoch k'een winh t'a spixan winhaj Absalón chi'. Yujto pitzanto winh, yuj chi' ix oymaj lajunhwanh heb' stanhwumal winhaj Joab chi' t'a spatik winh, ix swach' milancham winh heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Joab chi' to spukhaj k'een trompeta yik mantzak b'at heb' soldado t'a spatik heb' yetisraelal chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'anb'at sniwanil winhaj Absalón chi' heb', ix b'at yak'anoch heb' t'a yol jun olan t'a kaltak te' chi', ix k'ekan jun niwan b'ulanh k'een t'a yib'anh yuj heb'. Axo pax heb' soldado winhaj Absalón chi' ixto kani, ix el heb' elelal, ix paxkan heb' t'a spat.

Ayic pitzanto winhaj Absalón chi', ay jun monumento yak'nak b'ojok winh t'a jun lugar skuch sch'olanil yik heb' winh rey. Ha sb'i winh ix yak'kanoch t'ay, yujto malaj junok yuninal winh tz'ak'ankan b'inajok: “Smonumento winhaj Absalón” ix sb'iejkani.
Axo winhaj Ahimaas yuninal winhaj Sadoc, ix alan t'a winhaj Joab: --Swal t'ayach, cha in b'ati yik b'at wal t'a winh rey to a Jehová toxo ix kolanel winh t'a yol sk'ab' heb' yajk'ool, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Joab chi' icha tik: --Max yal-laj a b'ati, manh a mojok a ach ol b'at al jun lolonel chi', tope ato t'a junelxo ol ach b'atok, palta a tiknaik maay, yujto a wal winh yuninal winh rey chi' ix chami, xchi winh t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Joab t'a jun winh soldado aj Etiopía: --Ixic, al t'a winh rey tas ix il chi', xchi winh. Ix em nhojan winh aj Etiopía chi' t'a yichanh winhaj Joab chi', ix b'at lemnaj winh yal t'a winh rey chi'.

Ix yalanpax winhaj Ahimaas t'a winhaj Joab chi': --Eloc wal t'a a k'ool, cha in b'at t'a spatik winh aj Etiopía chi', xchi winh. Ix tak'wipax winhaj Joab chi' icha tik: --¿Tas wal yuj tza nib'ej tzach b'ati? ¿Toc ay tas ol ik' t'a jun lolonel chi'? xchi winh.

--Malaj yelk'ochi, wach'chom malaj tas swik' t'ay, palta ol in b'at lemnajok, xchi winh. --Ixic an, xchi winhaj Joab chi'. Val t'a jun rato chi' ix b'at lemnaj winhaj Ahimaas chi' t'a jun ak'lik, ix b'ab'laj winh yuj winh aj Etiopía chi'.

k'ojanem winhaj rey Dawid t'a snanhal chab' spuertail chonhab' chi', haxo pax winh stanhwumal chonhab' chi', ayek' winh t'a spanhanil yib'anh smuroal b'aj ayoch puerta chi'. Ix yilan winh skot jun winh winak sch'okojil, te yelk'olal skot winh.
Te chaanh ix awaj winh, ix yalan winh to ay jun winh sjawi. Ix yalan winh rey chi': --Tato sch'okoj winh, alum wach' ab'ix winh syal chi', xchi winh rey chi'. Ayic lak'anxo sjawi winh,

ix yilan winh stanhwumal chonhab' chi' to tzak'an skot junxo winh, ix awaj winh t'a winh tanhwum puerta chi': --Ay wal junxo winh winak te yelk'olal skoti, xchi winh. --Anheja' wach' ab'ix tzul yal junxo winh chi', xchi winh rey chi'.

Ix yalanxi winh stanhwumal chonhab' chi': --Ha jun winh b'ab'el chi' icha wal sb'ey winhaj Ahimaas yuninal winhaj Sadoc swila', xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winh rey chi': --Tato a winh chi', wach' spensar winh, wach' am tas ol ul yal winh, xchi winh.

Axo yik ix jawi winhaj Ahimaas chi' t'a yichanh winh rey chi', ix em nhojan winh, ix yak'an stzatzil sk'ol winh rey chi' winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: --Mamin rey, aljokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová ko Diosal, yujto a heb' ix meltzajoch ajk'olal t'ayach, toxo ix satjiel heb' yuj Jehová, xchi winh.

--¿Wach'am sk'ol winhaj Absalón ix ila'? xchi winh rey chi'. Ix tak'wi winhaj Ahimaas chi' icha tik: --Toxonhej somsoman anima yik ix in chekjikot yuj winh a chekab' aj Joab, majxo wab'i tas ix uji, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winh: --B'esek' jab'ok a b'ha t'a chi', tzach kan ta', xchi winh. Ix sk'anab'ajan winh yochkan linhan ta'.

Ato wal chi' ix ja nhiknaj winh aj Etiopía chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: --Mamin rey, cha jun wach' ab'ix tzul wal tik t'ayach: Ha tiknaik, toxo ix ach skolel Jehová t'a yol sk'ab' masanil heb' ix och ajk'olal t'ayach, xchi winh.

Ix sk'anb'an winh rey chi' t'a winh: --Xalpax winhaj quelem Absalón ¿wach'am sk'ol winh? xchi winh rey chi'. Ix tak'wi winh aj Etiopía chi': --Mamin rey, tzok wal kot t'a yib'anh masanil heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach icha ix aj skot t'a yib'anh winh chi', xchi winh.

Ayic ix yab'an jun chi' winh rey chi', ix och pitz'an t'a spixan winh, ix k'e winh t'a yib'anh b'aj ay spuertail jun chonhab' chi'. Van sb'ey winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: Ay, ay ach wuninal aj Absalón. Comonoc a in ix in cham a k'exulok, xchi winh.

Ix yab'an heb' anima to a winhaj rey Dawid ste ok' winh yuj schamel winhaj Absalón, winh yuninal, yuj chi' a tzalajk'olal yuj b'aj ix yak' ganar owal heb' t'a jun k'u chi', ix meltzajkanoch t'a kusk'olal. Ha heb' soldado ix xid'ek' t'a owal chi', q'uixwelalxonhej ix aj sjax heb', elk'altakxonhej ix och heb' t'a yol chonhab' chi', ichato toxonhej ix el heb' t'a heb' ajk'ol chi'. Ha winhaj rey Dawid chi', makan sat winh tz'el yaw winh: Ay ach wuninal aj Absalón. Ay ach wuninal aj Absalón, xchi winh. Ix yab' winhaj Joab to wan yok' winh rey chi' yuj winh yuninal chi'.

Yuj chi' ix b'at winh b'aj ayek' winh rey chi' ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ha tiknaik wan ak'an q'uixwelal heb' a soldado ix ach kolanel yet' heb' al uninal yet' heb' ix etb'eyum yet' heb' ix schab'il etb'eyum.

Van a ch'oxaneli to malaj yelk'och heb' etyajalil yet' heb' a soldado t'a yol a sat. Ha heb' ajk'ol yajoch t'ayach, te xajan heb' uuj, haxo heb' tzach xajanan tik, wan a chakankanel heb'. Ha tiknaik snachajel wuuj, tekan wach' ix ab'i tato maj cham winhaj Absalón chi', a onhxo pax tik jun, onh chamokab' ko masanil.

Yuj chi', a tiknaik elanhkoti, tzak'an sniwanil sk'ol masanil heb' a soldado. Tato manh ol ach elok, wal t'a yichanh Jehová swala', manhxa junok mach ayek' ed'ok ol q'uinhib'ok. Tato icha chi', te chuk tas ol ja t'a ib'anh tiknaik t'a yichanh tastak ek'nak t'a ib'anh yiktax quelem achto, xchi winhaj Joab chi'.

Yuj chi' ix k'e waan winh rey chi', ix elta winh, ix b'at em k'ojan winh t'a sti' spuertail chonhab' chi'. Ayic ix alchaj yab' masanil heb' chonhab', ix ja heb' t'a yichanh winh. Axo pax heb' israel ayoch yet' winhaj Absalón, elelal ix aj spax heb' t'a spat.

Masanil makanhil heb' yinhtilal Israel chi' ix laj yal heb' icha tik: Ha winhaj rey Dawid tik ix onh kolanel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' filisteo yet' t'a juntzanhxo heb' kajk'ool, haxo tiknaik, yuj winhaj Absalón, ix el winh elelal t'a ko makb'en tik.
Ha winhaj Absalón chi' ix ko komon ak'ejoch ko reyalok, toxo ix champax winh t'a owal. ¿Tas sko tanhwejek, yuj chi' max quik'xikot winhaj rey Dawid chi' ko reyalok? xchi heb'.

Yuj chi', a winh rey chi' ix chekanb'at aljok t'a heb' winh sakerdote, aton winhaj Sadoc yet' winhaj Abiatar icha tik: Alec t'a heb' yichamtak winaquil chonhab' Judá icha tik: Toxo ix wab'i tastak wan yalan juntzanhxo makanhil heb' quetchonhab'. ¿Tas yuj tzak'anxo tze na' tas tz'aj in k'ochxi t'a in palakio?
Ayto wuj in b'a eyed'ok, junnhej pax quinhtilal, ¿tas yuj tzak'anxo tzul in eyik'xib'at t'a in palakio? xe chi t'a heb', xchi winh rey chi'.

Ix yalanxi winh rey chi' to sb'at alchaj t'a winhaj Amasa icha tik: Ha ach tik ayto wuj in b'a ed'ok, yuj chi' a tiknaik, a ach ol ach och yajalilok heb' soldado sk'exulok winhaj Joab. Tato max elk'och tas wan walan tik, aokab' Dios tz'ak'ankot yaelal t'a wib'anh, xchi winh.
Icha chi' ix aj smontanxi heb' aj Judá chi' winh rey chi', junxonhej ix aj spensar heb', ix yalanb'at heb' t'a winh to smeltzajxikot winh yet' masanil heb' soldado.
Yuj chi' ix kot winh rey chi', ix jawi winh t'a sti' ha' Jordán. Ix smolb'ejpax sb'a heb' aj Judá t'a Gilgal yik tzul schaanek'ta winh rey chi' heb' t'a yol ha ha' chi'.
Anhejtona' pax winhaj Simei yuninal winhaj Gera aj Bahurim, t'a yinhtilal Benjamín, elanhchamel ix kot winh yet' heb' aj Judá, yik tzul schaan winh rey chi' heb'.

Tzak'anoch mil heb' soldado yinhtilal Benjamín yuj winhaj Simei chi'. Axo pax winhaj Siba, chekab' yaj t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Saúl, 15 heb' yuninal winh yet'nak yet' pax 20 heb' schekab' winh, ix b'ab'laj k'och heb' t'a winhaj rey Dawid chi' t'a sti' ha' Jordán.

Elanhchamel ix k'axpajek' heb' t'a sjayil ha' yik syik'anek'ta heb' yuninal winh rey chi' heb' yet' ix yetb'eyum winh. Ix kolwajpax heb' t'a b'ajtak syal winh rey chi'. Ayic mantzak k'axpajek'ta winh rey t'a yol ha' chi', ix k'och winhaj Simei, ix em nhojan winh t'a yichanh winh.
Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Mamin rey, tzin tewi t'ayach to tzin ak' niwank'olal yik maxtzak a nakot in mul ix och t'ayach a in a chekab' in tik, ayik ix ach el t'a Jerusalén. Mokab' kot owal t'ayin.
Swojtaquejeli to chuk ix wutej in b'a, yuj chi' ha t'a yinhtilal José, a in ix in b'ab'laj jawi ul ach in cha mamin rey, xchi winh.
Axo winhaj Abisai yune' ix Sarwia ix alan icha tik: --Ha winhaj Simei tik, smoj scham winh yujto ix skatab'ej winh rey sik'b'ilel yuj Jehová tik winh, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winh rey chi' icha tik: --¿Tas wal eyoch a ex yune' ex ix Sarwia tik t'a jun lolonel tik? Manhxo eyak' somchaj in k'ool. Ha tiknaik wojtakxo to ol in ochxok sreyalok heb' wetisraelal, yuj chi' malaj junok mach syal scham t'a yol ko chonhab' tik tiknaik, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Simei chi' icha tik: --Swak' in ti' t'a yichanh Jehová to manh ol ach in mil-laj, xchi winh.

Ix kotpax winhaj Mefi-boset yixchiquin winhaj Saúl, ul scha winh rey chi'. Yictax ix elkan winh rey chi' elelal, masanto ix meltzaj winh t'a junk'olal, malaj junelok ix sb'iquel yok winh, maj sjoxel-laj jab'ok snhitak xil sti' winh, maj sk'exel spichul winh.
Ayic ix el winhaj Mefi-boset t'a Jerusalén, ix kot winh scha winh rey chi', ayik ix schalan sb'a heb' winh, ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winh: --¿Tas yuj maj ach b'at wed'ok? xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Mefi-boset chi': --Mamin rey, yujto chuklaj wok, yuj chi' ix wal t'a winh in chekab' aj Siba to syak'och stz'um nok' in b'uru winh, tzin k'e t'a yib'anh nok' yik tzin b'at ed'ok walani, palta ix smusej in sat winh.
Ix yesejpaxel in ti'ok winh t'ayach. Ha ach tik mamin rey, lajan ach icha junok Yángel Dios. Elokab' k'och tas tza nib'ej.
Wach'chom masanil yinhtilal in mam wicham syal a milanchamok, palta ix in awtej wael ed'ok t'a a mexa, yuj chi' manhxalaj tas wach' walani, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Manhxalaj tas wach' kalani, toxo ix in na to tza puquek' lum a lu'um yet' winhaj Siba, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Mefi-boset chi': --Canokab' lum lum chi' t'a winhaj Siba chi' smasanil, a jun niwan yelk'ochi to tzalajk'olal tzach jax t'a a palakio junelxo, xchi winh.
