Anhejtona' winhaj Barzilai aj Galaad, ix emta winh t'a Rogelim ix ul yilan winh sk'axpajkanek'ta winh rey chi' t'a yol ha' Jordán, yik spuklankan sb'a winh yet' winh.
Te icham winakxo winhaj Barzilai chi', 80 ab'ilxo sk'inal winh. Ayic ayek' winh rey chi' t'a Mahanaim, ix b'at winh yak'nhej swael winh rey chi', yujto te b'eyum winh.
Ix yalan winhaj rey Dawid chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Conh wed'ok t'a Jerusalén, ata' ol ach ajnhej wed'ok, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Barzilai chi' icha tik: --Jayexonhej ab'il pitzan in, nab'anhejxom tzin b'at ed' t'a Jerusalén chi'.

Ayxo 80 ab'il in k 'inal, maxtzak wab'laj swach'il tas tzin wa yet' tas swuk'ej, maxtzak yal-laj wilani tato wach' mato maay, maxtzak wab'laj sb'itan heb' winh sb'itani yet' heb' ix sb'itani. Nab'axonhej am ipan in swak'och in b'a a k'atk'ej.
Anhejto tzin k'axpajek' t'a yol ha' Jordán tik tzin b'at jab'okxo ed'ok, swilan a b'atkani. ¿Tasto wal yuj tzala' to tzin b'at ed'ok t'a Jerusalén yuj spakok swach'il in k'ool?

Yuj chi' elok t'a a k'ool, tzin a cha meltzaj t'a in pat, axonhej to tzin tanhwej in chami, ol in mukjok b'aj mukan in mam in nun. Anhej jun, ay jun a chekab' syal ik'anb'at mamin rey, aton winh wuninal skuchan Quimam, ik'b'at winh, tzak'an a wach'k'olal chi' t'a winh, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winh rey chi': --B'atokab' winh wed' an. Ichokab' chi' tz'aji. Yalnhej tas tza k'an yuj winh, ol wak' t'a winh, xchi winh.

Masanil heb' ajun yet' winh rey chi', ix k'axpajek'ta heb' t'a yol ha' Jordán, ix k'axpajpaxek' winh rey chi', ix stz'ub'ankanelta sti' winhaj Barzilai chi' winh, ix yalan wach' lolonel winh t'a yib'anh winh, ix paxkan winh t'a spat.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winh rey chi' t'a Gilgal, ajun winhaj Quimam chi' yet' winh yet' masanil heb' aj Judá, ajun pax nanhalxo heb' israel.

Masanil heb' soldado israel ix b'at ilan winh rey chi', ix yalan heb' t'a winh icha tik: --¿Tas yuj anhej heb' quetchonhab' yinhtilal Judá ix ach ik'ankoti, ix ach ik'anek'ta t'a yol ha' Jordán yet' heb' ix etb'eyum yet' pax heb' uninal yet' masanil heb' a soldado? xchi heb'.

Axo heb' aj Judá chi' ix tak'wi t'a heb' yetisraelal chi': --Yujto a winh rey tik ayto kuj ko b'a yet' winh, yuj chi' max yal-laj skot eyowal t'ayonh, ¿tok ha t'a spatik winh tzonh wa'i? ¿tokwal ay jab'ok ko ganar yet' winh? xchi heb'.

Ix tak'wi heb' yetisraelal heb' chi' t'ay: --Wach'chom icha chi', palta a onh tik lajunh makan inhtilal onh t'a eyichanh, yuj chi' te ay kalan quik t'a winh t'a eyichanh. ¿Tas yuj tzonh he patiquejkani? ¿Tom manhok onh ix ko b'ab'laj alej to smeltzajxi winh ko reyal? xchi heb'. Palta a heb' aj Judá chi', ek'to te ya tas ix yal heb' t'a heb' yetisraelal chi'.

Ay jun winh winak yelxo te chuk spensar t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Benjamín skuchan Seba yuninal winhaj Bicri. Ix spu nok' sch'aak winh, ix k'e somnaj heb' anima chi' yuj winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: Ha onh tik malaj kalan quik t'a winhaj Dawid yuninal winhaj Isaí tik. Conh paxek t'a ko pat ko masanil a onh israel onh tik, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Yuj chi', masanil heb' israel chi' ix aktankan winhaj rey Dawid chi', haxo yet' winhaj Seba chi' ix b'at heb'. Axo heb' soldado t'a yinhtilal Judá, ix kannhej heb' yet' winh rey chi', ix kot heb' yet' winh t'a sti' ha' Jordán masanto t'a Jerusalén.

Ayic ix jax winhaj rey Dawid chi' t'a spalakio t'a Jerusalén, ix yik'anelta lajunhwanh heb' ix schab'il yetb'eyum winh, aton heb' ix aykan stanhwej spat winh chi', ch'ok junxo pat b'aj ix tanhwaj heb' ix. Toxonhej ix ak'ji tas swa heb' ix, palta majxo waylaj winh yet' heb' ix. Ata' ix kannhej heb' ix masanto ix cham heb' ix, icha heb' ix chamnakxo yetb'eyum ix ajkan heb' ix.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Amasa: --B'at molb'ejkot masanil heb' winh winak yik Judá, haxo chab'ej tzach jawi yet' heb' winh t'a tik, xchi winh.
Ix b'at winhaj Amasa chi' smolb'ej heb' winh, palta ix ek' tiempo, maj jalaj winh icha wal sk'ual yaj yalankan heb' winh chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj rey Dawid chi' t'a winhaj Abisai: --Tekan to ek'b'al ol onh yixtej winhaj Seba tik t'a yichanh icha ix sk'ulej winhaj Absalón. Yuj chi' kuchb'ej masanil heb' soldado, tzach b'at t'a spatik winh, haxo talaj tz'aji tz'och winh skol sb'ha t'a junok chonhab' ayoch smuroal, tz'el winh t'ayonh, xchi winh.
Masanil heb' soldado yik winhaj Joab yet' heb' kereteo, heb' peleteo yet' juntzanhxo heb' soldado te jelan, ix el heb' t'a Jerusalén, ix b'at heb' yet' winhaj Abisai chi' t'a spatik winhaj Seba chi'.

Ayic ix k'och heb' t'a slak'anil jun niwan tenam ay t'a Gabaón, ata' ix schalaj sb'a winhaj Amasa chi' yet' heb'. Ha winhaj Joab ayoch spichul winh yik owal, ayoch jun kincho t'a snanhal winh. Ha t'a snanhal winh chi' jachanoch jun k'een espada ayem t'a yol yatut. Ayic wan sk'och winh yak' stzatzil sk'ol winhaj Amasa chi', ix k'eta jasnaj k'een yespada winh chi', ix sik'anxik'e k'een winh.
Ix syaman xil sti' winhaj Amasa chi' winh yet' swach' k'ab' yik stz'ub'anelta sti' winh winh, ix sk'anb'an winh t'a winh: --¿Vach' am ix ach ajelk'och wuk'tak? xchi winhaj Joab chi'.

Ha winhaj Amasa chi' max snalaj winh yuj k'een espada ix siq'uixk'e winhaj Joab chi'. Axo ix aji, ix stipanoch k'een winh t'a sk'ol winhaj Amasa chi'. Ix elta lanhnaj yol sk'ol winh smasanil t'a sat lu'um. Junnhej ix yak' winhaj Joab chi' t'a winh, ix cham winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj Joab chi' yet' winh yuk'tak chi', aton winhaj Abisai t'a spatik winhaj Seba chi'.

Ay jun winh t'a skal heb' soldado winhaj Joab chi' ix och linhan t'a stz'ey sniwanil winhaj Amasa chi', ix yalan winh: --Ha mach ayoch yet' winhaj Joab yet' pax winhaj rey Dawid, ochokab' tzak'an yuj winhaj Joab chi', xchi winh.

Ix kan telan sniwanil winhaj Amasa chi' t'a skal schiq'uil t'a yol b'e chi'. Ayic ix yilan jun winh soldado chi' to ayik wan yek'ta heb' soldado t'a stz'ey sniwanil winhaj Amasa chi', tz'och linhan heb' yila', yuj chi' ix snherkanel winh t'a ti' b'e, ix slich'anb'at jun k'apak winh t'a yib'anh.
Ayic toxo ix snherkanel winh chi', ix ek'b'at heb' soldado smasanil, ix b'at heb' yet' winhaj Joab say winhaj Seba chi'.

Ha winhaj Seba chi', ix ek' winh smolb'ej heb' soldado t'a junjun makan yinhtilal heb' israel, masanto ix k'och winh t'a Abel-bet-maaka. Axo masanil heb' yinhtilal Bicri tzak'anxo och heb' yuj winh, ix och heb' t'a yol chonhab' chi'.

Ayic ix k'och heb' soldado winhaj Joab t'a Abel-bet-maaka chi', ix oymaj heb' t'a spatik, ix sb'oanoch lum lum heb' stek'nub'ok t'a spatiktak smuroal chonhab' chi', yik syak'an owal heb' t'ay. Ix och ijan heb' smak'anem weknaj smuroal chi'.

Ata' ay jun ix ix te ay spensar, ix k'e ix t'a yib'anh smuroal chonhab' chi', ix yalan ix icha tik: --Ab'ek, ab'ek tas ol wala'. Alec t'a winhaj Joab chi' to skot winh t'a tik, yujto tzin nib'ej tzin lolon yet' winh, xchi ix.

Ayic ix k'och winh t'a slak'anil ix, ix sk'anb'an ix icha tik: --¿Tom a ach tik ach Joab? xchi ix t'a winh. --Ha in toni, xchi winh. Ix yalanxi ix t'a winh: --Ab' tas ol wal a in a chekab' in tik, xchi ix. --Tik swab'i, xchi winh.
Ix syamanoch ix yalan icha tik: --Ha t'a peka' tz'alji icha tik: Ha mach snib'ej syojtaquejel junok tasi, sk'anb'ejokab' t'a chonhab' Abel, xchi. Icha chi' tz'aj sb'o yaj junok tasi.

Ha onh kajan onh t'a jun ko chonhab' tik, ichnhej ta' kajeq'ui, k'anab'ajum onh t'a sk'ayb'ub'al Dios. Te niwan pax yelk'och jun ko chonhab' tik. Palta a achxo tik tza nib'ej tza sateli. ¿Tas yuj tza nib'ej tza satel tastak to yik Jehová yaji? xchi ix.
Ix yalan winhaj Joab chi' icha tik: --Manh ichokta' wan in naani yik tzin sataneli.

Manhok jun chi' sko saya', palta a jun winh skuchan Seba yuninal winhaj Bicri aj tzalquixtak t'a yol yik Efraín sko saya'. Ha jun winh chi' ix k'e waan winh ajk'olal t'a winhaj rey Dawid. Anhej winh tzeyak' t'a yol ko k'ab', tzonh el t'a jun chonhab' tik, xchi winh. --D'a yib'anh muro tik ol ko julem sjolom winh t'ayach, xchi ix.

Yuj sjelanil spensar ix chi', ix b'at ix smontej heb' yetchonhab' chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix stzepanel sjolom winhaj Seba chi' heb', ix sjulanemta heb' t'a winhaj Joab chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh to spukhaj nok' ch'aak yik tz'el heb' t'a jun chonhab' chi', yuj chi' ix paxkan junjun heb' soldado t'a spat, ix meltzajpaxkan winhaj Joab chi' t'a Jerusalén yik b'at lolon winh yet' winh rey chi'.
Icha chi' ix aj skanxi winhaj Joab chi' yajalil t'a skal masanil heb' soldado yik Israel, haxo pax winhaj Benaía yuninal winhaj Joiada, a winh yajal yaj t'a heb' kereteo yet' t'a heb' peleteo.
Ha winhaj Adoram tz'ilan heb' aynhejkanoch sb'oan munlajel, haxo winhaj Josafat yuninal winhaj Ahilud tz'ib'um yaj winh t'a winh rey chi'.
Ha winhaj Sewa stz'ib'an yab'ixal winh rey chi' t'a stzolal. Axo winhaj Sadoc yet' winhaj Abiatar, sakerdote yaj heb' winh.
Axo pax winhaj Ira, aj chonhab' Jair, sakerdote yaj winh t'a winhaj rey Dawid chi'.

Ha t'a yol stiempoal winhaj rey Dawid, oxe' ab'il ix yak' jun wejel. Ix sk'anb'an winhaj Dawid chi' t'a Jehová tas yuj icha chi' tzuji. Ix yalan Jehová chi' icha tik: Van eyab'an syail yuj jun wejel tik, yuj smul winhaj Saúl yet' yinhtilal, yujto smilnakcham heb' gabaonita winh, xchi.

Yuj chi' ix yawtej heb' gabaonita chi' winh rey chi' yik slolon winh yet' heb'. (Ha heb' gabaonita chi', manh israelok heb', amorreo heb', aykan heb' t'a skal heb' israel chi', yujto ix yak' sti' heb' israel chi' to max satel heb' gabaonita chi' heb'. Palta haxo winhaj Saúl, ix yak'lej winh satanel heb' yuj swach'ilok heb' israel yet' heb' aj Judá yalani.)

Ix yalan winhaj rey Dawid chi' t'a heb': --¿Tas wach' tzin k'ulej eyed'ok? ¿Tas spak swak' t'ayex yuj b'aj ix ex ixtaxi, yik wach' syak' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a quib'anh a onh schonhab' onh tik? xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi heb' gabaonita chi' icha tik: --Ha kowal yet' winhaj Saúl yet' yinhtilal, malaj sb'onab'il, max b'olaj yet' k'een tumin, malaj kalan quik ko milancham junok ex, xchi heb'. Ix yalanxi winhaj rey Dawid chi' t'a heb': --Alec t'ayin an, tas tze nib'ej swak' t'ayex, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi heb' icha tik: --Co gana tzak'och ukwanhok yinhtilal winhaj Saúl t'a yol ko k'ab', yujto snib'ejnak winh onh sateli yik wach' max onh kan t'a he kal a ex israel ex tik.

Ha heb' ukwanh chi' ol ko milcham heb', ol kak'ank'e lokan heb' t'a yichanh Jehová t'a Gabaa t'a schonhab' winhaj Saúl chi', aton winh sik'nakoch Jehová reyal, xchi heb'. Ix stak'wej winhaj rey Dawid chi' yak'an t'a heb'.

Maj ak'jilaj winhaj Mefi-boset t'a yol sk'ab' heb', aton winh yuninal winhaj Jonatán yixchiquin winhaj Saúl, yujto yak'nak sti' winhaj Dawid t'a winhaj Jonatán chi' t'a yichanh Jehová to manh ol miljokcham yinhtilal winh.

Ix schekan winh rey chi' yamchaj winhaj Armoni yet' junxo winh skuchan Mefi-boset, aton heb' winh yuninal winhaj Saúl yet' ix Rizpa yisil winhaj Aja. Ix schekan winh yamchajpax owanh heb' winh yune' ix yisil winhaj Saúl chi' skuchan Merab, aton heb' winh yune' ix yet' winhaj Adriel, yuninal winhaj Barzilai aj Mehola.

Ix ak'jioch heb' winh ukwanh chi' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' aj Gabaón chi'. Ix ak'jik'e lokan heb' winh t'a yichanh Jehová t'a jolom witz. Icha chi' ix aj scham heb' winh ukwanh chi' t'a stiempoal yel yich sjochchaj ixim kebada.

Axo ix Rizpa chi' ix lich'anem jun icha nok' lopil t'a sjolom jun k'een k'een, ix kan ix stanhwej sniwanil heb' winh chamnak chi'. Ix kannhej ix ta' yik ix el yich sjochchaj ixim kebada, masanto ix jawi nhab'il k 'inal. Max scha emlaj nok' ostok ix t'a sniwanil heb' winh chi' t'a k'ualil, max schapaxk'ochlaj nok' chium nok' ix t'ak'walil.
Ayic ix yab'an winhaj rey Dawid tastak sk'ulej ix Rizpa chi',

ix schekan winh b'at ik'jokkot sb'aquil winhaj Saúl yet' yik winh yuninal, aton winhaj Jonatán, t'a chonhab' Jabes t'a yol yik Galaad. Yujto a heb' aj Jabes chi' xid' ik'jinakkot t'a slak'anil merkado yik Bet-sán, b'aj lokankank'e yuj heb' filisteo, ayik smiljicham heb' t'a owal t'a Gilboa.
Ix schekan winh rey chi' ik'jokkot sb'aquil heb' winh chi' yet' pax sb'aquil heb' winh ukwanh ix k'e lokan chi'.

Ix mukji sb'aquil heb' winh chi' t'a Zela t'a yol yik Benjamín, aton b'aj mukan winhaj Cis smam winhaj Saúl chi'. Ix uji masanil tas icha ix aj yalan winh rey chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix yab' Dios tas ix k'anchaj t'ay yuj swach'ilok chonhab'.
Ix yak'anxi owal heb' filisteo yet' heb' israel, yuj chi' ix b'atxi winhaj rey Dawid chi' yet' heb' soldado yak' owal yet' heb', palta ix te k'unb'i winh rey chi'.

Ay jun winh skuchan Isbi-benob, yinhtilal heb' chaanh steel, ix snib'ej winh smilcham winh rey chi'. Ha k'een slanza winh, ek'to uque' libra yalil k'een, haxo t'a jun kincho winh ayoch t'a snanhal lokanoch jun k'een espada ak'to.

Axo winhaj Abisai yune' ix Sarwia ix kolan winhaj rey Dawid chi'. Ix smilancham jun winh filisteo chi' winh, yuj chi' ix yak' sti' heb' soldado t'a winhaj Dawid chi' icha tik: Manhxo ol ach ko chab'at qued' t'a owal, yik wach' max ach chami, yujto a ach ayachoch yipok ko k'ol a onh israel onh tik, xchi heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'anxi owal heb' israel yet' heb' filisteo t'a Gob. Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', a winhaj Sibecai aj Husa ix milancham winhaj Saf yinhtilal heb' chaanh steel.

Anheja' t'a Gob chi' ix ochpax junxo owal yet' heb' filisteo chi'. Ha winhaj Elhanán yuninal winhaj Jaare-oregim aj Belén, ix milancham winhaj Goliat aj Gat. Ha ste'al slanza jun winh chi', lajan spatik icha te te' b'aj tz'och anh ch'al t'a te' jal-lab'.
Ix ochpax junxo owal t'a Gat. Ay jun winh te chaanh steel ta', yinhtilal heb' chaanh steel. Ha jun winh chi', lajchawe' yiximal sk'ab' winh, lajchawe' pax yiximal yok winh.
Ix te b'uchwaj winh t'a heb' soldado Israel, palta ix miljicham winh yuj winhaj Jonatán yuninal winhaj Simea yuk'tak winhaj rey Dawid.
Ha heb' winh chanhwanh chi', a winhaj Refa aj Gat ay yinhtilal heb', palta ix ak'ji ganar heb' winh yuj winhaj rey Dawid yet' heb' soldado.
Ha winhaj Dawid ix b'itan jun b'it tik t'a Jehová ayik ix kolchajel winh t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj rey Saúl yet' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ol t'a winh.
Mamin Jehová, ichato nhak'een aj t'ayin, ichato in kuartel aji, yujto in Kolumal ach.

Ach in Diosal, a t'ayach skot wip, a t'ayach tzin kol in b'a, in Tanhwumal aji. In Kolumal ach, te ay a poder. Uuj max in yamchajlaj yuj heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin. Ha ach ix in a kol t'a mach snib'ej in sataneli.
Smojton wal a b'itaji. Ayic swalan in b'a t'ayach, t'a wal elanhchamel tzin a kolankanel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ol yajoch t'ayin.
Ha smay chamel ix oymaj t'a in patik. Manh jantakok yaelal ix jawi t'a wib'anh yik tzin sateli.
Ha chamel, ichato toxo ix spixoch slasu t'ayin, ichato ix sb'o in yaalil yik tzin telwi.
Mamin Jehová, ix wal in b'a t'ayach ayik ayinek' t'a skal in somk'olal. Ach in Diosal, ix in k'an a kolwal. Ha t'a a kajnub' ix ab' tas ix wala'. Ix k'och waw t'a a chiquin.
Ichato ix ek' jun niwan quixkab' te ow. Ix te ib'xi sb'akhnub'al satcha’anh. Ix tzikub'tanhaj wal yuj yowal a k'ool ach in Diosal.
Ichato ix elta tab' t'a yol a nhi', haxo t'a yol a ti' ichato ix elta jun k'ak' te ow. Ichato ix elta tzipipok tzak'ak' t'a yol a ti' chi'.
Ix a jak satcha’anh, ix ach emuli. Ayoch niwak k'ik'al asun t'a yalanh ok ayik ach emul chi'.
Ay ach k'e t'a yib'anh jun querubín, ix ach b'at jenhenhok, ix ach b'at b'akhachok t'a yib'anh ik'.
k'ub'an ach el b'aj te k'ik'k 'inal. Ix a k'ub'ejel a b'ha t'a skal k'ik'al asun b'ud'jinaquel yuj ha ha'.
Ach in Diosal, yuj skopopial a tziquiquial ix scha sk'ak'al juntzanh tzak'ak' chi'.
Mamin Jehová, ek' achto t'a yib'anh smasanil, ix el aw icha wal sk'anh k'u t'a satcha’anh. Ix kot sakb'at yet' tzak'ak'.
Ix ak'anb'at a jul-lab', haxo heb' ajk'ool ix saklemkanb'at heb' yuj. Ix a julanb'at jun k'ak' tzek' kopnaj t'a skal heb', ix pechchaj heb' yuj.
Mamin Jehová, yuj schaanhil ix ach awaji yuj pax jun ik' te ow ix ak'elta, ix cheklaj yich ha' mar. Yuj pax chi' ix cheklaj yich yol yib'anhk’inal tik.
Ach in Diosal, masanto t'a satcha’anh ix ak'kot a kolwal t'ayin, ichato ix in ik'k'eta t'a yol jun ha ha' te jul yich.
Ix in a kolan t'a heb' ajk'ool te ay yip, malaj tzin och t'a heb', yelxo wal te tek'an heb' t'a wichanh.
Ix och b'ulnaj heb' t'ayin ayik ay in och t'a ilk'olal, a achxo Jehová ix ach och wed'ok.
Ix in ik'anelta b'aj lot'an, ix in ak'ankanoch b'aj lewan. Ix in a kolo' yujto xajan in uuj.
Mamin Jehová, ix ak' spak t'ayin yujto tojol ix wutej in b'a. Ix ak' a wach'k'olal t'ayin, yujto malaj in mul,
yujto tzin k'anab'ajej a b'eyb'al. Ach in Diosal, max in k'ulejlaj chukal, malaj in gana swik'kanel in b'a t'ayach.
Naannhej masanil a k'ayb'ub'al wuuj, malaj b'ak'uinh sb'at a lolonel satk'olal wuuj.
Wach'nhej in b'eyb'al t'a ichanh. Ix in ya'ilej in b'a yik max in b'at t'a chukal.
Yujnhejton chi' ix ak' spak t'ayin yujto tojol swutej in b'a, malaj pax in mul t'a ichanh ach Jehová.
Mamin, a heb' tzach k'anab'ajani, ol elk'och syal a lolonel t'a heb'. Ha heb' wach' spensar, wach' pax tzutej a pensar t'a heb'.
Wach' tzutej a b'ha t'a heb' wach' sb'eyb'al, palta tza ch'ox a jelanil a tenanek' spensar heb' ixtum anima.
Tza kol heb' emnaquil, haxo heb' syik'chaanh sb'a, tzik'emta heb'.
Mamin Jehová, a achton tzak' sakil k'inal t'ayin. Ha achton tzik'kanel k’ik’ k’inal t'ayin ach in Diosal.
Yuj a kolwal ix in saklemejb'at heb' soldado, ix in k'axpajek' t'a yib'anh smuroal juntzanh chonhab'.
Ach Jehová in Diosal, yelxo wal te wach' a b'eyb'al. Ha a lolonel ix ak'kani, smoj ton wal malaj ko chab'k'olal t'ay. Tza kolel masanil mach yipk'olal aj yuj.
Mamin Jehová, malaj junokxo Dios, a achnhej. ¿Tocwal ay junokxo kolwajum icha ach tik?
Ach in Diosal, a ach tzak'nhej wip. Ha ach tzin a kuchb'ej t'a jun b'e te wach'.
Icha sb'ey junok nok' k'ultaquil chej, icha wal chi' tz'aj in b'ey uuj. D'a sattak witz yeq'ui, tek'tek' waj uuj.
Ha ach tzin a k'ayb'ej t'a owal, tzak'anpax wip yik tzin pakchitan junok jul-lab' nab'a bronke.
Mamin, a ach tzin a tanhwej, tzin a kolani. Ha a wach' k'ab' tzin yamank'e linhan. Yujnhej a wach'k'olal ix in ik'chaanh.
Wach' ix utej in b'e a b'oani yik wach' max in el-laj nhernajok.
Ix in pech heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, ix yamchaj heb' wuuj. Maj in ochlaj waan masanto ix cham heb' wuuj.
Chok' ix wutejkan heb' yik wach' manhxo ol k'e waan heb'. Ix telwi heb' t'a skal wok.
Ha achton tzak' wip yik swak'an owal. Ha heb' schichon sk'ol t'ayin, tzak' yak'em sb'a heb' t'ayin.
Ha ach tza pechel heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin. Yuj chi' syal in satanel heb' malaj tzin och t'ay.
Sk'an kolwal heb', palta malaj mach skolan heb'. Stewi heb' t'ayach Jehová, palta max ach tak'wilaj t'a heb'.
Chok' tz'aj heb' wuuj icha wal lum pokok tz'ik'chajk'e waan yuj ik'. Tzin tek'anem heb' icha wal stek'chajem lum sok'om t'a yoltak b'e.
Tzin a kolel t'a yowal heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, tzin ak'ankanoch yajalilok juntzanh niwak chonhab'. Ha heb' anima manh wojtakoklaj, a heb' tzin ak'an serwil.
Anhej syab'an wab'ixal heb', tzin sk'anab'ajan heb'. Ha heb' ch'ok chonhab'il chi', syak'och sb'a heb' t'a yol in k'ab'.
Tz'ib'xik'e heb' yuj xiwelal ayik tz'elta heb' t'a yol skuartel.
Mamin Jehová, pitzan ach. Ach in Kolumal, alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'ayach. Ach Dios in Kolumal, ik'jokab' chaanh a b'i.
Ha ach tzak' yojtaquejel heb' tzin ixtani to ayach och wed'ok. Tzik'ankot heb' ch'ok chonhab'il t'a yalanh in mandar.
Ha ach tzin a kolel t'a yowal sk'ol heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, aton heb' schichon sk'ool t'ayin. Mamin, tzin a kolanpax t'a heb' komonnhej smak'an anima.
Yuj chi' swal wach' lolonel t'ayach t'a skal juntzanh niwak chonhab', tzin b'itanpax a b'i.

Uuj wal, swak' ganar niwak owal a in rey in tik, a in sik'b'il in el uuj. D'a masanil tiempo tza ch'ox a wach'k'olal t'ayin, a in Dawid in tik yet' t'a heb' winhtilal icha ajnak alani, xchi winhaj Dawid t'a sb'it t'a Jehová.

Aton juntzanh slajwub' slolonel winhaj rey Dawid tik: Ha winhaj Dawid yuninal winhaj Isaí, ix ik'jiwalchaanh winh yuj Dios Axonhej Ochi. Ix sik'jiel winh yuj Dios chi' yik tz'och winh reyal t'a skal heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jacob. Te wach' sb'itan winh t'a skal heb' yetisraelal. Ha winh ix alan icha tik:
Ha Yespíritu Jehová tz'ak'an wal juntzanh tik. Ha slolonel ayek' t'a in ti'.
Ha Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, ko Kolumal paxi, a ix alan t'ayin: Ha mach tz'ak'an yajalil t'a skal anima t'a stojolal, icha wal snib'ej in k'ool,
lajan wal icha saquil yichchaanh, ayik sk'eul k'u t'a junok k'u te k'achan, malaj asun. Lajan icha sk'achwi ayik toxo ix ek' junok yax nhab' tz'ak'an syaxil sat lum lum, xchi Jehová t'ayin.
Icha chi' ol aj winhtilal, masanil tas ix yal Dios t'ayin ol elnhejk'ochok, malaj b'ak'uinh ol sk'ex tas ix yalkan chi' t'ayin. Ha Dios chi' ol kolwajnhej wed'ok yik tz'elk'och tastak tzin nib'ej.
Palta masanil heb' sk'ulan chukal, lajan ol aj heb' icha te' q'uiix smolb'aji yik stakji, malaj junok mach syal syamani.

Tato ay junok mach snib'ej smolb'an te', yowalil sk'an junok k'een k'een, ma junok ste'al lanza yik smolb'ani, snhusjitz'a te' t'a yet'tal chi', stz'akanb'at te' junelnhej, xchi winhaj Dawid chi' t'a slajwub'al sb'it tik.

Ha heb' winh soldado te jelan t'a skal heb' winh soldado winhaj rey Dawid, oxwanh heb' winh: Vinh b'ab'el, aton winhaj Joseb-basebet aj Tacmón. Ha t'a junel, 800 winak smilcham winh yet' k'een slanza.

Axo winh schab'il t'a skal heb' winh oxwanh jelan chi', aton winhaj Eleazar yuninal winhaj Dodo aj Aho. Ayek' winh yet' winhaj rey Dawid chi' t'a Pas-damim, ix stzuntzejb'at heb' filisteo heb' winh ta' yik syak'an owal heb' winh, haxo yik ix kot heb' filisteo chi' t'a heb' winh, ix el lemnaj heb' yetisraelal heb' winh chi'.

Axo winhaj Eleazar chi' ix stek'b'ej sb'a, ix smilancham heb' filisteo chi' winh, ix tzatzb'ikanoch b'uk'naj sk'ab' winh t'a yok k'een yespada chi'. Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ix k'anchaj winh yuj Jehová yik ix yak'an ganar owal chi'. Ayic toxo ix lajwi owal chi', ix meltzajxik'och heb' soldado israel chi' yet' winhaj Eleazar chi' yujnhej yik'anek' heb' masanil tastak yet'nak heb' ajk'ol ix cham chi'.
Axo winh yoxil, aton winhaj Sama, yuninal winhaj Age aj Arar. Ayic ix smolb'an sb'a heb' filisteo t'a Lehi, aton b'aj awab'il juntzanh tut skuchan lenteja. Ata' ix el lemnaj heb' soldado yik Israel.
Palta ix stek'b'ej sb'a winhaj Sama chi' t'a skal juntzanh anh tut chi' yik skolankan winh. Ix smilancham heb' filisteo chi' winh. Ha winh ix k'anchaj yuj Jehová yuj yak'an ganar jun owal chi'.

Ha t'a junel, t'a stiempoal smolji sat awb'en, a heb' winh oxwanh sat yaj t'a skal heb' winh 30 soldado te jelan, ix b'at heb' winh b'aj ayek' winhaj Dawid t'a k'een nhak'een yik Adulam. Axo pax heb' filisteo, ayek' skampamento heb' t'a spanhanil ch'olan yik Refaim.
Ha t'a Belén, ay jun makan heb' soldado heb' filisteo chi'.
Axo winhaj Dawid chi' ix alan icha tik: Comonoc ay mach tz'ak'an ha ha' skot t'ha ha' uk'b'ila' ay t'a spuertail Belén wuk'ej, xchi winh.

Axo heb' winh oxwanh soldado te jelan chi', ix och heb' winh t'a skampamento heb' filisteo, ix b'at yik'an ha ha' chi' heb' winh t'a spuertail Belén chi', ix yik'ankot ha' heb' winh t'a winhaj Dawid chi'. Palta maj yal-laj sk'ol winh ix yuk'ej ha', tonhej ix sequem ha' winh t'a sat lu'um icha junok ofrenda tz'ak'ji t'a Jehová.

Ix yalan winh: Mamin Jehová, ¿tom ol wuk' wal jun ha ha' tik? Tato swuk'ej ha' icha wal to a schiq'uil juntzanh heb' winh tik swuk'ej, yujto ix sb'ek sb'a heb' winh schami yik ix b'at yik'ankot ha' heb' winh, xchi winhaj Dawid chi'. Yuj chi' maj yal-laj sk'ol winh ix yuk'ej ha'. Ha heb' winh oxwanh soldado te jelan chi', a heb' winh ix k'ulan jun chi'.

Ha winhaj Abisai yuk'tak winhaj Joab yune' ix Sarwia, a winh ayoch yajalilok 30 heb' winh soldado te jelan. Ha junel ix smilcham 300 winak winh yet' k'een slanza. Icha chi' ix aj sniwanb'i yelk'och winh, icha wal heb' winh oxwanh chi'.
Yelxo te niwan ix aj yik'jichaanh winh t'a skal heb' winh chi', yuj chi' ix ochkan winh yajalilok heb' winh 30 chi', palta maj ochlaj winh stz'akub'ok heb' winh oxwanh b'ab'el chi'.

Axo pax winhaj Benaía, yuninal winhaj Joiada aj chonhab' Cabseel, te jelan winh, tzijtum tas ix sk'ulej winh. Chanhwanh heb' soldado aj Moab te jelan ix smilcham winh. Ha junel ayik te ay k'een sakb'akom, ix em winh t'a yol jun k'een xab', ix smilancham jun nok' choj winh ta'.

Ay pax jun winh aj Egipto te chaanh steel yet'nak slanza ix smilcham winh. Axo winh anhej jun te te' yet'nak winh, ix b'at juknaj winh t'a winh aj Egipto chi', ix yik'anek' slanza winh chi' winh, haxo yet' k'een ix smilcham winh aj Egipto chi' winh.
Ha yuj tas ix sk'ulej winhaj Benaía chi', lajan ix aj yelk'och winh icha oxwanh heb' winh soldado te jelan.
Wach'chom niwan yelk'och winh t'a skal heb' winh 30, palta maj ochlaj winh stz'akub'ok heb' winh oxwanh chi'. Ix ak'jioch winh yuj winhaj Dawid yajalilok heb' stanhwumal.
Ha t'a skal heb' winh 30 jelan chi', ayoch winhaj Asael yuk'tak winhaj Joab, winhaj Elhanán yuninal winhaj Dodo aj Belén,
winhaj Sama yet' winhaj Elica aton heb' aj Harod,
winhaj Heles aj Palti, winhaj Ira yuninal winhaj Iques aj Tecoa,
winhaj Abiezer aj Anatot, winhaj Mebunai aj Husa,
winhaj Salmón aj Aho, winhaj Maharai aj Netofa,
winhaj Heleb yuninal winhaj Baana, winhaj Itai yuninal winhaj Ribai aj Gabaa t'a yol yik Benjamín,
winhaj Benaía aj Piratón, winhaj Hidai kajan t'a sti' ha ha' t'a yol yik Gaas,
winhaj Abi-albón aj Arba, winhaj Azmawet aj Bahurim,
winhaj Eliaba aj Saalbón, heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jasén, aton winhaj Jonatán yet'
winhaj Sama aj Harod, winhaj Ahíam yuninal winhaj Sarar aj Harod paxi,
winhaj Elifelet yuninal winhaj Ahasbai aj Maaca, winhaj Eliam yuninal winhaj Ahitofel aj Gilo,
winhaj Hesrai aj Carmel, winhaj Paarai aj Arba,
winhaj Igal yuninal winhaj Natán aj Soba, winhaj Bani aj Gad,
winhaj Selec aj Amón, winhaj Naharai aj Beerot, skuchumal syamk'ab' winhaj Joab yune' ix Sarwia,
winhaj Ira aj Itra, winhaj Gareb aj Itra paxi,
yet' winhaj Urías hitita. 37 heb' winh tik t'a smasanil.
Ix kot yowal Jehová t'a chonhab' Israel junelxo, yuj chi' ix yak'och t'a spensar winhaj rey Dawid yik syak' ik'jokchaanh sb'isul heb' soldado yik Israel winh yet' heb' aj Judá.

Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Joab yajalil heb' soldado ayoch yet'ok: --Ek'anh t'a skal junjun makan heb' quetisraelal, skot t'a Dan masanto t'a chonhab' Beerseba, tzik'ank'e waan sb'isul heb' smojxo yoch soldadoal. Icha chi' ol aj wojtakani jantak heb' t'a smasanil, xchi winh t'a winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Joab chi': --Mamin rey, aokab' Jehová ko Diosal tz'ak'an q'uib' sb'isul heb' anima, 100 okab'to tzek' t'a yichanh icha tiknaik, olto ila', palta, ¿tas wal yuj a gana tzik'chaanh sb'isul heb' anima tik? xchi winh.

Palta ix yak'xonhejoch winh rey chi' t'a yib'anh winhaj Joab yet' heb' yajalil heb' soldado to yowalil tz'ik'jik'e waan sb'isul heb' anima chi'. Yuj chi' ix elta heb' t'a yichanh winh rey chi', ix sk'anab'ajan heb' sb'at b'aj ix alchaj chi'.
Ix k'axpajek' heb' t'ha ha' Jordán, ix sb'oank'e skampamento heb' t'a Aroer t'a snanhal jun panhan. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at heb' t'a Gad yet' t'a Jazer.
Ix b'at heb' t'a Galaad yet' t'a Cades t'a yol smakb'en heb' hitita. Ix b'atpax heb' t'a Dan, ichato chi' ix meltzaj heb' t'a stitak yik Sidón.
Ix b'atpax heb' t'a niwan chonhab' Tiro t'a smakb'en heb' heweo yet' pax schonhab' heb' kananeo. Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at heb' t'a chonhab' Beerseba t'a Neguev t'a yol yik Judá.
B'alunhe' uj yet' 20 k'ualxo ix yak' heb' yek' t'a smasanil, ix lajwi chi' ix meltzajxi heb' t'a Jerusalén.
Axo winhaj Joab chi' ix ak'an sb'isul heb' anima t'a junjun chonhab' t'a winh rey chi': 500 mil heb' winh aj Judá to stiempo yoch t'a soldadoal yet' 800 mil yik juntzanhxo makan heb' israel.

Ixlajwi chi' ix snaan sb'a sk'ool winhaj rey Dawid chi'. Ix och winh t'a ilk'olal yuj b'aj ix yik'k'e waan sb'isul heb' israel chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: --Mamin Jehová, te niwan in mul ix och t'ayach yuj jun tas ix in k'ulej tik. Ha wal tiknaik tzin tewi wal t'ayach to tzik'el jun in mul tik t'a wib'anh. Icha junok anima malaj spensar ix wutej in b'a t'ayach, xchi winh.
Ayic ix sakb'i t'a junxo k'u, ayik mantzak k'e waan winhaj Dawid chi' ix yalan Jehová icha tik t'a winhaj Gad schekab', aton winh ak'um pensar t'a winhaj Dawid chi':
--Ixic al t'a winhaj Dawid to a in Jehová in swal icha tik: Oxe' makan yaelal swaltej t'ayach. Ha achxo ol a sik'lej b'aja junok tza nib'ej, xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Gad chi'.

--Inye, xchi winhaj Gad chi'. Ix ul yalan winh t'a winhaj rey Dawid chi' icha tik: --¿Tzam yal a k'ol sjawi uqueok ab'il wejel t'a yol a chonhab' tik? ¿Mato a gana oxeok ujal tzex ak'ji ganar yuj heb' ajk'ool? ¿Ma a gana oxeok k'ual ilya yik scham anima t'a yol a chonhab' tik? Na' wal sik'lab'il, ol alani. Slajwi chi' ol b'at walanxi t'a Jehová ix in chekankoti, xchi winh t'a winh rey chi'.

Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winh: --Maxtzac nachaj wuj tiknaik tas tz'aj walani. Wach' tzonh kan t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová, yujto niwan tz'ok' sk'ol t'ayonh, mokab' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' anima tzonh kani, xchi winh.

Yuj chi', ha t'a jun q'uinhib'alil chi', ix yak'kot jun niwan ilya Jehová t'a skal heb' israel, masanto ix tz'akwi sk'ual ix alchajkan chi'. Yuj chi' 70 mil anima ix cham t'a yol smakb'en heb' chi', ix kotnhej t'a Dan masanto t'a Beerseba.

Ayic ix yak'anb'at sk'ab' jun ángel t'a yib'anh Jerusalén yik syak' lajwok heb' anima yalani, ix kus sk'ol Jehová yuj tas ix uji chi', yuj chi' ix yal t'a jun ángel chi': k'okb'ilxo chi', ochokab' waan, xchi. Ha t'a stek'lab' trigo winhaj Arauna aj Jebús, ata' ayek' jun ángel chi' ayik ix alji chi' t'ay.

Ayic ix yilan jun ángel chi' winhaj Dawid, ix yalan winh t'a Jehová: --Ha in ton ay in mul, malaj smul juntzanh anima tik. Tzin k'an t'ayach to ha t'a wib'anh yet' t'a yib'anh winhtilal tz'och jun niwan yaelal tik, xchi winh.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ix jawi winhaj Gad yal t'a winhaj Dawid chi' icha tik: --Q'ueanh t'a stek'lab' trigo winhaj Arauna aj Jebús, tza b'oan junok altar t'a Jehová, xchi winh.
Ix b'at winhaj Dawid chi' icha ix aj yalan winhaj Gad yuj Jehová.
Ix yilankot winhaj Arauna to wan sk'och winh rey yet' heb' yetyajalil b'aj ayeq'ui, ix kot winh scha winh rey chi', ix em nhojan winh t'a sat lu'um t'a yichanh winh.

Ix yalan winh: --Mamin rey, ¿tas wal yuj tzach jawi t'ayin? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Dawid chi': --Ha yuj in manan jab'ok lugar t'a a tek'lab' trigo tik, ol in b'oank'e junok yaltar Jehová t'ay, yik wach' ol wanaj scham anima t'a yol chonhab' tik, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Arauna chi': --Ujokab' mamin, b'o'okab'i, tzak'an silab' t'a Jehová icha wal snib'ej a k'ool. Ay nok' wakax syal ak'an silab'il t'a tik. Ay te' mak'lab' trigo yet' te' yugo syal yoch k'atzitzal.
Ha in tik swak' masanil juntzanh tik t'ayach, xchi winh. Ix yalanxi winh: --Tzoc walel t'a sk'ol Jehová to scha yab' tas ol a k'an t'ay, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Arauna chi' icha tik: --Maay, ol in man masanil juntzanh chi' t'ayach, yujto max yal-laj wak'an t'a Jehová ko Diosal tastak to tonhej tza siej t'ayin, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix sman jun lugar chi' winhaj Dawid chi' yet' nok' wakax t'a 50 siklo k'een plata.

Ix sb'oank'e jun altar winh t'a Jehová, ix yak'an silab' winh snhusji yet' pax silab' yik junk'olal t'ay. Ichato chi' ix schaan yab' Jehová tas ix sk'an winhaj Dawid chi' yuj chamel wan yoch t'a yoltak schonhab' heb' israel. Yuj chi' ix wanaj jun ilya chi'.
Ayic te icham winakxo winhaj rey Dawid, te siikxo syab' winh. Wach'chom te pim tz'ajk'e sk'u' winh, palta maxtzak q'uixnajlaj winh.
Yuj chi' ix yal heb' tz'ak'an serwil winh icha tik: Smoj wal saychaj junok ix kob'es tz'ilan winh, sway ix t'a stz'ey winh yik sq'uixnaj jab'okxo sniwanil winh, xchi heb'.
Yuj chi' ix b'at sayumal jun ix kob'es te wach' yilji t'a masanil yol yik Israel. Ix ilchaj jun ix yuj heb' t'a chonhab' Sunem, Abisag sb'i ix, ix ik'jikot ix t'a winhaj rey Dawid chi'.
Te wach' yilji ix. Ha ix stanhwan winhaj rey Dawid chi', swaypax ix yet' winh, palta malaj junelok ay tas ix sk'ulej winh yet' ix.

Axo winhaj Adonías yuninal winhaj Dawid yet' ix Haguit, ix yak'och sb'a winh reyal yalani. Ix yik'an juntzanh karruaje winh yet' heb' soldado ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej yet' 50 heb' soldado tzek' yet' winh.

Yictax ix q'uib' winh, malaj junelok ix kachji winh yuj winh smam chi', maj sk'anb'ej winh smam winh chi' t'ay junelok tas sk'ulej. Te wach' yilji winhaj Adonías chi', b'ab'el ix ajkan winh t'a skal heb' yuninal winhaj Dawid chi' ayik ix cham winhaj Absalón.
Ha winhaj Joab yune' ix Sarwia yet' winhaj sakerdote Abiatar ix yak'och sb'a heb' winh yet' winhaj Adonías chi', yuj chi' ix sk'anb'ej srazón winh t'a heb' winh.

Axo pax winhaj sakerdote Sadoc, winhaj Benaía yuninal winhaj Joiada, winhaj Natán schekab' Dios, winhaj Simei, winhaj Rei yet' heb' soldado stanhwan winhaj rey Dawid chi', maj ochlaj heb' winh yet' winhaj Adonías chi'.

Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi' ix sb'o jun niwan wael winhaj Adonías chi' t'a yich jun k'een k'een skuch Zohelet t'a slak'anil b'aj sk'eul sjaj ha ha' t'a Rogel. Tzijtum nok' kalnel, nok' mam wakax yet' nok' kelemtak wakax b'ak'uech ix yak' winh silab'il. Ix yawtan heb' yuk'tak winh, heb' yuninal winhaj rey Dawid chi'. Ix yawtanpax masanil heb' aj Judá winh, aton heb' smunlaj yet' winh rey chi'.
Palta haxo winhaj Natán schekab' Dios, maj awtajlaj winh yuj winh. Maj yawtejpaxlaj winhaj Benaía winh yet' heb' soldado stanhwan winhaj rey Dawid chi', ma winhaj Salomón yuk'tak winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winhaj Natán chi' yal t'a ix Betsabé snun winhaj Salomón chi', ix yalan winh: --¿Tom manto ab'i to toxo ix yak'och sb'a winhaj Adonías reyal t'a elk'altak? Palta manh yojtakokpax winhaj rey Dawid.
Ha tiknaik, cha ab' tas ol wal t'ayach yik wach' manh ol ach cham yet' winh une' aj Salomón tik.

Ixic t'a winhaj rey Dawid chi', tzalan t'a winh: Mamin rey, alnakxokan t'ayin to a winh wune' aj Salomón ol ochkan reyal a k'exulok, a winh ol ochkan t'a yol a despacho. ¿Tas yuj a winhaj Adonías ix yak'och sb'a reyal? xa chi.
Ayic wan a lolon yet' winh rey chi' ol in ochk'ochok. Ha inxo ol wala' to yelton tas tzal chi', xchi winhaj Natán chi' t'a ix.
Yuj chi', ix b'at ix Betsabé chi' yil winhaj rey Dawid b'aj ayek' chi'. Te icham winakxo winh. Ha ix Abisag sunamita tz'ilan winh.
Ayic ix k'och ix Betsabé chi' t'a yichanh winh, ix em nhojan ix yak'an stzatzil sk'ol winh, ix yalan winh t'a ix: --¿Tas tza nib'ej? xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi ix: --Val t'a sb'i Jehová ix ala' to a winh wune' aj Salomón ol ochkan a k'exulok t'a reyal. Ha winh ol ochkan t'a yol a despacho.
Palta ina toxo ix yak'och sb'a winhaj Adonías reyal, a achxo tik mamin rey, manh ojtakok yaji.

Tzijtum nok' kalnel, nok' mam wakax yet' nok' kelemtak wakax b'ak'uech ix yak' winh silab'il. Ix yawtej heb' uninal winh yet' winhaj sakerdote Abiatar, winhaj Joab yajalil heb' a soldado t'a jun wael ix sb'o winh chi', palta maj yawtejlaj winh uninal aj Salomón winh.
Yuj chi', wan stanhwan masanil heb' chonhab' israel tas xa chi, mach ol ak'kanoch reyal a k'exulok.
Palta tato max a b'okan yaj jun tik, haxo yik toxo ix ach chami, axom in miljicham yet' winh wune' aj Salomón chi', xchi ix.
Vanto wal slolon ix yet' winh rey chi', ix ja winhaj Natán schekab' Dios.
Ix alchaj yab' winhaj rey Dawid chi' to toxo ix jawi winhaj Natán chi', ix awtajoch winh, ix em nhojan winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi'.
Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a winh rey chi': --¿Tom a ach ix ala' to tz'ochkan winhaj Adonías reyal a k'exulok?

Ina tiknaik tzijtum nok' kalnel toxo ix smilcham winh yet' nok' mam wakax yet' nok' kelemtak wakax te b'ak'uech silab'il. Ix yawtan heb' winh uninal winh yet' masanil heb' winh ayoch yajalilok heb' a soldado yet' winhaj sakerdote Abiatar. Ha tiknaik wan swa heb' winh smasanil, tz'el yaw heb': Niwanokab' yelk'och winhaj rey Adonías, xchi heb' winh.
Ha inxo tik maj in yawtejlaj winh yet' winhaj sakerdote Sadoc. Maj yawtejpax winhaj Benaía yuninal winhaj Joiada winh, maj awtajlajpax winh uninal aj Salomón.
¿Tom a ch'okojnhej tza b'ok'e jun tik? ¿Tom maj al t'ayonh, mach ol ochkan reyal a k'exulok chi'? xchi winhaj Natán chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj rey Dawid to tz'awtajxikot ix Betsabé. Ayic ix k'och ix t'a yichanh winh rey chi',
ix yalan winh t'a ix: --Swak' in ti' t'a Jehová, aton ix in tanhwan t'a skal in yaelal
to a tiknaik ol wak'elk'och tas ix wal t'ayach t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal, a winh une' aj Salomón ol ochkan t'a in despacho tik in k'exulok, xchi winh.
Ixnhej yab' ix Betsabé chi' icha chi', ix em nhojnaj ix t'a yichanh winh, ix yalan ix: --Mamin rey, ayachnhejokab' ek' t'a masanil tiempo, xchi ix.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj rey Dawid chi' to tz'awtaj winhaj sakerdote Sadoc yet' winhaj Natán schekab' Dios yet' pax winhaj Benaía yuninal winhaj Joiada. Ayic ix k'och heb' winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi',
ix yalan winh: --Ik'ekb'at jaywanh heb' winh ayoch yajalil wed'ok, tzeyak'ank'e winh wuninal aj Salomón t'a yib'anh nok' in mula tzin k'e t'a yib'anh, tzeyik'anb'at winh t'a sjaj ha' Gihón.

Ach sakerdote Sadoc yet' ach Natán, tzeyak'k'e akeite t'a sjolom winhaj Salomón chi' yik tz'ochkan winh reyal t'a ko chonhab' tik. Tze pu'anpax nok' ch'aak tzex awaji: Niwanokab' yelk'och winhaj rey Salomón, xe chi.
Slajwi chi' tzex k'eul yet' winh t'a tik, haxo yochkan winh t'a yol in despacho tik reyal in k'exulok, yujto toxo ix wala' to a winh ol ochkan reyal t'a chonhab' Israel yet' t'a Judá, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Benaía chi' icha tik: --Ichokab'ta' mamin rey. Aokab' Jehová Dios sb'oankan icha chi'.
Icha wal ix aj yoch Jehová ed'ok, ichokab'ta' ol aj yoch yet' winhaj Salomón chi', te niwanokab' ol aj yelk'och yopisio winh t'a yichanh iko', xchi winh.

Yuj chi', ix ak'jik'e winhaj Salomón chi' t'a yib'anh nok' smula winhaj rey Dawid chi' yuj winhaj Sadoc chi', winhaj Natán schekab' Jehová Dios, winhaj Benaía chi' yet' heb' soldado stanhwan winh rey, aton heb' peleteo yet' heb' kereteo. Ix yik'anb'at winh heb' t'a sjaj ha' Gihón.

Ha winhaj sakerdote Sadoc chi' ix ik'ankot akeite t'a skajnub' Dios, ix yak'ank'e winh t'a sjolom winhaj Salomón chi'. Icha chi' ix aj yak'jioch winhaj Salomón chi' reyal yuj heb'. Ixlajwi chi' ix spu'an nok' ch'aak heb', ix awajk'e masanil anima: Niwanokab' yelk'och winhaj rey Salomón, xchi heb'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix och tzak'an heb' anima chi' smasanil yuj winhaj Salomón chi', ix k'ek'och heb' t'a yol chonhab' Jerusalén. Ix spu'an flauta heb', manhxa yalb'anil jantak tzalajk'olal, stak'wi lum witz yuj yel yaw heb'.

Ato wal slajwi swa winhaj Adonías yet' heb' ix yawtej, ix yab'an winh yoch jun aw chi'. Ix yab'anpax winhaj Joab yok' nok' ch'aak, ix yalan winh: --¿Tas yaj jun aw tz'och t'a chonhab' chi'? xchi winh.
Vanto wal slolon winhaj Joab chi', ix k'och winhaj Jonatán yuninal winhaj Abiatar, ix yalan winhaj Adonías t'a winh: --Ochanhcoti, ach wach' a pensar, tekan wach' tas tzul ala', xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Jonatán chi': --Tocwal wach'. Ha tiknaik toxo ix ak'jioch winhaj Salomón reyal yuj winhaj rey Dawid sk'exulok.

Ha winh rey chi' ix chekanb'at winhaj sakerdote Sadoc, winhaj Natán schekab' Dios, winhaj Benaía yuninal winhaj Joiada, heb' kereteo yet' pax heb' peleteo yik sb'at heb' yet' winhaj Salomón. Ix yak'ank'e winhaj Salomón chi' heb' t'a yib'anh nok' smula winh rey chi'.

Ha winhaj sakerdote Sadoc chi' yet' winhaj Natán schekab' Dios chi', ix yak'k'e akeite heb' t'a sjolom winh t'a sjaj ha' Gihón, te tzalajk'olal yaj heb'. Ix meltzaj heb' t'a chonhab', yuj chi' ste awaj heb' anima chi' tzeyab'i.
Ha tiknaik toxo ix och k'ojan winhaj Salomón chi' t'a yol despacho.

Masanil heb' ay yopisio yet' winhaj rey Dawid chi' ix b'at alan winhaj Salomón chi' wach'il. Ix yalan heb' to niwanokab' ol aj yelk'och winh t'a yichanh winh smam chi', niwanokab' pax ol aj smakb'en winh t'a yichanh yik winh smam chi'. Ha jun pax winhaj rey Dawid chi' ix em nhojan d'ha Dios t'a sat sch'at,

ix yalan winh: Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, yujto ix yak' t'a jun wuninal tik to ha' tz'em k'ojan t'a in despacho, tik wal tzato wila'', xchi winh, xchi winhaj Jonatán chi'.
Axo jantak heb' awtab'il yuj winhaj Adonías chi', ix xiwk'e heb', junjunalxonhej ix aj spax heb'.

Ix xiwpaxk'e winhaj Adonías chi' t'a winhaj Salomón chi', yuj chi' ix b'at winh t'a yol skajnub' Jehová. Ata' ix b'at skol sb'a winh yalani. Ix och yub'yub' winh t'a sch'aak altar ayk'e t'a schiquintak.

Elanhchamel ix b'at alchaj t'a winhaj Salomón chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, a wal tiknaik a winhaj Adonías ste xiw winh t'ayach. Ha t'a sch'aak altar ix b'at skol sb'a winh. Syalcot winh t'ayach tiknaik to tzak' a ti' to manh ol a milchamlaj winh, xchi heb'.
Ix tak'wi winh rey chi' icha tik: --Tato wach' syutej sb'a winh, max spitej sb'a winh t'ayin, manh ol chamlaj winh. Palta tato ay chukal ol sk'ulej winh jun, yowalil ol cham winh, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj rey Salomón chi' to sb'at ik'jielta winhaj Adonías chi' b'aj ay altar chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix k'och winh t'a yichanh winh, ix em nhojan winh. Ix yalan winhaj Salomón chi' t'a winh to smeltzaj winh t'a spat t'a junk'olal.
Toxo wal scham winhaj rey Dawid chi', yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a winhaj Salomón yuninal icha tik:
Toxo ol in chamok icha tz'aj masanil heb' quetanimail. Tek'an wal tzutej a b'a, icha junok winak te tek'anxo spensar.

k'anab'ajej scheknab'il Jehová ko Diosal, icha tas snib'ej, tas syal skachnab'il, scheknab'il yet' sk'ayb'ub'al tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj winhaj Moisés. Yuj chi' te wach'nhej ol aj yelk'och masanil tas ol a k'ulej yet' b'ajtak ol ach ek'ok.

Icha chi' ol aj yelk'och tas ix yalkan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Tato ol in sk'anab'ajejnhej heb' inhtilal, tato tojolnhej ol yutej sb'a heb' t'a wichanh yet' smasanil sk'ool yet' smasanil spensar, manh ol yak' palta heb' inhtilal yochnhejkan yajalil t'a Israel tik, xchi t'ayin.

Ojtacxo tas ix in yutej winhaj Joab yune' ix Sarwia, ix smilcham chawanh heb' winh yajalil heb' soldado quetisraelal winh: Aton winhaj Abner yuninal winhaj Ner yet' winhaj Amasa yuninal winhaj Jeter. Manhoklaj t'a skal owal ix miljicham heb' winh yuj winh, palta ichato t'a owal chi' ix cham heb' winh. Ichato ix b'onhchajb'at stzek'ul winh yet' xanhab' yuj schiq'uil heb' winh.
Yuj chi' nhikan tzutej a b'a, mokab' chamlaj winhaj Joab chi' t'a ichnhejta'.

Axo pax heb' winh yuninal winhaj Barzilai aj Galaad, tza xajanej heb' winh in k'ana', tzawtejnhej heb' winh wael ed'ok. Ha heb' winh chi', ix kolwaj heb' winh wed'ok ayik ix in el t'a winh uk'tak aj Absalón chamnak.

Ha pax winhaj Simei ayek' t'a tik, winh yuninal winhaj Gera aj Bahurim t'a yinhtilal Benjamín, te chuk ix yal winh t'ayin ayik wan in b'at t'a Mahanaim, palta ix k'och winh in scha t'a sti' ha' Jordán. Ix wak' in ti' t'a yichanh Jehová to manh ol in milchamlaj winh.

Manh ak' niwank'olal winh. Anhej, a ach tik te nhikan ach. Scham a naani tas ol utej winh. Mokab' tonhejok ol cham winh ichnhej ta', palta to ol miljokcham winh, xchi winhaj rey Dawid chi' t'a winhaj Salomón chi'.
Axo yik ix cham winhaj rey Dawid chi', ha t'a chonhab' skuch Schonhab' Dawid, ata' ix mukchaj winh.
40 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a chonhab' Israel. Uque' ab'il t'a Hebrón, 33 ab'il t'a Jerusalén.
Axo winhaj Salomón ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh smam chi'. Te tek'an ix aj winhaj Salomón yet' yopisio chi'.
Ha winhaj Adonías yune' ix Haguit, ix b'at winh yil ix Betsabé, ix snun winhaj Salomón. Ix sk'anb'an ix t'a winh icha tik: --¿D'a junk'olal am tzach jawi? xchi ix. --I', t'a junk'olal, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winh: --Ay wal jun tas tzin nib'ej swal t'ayach, xchi winh t'a ix. --Ala', xchi ix.
--Ojtac to toxonton wik yaj jun reyal tik. Ix stanhwej masanil chonhab' Israel b'ak'uinh tzin och reyal. Axo tiknaik jun, haxo winh wuk'tak ix och reyal chi', yujto icha chi' ix aj snaan Jehová.
Ha tiknaik ay wal jun tas tzin k'an t'ayach, komonok manh ol a teneq'ui, xchi winh t'a ix. --Al tas tza nib'ej chi', xchi ix.
Ix yalan winh: --Tzin tewi t'ayach to tzal t'a winhaj rey Salomón to syak' ix Abisag aj Sunem winh wetb'eyumok. Ol sk'anab'ajej winh tas tzala', xchi winh t'a ix.
--Ichokab'ta', ol wal t'a winh rey tas tza nib'ej chi', xchi ix Betsabé chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at ix yal t'a winhaj rey Salomón chi' tas ix yal winhaj Adonías chi'. Ixnhej yil winh rey chi' yochk'och ix, ix k'e waan winh, ix em nhojan winh t'a yichanh ix. Ixlajwi chi', ix emxi k'ojan winh t'a yol sdespacho, ix schekan winh ik'chajkot jun niwan xila b'aj tz'em k'ojan ix snun winh chi' t'a swach' k'ab'.

Ix yalan ix: --Tzin tewi t'ayach to ay jayb'elanh in lolonel swal t'ayach, mokab' a teneq'ui, xchi ix. --Al masanil tas tza k'an chi' nunin, manh a na' to ol in tenek' t'ayach, xchi winh rey chi' t'a ix.
--Comonoc ab' tzak' ix Abisag aj Sunem yetb'eyumok winh uk'tak aj Adonías, xchi ix.

Ix tak'wi winh t'a ix snun chi': ¿Tas yuj tzul a k'an ix Abisag yetb'eyumok winhaj Adonías chi'? Ichato tzul a k'ana' to swak' wopisio tik t'a winh, yujto b'ab'el winak winh, aypaxoch winhaj sakerdote Abiatar yet' winhaj Joab yune' ix Sarwia yet' winh, xchi winh t'a ix.
Ixlajwi yalan juntzanh chi' winhaj rey Salomón chi', ix yak'an sti' winh t'a Jehová: Yak'okab' in yaelal Jehová tato max cham winhaj Adonías yuj tas sk'an chi'.

Ha Jehová ix in ak'anoch reyal sk'exulok winh in mam, yik wach' tz'aj yelk'och b'aj ix yak' sti' to ix yak' jun opisio tik t'ayin yet' t'a smasanil winhtilal. Yuj chi' swak' in ti' t'a yichanh to a tiknaik ol cham winhaj Adonías chi', xchi winh.
Ha t'a jun rato chi' ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Benaía yuninal winhaj Joiada to b'at smilcham winhaj Adonías chi' winh. Yuj chi' ix b'at winh smilcham winhaj Adonías chi'.

Ix yalanpax winh rey chi' t'a winhaj sakerdote Abiatar: Ha tiknaik swal t'ayach to tzach b'at t'a a chonhab' Anatot. Smoj wal tzach chami, palta manh ol ach in milchamlaj yujto a ach ek'nak ach yilumalok te' skaxail strato Jehová t'a stiempoal winh in mam. Ha jun ach pax ab'nak syail t'a masanil b'aj yab'nak syail winh in mam chi', xchi winhaj Salomón chi'.
Icha chi' ix aj yelkan winhaj Abiatar chi' t'a sakerdoteal yuj winhaj Salomón chi', ix elkank'och tas alb'il yuj Jehová t'a Silo yuj heb' yinhtilal winhaj Elí.

Anheja' winhaj Joab, ix yak'paxoch sb'a winh yet' winhaj Adonías chi', wach'chom maj yak'och sb'a winh yet' winhaj Absalón. Yuj chi', ayik ix k'och jun lolonel tik t'a winh, ix b'at sk'ub'anel sb'a winh t'a yol skajnub' Jehová yalani, ix och yub'yub' winh t'a sch'aak altar t'a schiquintak.

Ix b'at alji t'a winhaj Salomón chi' chajtil to ha t'a altar t'a skajnub' Jehová, ata' ayek' winhaj Joab chi' skol sb'a. Ix yalan winhaj Salomón chi' t'a winhaj Benaía to sb'at winh smilcham winh ta'.

Ix b'at winh b'ian, ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Joab chi': --Toxo ix yal winh rey to tzach elta, xchi winh t'a winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Joab chi': --Maay. Ha t'a tik tzin chami, xchi winh. Ix b'at yalanxi winhaj Benaía chi' t'a winh rey tas ix yutej winhaj Joab chi' yalani.

Ix yalan winhaj rey Salomón chi': --Chamokab' winh ta', ujokab' icha snib'ej winh chi'. B'at a mukan sniwanil winh chi', yik wach' a schamel heb' malaj smul smilnakcham winh, manhxook t'a yib'anh winh in mam yet' t'a wib'anh skani.

Aokab' Jehová tz'ak'ankanoch juntzanh chamel chi' smulok winh, yujto manhok winh in mam chekjinak winh ayik smilannak winhaj Abner winh, aton winh yuninal winhaj Ner yajalil heb' soldado Israel yet' winhaj Amasa yuninal winhaj Jeter yajalil heb' soldado Judá. Ha heb' winh chawanh chi' más te wach' heb' winh t'a yichanh winhaj Joab chi', tojol spensar heb' winh.

Ha schamel heb' winh chi' ochokab'kan smulok winhaj Joab chi' yet' heb' yinhtilal t'a junelnhej. Palta yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a quib'anh a onh yinhtilal onh winhaj rey Dawid tik, ol onh ochnhejkan t'a sdespacho winh, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winhaj Benaía smilcham winhaj Joab chi'. Ayic toxo ix cham winh, ix b'at mukjikan sniwanil winh t'a spat t'a tzinan lu'um.
Axo winh rey chi' ix ak'anoch winhaj Benaía chi' yajalilok heb' soldado sk'exulok winhaj Joab chi'. Ix ak'jipaxoch winhaj sakerdote Sadoc sk'exulok winhaj Abiatar.
Ixlajwi chi', ix awtaj winhaj Simei yuj winh rey chi', ix yalan winh t'a winh: --B'ok'e junok a pat t'a Jerusalén tik b'aj tzach kajnaji, junelnhej tzach kan t'a tik.
Tato tzach el jun, tzach k'axpajek' t'ha ha' Cedrón, haxo a cham chi'. Ha a chamel chi', a ach tzik'kot t'a ib'anh, xchi winh rey chi' t'a winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Simei chi': --Ichokab' ta' mamin rey, ol in k'anab'ajej tas tzal chi', xchi winh. Najtil ix ek' kajan winhaj Simei chi' t'a Jerusalén.

Palta haxo ix el yoxil ab'il, ix el chawanh heb' winh schekab' winh, haxo t'a Gat b'aj ayoch winhaj Aquis yuninal winhaj Maaca reyal ix k'ochkan heb' winh. Axo yik ix alji t'a winh to ha t'a Gat ayek' heb' winh schekab' winh chi',
elanhchamel ix yak'och stz'um nok' sb'uru winh. Ix b'at winh say heb' winh schekab' t'a Gat chi'. Axo yik ix ilchaj heb' winh yuj winh ix yik'an meltzaj heb' winh.
Axo ix yab'an winhaj Salomón to a winhaj Simei ix xid'ek' winh t'a Gat, palta ayxoek' winh t'a Jerusalén chi'.

Yuj chi' ix schek winh rey chi' awtajkot winh, ix yalan winh t'a winh: --¿Tom maj wal t'ayach to tzak' a ti' t'a yichanh Jehová to max yal el t'a yol chonhab' tik? Ix cham wal walan t'ayach tato ay b'aj tzach b'at t'a junokxo lugar tzach chamxonhej. Ina ix a tak'wej a ti'ok to tza k'anab'ajej tas ix wal chi'.
¿Tas yuj maj a k'anab'ajej b'aj ix ak' a ti' chi' t'a yichanh Jehová?
Nacot tiknaik jantak chukal alnak t'a winh in mam. Ha tiknaik a Jehová ol ach ch'olb'itanok, ol kotkan t'a ib'anh yuj masanil tas a k'ulejnak chi'.
Palta yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a wib'anh a in tik. Ha onh yinhtilal onh winhaj rey Dawid tik ol onh ochnhejkan t'a sdespacho t'a masanil tiempo, xchi winh rey chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Benaía yik b'at smilcham winhaj Simei chi' winh. Ix smilancham winhaj Simei chi' winh. Icha chi' ix aj swach' ochkan reyal chi' t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Salomón chi'.

Ix yik'laj sb'a winhaj Salomón yet' ix yisil winh sreyal Egipto yik tz'och junk'olal t'a skal schonhab' heb'. Ha t'a schonhab'kan winhaj Dawid ix ik'jib'at ix yuj winh yakb'an sb'ochaj spalakio winh yet' stemplo Jehová yet' pax muro t'a spatiktak Jerusalén.
Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', ha t'a juntzanh lugar chaanh, ata' syak' silab' heb' anima wach'chom manh smojok, yujto manto b'olaj stemplo Jehová.

Te ay wal och Jehová t'a sk'ool winhaj Salomón, sk'anab'ajej wal sk'ayb'ub'al Jehová winh, aton alb'ilkan yuj winh smam winh. Wach'chom icha chi', palta anheja' ix yak' juntzanh silab' winh yet' inkienso t'a Jehová t'a juntzanh lugar chaanh chi'.
Ix xid'ek' winh yak' silab' t'a Gabaón yujto, niwan yelk'och jun lugar chi'. Jun mil nok' silab' ix yak' nhusjok tz'a winh t'a jun altar ay ta'.
Ha t'a jun ak'wal ayik ayek' winh t'a Gabaón chi', ix sch'oxan sb'a Jehová t'a winh t'a wayichal. Ix yalan t'a winh: k'an tas tza nib'ej t'ayin, ol wak' t'ayach, xchi t'a winh.

Ix tak'wi winh: Mamin, a xajanejnak wal winh a chekab' aj Dawid, aton winh in mam, yujto ach sk'anab'ajejnhej winh, tojolnhej yutejnak sb'a winh t'ayach. Yuj chi' ix el t'a a k'ool to a in yuninal in winh tik tzin emkan k'ojan t'a sdespacho, icha ix aj yelk'och tiknaik.
Mamin Jehová in Diosal, wach'chom quelem into, mantalaj in jelanil yik swalan tas tz'aj heb' anima, palta ix el wal t'a a k'ool ix in ak'anoch reyal sk'exulok winh in mam chi'.
Axo tiknaik ayinxo och yilumalok a chonhab' sik'b'ilel uuj tik. Ha wal jun a chonhab' tik te niwan, maxtzak b'ischaj heb' anima.

Yuj chi' tzin k'an t'ayach to tzak' in jelanil yik wach' ol yal in kuchb'ani yet' snachajel wuuj b'aj ay tas wach' yet' tas chuk. ¿Tas wal ol aj in ch'olb'itan jun a chonhab' te niwan tik, tato manh ol ak' in jelanil? xchi winh.
Ix scha wal sk'ol Jehová tas ix sk'an winh chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yal icha tik: Yujto maj a k'ana' yik snajtilax a k 'inal, manhok pax a b'eyumal, ma schamel heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach ix a k'ana', palta a a jelanil ix a k'ana' yik tza ch'olb'itan in chonhab' tik,
yuj chi' ol wak' tas tza k'an chi'. Ol wak' a jelanil chi'. Malaj junok mach ek'nakxo lajan spensar icha ach tik. Malaj pax junokxo mach ol pitzwokchaanh ayik toxo ix ach ek'b'ati.
Manhoknhejlaj chi' ol wak' t'ayach, palta ol wak'pax a b'eyumal yet' sniwanil elk'ochi, wach'chom maj a k'ana'. Syalelk'ochi to malaj junokxo rey icha ach tik yakb'an pitzan ach.
Tato ol a k'anab'ajejnhej tas tzin nib'ej yet' in cheknab'il icha aj sk'anab'ajannak winh a mam, ol wak' najatb'ok a k 'inal, xchi Dios chi' t'a winh.

Axo yik ix el swayanh winhaj rey Salomón chi', ix nachajel yuj winh to wan swayichan winh. Axo yik ix jax winh t'a Jerusalén, ix b'at winh b'aj ayek' skaxail strato Jehová, ata' ix schek winh nhusjoktz'a silab' stz'a smasanil yet' silab' yik junk'olal yet' Dios. Ixlajwi chi', ix yawtan winh masanil heb' ayoch yopisio yet'ok yik swa heb' yet' winh.
Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', ix k'och chawanh heb' ix ajmul ix sb'o yaj jun yowal t'a yichanh winhaj rey Salomón chi'.
Ix yalan jun ix t'a winh: --Mamin rey, a in tik yet' jun ix tik junnhej patil kaji. Ayic ix k'och sk'ual, ix alji jun wune'.
Schab'jial wal chi', ix aljipax yik ix tik. Ha onnhej ko chawanhil t'a yol te' pat chi', malaj junokxo mach.
Axo t'a jun ak'wal ix sk'anhatzancham yune' ix chi' ayik te chamnak el ix swayi.

Axom t'a chimilak'wal, ix k'e waan ix, ayik te chamnak in el in wayi, ix yik'ank'e waan yune' ix chamnakxo chi', ix ul stelb'ankanoch ix t'a in tz'ey, haxo wik pitzan chi' ix yik'b'at ix t'a stz'ey sk'exulok yik chi'.
Axo yik ix sakb'i jun, ix wak'an yim wune' chi' walani, palta chamnakxo. Axo yik ix te sakb'i, ix wilani to manh wikoklaj jun unin chi', xchi ix.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan yik junxo ix chi': --Maay, a jun unin pitzan tik wiko', haxo jun chamnakxo chi' iko', xchi ix chi'. Ix yalanpax ix b'ab'el chi': --Maay, a jun chamnakxo chi' iko', haxo jun pitzan tik wiko', xchi ix. Icha chi' ix aj stelan sb'a heb' ix t'a yichanh winh rey chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winh: Ha jun ix tik syal ix: Vic jun unin pitzan tik, haxo jun chamnakxo chi' iko', xchi ix. Anheja' junxo ix chi', icha chi' syutej ix yalan t'a ix b'ab'el ix alan chi', xchi winh rey chi'.
Yuj chi' ix yalan winh: --Ik'ekkot junok k'een espada t'ayin, xchi winh. Ayic ix ja k'een espada chi',
ix yalan winh rey chi' icha tik: --Chab' tzeyutej jun unin pitzan tik, tzeyak'an nanhalok yik junjun heb' ix, xchi winh.

Ha ix ay yik jun nene' unin pitzan chi', ix och wal pitz'naj kusk'olal t'a spixan ix, ix yalan ix t'a winh rey chi': --Mamin rey, elokab' t'a a k'ol max chab'ajlaj snanhal jun unin tik. Ak'jokab' t'a ix tik, xchi ix. Ix yalan junxo ix chi': --Max kanlaj wed'ok, max kanpaxlaj yet' ix tik. Chab'ajokab' snanhal, xchi ix.
Yuj chi' ix yalan winh rey chi': --Manh he milcham jun unin chi', aq'ek t'a ix malaj snib'ej smiljicham chi', yujto wal yel a ix ay yiko', xchi winh.

Masanil heb' aj Israel chi', ix yab' heb' tas ix aj sb'oan yaj jun owal chi' winh rey chi'. Te niwan ix aj yelk'och winh t'a sat heb', yujto ix nachajel yuj heb' to ix ak'ji sjelanil winh yuj Dios yik sb'oan yaj owal winh.
Ix och winhaj Salomón reyal t'a smasanil heb' yetisraelal.

Ha heb' winh ayoch yet' winh t'a yopisio, aton heb' winh tik: Ha winhaj Azarías yuninal winhaj Sadoc ayoch sakerdoteal. Ha winhaj Elihoref yet' winhaj Ahías, heb' winh yuninal winhaj Sisa, a heb' winh stz'ib'an yab'ixal tas sk'ulej winh rey chi'. Ha winhaj Josafat yuninal winhaj Ahilud, a winh tz'ib'um yaj t'a winh rey chi'. Ha winhaj Benaía yuninal winhaj Joiada, a winh ayoch yajalilok heb' soldado. Ha winhaj Sadoc yet' winhaj Abiatar, a heb' winh sakerdote yaji. Ha winhaj Azarías yuninal winhaj Natán, yajal yaj winh t'a skal heb' winh gobernador. Ha winhaj Zabud yuninal pax winhaj Natán chi', sakerdote yaj winh, ak'um pax razón yaj winh t'a winh rey chi'. Ha winhaj Ahisar tz'ilan tas ay t'a spalakio winh rey chi'. Axo winhaj Adoniram yuninal winhaj Abda, a winh tz'ilan heb' munlajwum yowalil smunlaji.

Ha winhaj Salomón chi', ay lajchawanh heb' winh gobernador t'a masanil yol smakb'en Israel tz'ak'an serwil winh. Ha yopisio heb' winh chi', junjun heb' winh t'a junjun ujal t'a yol ab'il, syik'kot heb' winh tastak syab'lej winh rey chi' yet' heb' ayek' yet' winh t'a spalakio.
Ha lajchawanh heb' winh gobernador chi', aton heb' winh tik: Vinhaj Ben-hur, a winh tz'ik'ankot tastak tz'ab'laj chi' t'a tzalquixtak t'a yol yik Efraín.
Vinhaj Ben-dekar, a winh tz'ik'ankot tastak tz'ab'laj chi' t'a juntzanh chonhab' tik: Macaz, Saalbim, Bet-semes, Elón yet' Bet-hanán.
Ha winhaj Ben-hesed, a winh tz'ik'ankot tastak tz'ab'laj chi' t'a Arubot, t'a Soco yet' t'a masanil yol yik Hefer.
Ha winhaj Ben-abinadab, a winh tz'ik'ankot tastak tz'ab'laj chi' t'a masanil yol smakb'en Dor, a ix yetb'eyum winh, aton ix Tafat yisil winhaj Salomón chi'.

Ha winhaj Baana yuninal winhaj Ahilud, a winh tz'ik'ankot tastak tz'ab'laj chi' t'a Taanac, Meguido yet' t'a masanil yol yik Bet-seán. Ha jun chonhab' chi' junnhej yaj yet' Saretán, t'a yalanhemta Jezreel, sb'atnhej t'a Bet-seán masanto sk'och t'a Abel-mehola yet' t'a sk'axepalb'at Jocmeam.

Ha winhaj Ben-geber, a winh tz'ik'ankot tastak tz'ab'laj chi' t'a Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad yet' t'a masanil chonhab' t'a yol yik Galaad chi', aton juntzanh schonhab' heb' yinhtilalkan Jair yuninal Manasés yet' pax t'a yol smakb'en Argob t'a yol yik Basán. Ata' ay 60 niwak chonhab' ayoch smuroal, ayoch k'een bronke tzek' k'atan syamnub'alok spuertail.
Ha winhaj Ahinadab yuninal winhaj Iddo, a winh tz'ik'ankot tastak tz'ab'laj chi' t'a Mahanaim.
Ha winhaj Ahimaas, a winh tz'ik'ankot tastak tz'ab'laj chi' t'a yol yik Neftalí. Aton jun winh chi' ix yik'laj sb'a yet' ix Basemat yisil winhaj Salomón.
Ha winhaj Baana yuninal winhaj Husai, a winh tz'ik'ankot tastak tz'ab'laj chi' t'a yol yik Aser yet' t'a Alot.
Ha winhaj Josafat yuninal winhaj Parúa, a winh tz'ik'ankot tastak tz'ab'laj chi' t'a yol yik Isacar.
Ha winhaj Simei yuninal winhaj Ela, a winh tz'ik'ankot tastak tz'ab'laj chi' t'a yol yik Benjamín.

Ha winhaj Geber yuninal winhaj Uri, a winh tz'ik'ankot tastak tz'ab'laj chi' t'a yol yik Galaad, aton b'aj ek'nak schonhab' winhaj Sehón sreyal heb' amorreo yet' winhaj Og sreyal Basán. Anhej winhaj Geber chi' yajal yaj t'a jun makan lum lum chi'.
Ha heb' aj Judá yet' heb' aj Israel maxtzak b'ischaji jantak sb'isul heb', lajan heb' icha yarenail sti' ha' mar. Manh jantakok tas swaji yet' tas tz'uk'ji, tzalajk'olalnhej yajek' heb'.

Ha winhaj Salomón rey t'a yib'anh masanil juntzanh chonhab' chi'. Scotnhej t'ha ha' Éufrates masanto sja t'a schonhab' heb' filisteo yet' t'a smojonal yik Egipto. Ha masanil juntzanh chonhab' chi', junjun ab'il syak'an k'een tumin heb' yik stupan heb' b'aj aykan t'a yalanh scheknab'il winhaj Salomón chi' yakb'an pitzan winh.
Ha masanil tastak syab'lej winhaj Salomón chi' t'a junjun k'u yet' heb' kajan yet' winh, aton tik: 70 quintal ixim harina te chok' yaji, 140 quintal pax ixim weech yaji,
lajunhwanh nok' mam wakax te b'ak'uech, 20 pax nok' libre yaj t'a yol potrero yet' 100 nok' kalnel. Ch'ok pax yaj nok' k'ultaquil chej, nok' ch'ukul yet' nok' much te b'ak'uech.

Ix yak' wal yajalil winhaj Salomón chi' t'a yib'anh lum lum schakot t'a stitak ha' Éufrates, skotnhej t'a Tifsa masanto tz'emk'och t'a Gaza. Yajal yaj winh t'a yib'anh masanil heb' winh sreyal juntzanh nakión chi'. Ay junk'olal t'a skal winh yet' juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a spatiktak chi'.
Ayic pitzanto winhaj Salomón chi', masanil anima t'a yol yik Judá yet' Israel skotnhej t'a Dan masanto t'a Beerseba, junk'olal yaj heb'. Junjun heb' ay te' yawb'ente' t'a spatiktak spat.
Ha winhaj Salomón chi', ay pax juntzanh pat b'aj ayoch 40 mil nok' chej stok'an karruaje yik owal yuj winh. Ay pax 12 mil heb' soldado sk'e t'a yib'anh nok' chej chi'.
Masanil heb' winh tz'ik'ankot tastak syab'lej winhaj rey Salomón yet' masanil heb' winh swa yet' winh, scham wal yilan heb' winh tato tz'akan syab' t'a jun uj chi'.
Ha heb' winh ayoch t'a yib'anh yik'ankot juntzanh chi', syik'paxkot ixim kebada yet' anh yanh nok' chej chi' heb' winh yet' yik juntzanhxo nok' chej tok'um ikatz yalnhej b'aj ay.
Manhxo jantakok sjelanil winhaj Salomón chi' ix ak'ji yuj Dios. Manhxo alchajb'enok jantak sjelanil winh chi'.
Ha sjelanil winh chi', te ek'to t'a yichanh yik heb' aj Egipto yet' t'a yichanh yik heb' ay b'aj sjawi k'u.

Te jelan winh t'a yib'anh juntzanh heb' winh winak b'inajnak yuj sjelanil, aton winhaj Etán yinhtilal winhaj Zera, winhaj Hemán, winhaj Calcol yet' winhaj Darda, aton heb' winh yuninal winhaj Mahol. Ha sb'inajnaquil sjelanil winh chi', ix k'och spekal t'a masanil juntzanh chonhab' t'a spatik yichanh Israel.
Ha winhaj Salomón chi', oxe' mil k'ayb'ub'al yik jelanil ix yalkan winh, ix sb'oanpax mil kinko b'it winh.

Ix lolon winh t'a yib'anh te te' yet' t'a yib'anh tas tz'awchaji. Ix schael yich winh slolon t'a te' k'ute' ay t'a Líbano masanto t'a yib'anh te' hisopo sq'uib'k'e t'a spatiktak te' pat. Ix lolonpax winh t'a yib'anh juntzanh nok' chanhe' yok, nok' much, nok' tzek' t'a sat lu'um yet' t'a yib'anh nok' chay ay t'a yoltak ha ha'.
Ha heb' winh sreyal masanil juntzanh nakión ix ab'an jantak sjelanil winh, ix schekkot heb' anima heb' winh yik tzul yab'an sjelanil winh heb'.

Ayic ix yab'an winhaj Hiram sreyal Tiro to a winhaj Salomón ix och reyal sk'exulok winh smam, ix yak'ankot heb' schekab' winh yik tzul lolon heb' yet' winh, yujto te wach'taxon yak'an winh yet' winhaj Dawid.
Yuj chi' ix yalanxib'at winhaj Salomón t'a winhaj Hiram chi' icha tik:

Ha ach tik ojtak to maj yal-laj sb'oankank'e junok stemplo Jehová ko Diosal winh in mam yujto niwan tiempoal ix yak' owal winh, masanto a Jehová ix ak'anoch heb' ayoch ajk'olal chi' t'a yol sk'ab' winh.
Ha tiknaik jun, toxo ix yak' junk'olal Jehová t'ayonh israel onh tik, manhxalaj heb' ajk'ol t'ayonh, manhxalaj chukal b'aj tzonh xiwi.

Yuj chi', toxo ix in na' to ol in b'ok'e junok stemplo Jehová ko Diosal, icha ajnak yalan t'a winh in mam chi', ayik yalannak icha tik: Ha junok uninal ol ochkan t'a yol sdespacho a k'exulok, ha' ol b'oank'e junok in templo, xchi Jehová t'a winh in mam chi'.

Yuj chi', tzin k'an t'ayach to ol a chek ik'joquel ste'al, aton te' k'ute' t'a Líbano. Ol wak'b'at heb' winh in chekab' yik skolwaj heb' winh yet' heb' winh a chekab' chi'. Ol in tup sk'u heb' winh icha jantak tza k'ana', yujto ojtak to malaj junok onh syal quik'anel te' icha ex aj Sidón ex chi', xchib'at winh.

Ix te tzalaj winhaj Hiram chi' ayik ix yab'an winh tas ix yalb'at winhaj Salomón chi'. Ix yalan winh: Aljokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová, yujto ix yak' jun yuninal winhaj Dawid te nhikan ix ochkan sk'exulok skuchb'an jun niwan chonhab' chi', xchi winh.
Elanhchamel ix yalxikot winh t'a winhaj Salomón chi': Toxo ix wab' tas ix alkoti, tik tzin chek ik'joquel te' k'ute' yet' te' taj icha ix al chi', ol wak'b'at te' t'ayach.

Ol yik'emta te' heb' winh in chekab' t'a Líbano, ol emk'och te' t'a sti' ha' mar. Yaman ol aj te' yik ol laj b'at te' t'a yib'anh ha', icha chi' ol aj sk'och te' b'aj ix ala'. Ata' ol he cha te', ol eyik'anb'at te' b'ian. Ha achxo jun, ol ak'kot tas ol in wa yet' heb' anima t'a in palakio tik stojolok te', xchikot winh.
Ichaton chi' ix aj yak'an te' k'ute' winhaj Hiram yet' te' taj ix och yopisio yuj winhaj Salomón chi'.
Axo winhaj Salomón chi' ix ak'an jantak tas tz'och yuj winhaj Hiram chi' t'a junjun ab'il: 75 mil quintal ixim trigo yet' 115 mil galón akeite yik sat te' oliwo.
Icha chi' ix aj yak'ji sjelanil spensar winhaj Salomón chi' yuj Jehová, icha ix aj yalani. Ix sb'oan strato winh yet' winhaj Hiram chi' yik ay junk'olal t'a skal heb' winh schawanhil.

Ix schek winhaj Salomón chi' to ha t'a masanil yol yik Israel smolchaj heb' winh winak to yowalil sb'at t'a munlajel t'a Líbano. Ha sb'isul heb' winh chi', 30 mil heb' winh t'a smasanil. 10 mil heb' winh schekjib'at t'a junjun uj. Jun ujal xid'ek' heb' winh munlajel t'a Líbano chi', chab' ujal ayek' heb' winh t'a spat. Ha winhaj Adoniram ayoch yajalilok heb' winh 30 mil chi'.
Ay pax 70 mil heb' winh kuchum ikatz. Ay pax 80 mil heb' winh tzeyum k'een t'a tzalquixtak t'a yol yik Israel chi'.
Ch'ok pax yaj oxe' mil 300 heb' winh ayoch t'a kaporalil yilan munlajel chi'.
Ix yalan winhaj Salomón chi' to stzeyji k'een niwak k'een, wach' tz'aj k'een stzeyji yik wach' a k'een tz'emkan yichok stemplo Jehová chi'.

Ha heb' winh smunlajwum winhaj Salomón yet' heb' winh yik winhaj Hiram chi' yet' pax heb' winh kajan t'a Gebal, ix sjoch te te' heb' winh, ix stzeyanpax k'een k'een heb' winh yik tz'och t'a templo chi'.
Ayic 480 ab'ilxo yelta heb' israel t'a Egipto, chanhexo ab'il yoch winhaj Salomón reyal, yik schab'ilxo ujal yoch jun ab'il chi', aton t'a uj skuch Zif, ix el yich sb'ochaj stemplo Jehová.
Ha jun templo chi', a winhaj Salomón ix alani to sb'oi yik tz'ik'jichaanh Jehová. 27 metro ix aj sk'atul, b'alunhe' metro ix aj yol schiquin, 13 metro yet' nanhalxo ix ajk'e schaanhil.
Axo yolxoelul sti', ay junxo makan yool, b'alunhe' metro sat, lajan icha yol schiquin templo chi', haxo jantak ayeluli, nanhal yoil metro.
Ha swentenail templo chi', lewnik ix ajkan sat t'a yool, haxo t'a spatik lot'an.
Ix b'ochajpaxoch lotzan jun pat, ix oymaj t'a skostiltak templo chi' yet' t'a junxo yol schiquin. Macquiltac ix aj yool, ata' sik'chaj tastak tz'ak'ji t'a Jehová.

Oxe' piso ix ajk'ei: Ha b'ab'el piso, chab' metro yet' 25 kentímetro ix aj slewanil sat. Axo schab'il piso, chab' metro yet' 70 kentímetro ix aj sat. Axo yoxil piso, oxe' metro yet' 15 kentímetro ix aj sat. Jab'jab'il ix utz' spimal skajonal sk'atul templo chi' t'a spatiqueli, yujto b'akhquiltak ix ajkani yik wach' max olji spak'ul templo chi' b'aj tz'och spatzab'il jun pat chi'.

Ha jantak k'een k'een ix och t'a templo chi', tzeyb'il k'een smasanil. Wach'xo yaj k'een ayik ix jawi k'een, yuj chi' manhxalaj b'aj ix ab'chaj sk'anh junok k'een mak'umpoj k'een, ma junok k'een tzeylab' k'een, ma yalnhej tas k'enal.
Ha spuertail jun pat chi', ha t'a stojolal ko k'exanh yik tzonh och t'a yol templo chi' ix kani. Axo sk'oochal sk'e t'a juntzanhxo piso chi' tzek' oyoyok.
Ayic ix b'oel skajonal templo chi', ix och spatzab'il, haxo te' niwak chemte' nab'a k'ute' ix em t'a yib'anh te'.
Ayic ix b'ochaj jun pat t'a spatiktak templo chi', chab' metro yet' 25 kentímetro ix ajk'e schanhil junjun piso. Ix och spatzab'il, ix k'och tenan te' t'a templo chi', nab'a k'ute' te' patzab' chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Salomón chi' icha tik:

Yuj jun templo wan a b'oan tik, swal t'ayach, tato tzach ochnhej tzak'an t'a spatik in k'ayb'ub'al yet' in cheknab'il, tza k'anab'ajan smasanil, ol elk'och masanil tas walnak t'a winhaj Dawid winh a mam.
Ol in ajnhejek' t'a he kal a ex israel ex tik, manh ol ex waktejkani, xchi Jehová chi'.
Ayic ix lajwi sb'oel templo ix schek b'ojok winhaj Salomón chi',

te wach' ix ajoch te' chemte' t'a sattak schanhil pak'anh t'a yool, nab'a k'ute' te' chemte' chi'. Ix b'atnhej te' t'a yich masanto ix k'ek'och te' t'a yalanh te' patzab'. Ix empax te' chemte' nab'a taj t'a yool.

Ha t'a yol templo chi' t'a yichochi, ix makchaj jun kuarto, b'alunhe' metro ix aj yool t'a schanhil pak'anh. Ha te' chemte' ix och chi' t'ay, nab'a k'ute' te'. Ix b'atnhej te' t'a yich masanto ix k'ek'och te' t'a yalanh te' patzab'. Ha jun kuarto chi', aton jun lugar Yicnhej Jehová Yaji.
Axo junxo makan yol templo t'a yichanhelta jun kuarto chi', 18 metro ix ajkan spak'ultak.
Ha te' chemte' ix och t'a yol templo chi', nab'a a te' k'ute'. Yoch'b'iloch yechel sat te te' yet' te' xumak yelwanub'ok sattak te'. Malaj junok k'een k'een chequel t'a yool chi'.
Te wach' ix aj sb'o jun lugar Yicnhej Jehová Yaji, yujto ata' ix och te' skaxail strato Jehová chi'.

Ha spak'ultak yool chi' schanhil, b'alunhe' metro ix aj junjun, b'alunhe' metro pax ix ajk'e schaanhil. Ix ak'chajoch k'een oro jay yaj stenchaj t'a sattak spak'ul chi' t'a yool. Ix b'ojipax jun altar nab'a k'ute', ix ochpax k'een oro chi' t'ay.
Ix ochpax k'een oro chi' t'a te' chemte' ayoch t'a yol templo chi' smasanil. Axo k'een kadena ix och t'a spuertail jun lugar Yicnhej Jehová Yaji, nab'a oro k'een.
Syalelk'ochi, masanil yol templo chi', nab'a oro ix aji. Nab'a oro pax ix aj jun altar ay t'a spatiquelta sti' jun lugar Yicnhej Dios Yaj chi'.
Ix yak'pax b'ojok chab' yechel querubín winh t'a te' oliwo, ix ochkan t'a jun lugar Yicnhej Jehová Yaji. Nanhal yoil metro ix ajk'e schaanhil junjun.
Chab' metro yet' 25 kentímetro ix ajel jenhan junjun sk'axil, yuj chi' nanhal yoil metro ix ajel jenhan sk'axil junjun heb' querubín chi' schab'il.
Lajannhej yajel jenhan sk'axil heb' chi' schawanhil, lajan pax yilji heb'.
Nanhal yoil metro ix ajk'e schaanhil steel junjun heb'.

Ix ak'jioch yechel heb' querubín chi' t'a yol jun lugar Yicnhej Jehová Yaji. Jenhanel sk'axil junjun heb', yuj chi' junjun snhi' sk'axil heb' sk'och tenan t'a junjun spak'ul yool chi'. Axo junjunxo sk'axil heb' schalaj sb'ha t'a snanhal yol jun lugar chi'.
Ix ak'chajoch k'een oro jay yaj stenchaj t'a spatiktak heb' querubín chi'.
D'a masanil sattak spak'ul yol chab' kuarto ay t'a yol templo chi', ix ak'jioch yechel querubín, yechel te' palma yet' yechel xumaak yelwanub'ok.
Ix ak'jipaxem k'een oro jay yaj t'a yib'anh te' chemte' ayem t'a yol kuarto chi' schab'il.

Ha te' spuertail jun lugar Yicnhej Jehová Yaj chi', chab' yaj te'. B'ob'il te' t'a te' oliwo, haxo yelwanub' te' yoch'b'ilochi, aton yechel querubín, te' palma yet' xumaak. Ha te' puerta chi' yet' yelwanub', ix ak'jioch k'een oro t'a te' yet' t'a te' smarkoal te' linhjab'k'ei yet' t'a chab' te' utz'el tz'aj schaan sb'ha t'a yib'anh te' puerta chi'.

Ix ak'jipaxoch te' smarkoal sti' templo chi', anheja' ha t'a te' oliwo b'ob'il te', tojol ix ajek' k'atan te'. Axo te' spuertail ix och chi', ha t'a te' taj ix b'oji te', chab' jenhan ix aj te'. Junjun jenhan te', anhejtona' linhanpax tz'aj spakchaj snanhal te'.
Ix yoch'jipaxoch yelwanub' te': Aton yechel querubín, yechel te' palma yet' yechel xumaak. Ix ak'jipaxoch k'een oro t'a te'.
Ix b'ochajpaxoch smuroal templo chi', ix ek' oyan t'a spatiktak. Ox tzol k'een k'een tzeyb'il slatz'jik'ei, haxo t'a yib'anh k'een tzek' te' k'ute', ichanhej chi' ix aj sk'ei.
Ix el yich yak'jiem yich stemplo Jehová t'a uj Zif ayik schanhil ab'il yoch winhaj Salomón reyal.
Axo t'a swajxaquil uj skuchan Bul, ayik yuxluchil ab'il yoch winh reyal, ix b'oel jun templo chi' smasanil, icha wal yaj yechel b'ob'ilkani. Uque' ab'il ix yak' sb'oi.
Ix sb'opaxk'e spalakio winhaj Salomón chi', 13 ab'il ix yak' winh sb'oani.

Ix sb'oanpaxk'e jun niwan pat winh, te lewan ix aj yool. Ix yak'an skuch winh Spatil Te Te' yik Líbano. 45 metro ix aj sk'atul, 22 metro yet' nanhalxo ix aj yol schiquin, 13 metro yet' nanhalxo ix ajk'e schaanhil. Chanh tzol ix ajoch yoyal, nab'a k'ute'. Axo t'a sjolomtak te' oy chi', ix ek' te' patzab' nab'a k'ute'.
Ha juntzanh te' patzab' chi' 45 te', ox tzol ix ajek' te', 15 te' t'a junjun tzol. Axo t'a yib'anh te' ix b'at te' nab'a k'ute' ix och yib'anhok jun pat chi'.
Ox tzol ix ajk'e swentenail t'a junjun spak'ul. Q'uelk'umb'a ix aj juntzanh wentena chi'.
Oxox sti' aykan t'a junjun yol schiquin. Anheja' k'elk'umb'a ix aj junjun. Ha smarkoal spuertail yet' swentenail, tojol ix ajek' k'atan t'a yib'anh.
Ix b'opax junxo niwan pat, 22 metro yet' nanhalxo ix aj sk'atul, 13 metro yet' nanhalxo ix aj yol schiquin. Ix yak'an skuch winh Yoyal Pat. Axo t'a stentail ayoch yoyal yet' yib'anh.
Ix sb'oanpax junxo pat winh b'aj sch'olb'itaj heb' anima. Anheja' te' k'ute' ix och t'a sattak t'a yool chi'. Ix b'atnhej t'a yich masanto ix k'ek'och t'a yalanh te' patzab'.

Axo pax b'aj kajan winhaj Salomón chi' t'a spalakio, ha t'a spatik jun pat b'aj sch'olb'itaj heb' anima chi' ay. Lajannhej ix aj sb'o icha ix aj sb'o juntzanh pat chi'. Ix yak'anpax b'ojok junxo pat yik ix yetb'eyum winh, aton ix yisil winh sreyal Egipto. Lajan ix aj sb'o icha ix aj yik winh.

Ha masanil juntzanh pat chi', icha ix aj skot t'a yich, icha chi' ix aj sk'ek'och t'a schon. Icha chi' ix ajpax yamaq'uil. Ha k'een k'een ix laj och t'ay te wach' yaj k'een stzeychaji icha yaj yechel. Ha k'een ix cheklajkan t'a spatik yet' t'a yool, polb'il k'een t'a k'een polum k'een.
Anheja' k'een ix kan t'a yich, a k'een k'een te wach' yaj sb'oi, a k'een ix kan t'ay, te niwak k'een. Ay k'een nanhal yoil metro sk'atul, ay pax k'een oxe' metro yet' 60 kentímetro sk'atul.
Ha t'a yib'anh k'een yich chi', ix och k'een k'een tzeyb'il icha wal yaj yechel. Ix ochpax te' k'ute' jochb'il yet' k'een k'een.

Ha t'a spatiktak jun niwan amak' chi', ix och ox tzol k'een k'een. Axo t'a yib'anh k'een ix ochpax jun tzol te' patzab' nab'a k'ute'. Ichanhej chi' ix aj sk'e t'a chaanh, icha ix aj sb'o jun ix och t'a spatiktak templo yet' pax jun ix b'o t'a yolelul sti' templo chi'.
Ay jun winh aj Tiro skuch Hiram ix yawtejkot winhaj rey Salomón chi'.

Ha jun winh chi', yune' winh jun ix chamnak yetb'eyum t'a yinhtilal Neftalí, aj Tiro winh smam winh, te jelan winh sb'oan k'een bronke. Anhejtona' te jelan pax spensar winh, yojtak winh sb'oan yalnhej tas munlajelal t'a k'een bronke chi'. Yuj chi' ix awtajkot winh yik smunlaj winh t'a winhaj rey Salomón sb'oan juntzanh tas nab'a bronke.
Ix sb'o chab' niwak oy winh, nab'a bronke ix aji, wajxaque' metro steel junjun, nanhal swaquil metro ix aj b'alan spatik junjun.
Ix sb'oanpax chab' sjolom chab' oy chi' winh. Ha steel juntzanh sjolom chi', chab' metro yet' 25 kentímetro ix aji.
Ha t'a spatiktak chab' sjolom chi' ix ak'jioch k'een kadena bronke, icha k'een malla yaj k'een sb'oi. Uque' ayoch t'a junjun sjolom chi'.
Ix sb'opax cha tzol icha yechel sat te' granado winh. Ix och t'a juntzanh kadena chi' yik tz'och t'a spatik junjun sjolom oy chi'. Lajannhej ix aj schab'il.
Ha juntzanh jolom oy chi', ay am chab'ok metro ayk'ei, lajan yilji icha anh chochol.

Ha chab' sjolom juntzanh oy chi' k'olan k'olan yaji. Axo t'a yib'anh, ata' ayk'e junxo icha anh chochol chi'. Ha b'aj tz'emul k'een kadena t'a spatiktak jun k'olan k'olan chi', ata' ayoch 200 yechel sat te' granado, cha tzol yajochi.

Ix yak'och chab' oy winhaj Hiram chi' t'a sat templo chi'. Ayic ix yak'anem winh t'a yet'tal, ay jun ix kan t'a ko k'exanh ayik tzonh och t'a yol templo chi', Jaquín ix yak' winh sb'iej. Axo junxo oy chi' ix kan t'a ko wach', Boaz ix yak' winh sb'iej.
Ha sjolom juntzanh oy chi', lajan yilji icha xumaquil anh chochol. Icha chi' ix aj juntzanh oy chi' sb'oan winhaj Hiram chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix sb'oan jun niwan pila nab'a bronke winhaj Hiram chi', yik b'aj smolchaj ha ha'. Suyansuyan ix aji, nanhal yoil metro ix aj slewanil sat. Axo ix ajk'e schaanhil steel, chab' metro yet' 25 kentímetro ix aji, haxo ix aj setan smasanil, 13 metro yet' nanhalxo.
Ha t'a yalanh sti' jun pila chi', ayoch chab' tzol yechel sattak te te' icha yilji te' tzima. Lajunhe' ix och t'a junjun 45 kentímetro, junnhej ix aj sb'o yet' jun pila chi'.

Ha jun pila chi' b'akhanem t'a yib' snanhal juntzanh yechel nok' mam wakax nab'a bronke. Ha juntzanh yechel nok' chi', oxe' k'elanb'at t'a stojolal sur, oxe' k'elanb'at t'a stojolal norte, oxe' k'elanb'at t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, oxe' pax k'elanb'at t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u. Ha yok juntzanh yechel wakax chi' aykanoch t'a yalanh jun pila chi'.
Ha jun pila chi' nab'a bronke ix aji, chanhek'ab'il spimal. Niwan yajel pechan sti' icha yilji xumaquil anh chochol. Ha t'a yol jun pila chi', tz'em 44 mil litro ha ha'.
Ix sb'oanpax lajunhe' karreta winh, nab'a bronke ix aj junjun. Jun metro yet' 80 kentímetro ix aj spak'ul schanhil, jun metro yet' 35 kentímetro ix ajk'e steel.
Ha juntzanh karreta chi', icha tik yaji: Ay chanhe' smarkoal, makan yoltak sat smarkoal chi'.
Ha t'a sat juntzanh chi' ayoch yechel nok' choj, nok' toro yet' yechel querubín. Ha t'a yib'anh yet' t'a yalanh juntzanh yechel chi', ata' ayoch yelwanub' smarkoal chi'.

Junjun karreta chi' ay chanhe' syantail nab'a bronke, chab' k'een k'een k'atanek' t'a yalanh syaman syantail chi'. Ha t'a schanhil schiquintak juntzanh karreta chi' t'a yib'anh, ay syamnub'al nab'a bronke, a syaman jun yune' pila ayem t'a yol jun karreta chi'. Ha juntzanh syamnub' chi' ayoch yelwanub'.

Axo t'a yol jun karreta chi', ayem jun icha niwan tubo, 45 kentímetro schaanhil ayk'eta t'a yib'anh sti' juntzanh karreta chi'. Aypaxoch yelwanub' spatiktak jun niwan tubo chi', haxo schanh pak'anhil jun karreta chi', manh setansetanoklaj.
Ha chanhe' syantail chi' ayoch t'a schiquintak schanhil. Axo pax juntzanh k'een k'een syaman syantail chi', yaman yaj k'een yet' smarkoal chi'. Ha syantail chi', 70 kentímetro yaj setan.
Lajan yaj sb'o juntzanh syantail chi' icha yik karruaje yik owal. Ha junjun syantail chi' yaman yaj yet' k'een k'een ayoch b'aj ay yolanil, nab'a bronke, junnhej yaj setan.
Ha chanhe' syamnub'al t'a schiquintak karreta chi', junnhej yaj yet' smarkoal junjun karreta.
Ha t'a yib'anh karreta chi', ay junxo setanoch t'a spatik sti', 23 kentímetro yajk'e schaanhil. Ha jantak tas ayoch t'a junjun karreta chi', junnhej yaj sb'o smasanil.
Ha t'a spak'ultak yoltak smarkoal chi', ix yak'och yechel querubín winhaj Hiram chi' t'ay, nok' choj yet' te' palma. Ix ochnhej yelwanub' chi' t'a spatiktak smasanil.
Icha chi' ix aj sb'o lajunhe' karreta chi', lajannhej ix aj smasanil, lajannhej yechel, lajannhej pax yilji.

Ix sb'oanpax lajunhe' yet'tal ha' yik juntzanh karreta chi' winh, nab'a bronke ix aji. Lajannhej yechel smasanil. Jun metro yet' 80 kentímetro yool junjun, 800 litro am ha' tz'em t'a yool. Junjun ay k'e t'a yib'anh skarretail.

Oye' juntzanh karreta chi' ix kan t'a stojolal ko wach' t'a templo, oye' pax ix kan t'a stojolal ko k'exanh. Axo jun niwan pila, ha t'a ko k'exanh koch t'a templo chi' ix kani, t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u.
Ixlajwi chi' ix sb'oanpax juntzanh chen, k'een pala yet' niwak uk'ab' winhaj Hiram chi'. Icha wal chi' ix aj slajwi sb'o smasanil juntzanh ix schek winhaj rey Salomón b'ojok yikok stemplo Jehová.
Aton masanil juntzanh tik ix chekji sb'o winhaj Hiram: Chab' niwak oy, chab' sjolom oy chi', juntzanh k'een kadena icha k'een malla nab'a bronke ayoch t'a spatiktak jolom oy chi',
yet' pax 400 yechel sat te' granado ayoch t'a juntzanh kadena chi'. Cha tzol yajoch t'a spatiktak chab' jolom oy chi'.
Lajunhe' karreta kuchjinak lajunhe' yet'tal ha',
jun niwan pila, lajchawe' yechel mam wakax kuchjinak,

juntzanh k'een chen, juntzanh k'een pala yet' juntzanh k'een niwak uk'ab'. Masanil juntzanh yamk'ab' tik ix sb'o winhaj Hiram t'a winhaj rey Salomón yikok stemplo Jehová, nab'a bronke to kopopi yilji.
Ix schek winh rey chi' b'ojok t'a moldeal t'a yak'likal sti' ha' Jordán t'a lum b'ak'uech lu'um, t'a skal snanhal Sucot yet' Saretán.
Te tzijtum yamk'ab' nab'a bronke, yuj chi' majxo yechtej winhaj rey Salomón chi' jantak yalil k'een bronke chi' ix k'anchaji.
Ix schekanpax winh rey chi' b'ojok masanil juntzanhxo yamk'ab' nab'a oro t'a yol stemplo Jehová: Jun altar, jun mexa b'aj tz'ak'jiem ixim pan t'a yichanh Jehová,

juntzanh b'akhnub' kandil yet' yelwanub' icha yechel xumaak, aton ayoch t'a yichanh lugar Yicnhej Jehová Yaji. Ay oye' t'a stojolal ko wach', ay oyexo t'a stojolal ko k'exanh, juntzanh kandil, juntzanh yamlab',

juntzanh kopa, juntzanh k'een ik'lab'el stanhil b'aj ayoch sk'ak'al kandil, juntzanh niwak uk'ab', juntzanh niwak kuchara yet' juntzanh chaynub' yik inkienso. Masanil juntzanh chi' nab'a oronhej. Axo k'een wisagre ayoch t'a spuertail jun lugar Yicnhej Jehová Yaji, aton t'a yol templo yet' pax yik spuertail templo chi', nab'a oronhej.

Ayic ix b'oel masanil tas ix schek winhaj Salomón b'ojok yik stemplo Jehová, ix schekan winh ik'jokb'at masanil k'een oro, k'een plata yet' juntzanh yamk'ab' yak'nakkan winhaj Dawid smam winh t'a Jehová. Ix schekan winh sik'chajkan t'a yol juntzanh pat ay t'a spatiktak templo b'aj sik'chaj tas tz'ochkan yikok Jehová.

Ha te' skaxail strato Jehová, ayek' te' t'a schonhab' winhaj Dawid skuchan Sion. Axo winhaj Salomón ix naani to syik'b'at te' winh t'a yol templo yakb'an molanek' masanil heb' anima t'a Jerusalén yuj snaankot q'uinh chinama heb' t'a yuquil uj skuchan Etanim. Yuj chi' ix smolb'an masanil heb' yichamtak winaquil chonhab' Israel winh, heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun yinhtilal heb' yet' heb' sat yaj t'a junjun makan heb'.
Axo heb' sakerdote yet' juntzanhxo heb' lewita ix ik'anb'at te' kaxa chi' yet' k'apak mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová yet' masanil yamk'ab' ayoch t'a yool chi'.
