Axo winhaj Salomón chi' yet' masanil heb' yetchonhab' Israel molanek' chi', ix b'ab'laj heb' t'a yichanh te' kaxa chi'. Yakb'an wan sb'at heb', manhxo b'ischajb'enok jantak nok' kalnel yet' nok' wakax ix yak' heb' silab'ok t'a Jehová.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'anb'at te' kaxa chi' heb' sakerdote t'a yol templo masanto t'a yol jun lugar Yicnhej Jehová Yaji, t'a snanhal chab' yechel querubín.
Jenhanb'at sk'axil chab' yechel querubín chi' t'a yib'anh b'aj ix ak'jioch te' kaxa chi'. Ha sk'axil heb' ayoch yenhulok te' kaxa chi' yet' te' sb'akhnub'al.

Ha te' regla ayoch sb'akhlab'ilok te' kaxa chi', najat steel te'. Scheclajelul snhi' te' t'a junxo kuarto ay t'a satelta, palta manhxo chequeloklaj te' t'a stieli. Ata' ix kanxonhej te' kaxa chi' t'a junelnhej.

Malaj junokxo tas ayem t'a yol te' kaxa chi', anhej wal chab' pachanh k'een k'een yak'nakkanem winhaj Moisés t'a yol te' t'a Horeb, aton k'een b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkanoch strato Jehová yet' heb' israel ayik yelnakkot heb' t'a Egipto.
Ayic ix elixta heb' sakerdote t'a yol templo chi', ix b'ud'jiel yol chi' yuj yasunal stziquiquial Jehová. Ha yuj jun asun chi', majxo yal-laj smunlaj heb' t'a yool chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix lesalwi winhaj rey Salomón, ix yalan winh icha tik: Mamin Jehová, ix ala' to t'a skal k’ik’ k’inal ayach.
Palta ix in b'ok'e jun a pat b'aj wach' tzach aji. Ix in b'o jun a pat yik tzach kajnaj t'ay t'a junelnhej, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzajb'at k'elan winh rey chi' t'a masanil heb' israel linhjab'och ta', ix sk'anan swach'k'olal Dios winh t'a yib'anh heb'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh: Aljokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, yujto toxo ix elk'och tas yalnakkan t'a winh in mam winhaj rey Dawid.

Ayic yalannak icha tik: Atax wik'annaquelta heb' in chonhab' t'a Egipto, mantalaj b'aj tzin sik'el junok chonhab' t'a he kal b'aj sb'ojik'e junok in pat b'aj tzin kajnaji. Anhej winhaj Dawid ix in sik'eli yik tz'och winh reyal t'a skal heb' in chonhab' Israel tik, xchi Jehová chi'.
Ha winh in mam chi', snib'ejnak winh sb'ok'e junok templo yuj sniwanil yelk'och Jehová ko Diosal.
Palta yalnak Jehová t'a winh icha tik: Ha jun tza na' chi' te wach', tza b'ok'e junok in pat alani,
palta manhokachlaj ol a b'ok'ei, ato junok uninal ol b'oank'eok, xchi t'a winh.

Yuj chi', a tiknaik tz'elk'och tas yalnak Jehová chi'. Icha wal ajnak yalan chi', icha wal chi' ix aj yelk'ochi. Ha in ix in ochkan sk'exulok winh in mam chi', ix in och sreyalok ko chonhab' tik, yuj chi' ix in b'ok'e jun templo b'aj tz'och ejmelal t'a Jehová ko Diosal.
Ha t'a yool chi' ix in b'okan jun lugar b'aj tz'aj te' skaxail trato sb'onak Jehová yet' heb' ko mam quicham ayik yik'annaquelta heb' t'a Egipto, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix k'och linhan winh t'a stz'ey yaltar Jehová t'a yichanh masanil heb' chonhab' israel, ix yik'anchaanh sk'ab' winh,

ix yalan winh icha tik: Mamin Jehová ko Diosal, malaj junokxo Dios lajan ed'ok t'a satcha’anh yet' t'a sat lu'um tik, yujto tzak'elk'och a trato. Tzak'an a wach'k'olal t'a mach sk'anab'ajan t'a smasanil sk'ool tas tzala'.
Toxo ix ak'elk'och tas alnakkan t'a winh in mam winh a chekab' aj Dawid. Manh tonhejok alnak, palta ha t'a jun k'u tik ix elk'och tas alnakkan chi'.

Yuj wal chi', Mamin Jehová ko Diosal, elokab'k'och tas alnak t'a winh in mam chi' to aynhej yinhtilal winh ol och t'a yol sdespacho, anhej tato tzach sk'anab'ajej heb', icha wal ajnak sk'anab'ajan winh in mam chi'.
Ha tiknaik jun, ach Jehová ko Diosal, elokab'k'och tas alnakkan t'a winh a chekab' chi'.
Palta, ¿yel am wal Mamin ol ach kajnaj t'a sat lu'um tik? Ina to max yab'laj satcha’anh b'aj syal a kajnaji, okxom wal jab' pat ix in b'ok'e tik t'ayach.
Wach'chom icha chi' ach in Diosal, palta maklej ab' in lesal yet' tas tzin k'an t'ayach, ab' tas swal t'ayach a in a chekab' in tik.
Tzin k'an wal t'ayach to max ik'el a sat t'a junjun k'u yet' t'a junjun ak'wal t'a templo tik, jun ix ala' to a t'ay ol ach b'inajok.

Maclej wal in lesal a in a chekab' in tik yet' yik heb' a chonhab' tik. Ayic tzonh lesalwi t'ayach tzonh kot k'elan t'a stojolal jun a templo tik, komonok tzab' t'a satcha’anh b'aj kajan ach, tzak'an lajwok ko chukal t'a quib'anh.
Q'uinalok ay junok mach tz'ak'jioch t'a yib'anh to ix och smul t'a junok yetanimail, tz'ik'jikoti yik syak'an sti' t'a yichanh altar t'a jun templo tik,

komonok tzab' t'a satcha’anh, tza ch'olb'itan t'a stojolal mach ay smul, tom a jun mach tz'ak'jioch t'a yib'anh chi', mato a jun mach tz'ak'anoch t'a yib'anh chi'. Ha achokab' tzak' syaelal jun mach ay smul chi', haxo pax jun mach malaj smul chi' jun, a achokab' tzak' cheklajok to malaj smul.
Q'uinalok ay b'aj tzonh yak' ganar heb' kajk'ool yujto ix och ko mul t'ayach, tato sko na ko b'a, skalan ko b'a t'ayach, sko k'anan niwank'olal ko b'a t'ayach t'a jun a templo tik,
komonok tzab' t'a satcha’anh, tzak'an niwank'olal ko mul. Tzak'an meltzaj heb' tz'ik'jib'at t'a ch'ok chonhab'il t'a ko lu'um tik, aton lum ak'nakkan t'a heb' ko mam quicham.

Q'uinalok maxtzak yak' nhab' yujto ix och ko mul t'ayach, palta tato elanhchamel tzonh lesalwi t'ayach t'a stojolal jun templo tik, skalan ko b'a t'ayach, sko naan ko b'a yuj ko mul chi' yuj yaelal tz'och t'a quib'anh chi',

komonok tzab' t'a satcha’anh tas skal a onh a chekab' onh tik to a chonhab' onh. Tzak'an lajwok ko mul chi', tza ch'oxan junok b'eyb'al wach' yik sko b'eyb'alej. Slajwi chi' jun, tzak'ankot nhab' t'a yib'anh lum lum ix ak' t'ayonh a chonhab' onh tik.

Q'uinalok sjawi wejel t'a ko lu'um tik, ma junok ilya, ma stakjiel tastak yuj k'ak', ma sjawi nok' k'ulub', ma junokxo makan nok' nok' t'a kawb'en, ma tz'em tz'aub' t'ay, ma sjawi oyan heb' ajk'ol t'a ko chonhab' tik, ma junokxo yalnhej tas sjawi t'a quib'anh,

sko nib'ej to tzab' tas sko k'an a onh a chonhab' onh tik. Ma yalnhej mach tz'awaj t'ayach yujto snachajel kuuj to wan kab'an syail yuj ko mul, ayik sko mojb'ankot ko k'ab' t'a stojolal jun templo tik, komonok tzab' ko lesal chi' t'a satcha’anh b'aj ayach. Tzak'an tup ko mul, tzonh a kolani yet' onh a ch'olb'itani, haxo ak'an spak chi' t'ayonh ato syala' tas kaji, yujto ojtak tas ay t'a ko pensar junjun onh.
Tato icha chi', ol ach ko k'anab'ajej ko masanil yakb'an pitzan onh t'a sat lum lum ak'nak tik t'a heb' ko mam quicham.

Ol yab'nhej heb' ch'ok chonhab'il sniwanil elk'ochi yet' jantak a wach'k'olal tzak' t'ayonh a onh a chonhab' onh tik, yuj chi' ay heb' ol jawok yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'ayach. Q'uinalok ay junok heb' skot t'a najat yik syak'an lesal t'a stojolal jun templo tik,

komonok tzab' tas syal chi' t'a satcha’anh b'aj ayach. Tzak'an tas sk'ana' yik wach' tzach yojtaquejel masanil chonhab', tzach sk'anab'ajan heb' icha tz'aj ach ko k'anab'ajan a onh a chonhab' onh tik. Icha chi' snachajel yuj heb' to a jun templo ix in b'ok'e tik iko'.

Q'uinalok a onh a chonhab' onh tik tzonh b'at kak' owal yet' heb' kajk'ool, yalnhej b'ajtil tzonh a chekb'ati, tato tzonh lesalwi t'ayach t'a stojolal jun a chonhab' sik'b'ilel tik uuj yet' t'a stojolal jun templo ix in b'okank'e tik t'ayach,
komonok tzab' ko lesal chi' t'a satcha’anh, tzak'anelk'och tas sko k'an chi'.

Ayic ol och ko mul t'ayach a onh a chonhab' onh tik, (yujto malaj junok anima max och smul), ol onh ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ool, tzonh yik'anb'at heb' t'a ch'ok chonhab'il t'a lak'an, ma najat yuj yowal a k'ool.

Tato sko na ko b'ha t'a smasanil ko k'ool yet' ko pensar, ayik ayonhek' t'a juntzanh ch'ok chonhab'il chi', tato sko k'an niwank'olal ko b'a t'ayach yujto snachajel kuuj to ix och ko mul, haxo tzonh lesalwikot t'a stojolal lum lum ak'nak t'a heb' ko mam quicham, aton jun chonhab' sik'b'ilel uj b'aj ix in b'ok'e jun templo tik t'ayach,
komonok tzab' ko lesal yet' tas sko k'an t'ayach b'aj ayach ek' t'a satcha’anh chi', tza b'oan yaj t'ayonh.

Tzak'an lajwok ko mul tz'och t'ayach yet' ko pital a onh a chonhab' onh tik. Tza k'exan spensar heb' tzonh ik'anb'at chi' yik tz'ok' sk'ol heb' t'ayonh, yujto a chonhab' kaji, ik onh. Ha ach ik'nak onh elta t'a Egipto b'aj ayonh och t'a syaelal.
Yuj chi' jun Mamin, ab' wal in lesal a in a chekab' in tik yet' slesal heb' wetchonhab' israel tik yujto ik onh. Maclej wal ab' Mamin Jehová ayik tzonh lesalwi t'ayach.

Yujto a ach onh a sik'naquel t'a skal juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik yik tzonh ochkan ikok, icha wal utej a chekannak yal winh a chekab' aj Moisés, ayik ik'annaquelta heb' ko mam quicham t'a Egipto, xchi winhaj Salomón chi' t'a slesal.
Cumanem winh t'a stz'ey altar, ayk'e sk'ab' winh t'a satcha’anh ayik ix lesalwi winh chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix k'e waan winh, ix yalan wach' lolonel winh t'a yib'anh heb' yetisraelal chi', te chaanh ix yal winh icha tik:
Aljokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová ix ak'an junk'olal t'ayonh, icha ajnak yalankani. Masanil tas wach' yalnakkan kuuj t'a winhaj Moisés schekab', ix elk'ochi.
Aynhejokab' ek' Jehová ko Diosal qued'ok, icha ajnak ek' yet' heb' ko mam quicham. Malajokab' b'ak'uinh tzonh yaktejkan ko ch'okoj.
Yak'okab'och Jehová t'a ko pensar to sko k'anab'ajej sk'ayb'ub'al yet' scheknab'il, aton juntzanh scheknak sk'anab'ajej heb' ko mam quicham.
Masanil tas ix in k'an t'a Jehová ko Diosal, naannhejokab' yuj t'a masanil tiempo. Aokab' tzin tanhwan a in schekab' in tik yet' a onh schonhab' onh tik yalnhej tas sjawi t'a quib'anh t'a junjun k'u,
yik wach' syojtaquejel masanil chonhab' t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik to a Jehová anhej Dios, malaj junokxo.
Yuj chi', anhejokab' t'a Jehová b'aj skak'och ko k'ool, sko k'anab'ajan sk'ayb'ub'al yet' scheknab'il, icha sko k'ulej tiknaik, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an silab' winh yet' masanil chonhab' Israel t'a Jehová.

Ay 22 mil nok' wakax yet' 120 mil nok' kalnel ix yak' winh silab'il d'ha Dios yuj sch'oxan sjunk'olal yet'ok. Icha chi' ix aj yochkan jun templo chi' t'a yopisio yuj winhaj Salomón chi' yet' masanil chonhab'.

Ha t'a jun k'u chi' ix sik'kanel snanhal yol yamaq'uil templo winh rey chi' yik snhusjitz'a nok' silab', sat awb'en tz'ak'ji ofrendail yet' xepual nok' silab' yik sch'oxan sjunk'olal heb' yet' Jehová, yujto a jun altar nab'a bronke ay t'a yamaq'uil templo chi', max yab'laj yujto te niwan juntzanh silab' chi' tz'ak'ji.

Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', uque' k'ual ix och q'uinh yuj winhaj rey Salomón chi' yet' masanil chonhab' t'a yichanh Jehová. Te tzijtum anima ix molchaji. Ix laj kot heb' t'a masanil yol smakb'en Israel, wach'chom te najat ichato t'a smojonal Hamat t'a norte masanto pax t'a ha ha' smojonal yet' Egipto t'a sur. Ayic ix lajwi uque' k'ual q'uinh chinama chi', ix schaanel yich uquexo k'ual q'uinh chi' heb', yuj chi' chab' semana ix yak' q'uinh chi' heb'.

Axo yik ix lajwi q'uinh chi' jun, ix tak'ajkan heb' anima chi' yuj winhaj rey Salomón chi'. Ix yalanpax wach' lolonel heb' t'a winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix pax heb' t'a spat. Ix te tzalaj heb' yuj masanil tas wach' ix sk'ulej Jehová yet' winh schekab' aj Dawid yet' heb' schonhab' Israel.
Ayic ix lajwi sb'oel stemplo Jehová yuj winhaj rey Salomón chi' yet' spalakio winh yet' pax juntzanhxo tas snib'ej winh sb'o'o,
ix sch'oxanxi sb'a Jehová t'a winh t'a schaelal, icha aj sch'oxan sb'ha t'a winh t'a chonhab' Gabaón.

Ix yalan Jehová chi' t'a winh: Ix wab' tas ix al t'a a lesal yet' masanil tas ix a k'ana'. Ix wak'kanoch jun templo ix a b'o tik wikok yik wach' a t'ay ol ochnhej ejmelal t'ayin. Ol in tanhwejnhej jun templo tik, ol in ajnhej ek' t'ay t'a masanil tiempo.

Yuj chi', tato wach'nhej ol utej a b'a t'ayin t'a smasanil a k'ool, icha yutejnak sb'a winhaj Dawid a mam, tato tzin ak'och yipok a k'ool, tojolnhej tzutej a b'a, tza k'anab'ajan masanil tas ix wak' a k'ulej, tza k'anab'ajan in k'ayb'ub'al yet' in cheknab'il,
a opisio tik ol b'eynhejb'at t'a heb' inhtilal icha ajnak walan t'a winh a mam chi', ayik walannak t'a winh icha tik: Aynhej inhtilal ol och reyal t'a skal heb' chonhab' israel, xin chi t'a winh.

Palta tato a ach tik yet' heb' inhtilal ol eyik'el he b'ha t'a in patik, manh ol he k'anab'ajej in cheknab'il yet' in k'ayb'ub'al ix wak' he k'anab'ajej, haxo t'a komon Dios ol ex och ejmelal, ol eyalan he b'a t'ay,
ol ex wik'el t'a sat lum lum wak'nak tik t'ayex. Axo jun templo ix in sik'kanoch wikok tik, ol in patiquejkaneli, ol ex b'uchjok yuj masanil nakión.

Ha jun templo te wach' yilji tik tiknaik, toxonhej ol k'ekan juyan k'een sk'eenal. Yuj chi' a heb' ol ek' t'a stz'ey, ol stzetzej heb', ol laj yal-lan heb' t'ay junjun: ¿Tas yuj icha tik ix utaj jun chonhab' yet' jun templo tik yuj Jehová? xcham heb'.

Axo ol yalan heb' anima chi' icha tik: Ha heb' israel tik, ix yik'el sb'a heb' t'a spatik Jehová sDiosal, aton jun ik'annaquelta heb' smam yicham heb' t'a Egipto. Axo tiknaik a juntzanh komon Dios ix yak'och heb' t'a sk'ool, ix ochpax heb' ejmelal t'ay, yuj chi' a sDiosal heb' chi' ix ak'ankot jun chukal tik t'a yib'anh heb', xcham heb' anima chi', xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Salomón chi'.
Ha winhaj Salomón chi', 20 ab'il ix yak' winh sb'oank'e chab' niwak pat, aton stemplo Jehová yet' pax spalakio winh.

Ha winhaj Hiram sreyal Tiro ix ak'ankot ste'al juntzanh pat chi', aton te' k'ute', te' taj yet' jantak k'een oro ix och t'ay. Yuj chi' 20 chonhab' t'a yol smakb'en Galaad ix yak' winhaj Salomón t'a winhaj Hiram chi'.
Ayic ix xid'ek' winhaj Hiram chi' yil juntzanh chonhab' chi', maj schalaj sk'ool winh.

Ix yalan winh icha tik: Ach wamigo, ¿tas chonhab'il juntzanh ix ak' tik t'ayin? xchi winh. Yuj chi' a jun makan lum lum t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', Cabul ix yak' winhaj Hiram chi' sb'iej lu'um, syalelk'ochi “Malaj wach' yochi”.
Axo jantak k'een oro ix yak' winhaj Hiram t'a winhaj Salomón chi' jun, ay am 90 quintalok k'een.

Ha winhaj rey Salomón chi', ix yak' wal pural winh yoch heb' yinhtilal heb' kananeo t'a munlajel, aton heb' maj yal satjiel yuj heb' israel ayik sjawinak heb' t'a Canaán chi'. Ha heb' chi' aton heb' amorreo, heb' hitita, heb' ferezeo, heb' heweo yet' heb' jebuseo. Ha juntzanh anima chi', chekab' yaj heb', manh yikoklaj sb'a heb'. Yuj smunlajel heb' ix sb'ok'e spalakio winh rey chi' yet' stemplo Jehová. Ix sb'oanpaxk'e smuroal Jerusalén heb'. Ix swach' b'oan juntzanhxo chonhab' heb', aton Hazor, Meguido yet' Gezer yik syal skolan sb'a heb' t'a owal. (Ha t'a yalanhtaxo a winh sreyal Egipto yak'nak owal winh t'a chonhab' Gezer chi', yak'annak ganar winh. Masanil heb' kananeo kajan ta' smilnakcham winh, snhusannakpaxtz'a chonhab' chi' winh. Ha jun chonhab' chi' ix yak' winh t'a ix yisil ayik ix yik'lan sb'a ix yet' winhaj Salomón chi'. Axo winhaj Salomón chi' ix b'oanxik'e yuj smunlajel heb' kananeo chi'.) Ix sb'oanpaxk'e chonhab' Bet-horón heb' t'a yalanh yet' Baalat yet' Tadmor ay t'a tzinan lum t'a yol yik Judá yet' juntzanhxo chonhab' b'aj smolchajkan tas tz'ab'laji yet' juntzanh chonhab' b'aj ay nok' chej stok'an karruaje yik owal. Ix sb'oanpaxk'e masanil juntzanhxo tas heb' ix schek winhaj Salomón sb'o heb' t'a Jerusalén, t'a Líbano yet' t'a smasanil yol smakb'en Israel chi'. Anhejtona' a heb' ix b'ut'an jun ch'olan t'a stojolal b'aj sk'eul k'u t'a Jerusalén chi'. Ix sb'o jun tik heb' ayik toxo ix el ix yisil winh sreyal Egipto, ix yetb'eyum winhaj Salomón t'a yol schonhab'kan winhaj Dawid, ix b'at kajnaj ix t'a spat ix sb'ok'e winhaj Salomón chi'. Maj yak'laj pural heb' yetisraelal winhaj Salomón chi' smunlaji. Ha tas ix sk'ulej heb', 550 heb' ix ak'jioch yil juntzanh munlajel chi'. Ix och heb' yajalil yet' winhaj Salomón chi', ix ochpax heb' sat yajalil t'a heb' soldado, yajalil t'a karruaje yik owal yet' t'a heb' soldado sk'e t'a yib'anh chej.

Oxtaquel syak' silab' winhaj rey Salomón chi' t'a Jehová t'a junjun ab'il, aton silab' snhusjitz'a smasanil yet' silab' yik junk'olal yet' Dios. Ha t'a altar ix sb'ok'e winh yikok Jehová, ata' ix yak' silab' chi' winh. Ix schekanpax winh nhusjoktz'a inkienso t'a yichanh Jehová ayik ix lajwi sb'oel jun templo chi'.
Ix schekanpax winh b'ojok juntzanh te' barko t'a Ezión-geber t'a slak'anil Elat, t'a sti' ha' Chacchac Mar t'a yol yik Edom.
Ha winhaj rey Hiram ix chekankot juntzanh heb' smunlajwum, aton heb' te k'aynak yek' t'a yib'anh ha' mar. Ix b'at heb' t'a yol te' barko chi' yet' heb' smunlajwum winhaj rey Salomón chi'.
Ix k'och heb' t'a Ofir, ata' ix yik'kot 310 quintal k'een oro heb' t'a winhaj rey Salomón chi'.

Ha ix sreinail chonhab' Sabá, ix yab' spekal ix to te b'inajnak winhaj rey Salomón yuj sjelanil syak' Jehová. Yuj chi' ix jawi ix t'a Jerusalén, yik syilan ix tato syal spakan juntzanh tas ajaltak sk'anb'ej ix t'a winh. Tzijtum heb' schekab' ix yet'nak, yet'nakpax nok' kamello ix. Al yaj nok' t'a perfume, t'a k'een oro yet' t'a juntzanh k'een k'een te wach' yilji. Ayic ix jawi ix t'a yichanh winhaj rey Salomón chi', ix sk'anb'an ix tas snib'ej sk'anb'ej chi' t'a winh.
Ix spakan winh masanil tas ix sk'anb'ej ix chi', malaj wal junok tas sk'anb'ej ix chi' to maj nachaj spakan winh.

Ix te sat sk'ol ix ayik ix yilan ix jantak sjelanil winh, yuj spalakio winh b'ob'il yuj, yuj pax tas swa winh t'a smexa yet' b'aj kajan heb' ayoch t'a yopisio yet' winh. Ch'okxo yilji pax spichul heb' schekab' winh, heb' sb'akhumalkot skopa winh yet' juntzanh silab' snhustz'a winh t'a stemplo Jehová. Ayic ix yilan juntzanh chi' ix, ix te sat sk'ool ix.
Yuj chi' ix yal ix t'a winhaj Salomón chi' icha tik: Ha tas ix wab' spekal t'a in chonhab' yuj masanil tastak tza k'ulej yet' a jelanil sb'inaji, a juntzanh chi' te yel.

Ayic manto wil juntzanh tik, max in chalaj wab'i, haxo tiknaik ix wil yet' in sat, max k'ochlaj nanhal juntzanh tik ix alji wab'i. Ha a jelanil yet' masanil tas ay t'ayach, yelxo wal ek'to t'a yichanh icha tas ix wab' chi'.
Te wach' yik heb' anima smunlaj t'ayach, te wach' pax yik heb' a chekab' ayek' ed'ok yik syab'an a jelanil heb'.

Aljokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová a Diosal, stzalaj ed'ok yuj chi' ix yak' smakb'en Israel tik t'ayach. Yujto te xajan chonhab' Israel tik yuj Jehová, yuj chi' ix ach yak'och reyal yik tzak'an yajalil t'a stojolal yet' t'a swach'il, xchi ix reina chi' t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an 90 quintal k'een oro ix, jantak perfume yet' k'een k'een te wach' yilji t'a winhaj rey Salomón chi'. Manhxa junelok ix jawi perfume t'a Israel icha jantak ix yak' ix t'a winh rey chi'.

Axo winh rey chi' ix ak'anpax masanil tas ix sk'an ix sreinail Sabá chi', ch'ok pax tas ix el t'a sk'ol winh yak'an t'a ix. Ixlajwi chi', ix meltzaj ix t'a schonhab' yet' heb' schekab' ajun yet'ok. Ay pax juntzanhxo tastak ix ik'jikot t'a yol te' sbarko winhaj rey Hiram, ix yik'kot k'een oro heb' t'a chonhab' Ofir. Manhxo jantakok te te' sándalo sb'i yet' k'een k'een te wach' yilji. Ha te' waranda ix och t'a stemplo Jehová yet' te' ix och t'a spalakio winhaj Salomón chi', ha t'a te' sándalo chi' ix yak' b'ojok te' winh. Ix b'ojipax te' arpa t'a te' yet' salterio yik heb' sb'itani. Manhxa junelokxo ix jawi jantak te' sándalo icha te' ix jawi junel chi'.
Ha k'een oro scha winhaj rey Salomón t'a junjun ab'il, 500 quintal k'een.
Ch'ok pax yaj k'een syak' heb' chonhwajum yet' pax k'een syak' heb' winh sreyal Arabia yet' heb' yajal t'a yol smakb'en Israel chi'.
Ix schek winh rey chi' b'ojok 200 niwak jenhan oro maklab' jul-lab', ay am lajchaweok libra k'een oro ix och t'a junjun.

Ixlajwi chi' ix schekanpax b'ojok 300-xo kotak smaklab'il jul-lab' chi' winh, ay am waqueok libra k'een oro ix och t'a junjun. Ix yak'och juntzanh chi' winh t'a yol jun pat skuchan Spatil Te te' yik Líbano.
Ix schekanpax winh b'ojok jun sk'ojnub' t'a sdespacho, ix ak'jioch k'een oro te wach' t'ay, ix ak'jipaxoch marfil yelwanub'ok.

Ha jun k'ojnub' chi', wak tzol sk'e sb'akhquiltaquil sk'oochal. Ay lajchawe' yechel nok' choj aykan t'a stitak jun k'ooch chi', waque' nok' t'a junjun stitak. Ha yelaw yich spatik jun k'ojnub' chi', setansetan yaji. Ha sk'ab' t'a junjun stz'eytak, ayoch junjun yechel nok' choj t'ay. Malaj junokxo rey b'oannak junok sk'ojnub' icha jun chi'.

Ha skopa winh rey chi', nab'a oro smasanil yet' jantak xalu yet' chen sk'anchaj t'a jun pat skuchan Spatil Te te' yik Líbano. Malaj junok yamk'ab' chi' plata, yujto ha t'a stiempoal winhaj rey Salomón chi', a k'een plata chi' malaj yelk'och k'een.

Ha winhaj Salomón chi', ay juntzanh te' sniwak barko winh tzek' yet' juntzanh te' yik winhaj Hiram. D'a junjun yoxil ab'il sjawi heb' schekab' winh yet' te' barko chi', yet'nak k'een oro heb', k'een plata, marfil, nok' chab'in yet' nok' pawo real.
Icha chi' ix aj ste k'echaanh winhaj rey Salomón chi' yuj sjelanil yet' sb'eyumal t'a yichanh juntzanhxo heb' rey t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik.
Masanil juntzanh chonhab', snib'ej heb' syila' yet' yab'an jantak sjelanil winh ix ak'ji yuj Dios.
Ha heb' anima sjawi t'a junjun ab'il, syik'kot juntzanh silab' tik heb': Q'uen plata, k'een oro, pichul karo stojol, yamk'ab' yik owal, juntzanh suk'uq'ui sjab', nok' chej yet' nok' mula.

Ix smolb'an jantak karruaje yik owal yet' nok' chej winhaj Salomón chi'. Ay mil 400 karruaje yet' 12 mil nok' chej sk'e heb' soldado t'a yib'anh. Ay karruaje yet' nok' chej chi' ayek' t'a juntzanh chonhab' to yiktaxon juntzanh chi' yaji. Ay pax juntzanhxo karruaje chi' ayek' yet' heb' soldado stanhwan winh rey chi' t'a Jerusalén.

Manhxo jantakok k'een plata ix smolb'ej winh rey chi' t'a Jerusalén chi', icha wal k'een komon k'een. Manhxo jantakok pax te' k'ute', icha te' kaltakte'al higo ay t'a spanhanil yichtak witz, icha chi' yaj te'.
Ha nok' schej winh rey chi', ha t'a Egipto skot nok' yet' t'a Cilicia, yujto a heb' schonhwajum winh, a heb' smanankot nok' ta'.

Ha junok karruaje smanchajkot t'a Egipto, 600 siklos plata stojol, haxo junok nok' chej, 150 siklos stojol nok'. Ha heb' winh sreyal hitita yet' heb' winh sreyal sirio smananpax nok' t'a heb' schonhwajum winhaj rey Salomón chi'.

Ha winhaj rey Salomón chi', manhoknhej ix yisil winh sreyal Egipto chi' ix yik' winh, palta ayto juntzanhxo heb' ix ix ch'ok chonhab'il ix yik' winh, aton heb' ix moabita, heb' ix amonita, heb' ix edomita, heb' ix aj Sidón yet' heb' ix hitita.

Yalnac Jehová to ay yowalil yik'lan sb'a heb' israel yet' juntzanh heb' ix chi', yik max montajb'at heb' yuj heb' ix t'a spatik juntzanh skomon diosal schonhab' heb' ix chi'. Palta haxo winhaj rey Salomón chi', ix kan snib'ej winh t'a heb' ix, ix yik'lan sb'a winh yet' heb' ix.
Ay 700 heb' ix yetb'eyum winh chi', yisil rey heb' ix. Ay pax 300 heb' ix schab'il yetb'eyum winh yaji. Ha yuj heb' ix chi' ix juwiel spensar winh.

Axo yik ix ichamwinakax winh, ix somchajb'at spensar winh yuj heb' ix. Ix montajb'at winh t'a spatik juntzanhxo komon Dios. Majxo yak'och spensar winh sik'lab'il t'a Jehová sDiosal icha yutejnak sb'a winhaj Dawid smam winh.
Ix och winh ejmelal t'a jun komon Dios skuch Astoret, ix sdiosal heb' aj Sidón yet' t'a junxo komon Dios skuch Milcom, sdiosal heb' amonita. Ha juntzanh chi' te yajb'ilel yuj Jehová.
Yuj chi', te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová chi', yujto manh k'anab'ajumoklaj ix yutej sb'a winh t'ay, manh lajanoklaj ix yutej sb'a winh icha yutejnak sb'a winh smam chi'.

Ha t'a jun tzalan t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a Jerusalén, ata' ix sb'ok'e stemplo sdiosal heb' moabita winh, aton jun skuchan Quemos. Ix sb'opax stemplo sdiosal heb' amonita winh, aton jun skuch Moloc. Ha juntzanh komon Dios chi' yajb'ilel yuj Jehová.
Ichanhej chi' ix sk'ulej winh yet' masanil heb' ix ix ch'ok chonhab'il ix yik'a', yik syak' silab' heb' ix yet' inkienso t'a sdiosal junjun.
Yuj chi' ix kot yowal Jehová sDiosal Israel t'a winhaj Salomón chi', yujto ix patikajkanel yuj winh, wach'chom chael sch'oxnak sb'ha t'a winh.
Ix yal Jehová t'a winh to ay yowalil yoch ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios, palta maj sk'anab'ajej winh sk'ulan tas ix yal Jehová chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yal Jehová chi' t'a winh icha tik: Yujto icha tik ix a k'ulej, maj a k'anab'ajej in trato yet' in cheknab'il walnak t'ayach, yuj chi' ol wik'ek' opisio tik, ol wak'an t'a junok heb' a chekab'.
Palta yujto xajan winh a mam wuuj, yuj chi' yakb'an pitzanachto, manh ol wik'ek'laj opisio tik, palta ha t'a jun uninal, ata' ol wik'eq'ui.
Manh ol wik'ek' yopisio chi' smasanil. Olto kan junok makan t'a yol sk'ab' yujto xajan winh in chekab' aj Dawid wuuj yet' chonhab' Jerusalén tik, yujto sik'b'ilel wuuj, xchi t'a winh.
Yuj chi' a Jehová ix ak'ankot jun winh ajk'ool t'a winhaj Salomón chi', aton winhaj Hadad yinhtilalkan heb' winh sreyal Edom.

Ha t'a yalanhtaxo, ayik yak'annak ganar chonhab' Edom chi' winhaj rey Dawid, a winhaj Joab yajalil heb' soldado b'at yet' jun makan heb' soldado Israel, yik b'at smukan heb' chamnak heb', waque' ujal kan heb' ta'. Yakb'an chi', swach' milancham masanil heb' winh winak aj Edom chi' heb'.
Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', yune' quelemto winhaj Hadad chi', palta elkan lemnaj winh, b'atkan winh yet' juntzanh heb' schekab' winh smam, sb'atkan heb' t'a Egipto.

El heb' t'a Madián, sk'och heb' t'a Parán. Ata' yik'b'at juntzanhxo heb' winh winak heb', sk'ochkan heb' t'a winh sreyal Egipto chi'. Ata' ak'ji spat heb', swael heb' yet' slum heb' yuj winh rey chi'.
Ha winhaj Hadad chi', te wach' snaan winh rey chi' t'a spatik winh, yuj chi' yak' jun ix smu' winh rey chi' yetb'eyumok winh, aton ix snulej ix reina Tahpenes.
Yalji jun yune' ix yet' winhaj Hadad chi', Genubat yak' ix sb'iej. Ha ix Tahpenes chi' ilan q'uib' jun unin chi' t'a spalakio winh rey chi', junnhej q'uib'nak yet' heb' yuninal winh rey chi'.

Axo yik yab'an spekal winhaj Hadad t'a Egipto chi' to a winhaj rey Dawid chamnakxo winh, chamnakxo pax winhaj Joab yajalil heb' soldado, yalan winh icha tik t'a winh sreyal Egipto chi': --Cha in meltzaj t'a in chonhab', xchi winh.

Stak'wi winh rey chi' t'a winh icha tik: --¿Tas yuj tza nib'ej tzach meltzaj t'a a chonhab' chi'? ¿Tom ay tas syak' palta t'ayach wuuj? xchi winh. Stak'wi winhaj Hadad chi': --Tz'akan yaj masanil t'ayin uuj, palta tzin tewi t'ayach to tzin a cha meltzajok, xchi winh. Yuj chi' chaji meltzaj winh yuj winh rey chi'. Ha winhaj Hadad chi' ix och ajk'olal t'a winhaj Salomón chi'.

Ay junxo winh skuchan Rezón yuninal winhaj Eliada, ha Dios ix ak'anoch t'a spensar winh, ix och winh ajk'olal t'a winhaj Salomón chi'. Ha winhaj Rezón chi' elnak lemnaj winh t'a winh sreyal, aton winhaj Hadad-ezer sreyal Soba.

Ayic yak'jinak ganar winhaj Hadad-ezer sreyal Soba chi' yet' smiljicham heb' soldado winh yuj winhaj rey Dawid, a winhaj Rezón chi' smolb'ej jun nhilanh heb' elk'um winh, yoch winh yajalok heb'. Sb'atkan kajan winh yet' heb' soldado chi' t'a Damasco, ata' ak'jioch winh reyal yuj heb'.
Ix te och winh ajk'olal t'a chonhab' Israel ayik ayoch winhaj Salomón chi' reyal, icha ix yutej sb'a winhaj Hadad sreyal Edom.

Ay pax junxo winh ayoch t'a yopisio yet' winhaj Salomón chi', ix meltzajoch winh ajk'olal t'a winh. Aton winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat aj Sere t'a yinhtilal heb' Efraín. Chamnacxo smam winh chi', haxo ix snun winh, Serúa sb'i ix.
Icha wal tik ix aj spitzwichaanh owal yuj winh: Ha winhaj rey Salomón chi' ix chekan b'ud'jok jun ch'olan yik wach' schalaj sb'a smuroal schonhab' winhaj rey Dawid.
Ha winhaj Jeroboam chi' te nhikan winh, ayik ix yilan winh rey chi' to te ay yelk'och winh t'a sat heb' yetchonhab', ix yak'anoch winh yajalil t'a heb' munlajwum yinhtilalkan José.

Ha junel ix elta winhaj Jeroboam chi' t'a stiel Jerusalén chi', k'okb'il ix schalaj sb'a winh yet' winhaj Ahías schekab' Dios, aj Silo. Ayoch jun sjukan pichul winhaj Ahías chi', te ak'to. Ix lolon heb' winh sch'okoj schawanhil.
Ix yik'anel jun sjukan pichul winhaj Ahías chi', lajchawe' ix yutej winh snhik'chitanb'ati.
Ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Jeroboam chi' icha tik: Cha lajunheok iko', yujto icha tik syal Jehová ko Diosal t'ayach: Ol wik'ek' smakb'en winhaj Salomón, haxo t'ayach ol wak' lajunheok inhtilal.
Palta yujto xajan winh in chekab' aj Dawid wuuj yet' pax chonhab' Jerusalén sik'b'ilel wuuj t'a skal masanil chonhab' Israel, yuj chi' olto wak'kan junok inhtilal t'a yinhtilal winhaj Salomón chi'.

Ha winhaj Salomón chi' ix in yaktejkan winh, ix och winh ejmelal t'a Astarté, ix sdiosal heb' aj Sidón yet' t'a Quemos sdiosal heb' moabita yet' t'a Milcom sdiosal heb' amonita. Te manhxa swach'il tas syutej sb'a winh t'a wichanh, maxtzak sk'anab'ajej in k'ayb'ub'al winh yet' in cheknab'il. Manh ichok yutejnak sb'a winhaj Dawid smam winh, manh ichokta' syutej sb'a winh.

Palta yakb'an pitzanto winh, manh ol wik'ek'laj yopisio winh tik t'a reyal. Yujto xajan winh in chekab' aj Dawid wuuj to in sik'naquel winh, sk'anab'ajejnak wal in cheknab'il winh yet' in k'ayb'ub'al.
Palta ha t'a jun winh yuninal winhaj Salomón chi' ol wik'ek' lajunheok inhtilal, ol wak'an t'ayach.
Junxonhej inhtilal ol wak'kan t'a winh yik wach' ayto mach ol naankot winh in chekab' aj Dawid t'a wichanh t'a Jerusalén tik, aton jun chonhab' in sik'nakkanel b'aj tz'och ejmelal t'ayin.
Ol ach wak'och reyal t'a yib'anh tas tza nib'ej, aton chonhab' Israel.

Yuj chi', tato ol a k'anab'ajej masanil tas tzin chek a k'ulej tik, tato tojolnhej pax ol utej a b'ha t'a wichanh, tato ol a k'anab'ajejnhej in k'ayb'ub'al yet' in cheknab'il, icha yutejnak sb'a winh in chekab' aj Dawid, tato icha chi', ayinnhej ek' ed'ok. Ol wak'nhej opisio, icha ajnak wak'an yopisio winh in chekab' aj Dawid chi', ol wak'anoch chonhab' Israel tik t'a yol a k'ab'.
Ol wak'och yaelal t'a yib'anh heb' yinhtilal winhaj Dawid junok tiempoal yujnhej smul winhaj Salomón chi', palta manh ol wak'kanochlaj t'a junelnhej, xchi Jehová t'ayach, xchi winhaj Ahías chi'.

Ha yuj tas ix yal Jehová chi', ix snib'ej winhaj Salomón smilcham winhaj Jeroboam chi'. Yuj chi' ix el lemnaj winh, ix b'atkan winh t'a Egipto b'aj ayoch winhaj Sisac reyal. Ix kannhej winh ta' masanto ix cham winhaj Salomón chi'.
Ha yab'ixal juntzanhxo tas sk'ulejnak winhaj Salomón chi' yet' sjelanil winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj tz'ib'ab'il yab'ixal winh.
Ha winhaj Salomón chi', 40 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén t'a yib'anh masanil chonhab' Israel.
Ayic ix cham winh, ix mukchaj winh t'a schonhab' winhaj Dawid winh smam. Ixlajwi chi' haxo jun yuninal winh skuchan Roboam ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ix b'at winhaj Roboam t'a Siquem, yujto ata' molanxo ek' masanil heb' yinhtilal Israel ay t'a stojolal norte yik syak'ankanoch winh heb' sreyalok.
Ix k'och spekal jun tik t'a winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat ayik ayek' winh t'a Egipto, yujto elnak lemnaj winh t'a winhaj rey Salomón chi'.
Ix schekan heb' israel chi' to b'at ik'chajkot winh. Axo yik ix jawi winh, ix b'at winh yet' masanil heb' yetisraelal lolonel yet' winhaj Roboam chi'. Ix yalan heb' t'a winh icha tik:

--Ha winh a mam te ek'al ya munlajel ix yak' winh ko k'ulej. Axo tiknaik jun, sko nib'ej to tzik'el jab'ok juntzanh munlajel te ya chi' t'a quib'anh, yik ol kak'och ko b'ha t'a yalanh a mandar, xchi heb'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Roboam chi': --Ha tiknaik paxanhek, chab'ejto tzex jax in eyila', swalan t'ayex tas tz'aji, xchi winh t'a heb'. Ix pax heb' anima chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix sk'anb'an winh rey chi' t'a heb' winh yichamtak winaquil chonhab' munlajnak yet' winh smam winh chi' icha tik: --¿Tas wal junok razón tzeyak' t'ayin, yik tzin pakan slolonel heb' anima tik? xchi winh t'a heb' winh.
Ix tak'wi heb' winh: --Tato tza nib'ej tzak' serwil jun chonhab' tik, wach' tzutej tak'wok a b'ha t'a heb', yik wach' ol yak'nhejoch sb'a heb' t'a yalanh a mandar, xchi heb' winh t'a winh.

Palta maj schalaj yab' winh tas ix yal heb' winh ichamtak winak chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix sk'anb'anxi winh t'a juntzanh heb' winh kelemtak winak jun ix q'uib' winh yet'ok, heb' winh ix och t'a yopisio yet' winh.

Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --¿Tas junok razón tzeyak' t'ayin, tas ol wutok in pakan slolonel heb' anima chi'? Snib'ej heb' swik'el jab'ok munlajel yet' juntzanhxo tas aykanoch t'a yib'anh heb' yuj winh in mam, xchi winh t'a heb' winh.

Ix tak'wi heb' winh kelemtak chi' t'a winh: --Ha heb' tz'alan chi' to tzik'el jab'ok munlajel aykanoch t'a yib'anh heb' yuj winh a mam chi', al t'a heb' icha tik: Ya munlajel b'aj yak'nak ex och winh in mam chi', a inxo pax tik, ek'alto syail b'aj ol ex wak'ochi.

Al yutejnak eyikatz winh in mam chi', a inxo pax tik, ek'alto ol wutej yalil eyikatz chi'. Ha winh in mam chi', anhej t'a nok' tz'uum smak'nak ex winh, a inxo pax tik, a nok' tz'uum ayoch k'een k'een t'a snhi' ol wak'lab'ej t'ayex, xa chi t'a heb', xchi heb' winh kelemtak chi'.
Axo t'a schab'jial chi', ix jax winhaj Jeroboam yet' masanil heb' chonhab' israel yil winhaj rey Roboam chi', icha ix aj yalan winh.
Axo winh rey chi', maj yal-laj winh icha ix aj yalan heb' winh ichamtak winak chi', palta te chuk ix yutej winh spakan t'a heb' chonhab' chi'.

Ha tas ix yal heb' winh kelemtak, a ix yal winh t'a heb', ix yalan winh icha tik: Al yutejnak eyikatz winh in mam chi', a inxo pax tik, ek'alto ol wutej yalil eyikatz chi'. Ha winh in mam chi', anhej t'a nok' tz'uum smak'nak ex winh, a inxo pax tik, a nok' tz'uum ayoch k'een k'een t'a snhi' ol wak'lab'ej t'ayex, xchi winh t'a heb' anima chi'.

Ayic ix yilan heb' israel chi' to maj schalaj yab' winh rey chi' tas ix yal heb', yuj chi' ix yalan heb' icha tik: Malaj kalan quik t'a yinhtilal winhaj Dawid. Malaj junok makan onh tzonh kan yet' yinhtilal winhaj Isaí. Conh paxek t'a ko pat. Olxo yilkan sb'a winhaj Dawid yet' yinhtilal tas sk'ulej, xchi heb'. Ix chekjib'at winhaj Adoram yuj winh rey chi' yik b'at lolon winh yet' heb' israel chi', yujto a winh ay yopisio skuchb'an heb' munlajwum yowalil smunlaji. Axo heb' israel chi', ix k'e somnaj heb', ix sjulk'enancham winh heb'. Axo yik ix yab'an jun chi' winhaj Roboam chi', ix k'e winh t'a yol skarruaje, ix kot lemnaj winh t'a Jerusalén. Ixlajwi chi', haxo masanil makanhil heb' israel ay t'a stojolal norte ix pax heb' t'a spat. Axonhej t'a heb' kajan t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá ix yak' reyal winhaj Roboam chi'. Ichaton chi' ix aj yik'anel sb'a heb' israel t'a yol sk'ab' yinhtilal winhaj Dawid. Icha chi' ix aj yelk'och tas yalnakkan Jehová t'a winh schekab', aton winhaj Ahías aj Silo, yuj winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat.

Ayic ix yab'an heb' israel to ayxo ek' winhaj Jeroboam t'a yol schonhab' heb', ix schekan heb' awtajkot winh yik sch'oxan sb'a winh t'a yichanh heb'. Ix yak'anoch winh heb' sreyalok. Axonhej heb' yinhtilal Judá ix kan yet' winhaj Roboam yixchiquin winhaj Dawid.

Ayic ix jax winhaj Roboam t'a Jerusalén chi', ix smolb'an 180 mil heb' soldado winh t'a yinhtilal Judá yet' t'a yinhtilal Benjamín yik syak'an owal heb' yet' heb' yetisraelal yik smeltzajxioch heb' t'a yalanh smandar winh yalani.
Palta ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Semaías schekab' icha tik:
Al t'a winhaj Roboam yuninal winhaj Salomón, sreyal Judá yet' t'a masanil heb' yinhtilal Judá chi', t'a yinhtilal Benjamín yet' t'a juntzanhxo heb' anima ayek' t'a skal heb':

Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Manh eyak' owal yet' heb' eyetisraelal chi', yujto a in ix el t'a in k'ool to icha chi' tz'aji. Meltzajanhec t'a he pat, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb', xchi t'a winh. Ayic ix yab'an heb' anima chi', ix meltzaj heb' icha ix aj yalan Jehová.
Ixlajwi chi', ix swach' b'oank'e chonhab' Siquem winhaj Jeroboam chi', aton ay t'a tzalquixtak t'a yol yik Efraín. Ata' ix kajnaj winh. Ix sb'oanpaxk'e chonhab' Penuel winh.
Ix snaan winh icha tik: Ha tiknaik tekan ol yik'xiek' in reyal tik jun winh yinhtilal winhaj Dawid.

Tato ol b'atnhej heb' anima tik yak' silab' t'a stemplo Jehová t'a Jerusalén, axom yak'anxioch spensar heb' t'a winhaj Roboam sreyal Judá. Ol am in smilcham heb', ol am b'atkan heb' smasanil yet' winhaj Roboam chi', xchi winh.

Axo yik ix lajwi slolon winh yet' heb' ayoch yajalil yet'ok, ix schekan winh b'ojok chab' yechel quelem wakax nab'a oro. Ix yalan winh t'a masanil anima icha tik: Ex wetisraelal, manhxo ex b'at t'a Jerusalén. Ajaltac he b'ati, ina wal ko diosal tik, aton ik'annak onh elta t'a Egipto, xchi winh t'a heb'.
Jun yechel wakax chi' ix yak'kan winh t'a chonhab' Betel, ix yak'ankan junxo winh t'a chonhab' Dan.
Ha yuj jun chi' ix och smul heb' anima chi', yujto ix b'at heb' t'a chonhab' Dan yak'em sb'ha t'a jun yechel chi'.
Ix sb'oanpaxk'e spatil sdiosal winh chi' t'a juntzanh lugar chaanh. Ix yak'anoch yopisio heb' komon anima winh t'a sakerdoteal, manh lewitaok heb'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'anoch jun q'uinh winh t'a 15 yoch swajxaquil uj yik jun ab'il chi' icha jun q'uinh tzek' t'a Judá. Ix yak'ank'e silab' winh t'a yib'anh altar t'a jun yechel wakax ix sb'o winh chi' t'a chonhab' Betel. Ix yak'anpaxoch heb' sakerdote chi' winh yilumalok spatil sdiosal ix sb'o t'a juntzanh lugar chaanh.

Yuj chi' ha t'a 15 yoch swajxaquil uj chi', ix yak'anoch jun q'uinh chi' winh, munil ix snaelta winh t'a yol yiko'. Ix yak'an silab' winh t'a yib'anh altar ix sb'o t'a chonhab' Betel chi'. Ha t'a jun k'u chi' ix snhuspaxtz'a inkienso winh t'a yib'anh altar chi'.
Ayic wan snhusantz'a inkienso winhaj Jeroboam t'a yib'anh altar t'a chonhab' Betel, ix k'och jun winh schekab' Dios t'a winh ix kot t'a Judá.

Ha wal Jehová ix chekan winh, yuj chi' te ow ix yutej winh yalan t'a altar chi', ix yalan winh: Ha ex tzeyak'em he b'ha t'a jun altar tik, a wal Jehová ix alani to ha t'a yinhtilal winhaj Dawid ay jun unin ol aljok. Ha jun chi', Josías ol sb'iej. Ha winh ol milancham juntzanh heb' winh sakerdote yik komon Dios t'a yib'anh jun altar tik, aton heb' snhusan inkienso t'a tik. Ol snhusanpaxtz'a sb'aquil anima winh t'a yib'anh, xchi Jehová, xchi winh schekab' chi'.

Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ix yal winh schekab' Dios chi' tas ol ujok yik sch'oxaneli to schekab' Jehová yaj winh. Ix yalan winh icha tik: Ha jun altar tik ol pojb'atok, haxo k'een taanh ayek' t'a yib'anh tik, ol tob'kanb'at k'een, xchi Jehová, xchi winh.

Ayek' winhaj rey Jeroboam t'a stz'ey altar chi', ayik ix yab'an winh masanil tas ix yal winh schekab' Dios yuj jun altar chi', ix yak'anb'at jekan sk'ab' winh sch'oxan winh schekab' Dios chi', ix yalan winh: Yamec jun winh tik, xchi winh. Palta a sk'ab' winh ix b'at jekan chi', ix tzatzb'ikanel lian, majxo yal-laj spakan sb'a.
Ha wal t'a jun rato chi' ix pojb'at jun altar chi', haxo jantak k'een taanh ay t'a yib'anh, ix tob'kanb'at k'een. Ix elk'och icha ix schek Jehová yal winh schekab' chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yal winh rey chi' t'a winh schekab' Dios chi': Swal t'ayach to tzach tewi t'a Jehová a Diosal wuuj, yik sb'oxikan in k'ab' tik, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix lesalwi winh chekab' chi' t'a Jehová, ix b'oxikan sk'ab' winh rey chi' ichataxon yaji.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winh schekab' Dios chi': --Conh wed' t'a in pat, ol ach wa jab'ok yakb'an tzin b'o jab'ok tas ol in siej t'ayach, xchi winh.
Palta ix tak'wi winh schekab' Dios chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Wach'chom nanhal tas ay t'ayach tzak' t'ayin, manh ol in b'atlaj ed'ok, max yalpax in wa'i, ma wuk'an ha ha' t'a jun lugar tik.
Yujto a Jehová ix alan t'ayin icha tik: Malaj jab'ok tas ol a wa''a, manh ol uk'ejpax jab'ok ha ha', manh ol ach meltzaj t'a b'e b'aj ol ach b'atok, xchi t'ayin, xchi winh chekab' chi'.
Ch'okxo jun b'e b'aj ix meltzaj winh schekab' Dios chi', manhxooklaj t'a jun b'e b'aj ix k'och winh t'a Betel chi'.

Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi' ay jun winh schekab' Dios te icham winakxo kajan t'a Betel chi'. Ha heb' yuninal winh ix alan t'ay tas ix sk'ulej winh schekab' Dios t'a Betel t'a jun k'u chi', aton winh ix kot t'a Judá. Ix yalanpax heb' t'a winh smam chi' tas ix yal winh chekab' chi' t'a winh rey chi'.
Ix sk'anb'an winh icham chi' t'a heb' yuninal chi' icha tik: --¿Tas b'eal b'aj ix b'at winh schekab' Dios chi'? xchi winh. Ix yalan heb' winh b'aja b'e b'aj ix b'at winh chi'.
Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh yuninal chi': --Hak'uekoch stz'um nok' in b'uru, xchi winh. Ixlajwi yoch stz'um nok' yuj heb', ix k'e winh t'a yib'anh nok',

ix b'at tzak'an winh t'a spatik winh schekab' Dios aj Judá chi'. Ix k'och winh t'a spatik winh ayik k'ojanem winh t'a yich jun te' mach', ix sk'anb'an winh t'a winh: --¿Tom a ach tik schekab' ach Dios ach kot t'a Judá? xchi winh. --Ha in toni, xchi.
--Conh wed' wa''el t'a in pat, xchi winh icham winak chi'.
Ix tak'wi winh schekab' Dios chi': Max yal-laj in b'ati yik tzin wa ed'ok, ma wuk'an ha' ed' t'a jun lugar tik.
Yujto icha tik ix aj yalan Jehová t'ayin: Malaj jab'ok tas ol a wa''a, manh ol uk'ejpax jab'ok ha ha', manh ol ach meltzaj t'a b'e b'aj ol ach b'atok, xchi t'ayin, xchi winh.

Palta ix yalanxi winh icham winak chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Ha in tik schekab' in pax Dios icha ach tik. Ha jun yángel Jehová ix alan t'ayin to tzach wik'b'at wa''el t'a in pat, swak'anpax ha' uk'ej, xchi winh. Palta tonhej ix yesej winh icham winak chi' t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winh schekab' Dios chi' yet' winh icham winak chi' t'a spat, ix wa winh, ix yuk'an ha' winh.
Vanto swa heb' winh, ix lolon Jehová t'a winh schekab' icham winakxo chi', ix yalani:
--Ix a pitej a b'a, maj a k'anab'ajej tas ix yal Jehová t'ayach,

yujto ix ach meltzaji, ix ach wa'i, ix uk'anpax ha' t'a jun lugar b'aj ix yal Jehová to max yal-laj. Yuj chi' jun, manh ol mukchaj a niwanil b'aj mukan heb' a mam icham, xchi winh icham winak chi' t'a winh.
Ayic ix lajwi swa'i yet' yuk'an ha' winh schekab' Dios ix kot t'a Judá chi', ix yak'anoch stz'uum jun nok' sb'uru winh icham winak chi', ix yak'an nok' winh t'a winh schekab' Dios chi'.

Ix pax winh schekab' Dios chi', palta haxo t'a yol b'e ix elta jun nok' choj t'a winh, ix miljicham winh yuj nok'. Ata' ix kan telan sniwanil winh, haxo nok' b'uru yet' nok' choj chi', ayek' nok' t'a stz'ey sniwanil winh chi'.

Ay juntzanh heb' winh winak ix ek' ta', ix yilan heb' winh to telanek' sniwanil jun chamnak t'a yol b'e chi', haxo nok' choj chi' ayek' nok' t'a stz'ey. Ix b'at heb' winh b'aj kajan winh icham winak schekab' Dios chi', ix yalan heb' winh tas ix yil heb' winh t'a yol b'e chi'.

Ayic ix yab'an winh icham winak chi', winh ix b'at ik'an meltzaj winh schekab' Dios t'a yol b'e chi', ix yalan winh: Aton winh schekab' Dios maj k'anab'ajan tas ix yal Dios chi', yuj chi' ix ak'jioch winh t'a yol sk'ab' nok' choj chi', ix tzilchitajb'at winh yuj nok', icha ix aj yalan Jehová, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winh t'a heb' yuninal to syak'och stz'uum junok nok' b'uru heb'. Ix yak'anoch stz'uum nok' heb'.

Ix b'at winh icham winak chi', ix k'och winh b'aj telan ek' sniwanil winh schekab' Dios chi' t'a yol b'e chi'. Ha nok' b'uru yet' nok' choj chi', ayek' nok' t'a stz'ey sniwanil winh chi'. Mantalaj jab'ok sniwanil winh schi nok' choj chi', malaj pax ix utaj nok' b'uru chi' yuj nok'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'ank'e waan sniwanil winh schekab' Dios aj Judá winh icham winak chi'. Ix yak'ank'e winh t'a yib'anh nok' sb'uru chi', ix yik'anb'at winh t'a schonhab' chi', yik tz'och winh t'a kusk'olal yuj, yik smukanpax winh.
Ha b'aj ijan ix mukji winh icham chi', ata' ix yak'och sniwanil winh schekab' Dios chi' winh. Ix te kus winh yet' heb' winh yuninal, ix yalan heb': Ay, ach kuk'tak, ob'iltak ach, xchi heb' winh.

Ayic toxo ix lajwi yak'ankanoch sniwanil winh chi' winh icham chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' yuninal chi': --Ayic ol in chamok, ol eyak'och in niwanil b'aj ix ochkan sniwanil winh schekab' Dios tik, junnhej tzeyutejkanoch in niwanil tik yet'ok.
Yujto yowalil ol elk'och tas ix schek Jehová yal winh t'a jun altar t'a Betel tik yet' t'a juntzanh lugar chaanh ay t'a yol yik Samaria tik, aton b'aj syak'em sb'a heb' anima, xchi winh.

Wach'chom ix uji juntzanh chi', palta a winhaj rey Jeroboam chi', maj yaktejkan masanil schuk b'eyb'al winh, ix yak'nhejoch heb' komon anima winh sakerdoteal t'a juntzanh komon Dios t'a juntzanh lugar chaanh. Yalnhej mach snib'ej winh tz'och sakerdoteal, syak'nhejoch yopisio heb' winh t'a juntzanh lugar chi'.
Ichaton chi' ix aj yochnhej smul winhaj Jeroboam yet' heb' yinhtilal, yuj chi' ix satel heb' smasanil.
Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', ix ilyaan winhaj Abías yuninal winhaj Jeroboam.

Ix yalan winhaj Jeroboam chi' t'a ix yetb'eyum icha tik: --Ha tiknaik ixik t'a Silo. Ata' kajan winhaj Ahías, winh schekab' Dios, aton winh aljinak to a in ol in ochkan reyal t'a jun chonhab' tik. Q'uexel a pichul yik wach' malaj mach ol naanok to wetb'eyum ach.
Ik'b'at lajunheok ixim niwak pan yet' juntzanh ixim k'oxox pan yet' junok xalu yal chab'. Ixic, k'anb'ej t'a winh yik syalan winh t'ayach tas ol aj winh unin tik, xchi winh t'a ix.
Icha chi' ix yutej sb'a ix. Ix sk'exel spichul ix, ix b'at ix t'a Silo chi'. Ix k'och ix t'a spat winhaj Ahías chi'. Ha winhaj Ahías chi', maxtzak yal-laj yilan winh, te icham winakxo winh.

Palta toxo ix yal Jehová t'a winh to ol k'och ix yetb'eyum winhaj Jeroboam sk'anb'ej yuj jun yune' chuk sk'ool. Ix yalanpax Jehová t'a winh tas ol yutok winh yalan t'a ix. Ix ak'ji yojtaquejel winh to ol sk'exel sb'a ix.
Ayic ix yab'an winh sk'anh sk'och ix t'a ti' pat, ix yalan winh: --Ach yetb'eyum winhaj Jeroboam, ochanh, ¿tas yuj ix a k'exel a b'a? Te kusk'olal tas ix chekji wal t'ayach.
Yuj chi' meltzajanh, al t'a winh etb'eyum chi' to a Jehová ko Diosal tz'alan t'a winh icha tik: Ix ach in sik'elta t'a skal heb' chonhab', ix ach wak'anoch yajalil t'a yib'anh heb'.

Ha in ix wik'ek' yopisio heb' yinhtilal winhaj Dawid, ix wak'an t'ayach, palta manh ichok yutejnak sb'a winh in chekab' aj Dawid chi' tzutej a b'a. Sk'anab'ajejnak in cheknab'il winh yet' smasanil sk'ool, a masanil tas sk'ulejnak winh, wach'nhej t'a wichanh.

Palta a achxo pax tik, yelxo wal te chuk tas tza k'ulej t'a yichanh juntzanhxo heb' yajal ek'nak ayik mantzak ach ochi. Ha ach tik ix a tzuntzej wal kot wowal, ix a b'o juntzanh k'een k'een a diosalok, ix in a patikaneli.

Yuj chi' ol wak'kot yaelal t'a yib'anh heb' inhtilal. Ol in satel masanil heb' winak t'a skal inhtilal t'a skal heb' israel tik, wach'chom chekab' yaji, ma yik sb'a, manhxa junok ol kanok. Pilan ol in satel inhtilal chi', icha tz'aj snhusjitz'a stza' nok' nok'.
Ha heb' ol cham t'a yol chonhab', a nok' tz'i' ol chianb'at heb'. Axo heb' ol cham t'a spatiktaquel chonhab' chi' jun, a nok' ostok ol chianb'at heb', xchi Jehová.
Ha achxo pax tik ach ix, paxanh t'a a pat. Anhej yik ol ach ochk'och tek'naj t'a yol sti' a chonhab' ol cham winh unin chi'.

Axo masanil heb' israel, ol kus heb' yuj winh, ol smukan winh heb', anhej wal jun yinhtilal winhaj Jeroboam chi' ol mukjok, yujto anhej jun chi' wach'tak wal t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal t'a skal heb' yinhtilal winh.
Ato yik b'ak'uinh ol yak'anxioch Jehová junokxo rey t'a ko kal tik, ha' ol satanel masanil yinhtilal winhaj Jeroboam t'a jun k'ual chi'.

Ol onh tzikub'tanhaj a onh israel onh tik yuj Jehová, icha wal tz'aj stzikub'tanhaj te' welek' yuj ha ha'. Ol onh ik'joquel t'a jun lum lum manh jantakok swach'il ak'b'il tik t'a heb' ko mam quicham. Ichato ol onh yumjokkanb'at t'a sk'axepalb'at ha' Éufrates, yujto ix ko b'o yechel jun komon Dios skuchan Asera. Yuj chi' sko tzuntzejkot yowal sk'ol Jehová t'a quib'anh.
Ha Jehová ol onh ak'anb'at t'a yol sk'ab' junxo nakión yujnhej smul winhaj Jeroboam syak'och chi'. Ha winh skuchb'anb'at ko chonhab' tik t'a chukal, xchi winhaj Ahías chi' t'a ix.
Ixlajwi chi' ix pax ix yetb'eyum winhaj Jeroboam chi', ix k'och ix t'a Tirsa. Ha wal yochk'och ix t'a yol sti' spat, ix cham winh unin chi'.
Masanil heb' israel ix mukan winh, ix och heb' t'a kusk'olal yuj winh icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Ahías schekab'.
Ha juntzanhxo yab'ixal winhaj rey Jeroboam, ayik ix yak'an owal winh yet' juntzanhxo tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yol stiempoal, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Ha winhaj Jeroboam chi', 22 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh. Axo yik ix cham winh, a jun winh yuninal winh skuchan Nadab ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.

Ha t'a Judá ix yak' reyal winhaj Roboam yuninal winhaj Salomón. 41 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal chi'. 17 ab'il ix yak' reyal chi' winh t'a Jerusalén, aton wal jun chonhab' chi' ix sik'el Jehová t'a skal masanil chonhab' t'a yol yik Israel yik tz'och ejmelal t'ay ta'. Naama sb'i ix snun winh, amonita ix.
Ha winhaj Roboam chi' yet' heb' aj Judá, te chuk tas ix sk'ulej heb' t'a yichanh Jehová. Ix ste tzuntzejkot yowal sk'ol Jehová heb' t'a yichanh tas sk'ulejnak heb' smam yicham heb',
yujto ix laj sb'oxi juntzanh lugar chaanh heb', aton b'aj tz'och heb' ejmelal yet' pax t'a yichtak te te' k'ayum xiil. Ix laj sb'oanpaxk'e k'een k'een heb' yechel komon Dios Asera.

Ay pax heb' winh winak ix k'ulan ajmulal yet' yetwinaquil yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a skomon diosal chi'. Ix sb'eyb'alej ajmulal heb' te yajb'entak, icha sk'ulejnak heb' ch'ok chonhab'il yik'naquel Jehová t'a yichanh heb' israel chi'.
Ayic yoilxo ab'il yoch winhaj Roboam chi' reyal, ix jawi winhaj Sisac sreyal Egipto yak' owal t'a Jerusalén.
Ix yik'anb'at masanil b'eyumal winh ay t'a stemplo Jehová, masanil b'eyumal ay t'a spalakio winh rey yet' masanil juntzanh k'een maklab' jul-lab' nab'a oro b'ob'ilkan yuj winhaj Salomón.

Ixlajwi chi', haxo k'een bronke ix schek b'ojok winhaj Roboam chi' sk'exulok juntzanh maklab' jul-lab' nab'a oro chi', ix yak'ankan winh t'a heb' yajalil heb' soldado ayoch stanhwumalok sti' spalakio winh.
Juntaquel sb'at winh rey chi' t'a stemplo Jehová, a heb' soldado chi', syik'b'at k'een maklab' jul-lab' chi' heb', haxo smeltzajxi heb' syak'anxikan k'een heb' t'a yet'tal.
Ha yab'ixal juntzanhxo tas sk'ulejnak winhaj Roboam chi', tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal masanil heb' winh sreyal Judá.
Aynhej owal t'a skal winhaj Roboam yet' winhaj Jeroboam.

Ayic ix cham winhaj Roboam chi', ix mukji winh b'aj mukan heb' smam yicham t'a schonhab' winhaj Dawid. Naama sb'i ix snun winh, amonita ix. Ixlajwi chi' haxo jun yuninal winh skuchan Abiam ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayic 18 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat reyal t'a Israel, ix och winhaj Abiam reyal t'a Judá.
Oxe' ab'il ix yak' reyal chi' winh t'a Jerusalén. Maaca sb'i ix snun winh, yisil ix winhaj Abisalom.

Ha winhaj Abiam chi', ix sb'eyb'alej chukal winh icha ix sk'ulej winh smam winh. Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová sDiosal. Maj sk'anab'ajej Jehová winh t'a smasanil sk'ool icha sk'ulejnak winhaj rey Dawid, aton winh smam icham winh.
Palta yujto xajan winhaj rey Dawid chi' yuj Jehová, yuj chi' maj satkanel yinhtilal winh. Ixto ochkan yinhtilal winh chi' reyal t'a Jerusalén. Anhejtona' ix skolkanel jun chonhab' chi' Jehová,

yujto te wach' yutejnak sb'a winhaj rey Dawid chi' t'a yichanh. Manh yik'nakoquel spensar winh t'a tas yalnak Jehová chi', anhej wal smul winh ochnak aton yuj tas ajnak smilan winhaj Urías hitita winh.

Ha winhaj Abiam chi', ix yak'nhej owal winh yet' winhaj Jeroboam chi', icha sk'ulejnak winhaj Roboam smam winh. Ha yab'ixal winhaj Abiam chi' yet' masanil tas sk'ulejnak winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá.
Axo yik ix cham winh, ix mukji winh t'a schonhab' winhaj Dawid, haxo jun winh yuninal winh skuchan Asa ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ha winhaj Asa, ix schael yich winh yak'an reyal t'a Judá, a wal yik 20 ab'il yoch winhaj Jeroboam chi' reyal t'a Israel.
Ha winhaj Asa chi', 41 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Maaca sb'i ix snun chichim winh, yisil ix winhaj Abisalom.
Te wach' tas ix sk'ulej winhaj rey Asa chi' t'a yichanh Jehová, icha wal ix sk'ulej winhaj rey Dawid smam icham winh.

Ix spechel masanil heb' winh winak winh t'a yol smakb'en chi', aton heb' winh sk'ulan ajmulal yet' yetwinaquil t'a juntzanh lugar b'aj tz'och ejmelal. Masanil juntzanh yechel komon Dios ix sb'o heb' smam yicham winh, ix laj satpaxel winh.

Ix yik'el sniwanil yelk'och ix snun chichim winh, aton ix Maaca. Ix schekpax winh mak'jokpoj jun yechel Asera yajb'entak yak'nak b'o ix snun chichim chi', ix schekan nhusjoktz'a winh t'a sti' ha' Cedrón.
Wach'chom maj yik'el winh masanil juntzanh lugar yik ejmelal t'a juntzanh lugar chaanh, palta te wach' ix yutej spensar winh t'a yichanh Jehová t'a masanil tiempo.
Ix yak'anpaxkanoch k'een oro winh yet' k'een plata b'aj sik'chajkan tas tz'ak'ji yikok Jehová yet' juntzanhxo yamk'ab' ix yak'kan winh smam winh yet' pax juntzanh ix sb'o winh.
Aynhej owal t'a skal winhaj Asa sreyal Judá yet' winhaj Baasa sreyal Israel.
Ix kot winhaj Baasa yak' owal t'a Judá, ix och ijan winh sb'oan skuartel t'a chonhab' Ramá, yik smakan b'e winh yik wach' manhxa mach syal sk'och t'a Judá chi'.

Yuj chi', haxo winhaj Asa chi' ix ik'anelta masanil k'een oro yet' k'een plata sik'b'iltokan t'a yol stemplo Jehová yet' t'a spalakio winh. Ix schekanb'at heb' ayoch t'a yopisio yet' winh yik sb'at yak'ankan k'een chi' heb' t'a winhaj Ben-adad sreyal Siria kajan t'a Damasco, aton winh yuninal winhaj Tabrimón, yixchiquin winhaj Hezión. Ha yet' k'een tumin chi', ix yalanb'at winh t'a winhaj Ben-adad chi' icha tik:

Co b'o junok ko trato, icha sk'ulejnak heb' ko mam quicham. Tik swak'b'at k'een oro yet' k'een plata in silab'ok t'ayach. Ak' lajwok a trato yet' winhaj Baasa sreyal Israel yik ol yaktej winh yak'an owal wed'ok, xchib'at winhaj Asa chi'.

Ix scha sk'ol winhaj Ben-adad chi' tas ix yalb'at winhaj rey Asa chi', yuj chi' ix schekkot heb' soldado winh yak' owal t'a yol yik Israel. Aton juntzanh chonhab' tik ix yak' ganar heb' soldado winh chi': Ijón, Dan, Abel-bet-maaka yet' masanil Cineret yet' masanil smakb'en Neftalí.
Ayic ix yab'an winhaj Baasa icha chi', ix yaktan winh sb'oank'e chonhab' Ramá, ix meltzaj winh t'a chonhab' Tirsa.

Yuj chi' ix smolb'ej masanil heb' winh aj Judá winhaj rey Asa chi', manhxa junok mach maj k'ochok. Ix yik'ankot jantak k'een k'een heb' yet' te te', aton juntzanh chi' wan yak'anoch winhaj Baasa yik sb'oank'e chonhab' Ramá chi'. Axo yet' juntzanh chi' ix sb'ok'e skuartel winhaj rey Asa chi' t'a chonhab' Geba t'a yol yik Benjamín yet' t'a chonhab' Mizpa.

Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Asa, juntzanh owal ix yak' ganar winh, masanil tas ix sk'ulej winh yet' juntzanh chonhab' ix sb'ok'e winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá. Axo yik ichamxo winh, ix och jun yab'il t'a yok winh.
Ayic ix cham winh, ix mukji winh t'a schonhab' winhaj rey Dawid b'aj mukan heb' smam yicham. Axo winh yuninal winh skuchan Josafat ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayic schab'ilxo ab'il yoch winhaj Asa reyal t'a Judá, ix schaanel yich winhaj Nadab yuninal winhaj Jeroboam yak'an reyal t'a Israel, chab' ab'il ix yak' reyal winh.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha sb'eyb'al winh smam winh ix sb'eyb'alej, aton winh kuchb'annakb'at heb' israel t'a chukal.

Palta haxo winhaj Baasa yuninal winhaj Ahías yinhtilal Isacar ix och ajk'olal t'a winhaj Nadab chi'. Ayic ix yak'an owal winhaj Nadab yet' heb' soldado Israel t'a chonhab' Gibetón, t'a yol yik heb' filisteo, ata' ix miljicham winh yuj winhaj Baasa chi'. Yuj chi' ayik yoxilxo ab'il yoch winhaj Asa reyal t'a Judá, ix schaanel yich winhaj Baasa chi' yak'an reyal t'a chonhab' Israel.

Anhej wal yik ix och winh reyal chi', ix smilancham masanil yinhtilal winhaj Jeroboam chi' winh, pilan ix cham heb' yuj winh, manhxa junok heb' ix kani, icha yalnakkan winhaj Ahías schekab' Jehová aj Silo.
Ix uji jun tik yuj smul winhaj Jeroboam ix yak'ochi ayik ix skuchb'anb'at heb' yetisraelal winh t'a chukal. Yuj chi' ix stzuntzajkot yowal sk'ol Jehová sDiosal chonhab' Israel yuj winh.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Nadab yet' masanil tas ix sk'ulej, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Ix ochnhej owal t'a skal winhaj Asa sreyal Judá yet' winhaj Baasa sreyal Israel.
Ayic yoxilxo ab'il yoch winhaj Asa reyal t'a Judá, ix schaanel yich winhaj Baasa yuninal winhaj Ahías yak'an reyal t'a Israel, t'a chonhab' Tirsa. 24 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh.
Masanil tas ix sk'ulej winh, te chuk t'a yichanh Jehová, icha sk'ulejnak winhaj Jeroboam, aton winh kuchb'annakb'at heb' israel t'a chukal.
Ixlajwi chi', ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Jehú, yuninal winhaj Hanani, yik b'at yalan winh t'a winhaj Baasa icha tik:

Te malaj elk'ochi, palta ach wik'chaanh, ix ach wak'anoch yajalil t'a in chonhab' Israel tik, palta haxo sb'eyb'al winhaj Jeroboam tza b'eyb'alej. Ix a kuchb'anb'at in chonhab' tik t'a chukal, yuj chi' ix he tzuntzejkot yowal in k'ool yuj he chukal chi'.
Yuj chi' ach Baasa, ol ach in satel yet' masanil inhtilal, icha ix wutej in satanel yinhtilal winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat.
Yalnhej mach heb' a k'ab' ok ol cham t'a yoltak chonhab', a nok' tz'i' ol chianb'at heb', haxo heb' ol cham t'a kaltak te', a nok' ostok ol chianb'at heb', xchi Jehová, xchi winhaj Jehú chi'.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Baasa chi' yet' jantak owal ix yak' ganar winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Axo yik ix cham winh, ix mukji winh t'a Tirsa, haxo jun winh yuninal winh skuchan Ela ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Jehú schekab', aton winh yuninal winhaj Hanani, tastak yaelal ol jawok t'a yib'anh winhaj Baasa yet' heb' yinhtilal yet' sk'ab' yok, yujto te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Yuj chi' ix stzuntzejkot yowal sk'ol Jehová chi' winh, icha sk'ulejnak winhaj Jeroboam. Ix kotpax yaelal t'a yib'anh winh yujto ix satel yinhtilal winhaj Jeroboam chi' winh.
Ayic 26 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Asa reyal t'a Judá, ix schaanel yich winhaj Ela yuninal winhaj Baasa yak'an reyal t'a Israel t'a chonhab' Tirsa. Chab' ab'il ix yak' reyal chi' winh.

Ay jun winh Zimri sb'i, yajal winh t'a nanhal heb' soldado tzek' yet' karruaje yik owal, a winh ix och ajk'olal t'a winhaj Ela chi'. Ay jun k'ual ayek' winhaj Ela chi' t'a Tirsa, t'a spat winhaj Arsa, winh tz'ilan spalakio winh rey. Axo ix aji, ix yuk' anh winh rey chi', ix k'e anh t'a sjolom winh.
Elanhchamel ix k'och winhaj Zimri chi', ix smilancham winh rey chi' winh, haxo winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh. Ix uji jun tik ayik 27 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Asa reyal t'a Judá.
Anhej wal yik ix och winhaj Zimri chi' reyal, ix smilancham masanil yinhtilal winhaj Baasa chi' winh. Manhxa junok winak ix kani, manhxa pax junok sk'ab' yok winh, ma junok yamigo winh ix kani.
Icha wal chi' ix aj satel masanil yinhtilal winhaj Baasa chi', icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Jehú yuj winhaj Baasa chi'.

Ha tas ix sk'ulej winhaj Baasa chi' yet' winhaj Ela yuninal winh, ix och smul heb' winh yuj skuchb'anb'at heb' israel yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios. Yuj chi' ix stzuntzejkot yowal sk'ool Jehová heb'.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Ela chi' yet' tastak ix sk'ulej winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.

Ayic 27 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Asa reyal t'a Judá, ix schaanel yich winhaj Zimri yak'an reyal t'a Tirsa, palta uquenhej k'ual ix yak' reyal chi' winh. Ha t'a juntzanh k'ual chi' ayek' heb' soldado yik Israel yak' owal t'a Gibetón t'a yol yik heb' filisteo.
Axo yik ix yab'an heb' soldado chi' to ix miljicham winh rey yuj winhaj Zimri, yuj chi' wal t'a jun k'u chi' ix yak'anoch winhaj Omri heb' sreyalok, aton winh yajalil heb'.
Yuj chi' ix yaktej winhaj Omri chi' yak'an owal yet' heb' soldado t'a Gibetón chi', haxo t'a chonhab' Tirsa ix k'och heb' yak' owal.
Axo ix yilan winhaj Zimri chi' to wan yak'ji ganar jun chonhab' chi', ix och winh t'a yol skuartel t'a yol spalakio, ix yak'anoch sk'ak'al winh. Icha chi' ix aj scham winh.
Icha chi' ix aji yujto te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, to a wal sb'eyb'al winhaj Jeroboam winh kuchb'annakb'at heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal, a ix sb'eyb'alej winh.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Zimri chi' yet' tas ix snachaanh winh t'a spatik winhaj Ela, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Ix spoj sb'a chonhab' Israel, cha poj ix aj heb': Jun makan heb', a winhaj Tibni yuninal winhaj Ginat snib'ej heb' tz'och reyal. Axo junxo makan heb', ix kan heb' yet' winhaj Omri.

Axo ix aji, a heb' ix kan yet' winhaj Omri chi', más jelan heb' t'a yichanh heb' ix och yet' winhaj Tibni chi', yuj chi' ix miljicham winhaj Tibni chi' yuj heb', haxo winhaj Omri chi' ix ochkan reyal.
Ayic 31 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Asa reyal t'a Judá, ix schaanel yich winhaj Omri chi' yak'an reyal t'a Israel. 12 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh, waque' ab'il ix ek' winh t'a Tirsa.

Ixlajwi chi' ix smanan jun lum tzalan winh t'a Samaria t'a winhaj Semer. Nanhal schab'il quintal k'een plata ix yak' winh stojolok lu'um. Axo ta' ix sb'ok'e jun chonhab' winh, Samaria ix yak' winh sb'iej, yujto Semer sb'i winh b'aj ix sman lum lum chi' winh.
Ha tas ix sk'ulej winhaj Omri chi', te chuk t'a yichanh Jehová, ek'b'al schukal t'a yichanh juntzanhxo heb' winh rey ek'nak.

Ix sb'eyb'alej sb'eyb'al winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat winh, winh kuchb'annakb'at heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios, yuj chi' stzuntzejnakkot yowal sk'ool Jehová Dios heb'.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Omri yet' tas ix sk'ulej yet' tastak ix yak' ganar winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Ayic ix cham winh, ix mukji winh t'a Samaria, haxo jun winh yuninal winh skuchan Acab ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayxo 38 ab'il yoch winhaj Asa reyal t'a Judá, ayik ix och winhaj Acab yuninal winhaj Omri reyal t'a Israel. 22 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a chonhab' Samaria.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, ek'b'al chukal ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh juntzanhxo heb' winh rey ek'nak.

Malaj yalan sb'eyb'al winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat t'a winh. Ek'b'al te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh chi', ix yik' ix Jezabel yisil winhaj Et-baal sreyal Sidón winh yetb'eyumok, ix ochpax winh ejmelal t'a jun komon Dios skuch Baal.
Ix sb'ok'e stemploal Baal chi' winh yet' jun altar t'a Samaria.

Ix sb'oanpaxk'e jun yechel komon Dios skuch Asera winh. Ix ste tzuntzejkot yowal sk'ol Jehová sDiosal Israel winh, yujto ek'b'al chuk ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh juntzanhxo heb' winh sreyal Israel ek'nak.

Ayic ayoch winhaj Acab chi' reyal, haxo winhaj Hiel aj Betel ix b'oanxik'e chonhab' Jericó. Ayic ix yak'anxiem yich jun chonhab' chi' winh, ix cham jun sb'ab'el yuninal winh skuch Abiram. Axo yik ix och spuertail, ix cham winhaj Segub slajwub' yuninal winh. Ix elk'och icha tas yalnakkan Jehová t'a winhaj Josué yuninal winhaj Nun.

Ay jun winh schekab' Dios skuchan Elías aj Tisbe t'a yol yik Galaad. Ha winh ix alan t'a winhaj rey Acab icha tik: Ha in tik schekab' in Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, a wal t'a yichanh Jehová swalkan t'ayach to manhxo ol yak'laj nhab' t'a jaye' ab'il tik, malaj jab'ok yal ak'wal ol emok, masanto a in ol wal junelxo, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Elías chi' icha tik:
--Elanh t'a tik, b'at k'ub'ejkanel a b'ha t'a sch'olanil sti' ha' Querit, aton ha' sk'ochkan t'ha ha' Jordán t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u.
Ha jun ha ha' chi' ol uk'ej, a inxo ol wal t'a nok' joj yik ol b'at nok' yak'kan a wael, xchi t'a winh.
Ix sk'anab'ajej winhaj Elías tas ix yal Jehová chi', ix b'at sk'ub'anel sb'a winh t'a sch'olanil sti' ha' Querit chi'.
Junjun q'uinhib'alil yet' junjun yemk'ualil syik'anb'at swael winh nok' joj chi' yet' schib'ej, haxo jun ha ha' chi' syuk' winh.
Palta ix k'och stiempoal ix tup ha ha' chi' yujto maxtzak yak'laj nhab'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Elías chi':
--Elanh t'a tik, ixikkan t'a chonhab' Sarepta t'a yol yik Sidón, tzach kan ta' junok tiempoal. Toxo ix wal t'a jun ix ix chamnakxo yetb'eyum to a ix ol ak'an a wael, xchi t'a winh.

Ix el winhaj Elías chi', ix b'atkan winh t'a Sarepta chi'. Ayic ix k'och winh t'a sti' chonhab', ix yilanb'at jun ix ix winh, chamnakxo yetb'eyum ix, wan smolan chab' te' b'olob' ix. Ix yawtankot ix winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: --Mamax el t'a a k'ool, b'at ik' junok waso ha' wuk'ej, xchi winh.
Vanxo sb'at ix yik'kot ha', ix awajxi winh t'a ix: --Tzin tewipax t'ayach to tzik'kot jab'ok pan in wa''a, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi ix: --Val t'a yichanh Jehová a Diosal swala', malaj jab'ok ixim pan b'ob'il wuuj, axonhej wal jun b'ech jab' warina yaab'ilkan wuj t'a yol jun xalu yet' jab' wakeite ay t'a yol yet'tal. Anhej ol in k'ochxok yet' chab' in b'olob' tik, ol in wach' b'oan jab' warina chi' in wa yet' tzun wune' tik, ol lajwok chi', ol ko tanhwan cham ko b'a yuj wejel, xchi ix.

Ix yalan winhaj Elías chi' t'a ix icha tik: --Manh ach xiwok. Ixic, b'at b'o ixim icha ix aj alan chi', palta to tza b'ab'laj b'oej junok wik t'a jab' harina chi', tzik'ankot t'ayin, slajwi chi' ol a b'oan ik ol a wa yet' winh unin chi'.

Yujto toxo ix yal Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik to manh ol lajwok jab' harina ayem t'a yol a xalu chi' yet' jab' akeite ayem t'a yol yet'tal chi', masanto yik ol yak'anxikot nhab' Jehová, xchi winh t'a ix.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at ix sb'o icha ix aj yalan winh chi'. Jantacnhej tiempo ix yak' jun wejel chi', ix wa winh yet' ix yet' pax heb' ayek' yet' ix t'a spat chi'.
Maj lajwiel-laj jab' yarina ix chi' yet' jab' yakeite chi', icha ix aj yalan winhaj Elías chi' yuj Jehová.
Ix ek' jun pekti’, ix ilyaan jun yune' ix chi'. Te ow ix aj jun syaelal chi', ix chami.
Ix yalan ix t'a winhaj Elías chi' icha tik: --Ach schekab' Dios, ¿tas alan ik t'ayin? ¿Tom yuj snachajkot in mul yet' scham tzun wune' tik, yuj chi' ach jawi? xchi ix.
--Ik'kot winh une' chi' t'ayin, xchi winhaj Elías chi' t'a ix. Ix schaanek' winh unin chi' winh t'a ix, ix yik'ank'e winh t'a yol skuarto, ix yak'anek' jichan winh t'a sat sch'at.
Val chi' ix yalan winh t'a Jehová icha tik: Mamin Jehová in Diosal, ¿tas yuj tzak'kot kusk'olal t'a yib'anh ix ix tz'ak'an in posado tik, tza chaan cham winh yune' ix tik? xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', oxel ix b'at lachan winh t'a yib'anh winh unin chi', ix yalan winh t'a Jehová: Mamin Jehová in Diosal, tzin k'an t'ayach to tzak'xi sk'inal winh unin tik, xchi winh.
Ix yab'an Jehová tas ix yal winh chi', ix jax sk'ool winh unin chi'.
Elanhchamel ix yik'emta winh unin chi' winh b'aj aykan ix snun chi', ix yak'anxi winh t'a ix, ix yalan winh: --Ilnab'i, toxo ix jax sk'ool winh une' tik, xchi winh.
Ix yalan ix t'a winh: --Ha tiknaik swak'och t'a in k'ool to yel schekab' ach ton Jehová Dios, a tas schek ala', tz'elnhejk'ochi, xchi ix.
Ix ek'b'at oxe' ab'il, ix lolonxi Jehová t'a winhaj Elías chi' icha tik: B'at ch'ox a b'ha t'a winhaj Acab yujto ol wak'xib'at k 'inal nhab', xchi t'a winh.
Ix b'at winh sch'ox sb'ha t'a winhaj rey Acab chi'. Ha t'a Samaria te ow yak'an wejel.

Ha winhaj Acab chi' ix awtan winhaj Abdías, winh ayoch yilumalok spalakio winh. Ix yalan winh t'a winh icha tik: --Conh, b'at ko say quila', tope ay b'aj ay ha ha' t'a yol ko makb'en tik, b'aj sko say jab'ok yanh nok' ko chej, yik manh ol cham nok' yuj wejel, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix spoj sb'a heb' winh, ch'okch'ok b'aj ix b'atkan junjun heb' winh. Ha winhaj Abdías chi', aynhej xiwk'olal winh t'a Jehová. Ha t'a yalanhtaxo, ayik ix schekan ix Jezabel yetb'eyum winhaj Acab chi' to smiljicham heb' winh schekab' Jehová, a winhaj Abdías chi' ix k'ub'anel 100 heb' winh schekab' Jehová chi'. Chab' makan ix aj heb' winh yuj winh, 50 tak ix aj heb' winh. Ix b'at winh sk'ub'ejel heb' winh t'a yol chab' k'een nhak'een, haxo winh sb'at ak'an tas swa heb' winh yet' tas syuk'ej heb' winh t'a jun pekti’ chi'.

Ayic wan yek' winhaj Abdías sayoj yanh chej chi', ix schalaj sb'a winh yet' winhaj Elías chi'. Ayic ix yilanoch winhaj Elías chi' winh, ix em nhojan winh t'a yichanh winh, ix yalan winh: --Mamin, ¿tok a ach tik Elías ach? xchi winh.
--I' a in toni. Ixic al t'a winhaj Acab to ayinek' t'a tik, xchi winhaj Elías chi'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Abdías chi': --¿Tas in mul yuj chi' tzin ak'och t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Acab yik tzin smilancham winh?

D'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal swal t'ayach to malaj junok nakión b'aj maj ach sayjiek' yuj winh rey chi'. Ayic ix yalan heb' winh rey chi' to malaj ach ayach ek' t'a yol smakb'en heb' winh, ix yalan winhaj Acab chi' to syak' sti' heb' winh tato yel malaj ach ayach ek' ta'.
Axo tiknaik tzalan t'ayin to sb'at wal t'a winh rey chi' to ayach ek' t'a tik.

Axom ol ajok, anhej yik tzin el t'a a tz'ey tik, haxo Yespíritu Dios ol ach ik'anb'atok. Ma chequel b'ajtom ol ach k'ochok, haxo yik ol in k'och wal t'a winhaj Acab chi', ol kot winh ach saya'. Tato manhxo ach ayok ek' t'a tik, axom in smilancham winh chi' uuj. Ha in a chekab' in tik, yiktax quelem into aynhej in xiwk'olal t'a Jehová.

¿Tom manta mach tz'alan t'ayach tas ix aj in kolan heb' winh schekab' Jehová t'a ix Jezabel ayik wan smiljicham heb' winh yuj ix? Ix in k'ub'ejel 100 heb' winh t'a yol chab' k'een nhak'een, 50 tak ix wutej in k'ub'anel heb' winh, ix wak'an tas swa heb' winh yet' tas ix yuk'ej heb' winh.
Axo tiknaik tzalani to sb'at wal t'a winh rey chi' to ayachek' t'a tik, axom in smilancham winh chi', xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Elías chi': --Val t'a yichanh Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil swal t'ayach, jun swak' serwil to ha t'a jun k'u tik yowalil tzin lolon yet' winhaj Acab chi', xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winhaj Abdías chi' yal t'a winhaj rey Acab chi'. Axo yik ix yab'an jun chi' winhaj Acab chi', ix kot winh scha winhaj Elías chi'.
Axo yik ix ilchaj winhaj Elías chi' yuj winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: --¿Tom a ach wan ixtan chonhab' Israel tik? xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Elías chi' t'a winh icha tik: Manhok in laj wan wixtan jun chonhab' tik, palta a ach yet' masanil heb' a k'ab' ok, yujto ix eyaktejkan scheknab'il Jehová. Axo t'a komon Dios Baal tzex och ejmelal.

Ha tiknaik, chekb'at yik'umal heb' quetisraelal yet' 450 heb' winh schekab' Baal yet' pax 400 heb' winh schekab' ix Dios Asera, aton heb' winh tz'ak'ji wa yuj ix Jezabel. Ol in chalaj in b'a yet' heb' winh t'a jolom witz Carmelo, xchi winh t'a winh rey chi'.
Yuj chi' ix schekan winhaj Acab chi' molb'aj masanil heb' winh schekab' komon Dios Baal t'a yol smakb'en Israel t'a jolom witz Carmelo.

Ixlajwi chi', ix k'och winhaj Elías chi' t'a skal heb' anima chi' smasanil, ix yalan winh t'a heb' icha tik: --¿B'aq'uinh wal ol eyaktejkan somsoman he pensar? Tato a Jehová to yel Dios toni, anhejokab' t'ay tzex och ejmelal. Tato a Baal chi' Dios pax jun, anhejokab' t'ay tzeyak'em he b'a, xchi winh. Axo heb' anima chi' maj tak'woklaj heb'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Elías chi' icha tik: --Ha t'a skal masanil heb' winh schekab' Jehová, a inxonhej pitzan in, haxo pax heb' winh yik Baal, ay 450 heb' winh.

Yuj chi', ik'ekkot chawanhok nok' mam wakax, sik'lan heb' winh schekab' Baal chi' junok nok' yiko', skotak xikanb'at nok' heb' winh, syak'ank'e nok' heb' winh t'a yib'anh te' k'atzitz, palta max yak'ochlaj sk'ak'al te' k'atzitz chi' heb' winh. Ha inxo ol in b'opax junxo nok' chi', ol wak'anpaxk'e nok' t'a yib'anh te' k'atzitz, anheja' malaj sk'ak'al ol wak'ochi.

Slajwi chi', ol awaj heb' winh t'a sdiosal chi', anheja' in pax tik ol in awaj t'a Jehová in Diosal. Ha junok Dios ol ak'ankot k'ak' t'a yib'anh nok' silab' chi', aton jun chi' Dios t'a yel, xchi winh t'a heb'. --Te wach' ton ix aj a naan chi', xchi heb' anima chi' smasanil.

Ix yalan winhaj Elías chi' t'a heb' winh schekab' Baal chi' icha tik: --Sik'equel junok nok' mam wakax tik tze b'oan nok', a ex ol he b'ab'laj b'oej eyik chi' yujto tzijtum ex, palta manh eyak'ochlaj sk'ak'al. Slajwi chi' tzex awaj t'a he diosal chi', xchi winh.

Ix smilancham nok' yik heb' winh chi', ix sb'oan nok' heb' winh. Ix syamanoch heb' winh yawaj t'a sdiosal chi' t'a q'uinhib'alil, anheja' yawaj heb' winh masanto ix och chimk'ualil, syalan heb' winh icha tik: Tak'wanh t'ayonh Baal, xchi heb' winh. Sk'e chennaj heb' winh, tzek' oyoyok heb' winh t'a spatik altar b'aj ayk'e silab' ix sb'o chi', malaj mach stak'wi t'a heb' winh.

Axo yik ix och chimk'ualil, ix syamanoch winhaj Elías chi' sb'uchwaj t'a heb' winh: --Más chaanh tzex awaji, yujto Dios jun, tekan ay tas wan sk'ulani, mato ayb'at chuljel, ma ay b'aj ayb'at schek sb'a, mato jun, waynak, pitzequel swayanh, xchi winh.
Ix ochxi ijan heb' winh yawaj chaanh, ix laj spolan sb'a heb' winh t'a k'een kuchilub' yet' t'a k'een kotak lanza, ichataxon sb'eyb'al heb' winh, chik'takxonhej ix aj heb' winh.
Ix ek' chimk'ualil, anheja' yel yaw heb' winh, sk'e chennaj heb' winh masanto ayik wan sk'och yorail tz'ak'ji silab' t'a Jehová t'a yemk'ualil. Palta malaj mach ix ab'an tas ix yal heb' winh chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj Elías chi' t'a heb' anima chi': --Cotanhec t'a in tz'ey tik, xchi winh. Ix snitzanb'at sb'a masanil heb' anima chi' t'a stz'ey winh, ix syamanoch winh sb'oanxik'e jun altar yik Jehová jub'ileli.
Ix yik'ankot lajchawe' k'een k'een winh, yujto icha chi' sb'isul heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jacob, aton winh yalnak Jehová t'ay to Israel sb'iejkani.
Ix sb'oan jun altar chi' winh t'a Jehová t'a k'een k'een chi', ix sjoyan jun sanja winh t'a spatiktak jun altar chi', chanhe' am galón ha' tz'em t'a yool.
Ix sb'oank'e te' k'atzitz winh t'a yib'anh altar chi', ix skotak xikanb'at nok' wakax chi' winh, ix yak'ank'e nok' winh t'a yib'anh te' k'atzitz chi'.

Ix yalan winh: --B'ud'ek chanheok ch'ub' t'a ha ha', tze tob'anb'at ha' t'a yib'anh nok' silab' chi' yet' t'a yib'anh te' sk'atzitzal chi', xchi winh. Ix yalanxi winh t'a heb' to syik'kot ha' heb' t'a schaelal. Ix yik'anxikot ha' heb'. Ix yalanxi winh to syik'xikot ha' heb' t'a yoxelal, ix sb'oan heb' icha tas ix yal winh chi'.
Ix el yok ha' t'a spatiktak altar chi', masanto ix b'ud'jikan jun sanja chi'.

Ayic ix k'och yorail ichataxon yik tz'ak'ji silab' t'a yemk'ualil, ix snitzanoch sb'a winhaj Elías chi' t'a stz'ey altar chi', ix yalan winh: Mamin Jehová sDiosal ach winhaj Abraham, winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Israel. Ha tiknaik ojtakajokab'eli to a ach ton ko Diosal ach a onh israel onh tik, a inxo tik to a chekab' in, a ach ix a chek in k'ulej juntzanh tik.
Mamin Jehová, tak'wanh t'ayin, yik wach' ol yojtaquejel juntzanh anima tik to a achnhej ton Dios ach, tzik'anxi meltzaj spensar heb' t'ayach, xchi winh.
Val t'a jun rato chi' ix kot kopnaj k'ak' t'a satcha’anh yuj Jehová, ix tz'ab'at nok' silab' chi' yet' te' k'atzitz chi' yet' k'een k'een yet' lum pokok, ix tupb'atpax ha ha' t'a yol sanja chi'.
Ayic ix yilan heb' anima tas ix uji chi', ix sjulanek' telnaj sb'a heb' t'a sat lu'um, ix laj awaj chaanh heb': Anhej Jehová yel Dios toni, xchixonhej heb'.

Ix yalan winhaj Elías chi' t'a heb': --Yamec heb' winh schekab' Baal tik. Malajokab' junok heb' winh tz'eli, xchi winh. Ix yamji heb' winh yuj heb' anima chi', ix schekan winh ik'chajb'at heb' winh t'a sti' ha' Cisón. Ata' ix miljicham heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Elías t'a winhaj Acab icha tik: --Ixic, b'at wa''anh, tzuk'an ha', yujto wan sk'anh sjawi jun niwan yaxnhab' swab'i, xchi winh.

Ix b'at winhaj Acab chi', ix wa winh, ix yuk'an ha' winh. Axo winhaj Elías chi', ix k'ex winh t'a jolom witz Carmelo chi', ix em kuman winh ta' lesal, ix emk'och snanhal sat winh t'a skal sjolom spenek.

Ix yalan winh t'a winh schekab' icha tik: --Q'ueanh t'a jolom witz chi', tzach b'at k'elan t'a yib'anh ha' mar, xchi winh. Ix k'ek'och winh schekab' winh chi', ix yilanb'at winh t'a yib'anh ha' mar chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix jax winh t'a winhaj Elías chi', ix yalan winh: --Malaj jab'ok tas ix wila'', xchi winh. Uquel ix chekjib'at winh yil yuj winhaj Elías chi'.

Ayic ix lajwi xid'ek' winh t'a yuquelal chi', ix yalan winh: --Ay wal tzin jab' asun t'a yib'anh ha' mar chi', smuslaj yuj junok ko k'ab', xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Elías chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Ixic al t'a winhaj Acab to syak' lista nok' schej winh stok'an karruaje yik spax winh, tato maay, majxo ta yal sk'och winh t'a spat yuj nhab', xchi winh.
Ix k'e winhaj Acab chi' t'a yol skarruaje yik sb'at t'a Jezreel. Vanto wal sb'at winh ix k'ik'b'iel satchanh yuj asun, ix kot ik' te ow, ix kot jun niwan yaxnhab'.

Axo Jehová ix och yet' winhaj Elías chi', elanhchamel ix stok'chaanh sjukan pichul winh, ix sch'apank'e winh t'a stzek'ul snanhal, ix b'at lemnaj winh. B'ab'el sb'at winh yuj winhaj Acab chi' masanto ix k'och winh t'a Jezreel.
Ix yalan winhaj Acab t'a ix Jezabel tas ix sk'ulej winhaj Elías yet' tas ix yutej winh smilancham heb' winh schekab' Baal.

Yuj chi', ix schekanb'at jun schekab' ix t'a winhaj Elías chi', ix yalanb'at ix icha tik: Aokab' heb' Dios tz'ak'ankot yaelal t'a wib'anh tato manto ach cham wuuj yab' icha tik k'ik'an, icha ix utej a milancham heb' winh schekab' in diosal chi', xchi ix.
Ayic ix yab'an winhaj Elías to ay smay jun chi', ix b'at winh elelal. Ayic ix k'och winh t'a Beerseba t'a yol yik Judá, ata' ix yaktejkan jun winh schekab' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winh t'a tzinan lu'um. Jun k'ual ix b'ey winh. Ix k'unb'i winh, ix em k'ojan winh t'a yich jun te' mes. Ata' ix snib'ej cham sb'a winh. Ix yalan winh: k'okb'ilxo tik Mamin. Ik'el in k 'inal, manh ek'b'aloklaj welk'och t'a heb' in mam wicham, xchi winh.
Ix ek' jichan winh t'a yich jun te te' chi', ix wayb'at winh. Axo yik waynak winh chi', ix k'och jun ángel t'a winh, ix tenji winh yuj, ix yalani: Q'ueanh waan, wa''anh, xchi t'a winh.
Axo ix yilan winh t'a sjolomtak, ayek' jun ixim pan k'anb'inak t'a te' tzak'ak' yet' jun xalu ha ha'. Ix k'e k'ojan winh, ix wa winh, ix yuk'an ha' winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix ek'xi jichan winh swayi.
Ix k'ochxi jun ángel chi' t'a winh, ix tenjixi winh yuj, ix yalani: Q'ueanh waan, wa''anh, yujto te najatto skan b'aj ol ach k'ochok, xchi t'a winh.
Ix k'e waan winh, ix wa winh, ix te och yip winh yuj tas ix swa chi'. 40 k'u yet' 40 ak'wal ix b'ey winh, masanto ix k'och winh t'a lum witz Horeb b'aj sch'oxnak sb'a Jehová t'a heb' israel.
Ayic ix k'och winh ta', ix way winh t'a yol jun k'een nhak'een t'a jun ak'wal chi'. Ix lolon Jehová t'a winh, ix yalan icha tik: Elías, ¿tas tza k'ulej t'a tik? xchi.

Ix tak'wi winh t'ay icha tik: Mamin Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, ix te kot wowal yuj tas tzach utaj yuj heb' wetisraelal. Yujto ix spatiquejel a trato heb', ix sjuanem altar heb', ix xikancham heb' a chekab' heb'. Ha inxonhej ix in kolchajkaneli, palta wan in sayjiek' yuj heb' yik tzin smilancham heb', xchi winh.

Ix yalan Jehová chi' t'a winh: Elanh t'a chi' tzach och linhan t'a wichanh t'a jolom witz tik, yujto ol in ek' ta', xchi t'a winh. Ix yak'ankot jun niwan ik' Jehová chi', ix laj pojb'at k'een tenam yuj, palta manh ayokochlaj t'a skal jun ik' chi'. Ixlajwi yek' jun ik' chi', ix yak'anpaxkot jun quixkab'. Palta anheja' manh ayokochlaj t'a skal jun quixkab' chi'.

Ixlajwi yek' jun quixkab' chi', ix yak'anpaxkot jun k'ak', anheja' malaj Jehová chi' ayoch t'a skal jun k'ak' chi'. Ayic ix lajwi yek'b'at jun k'ak' chi', ix yab'an jun lolonel winhaj Elías chi', te k'ununi ix aj yalani.

Ayic ix yab'an winh chi', ix smusan sat winh yet' jun spichul jukan, ix elta winh, ix aj linhan winh t'a sti' k'een nhak'een chi', ix yab'an jun lolonel chi' winh, ix yalani: Elías ¿tas tza k'ulej t'a tik? xchi.

Ix tak'wi winh: Mamin Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, ix te kot wowal yuj tas ix ach utaj yuj heb' wetisraelal, yujto ix spatiquejel a trato heb'. Ix sjuanem altar heb', ix xikancham heb' a chekab' heb'. Ha inxonhej ix in kolchajkaneli, palta wan in sayjiek' yuj heb' yik tzin smilancham heb', xchi winh.

Ix yalan Jehová chi' t'a winh icha tik: Ixic, meltzajanh t'a b'e b'aj ach koti, slajwi chi' tzach b'at t'a tzinan lum yik Damasco. Ayic ol ach k'och ta', tza sik'kanel winhaj Hazael yik ol och winh reyal t'a Siria.

Axo winhaj Jehú yinhtilal winhaj Nimsi tza sik'paxkaneli yik ol och winh sreyalok Israel. Axo winhaj Eliseo yuninal winhaj Safat aj Abel-mehola, tza sik'kanel winh yik ol och winh in chekab'ok a k'exulok.
Ha tas ol ujok, a mach ol kolchajkanel t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Hazael, haxo winhaj Jehú ol milanchamok. Axo mach ol kolchajkanel t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Jehú chi', haxo pax winhaj Eliseo ol milanchamok.
Palta ayto uque' mil heb' israel chi' sik'b'ilkanel wuuj, maj ochlaj heb' ejmelal t'a Baal, maj stz'ub'pax eltalaj heb', xchi Jehová chi'.

Ix meltzaj winhaj Elías chi' t'a jun lugar chi', ix ja winh b'aj ayek' winhaj Eliseo yuninal winhaj Safat. Van sd'okwi lum winh yet' lajchawe' mojanh nok' mam wakax. Ha winh ed'jinak nok' tzak'anto sb'ati. Ix k'och winhaj Elías chi' t'a stz'ey winh, ix yak'anb'at jun sjukan pichul winhaj Elías chi' t'a yib'anh winh.

D'a jun rato chi' ix yaktankan nok' wakax winhaj Eliseo chi', ix och tzak'an winh yuj winhaj Elías chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: --Cha in b'ati, b'at walkan quilkob'ha t'a in mam in nun, tzin tz'ub'ankanelta sti' heb' yik tzin pukankan in b'a yet' heb'. Slajwi chi', tzin och tzak'an uuj, xchi winhaj Eliseo chi'. --Syal a b'ati, manh wanok ach wak'an pural, xchi winhaj Elías chi'.

Ix b'at winhaj Eliseo chi', ix smilan chawanh nok' wakax chi' winh. Axo yet' te' yugo ayoch t'a nok' ix sb'ol schib'ejal nok' winh, ix yak'an wa heb' anima smunlaj yet' winh chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix och tzak'an winh yuj winhaj Elías chi'.
