Ha winhaj Ben-adad sreyal Siria, ix smolb'ej masanil heb' soldado winh. Ay pax 32 heb' winh rey junnhej ix yutej sb'a yet' winh yet' pax schej heb' winh yet' skarruaje heb' winh yik owal. Ix jawi heb' winh yak' owal t'a chonhab' Samaria, ix och oyan heb' winh t'a spatik jun chonhab' chi'.
Ix yak'ankot schekab' heb' winh t'a winhaj Acab sreyal Israel, ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: Ha winhaj Ben-adad ix onh chekankot ul kala':
Vic yaj masanil a b'eyumal, heb' ix etb'eyum te wach' yet' heb' uninal te wach', xchikot winh, xchi heb' chekab' chi'.
Ix yalanb'at winhaj Acab chi' t'a winh icha tik: Mamin rey, ujokab' icha ix al chi'. Ha in tik yet' masanil tastak ay t'ayin ikokab'i, xchib'at winh.

Ix jaxpax heb' chekab' chi' t'a winhaj Acab chi', ix yalanxi heb' icha tik: Icha tik ix yutej winhaj Ben-adad yalanxikoti: Toxo ix walb'at t'ayach to wik yaj masanil a b'eyumal, heb' ix etb'eyum yet' pax heb' uninal.

Anhejtona' yab' icha tik k'ik'an, swak'anb'at heb' yajalil heb' in soldado yik sb'at yilan heb' masanil tas ay t'a yol a palakio yet' yoltak spat heb' winh ayoch yajalil ed'ok. Masanil tas ol snib'ej heb', ol yik'kot heb', xchi winh, xchi heb' chekab' chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yawtankot masanil heb' yichamtak winaquil chonhab' winhaj Acab chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb': --¿Tas tz'aj he naan a ex tik? Ha winhaj Ben-adad chi' wannhej sayan winh tas ol yutej onh yixtani, wach'chom a in tik toxo ix wal t'a winh to syal wak'an in b'eyumal, heb' ix wetb'eyum yet' heb' wuninal t'a winh, xchi winh.
Ix yalan heb' ichamtak winak chi' yet' masanil heb' chonhab': --Mamin rey, manh a cha ab' tas syalkot winh chi' t'ayach, xchi heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj rey Acab chi' t'a heb' schekab' winhaj Ben-adad chi': --Alec t'a winh rey wajal chi', ol in k'anab'ajej masanil tas ix yal winh t'a sb'ab'elal, palta haxo tas syalkot winh t'ayin tiknaik, manhxo ol in k'anab'ajejlaj, xchib'at winh. Icha chi' ix aj yalanxik'och heb' schekab' winhaj Ben-adad chi'.

Ix schekanxikot heb' schekab' winh chi' junelxo t'a winhaj rey Acab chi', ix yalankot winh: Aokab' juntzanh Dios tz'ak'anoch in yaelal tato max in satel Samaria chi' t'a junelnhej. Manh ol yab'laj sk'alemal yik syik'ankot jun jopok yik junjun heb' in soldado, xchi winh.
Ix yalanxib'at winhaj Acab chi' t'a winhaj Ben-adad chi' icha tik: Manh smojok syik'chaanh sb'a junok mach to wanto sb'at t'a owal, icha junok mach to wanxo sjaxi, xchib'at winh.

Van yuk'an anh winhaj Ben-adad chi' yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh rey ayek' yet' winh t'a skampamento ayik ix yab'an winh tas ix yal heb' chekab' chi'. Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a heb' yajalil heb' soldado to syak' lista sb'a heb' yik syak'an owal yet' jun chonhab' chi'. Yuj chi' ix yak'an lista sb'a heb'.

Yakb'an chi', ix jawi jun winh schekab' Dios t'a winhaj Acab chi', ix yalan winh: --Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Scham wal ilan jantak heb' ajk'ol chi', palta ol wak'och heb' t'a yol a k'ab' t'a jun k'u tik, yik wach' ol ojtaquejeli to a inton Jehová Dios in, xchi Jehová, xchi winh chekab' chi'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Acab chi', ¿mach yuj ol ak'jokoch heb' t'a yol in k'ab' chi'? xchi winh. --Ha Jehová ix alani to a yuj heb' winh kelemtak skolwaj yet' heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun chonhab' t'a yoltak a makb'en tik, a yuj heb' winh ol ak' ganar, xchi winh schekab' Dios chi'. --¿Palta mach ol b'ab'laj yamanoch owal chi'? xchi winhaj Acab chi'. --Ha extoni, xchi winh chekab' chi'.
Yuj chi' ix smolb'ej 232 heb' winh kelemtak chi' winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix smolb'anpax heb' soldado winh ayek' ta', uque' mil heb' t'a smasanil.

Chimk'ualil wal ix el heb', b'ab'el sb'at heb' winh kelemtak chi' yuj heb', haxo winhaj Ben-adad yet' 32 heb' winh rey ajun yet'ok, anheja' yuk'an anh heb' winh t'a yol skampamento. Ayic ix alji t'a winh yuj heb' soldado ayel yila' to ay juntzanh winak ix el t'a yol chonhab' Samaria,
ix yalan winh icha tik: Wach'chom t'a junk'olal ix elul heb', ma owal jun, yamek heb', pitzan heb' tzeyik'ankot heb' t'ayin t'a tik, xchi winh.
Ha heb' winh kelemtak skolwaj t'a heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun chonhab' yik Israel chi', b'ab'el heb' winh, tzak'anoch masanil heb' soldado yuj heb' winh.

Junjun heb' ix milancham junjun heb' sirio ajk'ol chi'. Yuj chi' ix b'at heb' sirio chi' elelal, haxo heb' israel ix b'at t'a spatik heb'. Axo winhaj Ben-adad chi', ix k'e winh t'a yib'anh schej yet' juntzanhxo heb' soldado, ix b'atkan heb' elelal.
Ix ak'ji ganar heb' sirio chi' yuj heb' israel chi', ix yik'ankan nok' chej heb' yet' karruaje yik owal. Te niwan heb' sirio chi' ix chami.

Ixlajwi chi' ix jax winh schekab' Dios chi' t'a winhaj Acab sreyal Israel chi', ix yalan winh: --Ha tiknaik scham wal a naani tas tzutej ak'anoch stz'akub' heb' winh a soldado tik, yujto ha t'a junxo ab'il yab' icha tik, sjax heb' sirio tik yak' owal ed' junelxo, xchi winh.

Anheja' ix yalanpax heb' winh yajalil heb' soldado sirio chi' t'a winh sreyal chi' icha tik: --Ha juntzanh sdiosal heb' israel chi', sdiosal jolomtak witz. Yuj chi', ix onh yak' ganar heb'. Palta tato ha t'a panhquiltak skak' owal yet' heb', skak' ganar heb'.
Mamin rey, a tas tza k'ulej tiknaik to maxtzak ak'och heb' winh rey tik yajalilok heb' soldado, say sk'exul heb' winh.

Tzak'anpaxoch heb' soldado icha sb'isul heb' ix ak'ji ganar chi', lajan tz'aj sb'isul heb' yet' nok' chej yet' pax karruaje. Slajwi chi' tzonh b'at kak' owal yet' heb' israel t'a lum panhquiltak chi', ol quilan b'ian tato manh ol kak' ganar heb', xchi heb'. Ix schaan yab' winhaj Ben-adad tas ix yal heb' chi'.
Ayic ix ek' jun ab'il chi', ix yak'an lista heb' soldado winhaj Ben-adad chi', ix jawi heb' t'a chonhab' Afec yik syak'an owal heb' yet' heb' israel chi'.

Anhejtona' ix yak'anpax lista sb'a heb' winh soldado israel chi', ix ak'ji syamk'ab' heb' yik sb'at heb' yak' owal yet' heb' sirio chi'. Ix b'at heb' israel chi', ix sb'oank'e skampamento heb' t'a yichanh heb' sirio chi'. Lajan wal yilji heb' icha chab'ok makte'al nok' chiwa, haxo pax heb' soldado yik heb' sirio chi' jun, majnaquel sat lum ak'lik chi' yuj heb'.

Ha wal ta' ix jawi jun winh schekab' Dios t'a winhaj Acab sreyal Israel chi', ix yalan winh icha tik t'a winh: --Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Yujto a heb' sirio tik ix alani to a in tik sDiosal in lum jolomtak witz, manh in sDiosalok lum panhquiltak, yuj chi' a tiknaik ol wak'och juntzanh tzijtumal anima tik t'a yol a k'ab', icha wal chi' ol aj ojtakaneli to a in ton Jehová Dios in, xchi Jehová, xchi winh chekab' chi'.

Uque' k'ual tonhej ix ajek' heb' soldado sirio t'a yichanh heb' soldado israel chi', ix lajwi chi' ix syamanoch heb' yak'an owal. Ha t'a jun k'u chi' 100 mil soldado yik heb' sirio chi' sb'ey t'a yok ix cham yuj heb' israel chi'.

Axo juntzanhxo heb' soldado chi', ix b'at heb' elelal t'a chonhab' Afec. Axo smuroal jun chonhab' chi' ix kot lanhnaj t'a yib'anh heb', 27 mil heb' soldado ix el chi' ix chami. Ix pax lemnaj winhaj Ben-adad chi', ix k'och winh t'a jun chonhab' chi', tzuli tzek' winh sk'ub'ejel sb'ha t'a yoltak pat.

Yuj chi' haxo heb' ayoch yajalil yet' winh ix alan t'ay icha tik: --Ix kab'i to a heb' winh sreyal Israel ay yok'elk'olal heb' winh, yuj chi' komonok scha a k'ool skak'och pichul ya swa'i, skak'anoch lasu t'a ko jaj. Slajwi chi' b'at ko ch'oxan ko b'ha t'a winh sreyal Israel chi', talaj tz'ok' sk'ol winh t'ayonh, manh ol onh smilchamlaj winh, xchi heb' t'a winhaj Ben-adad chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yak'anoch pichul heb' ya swa'i, ix yak'anoch lasu heb' t'a sjaj, ix b'at heb' sch'ox sb'ha t'a winh sreyal Israel chi', ix yalan heb': --Mamin rey, a winh a chekab' aj Ben-adad, tzonh schekkot winh kal t'ayach, komonok tz'ok' a k'ool max a milchamlaj winh, xchi heb'. Ix tak'wi winhaj Acab chi' t'a heb' icha tik: --¿Tom pitzanto winh jun? Ha t'a in sat, icha wuk'tak yaj winh, xchi winh.

Te wach' ix yal winh rey chi' ix yab' heb', yuj chi' ix yal heb' icha tik: --Mamin rey, a winh uk'tak aj Ben-adad chi' pitzanto winh, xchi heb'. --B'at ik'ekkot winh an, xchi winhaj Acab chi' t'a heb'. Yuj chi' ix jawi winhaj Ben-adad chi' t'a yichanh winh, ix yak'ank'e winh winh t'a yol skarruaje.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Ben-adad chi' icha tik: --Ha tiknaik a juntzanh chonhab' yik'nak ek' winh in mam t'a winh a mam, swak'xikan t'ayach. Syal sb'at heb' a chonhwajum t'a Damasco icha sk'ulejnak heb' schonhwajum winh in mam chi' t'a Samaria, xchi winh. --Tato icha chi', ol ach wak'el t'a libre, xchi winhaj Acab chi'. Icha chi' ix aj sb'oan jun strato heb' chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix pax winhaj Ben-adad chi'.

Palta ay jun winh t'a skal heb' winh schekab' Jehová, a Jehová ix alan t'a winh, yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a jun winh yetb'eyum icha tik: --Ak' in echnaj in k'ana', xchi winh. Palta maj yal-laj sk'ool winh yetb'eyum winh chi'.

Ix yalan winh schekab' Dios chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Yujto maj a k'anab'ajej tas ix yal Jehová, yuj chi' ayik ol ach el t'a in tz'ey tik, ay jun nok' choj ol ach milanchamok, xchi winh. Ayic ix el winh chi' t'a stz'ey winh schekab' Dios chi', haxo t'a yol b'e ix elta jun nok' choj t'a winh, ix miljicham winh yuj nok'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix schalan sb'a winh schekab' Dios chi' yet' junxo winh winak, ix yalanxi winh t'a winh icha tik: Ak' in echnajok, xchi winh. Ha jun winh chi' ix mak'an winh schekab' Dios chi', ix lajwi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winh schekab' Dios chi' smaklej winh rey t'a yol b'e. Ix sk'exanel sb'a winh, ix smusan sat winh t'a jun k'apak.

Ayic wan yek'b'at winh rey chi' ta', te chaanh ix yal winh schekab' Dios chi': --Mamin rey, a in a chekab' in tik, ix in b'at t'a owal. Ha t'a skal heb' soldado ix elta jun winh soldado ix yik'ankot jun winh ajk'ol winh t'ayin. Ix yalan winh t'ayin to tzin tanhwej jun winh chi'. Ix cham wal yalan winh tato swaktejel winh ajk'ol chi', a inxo tzin cham sk'exulok winh, mato yowalil swak' oxeok arroba k'een plata.

Palta mamin rey, a in tik yakb'an ay jab'ok tas wan in k'ulani, ix el lemnaj winh ajk'ol chi' t'ayin, xchi winh t'a winhaj Acab chi'. Ix tak'wi winhaj Acab sreyal Israel chi': --Munil a ach ix alk'eta a mul yet' tas ol elul t'a ib'anh yuj, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'anel smusil sat winh schekab' Dios chi'. Axo ix yilan winh rey chi' to a jun winh chi' a junok heb' winh schekab' Dios.

Ix yalan winh schekab' Dios chi': --Icha wal tik yalan Jehová: Ha ach tik ix aktejb'at jun winh winak ix wala' to yowalil schami, yuj chi' a ach ol ach cham sk'exulok winh, haxo a chonhab' ol satel sk'exulok yik winh, xchi Jehová, xchi winh schekab' Dios chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'atkan winhaj Acab chi' t'a Samaria, ix chab'axk'e sk'ool winh. Van schichon sk'ool winh ix ochkan winh t'a yol spalakio.

Ayic ix lajwi yek'kan juntzanh chi', a winhaj Acab rey t'a Samaria, ix snib'ej winh sman jab' slum jun winh aj Jezreel skuch Nabot. Ha jab' slum winh chi' awab'il te' uwa t'a sat, ha t'a stz'ey spalakio winh rey chi' ay. Ay jun k'ual ix yal winhaj Acab chi' t'a winhaj Nabot chi' icha tik: --Ak' jab' a lum chi' t'ayin, yik ata' swawej jab'ok witaj, yujto t'a stz'ey in palakio ay. Axo junokxo lum te wach' swak' sk'exulok, mato tzin tup t'ayach icha stojol, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Nabot chi' icha tik: --Max yal-laj, yujto max yal-laj sk'ol Dios to tzin chonhel in makb'en ak'b'ilkan yuj in mam wicham, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix pax winhaj Acab chi' t'a spalakio. Ix te och pitz'an t'a sk'ool winh, ix somchajchaanh winh yuj tas ix yal winhaj Nabot chi'. Yuj chi' ayik ix k'och winh t'a spalakio chi', ix ek' jichan winh, ix meltzajkanoch k'elan winh t'a yich sch'at, majxo scha walaj sb'a winh.
Ix k'och ix Jezabel, ix yetb'eyum winh t'a stz'ey, ix sk'anb'an ix: --¿Tas yuj schichon a k'ool, max yal a k'ol tzach wa'i? xchi ix.

Ix tak'wi winh: --Yujto ix in lolon yet' winhaj Nabot aj Jezreel yuj jab' sluum winh b'aj ay te' uwa, ix in k'an in man t'a winh, mato swak' junokxo lum sk'exulok, palta maj yal-laj sk'ol winh ix yak' lum t'ayin, yuj chi' schichon in k'ool, xchi winh t'a ix.

Ix tak'wi ix t'a winh: --¿Tas yuj stak a k'ol yuj jun chi'? ¿Tom manh sreyalok Israel aj jun? Manh ak' pensar yuj jun chi'. Q'ueanh waan, wa''anh. Ha in ol wik'ek' jun lum chi', ol wak'an lum t'ayach, xchi ix.

Ixlajwi chi' ix sb'oan jun ch'anh karta ix t'a sb'i winhaj Acab chi', haxo sello winh ix yak'och ix t'a ch'anh. Ix yak'anb'at ch'anh ix t'a heb' yichamtak winaquil chonhab' b'aj kajan winhaj Nabot chi'.
Ix yalan ix t'a ch'anh karta chi' icha tik: Tze molb'ej heb' anima yik tz'och heb' t'a tzek'ojk'olal. Tzeyak'em k'ojan winhaj Nabot t'a yichanh heb' anima chi' t'a junok lugar niwan yelk'ochi.

Tze sayan chawanhok winak chuk spensar stek'b'ej sb'a yalan t'a spatik winh icha tik: Ha ach tik, ix ach b'uchwaj d'ha Dios yet' t'a winh rey, xchiokab' heb' t'a winh. Slajwi chi' tzeyik'anel winh t'a stiel chonhab', haxo ta' tze julk'enejcham winh, xchib'at ix.
Axo heb' ichamtak winak chi', ix sk'anab'ajej heb' icha wal ix aj yalanb'at ix Jezabel chi' t'a ch'anh skarta chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalankot heb' t'a ix Jezabel chi' to toxo ix cham winhaj Nabot chi'.

Ayic ix yab'an ix Jezabel chi', ix yalan ix t'a winhaj Acab chi': --Ha tiknaik b'at makkan ikok lum sluum winhaj Nabot aj Jezreel, aton lum maj yal sk'ool winh ix schonh t'ayach, yujto toxo ix cham winh, xchi ix.
Ayic ix yab'an winhaj Acab chi' to toxo ix cham winhaj Nabot chi', ix b'at sb'oanoch sb'a winh t'a sat lu'um.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Elías aj Tisbe:
--Ixic b'at il winhaj Acab sreyal Samaria. Ha t'a Jezreel ayek' winh tiknaik t'a lum sluum winhaj Nabot, aton lum ix yik'ek' winh t'a winh.

Tzalan t'a winh icha tik: Ha Jehová tz'alan t'ayach icha tik: Yujto ix a milcham winhaj Nabot, ix ik'anek' lum sluum winh tik, yuj chi' a b'aj ix lek'jik'e schiq'uil winh yuj nok' tz'i', anheja' pax ta' ol lek'jokk'e a chiq'uil a ach tik yuj nok', xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a winh, xchi t'a winhaj Elías chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Acab chi' t'a winhaj Elías chi' icha tik: --Ach ajk'ool, ix in ilchaj uuj, xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Elías chi': --Ach ilchaj toni, yujto ix a tek'b'ej a b'a a k'ulan tas te chuk t'a yichanh Jehová.
Yuj chi' ix yal Jehová: Ol wik'kot kusk'olal t'a ib'anh, ol satel masanil heb' winak t'a inhtilal yet' heb' winak niwak yelk'och t'a skal chonhab' Israel, ma heb' chekab' yaji.

Icha wal wutejnak in satanel heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat yet' heb' yinhtilal winhaj Baasa yuninal winhaj Ahías, icha wal chi' ol wutej in satanel heb' inhtilal, yujto ix a tzuntzejkot yowal in k'ool yuj tas ix a k'ulej, ix a kuchb'anb'at heb' etisraelal t'a chukal, xchi Jehová.
Axo pax yuj ix Jezabel, a Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha nok' tz'i' ol chianb'at schib'ejal ix t'a Jezreel tik.

Ha heb' inhtilal ol cham heb' t'a yol chonhab', a nok' tz'i' ol chianb'at sniwanil heb'. Axo heb' ol cham t'a spatiquel chonhab' chi', a nok' ostok ol chianb'at heb', xchi Jehová, xchi winhaj Elías chi'.
(Val yel malaj junokxo rey ix yutej sb'a icha ix yutej sb'a winhaj Acab chi'. Ix kuchb'aj winh yuj ix Jezabel ix yetb'eyum, yik stek'b'an sb'a winh sk'ulan chukal t'a yichanh Jehová.

Te yajb'entak ix yutej sb'a winh ayik ix och winh ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios. Lajan wal ix yutej sb'a winh icha yutejnak sb'a heb' amorreo, aton heb' yik'naquel Jehová t'a yichanh chonhab' Israel.)

Ayic ix yab'an winhaj Acab tas ix yal winhaj Elías chi', ix snhik'chitanb'at spichul winh. Ix yak'anoch pichul winh te ya swa'i. Ix och winh t'a tzek'ojk'olal. Ix way winh yet' spichul ya swa chi'. Te kusnak winh tzek' winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Elías chi' icha tik:

¿Tzam ila' tas syutej winhaj Acab chi' yik'anem sb'a t'ayin? Yuj chi' manh ol wak'b'at jun yaelal chi' t'a yib'anh winh. Ato yik ayoch junok yuninal winh reyal sk'exulok, ato ta' ol wak'b'ati, xchi t'a winh.
Oxe' ab'il malaj jab'ok owal t'a skal chonhab' Israel yet' heb' sirio.
Axo ix el yoxil ab'il chi', ix k'och winhaj Josafat sreyal Judá lolonel yet' winhaj Acab sreyal Israel chi'.

Ix yalan winh sreyal Israel chi' t'a masanil heb' ayoch yopisio yet'ok: --Ha ex tik eyojtak sik'lab'il to a chonhab' Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad, quiktaxon yaji. ¿Tas yuj max quik'ek' t'a winh sreyal Siria chi'? xchi winh t'a heb'.

Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a winhaj Josafat chi': --¿Mamax yal a k'ol tzach och wed'ok yik skak'an owal yet' chonhab' Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Josafat chi': --Ha in tik ol in b'at ed'ok yet' masanil heb' in soldado yet' jantak nok' in chej yik owal.
Palta ayik manto och owal chi', ol ko k'anb'ej t'a Jehová, xchi winh.

Ix yawtankot 400 heb' winh syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios winhaj Acab chi', ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb' winh: --¿Tzam yal ko yamanoch owal yet' chonhab' Ramot, mato maay? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi heb' winh icha tik: --Hak'ek owal chi'. Ha Dios Kajal ol ak'anoch t'a yol he k'ab', xchi heb' winh.
Ix sk'anb'an winhaj Josafat chi': --¿Mama wal junok winh schekab' Jehová t'a tik b'aj sko k'anb'ej? xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winh sreyal Israel chi' t'a winh: --Ayto wal junxo winh syal slolon yet' Jehová, aton winhaj Micaías yuninal winhaj Imla. Palta malaj in gana swil winh, yujto malaj jab'ok tas wach' syal winh t'a wib'anh, chuknhej tas syal winh, xchi winh. Ix yalan winhaj Josafat chi': --Manh al icha chi', xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yawtan jun winh schekab' winhaj Acab chi', ix yalan winh t'a winh: --Ixic t'a elanhchamel, b'at ik'kot winhaj Micaías yuninal winhaj Imla, xchi winh.

Ha winhaj rey Acab yet' winhaj Josafat sreyal Judá chi', ayoch spichul heb' winh yik sreyal yuj, ix em k'ojan heb' winh t'a juntzanh xila yik heb' winh rey t'a jun tek'lab' trigo t'a stiel spuertail chonhab' Samaria. Masanil heb' winh syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios chi', ix stz'ak yal heb' winh tas ol aj yak'an ganar heb' winh rey chi'.

Ha winhaj Sedequías yuninal winhaj Quenaana, ix sb'o juntzanh k'een k'een winh, icha sch'aak nok' wakax ix aji, ix yalan winh: Icha wal tik ix aj yalan Jehová: Ha juntzanh yechel ch'aak wakax tik, a sch'oxanel ipalil b'aj ol ak' owal yet' masanil heb' sirio masanto ol satel heb', xchi Jehová, xchi winh.

Masanil heb' winh syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios chi', lajannhej syutej heb' winh yalan t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: Ixic, ak' owal t'a chonhab' Ramot yujto a Jehová ol ak'anoch t'a yol a k'ab', xchi heb' winh.

Axo winh schekab' winh rey ix b'at yik'kot winhaj Micaías chi', ix yal winh t'a winhaj Micaías chi' icha tik: --Masanil heb' winh schekab' Dios wan yalani to wach' ol elk'och winh rey, yuj chi' alpax icha tz'aj yalan heb' winh chi' a ach tik, xchi winh t'a winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Micaías chi' icha tik: --D'a yichanh Jehová swal t'ayach to a tas ol yal Jehová t'ayin, a ol wala', xchi winh.

Ix jawi winhaj Micaías chi' t'a yichanh winh rey chi', ix sk'anb'an winh rey chi' t'a winh: --Ha tiknaik ach Micaías, ¿tom smoj sko yamoch owal yet' chonhab' Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad, mato maay? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Micaías chi': --Ixic, ol ak' ganar jun owal chi', yujto a Jehová ol ak'anoch jun chonhab' chi' t'a yol a k'ab', xchi winh. Palta tonhej ix yal winh icha chi'.
Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winh: --Tzijtum elxo swal t'ayach to a tas yel, a chi' tzal t'ayin t'a sb'i Jehová, xchi winh rey chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Micaías chi' icha tik: Ix wila'', masanil heb' soldado quetisraelal sakleminak sb'atkan heb' t'a jolomtak witz icha nok' kalnel malaj stanhwumal. Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Ha juntzanh heb' soldado tik, malaj yilumal heb', meltzajokab' junjun heb' t'a spat t'a junk'olal, xchi, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Acab chi' t'a winhaj Josafat chi': --Ina ton swal t'ayach to a jun winh tik malaj jab'ok tas wach' syal winh t'a wib'anh, anhej chukal syal winh, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalanxi winhaj Micaías chi' icha tik: --Ab' wal slolonel Jehová. Ix wila'' to k'ojanem Jehová t'a yol sdespacho, haxo heb' yángel t'a satcha’anh oyanoch heb' t'a spatik yichanh.

Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: ¿Mach wal junok ex b'at he montejb'at winhaj Acab yik sb'at winh yak' owal t'a chonhab' Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad, yik ata' schamkan winh? xchi. Ch'okch'ok ix yutej heb' ángel chi' yalan t'ay.
Axo ix aji, ay jun espíritu ix k'och t'a yichanh Jehová, ix yalan icha tik: Ol b'at in montejb'at winh, xchi. Ix yalan Jehová t'ay: ¿Tas ol utej b'at a montanb'at winh jun? xchi.

Ix yalan jun espíritu chi' icha tik: Ol in b'at wek sna' juntzanh heb' winh schekab' winhaj Acab chi' yik anhej esal lolonel ol yal heb' winh, xchi. Yuj chi' ix yal Jehová: Ixic ol yal uj icha tzal chi', xchi.

Yuj chi', a tiknaik a Jehová ix ak'anoch jun espíritu t'a heb' winh a chekab' tik yik anhej esal lolonel syal heb' winh t'ayach. Ha Jehová ix alani to icha chi' tz'aj a chami, xchi winh t'a winh rey chi'.

D'a wal jun rato chi' ix snitzankot sb'a winhaj Sedequías chi' t'a stz'ey winhaj Micaías chi', ix stz'itanb'at sat winhaj Micaías chi' winh, ix yalan winh: --Ha jun espíritu tz'esan ix kot t'a Jehová chi', ¿tas ix aj yel t'ayin, haxo t'ayach sloloni? xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Micaías chi' icha tik: --Olxo ab'i ayik ol ach ek' a k'ub'ejel a b'ha t'a yoltak pat, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj rey Acab chi': --Yamec winhaj Micaías tik, tzeyik'anb'at winh t'a winhaj Amón sgobernadoral chonhab' tik yet' t'a winh wuninal aj Joás.

Tzeyalan t'a heb' winh icha tik: Ha winh rey ix alani to tz'och jun winh tik t'a preso. Jab'nhej swael winh tzeyak'a', jab'nhej pax ha' tzeyak' yuk'ej winh, masanto tzin meltzaj t'a junk'olal, xchi winh rey chi', xe chi t'a heb' winh.

Ix yalan jay b'elanh lolonel tik winhaj Micaías chi': Tato tzach meltzaj t'a junk'olal, syalelk'ochi to manhok Jehová ix chekan wal juntzanh lolonel chi', xchi winh t'a winh rey chi'. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' anima chi': --Ex wetchonhab', scham wal he naan jun ix wal tik, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winhaj Acab sreyal Israel chi' yet' winhaj Josafat sreyal Judá. Ix k'och heb' winh yak' owal t'a chonhab' Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad.

Ix yalan winhaj Acab t'a winhaj Josafat chi': --Ha in tik, ol in k'exel in pichul yik ol wak' owal chi', a achxo tik, ayokab'nhej och a pichul yik reyal tik, xchi winh t'a winh. Ix sk'exanel spichul winh chi', ix och winh t'a skal owal chi'.
Axo pax winh sreyal Siria, toxo ix yal winh t'a heb' 32 yajalil soldado yik karruaje: Manh eyak' owal yet' junokxo mach, palta anhej yet' winh sreyal Israel tzeyak' owal chi', xchi winh.
Ayic ix iljib'at winhaj Josafat yuj heb' yajalil soldado chi', a snaan heb' to a winh sreyal Israel, ix yoyan sb'a heb' t'a spatik winh, yuj chi' ix el yaw winh.
Ix yab'an heb' soldado chi' to manhoklaj winh sreyal Israel chi', yuj chi' ix yaktej heb' spechan winh.

Palta ay jun soldado sirio ix komon julanb'at sjul-lab' t'a skal heb' soldado wan yak'an owal chi'. k'okb'il wal a winhaj rey Acab chi' ix yamchaji. Ha wal b'aj schalaj sb'a cha makan k'een pichul ayoch yuj winh, ata' ix och jun jul-lab' chi'. Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a winh yamjinak sch'anhal nok' chej tok'jinak karruaje b'aj ayk'e winh chi': --Ik' meltzaj nok' chej tik, tzin ik'anel t'a skal owal tik, yujto te niwan ix in aj in lajwi, xchi winh.

Ha t'a jun k'u chi' te niwan jun owal ix yak' chi'. Ixto syamk'e linhan winhaj Acab chi' heb' t'a yol karruaje yik tzato wal yak' yip heb' yak'an owal yet' heb' aj Siria chi', ix k'e wal sib'an schiq'uil winh t'a yol karruaje chi', haxo yik ix em k'u ix cham winh.
Axo yik wanxo sq'uik'b'i, ix och jun aw t'a skal masanil heb' soldado, ix yalani: Paxanhec t'a he chonhab', ma t'a he lu'um junjun ex, xchi.
Icha chi' ix aj scham winhaj Acab chi', ix ik'jikot sniwanil winh t'a Samaria. Ha t'a Samaria chi' ix mukji winh.

Ix b'ikjiel skarruaje winh chi' t'a jun tanque b'ob'il t'a Samaria chi', b'aj sb'iquel sb'a heb' ix aj mul ix. Ata' ix lek'ji schiq'uil winhaj Acab chi' yuj nok' tz'i'. Icha wal chi' ix aj yelk'och tas ix yal Jehová.

Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj rey Acab chi' yet' tas ix sk'ulej winh yet' pax yab'ixal spalakio winh ayoch marfil yelwanub'ok yet' niwak chonhab' ix laj sb'o winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Ayic ix cham winh, haxo winhaj Ocozías yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayic chanhexo ab'il yoch winhaj Acab reyal t'a Israel, ix och winhaj Josafat yuninal winhaj Asa reyal t'a Judá.
Ayxo 35 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal chi', 25 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Azuba sb'i ix snun winh, yisil ix winhaj Silhi.

Ha winhaj Josafat chi', wach'nhej ix yutej sb'eyb'al winh t'a yichanh Jehová, icha yutejnak sb'a winhaj Asa smam winh. Anhej to maj scheklaj winh ik'joquel masanil yet'tal b'aj tz'och ejmelal b'aj syak' silab' heb' anima yet' b'aj snhus inkienso heb' t'a juntzanh lugar chaanh.
Ix och winh t'a junk'olal yet' winh sreyal Israel.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winh yet' sb'inajnaquil winh yet' b'ajtak ix yak' ganar owal winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá.
Masanil juntzanh winak smulan yet' yetwinaquil, ix laj spechel heb' winh t'a yol smakb'en, aton juntzanh heb' winh ixto kan t'a stiempoal winhaj Asa smam winh.
(Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', malaj rey ayoch t'a Edom, anhej jun winh yajal ak'b'iloch yuj winhaj Josafat.)

Ha winhaj Josafat chi', ix yak' b'ojok juntzanh te' barko winh icha te' yik heb' aj Tarsis, yik sb'at te' yik' k'een oro t'a Ofir, palta maj yal-laj sb'at te', yujto ix pojkanb'at te' t'a Ezión-geber.
Ha winhaj Ocozías yuninal winhaj Acab, ix snib'ej winh ix b'at heb' smunlajwum t'a te' barko yet' heb' yik winhaj Josafat chi', palta maj yal-laj sk'ol winhaj Josafat chi'.
Ayic ix cham winhaj Josafat chi', ix mukji sniwanil winh yet' heb' smam yicham t'a schonhab' winhaj Dawid. Axo winhaj Joram yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayic 17 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Josafat reyal t'a Judá, ix och winhaj Ocozías yuninal winhaj Acab reyal t'a Israel t'a chonhab' Samaria. Chab' ab'il ix yak' reyal chi' winh.

Palta te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha sb'eyb'al smam snun winh ix sb'eyb'alej yet' pax sb'eyb'al winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat, aton winh kuchb'annakb'at heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal.
Ix och winhaj Ocozías chi' ejmelal t'a komon Dios Baal, icha sk'ulejnak winh smam winh. Icha chi' ix aj stzuntzankot yowal sk'ol Jehová sDiosal Israel winh t'a yib'anh.
Ayic toxo ix cham winhaj rey Acab, ix yik'anel sb'a chonhab' Moab t'a yalanh smandar chonhab' Israel.

Ay jun k'u ix kot sutnaj winhaj Ocozías yuninal winhaj Acab chi' t'a spanhanil yib'anh spat t'a Samaria. Te niwan ix aj winh slajwi, yuj chi' ix schekb'at heb' schekab' winh yik b'at sk'anb'ej yab' heb' t'a Baal-zebub sdiosal heb' aj Ecrón, tato olto b'oxok winh.

Palta a jun yángel Jehová ix alan t'a winhaj Elías aj Tisbe icha tik: Ixic, b'at cha heb' schekab' winhaj Ocozías sreyal Samaria, tzalan t'a heb' icha tik: ¿Tom malaj Dios t'a ko chonhab' a onh israel onh tik, yuj chi' ato t'a Baal-zebub sdiosal Ecrón sb'at he k'anb'ej eyab'i? xa chi t'a heb'.

Tzalanpaxi to a in Jehová in swal t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: Manhxo ol ach k'e waan, palta ol ach chamxonhej, xchi Jehová, xa chi, xchi yángel Jehová chi' t'a winhaj Elías chi'. Ix b'at winhaj Elías chi', ix sk'anab'ajan winh icha tas ix alji chi' t'ay.
Yuj chi' ix meltzaj heb' schekab' winh rey chi', ix k'ochxi heb' t'a yichanh winh, ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb': --¿Tas yuj ix ex meltzaj t'a elanhchamel? xchi winh t'a heb'.

Ix tak'wi heb': --Mamin rey, ay jun winh winak ix ko cha t'a yol b'e. Ha winh ix alan t'ayonh icha tik: Meltzajanhec t'a winh ix ex chekankot chi', tzeyalan t'a winh icha tik: Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: ¿Tom malaj Dios t'a Israel tik, yuj chi' ato t'a Baal-zebub sdiosal Ecrón tza chekb'at ab'chajok? Yuj wal jun tas ix a na' tik, manhxo ol ach k'e waan, ol ach chamxonhej, xchi Jehová, xe chi, xchi jun winh chi' t'ayonh, xchi heb'.
Ix sk'anb'an winh rey chi' t'a heb' icha tik: --¿Chajtil yilji jun winh ix alan chi' t'ayex? xchi winh.
--Mamin rey, a jun winh chi' ayoch jun pichul ay xiil yuj winh, aypaxoch jun tzek'ul tz'uum t'a snanhal winh, xchi heb' t'a winh. --Ha jun winh chi', aton winhaj Elías aj Tisbe, xchi winh rey chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix schekanb'at jun winh kapitán winh rey chi' yet' 50 heb' winh soldado yik b'at ik'jokkot winhaj Elías chi'. Axo yik ix k'och heb' t'a winh, k'ojanem winh t'a jun tzalan. Ix yalan winh kapitán chi' t'a winh: --Ach schekab' Dios, a winh rey ix alankoti to tzach emta, xchi winh kapitán chi'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Elías chi' icha tik: --Tato schekab' in Dios, kotokab' k'ak' t'a satcha’anh tzach tz'ab'at yet' 50 heb' winh a soldado chi', xchi winh. Ha wal t'a jun rato chi' ix emta k'ak', ix tz'ab'at heb' winh smasanil.

Ixlajwi chi' ix schekanxib'at junxo winh kapitán winh rey chi' yet' 50-xo heb' winh soldado, ix b'at yalan heb' winh t'a winhaj Elías chi': --Ach schekab' Dios, emanhkot t'a elanhchamel yal winh rey, xchi winh kapitán chi'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Elías chi': --Tato schekab' in Dios, kotokab' k'ak' t'a satcha’anh tzach tz'ab'at yet' 50 heb' winh a soldado chi', xchi winh. D'a wal jun rato chi' ix emta k'ak' t'a satcha’anh, ix tz'ab'at heb' winh smasanil.

Ixlajwi chi' ix schekanxib'at junxo winh kapitán winh rey chi' yet' 50-xo heb' winh soldado t'a yoxelal. Palta a jun winh kapitán chi', ix k'ek'och winh b'aj ayek' winhaj Elías chi', ix em kuman winh t'a yichanh winh, ix yalan winh: --Mamin schekab' Dios, ak' wal niwank'olal t'a wib'anh yet' 50 heb' winh soldado a chekab' tik.

Yujto a juntzanh heb' winh kapitán yet' soldado, heb' winh ix b'ab'laj ja t'ayach, ix tz'ab'at heb' winh yuj k'ak' ix kot t'a satcha’anh. Ha in tik tzin tewi t'ayach to tzonh ak' niwank'olal yik max onh chami, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan yángel Jehová chi' t'a winhaj Elías chi' icha tik: --Ixic yet' winh, manh ach xiwok, xchi t'a winh. Yuj chi' ix emta winhaj Elías chi', ix b'at winh yet' winh kapitán chi', ix b'at winh yil winh rey chi'.

Ix yalan winh icha tik t'a winh rey chi': --Icha wal tik yalan Jehová: Yujto ix a chekb'at heb' a chekab' t'a Baal-zebub sdiosal Ecrón, yik b'at a k'anb'ej a b'a, ichato malaj Dios t'a Israel tik b'aj syal tza k'anb'ej ab'i, yuj chi' manhxo ol ach k'e waan, palta to ol ach chamxonhej, xchi Jehová, xchi winhaj Elías chi'.

Icha chi' ix aji, ix cham winh rey chi', icha tas ix schek Jehová yal winhaj Elías chi'. Yujto malaj junok yuninal winhaj Ocozías chi', yuj chi' a jun winh yuk'tak winh skuchan Joram, a winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok, aton yik schab'ilxo ab'il yoch junxo winhaj Joram yuninal winhaj Josafat reyal t'a Judá.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj rey Ocozías yet' juntzanhxo tas ix sk'ulej winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Ayic toxo wal sk'och sk'ual yik'jib'at winhaj Elías yuj Jehová t'a satcha’anh t'a skal jun chakxuxum ik', ix el winh yet' winhaj Eliseo t'a Gilgal.

Ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Eliseo chi' icha tik: --Cananh t'a tik, yujto tzin schekb'at Jehová t'a Betel, xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Eliseo chi': --Swak' in ti' t'ayach t'a yichanh Jehová to ol in b'atnhej ed'ok, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix b'at heb' winh schawanhil t'a Betel chi'.

Ix elta heb' winh schekab' Dios ay t'a Betel chi' scha heb' winh, ix yalan heb' winh t'a winhaj Eliseo chi': --¿Ojtac ama to a tiknaik ol ik'joquel winh a k'ayb'umal tik t'ayach yuj Jehová? xchi heb' winh t'a winh. --Vojtakxo, tz'inek xe chi, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalanxi winhaj Elías chi' t'a winhaj Eliseo chi' icha tik: --Cananh t'a tik, yujto tzin schekb'at Jehová t'a Jericó, xchi winh. Ix tak'wixi winhaj Eliseo chi': --Swak' in ti' t'ayach t'a yichanh Jehová to ol in b'atnhej ed'ok, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix b'atxi heb' winh schawanhil t'a Jericó chi'.

Ix eltapax heb' winh schekab' Dios ayek' ta' scha heb' winh, ix yalan heb' t'a winhaj Eliseo chi': --¿Ojtac ama to a tiknaik ol ik'joquel winh a k'ayb'umal tik t'ayach yuj Jehová? xchi heb' winh. --Vojtakxo, tz'inek xe chi, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalanxi winhaj Elías chi' t'a winhaj Eliseo chi' icha tik: --Cananh t'a tik, yujto tzin schekb'at Jehová t'ha ha' Jordán, xchi winh. Ix tak'wixi winhaj Eliseo chi': --Swak' in ti' t'ayach t'a yichanh Jehová to ol in b'atnhej ed'ok, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix b'atnhej heb' winh schawanhil.
Najat ix b'at tzak'an 50 heb' winh schekab' Dios yuj heb' winh, najatto ix kan heb' winh t'a yichanhkot heb' winh chawanh chi' t'a sti' ha' Jordán.
Ixlajwi chi' ix spakan jun sjukan pichul winhaj Elías chi', ix spajanem winh t'a sat ha' Jordán chi'. Ix spojan sb'ha ha', taquinh ix aj b'aj ix ek' heb' winh t'a yol ha' chi'.

Ayic toxo ix k'axpaj ek' heb' winh chi', ix yalan winhaj Elías t'a winhaj Eliseo chi' icha tik: --Al t'ayin tas tza nib'ej swak' t'ayach yakb'an manto in ik'joquel t'a a tz'ey, xchi winh. Ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi': --Tzin k'an t'ayach to cha makan tz'aj ak'ankan opisio chi' t'ayin, ichato a b'ab'el unin tzin ajkan a k'exulok, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Elías chi': Te ajaltak jun tza k'an tik t'ayin. Tato ol il tas ol aj wik'jiel t'a a tz'ey, ol ak'jok t'ayach. Tato manh ol il jun, manh ol ak'joklaj t'ayach, xchi winh.

Yakb'an wan sb'ey heb' winh, wan slolon heb' winh. Elanhchamel ix cheklajk'e jun karruaje k'ak' yilji, tok'b'il yuj nok' chej k'ak' yiljipaxi. A' ix ik'anel winhaj Elías chi' t'a stz'ey winhaj Eliseo chi', ix ik'jib'at winh t'a satcha’anh t'a skal jun chakxuxum ik'.

Ayic ix yilan jun chi' winhaj Eliseo chi', ix el yaw winh, ix yalan winh: Ay mamin, lajan ach icha nok' chej yet' karruaje yik owal t'ayonh israel onh tik, yujto tzach kolwajnhej t'ayonh, xchi winh. Manhxa b'aj ix yil winhaj Elías winhaj Eliseo chi'. Ix snhik'chitanb'at jun spichul winhaj Eliseo ayoch yuj yik sch'oxanel skusk'olal winh.
Elanhchamel ix b'at winh sik'k'e jun sjukan pichul winhaj Elías ix kan lanhnaj chi'. Ix meltzajkan winh t'ha ha' Jordán chi', ix och linhan winh t'a sti' ha'.

Ix spajanem sjukan pichul winhaj Elías chi' winh t'a sat ha ha' chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: ¿B'ajtil ayek' Jehová sDiosal winhaj Elías? xchi winh. Ixnhej em k'apak chi' t'a sat ha', ix spojan sb'ha ha'. Icha chi' ix aj yek'xita winh t'a yol ha'.

Ayic ix yilan heb' winh schekab' Dios ay t'a Jericó, aton heb' winh najat linhjab'kan yila', ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: Ha yopisio winhaj Elías ix ochkan t'a winhaj Eliseo tik, xchi heb' winh. Ix kot heb' scha winh, ix em nhojnaj heb' t'a yichanh winh.

Ix yalan heb' icha tik: --Mamin, iltonab'i, ay 50 heb' winh winak t'a ko kal tik te tek'an. Tato syal a k'ol sb'at heb' winh say winh a k'ayb'umal chi', talaj ay b'aj ix aktajkan winh yuj Yespíritu Jehová t'a jolomtak witz, ma t'a yoltak ch'olan, xchi heb' winh t'a winh. Palta ix yalan winh: --Maay, malaj mach sb'ati, xchi winh.
Ix ochnhej ijan heb' winh yalan t'a winh, yuj chi' ix yal winh icha tik: Ixiquec an, xchi winh. Ix b'at heb' winh 50 chi' say t'a oxe' k'ual. Malaj mach ix ilchaj yuj heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzaj heb' winh t'a Jericó b'aj aykan winhaj Eliseo chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh: --¿Tom maj wal t'ayex jun to max ex b'atlaj? xchi winh.

Ix yalan heb' anima kajan t'a jun chonhab' chi' t'a winhaj Eliseo chi' icha tik: --Mamin, ilnab' wal yilji jun lugar tik, te wach', palta malaj tas tz'el t'a sat lu'um yujto manh wach'ok ha ha' ay t'a lu'um, xchi heb'.
--Ix yalan winh t'a heb' icha tik: --Ik'ekkot atz'am atz'am t'a yol junok uk'ab' ak'to, xchi winh. Ix yik'ankot jun uk'ab' atz'am chi' heb' t'a winh,

ix b'at sekanem winh t'a yol sjaj ha ha' chi'. Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Icha tik yalan Jehová: Ha in ix in b'o jun ha ha' tik. Manhxa b'ak'uinh ay mach ol cham yuj ha', manhxa pax b'ak'uinh malaj tas ol yak' t'a sat lu'um yuj ha', xchi Jehová, xchi winh.
Icha chi' ix aj sb'okan ha', icha ix aj yalan winhaj Eliseo chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winh t'a Betel. Ayic wan sk'e winh t'a sb'eal chi', ay jun nhilanh heb' winh kelemtak ay t'a jun chonhab' chi' ix elta t'a yol sb'e winh, ix och ijan heb' winh sb'ajan winh, ix yalan heb' winh: Q'ueanh ach d'en jolom. Q'ueanh ach d'en jolom, xchi heb' winh.

Ix meltzajb'at k'elan winh t'a heb' winh, ix katab'aj heb' winh yuj winh t'a sb'i Jehová. Elanhchamel ix elta chawanh nok' oso t'a kaltak te', ix kotak nhik'chitajb'at 42 heb' winh kelemtak chi' yuj nok'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winh t'a jolom witz Carmelo, ix meltzajxi winh t'a Samaria.
Ayic 18 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Josafat reyal t'a Judá, ix schaanel yich winhaj Joram yuninal winhaj Acab yak'an reyal t'a Israel, 12 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Samaria.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, palta maj k'och wal ijan chukal ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh yik smam snun. Yujto ix sjuel jun k'een k'een winh yik Baal sb'onakkan winh smam winh chi'.
Wach'chom icha chi', palta ix sb'eyb'alejnhej schukal b'eyb'al winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat winh, aton winh kuchb'annakb'at heb' israel t'a chukal.

Ha winhaj Mesa sreyal Moab, molum kalnel winh yet' masanil anima ay t'a yol smakb'en chi'. Yuj chi' a nok' syak' winh yik stupan winh t'a winh sreyal Israel chi', 100 mil nok' yunetak kalnel yet' pax 100 mil nok' ch'ak kalnel yet' slanail syak' winh.
Palta ayik ix cham winhaj Acab, ix yik'anel sb'a winh sreyal Moab chi' t'a yalanh smandar chonhab' Israel.
Yuj chi', ix el winhaj Joram t'a Samaria, ix smolb'an masanil heb' soldado yik Israel winh.

Elanhchamel ix yalb'at winh t'a winhaj Josafat sreyal Judá: Ha winh sreyal Moab toxo ix yik'el sb'a winh t'a yalanh in mandar, ¿tzam yal a k'ol tzach och wed'ok yik skak'an owal yet' winh? xchib'at winh. Ix tak'wi winh sreyal Judá chi' icha tik: Ol in b'at ed'ok yet' heb' in soldado yet' nok' in chej.
Anhej b'ian, ¿tas b'eal b'aj ol onh b'atok? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Joram chi' ix yalan winh: Ha t'a sb'eal taquinh lu'um t'a yol yik Edom, ata' ol onh b'atok, xchi winh.

Icha chi' ix aj sb'at winh sreyal Israel yet' winh sreyal Judá yet' pax winh sreyal Edom yet' heb' soldado. Uque' k'ual ix b'ey heb' yujto ix ek' yoymitej lum taquinh lum chi' heb', yuj chi' ix lajwiel ha' yaal heb' soldado syuk'ej yet' pax yik masanil snok' heb' yet'nak.
Yuj chi' ix yal winh sreyal Israel chi' icha tik: --Ha tiknaik, ichato onh smolb'ej Jehová a onh oxwanh rey onh tik yik tzonh yak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' aj Moab tik, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Josafat chi' icha tik: --¿Mama junok winh schekab' Jehová ayek' t'a tik yik wach' sk'anb'ej winh t'a Jehová kuuj? xchi winh. Ay jun winh yajal soldado yaj t'a winh sreyal Israel chi' ix tak'wi icha tik: --Ha t'a tik ayek' winhaj Eliseo yuninal winhaj Safat. Aton winh schekab'kan winhaj Elías, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Josafat chi' icha tik: Ha jun winh chi' yel schekab' Jehová yaj winh, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix b'at oxwanh heb' winh rey chi' lolonel yet' winhaj Eliseo chi'.

Palta ix yalan winh t'a winh sreyal Israel chi' icha tik: --¿Tas walan wik t'ayach? Ixic, b'at k'anb'ej a b'ha t'a heb' winh schekab' sdiosalkan heb' a mam a nun, xchi winh. Palta ix yalan winh sreyal Israel chi': --Maay, yujto onh ik'jikot yuj Jehová a onh oxwanh rey onh tik, yik tzonh yak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' moabita, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi' t'a winh: --D'a wal yichanh Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil swala', aton jun swak' serwil, q'uinalok malaj yelk'och winhaj Josafat sreyal Judá tik t'a yol in sat, manh jab'ok tzin cha wab' tas tzala', max in ochpax k'elan jab'ok t'ayach.

Ik'ekkot junok mach syal schalan te' arpa t'a wichanh tik, xchi winh. Ix yik'ankot jun winh syal schalan te' arpa chi' heb' winh. Ayic wan schalan te' arpa chi' winh, ix jawi yipalil Jehová t'a winhaj Eliseo chi',
Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: B'oek tzijtumok sanja t'a jun ch'olan tik.
Wach'chom malaj ik', ma nhab' ol eyil sjawi, palta a jun ch'olan tik ol b'ud'jok yuj ha ha', yuj chi' he masanil ol eyuk' ha', ol yuk'an ha' nok' he wakax yet' pax nok' he chej, xchi Jehová.
Chequelnhej wal yaj jun tik t'a yichanh tas ol sk'ulej Jehová, ol yak'och heb' moabita chi' t'a yol he k'ab'.

Yuj chi' ol he juem lanhnaj schonhab' heb' wach' yajoch smuroal yet' juntzanh niwak chonhab' wach' yilji. Ol he ch'akanem masanil yawb'en te' heb', ol laj he mukankan sjaj ha' yuk'lab' ha' heb', ol he b'ut'ankan sat slum heb' yet' k'een k'een b'aj smunlaji, xchi winhaj Eliseo chi'.
Axo ix aji, ha t'a junxo q'uinhib'alil, icha yorail tz'ak'ji silab' t'a Jehová, ha t'a yol yik Edom, ix kot ha ha', ix b'ud'jiel sat lum lum chi' yuj ha'.

Ayic ix yab'an heb' moabita to wan sk'och heb' winh rey yak' owal yet' heb', ix smolb'an masanil heb' winh kelemtak heb' yet' heb' winh ichamtak winak, heb' winh syal yoch t'a owal, ix och heb' winh smak t'a sat smojon snakión chi'.
Ayic ix k'e wan heb' moabita chi' t'a q'uinhib'alil, ix yilan heb' toxonhej skopopi yilji yib'anh ha ha' chi' yuj yok k'u, ichato chik'xonhej yilji ha'.
Yuj chi' ix yalan heb' icha tik: Ha jun chi' chik'. Tope a heb' winh rey yet' heb' winh soldado ix smil-lajcham sb'a. Ha tiknaik koyek sb'at quik'ankan masanil tastak yet'nak heb' ix kani, xchi heb'.

Palta haxo ix jawi heb' moabita t'a skampamento heb' israel, ix elta heb' israel chi' yak' owal yet' heb', ix ak'ji ganar heb' moabita chi' yuj heb'. Yuj chi' ix el heb' elelal, palta ix och heb' israel chi' t'a spatik heb', ix miljicham heb' yuj heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix sjuanem lanhnaj schonhab' heb' moabita chi' heb', ix sb'ut'an lum lum heb' t'a k'een k'een, aton lum te yax sat yik munlajel. Ix smukan sjajtak ha ha' heb', ix sch'akanel masanil te' awb'en te' heb' te wach'. Axonhej chonhab' Kir-hareset ixto kani, palta haxo heb' sjulwaj yet' ch'anh mejmeech, ix oymaj heb' t'a spatiktak chonhab' chi', ix yak'an ganar jun chonhab' chi' heb'.

Ayic ix yilan winh sreyal Moab to wan yak'ji ganar winh t'a owal chi', ix yik'ankot 700 heb' soldado winh, heb' te jelan yak'an owal yet' k'een espada. Ix yekanoch sb'a heb' t'a skal heb' soldado yik sk'och heb' b'aj ayek' winh sreyal Edom chi', yik smilancham winh heb' yalani, palta maj yal-laj yuj heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'ankot jun sb'ab'el yuninal winh sreyal Moab chi', aton jun d'inhan yochkan reyal sk'exulok winh. Ix snhusantz'a winh silab'il t'a sdiosal t'a yib'anh smuroal schonhab' chi'. Te chuk ix aj snaan heb' winh israel chi' yuj jun chi', yuj chi' ix yik'k'e waan skampamento heb' winh, ix pax heb' winh t'a schonhab'.

Ay jun ix ix yetb'eyumkan junok heb' winh schekab' Dios, ix b'at ix yal sb'ha t'a winhaj Eliseo icha tik: --Ha winh wetb'eyum chamnakxo winh, ojtak to te ay xiwk'olal winh t'a Jehová. Axo tiknaik ay jun winh ak'annak k'een tumin smajnej winh wetb'eyum chi', ix jawi winh t'ayin, snib'ej winh syik'b'at chawanh heb' wune' tik schekab'ok yuj k'een tumin chi', xchi ix.

Ix sk'anb'an winhaj Eliseo chi' t'a ix icha tik: --¿Tas tza nib'ej tzin b'o t'ayach? Al t'ayin tastak ay t'ayach, xchi winh. Ix yalan ix t'a winh icha tik: --Ha in a chekab' in tik, malaj wal jab'ok tas ay t'ayin, anhej wal jab' yune' xalu akeite ayek' t'ayin, xchi ix.
Ix yalan winh t'a ix: --Ixic, tza k'anan a majnej jantak xalu t'a heb' ay t'a a lak'anil, jantaknhej malaj yool tz'ilchaj uuj.

Elanhchamel tzach och t'a yol a pat yet' heb' winh une' chi'. Tza makan a pat chi', tzak'an b'ud'jok masanil juntzanh yet'tal chi' t'a akeite chi'. Ch'ok b'aj tzak'kanem juntzanh sb'ud'jikan chi', xchi winh.
Ayic ix lajwi slolon ix yet' winhaj Eliseo chi', ix b'at smakanoch sb'a ix yet' heb' winh yune' chi' t'a yol spat, ix syamanoch heb' sb'ut'an juntzanh xalu ix smajnej chi' t'a akeite chi'.

Ayic toxo ix b'ud'ji masanil xalu chi', ix yalan ix t'a junok heb' winh yune' chi' icha tik: --Ik'kot junokxo xalu, xchi ix. Ix yalan jun winh yune' ix chi': --Manhxalaj tas, xchi winh. Ha wal t'a jun rato chi' ix wanaj akeite chi' yeli.

Ix lajwinhej chi', ix b'at ix yal t'a winhaj Eliseo schekab' Dios chi', ix yalan winh icha tik t'a ix: --Ha tiknaik ixik a chonh akeite chi', slajwi chi' tza tupan a b'ok chi', haxo jantak stojol chi' skani, tza k'an k'een yet' heb' winh une' chi', xchi winh t'a ix.

Ay jun k'u ix ek' winhaj Eliseo t'a chonhab' Sunem. Ata' ay jun ix ix te b'eyum. Ix och tean ix t'a winh to tzek' winh wael t'a spat ix. Yuj chi' ayik tzek' winh juntak el t'a jun chonhab' chi', tzek'nhej winh wael t'a spat ix chi'.
Yuj chi' ix yalan ix t'a winh yetb'eyum icha tik: --Ha tiknaik, snachajel wuuj to a jun winh tzek'nhej onh yil t'a juntak el, wal yel schekab' Dios yaj winh.
Yuj chi', wach' sko b'o junok kuarto t'a yib'anh ko pat tik, skak'anoch junok ch'at t'a yool, junok mexa, junok xila yet' junok kandil, yik wach' ayik sjawi winh onh yila', ata' skan winh, xchi ix.
Ix ek'xi winhaj Eliseo chi' ta' yet' winh schekab' skuchan Giezi, ix k'e heb' winh t'a yol jun kuarto chi', ata' ix waykan heb' winh.
Ix yalan winh t'a winh schekab' chi' icha tik: --Avtej ix aj Sunem chi', xchi winh. Ix yawtan ix winh, ix jawi ix t'a yichanh winhaj Eliseo chi', ix yalan winh t'a winh schekab' chi':

--k'anb'ej t'a ix tas snib'ej sk'ol ix, yujto te wach' syutej sk'ol ix t'ayonh. Tato syal sk'ol ix syal tzonh lolon yet' winh rey yuj ix, ma yet' heb' yajalil heb' soldado, xchi winh. Ix yalan ix: --Maay, wach' waj t'a yol in chonhab' tik, xchi ix t'a winh chekab' chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix pax ix.
--¿Tas wach' sko k'ulej t'a ix syal chi'? xchi winh t'a winh schekab' chi'. --Max nachajel wuuj, anhej, malaj yune' ix, haxo winh yetb'eyum ix icham winakxo winh, xchi winhaj Giezi chi'.
--Avtejxicot ix, xchi winhaj Eliseo chi'. Ix awtajxikot ix, ix jawi tek'tek' ix t'a spuertail jun kuarto chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi' t'a ix: --Yab' wal icha tik junab', chelb'ilxo k'e junok une' uuj, xchi winh t'a ix. Ix yalan ix icha tik: --Maay mamin, ach schekab' Dios, manh ach b'uchwaj t'ayin, xchi ix.
Palta ix skuchanoch jun yune' ix, haxo t'a junxo ab'il, ix alji jun yune' ix chi', icha wal ix aj yalan winhaj Eliseo chi'.
Ix q'uib' jun unin chi', ay jun k'u ix b'at yil winh smam b'aj ayb'at yil heb' sjochum trigo.

Ix yalan jun unin chi' t'a winh smam chi' icha tik: --Ay, te ya in jolom. Te ya in jolom, xchi. Ix yalan winh mamab'il chi' t'a junok heb' winh schekab': --Ik'b'at winh unin tik t'a ix snun, xchi winh.
Ix ik'jib'at winh unin chi' t'a ix snun yuj winh chekab' chi', ix schelank'e ix t'a sat xub', haxo ix och chimk'ualil ix chami.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at yak'ankanek' telan ix t'a sat sch'at winhaj Eliseo schekab' Dios chi', ix smakankan jun kuarto chi' ix.
Elanhchamel ix yawtej winh yetb'eyum ix, ix yalan ix t'a winh: --Chekb'at junok heb' winh ko chekab' yet' junok nok' b'uru wed'ok, sb'at wilan winh schekab' Dios, naktik in jaxi, xchi ix.
--¿Tas yuj b'at il winh tiknaik? Manh stiempoalok yalji k'een uj, manh sk'ualok pax ik'oj ip, xchi winh yetb'eyum ix chi'. --Manh ak' pensar, xchi ix.

Ix yalan ix to tz'ak'jioch stz'uum nok' b'uru chi', ix yalan ix t'a winh schekab' chi': --Conh an, yelk'olal a pechan nok', manh a cha och waan nok' t'a yol b'e masanto a in ol wal t'ayach, xchi ix t'a winh.

Icha chi' ix aj sb'at ix masanto ix k'och ix t'a lum witz Carmelo b'aj ayek' winhaj Eliseo schekab' Dios chi'. Najatto wan skot ix ix yilanb'at winh, ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Giezi icha tik: --Ilnab'i, a ix aj Sunem sjawi chi'.
Ixic b'at cha ix, tza k'anb'an t'a ix tato wach' sk'ol ix yet' winh yetb'eyum yet' winh nene' unin, xchi winh. Ix b'at winh scha ix. Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a ix, ix yalan ix to wach' sk'ol heb'.

Palta elanhchamel ix k'och ix b'aj ayek' winhaj Eliseo t'a lum witz Carmelo chi', ix och lak'naj ix t'a yok winh, haxo winhaj Giezi chi' ix quetzanel ix yalani. Ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Actejel ix, yujto te kusnak spixan ix swila', manta tas syal Jehová t'ayin tas yuj ix kot ix, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalan ix icha tik: --Mamin, ¿tokwal a in ix in k'an t'ayach to tz'alji junok wune'? ¿Tom maj wal t'ayach tas yuj tonhej tzach b'uchwaj t'ayin? xchi ix.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj Eliseo t'a winh schekab' chi': --Ak' lista a b'a, ik'b'at te' in k'okoch tik ed'ok, tzach b'at t'a elanhchamel. Tato ay mach tza cha'a, manh ach lolon yet'ok. Tato ay heb' tz'awajkot t'ayach, manh ach tak'wok t'a heb'. Ayic tzach k'och chi' tzak'em te' in k'okoch tik t'a sat winh unin chi', xchi winh.
Ix yalan ix snun winh unin chi': --Swak' in ti' t'ayach t'a yichanh Jehová to max in b'at t'a tik tato max ach b'at wed'ok, xchi ix.

Yuj chi' ix b'at winh yet' ix. Axo pax winhaj Giezi chi', toxo ix b'ab'lajb'at winh, toxo ix yak'em te' k'okoch chi' winh t'a sat winh unin chi', palta maj jaxlaj sk'ol winh. Yuj chi' ix kot winh scha winhaj Eliseo chi', ix yalan winh: --Max jalaj sk'ol winh unin chi', xchi winh.
Ayic ix k'och winhaj Eliseo t'a yol kuarto chi', telanek' winh unin chi' t'a sat sch'at winh, chamnakxo.
Yuj chi' ix och winh t'a yol jun kuarto chi' sch'okoj yet' winh unin chi', ix smakan winh, ix lesalwi winh t'a Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi' ix k'e winh t'a sat ch'at chi', ix k'e lachan winh t'a yib'anh winh unin chi', ix em tenan sat winh t'a sat winh unin chi', ix yak'anoch sti' winh t'a sti' yet' sk'ab' winh t'a sk'ab'. Ix k'e lachan winh t'a yib'anh winh unin chi'. Ix q'uixnajxi sniwanil winh unin chi'.

Ix el winh t'a yib'anh winh unin chi', ix ek' b'esesok winh t'a yol pat chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix k'ex lachan winh t'a yib'anh winh unin chi' icha t'a sb'ab'elal. Axo ix aj jun, uquel ix ad'iswi winh unin chi', ichato chi' ix elta k'elan winh.

Ix yawtan winhaj Giezi winhaj Eliseo chi', ix yalan winh: --Avtejcot ix sunamita chi', xchi winh. Ix b'at winh yawtejkot ix. Axo ix k'och ix t'a stz'ey winhaj Eliseo chi' jun, ix yalan winh: --Ina winh une' tik, xchi winh.
Ix snitzanoch sb'a ix, ix em kuman ix t'a yichanh winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix schelank'e winh yune' ix chi', ix elta ix t'a yol skuarto winhaj Eliseo chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix meltzajxi winhaj Eliseo chi' t'a Gilgal ayik te ayem jun niwan wejel t'a yol yik Israel. Ha junel molanoch heb' winh schekab' Dios t'a stz'ey winhaj Eliseo chi', ix yalan winh t'a winh schekab' icha tik: Ak'k'e junok niwan chen t'a yib'anh k'ak', tza b'oan swael heb' winh schekab' Dios tik, xchi winh.

Ay jun winh t'a skal heb' winh chekab' chi' ix b'at sayoj itaj. Ix ilchaj jun anh itaj icha anh kaltakte'al k'um ay sat yuj winh. Ix smolankot sat chi' winh t'a yol jun spichul jukan. Axo yik ix jax winh, ix slesanem winh t'a yol jun niwan chen chi', palta manh yojtakok winh tas.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'an winh t'a heb' winh schekab' Dios chi'. Axo ix syamanoch heb' winh swa'i, ix el yaw heb' winh, ix yalan heb' winh: --Mamin schekab' Dios, a jun wan ko chi'an tik ayb'at weneno t'a skal, xchi heb' winh. Yuj chi' majxo schilaj heb' winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi' icha tik: --Ik'ekkot jab'ok ixim harina t'ayin, xchi winh. Ix yak'anem ixim winh t'a yol chen chi', ix yalan winh: --Ha tiknaik ak' wa heb' anima tik, xchi winh. Axo ix schi'an heb', manhxalaj tas ix ik'an heb'.

Axo t'a junel ix k'och jun winh winak aj Baal-salisa, yet'nak 20 ixim pan kebada winh b'ob'il t'a ixim b'ab'el sat kebada chi', ix yak'an winh t'a winhaj Eliseo chi', yet'nakpax ixim jolom trigo winh yaxto. Ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi' t'a winh schekab': --Ak' ixim pan chi' swa heb' anima tik, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winh schekab' winh chi': --¿Tocwal ol yal wak'an jab' tik t'a 100 anima tik? xchi winh. Ix yalanxi winhaj Eliseo chi': --Ak' wa heb' anima tik, yujto toxo ix yal Jehová to ol wa heb', aytopax ol kanok, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an wa heb' anima chi' winh chekab' chi'. Ayto ix kani, icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová.

Ay jun winh winak skuch Naamán, yajalil heb' soldado winh sreyal Siria. Te xajan winh yuj winh rey chi', te niwan pax yelk'och winh, yujto a Jehová ix ak'anoch heb' ajk'ol t'a yol sk'ab' winh. Te jelan winh t'a owal, palta ayoch jun yab'il lepra t'a winh.
Ay junel, ay juntzanh heb' soldado aj Siria ix b'at elk'al t'a yol yik Israel. Ix yelk'ejb'at jun ix kob'es unin heb'. Ix och ix schekab'ok ix yetb'eyum winhaj Naamán chi'.
Ix yalan ix kob'es unin chi' t'a ix b'aj ayoch chekab'ok chi': --Comonoc sb'at winh in patrón tik t'a jun winh schekab' Dios ay t'a Samaria, talaj sb'oxi winh yuj jun yab'il tik, xchi ix.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Naamán chi' yal t'a winh sreyal Siria tas ix yal ix kob'es chi'.

Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winh: --Wach' tzach b'ati, swak'b'at junok karta t'a winh sreyal Israel chi', xchi winh. Icha chi' ix aj sb'at winhaj Naamán chi', ix yik'anb'at nanhal swajxaquil quintal k'een plata winh yet' nanhal schab'il quintal k'een oro yet' lajunh moj pichul.

Ix yik'anb'at jun karta chi' winh t'a winh sreyal Israel chi', syalan winh sreyal Siria chi' t'a jun karta chi' icha tik: Ayic ol a chaan in karta tik, ol ojtaquejeli to a in tzin chekb'at winh sat yajal heb' in soldado skuchan Naamán tik t'ayach, tzanhtej winh t'a jun lepra ayoch t'ay, xchi winh t'a skarta chi'.

Ayic ix lajwi yilan jun karta chi' winh sreyal Israel chi', ix snhik'chitanb'at spichul winh yuj sch'oxaneli to tz'och winh t'a ilk'olal, ix yalan winh: --Tocwal Dios in, ¿tom a in syal wak'an schamel anima, ma swak'anpax sk'inal heb', yuj chi' schekjikot jun winh winak tik t'ayin yik swik'el jun lepra tik t'a winh? Syalelk'ochi to ay tas sna' winh rey chi' t'a in patik, xchi winh.

Ayic ix yab'an winhaj Eliseo schekab' Dios to ix snhik'chitejb'at spichul winh rey chi', ix yalanb'at winh: --¿Tas yuj ix a nhik'chitejb'at a pichul? Checcot jun winh chi' t'ayin, ol yilan winh to ay schekab' Dios t'a ko chonhab' Israel tik, xchib'at winh.
Ix b'at winhaj Naamán chi' yet' skarruaje yet' schej yet' heb' ajun yet'ok, ix k'och linhan heb' t'a sti' spat winhaj Eliseo chi'.

Ix schekanb'at winh schekab' winhaj Eliseo chi' yal t'a winhaj Naamán chi' icha tik: Ixic, b'at b'iquel uquelok a b'ha t'ha ha' Jordán, icha chi' ol aj yel yab'il lepra chi' t'a a niwanil chi', xchi winhaj Eliseo chi'.

Ix kot yowal winhaj Naamán chi', ix b'at winh, ix yalan winh: --Ha wal in naani to ol elta winh in scha'a, ol k'e wal linhan winh slesalwi t'a Jehová sDiosal t'a wichanh, ol yak'anek' sk'ab' winh b'aj ayoch lepra chi' t'ayin, tz'elkan yab'il walani.

¿Toc ek'b'al swach'il junok ha' ay t'a Israel tik t'a yichanh ha' Abana yet' ha' Farfar ay t'a Damasco? ¿Tom max yal b'at in b'ikanel in b'ha t'a yol ha' chi', tzin b'oxi? xchi winh. Te aykot yowal winh, ix meltzaj winh.

Palta haxo heb' schekab' winh ajun yet'ok, ix yal heb' t'a winh icha tik: --Mamin, q'uinalok ay junok tas ajaltak ix yal winh schekab' Dios t'ayach, ¿tom max a k'anab'ajej? Ocxo jun, anhej ix yal winh to tza b'iquel a b'a tzach b'oxikani, xchi heb' t'a winh.

Ichato chi' ix b'at winhaj Naamán chi', uquel ix em winh t'a yol ha' Jordán chi', icha ix aj yalan winhaj Eliseo schekab' Dios. Ix b'oxikan sniwanil winh chi', icha sniwanil junok unin, te wach' ix ajkani.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winh yet' heb' ajun yet' chi' yil winhaj Eliseo chi'. Ayic ix k'och heb' t'a yichanh winh, ix yalan winhaj Naamán chi' icha tik: --Ha tiknaik ix nachajel wuuj to malaj junokxo Dios t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, palta anhej wal he Diosal a ex israel ex tik. Yuj chi', elokab' t'a a k'ool a chaan in silab' swak' tik t'ayach, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Eliseo chi': --Swak' in ti' t'a Jehová, aton ayin schekab', max in chalaj tas tzak' chi', xchi winh. Wach'chom ix ochnhej tean winhaj Naamán chi' t'a winh, palta maj schalaj winh.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj Naamán chi' icha tik: --Tato icha chi' jun, elok wal t'a a k'ool a chaan wik'b'at chab'ok chejal lum lum yik Israel tik, yujto a in a chekab' in tik, manhxa junokxo Dios b'aj ol wak' in silab', palta to anhej t'a Jehová sDiosal Israel.

Anhej wal jun tzin k'an t'a Jehová to tzin yak' niwank'olal, yujto ayik ol b'at winh in reyal yak'em sb'ha t'a stemplo sdiosal skuch Rimón, ol och quetzquetz winh t'a in k'ab', anhejtona' ol in em kuman yet' winh t'a templo chi', yak'okab' niwank'olal Jehová t'a in patik yuj jun chi', xchi winhaj Naamán chi'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Eliseo chi': --Manh ak' pensar, ixik, xchi winh. Ix b'at winhaj Naamán chi'. Palta quenanto sb'at winh,

ix snaan winhaj Giezi schekab' winhaj Eliseo chi': ¿Tas yuj tonhej ix schab'at winhaj Naamán aj Siria winh wajalil tik, malaj jab'ok tas ix yak'kan winh? Swak' in ti' t'a Jehová to b'at in tzak'wej winh, yalnhej tas ol wik'ek' t'a winh, xchi winh.

Ix b'at lemnaj winhaj Giezi chi'. Axo ix yilankot winhaj Naamán to wan skot winh t'a spatik, ix emta winh t'a yol skarruaje, ix kot winh scha winh, ix sk'anb'an winh: --¿Mantoc ay tas ix uji? xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Giezi chi' icha tik: Maay, malaj tasi, palta a winh wajalil ix in chekankot wal t'ayach to ato wal sk'och chawanh heb' kelemtak schekab' Dios spetoj t'a tzalquixtak yik Efraín. Yuj chi' sk'an winh t'ayach to tzak' oxeok arroba k'een plata yet' cha mojanhok k'apak pichul yuj heb' winh, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Naamán chi': --Comonoc tz'el t'a a k'ool tza cha wal waqueok arroba k'een plata tik, xchi winh. Yakb'an wan yalan winh chi', ix schekan winh ak'chajem k'een yet' cha moj k'apak pichul chi' t'a yol chab' koxtal, ix yak'ankot chawanh schekab' winh yet' winhaj Giezi chi'.

Ayic ix k'och heb' t'a tzalan b'aj ayek' winhaj Eliseo chi', ix yik'an ek' winhaj Giezi tastak yet'nak heb' schekab' winhaj Naamán chi', ix sk'ub'ankanel winh t'a yol spat, ix schekan meltzaj heb' winh.
Elanhchamel ix jawi winh t'a winhaj Eliseo chi', ix sk'anb'an winhaj Eliseo chi' t'a winh: --Giezi, ¿b'ajtil ix ach xid'eq'ui? xchi winh. --Malaj b'aj ix in xid'ek' mamin, xchi winhaj Giezi chi'.

Palta ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Ayic ix emta jun winh winak t'a yol skarruaje ix kot winh ul ach scha'a, ¿tokwal maj yil in pixan jun chi' tza na'a? Ha tiknaik, manh smojok ko chaan tumin yet' pichul. Manh smojok pax ko manan te' awb'en te', icha te' oliwo yet' te' uwa, nok' kalnel, ma nok' wakax, ma heb' winh chekab' yet' heb' ix chekab'.

Yuj jun tas ix a k'ulej tik, a tiknaik, a slepra winhaj Naamán chi' ol ochkan t'ayach yet' t'a heb' inhtilal t'a junelnhej, xchi winh. Axo yik ix spukan sb'a winhaj Giezi yet' winhaj Eliseo chi', ayxo lepra t'a winh, sakxonhej yilji sniwanil winh icha k'een cheew.
Ay junel ix yal heb' winh schekab' Dios t'a winhaj Eliseo: --Ina wal jun lugar b'aj ayonh ek' ed' tik, te lot'an.
Yuj chi' tzok wal el t'a a k'ool tzonh a chab'at t'a sti' ha' Jordán, sb'at ko ch'ak junjunok ko te', sko b'oank'e junok pat b'aj tzonh aji, xchi heb' winh. --Ixiquec, xchi winhaj Eliseo chi'.
--Tzoc yal a k'ool tzach b'at qued'ok, xchi jun winh t'a winh. --Inye, ol in b'atok, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Eliseo chi' yet' heb' winh t'a sti' ha' Jordán ch'akoj te' chi'.

Ayic wan sch'akan te' heb' winh, ay jun winh ix elta surnaj k'een sch'akab', ix b'atkan k'een t'a yol ha ha' chi', ix el yaw winh: --Ach in k'ayb'umal. Ha jun k'een ch'akab' tik hierro k'een, in majanpax k'een, xchi winh.

--¿B'ajtil ix b'at k'een? xchi winhaj Eliseo chi'. Ix sch'oxan winh b'aj ix b'at k'een chi'. Ix xikanelta jun te te' winhaj Eliseo chi', ix yak'anem te' winh t'a yol ha', ix k'eul b'akhnaj k'een ch'akab' chi' t'a sat ha'.
--Ik'k'eta k'een, xchi winhaj Eliseo chi' t'a winh. Ix yak'anem sk'ab' winh, ix yik'ank'eta k'een winh.
Ha winh sreyal Siria ayoch owal yuj winh t'a Israel, ix slajtian sb'a winh yet' heb' winh yajalil heb' winh soldado smasanil b'ajtil sb'ok'e skampamento heb' winh.
Ix yalanb'at winhaj Eliseo t'a winh sreyal Israel b'ajtak ayek' heb' winh aj Siria chi' yik wach' syak' lista sb'a winh b'ajtak ayek' heb' winh chi'.
Ix schekanpaxb'at yilumal winh sreyal Israel t'a juntzanh lugar b'aj syal winh schekab' Dios chi', yik syil heb' winh tas yaji, yuj chi' tzijtum el ix skol sb'a heb' winh.

Ha winh sreyal Siria chi', ix te somchaj spensar winh, yuj chi' ix yawtej heb' winh yajalil soldado winh, ix yalan winh: --Alec t'ayin mach junok t'a ko kal tik ayoch yet' winh sreyal Israel chi', xchi winh t'a heb' winh.

Ix tak'wi jun winh yajal soldado icha tik: --Malaj mach mamin, palta a winhaj Eliseo schekab' Dios ayek' t'a Israel chi', a winh tz'alan t'a winh rey masanil tas tzala', wach'chom t'a elk'altak tzala', xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix yal winh sreyal Siria chi': --Ixiquec, b'at ilek b'ajtil ayek' winhaj Eliseo chi', ol wak'anb'at jaywanhok in soldado yik b'at tzek'jikot winh, xchi winh. Axo ix aj yalji t'a winh rey chi' to ha t'a Dotán ayek' winhaj Eliseo chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yak'anb'at jun nhilanh heb' winh soldado winh yet' heb' winh ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej yet' karruaje yik owal. D'ak'walil ix k'och heb' winh t'a Dotán chi', ix yoyan sb'a heb' winh t'a spatiktak chonhab' chi'.

Ayic ix sakb'i, ix k'e waan winh schekab' winhaj Eliseo chi'. Ayic ix elta winh, ix yilan winh to manhxo jantakok soldado oyanek' t'a spatiktak chonhab' chi', ay nok' chej yet' karruaje yik owal. Yuj chi' ix b'at winh yal t'a winhaj Eliseo chi': --Ay mamin, ¿tas wal ol ko k'ulej? xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Eliseo chi': --Manh ach xiwok, yujto ek'alto sb'isul heb' ayek' qued'ok t'a yichanh heb' winh chi', xchi winh.

Ix och ijan winhaj Eliseo chi' slesalwi t'a Jehová icha tik: Mamin tzin k'an t'ayach to tza jak sat winh in chekab' tik, xchi winh. Ix jakji sat winh chekab' chi' yuj Jehová, ix yilan winh to ha t'a sattak witz yet' t'a jolomtak witz, toxonhej oyankot soldado t'a yib'anh chej yet' t'a yoltak karruaje nab'a k'ak', oyanoch t'a spatik yichanh winhaj Eliseo chi'.

Ayic wan sjawi heb' winh sirio chi' yak' owal, ix sk'anan winhaj Eliseo chi' t'a Jehová: Mamin tzin k'an t'ayach to tza mak sat heb' winh tik, xchi winh. Axo Jehová ix makan sat heb' winh soldado ajk'ol chi', icha ix aj sk'anan winhaj Eliseo chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winhaj Eliseo chi' yal t'a heb' winh: --Manhoklaj jun b'e yet' jun chonhab' tik tze saya'. Ochanhec tzak'an wuuj, ol ex wik'b'at b'aj ayek' jun winh tze say chi', xchi winh t'a heb' winh. Ix yik'anb'at heb' winh winh t'a Samaria.

Ayic toxo ix och heb' winh t'a yol chonhab' chi', ix lesalwi winh icha tik: Mamin Jehová, jak sat heb' winh yik syal yilan heb' winh, xchi winh. Ix jakji sat heb' winh chi'. Ix yilan heb' winh to ha t'a yol chonhab' Samaria ayek' heb' winh.
Ayic ix yilan heb' winh chi' winh sreyal Israel, ix sk'anb'an winh t'a winhaj Eliseo chi'. --Mamin, ¿tzam yal in milancham heb' winh tik? xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi': --Maay, manh a milchamlaj heb' winh. Q'uinalok ay heb' syamchaj uuj t'a owal, ¿tom tza milcham heb'? Ak' wa heb' winh, tzak'an yuk' ha' heb' winh, tzak'an meltzaj heb' winh t'a winh yajalil, xchi winh.

Ix b'o jun niwan wael, ix wa heb' winh, ix yuk'an ha' heb' winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh sreyal Israel to spax heb' winh, ix meltzaj heb' winh b'aj ayek' winh yajalil chi'. Atax ta' ix yaktej heb' winh soldado sirio yochta yik syixtan chonhab' Israel yet' yochta heb' elk'al.
Ixlajwi yek' jun pekti’, a winhaj Ben-adad sreyal Siria, ix molb'ej masanil heb' winh soldado winh, ix b'at yoyank'e Samaria heb' winh yik syak'an owal yet'ok.

Yuj chi' ix em jun niwan wejel t'a Samaria chi'. Ix te k'e stojol masanil tastak, yujto te wach' yajoch oyan heb' winh aj Siria chi' t'a spatik chonhab' chi'. Ha junok sjolom nok' b'uru, 80 kiklo plata stojol, haxo junok waso stza' nok' paramuch, oye' kiklo plata stojol.
Ay jun k'u wan sb'eyek' winh sreyal Israel chi' t'a yib'anh smuroal chonhab' chi', ix awajb'at jun ix ix t'a winh: --Mamin rey, kolin, xchi ix.
Ix tak'wi winh rey chi': --Tato max ach kolji yuj Jehová, ¿tom a into wal tik ol ach in kolo'? ¿Tom ol yal wak'an ixim a trigo yet' a wino?
¿Tas tzach ik'ani? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi ix: --Ha jun ix ix tik, ix yal ix t'ayin: Ak' jun une' tik ko chi tiknaik, haxo k'ik'an sko chi'an jun wik tik, xchi ix.
Yuj chi' ko tz'anh wune' chi', ko chi'ani. Axo t'a junxo k'u chi', walan t'a ix to syak' yune' ix chi' ko chi'a, palta toxo ix sk'ub'ejel ix, xchi ix t'a winh rey chi'.

Ayic ix yab'an winh rey tas ix yal jun ix chi', ix snhik'chitanb'at spichul winh yuj sch'oxanel skusk'olal. Yakb'an wan yek' winh t'a yib'anh muro chi', ix yilan heb' anima ayek' t'a slak'anil chi' to ayoch pichul ya swa yuj winh t'a yol spichul.
Ix yalan winh rey chi': Kotokab'kan yowal sk'ol Dios t'a wib'anh tato max wik'el sjolom winhaj Eliseo yuninal winhaj Safat t'a jun k'u tik, xchi winh.

Ix schekanb'at jun winh winak winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Eliseo chi'. k'ojanem winh t'a yol spat yet' heb' winh yichamtak winaquil chonhab'. Ayic manto k'ochlaj jun winh schekab' winh rey chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh ichamtak winak chi': --Ilec tonab'i, ix schekkot jun winh schekab' jun winh milum anima chi' yik tzul yik'el in jolom winh. Palta maklejek eyab' tas ol wala': Ayic ol jawok winh chi', ol he maquel te' puerta tik, wach' tzeyutej he makan te', tzak'an sjawi winh rey t'a spatik winh, xchi winh.

Vanto wal slolon winh ix jawi winh schekab' winh rey chi', ajun pax winh rey chi', ix yalan winh rey chi': --Ha jun yaelal tik, a Jehová ix ak'ankoti. ¿Tasto wal sko te tanhwej tiknaik yik tzonh skolani? xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi' icha tik: --Ab'ek wal tas syal Jehová: Ha k'ik'an yab' icha tik, ha t'a spuertail Samaria tik, a junok almul ixim harina, jun kiklo plata stojol ixim. Chab' almul pax ixim kebada t'a jun kiklo k'een, xchi Jehová, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi jun winh stanhwan winh rey chi' icha tik: --Wach'chom sjakwi swentenail satcha’anh yuj Jehová, palta max ujilaj icha tzal chi', xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Eliseo chi': --Olto il wal jun chi', palta manhxo ol a walaj ixim, xchi winh.

Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', ay chanhwanh heb' winh ayoch lepra t'ay, ayel heb' winh t'a stiel chonhab' chi', ix yal-lan heb' winh t'ay junjun: --¿Tas wal sko k'ulej t'a tik? Tonhej k'ojan onh em ko tanhwan cham ko b'a.

Tato tzonh och t'a yol chonhab' tik, yowalil tzonh cham yuj wejel. Tato tzonh kan k'ojan t'a tik, yowalil ol onh champaxok. Ha tiknaik koyek t'a skampamento heb' sirio, talaj tzonh yak' niwank'olal heb', max onh smil-laj heb'. Tato maay jun, toxonton yik chamel kaji, xchi heb' winh.
Ayic numnonxo sq'uik'b'i, ix b'at heb' winh t'a skampamento heb' sirio chi'. Axo ix k'och heb' winh, ix yilan heb' winh manhxa junok mach ayeq'ui.

Yujto a Jehová ix ak'an yab' heb' soldado sirio sk'anh yek' karruaje yet' nok' chej yet' pax jun niwan nhilanh soldado. Ha yalan heb' sirio chi' to a winh sreyal heb' israel ix tupan heb' winh sreyal hitita yet' winh sreyal Egipto yik syak'an owal yet' heb' yalani.
Yuj chi' ayik wan sq'uik'b'i ix b'at heb' elelal, ix yaktankan skampamento heb' yet' smantiado yet' nok' chej yet' skarruaje heb'. Anhej heb' ix skol sb'a.

Ayic ix k'och heb' winh ayoch lepra chi' t'ay t'a stitak kampamento chi', ix och heb' winh t'a yol junok mantiado, ix wa heb' winh, ix yuk'an ha' heb' winh. Ix yik'anelta k'een oro heb' winh, k'een plata yet' pichul, ix b'at heb' winh sk'ub'ejeli. Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzaj heb' winh, ix ochxi heb' winh t'a yol junxo mantiado, ix yik'anelta heb' winh tastak ay t'a yool, ix b'atxi heb' winh sk'ub'ejeli.

Ix laj yalan heb' winh t'ay junjun: --Manh wach'ok jun wan ko k'ulan tik. Ha tiknaik smoj wal quik'anb'at ab'ix, palta ichnhejta' kajeq'ui. Tato sko tanhwej, ato k'ik'an b'at kala', ay ta tas skot t'a quib'anh. Wach' to b'at kalek t'a winh rey, xchi heb' winh.

Yuj chi' ix b'at heb' winh, ix yawtan heb' winh stanhwumal sti' chonhab' chi' heb' winh, ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --Ix onh xid'ek' t'a skampamento heb' sirio, manhxa junok mach ayeq'ui, manhxa junok mach skab' sloloni, axonhej nok' chej yet' nok' b'uru etzjab'kani. Axo smantiado heb', icha ix aj sb'oankan heb', icha chi' yajkani.
Ix b'at heb' winh stanhwumal sti' chonhab' chi' yawtej heb' winh stanhwan spalakio winh rey.

Ix alji yab' winh rey chi', yuj chi' ix k'e waan winh t'ak'walil chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh ayoch t'a opisio yet'ok: --Ol wal t'ayex tas snib'ej heb' sirio chi' tzonh yutej, yujto yojtak heb' to wan ko cham yuj wejel, yuj chi' ix yaktejkan skampamento heb' chi', ix sk'ub'anel sb'a heb' t'a kaltak te', yuj chi' tato tzonh el t'a spatiquel chonhab' tik, ol onh syam heb' t'a pitzanil, haxo yochkankot heb' t'a yol chonhab' tik, xchi winh rey chi'.

Ix yalan junok heb' winh schekab' winh icha tik: --B'atokab' jaywanhok winak yila' yet' owanhok nok' chej ayto ek' tik, ol quilani tas ix uji chi'. Tato scham heb', mato maay, lajannhej, yujto ay smay b'aj sb'at heb' chi', ay pax smay t'a tik, xchi winh chekab' chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yik'b'at chab' karruaje heb' yet' nok' chej, ix chekjib'at heb' yuj winh rey chi', yik b'at yil heb' b'ajtil ix b'at heb' sirio chi'. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' icha tik: B'at ilek tas wal yaji, xchi winh.

Ix b'at tzak'an heb' t'a yoklem heb' sirio chi', masanto ix k'och heb' t'ha ha' Jordán. Ix yilan heb' to aykan spichul heb' t'a yoltak b'e yet' syamk'ab' heb' ayik wan yel heb' skol sb'a yalani. Elanhchamel ix meltzaj heb' chekab' chi', ix ul yalan heb' t'a winh rey chi' tas ix yil heb' chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix elta masanil heb' anima t'a yol chonhab' chi', ix yik'anelta masanil tastak ay t'a yol skampamento heb' sirio chi' heb', ix yik'ankot heb'. Ix elk'och icha ix aj yalan Jehová, a jun almul ixim harina, jun kiklo plata stojol ixim. Chab' almul pax ixim kebada t'a jun kiklo plata chi'.

Ix yalan winh rey t'a winh stanhwumal to skan winh stanhwej spuertail chonhab' chi', palta ix b'at heb' anima t'a yib'anh winh, ix telwikan winh t'a skal yok heb', ix cham winh, icha ix aj yalan winhaj Eliseo schekab' Dios t'a winh ayik ix xid'ek' winh rey lolonel yet' winhaj Eliseo chi'.

Ix elk'och icha ix aj yalan winhaj Eliseo chi' to ha t'a spuertail chonhab' Samaria yab' icha tik k'ik'an, schonhchaj ixim harina, a jun almul ixim, jun kiklo plata stojol. Chab' almul pax ixim kebada t'a jun kiklo k'een, xchi winh.

Axo jun winh stanhwumal winh rey chi', ix tak'wi winh t'a winh schekab' Dios chi': Wach'chom sjakwi swentenail satcha’anh yuj Jehová, palta max ujilaj icha tzal chi', xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Eliseo: Olto il wal jun chi', palta manhxo ol a walaj ixim, xchi winh.
Ichaton chi' ix aji, yujto a heb' anima ix tek'ancham winh t'a spuertail chonhab' chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Eliseo t'a ix aj Sunem, aton ix pitzwinakxi yune' yuj winh, ix yalan winh t'a ix icha tik: Ixic, b'at kajnajan t'a junokxo nakión yet' heb' kajan t'a a pat, yujto ix yal Jehová to ol yak'kot junok niwan wejel t'a ko nakión tik, uque' ab'il ol yak'a', xchi winh t'a ix.
Yuj chi' ix sk'anab'ajej ix sb'ati, icha ix aj yalan winh chi'. Ix b'atkan ix t'a yol smakb'en heb' filisteo. Uque' ab'il ix kan kajan ix ta'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix paxta ix t'a smakb'en heb' filisteo chi'. Ix b'at ix t'a yichanh winh sreyal Israel yik sk'ananxi spat ix yet' sluum.
Van slolon winh rey chi' yet' winhaj Giezi schekab' winhaj Eliseo chi', ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winh icha tik: Al wab' masanil tastak satub'tak ix sk'ulej winhaj Eliseo chi', xchi winh.

Ha wal yik wan yalan winhaj Giezi chi' yab'ixal tas ix aj yak'anxi pitzwok jun yune' jun ix ix chi' winhaj Eliseo chi', ix jawi ix yal yuj sluum yet' spat. Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj Giezi chi' t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, aton wal jun ix ix tik swala', aton jun yune' ix tik pitzwinakxi yuj winhaj Eliseo chi', xchi winh t'a winh rey chi'.

Ix sk'anb'an winh rey chi' t'a ix, ix yalan jun ab'ix chi' ix t'a winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix schekan junok heb' schekab' winh rey chi' yik b'at ak'jixi smakb'en ix ix chi' yet' masanil sat awb'en ix el t'a lu'um yiktax ix el ix t'a yol nakión chi' masanto ix meltzajxi ix.
Ay junel ix b'at winhaj Eliseo t'a Damasco. Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', te penaay winhaj Ben-adad sreyal Siria. Ix alchaj t'a winh to ix k'och winh schekab' Jehová ta'.

Yuj chi' ix yal winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Hazael schekab' icha tik: --Ik'b'at junok silab' tzach b'at il winh schekab' Jehová chi'. Tza k'anan t'a winh to sk'anb'ej winh t'a Jehová chi' wuuj, tato olto in b'oxok yuj jun yaelal tik, xchi winh.

Ix b'at winhaj Hazael chi' yil winhaj Eliseo chi'. Ix yik'anb'at silab' winh, aton tas te wach' tz'el t'a Damasco chi', 40 nok' kamello kuchjinak silab' chi'. Ayic ix k'och winh t'a yichanh winhaj Eliseo chi', ix yalan winh: --Ha winh a chekab' aj Ben-adad sreyal Siria, a winh tzin chekankoti yik tzul in k'anb'an t'ayach, tom olto b'oxok sk'ol winh yuj jun yaelal ayoch t'ay, mato manhxo, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Eliseo chi': --Ixic, tzalan t'a winh to ol b'oxok sk'ol winh yuj jun yaelal chi', palta ix yal Jehová to ol chamxonhej winh, xchi winh.
Ha wal t'a jun rato chi', ix te och k'elan winhaj Eliseo chi' t'a sat winhaj Hazael chi', masanto ix q'uixwi winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix ok'k'e winh schekab' Dios chi'.

Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'ej winhaj Hazael chi' t'a winh: --Mamin ¿tas yuj tzach oq'ui? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Eliseo chi': --Vojtak wal to ol ak' wal chukal t'a heb' wetisraelal, ol ak'och sk'ak'al skuartel heb', ol a milancham heb' kelemtak t'a owal. Ol a milancham heb' kotak unin, ol a tekanelta yol sk'ol heb' ix yab'ix, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Hazael t'a winh icha tik: --Ha in tik te malaj jab'ok welk'ochi, lajan in icha junok nok' tz'i'. ¿Tas wal ol aj in k'ulan tas icha chi'? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Eliseo chi' t'a winh: --Toxo ix yal Jehová t'ayin to a ach ol ach ochkan sreyalok Siria tik, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix spukan sb'a winhaj Hazael chi' yet' winhaj Eliseo chi', ix meltzaj winh t'a winh yajalil chi'. Ix sk'anb'an winh rey chi' t'a winh: --¿Tas xchi winhaj Eliseo chi' t'ayach? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Hazael chi' icha tik: --Ix yal winh t'ayin tob' ol ach b'oxok yuj jun a yaelal tik, xchi winh.

Axo t'a junxo k'u, ix sch'ayan jun k'apak k'apak pim winhaj Hazael chi', ix b'at yak'anb'at k'apak winh t'a sat winh rey chi', ix tup yik winh. Icha chi' ix aj scham winh rey chi'. Axo winhaj Hazael chi' ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.
Ayic oyexo ab'il yoch winhaj Joram yuninal winhaj Acab reyal t'a Israel, ix schaanel yich winhaj Joram yuninal winhaj Josafat yak'an reyal t'a Judá.
Ha winhaj Joram chi', 32 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix schaanel yich winh yak'an reyal chi'. Vajxaque' ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén.

Palta ha' sb'eyb'al heb' winh sreyal Israel yet' sb'eyb'al heb' yinhtilal winhaj Acab chi' ix sb'eyb'alej winh, yujto ix yik' ix yisil winhaj Acab chi' winh yetb'eyumok. Yuj chi', te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová.
Palta maj yal-laj sk'ol Jehová ix satel Judá, yujto yak'nakkan sti' t'a winhaj rey Dawid schekab' to ol ochnhejkan yinhtilal winh reyal.
Ha t'a stiempoal winhaj Joram chi', ayik ix yak'an reyal winh, ix yik'el sb'a heb' aj Edom t'a yalanh smandar chonhab' Judá, ix yak'anoch sreyal heb' t'a yol yiko'.

Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Joram chi' yet' masanil skarruaje yak' owal yet' heb' aj Edom chi' t'a Zair, palta a heb' aj Edom chi', ix oymaj heb' t'a spatik winh yet' heb' yajal yaj t'a skarruaje winh yik owal. Axo t'ak'walil ix k'e wan winh, ix yak'an owal winh yet' heb' edomita chi'. Icha chi' ix aj skolanel sb'a winh t'a yol sk'ab' heb', a heb' soldado winh chi', ix paxkan heb' t'a spat.
Atax ta' ix yiquej sb'a heb' aj Edom chi'. Anheja' pax t'a jun pekti’ chi' ix yik'el sb'a chonhab' Libna t'a Judá chi'.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Joram chi' yet' tastak ix sk'ulej winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá.
Ayic ix cham winhaj Joram chi', ix mukji sniwanil winh b'aj mukan heb' smam yicham, aton t'a schonhab' winhaj Dawid. Axo winhaj Ocozías winh yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayic slajchawil ab'il yoch winhaj Joram yuninal winhaj Acab reyal t'a Israel, ix schaanel yich winhaj Ocozías yak'an reyal t'a Judá.
Ha winhaj Ocozías chi', 22 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal chi', jun ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Atalía sb'i ix snun winh, yixchiquin ix winhaj Omri sreyal Israel.
Ha winhaj Ocozías chi', a sb'eyb'al winhaj Acab ix sb'eyb'alej winh, te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, yujto smam icham winhaj Acab chi' winh.

Ha winhaj Ocozías chi', junnhej ix yutej spensar winh yet' winhaj Joram yuninal winhaj Acab, ix yak'an owal heb' winh t'a Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad yet' winhaj Hazael sreyal Siria, palta ix lajwi winhaj Joram chi' yuj heb' sirio chi'.
Yuj chi' ix k'ochkan winh t'a Jezreel yik syanhtan sb'a winh b'aj ix echnaj yuj heb' sirio chi'. Ix k'och winhaj Ocozías chi' yil winh yujto ya yaj winh.

Ha winhaj Eliseo schekab' Dios, ix yawtej jun winh yetchekab'wumal winh quelemto, ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ak' lista a b'a, tzach b'at t'a Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad. Ik'b'at jun yet'tal akeite tik tzach b'ati.

Ayic tzach k'och ta', tza sayanek' winhaj Jehú yuninal winhaj Josafat yixchiquin winhaj Nimsi. Tzach och b'aj ayek' winh chi', tzik'anelta winh t'a skal heb' winh ayek' yet' winh ta', tzik'anb'at winh t'a junokxo kuarto.

Slajwi chi' tzik'ankot akeite chi', tza tob'ank'e t'a sjolom winh, tzalan t'a winh icha tik: Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha in tzach in sik'kaneli yik ol ach och reyal t'a Israel, xchi, xa chi. Slajwi chi' tza jakan puerta, tzach el lemnajok, manh ach och waan, xchi winhaj Eliseo chi'.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winh quelem schekab' Dios t'a Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad chi'.

Ayic ix k'och winh ta', molanek' masanil heb' winh yajalil heb' soldado, ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ach in kapitán, ay wal jab' tas ol wal t'ayach, xchi winh. --¿Mach junok onh b'aj tzal chi'? xchi winhaj Jehú. --Ach in kapitán, a ach ton tzach wala', xchi winh t'a winhaj Jehú chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix k'e juknaj winhaj Jehú chi', ix och winh t'a yol pat. Ix yak'ank'e akeite winh schekab' Dios chi' t'a sjolom winh, ix yalan winh: --Ha Jehová ko Diosal tz'alan t'ayach icha tik: Ha in tzach in sik'kaneli, yik ol ach och reyal t'a in chonhab' Israel.

Ha ach ol a satel masanil heb' yinhtilal winhaj Acab, winh ayach t'a yalanh smandar. Icha chi' ol aj in pakan schamel heb' winh in chekab' yet' heb' winh tz'alanel in lolonel, yujto elnak schiq'uil heb' winh yuj ix Jezabel.

Masanil heb' yinhtilal winhaj Acab chi', yowalil ol satel heb'. Masanil heb' winak, wach'chom chekab' yaji, ma yik sb'a, ol satel heb' t'a chonhab' Israel. Manhxa junok yinhtilal winh chi' olto kanok.
Icha wutejnak yinhtilal winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat, icha wutejnakpax yik winhaj Baasa yuninal winhaj Ahías, icha wal chi' ol wutej yinhtilal winhaj Acab chi'.

Axo pax ix Jezabel jun, a nok' tz'i' ol chianb'at sniwanil ix t'a yol yik Jezreel, manhxalaj mach ol mukan ix, xchi Jehová, xchi winh schekab' Dios chi'. Ayic ix lajwi yalan masanil juntzanh tik winh schekab' Dios chi', ix sjakan spuertail jun pat chi' winh, ix b'at winh elelal.

Ayic ix k'ochxi winhaj Jehú chi' b'aj molanek' heb' winh yetyajalil chi', ix sk'anb'an heb' winh t'a winh: --¿Tas xchi, wach' ama? ¿Tas yuj ix ul ach yil jun winh quistal chi'? xchi heb' winh. --Ha ex tik eyojtakxo winh, eyojtak tas syaltaxon heb' winh schekab' Dios chi', xchi winhaj Jehú chi'.

--Maay, manh kojtakoklaj, al t'ayonh tas ix ul yal winh, xchi heb' winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Jehú chi' t'a heb' winh: --Ix yal winh t'ayin icha tik: Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha in tzach in sik'kanel sreyalok Israel tiknaik, xchi Jehová, xchi winh t'ayin, xchi winhaj Jehú chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', junjun heb' winh ix yik'el sjukan pichul, ix slich'anem heb' winh t'a yalanh yok winhaj Jehú b'aj b'akhquiltak sk'ei. Ix laj spu'an sch'aak heb' winh, te chaanh ix yal heb' winh: Ha winhaj Jehú, reyxo winh, xchi heb' winh.

Ha winhaj Jehú yuninal winhaj Josafat yixchiquin winhaj Nimsi, te chuk tas sna winh t'a yib'anh winhaj Joram. Ha winhaj Joram chi', aynhejoch winh yet' heb' yetisraelal skolanelta chonhab' Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Hazael sreyal Siria.

Palta ayxo jaye' k'u sk'och winh t'a Jezreel yik syanhtan sb'a winh b'aj ix lajwi yuj heb' sirio chi' ayik ix yak'an owal winh yet' winhaj Hazael chi'. Ix yalan winhaj Jehú t'a heb' ajun yet'ok: Tato t'a wal yel he gana tzin och he reyalok, malaj junok mach tz'el t'a yol chonhab' tik yik wach' malaj mach sb'at alan jun ab'ix tik t'a heb' winh aj Jezreel, xchi winh.
Ix k'e winh t'a yol skarruaje yik owal, ix b'at winh t'a Jezreel b'aj wan yanhtan sb'a winhaj Joram chi'. Aypaxek' winhaj Ocozías sreyal Judá ta', yujto ayk'och winh yil winhaj Joram chi'.

Ayic ix yilanb'at winh ayk'e t'a chaanh stanhwej chonhab' Jezreel chi' to wan sjawi winhaj Jehú yet' jun nhilanh heb' soldado, ix el yaw winh, ix yalan winh: --Ay juntzanh heb' soldado wan sjawi, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Joram chi' icha tik: --B'atokab' junok winh soldado t'a yib'anh chej, yik b'at yil winh mach jun sjawi chi', sk'anb'anpax t'ay, tom t'a ak'ank'olal sjawi, xchi winh.
