Yuj chi' ix b'at jun winh soldado t'a yib'anh chej chi' yik b'at yil winh, ix yalan winh: --Ha winh rey tzin chekankot in k'anb'ej t'ayach, tom ak'ank'olal tzach jawi, xchi winh. Ix yalan winhaj Jehú chi' t'a winh: --Ha ach tik, malaj alan ik t'a jun tik, anhej to tzach och tzak'an wuuj, xchi winh. Axo ix yalanxi winh stanhwumal chonhab' chi' icha tik: --Ha winh chekab' chi', ix k'och winh b'aj wan sjawi heb' chi', palta malaj winh smeltzaji, xchi winh.

Val t'a jun rato chi' ix chekjib'at junxo winh soldado t'a yib'anh chej yuj winh rey chi'. Ix k'och winh soldado chi' t'a heb', ix yalan winh: --Ha winh rey tzin chekankoti yik tzul in k'anb'an t'ayach, tom ak'ank'olal tzach jawi, xchi winh. Ix yalan winhaj Jehú chi' t'a winh: --Ha ach tik, malaj alan ik t'a jun tik, anhej to tzach och tzak'an wuuj, xchi winh.

Ix yalanxi winh stanhwumal chonhab' chi': --Anheja' junxo winh chi' ix k'och winh t'a heb', palta malaj winh smeltzaji. Ha mach sja t'a yol karruaje chi', ichato a winhaj Jehú yixchiquin winhaj Nimsi, yujto te lokotak skot winh, ichataxon smodo, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj Joram chi': --Hak'uekoch nok' chej t'a in karruaje yik owal, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix b'ochaj skarruaje winhaj Joram sreyal Israel chi' yet' pax yik winhaj Ocozías sreyal Judá. Ix b'at heb' winh junjun t'a yol skarruaje chi'. Ix b'at schaan winhaj Jehú chi' heb' winh. Ix schalaj sb'a heb' winh t'a lum sluum winhaj Nabot t'a yol yik Jezreel.

Ayic ix yilan winhaj Joram chi' to a winhaj Jehú sk'ochi, ix yalan winh: --Ach Jehú, ¿tom t'a ak'ank'olal tzach jawi? xchi winh. Ix yalan winhaj Jehú chi': --Tom ijan ak'ank'olal tzin jawi yakb'an a ix a nun ix Jezabel, anheja' yak'anem sb'a ix t'a juntzanh sdiosal yet' t'a yajb'aalil, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix meltzaj winhaj Joram chi', ix el lemnaj winh, ixto awajkan winh t'a winhaj Ocozías chi': --Ocozías, chamel jun tik, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' a winhaj Jehú chi' yet' wal yip winh ix sjulb'at sjul-lab' t'a winhaj Joram chi', awal t'a snanhal yich spatik winh ix ochi, ix k'axpaj t'a spixan winh. Yuj chi' ix telwi winh t'a yol skarruaje chi', ix cham winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Jehú chi' t'a winhaj Bidcar, winh skolwaj yet'ok: --Ik'elta winh t'a yol skarruaje chi', tza yumankanb'at winh t'a yol smakb'enkan winhaj Nabot aj Jezreel, yujto tzato in nakoti to a ach jun wed'nak ach ayik tzak'an onh och t'a spatik skarruaje winhaj Acab smam jun winh tik, ayik yalannakkan jun lolonel tik Jehová t'a yib'anh winhaj Acab chi' icha tik:

Ha ewi wil schamel winhaj Nabot yet' heb' yuninal. Anheja' icha wal chi' ol aj wak'an spak t'ayach t'a jun lugar tik, xchi Jehová. Yuj chi' ik'elta sniwanil winh chi', tza julankanb'at t'a lum sluumkan winhaj Nabot chi', yujto icha chi' ajnak yalan Jehová, xchi winhaj Jehú chi'.

Ayic ix yilan winhaj Ocozías sreyal Judá tas ix uji chi', ix el lemnaj winh, ix b'atkan winh t'a sb'eal Bet-hagán, palta ix b'at winhaj Jehú chi' t'a spatik winh, ix yalan winh: --Milecpaxcham jun winh tik, xchi winh. Ix yamchaj winhaj Ocozías chi' yuj heb' t'a switzal Gur t'a slak'anil Ibleam. Ata' ix lajwi winh t'a yol skarruaje chi' yuj heb', palta ixto yal yel winh, masanto ix k'och winh t'a Meguido. Ata' ix cham winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix ik'jib'at sniwanil winh yuj heb' winh schekab' t'a Jerusalén t'a yol jun karruaje. Ix mukchaj winh b'aj mukan heb' smam yicham t'a schonhab' winhaj rey Dawid.
Ha winhaj Ocozías chi', ix schael yich winh yak'an reyal t'a Judá ayik yuxluchilxo ab'il yoch winhaj Joram yuninal winhaj Acab reyal t'a Israel.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj Jehú chi' t'a Jezreel. Ayic ix yab'an ix Jezabel tas ix uji chi', ix yak'an uk' stitak sat ix, ix sjixb'an sjolom ix, ix elta t'anhan ix t'a jun wentena.
Ayic ix k'och winhaj Jehú t'a ti' chonhab' chi', ix yalan ix t'a winh icha tik: --¿Wach'am a k'ool? Lajan ach yet' winhaj Zimri, ix a milcham winh ajalil, xchi ix.
Ix k'e k'elan winhaj Jehú chi' t'a jun wentena chi', ix yalan winh: --¿Mach ayoch wed'ok? xchi winh. Ay chawanh oxwanh heb' winh munlajwum t'a yol spat ix, ix elta t'anhan heb' winh yila'.

Ix yalan winhaj Jehú chi' t'a heb' winh: --Equec emta jun ix ix chi' t'a tik, xchi winh. Ix yekankot sutnaj ix heb' winh, ix laj och tzipnaj schiq'uil ix t'a sattak yich pat chi' yet' t'a nok' chej, haxo nok' chej chi' ix ek' t'a yib'anh sniwanil ix chi' yet' skarruaje.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winhaj Jehú chi' wael. Ayic ix lajwi swa winh chi', ix yalan winh: --Ilec tas tzeyutej jun ix ix te chuk chi', yujnhej to yisil ix winh rey, yuj chi' mukchajokab' ix, xchi winh.
Ayic ix b'at heb' winh smuk sniwanil ix yalani, ix yilan heb' winh to axonhej sb'aquil sjolom ix, yok ix yet' sk'ab' ix ayeq'ui.

Axo ix paxta heb' winh, ix yalan heb' winh t'a winhaj Jehú tas yaji, ix yalan winh: --Icha tik ix aj yelk'och tas scheknak Jehová yal winhaj Elías aj Tisbe, winh schekab' to a nok' tz'i' ol chianb'at sniwanil ix Jezabel t'a yol yik Jezreel.

Ha sniwanil ix chi', stza' nok' nok' ol ajkanb'atok, yuj chi' yalxonhej b'aj ol kan t'a sattak lum lum t'a yol yik Jezreel, malaj mach ol alanok: Ina b'aj mukan ix Jezabel tik, manh xchiok heb', xchi Jehová, xchikan winhaj Elías chi', xchi winhaj Jehú chi'.

Ha t'a Samaria, ay 70 heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Acab. Yuj chi' ix stz'ib'ejb'at jun karta winhaj Jehú t'a heb' winh yichamtak winaquil chonhab' yet' t'a heb' winh yilumal heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Acab chi'. Ix yalan winh t'a skarta chi' icha tik:
Ha b'aj ayex chi', ata' ayek' heb' yinhtilal winh he reyal, nok' chej, karruaje yik owal, jun chonhab' te wach' yaji yet' jantak syamk'ab' winh yik owal. Yuj chi' ayik ol k'och jun karta tik t'ayex,
tze sik'el junok yinhtilal winh eyajalil chi' te wach', smoj wal yoch he reyalok sk'exulok winh smam chi', tzeyak'an owal yuj yopisio winh eyajalil chi', xchib'at winh t'a heb' winh.

Ayic ix yab'an jun chi' heb', ix te xiwk'e heb', ix yalan heb' icha tik: Ina tax maj tzak'wan stek'b'an sb'a chawanh heb' winh rey t'a yichanh winh, okonhxo ¿tom a onh to tik ol yal ko tek'b'an ko b'ha t'a yichanh winh? xchi heb'.

Axo winh tz'ilan spalakio winh rey chi' yet' winh sgobernadoral chonhab' chi', masanil heb' yichamtak winaquil chonhab' yet' pax heb' ix ilan q'uib' heb' yuninal winhaj Acab chi', ix yalb'at heb' t'a winhaj Jehú chi': Ha onh tik ayonh ek' t'a yol a k'ab'. Masanil tas ol ala' ol ko k'anab'ajej, manh ol kak'ochlaj junokxo ko reyal. Ujokab' icha tas wach' tz'aj a naani, xchib'at heb'.

Ix stz'ib'anxib'at junxo karta winhaj Jehú chi' t'a heb', ix yalan winh: Tato tze nib'ej tzex och wed'ok, ol he k'anab'ajan tas swala', a k'ik'an tzeyik'kot sjolom heb' yinhtilal winh eyajalil chi', tzex jawi t'ayin t'a Jezreel tik, xchib'at winh t'a heb'. Ha heb' 70 yinhtilalkan winh rey chi', junnhej yaj heb' yet' heb' yichamtak winaquil chonhab' ix ilan q'uib' heb' t'a Samaria chi'.

Ayic ix schaan jun karta chi' heb', ix syaman heb' 70 yinhtilal winh rey chi' heb', ix xikjiel sjolom heb' yuj heb'. Ix yak'anem sjolom heb' chi' heb' t'a yol juntzanh mooch, ix yak'anb'at heb' t'a winhaj Jehú t'a Jezreel chi'.

Ix jawi jun winh chekab' t'a winhaj Jehú chi', ix yalan winh: --Toxo ix ik'chajkot sjolom heb' yinhtilal winh rey, xchi winh. Ix yalan winhaj Jehú chi': --Chab' juyanh tzeyutejkan t'a sti' chonhab' tik. Ata' skani masanto k'ik'an, xchi winh.

Axo t'a junxo k'u, ix b'at winhaj Jehú chi', ix och linhan winh t'a ti' chonhab' chi', ix yalan winh t'a masanil heb' anima: --Ha ex tik, malaj he mul. Ha in ix in milcham winh ko reyal yuj wik'anel winh t'a yopisio, palta ¿mach ix milancham masanil juntzanh heb' tik?

Ha tiknaik scham wal eyojtakaneli to a masanil tas yalnakkan Jehová t'a yib'anh heb' yinhtilal winhaj Acab, malaj junok manh ol elk'ochok. Van yelk'och masanil tas scheknak Jehová yalkanel winhaj Elías schekab', xchi winhaj Jehú chi'.

Ha winhaj Jehú chi', ix smilcham juntzanh sk'ab' yok winhaj Acab chi' winh t'a Jezreel, aton heb' niwak winak yaji yet' heb' yamigo winhaj Acab chi' yet' heb' yak'nakoch winh sakerdoteal. Manhxo junok heb' ix kani.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winhaj Jehú chi' t'a Samaria. Ayic wan sb'at winh chi' t'a yol b'e, ix k'och winh t'a jun b'aj tz'ajtaxon heb' tanhwum kalnel.

Ata' ix schalaj sb'a winh yet' juntzanh heb' sk'ab' yok winhaj Ocozías sreyal Judá, ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb': --¿Mach ex a ex tik? xchi winh t'a heb'. Ix tak'wi heb' t'a winh: --Ha onh tik ayto kuj ko b'a yet' winhaj Ocozías, onh jawi kak' stzatzil sk'ol heb' winh yuninal winh rey yet' heb' yune' ix reina Jezabel, xchi heb'.

Ix yalan winhaj Jehú t'a heb' ajun yet'ok: --Yamec heb', xchi winh. Axo heb' ajun yet' winh chi' ix yaman heb', ix smilancham heb' winh t'a sti' jun ha' uk'b'il ha' skuch Bet-equed b'aj tz'ajtaxon heb' tanhwum kalnel chi'. 42 heb' t'a smasanil, manhxo junok heb' ix kani.

Ayic ix elxi winhaj Jehú chi' ta', ix schalan sb'a winh yet' winhaj Jonadab yuninal winhaj Recab. Ix yak'an stzatzil sk'ool winh winhaj Jehú chi', ix yalan winh: --¿Mek'an ach am wed'ok, icha in tik wach' in naan t'a a patik? xchi winh. --I', wach' toni, xchi winhaj Jonadab chi' t'a winh. --Tato icha chi' an, ak'kot a k'ab' t'ayin, xchi winhaj Jehú chi' t'a winh. Ix yak'anb'at sk'ab' winhaj Jonadab chi' t'a winh, ix yik'ank'e winh winh t'a yol skarruaje chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Jehú chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Conh wed'ok, ol in ch'ox ila' tas ol wutej yik tzin k'anab'ajej tas ix yal Jehová, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix yik'b'at winhaj Jonadab chi' winh t'a yol skarruaje chi'.

Ayic ix k'och winhaj Jehú chi' t'a Samaria, ix smilancham masanil heb' yinhtilal winhaj Acab winh ta', aton heb' pitzanto ix kani. Yuj chi' pilan ix satel heb' smasanil yuj winh, icha ajnak yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Elías.
Ixlajwi chi', ix smolb'an masanil chonhab' winhaj Jehú chi', ix yalan winh: --Ha winhaj Acab, quennhej ochnak winh ejmelal t'a Baal, a inxo pax tik, ek'b'alto ol in och ejmelal t'a Baal chi'.

Yuj chi' awtejek masanil heb' winh schekab' Baal yet' mach tz'ochtaxon ejmelal t'ay yet' masanil heb' sakerdote yaj t'ay. Manhxa junok mach max jawi, yujto ol in b'o jun niwan silab' yuj wik'anchaanh Baal chi'. Ha mach max jawi, yowalil tz'och chamel t'a yib'anh, xchi winh. Palta tonhej ix yal jun chi' winh, masanil heb' tz'och ejmelal t'a Baal ol satel winh.
Yuj chi' ix schek winh alchajeli to ol och q'uinh yik tz'ik'jichaanh Baal chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'anb'at schekab' winh t'a masanil yol smakb'en Israel to yowalil sk'och masanil heb' tz'och ejmelal t'a Baal t'a stemplo. Yuj chi' manhxa junok mach maj k'ochok. Ha templo yik Baal chi', te b'ut'an ix aji.
Ix yalan winhaj Jehú chi' t'a heb' molum pichul to tz'ik'jielta spichul heb' tz'ochtaxon ejmelal t'a Baal, ix sk'anab'ajej heb' yik'anelta.

Ixlajwi chi' ix och winh yet' winhaj Jonadab t'a yol templo chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' tz'och ejmelal t'a Baal chi': --Scham eyilani to malajokab' heb' tz'och ejmelal t'a Jehová ayek' t'a he kal tik, anhejokab' mach tz'och ejmelal t'a Baal ayeq'ui, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Yuj chi' ayik toxo ix och heb' tz'och ejmelal t'a Baal chi' t'a yol stemplo chi', ix yak'an silab' heb' snhusji yet' juntzanhxo silab'. Yakb'an wan yak'an silab' heb' chi', ayxo och oyan 80 heb' soldado yuj winhaj Jehú t'a spatik templo chi', ix yalkan winh t'a heb' to malaj junok mach schael heb': --Tato ay junok mach schaanel junok heb' ayoch ejmelal chi', haxo scham sk'exulok, xchi winh.

Ayic ix lajwi yak'ji silab' chi', ix yalan winhaj Jehú t'a heb' soldado yet' t'a heb' kapitán: --Ochanhec, milekcham heb'. Manhxa junok mach tze chaeli, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix och heb' soldado winh chi', ix smilancham masanil heb' anima chi' heb' t'a k'een espada. Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'anelta heb' chamnak chi' heb' t'a spatiquel templo chi'. Ix och heb' t'a yet'tal Baal t'a yol templo chi'.
Masanil juntzanh yechel ix yik'elta heb', ix snhusantz'a heb'.
Icha chi' ix aj satanel Baal chi' heb'. Ix sjuanem lanhnaj templo chi' heb' smasanil, yikxo b'aj schulaj anima ix ajnhejkani.
Icha chi' ix aj satanel ejmelal winhaj Jehú t'a Baal t'a kal chonhab' Israel.

Wach'chom icha chi' ix sk'ulej winhaj Jehú chi', palta maj yik'el-laj sb'a winh t'a chukal sk'ulejnak winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat, winh kuchb'annak heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal. Maj satel-laj juntzanh yechel wakax winh, aton juntzanh nab'a oro aykan t'a Dan yet' t'a Betel.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a winh: Yujto tojol tas ix a k'ulej t'a wichanh, ix a k'anab'ajej a satanel heb' yinhtilal winhaj Acab chi' icha wal ix aj walani, a heb' inhtilal, ol ochnhej heb' reyal masanto t'a schanhil makan, xchi t'a winh.

Wach'chom icha chi', palta maj yak'waloch winh t'a sk'ol sk'anab'ajan scheknab'il Jehová sDiosal Israel, yujto maj yik'el sb'a winh t'a chukal sk'ulejnak winhaj Jeroboam winh kuchb'annak heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal.

Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', ix och ijan Jehová yik'anek' lum sluum heb' israel. Ha winhaj Hazael sreyal Siria ix ik'anek' lum t'a sk'axepalek' ha' Jordán t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, aton lum yik heb' yinhtilal Gad, lum yik heb' yinhtilal Rubén yet' lum yik nanhalxo heb' yinhtilal Manasés, ix kotnhej t'a chonhab' Aroer t'a sti' ha' Arnón tzek' t'a Galaad masanto t'a Basán.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Jehú yet' tas ix sk'ulej winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.

Ha winhaj Jehú chi', 28 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a heb' yetisraelal t'a Samaria. Ayic ix cham winh, ix mukji winh t'a Samaria chi', haxo jun winh yuninal winh skuchan Joacaz ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayic ix yab'an ix Atalía to toxo ix cham winh yune' ix, aton winhaj rey Ocozías, ix schekan ix satjiel masanil heb' yinhtilal winh rey chi'.

Axo ix Josaba, yisilkan winhaj rey Joram, schab'il yanab' winhaj rey Ocozías chi', ha' ix ix ik'ankanel winhaj Joás yuninal winhaj Ocozías chi' t'a skal heb' yuninal winh wan smiljicham chi'. Icha chi' ix aj sk'ub'anel winh ix t'a ix Atalía chi'. Ix b'at sk'ub'ejel winh ix yet' jun ix tz'ilan q'uib' winh t'a jun kuarto b'aj ay juntzanh ch'at sik'an, yuj chi' maj miljokcham winhaj Joás chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix k'ub'chajel winh yet' ix tz'ilanq'uib' chi' t'a stemplo Jehová, waque' ab'il ix kan winh ta', yakb'an ayoch ix Atalía yajalil t'a Judá chi'.

Axo t'a yuquil ab'il, a winhaj sat sakerdote Joiada yetb'eyum ix Josaba chi', ix schek winh awtaj heb' yajalil soldado, heb' quereteo yet' heb' stanhwan spalakio winh rey. Ha winh ix ak'anoch heb' t'a yamaq'uil stemplo Jehová. Ata' ix schek winh yak' sti' heb' yik tz'och heb' yet' winh t'a tas nab'il yuj. Ixlajwi chi' ix ch'oxjioch winhaj Joás yuninal winhaj Ocozías chi' t'a heb'.
Elanhchamel ix yal winh t'a heb': Aton tik ol he k'ulok: Ay ex mach ex ol ex ochkan he tanhwej spalakio winh rey t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip,
ayex pax mach ex ol he tanhwej spuertail yik Shur, anhejtona' ayex mach ex ol he tanhwej spuertail spat heb' stanhwan winh rey. Icha chi' ol aj he kannhej he tanhwej yik malaj mach sk'och ta'.
Ha exxo tzex elkan t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip chi' jun, cha makan tzeyutej he b'a he tanhwan stemplo Jehová t'a stz'eytak winh rey.

Tzex och oyan t'a spatiktak b'aj ay winh chi', junjun heb' yet'nak syamk'ab' yik owal. Yalnhej mach tz'och t'a he kal b'aj tzolan ex och chi', tojolnhej schami. Yalnhej b'ajtil sb'at winh rey chi', tzex b'at yet' winh, xchi winhaj Joiada chi'.

Ix sk'anab'ajej heb' kapitán chi' tastak ix yal winhaj Joiada chi'. Junjun heb' ix yak'och soldado heb', heb' tz'och stanhwej t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip yet' heb' tz'elkani, ix k'och heb' t'a yichanh winhaj sakerdote Joiada chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an k'een lanza winh yet' k'een smaklab' jul-lab' t'a heb' kapitán chi', aton k'een aykan yuj winhaj rey Dawid t'a yol stemplo Jehová chi'.
Ix och oyan heb' soldado chi' stanhwan t'a yamaq'uil templo yet' t'a spatiktak altar yet' t'a spatik yichanh winh rey chi'. Junjun heb', yet'nak syamk'ab' heb' yik owal.

Ix yik'anelta winh yuninal winh rey chi' winhaj Joiada chi', ix yak'ank'e korona winh t'a sjolom winh, ix yak'an jun yumal strato Dios winh t'a winh. Ix stob'ank'e akeite winh t'a sjolom winh unin chi', ix yalan winh to reyxo winh. Ixlajwi chi', masanil heb' ix stz'it sk'ab', ix syamanoch heb' yawaji: Niwanokab' yelk'och winh ko reyal, xchi heb'.
Ayic ix yab'an ix Atalía yel yaw heb' winh soldado yet' heb' anima chi' yeq'ui, ix jawi ix t'a stemplo Jehová b'aj ayek' heb' anima smasanil.

Axo ix yilan ix ayek' winh rey chi', linhanoch winh t'a stz'ey jun oy t'a amak' chi', ichataxon sb'eyb'al heb'. Ha t'a stz'eytak winh rey chi' ayek' heb' yajal yet' heb' tz'ak'anoch sonal heb' sb'itani. Masanil heb' anima chi' stzalaj heb', spu'an sch'aak heb'. Yuj chi' ix snhik'chitejb'at spichul ix, ix el yaw ix: --Pechum ex el yajal a ex tik. Pechum ex el yajal, xchi ix.

Ix yalan winhaj sakerdote Joiada t'a heb' yajalil heb' soldado icha tik: --Ik'equel ix a ex tzolan ex ek' chi'. Ha mach tz'och tzak'an yuj ix miljokab'chamok, xchi winh. Yujto toxo ix yal winh sakerdote chi' to max yal-laj smiljicham ix t'a yamaq'uil stemplo Jehová.
Yuj chi' ix ik'jielta ix t'a skal heb' chi', ix ik'chajb'at ix b'aj tz'ochk'och sb'e heb' ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej sk'och t'a spalakio winh rey. Ata' ix miljicham ix yuj heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Joiada chi' to sb'okan junok strato winh rey yet' heb' chonhab' to ol ochkan heb' schonhab'ok Jehová. Ix yalanpax winh to ayokab' junok strato winh rey yet' heb' chonhab' chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix smak'anem lanhnaj stemplo Baal heb', ix smak'anpoj juntzanh altar heb' yet' juntzanh yechel. Ix mak'jipaxcham winhaj Matán, sakerdote yaj t'a Baal chi' t'a yichanh juntzanh altar chi'. Ix yak'anoch stanhwumal stemplo Jehová winhaj Joiada chi'.

Ix elta heb' yajalil soldado, heb' quereteo, aton heb' stanhwan winh rey chi' yet' masanil anima. Yaman ix aj yel heb' yet' winh rey t'a yamaq'uil stemplo Jehová, masanto ix k'och heb' t'a palakio. Ha t'a spuertail b'aj ayek' heb' stanhwan palakio chi' ix k'och heb', ix em k'ojan winhaj rey Joás chi' t'a yol sk'ojnub' heb' rey.
Masanil heb' anima, ix tzalajk'e heb', yujto a ix Atalía toxo ix miljicham ix t'a sti' palakio chi'. Icha chi' ix aj skan jun chonhab' chi' t'a junk'olal.
Uque' ab'il sk'inal winhaj rey Joás chi' ayik ix och winh reyal t'a Judá.
Ayic uquexo ab'il yoch winhaj Jehú reyal t'a Israel, ix och winhaj Joás chi' reyal t'a Judá. 40 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Sibia sb'i ix snun winh, aj Beerseba ix.
Masanil tas ix sk'ulej winhaj Joás chi', te wach' t'a yichanh Jehová, yujto ix k'ayb'aj winh yuj winhaj sakerdote Joiada.
Palta a b'aj syak'em sb'a anima t'a juntzanh lugar chaanh, maj yik'el-laj winh, yuj chi' ixto yak'nhej silab' heb' anima yet' snhusan inkienso heb' ta'.

Ay jun k'ual ix yal winhaj rey Joás chi' t'a heb' winh sakerdote: --Molec k'een tumin yet' k'een ofrenda tz'ik'jikot t'a stemplo Jehová, k'een yowalil syak' junjun anima yet' jantak k'een ofrenda tonhej tz'el t'a sk'ol heb' yak'ani. Junjun ex ol eyak' k'een tumin ol he cha chi' yuj sb'oji templo, xchi winh t'a heb' winh.
Palta ayik ix el 23 ab'il yoch winh reyal chi', manta jab'ok stemplo Jehová chi' sb'o heb' winh sakerdote chi'.

Yuj chi' ix awtaj winhaj Joiada yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh sakerdote yuj winh, ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh: --¿Tas yuj manta jab'ok templo tik tze b'o'o? Ha tiknaik t'a quichanhb'at tik, manhxook ex laj ol he cha k'een tumin t'a heb' anima tik. Ha jantak k'een tumin ol ak'jok, yowalil skan k'een yik sb'oji templo chi', xchi winh.
Ix scha sk'ol heb' winh sakerdote chi' to manhxooklaj heb' winh schaan k'een tumin chi', manhxa paxlaj yalan yik heb' winh sb'oan stemplo Jehová chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yik'kot jun kaxa winhaj Joiada chi', ix yolan smakul te' winh, ix yak'ankan te' winh t'a slak'anil altar t'a stojolal swach' mach tz'och t'a yol templo chi'. Aton ta' syak'em k'een tumin heb' winh sakerdote stanhwan sti' templo scha t'a heb' anima sk'och t'a templo chi'.

Ayic syilan heb' winh to niwanxo k'een tumin chi' ay t'a yol te' kaxa chi', sk'och jun winh stz'ib'um winh rey yet' winh sat sakerdote chi', sb'isan k'een tumin chi' heb' winh. Slajwi chi' syak'anem k'een heb' winh t'a yol juntzanh mukuk.

Ayic slajwi sb'isan k'een chi' heb' winh, syak'an k'een heb' winh t'a heb' winh ayoch yilumalok munlajel tas tz'aj sb'oxi templo chi', yik stupchaj heb' winh snhikan te te', heb' winh tz'ilan sb'o munlajel chi',

heb' winh albañil yet' heb' winh b'oum k'een. Ix manchaj pax te te' yet' k'een k'een mak'b'ilpojok yik tz'och t'a munlajel chi'. Sk'anchajpax k'een tumin chi' t'a juntzanhxo tas smanchaj yuj munlajel chi'.

Ha k'een tumin syik'b'at heb' t'a templo chi', max k'anchajlaj k'een yik sb'ochaj juntzanh waso, pultu, k'een ik'lab'el stanhil b'aj tz'och sk'ak'al kandil, k'een niwak uk'ab' yet' trompeta yet' juntzanhxo yamk'ab' nab'a oro yet' plata.
Palta a masanil k'een tumin chi', ha t'a heb' winh ayoch t'a yib'anh yilan munlajel yik sb'oji stemplo Jehová chi', ha t'a heb' winh tz'ak'ji k'een.
Maj ch'olb'itaj smunlajel heb' winh schaan k'een tumin chi', yik slaj stupan heb' winh munlajwum heb' winh, yujto te tz'akan syutej heb' winh sb'oani.
Axo pax k'een tumin tz'ak'ji yuj spakok mul yet' silab' tz'ak'chaj yuj stupchaj mul, max ak'jilaj k'een t'a templo chi', yujto yik heb' winh sakerdote yaj k'een.
Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', a winhaj Hazael sreyal Siria, ix jawi winh yak' owal t'a chonhab' Gat, ix yak'an ganar jun chonhab' chi' winh, ix lajwi chi' ix kot winh t'a sb'eal Jerusalén yak' owal.

Ha winhaj Joás sreyal Judá, ix smolb'ej jantak tas yak'nak heb' smam yicham winh t'a stemplo Jehová, aton winhaj Josafat, winhaj Joram yet' winhaj Ocozías. Ix smolb'anpax juntzanh tas yak'nak winh t'a templo chi' yet' masanil k'een oro ayxo ek' ta' yet' masanil tas ay t'a spalakio winh. Masanil juntzanh chi' ix yak'b'at winh t'a winhaj Hazael chi', yuj chi' majxo yak'laj owal chi' t'a Jerusalén chi'.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Joás yet' masanil tastak ix sk'ulej winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá.
Ix smolb'an sb'a heb' winh ayoch yajalil yet' winhaj Joás chi', ix smol alan heb' winh t'a spatik winh. Ix smilancham winh heb' winh t'a jun pat b'aj mukb'il jun ch'olan t'a ti' b'e tz'emta t'a Sila.

Ha heb' winh ix milancham winh chi', aton winhaj Josacar yuninal winhaj Simat yet' winhaj Jozabad yuninal winhaj Somer. Ayic ix cham winh chi', ix mukji winh t'a schonhab' winhaj rey Dawid. Axo winh yuninal winh skuchan Amasías ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayic 23 ab'il yoch winhaj Joás yuninal winhaj Ocozías reyal t'a Judá, ix schaanel yich winhaj Joacaz yuninal winhaj Jehú yak'an reyal t'a Israel. 17 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Samaria.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha juntzanh chukal sk'ulejnak winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat, winh kuchb'annak heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal, a chi' ix sb'eyb'alej winh.
Yuj wal chi' ix kot yowal sk'ool Jehová t'a heb' israel chi', niwan tiempo ix kan heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Hazael sreyal Siria yet' pax t'a yol sk'ab' winh yuninal winh, aton winhaj Ben-adad.
Yuj chi' ix lesalwi winhaj Joacaz chi' t'a Jehová, ix ab'chaj slesal winh chi', yujto ix yil Jehová tas wal tz'utaj heb' israel yuj winh sreyal Siria chi',
yuj chi' ix ak'ji jun mach skolwaj t'a heb' yuj Jehová chi'. Icha chi' ix aj yel heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' sirio chi', ix kanxi heb' t'a junk'olal, ichataxon yajek' heb' t'a yalanhtaxo.

Palta maj yaktejkanlaj heb' sb'eyb'alan juntzanh chukal sk'ulejnak winhaj Jeroboam winh kuchb'annak heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal. Ix k'enhejchaanh heb' yet' jun chukal chi', anheja' ayek' jun yechel Asera t'a Samaria chi'.

Ha heb' soldado winhaj Joacaz chi', quenxonhej sb'isul heb', yujto a winh sreyal Siria ix satanel heb'. 50-xonhej heb' sk'e t'a yib'anh chej, lajunhe' karruaje yik owal yet' 10 mil soldado sb'ey t'a yok ayeq'ui.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj rey Joacaz yet' tastak ix sk'ulej winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Axo yik ix cham winh, ix mukji winh t'a Samaria. Ixlajwi chi', haxo winhaj Joás winh yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayic 37 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Joás reyal t'a Judá, ata' ix schael yich winhaj Joás yuninal winhaj Joacaz yak'an reyal t'a Israel, 16 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Samaria.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha juntzanh chukal sk'ulejnak winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat, winh kuchb'annakb'at heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal, a chi' ix sb'eyb'alej winh.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Joás chi', tastak ix sk'ulej winh yet' tas ix aj yak'an owal winh yet' winhaj Amasías sreyal Judá, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Ayic ix cham winhaj Joás chi', ix mukji winh t'a Samaria b'aj mukan juntzanhxo heb' winh sreyal Israel. Axo winhaj Jeroboam ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.

Ayic manto cham winhaj Joás sreyal Israel chi', ix xid'ek' winh yil winhaj Eliseo ayik te penaay winhaj Eliseo chi' yuj jun yab'il ix ik'an schami. Yuj chi' ix ok'k'e winhaj Joás chi' t'a winh, ix och lak'naj winh t'a winh, ix yalan winh rey chi': --Ay mamin, lajan ach icha nok' chej yet' karruaje yik owal t'ayonh israel onh tik, yujto tzach kolwajnhej t'ayonh, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi': --Ik'kot junok a jul-lab' yet' jayeok sjul-lab'il, xchi winh. Ix yik'ankot winh rey chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi': --Jac wentena t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u. Ix sjakan winh rey chi', ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi': B'ooch a jul-lab' chi' yik ol ach julwajok, xchi winh. Yakb'an yamb'il te' yuj winh rey chi', ix yak'anoch sk'ab' winhaj Eliseo t'a yib'anh sk'ab' winh rey chi'. --Julwajanh an, xchi winh. Ix julwajb'at winh rey chi', ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi': --Ha a jul-lab' tik sch'oxanel skolwal Jehová t'a schonhab' to ol ak' ganar heb' sirio t'a Afec, ol a satanel heb' smasanil, xchi winh.

Ix yalanxi winhaj Eliseo chi' t'a winh rey chi': --Yam juntzanh a jul-lab', xchi winh. Ayic ix syaman sjul-lab' winh chi', ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi': --Ha tiknaik, tekub'tanhejem t'a sat lu'um, xchi winh. Yuj chi' oxel ix stequem winh rey chi', ix och waan winh.
Ix kot yowal winhaj Eliseo chi', ix yalan winh: --Octom ix a tequem oel waquelok, tato icha chi', icham chi' ol aj a satanel heb' sirio chi' smasanil. Ocxo jun, oxelnhej ol ak' ganar heb', xchi winh.
Ix cham winhaj Eliseo chi', ix mukchaj winh. Junjun ab'il tzulnhejek' heb' moabita elk'al t'a yol smakb'en heb' israel.

Ha junel, ix b'at juntzanh heb' israel smuk jun chamnak. Ayic wan sk'och heb' b'aj ol smuk chi', ix yilan heb' sjawi heb' elk'um chi', toxonhej ix syumkanoch jun chamnak chi' heb' b'aj mukan winhaj Eliseo chi', ix b'at heb' elelal. Ayic ix och tennaj jun chamnak chi' t'a sb'aquil winhaj Eliseo chi', ix pitzwixi, ix k'ex linhan.
Ix te ixtaj wal heb' israel yuj winhaj Hazael sreyal Siria ayik pitzanto winhaj rey Joacaz.

Palta ix yak' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a heb', ix ok' sk'ol t'a heb' yujnhej strato yet' winhaj Abraham, winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Jacob. Yuj chi' maj schalaj satjiel heb', maj yik'el-laj heb' t'a yichanh.
Ayic ix cham winhaj Hazael sreyal Siria chi', haxo winh yuninal winh skuchan Ben-adad ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.

Yuj chi', a winhaj Joás yuninal winhaj Joacaz ix ik'anxikanek' juntzanh chonhab' ix yik'ek' winhaj Hazael t'a winhaj rey Joacaz ayik ix yak'an owal heb'. Oxel ix ak'ji ganar winhaj Ben-adad yuj winhaj Joás chi'. Icha chi' ix yutej winh skolanxikan juntzanh chonhab' chi'.
Ayic schab'ilxo ab'il yoch winhaj Joás yuninal winhaj Joacaz reyal t'a Israel, ix schaanel yich winhaj Amasías yuninal winhaj Joás yak'an reyal t'a Judá.
Ha winhaj Amasías chi', 25 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal chi'. 29 ab'il ix yak' reyal chi' winh t'a Jerusalén. Joadán sb'i ix snun winh, aj Jerusalén ix.
Ha tas ix sk'ulej winh wach' t'a yichanh Jehová, palta maj k'ochlaj icha sk'ulejnak winhaj Dawid, aton smam yicham winh. Ha sb'eyb'al winhaj Joás winh smam winh ix sb'eyb'alej.
Ha juntzanh lugar chaanh b'aj tz'och ejmelal, maj yik'el-laj winh, yuj chi' ix yak'nhej silab' heb' anima ta', ix snhusanpax inkienso heb'.
Ayic ix yik'an wal yip yopisio winhaj Amasías chi', ix smilcham heb' winh ay yopisio winh, aton heb' winh miljinak cham winh smam winh.

Palta maj smilchamlaj heb' yuninal heb' winh ix cham chi' winh, yujto tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a ley Moisés, b'aj syalkan Jehová icha tik: Ha heb' mamab'il, max yal-laj scham heb' yuj smul yuninal, anhejtona' heb' uninab'il, max yalpax scham heb' yuj smul smam, palta junjun mach scham yuj smul, xchi Jehová.
Ix smilpaxcham 10 mil heb' edomita winhaj Amasías t'a owal t'a lum Spanhanil Atz'am Atz'am. Ix yak'pax ganar chonhab' Sela winh, ix yak'ankan skuch winh Jocteel, aton chi' ix sb'iejkani.
Ixlajwi chi', ix schekanb'at heb' schekab' winh t'a winhaj Joás sreyal Israel, yuninal winhaj Joacaz yixchiquin winhaj Jehú. Ix yalanb'at winh icha tik: Cotanh, kak' owal, xchib'at winh.

Palta ix yak'anb'at spak winhaj Joás chi' icha tik: Ay jun te' sak q'uiix, ix yalb'at te' t'a te' k'ute' ay t'a Líbano: Ak' ix isil yetb'eyumok winh wunin, xchi te'. Palta haxo nok' chium nok' ix ek' ta', ix stek'anem lat'an te' sak q'uiix chi' nok'.

Yel ix ak' ganar heb' edomita chi', yuj chi' tzik'walchaanh a b'a tiknaik. Wach' toni, ik'chaanh a b'ha t'a a pat. Tato tza nib'ej ak' owal wed'ok, a jun chi' tonhej ol kot t'a ib'anh yuj yet' t'a yib'anh Judá, xchib'at winh.
Palta maj schalaj yab' juntzanh chi' winhaj Amasías chi'. Yuj chi' ix kot winhaj Joás chi' yak' owal yet' winh, ix schalaj sb'a heb' winh t'a Bet-semes t'a yol yik Judá.
Ix ak'ji ganar heb' soldado yik Judá chi' yuj heb' soldado yik Israel, toxonhej ix el lemnaj heb', ix paxkan heb' t'a spat.

Ix yamchaj winhaj Amasías sreyal Judá chi' yuj winhaj Joás chi' t'a Bet-semes chi', ix ik'jik'e winh t'a Jerusalén yuj winh. Ix sjuanem 180 metro smuroal chonhab' chi' heb' soldado, ix b'at t'a puerta yik heb' aj Efraín masanto t'a spuertail schiquin.

Ix yik'anpax masanil k'een oro winhaj Joás chi', k'een plata yet' pax masanil tastak ay t'a stemplo Jehová yet' masanil tas ay t'a spalakio winhaj rey Amasías chi'. Ay pax juntzanh anima ix yik'b'at winh t'a Samaria yik tz'ak'ji pural winhaj Amasías chi' yoch junk'olal yet' winh.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Joás chi', tastak ix sk'ulej winh yet' tas ix aj yak'an owal winh yet' winhaj Amasías sreyal Judá, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Ayic ix cham winhaj Joás chi', ix mukji winh t'a Samaria b'aj mukan juntzanhxo heb' winh sreyal Israel. Axo winhaj Jeroboam ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.
Ha winhaj Amasías yuninal winhaj Joás sreyal Judá chi', 15 ab'ilto ix kan winh ayik ix cham winhaj Joás yuninal winhaj Joacaz sreyal Israel.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Amasías chi', tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá.

Ay juntzanh heb' winh ay t'a Jerusalén ix och ajk'olal t'a winhaj Amasías chi', yuj chi' ix b'at winh elelal t'a Laquis. Palta ix ochnhej heb' winh t'a spatik winh, yuj chi' ata' ix cham winh yuj heb' winh.
Ix yik'anb'at winh heb' winh t'a yib'anh chej, ix mukji winh t'a Jerusalén b'aj mukan heb' smam yicham winh t'a schonhab'kan winhaj Dawid.
Yuj chi' masanil heb' aj Judá ix ak'anoch winhaj Azarías reyal sk'exulok winh smam chi'. 16 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal chi'.
Ayic ayxo och winh reyal sk'exulok winh smam chi', ix yik'anxiek' chonhab' Elat winh, ix sb'oanxik'e winh.
Ayic 15 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Amasías yuninal winhaj Joás reyal t'a Judá, ix schaanel yich winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Joás yak'an reyal t'a Israel, 41 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Samaria.
Palta te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha juntzanh chukal sk'ulejnak winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat, winh kuchb'annakb'at heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal, a chi' ix sb'eyb'alej winh.

Ha winhaj Jeroboam chi' ix ik'anxiek' b'aj tzek'taxon smojonal smakb'en Israel, sb'atnhej b'aj tz'ochk'och b'e t'a Hamat masanto t'ha ha' mar yik Arabá, icha aj yalannakkan Jehová sDiosal Israel t'a winhaj Jonás schekab', aton winh yuninal winhaj Amitai aj Gat-hefer.
Yujto ix yil Jehová to te ya tzek' heb' israel smasanil, malaj wal junok mach skolwaj yet' heb'.
Yuj chi' a winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Joás ix yak'lab'ej Jehová skolan heb', yujto malaj t'a spensar Jehová satanel schonhab' t'a junelnhej.

Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Jeroboam chi', tastak ix sk'ulej winh yet' jantak owal ix yak' winh ayik ix yik'anxiek' juntzanh chonhab' winh t'a Judá, aton Damasco yet' Hamat, masanil juntzanh chi', tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Ayic ix cham winhaj Jeroboam chi', ix mukji winh b'aj mukan heb' winh sreyal Israel, haxo winhaj Zacarías yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayic 27 ab'il yoch winhaj Jeroboam reyal t'a Israel, ata' ix schael yich winhaj Azarías yuninal winhaj Amasías yak'an reyal t'a Judá.
16 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal chi'. 52 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Jecolías sb'i ix snun winh, aj Jerusalén ix.
Ha tas ix sk'ulej winhaj Azarías chi' wach' t'a yichanh Jehová, icha sk'ulejnak winhaj Amasías smam winh.
Palta a juntzanh lugar chaanh b'aj tz'och ejmelal, maj yik'el-laj winh, ix yak'nhej silab' heb' anima, ix snhusanpax inkienso heb' ta'.

Ix yak'och jun yab'il skuch lepra Jehová t'a winh rey chi' masanto ix cham winh. Yuj chi', majxo ajlaj winh rey chi' t'a spalakio, ch'ok patil b'aj ix ajek' winh. Axo winhaj Jotam, winh yuninal winh, ha' winh ix och yilumalok spalakio winh chi', ix yak'anpax yajalil winh t'a Judá chi'.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Azarías yet' tastak ix sk'ulej winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá.
Ayic ix cham winh, ix mukji winh t'a schonhab'kan winhaj rey Dawid t'a slak'anil b'aj mukan heb' smam yicham, haxo winhaj Jotam winh yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayic 38 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Azarías reyal t'a Judá, ix och winhaj Zacarías yuninal winhaj Jeroboam reyal t'a Israel, waque' ujal ix yak' reyal winh t'a Samaria.

Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, icha ix sk'ulej heb' smam yicham winh. Ha juntzanh chukal sk'ulejnak winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat, winh kuchb'annakb'at heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal, a chi' ix sb'eyb'alej winh.

Axo winhaj Salum yuninal winhaj Jabes ix och ajk'olal t'a winh, ix b'at juknaj winh t'a winhaj Zacarías chi', ix smilancham winh winh t'a yichanh heb' chonhab'. Axo winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Zacarías chi', tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Icha chi' ix aj yelk'och tas yalnakkan Jehová t'a winhaj Jehú, ayik yalannak to a heb' yinhtilal winh, ol ochnhej heb' reyal t'a Israel masanto t'a schanhil makan yinhtilal chi'.
Ha winhaj Salum chi', ix schael yich winh yak'an reyal ayik 39 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Azarías reyal t'a Judá, palta junnhej ujal ix yak' reyal winh t'a Samaria.

Axo winhaj Manahem yuninal winhaj Gadi ix kot yet' heb' winh soldado t'a Tirsa, ix yak'an owal heb' winh t'a chonhab' Tifsa. Ix smilancham masanil heb' anima heb' winh ta' yet' masanil anima ay t'a yol smakb'en Tifsa chi'. Ix tekjielta yol sk'ol heb' ix yab'ix yuj heb' winh. Masanil tas ay ta', ix yik'b'at heb' winh. Icha chi' ix sk'ulej heb' winh yujto maj chajioch heb' winh yuj heb' aj chonhab' chi' t'a yol schonhab' chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix k'och winhaj Manahem chi' t'a Samaria yak' owal yet' winhaj Salum chi'. Ayic ix lajwi smilancham winhaj Salum chi' winh, haxo winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh. Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Salum chi' yet' tas ix aj yoch winh ajk'olal t'a winhaj Zacarías, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Ayic 39 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Azarías reyal t'a Judá, ix schaanel yich winhaj Manahem yuninal winhaj Gadi yak'an reyal t'a Israel. 10 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Samaria.

Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, yujto a chukal sk'ulejnak winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat, winh kuchb'annak b'at heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal, a chi' ix sb'eyb'alej winh. Ha t'a stiempoal ayoch winhaj Manahem reyal chi',
ix jawi winhaj Pul sreyal Asiria yak' owal t'a Israel chi'. Yuj chi' 750 quintal k'een plata ix yak' winh t'a winhaj Pul chi' yik tz'och winh yet' winh yik wach' skannhej winh t'a yopisio.

Ix yak'och 50 siklo k'een plata winhaj Manahem chi' t'a yib'anh junjun heb' b'eyum t'a yol smakb'en Israel chi', yik syal stupan k'een tumin syak' winh t'a winh sreyal Asiria chi'. Icha chi' ix aj smeltzaj winh sreyal Asiria chi' t'a schonhab', majxo ochlaj waan winh t'a yol yik Israel chi'.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Manahem yet' tastak ix sk'ulej, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Ixlajwi chi' ix cham winh, haxo winhaj Pekaía winh yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayic 50 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Azarías reyal t'a Judá, ix och winhaj Pekaía yuninal winhaj Manahem reyal t'a Israel. Chab' ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Samaria.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha juntzanh chukal sk'ulejnak winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat, winh kuchb'annakb'at heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal, a chi' ix sb'eyb'alej winh.

Palta a winhaj Peka yuninal winhaj Remalías yajal heb' winh soldado winhaj Pekaía chi', ix och winh ajk'olal t'a winhaj Pekaía chi', ix yak'anoch sb'a 50 heb' winak aj Galaad yet' winh. Ix miljicham winhaj Pekaía chi' yuj heb' winh t'a skuartel t'a yol spalakio t'a Samaria yet' winhaj Argob yet' winhaj Arie. Axo winhaj Peka chi' ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Pekaía chi' yet' tastak ix sk'ulej, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Ayic 52 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Azarías reyal t'a Judá, ix och winhaj Peka yuninal winhaj Remalías reyal t'a Israel. 20 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Samaria.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha juntzanh chukal sk'ulejnak winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat, winh kuchb'annakb'at heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal, a chi' ix sb'eyb'alej winh.

Ha t'a stiempoal ayoch winhaj Peka reyal t'a Israel chi', ata' ix jawi winhaj Tiglat-pileser sreyal Asiria, ix ak'ji ganar juntzanh chonhab' tik yuj winh: Aton Ijón, Abel-bet-maaka, Janoa, Cedes, Hazor, Galaad, Galilea yet' masanil yol yik Neftalí. Masanil heb' kajan t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', ix ik'jib'at heb' icha preso t'a Asiria chi'.

Ayic 20 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Jotam yuninal winhaj Azarías reyal t'a Judá, a winhaj Oseas yuninal winhaj Ela ix och ajk'olal t'a winhaj Peka yuninal winhaj Remalías chi', ix smilancham winhaj Peka chi' winh, haxo winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Peka yet' tastak ix sk'ulej winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Ayic schab'il ab'il yoch winhaj Peka yuninal winhaj Remalías reyal t'a Israel, ix och winhaj Jotam yuninal winhaj Azarías reyal t'a Judá.
Ha winhaj Jotam chi', 25 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal chi', 16 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Jerusa sb'i ix snun winh, yisil ix winhaj Sadoc.
Masanil tas ix sk'ulej winhaj Jotam chi', te wach' t'a yichanh Jehová, icha wal sb'eyb'al winhaj Azarías smam winh.
Ix sb'o'okh spuertail stemplo Jehová winh t'a yib'anh, palta a juntzanh lugar chaanh b'aj tz'och ejmelal, maj yik'el-laj winh, ix yak'nhej silab' heb' anima yet' snhusan inkienso heb' ta'.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Jotam yet' tastak ix sk'ulej winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá.
Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi' ix och ijan Jehová yak'ankot winhaj Rezín sreyal Siria yet' winhaj Peka yuninal winhaj Remalías yak' owal yet' Judá chi'.
Ayic ix cham winhaj Jotam chi', ix mukji winh t'a schonhab' winhaj rey Dawid, winh smam yicham winh. Ixlajwi chi' haxo winhaj Acaz yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayic 17 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Peka yuninal winhaj Remalías reyal t'a Israel, ix schaanel yich winhaj Acaz yuninal winhaj Jotam yak'an reyal t'a Judá.

Ayxo 20 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal chi'. 16 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, maj sb'eyb'alej sb'eyb'al winhaj Dawid smam yicham winh.

Anhej sb'eyb'al juntzanh heb' winh sreyal Israel ix sb'eyb'alej winh. Ix snhustz'a yuninal winh silab'il. Lajan wal ix sk'ulej winh icha wal sb'eyb'al juntzanh nakión ik'b'ilel yuj Jehová ayik yochnak heb' israel t'a lu'um tik.
Anhejtona' ix yak' silab' winh, ix snhusanpax inkienso winh t'a juntzanh lugar chaanh b'aj tz'och ejmelal t'a jolomtak witz yet' t'a yichtak te te' k'ayum xiil.

Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', a winhaj Rezín sreyal Siria yet' winhaj Peka yuninal winhaj Remalías sreyal Israel, ix k'och heb' winh t'a Jerusalén yik syak'an owal heb' winh yet' winhaj rey Acaz chi'. Ix oymaj heb' winh t'a spatiktak Jerusalén chi', palta maj yak'laj ganar heb' winh.

Anheja' t'a jun pekti’ chi', a winh sreyal Edom ix ak'an ganar chonhab' Elat, ix ochkan yikok Edom chi'. Ha heb' aj Judá kajan ta', ix pechjiel heb' yuj winh, haxo heb' aj Edom chi' ix kannhej kajan ta'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix schekanb'at jaywanh heb' schekab' winhaj Acaz t'a winhaj Tiglat-pileser sreyal Asiria, yik sb'at alchaj t'a winh icha tik: Swak'och in b'ha t'a yol a k'ab'. Yuj chi' kotanh yuj tzul in a kolan t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Siria yet' winh sreyal Israel, yujto wan yak'an owal heb' winh wed'ok, xchi b'at winh.
Yuj chi', a winhaj Acaz chi', ix yik'elta k'een plata winh yet' k'een oro t'a stemplo Jehová yet' k'een ay t'a spalakio winh, ix sianb'at k'een winh t'a winh sreyal Asiria chi'.

Ix sk'anab'ajej winh sreyal Asiria chi' tas ix yal winhaj Acaz chi', yuj chi' ix kot winh yet' heb' soldado yak' owal t'a Damasco. Ix yak'an ganar jun chonhab' chi' winh. Ha heb' kajan ta', ix ik'jib'at heb' yuj winh t'a Kir. Ix smilanpaxcham winhaj Rezín chi' winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winhaj rey Acaz t'a Damasco scha winhaj Tiglat-pileser chi'. Ata' ix yil jun altar winh, ix stz'ib'anb'at yechel jun altar chi' winh t'a winhaj sakerdote Urías t'a Jerusalén.
Icha chi' ix aj sb'oank'e jun altar winhaj sakerdote Urías chi', lajan ix aj icha yechel ix yak'kot winhaj rey Acaz t'a Damasco chi'. Wach'xo yaji ayik ix jax winhaj Acaz chi' t'a Jerusalén.
Ayic ix jax winh t'a Jerusalén chi', ix yilan jun altar chi' winh, ix snitzanoch sb'a winh t'a stz'ey yik snhusantz'a silab' winh t'a yib'anh.

Ix yak'an nok' silab' winh stz'a smasanil yet' ofrenda yet' tas swaji. Ix sekanpaxem wino winh t'a yib'anh altar chi' t'a ofrendail. Ix stzikanpaxoch schiq'uil nok' silab' yik junk'olal winh t'a spatiktak altar chi'.
Axo pax altar bronke ay t'a yichanh stemplo Jehová, ix yik'el winh t'a skal jun ak' altar chi' yet' stemplo Jehová chi', ix yak'an kan winh t'a stojolal snorteal jun ak' altar chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh t'a winhaj sakerdote Urías chi' icha tik: Ha tiknaik a masanil nok' silab' tz'ak'ji t'a q'uinhib'alil yet' t'a yemk'ualil yet' ofrenda t'a tas swaji yet' wino, anhej t'a yib'anh jun ak' altar tik tz'ak'ji. Anheja' juntzanhxo silab' syak' heb' chonhab' yet' wik a in tik, ha t'a yib'anh jun altar chi' stz'ai. Stzicchajpaxoch schiq'uil nok' silab' chi' t'a spatiktak. Palta haxo jun altar bronke chi', wik tz'ajkani yik ata' tzin k'anb'ej in b'ha t'a Jehová.
Ix sk'anab'ajej winhaj Urías chi' icha wal ix aj yalan winh rey chi'.

Ix schekan winh rey chi' ik'chajel yol sat smarkoal juntzanh karreta nab'a bronke t'a templo. Ix ik'chajpaxel palangana ayem t'a yib'anh. Ix yik'anpaxel k'een yechel mam wakax nab'a bronke ayoch t'a yalanh jun niwan pila, haxo t'a yib'anh k'een k'een t'a sat lu'um ix yak'kanem winh.

Yic wach' skan winh t'a sat winh sreyal Asiria chi', yuj chi' ix yik'el jun yet'tal b'aj skan heb' rey t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip winh t'a stemplo Jehová yet' spuertail ay t'a spatiqueli, aton b'aj tz'och winh rey t'a templo chi'.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj rey Acaz yet' tastak ix sk'ulej winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá.
Ayic ix cham winh, ix mukji winh b'aj mukan heb' smam yicham t'a schonhab'kan winhaj Dawid. Axo winhaj Ezequías yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayic 12 ab'il yoch winhaj Acaz reyal t'a Judá, haxo winhaj Oseas yuninal winhaj Ela ix och reyal t'a Israel, b'alunhe' ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Samaria.
Chuc tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, wach'chom maj k'och ijan icha schukal juntzanh heb' winh rey ek'nak t'a Israel chi' t'a yalanhtaxo.

Ha winhaj Salmanasar sreyal Asiria, ix yak' owal winh yet' winhaj Oseas chi'. Ix kan winhaj Oseas chi' t'a yalanh smandar winh, ix yak'an k'een tumin winh t'a winh sreyal Asiria chi' t'a junjun ab'il.

Palta ix yaktej winhaj Oseas chi' yak'an k'een tumin chi', ix schekanb'at schekab' winh t'a winhaj So sreyal Egipto yik skolwaj winh yet' winh yik tz'el winh t'a yalanh smandar winh sreyal Asiria chi'. Yuj chi' a winhaj rey Salmanasar ix yaman winhaj Oseas chi', ix yak'anoch winh winh t'a preso.
Ix lajwinhej chi', ix syamanoch winh yik'anek' masanil smakb'en Israel chi'. Oxe' ab'il ix yoymitej chonhab' Samaria winh.

Axo ix aji, ha t'a sb'alunhil ab'il yoch winhaj Oseas chi' reyal, ix ak'ji ganar Samaria yuj winhaj Salmanasar sreyal Asiria chi'. Yuj chi' ix ik'jib'at masanil heb' israel t'a preso. Axo t'a chonhab' Halah t'a yol yik Habor t'a sti' ha' Gozán yet' t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' yik heb' medo, ix ak'jib'at heb' yuj winh.

Icha chi' ix aj skot jun chi' t'a yib'anh heb' israel chi', yujto ix och wal smul heb' t'a yichanh Jehová sDiosal. Ha Jehová chi' ik'jinaquelta heb' smam yicham heb' t'a Egipto, t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Egipto chi'. Ochnac heb' ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios,
sb'eyb'alannak sb'eyb'al juntzanh nakión heb', aton juntzanh yik'naquel Jehová t'a yichanh heb' yet' juntzanh b'eyb'al b'aj ix kuchb'aj heb' yuj juntzanh heb' winh sreyal.

Elk'altak ix sk'ulej juntzanh tas manh wach'ok heb' t'a yichanh Jehová sDiosal, ix sb'oank'e juntzanh lugar chaanh heb' t'a junjun niwak chonhab' yet' t'a junjun kuartel, yik b'aj tz'och heb' ejmelal.

Ix sb'oanpaxk'e k'een k'een heb' yik syal sb'a heb' t'ay, ix sb'oanpax te te' heb' yik yechel jun sdiosal heb' skuch Asera. Ha t'a tzalquixtak yet' t'a yich te te' k'ayum xiil sb'o juntzanh chi' heb'.
Ata' ix snhus inkienso heb' icha wal sb'eyb'al juntzanh nakión yik'naquel Jehová t'a yichanh heb'. Ix stzuntzankot yowal sk'ol Jehová chi' heb'.
Ix och heb' ejmelal t'a yechel komon Dios, aton wal juntzanh yalnak Jehová to ay yowalil yoch heb' ejmelal t'ay.

Ix schek Jehová yal heb' schekab' t'a Israel yet' t'a Judá: Naec he b'ha t'a masanil he chuk b'eyb'al, k'anab'ajejek masanil cheknab'il, kachnab'il yet' masanil k'ayb'ub'al wak'nak t'a heb' he mam eyicham. Anheja' heb' in chekab' wan yalan heb' t'ayex, xchi Jehová, xchi heb'.
Palta manh wal jab'ok ix scha heb' yab'i, te pit ix yutej spensar heb' icha yutejnak sb'a heb' smam yicham heb', yujto maj yak'och Jehová sDiosal heb' t'a sk'ool.

Ix spatiquejel ley heb' yet' trato sb'onak Jehová yet' heb' smam yicham heb' chi'. Ix spatiquejpaxel cheknab'il ix alchaj t'a heb'. Ix ochpax tzak'an heb' yuj juntzanh Dios malaj jab'ok yelk'ochi. Ha yuj juntzanh chi' manhxa jab'ok yelk'och heb', axonhej schuk b'eyb'al juntzanhxo nakión ix sb'eyb'alej heb', juntzanh to ay yowalil yuj Jehová sb'eyb'alaji.

Ix yaktankan masanil scheknab'il Jehová sDiosal heb', ix sb'oan chab' yechel wakax heb' sdiosalok. Ay pax jun te' yechel ix Asera b'aj ix och heb' ejmelal. Ix ochpax heb' ejmelal t'a k'een k'anal yet' t'a Baal.

Ix snhusantz'a yal yuninal heb' silab'il t'a komon Dios, ix sk'anb'an sb'a heb' t'a heb' naumel lolonel yet' t'a heb' aj chum. Ix ste k'ulejnhej chukal heb' t'a yichanh Jehová. Icha wal chi' ix aj stzuntzankot yowal sk'ol Jehová heb'.
Yuj chi' ix te kot yowal sk'ol Jehová t'a Israel, ix yik'anel heb' t'a yichanh. Axonhej heb' yinhtilal Judá ix kan yuj.
Maj sk'anab'ajej pax scheknab'il Jehová sDiosal heb' aj Judá chi'. Palta ix sb'eyb'alej heb' icha wal tas ix sb'eyb'alej heb' israel chi'.

Yuj chi', masanil heb' yinhtilal Israel ix patikanel Jehová, ix ak'jioch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' juntzanh heb' ch'ok chonhab'il yik tz'ixtaj heb' yuj heb', masanto ix yal yel heb' t'a yichanh Jehová chi'.

Ayic ix ik'jiel lajunhe' inhtilal heb' israel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' yinhtilal winhaj Dawid, haxo winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat ix yak'och heb' sreyalok. Aton winh ix kuchb'anel heb' t'a spatik Jehová, te niwan chukal ix sk'ulej heb' yuj winh.
Icha wal chi' ix te aj yoch smul heb', ix sk'ulejnhej heb' icha chukal ix sk'ulej winhaj Jeroboam chi'.
Yuj chi', ix yik'el heb' israel chi' Jehová t'a yichanh, icha ix aj yalankan heb' schekab'. Ix ik'jib'at heb' preso t'a Asiria, ix kannhej heb' ta'.

Ha winh sreyal Asiria chi' ix ik'ankot heb' anima ay t'a juntzanh chonhab' tik: Aton Babilonia, Cuta, Awa, Hamat yet' Sefarwaim. Aton heb' chi' ix kajnaj yuj winh t'a yol yik Samaria sk'exulok heb' israel. Icha chi' ix ajek' kajan juntzanh anima chi' t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a yol smakb'en Samaria chi'.
Ha juntzanh anima ix jawi kajan chi', max ochlaj heb' ejmelal t'a Jehová, yuj chi' ix yak'kot nok' choj Jehová t'a skal heb', ix miljicham jaywanh heb' yuj nok'.

Ix alchaj t'a winh sreyal Asiria chi' icha tik: Ha heb' anima ix ak'b'at t'a Samaria yik b'at kajnaj heb' ta', manh yojtakok heb' yoch ejmelal t'a sDiosal jun lugar chi', yuj chi' a jun Dios chi' schekankot nok' choj t'a heb', smiljicham heb' yuj nok', xchi heb'.

Yuj chi' ix ak'ji meltzaj junok heb' winh sakerdote ik'b'ilb'at t'a preso chi' yuj winh sreyal Asiria chi', yik wach' tz'aj winh ta', yik sk'ayb'aj heb' anima chi' yuj winh t'a tas snib'ej sDiosal jun chonhab' chi'.
Yuj chi' ix kot junok heb' winh sakerdote aj Samaria ik'b'ilb'at chi'. Axo t'a Betel ix aj winh, ix sk'ayb'an heb' anima chi' winh t'a tas tz'aj yoch heb' ejmelal t'a Jehová.
Palta junjun chonhab'il heb' ix sb'o sdiosal t'a junjun chonhab' b'aj kajan. Ix sb'oanxik'e lugar heb' chaanh b'aj b'ob'iltaxon yuj heb' aj Samaria chi'.
Ha heb' aj Babilonia, ix sb'o yechel Sukot-benot heb'. Axo heb' aj Cuta, ix sb'o yechel Nergal heb'. Axo heb' aj Hamat, ix sb'o yechel Asima heb'.

Axo heb' aj Awa, ix sb'o yechel Nibhaz heb' yet' yechel Tartac. Axo pax heb' aj Sefarwaim, ix snhustz'a yalyuninal heb' silab'il t'a yechel Adramelec yet' t'a Anamelec, aton juntzanh chi' sdiosal heb'.
Scomon ochpax heb' ejmelal t'a Jehová. Syak'anpaxoch heb' yetchonhab' heb' sakerdoteal yik tz'och ejmelal t'a juntzanh lugar chaanh.
Wach'chom tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a Jehová yalani, palta anheja' yoch heb' ejmelal t'a skomon Dios, icha sb'eyb'al heb' anima b'aj kotnak heb'.

Ix sb'eyb'alejnhej heb' icha sb'eyb'altaxon t'a peka'. Max ochlaj heb' ejmelal t'a Jehová, max sk'anab'ajej cheknab'il heb' yet' k'ayb'ub'al ix yak' Jehová to yowalil sk'anab'ajej heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jacob, aton winh ix ak'ji skuch Israel.
Ayic ix sb'oan strato Jehová yet' heb' israel, ix yalani: Manh ex och ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios, manh eyak' serwil, manh eyak' he silab' t'ay.
Palta anhej t'ayin tzex och ejmelal, yujto Ha in ix ex wik'elta t'a Egipto yet' in poder, yuj chi' anhej wal t'ayin yowalil tzex och ejmelal, anhej t'ayin tzeyak'pax he silab'.
Anhejtona' tze k'anab'ajej masanil in k'ayb'ub'al, in cheknab'il yet' kachnab'il tz'ib'yajkani. Manh ex och ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios.
Ha in trato tzin b'o tik eyed'ok, manh eyak'b'at satk'olal. Manh ex och ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios,
palta anhej t'ayin Jehová he Diosal in tik tzex och ejmelal. Tato icha chi' tze k'ulej, ol ex in kolel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' eyajk'ool, xchi Jehová.

Palta a juntzanh anima chi', maj schalaj yab' heb'. Ix sb'eyb'alejnhej heb' ichataxon sb'eyb'al. Wach'chom tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a Jehová yalani, tz'ochpax heb' ejmelal t'a sdiosal. Ha heb' yinhtilal heb', ix sb'eyb'alejnhej sb'eyb'al heb' smam yicham heb'.
Ayic yoxilxo ab'il yoch winhaj Oseas yuninal winhaj Ela reyal t'a israel, ix och winhaj Ezequías yuninal winhaj Acaz reyal t'a Judá.
25 ab'il sk'inal winh, 29 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Abi sb'i ix snun winh, yisil ix winhaj Zacarías.
Ha tas ix sk'ulej winhaj Ezequías chi', te wach' t'a yichanh Jehová, icha sk'ulejnak winhaj Dawid smam yicham winh.

Maj schaochlaj heb' anima winh ejmelal t'a juntzanh lugar chaanh. Ix schekan winh mak'jokpoj juntzanh k'een k'een chajul yaj t'a heb'. Ix ch'akchajel juntzanh te te' yechel Asera. Ix mak'jipoj jun k'een yechel chan bronke b'ob'ilkan yuj winhaj Moisés, yujto snhus inkienso heb' israel chi' t'ay, Nehustán ix sb'iejkan k'een yuj winhaj Ezequías chi'.

Ha winhaj Ezequías chi', a Jehová sDiosal Israel ix yak'och winh yipok sk'ool. Ha t'a skal masanil heb' winh sreyal Judá, heb' ek'nakxo yet' heb' tzak'anto ochnak yuj winhaj Ezequías chi', malaj junok lajan spensar yet' winh.
Te k'anab'ajumnhej ix yutej sb'a winh t'a Jehová. Malaj junelok ix yik'el sb'a winh t'ay. Masanil scheknab'il Jehová yalnakkan t'a winhaj Moisés, ix sk'anab'ajej winh.
Masanil tas ix sk'ulej winh, wach'nhej ix aj yelk'ochi, yujto aynhejoch Jehová yet' winh. Ix yik'el sb'a winh t'a yalanh smandar winh sreyal Asiria, majxo yak'laj k'een tumin winh t'a winh.
Ix yak' ganar heb' filisteo winh, heb' ay t'a juntzanh kuartel yet' heb' ay t'a juntzanh niwak chonhab' ayoch smuroal, masanto ix k'och winh t'a Gaza yet' b'aj sk'och smakb'en Gaza chi'.

Ayic schanhil ab'il yoch winhaj Ezequías reyal t'a Judá, ayik yuquil ab'il yoch winhaj Oseas yuninal winhaj Ela reyal t'a Israel, ix yoymitan chonhab' Samaria winhaj Salmanasar sreyal Asiria yet' heb' soldado.

Ayic ix lajwi yoxil ab'il yoymitan heb', ix yak'an ganar Samaria chi' heb'. Ix uji jun chi' ayik waquexo ab'il yoch winhaj Ezequías chi' reyal, b'alunhexo pax ab'il yoch winhaj Oseas reyal t'a Israel.
Ix yik'b'at heb' israel winhaj Salmanasar chi' t'a Asiria. Ha t'a chonhab' Halah t'a yol yik Habor t'a sti' ha' Gozán yet' t'a juntzanh chonhab' yik heb' medo ix aj heb' yuj winh.
Icha chi' ix uji yujto manh k'anab'ajumok ix yutej sb'a heb' israel t'a Jehová sDiosal, ix spitej sb'a heb' t'a strato, maj schalaj yab' heb' tas alb'ilkan yuj winhaj Moisés schekab' Jehová.

Ayic 14 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Ezequías reyal t'a Judá, ix och winhaj Senaquerib sreyal Asiria yak' owal t'a masanil chonhab' ay smuroal t'a yol yik Judá chi', ix laj ak'ji ganar juntzanh chonhab' chi' yuj winh.

Yuj chi' ix yak'b'at jun uum winhaj Ezequías chi' t'a winh sreyal Asiria t'a Laquis, ix yalanb'at winh icha tik: Ix och in mul t'ayach, ik'el a soldado ayoch t'a sat ko lugar tik, ol wak' k'een tumin ayoch t'a wib'anh uuj, xchib'at winh. Yuj chi', 225 quintal k'een plata yet' 23 quintal k'een oro ix yak'och winh sreyal Asiria chi' t'a yib'anh winhaj Ezequías sreyal Judá chi'.
Masanil k'een plata ayek' t'a yol stemplo Jehová ix yak'b'at winhaj Ezequías chi' yet' jantakxo sb'eyumal winh ay t'a yol spalakio.

Ix yik'anpaxel k'een oro winh, aton k'een ayoch t'a templo chi', k'een ayoch t'a spuertail yet' t'a smarkoal, aton k'een yak'nakoch winh t'a spuertail templo chi'. Masanil juntzanh chi' ix yak'b'at winh t'a winh sreyal Asiria chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'ankot oxwanh heb' winh sat yaj t'a heb' winh yajalil heb' soldado winh sreyal Asiria chi' t'a winhaj rey Ezequías chi' yet' jun niwan nhilanh heb' soldado. Ix el heb' t'a Laquis, ix jawi heb' t'a Jerusalén. Ix sb'oan skampamento heb' b'aj tz'emul yoktak jun stanqueal ha ha' ay t'a yib'anh, t'a yol b'e sb'at b'aj sjuk'wi heb' jalum k'apak.

Elanhchamel ix awtaj winhaj rey Ezequías yuj heb' winh. Yuj chi' a heb' winh oxwanh tik ix schekb'at winh rey chi', yik sb'at lolon heb' winh yet' heb': Aton winhaj Eliaquim yuninal winhaj Hilcías, winh stanhwumal spalakio winh rey chi', winhaj Sebna tz'ib'um ab'ix yet' winhaj Joa yuninal winhaj Asaf, stz'ib'um winh rey chi'.
Ix yalan jun winh sat yajalil heb' soldado yik Asiria chi' t'a heb' winh: --Alec t'a winhaj Ezequías tas syal winh sreyal Asiria, winh niwan yelk'och t'a sat lu'um tik: ¿Tas ayoch yipok a k'ool?
¿Tom tza na' to yujnhej sjelanil a pensar syal ak'an ganar heb' in soldado jelan t'a owal? ¿Tas ayoch yipok a k'ool yuj chi' tzach och ajk'olal t'ayin?

Ix wila'' to a Egipto tzak'och yipok a k'ool. Wach' toni, yujto a Egipto chi' lajan wal icha junok te' aj pojeltakxo. Ayic sko k'okochan te', tzek' paknaj te', haxo sjayil snhi' te' sb'at t'a ko k'ab'. Icha chi' yaj winh sreyal Egipto t'a mach tz'ak'anoch winh yipok sk'ool.

Ach Ezequías, tekan tzal icha tik: Ha onh tik a Jehová ko Diosal skak'och yipok ko k'ool. Palta ina toxo ix a chek satjiel juntzanh altar b'aj chaanh, b'aj tz'och heb' anima ejmelal t'a jun he Diosal chi'. Ix alani to junxonhej altar b'aj tz'och heb' aj Judá yet' heb' aj Jerusalén ejmelal.

Ha tiknaik b'o junok a trato yet' winh wajalil, aton winh sreyal Asiria. Syal winh t'ayach icha tik: Ol wak' chab'ok mil nok' chej t'ayach, tato tz'ilchaj heb' soldado sk'e t'a yib'anh nok' uuj. ¿Tom ol yal uuj?
Tato icha chi', ¿tom ol tzak'wan eyak'an owal yet' jun nhilanh heb' ko soldado aj Asiria wanto sk'ayi, wach'chom tze komon ak'ejoch heb' aj Egipto yet' skarruaje yipok he k'ool?
Anhejtona', ¿tom tza na' to tzonh komon jawi ko satel jun chonhab' tik tato manhok Jehová ayoch qued'ok? Aton wal ix onh chekankot ul ex ko sateli.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Eliaquim, winhaj Sebna yet' winhaj Joa t'a jun winh yajal soldado chi': --Tzonh tewi t'ayach to ha t'a arameo tzal t'ayonh, yujto skab' arameo chi'. Palta manh ach lolon t'a hebreo chi', yujto syab' masanil anima ayk'e t'a yib'anh smuroal chonhab', xchi heb' winh.

Ix tak'wi winh yajal heb' soldado chi': --Manhoknhej t'ayex yet' t'a winh he reyal b'aj ix in chekjikot yuj winh in reyal yik tzul walan juntzanh lolonel tik. Palta aton wal t'a masanil heb' anima ayk'e t'a yib'anh muro chi' b'aj swala', yujto ol yab' syail heb' eyed'ok, ol he lo he tza', ol eyuk'an he chul tato tz'och owal.
Yuj chi' ix k'e waan winh yajalil heb' soldado chi', te chaanh ix yal winh t'a hebreo: --Ab'ek wal tas syal winh rey te niwan yelk'ochi, aton winh sreyal Asiria:
Manh eyak' he b'a yixtej winhaj Ezequías chi'. ¿Tocwal ol yal ex skolanel winh t'a yol in k'ab'?

Ha winhaj Ezequías chi' snib'ej winh to a Jehová tzeyak'och yipok he k'ool. Syalan winh icha tik: Val yel ol onh skol Jehová ko Diosal. Manh ol ak'jokoch ko chonhab' tik t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Asiria chi' yuj, xchi winh.

Palta manh he cha eyab' tas syal winh chi', xchi winh sreyal Asiria chi'. Yujto a winh rey chi' tzul chekan wal t'ayex tato tzeyak'och he b'ha t'a yol sk'ab' winh t'a ak'ank'olal, ol he lo sat eyawb'en te', icha te' uwa yet' te' higo. Ol eyuk'anpax ha ha' joyb'il eyuuj.

Ol lajwok chi', ol ex yik'anb'at winh t'a jun lum lum lajan icha eyik tik, b'aj ay te' uwa yet' ixim trigo. Ol he b'o he pan yet' he wino. Ay pax akeite yet' te' oliwo yet' nok' yalchab'. Wach' ol aj yek' eyuuj, manh ol ex chamlaj yuj wejel. Palta manh eyak'och t'a he k'ol tas syal winhaj Ezequías chi', yujto tonhej tzex yixtej winh syalan winh: Ha Jehová ol onh kolanok, xchi winh.
Ha juntzanhxo nakión maj koljilaj heb' yuj sdiosal t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Asiria chi'.
¿B'aj ix k'och sdiosal chonhab' Amat yet' chonhab' Arfad? ¿B'ajtil ix k'och sdiosal chonhab' Sefarwaim, Hena yet' Iwa? ¿Tocwal ix kolchaj Samaria t'a yol ko k'ab' a onh Asiria onh tik yuj sdiosal?

¿Mach junok t'a skal juntzanh sdiosal juntzanh nakión chi' ix yal skolanel schonhab' t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Asiria? ¿Tas yuj tze na' to a Jehová ol yal skolanel Jerusalén tik? xchi winh yajal soldado yik Asiria chi'.
Palta tz'innhej xchi masanil heb' anima chi'. Manhxa mach ix tak'wi, yujto a winhaj rey Ezequías ix alani to malaj mach stak'wi.

Yuj chi' ix stzilchitanb'at spichul heb' winh oxwanh chi', yujto ix te tak sk'ol heb' winh yuj tas ix yal winh schekab' winh sreyal Asiria chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at yalan heb' winh t'a winhaj rey Ezequías tas ix alchaj chi'.
Ayic ix yab'an winhaj rey Ezequías tas ix alchaj chi', ix stzilchitanb'at spichul winh. Ix yak'anoch spichul winh yik kusk'olal, ix b'at lesalwok winh t'a yol stemplo Jehová.

Ix schekanb'at winhaj Eliaquim winh, winhaj Sebna yet' pax heb' winh yajal heb' winh sakerdote. Ayoch pichul yik kusk'olal yuj heb' winh. Ix b'at heb' winh yil winh schekab' Dios, aton winhaj Isaías yuninal winhaj Amoz.

Ix b'at yalan heb' winh tas syal winh rey: Ha tiknaik ayonh och t'a yaelal, t'a kusk'olal yet' t'a q'uixwelal. Icha junok ix ix wan sb'o sk'ol yuj unin, manhxa jab'ok yip skani, icha wal chi' kaj tiknaik.

Comonoc wal ix yab' Jehová ko Diosal tas ix yal jun winh schekab' winh sreyal Asiria ayik ix b'uchwaj winh t'a ko Diosal pitzan. Comonoc tz'ak'jioch yaelal t'a yib'anh winh yuj Jehová, yuj tas ix yal chi'. Lesalwanh kuuj mach onh ayonh to ek' tik, xchikot winhaj Ezequías, xchi heb' winh.
Ayic ix yab'an winhaj Isaías tas ix yal heb' winh schekab' winhaj Ezequías chi',

ix schekanxib'at heb' winh winh yal t'a winh rey icha tik: Icha wal tik yalan Jehová: Manh ex xiw yuj tas ix yal jun winh schekab' winh sreyal Asiria chi', te chuk tas ix yal winh t'ayin, max yal-laj in kolwaj yalan winh.
Ha in swala' to ol wak'och jun xiwk'olal t'a winh, yuj chi' ayik ol yab'an junok ab'ix winh, ol meltzaj winh t'a schonhab', ata' ol wak' miljokcham winh, xchi Jehová, xchib'at winhaj Isaías chi'.

Ix yab'an winh sat yajalil heb' soldado yik Asiria to manhxo ayok ek' winh sreyal Asiria chi' t'a chonhab' Laquis. Yuj chi' ix meltzaj winh, ix schalan sb'a winh yet' winh rey chi' t'a chonhab' Libna, wan yak'an owal winh yet' jun chonhab' chi'.
Ata' ix yab' winh rey chi' yalji to a winhaj Tirhaca sreyal Etiopía wan skot yet' heb' soldado ul yak' owal yet' winh. Yuj chi' ix schekxikot schekab' winh t'a winhaj rey Ezequías chi'.
Ix yalankot winh icha tik: Ha a Diosal tz'alan t'ayach to manh ol ak'jokoch Jerusalén t'a yol in k'ab', palta manh ak' musansatil a b'a yuj tas syal a Diosal chi' t'ayach.
Tekan ix ab'i tas ix aj ko satanel juntzanhxo nakión a onh sreyal onh Asiria tik, ¿tom ol yal a kolji yuj a Diosal chi' a naani?
¿Tocwal ix kolji heb' anima yuj sdiosal t'a yol sk'ab' heb' in mam wicham? Aton heb' aj Gozán, heb' aj Harán, heb' aj Resef heb' aj Bet-edén kajan t'a Telasar, ix satjiel heb'.
¿B'ajtil ay winh sreyal chonhab' Hamat, Arpad, Sefarwaim, Hena yet' Iwa? xchikot winh sreyal Asiria chi'.

Ix schaan jun karta winhaj rey Ezequías chi' b'aj tz'ib'ab'il juntzanh lolonel ix alchaj chi'. Ix yilan winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winh t'a stemplo Jehová, ix xuyanel jun karta chi' winh t'a yichanh Jehová chi'.

Ix lesalwi winh icha tik: Mamin Jehová, ach ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, ayach ek' t'a skal snanhal querubín, a achnhej Dios ach t'a yib'anh masanil nakión t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik. Ha ach ix a b'o satcha’anh yet' lum lum tik.
Mamin Jehová, kotanh k'elan t'ayin, tzab'an tas ix yalkot winhaj Senaquerib t'ayin. Ach Dios pitzan, ix te b'uchwaj winh t'ayach.
Val yel tzijtum nakión satnakxoel yuj heb' winh sreyal Asiria chi'.
Ix snhusantz'a sdiosal heb', heb' winh. Yujto a juntzanh chi' manh diosoklaj, nab'a te', nab'a k'een b'ob'il yuj heb' anima, yuj chi' ix yal satanel heb' winh.

Ha tiknaik jun, ach Jehová ko Diosal, kolonhel t'a yol sk'ab' jun winh rey chi', yik syojtaquejel masanil nakión t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik to a achnhej Dios ach, malaj junokxo, xchi winhaj rey Ezequías chi' t'a Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalankot winhaj Isaías chi' t'a winhaj Ezequías chi' icha tik: Ha Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, a tz'alan t'ayach icha tik: Ix wab' a lesal yuj tas syal winhaj Senaquerib sreyal Asiria.

Yuj chi' a in Jehová in tik swal yuj winh sreyal Asiria chi' icha tik: Ach Senaquerib, a heb' ix kob'estak aj chonhab' Sion, malaj elk'och t'a yol sat heb' ix, tonhej ol ach stzetzej heb' ix. Ha heb' aj Jerusalén, ol b'at miknaj heb' ol ach sb'uchan heb'.
¿Mach jun ix a b'uchu' ix a xib'tani? ¿Mach jun b'aj chaanh ix utej a jaj, ix ik'anchaanh a b'a t'ay? Aton t'ayin a in sDiosal in Israel tik to a inxonhej ochi.

Ix a chek yal b'uchwal lolonel heb' winh a chekab' t'ayin Yajal in tik. Ix alan icha tik: Ix in k'e t'a jolomtak witz yet' jantak in karruaje, aton t'a jolomtak witz chaanh t'a yol yik Líbano. Ix in ch'akanel te' k'ute' chaanh steel yet' te' taj manh jantakok swach'il. Ix in k'enhejk'och t'a jolomtak witz chaanh b'aj te k'ayum te te' wach' yilji.
Ha t'a ch'ok chonhab'il ix wak' joychaj ha' uk'b'ila', ata' ix wuk' ha'. Ha ix in ek' t'a yoltak ha ha' t'a Egipto, ix in tek'ankan tup ha', xa chi.

Palta, ¿tom malaj b'aj ix ab'i to a in ton Jehová in? Vuuj tz'elk'och juntzanh tik. Atax t'a peka' ix in na'a to ol a k'ulej juntzanh tik. Ha tiknaik jun, wan yelk'och wuuj, yuj chi' syal a satanel juntzanh nakión te ay yip ix k'ekan b'ulan sk'ajil uuj.

Manhxalaj yip heb' anima kajan t'a juntzanh nakión chi', ix te xiw heb', ix q'uixwi heb'. Lajan ix aj heb' icha anh itaj yaax, mato icha anh ank'ultak sq'uib'k'e t'a yib'anhtak pat, kotakto anh stakjiel anh, icha chi' yaj heb' anima chi'.
Vojtak masanil tas tza k'ulej yet' tas nab'il uuj tzach eq'ui. Vojtakpaxi to te aykot owal t'ayin.

Toxo ix wab'i to aykot owal t'ayin, tzik'anchaanh a b'a. Yuj chi' ol wak'och jun k'een argolla t'a a nhi' yet' jun freno t'a a ti', ol ach wak'an meltzaj t'a b'e b'aj ix ach koti, xchi Jehová t'a winh sreyal Asiria chi', xchi winhaj Isaías chi'.

Ix yalanpax winhaj Isaías t'a winhaj rey Ezequías chi': Ha jun tik yechel ol ch'oxjok eyila' yuj tastak toto ol ujok: Ol he wa ixim trigo munil syawej sb'ha t'a jun ab'il tik yet' t'a junxo ab'il sjawi. Manhok exlaj ol yawej ixim. Axo wal t'a yoxil ab'il jun, a exxo ol eyawej ixim he trigo chi', ol he jochank'e waan. Ol eyawejpax eyuwa, ol he loan sat.
Ha jaywanhokxo ex ol ex kan t'a Judá, lajan ol ex ajkan icha junok te te' sb'at sch'anhal yib' t'a yol lu'um syak'an sat.
Axo t'a Jerusalén, ayto mach ol kan t'ay. Yed' pax t'a tzalan Sion, manh ol satel-laj anima smasanil. Ha jun tik, ol sk'ulej Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil yujto te xajan ex yuj.

Yuj chi' syal Jehová t'a yib'anh winh sreyal Asiria icha tik: Manh ol ochlaj winh t'a yol chonhab' Jerusalén, malaj wal junok sjul-lab' winh ol yak'lej sjulankoti. Manh ol jawoklaj winh yak' owal t'a Jerusalén tik, manh ol sb'ok'elaj stek'nub' winh t'a spatiktak smuroal chonhab' tik.
Ha in Jehová in tik swala' to ha t'a b'e b'aj ix jawi winh, anheja' ta' ol meltzajpax winh. Manh wal jab'ok ol yal yoch winh t'a yol chonhab' tik.
Ha in ol in tanhwej jun chonhab' tik, yujto xajan winh in chekab' aj Dawid wuuj, yuj pax in b'inaji, xchi Jehová, xchi winhaj Isaías chi'.
Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi', ix ek' jun yángel Jehová smilcham 185 mil heb' soldado asirio t'a skampamento heb', yuj chi' chamnakxo heb' ix sakb'i t'a junxo k'u.
Icha chi' ix aj yik'anel skampamento winhaj Senaquerib chi' ta', ix paxkan winh t'a Níniwe.

Ha t'a jun k'u ayik ayoch winh ejmelal t'a sdiosal skuch Nisroc t'a yol stemplo, ix tekjicham winh yuj heb' winh yuninal ta', aton winhaj Adramelec yet' winhaj Sarezer. Ixlajwi chi' ix b'atkan heb' winh elelal t'a yol yik Ararat, haxo junxo yuninal winh skuchan Esarhadón ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.

Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', te ow jun ilya ix och t'a winhaj Ezequías, wanxo scham winh. Axo winhaj Isaías schekab' Dios, yuninal winhaj Amoz ix b'at ilan winh, ix yalan winh t'a winh icha tik: --Toxo ix yal Jehová to tzalkani tas ol ajkan masanil tas ay t'ayach, yujto ol ach chamnhej, manhxo ol ach b'oxok, xchi winh t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix sutmajoch winhaj Ezequías chi' t'a sat pat, ix lesalwi winh t'a Jehová, ix yalan winh:
Mamin Jehová, tzin tewi t'ayach to tzin a nakot yuj tas ix wutej ach wak'an serwil yet' in k'anab'ajan t'ayach t'a wal yel. Ix in k'ulej tas scha a k'ool, xchi winh. Ix ok' wal winh sik'lab'il.
Axo ix aji, ayik manto wal elk'och winhaj Isaías t'a snanhal yamaq'uil spat winh rey chi', ix lolonpax Jehová t'a winh, ix yalani:

Meltzajanh, b'at al t'a winhaj Ezequías yajal in chonhab': Icha tik yalan Jehová ko Diosal, sDiosal pax winh a mam icham aj Dawid: Toxo ix wab' a lesal, ix wil yel yal a sat oq'ui. Ol wak' b'oxok a k'ool, haxo chab'ej syalxo a b'at t'a templo.

Olto wak' 15-okxo ab'il a k 'inal. Ol ach in kolnhej yet' chonhab' Jerusalén tik t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Asiria. Ha in ol in tanhwej chonhab' tik, yuj sniwanil welk'ochi, yuj pax in ti' wak'nak t'a winh in chekab' aj Dawid, xchi Jehová, xchi winhaj Isaías chi'.
Ix schekan winhaj Isaías b'ojok sat te' higo, ix ak'chajoch t'a sat jun yab'il chi', ix b'oxikan sk'ool winh yuj.

Ayic manto b'o jun remeyo chi', ix sk'anb'an winhaj Ezequías chi' t'a winhaj Isaías chi' icha tik: --¿Tas junok yechel ol wila'' yik ol nachajel wuuj to a Jehová ol ak'an b'oxok in k'ool, yik syal in b'at t'a stemplo t'a chab'ej chi'? xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Isaías chi': --Ay jun yechel ol sch'ox Jehová t'ayach yik wach' ol nachajel uuj to ol elk'och tas ix yala'. Ha ach tzala' tato sb'ab'laj wewen t'a lajunhe' b'akhquiltak t'a jun tz'ilan jantak yek' k'u, mato schael yich yemxi jun wewen chi' t'a spatik lajunheok b'akhquiltak chi', xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Ezequías chi' t'a winh: --Ayic sb'at wewen chi' t'a yichanh, sekojtak, palta tato schaxiel yemxi lajunheok b'akhquiltak t'a spatik, a jun chi' ajaltak, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix tewi winhaj Isaías chi' t'a Jehová, haxo Jehová chi' ix ak'anxi yik tz'elxi yich yemxita wewen chi' t'a lajunh b'akhquiltak chi' t'a jun tz'ilan jantak yek' k'u yik winhaj Acaz.

Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', a winh sreyal Babilonia, aton winhaj Merodak-baladán yuninal winhaj Baladán, ix yab' winh to penaayaxnak winhaj Ezequías, yuj chi' ix schekkot heb' winh schekab' winh yik tzul yak'ankan jun karta heb' winh yet' junok silab' t'a winhaj Ezequías chi'.

Ix chaji heb' winh chekab' chi' yuj winhaj Ezequías chi'. Masanil tas sik'an yuj winh, ix sch'ox winh t'a heb' winh: Aton k'een plata, k'een oro, perfume yet' akeite te wach' yet' pax b'aj molanek' yamk'ab' yik owal yet' jantak tas molan yuj winh. Manhxa junokxo tas ay t'a spalakio winh yet' t'a yol smakb'en to maj sch'oxlaj t'a heb' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj Isaías schekab' Dios t'a winhaj Ezequías chi', ix sk'anb'an winh t'a winh icha tik: --¿B'ajtil ix kot juntzanh heb' winh winak chi'? ¿Tas xchi heb' winh t'ayach? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Ezequías chi' t'a winh: --Ix kot heb' winh t'a jun nakión te najat, t'a Babilonia, xchi winh.

Ix sk'anb'anxi winhaj Isaías chi': --¿Tas ix yil heb' winh t'a yol a palakio tik? xchi winh. Ix tak'wixi winhaj Ezequías chi': --Masanil tas ix yil heb' winh, manhxa jab'ok tas ayek' tik maj yil heb' winh, masanil ix in ch'ox t'a heb' winh, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Isaías chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Ab' tas syal Jehová t'ayach:
Ol k'och wal sk'ual, masanil tas ay t'a a palakio yet' masanil tas ix smolb'ejkan heb' a mam icham, ol ik'chajb'at smasanil t'a Babilonia, manhxa jab'ok tas ol kanok.
Yed' pax heb' inhtilal, ol ik'chajb'at heb' t'a Babilonia chi', ol ik'chajel snholob' sk'een heb', ol ak'chajoch heb' yak'umalok serwil winh sreyal Babilonia chi', xchi Jehová, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj rey Ezequías chi' t'a winhaj Isaías chi': --Ha jun lolonel ix al t'ayin yuj Jehová tik te wach', xchi winh. Ix yal winhaj Ezequías chi' icha chi', yujto ix sna' winh to ay junk'olal yakb'an pitzanto winh.

Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Ezequías yet' tas niwan yelk'och ix sk'ulej winh, aton tas ix aj sb'oan jun nhajab' winh yet' tas ix aj yik'ankot ha ha' winh t'a yol chonhab', tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá.
Axo yik ix cham winh, a winhaj Manasés yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ha winhaj Manasés chi', 12 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix schaanel yich winh yak'an reyal, 55 ab'il ix yak' reyal chi' winh t'a Jerusalén. Hepsiba sb'i ix snun winh.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha masanil chukal sb'eyb'alej juntzanh nakión ix yik'el Jehová t'a yichanh heb' israel, a ix sb'eyb'alej winh.

Ix schekan winh to sb'ojixik'e juntzanh lugar chaanh b'aj tz'och ejmelal, juntzanh ix schek winhaj Ezequías mak'jipojok. Ix sb'oanxik'e altar yik Baal winh, ix sb'oanpaxk'e jun yechel Asera winh, icha sk'ulejnak winhaj Acab sreyal Israel. Ix och winh ejmelal t'a k'een k'anal.
Ix sb'oanpaxk'e juntzanh altar winh t'a yol stemplo Jehová, aton t'a jun lugar yalnak Jehová icha tik: Ha t'a jun templo t'a Jerusalén ol och ejmelal t'ayin, xchi.
Ay juntzanhxo altar ix sb'ok'e winh t'a chab' yamaq'uil stemplo Jehová, yik tz'och winh ejmelal t'a juntzanh k'een k'anal.

Anhejtona' ix snhusanpaxtz'a yuninal winh silab'il t'a junok sdiosal chi'. Ix sk'anb'an sb'a winh t'a heb' ajb'aal, t'a heb' ajchum, t'a heb' naumel lolonel. Ix sk'anb'anpax sb'a winh t'a heb' tz'awtan spixan heb' chamnak. Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh, yuj chi' ix stzuntzejkot yowal sk'ool Jehová winh t'a yib'anh.

Ix yak'paxoch jun te' yechel Asera winh t'a yol stemplo Jehová, aton jun templo chi' yalnakkan Jehová t'a winhaj Dawid yet' t'a winh yuninal aton winhaj Salomón icha tik: Ha t'a in templo t'a Jerusalén, jun chonhab' ix in sik'kanel t'a skal masanil chonhab' t'a yol smakb'en Israel tik, a t'ay ol in kajnaj t'a junelnhej.

Tato ol sk'anab'ajej masanil in cheknab'il heb' eyetchonhab' yet' in kachnab'il yet' pax in k'ayb'ub'al in cheknak yal winh in chekab' aj Moisés t'a heb', manhxo ol wik'el heb' t'a sat jun lum lum wak'nak t'a he mam eyicham, xchi Jehová.

Palta maj scha yab' juntzanh chi' heb'. Ha wal winh rey chi' ix kuchb'an heb' t'a chukal chi'. Ek'b'al chukal ix sk'ulej heb' t'a yichanh juntzanh nakión satb'ilel yuj Jehová t'a yichanh heb' smam yicham heb' t'a peka'.
Yuj chi' ix yal Jehová t'a heb' schekab':

Ha winhaj Manasés chi', a tas te yajb'entak sk'ulej winh t'a wichanh, yelxo wal ek'b'al chukal sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh heb' amorreo, heb' ek'nak t'a yalanhtaxo. Skuchb'an heb' yetchonhab' winh t'a chukal yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a juntzanh yechel.
Yuj chi' a in Jehová sDiosal Israel swal icha tik: Ol wik'kot yaelal t'a yib'anh Jerusalén yet' t'a yib'anh Judá tik, ol te sat sk'ol heb' ol ab'anok.

Ol wak'och yaelal t'a yib'anh Jerusalén tik icha ix wutej Samaria yet' heb' yinhtilal winhaj Acab. Ol wik'el masanil heb' anima kajan t'ay, lajan ol ajkan icha junok uk'ab' ayik slajwi sb'ikchaji nhojan tz'ajkani.
Axo jaywanhokxo heb' in chonhab' tik, ol waktejkan heb', ol wak'kanoch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ool, yik wach' ol ik'chajek' masanil tastak ay t'a heb'.
Yictax wik'annaquelta heb' smam yicham heb' t'a Egipto, stzuntzejnhejkot yowal in k'ool heb' yuj chukal sk'ulej heb' t'a wichanh, xchi t'a heb' schekab'.
Ix te kuchb'aj wal heb' aj Judá yuj winhaj Manasés chi' t'a chukal t'a yichanh Jehová. Tzijtum pax heb' anima malaj smul ix smilcham winh, ix laj b'ey schiq'uil heb' smasanil t'a smakb'en Jerusalén.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Manasés chi' yet' tastak ix sk'ulej winh yet' jantak smul winh ix ochi, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá.
Ayic ix cham winh, ha t'a skaltak te' awb'en te' yik winhaj Uza t'a sti' spalakio winh ix mukchaji. Axo winhaj Amón yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ha winhaj Amón chi', 22 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal t'a Judá. Chab' ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Mesulemet sb'i ix snun winh, yisil ix winhaj Haruz aj Jotba.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová icha sk'ulejnak winhaj Manasés smam winh.
Ha sb'eyb'al winh smam winh chi' ix sb'eyb'alej, ix och winh ejmelal t'a juntzanh yechel b'aj ochnak winh smam winh chi' ejmelal.
Icha chi' ix aj spatikanel Jehová Dios winh, aton sDiosal heb' smam yicham winh. Maj sk'anab'ajejlaj scheknab'il Jehová winh.
Ha heb' winh ayoch yajalil yet' winh, ix meltzajoch heb' winh ajk'olal t'a winh, ix miljicham winh yuj heb' winh t'a yol spalakio.

Yuj chi', haxo heb' aj Judá ix milancham heb' winh ix milancham winh rey chi', haxo winhaj Josías yuninal winh ix yak'och heb' reyal sk'exulok. Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Amón yet' tastak ix sk'ulej, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá. Ayic ix cham winh, ha t'a skaltak te' awb'en te' yik winhaj Uza ix mukji winh.
Ha winhaj Josías wajxaque' ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal. 31 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Jedida sb'i ix snun winh, yisil ix winhaj Adaías aj Boscat.
Te wach' ix yutej sb'a winh t'a yichanh Jehová, icha wal sb'eyb'al winhaj Dawid smam yicham winh, manh wal jab'ok ix yik'el sb'a winh t'a sb'eyb'al winh smam yicham chi'.

Ayic 18 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Josías chi' reyal, ix schekanb'at winh stz'ib'um winh t'a stemplo Jehová, aton winhaj Safán yuninal winhaj Azalías yixchiquin winhaj Mesulam. Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winh icha tik:
--Ixic t'a winhaj Hilcías winh sat sakerdote, tzalan t'a winh to smolb'ej k'een tumin winh tz'ak'ji t'a stemplo Jehová, k'een scha heb' stanhwan puerta b'aj tz'och heb' anima,
syak'an k'een winh t'a heb' winh yajal yaj yilan sb'ochajxi templo chi' yik stupchaj heb' winh smunlaj t'ay,
aton heb' winh nhikum te' yet' heb' winh tz'ilan tas tz'aj sb'o munlajel chi' yet' heb' winh albañil. Smanchajpax te te' yet' k'een k'een tzeyb'il, yik sb'ochajxi templo chi'.
Manh yowalilok sk'anchaj yumal k'een tumin chi' t'a heb' winh tz'ilan munlajel chi', yujto tz'akan syutej heb' winh sb'oani, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Hilcías chi' t'a winhaj Safán to ix cheklaj b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkan ley t'a yol stemplo Jehová. Ix yak'an ch'anh winh t'a winhaj Safán chi', ix yawtan ch'anh winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj Safán chi' yal t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: --Toxo ix smol k'een tumin ay t'a yol templo heb' winh a chekab', ix yak'an k'een heb' winh t'a heb' winh ayoch yajalil yilan sb'ochajxi stemplo Jehová chi', xchi winh.
Anhejtona' ix yalanxi winh to ix ak'ji jun ch'anh uum t'a winh yuj winhaj sakerdote Hilcías, yuj chi' ix yawtej ch'anh winh yab' winh rey chi'.
Ayic ix yab'an winh rey chi' tas syal t'a yol ch'anh, ix snhik'chitan spichul winh,

ix schekan winh awtaj winhaj Hilcías chi', winhaj Safán tz'ib'um yet' winhaj Ahicam yuninal winhaj Safán chi', winhaj Acbor yuninal winhaj Micaías yet' winhaj Asaías schekab' winh rey chi'. Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a heb' winh icha tik:

--Ixiquec he k'anb'ej t'a Jehová wuuj, yuj heb' chonhab', yuj pax masanil heb' aj Judá, tas syalelk'och ch'anh ley tik. Ay am kot yowal sk'ol Jehová chi' t'a quib'anh, yujto maj sk'anab'ajej heb' ko mam quicham tas syal ch'anh, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj sakerdote Hilcías, winhaj Ahicam, winhaj Acbor, winhaj Safán yet' winhaj Asaías yil ix schekab' Dios, ix skuchan Hulda yetb'eyum winhaj Salum yuninal winhaj Ticwa, yixchiquin winhaj Harhas. Ha winhaj Salum chi', a winh stanhwan b'aj sik'chaj k'apak pichul t'a templo. Ha ix Hulda chi', ha t'a junxo makan yik Jerusalén toto b'onak, ata' kajan ix. Ayic ix lolonb'at heb' winh t'a ix,
ix tak'wi ix t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Ha Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, a tz'alan icha tik: Alec t'a winh ix ex chekankot he k'anb'ej tik t'ayin
to a in ol wak'kot junok yaelal t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik yet' t'a yib'anh heb' kajan t'a tik, icha yalan ch'anh ley ix yawtej winh sreyal Judá chi'.

Yujto ix in yaktejkan heb' anima tik, ix snhusan inkienso heb' t'a juntzanh komon Dios, ix stzuntzankot yowal in k'ol heb' yuj juntzanh sdiosal heb' ix sb'o chi'. Yuj wal chi' ix kot wowal t'a jun lugar tik. Manhxo ol sikb'ilaj wowal chi', xchi Jehová.
Alec t'a winh rey chi', winh ix ex chekankot he k'anb'ej t'a Jehová: Ha Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik tz'alan icha tik: Yujto ix awtej tas ayem t'a yol ch'anh uum chi',

ix ak'anoch t'a a k'ool, yuj chi' ix al a b'a t'ayin, ix a nhik'chitanb'at a pichul, ix ach ok'k'e t'a wichanh. Yujto ix ab'pax tas ix wala' to ol satjoquel a chonhab' tik, ol in katab'an heb' kajan t'ay, yuj chi' toxo ix wab' tas ix ala'. Swal t'ayach

to ix ach wak' niwank'olal, ol ach mukjok t'a junk'olal. Manhxo ol il-laj jun yaelal ol wak'kot t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik, xchi Jehová, xchi ix Hulda chi'. Ix paxta heb' winh schekab' winh rey chi' yik tzul yalan heb' winh t'a winh tas ix b'at yab' heb' winh chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh rey chi' to tz'awtaj masanil heb' winh yichamtak winaquil Jerusalén yet' juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá, yik wach' smolb'ej sb'a heb' winh yet' winh.

Ayic ix jawi heb' winh, ix b'at winh yet' heb' winh, heb' winh sakerdote, heb' winh schekab' Dios yet' masanil heb' komon anima, heb' malaj wal yelk'ochi yet' heb' niwak yelk'ochi. Ix b'at heb' smasanil t'a stemplo Jehová. Ata' ix yal winh rey chi' to a ch'anh yumal strato Jehová ix chax t'a stemplo, tz'awtaj ch'anh t'a yichanh heb' anima chi'.
