Ix och tek'tek' winh rey chi' t'a stz'ey jun niwan oy, ix yak'an sti' winh t'a yichanh Jehová to ol sk'anab'ajej juntzanh cheknab'il winh yet' k'ayb'ub'al t'a smasanil sk'ool, icha syal jun trato tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a yol ch'anh uum chi'. Anheja' masanil heb' anima chi', ix yak' sti' heb' sk'anab'ajani.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winh sat sakerdote aj Hilcías yet' t'a juntzanhxo heb' winh sakerdote yet' t'a heb' winh stanhwan spuertail templo to syik'elta heb' winh masanil tastak ay t'a yol stemplo Jehová, aton yamk'ab' sk'an heb' anima yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a Baal, t'a Asera yet' t'a k'een k'anal. Ix yik'el heb' winh t'a stiel chonhab' Jerusalén, ix snhusantz'a heb' winh t'a sti' ha' Cedrón, ix lajwi chi' ix ik'jib'at staanhil t'a Betel.

Ix yik'anel yopisio heb' winh sakerdote winh rey chi', aton heb' winh snhusantz'a inkienso b'aj chaanh t'a yol yik Judá yet' t'a stitak chonhab' Jerusalén, aton heb' winh ak'b'il yopisio yuj heb' winh rey ek'nak. Ix ik'chajpaxel heb' winh sakerdote snhusantz'a inkienso t'a Baal, t'a k'u, t'a k'een uj, t'a k'een k'anal yet' t'a juntzanh niwak k'anal sb'eyek' t'a satcha’anh.

Ix yik'anpaxel jun yechel Asera winh rey chi', aton jun ayoch t'a yol stemplo Jehová. Ix b'at yak'ankan heb' t'a stiel chonhab' Jerusalén. Ix nhuschajtz'ha t'a sti' ha' Cedrón, ix stenanchojok stanhil chi' winh, ix stzikanb'at winh t'a yib'anh b'aj mukan heb' komon anima.
Ix pojjipaxem juntzanh yet'tal heb' winh ix-winak yuj winh, aton b'ob'il t'a yamaq'uil stemplo Jehová. Ata' sch'alwipax heb' ix ix sb'oan k'apak mantiado yik Asera.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yawtankot masanil heb' winh sakerdote winh rey chi', aton heb' winh ay t'a junjun chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá, ix yixtanb'at masanil altar winh t'a masanil lugar chaanh t'a Geba masanto t'a Beerseba, aton b'aj snhustz'a inkienso juntzanh heb' winh sakerdote. Ix spojanpaxem juntzanh altar winh, juntzanh ay t'a spuertail chonhab' skan t'a stojolal sk'exan mach tz'och t'a yol chonhab' chi', aton jun puerta yik winhaj Josué yajal t'a Jerusalén.

Ha heb' winh sakerdote yinhtilal Leví ix ak'an silab' t'a juntzanh lugar chaanh, majxo k'ochlaj heb' winh t'a altar yik Jehová t'a Jerusalén, axonhej swael heb' winh tz'ak'ji yuj heb' winh yetsakerdoteal chi'.

Ix yixtanpaxb'at jun lugar winh rey chi', jun skuchan Tofet t'a sch'olanil Ben-hinom b'aj snhusjitz'a heb' unin silab'il t'a jun komon Dios skuchan Moloc, yik manhxa junok mach sk'ulan jun chukal chi'.

Ix yik'anpaxel nok' chej winh, nok' ayoch yuj heb' winh sreyal Judá yik tz'och ejmelal t'a k'u. Ix snhusantz'a skarruaje nok' chej chi' winh. Ha juntzanh chi', ha t'a jun amak' t'a slak'anil b'aj tz'och anima t'a yol stemplo Jehová, ata' ay, t'a stz'ey skuarto jun winh ay yopisio skuchan Natán-melek.

Ix spojanpaxem juntzanh altar winh rey chi', juntzanh b'ob'ilkan yuj heb' winh sreyal Judá t'a spanhanil yib'anh skuartokan winhaj rey Acaz. Ay pax juntzanh altar b'ob'ilkan yuj winhaj rey Manasés t'a chab' yamaq'uil stemplo Jehová, ix smak'poj winh, ix syumankanb'at sk'ajil winh t'a yol ha' Cedrón.

Ix yixtanpaxb'at juntzanh lugar winh, juntzanh chaanh t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a Jerusalén, t'a stojolal sur t'a tzalan Oliwo, aton jun sb'onakkan winhaj Salomón sreyal Israel, aton Astarté sdiosal heb' aj Sidón, Quemos sdiosal heb' moabita yet' Milcom sdiosal heb' amonita. Masanil juntzanh chi' yajb'ilel yuj Jehová.
Ix smak'anpaxpoj k'een k'een winh, k'een chajul yaj t'a heb' anima, ix ch'akchajpaxel te' yechel Asera. Ix saklemajb'at sb'aquil chamnak ta' yuj winh.

Ix smak'paxpoj jun altar winh yet' templo t'a Betel, aton sb'onakkan winhaj rey Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat, winh kuchb'annakb'at heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal. Pococxonhej ix aji, ix snhusantz'a yechel Dios Asera chi' winh.

Ix ek' k'elelok winhaj Josías chi', ix yilanb'at juntzanh yet'tal chamnak winh t'a jun tzalan, ix yalan winh to tz'ik'chajelta sb'aquil chamnak ayoch t'a yool chi', ix snhusantz'a winh t'a yib'anh altar yik tz'ixtaxb'ati. Icha chi' ix aj yelk'och tas yalnakkan jun winh schekab' Jehová t'a peka'.

Ix sk'anb'an winhaj rey Josías chi': --¿Mach ay yik jun yet'tal chamnak swilb'at chi'? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi heb' kajan t'a Betel chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Aton b'aj mukan jun winh schekab' Dios kotnak t'a Judá, a winh aljinakkan yuj tas ix utej jun altar t'a Betel tik, xchi heb' t'a winh.
Ix yalan winh: --Actejeckani, malaj junok mach syaman sb'aquil chi', xchi winh. Yuj chi' majxo yamjilaj sb'aquil jun winh schekab' Dios chi' yet' sb'aquil junxo winh schekab' Dios kotnak t'a Samaria.

Icha ix yutej winhaj Josías chi' t'a Betel chi', icha pax chi' ix yutej winh satanel juntzanh lugar chaanh, juntzanh b'ob'il t'a Samaria chi' yuj heb' winh sreyal Israel, juntzanh stzuntzankot yowal sk'ol Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi', haxo t'a yib'anh juntzanh altar ix smilcham masanil heb' winh sakerdote winh, aton heb' winh yik juntzanh lugar chaanh t'a Samaria chi'. Ix snhusantz'a sb'aquil juntzanh chamnak winh t'a yib'anh juntzanh altar chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix paxta winh t'a Jerusalén.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Josías t'a masanil heb' chonhab' icha tik: Kak'ekoch q'uinh yik sko naankot tas aj yelnakkot heb' ko mam quicham t'a Egipto yik squik'anchaanh sb'i Jehová ko Diosal, icha syalkan t'a yumal trato, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix och jun q'uinh chi'. Yictax ix lajwiek' stiempoal heb' juez, heb' ix ak'an yajalil t'a chonhab' Israel, malaj junelok ix och jun q'uinh icha jun chi' t'a stiempoal heb' winh ix ak'an reyal t'a Judá yet' t'a Israel.
Yic wal 18 ab'il yoch winhaj Josías chi' reyal ix och jun q'uinh chi' t'a Jerusalén, yuj yik'jichaanh Jehová.

Masanil heb' tz'awtan spixan heb' chamnak, heb' ajb'aal yet' juntzanh yechel t'a yoltak pat, ix satjiel yuj winhaj Josías chi'. Masanil pax juntzanh komon Dios yajb'entak ay t'a Jerusalén yet' t'a yol smakb'en Judá ix satel winh. Icha chi' ix sk'ulej winh yik sk'anab'ajan winh tas syalkan t'a yumal ley ix chax yuj winhaj sakerdote Hilcías t'a yol stemplo Jehová.

Malaj junokxo rey ek'nakxo ix sk'ex spensar yik syak'anoch sb'ha t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová t'a smasanil sk'ool, t'a smasanil spensar yet' t'a smasanil yip, icha ix yutej sb'a winhaj Josías chi', yujto ix sk'anab'ajej winh tas alb'ilkan t'a ley Moisés. Manhxalaj pax junokxo rey icha chi' ix yutej sb'a.
Wach'chom icha chi' ix sk'ulej winh, palta yuj tas te chuk sk'ulejnak winhaj Manasés, yuj chi' aykot yowal sk'ol Jehová t'a Judá chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yal Jehová icha tik: Ol wik'el Judá t'a wichanh, icha wutejnak Israel. Ol in patiquejkanel Jerusalén, jun chonhab' sik'b'ilel wuuj yet' jun templo tik, jun walnak yuj to a t'ay tz'och ejmelal t'ayin, xchi.

Ha t'a stiempoal chi' ix kot winhaj Necao sreyal Egipto yet' heb' soldado yik sb'at heb' t'ha ha' niwan Éufrates, yik sb'at kolwaj winh yet' winh sreyal Asiria. Ix b'at winhaj rey Josías yet' heb' soldado yak' owal yet' winhaj Necao chi' t'a Meguido. Ayic ix schalan sb'a heb' winh t'a owal chi', ix miljicham winhaj Josías chi' yuj winh. Ix ak'jik'e sniwanil winh t'a yol karruaje yuj heb' winh ayoch yajalil yet' winh. Ix kot heb' winh t'a Meguido chi' masanto ix jawi heb' winh t'a Jerusalén, ix ak'jikanoch sniwanil winh chi' t'a jun yet'tal b'ob'ilxo. Axo heb' anima smasanil t'a yol chonhab' chi' ix ak'anoch winhaj Joacaz yuninal winh reyal sk'exulok. Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Josías chi' yet' tastak ix sk'ulej winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá.
Ha winhaj Joacaz chi', 23 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal t'a Jerusalén. Oxenhej ujal ix yak' reyal chi' winh. Hamutal sb'i ix snun winh, yisil ix winhaj Jeremías aj Libna.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, icha ix sk'ulej heb' smam yicham winh.

Ix ak'jioch winh t'a preso yuj winhaj rey Necao t'a Ribla t'a yol yik Hamat, yik wach' maxtzak yak' yajalil winh t'a Jerusalén. Ix yak'anoch k'een tumin winhaj Necao chi' t'a yib'anh heb' aj Judá chi', 75 quintal k'een plata yet' oxe' arroba k'een oro.

Axo winhaj Eliaquim yuninal winhaj Josías chi' ix yak'och winhaj rey Necao chi' reyal sk'exulok winh smam chi'. Ix sk'exan sb'i winhaj Eliaquim chi' winh, Joacim ix sb'iej winh. Ix yik'anb'at winhaj Joacaz chi' winh t'a Egipto. Ata' ix cham winhaj Joacaz chi'.

Ix yak'an k'een oro winhaj Joacim chi' yet' k'een plata sk'an winh sreyal Egipto chi'. Yuj chi' ix yak'och k'een winh t'a yib'anh heb' anima t'a yol smakb'en chi', junjun anima ix yak' k'een oro yet' k'een plata, icha tastak ay t'a junjun heb'. Icha chi' ix aj smolan k'een tumin winh ix kan t'a yib'anh chi'.
Ha winhaj Joacim chi', 25 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal, 11 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Zebu sb'i ix snun winh, yisil ix winhaj Pedaías aj Ruma.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, icha wal ix sk'ulej heb' smam yicham winh.

Ha t'a stiempoal winhaj Joacim chi', ix kot winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia yet' heb' soldado yak' owal yet' winh. Icha chi' ix aj yochkan winhaj rey Joacim oxe' ab'il t'a yalanh smandar winhaj Nabucodonosor chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzajoch winhaj Joacim chi' ajk'olal t'a winh sreyal Babilonia chi'.

Palta ix ak'jikot heb' soldado kaldeo yuj Jehová, heb' soldado sirio, heb' soldado moabita yet' heb' soldado amonita yik sjawi heb' elk'al t'a Judá yik syixtanb'at heb', icha ix aj yalan heb' schekab' Jehová.
Val yel ix jawi jun tik t'a yib'anh Judá, yujto a Jehová ix alani yik syik'anel Judá t'a yichanh, yuj smul winhaj Manasés,
yuj pax schamel heb' anima malaj smul t'a Jerusalén ix cham yuj winh. Yuj chi' majxo yak'laj niwank'olal Jehová.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Joacim chi' yet' tastak ix sk'ulej winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá.
Axo yik ix cham winh, a winhaj Joaquín yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Majxo eltalaj winh sreyal Egipto yet' heb' soldado t'a yol smakb'en, yujto a winh sreyal Babilonia ix ik'anxiek' tas ik'b'ilek' yuj winh, skot t'ha ha' eluma' yik Egipto masanto t'ha ha' Éufrates.
Ha winhaj Joaquín chi', 18 ab'ilxo sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal, oxenhej ujal ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Nehusta sb'i ix snun winh, yisil ix winhaj Elnatán aj Jerusalén.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, icha wal ix sk'ulej winh smam winh.
Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', ix kot heb' soldado winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia yak' owal t'a Jerusalén, ix oymaj heb' t'a spatik.
Van yak'an owal heb', ix k'och winhaj Nabucodonosor chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yak'och sb'a winhaj Joaquín sreyal Judá yet' ix snun, heb' winh yetyajalil winh yet' pax heb' winh schekab' winh t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Nabucodonosor chi'. Ix ik'jib'at heb' t'a Babilonia ayik swajxaquilxo ab'il yoch winhaj Nabucodonosor chi' reyal.

Ixlajwi chi', ix schekan winhaj Nabucodonosor chi' ik'chajelta masanil k'een tumin ay t'a yol stemplo Jehová yet' t'a yol spalakio winh sreyal Judá chi'. Ix smak'anpoj masanil yamk'ab' winh nab'a oro yik templo chi' b'ob'ilkan yuj winhaj Salomón sreyal Israel. Ix elk'och jun tik icha ajnak yalankan Jehová.

Ix schekan winh ik'chajb'at masanil anima kajan t'a Jerusalén chi' yet' heb' yajal, heb' soldado te jelan, heb' winh jelan sb'oan tastak yet' heb' winh tenum k'een. 10 mil heb' ix ik'jib'at t'a Babilonia chi' t'a smasanil. Manhxa mach ix kani, axonhej heb' meb'a' ixto kani.

Ha winhaj rey Joaquín chi', ix snun winh, heb' ix yetb'eyum winh, heb' ayoch yajalil yet' winh yet' heb' anima niwak yelk'och t'a yol smakb'en winh chi', ix ik'jib'at heb' yuj winhaj Nabucodonosor chi' t'a Babilonia.

Ha t'a skal masanil anima ix ik'chajb'at chi', ay 7 mil heb' winh soldado, ay pax mil heb' winh syal sb'oan tastak yet' heb' winh tenum k'een. Masanil heb' winh tik te tek'an heb' winh, te jelan pax heb' winh t'a owal.
Axo winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi' ix ak'anoch winhaj Matanías yuk'tak smam winhaj Joaquín chi' reyal sk'exulok winh. Ix k'exji sb'i winh yuj winh, Sedequías ix sb'iejkan winh.
Ha winhaj Sedequías chi', 21 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal, 11 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Hamutal sb'i ix snun winh, yisil ix winhaj Jeremías aj Libna.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, icha ix sk'ulej winhaj Joacim.
Yuj chi' ix kot yowal sk'ol Jehová t'a Jerusalén yet' t'a Judá, ix yik'ankanel heb' t'a yichanh. Ix meltzajoch winhaj Sedequías ajk'olal t'a winh sreyal Babilonia.

Ayic slajunhil k'ual yoch slajunhil uj, ayik sb'alunhil ab'il yoch winhaj Sedequías reyal, ix jawi winhaj rey Nabucodonosor yet' heb' winh soldado yak' owal t'a Jerusalén. Ix oymaj heb' winh t'a spatiktak Jerusalén chi', ix sb'oank'e skampamento heb' winh t'a spatiktak, ix sb'oank'e stek'nub' heb' winh t'a spatiktak smuroal.
Oyb'ilnhej jun chonhab' chi' yuj heb' winh, masanto ayik 11 ab'il yoch winhaj Sedequías chi' reyal.
Ayic sb'alunhil k'ual yoch schanhil uj t'a yol jun ab'il chi', ix em jun niwan wejel t'a yol chonhab' chi', manhxa jab'ok tas wach' swaan heb' anima chi'.

Ix sb'oan jun olan heb' winh soldado kaldeo chi' t'a smuroal chonhab' chi'. Wach'chom oyanoch heb' winh soldado t'a spatiktak chi', palta ix el winhaj rey Sedequías chi' yet' heb' winh soldado t'ak'walil. Ix elk'och heb' winh t'a jun puerta t'a skal chab' muro t'a stz'ey b'aj ay yawb'en te' heb' winh rey, ix b'at heb' winh t'a jun b'e sk'och t'a sch'olanil ha' Jordán.
Palta ix b'at heb' winh soldado kaldeo chi' t'a spatik heb' winh, ix yamchaj winhaj Sedequías chi' yuj heb' winh t'a yak'likal Jericó. Ix saklemkanb'at heb' winh soldado winh.
Ix syaman winh rey chi' heb' winh, ix yik'anb'at winh heb' winh t'a winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia chi' t'a Ribla, t'a yol yik Hamat. Ata' ix yal winh tas ol utaj winhaj Sedequías chi'.
D'a wal yichanh winhaj Sedequías chi' ix xikjicham heb' yuninal. Ix ik'chajk'eta yol sat winh, ix tzek'chaj winh t'a k'een kadena nab'a bronke, ix ik'chajb'at winh t'a Babilonia.

Ayic uque' k'ualxo yoch yoil uj t'a 19 ab'il yoch winhaj Nabucodonosor reyal t'a Babilonia, ix jawi winhaj Nabuzaradán yajalil heb' winh soldado stanhwumal winh rey chi' yet' heb' winh soldado t'a Jerusalén.
Ix snhusantz'a stemplo Jehová heb' winh yet' spalakio winh rey, masanil spat heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén chi' yet' masanil niwak pat.
Ix spojanem masanil smuroal chonhab' Jerusalén chi' heb' winh.
Masanil heb' anima ayto kani, ix yik'b'at heb' winhaj Nabuzaradán chi', aton heb' ix yak'och sb'a yet' winh sreyal Babilonia yet' heb' jelan sb'oan tastak.
Axonhej heb' te meb'a' ix yaktejkan winh, yik smunlaj heb' t'a awoj uwa yet' juntzanhxo tas tz'awchaji.

Masanil tastak nab'a bronke ay t'a yol templo ix smak'poj heb' winh soldado chi', aton chab' oy ayoch t'a sat templo chi', juntzanh sb'akhnub' yich kotak pila yet' jun niwan pila. Ix yik'anb'at k'een bronke chi' heb' winh t'a Babilonia.

Anhejtona' b'aj tz'em k'een tik'aq'uil taanh, k'een pala, k'een ik'lab'el stanhil b'aj tz'och sk'ak'al kandil, k'een niwak kuchara yet' masanil tastak nab'a bronke sk'anchaji ayik tz'och ejmelal t'a Jehová, ix yik'b'at heb' winh smasanil.
Ix yik'paxb'at juntzanh niwak waso heb' winh yet' k'een b'aj snhusji inkienso yet' juntzanhxo tastak nab'a oro ma nab'a plata.

Manhxa yalb'anil jantak yalil k'een bronke ayoch t'a chab' niwak oy yik templo, t'a jun pila yik ha ha' yet' t'a juntzanh yich b'akhnub' b'ob'ilkan yuj winhaj rey Salomón yik tz'ochkan t'a stemplo Jehová.

Ha junjun oy chi', ek'b'al wajxaque' metro steel. Ha sjolom oy chi' nab'a bronke, nanhal schab'il metro yaj k'ei, haxo spatiktak sjolom oy chi', aypaxoch yelwanub' icha yilji te' granada. Ha juntzanh chi' nab'a bronke. Lajannhej yaj chab' oy chi'.
Ha winhaj Nabuzaradán chi' ix yaman winhaj Seraías sat sakerdote, winhaj Sofonías schab'il sakerdote yet' oxwanh heb' winh stanhwan sti' templo, ix ik'jib'at heb' winh yuj winh t'a Babilonia.

Ha t'a skal heb' anima ix kan t'a yol chonhab' chi', ix yamchajpax jun winh sat yajal skuchb'an heb' winh soldado yet' pax owanhxo heb' winh tz'ak'an srazón winh rey yet' jun winh tz'ib'um sb'oan slistail heb' winh soldado yet' pax 60-xo heb' winh niwak winak yaj t'a yol chonhab' chi'.

Masanil juntzanh heb' anima chi' ix yik'b'at winhaj Nabuzaradán chi' t'a Ribla t'a yol yik Hamat. Ata' ix yal winh rey to scham heb'. Icha chi' ix aj yik'jiel heb' aj Judá chi' t'a schonhab' yet' t'a sluum, ix ik'jib'at heb' t'a Babilonia.
Ix och winhaj Gedalías yuninal winhaj Ahicam yixchiquin winhaj Safán gobernadoral yuj winh sreyal Babilonia chi'. Ha winh ix kan yil jantakto anima ix kan t'a Judá chi'.

Ayic ix yab'an jun lolonel chi' heb' winh yajal heb' winh soldado ixto kani, ix b'at heb' winh t'a Mizpa yet' heb' winh soldado chi', yik b'at lolon heb' winh yet' winhaj Gedalías chi'. Ha heb' winh chi', aton winhaj Ismael yuninal winhaj Netanías, winhaj Johanán yuninal winhaj Carea, winhaj Seraías yuninal winhaj Tanhumet aj Netofa yet' winhaj Jaazanías yuninal jun winh aj Maaca.

Ix yak'an sti' winhaj Gedalías chi' t'a heb' winh yet' t'a heb' winh soldado, ix yalan winh icha tik: Manh ex xiw he kan t'a yalanh smandar heb' kaldeo chi', kajnajanhek t'a yol nakión tik, tzex och t'a yalanh scheknab'il winh sreyal Babilonia. Tato icha chi' wach'nhej ol aj he b'eyb'ati, xchi winh.

Axo t'a yuquil uj, ix jawi winhaj Ismael yuninal winhaj Netanías yixchiquin winhaj Elisama, t'a yinhtilal heb' winh sreyal Judá. Ay lajunhwanhxo heb' winh winak ajun yet' winh, ix smilancham winhaj Gedalías chi' heb' winh yet' heb' aj Judá yet' pax heb' kaldeo ayek' yet' winh t'a Mizpa chi'.
Yuj chi' masanil heb' anima ix b'at elelal t'a Egipto yuj xiwelal t'a heb' kaldeo chi'. Ata' ix b'at heb' anima niwak yelk'ochi, heb' malaj yelk'ochi yet' heb' yajalil heb' soldado.

Ayic 27 k'ual yoch slajchawil ujal, ayik 37 ab'ilxo yik'chajb'at winhaj rey Joaquín t'a Babilonia, ix och winhaj Ewil-merodak reyal t'a Babilonia chi'. Ha t'a b'ab'el ab'il yoch winh reyal chi' ix sch'oxan swach'k'olal winh t'a winhaj Joaquín chi', ix yik'anelta winh winh t'a preso.
Te wach' ix yutej sb'a winh rey chi' t'a winh t'a yichanh juntzanhxo heb' winh rey ayoch preso t'a Babilonia chi'.
Yuj chi' ix sk'exel spichul winhaj Joaquín sk'an t'a yol preso chi', ix wa winh yet' winh rey chi' t'a jantakto tiempoal pitzan winh.
Ix ak'jinhej sgasto winh yuj winh sreyal Babilonia chi' masanto ix cham winh.
Aton stzolal heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Adán tik: Vinhaj Set, winhaj Enós,
winhaj Cainán, winhaj Mahalaleel, winhaj Jared,
winhaj Enoc, winhaj Matusalén, winhaj Lamec,
winhaj Noé. Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Noé: Aton winhaj Sem, winhaj Cam yet' winhaj Jafet.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jafet chi': Vinhaj Gomer, winhaj Magog, winhaj Madai, winhaj Javán, winhaj Tubal, winhaj Mesec yet' winhaj Tiras.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Gomer chi': Vinhaj Askenaz, winhaj Rifat yet' winhaj Togarma.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Javán chi': Aton winhaj Elisa, winhaj Tarsis, winhaj Quitim yet' winhaj Dodanim.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Cam: Aton winhaj Cus, winhaj Mizraim, winhaj Fut, winhaj Canaán.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Cus chi': Aton winhaj Seba, winhaj Hawila, winhaj Sabta, winhaj Raama yet' winhaj Sabteca. Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Raama chi': Aton winhaj Seba yet' winhaj Dedán.
Ha winhaj Cus chi', aton winh smam winhaj Nimrod. Aton jun winh chi' te niwan ajnak yelk'och t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik yujto te jelan ajnak winh t'a owal.
Ha t'a winhaj Mizraim, ata' kotnak heb' ludeo, heb' anameo, heb' lehabita, heb' naftuhítas,
heb' patruseo, heb' kasluhítas yet' heb' kaftoritas. Ha t'a heb' chi' kotnak yinhtil heb' filisteo.
Ha winhaj Sidón, b'ab'el yuninal winhaj Canaán. Ha junxo yuninal winh, aton winhaj Het.
Ha winhaj Canaán chi' ay yinhtilal heb' jebuseo, heb' amorreo, heb' gergeseo,
heb' heweo, heb' arakeo, heb' sineo,
heb' arwadeo, heb' zemareo yet' heb' hamateo.

Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Sem: Aton winhaj Elam, winhaj Asur, winhaj Arfaxad, winhaj Lud yet' winhaj Aram. Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Aram chi': Aton winhaj Uz, winhaj Hul, winhaj Geter yet' winhaj Mesec.
Ha winhaj Arfaxad chi' smam winhaj Sela, haxo winhaj Sela chi' smam winhaj Heber.
Ha winhaj Heber chi', chawanh yuninal winh: Ha winh b'ab'el skuch Peleg, yujto ha t'a stiempoal winh ix pojchajb'at lum lum. Axo junxo winh yuninal winh chi' skuchan Joctán.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Joctán chi': Aton winhaj Almodad, winhaj Selef, winhaj Hazar-mawet, winhaj Jera,
winhaj Adoram, winhaj Uzal, winhaj Dicla,
winhaj Ebal, winhaj Abimael, winhaj Seba,
winhaj Ofir, winhaj Hawila yet' winhaj Jobab. Ha masanil heb' winh tik, yuninal heb' winh winhaj Joctán.
Aton sb'i heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Sem tik t'a stzolal: Vinhaj Arfaxad, winhaj Sela,
winhaj Heber, winhaj Peleg, winhaj Reu,
winhaj Serug, winhaj Nacor, winhaj Taré,
yet' winhaj Abram, aton winhaj Abraham.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Abraham: Aton winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Ismael.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Ismael: Aton winhaj Nebaiot, b'ab'el yuninal, winhaj Cedar, winhaj Adbeel, winhaj Mibsam,
winhaj Misma, winhaj Duma, winhaj Massa, winhaj Hadad, winhaj Tema,
winhaj Jetur, winhaj Nafis yet' winhaj Cedema.

Axo heb' yune' ix Cetura, schab'il yetb'eyum winhaj Abraham chi': Aton winhaj Zimram, winhaj Jocsán, winhaj Medán, winhaj Madián, winhaj Isbac yet' winhaj Súa. Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jocsán chi': Aton winhaj Seba yet' winhaj Dedán.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Madián chi': Aton winhaj Efa, winhaj Efer, winhaj Hanoc, winhaj Abida yet' winhaj Elda. Masanil heb' winh tik, yinhtilal heb' winh ix Cetura.
Ha winhaj Abraham smam winhaj Isaac. Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Isaac chi', aton winhaj Esaú yet' winhaj Israel.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Esaú chi': Aton winhaj Elifaz, winhaj Reuel, winhaj Jeús, winhaj Jaalam yet' winhaj Coré.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Elifaz chi': Aton winhaj Temán, winhaj Omar, winhaj Zefo, winhaj Gatam, winhaj Cenaz yet' winhaj Amalec yune' ix Timna.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Reuel chi': Aton winhaj Nahat, winhaj Zera, winhaj Sama yet' winhaj Miza.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Seir: Aton winhaj Lotán, winhaj Sobal, winhaj Zibeón, winhaj Aná, winhaj Disón, winhaj Ezer yet' winhaj Disán.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Lotán chi': Aton winhaj Hori yet' winhaj Homam. Ha winhaj Lotán chi' ay yanab' ix Timna.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Sobal chi': Aton winhaj Alván, winhaj Manahat, winhaj Ebal, winhaj Sefo yet' winhaj Onam. Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Zibeón chi': Aton winhaj Aja yet' winhaj Aná.
Ha winhaj Aná chi', smam winhaj Disón, haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Disón chi': Aton winhaj Amram, winhaj Esbán, winhaj Itrán yet' winhaj Querán.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Ezer: Aton winhaj Bilhán, winhaj Zaaván yet' winhaj Jaacán. Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Disán chi': Aton winhaj Uz yet' winhaj Arán.
Aton heb' winh tik ix ak'an yajalil t'a Edom ayik mantalaj sreyal heb' israel tz'ochi: Ha winhaj Bela yuninal winhaj Beor, Dinaba sb'i schonhab' winh.
Ayic ix cham winhaj Bela chi', haxo winhaj Jobab yuninal winhaj Zera, aj chonhab' Bosra ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.
Axo yik ix cham winhaj Jobab chi', haxo winhaj Husam ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh. Ha jun winh chi', ha t'a yol yik Temán kajan winh.
Axo yik ix cham winhaj Husam chi', haxo winhaj Hadad yuninal winhaj Bedad aj chonhab' Awit ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh. Ha jun winh chi' ix ak'an ganar winhaj Madián t'a ak'lik yik Moab.
Ayic ix cham winhaj Hadad chi', haxo winhaj Samla aj chonhab' Masreca ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.
Ayic ix cham winhaj Samla chi', haxo winhaj Saúl ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh. kajan winh t'a chonhab' Rehobot t'a sti' ha' Éufrates.
Ayic ix cham winhaj Saúl chi', haxo winhaj Baal-hanán, yuninal winhaj Acbor ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.
Ayic ix cham winhaj Baal-hanán chi', haxo winhaj Hadad aj chonhab' Pai ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh. Mehetabel sb'i ix yetb'eyum winh, a winhaj Matred ay yisil ix, yixchiquin ix winhaj Mezaab.
Axo yik ix cham winhaj Hadad chi', a heb' winh ix och reyal t'a Edom chi': Aton winhaj Timna, winhaj Alwa, winhaj Jetet,
winhaj Aholibama, winhaj Ela, winhaj Pinón,
winhaj Cenaz, winhaj Temán, winhaj Mibzar,
winhaj Magdiel yet' winhaj Iram. Aton juntzanh heb' winh tik ix ak'an reyal t'a Edom chi'.
Aton heb' winh yuninal winhaj Israel tik: Vinhaj Rubén, winhaj Simeón, winhaj Leví, winhaj Judá, winhaj Isacar, winhaj Zabulón,
winhaj Dan, winhaj José, winhaj Benjamín, winhaj Neftalí, winhaj Gad yet' winhaj Aser.

Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Judá: Aton winhaj Er, winhaj Onán yet' winhaj Sela. Ha snun heb' winh oxwanh tik, aton ix yisil winhaj Súa aj Canaán. Ha winhaj Er chi' b'ab'el yuninal winhaj Judá, te chuk sb'eyb'al winh, yuj chi' ix satjiel winh yuj Jehová.
Axo ix Tamar, ix yalib' winhaj Judá chi', ay chawanh yune' ix yet' winh: Aton winhaj Fares yet' winhaj Zera. Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Judá chi' owanh heb' winh t'a smasanil.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Fares chi': Aton winhaj Hezrón yet' winhaj Hamul.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Zera chi': Aton winhaj Zimri, winhaj Etán, winhaj Hemán, winhaj Calcol yet' winhaj Dara. Owanh heb' t'a smasanil.
Axo winhaj Carmi smam winhaj Acán. Ha winhaj Acán chi' ix ik'ankot yaelal t'a yib'anh chonhab' Israel, yujto ix yik'kot juntzanh tas winh t'a skal tas ix yal Dios to satjiel t'a junelnhej.
Axo yuninal winhaj Etán, aton winhaj Azarías.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Hezrón: Aton winhaj Jerameel, winhaj Ram yet' winhaj Quelubai.
Ha winhaj Ram chi' smam winhaj Aminadab. Axo winhaj Aminadab chi' smam winhaj Naasón. Ha winhaj Naasón yajal ix aj winh t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Judá.
Ha winhaj Naasón chi' smam winhaj Salmón. Ha winhaj Salmón chi' smam winhaj Booz.
Ha winhaj Booz chi' smam winhaj Obed, aton winh smam winhaj Isaí.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Isaí chi', aton heb' winh tik: B'ab'el winhaj Eliab, schab'il winhaj Abinadab, yoxil winhaj Simea,
schanhil winhaj Natanael, yoil winhaj Radai,
swaquil winhaj Ozem, yuquil winhaj Dawid.
Eb' ix yanab' heb' winh tik: Aton ix Sarwia yet' ix Abigail. Axo heb' winh yune' ix Sarwia chi', oxwanh heb' winh: Aton winhaj Abisai, winhaj Joab, winhaj Asael.
Axo winh yune' ix Abigail chi', aton winhaj Amasa. Ha winh smam winhaj Amasa chi', aton winhaj Jeter ismaelita.
Axo winhaj Caleb yuninal winhaj Hezrón, ay jun yuninal winh skuch Jeriot, yune' ix Azuba. Axo juntzanhxo heb' winh yune' ix: Aton winhaj Jeser, winhaj Sobab yet' winhaj Ardón.
Axo ix cham ix Azuba chi', haxo ix Efrata ix yik' winhaj Caleb chi'. Ay jun yune' ix, aton winhaj Hur.
Ha winhaj Hur chi' smam winhaj Uri. Axo winhaj Uri chi' smam winhaj Bezaleel.
Ayic 60 ab'ilxo sk'inal winhaj Hezrón, ix yik' ix yisil winhaj Maquir winh, aton winh smam winhaj Galaad. Ix alji jun yune' ix yet' winhaj Hezrón chi', aton winhaj Segub.
Ha winhaj Segub chi' smam winhaj Jair. Ha winhaj Jair chi' ayoch yajalil t'a 23 chonhab' t'a yol smakb'en Galaad.

Axo pax heb' aj Gesur yet' heb' aj Aram ix ik'ankan juntzanh schonhab' winhaj Jair chi' yet' chonhab' Kenat yet' yaldeail, 60 chonhab'il t'a smasanil. Masanil juntzanh heb' tik, yinhtilal heb' winhaj Maquir.
Ayic toxo ix cham winhaj Hezrón chi', haxo winhaj Caleb ix ik'ankan ix yetb'eyum winh, aton ix Efrata. Ix alji jun yune' ix, aton winhaj Asur smam yicham heb' aj Tecoa.
Aton sb'i heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jerameel tik, winh sb'ab'el unin winhaj Hezrón: Vinhaj Ram winh b'ab'el unin, winhaj Buna, winhaj Orén, winhaj Ozem yet' winhaj Ahías.
Ha winhaj Jerameel chi', ay junxo ix yetb'eyum winh, aton ix Atara snun winhaj Onam.
Aton sb'i heb' winh yuninal winhaj Ram tik, winh sb'ab'el unin winhaj Jerameel: Vinhaj Maaz, winhaj Jamín yet' winhaj Equer.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Onam chi': Aton winhaj Samai yet' winhaj Jada. Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Samai chi': Aton winhaj Nadab yet' winhaj Abisur.
Ha ix yetb'eyum winhaj Abisur chi', aton ix Abihail. Ha ix chi' snun winhaj Ahbán yet' winhaj Molid.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Nadab chi': Aton winhaj Seled yet' winhaj Apaim. Ha winhaj Seled chi' malaj yuninal winh.
Axo winhaj Apaim chi' smam winhaj Isi. Axo winhaj Isi chi' smam winhaj Sesán. Axo winhaj Sesán chi' smam winhaj Ahlai.
Axo winhaj Jada yuk'tak winhaj Samai, a winh smam winhaj Jeter yet' winhaj Jonatán. Ha winhaj Jeter chi' malaj yuninal winh.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jonatán chi': Aton winhaj Pelet yet' winhaj Zaza. Ha heb' winh tik, yinhtilal heb' winh winhaj Jerameel.
Ha winhaj Sesán, malaj yuninal winh, yuj chi' a junok heb' ix yisil winh ix yik'laj sb'a yet' jun winh schekab' winh skuch Jarha aj Egipto. Ix alji jun yune' ix skuch Atai.

Aton heb' winh tik yinhtilal winhaj Atai t'a stzolal: Vinhaj Natán, winhaj Zabad, winhaj Eflal, winhaj Obed, winhaj Jehú, winhaj Azarías, winhaj Heles, winhaj Elasa, winhaj Sismai, winhaj Salum, winhaj Jecamías yet' winhaj Elisama.
Ha winhaj Caleb yuk'tak winhaj Jerameel chi', a winh smam winhaj Mesa b'ab'el yuninal, winhaj Zif yet' winhaj Maresa smam winhaj Hebrón.
Axo winhaj Hebrón chi' smam winhaj Coré, winhaj Tapúa, winhaj Requem yet' winhaj Sema.
Aton heb' winh tik yinhtilal winhaj Sema t'a stzolal: Vinhaj Raham, winhaj Jorcoam, winhaj Requem, winhaj Samai, winhaj Maón yet' winhaj Bet-sur.
Ha ix Efa schab'il yetb'eyum winhaj Caleb, aton ix ay yune' winhaj Harán, winhaj Mosa yet' winhaj Gazez. Axo winhaj Harán chi' smam junxo winhaj Gazez.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jahdai: Aton winhaj Regem, winhaj Jotam, winhaj Gesam, winhaj Pelet, winhaj Efa yet' winhaj Saaf.

Axo ix Maaca schab'il pax yetb'eyum winhaj Caleb chi', a ix ay yune' winhaj Seber yet' winhaj Tirhana. Anheja' ix ay yune' winhaj Saaf smam winhaj Madmana. Anheja' ix ay yune' winhaj Sewa smam winhaj Macbena yet' winhaj Gibea. Axo ix yisil winhaj Caleb chi', aton ix Acsa.
Ha juntzanh heb' winh tik yinhtilal heb' winhaj Caleb chi'. Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Hur, winh sb'ab'el une' ix Efrata, aton winhaj Sobal, winh smam yicham heb' aj Quiriat-jearim,
winhaj Salma, smam yicham heb' aj Belén yet' winhaj Haref smam yicham heb' aj Bet-gader.
Axo heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Sobal smam yicham heb' aj Quiriat-jearim: Aton winhaj Haroe, nanhal heb' manahetita,
yet' junjun makan heb' aj Quiriat-jearim: Aton heb' itrita, heb' futita, heb' sumatita yet' heb' misraita. Aton t'a heb' chi' ix kot heb' zoratita yet' heb' estaolita.
Axo winhaj Salma ix kajnajkan t'a chonhab' Belén. Ha winh smam yicham heb' netofatita, heb' aj Atrot-bet-joab yet' nanhalxo heb' manahetita, heb' zoraíta,
yet' heb' yinhtilal heb' soferita ix ek' kajan t'a Jabes, aton heb' tirateo, heb' simateo yet' heb' sukateo. Yed' heb' keneo kotnak t'a yinhtilal winhaj Hamat smam yicham heb' yinhtilal Recab.

Ha winhaj rey Dawid nanhal swajxaquil ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Hebrón. Ayic ayoch winh reyal t'a Hebrón chi', wakwanh heb' winh yuninal winh ix alji, aton heb' tik: Ha winh b'ab'el, a winhaj Amnón, yune' ix Ahinoam aj Jezreel. Axo winh schab'il, a winhaj Daniel yune' ix Abigail aj Carmel. Axo winh yoxil, a winhaj Absalón, yune' ix Maaca, ix yisil winhaj Talmai sreyal Gesur. Axo winh schanhil, a winhaj Adonías yune' ix Haguit. Axo winh yoil, a winhaj Sefatías yune' ix Abital. Axo winh swaquil, aton winhaj Itream yune' ix Egla. Ixlajwi chi' 33 ab'il pax ix yak' reyal winhaj Dawid chi' t'a Jerusalén.

Ayic ayoch winh reyal t'a Jerusalén chi', 13 to heb' winh yuninal winh ix alji, aton heb' winh tik: Vinhaj Simea, winhaj Sobab, winhaj Natán yet' winhaj Salomón. Ha heb' winh tik, yune' heb' winh ix Betsabé, ix yisil winhaj Amiel.
Ha juntzanhxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Dawid chi': Aton winhaj Ibhar, winhaj Elisama, winhaj Elifelet, winhaj Noga, winhaj Nefeg, winhaj Jafía, winhaj Elisama, winhaj Eliada yet' winhaj Elifelet.
Yanab' pax ix Tamar juntzanh heb' winh tik. Ch'ok pax yaj juntzanhxo heb' winh yuninal winh yet' juntzanhxo heb' ix schab'il yetb'eyum max b'inajlaj t'a skal heb' winh tik.

Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Salomón t'a stzolal: Aton winhaj Roboam, winhaj Abías, winhaj Asa, winhaj Josafat, winhaj Joram, winhaj Ocozías, winhaj Joás, winhaj Amasías, winhaj Azarías, winhaj Jotam, winhaj Acaz, winhaj Ezequías, winhaj Manasés, winhaj Amón yet' winhaj Josías.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Josías chi', winh b'ab'el, a winhaj Johanán, winh schab'il, a winhaj Joacim, winh yoxil, a winhaj Sedequías, winh schanhil a winhaj Salum.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Joacim chi': Aton winhaj Jeconías yet' winhaj Sedequías.

Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jeconías winh ik'b'ilb'at preso t'a Babilonia, aton winhaj Salatiel, winhaj Malquiram, winhaj Pedaías, winhaj Senazar, winhaj Jecamías, winhaj Hosama yet' winhaj Nedabías.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Pedaías, aton winhaj Zorobabel yet' winhaj Simei. Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Zorobabel chi': Aton winhaj Mesulam, winhaj Hananías yet' pax ix Selomit yanab' heb' winh.
Ay pax owanhxo yuninal winhaj Zorobabel chi', aton heb' winh tik: Vinhaj Hasuba, winhaj Ohel, winhaj Berequías, winhaj Hasadías yet' winhaj Jusab-hesed.

Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Hananías chi': Aton winhaj Pelatías yet' winhaj Jesaías. Axo heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Jesaías chi' t'a stzolal aton heb' winh tik: Vinhaj Refaías, winhaj Arnán, winhaj Abdías yet' winhaj Sekanías.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Sekanías chi', aton winhaj Semaías, winhaj Hatús, winhaj Igal, winhaj Barías, winhaj Nearías yet' winhaj Safat. Vacwanh heb' winh t'a smasanil.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Nearías oxwanh sb'ey heb' winh. Aton winhaj Elioenai, winhaj Ezequías yet' winhaj Azricam.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Elioenai chi', ukwanh sb'ey heb' winh: Aton winhaj Hodabías, winhaj Eliasib, winhaj Pelaías, winhaj Acub, winhaj Johanán, winhaj Dalaías yet' winhaj Anani.
Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Judá, aton heb' winh tik t'a stzolal: Vinhaj Fares, winhaj Hezrón, winhaj Carmi, winhaj Hur yet' winhaj Sobal.
Ha winhaj Sobal chi' smam winhaj Reaía, smam icham winhaj Jahat. Axo winhaj Jahat chi' smam winhaj Ahumai yet' winhaj Lahad. Ha yinhtilal heb' winh ix kajnaj t'a Zora.

Ha winhaj Hur sb'ab'el yune' ix Efrata yet' winhaj Caleb. Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winh ix b'ab'laj kajnaj t'a chonhab' Belén. Ay oxwanh heb' winh yuninal winh, aton winhaj Etam, winhaj Penuel yet' winhaj Ezer. Ha winhaj Etam smam winhaj Jezreel, winhaj Isma, winhaj Ibdas yet' ix Haze-lelponi. Ha winhaj Penuel chi' ix b'ab'laj kajnaj t'a chonhab' Gedor, haxo winhaj Ezer chi' ix b'ab'laj kajnaj t'a chonhab' Husa.
Axo winhaj Asur ix b'ab'laj kajnaj t'a chonhab' Tecoa, chawanh heb' ix yetb'eyum winh: Aton ix Hela yet' ix Naara.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winh yet' ix Naara chi', aton winhaj Ahusam, winhaj Hefer, winhaj Temeni yet' winhaj Ahastari.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winh yet' ix Hela chi', aton winhaj Seret, winhaj Jezoar yet' winhaj Etnán.
Axo winhaj Cos smam winhaj Anub yet' winhaj Sobeba. D'a yinhtilal winhaj Cos chi' ix kot winhaj Aharhel, yuninal winhaj Harum.
Ay jun winh skuchan Jabes, te niwan yelk'och winh t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok. Ha ix snun winh ix ak'an skuch Jabes, yujto ix yal ix: Te ya ix in ek' yuj jun wune' ix alji tik, xchi ix.

Ha winhaj Jabes chi', ix och winh ejmelal t'a sDiosal Israel, ix yalan winh t'ay: Tzin k'an t'ayach Mamin to tzak' a wach'k'olal t'a wib'anh, yik niwan tz'aj in makb'en, to tzach och wed'ok tzin a kolanel t'a chukal, yik wach' max wab' syail, xchi winh t'a slesal chi'. Ix yak'an Dios masanil tas ix sk'an winh chi'.
Ha winhaj Quelub yuk'tak winhaj Súa, a winh smam winhaj Mehir, haxo winhaj Mehir chi', smam winhaj Estón.

Axo winhaj Estón chi' ay oxwanh yuninal winh: Aton winhaj Bet-rafa, winhaj Paseah yet' winhaj Tehina. Ha winhaj Tehina chi' ix b'ab'laj kajnaj t'a chonhab' Nahas. Ha heb' yinhtilal heb' winh oxwanh chi' ek'nak kajan t'a Reca.
Axo winhaj Cenaz ay chawanh yuninal winh: Aton winhaj Otoniel yet' winhaj Seraías. Chawanh pax heb' winh yuninal winhaj Otoniel chi', aton winhaj Hatat yet' winhaj Meonotai.

Ha winhaj Meonotai chi' smam winhaj Ofra. Axo winhaj Seraías chi' smam winhaj Joab, aton winh ix b'ab'laj kajnaj t'a ak'lik Carisim. Icha chi' sb'i jun lugar chi', yujto ata' kajan heb' anima jelan sb'oan tastak.
Axo winhaj Caleb yuninal winhaj Jefone ay oxwanh heb' winh yuninal winh: Aton winhaj Iru, winhaj Ela yet' winhaj Naam. Ha winhaj Ela chi' smam winhaj Cenaz.
Axo winhaj Jahalelel ay chanhwanh heb' winh yuninal winh: Aton winhaj Zif, winhaj Zifa, winhaj Tirías yet' winhaj Asareel.

Ha winhaj Esdras ay chanhwanh yuninal winh: Aton winhaj Jeter, winhaj Mered, winhaj Efer yet' winhaj Jalón. Ha winhaj Mered chi', ix yik'laj sb'a winh yet' ix Bitia, yisil winh sreyal Egipto. Axo yalyuninal winh yet' ix, aton ix María, winhaj Samai yet' winhaj Isba. Ha winhaj Isba chi' ix b'ab'laj kajnaj t'a chonhab' Estemoa. Axo junxo ix yetb'eyum winhaj Mered chi', aj Judá ix. Oxwanh yuninal winh yet' ix, aton winhaj Jered, winhaj Heber yet' winhaj Jecutiel. Ha winhaj Jered chi' ix b'ab'laj kajnaj t'a chonhab' Gedor, haxo winhaj Heber, ha t'a chonhab' Soco ix b'ab'laj kajnaj winh. Axo pax winhaj Jecutiel chi', ha t'a chonhab' Zanoa ix b'ab'laj kajnaj winh.

Ha winhaj Hodías ix yik'laj sb'a winh yet' ix yanab' winhaj Naham. D'a yinhtilal heb' ix kot heb' garmita, ix kajnaj heb' t'a Keila. Anheja' t'a yinhtilal winhaj Hodías chi' ix kot heb' maakateo, haxo t'a Estemoa ix kajnaj heb'.
Ha winhaj Simón chanhwanh yuninal winh: Aton winhaj Amnón, winhaj Rina, winhaj Ben-hanán yet' winhaj Tilón. Axo winhaj Isi ay chawanh yuninal winh: Aton winhaj Zohet yet' winhaj Benzohet.

Axo heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Sela yuninal winhaj Judá, aton heb' winh tik: Vinhaj Er, winh b'ab'laj kajnajnak t'a Leca yet' winhaj Laada, winh b'ab'laj kajnajnak t'a Maresa, smam yicham heb' sch'alan k'apak lino t'a chonhab' Bet-asbea. Anhejtona' winhaj Er chi' smam winhaj Joacim yet' heb' anima kajan t'a Cozeba yet' winhaj Joás yet' winhaj Saraf. Ha winhaj Joás yet' winhaj Saraf, ix yik'laj sb'a heb' winh yet' chawanh heb' ix aj Moab. Slajwi chi' smeltzajnakxi heb' winh t'a Belén, icha chi' yaj stz'ib'chajkan t'a peka'.
Ha juntzanh heb' chi' tz'akum heb'. Ha t'a Netaim yet' t'a Gedera kajan heb', yak'nak serwil winh rey heb'.
Ha winhaj Simeón owanh heb' winh yuninal winh: Aton winhaj Nemuel, winhaj Jamín, winhaj Jarib, winhaj Zera yet' winhaj Saúl.
Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Saúl chi' t'a stzolal: Vinhaj Salum, winhaj Mibsam, winhaj Misma.
Axo heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Misma chi', aton winhaj Hamuel, winhaj Zacur yet' winhaj Simei.

Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Simei chi', 16 heb' winh, wakwanh pax heb' ix yisil winh. Axo pax heb' winh sk'ab'yok winh, malaj wal yuninal heb' winh, yuj chi' maj q'uib' sb'isul heb' winh icha yinhtilal Judá.

Ha heb' yinhtilal Simeón chi' ix kajnaj heb' t'a juntzanh lugar tik: D'a Beerseba, t'a Molada, t'a Hazar-sual, t'a Bilha, t'a Esem, t'a Tolad, t'a Betuel, t'a Horma, t'a Siclag, t'a Bet-markabot, t'a Hazar-susim, t'a Bet-birai yet' t'a Saaraim. Ata' kajan heb' masanto yik ix och winhaj Dawid reyal.
Ayto pax oyexo schonhab' heb': Aton Etam, Aín, Rimón, Toquén yet' Asán,
yet' masanil yaldeail juntzanh chonhab' chi' masanto t'a chonhab' Baal. Aton juntzanh chonhab' chi' b'aj kajan heb' yet' yinhtilal icha yaj stz'ib'chajkani.

Ayic ix q'uib' sb'isul heb' yinhtilal Simeón chi', aton heb' winh tik yajal yaj t'a skal heb': Vinhaj Mesobab, winhaj Jamlec, winhaj Josías (yuninal winhaj Amasías), winhaj Joel, winhaj Jehú (yuninal winhaj Josibías, haxo winhaj Josibías chi' yuninal winhaj Seraías, haxo winhaj Seraías chi' yuninal winhaj Asiel) yet' pax winhaj Elioenai, winhaj Jaacoba, winhaj Jesohaía, winhaj Asaías, winhaj Adiel, winhaj Jesimiel, winhaj Benaía yet' winhaj Ziza. (Ha winh smam winhaj Ziza chi' aton winhaj Sifi, yuninal winhaj Alón, yuninal winhaj Jedaías, yuninal winhaj Simri yuninal winhaj Semaías).

Yujto ix q'uib' sb'isul heb', yuj chi' ix b'at heb' t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, ix k'och heb' t'a slak'anil chonhab' Gedor. Ix sayan heb' b'aj swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, t'a jun ch'olan b'aj skan jun chonhab' chi'.

Ata' ix ilchaj anh ank'ultak te yaax yuj heb', te wach' anh, te ay pax anh. Te lewan yek' jun lum lum chi', junk'olal yajek' heb', malaj tas tz'ik'an heb', aton ta' ek'nak kajan heb' yinhtilal Cam t'a peka'.

Ha t'a stiempoal winhaj Ezequías sreyal Judá, ata' ix jawi juntzanh heb' toxo ix b'inaj sb'i tik. Ha heb' satjinaquel heb' anima kajan ta' yet' skampamento heb' yet' spat heb'. Junelnhej ix satel heb' smasanil. Axo heb' ix kajnajkan t'a slum heb' chi', yujto te ay swael nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.

Anhejtona', ay pax 500-xo heb' winh winak t'a yinhtilal Simeón chi' ix k'och kajan t'a lum tzalquixtak t'a yol yik Seir. Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Isi, aton winhaj Pelatías, winhaj Nearías, winhaj Refaías yet' winhaj Uziel ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Ha heb' ix satanel heb' amalekita aytoek' ta'. Axo heb' ix kajnajkan ta'.

Ha winhaj Rubén, winh sb'ab'el unin winhaj Jacob, palta maj scha chab' makan smakb'en winh yik sb'ab'el uninal chi', yujto ix way winh yet' ix schab'il yetb'eyum smam. Yuj chi' a junxo makan smakb'en winh chi', ix ak'chajkan t'a heb' winh yuninal winhaj José, aton junxo yuninal winhaj Jacob chi'.

Wach'chom ha t'a winhaj José chi' ix ak'chajkan jun makb'en yik b'ab'el uninab'il chi', palta a winhaj Judá te niwan ix aj yelk'och t'a skal heb' yuk'tak chi', yuj chi' ha t'a yinhtilal winh ix kot heb' ix ak'an yajalil t'a Israel.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Rubén chi': Aton winhaj Hanoc, winhaj Falú, winhaj Hezrón yet' winhaj Carmi.

Axo heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Joel t'a stzolal: Vinhaj Semaías, winhaj Gog, winhaj Simei, winhaj Micaías, winhaj Reaía, winhaj Baal yet' winhaj Beera. Ha winhaj Beera chi', yajal yaj winh t'a skal masanil heb' yinhtilal Rubén chi', aton winh ik'jinakb'at preso yuj winhaj Tiglat-pileser sreyal Asiria.
Ha heb' sk'ab'yok winhaj Beera chi', t'a stzolal ix aj stz'ib'chajkan heb' yet' yinhtilal. Aton winhaj Jeiel yajal yaji, winhaj Zacarías,

winhaj Bela yuninal winhaj Azaz, yixchiquin winhaj Sema, yinhtilal winhaj Joel. Ha winhaj Bela chi' yet' yinhtilal winh, ix kajnaj heb' t'a Aroer, ix k'och smakb'en heb' chi' t'a Nebo yet' t'a Baal-meón.
Ix kajnaj pax heb' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u masanto t'a tzinan lu'um, aton lum sk'ochnhej t'ha ha' Éufrates, yujto ix te q'uib' sb'isul nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' t'a yol yik Galaad.

Ayic ayoch winhaj Saúl reyal, a heb' yinhtilal Rubén chi', yak'nak owal heb' yet' heb' agarenos, yak'nak ganar heb' agareno chi' heb', haxo heb' kajnajnakkan t'a schonhab' heb' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a Galaad chi'.
Ha heb' yinhtilal Gad, ix kajnaj heb' t'a snorteal smakb'en heb' yinhtilal Rubén, t'a yol yik Basán, masanto t'a chonhab' Salca t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, aton sb'i heb' winh tik:
Ha winhaj Joel yajal t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok kajan t'a Basán chi', schab'il winhaj Safán.Ix kajnajpax winhaj Jaanai yet' winhaj Safat ta'.

Axo juntzanhxo heb' winh sk'ab'yok heb' winh, icha syal stzolal smam yicham heb' winh: Vinhaj Micael, winhaj Mesulam, winhaj Seba, winhaj Jorai, winhaj Jacán, winhaj Zía yet' winhaj Heber, ukwanh heb' winh t'a smasanil.

Ha heb' winh chi' yinhtilal winhaj Abihail yuninal winhaj Huri. Ha sb'i heb' smam yicham heb' t'a stzolal: Vinhaj Abihail, winhaj Huri, winhaj Jaroa, winhaj Galaad, winhaj Micael, winhaj Jesisai, winhaj Jahdo yet' winhaj Buz.
Yed' pax winhaj Ahí, yuninal winhaj Abdiel yixchiquin winhaj Guni, yajal t'a skal heb' yinhtilal.
Ix kajnaj heb' smasanil t'a Galaad yet' t'a Basán yet' t'a yaldeail yet' t'a masanil b'aj wach' swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' t'a Sarón, masanto t'a smojon heb'.
Masanil juntzanh heb' tik ix tz'ib'chaj yet' yinhtilal ayik ayoch winhaj Jotam reyal t'a Judá, haxo winhaj Jeroboam ayoch reyal t'a Israel.

Ha heb' yinhtilal Rubén chi', heb' yinhtilal Gad yet' nanhalxo heb' yinhtilal Manasés, ay 44 mil 760 heb' soldado te tek'an, yet'nak smaklab' jul-lab' heb', yespada heb' yet' sjul-lab' heb', te k'ayb'ab'il heb' yak'an owal.
Ix yak'an owal heb' yet' heb' agareno yet' winhaj Jetur, winhaj Nafis yet' winhaj Nodab.
Ix yak'och Dios heb' yipok sk'ool, ix sk'anan skolwal Dios chi' heb'. Ix spakan tas ix sk'an heb', yuj chi' ix ak'jioch heb' agareno yet' heb' ayoch yet' heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' israel chi'.
Yuj chi', aton tik ix yik'kan heb' t'a heb' agareno chi': 50 mil nok' kamello, 250 mil nok' kalnel, 2 mil nok' b'uru yet' 100 mil anima ix yik'b'at heb' chekab'wumal.
Te niwan heb' ajk'ol chi' ix chami, yujto a jun owal chi' ha Dios ay yiko'. Icha chi' ix aj skajnajkan heb' yinhtilal Rubén t'a juntzanh lugar chi', masanto ix ik'chajb'at heb' t'a ch'ok nakional.
Axo nanhalxo heb' yinhtilal Manasés chi', yujto te tzijtum sb'isul heb', ix kajnaj heb' t'a sat lum sb'atnhej t'a Basán masanto sk'och t'a Baal-hermón, skuchanpax lum Senir yet' lum switzal Hermón.

Ha heb' winh yajal yaj t'a skal heb': Aton winhaj Efer, winhaj Isi, winhaj Eliel, winhaj Azriel, winhaj Jeremías, winhaj Hodabías yet' winhaj Jahdiel. Masanil juntzanh heb' winh chi', soldado te tek'an, te jelan pax heb' winh, b'inajnak heb' winh, yajal heb' winh t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok.

Palta ix te och wal spitalil heb' winh d'ha Dios, ix yaktejkan sDiosal smam yicham heb' winh, haxo t'a juntzanh sdiosal juntzanh chonhab' ix satel Dios t'a yichanh heb' chi', ata' ix och heb' ejmelal.

Yuj chi' ha Dios chi' ix chekankot winh sreyal Asiria, aton winhaj Pul, skuchan pax Tiglat-pileser. Ix jawi winh t'a slum heb' yinhtilal Rubén, heb' yinhtilal Gad yet' nanhalxo heb' yinhtilal Manasés chi'. Ix ak'jioch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winh, yuj chi' ix ik'jib'at heb' t'a chonhab' Halah, t'a Habor, t'a Hara yet' t'a stitak ha' Gozán. Ata' ix kannhej heb'.
Ay oxwanh heb' winh yuninal winhaj Leví: Aton winhaj Gersón, winhaj Coat yet' winhaj Merari.
Axo winhaj Coat chi' chanhwanh yuninal winh: Aton winhaj Amram, winhaj Izhar, winhaj Hebrón yet' winhaj Uziel.

Ha winhaj Amram chi' chawanh yuninal winh: Aton winhaj Aarón yet' winhaj Moisés yet' jun yisil winh, aton ix María. Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Aarón chi' chanhwanh heb' winh: Aton winhaj Nadab, winhaj Abiú, winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Itamar.

Aton sb'i heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Aarón tik sb'eyb'at t'a stzolal t'a heb' winh uninab'il yet' t'a heb' winh ichiquinab'il: Vinhaj Eleazar, winhaj Finees, winhaj Abisúa, winhaj Buqui, winhaj Uzi, winhaj Zeraías, winhaj Meraiot, winhaj Amarías, winhaj Ahitob, winhaj Sadoc, winhaj Ahimaas, winhaj Azarías, winhaj Johanán, winhaj Azarías, (aton winh sakerdote yaj t'a templo ix sb'ok'e winhaj Salomón t'a Jerusalén), winhaj Amarías, winhaj Ahitob, winhaj Sadoc, winhaj Salum, winhaj Hilcías, winhaj Azarías, winhaj Seraías yet' winhaj Josadac. Ha winhaj Josadac chi' ix ik'jib'at winh preso yet' heb' ay t'a Jerusalén yet' juntzanhxo lugar t'a yol yik Judá yuj winhaj rey Nabucodonosor, yujto a Jehová ix ak'an sk'ulej winh icha chi'.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Leví oxwanh heb': Aton winhaj Gersón, winhaj Coat yet' winhaj Merari.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Gersón chi': Aton winhaj Libni yet' winhaj Simei.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Coat chi': Aton winhaj Amram, winhaj Izhar, winhaj Hebrón yet' winhaj Uziel.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Merari chi': Aton winhaj Mahli yet' winhaj Musi. Ha heb' winh ix b'inaj tik, yinhtilal Leví heb' winh.
Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Gersón t'a stzolal: Aton winhaj Libni, winhaj Jahat, winhaj Zima, winhaj Joa, winhaj Iddo, winhaj Zera yet' winhaj Jeatrai.
Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Coat t'a stzolal: Aton winhaj Aminadab, winhaj Coré, winhaj Asir, winhaj Elcana, winhaj Ebiasaf, winhaj Asir, winhaj Tahat, winhaj Uriel, winhaj Ozías yet' winhaj Saúl.

Axo winhaj Elcana chawanh yuninal winh: Aton winhaj Amasai yet' winhaj Ahimot. Axo heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Ahimot chi' t'a stzolal: Aton winhaj Elcana, winhaj Safai, winhaj Nahat, winhaj Eliab, winhaj Jeroham, winhaj Elcana yet' winhaj Samuel.
Axo winhaj Samuel chi' chawanh yuninal winh: Aton winhaj Vasni sb'ab'el yuninal winh, schab'il winhaj Abías.
Axo heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Merari t'a stzolal: Vinhaj Mahli, winhaj Libni, winhaj Simei, winhaj Uza, winhaj Simea, winhaj Haguía yet' winhaj Asaías.
Aton juntzanh heb' winh tik ix ak'jioch yuj winhaj rey Dawid yik sb'itan heb' winh t'a skajnub' Jehová, yiktax ix ak'jioch te' skaxail trato t'a yol skajnub' Jehová t'a Jerusalén.
D'a stzolal tz'aj yoch heb' winh sb'itan t'a yichanh kajnub' chi' masanto yik ix b'ojik'e stemplo Jehová yuj winhaj Salomón.

Ha heb' winh ayoch t'a yopisio sb'itan chi' yet' heb' winh yuninal, aton sb'i heb' winh tik t'a stzolal: Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Coat, aton heb' winh tik: Vinhaj Hemán skuchb'an jun makan heb' winh sb'itan chi'. Ha sb'i heb' winh b'aj ix kot yinhtilal winhaj Hemán chi' tz'el yich t'a winh smam winh masanto t'a slajwub'xo smam yicham winh, aton heb' winh tik: Vinhaj Joel, winhaj Samuel, winhaj Elcana, winhaj Jeroham, winhaj Eliel, winhaj Toa, winhaj Zuf, winhaj Elcana, winhaj Mahat, winhaj Amasai, winhaj Elcana, winhaj Joel, winhaj Azarías, winhaj Sofonías, winhaj Tahat, winhaj Asir, winhaj Ebiasaf, winhaj Coré, winhaj Izhar, winhaj Coat, winhaj Leví yet' winhaj Israel.

Ha t'a swach' winhaj Hemán chi' skan winhaj Asaf, aton winh skuchb'an junxo makan heb' winh sb'itan chi'. Aton sb'i heb' winh smam yicham winhaj Asaf chi' t'a stzolal: Vinhaj Berequías, winhaj Simea, winhaj Micael, winhaj Baasías, winhaj Malquías, winhaj Etni, winhaj Zera, winhaj Adaía, winhaj Etán, winhaj Zima, winhaj Simei, winhaj Jahat, winhaj Gersón yet' winhaj Leví.

Axo t'a sk'exanh winhaj Hemán chi' skan heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Merari sb'itan paxi. Ha winhaj Etán skuchb'an heb' winh t'a b'it chi'. Aton stzolal smam yicham winhaj Etán tik: Vinhaj Quisi, winhaj Abdi, winhaj Maluc, winhaj Hasabías, winhaj Amasías, winhaj Hilcías, winhaj Amsi, winhaj Bani, winhaj Semer, winhaj Mahli, winhaj Musi, winhaj Merari yet' winhaj Leví.
Axo juntzanh heb' winh sk'ab'yok heb' winh, anheja' yinhtilal Leví heb' winh, ix kan heb' winh munlajel t'a stemplo Jehová.

Ha winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yinhtilal, a heb' snhusan ofrenda t'a altar b'aj stz'a silab' yet' t'a altar yik inkienso. Anhejtona' a heb' tz'ilan masanil opisio t'a jun Lugar Yicnhej Jehová yaji yet' yik tz'ak'ji tup smul heb' yetisraelal heb', icha wal yutejnak winhaj Moisés schekab' Dios yalankani.

Aton sb'i heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Aarón tik t'a stzolal: Vinhaj Eleazar, winhaj Finees, winhaj Abisúa, winhaj Buqui, winhaj Uzi, winhaj Zeraías, winhaj Meraiot, winhaj Amarías, winhaj Ahitob, winhaj Sadoc, winhaj Ahimaas.

Aton juntzanh chonhab' tik yet' smakb'en b'aj ix kajnaj heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Aarón. Ix och suerte t'a yib'anh heb' winh. Ha t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Coat ix em jun b'ab'el makan, yuj chi' a chonhab' Hebrón t'a yol yik Judá, a ix kan t'a heb' winh yet' sluumal t'a spatiktak b'aj swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' winh. Palta a juntzanh yaldeail yet' sluumal t'a spatiktak chi' ak'b'il t'a winhaj Caleb yuninal winhaj Jefone. Ha t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Aarón chi' ix ak'chaj Hebrón, aton jun chonhab' chi' b'aj syal skolan sb'a heb' smilancham junok anima manh sk'anok sk'ool. Ix ak'jipax juntzanhxo chonhab' tik t'a heb': Libna, Jatir, Estemoa, Hilén, Debir, Asán yet' Bet-semes. Ha juntzanh chonhab' chi', ha t'a yol yik Judá ay. Axo t'a yol yik Benjamín ix ak'chaj juntzanhxo chonhab' tik: Geba, Alemet yet' Anatot. Ha juntzanh chonhab' chi', 13 t'a smasanil, ix kannhej yet' sluumal t'a spatiktak b'aj syal swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.
Yed' t'a smakb'en yinhtilal Manasés ay t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, ix ak'chajpax lajunhexo chonhab' t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Coat chi'.

Axo pax t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Gersón, icha jay makan yaj heb', 13 chonhab' ix ak'chaj t'a heb'. Ha juntzanh chonhab' chi' ay t'a yol smakb'en heb' yinhtilal Isacar, heb' yik Aser, heb' yik Neftalí yet' t'a yik heb' Manasés ay t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, aton t'a Basán.

Anheja' pax t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Merari, ix ak'chaj 12 chonhab' icha jay makan yaj heb'. Ha juntzanh chonhab' chi', ha t'a yol smakb'en heb' yinhtilal Rubén ay, heb' yik Gad yet' heb' yik Zabulón.
Ix ak'chaj juntzanh chonhab' chi' t'a heb' yinhtilal Leví yuj heb' yetisraelal yet' pax b'aj syal swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' t'a spatiktak juntzanh chonhab' chi'.
Ha t'a smakb'en Judá, yik Simeón yet' yik Benjamín, ata' ay juntzanh chonhab' toxo ix b'inaj ix ak'chaj t'a heb' yinhtilal Leví chi', icha ix aj yik'an heb' t'a suerteal.
Ay juntzanhxo makan yinhtilal winhaj Coat ix chaan juntzanh chonhab' b'aj tz'aj heb' t'a smakb'en heb' yinhtilal Efraín:
Aton Siquem t'a tzalquixtak t'a yol yik Efraín chi', aton t'a jun chonhab' chi' syal skolan sb'a heb' smilancham junok anima to manh sk'anok sk'ool. Ix yik'anpax juntzanh chonhab' tik heb': Gezer,
Jocmeam, Bet-horón, Ajalón yet' Gat-rimón. Masanil juntzanh chi' ix yik' heb' yet' b'aj syal swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.
Yed' t'a smakb'en yinhtilal Manasés ay t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, ix schapax chonhab' Aner yet' Bileam heb' yet' pax b'aj syal swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.

Axo t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Gersón, icha syal jay makan yaj heb', ix ak'chaj chonhab' Golán t'a yol yik Basán, chonhab' Astarot yet' b'aj syal swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'. Ha chab' chonhab' chi' ay t'a yol smakb'en Manasés t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u.
Ix ak'chajpax juntzanhxo chonhab' tik t'a heb' t'a yol yik heb' yinhtilal Isacar: Cedes, Daberat, Ramot yet' Anem. Ha t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', aynhej b'aj swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.
Ix ak'chajpax juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a heb' t'a yol smakb'en heb' yinhtilal Aser: Masal, Abdón, Hucoc yet' Rehob. Ha t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', aynhej b'aj swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.

Axo t'a yol smakb'en heb' yinhtilal Neftalí, ix ak'chaj juntzanh chonhab' tik t'a heb': Cedes t'a yol yik Galilea, Hamón yet' Quiriataim. Ha t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', aynhej b'aj swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.

Axo t'a juntzanhxo heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Merari, ix ak'chaj juntzanh chonhab' t'a heb' t'a yol yik heb' yinhtilal Zabulón: Rimón yet' Tabor. Ha t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', aynhej b'aj swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.

Axo t'a yol yik heb' yinhtilal Rubén t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'ha ha' Jordán, t'a yichanhb'at Jericó, ix ak'chaj juntzanh chonhab' tik t'a heb': Beser t'a jun ak'lik tzinan lu'um, Jaza, Cademot yet' Mefaat. Ha t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', aynhej b'aj swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.

Axo t'a yol yik heb' yinhtilal Gad, ix ak'chajpax juntzanh chonhab' tik t'a heb': Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad, Mahanaim, Hesbón yet' Jazer. Ha t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', aynhej b'aj swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Isacar chanhwanh heb' winh: Aton winhaj Tola, winhaj Fúa, winhaj Jasub yet' winhaj Simrón.

Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Tola chi': Aton winhaj Uzi, winhaj Refaías, winhaj Jeriel, winhaj Jahmai, winhaj Jibsam yet' winhaj Semuel. Aton heb' winh chi' yajal yaj t'a skal yinhtilal. Ha t'a stiempoal winhaj rey Dawid, 22 mil 600 sb'isul heb' soldado te jelan t'a owal t'a skal heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Tola chi'.

Ha winhaj Uzi chi' ay jun yuninal winh, aton winhaj Israhías. Ha winhaj Israhías chi' ay chanhwanh yuninal winh: Vinhaj Micael, winhaj Obadías, winhaj Joel yet' winhaj Isías. Ha winh yet' heb' winh yuninal chi' yajal yaj t'a skal heb' yinhtilal.
Yujto tzijtum heb' ix yetb'eyum heb' winh yet' yal yuninal junjun heb' winh, yuj chi' ha t'a skal heb' winh, ay 36 mil sb'isul heb' winh soldado te jelan t'a owal.
Ha sb'isul masanil heb' winh soldado yinhtilal heb' chanhwanh yuninal winhaj Isacar chi' te jelan t'a owal, ay 87 mil heb'.
Oxwanh heb' winh yuninal winhaj Benjamín: Aton winhaj Bela, winhaj Bequer yet' winhaj Jediael.

Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Bela chi', owanh heb' winh: Vinhaj Ezbón, winhaj Uzi, winhaj Uziel, winhaj Jerimot yet' winhaj Iri. Masanil juntzanh heb' winh chi', yajal yaj heb' winh t'a skal heb' yinhtilal. Axo sb'isul heb' soldado t'a skal yinhtilal heb' winh, ay 22 mil 34 heb'.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Bequer: Aton winhaj Zemira, winhaj Joás, winhaj Eliezer, winhaj Elioenai, winhaj Omri, winhaj Jerimot, winhaj Abías, winhaj Anatot yet' winhaj Alemet.
Ha sb'isul heb' soldado t'a skal yinhtilal heb' winh, ay 20 mil 200 heb'.

Ha winhaj Jediael ay jun yuninal winh: Aton winhaj Bilhán. Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Bilhán chi': Aton winhaj Jeús, winhaj Benjamín, winhaj Aod, winhaj Quenaana, winhaj Zetán, winhaj Tarsis yet' winhaj Ahisahar.
Ha juntzanh heb' winh tik yajal yaj heb' winh t'a skal heb' yinhtilal, te jelan heb' winh t'a owal. Axo sb'isul heb' soldado t'a skal yinhtilal heb' winh chi', ay 17 mil 200 heb'.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Ir, aton winhaj Supim yet' winhaj Hupim. Axo yuninal winhaj Aher, aton winhaj Husim.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Neftalí: Aton winhaj Jahzeel, winhaj Guni, winhaj Jezer yet' winhaj Salum. Aton juntzanh heb' winh tik yinhtilal winhaj Jacob yet' ix Bilha.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Manasés yet' ix aj Siria schab'il yetb'eyum: Aton winhaj Asriel yet' winhaj Maquir, smam winhaj Galaad.

Ha winhaj Maquir chi', ix yik'laj sb'a winh yet' ix Maaca, yinhtilal winhaj Hupim yet' winhaj Supim. Ay jun yuninal winhaj Maquir chi', aton winhaj Zelofehad. Ha jun winh chi', anhej heb' ix yisil winh ay.

Axo ix Maaca yetb'eyum winhaj Maquir chi', ix alji chawanh swinak unin ix. Peres ix yak' ix sb'iej jun, haxo junxo Seres. Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Peres chi', Ulam sb'i winh b'ab'el, Requem sb'i junxo winh.
Axo jun yuninal winhaj Ulam chi', aton winhaj Bedán. Ha heb' winh tik a winhaj Galaad yuninal winhaj Maquir ay yinhtilal heb' winh, aton winh yixchiquin winhaj Manasés.
Ha jun ix yanab' winhaj Maquir chi': Aton ix Hamolequet, aton ix snun winhaj Isod, winhaj Abiezer yet' winhaj Mahala.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Semida: Aton winhaj Ahián, winhaj Siquem, winhaj Likhi yet' winhaj Aniam.

Ha heb' yinhtilal Efraín sb'eynhejkot t'a stzolal: Aton winhaj Sutela, winhaj Bered, winhaj Tahat, winhaj Elada, winhaj Tahat, winhaj Zabad, winhaj Sutela. Ay chawanhxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Efraín chi', aton winhaj Ezer yet' winhaj Elad, milb'ilcham heb' winh yuj heb' kajan t'a Gat, yujto ix emk'och heb' yelk'ej nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' kajan t'a Gat chi'.
Ha winhaj Efraín smam heb' winh chi', tzijtum k'ual ix te kus winh. Ix jawi heb' sk'ab'yok winh yak' sniwanil sk'ool.
Ixlajwi chi' ix alji pax junxo yuninal winhaj Efraín chi' yet' ix yetb'eyum, Bería ix yak' winh sb'iej, yujto ix ek' jun niwan kusk'olal chi' t'a heb'.
Ha ix Seera yisil winhaj Bería chi', a ix ix b'oank'e chonhab' Bet-horón jun ay t'a yalanh yet' Bet-horón ay t'a yib'anh yet' chonhab' Uzen-seera.
Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Bería sb'eynhejkot t'a stzolal: Aton winhaj Refa, winhaj Resef, winhaj Telah, winhaj Tahán, winhaj Laadán, winhaj Amiud, winhaj Elisama, winhaj Nun, winhaj Josué.

Axo sluum heb' winh b'aj kajan: Aton Betel yet' Naarán t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, Gezer t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u yet' Siquem masanto sk'och t'a Ayah. Ix scha juntzanh chonhab' chi' heb' winh yet' yaldeail.

Ha heb' winh yinhtilal Manasés, ix kajnaj heb' winh t'a chonhab' Bet-seán, Taanac, Meguido, Dor yet' yaldeail juntzanh chonhab' chi'. Aton t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi' ix kajnaj heb' yinhtilal José, yuninalkan winhaj Israel.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Aser: Aton winhaj Imna, winhaj Isúa, winhaj Isúi, winhaj Bería yet' ix Sera yanab' heb' winh.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Bería chi': Aton winhaj Heber yet' winhaj Malquiel smam winhaj Birzawit.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Heber chi': Aton winhaj Jaflet, winhaj Semer, winhaj Hotam yet' ix Súa yanab' heb' winh.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jaflet chi': Aton winhaj Pasac, winhaj Bimhal yet' winhaj Aswat.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Semer chi': Aton winhaj Ahí, winhaj Rohga, winhaj Jehúba yet' winhaj Aram.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Helem: Aton winhaj Sofa, winhaj Imna, winhaj Seles yet' winhaj Amal.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Sofa chi': Aton winhaj Súa, winhaj Harnefer, winhaj Súal, winhaj Beri, winhaj Imra,
winhaj Beser, winhaj Hod, winhaj Sama, winhaj Silsa, winhaj Itrán yet' winhaj Beera.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jeter: Aton winhaj Jefone, winhaj Pispa yet' winhaj Ara.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Ula: Aton winhaj Ara, winhaj Haniel yet' winhaj Rezia.

Masanil juntzanh heb' winh tik yinhtilal Aser heb' winh. Yajal yaj heb' winh t'a skal heb' yinhtilal, te jelan heb' winh t'a owal, te niwak pax yelk'och heb' winh. Ha sb'isul heb' soldado t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Aser chi', ay 26 mil heb'.
Ha winhaj Benjamín owanh yuninal winh: Aton sb'i heb' winh tik t'a stzolal: Vinhaj Bela, winh b'ab'el, winhaj Asbel, winhaj Ahara, winhaj Noha yet' winhaj Rafa.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Bela chi': Aton winhaj Adar, winhaj Gera, winhaj Abiud, winhaj Abisúa, winhaj Naamán, winhaj Ahoa, winhaj Gera, winhaj Sefufán yet' winhaj Hiram.

Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Aod: Aton winhaj Naamán, winhaj Ahías yet' winhaj Gera. Ha heb' winh tik yajal yaj heb' winh t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok kajan t'a Geba, palta ik'jinaquel heb' t'a Geba chi', ik'chajnakb'at kajan heb' t'a Manahat yuj winhaj Gera smam winhaj Uza yet' winhaj Ahiud.
Ha winhaj Saharaim ayto juntzanhxo heb' winh yuninal winh ix alji ayik ayek' winh t'a Moab, ayik toxo ix spuklaj sb'a winh yet' heb' ix yetb'eyum, aton ix Husim yet' ix Baara.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winh yet' junxo ix yetb'eyum skuchan Hodes: Aton winhaj Jobab, winhaj Sibia, winhaj Mesa, winhaj Malcam,
winhaj Jeúz, winhaj Saquías yet' winhaj Mirma. Ha juntzanh heb' winh tik yajal yaj heb' winh t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok.
Ay chawanh yuninal winh yet' ix yetb'eyum skuchan Husim chi', aton winhaj Abitob yet' winhaj Elpaal.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Elpaal chi': Aton winhaj Heber, winhaj Misam yet' winhaj Semed. Ha winhaj Semed chi' b'oannakk'e chonhab' Ono, chonhab' Lod yet' yaldeail.
Ha winhaj Bería yet' winhaj Sema, yajal yaj heb' winh t'a skal heb' kajan t'a Ajalón, pechjinaquel heb' kajan t'a Gat yuj heb' winh.
Ha heb' yinhtilal winhaj Bería chi': Aton winhaj Ahío, winhaj Sasac yet' winhaj Jeremot, winhaj Zebadías, winhaj Arad, winhaj Ader, winhaj Micael, winhaj Ispa yet' winhaj Joha.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Elpaal: Aton winhaj Zebadías, winhaj Mesulam, winhaj Hizqui, winhaj Heber, winhaj Ismerai, winhaj Jezlías yet' winhaj Jobab.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Simei: Aton winhaj Jaquim, winhaj Zicri, winhaj Zabdi, winhaj Elienai, winhaj Ziletai, winhaj Eliel, winhaj Adaías, winhaj Beraías yet' winhaj Simrat.

Eb' winh yuninal winhaj Sasac: Aton winhaj Ispan, winhaj Heber, winhaj Eliel, winhaj Abdón, winhaj Zicri, winhaj Hanán, winhaj Hananías, winhaj Elam, winhaj Anatotías, winhaj Ifdaías yet' winhaj Peniel.
Eb' yuninal winhaj Jeroham: Aton winhaj Samserai, winhaj Seharías, winhaj Atalías, winhaj Jaresías, winhaj Elías yet' winhaj Zicri.
Ha juntzanh heb' winh ix b'inaj tik, yajal yaj heb' winh t'a junjun makan yinhtilal ix kajnaj t'a Jerusalén.
Ha t'a chonhab' Gabaón ek'nak winhaj Jehiel smam yicham heb' aj Gabaón chi'. Maaca sb'i ix yetb'eyum winh.

Ha heb' winh yuninal winh: Aton winhaj Abdón winh b'ab'el, winhaj Zur, winhaj Cis, winhaj Baal, winhaj Ner, winhaj Nadab, winhaj Gedor, winhaj Ahío, winhaj Zequer yet' winhaj Miclot, smam winhaj Simea. Anhejtona' juntzanh heb' winh tik ix kajnajpax heb' winh yet' heb' winh sk'ab'yok t'a Jerusalén.
Ha winhaj Ner chi' smam winhaj Cis, haxo winhaj Cis smam winhaj Saúl. Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Saúl chi': Aton winhaj Jonatán, winhaj Malquisúa, winhaj Abinadab yet' winhaj Es-baal.
Ay jun yuninal winhaj Jonatán chi', aton winhaj Merib-baal, smam winhaj Micaía.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Micaía chi': Aton winhaj Pitón, winhaj Melec, winhaj Tarea yet' winhaj Acaz.
Axo winhaj Acaz chi' smam winhaj Joada, haxo winhaj Joada chi' smam winhaj Alemet, winhaj Azmawet yet' winhaj Zimri. Axo winhaj Zimri chi' smam winhaj Mosa.
Axo heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Mosa chi' t'a stzolal: Vinhaj Bina, winhaj Rafa, winhaj Elasa, winhaj Azel.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Azel wakwanh heb' winh: Vinhaj Azricam, winhaj Bocru, winhaj Ismael, winhaj Searías, winhaj Obadías, winhaj Hanán.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Esec yuk'tak winhaj Azel: Aton winhaj Ulam winh b'ab'el unin, schab'il winhaj Jehús, yoxil winhaj Elifelet.

Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Ulam chi', te tek'an heb' winh yak'an owal, yojtak wal heb' winh sjulwaji. Tzijtum yuninal heb' winh yet' yixchiquin, 150 sb'isul heb' winh t'a smasanil. Masanil juntzanh heb' winh chi', a winhaj Benjamín ay yinhtilal heb' winh.
Icha tik ix aj stz'ib'chajkan masanil heb' israel t'a stzolal tas yaj yinhtilal heb' b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' sreyal Israel. Ha heb' anima ay t'a Judá, ik'chajnakb'at heb' t'a Babilonia yuj schukal.
Ha heb' yinhtilal Israel b'ab'laj meltzajxikot t'a sluum yet' t'a schonhab', aton heb' sakerdote, heb' lewita yet' heb' smunlaj t'a templo.
Ha t'a Jerusalén ix kan kajan heb' yinhtilal Judá, heb' yik Benjamín, heb' yik Efraín yet' heb' yik Manasés.

Ha t'a yinhtilal Judá chi', ay 690 heb' winh winak t'a smasanil. Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Fares yuninal winhaj Judá, a winhaj Utai yuninal winhaj Amihud yajal yaj t'a skal heb' yet' pax juntzanhxo heb' smam yicham t'a stzolal: Aton winhaj Omri, winhaj Imri, winhaj Bani yet' winhaj Fares yuninal winhaj Judá chi'. Ha t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Sela yuninal winhaj Judá chi', a winhaj Asaías winh b'ab'el unin, yajal yaj pax winh t'a heb' sk'ab'yok. Axo t'a skal heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Zera, yuninal pax winhaj Judá chi', a winhaj Jeuel yajal yaj t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok.

Aton sb'i heb' winh yajal yaj t'a heb' yinhtilal Benjamín tik: Vinhaj Salú yuninal winhaj Mesulam yixchiquin winhaj Hodabías, yinhtilal winhaj Asenúa, winhaj Ibneías yuninal winhaj Jeroham, winhaj Ela yixchiquin winhaj Uzi, yinhtilal winhaj Micri, winhaj Mesulam yuninal winhaj Sefatías, yixchiquin winhaj Reuel, yinhtilal winhaj Ibnías. 956 heb' t'a smasanil.

Axo heb' winh sakerdote kajan t'a Jerusalén yajal yaj t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok: Aton winhaj Jedaías, winhaj Joiarib, winhaj Jaquín yet' winhaj Azarías yuninal winhaj Hilcías. Ha heb' smam yicham winhaj Azarías t'a stzolal: Aton winhaj Mesulam, winhaj Sadoc, winhaj Meraiot yet' winhaj Ahitob. Ha winhaj Azarías chi' yajal t'a stemplo Dios. Anheja' t'a skal heb' winh yajal yaj chi', ayoch winhaj Adaías yuninal winhaj Jeroham. Ha sb'i heb' smam yicham winhaj Adaías chi' t'a stzolal: Aton winhaj Jeroham, winhaj Pasur, winhaj Malquías, winhaj Masai, winhaj Adiel, winhaj Jahzera, winhaj Mesulam, winhaj Mesilemit yet' winhaj Imer. Ha juntzanh heb' winh tik yajal yaj heb' winh t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok. Ha t'a skal heb', ay mil 760 heb' winh te nhikan smunlaj t'a skajnub' Dios.
Ha heb' winh yajal yaj t'a skal heb' lewita kajan t'a Jerusalén: Aton winhaj Semaías yuninal winhaj Hasub, yixchiquin winhaj Azricam, schab'il yixchiquin winhaj Hasabías, yinhtilal winhaj Merari.
Yajal pax winhaj Bacbacar, winhaj Heres, winhaj Galal yet' winhaj Matanías yuninal winhaj Micaía, yixchiquin winhaj Zicri, yinhtilal winhaj Asaf.

Yajal pax yaj winhaj Obadías yuninal winhaj Semaías, yixchiquin winhaj Galal, yinhtilal winhaj Jedutún yet' winhaj Berequías, yuninal winhaj Asa, yixchiquin winhaj Elcana ek'nak kajan t'a juntzanh aldea yik heb' netofatita.
Axo heb' winh stanhwan puerta: Aton winhaj Salum, winhaj Acub, winhaj Talmón, winhaj Ahimán yet' heb' winh sk'ab'yok heb' winh. Ha winhaj Salum yajal yaj t'a heb' winh.
Ha heb' winh tik stanhwannhej puerta yik heb' winh rey t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u. Aton heb' winh stanhwan puerta chi' t'a skal heb' yetlewitail.

Ha winhaj Salum yuninal winhaj Coré, yixchiquin winhaj Ebiasaf, yinhtilal winhaj Coré yet' heb' sk'ab'yok, a heb' stanhwan skajnub' Dios, icha ajnak stanhwan spuertail skajnub' Dios chi' heb' smam yicham heb' t'a peka'.
Ha t'a peka' chi', a winhaj Finees yuninal winhaj Eleazar ayoch yajalilok heb' stanhwan skajnub' Dios chi'. Aynhej wal och Jehová yet' winh.
Axo winhaj Zacarías yuninal winhaj Meselemías, a winh stanhwan spuertail b'aj sch'ox sb'ha Dios.

Ha sb'isul heb' stanhwan spuertail kajnub' sik'b'ilel chi', 212 heb' tz'ib'ab'ilkani icha tas yinhtilal junjun makan b'aj kajan heb'. Ha winhaj rey Dawid yet' winhaj Samuel schekab' Dios ak'jinakkanoch heb' t'a yopisio niwan yelk'och chi'.
Masanil heb' yet' pax yuninal heb', ayoch heb' t'a stzolal stanhwan spuertail skajnub' Dios.
Aynhejoch stanhwumal chi' t'a schanhil pak'anh: D'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, t'a stojolal norte yet' t'a stojolal sur.
Ha heb' yetlewitail heb' kajan t'a juntzanhxo aldea, t'a junjun yuktaquil k'ual sjawi heb' stanhwej templo chi', yik skolwaj heb' yet' heb'.
Ay chanhwanh heb' lewita niwak yopisio stanhwan puerta chi'. Ha heb' chi' ayoch heb' t'a masanil tiempo stanhwan juntzanh kuarto yet' b'aj smolchaj tas tz'ak'ji t'a skajnub' Dios chi'.
Ha heb' chi' aynhejek' heb' t'a spatiktak kajnub' chi' tzek' ak'wal, yujto a heb' stanhwani. Axo t'a junjun q'uinhib'alil sjakan kajnub' chi' heb'.
Ay juntzanh heb' t'a skal heb' chi' stanhwan juntzanh yamk'ab' sk'anchaji yik tz'och ejmelal d'ha Dios. Yowalil sb'is heb' jantak tz'elta, slajwi chi' sb'isan heb' yochxikani.
Axo juntzanhxo heb' tz'ilan juntzanhxo yamk'ab' niwak yelk'ochi yet' pax ixim harina, wino, akeite, inkienso yet' perfume.
Ay pax heb' sakerdote sb'oan perfume chi'.
Axo jun winh lewita skuchan Matatías, b'ab'el yuninal winhaj Salum, yinhtilal winhaj Coré, a winh sb'oan ixim pan tz'ak'ji ofrendail.
Axo juntzanhxo heb' winh yetlewitail heb' winh, heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Coat, a heb' winh sb'oan ixim pan tz'em tzolan t'a sat mexa t'a yol skajnub' Dios t'a junjun k'ual ik'oj ip.

Anhejtona' ay heb' winh yajal yaj t'a yinhtilal heb' winh lewita chi' sb'itani. Ha t'a juntzanh kuarto yik templo chi' ay heb' winh, malaj yalan yik heb' winh t'a juntzanhxo munlajel, yujto k'ual t'ak'wal yajoch heb' winh t'a yopisio chi'.
Ha heb' winh ix b'inaj tik, yajal yaj heb' winh t'a skal masanil heb' yinhtilal Leví chi', icha yaj stzolal yinhtilal heb' winh. Ha t'a Jerusalén kajan heb' winh.
Ha t'a chonhab' Gabaón, ata' ek'nak kajan winhaj Jehiel, smam yicham heb' aj Gabaón chi'. Maaca sb'i ix yetb'eyum winh.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winh: Aton winhaj Abdón winh b'ab'el unin, winhaj Zur, winhaj Cis, winhaj Baal, winhaj Ner, winhaj Nadab, winhaj Gedor, winhaj Ahío, winhaj Zacarías yet' winhaj Miclot.
Ha winhaj Miclot chi' smam winhaj Simeam. Ha juntzanh heb' winh tik ix kajnaj heb' winh yet' heb' sk'ab'yok t'a Jerusalén.
Ha winhaj Ner smam winhaj Cis, haxo winhaj Cis chi' smam winhaj Saúl. Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Saúl chi': Aton winhaj Jonatán, winhaj Malquisúa, winhaj Abinadab yet' winhaj Es-baal.
Ha winhaj Jonatán chi' smam winhaj Merib-baal smam winhaj Micaía.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Micaía chi': Aton winhaj Pitón, winhaj Melec, winhaj Tarea yet' winhaj Acaz.

Axo winhaj Acaz smam winhaj Jara. Axo winhaj Jara chi' smam winhaj Alemet, winhaj Azmawet yet' winhaj Zimri. Axo winhaj Zimri chi' smam winhaj Mosa. Axo winhaj Mosa chi' smam winhaj Bina. Axo winhaj Bina chi' smam winhaj Refaías, winhaj Elasa yet' winhaj Azel.
Eb' yuninal winhaj Azel chi', wakwanh heb' winh: Aton winhaj Azricam, winhaj Bocru, winhaj Ismael, winhaj Searías, winhaj Obadías yet' winhaj Hanán.
Ix yak' owal heb' filisteo yet' heb' israel, ix el lemnaj heb' israel chi', te niwan heb' ix cham t'a lum witzal Gilboa.
Ix b'at heb' filisteo chi' t'a spatik winhaj Saúl yet' heb' winh yuninal: Aton winhaj Jonatán, winhaj Abinadab yet' winhaj Malquisúa. Ix miljicham heb' winh yuninal winh chi' yoxwanhil.
Ix ochwal heb' winh filisteo chi' t'a spatik winhaj Saúl chi', ix lajwi winh sjulan heb' winh.

Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a winh ed'jinak syamk'ab' icha tik: Ik'k'eta k'een espada chi', tza tipanoch k'een t'ayin, yik wach' manhok juntzanh ch'ok chonhab'il tik ol tzalaj in smilani, xchi winh. Palta a winh ed'jinak syamk'ab' winh chi', maj yal-laj sk'ol winh ix sk'ulej icha ix yal winh chi', yujto xiw winh. Yuj chi' a winh ix ik'ank'eta k'een yespada, ix syumanb'at nhojnaj sb'a winh t'a yib'anh snhi' k'een.
Ayic ix yilan winh ed'jinak syamk'ab' winh chi' to toxo ix cham winh, ix syumanpaxb'at nhojnaj sb'a winh t'a yib'anh snhi' k'een yespada chi', ix champax winh.
Icha chi' ix aj scham winhaj Saúl t'a jun k'u chi' yet' oxwanh heb' winh yuninal. Manhxo junok yinhtilal winh ix elkani.

Ayic ix yilan heb' israel kajan t'a jun ch'olan chi' to toxo ix el lemnaj heb' yetisraelal heb', toxo ix champax winhaj Saúl yet' heb' winh yuninal, yuj chi' ix yaktejkan schonhab' heb', ix b'at heb' elelal. Axo heb' filisteo ix k'ochkan kajan t'a juntzanh schonhab' heb' chi'.

Axo t'a junxo k'u, ix b'at heb' filisteo chi' spojek' tastak ay t'a heb' ix cham chi'. Ix yilan heb' to a winhaj Saúl yet' heb' winh yuninal chamnakxo heb' winh, teljab'kan sniwanil heb' winh t'a lum witzal Gilboa.

Ha spichul winhaj Saúl chi' yik owal ayochi, elanhchamel ix yik'el heb', ix xikanel sjolom winh heb'. Ix yik'anb'at heb'. Ix schekan heb' b'at alchaj t'a masanil yol smakb'en heb' yet' t'a sdiosal heb'.
Ix b'at yak'anoch syamk'ab' winhaj Saúl chi' heb' t'a stemplo jun sdiosal skuchan Dagón, ix yak'ank'e lokan sjolom winh heb'.
Ayic ix yab'an heb' aj Jabes ay t'a yol yik Galaad tas ix yutej sniwanil winhaj Saúl heb' filisteo chi',

ix slajtian sb'a masanil heb' winh winak te tek'an. Ix b'at yik'ankot sniwanil winhaj Saúl chi' heb' yet' pax sniwanil heb' winh yuninal winh, ix k'och yuj heb' t'a Jabes chi'. Ha t'a yich jun te' ji ix smuk sniwanil heb' winh chi' heb'. Uque' k'ual ix och heb' t'a tzek'ojk'olal yuj kusk'olal.

Icha chi' ix aj scham winhaj Saúl yuj chukal ix sk'ulej, yujto maj sk'anab'ajej scheknab'il Jehová winh, yujto ix sk'anb'ej pax sb'a winh t'a jun ix sk'uman spixan heb' chamnak, manhok t'a Jehová ix sk'anb'ej sb'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix cham winh yuj Jehová, haxo t'a winhaj Dawid yuninal winhaj Isaí ix ak'jikan yopisio winh chi'.
Ix smolb'ej sb'a masanil heb' israel, ix b'at lolon heb' yet' winhaj Dawid t'a Hebrón. Ix yalan heb' t'a winh icha tik: Ha onh tik, junnhej ko mam quicham ed'ok.

Ha t'a yalanhtaxo wach'chom a winhaj Saúl ayoch reyal, palta a ach ix onh a kuchb'ej ayik ix kak'an owal. Anhejtona', ix yal Jehová ko Diosal t'ayach to a ach ol onh a kuchb'ej, ol ach ochpaxkan ko reyalok, xchi heb' t'a winh.

Ayic ix k'och heb' yichamtak winaquil chonhab' Israel lolonel yet' winh t'a Hebrón chi', ix sb'oan jun strato winh yet' heb' t'a yichanh Jehová. Ata' ix ak'jik'e akeite t'a sjolom winh yik tz'ochkan winh sreyalok Israel, icha wal tas scheknak Jehová yal winhaj Samuel.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj rey Dawid chi' yet' masanil heb' yetisraelal t'a Jerusalén, skuchan pax Jebús, b'aj kajan heb' jebuseo.

Ix yalan heb' jebuseo chi' t'a winh icha tik: Ha ach tik, manh ol yal-laj ochta t'a tik, xchi heb' t'a winh. Palta ix ak'ji ganar skuartel heb' t'a tzalan Sion chi' yuj winh, yuj chi' ix skuchkan schonhab' winhaj Dawid.

Ix yalan winh icha tik: Ha mach ol b'ab'lajoch yak' owal yet' heb' jebuseo tik, ol wak'och yajalilok heb' soldado, xchi winh. Axo winhaj Joab yune' ix Sarwia ix b'ab'laji, yuj chi' ix och winh yajalilok heb' soldado chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix kajnaj winhaj rey Dawid t'a kuartel t'a Sion chi', yuj chi' Schonhab' Vinhaj Dawid ix sb'iejkani.
Ix sb'ok'e juntzanhxo pat winh t'a spatiktak chi', ix schab'at t'a ch'olan masanto ix k'och t'a smuroal chonhab'. Axo winhaj Joab ix wach' b'oan stz'akub' chonhab' Jebús chi'.
Ix yik'an stek'anil yopisio winhaj rey Dawid chi', yujto a Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil aynhejoch yet' winh.

Ha heb' winh soldado winhaj rey Dawid te b'inajnak, ix och heb' winh yet' masanil heb' yetisraelal ayik ix yak'anoch winhaj Dawid chi' heb' reyal t'a yol smakb'en Israel smasanil. Ix te och wal heb' winh yet' winh yik syak'an reyal winh icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová.

Aton slistail heb' winh soldado winhaj rey Dawid te b'inajnak chi': Ha winhaj Jasobeam yuninal winhaj Hacmoni, sat yaj winh t'a skal oxwanhxo heb' winh yetb'inajnaquil chi'. Ha t'a junel ix smilcham 300 heb' winh winak winh yet' k'een slanza.
Axo junxo winh t'a skal heb' winh oxwanh chi', aton winhaj Eleazar yuninal winhaj Dodo, yinhtilal winhaj Aho.

Ha t'a junel ayek' winh yet' winhaj rey Dawid t'a Pas-damim ayik ix smolb'an sb'a heb' filisteo yak' owal ta'. Ata' ay jun munlajel b'aj awab'il ixim kebada. Ayic ix el lemnaj heb' soldado Israel t'a yichanh heb' filisteo,

haxo heb' winh chawanh chi' ix kan tek'naj t'a skal jun munlajel chi', yik syak'an owal heb' winh. Ix ak'ji ganar heb' filisteo chi' yuj heb' winh. Icha chi' ix aj skolchajkan chonhab' Israel yuj Jehová.

Ha t'a junel, a oxwanh heb' winh soldado te b'inajnak chi', ix b'at heb' winh t'a sattak k'een yik b'at schalan sb'a heb' winh yet' winhaj rey Dawid t'a jun k'een nhak'een skuchan Adulam. Axo heb' filisteo ay skampamento heb' t'a sch'olanil Refaim.
Ayic ayek' winhaj Dawid t'a k'een nhak'een chi', ayek' skampamento heb' filisteo t'a Belén.
Yujto ste takji sti' winhaj Dawid chi', yuj chi' ix yal winh icha tik: Comonoc a ha ha' ay t'a stiel chonhab' Belén swuk'ej, xchi winh.

Axo oxwanh heb' winh soldado te b'inajnak chi', ix och heb' winh t'a skampamento heb' filisteo, ix b'at yik'anelta ha ha' heb' winh t'ha ha' uk'b'ila' t'a stiel chonhab' Belén chi', ix yik'ankot ha' heb' winh t'a winhaj Dawid chi'. Palta maj yal-laj sk'ol winh ix yuk'ej ha', tonhej ix sequem ha' winh t'a sat lu'um silab'il t'a Jehová.

Ix yalan winh icha tik: Mokab' scha Dios wuk' ha ha' tik. Ichato ha' schiq'uil heb' winh tik swuk'ej tato swuk' ha', yujto ix sb'ek sb'a heb' winh schami yik ix b'at yik'ankot ha' heb' winh, xchi winh. Yuj chi' maj yuk'ejlaj ha' winh. Aton jun tik ix sk'ulej heb' winh oxwanh te b'inajnak chi'.

Ha winhaj Abisai yuk'tak winhaj Joab, yajal yaj winh t'a 30-xo heb' winh te b'inajnak. Ha t'a jun pekti’, ix smilcham 300 winak winh yet' k'een slanza. Icha wal chi' ix aj yik'an sb'inajnaquil winh t'a skal heb' winh 30 chi'.
Yuj chi' te niwan ix aj yelk'och winh t'a yichanh heb' winh chi'. Ix och winh yajalok heb' winh, palta maj k'ek'och winh icha heb' winh oxwanh b'ab'el chi'.

Ha winhaj Benaía yuninal winhaj Joiada aj chonhab' Cabseel, te b'inajnak pax winh, tzijtum tas ix sk'ulej winh. Ha winh ix milancham chawanh soldado yuninal winhaj Ariel aj Moab. Axo t'a junel ayik te ay k'een sakb'akom, ix em winh t'a yol jun jul. Ata' ix smilcham jun nok' choj winh.

Anhejtona' ix smilcham jun winh aj Egipto winh. Nanhal am yoxil metro steel winh aj Egipto chi', haxo steal k'een slanza winh yet'nak, niwan spatik. Palta a winhaj Benaía chi' anhej jun te te' yet'nak winh. Ix yik'ek' k'een slanza winh aj Egipto chi' winh, haxo yet' k'een slanza winh chi', ix smilcham winh.
Ha yuj juntzanh tas ix sk'ulej winh chi' ix yik' wal sb'inajnaquil winh icha heb' winh oxwanh b'ab'el b'inajnak chi'.
Niwan ix aj sb'inaj winh t'a yichanh heb' winh 30 chi', palta maj k'ochlaj icha heb' winh oxwanh chi'. Ix ak'jioch winhaj Benaía chi' yuj winhaj rey Dawid yajalilok heb' stanhwumal.
Ha heb' winh 30 b'inajnak chi', aton heb' winh tik: Vinhaj Asael yuk'tak winhaj Joab, winhaj Elhanán yuninal winhaj Dodo aj Belén,
winhaj Samot aj Harod, winhaj Heles aj Pelón,
winhaj Ira yuninal winhaj Iques aj Tecoa, winhaj Abiezer aj Anatot,
winhaj Sibecai aj Husa, winhaj Ilai aj Aho,
winhaj Maharai aj Netofa, winhaj Heled yuninal winhaj Baana aj Netofa paxi,
winhaj Itai yuninal winhaj Ribai aj Gabaa ay t'a yol yik Benjamín, winhaj Benaía aj Piratón,
winhaj Hurai kajan t'a sti' ha' Gaas, winhaj Abiel aj Arba,
winhaj Azmawet aj Bahurim, winhaj Eliaba aj Saalbón,
heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jasén aj Gizón, winhaj Jonatán yuninal winhaj Sage aj Harar,
winhaj Ahíam yuninal winhaj Sacar aj Harar paxi, winhaj Elifal yuninal winhaj Ur,
winhaj Hefer aj Mequera, winhaj Ahías aj Pelón,
winhaj Hezro aj Carmel, winhaj Naarai yuninal winhaj Ezbai,
winhaj Joel yuk'tak winhaj Natán, winhaj Mibhar yuninal winhaj Hagrai,
winhaj Selec aj Amón, winhaj Naharai aj Berot. Ha jun winh chi' ed'jinak syamk'ab' winhaj Joab yune' ix Sarwia,
winhaj Ira aj Itra, winhaj Gareb aj Itra paxi,
winhaj Urías hitita, winhaj Zabad yuninal winhaj Ahlai,
winhaj Adina yuninal winhaj Siza, yinhtilal Rubén, yajal yaj winh t'a skal heb' yinhtilal chi', 30 heb' winh winak ajun yet' winh,
winhaj Hanán yuninal winhaj Maaca, winhaj Josafat aj Mitán,
