winhaj Uzías aj Astarot, winhaj Sama yet' winhaj Jehiel, heb' winh yuninal winhaj Hotam aj Aroer,
winhaj Jediael yuninal winhaj Simri yet' winhaj Joha yuk'tak winh, aj Tiza heb' winh,
winhaj Eliel aj Mahab, winhaj Jerebai yet' winhaj Josavía. Ha heb' winh tik yuninal heb' winh winhaj Elnaam, winhaj Itma aj Moab,
winhaj Eliel, winhaj Obed yet' winhaj Jaasiel, aj Soba heb' winh.
Ayic wan spechji b'eyek' winhaj Dawid yuj winhaj Saúl yuninal winhaj Cis, ay jun nhilanh heb' winh jelan yak'an owal ix b'at yak'och sb'a yet' winh t'a Siclag.

Ha juntzanh heb' winh soldado chi' ay sjul-lab' heb' winh yet' ch'anh smejmeech yet'nak. Syal sjulwaj heb' winh t'a schab'il sk'ab'. Ha t'a skal heb' winh chi' ay heb' winh ayto yuj sb'a yet' winhaj Saúl t'a yinhtilal Benjamín. Aton heb' winh tik:

Ha winhaj Ahiezer sat yajal yaj winh yet' winhaj Joás yuk'tak winh, yuninal heb' winh winhaj Semaa aj chonhab' Gabaa, winhaj Jeziel yet' winhaj Pelet, heb' winh yuninal winhaj Azmawet, winhaj Beraca yet' winhaj Jehú aj chonhab' Anatot heb' winh,
winhaj Ismaías aj Gabaón. Ha jun winh tik ayoch winh stz'akub'ok heb' winh 30 b'inajnak, yajal yaj pax winh t'a heb' winh, winhaj Jeremías, winhaj Jahaziel, winhaj Johanán, winhaj Jozabad aj Gedera,
winhaj Eluzai, winhaj Jerimot, winhaj Bealías, winhaj Semarías, winhaj Sefatías aj chonhab' Haruf,
winhaj Elcana, winhaj Isías, winhaj Azareel, winhaj Joezer yet' winhaj Jasobeam, yinhtilal heb' winh winhaj Coré,
winhaj Joela yet' winhaj Zebadías heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jeroham aj chonhab' Gedor.

Ay pax juntzanh heb' winh yinhtilal Gad ix b'at yak'och sb'a yet' winhaj Dawid chi' ayik ayek' winh t'a k'een nhak'een t'a tzinan lu'um. Ha juntzanh heb' winh chi' te jelan heb' winh, k'ayb'ab'il yuj heb' winh yak'an owal, yet'nak smaklab' jul-lab' heb' winh yet' k'een slanza. Te ow sat heb' winh icha nok' choj. Te jelan sb'ey heb' winh icha sb'ey nok' k'ultaquil chej.

Ha sb'i heb' winh tik t'a stzolal, schael t'a winh b'ab'el masanto t'a winh yuxluchil: Vinhaj Ezer, winhaj Obadías, winhaj Eliab, winhaj Mismana, winhaj Jeremías, winhaj Atai, winhaj Eliel, winhaj Johanán, winhaj Elzabad, winhaj Jeremías yet' winhaj Macbanai.

Aton heb' winh tik yajal yaj t'a skal juntzanh heb' winh yinhtilal Gad chi'. Ha junok winh quennhej yopisio t'a skal heb' winh, yajal winh t'a junok 100 soldado, haxo junok winh niwan yopisio, yajal yaj winh t'a junok mil soldado.

Aton heb' winh ix k'axpajek' t'ha ha' Jordán t'a b'ab'el uj t'a yol ab'il, ayik ix te k'e ha', wan yel ha' t'a stitak b'aj sb'eyi. Ha heb' winh ix pechanel heb' anima kajan t'a ak'lik ay t'a sk'axepaltak ha'.
Anhejtona' ay pax juntzanhxo heb' winh yinhtilal Benjamín yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh yinhtilal Judá ix k'och yak'och sb'a yet' winhaj Dawid t'a k'een nhak'een chi'.

Ix elta winhaj Dawid chi' scha heb' winh, ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: Tato t'a junk'olal tzex jawi, yik tzex kolwaj wed'ok, tzex in cha t'a smasanil in k'ool, palta tato tzex jawi yik tzin eyak'och t'a yol sk'ab' heb' wajk'ol jun, wach'chom malaj junok tas chuk ix in k'ulej, aokab' ko Diosal, aton sDiosal heb' ko mam quicham ol yil sb'a eyed'ok, syak'anoch eyaelal, xchi winh t'a heb' winh.

Ix och Yespíritu Dios t'a winhaj Amasai yajalil heb' winh 30 soldado b'inajnak, yuj chi' ix yal winh icha tik: Skak' wal och ko b'a ed'ok ach Dawid yuninal winhaj Isaí. Ha ach tik yet' heb' ayoch ed'ok, wach'nhej ol aj eyelk'ochi, yujto a ko Diosal skolwaj wal ed'ok, xchi winh t'a winhaj Dawid chi'. Yuj chi' ix chaji heb' winh yuj winhaj Dawid chi', ix ak'ji yopisio heb' winh t'a skal heb' winh yajalil heb' winh soldado chi' yuj winh.

Ay pax juntzanhxo heb' winh soldado yinhtilal Manasés, ix och heb' winh yet' winhaj Dawid chi' ayik ix b'at winh yet' heb' winh filisteo yak' owal yet' winhaj Saúl yalani. Axo ix smolb'an sb'a heb' winh yajalil heb' filisteo chi', ix yalan heb' winh to max yal-laj sb'at winhaj Dawid chi' yet' heb' winh, yuj chi' ix schek meltzaj winh heb' winh t'a Siclag. Yujto ix yal heb' winh icha tik: Axo talaj tz'aji, a yet' winhaj Saúl syak'och sb'a winh, yujto yajal winhaj Saúl chi' winh, a onh xo tzonh smilcham winh t'a skal owal chi', xchi heb' winh.

Ayic wan sjaxkan winhaj Dawid t'a Siclag chi', ata' ix k'och heb' winh yinhtilal Manasés chi' yik syak'och sb'a heb' yet' winh, aton heb' winh tik: Vinhaj Adnas, winhaj Jozabad, winhaj Jediaiel, winhaj Micael, winhaj Jozabad, winhaj Eliú yet' winhaj Ziletai. Yajal yaj heb' winh t'a junjun mil soldado t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Manasés chi'.

Aton juntzanh heb' winh tik ix kolwaj yet' winhaj Dawid chi' ayik ix yak'an owal winh yet' jun nhilanh heb' soldado elk'um yujto te jelan heb' smasanil t'a owal. Ix och heb' winh yajalilok heb' winh soldado winhaj Dawid chi'.
Junjun k'u sq'uib' sb'isul heb' winh soldado ix yak'och sb'a yet' winhaj Dawid chi'. Te niwan heb' winh, te ay pax smay heb' winh.

Ha sb'isul juntzanh soldado te jelan ix k'och t'a winhaj Dawid t'a Hebrón yik tz'ak'jikanoch winh reyal sk'exulok heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Saúl yuj heb' winh, icha ix aj yalan Jehová, aton heb' winh tik:
Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal Judá, ay 6 mil 800 soldado yet'nak smaklab' jul-lab', yet'nak pax slanza heb' winh, lista yaj heb' winh yak'an owal.
Axo t'a heb' yinhtilal Simeón, ay 7 mil 100 heb' winh soldado tek'an.
Axo t'a heb' yinhtilal Leví, ay 4 mil 600 heb' winh soldado.
Ay pax 3 mil 700 t'a yinhtilal winhaj Aarón, a winhaj Joiada ayoch yajalilok heb' winh.
Ha winhaj Sadoc quelem winh, te tek'an winh t'a owal. Ay 22 heb' sk'ab'yok winh, yajal yaj heb' winh, ajun heb' winh yet' winh.

Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal Benjamín, aton heb' sk'ab'yok winhaj Saúl, ay 3 mil heb' winh soldado ix k'och yet' winhaj Dawid chi'. Ayic mantzak uji jun tik, quen manh masanilok heb' ayoch yet' heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Saúl.
Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal Efraín, ay 20 mil 800 heb' winh soldado te tek'an, te b'inajnak heb' winh t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok.
Ha t'a nanhal heb' yinhtilal Manasés, ay 18 mil heb' winak ix chekjikoti yik tz'ak'jikanoch winhaj Dawid reyal.

Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal Isacar, ix jawi 200 heb' winh yajal yet' pax masanil heb' winh soldado ayoch t'a yalanh smandar heb' winh. Ha juntzanh heb' winh winak tik, snachaj wal el yuj heb' winh tas smoj sk'ulej chonhab' Israel.
Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal Zabulón, ay 50 mil heb' winh soldado smoj sb'at t'a owal, syalnhej sk'anan masanil yamk'ab' yik owal heb' winh, b'ekan sk'ool heb' winh skolwaj yet' winhaj Dawid chi'.
Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal Neftalí, ay mil heb' winh yajal yaji yet' 37 mil heb' winh soldado yet'nak slanza yet' smaklab' jul-lab'.
Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal Dan, ay 28 mil 600 heb' winh soldado smoj sb'at t'a owal.
Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal Aser, ay 40 mil heb' winh soldado smoj sb'at t'a owal.

Axo t'a heb' ay t'a sk'axepal ha' Jordán, ay 120 mil heb' winh soldado t'a yinhtilal Rubén, t'a yinhtilal Gad yet' pax t'a nanhalxo yinhtilal Manasés. Ha heb' winh chi' tz'akan yaj heb' winh yet' masanil syamk'ab' yik owal.

Ha masanil juntzanh heb' winh soldado tik, ix ja heb' winh t'a Hebrón ayik ix yak'ankanoch winhaj Dawid heb' winh sreyalok chonhab' Israel. Anhejtona' juntzanhxo heb' yetisraelal heb', junxonhej ix aj spensar heb' smasanil.
Oxe' k'ual ix ek' heb' yet' winhaj Dawid chi' ta'. Ix wa heb', ix yuk'an ha' heb', yujto a heb' yetchonhab' heb' ix ak'an jantak tas ix swa heb' chi'.

Masanil heb' kajan t'a slak'aniltak chi' yet' heb' kajan t'a najat, icha heb' yinhtilal Isacar, heb' yinhtilal Zabulón yet' heb' yinhtilal Neftalí, ix yik'kot wael heb' kuchb'il yuj nok' b'uru, nok' kamello, nok' mula yet' pax nok' wakax. Tzijtum makanhil wael ix yik'kot heb', icha ixim harina, taquinh higo, taquinh uwa, wino, akeite, nok' wakax yet' nok' kalnel. Te niwan tas tz'ab'laj ix yik'kot heb', yujto manhxo jantakok tzalajk'olal t'a Israel chi'.
Ix lolon winhaj rey Dawid yet' masanil heb' winh yajal yaj t'a junjun nhilanh heb' winh soldado.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh t'a masanil heb' yetisraelal icha tik: Ex wetisraelal, tato scha he k'ool, schaanpax sk'ol Jehová ko Diosal, skawtej heb' quetisraelal ay t'a yol ko makb'en tik, heb' aytokan t'a juntzanhxo lugar. Scavtej pax masanil heb' sakerdote yet' juntzanhxo heb' lewita ayek' t'a schonhab' yet' t'a slum b'aj swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb',
yik wach' b'at quik'kot te' skaxail strato ko Diosal. Yujto atax t'a stiempoal winhaj Saúl ix b'atkan te' satk'olal kuuj, xchi winhaj Dawid chi'.
Masanil heb' chonhab', ix cha sk'ol heb' to icha chi' tz'aji, yujto wach' jun pensar chi' ix yab' heb'.

Ix smolb'ej masanil heb' yetisraelal winhaj rey Dawid t'a yol masanil smakb'en, skotnhej t'ha ha' Sihor t'a smojonal Egipto, masanto b'aj tzonh k'och t'a chonhab' Amat, yik sb'at ik'chajkot te' skaxail strato Dios t'a Quiriat-jearim,
skuchanpax Baala t'a yol yik Judá. Ix b'at yik'kot te' skaxail strato Jehová Dios chi' heb' ta', aton Dios ay t'a yib'anh heb' querubín b'aj tz'ik'chajchaanh sb'i.
Ix yik'elta te' skaxail strato Dios chi' heb' t'a spat winhaj Abinadab, ix yak'ank'e te' heb' t'a yib'anh jun te' ak' karreta. Axo winhaj Uza yet' winhaj Ahío, ix kuchb'an b'ey te' karreta chi'.

Axo winhaj rey Dawid yet' masanil heb' yetisraelal, ste tzalaj wal heb' t'a yichanh Dios. Yed' wal smasanil yip heb' sk'e cheneljok, sb'itan heb' yet' arpa, salterio, panderas, platillo yet' trompeta.
Palta ayik ix jawi heb' t'a stek'lab' trigo winhaj Quidón, a winhaj Uza chi' ix b'at yub'naj winh t'a te' skaxail trato chi', yujto ijan ix telwi nok' wakax tok'jinak te' karreta chi'.
Yuj chi' ix kot yowal Jehová t'a winh, ix chamkan winh ta' yuj, yujto ix b'at yub'naj winh t'a te' skaxail trato chi'.
Ix kot yowal winhaj rey Dawid chi', yujto ix kot yowal sk'ol Jehová t'a winhaj Uza chi', ix cham winh yuj. Yuj chi' Pérez-uza ix sb'iejnhejkan jun lugar chi'.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi' ix te xiw winhaj rey Dawid d'ha Dios, ix yalan winh icha tik: Tekan manhxo ol yal-laj wik'anb'at te' skaxail strato Dios b'aj kajan in, xchi winh.
Majxo yik'kot te' winh b'aj kajan chi', anhej to ix yal winh to skan te' t'a spat winhaj Obed-edom aj Gat.

Ha te' skaxail strato Jehová chi', oxe' ujal ix kan te' t'a spat winhaj Obed-edom chi'. Ix yak' wal swach'k'olal Jehová t'a yib'anh winh yet' yetb'eyum yet' yalyuninal yet' t'a yib'anh masanil tas ay t'a winh.

Ha winhaj Hiram sreyal Tiro, ix yak'kot schekab' winh t'a winhaj rey Dawid. Ix yak'anpaxkot heb' albañil winh yet' heb' nhikum te', ix yik'ankot te' k'ute' heb' yik sb'ochaj spalakio winhaj rey Dawid chi'.
Yuj chi' ix nachajel yuj winhaj rey Dawid chi' to a Jehová ix ak'anoch winh reyal t'a chonhab' Israel. Ix ik'jichaanh yopisio winh yuj Jehová yujto xajan chonhab' Israel yuj.
Ay juntzanhxo heb' ix yetb'eyum winhaj rey Dawid ix yik' t'a Jerusalén, yuj chi' ayto yuninal winh yet' yisil ix alji yet' heb' ix.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winh ix alji t'a Jerusalén chi', aton winhaj Samúa, winhaj Sobab, winhaj Natán, winhaj Salomón,
winhaj Ibhar, winhaj Elisúa, winhaj Elpelet,
winhaj Noga, winhaj Nefeg, winhaj Jafía,
winhaj Elisama, winhaj Beeliada yet' winhaj Elifelet.

Ayic ix yab'an heb' filisteo to toxo ix och winhaj Dawid sreyalok masanil heb' israel, ix och ijan heb' sayan tas tz'aj yak'an ganar, palta elanhchamel ix yab' winh, ix elta winh t'a yichanh heb' chi'.
Ix jawi heb' filisteo chi' yak' chukal t'a heb' anima kajan t'a sch'olanil Refaim.

Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'ej winhaj rey Dawid d'ha Dios icha tik: --¿Tzam yal wak'an owal yet' heb' filisteo tik? ¿Ol am ak'och heb' t'a yol in k'ab'? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi Jehová t'a winh: --Ak' owal yet' heb', yujto ol wak'och heb' t'a yol a k'ab', xchi.

Yuj chi' ix k'e winhaj rey Dawid b'aj ayek' heb' filisteo chi'. Ata' ix ak'ji ganar heb' yuj winh. Ix yalan winh icha tik: Icha wal tz'aj sjakan sb'e junok ha' eluma', icha chi' ix aj sjakan b'e Jehová t'ayin t'a skal heb' wajk'ool, xchi winh. Yuj chi' Baal-perazim ix yak' winh sb'iej jun lugar chi'.
Ix yaktejkan juntzanh sdiosal heb' filisteo chi', yuj chi' ix schek winhaj rey Dawid chi' nhusjoktz'aok.
Palta a heb' filisteo chi', ix jaxxi heb' t'a sch'olanil yik Refaim chi'.

Yuj chi', ix sk'anb'ejxi winhaj rey Dawid chi' d'ha Dios, ix yalan Dios t'a winh icha tik: --Ha tiknaik, manh ach och t'a sat heb' ak'an owal, palta to ha t'a spatik heb' tzach koti, b'aj ay te' bálsamo.

Ayic ol ab'ani ichato ay mach wan sb'eyek' t'a sk'ab'tak te te' chi', tzach och ak' owal yet' heb'. Ha jun chi' syalelk'ochi to a in ol in b'ab'laj t'a eyichanh yik tzin milancham heb' soldado filisteo chi', xchi Jehová.
Icha ix aj yalan Dios, icha wal chi' ix yutej winhaj Dawid chi', yuj chi' ix satel heb' soldado filisteo chi', ix b'atnhej t'a Gabaón masanto ix k'och t'a Gezer.
Icha wal chi' ix aj sk'echaanh sb'inajnaquil winhaj rey Dawid t'a masanil nakión. Ha Jehová ix ak'an xiwk'e masanil nakión chi' t'a winh.
Ix schekan winhaj rey Dawid b'ochajk'e juntzanh pat t'a jun chonhab' skuch Schonhab' winhaj Dawid. Ix sik'anel jun lugar winh b'aj tz'aj te' skaxail strato Dios t'a yol jun mantiado ix b'ochaji.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winh icha tik: Ha heb' manh lewitaok, max yal yik'anb'ey te' skaxail trato heb', yujto a Jehová ix sik'anel heb' lewita chi' yik syik'an b'ey te' kaxa chi' heb', yik tz'ak'jipax serwil yuj heb' t'a masanil tiempo, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yawtejkot masanil heb' yetisraelal winh, ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' t'a Jerusalén, yik sb'at ik'chajkot te' skaxail strato Jehová yik tz'ochkan te' t'a jun lugar b'ob'ilxo yuj winh.
Ix smolb'an pax masanil heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Aarón winh yet' juntzanhxo heb' lewita.
Ha t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Coat, 120 heb' ix molchaji, a winhaj Uriel yajal yaj t'a heb' sk'ab'yok.
Axo t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Merari, 220 heb' ix molchaji. Ha winhaj Asaías yajal yaj t'a masanil heb' sk'ab'yok.
Ha t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Gersón, 130 heb' ix molchaji. Ha winhaj Joel yajal yaj t'a masanil heb' sk'ab'yok.
Axo t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Elizafán, 200 heb' ix molchaji: Ha winhaj Semaías yajal yaj t'a heb' sk'ab'yok.
Ha t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Hebrón, 80 heb' ix molchaji. Ha winhaj Eliel yajal yaj t'a masanil heb' sk'ab'yok.
Ha t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Uziel, 112 heb' ix molchaji, a winhaj Aminadab yajal yaj t'a masanil heb' sk'ab'yok.

Ix yawtan heb' winh sakerdote winhaj rey Dawid chi', aton winhaj Sadoc, winhaj Abiatar yet' pax juntzanhxo heb' winh lewita, aton winhaj Uriel, winhaj Asaías, winhaj Joel, winhaj Semaías, winhaj Eliel yet' winhaj Aminadab.

Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: Ha ex lewita ex tik, yajal eyaj t'a skal masanil heb' he k'ab' eyok, b'oek he b'a icha yalan ley yet' masanil heb' he k'ab' eyok, yik syal eyik'ankot te' skaxail strato Jehová ko Diosal, yik tz'ochkan te' t'a jun lugar b'ob'il wuuj.
Yujto ha t'a sb'ab'elal, manhok ex ix eyik'kot te', yuj chi' ix kot yowal sk'ool Jehová ko Diosal t'a quib'anh, yujto manh chamok ix ko k'anb'ej kab'i tas sko k'ulej, xchi winh.
Yuj chi', ix sakb'itan sb'a heb' winh icha yalan ley, yik wach' syal yik'ankot te' skaxail strato Jehová sDiosal Israel chi' heb' winh.
Ix sb'akhankot te' heb' winh t'a sjolom sjenhjab' yet' te' sb'akhlab'il, icha ajnak yalankan winhaj Moisés yuj Jehová.

Ix yalanpax winhaj rey Dawid chi' t'a heb' winh yajalil heb' lewita to ha t'a skal yinhtilal heb' winh chi', sik'chajelta heb' winh sb'itan t'a tzalajk'olal yet' juntzanh yamk'ab', aton salterio, arpa yet' platillo.

Yuj chi' ha t'a skal heb' winh yinhtilal Leví chi' ix sik'chajel heb' winh stzinhan platillo, aton heb' winh tik: Vinhaj Hemán yuninal winhaj Joel yet' winhaj Asaf yuninal winhaj Berequías sk'ab'yok winhaj Hemán chi' yet' winhaj Etán yuninal winhaj Cusaías. Ha heb' winh tik yinhtilal heb' winh winhaj Merari. Ix sik'chajpaxoch juntzanhxo heb' winh tz'ak'an te' arpa: Aton winhaj Zacarías, winhaj Jaaziel, winhaj Semiramot, winhaj Jehiel, winhaj Uni, winhaj Eliab, winhaj Benaía, winhaj Maaseías, winhaj Matatías, winhaj Elifelehu, winhaj Micnías yet' heb' winh stanhwan puerta, aton winhaj Obed-edom yet' winhaj Jeiel.
Axo winhaj Quenanías yajalil heb' winh lewita chi'. Ha winh skuchb'an heb' winh t'a b'it chi', yujto te jelan winh.

Axo heb' winh stanhwan te' skaxail trato: Aton winhaj Berequías, winhaj Elcana, winhaj Obed-edom yet' winhaj Jehías. Axo heb' winh sakerdote: Aton winhaj Sebanías, winhaj Josafat, winhaj Natanael, winhaj Amasías, winhaj Zacarías, winhaj Benaía yet' winhaj Eliezer. Aton heb' winh spu'an trompeta t'a yichanh te' skaxail strato Dios chi'.

Ha winhaj rey Dawid yet' masanil heb' winh yichamtak winaquil chonhab' Israel yet' heb' winh yajalil heb' winh soldado, te tzalajk'olal yaj heb' ayik ix xid' yik'an te' skaxail strato Jehová chi' heb' t'a spat winhaj Obed-edom chi'.
Ix och wal Dios yet' heb' lewita chi' ayik ix yik'ankot te' kaxa chi' heb', yuj chi' ix yak' ukwanh nok' mam wakax heb' yet' ukwanh nok' ch'ak kalnel silab'il.

Ha pichul lino te wach' ayoch yuj winhaj rey Dawid chi', icha pax chi' yik heb' winh lewita b'akhjinak te' kaxa chi' yet' yik heb' winh sb'itani yet' yik winhaj Quenanías skuchb'an heb' winh. Ay pax och jun chaleka nab'a lino yuj winhaj rey Dawid chi'.
Masanil heb' israel ix el yaw heb' yuj tzalajk'olal ayik ix ik'jikot te' skaxail strato Jehová chi', ix puchaj nok' ch'aak kalnel yet' trompeta, ix tzinhji platillo, salterio yet' arpa.

Ayic ix jawi te' skaxail strato Jehová chi' t'a Schonhab' winhaj rey Dawid, haxo ix Mical ix yetb'eyum winh, aton ix yisil winhaj Saúl, ix elta t'anhan ix t'a swentena. Ayic ix yilan ix to a winhaj rey Dawid chi', sk'echennaj winh yuj tzalajk'olal, yuj chi' ix schaquel winh ix t'a spensar.

Ix ak'jioch te' skaxail strato Dios chi' t'a yol jun mantiado b'ob'ilxok'e yuj winhaj rey Dawid chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix snhusan juntzanh silab' heb' stz'a smasanil yet' juntzanh silab' yik junk'olal yet' Dios.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan wach' lolonel winh rey chi' t'a yib'anh masanil heb' anima t'a sb'i Jehová.
Ix yak'an junjun ixim pan winh yet' jab'jab' nok' chib'ej yet' juntzanh te' taquinh sat uwa t'a junjun anima chi'.

Ix yak'ankanoch yopisio heb' winh lewita winh yik smunlaj heb' winh b'aj ay te' skaxail strato Jehová, aton heb' winh chi' yowalil tz'ak'an yuj diosal, syalanpax wach' lolonel heb' winh t'a Jehová sDiosal chonhab' Israel t'a b'ital.

Ha mach skuchb'an heb' winh t'a b'it chi', aton winhaj Asaf, haxo winh schab'il, aton winhaj Zacarías. Slajwi chi' skot pax winhaj Jeiel, winhaj Semiramot, winhaj Jehiel, winhaj Matatías, winhaj Eliab, winhaj Benaía, winhaj Obed-edom yet' winhaj Jeiel. Aton heb' winh chi' ay syamk'ab' yik b'it, ay salterio heb' winh, ay pax yarpa heb' winh. Axo winhaj Asaf chi' stzinhan platillo.
Axo pax heb' winh sakerdote: Aton winhaj Benaía yet' winhaj Jahaziel, a heb' winh spu'annhej k'een trompeta t'a yichanh te' skaxail strato Dios.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi' b'ab'elto ix yal winhaj rey Dawid t'a winhaj Asaf yet' pax t'a heb' winh ayoch yet' winh to sb'itej juntzanh ak'oj yuj diosal tik heb' winh t'a Jehová:
Kaq'ek yuj diosal t'a Jehová. Calequel yab'ixal. Calec t'a masanil chonhab' tas ix sk'ulej.
Co b'itejek b'it yuj quik'anchaanh. Calequel tas satub'tak yilji sk'ulejnak Jehová.
Conh tzalajek yujto yik onhxo. Ayokab' tzalajk'olal yik skak'anem ko b'a t'ay.
Co k'anek skolwal Jehová, kak'equem ko b'a t'ay t'a masanil tiempo.
Ha onh yuninal onh winhaj Jacob schekab' Jehová, a onh chonhab' israel onh tik, to sik'b'il onh eli, ko naekkot tastak satub'tak yilji sk'ulejnak Jehová yet' tas syutej sch'olb'itan t'a stojolal.
Ha Jehová ko Diosal, Yajal t'a masanil sat lu'um tik.
Syak'nhej elk'och strato t'a masanil k 'inal. Ha tas yalnakkani, syak'nhej elk'och t'a smilal makanhil anima tz'eq'ui,
aton jun strato sb'onak yet' winhaj Abraham, b'aj yak'nakpax sti' t'a winhaj Isaac.
Ley ajnakkan jun tik t'a winhaj Jacob. Ha jun strato tik ix kan t'ayonh a onh israel onh tik t'a junelnhej,
ayik yalannakkan Jehová icha tik: Ol wak' lum Canaán t'ayach, ol ochkan lum a makb'enok, xchinakkan t'a winhaj Jacob chi'.
Jaywanhanto sb'isul heb' ta'. Tonhej skomon ek' heb' t'a sat lum lum tik.
Tzijtum chonhab' b'aj ek'nak kajan heb' t'a yoltak smakb'en heb' rey.
Manh yalnakoklaj sk'ool Dios ixtajnak heb', yuj chi' icha tik yalnak t'a juntzanh heb' rey chi':
Manh eyixtej heb' in chekab' sik'b'ilel tik, xchi.
Conh b'itanek t'a Jehová ko masanil a onh kajan onh t'a sat lu'um tik. Calequeli to tzonh skolnhej Jehová t'a junjun k'u.
Calequel sniwanil yelk'ochi yet' tas satub'tak yilji sk'ulej t'a masanil chonhab' yet' t'a masanil nakión.
Yujto a Jehová te niwan yelk'ochi, smoj wal tz'alchaj wach' lolonel t'ay. Te ay spoder t'a yichanh juntzanh komon Dios.
Ha sdiosal juntzanh chonhab', malaj jab'ok yelk'ochi, palta a Jehová b'oannak satcha’anh.
Niwan chequel sniwanil yelk'ochi yet' sb'inajnaquil. Ha swach'il yilji yet' spoder scheklaj t'a skajnub'.
Ex anima t'a junjun chonhab', alek to a Jehová te niwan yelk'ochi, te ay pax spoder.
Alec wach' lolonel t'ay yujto niwan yelk'ochi. Ochanhec yet' eyofrenda t'a yamaq'uil stemplo Jehová. Ochanhec ejmelal t'ay t'a skajnub' te wach' yilji.
Ib'xokab'k'e masanil anima t'a yichanh. A' ix tzatzb'itan yol yib'anhk’inal tik, yuj chi' max ib'xilaj.
Tzalajokab' satcha’anh yet' lum lum tik. Calec yab' junjun chonhab' to a Jehová rey toni.
k'anhokab' ha' mar, elokab' yaw masanil tas ay t'a yol ha'. Tzalajokab' masanil lum lum b'aj sb'o munlajel yet' masanil tastak ay t'a sat lu'um.
Elokab' yaw te' niwak te' t'a yichanh Jehová yuj tzalajk'olal, yujto sja yak' yajalil t'a sat lu'um tik.
Kaq'ek yuj diosal t'a Jehová yujto wach'nhej, tzonh xajanej t'a masanil tiempo.
Calec icha tik: Mamin, ko Kolumal ach, kolonh. Tzonh a molb'anxikot t'a skal juntzanh ch'ok nakional, yik skak' yuj diosal, skalan wach' lolonel t'ayach t'a tzalajk'olal.

Calec wach' lolonel t'a Jehová ko Diosal t'a masanil tiempo a onh israel onh tik, xe chi, xchi winhaj Dawid chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan masanil anima: Ujokab' icha tzal chi', xchi heb'. Yuj chi' ix yal wach' lolonel heb' t'a Jehová.
Ixlajwi chi', a winhaj rey Dawid chi' ix ak'ankanoch winhaj Asaf yet' heb' winh yetlewitail yik syilannhej heb' winh yoch ejmelal b'aj ix kan te' skaxail strato Jehová t'a junjun k'u.

Ix kanpax winhaj Obed-edom yet' 68 heb' winh ajun yet' winh yik skolwaj heb' winh yet' heb' winh. Axo pax winhaj Obed-edom yuninal winhaj Jedutún yet' winhaj Hosa, a heb' winh ix tanhwankan spatil chi'.
Ix kanpax winhaj sakerdote Sadoc yet' heb' winh yetsakerdoteal ajun yet'ok yik syilan heb' winh yoch ejmelal t'a skajnub' Dios t'a Gabaón, aton jun anhej Jehová ay yiko'.
Ha heb' winh snhusan silab' t'a Jehová t'a masanil tiempo t'a altar, t'a q'uinhib'alil yet' t'a yemk'ualil, icha wal yajkan t'a sley Jehová ak'b'ilkan yuj t'a chonhab' Israel.

Ha yet' heb' winh sakerdote chi', ix kan pax winhaj Hemán, winhaj Jedutún yet' pax jaywanhxo heb' winh sik'b'ileli yik sb'itan heb' winh, syalan heb' winh icha tik: Calec wach' lolonel t'a Jehová, yujto tzonh xajanej t'a masanil tiempo, xchi heb' t'a sb'it chi'.
Ha juntzanh heb' winh tik, spu k'een strompeta heb' winh, stzinhan splatillo heb' winh yet' juntzanh yamk'ab' yik b'it d'ha Dios. Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jedutún chi' stanhwan ti' puerta.
Ixlajwi chi', ix laj meltzaj masanil heb' anima chi' t'a spat. Ix meltzaj pax winhaj rey Dawid yik b'at yalan wach' lolonel winh t'a yib'anh masanil heb' kajan yet'ok t'a spat.

Ayic kajanxoek' winhaj rey Dawid t'a yol spalakio ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Natán schekab' Dios icha tik: --Ilnab'i, a in tik ayinxo och t'a yol in palakio nab'a k'ute' ayoch t'ay, palta haxo skaxail strato Jehová, ha t'a yol mantiado ayeq'ui, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Natán chi' icha tik: --Syalnhej a b'oan masanil tas tza nib'ej yujto ayoch Dios ed'ok, xchi winh.
Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi' ix lolon Dios t'a winhaj Natán chi', ix yalan t'a winh icha tik:
Ixic, b'at al t'a winh in chekab' aj Dawid to a in Jehová in swal icha tik t'a winh: Manhok ach ol a b'ok'e junok in templo b'aj ol in kajnajok.
Yictax wik'annaquelta heb' he mam eyicham t'a Egipto masanto tiknaik, manta b'aj tzin kajnaj t'a yol junok pat, palta to anhej t'a yoltak mantiado ix in ajeq'ui.

Masanil tiempo ix in b'eyek' yet' heb' he mam eyicham chi', malaj b'aj walnak t'a heb' yajalil heb' skuchb'ani to sb'o junok templo heb' nab'a k'ute' tz'och t'ay b'aj tzin kajnaji, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a winh.
Tzalanpax t'a winh to a in swal icha tik: Ha in Jehová Yajal waj t'a smasanil, a in swal icha tik: Ha in ix ach wik'el t'a tanhwum kalnelal yik tzach och yajalil t'a in chonhab' Israel tik.
B'ajtaktil ix ach eq'ui ayinnhej och ed'ok, ix in satel masanil heb' ajk'ol ix ak'an owal ed'ok, ol ach wak'an b'inajok, icha sb'inaj heb' niwak yajal ay t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik.

Anhejtona' ix in sik'elta jun lum b'aj tzex kajnajkan a ex in chonhab' ex tik. Ha tik ol ex kannhej kajan t'a junelnhej. Manhxa mach ol ex xib'tanok, manhxo ol ex tzuntzaj yuj heb' eyajk'ool icha ix ex yutej heb' t'a sb'ab'elal,
ayik ix wak'anoch heb' ix ex kuchb'ani. Ha in ol in satel masanil heb' eyajk'ool. Swak'anpax ojtaquejeli to ol wak'nhej opisio t'a heb' inhtilal.
Ayic ol lajwoquek' a k 'inal, yik mukb'il achxo, ol wak'och junok uninal reyal a k'exulok, tek'an wal ol wutej yopisio chi'.
Ha jun uninal chi' ol b'oank'e in templo b'aj ol in b'inajok. Ha in ol wak'nhejkan yopisio chi' t'a yinhtilal.

Ha in ol in och smamok, haxo ol och wuninalok. Malaj b'ak'uinh ol waktejkan in xajanani. Manh ichaok wutejnak waktankan in xajanan winhaj Saúl, wik'naquel winh t'a yopisio yik ach och sk'exulok winh, manh ichok ta' ol wutok.
Ol wak'nhej yopisio uninal chi' t'a in chonhab'. Ha yopisio chi' ol b'eynhejb'at t'a masanil tiempo, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a winh, xchi t'a winhaj Natán chi'.
Yuj chi' masanil tas ix yal Jehová t'a winhaj Natán chi', ix yal winh t'a winhaj rey Dawid chi'.

Yuj chi' ix och winh rey chi' t'a yichanh Jehová, ix em k'ojan winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: Mamin Jehová in Diosal, ¿tas wal welk'och a in tik? ¿tas pax wal yelk'och heb' in mam wicham, yuj chi' niwan a wach'k'olal tzak' t'ayin?

Ach in Diosal, manhoknhej juntzanh tik ix ak' t'ayin, wan alanpaxkani to ol ak' a wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh heb' winhtilal t'a b'ak'uinh. Lajan tzin utej icha juntzanh heb' niwak winak t'a sat lu'um tik.
¿Tasto wal syal walan t'ayach yuj sniwanil welk'och tzak'a'? Ha ach tik Mamin Jehová, ojtak wal tas waji.
Mamin Jehová, yujto tzin a xajanej a in a chekab' in tik, yuj chi' ix el t'a a k'ool, ix ak'an juntzanh opisio satub'tak tik t'ayin, ix ak'an wojtaquejeli.
Mamin Jehová, malaj junokxo mach lajan ed'ok. Ha achnhej toni, malaj junokxo Dios skab' spekal icha ach tik.

Ha onh pax a chonhab' Israel onh tik, malaj junokxo chonhab' lajan qued'ok, yujto a ach ix onh a kolo', yik tzonh ochkan a chonhab'ok. Mamin Jehová ko Diosal, te niwan ix aj a b'inaj kuuj, yujto a k'ulejnak tas satub'tak ayik a kolannaquelta heb' ko mam quicham t'a Egipto. Ik'annaquel juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a yichanh heb'.
Yujto ix onh ak'och a chonhab'ok t'a junelnhej. Ha achxo Mamin Jehová, ach ochkan ko Diosaloc.
Ha tiknaik Mamin Jehová, elokab'k'och tas ix alkan t'ayin a in a chekab' in tik yet' t'a heb' winhtilal.

Elokab'k'och tas ix ala', yik wach' tzach ik'jichaanh. Mamin Jehová, ol alchajok to a ach Yajal aj t'a Smasanil, ko Diosal ach pax a onh israel onh tik. Ol ochnhej pax winhtilal t'a reyal t'a junelnhej t'a ichanh.
Mamin ach in Diosal, ix ak' wojtaquejeli to ol ochnhejkan winhtilal t'a wopisio. Yuj chi' tzin tek'b'ej in b'a in lesalwi t'ayach.
Ha ach tik Mamin Jehová, ko Diosal ach, a ach ix alkan jun wach'ilal tik t'ayin.

Ha tiknaik jun, elokab' t'a a k'ol ak'an a wach'k'olal t'a winhtilal, yik wach' ol ajnhej ek' heb' t'a ichanh. Ha ach ol ak' a wach'k'olal t'a heb', ol schaannhej heb' t'a masanil tiempo, xchi winhaj rey Dawid chi' t'a Jehová.
Ayic ix lajwi yek' juntzanh tik, ix ak'ji ganar heb' filisteo yuj winhaj rey Dawid. Ix kan heb' t'a yalanh smandar winh. Ix yik'anek' chonhab' Gat winh yet' yaldeail t'a yol sk'ab' heb'.
Ix ak'jipax ganar heb' moabita yuj winh, yuj chi' ix yak'och sb'a heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winh, ix ak'jikanoch t'a yib'anh heb' yak'an k'een tumin t'a winh.
Anhejtona' ix ak'jipax ganar winhaj Hadad-ezer sreyal Soba ay t'a stojolal Hamat yuj winh. Ha jun winh rey chi' wan smakan yikok lum lum masanto t'ha ha' Éufrates.

Ix yamchaj mil karruaje yik owal yuj winhaj Dawid chi' yet' heb' soldado. Ix yamchajpax 7 mil heb' soldado ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej yet' pax 20 mil heb' soldado sb'ey t'a yok. Ix spol d'inhchaj sch'anhal yok masanil nok' chej ed'jinak karruaje yik owal chi' heb', axonhej nok' sk'anchaj yik stok'an 100 karruaje ix kani.
Ix k'och heb' soldado sirio aj Damasco yik skolwaj heb' yet' winhaj Hadad-ezer chi', palta ix ak'jipax ganar heb' yuj winhaj rey Dawid chi', ix miljicham 22 mil heb'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'ankan juntzanh heb' soldado winh t'a skal heb' sirio aj Damasco chi'. Icha chi' ix aj skan heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winh, ix ak'jikanoch t'a yib'anh heb' yak'an k'een tumin t'a winh. B'ajtak ix yak' owal winhaj Dawid chi', ix yak'nhej ganar winh yuj Jehová.
Anhejtona', ix yik'anpaxek' juntzanh maklab' jul-lab' winh ayoch oro t'ay sk'an heb' yajalil heb' soldado winhaj Hadad-ezer chi', ix yik'ankot heb' t'a Jerusalén.

Niwan pax k'een bronke ix yik'ek' winh t'a Tibhat yet' t'a Cun, aton juntzanh chonhab' chi' ay t'a yol smakb'en winhaj rey Hadad-ezer chi'. Aton yet' k'een bronke chi' ix sb'o jun niwan pila winhaj rey Salomón. Ix sb'o pax juntzanh niwak oy winh yet' masanil yamk'ab' nab'a bronke ix k'anchaj t'a templo.
Ayic ix yab'an winhaj Toi sreyal Hamat to toxo ix ak'ji ganar masanil heb' soldado winhaj rey Hadad-ezer chi' yuj winhaj rey Dawid,

ix schekankot jun yuninal winh, skuchan Adoram. Yed'nak k'een oro winh, k'een plata yet' k'een bronke yik tz'ak'ji stzatzil sk'ool winhaj rey Dawid yet' yalan wach' lolonel t'a winh, yujto ix ak'ji ganar winhaj rey Hadad-ezer chi' yuj winh. Ha winhaj Toi chi' yak'nak owal winh yet' winhaj rey Hadad-ezer chi' t'a yalanhtaxo.

Ix yak' masanil juntzanh k'een chi' winhaj rey Dawid t'a Jehová. Junnhej ix aj yak'an k'een winh yet' k'een oro yet' k'een plata yik'naquek' winh t'a juntzanh nakión tik: Aton t'a Edom, t'a Moab, t'a Amón, t'a heb' filisteo yet' t'a heb' amalekita.
Yed' pax winhaj Abisai yune' ix Sarwia, yajalil jun makan heb' soldado winhaj rey Dawid, ix ak'ji ganar heb' soldado yik Edom yuj winh. 18 mil heb' ix smilcham winh t'a yak'likal Atz'am Atz'am.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'ankan juntzanh heb' soldado winh t'a Edom chi'. Yuj chi' masanil heb' edomita ix ochkan t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj rey Dawid chi'. B'ajtak ix yak' owal winh, ix yak'nhej ganar winh yuj Jehová.
Ha winhaj Dawid, ix yak' reyal winh t'a yib'anh chonhab' Israel. Te wach' ix yutej sb'eyb'al winh, t'a stojolal ix sb'o yaj winh tas yaj heb' chonhab'.
Ha winh yajalil heb' soldado, aton winhaj Joab yune' ix Sarwia. Axo pax winhaj Josafat yuninal winhaj Ahilud, tz'ib'um yaj winh t'a winh rey chi'.
Ha winhaj Sadoc yuninal winhaj Ahitob yet' winhaj Abimelec yuninal winhaj Abiatar, sakerdote heb' winh, haxo winhaj Savsa, tz'ib'um ab'ix winh.

Ha pax winhaj Benaía yuninal winhaj Joiada, yajal yaj winh t'a heb' quereteo yet' t'a heb' peleteo, aton heb' stanhwumal winh rey, haxo heb' winh yuninal winh rey chi', yajal yaj heb' yik skolwaj heb' yet' winh.
Ayic toxo ix ek' jun pekti’, ix cham winhaj Nahas sreyal heb' amonita, haxo winh yuninal winh skuchan Hanún ix ochkan reyal.

Ix sna' winhaj rey Dawid to yowalil sch'ox swach'k'olal winh t'a winhaj Hanún chi', yujto a winh smam winh ix sch'ox swach'k'olal winh t'a winh. Yuj chi' ix schekb'at juntzanh schekab' winhaj Dawid chi' t'a winhaj Hanún chi' yik syak'an sniwanil sk'ool winh yuj schamel winh smam winh chi'. Palta ayik ix k'och heb' winh chekab' t'a schonhab' heb' amonita,

a heb' winh yajal yaj t'a chonhab' chi', ix yal heb' winh t'a winhaj Hanún chi': Mamin rey, ¿tom tzak'och t'a a k'ool to niwan yelk'och winh a mam chi' t'a yol sat winhaj rey Dawid chi', yujnhej chi' ix schekkot juntzanh winak tik winh yik syak' sniwanil a k'ool heb' winh? Maay. Ix chekjikot heb' winh yuj winh yik syil heb' winh tas yaj ko chonhab' tik, yik tzul satanel heb' winh, xchi heb' winh t'a winh.

Yuj chi', ix schek winhaj Hanún chi' yamjok heb' winh schekab' winhaj rey Dawid chi'. Ix joxjiel xil sti' heb' winh, ix poljiel yoktak sti' spichul heb' winh masanto ix k'eul t'a sti' syoop heb' winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix schekan pax heb' winh winh.

Ayic ix yab'an winhaj rey Dawid tas ix aj heb' winh, ix schekanb'at schaumal heb' winh yujto te q'uixwelal ix utaj heb' winh. Ix alji t'a heb' winh to skan heb' winh t'a Jericó masanto sq'uib'xi xil sti' heb' winh chi', ichato chi' syal smeltzaj paxta heb' winh.

Axo heb' amonita chi', ix nachajel yuj heb' to chuk ix kan heb' t'a winhaj rey Dawid chi', yuj chi' ix yak'b'at 660 quintal k'een plata winhaj Hanún chi' t'a Mesopotamia, t'a Siria, t'a Maaca yet' t'a Soba yik skot karruaje yet' heb' winh soldado ed'jinak yet' heb' winh soldado ayk'e yib'anh nok' chej yik skolwaj yet' winh.

Ix stupanpax heb' t'a winh sreyal Maaca yik skot winh yet' 32 mil karruaje yik owal yet' soldado. Ix sb'oank'e skampamento heb' ix tupchaj chi' t'a slak'anil chonhab' Medeba. Ix elpaxkot masanil heb' amonita chi' t'a yoltak schonhab', ix smolb'an sb'a heb' yik syak'an owal heb' yet' heb' israel.
Ayic ix yab'an jun chi' winhaj rey Dawid ix schekanb'at winhaj Joab winh yet' masanil heb' soldado.
Ix yak' lista sb'a heb' amonita chi' t'a owal t'a yichanh schonhab' heb'. Axo heb' winh rey ix yawtejkot heb' chi', ch'ok ix kan heb' winh t'a ak'lik.
Ayic ix yilan winhaj Joab to ay heb' ajk'ol t'a yichanh yet' t'a spatik, ix sik'anel heb' soldado te jelan winh yik syak'an owal heb' yet' heb' sirio chi'.
Axo nanhalxo heb' ix yak'och winh yik skuchb'aj heb' yuj winhaj Abisai yuk'tak winh yik syak'an owal heb' yet' heb' amonita chi'.
Ix yalan winhaj Joab chi' icha tik: Tato max onh tzak'wan t'a heb' sirio chi', elanhchamel tzex kolwaj qued'ok. Tato max ex tzak'wan t'a heb' amonita chi' jun, a onhxo ol b'at onh kolwaj eyed'ok.
Tek'b'ej a b'a, kak' owal yuj ko kolan heb' quetchonhab', aton schonhab' ko Diosal. Yak'okab' Jehová tas tz'el t'a sk'ool, xchi winhaj Joab chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winhaj Joab chi' yet' heb' soldado yak' owal yet' heb' sirio chi'. Axo ix aji, ix el lemnaj heb' t'a yichanh winh.

Ayic ix yilan heb' amonita to toxo ix el lemnaj heb' sirio chi', ix el pax lemnaj heb' t'a yichanh winhaj Abisai chi', ix och heb' skol sb'ha t'a yol schonhab'. Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzaj winhaj Joab chi' yet' masanil heb' soldado t'a Jerusalén.

Ayic ix yilan heb' sirio chi' to ix ak'ji ganar heb' yuj heb' israel, ix yak'anb'at schekab' heb' t'a heb' yetchonhab' ay t'a sk'axepalb'at ha' Éufrates yik skot heb' kolwal yet' heb'. Ha winhaj Sofac yajalil heb' soldado winhaj rey Hadad-ezer skuchb'an heb'.

Ix alchaj juntzanh tik t'a winhaj rey Dawid, yuj chi' ix smolb'anpax masanil heb' soldado Israel winh, ix k'axpajek' heb' t'ha ha' Jordán, ix k'och heb' b'aj ayek' heb' sirio chi'. Ix sb'oanoch soldado winhaj rey Dawid chi' t'a yichanh heb' sirio chi', haxo heb' ix ak'an owal yet' heb'.
Axo ix aji, ix el lemnaj heb' sirio t'a yichanh heb' israel chi'. Ay 40 mil heb' soldado sb'ey t'a yok ix chami yet' 7 mil heb' ayk'e t'a yol karruaje. Ix champax winhaj Sofac chi'.

Ayic ix yilan heb' ayoch yet' winhaj Hadad-ezer chi' to toxo ix ak'ji ganar heb' yuj heb' israel, ix och heb' t'a junk'olal yet' winhaj rey Dawid chi', ix kan heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winh. Atax ta' majxo yal sk'ol heb' sirio chi' ix kolwaj yet' heb' amonita.

Ha t'a junxo ab'il, t'a stiempoal sb'at heb' rey t'a owal, ix kan winhaj rey Dawid t'a Jerusalén, haxo winhaj Joab ix molb'anb'at heb' soldado yetisraelal yik syixtanb'at heb' tastak ay t'a yol smakb'en heb' amonita. Ix b'atnhej heb', ix yoymitan chonhab' Rabá heb', ix yak'an owal heb' yet'ok, masanto ix yak' ganar jun chonhab' chi' heb'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix k'och winhaj rey Dawid yik'kot skorona winh sreyal heb' amonita chi'. Nab'a oro jun korona chi', tzijtum k'een k'een wach' yilji ayoch t'ay, ay am oxeok arroba yalil. Ix yak'ank'e heb' t'a sjolom winhaj rey Dawid chi'. Manh jantakok tas karo stojol ix yik' winh t'a jun chonhab' chi'.

Axo masanil heb' anima ixto kani, ix ik'jib'at heb' yuj winh, ix ak'chajoch heb' t'a munlajel yet' k'een sierra, k'een piocha yet' k'een ch'akab'. Anheja' icha chi' ix sk'ulej winh yet' heb' amonita t'a juntzanhxo chonhab'. Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzajkot winh yet' masanil heb' soldado t'a Jerusalén.

Ixlajwi chi' ix och jun owal yet' heb' filisteo t'a Gezer. Ha t'a jun owal chi', a winhaj Sibecai aj Husa ix milancham winhaj Sipai. Ha winhaj Sipai chi' yinhtilal winh heb' chaanh steel. Icha chi' ix aj skan heb' filisteo t'a yol sk'ab' heb' israel.

Ix och junxo owal yet' heb' filisteo chi'. Ha winhaj Elhanán yuninal winhaj Jair ix milancham winhaj Lahmi yuk'tak winhaj Goliat aj Gat. Te niwan spatik yok slanza winhaj Lahmi chi', icha am spatik te te' b'aj sb'ak'chajoch anh ch'al yik heb' sch'alwi.
Ix och junxo owal t'a Gat. Ay junxo winh winak ta' te chaanh steel, lajchawe' yiximal sk'ab' winh, lajchawe' pax yiximal yok winh, yinhtilal pax winh heb' chaanh steel.
Ha jun winh chi', ix b'uchwaj winh t'a heb' israel, yuj chi' ix miljicham winh yuj winhaj Jonatán yuninal winhaj Simea yuk'tak winhaj rey Dawid chi'.
Ha juntzanh heb' winh niwak winak chi', a winhaj Réfah aj Gat ay yinhtilal heb' winh, palta ix miljicham heb' winh yuj winhaj rey Dawid yet' heb' soldado winh.
Ha winh Satanás ix och ajk'olal t'a heb' israel, yuj chi' ix yak' winh sk'ulej winhaj rey Dawid yik syik'anchaanh sb'isul heb' soldado israel winh smasanil.

Yuj chi' ix yal winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Joab yet' pax t'a heb' winh yajalil heb' soldado icha tik: --Ixiquec eyik'chaanh sb'isul heb' soldado. Sb'at he chakot t'a chonhab' Beerseba, masanto tzex k'och t'a chonhab' Dan. Ayic slajwi chi' tzeyik'ankot sb'isul heb' chi' t'ayin, yik swila' jantak heb' t'a smasanil.

Palta ix tak'wi winhaj Joab chi' icha tik: --Aokab' Jehová tz'ak'an q'uib' sb'isul schonhab' masanto maxtzak yal sb'ischaji. Mamin rey ayoch heb' t'a yol a k'ab' smasanil, ¿tas yuj tza nib'ej jun tik? Ha t'a jun tik ol och smul ko chonhab' tik uuj, xchi winh.
Palta majxo schalaj yab' winh rey chi' tas ix yal winhaj Joab chi', yuj chi' ix b'at heb'. Ayic ix lajwi yik'anchaanh sb'isul masanil heb' soldado Israel chi' heb', ix meltzaj heb' t'a Jerusalén.

Ix yak'an jantak sb'isul masanil heb' winh soldado winhaj Joab t'a winhaj Dawid chi', ay 470 mil heb' winh soldado yik Judá yet' pax t'a juntzanhxo smakb'en Israel ay jun millón yet' 100 mil heb' winh winak stiempo sb'at t'a owal.
Palta maj ochlaj heb' winh winak yinhtilal Leví yet' heb' winh yik Benjamín sb'isulok, yujto maj scha sk'ol winhaj Joab jun scheknab'il winh rey chi'.
Maj schapaxlaj sk'ol jun chi' Dios, yuj chi' ix yak'kot jun yaelal t'a yib'anh chonhab' Israel chi'.

Ichato chi' ix yalank'eta smul winhaj rey Dawid chi' d'ha Dios icha tik: --Te niwan in mul ix ochi, yujto ix in k'ulej jun tik, palta tzin k'an t'ayach to tzak' niwank'olal jun in mul tik, yujto icha junok quistal anima ix wutej in b'a, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yal Jehová t'a winhaj Gad schekab', aton winh tz'ak'an srazón winh rey chi', ix yalan icha tik:
Ixic, b'at il winhaj rey Dawid, tzalan t'a winh to a in Jehová in swal icha tik: Ay oxe' tas swak' a sik'lej, a ach ol a sik'lej tas junok ol wak' t'ayach, xchi Jehová.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Gad chi' yil winhaj rey Dawid chi', ix yalan winh t'a winh icha tik: --Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Sik'lej junok t'a skal juntzanh yaelal tik:

¿Tom ha' oxe' ab'il wejel, ma oxe' ujal ol yak' heb' ajk'ol ex smilanchamok, mato oxe' k'ual ilya ol yak' t'a yol a makb'en tik? Ha jun chi' wespada a in Jehová in tik, yujto a jun wángel ol satanel anima t'a yol a makb'en tik, xchi Jehová. Yuj chi' sik'lej tiknaik yik wach' ol yal wak'an spak t'a Jehová, aton in chekankoti, xchi winhaj Gad chi' t'a winh.

Ix yalan winhaj rey Dawid chi' t'a winhaj Gad chi' icha tik: --Maxtzac nachajlaj wuuj tas tzin sik'lej. Wach' ama to a Jehová tz'em sk'ab' t'a wib'anh, manhok anima swa sk'ab' t'ayin, yujto wojtak to niwan yok'elk'olal Jehová chi', xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yak'kot jun ilya Jehová t'a yib'anh chonhab' Israel chi', 70 mil heb' ix cham yuj.

Ix schekankot jun yángel Jehová yik satanel heb' anima t'a Jerusalén. Ayic wan satanel heb' anima chi', ix kusk'e sk'ol Jehová yuj jun yaelal chi', ix yalan t'a jun yángel wan smilancham anima chi' icha tik: Yechelxo chi', aktej, xchi t'ay. Ha wal t'a jun rato chi', a jun yángel Jehová chi', ay wal ek' b'aj wan stek'wi trigo winhaj Ornán jebuseo.

Axo ix k'e k'elan winhaj rey Dawid, ix yilan winh to ayek' jun yángel Jehová chi' t'a snanhal lum lum tik yet' satcha’anh, yet'nakk'e jun k'een espada, wan yak'anem k'een yespada chi' t'a yib'anh Jerusalén. Yed'nhej chi' ix em nhojan winhaj rey Dawid chi' yet' heb' yichamtak winaquil chonhab' Israel masanto t'a sat lu'um, ayoch pichul yik kusk'olal yuj heb'.

Ix yalan winhaj rey Dawid chi' d'ha Dios icha tik: --Mamin, a in wal ix wala' to tz'ik'jichaanh sb'isul heb' chonhab' tik. Ha in wal ix och in mul. Malaj smul heb' anima tik. Mamin Jehová, ach in Diosal, tzin tewi t'ayach to a jun yaelal tik, ha t'a wib'anh yet' winhtilal tz'emi, manh a satel a chonhab' tik, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yal Yángel Jehová chi' t'a winhaj Gad to syal winh t'a winhaj rey Dawid chi' to sb'ok'e junok altar winh b'aj stek'wi trigo winhaj Ornán jebuseo chi'.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winh rey chi' sb'ok'e jun altar yik tz'ik'jichaanh sb'i Jehová, icha ix aj yalchaj chi'.
Ha winhaj Ornán yet' chanhwanh yuninal winh, wan stek'wi trigo heb', haxo ix yilan heb' to ayek' Yángel Jehová chi' ta', ix b'at heb' winh yuninal winh chi' sk'ub'ejel sb'a.
Ayic ix yilan winhaj Ornán chi' to wan sk'och winh rey t'a slak'anil, ix elta winh b'aj wan stek'wi trigo chi', ix em nhojan winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yal winh rey chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Tzoc wal el t'a a k'ool, tza chonh jun lugar b'aj tzach tek'wi trigo tik t'ayin, yik tzin b'ok'e junok altar t'a Jehová, yik tz'och waan jun ilya tik t'a kal chonhab' tik. Chonh t'ayin icha wal jantak stojol, xchi winh rey chi'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Ornán chi' t'a winh: --Mamin rey, syal in sian jun lugar tik t'ayach yik tza b'oan tas snib'ej a k'ool. Swak'anpax nok' toro yik tz'och nok' silab'il yet' te' tek'lab' tik syal yoch te' t'a k'atzitzal, haxo ixim trigo tik, syal yoch ixim t'a ofrendail. Mamin rey, masanil juntzanh tik swak' t'ayach, xchi winh.

Palta ix tak'wi winhaj rey Dawid chi' icha tik: --Yuj wal Dios t'ayach yuj masanil juntzanh tik, palta a in tik yowalil ol in tup juntzanh tik smasanil icha wal stojol, yujto max yal-laj wik'anek' a tastak, swak'an silab'il t'a Jehová. Max yal-laj wak'an junok tas silab'il to manh ol in tupu', xchi winh.
Icha chi' ix aj smanan jun lu'um chi' winh rey chi' t'a 600 siklo k'een oro.

Ata' ix sb'ok'e jun altar winh, ix snhusan silab' winh yet' silab' yik junk'olal. Ixlajwi chi', ix lesalwi winh t'a Jehová, haxo Jehová chi' ix ak'ankot k'ak' t'a satcha’anh t'a yib'anh jun silab' t'a yib'anh altar chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a jun ángel chi' to syak'xiem k'een yespada chi' t'a yol yatut.
Ayic ix yilan winhaj rey Dawid to ix tak'wi Jehová t'a winh t'a stek'lab' trigo winhaj Ornán chi', ix yak'an juntzanhxo silab' winh t'a Jehová ta'.
Wach'chom a jun mantiado sb'onakk'e winhaj Moisés yikok Jehová t'a tzinan lu'um yet' jun altar b'aj stz'a silab' ay t'a Gabaón jun lugar chaanh yik ejmelal,
palta maj yal-laj sb'at winhaj rey Dawid ta' yik sk'anb'ej d'ha Dios, yujto ix te xiw winh ayik ix yilan jun k'een espada winh yet'nak Yángel Jehová.
Yuj chi' ix yal winh icha tik: Ha tik ol aj stemplo Jehová Dios yet' jun altar b'aj sko nhustz'a ko silab' a onh israel onh tik, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj rey Dawid chi' to smolchaj masanil heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan t'a skal heb' israel. Ix sik'chajel heb' tzeyum k'een, aton k'een ol och t'a yik sb'ochaj stemplo Dios.
Niwan pax k'een hierro ix smolb'ej heb' yik tz'och k'een t'a lawuxal sk'anchaj t'a puerta. Niwan pax k'een bronke ix molb'aji, maxtzak yal-laj yechtaj k'een.
Niwan pax te' k'ute', maxtzak nachaji jantak sb'isul te' ix molchaji, yujto a heb' aj Sidón yet' heb' aj Tiro te niwan te' k'ute' chi' ix yik'kot heb'.

Ix sna winhaj rey Dawid chi' icha tik: Ha winh wuninal aj Salomón tik, te uninto winh, haxo pax jun stemplo Jehová ol b'o chi', te niwan ol ajok. Ol te b'inaj yuj swach'il yilji t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, yuj chi' a tiknaik yowalil ol in molb'ejkan tastak ol och t'ay, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ayik pitzanto winhaj Dawid chi', te niwan tas ix smolb'ejkan winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yawtankot winhaj Salomón chi' winh, aton winh yuninal winh. Ix yalankan winh to a winh ol b'oank'e jun stemplo Jehová sDiosal chonhab' Israel.
Ix yalan winh icha tik: Ach wuninal, nab'ilxo wal wuuj to tzin b'ok'e junok stemplo Jehová ko Diosal.
Palta yalnak t'ayin icha tik: Ix wila'' to a ach tik, manh jantakok anima ix a milchamok, manh jantakok pax owal ix ak'a', yuj chi' manhok ach ol a b'ok'e jun in templo chi'.

Palta ay jun uninal toto ol ajok, Salomón ol ak' sb'iej, malaj owal ol yak'a', yujto a in ol wak'och junk'olal t'a skal yet' heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ay. Ha t'a stiempoal chi' ol wak' junk'olal yet' tzalajk'olal t'a in chonhab' Israel. A' ol b'oank'e jun in templo chi'. Ol och wuninalok, a inxo ol in och smamok. Ol wak'nhejkan yopisio t'a yinhtilal t'a chonhab' tik t'a junelnhej, xchinak Jehová t'ayin.
Yuj chi' a tiknaik ach wuninal, aokab' Jehová tz'ochnhej ed'ok yik ol a b'oank'e jun templo chi', icha ajnak yalan chi' uuj.
Aokab' Jehová ko Diosal ol ak'an a jelanil, yik wach' ayik ol ak'an reyal t'a chonhab' Israel tik, ol a k'anab'ajej masanil scheknab'il.

Wach'nhej ol ajelk'och smasanil, tato ol a k'anab'ajej wal masanil sk'ayb'ub'al yet' scheknab'il yalnakkan t'a winhaj Moisés kuj a onh israel onh tik. Ak' ip, tek'annhej tzutej a b'a. Manh ak' chab'ax a k'ool, manh ach xiwok.

Ix wak' wal wip yik smolb'ajkan 66 mil quintal k'een oro yik tz'och t'a stemplo Jehová chi' yet' 660 mil quintal k'een plata yet' jun niwan b'ulanh k'een bronke yet' k'een hierro maxtzak yal yechtaji. Manh jantakok pax te te' ix in chek molb'ajkanok yet' k'een k'een. Ha achxo ol ak' tz'akwok.

Tzijtum heb' winh munlajwum ayek' t'a yol a k'ab' ol munlaj ed'ok, heb' tzeyum k'een, heb' albañil yet' heb' nhikum te'. Maxtzac b'ischaj jantak heb' winh winak te jelan t'a yalnhej tas munlajelal, icha t'a k'een oro, k'een plata, k'een bronke yet' t'a k'een hierro ol munlaj ed'ok. Yuj chi' jun, ochokab' munlajel, ochokab' Jehová ed'ok, xchi winh t'a winhaj Salomón chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh t'a masanil heb' winh ayoch yajalil to tz'och heb' winh yet' winhaj Salomón chi' t'a munlajel. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik:

Ha Jehová ko Diosal ayoch eyed'ok. A' ix ak'annhej junk'olal t'ayonh t'a masanil ko makb'en, yujto ha' ix ak'anoch masanil juntzanh chonhab' tik t'a yol in k'ab', yuj chi' ix ochkan heb' t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová yet' t'a yol ko k'ab' a onh schonhab' onh tik.

Yuj chi' aq'ek wal och t'a he k'ool eyak'anoch he b'ha t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová ko Diosal. Tzeyak' wal och t'a he k'ool he b'oank'e templo b'aj tz'ik'jichaanh Jehová chi', yik wach' ol ak'jokoch te' skaxail strato chi' t'a yool yet' pax masanil syamk'ab'il jun templo chi', xchi winh t'a heb' winh.
Ayic te icham winakxo winhaj rey Dawid, ix yak'ankanoch yopisio winh yuninal winh, aton winhaj Salomón yik tz'och winh reyal t'a chonhab' Israel.
Ix molb'aj masanil heb' winh yajal yaj t'a chonhab' chi' yuj winh, heb' winh sakerdote yet' heb' winh lewita.
Ix schekan b'ischaj heb' winh lewita winh, aton heb' winh winak ek'alxo t'a 30 ab'il sk'inal, 38 mil sb'isul heb' winh.
Ha t'a skal heb' winh chi', ix sik'chajel 24 mil heb' winh skuchb'an heb' smunlaji yik sb'ochaj stemplo Jehová. Axo 6 milxo heb' winh, ix och heb' winh t'a juezal yet' t'a yajalilok chonhab' chi'.

Chanhe' mil heb' winh ix och stanhwumalok puerta. Chanhe' mil pax heb' winh ix och yik syalan wach' lolonel heb' winh t'a Jehová, sk'anan jantak yamk'ab' yik b'it heb' winh, aton juntzanh yamk'ab' scheknak winhaj rey Dawid chi' b'ojok yik sk'anchaj ta'.
Macquiltaquil ix yutej heb' winh lewita chi' winh, icha smam yicham junjun makan heb' winh: Aton winhaj Gersón, winhaj Coat yet' winhaj Merari.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Gersón chi': Aton winhaj Laadán yet' winhaj Simei.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Laadán chi', oxwanh heb' winh: Aton winhaj Jehiel, winh b'ab'el yuninal winh, winhaj Zetam yet' winhaj Joel.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Simei chi', oxwanh pax heb' winh: Vinhaj Selomit, winhaj Haziel yet' winhaj Harán. Aton heb' winh tik yajal yaj t'a yinhtilal winhaj Laadán chi'.

Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Simei chi', chanhwanh heb' winh: Aton winhaj Jahat b'ab'el, winhaj Zina schab'il, winhaj Jeús yet' winhaj Bería. Ha winhaj Jeús yet' winhaj Bería chi', manh wal tzijtumok yinhtilal heb' winh yik stzak'wan heb' yilan yopisio, yuj chi' junnhej makan ix aj heb'.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Coat, chanhwanh heb' winh: Aton winhaj Amram, winhaj Izhar, winhaj Hebrón yet' winhaj Uziel.

Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Amram chi', aton winhaj Aarón yet' winhaj Moisés. Ha winhaj Aarón chi' ix sik'chajel yet' yinhtilal yuj Jehová t'a junelnhej, yik syil heb' tastak yiknhej Jehová yaji, yik snhusan inkienso heb', skuchb'an heb' yetisraelal heb' yik tz'och ejmelal yet' yalan wach' lolonel heb' t'a yib'anh heb' anima t'a sb'i Jehová.
Axo pax heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Moisés schekab' Dios jun, ix och heb' stz'akub'ok heb' yetlewitail.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Moisés, aton winhaj Gersón yet' winhaj Eliezer.
Ha t'a skal heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Gersón chi', a winhaj Sebuel yajal yaji.
Ha winhaj Eliezer chi' junnhej yuninal winh, aton winhaj Rehabías, winh yajal yaji. Axo pax winhaj Rehabías chi', tzijtum yuninal winh.
Ha winhaj Selomit yuninal winhaj Izhar, yajal yaj winh.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Hebrón: Aton winhaj Jerías winh b'ab'el unin, winhaj Amarías winh schab'il, winhaj Jahaziel winh yoxil yet' winhaj Jecamán winh schanhil.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Uziel: Aton winhaj Micaía winh b'ab'el yet' winhaj Isías.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Merari, aton winhaj Mahli yet' winhaj Musi. Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Mahli chi', aton winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Cis.
Ha winhaj Eleazar chi' malaj junok yuninal winh, anhej heb' ix yisil winh ay, aton heb' ix chi' ix yik' sb'a yet' heb' sk'ab'yok, heb' winh yuninal winhaj Cis.
Axo pax heb' winh yuninal winhaj Musi, oxwanh heb' winh: Aton winhaj Mahli, winhaj Edar yet' winhaj Jeremot.
Aton juntzanh heb' winh chi' yinhtilal winhaj Leví, icha syal smakanhil ix aj stz'ib'chaj heb' winh ek'alxo t'a 20 ab'il sk'inal, aton juntzanh heb' winh chi' ayoch yopisio t'a templo.
Ix yal winhaj rey Dawid icha tik: Yujto a Jehová ko Diosal ix onh ak'ankan kajan t'a tik a onh schonhab' onh tik, ix kan pax skajnub' t'a Jerusalén tik,
yuj chi' a heb' lewita manhxo ol skuch b'eyek' smantiado Jehová heb' yet' pax jantak syamk'ab'il yik tz'och ejmelal, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' a heb' winh yinhtilal Leví, ayik stz'akwi 20 ab'il sk'inal heb' winh, stz'ib'an sb'a heb' winh icha ajnak yalankan winhaj rey Dawid t'a slajwub' slolonel.

Ha heb' winh chi' ix kan heb' winh t'a yol sk'ab' heb' winh sakerdote yinhtilal winhaj Aarón, yik smunlaj heb' winh t'a stemplo Jehová, yik syilan yamaq'uil heb' winh yet' yoltak kuarto yet' yilan heb' winh sakb'itaj masanil yamk'ab' yiknhej Jehová yaji. Syilanpax juntzanh munlajel heb' winh t'a templo chi'.

Aton yik sb'ochaj ixim pan tz'och t'a yichanh Jehová, syilan ixim harina heb' winh tz'ak'ji t'a ofrendail, ixim k'oxox pan malaj yich, juntzanh ofrenda sb'ochaj t'a yol xalten yet' ixim harina kalab'il yet' akeite. Syilanpax echlab' heb' winh sk'anchaj t'a ofrenda.
Anhejtona' yowalil aynhejek' heb' winh t'a templo chi', yuj yak'an yuj diosal heb' winh yet' aloj wach' lolonel t'a Jehová t'a junjun q'uinhib'alil yet' t'a yemk'ualil,

yet' yik snhuschaj silab' t'a Jehová t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip, t'a sk'ual q'uinh ayik tz'alji k'een uj yet' pax juntzanhxo q'uinh te niwak yelk'ochi. Tz'ak'winhej serwil heb' winh t'a Jehová icha jantak sb'isul heb' winh yet' munlajel ak'b'il sk'ulej heb' winh.

Ha heb' winh chi' stanhwanpax mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová yet' skajnub' chi'. Smunlajpax heb' winh t'a stemplo Jehová chi' icha yajkan t'a yib'anh yinhtilal heb' winh yuj tas yalnakkan heb' winh sakerdote yinhtilalkan winhaj Aarón.
D'a stzolal tz'aj yilan yopisio heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Aarón chi'. Axo heb' winh yuninal winh: Aton winhaj Nadab, winhaj Abiú, winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Itamar.

Ha winhaj Nadab yet' winhaj Abiú chi', b'ab'laj chamnak heb' winh t'a yichanh winh smam chi'. Mantalaj yuninal heb' winh schamnak heb' winh chi', yuj chi' anhej winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Itamar ix och sakerdoteal.
Macquiltac ix aj heb' winh sakerdote yuj winhaj rey Dawid chi', yuj winhaj Sadoc yinhtilal winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Ahimelec yinhtilal winhaj Itamar.

Axo ix yilan heb' winh to a heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Eleazar chi' tzijtum sb'isul heb' winh t'a yichanh heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Itamar, yuj chi' 16 makan ix aj heb' winh, haxo heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Itamar chi', wajxak makannhej heb' winh.

D'a sorteoal ix aj yochkan junjun makan heb' winh t'a stzolal smunlaji, yujto ha t'a skal heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Eleazar yet' t'a skal heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Itamar ay heb' winh niwak yajal sik'b'iloch t'a yopisio t'a templo t'a yichanh Dios.

Ha heb' winh yajal yaj t'a skal heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Eleazar yet' pax heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Itamar, ix sik' sorteo heb' winh t'a stzolal, jun yik heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Eleazar chi', jun pax yik heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Itamar chi'. Icha chi' ix aj smunlaj heb' winh t'a yopisio. Axo winhaj Semaías yuninal winhaj Natanael yinhtilalkan winhaj Leví ix tz'ib'an sb'i heb' winh ayik ix sik'an sorteo chi' heb' winh. Axo heb' winh sakerdote ayoch t'a yopisio yet' winh rey, aton winhaj Sadoc yet' winhaj Ahimelec yuninal winhaj Abiatar yet' heb' winh yajal yaj t'a skal heb' winh sakerdote chi' yet' t'a skal heb' winh lewita, testigo yajkan heb' winh.

Aton sb'i heb' winh tik ix kannhej t'a junjun makan t'a stzolal, icha syal sb'i heb' winh yajalil heb' winh ix sik'an sorteo chi', schael yich t'a heb' winh b'ab'el masanto t'a heb' winh slajwub', 24 makan heb' winh t'a smasanil: Vinhaj Joiarib, winhaj Jedaías, winhaj Harim, winhaj Seorim, winhaj Malquías, winhaj Mijamín, winhaj Cos, winhaj Abías, winhaj Jesúa, winhaj Sekanías, winhaj Eliasib, winhaj Jaquim, winhaj Hupa, winhaj Jesebeab, winhaj Bilga, winhaj Imer, winhaj Hezir, winhaj Afses, winhaj Petaías, winhaj Hezequiel, winhaj Jaquín, winhaj Gamul, winhaj Delaía yet' winhaj Maazías.

Aton heb' winh tik ix pojchajek' t'a stzolal t'a sakerdoteal yik smunlaj heb' winh t'a templo, icha syal sley Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, icha ajnak yalan t'a winhaj Aarón smam yicham heb' winh.
Aton sb'i heb' winh yajal yaj t'a skal juntzanhxo heb' winh yinhtilal Leví tik: Aton winhaj Jehedías yinhtilal winhaj Subael, yinhtilal pax winhaj Amram.
Vinhaj Isías b'ab'el t'a skal heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Rehabías.
Vinhaj Jahat yinhtilal winhaj Selomot, yinhtilal pax winhaj Izhar.
Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Hebrón t'a stzolal: Aton winhaj Jerías, winhaj Amarías, winhaj Jahaziel yet' winhaj Jecamán.
Vinhaj Samir yinhtilal winhaj Micaía, yinhtilal pax winhaj Uziel.
Vinhaj Zacarías yuninal winhaj Isías yuk'tak winhaj Micaía.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Merari: Aton winhaj Mahli, winhaj Musi yet' winhaj Jaazías.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jaazías chi': Aton winhaj Beno, winhaj Soham, winhaj Zacur yet' winhaj Ibri.
Chawanh yuninal winhaj Mahli chi': Aton winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Cis. Ha winhaj Eleazar chi', malaj yuninal winh. Axo pax winhaj Cis chi', ay jun yuninal winh, aton winhaj Jerameel.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Musi chi': Aton winhaj Mahli, winhaj Edar yet' winhaj Jerimot. Aton heb' winh chi' yajal yaj t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Leví.

Anhejtona' heb' winh chi', t'a sorteoal ix aj yoch heb' winh t'a stzolal smunlaji, icha ix sk'ulej heb' winh sk'ab'yok heb' winh, aton heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Aarón. Aton t'a yichanh winhaj rey Dawid yet' winhaj Sadoc yet' winhaj Ahimelec yet' heb' winh yajal yaj t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Leví yet' heb' winh sakerdote, ata' ix och sorteo chi'. Lajannhej ix aj heb' winh yajal yaj t'a skal yinhtilal winh b'ab'el winak yet' t'a skal yinhtilal winh tzak'anto.

Ha winhaj rey Dawid yet' heb' yajalil heb' soldado, ix sik'el heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Asaf heb', winhaj Hemán yet' winhaj Jedutún, yik skuchb'an heb' anima heb' ayik tz'och heb' ejmelal d'ha Dios, yik syalanel slolonel Dios heb' yet' sonal arpa, salterio yet' pax platillo. Aton sb'i heb' ayoch t'a yopisio tik:

Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Asaf chi', aton heb' winh tik: Vinhaj Zacur, winhaj José, winhaj Netanías yet' winhaj Asarela. Ha winhaj Asaf chi' skuchb'an heb' winh. Ha winh tz'alanel slolonel Dios ayik syalan winh rey chi' t'a winh.

Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Jedutún, wakwanh heb' winh: Aton winhaj Gedalías, winhaj Zeri, winhaj Jesaías, winhaj Hasabías, winhaj Matatías yet' winhaj Simei. Ha winhaj Jedutún chi' skuchb'an heb' winh, syalanpax slolonel Dios heb' winh yet' arpa yik tz'alji yuj diosal yet' yalchaj wach' lolonel t'a Jehová t'a b'ital.

Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Hemán, aton heb' winh tik: Vinhaj Buquías, winhaj Matanías, winhaj Uziel, winhaj Sebuel, winhaj Jeremot, winhaj Hananías, winhaj Hanani, winhaj Eliata, winhaj Gidalti, winhaj Romanti-ezer, winhaj Josbecasa, winhaj Maloti, winhaj Hotir yet' winhaj Mahaziot.

Ha heb' winh chi' yuninal heb' winh winhaj Hemán. Ha winhaj Hemán chi', schekab' Dios yaj winh, a winh tz'ak'an razón t'a winh rey. 14 yuninal winh ix yak' Dios yet' oxwanh yisil winh, yik tz'elk'och sti' Dios yak'nak t'a winh, ayik yalannak to niwan ol ajelk'och winh.

Masanil juntzanh heb' winh chi', a winh smam heb' winh skuchb'an t'a b'it yik tz'och ejmelal t'a stemplo Jehová yet' juntzanh yamk'ab', aton platillo, salterio yet' arpa. Ha winhaj Asaf, winhaj Jedutún yet' winhaj Hemán ayoch heb' winh t'a yalanh scheknab'il winh rey.
Ha sb'isul heb' winh k'ayb'annak sb'itan t'a Jehová chi' yet' yinhtilal, 288 heb' winh t'a smasanil.
D'a sorteoal ix aj yoch heb' winh sb'itani, tz'och heb' winh ichamtak winak yet' heb' winh kelemtak, heb' winh k'ayb'umxo yet' heb' winh wanto sk'ayb'ani.

Ayic ix lajwi yoch sorteo chi', icha tik ix aj yoch heb' winh t'a stzolal, 24 makan heb' winh t'a smasanil. Lajchawanh sb'ey heb' winh t'a junjun makan, aynhej yuj sb'a heb' winh. Ha t'a skal junjun makan heb' winh, ay junjun heb' winh skuchb'an heb' winh, aton heb' winh tik, schael yich t'a winh b'ab'el masanto t'a winh slajwub': Vinhaj José, winhaj Gedalías, winhaj Zacur, winhaj Izri, winhaj Netanías, winhaj Buquías, winhaj Jesarela, winhaj Jesahías, winhaj Matanías, winhaj Simei, winhaj Azareel, winhaj Hasabías, winhaj Subael, winhaj Matatías, winhaj Jeremot, winhaj Hananías, winhaj Josbecasa, winhaj Hanani, winhaj Maloti, winhaj Eliata, winhaj Hotir, winhaj Gidalti, winhaj Mahaziot, winhaj Romanti-ezer.
Anhejtona' t'a stzolal ix aj spojchajb'at heb' winh tanhwum puerta, icha tik ix aj heb' winh: Aton heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Coré: Ha winhaj Meselemías yuninal winhaj Coré yinhtilal winhaj Asaf.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Meselemías chi' t'a stzolal: Aton winhaj Zacarías, winhaj Jediael, winhaj Zebadías, winhaj Jatniel,
winhaj Elam, winhaj Johanán yet' winhaj Elioenai.

Ix yak' swach'k'olal Dios t'a yib'anh winhaj Obed-edom, yuj chi' tzijtum yuninal winh. Aton stzolal sb'i heb' winh tik: Vinhaj Semaías, winhaj Jozabad, winhaj Joa, winhaj Sacar, winhaj Natanael, winhaj Amiel, winhaj Isacar yet' winhaj Peultai.
Axo winhaj Semaías chi', ay heb' winh yuninal winh te niwak ix aj yelk'ochi, yuj chi' yajal ix aj heb' t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Semaías chi', aton heb' tik: Vinhaj Otni, winhaj Rafael, winhaj Obed, winhaj Elzabad, winhaj Eliú yet' winhaj Samaquías.

Masanil heb' winh tik, yinhtilal heb' winh winhaj Obed-edom. Masanil heb' winh uninab'il yet' heb' winh sk'ab'yok heb', te tek'an heb' winh, ay yip heb' winh smunlaji, 62 sb'isul heb' winh t'a smasanil.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Meselemías yet' heb' sk'ab'yok winh, 18 heb', te jelan heb'.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Hosa, yinhtilal winhaj Merari: Aton winhaj Simri. Wach'chom manhok winh b'ab'el uninab'il yaji, a winh smam winh ix ak'anoch yajalil.
Axo heb' yuk'tak winh: Aton winhaj Hilcías schab'il, yoxil winhaj Tebalías, schanhil winhaj Zacarías. Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Hosa yet' heb' sk'ab'yok, 13 heb' t'a smasanil.
Ix pojchajek' heb' stanhwan stemplo Jehová yet' heb' yajalil heb', icha ix aj juntzanhxo heb' yetlewitail heb'.
Sorteoal ix aj sch'oxji tas puertail stanhwej junjun makan heb', ayoch heb' kelemtak yet' heb' ichamtak winak.

Ha winhaj Selemías yet' heb' ayoch yet'ok ix tanhwan puerta chi' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u. Axo winhaj Zacarías yuninal winhaj Selemías chi', jelan yak'an razón winh. Ha winh ix tanhwan puerta chi' t'a stojolal norte yet' heb' ayoch yet'ok.
Axo winhaj Obed-edom yet' heb' ayoch yet'ok ix tanhwan puerta t'a stojolal sur. Axo heb' winh yuninal winh ix tanhwan b'aj sik'chaj tas ay t'a templo.

Axo winhaj Supim yet' winhaj Hosa yet' heb' ayoch yet' heb' winh, a heb' winh ix tanhwan puerta chi' t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u yet' jun puerta yik Salequet b'aj sk'e b'e. Ha heb' winh kuchb'um chi', t'a stzolal tz'aj stanhwan puerta chi' heb' winh.

Junjun k'u, ay wakwanh heb' winh stanhwan puerta t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, chanhwanh heb' winh t'a stojolal norte, chanhwanh pax heb' winh t'a stojolal sur, haxo pax b'aj sik'chaj tas tz'ak'ji silab'il t'a Jehová chi', chatakwanh heb' winh stanhwan junjun puerta.
Axo t'a yamaq'uil templo t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, chanhwanh heb' winh stanhwan t'a sti' skalleal, chawanh pax heb' winh stanhwan t'a yamaq'uil chi'.
Ichaton chi' ix aj spojchajek' opisio chi' t'a skal heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Coré yet' yik winhaj Merari.
Ay pax juntzanhxo heb' yetlewitail heb' tz'ilan b'aj sik'chaj tas yik Jehová yaji yet' b'aj smolchaj ofrenda tz'ak'ji t'ay.
Ha winhaj Jehiel yuninal winhaj Laadán, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Gersón, a winh yajal yaj t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok.
Axo pax heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jehiel chi', aton winhaj Zetam yet' winhaj Joel, a heb' winh ayoch t'a yib'anh stanhwan b'aj sik'chaj tas ay t'a skajnub' Jehová.
Ix ak'chajpaxoch heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Amram t'a yopisio, aton heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Izhar, winhaj Hebrón yet' winhaj Uziel.
Ha winhaj Sebuel, yinhtilal winhaj Gersón yuninal winhaj Moisés, a winh tz'ilan wal juntzanh tas ay t'a skajnub' Jehová.

Ha winhaj Sebuel chi', sk'ab'yok sb'a winh yet' winhaj Selomit, yujto a smam yicham winhaj Selomit chi', aton winhaj Eliezer yuk'tak winhaj Gersón smam yicham winhaj Sebuel chi'. Ha heb' smam yicham winhaj Selomit chi' t'a stzolal: Aton winhaj Zicri, winhaj Joram, winhaj Jesaías, winhaj Rehabías yet' winhaj Eliezer.
Ha winhaj Selomit yet' heb' sk'ab'yok stanhwan tastak ak'b'il yikok Jehová yuj winhaj rey Dawid yet' heb' yajal yaj t'a skal junjun makan yinhtilal yet' heb' niwak yajalil heb' soldado.
Ha juntzanh tas ix yak' heb' chi', aton tastak ix yik' heb' b'ajtak ix laj och owal, ix yak' heb' yik sk'anchaj t'a stemplo Jehová.

Ata' aypaxkan masanil tas yak'nakkan winhaj Samuel schekab' Dios, winhaj Saúl yuninal winhaj Cis, winhaj Abner yuninal winhaj Ner yet' winhaj Joab yune' ix Sarwia. Masanil juntzanh ak'b'il yikok Jehová chi', a winhaj Selomit yet' heb' sk'ab'yok ix tanhwani.

Ha t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Izhar kotnak winhaj Quenanías yet' heb' winh yuninal yet' heb' sk'ab'yok. Ha heb' chi', manhxook t'a stemplo Jehová ix och heb' t'a yopisio, palta to ix och heb' t'a niwak yajalil yet' juezal t'a chonhab' Israel.

Ha winhaj Hasabías yet' heb' sk'ab'yok, aton heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Hebrón, ay mil 700 sb'isul heb', te jelan heb'. Ix ak'jioch yopisio heb' yilan tastak yik Jehová yaji yet' masanil tastak yik winh rey t'a sk'axepalek' ha' Jordán t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u.

Axo pax t'a sk'axepal ha' Jordán chi', b'aj kajan heb' yinhtilal Rubén, heb' yinhtilal Gad yet' nanhalxo heb' yinhtilal Manasés, a winhaj Jerías yet' 2 mil 700 heb' sk'ab'yok, ix ak'jipaxoch heb' t'a yopisio chi'. Yinhtilal pax heb' winhaj Hebrón. Ayic 40 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Dawid reyal, ata' ix saychajeq'ui b'ajtak kajan heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Hebrón. Ix ilchaji to ay heb' kajan t'a Jazer t'a yol yik Galaad, te jelan pax heb', yuj chi' ix ak'jioch heb' t'a jun opisio chi'.

Junjun ujal tz'och 24 mil heb' winh winak t'a soldadoal. Ha t'a skal heb' winh ay heb' winh yajal yaj t'a skal yinhtilal, ay heb' winh niwak yajalil heb' soldado yet' heb' winh yajalil heb' tz'ilan tastak yik winh rey. Aton sb'i heb' winh ayoch yajalil tik, t'a stzolal tz'aj yoch heb' winh t'a junjun uj.
Ha t'a b'ab'el uj a winhaj Jasobeam yuninal winhaj Zabdiel yinhtilal winhaj Fares tz'ochi.
Axo t'a schab'il uj, a winhaj Dodai aj Aho tz'ochi. Axo winhaj Miclot schab'il yajal yaji.
Axo t'a yoxil uj, a winhaj Benaía yuninal winhaj sat sakerdote Joiada tz'ochi.
Ha winhaj Benaía chi', yajal yaj winh t'a 30 heb' soldado te b'inajnak, haxo winh yuninal winh skuchan Amisabad, schab'il yajal yaj winh t'a jun makan heb' soldado tz'och t'a jun uj chi'.
Axo t'a schanhil uj, a winhaj Asael yuk'tak winhaj Joab aykanoch sb'i t'ay, palta haxo winhaj Zebadías yuninal winh ayoch yajalil sk'exulok.
Axo t'a yoil uj, a winhaj Samhut yinhtilal Izhar tz'ochi.
Axo t'a swaquil uj, a winhaj Ira yuninal winhaj Iques aj Tecoa tz'ochi.
Axo t'a yuquil uj, a winhaj Heles aj Pelón, yinhtilal Efraín tz'ochi.
Axo t'a swajxaquil uj, a winhaj Sibecai aj Husa, yinhtilal winhaj Zera tz'ochi.
Axo t'a sb'alunhil uj, a winhaj Abiezer aj Anatot, yinhtilal Benjamín tz'ochi.
Axo t'a slajunhil uj, a winhaj Maharai aj Netofa, yinhtilal winhaj Zera tz'ochi.
Axo t'a yuxluchil uj, a winhaj Benaía aj Piratón, yinhtilal Efraín tz'ochi.
Axo t'a slajchawil uj, a winhaj Heldai aj Netofa, yinhtilal winhaj Otoniel tz'ochi.

Axo pax heb' winh yajal yaj t'a junjun makan heb' yinhtilal Israel, aton heb' winh tik: Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal Rubén, a winhaj Eliezer yuninal winhaj Zicri yajal yaji. Axo t'a heb' yinhtilal Simeón, a winhaj Sefatías yuninal winhaj Maaca yajal yaji. Axo t'a heb' yinhtilal Leví, a winhaj Hasabías yuninal winhaj Kemuel yajal yaji. Axo t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Aarón, a winhaj Sadoc yajal yaji. Axo t'a heb' yinhtilal Judá, a winhaj Eliú yuk'tak winhaj rey Dawid yajal yaji. Axo t'a heb' yinhtilal Isacar, a winhaj Omri yuninal winhaj Micael yajal yaji. Axo t'a heb' yinhtilal Zabulón, a winhaj Ismaías yuninal winhaj Abdías yajal yaji. Axo t'a heb' yinhtilal Neftalí, a winhaj Jerimot yuninal winhaj Azriel yajal yaji. Axo t'a heb' yinhtilal Efraín, a winhaj Oseas yuninal winhaj Azazías yajal yaji. Ha t'a nanhal heb' yinhtilal Manasés, a winhaj Joel yuninal winhaj Pedaías yajal yaji. Axo t'a nanhalxo heb' yinhtilal Manasés ay t'a Galaad, a winhaj Iddo yuninal winhaj Zacarías yajal yaji. Axo t'a heb' yinhtilal Benjamín, a winhaj Jaasiel yuninal winhaj Abner yajal yaji. Axo t'a heb' yinhtilal Dan, a winhaj Azareel yuninal winhaj Jeroham yajal yaji. Aton juntzanh heb' winh tik yajal yaj t'a junjun makan heb' yinhtilal Israel.

Ayic ix yalan winhaj rey Dawid to sb'ischaj masanil heb' israel, ix yalan winh to max b'ischajlaj heb' manto tz'akwi t'a 20 ab'il sk'inal, yujto yak'nak sti' Jehová to ol yik' wal chaanh sb'isul heb' yinhtilal Israel icha sb'isul k'een k'anal.

Ix schael yich winhaj Joab yik'anchaanh sb'isul heb' yetisraelal chi', palta maj lajwoklaj yik'anchaanh winh, yujto yuj jun chi' ix kot jun niwan yaelal t'a yib'anh chonhab' Israel. Yuj chi' a sb'isul heb' chi' manh tz'ib'ab'ilok t'a yab'ixal winhaj rey Dawid.

Ha winhaj Azmawet yuninal winhaj Adiel tz'ilan tastak ay t'a winh rey. Axo winhaj Jonatán yuninal winhaj Uzías tz'ilani jantak tas molan t'a junjun chonhab', t'a junjun aldea yet' t'a junjun kuartel ay t'a sattak mojon.
Axo winhaj Ezri yuninal winhaj Quelub tz'ilan heb' smunlaj t'a sluum winh rey chi'.
Axo winhaj Simei aj Ramat tz'ilan heb' smunlaj t'a te' yuwa winh rey chi'. Axo winhaj Zabdi aj Safat tz'ilan heb' smolb'an wino t'a yet'tal.
Axo winhaj Baal-hanán aj Gedera tz'ilan heb' smunlaj t'a te' oliwo yet' t'a te' kaltakte'al higo ay t'a panhquiltak. Axo winhaj Joás tz'ilan heb' smolan akeite yik sat te' oliwo.
Axo winhaj Sitrai aj Sarón tz'ilan heb' ayoch yil nok' wakax ay t'a Sarón chi'. Axo pax winhaj Safat yuninal winhaj Adlai tz'ilan heb' ayoch yil nok' wakax ay t'a panhquiltak.
Axo winhaj Obil ismaelita tz'ilan heb' ayoch yil nok' kamello. Axo winhaj Jehedías aj Meronot tz'ilan heb' ayoch yil nok' b'uru.
Axo winhaj Jaziz agareno tz'ilan heb' ayoch yil nok' kalnel yet' nok' chiwa. Aton masanil heb' winh tik tz'ilan masanil tastak ay t'a winhaj rey Dawid chi'.

Ha winhaj Jonatán yicham winhaj rey Dawid chi', tz'ib'um winh, te jelan pax winh, ak'um razón yaj winh t'a winh rey chi'. Axo winhaj Jehiel yuninal winhaj Hacmoni tz'ilan heb' winh yuninal winh rey chi'.
Yed' pax winhaj Ahitofel ak'um razón yajpax winh t'a winh rey chi' yet' winhaj Husai arquita, te wach' yak'an winh rey chi' yet' winh.
Ayic toxo ix cham winhaj Ahitofel chi', a winhaj Joiada yuninal winhaj Benaía yet' winhaj Abiatar ix ochkan sk'exulok winh. Axo winhaj Joab sat yajal yaj t'a heb' soldado winh rey chi'.

Ha t'a Jerusalén ix smolb'ej masanil heb' yajal yaj t'a chonhab' Israel winhaj rey Dawid: Aton heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun inhtilal, heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun makan heb' soldado tz'ilan winh rey chi' yet' heb' sat yajal yaj t'a junjun niwak nhilanh heb' soldado. Ix smolb'ejpax heb' yajal yaj t'a heb' tz'ilan tastak ay t'a winh rey chi', aton masanil lum lum yet' masanil nok' nok', heb' tz'ilan heb' winh yuninal winh, heb' ayoch t'a yopisio yet' winh yet' masanil heb' soldado te tek'an yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh niwan yelk'ochi.

Ixlajwi chi' ix k'e linhan winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: Ab'ek he masanil ex wetchonhab'. Ay wal och t'a in pensar in b'oank'e junok templo b'aj skan te' skaxail strato Jehová t'a junelnhej, yik wach' ata' skajnaj ko Diosal chi'. Toxo ix in molb'ej masanil tastak ol k'anchaj t'ay.
Palta ix yal Jehová chi' t'ayin icha tik: Manhok ach ol a b'ok'e jun in kajnub' chi', yujto ak'um ach owal, manh jantakok anima a milnakchamok, xchi t'ayin.

Palta a Jehová ko Diosal chi' ix in sik'ankaneli yik tzin och reyal t'a ko chonhab' tik t'a junelnhej, yujto ha' ix sik'anel yinhtilal Judá, yik syak'an yajalil t'a masanil quinhtilal. Axo t'a yinhtilal Judá chi', a yinhtilal winh in mam ix sik'kaneli, haxo pax t'a yinhtilal winh in mam chi', a in ix in sik'el t'a skal heb' wuk'tak yik tzin och reyal t'a ko chonhab' tik.
Axo tiknaik, ha t'a skal jantak heb' wuninal ix yak' Jehová chi', ata' ix sik'el winh wuninal aj Salomón tik, yik tz'ochkan winh reyal in k'exulok t'a ko chonhab' tik.

Ix yalanpax Jehová chi' t'ayin icha tik: Ha winh uninal aj Salomón, a winh ol b'oank'e jun in kajnub' yet' yamaq'uil, yujto a in ix in sik'kanel winh yik tz'ochkan winh wuninalok, a inxo ol in ochkan smamok winh.
Anhejtona' ol wak'kan yopisio winh t'a junelnhej, tato ol stek'b'ej wal sb'a winh sk'anab'ajan masanil in cheknab'il yet' masanil in k'ayb'ub'al, icha sk'ulej winh tiknaik, xchi Jehová t'ayin.

Ha tiknaik jun, wal t'a eyichanh he masanil ex wetchonhab', schonhab' Jehová yet' t'a yichanh ko Diosal tz'ab'an tas skala', scham wal walan t'ayex to tze b'eyb'alej wal masanil scheknab'il Jehová ko Diosal. Tze k'anab'ajani, yik wach' ol ex kajnajnhej t'a jun chonhab' manhxo jantakok swach'il tik. Ha exxo ol eyak'kan smakb'enok heb' eyuninal t'a junelnhej.

Ha achxo tik ach wuninal aj Salomón, ojtaquej wal ko Diosal, tza k'anab'ajan wal yet' smasanil a k'ool. Yujto a Jehová yojtak masanil tas sko na' yet' tas sko nib'ej. Tato ol al a b'a t'ay, ol tak'wok t'ayach, palta tato ol ik'kanel a b'a t'ay jun, ol ach spatiquejkanel t'a junelnhej.
Ha tiknaik a Jehová ix ach sik'aneli yik ol a b'ok'e jun templo b'aj ol kajnajok, yuj chi' tek'an wal tzutej a b'a, ochokab' munlajel, xchi winhaj rey Dawid chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an yumal winhaj rey Dawid chi' t'a winhaj Salomón chi', aton yechel tas ol aj sb'o yamaq'uil yet' juntzanh kuarto b'aj ol sik'chaj tas tz'ak'ji yikok Jehová yet' juntzanh kuarto ol kan t'a chaanh yet' juntzanh kuarto ol kan t'a yol templo chi' yet' jun lugar b'aj tz'ak'ji tup mul.

Ix yak'anpax yumal masanil tas nab'ilxo yuj winh, aton tas ol aj sb'o yamaq'uil templo chi' yet' juntzanh kuarto ol och t'a spatiktak b'aj ol sik'chaj masanil syamk'ab'il yet' juntzanh tas tz'ak'ji silab'il d'ha Dios.
Ix yak'anpax yumal winh tas ol aj yoch heb' sakerdote yet' heb' lewita t'a stzolal yik ol munlaj heb' t'a templo chi' yet' slistail jantak yamk'ab' yik ejmelal ol och t'a Jehová.
Ix yak'an slistail winh jantak k'een oro yet' jantak k'een plata ol och t'a junjun makan juntzanh syamk'ab'il templo chi':
Ix yalanpax winh yuj jantak yalil ol aj junjun sb'akhnub'al kandil yet' junjun skandilal chi', tato oro, mato plata.
Icha pax chi' ix aj yalan winh yuj juntzanh mexa ol och oro t'ay b'aj ol em tzolan ixim pan to yik Jehová yaji yet' juntzanh mexa ol och plata t'ay.

Ix yalanpax winh yuj jantak k'een oro ol och t'a k'een niwak tenedor yik chib'ej, t'a k'een niwak uk'ab' yet' t'a k'een niwak xalu yet' jantak k'een oro, ma k'een plata ol och t'a k'een kopa yet' t'a juntzanhxo k'een icha jantak yalil junjun makan.

Ix yalpax winh yuj jantak k'een oro te wach' ol och t'a jun altar yik inkienso. Ix yalpax winh jantak k'een oro ol k'anchaj t'a jun karruaje, aton juntzanh yechel querubín jenhanb'at sk'axil t'a yib'anh te' skaxail strato Jehová Dios.
Masanil juntzanh chi', tz'ib'ab'ilkani, yujto a wal Jehová ix ak'an nachajel yuj winhaj rey Dawid chi' tas ol aj sb'o jun munlajel chi', icha ix aj yechel.

Yuj chi', ix yalanpax winhaj rey Dawid chi' t'a winhaj Salomón chi' icha tik: Tek'an wal tzutej a b'a, ochokab' munlajel. Manh ak' chab'axk'e a k'ool, manh ach xiwok, yujto a Jehová ko Diosal manh ol ach yaktejkani. Ol ochnhej ed'ok yik ol yik'elk'och sb'a jun munlajel t'a jun templo tik.

Aton heb' sakerdote tik yet' heb' lewita, icha syal jay makan heb', te b'ekan sk'ol heb' smunlaj t'a templo chi'. Te b'ekanpax sk'ool masanil heb' winh winak smunlaji, heb' jelan spensar smunlaj t'a yalnhej tas munlajelal yet' heb' yajal yaji. Masanil pax heb' anima, ol sk'anab'ajej heb' tas ol ala', xchi winh t'a winhaj Salomón chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj rey Dawid chi' t'a masanil heb' anima molanek' chi' icha tik: Ex wetchonhab', anhej wal winh wuninal aj Salomón tik ix sik'jiel yuj Dios, palta yune' quelemto winh. Axo pax jun munlajel tik te niwan, yujto a jun templo chi' manh yikok anima, palta to skajnub' Jehová Dios ol ajok.

Ix wak' wal wip in molb'an masanil tastak ol k'anchaj t'a stemplo ko Diosal chi': Aton k'een oro, k'een plata, k'een bronke, k'een hierro yet' te te', icha jantak ol k'anchaj t'a junjun makan munlajel. Te niwan k'een kornalina ix in molb'ej yet' juntzanhxo k'een k'een tz'och yelwanub'ok yet' tzijtum makanhil k'een k'een wach' yilji, manh jantakok pax k'een mármol.
Ha yet' jantak tas molb'ab'ilxo chi' wuuj yik sb'ochaj templo chi', swak'anpax jantak k'een oro yet' k'een plata to yel wiko', yujto te xajan stemplo in Diosal wuuj.
Aton 2 mil 300 quintal k'een oro te wach' yet' 5 mil 300 quintal k'een plata, te wach' pax yaj k'een sb'oi, yik tz'och k'een t'a sattak yol templo yet' juntzanh kuarto,
yet' t'a juntzanhxo munlajel ol sb'o heb' munlajwum t'a k'een oro, ma t'a k'een plata chi'. Axo tiknaik, ¿mach ex wal b'ekan he k'ol eyak'an he kolwal t'a Jehová? xchi winh rey chi'.

Yuj chi', a heb' yajal yaj t'a heb' sk'ab'yok, heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun inhtilal heb' yetisraelal, heb' niwak yajalil heb' soldado yet' heb' yajal yaj t'a heb' tz'ilan smunlajel winh rey, masanil heb' chi', ix el wal t'a sk'ol heb' yak'an skolwal.

Ix laj yak' skolwal heb' yik sb'ochaj templo chi': 3 mil 800 quintal k'een oro, 7 mil 600 quintal k'een plata, 13 mil 500 quintal k'een bronke yet' pax 75 mil quintal k'een hierro, masanil juntzanh k'een chi' ix yak' heb'.
Yed' pax heb' b'aj ay k'een k'een wach' yilji, ix yak' k'een heb' t'a winhaj Jehiel yinhtilal winhaj Gersón, yujto a winh schaan masanil tas tz'ak'ji yik sb'ochaj templo chi'.
Ix tzalaj wal masanil anima yuj jantak tas ix yak' heb' yajal chi', yujto t'a smasanil sk'ol heb' ix yak' juntzanh chi' t'a Jehová. Anhejtona' ix te tzalajpax winhaj rey Dawid chi' yet' heb'.

Yuj chi' ix yal wach' lolonel winh t'a Jehová t'a yichanh masanil heb' anima chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: Mamin Jehová, ko Diosal ach, sDiosal ach pax winh ko mam quicham Israel. Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'ayach t'a masanil tiempo.
Ic yaj smasanil tas, te niwan elk'ochi, ay a poder, ay a tziquiquial, Yajal ach t'a satcha’anh yet' t'a sat lu'um tik.
Ha ach tzak' b'eyumal yik tzonh ik'anchaanh. Yajal ach t'a yib'anh smasanil. Ha t'a yol a k'ab' ay masanil ipalil. Tzak' sniwanil yelk'ochi yet' poder t'a heb' b'aj a gana ak'ani.
Yuj wal chi' ach ko Diosal, skak' yuj diosal, skalanpax wach' lolonel t'ayach yuj a b'inajnaquil.
Val yel, a in tik yet' heb' wetchonhab' tik, malaj wal jab'ok tas syal ko sian t'ayach, yujto masanil juntzanh tik a t'ayach skoti, yuj chi' a tas tzak' t'ayonh, ha' skak'pax t'ayach.
Ha onh tik, ek'elb'anhej tzonh ek' t'a tik. Mamin, lajan quek' icha ajnak yek' heb' ko mam quicham. Ha ko k 'inal t'a sat lu'um tik, lajan icha xob'al lum lum, manh najtilok tzonh eq'ui.
Yuj chi' Mamin Jehová ko Diosal, ik yaj masanil juntzanh b'eyumal tik. Ha t'ayach skot masanil juntzanh tas ix ko molb'ej tik yik sko b'oank'e jun templo yuj ach quik'anchaanh.

Mamin, wojtak wal to tza ch'olb'itej ko pensar, anhej wal tojolal scha a k'ool. Yuj chi' t'a wal smasanil in k'ool swak' juntzanh tik t'a yol a k'ab'. Ha tiknaik, swil t'a tzalajk'olal to a masanil heb' a chonhab' molanek' tik, wal t'a smasanil sk'ool heb' yet' stzalajk'olal heb' syak' silab' t'ayach.

Mamin Jehová, ko Diosal ach, sDiosal ach pax heb' ko mam quicham, aton winhaj Abraham, winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Israel. Ak'nhejoch t'a spensar heb' a chonhab' tik, yik tz'elnhej t'a sk'ol heb' yak'ani. Yak'okab' wal och sb'a heb' t'a yol a k'ab'.

Anhejtona' tzak'an wach' pensaril t'a winh wuninal aj Salomón tik, yik sk'anab'ajej masanil a cheknab'il winh yet' a k'ayb'ub'al t'a smasanil sk'ool, sb'eyb'alanpax winh, yik ol yal sb'oank'e jun templo winh, jun ix in molb'ejkan tas ol och t'ay, xchi winhaj rey Dawid chi' t'a slesal.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalanxi winh t'a heb' anima chi' icha tik: Ha tiknaik ex wetchonhab', alek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová ko Diosal, xchi winh. Yuj chi' masanil heb' anima chi' ix alan wach' lolonel t'a Jehová Dios, aton sDiosal pax smam yicham heb'. Ix em kuman heb', ix empax nhojan heb' t'a yichanh Dios ayik ayek' heb' t'a yichanh winh rey chi'.

Axo t'a junxo k'u, ix snhusan silab' heb' t'a Jehová: Mil nok' kelemtak wakax, mil nok' ch'ak kalnel, mil nok' yunetak kalnel. Ix yak'pax wino heb', aton tz'ak'jitaxon yet' junjun makan nok' silab'. Te niwan nok' silab' ix yak' heb' yik schi'an nok' heb' smasanil.

Ha wal t'a jun k'u chi', ix wa heb', ix yuk'an ha' heb' t'a tzalajk'olal t'a yichanh Jehová. Ix yak'ank'e akeite heb' t'a sjolom winhaj Salomón yuninal winhaj rey Dawid t'a yichanh Jehová t'a schaelal, yik tz'ochkan winh sreyalok heb'. Ix yak'anpaxk'e akeite heb' t'a sjolom winhaj Sadoc yik tz'ochkan winh sat sakerdoteal.
Icha chi' ix aj yoch winhaj Salomón reyal sk'exulok winh smam t'a yopisio ix yak' Jehová. Te wach' ix aj yelk'och winh yet' yopisio chi'. Masanil heb' israel ix k'anab'ajan winh.
Masanil heb' yajal yaji, heb' soldado yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj rey Dawid, ix yak' sti' heb' sk'anab'ajan winhaj rey Salomón chi'.
