Masanil heb' aj Judá, linhank'e heb' t'a yichanh Jehová yet' masanil yetb'eyum yet' yal yuninal heb', wach'chom heb' te kotakto.
Ay jun winh lewita yinhtilal winhaj Asaf skuchan Jahaziel yuninal winhaj Zacarías, yixchiquin winhaj Benaías yuninal winhaj Jeiel, yixchiquin winhaj Matanías. Ix och Yespíritu Jehová t'a winh,

yuj chi' ix yal winh icha tik: Ab'ek wal ex aj Judá, ex aj Jerusalén yet' ach rey Josafat. Xchi wal Jehová icha tik: Manh ex xiwok, manh eyek xiw he b'ha t'a yichanh jantak soldado chi', yujto a jun owal chi', manh eyikok, palta wik a in Dios in tik.
Ha k'ik'an tzex emk'och eyak' owal yet' heb'. Sk'eul heb' t'a lum switzal yik Sis, yik tze chalan he b'a yet' heb' t'a stitak ha ha' tzek' t'a tzinan lum yik Jeruel.

Manhok ex ol eyak' owal chi', palta tonhej ol ex aj ta', malaj tas ol he k'ulej, tonhej ol eyila' tas ol aj ex in kolani, xchi Jehová. Yuj chi' he masanil ex kajan ex t'a Jerusalén yet' t'a Judá, manh ex xiwok, manh eyek xiw he b'a. Tzex b'at k'ik'an chi', yujto a Jehová ayoch qued'ok, xchi winh.
Yuj chi', ix em kumnaj winhaj Josafat chi', ix emk'och snanhal sat winh t'a sat lu'um, ix empax kumnaj masanil heb' aj Judá yet' heb' aj Jerusalén chi', ix yak'anem sb'a heb' t'a yichanh Jehová.
Ay juntzanh heb' lewita yinhtilal winhaj Coat yet' heb' yinhtilal winhaj Coré, ix syamanoch heb' sb'itan t'a chaanh, syalan wach' lolonel heb' t'a Jehová sDiosal Israel.

Axo t'a q'uinhib'alil t'a junxo k'u chi', ak'walto ix k'e wan heb' smasanil, ix b'at heb' t'a sb'eal tzinan lu'um yik Tecoa. Ayic wan sb'at heb' chi', ix och tek'tek' winhaj Josafat, ix yalan winh t'a heb' icha tik: Ab'ek tas ol wal ex aj Jerusalén yet' ex aj Judá: Kak'ekoch Jehová ko Diosal yipok ko k'ool, malaj tas ol onh ik'anok, skak'anpaxoch heb' schekab' Dios tik yipok ko k'ool yik wach'nhej ol aj quelk'ochi, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Ayic toxo ix lajwi slolon winh yet' heb' chonhab' chi', ix sik'anel juntzanh heb' sb'itan winh. Ix yak'anoch spichul heb' yik yopisio yik b'it. Ix b'ab'laj heb' yuj heb' soldado. Syalan wach' lolonel heb' t'a Jehová t'a b'ital icha tik: Kaq'ek yuj diosal t'a Jehová, yujto tzonh xajanej t'a masanil tiempo, xchi heb'.

Ayic ix schaanel yich heb' sb'itan wach' lolonel chi' t'a tzalajk'olal chi', haxo Jehová ix ak'anoch somk'olal t'a skal heb' wan skot yak' owal yet' heb' aj Judá chi', aton heb' amonita, heb' moabita yet' heb' ix kot t'a tzalquixtak yik Seir chi'. Yuj chi' ix ak'ji ganar heb'.
Yujto a heb' amonita yet' heb' moabita chi', ix och heb' yak' owal yet' heb' ix kot t'a Seir chi', ix lajwiel heb' smasanil yuj heb'. Ixlajwi chi', axonhej heb' ix yutej sb'a, ix satlanel sb'a heb'.
Axo yik ix k'och heb' winh winak yik Judá b'aj chequel lum tzinan lu'um, ix yilanb'at heb' winh to a heb' ajk'ol chi' latz'anem heb' t'a sat lum schami, manhxa junok heb' ixto elkani.

Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Josafat yet' heb' soldado ajun yet'ok chi', yik sb'at sik'anchaanh heb' masanil tas ix kan yuj heb' ajk'ol ix cham chi'. Ix ilchaj yamk'ab' yuj heb', pichul yet' juntzanhxo tas te karo stojol. Yuj chi' tzijtum tas ix yik' heb', palta ayto tas majxo tzak'wan heb' yik'ankoti. Ha jantak tas ix yik'kot heb' chi', oxe' k'ual ix yak' heb' smolank'ei.

Axo t'a schanhil k'ual, ix smolb'an sb'a heb' t'a jun ak'lik skuchan Beraca. Ata' ix yal wach' lolonel heb' t'a Jehová. Yuj chi' spanhanil Beraca ix sb'iejkan jun lugar chi' yuj heb'. (Beraca syalelk'ochi aloj wach' lolonel.)
Ixlajwi chi', t'a tzalajk'olal ix b'ab'laj winhaj Josafat yuj heb' aj Judá yet' heb' aj Jerusalén, yujto a Jehová ix ak'an jun tzalajk'olal chi' t'a heb' yujto ix ak'ji ganar heb' ajk'ol chi'.
Axo ix jawi heb' t'a Jerusalén, ix b'at heb' t'a stemplo Jehová yet' sonal salterio, te' kítara yet' k'een trompeta.
Ayic ix ab'chaji to a Jehová ix ak'an owal yet' heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'a heb' israel chi', ix te xiw masanil juntzanhxo nakión d'ha Dios chi'.
Junk'olal ix yak' reyal winhaj Josafat chi', yujto ha Dios ix ak'an junk'olal t'a skal winh yet' juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a slak'anil chi'.
Ayic 35 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Josafat chi' ix schaanel yich winh yak'an reyal t'a Judá, 25 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a chonhab' Jerusalén. Azuba sb'i ix snun winh, yisil ix winhaj Silhi.
Ha winhaj Josafat chi', wach'nhej ix yutej sb'a winh icha ix yutej sb'a winhaj Asa smam winh. Masanil tas ix sk'ulej winh, tojolnhej t'a yichanh Jehová.
Palta a juntzanh lugar yik ejmelal b'ajtak chaanh, maj yik'el-laj winh, yujto manh masanilok heb' anima tek'anxo spensar yoch tzak'an yuj sDiosal heb' yet' smam yicham.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Josafat chi' ayik ix el yich, masanto ix lajwi, tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a yumal yik winhaj Jehú yuninal winhaj Hanani, junnhej yajkan yet' yumal yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Axo t'a slajwub'al sreyal winhaj Josafat chi', ix sb'oan strato winh yet' winhaj Ocozías sreyal Israel. Ha jun winh rey chi', te chuk spensar winh.
Ix sb'o juntzanh te' barko heb' winh yik sb'at t'a chonhab' Tarsis. Ha t'a chonhab' Ezión-geber ix sb'o te' heb' winh.

Yuj chi', a winhaj Eliezer aj Maresa yuninal winhaj Dodawa ix alan jun lolonel tik t'a winhaj Josafat chi': Yujto junnhej ix utej a b'a yet' winhaj Ocozías, yuj chi' a Jehová chok' ol utanb'at masanil tas ix a b'o tik, xchi winh. Yuj chi', chok' ix aj juntzanh te' barko ix sb'o heb' winh chi', majxo yal-laj sb'at te' t'a Tarsis chi'.
Ayic ix cham winhaj Josafat chi', ix mukchaj winh yet' heb' smam yicham t'a schonhab' winhaj Dawid. Axo winhaj Joram yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.

Ix ak'ji opisio yik reyal t'a winhaj Joram chi' yuj winh smam, yujto b'ab'el unin winh. Axo heb' winh yuk'tak winh, aton winhaj Azarías, winhaj Jehiel, winhaj Zacarías, winhaj Azarías, winhaj Micael yet' winhaj Sefatías. Masanil heb' winh tik, yuninal heb' winh winhaj Josafat chi'. Manh jantakok k'een oro yet' k'een plata ix siaj t'a heb' winh yuj winh smam chi' yet' juntzanhxo tas te karo stojol. Ix ak'chajpax chonhab' te wach' yajoch smuroal t'a heb' winh, aton juntzanh ay t'a yol yik Judá.
Palta a winhaj Joram chi', ayik ix tek'k'aj winh yet' yopisio chi', ix smilancham masanil heb' winh yuk'tak winh chi', ix smilpaxcham juntzanhxo heb' winh yajal winh t'a smakb'en chi'.
Ayic ix och winh reyal chi', 32 ab'il sk'inal winh, wajxaque' ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén.

Anhej sb'eyb'al heb' winh sreyal Israel ix sb'eyb'alej winh yet' sb'eyb'al heb' yinhtilal winhaj Acab, yujto a ix yetb'eyum winh, yisil ix winhaj Acab chi'. Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová.
Palta yuj sti' Jehová yak'nak t'a winhaj rey Dawid to ol ochnhej yinhtilal winh reyal t'a masanil tiempo, yuj chi' maj yal-laj sk'ol Jehová ix satel heb' yinhtilal winhaj Dawid chi'.
Ayic ayoch winhaj Joram chi' reyal, a heb' aj Edom, ix yik'el sb'a heb' t'a yalanh smandar Judá, ix yak'anoch sreyal heb' sch'okoj.

Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Joram chi' yet' heb' winh yajalil heb' soldado yet' pax karruaje yik owal yik skanxi heb' aj Edom chi' t'a yol sk'ab' heb'. Palta a heb' aj Edom chi', ix yoy sb'a heb' t'a spatik heb'. Axo t'ak'walil ix k'e waan winhaj Joram chi' yet' heb' winh yajal yik karruaje yik syak'an owal heb'. Icha chi' ix aj sjakwi b'aj ix el heb'.

Ha heb' aj Edom chi', ix yak' ganar heb' yik'anel sb'ha t'a yalanh smandar heb' aj Judá chi', ix elnhejkan heb'. Aton t'a jun pekti’ chi' ix yik'paxel sb'a chonhab' Libna, yujto ix yaktejkan Jehová winhaj Joram chi', aton sDiosal heb' smam yicham winh.

Ix sb'oanxik'e juntzanh lugar yik ejmelal winh, aton b'ajtak chaanh t'a yol yik Judá chi'. Yuj chi' masanil heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén pit ix yutej sb'ha t'a Jehová. Icha chi' ix aj sjuwiel spensar heb' aj Judá chi' yuj winh.

Yuj chi' ata' ix scha jun skarta winhaj Elías schekab' Dios winhaj Joram chi', b'aj syal icha tik: Ha Jehová sDiosal winh a mam icham aj Dawid, ha' tz'alan t'ayach: Manh wanok a b'eyb'alan sb'eyb'al winhaj rey Josafat winh a mam yet' sb'eyb'al winhaj Asa winh a mam icham,

palta to a sb'eyb'al heb' winh sreyal Israel wan a b'eyb'alani. Yuj chi' masanil heb' aj Judá yet' heb' aj Jerusalén, uuj pit syutej sb'a heb' t'ayin icha wal sb'eyb'al heb' yinhtilal winhaj Acab chi'. Anhejtona' ix a milpaxcham heb' winh uk'tak, a heb' winh chi' wach' sb'eyb'al heb' winh t'a ichanh.
Yuj chi' ol wak'em jun yaelal t'a yib'anh a chonhab' tik, t'a yib'anh heb' uninal, t'a yib'anh heb' ix etb'eyum yet' t'a yib'anh masanil tas ay t'ayach.

Ha achxo tik, ay jun ilya ol jawok t'a ib'anh. Ol och jun ya k'ool t'ayach, junjun k'u ol te niwtajok, masanto ol yal yelta a ch'anh tza' yuj jun ilya chi', xchi Jehová, xchi jun skarta winhaj Elías chi'.
Yuj chi', a Jehová ix ak'an sk'ulej heb' filisteo yet' heb' árabe kajan t'a slak'anil Cus, ix kot heb' yak' yowal yet' winhaj rey Joram chi'.

Ix jawi heb' t'a Judá, ix yak' ganar heb'. Ix yik'b'at masanil b'eyumal heb', aton ay t'a spalakio winh rey chi', ix ik'chajb'at masanil yuninal winh yet' heb' ix yetb'eyum winh. Axonhej winhaj Joacaz slajwub' yuninal winh ix kani.
Ayic ix lajwi yek' masanil juntzanh chi', ix yak'anoch jun ilya Jehová t'a sk'ool winhaj Joram chi', manhxa yanhal.

Ix ek' tiempo, ayik schab'il ab'il yoch jun ilya chi' t'a winh, ix elta sch'anhtza' winh yuj. Te ya ix aj scham winh. Ayic ix cham winh chi', malaj junok niwan k'ak' ix yak'och heb' anima, yujto malaj yelk'och winh t'a yol sat heb', palta ayik schamnak heb' smam yicham winh, ochnak niwak k'ak' chi'.

Ayic ix schaanel yich yak'an reyal winhaj Joram chi', 32 ab'il sk'inal winh. Vajxaque' ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Malaj mach ix naan winh ayik ix cham winh. Ix mukji winh t'a schonhab' winhaj Dawid, palta manhok b'aj smukchaj heb' rey.

Masanil heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén chi', ix yak'och winhaj Ocozías heb' reyal sk'exulok winh smam chi', aton winh slajwub' yuninal winhaj Joram chi. Ha winh ix och reyal chi', yujto a heb' árabe yak'nak owal heb' t'a Judá, milb'ilcham heb' winh b'ab'el yuninal winhaj Joram chi' yuj heb'.
Ayic ix schaanel yich winhaj Ocozías chi' yak'an reyal, 22 ab'il sk'inal winh, junnhej ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Atalía sb'i ix snun winh, yixchiquin ix winhaj Omri.

Ha winhaj rey Ocozías chi', a sb'eyb'al winhaj Acab yet' yinhtilal ix sb'eyb'alej winh. Ha ix snun winh chi' ix kuchb'an t'a chukal b'eyb'al chi', yujto yisil ix winhaj Acab chi', yuj chi' te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Ayic toxo ix cham winh smam winh chi', a heb' sk'ab' yok winh chi' ix kuchb'an t'a chukal, yuj chi' ix juwiel spensar winh t'a junelnhej.

Yujto ix sk'anab'ajej juntzanh pensar chi' winh, yuj chi' junnhej ix aj spensar winh yet' winhaj Joram sreyal Israel, aton winh yuninal winhaj Acab. Yuj chi' ix yak' owal heb' winh yet' winhaj Hazael sreyal Siria t'a chonhab' Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad. Palta ix lajwi winhaj Joram chi' yuj heb' sirio chi'.
Yuj chi' ix meltzajkot winh t'a Jezreel yik tzul yanhtan sb'a winh ta'. Te ya yaj winh, yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Ocozías yil winh t'a Jezreel chi'.

Ha Dios toxo ix sna'a to ayik ol k'och winhaj Ocozías chi' yil winhaj Joram chi', ata' ol cham winh. Ayic ayek' winh ta', ix elta winh yet' winhaj Joram chi', yik syak'an owal heb' winh yet' winhaj Jehú yuninal winhaj Nimsi, aton winh ix sik'jiel yuj Jehová yik satanel masanil makanhil heb' yinhtilal winhaj Acab chi'.

Ayic wan smilancham heb' yinhtilal winhaj Acab winhaj Jehú chi', ix ilchajelta heb' winh yajal yaj t'a Judá yet' heb' sk'ab'yok winhaj Ocozías chi' yuj winh, ix smilancham heb' winh. Ha heb' winh chi' ayoch yopisio heb' winh yet' winhaj Ocozías chi'.

Ix schekan winh saychaj ek' winhaj Ocozías chi', yujto ha t'a Samaria ix sk'ub'ejel sb'a winh, palta ix yamchaj winh yuj heb', ix yik'anb'at winh heb' t'a winhaj Jehú chi', haxo ta' ix miljicham winh yuj winh. Ix yalan heb' icha tik: Co muquek winh, yujto yinhtilal winh winhaj Josafat, winh ak'jinak serwil Jehová t'a smasanil sk'ool, xchi heb'. Ha t'a skal heb' sk'ab' yok winhaj Ocozías chi', manhxa junok mach ix stek'b'ej sb'a yochkan reyal.
Ayic ix yab'an ix Atalía to toxo ix cham winhaj Ocozías yune' ix chi', ix schekan ix miljokcham masanil heb' yinhtilal heb' winh sreyal Judá chi'.

Palta haxo ix Joseba, elk'altak ix aj yik'ankanel winhaj Joás ix t'a skal juntzanhxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Ocozías wan smiljicham chi'. Ix sk'ub'anel winh ix t'a ix Atalía chi'. Ix b'at ix sk'ub'ejel winh t'a jun kuarto yik templo b'aj sway anima, haxo jun ix ix, ix ilan q'uib' winh ta'. Yuj chi' maj chamlaj winh. Ha ix Joseba chi' yisil ix winhaj Joram, yanab' ix winhaj Ocozías chi', yetb'eyum ix winhaj sakerdote Joiada.
Ha winhaj Joás chi', waque' ab'il ix k'ub'ajel winh t'a stemplo Jehová yet' jun ix ix, ix ilan q'uib'ok. Yakb'an chi' haxo ix Atalía chi', ayoch ix yajalil t'a jun chonhab' chi'.

Ayic yuquil ab'ilxo winhaj Joás chi', haxo winhaj sakerdote Joiada ix stek'b'ej sb'a, ix schekan winh awtaj masanil heb' winh yajal soldado, aton heb' winh yajal yaj t'a junjun kiento heb'. Aton winhaj Azarías yuninal winhaj Jeroham, winhaj Ismael yuninal winhaj Johanán, winhaj Azarías yuninal winhaj Obed, winhaj Maasías yuninal winhaj Adaías yet' winhaj Elisafat yuninal winhaj Zicri. Ix yalan winh to junxonhej tz'aj spensar heb' winh yet' winh.

Aton heb' winh tik ix b'at t'a masanil yol yik Judá, yik b'at smolb'an masanil heb' winh lewita heb' winh yet' heb' winh yajal yaj t'a junjun makan yinhtilal Israel, yik skot heb' winh smasanil t'a Jerusalén.

Masanil heb' winh ix smolb'ej sb'a chi', ix sb'o jun strato heb' winh yet' winh rey t'a stemplo Dios. Ix yalan winhaj Joiada chi' t'a heb' winh icha tik: Ina winh yuninalkan winh rey chamnak. Aton winh yowalil tz'och reyal, icha ajnak yak'ankan sti' Jehová yuj heb' yinhtilal winhaj Dawid.
Ha tiknaik jun icha tik ol he k'ulej: Ha ex sakerdote ex tik yet' ex lewita ex tik, a ex ton tzeyil munlajel t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip, ox makan ol ex ajok. Jun makan ex ol he tanhwej sti' stemplo Jehová.
Junxo makan ex ol he tanhwej sti' spalakio winh rey. Ha exxo junxo makan ex, ol ex kan he tanhwej t'a spuertail kimiento. Axo masanil anima, wach' skannhej heb' t'a yol yamaq'uil stemplo Jehová tik.

Palta malaj junok mach syal yoch t'a yol templo chi', anhej heb' winh sakerdote yet' heb' winh lewita ayoch t'a yopisio syal yochi, yujto sik'b'ilel heb' winh. Axo masanil anima, skan heb' t'a yamaq'uil templo chi', icha yalan scheknab'il Jehová.

Ha exxo lewita ex tik, ol ex och oyan t'a spatik winh rey, junjun ex eyed'nakokab' eyamk'ab' yik owal. Ha mach syak' pural yekanoch sb'ha t'a yol templo chi', b'enhej schami. Ha exxo tik, ajun exnhej yet' winh rey chi' yalnhej b'aj sb'at winh, xchi winhaj Joiada chi'.

Ha heb' winh lewita chi' yet' masanil heb' anima aj Judá chi', ix sk'anab'ajej heb' masanil tas ix yal winhaj sakerdote Joiada chi'. Junjun heb' winh yajal soldado chi', ayek' heb' winh yet' heb' ayoch t'a yalanh smandar heb' winh, aton heb' smunlaj t'a yopisio t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip yet' heb' tz'elkani, yujto maj chajiel-laj heb' yuj winhaj Joiada chi' ayik sk'och yorail yel heb'.
Ix yak'anpax k'een lanza winhaj Joiada chi' yet' maklab' jul-lab' t'a heb' winh yajal yaj t'a junjun kiento heb' soldado chi', aton juntzanh syamk'ab' winhaj rey Dawid aykan t'a stemplo Dios.

Ix ak'chajoch masanil heb' winh winak chi' yuj winh t'a stzolal, junjun heb' winh yet'nak syamk'ab' yik owal, yik stanhwan winh rey chi' heb' winh. Ix och oyan heb' winh t'a schanh pak'anhil yamaq'uil stemplo Jehová chi' yet' b'aj ay jun altar yet' t'a spuertail templo chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', a winhaj sakerdote Joiada chi' yet' heb' yuninal ix ik'anelta winh yuninalkan winh rey chi'. Ix yak'ank'e skorona winh heb', ix yak'an jun yumal strato Dios heb' t'a winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'ank'e akeite heb' t'a sjolom winh, ix yalan heb' to reyxo winh. Ix k'e nhilnaj masanil anima yalani: Niwanokab' yelk'och winh ko rey, xchi heb'.
Ayic ix yab'an ix Atalía chi' yel yaw heb' anima chi' yeq'ui, syak'an b'inaj winh rey chi' heb', ix b'at ix t'a stemplo Jehová chi'.

Axo ix yilan ix, a winh rey chi' linhanoch winh t'a jun niwan yoyal sti' stemplo Jehová chi', haxo t'a stz'ey winh ayek' heb' winh yajal yaji yet' heb' winh spu'an k'een trompeta. Masanil heb' anima chi' stzalaj heb'. Ay heb' spu'an k'een strompeta, ay pax heb' sb'itan yet' syamk'ab', aton heb' skuchb'an b'it chi' yik syalan wach' lolonel heb' d'ha Dios. Yuj chi', ix stzilchitanb'at spichul ix, ix yalan ix icha tik: --Pechum ex el yajal a ex tik. Pechum ex el yajal, xchi ix.

Palta a winhaj Joiada chi' ix chekan elta heb' winh yajal yaj t'a junjun kiento heb' soldado, ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Ik'equel ix b'aj tzolan ex och chi'. Yalnhej mach syak'och sb'a yet' ix, tze xikchamok, xchi winh. Toxo ix yal winhaj Joiada chi' to manhok t'a stemplo Jehová smiljicham ix.
Ix syaman ix heb' winh, ix yik'anel ix heb' winh t'a spuertail yik nok' schej winh rey, ata' ix miljicham ix yuj heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix sb'oan jun trato winhaj sakerdote Joiada chi' yet' masanil heb' anima chi' yet' winh rey chi', ix yalan heb' to ol ochkan heb' schonhab'ok Jehová.

Elanhchamel ix b'at heb' t'a stemplo Baal, ix b'at spojanem heb', ix smak'anpaxpoj altar heb' yet' juntzanh yechel komon Dios. Axo winhaj Matán sakerdote yik Baal chi', ha t'a yichanh altar chi' ix smilcham winh heb'.

Ix yak'ankan juntzanh munlajel t'a stemplo Jehová chi' winhaj Joiada chi' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' winh sakerdote yet' heb' winh lewita, yik wach' sk'anab'ajej heb' winh sb'oan munlajel ak'b'ilkan t'a yol sk'ab' heb' winh yuj winhaj rey Dawid. Aton yik snhusji silab' tz'ak'ji t'a Jehová icha yalan ley tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj winhaj Moisés. Ay pax heb' sb'itan t'a tzalajk'olal icha yutejnakkan winhaj rey Dawid chi'.
Ix yak'anpaxoch heb' stanhwan sti' stemplo Jehová chi' winh, yik wach' max och heb' anima manh wach'ok yaj icha yalan ley.

Ix yawtankot masanil heb' winh yajalil heb' soldado winhaj Joiada chi' yet' heb' winh niwak yelk'ochi yet' heb' winh yajal yaj t'a junjun chonhab' yet' pax masanil anima chi'. Ix yik'anelta winh rey chi' heb' t'a stemplo Jehová, ix yik'anb'at winh heb' t'a spalakio heb' rey. Ix och heb' t'a jun puerta t'a yib'anh. Ix yak'ankanem k'ojan winh heb' t'a sk'ojnub' heb' winh rey chi'.
Masanil heb' anima, ix te tzalajk'e heb', yujto toxo ix xikjicham ix Atalía. Yuj chi' junk'olal ix ajkan jun chonhab' chi'.
Ha winhaj Joás chi', uque' ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix schaanel yich winh yak'an reyal. 40 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Sibia sb'i ix snun winh, aj Beerseba ix.
Masanil tas ix sk'ulej winhaj Joás chi', yakb'an pitzanto winhaj sakerdote Joiada chi', te wach'nhej t'a yichanh Jehová.
Ha winhaj Joiada chi' ix sayan chawanh heb' ix yetb'eyum winhaj Joás chi', ay yalyuninal winh yet' heb' ix.
Ix ek' jab'ok tiempo, ix snaan winhaj rey Joás chi' to sb'ochajxi stemplo Jehová.

Yuj chi' ix smolb'ej heb' winh sakerdote winh yet' heb' winh lewita, ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: Ixiquec t'a masanil chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá tik, sb'at he molb'an k'een tumin, aton k'een syak'taxon heb' quetchonhab' tik t'a junjun ab'il yik sb'ochajxi stemplo Dios tik. Hak'ek wal eyip he b'ati, xchi winh. Palta maj yak'och wal heb' winh t'a sk'ool sb'ati.

Yuj chi' ix awtaj winhaj sat sakerdote Joiada yuj winhaj rey Joás chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: --¿Tas yuj max ak'och t'a a k'ol iptzitan heb' winh lewita yik sb'at yik'kot k'een ofrenda heb' winh t'a yol yik Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén tik, icha yalnakkan winhaj Moisés schekab' Jehová to masanil heb' quetisraelal smolan k'een tumin yik sb'ochaj skajnub' skaxail strato Jehová? xchi winh rey chi'.

Yujto a ix Atalía yet' heb' ochnak tzak'an yuj ix, ix ixtanb'at stemplo Jehová chi'. Ha juntzanh yamk'ab' niwak yelk'och yik templo chi', a ix sk'an heb' yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a jun komon Dios Baal.
Yuj chi' ix schek winhaj rey Joás chi' b'ochaj jun te' kaxa, haxo t'a stielta stemplo Jehová ix schek winh ak'chajkan te'.
Ix schekan winh alchajel t'a masanil yol yik Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén chi' to tz'ik'chajkot k'een ofrenda alb'ilkan yuj winhaj Moisés schekab' Jehová t'a tzinan lu'um.
Masanil heb' winh yajal yaji yet' masanil anima, t'a wal smasanil sk'ol heb' ix yak'em yofrenda t'a yol jun kaxa chi', masanto ix b'ud'ji te' yuj heb'.

Axo heb' winh lewita tz'ik'anb'at te' kaxa chi' t'a winh rey chi', haxo yik syilan winh to b'ut'anxo te', tz'awtaj winh stz'ib'um winh yet' jun winh ayoch yopisio yuj winh sat sakerdote. Sekanelta k'een tumin chi' heb' winh t'a yol te' kaxa chi', sb'at yak'anxikan te' heb' winh b'aj aykan chi'. Icha chi' syutej heb' winh t'a junjun k'u, yuj chi' niwan k'een tumin chi' ix molchaji.

Ha winh rey chi' yet' winhaj sakerdote Joiada chi' ix yak' k'een tumin chi' heb' winh t'a heb' winh ayoch yilan munlajel sb'o t'a stemplo Jehová chi', yik saychaj heb' winh mak'umpoj k'een, heb' winh nhikum te', heb' winh smunlaj t'a k'een hierro yet' t'a k'een bronke, yik wach' sb'ochajxi templo chi'.
Yuj chi' a heb' winh tz'ilan munlajel chi', a heb' winh skuchb'an heb' winh swach' b'oanxi templo chi'. Ix sb'o heb' winh icha wal yajtaxon t'a yichb’anel, te wach' ix ajxikan sb'o yuj heb' winh.

Axo yik ix lajwi sb'oel yuj heb' winh, ix yik'anb'at k'een tumin heb' winh ixto kani, ix yak'an k'een heb' winh t'a winh rey yet' t'a winhaj sakerdote Joiada chi'. Axo yet' k'een ix schek winh rey chi' b'ochaj yamk'ab' yik templo chi', aton juntzanh sk'anchaji ayik tz'och ejmelal yet' juntzanh sk'anchaj t'a altar yuj silab' snhusjitz'aok, icha k'een niwak kuchara yet' juntzanhxo yamk'ab' nab'a oro, ma plata. Yakb'an pitzanto winhaj sakerdote Joiada chi', snhusjitz'anhej silab' t'a stemplo Jehová.
Palta ix ichamwinakax winhaj Joiada chi', 130 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix cham winh.

Ha t'a schonhab' winhaj Dawid ix mukji winh, aton b'aj smukchaj heb' winh rey. Ha tas ix sk'ulej winh te wach'nhej yuj swach'ilok heb' yetisraelal, wach' ix yutej winh yak'an serwil Dios yet' t'a stemplo.

Ayic toxo ix cham winhaj Joiada chi', ix jawi heb' winh yajal yaj t'a Judá, ix em nhojan heb' winh t'a winhaj rey Joás chi' yik smontan winh heb' winh. Axo ix aji, ix och t'a spensar winh tas ix yal heb' winh chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yaktejkan stemplo Jehová heb', aton sDiosal smam yicham heb'. Axo t'a yechel komon Dios Asera ix och heb' ejmelal yet' t'a juntzanhxo komon Dios. Yuj chi' ix kot yowal sk'ol Jehová t'a heb' aj Judá chi' yet' t'a heb' aj Jerusalén chi'.
Ix schekkot heb' schekab' Jehová yik tzul yalan heb' to smeltzajxi heb' t'a Jehová chi', palta majxo schalaj yab' heb' tas ix yal heb' chekab' chi'.

Yuj chi', ix och Yespíritu Dios t'a winhaj Zacarías yuninalkan winhaj Joiada chi'. Ix k'e linhan winh t'a jun lugar chaanh, ix yalan winh t'a masanil anima chi' icha tik: Ha Jehová Dios tz'alan icha tik: ¿Tas yuj max he k'anab'ajej in cheknab'il? ¿Tas yuj tze saykot eyaelal t'a eyib'anh? Yujto ix in eyaktajkani, yuj chi' ol ex waktejpaxkani, xchi Jehová, xchi winh.

Palta ix och heb' ajk'olal smasanil t'a winh, ix snaan heb' tas tz'aj smilancham winh heb'. Ix yalan winhaj rey Joás chi' to sjulk'enajcham winh t'a yamaq'uil stemplo Jehová. Icha chi' ix aj scham winh.

Ha winhaj Joás chi', majxo snakotlaj jantak swach'k'olal winhaj Joiada chi' ix yak' t'a winh, palta to ix schek miljokcham winhaj Zacarías winh, aton winh yuninal winhaj Joiada chi'. Ayic wan scham winhaj Zacarías chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: Aokab' Jehová tz'ilan jun tik, ha' ol ak'an yowalil, xchi winh.

Ayic ix el yab'ilal scham winh, ix jawi heb' soldado sirio yak' owal yet' winhaj Joás chi'. Ix jawi heb' t'a Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén. Tzijtum heb' yajal yaj t'a Judá chi' ix smilcham heb'. Ix yik'anek' masanil tas ay stojol heb', ix yak'anb'at heb' t'a winh sreyal Damasco.

Jaywannhej heb' soldado sirio ix jawi yak' owal chi', haxo Jehová ix ak'anoch jantak heb' soldado yik Judá chi' t'a yol sk'ab' heb', yujto ix aktajkan Jehová chi' yuj heb', aton sDiosal heb' yet' heb' smam yicham. Icha wal chi' ix aj yab'an syail winhaj Joás chi' yuj chukal ix sk'ulej.

Ayic ix el heb' sirio t'a yol yik Judá chi', te niwan ix ajkan winhaj Joás chi' slajwi yuj heb'. Axo heb' winh ayoch yajalil yet' winh, ix sna' heb' winh tas syutej heb' winh swach' milancham winh, yik syak'anek' spak schamel winh yuninal winhaj sakerdote Joiada chi' heb' winh. Yuj chi' ix swach' milejcham winh heb' winh t'a sat sch'at. Ixlajwi chi', ix mukji winh t'a schonhab' winhaj Dawid, palta manhok b'aj smukchaj heb' winh rey.
Ha heb' winh ix wach' milancham winhaj Joás chi', aton winhaj Zadad yune' ix Simat aj Amón yet' winhaj Jozabad yune' ix Simrit aj Moab.

Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Joás chi' yet' heb' yuninal winh yet' lolonel ix yal heb' schekab' Dios t'a winh yet' yab'ixal b'aj swach' b'oejxi stemplo Jehová winh, aykan b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkan yab'ixal heb' winh rey. Axo winhaj Amasías yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayic 25 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Amasías ix och winh reyal, 29 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Joadán sb'i ix snun winh, aj Jerusalén ix.
Ha tas ix sk'ulej winh, wach' t'a yichanh Jehová, anhej to maj sk'ulej wal winh t'a smasanil sk'ool.
Ayic ix tek'k'aj yopisio winh chi', a heb' winh ayoch yajalil yet' winh, ix smilcham heb' winh, aton heb' winh miljinakcham winh smam winh.

Palta maj miljicham heb' winh yuninal heb' yuj winh, yujto tz'ib'yajkan t'a ley Moisés, b'aj syal Jehová: Ha heb' mamab'il, max yal scham heb' yuj smul yuninal, max yal pax scham heb' uninab'il yuj smul smam, yujto junjun mach scham yuj smul, xchikani.

Ix schekan winh to smolb'ej sb'a masanil heb' winh aj Judá yet' heb' winh yik Benjamín. Macquiltaquil ix aj heb' winh t'a junjun yinhtilal. Icha chi' ix aj yoch heb' winh yajalil t'a junjun mil yet' t'a junjun kien anima. Ix yik'anchaanh sb'isul anima winh, schael yich t'a heb' 20 ab'il sb'eynhejb'ati. Ha sb'isul heb' ix k'e waan chi', 300 mil, aton heb' stiempoalxo sb'at t'a owal, lista yaj heb' yet' slanza yet' smaklab' jul-lab'.
Ix smajnan 100 mil heb' soldado yik Israel winh, 75 quintal k'een plata ix yak' winh stojolok heb'.
Palta ay jun winh schekab' Dios ix k'och t'a winh, ix yalan winh t'a winh icha tik: --Ach rey, manh ik'och heb' soldado yik Israel yet' heb' yik Efraín ed'ok, yujto manh ayokoch Jehová yet' heb',

wach'chom tza na'a to yuj heb' ay yip heb' a soldado t'a owal, palta ha Dios ol ach ak'an ak'jok ganar yuj heb' ajk'ol chi', yujto ay spoder skolwaji, ay pax spoder satanel masanil, xchi winh schekab' Dios chi'.

Ix sk'anb'an winhaj Amasías chi' t'a winh schekab' Dios chi' icha tik: --Palta, ¿tas ol aj pax 75 quintal k'een plata ix wak' t'a heb' soldado israel chi' jun? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winh schekab' Dios chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Ha Jehová syal yak'an ek'alokxo icha k'een chi' t'ayach, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix chekji pax heb' soldado ix kot t'a yol yik Efraín chi' yuj winhaj Amasías chi', palta ix te kot yowal heb' t'a heb' yik Judá chi', yuj chi' te yowal heb' ayik ix pax heb' chi'.
Ix stek'b'an sb'a winhaj rey Amasías chi', ix b'at winh yet' heb' soldado t'a spanhanil yik Atz'am Atz'am. Ata' ix smilcham 10 mil soldado aj Seir heb'.
Anheja' ix syam pax 10 mil heb' aj Seir chi' heb', ix ik'jib'at heb' yuj heb' t'a sjolom jun lum witz sattak k'een yeq'ui. Ata' ix laj yumjikanb'at heb' yuj heb', chok' ix laj ajkan heb'.

Axo heb' soldado yik Israel maj chajokb'atlaj yuj winhaj Amasías t'a owal chi', aton heb' ix chekjikan meltzaj t'a spat, ix satel jaye' chonhab' heb' t'a yol smakb'en Judá, schab'at t'a Samaria masanto t'a Bet-horón. Ix smilancham 3 mil anima heb', tzijtum tastak ix yelk'ejb'at heb'.

Ayic ix meltzaj winhaj Amasías chi', ayik toxo ix satel heb' aj Edom yuj winh, aton heb' aj Seir, ix yik'ankot juntzanh skomon diosal heb' aj Seir chi' winh, ix yak'anoch winh sdiosalok. Ix yalan sb'a winh t'ay, ix snhusan pax inkienso winh t'ay.

Yuj jun chi' ix kot wal yowal Jehová t'a winh, ix schekkot jun winh schekab' yal t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: --¿Tas yuj tzach och ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios maj yal skolanel schonhab' t'a yol a k'ab'? xchi winh schekab' Dios chi'.

Ayic wanto yalan juntzanh chi' winh schekab' Dios chi', ix tak'wi winh rey chi' icha tik: --¿Tom ix wal t'ayach to a ach ol ak' in razón a in rey in tik? Actej alan juntzanh chi'. ¿Mato tza nib'ej tzach miljichamok? xchi winh. Axo winh schekab' Dios chi' manhxa tas ix yal winh, axonhej ix yal winh t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: --Vojtak a in tik to nab'ilxo yuj Dios to ol ach satelok, yujto ix a k'ulej jun tik, maj a k'anab'ajej tas ix wal t'ayach, xchi winh.

Ha winhaj Amasías sreyal Judá chi', ix sk'anb'ej yab' winh t'a juntzanh heb' ak'um razón. Yuj chi' ix schekan winh b'at alchaj t'a winhaj Joás yuninal winhaj Joacaz, yixchiquin winhaj Jehú, sreyal Israel, ix yalan winh icha tik: Cotanh, kak' owal, xchib'at winh.

Ix spakanpaxkot winhaj Joás chi' t'a winh icha tik: Ayab' jun te' sak q'uiix t'a Líbano, ix yalb'at te' t'a jun te' k'ute' ay pax ta' icha tik: Ak' ix isil yetb'eyumok winh wuninal, xchib'at te'. Palta ay jun nok' chium nok' ix ek' ta', haxo nok' ix tek'anem jun te' q'uiix chi'.

Ha ach tik tzala' to ix ak' ganar heb' aj Edom, yuj chi' tzik' wal chaanh a b'a, tza say tas tz'aj ik'jichaanh. Palta te wach' tato tzach kannhej t'a a pat. ¿Tas yuj tza nib'ej tzik'kot junok yaelal t'a ib'anh yet' t'a yib'anh chonhab' Judá? xchikot winhaj Joás chi' t'a winh.

Palta haxo winhaj Amasías chi', maj schalaj yab' winh, yujto toxo ix sna Dios to ol ak'jokoch winh t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Joás chi' yuj, yujto ha t'a juntzanh sdiosal heb' aj Edom chi' tz'och winh ejmelal.
Ixlajwi chi' ix kot winhaj Joás chi' yak' owal yet' winhaj Amasías chi', ix schalaj sb'a heb' winh t'a Bet-semes, t'a yol smakb'en Judá chi'.
Ix ak'ji ganar Judá chi' yuj heb' aj Israel, yuj chi' a heb' soldado aj Judá chi' toxonhej ix el lemeljok heb', ix paxkan heb' t'a spat.

Ix yamchaj winhaj Amasías sreyal Judá t'a Bet-semes chi' yuj winhaj Joás winh sreyal Israel chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix ik'chajkot winh t'a Jerusalén. Ix smak'ankanem lanhnaj smuroal jun chonhab' chi' heb' israel chi'. Ay am 180 metrook ix spojem heb', ix b'atnhej t'a puerta yik Efraín, masanto ix k'och t'a spuertail schiquin jun smuroal chi'.

Ix yik'anpaxb'at k'een oro heb', k'een plata yet' juntzanhxo tas ay t'a yol stemplo Dios, aton juntzanh stanhwej heb' yinhtilal winhaj Obed-edom. Ix yik'paxb'at jantaknhej b'eyumal ay t'a spalakio winh rey chi' heb'. Ix yik'anpaxb'at juntzanh anima heb' icha presoal ayik ix pax heb' t'a Samaria. Ix ak'ji pural winhaj Amasías chi' yuj winhaj Joás yochkan wach'k'olal yet'ok.
Ha winhaj Amasías yuninal winhaj Joás sreyal Judá chi', 15 ab'ilto ix yak' reyal winh t'a Judá ayik toxo ix cham winhaj Joás yuninal winhaj Joacaz sreyal Israel.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Amasías chi', ayik ix el yich masanto ix lajwi, aykan b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá yet' heb' winh sreyal Israel.

Atax wal yik ix yik'anel sb'a winhaj Amasías t'a Jehová, ay juntzanh heb' aj Jerusalén chi' ix naan smilcham winh. Yuj chi' ix b'atkan winh elelal t'a chonhab' Laquis, palta ix b'atnhej heb' t'a spatik winh t'a jun chonhab' chi', ata' ix cham winh yuj heb'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'anb'at sniwanil winh heb' t'a yib'anh jun nok' chej, haxo b'aj mukan heb' smam yicham winh ix mukchaji, aton t'a schonhab' winhaj Dawid.

Ayic toxo ix cham winhaj Amasías chi', haxo winhaj Uzías ix yak'och heb' aj Judá reyal sk'exulok winh smam chi'. Ayic ix schaanel yich winh yak'an reyal, 16 ab'il sk'inal winh. 52 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Jecolías sb'i ix snun winh, aj Jerusalén ix. Ayic ayoch winh reyal ix sb'oanxik'e chonhab' Elat winh, ix kanxi yikok Judá.
Masanil tas ix sk'ulej winhaj Uzías chi', wach'nhej t'a yichanh Jehová, icha sk'ulejnak winhaj Amasías smam winh.

Ix yak' wal och spensar winh d'ha Dios yakb'an pitzanto winhaj Zacarías. Ha winhaj Zacarías chi' ix k'ayb'an winh t'a tas syutej sk'anab'ajan Jehová. Yakb'an ix sk'anab'ajej winh, wach'nhej ix ajelk'och winh yuj Jehová.

Ha winhaj Uzías chi', ix b'at winh yet' heb' winh soldado yak' owal yet' heb' filisteo, ix smak'anem lanhnaj smuroal chonhab' Gat heb' winh, Jabnia yet' Asdod. Ix sb'oank'e juntzanh chonhab' heb' t'a yol yik Asdod chi' yet' juntzanhxo chonhab' yik heb' filisteo chi'.
Ix och wal Dios yet' winh ayik ix yak'an owal winh yet' heb' filisteo chi' yet' heb' árabe kajan t'a Gur-baal yet' heb' amonita.
Ix yak'an k'een tumin heb' amonita t'a winh, aton k'een ix ak'jioch t'a yib'anh heb' yak'ani. Ix yak'nhej yajalil winh masanto t'a smojonal Egipto, yujto ix yik' wal yip yopisio winh chi'.

Ix sb'oxik'e juntzanh b'aj tz'aj heb' soldado winh t'a yib'anh smuroal Jerusalén chi' yet' t'a yib'anh spuertail t'a schiquin yet' t'a yib'anh puerta t'a ch'olan yet' t'a juntzanhxo schiquintak. Te wach' ix aj sb'oanxik'e winh.

Ix sb'oanpax juntzanh yet'tal heb' winh soldado winh t'a tzinan lu'um yet' pax b'aj tz'aj heb' soldado chi' t'a chaanh. Ix schekanpax winh joychaj jantak a uk'b'ila', yujto te niwan nok' smolb'etzal nok' winh t'a ak'liktak yet' t'a yichtak witz. Ay pax heb' smunlajwum winh smunlaj t'a awoj uwa yet' t'a juntzanhxo awb'en ay t'a tzalquixtak yet' t'a lum ak'liktak. Te ay wal och t'a sk'ol winh smunlaj t'a tas tz'awchaji.

Ay pax jun niwan nhilanh heb' soldado winh, ayik sb'at heb' t'a owal, pojquiltak yaj heb', icha tas makanhil yajek' sb'i heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Jeiel winh tz'ib'um yet' winhaj Maasías yajal. Ha winhaj Hananías sat yajal yaj t'a heb', ayoch yopisio winh yet' winhaj rey Uzías chi'.
Axo masanil heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun makan heb' winh soldado chi' icha tas yinhtilal heb', ay 2 mil 600 heb'.
Axo heb' soldado ayoch t'a yalanh smandar heb', ay 307 mil 500 heb', listaxo yaj heb' sb'at t'a owal, te tek'an heb' skolwaj t'a winh rey chi' yik syak'an owal winh yet' heb' ajk'ool.
Ix schekan winhaj rey Uzías chi' b'ojok juntzanh syamk'ab' heb' soldado chi': Aton maklab' jul-lab', k'een lanza, k'een xumpil, maklab' nhik'ool, yol jul-lab' yet' mejmeech.

Ix sayan juntzanh heb' winh winak winh te jelan yik sb'oan juntzanh k'een niwak máquina yik owal. Ix b'ochaj k'een b'ajtak ayk'e heb' soldado t'a chaanh t'a yib'anhtak muro. Ha juntzanh k'een máquina chi', a k'een sjulanb'at k'een niwak k'een. Ix te pukaxb'at yab'ixal winh t'a najat. Ix och wal Dios yet' winh, yuj chi' te ay smay ix aj sb'inaj winh.

Palta ayik ix tek'k'aj wal yopisio winh chi', ix yik'anchaanh sb'a winh. Yuj chi' ix yik'kot winh t'a yib'anh. Ix spitej sb'a winh t'a Jehová Dios, aton sDiosal heb' smam yicham winh. Ix och winh t'a yol stemplo Jehová, ix snhusan inkienso winh t'a altar.
Tzak'an yoch winhaj sakerdote Azarías yuj winh yet' pax 80 heb' winh sakerdote yik Jehová. Manh jab'ok ix xiw heb' winh yochi.

Axo yik ix k'och heb' winh t'a winh rey chi', ix yalan heb' winh icha tik t'a winh: Mamin rey Uzías, a ach tik manh opisiook a nhusan inkienso t'a Jehová, palta a onh sakerdote onh yinhtilal onh winhaj Aarón tik, a onh sik'b'ilonhkanoch t'a jun opisio tik. Yuj chi' mamin rey, wach' tzach el t'a jun lugar tik, yujto toxo ix och a chukal t'a Jehová, yuj chi' manhxo ol ach ik'jokchaanh yuj, xchi heb' winh t'a winh.

Ha winhaj rey Uzías chi', ayik linhan och winh t'a stz'ey jun altar yik inkienso t'a yol templo chi' yet'nak jun chaynub' yik inkienso winh. Ix kot wal yowal winh t'a heb' winh sakerdote chi', haxo wal t'a jun rato chi' ix elta yab'il lepra t'a snanhal sat winh.

Ayic ix yilan winhaj sat sakerdote Azarías yet' heb' winh ajun yet' winh chi' to toxo ix elta yab'il lepra t'a snanhal sat winh rey chi', ix yik'anelta winh heb' winh t'a elanhchamel. Ix snib'ej pax winh rey chi' tz'elta t'a elanhchamel, yujto toxo ix jawi yaelal t'a yib'anh winh yuj Jehová.

Ix kannhej jun lepra chi' t'a winhaj rey Uzías chi' masanto ix cham winh, yuj chi' sch'okoj winh ix aj t'a jun pat, majxo chajokochlaj winh t'a yol stemplo Jehová. Axo winhaj Jotam yuninal winh ix ochkan sk'exulok, yik skan winh t'a spalakio yik syak'anpax yajalil winh t'a jun chonhab' chi'.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj rey Uzías chi', ayik ix el yich masanto ix lajwi, tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj winhaj Isaías schekab' Dios, winh yuninal winhaj Amoz.

Ayic ix cham winh Uzías chi', ix mukji winh t'a smakb'en b'aj smukchaj heb' winh rey. Yujto ay lepra t'a winh, yuj chi' maj yal smukchaj winh t'a yet'tal heb' winh rey chi'. Ixlajwi chi' haxo winhaj Jotam yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ha winhaj Jotam chi', 25 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal. 16 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Jerusa sb'i ix snun winh, yisil ix winhaj Sadoc.

Ha tas ix sk'ulej winhaj Jotam chi', wach' t'a yichanh Jehová icha ix sk'ulej winhaj Uzías smam winh. Palta maj ochlaj winh t'a yol stemplo Jehová icha ix yutej sb'a winh smam winh chi'. Axo masanil anima, te chuk tas ix sb'eyb'alej heb'.
Ha winhaj Jotam chi' ix chekan b'ojok jun spuertail templo t'a yib'anh. Tzijtum tas ix schek winh b'ojok t'a yib'anh smuroal chonhab' b'aj mukb'il jun ch'olan.
Ix schekan winh b'ochajxik'e juntzanh niwak chonhab' t'a tzalquixtak t'a yol yik Judá yet' yet'tal heb' winh soldado chaanh yajk'e b'aj stanhwej heb' winh t'a kaltak te'.

Ix yak' owal winh yet' heb' amonita, ix ak'ji ganar heb' yuj winh. Ha t'a jun ab'il chi', ix yak' k'een tumin heb' ix ak'jioch t'a yib'anh yak'an t'a winh. Ix yak' 75 quintal k'een plata heb' yet' 37 mil quintal ixim trigo. Anheja' icha pax chi' ixim kebada ix yak' heb'. Icha chi' ix sk'ulej heb' t'a oxe' ab'il.
Te tek'an ix aj winh t'a sreyal chi', yujto te wach' sb'eyb'al winh t'a yichanh Jehová.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj rey Jotam chi' yet' tastak sk'ulejnak winh yet' jantak owal yak'nak winh, aykan b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel yet' Judá.
Ayic ix och winh t'a reyal, 25 ab'il sk'inal winh. 16 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén.
Axo yik ix cham winh, ix mukji winh yet' heb' smam yicham t'a schonhab' winhaj Dawid. Ixlajwi chi', haxo winhaj Acaz yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.

Ayic ix och winhaj Acaz chi' reyal, 20 ab'il sk'inal winh. 16 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén, palta manh wach'ok tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, maj sk'ulej winh icha tas sk'ulejnak winhaj Dawid smam yicham winh.
Ha sb'eyb'al heb' winh sreyal Israel ix sb'eyb'alej winh. Ix schekan winh b'ochaj k'een k'een yechel komon Dios Baal.
Ix snhusan inkienso winh t'a sch'olanil yik Ben-hinom, ix snhusanpaxtz'a yuninal winh silab'il icha wal schuk b'eyb'al juntzanh chonhab' ix ik'jiel yuj Jehová t'a yichanh heb' israel t'a lum chi'.
Anhejtona', ix snhus pax silab' winh yet' inkienso t'a juntzanh lugar b'ajtak chaanh yet' t'a yichtak te te' k'ayum xiil.

Yuj chi' ix ak'jioch winh yuj Jehová sDiosal t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Siria. Te niwan anima ix ik'jib'at t'a Damasco yuj heb' sirio chi'. Anheja' ix ak'jipaxoch winh yuj Jehová t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Peka yuninal winhaj Remalías sreyal Israel. Ha t'a jun k'u, 120 mil heb' soldado te tek'an yik Judá ix smilcham heb', yujto ix yaktejkan Jehová sDiosal heb', aton sDiosal smam yicham heb'.

Ay jun winh soldado te tek'an t'a yinhtilal Efraín skuchan Zicri, a winh ix milancham winhaj Maasías yuninal winh rey chi' yet' winhaj Azricam yajal t'a spalakio winh rey chi' yet' winhaj Elcana sat yajal yuj winh rey chi'.

Wach'chom yetchonhab' sb'a heb' yet' heb' israel chi', palta ix ik'jib'at 200 mil heb' yuj heb', aton heb' ix ix, heb' winak unin yet' heb' ix unin, ix ik'jib'at heb' t'a Samaria. Manhxo jantakok pax tas ix yik'b'at heb' israel chi'.

Ha t'a Samaria chi', ay jun winh schekab' Dios skuchan Obed. Ix elta winh scha heb' soldado wan sk'ochxi t'a Samaria chi'. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' icha tik: --Ha Jehová ko Diosal, sDiosal pax heb' ko mam quicham, ix kot yowal sk'ol t'a Judá, yuj chi' ix yak'och heb' t'a yol he k'ab'. Palta a exxo tik ix he milcham heb' yet' wal yowal he k'ool to ix k'e wal k'och t'a satcha’anh.
Axo tiknaik, tze na'a to tzeyak'och heb' aj Judá tik yet' heb' aj Jerusalén tik eyak'umalok serwil. Palta ¿tom malaj pax he mul a ex tik t'a yichanh Jehová?
Ha tiknaik, ab'ek tas ol wala': Hak'ek meltzaj masanil heb' quetisraelal ix eyik'kot chi' t'a tik, yujto ay wal kot yowal Jehová t'ayex, xchi winhaj Obed chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ay jaywanh heb' winh yajal yaj t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Efraín, aton winhaj Azarías yuninal winhaj Johanán, winhaj Berequías yuninal winhaj Mesilemot, winhaj Ezequías yuninal winhaj Salum yet' winhaj Amasa yuninal winhaj Hadlai, ix och heb' winh t'a sat heb' winh wan sjax t'a owal chi'.

Ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --Manh eyik'kot heb' chi' t'a tik, yujto a jun tik tz'och ko mulok t'a Jehová. ¿Tom tze say tas tz'aj swach' och ko mul t'ay? Te niwanxo ko mul tz'ochi, yuj chi' skot wal yowal Jehová chi' t'ayonh, xchi heb' winh.
Yuj chi', ix aktajel masanil heb' ix ik'jikot yuj heb' soldado chi' yet' pax masanil tastak ix yik'kot heb', ix yak'ankan heb' t'a yichanh heb' yajalil chonhab' yet' t'a yichanh masanil anima.

Axo heb' winh ix b'inaj sb'i tik, a heb' winh ix tanhwan heb' ix ik'jikot chi'. Ha t'a skal masanil tastak ix yik'ek' heb' soldado chi', ata' ix k'eta pichul ix ak'jioch t'a heb' b'eraneli. Ix ak'jioch xanhab' heb', ix ak'ji wa heb', ix yuk'an pax ha' heb'. Ix ak'jioch akeite t'a heb' echen yaji. Axo heb' maxtzak yal-laj sb'eyi, ix ak'jik'e heb' t'a yib'anh nok' b'uru yuj heb'. Ix kot heb' winh yajal chonhab' Samaria chi' yak'xikan heb' t'a heb' yetchonhab' t'a Jericó, aton b'aj te ay te' palma. Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzajxi heb' winh t'a Samaria chi'.
Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', ix schekb'at heb' schekab' winhaj rey Acaz t'a winh sreyal Asiria, yik sk'anan kolwal winh t'a winh.
Yujto a heb' aj Edom ix jawi heb' junelxo yak' owal t'a heb' aj Judá, ay heb' anima ix yik'b'at heb'.

Yakb'an chi' haxo heb' filisteo, ix ik'anpaxb'at tastak ay t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a yichtak witz yet' t'a Neguev t'a yol yik Judá chi'. Ix yik'anek' chonhab' Bet-semes heb', Ajalón, Gederot, Soco, Timna yet' Gimzo yet' yaldeail junjun juntzanh chonhab' chi'. Ixlajwi chi' haxo heb' filisteo chi' ix kajnaj ta'.
Emnaquil ix ajkan heb' aj Judá chi' yuj Jehová, yujto a winhaj Acaz sreyal heb', a winh ix kuchb'anb'at heb' t'a chukal, ix spitej wal sb'a winh t'a Jehová.
Ayic ix jawi winhaj Tiglat-pileser sreyal Asiria chi' t'a Judá, maj kolwajlaj winh, palta to ix wach' lajwiel yuj winh.

Wach'chom ixto smolb'ejelta juntzanh tastak karo stojol ay t'a stemplo Jehová winhaj Acaz chi' yet' tastak ay t'a spalakio winh yet' tastak ay t'a spat heb' winh yajal yaji, ix yak'an winh t'a winh sreyal Asiria chi', palta nab'anhej, majxo kolwaj jab'ok winh yet' winh.
Wach'chom niwan yaelal ix jawi t'a yib'anh winhaj Acaz chi', palta anheja' ix ochnhej smul winh t'a Jehová.

Ix yak'an silab' winh t'a juntzanh skomon diosal heb' aj Damasco. Yujto toxo ix ak'ji ganar winh yuj heb', ix yalan winh icha tik: Ha juntzanh sdiosal heb' sirio tik skolwaji, yuj chi' ol wak' in silab' t'ay yik wach' ol kolwaj wed'ok, xchi winh. Icha chi' ix aj skot wal t'a yib'anh winh yet' heb' yetchonhab' chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix smolb'an juntzanh yamk'ab' yik stemplo Dios winh, ix smak'anpoj winh. Ix smakankan templo chi' winh, ix schekan winh b'ojokk'e juntzanh altar t'a schiquintak skalleal Jerusalén chi'.

Ix schekanpax winh b'ojokk'e juntzanh altar b'ajtak chaanh t'a yoltak chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá chi'. Ata' snhus inkienso winh t'a komon Dios. Icha chi' ix yutej winh stzuntzankot yowal sk'ol Jehová sDiosal smam yicham.
Ha jantakto tas ix sk'ulej winh, ayik ix el yich masanto ix lajwi, aykan b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkan yab'ixal heb' sreyal Judá yet' Israel.
Axo yik ix cham winh, ix mukji winh t'a chonhab' Jerusalén, palta manhok t'a yet'tal heb' winh rey ix mukji winh. Axo winhaj Ezequías yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayic ix schaanel yich winhaj Ezequías yak'an reyal, 25 ab'il sk'inal winh. 29 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Abías sb'i ix snun winh, yisil ix winhaj Zacarías.
Ha tas ix sk'ulej winh, wach'nhej t'a yichanh Jehová, icha wal sb'eyb'al winhaj Dawid smam yicham winh.
Ha t'a b'ab'el uj yik b'ab'el ab'il yoch winhaj Ezequías reyal, ix schekan winh jakchajxi stemplo Jehová, ix schekan winh wach' b'ochajxi spuertail.
Ix schekan winh awtajkot heb' winh sakerdote yet' heb' winh lewita, ix molb'aj heb' winh t'a yamaq'uil templo chi' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u.

Ix yalan winh icha tik: Ex lewita, ab'ek tas ol wala': Sakb'itejek he b'a, tze sakb'itan pax stemplo Jehová, aton ko Diosal yet' heb' ko mam quicham. Ik'equelta masanil tas manh wach'ok ayoch t'a yool.
Yujto a heb' ko mam quicham, te pit yutejnak sb'a heb' t'a Jehová ko Diosal, te chuk tas k'ulejnak heb' t'a yichanh. Aktab'ilkan yuj heb', yik'naquel spensar heb' t'a skajnub'.
Smakannakkan spuertail heb', spu'annak tup sk'ak'al kandil heb', maxtzak snhus inkienso heb', maxtzak yak' silab' heb' to snhusjitz'a masanil t'a stemplo ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik.

Yuj chi', ix kot wal yowal sk'ol Jehová t'a Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén tik, kuseltak ix onh ajkan yuj, te q'uixwelal pax ix onh ajkani, ix onh ochpaxkan sb'uchlab'ejok juntzanh chonhab', icha wal tz'aj eyilan tiknaik.
Yuj chi', ay heb' ko mam quicham chamnak t'a owal. Manh jantakok heb' ix quetb'eyum yet' heb' kalkuninal ik'chajnakb'at t'a ch'ok chonhab'il.
Ha tiknaik ix in na'a to ol in b'o jun trato yet' Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, yik wach' syik'el yowal sk'ol t'a quib'anh.
Yuj chi', ex wetchonhab', manh eyik'ek' tiempo he b'oan stemplo Jehová, yujto ha' ex sik'aneli, yik tzeyak'an serwil, tze nhusanpaxtz'a inkienso t'a yichanh, xchi winh.

Aton sb'i heb' lewita ix och t'a munlajel tik: Ha t'a skal heb' yinhtilal winhaj Coat: Vinhaj Mahat yuninal winhaj Amasai yet' winhaj Joel yuninal winhaj Azarías. Axo t'a skal heb' yinhtilal winhaj Merari: Vinhaj Cis yuninal winhaj Abdi yet' winhaj Azarías yuninal winhaj Jehalelel. Axo t'a skal heb' yinhtilal winhaj Gersón: Vinhaj Joa yuninal winhaj Zima yet' winhaj Edén yuninal winhaj Joa.
Axo t'a skal heb' yinhtilal winhaj Elizafán: Vinhaj Simri yet' winhaj Jeiel. Ha t'a skal heb' yinhtilal winhaj Asaf: Vinhaj Zacarías yet' winhaj Matanías.
Axo t'a skal yinhtilal winhaj Hemán: Ha winhaj Jehiel yet' winhaj Simei. Axo t'a skal heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jedutún: Ha winhaj Semaías yet' winhaj Uziel.

B'ab'el, ix smolb'ej heb' sk'ab' yok heb' winh, ix sakb'itan sb'a heb' winh smasanil icha yalan ley. Ixlajwi chi' ix och heb' winh t'a yol templo chi', ix sakb'itanpax templo chi' heb' winh icha yalan ley, icha ix yutej winh rey yalani, icha syal scheknab'il Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi', ix och heb' winh sakerdote chi' t'a yol templo yik sakb'itan heb' winh. Masanil tas manh wach'ok ix ilchaj yuj heb' winh, ix laj yik'elta heb' winh, ix yik'anel heb' winh t'a yamaq'uil templo chi'. Axo juntzanh heb' winh lewita ix b'at julankanb'at t'a sch'olanil stitak ha' Cedrón.

Ha t'a b'ab'el k'u yik b'ab'el uj chi' ix syamoch heb' winh sakb'itan juntzanh yamaq'uil templo chi'. Axo t'a swajxaquil k'ual ix elk'och heb' winh sakb'itan t'a sti' templo chi'. Vajxaqueto k'ual ix yak' pax heb' winh sakb'itan yol templo chi', yuj chi' 16 k'ual ix yak' heb' winh sakb'itani, ix lajwielk'och smasanil.

Ixlajwi chi', ix k'och heb' winh t'a spalakio winhaj rey Ezequías chi', ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: Toxo ix ko sakb'itej stemplo Jehová yet' altar b'aj stz'a silab', smexail ixim pan tz'em t'a yichanh Jehová yet' syamk'ab'il junjun.

Anhejtona' ix ko sakb'itej juntzanh yamk'ab' elnakkan t'a yopisio yuj winhaj rey Acaz, ayik yochnak spitalil winh. Axo tiknaik, toxo ix ko b'oxikanoch t'a yet'tal t'a yichanh yaltar Jehová, xchi heb' winh.
Axo t'a junxo k'u, ix pet k'e wan winhaj rey Ezequías chi', ix smolb'an masanil heb' yajal chonhab' chi' winh, ix b'at heb' t'a stemplo Jehová.

Ix yik'anb'at ukwanh nok' quelem wakax heb', ukwanh nok' ch'ak kalnel yet' ukwanh nok' kelemtak kalnel yet' ukwanh nok' kelemtak chiwa. Ha juntzanh nok' chi' ix yak' nok' heb' silab'il yik tz'ak'jikan lajwok smul heb' yajal yaj t'a chonhab' chi' yet' masanil heb' aj Judá chi', yik sakb'ikan pax stemplo Jehová chi'. Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a heb' winh sakerdote yinhtilal winhaj Aarón to snhustz'a silab' chi' heb' t'a yib'anh altar yik Jehová.

Ix smilancham nok' wakax chi' heb' winh sakerdote chi', ix schaan schiq'uil nok' heb' winh, ix stzikanem heb' winh t'a yib'anh altar chi'. Anheja' icha chi' ix yutejpax nok' ch'ak kalnel chi' heb' winh yet' pax nok' kelemtak kalnel chi'.
Ix yik'anb'at nok' chiwa chi' heb' winh t'a yichanh winh rey yet' t'a yichanh heb' anima smasanil. Ix yak'ank'e sk'ab' heb' t'a sjolom nok' yik tz'ak'jikan lajwok smul heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix smilancham nok' heb' winh sakerdote chi', ix sekanem schiq'uil nok' heb' winh t'a yib'anh altar. Ha jun chi' ofrenda yuj yak'ji tup smul heb' israel chi', icha ix aj yalan winh rey chi'.

Ix ak'jipaxoch heb' winh lewita yuj winhaj rey Ezequías chi' t'a stemplo Jehová yet' syamk'ab' heb' winh yik b'it: Aton k'een platillo, salterio, kítara, icha yajkan stzolal yuj winhaj rey Dawid yet' winhaj Gad, aton winh ak'um razón t'a winhaj rey Dawid chi', icha pax yaj yalankan winhaj Natán schekab' Dios. Ha juntzanh cheknab'il chi' alb'ilkan yuj Jehová yuj heb' schekab'.
Linhanoch heb' winh lewita yet' yamk'ab' yik b'it ak'b'ilkan yuj winhaj rey Dawid. Linhanpaxoch heb' winh sakerdote spu'an strompeta.

Yuj chi', ix yalan winhaj rey Ezequías chi' to snhusjitz'a silab' t'a yib'anh altar chi'. Axo yik ix el yich snhusantz'a nok' silab' chi' heb' winh, ix el pax yich sb'itan heb' winh sb'itan chi', yik syik'anchaanh Jehová heb' winh, ix spu'an strompeta heb' winh. Ix k'anjipax juntzanh yamk'ab' yik b'it ak'b'ilkan yuj winhaj rey Dawid chi'.

Axo masanil anima, nhojanem heb' ejmelal yakb'an wan sb'itan heb' winh sb'itan chi', wan spu'an pax strompeta heb' winh sakerdote. Masanto yik ix lajwi stz'ab'at silab' chi' ix och waan heb' winh sb'itani.
Ayic ix lajwi yak'ji silab' chi', ix em nhojan winh rey yet' masanil heb' ajun yet' chi' ejmelal.

Ix yalan winh yet' heb' winh yajal chonhab' chi' t'a heb' winh lewita to syal wach' lolonel heb' winh t'a Jehová yet' juntzanh b'it sb'onakkan winhaj rey Dawid yet' pax juntzanh yik winhaj Asaf schekab' Dios. Ix sk'anab'ajan heb' winh yet' wal stzalajk'olal, ix empax nhojan heb' winh ejmelal.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a heb' anima: Yakb'an toxo ix he sakb'itej he b'ha t'a yichanh Jehová icha yalan ley, kotanhek, ik'ekkot he silab' yet' eyofrenda yuj eyak'an yuj diosal t'a stemplo Jehová, xchi winh. Yuj chi' masanil heb' anima chi', ix yik'kot silab' heb' yet' yofrenda yuj yak'an yuj diosal heb'. Axo heb' ix el wal t'a sk'ol yak'ani, ix yak' silab' heb' snhusjitz'a smasanil.
Masanil nok' nok' ix yik'kot heb' anima chi' silab'il snhusjitz'a smasanil chi', 70 nok' mam wakax, 100 nok' ch'ak kalnel yet' 200 nok' kelemtak kalnel. Ix nhusjitz'a nok' silab'il t'a Jehová.
Ha sb'isul masanil nok' ix yak' heb' silab'il chi', 600 nok' mam wakax yet' 3 mil nok' kalnel yet' nok' chiwa.

Yujto quennhej sb'isul heb' winh sakerdote, maj tzak'wanlaj heb' winh spatz'anel masanil nok' silab' snhusjitz'a smasanil chi', yuj chi' ix kolwaj heb' winh yetlewitail heb' winh, yakb'an sakb'itej pax sb'a juntzanhxo heb' winh sakerdote, yujto a heb' winh lewita elanhchamel ix yak'och heb' winh t'a sk'ol sakb'itan sb'ha t'a yichanh juntzanh heb' winh sakerdote chi'.

Ayto nanhalxo nok' silab' chi' ix ak'chaji yet' pax xepual nok' silab' yik junk'olal yet' wino ix ak'chaj ofrendail yet' pax nok' silab' snhusjitz'a smasanil. Ichaton chi' ix aj yelxi yich yochxi ejmelal t'a stemplo Jehová.
Ix te tzalaj winhaj Ezequías chi' yet' masanil heb' anima yuj tas ix sk'ulej Dios yet' heb', yujto elanhchamel ix yik' sb'a masanil tas ix uji chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix schekan winhaj rey Ezequías chi' alchajel t'a yol yik Israel yet' t'a yol yik Judá, ix yak'anpaxb'at yumal winh t'a heb' ay t'a yol yik Efraín yet' t'a yol yik Manasés, yik skot heb' t'a stemplo Jehová t'a Jerusalén, yik tz'och q'uinh yik snaankot heb' ayik yelnak heb' smam yicham heb' libre yuj Jehová sDiosal Israel t'a Egipto.
Ayic ix lajwi slolon winh rey chi' yet' heb' ayoch yajalil yet' winh yet' masanil heb' anima t'a Jerusalén chi', ix snaan heb' to ha t'a schab'il uj ol och q'uinh chi',
yujto maj yal-laj yoch q'uinh chi' t'a sk'ual aykani, yujto quennhej heb' winh sakerdote ix sakb'itej sb'a icha yalan ley, manta pax heb' anima smolb'ej sb'ha t'a Jerusalén chi'.
Yujto ix scha sk'ol winh rey yet' masanil anima tas ix nachaj chi',

yuj chi' ix sna heb' to spukchaj yumal t'a masanil yol yik Israel. Schacot t'a Dan, masanto sk'och t'a Beerseba. Ix awtajkot heb' yik sjawi heb' t'a Jerusalén yik tz'och q'uinh chi', yujto ha t'a yalanhtaxo, manh niwanok heb' smolb'ej sb'a yik syak'anoch jun q'uinh chi' heb', icha yaj stz'ib'chajkani.

Yuj chi' ix b'at heb' schekab' winh rey chi' t'a masanil yol yik Israel yet' t'a yol yik Judá, ix yik'anb'at yumal heb', aton ix schek b'ojok winh rey chi' yet' heb' ayoch yajalil yet'ok, b'aj syal winh icha tik: Ex quetisraelal, meltzajanhekxi t'a Jehová sDiosal winh ko mam quicham aj Abraham, winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Israel, yik ol ochxok eyed'ok a ex manh ex kannakok t'a yol sk'ab' heb' winh sreyal Asiria.

Mokab' lajanok tzeyutej he b'a icha heb' he mam eyicham, icha pax heb' quetisraelal, ix spitej wal sb'a heb' t'a Jehová ko Diosal yet' heb' ko mam quicham chi'. Ha wal ko Diosal chi' ix satanel heb' icha wal tz'aj quilan tiknaik.

Yuj chi' manh eyak' pitb'ok he b'a, icha yutejnak sb'a heb' ko mam quicham chi'. Hak'uekxioch he b'ha t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová ko Diosal, kotanhek t'a stemplo sik'b'ilel yuj t'a masanil tiempo, tzeyak'an serwil yik maxtzak kot yowal sk'ol t'ayex.

Tato ol eyak'xioch Jehová t'a he k'ool, haxo heb' ajk'ol ik'jinakb'at heb' quetisraelal yet' heb' eyuninal t'a preso chi', ol ok' sk'ol heb' t'a heb', ol ak'jok meltzaj heb' t'a ko chonhab' tik. Yujto a Jehová ko Diosal, te ay sniwank'olal, ay pax yok'elk'olal, manh ol ex spatiquejkaneli tato ol eyak'xioch he b'ha t'a yol sk'ab', xchib'at winh rey chi' t'a heb'.

Ix b'at heb' chekab' chi' t'a masanil yol yik Efraín yet' t'a yol yik Manasés, ix b'atnhej heb' t'a junjun chonhab', masanto ix k'och heb' t'a yol yik Zabulón. Palta a heb' anima chi', tonhej ix tzewaj heb', ix b'uchwaj pax heb' t'a heb' chekab' chi'.
Palta ay jaywanh heb' winh winak t'a yinhtilal Aser, t'a yik Manasés yet' t'a yik Zabulón ix och heb' ejmelal d'ha Dios chi', ix jawi heb' t'a Jerusalén chi'.
Ha Dios ix ak'an sna' masanil heb' anima t'a Judá chi', yik sk'anab'ajan heb' jun cheknab'il ix yal winh rey chi' yet' heb' ayoch yajalil yet'ok, icha ix aj yalan Jehová.
Yuj chi' a wal t'a schab'il uj, ix smolb'an sb'a jantak anima t'a Jerusalén chi', ix yak'anoch q'uinh heb' yik ixim pan malaj yich.
Ix syamanoch heb' yik'anel masanil juntzanh altar yet' juntzanh lugar b'ajtak snhuschaj inkienso t'a Jerusalén chi'. Ix syumankanem heb' t'a sch'olanil ha' Cedrón.

Ayic 14 yoch schab'il uj chi', ix smilancham nok' quelem kalnel heb' yik q'uinh chi'. Axo heb' winh sakerdote yet' heb' winh lewita, ix te q'uixwik'e heb' winh, yuj chi' ix sakb'itej sb'a heb' winh icha yalan ley. Ix yik'anb'at nok' silab' heb' winh snhusjitz'a smasanil t'a stemplo Jehová.
Icha chi' ix aj yochxi heb' winh t'a yopisio, icha yalan ley Moisés winh schekab' Dios. Ha heb' winh sakerdote ix tzikanem schiq'uil nok' silab' ix yak' heb' winh lewita.

Yujto tzijtumto heb' t'a skal masanil anima chi' manto sakb'itejlaj sb'a, yuj chi' a heb' winh lewita chi' ix milancham nok' silab'il yik q'uinh chi' yuj heb' anima chi', yik tz'och yopisio nok' t'a q'uinh chi'.

Te niwan heb' t'a yinhtilal Efraín, t'a yik Manasés, t'a yik Isacar yet' t'a yik Zabulón ix komon chi'an nok' silab' yik q'uinh chi', manh ichaok yaj stz'ib'chajkani, yujto maj sakb'itej sb'a heb' icha yalan ley. Palta a winhaj rey Ezequías chi' ix lesalwi yuj heb', ix yalan winh icha tik: Mamin Jehová, ko Diosal ach yet' heb' ko mam quicham, te wach' a pensar. Ak' niwank'olal heb' syak'och t'a sk'ol yalan sb'a t'ayach, wach'chom maj sakb'itej sb'a heb' icha yalan sleyal a templo, xchi winh.
Ix yab' Jehová slesalwi winhaj rey Ezequías chi', yuj chi' ix yak' niwank'olal t'a yib'anh masanil anima chi'.

Uque' k'ual ix ek' heb' israel chi' t'a Jerusalén, te tzalajk'olal ix ek' q'uinh yik ixim pan malaj yich chi'. Axo heb' winh sakerdote yet' heb' winh lewita, junjun k'u sb'itan heb' winh, syalan wach' lolonel heb' winh t'a Jehová yet' masanil yamk'ab' yik b'it te wach' yik Jehová yaji.

Ha winhaj Ezequías chi', ix yak' yuj diosal winh t'a heb' winh lewita, yujto ix sch'oxel sb'ekank'olal heb' winh yak'an serwil Jehová. Uque' k'ual ix schi nok' silab' yik q'uinh chi' heb', ix yak'anpax nok' silab' heb' yik junk'olal, ix yalan wach' lolonel heb' t'a Jehová sDiosal smam yicham.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan heb' smasanil to syak' uqueokxo k'ual q'uinh chi'. Te tzalajk'olal ix aj yoch q'uinh chi' yuj heb'.

Ha winhaj Ezequías sreyal Judá chi', mil nok' mam wakax yet' 7 mil nok' kalnel ix siej winh t'a heb' anima chi'. Yed' heb' winh yajal t'a junjun chonhab' ix siejpax mil nok' wakax chi' heb' winh yet' 10 mil nok' kalnel. Niwan heb' winh sakerdote ix sakb'itej sb'a icha yalan ley.

Masanil heb' aj Judá chi' yet' heb' winh sakerdote yet' heb' winh lewita yet' masanil heb' ix laj kot t'a yol yik Israel yet' masanil heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ix ja kajan t'a yol yik Israel chi', ma t'a yol yik Judá, ix te tzalaj heb'.
Jantac tzalajk'olal ix uji t'a Jerusalén chi', yujto atax yik yak'annak reyal winhaj Salomón yuninal winhaj Dawid, manta b'aj tzuji icha jun ix uji t'a Jerusalén chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix k'e linhan heb' winh sakerdote yet' heb' winh lewita yik sk'anan swach'k'olal Jehová heb' winh t'a yib'anh masanil heb' anima. Ix ab'chaj slesal heb' winh chi' t'a satcha’anh b'aj kajan Dios.

Ayic toxo ix lajwi jun q'uinh chi', masanil heb' israel ix smolb'ej sb'a, ix b'at heb' t'a masanil chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá. Ix smak'anpoj juntzanh k'een k'een heb' niwan yelk'och b'aj syal sb'a heb' anima chi' yet' pax juntzanh yechel komon Dios Asera. Ix laj spojanem juntzanh yik ejmelal heb' b'ajtak chaanh yet' pax juntzanh altar ay t'a yol yik Judá chi' yet' t'a yol yik Benjamín, t'a yol yik Efraín yet' t'a yol yik Manasés. Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzaj heb' smasanil t'a schonhab', ix laj b'atkan heb' t'a slugar junjun.

Ixlajwi chi' ix spojanek' heb' winh sakerdote yet' heb' winh lewita winhaj Ezequías t'a stzolal, junjun makan heb' winh yet' yopisio: Ha heb' winh sakerdote, a heb' winh tz'ak'an silab' snhusjitz'a smasanil yet' silab' yik sch'oxan sjunk'olal heb' yet' Jehová. Axo heb' winh lewita tz'ak'an yuj diosal t'a Jehová chi', syalanpax wach' lolonel heb' winh t'ay t'a b'ital, ay pax heb' winh stanhwan spuertail templo.

Ha winh rey chi', a nok' smolb'etzal nok' winh ix yak' silab'il: Aton nok' silab' snhusjitz'a smasanil tz'ak'ji t'a q'uinhib'alil yet' t'a yemk'ualil yet' pax silab' snhusjitz'ha t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip yet' pax silab' tz'ak'ji yik tz'och q'uinh ayik tz'alji k'een uj yet' silab' tz'ak'ji t'a juntzanhxo q'uinh niwak yelk'ochi, icha yaj stz'ib'chajkan t'a sley Jehová.

Ix yalanpax winh rey chi' t'a masanil heb' anima kajan t'a Jerusalén chi' to syak' skolwal heb' syak'taxon t'a heb' winh sakerdote yet' t'a heb' winh lewita, yik wach' anhej Jehová syak' serwil heb' winh icha yalan ley.

Ayic ix alchajel jun cheknab'il chi', ix yak' heb' israel jantak wal ix el t'a sk'ool yak'ani: Aton ixim trigo wach', wino, akeite, nok' yal chab' yet' masanil sat awb'en te wach' slaj smol heb'. Ix yik'anpaxkot sdiezmoal masanil tas syawej heb'. Te niwan ix yak' heb'.

Anhejtona' pax heb' aj Israel chi' yet' heb' kajan t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá chi', ix yik'kot sdiezmoal nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb': Aton nok' wakax, nok' kalnel, nok' chiwa yet' pax sdiezmoal masanil tastak ay t'a heb' to yikxo Jehová Dios yaji. Juyjumb'a ix laj yutej heb' yak'ankani.
Ayic yoxil uj yoch jun ab'il chi', ix och ijan heb' smolb'an masanil juntzanh chi'. Ato t'a yuquil uj ix och waan heb' yak'ani.
Ayic ix b'at yilan masanil juntzanh ix molchaj chi' winhaj Ezequías yet' heb' ayoch yajalil yet' winh, ix yalan wach' lolonel heb' t'a Jehová yet' t'a chonhab' Israel.
Ixlajwi chi' ix sk'anb'an winhaj Ezequías chi' t'a heb' winh sakerdote yet' t'a heb' winh lewita yuj masanil juntzanh tas ix jawi chi'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj sat sakerdote Azarías yinhtilal winhaj Sadoc icha tik: Yictax ix schaanel yich heb' yik'ankot skolwal t'a stemplo Jehová tik, aynhej tas sko wa''a, ayto pax skani. Masanil juntzanh tik toxo ix kani, yujto ix yak' wal swach'k'olal Jehová t'a yib'anh heb' quetchonhab' tik, xchi winh.
Yuj chi', ix schek winhaj Ezequías b'ochaj yet'tal b'aj smolchaj juntzanh chi' t'a templo chi'. Axo yik toxo ix b'o jun yet'tal chi',

wach' ix yutej heb' smolb'an juntzanh kolwal chi' t'a yool yet' diezmo ix yik'kot heb' anima chi' yet' masanil tas to yik Jehová yaji. Axo jun winh lewita skuchan Conanías sat ix ajkan yilani, haxo jun winh yuk'tak winh skuchan Simei ix och schab'ilok yilan juntzanh chi'.

Ha winhaj rey Ezequías yet' winhaj Azarías chi' sat yaj t'a heb' winh tz'ilan templo chi'. Ha heb' winh ix ak'anoch juntzanhxo heb' winh lewita t'a yalanh smandar winhaj Conanías yet' winhaj Simei chi', aton heb' winh tik: Vinhaj Jehiel, winhaj Azazías, winhaj Nahat, winhaj Asael, winhaj Jerimot, winhaj Jozabad, winhaj Eliel, winhaj Ismaquías, winhaj Mahat yet' winhaj Benaía.

Axo winhaj Coré yuninal winhaj Imna yinhtilal Leví, yajal yaj winh t'a heb' winh stanhwan spuertail templo t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u. Aypaxoch t'a yib'anh winh schaan ofrenda to tz'el wal sk'ol heb' yak'an t'a Jehová, spukanpaxek' winh tastak to yik Jehová yaj chi' tz'ak'chaj t'a heb' winh sakerdote yet' t'a heb' winh lewita.

Ha juntzanh heb' winh lewita: Aton winhaj Edén, winhaj Miniamín, winhaj Jesúa, winhaj Semaías, winhaj Amarías yet' winhaj Sekanías. Ha heb' winh ix kolwaj yet' winhaj Coré chi' spukanek' ofrenda t'a schonhab' heb' winh sakerdote, icha syal makquiltak yaj heb', heb' icham anima yet' heb' unin.

Syak'an heb' winh t'a heb' winh tz'ib'ab'il sb'i b'aj ay sb'i heb' yinhtilal Leví, aton heb' winh ayoch t'a yib'anh yilan yopisio t'a stzolal t'a templo t'a junjun k'u, heb' oxe' ab'il sk'inal sb'eynhejb'ati.

Ha heb' winh sakerdote chi', b'ob'il slistail heb' winh, icha syal stzolal smam yicham heb' winh. Axo heb' winh lewita 20 ab'il sk'inal sb'eynhejb'ati, ay pax sb'i heb' winh icha yajoch heb' winh t'a yopisio t'a stzolal.

Ha yet' sb'i heb' winh chi', tz'ib'ab'il pax sb'i heb' ix yetb'eyum heb' winh, heb' nenetak unin yet' juntzanhxo yuninal heb' winh yet' yisil heb' winh, aton masanil mach ay yalan yik heb' winh yilani. Val t'a stojolal ix aj spojanek' heb' winh juntzanh tas ak'b'il d'ha Dios.

Ay pax heb' winh winak ayoch t'a yib'anh spojanek' tas swa heb' winh sakerdote yinhtilal Aarón yet' heb' winh lewita, aton heb' winh tz'ib'ab'il sb'i b'aj ay sb'i heb' smam yicham heb' winh, aton heb' winh kajan t'a spatiktaquel schonhab' heb' winh sakerdote yet' t'a juntzanhxo chonhab'.
Icha chi' ix yutej winhaj Ezequías chi' sb'oan juntzanh tik t'a masanil yol yik Judá. Ha masanil tas ix sk'ulej winh, te wach', te tojol t'a yichanh Jehová Dios.
Masanil tas ix sk'ulej winh yik ix yak'an serwil winh t'a stemplo Dios, ix sk'ulej wal winh t'a smasanil sk'ool, icha yalan sk'ayb'ub'al Dios yet' scheknab'il. Yuj chi' te wach'nhej ix elk'och winh.

Ayic toxo ix sk'ulej masanil juntzanh chi' winhaj Ezequías, yik sk'anab'ajan Jehová winh, ix jawi winhaj Senaquerib sreyal Asiria yet' heb' soldado. Ix laj och oyan heb' t'a spatiktak juntzanh chonhab' ayoch smuroal t'a yol yik Judá, yik syik'anek' heb' yalani.
Ayic ix yilan winhaj Ezequías chi' to toxo ix jawi winhaj Senaquerib chi' yak' owal t'a Jerusalén,
ix smol alan winh yet' heb' winh yajal yet' heb' winh yajalil heb' soldado to smuk sjajtak ha ha' heb' winh ay t'a spatiktak chonhab' chi'. Ix cha sk'ol heb' winh sk'ulan tas ix alchaj chi'.

Yuj chi' te niwan heb' anima chi' ix smolb'ej sb'a, ix laj smukan sjajtak ha ha' chi' heb' yet' ha ha' sb'ey t'a slak'anil chi', yik wach' ayik sjawi heb' asirio chi', manhxalaj ha' tz'ilchaj yuj heb'.

Ix yak' wal yip winhaj rey Ezequías chi' sb'oanxik'e smuroal chonhab' chi' b'aj mak'b'ilem lanhnajok. Ix b'ochajxik'e juntzanh b'aj stanhwej heb' soldado t'a yib'anhtak muro yet' junxo muro t'a spatiqueli. Te wach' ix ajoch muro b'aj mukb'il jun ch'olan t'a schonhab' winhaj Dawid. Tzijtum k'een lanza yet' maklab' jul-lab' ix schek winh rey chi' b'ojok.

Ix yak'anoch yopisio juntzanh heb' winh winak winh yik tz'och heb' winh yajalil t'a masanil chonhab'. Ix smolb'an sb'a heb' winh b'aj smolb'ej sb'a heb' anima t'a stiel spuertail chonhab' chi', ix yalan winh rey chi' to stek'b'ej sb'a heb', ix yalan winh icha tik:

Tek'an tzeyutej he b'a, manh ex xiwok, mokab' chab'axk'e he k'ool t'a yichanh winh sreyal Asiria chi' yet' t'a jun niwan nhilanh heb' winh soldado yet'nak winh chi', yujto ek'b'al quip t'a yichanh heb' chi'.

Ha winh chi', a heb' soldado ayoch yipok sk'ol winh, palta a onhxo tik, a Jehová ko Diosal ayoch qued'ok, ha' ol kolwaj qued'ok ayik ol kak'an owal chi', xchi winh. Ayic ix yab'an heb' anima chi' tas ix yal winh rey chi', ix stek'b'an wal sb'a heb'.

Yakb'an wan yak'an owal winhaj Senaquerib sreyal Asiria yet' heb' soldado t'a chonhab' Laquis, ix schekankot juntzanh heb' schekab' winh t'a Jerusalén, yik tzul yal heb' t'a winhaj Ezequías sreyal Judá yet' t'a masanil heb' aj Judá kajan ta' icha tik:
Icha tik ix yutej winhaj Senaquerib sreyal Asiria yalankoti: ¿Mach ayoch yipok he k'ol a ex tik, yuj chi' ayex kan t'a Jerusalén tik, ina to oyb'il exxo k'ei?
Tato syal winhaj Ezequías t'ayex to a Jehová he Diosal ol ex kolanel t'a yol in k'ab', tonhej tzex yixtej winh, ol ex cham yuj wejel yet' taquinhtial.

¿Tom manhok winhaj Ezequías chi' ix ik'anel juntzanh lugar yik ejmelal b'ajtak chaanh yet' altar yik jun Dios chi'? Ix yalan winh t'a masanil anima t'a Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén to junnhej jun altar b'aj snhusji inkienso t'a jun Dios chi'.
¿Tom manh eyojtakok tas in k'ulejnak yet' heb' in mam wicham t'a juntzanhxo chonhab'? ¿Tocwal ix yal yuj sdiosal juntzanh chonhab' chi' skolanel heb' t'a yol in k'ab'?
¿Tom ay junok t'a juntzanh sdiosal juntzanh chonhab' ix satel heb' in mam wicham chi' ix yal skolanel schonhab' t'a yol sk'ab' heb'? ¿Tas yuj tze na' to a he Diosal chi' ol ex kolan t'a yol in k'ab'?

Yuj chi', manh eyak' he b'a musansatil yuj winhaj Ezequías chi'. Manh he cha eyab' tas syal winh. Yujto malaj junok sdiosal juntzanh chonhab' chi' ix yal skolan schonhab' t'a yol in k'ab'. Anhejtona' malaj pax juntzanh Dios chi' ix yal skolan sb'ha t'a yol sk'ab' heb' in mam wicham. Ocxo jun he Diosal chi'. ¿Tom ato wal ol yal ex skolan t'a yol in k'ab'? xchikot winh, xchi heb'.
Ay juntzanhxo tas ix yal heb' schekab' winh sreyal Asiria chi' yik sb'uchwaj heb' t'a Jehová Dios yet' t'a winhaj Ezequías aton schekab'.

Ix stz'ib'anpaxkot jun yumal winhaj Senaquerib chi' yik sb'uchwajkot winh t'a Jehová sDiosal Israel. Ha t'a jun yuum winh chi', ix yalkot winh icha tik: Ha juntzanh sdiosal juntzanhxo chonhab', maj yal-laj skolan schonhab' heb' chi' t'a yol in k'ab', icha pax chi' sDiosal winhaj Ezequías, manh ol yal-laj skolan schonhab' t'a yol in k'ab', xchikot winh t'a yuum chi'.

Ha heb' schekab' winhaj Senaquerib chi', te chaanh ix yal heb' t'a heb' anima ay t'a Jerusalén chi', aton heb' linhjab'k'e t'a yib'anh muro, te chaanh ix yal heb' t'a hebreo, yik xib'taj heb' anima chi' yuj heb', yik syak'an ganar Jerusalén chi' heb' yalani.
Ix slajb'ej wal sDiosal Jerusalén heb' yet' juntzanh komon Dios b'ob'il yuj anima, sdiosal juntzanhxo chonhab'.
Yuj wal jun lolonel chi', ix lesalwi winhaj rey Ezequías yet' winhaj Isaías schekab' Dios yuninal winhaj Amoz. Ix sk'anan skolwal Jehová heb' winh.

Yuj chi' a Jehová ix chekankot jun ángel yik tzul satanel heb' soldado te tek'an, heb' yajalil heb' yet' heb' sat yaj t'a skampamento winh sreyal Asiria chi'. Yuj chi' te q'uixwelalxonhej ix aj smeltzajxi winh rey chi' t'a schonhab'. Axo yik ix och winh t'a yol stemplo sdiosal, a heb' yuninal winh ix milanchamok.

Icha chi' ix yutej Jehová skolan winhaj Ezequías chi' yet' masanil heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén chi' t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Senaquerib sreyal Asiria chi', yet' pax t'a yol sk'ab' juntzanhxo chonhab'. Junk'olal ix laj aj heb' yet' juntzanhxo chonhab' ay t'a slak'anil chi'.

Yuj chi', tzijtum heb' ix yik'kot yofrenda t'a Jerusalén, ix yak'an heb' t'a Jehová, ix yak'anpax silab' heb' te karo stojol t'a winhaj Ezequías chi'. Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi' niwan ix aj yelk'och winh t'a juntzanhxo chonhab'.

Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', te ow yak'an syaelal winhaj Ezequías chi', ijan ix cham winh. Yuj chi' ix lesalwi winh t'a Jehová. Ix tak'wi Jehová chi', ix sch'oxan jun yechel t'a winh te satub'tak yilji, yik sch'oxani to ol b'oxok sk'ool winh.

Wach'chom jantak wach'il ix scha winhaj Ezequías chi', palta maj yak' yuj diosal winh t'a Jehová, to ix yik'chaanh sb'a winh. Yuj chi' ix kot yowal sk'ol Jehová t'a winh yet' t'a Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén.
Yuj chi' ix yik'xiem sb'a winh yet' heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén chi' t'a yichanh Dios. Yuj chi' majxo yak'kot yowal sk'ol Jehová chi' t'a yib'anh heb' yakb'an pitzanto winh.

Ha winhaj Ezequías chi', ix te aj sb'eyumal winh, niwan ix aj yelk'och winh. Te niwan k'een plata, k'een oro, k'een k'een te wach' yilji, perfume, maklab' jul-lab' yet' pax masanil tas to ay stojol ix smolb'ej winh.
Ix schekanpax winh b'ojok spatil b'aj sik'chaj ixim trigo, wino yet' akeite. Ix b'ochaj pax smakte' nok' wakax, nok' kalnel yet' nok' chiwa.
Ix schekanpax winh b'ojok juntzanh chonhab', yujto manh jantakok nok' swakax winh yet' nok' skalnel. Te niwan sb'eyumal winh ix yak' Dios.

Aton winh ix chekan makchaj sjaj ha' Gihón t'a yib'anh, yik wach' haxo t'a yalanh lu'um sb'ey ha'. Ha t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'a schonhab' winhaj Dawid, ata' ix k'och ha'. Masanil tas ix sk'ulej winh, wach'nhej ix elk'ochi.

Ha heb' winh yajal t'a Babilonia, ix schekkot heb' winh schekab' heb' winh yik tzul sk'anb'an heb' winh yuj jun tas satub'tak ix uji t'a Judá. Ix aktajkan winhaj Ezequías chi' yuj Dios sch'okoj yik tz'ak'ji prowal winh yuj, yik syila' tas yaj spensar winh.

Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Ezequías yet' tastak ix sk'ulej winh yet' b'aj ix sk'anab'ajej Dios winh, aykan b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkan tas yilnak winhaj Isaías yuninal winhaj Amoz yet' t'a yumal yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá yet' Israel.

Axo yik ix cham winh, ix mukji winh t'a yib'anhk'e b'aj mukb'il heb' yinhtilal winhaj Dawid. Masanil heb' aj Judá yet' heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén, ix sch'oxel heb' to niwan yelk'och winh ayik ix smukan winh chi heb', haxo winhaj Manasés yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ha winhaj Manasés chi', lajchawe' ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal. 55 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén.

Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, yujto a juntzanh tastak yajb'entak sb'eyb'alej juntzanh chonhab' yik'naquel Jehová t'a yichanh heb' israel t'a sat sluum tik, a chi' ix sb'eyb'alej winh.

Ix schek winh b'ochajxik'e juntzanh lugar yik ejmelal b'ajtak chaanh, aton juntzanh yik'naquel winh smam winh. Ix schekan winh b'ochajxik'e altar yik komon Dios Baal yet' yechel komon Dios Asera. Ix yalan sb'a winh t'a masanil tas syak' sk'ak'al t'a satcha’anh, ix yak'anpaxem sb'a winh t'ay.
Ix schekan winh b'ochajk'e juntzanh altar t'a stemplo Jehová t'a Jerusalén, aton jun templo chi' b'aj yalnak Jehová to ol b'inajnhej sb'i t'a masanil tiempo.
Ix schekanpax winh b'ochajk'e juntzanhxo altar t'a chab'xo yamaq'uil stemplo Jehová chi', yik syal sb'a winh t'a masanil tas syak' sk'ak'al t'a satcha’anh.

Ix snhusantz'a heb' yuninal winh silab'il t'a sch'olanil yik Ben-hinom. Ix sk'anb'an sb'a winh t'a heb' ajb'aal, t'a heb' ajchum, t'a heb' naumel lolonel. Ix skuchb'an heb' anima winh yik sk'uman spixan chamnak. Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh, yuj chi' ix stzuntzejkot yowal sk'ol Jehová winh t'a yib'anh.

Ix schekan winh ak'chajoch yechel komon Dios t'a yol skajnub' Jehová Dios. Aton yuj jun kajnub' chi' yalnak Jehová t'a winhaj Dawid yet' t'a winhaj Salomón icha tik: Ha jun pat t'a Jerusalén tik, ix in sik'kanel t'a yol smakb'en heb' yinhtilal Israel, in kajnub' tz'ajkan t'a junelnhej.

Manhxo ol ex wik'el a ex israel ex tik t'a jun lum lum wak'nak t'a heb' he mam eyicham, tato tze k'anab'ajej masanil in k'ayb'ub'al, in cheknab'il yet' in kachnab'il in chek yak'nakkan winhaj Moisés t'ayex, xchi Jehová.

Palta haxo winhaj Manasés chi' ix kuchb'an wal heb' aj Jerusalén t'a chukal yet' juntzanhxo heb' ay t'a yol yik Judá chi'. Yelxo wal te chuk ix aj sb'eyb'al heb' t'a yichanh schuk b'eyb'al juntzanh chonhab' satb'ilel yuj Jehová t'a yichanh heb' smam yicham heb' t'a peka'.
Ix kachji winhaj Manasés yet' masanil heb' anima chi' yuj Jehová, palta maj sk'anab'ajej heb'.

Yuj chi' a Jehová ix ak'ankot heb' yajalil heb' soldado winh sreyal Asiria t'a heb', ix yamchaj winhaj Manasés chi' yuj heb'. Ix yak'anoch gancho heb' t'a snhi' winh, ix tzek'chaj winh t'a k'een kadena nab'a bronke, ix yik'anb'at winh heb' t'a Babilonia.
Ayic ix yab'an wal syail winh chi', ix lesalwi winh t'a Jehová Dios. Yelk'olal wal ix yik'em sb'a winh t'a yichanh sDiosal smam yicham.

Ayic ix lesalwi winh chi', ix yab'an Dios tas ix sk'an winh chi', yuj chi' ix meltzajxi winh yuj Jehová t'a Jerusalén chi' yik tz'ochxi winh t'a yopisio. Icha chi' ix aj snachajel yuj winh to anhej Jehová Dios toni.

Ixlajwi chi', ix schekan winh b'ochajxik'e smuroal schonhab' winhaj Dawid t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'ha ha' Gihón t'a panhan b'aj ay sjaj ha ha' chi', masanto sk'och t'a spuertail yik nok' chay. Ix wach' b'oji pax b'aj skumlaj muro chi'. Chaanh ix ajk'e muro chi'. Ix yak'anpaxoch heb' yajalil heb' soldado winh t'a masanil chonhab' ayoch smuroal t'a yol yik Judá chi'.

Ix schekan winh ik'chajel sdiosal heb' ch'ok chonhab'il yet' juntzanh yechel ix yak'och winh t'a yol skajnub' Jehová yet' juntzanh altar ix schek winh b'ojok t'a jun tzalan yik templo chi' yet' juntzanhxo t'a Jerusalén chi'. Ha juntzanh chi' ix schek winh julchajkanel t'a stitaquel chonhab' chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix schekan winh wach' b'ochajxi altar t'a Jehová, ix yak'an silab' winh yik sch'oxan sjunk'olal yet' Dios yet' silab' yik ak'oj yuj diosal. Ix yalan winh t'a masanil heb' aj Judá to tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a Jehová Dios.
Palta a heb' anima chi', anheja' ix yak'nhej silab' heb' t'a juntzanh lugar yik ejmelal b'ajtak chaanh, wach'chom ha t'a Jehová sDiosal heb' syak' yalani.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Manasés chi' yet' slesal winh d'ha Dios yet' tas ix schek Jehová yal heb' schekab', aykan b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.

Tz'ib'ab'il pax slesal winh yet' tas ix aj spakan Dios. Anhejtona' pax tas ix aj yoch spitalil winh yet' yik ejmelal ix sb'ok'e winh b'ajtak chaanh yet' b'ajtak ix b'ochaj yechel Asera yet' juntzanhxo yechel komon Dios ayik manto sna sb'a winh t'a yichanh Jehová, aykan t'a yumal ix stz'ib'ejkan heb' schekab' Dios.
Ayic ix cham winh, ix mukji winh b'aj ay juntzanh tas awab'il t'a spalakio. Axo winhaj Amón yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ha winhaj Amón chi', 22 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix schaanel yich winh yak'an reyal, chab' ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén.
Ix stzuntzejkot yowal sk'ol Jehová winh t'a yib'anh icha ix sk'ulej winh smam winh. Ix snhus silab' winh t'a juntzanh komon Dios b'ob'ilkan yuj winh smam winh chi', ix ochpax winh ejmelal t'ay.
Maj yik'emlaj sb'a winh t'a Jehová icha sk'ulejnak winh smam winh chi', palta a wal chukal ix ste k'ulej winh.
Ha heb' winh ayoch yajalil yet' winh, a heb' winh ix milancham winh t'a spalakio.
Axo heb' anima t'a yol chonhab' chi' ix milanpaxcham heb' winh ix milancham winh. Axo winhaj Josías yuninal winh ix yak'kanoch heb' reyal sk'exulok winh.
Ha winhaj Josías chi', wajxaque' ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix schaanel yich winh yak'an reyal. 31 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén.
Ha tas ix sk'ulej winh te wach' t'a yichanh Jehová, tz'akan ix sb'eyb'alej winh icha sb'eyb'alejnak winhaj Dawid smam yicham winh.

Ayic 16 ab'ilxo sk'inal winhaj Josías chi', ayik quelem unin wal winh, ix yak'an wal och winh t'a sk'ool sk'anab'ajan Jehová sDiosal winhaj Dawid smam yicham winh. Axo yik 20 ab'il winh, ix syamanoch winh yik'anel tas manh wach'ok t'a Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén chi'. Ix schekan winh satjiel masanil juntzanh b'aj tz'och ejmelal b'ajtak chaanh, yechel komon Dios Asera yet' juntzanhxo yechel komon Dios tzeyb'il yet' masanil yechel b'ob'il t'a k'een k'een.

Ha wal t'a yichanh winh ix mak'jipoj juntzanh altar yik masanil yechel Baal. Ix schekanpax winh mak'jipoj altar b'aj snhuschajtz'a inkienso b'ajtak chaanh. Ix schekanpax winh mak'jipoj yechel komon Dios Asera yet' masanil juntzanhxo yechel komon Dios. Chok' ix ajkan smasanil. Ixlajwi chi' ix stzikanb'at winh t'a yib'anh b'ajtak mukan heb' ix ak'an silab' t'a juntzanh yechel chi'.
Ix schekanpax winh nhusjoktz'a sb'aquil heb' sakerdote t'a juntzanh komon Dios chi' t'a yib'anh juntzanh altar chi'. Ichaton chi' ix aj sakb'itan Judá yet' Jerusalén chi' winh.
Icha pax chi' ix sk'ulej winh t'a juntzanh chonhab' mak'b'ilem lanhnaj t'a yol yik Manasés, t'a yol yik Efraín yet' t'a yol yik Simeón, masanto ix k'och t'a yol yik Neftalí.

Ayic ix lajwi smak'jikanpoj masanil juntzanh altar, juntzanh yechel komon Dios Asera yet' juntzanhxo yechel komon Dios, chok' ix ajkani, ix mak'jipaxkanpoj masanil altar b'aj stz'a inkienso t'a masanil yol yik Israel chi'. Ichato chi' ix meltzajxi winh t'a Jerusalén.

Ayic 26 ab'ilxo sk'inal winhaj Josías chi', ayik toxo ix sakb'itej masanil jun nakión chi' winh yet' skajnub' Jehová Dios, ix schekan winh wach' b'ochaj skajnub' Dios chi'. Ix ochkan jun munlajel chi' t'a yib'anh winhaj Safán yuninal winhaj Azalías yet' winhaj Amasías yajal t'a chonhab' Jerusalén yet' winh tz'ib'um, aton winhaj Joa yuninal winhaj Joacaz.

Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at heb' winh tik yil winhaj Hilcías sat sakerdote. Ix b'at yak'an k'een tumin heb' winh t'a winh, aton k'een ix scha heb' winh lewita stanhwan spuertail stemplo Dios t'a heb' yinhtilal Manasés yet' heb' yinhtilal Efraín, aton masanil heb' kannak t'a yol yik Israel. Ay pax k'een ix yak' heb' yinhtilal Judá, heb' yinhtilal Benjamín yet' heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'ankan k'een tumin chi' heb' winh t'a heb' winh ayoch yilan munlajel t'a stemplo Jehová chi', haxo heb' winh stupan heb' winh smunlaj t'a templo chi'.

Ix yak'anpax k'een tumin chi' heb' winh t'a heb' winh nhikum te' yet' t'a heb' winh skuchb'an munlajel chi', yik smanchaj k'een k'een tzeyb'il yet' pax masanil te te' tz'och syamnub'alok yet' pax spatzab'il juntzanh pat emnakkan lanhnaj yuj heb' winh sreyal Judá.

Ha juntzanh heb' winh winak chi', te wach' ix yutej heb' winh yilan munlajel chi'. Ha heb' winh skuchb'an munlajel chi', a heb' winh lewita, aton sb'i heb' winh tik: Vinhaj Jahat yet' winhaj Abdías yinhtilal winhaj Merari, winhaj Zacarías, winhaj Mesulam yinhtilal winhaj Coat. Ha heb' winh tik yajal yaj heb' winh. Ay juntzanhxo heb' winh lewita kuchb'um t'a b'it yet' pax t'a yamk'ab' yik b'it chi', a heb' winh tz'ilan heb' kuchum ikatz, ay pax heb' winh tz'ilan heb' smunlaji. Ay pax heb' winh tz'ib'um, ay pax heb' winh stanhwan spuertail skajnub' Dios chi'.
Ayic wan yik'chajelta k'een tumin ix b'at ak'chajkan t'a skajnub' Jehová chi', haxo winhaj sakerdote Hilcías ix ilanelta yumal b'aj aykan sley Jehová yuj winhaj Moisés.
Ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Safán winh tz'ib'um to ix ilchaj yumal ley t'a skajnub' Jehová. Ix yak'ankan winh t'a winhaj Safán chi'.
Axo winhaj Safán chi' ix ik'anb'at t'a winh rey chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: --Mamin rey, a onh a chekab' onh tik wan ko b'oan masanil munlajel aykan och t'a quib'anh.
Ix molb'aj k'een tumin ix ul ak'chajkan t'a skajnub' Jehová, ix ak'chaj k'een t'a heb' winh tz'ilan munlajel chi' yet' pax t'a heb' winh smunlaji, xchi winh.
Ix yalanpax winh t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: Ha winhaj Hilcías ix yak' jun uum winh t'ayin, xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix yawtan jun uum chi' winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi'.
Ha wal yik ix yab'an winh rey tas syal jun uum chi', ix snhik'chitanb'at spichul winh.
