Ix yawtankot winhaj Hilcías winh, winhaj Ahicam yuninal winhaj Safán, winhaj Abdón yuninal winhaj Micaía, winhaj Safán winh tz'ib'um yet' winhaj Asaías ay yopisio skolwaj yet' winh. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik:

--Ixiquec, b'at k'anb'ejek t'a Jehová wuuj, yuj pax masanil anima kannak t'a Israel tik yet' t'a Judá yuj tas syal jun uum ix ilchaj tik. Tekan aykot yowal sk'ol Jehová t'a quib'anh tiknaik, yujto a heb' ko mam quicham maj sk'anab'ajej heb' tas syal Jehová, maj sb'eyb'alej pax heb' tastak aykan t'a jun uum tik, xchi winh rey chi'.

Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Hilcías yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh ix chekjib'at yuj winh rey chi', ix b'at heb' winh yil ix Hulda ix schekab' Dios, ix yetb'eyum winhaj Salum yuninal winhaj Ticwa, yixchiquin winhaj Harhas. Ha winhaj Salum chi' sik'an masanil pichul t'a skajnub' Dios. kajan ix Hulda chi' t'a jun scha makanhil chonhab' t'a Jerusalén. Ayic ix yalan heb' winh t'a ix,
ix tak'wi ix t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Ha Jehová ko Diosal tz'alan icha tik: Alec t'a winh ix ex chekankot he k'anb'ej chi' t'ayin
to a in Jehová in tik swala': Ol wak'kot junok yaelal t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik yet' t'a yib'anh masanil anima kajan t'ay, icha wal yaj stz'ib'chajkan t'a jun uum ix awtaj t'a ichanh chi'.

Yujto ix in eyaktejkani, haxo t'a juntzanh komon Dios tze nhus inkienso. Tze tzuntzankot yowal in k'ol yuj masanil tas ix he k'ulej chi'. Yuj chi' toxo ix kot yowal in k'ool t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik, maxtzak tuplaj.
Yuj chi' alek t'a winh sreyal Judá, winh ix ex chekankot ul he k'anb'ej t'ayin Jehová sDiosal in Israel tik to a in swal icha tik: Yujto ix a cha ab' tas syal jun uum chi',

ix ak'an wal och t'a a k'ool, ix ak'anoch a b'ha t'a yol in k'ab' ayik ix ab'ani to ay yowal in k'ol t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik yet' t'a yib'anh heb' kajan t'ay, yujto ix ik'em a b'ha t'a wichanh, ix a nhik'chitanb'at a pichul, ix ach oq'ui, anhejtona' in ix wab' pax tas ix ala'. Yuj chi' a in wal Jehová in swal t'ayach:

Ha in ol wak'elk'ochi to junk'olal ol ach chamok, ol ach mukchaj b'aj mukan heb' a mam icham. Ichato chi' ol jawok juntzanh yaelal ol wak'kot t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik yet' t'a yib'anh masanil heb' kajan t'ay, xchi Jehová, xchi ix Hulda chi'. Yuj chi' ix meltzaj heb' winh schekab' winh rey chi', ix ul yalan spak tas ix b'at sk'anb'ej heb' winh chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix schekan winh rey chi' awtajkot masanil heb' winh yichamtak winaquil Judá yet' heb' yik Jerusalén chi' to smolb'ej sb'a heb' winh smasanil.

Ixlajwi chi', ix k'e winh rey chi' t'a skajnub' Jehová yet' masanil heb' ix smolb'ej sb'a chi' yet' pax heb' winh sakerdote, heb' winh lewita yet' masanil anima ay t'a yol smakb'en chi' yet' pax masanil heb' unin yet' masanil heb' ichamtak anima. Ata' ix schek winh rey chi' awtaj jun uum chi' yab' masanil anima chi', aton tastak aykan t'a yumal strato Jehová ix ilchajelta yuj heb' t'a yol templo chi'.

Ix och linhan winh rey chi' t'a stz'ey jun niwan oy. Ata' ix yak' sti' winh t'a yichanh Jehová to t'a wal smasanil sk'ool winh ol sk'anab'ajej sb'eyb'alan masanil cheknab'il yet' k'ayb'ub'al chi', icha wal yaj stz'ib'chajkan t'a yumal strato Jehová chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh t'a masanil anima molanek' chi', heb' aj Jerusalén yet' heb' yik Benjamín to syak' sti' heb' sk'anab'ajani. Masanil heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén chi', ix sk'anab'ajej heb' icha wal yajkan t'a yumal strato sDiosal heb' yet' heb' smam yicham.

Ix schekan winhaj Josías chi' ik'joquel masanil yechel yajb'entak ay t'a yol smakb'en Israel chi'. Ix yalan winh to tz'och masanil heb' ayek' t'a Israel chi' ejmelal t'a Jehová Dios. Yakb'an pitzanto winh, maj yik'el sb'a heb' t'a Jehová sDiosal heb' smam yicham heb'.

Ix och q'uinh yuj winhaj Josías chi' yik syik'anchaanh Jehová winh t'a Jerusalén chi', aton yik snaankot heb' ayik yelnakkot heb' smam yicham heb' t'a Egipto. Ayic 14 yoch b'ab'el uj ix smilcham nok' kalnel heb' silab'il yuj q'uinh chi'.
Ix yak'anoch heb' winh sakerdote winh t'a yopisio, ix iptzitaj heb' winh yuj winh yik syilan yopisio heb' winh chi' t'a skajnub' Jehová.

Ix schekan winh smolb'ej sb'a heb' winh lewita tz'ak'an serwil Jehová, aton heb' winh sk'ayb'an heb' yetisraelal. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: Naeccoti to a te' skaxail strato Jehová, aykan te' t'a yol skajnub' Jehová sb'onak winhaj Salomón yuninal winhaj Dawid sreyal Israel. Yuj chi' a ex tik maxtzak he b'akhlaj b'eyek' te' t'a sjolom he jenhjab'. Ha tiknaik aq'ek serwil Jehová ko Diosal yet' pax heb' quetisraelal schonhab' ko Diosal chi'.
B'oekoch he b'ha t'a stzolal, icha syal stzolal smakanhil heb' he mam eyicham, icha yaj stz'ib'chajkan yuj winhaj Dawid yet' winhaj Salomón chi'.
Tzex kan nanhalok ex lewita ex tik t'a skajnub' Jehová chi', icha syal smakanhil eyaji, yik wach' tzex kolwaj t'a junjun makan heb' quetisraelal sk'ab'yok sb'a,

yik tze milancham nok' kelemtak kalnel silab'il yik q'uinh tik. Yuj chi' sakb'itejek he b'a icha yalan ley yet' pax tas yowalil sakb'itaji, yik wach' syal sk'anab'ajan heb' quetisraelal tik masanil tas yalnakkan winhaj Moisés yuj Jehová, xchi winh rey chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', haxo t'a skal nok' smolb'etzal nok' winhaj Josías chi' ix yik'elta juntzanh nok' ix yak' winh t'a heb' anima molanek' chi', yik wach' ay nok' syal yak'an heb' silab'il t'a q'uinh chi'. Aton sb'isul nok' tik: 30 mil nok' kalnel yet' nok' chiwa yet' 3 mil nok' kelemtak wakax.

Anhejtona' heb' winh ayoch yajalil yet' winh rey chi', ix el wal t'a sk'ool heb' winh yak'an silab' t'a heb' chonhab' chi', t'a heb' winh sakerdote yet' t'a heb' winh lewita. Axo pax winhaj Hilcías, winhaj Zacarías yet' winhaj Jehiel, aton heb' winh tz'ilan skajnub' Jehová, 2 mil 600 nok' kalnel yet' 300 nok' kelemtak wakax ix yak' heb' winh yik tz'och q'uinh chi'.

Ha winhaj Conanías yet' heb' winh yuk'tak, aton winhaj Semaías, winhaj Natanael, winhaj Hasabías, winhaj Jeiel yet' winhaj Josabad, aton heb' winh yajalil heb' winh lewita, 5 mil nok' kalnel yet' nok' chiwa ix yak' heb' winh yik tz'och q'uinh chi'. Ix yak'anpax 500 nok' kelemtak wakax heb' winh yik syak' nok' heb' winh lewita silab'il.
Ayic wach'xo yaj masanil yik tz'och q'uinh chi', ix sb'oanoch sb'a heb' winh sakerdote t'a stzolal yet' pax heb' winh lewita, icha ix aj yalan winh rey.

Ix smilancham nok' nok' chi' heb' winh silab'il yik q'uinh chi'. Ix yak'an schiq'uil nok' heb' winh lewita chi' t'a heb' winh sakerdote. Axo heb' winh ix tzikanoch schiq'uil nok' chi' t'a altar. Ixlajwi chi' ix spatz'anel nok' heb' winh lewita chi'.

Ix spojanek' xepual nok' silab' snhusjitz'a smasanil heb' winh sakerdote chi', ix yak'an heb' winh t'a junjun makan heb' ayto yuj sb'a, yik syak'an heb' t'a Jehová, icha yaj stz'ib'chajkan t'a yumal yuj winhaj Moisés. Anheja' icha chi' ix yutej pax nok' wakax heb' winh.

Ix sb'olan nok' silab' yik q'uinh chi' heb' winh, icha wal yaj stz'ib'chajkani. Axo juntzanhxo nok' silab' chi', ix stz'anh nok' heb' winh t'a yol chen yet' t'a yoltak xalten. Elanhchamel ix spuquek' nok' heb' winh t'a heb' anima.

Ixlajwi chi', ix sb'oan yik heb' winh lewita chi' yet' pax tas yik heb' winh sakerdote, yujto a heb' winh sakerdote yinhtilal Aarón te ay tas sk'ulej heb' winh sk'e ak'wal yik snhusan nok' silab' heb' winh stz'a smasanil yet' pax xepual nok'. Yuj chi' munil ix sb'o yik heb' winh lewita chi', ix sb'oanpax yik heb' winh sakerdote chi' heb' winh.

Axo pax heb' winh sb'itani, aton heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Asaf, ayoch heb' winh t'a yopisio chi', icha yajkan yuj winhaj rey Dawid, winhaj Asaf, winhaj Hemán yet' winhaj Jedutún, schekab' heb' tik winhaj rey Dawid chi'. Axo heb' winh stanhwan puerta, aypaxoch heb' winh yilan yopisio chi'. Malaj junok heb' winh syaktejkan yilan yopisio, yujto a heb' winh yetlewitail heb' winh sb'oan nok' silab' heb' winh.
Icha chi' ix aj yak'ji serwil Jehová t'a sk'ual q'uinh chi', yik tz'ak'jipax silab' t'ay t'a altar, aton silab' snhusjitz'a smasanil, icha ix aj yalan winhaj rey Josías chi'.
Masanil heb' israel wan sb'oan q'uinh chi', uque' k'ual pax ix swa ixim pan heb' malaj yich.

Malaj b'aj ix och junok q'uinh icha jun chi' yiktax t'a stiempoal winhaj Samuel schekab' Dios. Malaj wal junokxo sreyal Israel ix ak'anoch jun q'uinh chi' icha ix aj yoch yuj winhaj rey Josías yet' heb' winh sakerdote, heb' winh lewita yet' masanil heb' aj Judá yet' heb' aj Israel ayek' chi' yet' pax heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén chi'.
Ayic 18 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Josías chi' reyal ix och jun q'uinh chi'.

Ayic toxo ix laj uji juntzanh chi', ayik toxo ix b'ochajxi skajnub' Jehová yuj winhaj rey Josías chi', haxo winhaj Necao sreyal Egipto, wan sb'at winh t'ha ha' Éufrates yik syak' owal winh yet' chonhab' Carquemis. Axo winhaj rey Josías chi' ix b'at smak sat winh.

Ha winhaj Necao chi', ix schekkot heb' schekab' winh yik tzul alchaj t'a winhaj Josías chi' icha tik: Ach sreyal Judá, manh ak' owal wed'ok, yujto manhok ed'ok tzin jawi wak' owal, palta a yet' junxo nakión aytaxon wowal yet'ok, yujto ha Dios ix alan t'ayin to tzin pil wip wak'an owal tik. Actej a telan a b'a yet' Dios yik wach' max ach satel yuj, yujto ha' ayoch wed'ok, xchikot winh.

Palta haxo winhaj Josías chi' maj meltzajlaj winh, to ix sk'exel sb'a winh yik syak'an owal winh. Maj schalaj yab' winh tas ix yal winhaj Necao chi', wach'chom ha Dios ix alani. Yuj chi' ix yak' owal winh yet' winhaj Necao chi' t'a jun panhan yik Meguido.

Ha heb' sjulwajum winhaj Necao chi', ix sjulb'at sjul-lab' heb' t'a winhaj Josías chi'. Ix yamchaj winh sjulan heb', yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a heb' ed'jinak skarruaje: Iq'ek in el t'a tik, yujto te niwan ix in aj in lajwi, xchi winh.

Ix yik'anelta winh heb', ix yak'anoch winh heb' t'a yol junxo schab'il karruaje, ix yik'ankot winh heb' t'a Jerusalén, ata' ix cham winh. Ix smukan winh heb' b'aj mukb'il heb' smam yicham. Masanil heb' aj Judá yet' heb' aj Jerusalén ix ok' heb' yuj winh.

Axo winhaj Jeremías ixb’o’an jun sb'ital yik snachajkot schamel winh. Ix kannhej jun b'it chi', masanil heb' winh winak yet' heb' ix ix sb'itani, ayik sb'itan jun b'it chi' heb' yuj schamel junok anima, snakot winhaj Josías chi' heb'. Ha jun b'it chi' ix ochkan t'a stzolal sb'itan heb' israel yuj junok chamel, aykan t'a yumal sb'ital kusk'olal.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Josías chi' yet' tastak ix sk'ulej winh, te wach' icha yaj stz'ib'chajkan t'a yumal sley Jehová
yet' masanil tastak ix sk'ulej winh ayik ix el yich yet' slajwub', aykan b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel yet' Judá.
Ixlajwi chi' haxo masanil heb' anima ix ak'anoch winhaj Joacaz yuninal winhaj Josías chi' reyal t'a Jerusalén sk'exulok winh smam chi'.
Ayic ix schaanel yich winh yak'an reyal, 23 ab'il sk'inal winh, oxenhej ujal ix yak' reyal winh.

Ha winh sreyal Egipto ix ik'anel winh t'a reyal chi'. Ix yak'anoch k'een tumin winh sreyal Egipto chi' t'a yib'anh heb' aj Judá chi' yik syak'an 75 quintal k'een plata heb' yet' oxe' arroba k'een oro.

Axo winhaj Eliaquim yuk'tak winhaj Joacaz chi' ix ochkan reyal t'a Judá chi' yuj winh sreyal Egipto chi'. Ix k'exchaj sb'i winhaj Eliaquim chi' yuj winh, Joacim ix sb'iejkan winh, haxo winhaj Joacaz chi', ix ik'jib'at winh yuj winh sreyal Egipto chi'.
Ayic ix och winhaj Joacim chi' reyal, 25 ab'il sk'inal winh, 11 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Palta te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová Dios.
Axo winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia ix jawi yak' owal yet' winh, ix tzek'ji winh t'a k'een kadena, ix ik'jib'at winh t'a Babilonia chi'.
Anhejtona' ix yik'b'at juntzanh yamk'ab' yik skajnub' Jehová winhaj Nabucodonosor chi', ix yak'anoch winh t'a yol stemplo sdiosal t'a Babilonia chi'.

Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Joacim chi' yet' tastak te yajb'entak ix sk'ulej winh yet' juntzanhxo chukal ix sk'ulej winh, aykan b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkan yab'ixal heb' sreyal Israel yet' heb' yik Judá. Axo winhaj Joaquín yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayic ix schaanel yich winhaj Joaquín yak'an reyal, 18 ab'il sk'inal winh. Oxe' ujal yet' lajunhexo k'ual ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén, te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová.

Ha t'a b'ab'el uj yik jun ab'il chi', ix yal winhaj Nabucodonosor to tz'ik'jib'at winhaj Joaquín chi' t'a Babilonia yet' juntzanh yamk'ab' te karo stojol ay t'a skajnub' Jehová. Axo winhaj Sedequías ix ak'jioch reyal t'a Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén sk'exulok winhaj Joaquín chi'. Ha winhaj Sedequías chi', sk'ab' yok sb'a winh yet' winhaj Joaquín chi'.
Ha winhaj Sedequías chi', 21 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix schaanel yich winh yak'an reyal, 11 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Maj sna sb'a sk'ool winh yuj skachnab'il ix schek Jehová yal winh schekab' aj Jeremías.

Ijan ix yik'el sb'a winh t'a winhaj Nabucodonosor yalani, aton b'aj ix yak' sti' winh t'a yichanh Dios to junnhej ix yutej spensar winh yet' winh. Junelnhej ix yak' pitb'oquel spensar winh, majxo yal sk'ool winh ix meltzaj t'a Jehová sDiosal Israel.

Anhejtona' masanil heb' winh yajal t'a Judá chi', heb' winh sakerdote yet' masanil heb' anima, ix te k'e wal chaanh heb' sk'ulan chukal te yajb'entak. Ha wal sb'eyb'al juntzanhxo ch'ok chonhab'il ix sb'eyb'alej heb', ix yixtanel skajnub' Jehová heb', aton jun sik'b'ilel yuj t'a Jerusalén chi'.
Ha Jehová sDiosal heb' yet' smam yicham heb', ix scheknhejkot heb' schekab' yik tzul kachji heb', yujto tz'ok' sk'ol t'a schonhab' yet' t'a skajnub' chi'.

Palta tonhej ix stzetzej heb' schekab' Dios chi' heb', malaj yelk'och tas ix yal heb' t'a sat heb'. Ix b'uchwaj heb' t'a heb' schekab' Dios chi', masanto ix em wal yowal sk'ol Jehová t'a yib'anh schonhab' chi', majxo yal-laj yoch waan.

Ixlajwi chi', ix chekjikot winh sreyal heb' aj Babilonia chi' yuj Jehová, ix jawi winh yak' owal yet' heb' aj Judá chi'. Ix miljicham heb' kelemtak t'a k'een espada t'a yamaq'uil skajnub' Dios. Manhxa jab'ok sniwank'olal heb' t'a heb' kelemtak chi' yet' t'a heb' ix kob'estak, t'a heb' icham anima manhxa yip. Ix ak'jioch heb' smasanil t'a yol sk'ab' winh rey chi' yuj Jehová.

Masanil yamk'ab' yik skajnub' Dios, niwak yet' kotak, jantaknhej tas ay t'a skajnub' chi' yet' masanil sb'eyumal winh rey yet' yik heb' winh ayoch yajalil yet' winh rey chi', pilan ix yik'b'at winhaj Nabucodonosor chi' t'a Babilonia.
Ix snhusankantz'a skajnub' Dios chi' heb', ix smak'ankanem lanhnaj smuroal Jerusalén chi' heb'. Ix snhusantz'a spalakio winh rey heb', ix smak'anpoj masanil tas karo stojol heb'.

Axo heb' maj miljokcham t'a owal chi', ix ik'jib'at heb' t'a Babilonia chi'. Ix ochkan heb' chekab'ok t'a winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi' yet' t'a heb' yinhtilal winh, masanto ayik ix ak'ji ganar Babilonia chi' yuj heb' aj Persia.
Icha wal chi' ix aj yelk'och tas ix schek Dios yal winhaj Jeremías schekab'. Icha chi' ix aj yik'an yip lum lum, yujto 70 ab'il manhxalaj mach ix munlaj t'a sat lu'um.

Ayic b'ab'el ab'il yoch winhaj Ciro reyal t'a Persia, ix elk'och slolonel Jehová alb'ilkanel yuj winhaj Jeremías schekab'. Ha Jehová ix ak'an sna winhaj rey Ciro chi', yuj chi' ix yak'elta jun cheknab'il winh. Ix schekan winh alchajel t'a masanil yol smakb'en, ix schekanpax winh pukchaj uum, syalan icha tik:

Ha in Ciro in tik sreyal in Persia, a in swal icha tik: Ha Jehová sDiosal satcha’anh, ha' ix ak'anoch masanil nakión t'a sat lu'um tik t'a yol in k'ab'. A' ix alan t'ayin to tzin b'ok'e skajnub' t'a Jerusalén t'a yol yik Judá. Yuj chi', yalnhej mach ex schonhab' ex Jehová, kolwajokab' Jehová he Diosal chi' eyed'ok. Ha tiknaik meltzajanhek t'a Jerusalén chi', xchi winh.

Ayic b'ab'el ab'il yoch winhaj Ciro reyal t'a Persia, ix elk'och slolonel Jehová yalnakkanel winhaj Jeremías schekab'. Ha Jehová ix ak'an sna winhaj rey Ciro chi', yuj chi' ix yak'elta jun cheknab'il winh. Ix schekan winh alchajel t'a masanil yol smakb'en, ix schekanpax winh pukchajel ab'ix, syalan icha tik:

Ha in Ciro in tik sreyal in Persia, a in swal icha tik: Ha Jehová sDiosal satcha’anh, ha' ix ak'anoch masanil nakión t'a sat lum tik t'a yol in k'ab'. A' ix alan t'ayin to tzin b'ok'e skajnub' t'a Jerusalén t'a yol yik Judá.
Yuj chi', yalnhej mach ex schonhab' ex Jehová, kolwajokab' Jehová he Diosal chi' eyed'ok. Ha tiknaik ixiquek t'a Jerusalén t'a yol yik Judá, tze b'oanxik'e skajnub' Jehová he Diosal chi' ta'.

Yalnhej mach ex ix to ex kan t'a tik, tato he gana tzex pax t'a Jerusalén, kolwajokab' heb' kajan t'a he lak'anil chi', yak'okab' k'een oro heb', k'een plata yet' pax tastak yet' nok' molb'etzal nok' t'ayex. Yak'okab' pax yofrenda heb' yuj skajnub' Dios t'a Jerusalén chi', xchi jun cheknab'il chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yak' lista sb'a heb' yajalil t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Judá, t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Benjamín yet' masanil heb' sakerdote yet' heb' lewita, aton heb' b'aj ix lolon Jehová t'a spensar to sb'at heb' t'a Jerusalén yik b'at sb'oanxik'e skajnub' Jehová heb'.
Axo masanil heb' anima kajan t'a slak'anil heb', ix yak' k'een oro heb', k'een plata, nok' molb'etzal nok', tastak te karo stojol yet' pax juntzanhxo ofrenda to tz'el wal t'a sk'ol heb' yak'ani.
Ay pax juntzanh yamk'ab' yik skajnub' Jehová ik'b'ilkot t'a Jerusalén yuj winhaj Nabucodonosor, aykanoch t'a yol stemplo sdiosal winh.
Axo winhaj Ciro chi' ix alan t'a winhaj Mitrídates, winh sik'um tumin to syik'elta juntzanh tastak chi' winh, sb'isan winh, syak'an winh t'a winhaj Sesbasar, winh ol och yajalil t'a Judá.
Aton sb'isul tastak tik: 30 k'een niwak uk'ab' nab'a oro, mil k'een niwak uk'ab' nab'a plata, 29 k'een kuchilub',
30 k'een yunetak uk'ab' nab'a oro, 410 k'een yunetak uk'ab' nab'a plata, haxo juntzanhxo tastak, mil sb'isul.

Ha sb'isul juntzanh tas nab'a oro yet' nab'a plata t'a smasanil, 5 mil 400. Masanil juntzanh chi' ix yik' meltzaj winhaj Sesbasar yet' juntzanhxo heb' ayik ix paxta heb' t'a Babilonia chi', ix jaxkan heb' t'a Jerusalén.

Aton slistail heb' aj Judá ik'b'ilb'at yuj winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia, heb' ix jax t'a Jerusalén yet' t'a juntzanhxo lugar t'a yol yik Judá. Junjun heb' ix k'ochxikan t'a schonhab'. Axo heb' winh kuchb'um t'a heb', aton heb' winh tik: Vinhaj Zorobabel, winhaj Jesúa, winhaj Nehemías, winhaj Seraías, winhaj Reelaías, winhaj Mardoqueo, winhaj Bilsán, winhaj Mizpar, winhaj Bigwai, winhaj Rehum yet' winhaj Baana.

Ha heb' yinhtilal winhaj Paros, 2 mil 172 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Sefatías, 372 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Ara, 775 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Pahat-moab, aton heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jesúa yet' winhaj Joab, 2 mil 812 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Elam, mil 254 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Zatu, 945 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Zacai, 760 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Bani, 642 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Bebai, 623 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Azgad, mil 222 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Adonicam, 666 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Bigwai, 2 mil 56 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Adín, 454 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Ater, anhejtona' winh skuchanpax Ezequías, 98 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Bezai, 323 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Jora, 112 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Hasum, 223 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Gibar, 95 heb'.

Ay heb' yinhtilalkan heb' anima ek'nak kajan t'a juntzanh chonhab' ix meltzajpaxi, aton heb' tik: Eb' aj Belén, 123 heb'. Eb' aj Netofa, 56 heb'. Eb' aj Anatot, 128 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Azmawet, 42 heb'. Eb' aj Quiriat-jearim, heb' aj Cafira yet' heb' aj Beerot, 743 heb'. Eb' aj Ramá yet' heb' aj Geba, 621 heb'. Eb' aj Micmas, 122 heb'. Eb' aj Betel yet' heb' aj Hai, 223 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Nebo, 52 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Magbis, 156 heb'. Eb' ek'nak t'a junxo skuchan Elam, mil 254 heb'. Eb' aj Harim, 320 heb'. Eb' aj Lod, heb' aj Hadid yet' heb' aj Ono, 725 heb'. Eb' aj Jericó, 345 heb'. Eb' aj Senaa, 3 mil 630 heb'.

Axo heb' sakerdote, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jedaías, aton heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jesúa, 973 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Imer, mil 52 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Pasur, mil 247 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Harim mil 17 heb'.

Eb' lewita yinhtilal winhaj Jesúa yet' heb' yinhtilal winhaj Cadmiel, a heb' chi' yinhtilal pax heb' winhaj Hodabías, 74 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Asaf sb'itani, 128 heb' t'a smasanil. Eb' tanhwum puerta, aton heb' yinhtilal winhaj Salum, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Ater, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Talmón, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Acub, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Hatita yet' heb' yinhtilal winhaj Sobai, 139 heb' t'a smasanil.

Axo heb' smunlaj t'a templo, aton heb' yinhtilalkan heb' winh ol b'inaj tik: Vinhaj Ziha, winhaj Hasufa, winhaj Tabaot, winhaj Queros, winhaj Siaha, winhaj Padón, winhaj Lebana, winhaj Hagaba, winhaj Acub, winhaj Hagab, winhaj Salmai, winhaj Hanán, winhaj Gidel, winhaj Gahar, winhaj Reaía, winhaj Rezín, winhaj Necoda, winhaj Gazam, winhaj Uza, winhaj Paseah, winhaj Besai, winhaj Asena, winhaj Meunim, winhaj Nefusim, winhaj Bacbuc, winhaj Hacufa, winhaj Harhur, winhaj Bazlut, winhaj Mehída, winhaj Harsa, winhaj Barcos, winhaj Sísara, winhaj Tema, winhaj Nezía yet' pax winhaj Hatifa.

Ay pax heb' yinhtilalkan heb' ak'jinak serwil winhaj Salomón, aton heb' yinhtilal heb' winh ol b'inaj tik: Vinhaj Sotai, winhaj Soferet, winhaj Peruda, winhaj Jaala, winhaj Darcón, winhaj Gidel, winhaj Sefatías, winhaj Hatil, winhaj Poqueret-hazebaim yet' pax winhaj Ami.
Masanil heb' tz'ak'wi serwil t'a skajnub' Dios yet' pax yinhtilal heb' ak'jinak serwil winhaj Salomón, 392 heb' t'a smasanil.

Ha winhaj Delaías yet' heb' yinhtilal winhaj Tobías yet' heb' yinhtilal winhaj Necoda, 652 heb'. Ha heb' tik ix kot heb' t'a Tel-mela, t'a Tel-harsa, t'a Querub, t'a Addán yet' t'a Imer. Ha heb' tik, maxtzak yal-laj sch'oxanel sb'a heb' tato yinhtilal Israel heb'.

Ha heb' yinhtilal winhaj Habaía, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Cos yet' heb' yinhtilal winhaj Barzilai, ix yal heb' to sakerdote heb', palta malaj b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkani tato yinhtilal sakerdote heb'. Yuj chi' maj chajioch heb' t'a opisio t'a sakerdoteal. Ha winhaj Barzilai chi', ix yik'laj sb'a winh yet' jun ix yisil jun winh aj Galaad skuchan Barzilai, yuj chi' a sb'i winh snhi' winh chi' ix ochkan t'ay.
Ix yalan winh yajal yaj t'a heb' to max yal swaan wael heb' yik Dios yaji, masanto yik ol yil junok winh sakerdote t'a Urim yet' Tumim yik scheklaji tato yel yinhtilal sakerdote heb'.

Junnhej ix aj heb' anima chi' smasanil, 42 mil 360 heb'. Ch'ok pax yaj heb' winh chekab' yet' heb' ix chekab', 7 mil 337 heb' t'a smasanil, ch'ok pax yaj 200 heb' winh winak yet' heb' ix ix sb'itani. Ay pax 736 nok' chej, 245 nok' mula, 435 nok' kamello yet' 6 mil 720 nok' b'uru.
Ayic ix k'och heb' t'a Jerusalén, ay juntzanh heb' yajal t'a skal heb', ix yak' silab' heb' yuj sb'ochajxi skajnub' Jehová b'aj ayek' t'a peka'.
Icha syal jantak ix techaj yuj heb', a ix yak' heb' yik sb'ochajxi templo chi'. Mil 30 libra k'een oro ix yak' heb' yet' 5 mil 740 libra k'een plata yet' 100 pichul yik heb' sakerdote.

Ha heb' sakerdote, heb' lewita sb'itani, heb' tanhwum puerta yet' heb' smunlaj t'a templo yet' juntzanhxo heb' chonhab', ix kajnajkan heb' t'a Jerusalén chi'. Axo masanil heb' yetisraelal heb' chi', ix b'at kajnajxikan junjun heb' b'aj ek'nak heb' smam yicham heb' t'a peka'.
Toxo ix laj ajxi kajan heb' israel t'a schonhab'kani, haxo yik ix jawi jun yuquil uj, ix smolb'an sb'a heb' masanil t'a Jerusalén.

Axo winhaj Jesúa yuninal winhaj Josadac yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh sakerdote yet' pax winhaj Zorobabel yuninal winhaj Salatiel yet' heb' sk'ab'yok, ix syamoch heb' winh sb'oanxik'e altar yik Jehová Dios, yik syak' silab' heb' t'a yib'anh altar chi', icha yajkan t'a ley yuj winhaj Moisés schekab' Dios.

Yujto xiw heb' t'a heb' ch'ok chonhab'il kajan t'a slak'anil, yuj chi' te wach' ix yutej heb' sb'oank'e jun altar chi'. Junjun q'uinhib'alil yet' junjun yemk'ualil snhus silab' heb' t'a yib'anh altar chi', yik syik'anchaanh Jehová heb'.
Ix yak'anoch q'uinh heb' yik chinama, ix yak'an silab' heb' tz'ak'ji t'a junjun k'u, icha yalankan ley.
Ix yak'an silab' heb' to stz'ha t'a junjun k'u, silab' ayik tz'alji k'een uj, silab' yuj q'uinh tz'och t'a junjun ab'il yet' silab' mach tz'el t'a sk'ool yak'an t'a Jehová.
Ha t'a b'ab'el k'ual yik yuquil uj, ix schaanel yich heb' yak'an silab' stz'ai, wach'chom manto em yich skajnub' Jehová.

Ix yak'an tumin heb' t'a heb' albañil yet' t'a heb' nhikum te'. Ix yak'anpax ixim trigo heb', wino yet' akeite t'a heb' aj Sidón yet' t'a heb' aj Tiro yik syak'ankot te' k'ute' heb' t'a Líbano. Scot te' t'a yib'anh ha' mar masanto sjawi te' t'a Jope, icha ix aj yalan winhaj Ciro sreyal Persia.

Ix el yich sb'ochajxi skajnub' Dios yuj winhaj Zorobabel yuninal winhaj Salatiel, winhaj Jesúa yuninal winhaj Josadac yet' heb' sakerdote, heb' lewita yet' masanil heb' ix kot t'a Babilonia. D'a schab'il ujal yik schab'il ab'il sjawi heb' t'a Jerusalén, ix syamanoch heb' sb'oanxi skajnub' Jehová, ix yak'anoch jun munlajel chi' heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' lewita ek'xo 20 ab'il sk'inal.

Ha jun winh lewita skuchan Jesúa, heb' yuninal winh yet' heb' yuk'tak winh, winhaj Cadmiel yet' heb' yuninal yet' pax heb' yinhtilal heb' aj Judá, junnhej ix yutej sb'a heb'. Kuchb'um ix aj heb' t'a munlajel chi'. Ix kolwajpax heb' lewita yinhtilal winhaj Henadad yet' heb' ayto yuj sb'a yet' heb'.

Ayic ix yak'anem yich skajnub' Jehová chi' heb' albañil, ix k'e linhan heb' winh sakerdote, ayoch spichul heb' winh yik sakerdoteal, yet'nak strompeta heb' winh. Axo heb' lewita yinhtilal winhaj Asaf yet'nak splatillo heb', sb'itan heb' t'a Jehová, icha yalnakkan winhaj Dawid sreyal Israel t'a peka'.

Sb'itan jun makan heb', stak'wipax nanhalxo heb', syalan heb' icha tik: Kaq'ek yuj diosal t'a Jehová yujto te wach', yujto te xajan onh a onh israel onh tik yuj t'a junelnhej, xchi masanil anima. Tz'el yaw heb' yuj tzalajk'olal, sb'itanpax heb' t'a Jehová Dios yujto toxo ix emxi yich skajnub'.

Tzijtum heb' sakerdote, heb' lewita yet' heb' yajalil chonhab' te ichamtak winakxo, yilnak jun b'ab'el templo heb'. Te chaanh ix el yaw heb' yoq'ui ayik ix yilan heb' yem yich junxo ak' templo chi'. Tzijtum pax mach tz'el yaw yuj tzalajk'olal.
Maxtzac nachajel yuj heb' tz'ab'ani tas wan yuji chi'. Ay mach tz'oq'ui, ay mach tz'awaj yuj tzalajk'olal, najat tz'ab'chaj yel yaw heb' yujto te chaanh tz'awaj heb'.
Ayic ix yab'an heb' ajk'ol yaj t'a heb' yik Judá yet' t'a heb' yik Benjamín to a heb' ix meltzajkot t'a Babilonia wan sb'oanxik'e stemplo Jehová sDiosal heb',

ix k'och heb' t'a winhaj Zorobabel yet' t'a heb' yajal yaj t'a skal junjun makan heb'. Ix yalan heb' icha tik: --Comonoc scha he k'ool sko b'o jun munlajel tik eyed'ok, yujto tzonh ochpax ejmelal t'a he Diosal chi' icha ex tik. Atax yik onh ik'chajkot t'a tik yuj winhaj Esar-hadón sreyal Asiria, atax ta' onh och ijan kak'an ko silab' t'a he Diosal chi', xchi heb'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Zorobabel yet' winhaj Jesúa yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh yajal yaj chi', ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --Manh ol yal-laj junnhej ol ko b'oxik'e skajnub' Jehová ko Diosal tik eyed'ok. Ha onnhej israel onh tik ol ko b'o'o, yujto icha chi' ix aj yalan winhaj Ciro sreyal Persia t'ayonh, xchi heb' winh.
Palta ix och wal ijan heb' ajk'ol chi' yak'an chab'axk'e sk'ol heb', yik xiwchaanh masanil heb' kajan t'a Judá chi' yik wach' maxtzak sb'oxik'e jun templo chi' heb'.

Ix yak'an k'een tumin heb' ajk'ol chi' t'a juntzanh heb' yajal ak'b'iloch yuj winh sreyal Persia t'a skal heb', yik smontaj heb', yik wach' skachoch waan heb' israel chi' heb' t'a jun munlajel chi'. Ichanhej chi' ix yutej sb'a heb' ayik ayoch winhaj Ciro reyal t'a Persia, masanto ayik ix och winhaj Darío reyal.
Ayic ix schaanpaxel yich winhaj Asuero yak'an reyal, ix ak'wipax queja heb' ajk'ol chi' t'a spatik heb' kajan t'a Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén.

Anhejtona' ayik ayoch winhaj Artajerjes reyal t'a Persia, ix slajtiej sb'a winhaj Bislam, winhaj Mitrídates, winhaj Tabeel yet' pax juntzanhxo heb' winh yetb'eyum heb' winh. Ix stz'ib'ejb'at juntzanh lolonel heb' winh t'a winh rey chi'. Ha t'a ti' arameo ix tz'ib'chaj ch'anh uum chi'.
Axo winhaj Rehum winh sat yajal heb' soldado yet' winhaj Simsai winh tz'ib'um, ix stz'ib'ejpaxb'at junxo karta heb' winh t'a winhaj rey Artajerjes chi'.

Aton jun karta tik ix yak'b'at heb' winh chawanh chi' yet' heb' winh yajal yaj yet' heb' winh yet' heb' winh ay yopisio kotnak t'a Persia yet' heb' ik'b'ilkot t'a Erec, t'a Babilonia, t'a Susa, t'a yol smakb'en Elam

yet' t'a juntzanhxo nakión. Aton heb' ik'b'ilkot t'a schonhab' yuj winhaj Asnapar, winh yak'nak yajalil t'a Asiria to niwan yelk'ochi. Ix ul ak'jikan heb' yuj winh t'a chonhab' Samaria yet' t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'ha ha' Éufrates.
Ix yalanb'at heb' winh icha tik: Mamin rey Artajerjes, a onh a chekab' onh kajan onh t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'ha ha' Éufrates, sko tz'ib'ej jun uum tik t'ayach:

Mamin rey, skalb'at t'ayach to a heb' judío ak'b'il meltzaj t'a yol a makb'en, ix jawi heb' t'a Jerusalén tik. Van sb'oanxik'e jun chonhab' heb', jun pit yutejnak sb'a. Toxo ix syamoch heb' sb'oanxik'e smuroal, wanxo sb'oel yuj heb'.

Mamin rey, skak'anpax ojtaquejeli, tato ol b'ochajxik'e jun chonhab' tik yet' smuroal, a juntzanh anima tik manhxo ol yak' k'een tumin heb' syak'taxon t'ayach yet' k'een tumin sk'anel heb' t'a heb' tzek' t'a a makb'en tik. Yuj chi' manhxo ol k'och k'een tumin chi' t'ayach.
Yujto a onh tik mamin rey, ayonh och ach kak'an serwil, malaj ko gana to icha chi' ol ach utajok, yuj chi' skalb'at juntzanh tik t'ayach.

Saychajokab' iljok b'aj molb'ab'il tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj heb' a mam icham. Ata' ol il yuj tas skalb'at tik, ol ojtakaneli to a jun chonhab' tik te chuk, ay smay heb' t'a juntzanhxo heb' rey yet' t'a juntzanhxo nakión. Yuj schukal heb', ix satjiel schonhab' heb' tik.
Yuj chi' mamin rey, skalb'at t'ayach, tato sb'ochajxik'e jun chonhab' tik yet' smuroal, manhxa alan ik t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'ha ha' Éufrates tik, xchib'at heb' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'ankot spak slolonel heb' winh chi' winhaj rey Artajerjes chi' icha tik: Ach sat yajal Rehum yet' ach Simsai tz'ib'um yet' heb' winh ayoch eyed'ok t'a Samaria yet' t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'ha ha' Éufrates chi', swak' stzatzil he k'ool.
Ha tas ix eyalkot t'ayin, wach' ix aj yawtaj wab'i.
Ix in chek saychaj ilchajok, icha ix eyala'. Ix ilchaji to a heb' anima kajan t'a Jerusalén chi', te pit ix yutejnhej sb'a heb' t'a heb' rey ek'nakxo.

Ha t'a yik chi' ay heb' sreyal Jerusalén te tek'an, a heb' ix ak'an mandar t'a lum lum t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'ha ha' Éufrates chi'. Ix yak' k'een tumin heb' anima t'a heb' yuj stupan heb' b'aj kajan chi'.
Yuj chi' alek t'a juntzanh winak chi' to swanaj heb' smunlaji, mokab' b'ochajxik'e jun chonhab' chi', masanto a in ol wala'.
Manh tonhejok tzeyiloch jun chi' yik wach' max te ixtaxel yol in makb'en chi', xchikot winh rey chi'.

Axo yik ix awtaj tas ix yalkot winhaj Artajerjes chi' t'a yichanh winhaj Rehum, winhaj Simsai yet' t'a yichanh heb' winh ajun yet' heb' winh, elanhchamel ix jawi heb' winh t'a Jerusalén. Ix ul yak'an pural heb' judío heb' winh yoch waan smunlaji.
Yuj schukal heb' ajk'ol chi', ix och waan sb'ochajxik'e skajnub' Dios t'a Jerusalén tik, masanto t'a schab'il ab'il yoch winhaj Darío reyal t'a Persia.
Ha heb' winh schekab' Jehová Dios, aton winhaj Hageo yet' winhaj Zacarías yuninal winhaj Iddo, ix och ijan heb' winh yalan t'a heb' aj Judá yet' t'a heb' aj Jerusalén, tas syal Jehová Dios t'a heb'.

Yuj chi', ix och winhaj Zorobabel yuninal winhaj Salatiel yet' winhaj Jesúa yuninal winhaj Josadac t'a munlajel junelxo yik sb'ochajxik'e skajnub' Dios chi'. Ix och heb' winh schekab' Dios chi' yiptzitan heb'.

Axo pax winhaj Tatnai yajal t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'ha ha' Éufrates, winhaj Setar-boznai yet' heb' winh yetb'eyum sb'a yet' heb' winh, ix ulek' heb' winh yal icha tik: ¿Mach ix alan t'ayex yuj chi' tze b'oxik'e jun niwan pat tik, tzeyak'anoch ste'al?
¿Tastac sb'i heb' sb'oan jun niwan pat tik? xchi heb' winh.

Palta ha Dios ix och wal yet' heb' israel skuchb'an jun munlajel chi', yuj chi' maj kachjioch waan heb' munlajwum yuj winh yajal chi' yet' heb' ajun yet'ok. Anhejto ix stz'ib'ejb'at juntzanh lolonel heb' winh t'a winhaj rey Darío, ix stanhwan heb' winh tas ol aj spakan winh.
Aton skopiail tas ix stz'ib'ejb'at winhaj Tatnai, winhaj Setar-boznai yet' pax juntzanhxo heb' winh yetyajalil heb' winh t'a winhaj rey Darío chi'.
Ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: Mamin rey, junk'olalokab' aji.

Ha wal jun tik skak' ojtaquejeli: Ix onh xid'ek' t'a Judá, ix quilani to wan sb'ochajxi skajnub' jun Dios niwan yelk'ochi. Van yak'anoch k'een niwak k'een heb' tzeyb'il t'ay yet' te te' tzek' pax t'a yib'anh k'een. Te yelk'olal smunlaj heb', wanxo sb'o yuj heb'.
Ix ko k'anb'ej t'a heb' skuchb'an munlajel chi' mach ix alani sb'oan jun munlajel chi' heb' yet' yak'anoch te te' chi' heb' t'ay.
Ix ko k'anb'ejpax kab'i tastak sb'i heb' skuchb'an heb' chi', yik sko tz'ib'anb'at t'ayach kalani.
Ix yalan heb' t'ayonh tob' tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a sDiosal satcha’anh yet' sat lum tik, yuj chi' wan sb'oanxik'e jun spat chi' heb', jun sb'onak jun niwan rey t'a Israel t'a peka'.

Ix yalan heb' to a heb' smam yicham heb' tzuntzannakkot yowal sk'ol sDiosal satcha’anh chi', yuj chi' a ak'annakoch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia, yinhtilal heb' kaldeo. Ha winh pojannak em jun pat chi', yik'annakb'at heb' anima winh t'a Babilonia chi'.
Axob' t'a b'ab'el ab'il yoch winhaj Ciro reyal t'a Babilonia chi', ix ab' schekan winh b'ochajxik'e jun pat chi'.

Anhejtona' yik'nak ab' b'at juntzanh yamk'ab' nab'a oro, nab'a plata ay t'a yol skajnub' Dios t'a Jerusalén winhaj Nabucodonosor chi'. Yak'annak och winh t'a yol stemplo sdiosal t'a Babilonia chi'. Axob' winhaj rey Ciro ix ak'an juntzanh yamk'ab' chi' t'a winhaj Sesbasar, winh ix yak'och winh yajalil t'a Jerusalén.
Ix ab' yalan winh to syik'b'at juntzanh yamk'ab' chi' winh t'a Jerusalén chi' masanto yik sb'ochajxik'e skajnub' Dios chi' b'aj aytaxoni.
Ayic ix k'och winhaj Sesbasar t'a Jerusalén chi', ix yak'anem yich stemplo Dios chi' winh. Atax ta' ix chael yich sb'ochajxi, palta manto b'oel-laj tiknaik.

Ha tiknaik mamin rey, tato wach' skan jun tik t'ayach, saychajokab' ilchaj b'ajtak tz'ib'ab'il tastak yik heb' rey t'a spalakio heb' t'a Babilonia chi', tato yel to a winhaj rey Ciro chi' ix chekan b'ochajxi stemplo Dios t'a Jerusalén chi', mato maay. Slajwi chi' tzalan kab'i tas tz'aj a naan t'a yib'anh jun tik, xchib'at heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj rey Darío chi' to saychaj tastak tz'ib'ab'il b'aj sik'b'ilkan tastak t'a Babilonia.
Palta ha t'a yol palakio t'a chonhab' Ecbatana, t'a yol yik Media, ata' ix ilchaj jun tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan chi', b'aj syal icha tik:

Ha t'a b'ab'el ab'il yoch winhaj Ciro reyal, ix yalan winh icha tik: B'ochajokab'xi skajnub' Dios t'a Jerusalén. Wach' tz'aj yem yich sb'ochajxik'ei yik ha t'a yool tz'ak'chaj silab'. 27 metro tz'ajk'e schaanhil, 27 metro tz'ajpax yol schiquin.

Ox tzol k'een niwak k'een tzeyb'il tz'och t'ay, jun tzol pax te te' ak'to tzek' t'a yib'anh k'een. Axo k'een tumin ol k'anchajok, a b'aj smolchaj masanil k'een tumin t'a yol in makb'en, ata' tz'elta k'een.

Axo juntzanh yamk'ab' nab'a oro yet' plata ik'b'ilkot t'a yol templo t'a Jerusalén yuj winhaj Nabucodonosor t'a Babilonia tik, ik'chajokab' meltzaj t'a Jerusalén chi', tz'ak'chajkanoch t'a yol templo chi', t'a b'ajtaxon ayeq'ui, xchi winh, xchi jun cheknab'il chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalankot winhaj rey Darío chi' icha tik: Ach Tatnai yajal t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'ha ha' Éufrates yet' ach Setar-boznai yet' ex yetyajalil heb' winh: B'esequel he b'ha t'a Jerusalén chi'.
Manh eyamoch waan winh yajalil heb' israel yet' heb' skuchb'an munlajel yik sb'ochajxi skajnub' Dios b'ajtaxon ay yet'tal.

Ha in swala' to tzex kolwaj yet' heb' skuchb'an heb' wan sb'oanxi skajnub' Dios chi'. Ha t'a k'een tumin syak' heb' kajan t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'ha ha' Éufrates, ata' tz'elta k'een sk'anchaj t'a munlajel chi'. Mokab' ek' tiempo yak'chaj k'een, yik wach' max och waan munlajel chi'.

Masanil tas tz'och yopisio t'a junjun k'u, mokab' yak' palta t'a heb' sakerdote ayek' t'a Jerusalén, icha tz'aj sk'anan heb': Nok' kelemtak wakax, nok' ch'ak kalnel, nok' yunetak kalnel, yik snhusjitz'a nok' silab'il t'a sDiosal satcha’anh. Mokab' yak'pax palta ixim trigo, atz'am atz'am, wino yet' akeite,
yik tz'ak'ji silab'il d'ha Dios, yik sk'anji in k 'inal yet' wal wuninal.

Ha in swalpaxi, tato ay mach max k'anab'ajan tas swal tik, tz'ik'chajelta junok spatzab'il spat, sjoychajem t'a yol lu'um, haxo ta' tz'ak'jik'e lokan. Axo spat chi' sjuchajemi, tz'ochkan yet'talok b'aj b'at tzajok anima.

Ha Dios ix sik'anel Jerusalén chi' yik tz'och ejmelal t'ay ta'. Yuj chi' aokab' satanel heb' rey yet' smakb'en heb' stenanek' jun lolonel swal tik, ma heb' tz'ixtanb'at skajnub' Dios t'a Jerusalén chi'. Ha in Darío in swak' jun cheknab'il tik, yowalil sk'anab'ajaj masanil t'a elanhchamel, xchi winh rey chi'.
Ha winhaj Tatnai yet' winhaj Setar-boznai yet' heb' winh yetyajalil heb' winh, ix sk'anab'ajej heb' winh icha ix aj yalankot winhaj rey Darío chi'.

Yuj chi', a heb' israel skuchb'an jun munlajel chi', ix yal smunlaj heb' yik sb'oanxik'e templo chi' heb' icha ix aj yalan heb' winh schekab' Dios, aton winhaj Hageo yet' winhaj Zacarías yuninal winhaj Iddo. Ix b'oel templo chi' icha ix aj yalan Jehová sDiosal Israel, icha pax ix aj yalan heb' winh sreyal Persia, aton winhaj Ciro, winhaj Darío yet' winhaj Artajerjes.
Ayic oxe' k'ualxo yoch uj Adar yik swaquil ab'il yoch winhaj Darío reyal t'a Persia, ata' ix b'oel templo chi'.
Axo heb' israel, heb' sakerdote, heb' lewita yet' masanil heb' ix xid'ek' t'a Babilonia, ix yak'och q'uinh heb' yik tzalajk'olal yuj skajnub' Dios chi'.

Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', ix yak' juntzanh silab' tik heb': 100 nok' kelemtak wakax, 200 nok' ch'ak kalnel, 400 nok' yunetak kalnel yet' lajchawanh nok' mam chiwa. Junjun nok' chiwa chi' yik junjun makan yinhtilal heb' israel, yik stupchaj smul heb' masanil.
Ixlajwi chi', ix ak'jioch heb' sakerdote t'a stzolal t'a yopisio. Ix ak'jipaxoch junjun makan heb' lewita t'a yopisio t'a skajnub' Dios t'a Jerusalén chi', icha yajkan t'a ley Moisés.
Anhejtona' pax heb' xid'naquek' t'a Babilonia, ix yak'och q'uinh heb' yik snaankot heb' ayik yelnak heb' smam yicham heb' t'a Egipto t'a 14 yoch b'ab'el uj.

Axo heb' sakerdote yet' heb' lewita, ix sakb'itej sb'a heb' icha yalan ley. Ayic wach'xo yaj heb', ix yak'an nok' silab' yik q'uinh chi' heb' yuj masanil heb' ix xid'ek' t'a Babilonia chi', aton heb' yetsakerdoteal heb' yet' heb' yetlewitail heb'.

Masanil heb' israel ix xid'ek' t'a Babilonia chi', ix chi nok' silab' yik q'uinh chi' heb', yet' heb' ix yik'el sb'ha t'a schukal juntzanh ch'ok chonhab'il kajan t'a slak'anil. Junnhej ix yutej sb'a heb' yet' heb' israel yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a Jehová sDiosal Israel chi'.

Uque' k'ual ix och q'uinh yik ixim pan malaj yich yuj heb' t'a tzalajk'olal, yujto a Jehová ix ak'anoch tzalajk'olal chi' t'a spensar heb'. A' ix k'exanpax spensar winh sreyal Persia, yuj chi' ix kolwaj winh yik sb'ochajxi skajnub'.

Ayic ayoch winhaj Artajerjes reyal t'a Persia, ay jun winh skuchan Esdras. Ha sb'i heb' smam yicham winh, aton tik: Vinhaj Seraías, winhaj Azarías, winhaj Hilcías, winhaj Salum, winhaj Sadoc, winhaj Ahitob, winhaj Amarías, winhaj Azarías, winhaj Meraiot, winhaj Zeraías, winhaj Uzi, winhaj Buqui, winhaj Abisúa, winhaj Finees, winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Aarón winh b'ab'el sakerdote.

Ha winhaj Esdras chi', k'ayb'um winh t'a sk'ayb'ub'al Jehová sDiosal Israel, aton k'ayb'ub'al yak'nak Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés. Masanil tas ix sk'an winh, ix yak' winhaj rey Artajerjes chi' t'a winh, yujto a Jehová ayoch yet' winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix paxta winh t'a Babilonia.

Ayic yuquil ab'il yoch winhaj Artajerjes chi' reyal, ix jawi winhaj Esdras chi' t'a Jerusalén tik yet' jun nhilanh heb' yetisraelal, aton heb' sakerdote, heb' lewita sb'itani yet' heb' stanhwan puerta yet' heb' smunlaj t'a templo.

Ayoch Dios yet' winhaj Esdras chi', yuj chi' ix kot winh t'a Babilonia t'a b'ab'el k'u yik b'ab'el uj, t'a yuquil ab'il yoch winhaj Artajerjes chi' reyal. Ix jawi winh yet' heb' ajun yet'ok t'a Jerusalén tik t'a b'ab'el k'u yik yoil uj, anheja' t'a yuquil ab'il chi'.
Te ayoch t'a spensar winhaj Esdras chi' sk'ayb'an wal sk'ayb'ub'al Dios, sb'eyb'alan winh yet' sk'ayb'anpax heb' yetisraelal winh t'a jun k'ayb'ub'al chi'.
Aton skopiail scheknab'il winhaj rey Artajerjes tik ix yak' t'a winhaj sakerdote Esdras, k'ayb'um t'a sk'ayb'ub'al Jehová yet' scheknab'il ak'b'il t'a heb' yetisraelal:
Ha in Artajerjes in, yajal waj t'a juntzanhxo heb' rey, swak' stzatzil a k'ool ach Esdras, sakerdote ach, k'ayb'um ach pax t'a sk'ayb'ub'al sDiosal satcha’anh.
Toxo ix walel t'a masanil heb' etisraelal, heb' sakerdote yet' heb' lewita ayek' t'a yol in makb'en tik, tato syal sk'ol heb' sb'at t'a Jerusalén chi' ed'ok, b'atokab' heb'.
Ha in tik yet' ukwanh heb' tz'ak'an in razón, tzach kak'b'at ila' tas wal yaj Judá yet' Jerusalén chi', wan am sk'anab'ajan scheknab'il he Diosal ayek' t'a yol a k'ab' chi' heb'.
Ha k'een plata yet' k'een oro tz'el t'a ko k'ool kak'anb'at t'ayach, ik'b'at k'een t'a he Diosal a ex israel ex chi', aton jun ay skajnub' t'a Jerusalén chi'.
Tzik'anpaxb'at masanil k'een plata, k'een oro ix a cha t'a heb' anima t'a yol yik Babilonia yet' jantak tas tz'el t'a sk'ol heb' etisraelal yet' heb' sakerdote yak'an yuj skajnub' he Diosal chi'.

Ha yet' k'een tumin chi' tza man nok' wakax, nok' ch'ak kalnel, nok' yunetak kalnel yet' juntzanhxo tastak tz'ak'ji yet' nok', aton ixim trigo, ixim kebada, wino yik tz'ak'ji juntzanh chi' silab'il t'a yib'anh altar t'a skajnub' he Diosal chi'.
Axo jantakto k'een oro yet' k'een plata skani, ol xo eyila' tas b'aj wach' syal yoch k'een, icha syal tas snib'ej he Diosal chi'.
Axo pax masanil yamk'ab' ix ak'ji t'ayach yik sk'anchaji yik tz'och ejmelal t'a skajnub' he Diosal chi', a ach wal lak'an tzak' t'a a Diosal t'a Jerusalén chi'.
Yalnhej junokxo tas ay tz'och eyuuj t'a skajnub' he Diosal chi', syal he k'ananelta stojol t'a winh smolan k'een tumin t'a yol in makb'en.

Ha in rey Artajerjes in tik swal t'a masanil heb' molum tumin t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'ha ha' Éufrates: Masanil tas sk'an winhaj Esdras winh sakerdote, winh k'ayb'um pax t'a sk'ayb'ub'al sDiosal satcha’anh, elanhchamel tzeyak' t'a winh.
Syal eyak'an 75 quintalok k'een plata, 300 quintalok ixim trigo, 550 galónok wino, 550 galónok akeite yet' jantak atz'am atz'am sk'an winh.
Masanil tas sk'an sDiosal satcha’anh yuj skajnub', elanhchamelokab' tz'ak'chaji, yik wach' max kot yowal sk'ol t'a wib'anh yet' t'a yib'anh heb' wal wuninal yet' t'a yib'anh masanil in makb'en.

Tzeyojtakaneli to max yal-laj he k'anan k'een tumin t'a heb' sakerdote, t'a heb' lewita sb'itani yet' t'a heb' tanhwum puerta yet' t'a heb' smunlaj t'a stemplo Dios chi', aton k'een syak' heb' t'ayin, ma juntzanhxo k'een mol tumin.

Ha achxo pax tik ach Esdras, ato ha' a jelanil ak'b'il yuj a Diosal, ak'och heb' juez yet' heb' yajal. Ha heb' ol b'oan tas snib'ej heb' anima kajan t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'ha ha' Éufrates chi'. Ha heb' tz'och yopisio chi', yowalil yojtak sk'ayb'ub'al a Diosal chi' heb', haxo heb' manh ojtannakok jun, tza k'ayb'ej heb'.

Axo mach max k'anab'ajan scheknab'il a Diosal chi' yet' in cheknab'il a in rey in tik, elanhchamel tz'ak'jioch chamel t'a yib'anh, mato tz'ik'chajel t'a yol chonhab' chi', ma tz'ik'chajek' tastak ay t'ay, ma tz'ochkan t'a preso, xchi winh rey chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix lesalwi winhaj Esdras icha tik: Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová ko Diosal, aton sDiosal heb' ko mam quicham, yujto ha' ix ak'an sna' winh rey chi' to niwan yelk'och skajnub' t'a Jerusalén.

Yuj swach'k'olal Jehová, wach' in t'a yichanh winh rey chi' yet' t'a heb' tz'ak'an srazón winh yet' t'a sat masanil heb' niwak yajal ayoch yet' winh. Yuj skolwal Jehová ix in tek'b'ej in b'a in molb'an masanil heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun makan heb' wetisraelal, yik smeltzaj heb' wed'ok, xchi winhaj Esdras chi'.
Ha heb' winh yajal ix kot wed' t'a Babilonia ayik ayoch winhaj Artajerjes reyal, aton sb'i heb' winh tik icha tas yaj stz'ib'chaj heb' winh t'a junjun yinhtilal:

Aton winhaj Gersón, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Finees. Vinhaj Daniel, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Itamar. Vinhaj Hatús, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Sekanías, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Dawid. Vinhaj Zacarías, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Paros, 150 heb' winh winak ajun yet' winh. Vinhaj Elioenai yuninal winhaj Zeraías, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Pahat-moab, 200 heb' winh winak ajun yet' winh. Vinhaj Sekanías yuninal winhaj Jahaziel, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Zatu, 300 heb' winh winak ajun yet' winh. Vinhaj Ebed yuninal winhaj Jonatán, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Adín, 50 heb' winh winak ajun yet' winh. Vinhaj Jesaías yuninal winhaj Atalías, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Elam, 70 heb' winh winak ajun yet' winh. Vinhaj Zebadías yuninal winhaj Micael, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Sefatías, 80 heb' winh winak ajun yet' winh. Vinhaj Obadías yuninal winhaj Jehiel, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Joab, 218 heb' winh winak ajun yet' winh. Vinhaj Selomit yuninal winhaj Josifías, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Bani, 160 heb' winh winak ajun yet' winh. Vinhaj Zacarías yuninal winhaj Bebai, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Bebai, 28 heb' winh winak ajun yet' winh. Vinhaj Johanán yuninal winhaj Hacatán, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Azgad, 110 heb' winh winak ajun yet' winh. Ha winhaj Elifelet, winhaj Jeiel yet' winhaj Semaías t'a skal yinhtilal winhaj Adonicam, tzak'anxo ix meltzaj heb' winh yet' 60 heb' winh winak. Vinhaj Utai yet' winhaj Zabud, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Bigwai, 70 heb' winh winak ajun yet' winh.

Ha in Esdras in tik, ix in molb'ej heb' wetchonhab' tik t'a sti' jun ha ha' skuchan Ahawa, oxe' k'ual onh ek' ta'. Ix in sayanek' heb' lewita t'a skal heb' anima chi' yet' t'a skal heb' sakerdote, malaj junok heb' ix ilchaj wuuj.

Ix in chekanb'at winhaj Eliezer, winhaj Ariel, winhaj Semaías, winhaj Elnatán, winhaj Jarib, winhaj Elnatán, winhaj Natán, winhaj Zacarías yet' winhaj Mesulam. Ha heb' winh tik niwak yelk'och heb' winh yet' pax heb' winh k'ayb'um, aton winhaj Joiarib yet' winhaj Elnatán.

Ix in chekb'at heb' winh yal t'a winhaj Iddo, yajal t'a jun lugar skuch Casifia yet' t'a masanil heb' ayek' yet' winh ta', aton heb' yinhtilal heb' munlajnak t'a stemplo Dios to schekkot heb' anima heb' yik skolwaj heb' qued'ok t'a skajnub' ko Diosal.

Yuj skolwal Dios ix ik'chajkot winhaj Serebías yuj heb' winh, yujto a winh chi' te jelan winh, yinhtilal winh jun winh lewita skuchan Mahli. Ha winhaj Serebías chi', ix kot winh yet' heb' yuninal yet' heb' yuk'tak, 18 heb' t'a smasanil.
Ix yik'anpaxkot winhaj Hasabías heb' winh yet' winhaj Jesaías yet' pax yuninal heb' winh yet' heb' sk'ab'yok heb' winh, 20 heb' t'a smasanil, yinhtilal heb' winhaj Merari.
Ix jawipax 220 heb' yinhtilal heb' munlajnak t'a templo, heb' ak'b'ilkanoch yuj winhaj rey Dawid yet' heb' skuchb'an heb' lewita t'a yopisio. Masanil juntzanh heb' tik, tz'ib'ab'il sb'i heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix walani to tzonh och t'a tzek'ojk'olal t'a sti' ha' niwan Ahawa chi', yik wach' sko cha ko mulej ko chukal t'a yichanh ko Diosal, sko k'ananpax t'ay to tzonh yik'b'at t'a wach'il yet' heb' kuninal yet' masanil tas ay t'ayonh.

Ix in q'uixwi in k'anan heb' soldado t'a winh rey, aton heb' sb'ey t'a yok yet' heb' ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej, yik tzonh stanhwan heb' t'a heb' ajk'ol t'a yoltak b'e, yujto toxo ix kal t'a winh rey chi' to a ko Diosal stanhwan masanil mach tz'ak'anoch yipok sk'ool, palta skot yowal, syak'ankot yaelal t'a yib'anh mach max k'anab'ajani.
Yuj wal chi', ix onh och t'a tzek'ojk'olal, ix ko k'anan d'ha Dios to tzonh stanhwej. Ix yab' wal tas ix kal chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix in sik'anel lajchawanh heb' winh sat yaj t'a heb' winh sakerdote: Aton winhaj Serabías, winhaj Hasabías yet' lajunhwanhxo heb' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix wechtan juntzanh silab' ix ak'chaj yuj sb'ochajxi stemplo ko Diosal, ix in pukanb'at t'a lajchawanh heb' winh sakerdote ix in sik'el chi'. Ha juntzanh silab' chi', ay k'een plata, k'een oro yet' juntzanh yamk'ab' ix yak' winh rey yet' heb' tz'ak'an srazón winh yet' heb' ay yopisio yet' winh yet' pax tastak ix yak' heb' quetisraelal ayek' ta'. Ha t'a smasanil, ay 500 quintal k'een plata. Yed' juntzanhxo yamk'ab' nab'a plata, 75 quintal yalil yet' 75 quintal k'een oro yet' pax 20 uk'ab' oro, 17 libra yalil yet' chab'xo yamk'ab' bronke te wach' yaj sb'oi, lajan stojol icha yamk'ab' oro.

Ixlajwi chi', ix walan t'a heb' winh icha tik: Ha ex tik sik'b'il exxo el yikok Jehová yet' juntzanh k'een oro, k'een plata yet' masanil yamk'ab' ix siaj t'a Jehová ko Diosal yet' heb' ko mam quicham.

Tze tanhwej wal k'een masanto ol echtaj k'een t'a yoltak skuartoal templo t'a Jerusalén t'a yichanh heb' yajalil heb' sakerdote yet' heb' lewita yet' heb' yajal yaj t'a skal heb' quetisraelal, xin chi t'a heb' winh.

Yuj chi' a heb' winh sakerdote yet' heb' winh lewita chi', ix schaan masanil k'een silab' heb' winh yet' juntzanh yamk'ab' ix echtaj chi' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' winh yik syik'anb'at heb' winh t'a skajnub' ko Diosal t'a Jerusalén.
Ayic slajchawil k'ual t'a b'ab'el uj, ix onh el t'a sti' ha' Ahawa chi', ix onh kot t'a Jerusalén tik. Ha ko Diosal ix onh kolan t'a heb' ajk'ool yet' t'a heb' elk'um t'a yoltak b'e.
Ayic ix onh jawi t'a Jerusalén tik, oxe' k'ual ix quik' quip.

Axo t'a schanhil k'ual jun, ix onh b'at t'a skajnub' ko Diosal yik tz'echtaj k'een plata yet' k'een oro yet' jantak yamk'ab' yik skajnub' ko Diosal chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix ak'chaj t'a winh sakerdote skuchan Meremot yuninal winhaj Urías. Aypaxek' winhaj Eleazar yuninal winhaj Finees yet' winh yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh lewita, aton winhaj Jozabad yuninal winhaj Jesúa yet' winhaj Noadías yuninal winhaj Binúi.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ix echtaj k'een, ix b'ischajpax k'een smasanil, tz'akan yaj k'een. Icha chi' ix aj stz'ib'chajkan k'een smasanil.

Ixlajwi chi', masanil heb' ix jax t'a Babilonia, ix yak'an nok' silab' heb' stz'a smasanil t'a ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik. Ix ak'chaj lajchawanh nok' kelemtak wakax kuuj ko masanil, 96 nok' ch'ak kalnel yet' 77 nok' kelemtak kalnel. Ix ak'chaj pax lajchawanh nok' mam chiwa silab'il yik tz'ak'ji tup mul. Masanil juntzanh chi' ix nhusjitz'ha t'a yichanh Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi', ix ak'chaj b'aj tz'ib'ab'il scheknab'il winh rey t'a heb' ayoch yajalil t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'ha ha' Éufrates, yuj chi' a heb' ix kolwaj qued'ok t'a munlajel t'a stemplo ko Diosal.

Ayic ix lajwi juntzanh chi', ix jawi jaywanh heb' yajal yaj t'a skal heb' quetchonhab' t'ayin, ix yalan heb' icha tik: Tzijtum heb' quetisraelal yet' heb' sakerdote yet' pax heb' lewita max yik'el-laj sb'ha t'a skal heb' ch'ok chonhab'il kajan t'a ko chonhab' tik, palta a schuk b'eyb'al heb' kananeo, heb' heteo, heb' ferezeo, heb' jebuseo, heb' amonita, heb' moabita, heb' egipkio yet' heb' amorreo, a chi' sb'eyb'alej heb'.

Ha heb' chi' yet' heb' yuninal heb', wan yik'lan sb'a heb' yet' heb' ix yisil heb' ch'ok chonhab'il chi'. Yuj chi' a schonhab' Dios toxo ix somchaj yet' juntzanh anima chi'. Ha wal heb' b'ab'el ix yak'och smul tik, aton heb' yajal yaj t'a ko kal, xchi heb' t'ayin.
Ayic ix wab'an jun chi', ix in nhik'chitanb'at in pichul. Ix in tzukanel xil in jolom yet' xil in ti' yuj kusk'olal. Ix in em k'ojan, manhxo animaok in aj ix wab'i.

Masanil heb' xiw yuj yowal sk'ol ko Diosal yuj smul heb' quetisraelal, heb' janakxi t'a Babilonia, ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' wed'ok. k'ojan innhej emi, manhxo in animaok swab'i, masanto t'a yorail tz'ak'ji silab' t'a yemk'ualil.
Ha wal t'a jun rato chi', ix in k'e waan b'aj k'ojaninem chi', nhik'chimtak in pichul chi'. Ix in em kuman in lesalwi. Ix wik'ank'e in k'ab' t'a yichanh Jehová in Diosal.

Ix walan icha tik: Ach in Diosal, tzin te q'uixwi t'ayach. Tzin somchaj chaanh. Maxtzac nachaj wuuj tas swutej walan in b'a t'ayach, yujto ix te ek' yib'anh ko chukal. Ha ko mul chi' ix k'ek'och t'a satcha’anh.

Atax t'a stiempoal heb' ko mam quicham, masanto tiknaik, te ayonnhej och ko k'ulan chukal. Yuj ko chukal ix onh ak'jioch yet' heb' ko reyal yet' heb' sakerdote t'a yol sk'ab' heb' sreyal juntzanhxo nakión. Ix onh miljichamok. Ix onh ik'jib'at t'a ch'ok chonhab'il. Ix elk'ajb'at tastak ay t'ayonh, te q'uixwelal ix onh ajkani, icha wal kaj tiknaik.

Palta tiknaik jun, ach Jehová ko Diosal, yuj a wach'k'olal, ix onh a kol jaywanh onh ayonhek' tik. Yuj chi' syal ko kajnajxi t'a sat lum lum to ik yaj tik. Ha ach ix ak'xi ko tzalajk'olal, ix ak'anpax ko junk'olal b'aj chekab' kaji.

Wach'chom chekab' kaji, palta maj onh aktejkanlaj. Ix a ch'ox a wach'k'olal t'ayonh t'a yichanh heb' sreyal Persia. Ix ak' ko k 'inal yik ix ko b'oanxik'e a kajnub' tik, yujto jub'ilemi. Ha ach tzonh a tanhwej t'a Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén tik.
Axo tiknaik, ach ko Diosal, ¿tas wal wach' kalan t'ayach, yujto toxo ix och ko mul? Maj ko k'anab'ajej a cheknab'il,

aton a cheknak yal heb' a chekab', heb' tzach ak'an serwil. Ha ach tik alnak t'ayonh to junelnhej te chuk sb'eyb'al juntzanh anima kajan t'a lum lum ol ak' quiquej, manh jantakok chukal sk'ulej heb' t'a yol smakb'en.

Alannacpaxi to max yal-laj kak'an yik'laj sb'a heb' ix quisil yet' heb' yuninal heb'. Max yalpax yik'lan sb'a heb' kuninal yet' heb' ix yisil heb', max yalpax ko kolwaj t'a heb'. Alannakkani tato max ko k'ulej juntzanh chi', wach' ol aj yelk'och ko chonhab' tik, ol kak'an tzalajb'ok ko k'ool yuj a wach'k'olal, yik wach' skak'kan lum lum tik smakb'enok heb' quinhtilal t'a junelnhej.

Ha wal yuj ko chukal ix och t'ayach, yuj chi' ix jawi juntzanh yaelal tik t'a quib'anh, palta a ach tik, ach ko Diosal, maj ak'och ko yaelal icha tas smoj ko chaani, quennhej yaelal chi' ix jawi t'a quib'anh. Palta ix el wal t'a a k'ool to pitzan jaywanhonhxo tik.
Tato te chuk skutejxi ko b'a t'ayach, tato squik'laj ko b'a yet' juntzanh ch'ok animail te chuk sb'eyb'al chi', ol am te kot owal t'ayonh, ol onh a sataneli, masanto manhxa junok onh ol onh kanok.

Mamin Jehová, ko Diosal ach a onh israel onh tik, te tojolnhej tzutej a b'a t'ayonh, yuj chi' ix to onh kan jaywanhonhxo tik. Palta ina jantak ko mul ix ochxi t'ayach, yuj chi' maxtzak ko tek'b'ej ko b'a koch t'a ichanh, xin chi t'a Jehová.

Yakb'an wan slesalwi winhaj Esdras chi', wan yok' winh syalank'eta smul heb' yetisraelal winh, kumanem winh t'a yichanh skajnub' Dios. Yakb'an chi', ix och oyan jun nhilanh heb' yetisraelal winh t'a spatik, heb' winh winak, heb' ix ix yet' heb' unin. Ix te ok' wal heb' yet' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', haxo winhaj Sekanías yuninal winhaj Jehiel t'a yinhtilal winhaj Elam, ix alan t'a winhaj Esdras chi' icha tik: Ha onh tik maj ko k'anab'ajej ko Diosal, yujto ix quik'laj ko b'a yet' heb' ix ix ch'ok chonhab'il, palta jun, ayto wal sb'onab'il jun tik t'ayonh.
Ha tiknaik, skak' ko ti', ol ko chek pax heb' ix ch'ok chonhab'il chi' yet' yune'. Ol ko k'anab'ajan tas tzal chi' yet' tas syal heb' sk'anab'ajan scheknab'il Dios ed'ok, icha yalan cheknab'il chi'.
Yuj chi' k'eanh waan, yujto a ach tik syal a b'oan yaj jun tik. Ol onh kolwaj ed'ok. Tek'b'ej a b'a a b'oan jun munlajel tik, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix k'e linhan winhaj Esdras chi', ix schekan winh yak' sti' heb' yajalil heb' sakerdote, heb' lewita yet' juntzanhxo heb' yetisraelal heb' yik sk'anab'ajej heb' icha ix aj yak'an sti' chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix el winhaj Esdras chi' t'a yichanh skajnub' Dios chi', ix b'at winh t'a skuarto winhaj Johanán yuninal winhaj Eliasib. Ata' ix ek' ak'wal yuj winh. Malaj jab'ok tas ix swa winh, malaj pax tas ix yuk'ej winh, yujto ix te kus sk'ol winh yuj smul heb' ix jax t'a Babilonia chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix alchaji to a masanil heb' ay t'a Jerusalén yet' heb' ay t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá, aton heb' jaxnak chi', to smolb'ej sb'a heb' t'a Jerusalén chi'.

Ix smol alan heb' winh yajal yet' heb' winh ichamtak winak to t'a schab'jial sk'och heb' anima chi', ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: Tato ay heb' max jawi t'a sk'ual chi', tz'ik'jiek' masanil tastak ay t'a heb', spechjiel heb' t'a skal heb' yetchonhab' chi', xchi heb' winh.

Yuj chi', haxo t'a jun k'u chi', aton t'a 20 yoch sb'alunhil uj, ix smolb'an sb'a masanil heb' winh ay yopisio yik Judá yet' yik Benjamín t'a Jerusalén chi'. Ix em k'ojan heb' smasanil t'a yamaq'uil skajnub' Dios. Ste ib'xi heb' yuj tas wan yalchaj chi' yet' pax yuj jun nhab' ow yemi.

Ixlajwi chi', ix k'e linhan winhaj sakerdote Esdras chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' icha tik: --Ha ex tik ix och he mul yujto ix eyik'laj he b'a yet' heb' ix ix ch'ok chonhab'il. Icha chi' ix aj swach' och ko mul.

Ha tiknaik, alekk'eta he mul t'a yichanh Jehová sDiosal heb' ko mam quicham, k'anab'ajejek tas snib'ej. Ik'equel he b'ha t'a skal heb' anima ch'ok chonhab'il chi', tzeyaktanpaxkan heb' ix ix, ix eyik'laj he b'a yet'ok t'a skal heb' chi', xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi heb' anima chi' smasanil, te chaanh ix yal heb' icha tik: --Ol ko k'anab'ajej icha tzal chi'.
Palta ina max ek'laj nhab' tik, max yal-laj ko kan t'a kalle tik, yujto a jun tik, manh jun chab'nhejok k'ual ol yak' sb'oi, yujto te niwan onh ix och ko mul tik.

Wach' tato anhej heb' yajal skan t'a tik yik sb'oan yaji, haxo masanil heb' kajan t'a yoltak ko chonhab', heb' ix yik'laj sb'a yet' heb' ix ch'ok chonhab'il chi', syal sjawi heb' t'a junok k'u to skan sk'ual. Aokab' heb' juez yet' heb' yichamtak winaquil chonhab' tz'ik'ankot heb'. Icha chi' ol ko k'ulej ko masanil, masanto ol yal stup yowal sk'ol ko Diosal t'a quib'anh yuj tas ix ko k'ulej tik, xchi heb'.

Masanil heb' ix jax t'a Babilonia chi', ix scha sk'ol heb' tas ix alchaj chi', palta anhej winhaj Jonatán yuninal winhaj Asael yet' winhaj Jahazías yuninal winhaj Ticwa yet' chawanh heb' winh lewita, aton winhaj Mesulam yet' winhaj Sabetai maj chaan sk'ool. Yuj chi' a winhaj sakerdote Esdras chi', ix yak'och juntzanh heb' winh yajal winh, aton heb' winh yajal t'a skal heb' yinhtilal. Ix tz'ib'chajkan sb'i heb' winh. Axo t'a b'ab'el k'ual yik slajunhil uj, ix smolb'an sb'a heb', yik sch'olb'itan junjun makan heb'.
Axo t'a b'ab'el k'u yik b'ab'el uj, ata' ix lajwi sch'olb'itaj masanil heb' ix yik'laj sb'a yet' heb' ix ix ch'ok chonhab'il chi'.

Aton sb'i heb' winh ix yik'laj sb'a yet' heb' ix ch'ok chonhab'il chi': Ha t'a yinhtilal heb' sakerdote yet' t'a heb' sk'ab'yok winhaj Jesúa yuninal winhaj Josadac: Aton winhaj Maasías, winhaj Eliezer, winhaj Jarib yet' winhaj Gedalías.
Ha heb' winh ix yak' wal sti' schekan pax heb' ix ix chi'. Ix yak' junjun nok' ch'ak kalnel heb' winh silab'il d'ha Dios yuj smul.
Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Imer: Aton winhaj Hanani yet' winhaj Zebadías.
D'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Harim: Aton winhaj Maasías, winhaj Elías, winhaj Semaías, winhaj Jehiel yet' winhaj Uzías.
D'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Pasur: Aton winhaj Elioenai, winhaj Maasías, winhaj Ismael, winhaj Natanael, winhaj Jozabad yet' winhaj Elasa.
Axo t'a heb' yinhtilal heb' lewita: Aton winhaj Jozabad, winhaj Simei, winhaj Kelaía, (skuchan pax Kelita) winhaj Petaías, winhaj Judá yet' winhaj Eliezer.
Axo t'a skal heb' sb'itani: Aton winhaj Eliasib. Axo t'a skal heb' tanhwum puerta: Aton winhaj Salum, winhaj Telem yet' winhaj Uri.
Axo t'a skal juntzanhxo heb' quetisraelal, t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Paros: Aton winhaj Ramía, winhaj Jezías, winhaj Malquías, winhaj Mijamín, winhaj Eleazar, winhaj Malquías yet' winhaj Benaía.
Axo t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Elam: Aton winhaj Matanías, winhaj Zacarías, winhaj Jehiel, winhaj Abdi, winhaj Jeremot yet' winhaj Elías.
Axo t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Zatu: Aton winhaj Elioenai, winhaj Eliasib, winhaj Matanías, winhaj Jeremot, winhaj Zabad yet' winhaj Aziza.
Axo t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Bebai: Aton winhaj Johanán, winhaj Hananías, winhaj Zabai yet' winhaj Atlai.
Axo t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Bani: Aton winhaj Mesulam, winhaj Maluc, winhaj Adaía, winhaj Jasub, winhaj Seal yet' winhaj Ramot.
Axo t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Pahat-moab: Aton winhaj Adna, winhaj Quelal, winhaj Benaía, winhaj Maasías, winhaj Matanías, winhaj Bezaleel, winhaj Binúi yet' winhaj Manasés.
Axo t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Harim: Aton winhaj Eliezer, winhaj Isías, winhaj Malquías, winhaj Semaías, winhaj Simeón,
winhaj Benjamín, winhaj Maluc yet' winhaj Semarías.
Axo t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Hasum: Aton winhaj Matenai, winhaj Matata, winhaj Zabad, winhaj Elifelet, winhaj Jeremai, winhaj Manasés yet' winhaj Simei.

Axo t'a yinhtilal winhaj Bani: Aton winhaj Madai, winhaj Amram, winhaj Uel, winhaj Benaía, winhaj Bedías, winhaj Quelúhi, winhaj Vanías, winhaj Meremot, winhaj Eliasib, winhaj Matanías, winhaj Matenai, winhaj Jaasai.

Axo t'a yinhtilal winhaj Binúi: Aton winhaj Simei, winhaj Selemías, winhaj Natán, winhaj Adaía, winhaj Macnadebai, winhaj Sasai, winhaj Sarai, winhaj Azareel, winhaj Selemías, winhaj Semarías, winhaj Salum, winhaj Amarías yet' winhaj José.
Axo t'a yinhtilal winhaj Nebo: Aton winhaj Jeiel, winhaj Matatías, winhaj Zabad, winhaj Zebina, winhaj Jadau, winhaj Joel yet' winhaj Benaía.
Masanil juntzanh heb' winh tik, ix yik'laj sb'a heb' winh yet' heb' ix ix ch'ok chonhab'il. Ay heb' winh ayxo yuninal yet' heb' ix.
Aton wab'ixal a in Nehemías in tik, yuninal in winhaj Hacalías. Ayic 20 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Artajerjes reyal, t'a jun uj skuchan Quisleu, ayinek' t'a Susa skapitalil Persia.
Ata' ix k'och winh wuk'tak skuchan Hanani yet' juntzanhxo heb' ix kot yet' winh t'a Judá. Ix in k'anb'an t'a heb' tas yaj Jerusalén yet' heb' yinhtilal heb' anima ik'b'ilkot t'a Babilonia.
Ix yalan heb' t'ayin: Ha heb' quetchonhab' chi' ayek' heb' t'a Judá, te kusk'olal yajek' heb', te q'uixweltak yajek' heb'. Axo Jerusalén chi' mak'b'ilem smuroal, tz'anakpaxb'at spuertail, xchi heb'.
Ayic ix wab'an juntzanh chi', ix in em k'ojan, ix in oq'ui. Ix in te kus wal jaye' k'ual. Ix in och t'a tzek'ojk'olal, ix in lesalwi t'a sDiosal satcha’anh.
Ix walan icha tik: Mamin Jehová sDiosal satcha’anh, te niwan elk'ochi, te ay a may, tzak'elk'och a trato yet' heb' tzach xajanani, heb' sk'anab'ajan a cheknab'il.

Tzin k'an t'ayach to tza cha ab' in lesal a in a chekab' in tik. D'a junjun k'u yet' t'a junjun ak'wal tzin tewi t'ayach kuuj a onh a chonhab' onh tik, a chekab' kaji. Swalk'eta ko mul t'ayach. Ha onh tik yet' heb' ko mam quicham, ix och ko mul t'ayach.
Te chuk ix kutej ko b'a t'ayach. Maj ko k'anab'ajej a cheknab'il, a k'ayb'ub'al yet' tas a chek yalnakkan winh a chekab' aj Moisés t'ayonh.
Nacot tas alnak t'a winh a chekab' chi': Tato manh ol he k'anab'ajej tas ix wala', ol ex in saklemejkanb'at t'a skaltak juntzanhxo ch'ok chonhab'il.

Palta tato ol ex meltzajxok t'ayin jun, ol he k'anab'ajan in cheknab'il, tze b'eyb'alani, wach'chom sakleminak eyajkanb'at b'aj slajwik'och yol yib'anhk’inal tik, ol ex in molb'ejxikot t'a jun lugar to sik'b'ilel wuuj, b'aj tz'och ejmelal t'ayin, xa chi.
Ha onh a chekab' onh tik, a chonhab' onh paxi, ix onh a kol yet' a poder.

Mamin, tzin k'an t'ayach to tza cha ab' in lesal a in a chekab' in tik yet' tas sk'an juntzanhxo heb' a chekab' to sko nib'ej tzach quik'chaanh. Tzin k'an t'ayach to tzak' a wach'k'olal t'ayin, yik wach' scha yab' winh rey tas ol wala', xin chi. Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi' ayin och sb'akhumalok swino winhaj rey Artajerjes chi'.
Ay jun k'u t'a yol uj Nisán, ayik 20 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Artajerjes reyal, ayik wan wak'an swino winh rey chi', ix yilan winh to kuseltak yilji in sat. Malaj b'aj icha chi' wiljitaxoni.
Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'an winh t'ayin: --¿Tas yuj kuseltak yilji a sat? Ina manh ach penaokay swila'. Ichato ilk'olal aji, xchi winh rey chi'. Ha wal t'a jun rato chi', ix in xiwk'ei,

ix walan t'a winh icha tik: --Mamin rey, ayokab' achnhej eq'ui. ¿Tas yuj manh kuseltakok yilji in sat a naani, ina to a in chonhab' b'aj mukan heb' in mam wicham, emnak lanhnajok, tz'anakpaxb'at spuertail? xin chi t'a winh.
--¿Tas swutej in kolwaj t'ayach tiknaik jun? xchi winh rey chi'. Yuj chi' ix in lesalwi t'a sDiosal satcha’anh.

Ix walan t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: --Tato scha a k'ol mamin rey, tato wach' in t'a yol a sat, tzin k'an t'ayach to tzin a chab'at t'a Judá chi', b'aj mukan heb' in mam wicham, yik sb'at in b'oanxik'ei, xin chi t'a winh.

k'ojanem winh rey chi', k'ojanpaxem ix reina t'a stz'ey winh. Ix yalan winh t'ayin icha tik: --¿Jantac tiempo tzach b'at jun? ¿B'aq'uinh tzach jaxi? xchi winh. Ix walani jantak tiempo, ix schaan sk'ol winh tas ix wal chi'.

Ix walanpax t'a winh icha tik: Tato wach' tz'aj tza na' mamin rey, ak'b'at junok karta t'a heb' winh gobernador ay t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'ha ha' Éufrates, yik wach' tzin schaek' heb' winh ta' masanto tzin k'och t'a Judá.

Sb'at junokxo karta chi' t'a winhaj Asaf yilumal te' niwak te' ay ta', yik syak' te' winh t'ayin, yik tz'och te' t'a spuertail b'aj ay heb' stanhwan templo, t'a smuroal chonhab' chi' yet' t'a te' pat b'aj ol in ajok, xin chi t'a winh. Yuj swach'k'olal in Diosal, ix yak' masanil juntzanh tik winh rey chi' t'ayin.

Ayic ix in jawi t'a heb' winh ayoch yajalil t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'ha ha' Éufrates chi', ix wak'an jun karta ix yak'kot winh rey chi' t'a heb' winh. Ajun pax juntzanh heb' winh yajal heb' soldado yet' heb' ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej ix yak'kot winh rey chi' wed'ok.
Palta haxo ix yab'an winhaj Sanbalat aj Horón yet' winhaj Tobías yajal yaj t'a Amón to ix in jawi yik tzin kolwaj yet' heb' wetisraelal, ix kot yowal heb' winh.
Ayic yoxilxo k'ual in jawi t'a Jerusalén,

in k'e waan t'ak'walil yet' jaywanh heb' winh winak ajun wed'ok, palta malaj junok mach b'aj ix wala' tas ix yal Dios t'a in pensar yuj tas ol in k'ulej t'a Jerusalén chi'. Malaj nok' chej ix quik'b'ati, a innhej ix wik' nok' in kuchumal.

Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi', onh elta t'a jun puerta t'a panhan, t'a stojolal sjaj ha' Dragón, onh ek' t'a spuertail b'aj sb'atkan k'alem. Ix wilan smuroal Jerusalén chi', mak'b'ilem lanhnajok, tz'anakpaxb'at spuertail.
Ix ek' wilanpax jun puerta t'a sjaj ha ha' yet' pax stanque winh rey. Majxo yal-laj wek' yet' nok' in chej chi' ta'.
Anheja' k'ik'to in k'ek'och t'a sti' ha' Cedrón. Ayic ix lajwi wilan muro chi', in meltzajxi b'aj in b'at chi', in ochxi t'a jun puerta t'a panhan chi'.

Ha heb' yajal yaj t'a chonhab' chi', manh yojtakok heb' b'ajtil ayinb'ati, manh yojtakok pax heb' tas tzin k'ulej. Malaj pax tas swal t'a heb' wetisraelal, t'a heb' sakerdote, t'a heb' yajal yaji yet' t'a heb' ol munlajok.

Ixlajwi chi' ix walan t'a heb' icha tik: --Ha ex tik eyojtak sik'lab'il to a jun pekti’ b'aj ayonh ek' tik te chuklaj, ina ix mak'chajem lanhnaj chonhab' Jerusalén tik, tz'anakxopaxb'at spuertail. Yuj chi' ko molb'ejek ko b'a sko b'oanekxik'e smuroal tik, yik wach' maxtzak onh b'uchji, xin chi t'a heb'.

Ayic ix walan t'a heb' jantak swach'k'olal Dios ix sch'ox t'ayin yet' tas ix yal winh rey t'ayin, ix yalan heb': --Co yamekoch ko munlaji, xchi heb'. Icha chi' ix aj skuchb'an sb'a heb' t'a jun munlajel chi'.

Ayic ix yab'an winhaj Sanbalat aj Horón yet' winhaj Tobías yajal yaj t'a Amón yet' pax winhaj Gesem árabe, ix te b'uchwaj heb' winh t'ayonh, ix yalan heb' winh: --¿Tas ol he k'ulej? ¿Tom tze nib'ej tzeyik'el he b'ha t'a yol sk'ab' winh rey? xchi heb' winh.

Ix in tak'wi t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Yuj skolwal sDiosal satcha’anh, ol yal kuuj. Ha onh schekab' onh tik ol ko yamoch ko b'oani, palta a ex tik, malaj eyalan eyik t'ayonh, malaj eyopisio, yujto manh ex quetchonhab'ok, xin chi.

Ha winhaj sat sakerdote Eliasib yet' heb' yetsakerdoteal, a heb' ix b'oanxi b'aj tz'och nok' kalnel, ix yak'anoch spuertail heb'. Ix sb'oanxik'e muro heb', ix b'atnhej t'a torre skuch Hamea masanto t'a torre skuch Hananeel, ix yak'ankanoch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' Dios.
Axo junxo makan muro chi', a heb' winh aj Jericó ix b'oanxik'ei. Axo junxo makan, a winhaj Zacur yuninal winhaj Imri ix b'oanxik'ei.
Axo heb' yinhtilal winhaj Senaa ix b'oanxik'e b'aj ay spuertail yik nok' chay. Ix yak'anoch sjolom spuertail chi' heb', ix ochkan spuertail chi', ix ek'kan k'atan k'een hierro syamnub'ok.

Ix b'onhejb'at jun muro chi', a winhaj Meremot yuninal winhaj Urías yixchiquin winhaj Cos ix b'oanxik'e junxo makan. Axo winhaj Mesulam yuninal winhaj Berequías, yixchiquin winhaj Mesezabeel ix b'oanxik'e junxo makan. Axo winhaj Sadoc yuninal winhaj Baana ix b'oanxi junxo makan.
Axo junxo makan a heb' aj Tecoa ix b'oanxik'ei, palta a heb' niwak winak yaj t'a skal heb', maj yal sk'ol heb' ix kolwaj yet' heb' skuchb'an jun munlajel chi'.

Ha winhaj Joiada yuninal winhaj Paseah yet' winhaj Mesulam yuninal winhaj Besodías, a heb' winh ix b'oanxik'e b'aj ay jun puerta skuchan Jesana. Ix yak'anoch sjolom spuertail chi' heb' winh, ix ochpaxkan spuertail chi', ix ek'kan k'atan k'een hierro syamnub'ok.

Axo junxo makan, a winhaj Melatías aj Gabaón ix b'oanxik'e yet' winhaj Jadón aj Meronot yet' heb' aj Gabaón yet' heb' aj Mizpa, aton heb' ay t'a yalanh smandar winh yajal yaj t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'ha ha' Éufrates.

Axo junxo makan, a winhaj Uziel yuninal winhaj Harhaía, winh smunlaj yet' k'een k'een wach' yilji, a winh ix b'oanxik'ei. Axo junxo makan, a winhaj Hananías yuninal jun winh b'oum perfume ix b'oanxik'ei. Ha heb' winh chawanh chi' ix b'oanxik'e muro chi' masanto ix k'och t'a sti' jun muro lewan sat.
Axo junxo makan a winhaj Refaías yuninal winhaj Hur ix b'oanxik'ei. Ha winh chi' yajal yaj winh t'a nanhal lugar t'a yol smakb'en Jerusalén.
Ha winhaj Jedaías yuninal winhaj Harumaf ix b'oanxik'e junxo makan t'a yichanh spat. Axo junxo makan, a winhaj Hatús yuninal winhaj Hasabnías ix b'oanxik'ei.
Ha junxo makan, a winhaj Malquías yuninal winhaj Harim yet' winhaj Hasub yuninal winhaj Pahat-moab, a heb' winh ix b'oanxik'e yet' jun torre skuch Hornos.
Axo junxo makan, a winhaj Salum yuninal winhaj Halohes ix b'oanxik'ei. Ha winh chi' yajal yaj winh t'a nanhalxo lugar ayoch t'a yol smakb'en Jerusalén. Ix kolwajpax heb' ix yisil winh yet'ok.

Ha winhaj Hanún yet' heb' kajan t'a Zanoa ix b'oanxik'e b'aj ix kan sti' t'a ch'olan. Ix yak'anoch spuertail heb', ix ek'kan k'atan k'een hierro syamnub'ok. Ix sb'oanxik'e 450 metro muro chi' heb', masanto t'a spuertail b'aj sb'atkan k'alem.

Axo winhaj Malquías yuninal winhaj Recab yajal t'a yol smakb'en chonhab' Bet-haquerem, a winh ix b'oanxik'e b'aj ix kan sti' b'aj sb'atkan k'alem chi'. Ix yak'anoch spuertail winh, ix ek'kan k'atan k'een hierro syamnub'ok.

Ha winhaj Salum yuninal winhaj Colhoze, yajal t'a yol smakb'en chonhab' Mizpa, a winh ix b'oanxik'e b'aj ix kan sti' t'a sjaj ha ha'. Ix yak'k'e spatil winh, ix yak'anoch spuertail chi' winh, ix ek'paxkan k'atan k'een hierro syamnub'ok. Ix sb'oanxik'e muro chi' winh b'aj ay tanque skuch Siloé t'a slak'anil yawb'en te' heb' rey, masanto b'aj b'akhquiltak yem sb'eal schonhab' winhaj Dawid.

Ha winhaj Nehemías yuninal winhaj Azbuc, yajal t'a nanhal yol smakb'en chonhab' Bet-sur, a winh ix b'oanxik'e junxo makan muro chi'. Ix kotnhej t'a yichanh b'aj mukb'il winhaj rey Dawid masanto ix k'och b'aj ay stanqueal ha ha', ix k'och b'aj ay skuartel heb' soldado.

Axo heb' lewita skuchb'ej winhaj Rehum yuninal winhaj Bani, a heb' ix b'oanxik'e junxo makan. Axo t'a yichanhb'ati, a winhaj Hasabías yajal t'a nanhal smakb'en chonhab' Keila, a winh ix b'oanxik'e junxo makan sk'exulok heb' yetchonhab'.
Axo b'aj ix k'och yik heb' chi', ata' ix sb'oxik'e juntzanhxo heb' sk'ab'yok heb'. Ha winhaj Bawai yuninal winhaj Henadad, yajal t'a nanhalxo smakb'en Keila chi', a winh skuchb'an heb'.
Axo winhaj Ezer yuninal winhaj Jesúa, yajal t'a Mizpa, a winh ix b'oanxik'e jun makanhxo t'a yichanh b'aj smolchaj yamk'ab' yik owal b'aj skumlaj muro chi'.
Axo winhaj Baruc yuninal winhaj Zabai, t'a smasanil sk'ool winh ix sb'oxik'e junxo makan b'aj skumlaj chi' masanto ix k'och t'a spuertail spat winhaj Eliasib, winh sat sakerdote.
Ha winhaj Meremot yuninal winhaj Urías, yixchiquin winhaj Cos, a winh ix b'oanxik'e junxo makan sb'at t'a spuertail spat winhaj Eliasib chi' masanto b'aj slajwik'och spat winh chi'.
Axo junxo makan, a heb' sakerdote kajan t'a sch'olanil ha' Jordán ix b'oanxik'ei.

Axo winhaj Benjamín yet' winhaj Hasub, a heb' winh ix b'oanxib'at t'a yichanh spat. Axo t'a snhi' yik heb' winh chi', haxo winhaj Azarías yuninal winhaj Maasías yixchiquin winhaj Ananías, a winh ix b'oanxik'e t'a slak'anil spat.
Axo junxo makan, a winhaj Binúi yuninal winhaj Henadad, a winh ix b'oanxik'ei, ix b'at t'a spat winhaj Azarías masanto ix k'och b'aj skumlaj t'a jun schiquin.

Axo winhaj Palal yuninal winhaj Uzai, a winh ix b'oanxik'e b'aj skumlaj chi' yet' jun torre ayel t'a spatik muro chi' t'a spalakio winh rey, aton t'a yamaq'uil spat heb' soldado stanhwan winh rey chi'. Axo junxo makan, a winhaj Pedaías yuninal winhaj Faros ix b'oanxik'ei,

masanto ix k'och t'a spuertail b'aj tz'el heb' ix ix ik'oj ha', jun sb'atkan t'a stojolal b'aj sk'eul k'u, t'a slak'anil jun torre ayel t'a spatik muro chi'. Axo junxo makan, a heb' smunlaj t'a templo kajan t'a Ofel, a heb' ix b'oanxik'ei.
Axo heb' aj Tecoa ix b'oanxik'e junxo makan, sb'atnhej t'a yichanh jun torre chi' masanto t'a smuroal t'a Ofel chi'.
Axo heb' sakerdote ix b'oanxik'e t'a yichanh spat junjun, sb'atnhej t'a spuertail b'aj tz'och nok' chej.

Axo winhaj Sadoc yuninal winhaj Imer ix b'oanxik'e junxo makan t'a yichanh spat. Axo winhaj Semaías yuninal winhaj Sekanías ix b'oanxik'e junxo makan b'aj ay heb' stanhwan puerta t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u.

Axo winhaj Hananías yuninal winhaj Selemías yet' winhaj Hanún swaquil yuninal winhaj Salaf, a heb' winh ix b'oanxik'e junxo makan. Axo winhaj Mesulam yuninal winhaj Berequías ix b'oanxik'e jun makan t'a yichanh spat.

Axo winhaj Malquías, winh b'oum k'een wach' yilji, a winh ix b'oanxik'e junxo makan t'a spat heb' smunlaj t'a templo yet' t'a yik heb' chonhwajum yet' t'a yichanh spuertail b'aj ay heb' stanhwan chonhab' chi', masanto b'aj ay heb' stanhwan t'a schiquin muro chi'.

Axo juntzanhxo heb' winh b'oum k'een wach' yilji yet' heb' winh chonhwajum, a heb' winh ix b'oanxik'e junxo makan, sb'atnhej b'aj ay heb' stanhwan t'a schiquin chi', masanto ix k'och b'aj ay spuertail yik nok' kalnel.
Ayic ix yab'an winhaj Sanbalat to wan ko b'oanxik'e muro chi', ix te kot yowal winh, ix syamanoch winh sb'uchwaj t'ayonh.

Ix och ijan winh yalan b'uchwal lolonel t'ayonh t'a yichanh heb' winh ajun yet'ok yet' t'a yichanh heb' winh soldado aj Samaria. Ix yalan winh icha tik: Ob'iltak juntzanh heb' judío tik, ¿tom ay jab'ok tas syal sb'oan heb'? ¿Tom ol yak'xi silab' heb' snaani? ¿Tom junnhej k'ual ol sb'o jun munlajel tik heb' snaani? ¿Am snaan heb' to ha t'a skal juntzanh tz'aeltak k'een juyanek' tik ol yik'elta k'een ak' k'een heb'? xchi winh.

Ayek' pax winhaj Tobías amonita t'a stz'ey heb' winh. Ix yalanpax winh icha tik: Ha juntzanh k'een sb'ok'e heb' muroal tik, q'uinalok a junok nok' waax tzek' t'a yib'anh k'een, tz'el nhilnaj k'een stek'an nok', xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix in lesalwi icha tik: Mamin, ach ko Diosal, tzab' wal onh sb'uchan heb'. Kotokab'kan sb'uchwal lolonel heb' chi' t'a yib'anh. Aokab' heb' yajk'ol heb' tz'ik'anek' tastak ay t'ay. Ik'jokab'b'at heb' t'a junokxo nakión.
Manh ak' niwank'olal smul heb' tik, mokab' b'at tas ix sk'ulej heb' tik satk'olal uuj, yujto tzonh sb'uchwal heb' a onh sko b'oxik'e muro tik, xin chi.
Ix onh munlajnhej, elanhchamel ix nanhalb'i kuuj yujto te ay wal stzalajk'olal heb' chonhab' smunlaji.

Ha winhaj Sanbalat, winhaj Tobías, heb' árabe, heb' amonita yet' heb' aj Asdod, ix te kot yowal heb' ayik ix yab'an heb' to yelk'olal tzonh munlaji yik sko b'oanxik'e smuroal Jerusalén. Toxo pax ix makchaj b'aj niwak ix aj spojemi.
Smol alan heb' to syak' owal heb' qued'ok, yik syak'an chukal heb' t'a Jerusalén tik yalani.
Yuj chi' ix onh lesalwi t'a ko Diosal, ix kak'anoch ko tanhwumal t'a junjun k'u yet' t'a junjun ak'wal yik sko kolan ko b'ha t'a heb' ajk'ol chi'.

Ix yalanpax heb' smunlaj chi' icha tik: Toxo ix te el yip heb' kuchum k'een yik syik'anel jantak k'een k'een heb' yet' spojelal jun muro telwinak tik, yuj chi' manh ol techajlaj kuuj ko b'oanxik'ei, xchi heb'.
Ha snaan heb' ajk'ol chi' to manh ol nachajel kuuj, mato manh ol quil yoch heb' t'a ko kal yik tzonh smilancham heb' yik tz'och waan munlajel tik.
Palta haxo heb' quetchonhab' kajan t'a slak'anil heb' chi', xikan sjawi heb' ul yal t'ayonh: Ha juntzanh anima chi' yalnhej b'aj ol jawok heb' yak' owal qued'ok, xchi heb'.
Yuj chi' ix wala' to junjun patil heb' stanhwej heb' t'a spatiquel muro chi', b'aj ch'olquixtak lu'um yet' b'aj pojnaquel muro chi', yet'nak yespada heb', lanza yet' sjul-lab' heb'.

Ayic ix wilani to xiw heb', ix in tek'b'an in b'a walan t'a heb' yichamtak winaquil chonhab' yet' t'a heb' ayoch yajalil t'a ko chonhab' tik yet' t'a masanil anima: Manh onh xiweklaj. Co naekkoti to a ko Diosal te niwan yelk'ochi, te ay smay, yuj chi' ko kolek ko chonhab' tik yet' kal kuninal, heb' ix quetb'eyum yet' ko pat, xin chi t'a heb'.
Ayic ix yab'an heb' ajk'ol chi' to lista kaji, ix nachajel yuj heb' to ha Dios ix juanb'at tas ix smol alej heb' chi'. Icha chi' ix aj ko munlajxi junjun onh.

Atax t'a jun k'u chi', nanhalnhej heb' winh in munlajwum chi' smunlaji, haxo nanhalxo heb' winh yet'nak syamk'ab' heb' winh yik owal, aton k'een lanza, maklab' jul-lab' yet' jul-lab' chi'. Aypaxoch k'een k'een t'a snhi' sk'ol heb' winh. Axo heb' yajalil heb' tz'ak'an stek'anil heb' smunlaj chi'.
Ha heb' kuchum ikatz, kuchb'il yikatz heb' chi' yuj, jun sk'ab' heb' chi' yamjinak yikatz chi', haxo t'a junxo sk'ab' heb' yet'nak syamk'ab' yik owal.
Yed' heb' smunlaji yik sb'oanxik'e muro chi', ayoch jachan k'een yespada heb' t'a snanhal. Axo t'a in tz'ey ayek' winh spu'an nok' ch'aak.

Ix walan t'a heb' yajal yaji, t'a heb' kuchb'um yet' t'a masanil heb' anima: Ha jun munlajel tik te niwan yaji, yuj chi' ix onh pukaxb'at t'a spatiktak muro tik, ch'okch'ok b'aj ayonhkanb'at junjun onh.
Yuj chi' ayik tzeyab'an yok' nok' ch'aak, tzex kot t'a ko tz'ey, haxo ko Diosal ol kolwaj qued' t'a owal chi', xin chi.
Yuj chi' nanhal onh tzonh munlaji, tzonh ochi ayik sakb'i masanto sq'uik'b'i, haxo nanhalxo jun, yet'nak syamk'ab' yik owal.
Ix walanpax t'a heb' wetchonhab' chi' to swaykanem heb' yet' heb' schekab' t'a yol chonhab' chi' yik stanhwan chonhab' chi' heb' qued'ok t'ak'walil. Axo t'a k'ualil tzonh munlaji.
Anhejtona' in pax tik yet' heb' ayto wuj in b'a yet'ok, heb' in chekab' yet' heb' tzin tanhwani, max quik'el-laj ko pichul t'ak'walil, junjun onh ayek' k'een ko lanza t'a ko tz'ey.
Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', ix yal wal sb'a heb' anima, heb' winh winak yet' heb' ix ix yuj tas tz'utaj heb' yuj heb' quetchonhab'.
Ay heb' tz'alani to tzijtum yuninal heb', yuj chi' yowalil sb'oquej ixim strigo heb' yik max cham heb' yuj wejel.
Ay pax heb' tz'alani to syak'kanb'at yumal sluum heb', ma yuwa heb' awab'il, ma spat heb' t'a prentail yuj smanan tas swa heb' yuj wejel.
Ay pax heb' tz'alani to yuj yak'an k'een tumin heb' syak' t'a winh rey, yuj chi' sk'an k'een tumin chi' heb' smajnej, syak'anb'at slum heb', ma yawb'en heb' yuj smajananub'al k'een tumin chi'.

Ix yalanpax heb' icha tik: Ha onh tik yet' heb' quetchonhab' tik, junnhej quinhtilal, malaj mach ch'ok yilji yuninal, lajannhej yilji kuninal yet' yuninal heb', yuj chi', ¿tas yuj a heb' kuninal ayoch schekab'ok heb'? Ayonh ayxo och heb' ix quisil schekab'ok heb'. Maxtzac yal ko kolan ko b'a, yujto yikxo lum ko lu'um heb' yet' kawb'en, xchi heb'.
Ayic ix wab'an yalan heb' anima tas tz'utaj chi', ix te kot wowal.

Ixlajwi chi', ix in naan wal sik'lab'il, ix in kachan heb' niwak winak yet' heb' yajal yaji, yik maxtzak sk'an yune' stumin heb' chi' t'a heb' quetchonhab' tik. Yuj chi' ix wawtan masanil heb' anima t'a jun molchajelal yuj jun lolonel chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix walan t'a heb' icha tik: Ha onh tik ix kak' wal quip ko kolanxielta heb' quetchonhab' chonhb'ilkanb'at t'a juntzanh ch'ok chonhab'il, ¿tom a exxo tik ol he chonhxikanb'at heb' yik a onhxo tik ol ko manxielta heb'? xin chi t'a heb'. Manhxalaj heb' ix tak'wi, maxtzak nachaj yuj heb' tas syutej heb' spakani.
Ix walanpaxi: Ha jun tas wan he k'ulan tik manh wach'oklaj. Smoj wal to tze ch'oxeli to niwan yelk'och ko Diosal t'a he sat, yik maxtzak b'uchwaj heb' anima ajk'ol t'ayonh.
Anhejtona' in yet' heb' ayto wuj in b'a yet'ok yet' heb' in chekab', ix kak' k'een tumin smajnej heb'. Ix kak'anpax ixim trigo sk'ex heb'. Ha tiknaik skak' lajwok juntzanh sb'ok heb' chi'.
