Yuj chi' swal t'ayex to tzeyak' meltzaj slum heb' chi' tiknaik yet' yawb'en heb', te' yoliwo heb' yet' spat heb', tzeyak'an lajwok sb'ok heb' chi' t'ayex. Tzeyak'an meltzaj yune' k'een tumin ix yak' heb' chi' t'ayex, ma trigo, ma wino, ma akeite, tas ix he k'an t'a heb', xin chi t'a heb'.

Ix tak'wi heb' smasanil icha tik: Ol kak'xi meltzaj masanil juntzanh chi' t'a heb'. Manhxalaj tas ol kal yuj juntzanh chi'. Ol ko k'anab'ajej masanil tas ix al chi', xchi heb'. Yuj chi' ix wawtan heb' sakerdote. Ha wal t'a yichanh heb' ix in chek yak' sti' heb' yuj tas ix yal chi'.

Ix in tzikub'tanhej pax in pichul, ix walani: Ichokab' tik ol aj ex stzikanel Dios t'a he pat yet' t'a he lu'um, tato manh ol he k'anab'ajej b'aj tzeyak'kan he ti' tik. Icha chi' ol aj yik'anek' tastak ay t'ayex, xin chi t'a heb'. Ix tak'wi heb' anima chi' smasanil: Ichokab' chi' tz'aji, xchi heb'. Ix yalan wach' lolonel heb' t'a Jehová. Ix sk'anab'ajan heb' b'aj ix yak' sti' chi'.

Ayic 20 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Artajerjes reyal t'a Persia, ix in yak'anoch winh yajalil t'a Judá, masanto yik 32 ab'ilxo yoch winh t'a reyal chi'. Ha t'a lachawe' ab'il ayin och yajalil chi', malaj in tojol ix in k'an t'a heb' anima to smoj in chaani, maj schapaxlaj yik heb' in k'ab' wok ayoch t'a opisio.

Palta a heb' yajal ek'nak ayik manto in ochi, icha ikatz yaj heb' t'a heb' anima. Junjun k'u sk'ananel 40 siklo k'een plata heb' yuj tas swa'a yet' yuj wino syuk'ej. Anhejtona' tz'ixtaj heb' chonhab' yuj heb' schekab' heb'. Palta a inxo tik, manh ichok ta' ix wutej in b'a, yujto te niwan yelk'och Dios t'a in sat.
Anhejtona', ix in b'oxik'e jun makan smuroal chonhab' tik yet' heb' in chekab', ix munlajnhej heb' wed'ok. Malaj junok lum lum ix wik'eq'ui.

Ay pax 150 heb' winh winak swa wed'ok, aton heb' winh wetchonhab' yet' heb' winh ayoch yajalil wed'ok. Ch'ok pax yaj heb' winh tonhej tzul onh ilani, heb' winh skot t'a juntzanh nakión ay t'a ko lak'anil.

Ha tas to wik yaj sb'o t'a junjun k'u: Jun nok' wakax schami, wakwanh nok' ch'ak kalnel, ch'ok pax yaj nok' kaxlanh. Ha t'a junjun slajunhil k'ual, niwan wino tz'ik'chajkoti, palta malaj junelok ix in k'an tas tzin wa''a to smoj in chaan yuj wopisio tik, yujto te niwan tas aykot t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik.
Yuj chi' in lesalwi icha tik: Ach in Diosal, ak' a wach'k'olal t'ayin yuj masanil tas ix in k'ulej yuj jun chonhab' tik, xin chi.
Ayic ix yab'an winhaj Sanbalat, winhaj Tobías, winhaj Gesem winh árabe yet' juntzanhxo heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayonh to toxo ix b'ok'e muro chi', manhxalaj b'aj jakan, (wach'chom manto och spuertail),
ix schekankot jun schekab' heb' winh t'ayin yik tzul yalani to sko molb'ej ko b'a yet' heb' winh t'a junok aldea t'a ak'lik yik Ono. Sna jun chi' heb' winh yik syak'an chukal heb' winh t'ayin.

Yuj chi' ix in chekb'at jun in chekab' yal t'a heb' winh, malaj in kolanil, te witz'an waj t'a in munlajel niwan yelk'ochi, max yal-laj in b'ati. Tato tzin b'ati, tzam ochkan waan jun munlajel tik, xin chib'ati.
Chanhel ix schek heb' winh ul alchaj jun lolonel chi' t'ayin, palta anheja' ichnhej ta' ix wutej in pakan t'a heb' winh.
Axo t'a yoelal, a wal jun schekab' winhaj Sanbalat chi' ix schekkot ul yak' jun karta to jakan,

b'aj syal winh icha tik: Sb'ey spekal t'a skal anima, icha pax chi' yalan winhaj Gesem to wan he naan eyik'anel he b'ha t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Persia, yuj chi' wan he b'oanxik'e muro chi'. Skab' spekal, tob' a ach ol ach och reyal.

Toxo ab' ix ak'och heb' schekab' Dios yik syalanel heb' t'a Jerusalén to rey achxo t'a Judá chi'. Ol yab' jun tik winhaj rey Artajerjes chi', yuj chi' kotanh, ol onh lolon ed'ok, xchi winh t'a jun skarta chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix in pakan t'a winh icha tik: Ha juntzanh lolonel tzal chi' manh yeloklaj, a ach tza nak'ei, xin chib'ati.
Ha heb' chi' syal heb' icha chi' yik tzonh xib'tan heb'. Am snaan heb' to ol chab'axk'e ko k'ool yik maxtzak yik'laj sb'a jun munlajel tik. Palta in lesalwi icha tik: Mamin ak' in tek'anil, xin chi.

Ixlajwi chi' ix in b'at t'a spat winhaj Semaías yuninal winhaj Delaía, yixchiquin winhaj Mehetabel. Ha winh chi' toxo ix smakoch sb'a winh t'a yol spat. Ix yalan winh t'ayin icha tik: Co k'ub'ej ko b'ha t'a yol stemplo Dios, sko makan spuertail, yujto ha t'a jun ak'wal tik sna heb' winh sjawi ul ach smilchamok, xchi winh t'ayin.
Palta ix in tak'wi t'a winh icha tik: ¿Tom smoj tzin k'ub'ejel in b'a, tzin makanoch in b'ha t'a yol templo chi' yik tzin kol in b'a? Manh ol in ochlaj t'a yol templo chi', xin chi t'a winh.

Ix nachajel wuuj to manhok Dios tz'ak'an yal winh icha chi'. Ix yal juntzanh chi' winh yik tzin xib'tan winh yik tz'och in mul d'ha Dios, yujto a winhaj Sanbalat chi' yet' winhaj Tobías toxo ix yak' k'een tumin heb' winh t'a winh.
Ix tupji winh yuj heb' winh yik tzin xib'tej winh, yik tz'och in mul yalan heb' winh, yik wach' te chuk in b'inaji, tz'el in q'uixwelal.

Yuj chi' ix in lesalwi icha tik: Ach in Diosal, tza nakoti yik tzak'anoch yaelal t'a yib'anh winhaj Sanbalat yet' winhaj Tobías chi' yuj tas ix sk'ulej. Anhejtona' tza nakot ix Noadías syaloch sb'a a chekab'ok yet' juntzanhxo heb' syaloch sb'a a chekab'ok snib'ej tzin xib'tej, xin chi t'a in lesal chi'.
Ix b'oelk'och muro chi', 52 k'ual ix yak' sb'oi. Ix b'oelk'ochi ayik 25 yoch uj Elul.

Ayic ix yab'an masanil heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayonh yet' masanil juntzanhxo nakión ay t'a ko lak'anil to ix b'o muro chi', ix xiwk'e heb'. Ix q'uixwipax heb', yujto ix nachajel yuj heb' to a jun munlajel chi' ix yik' sb'a yuj skolwal ko Diosal.
Ha t'a juntzanh k'ual chi' tzijtum karta ix stz'ib'ejb'at heb' winh winak niwak yopisio aj Judá t'a winhaj Tobías chi', ix spaknhejxi winh.

Yujto tzijtum juntzanh heb' winh winak niwak yopisio wach' yak'an yet' winh, yujto nhiab'il yaj winh t'a winhaj Sekanías yuninal winhaj Ara. Axo pax winhaj Johanán yuninal winhaj Tobías chi', ix yik'laj sb'a winh yet' ix yisil winhaj Mesulam yuninal winhaj Berequías.

Yuj chi' wach' yak'an heb' winh niwak yopisio chi' yet' winhaj Tobías chi'. Syalan heb' winh t'ayin to te wach' winh, syalanxib'at heb' winh t'a winh masanil tas swal t'a heb' winh. Tzijtum karta ix stz'ib'ejkot winh yik tzin xib'tani.
Ayic ix lajwi sb'oel muro chi', ix ochkan spuertail, ix wak'anpaxoch heb' stanhwan spuertail skajnub' Dios, heb' sb'itani yet' juntzanhxo heb' lewita.

Ix wak'anoch winh wuk'tak aj Hanani yajalil t'a heb' stanhwan Jerusalén yet' winhaj Hananías yajalil t'a kuartel ay t'a yol chonhab' chi'. Ha jun winh chi' te wach' spensar winh, te ay yelk'och Dios t'a winh t'a yichanh juntzanhxo heb' winh.

Ix walani to ayik chaanhxo k'u sjakchaj spuertail Jerusalén chi', haxo t'a yemk'ualil ayik manto pax heb' stanhwani, wach' tz'aj smakchajxikani. Ay pax heb' winh ix wak'och stanhwej Jerusalén chi'. Ay heb' winh stanhwan b'aj stanhwajtaxoni, ay pax heb' winh t'a stz'ey spat stanhwej.
Ha jun chonhab' tik te niwan, palta quenanto anima ayek' t'ay, yujto manto b'ochajxik'e spat heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ha Dios ix ak'an in na' to tzin molb'ej heb' winh winak niwak yelk'ochi, heb' winh yajal yaji yet' masanil heb' chonhab', yik stz'ib'chaj heb' t'a ch'anh libro, icha syal yinhtilal smam yicham heb'. Ix chax pax ch'anh b'aj tz'ib'ab'il sb'i heb' b'ab'laj janakxi, icha syal sb'i smam yicham heb', ata' tz'ib'ab'il heb' tik:

Aton tik slistail heb' aj Judá ik'b'ilkanb'at yuj winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia. Aton heb' yinhtilal heb' tik ix jax t'a Jerusalén yet' t'a juntzanhxo lugar t'a yol yik Judá. Ix jax heb' t'a schonhab'kan smam yicham junjun.

Ha heb' winh skuchb'an heb', aton heb' winh tik: Vinhaj Zorobabel, winhaj Jesúa, winhaj Nehemías, winhaj Azarías, winhaj Raamías, winhaj Nahamani, winhaj Mardoqueo, winhaj Bilsán, winhaj Misperet, winhaj Bigwai, winhaj Nehum yet' winhaj Baana.

Ha heb' yinhtilal winhaj Paros, 2 mil 172 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Sefatías, 372 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Ara, 652 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Pahat-moab, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jesúa yet' heb' yinhtilal winhaj Joab, 2 mil 818 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Elam, mil 254 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Zatu, 845 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Zacai, 760 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Binúi, 648 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Bebai, 628 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Azgad, 2 mil 322 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Adonicam, 667 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Bigwai, 2 mil 67 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Adín, 655 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Ater, aton heb' yinhtilal winhaj Ezequías, 98 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Hasum, 328 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Bezai, 324 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Harif, 112 heb'.

Eb' yinhtilal heb' aj Gabaón, 95 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal heb' aj Belén yet' heb' yinhtilal heb' aj Netofa, 188 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal heb' aj Anatot, 128 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal heb' aj Bet-azmawet, 42 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal heb' aj Quiriat-jearim, Cafira yet' Beerot, 743 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal heb' aj Ramá yet' heb' yinhtilal heb' aj Geba, 621 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal heb' aj Micmas, 122 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal heb' aj Betel yet' heb' yinhtilal heb' aj Hai, 123 heb'. Eb' aj schab'il Nebo, 52 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal heb' aj schab'il Elam, mil 254 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal heb' aj Harim, 320 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal heb' aj Jericó, 345 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal heb' aj Lod, heb' yinhtilal heb' aj Hadid yet' heb' yinhtilal heb' aj Ono, 721 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal heb' aj Senaa, 3 mil 930 heb'.

Axo jun makan heb' sakerdote yinhtilal winhaj Jedaía yinhtilal winhaj Jesúa, 973 heb'. Axo heb' yinhtilal winhaj Imer, mil 52 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Pasur, mil 247 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Harim, mil 17 heb'.

Axo heb' lewita yinhtilal winhaj Jesúa yet' winhaj Cadmiel, yinhtilal pax heb' winh winhaj Hodabías, 74 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Asaf, heb' sb'itani, 148 heb'. Eb' tanhwum puerta, yinhtilal winhaj Salum, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Ater, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Talmón, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Acub, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Hatita yet' heb' yinhtilal winhaj Sobai, 138 heb' t'a smasanil.

Axo heb' ix munlaj t'a templo, aton heb' yinhtilal winhaj Ziha, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Hasufa, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Tabaot, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Queros, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Siaha, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Padón, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Lebana, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Hagaba, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Salmai, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Hanán, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Gidel, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Gahar, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Reaía, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Rezín, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Necoda, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Gazam, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Uza, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Paseah, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Besai, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Mehunim, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Nefisesim, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Bacbuc, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Hacufa, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Harhur, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Bazlut, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Mehída, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Harsa, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Barcos, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Sísara, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Tema, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Nezía yet' heb' yinhtilal winhaj Hatifa.

Axo heb' yinhtilalkan heb' yak'umal serwil winhaj Salomón, aton heb' yinhtilal winhaj Sotai, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Soferet, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Perida, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jaala, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Darcón, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Gidel, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Sefatías, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Hatil, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Poqueret-hazebaim yet' heb' yinhtilal winhaj Amón.
Masanil heb' ix munlaj t'a templo yet' heb' yinhtilal heb' yak'umal serwil winhaj Salomón, ay 392 heb' t'a smasanil.

Ha heb' yinhtilal winhaj Delaía, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Tobías yet' heb' yinhtilal winhaj Necoda, 642 heb'. Maj yal-laj sch'oxanel sb'a heb' tato Israel yinhtilal heb'. Ha heb' tik ix kot heb' t'a Tel-mela, t'a Tel-harsa, t'a Querub, t'a Adón yet' t'a Imer.

Ha heb' yinhtilal winhaj Habaía, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Cos yet' heb' yinhtilal winhaj Barzilai, ix yal heb' to sakerdote heb'. Axo ix sayji ilchaj sb'i heb', maj ilchajlaj b'aj tz'ib'ab'il sb'i heb' chi', yuj chi' maj ochlaj heb' t'a yopisio t'a stemplo Dios. Ha winhaj Barzilai chi' ix yik'laj sb'a winh yet' jun ix yisil winhaj Barzilai aj Galaad, yuj chi' a sb'i winh snhi' winh chi' ix ochkan t'ay.
Ix yalan winh yajal t'a Judá to max yal swaan ixim pan heb' yik Dios yaji, ato junok winh sakerdote ol k'anb'an t'a Urim yet' t'a Tumim tato yel yinhtilal heb' winhaj Aarón.
Ay 42 mil 360 heb' anima chi' t'a smasanil,
palta manh ayok och heb' winh chekab' yet' heb' ix chekab' sb'isulok. Ha heb' chi' 7 mil 337 heb' t'a smasanil. Ay pax 245 heb' winh winak yet' heb' ix ix sb'itani.
Axo nok' nok': 736 nok' chej, 245 nok' mula,
435 nok' kamello yet' 6 mil 720 nok' b'uru.

Tzijtum anima ix yak' silab' yik smanchaj tas ol och yik sb'ochajxi templo. Ha winh yajal yaj t'a skal heb', 17 libra k'een oro ix yak' winh yet' 50 niwak uk'ab' sk'anchaj t'a templo yet' 530 pichul yik heb' sakerdote. Ay heb' winh yajal yaj t'a junjun inhtilal, ix smolb'ej silab' heb' winh, ix yak'an 337 libra k'een oro heb' winh yet' 2 mil 215 libra k'een plata. Axo nanhalxo heb' chonhab' ix ak'an 337 libra k'een oro, 24 quintal k'een plata yet' pax 67 pichul yik heb' sakerdote. Ha juntzanh chi' ix yak' heb' b'aj schaji silab'.

Ha heb' sakerdote, heb' lewita, heb' tanhwum puerta, heb' sb'itani yet' masanil heb' anima ay t'a chonhab' chi', heb' tz'ak'wi serwil t'a templo yet' juntzanhxo heb' israel, ix laj aj heb' t'a schonhab' junjun.

Ayic ix el yich yuquil uj, ix smolb'ej sb'a masanil heb' anima t'a Jerusalén chi', ix kot junjun heb' t'a schonhab', ix jawi heb' b'aj ay jun puerta b'aj tz'el heb' ix ix ik'oj ha'. Ix alji t'a winhaj sakerdote Esdras k'ayb'um paxi to syik'kot ch'anh ley Moisés winh, aton jun ley chi' ak'b'il yuj Jehová t'a chonhab' Israel. Ha t'a b'ab'el k'u yik jun uj chi', ix yik'kot ch'anh winh t'a yichanh heb' anima molanek' chi', heb' winh winak yet' heb' ix ix yet' pax heb' unin tzaxo nachajel yuj.
Ix syamanoch winh yawtan ch'anh t'a yichanh masanil anima chi' t'a q'uinhib'alil masanto ix och chimk'ualil. Ix smaklej wal yab' heb' masanil tas aykan t'a ch'anh ley chi'.

Ix k'e linhan winhaj Esdras chi' t'a yib'anh juntzanh te te' ix b'ochajk'e stek'nub'ej winh. Axo t'a swach' k'ab' winh ayek' winhaj Matatías, winhaj Sema, winhaj Anías, winhaj Urías, winhaj Hilcías yet' winhaj Maasías. Axo t'a sk'exanh winh ayek' winhaj Pedaías, winhaj Misael, winhaj Malquías, winhaj Hasum, winhaj Hasbadana, winhaj Zacarías yet' winhaj Mesulam.
Yujto chaanh b'aj ayk'e winhaj Esdras chi', yuj chi' ayik ix yilan heb' anima chi' smasanil xuyanel ch'anh ley chi' winh, ix k'e linhan heb'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan wach' lolonel winh t'a Jehová Dios Niwan Yelk'ochi. Ix tak'wi masanil heb' anima chi', ix yik'anchaanh sk'ab' heb', ix yalan heb': Ichokab'ta', xchi heb'. Ix em nhojnaj heb' t'a sat lu'um, ix och heb' ejmelal t'a Jehová.

Ayic ix yawtan ch'anh ley chi' winhaj Esdras chi', haxo heb' winh lewita, aton winhaj Jesúa, winhaj Bani, winhaj Serebías, winhaj Jamín, winhaj Acub, winhaj Sabetai, winhaj Hodías, winhaj Maasías, winhaj Kelita, winhaj Azarías, winhaj Jozabed, winhaj Hanán yet' winhaj Pelaía, a heb' winh ix alan t'a sti' heb' anima chi' tas syal ch'anh ley chi', yik snachajel yuj heb' tas syal ch'anh, haxo heb' anima chi' aynhej ek' heb' t'a yet'tal junjun.

Ayic ix yab'an heb' anima chi' tas wal syal ch'anh ley chi', ix ok'k'e heb'. Axo winhaj Nehemías yajal yet' winhaj sakerdote Esdras chi' yet' heb' lewita wan yawtan ch'anh ley chi' t'a heb' chonhab' chi', ix yalan heb' winh: Ha jun k'u tik yik Jehová ko Diosal yaji, yuj chi' manh ex kusok, manh ex ok'ok, xchi heb' winh.

Ix yalanpax winhaj Nehemías t'a heb': Ixiquec, b'at waanhek. Ha wael te wach' tze wa''a. Tzeyuk'an ak' wino t'a tzalajk'olal. Tzeyak' yik heb' anima malaj yik b'ob'il yuj, yujto a jun k'u tik yik Jehová ko Diosal yaji. Manh ex kusok, yujto a tzalajk'olal syak' Jehová, a ayoch quipumalok, xchi winh.
Ix kachjipax heb' anima chi' yuj heb' lewita chi' icha tik: Actejec eyoq'ui yujto yik Jehová yaj jun k'u tik, manh ex kusok, xchi heb'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at heb' wael, ix yuk'an ha' heb', ix yak'an yik heb' malaj yik heb'. Ix te tzalaj heb', yujto ix cham wal yab'an heb' tas ix yal sk'ayb'ub'al heb'.

Axo t'a junxo k'u, ix smolb'an sb'a heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun makan yinhtilal, heb' sakerdote yet' juntzanhxo heb' lewita, yik sk'ayb'aj heb' yuj winhaj Esdras t'a ch'anh ley ak'b'ilkan yuj Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés. Ata' ix ilchaj yuj heb' to ayik tz'och q'uinh chinama t'a yuquil uj t'a junjun ab'il, tz'aj heb' israel t'a yol chinama chi'.

Yuj chi' ix alchajel t'a kaltak chonhab' yet' t'a Jerusalén to sb'at heb' anima t'a kaltak te' yik'kot sk'ab'tak te' oliwo awab'il yet' te' kaltakte'al oliwo, te arrayán, te' palma, ma junokxo yalnhej tas te'al k'ayum xiil yik sb'o chinama chi', icha yajkan t'a ch'anh ley chi'.

Yuj chi' ix b'at heb' yik'kot te' k'ab'tak te' chi', haxo t'a yib'anh spat heb' ix sb'ok'e chinama chi', ma t'a yamaq'uil spat heb', ma t'a yamaq'uil stemplo Dios, ma t'a sti' jun puerta b'aj tz'el heb' ix ix ik'oj ha', ma t'a sti' spuertail yik Efraín.

Masanil heb' anima janakxi t'a Babilonia, ix sb'o schinama heb' chi', ix och heb' t'a yool. Atax t'a stiempoal winhaj Josué yuninal winhaj Nun, malaj b'aj ix uji icha jun chi', yuj wal chi' ix te tzalaj heb' anima chi'.

Ix yawtan ch'anh ley winhaj Esdras chi' t'a junjun k'u masanto ix tz'akwi yuquil k'ual q'uinh chi'. Axo t'a swajxaquil k'ual, ix smolb'an sb'a heb' smasanil yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a Jehová icha yalan ch'anh ley chi'.
Ayic 24 yoch yuquil uj chi', ix smolb'an sb'a masanil heb' israel yik tz'och heb' tzek'ojk'olal, ix yak'anoch pichul heb' yik kusk'olal, ix yak'ank'e pokok heb' t'a sjolom.
Ix yik'anel sb'a heb' t'a skal heb' ch'ok chonhab'il. Ix k'e linhan heb' yalank'eta smul yet' smul heb' smam yicham heb'.
Yakb'an linhank'e heb' t'a yet'tal chi', oxe' wal hora ix awtaj ch'anh sley Jehová t'a skal heb', haxo t'a oxe' horaxo, ix yalank'eta smul heb', ix och heb' ejmelal t'a Jehová sDiosal.

Axo jun makan heb' winh lewita, aton winhaj Jesúa, winhaj Bani, winhaj Cadmiel, winhaj Sebanías, winhaj Buni, winhaj Serebías, winhaj Bani yet' winhaj Quenani, ix k'e heb' winh t'a yib'anh jun b'akhquiltak sk'ei, te chaanh ix yal heb' winh t'a Jehová Dios.

Ix yalanpax junxo makan heb' winh lewita chi', aton winhaj Jesúa, winhaj Cadmiel, winhaj Bani, winhaj Hasabnías, winhaj Serebías, winhaj Hodías, winhaj Sebanías yet' winhaj Petaías icha tik: Calec wach' lolonel t'a Jehová ko Diosal t'a masanil tiempo. Mamin, alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'ayach wach'chom max k'ek'och ach ko b'itan t'a smojal.

Mamin Jehová, a achnhej ayachnhej eq'ui. Ha ach ix a b'o satcha’anh squila' yet' juntzanhxo satcha’anh max quil-laj. Ha ach ix a b'o masanil k'een k'anal. Ha ach pax ix a b'o lum lum tik yet' pax masanil tastak ay t'a lu'um. Ha ach pax ix a b'o ha' mar yet' masanil tas ay t'ha ha'. Ha ach tzak' sk'inal masanil tas, yuj chi' tz'och heb' ángel ejmelal t'ayach.
Mamin Jehová, a ach ton wal Dios ach, a sik'naquelta winhaj Abram. Ik'annaquelta winh t'a Ur schonhab' heb' kaldeo, ak'annak skuch winh Abraham.

Ilnac to yak'nak ach och winh t'a sk'ool, yuj chi' a b'onak jun a trato yet' winh yik tzak'an lum lum t'a heb' yinhtilal winh, aton lum yik heb' kananeo, heb' heteo, heb' amorreo, heb' ferezeo, heb' jebuseo yet' heb' gergeseo. Elnakxok'och a lolonel chi' yujto tz'elnhejk'och tas tzala'.
Ilnac wal yab'an syail heb' ko mam quicham t'a Egipto, ab'annak yel yaw heb' t'a sti' a Chacchac Mar.

Ha ch'oxannak juntzanh tas satub'tak yilji t'a winh sreyal Egipto chi' yet' t'a masanil heb' schekab' winh yet' t'a masanil anima ay t'a yol smakb'en winh, yujto ilnak to te chakjinaquel heb' quetisraelal yuj heb'. Yuj juntzanh chi' tzach te b'inajnhej.

Ha pojnak snanhal ha' mar chi' t'a yichanh heb' ko mam quicham chi', yek'nakta heb' t'a stak'inhal lum t'a yol ha' chi'. Axo heb' pechjinak heb' chi', b'atnakkan heb' t'a yich ha' icha wal tz'aj sb'atkan junok k'een k'een t'a sjulal yich ha'.
Slajwi chi', ik'annak b'ey heb' t'a k'ualil yet' jun niwan topanh asun, haxo t'ak'walil ayoch sk'ak'al jun asun chi' yik syak'an sakil k'inal b'aj sb'at heb'.
Slajwi chi', emnakul t'a sjolom lum witz Sinaí, a lolonnak emta t'a heb'. Ak'annak ley to tojol t'a heb' yet' k'ayb'ub'al te yel yet' pax cheknab'il te wach'.
Ha k'ayb'annak heb' yik sk'anab'ajej sk'ual ik'oj ip heb' yuj ach yik'anchaanh heb', ak'annak cheknab'il yet' k'ayb'ub'al t'a winhaj Moisés, haxo winh alannak t'a heb'.

Ak'annak wael skot t'a satcha’anh swa heb' ayik tz'och swejel heb'. Ak'annaquelta ha ha' t'a sat k'een k'een yuk' heb' yik tzek' staquinhtial heb'. Slajwi chi' alannak t'a heb' to skajnaj heb' t'a sat lum lum ak'nak a ti' ak'an t'a heb'.
Palta a heb' ko mam quicham chi' te ak'umtak heb', te pit yutejnak sb'a heb', manh schanakok yab' a cheknab'il heb'.

Manh ach sk'anab'ajejnakok heb', manhxo snanakokkot heb' tas satub'tak a k'ulejnak yuj swach'ilok heb'. Te pit yutejnak sb'a heb', snaannak heb' yak'och jun yajalil yik skuchb'aj meltzaj heb' yuj t'a Egipto, yik tz'ochxi heb' chekab'il ta' yalani. Palta a ach tik, Dios ach, te ay a niwank'olal, ay ok'elk'olal, te xajan anima uuj, manh k'unok skot owal. Manh aktejnakokkanlaj heb'
wach'chom sb'onak jun k'een yechel wakax heb'. Yalannac wal heb' to a jun chi' sdiosal heb', to ha' ik'anelta heb' t'a Egipto. Te niwan smul heb' yak'nakochi.

Palta a ach tik te niwan a k'ool, yuj chi' manh aktejnakokkan heb' t'a tzinan lu'um. Manh ik'nakoquel jun niwan topanh asun tz'ik'an b'ey heb' t'a k'ualil, manh ik'nakokpaxeli ayik syak'an yok t'a heb' t'ak'walil yik syak'an sakil k'inal t'a heb' b'aj sb'ati.
Ak'nak Espíritu wach' t'a heb' yik sk'ayb'aj heb' yuj. Manh aktejnakok ak'an maná swa heb'. Ak'naknhej ha ha' yuk' heb' yik tzek' staquinhtial heb'.
40 ab'il ak'nak swael heb' t'a tzinan lum chi'. Malaj wal jab'ok tas yak'nak palta t'a heb', manh lajwinakoquel spichul heb' ayochi, manh malnakokk'e yok heb' sb'eyi.

Uuj yak'nak ganar heb' rey heb' yet' juntzanh chonhab', yikannakkan slum heb' chi' heb', a pojannak ek' lum t'a heb'. Ak'annak lum Hesbón t'a heb', aton lum b'aj ochnak winhaj Sehón reyal yet' lum Basán b'aj ochnak winhaj Og reyal.
Ak'annakpax q'uib' sb'isul yuninal heb' icha sb'isul k'een k'anal t'a satcha’anh. Ik'annakkot heb' yik schaan smakb'en heb' b'aj ak'nak a ti' ak'an yikok heb' ko mam quicham.
Ochnac heb' yuninal heb' t'a lum Canaán, yik'annak lu'um heb'. Uuj yak'nak ganar juntzanh anima chi' heb' yet' sreyal, yik sk'ulan heb' tas snib'ej sk'ulej t'a juntzanh anima chi'.

Yik'annakpax chonhab' heb' te wach' yaj sb'oi, lum lum te yax sat yet' juntzanh pat te b'ut'an yuj tastak wach'. Yik'annakpax ha' uk'b'ila' heb', te' uwa, te' oliwo yet' juntzanhxo te te' syak' sat. Vanac heb', b'ud'jinak heb', b'ak'uechb'inak heb'. Yak'nak wal tzalajb'ok sk'ool heb' yuj a niwan wach'k'olal.

Palta te pit yutejnak sb'a heb', yochnak heb' ajk'olal t'ayach, spatikannaquel a k'ayb'ub'al heb'. Cachjinac heb' yuj heb' a chekab', yik syak'xioch sb'a heb' t'a yol a k'ab', palta smilnakcham heb' a chekab' chi' heb'. Yelxo te niwan smul heb' ochnak t'ayach.

Yuj chi' ak'nakoch heb' ko mam quicham chi' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ool, ixtajnak wal heb' yuj heb'. Palta ayik wan yab'an syail heb' chi', sk'anannak a kolwal heb'. Ha achxo jun, ayach ek' t'a satcha’anh, ab'nak slesal heb' chi', yujto ok'nak wal a k'ol t'a heb', yuj chi' ak'nakkot heb' skolan heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ool chi'.

Palta ayik junk'olalxo yajxi heb', sk'ulannakxi chukal heb' t'a ichanh. Yuj chi' aktejnakxib'at heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ol chi', yak'jinakoch syaelal heb' yuj heb'. Yuj chi' sk'ananxi a kolwal heb'. Ha achxo ayach ek' t'a satcha’anh, ab'annak slesal heb'. Yujto tz'ok' wal a k'ool t'a heb', tzijtum el a kolnak heb'.

Alannac t'a heb' to sk'anab'ajej a k'ayb'ub'al heb', palta anheja' pit yutejnak sb'a heb', manh sk'anab'ajejnakok a cheknab'il heb'. Ochnac smul heb' t'a a k'ayb'ub'al, aton jun tz'ak'an sk'inal heb' sk'anab'ajani. Te chuk yutejnak sb'a heb', te pit heb', manh schanakoklaj heb' yab'i.

Tzijtum ab'il ak'nak techaj schukal heb'. Ha Espíritu ak'annak yojtaquejel heb' a chekab', haxo heb' kachannak heb', palta manh schanakoklaj heb' yab'i. Yuj chi' ak'nakoch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' juntzanhxo nakión.
Palta yujto tz'ok' wal a k'ool t'a heb', te niwan a wach'k'olal, yuj chi' manh a satnakoquel heb' smasanil, manh aktejnakok paxkan heb' sch'okoj.

Yuj chi', ach ko Diosal, te niwan elk'ochi, te ay a may, smojton wal ko xiw t'ayach. Max b'at a lolonel satk'olal uuj yujto te xajan onh uuj. Nacot jantak syaelal heb' ko reyal, heb' kajalil, heb' sakerdote, heb' a chekab', heb' ko mam quicham yet' masanil heb' quetchonhab', a tax t'a stiempoal heb' sreyal Asiria syab'nhej syail heb' masanto tiknaik.
Palta tojolnhej tas sjawi t'a quib'anh uuj. Wach'nhej tas tza k'ulej, a onhxo tik, chuknhej tas sko sk'ulej.
Ha heb' ko reyal, heb' kajalil, heb' sakerdote yet' heb' ko mam quicham, manh schanakoklaj yab' heb', manh sk'anab'ajejnakoklaj a cheknab'il heb' icha ajnak yalji t'a heb'.
Manh jantakok tas ak'nak t'a heb', te lewan lum lum te yax sat tik ak'nak t'a heb', palta manh ochnakok heb' ejmelal t'ayach, manh yaktejnakokkan chuk b'eyb'al heb' t'a yol smakb'en heb' ak'nak chi'.
Ina wal quilji tiknaik, toxo ix onh meltzajoch chekab'il t'a lum lum ak'nak t'a heb' ko mam quicham, lum b'aj yak'nak wal tzalajb'ok sk'ool heb'.

Ha wal tas te wach' awab'il kuuj, a chi' syik'ek' heb' rey t'ayonh, aton heb' b'aj onh ak'och t'a yalanh smandar yuj ko mul ix och t'ayach. Sk'ulej heb' tas snib'ej sk'ol t'ayonh yet' t'a nok' ko molb'etzal nok', yuj chi' te ayonh wal och t'a ilk'olal tiknaik.

Yuj chi' a onh tik skak' ko ti', stz'ib'chajkani to yel ol ko k'anab'ajej. Yuj chi' tz'ochkan sello yet' sb'i heb' kajalil, heb' lewita yet' heb' sakerdote t'a ch'anh uum tik, xchi heb' winh t'a slesal chi'.

Aton heb' winh tik ix yak' sb'i t'a ch'anh uum ix tz'ib'chaj chi'. Ha in Nehemías in tik, yuninal in winhaj Hacalías, yajal waji. Ix yak'anpax sb'i heb' winh sakerdote: Aton winhaj Sedequías, winhaj Seraías, winhaj Azarías, winhaj Jeremías, winhaj Pasur, winhaj Amarías, winhaj Malquías, winhaj Hatús, winhaj Sebanías, winhaj Maluc, winhaj Harim, winhaj Meremot, winhaj Obadías, winhaj Daniel, winhaj Ginetón, winhaj Baruc, winhaj Mesulam, winhaj Abías, winhaj Mijamín, winhaj Maazías, winhaj Bilgai yet' winhaj Semaías.

Axo pax juntzanhxo heb' winh lewita, aton heb' winh tik: Vinhaj Jesúa yuninal winhaj Azanías, winhaj Binúi yinhtilal winhaj Henadad, winhaj Cadmiel yet' heb' yetlewitail: Aton winhaj Sebanías, winhaj Hodías, winhaj Kelita, winhaj Pelaías, winhaj Hanán, winhaj Micaías, winhaj Rehob, winhaj Hasabías, winhaj Zacur, winhaj Serebías, winhaj Sebanías, winhaj Hodías, winhaj Bani yet' winhaj Beninu.

Axo pax heb' ayoch yajalil t'a chonhab' chi': Aton winhaj Paros, winhaj Pahat-moab, winhaj Elam, winhaj Zatu, winhaj Bani, winhaj Buni, winhaj Azgad, winhaj Bebai, winhaj Adonías, winhaj Bigwai, winhaj Adín, winhaj Ater, winhaj Ezequías, winhaj Azur, winhaj Hodías, winhaj Hasum, winhaj Bezai, winhaj Harif, winhaj Anatot, winhaj Nebai, winhaj Magpías, winhaj Mesulam, winhaj Hezir, winhaj Mesezabeel, winhaj Sadoc, winhaj Jadúa, winhaj Pelatías, winhaj Hanán, winhaj Anaías, winhaj Oseas, winhaj Hananías, winhaj Hasub, winhaj Halohes, winhaj Pilha, winhaj Sobec, winhaj Rehum, winhaj Hasabna, winhaj Maasías, winhaj Ahías, winhaj Hanán, winhaj Anán, winhaj Maluc, winhaj Harim yet' winhaj Baana.

Axo jantakto heb' chonhab', aton heb' sakerdote yet' juntzanhxo heb' lewita tanhwum puerta, heb' sb'itani, heb' smunlaj t'a templo yet' masanil heb' anima toxo ix yik'el sb'ha t'a skal heb' ch'ok chonhab'il yik sk'anab'ajan sk'ayb'ub'al Dios heb', ix yak' sti' heb' yet' heb' ix yetb'eyum yet' heb' yal yuninal heb' tzaxo nachaj yuj.

Ha heb' tik ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' yet' heb' sk'ab'yok yet' pax heb' yajal, ix yak'an sti' heb' to ol sb'eyb'alej scheknab'il Dios heb', aton alb'ilkan yuj winhaj Moisés schekab' Dios chi'. Ix yalan heb' to ol sk'anab'ajej wal scheknab'il yet' sk'ayb'ub'al Jehová Cajalil heb'.
Yuj chi' ix yal heb' icha tik: Manhxo ol yik'laj sb'a heb' kal kuninal yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il.

Tato sjawi heb' ch'ok chonhab'il chonhoj tastak t'ayonh t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip, ma t'a juntzanhxo sk'ual q'uinh, malaj tas ol ko man t'a heb'. Axo t'a yuquil ab'il ol yik' yip lum ko lu'um, ol kak'anpax lajwok sb'ok heb' ay sb'ok t'ayonh.
Anhejtona' toxo ix kak'och t'a quib'anh to yowalil ol kak' chanhe' gramo k'een plata junjun onh t'a junjun ab'il yik smanchaj tas sk'anchaj t'a skajnub' ko Diosal:

Aton yuj ixim pan tz'ak'chajoch t'a yichanh Dios, ofrenda tz'ak'ji t'a junjun k'u t'a tas swaji, silab' snhusjitz'ha t'a junjun k'u, silab' t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip, silab' ayik tz'alji k'een uj yet' juntzanhxo q'uinh tz'och t'a junjun ab'il, yet' pax juntzanhxo ofrenda yet' silab' yuj yak'ji tup ko mul a onh israel onh tik yet' juntzanhxo tas sk'anchaj t'a stemplo ko Diosal.

Anhejtona' yuj te' k'atzitz sk'anchaj t'a stemplo Jehová, yik stz'a te' t'a yaltar Jehová ko Diosal, toxo ix ko b'o t'a junjun makan quinhtilal tas tiempoal t'a junjun ab'il ol kak' te' k'atzitz chi', icha yajkan t'a ch'anh ley chi'. Wach'chom sakerdote, ma lewita, ma komon anima, ol ko k'anab'ajej ko masanil.
Ix ko chaoch t'a quib'anh to ol quik'kot sb'ab'el sat ko munlajel yet' b'ab'el sat kawb'en te' t'a junjun ab'il t'a skajnub' ko Diosal.
Ol quik'anpaxkot heb' b'ab'el kuninal yet' b'ab'el yune' nok' ko wakax yet' nok' ko kalnel t'a stemplo ko Diosal t'a yichanh heb' sakerdote smunlaj ta', icha wal yajkan t'a ch'anh ley chi'.

Ol quik'anpaxkot ko kolwal t'a heb' sakerdote, aton ixim ko b'ab'el harina, b'ab'el sat kawb'en te', ko b'ab'el wino yet' ko b'ab'el akeite. Ol kak'an b'aj sik'chaj t'a stemplo ko Diosal. Ol quik'anpaxkot sdiezmoal sat kawb'en. Ol kak'an t'a heb' lewita, yujto a heb' smolb'an sdiezmoal tas squik' t'a sat ko lu'um t'a junjun chonhab' b'aj tzonh munlaji.

Ayic ol b'at heb' lewita chi' smolb'ej ko diezmo chi', yowalil sb'at junok heb' sakerdote yinhtilal winhaj Aarón yet' heb'. Syik'anpaxb'at sdiezmoal diezmo scha heb' chi', syak'anoch heb' b'aj sik'chaj tas tz'ak'ji t'a skajnub' ko Diosal.

Ha onh israel onh tik yet' heb' lewita ol quik'kot ixim trigo, wino yet' akeite b'aj molan masanil tas sk'anchaj t'a templo, b'aj ay pax skuarto heb' ayoch t'a opisio, aton heb' sakerdote, heb' tanhwum puerta yet' heb' sb'itani. Ix kak'an ko ti' to manh ol kaktejkan stemplo ko Diosal, xchi heb'.

Ha heb' yajal t'a ko chonhab' tik ix kajnaj heb' t'a Jerusalén. Axo juntzanhxo heb', lajunhe' makan ix laj aj heb', ix och suerte t'a yib'anh heb' mach junok makan heb' ol kajnaj t'a Jerusalén tik, aton t'a jun chonhab' to yik Dios yaji. Axo b'alunh makanhxo heb' sb'atxikan heb' t'a schonhab' junjun.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan wach' lolonel heb' chonhab' t'a yib'anh heb' b'ekan sk'ol skajnaj t'a Jerusalén chi'.

Ay heb' quetisraelal, heb' sakerdote, heb' lewita, heb' smunlaj t'a templo, heb' yinhtilal heb' ak'jinak serwil winhaj Salomón, ix kajnaj heb' t'a sluum t'a juntzanh schonhab' heb' t'a yol yik Judá. Palta haxo heb' yajal yaj t'a skal heb', ix kan kajan heb' t'a Jerusalén yet' yal yuninal.

Aton heb' yinhtilal Judá tik yet' heb' yinhtilal Benjamín ix kan kajan t'a Jerusalén: Ay chawanh heb' winh yajal yaji. Ha jun winh skuchan Ataías yuninal winhaj Uzías. Axo heb' smam yicham winh, aton winhaj Zacarías, winhaj Amarías, winhaj Sefatías, winhaj Mahalaleel. Ha masanil heb' tik yinhtilal heb' winhaj Fares yuninal winhaj Judá. Ha sb'isul heb', 468 t'a smasanil, te tek'an heb'. Axo junxo winh yajal chi', Maasías sb'i winh, yuninal winh winhaj Baruc. Axo heb' smam yicham winh, aton winhaj Colhoze, winhaj Hazaías, winhaj Adías, winhaj Joiarib, winhaj Zacarías, yinhtilal heb' winhaj Siloni yuninal winhaj Judá.

Axo pax t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Benjamín, ay oxwanh heb' winh yajal yaji. Aton winhaj Salú, winhaj Gabai yet' winhaj Salai. Ha winhaj Salú chi' yuninal winhaj Mesulam, haxo heb' smam yicham winh, aton winhaj Joed, winhaj Pedaías, winhaj Colaías, winhaj Maasías, winhaj Itiel, winhaj Jesaías. 928 sb'isul heb' t'a smasanil.
Axo winhaj Joel yuninal winhaj Zicri yajal soldado yaj t'a heb', haxo winhaj Judá yuninal winhaj Senúa schab'il yajal yaji.
Ha heb' winh yajal yaj t'a skal heb' winh sakerdote, heb' winh ix kan kajan t'a Jerusalén, chanhwanh heb' winh: Ha winh b'ab'el, aton winhaj Jedaías yuninal winhaj Joiarib sk'ab'yok winhaj Jaquín.
Axo winh schab'il, aton winhaj Seraías yuninal winhaj Hilcías. Axo heb' smam yicham winh, aton winhaj Mesulam, winhaj Sadoc, winhaj Meraiot, winhaj Ahitob winh yak'nak sat sakerdoteal.

Ha sb'isul masanil heb' tik, 822 heb', sk'ab'yoknhej sb'a heb', aton heb' munlajnak t'a skajnub' Dios. Axo winh yoxil, aton winhaj Adaías yuninal winhaj Jeroham. Axo heb' smam yicham winh, aton winhaj Pelalías, winhaj Amsi, winhaj Zacarías, winhaj Pasur yet' winhaj Malquías.

Ha sb'isul heb' yajal yaj t'a heb', 242 heb', sk'ab'yoknhej sb'a heb'. Axo winh schanhil, aton winhaj Amasai yuninal winhaj Azareel. Axo heb' smam yicham winh, aton winhaj Azai, winhaj Mesilemot yet' winhaj Imer.
Ha sb'isul heb', 128, te jelan heb' t'a owal. Axo winhaj Zabdiel yuninal winhaj Gedolim, a winh yajal yaj t'a skal heb'.
Axo heb' winh yajal yaj t'a heb' lewita, heb' ix kan kajan t'a Jerusalén, aton winhaj Semaías yuninal winhaj Hasub. Axo heb' smam yicham winh, aton winhaj Azricam, winhaj Hasabías yet' winhaj Buni.
Ay pax chawanhxo heb' winh yajal, aton winhaj Sabetai yet' winhaj Jozabad. Ha heb' winh ayoch yil munlajel t'a spatiktak skajnub' Dios.

Axo junxo winh, aton winhaj Matanías yuninal winhaj Micaía. Axo heb' smam yicham winh, aton winhaj Zabdi yet' winhaj Asaf. Ha winhaj Matanías chi' skuchb'an heb' sb'itan wach' lolonel yet' ak'oj yuj diosal t'a stiempoal lesal. Axo winhaj Bacbuquías schab'il kuchb'um yaj winh. Axo junxo winh, aton winhaj Abda yuninal winhaj Samúa. Axo heb' smam yicham winh, aton winhaj Galal yet' winhaj Jedutún.
Ha sb'isul heb' yinhtilal Leví ix kan kajan t'a schonhab' Dios chi', 284 heb' t'a smasanil.
Axo heb' tanhwum puerta, 172 sb'isul heb'. Ha winhaj Acub yet' winhaj Talmón yajal t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok stanhwan puerta chi'.
Axo juntzanhxo heb' quetisraelal, heb' sakerdote yet' juntzanhxo heb' lewita, ix kajnaj junjun heb' t'a smakb'en t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá.
Ha heb' smunlaj t'a templo, ix kajnaj heb' t'a Jerusalén t'a jun tzalan skuchan Ofel. Axo winhaj Ziha yet' winhaj Gispa skuchb'an heb' t'a munlajel chi'.

Ha winhaj Uzi yajal t'a skal heb' lewita yinhtilal winhaj Asaf t'a Jerusalén chi', aton heb' winh skuchb'an b'it t'a skajnub' Dios. Ha heb' smam yicham winhaj Uzi chi', aton winhaj Bani, winhaj Hasabías, winhaj Matanías yet' winhaj Micaía.
D'a stzolal tz'aj yoch heb' sb'itan t'a junjun k'u icha yalan winh rey.
Ha mach tz'och t'a yichanh winh rey yuj yalnhej tas scheknab'il heb' chonhab', aton winhaj Petaías. Ha heb' smam yicham winh, aton winhaj Mesezabeel yinhtilalkan winhaj Zera yuninal winhaj Judá.

Ha juntzanhxo heb' yinhtilal Judá, ix kajnaj heb' t'a juntzanh chonhab' tik yet' t'a masanil yaldeail: Aton t'a Quiriat-arba, t'a Dibón, t'a Jecabseel, t'a Jesúa, t'a Molada, t'a Bet-pelet, t'a Hazar-sual, t'a Beerseba, t'a Siclag, t'a Mecona, t'a En-rimón, t'a Zora, t'a Jarmut, t'a Zanoa, t'a Adulam, t'a Laquis yet' t'a Azeca. Ix kajnajpax heb' b'aj sb'o munlajel. Ix aj heb' t'a Beerseba masanto ix k'ek'och heb' t'a sch'olanil yik Hinom.

Axo heb' yinhtilal Benjamín, ix kajnaj heb' t'a juntzanh chonhab' tik: Aton t'a Geba, t'a Micmas, Aía, Betel yet' t'a yaldeail, Anatot, Nob, Ananías, Hazor, Ramá, Gitaim, Hadid, Seboim, Nebalat, Lod, Ono yet' t'a sch'olanil yik heb' b'oum k'een.
Ay pax heb' lewita ix scha smakb'en t'a yol yik Judá yet' t'a yol yik Benjamín.

Ay juntzanh heb' winh sakerdote yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh lewita janakxi yet' winhaj Zorobabel yuninal winhaj Salatiel yet' winhaj Jesúa yajal t'a heb' winh. Aton heb' winh tik: Vinhaj Seraías, winhaj Jeremías, winhaj Esdras, winhaj Amarías, winhaj Maluc, winhaj Hatús, winhaj Sekanías, winhaj Rehum, winhaj Meremot, winhaj Iddo, winhaj Gineto, winhaj Abías, winhaj Mijamín, winhaj Maadías, winhaj Bilga, winhaj Semaías, winhaj Joiarib, winhaj Jedaías, winhaj Salú, winhaj Amoc, winhaj Hilcías yet' winhaj Jedaías. Aton heb' winh tik yajal yaj t'a skal heb' winh yetsakerdoteal t'a yol stiempoal winhaj Jesúa.

Axo pax heb' winh lewita, aton heb' winh tik: Vinhaj Jesúa, winhaj Binúi, winhaj Cadmiel, winhaj Serebías, winhaj Judá yet' winhaj Matanías. Yajal yaj heb' winh t'a heb' winh sb'itan wach' lolonel d'ha Dios.
Axo winhaj Bacbuquías yet' winhaj Uni yet' heb' winh skolwaj yet' heb' winh, a heb' winh stak'wi t'a skal heb' winh sb'itan chi'.
Ha sb'i heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Jesúa t'a stzolal, aton winhaj Joiacim, winhaj Eliasib, winhaj Joiada, winhaj Jonatán yet' winhaj Jadúa.

Ha sb'i heb' winh sakerdote yajal t'a junjun makan heb' yetsakerdoteal t'a stiempoal winhaj sat sakerdote Joiacim, aton heb' winh tik: Ha winhaj Meraías yajal t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Seraías. Ha winhaj Hananías yajal t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jeremías. Ha winhaj Mesulam yajal t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Esdras. Ha winhaj Johanán yajal t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Amarías. Ha winhaj Jonatán yajal t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Melicú. Ha winhaj José yajal t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Sebanías. Ha winhaj Adna yajal t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Harim. Ha winhaj Helcai yajal t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Meraiot. Ha winhaj Zacarías yajal t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Iddo. Ha winhaj Mesulam yajal t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Ginetón. Ha winhaj Zicri yajal t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Abías. Ha winhaj Piltai yajal t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Miniamín yet' t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Moadías. Ha winhaj Samúa yajal t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Bilga. Ha winhaj Jonatán yajal t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Semaías. Ha winhaj Matenai yajal t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Joiarib. Ha winhaj Uzi yajal t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jedaías. Ha winhaj Calai yajal t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Salai. Ha winhaj Eber yajal t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Amoc. Ha winhaj Hasabías yajal t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Hilcías. Ha winhaj Natanael yajal t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jedaías.

Ayic ayoch winhaj Eliasib, winhaj Joiada, winhaj Johanán yet' winhaj Jadúa t'a sat sakerdoteal, ix tz'ib'chaj sb'i heb' lewita yajal t'a junjun makan yinhtilal yet' heb' sakerdote. Ixlajwi stz'ib'chaj sb'i heb' chi' t'a stiempoal winhaj Darío sreyal Persia.
Axo sb'i heb' lewita yajal t'a junjun makan yinhtilal, aykan b'aj tz'ib'ab'il yab'ixal templo. Ix tz'ib'chajnhej jun lista chi' masanto t'a stiempoal winhaj Johanán yixchiquin winhaj Eliasib.

Ha winhaj Hasabías, winhaj Serebías, winhaj Jesúa yuninal winhaj Cadmiel yet' heb' winh skolwaj yet' heb' winh, a heb' winh ixb’o’an cha makan heb' sb'itani yik syak'an yuj diosal heb' t'a Jehová, icha ajnak yalan winhaj rey Dawid schekab' Dios.

Axo heb' winh stanhwumal juntzanh kuarto b'aj molan tastak ay t'a slak'anil spuertail templo, aton heb' winh tik: Vinhaj Matanías, winhaj Bacbuquías, winhaj Obadías, winhaj Mesulam, winhaj Talmón yet' winhaj Acub.

Aton heb' winh ayoch t'a yopisio chi' t'a stiempoal winhaj Joiacim yuninal winhaj Jesúa yixchiquin winhaj Josadac, aton t'a stiempoal ayik ayin och a in Nehemías in tik yajalil, ayik ayek' winhaj sakerdote Esdras k'ayb'um paxi.

Ayic ix k'och sk'ual yak'jikanoch smuroal Jerusalén t'a yol sk'ab' Dios, ix awtajkot masanil heb' lewita t'a junjun chonhab'. Ix jawi heb' t'a Jerusalén yuj jun q'uinh chi', yik syalanpax wach' lolonel heb' d'ha Dios, yik sb'itanpax heb' t'a tzalajk'olal yet' k'een platillo, te' arpa yet' te' lira.
Ha heb' sb'itan chi', ix kot heb' t'a slak'anil Jerusalén, t'a yaldeail Netofa,
t'a yol yik Gilgal, t'a yol smakb'en Geba yet' t'a yol yik Azmawet, yujto ha t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a slak'anil Jerusalén chi' kajan heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix sakb'itan sb'a heb' sakerdote yet' heb' lewita icha yalan ley. Ix sakb'itan pax heb' anima heb' yet' spuertail chonhab' yet' smuroal.

Ixlajwi chi', a in Nehemías in tik, ix in chekk'e heb' yajal yik Judá t'a yib'anh muro chi'. Ix wak'anoch chab' makan heb' sb'itani yik syak'an yuj diosal heb'. Ha heb' b'ab'el makan, ix b'at heb' t'a yib'anh muro chi' t'a stojolal ko wach', b'aj ay jun puerta b'aj sb'atkan k'alem.
Axo t'a spatik heb' chi' tzak'anoch winhaj Osaías yet' nanhalxo heb' yajal yaj t'a Judá.
Tzak'anpax heb' winh sakerdote, aton heb' winh tik: Vinhaj Azarías, winhaj Esdras, winhaj Mesulam,
winhaj Judá, winhaj Benjamín, winhaj Semaías yet' winhaj Jeremías.

Van spu'an k'een strompeta junjun heb' winh. Tzak'anpax juntzanhxo heb' winh tik: Aton winhaj Zacarías yuninal winhaj Jonatán, haxo heb' smam yicham winh, aton winhaj Semaías, winhaj Matanías, winhaj Micaías, winhaj Zacur yet' winhaj Asaf.

Ajun pax juntzanh heb' winh sk'ab'yok heb' winh, aton winhaj Semaías, winhaj Azarael, winhaj Milalai, winhaj Gilalai, winhaj Maai, winhaj Natanael, winhaj Judá yet' winhaj Hanani. Aton heb' winh chi' sk'anan juntzanh yamk'ab' yik b'it icha yak'nak winhaj rey Dawid, winh schekab' Dios. Axo t'a yichanh heb' winh, b'ab'el sb'at winhaj Esdras winh k'ayb'um.

Ix ek' heb' t'a yib'anh spuertail sjaj ha ha', ix b'atnhej heb' t'a yichanh t'a yib'anh muro chi'. Ix k'e heb' t'a jun b'e b'akhquiltak sk'e t'a schonhab' winhaj Dawid, ix ek' heb' t'a yib'anh spalakiokan winh, masanto ix k'och heb' t'a spuertail b'aj tz'el heb' ix ix ik'oj ha' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u.

Axo junxo schab'il makan heb' sb'itan chi', ix b'atkan heb' t'a stojolal ko k'exanh. Tzak'an in t'a spatik heb' t'a yib'anh muro chi' yet' nanhalxo heb' anima. Ix onh b'atnhej t'a torre skuchan Hornos, masanto b'aj lewan sat muro chi'.

Onh ek' t'a puerta skuch Efraín, t'a puerta skuch Jesana, t'a puerta yik nok' chay, t'a torre skuch Hananeel yet' torre skuch Hamea, masanto t'a puerta yik nok' kalnel. Ix onh och waan t'a puerta b'aj ay heb' stanhwani.
Ix ko chalaj ko b'a yet' junxo makan heb' sb'itan chi' t'a yichanhkot templo b'aj tz'och b'it t'a ko Mam Dios. Ajun pax nanhalxo heb' yajal wed'ok.
Ajun pax heb' winh sakerdote spu'an k'een strompeta: Aton winhaj Eliacim, winhaj Maaseías, winhaj Miniamín, winhaj Micaías, winhaj Elioenai, winhaj Zacarías, winhaj Hananías,

winhaj Maasías, winhaj Semaías, winhaj Eleazar, winhaj Uzi, winhaj Johanán, winhaj Malquías, winhaj Elam yet' winhaj Ezer. Ha heb' winh sb'itan chi' te chaanh ix b'itan heb' winh. Ha winhaj Izrahías skuchb'an heb' winh.

Ha wal t'a jun k'u chi' te niwan nok' silab' ix yak' heb' anima chi' d'ha Dios. Ix te tzalaj heb' yujto ha Dios ix ak'an jun niwan tzalajk'olal chi' t'a heb'. Anhejtona' heb' ix ix yet' heb' unin, ix te tzalajpax heb'. Ha jun tzalajk'olal ix uji t'a Jerusalén chi', ix ab'chaj t'a najat.

Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ay juntzanhxo heb' ix ak'jioch yilumalok b'aj smolchaj ofrenda, b'ab'el sat awb'en yet' diezmo, icha jantak tas skot t'a junjun lugar t'a yol yik junjun chonhab'. Ha juntzanh chi' yik heb' sakerdote yet' heb' lewita yaji icha yalan ley, yujto a masanil heb' anima chi' ste tzalaj heb' yet' heb' sakerdote chi' yet' pax heb' lewita chi', yujto smunlaj heb' t'a skajnub' Dios.

Yuj chi' a heb' sakerdote chi', heb' sb'itani yet' heb' stanhwan puerta, ix sk'anab'ajej heb' sk'ulan icha yalan sley Dios yik sakb'itan sb'a heb'. Ix sk'anab'ajej pax heb' icha yalnakkan winhaj rey Dawid yet' winhaj Salomón.
Yujto ha t'a stiempoal winhaj rey Dawid chi' yet' winhaj Asaf, ay heb' yajalil heb' sb'itan chi', aton heb' sb'itan wach' lolonel yet' ak'oj yuj diosal d'ha Dios.

Yuj chi' ha t'a stiempoal winhaj Zorobabel yet' in Nehemías in tik, masanil heb' anima, t'a junjun k'u syak' swael heb' sb'itan heb', heb' stanhwan puerta yet' heb' lewita ay yalan yik schaani. Axo pax heb' lewita chi' tz'ak'an yik heb' sakerdote yinhtilal winhaj Aarón.
Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', ix awtaj ch'anh ley Moisés yab' heb' anima. Ix ilchaj yuj heb' t'a ch'anh to a heb' amonita yet' heb' moabita malaj b'ak'uinh syal yaj heb' t'a skal heb' schonhab' Dios,

yujto ayik spetoj heb' ko mam quicham t'a Egipto, a heb' chi' maj eltalaj heb' scha heb' yet' wael, ma tas tz'uk'chaji. Palta to stup winhaj Balaam heb' yik sb'at skatab'an heb' ko mam quicham chi' winh, palta a ko Diosal k'exan jun katab' chi' t'a wach'ilal.
Yuj chi' ayik ix yab'an heb' quetchonhab' chi' tas syal ch'anh ley chi', ix yik'anel sb'a heb' t'a skal heb' ch'ok chonhab'il kajan t'a skal heb'.

Ayic manto uji jun chi', a winhaj sakerdote Eliasib chi' ayoch yajalil yilan juntzanh b'aj molan tastak tz'ak'ji t'a skajnub' ko Diosal. Ha winhaj Eliasib chi' wach' yak'an winh yet' winhaj Tobías, yuj chi' ix yak' jun niwan kuarto winh t'a winhaj Tobías chi'.

Ha jun kuarto chi', aton b'aj smolchajtaxon ofrenda, inkienso, yamk'ab', sdiezmoal ixim trigo, wino yet' akeite, aton juntzanh chi' ix alchaji to tz'ak'ji t'a heb' lewita, t'a heb' sb'itani yet' t'a heb' tanhwum puerta yet' pax juntzanh kolwal tz'ak'ji t'a heb' sakerdote.

Palta ayik ix uji jun chi', a in tik manh in ayok ek' t'a Jerusalén tik, yujto ayik 32 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Artajerjes reyal t'a Babilonia, ata' ix in k'ochxi t'a yichanh winh rey chi'. Palta ayik toxo ix ek' jab'okxo tiempoal ix in k'ananxi in permiso t'a winh rey chi',
ix in jax t'a Jerusalén tik. Ata' ix wab'i tastak manh wach'ok ix sk'ulej winhaj Eliasib chi', to ix yak' jun niwan kuarto winh, aton jun ay t'a sti' yamaq'uil stemplo Dios t'a winhaj Tobías chi'.
Ix kot wal wowal yuj jun chi', yuj chi' a tas ayoch yuj winhaj Tobías t'a yol kuarto chi', ix in julelta t'a sti'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix walani to sakb'itaj jun kuarto chi' icha yalan ley, tz'ak'chajxioch yamk'ab' yik stemplo Dios chi' t'a yool, ofrenda yet' inkienso.
Ix wab'anpaxi to maxtzak ak'chaj swael heb' lewita yet' heb' sb'itani, aton heb' ayoch t'a yib'anh yoch ejmelal, yuj chi' ix yaktejkan yopisio heb', ix pax heb' t'a schonhab' junjun.
Yuj chi' ix in tumej heb' yajal yaji, yujto ix yaktejkan stemplo Dios heb', maxtzak yil-laj heb'. Ixlajwi chi' ix in molb'an heb' sakerdote yet' heb' lewita yik swak'anxioch heb' t'a yopisio.
Axo masanil heb' anima aj Judá tik, ix syamxioch heb' yak'an sdiezmoal ixim trigo, wino yet' akeite, ix yak'anxi heb' b'aj smolchaji.

Ixlajwi chi' ix wak'anoch winhaj sakerdote Selemías yilumalok b'aj smolchaj chi' yet' pax winhaj Sadoc winh tz'ib'um yet' pax jun winh lewita skuchan Pedaías yet' winhaj Hanán yuninal winhaj Zacur yixchiquin winhaj Matanías yik skolwaj winh yet' heb' winh, yujto te wach' spensar heb' winh. Aton heb' winh ix ochkan t'a yib'anh spojanek' wael t'a masanil heb' yetb'eyum chi'.
Ix walan icha tik t'a in lesal: Ach in Diosal, nakot juntzanh tas ix in k'ulej tik. Mokab' b'at satk'olal uj masanil tas ix in k'ulej t'a a kajnub' yik tz'och ejmelal t'ayach, xin chi.

Ha t'a juntzanh k'ual chi', ix wila'' to ay heb' t'a yol yik Judá tik stek'anel yal uwa t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip. Tz'ek'pax heb' kuchoj trigo, tzek'pax nok' sb'uru heb' kuchoj wino yet' kuchoj sat uwa ayto och t'a sk'ojlab'il, kuchoj higo yet' yalnhej tas ikatzil. Syik'ankot juntzanh chi' heb' t'a Jerusalén tik t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip. Yuj chi' ix in kach heb' to maxtzak schonh juntzanh chi' heb' t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip.
Anhejtona' ay pax juntzanh heb' aj Tiro kajan t'a Jerusalén, syik'kot nok' chay heb' yet' juntzanhxo tastak schonh t'a Jerusalén tik, schonhan heb' t'a heb' quetisraelal t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip.
Yuj chi' ix in kach heb' yajal yaj t'a Judá tik, ix walan t'a heb' icha tik: --Manh jantakok chukal tze k'ulej t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip, icha junok komon k'ual tzeyutej.

Aton juntzanh tik sk'ulejnak heb' ko mam quicham, yuj chi' ix yak'kot juntzanh yaelal tik ko Diosal t'a quib'anh yet' t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik. ¿Tom he gana tze tzuntzejkot yowal sk'ol Dios t'a quib'anh a onh israel onh tik, yuj chi' icha junok komon k'ual tzeyutej sk'ual ik'oj ip tik? xin chi t'a heb'.

Ix in chekan makchaj spuertail Jerusalén tik t'a yemk'ualil ayik wan yoch sk'ual ik'oj ip. Max jakwilaj masanto tzek'b'at jun k'ual chi'. Ix wak'anpaxoch heb' in chekab' stanhwan puerta chi' yik wach' malaj junok ikatz tz'och t'a jun k'u chi'.
Ha heb' chonhwajum chi' chab' oxe' ak'wal ix way heb' t'a spatiktak chonhab' Jerusalén tik.

Yuj chi' ix in kachan heb', ix walani: ¿Tas yuj tzex waykan t'a spatiktak muro? Tato ol he k'ulejnhej icha tik, ol ex wak'och t'a preso, xin chi t'a heb'. Yuj chi' ix yaktej heb' sjawi t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix walan t'a heb' lewita to sakb'itej sb'a heb' yik sb'at stanhwan puerta chi' heb', yik wach' max ixtaxel sk'ual ik'oj ip chi'. Yuj chi' ix wal t'a in lesal icha tik: Ach in Diosal, na in kot yuj juntzanh tas ix in k'ulej tik, ok'okab' a k'ol t'ayin icha syal a wach'k'olal, xin chi.
Anheja' ix wilanpax t'a juntzanh k'ual chi' to ay heb' winh wetisraelal chi' ix yik'laj sb'a yet' heb' ix aj Asdod, heb' ix aj Amón yet' heb' ix aj Moab.
Nanhalxo yal yuninal heb' tzaxo alan sti' heb' aj Asdod chi' yet' sti' juntzanhxo nakión. Axo pax ko ti' a onh israel onh tik, maxtzak yal-laj yalan heb'.

Yuj chi' ix in tumej heb', ix in katab'an heb'. Ay heb' ix in mak'a', ix in tzuquel xil sjolom heb', ix wak'an pural heb' yak'an sti' d'ha Dios to manhxo ol yik'laj sb'a yal yuninal heb' yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il chi', manhxo ol ochlaj heb' ix ch'ok chonhab'il chi' yetb'eyumok heb'. Ix walanpaxi:

Icha wal tik aj yochnak smul winhaj Salomón ochnak reyal t'a ko chonhab' tik. Malaj junokxo rey lajan yet' winh t'a juntzanhxo nakión, te xajan winh yuj Dios, yuj chi' ak'jinakoch winh ko reyalok yuj, palta kuchb'ajnakb'at winh t'a chukal yuj heb' ix ch'ok chonhab'il chi'.
Yuj chi', max yal ko k'ool tzeyak'och he mul te chuk t'a yichanh ko Diosal, tzeyik'lan he b'a yet' heb' ix ch'ok chonhab'il tik, xin chi t'a heb' winh.
Ha junok heb' yuninal winhaj Joiada, yixchiquin winhaj Eliasib sat sakerdote, a ix yisil winhaj Sanbalat, winh aj Horón, a ix yetb'eyum winh. Yuj chi' ix in spechel winh t'a Jerusalén tik.

Yuj chi' ix wal t'a in lesal icha tik: Ach in Diosal, il wal juntzanh chukal ix sk'ulej heb', yuj chi' ix juwiel jun opisio yik sakerdoteal yet' trato ix a b'o yet' heb' yet' pax heb' yinhtilal Leví, xin chi.
Icha chi' ix aj in b'oan tastak ix juwib'at yuj heb' ch'ok chonhab'il chi', ix wak'anxioch heb' sakerdote yet' heb' lewita t'a yopisio t'a stzolal.

Ix walani tas k'ual tz'ik'chajkot te' k'atzitz. Ix walanpax yuj sb'ab'el sat awb'en yowalil syik'kot heb' t'a skajnub' Dios. Yuj chi' ix wal t'a in lesal icha tik: Ach in Diosal, na in koti, ok'okab' a k'ol t'ayin, xin chi.
Ha jun syalkan tik ix uji ayik ayoch winhaj Asuero reyal t'a Persia. 127 makanhil yaj smakb'en winh chi', skot t'a India masanto sk'och t'a Etiopía.
Axo t'a chonhab' Susa, ata' ay spalakio winh rey chi'.

Ayic yoxil ab'il yoch winhaj Asuero chi' reyal, ix yak'an jun niwan wael winh t'a heb' niwak winak ayoch yajalil yet'ok, aton heb' yajalil heb' soldado yik Persia, heb' yik Media, heb' niwak yelk'ochi yet' heb' ayoch yajalil t'a junjun makan smakb'en winh chi'.
Nanhal ab'il wal ix yak' jun q'uinh chi' winh, yik sch'oxanel jantak sb'eyumal winh yet' sniwanil yelk'och yopisio winh t'a heb' awtab'il chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'anoch uquexo k'ual q'uinh winh t'a yamaq'uil spalakio. Masanil heb' ayek' t'a chonhab' Susa chi', heb' niwak yelk'ochi yet' heb' malaj yelk'ochi, ix awtaj heb' smasanil.

Te wach' ix aj sb'o b'aj ix och q'uinh chi'. Ha k'apak saksak k'apak yet' k'apak yaax ix och skortinailok. Anhejtona' pax k'apak lino saksak yet' k'apak k'ik' mutz'inak ayoch sch'anhalok pax k'apak kortina chi'. Yamb'il k'apak yuj k'een argolla nab'a plata ayoch t'a juntzanh k'een oy nab'a mármol. Axo xila, a k'een oro yet' k'een plata ayoch t'ay. Axo t'a sat lu'um, a k'een mármol ayem t'ay, ay k'een saksak, ay k'een q'uiq'uik'.
Axo juntzanh waso nab'a oro syuk'lab'ej heb'. Ch'okch'ok yilji junjun waso chi'. Te niwan wino ix el t'a sk'ol winh rey chi' yak'ani.
Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a heb' yajal yaj t'a heb' tz'ak'an serwil winh to malaj junok mach tz'ak'chaj pural yuk'an wino chi', junjun heb' syal yuk'an heb' jantak snib'ej.
Anhejtona' pax ix reina Vasti, ix schek pax b'ochaj jun niwan wael ix t'a spalakio winh rey chi' yik wach' swa heb' ix ix awtab'il.

Ha wal t'a yuquil k'ual q'uinh chi', ix te tzalaj sk'ol winh rey chi' yuj wino. Yuj chi' ix schekb'at ukwanh heb' winh yak'umal serwil winh, heb' winh ayoch yipok sk'ol winh, aton winhaj Mehumán, winhaj Bizta, winhaj Harbona, winhaj Bigta, winhaj Abagta, winhaj Zetar yet' winhaj Carcas.

Ix chekjib'at heb' winh yik b'at yik'ankot ix reina Vasti chi' heb' winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi', yujto snib'ej winh sjawi ix yet' skorona kopopi yilji, yik sch'oxanpaxel swach'il yilji ix t'a yichanh masanil heb' anima yet' t'a yichanh heb' niwak yajal, yujto te wach' yilji ix.
Palta maj stak'kotlaj sb'a ix. Ix stenek' ix tas ix b'at yal heb' winh schekab' winh rey chi'. Yuj chi' ix te kot yowal winh rey chi'.

Ix yawtankot ukwanh heb' winh niwak yopisio t'a Media yet' t'a Persia chi' winh, heb' winh yipk'olal yaj yuj winh: Aton winhaj Carsena, winhaj Setar, winhaj Admata, winhaj Tarsis, winhaj Meres, winhaj Marsena yet' winhaj Memucán. Ha heb' winh chi', yojtak ley heb' winh sik'lab'il, yuj chi' t'a heb' winh ix sk'anb'ej winh rey chi' tas tz'aj jun chi' sb'oi.
Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Icha syal ko ley, naek wed'ok ¿tas yowalil tz'aj ix reina Vasti chi', yujto maj sk'anab'ajej in cheknab'il ix, ix b'at yal heb' winh in chekab'? xchi winh.

Ha wal t'a yichanh masanil heb' molan chi', ix yalan winhaj Memucán t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, a ix reina Vasti chi', manhoknhej t'ayach ix och smul ix, palta ix ochpax smul ix t'ayonh a onh niwak yajal onh tik yet' t'a masanil heb' winh winak ay t'a yol a makb'en tik.

Ha tas ix sk'ulej ix chi' ol yab' masanil heb' ix ix, ol sk'ayb'an heb' ix, manhxa ol aj yelk'och heb' winh yetb'eyum heb' ix t'a yol sat, ol am yalan heb' ix icha tik: Ha winhaj rey Asuero ix awtan ix reina Vasti, palta maj sk'anab'ajejlaj ix sb'ati, xcham heb' ix.

Ha heb' ix yetb'eyum heb' winh niwak yajal t'a Persia yet' t'a Media tik, ayik ol yab'an heb' ix tas ix yutej sb'a ix reina chi', ol laj yalan heb' ix t'a heb' winh yetb'eyum. Yuj chi' a yuj jun tik ol spatiquejel heb' winh yetb'eyum heb' ix, haxo skot yowal heb' winh chi' t'a heb' ix.

Yuj chi' jun mamin rey, tato wach' skan jun tik t'ayach, ak' tz'ib'chaj junok ley yik skan leyal t'a Persia yet' t'a Media tik, to maxtzak yal yek'b'ati: Manhxa b'ak'uinh sjawi ix reina Vasti t'a yichanh winh rey, xchiokab' jun ley chi'. Axo junokxo ix ek'to swach'il t'a yichanh ix chi', a ix tz'ochkan reinail sk'exulok ix.
Ha jun ley chi' yowalil tz'ak'chaj ojtakajel t'a masanil yol a makb'en tik yik wach' masanil heb' ix ix ol sk'anab'ajej wal heb' winh yetb'eyum heb' ix, yalnhej tas animail, xchi winh.
Ha jun ix yal winhaj Memucán chi', ix scha wal sk'ol winh rey chi' yet' masanil heb' ayek' yet' winh, ix och t'a yopisio yuj winh.

Yuj chi' ix schekan winh tz'ib'chajb'at t'a junjun makan t'a yol smakb'en chi', t'a sti' junjun chonhab'. Ix yalanb'at winh to ayokab' yelk'och heb' winh winak t'a yol spat, aokab' heb' winh tz'alani tastak sb'oi.
Ix ek' junok tiempoal, ix sikb'i yowal sk'ol winhaj rey Asuero chi'. Ix snaankot winh tas ix sk'ulej ix Vasti chi' yet' pax jun ley ix alchajel yuj ix.
Yuj chi' haxo heb' winh ayoch yajalil yet' winh t'a yol smakb'en chi', ix yal heb' winh icha tik: --Yowalil saychajkot heb' ix kob'estak t'a winh rey tik, aton heb' ix te wach' yilji.

Sik'okab' winh rey tik junjunok schekab' t'a junjun makan t'a yol smakb'en tik, yik wach' a heb' winh tz'ik'ankot masanil heb' ix kob'estak te wach' yilji. Sjawi heb' ix t'a spalakio winh t'a chonhab' Susa tik, tz'ochkan heb' ix t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Hegai, winh stanhwan heb' ix yetb'eyum winh rey tik. Ha winh tz'ak'an serwil heb' ix yik ste b'o yilji heb' ix.

Ha junok ix kob'es ol scha sk'ol winh rey tik, aton ix ol ochkan reinail sk'exulok ix Vasti chi', xchi heb' winh. Ha jun pensar chi', ix scha wal sk'ol winh rey chi', yuj chi' ix schek winh k'ulaj icha chi'.
Ha t'a chonhab' Susa chi', ata' kajan jun winh israel skuchan Mardoqueo yuninal winhaj Jair yinhtilal winhaj Simei. Ha winhaj Simei chi', a winhaj Cis ay yinhtilal winh t'a yinhtilal Benjamín.
Ha heb' smam yicham winh, ik'b'ilkot heb' yuj winhaj rey Nabucodonosor t'a Jerusalén, jawinakkan heb' t'a Babilonia. Junnhej janakkan heb' yet' winhaj Jeconías sreyal Judá.

Ha winhaj Mardoqueo chi', ay jun ix yisil jun winh sk'ab'yok winh ayek' yet'ok, aton ix Hadasa, syalelk'ochi Ester, meb'a' ix, yujto chamnak smam snun ix. Axo winhaj Mardoqueo chi' ix ilan q'uib' ix, icha wal yisil winh yaj ix. Te wach' yilji sat ix yet' sniwanil.

Axo yik ix elta jun ley yuj winh rey chi', tzijtum heb' ix kob'estak ix molchaj t'a chonhab' Susa t'a spalakio winh. Ha winhaj Hegai ix ak'chajoch stanhwumalok heb' ix, aton winh stanhwantaxon heb' ix yetb'eyum winh rey chi'. Ayoch ix Ester chi' t'a skal heb' ix.

Te wach' spensar ix ix yiloch winhaj Hegai chi', yuj chi' te wach' ix yutej spensar winh t'a ix. Elanhchamel ix te ak'chaj juntzanh remeyo yik tz'ak'chajoch t'a sniwanil ix yik ste b'o yilji ix, tz'ak'chaj pax wael te wach' t'a ix. Ix ak'chajoch ukwanh heb' ix schekab' winh rey te wach' yik tz'ak'ji serwil ix. Ix ak'chajb'at heb' ix yet' ix Ester chi' t'a jun kuarto te wach' b'aj ay heb' ix yetb'eyum winh rey chi'.
Ha ix Ester chi' malaj jab'ok tas ix yal ix tas inhtilal, ma tas chonhab'il ix, yujto ix cham wal yalan winhaj Mardoqueo chi' t'a ix to max yal-laj ix.
Junjun k'u tzek' winhaj Mardoqueo t'a sat b'aj ayek' heb' ix ix chi', yik syab'an winh tato wach' sk'ol ix Ester chi' yet' tas tz'aj yak'ji serwil ix.

Masanil juntzanh heb' ix kob'estak chi', jun ab'il ix b'ochaj yilji heb' ix. D'a sb'ab'elal waque' ujal sukchajek' akeite yik mirra t'a sniwanil heb' ix. Axo t'a junxo waque' ujal, sukchajek' perfume yet' krema t'a heb' ix ichataxon juntzanh sk'an heb' ix ix. Axo yik ix el yab'ilal sb'ochaj yilji heb' ix chi', junjunal ix ik'jib'at heb' ix yik sway heb' ix yet' winh rey chi'.
Icha chi' ix aj sk'och junjun heb' ix t'a winh rey chi'. Ayic tz'elta heb' ix b'aj ayek' heb' ix kob'estak chi', syalnhej sk'anan heb' ix tastak snib'ej yik sb'oan sb'a heb' ix.

Sb'at heb' ix t'a spalakio winh rey chi' t'a yemk'ualil, haxo t'a junxo q'uinhib'alil, sk'ochkan heb' ix t'a junxo pat b'aj ay heb' ix schab'il yetb'eyum winh rey chi', b'aj ayoch winhaj Saasgaz yilumalok heb' ix yuj winh rey chi'. Majxo k'ochlaj heb' ix t'a winh rey chi', anhej tato ay junok heb' ix te wach', scha sk'ol winh, a jun ix chi' tz'awtaj sb'i, sb'at ix b'ian.

Axo ix aji, ayik ix k'och stzolal t'a yib'anh ix Ester yisilkan winhaj Abihail, sk'ab'yok winhaj Mardoqueo chi', yik b'at way ix yet' winh rey chi', anhej tas ix yal winhaj Hegai stanhwumal heb' ix, anhej ix yik'b'at ix. Te wach' ix Ester chi' t'a yol sat masanil heb' tz'ilan ix.
Ayic slajunhil uj, t'a jun uj skuchan Tebet, ayik yuquil ab'il yoch winhaj Asuero reyal, ata' ix ik'chajb'at ix t'a spalakio winh yik sway ix yet' winh.

Yelxo wal te xajan ix Ester chi' yuj winh rey chi'. Malaj junokxo ix te xajan yuj winh. Te niwan swach'k'olal winh ix sch'ox t'a ix t'a yichanh juntzanhxo heb' ix kob'estak chi'. Yuj chi' ix schek winh ak'chajk'e jun korona t'a sjolom ix. Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'ankanoch ix winh reinail sk'exulok ix Vasti.

Ix schekan b'ojok jun niwan wael winh yik tz'ik'jichaanh ix Ester chi'. Ix yawtan masanil heb' yajal ayoch t'a yopisio yet' winh t'a yol smakb'en chi'. Ix yik'anemta sb'isul k'een tumin winh ayoch t'a yib'anh heb' anima yak'ani. Te tzijtum pax tas ix yak' winh t'a juntzanh nakión ay t'a yol smakb'en chi'. Icha chi' ix aj sch'oxanel swach'k'olal winh rey chi'.
Ayic toxo ix k'exchaj b'aj kajan heb' ix kob'estak chi', ayik ayxo och winhaj Mardoqueo t'a yopisio t'a spalakio winh rey,
a ix Ester chi' anheja' max yal-laj ix tas chonhab'il ix, tas yinhtilal ix. Anheja' sk'anab'ajan ix tas syal winhaj Mardoqueo chi', icha ix sk'anab'ajej ix ayik ayek' ix t'a spat winh.

Ha junel, ayik ix k'och stzolal t'a yib'anh winhaj Mardoqueo t'a yopisio t'a palakio winh rey chi', ay chawanh heb' winh stanhwan b'aj ay winh rey chi', aton winhaj Bigtán yet' winhaj Teres. Te aykot yowal heb' winh t'a winh rey chi', wan yalan heb' winh tas syutej heb' winh smilancham winh rey chi'.

Ix yab'an winhaj Mardoqueo tas wan yalan heb' winh chi', haxo winh ix chekan aljok t'a ix reina Ester chi'. Axo ix ix alan t'a winh rey chi' to a winhaj Mardoqueo ix ab'an tas wan yalchaj t'a spatik winh.

Axo ix sk'anb'an winh yab'i, ix cheklaji to yel jun lolonel ix yal winhaj Mardoqueo chi'. Yuj chi' a chawanh heb' winh stanhwumal winh rey chi', ix k'e lokan heb' winh t'a te te'. Ha jun ix uji chi' ix stz'ib'chajkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal winhaj rey Asuero ayik ix yak'an reyal winh.

Ixlajwi yek' juntzanh chi', ix yak'anoch yopisio winhaj Amán yuninal winhaj Hamedata yinhtilal winhaj Agag winh rey chi'. Ix ak'jioch winh sat yajalil t'a juntzanhxo heb' winh yajal t'a yol smakb'en winh rey chi'.

Masanil heb' winh tz'ak'an serwil winh rey chi', yowalil tz'em kuman heb' winh, tz'empax nhojan heb' winh t'a yichanh winhaj Amán chi', yujto icha chi' ix aj yalan winh rey chi'. Axo pax winhaj Mardoqueo chi', max sk'anab'ajejlaj jun cheknab'il chi' winh.
Axo juntzanhxo heb' winh yajal chi', ix sk'anb'an heb' winh t'a winhaj Mardoqueo chi' tas yuj max sk'anab'ajej jun cheknab'il chi' winh.

Junjun k'u syalan heb' winh t'a winh, palta max schalaj yab' winh tas syal heb' winh chi', yujto toxo ix yal winh t'a heb' winh to israel winh. Yuj chi' ix b'at yalan heb' winh t'a winhaj Amán chi' yik syilan heb' winh tato tonhej ol yiloch winh winhaj Amán chi'.
Ayic ix yilan winhaj Amán to yel max emlaj kuman winhaj Mardoqueo chi', max empax nhojan winh t'a yichanh winh ayik tzek' winh, ix te kot yowal winh.

Toxo ix yab' winh to israel winhaj Mardoqueo chi', yuj chi' ix snaan winh to manhoknhej winh smiljichamok, palta ix sna winh tas tz'aj satjiel masanil heb' israel ayek' t'a yol smakb'en winhaj rey Asuero chi'.

Ha t'a b'ab'el uj skuch Nisán, yik slajchawil ab'il yoch winhaj Asuero reyal, ix och suerte t'a yichanh winhaj Amán yik syil winh tas k'ual, ma tas tiempoal ol elk'och jun tas sna winh chi'. Axo ix aji, ha t'a 13 yoch slajchawil uj skuch Adar, ix cheklaj sk'ual.

Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, ha t'a masanil chonhab' ay t'a yol a makb'en, ay jun makan anima ch'ok yeli. Ch'ok yel sley heb' t'a yichanh juntzanhxo chonhab', max sk'anab'ajej a ley heb'. Manh smojok skajnaj heb' t'a yol a makb'en tik.

Yuj chi' mamin rey, tato scha a k'ool, ak'elta junok ley yik syab' masanil chonhab' to satel juntzanh anima chi'. Tato icha chi' ol wak' junok 7,500 quintal k'een plata b'aj smolchaj k'een tz'ak'ji t'ayach, xchi winh.
Ix scha sk'ol winh rey tas ix yal winh chi', yuj chi' ix yik'el skolk'ab' winh b'aj ayoch sello, ix yak'an winh t'a winhaj Amán chi', aton winh ajk'ol t'a heb' israel.
Ix yalan winh rey chi' icha tik: --Ha k'een plata ix al chi', kanokab' k'een t'ayach, haxo heb' anima tzal chi', ik yaj heb', syal tza k'ulej tas nab'il uj t'a yib'anh heb', xchi winh t'a winh.

Ayic 13 yoch b'ab'el uj t'a yol ab'il chi', ix awtaj masanil heb' winh stz'ib'um winh rey chi' yik stz'ib'an jun ley chi' heb' winh ix yak'elta winhaj Amán chi', yik sb'at t'a masanil heb' yajal t'a junjun chonhab' t'a yol smakb'en winh rey chi'. Ha jun ley chi' ix tz'ib'chaj t'a sti' yet' t'a sletrail junjun chonhab'. Ix och sb'i winh rey chi' t'ay yet' sello winh.

Elanhchamel ix chekjib'at heb' winh chekab' t'a masanil yol smakb'en winh rey chi'. Syalan jun ley chi' to junnhej k'ual ol satjiel masanil heb' israel yet' masanil heb' yuninal heb'. Axo tastak ay t'a heb', ol ik'chajkanek' smasanil. Ha jun k'u ix cheklaj chi', aton t'a 13 yoch slajchawil uj skuch Adar.
Ix pukax jun ley chi' t'a masanil smakb'en winh rey chi'. Ix alchajel t'a skal masanil anima yik wach' listaxo yaj heb' anima t'a jun k'u chi'.

Elanhchamel ix pukaxb'at jun ley chi' icha ix aj yalan winh rey chi'. B'ab'el ix alchajel t'a yol chonhab' Susa. Yakb'an wan yuk'an anh winh rey yet' winhaj Amán chi', haxo heb' anima t'a chonhab' Susa chi', ix te somchajchaanh heb' yuj jun ley chi'.

Ayic ix yab'an winhaj Mardoqueo masanil tas ix alchaj chi', ix snik'chitanb'at spichul winh yuj sch'oxanel skusk'olal, ix yak'anoch pichul yik kusk'olal winh, ix yak'ank'e k'een tik'aq'uil taanh winh t'a sjolom, ix och ijan winh yek' t'a kal chonhab'. Tz'el yaw winh yuj kusk'olal.
Axo yik ix k'och winh t'a sti' spalakio winh rey, maj ochlaj winh t'a yool, yujto max chajiochlaj junok mach yuj winh rey chi' tato ayoch pichul yik kusk'olal yuj.

Anhejtona' t'a masanil chonhab' b'ajtak ix tz'ib'chajb'at jun ley chi', masanil heb' israel ix och t'a kusk'olal. Ayic ix sch'oxanel skusk'olal heb' chi', ix och heb' t'a tzek'ojk'olal. Tz'ok' heb', tz'el yaw heb', tzijtum heb' ix sjulek' jichan sb'ha t'a skal k'een tik'aq'uil taanh, ix yak'anoch pichul heb' yik kusk'olal.

Ha heb' ix ix tz'ak'an serwil ix reina Ester yet' heb' winh winak stanhwan ix, ix yal heb' yab' ix tas yaj winhaj Mardoqueo chi', yuj chi' ix te kus sk'ol ix, ix yak'anb'at pichul ix t'a winh yik syik'anel pichul yik kusk'olal ayoch chi' yuj winh, palta maj yal-laj sk'ol winh ix scha'a.

Axo ix Ester chi' ix awtankot jun winh schekab' winh rey skuch Hatac, schekab' pax winh ix. Ix schekanb'at winh ix t'a winhaj Mardoqueo yik b'at sk'anb'ej winh tas wan yuji, tas pax yuj icha chi' syutej sb'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix k'och winhaj Hatac chi' b'aj ayek' winhaj Mardoqueo chi' t'a jun parque t'a yichanh sti' spalakio winh rey chi', ix lolon winh yet' winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Mardoqueo masanil tastak tz'alchaj chi' t'ay yet' pax jantak sb'isul k'een plata syaltej winhaj Amán yik tz'och b'aj smolchaj k'een stumin winh rey yik wach' satjiel masanil heb' israel yalan winh.

Ix yak'anpax jun skopiail jun ley chi' winh t'a winhaj Hatac chi', yik sch'ox winh t'a ix Ester chi' yik syojtaquejel ix yuj tas wan yuji t'a chonhab' Susa chi'. Ix yalanpaxb'at winhaj Mardoqueo chi' to stewi ix t'a winh rey, tope wal syal yek'b'at jun ley chi' t'a yib'anh heb' yetchonhab' ix chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix paxta winhaj Hatac chi', ix ul yalan winh t'a ix Ester chi' masanil tas ix yalkot winhaj Mardoqueo chi'.
Ix schekanxib'at winhaj Hatac chi' ix yik b'at yalxi winh t'a winhaj Mardoqueo chi' icha tik:

Masanil mach ayoch schekab'ok winh rey yet' masanil chonhab' ayoch t'a yol smakb'en winh, yojtak heb' to ay jun ley tz'alani tato ay mach tz'och t'a yol sti' b'aj ay winh rey t'a spalakio, tato manh awtab'ilok yuj winh rey chi', b'enhej schami, taxonhej winak ma ix. Anhej b'ian tato syik'k'e sk'okoch winh rey chi', aton jun nab'a oro, sch'oxanelta winh t'ay, a jun chi' max chamlaj. Ha in tik, ayxo jun ujal max in awtaj yuj winh rey chi', xchib'at ix.
Ix yalan winhaj Hatac t'a winhaj Mardoqueo chi' masanil tas ix yal ix Ester chi'.
Yuj chi' ix spakanxi winh tas ix yal ix chi': Manh a nalaj to yujnhej to ayach ek' t'a spalakio winh rey chi' ol ach kolchajok yakb'an masanil heb' quetchonhab' ol cham heb'.

Tope yuj jun sjawi t'a quib'anh tik jun, yuj chi' ix ach sik'chajoch reinail, yik tzonh a kolani. Palta tato malaj tas ol al tiknaik, b'ajam ol kot junok mach ol onh kolanok, palta a ach tik ol ach satel yet' masanil heb' a k'ab'ok, xchib'at winh.
Ix yalanxib'at ix Ester chi' t'a winh icha tik:

Ixic, molb'ej masanil heb' quetchonhab' kajan t'a chonhab' Susa tik, tzex och t'a tzek'ojk'olal wuuj, malaj jab'ok tas tze wa''a, malaj pax tas tzeyuk'ej oxeok k'ual oxeok ak'wal. Ol och pax heb' ix tzin ak'an serwil t'a tzek'ojk'olal wed'ok. Ol lajwok chi', ol in b'at wil winh rey chi', wach'chom manh ichokta' yalan ley. Taxonhej tzin cham jun, chamok in okab'i, xchib'at ix.
Ix sk'anab'ajej winhaj Mardoqueo chi' masanil tas ix yal ix chi'.

Axo yik ix lajwiek' oxe' k'ual chi', ix sb'oan sb'a ix Ester chi', ix yak'anoch spichul ix yik sreinail. Ixlajwi chi' ix k'och ix t'a jun amak' ay t'a sti' jun yet'tal winh rey chi', b'aj k'ojanem winh t'a sk'ojnub' yik sreyal.
Ayic ix yilanelta winh to ayek' ix t'a stielta chi', ix sch'oxan winh to stzalaj winh yet' ix, ix yak'anelta sk'okoch winh nab'a oro. Ix ochk'och ix, ix och yub'yub' ix t'a snhi' k'een k'okoch chi'.
Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a ix icha tik: --¿Tas tzach ik'an reina Ester? ¿Tas tza nib'ej? Tato tza nib'ej tza k'an nanhalok in makb'en tik, syal wak'an t'ayach, xchi winh t'a ix. Ix tak'wi ix icha tik:
--Mamin rey, tato syal a k'ool, ay jun niwan wael ix wak' b'ochajok to tzach kot wael tiknaik yet' winhaj Amán, yujto niwan elk'och t'a yol in sat, xchi ix. Ix yalan winh icha tik:
--Avtejeccot winhaj Amán t'a elanhchamel to sk'anab'ajaj masanil tas snib'ej ix reina Ester tik, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix b'at winh rey yet' winhaj Amán t'a jun niwan wael ix sb'o ix Ester chi'.
Ayic wan yuk'an wino heb', ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a ix icha tik: --k'an masanil tas tza nib'ej t'ayin, ol wak' t'ayach, wach'chom tza k'an nanhalok in makb'en tik, syal wak'an t'ayach, xchi winh.
Ix yalan ix t'a winh icha tik: --Mamin rey, a wal tas tzin nib'ej tzin k'an t'ayach aton tik:

Tato yel xajan in uuj, tato b'ekan a k'ol ak'an tas tzin k'ana', schaokab' a k'ol a kotxi wael k'ik'an yet' winhaj Amán tik. Ol in chek b'ochaj junokxo wael, yujto te niwan elk'och t'a yol in sat. Ato k'ik'an chi' swal t'ayach tas tzin nib'ej, xchi ix.

Ix te tzalaj winhaj Amán ayik ix elta winh b'aj ix och wael chi', palta ayik ix yilan winh to ayek' winhaj Mardoqueo t'a sti' spalakio winh rey chi', ix te kot yowal winh yujto ayik ix ek' winh ta', maj k'elaj linhan winhaj Mardoqueo chi', maj empax nhojan winh.
Ha t'a jun rato chi' maj sch'oxel-laj schichonk'olal winh chi'. Axo yik ix k'och winh t'a spat, ix yawtankot juntzanh heb' yamigo winh, ix yawtanpaxkot ix yetb'eyum winh, aton ix Zeres.

Ix och ijan winh yik'anchaanh sb'a, ix yalan jantak sb'eyumal winh t'a heb', tzijtum pax yuninal winh. Ix yalanpax winh to ix sik'chajelta winh yuj winh rey t'a skal juntzanhxo heb' winh ayoch yajalil yet'ok, ix ak'chajoch winh yajalilok juntzanh heb' winh chi'.

Ix yalanxi winh icha tik: --Anhejtona' a innhej ix in awtajb'at wael yet' winh rey t'a jun niwan wael yuj ix reina Ester. Awtab'il in pax wael yet' winh rey chi' k'ik'an t'a junxo niwan wael syak' ix t'a winh rey chi'.
Palta ayik swilanoch jun winh israel skuchan Mardoqueo k'ojanem t'a sti' spalakio winh rey chi', masanil juntzanh tas ay t'ayin tik, manhxa jab'ok yelk'och t'a yol in sat, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix yal ix yetb'eyum winh chi' yet' heb' yamigo winh chi' icha tik: --Ak' b'ochajem junok te te' jun ch'anhil tz'ajk'e steel. Tza k'anan t'a winh rey chi', haxo k'ik'an q'uinhib'al sk'e d'unhan winhaj Mardoqueo chi' t'a te', yik wach' tzalajk'olal tzach b'at t'a jun niwan wael yet' winh rey chi', manhxa jab'ok tas tza na'a, xchi heb'. Ha jun pensar chi' ix scha sk'ol winhaj Amán chi', ix schekan winh b'ojok jun te te' chi'.
Ha wal t'a jun ak'wal chi', maj ochlaj swayanh winh rey chi', yuj chi' ix yal winh to tz'ik'chajkot juntzanh b'aj tz'ib'ab'il yab'ixal tastak ujinak t'a yol smakb'en winh chi', ix awtaj yab' winh.
Ix ilchaj b'aj syala' to a winhaj Mardoqueo ix alani tas yalnak winhaj Bigtán yet' winhaj Teres, stanhwumal sti' spalakio winh rey chi'. Ix sna heb' winh tas syutej smilancham winhaj rey Asuero chi'.

Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'ej winh rey chi' t'a heb' winh ayoch yopisio yuj winh: --¿Tas ak'b'il yet' tas utajnak winhaj Mardoqueo yuj jun tas sk'ulejnak winh tik? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi heb' winh: --Malaj wal jab'ok tas ak'b'il t'a winh, xchi heb' winh.

Ix yalan winh rey chi' icha tik: --¿Mach jun ayek' t'a yamaq'uil palakio tik? Ixiquec eyila', xchi winh. Ha wal ta' wan sjawi winhaj Amán yik tzul sk'anan winh t'a winh rey chi' to tz'ak'chajk'e lokan winhaj Mardoqueo t'a jun te te' toxo ix schek b'ojok winh.
Yuj chi' ix yal heb' winh schekab' winh rey chi': --Ha winhaj Amán ayeq'ui, xchi heb' winh. --Ix yalan winh rey chi' to tz'awtajoch winh b'aj ayek' winh chi'.

Ix och winhaj Amán chi' b'ian, ix sk'anb'an winh rey chi' t'a winh icha tik: --¿Tas smoj tz'utaj junok winh winak, tato tzin nib'ej swik'chaanh winh? xchi winh. Ix snaan winhaj Amán chi' t'a spensar icha tik: ¿Machto wal junok ol yik'chaanh winh rey tik? Ha innhej toni, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix tak'wi winh icha tik: --Mamin rey, a wal tas smoj tz'utaj junok winak chi',
to tz'ik'chajkot junok a pichul tza k'an t'a opisio tik yet' nok' a chej tza k'antaxoni. Axo t'a sjolom nok' tz'ak'chajk'e junok yelwanub' icha korona, a sch'oxani to ik nok'.

Axo jun a pichul chi' yet' nok' chej chi' tz'ak'chaj t'a junok heb' winh yajal to niwan yelk'och yopisio tik, syak'anoch a pichul jun winh tza nib'ej tzik'chaanh chi'. Tz'ak'chajk'e winh t'a yib'anh nok' a chej chi', slajwi chi' squetzchaj nok' t'a yalanh winh t'a yoltak kalle yet' t'a parque. Syalan winh quetzjinak nok' chi' icha tik: Ichaton tik tz'aj yik'jichaanh junok winh winak snib'ej winh rey syik'chaanh, xchiokab'i, xchi winhaj Amán chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Amán chi' icha tik: --Ixic t'a elanhchamel, ik'b'at k'apak in pichul chi' yet' nok' in chej chi', icha wal ix aj alan chi', icha wal chi' tzutej a b'oan winhaj Mardoqueo winh israel, aton winh k'ojanem t'a sti' in palakio tik. Malajokab' junok tas ix al chi' to max a k'ulej, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix yik'b'at k'apak pichul chi' winhaj Amán chi' yet' nok' chej chi', ix yak'anoch winh t'a winhaj Mardoqueo chi'. Ix squetzan nok' chej chi' winh t'a yalanh winh, ix ek' winh t'a yoltak kalle yet' t'a parque, ix yalan winh icha tik: Ichaton tik tz'aj yik'jichaanh junok mach to snib'ej winh rey syik'chaanh, xchi winh.

Ayic ix lajwi yik'jiek' winhaj Mardoqueo chi' yuj winh, ix b'at winh yak'xikan winh t'a sti' spalakio winh rey chi', haxo winh elanhchamel ix paxkan winh t'a spat. Te kusk'olal ix aj winh, ix smakan sat winh yuj q'uixwelal.

Ix yalan winh t'a ix yetb'eyum yet' t'a heb' yamigo masanil tas ix utaj winh chi', yuj chi' ix yal heb' icha tik: --Ha winhaj Mardoqueo chi', israel winh, yuj chi' wan slajwiem opisio tik t'a spatik winh. Manh ol ak'laj ganar winh, palta to a winh ol ach ak'an ganar, xchi heb'.
Manto lajwi yalan heb' icha chi', ix k'och heb' winh schekab' winh rey chi' t'a elanhchamel yik tz'ik'jib'at winhaj Amán chi' t'a jun niwan wael ix schek b'ojok ix Ester chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winh rey yet' winhaj Amán chi' t'a jun niwan wael chi'.
Axo yik wan yuk'an wino heb' winh, ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a ix Ester chi' icha tik: --k'an tas tza nib'ej t'ayin, ol wak' t'ayach, wach'chom a nanhalok in makb'en tik tza k'ana', xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi ix Ester chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, tato wach' in t'a yol a sat, tato scha a k'ool tas tzin k'an t'ayach, anhej wal tas tzin k'an t'ayach to max in a cha miljokchamok, max champaxlaj heb' wetchonhab'.

Yujto a in tik yet' heb' wetchonhab' chi', ix onh chonhchaji yik tzonh satjiel t'a junelnhej. Comonoc wal tonhej onh chonhchajb'at chekab'ok, tato icha chi' tekan manh smojok to swik'ek' a tiempo, okxo jun, to ol onh satjoquel t'a junelnhej, xchi ix.
Ix sk'anb'an winhaj rey Asuero chi' icha tik: --¿Mach jun chi'? ¿B'ajtil ay jun mach snaan jun tzal chi'? xchi winh.

Ix yalan ix icha tik: --Ha winh ajk'ol chuk spensar chi', aton winhaj Amán tik, xchi ix. Ha wal yik ix yab'an jun lolonel winhaj Amán chi', sakxonhej ix aj yilji sat winh yuj xiwelal t'a yichanh winh rey yet' t'a yichanh ix reina Ester chi'.

Ix k'e wan winh rey chi', ix te kot yowal winh, ix elta winh t'a yol pat b'aj wan swa heb' chi'. Ix el winh b'aj ay yamaq'uil spalakio. Palta haxo winhaj Amán chi', ix yilan winh to wan yak'jioch chamel t'a yib'anh winh, ix kannhej winh b'aj ix wa heb' chi', ix tewioch winh t'a ix reina Ester chi' to tz'ak'ji niwank'olal winh yuj ix.

Ayic ix ochxik'och winh rey b'aj ix wa chi', ix yilan winh to kumanem winhaj Amán chi' t'a stz'ey b'aj k'ojanem ix reina chi'. Ix yalan winh rey chi' icha tik: --¿Tom tza nib'ej tzixtej ix reina t'a wichanh t'a yol in pat tik? xchi winh. Ayic ix yalan juntzanh lolonel winh rey chi', elanhchamel ix makchaj sat winhaj Amán chi' yuj heb' winh schekab' winh rey chi'.

Ix yalan jun winh chekab' skuchan Harbona icha tik: --Mamin rey, ha t'a spat winhaj Amán tik, ix yak' b'ochajem jun te te' winh jun ch'anhil ix ajk'e steel. Ata' ol k'e lokan winhaj Mardoqueo yuj winh yalani, aton winh sk'ulejnak jun tas wach' t'ayach, xchi winh. --Hak'uekk'e lokan winhaj Amán tik t'a jun te te' chi', xchi winh rey chi'.
Yuj chi' ix k'e lokan winhaj Amán chi' t'a te', aton te' ix sb'ok'e winh yuj winhaj Mardoqueo yalani. Icha chi' ix aj sikb'i yowal sk'ol winh rey chi'.

Ha t'a jun k'u chi', masanil tas ay t'a winhaj Amán, winh ajk'ol yajoch t'a heb' israel, ix yak' winh rey chi' t'a ix Ester. Axo winhaj Mardoqueo chi', niwan yopisio winh ix ak'ji yuj winh rey chi', yujto toxo ix yal ix Ester chi' to te ayto yuj sb'a ix yet' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'anel k'een skolk'ab' winh rey chi', k'een ix ik'chajek' t'a winhaj Amán, ix yak'anoch k'een winh t'a winhaj Mardoqueo chi'. Axo masanil tas ay t'a winhaj Amán ak'b'il t'a ix Ester chi', ix ak'jioch t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Mardoqueo chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix k'ochxi ix Ester t'a yichanh winh rey chi'. Ix em kuman ix, ix och ijan ix yoq'ui. Ix tewi ix to tz'ik'jiel yopisio jun ley te chuk ix sb'o winhaj Amán chi'. Ix yalan ix to max elk'och tas syal jun ley chi' t'a heb' israel.
Ix yak'anelta sk'okoch winh rey chi' nab'a oro t'a ix, ix k'e linhan ix t'a yichanh winh.

Ix yalan ix icha tik: --Mamin rey, tato wach' in t'a yol a sat, tato wach' tas tzin k'an tik tzab'i, tato t'a wal yel xajan in uuj, komonok tzak' tz'ib'chajb'at junokxo ley yik tz'el yopisio tas syal jun ley ix yak'b'at winhaj Amán yuninal winhaj Hamedata yinhtilal winhaj Agag t'a masanil yol a makb'en b'aj syala' to satjiel masanil heb' wetchonhab'.
Manh ol techaj wuj wilan tas ol jawok t'a yib'anh masanil heb' wetchonhab' yuj tas ol aj ko satjieli, xchi ix.

Ix yalan winhaj rey Asuero chi' t'a ix yet' t'a winhaj Mardoqueo chi' icha tik: --Ha winhaj Amán chi' lokanxok'e winh t'a te te', yujto chuk tas ix snachaanh winh t'a spatik heb' eyetchonhab'. Masanil tas ay t'a winh, toxo ix wak' t'ayach.

Ha tiknaik tz'ib'ejb'at icha tas tze na yuj swach'ilok masanil heb' eyetchonhab' chi'. Tzeyak'anoch in b'i yet' in sello t'ay. Yujto a junok ley b'aj ayoch in b'i yet' in sello t'ay, maxtzak yal-laj yeq'ui, xchi winh.

Elanhchamel ix awtaj heb' winh stz'ib'um winh rey chi', ayik 23 yoch yoxil uj skuch Siván. Masanil tas ix yal winhaj Mardoqueo chi' ix tz'ib'chajb'at t'a masanil heb' israel, t'a heb' winh yajal, t'a heb' winh yajalil heb' soldado, t'a masanil heb' winh yajal yaj t'a 127 makanhil yaj smakb'en winh rey chi', skotto t'a India masanto sk'och t'a Etiopía. Ix tz'ib'chajb'at t'a sti' yet' t'a sletra junjun chonhab' yet' t'a sti' heb' israel.

Ix ochpax sello winhaj rey Asuero t'ay yik scheklaji to a winh tz'alani. Ha heb' ix b'at spuk jun ley chi', ha t'a yib'anh nok' chej jelan sb'eyi, aton nok' schej winh rey ayek' t'a yet'tal, ata' ix k'e heb'.

Ha t'a jun ley ix yalb'at winh rey chi', yalnhej tas chonhab'il b'aj ayek' heb' israel chi', syal smolb'an sb'a heb' yik skolan sb'a heb'. Tato ay heb' ajk'ol yalnhej tas chonhab'il sk'och t'a heb' yet' syamk'ab' yik owal, syal satanel heb' ajk'ol chi' heb'. Yed' pax yetb'eyum yet' yalyuninal heb' ajk'ol chi' syal satanel heb'. Syik'ankanek' heb' tas ay t'a heb' ajk'ol chi'.
Ha juntzanh tik, junnhej k'ual tz'aj sb'o t'a masanil yol smakb'en winhaj rey Asuero chi', aton t'a jun k'u chequel yajkan t'a 13 yoch slajchawil uj skuch Adar.

Ha skopiail jun ley chi', yowalil spukax t'a junjun makanhil yaj smakb'en winh rey chi', yowalil tz'alchajel t'a skal masanil chonhab' yujto ley yaji, yik wach' ha t'a jun k'u chi', masanil heb' israel chi' syak' lista sb'a heb' yik spakan sb'a heb' t'a heb' ajk'ol chi'.

Ha heb' winh ix b'at yal jun ley chi', elanhchamel ix chekjib'at heb' winh yuj winh rey chi', ix k'e heb' winh t'a yib'anh nok' schej winh. Ix alchajpaxel jun ley chi' t'a chonhab' Susa chi', b'ab'el chonhab' yaj t'a yol smakb'en winh rey chi'.
