Ayic ix elta winhaj Mardoqueo t'a sdespacho winh rey chi', ayoch spichul winh yik yopisio yuj, k'ik'mutz'inak yet' saksak yilji. Ayk'e jun niwan korona nab'a oro t'a sjolom winh, ayoch jun xotil winh nab'a lino k'ik'mutz'inak yilji. Masanil heb' anima ay t'a chonhab' Susa chi', ix awajk'e heb' yuj tzalajk'olal.
Yuj chi' a heb' israel ix el lenaj ix yil heb', ix te tzalaj heb', yujto ix ik'jichaanh heb' ix yab'i.

Ayic ix k'och jun ley chi' t'a masanil lugar yet' t'a junjun chonhab', masanil heb' israel ix te tzalaji. Ix yak'anoch jun q'uinh heb', ix wa heb'. Tzijtum heb' anima t'a junjun chonhab' ix yak'och sb'a israelal yet' heb', yujto xiw heb' t'a heb' israel chi'.

Ayic 13 yoch slajchawil uj skuch Adar, aton jun k'u chi' chequel yaji yik tz'elk'och tas syal jun ley alb'ilel yuj winh rey chi', aton t'a jun k'ual chi' satjiel heb' israel yuj heb' ajk'ol chi' yalani. Axo ix aji, maj elk'ochlaj icha chi', palta to a heb' ajk'ol chi' ix ak'ji ganar yuj heb' israel chi'.

Ha t'a masanil yol smakb'en winhaj rey Asuero chi', ix smolb'ej sb'a masanil heb' israel t'a junjun chonhab' b'ajtak ay heb'. Ix syamanoch heb' yak'an owal yet' heb' ix snib'ej satanel heb' chi'. Manhxa junok mach ix stek'b'ej sb'ha t'a yichanh heb' israel chi', yujto toxo ix och xiwk'olal t'a skal heb' anima smasanil.
Masanil heb' winh niwak yajal ay t'a junjun makan smakb'en winh rey chi' yet' heb' winh niwak yopisio, ix yak'och sb'a heb' winh yet' heb' israel, yujto ix te xiw heb' winh t'a winhaj Mardoqueo chi',
yujto te niwan yopisio winh t'a spalakio winh rey chi'. Ha sb'inajnaquil winh ix te pukax t'a masanil chonhab', yujto t'a junjun k'u ste niwanb'i yopisio winh chi'.
Ix miljicham heb' ajk'ol chi' t'a k'een espada yuj heb' israel chi'. Ix satjiel heb' smasanil, ix sk'ulej heb' israel chi' icha wal tas snib'ej.

Ha t'a chonhab' Susa chi', ay 500 heb' winh winak ix miljicham yuj heb' israel chi', palta malaj wal jab'ok tastak ay t'a heb' winh ix cham chi' ix yik'ek' heb'. Ha t'a skal heb' winh ix cham chi', ix cham heb' winh tik: Vinhaj Parsandata, winhaj Dalfón, winhaj Aspata, winhaj Porata, winhaj Adalías, winhaj Aridata, winhaj Parmasta, winhaj Arisai, winhaj Aridai yet' winhaj Vaizata. Ha winhaj Amán ajk'ol t'a heb' israel, winh yuninal winhaj Hamedata, a winh ay yuninal heb' winh slajunhwanhil.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ayik ix yab'an winh rey jantak sb'isul heb' anima ix cham t'a chonhab' Susa chi', aton b'aj kajan winh,

ix yalan winh t'a ix reina Ester icha tik: --Ha heb' etchonhab' toxo ix smilcham 500 heb' winh winak heb' yet' lajunhwanh heb' winh yuninal winhaj Amán t'a chonhab' Susa tik. Ocxom pax t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a yol in makb'en tik, jantak am tas ix uji. Al t'ayin tasto tza nib'ej, ol wak' t'ayach, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi ix Ester chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, tato syal a k'ool, tzala' to a k'ik'an sk'ulejxi heb' wetchonhab' t'a chonhab' Susa tik icha tas ix sk'ulej heb' tiknaik icha yalan a ley. Tzalan paxi to sk'e lokan sniwanil lajunhwanh heb' winh yuninal winhaj Amán chi' t'a te te', xchi ix.
Ix yalan winh rey to sk'ulaj icha chi'. Ix alchajel jun ley chi' t'a masanil yol chonhab' Susa chi'. Ix k'e lokan sniwanil lajunhwanh heb' yuninal winhaj Amán chi'.

Masanil heb' israel kajan t'a chonhab' Susa chi', ix smolb'ejxi sb'a heb' ayik 14 yoch uj skuch Adar, ix smilancham 300 xo heb' winh winak heb', palta malaj jab'ok tas ay t'a heb' anima chi' ix yik'ek' heb'.

Masanil heb' israel kajan t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a smakb'en winh rey chi', ix smolb'ejpax sb'a heb' ayik 13 yoch uj chi', yik skolan sb'a heb' t'a heb' ajk'ol chi'. 75 mil heb' ajk'ol chi' ix smilcham heb', palta malaj jab'ok tas ay t'a heb' ix yik'ek' heb'. Ayic 14 yoch uj chi', ix och waan heb' smilancham heb' anima chi', ix yak'anoch q'uinh heb' yet' niwak wael t'a tzalajk'olal.

Axo heb' israel kajan t'a chonhab' Susa chi', ix smolb'ejpax sb'a heb' yik skolan sb'a heb' t'a 13 yoch uj yet' t'a 14, haxo t'a 15 ix och waan heb' smilancham heb' anima chi', ix yak'anoch q'uinh heb' yet' niwak wael t'a tzalajk'olal.
Axo pax heb' israel kajan t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' yet' t'a juntzanh aldea malaj smuroal, ha t'a 14 yoch uj skuch Adar, ata' ix yak'och q'uinh heb' t'a tzalajk'olal, ix sian wael heb' t'ay junjun.

Ix schekan tz'ib'chaj masanil juntzanh tas ix uji tik winhaj Mardoqueo, ix schekan winh to tz'ak'chajb'at t'a masanil heb' yetisraelal winh kajan t'a masanil yol smakb'en winhaj rey Asuero chi', heb' kajan t'a slak'anil yet' heb' kajan t'a najat.
Ix yalanb'at winh to t'a 14 yet' t'a 15 yoch uj Adar t'a junjun ab'il, yowalil tz'och q'uinh,

yujto ha t'a juntzanh k'ual chi' a heb' israel ix satanel heb' yajk'ool. Ha wal t'a jun uj chi', a skusk'olal heb' yet' yok'elk'olal, ix meltzajkanoch t'a tzalajk'olal. Yuj chi' ha t'a jun k'u chi' ix yak'och q'uinh heb' yet' niwak wael, ix laj sian wael heb' t'ay junjun, ix yak'an skolwal heb' t'a heb' meb'a'.
Ha jun ley ix schek tz'ib'chaj winhaj Mardoqueo chi', ix ochkan sb'eyb'alok heb' israel chi'.
Yujto a winhaj Amán ajk'ol t'a heb' israel chi', ix yak'och suerte winh t'a yib'anh heb' tas k'ual satjiel heb' smasanil,

palta yujto ix b'at tewi ix Ester t'a winh rey, yuj chi' ix yak'elta jun ley winh to a masanil chukal ix sna winhaj Amán chi' sk'ulej t'a heb' israel chi', ha t'a yib'anh winh smeltzajkani. Yuj chi' ix ak'jik'e lokan winh yet' heb' yuninal t'a te te'.

Yuj chi' a juntzanh k'ual chi' ix skuchkan Purim. Ha jun lolonel chi' syalelk'ochi, juntzanh tastak sk'an heb' t'a suerteal. Icha syal tas ix tz'ib'ejb'at winhaj Mardoqueo chi' yet' tas ix sk'ulej heb',
a ix sb'eyb'alej heb' israel chi' yet' yinhtilal yet' pax masanil heb' syak'och sb'a israelal. Yowalil syak'och chab' k'ual q'uinh chi' heb' t'a junjun ab'il, icha sk'ual ix aj yalchajkani.

Icha chi' ix ajkani yik snachajkot yuj heb' yinhtilal Israel t'a junjun makan smakb'en winh rey yet' t'a junjun chonhab' to yowalil snakot heb', syak'anoch q'uinh heb' yik Purim t'a sk'ual ix cheklajkan chi' t'a masanil tiempo.

Axo ix reina Ester yisilkan winhaj Abihail yet' winhaj Mardoqueo winh israel, ha t'a sb'i yopisio heb' chi', ix schek heb' tz'ib'chajb'at yuj q'uinh yik Purim chi', yik swach' ak'chajoch yip jun ix schek b'ab'laj tz'ib'chajb'at heb'.
Ix schekan heb' pukchajb'at t'a masanil heb' yetisraelal heb' kajan t'a 127 makan yaj smakb'en winhaj rey Asuero chi'. Ix ak'jib'at stzatzil sk'ol heb' yetisraelal heb' chi' yuj.

Ixlajwi chi', ix alchaji to yowalil tz'och q'uinh yik Purim t'a sk'ual chequelxo ix ajkani, icha wal ix yutej winhaj Mardoqueo yet' ix reina Ester chi' yalani. Yowalil sk'anab'ajej heb' yet' pax yinhtilal heb' yik snachajkot tzek'ojk'olal yet' kusk'olal.
Ha jun cheknab'il ix yak' ix Ester chi', a tz'alani tas tz'aj yoch q'uinh chi'. Ha jun tik ix schek ix tz'ib'chajkani.
Ix yak'och k'een tumin winhaj rey Asuero t'a yib'anh masanil heb' anima, aton heb' ay t'a yol smakb'en winh masanto heb' kajan t'a stitak ha' mar, yik syak' k'een heb' t'a winh.

Masanil sjelanil winh rey chi' yet' yopisio yet' yab'ixal tas wal yutejnak winh yak'an niwak opisio t'a winhaj Mardoqueo, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal tastak ujinak t'a yol smakb'en Media yet' Persia.

Ha winhaj Mardoqueo chi', ix ochkan winh schab'il yajalil t'a winhaj rey Asuero chi'. Te niwan ix aj yelk'och winh t'a skal heb' yetisraelal. Te xajan ix ilji winh yuj heb' yetchonhab' chi', yujto ix sayjiek' swach'il heb' yuj winh, ix yak'an wal yip winh yik wach' tzalajk'olal yet' junk'olal tz'aj heb'.

Ha t'a yol smakb'en Uz ek'nak jun winh winak skuchan Job. Te tojol spensar winh, te wach' sb'eyb'al winh, te ay yelk'och Dios t'a sat winh. Sya'ilej wal sb'a winh, max yak'och sb'a winh t'a skal chukal.
Ha winhaj Job chi' ay ukwanh yuninal winh yet' oxwanh yisil.

Ay 7 mil nok' skalnel winh, 3 mil nok' skamello winh, 500 moj nok' wakax smunlaji yet' 500 nok' b'uru. Manh jantakok heb' schekab' winh. Anhej wal winh te b'eyum t'a yichanh heb' kajan t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winh chi', k'ajan heb' winh yoch q'uinh t'a spat junjun. Stzolal yek' q'uinh chi' t'a heb' winh, syawtan heb' ix oxwanh yanab' heb' winh chi' wael yet'ok.

Ayic slajwi yek'chaj q'uinh chi' t'a heb' winh t'a stzolal, tz'awtajkot heb' winh yuj winhaj Job chi'. Ak'walto sk'e waan winh, snhusan silab' winh yuj junjun heb' winh, yik sakb'itan sb'a heb' winh t'a sat Dios, talaj tz'och smul heb' winh, syalan chuk heb' winh d'ha Dios t'a spensar snaan winh. Icha chi' sk'ulej winh t'a juntak el.
Ay jun k'u ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' ángel tz'ak'an serwil Jehová t'a yichanh t'a satcha’anh. Ha t'a skal heb' chi', ix k'ochpax jun ángel ajk'ool, aton winh Satanás.
Ix sk'anb'an Jehová t'a winh Satanás chi' icha tik: --¿B'ajtil ach koti? xchi. Ix yalan winh: --In kot t'a yol yib'anhk’inal, yujto tzek' woymitej lum smasanil, xchi winh.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winh icha tik: --¿Tzam il tas yaj winh in chekab' aj Job? Malaj junokxo mach t'a yol yib'anhk’inal icha winh chi', te tojol spensar winh, te wach' sb'eyb'al winh, ay welk'och t'a yol sat winh, sya'ilej wal sb'a winh, max yak'och sb'a winh t'a skal chukal, xchi Jehová chi'.
Ix tak'wi winh Satanás chi' icha tik: --Manh nab'anhejok wach' syutej sb'a winh t'a ichanh.

Yujto max yal a k'ol to ay junok mach tz'ik'anek' junok tas t'a winh, ma tastak ay t'a yol spat winh yet' masanil tastak ay t'a winh. Ha ach tzak'nhej a wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh masanil tastak sk'ulej winh, yuj chi' ek'b'al sb'isul nok' smolb'etzal nok' winh yet' sb'eyumal.
Palta q'uinalok a tiknaik tzik'ek' masanil tas ay t'a winh chi', ol ilani tato manh ol yal chuk winh t'ayach, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi Jehová t'a winh icha tik: --Ichokab' ta', ol xo ila' tas tza k'ulej yet' masanil tastak ay t'a winh chi', anhej to malaj tas tzutej sniwanil winh, xchi. Ixlajwi chi' ix el winh Satanás chi' t'a yichanh Jehová.
Ay jun k'u, ayik wan swa heb' winh yuninal yet' heb' ix yisil winhaj Job chi' t'a spat winh b'ab'el winak,
ix jawi jun winh chekab' b'aj ayek' winhaj Job chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: --Van ko munlaj yet' nok' wakax, haxo nok' b'uru wan swa nok' t'a ko lak'anil chi'.
Axo ix aji, ix jawi heb' winh sabeo, ix miljikancham heb' winh munlajwum chi' yuj heb' winh. Ix yelk'anb'at nok' wakax chi' heb' winh. Ha inxonhej ix yal wel lemnajok yik tzul walan ab'i, xchi winh.

Manto wal lajwilaj yalan jun winh chi', ix jawi junxo winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ix kot k'ak' t'a satcha’anh yuj Dios, ix cham masanil heb' winh tanhwum kalnel yet' nok' kalnel chi'. Ha inxonhej ix yal wel lemnajok yik tzul walan ab'i, xchi winh.

Manto wal lajwilaj yalan junxo winh chi', ix jawi junxo winh yoxil, ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ha heb' winh kaldeo, ox makan wal ix aj heb' winh yak'an owal t'ayonh. Ix smilancham masanil heb' winh stanhwan nok' a kamello heb' winh, ix yelk'anb'at nok' heb' winh. Ha inxonhej ix yal wel lemnajok yik tzul walan ab'i, xchi winh.
Manto wal lajwilaj yalan junxo winh chi', ix jawi junxo winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ha heb' winh uninal yet' heb' ix isil, wan swa heb', syuk'an wino heb' t'a spat winh b'ab'el uninal,

haxo ix aji, ix jawi jun tzijtumal ik' t'a stojolal lum taquinh lu'um. Ix em lanhnaj spat heb' uninal chi' t'a yib'anh yuj jun ik' chi', ix cham heb' smasanil. Ha inxonhej ix yal wel lemnajok yik tzul walan ab'i, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix k'e waan winhaj Job chi', ix te kus winh sik'lab'il. Ix snhik'chitan spichul winh, ix stzukanel xil sjolom winh, ix em nhojan winh ejmelal d'ha Dios.

Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Malaj jab'ok tas wed'nak in alji t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, malaj pax jab'ok tas ol wik'b'ati ayik ol in meltzajxok. Ha Jehová ix ak'an masanil tas t'ayin, anheja' pax tz'ik'anxieq'ui. Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'ay, xchi winh.
Wach'chom niwan yaelal ix ek' t'a yib'anh winhaj Job chi', palta maj ochlaj smul winh yujto maj yal-laj chukal winh t'a spatik Dios yuj tas ix utaj chi'.
Ayic ix k'och sk'ual smolb'anxi sb'a heb' ángel tz'ak'an serwil Jehová t'a yichanh, ix k'och pax winh Satanás t'a skal heb'.
Ix sk'anb'an Jehová chi' t'a winh: --¿B'ajtil ach koti? xchi. Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ix in kot t'a yol yib'anhk’inal, yujto tzek' woymitej lum smasanil, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix yalan Jehová chi' t'a winh: --¿Tzam il tas yaj winh in chekab' aj Job? Malaj wal junokxo mach t'a yol yib'anhk’inal chi' lajan yet' winh. Te tojol spensar winh, te wach' sb'eyb'al winh. Ay wal welk'och t'a yol sat winh, sya'ilej wal sb'a winh, max yak'och sb'a winh t'a skal chukal. Uuj wal ix in satel masanil tastak ay t'a winh, palta tokwal yuj chi' ix juwiel spensar winh, xchi.
Ix tak'wi winh Satanás chi' icha tik: --Tato malaj tz'ik'an sniwanil junok mach, ¿tok ay tas sna'a? B'ekan sk'ol slajwiel masanil tastak ay t'ay yik skolan sk'inal.
Palta tato a tiknaik ha t'a sniwanil winh chi' tzak'och junok yaelal, ol ilani tato manh ol yal chuk winh t'ayach, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi Jehová chi' t'a winh: --Ichokab' ta'. Olxo ila' tas tza k'ulej yet' sniwanil winh chi', anhej b'ian to malaj alan ik ik'anel sk'inal winh, xchi.
Ix el winh Satanás chi' t'a yichanh Jehová. Ix b'at yak'ank'e juntzanh yab'il winh te niwan t'a sniwanil winhaj Job chi', schakot t'a yok winh masanto t'a sjolom winh.
Yuj chi' ix b'at em k'ojan winhaj Job chi' t'a skal k'een tik'aq'uil taanh. Ix yik'ankot jab' sti' lum chen winh, sjotz'anek' lum winh t'ay.
Palta haxo ix yetb'eyum winh ix alan t'ay icha tik: --¿Tom anheja' wach'nhej tzutej a pensar? Al chuk d'ha Dios, tzach cham b'ian, xchi ix.

Ix tak'wi winh icha tik: --Ach ix, lajan wal a lolon icha heb' ix ix malaj jab'ok spensar. Toxo ix ko cha swach'k'olal Dios, ¿tom manh ol ko chapax ko yaelal syak'a'? xchi winhaj Job chi'. Yuj chi', wach'chom ayoch syaelal winh, palta maj ochlaj smul winh yujto malaj chuk ix yal winh t'a spatik Dios.

Ay oxwanh heb' winh yamigo winhaj Job chi': Aton winhaj Elifaz aj Temán, winhaj Bildad aj Súa yet' winhaj Zofar aj Naamat. Ayic ix yab'an spekal masanil juntzanh yaelal ix jawi t'a yib'anh winhaj Job chi' heb' winh, ix yak'anoch heb' winh t'a sk'ol skot yak' sniwanil sk'ol winh, yik tzul mol kus pax heb' winh yuj syaelal winh chi'.

Najatto wan skot heb' winh, ix yilankot winhaj Job chi' heb' winh. Pural ix och sat heb' winh t'a winh, yuj chi' ix syamanoch heb' winh yok' yuj winh. Ix te kus heb' winh, ix snhik'chitanb'at spichul heb' winh. Ix stzipanchaanh pokok heb' winh t'a chaanh, haxo t'a sjolom heb' winh tz'em lu'um.

Ix em k'ojan heb' winh t'a sat lum yet' winh, uque' k'ual, uque' ak'wal ix ek' heb' winh yet' winh ta', malaj junok b'elanh lolonel ix yal heb' winh, yujto te ow yak'an syaelal winhaj Job chi' ix yil heb' winh.
Ayic ix lajwiek' juntzanh chi', ix skatab'an winhaj Job chi' jun k'u b'aj aljinak. Ix yalan winh icha tik:
Tzin katab'ej jun ak'wal ayik skuchannak in och ix in nun. Tzin katab'ej jun k'u ayik waljinak.
Comonoc a jun k'u chi' och t'ak'walilal. Comonoc kannhej icha chi' yuj Dios, maj sakb'ok.
Comonoc ay wal junok niwan wewen ochnak, yik wach' k'ik'b'ikaneli. Comonoc ay wal junok niwan k'ik' asun musani, ma junok k'ik' och t'a sat k'u, yik ay xiwk'olal t'a jun k'u chi'.
Comonoc k’ik’ k’inal ajkan jun ak'wal chi', yik wach' maj och jun k'u chi' sb'isulok sk'ual yik jun uj chi' yet' jun ab'il chi'.
Comonoc malaj tas uji t'a jun ak'wal chi', yik wach' malaj aw yik tzalajk'olal ochi.
Comonoc skatab'aj jun ak'wal chi' yuj heb' ajb'aal, aton heb' syal skuchb'an nok' lewiatán.
Comonoc maj k'eul k'een niwak k'anal t'a jun q'uinhib'alil chi'. Comonoc maj k'eul sakil k'inal stanhwaj sk'euli yet' saquil yich chaanh.
Tzin katab'ej jun ak'wal chi', yujto maj syamoch waan waljub'al. Tato maay, tekan max wil jantak yaelal yet' kusk'olal tik.
Octom cham in t'a yol sk'ol ix in nun. Octom cham in ayik wan walji.
Octom malaj jolom penek chaan in. Octom malaj im in chu'u yik tzin q'uib'i.
Octom chamnak in, tzalajk'olal am tzin way tiknaik. Junk'olal am swik' wip
yet' heb' rey yet' heb' yajal, aton heb' ix b'oanxik'e juntzanh niwak pat emnak lanhnajok,
ma yet' heb' niwak yajal b'ut'an spalakio yuj k'een oro yet' k'een plata.
¿Tas yuj maj in mukchaj icha junok unin tonhej tz'eq'ui, ma icha junok unin chamnakxo tz'alji?
Ha b'aj smukchaj heb' chamnak, ata' slajwikan b'aj syixtej anima heb' chuk. Ha pax ta' syik' yip heb' tz'ixtaj yuj heb' chi'.
Ata' syik' yip heb' icha preso yaj t'a munlajel, manhxa b'aj syab' heb' stumaj yuj heb' tz'ilan munlajel chi'.
Ata' ayek' heb' niwak yelk'ochi yet' heb' malaj yelk'ochi yet' heb' elnakxo t'a yalanh smandar spatrón. Lajanxonhej heb' smasanil.
¿Tas yuj syak' Dios sakil k'inal yil heb' tz'ixtaji? ¿Tas yuj syak' sk'inal heb' ayoch t'a syaelal,
heb' snib'ej cham sb'a, palta max chamlaj heb', wach'chom snib'ej chamel chi' heb' t'a yichanh b'eyumal?
Ha jun anima chi' schax stzalajk'olal yuj ayik toxo ix b'atkan t'a yol b'aj smukchaji.
¿Tas yuj anheja' yak'an in k 'inal Dios, a in to manh wojtakok tas ol in ajok, a in icha wal to makan in yuj?
Maxtzac yal in wa'i, maxtzak yal pax wuk'an ha' yuj ok'el yuj in yaelal.
Ha tas b'aj swekxiw in b'a, aton sjawi t'a wib'anh.
Maxtzac yal wik'an jab'ok wip, manhxalaj swach'il waji. Manhxa jab'ok in junk'olal, axonhej yaelal tzin ik'ani, xchi winhaj Job chi'.
Ix yalan winhaj Elifaz aj Temán t'a winhaj Job chi' icha tik:
Ach Job, tekan chuk tzab'i tato ay mach stek'b'ej sb'a slolon ed'ok, palta maxtzak techaj wuuj tato tonhej swab'i.
Yujto tzijtum mach b'aj ix ak' k'ayb'ub'al, ix ak'an pax stek'anil heb' somchajnaqueli.
Ix ak' stek'anil heb' telwinak. Ix a yamanoch waan heb' ay schab'k'olal,
haxo yik ix ja yaelal t'a ib'anh tik, manhxa jab'ok a tek'anil.
Ha ach tik tza k'anab'ajej wal Dios, tojol a b'eyb'al alani. ¿Tas yuj somchajel a k'ol tiknaik?
Nawalcoti, ¿tokwal sjawi yaelal t'a yib'anh heb' malaj smul? ¿Tocwal komon scham heb' wach' sb'eyb'al?
Ha swilani, a heb' sk'ulan chukal, a tas sk'ulej heb' chi' sjawi t'a yib'anh.
Syak'kot yowal sk'ol Dios t'a yib'anh heb', satjiel heb' t'a junelnhej yuj, icha tz'aj satjiel tastak yuj chakxuxum ik'.
Tz'el yaw heb' icha yel yaw nok' choj, palta ha Dios tz'ak'an em numan heb', icha yem numan nok' choj smak'jiel ye.
Maxtzac yal-laj swa nok', scham nok' yuj wejel, haxo nok' yunetak, toxonhej saklemkanb'at nok'. Icha chi' tz'aj heb' chuk chi' yuj Dios.
k'unnhej ix k'och jun lolonel ix sajjioch t'a in chiquin, pural wal ix wab'i.
Ha t'ak'walil ayik yoralil sway anima, ix in wayichej jun tas te xiwub'tak.
Ix jawi jun niwan xiwk'olal t'ayin, ix in ib'xik'e yuj xiwelal.
Ay jun icha spixan anima ix wab' yek' masasok t'a in sat, ix k'e chijan xil in jolom yuj xiwelal.
Ix k'och linhan jun pixan chi' t'a in tz'ey ix wab'i. Maj wilochlaj. Axo ix wab'ani ix sajsonk'ei, ix yalan icha tik:
¿Tocwal ay junok anima tojol t'a yichanh Dios? Wach'chom ay mach te tek'an, ¿tokwal malaj jab'ok spaltail t'a yichanh mach ix b'oani?
Ina max yak' wal och Dios heb' schekab' ay t'a satcha’anh yipok sk'ool. Inatax heb' ángel tz'och spaltail heb' t'a yichanh.
Ocxom wal heb' anima. Jab'nhej sk'inal heb', lajan heb' icha junok xan pat b'ob'il t'a yib'anh lum pokok, k'un yem lanhnajok. Syal stek'chajem heb' icha nok' ij.
Wach'chom wach' heb' t'a q'uinhib'alil, haxo tz'emkan k'u, satxikanem heb'. Satel heb' t'a junelnhej, malaj mach skus yuj heb'.
Icha yik tz'em lanhnaj junok mantiado spolchaj sch'anhal, icha chi' yaj sk'inal heb' anima. Tz'ek'b'at lemnajok, malaj jab'ok jelanil syik'kan heb', xchi jun pixan chi' t'ayin.
Ha tiknaik ach Job elokab' aw, ol quila' mach junok ol tak'wok t'ayach. ¿Mach junok ángel ol ach kolanok?
Ha junok anima chuk spensar, schichon sk'ool, snib'anoch tastak. Ha schichonk'olal chi' ol ik'anel sk'inal.
Vilnac heb' chuk spensar, slaj k'echaanh tastak ay t'a heb', palta elanhchamel satxiem juntzanh chi'.
Ha yalyuninal heb', manhxa mach skolwaj t'a heb'. Ayic sk'och heb' t'a yichanh heb' yajal, manhxalaj tz'aj yelk'och heb', manhxa mach skolan heb'.
Ayic tz'elul sat yawb'en heb', haxo heb' anima wan scham yuj wejel slajaneli, sayanelta heb' t'a kaltak q'uiix. Axo heb' malaj jab'ok tas ay t'ay, syiloch sk'ool heb' t'a sb'eyumal heb'.
Ha yaelal manh b'ajokto skoti, manhokto t'a yol lu'um sk'eta.
Toxonton yik yaelal kaji, icha te namix k'ak' tz'elnhejta t'a kal k'ak'.
Tato a in tik icha aj tik waji, elanhchamel am swak'och in b'ha t'a yol sk'ab' Dios.
Ha Dios satub'tak tastak sk'ulej, manhxo b'ischajb'enok tas k'ulej chi'. Malaj mach snachajel yuj tastak sk'ulej chi'.
Ha Dios chi' tz'ak'ankot nhab' t'a yib'anh lum lum tik. Icha chi' tz'aj yoch yalil masanil tas ay t'a sat lu'um.
Ha tz'ik'anchaanh heb' anima emnaquil syutej sb'a, anheja' pax tz'ak'an sniwanil sk'ol heb' ayoch t'a syaelal.
Ha Dios chi' sjuanb'at tas nab'il yuj heb' jelan, yik max elk'ochi.
A' syamanoch waan heb' jelan t'a chukal, yik max elk'och tas snib'ej heb' t'a chukal chi'.
Ha wal t'a chimk'ualil stelwi heb', k'ik'k 'inal t'a heb'. Icha wal to t'ak'walil sb'eyek' heb', toxonhej tzek' machmon heb'.
Ha Dios skolan heb' tz'ixtaj yuj heb' chuk spensar, anheja' skolan heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ixtum anima.
A' ayoch yipok sk'ol heb' malaj stek'anil, ha' smakan sti' heb' manh tojolok syutej sb'a.
Wach' yik heb' skachji yuj Dios. Manh a patiquejel a kachnab'il syak' Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil chi'.
Tato ha Dios chi' tz'ak'an echnaj junok mach, ha' tz'anhtanpaxi. Tato ha' tz'ak'anoch syaelal junok mach, a tz'ak'anpax b'oxok sk'ool.
Tzijtum el ol ach kolchaj yuj Dios t'a tas ay smay. Manh ol ach scha ak'jok ganar yuj junok tas sjawi t'a ib'anh.
D'a stiempoal wejel ol ach kolchaj yuj t'a yol sk'ab' chamel. Ayic ay owal, anheja' ol ach kolanpaxok.
Ha Dios ol ach kolan t'a tas syal heb' alum pekal. Manh ol ach xiwok ayik sjawi yalnhej tas t'a ib'anh.
Ayic ol jawok wejel, ma owal, tonhej ol ach tzewajok. Manh ol ach xiwok ayik ol jawok nok' chium nok'.
Ha b'aj ol ach munlajok, malaj k'een k'een ol ach ixtanok. Ha nok' chium nok', malaj tas ol ach yutej nok'.
Ol ajxok jantak tastak t'a a pat. Ayic ol a b'isan nok' a molb'etzal nok' tz'akannhej yajek' nok'.
Tzijtum ol aj sb'isul inhtilal icha anh ank'ultak sq'uib' t'a sat lum lum.
Icham winak achxo ol ach chamok, icha junok tob'anh ixim trigo k'anxo sjochchaji.
Ach Job, a tas kojtak a tzonh k'ayb'ani. Cojtak to icha chi' yaji, yuj chi' scham wal a b'eyk'olan juntzanh tik, xchi winhaj Elifaz chi'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Job chi' icha tik:
Tato smasanil in yaelal yet' in kusk'olal tik, tz'echtaj t'a yol junok echlab',
tekan ek'to yalil t'a yichanh yarenail sti' ha' mar, yuj chi' ix in komon alej icha tik.
Ha Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil, ichato ix och ch'apnaj sjul-lab' t'ayin, haxo swenenoal spukax t'a in niwanil. Toxo ix oymaj tas ay smay t'ayin yuj.
¿Tocwal tz'ok' nok' kaltakte'al b'uru tato ay yanh nok'? ¿Tocwal tz'ok' nok' mam wakax tato ay tas sk'ux nok'?
¿Mach schi'an junok chib'il wail tato malaj yatz'amil? ¿Tocwal wach' sloji saquil nok' nholob' tato malaj yatz'amil?
Icha chib'il wail malaj yatz'amil, icha chi' tas tzin chi tiknaik swab'i. Manhxalaj in gana in wa'i.
Comonoc tz'el t'a sk'ol Dios yak'an tas tzin k'an t'ay. Comonoc syak' tas tzin nib'ej.
Comonoc tz'el t'a sk'ol Dios chi' in sataneli, yik tzin lajwiel t'a junelnhej.
Wach'chom swab' syail yuj in yaelal yet' in kusk'olal tik, palta tzin te tzalaji, yujto swak'nhej och sley Dios yipok in k'ool, aton Dios Axonhej Ochi.
Manhxalaj wip swab'i yik swak'an techaj in yaelal tik, ¿tasxom yuj komon pitzan into?
¿Tocwal lajan stzatzil in niwanil tik icha k'een k'een? ¿Tocwal icha stzatzil k'een bronke stzatzil in b'ak'chil?
Maxtzac yal in kolan in b'ha t'a yol wiko'. Manhxa junok mach skolwaj wed'ok.
Ha junok mach ayoch t'a syaelal, wach'chom manhxa yelk'och Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil t'ay, palta smoj wal tz'ak'ji sniwanil sk'ol yuj heb' swach'k'ool.
Palta a ex tik ex wamigo, tonhej ix in he wach' juejeli. Lajan ex icha junok ha' eluma' stup t'a smelemal.
Ayic syak'an nhab' tat tz'aj sat ha' sb'eyi kalan ha' yet' k'een cheew, ma yet' k'een sakb'akom.
Ayic tz'ulax k'een cheew chi', stupem ha' eluma' chi', haxo yik tzowaj k'ak' stakjiem ha'.
Ha heb' anima b'eyum, sb'at heb' t'a titak b'e yik sayan ha' heb' yuk'ej, haxo tz'aji, satkanb'at heb' t'a lum taquinh lu'um chi', ata' schamkan heb'.
Ha heb' b'eyum anima aj chonhab' Temán yet' heb' aj Sabá, say ha ha' heb' yojtaktaxon b'aj skani,
haxo yik sk'och heb' b'aj aytaxon ha' chi', taquinhxo yet'tal ha', toxonhej stakkank'e sk'ol heb'.
Icha chi' eyaj t'ayin a ex tik, yujto ayik tzeyilanoch jantak in yaelal tik, tonhej tzex xiwk'ei.
Palta a in tik, malaj tas tzin k'an t'ayex. Malaj tumin tzin k'an t'ayex yik tzin kolchaji.
¿Tocwal tzin k'an he kolwal yik tzin kolchaj t'a yol sk'ab' jun ajk'ol t'ayin, ma t'a juntzanh heb' elk'um?
Hak'ek in k'ayb'ub'al, ol in cha wab' t'ayex. Ch'oxek och in mul chi' t'a in sat.
Malaj junok mach spatikanel junok pensar to wach', palta a ex tik, manhxa stzolal tas tzeyak'och t'a wib'anh.
Ha ex tik nab'anhej tzin he tumej, palta eyojtak to a slolonel junok mach ayoch t'a syaelal, ay b'aj malaj jab'ok yelk'ochi.
Ha ex tik, syal eyak'an he suerte t'a yib'anh heb' meb'a' ob'iltak. Syalpax he chonhanel junok eyamigo.
Ochanhec k'elan t'a in sat, tato tonhej swesej.
Actejec eyalan juntzanh chi' t'a in patik. Comonoc tzeyojtaquejeli to yel juntzanh swal tik.
Ha he naani to esalwum in. Ha he naani to manh wojtakok tas yel yet' tas manh yelok.
Ha onh anima kajan onh t'a sat lum tik, lajan wal kab'an syail icha junok soldado ma icha junok chekab' yaji.
Ha junok chekab', snib'ej elanhchamel sq'uik'b'i. Ha junok munlajwum, snib'ej elanhchamel scha stojol.
Icha chi' waj yet' in yaelal tik, ujal swab' syail. Junjun ak'wal aynhejoch in kusk'olal.
Ayic tzin ek' jichan, te najat yek' ak'wal swab'i. Tzin tzaktzaj wek' b'alb'onok, max sakb'ilaj. Swalan icha tik: ¿Janik' ol in k'e waan? xin chi.
Majnaquel in niwanil tik yuj nok' ha'ay. Taquinh quechinak sat, slaj k'e tzililjok tz'elxi spojowal.
Ha in k 'inal elanhchamel tz'eq'ui, icha yek' sjul-lab' heb' ch'alwum sjulek' t'a skal sch'al. Van sk'och in k 'inal tik t'a slajwub', manhxa tas ayoch yipok in k'ool.
Ach in Diosal, nakoti, a jab' in k 'inal tik, lajan icha yik squik'an junelok quik'. Manhxa b'ak'uinh tzalajk'olal ol in ajok.
Ha heb' anima tzin ilan tiknaik, manhxo ol in yil-laj heb'. Ol in satelok, manhxo ol in ilpaxlaj.
Icha yek' numumok asun satxikanemi, icha chi' tz'aj satxiem junok anima ayik sb'at mukchajkan t'a kampusante. Manhxa b'ak'uinh ol jaxok, manhxa b'ak'uinh ol yiloch heb' sk'ab'yok.
Yuj chi' max yal wem numan, yuj in yaelal yet' in kusk'olal tik, ol walnhej tas swala'.
Mamin ¿tom lajan in icha nok' niwan nok' t'a yol ha' mar tzila', yuj chi' aynhejoch a sat t'ayin?
Ayic tzin naani, tekan wach' ol in way jab'ok t'a in ch'at, tope tz'och waan jab'ok in yaelal tik yik tzin way jab'ok, xin chi.
Axo juntzanh wayich xiwub'tak tzak' wila'', tzin a te xib'tani.
Más wach' tzin a b'inchamok, más wach' tzin cham t'a yichanh to pitzan in.
Maxtzac techaj wuj swab'i, nab'axonhej pitzan in. Manhxo in ixtej. Ha in k 'inal tik lajan icha yik squik'an junelok quik'.
¿Tas quelk'och a onh anima onh tik, yuj chi' tzonh ik'chaanh? ¿Tas yuj tzach och ilk'olal kuuj?
¿Tas yuj aynhejoch a chum t'ayonh t'a junjun k'u, tzonh ak'annhej prowal?
¿Tas yuj max ik'el jab'ok a sat t'ayin, yik syal in b'uk'anem jab'ok yal in ti'?
Ach Dios, Yilumal anima aji. Tato tz'och in mul, ¿tom tzab' syail yuj? ¿Tas yuj a t'ayin tzak'och ijan a jul-lab'? ¿Tom al wajoch t'ayach icha junok ikatz?
¿Tom maxtzak ak' niwank'olal in mul? ¿Tom maxtzak ak' niwank'olal tastak chukal ix in k'ulej? Toxo wal tzin b'atkan t'a yol lu'um. Ol in a sayeq'ui, manhxo ol in chax uuj, xchi winhaj Job chi'.
Ix yalan winhaj Bildad aj Súa icha tik:
¿B'aq'uinh ol aktej a lolon icha tik? Lajan a lolonel tik icha junok owal chakxuxum ik'.
Ha Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil, malaj b'ak'uinh syixtejb'at tojolal, max yik'ek' smakb'en junok anima.
Tekan ix och smul heb' uninal chi' d'ha Dios, yuj chi' ix ak'ji syaelal heb' yuj t'a smojalil.
Ak' wal och a b'ha t'a yol sk'ab' Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil, tza k'anan t'ay to tz'ok' sk'ol t'ayach.
Tato wach' a pensar, tojolnhej tzutej a b'a. Ol ach skol Dios chi', ol yak'anxi masanil tastak iktaxon yaji.
Ha a b'eyumal t'a yalanhtaxo, manhxo ol yal slajb'an sb'a yet' jantak tas ol ajxok t'ayach.
k'anb'ejek' ab'i tas ek'nak heb' anima t'a peka', tza k'ayb'an sjelanil heb' chi'.
Ha onh tik ichato ewi onh alji, malaj jab'ok tas kojtak. Ha ko k 'inal t'a sat lum tik lajan icha yek' junok enhul.
Ha heb' anima t'a peka', jantak tas b'aj syal ach sk'ayb'ankan heb'.
Ha te' junko yet' te' papiro, anhej b'aj ay ha ha' sq'uib' te'.
Te yaax te', palta tato stup ha', b'ab'el stakjixiel te' t'a yichanh juntzanhxo te te'.
Icha wal chi' ol aj heb' sk'ulan chukal, aton heb' sb'atkan Dios satk'olal yuj, maxtzak elk'och tas ayoch yipok sk'ol heb'.
Ha tas komon ayoch yipok sk'ol heb' chi', lajan wal icha ch'alxim.
Q'uinalok ay mach tz'och yub'naj t'a ch'alxim chi', malaj jab'ok yip. Q'uinalok tzonh kan d'unhnaj t'ay, max techajlaj yuj.
Ha heb' sk'ulan chukal, lajan wal heb' icha sat anh ank'ultak tz'el tziknaj yuj yok k'u, spukaxkanb'at t'a skaltak awb'en,
sb'atkan t'a slod'iltak k'een k'een, slaj q'uib' anh, sb'at anh t'a yib'anhtak k'een.
Palta tato ay mach stok'ank'eta anh, manhxa mach ojtannak tato ek'nak anh ta'.
Icha chi' tz'aj slajwiel anh, ch'okxo junokxo ank'ultak sq'uib' b'aj tok'b'ilk'eta anh chi'.
Ha Dios, max aktajkan junok mach wach' spensar yuj. Max kolwajlaj t'a heb' sk'ulan chukal.
Tato tza na a b'a, ha' ol ach ak'anxi tzewajok, ol yak'anxi a tzalajk'olal.
Axo pax heb' ajk'ool, ol q'uixwokkan heb'. Ha spat heb' chuk spensar chi', ol lajwoquelok, xchi winhaj Bildad chi'.
Ix tak'wixi winhaj Job chi' icha tik:
Vojtak wal sik'lab'il to icha chi' yaji. Palta, ¿tok ay junok onh syal kalanoch ko b'a wach'il t'a yichanh Dios?
Q'uinalok sko telaj ko b'a yet'ok, malaj am junok tas syal ko pakan t'ay t'a milok tas sk'anb'ej t'ayonh.
Ha Dios te niwan sjelanil yet' spoder. Q'uinalok sko tek'b'ej ko b'ha t'a yichanh, ¿tokwal stechaj kuuj?
Ha yuj yowal sk'ol Dios tz'ib'xik'e lum niwak witz, tz'el lum k'akap, malaj mach ojtannak tato tzuji juntzanh chi'.
Ayic stzikub'tanhan lum lum tik t'a yet'tal, tz'ib'xi sb'akhnub'al lu'um.
Ha Dios chi' syal yalan t'a k'u to max jawilaj, syalanpax t'a k'een k'anal to max yak'laj yok k'een.
Malaj junok mach ix kolwaj yet'ok ayik ix yak'anb'at jenhan satcha’anh. Anheja' pax stek'anem sat ha' mar yik sk'e chulnaj ha'.
A' ixb’o’an juntzanh k'een k'anal skuch niwan Osa, k'een Oxd'ilanh, k'een Mootz yet' juntzanhxo k'een yaman yaji scheklaj t'a stojolal sur.
Manhxo b'ischajb'enok tastak satub'tak sk'ulej. Ha juntzanh chi' malaj junok mach syal snachajel yuj.
Tato tzek' Dios t'a ko tz'ey, max yal-laj quilani. Tato tzek' t'a chi' ¿tok snachajel wuuj?
Tato ay tas syik'ek' t'a junok mach, ¿mach syal skachanoch waan? ¿mach syal sk'anb'an t'ay tas sk'ulej?
Tato skot yowal sk'ol Dios chi', max yal yoch waan t'a ichnhej ta'. Ha heb' ayoch yet' Rahab ol kan heb' t'a yalanh yuj.
Yuj chi', ¿tas lolonel syal walani yik tzin pakan d'ha Dios?
Wach'chom malaj in mul, palta max yal-laj in tak'wi t'ay. In juezal yaji, tzin k'anan yok'elk'olal t'ayin.
Q'uinalok swawtej Dios chi' b'aj tzin ch'olb'itaji, wach'chom sk'ochi, palta ¿tokwal ol scha yab' tas swala'?
Axo tz'aji, tzam in yak' lajwok yet' junok ik'nhab' te ow, swach' niwtaj in yaelal tik t'a ichnhej ta'.
Maxtzac xom yal wik'an wip junok rato. Tzam te wach' niwtaj in yaelal tik yuj.
Q'uinalok swak' pural Dios chi' yik sb'oan icha tzin nib'ej, max yal-laj yujto aton Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil. Q'uinalok swawtej t'a yichanh heb' juez, ¿mach syal yak'an pural sk'ochi?
Q'uinalok swala' te wach' in, haxo in lolonel sch'oxaneli to ay in paltail. Q'uinalok swala' to malaj jab'ok in paltail chi', axom Dios tz'alani to manh yelok.
Wach'chom a in tik malaj in mul, palta malaj welk'och t'a yol in sat, maxtzak yal in k'ol pitzan in.
Ha in naani, lajanxonhej smasanil. Ha Dios chi' satanel heb' ay smul yet' heb' malaj smul.
Q'uinalok sjawi chamel t'a yib'anh masanil anima, malaj tas sna Dios chi' ayik slajwiel anima malaj smul.
Skan jun yol yib'anhk’inal tik t'a yol sk'ab' heb' chuk yuj, smakchaj sat heb' juez yuj. Tato manhok Dios sk'ulani, ¿mach sk'ulan jun?
Elanhchamel tzek'b'at in k 'inal, malaj jab'ok tzalajk'olal swila'.
Lajan wal sb'ey in k 'inal tik icha sb'ey junok te' balso t'a sat ha ha', aton te' b'ob'il yet' te' papiro. Lajan pax icha sb'at xumumok nok' ch'akb'a yik syaman schib'ej nok'.
Q'uinalok sb'atkan in yaelal tik satk'olal wuuj, tzalajk'olal am tzin ajkani.
Palta masanil in yaelal tik tonhej tzin somchajel yuj, yujto wojtak to max in yal Dios wach'il.
Tato ay in mul yalani, nab'anhej swak' wip walani to wach' in.
Wach'chom tzin b'ik in k'ab' yet' nok' xapon, ma yet' yal taanh,
palta ha Dios tzin yak'nhejem t'a skal ha ha' sok'omtak, haxo in pichul sq'uixwi wuuj.
Max yal in pakan in b'a d'ha Dios icha t'a junok komon anima. Max yal walani to syal in b'at yet'ok t'a yichanh heb' juez.
Comonoc ay junok mach syal yak'an wil-laj in b'a yet'ok, syalan tas tzonh aj ko chawanhil.
Octom ay junok mach syal yalan t'ay yik tz'och waan yak'anoch in yaelal, tz'och waan in xib'tani.
Tato icha chi', maxtzak am in xiw in loloni, yujto malaj in mul icha eyalan tik.
Manhxa in gana pitzan in. Ol wak' cheklaj in yaelal tik, ol in lolon yet' in k'ak'alk'olal.
Swal d'ha Dios, manh tonhejok tzak'och in mul t'a wib'anh, al t'ayin b'aj ix och in mul chi'.
Ina a ach in a b'onak, ¿tom wach' tzab'i tzin a chakkaneli? Chuc tz'alji t'ayin, haxo yet' tas sna heb' chuk spensar tzach ochi.
¿Tom lajan ilan icha quilan a onh anima onh tik?
¿Tom lajan a k 'inal icha jab' quik a onh chamelb'a anima onh tik?
Yuj chi' ¿tas yuj tza say walek' in mul yet' in paltail?
Wach'chom ojtak to malaj in mul, malaj junok mach syal in skolanel t'a yol a k'ab'.
Ha ach wal ix in a b'o'o, haxo tiknaik tza nib'ej tzin a sateli.
Nacoti to t'a lum lum ix in a b'o'o, haxo tiknaik, tzin ak'anxikanoch pokokal.
Ix a b'o in niwanil tik icha tz'aj sb'o nok' queso ayik spajb'i nok' lech.
Ha ach ix ak' syamlaj sb'a in b'aquil yet' in ch'anhal. Ix ak'anoch in b'ak'chil yet' in tz'umal t'a spatik.
Ix ak' in k 'inal, ix in a xajanani. Ix in a tanhwej, yuj chi' pitzan in.
Palta haxo tiknaik jun, snachajel wuuj to ay tas k'ub'eltak tza na' t'a in patik.
Van in ilani tato tz'och in mul, max in ak' niwank'olal jab'ok yuj in mul chi'.
Tato ay in mul, ob'iltak in. Tato malaj in mul, palta max yal woch t'a ichanh t'a junk'olal, yujto tzin q'uixwi, tzin naankot in yaelal.
Tato swik'chaanh in b'a, satub'tak am tzutej in a sataneli. Icham syutej nok' choj spechan junok nok' yik schi'a, icha chi' am tzin utej.
Tza say juntzanh testigo t'a in patik. Tzak' wal kot owal t'ayin, icha skot nhilnaj heb' soldado yak'an owal.
¿Tas yuj in a chanak aljok? Comonoc ayik manto in aljok ix in chamkani, yik malaj mach iljinak in.
Comonoc ayik waljinak t'a in nun, wik'chajnakb'at t'a kampusante, ichato malaj mach cheklajnak.
Yakb'an to jab'nhej in k 'inal tik, elok t'a a k'ol tzak'an jab'ok in junk'olal. Eloc t'a a k'ol tzak'an jab'ok in tzalajk'olal,
yik manto in b'at t'a chamub' t'a skal k’ik’ k’inal b'aj maxtzak yal in paxta. Ha t'a jun lugar chi', wewentak yilji, k’ik’ k’inal xonhej, manhxalaj jab'ok sakil k'inal, xchi winhaj Job chi'.
Ix yalan winhaj Zofar aj Naamat t'a winhaj Job chi' icha tik:
Ha juntzanh a komon lolonel tik smoj wal spakji t'ayach. Manh yujok to tzach te loloni, scheklaji to wach' ach.
Ha a naani yujto tzach te loloni manhxa tas skala'. Ha a naani to manhxalaj mach syal spakan juntzanh a b'uchwal lolonel tik.
Ha ach tik tzala' to wach' ach t'a yichanh Dios, tzaloch a b'a wach'il.
Comonoc slolon Dios spakan juntzanh tzal chi',
sch'oxan sjelanil t'ayach k'ub'eltak yaji, aton juntzanh max yal snachajeli. Ichato chi' ol ilani to mantzak yak' a yaelal Dios icha wal smoj a chaani.
¿Am a naani to ol ojtaquej wal el sjelanil Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil, aton juntzanh k'ub'eltak yaji?
¿Tas wal ol aj ojtakanel jun jelanil chi'? Yujto ek'b'al te chaanh yajk'e icha yajk'e satcha’anh tik. Te ek'b'al jul yajem t'a yichanh b'aj ay heb' chamnak.
Te ek'b'al t'a yichanh lum lum tik. Te lewan sat t'a yichanh ha' mar.
Tato ha Dios tzach awtani yik tzach sch'olb'itej, ¿mach junok syal skachanoch waan?
Yojtak heb' esalwum, anheja' syil jantak chukal, ¿mato tza na' to manh yojtakok Dios chi'?
¿Tocwal syal yalji junok nok' b'uru icha spensar junok anima? Icha chi' junok mach malaj spensar, ¿tokwal ol yal sjawi spensar?
Tato tza tojolb'itej a pensar, al a yaelal d'ha Dios.
Actejkan a k'ulan chukal yet' juntzanh tas tza k'ulej t'a elk'altak.
Tato icha chi', wach' ilji t'a sat Dios, manhxalaj b'aj ol ach q'uixwok. Tzalajk'olal ol ach ajok, manhxa b'aj ol ach xiwok,
haxo sat a k'ol t'a a yaelal ix ek' tik. Icha tz'aj stup ha ha' sb'eyi, icha chi' ol aj sat t'a a k'ool.
Wach'chom ix ach kan t'a k’ik’ k’inal yuj a yaelal tik, palta haxo tiknaik ichato ol sakb'okpaxel t'a ib'anh icha t'a q'uinhib'alil. Tzalajk'olal ol ach ajxok, ichato chimk'ualil b'aj ayach eq'ui.
Junk'olal ol ach ajxok, yujto ay tas ayoch yipok a k'ool. Ha Dios ol ach tanhwanok, junk'olal ol ach wayok.
Ol ik' ip, malaj tas ol ach xib'tanok. Tzijtum mach ol jawok ach sayeq'ui, wach' ol ach aj yet' heb'.
Axo heb' chuk spensar, olto skomon sayej heb' b'aj skolchaji, palta nab'axonhej. Manhxo ol ilchaj b'aj syal skolan sb'a heb', axonhej chamel ol yak'och heb' yipok sk'ool, xchi winhaj Zofar chi'.
Ix spakanxi winhaj Job chi' icha tik:
Ha wal swab'ani to a exxonhej eyojtak masanil tas t'a skal masanil anima. Ayic ol ex chamok, tekan ol satkanel jelanil.
Palta a in pax tik ay pax in pensar, mato yelxo wal malaj jab'ok tas wojtak t'a eyichanh he naani, ¿mach wal junok manh ojtannakok juntzanh tik?
Wach'chom a in tik malaj in mul, ma in paltail, wach'chom ix yab' Dios in tewi t'a yalanhtaxo, haxo tiknaik toxonhej tzin tzetzaji.
Ha ex malaj jab'ok tas tzex ik'an tik, tzex te b'uchwaj t'ayin. Lajan ex icha junok mach swach' ekan telwok junok mach wanxo stelwi.
Ha heb' elk'um, tzalajk'olal yaj heb' t'a yol spat. Ha heb' tz'alan chuk d'ha Dios, junk'olal yaj heb'. Ha snaan heb' to malaj tas ol utaj heb' yuj.
k'anb'ejek t'a nok' nok' t'a sat lu'um yet' t'a nok' sjenhwi, syal ex sk'ayb'an nok'.
k'anb'ejekpax t'a nok' tzek' nhernhon t'a sat lu'um yet' nok' ay t'a yol ha' mar, syal ex sk'ayb'an nok' t'a jelanil.
Masanil juntzanh nok' nok' chi', yojtak nok' to a tas tzuji a Jehová tz'ak'ankoti.
Ha t'a yol sk'ab' ay sk'inal masanil tastak pitzan, syak'an yik' yik' heb' anima.
Ha yol ko ti' tz'ab'lan swach'il tas skab'lej. Ha pax ko chiquin tz'ab'an tas tz'alchaji.
Ha heb' ichamtak winak, ayxo spensar heb', yujto tzijtumxo ab'il syil heb', yuj chi' ay spensar heb'.
Palta ha Dios toxonton jelan, syal yuj smasanil.
Ha tas satel Dios, manhxa junok mach syal sb'oanxi. Ha junok mach syamchajoch waan yuj Dios, manhxa junok mach skolani.
Tato ha' syamanoch waan nhab', stakjiel masanil tastak t'a sat lu'um tik. Tato syak'paxkot nhab', sb'at ha' t'a yalanh lu'um.
Ha Dios ay spoder, jelan toni, tz'elnhejk'och yuj. A' t'a yol sk'ab' ayek' heb' smusan sat heb' anima yet' pax heb' tz'ak'ji musansatil chi'.
A' tz'ak'an satel spensar heb' jelan. Axo heb' juez somchajkank'e spensar heb' yuj.
A' tz'ik'anel heb' rey t'a yopisio, syak'an ik'jokb'at heb' t'a preso t'a junokxo ch'ok chonhab'il, b'eranel heb' sb'atkan heb'.
A' tz'ak'an quistalax heb' sakerdote. A' tz'ak'an ak'jok ganar heb' niwak yopisio.
Ha heb' ak'um razón yipk'olal yaji, manhxalaj tas syal yalan heb'. Ha heb' ayoch yopisio sch'olb'itan heb' anima, tz'ik'jiek' sjelanil heb' yuj.
A' tz'ak'an patikajkanel heb' niwak yelk'och t'a heb' anima. Axo heb' te tek'an, tz'elkan yip heb' yuj.
Syak'an ojtakajel tas k'ub'eltak yaji. Syak'an cheklaj tas manh ojtakab'ilok.
Ha Dios chi' tz'ik'anchaanh juntzanh niwak chonhab', anheja' satanpaxeli. Ha saklemanb'at heb' anima, anheja' smolb'anxi heb'.
Ha tz'ik'anek' sjelanil heb' yajalil junok chonhab', yuj chi' ichato satkanb'at heb' t'a tzinan lum b'aj manhxalaj b'e.
Toxonhej machmon yek' heb' icha t'a k’ik’ k’inal. Toxonhej squetkonek' heb' icha heb' uk'um anh.
Masanil juntzanh tik ix wil wal yet' in sat, ix wab' wal yet' in chiquin.
Ha tas eyojtak a ex tik, wojtakpaxi, mantok yelxo wal emnaquil waj t'ayex.
Palta tzin nib'ej tzin lolon yet' Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil. Tzin nib'ej tzin telaj in b'a yet'ok.
Ha ex tik, yuj eyesalwumal tze k'ub'anel tas yel. Lajan ex yet' heb' anhtum malaj wach' yochi.
Comonoc numan tzex aji, yik icha chi' scheklaji to jelan ex.
Maclejec eyab' tas ol wala', ol wal tas nab'il wuuj.
¿Am he naani to ol ex kolwaj d'ha Dios yuj eyesalwumal chi'? ¿Am he naani to ay tas ol yik' t'a he ak'oj musansatil chi'?
Tze nib'ej tzeyak'och he b'a yet' Dios, tze kolan he naani.
Palta q'uinalok tzex ch'olb'itaj yuj Dios chi', ¿tas tzex aj he naani? ¿Tzam yal eyak'an musansatil, icha tzeyutej junok anima?
Tato tze komon ak'ejoch he b'a yet' Dios he naani, ol ex stumej sik'lab'il.
Ha wal smay ol ik'an he xiwi, mato syal he tek'b'an he b'ha t'a yichanh he naani.
Ha juntzanh peka' k'ayb'ub'al tzeyala', malaj yelk'ochi, lajan icha junok muro nab'a lu'um skak'och yipok ko k'ool.
Axo tiknaik, tz'inek xe chi to ol in lolonok, taxonhej skot t'a wib'anh yuj tas ol wal tik.
Wach'chom skotxonhej t'a wib'anh, palta ol walnhej.
Wach'chom yuj chi' tzin smilcham Dios, palta ol wak'nhejoch yipok in k'ool. Ol in kolnhej in b'ha t'a yichanh.
Talaj ata' ay in kolnab'il, yujto a junok mach chuk max stek'b'ej sb'a yoch t'a yichanh Dios.
Maclejec wal eyab' tas ol aj walani.
Toxo ix in na' tas ol wutej in kolan in b'a, wojtak to wach' ol in elk'ochok.
Tato ay mach sch'oxaneli to ay in mul, syal woch waan walani masanto tzin chami.
Ach in Diosal, chab'nhej wal tas tzin k'an t'ayach, icha chi' syal in k'och t'a ichanh.
Actejxo ak'anoch in yaelal tik, manhxo in a xib'tej yet' tas ay smay.
Avtej in, ol in tak'wok t'ayach, ma jun, tzin b'ab'laj loloni, tzach tak'wi t'ayin.
Al t'ayin, ¿b'ajtil ix och in mul, ma in paltail? ¿B'ajtil ay b'aj ix in ek' t'a yib'anh chi'?
¿Tas yuj tza k'ub'ejel a b'a t'ayin? ¿Tas yuj icha junok ajk'ol tzin utej?
Lajan in icha junok xil te' tz'ik'jib'at yuj ik', ma icha anh taquinh ak. ¿Tas yuj tzak' owal wed'ok, tza nib'ej tzin a sateli?
Te ya tzal t'ayin swab'i. Tza k'anb'an t'ayin tastak in mul yiktax in quelemal.
Ichato ix ak'och k'een kadena t'a wok, k'elan achnhej ochi b'aj tz'em wok.
Yuj chi' wanxo in k'ab'at icha junok tas sk'ai, ma icha junok pichul ijtakxo.
Ha onh anima onh tik tzonh alji t'a ko nun, jab'nhej tiempo squila', skalnhej yaelal tzonh eq'ui.
Lajan ko k 'inal tik icha junok anh xumak wanto spojeli, elanhchamel stakjipaxi. Lajan pax icha tz'aj satxikanem junok enhul.
Mamin, ¿tas yuj tzak' wal och a sat t'ayin to anima innhej? ¿Tas yuj tza nib'ej tza ch'olb'itej junok tas malaj yelk'ochi?
¿Toc ay mach syal yik'anel tas wach' t'a skal tas manh wach'ok?
Ha ach tik tzala' jantak tiempo syil junjun anima. Chequel yaji jaye' sb'isul k'ual squila', max yal yek' jayeokxo k'ual uuj.
Ik'el a sat t'ayin yik tzin kan t'a junk'olal. Ak' tzalajb'ok in k'ol icha stzalajb'i sk'ol heb' munlajwum, ayik slajwi smunlaj heb'.
Ayic sch'akjiel junok te te', skak'och yipok ko k'ool to ol ja swol te', haxo te swol chi' sq'uib'xi.
Wach'chom te ichamxo te' sch'anhal yib' chi', wach'chom wanxo sk'ab'at te' yib',
haxo yik tz'emk'och sikal ha ha' t'a te', syaxb'ixi te', swolanxi te' icha junok te' yuneto tz'awchaji.
Ha onhxo pax anima onh tik, ayik tzonh chami, manhxa tas syal kuuj. Ayic tz'el ko pixan, manhxalaj mach tzonh ilani.
Icha tz'aj sk'e waan xob'al ha' mar, ma icha tz'aj stup ha ha' sb'eyi,
icha chi' tz'aj ko cham a onh anima onh tik. Yakb'an aytoek' satcha’anh tik, malaj wal junok chamnak anima ol komon pitzwok b'aj mukan, malaj junok ol komon k'e waan t'a yet'tal chi'.
Comonoc tzin a k'ub'ejel t'a chamel chi', yakb'an tzek'b'at yowal a k'ool. Tza naanpaxi b'ak'uinh tzin a naxikoti.
Ha junok anima schami, ¿tom ol pitzwokxi? Palta a inxo tik ol wak' techaj in yaelal tik, masanto ol k'och sk'ual wel t'a libre.
Ol ach awaj t'ayin, ol in tak'wok t'ayach. Ol am ach tzalaj in ilanochi, yujto a ach a b'onak in.
Ha tiknaik, k'elan ach och t'a in b'eyb'al. Axo t'a jun k'ual chi', manhxo ol ik' a kuenta t'a in mul.
Ol b'atkan in chukal chi' satk'olal uuj. Ol ak'an lajwok in mul.
Ha lum niwak witz ayik tz'elta lum k'akapil, satem lu'um, haxo k'een niwak k'een tz'el k'een t'a yet'tal.
Anhejtona' icha tz'aj yulaxb'at k'een k'een t'a yol sb'e ha ha', ma icha tz'aj yik'chajb'at lum lum yuj ha', icha chi' tz'aj ak'an lajwok tas ayoch yipok ko k'ool a onh anima onh tik.
Ha ach te ek'b'al achnhej t'a quichanh, tzonh ik'anxi meltzaj t'a junelnhej, tzak'an ixtax ko sat yik tzonh chami.
Wach'chom a heb' kalkuninal te b'inajnak ol aj heb', mato ay heb' manhxalaj ol aj yelk'ochi, palta manhxo kojtakok, manhxalaj mach ol yal yalan kab'i.
Q'uinalok chamnak onhxo, axonhej am kuuj skak' pensar, yujto skab'wal syail, xchi winhaj Job chi'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Elifaz aj Temán icha tik:
Ha mach jelan, manh smojok stak'wi t'a komon lolonel, manh smojok pax syik'chaanh sb'a syalan tas tonhej sb'at yuj ik'.
Manh tonhejok skomon loloni, max sk'anlaj komon pensar.
Ach Job, tzala' to malaj yelk'och xiwk'olal d'ha Dios, malaj pax yelk'och ejmelal t'ayach.
Ha yuj tas tzala' a sch'oxanel a mul. Tza nib'ej tza musej ko sat yet' sjelanilal a pensar chi'.
Manh a na' to a in ol walk'eta a mul, a yuj tas tzala' tzik'kot t'a ib'anh.
¿Tom a a naani to a ach b'ab'el b'ob'il ach? ¿Tom ayachxo ayik ix laj b'oji lum niwak witz?
¿Tom tz'eyanoch a chiquin ayik ix snaan Dios tas ol sk'ulej? ¿Tocwal a achnhej jelan ach t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik?
Masanil tas ojtak, kojtak pax a onh tik.
Ha ko jelanil, ix ko k'ayb'ej t'a heb' ichamtak winak sakxo xil sjolom, aton heb' ichamtak winak t'a yichanh winh a mam.
Ha Dios snib'ej syak' sniwanil a k'ol yet' lolonel k'ununi skal t'ayach, ¿tas yuj max a cha ab'i?
¿Tas yuj tzik'el a b'a d'ha Dios, tz'elwalkot jinhjinh yol a sat skot owal?
¿Tas yuj skot wal owal d'ha Dios, komonxonhej tzal juntzanh lolonel?
¿Toc ay junok anima wach'nhej to malaj jab'ok smul?
Inatax heb' ángel, manh ayokoch heb' yipok sk'ol Dios yet' pax satcha’anh, manh wal yelxo wach'ok t'a yol sat.
Ocxo wal a onh anima onh tik yajb'entak onh. Icha ko komon uk'an ha ha', icha chi' ko k'ulan chukal chi'.
Ach Job, komonok tza maklej ab' tas ol wala'. Ha jab'ok tas wojtak, ha' ol wala'.
Ha heb' aj pensar, a heb' ix onh k'ayb'ani. Ha tas yojtak heb' chi' sk'ayb'ejnakkan heb' t'a heb' smam yicham.
Aton t'a heb' smam yicham heb' chi' ak'b'il lum lum tik, manh skalejnakok sb'a heb' yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il.
Ha heb' anima chuk sb'eyb'al, tzapan sk'inal heb', skalnhej yaelal tzek' heb'.
Ayic syab'an heb' sk'anh junok tas, xiwk'e heb'. Axo yik malaj tas sna heb', sjawi heb' elk'um, syelk'anb'at heb' tas ay t'a heb'.
Manhxa tas ayoch yipok sk'ol heb' yik skolchaj heb' t'a skal k’ik’ k’inal. Ayxo och ijan k'een kuchilub' t'a heb' yik scham heb'.
Axo sniwanil heb' ol chijokb'at yuj nok' ostok. Yojtak heb' to a tas ol kot t'a yib'anh heb', manh ol ek'laj.
Ha yaelal yet' ilk'olal ol ak'an xiwk'e heb', icha tz'aj ko xiwk'e t'a yichanh junok yajal sjawi yak' owal t'ayonh.
Icha chi' tz'aj sjawi t'a yib'anh heb' syik'chaanh sb'ha t'a yichanh Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil, stek'b'an sb'a heb' t'a yichanh.
Ichato yet'nak smaklab' jul-lab' heb', sb'at lemnaj heb' yak' owal yet' Dios.
Te b'ak'uech sat heb' yet' sniwanil,
yujto yak'nak ganar juntzanh chonhab' heb', yikannakkan juntzanh pat heb' manhxalaj yajal, palta ol lajwoquel juntzanh chonhab' chi' yet' juntzanh pat chi' yuj owal.
Manh najtilok ol ek' heb' yet' sb'eyumal. Ol satel heb' icha yek' swewenal asun.
Manhxo ol yal skolanel sb'a heb' t'a skal k’ik’ k’inal. Lajan ol aj heb' icha junok te' k'ab' te' stz'a yuj k'ak', ma icha junok te te' tz'el xumaquil yuj ik'.
Mokab' yak'och tas chuklaj heb' yipok sk'ool, yujto a spak ol scha heb' aton yaelal.
Ol pet cham heb', icha junok te' k'ab'te' stzepjiel t'a snunal maxtzak yaxb'i.
Lajan ol aj heb' icha junok ib' te' uwa tz'el b'ulnaj sat ayik manto q'uinhb'i, ma icha junok te' oliwo tonhej sk'ajb'anel xumaquil.
Ha heb' chuk chi', malaj yinhtilal heb' ol elkanok. Ha jantak sb'eyumal heb' ix yik' t'a elk'altak, tonhej ol tz'akanb'atok.
Aton heb' anhej chukal nab'il yuj, anhej ixtoj anima naan yuj heb', xchi winhaj Elifaz chi'.
Ix tak'wixi winhaj Job chi' icha tik:
Ayxo skajwi in te ab'an juntzanh lolonel tzeyalub'tanhej tik. Tzeyak'och he b'a eyak'an sniwanil in k'ool, palta anhej yaelal tze wach' ik'ejkot t'a wib'anh.
¿Tom malaj slajwub' juntzanh he lolonel malaj yelk'och tik? ¿Tas eyaji yuj chi' anhej wal ha' he pakan t'ayin?
Q'uinalok a ex tik icha wal waj tik eyaji, max am wal-laj icha tzeyutej eyalan tik t'ayin, max am in tzikub'tanhej in sat walan jantak lolonel t'ayex.
Palta jun, a am lolonel wach' syak' sniwanil he k'ool, syak' he tek'anil, a am swal t'ayex.
Manh yujok to tzin loloni, tz'och waan in yaelal tik, manh yujok pax to tzin em numan tz'ochpax waan.
Ha Dios tz'ak'an lajwoquel wip. Ha pax tz'ik'anel heb' wamigo t'ayin.
Ichato preso waj yuj. Jantac tas syik'chaanh heb' anima t'a in patik, jantak es lolonel syik'kot heb' t'a wib'anh.
Ha Dios tzak'anoch wuuj yik tzin sataneli, icha junok nok' chium nok'. Ay wal och sat t'ayin, icha wal to wajk'ool yaji.
Jantac heb' anima smolb'ej sb'a yik tzin sb'uchan heb'. Stz'itanb'at in sat heb', emnaquil tzin yutejkan heb'.
Ha Dios ix in ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' juntzanh anima te chuk spensar.
Junk'olal wajeq'ui, ix in swekchitani. Ix och yub'naj t'a in jaj, chok' ix in yutej, ix in yak'anoch t'a sat sjul-lab'.
Yalnhej b'aj sjawi sjul-lab' chi' t'ayin, ichato sk'axpaj t'a in niwanil tik, manhxa jab'ok sniwank'olal t'ayin. Toxonhej spukkanb'at yol in k'ol t'a sat lu'um.
Jantac in aj in lajwi yuj. Scot wal t'ayin icha junok soldado te tek'an.
Te kusk'olal waji, ayoch pichul ya swa wuuj, manhxa jab'ok wopisio.
Ste mal in sat woq'ui, sq'uik'b'i k 'inal swila'.
Icha chi' waji, wach'chom malaj mach b'aj ix och in mul, wach'nhej in lesal.
Mokab' k'ub'chajel jantak chukal ix ak'jioch t'a wib'anh. Ab'chajokab'i ayik tzin tewi yik tzin k'anan tojolal.
Ay jun ayoch in testigook ayek' t'a satcha’anh, ha' ol och wed'ok.
Ha heb' wamigo tonhej tzin sb'uch heb', a inxo tik tzin ok'nhej t'a yichanh Dios.
Ayoc wal junok mach tz'alan d'ha Dios wuuj, icha syutej junok mach skolan junok yetanimail.
Jayexonhej ab'il ayin eq'ui, haxo in b'at t'a chamel chi' b'aj maxtzak yal ko paxta.
Jab'xonhej wal syal wik'an wik' swab'i. Vanxo sk'och in k 'inal t'a slajwub', wach'xo yaj wed'tal t'a kampusante.
Ha heb' anima, oyanoch heb' in sb'uchani, masanil tiempo syak' kus in k'ol heb', maxtzak yal in kolan in b'ha t'a heb'.
Palta Mamin kolin, yujto malaj junokxo mach syak'och sb'a in skolani, a achnhej syal uuj.
Ha ach ix a k'ub'ejel jelanil t'a juntzanh heb' winh wamigo tik, manh in a cha ak'jok ganar yuj heb' winh.
Elokab'k'och icha syal jun ab'ix: Ha junok mach syixtej junok yamigo, haxo yuninal ol ab'an syail yuj jun tas sk'ulej chi'.
Ha ach ix ak' yal chuk heb' anima t'ayin, ix laj stzub'an in sat heb'.
Toxonhej k'ik'aminak wilan yuj in yaelal. Ichato manh chequelok in niwanil tik, yujto ix in te b'akb'i.
Ayic syilan heb' anima wach' sb'eyb'al tas tzin ik'an tik, sat sk'ol heb', skot yowal heb', yujto chuk in snaan heb'.
Ha heb' wach' sb'eyb'al, wach'nhej ol elk'och heb'. Ha heb' malaj chukal sk'ulej, ol k'enhejchaanh heb'.
Palta kotanhek t'a tik ex wamigo. Malaj junok aj pensar tz'ilchaj wuj t'a he kal.
B'elb'on yek' in k 'inal, haxo tas nab'il wuuj, ma tas tzin nib'ej, toxo ix juwieli.
Ha ex tik a t'ak'walil tzeyaloch k'ualil, haxo yik k'ik'k 'inal, tzeyalani, lak'anxo ay sakil k'inal.
Toxonhej tzin tanhwej in chami, yik sk'och telan in niwanil sway t'a kal k’ik’ k’inal.
Ha nok' ha'ay yet' kampusante swaloch in mam in nunok yet' wanab'ok.
¿B'ajtil ay tas swak'och yipok in k'ool? ¿Ay am mach ojtannak tas ol in ajok?
¿Tom ol k'och jun chi' wed' t'a yet'tal heb' chamnak? ¿Tom ol kannhej wed' ta' t'a yol lum lum chi'? xchi winhaj Job chi'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Bildad icha tik:
¿B'aq'uinh wal ol aktej a loloni? Nachajokab' uuj, ichato pax chi' syal ko loloni.
¿Tas yuj tzonh al nok'al, manhxa jab'ok quelk'och t'a a sat?
¿Tas yuj tza chalchitej a b'a yuj chichonk'olal? ¿Am a naani yujto icha chi' tzutej a b'a ol kan tzinan lum lum tik, ma ol k'exwok yet'tal k'een tenam?
Ha tas ayoch yipok sk'ol junok mach chuk spensar, ol tupemok, icha stup junok kandil wanxo stup sk'ak'al.
Ol tup sk'ak'al skandil t'a yol spat, manhxa sakil k'inal ta'.
Maxtzac yal yek' yet' stek'anil, wan slokan sb'a yok, stelwi yuj tas nab'il yuj.
Ichato ol em junok ch'anh yaal t'a yol sb'e, ol kan sud'naj t'a yol jun ch'anh yaal chi'.
Ol em jun ch'anh yaal chi' t'a yol sb'e. Ha t'a sjaj yok ol och sud'naj ch'anh.
k'ub'eltak yajem jun yaal chi' t'a yol sb'e.
Aynhejoch xiwk'olal t'a spatik yichanh, ichato spechji b'eyek'ok.
Ay tas t'ay t'a peka', haxo tiknaik wan scham yuj wejel, a yaelal k'elanxo och t'ay.
Ha jun ilya slajanel sniwanil, haxo sk'ab' yet' yok ichato ol k'uxjokb'at yuj jun ilya chi'.
Ol ik'joquel t'a skal junk'olal b'aj kajan, ol nherjokkanb'at t'a yichanh jun aj chamel.
Ch'okxo mach ol kajnajkan t'a skajnub'. Ayic toxo ix cham chi', ol tzikchajek' azufre t'a yol spat chi', yik satel jun yab'il chi'.
Lajan wal icha junok te te' taquinhxo sch'anhal yib' yet' sk'ab'tak.
Ha sb'inajnaquil ol satkanel t'a sat lu'um tik. Manhxa b'ak'uinh ol b'inajok.
Ol ik'chajel t'a skal heb' pitzan b'aj sakq'uinal. B'aj ay heb' chamnak t'a k’ik’ k’inal ol yumjokkanb'atok.
Manhxa yinhtilal ol kan t'a schonhab' yet' b'aj kajan.
Ayic ol ab'chaj tas ix jawi t'a yib'anh, ol xiwkank'e heb' kajan t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u yet' b'aj tz'em k'u.
Icha wal chi' ol aj satel heb' chuk, aton heb' malaj yelk'och Dios t'ay, xchi winhaj Bildad chi'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Job chi' icha tik:
¿B'aq'uinh wal ol eyaktej he tzuntzan owaj in yaelal tik, tzeyak'an kus in k'ol yet' juntzanh he lolonel tik?
Ayexnhejoch eyalan chukal lolonel t'ayin. ¿Tom max ex q'uixwi eyalan t'ayin?
Q'uinalok yel ay in mul chi', ¿tom tzeyab' syail yuj?
Tzeyik' wal chaanh he b'a t'ayin yuj in yaelal tik, tzeyalanoch t'a in sat to chuk in.
Palta komonok snachajel eyuuj to ha Dios icha tik tzin utani. A' ix in ak'anem t'a yol jun yaal tik.
Scomon el waw, swalan icha tik: Swab' wal in chami, xin chi. Palta malaj mach stak'wi t'ayin. Tzin nib'ej ay mach tzin kolani, palta malaj mach sb'oan yaj t'ayin.
Ha Dios ix makan yol in b'e, yik maxtzak yal in b'eyeq'ui. Ichato t'a skal k’ik’ k’inal tzin ek' yuj.
Ix yik'ek' in b'eyumal, ix yik'anek' sniwanil welk'ochi.
Ix in satem t'a junelnhej. Ha tas ayoch yipok in k'ool, pilan ix lajwiel icha junok te te' malaj sch'anhal yib'.
Ix sekkot yowal sk'ool t'a wib'anh, icha wal junok yajk'ool ix in yutej.
Masanil heb' soldado Dios chi' ix och oyan t'ayin. Ix oymaj heb' t'a spatiktak in pat yik syak'an owal heb' wed'ok.
Ha Dios chi' ix ik'anel heb' wuk'tak yet' heb' wamigo t'a in tz'ey, ichaxonhej junok komon anima ix in yutejkan heb'.
Ha heb' ayto wuj in b'a yet'ok yet' heb' wamigo, ix in yaktejkan heb', ix in b'atkan satk'olal yuj heb'.
Axo heb' kajan t'a in pat yet' masanil heb' in chekab', icha junok ch'ok animail ix in ajkan t'a heb', maxtzak in yilochlaj heb'.
Tato swawtejkot junok heb' in chekab' chi', maxtzak tak'wilaj heb' t'ayin, wach'chom tzin tewi t'a heb'.
Ayic tzin k'och t'a stz'ey ix wetb'eyum, chuklaj sjab' xob'al in ti' syab' ix, haxo heb' ayto wuj in b'a yet'ok, tzin syajel heb'.
Icha pax chi' heb' unin tzin spatiquejel heb'. Ayic syilan heb' weq'ui sb'uchwaj heb' t'ayin.
Ha wal heb' ek'b'al te wach' wak'an yet'ok, tzin spatiquejel heb'. Ha wal heb' tzin te tzalaj yet'ok, ix meltzajoch heb' ajk'olal t'ayin.
Toxo ix takjioch in tz'umal yet' in b'ak'chil t'a in b'aquil, tewelxonhej pitzan in.
Ex wamigo, ok'okab' he k'ool t'ayin, yujto ha Dios ix ak'ankot jun yaelal tik t'a wib'anh.
¿Tas yuj tzak'anexnhej wuuj, icha tzin yutej Dios? ¿Tom manh k'okb'ilokxo in eyak'an kusok?
Ayoc wal mach stz'ib'ankan juntzanh in lolonel tik. Comonoc tz'ak'chajkanoch t'a k'een k'een.
Comonoc a yet' k'een kinkel nab'a hierro tz'ak'jikanoch t'a k'een k'een yik skan t'a junelnhej.
Vojtak to a in Kolumal pitzannhej, haxo t'a slajwub' k'ual ol emul t'a sat lum tik yik tzin skolani.
Wach'chom slajwiel in tz'umal tik, palta ol wil wal och Dios yet' in niwanil tik.
Ha in wal lak'an ol wil wal och yet' in sat, manh ch'okok mach ol ilanok. Vanxo slajwik'och wip swab'i.
Ayic swab'an eyalan icha tik: ¿Tas wal skutej kak'an kus sk'ol winh, yujto munil a winh tz'ik'ankot syaelal chi' t'a yib'anh? xe chi.
Palta xiwanhek t'a k'een espada, aton yowal sk'ol Dios syak'lab'ej t'a heb' sk'ulan chukal. Ojtaquejequeli to ay jun Dios tzonh ch'olb'itani, xchi winhaj Job chi'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Zofar aj Naamat icha tik:
Ach Job, maxtzak yal-laj to tonhej numan tzin aji. Yuj chi' tzin nib'ej tzin tak'wi t'ayach.
Ix onh a b'uch wal yet' a chukal lolonel, palta wojtak tas ol aj in pakan t'ayach.
Ha ach tik ojtaktaxoni to atax yik ix te q'uib'chaanh anima t'a sat lu'um tik,
a stzalajk'olal heb' chuk max najtilaxlaj. Junnhej rato syak' jab' stzalajk'olal heb' chi'.
Wach'chom te chaanh yajk'e heb' icha schaanhil satcha’anh, haxo sjolom heb' sk'ek'och b'aj ay asun,
palta ol lajwoquem heb' icha stza' nok' nok', haxo heb' yamigo heb', manhxo ol nachaj yuj heb' b'aj ol k'ochkan heb' chuk chi'.
Ol satem heb' t'a ichnhej ta' icha junok wayich. Manhxalaj mach ol ilanoch heb'.
Ha heb' tz'ilantaxonoch heb' yet' heb' junnhej tzek' yet' heb', manhxa b'ak'uinh ol iljokoch heb' yuj heb'.
Ha tas yelk'ejnak heb', haxo heb' yuninal heb' ol ak'an meltzaj t'a heb' meb'a' b'aj yelk'ejnak heb' chi'.
Ayic tek'an wal yip heb' t'a squelemal, ol emkan heb' b'aj smukchaj heb' chamnak.
Wach'chom te wach' sk'ulan chukal heb' syab'i, ste tzalaj heb' yet'ok,
te chi' jun chukal chi' t'a heb',
haxo t'a yol sk'ol heb', ol meltzajoch wenenoal, icha swenenoal nok' chan.
Masanil sb'eyumal heb' ix sb'uk'emi, ol xejejxik'eta heb', yujto ha Dios ol ik'ank'eta t'a yol sk'ol heb' chi'.
Ichato ix stz'ub'b'at swenenoal nok' chan chi' heb'. Ha jun weneno chi' ol ik'an scham heb'.
Manhxo ol yak' tzalajb'ok sk'ol heb' yet' jantak tas ay t'ay, aton lech, nok' yal chab' to manhxa yalnab'il.
Masanil tas yik'naquek' heb', yowalil ol yak'xi meltzaj heb'. Manhxo ol yal yak'an tzalajb'ok sk'ol heb' yet' sb'eyumal chi'.
Ix te ixtaj heb' meb'a' yuj heb', manhxa jab'ok tas ix kan t'a heb'. Ha heb' chuk chi' ix makank'e yikok juntzanh pat to manhoklaj heb' b'ojinak.
Manhxa jab'ok tas ix kolchajkanel t'a yol sk'ab' heb'. Axonhej heb' smakb'ej sb'a t'ay smasanil, palta manh najtilok ol yak' tzalajb'ok sk'ol heb' yet'ok.
Ayic tzijtum tas tz'aj t'a heb', tzijtum pax kusk'olal ol jawok t'a yib'anh heb'.
Ha wal yik wan yak'an b'ud'jok sk'ol heb', syak'an snib'ej heb' yet' tastak ay t'ay, ata' ol sekkot yowal sk'ol Dios t'a yib'anh heb'.
Tato ol yak' ganar heb' yel t'a k'een espada nab'a hierro, haxo jul-lab' nab'a bronke ol ek' t'a heb'.
Ha jun jul-lab' chi' ol k'axpajek' t'a sniwanil heb'. Ol ek' t'a seyub' heb', ol elk'och t'a yich spatik heb'. Ol te xiwk'e heb' yuj jun chi'.
Ha k’ik’ k’inal ol k'ub'anel tastak sik'an yuj heb'. Ha jun k'ak' max tupi, ha' ol nhusantz'a masanil tastak ay t'a heb'.
Ha Dios ol ak'an cheklaj schukal heb'. Ol yalanpax heb' anima to ay smul heb'.
Ayic ol jawok yowal sk'ol Dios t'a yib'anh heb', ol satel masanil sb'eyumal heb'.
Aton wal juntzanh tik nab'il yuj Dios t'a yib'anh heb' chuk chi', wach'xo yajkan t'a yib'anh heb' yuj, xchi winhaj Zofar chi'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Job chi' icha tik:
Maclejec wal eyab' tas swala', tato icha chi' ol eyak' sniwanil in k'ool.
Niwan tzeyutej he k'ool yakb'an tzin loloni. Slajwi in lolon chi' tzex b'uchwajxi t'ayin b'ian.
¿Tocwal a yet' junok anima wan wak'an owal? ¿Tom manh smojok skus in k'ool he naani?
Ilineknab'i ol ex xiwb'atok, manhxalaj tas ol elta t'a he ti'.
Ayic tzin naankot juntzanh chi', tz'ib'xik'e in niwanil tik yuj xiwelal.
¿Tas yuj niwan tiempo syil heb' chuk? Sk'och heb' icham animail, sb'inaj wal heb'.
Tzato yil heb' sq'uib' yuninal, stzalaj pax heb' yoch oyan heb' yixchiquin t'a stz'ey.
Malaj tas xib'tan heb', junk'olalnhej yajek' heb'. Malaj syaelal heb' tz'ak'ji yuj Dios.
Ha nok' smam swakax heb', wach'nhej yel yinhtilal nok'. Ayic stajni nok' snun swakax heb', max ek'laj yune' nok'.
Ha yalyuninal heb' sk'e cheneljok heb' icha sk'e tz'itiljok nok' yunetak chiwa.
Ayic syab'an heb' yoch sjajil yamk'ab' yik b'it, aton te' arpa, te' tanhb'il yet' te' spukhaji, sk'e cheneljok heb' yuj tzalajk'olal.
Wach'nhej yaj heb' chuk chi', junk'olal tz'aj sb'atkan heb' b'aj smukchaji.
Syalan heb' d'ha Dios: Manh onh a tzuntzej, max yal ko k'ol skojtaquejel a cheknab'il.
¿Mach jun Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil chi', yik tzonh och ejmelal t'ay? ¿Tas skak' yala' tzonh tewi t'ay? xchi heb'.
Ha snaan heb' chuk chi' to yujnhej sjelanil heb' ay sb'eyumal heb'. Ha inxo tik max in cha wab' tas syal heb'.
¿Tom skomon cham heb' chuk icha tz'aj stup junok kandil? ¿Tom skomon jawi yaelal t'a yib'anh heb'? ¿Tom skomon kot yowal sk'ol Dios t'a yib'anh heb' syab'an syail heb' yuj?
¿Tom skomon saklemb'at heb' icha anh ak tz'ik'jib'at yuj chakxuxum ik'?
Ha eyalani to ato heb' uninab'il stupan smul smam. Palta a in tik swala' to smoj a wal lak'an heb' stupan smul chi', yik syojtaquejel heb' to yuj smul heb' icha chi' tz'aj heb'.
Ha heb' chuk chi' smojton schaan yaelal heb' sjawi t'a yib'anh yuj yowal sk'ol Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil.
Ayic toxo ix cham heb', manhxalaj yalan yik heb' yuj tas skotkan t'a yib'anh yuninal heb' chi'.
Palta, ¿mach syal sk'ayb'an Dios t'a jelanil? Anhejton wal Dios chi' sch'olb'itan heb' te niwak yelk'ochi.
Ay heb' wach'nhej tz'aj yeq'ui, tek'an wal yip heb' scham heb'.
Ay pax heb' jun, te kusk'olalnhej tz'aj yek' heb' scham heb', malaj jab'ok tzalajk'olal syil heb'.
Palta jun, a b'aj smukchaj heb' chamnak chi', lajannhej ol aj heb'. Junlajan ol chijokb'at heb' yuj nok' ha'ay.
Vojtak tas tze na t'a in patik yet' he chuk pensaril.
Tze naan icha tik: ¿B'ajtom ix kan spat jun winh chuk tik, jun winh yajalxo ix yutej sb'a tik? xe chi.
¿Tom malaj b'aj tzex lolon yet' heb' anima sb'eyeq'ui? ¿Tom maj eyab' tas syik'tiej heb'?
Ayic skot yowal sk'ol Dios, syak'ankot junok yaelal, haxo heb' chuk malaj tas tz'ik'an heb'.
¿Mach tz'alanoch t'a sat heb' yuj tastak sk'ulej chi'? ¿Mach ol ak'an spak yuj tas sk'ulej heb' chi'?
Axo sb'at mukchajkan heb', stanhwaj b'aj smukchaj heb' chi'.
Siklab'inak lum lum sb'atkan t'a yib'anh heb'. Jantac heb' mukb'ilxo ta', jantakto pax heb' ol mukjokpaxok.
¿Tas tz'aj eyak'an sniwanil in k'ol yet' juntzanh he lolonel malaj yelk'och tik? Nab'a es juntzanh tzeyal tik t'ayin, xchi winhaj Job chi'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Elifaz aj Temán icha tik:
¿Tocwal ay tas ol yik' Dios t'a junok anima, wach'chom to aj pensar?
Q'uinalok te tojol tzutej a b'a, mato malaj a mul, ¿tom ay jab'ok tas ol yik' Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil t'a a patik?
Manh yujok to tza k'anab'ajej, ma yuj a wach'il syak'an a kachnab'il yet' a yaelal Dios chi'.
Palta yujto a wal a chukal yet' a mul chi' malaj slajwub'.
Ix a k'ankanek' spichul heb' meb'a' ayik ix ak'an tas sk'ex heb', wach'chom ix elkan b'eran heb'.
Wach'chom te b'inajnak ach, to ik masanil lum lum tik, palta maj ak' jab'ok ha' yuk'ej heb' ay staquinhtial, maj ak' pax wa heb' ay swejel.
Ix a chek meltzaj heb' ix ix chamnak yetb'eyum, malaj jab'ok tas ix ak' t'a heb' ix. Ix ik'anek' tas aykan t'a heb' chamnak smam.
Yuj chi' tzoymaj chukal t'a a patik tiknaik, tzach somchajk'e yuj tas ay smay.
Ichato k’ik’ k’inal yaj t'ayach, maxtzak yal ilan jab'ok. Icha wal to a junok ha' eluma' wan ach yik'anb'ati.
Ha Dios ay t'a satcha’anh, najat ayk'e t'a yib'anh k'een k'anal, syilemta masanil tastak tzuji.
¿Am a naani to max yil ko b'eyb'al? ¿Tom a k'ik'al asun tzach k'ub'anel t'ay?
¿Am a naani to yuj k'ik'al asun chi' max yil Dios, yakb'an wan sb'eyek' t'a yib'anh satcha’anh chi'?
¿Tom tza tek'b'ejnhej a b'a a b'eyb'alan sb'eyb'al heb' peka' anima chuk sb'eyb'al?
Pet chamnak heb' chi', icha tz'aj yik'jib'at junok mach yuj ha' eluma'.

Wach'chom ha Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil ix ak'an b'ud'jok spat heb' yuj masanil tastak, palta ix spatiquejel Dios chi' heb'. Snaan heb' to malaj tas tz'utaj heb' yuj. Mokab' in na icha sna heb' pit syutej sb'a chi'.
Ayic ol yilan heb' wach' spensar satel heb' chuk, ol tzalajk'e heb'. Axo heb' malaj smul tonhej ol tzewaj heb' ol yalan heb' icha tik:
Ha heb' kajk'ool wan satel heb', wan stz'ab'at sb'eyumal heb', xcham heb'.
Ach Job, ochanhxi junk'olal yet' Dios, tato icha chi' wach' ol ach ajxieq'ui.
Schaokab' a k'ol to ha Dios chi' tzach k'ayb'ani. Canokab' wal slolonel t'a a pensar.
Tato tzik'em a b'a, tzak'anxioch a b'ha t'a yol sk'ab' Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil chi', ol ach yik'xichaanh. Tato najat tzik'kanel chukal t'a a pat,
tato manhxa yelk'och k'een oro jantak swach'il t'a yol a sat, ichaxonhej lum pokok, ma k'een komon k'een ay t'a yoltak ha ha' tz'ajkan k'een t'ayach,
tato icha chi' tzutej a b'a, ha Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil chi' ol och a b'eyumalok, icha jantak k'een oro, ma k'een plata.
Ol ach tzalaj yet'ok, ol ak'paxoch yipok a k'ool.
Tato ay tas ol a k'an t'ay, ol yab' tas ol ala', a achxo ol ak'elk'och b'aj ix ak' a ti' t'ay.
Ha tastak ol a na'a, ol elk'och t'ayach, yujto a swach'k'olal Dios ol ochnhej ed'ok.
Ha Dios tz'ik'anem heb' syik'chaanh sb'a, skolwaj t'a heb' emnaquil syutej sb'a.
Anheja' skolan heb' malaj smul, ol ach skol paxi tato malaj a mul, xchi winhaj Elifaz chi'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Job chi' icha tik:
Ha tiknaik anheja' yel waw yuj in yaelal tik. Wach'chom tzin te k'akwi, palta anheja' yak'anoch in yaelal Dios.
Comonoc swojtaquejeli b'ajtil tz'ilchaj Dios chi' wuuj, tas pax tz'aj in k'och b'aj ay sdespacho.
Tato icha chi' tzam wal t'ay yuj in yaelal tik, yujto tzijtum tas tzin nib'ej swal t'ay yuj in kolan in b'a.
Tzin nib'ej swojtaquejeli tas ol yal t'ayin.
¿Tocwal ol yak'lab'ej yip yik tzin skachanem numnajok? Maay, ol smaklej yab' tas ol wala'.
Ol am yojtaquejeli to yel swala', ol am yalani to malaj in mul. Icham chi' ol aj in yak'anel t'a libre t'a junelnhej.
Tzin sayek' Dios t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, malaj ayek' ta'. Tzin saypaxek' t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, max ilchajpaxlaj wuj ta'.
Tzin sayek' t'a stojolal norte, max ilchajlaj wuuj. Anhejtona', tzin sayanxi t'a stojolal sur, max sch'ox pax sb'a t'ayin ta'.
Palta yojtak in b'eyb'al. Ayic ol lajwok in yak'an prowal, wach'xonhej ol in ajkan icha k'een oro sb'o t'a kal k'ak'.
Ha jun b'eyb'al ix sch'oxkan t'ayin, malaj b'ak'uinh swaktejkan in b'eyb'alani.
Tzin k'anab'ajejnhej scheknab'il yet' sk'ayb'ub'al. Ek'b'alxo yelk'och scheknab'il chi' t'a yichanh b'eyumal t'a yol in sat.
Ayic snaan Dios sk'ulan junok tasi, sk'ulejnhej, malaj junok mach syal skachanoch waan.
Ha tas nab'il yuj sk'ulan t'ayin, sk'ulejnhej. Tzijtumto pax tas nab'il yuj t'a wib'anh.
Yuj wal chi' tzin te xiw t'ay. Anhej tzin naankoti tzin te xiwk'ei.
Ha Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil, yuj tz'el wip yuj xiwelal.
Wach'chom maxtzak wil-laj yuj k’ik’ k’inal oyanoch t'a in patik, palta max in emlaj numan.
Ha Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil, ¿tas yuj max yal sk'ual ayik sch'olb'itani, yik wach' stanhwaj yuj heb' swach'k'ol chi' t'a jun k'u chi'?
Ha heb' chuk sk'ex stz'akanhil lum lum heb', syelk'an nok' kalnel heb', syak'anoch nok' heb' t'a skal nok' yiko'.
Syik'anek' nok' sb'uru heb' meb'a' chamnak smam heb', sk'anankan nok' swakax heb' ix ix chamnak yetb'eyum yuj k'een tumin syak' heb' majanil.
Tz'ik'jikanel heb' meb'a' t'a yoltak b'e yuj heb'. Axo heb' anima emnaquil yeq'ui, sk'ub'ejel sb'a heb' t'a heb' chuk chi'.
Ha heb' meb'a' chi' lajan tz'ajkan heb' icha nok' kaltakte'al b'uru t'a tzinan lu'um. Ata' say wa sb'a heb'. Ha t'a tzinan lum chi' say swael yalyuninal heb'.

Ha heb' meb'a' chi' sb'at heb' t'a smunlajel heb' ch'ok animail. Sb'at sik'k'e ixim jolom trigo heb', sb'at pax heb' t'a skal yawb'en uwa heb' chuk chi', sb'at heb' say te' sat tzato kani ayik smolji.
Ha heb' meb'a' chi', malaj spichul heb' ayochi tzek' ak'wal. Malaj jab'ok tas spichan heb' t'a siik.
Ayic syak'an nhab', tzek'chaj ha' t'a heb' t'a kaltak te', haxo t'a yoltak k'een nhak'een skol sb'a heb'.
Ha heb' chuk chi' syik'ek' snenetak unin heb' ix chamnak yetb'eyum heb', yik skan t'a heb' yuj tas syak' heb' majanil t'a heb' ix.
Ha heb' meb'a' chi', jab'tzin spichul heb' ayochi. Tz'ek' heb' kuchoj trigo, palta wan schampax heb' yuj wejel.
Smunlaj heb' yet' k'een molino tz'ik'anelta akeite. Stek'anel yal sat te' uwa heb', palta wan schampax heb' yuj taquinhtial.
Axo heb' ya yaji, tz'el yaw heb' sk'anan kolwal. Van scham heb' t'a kal chonhab', palta max ab'chajlaj yel yaw heb' yuj Dios.
Ay heb' malaj snib'ej t'a jun b'e yik sakil k'inal, max sb'eyb'alej tojolal heb'.
Ayic k'ik'to sk'e waan heb' mak'umcham anima, yik sb'at smak'ancham heb' meb'a' heb'. Axo tzek' ak'wal, a elk'al syak' heb'.
Ha heb' tz'em ajmulal stanhwej heb' sq'uik'b'i, smakan sat heb'. Snaan heb' icha tik: Malaj mach ol onh ilanochok, xchi heb'.
Ha heb' elk'um chi', a t'ak'walil tz'och heb' elk'al t'a te' pat. Axo t'a k'ualil makan heb', yujto max schalaj sk'ol sakil k'inal heb'.
Xiv heb' t'a sakil k'inal chi', haxo k’ik’ k’inal stzalaj heb' yet'ok, yujto ata' xiw juntzanhxo anima.
Ha heb' chuk chi', elanhchamelnhej ol ek' heb' icha sb'ey swomal ha ha', haxo sluum heb' ol katab'ajkanok. Manhxa mach ol munlaj b'aj ay yawb'en uwa heb'.
Icha tz'aj yulaxb'at k'een cheew yuj sk'ak'al yok k'u, icha chi' ol aj satem heb' chuk chi' b'aj smukchaji.
Ha heb' chuk chi' sb'atkan heb' satk'olal yuj snun. Manhxa mach snaankot heb', haxo nok' ha'ay schianb'at heb'. Stelwi heb' icha tz'aj stelwi junok te te' sch'akchaji.
Tz'ixtaj heb' ix ix toxon max unewilaj yuj heb'. Max kolwajpaxlaj heb' t'a heb' ix chamnak yetb'eyum.
Palta ha Dios yet' spoder satanel heb' chuk chi'. Ha wal yik sch'oxan spoder Dios chi', manhxa junok mach max xiw t'a chamel.
Tato tz'el t'a sk'ol Dios, junk'olal pitzan heb' chuk chi', palta aynhejoch sat t'a tas sk'ulej heb'.
Quennhej tiempo tz'ik'jichaanh heb' chuk chi', palta elanhchamel satxikanel heb'. Icha tz'aj stakji ixim trigo jochb'ilxo, icha chi' tz'aj heb'.
Tato manh ichokta', ¿mach ex syal eyalani to wan wesani, to satnak in? xchi winhaj Job chi'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Bildad aj Súa icha tik:
Ha Dios ay spoder, xiwub'tak, a tz'ak'anoch junk'olal t'a skal heb' ay t'a satcha’anh.
Manhxo b'ischajb'enok jantak k'een k'anal b'ob'il yuj, ¿tom ay junok mach b'aj max k'och sakil k'inal yuj?
¿Tocwal ay junok anima malaj smul t'a yichanh Dios? ¿Tocwal ay junok mach te wach'?
Ha k'een uj malaj yok k'een t'a yichanh. Axo k'een k'anal manh wach'ok k'een t'a yol sat.
Ocxo wal onh anima onh tik, lajan onh icha nok' ha'ay, xchi winhaj Bildad chi'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Job chi' icha tik:
Yipk'olal ix kolwaj a lolonel ix al t'ayin t'a in kusk'olal tik, yuj am to tzila' to manhxalaj wip.
Wach' jun, syal ak'an in razón, tzin a k'ayb'an a in malaj in pensar tik.
¿Mach ix lolon t'a a pensar yuj chi' tzala'? ¿Mach ix alan t'ayach, yuj chi' tzal icha chi'?
Ha heb' chamnak ayek' t'a sjulal yich ha' mar, tz'ib'xi heb' yuj xiwelal.
Ha b'aj ayek' heb' chamnak, chequel yaj t'a yichanh Dios, chequel yaj junjun heb' t'a yichanh.
Ha ix jenhb'anb'at satcha’anh t'a stojolal norte b'aj jakan, malaj tas t'ay. Ix sb'oanoch lum lum b'aj malaj tasi.
Ha tz'ak'anb'at ha ha' t'a skal asun, palta max nhik'chajlaj asun chi' yuj yalil ha'.
Ha tz'ak'an k'ik'b'oquel sat k'een uj, wach'chom k'ojan k'een, palta ha' tz'ak'anoch asun t'a sat k'een.
Ha ix ak'anem yechel t'a yib'anh ha' mar b'aj sk'och k'aman sakil k'inal yet' k’ik’ k’inal.
Ha yipumal satcha’anh tz'ib'xi, xiwpaxk'ei ayik stumwaj Dios chi'.
Ha yuj spoder ix skachanoch waan ha' mar, yuj sjelanil ix yak'an ganar nok' niwan Rahab.
Jun pusnhej syak'a' sk'achwi, a yet' spoder stekancham nok' chan mekan kuman sb'ati.
Ha jantak tas satub'tak sk'ulej ix kab' tik, jab'nhej. Ha tas ix kab' tik tonhej ix ko mak ab'ej. Ocxom wal to tz'akan tz'aj kab'ani, maxtzak am nachajel kuuj, xchi winhaj Job chi'.
Ix lolonnhej winhaj Job:
Swak' in ti' t'a yichanh Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil, aton jun max yal sk'ol sb'oan yaj tas waji, aton tz'ak'an ixtaxel in pensar yuj in yaelal,
yakb'an pitzan into, yakb'an tzato yal wik'an wik' yuj, anhej tas yel ol wala', manh ol wal tas manh yelok.
Toxon malaj b'ak'uinh ol wala' to yel tas tzeyal t'ayin. Manh ol in chaoch t'a wib'anh to ay in mul.
Ol walnhej to wach' in pensar, manh ol in k'ex tas swala'. Tzin b'eyk'olej wal in b'a to malaj in mul swab'i.
Masanil heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, jaokab' yaelal t'a yib'anh heb', icha yaelal sjawi t'a yib'anh heb' chuk.
¿Tasto wal ayoch yipok sk'ol heb' chuk, ayik tz'ik'jiel sk'inal heb' yuj Dios?
Ayic ayoch heb' t'a syaelal, ¿tom ol scha yab' Dios ayik ol tewok heb' t'ay?
¿Tocwal tz'ilchaj stzalajk'olal heb' d'ha Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil tato malaj b'aj syal sb'a heb' t'ay?
Ha tiknaik ol in ch'ox wal sniwan poder Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil t'ayex yet' tas nab'il yuj.
Ha ex tik eyilnakxo juntzanh chi', haxo tiknaik jun, ¿tas yuj tzex lolon t'a manh pensaril?
Ha jun yaelal tik syak' Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil spakok t'a heb' ixtum anima.
Wach'chom tzijtum yuninal heb', palta ol cham heb' t'a owal, ma yuj wejel.
Axo heb' olto kan t'a skal heb', a ilya ol ik'an scham heb'. Axo heb' ix yetb'eyum heb' skani, manh ol ok'laj heb' ix yuj heb'.
Wach'chom a heb' chuk chi' ste molb'ej k'een plata heb' icha lum pokok, wach'chom manh jantakok spichul heb' ayeq'ui,
axom junok winh winak te wach' spensar ol ak'anoch juntzanh pichul chi', ol yak'an snib'ej winh yet' k'een plata chi'.
Ha spat heb' chuk chi', k'uun, lajan icha juntzanh yet'tal nok' tzokoy, ma icha junok lechpat t'a kal munlajel.
Ha heb' chuk chi' swaykanem heb' yet' sb'eyumal, haxo tz'el swayanh heb' manhxalaj tas t'a heb', mheb'haxo heb'.
Ha xiwelal ol jawok t'a heb' icha ha' eluma', ma icha tz'aj yik'jib'at junok tas yuj ik'nhab' t'ak'walil.
Ha chakxuxum ik' skot t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, a ol ek' leman spat heb',
ol och xuman t'a heb', ol lajwoquel heb' yuj. Wach'chom olto snib'ej el lemnaj sb'a heb', palta manhxalaj niwank'olal t'a heb'.
Ha jun owal ik' chi' ol k'anh wal, ol xururok yoch t'a spatik heb'.
Ha k'een plata ay sminasil k'een b'aj sk'eta, haxo k'een oro ay yet'tal k'een b'aj sb'oi.
Ha k'een hierro tz'ik'chajk'eta k'een t'a yol lu'um, haxo k'een k'een, ayik stz'a k'een t'a kal k'ak', tz'elta k'een kobre t'a k'een.
Ha heb' anima, maxtzak xiwlaj heb' b'aj te k'ik'k 'inal. Tz'emnhej heb' t'a yoltak k'een niwak xab' te jul yich. Ha t'a skal k’ik’ k’inal chi', ata' say k'een k'een chi' heb'.
Sjoyk'eta juntzanh minas heb' b'aj maxtzak ek' anima, najat yajb'at b'aj ay chonhab'. Ha yet' ch'anh lasu tzek' d'unhunhok heb'.
Ha t'a sat lu'um tik, sq'uib'chaanh tas swaji, haxo t'a yalanh lu'um syak'och k'ak' heb' anima yik spoj k'een k'een.
Axo t'a skal sk'ajil k'een chi', tz'ilchaj k'een zafiro yet' k'een oro.
Ha t'a yoltak minas chi', malaj junok nok' ik'umb'at much tzek' ta'. Malaj pax nok' ch'akb'a tz'ilan yool chi'.
Ha nok' chium nok', maxtzak ek'laj nok' ta'. Maxtzac ek'paxlaj nok' choj ta'.
Ha heb' winh winak, smak' k'een k'een heb' winh te tzatz, syamanoch heb' winh sjoyan yichtak lum niwak witz.
Sjoyanoch niwak olan heb' winh t'a sattak k'een tenam, yik sayan k'een k'een heb' winh karo stojol.
Sjakank'eta ha ha' heb' winh ta'. Syik'ank'eta heb' winh t'a sakil k'inal tastak k'ub'eltak yaji.
Palta a jelanil ¿b'ajtil tz'ilchaji? ¿b'ajtil ay aj pensaril?
Ha jelanil chi' malaj junok anima ojtannak tastak yet'nak, max chaxlaj t'a skal heb' anima t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik.
Wach'chom sko sayek' t'a sjulal yich ha' mar, max chaxlaj kuj ta'.
Max yal yak'chaj k'een oro, ma k'een plata sk'exulok.
Max yal smanchaj yet' k'een oro te wach', ma yet' k'een kornalina, ma yet' k'een zafiro.
Max yal ko lajb'an yet' k'een oro, ma yet' k'een k'een karo stojol. Max yal sk'exchaj yet' yelwanub' sk'an heb' ix ix nab'a oro.
Ha jelanil chi' te nib'ab'il t'a yichanh k'een koral. Ek'b'al te wach' t'a yichanh k'een kuarzo, ma k'een perla.
Max yal slajb'an sb'a jelanil chi' yet' k'een krisólito skot t'a Etiopía, max yal stupchaj yet' k'een oro te wach'.
Palta ¿b'ajtil skot jelanil chi'? ¿b'ajtil ay aj pensaril?
k'ub'ab'ilel t'a masanil anima pitzan. k'ub'ab'ilpaxel t'a nok' much sjenhwi.
Ha b'aj ayek' heb' chamnak yet' jun chamel, syal heb' icha tik: Tonhej ix kab' sb'inajnaquil jelanil chi', xchi heb'.
Palta ha Dios yojtak sb'eal jelanil chi', yojtak b'aj ay.
Yujto syil masanil b'aj slajwik'och yol yib'anhk’inal tik yet' masanil tas ay t'a yalanh satcha’anh.
Ayic ix yak'ankanoch Dios yipal ik', ayik ix yak'anem yechel b'aj sjawi k'aman ha ha',
ayik ix sb'oankan tiempoal nhab'ilq'uinal, ayik ix sb'oankan b'aj tzek' lheb'lon yik smak'waj k'u,
ata' ix yila' to te niwan yelk'och jelanil, ix sch'olb'itani, ix yilani to wach' tz'aj icha chi'.
Ix yalan Dios t'a heb' anima icha tik: Tato niwan welk'och t'a yol he sat, aton jelanil chi', tato tzeyik'el he b'ha t'a skal chukal, aton aj pensaril chi', xchi Dios chi'.
Ix syamanxioch winhaj Job yalan icha tik:
Comonoc wal syal in k'ochxi icha wajtaxon t'a yalanhtaxo ayik te tanhwab'il in yuj Dios.
Ayic syak'an sakil k'inal Dios t'ayin, wach' in ek' t'a kal k’ik’ k’inal,
tek'an anima in, chequel wal skolwaj Dios yet' tastak ay t'ayin.
Aynhejek' Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil chi' wed'ok, haxo heb' wuninal, oyanoch heb' t'a in patik.
Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', manhxo jantakok yal yim nok' in wakax yet' nok' in chiwa tz'elta. Ha te' oliwo awab'il t'a kaltak k'een, manh jantakok akeite swik' t'a te'.
Ayic tzin k'och b'aj smolb'ej sb'a heb' yajalil chonhab', tzin em k'ojan t'a in xila t'a skal heb'.
Ayic tzin yilan heb' kelemtak, sb'es sb'a heb', haxo heb' ichamtak winak sk'e linhan heb' ayik tzin k'ochi.
Ha heb' yajal chonhab', numan tz'aj heb', syak' yechel heb' yik numan tz'aj juntzanhxo heb'.
Ha heb' yajalil chonhab', k'unxonhej slolon heb', manhxa tas syal heb'.
Ayic tzin yilan heb', syab'an heb' tas swala', syalan wach' lolonel heb' t'a in patik,
yujto tzin kolwaj t'a heb' manhxa smam yet' t'a heb' meb'a', aton heb' malaj junokxo mach skolan t'a skal yaelal.
Ha heb' wan scham yuj mheb'ail, syak' yuj diosal heb' t'ayin, haxo heb' ix chamnak yetb'eyum, stzalaj heb' ix yuj in kolwal.
Ha tojolal yet' wach'k'olal aynhejoch t'ayin, ichato in pichul yajochi.
In och yet' heb' max uji yilani yet' heb' max uji sb'eyi.
Icha mamab'il waj t'a heb' ay stzapan smajanil. Tzin kolan pax heb' max yal skolan sb'ha t'a yichanh heb' yajal, wach'chom manh wojtakok heb' palta tzin kolnhej heb'.
Swik'el yopisio heb' ixtum anima, tzin kolankanel heb' ayoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb'.
Ha in naani to te niwan tiempo ol wila'', icham animail ol ik'an in cham t'a in ch'at.
Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi' lajan in icha junok te te' awab'il t'a sti' junok ha ha', a sk'ab'tak te' schaan yal ak'wal tz'emi.
Wach' syutej heb' anima in yak'an b'inajok, ichato junjun k'u tz'ochnhej wip in kolan in b'a.
Masanil anima smaklan yab' tas swala', numan tz'aj heb' yab'an in razón.
Ayic slajwi in lolon chi', schanhej sk'ol heb' smasanil. Wach'nhej syab' heb'.
Snib'ej wal heb' syab' in lolonel chi', icha wal snib'an nhab' heb' munlajwum t'a waresma.
Ayic tzin tzewaj yet' heb', tz'och k'elan heb', ijan wal max schalaj heb', max stzuntzejkotlaj wowal heb'.
Swak'och wopisio t'a skal heb', swalani tas yowalil sk'ulej heb', icha junok rey tz'ak'an mandar t'a skal heb' soldado. Ayic ay skusk'olal heb', swak' sniwanil sk'ool heb'.
Ha heb' kelemtak te tzak'anto t'ayin, tzin stzetzej heb' tiknaik, okxo t'a yalanhtaxo, a heb' smam heb' manh smojok yek' heb' yet' nok' in tz'i' stanhwan nok' in kalnel.
Toxonton malaj yip heb', malaj tz'och heb' wuuj.
Yuj wejel yet' mheb'ail, tzek' heb' t'a taquinh lu'um t'ak'walil sch'okoj, haxo sch'anhal yib'tak te te' sjoyk'eta heb' sk'uxu'.
Slaj stok'k'eta anh komon ank'ultak heb' t'a kaltak te' schi'a, schi'an pax sch'anhal yib' te' meslab' heb'.
Aton juntzanh anima chi' pechb'ilel yuj heb' yetanimail. Ayic spechjib'at heb' chi', tz'el yaw heb' spechanb'at heb' chi', icha tz'aj spechji heb' elk'um.
