Ha t'a yoltak k'een nhak'een, t'a sattak k'akap yet' t'a sattak k'een tenam, ata' ix laj aj heb'.
Slaj awaj heb' t'a kaltak wayumtak icha yel yaw nok' nok', haxo t'a yichtak yok te' q'uiix slaj smolb'ej sb'a heb'.
Malaj jab'ok tas syal yuj heb', malaj yelk'och heb', pechb'ilel heb' t'a skal heb' anima.
Axo tiknaik tzin sb'uch heb' yuninal heb', syik'anel in q'uixwelal heb'.
Tzin syajan heb', tz'el heb' t'a in tz'ey, stzub'anoch heb' t'a in sat.
Palta a tiknaik, ha Dios ix ik'anel wip, maxtzak yal in kolan in b'a, yuj chi' syak' wal snib'ej heb' in yixtani.
Ha heb' anima schichon sk'ol t'ayin, toxonhej sja nhilan heb' yik tzin spechanel heb' snaani, snib'ej heb' tzin sateli.
Smakan yol in b'e heb' yik tzin satanel heb' snaani, manhxa mach skachan heb'.
Sjawi nhilnaj heb' t'ayin, ichato ay junok olan b'aj tz'ochta nhilnaj heb', ma icha ko yamchaj yuj junok ik' nhab'.
Icha wal chi' tz'aj sjawi xiwk'olal t'ayin. Ha in b'inajnaquil ix sateli, ichato ix ik'jib'at yuj ik'. Masanil tas ay t'ayin ix satkanel icha asun.
Ha tiknaik wan in chami, maxtzak och waan in yaelal tik.
Ha in yaelal tik sk'och wal t'a yoltak in b'aquil. Max och waan wab'an syail tzek' ak'wal.
Yed' wal yip Dios ichato ix sch'umoch sut'an in pichul t'a in jaj, ix och b'iran t'a in niwanil.
Ix in sjulem t'a kal sok'om. Icha lum pokok, ma k'een tik'aq'uil taanh in ajkan t'a yol sat.
Ach in Diosal, tzin k'an a kolwal, palta max ach tak'wi t'ayin. Tzin tewi t'ayach palta maxtzak a cha ab'i.
Chuc tzutej a b'a t'ayin, tzin a pechan yet' yowal a k'ool.
Ichato tzin ik'jik'e waan yuj ik', haxo ik' nhab' tzin tzikub'tanhani.
Vojtakxo to wanxo in ik'anb'at t'a chamel, aton b'aj ol k'ochnhej masanil anima.
Palta ¿tokwal max k'e ch'ikan sk'ab' junok mach ayek' t'a skal syaelal yik sk'anan kolwal?
In ok' yuj heb' ayoch t'a syaelal, in kus yuj heb' malaj tas ay t'ay.
Palta haxo tiknaik ayik tzin tanhwan tzalajk'olal, haxo kusk'olal sjawi t'ayin. Tzin tanhwej sakil k'inal, haxo k’ik’ k’inal sjawi.
Toxonhej stinhtinhan in pixan yuj xiwelal, maxtzak yal wik'an jab'ok wip, axonhej yaelal ste ja t'a wib'anh.
Ix ja wal kusk'olal t'ayin, maxtzak wil-laj sakil k'inal. Val t'a yichanh anima tzin k'e waan in k'anan kolwal.
Cuseltacxonhej yel waw icha nok' oques, ma icha nok' kujub'.
Ha in tz'umal ix te k'ik'b'ieli, schiwajpax in niwanil yuj k'ak'.
Ha t'a yalanhtaxo, tzin b'itan wal yet' yamk'ab' yik b'it t'a tzalajk'olal, haxo tiknaik, anhej ok'el swak'a'.
In nanak sik'lab'il to malaj b'ak'uinh swiloch in k'ol t'a heb' ix kob'estak.
Q'uinalok swiloch in k'ol t'a heb' ix, ¿tokwal manh ol yak' spak Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil t'ayin?
¿Tom manhok t'a heb' chuk yet' t'a heb' b'aj malaj yelk'och Dios sjawi yaelal?
¿Tocwal max yil Dios tas tzin k'ulej yet' b'ajtak tzin eq'ui?
Swak' wal in ti' to malaj mach b'aj chuk swutej in b'a, malaj b'aj ek'nak t'a in k'ol in musan sat anima.
Comonoc tzin sch'olb'itej Dios t'a stojolal icha yechtaj yalil junok tas, yik syilani to tz'akan in wach'il.
Q'uinalok in el t'a b'eyb'al yik tojolal, mato in nib'ejnak in k'ulej tas swilochi, mato ay tas manh wikok in maknak wikok,
tato icha chi', ch'okokab' mach slajankanel sat wawb'en, sjoyokab'k'eta heb' tas awab'il chi' wuuj.
Q'uinalok ay junok ix ix, ix kuchb'anb'at in pensar, mato in maklej yelta junok ix yetb'eyum junokxo winak t'a sti' spat,
tato icha chi', ak'jokab' serwil junok ch'ok winaquil yuj ix wetb'eyum, wayokab' junok ch'ok winaquil yet' ix.
Q'uinalok in k'ulej juntzanh chi', smoj wal wab'an syaelal tz'ak'jioch t'a wib'anh yuj heb' juez.
Tato icha chi', jaokab' in yaelal. Icha junok niwan k'ak' satanel tastak, ichaokab' ta' tz'aj satanel tastak ay t'ayin.
Ayic stek'b'an sb'a heb' in chekab' yalan t'ayin yuj tas swutej, swab' tas syal heb' chi'.
Tato manh ichaokta ix in k'ulej, ¿tas ol wutej woch t'a yichanh Dios? ¿Tas ol wutej walani ayik ol sk'anb'an t'ayin yuj tas ix in k'ulej?
Junnhej Dios onh ak'an pitzwok t'a ko nun yet' heb' in chekab' chi', anhejtona' tz'ak'an ko k 'inal.
Manh tonhejok swiloch heb' meb'a' ay stzapan majanil, manh tonhejok swilpaxi to malaj tas swa heb' ix ix chamnak yetb'eyum.
Ayic in wa'i laj wak' yik heb' meb'a' unin wed'ok.
Icha wal wuninal swutej heb' meb'a' unin chi'. In kolwajnhej t'a heb' ix chamnak yetb'eyum.
Ayic swilani to ay heb' anima te meb'a' malaj spichul ayochi,
haxo xil nok' in kalnel swak' b'ojok, swak'anoch sq'uixinalok heb'. Yuj chi' syak' yuj diosal heb' t'ayin.
Tato ay b'aj ix wixtej junok meb'a' unin yujto wojtak to chab'il wik yuj heb' yajal,
mak'jokab'el in k'ab' tik, elokab' weknaj in jenhjab' tik.
Yujto tzin xiw yak'an in yaelal Dios, yuj chi' max yal in tek'b'an in b'ha t'a yichanh, yujto te niwan yelk'ochi.
Malaj b'aj anhej t'a niwak b'eyumal swak'och in pensar, maj wak'och k'een oro yipok in k'ool.
Malaj b'aj wik'nakchaanh in b'a yuj in b'eyumal, ma yuj jantak tas ay t'ayin.
Swil skopopial yok k'u yet' pax yik k'ojan k'een uj te wach' yilji,
palta malaj b'aj elk'altak tzin tz'ub'elta in k'ab' yik tzin ch'oxan yechel to tzin tz'ub'elta sti' k'u yet' k'een uj chi' yik swak'anem in b'a t'ay.
Q'uinalok icha chi' swutej in b'a, smoj am wal tz'ak'jioch in yaelal, yujto chab'sat am swutej in b'a d'ha Dios ay t'a satcha’anh.
Malaj b'aj in tzalaj yuj yaelal sjawi t'a yib'anh heb' wajk'ool, ma yik sjawi chukal t'a yib'anh heb'.
Malaj b'aj ochnak in mul in k'anankot katab' t'a yib'anh heb', yik scham heb'.
Masanil heb' ayek' wed'ok, yojtak wal heb' to ayik sjawi heb' ch'ok chonhab'il t'ayin, malaj junok heb' maj ak'ji tas swa'a.
Ha heb' anima sb'eyeq'ui, maj yal in k'ol skan heb' t'a yoltak kalle t'ak'walil, jakannhej in pat t'a heb'.
Malaj in mul syal in k'ub'aneli, icha syutej sb'a juntzanhxo heb'. Malaj in mul elk'altak yaji,
yujto tzin xiw t'a heb' anima, talaj chuk tas syal heb' t'ayin. Maj in makoch in b'ha t'a yol in pat yujto in xiw yuj tas syal heb' in k'ab' wok.

Comonoc ay mach tz'ab'an tas swal tik. Ha juntzanh swal tik yelnhej smasanil. Axo tiknaik tzin tanhwej tas spak ol ak'jok t'ayin yuj Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil chi'. Ha tas tz'ak'jioch t'a wib'anh chi', komonok wach' yaj stz'ib'chaj yuj winh tz'ak'anoch t'a wib'anh chi'.
Tato icha chi', tzam wak'k'e b'aj tz'ib'ab'iloch chi' t'a sjolom in jenhjab', ma t'a in jolom icha junok korona yik swik'anchaanh in b'a.
Tzam wal d'ha Dios yuj masanil tas ix in k'ulej, max am in q'uixwi in k'och t'a yichanh.
Q'uinalok tonhej in tok'naquek' lum lum t'a heb' ay yiko', aton lum b'aj tzin munlaji,
q'uinalok tonhej ix in wab'at sat tas b'aj ix munlaj heb' in munlajwum, maj in tuppaxlaj heb', a na wan scham heb' yuj wejel.
Tato icha chi', q'uib'okab' te q'uiix t'a sat in lum chi' sk'exulok ixim trigo, haxo anh komon ank'ultak sq'uib' sk'exulok ixim kebada, xchi winhaj Job chi'. Aton slajwub' slolonel winhaj Job tik.
Ayic ix yilan heb' winh oxwanh chi' to stek'b'ej sb'a winhaj Job yalani to malaj smul winh, ix yaktan heb' winh stelan sb'a yet' winh.

Palta ha t'a skal heb' winh ay jun winh winak aj chonhab' Buz, Eliú sb'i winh, yuninal winh winhaj Baraquel yinhtilal winhaj Ram. Majxo techaj yuj winh skot yowal t'a winhaj Job chi', yujto stek'b'ej sb'a winh yalani to malaj smul winh, syak'ankanb'at winh t'a yib'anh Dios.

Ix kot pax yowal winhaj Eliú chi' t'a oxwanh heb' winh yamigo winhaj Job chi', yujto maj nachajel yuj heb' winh tas ix aj spakan slolonel winh heb' winh, wach'chom ix yak'kan heb' winh t'a yib'anh winh.
Ha winhaj Eliú chi' quelemto winh t'a skal heb' winh chi', yuj chi' ix stanhwej winh slolon juntzanhxo heb' winh chi' yet' winhaj Job chi'.
Ayic ix yilan winh to maxtzak yal spakan heb' winh t'a winhaj Job chi', majxo techaj yuj winh syamanoch waan sb'a,
ix syamanoch winh yalan yik t'a skal heb' winh icha tik: Ha in tik quelem unin into, a exxo tik ichamtak winak exxo, yuj chi' maj yal in k'ol ix walb'at tas tzin na' t'a skal eyiko'.
Ix in naan icha tik: Lolonokab' heb' winh ichamtak winak tik, yujto te ay tas yojtak heb' winh. Sch'oxokab'el sjelanil heb' winh chi', xin chi.
Palta jun, masanil anima aynhej spensar, yujto ha Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil, ha' ix ak'anoch Yespíritu t'a heb'.
Manh yujok to niwanxo ab'il syil junok mach, yuj chi' jelan, manh yujok yicham winaquil junok mach, yuj chi' wach' snachajel yuj.
Yuj chi' swal icha tik: Comonoc tze maklej pax eyab' tastak wik ol wala', ay pax jab'ok tas tzin nib'ej swala'.
Ha in tik ix in maklej wab' tas ix eyala' yakb'an a ex tik wan he naan tas tzeyutej he pakan t'a winh t'a jelanil.
Ix wilanpaxi to malaj junok ex ix yal he pakan t'a winh icha wal smojal.
Xeyaltaoch he b'a jelanil, yujto maj yal eyuuj. Anhej Dios ol pakan slolonel winh chi'.
Manhok t'ayin ix yal juntzanh lolonel winh, yuj chi' manh ol in pak t'a winh icha ix he k'ulej a ex tik.
Ha tiknaik mamin Job, a heb' winh oxwanh tik, somchajnak heb' winh, max yal-laj spakan heb' winh tas ix ala'.
Palta a in tik manh ol in em numan, wach'chom a heb' winh tik manhxa tas wach' yalan heb' winh, maxtzak nachaj yuj heb' winh tas tz'aj spakani.
Palta ol wak'och in b'ha t'a skal jun lolonel tik, ol walan tas nab'il wuuj.
Tzijtum tas tzin nib'ej swala', maxtzak yal in yamanoch waan in b'a yuj tas nab'il tik wuuj.
Ijan wal tzin d'inhchaj yuj in lolonel chi' swab'i, icha nok' ak' tz'uum b'ut'an yuj yal sat uwa.
Yowalil ol wala', ichato chi' ol b'o in k'ool, yowalil ol in pak a lolonel tik.
Ha t'ayin, manh ch'okch'okoklaj yilji anima, palta lajannhej heb' smasanil.
Val yel, a in tik manh in b'eyb'alok to ay junok mach swik'chaanh. Q'uinalok icha chi', tzam yak'och in yaelal Dios, aton b'ojinak in.
Yuj chi' mamin Job, ab' tas ol wala', cham tza maklej ab' in lolonel tik:
Yujto a spak a lolonel chi' ayxoek' t'a yol in ti' yik swalani.
Ha tas nab'il wuuj, ol wal t'ayach t'a stojolal yet' t'a smasanil in k'ool.
Ha Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil, ha' ix in b'oani, a tz'ak'an in k 'inal, yuj chi' pitzan in.
Tak'wanh t'ayin tato syal a pakani, na tas ol utej a kolan a b'a.
Lajanonnhej ko chawanhil t'a yichanh Dios chi', anheja' t'a lum lum tik b'ob'il onh.
Yuj chi' max yal a xiw wuuj, max yal emnaquil ol ach wutej.
Icha tik ix wab' alani:
Wach'chom malaj in mul, malaj jab'ok in paltail, malaj chukal tzin k'ulej,
palta ha Dios sayan tas tz'aj yak'anoch t'a wib'anh, icha junok yajk'ol tzin yutej.
Ichato ix yak'och k'een kadena t'a wok, k'elannhejoch t'ayin b'ajtak tzin eq'ui, xa chi.
Palta a tas ix al tik manh wach'oklaj, yuj chi' ol wak' spak t'ayach: Ha Dios yelxo te ek'to yelk'och t'a quichanh a onh anima onh tik.
¿Tas yuj tzaloch t'a sat to max spak tas tzal t'ay?
Ha Dios chi' tzijtum makanhil syutej lolon sb'a, palta max nachajel-laj kuuj.
Ay b'aj slolon t'ak'walil, ma t'a wayichal, ma t'a ilwalil ayik te waynak onh.
Ha Dios slolon t'a ko pensar, yik tzonh kachjioch waan t'a tas sko k'ulej, icha chi' tz'aj onh xib'tanpaxi.
Icha chi' tzonh yutej Dios, yik wach' squik'el ko b'ha t'a skal chukal, yik manh komonok squik'chaanh ko b'a.
Icha chi' syutej Dios onh skolanel t'a chamel yik wach' max onh sateli.
Ay pax b'aj jun, a yet' yaelal syak' ko kachnab'il Dios chi', skab'an wal syail t'a ko niwanil.
Masanil wael te wach' tz'ak'ji ko wa''a, tonhej sko yajeli.
Stz'onb'i ko niwanil, scheklajelta ko b'aquil t'a ko niwanil chi'.
Ichato sk'och ko niwanil b'aj smukchaj heb' chamnak, ayxoek' t'a yol sk'ab' chamel.
Palta q'uinalok t'a skal jantak heb' schekab' Dios, sik'jielta junok te niwan yelk'ochi, skoti yik tzul kolwaj qued'ok, syalani tas smoj sko k'ulej,
sk'anan kuuj d'ha Dios to tz'ok' sk'ol t'ayonh. Sk'ananpax d'ha Dios chi' to max yik'el ko k 'inal, yujto chequelxo mach stupan yuj ko chukal chi'.
Icha chi' tz'aj sb'oxi ko k'ool, haxo ko niwanil tik tz'uninb'ixi, icha yik skotnak quelemal.
Ayic tzonh tewi d'ha Dios, syak'an swach'k'olal t'ayonh. Val t'a tzalajk'olal tzonh och ejmelal t'a yichanh Dios, skalan swach'k'olal t'a skal heb' quetanimail.
Skalan junjun onh t'a yichanh heb' anima icha tik: Ix och in mul, ix in k'ulej tas manh tojolok, palta ha Dios maj yal sk'ol ix yak'och in yaelal t'a smojal.
Ha ix yutej to ix in skol t'a yol sk'ab' chamel, yuj chi' tzato wil sakil k'inal, xko chama.
Icha chi' tzonh yutej Dios, manh jun chaeloknhej sk'ulej icha chi',
yuj onh skolanelta t'a yol sk'ab' chamel, yik skak'an tzalajb'ok jab'okxo ko k'ool.
Mamin Job ab' wal tas ol wala'. Numan tzach aji yakb'an tzin loloni.
Tato ay tas tza nib'ej tzala', syal alan t'ayin. Tato ay tas snachaj uuj, ala', tzin nib'ej malaj tas skan t'a ib'anh.
Tato malaj tas tzal jun, maklej ab' tas ol wala', ol ach in k'ayb'ej t'a jelanil, xchi winhaj Eliú chi'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Eliú chi' icha tik:
Ha ex jelan ex, ex he k'ayb'ejnak, ab'ek tas ol wala':
Ha yol ko ti' a tz'ab'an swach'il tastak skab'lej. Icha pax chi' ko chiquin a tz'ab'an tastak tz'alchaji.
Yuj chi' sko b'eyk'olej tas yaj juntzanh lolonel tik, yik snachajel kuuj tas yaji.
Ha winhaj Job ix alan icha tik: Ha in tik malaj in mul, palta ha Dios max b'oanel-laj tas waji.
Q'uinalok tato swala' to ay in mul, wan am wesan syal chi'. Wach'chom malaj in mul chi', palta max yik'el-laj in yaelal tik, xchi winh.
Malaj junok mach lajan yet' winhaj Job tik, skomon b'uchwaj winh d'ha Dios icha ko komon uk'an ha ha'.
Scha wal sk'ol winh junnhej tz'aj yet' heb' chuk. Junnhej tzek' winh yet' heb' anima chuk spensar.
Syalan winh to malaj tas skak' ganar ayik wach' skutej ko b'ha t'a sat Dios.
Palta a ex ay he pensar tik, ab'ek tas ol wala'. Ha Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil, malaj b'aj sk'ulej tas manh tojolok.
Ha tz'ak'an spak t'a junjun anima icha tastak sk'ulej. Junjun mach ol scha spak icha wal t'a smojalil.
Val yel ha Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil chi', malaj b'aj sk'ulej junok chukal, ma junok tas manh tojolok.
Malaj junok mach ix ak'an yopisio yak'an yajalil t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik.
Q'uinalok syal sk'ol Dios syik'el quik' yak'nakoch t'ayonh,
junlajannhej am tz'aj ko cham ko masanil, tzonh meltzajxikanoch pokokal.
Mamin Job, tato ay a pensar, ab' tas ol wala'. Tza maklej wal ab' in lolonel tik.
Q'uinalok tato manh tojolok Dios ¿tom syal yak'an Yajalil? ¿Tom tza nib'ej tzak'och t'a yib'anh Dios, jun yelxo wal ek'b'al te wach'?
Tato chuk syutej sb'a heb' rey yet' heb' yajal, max xiwlaj Dios yalanoch t'a sat heb'.
Ha Dios max yak'ochlaj sb'a yet' heb' yajal, max yak'paxochlaj sb'a yet' heb' b'eyum t'a yichanh heb' meb'a'. Lajannhej quelk'och t'a sat, yujto a b'ojinak onh ko masanil.
Tato syal sk'ol Dios, elanhchamel tzonh cham t'a junok ak'wal. Ha heb' te jelan yalani, munil ol cham heb', manh yowalilok anima ol milan heb'.
Ha Dios tz'ilan tastak sko b'eyb'alej, yojtakpaxi tastak tz'aj ko b'eyeq'ui.
Wach'chom te k'ik'k 'inal, palta max yal-laj sk'ub'anel sb'a heb' sk'ulan chukal.
Ha Dios manh yowalilok syawtej junok anima t'a yichanh yik sch'olb'itani.
Manh yowalilok sk'anb'ejek' yab'i tas yuj satel heb' niwak yajal, ch'okxo mach tz'ochkan t'a yopisio heb' chi'.
Ha Dios yojtak tastak sk'ulej heb'. Syalnhej sk'och t'ak'walil satankanel heb'.
Ha wal t'a quichanh tz'ak'jioch syaelal heb', icha tz'utaj heb' chuk,
yujto malaj snib'ej heb' sk'anab'ajan tas syala', malaj snib'ej heb' sb'eyb'alan scheknab'il.
Yuj schukal heb' yajal chi', tz'el yaw heb' meb'a' yet' heb' tz'ixtaji. Ha Dios tz'ab'an yel yaw heb' chi'.

Q'uinalok malaj tas syal Dios, malaj mach syal yak'anoch t'a yib'anh. Q'uinalok sb'at mikan Dios t'a heb' wan yixtaji, malaj mach syal skolan heb'. Wach'chom junok niwan chonhab', ma junok anima, max yal skolan sb'a.
Anhej Dios syal skolwaji yik max yak' yajalil heb' chuk spensar t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', yik max ixtaj heb' anima yuj heb'.
Mamin Job, tokwal ix al d'ha Dios: Ix och in mul, palta manhxo ol in k'ulejlaj.
Ch'ox wal in mul to maxtzak in nakoti. Tato ay b'aj chuk ix laj wutej in b'a, haxo tiknaik, manhxo ol in k'ulejlaj, manh xa chiok.
Tato max a cha ab' tas syal Dios, ¿tom a a naani to ol spak Dios t'ayach icha wal tas tza nib'ej? Yuj chi' a ach tza na' tas tzutej a b'a, manhok in ol wal t'ayach. Al wal t'ayonh tas tza na' chi'.
Ha heb' anima jelan tz'ab'an tas swal tik, ol yal heb' icha tik:
Manh yojtakok winhaj Job chi' tas syala', malaj yelk'och slolonel winh syal chi', xcham heb'.
Chamokab' wal sch'olb'itaj winhaj Job tik, yujto a tas syal winh, lajan icha tas syal heb' malaj swach'il sb'eyb'al.
Ha winhaj Job tik, manh tonhejok ay smul winh, palta yelxo te pit winh. Val t'a quichanh sb'uchwaj winh d'ha Dios, stelan wal sb'a winh yet'ok, xchi winhaj Eliú chi'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Eliú chi' icha tik:
Mamin Job, ¿tom tza na' to wach' tas ix ala'? Ha Dios ol alanok to malaj in mul, xa chi.
Wach'chom tzal wal icha tik d'ha Dios: ¿Tas alan iko' wach'chom tz'och in mul? ¿Tas in ganar tato max och in mul chi'? xa chi.
Ol in tak'wok t'ayach yet' t'a heb' winh amigo tik:
Q'ueanh k'elan t'a satcha’anh, ol ilani to a asun te chaanh yajk'e t'a ib'anh.
Wach'chom ste och a mul, malaj tas ol ik'an Dios uuj.
Taxonhej te wach' pax tas tza k'ulej jun, malaj pax tas syik'elta t'a a patik, malaj jab'ok wach'ilal syak' t'ay.
Ha heb' quetanimail, aton heb' tz'ixtaj yuj a mul, a heb' chi', wach' pax tz'elk'och heb' yuj swach'il tas tza k'ulej.
Ayic tz'ixtaj wal heb' anima, tz'el wal yaw heb' yik sayan mach skolan heb' t'a yol skab' heb' tz'ixtan chi',
palta max sayek'laj Dios heb' yik skolwaj yet' heb', aton Dios b'ojinak heb', jun tz'ak'an ko tzalajk'olal t'a skal yaelal.
Max saypaxek'laj Dios chi' heb', aton jun ek'al tzonh k'ayb'an t'a yichanh nok' nok', jun tz'ak'an ko jelanil t'a yichanh nok' much.
Tz'el yaw heb', palta max tak'wilaj Dios t'a heb', yujto te chuk heb', syik' wal chaanh sb'a heb'.
Yujto ha Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil, max scha yab' komon lolonel syal heb'.
Wach'chom tzala' to max ilochlaj Dios chi', palta a tas ayoch t'a ib'anh ayek' t'a yichanh, yuj chi' tanhwej tas ol aj sb'oan Dios chi' t'ayach.
Tzala' to max kot yowal, malaj yaelal syak' t'a heb' sk'ulan chukal.
Palta mamin Job, a juntzanh a lolonel tzal chi' malaj jab'ok yelk'ochi. Jantac tas tzala', palta malaj a pensar ayik tzach loloni, xchi winhaj Eliú chi'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Eliú chi' icha tik:
Ha tiknaik ak' niwank'olal, yujto ol ach in k'ayb'ej, ayto tas ol wal yuj swach'ilok Dios.
Ol wak'lab'ej jantak in jelanil yik tzin ch'oxaneli to ha Dios chi' b'ojinak onh, tojol ton paxi.
Ojtaquejeli to a tas swal tik t'ayach manh esok. Ha in tzin lolon ed' tik, tz'akan in jelanil.
Ha Dios te ay spoder, te ay pax sjelanil, palta malaj junok mach spatiquejeli.
Ha heb' chuk sk'ulej, scham heb' yuj Dios chi', haxo heb' tz'ixtaji, sb'oji yaj heb' yuj.
Ha stanhwan heb' anima wach' sb'eyb'al. Ha tz'ak'anoch heb' yajalil yik sb'inaj heb' t'a masanil tiempo.
Axo heb' sk'ulan chukal, tato stzek'chaj heb' t'a k'een kadena, syab' wal syail heb'.
Ha Dios sch'oxani b'ajtak tz'och smul heb' chi' yujto tzek' heb' t'a yib'anh.
Sloloni yik skachan heb', syalani to syaktejkan schukal heb' chi'.
Tato scha yab' heb', syak'anoch sb'a heb' t'a yol sk'ab', tzalajk'olal tzek' heb', ato syal jantak sk'inal heb' syak'a'.
Palta tato max scha yab' heb' jun, xikjicham heb', sb'atkan heb' t'a skal heb' chamnak yujto maj yak'och heb' t'a sk'ool tas syal Dios.
Ha heb' malaj yelk'och Dios t'ay, aynhejkot yowal heb'. Wach'chom tz'ak'jioch syaelal heb' yuj, palta max yal-laj sb'a heb' t'ay yik sk'anan skolwal heb' t'a yib'anh.
Spet cham heb', q'uixwelal tz'aj satel heb'.
Ha t'a skal syaelal junok mach, ha Dios tz'ak'an nachajel smul, yik skolchaj t'a skal syaelal chi'.

Mamin Job, icha chi' snib'ej Dios tzach yutej. Tzach yik'anelta t'a skal a yaelal, tzach yik'anb'at t'a jun lugar te wach' b'aj manhxa tas syak' palta t'ayach, yik tzak' tzalajb'ok a k'ool t'a wael jantak swach'il.
Palta haxo tiknaik, ha Dios tzach ch'olb'itani, a yaelal smoj schaan heb' chuk, a chi' wan a chaani.
Yuj chi' ya'ilej a b'a yik wach' manh elanhchamelok tzach satel yuj yowal sk'ol Dios. Manh ol yal a kolchaj t'a yowal sk'ol chi' yuj jantakok tumin.
Malaj yelk'och a b'eyumal t'a sat. Malaj pax yelk'och jantak ipalil t'ay.
Mokab' a nib'ejkot sq'uik'alq'uinalil chamel t'a ib'anh, aton stiempoal satjiel niwak chonhab' t'a elanhchamel.
Ya'ilej a b'a yik max a nib'ejb'at a b'ha t'a chukal, yujto a yaelal tik ix jawi t'a ib'anh yik max ach b'at t'a chukal chi'.
Scham wal ilan jantak spoder Dios. Malaj junok k'ayb'um syal slajb'an sb'a yet'ok.
Malaj junok mach syal yalan tas sk'ulej, malaj mach syal yalanoch t'a sat to chuk ix sk'ulej.
Masanil anima tz'alan wach' lolonel yuj tas wach' ix sb'o Dios chi'. Ya'ilej pax a b'a yik max b'at satk'olal alan wach' lolonel t'ay.
Masanil anima tz'ilan tastak b'ob'il yuj, wach'chom najatnhej syilb'at heb'.
Maxtzac nachajel kuuj jantak sniwanil yelk'ochi, max yal ko b'isan jantak yab'ilal.
Ha tz'ik'ank'e jantak ha ha' t'a chaanh, smeltzajoch ha' nhab'il.
Smolan sb'ha ha' t'a skal asun, slajwi chi' yax nhab' tz'aj yem ha' t'a quib'anh.
Malaj mach snachajel yuj tas tz'aj spukaxb'at asun chi' yuj, ma tas yuj sk'anh k'u t'a satcha’anh b'aj ay skajnub'.
Ha tz'ak'anek' kopoljok lheb'lon t'a spatiktak b'aj ayeq'ui, palta a yich ha' mar, anheja' k'ik'k 'inal yilji.
Icha tik tz'aj sch'olb'itan juntzanh chonhab', syak'an jantak wael t'a heb' anima.
Ha yamjinak lheb'lon, syumanb'at b'aj syal sk'ool, d'inhannhej sk'och b'aj sk'och chi'.
Ayic sk'anh k'u chi' a sch'oxani to wan skot niwak ik'nhab', inatax nok' molb'etzal nok', yojtak nok' to wanxo skot ik'nhab' chi'.
Ha swilan niwak ik'nhab' chi', ste ib'xik'e in pixan yuj xiwelal, ichato sk'eta swab'i.
Ab'ek wal sk'anh k'u, aton sjaj Dios, ha t'a yol sti' tz'elta jun sk'anh chi'.
Ha tz'ak'anek' kopnaj lheb'lon t'a masanil satcha’anh, scheklajk'och b'aj slajwik'och lum lum tik.
Slajwi chi' tz'ab'chaj sk'anh yoch sjaj Dios te niwan yelk'ochi. Yakb'an wan sk'anh chi' haxo lheb'lon chi' maxtzak och waan yek' kopoljok.
Ha yuj sk'anh yol sjaj chi', ay tas satub'tak sk'ulej, max nachajel kuuj.
Ha tz'ak'anem k'een sakb'akom t'a sat lu'um tik, syak'anpaxem nhab' te ay smay.
Yuj chi' ha Dios tz'ak'anoch heb' anima t'a yol spat, yik wach' snachajel yuj heb' to a tz'ak'ankot juntzanh chi'.
Axo nok' nok' sb'at nok' t'a yoltak snhak'een, ata' b'at sk'ub'ejkan sb'a nok'.
Scot chakxuxum ik' t'a stojolal sur, haxo t'a stojolal norte skot siik yuj ik'.
Ha yuj yik' Dios spitzwik'e k'een cheew, sb'at quechan k'een t'a yib'anh ha' niwak ha'.
Ha tz'ak'anoch ha' t'a skal asun, haxo t'a skal ha' spitzwielta lheb'lon.
Ha asun tzek'nhej b'aj snib'ej Dios. Icha chi' tz'aj sk'anab'ajan asun chi' tas syal t'a smasanil sat lu'um tik.
Ha yet' juntzanh tik sch'oxan Dios, syak'an yaelal ma syak'an swach'k'olal t'a heb' anima.
Mamin Job, ab' wal tas swala', scham wal ilan tas satub'tak sk'ulej Dios.
¿Tzam nachajel uuj tas syutej Dios sk'ulan masanil juntzanh tik, tas tz'aj yek' kopnaj lheb'lon t'a skal asun chi'?
¿Ojtac ama tas tz'aj skan waan asun t'a satcha’anh? Aton jun chi' sch'oxanel sjelanil Dios satub'tak.
Ha ach tik, pural stechaj k'ak' uuj t'a yol a pichul. Yuj ik' te k'ak' skot t'a sur numanxonhej tz'aj sat lum tik.
¿Tzam yal a kolwaj yet' Dios yik syak'anb'at jenhan satcha’anh tik, icha junok quechanh k'een k'een tzatz tz'ajkani?
Al t'ayonh tiknaik tas wach' skal d'ha Dios, yujto icha t'a skal k’ik’ k’inal ayonh eq'ui, manhxa tas wach' kalani.
Ha in tik max in tek'b'ej in b'a walani to tzin lolon yet' Dios. Tato tzin k'ulej icha chi', ichato in gana swik'kot in chamel.
Ina ayik tzek' ik' syik'anel asun, sk'achwi t'a chaanh, maxtzak yal ko k'e k'elan t'a yok k'u.
Ha t'a stojolal norte toxonhej kopopi tz'aj icha k'een oro, toxonhej sat ko k'ol quilan stziquiquial Dios.
Maxtzac nachajel kuuj tas yaj Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil, yujto ek'b'al spoder yet' stojolal. Te tojol yuj chi' malaj b'aj syixtej junok anima.
Yuj chi' xiw heb' anima t'ay. Malaj jab'ok yelk'och heb' syaloch sb'a jelanil t'a yichanh, xchi winhaj Eliú chi'.
Ixlajwi chi, ix lolonelta Jehová t'a winhaj Job t'a skal jun chakxuxum ik', ix yalan icha tik:
¿Tas aji, yuj chi' yet' a lolonel malaj yelk'och tzala'? Scheclaji to max a chalaj tato tz'akan in jelanil.
Tek'b'ej a b'a a pakan juntzanh tas ol in k'anb'ej tik:
¿B'ajtil ayach eq'ui ayik ix wak'anem yich lum lum tik? Al t'ayin tato yel te ay tas ojtak.
¿Ojtac ama mach ix naani jantak ix aj yem yechel yich lum chi'? ¿Mach ix naani jantak tz'aj lu'um?
¿Ojtac ama b'ajtil b'akhankan yich lum chi'? ¿Mach ix b'ab'laj ak'anem k'een k'een ayem yichok lu'um?
Ayic wanxo sq'uinhib'i t'a jun k'u chi', ix b'itan k'een k'anal. Masanil heb' ángel, ix el yaw heb' yuj tzalajk'olal.
Ayic ix elul chulnaj ha' mar t'a sat lum tik, ¿mach ix makan sat ha' yik skannhej ha' b'aj aykani?
Ha in ix wak'kan asun sk'uok ha', anheja' asun chi' ix wak'kanoch sb'alok ha'.
Ha in ix wak'kan b'aj sjawi k'aman ha' mar chi', ichato ix wak'kanoch sllaweal sti' ha'.
Ix walan t'ha ha' icha tik: Anhej t'a tik tzach jawikan k'aman, maxtzak yal ek' t'a tik, anhej t'a tik ol ach ja ponhnajok, xin chi t'ha ha'.
¿Ayxom b'aj ix ala' to skot saquil yichchaanh yik sakb'i t'a junok k'u?
¿Ix am a puk sakil k'inal t'a smasanil sat lum lum yuj a lolonel chi', yik b'at sk'ub'ejel sb'a heb' chuk?

Scheclaj wal sch'olquiltaquil sat lum lum ayik tz'och yok k'u t'a lu'um t'a q'uinhib'alil, icha scheklaj schukquiltaquil junok k'apak, ma icha tz'aj scheklajkanem otz'an junok sello t'a lum b'ak'uech lu'um.
Ha sakil k'inal chi' syaman wanaj heb' chuk, yuj chi' maxtzak yal-laj sk'ulan chukal heb'.
¿Ayxom b'aj ix ach xid'ek' il juntzanh xab' olan k'ub'eltak b'aj sk'eul ha' mar?
¿Toxom ix ila' b'ajtil ay spuertail chamub'?
¿Ojtac ama jantak yechel sat lum lum tik? Al t'ayin, tato yel ojtak smasanil.
¿Ojtac ama b'ajtil skot sakil k'inal yet' k’ik’ k’inal?
¿Tzam yal alan t'a sakil k'inal b'aj sk'ochkani? ¿Tzam yal ik'anxi meltzaj b'aj kajan?
Tekan ojtak wal sik'lab'il, ina ayachxo ayik ix in b'oan masanil tas, te ayxo a k 'inal.
¿Ayxom b'aj ix ach xid'ek' b'aj molan k'een cheew yet' k'een sakb'at wuuj?
Ha juntzanh chi', sik'an wuuj, yik swak'lab'an t'a junok yaelal, ma t'a junok owal.
¿Ojtac ama b'ajtil sjawi k'u? ¿Ojtac ama b'aj skot ik' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u chi'?
¿Mach sjakan b'aj skot seknaj yaxnhab', sch'oxan b'aj sb'at owal ik' nhab',
ayik syak'an nhab' t'a lum tzinan lu'um, b'aj malaj anima kajan,
yik sch'ayxi lum lum malaj tas sq'uib' t'ay, slajwi chi' sq'uib' anh ank'ultak?
¿Mach mamab'il yaj t'a yaxnhab' yet' t'a yal ak'wal?
¿Mach nunab'il yaj t'a k'een cheew?
¿Mach tz'ak'an tzatzb'ok ha ha' icha k'een k'een, stzatzb'iel sat ha' mar yuj siik?
¿Tzam yal a molb'an k'een k'anal skuchan Mootz, ma tza saklemb'at k'een k'anal skuchan Orión?
¿Tom a ach tzak' k'eul k'een nitk'anal ayik wan sq'uinhib'i? ¿Tom a ach tzik'elta juntzanh k'een k'anal skuch niwan Osa yet' k'een yune' Osa?
¿Tom ojtak juntzanh sleyal tastak tz'aj sb'eyek' tastak ay t'a satcha’anh? ¿Tom a ach tzak' elk'och juntzanh ley chi' t'a sat lum tik?
¿Tom syal alan t'a asun to syak'kot snhab'il?
Tato tza chekb'at lheb'lon yik sb'at t'a junok lugar, ¿tzam tak'wi t'ayach icha tik: Ina in tik, chek in, xchama?
¿Tom a ach ix ak' sjelanil nok' much yet' nok' ajtzo' yik syojtakanel nok' to ol yak' nhab'?
¿Ay am mach te jelan yojtak jantak asun ay t'a smasanil? ¿Tom syal a sekanel ha ha' ayoch t'a skal asun chi' yik syak'an nhab',
yik a lum pokok tz'och lum sok'omal, telquiltak tz'aj lu'um?
¿Tom a ach tza say schib'ej nok' nun choj yik syik'anb'at nok' t'a nok' yunetak yik sb'ud'ji nok' yunetak chi',
ayik syil-lan sb'a nok' b'aj ay, mato yik tz'em lachan nok' t'a kaltak ank'ultak?
¿Mach tz'ak'an swael nok' joj ayik tzek' nok' say swael nok' yune', yujto tz'el yaw nok' sk'anan swael t'ayin?
¿Tom ojtak b'ak'uinh tz'aj yune' nok' k'ultaquil chiwa? ¿Tom tzila' chajtil tz'aj yalji yune' nok' k'ultaquil chej?
¿Tom ojtak jaye' ujal skuchoch yune' nok', b'ak'uinh pax tz'aj yune' nok' chi'?
Ayic tz'aj yune' nok' chi', tz'em wotz'an nok' yik tz'el yune' nok' chi' yik tzek' syail.
Ayic toxo ix och yip nok' yunetak chi', sq'uib' nok' t'a kaltak te', maxtzak meltzajlaj nok' t'a snun chi'.
¿Mach ak'jinakkan nok' kaltakte'al b'uru? ¿Mach aljinakkani, yuj chi' libre yajkan nok'?
Ha in walnak b'ajtaktil skajnajkanek' nok', aton t'a taquinh lu'um yet' t'a panhquiltak b'aj malaj tas sq'uib'i.
Max yal-laj sk'ol nok' tz'aj b'aj ay aw yuj anima, malaj mach syal yak'an munlaj nok'.
Tz'ek' nok' say wa sb'ha t'a tzalquixtak, sayan anh ank'ultak nok' sk'uxu'.
¿Tom tza na' to a nok' kaltakte'al wakax syal ak'an munlajok, mato tz'ochkan nok' junok ak'wal t'a yol a makte'?
¿Tom syal a tzek'anoch te' yugo t'a nok', yik tzak'an pural nok' smunlaj t'a arado ed'ok, ma tz'och tzak'an nok' t'a a patik yik tzach d'okwi lum yet' nok'?
¿Tom yujto te ay yip nok' syal ak'anoch nok' yipok a k'ool t'a a munlajel?
¿Tom tza na' to syal a k'anan nok' yik tza molan sat tas tzawej b'aj smolb'aji?
Ilnab' nok' awestruz, slawlawan sk'axil nok' t'a tzalajk'olal, palta max yal-laj sb'at jenhenhok nok' icha nok' garza.
Ha t'a skal k'een arena syak'em snholob' nok' yik sq'uixnaj yuj sq'uixinal k'een.
Max snalaj nok' tato ay mach ol tek'an pojok, ma junokxo nok' sk'e tek'tek' t'a yib'anh.
Te chuk nok' t'a yune', ichato manh yuneok nok'. Malaj sna nok', wach'chom max k'eta nok' yune' chi'.
Yujto a in maj wak' spensar nok', yuj chi' icha chi' syutej sb'a nok'.
Ayic sk'e waan nok' sb'at lemnaj nok', max xiwlaj nok' syamchaj yuj nok' chej ayk'e anima t'a yib'anh, yujto max tzak'wan sb'ey nok' chej chi' t'a nok'.
¿Tom a ach ak'nak yip nok' chej chi'? ¿Tom a ach ak'nak xil yib' sjaj nok' yik wach' yilji nok' yuj?
¿Tom a ach tzak'k'e chennaj nok' icha nok' chil? Ste xiw heb' soldado yuj nok' ayik sjornaj snhi' nok'.
Smak'an lum lum nok' t'a ak'liktak yujto stek'ton yip nok', max xiwlaj nok' sb'at t'a owal.
Manh yojtakoklaj nok' tato ay tas ay smay, max xiwlaj nok', max ochlaj tek'naj nok' yuj k'een espada.
Wach'chom toxonhej stzinhiljub' k'een k'een ayoch t'a winh ayk'e t'a yib'anh nok', skopoljub' k'een espada yet' k'een slanza winh,
palta yet' wal yip nok' sb'at nhiknajok. Ayic tz'ok' k'een trompeta yik owal, maxtzak yal syamchajoch waan nok'.
Ayic tz'ok' k'een trompeta chi' tz'ok' pax nok'. Najatto ay nok', syab'an nok' to ay owal, syab'an nok' yoch sjaj heb' yajal.
¿Tom te jelan ach, tom syal a k'ayb'an nok' ch'akb'a yik sb'at jenhenhok nok' t'a stojolal sur?
¿Tom a ach tzal t'a nok' d'iw to sb'o so' nok' b'aj te chaanh?
Ha t'a sattak k'een tenam ayek' nok' tzek' k'u tzek' ak'wal. Ha t'a sjolomtak k'een sk'e tek'tek' nok'.
Ha t'a chaanh chi' smaklej yil nok' b'ajtil sb'at nok' syam schib'ej.
Ha nok' yune' nok' anhej chik' ik'an pitzan nok'. Ha b'aj ay sniwanil chamnak, ata' aynhejek' nok', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Job chi' icha tik:
Ach Job, ix a nib'ej a telaj a b'a wed'ok a in to Syal Vuj Smasanil, ¿ayto am tas tza nib'ej tzal t'ayin? Tak'wanh t'ayin, xchi Jehová chi'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Job chi' d'ha Dios icha tik:
¿Tas ol wutej in tak'wi a in malaj jab'ok welk'och tik? Wach' ama to malaj tas swala'.
Chael oxelxo ix in loloni, manhxalaj tas wach' walani, xchi winh.
Ix lolonpaxelta Jehová chi' t'a winh t'a skal jun chakxuxum ik' chi', ix yalan icha tik:
Tek'b'ej a b'ha t'a wichanh, ol a pakan t'ayin tastak juntzanh ol in k'anb'ej tik t'ayach:
¿Tzam a tek'b'ej a b'a alani to manh tojolok swutej in b'a, yujto malaj a mul alani?
¿Tocwal ek'b'al ip t'a wichanh? ¿Tzam nhilili sk'anh yol a jaj icha sk'anh wik tik?
Ch'oxnek wil an tato niwan elk'ochi, cheklajokab' a b'inajnaquil yet' a poder.
Scham wal ilan heb' syik'chaanh sb'a, ak' owal yet' heb', emnaquil tzutejkan heb' tato syal uuj.
Ha heb' syik' wal chaanh sb'a te chuk sb'eyb'al chi', yalnhej b'ajtil ay heb', tek'kanem heb' t'a sat lu'um wila''.
Tza mukankan heb' t'a yol lu'um. Tza makankanem heb' b'aj ayek' heb' chamnak.
Icha chi' ol aj wilani to yel ay a jelanil, syal a kolan a b'a yet' wal ip.
Ilnab' nok' niwak Behemot, a in ix in b'o nok' icha ix wutej ach in b'oani. Ha anh anh sk'ux nok' icha nok' wakax.
Ina te ay yip snanhal nok' yet' yip sb'ak'chil xub' nok'.
Ha snhe nok' lajan stzatzil icha te' k'ute', haxo sch'anhal xub' nok' pixquiltak yaji.
Ha sb'aquil nok' lajan icha k'een tubo nab'a bronke, haxo yok nok' icha k'een hierro.
Anhej juntzanh nok' chi' satub'tak yilji ix in b'o t'a skal masanil nok' nok'. Ha innhej syal in satanel nok', yujto a in ix in b'o nok'.
Ha t'a jolomtak witz b'aj stajni nok' k'ultaquil nok', ata' say anh ank'ultak nok' sk'uxu'.
Axo t'a yenhultak te te' tz'em kutzan nok', mato t'a skaltak te' aj b'aj k'ub'eltak, b'aj sitz'atak.
Ha te te' ay yenhul chi', ha t'a yenhul te' sik'b'an nok'. Ha t'a skaltak te' b'akmam oyanoch t'a stitak ha ha', ata' ay nok'.
Wach'chom ste niwanb'i ha ha' chi', max xiwlaj nok'. Wach'chom sk'ek'och ha' Jordán t'a yol snhi' nok', malaj tas sna nok'.
¿Mach wal junok syal yik'ank'eta yol sat nok', ma syal yak'anek' junok lasu t'a yol snhi' nok'?
Anheja' pax nok' lewiatán, ¿tokwal syal a yaman nok' yet' k'een anzuelo? ¿Tocwal syal a tzek'an sti' nok' yet' junok ch'anh ch'anh?
¿Tom syal ak'anek' junok ch'anh ch'anh t'a yol snhi' nok', ma tzak'ek' junok k'een gancho t'a yalanh sti' nok'?
¿Tom syal stewioch nok' t'ayach yik tz'ok' a k'ol t'a nok'? ¿Tom nanam syutej sb'a nok' t'ayach yik malaj tas tzutej nok'?
¿Tom syal ak'an a trato yet' nok' yik tz'och nok' a chekab'ok t'a masanil tiempo?
¿Tom syal a tajni yet' nok' icha tzach tajni yet' nok' much? ¿Tom syal ak'anoch sch'anhal nok' yik stajni heb' ix isil yet' nok'?
¿Tom syal spojchajek' schib'ejal nok'? ¿Tom syal skotak xikanb'at nok' heb' chonhwajum?
¿Tocwal tzek' junok jul-lab' t'a stz'umal nok' uuj? ¿Tocwal sk'axpaj k'een arpón t'a sjolom nok' uuj?
Tato tzak'lej a yaman nok', tzak'an owal yet' nok', manh ol b'at satk'olal uuj tas tzach yutej nok', manhxa b'ak'uinh ol a tzuntzej nok'.
Yalnhej mach tz'ilan nok' lewiatán chi', tz'el yip heb' yuj xiwelal.
Malaj junok mach stek'b'ej sb'a stzuntzan nok'. Ocxom wal in a in tik, ¿tokwal ay junok mach stek'b'ej sb'ha t'a wichanh?
Malaj junok mach ak'jinak junok tas t'ayin, yuj chi' malaj b'aj ay in b'ok, yujto wiknhej masanil tas.
Max waktej walan yuj yok nok' lewiatán chi', yujto te' ay yip, malaj tas stzak'wan icha yip nok' chi'.
Malaj mach syal yik'anel stz'umal nok', mato stekoch slanza heb' t'a stz'umal nok' chi', yujto a stz'umal nok' chi' icha k'een smakul snhi' sk'ol heb' soldado yaji.
Malaj mach syal sjakan sti' nok', yujto a k'een ye nok' yelxo te ay smay yilji k'een.
Ha stz'umal yich spatik nok' latz'anochi, te tzatz icha k'een k'een, lajan icha maklab' jul-lab'.
B'uk'uq'ui yaj stz'umal nok' chi', manhxa jab'ok ik' syal yek' t'ay.
Junnhej yamanh yaji, malaj mach syal snhik'chitani.
Ayic tz'ad'iswi nok', lajan wal icha yek' lheb'lon. Axo yol sat nok' stziquiqui yilji icha sjawi k'u t'a q'uinhib'alil.
Ha t'a yol snhi' nok' tz'elta k'ak', spukb'at icha namix k'ak',
tz'elta tab', icha xob'al junok chen wan xej t'a skal te' k'ak'.
Ha yet' yik'al snhi' nok' schakb'i te' tzak'ak', tz'eltapax namix k'ak' t'a yol snhi' nok'.
Ha sjaj nok' te ay yip. Masanil anima xiw t'a nok'.
Ha schib'ejal nok' te tzatz, icha wal k'een hierro b'ob'il t'a kal k'ak'.
Ha spixan nok' te tzatz icha k'een k'een, tzatz icha k'een cha'.
Tato skot nok' t'a heb' anima, a heb' te winak yalani xiw heb' t'a nok', sb'at heb' elelal yuj xiwelal chi'.
Malaj tz'och k'een espada, k'een lanza, ma jul-lab' yik syak'an owal heb' anima yet' nok'.
Ha k'een hierro icha te' unin te' yaj k'een t'a nok', haxo k'een bronke icha te te' k'aeltak yaj k'een t'a nok'.
Ha jul-lab' sjulchajoch t'a nok', max xiwlaj jab'ok nok' yuj. Ha junok k'een k'een sjulchajoch t'a nok' icha yoch anh ak icha chi' yoch k'een t'a nok'.
Tato sko jikoch junok te' niwan mak'lab' t'a nok', ichanhej ko pajanoch junok te' aj t'a nok'. Ayic sk'anh sti' jul-lab' sjawi t'a nok', tonhej tz'och k'elan nok'.
Ayic sb'at nhernhon nok' t'a sat lu'um, jul tz'ajkan yek'b'en b'aj tzek' nok' chi', icha tz'aj yuj sjayil sti' k'een rastrillo.
Ayic tzek' nok' t'a sjulal ha' mar, tz'ib'xi sat ha' yuj nok', ichato xej ha', icha xej nok' mantekat t'a yol yet'tal.
Sac tz'ajkan ha' mar b'aj tzek' nok' chi', icha saquil xil jolom.
Malaj junokxo tas t'a sat lum tik syal slajb'an sb'a yet' nok'. Ha juntzanh nok' nok' chi', a in in b'onak nok', max xiwlaj nok'.
Ha nok' sat yaj wuj t'a masanil nok' nok' ay smay. Ha nok' ayoch reyal t'a masanil nok' chium nok', xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Job chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Job chi' t'a Jehová icha tik:
Vojtak to masanil syal uuj, a tas tza nib'ej, tza b'onhej.

Ha ach ix al t'ayin icha tik: ¿Tas aji, yuj chi' yet' a lolonel malaj yelk'och tzala' scheklaji to max a chalaj tato tz'akan in jelanil? xa chi. Ha in tik a tas satub'tak yet' tas max nachaj wuuj, a chi' ix wala'.
Ix alan pax t'ayin icha tik: Ab' tas ol wala', tza pakan t'ayin tas ol in k'anb'ej t'ayach, xa chi.
Ha t'a yalanhtaxo anhej ab'ixal ix wab'i, palta haxo tiknaik tzach wil wal och yet' in sat.
Yuj chi' snachajel wuuj to malaj jab'ok welk'ochi, wach' tzin emxonhej k'ojan t'a kal pokok tik yet' t'a skal k'een tik'aq'uil taanh tik yik tzin naan in b'a, xchi winhaj Job chi'.

Ayic ix lajwi yalan juntzanh tik Jehová t'a winhaj Job chi', ix yalanpax t'a winhaj Elifaz chi' icha tik: Scot wal wowal t'ayach yet' chawanhxo heb' winh ajun ed' chi', yujto manh wach'ok tas ix eyal t'a in patik, manh lajanok ix eyutej he b'a yet' winh in chekab' aj Job tik.

Ha tiknaik, ik'ekkot ukwanhok nok' kelemtak wakax yet' ukwanhok nok' ch'ak kalnel, tzul eyak'an nok' t'a winh in chekab' aj Job tik, haxo winh ol nhusantz'a nok' smasanil silab'il t'ayin eyuuj. Ha winh ol lesalwok eyuuj, ol in chaan slesal winh chi'. Wach'chom to smoj he chaan eyaelal, yujto manh wach'ok tas ix eyal t'a in patik, manh ichok ix yutej sb'a winh in chekab' aj Job tik ix eyutej he b'a, palta manhxa tas ol ex wutej, xchi Jehová.
Yuj chi' ix kot winhaj Elifaz chi', winhaj Bildad yet' winhaj Zofar, ix sk'ulan heb' winh icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová. Ix chaji slesal winhaj Job chi' yuj Jehová chi'.
Ayic lesalwinakxo winhaj Job yuj heb' winh yamigo chi', ix yak'anxi swach'k'olal Jehová t'a winh icha t'a yalanhtaxo, ek'b'alto pax ix aj yak'an t'a winh icha ay t'a winh t'a yalanhtaxo.

Ix jawi pax heb' yuk'tak winh yila', heb' ix yanab' winh, juntzanh heb' yamigo winh yet' masanil heb' anima ojtannak winh t'a yalanhtaxo. Ix och wal jun niwan wael yuj heb' t'a spat winh. Ix yak'an sniwanil sk'ol winh heb'. Ix yalan heb' to ix kuspax heb' yuj yaelal ix yak'kot Jehová t'a yib'anh winh. Ix yak'ankan k'een tumin heb' yet' junjun kolk'ab' nab'a oro t'a winh.

Ix yak' jantak swach'k'olal Dios t'a yib'anh winhaj Job chi', ek'b'alto niwan t'a yichanh tas ay t'a winh t'a yalanhtax chi'. Ix k'ek'och sb'isul nok' skalnel winh t'a 14 mil, 6 mil nok' kamello, mil par nok' wakax smunlaji yet' mil nok' b'uru.
Ix aljixi ukwanh yuninal winh yet' oxwanh yisil.
Ha ix b'ab'el, Jemima ix yak' winh sb'iej ix, haxo ix schab'il Cesia ix sb'iej ix, haxo ix yoxil, Keren-hapuk ix sb'iej ix.
Malaj heb' ix ix t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik stzak'wan swach'il yilji icha yilji heb' ix yisil winhaj Job chi'. Ix ak'ji smakb'en heb' ix icha yik heb' winh snulej yuj smam chi'.
Ayic ix lajwi yek' juntzanh tik, 140 ab'il to ix yil winhaj Job chi'. Ixto yil winh sq'uib'kan heb' yuninal, masanto heb' yixchiquin heb' yixchiquin winh chi'.
Te icham winakxo winh ayik ix cham winh.
Te wach' yik heb' max k'anab'ajan tas syal heb' sk'ulan chukal, max b'at heb' t'a sb'e heb' manh wach'ok sb'eyb'al, max yak'och sb'a heb' t'a skal heb' b'uchumtak d'ha Dios.
Palta t'a smasanil sk'ol heb' sk'anab'ajej sk'ayb'ub'al Jehová, snaub'tanhan heb' t'a k'ual t'ak'wal.
Masanil tas sk'ulej heb', wach'nhej tz'aj yelk'ochi. Lajan yaj heb' icha junok te te' ay t'a sti' ha ha', syak' sat te' t'a stiempoal, malaj b'ak'uinh stakjiel xil te'.
Axo pax heb' chuk sb'eyb'al jun, manh ichokta heb'. Lajan yaj heb' icha smatz'il ixim trigo tz'ik'jib'at yuj ik'.
Yuj chi' manhxo ol yal-laj skolan sb'a heb' chuk chi' ayik ol ch'olb'itaj heb' t'a yichanh heb' anima tojol sb'eyb'al.
Te xajan heb' anima tojol sb'eyb'al yuj Jehová. Axo heb' anima ayb'at t'a chukal, wan sb'atkan heb' t'a syaelal.
¿Tas wal yuj tz'el wek'ek'ok yaw heb' ch'ok chonhab'il sk'echaanh? ¿Tas wal yuj slajtiej sb'a heb' t'a junok tas manh ol tzak'wan heb' sb'oani?
Ha heb' winh rey yet' heb' yajal t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', schichonoch sk'ool heb', junlajanxonhej syutej slajtian sb'a heb' yoch ajk'olal t'a Jehová yet' t'a Vinh Rey Sik'b'ilel yuj.
Slaj yalan heb' icha tik: Quik'equel ko b'ha t'a yol sk'ab' Dios yik manhxalaj yalan yik t'ayonh, xchi heb'.
Ha Jehová Yajal t'a satcha’anh tonhej stzetzaj wal heb' yuj, sb'uchji heb' yuj.
Scot yowal t'a heb', xib'taj heb' yuj. Yed' yowal sk'ool ol yalan t'a heb' icha tik:
Toxo ix wak'och yopisio Vinh Rey t'a tzalan Sion, aton jun tzalan sik'b'ilel wuuj, xcham Jehová chi'.
Axo Vinh Rey Sik'b'ilel chi' tz'alani: Swalkanel tastak ix sna Jehová. Ix yal t'ayin: Ha t'a jun k'u tik, tzin ch'oxeli to Vuninal ach.
k'an t'ayin, ol wak'an juntzanh niwak chonhab' yet' masanil yol yib'anhk’inal tik t'ayach.
Ol ak' yajalil t'a yib'anh heb' yet' wal a poder. Ol a satel heb' icha tz'aj smak'jipoj junok lum chen t'a junok k'een k'okoch, xchi t'ayin, xchi Vinh Uninab'il chi'.
Ha tiknaik jun, ex sreyal, ex yajalil juntzanh chonhab', jelanokab' tzeyutej he pensar, scham wal he k'ayb'an tas swala'.
Hak'uequem he b'ha t'a Jehová t'a tzalajk'olal, ayokab' yelk'och t'a yol he sat.
Emnaquil tzeyutej pax he b'a t'ay t'a smasanil he k'ool, yik max kot yowal t'ayex. Tato maay, ol ex satel yuj, yujto elanhchamel skot yowal. Te tzalajk'olal yik masanil heb' skol sb'ha t'a Jehová.
Mamin Jehová, tzijtum heb' anima ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, tzijtum heb' smeltzajoch wajk'oolok.
Tzijtum heb' tz'alani to manh ol in a kolo'.
Ha achxo Mamin, in Kolumal ach, uuj tzin tzalaji. Ha ach tzak' in tek'anil.
Ha tzin awaj t'ayach, tzin a tak'wej t'a jun tzalan b'aj syal sb'a heb' anima t'ayach.
Tzin ek' jichan, tzin wayb'ati, te wach' tz'aj yel in wayanh, yujto a ach tzin a tanhwej.
Manh ol in xiwlaj yuj jantak anima ak'um owal molaneq'ui, yuj heb' oyanek' t'a in patik wichanh tik.
Mamin Jehová, ochanh wed'ok. Ach in Diosal, kolinnhej. Ha ach ol a mak'poj sti' heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin. Manhxalaj jab'ok ol elk'och spoder heb' sk'ulan chukal chi'.
Mamin Jehová, a achton tzach kolwajnhej. Ak' a niwan wach'k'olal t'a quib'anh a onh a chonhab' onh tik.
Ach in Diosal, a ach tza b'o yaj in lolonel, tak'wej in ayik tzin awaj t'ayach. Ayic ay in och t'a syaelal ix in a kolani. Ok'okab' a k'ool t'ayin tiknaik, ab' tas swal t'a in lesal tik.
Ex wetanimail, ¿b'aq'uinh ol eyaktejkan eyalan in pekal? ¿B'aq'uinh ol eyaktejkan eyalan lolonel malaj yelk'ochi? ¿B'aq'uinh ol eyaktejkan he sayan tas manh yelok?
Ab'ek, a Jehová ix sik'ankanel heb' anima ayoch spensar t'ay, yik wach' tz'och heb' yikok. Ayic tzin awaj t'ay, stak'wi t'ayin.
Xiwanhec d'ha Dios, yik manhxo ol och he mul. Ayic jichan ex eq'ui, a wal yik te numan, tze b'eyk'olan he b'a.
Hak'ek och Jehová yipok he k'ool, aq'ek he silab' t'ay icha wal t'a smojal.
Tzijtum heb' tz'alani: ¿Mach ol ch'oxan swach'il t'ayonh? xchi heb'. Mamin Jehová, ch'ox a wach'k'olal t'ayonh.
Ha ach ix ak'kot tzalajk'olal t'ayin, ek'to t'a yichanh stzalajk'olal heb' niwan tas syik' t'a smunlajel.
Malaj tas tzin na' ayik tzin ek' jichan, te junk'olal tzin wayi. Mamin Jehová, a ach ton ayach och wed'ok, yuj chi' malaj tas tzin ik'ani.
Mamin Jehová, cham wal ab'an tas swala'. Ochanh k'elan t'ayin ayik sja sik'son in k'ool.
Scham wal ab'ani a swalan in b'a t'ayach. In reyal ach, in Diosal ach, yuj chi' a t'ayach ol in lesalwok.
Mamin Jehová, t'a junjun q'uinhib'alil tzin awaj t'ayach. Ha sq'uinhib'i swalan in b'a t'ayach, tzin tanhwan a paktzitan t'ayin.
Val yel Mamin, malaj a gana t'a chukal, max yal-laj yaj heb' chuk t'a a tz'ey.
Ha heb' syik'chaanh sb'a, manh ol aj heb' t'a ichanh, max schalaj a k'ool heb' sk'ulan chukal.
Ol a satel heb' tz'esani. Tza chakankanel heb' ixtum anima yet' heb' milumcham anima.
Ha inxo ol in k'och t'a a kajnub' yuj a niwan wach'k'olal t'ayin. Ol wal wach' lolonel t'ayach t'a emnaquil t'a a kajnub' iknhej yaji.
Mamin Jehová tojol ach toni, yuj chi' kuchb'ej in t'a a b'eal, cheklitej a b'eal t'a wichanh yujnhej heb' ajk'ool tzin maklani.
Malaj wal lolonel yel syal heb', anhej tas chuk sna heb'. Yuj tas syal heb' chi' sb'atkan heb' anima t'a chamel, syal wach' lolonel heb' t'a chab'satil.

Ach in Diosal, ak' wal kot yaelal t'a yib'anh heb'. Cotokab' t'a yib'anh heb' yuj juntzanh chukal sna heb' t'a yib'anh heb' yetanimail. Yujto manh jantakok schukal heb', ik'kanel heb' t'a skal a chonhab', ina to spitej wal sb'a heb' t'ayach.

Axo pax masanil heb' tzach ak'anoch yipok sk'ool jun, tzalajokab' sk'ool heb'. Elokab' yaw heb' t'a tzalajk'olal t'a masanil tiempo, yujto tza kolel heb'. Ha heb' tzach xajanani, tzalajokab' heb' uuj.
Yujto a ach Jehová, tzak' a wach'k'olal t'a heb' wach' syutej sb'a. Tza kolanel heb' yet' a wach'k'olal.
Mamin Jehová, manh in a tumej yet' yowal a k'ool. Manh ak' in yaelal ayik skot owal t'ayin.
Mamin, ok'ok wal a k'ool t'ayin, yujto manhxalaj wip swab'i. Mamin, ak'xi b'ox in k'ool yujto a in niwanil tik sluklon yuj manh ipal.
Te somchajnak in k'ool. Ha achxo Mamin Jehová, ¿b'aq'uinh ol ach och wed'ok?
Mamin Jehová, ochanh wal k'elan t'ayin, kolinel yet' wal a niwan wach'k'olal.
¿Tom ay mach olto ach naankotok ayik toxo ix chami? Malaj junok mach ol b'itan t'ayach t'a skal heb' yetchamnaquil chi'.
Ste el wip woq'ui. Manh jantakok wok' t'a junjun ak'wal. Sch'ayxiel in k'anh jolom yuj yal in sat.
Maxtzac yal-laj wilani, yujto ix mal in sat woq'ui yujnhej heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin.
Elanhec t'a in tz'ey a ex to anhej chukal tze k'ulej. Toxo ix yab' Jehová in sik'sik'an woq'ui.
Toxo ix yab' in tewi t'ay. Toxo ix scha in lesal.
Ha heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, ol kan heb' t'a q'uixwelal. Tonhej ol somchajkanel heb'. D'a junnhej mutz'satil ol kan heb' t'a q'uixwelk'olal.
Mamin Jehová, ach in Diosal, ha t'a yol a k'ab' wan in sayan in kolnab'il. Colinel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' tzin pechan b'eyek'ok.
Tato maay, ol in skotak jekchitejb'at heb' ayoch ajk'olal chi' t'ayin, icha syutej schib'ej nok' choj, yujto manhxalaj mach ol yal in skolani.
Ach Jehová in Diosal, ¿tokwal ix in k'ulej icha juntzanh tas syal heb' t'a in patik? ¿Tocwal ay in mul t'a jun chi'?
Malaj b'aj chuk ix wutej in k'ool t'a heb' wach' syutej sk'ool t'ayin. Malaj b'aj ix wixtej winh ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin wach'chom malaj in mul.
Tato ix wixtej winh, yak'okab' snib'ej winh in spechan b'eyek'ok. In yamchajokab' yuj winh, tzin stek'ub'tanhan winh masanto satel in b'inajnaquil.
Mamin Jehová, k'eanh linhan yet' yowal a k'ool. Elanhcot t'a yichanh yowal sk'ool heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin. B'o yaj t'ayin icha wal a gana t'a stojolal.
Ochokab' oyan juntzanh nakión t'a ichanh, tza ch'olb'itan yaj heb' masanto t'a satcha’anh b'aj ay a despacho.
Mamin Jehová, a achton ol a ch'olb'itej juntzanh nakión. B'o yaj t'ayin icha wal in wach' b'eyb'al yet' in tojolal.
Ach Dios te tojol, tzil spensar yet' tas tzek' t'a sk'ol junjun anima. k'okb'ilxo Mamin, satokab'el heb' te chuk sb'eyb'al chi', tzak'anpax stek'anil heb' wach' sb'eyb'al.
Ha Dios in Kolumal yaji, aton ek'to t'a yib'anh smasanil, a skolan heb' wach' spensar.
Ha Dios Juez tojol toni, yuj chi' aykot yowal t'a heb' chuk t'a junjun k'u.
Tato max snalaj sb'a sk'ool heb', ha Dios ol yak'och ye yespada. Wach'xo yaj sjul-lab' b'aj ol sjul heb'.
Vanxo sk'e sk'ak'al yol sjul-lab' chi'. Wach'xo yaj syamk'ab' to ol och chamel yuj.
Ilecnab' wal tas sna heb' chuk t'a heb' yetanimail, anhej ixtoj anima syak' heb'.
Ichato sb'o jun olan heb' te jul yich yik syamchaj heb' yetanimail heb', palta ha' heb' ol b'atkan t'a jun olan ix sb'o chi'.
Ha schukal heb' komonnhej sk'ulej, a ol kotkan t'a yib'anh heb'.
Swak' yuj diosal t'a Jehová yuj stojolal. Tzin b'itej Dios ek'to t'a yib'anh smasanil.
Mamin Jehová, Cajalil ach. Te b'inajnak ach, te niwan elk'och t'a sat lu'um tik. Icha pax chi' tz'aj yalchaj wach' lolonel t'ayach t'a satcha’anh.
Ha heb' unin yet' heb' tzato chuni tzak'lab'ej yik syalan ipalil heb', yik wach' tz'em numnaj heb' pit, heb' ajk'ool yajoch t'ayach.
Ha wal yik tzin k'e k'elan t'a satcha’anh b'ob'il uuj, b'aj ay k'een uj yet' k'een k'anal a b'onak,
tzin naan t'a yol wiko': ¿Tas wal jab'ok quelk'och a onh anima onh tik, yuj chi' tzonh a nakoti, tzonh a tanhwan yuj ko wach'ilok?
Ejminac ix onh utejkan janik' t'a yichanh heb' ángel ayik ix onh a b'oani, palta niwan quelk'och yuj kopisio ix ak'a'.
Ix ak' kopisio t'a yib'anh tas ix a b'o'o. Ix ak'anoch masanil tastak b'ob'il uuj t'a yol ko k'ab'.
Ix ak'kanoch masanil makanhil nok' nok' t'a yol ko k'ab': Nok' kalnel, nok' wakax, nok' k'ultaquil nok',
nok' much tzek' jenhenhok t'a satcha’anh, nok' chay ay t'a yol ha' mar yet' masanil nok' tzek' t'a yol ha ha' chi'.
Mamin Jehová, Cajalil ach. Te b'inajnak ach, te niwan elk'och t'a sat lu'um tik.
Mamin Jehová, t'a smasanil in k'ool tzin nib'ej swal wach' lolonel t'ayach, swalanel yab'ixal masanil tastak satub'tak ix a k'ulej.
Ach Dios, te ek' ach to t'a yib'anh smasanil, uuj wal tzin awaj t'a niwan tzalajk'olal. In gana tzach in b'itej.
D'a wal ichanh ix b'atkan heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin elelal. Ix telwi heb', ix cham heb'.
Yajal ach t'a stojolal. k'ojan ach em t'a a despacho, ix a b'oan yaj tas ix in k'an t'ayach.
Ix ak'an owal yet' juntzanh heb' ch'ok chonhab'il. Ix ak' telwok heb' sk'ulan chukal. Ix a suksat sb'i heb' yik wach' maxtzak nachajkot heb' t'a b'ak'uinh.
Toxo ix cham heb' ajk'ool, ix satel schonhab' heb' t'a junelnhej. Ha ach ix a sateli, manhxalaj junok ix kani, yik wach' maxtzak nachajkoti.
Ha achxo ach Jehová, toxonton rey ach t'a masanil tiempo. k'ojan ach em t'a a despacho yik tza ch'olb'itan heb' anima.
Ol a ch'olb'itej yol yib'anhk’inal tik t'a wach'il. Ol ach och yajalil t'a masanil chonhab' t'a stojolal.
Ach Jehová, tza kol heb' tz'ixtaji, tzak' yip heb' ayik ayoch heb' t'a niwak yaelal.
Mamin Jehová, yipk'olal aj yuj heb' ojtannak ach, yujto malaj b'aj tzaktejkan heb' ayik syalan sb'a heb' t'ayach.
B'itananhek t'a Jehová Kajal t'a Sion, alek yab' heb' chonhab' tastak ix sk'ulej.
Manh tonhejok tz'iljioch heb' milumcham anima yuj Dios, max b'atkanlaj satk'olal syaelal heb' ayoch t'a ilk'olal yuj.
Mamin Jehová, ok'okab' a k'ool t'ayin, il in emta, te ya tzin ek' yuj heb' tzin chakaneli. Colinel t'a chamel.
Ichato wal chi' b'ian, ol walan wach' lolonel t'ayach t'a yichanh heb' anima t'a spuertail Jerusalén. Tzin tzalaji, yujto ix in a kolkaneli.
Ha juntzanh ch'ok chonhab'il chi', ix telwiem heb' t'a yol jun olan ix sb'o'o. Ha yok heb' syamchaj yuj ch'anh yaal ix yak'em chi'.
Ojtakab'il Jehová yujto tojol syutej spaktzitan tas sk'ulej anima. Munil syik'kot yaelal heb' sk'ulan chukal t'a yib'anh.
Ha heb' sk'ulan chukal yet' heb' sb'atkan Dios satk'olal yuj, ol b'atkan heb' t'a chamel.
Manh masanilok tiempo ol b'atkan heb' meb'a' satk'olal yuj Dios. Ol jawok sk'ual ol elk'och tastak ayoch yipok sk'ool heb'.
Mamin Jehová, ch'oxel ipalil. Mokab' yik'chaanh sb'a heb' anima t'ayach. Ik'kot juntzanh chonhab' t'a ichanh, tzak'an syaelal heb'.
Ak'och heb' t'a xiwk'olal. Ak' yojtaquejel heb' to animanhej heb'.
Mamin Jehová, ¿tas yuj najat tzach elkani? ¿Tas yuj ichato tza k'ub'ejel a b'a ayik ay in och t'a syaelal?
Syik'chaanh sb'a heb' sk'ulan chukal, tz'och heb' ajk'olal t'a heb' meb'a', palta munil a heb' ol kan t'a yol ch'anh yaal ix sb'oem chi'.
Ha heb' sk'ulan chukal, syik'chaanh sb'a heb' yet' tas snib'ejochi. Syal wach' lolonel heb' t'a heb' snib'anoch smasanil tastak, haxo t'ayach Mamin, tonhej sb'uchwaj heb'.
Ha heb' chuk chi', max ach snalaj jab'ok heb' yuj yak'umtaquil. Ha snaan heb' to max il-laj tas wan sk'ulan heb' chi'.
Wach'nhej tz'elk'och masanil tas sk'ulej heb' chi'. Malaj yelk'och jab'ok a k'ayb'ub'al t'a heb'. Malaj tz'och heb' yajk'ol heb' chi' t'ay.
Snaan heb' t'a yol yiko' to malaj b'ak'uinh ol telwok heb'. Malaj b'ak'uinh ol somchajel heb' yalannaji.
Anhej katab' lolonel syal heb', slaj yalan es heb' yet' tas syutej xib'tan heb' anima. Elanhchamel slolon heb' yet' yowal sk'ool yet' chukal.
D'a stitak chonhab' tz'em k'ojan heb' smaklan yila' mach tzek'ta. D'a elk'altak smilcham heb' malaj smul heb'. Aynhejoch sat heb' t'a heb' max uji skolan sb'a.

Icha nok' choj ayoch t'a yol snhak'een, icha chi' syutej sb'a heb'. Sk'ub'ejel sb'a heb', smaklan heb' ilb'ajk'ool heb'. Stanhwej wal heb' janik' wal ol yak' ganar heb'. Ayic syamchaj heb', tz'ik'jib'at heb' yuj heb'.
Tz'em wotz'an heb', sk'e juknaj heb' icha nok' choj chi'. Ha heb' max yal-laj skolan sb'ha t'a yol sk'ab' heb', syamchaj heb' yuj heb'.
Ha snaan heb' sk'ulan chukal chi' to sb'atkan satk'olal uuj. Macan a sat yalan heb', max ujilaj ilan snaan heb'.
Mamin Jehová, kotanh, ak' ip ak'an syaelal heb' sk'ulan chukal chi'. Mokab' sat a k'ool t'a heb' ayoch t'a kusk'olal.
¿Tas yuj tza cha ach spatiquejel heb' sk'ulan chukal chi'? Ha snaan heb' to manh ol a ch'olb'itejlaj yaj heb'.

Ha ach wal tzil schukal heb'. Ha ach ix ila', yuj chi' ol ak' syaelal heb' icha wal smojal, icha tas sk'ulej heb'. Ha t'ayach syal sb'a heb' max yal-laj skolan sb'a. Ha ach tzach kolwaj t'a heb' unin manhxalaj smam.
Mak' q'uichaj sk'ab' heb' sk'ulan chukal chi'. Ak' yowalil chukal sk'ulej heb' chi'. Tz'akanokab' tz'aj stupan smul heb' chi'.
Ach Jehová, Yajal ach t'a masanil tiempo. Ha heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, ol ik'el heb' t'a sat lum a lu'um.

Mamin Jehová, a ach ton wal tzab' slesal heb' anima emnaquil, a ach ton wal tzak' yip heb'. Ha ach ton wal tzab' yalan sb'a heb' tz'ixtaji yet' heb' unin manhxalaj smam. Ha achton ol il tas ol ajkan heb' chuk chamelb'a yaji, yik wach' manhxo ol xib'tejlaj heb' emnaquil heb'.
Ha Jehová swak'och yipok in k'ool, yuj chi' nab'anhej tzeyal t'ayin: Ixic, k'ub'ejel a b'ha t'a kaltak te' icha syutej sb'a nok' much.
Ina wal heb' winh chuk, syak' lista sjul-lab' heb' winh yik sjulwaji, ijanxokan heb' winh yet' sjul-lab' chi'. D'a k'ub'eltak sjulji heb' anima wach' yuj heb' winh.
Tato a heb' yajal axonhej chukal ay t'a spensar, ¿tasto wal ol yutok sb'a heb' wach' sb'eyb'al? xe chi t'ayin.
Palta ayek' Jehová t'a stemplo to anhej ay yiko'. Ha t'a satcha’anh, ata' ay sdespacho, scham wal sk'ool yilani, sch'olb'itan sb'eyb'al heb' anima.
Ha Jehová sch'olb'itan yaj heb' anima wach' yet' heb' chuk. Te yajb'ilel heb' anima komonnhej smak'waj yuj.

Ha ol ak'anemta k'ak' icha wal yax nhab' yet' azufre ayoch sk'ak'al t'a yib'anh heb' chuk. Ol yak'anemta jun niwan ik' yik stakjiel masanil tas yuj. Ha ol paktzitan t'a heb' anima, ato syala' tastak sk'ulej heb'.
Ha Jehová tojol toni, scham wal sk'ool yet' tojolal. Yuj chi', a heb' anima tojol sb'eyb'al, ol yil wal Dios heb'.
Mamin Jehová, kolonh, yujto manhxalaj heb' ay elk'och t'a sat, wan satel heb' tzach k'anab'ajan t'a skal heb' anima.
Syesej heb' t'ay junjun. D'a chab'satil slolon heb' t'ay junjun yik slaj yixtan sb'a heb'.
Mamin Jehová, satkanel juntzanh anima ayoch t'a chab'satil chi' yet' heb' syik'chaanh sb'a.
Aton heb' tz'alani: Anhej tato syal ko loloni, k'okb'ilnhej chi'. Ha ko ti' tik ol onh kolanok. ¿Machto wal ol yal onh schekani? xchi heb'.
Axo Jehová tz'alani: Tz'ixtaj wal heb' malaj tas syal yuj. Ha heb' meb'a' tz'el yaw heb' yuj syail. Yuj chi', yowalil ol in kolkanel heb' stanhwan in kolwal, xchi Jehová.
Ha tas yalnakkan Jehová te wach'nhej. Icha wal k'een plata sik'lab'il stz'ai, manhxalaj jab'ok smikal, uquel snhusji t'a yol k'ak', icha chi' yaj tas yalnakkani.
Mamin Jehová, a ach ton wal tzonh a tanhwej. Toxonton tzonh a kolnhej t'a juntzanh anima tik.
Ayic schaan yab' chukal heb' anima, masanil b'aj tz'ik'jichaanh heb' chuk chi'.
Mamin Jehová, ¿b'aq'uinh wal ol in a nakoti? ¿Tocwal ol in b'atkan satk'olal uuj t'a masanil tiempo? ¿B'aq'uinh wal ol a ch'ox a wach'k'olal t'ayin?
¿Jantacto tiempo ol in te kus t'a junjun k'u? ¿Jantacto tiempo ay in ek' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ool?
Mamin Jehová in Diosal, kotanh k'elan t'ayin, tak'wanh t'ayin, ak' a wach'k'olal t'ayin, yik wach' manh ol in pet chamok,
yik manh ol yal winh ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin: Toxo ix wak' ganar, xchi talaj winh. Malaj in gana stzalaj sk'ool winh, tato tzin yak' ganar winh.
Ha a wach'k'olal ayoch yipok in k'ool, stzalajb'i in k'ool yuj a kolwal.
Mamin Jehová, tzach in b'itej yuj a wach'il t'ayin.
Ha heb' chuk spensar sna heb' to malaj Dios. Junlajanxonhej ix aj sjuanel spensar heb'. Yelxo wal te chuk sk'ulej heb'. Malaj mach sk'ulan wach'il.
Ato t'a satcha’anh k'elanemta Jehová t'a anima, yik syila' tato ay heb' syak'och spensar t'ay, yik syilpaxi tato naan yuj heb'.
Ha juntzanh b'eyb'al chuk sb'eyb'alej heb' smasanil. Junlajanxonhej tz'aj sjuwib'at heb'. Malaj junok mach b'oan wach' b'eyb'al. Toton malaj wal junok mach.
Icha wal to malaj spensar heb' sk'ulan chukal chi'. Ha heb' chi' satanel heb' yetchonhab', icha wal to swael heb' yaj heb', max yal-laj sb'a heb' t'a Jehová.
Ste ib'xi heb' yuj xiwelal, yujto ha Dios ayek' yet' heb' wach' sb'eyb'al.
Snib'ej heb' syixtejb'at tas nab'il yuj heb' emnaquil, palta a Jehová skolan heb' emnaquil chi'.
Comonoc ha t'a tzalan Sion skot ko kolnab'il a onh israel onh tik. Ayic ol yak'anxi swach'k'olal Dios t'a quib'anh, ol tzalaj wal ko k'ool a onh yinhtil onh winhaj Jacob tik. Ol el lenaj ol quila'.
Mamin Jehová, ¿mach heb' syal skajnajek' t'a a kajnub'? ¿Mach pax heb' syal yaj ed' t'a jun tzalan b'aj syak'em sb'a anima t'ayach?
Aton heb' wach' sb'eyb'al yet' heb' sb'oan tojolal, heb' anhej lolonel yel syal t'a smasanil sk'ool.
Eb' max naank'e esal lolonel, max yixtejlaj yamigo, max yal-laj spekal heb' kajan t'a slak'anil.
Eb' spatikanel heb' patikab'ilel uuj, palta stzalaj sk'ool heb' yet' heb' ay elk'och t'a sat. Eb' max k'exan tas syala', tz'elnhejk'och tas syal heb' chi', wach'chom skan heb' t'a yalanh yuj.

Eb' tz'ak'an stumin majanil, palta max sk'anlaj yune' stumin heb' chi'. Eb' max schonhlaj sb'ha t'a es testigoal t'a spatik heb' malaj smul. Ha heb' icha chi' sb'eyb'al, wal yel malaj b'ak'uinh ol ak'jok ganar heb'.
Ach in Diosal, tanhwej in wal, anhej t'ayach tzin kol in b'a.
Mamin Jehová, swal t'ayach to Vajal ach. Masanil wach'il ay t'ayin, a t'ayach skoti.
Te wach' yik heb' tzach k'anab'ajan t'a skal heb' a chonhab'. In gana tzin aj t'a skal heb'.
Ol te q'uib'chaanh syaelal heb' sb'atkan t'a spatik junok komon Dios. Max wak'ochlaj in b'a wak'an schiq'uil nok' silab' yet' heb' t'a skomon Dios chi'. Max wal-laj in b'ha t'a sdiosal heb' chi'.
Mamin Jehová, anhej t'ayach swik' masanil wach'il. Ha achton tzak' masanil tas snib'ej in k'ool. D'a yol a k'ab' ayek' in k 'inal.
Ha wal b'aj ix echtejkan in makb'en, yelxo te wach'. Manhxo jantakok swach'il tas ix ak'kan chi' t'ayin.
Mamin Jehová, swal wach' lolonel t'ayach yujto a ach tzak' in razón, tza k'ayb'an pax in pensar t'ak'walil.
Masanil tiempo naan achnhej wuuj. Yujto ayachnhej ek' wed'ok, yuj chi' malaj tas tzin ik'ani.
Yuj chi' ste tzalaj in k'ool tzin b'itani. Malaj tas tzin na'a, yujto tzach wak'och yipok in k'ool.
Manh ol in aktejkanlaj t'a skal heb' chamnak, manh ol a cha k'ab'at in niwanil tik, a in k'anab'ajum in tik t'ayach.
Tzak' wojtaquejel sb'eal k 'inal, tzak'an tzalajb'ok in k'ool ayik ayinek' ed'ok. Aynhej tzalajk'olal t'a a tz'ey t'a masanil k 'inal.
Mamin Jehová, ab' in lolonel te yel tik, kotanh k'elan t'ayin ayik swalan in b'a t'ayach. Ak'kot tz'eyan a chiquin t'a in lesal tik, yujto manh in k'ajanok walan esal lolonel.
Ha ach ton tzala' to malaj in mul, ojtak wal to tojol in pensar.

Ojtac masanil tas tzin na'a, wach'chom t'ak'walil. Ix in a b'eyk'olej, palta malaj jab'ok chukal ix ilchaj uuj t'ayin. Toxo ix in na' to malaj tas chuk ol wala'. Icha syal a lolonel, najat ix in elkan t'a sb'eal heb' komonxonhej smak'an heb' yetanimail.
Tek'tek' swutej in b'a in b'at t'a yol a b'e. Malaj b'aj ix in el b'esnaj t'ay.
Ach in Diosal, swal in b'a t'ayach, yujto tzab'nhej tas swala'. Mamin ak'kot tz'eyan a chiquin t'ayin t'a tas swal tik.
Ha heb' sayanek' a kolwal, tza kol heb' t'a heb' yajk'ool, tzin nib'ej to tza ch'ox a wach'k'olal t'ayin, aton juntzanh satub'tak.
Ya'ilej in, icha syutej junok mach syailan yol sat, icha chi' tzin utej. k'ub'ej in el icha wal syutej nok' kaxlanh smoyank'e yune'.
Colinel t'a heb' chuk skot t'ayin. Colin t'a heb' milumcham anima tz'och oyan t'a in patik chi'.
Max ok'laj sk'ol heb' chuk chi' t'a heb' yetanimail, te ak'umtaknhej slolon heb'.
Lak'an tzak'an heb' t'a in patik, ix oymaj heb' t'a in patik wichanh, toxonhej stanhwej heb' in yekan telwok t'a sat lu'um.
Lajan heb' icha junok nok' choj wotz'anemi, ayik tz'elta juknaj nok' syam schib'ej.
Mamin Jehová, ochanh wed'ok, mak sat heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin yik stelwi heb'. Ak'lab'ej k'een espada tzin a kolanel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' chuk chi'.

Mamin Jehová, kolinel yet' a poder t'a yol sk'ab' heb' anima anhej tastak ay t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik snib'ej syik'kani. Ak'kot syaelal heb', jun yaelal yiktaxon heb' yaji. Ochokab' lokan heb' yuninal heb' yet' yixchiquin heb' yet'ok.
Ha inxo jun, yujto tojol in pensar, yuj chi' ol ach wila''. Ayic ol in pitzwokk'e waan, manhxalaj tas ol snib'ej in k'ool, yujto ol in tzalaj wal t'a ichanh.
Mamin Jehová, tzach in xajanej, a ach tzak' ipal t'ayin.

Mamin Jehová, ichato nhak'een aj t'ayin, ichato in kuartel aji, yujto in Kolumal ach. Ach in Diosal, a t'ayach skot wip, a t'ayach tzin kol in b'a, in Tanhwumal aji. In Kolumal ach, te ay a poder. Uuj max in yamchajlaj yuj heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin.
Smojton wal a b'itaji. Ayic swalan in b'a t'ayach, t'a wal elanhchamel tzin a kolkanel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ol yajoch t'ayin.
Ha smay chamel ix oymaj t'a in patik. Manh jantakok yaelal ix jawi t'a wib'anh yik tzin sateli.
Ha chamel, ichato toxo ix spixoch slasu t'ayin, ichato ix sb'o in yaalil b'aj ol in telwok.
Mamin Jehová, ix wal in b'a t'ayach ayik ayinek' t'a skal in somk'olal. Ach in Diosal, ix in k'an a kolwal. Ha t'a a templo ix ab' tas ix wala'. Ix k'och waw t'a a chiquin.
Ichato chi' ix ek' jun niwan quixkab'. Yelk'olal ix ib'xi yib' lum niwak witz. Ix tzikub'tanhaj wal yuj yowal a k'ool ach in Diosal.
Ichato ix elta tab' t'a yol a nhi', haxo t'a yol a ti' ichato ix elta jun k'ak' te ow. Ichato ix elta tzipipok tzak'ak' t'a yol a ti' chi'.
Ix a jak satcha’anh, ix ach emuli. Ayoch niwak k'ik'al asun t'a yalanh ok ayik ach emul chi'.
Ay ach k'e t'a yib'anh jun querubín, ix ach b'at jenhenhok, ix ach b'at b'akhachok t'a yib'anh ik'.
k'ub'an ach el b'aj te k'ik'k 'inal. Ix a k'ub'ejel a b'ha t'a skal k'ik'al asun b'ud'jinaquel yuj ha ha'.
Ay k'ak' ix laj elta kopnaj t'a ichanh icha wal lheb'lon. Ix kot sakb'at t'a skal asun yet' tzak'ak'.
Mamin Jehová, ek' achto t'a yib'anh smasanil, ix el aw, icha wal sk'anh k'u t'a satcha’anh. Ix kot sakb'at yet' tzak'ak'.
Ix ak'anb'at a jul-lab' chi', haxo heb' ajk'ool ix saklemkanb'at heb' yuj. Ix a julanb'at jun k'ak' tzek' kopnaj t'a skal heb', ix pechchaj heb' yuj.
Mamin Jehová, yuj schaanhil ix ach awaji, yuj pax jun ik' te ow ix ak'elta, ix cheklaj yich ha' mar. Yuj pax chi' ix cheklaj yich yol yib'anhk’inal tik.
Ach in Diosal, masanto t'a satcha’anh ix ak'kot a kolwal t'ayin, ichato ix in ik'k'eta t'a yol jun ha ha' te jul yich.
Ix in a kolan t'a heb' ajk'ool te ay yip, malaj tzin och t'a heb', yelxo wal te tek'an heb' t'a wichanh.
Ix och b'ulnaj heb' t'ayin ayik ay in och t'a ilk'olal, a achxo Jehová ix ach och wed'ok.
Ix in ik'anelta b'aj lot'an, ix in ak'ankanoch b'aj lewan. Ix in a kolo' yujto xajan in uuj.
Mamin Jehová, ix ak' spak t'ayin, yujto tojol ix wutej in b'a. Ix ak' a wach'k'olal t'ayin, yujto malaj in mul,
yujto ix in k'anab'ajej a b'eyb'al. Ach in Diosal, maj in k'ulejlaj chukal yik swik'kanel in b'a t'ayach.
Masanil a k'ayb'ub'al, naannhej wuuj, malaj b'ak'uinh sb'at a lolonel satk'olal wuuj.
Wach'nhej in b'eyb'al t'a ichanh. Ix in ya'ilej in b'a yik max in b'at t'a chukal.
Yujnhejton chi' ix ak' spak t'ayin yujto tojol swutej in b'a, malaj pax in mul t'a yol a sat ach Jehová.
Mamin, a heb' tzach k'anab'ajani, ol elk'och syal a lolonel t'a heb'. Ha heb' wach' spensar, wach' pax tzutej a pensar t'a heb'.
Wach' tzutej a b'ha t'a heb' wach' sb'eyb'al, palta tza ch'ox a jelanil a tenanek' spensar heb' ixtum anima.
Tza kol heb' emnaquil, haxo heb' syik'chaanh sb'a, tzik'emta heb'.
Mamin Jehová, a achton tzak' sakil k'inal t'ayin. Ach in Diosal, a achton tzik'kanel k’ik’ k’inal t'ayin.
Yuj a kolwal ix in saklemejb'at heb' soldado, ix in k'axpajek' t'a yib'anh smuroal juntzanh chonhab'.
Ach Jehová Dios, yelxo wal te wach' a b'eyb'al. Ha a lolonel ix ak'kani, smoj ton wal malaj ko chab'k'olal t'ay. Tza kolel masanil mach yipk'olal aj yuj.
Mamin Jehová, malaj junokxo Dios, a achnhej. ¿Tocwal ay junokxo kolwajum icha ach tik?
Ach Dios, a ach tzak'nhej wip. Ha ach tzin a kuchb'ej t'a jun b'e te wach'.
Icha wal sb'ey junok nok' k'ultaquil chej, icha wal chi' tz'aj in b'ey uuj. D'a sattak witz yeq'ui, tek'tek' waj uuj.
Ha ach tzin a k'ayb'ej t'a owal, tzak'anpax wip yik tzin pakchitan junok jul-lab' nab'a bronke.
Mamin, a ach tzin a tanhwej, tzin a kolani. Ha a wach' k'ab' tzin yamank'e linhan. Yujnhej a wach'k'olal ix in ik'chaanh.
Wach' ix utej in b'e a b'oani yik wach' max in el-laj nhernajok.
Ix in pech heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, ix yamchaj heb' wuuj. Maj in ochlaj waan masanto ix cham heb' wuuj.
Chok' ix wutejkan heb' yik wach' manhxo ol k'e waan heb'. Ix telwi heb' t'a skal wok.
Ha achton tzak' wip yik swak'an owal. Ha heb' schichon sk'ol t'ayin, tzak' yak'em sb'a heb' t'ayin.
Ha ach tza pechel heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin. Yuj chi' syal in satanel heb' malaj tzin och t'ay.
Sk'an kolwal heb', palta malaj mach skolan heb'. Stewi heb' t'ayach Jehová, palta max ach tak'wilaj t'a heb'.
Chok' tz'aj heb' wuuj icha wal pokok tz'ik'chajk'e waan yuj ik'. Tzin tek'anem heb' icha wal stek'chajem lum sok'om t'a yoltak b'e.
Tzin a kolel t'a yowal heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, tzin ak'ankanoch yajalilok juntzanh niwak chonhab'. Ha heb' anima manh wojtakoklaj, a heb' tzin ak'an serwil.
Anhej syab'an wab'ixal heb', tzin sk'anab'ajan heb'. Ha heb' ch'ok chonhab'il chi', syak'och sb'a heb' t'a yol in k'ab'.
Tz'ib'xik'e heb' yuj xiwelal ayik tz'elta heb' t'a yol skuartel.
Ach Jehová pitzan ach. Ach in Kolumal, alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'ayach. Ach Dios in Kolumal, ik'jokab' chaanh a b'i.
Ha ach tzak' yojtaquejel heb' tzin ixtani to ayach och wed'ok. Tzik'ankot heb' ch'ok chonhab'il t'a yalanh in mandar.
Ha ach tzin a kolel t'a yowal sk'ool heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, aton heb' schichon sk'ool t'ayin. Mamin, tzin a kolanpax t'a heb' komonnhej smak'an anima.
Yuj chi' jun, swal wach' lolonel t'ayach t'a skal juntzanh niwak chonhab', tzin b'itan pax a b'i.
Uuj wal, swak' ganar niwak owal a in rey in tik, a in sik'b'il in el uuj. D'a masanil tiempo tza ch'ox a wach'k'olal t'ayin a in Dawid in tik yet' t'a heb' winhtilal icha ajnak alani.
Ha satcha’anh yet' masanil tas ay t'ay, a sch'oxanel sb'inajnaquil Dios, sch'oxanel swach'il smunlajel.
Junjun k'u, junjun ak'wal sch'oxjiel sjelanil yuj tastak ay t'a satcha’anh.
Wach'chom malaj junok lolonel tz'ab'chaji, malaj pax junok jaj tz'ab'chaj yochi,
palta sb'eyb'at yab'ixal Dios t'a masanil sat lu'um tik, masanto b'aj slajwik'och masanil yol yib'anhk’inal tik. Ha t'a satcha’anh, ata' ay k'u yuj Dios.
Icha wal junok winh quelem ato wal snupnaji, stzalaji tz'elta t'a yol skuarto, icha chi' sjawi k'u. Ma icha junok winak te ay yip stzalaj sk'ool ayik sb'at t'a smunlajel.
Sk'eul yok k'u t'a yichchaanh, sb'atxikan t'a b'aj tz'emxikani, malaj junok tas syal skolan sb'ha t'a sk'ak'al.
Ha wal sk'ayb'ub'al Jehová malaj jab'ok spaltail, tz'ak'ji quip yuj. Ha scheknab'il te yel, syak'an sjelanil heb' mantalaj spensar.
Ha tas syal Jehová, te wach'nhej yaji, stzalajb'i ko k'ool yuj. Ha sley Jehová, tojol toni, sjakwi ko pensar yuj.
Ha emnaquilal t'a Jehová te wach'nhej, aynhejek' t'a junelnhej. Ha tas nab'il yuj Jehová te yel, tojol toni.
Yelxo wal te nib'ab'il t'a yichanh k'een oro te wach'. Yelxo wal te chi' t'a yichanh nok' yal chab' ayoch t'a yet'tal.
Kachnab'il pax yaj t'ayin a in a chekab' in tik. Tato tzin k'anab'ajej a lolonel chi', wach' ol in elk'och yuj.
¿Tom ay junok mach syal yilan sb'ha t'a spaltail? Mamin Jehová, ak' in niwank'olal yuj juntzanhxo in paltail max wil in k'ulani.
Manh a cha wak'och in b'ha t'a skal chukal. Manh a cha yak' yajalil chukal chi' t'ayin. Icha chi' max och in mul, malaj junok in chukal t'a yol a sat.
Mamin Jehová in Kolumal ach, in Tanhwumal ach, chab'ilokab' uuj tas swala' yet' tas tzin na'a.
Mamin rey, yab'okab' Jehová ko Diosal a onh yinhtil onh winhaj Jacob a lesalwi. Aokab' tzach kolani ayik ayach och t'a ilk'olal.
Yak'okab'kot skolwal t'ayach masanto t'a stemplo t'a Sion.
Snaokab'kot masanil ofrenda ix ak'a'. Schaokab' sk'ool a silab' tza nhustz'aok.
Aokab' ol ak'an elk'och icha a gana yet' masanil tastak nab'il uuj.
Ol el kaw yuj tzalajk'olal ayik ol ak'an ganar heb' ajk'ool. Ol quik'chaanh ko bandera yuj quik'anchaanh ko Diosal. Aokab' Jehová tz'ak'an masanil tas k'anb'il uuj.
Cojtakxo tiknaik to a Jehová ol kolan winh ko reyal sik'b'ilel yuj. Masanto t'a satcha’anh to anhej ay yiko', ol tak'wokkot t'ay. Yuj spoder Jehová chi' ol yak' ganar niwak owal winh ko reyal.
Ay heb' tz'ak'anoch skarruaje yik owal yipok sk'ool, ay pax juntzanhxo heb', a nok' schej heb' syak'och yipok sk'ool. Ha onhxo pax tik, a Jehová ko Diosal skak'och yipok ko k'ool.
Ha heb' chi' spax yip yok heb', stelwi heb', a onhxo pax tik jun, tek'tek' kaji, linhannhej onh k'ei.
Mamin Jehová, kol winh ko reyal. Tak'wanh t'ayonh ayik tzach kawtani.
Mamin Jehová, a in rey in tik, tzin tzalaji, yujto syal uuj smasanil. Yelxo wal tzin te tzalaji, yujto uuj wal ix wak' ganar.
Ix a b'o tas snib'ej in k'ool, maj a tenek'laj tas ix in k'ana'.
Te niwan wach'il ix ak' t'ayin, ix ak'ank'e jun korona oro t'a in jolom.
Ix in k'an t'ayach to tzak' najatb'ok in k 'inal, a achxo ix ak' t'ayin.
Te b'inajnak in yuj a kolwal. Uuj wal syal wuuj, ay pax in tziquiquial.
Manh jantakok a wach'k'olal ix ak' t'ayin t'a masanil tiempo. Ste tzalaj in k'ool t'a ichanh.
Mamin Jehová, ek'al ach t'a yib'anh masanil, yujto a a wach'k'olal ayoch yipok in k'ool, yuj chi' malaj b'ak'uinh ol in ak'jok ganar.
Mamin rey, ol a yam masanil heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach, aton heb' malaj snib'ej tzach yila'.
Ayic ol a ch'oxan a b'ha t'a skal heb', ol a satankanel heb', icha wal tz'aj junok tas slajwiel yuj k'ak'. Ha Jehová ol satanel heb' yet' yowal sk'ool, haxo k'ak' ol ak'an lajwoquel heb'.
Ha yuninal heb' ajk'ool chi' yet' heb' yinhtilal heb', ol a satkanel heb' t'a skal anima t'a sat lu'um tik.
Wach'chom ix snib'ej heb' ix ach yixtej, ix say wal modo heb' tas tz'aj ach yak'an ganar, palta maj yal-laj yuj heb',
yujto a ach tik ix a pechkanb'at heb' ayik ix och ijan a jul-lab' t'a heb'.
Mamin Jehová, ach ik'jokab'chaanh yujto masanil syal uuj. Ol ko b'itej ipalil.
Ach in Diosal, ach in Diosal, ¿tas wal yuj tzin aktejkani? ¿tas wal yuj max in a kolo' ayik tz'el waw t'a skal in yaelal?
Ach in Diosal, k'ual t'ak'wal wawaj t'ayach, palta max ach tak'wilaj t'ayin, manhxa b'aj syal wik'an wip.
Ha achxo pax jun, a achxonhejochi, tzach sb'itej heb' wetisraelal.
Ha heb' ko mam quicham, yak'nak ach och heb' yipok sk'ool, yalnak sb'a heb' t'ayach, yuj chi' a kolnakkanel heb'. Yak'annak ach och heb' t'a sk'ool, yuj chi' maj q'uixwoquel-laj heb'.
Ha inxo jun, manhxo in animaok swab'i, icha wal junok nok' ha'ay waj swab'i. Tzheb'ajtak in yilanoch heb' wetanimail, patikab'il in kaneli.
Ha heb' tzin ilani, sb'uchwaj heb' t'ayin, syed'tej in sat heb', syak'an ib'xok sjolom heb'.
Syalan heb': Ha jun winh tik, a Jehová ix yak'och winh yipok sk'ool yalani, yuj chi' koljokab'el winh yuj Jehová chi'. Tato stzalaj sk'ol Dios yet' winh, ak'jokab' el winh t'a libre yuj, xchi heb'.
Yel toni, a ach ix in ak' aljok. Ayic wanto in chuni t'a in nun, ix in a tanhwej.
Atax ix in alji ix in ochkan t'a yol a k'ab'. Atax ay in ek' t'a yol sk'ool in nun, in Diosal achtaxoni.
Yuj chi' jun, manh a b'esel a b'a t'ayin. Ay in och t'a niwak yaelal, malaj pax mach tz'och wed'ok.
Toxo ix oymaj heb' ajk'olal t'a in patik, icha wal juntzanh owal wakax t'a yol yik Basán, icha wal chi' heb'.
Toxonhej sjalali sjaj heb' icha wal junok nok' choj. Sjac sti' heb', sjawi juknaj heb' t'ayin.
Van yelkan wip, icha wal tz'aj stob'b'at ha ha'. Toxo ix yaktej sb'a in b'aquil, a wal in pixan, toxo ix ulaxb'at t'a yol in k'ool icha wal nok' chaq'uib'.
Toxo ix takji yol in jaj, icha wal junok taquinh lu'um. Toxo ix k'e lotzan wak' stakji, ix in ak'anem t'a skal pokok icha wal junok chamnak.
Jun wal nhilanh heb' chuk ix och b'uyan t'ayin icha wal nok' tz'i', ix yol in k'ab' heb' yet' wok.
Syal in b'isan masanil in b'aquil. Yakb'an wan wab'an syail chi', haxo heb' chuk chi', k'elannhej och heb' t'ayin.
Ha in pichul, ix spuquek' heb' t'a spatik. Axo t'a in pichul jukan, ix yak' suerte heb'.
Ha achxo Mamin Jehová, Vipumal aji. Manh ach najatb'okb'at t'ayin. Colin, kotanh elanhchamel t'ayin.
Colin, manh in a cha xikjokchamok, manh in a cha smilcham heb' anima icha nok' tz'i'.
Colinel t'a sti' juntzanh heb' icha nok' choj chi', kolinel t'a sch'aak juntzanh icha wal nok' k'ultaquil wakax chi'.
Ol walanel ab'ixal t'a heb' wetchonhab'. Ayic ol smolb'an sb'a heb', ol ach in b'itej t'a skal heb', ol walan icha tik:
Mach onh ay yelk'och Jehová t'a ko sat, kalek wach' lolonel t'ay. B'inajnakokab' kuuj masanil onh yinhtilal onh winhaj Jacob. Masanil onh yinhtilal onh Israel, kak'equem ko b'a t'ay.
Ha Jehová maj yaktejkanlaj heb' ayoch syaelal. Manh tonhejok ix yilochi, maj sk'ub'ejel-laj sb'a. Ayic ix sk'anan skolwal heb', ix sk'anab'ajej Jehová chi' yab'ani, xin cham t'a heb'.
Mamin Jehová, ol ach in b'itej t'a yichanh junok sniwan molchajelal heb' a chonhab' yet' t'a yichanh heb' tzach xajanani. Ol wak'elk'och in ti' ix wak' t'ayach.
Ol wa heb' meb'a', ol b'ud'jokkan sk'ool heb'. Ol och heb' ejmelal t'a Jehová, ol yal wach' lolonel heb' t'ay, pitzannhej heb' t'a masanil tiempo.
Masanil juntzanh ch'ok nakional yet' yinhtilal kajan t'a slajwub'k'och sat lu'um tik, ol nachajkot Jehová yuj heb', ol ja heb' t'ay, ol em kuman heb' t'a yichanh.
Yujto a Jehová ay yik masanil opisio, a Yajal yaj t'a masanil nakión t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik.
Masanil heb' b'eyum ol wa heb', ol yak'anem sb'a heb' ejmelal t'a Jehová. Masanil heb' chamelb'a yaji, ol em kuman heb' t'a yichanh yujto malaj mach syal skolan sb'ha t'a chamel.
Ha heb' ichiquinab'il t'a yik b'ak'uinh, ol yak'em sb'a heb' t'a Jehová. Ol alchajel yab'ixal winh Yajal t'a heb' anima toto ol aljok.
Ha yab'ixal stojolal yet' swach'il tas sb'onak, ol alchaj t'a heb' toto ol aljok chi'.
Mamin Jehová Vilumal aji. Icha junok tanhwum kalnel aj t'ayin, yuj chi' malaj tas syak' palta t'ayin.
Ichato a b'aj yax anh ank'ultak tzak' wik' wip. Ichato ha t'a ha ha' malali sb'eyi, ata' tzin ik'b'ati.
Tzak'an wip t'a junjun k'u, tzin ik'anb'at t'a yoltak b'e wach', icha yaj alannakkani.

Mamin, wach'chom tzin ek' t'a ch'olquixtak b'aj te k'ik'k 'inal, max in xiwlaj yuj junok tas ay smay, yujto ayach ek' wed'ok. Icha junok winh tanhwum kalnel yet'nak te' sk'okoch yet' pax jun te' ay sch'okal, icha chi' tzutej in a tanhwani, yuj chi' max in xiwlaj.
Tza b'o in wael t'a yichanh heb' wajk'ool. Tzak'k'e akeite t'a in jolom, tzak'an b'ud'jok in waso masanto tz'el malnaj t'a sti'.
Ha a wach'k'olal yet' b'aj tzin a xajanej aynhejek' wed'ok yakb'an pitzan in. Mamin Jehová, ol in aj kajan b'aj ayach t'a masanil tiempo.
Ha Jehová ay yik lum lum tik. Ha ay pax yik masanil tastak ay t'a sat lu'um.
Yujto a ix b'oanem yich lum lum tik t'a yich ha' mar yet' t'a yich ha' niwak ha'.
¿Mach heb' syal sk'ek'och t'a jun tzalan to yik Jehová? ¿Mach heb' syal yajek' b'aj syal sb'a heb' anima t'a Jehová chi'?
Aton heb' tik syal sk'ek'ochi: Eb' malaj chukal sk'ulej, heb' te wach' spensar, heb' max yak'em sb'ha t'a juntzanh komon Dios, heb' max skomon ak'ej sti' yuj yak'an musansatil junokxo anima.
Ha Jehová Dios Scolumal heb', a tz'ak'an wach'ilal t'a heb'. Syak'anpax spak t'a heb' icha smojal yuj swach'il heb' chi'.
Icha chi' sb'eyb'al heb' snib'ej yoch t'a yichanh Dios Cajalil a onh yinhtilal onh kan Jacob.
Ex aj Jerusalén, jaquek jun sniwan puertail he chonhab' aytaxon t'a peka'. Jaquec te' sik'lab'il yik wach' tze cha wal jun Rey t'a tzalajk'olal, aton jun Te B'inajnak.
¿Mach jun Rey Te B'inajnak chi'? Aton Jehová, te ay yip, te ay spoder. Ha Jehová syak'nhej ganar owal.
Ex aj Jerusalén, jaquek jun sniwan puertail he chonhab' aytaxon t'a peka'. Jaquec te' sik'lab'il yik wach' tze cha wal jun Rey t'a tzalajk'olal, aton jun Te B'inajnak.
¿Mach jun Rey Te B'inajnak chi'? Ha Jehová Yajal t'a smasanil, aton Rey Te B'inajnak.
Mamin Jehová, tik wal swal in b'a t'ayach.
Ach in Diosal, a achnhej tzach wak'och yipok in k'ool. Manh in aktejkan t'a skal niwak q'uixwelal. Manh in a cha yak' ganar heb' ajk'ool yajoch t'ayin yik max tzalaj heb' in stzetzani.
Vojtak wal to a masanil heb' tzach ak'anoch yipok sk'ool, manh ol q'uixwoquel-laj heb'. Ha heb' schichon sk'ol t'ayach t'a nab'anhej, q'uixwokab'el heb'.
Mamin Jehová, ch'ox a b'e t'ayin. D'a juntzanh a b'e chi' tzin ik' b'eyok.
k'ayb'ej in t'a a lolonel te yel, yik wach' tzin b'ey t'a wach'il, yujto in Diosal ach, in Kolumal ach. Ha achnhej tzach wak'och yipok in k'ool t'a masanil tiempo.
Mamin Jehová, nakot a chamk'olal yet' a wach'k'olal, jun toxonton ix ak' quila'.
Axo pax juntzanh in mul jun, manhxo a nakoti. Manhxookab' a nakot in chukal t'a yiktax ix wak'an quelemal. Mamin, tzin a nakot yet' a niwan chamk'olal yet' a wach'k'olal.
Mamin Jehová, wach' ach toni, tojol ach toni. Yuj chi' tza tojolb'itej sb'eyb'al heb' sk'ulan chukal.
Tza ch'oxan pax heb' emnaquil t'a sb'eal tojolal, aton b'eyb'al tza nib'ej.
Yuj a wach'k'olal, yujto tza k'anab'ajej pax tas tzala', yuj chi' tza kuchb'ej heb' sk'anab'ajan a cheknab'il icha syal a trato.
Mamin Jehová, te niwan in chukal. Ak' in niwank'olal icha wal ix utej alani.
Ha mach tzach k'anab'ajani, tza k'ayb'ej heb'. D'a jun b'e wach' tzik'b'at heb'.
Toxonton tzik'chaanh heb'. Ha heb' yuninal heb' ol ikankan lum lum tik.
Ha heb' ay elk'och t'a sat, aton heb' ay xiwk'olal t'ayach, tzak' razón t'a heb', tzak'an pax elk'och a trato t'a heb'.
Mamin Jehová, anhej t'ayach ayoch in pensar. Ha ach ol in a kolel t'a ch'anh yaal.
Mamin, ilinkoti, ok'ok wal a k'ool t'ayin. Ina to in ch'okojil, te ay in och t'a ilk'olal.
Ix te niwanb'i wilk'olal tik, kolinel t'a in somk'olal.
Ilincot t'a in kusk'olal yet' t'a in yaelal, tzak'ankan niwank'olal in chukal.
Il tonab'i, manh jantakok heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, ste chichonoch sk'ol heb' t'ayin.
Tanhwej in, manh in a cha chamok, manh in a chab'at t'a niwak q'uixwelal, yujto a t'ayach tzin kol in b'a.
Comonoc tzin a kolo', yujto wach' in b'eyb'al, malaj in mul. Ha ach ayachoch yipok in k'ool.
Ach in Diosal, kolonhkanel a onh israel onh tik t'a ko kusk'olal yuj masanil syaelal.
Mamin Jehová, ch'oxkaneli to malaj in mul, yujto anhej tas wach' ayoch t'a in pensar in k'ulani. Mamin, ayach och yipok in k'ool, malaj in chab'k'olal t'ayach.
Mamin, ilin, b'eytzitej in pensar yet' tas tzin nib'ej.
Yujto max b'atkanlaj a wach'k'olal satk'olal wuuj, tzach in k'anab'ajejnhej.
Manh junnhejoklaj tzin ek' yet' heb' ixtum anima. Malaj b'aj junnhej tzin ek' yet' heb' chab' sat.
Tzin yajkanel smolchajelal heb' chuk chi'. Val yel malaj b'aj wach' wak'an yet' heb' tz'ixtanb'at wach' b'eyb'al.
Tzin b'iquel in k'ab' yuj in ch'oxaneli to malaj in chukal. Ichato chi' b'ian tzin ek' oyoyok t'a spatik yichanh altar,
swalan wach' lolonel t'a b'ital, swalanel masanil tas satub'tak tza b'o'o.
Mamin Jehová, tzin xajanej a templo b'aj kajan ach eq'ui. Ata' tz'alchajel sniwanil elk'ochi.
Manh ik'el in k 'inal yet' heb' sk'ulan chukal. Manh in a satel yet' heb' milum anima,
yujto anhej chukal snib'ej heb' sk'ulej, b'ekan sk'ol heb' schaan k'een tumin yik smontaji.
Ha inxo jun, tzin nib'ej tzin b'eynhej t'a in wach'ilal, yuj chi' kolinel Mamin, ok'ok wal a k'ool t'ayin,
yik tek'annhej waj t'a b'eyb'al wach'. Mamin Jehová, ol wal wach' lolonel t'ayach t'a skal heb' molanek' t'a ichanh.
Ha Jehová tz'ak'an sakil k'inal t'ayin, in Kolumal paxi. ¿Machto wal b'aj syal in xiwi? Ha tzin kolani, yuj chi' malaj b'aj tzin xiwi.
Ha heb' chuk smol sb'ha t'a in patik yik tzin satanel heb' yalani, palta a heb' ayoch ajk'olal chi' t'ayin, ol lajwoquel heb'.
