Wach'chom junok b'ulan soldado tz'och oyan t'a in patik wichanh, wal yel, manh ol in xiwlaj. Wach'chom sk'e waan heb' yak' owal wed'ok, anheja' wak'anoch Dios yipok in k'ool.
Junnhej wal tas tzin k'an t'a Jehová, aton jun tik tzin nib'ej: To tzin ek' t'a stemplo Dios yakb'an pitzan in yik swil sniwanil yelk'och Dios chi', swak'anpaxem in b'a t'ay.
Ayic ol jawok yaelal t'a wib'anh, a ol in k'ub'anelok. Ha t'a skajnub', ata' ol in sk'ub'ejeli. Ol in yik'k'e t'a yib'anh junok k'een yik tzin kolchajkaneli.
Ichaton wal chi' ol aj in skolankanel t'a heb' ajk'ool oyanoch t'a in patik wichanh. D'a skal aw yet' tzalajk'olal ol wak' in silab' t'a Jehová t'a yol stemplo. Ol wal wach' lolonel t'a b'ital t'ay.
Mamin, a t'ayach tzin awaji, cha ab' t'ayin. Ok'ok wal a k'ool t'ayin, tak'wanh t'ayin.
Mamin Jehová, a in pensar ix alan t'ayin to tzin nitzkot in b'ha t'a a tz'ey. Yuj chi' swak' wip in nitzanoch in b'ha t'a a tz'ey chi'.
Manh a k'ub'ejel a b'a t'ayin. Manh in a chek meltzaj yet' yowal a k'ool. Ha achtaxon tzin a kolo'. Ach in Diosal in Kolumal ach, manh in aktejkan in ch'okoj.
Mamin Jehová, wach'chom tzin yaktejkan heb' in mam in nun, palta a ach ol in a tanhwej.
Mamin, ch'ox a b'e t'ayin, ik' in b'at t'a yol b'e tojol, yuj heb' ajk'ool snib'an in yak'an telwok.
Manh in ak'kanoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin. Sk'e waan heb' t'a in patik, syesan in mulok heb'. Snib'ej heb' tzin yak' chamok.
Mamin Jehová, swak'och t'a in k'ool to ol a ch'ox a wach'k'olal t'ayin yakb'an pitzan into, tato maay, toxom ix pax wip naik.
Ex wetchonhab', ak'ekoch Jehová yipok he k'ool. Tek'tek' tzeyutej he b'a, manh eyak' chab'ax he k'ool. Val yel, ak'eknhejoch Jehová yipok he k'ool.
Mamin Jehová, anhej t'ayach swal in b'a, icha nhak'een aj t'ayin, manh ach b'at mikan t'ayin. Tato max ach kolwaj t'ayin, aton wal in b'at t'a skal heb' chamnak chi' b'ian.
Mamin, snib'ej in k'ool tzab'i ayik swalan in b'a t'ayach. Swik'k'e in kab' t'a yol a templo, tzin k'anan a kolwal.
Manh ak' in yaelal icha tzutej heb' sk'ulan chukal, aton heb' stz'akan yal wach' lolonel t'a heb' yetanimail, palta anhej chukal sna heb' t'a spatik heb' anima chi'.
Ak' spak t'a heb', icha syal tastak sk'ulej heb', icha syal tas chukal sk'ulej heb', ichato chi' b'ian, tzak'anoch syaelal heb'.
Malaj yelk'och juntzanh tastak ix a b'o t'a yol sat heb'. Ha heb' chi' ol a satkanel heb', manhxo ol ik'chajk'e waan heb'.
Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová, yujto ix yab' tas ix wal t'a skal in yaelal.

Ha Jehová Vipumal, ha' tzin kolan icha junok k'een k'een tz'och wenhulok. Ha swak'och yipok in k'ool, tz'ochnhej wed'ok, yuj chi' manh jantakok stzalaj in k'ool. Tzin b'itani, swak'an pax yuj diosal t'ay.
Ha Jehová ayoch yipumalok heb' schonhab', skolwajpax t'ayin, to sreyal in heb', sik'b'il in el yuj.
Mamin Jehová, kolkanel a chonhab', ak'kot a wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh heb' iktaxoni. Tanhwej heb' t'a masanil tiempo.
Ex aj satcha’anh, alek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová. Alec wach' lolonel t'ay to syal yuj smasanil, te b'inajnak.
Alec wach' lolonel t'a Jehová icha t'a smojal. Hak'uequem he b'a t'ay t'a stemplo te wach' yilji.
Ha Jehová Dios te niwan yelk'ochi, tz'ab'chaj sjaj t'a yib'anh ha' mar. Ha tz'ak'an k'anh k'u, a tz'ak'an mandar t'a yib'anh ha' owal mar chi'.
Ha sjaj Jehová tz'ab'chaji, manh jantakok spoder. Yuj sjaj chi' scheklaji to te niwan yelk'ochi.
Yuj yaw Jehová sjekchajkanb'at te' k'ute'. Yuj Jehová spojkan juntzanh te' niwak k'ute' t'a Líbano.
Ha juntzanh lum niwak witz yik Líbano yet' lum yik Sirión, tz'ib'xi lum yuj Jehová. Sk'e b'akhnaj lum witz chi', icha sk'e chennaj junok nok' quelem wakax.
Ha yaw Jehová, a tz'ak'ankot kopnaj lheb'lon.
Ha yaw Jehová tz'ak'an ib'xok lum tzinan lu'um. A' tz'ak'an ib'xok lum tzinan lu'um yik Cades.
Ha yuj yaw Jehová tz'el jequeljok sk'ab'tak te' ji, axonhej yib' te' skan t'a sat lum witz. Axo t'a stemplo tz'alchaj wach' lolonel t'ay yuj heb' anima smasanil.
Ha Jehová ak'annak yajalil t'a jun ha' owal ha' mukwajum. Yajal yaj t'a masanil tiempo.
Ha tz'ak'an yip heb' schonhab'. Yuj swach'il sk'ool Jehová, syak' junk'olal t'ayonh a onh schonhab' onh tik.
Mamin Jehová, tzach in b'itej yet' in wach' lolonel, yujto ix in a sik'k'e waan t'a skal in niwan yaelal, maj in a cha b'uchjok yuj heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin.
Mamin, in Diosal ach, ix in k'an a kolwal, ix ak'an b'oxok in k'ool.
Mamin, a ach ton ix in a kolel t'a chamel. Ix ak' in k 'inal, maj in a chab'atlaj t'a skal heb' chamnak.
B'itananhek t'a Jehová, mach ex to schonhab' ex, b'itejek yujto anhej Te Niwan Yelk'ochi.
Yujto junnhej rato ay yowal sk'ool, haxo swach'k'olal aynhejek' t'a masanil tiempo. Wach'chom tzonh ok' t'ak'walil, haxo yik sq'uinhib'i sja ko tzalajk'olal.
Ayic te wach' waji, ix in na' icha tik: Malaj b'ak'uinh ol in telwok yuj junok tas, xin chi.
Mamin Jehová, yuj wal swach'il a k'ool, ix in ak'kanoch b'aj malaj tas tzin ik'ani. Palta ayik ix ik'anel a b'a t'ayin, ix somchajkanel in k'ool.
Mamin, ix ach wawtej, ix walan in b'a t'ayach:

¿Tasto a ganar t'ayin, q'uinalok tato tzin chami, tzin mukchaji? Manhxo ol yal-laj ach sb'itan heb' toxo ix och pokokal. Manh ol yal pax laj yalan wach' lolonel heb' t'ayach yuj swach'il tas ix a b'o'o, xin chi.
Mamin Jehová, ab' wal tas swala', ok'ok wal a k'ool t'ayin. Mamin, ochannhej wed'ok.
Ix ak'an k'exmaj in yaelal t'a tzalajk'olal. Ix ik'anel in kusk'olal, ix ak'ankanoch k'apak pichul yik q'uinh in pichulok.
Yuj wal chi' jun, ach Jehová in Diosal, max yal-laj wem numan. Tzin b'itan t'ayach t'a aloj wach' lolonel yet' ak'oj yuj diosal t'ayach t'a masanil tiempo.
Mamin Jehová, anhej t'ayach tzin kol in b'a. Malajokab' b'ak'uinh tzin a cha somchajeli. Colinel yuj a tojolal.
Ak'kot tz'eyan a chiquin t'ayin, tzin a kolan t'a elanhchamel. Ochanh in nhak'eenok b'aj ol in kol in b'a.
Yujto in nhak'een ach, in kuartel ach, yuj chi' ochanh wenhulok. Ik' in b'eyok yik manh ol ach alchaj chukal.
Colin t'a jun yaal ix em t'a wichanh, yujto in Kolumal ach.
Mamin Jehová, ach in Diosal, swak'kanoch in b'ha t'a yol a k'ab'. Ha ach tzin a kolkaneli, to tz'elk'och syal a lolonel.
Tzin chaquel heb' anima syak'em sb'ha t'a juntzanh komon Dios malaj yelk'ochi. Ha inxo Mamin Jehová, tzach wak'och yipok in k'ool.
Tzin tzalaj wal yuj a wach'k'olal. Ha ach ix ik'el in kusk'olal, ojtak pax in yaelal.
Maj in ak'kanoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' wajk'ool. Te lewan b'aj ix in kan uuj.
Mamin Jehová, ok'okab' wal a k'ool t'ayin, yujto ay in och t'a ilk'olal. Ix te chakb'i in sat woq'ui, manhxalaj yip in pixan yet' in niwanil.
Ha in k 'inal slajwiem t'a skal in yaelal. Ha wab'ilal slajwiel yuj in k'akwi. Ha kusk'olal tz'ik'anel wip, k'ununi yel yip in niwanil tik swab'i.
Tzetzab'il in yuj heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, b'uchb'il in yuj heb' kajan t'a in lak'anil. Yajb'il in kanel yuj heb' ojtannak in. Ha heb' tzin ilan t'a yoltak b'e, tz'el heb' t'ayin.
Junelnhej ix in b'atkan satk'olal yuj heb'. Icha wal to manhxo in animaok swab'i, icha wal junok lum xalu pojnak, icha chi' waji.
Swab' sajson heb' wetchonhab' t'a in patik. Yalxonhej b'ajtiil, ay xiwk'olal sja t'ayin. Junlajanxonhej snaan heb' t'a in patik. Nanon yek' sk'ool heb' tas syutej in yak'anchamok.
Ha inxo jun Mamin Jehová, a achnhej ayachoch yipok in k'ool. Toxonton swala': Ha ach wal tik, in Diosal ach, xin chi.
Yol wal a k'ab' ay in k 'inal. Colinel t'a heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, aton heb' tzak'anoch wuuj.
Il in wal och a in a chekab' in tik yuj swach'il a k'ool, tzin a kolanel yuj a wach'k'olal.
Mamin, wan walan in b'a t'ayach. Manh in ak'b'at t'a niwak q'uixwelal. Ha heb' chuk tzak'kanb'at t'a niwak q'uixwelal chi', tzak'ankanb'at heb' b'aj tzinan, b'aj ay heb' chamnak.
Ha heb' snaank'e lolonel, numk'ajokab' heb', yujto syal lolonel heb' ya t'a heb' anima wach'. Spatiquejel heb' wach' spensar heb', sb'uchwaj heb' t'a heb' wach' chi'.
Yel ton wal niwan a wach'k'olal tzak' t'a heb' tzach ik'anchaanh. D'a yichanh heb' anima tzak' a wach'ilal t'a heb' tzach ak'anoch yipok sk'ool.
Ha t'a a tz'ey tza k'ub'ejel heb' t'a chukal sna heb' puch winak. Ha b'aj ay ach tza kolel heb' t'a schukal lolonel heb' ajk'olal yajoch t'a heb'.
Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'ayach Mamin Jehová, yujto satub'tak tas ix a b'o t'ayin yuj a wach'k'olal, ayik oyanoch heb' ajk'ool t'a in patik wichanh.
Ha wal yik manhxo animaok in k'ool, ix in na' to ix in ik'kanel t'a ichanh, haxo wal yik ix in k'anan a kolwal, ix ab' in tewi.
Xajanejec Jehová, masanil ex yiquexxo yujto ha' stanhwan heb' sk'anab'ajani, palta tz'akan syutej yak'an yaelal t'a yib'anh heb' syik'chaanh sb'a.
Tek'b'ejek he b'a mach ex tzeyak'och Jehová yipok he k'ool.
Te wach' yik heb' tz'ak'chaj lajwok smul, sukchaj sat schukal heb'.
Te wach' yik heb' syal Jehová to manhxalaj smul heb' t'a yichanh, aton heb' maxtzak k'ub'anel smul t'a heb' yetanimail.
Ayic manto walk'etalaj in mul, yelxo wal ijan ix lajwiel in niwanil ix wab'i, yujto ix in te k'akwi.
Ach in Diosal, k'ual t'ak'wal yelk'olal ix ak'och in yaelal. Icha wal anh taquinh ank'ultak stakjiel yuj waresma, ichinta ix wab'i.
Ichato chi' ix walank'eta in mul chi' t'ayach, malaj tas ix in k'ub'ejeli. Ix el wal t'a in k'ool walan in b'a t'ayach. Ha achxo Mamin Jehová ix in ak' niwank'olal.
Yuj wal chi' jun, yalokab' sb'a heb' tzach k'anab'ajani yakb'an tzato yala'. Wach'chom sja yaelal icha ha' eluma', palta max yamchajlaj heb' yuj.
Ha ach ay ach och wenhulok, a ach ol in a kolel t'a yaelal. Tzach in b'itej yujto ix in a koleli.
Ix yal Jehová t'ayin: Ol ach in k'ayb'ej t'a tas ol a k'ulej. Ol in ch'ox t'ayach b'ajtil ol ach b'atok, ol ach in tanhwej.

Manh utej a b'a icha nok' chej ma icha junok nok' mula, a juntzanh nok' chi' max nachajel-laj yuj nok'. Yowalil syamchajoch waan nok' yet' k'een freno. Tato manh ichokta tz'utaj nok', max sk'anab'ajejlaj nok', xchi Jehová t'ayin.
Ha heb' chuk sb'eyb'al, manh jantakok yaelal ol kot t'a yib'anh heb'. Axo heb' ayoch Dios yipok sk'ool, a swach'k'olal Dios chi' ol moyank'e heb'.
Hak'ek tzalajb'ok he k'ool t'a Jehová ex anima wach' he pensar. B'itananhek t'a tzalajk'olal he masanil ex ayex och t'a stojolal.
Ex anima wach' he pensar, b'itejek Jehová t'a tzalajk'olal. Yujto a heb' anima tojol sb'eyb'al, smojton wal sb'itan heb' t'a Jehová chi'.
Alec wach' lolonel t'a Jehová yet' te' arpa. B'itananhek t'ay yet' salterio lajunhe' sch'anhal.
B'itananhek t'a Jehová yet' ak' b'it. Wach' tzeyutej he b'itan t'ay t'a tzalajk'olal.
Yujto a slolonel Jehová yel toni. Ha tas sb'o'o, a sch'oxaneli to syak'elk'och tas syala'.
Ha Jehová, a tojolal yet' wach' b'eyb'al snib'ej. Sch'oxel sb'a swach'k'olal t'a masanil yol yib'anhk’inal tik.
Tonhej ix yal Jehová, ix b'o satcha’anh yet' masanil tastak ay t'ay.
A' ix molb'ankan ha ha'. Ha ha' mar tonhej malanek' ha' t'a yet'tal yuj.
Ayokab' yelk'och Jehová t'a masanil tastak ay t'a sat lu'um tik. E masanil kajan ex t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, ayokab' he xiwk'olal t'a Jehová.
Yujto ha' ix alani, ix b'o smasanil. A' ix alani, wach' ix ajkan masanil tas.
Ha Jehová smak'an lajwok spensar juntzanh ch'ok nakional.
Axo tas sna'a, aynhej ek' t'a masanil tiempo.
Tzalajk'olal yik junok nakión to a Jehová ayoch sDiosalok, to sik'b'ilel yuj yik tz'och yikok.
Ha t'a satcha’anh k'elanemta Jehová, syilanemta masanil anima.
Ha b'aj kajanek' Jehová syilkot masanil heb' kajan t'a sat lu'um tik.
A' ixb’o’an spensar heb' smasanil. Anheja' pax smaklan yila' tas sk'ulej heb'.
Manh yujok to te niwan sb'isul soldado ol kolchajel junok yajal. Manh yujok to te ay yip junok soldado, ol kolchajok.
Ha nok' chej, malaj yopisio nok' skolan heb' anima. Wach'chom te ay yip nok', palta max yal-laj skolwaj nok'.
Ha Jehová k'elanoch t'a heb' ay xiwk'olal t'ay, aton heb' ayoch swach'k'olal yipok sk'ool.
Scoljikanel heb' yuj t'a chamel, tz'ak'ji wa heb' yuj t'a stiempoal wejel.
Ha onh tik, a Jehová skak'och yipok ko k'ool. A' tzonh kolani, tzonh stanhwan paxi.
Yuj chi' stzalajb'i ko k'ool yuj. Skak'anoch yipok ko k'ool, yujto Axonhejochi.
Mamin Jehová, ayokab'och a wach'k'olal t'ayonh, yujto tzach kak'och yipok ko k'ool.
Swik'chaanh Jehová t'a masanil tiempo, swalnhej wach' lolonel t'ay.
Ha t'ay stzalaj in k'ool. Ab'ek ex anima emnaquil, tzalajanhek.
Alequel yab'ixal sb'inajnaquil Jehová wed'ok, junnhej skutej quik'anek chaanh.
Ix in awaj t'a Jehová, ix tak'wi t'ayin, ix yik'kanel masanil in xiwk'olal.
Ha heb' tz'ak'anoch Jehová yipok sk'ool, stzetzon sat heb' yuj tzalajk'olal, malaj b'aj sq'uixwi heb'.
Ix wal in b'ha t'a Jehová, wach'chom te malaj welk'ochi, haxo ix ab'ani, ix in skolanel t'a masanil wilk'olal.
Ha heb' ay yelk'och Jehová t'a sat, a yángel tzoymaj t'a spatik yichanh heb', haxo skolchaj heb' chi' yuj.
Ak'lejek eyila', ol eyilani to te ay swach'k'olal Jehová. Te wach' yik heb' skol sb'ha t'a Jehová chi'.
Mach ex yiquex Jehová, ayokab' yelk'och t'a he sat. Malaj tas ol yak' palta t'a heb' ay yelk'och Dios t'ay.
Ha nok' choj, tz'el yip nok' yuj wejel, haxo pax heb' syak'em sb'ha t'a Jehová, malaj b'ak'uinh ol yak' palta junok tas wach' t'a heb'.
Ex unin, kotanhek, ab'ek tas swala', ol ex in k'ayb'ej yik tzeyak'och he pensar t'a Jehová.
Tato syal he k'ol snajatb'i he k 'inal, he gana pax tzalajk'olal tzek' junjun k'u eyuuj,
manhxo eyal chukal lolonel, manhxo eyesej.
Ik'equel he b'ha t'a chukal, manhxo eyak' owal, haxo wach'il tze k'ulej, tze b'eyb'alan junk'olal.
Ha Jehová stanhwan heb' anima wach' sb'eyb'al, smaklan wal yab'i ayik syalan sb'a heb' t'ay.
Ha Jehová, aykot yowal sk'ol t'a heb' sk'ulan chukal yik satel heb', yik manhxa mach ol naan heb'.
Syab' Jehová ayik syalan sb'a heb' anima wach' spensar t'ay, skolchajkanel heb' t'a masanil yilk'olal.
Ha Jehová ayek' t'a stz'ey heb' anima manhxo animaok yet'nak syab'i, skolankanel heb' somchajel sk'ool yuj kuselal.
Ha heb' anima wach' spensar, wach'chom tzijtum tas tz'ik'an heb', haxo Jehová skolanel heb' t'a masanil juntzanh syaelal chi'.
A' stanhwan heb', malaj junok sb'aquil heb' ol q'uichajok.
Axo pax heb' sk'ulan chukal jun, a yuj schukal heb' chi' ol chamok. Ha heb' schichon sk'ol t'a heb' wach' sb'eyb'al, ol kotkan t'a yib'anh heb'.
Axo Jehová ol kolan heb' schekab'. Ha heb' skol sb'a t'ay, manh ol kotkanlaj t'a yib'anh heb'.
Mamin Jehová, telaj a b'a yet' heb' stelaj sb'a wed'ok, ak' owal yet' heb' tz'ak'an owal wed'ok.
Ik'elta a yamk'ab' yik owal, tzul in a kolani.
Ik'elta a lanza tza makan sat heb' tzin pechan b'eyek'ok. Al t'ayin to in Kolumal ach.
Ha heb' snib'ej in chami, somchajokab'b'at heb' yuj q'uixwelal. Ha heb' snib'ej ay tas skot t'a wib'anh, meltzajokab'b'at heb' t'a spatik.
Ichokab' smatz'il ixim trigo syik'b'at ik', ichokab' ta tz'aj heb'. Pechjokab'b'at heb' yuj ángel.
K'ik'olinakokab'i, nhereriokab' sb'e heb', haxo ángel spechan heb'.
Wach'chom malaj in mul, palta ix yak'em in yaalil heb'. Malaj in mul, palta ix sjoy jun olan heb' yik wach' tzin b'at t'a yool snaan heb'.
Yuj chi', mokab' naanok yuj heb' ayik sjawi niwak yaelal t'a yib'anh heb'. Canokab' heb' t'a syaalil ix yak'em chi'. B'atokab'kan heb' t'a yol jun olan ix sb'o chi'.
Ichato chi' ol wak'an tzalajb'ok in k'ol t'ayach Jehová. Ol el lenaj ol wil yuj a kolwal.

D'a smasanil in k'ool ol wal icha tik: Mamin Jehová, ¿machto wal junok icha ach tik? Ha heb' meb'a' yet' heb' ayoch t'a tzapan majanil, tza kolel heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' te ay yip, to syik'ek' heb' tastak ay t'a heb', xin chama.
Scot heb' testigo esum, haxo tas manh wojtakok sk'anb'ej heb' t'ayin.
Ha in wach'k'olal chuk ix yutej heb' spaktzitan t'ayin, ix in stzuntzej kus heb'.
Ha inxo, ayik ya'ay heb', ix wak'och pichul yik kusk'olal, maxtzak in walaj yuj kusk'olal, ya swab'i. Max waktejkanlaj in lesalwi t'a in pixan yuj heb'.
Cusnac in k'ool ix in b'eyeq'ui, icha wal to a yuj junok wamigo, ma wuk'tak, ma icha in nun tzin kus yuj.
Ayic ix in telwi, ix k'e umnaj heb' smasanil in stzetzani. Ichato ch'ok animail in t'a heb', ichato manh in yojtakok heb'. Max yaktejkanlaj heb' in ste b'ajani.
Te ya ix in ek' yuj heb', ix in sb'uch heb', ix kot k'elan heb' t'ayin yet' schichonk'olal.
Mamin Jehová, ¿tom tonhej ol ach och k'elan yuj jun tik? Colinel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' icha nok' choj, tz'el yaw, skot t'ayin.
Ol walel yab'ixal a wach'k'olal t'a yichanh heb' tzijtumal anima molaneq'ui. Ol wal wach' lolonel t'ayach t'a yichanh heb' a chonhab'.
Mokab' tzalaj sk'ool heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin. Mokab' reprepan sat heb' schichon sk'ol t'ayin, wach'chom malaj in mul t'a heb'.
Malaj snib'ej heb' t'a junk'olal. Snib'ej heb' snak'e esal lolonel t'a spatik heb' munil ayeq'ui.
Te chaanh tz'el yaw heb' t'ayin, syalan heb': Ix quil tas ix a k'ulej chi', toxo ix quila', xchi heb'.
Mamin, ix il wal. Ak' yowalil t'a heb', manh ach najatb'okb'ati, manh ach el t'a in tz'ey.
Mamin ach Vajal, in Diosal ach, kotanh, kolin, b'o yaj tas swal tik. Ochanh wed'ok.
Ach Jehová in Diosal ach, b'o yaj t'ayin ato syal a tojolal, in gana to max in tzetzaj yuj heb'.
Mokab' yal heb' t'ayin icha tik: Ix elk'och icha ko gana. Junelnhej ix quixtejkanb'at winh, mokab' xchiok heb'.
Ha heb' stzalaj yuj in yaelal, q'uixwokab'kan heb', somchajokab'el sk'ool heb'. Q'uixwokab'el heb' niwak winak syutej sb'ha t'a wichanh.

Axo heb' snib'ej to wach' tzin elk'ochi, tzalajokab' sk'ool heb'. Elokab' yaw heb' yuj tzalajk'olal. Yalokab' heb' t'a masanil tiempo: Ha Jehová, te niwan ton yelk'ochi, stzalaj wal yuj swach'il jun schekab' tik, xchiokab' heb'.
Mamin, ol walel a tojolal, ol walnhej wach' lolonel t'ayach t'a masanil tiempo.
Ha heb' sk'ulan chukal, anhej chukal chi' ayoch t'a spensar heb' sk'ulani. Malaj jab'ok yelk'och Dios t'a sat heb'.
Yujto syaloch sb'a heb' wach'il, manh ojtakab'ilok smul heb' chi' snaani. Max snalaj heb' yaktejkan schukal chi'.
Anhej chukal lolonel syal heb', naumk'e lolonel heb'. Syactejkan wach' pensaril heb', max sb'olaj wach'il heb'.
Ayic waynak heb' t'a sat sch'at, toxonhej snanonek' sk'ool heb' sk'ulan chukal. Manh wach'ok sb'eyb'al heb', max yal-laj sk'ol heb' syik'el sb'ha t'a chukal.
Ha achxo Mamin Jehová, te niwanxo pax a wach'k'olal, masanto t'a satcha’anh sk'ek'ochi, tzak'nhejelk'och tas tzala'.
Ek'al a wach'ilal t'a yichanh lum niwak witz. Ha a tojolal, ek'al t'a sjulal yich ha' niwak mar. Mamin Jehová, ilb'il heb' anima yet' masanil nok' nok' uuj.
Ach Dios, satub'takxonhej a wach'k'olal, yuj chi' sko kol ko b'a t'ayach, icha nok' yunetak kaxlanh tz'och t'a yalanh snun.
Tzonh b'ud'ji yuj jun niwan wael tzak' t'ayonh. Ha ha ha' manhxo jantakok swach'il yuk'ji tzak' kuk'ej.
Yujto a t'ayach skot ko k 'inal icha yaj sjaj ha ha'. Yujnhej a sakil k'inal ay ko k 'inal.
Ha onh kojtak achxo, ayokab' a wach'k'olal t'ayonh. Ha onh wach' ko pensar, kolonhkaneli.
Manh a cha yak' chukal heb' syik'chaanh sb'a t'ayin. Manh a cha in spech b'eyek' heb' sk'ulan chukal.
Ilecnab' b'ajtil ix telwi heb' sk'ulan chukal. Ix telwi heb', manhxa b'ak'uinh ol k'ex waan heb'.
Mokab' somchajel ko k'ool yuj heb' sk'ulan chukal. Mokab' ko nib'ejoch sb'eyumal heb'.
Yujto elanhchamel ol satel heb', icha stakji anh ak sjochchajeli, ma icha stakjiel anh ank'ultak.
Kak'ekoch Jehová yipok ko k'ool, ko b'oek tas wach'. Conh kaneknhej kajan t'a lum lum tik, ol onh ak'jok wa t'a ak'ank'olal.
Kaq'ek tzalajb'ok ko k'ool t'a Jehová, a ol ak'an tas sko nib'ej.
Skab'enejoch ko b'ha t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová, skak'anoch yipok ko k'ool, a ol kolwaj qued'ok.
Axo ol ak'an cheklaj swach'il ko b'eyb'al icha wal tz'aj scheklaj yok k'u t'a chimk'ualil.
Numan skutejek ko b'ha t'a yichanh Jehová. Niwan skutejek ko k'ool ko tanhwan skolwaj qued'ok. Manh kaq'ek somchajel ko k'ool yuj heb' te wach' tz'elk'och yuj chukal sk'ulej.
Co satequel kowal, kaq'ek tup ko k'ak'alk'olal. Mokab' te chichon ko k'ool, ta maay, chuknhej tas ol onh ajelk'ochok.
D'a wal yel ol satel heb' sk'ulan chukal, a onhxo pax skak'och Jehová yipok ko k'ool jun, ol ko cha ko makb'en yik b'aj ol onh kajnaj t'a lum lum tik.
Ayic jaye' k'ual tik, manhxalaj heb' sk'ulan chukal chi'. Wach'chom ol ko sayek' heb', palta manhxo ol ilchajlaj heb' kuuj.
Axo heb' anima emnaquil, ol aj heb' t'a sat lum lum tik, ol yak'an wal snib'ej heb' yajek' t'a junk'olal.
Ha heb' sk'ulan chukal, nanon yek' sk'ool heb' yak'an chukal chi' t'a anima wach' sb'eyb'al. Juch'uch'i sk'uxan ye heb' t'a heb' yuj chichonk'olal.
Axo Jehová tonhej stzewaj yuj heb', yujto yojtak to lak'anxo sja yaelal t'a yib'anh heb'.
Ha heb' sk'ulan chukal, syik'elta yespada heb', sb'oan sjul-lab' heb' yik wach' slajwiel heb' emnaquil anima meb'a', to smilcham heb' wach' sb'eyb'al heb' yalani.
Ha k'een yespada heb' chuk chi', anheja' k'een ol ek' t'a spixan heb'. Axo sjul-lab' heb' chi', ol kanhchajkanb'at te'.
Yelxo wal te wach' jab'ok tas ay t'a heb' anima wach' spensar, t'a yichanh sb'eyumal jantak heb' sk'ulan chukal.
Ol satel sb'eyumal heb' anima chuk chi' yuj Jehová, haxo heb' anima wach' spensar, ol koljok heb' yuj.
Ha Jehová stanhwan heb' malaj spaltail, haxo tas ay t'a heb', malaj b'ak'uinh ol satelok.
Ayic te chuk tiempo yujto te ay wejel, manh ol ek'laj heb' k'exab', aynhej tas ol swa heb'.
Ha heb' sk'ulan chukal, ol satel heb' icha wal stakji anh xumak ay t'a kaltak te'. Ha heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'a Jehová, ol satkanel heb' icha wal satem te' tab'.
Ha heb' sk'ulan chukal, tz'och heb' majan, maxtzak yak' meltzaj smajan heb' chi'. Axo heb' anima wach' spensar, ay yok'elk'olal heb', elb'ennhej yel yuj heb'.
Ha heb' schaan swach'k'olal Jehová, a heb' ol kajan lum lum, haxo pax heb' chuk katab'il yuj, ol ik'chajel heb' t'a sat lu'um.
Ha Jehová skuchb'an b'ey heb' anima wach' spensar ayik wan sb'ey heb' t'a tojolal.
Wach'chom stelwi heb', palta max ek'laj tiempo sk'exwan heb', yujto yamb'il sk'ab' heb' yuj Jehová.

Atax t'a in quelemal masanto yik icham winak inxo tik, malaj b'aj ix wil yaktajkan junok anima wach' spensar yuj Jehová yik tzek' t'a syaelal. Malaj pax b'aj ix wil yuninal heb' wach' sb'eyb'al chi' sk'anan wa sb'ha t'a titak pat.
Tz'ok'nhej sk'ool heb' wach' pensar chi' t'a heb' yetanimail, aynhej tas syak' heb' majanil. Axo yuninal heb' chi', syik'kot yaxilal heb' t'a skal heb' yetanimail.
Yuj chi', kaktejekkan chukal, sko k'ulan wach'il, ichato wal chi' wach' ol onh aj t'a masanil tiempo.
Yujto stzalaj Jehová yet' tojolal, malaj b'ak'uinh syaktejkan heb' sk'anab'ajan t'ay. D'a masanil tiempo skolchajel heb'. Axo yinhtilal heb' sk'ulan chukal, satjiel heb' yuj Jehová chi'.
Ha heb' anima wach' spensar chi' ol ik'ankan lum lum tik, ol kajnajek' heb' t'a lum t'a masanil tiempo.
Ha heb' wach' sb'eyb'al, slolon heb' t'a jelanil, wach'nhej tas syal heb'.
Ha sk'ayb'ub'al Dios yet'nak heb', yuj chi' malaj b'aj ol em heb' t'a chukal.
Ha heb' sk'ulan chukal, aynhejoch sat heb' t'a heb' anima wach' sb'eyb'al, snib'ej heb' smilcham heb'.
Palta manh ol ak'chajkanlaj heb' wach' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' chuk chi' yuj Jehová. Manh ol stak'laj Dios skotkan t'a yib'anh heb' wach' t'a yichanh ley.
Kak'ekoch Jehová t'a ko k'ool, sko k'anab'ajanek. A' ol onh ik'anchaanh. Ol yak' lum lum tik t'ayonh. Ol quil wal satel heb' sk'ulan chukal.
Ha heb' sk'ulan chukal, ix wil wal yixtan heb' yetanimail heb', ix yik'chanh sb'a heb', niwaquil syutej sb'a heb' icha junok te te' manh jantakok sk'ab', te yax xiil.
Palta ix satel heb', manhxalaj mach ix kani. Ix in say heb', palta majxo ilchajlaj heb' wuuj.
Scham wal quilan heb' wach' spensar max k'ulanlaj chukal chi', te wach'nhej ol elk'och heb' yujto a junk'olal sayek' heb'.
Axo heb' pit, ol satjoquel heb'. Ol satjokpaxel yinhtilal heb' b'ak'uinh.
Ha Jehová skolanel heb' anima wach' spensar. A' ayoch yenhulok heb' ayik sja yaelal.
A' ol kolanel heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' sk'ulan chukal, yujto ha' ayoch yipok sk'ool heb'.
Mamin Jehová, manh ak' in yaelal yuj yowal a k'ool. Manh ak' in yaelal yakb'an aykot a k'ak'alk'olal.
Toxo ix och tzolan a jul-lab' t'ayin, ix ak'och in yaelal.
Ha yuj yowal a k'ool chi', masanil in niwanil tik te ya' ay swab'i, yujnhej to ix och in mul t'ayach.
Ha in chukal ichato k'ojank'e t'a wib'anh icha ikatz, maxtzak techajlaj wuuj.
Yujnhej in pital, wanxo sk'e sjab' wechen yujto wan sk'ab'ati.
nhojan in emi tzin b'eyi. Junelnhej lachan waji. Maxtzac och waan jab'ok in kusk'olal.
Van in cham yuj q'uixwelal swab'i. Masanil in niwanil te ya ay swab'i.
Ix te b'uychaj in niwanil tik, manhxalaj jab'ok yip. Tzin k'akwi yuj wilk'olal.
Mamin Vajalil, ojtak masanil tas tzin nib'ej. Ayic sik'son sja in k'ool, ichanh yaj jun tik.
Toxonhej ste tinhtinhan in pixan yab'an syail. Numumi yel wip, maxtzak yal-laj wilani.
Ha heb' anima wach' wak'an yet'ok yet' heb' junnhej tzin ek' yet'ok, najat sb'esel sb'a heb' t'ayin. Ha heb' kajan t'a in lak'anil, najat sb'esel sb'a heb' t'ayin yuj in yaelal.
Ha heb' snib'ej in smilanchamok, wan yak'anem in yaalil heb'. Ha heb' snib'an yak' chukal t'ayin, anhej chukal syal heb' t'a in patik. Max ochlaj waan heb' snaub'tanhan tas ol in yutok t'a elk'altak.
Ha inxo pax jun, ichato makan in chiquin, max wab'laj tas syal heb', ichato max ujilaj in loloni, malaj tas tz'elta t'a in ti'.
Lajan in icha junok mach max yab'laj, max yal-laj yalan sb'a.
Mamin Jehová in Diosal, a achnhej tzach wak'och yipok in k'ool, a ach ol in a tak'wej.
Ha jun tik tzin k'an t'ayach: Mokab' in stzetzej heb' ajk'ol chi'. Mokab' b'itan heb' yuj tzalajk'olal tato tzin ak'ji ganar.
Palta ijanxo wal tzin ak'ji ganar swab'i. Max och waan jab'ok in yaelal tik.
Ol walk'eta in mul. Manhxo in animaok swab' yuj in chukal.
Ha heb' ajk'ol snib'ej in chami, toxo ix te q'uib' sb'isul heb'. Manhxo jantakok ix te aj heb' tzin chakani, wach'chom malaj in mul t'a heb'.
Chucnhej syutej sb'a heb' t'ayin yuj in wach'k'olal t'a heb'. Yujnhej to tzin b'eyb'alej wach'il, tz'och heb' ajk'olal t'ayin.
Mamin Jehová, manh in aktejkani. Ach in Diosal, manh a b'esel a b'a t'ayin.
Ach Vajalil, ach in Kolumal, kotanh t'a elanhchamel tzin a kolani.
Ix wak' pensar to ol in ya'ilej in b'eyb'al, yik max och in mul yuj tas swala'. Tzin yamoch waan in ti' yakb'an ayek' heb' anima chuk spensar t'a wichanh.
Ix in em numnajok, majxo walpaxlaj wach' lolonel. Palta haxo in yaelal ix te niwtaji.
Vanxo stz'a in pixan ix wab'i. Yakb'an wan in te naub'tanhani, ix wach' och pitz'an t'a in pixan. Yuj chi' chaanh ix in awaji, ix walani:
Mamin Jehová, ak' wal wojtaquejeli to chamel b'a waji, to jayenhej ab'il in k 'inal. In gana snachajel wuuj to elanhchamel tzek'b'at in k 'inal.
Quennhej in k 'inal ix ak'a'. Manh niwanoklaj in k 'inal t'a ichanh. Ha onh anima onh tik, icha wal quik'an jab'ok quik', icha chi' ko k 'inal.
Icha wewen kaj ko masanil. Nab'anhej sko mak' k'unb'ok ko b'a. ¿Tocwal skak' ko gana yet' ko b'eyumal sko molb'ejk'e b'ulan? Manh kojtakok mach ol ik'ankanb'atok.
Mamin Vajal, haxo tiknaik, ¿tas wach' swak'och yipok in k'ool? Ha ach ton ayach och yipok in k'ool.
Colinel t'a masanil in chukal. Manh in a cha b'uchjok yuj heb' chuk spensar.
Icha wal heb' max ujilaj sloloni, icha chi' ix wutej in b'a. Manhxalaj tas ix elta t'a in ti', yujto a ach tik ix ak'och juntzanh tik t'ayin.
Ik'el in yaelal ix ak'ochi. Vanxo in lajwiel swab' yuj b'aj ix in a mak'a'.

Ha ach tzak'och ko yaelal a onh anima onh tik. Tzak'anoch ko tz'uumal yuj ko mul. Ha ach tzak' lajwok tas nib'ab'il kuuj, ichato tz'ijaxb'ati. Co masanil, icha wal quik'an quik', icha chi' yek' ko k 'inal.

Mamin Jehová, ab' in lesal tik, kotanh k'elan t'ayin ayik swalan in b'a t'ayach. Manh ak' sat a k'ool t'a yal in sat tik. Mamin, a t'ayach, ek'elb'anhej wek' t'a sat lu'um tik icha heb' in mam wicham.
Mamin, manh ak'kot a k'ak'alk'olal t'ayin, yik wach' tzin tzalaj junok rato, yakb'an manto el-laj in k'ool.
Ix in tanhwejnhej skolwal Jehová, haxo ix ab'ani ayik ix in tewi t'ay.
Ix in yik'k'eta t'a jun olan te ay smay. Ix in skol b'aj sitz'atak. Ix in yak'ank'e t'a yib'anh jun k'een k'een yik tzin tek'b'ej in b'a.
Ix yak' wal jun b'it ak'to t'ayin, b'it yik aloj wach' lolonel t'a ko Diosal. Comonoc sat sk'ol jantak heb' tz'ilan jun tik, yik syak'och Jehová heb' yipok sk'ool.
Te wach' yik heb' tz'ak'anoch Jehová yipok sk'ool, max yak'och spensar heb' t'a heb' syik'chaanh sb'a, aton heb' tz'och tzak'an t'a spatik juntzanh komon Dios.

Mamin Jehová in Diosal, manh jantakok juntzanh tas satub'tak ix a b'o'o yet' jantak a wach'k'olal ix ak' t'ayonh. Malaj junok mach syal slajb'an sb'a ed'ok. In gana swalel masanil a wach'k'olal chi', palta max in tzak'wanlaj, yujto manhxo b'ischajb'enok.
Max a nib'ejlaj nok' nok' yet' ixim trigo silab'il. Malaj nok' nok' tza k'ana' yik snhusji silab'il t'ayach, ma silab' yik stupkanel ko mul. Palta ix a jak in chiquin yik tzin cha wab' tas tzala'.
Yuj chi' ix wala': Tik tzin ja'i, xin chi. Ha tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a a lolonel, a wab'ixal syala'.
Ach in Diosal, snib'ej in k'ool tzin k'ulej icha a gana. Ayoch a k'ayb'ub'al t'a in pensar.
Mamin Jehová, ix walkanel yab'ixal a tojolal t'a skal heb' a chonhab'. Ojtac wal to malaj b'aj ix waktejkan walaneli.

Malaj b'aj max walel a tojolal. Ix walel yab'ixal to tz'elnhejk'och tas tzala', tzak'anpax kolnab'il. Malaj b'aj ix in k'ub'ejel t'a yichanh heb' a chonhab' molaneq'ui, to te niwan a wach'k'olal, yelnhej pax tzala'.
Mamin Jehová, ayokab'nhej ok'elk'olal t'ayin. Ilinnhej yet' a wach'k'olal icha ix aj alani.

Yujto te ay tas sjawi t'a wib'anh, maxtzak b'ischajlaj wuuj. In yamchajelta yuj in chukal. Ichato maxtzak yal-laj wilani. Ek'b'al in chukal chi' t'a yichanh sb'isul xil in jolom. Vanxo somchajel in k'ool.
Mamin, kotanh wal k'elan t'ayin, kotanh, kolineli. Cotanh elanhchamel, tzach och wed'ok.
Ha heb' snib'ej in smilanchamok, jawokab' q'uixwelal yet' somk'olal t'a yib'anh heb'. B'atokab' heb' elelal t'a skal niwak q'uixwelal, yujto snib'ej heb' yak'an chukal t'ayin.
Ha heb' tzin b'uchani, kanokab' heb' t'a manh pensaril yuj somk'olal.
Axo masanil heb' ayoch spensar t'ayach, tzalajokab' heb' t'ayach. Te niwan elk'och ach Jehová, xchiokab' heb' snib'an a kolwal.
Ha inxo jun, ob'iltak in, ay in och t'a ilk'olal. Mamin, mokab' in b'atkan satk'olal uuj. Ha ach tzach ochtaxon wed'ok yik tzin a kolani. Ach Jehová in Diosal, manh ik'ek' tiempo in a kolani.
Wach' yik heb' skolwaj t'a heb' meb'a', a Jehová ol kolanel heb' t'a skal syaelal.
A' ol tanhwan heb', ol ak'jok sk'inal heb' yet' stzalajk'olal yuj t'a sat lu'um tik. Manh ol ak'jok ochlaj heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ool yuj.
Ol ak'jok yip heb' t'a skal syaelal yuj Jehová, ol b'oxok sk'ool heb'.
Ha in ix wala': Mamin Jehová, ok'ok a k'ool t'ayin. Anhtej in, yel toni ay in mul t'ayach, xin chi.
Ha heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, syal chuk heb' t'ayin: Comonoc spet chami yik manhxo ol nachajkotok, xchi heb'.
Sja heb' yak' in paxyal, palta manhok t'a swach'il sk'ol heb' tzul in yila'. Masanil tas syilb'at heb' t'ayin, sik'kan heb' t'a spensar, haxo t'a yoltak b'e syal in pekal heb'.
Ha heb' tzin chakaneli, smolb'ej sb'a heb', syalan in pekal heb'. Chuc tas sna heb' t'a in patik.
Syalan heb': Ha syaelal jun tik, manhxa yanhal. Toxo ix b'atkan t'a sat sch'at, manhxo ol b'oxlaj sk'ool, xchi heb'.
Ha jun wamigo junnhej tzin wa yet'ok, yip in k'ool walani, ha' ix och ajk'olal t'ayin.
Ha achxo Mamin Jehová, ok'ok wal a k'ool t'ayin. Ik' in k'e waan yik ol wak'anek' in pak t'a heb'.
Tato manh ol tzalaj sk'ool heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, ichato chi' ol nachajel wuuj to tzach tzalaj wed'ok.
Ha inxo pax jun, malaj in mul t'a ichanh, yuj chi' ix in a quetz yet' a k'ab'. Ayinnhejokab' ek' t'a ichanh t'a masanil tiempo.
Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, tiknaik yet' t'a masanil tiempo. Ujokab'i.
Ach in Diosal, tzach in nib'ej wal icha junok nok' k'ultaquil chej tzek' sayoj ha' yuj taquinhtial.
Ach Dios pitzan, a wal in pensar tzach nib'anochi, ¿b'aq'uinh ol in k'och t'a ichanh junelxo?
k'ual t'ak'wal woq'ui. Axonhej wok'el tik ayoch in waelok, yakb'an sb'uchwaj heb' anima t'ayin sk'anb'ejnhej heb': ¿B'ajtil ay jun a Diosal chi? xchi heb'.

Ayic tzin naan juntzanh tik, ste och pitz'an t'a in k'ool. Tzin naankoti ayik ay in ek' t'a skal heb' anima, yik tzin kuchb'an heb', yik tzonh b'at t'a a templo. Manhxo jantakok yel yaw heb' yuj tzalajk'olal yet' ak'oj yuj diosal. Niwan q'uinh ton wal jun chi'.
¿Tas wal yuj schab'axk'e in k'ool? ¿Tas yuj somchaj in pensar? Ach in Diosal, ayach och yipok in k'ool, olto wal wach' lolonel t'ayach, in Kolumal, in Diosal aji.
Ach in Diosal te kusk'olal waj tiknaik, yuj chi', manh jantakok ach in naankot t'a yol yik ha' Jordán yet' t'a yol yik switzal Hermón yet' switzal Mizar.
Icha sk'anh yem ponholjok ha ha' t'a niwak pajaw, icha wal chi' juntzanh niwak kusk'olal tzek' t'a wib'anh uuj.
Ach Jehová, ha t'a k'ualil tza ch'oxnhej a wach'k'olal t'ayin, haxo t'ak'walil, max in och waan ach in b'itani, max in och pax waan in lesalwi t'ayach, yujto a ach tzak' in k 'inal.
Swalan icha tik t'ayach: Ach in Kolumal, ¿tas yuj tzin b'atkan satk'olal uuj? Yuj chi' kusnak in k'ool ayik tzin b'eyeq'ui, yujto tzin yixtej wal heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, xin chi.
Swab' wal syail, icha wal to smak'jipoj in b'aquil b'aj tzin yixtej heb' ajk'ool chi'. Junjun rato sb'uchwaj heb' t'ayin sk'anb'an heb': ¿B'ajtil ay jun a Diosal chi'? xchi heb'.
¿Tas wal yuj schab'axk'e in k'ool? ¿Tas yuj somchaj in pensar? Ach in Diosal, ayach och yipok in k'ool, olto wal wach' lolonel t'ayach, in Kolumal, in Diosal aji.
Ach in Diosal, ch'oxeli to malaj in mul. Ochanh walumalok t'a juntzanh anima malaj elk'och t'a yol sat tik. Colinel t'a heb' naumk'e lolonel yet' t'a heb' chuk sb'eyb'al.
Ach in Diosal, in Kolumal ach, ¿tas wal yuj najat tzin ik'kanel t'a ichanh? ¿Tas wal yuj kusnak in k'ool tzin b'eyeq'ui, tzin yixtan heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin?
Ch'ox a sakil k'inal t'ayin yet' a lolonel te yel, yik wach' ol in sch'ox t'a sb'eal jun tzalan yik ejmelal b'aj kajan ach eq'ui.
Ach in Diosal, ol in k'och t'a altar, ata' ol ach in b'itejnhej yet' te' arpa, yujto a ach tzak' in tzalajk'olal.
¿Tas wal yuj schab'axk'e in k'ool? ¿Tas yuj somchaj in pensar? Ach in Diosal ayach och yipok in k'ool, olto wal wach' lolonel t'ayach, in Kolumal, in Diosal aji.
Ach ko Diosal, ix kab' a poder yujto a heb' ko mam quicham ix alan t'ayonh tas utejnak heb' t'a peka'.
Yed' a poder ix a pechel juntzanh heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, ix a satankanel heb' t'a juntzanh niwak chonhab' chi', haxo heb' ko mam quicham chi' ix ak' kajnaj t'a tik.

Manhok yet' yip heb', manhok pax k'een yespada heb' ix yak'lab'ej ayik ix yik'an jun lu'um tik heb'. Maj yik'laj jun lu'um tik heb' t'a ak'oj owalil, palta yuj a poder, yuj ipalil yet' yuj a wach'k'olal ix yak' ganar jun owal chi' heb', yujto xajan heb' uuj.
Ach ko Diosal, ko Reyal ach, a ach alnak, yuj chi' kak'nak ganar a onh yinhtilal onh kan winhaj Jacob tik.
Ha ach ton tzach och qued'ok, yuj chi' skak' ganar heb' ajk'ool chi'. Yuj ipalil skan heb' ajk'ool chi' t'a yalanh kuuj.
Manhoklaj yamk'ab' yik owal skak'och yipok ko k'ool, manhokpaxlaj yuj k'een quespada ol kak' ganar owal.
Ha heb' kajk'ool schichonoch sk'ool t'ayonh, tzonh a kol t'a yol sk'ab' heb', q'uixwelal tz'ajkan heb' uuj.
Anhej t'ayach ol kak'nhej tzalajb'ok ko k'ool, a achnhej ol ach ko b'itej.
Palta a tiknaik Mamin, ix onh a patiquejeli, ix onh ak'anoch t'a q'uixwelal, maxtzak yal-laj a k'ool tzach b'at yet' heb' ko soldado.
Ha ach ix onh aktejkani, yuj chi' ix onh el lemnaj t'a heb' kajk'ool. Ha heb' schichon sk'ool t'ayonh, ix yik'b'at heb' tastak ay t'ayonh.
Ix onh ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb', icha junok nok' kalnel tz'ik'jib'at b'aj smiljichamok. Ix onh a saklemejkanb'at t'a skal juntzanh nakión.
Te yechel ix onh a chonhkanel a onh a chonhab' onh tik. Malaj jab'ok tas ix ak' ganar yuj b'aj ix onh a chonhel chi'.
Ix onh ak'an b'uchjok yuj heb' anima kajan t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a ko lak'anil. Tzonh stzuntzan heb', malaj quelk'och t'a heb'.
Ix onh ak'an b'uchjok yuj heb' ch'ok chonhab'il. Anhej wal yik tzonh yilan heb', tzonh ste tzetzan heb'.
Junjun k'u, toxonhej tzonh te em nhojan yuj q'uixwelal.
Tzonh stzuntzan heb' kajk'ool snib'ej onh yixtani. Malaj quelk'och t'a heb'.
Aton juntzanh tik skot t'a quib'anh, wach'chom maj ach b'atkan satk'olal kuuj. Ina to sko k'anab'ajejnhej a trato ak'nak t'ayonh.
Max ko nalaj ach ko patiquejeli. Malaj a k'ayb'ub'al ix kaktejkani.
Wach'chom icha chi', palta ichato tzonh aktejkan t'a skal nok' nok' ay smay, ichato onh a makchejem b'aj te k'ik'k 'inal.
Ach ko Diosal, q'uinalok ach b'atkan satk'olal kuuj, haxo t'a komon Dios ix kak'em ko b'a,
ix am ila', yujto malaj junok tas k'ub'eltak manh ojtakok.
Palta uuj junjun rato ijan onh smilancham heb' ajk'ol chi', icha nok' kalnel tz'ik'jib'at b'aj schami, icha chi' tzonh yutej heb'.
Mamin, ¿tas yuj ichato waynak ach b'ati? Ilonhcoti, manh onh a patiquejkanel t'a junelnhej.
¿Tas yuj tzach b'at mikan t'ayonh? ¿Tas wal yuj tzonh b'atkan satk'olal uuj t'a skal ko niwan yaelal tik?
Toxo wan yel quip, maxtzak yal-laj ko loloni, toxonhej tzonh ek' telton t'a sat lu'um.
Pil ip. Cotanh. Colonh eli yujto te xajan onh uuj.
Ay wal ek' wach' lolonel t'a in pensar. Ol in b'itan t'a winh rey yet' juntzanh in lolonel chi'. Ha in ti' lajan icha stz'ib'lab' junok mach te jelan stz'ib'ani.
Ach rey, a achnhej wach' ilji t'a yichanh masanil heb' winh winak. Te wach'nhej tas tzala', te jelan a loloni yujto syak'nhej swach'k'olal Dios t'a ib'anh.
Ak'och jachan k'een espada t'a a nanhal, ach winak te ak'um owal, te b'inajnak ach, te ay wal elk'ochi.
Ixic t'a yib'anh nok' a chej yet' a poder yik tzak'an ganar owal, yik sb'oji yaj lolonel t'a stojolal t'a heb' emnaquil. Niwan tastak satub'tak ol a k'ulej yet' ipalil.
Ach ko reyal, a jul-lab' te jay snhi' ol b'at ch'apnaj t'a snhi' sk'ool heb' ajk'ool. Yuj chi' ol telwok heb' anima yik juntzanh chonhab' t'a skal ok.
Ach ko Diosal, yajal ach t'a smasanil tiempo. Yajal ach, wach'nhej tz'aj a ch'olb'itan tastak.
Ha wal tojolal scha a k'ool, max schalaj a k'ool chukal. Yuj chi' ix ach sik'el Dios, aton a Diosal. Ix yak' niwan tzalajk'olal t'ayach t'a yichanh juntzanhxo heb' ay yopisio ed'ok.
Tz'el sjab' sperfumeal mirra, áloes yet' te' kanela ayoch t'a a pichul. Ha son ay sch'anhal ol ak'an tzalaj a k'ool t'a a pat marfilnhej ayoch yelwanub'ok.
Ay heb' ix yisil heb' winh rey t'a skal heb' awtab'il uuj. Ha t'a a tz'ey t'a a wach', ata' ayek' ix reina. Ha k'een oro yelxo wal wach' ayoch t'a spichul ix.
Ach yisil rey, maklej wal ab'i, scham wal ab'an tas ol wal t'ayach. Manhxo a na heb' a k'ab' ok yet' heb' etchonhab',
yujto a winh rey chi' snib'an swach'il ilji, aton winh ajalil. Hak'uem a b'ha t'a winh.
Ol yak' silab' heb' aj Tiro t'ayach. Ha heb' niwak b'eyum, ol snib'ej heb' yoch amigook.
Tik sja ix ix wan yoch yetb'eyumok winh rey, wach'nhej yilji ix, yisil pax ix junokxo winh rey. Oro ayoch yelwanub'ok spichul ix.
Wach'nhej yaj sb'o ix yet' spichul, tz'ik'jib'at ix t'a winh rey. Tzak'anoch heb' ix kob'estak yuk'lewok ix, aton heb' ix yamiga ix.
Stzalaj heb' ix sb'at heb' ix, masanto sk'och heb' ix t'a spat winh rey chi'.
Ach rey, a heb' uninal ol em k'ojan b'aj tz'emtaxon k'ojan heb' a mam icham. Ol ak'anoch yopisio heb' yik syilan masanil yol a makb'en tik heb'.
Ha in ol wak' nachajkot a b'i yuj masanil anima toto ol aljok t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik. Ol yal wach' lolonel junjun chonhab' t'ayach t'a masanil tiempo.
Ha Dios ayoch quenhulok, anheja' pax ayoch quipumalok. Ha tz'och qued'ok ayik ayonh t'a skal yaelal.
Yuj chi' max onh xiwlaj. Wach'chom stzikub'tanhaj lum lum tik, skot juyuljok juntzanh witz t'a yol ha' mar,
wach'chom sk'anh ha' mar chi', sk'epax chulnaj sat ha', wach'chom stzikub'tanhaj jolomtak witz yuj yowal ha', palta max onh xiwlaj.
Ay jun ha' niwan ha' tz'ak'an tzalaj sk'ol heb' kajan t'a schonhab' Dios, aton b'aj kajan Dios ek'to t'a yib'anh smasanil.
Ha Dios ayek' t'a schonhab' chi', yuj chi' manh ol satel-laj. Ha tz'och yet' schonhab' chi' ayik wan sakb'i.
Tz'el yaw juntzanh niwak chonhab' yuj owal. Ol satel juntzanh nakión chi'. Ol ulaxb'at lum lum tik ayik ol ab'chaj sjaj Dios.
Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, ayek' qued'ok. Ha sDiosal ko mam quicham Jacob, a ayoch qued'ok, ay paxoch quenhulok.
Ul ilek satub'taquil tas ix aj satjiel heb' ajk'ol t'a sat lu'um tik yuj Jehová.
Slajwiek' owal yuj masanto t'a slajwub' yol yib'anhk’inal tik. Skanhchajkanb'at sjul-lab' heb' yuj. Ha k'een lanza, chok' tz'aj k'een yuj. Syak'anoch sk'ak'al karruaje yik owal chi'.
Syalan Dios chi' t'a juntzanh nakión: Actejec eyak'an owal. Nachajokab'el eyuuj to a in ton Dios in. Ol alchajel in poder t'a skal masanil nakión t'a sat lu'um tik, xchi Dios.
Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, ayek' qued'ok. Ha sDiosal ko mam quicham Jacob, a ayoch qued'ok, ay paxoch quenhulok.
Tz'itek he k'ab' he masanil ex nakión. Awajanhec d'ha Dios t'a tzalajk'olal.
Yujto a Jehová, ek'to t'a yib'anh smasanil, sat ko k'ool yuj stziquiquial. Aton Yajalil t'a smasanil yol yib'anhk’inal tik.
Ix laj kan juntzanh nakión t'a yalanh yuj, ix yak'ankanoch t'a yol ko k'ab'.
A' ix sik'anel lum lum b'aj stzalajb'i ko k'ool a onh yinhtilal onh winhaj Jacob tik, a onh ton te xajan onh yuj.
Ha Jehová Dios toxo ix k'ek'och t'a sk'ojnub' t'a skal aw yik tzalajk'olal yet' t'a skal yik wan yok' k'een trompeta.
Conh b'itanek, konh b'itanek t'a ko Diosal. Conh b'itanek, konh b'itanek t'a ko Reyal.
Conh b'itanek t'a aloj wach' lolonel d'ha Dios, yujto ha' Yajal yaj t'a smasanil yol yib'anhk’inal tik.
Ha Dios ayoch Yajalil t'a smasanil nakión. k'ojanem t'a sk'ojnub' to anhej ay yiko'.
Ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' anima niwak yopisio t'a skal nakión. Ix och heb' ko tz'akub'ok a onh schonhab' onh sDiosal ko mam quicham Abraham.
Ha Dios ay yik heb' yajal t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik. A' te niwan yelk'och t'a yib'anh smasanil.
Ha Jehová ko Diosal, yelxo wal niwan yelk'ochi, smoj wal yalchaj wach' lolonel t'ay t'a yol schonhab', aton tzalan b'aj tz'och ejmelal t'ay.

Manhxo jantakok swach'il yilji jun tzalan tik, chaanh ayk'ei. Ha t'a chon tzalan Sion tik, b'aj kajan Dios, a tik ay wal stzalajk'olal masanil heb' kajan t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik. Ha Sion tik schonhab' Vinh Rey yelxo wal niwan yelk'ochi.
Ha Dios ayek' t'a juntzanh palakio t'a tzalan Sion tik. Ojtakab'il to ha Dios ayoch ko kolumalok.
Ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' winh rey, ix kot nhililok heb' winh yak' owal t'a chonhab' Sion tik.
Palta ayik ix yilan jun chonhab' tik heb' winh, ix sat sk'ool heb' winh. Ix somchajel sk'ool heb' winh, ix b'at heb' winh elelal.
Ix yamchaj heb' winh yuj xiwelal, tz'ib'xi heb' winh yuj yaelal, icha junok ix ix wan yalji yune'.
Icha tz'aj spojb'at te' barko yik chonhab' Tarsis yuj owal ik' skot t'a b'aj sjawi k'u, icha chi' ix aj satel heb' winh yuj Dios.
Ha t'a schonhab' Jehová ko Diosal Yajal t'a Smasanil, ix quil wal yelk'och icha wal alb'ilkan t'ayonh. Ha Dios ol yak'nhej stek'anil Jerusalén.
Ach ko Diosal, ayik ayonhek' t'a a templo, sko nakot a niwan wach'k'olal.
Ach ko Diosal, te b'inajnak ach t'a smasanil yol yib'anhk’inal tik, yuj chi' tz'alchaj wach' lolonel t'ayach. Tza b'o yaj masanil tas t'a stojolal yet' a poder.
Ay stzalajk'olal heb' aj Sion. Te tzalajokab' heb' aj Judá yujto t'a stojolal ix a b'o yaj smasanil.
Ek'anhek oyoyok t'a spatik yichanh Sion, tze b'isani jaye' storreal.
Scham wal he sayan eyil smuroal. Schampax eyilan spat heb' yajal, yik wach' ol yal eyalanel yab'ixal t'a heb' unin manto aljoklaj.
Ha sDiosal Sion, aton ko Diosal t'a junelnhej. Ha tzonh ik'annhej b'eyok masanto t'a slajwub'.
Ex anima ay t'a masanil yol yib'anhk’inal tik, scham wal eyab'an jun lolonel tik.
Ab'ek ex b'eyum yet' ex meb'a', mach ex ay eyelk'ochi yet' ex komon anima ex.
Ol in lolon t'a jelanil, ol wal juntzanh pensar ajaltak snachajeli.
Ol in maklej wal wab' slolonel heb' jelan. Ol in b'itej tas ix in k'ayb'ej chi' yet' sonal te' arpa.
¿Tas yuj ol in xiwok ayik ol ja juntzanh sk'ual yaelal t'ayin, ayik ol k'och oyan heb' ajk'ool t'ayin?
Ha heb' ajk'ol chi', a sb'eyumal heb' syak'och yipok sk'ool, syik'anchaanh sb'a heb' yujto manh jantakok tas ay t'a heb'.
Palta malaj junok mach syal skolan yetanimail t'a yol yiko', ma smananel sk'inal d'ha Dios.
Max yal-laj ko mananel ko k 'inal yik wach' ayonnhej eq'ui, yik max onh chami, yujto max techajlaj ko tupani.
Ina squila' to junlajan scham anima smasanil. Scham heb' jelan, schampax heb' man jelanok, haxo sb'eyumal heb', ch'ok mach b'aj skani.
Wach'chom manh jantakok ko lu'um, palta nab'anhej. Ha b'aj tzonh mukchaji, ata' ayonnhejek' t'a masanil tiempo. Junelnhej ol onh kannhej ta'.
Ha onh anima onh tik, manh masanilok tiempo ayonhek' t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik. Wach'chom yel te b'eyum onh, palta tzonh chamnhej icha scham nok' nok'.
Icha pax chi' tz'aj satel heb' syipk'olej sb'a, aton heb' syaloch sb'a wach'il.

Ha juntzanh anima chi', a chamel ayoch yilumalok heb'. Ha tz'ik'anb'at heb' b'aj smukchaj chamnak. Ayic ol sakb'ok, t'a sk'ual yik ol onh ch'olb'itajok, a heb' anima wach' spensar ol ak'an ganar t'a yichanh heb'. k'ojank'olal ol satem sniwanil heb', haxo b'aj smukchaj chamnak ol och skajnub'ok heb'.
Ha in xo jun, ha Dios ol in ik'ankanel t'a yol sk'ab' chamel, ol in yik'anb'at yet'ok.
Ex wetanimail, manh eyak' pensar yuj heb' tz'och b'eyumal, heb' ste k'echaanh sb'eyumal t'a spat.
Yuj chi' manh he na'a, yujto ayik ol cham heb', malaj jab'ok tas ol yik'b'at heb' yet'ok, manh ol b'atlaj sb'eyumal heb' chi' yet'ok.
Wach'chom te tzalajk'olal yik heb' ayik pitzan heb', ma tz'alji pax wach' lolonel t'a heb' yuj heb' yetanimail yuj sb'eyumal chi',
ol ja sk'ual scham heb', icha ix aj scham heb' smam yicham heb', manhxo ol yil-laj sakil k'inal heb'.
Ha heb' anima b'eyum, tato max nachajel yuj heb' to ek'elb'anhej yek' masanil tas, lajan ol aj scham heb' icha tz'aj scham nok' nok'.
Ha Jehová, Dios Axonhejochi, a ix loloni. Ix yawtej heb' kajan t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, b'aj sjawi k'u masanto b'aj tz'em k'u.
Ha t'a tzalan Sion, aton chonhab' te wach' yilji, ata' sch'ox sakil k'inal Dios.
Tik sja ko Diosal, palta manh ichnhejoktalaj ol jawok. Ha t'a spatik yichanh ay jun k'ak' to satumeli yet' jun chakxuxum ik'.
Ato t'a chaanh tz'awtaj heb' aj satcha’anh yet' heb' kajan t'a sat lum lum tik yuj Dios, yik wach' syil heb' sch'olb'itaj schonhab'.
Syal Dios icha tik: Molb'ejek he b'a ex wikxo, a ex eyak'nak jun silab' t'ayin, ayik eyak'annak he trato wed'ok, xchi.
Ha satcha’anh sch'oxani to ha Dios Juez ton t'a stojolal.
Syalanpax Dios icha tik: Ex in chonhab' Israel, ab'eknab'i, jichan ol wutej walanoch he paltail t'a he sat. Ha in Dios in, he Diosal in.
Maj ex in tumejlaj yuj eyofrenda tzeyak'taxon t'ayin yet' nok' nok' tze nhus silab'il t'ayin t'a waltar.
Max in k'anlaj nok' kelemtak wakax molb'il eyuuj. Malaj nok' mam chiwa t'a yol he makte' tzin k'an t'ayex.
Vicnhej masanil nok' kaltakte'al nok', wik pax nok' molb'etzal nok' ay t'a jolomtak witz.
Vic masanil nok' much ay t'a kaltak te' yet' masanil tas tzek' t'a kal wayumtak.
Q'uinalok ay in wejel, manh ol wal-laj t'ayex, yujto wik jun yol yib'anhk’inal tik yet' masanil tas ay t'ay.
¿Tocwal a sb'ak'chil nok' wakax tzin chi'a? ¿Tocwal a pax schiq'uil nok' mam chiwa swuk'ej?
Ha silab' tzin nib'ej, to tzeyak' yuj diosal t'ayin, tzeyak'elk'och tas tzeyaltej t'ayin, a in ton ek' in to t'a yib'anh smasanil.
Ayic ay eyaelal, awtejinek, ol ex in kolo', a exxo ol in eyik'chaanh, xchi Dios.
Axo t'a heb' chuk sb'eyb'al, syal Dios icha tik: ¿Toc ay eyalan eyik eyalanel in k'ayb'ub'al, ma eyalanel yab'ixal in trato?
Ina to max yal-laj he k'ool tzex in kacha', malaj yelk'och in lolonel t'ayex.
Ayic sja winh elk'umtaxoni, tzex k'e urnaj he b'at yet' winh. Te wach' eyak'anpax yet' heb' sk'ulan ajmulal.
Palta a tas tze k'ulej, to tze nak'e lolonel, max ex och waan eyesani.
Ha t'a heb' eyuk'tak junnhej he nun yet'ok, tzeyal chukal lolonel t'a spatik heb'.
Ayic ix he k'ulan juntzanh chukal tik, malaj tas swala'. Yuj chi' tze na' to lajan in eyed'ok, palta ol waloch he mul chi' t'a he sat, ol wil-lajoch in sat eyed'ok.
Ha ex tzin b'at satk'olal eyuuj tik, wach'okab' tz'aj snachajel jun tik eyuuj, haxo talaj tz'aji, ol ex in jatchitejb'ati, manhxalaj mach ol ex kolan t'ayin.
Ha mach tz'ak'an yuj diosal t'ayin, ay welk'och t'a yol sat. Ha mach tzin k'anab'ajani, ol in kolkaneli, xchi Dios.
Ach in Diosal yujto tzin a xajanej, ok'ok wal a k'ool t'ayin. Ha yuj a niwan ok'elk'olal, suksat in mul.
B'ik in el t'a masanil in mul, tzin a sakb'itani.
Yel toni ix och in mul, ix in ek' t'a yib'anh, max b'atlaj satk'olal junok rato in mul chi' wuuj.
Ix och wal in mul chi' t'ayach. Ix in k'ulej chukal t'a yol a sat. Yuj chi' smoj wal ak'an in yaelal. Max yal-laj yalchaj chukal t'ayach ayik tzin a ch'olb'itani.
Val yel, yiktax waljub'al chuk in. Toxonton chuk in atax yik kuchb'il into och yuj ix in nun.
Val yel tza xajanej mach snib'ej tojolal t'a smasanil sk'ool. Yuj chi' ak' a jelanil t'ayin.
nhikkanel in mul yik tzin sakb'ikaneli. B'ik in eli, yik wach' sakxonhej tzin ajkan icha k'een sakb'akom.
Ak'xi in tzalajk'olal in k'ana' yik tz'el in kusk'olal yuj b'aj ix ak' in yaelal sik'lab'il.
Manhxo a nakot in mul chi', tza sukan sat masanil in chukal.
Ach in Diosal, tojolb'itej in pensar. Ha junok ak' b'eyb'al tzak' t'ayin yik tzin k'anab'ajej yet' smasanil in k'ool.
Manh in ik'kanel t'a ichanh, manh ik'paxel a Santo Espíritu t'ayin.
Ak'xi in tzalajk'olal yuj in kolnab'il. Ak' wip yik b'ekan in k'ool ach in k'anab'ajani,
yik wach' tzin k'ayb'ej heb' chuk yik sb'eyb'alej a b'eyb'al heb' yik smeltzajoch heb' t'a yol a k'ab'.
Ach in Diosal, ix ak' in kolnab'il, manhxo a cha in mil anima, kolinel t'a in mul yik ol walan a tojolal t'a b'italil.
Mamin, jak in ti' yik ol ach in b'itani.
Tato a ofrenda, ma silab' nhusb'il tza nib'ej, tzam wak'laj, okxo jun, max a nib'ej paxlaj.
Ha tas a gana, aton heb' skus sk'ol yuj smul. Ach in Diosal, max a patiquejel-laj anima syik'em sb'a yujto sna sb'a yuj smul.
Ak' a wach'k'olal t'a Sion. Yuj swach'il a k'ool, b'oxik'e smuroal Jerusalén.
Ichato wal chi' t'a tzalajk'olal ol aj a chaan silab' a gana tz'ak'ji t'ayach, aton nok' nok' snhusji. Ichato chi' ol ak'jok nok' wakax silab'il t'ayach t'a altar.
Ach to jelan ach t'a owal, ¿tas yuj tzik'chaanh a b'ha t'a a chukal? Ha swach'k'olal Dios aynhejek' t'a smasanil tiempo.
Anhej chukal a gana tza k'ulej. Ha a ti' tzak'lab'ej t'a lolonel manh yelok, icha wal junok k'een kuchilub' te jay ye syak'lab'ej junok anima smil-lab'ok.
Ha chukal a gana t'a yichanh wach'il. Ha lolonel es a gana t'a yichanh lolonel yel.
Ach anima chab' sat, a wal lolonel yik tz'ixtan anima a gana.
Palta ha Dios ol ach satanel t'a junelnhej. Ol och yub'naj t'ayach, ol ach yik'ankanel t'a a pat, ol yik'anel a k 'inal.
Ha heb' sk'anab'ajan Dios ol yil jun tik heb', ol xiw heb' t'ay, palta ol b'uchwaj heb' t'a jun winh chuk chi'.
Ol yalan heb': Ilec wal winh maj ak'anoch Dios yipok sk'ool. Anhej wal t'a niwak b'eyumal ix yak'och sk'ol winh, aynhejoch spensar winh sk'ulan chukal, xcham heb'.
Ha inxo tik, lajan in icha junok te' oliwo te yaax, wach' sq'uib' t'a yamaq'uil stemplo Dios. Anhej swach'k'olal Dios ol wak'och yipok in k'ool.
Ach in Diosal, ol wak'nhej yuj diosal yuj a wach'k'olal t'ayin. Tzach wak'nhejoch yipok in k'ool yujto wach' ach. Ol walel ab'ixal t'a yichanh heb' ikxo, to toxonton wach' ach.
Ha heb' chuk spensar sna heb' to malaj Dios. Junlajanxonhej ix aj sjuanel spensar heb'. Yelxo wal te chuk sk'ulej heb'. Manhxalaj mach sk'ulan wach'il.
Ato t'a satcha’anh k'elanemta Dios t'a anima, yik syila' tato ay heb' syak'och spensar t'ay, yik syilpaxi tato naan yuj heb'.
Ha juntzanh b'eyb'al chuk sb'eyb'alej heb' smasanil. Junlajanxonhej tz'aj sjuwib'at heb'. Manhxalaj junok mach tzato b'eyb'alan wach' b'eyb'al. Toton manhxa wal junok.
Icha wal to malaj spensar heb' sk'ulan chukal chi'. Ha heb' chi' satanel heb' yetchonhab', icha wal to swael heb' yaj heb', max yal-laj sb'a heb' d'ha Dios.
Tz'ib'xi heb' yuj xiwelal wach'chom malaj tas xib'tan heb'. Ha Dios ix saklemankanb'at sb'aquil heb' ajk'ool, q'uixwelal ix ajkan heb' yujto ix patikajel heb' yuj Dios.
Comonoc ha t'a tzalan Sion skot ko kolnab'il a onh israel onh tik. Ayic ol yak'anxi swach'k'olal Dios t'a quib'anh, ol tzalaj ko k'ool a onh yinhtil onh winhaj Jacob tik. Ol el lenaj ol quila'.
Ach in Diosal, kolin icha ajnak alan t'ayin. Colin yujto syal uuj smasanil.
Ach in Diosal, ab' in lesal tik. Ak'kot tz'eyan a chiquin t'a tas swala'.
Yujto a heb' anima manh wojtakok tz'och ajk'olal t'ayin, aton heb' komonnhej tz'ak'an chukal t'a yetanimail. Snib'ej heb' to tzin chami. Malaj elk'och t'a heb'.
Palta jun, tik wal a ach ayachoch wed'ok. Tik wal uuj pitzan in.
Ha schukal heb' ayoch ajk'olal chi' t'ayin ol meltzajoch t'a yib'anh uuj. Mamin, satkanel heb' yujto tzak'nhejelk'och tas tzala'.
Mamin Jehová, ol wak' in silab' t'ayach t'a yol wiko', ol ach in b'itani yujto wach' ach,
yujto ix in a kolel t'a smasanil wilk'olal. Ix wilan skan heb' ajk'ool t'ayin t'a yalanh uuj.
Ach in Diosal, ab' in lesal, manh a patiquejel tas tzin k'an t'ayach.
Cotanh k'elan t'ayin, tak'wanh t'ayin in k'ana. D'a skal in yaelal swal in b'a t'ayach.
Tzin ib'xik'e yuj xiwelal yuj heb' chuk ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin. Tz'el yaw heb' yuj yajk'olal. Te niwan in yaelal ix yak'kot heb' t'a wib'anh. Yed' wal yowal sk'ol heb' tzin spechan b'eyek' heb'.
Syab' wal syail in pixan yuj heb'. Toxo ix jawi smay chamel t'a wib'anh.
Ix jawi jun niwan xiwk'olal t'ayin, wan wib'xik'e yuj.
Tzin naani, komonok ay in k'axil icha nok' uch, tzam in b'at jenhenhok, tato icha chi' junk'olal am tzin aji.
Tzam in b'at jenhenhok t'a najat, a am laj t'a tzinan lu'um tzin kajnaji.
Tzam in b'at in kol in b'a yuj yowal junok anima icha owal ik'nhab' yaji, xin chi.
Mamin, satkanel heb' chuk, jub'at tas syal heb'. Anhej owal swil t'a yol chonhab' tik, malaj jab'ok yok'elk'olal heb'.
k'ual t'ak'wal yek' heb' yoymitej chonhab' t'a yib'anh muro. Ay wal chukal t'a yol chonhab' yet' naoj chaanh es. Ix te juwiel chonhab' yuj heb'.
Comonxonhej sk'ulej chukal heb' t'a yoltak kalle yet' ak'oj musansatil.
Tato a heb' komon ajk'ool tzin ixtani, tzam techajlaj wuuj. Tato a mach schichonoch sk'ol t'ayin icha chi' tzin utani, tzam in k'ub'ejel in b'a t'ay.
Ocxo tiknaik, a mach wuk'lew yaji, in wach' k'ol yaji, ha' tzin utan icha tik.
Junnhej ix b'at wed' t'a stemplo Dios. Ix onh lolon t'a amigoal. Junnhej ix ek' wed' t'a skal heb' anima t'a templo chi'.
Jaokab' juknaj chamel t'a heb' ajk'ool yajoch t'ayin. Pitzanokab' heb' tz'emkan heb' b'aj smukjiem heb' chamnak, yujto ay wal och chukal t'a spensar heb' yet' t'a yol spat heb'.
Ha in tik, ha t'a Jehová Dios ol wal in b'a. A' ol in kolanok.
D'a q'uinhib'alil, t'a chimk'ualil yet' t'a yemk'ualil, ol wal in b'a t'ay t'a skal yal in sat, haxo ol ab'an tas ol wala'.
A' ol in kolanel t'a skal owal. Manh ol in chajoklaj cham yuj, wach'chom tzijtum heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin.
Ha Dios Yajal t'a masanil tiempo, ha' ol ab'an tas swala', emnaquil ol ajkan heb' ajk'ol chi' yuj, yujto max sk'exlaj jab'ok sb'eyb'al heb', max xiwpaxlaj heb' t'ay.
Ha winh wuk'lew chi', ix yik'chaanh sk'ab' winh t'ayin, wach'chom in wach' k'ol in b'a yet' winh. Max sk'anab'ajejlaj b'aj ix yak' sti' winh yoch wamigook.
k'ununi slolon winh, palta haxo t'a spensar winh, anhej owal snib'ej winh. Te k'ununi syutej winh sloloni, palta icha k'een espada te jay ye, icha chi' yaj slolonel winh chi'.
Masanil tas tzin na'a, ol wak'b'at t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová, ha' ol ak'an in tek'anil. Tato k'anab'ajum swutej in b'a t'ay, malaj b'ak'uinh ol in scha telwok.

Ach in Diosal, a heb' mak'umcham anima yet' heb' naumk'e es, tzapan ol aj sk'inal heb', manh ol yil-laj nanhalb'ok sk'inal heb'. Ha ach ton ol ak'b'at heb' b'aj smukchaj heb' chamnak. Palta a in tik, tzach wak'och yipok in k'ool.
Ach in Diosal, ok'ok wal a k'ool t'ayin, ay heb' anima tzin pechaneq'ui. Aynhejoch heb' yak'an owal t'ayin, manhxo animaok tzin ajkan yuj heb'.
Ha heb' ajk'ol t'ayin, manhxo jantakok heb', max yaktej heb' in spechanb'eyek'ok. Yuj yak'umtaquil heb' syak' owal heb' wed'ok.
Ayic tzin xiwi, a ach tzach wak'och yipok in k'ool.
Ach in Diosal, tzach wak'och yipok in k'ool, swalan wach' lolonel yuj tas alb'ilkan uuj. Tzach wak'och yipok in k'ool, yuj chi' max in xiwlaj yuj tas sna heb' anima in yutej.
Max yaktej heb' yalan lolonel te ya t'ayin. Anhej tas tz'aj in yixtan heb', a nab'il yuj heb'.
Yalxonhej b'ajtil sk'ub'ejel sb'a heb' yik tzin smaklani. Stanhwan heb' janik' ol in smilcham heb'.
Ach in Diosal, ak'kan juntzanh anima chi' t'a yalanh yuj yowal a k'ool. Manh a cha skol sb'a heb' t'a yalanh yaelal yuj schukal chi'.
Ojtac jantakxo sb'isul tzin eleq'ui. Ojtac jantak yal in sat ix eli. Vojtak to tz'ib'ab'il juntzanh tik uuj.
Ha heb' wajk'ool, ol el heb' ayik ol in k'anan a kolwal. Ha in tik wojtak wal to ay ach och wed'ok.
Ach Jehová Dios, tzach wak'och yipok in k'ool, swalan pax wach' lolonel yuj tas alb'ilkan uuj.
Ach Dios, tzach wak' wal och yipok in k'ool, yuj chi' max in xiwlaj yuj tas sna heb' anima in yutej.
Ach in Diosal, ol wak' silab' yik ak'oj yuj diosal t'ayach icha ix aj wak'an in ti' t'ayach.
Yujto ix in a kol t'a chamel, ix in a kolani yik maj in telwok. Yuj chi' tzin b'eyek' t'a ichanh t'a jun sakil k'inal tzak' t'a heb' pitzan.

Ach in Diosal, ok'ok wal a k'ool t'ayin, a t'ayach tzin say in kolnab'il. In gana tzin kol in b'a t'ayach icha tz'aj skolan sb'a nok' yunetak kaxlanh t'a yalanh sk'axil snun, masanto ol lajwoquek' jun yaelal tik.
Ach in Diosal te niwan elk'ochi, tzin awaj t'ayach, yujto a achnhej tzach kolwajnhej wed'ok.
Ha yuj a wach'k'olal, yuj pax to tz'elk'och tas tzala', yuj chi' masanto t'a satcha’anh tzak'kot in kolnab'il. Ol in a kolel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' tzin ixtan chi'.
Ichato t'a skal nok' choj schi'an anima ayin eq'ui. Ha k'een ye heb' lajan icha k'een lanza yet' te' jul-lab'. Ha tas syal heb', lajan icha k'een espada te jay ye.
Ach in Diosal, tzek'b'at sniwanil elk'och t'a satcha’anh. Ha sniwanil elk'och chi', chequel t'a masanil yol yib'anhk’inal tik.
Ha heb' ajk'ol yajoch t'ayin, ix yak'em in yaalil heb', manhxo animaok waj yuj heb', ix sb'oan jun olan heb' t'a yol in b'e, palta anheja' heb' ix b'at t'a yool.
Ach in Diosal, b'ekan in k'ool, in gana tzach in b'itej yet' wach' lolonel.
Yuj chi' ol wak'el in wayanh, ol ach in b'itej yet' te' arpa yet' salterio. Ayic wan sakb'i, ol el in wayanh, ol ach in b'itani.
Mamin, ol wal wach' lolonel t'ayach t'a skal juntzanh chonhab'. Ol ach in b'itej t'a skal juntzanh nakión.
Niwan ton a wach'k'olal, masanto t'a satcha’anh sk'ochi. Tz'elnhejk'och tas tzala'.
Ach in Diosal, tzek'b'at sniwanil elk'och t'a satcha’anh. Ha sniwanil elk'och chi', chequel t'a masanil yol yib'anhk’inal tik.
Ha ex wal juez ex tik, ¿tojol am wal tzeyutej he ch'olb'itan yaj junok tasi? ¿Yel am wal to t'a smojalil tze b'o yaj owal?
Palta jun, chuk tzeyutej he b'oani. Kuchb'um ex t'a elk'al yet' t'a mak'wal t'a yol chonhab' tik.
Ha heb' sk'ulan chukal, atax manto alji heb', chuktaxon heb'. Esalwumtaxon heb' atax yik yaljinak heb'.
Lajan heb' yet' nok' chan ay swenenoal. Lajan heb' yet' nok' ajawchan max ab'anlaj.
Max yab'laj sonal heb' winh mago nok', aton heb' winh jelan syal yak'an quistalax nok'.
Mamin Jehová, ach in Diosal, ik'el yip heb'. Utejkan heb' icha junok nok' choj mak'b'ilpoj yalanh sti'.
Satokab'em heb' icha tz'aj satem ha ha' stob'b'ati. Ayic sjulwaj heb', malajokab' snhi' te' sjul-lab' heb' chi'.
Ulaxokab'b'at heb' icha nok' unin. Ichaokab' junok unin manh tz'akanok yujal a tz'alji, max yil-laj sakil k'inal, ichokab' ta' tz'ajkanb'at heb'.
Icha te' taquinh q'uiix, smolchajoch spayulok lum chen, stup sk'ak'al te' ayik manto xejk'e lum chen chi', ichokab' ta' tzutej ik'ankanel heb' chuk sb'eyb'al chi', ayik pitzanto heb'.
Ha heb' sk'anab'ajan Dios, ol tzalaj heb' ayik ol ek' spak heb' t'a heb' chuk chi'. Ol sb'onhanb'at yok heb' t'a skal schiq'uil heb'.
Yuj chi' ol yal heb' anima icha tik: Wach' yik heb' sk'anab'ajan slolonel Dios. Ayton jun Dios sch'olb'itan heb' kajan t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, xcham heb'.
Ach in Diosal, kolinel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin. Colinel t'a heb' skot t'ayin yuj yajk'olal.
Colinel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' sk'ulan chukal. Colinel t'a heb' mak'umcham anima.
Mamin Jehová, tzin smaklej heb' anima te ow yik tzin smak'ancham heb', palta manh yujok in chukal, malaj tas ix wutej heb'.
Mamin, malaj in mul t'a heb'. Malaj tas chuk ix in k'ulej. Palta snanonek' sk'ol heb' yak'an chukal t'ayin. Mamin, il in koti, kotanh, tzul in a kolani.
Mamin Jehová, Yajal ach t'a smasanil, ko Diosal ach a onh israel onh tik, kotanh elanhchamel, tzak'anoch syaelal juntzanh nakión. Mokab' ok' a k'ool t'a heb' smeltzajoch yak'an chukal t'ayin.
Ayic sq'uik'b'i sjawi heb', tz'el yaw heb' icha nok' tz'i', slajwi chi' slaj ek' heb' t'a kal chonhab'.
Swoman sti' heb' tzek' heb', haxo lolonel te ya syal heb'. Malaj mach tzab'an kalani, xchamlaj heb'.
Ha achxo Mamin Jehová, tzaton ach tzewaj yuj heb'. Tzach b'uchwaj t'a juntzanh nakión chi'.
Ach in Diosal, a t'ayach ipan in kolan in b'a, yujto a ach ay ach och wipumalok yet' wenhulok.
Ach in Diosal, xajan in uuj, a ach ol ul in a kolo'. Ol a ch'ox t'ayin tas wal ol aj skan heb' wajk'ol chi' t'a yalanh uuj.
Ach Jehová ko Kolumal, tzikub'tanhej heb' yet' a poder. Emnaquilokab' tzutejkan heb', palta manh a mak'chamlaj heb' yik a syaelal heb' chi' manh ol b'atlaj satk'olal yuj heb' wetchonhab'.
Tz'och smul heb' yuj masanil tas syala'. Canokab' heb' t'a yalanh yuj yak'umtaquil, yuj yesalwumal yet' yuj skatab'wumal heb'.
Satel heb' yet' yowal a k'ool. ¿Tasto wal yuj pitzan heb'? Ach Dios Kajal a onh yinhtilonhkan winhaj Jacob, elokab' a pekal masanto b'aj slajwik'och yol yib'anhk’inal tik.
Sjawi heb' t'ak'walil, tz'el yaw heb' icha nok' tz'i', slaj ek' heb' t'a kal chonhab' say swael, tz'awaj heb' icha yok' nok' tz'i', yujto max yab'laj sk'ool swael heb'.
Ha in xo pax jun, ol ach in b'itej t'a q'uinhib'alil. Ol walel sniwanil elk'ochi yet' a wach'k'olal t'a b'ital, yujto ayachnhejoch wenhulok. In Kolumal ach t'a stiempoal yaelal.
Ach in Diosal, ol wal wach' lolonel t'ayach t'a b'ital. In Kolumal ach, in Diosal ach, xajanab'il in uuj.
Ach ko Diosal yet' wal yowal a k'ool ix onh aktankani. Ix onh aktejkani, onh ak'ji ganar. Mamin, ak'xikot quip tiknaik.
Ix ak' ib'xok jun lum tik, ix jatkanb'at lu'um. Ha tiknaik, makxi sjatelal lum chi', yik mantzak ib'xilaj lu'um.
Ha onh a chonhab' onh tik, niwan yaelal ix ak' quila'. Ichato te niwan wino ix ak' t'ayonh, ix k'e t'a ko jolom.
Ix ak' jun ch'oxnab'il t'a heb' niwan elk'och t'a yichanh yik wach' max yamchaj heb' yuj sjul-lab' heb' ajk'ool.
Tak'wanh t'ayonh, kolonheli, yujto masanil syal uuj. Colonhcanel a onh xajanab'il onh tik uuj.
Ix lolonkot Dios masanto t'a skajnub', ix yalan icha tik: Ol tzalaj in k'ool ayik ol in kotak pojanb'at lum Siquem yet' yak'likal lum Sucot.
Axo lum Galaad yet' lum Manasés wik yaj lu'um. Ha Efraín icha in k'een xumpil yaji. Axo Judá icha sk'okochal wopisio yaji.
Ha Moab, icha yet'tal b'aj tzin b'ik in b'a yaji. Ha t'a yib'anh Edom ol wak'kanb'at in xanhab'. D'a tzalajk'olal ol in awajok yujto ol wak' ganar heb' filisteo, xchi Dios.
Ach in Diosal ¿mach tzin ik'anb'at t'a jun chonhab' ayoch smuroal t'a spatik yichanh? ¿Mach tzin ik'anb'at t'a Edom?
Ach ko Diosal, ix onh a patiquejeli. Maxtzac yal-laj a k'ol tzach b'at yet' heb' ko soldado t'a owal.
Ochanh qued'ok, kolonhel t'a heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayonh. Ha skolwal heb' quetanimail t'ayonh, malaj yalani.
Ach ko Diosal, a yet' a kolwal ol kak' ganar owal. Ha ach ol a tek'kanem heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayonh.
Ach in Diosal, il in koti. Tz'el waw yuj yaelal tzin ik'ani. Cha ab' in lesal.
Ato b'aj slajwik'och sti' lum lum tik tzin awaj t'ayach, tz'el yip in pixan swab'i. Ik' in k'e t'a yib'anh junok niwan k'een yik tzin kolchaji.
Ha ach ayachoch in kolnab'ilok. Icha junok kuartel aj t'ayin, tzin a kol t'a heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin.
In gana tzin kajnaj t'a a kajnub' t'a masanil tiempo. In gana tzin k'ub'ej in b'ha t'a yalanh a wach'k'olal, icha nok' yunetak kaxlanh t'a yalanh sk'axil snun.
Ach in Diosal, ab'nak tas in ti' wak'nak t'ayach, ix ak' in makb'en yet' heb' ay elk'och t'ay.
Najatokab' tzutej in k 'inal a in rey in tik. Niwanokab' ab'il swila'
yik swak'an yajalil t'a ichanh. Tanhwej in yet' a wach'k'olal, yujto tz'elnhejk'och tas tzala'.
Icha chi' ol ach in b'itej t'a masanil tiempo. Junjun k'u ol in k'anab'ajan b'aj wak'nak in ti' chi' t'ayach.
Anhejton d'ha Dios tz'ilchaj junk'olal wuuj. Ha t'ay skot in kolnab'il.
Anhej tzin kolaneli, a tz'ochpax wenhulok. Malaj b'ak'uinh ol in ak'jok ganar yujto ha' ayoch in kolnab'ilok.
¿B'aq'uinh ol eyaktej eyoch b'ulan t'ayin yik ol in he tek'ankanem eyalani? Ichato toxo wal tzin telwi icha junok pat k'haxo, ma icha junok makte' toxo tzek' leknajok.
Axonhej tas tz'aj yixtaxel in b'inajnaquil tze naub'tanhej. E q'uinalxonhej he naank'e es. Tze tz'ak eyal wach' lolonel t'ayin, palta haxo t'a he pensar, tzin he katab'ej.
Anhej d'ha Dios tz'ilchaj junk'olal wuuj. Anhej ayoch yipok in k'ool.
Anhej tzin kolaneli, tz'ochpax wenhulok. Manh ol in telwoklaj. A' ayoch in kolnab'ilok.
Ha d'ha Dios skot in kolnab'il, yuj chi' ay welk'ochi. A' ayoch wenhulok yet' in kolnab'ilok.
Ex wetchonhab', anhej Dios tzeyak'och yipok he k'ool. D'a smasanil he k'ool, tzex lesalwi t'ay, yujto a ko kolnab'il yaji.

Ha heb' anima, junelnhej malaj jab'ok yelk'och heb', wach'chom meb'a' heb', ma b'eyum heb'. Q'uinalok tz'echtaj yalil heb' t'a junok echlab' smasanil, toton max cheklajlaj jab'ok yalil heb' chi', yuj chi' manh kaq'ek ochlaj ko pensar t'a heb'.
Manh eyak'och ixtoj anima, ma elk'al yipok he k'ool. Tato tzex och b'eyumal, manh eyak'och he b'eyumal chi' yipok he k'ool.

Manh jantakok wab'an yalchaji to ha Dios aljinakkan icha tik: Ha in Dios Yajal in tik, masanil syal wuuj, aynhej pax in wach'k'olal. Tzin paktzitej t'a junjun anima icha syal tas tz'el sk'ulani, xchi Dios.
Ach in Diosal, toxonton in Diosal ach. Tzach in nib'ej t'a smasanil in k'ool, tzach snib'ej in pixan icha tz'aj snib'an nhab' lum lum taquinh.
In gana tzach wiloch t'a a templo, ol cham wal in k'ool wilan a poder yet' a tziquiquial.
Te niwan yelk'och a wach'k'olal t'a yichanh b'aj pitzan in t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik. Yuj chi', ol ach in b'itej.
Yakb'an pitzan in, ol wal wach' lolonel t'ayach. Ol in mojb'ejk'e in k'ab' t'ayach t'a in lesal.
Wach'xonhej ol ajkan in k'ool uuj, icha junok mach syak' wal snib'ej yet' junok wael te wach'. Yed' in tzalajk'olal ol ach in b'itej.
Ha t'ak'walil ayik jichan inxo eq'ui, tzach in naub'tanhani, aynhejoch in pensar t'ayach.
Ha ach ton tzach kolwaj wed'ok, yuj chi' malaj tas tzin na' icha nok' yunetak kaxlanh t'a yalanh sk'axil snun.
Junnhej waj ed'ok sik'lab'il. Max in aktejel-laj yet' a wach' k'ab'.
Ha heb' snib'ej in smilanchamok, ol b'atkan heb' t'a yol sjulal b'aj smukchaj heb' chamnak.
Ol miljokcham heb' t'a k'een espada, haxo nok' oques ol chianb'at heb'.
Ha inxo pax rey in tik jun, ol wak' tzalajb'ok in k'ool ed'ok ach in Diosal. Masanil heb' tzach ak'an b'inaj b'aj syak' sti', ol tzalaj heb'. Axo pax heb' tz'esan jun, ol queekaxkan heb' uuj.
Ach in Diosal, tik wal swal in b'a t'ayach, ab' in lesal. k'ub'ejel in k 'inal t'a heb' ajk'ol yajoch t'ayin.
k'ub'ejinel t'a heb' sk'ulan chukal. Colinel t'a heb' snaan yak' chukal t'ayin t'a elk'altak.
Ste k'asanb'i sti' heb', icha snhikchajoch ye junok k'een espada. Ha tas syal heb' t'ayin te ya, lajan icha junok jul-lab'.
D'a k'ub'eltaquil sjulwajb'at heb' t'a heb' malaj smul. Max xiwlaj heb' sjulwajb'ati ayik manh naanok.
Munil syiptzitej sb'a heb' sk'ulan chukal. Snanonek' sk'ol heb' yak'anem yaal t'a elk'altak. Malaj mach tz'ilan heb' yalani.
Scham wal snaan heb' tas syutej sb'oan chukal. Wach'xonhej syutej heb' yak'an spensaril. Ha tas sna heb' chi', k'ub'eltak yaj t'a spensar heb'.
Ha Dios ol ak'an echnaj heb' yet' sjul-lab'. Satk'olal yaj heb' ol satjoquel heb'.
Ha tas syal heb' chi' ol ak'an telwok. Masanil heb' ol ilan heb', ol ib'xok heb' yuj xiwelal.
Ichato chi', masanil heb' anima, ol xiw heb' d'ha Dios. Masanil tas b'ob'il yuj Dios chi' ol yalel heb'. Masanil tastak sk'ulejnak Dios chi', ol snaub'tanhej heb'.
Ha heb' anima wach' sb'eyb'al, ol tzalaj heb' yet' Jehová, ol sayan pax kolwal heb' t'ay. Masanil heb' anima wach', junk'olalxonhej ol aj heb'.
Ach ko Diosal, smoj wal yalji wach' lolonel t'ayach t'a Sion. Ha moj wal skak'elk'och tas skaltej t'ayach.
Masanil heb' anima sja t'ayach yujto tzab'nhej slesal heb'.
Ha jantak ko chukal tz'ak'an yajalil t'a quib'anh, palta a achxo tza suk sat ko mul chi'.
Te wach' quiko', yujto a ach ix onh a sik'kaneli yik wach' ayonhek' t'a a templo. Wach' kaj yuj swach'il tas ay t'a a kajnub', aton a templo te niwan yelk'ochi.

Ach Dios ko Kolumal, tza paktzitej ko lesal yet' tas satub'tak tza k'ulej t'a stojolal. Masanil anima kajan t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, aton heb' kajan t'a tik yet' heb' kajan t'a sk'axepal ha' mar, ol ach yak'och heb' yipok sk'ool.
Te tzatz ix utejkan juntzanh lum niwak witz yuj a poder yet' ipalil.
Ha ach tzak' numk'aj sat ha' mar. Ayic sk'e somnaj juntzanh niwak chonhab', a ach tzak' pax numk'ajok.
Ha heb' kajan t'a juntzanh najatil lu'um, tz'ib'xik'e heb' t'a yichanh tas satub'tak tza k'ulej. Uuj wal ay tzalajk'olal b'aj sjawi k'u, masanto b'aj tz'em k'u.
Ayachnhejoch ilan lum lum, tzak' snhab'il lu'um, tzak'anpax q'uib' tas tz'awchaj t'a lu'um. Tzak' q'uib' ixim trigo yuj ha ha' tz'el yok. Ichaton wal chi', tzutej a b'oan lum lum tik.
Ha ach tzak' yaxb'ok sat lu'um, tzak' ch'ayxok sch'olquiltaquil lu'um, tzak'an k'unb'ok lum yuj yax nhab', tzak'an pax a wach'k'olal yik satan tas tz'awchaj t'a sat lu'um.
Manh jantakok sat awb'en syak' t'a junjun ab'il yuj nhab' tzak'koti.
Syaxb'i anh ank'ultak t'a tzinan lu'um b'aj swa nok' kalnel. Axo tzalquixtak wach' tz'aj yilji yuj awb'en.
Sb'ud'jiel tzalquixtak yuj nok' kalnel. Axo opquixtak, sb'ud'jikanel yuj ixim trigo. Yuj chi' sb'itan heb' anima smasanil, tz'el yaw heb' yuj tzalajk'olal.
E masanil ex kajan ex t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, b'itananhek d'ha Dios t'a tzalajk'olal.
B'itejek sb'inajnaquil. B'itananhek t'ay yet' juntzanh b'it manhxo jantakok swach'il.
Alec d'ha Dios icha tik: Mamin a tas tza b'o'o, te satub'tak. Ha wal t'a ichanh stelwikan heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach, yujto te niwan a poder.
Masanil heb' anima t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik syak'em sb'a t'ayach, tzach sb'itan heb', xe chi t'ay.
Cotanhec, ilek wal tas sb'onak Dios. Satub'tak tas sk'ulej yuj ko wach'ilok a onh anima onh tik.
Taquinh lu'um ajnak ha' mar yet' ha' niwak ha' yuj, haxo ta' ek'nakkot heb' ko mam quicham. Tzalajokab' ko k'ool d'ha Dios.
Ha yet' spoder syak' yajalil t'a masanil tiempo. Aynhejoch sat t'a junjun nakión, yik wach' max och heb' syik'chaanh sb'a ajk'olal t'ay.
Ex junjun nakión, alek wach' lolonel t'a ko Diosal. Ab'chajokab' he b'itan t'ay t'a wach' lolonelal.
Yujto ha' tz'ak'an ko k 'inal, max onh schalaj telwok.
Ach Dios, tik wal ix il ko pensar. Icha wal sakb'itaj k'een plata, icha wal chi' ix aj onh a sakb'itani.
Ix onh ak'kan t'a te' yaal. Yelxo wal te al ikatz ix ak' ko kuchu'.
Ha heb' komon anima ix ak'lab'ej onh stek'ani. Ix onh ak' ek' t'a skal te' k'ak' yet' t'a yol ha' niwak ha'. Ixlajwi chi' ix onh ik'anb'at b'aj junk'olal tzonh aji.
Ol in och t'a yol a templo yuj wak'an in silab' t'ayach. Ichato wal chi' ol wak'anelk'och in ti' wak'nak t'ayach,
aton tas walnak ayik ay in och t'a ilk'olal.
Ha nok' nok' b'ak'uech ol in nhustz'ha t'a altar. Ol wak' nok' wakax, nok' mam chiwa yet' pax nok' ch'ak kalnel in silab'ok t'ayach, aton tik scha a k'ool.
Cotanhec he masanil, mach ex ay yelk'och Dios t'a he sat. Maclejec eyab' t'ayin, ol wal t'ayex jantak swach'k'olal t'ayin.
Ix in k'an skolwal wed'ok, ix walan wach' lolonel t'ay.
Q'uinalok tato a chukal ix in nib'ej in k'ulej, maj am schalaj yab' Dios Yajal t'a Smasanil tas ix in k'an t'ay.
Palta ix yab'i tas ix in k'an chi' t'ay, ix sk'anab'ajej in lesal.
Alchajokab' wach' lolonel d'ha Dios, yujto max spatiquejel in lesal, manh puraloklaj ix yak' swach'k'olal t'ayin.
Ach ko Diosal, ak' a wach'k'olal t'ayonh. Ok'ok wal a k'ool t'ayonh, ach tzalajokab' qued'ok
yik syojtaquejel masanil nakión t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik tas snib'ej a k'ool yet' kolnab'il tzak'a'.
Ach Dios, b'itanokab' junjun chonhab' t'ayach. Masanilokab' chonhab' sb'itan t'ayach.
Awajokab' junjun nakión t'a tzalajk'olal, yujto tza ch'olb'itej yaj junjun chonhab' t'a stojolal. Ha ach ton tza kuchb'ej junjun nakión t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik.
Ach Dios, b'itanokab' junjun chonhab' t'ayach. Masanilokab' chonhab' sb'itan t'ayach.
Axo lum lum, ol yak' sat awb'en t'a lu'um, ol yak' swach'k'olal Dios t'ayonh.
Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Dios t'ayonh. Niwanokab' yelk'och Dios t'a masanil yol yib'anhk’inal tik.
Ayic syak'an owal Dios, sakleminak tz'aj yel heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ay. Ha heb' schichonoch sk'ol t'ay, tz'el lemnaj heb' t'a yichanh.
Icha wal tz'aj satem te' tab' t'a skal ik', icha chi' tz'aj satem heb'. Icha wal yulaxb'at nok' chaq'uib' t'a skal te' k'ak', icha chi' tz'aj satel heb' sk'ulan chukal t'a yichanh Dios.
Axo heb' wach' sb'eyb'al jun, ste tzalaj sk'ol heb' t'a yichanh Dios. Sk'e wal chennaj heb' yuj tzalajk'olal.
Conh b'itanek d'ha Dios yuj sniwanil yelk'ochi. Calec wach' lolonel t'a Jehová, aton tzek' t'a yib'anh asun. Conh tzalajek t'a Jehová, konh tzalajek t'a yichanh.
Ha Dios, kajanek' t'a skajnub', aton b'aj tz'och ejmelal t'ay. Mamab'il yaj t'a heb' manhxalaj smam, Scolumal yaj pax t'a heb' ix ix chamnakxo yetb'eyum.

Ha heb' meb'a', ha Dios tz'ak'an b'aj skajnaj heb'. Ha heb' ayoch t'a preso, tz'el heb' t'a libre yuj, slajwi chi' tz'ik'jichaanh heb'. Axo heb' pit syutej sb'a t'ay, ha t'a tzinan lum ol kajnaj heb'.
Ach ko Diosal, ayik ix ach b'ey t'a yichanh a chonhab' t'a tzinan lu'um,
ix ib'xik'e lum lum, ix kot yaxnhab' t'a satcha’anh, ix ib'xik'e tzalan Sinaí t'a ichanh. Ha onh israel onh tik, ko Diosal ach.
Ach ko Diosal, manh jantakok nhab' ix ak'koti yik syaxb'ixi sat lum a makb'en takjinak sat.
Ach ko Diosal, aton ta' ix aj heb' a chonhab'. Yuj a wach'k'olal, ix ak' swael heb' meb'a'.
Ach Cajalil, ayik alannak to toxo ix ak'ji ganar heb' ajk'ool, manhxo jantakok heb' ix ix, ix alaneli.
Vanxo yel lemnaj heb' winh rey yet' heb' winh soldado. Ha tas ix tok'jiek' t'a heb' ajk'ool, ix pukchajek' t'a heb' ix ix t'a kaltak pat,
aton juntzanh yechel nok' uch uk'nak sk'axil t'a k'een plata yet' t'a k'een oro. ¿Tas yuj ix ex kan jaywanh ex tik t'a skal nok' kalnel yik max ex b'at t'a owal?
Ayic ix el lemnaj heb' winh rey yuj Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil, ix kot k'een sakb'akom t'a yib'anh lum witzal Salmón.
Yelxo wal te chaanh steel lum witzal Basán. Manh jantakok yunetak witz t'a sjolomtak lu'um.
Mach ex kajan ex t'a jolomtak witz chi', ¿tas yuj yet' he chichonk'olal tzeyilkot jun witz sik'b'ilel yuj Jehová Dios yik tz'och yikok? Ata' ol kajnaj Dios chi' t'a junelnhej.
Ha Dios, manh b'ischajb'enok skarruaje yik owal. Ha t'a Sinaí ix kot yet' skarruaje chi', ix jawi t'a skajnub'.

Ach Dios, ix ach k'ekan t'a satcha’anh, ix ik'anb'at heb' ix yamchaj uuj. Ix a chaan silab' t'a heb' anima, ajun pax heb' pit syutej sb'a t'ayach ix yak' yiko'. Ach Jehová ko Diosal, ix ach k'ek'och kajan ta'.
Calec wach' lolonel t'a Kajal ko Diosal, aton ko Kolumal. Ha tzonh tanhwan t'a junjun k'u.
Ha ko Diosal, Colwajum toni. Ha Jehová Cajalil tzonh skolel t'a chamel.
Ha Dios ol mak'anpoj sjolom heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ay, aton sjolom heb' anheja' sk'ulan chukal.
Ha Dios Kajal tz'alan t'ayonh: Ha heb' ajk'ol t'ayex ay t'a jolom witz Basán, ol wik'xikot heb' t'ayex. Ol wik'anpaxkot heb' ay t'a sjulal yich ha' mar,
yik wach' ol he b'onh eyok t'a schiq'uil heb', ol slek'anpaxk'e nok' he tz'i', xchi.
Ach Dios, ko Diosal ach, masanil anima tz'ilan a k'och t'a a kajnub'. Ach ko Reyal, b'ab'el ach yuj anima wan sb'at nhililok yik tzach yik'anchaanh heb'.
B'ab'el heb' sb'itani, haxo heb' ak'um son, tzak'an heb'. Axo t'a spatiktak heb' ayoch heb' ix kob'estak tz'ak'an k'anh pandereta.
Calec wach' lolonel d'ha Dios Kajal. Ex wetisraelal, kalek wach' lolonel t'ay b'aj molanonhek' tik.
B'ab'el sb'at heb' yinhtilal winhaj Benjamín, winh tzak'an unin. Tzak'an heb' yajal yik Judá, heb' yajal yik Zabulón yet' heb' yik Neftalí.
Ach ko Diosal, icha ajnak a ch'oxanel a poder t'a yalanhtaxo, icha chi' tzutej a ch'oxanpaxel t'ayonh tiknaik,
yuj swach'ilok a templo t'a Jerusalén, aton b'aj sjawi heb' winh rey yak' silab' t'ayach.

Cachoch waan heb' anima icha nok' owal nok' ay t'a skaltak te' aj. Cachoch waan jun nhilanh owal wakax yet' nok' yune', aton juntzanh niwak chonhab' stek'b'ej sb'ha t'a owal, yujto anhej b'eyumal snib'ej heb'. Pech saklem heb' niwak chonhab' to snib'ej syak' owal.
Ol kot heb' aj Egipto stup alkabar t'ayach. Ol smojb'ejk'e sk'ab' heb' aj Etiopía t'ayach ach ko Diosal.
Ex yajal t'a juntzanh chonhab', b'itananhek d'ha Dios. B'itej b'it t'a Cajalil,
aton sb'eyek' t'a satcha’anh, aton satcha’anh aytaxon ek' t'a yichb’anel. Ab'ek yel yaw, aton yaw te ay spoder.
Scham wal eyalanel spoder Dios. Ha a ayoch ko Reyaloc a onh israel onh tik. Ha spoder sk'ek'och t'a satcha’anh.
Ach ko Diosal, te satub'tak ilji t'a a kajnub'. Tzak' a poder t'ayonh a onh israel a chonhab' onh tik. Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'ayach ach ko Diosal.
Ach in Diosal, kolineli yujto ichato wan in b'atkan t'a yich ha ha'.
Van in b'atkan t'a yich jun te sitz'atak te jul yich swab'i, manhxa b'aj tz'emk'och tek'tek' wok. Ichato toxo ix in emk'och t'a sjulal yich ha', wanxo in skuchanb'at ha'.
Toxo ix te tzap in jaj wawaji, ix te k'e syail. Toxo ix k'e syail yol in sat yuj in maklan wil a jawi ach in Diosal.

Ix ek'b'at sb'isul heb' tzin chakanel t'a xil in jolom, wach'chom malaj in mul t'a heb'. Toxo ix te k'echaanh sb'isul heb' snib'ej in smilanchamok. Snib'ej heb' swak' meltzaj tastak to manh welk'alok.
Ach in Diosal, ojtak wal in pital. Max yal-laj in k'ub'anel juntzanh in mul chi' t'ayach.

Mamin Jehová, Yajal ach t'a smasanil, a heb' tzach ak'anoch yipok sk'ool, mokab' q'uixwok heb' yuj in mul. Ach ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, a heb' syak'em sb'a t'ayach t'a smasanil sk'ool, mokab' takkank'e sk'ol heb' yuj in chukal.
Uuj wal, ix techaj yek' juntzanh jixjon lolonel wuuj. Maxtzac yal-laj in k'ol tzin ch'ox in sat yuj q'uixwelal.
Ichato manh in ojtakab'ilok yuj heb' wuk'tak, a na to junnhej in nun yet' heb'.
Te pitz'anoch in k'ool in ya'ilan a kajnub'. Ayic sb'uchwaj heb' t'ayach, a in jun swab' pax syail.
Ayic tzin oq'ui, tzin och t'a tzek'ojk'olal, sb'uchwaj heb' t'ayin.
Tato a pichul yik tzin ch'oxanel in kusk'olal swak'ochi, sk'e umnaj heb' in stzetzani.
Ha innhej tzin yal heb' tz'em k'ojan t'a spuertail chonhab'. Ha heb' uk'um anh, tzin yak' b'inaj heb' t'a sb'it.
Ha inxo pax Mamin Jehová, a t'ayach tzin awaji. Ach in Diosal, ochanh wed' tiknaik. Yuj a niwan wach'k'olal, tak'wanh t'ayin. Yujto tzach kolwajnhej wed'ok, yuj chi' ochanh wed'ok.
Colinel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' tzin chakaneli. Ichato wan in b'at t'a skal lum sok'om, ma t'a skal ha ha' jul yich, yuj chi' manh in aktejb'ati.
Manh in a cha yik'b'at ha ha'. Manh in a cha b'atkan t'a sjulal yich ha', in sattakanemlaj ta'.
Mamin Jehová, tak'wanh t'ayin. Wach' ach a ach tik, aynhej a wach'k'olal. Cotanh k'elan t'ayin yet' a niwan ok'elk'olal.
Manh in a patiquejel a in a chekab' in tik, tak'wanh t'ayin t'a elanhchamel yujto ay smay b'aj ay in ek' tik.
Colineli, nitzkot a b'ha t'a in tz'ey. Colinel t'a heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin.
Tik wal ojtak heb' tz'alan lolonel ya t'ayin. Ix in ixtaxel yuj heb', q'uixawk'olal waji, manhxo in animaok t'a sat heb'. Ojtac wal mach heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin.
Ix ixtaxb'at in pensar yuj b'uchwal lolonel. Manhxo animaok waji, manhxalaj wip swab'i. Nab'anhej ix in say mach tz'ak'an sniwanil in k'ool yet' mach tz'ok' sk'ool t'ayin.
Ix yak'b'at weneno heb' t'a skal in wael. Ayic ix takji in ti', a winagre ix yak' heb' wuk'ej.
Ochokab' jun sq'uinh heb' chi' syaalilok. Telwokab' heb' yuj jun sq'uinh chi'.
Mocxob' yal-laj yilan heb' uuj. Luclonokab' xub' heb' yuj manh ipal t'a masanil tiempo.
Ak'kot yowal a k'ol t'a yib'anh heb'. Yamchajokab' heb' yuj a k'ak'alk'olal.
Canokab' tzinan b'aj kajan heb'. Manhxaokab' mach ol kajnaj t'ay.
Yujto tzin spech b'eyek' heb' a in tzin ak' kus tik. Sb'uchwajpax heb' t'ayin a in tzin ak' echnaj tik.
Tz'akan tzutej ak'ankot yaelal t'a yib'anh heb' icha smojal yuj chukal sk'ulej heb'. Manhxaokab' yalan yik heb' t'a kolnab'il tzak'a'.
Sucsat sb'i heb' t'a yol ch'anh libro yik k 'inal. Manh ak'kanem sb'i heb' t'a yol ch'anh libro yik heb' tojol sb'eyb'al t'a ichanh.
