Ha schiq'uil heb' unin malaj smul ix yik'el heb', aton schiq'uil heb' yuninal heb' yet' heb' yisil heb', haxo t'a sdiosal heb' aj Canaán ix yak' heb' silab'il. Axo lum lum, ix ixtaxb'at lu'um yuj schamel heb' chi'.
Ix ixtaxb'at heb' yuj chukal ix sk'ulej chi', ix och heb' ajmulal t'a yol sat Jehová.
Ix tzaktzaj Jehová, ix kot yowal t'a heb' schonhab',
yuj chi' ix aktajkan heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, ix kan heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ool chi'.
Ix ixtaj heb' yuj heb' ajk'ool chi', ix kan heb' t'a yalanh smandar heb'.
Tzijtum el ix kolchajel heb' yuj Dios, palta ix och heb' ajk'olal t'a tas nab'il yuj Dios chi'. Yuj chi' ix te juwib'at heb' ste k'ulan chukal chi'.
Palta ayik ix yilan syaelal heb' chi' Jehová, ix yab'anpax stewi heb' t'ay,
ix snakot strato yet' heb', ix sk'exan spensar chi' t'a heb', yujto yel te niwan swach'k'olal.
A' ix ak'an sk'ulej heb' ajk'ool chi' yik wach' syutej spensar heb' t'a heb'.
Ach Mamin Jehová ko Diosal, kolonheli. Ik'onhelta t'a skal juntzanh nakión yik wach' skal wach' lolonel t'ayach, yik tzach ko b'itej t'a tzalajk'olal.
Calec wach' lolonel t'a Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik t'a masanil tiempo. Ujokab'i, xchiokab' masanil heb' chonhab'. Calec wach' lolonel t'a Jehová.
Calec wach' lolonel t'a Jehová yujto wach', yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
Ha onh kolb'il onh xo yuj, kalek to toxo ix onh kolchajel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' kajk'ool.
A' ix onh molb'ankot t'a juntzanh chonhab', b'aj sjawi k'u yet' b'aj tz'em k'u yet' t'a norte yet' t'a sur.
Ay mach sb'eyek' t'a tzinan lu'um b'aj malaj b'e, max ilchajlaj sb'eal junok chonhab' yuj heb' b'aj syal skajnaji.
Ay swejel heb', ay staquinhtial heb', toxo wal scham heb'.
Ha yuj syaelal heb' chi', ix yal sb'a heb' t'a Jehová, haxo ix kolanel heb'.
A' ix ik'anb'at heb' b'aj tojol sb'at sb'eal jun chonhab' b'aj syal skajnaj heb'.
Yak'okab' yuj diosal heb' t'a Jehová yuj swach'k'olal, yuj pax skolwal satub'tak t'ayonh a onh anima onh tik.
A' tz'ik'anek' staquinhtial mach stakji sti'. Tzijtum pax tas swaji syak' t'a mach ay swejel.
Ay mach kajanek' t'a skal k’ik’ k’inal b'aj ay smay chamel. Ichato ayoch heb' preso yuj skusk'olal, ichato ay paxoch k'een kadena t'a heb',
yujto max sk'anab'ajej slolonel Jehová heb'. Ix spatiquejkanel heb' tas nab'il yuj Dios Ek'to t'a yib'anh smasanil.
Ix ak'chajoch heb' t'a munlajel ya. Ix telwi heb', manhxalaj mach ix kolwaj t'a heb'.
Ha yuj syaelal heb' chi', ix yal sb'a heb' t'a Jehová, haxo ix kolanel heb' t'a syaelal chi'.
A' ix ilankot heb' t'a skal k’ik’ k’inal, ix yik'anel k'een kadena ayoch t'a heb'.
Yak'okab' yuj diosal heb' t'a Jehová yuj swach'k'olal, yuj pax skolwal satub'tak t'ayonh a onh anima onh tik.
Ha ix jekchitan k'een puerta bronke, ix sk'okchitan k'een yipumal spuertail chi'.
Ha heb' chuk spensar, ix laj och syaelal heb'. Ayoch heb' t'a ilk'olal yuj schukal.
Ix syajkanel swael heb'. Toxo wal scham heb' syutej yab'ani.
Ha yuj syaelal heb' chi', ix yal sb'a heb' t'a Jehová, haxo ix kolanel heb' t'a syaelal chi'.
A' ix alani, ix b'oxi sk'ool heb'. Ix kolchaj heb' yuj t'a yol sk'ab' chamel.
Yak'okab' yuj diosal heb' t'a Jehová yuj swach'k'olal, yuj pax skolwal satub'tak t'ayonh a onh anima onh tik.
Yak'okab' silab' heb' t'ay t'a ak'oj yuj diosal. Yalokab' heb' t'a tzalajk'olal tas ix sk'ulej Jehová.
Ay juntzanh heb' chonhwajum ix b'at t'a yib'anh ha' mar, ix ek' heb' yet' sbarko t'a yib'anh ha'.
Ata' ix yil heb' tas satub'tak ix sk'ulej Jehová.
Ha Jehová ix alani, ix te owaj ha', ix k'e chulnaj ha' t'a chaanh.
Ix ik'jichaanh heb', ix ik'jixiem heb' yuj ha', ix somchaj sk'ol heb' yuj smay ha'.
Ix te xiw heb', ix ek' quetkon heb' icha wal uk'um anh, manhxalaj ix aj yelk'och sjelanil heb'.
Ha yuj syaelal heb' chi' ix yal sb'a heb' t'a Jehová, haxo ix kolanel heb' t'a syaelal chi'.
A' ix ik'anel chakxuxum ik', ichato chi' ix och numnaj ha'.
Ix tzalaj heb' ayik ix yilan heb' snumk'aj ha'. Axo Dios ix ik'anb'at heb' t'a puerto b'aj d'inhan sk'och heb' chi'.
Yak'okab' yuj diosal heb' t'a Jehová yuj swach'k'olal, yuj pax skolwal satub'tak t'ayonh a onh anima onh tik.
Yik'okab' chaanh Jehová heb' b'aj smolb'ej sb'a heb' chonhab'. Yik'okab' chaanh Dios heb' b'aj smolb'ej sb'a heb' ichamtak winak.
Ha b'aj tzek' a niwak ha' yet' b'aj sk'eul sjaj ha', smeltzajoch taquinh lumal yuj Jehová.
A' sk'exan lum lum yax sat yik manhxalaj tas sq'uib' t'a lu'um. Yuj wal smul heb' anima kajanek' ta, yuj chi' icha chi' tz'aji.
Ha t'a lum taquinh lu'um, scheklaj ha' kotak nhajab' yuj Jehová. Sk'epaxul sjaj ha ha' t'a lum yuj.
Ata' syak' kajnaj heb' anima ay swejel, sb'oan niwak chonhab' heb' ta'.
Tz'awwi trigo heb' yet' uwa t'a sat sluum. Te niwan sat yawb'en heb' chi' syik'a'.
A' Jehová chi' tz'ak'an swach'k'olal t'a heb', yuj chi' sq'uib' sb'isul heb'. Max emta sb'isul nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.
Tato tz'emta sb'isul heb', emnaquilal, ilk'olal yet' yaelal sja t'a yib'anh heb' yuj heb' ajk'ool.
Palta a heb' niwak winak ajk'ool chi', a Jehová tz'ak'an satb'at heb' t'a tzinan lu'um b'aj manhxalaj b'e. Manhxalaj tz'ajkan yelk'och heb'.
Anheja' tz'ik'anel kusk'olal t'a heb' meb'a', syik'anchaanh sb'isul yuninal heb' icha wal sq'uib' sb'isul nok' kalnel.
Ayic syilan jun tik heb' anima wach' spensar, stzalaj sk'ol heb', haxo heb' anima chuk spensar jun, manhxalaj tas syal heb'.
Ha heb' jelan, snaokab' juntzanh tik heb'. Nachajokab'el swach'k'olal Jehová yuj heb'.
Ach in Diosal, te b'ekan in k'ool in b'itan t'ayach. D'a smasanil in k'ool ol in b'itej wach' lolonel t'ayach yujto niwan elk'ochi.
Ayic sakb'i k'inal tzin b'itan t'ayach yet' te' arpa yet' pax salterio.
Mamin Jehová, ol in b'itej wach' lolonel t'ayach t'a skal anima t'a juntzanhxo nakión.
Ha wal a wach'k'olal te niwan, tzek'b'at t'a yib'anh satcha’anh. Malaj b'ak'uinh max ak'elk'och tas tzala'.
Ach in Diosal, cheklajokab' a b'inajnaquil t'a satcha’anh. Checlajokab' a poder t'a masanil yol yib'anhk’inal tik.
Colonhel yet' a poder. Tak'wej onh yik wach' tzonh kolchaj a onh xajanab'il onh tik uuj.
Ix lolonkot Dios masanto t'a skajnub', ix yalan icha tik: Ol tzalaj in k'ool ayik ol in kotak pojanb'at lum Siquem yet' yak'likal lum Sucot.
Axo lum Galaad yet' lum Manasés wik yaj lu'um. Ha Efraín icha in k'een xumpil yaji. Axo Judá icha sk'okochal wopisio yaji.
Ha Moab, icha yet'tal b'aj tzin b'ik in b'a yaji. Ha t'a yib'anh Edom ol wak'kanb'at in xanhab'. D'a tzalajk'olal ol in awajok yujto ol kan heb' filisteo t'a yalanh wuuj, xchi Dios.
Ach in Diosal, ¿mach tzin ik'anb'at t'a jun chonhab' ayoch smuroal t'a spatik yichanh? ¿Mach tzin ik'anb'at t'a Edom?
Ach ko Diosal, ix onh a patiquejeli. Maxtzac yal-laj a k'ol tzach b'at yet' heb' ko soldado t'a owal.
Ochanh qued'ok, kolonhel t'a heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayonh. Ha skolwal heb' quetanimail t'ayonh, malaj yalani.
Ach ko Diosal, a yet' a kolwal ol kak' ganar owal. A' ach ol a tek'kanem heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayonh.
Ach in Diosal, swal wach' lolonel t'ayach, manh ach b'at mikan t'a in lesal.
Yujto a heb' sk'ulan chukal yet' heb' tz'ak'an musansatil anima, chuk syal heb' t'a in patik. Esnhej tas syal heb' chi' t'a in patik.
Ha schichonk'olal heb' ste oymaj t'a in patik. Tz'och chi'an sk'ol heb' t'ayin, palta malaj in mul t'a heb'.
Ha spak in wach'k'olal t'a heb', to tz'och heb' ajk'olal t'ayin. Ha inxo jun, wan in lesalwi yuj heb'.
Ha in wach' pensaril t'a heb', chuk syutej heb' spaktzitan t'ayin. Axo spak in wach'k'olal t'a heb', to schichon sk'ol heb' t'ayin.
Ha junok winh chuk spensar tzak'och juezal t'a yib'anh winh. Aokab' junok yajk'ool winh tz'ak'ankanb'at t'a yib'anh.
Ayic sch'olb'itaj winh, alchajokab'i to ay smul winh. Ochokab' pax slesal winh smulok.
Tzapanokab' tzutej sk'inal winh. Ch'okokab' pax mach tz'ochkan t'a yopisio winh.
Mheb'a' uninokab' tz'ajkan heb' yuninal winh. Axo ix yetb'eyum winh, kanokab' ix t'a manh etb'eyumal.
Ek'okab' heb' yuninal winh sk'an wa sb'ha t'a titak pat. Pechchajokab'el heb' b'aj ek'nak spat.
Ik'chajokab' ek' masanil tastak ay t'a heb' yuj winh tz'ak'an tumin majanil. Ik'chajokab'b'at smunlajel winh yuj heb' ch'ok animail.
Malajokab' mach tz'ok' sk'ool t'a winh. Malajokab' pax mach tz'ok' sk'ol t'a heb' yuninal winh mheb'haxo.
Satokab'el yinhtilal winh, satokab'el sb'i winh t'a junelnhej.
Mamin Jehová, nakot smul heb' smam yicham winh. Mokab' a suk sat smul snun winh.
Naanokab' smul heb' uuj. Mocxob' nachajkot heb' t'a sat lu'um tik.
Yujto manh naanok yak'an wach'k'olal winh. Palta to ix och winh ajk'olal t'a heb' meb'a', t'a heb' anima emnaquil yeq'ui yet' t'a heb' ayoch t'a ilk'olal, masanto smilcham heb' winh.
Skatab'ej anima winh, kotokab' katab' t'a yib'anh winh. Malajokab' b'ak'uinh scha wach'k'olal winh yujto maj yak'laj swach'k'olal winh t'a heb' anima chi'.
Axonhej katab' syal winh, ichato a katab' chi' spichul winh yaji. Ha katab' chi', icha ha' siquil ha' skuk'ej, ma icha akeite sko suquek' t'ayonh, icha chi' yaj t'a winh.
Cotokab' yaelal t'a yib'anh sniwanil winh yuj skatab'an heb' anima chi', icha smuschaj ko niwanil yet' ko pichul. Ochokab'kan sut'an yaelal chi' t'a winh t'a masanil tiempo icha junok tzek'ul.
Mamin Jehová, ichaokab' tik tzutej heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, aton heb' tz'alan in pekal.
Ha achxo pax ach Jehová Vajalil, ak'kot a wach'k'olal t'a wib'anh yik ol ach ik'jokchaanh. Yuj a wach'k'olal t'ayin, kolineli.
Te meb'a' in, manhxo animaok wed'nak swutej wab'ani, icha wal to lajwinak in swab'i.
Van in satel icha junok enhul. Van wik'jib'at yuj ik' ichok nok' k'ulub'.
Van yib'xi sjolom in penek, manhxalaj wip yujto maxtzak in walaj. Van in b'akb'i.
Tzheb'ajtak wilji t'a heb' anima. Ayic tzin yilan heb', sb'uchwaj heb' t'ayin.
Mamin Jehová, ochanh wed'ok. Ach in Diosal, kolinel yuj a wach'k'olal.
Mamin Jehová, yojtaquejokab'el heb' anima to a ach ix in utej icha tik.
Malaj yelk'och in skatab'an heb' tato a ach tzak'kot a wach'k'olal t'ayin. Q'uixwokab' heb' yakb'an wan stzalaj in k'ol a in a chekab' in tik.
Ha heb' tz'alan in pekal, chamokab' heb' yuj q'uixwelal. Toxonhejokab' sat sk'ol heb' yuj q'uixwelal.
Mamin Jehová, ol wak' yuj diosal t'ayach t'a masanil tiempo. D'a skal tzijtumal anima ol wal wach' lolonel t'ayach ach in Diosal,
yujto Yalumal heb' meb'a' aji. Ha ach tza kolel heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' snib'ej yak'anoch chamel t'a yib'anh heb'.
Ha Jehová ix alan t'a Vajalil: Emanh k'ojan t'a in wach' k'ab' tik, masanto ol wak'kanoch heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach t'a yalanh ok, xchi Jehová.
Mamin Rey, a Jehová ol ak'an opisio yik tzak' yajalil t'a Sion masanto t'a slajwub' lum lum. Ol ak' yajalil t'a yib'anh heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach.

Ayic ol ak'an owal yet' heb' ajk'ool, ol ja heb' a chonhab', ol yak'anoch sb'a heb' t'a owal chi' ed'ok. Icha yal ak'wal t'a q'uinhib'alil, icha chi' ol aj sja heb' winh kelemtak t'a jun tzalan to iknhej yaji.
Yak'nak pax kan sti' Jehová, malaj b'ak'uinh ol sk'exa', yalnak t'ayach icha tik: Sacerdote ach t'a masanil tiempo, icha yopisio winhaj Melquisedec, xchi.
Mamin Jehová, ayek' winh Rey t'a a wach' k'ab'. Ha t'a jun k'ual ol te kot yowal winh, ol satjoquel heb' rey yuj winh.
Ha winh ol ak'an syaelal juntzanh niwak nakión, ol cham anima, b'alb'umb'a ol aj heb' chamnak yuj winh. Ol satjoquel heb' yajal t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik yuj winh.
Ha t'a yol b'e ol yuk'a' winh Rey t'a jun ha ha' sb'eyi, yuj chi' ol och yip winh.
Calec wach' lolonel t'a Jehová. D'a wal smasanil in k'ool ol wal wach' lolonel t'a Jehová, b'aj molanek' heb' anima wach' sb'eyb'al.
Yelxo wal te satub'tak tas sk'ulejnak Jehová. Ha mach xajanan tas sk'ulejnak chi', snaub'tanhej heb' t'a yib'anh.
Te niwan yelk'och tas sk'ulejnak Jehová chi', te wach' pax yilji. Ha swach'k'olal aynhejek' t'a masanil tiempo.
Malaj b'ak'uinh ol b'atkan satk'olal tas satub'tak sk'ulejnak. Ha Jehová chi' te niwan swach'k'olal, te ay pax yok'elk'olal.
Syak' tas swaji t'a heb' ay xiwk'olal t'ay. Naannhej strato yuj.
Ha juntzanh tas te satub'tak ix sk'ulej swach'ilok heb' schonhab'. Ix yak' lum sluum heb' ch'ok chonhab'il yiquej heb'.
Tz'elnhejk'och tas syala', tojol toni. Masanil juntzanh scheknab'il, yelnhej syala'.
Malaj b'ak'uinh sk'exwi. Te tojol yaji, yelnhej pax syala'.
Ha Jehová te niwan yelk'ochi, Axonhej Ochi, ix skolel schonhab', malaj b'ak'uinh ol sk'ex strato ix yak'kani.
Tato sko nib'ej jelan tzonh aji, ayokab' yelk'och Jehová t'a ko sat. Ha heb' sb'eyb'alan scheknab'il, te aj pensar heb'. Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová t'a masanil k 'inal.
Aljokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová. Te wach' yik junok mach ay xiwk'olal t'a Jehová, t'a smasanil sk'ol sk'anab'ajej scheknab'il.
Ha yinhtilal jun anima wach' chi', wach' yik heb' yuj Dios, tz'ak'ji yopisio heb' t'a sat lu'um tik.
Manh jantakok sb'eyumal t'a yol spat, haxo stojolal, aynhejek' t'a masanil tiempo.
Icha wal sakil k'inal t'a skal k’ik’ k’inal, icha chi' yaj Dios t'a heb' anima wach' spensar, yujto ay yok'elk'olal heb', ay swach'k'olal heb', tojol pax sb'eyb'al heb'.
Ha junok anima wach' spensar, elb'ennhej tas yuj. Masanil tas sb'o t'a smunlajel, tojolnhej syutej.
Yuj chi', malaj b'ak'uinh ol kan t'a yalanh. Ha anima wach' chi', ol nachajnhejkot t'a masanil tiempo.
Malaj sxiwk'olal t'a junok ab'ix ay smay. Te tek'an syutej yak'anoch Jehová yipok sk'ool.
Max xiwlaj jab'ok, tonhej stzewaj t'a heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ay.
Max syaejlaj tastak b'aj skolwaj t'a heb' meb'a'. Ha swach'k'olal chi' aynhej t'a masanil tiempo, te niwan tz'aj sb'inaj yuj swach'il chi'.

Ha heb' chuk spensar, skot yowal heb' ayik syilan heb' yik'jichaanh heb' anima wach' spensar chi'. Sk'ux wal ye heb' skot yowal, ol lajwokkanel heb'. Ha tas snib'ej heb' anima chuk chi', manh ol elk'ochlaj.
Calec wach' lolonel t'a Jehová. Ha onh schekab' onh Jehová, kalek wach' lolonel t'ay.
Aljokab' wach' lolonel t'ay tiknaik yet' t'a masanil k 'inal.
B'itajokab' b'aj sjawi k'u masanto b'aj tz'em k'u.
Ha Jehová Yajal yaj t'a yib'anh juntzanh niwak chonhab'. Ha stziquiquial tzek'b'at t'a schaanhil satcha’anh.
