Ek'al in jelanil t'a yichanh masanil heb' in k'ayb'umal, yujto naannhej a k'ayb'ub'al wuuj.
Yelxo wal snachajel wuuj t'a yichanh heb' ichamtak winak, yujto tzin k'anab'ajej a cheknab'il.
Max yal-laj in k'ol swak'och in b'ha t'a chuk b'eyb'al, yik wach' tzin k'anab'ajejnhej a lolonel.
Maj wik'el-laj in b'ha t'a a k'ayb'ub'al, yujto wan in a k'ayb'ani.
Ek'b'al schi'al a lolonel t'a yichanh schi'al nok' yal chab' swab'i.
Te ay in jelanil ix wik'elta t'a a cheknab'il, yuj chi' tzin chaquel masanil chuk b'eyb'al. NUN
Ha a lolonel sch'oxan wach' b'eyb'al t'ayin ichato a tz'ak'an sakil k'inal t'a yol in b'e, ha' sch'oxan b'e t'ayin.
Ach in Diosal, ix wak' in ti' t'ayach, yuj chi' yowalil ol in k'anab'ajej. Ol in k'ayb'ej in b'ha t'a a ley to te tojol.
Mamin Jehová, yelxo wal ste kus in k'ool swab'i. Ak' in k 'inal ichataxon alani.
Mamin, cha in wach' lolonel swal t'ayach t'a smasanil in k'ool, tzin a k'ayb'an pax t'a a k'ayb'ub'al.
Junjun k'u sjawi tas ay smay t'a wib'anh, palta max b'atkanlaj a k'ayb'ub'al satk'olal wuuj.
Ha heb' sk'ulan chukal, syak'em in yaalil heb', palta max b'atlaj a cheknab'il satk'olal wuuj.
Ha a lolonel ix al t'ayin, wiknhej yaj t'a masanil tiempo, yujto ha' tz'ak'an in tzalajk'olal.
Toxo ix wak' pensar to ol in k'anab'ajej a ley masanto t'a slajwub'. SAMEC
Tzin chaquel heb' anima chab' sat, palta tzin xajanej a k'ayb'ub'al.
Ha ach ton ay ach och wenhulok yet' in kolnab'ilok. Ha a lolonel ayoch yipok in k'ool.
Elanhec t'a in tz'ey a ex tze k'ulej chukal, yujto in gana tzin k'anab'ajej scheknab'il in Diosal.
Mamin, ak' wip, ichataxon yaj alankani, yik aynhej in k 'inal. Manh ak' lajwok tas ayoch yipok in k'ool.
Ochanh wed'ok, yik ol in kolchajok. Ichato chi' ol in k'anab'ajan a ley.
Ix a tek'kanem heb' syik'el sb'ha t'a a ley, yujto a sjelanil heb' malaj yelk'ochi.
Icha wal k'alem, icha chi' yaj heb' sk'ulan chukal t'a yol a sat, yuj chi' tzin xajanej a lolonel.
Ha in niwanil tik, tz'ib'xi yuj in xiwk'olal t'ayach, yujto te niwan yelk'och a ley t'ayin. 'AYIN
Ha wach'il yet' tojolal tzin b'eyb'alej. Manh in aktejkan t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin.
Ochanh wilumalok yuj in wach'ilok. Mokab' in yixtej heb' ak'umtak syutej sb'a.
Van yixtaxel yol in sat yuj in maklan a jawi yik tzul in a kolani. Van in tanhwan in ik'anel t'a libre ichataxon alankani.
Wach' tzutej a k'ol t'ayin a in a chekab' in tik, icha jantak a wach'k'olal. k'ayb'ej in t'a a ley.
Ak' in jelanil a in a chekab' in tik. In gana swojtaquejel a kachnab'il tzala'.
Mamin Jehová, stiempoalxo ak'an syaelal heb' sk'ulan chukal, yujto ix spitej sb'a heb' t'a a k'ayb'ub'al.
Ek'b'al tzin nib'ej a cheknab'il t'a yichanh k'een oro te wach',
yuj chi' tzin k'anab'ajejnhej a cheknab'il chi', haxo pax masanil chuk b'eyb'al, tzin chakkaneli. PE
Satub'tak a kachnab'il, yuj wal chi' tzin k'anab'ajej t'ay.
Ayic tz'alchajel tas syalelk'och a lolonel, icha wal sakil k'inal yaj t'ayonh. Sk'ayb'aj heb' anima emnaquil yuj.
Tzin te nib'ej wal a cheknab'il, icha wal snib'an ha ha' junok mach yuj taquinhtial.
Ilincoti, ok'ok wal a k'ol t'ayin icha wal tzutej a k'ol t'a heb' tzach xajanani.
Kuchb'ej in t'a a b'eyb'al, icha wal yalan a lolonel. Manh in a cha ak'jok ganar yuj chukal.
Colinel t'a heb' anima malaj yok'elk'olal. In gana tzin k'anab'ajej a cheknab'il.
Tzalajokab' a k'ool wuj a in a chekab' in tik, tzin a k'ayb'anpax t'a a ley.
Tzin te oq'ui, yujto malaj yelk'och a k'ayb'ub'al t'a heb' wetanimail. TZADE
Mamin Jehová, tojol ach toni, wach'nhej yelk'och a ley.
Masanil a kachnab'il, tojol toni, yuj chi' syal kak'anoch t'a ko k'ool.
Te taknak in k'ool yuj heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, yujto ix b'atkan a lolonel satk'olal yuj heb'.
Ha tas tzala' tz'elnhejk'ochi, yuj chi' tzin xajanej a in a chekab' in tik.
Emnaquil anima in, patikab'il in el yuj heb' wetanimail, palta max b'atkanlaj a cheknab'il satk'olal wuuj.
Ha a tojolal malaj b'ak'uinh slajwi. Ha a k'ayb'ub'al yelnhej syala'.
Manhxo animaok waj yuj kusk'olal yet' yaelal, haxo a cheknab'il tz'ak'an in tzalajk'olal.
Ha a kachnab'il tojolnhej toni. Ak' ja in pensar yik wach' aynhej in k 'inal. COF
Mamin Jehová, t'a wal smasanil in k'ool tzin awaj t'ayach, tak'wej in, yujto in gana tzin k'anab'ajej a ley.
Ha t'ayach swal in b'a. Ochanh wed'ok yik wach' ol in k'anab'ajej a kachnab'il tzala'.
Ayic manto sakb'ilaj tzin k'e waan, tzin k'anan a kolwal yujto swak'och a lolonel yipok in k'ool.
Pitzan in tzek' ak'wal, tzin naub'tanhan tas alb'ilkan uuj.
Mamin Jehová, ab' tas swala' icha jantak a wach'k'olal. Ak' in k 'inal icha wal stojolal a b'eyb'al.
Ha heb' snaan yak'an chukal t'ayin, ayek' heb' t'a in lak'anil, palta najat yajkan heb' t'a a k'ayb'ub'al.
Ha achxo pax Mamin, te lak'an ayach eq'ui, yelton wal syal masanil a cheknab'il.
Pecatax ix wojtaquejel yuj a kachnab'il tik, a ach ix ak'kan t'a junelnhej. REX
Mamin, ilinkot yet' in yaelal tik, tzin a kolani yujto max b'atkan a k'ayb'ub'al satk'olal wuuj.
Colinel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' tz'esanoch t'a wib'anh. Ak' in k 'inal ichataxon alani.
Ha heb' sk'ulan chukal, malaj yalan yik heb' t'a a kolwal, yujto max sk'anab'ajejlaj a cheknab'il heb'.
Mamin Jehová, te niwan tz'ok' a k'ool t'ayonh. Ak' in k 'inal icha wal a tojolal.
Manh jantakok heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin yet' heb' tzin ixtani, a inxo jun, max wik'el-laj in b'ha t'a a kachnab'il.
Tzin chaquel heb' tzek' yib'anh sk'ulan chukal, aton heb' max k'anab'ajan a lolonel.
Mamin Jehová, yelxo wal xajan a cheknab'il wuuj. Ak' in k 'inal icha wal jantak a wach'k'olal.
Ha a lolonel te yel. Tojolton masanil a k'ayb'ub'al, malaj b'ak'uinh ol lajwoquelok. SIN
Wach'chom malaj in mul, tzin spech b'eyek' heb' anima niwan yopisio, palta te niwan yelk'och a lolonel t'ayin.
Stzalaj in k'ool yuj tas alnakkani, icha junok mach te niwan sb'eyumal syik'a'.
Max yal-laj in k'ool naojk'e lolonel, ste takkanel in k'ool yuj, palta tzin xajanej a k'ayb'ub'al.
D'a junjun rato swalan wach' lolonel t'ayach, yujto tojol ton a ley.
Ha heb' xajanan a k'ayb'ub'al, junk'olalnhej yaj heb', malaj tas tz'ak'an telwok heb'.
Mamin Jehová, wan in tanhwan in a kolani, yujto wan in k'anab'ajan a cheknab'il.
Van in k'anab'ajan a kachnab'il te xajan wuuj.
Van in k'anab'ajan a cheknab'il yet' a kachnab'il. Ojtac masanil in b'eyb'al. TAV
Mamin Jehová, k'eokab'k'och waw t'a ichanh, ak' ja in pensar ichataxon yalan a lolonel.
Axo in lesal jun, k'eokab'k'och t'a ichanh, kolineli, ichataxon yaj alankani.
Swal wach' lolonel t'ayach, yujto tzin a k'ayb'ej t'a a b'eyb'al.
Ol in b'itej junok b'it yuj tas alnakkani, yujto masanil a cheknab'il tojol yaji.
Aynhejokab'kot b'akhan a k'ab' t'ayin yik tzin a kolani, yujto tzin te nib'ej a cheknab'il.
Mamin Jehová, snib'ej wal in k'ool to tzin a kolo'. Ay in tzalajk'olal t'a a k'ayb'ub'al.
Tzin nib'ej to pitzaninnhej, yik wach' ol in b'itan t'ayach. Aokab' a tojolal tz'och wed'ok.
Ix in satb'at icha nok' kalnel sakleminak yajb'ati. Cotanh, say in ek' a in a chekab' in tik, yujto max b'atlaj a cheknab'il satk'olal wuuj.
Mamin Jehová, ayik ay in och t'a somk'olal ix in awaj t'ayach, a achxo ix ach tak'wi t'ayin.
Mamin, kolinel t'a lolonel manh yelok syal heb' naumk'e lolonel t'a in patik.
Ex esalwum, ¿tom manh ol yak'kot yaelal Dios t'a eyib'anh yujto tze nachaanh lolonel chi'?
Ol jawok niwan yaelal t'a eyib'anh, ichato ol ex juljok t'a jul-lab' jay snhi', ma ichato ol ex tz'ab'at yuj tzak'ak' chakxililnak.
Ob'iltak in, wal schukal juntzanh anima b'aj kajan in tik. Ek'b'al schukal heb' t'a heb' aj Mesec, ma t'a heb' aj Cedar.
Najtilxo kajan in ek' t'a skal heb' malaj snib'ej t'a junk'olal.
Ha in tik, malaj in gana t'a owal, ayik swalanel lolonel yik junk'olal t'a skal heb', haxo owal snib'ej heb'.
Ayic swilanb'at lum jolomtak witz, swalan t'a yol wiko': ¿B'ajtil ol kot in kolnab'il? xin chi.
Ha t'a Jehová skot in kolnab'il, aton b'oannak satcha’anh yet' sat lu'um tik.
Ha Jehová ko Diosal, manh ol ach schalaj telwok. Malaj b'aj ol och numnaj swayanh ach stanhwani.
Ha ko tanhwumal a onh israel onh tik, max waylaj, malaj b'ak'uinh swayi.
Ha Jehová tzach tanhwani, a ayek' t'a a tz'ey yik tz'och enhulok.
Manh ol ach tz'alaj yuj yok k'u t'a k'ualil, manh ol ach yixtejpaxlaj yok k'een uj t'ak'walil.
Ha Jehová ol ach kolanel t'a masanil tastak ay smay. A' ol ach kolanel t'a yol sk'ab' chamel.
A' ol ach tanhwanok ayik tzach b'ati yet' pax ayik tzach jaxi, tiknaik yet' t'a masanil tiempo.
Manhxo jantakok ix in tzalaj yet' heb' ix alan t'ayin icha tik: Conh t'a stemplo Jehová, xchi heb'.
Axo tiknaik ay onhxo ek' t'a yol chonhab' Jerusalén tik.
Ha Jerusalén, junnhej chonhab'il yaj sb'oi.
Ha t'a jun chonhab' tik sja junjun makanhil heb' schonhab' Jehová, yik wach' sb'itaj icha yutejnak yalankan t'a heb' ko mam quicham.
Ha t'a jun chonhab' tik ay juntzanh despacho b'aj sch'olb'itaj heb' anima yuj yinhtilal winhaj Dawid t'a stojolal.
k'anek to syak' junk'olal Dios t'a Jerusalén. Junk'olalokab' yaj heb' xajanan jun chonhab' tik.
Ayokab' junk'olal t'a yol smuroal yet' t'a yol spat sreyal jun chonhab' tik, xe chi.
Yuj swach'ilok heb' in k'ab' wok yet' heb' wetchonhab', yuj chi' swala': Ayokab' junk'olal, xin chi.
Yujto xajan skajnub' Jehová ko Diosal wuuj, yuj chi' ol wak' wip in sayanek' tas tz'och swach'ilok Jerusalén tik.
Mamin Jehová, Yajal ach t'a satcha’anh, tzin k'e k'elan t'ayach ayik ay tas snib'ej in k'ool.
Mamin, a t'ayach tzonh och k'elan, icha wal yoch k'elan winh chekab' t'a spatrón, ma icha wal yoch k'elan ix kriada t'a ix spatrona. Ach ko Diosal, wan ko maklan yok' a k'ool t'ayonh.
Mamin Jehová, ok'ok wal a k'ool t'ayonh. Ok'okab' a k'ool t'ayonh, yujto maxtzak techajlaj kuuj b'aj tzonh patikajkaneli.
Tzonh tzaktzaj yuj sb'uchwal heb' b'eyum yet' b'aj tzonh spatiquejel heb' ak'umtak syutej sb'a.
Tato manhok Jehová ix och qued'ok ¿tas am ix onh ajkani? Ex wetisraelal, kalek icha tik:
Tato manhok Jehová ix och qued'ok ayik ix k'e waan heb' anima yak' yowal t'ayonh,
ix am onh spitzanchiejb'at heb' ayik ix te kot yowal heb'.
Icha am tz'aj quik'jib'ey yuj ha' eluma' te ow, icham chi' ix aj ko satel yuj yowal sk'ool heb' chi'.
Calec wach' lolonel t'a Jehová, yujto maj yal sk'ool ix onh satjiel yuj heb'.
Toxonhej ix onh el t'a yol sk'ab' heb'. Icha tz'aj skolchaj junok nok' much t'a junok yaal. Ix onh kolchaji, ichato ix d'inhchajb'at sch'anhal jun yaal chi'.
Ha t'a Jehová skot ko kolnab'il, aton b'oannak satcha’anh yet' sat lu'um tik.
Ha heb' tz'ak'anoch Jehová yipok sk'ool, lajan heb' icha lum tzalan Sion, max ib'xilaj jab'ok, aynhejek' t'a masanil tiempo, icha chi' yaj heb'.
Icha wal yajoch oyan lum witz t'a spatik yichanh Jerusalén, icha chi' yaj Jehová t'a heb' schonhab' tiknaik yet' t'a masanil tiempo.
Ha heb' chuk sb'eyb'al, manh ol yak'laj yajalil heb' t'a yib'anh heb' wach' sb'eyb'al. Tato maay, haxo talaj tz'aji, a heb' wach' sb'eyb'al chi', sk'ayb'ej sb'a heb' yak'an chukal.
Mamin Jehová, ak' a wach'k'olal t'a heb' wach' sb'eyb'al, aton heb' syak' wal och sk'ol t'a tojolal.
Axo heb' tz'elkan t'a a b'eyb'al, ak'kanb'at heb' b'aj ol scha syaelal heb' sk'ulan chukal. Ayokab' ko junk'olal a onh israel onh tik.
Ayic ix onh yik'anxi meltzaj Jehová b'aj sakleminak kajkanb'ati, ix onh yik'ankot t'a Sion tik, ichato tonhej ix onh wayichani.
Ichato chi', ix onh te tzewaji, ix el kaw yuj tzalajk'olal. Yuj chi' ix yal heb' ch'ok chonhab'il icha tik: Ha Jehová ix ak'anxi sniwan wach'k'olal t'a heb', xchi heb'.
Yel toni, a Jehová ix ak'an sniwan wach'k'olal t'ayonh, yuj chi' tzonh te tzalaj tiknaik.
Mamin, ak'nhej a wach'k'olal t'a quib'anh, icha tz'aj syaxb'i sat lum taquinh lu'um yuj ha' eluma' t'a lum Neguev.
Ha heb' tz'awwi t'a skal ok'el, ol smol sat tas syawej heb' chi' t'a tzalajk'olal.
Wach'chom wan yok' heb' ayik syawanem ixim inhat te nib'ab'il heb'. Palta ayik ol elul ixim trigo chi', axonhej b'it ol yak' heb' yuj tzalajk'olal ayik mek'b'ilxok'e ixim yuj heb'.
Tato manhok Jehová sb'oan junok pat, nab'anhej am smunlaj heb' munlajwum. Tato manhok stanhwan junok chonhab', nab'anhej am stanhwaj yuj heb' stanhwumal.

Nab'anhej syixtej sb'a heb' pilan jun k'u syak' smunlaji, ste och heb' t'a ilk'olal yik tz'ilchaj swael heb', palta haxo pax heb' xajan yuj Dios, junk'olal sway heb', ha Dios chi' tz'ak'an tas tz'och yuj heb'.
Ha heb' kuninal, silab' Jehová yaj heb'. Ha heb' kuninal yet' ix quetb'eyum, swach'k'olalton Dios yaj heb'.
Ha heb' kuninal tz'alji ayik quelem anima onhto, icha wal juntzanh jul-lab' ay t'a yol sk'ab' junok ak'um owal yaj heb'.
Te wach' yik mach manh jantakok yuninal chi'. Manh ol q'uixwoquel-laj yuj heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ay, ayik ol skolan sb'ha t'a yichanh heb' yajal.
Te wach' yik junok mach ay xiwk'olal t'a Jehová, sb'eyb'alan pax scheknab'il.
D'a tzalajk'olal ol yab'lej sat tas syawej, te wach'nhej ol elk'ochok.
Icha satan te' uwa t'a spatik schiquin spat, manh jantakok sat syak'a', icha wal chi' ol aj ix yetb'eyum. Icha swol te' oliwo, icha wal chi' ol ajoch oyan heb' yuninal t'a spatik smexa.
Icha wal chi' ol aj yak'an swach'k'olal Jehová t'a junok mach ay xiwk'olal t'ay.
Yak'okab'kot swach'k'olal Jehová t'a quib'anh masanto t'a tzalan Sion. Quilokab' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a Jerusalén t'a junjun k'u yakb'an pitzan onhto.
Olto quilek tas ol aj heb' yuninal heb' kuninal. Ayokab' junk'olal t'a quib'anh a onh israel onh tik.
Yictax yichb’anel, manh jantakok yaelal ix yak'och heb' ajk'ol t'a quib'anh a onh israel onh tik. Yuj chi' a tiknaik kalek icha tik:
Manhxo jantakok yaelal ix yak'och heb' ajk'ol t'a quib'anh yiktax t'a yichb’anel, palta maj tzak'wanlaj chi' t'ayonh.
Ixlajwi yich ko patik smak'an heb', te niwan chequel ix aj staji schiq'uil yich ko patik chi' yuj heb'.
Axo Jehová, tojol toni, ha' ix onh kolan t'a yol sk'ab' heb' sk'ulan chukal chi', xko chiokab'i.
Ha heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'a Sion, q'uixwokab' heb', b'atokab' heb' elelal.
Icha tz'aj anh ank'ultak sq'uib' t'a yib'anh pat, jab'nhej sq'uib' steel, elanhchamel stakjieli, ichokab' ta' tz'aj heb'.
Ha anh ank'ultak chi', max ko jochlaj anh, max ko tzek'paxlaj anh t'a manojail.
Manh ol yal-laj heb' anima tzek' t'a stz'ey anh ank'ultak chi': Yak'okab' syaxilal Jehová t'a yib'anh anh. Sco k'an yaxilal t'a yib'anh anh, manh xchiok heb'.
Mamin Jehová, swal in b'a t'ayach yujto ayin och t'a wilk'olal, ichato ay in ek' t'a jun olan te jul yich swab'i.
Mamin, ab' in jaj tiknaik, ak'kot tz'eyan a chiquin ayik tzin awaj in k'anan a kolwal.
Mamin Jehová, q'uinalok tato tz'ib'ab'il ko chukal uuj ¿mach wal ol stek'b'ej sb'ha t'a ichanh?
Palta a t'ayach tz'ilchaj niwank'olal kuuj, yik wach' ay elk'och t'a ko sat.
Mamin Jehová, t'a wal smasanil in k'ool tzin tanhwej yik tzach jawi in a kolo'. Swak'och a lolonel yipok in k'ool.
Mamin, ek'al in tanhwan a kolwal t'a yichanh heb' winh stanhwumal chonhab' snib'ej spet sakb'i. Ek'alto in maklan a kolwal chi' t'a heb' winh stanhwan heb' chonhab' chi'.
Kak'ekoch Jehová yipok ko k'ool a onh israel onh tik, yujto ay yok'elk'olal, b'ekannhej sk'ool skolwaji.
A' ol onh kolanel t'a yalanh smasanil ko mul.
Mamin Jehová, manh ak'umtakok swutej in b'a, max wik'lajchaanh in b'a, max wak'och in b'ha t'a tas niwak yelk'ochi, t'a tas max in tzak'wanlaj in b'oani.
Palta munil ayin eq'ui, malaj tas tzin na'a. Icha wal junok nene' slajwi schuni, chelb'ilk'e yuj snun, icha chi' waji.
Ex wetchonhab', kak'ekoch Jehová yipok ko k'ool tiknaik yet' t'a masanil tiempo.
Mamin Jehová Te ay ip, ko Diosal ach a onh yinhtil onh winhaj Jacob, nakot winhaj Dawid yet' syaelal. Nacot sti' winh ix yak' t'ayach ayik ix yalan winh:
Manh ol in och t'a yol in pat, manh ol in ek'laj jichan t'a sat in ch'at,
manh ol in mutz'laj in sat, manh ol ochlaj numnaj jab'ok in wayanh
ayik manto in b'o junok kajnub' b'aj skajnaj Jehová ko Diosal Te ay yip a onh yinhtil onh winhaj Jacob, xchikan winh.
Ha t'a Efrata ix kab' yab'ixal te' skaxail strato Dios, haxo t'a yol lum smakb'en winhaj Jaar ix ilchaj te' kuuj.
Koyec t'a stemplo Jehová, haxo ta' tzonh emek kuman t'a yichanh.
Mamin Jehová, kotanh t'a a kajnub' aynhej eq'ui. Cotanh yet' te' skaxail a trato, aton b'aj scheklajel a poder.
Aokab' wach'il sb'eyb'alej heb' a sakerdote. Elokab' yaw heb' ikxo t'a tzalajk'olal.
Yuj tas alnakkan t'a winh a chekab' aj Dawid, manh ik'el a sat t'a winh rey sik'b'ilel uuj.
Ach Jehová, ix ak'kan a ti' t'a winhaj Dawid t'a sjichanil to manh ol a k'exlaj tas ix ala', ayik ix alan icha tik: Ha junok uninal ol wak'kanoch reyal a k'exulok.
Tato sk'anab'ajej in trato heb' inhtilal yet' tastak ol wal t'a heb', ol ochnhej heb' t'a a despacho t'a masanil tiempo, xa chi t'a winh.
Mamin Jehová, a ach ix a sik'kanel lum tzalan Sion yik tzach kajnaj ta', yujto icha chi' snib'ej a k'ool.
Ix alan icha tik: Aton jun tzalan tik b'aj in gana tzin kajnaji. Ol in kajnaj t'a lu'um yujto icha chi' ix aj schaan in k'ool.
Manh jantakok wael uk'el ol wak' t'a heb' ayek' kajan ta', ol wak'an b'ud'jok sk'ool heb' meb'a'.
Ol in kol heb' sakerdote. Axo heb' ol in k'anab'ajanok, ol wak' awajk'e heb' yuj tzalajk'olal.
Ha t'a Sion chi', ol wak'och jun yinhtilal winhaj Dawid reyal. Ha winh sik'b'ilel wuuj, manhxa b'ak'uinh ol yaktej heb' yinhtilal winh yak'an reyal.
Ha heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'a winh ol wak'kan q'uixwelal heb'. Axo yopisio winh, ol wik'chaanh, xa chikan ach Jehová.
Naeknab'i, manh jantakok swach'il schaan sb'a yaj heb' sk'ab' yok sb'a ayik junnhej tz'aj spensar heb'.
Lajan yet' jun perfume manh jantakok swach'il skot jililok t'a sjolom winhaj sakerdote Aarón, tz'emul t'a xil sti' winh, tz'emk'och t'a spayual sjaj spichul winh.
Lajan wal icha yal ak'wal tz'em t'a sjolom lum witzal Hermón, tz'empax t'a lum tzalan Sion. Ha b'aj ay junk'olal chi', syak'b'at swach'k'olal Jehová, aton k 'inal t'a junelnhej.
Ex schekab' Jehová, alek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová chi'. Alec wach' lolonel t'ay mach ex tze tanhwej stemplo tzek' ak'wal.
Ik'ekk'e wan he k'ab' t'a stojolal skajnub' Jehová, tzeyalan wach' lolonel t'ay.
Ha Jehová b'oannak satcha’anh yet' lum lum tik, aokab' tz'ak'ankot swach'k'olal t'a eyib'anh masanto t'a lum tzalan Sion.
Calec wach' lolonel t'a Jehová. Ex schekab' ex Jehová, alek wach' lolonel t'ay.
Mach ex ayex ek' t'a yamaq'uil stemplo Jehová ko Diosal,
alek wach' lolonel t'ay, yujto wach'. B'itananhek t'ay yujto te ay swach'k'olal t'ayonh anima onh tik.
Ix onh sik'kanel a onh israel onh yinhtilal onh winhaj Jacob, yik tzonh och yikok.
Ha in tik wojtak wal sik'lab'il to a Jehová ko Diosal, yelxo wal ek'b'al yelk'och t'a yichanh masanil komon Dios.
Syalnhej sk'ulan masanil tas snib'ej sk'ulej, wach'chom t'a satcha’anh, ma t'a sat lu'um tik, ma t'ha ha' mar, ma pax t'a yich ha'.
A' tz'ak'ankot asun b'aj slajwik'och lum lum tik. A' tz'ak'anek' kopnaj lheb'lon ayik syak'an nhab'. A' sjakanelta ik' b'aj molanek' yuj.
A' milannakcham heb' b'ab'el unin t'a junjun patil heb' aj Egipto yet' pax sb'ab'el yune' junjun nok' snok' heb'.
Ha t'a snanhal chonhab' Egipto chi', ay juntzanh tas te satub'tak sk'ulejnak yik syak'an syaelal winh rey yet' pax heb' schekab' winh.
Tzijtum juntzanh chonhab' satnaquel yuj, smilannakcham heb' rey te niwak yopisio.
Smilnaccham winhaj Sehón, sreyal heb' amorreo yet' winhaj Og sreyal Basán yet' masanil heb' rey t'a yol yik Canaán.
Axo lum sluum heb' rey chi' yak'nak t'ayonh a onh israel onh tik, yik squiquejkan lu'um.
Mamin Jehová, a a b'inajnaquil malaj b'ak'uinh ol satelok. D'a masanil tiempo ol ach nachajkotok.
Ha Jehová sb'oan yaj owal t'a heb' schonhab', tz'ok' sk'ol t'a heb' schekab'.
Ha sdiosal heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, nab'a oro, nab'a plata, anima sb'oani.
Ay sti' sdiosal heb' chi', palta max lolonlaj. Ay sat, palta max yil-laj.
Ay schiquin, palta max yab'laj, max yik'laj yik'.
Ha heb' sb'oan juntzanh yechel chi' yet' heb' tz'ak'anoch t'a sk'ool, lajan heb' yet'ok.
Ex wetisraelal, kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová. Ex sakerdote, ex yinhtilal winhaj Aarón, alek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová.
Ex yinhtilal winhaj Leví, alek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová. Mach ex ay yelk'och Jehová t'a he sat, alek wach' lolonel t'ay.
Aljokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová t'a Sion, aton t'a Jerusalén b'aj kajan. Calec wach' lolonel t'a Jehová.
Calec wach' lolonel t'a Jehová yujto te wach' spensar, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
Aljokab' wach' lolonel d'ha Dios, aton sDiosal masanil juntzanh Dios, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
Aljokab' wach' lolonel d'ha Dios Yajal heb' yajal, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
Anhej sb'oan tas te satub'tak, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' b'oannak satcha’anh yet' sjelanil, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' b'oannakk'e lum lum t'a yib'anh ha' mar te jul yich, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' b'oannak k'u yet' k'een uj, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' b'oannak k'u yik ay sakil k'inal t'a k'ualil, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' b'oannak k'een uj yet' k'een k'anal yik ay sakil k'inal t'ak'walil, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' milannakcham heb' b'ab'el unin t'a junjun pat t'a Egipto, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' ik'annaquelta heb' israel ko mam quicham t'a Egipto chi', yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
Yed' wal spoder yik'naquelta heb', yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' pojannak em snanhal ha' Chacchac Mar, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' ik'annak ek'ta heb' israel t'a snanhal ha' mar chi', yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
Palta haxo winh sreyal Egipto yet' heb' soldado, b'atnakkan heb' yuj t'a yol ha' mar chi', yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' ik'annak b'ey heb' schonhab' t'a tzinan lu'um, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' milannakcham heb' niwak rey, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' ik'annaquel sk'inal heb' rey te b'inajnak, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
Aton winhaj Sehón sreyal heb' amorreo, ik'jinaquel sk'inal winh yuj, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
Yed' pax winhaj Og sreyal Basán, ik'jinaquel sk'inal winh yuj, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' ik'annak ek' lum sluum heb' rey chi', yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
Yak'nakkan lu'um quikok a onh israel schekab' onh tik, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' onh naankoti ayik ayonhek' t'a skal yaelal, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
Ix onh skolkanel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayonh, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' tz'ak'an tas swa heb' anima yet' nok' nok', yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
Calec wach' lolonel t'a sDiosal satcha’anh, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
Ha t'a sti' ha ha' t'a yol yik Babilonia, onh em k'ojan ayik ix ko naankot Sion, ix onh ok' b'ian.
Ix kak'k'e lokan te' arpa t'a sk'ab' te' tak'u ay t'a sti' ha ha' chi'.
Ha heb' ix onh ik'anb'at icha t'a preso, ix b'uchwaj heb' t'ayonh, ix yalan heb' icha tik: B'itananhek t'a tzalajk'olal, a sb'ital Sion tze b'itej t'ayonh, xchi heb'.
¿Tom ol ko b'itej b'it yik Jehová t'a lum ch'ok chonhab'il? xko chi.
Tato sb'at satk'olal Jerusalén wuuj, satokab' sjelanil in wach' k'ab' tik in chalan te' warpa.
Tato manhxo naanok Jerusalén wuuj, tato manhxa pax in gana t'ay t'a yichanh pax tas snib'ej in k'ool, kanokab' lotznaj wak' t'a in joom, yik wach' manhxo ol yal-laj in b'itani.
Mamin Jehová, nakot heb' aj Edom, yujto ayik ix yamchaj chonhab' Jerusalén, ix yal heb' icha tik: Pojequemi, pojequemi, masanto scheklaj kimientoal yich, xchi heb'.
Ex aj Babilonia, ol ex satpaxelok. Te wach' yik mach ol ak'anek' spak chukal tas ix onh eyutej.
Te wach' yik mach ol yaman heb' eyuninal, ol smak'anpoj sjolom heb' t'a spatiktak k'een k'een.
Mamin Jehová, t'a smasanil in k'ool ol wak' yuj diosal t'ayach, ol ach in b'itej t'a yichanh juntzanh Dios.

Ol in em kuman t'ayach t'a stojolal a templo to iknhej yaji, yuj wak'an yuj diosal t'ayach yuj a wach'k'olal, yujto tzak'elk'och tas tzala'. Ix ik'chaanh a b'i yet' a lolonel t'a yib'anh masanil tastak.
Ix ach tak'wi t'ayin ayik ix in awaj t'ayach, ix ak'an wip.
Masanil heb' rey t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, ol yal wach' lolonel heb' t'ayach ayik ol yab'an heb' tas alnakkani.
Ol yal wach' lolonel heb' t'ayach yuj tastak a b'onak, yujto te niwan yelk'och a b'inajnaquil.
Wach'chom te niwan elk'ochi, palta tz'ok' a k'ol t'a heb' anima emnaquil yeq'ui, haxo heb' syik'chaanh sb'a, max ach b'atlaj k'elan t'a heb'.
Ayic ay in ek' t'a skal tas ay smay, pitzan innhej uuj, tzak'ankot a poder, tzin a kolanel t'a yowal heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin.
Ach Jehová, ol ach och wed'ok yik wach'nhej tzin elk'och t'a tas tza na t'ayin. Ha a wach'k'olal aynhejek' t'a masanil tiempo. Ha tastak ix ik'el yich t'ayin, mokab' kan xepan.
Mamin Jehová, ojtak in sik'lab'il, ix in a b'eyk'olej sik'lab'il.
Ojtac ayik tzin em k'ojan yet' pax yik tzin k'e waan. Ayocto tzojtakanel tas tzin na'a.
Ojtacxo b'ajtil tzin eq'ui yet' b'ajtil swik' wip. Ojtac pax masanil tas tzin k'ulej.
Ayic mantzak in na tas ol wala' a achxo pax Mamin, ojtakxo.
Ayachnhejek' t'a in patik wichanh, b'akhanb'at a k'ab' t'a wib'anh.
Satub'tak yoch a jelanil tik, manh jab'ok snachajel wuuj, te niwan yelk'ochi, ste sat in k'ool yuj.
¿B'ajto wal ol in b'at elelal t'a Espíritu? ¿B'ajto wal ol in b'at elelal t'a ichanh?
Tato tzin k'ek'och t'a satcha’anh, ata' ayach eq'ui. Tato tzin em t'a yol lu'um, ay ach pax ek'ta.
Tato tzin b'at t'a yichanhb'at b'aj sjawi k'u, ma tzin b'at kajan t'a sk'axepal ha' mar b'aj tz'em k'u,
palta sk'och pax a k'ab' t'ayin ta'. Tzin a quetzchaanh yet' a wach' k'ab', tzin ik'an b'eyok.
Tato tzin na in k'ub'ejel in b'ha t'a skal k’ik’ k’inal, mato a sakil k'inal oyanoch t'a in patik tz'och k'ik'alq'uinalil,
a t'ak'walil chi' max yal-laj in sk'ub'anel t'a ichanh. Ha k’ik’ k’inal, lajan yet' sakil k'inal t'a ichanh. Malaj sk'exanhil t'ak'walil t'a ichanh, yujto saquilq'uinalnhej masanil t'ayach.
Ha ach ton ix a b'o masanil tas t'a in niwanil tik. Ha ach ix in a b'o t'a yol sk'ool in nun.
Swal wach' lolonel t'ayach, yujto satub'tak tas tza b'o'o. Sat in k'ol in naani, palta wojtak sik'lab'il to icha chi' yaji.
Ayic ix q'uib' in niwanil tik t'a yol sk'ol in nun, wach'chom manh chequelok, palta manh k'ub'eltakok yaj t'a yol a sat.
Ha ach ix il in niwanil tik ayik manto in aljilaj. Masanil sb'isul sk'ual in k 'inal, tz'ib'ab'il t'a yol a libro ayik mantalaj junok k'ual swila'.
Ach in Diosal, max nachajel-laj wuuj tas yaj a pensar t'ayin. Manhxo b'ischajb'enok a pensar chi'.
Tato tzin och ijan in b'isani, ek'to sb'isul t'a yichanh k'een arena. Ayic tz'el in wayanh, ayinnhej ek' t'a ichanh.
Ach in Diosal, ik'el sk'inal heb' sk'ulan chukal. Najat tzik'kanel heb' mak'umcham anima t'a in tz'ey.
Yujto chuk tas syal heb', tzach yalub'tanhej heb' t'a chukal.
Mamin Jehová, tzin chak heb' tzach chakani, max in nib'ejlaj heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach.
Junelnhej malaj in gana swil heb', aypaxoch heb' ajk'olal t'ayin walani.
Ach in Diosal, b'eytzitej tas waji, il pax in pensar.
Ila' tato wan in b'at t'a chukal b'eyb'al, tzin a kuchb'anb'at t'a sb'eal k 'inal to aynhej t'a masanil tiempo.
Mamin Jehová, kolinel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' sk'ulan chukal, k'ub'ej in el t'a heb' b'aj malaj yelk'och a k'ayb'ub'al,
yet' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' naannhej chukal yuj, yujto anhej owal sna heb' t'a masanil tiempo.
Ha sti' heb' icha wal sti' nok' chan, a tas syal heb' icha wal swenenoal sti' junok nok' chan smilan anima.
Mamin Jehová, k'ub'ej in el t'a heb' sk'ulan chukal, heb' malaj yelk'och a k'ayb'ub'al t'ay, heb' naannhej yuj tas tz'aj in yak'an telwok.
Ha juntzanh heb' anima syik'chaanh sb'a chi', ix yak'em yaal heb' t'a yol in b'e.
Mamin Jehová, a t'ayach ix wala': In Diosal ach, ab' tas swala' ayik tzin awaji swalan in b'a t'ayach.
Mamin Dios, ach Vajalil, in Kolumal to syalnhej uuj, a ach ton tzin a kol t'a skal owal, xin chi.

Mamin Jehová, manh ak' snib'ej heb' sk'ulan chukal, manh ak' snib'ej spensar heb' yik max yik'chaanh sb'a heb'. Ha heb' tzoymajoch t'ayin, sna tastak heb', palta aokab' tas sna heb' chi' skot t'a yib'anh.
Emokab' tzak'ak' chak xilinak t'a yib'anh heb', b'atokab' heb' t'a skal k'ak'. Yumjokab'b'at heb' t'a yol xab' olan, b'aj maxtzak yal-laj sk'eta heb'.
Mocxob' kajnajek' heb' alum chukal lolonel t'a sat lu'um tik. Jawokab' yaelal t'a yib'anh heb' malaj yelk'och a k'ayb'ub'al t'ay, satokab'el heb'.
Vojtak a in tik to a ach tza b'o yaj yowal heb' meb'a', tza kolanel heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' tz'ik'ankanek' junok tas t'a heb'.
Ha heb' anima wach' spensar, ol yal wach' lolonel heb' t'ayach. Ha heb' anima tojol sb'eyb'al, ol ajnhejek' heb' t'a ichanh.
Mamin Jehová, swal in b'a t'ayach, kotanh t'a elanhchamel. Ab' in jaj ayik swalan in b'ha t'a ichanh.
Mamin, wach'okab' sk'ek'och in lesal icha wal sk'e stab'il inkienso t'a ichanh. Axo in k'ab' mojank'e t'ayach, lajanokab' wal icha ofrenda t'a yemk'ualil t'a yol a sat.
Mamin Jehová, tanhwej in ti', yik wach' manh ol wal chukal lolonel.
Najat tzik'kanel chukal t'a in pensar. Manh in a cha b'eyek' t'a chukal b'eyb'al. Manh in a chab'at wael b'aj ay sniwak wael heb' sk'ulan chukal.

Tato a junok anima wach' tzin mak'ani, wach'ton tzin yutej. Tato tzin stumej, icha wal to syak'och perfume t'ayin, yuj chi' scha in k'ool. Palta tzin lesalwinhej yik wach' syamchajoch waan tas sk'ulej heb' chuk.
Ha heb' yajalil heb' sk'ulan chukal, ol ekchajb'at heb' t'a sattak tenam, icha chi' ol aj yilan heb' anima to yel ix wala'.
Ha sb'aquil heb', sakleminak ol ajkanb'at b'aj smukchaj heb' chamnak, icha tz'ajkanb'at lum lum ayik sb'oji junok olan.
Mamin Jehová in Diosal ach, ay wal och in pensar t'ayach. Ha t'ayach tzin say in kolnab'il, manh in aktejkani.
Colinel t'a syaal heb' tz'ak'an chukal t'ayin.
Canokab' heb' chuk chi' t'a syaal chi', a inxo jun, ol in ek'nhej.
Mamin Jehová, a t'ayach tzin awaji ayik swalan in b'a. Swak' wal wip in k'anan t'ayach to tz'ok' a k'ool t'ayin.
D'a ichanh swal in b'a, a wal t'a ichanh swal wilk'olal.
Mamin Jehová, ayik manhxo animaok waj swab'i, ojtak wal in b'e. Ha t'a jun b'e b'aj tzin b'ati, ata' ix yak'em yaal heb' ajk'ol t'ayin.
Tzin b'at k'elan t'a in wach', malaj junok mach sjawi yik tz'och wed'ok. Malaj mach tzin kolani. Malaj mach tz'och ilk'olal wuuj, wach'chom tzin chami.
Mamin, a wal t'ayach swal in b'a, swalan icha tik: Ha t'ayach tzin kol in b'a, a achnhej tzach in nib'ej t'a yichanh masanil tas t'a sat lu'um tik.
Cotanh k'elan t'ayin tzin awaj t'ayach, yujto malaj wip. Colinel t'a heb' tzin pechan b'eyek'ok, yujto te ay yip heb' t'a wichanh.
Ik' in elta t'a skal in yaelal in k'ana', yik wach' ol wal wach' lolonel t'ayach, haxo heb' anima wach' spensar ol och oyan heb' t'a in patik ayik ol ak'an a wach'k'olal t'ayin, xin chi.
Mamin Jehová, ab' in lesal, cham wal ab'an tas swala'. Tak'wanh t'ayin, ina to te tojol ach, tzak'annhejelk'och tas tzala'.
Manh a k'anb'ej tas waj a in a chekab' in tik, yujto malaj junok mach wach' yaj t'a a sat.
Ix in pechji b'eyek' yuj heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, ix in stek'anem heb' t'a sat lu'um. Ix in yak' kajnaj heb' t'a skal k’ik’ k’inal, icha wal yaj heb' chamnakxo.
Manhxo animaok waj tiknaik swab'i, te somchajnak in k'ool.
Tzin nakot juntzanh k'ual ek'nak t'a peka', tzin naub'tanhan masanil tas a b'onak t'a yalanhtax chi'.
Ha t'ayach tzin mojb'ejk'e in k'ab', tzach in nib'ej wal, icha wal junok lum taquinh lu'um snib'an ha ha'.
Mamin Jehová, tak'wanh t'ayin t'a elanhchamel, toxo wal tz'el in k'ol swab'i. Manh a yaej a kolwal t'ayin. Icha wal heb' chamnak smukchajemi, icham chi' ol in ajok tato tza yaej a kolwal t'ayin.
Ak' in nakot a wach'k'olal t'a junjun q'uinhib'alil, ina to a ach tzach wak'och yipok in k'ool. Ch'ox t'ayin tas ol aj in b'eyb'ati, yujto wan in lesalwi t'ayach.
Mamin Jehová, kolinel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ool, yujto a t'ayach tzin say in kolnab'il.
k'ayb'ej in yik tzin b'o icha tas tza nib'ej, yujto in Diosal ach. Aokab' Espíritu wach' tzin ik'an b'ey t'a a wach' b'eyb'al.
Mamin, manh in a cha chamok, yik wach' max alchaj chukal lolonel t'ayach. Ik' in elta t'a skal wilk'olal, yujto wach' ach toni.
Yuj a wach'k'olal t'ayin, yuj chi' tza satkanel masanil heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, yujto a chekab' in.
Aljokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová, aton tz'ak'an wip. Aton wal tzin k'ayb'ani, syak'anpax in jelanil yik wach' swak' owal.
Aton icha in nhak'een, icha wal in kuartel, in Kolumal paxi. A' tzin k'ub'aneli. A' ayoch wenhulok. A' tz'ak'anoch heb' chonhab' t'a yalanh in mandar.
Mamin Jehová ¿tas wal jab'ok quelk'och a onh anima onh tik t'a yol a sat, yuj chi' tzonh a nakoti? ¿Tas wal quelk'ochi yuj chi' tzonh a ya'ilej?
Ha onh anima onh tik, lajan onh icha wal b'aj squik' quik', haxo ko k 'inal icha wal junok enhul tz'eq'ui.
Mamin, jak spuertail satcha’anh yik tzach emuli. Tzach emul t'a jolomtak witz yik sk'e stab'il lum uuj.
Julemta junok a jul-lab', aton jun k'ak' tzek' kopnajok, tza pechanb'at heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach t'a skal somk'olal.
Masanto t'a satcha’anh chi' tzak'emta a k'ab' tzin a kolanel t'a jun ha' mar te niwan, syalelk'ochi, aton heb' ch'ok chonhab'il.
Colinel t'a heb' esalwum chi', aton heb' syik'chaanh sk'ab' syak'an sti' t'a tastak manh yelok.
Ach in Diosal, ol in b'itej jun ak' b'it t'ayach. Ol in b'itan yet' sb'ital salterio t'ayach.
Uuj wal, syal yuj heb' rey, a ach ton ix in a kol t'a k'een espada tzonh milanchamok, a in Dawid a chekab' in tik.
Ha tiknaik, kolinel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, heb' esalwum syak' sti' t'a tastak manh yelok syala'.
Q'uib'okab' heb' kuninal icha wal tas tz'awchaj to ya ilab'il. Ha heb' ix quisil lajanokab' heb' ix icha junok yoyal templo tzeyb'il, te wach' yilji.
Ha ko pat, b'ud'jinakokab'el yuj junjun makan wael. Ha nok' ko kalnel, q'uib'okab' sb'isul nok' t'a smilal. Manhxo b'ischajb'enokab' tz'aj sb'isul nok' ko wakax.
Unewiokab' nok', mokab' tonhejok tzek' sti' nok'. Malajokab' mach tz'el yaw t'a yol skalleal ko chonhab' yuj yaelal.
Yelxo wal te wach' yik junok chonhab' to icha chi' yaji. Yelxo wal te wach' yik junok chonhab' to a Jehová ayoch sDiosalok.
Ach in Diosal, a ach ton in Reyal ach, ol walkanel a b'inajnaquil. D'a masanil tiempo ol wak' yuj diosal t'ayach.
Junjun k'u ol wal wach' lolonel t'ayach. Ol ach wik'anchaanh t'a masanil tiempo.
Mamin Jehová, te niwan ton elk'ochi, a moj ton wal yalchaj wach' lolonel t'ayach. Ha a b'inajnaquil, manhxo b'ischajb'enok.
Ha heb' mamab'il, ol yalel yab'ixal tastak tza k'ulej t'a heb' yuninal. Axo heb' uninab'il chi', ol yal pax heb' t'a heb' yixchiquin.
Ol yalel yab'ixal a tziquiquial heb', aton te niwan yelk'ochi, a inxo jun, ol in naub'tanhej tas satub'tak tza k'ulej.
Ol alchajel yab'ixal tas satub'tak ix a k'ulej, te ay pax smay. Ha inxo tik, ol walel a b'inajnaquil.
Ol alchajel yab'ixal jantak a niwan wach'k'olal, te chaanh ol aljok to te wach' ach toni.
Mamin Jehová, te niwan ton a wach'k'olal, ay pax ok'elk'olal, manh elanhchamelok skot owal, tz'ok'nhej a k'ool t'ayonh.
Mamin Jehová, yelxo wal te wach' ach t'a masanil anima. Masanil tas a b'onak, te xajan uuj.
Mamin Jehová, masanil tastak b'ob'il uuj, yalokab' wach' lolonel t'ayach. Yak'okab' yuj diosal heb' a chonhab' t'ayach.
Yalokab'el heb' to te wach' ak'an yajalil. Yalokab' wach' lolonel heb' t'a tas ix a k'ulej, a sch'oxanel a niwan poder.
Ha yab'ixal a poder yet' a b'inajnaquil t'a opisio, ol yab' heb' anima.
Ha opisio aynhej ek' t'a junelnhej, Yajal ach t'a masanil tiempo. Ha ach tik tzak'nhejelk'och tas tzala'. Te wach' ach yet' masanil tas a b'onak.
Mamin Jehová, tzak' yip heb' toxo wal stelwi, tzik'an k'e waan heb' tz'ixtaxi.
Ha masanil heb' anima, stanhwej a kolwal heb', yujto a ach tzak' swael heb' t'a stiempoal.
Elb'ennhej tas uuj t'a smasanil a k'ool, tzak'an swael masanil tas pitzan.
Mamin Jehová, tojolton a b'eyb'al, te ay a wach'k'olal t'a tas a b'onakkani.
B'ekannhej a k'ol a kolwaj t'a heb' syal sb'a t'ayach t'a smasanil sk'ool.
Mamin Jehová, tzak' tas icha snib'ej heb' ay xiwk'olal t'ayach. Ayic sk'anan heb', tzab'i tza kolan heb'.
Mamin Jehová, tzil heb' tzach xajanani. Axo heb' sk'ulan chukal jun, tza satel heb'.
Mamin Jehová, swal wach' lolonel t'ayach. Axo pax masanil tas b'ob'il uuj, yalokab' wach' lolonel t'ayach tiknaik yet' t'a masanil tiempo.
Calec wach' lolonel t'a Jehová. D'a wal smasanil in k'ool ol wal wach' lolonel t'a Jehová.
Yakb'an pitzan into ol wal wach' lolonel t'ay. Yakb'an ayinto eq'ui, ol in b'itan t'a in Diosal.
Manh eyak'och anima niwan yelk'och yipok he k'ool, yujto animanhej heb', yuj chi' max yal-laj skolwaj heb'.
Ayic scham heb', tz'ochkan heb' pokokal. Ha t'a jun k'u chi' slajwikanel tastak sna heb' sk'ulej.
Te wach' yik mach schaan skolwal sDiosal winhaj Jacob. Anhej Jehová Dios chi' ayoch yipok sk'ool.
Ha Jehová b'oannak satcha’anh, lum lum, ha' mar yet' masanil tastak ay t'a junjun makan chi'. Tz'elnhejk'och tas syala'.
A' sb'oan yaj b'aj tz'ixtaj heb' anima, syak'anpax swael heb' ay swejel. A' skolanel heb' ayoch t'a preso.
Ha Jehová sjakan sat heb' max ujilaj yilani, squetzan k'e waan heb' stelwi. Xajan heb' anima wach' spensar yuj.
Ha Jehová skolan heb' anima ch'ok chonhab'il. Anhejton pax ha' tz'ilan heb' unin chamnak smam yet' heb' ix ix chamnak yetb'eyum. Palta tz'ak'ji somchaj heb' sk'ulan chukal yuj.
Ex aj Sion, a Jehová ol ak'an Yajalil t'a masanil tiempo. Ha ko Diosal ol och Reyal t'a junelnhej. Calec wach' lolonel t'a Jehová.
Calec wach' lolonel t'a Jehová. Manhxo jantakok swach'il ko b'itan b'it t'a ko Diosal. Smojton wal ko b'itan t'ay yet' juntzanh b'it te wach'.
Ha Jehová sb'oanxi Jerusalén, ol smolb'ejxikot heb' quetisraelal sakleminak yajkanb'ati.
Ha tz'ak'an sniwanil sk'ol heb' pitz'anoch kuselal t'a spixan. A' tz'anhtan syaelal heb' chi'.
A' na'annak jantak sb'isul k'een k'anal sb'onak, yak'annakoch sb'i junjun k'een.
Yelxo wal te niwan yelk'och ko Diosal tik, niwan spoder, malaj slajwub'al sjelanil.
A' tz'ik'an k'e waan heb' anima emnaquil yeq'ui, palta a heb' sk'ulan chukal, tz'ik'chajkanem heb' sik'lab'il yuj.
Co b'itejek Jehová yik skak'an yuj diosal yet' te' arpa sko b'itejek.
A' tz'ak'anoch asun t'a satcha’anh, slajwi chi' syak'ankot nhab' t'a sat lu'um tik. A' tz'ak'an q'uib' anh ank'ultak t'a tzalquixtak.
Anhejton pax ha' tz'ak'an swael nok' nok' yet' nok' yunetak joj ayik tz'el yaw nok' yuj wejel.
Ha Jehová, max tzalajlaj yet' heb' anima tz'ak'anoch yip nok' chej, ma yipal heb' soldado yipok sk'ool.
Palta stzalaj yet' heb' ay xiwk'olal t'ay, aton heb' tz'ak'anoch swach'k'olal yipok sk'ool.
Ex aj Jerusalén, kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová. Ex aj Sion, ko b'itejek ko Diosal.
A' tz'ak'anoch yip yijchulok spuertail chonhab' Jerusalén, syak'anpax swach'k'olal t'a heb' kuninal.
A' tz'ak'an junk'olal t'a yol smakb'en ko chonhab' tik, syak'anpax b'ud'jok yuj ixim trigo te wach'.
A' tz'ak'ankot slolonel t'a sat lu'um tik, elanhchamel tz'elk'ochi.
Ha ko Diosal tz'ak'ankot k'een sakb'akom icha yilji sak lana. A' tz'ak'anoch k'een cheew pokokal, icha k'een tik'aq'uil taanh tz'ajkan k'een.
A' tz'ak'ankot k'een sakb'at icha k'een kotak k'een. Axo wal sikal k'een, malaj junok mach stechaj yuj.
Syalanpaxi to tz'ulaxb'at k'een, syak'ankot ik', yik sb'ey yalil k'een chi'.
Ha slolonel yet' sk'ayb'ub'al, ix yak' kojtaquejel a onh israel yinhtilal onh winhaj Jacob tik.
Manh ichokta' ix yutej t'a junokxo nakión. Maj yojtaquejel-laj sk'ayb'ub'al ko Diosal juntzanhxo chonhab' chi'. Calec wach' lolonel t'a Jehová.
Calec wach' lolonel t'a Jehová. Aljokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová masanto t'a schaanhil satcha’anh.
Alec wach' lolonel t'ay masanil ex yángel. Alec wach' lolonel masanil ex soldadoal satcha’anh.
Ik'chajokab' chaanh Jehová yuj k'u yet' k'een uj. Ik'chajokab' chaanh yuj k'een nitk'anal te wach' yilji yok.
Ik'chajokab' chaanh yuj satcha’anh, to chaanh ay yet' pax yuj ha ha' ayek' t'a yib'anh satcha’anh chi'.
Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová, yujto tonhej ix yala' ix b'okan smasanil.
A' ix b'oankan masanil juntzanh chi' t'a yet'tal yik wach' ayek' ta' t'a masanil tiempo, ix yak'ankanoch t'a sleyal to malaj b'ak'uinh ol k'exchajok.
Yalokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová masanil tastak ay t'a sat lu'um tik, nok' niwak nok' ay t'a yol ha' mar yet' pax nok' ay t'a sjulal yich ha',
yet' lheb'lon, k'een sakb'at, k'een sakb'akom, k'ik'al asun yet' chakxuxum ik', k'anab'ajumokab' syutej sb'ha t'a slolonel Jehová chi'.
Yalokab' wach' lolonel lum niwak witz t'a Jehová, lum tzalquixtak, te te' syak' sat, te' k'ute',
yet' nok' k'ultaquil nok', nok' molb'etzal nok', nok' snherwi, ma sjachwi yet' pax nok' much.
Ex sreyal yol yib'anhk’inal tik, ex anima t'a junjun chonhab', ex yajal yet' ex tze b'o yaj heb' chonhab',
ex winak, ex ix, ex ichamtak anima yet' pax ex unin, alek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová he masanil.
Alec wach' lolonel t'a Jehová he masanil yujto anhej te b'inajnak. Ha stziquiquial ay masanto t'a yib'anh satcha’anh yet' t'a yib'anh lum lum tik.
A' ix ak'an quipal a onh schonhab' onh tik. Calec wach' lolonel t'ay a onh israel onh tik, a onhton te xajanab'il onh yuj. Calec wach' lolonel t'a Jehová.
Calec wach' lolonel t'a Jehová. Co b'itejek ak' b'it t'a Jehová. Co b'itejek b'it t'ay b'aj molan onh ek' a onh yik onhxo tik.
Ex wetisraelal, konh tzalajek yet' ko Diosal chaannaquel yich ko nakión tik. Conh tzalajek yet' ko Reyal a onh aj chonhab' Sion onh tik.
Conh k'eek cheneljok skalanek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová, yik skak'an ejmelal t'ay. Conh b'itanek t'ay yet' te' arpa yet' pandereta,
yujto stzalaj qued'ok a onh schonhab' onh tik. Ol yak' ko tzalajk'olal a onh emnaquil onh tik, yujto ol yak' ko kolnab'il.
Yuj sniwanil yelk'och Jehová, konh tzalajek a onh yik onhxo tik. Anhejtona' konh b'itanek t'ay yuj tzalajk'olal ayik tzonh waykan ochi.
Q'ueokab' kaw ko b'itan d'ha Dios, haxo jun k'een espada ay ye t'a schab'il pak'anh yamb'il kuuj,
yik skak'anek' ko pak t'a heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, skak'anoch yaelal t'a juntzanh nakión,
yik wach' tz'och k'een kadena t'a sreyal heb' yet' t'a heb' anima ay yopisio t'a skal heb',
yik skotkan yaelal t'a yib'anh heb', aton tz'ib'yajkani. Ha jun niwan opisio tik syak' Dios t'a masanil heb' sk'anab'ajan t'ay. Calec wach' lolonel t'a Jehová.
Aljokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová. B'itananhek d'ha Dios t'a skajnub'. B'itananhek t'ay yujto te niwan sb'inajnaquil t'a satcha’anh.
B'itananhek d'ha Dios yuj tas satub'tak sb'o'o. B'itananhek t'ay yuj sb'inajnaquil, malaj junok mach lajan yet'ok.
B'itananhek t'ay yet' k'een trompeta. B'itananhek t'ay yet' te' arpa yet' pax salterio.
B'itananhek t'ay yet' pandereta, tzex k'epax cheneljok yuj tzalajk'olal. B'itananhek t'ay yet' flauta yet' pax juntzanh yamk'ab' yik b'it ay sch'anhal.
B'itananhek t'ay yet' k'een platillo tzinhinhi sk'anhi. B'itananhek t'ay yet' k'een platillo chaanh sk'anhi.
Masanil tastak syik' yik', b'itanokab' t'a Jehová. Aljokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová.
Ha sk'ayb'ub'al winhaj Salomón, aton winh yuninal winhaj Dawid sreyal Israel.
Ix tz'ib'chajkan juntzanh lolonel tik yik wach' snachajel jelanil yet' k'ayb'ub'al, yik skolwaji, yik wach' snachajel juntzanh lolonel ay yelk'och kuuj.
Yuj chi' syal ko b'eyb'alan jelanil, wach'ilal yet' tojolal icha wal yaji.
In gana to sjelanb'i spensar heb' kelemtak, heb' mantalaj spensar, to tz'ak'ji yojtaquejel heb', yik syil sb'a heb'.
Yab'okab' juntzanh tik heb' ay spensar yik wach' ste ojtaquejel heb'. Yab'okab' pax heb' jelan yik wach' ste jelanb'i heb' yuj.
Ha juntzanh lolonel tik skolwaj qued'ok yik snachajel kuuj tas syalelk'och juntzanh lolonel satub'tak yet' ajaltak, aton tas syal heb' jelan.
Tato sko nib'ej jelan tzonh aji, aynhejokab' yelk'och Jehová t'a ko sat. Tato sko nib'ej manh pensaril jun, ko patiquejokab' el jelanil yet' k'ayb'ub'al tz'alchaji.
Ach wuninal, cha ab' a k'ayb'ub'al swala', manh a patiquejel razón syak' ix a nun t'ayach.
Yujto a juntzanh ko k'ayb'ub'al tik ol b'o a b'eyb'al yuj, icha wal junok mach te wach' tz'aj sb'oan sb'a yet' spichul.
Tato a heb' chuk sb'eyb'al tzach montanb'ati, manh ach b'atok.
Q'uinalok ay b'aj syal heb' t'ayach icha tik: Ochanh qued'ok yik wach' b'at ko maklejek t'a yol b'e, yik sko mak'cham junok anima tzek' ta'.
Malaj tas naan yuj, ol ko yamani, ol ko mak'anchamok.
Ichato chi' b'ian ol quik'ankan masanil makanhil b'eyumal, ol ko b'ut'an ko pat yuj masanil tas ol quelk'ej chi'.
Cotanh, ochanh qued'ok, ol kak'an ik t'a tastak ol quik'a', q'uinalok xchi heb'.
Palta ach wuninal, manh ach b'at yet' heb'. B'esel a b'ha t'a yol sb'e heb'.
Yujto axonhej chukal syak' yip heb' sk'ulani, toxonhej snanon sk'ool heb' smak'ancham anima.
Tato syil junok nok' much yem syaalil, nab'anhej am tz'emi.
Palta a juntzanh winak chi', a syaalil heb' syak'emi, anheja' heb' ol smilcham sb'a t'ay.
Ha heb' snib'ej tz'och b'eyumal t'a spatik chukal, ol k'och ijan ol cham heb' yuj schuk b'eyb'al chi'.
Ha t'a yoltak kalle, b'aj sja b'e, t'a merkado yet' t'a yalnhej b'aj smolb'ej sb'a heb' anima, tzonh yawtej Dios yik syak'an ko razón. Syalan icha tik:
Ha ex kelemtak ex tik, ex mantalaj he pensar, toxonton b'uchumtak ex, ¿b'aq'uinh ol eyaktejkan he nib'an he manh pensaril chi'? ¿b'aq'uinh ol eyaktejkan he b'uchwaji yet' he patikanel jelanil?
Chaec eyab' tas b'aj ol ex in kacha', tato icha chi', ol wak' in razón t'ayex, ol wak' eyojtaquejel in lolonel.
Ha in tik tzex wawtejkoti, palta malaj he gana tze cha eyab'i.
Tze patiquejel tas swala', max yal he k'ol tzex kachji.

Yuj chi' ol ex in tzetzej ayik ol ja chukal t'a eyib'anh, ayik ol ja xiwk'olal, yaelal, ilk'olal yet' kusk'olal t'a eyib'anh, icha tz'aj sja junok chakxuxum ik' slajanel masanil tastak. Ayic wan he cham yuj xiwelal chi', toxonhej ol in b'uchwaj t'ayex.
Ha t'a jun k'ual chi', ol ex te awaj t'ayin, palta manhxo ol in tak'woklaj t'ayex. Ol eyal he b'a t'ayin, palta manh ol wab'laj.
Yujto tze patiquejel jelanil, malaj he gana ay welk'och t'a he sat,
malaj he gana tzeyab' tas swala', tze patiquejel he kachnab'il swak'a',
yuj chi' ol eyab' syail yuj he b'eyb'al chi', ol ex somchajchaanh yuj.
Ha heb' mantalaj spensar, ol cham heb' yuj smanh pensaril. Ol satel heb' chuk spensar, yujto malaj yelk'och razón tz'ak'ji t'a heb'.
Axo pax heb' schaan yab' tas swala', junk'olal ol aj heb', malaj b'aj ol xiw heb', xchi Dios.
Ach wuninal, ak'och juntzanh in lolonel tik t'a a k'ool, sik'kan juntzanh in cheknab'il tik t'a a pensar.
Maclej ab' jelanil swala', ak' ip a naaneli.
D'a smasanil a k'ool tza k'an a jelanil yik ol ach jelanb'ok.
Ak' ip a sayaneq'ui, icha tz'aj saychaj k'een plata, ma junok b'eyumal to k'ub'aneli.
Icha chi' ol aj snachajel uuj, tas ol aj a k'anab'ajan Jehová yik tzojtaquejel t'a wal yel.
Ha Jehová tz'ak'an jelanil. Yuj slolonel skojtaquejel smasanil, syak'an jelanb'ok ko pensar.
Ha Jehová tz'ak'an sjelanil heb' tojol sb'eyb'al, aton heb' max esanlaj.
Ha Jehová stanhwan heb' wach' syutej sb'a, aton heb' sk'anab'ajani.
Yuj chi' tato tza maklej ab' in cheknab'il, ol ojtaquejel tojolal yet' tas smoj tza k'ulej, yik wach' ol aj a b'eyb'al.
Icha chi' ol aj sjelanb'i a pensar, ol ach tzalaj yet' tas ojtak chi'.
Ha jelanil yet' wach' pensaril, aton juntzanh chi' ol ach kolanok.
Ha yuj juntzanh chi' ol ik'el a b'ha t'a juntzanh chuk b'eyb'al yet' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' anima chuk spensar.
Ha heb' anima anhej chukal sk'ulej chi', syaktejkan wach' b'eyb'al heb'.
Stzalaj wal heb' yet' schuk b'eyb'al chi', ste k'echaanh heb' yet' sb'eyb'al malaj swach'il chi'.
D'a sb'eyb'al heb' chuk chi' syak'och spensar, syaktankan jun b'eyb'al heb' wach'.
Ha jelanil yet' wach' pensaril, ol ach skolel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ix ix ayxo yetb'eyum, aton heb' ix ajmul ix wach' smontan yet' slolonel te wach',
to yaktejnakkan yetb'eyum yik'nak t'a skob'esal, sb'atkan satk'olal sti' yak'nakkan t'a yichanh Dios.
Tato tzach b'at t'a sb'eal spat heb' ix chi', wan a b'atkan t'a sb'eal chamel.
Ha mach tz'ochkan t'a yol spat heb' ix, manhxa b'ak'uinh tz'elxita heb', maxtzak yal-laj skajnajxi t'a wach' t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik.
Tato tza cha ab' jelanil chi', ol a b'eyb'alej sb'eyb'al heb' tojol spensar.
Ha heb' tojol syutej sb'a, heb' malaj jab'ok spaltail, najtil ol ek' heb' t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik.
Axo heb' chuk sb'eyb'al yet' heb' ixtum anima, ol ik'joquel heb' t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik icha ko tok'ank'eta junok anh ank'ultak.
Ach wuninal, manh ak' sat a k'ool t'a juntzanh in k'ayb'ub'al tik. Sik'kan in cheknab'il tik t'a a pensar,
yik wach' ol najatb'ok a k 'inal yuj, tzalajk'olalnhej ol ach ek'ok.
Manh aktejkan a b'eyb'alan wach'il, tza k'anab'ajejnhej tas ix ala'. Cham wal a naani, satta a k'ool t'ay.
Yuj chi' wach' ach ol ach yil Dios, ol ach b'inajpax yuj heb' anima.
Ak'nhejoch a pensar t'a Jehová, manh ak'och a jelanil yipok a k'ool.
Nacot Jehová t'a masanil tas tza k'ulej yik wach' a ol kolwaj ed'ok t'a smasanil.
Manh a na' to te jelan ach, niwanokab' yelk'och Jehová t'ayach, tzik'el a b'ha t'a skal chukal.
Tato icha chi' tza k'ulej, junk'olal ol ach ajok, tek'an ol ach ajok.
Ch'oxeli to niwan yelk'och Jehová t'ayach. Tzak'an junok ofrenda t'ay t'a tas ay t'ayach yet' pax t'a juntzanh sb'ab'el sat tas tzawej.
Tato icha chi' tza k'ulej, malaj b'ak'uinh ol yak' palta a wael yet' tas tzuk'ej.
Ach wuninal, manh a patiquejel skachnab'il Jehová, mokab' kot owal ayik tzach stumani.
Yujto a heb' xajanab'il yuj, aton heb' chi' skacha', icha wal tz'aj skachan yuninal junok mamab'il to stzalaj yet'ok.
Tzalajk'olal yik heb' syik' sjelanil, aton heb' te ay spensar.
Yujto a tas tz'ik'ji t'a juntzanh chi' yelxo te wach' t'a yichanh tas tz'ik'ji t'a k'een plata, ma k'een oro.
Ha jelanil chi', yelxo wal te wach' t'a yichanh swach'il yilji k'een tz'och kolk'ab'il. Max yal-laj ko lajb'an jun jelanil chi' yet' juntzanhxo tastak te nib'ab'il.
Yuj jelanil chi' ol najatb'ok a k 'inal, yuj ol ik' a b'eyumal, ol ach b'inaj pax yuj.
Tato sko b'eyb'alej jelanil, tzalajk'olal tzonh eq'ui, junk'olal tzonh aji.
Tato tz'ilchaj jelanil kuuj, ay ko k 'inal, wach' ol onh ek'ok, tzalajk'olal quiko'.
Ha Jehová ixb’o’an satcha’anh yet' sat lum tik yuj sjelanil yet' yaj pensaril.
Yuj sjelanil chi' sk'eul sjaj ha ha', skotpax yal ak'wal t'a skal asun.
Ach wuninal, manh aktejkan a jelanil yet' a wach' pensaril, manh ik'el a sat t'ay.
Yujto ol najatb'ok a k 'inal yuj, wach' ol ach elk'och t'a sat heb' anima yuj.
Te junk'olalnhej ol ach ek'ok, malaj b'ak'uinh ay tas ol ach ik'anok.
Ayic ol ik'an ip, malaj mach b'aj ol ach xiwok, t'a tzalajk'olal ol ach wayok.
Yujto ayoch Jehová yipok a k'ool, yuj chi' manh ol ach schakan t'a junok yaal, manh ol a na' to ay tas ol ja t'a ib'anh, icha sja t'a yib'anh heb' chuk sb'eyb'al.
Manh ach b'at mikan t'a heb' sk'anan kolwal t'ayach tato syal tzach kolwaj t'a heb'.
Tato syal a kolwaj tiknaik, mokab' ala' to k'ik'anto tzach kolwaji.
Manh a na ak' chukal t'a heb' kajan t'a a lak'anil, yujto malaj schab'k'olal heb' t'ayach.
Manh ik'b'at heb' etanimail t'a yichanh heb' yajal tato malaj tzach yutej heb'.
Manh a nib'ejoch b'eyumal icha syutej sb'a heb' malaj jab'ok yok'elk'olal, manh a k'ulej icha sb'eyb'al heb' chi'.
Yujto max scha sk'ool Jehová heb' chuk syutej sb'a chi', haxo pax heb' wach' syutej sb'a, wach' yak'an yet' heb'.
Scot skatab' Jehová t'a yib'anh heb' chuk sb'eyb'al yet' t'a yib'anh heb' kajan yet' heb', haxo pax t'a heb' tojol sb'eyb'al, syak' swach'k'olal.
Sb'uchwaj Jehová t'a heb' b'uchumtak, haxo t'a heb' emnaquil syutej sb'a, syak' swach'k'olal.
Ha heb' sb'eyb'alan wach'il, ol ik'jokchaanh heb', haxo heb' chuk spensar, ol ak'jok q'uixwelal heb'.
Ex wuninal, chaek eyab' in lolonel swala'. Maclejec eyab'i yik wach' ol jelanb'ok he pensar yuj.
Ha k'ayb'ub'al te wach' swak' t'ayex, yuj chi' tzeyailejnhej t'a masanil tiempo.
Ayic quelem unin in, ayinto ek' t'a yol spat in mam, yelxo wal xajanab'il in yuj ix in nun.
Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', icha tik ajnak yak'an in k'ayb'ub'al winh in mam. Yalannac winh icha tik: Sik'kan in lolonel tik t'a a pensar, k'anab'ajej tas swal tik, yik wach' ay a k 'inal.
Cha a jelanil yet' a wach' pensaril, manh ak'b'at in lolonel tik satk'olal.
Xajanej a jelanil, manh a patiquejeli, yujto ol ach kolchaj yuj.
Yowalil tza sayek' jelanil t'a junjun k'u. Wach'chom ajaltak tz'aj yilchaj uuj, palta te wach' ama tato a tza b'ab'laj sayejek' t'a yichanh juntzanhxo tas ay t'ayach.
Nib'ejoch jelanil, yik wach' ol ach ik'jokchaanh yuj, yik wach' niwan ol aj elk'och t'a yol sat heb' etanimail.
Ha yuj jelanil chi', wach' ol ach elk'ochok, ol och k'elan heb' anima yuj a jelanil chi', xchikan winh in mam chi' t'ayin.
Axo tiknaik ach wuninal, cha wal ab' juntzanh in lolonel tik, yik wach' ol najatb'ok a k 'inal.
Ha in ol ach wik' b'ey t'a sb'eyb'al heb' jelan, ol wak'an a b'eyb'alej tojolal.
Ha t'a tojol b'eyb'al chi', malaj tas ol ach yamanoch waan, wach'chom yelk'olal ol ach b'atok, palta manh ol ach telwoklaj.
Ak'och a pensar t'a k'ayb'ub'al tik, manh a patiquejeli. Yelxo wal tza b'eyb'alej yik wach' ay a k 'inal.
Manh ach b'at tzak'an t'a spatik heb' chuk sb'eyb'al, manh a k'ulej icha tas sk'ulej heb'.
B'esel a b'ha t'a skal heb', ak' ip a b'eyb'alan wach'il.
Max ochlaj swayanh heb' tato max sk'ulej chukal heb', max yik'laj yip heb', tato malaj junok mach syixtej heb'.
Ha chukal yet' ixtoj anima, a juntzanh chi' swael heb' yaji.
Ha sb'eyb'al heb' tojol spensar, lajan icha ayik wanto sakb'i masanto sk'e k'u, scheklaj spatik yichanh heb' yuj.
Axo sb'eyb'al heb' chuk spensar jun, lajan icha yik tzonh b'eyek' t'a skal k’ik’ k’inal, manh chequelok b'aj sko tenoch kok.
Ach wuninal, cha ab' in lolonel tik, maklej wal ab' sik'lab'il.
Mokab' ik'el a sat t'ay, sik'kan t'a a pensar,
yujto a juntzanh lolonel tik tz'ak'an sk'inal heb' tz'ilchaj yuj.
Tza ya'ilej a pensar t'a yichanh masanil tastak ay t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, yujto a a pensar chi' tzach kuchb'an t'a wach'il, ma t'a chukal.
Manh esalwumok tzutej a b'a, manh a komon alej pax chukal lolonel.
Te tojolnhej tzach b'at t'a ichanh t'a sb'eal wach'il, manh ach b'at k'elan t'a tas malaj swach'il.
Tza ya'ilej wal tas tza k'ulej icha wal ko sik'lan ko b'e b'aj tzonh b'eyi, aokab' wal sb'eal wach'il b'aj tzach ochi.
Manh ach elkan t'a jun b'e te tojol, manh ach b'atkan t'a sb'eal chukal.
Ach wuninal, cha ab' in jelanil tik, scham wal a maklan ab' in razón wach' swala'.
Icha chi' ol aj snachajel uuj, ol yal a lolon yet' jelanil.
Ha junok ix ix ay yetb'eyum, te wach' slolon ix, k'ununi slolon ix yik tzach smontejb'at ix t'a chukal.
Axo t'a slajwub'al, lajanxo tz'aj ix icha anh ixaj te k'a', icha wal tz'aj ko lajwi yuj k'een espada chab' ye.
Ha mach sb'eyek' yet' jun ix ix chi', ol chamok. Ha sb'eyb'al jun ix ix chi', b'eal chamel yaji.
Ha t'a ix chi' malaj yelk'och sb'eal k 'inal, max snalaj ix tato wach', mato chuk sb'eyb'al ix chi'.
Yuj chi' ach wuninal, ab' tas swala'. Manh ik'kanel a b'ha t'a a kachnab'il swak' tik.
Najat tzach el t'a stz'ey ix ay yetb'eyum chi', xach k'ochta wal t'a spuertail spat ix.
Tato maay, ol satel a b'inaj t'a wach'il, elanhchamel ol ach cham yuj junok winh malaj yok'elk'olal.
Tato icha chi' tza k'ulej, jantaknhej a b'eyumal ix ilchaj uuj ayik ix ak'an wal ip a munlaji, ol ak'kanb'at t'a yol sk'ab' junok ch'ok animail.
Tato tza k'anab'ajej tas syal ix, toxonhej ol ach ok'kanek'ok, jab'jab'il ol lajwoquem a niwanil.
Axo ol alan icha tik: ¿Tas wal yuj ix in patiquejel in kachnab'il? ¿Tas wal yuj maj in k'anab'ajej?
Maj yal in k'ool ix in cha wab' tas ix yal heb' in k'ayb'umal, oktom ix in cha wab' t'a heb'.
Axo tiknaik jab'xonhej maj in juwiel t'a yichanh masanil chonhab' t'a junelnhej, xa chama.
Uk' ha ha' iktaxon yaji yik wach' tzek' stak'inhal a ti'. (Syalelk'ochi anhej yet' ix etb'eyum tzak' a gana.)
¿Tas wal yuj ol aj uninal yet' heb' ix ix tzek' t'a yoltak kalle?
Wach' skolwaj heb' uninal ed'ok, t'a yichanh junokxo mach b'aj skolwaj heb' uninal chi'.
Tzalajanh, ayokab' uninal yet' ix etb'eyum chi', aton ix, ix ik' a b'a yet'ok ayik quelem achto.
Wach'okab' yilji ix t'a yol a sat, icha wal junok nok' k'ultaquil chej. Mokab' lajwok a tzalajk'olal t'a ix, ayokab' a tzalajk'olal chi' yujto xajan ach yuj ix.
Ach wuninal, manh ak' somchajel a pensar yuj junok ix ix ayxo yetb'eyum. ¿Tas yuj ol ach och chelchel t'a junxo ix ix chi'?
Ha Jehová wan ton yilan ko b'eyb'al junjun onh, malaj junok tas max uji yilani.
Ha heb' chuk, anheja' schukal heb' chi' ol ak'an juwoquelok. Anheja' schukal heb' chi' ol tzek'anok, icha ko tzek'ji t'a junok lasu.
Yujto max syamoch waan sb'a heb', yuj chi' ol b'atkan heb' t'a chamel. Yuj smanh pensaril heb' chi', ol satkanel heb'.
Ach wuninal, tato tzak'och a b'a a majnan k'een tumin yuj junok ch'ok animail t'a junok etchonhab',
wan ak'anem a yaalil, ol kotkan t'a ib'anh yuj b'aj ix ak'och a b'a chi'.

Ach wuninal, icha tik tzutej a kolanel a b'ha t'a yol sk'ab' winh aj tumin chi'. Ixic, emnaquil tzutej a b'a tzach tewi t'a winh, tza k'anan niwank'olal a b'ha t'a winh yik max ach yak' pural winh a tupanel sb'ok winh b'aj ix ak'och a b'a chi'.
Smoj wal maxtzak ach way yuj, mokxob' ik' ip junok rato
masanto tzach el t'a yalanh, icha wal yel junok nok' k'ultaquil chej t'a junok mach pechjinak, ma icha yel junok nok' much t'a junok yaal.
Ach anima malaj a gana a munlaji, ilnab' nok' ch'equem, sik'lab'il tzila' tas syutej nok' smunlaji yik tz'ilchaj swael nok', scham wal a k'ayb'an t'a nok'.
Wach'chom malaj mach schekan munlaj nok', malaj yajal nok' tz'alan yab' tas sk'ulej,
palta ayik stiempoan swael nok', syak' wal yip nok' smunlaji yik smolankan swael nok' chi'.
Ach anima malaj a gana a munlaji, k'okb'ilxo chi' tzach wayi. k'okb'ilxo chi' tzach ek' jichan.
Yakb'an skot numumok a wayanh, sneknekan a jolom, jeljumb'a tz'aj a k'ab', te wach' tz'aj a wayi,
haxo tz'aji, skot mheb'ail t'a ib'anh, ste b'at t'a ib'anh icha junok winh elk'um ed'jinak junok k'een kuchilub'.
Ha heb' chuk spensar, anhej es tzek' yal heb' t'a skal heb' anima.
Smutz'mutz'an sat heb' yak'an yechel, sch'oxanpax heb' yet' yiximal sk'ab'.
Junelnhej te chuk spensar heb', axonhej malaj swach'il sna sk'ulej heb'. Ha b'aj tzek' heb', anhej owal sq'ekan waan yuj heb'.
Yuj chi' elanhchamel ol ja yaelal t'a yib'anh heb'. Junnhej mutz'satil ol aj slajwiem heb', manhxa tas ol yal yuj heb'.

Ay uque' tas chakb'ilel yuj Jehová t'a junelnhej: Aton ik'ojchanhb'ail, esalwumal, mak'ojcham anima malaj smul, naojchaanh tas malaj swach'il, chukal sk'ulaji, ak'ojoch es t'a yib'anh junokxo mach yet' ik'ojchaanh owal t'a skal anima.
Ach wuninal, sik'kan juntzanh in k'ayb'ub'al tik t'a a pensar yet' a k'ayb'ub'al syak' ix a nun.
Sik'kan t'a a pensar, naannhejokab' uuj t'a masanil tiempo.
Ha ol ach kuchb'an b'aj ol ach ek'ok, manh ol ach xiwok ayik ol ach wayok. Ayic ol el a wayanh, anheja' juntzanh tik naan uuj.
D'a wal yel a a kachnab'il yet' a k'ayb'ub'al tik, icha sakq'uinal yaj t'ayach. Ha a kachnab'il chi' yet' a pensar tzach kuchb'anb'at t'a sb'eal k 'inal.
Ha ol ach kolanel t'a yol sk'ab' ix ix chuk spensar yet' ix ayxo winh yetb'eyum to te wach' smontan yet' slolonel.
Manh ak'och a pensar t'a swach'il yilji ix, manh a cha somchajel a k'ool yuj chajtil tzach aj yilanoch ix.
Ha mach smulan yet' ix ajmul ix, skot mheb'ail t'a yib'anh, haxo mach smontaj yuj ix ay yetb'eyum yik smulan ix yet'ok, syik'kot chamel t'a yib'anh.
Q'uinalok ay junok mach tz'ik'anb'at te' tzak'ak' t'a snhi' sk'ool, max ek'b'atlaj stz'ab'at spichul yuj te'.
Ha mach sb'ey t'a yib'anh te' tzak'ak', max ek'b'atlaj stz'ab'at yok yuj te'.
Ha mach smulan yet' ix ix ay yetb'eyum chi', yowalil skot t'a yib'anh.
Tato ay junok elk'um tz'elk'an junok tasi yujto ay swejel, tzato naji wal t'a yib'anh,
palta wach'chom icha chi', tato syamchaji, yowalil uquel tz'aj stupan tas ix yelk'ej chi', taxonhej manhxalaj tas skan t'ay.
Tato ay mach tzek' yet' ix ayxo winh yetb'eyum, yelxo wal malaj jab'ok spensar. Ha mach icha chi' sk'ulej, anhej syak' lajwok sb'a.
Ol scha syaelal, ol mak'jokpaxi, manhxa b'ak'uinh ol b'at sq'uixwelal chi' satk'olal yuj heb' anima.
Ha winh ix ixtaj ix yetb'eyum chi', te ow winh icha te tzak'ak', manh jab'ok syak' niwank'olal winh ayik sk'och stiempoal yak'anek' spak winh.
Ha silab' winh ay smul chi' syak' t'a winh, max schalaj winh, wach'chom te niwan silab' chi', palta max yak'laj niwank'olal winh.
Ach wuninal, cha ab' in lolonel tik. Ha juntzanh in cheknab'il swak' tik t'ayach, yowalil tza sik'kan t'a a pensar.
k'anab'ajej in cheknab'il tik yet' in k'ayb'ub'al yik wach' ol ach ek'ok. Icha skutej ko ya'ilan snenal yol ko sat, icha chi' tzutej a ya'ilan a kachnab'il swak' tik.
Naannhejokab' uuj, tza sik'ankan t'a a pensar.
Xajanej a jelanil yujto icha anab' yaji, ma icha a wach'k'ool.
Icha chi' ol aj a kolchajel t'a yol sk'ab' ix ajmul ix, aton ix ayxo yetb'eyum, ix te wach' smontan yet' slolonel.
Ay junel ix wilelta t'a swentenail in pat,
ay juntzanh heb' winh kelemtak malaj jab'ok sjelanil ayeq'ui. Axo ix wilani, ay jun winh malaj jab'ok spensar t'a skal heb' winh chi'.
Ayic wanxo yem k'u, wanxo sq'uik'b'i, ix eq'uixk'och winh t'a jun esquina, ix sk'axpitanek' kalle winh, t'a stojolal b'aj ay spat jun ix ix ay yetb'eyum.
Ix elta lemnaj ix scha winh. Icha spichul heb' ix ajmul ix spichul ix ayochi, icha pax spensar heb' ix chi' spensar ix.
Comonnhej slolon ix, max q'uixwilaj jab'ok ix, max emlaj k'ojan ix t'a spat.
Anhej t'a yoltak kalle tzek' ix, t'a merkado yet' t'a yesquinailtak kalle, ata' smaklej ix yek' junok winak.
Ha jun ix chi', ix och lak'naj ix t'a winh quelem chi', ix och tz'ub'naj ix t'a sti' winh, maj q'uixwoklaj jab'ok ix, ix yalan ix icha tik:
Ha tiknaik ix wak' in silab' yik in junk'olal alb'ilxo wuuj, yuj chi' ayto nok' chib'ej t'a in pat tiknaik.
Yuj chi' ix in elta ach in maklej, yujto in gana tzach wila''. Tik ach ilchaj wuuj.
Ha t'a sat in ch'at toxo ix in lich'em jun sábana nab'a lino, kotnak t'a Egipto.
Toxo ix wak'och perfume t'ay, toxonhej suk'uq'ui sjab', aton mirra, áloes yet' te' kanela.
Cotanh wed'ok, ol kak' wal ko gana masanto ol sakb'ok. Ol kak' wal tzalajb'ok ko k'ool ko xajanan ko b'a.
Ha winh wetb'eyum, malaj winh ayek' t'a in pat tik, yujto ay b'aj te najat ix b'at winh.
Ix yik'b'at jun mukuk k'een tumin winh, yuj chi' manto ol jalaj winh masanto ol k'och sk'ual sk'ojnaj k'een uj, xchi ix ix chi'.
Ha tas te wach' ix yal ix chi', elanhchamel ix montaj winh quelem chi' yuj.
Yuj chi' ix och tzak'an winh yuj ix, icha yik'jib'at junok nok' wakax b'aj ol chamok, ma icha junok nok' k'ultaquil chej skan t'a ch'anh yaal,
masanto ol ek' junok jul-lab' t'a spixan nok'. Icha pax junok nok' much skan t'a te' yaal, icha chi' yaj winh, max snalaj jab'ok winh tato ha t'a spat ix chi' ol cham winh.
Yuj chi' ach wuninal, maklej ab' tas swala'. Tanhwej wal ab' in lolonel tik.
Manh a juel a wach' b'eyb'al t'a junok ix ix icha chi' spensar, yik wach' manh ol ach satelok.
Yujto tzijtumxo mach toxo ix cham yuj heb' ix ix icha chi' sk'ulej. Manhxo b'ischajb'enok mach scham yuj heb' ix.
Tato tzach b'at t'a sb'eal spat heb' ix ix icha chi', wan a b'atkan t'a sb'eal chamel.
Ex kelemtak ab'ek, yujto tzex awtaji yik tzeyik' he jelanil, yik sq'uib' pax he pensar.
Yalnhej b'aj ayex eq'ui, t'a junok tzalan, ma t'a yol b'e, ma b'aj schalaj sb'a b'e, tzex awtaji.
Anhejtona' t'a spuertail he chonhab', tzex awtajpaxi.
E masanil ex anima ayex t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, ab'ek.
Ex kelemtak to mantalaj he pensar, k'ayb'ejek he b'ha t'a jelanil. Ex chuk he pensar, sayek jelan pensaril.
Ab'ek wal sik'lab'il, ol alchaj juntzanh tastak niwak yelk'och t'ayex, manhxo jantakok swach'il.
Te yel tas ol alchaj t'ayex, malaj tas tonhej ol nachajk'eok.
Masanil juntzanh lolonel tik wach'nhej, malaj jab'ok es t'ay.
Ha heb' jelan, sekojtak tz'aj snachajel juntzanh lolonel tik yuj heb'. Ha heb' ay spensar yojtak heb' tas syalelk'ochi.
Hak'ek eyip eyik'an he jelanil yet' aj pensaril, yujto yelxo wal te niwan yelk'och t'a yichanh k'een oro yet' k'een plata.
Yelxo wal te wach' jelanil t'a yichanh k'een k'een te wach' yilji yet' t'a yichanh junok tas snib'aj wal ochi.
Ha jelanil, yetb'eyum sb'a yet' wach' pensaril. Syak' kojtaquejel juntzanh wach' razonal.
Tato ay yelk'och Jehová t'ayonh, sko chakkanel chukal. Tato jelan onh, max yal-laj quik'anchaanh ko b'a. Max ko nib'ejochlaj chuk b'eyb'al yet' es.
Tato ay ko jelanil, syal ko naan junok tas sko k'ulej t'a stojolal, tz'elnhejpaxk'ochi.
Ha yuj jelanil syak' yajalil heb' rey, tojol syutej heb' sch'olb'itan tastak yaj heb' yetanimail.
Yuj jelanil chi', a heb' ayoch yajalil, wach' syutej heb' stanhwan schonhab', wach' pax syutej heb' sb'oan yaj yowal heb' anima.
Ha mach sayanek' jelanil yet' smasanil sk'ool, tz'ilchaj yuj.
Yuj jelanil chi', tz'aj ko b'eyumal, tzonh b'inaj yuj, ay pax quelk'ochi.
Ha tas tz'ilchaj yuj jelanil chi', yelxo te wach' t'a yichanh k'een oro yet' k'een plata sik'b'ileli.
Yuj jelanil, sko b'eyb'alej wach'ilal yet' tojolal.
Ha mach snib'an jelanil, ol yik' sb'eyumal yuj. Ol b'ud'jok spat yuj masanil tastak wach'.
Ha jelanil chi', aytaxoneq'ui ayik ix el yich smunlajel Jehová, ayik manto sb'o masanil tastak,
ayik manto sb'o yol yib'anhk’inal tik,
ayik mantalaj ha' niwak mar, mantalaj pax sjaj ha' niwak ha' sk'euli yet' pax sjaj ha' kotak ha'.
Ayic manto sb'olaj lum tzalquixtak yet' lum niwak witz, ayxoek' jelanil chi' ta'.
Ix yik'kanel yich jelanil Jehová ayik manto sb'olaj lum lum tik, mantalaj spokokal jun yol yib'anhk’inal tik ta'.
Ayic ix sb'oank'e satcha’anh masanto b'aj schalaj sb'a yet' ha' mar, aytaxon ek' jelanil chi' ta'.
Ayic ix sb'oan asun ay t'a satcha’anh yet' pax yik ix syamanoch waan ha' mar,
ayik ix yalan t'ha ha' mar chi' to manh ol el ha' b'aj aykani yet' pax ix yak'anem yich lum lum tik, aytaxon ek' jelanil chi' ta'.
Ha yuj sjelanil Dios ix sb'ok'e masanil tastak, ste tzalaj yuj tastak ix sb'o chi', yujto ha' sch'oxanel sjelanil.
Stzalaj yuj yol yib'anhk’inal yet' heb' anima sb'onak.
Axo tiknaik ex anima, ab'ek wal tas tz'alchaj t'ayex, b'eyb'alejek jelanil yik te wach' eyiko'.
Chaec eyab' he k'ayb'ub'al, manh he patiquejel jelanil.
Te wach' yik mach scham wal yab'an lolonel yik jelanil,
yujto a mach tz'ilchaj jelanil chi' yuj, tz'ilchajpax sk'inal, syik'anpax swach'k'olal Jehová.
Palta a mach max chaan yab' lolonel yik jelanil, munil syik'kot yaelal t'a yib'anh.
Ha ix wilani, ichato ay jun ix ix, ix sb'ok'e spat, te wach' ix aj yilji, uque' wal yoyal ix yak'em ix.
Ix smilcham nok' nok' ix, ix sb'oan jun niwan wael ix, ix sb'oan wino ix te wach', ix sb'oanb'at ix t'a sat smexa.
Ixlajwi chi', ix schekanb'at heb' schekab' ix t'a juntzanh tzalquixtak ay t'a yol chonhab'.
Axo heb' schekab' ix chi' ix alan icha tik: Ex kelemtak mantalaj he jelanil, kotanhek. Ex malaj he pensar, kotanhek.
Ol ex waok, ol eyuk'an wino to wach'xo yaji.
Actejekkan he manh pensaril chi' yik wach' tzalajk'olal ol ex ajok. B'eyb'alejek sb'eyb'al heb' te jelan spensar, xchi heb' schekab' ix chi'. Ha jun ix ix chi', a jelanil sch'oxo'.
Tato tzal t'a heb' b'uchumtak to chuk sk'ulej heb', anhej lolonel manh wach'ok ol yal heb' t'ayach. Tato tzal t'a heb' chuk to manh wach'ok syutej sb'a heb', tonhej ol ach sb'aj heb'.
Tato tza kach heb' anima ak'umtak, ol och heb' ajk'olal t'ayach. Tato tzal t'a heb' ay spensar b'ajtil tz'och spaltail heb', ol ach xajanej heb'.
k'ayb'ej heb' jelan yik wach' ol te jelanb'ok heb'. k'ayb'ej heb' anima wach' spensar yik wach' ol ste ojtaquejel heb'.
Tato sko nib'ej jelan tzonh aji, ayokab' yelk'och Jehová t'a ko sat. Tato skojtaquejel Dios to Axonhej Ochi, tz'akan ko pensar sik'lab'il syal chi'.
Ha yuj jelanil chi', ol najatb'ok ko k 'inal, te tzijtum ab'il ol quila'.
Tato ay ko jelanil, quiknhej yaj wach'ilal. Tato b'uchumtak skutej ko b'a jun, munil t'a quib'anh ol kotkan yaelal.
Ha junok ix ix malaj spensar, manh jantakok slolon ix, max q'uixwilaj jab'ok ix, malaj pax jab'ok tas snachajel yuj ix.
Tonhej tz'em k'ojan ix t'a yol xila, t'a sti' spat chaanh yajk'e t'a tzalan t'a yol chonhab',
syawtankot heb' tojolnhej tzek' t'a yol b'e chi' ix, syalan ix icha tik:
Ex kelemtak mantalaj he jelanil, kotanhek, xchi ix. Syalanpax ix t'a heb' malaj spensar:
Ha ha ha' tz'elk'aji, te wach' yuk'ji ha'. Ha jab'ok wael sko wa t'a elk'altak te wach', xchi ix.
Axo heb' winh kelemtak chi', manh yojtakok heb' winh tato a heb' winh yawtejnakkot ix, chamnakxo heb' winh tiknaik.
Ha juntzanh slolonel winhaj Salomón: Ha heb' uninab'il ay spensar, syak' tzalajb'ok sk'ool smam snun heb'. Axo heb' malaj spensar, syak' kus sk'ol smam snun heb' chi'.
Tato squik' ko b'eyumal t'a chukal, malaj skak' yala'. Tato tojol ko b'eyb'al, tzonh kolchajel yuj t'a yol sk'ab' chamel.
Ha Jehová malaj b'aj ol scha cham heb' wach' sb'eyb'al yuj wejel, palta haxo heb' chuk jun, max chajilaj yak' snib'ej heb' yuj.
Tato malaj ko gana tzonh munlaji, skot mheb'ail t'a quib'anh. Tato tzonh munlaj sik'lab'il jun, tzonh och b'eyumal.
Tato ay ko spensar, sko molb'ejkan sat tas skawej t'a stiempoal. Tato tonhej tzonh way t'a stiempoal smolchaj sat awb'en chi' jun, skak' q'uixwelal ko b'a.
Ha heb' anima wach' spensar, manh jantakok swach'k'olal Dios scha heb'. Axo heb' chuk jun, a yuj chukal sk'ulej heb', skotkan yaelal t'a yib'anh heb'.
Ha heb' wach' spensar, t'a wach'ilal ol aj snajikot heb'. Axo pax heb' chuk jun, manhxa mach ol naankot heb'.
Tato ay ko pensar, ol ko k'anab'ajej tas schekji ko k'ulej. Palta tato tonhej tzonh komon lolon jun, ol onh satel yuj.
Tato wach' ko b'eyb'al, malaj b'aj ol onh xiwok. Tato a chukal sko k'ulej jun, ol onh yamchajelta.
Ha heb' stz'eptz'epan sat snaan junok chukal, skotkan niwak yaelal yuj heb'. Yujto ste komon lolon heb', yuj chi' ol satel heb'.
Ha slolonel heb' wach' spensar, a ol ak'an wach'ilal t'a skal heb' anima. Axo heb' chuk jun, a yuj chukal sk'ulej heb', ol kotkan yaelal t'a yib'anh heb'.
Tato ay ko chichonk'olal, a owal sk'e waan kuuj. Palta tato sko xajanej heb' quetanimail, skak'nhej niwank'olal heb'.
Tato ay ko pensar, scheklajel ko jelanil t'a tas skala'. Tato malaj ko pensar jun, tzonh mak'jinhej t'a te' jixk'ab' te'.
Tato jelan ko pensar, sko ya'ilej tas skala'. Palta tato malaj ko pensar jun, tzonh te loloni, anhej chukal sk'e waan yuj tas skal chi'.
Ha heb' b'eyum, a sb'eyumal heb' skolani. Axo pax heb' meb'a' jun, malaj tas syal skolan heb'.
Ha ko k 'inal sko cha spakok ko wach' b'eyb'al. Palta tato chuk skutej ko b'a jun, a yaelal sko cha spakok.
Tato sko cha kab' ko kachnab'il, snajatb'i ko k 'inal. Tato max ko cha kab' jun, quennhej tiempo squila'.
Ha heb' elk'altak schichon sk'ol t'a junokxo anima, esalwum heb'. Ha heb' anhej aloj pekal tzek' yala', malaj jab'ok spensar heb'.
Tato tzonh te komon loloni, tz'och ko mul t'a skal tas skal chi'. Tato max onh lolon jun, ay ko pensar syal chi'.
Ha slolonel heb' wach' spensar, te niwan yelk'och icha k'een plata te wach'. Axo pax spensar heb' chuk jun, malaj jab'ok yelk'ochi.
Ha slolonel heb' wach' spensar, manh jantakok heb' sk'ayb'aj yuj. Axo heb' malaj spensar jun, scham heb' yuj smanh pensaril chi'.
Ha yuj swach'k'olal Jehová, tzonh och b'eyumal, manh yujok b'aj tzonh te munlaji.
Ha heb' malaj spensar, ste k'echaanh heb' ayik sk'ulan chukal heb'. Axo heb' ay spensar jun, syak' tzalajb'ok sk'ool heb' yuj sjelanil.
Ha tastak b'aj xiw heb' chuk, a sjawi t'a yib'anh heb'. Axo heb' wach' spensar jun, tz'elk'och tas snib'ej heb'.
Ha heb' chuk sb'eyb'al, quennhej tiempo tzek' heb' icha junok chakxuxum ik'. Axo pax heb' wach' spensar jun, aynhejek' heb' t'a junelnhej.
Tato sko chek junok jaragana, skab' syail yuj, ek'to t'a spajil yal nok' winagre t'a k'een que, ek'to icha syail sb'at te tab' t'a yol ko sat.
Tato ay yelk'och Jehová t'ayonh, snajatb'i ko k 'inal. Palta tato chuk sko k'ulej jun, stzap ko k 'inal.

Ha heb' wach' spensar tek'annhej yajek' heb'. Axo heb' chuk spensar, manh niwanok tiempo tzek' heb' t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik.
Ha heb' wach' spensar, anhej jelanil syal heb'. Axo heb' chuk slolon jun, maxtzak chajilaj lolon heb', ichato spolchajel yak' heb'.
Ha heb' wach' spensar, tzonh tzalaj yuj tas syal heb'. Axo pax heb' chuk spensar jun, anhej chukal lolonel syal heb'.
Ha echlab' manh tz'akanok, max schalaj sk'ol Jehová. Axo echlab' tz'akan jun, stzalaj sk'ool yet'ok.
Ha heb' ak'umtak, syak' q'uixwelal sb'a heb'. Axo heb' emnaquil syutej sb'a, jelan tz'aj heb'.
Ha heb' tojol spensar, a stojolal heb' chi' skuchb'ani. Axo pax heb' chuk jun, satel heb' yuj schab'satil.
Ayic ol jawok sk'ual ko ch'olb'itaji, manhxalaj yopisio ko b'eyumal, axonhej ko tojolal ol onh kolanel t'a chamel.
Tato tojol skutej ko b'a, a tojolal chi' tzonh ik'an b'ey t'a wach'ilal. Axo heb' chuk jun, anheja' schukal heb' chi' tz'ik'an sateli.
Tato tojol skutej ko b'a, a tojolal chi' tzonh kolan t'a yol sk'ab' chukal. Ha heb' chuk sb'eyb'al, a chukal snib'ej heb', a tz'ik'ankot t'a yib'anh heb'.

Ha heb' malaj spensar, chuklaj tas syal heb' t'a spatik heb' yetanimail. Axo heb' ay spensar jun, cham naab'il slolonel heb' syala'.

Ha heb' ix ix wach' spensar, tz'ik'jichaanh heb' ix. Axo heb' winh winak pek' tumin, anhej k'een tumin chi' tz'ilchaj yuj heb' winh.
Tato tz'ok' ko k'ool t'a heb' quetanimail, a t'ayonh syak' wach'il. Tato skak' chukal t'a heb' quetanimail chi' jun, anheja' onh squik'kot chukal t'a quib'anh.
Ha heb' chuk sb'eyb'al, a tas wach' scha heb' spakok yalani. Axo heb' tojol spensar jun, wal yel te wach' tas scha heb' spakok sb'eyb'al chi'.

Ha heb' max chonhanlaj ixim strigo, tonhej smolb'ejkan ixim heb', te chuk syal anima t'a spatik heb'. Axo heb' yechel schonhan ixim jun, a wach'il tz'aljikan t'a yib'anh heb'.

Ha heb' wach' spensar, syak'kan smakb'en heb' yixchiquin heb'. Axo sb'eyumal heb' chuk jun, ha t'a heb' wach' spensar skani.
Ha t'a sluum heb' meb'a', manh jantakok tas wach' syal yel t'a sat, palta yuj smanh pensaril heb', malaj tas syik' heb' t'a sluum chi'.
Tato max kak' tzalaj heb' kuninal, manh xajanok heb' kuuj syal chi'. Tato sko xajanej heb' jun, yunetakto heb' sko yamanoch kak'an tzalaj heb'.
Ha heb' tojol spensar, swa heb' masanto sb'ud'ji heb'. Axo pax heb' chuk spensar jun, tz'ochnhej swejel heb'.
Ha heb' ix ix ay spensar, wach'nhej yaj yol spat heb' ix. Axo pax heb' ix malaj spensar jun, juwinaquel yol spat heb' ix yuj.
Tato wach' ko b'eyb'al, te ay yelk'och Jehová t'ayonh. Axo pax heb' chuk sb'eyb'al jun, malaj yelk'och Jehová t'a heb'.
Ha tas syal heb' malaj spensar, a tz'ik'ankot yaelal t'a yib'anh heb'. Axo pax tas syal heb' ay spensar jun, a skolan heb'.
Tato malaj nok' wakax smunlaj t'a d'okoj lu'um, malaj ixim trigo sko molo'. Yuj smunlajel nok' wakax chi', niwan ixim trigo chi' squik'a'.
Ha heb' testigo wach', anhej yel syal heb'. Axo pax heb' testigo chuk jun, sekojtak tz'aj yesan heb'.
Ha heb' b'uchumtak, sayek' jelanil heb', palta max ilchajlaj yuj heb'. Axo pax heb' jelan spensar jun, sekojtak tz'aj yilchaj jelanil yuj heb'.
Quik'equel ko b'ha t'a stz'ey heb' malaj spensar, yujto malaj tas ol quik'elta t'a slolonel heb' syala'.
Ha heb' ay spensar, sna wal heb' sik'lab'il tas sk'ulej. Axo pax heb' malaj spensar jun, syak' musansatil sb'a heb'.
Ha heb' malaj spensar, malaj tas sna heb' yuj chukal sk'ulej. Axo pax heb' anima wach' spensar jun, snib'ej heb' to tz'ak'ji niwank'olal yuj Dios.
Ha onnhej kojtak tas yuj tzonh kusi, ma tas yuj tzonh tzalaji. Ha heb' ch'ok animail, malaj yalan yik heb' t'a tas sko na chi'.
Ha yinhtilal heb' chuk spensar, ol satelok, palta a yinhtilal heb' wach' spensar jun, ol q'uib'nhej.
Ay wal b'eyb'al te wach' ko naani, palta wan onh yik'anb'at t'a chamel.
Ay b'aj tzonh tzewaji, palta kusnak ko k'ool. Ay b'aj tzonh te tzalaji, palta kusk'olalxo slajwielk'ochi.
Ha heb' tz'aktankan wach' b'eyb'al, stzalaj heb' yuj schuk b'eyb'al. Axo pax heb' anima wach' spensar jun, stzalaj heb' yuj swach' b'eyb'al.
Ha heb' malaj spensar, masanil tas tz'alchaji syak'och heb' t'a sk'ool. Axo pax heb' ay spensar jun, scham wal yilan heb' tas sk'ulej.
Ha heb' ay spensar, ay xiwk'olal heb', yuj chi' syik'el sb'a heb' t'a chukal. Axo pax heb' malaj spensar jun, komonnhej syak'och sb'a heb' t'a yalnhej tas.
Ha heb' k'un skot yowal, malaj spensar heb', komonnhej syutej sb'a heb'. Ha heb' snaan chukal yik wach' tzek' yuj, chakb'ilel heb'
Ha spak scha heb' malaj spensar, aton manh pensaril. Axo spak scha heb' ay spensar jun, to swach' jakwi spensar heb'.
Ha heb' chuk, syak'em sb'a heb' t'a heb' wach', stewioch heb' t'a spuertail spat heb' wach' chi'.
Ha heb' meb'a', patikab'ilel heb' yuj heb' yetanimail. Axo pax heb' b'eyum jun, manh jantakok yamigo heb'.
Tz'och ko mul tato sko patiquejel heb' quetanimail, palta te wach' quiko' tato tz'ok' ko k'ool t'a heb' meb'a'.
Ha heb' anhej chukal snib'ej sk'ulej, sjuwiel heb' yuj tas sna chi'. Axo pax heb' snib'ej sk'ulan wach'il jun, xajan heb' yuj Dios.
Ha junok munlajel skak' quip ko b'oani, ay tas syak' t'ayonh, tato anhej lolonel skak' jun, skot mheb'ail t'a quib'anh.
Ha sniwanil yelk'och heb' ay spensar, aton sjelanil heb'. Axo pax yik heb' malaj spensar jun, aton smanh pensaril heb'.
Ha heb' testigo yel syala', skol heb' yetanimail heb' t'a chamel. Palta a heb' testigo esalwum jun, syak' musansatil heb' yajal heb'.
Ha ko xiwk'olal t'a Jehová, tzonh skol yet' heb' kuninal, yujto yip ko k'ool yaji.
Tato ay yelk'och Jehová t'a ko sat, ay ko k 'inal, a tzonh kolanel t'a yol sk'ab' chamel.
Tato ay heb' rey ayoch reyal t'a jantak anima, sb'inaj wal heb'. Tato jaywannhej anima b'aj ayoch heb' reyal jun, slajwiel heb'.
Tato ay ko niwank'olal, syalelk'ochi to ay ko pensar, tato k'un skot kowal jun, syalelk'ochi to malaj ko pensar.
Tato junk'olalnhej yaj ko pensar, wach'nhej yaj ko niwanil. Tato ay ko chichonk'olal jun, tz'och ko yab'il.
Tato squixtej heb' meb'a', wan ko patikanel Dios ix onh b'oani. Tato ay yelk'och Dios t'ayonh jun, tz'ok' ko k'ool t'a heb'.
Ha heb' chuk, anheja' schukal heb' chi' tz'ik'ankot t'a yib'anh. Axo heb' wach' spensar jun, aynhejoch Dios yipok sk'ol heb' masanto scham heb'.
Ha heb' jelan, anhej jelanil molanek' t'a spensar heb'. Axo pax heb' malaj spensar jun, max k'ochlaj ijan snaan heb'.
Tato a tojolal sb'eyb'alej junok chonhab', sk'e wal chaanh, tato a chukal sb'eyb'alej jun, tz'ak'ji q'uixwelal.
Ha heb' chekab' ay spensar, stzalaj winh rey yet' heb'. Axo pax heb' chekab' malaj spensar jun, skot yowal sk'ol winh rey t'a yib'anh heb'.
Tato sko pak junok lolonel t'a emnaquilal, stup owal yuj. Tato ow skutej ko pakan jun, ste wach' k'e waan owal chi'.
Ayic slolon heb' ay spensar, a jelanil syik' heb' anima t'a heb'. Axo yik slolon heb' malaj spensar jun, anhej manh pensaril syal heb'.
Aynhejek' Jehová t'a masanil b'aj, syilnhej tas sk'ulej heb' chuk yet' heb' wach'.
Ha lolonel wach' tz'alchaj t'ayonh, syak' sniwanil ko k'ool, ichato tzonh yanhtej. Axo pax chukal lolonel tz'alchaj t'ayonh jun, skab' wal syail yuj.
Ha heb' malaj spensar, chuk syab' heb' ayik tz'ak'ji skachnab'il heb' yuj smam. Axo heb' ay spensar jun, scha sk'ol skachnab'il heb' syak' smam.
Manh jantakok tas ay t'a yol spat heb' anima wach' spensar. Axo heb' chuk jun, max yak'laj snib'ej heb' yet' tas syak' ganar.
Ayic slolon heb' ay spensar, a jelanil syalel heb'. Axo heb' malaj spensar jun, malaj yelk'och tas syal heb'.
Ha silab' heb' chuk, max schalaj sk'ol Jehová, palta scha wal yab'i ayik slesalwi heb' tojol spensar t'ay.
Max schalaj sk'ool Jehová schuk b'eyb'al heb' chuk, palta te xajan heb' sb'eyb'alan tojolal yuj.
Ha heb' tz'aktankan swach' b'eyb'al, smojton wal yak'ji syaelal heb'. Smoj wal scham heb' malaj snib'ej skachji.
Syil Jehová chajtil yilji b'aj ay heb' chamnak, ¿tokwal max yil pax ko pensar?
Ha heb' te b'uchumtak, malaj snib'ej heb' ay mach skachani, toxon max sk'anb'ej junok razón heb' t'a heb' ay spensar.
Ha heb' stzalaji, stzetzon sat heb'. Axo pax heb' skus jun, tz'och pitz'an yaelal t'a spixan heb'.
Ha heb' ay spensar, snib'ej heb' swach' ojtaquejel jelanil. Axo heb' malaj spensar jun, stzalaj heb' yet' smanh pensaril chi'.
Ha heb' ilk'olal yaji, kuseltaknhej tzek' junjun k'u t'a heb'. Axo pax heb' tzalajk'olal yaj jun, q'uinnhej t'a heb' junjun k'u.
Tato ay yelk'och Jehová t'ayonh, yelxo te wach' quiko' wach'chom meb'a' onh, t'a yichanh pax to ay ko tumin palta ilk'olalnhej kaji.
Te wach' tato sko xajanej ko b'a wach'chom anhej anh itaj sko chi'a, t'a yichanh pax anhej nok' chib'ej sko chi'a tato owalnhej kaji.
Ha heb' k'un skot yowal, anhej owal sk'e waan yuj heb'. Axo pax heb' ay sniwank'olal jun, syak' tup owal heb'.
Ha t'a heb' jaragana, icha wal to a te q'uiix ayem t'a yol sb'e heb'. Axo pax heb' anima wach' spensar jun, wach'nhej sb'e heb'.
Ha heb' uninab'il ay spensar, syak' tzalajb'ok sk'ool smam snun heb'. Axo heb' malaj spensar jun, syak' q'uixwelal smam snun heb' chi'.
