Co k'anab'ajejek tas syal winh rey, yujto icha chi' ix kutej kak'an ko ti' d'ha Dios.
Manh elanhchamelok tzonh el t'a yichanh winh rey chi', mokab' ko tek'b'ejek ko b'a kalan quik t'a tas manh wach'ok t'a sat winh, yujto syalnhej sk'ulan winh tas snib'ej.
Anhej winh rey chi' syal yalan slajwub' junok lolonel, malaj mach syal sk'anb'an yab'i tas sk'ulej winh.
Tato sko k'anab'ajej junok cheknab'il, malaj tas skot t'a quib'anh. Tato ay ko pensar, snachajel kuuj tas tiempoal ayonh eq'ui, tas pax skutej ko k'anab'ajani.
Ay wal stzolal yet' sk'ual tas tz'aj ko k'anab'ajan juntzanh chi', palta ay wal jun tas tzonh ixtaneli, yujto manh kojtakok tas tzuji, malaj junok mach syal yalan t'ayonh.

Malaj mach syal snitzan sk'inal, malaj pax mach syal syamanoch waan schamel. Ha heb' soldado syal sk'ananel sb'a heb' t'a skal owal, palta ha t'a chamel chi', malaj mach syal yeli. Ha junok mach chuk, max yal-laj skoljiel t'a yol sk'ab' chamel yuj schukal.

Ayic ix wak'anoch t'a in k'ol wojtakaneli tastak tzuji t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, masanil juntzanh tik ix wila''. Ay b'aj ay heb' ayoch yajalil t'a skal heb' yetanimail, haxo tz'aji a heb' tz'ixtanpax heb' anima chi'.

Ay b'aj ix wilpaxi to ayik smukchaj junok winak chuk spensar, wach'chom chuk ix yutej sb'a winh t'a schonhab', palta tz'ik'jichaanh winh yuj heb' yetchonhab' chi'. Axo pax heb' anima sk'anab'ajan Dios, manhxalaj mach snaankot heb' t'a yol schonhab' b'aj tzijtum tas wach' sk'ulejnakkani. Ha juntzanh tik, malaj sjolomal yaji.
Yujto manh elanhchamelok tz'ak'jioch syaelal heb' sk'ulan chukal, yuj chi' anhej chukal sk'ulej heb' anima.
Wach'chom syalkan jun lolonel icha tik: Ha heb' sk'ulan wach'il ay yelk'och Dios t'a heb', wach'nhej tz'elk'och heb'.
Axo pax heb' chuk malaj yelk'och Dios t'ay, chuk tz'elk'och heb', quennhej tiempo syil heb', xchi jun lolonel chi'. Palta ix wila'' to ay heb' ste k'ulan chukal, niwan tiempo syil heb'.

Ha tas manh wach'ok swil t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, ay heb' anima wach' syutej sb'a, haxo tz'aji, syab' wal syail heb', ichato te chuk heb'. Axo pax heb' te chuk jun, tz'ik'jichaanh heb', ichato wach' heb'. Ha jun tik malaj sjolomal yet'nak.

Yuj chi' swala' yakb'an ayonhek' t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, smoj wal tzonh wa'i, skuk'an ha', skak'an tzalajb'ok ko k'ool. Icha chi' junk'olal tzonh eq'ui wach'chom ya tz'aj ko sayan wa ko b'ha t'a ko k 'inal syak' Dios.
Yakb'an swak' wal och t'a in k'ol wojtakaneli yet' wilan pax tastak tzuji t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, ay b'aj max och in wayanh t'ak'walil in naan yuj.

Axo ix nachajel wuuj jun to a masanil tas sk'ulej Dios yet' tastak tzuji, max nachajel kuuj. Wach'chom skak' quip kojtakaneli, palta malaj b'ak'uinh snachajel kuuj. Wach'chom a junok mach jelan tz'alani to snachajel yuj, palta wal yel, malaj tas snachaji.

Ayic ix wak'anoch t'a in k'ol in ch'olb'itan jun tik, ix nachajel wuuj to a tas sk'ulej heb' wach' yet' heb' jelan spensar, ayek' t'a yol sk'ab' Dios. Malaj junok onh kojtak tas ay t'a quichanh, tom ol onh xajanajok, mato ol onh chakjoquelok.

Axo tz'aji, wach'chom tojol ko b'eyb'al, mato manh tojolok, wach'chom wach' onh, ma chuk onh, wach'chom sko k'anab'ajej, ma pit onh, wach'chom skak' ko silab', mato max kak'a', wach'chom ay ko mul, mato malaj ko smul, wach'chom skak' ko ti' d'ha Dios, mato max kak' ko ti' chi', palta lajannhej tas sjawi t'a quib'anh.

Ay jun tas chuklaj t'a skal masanil tas tzuji t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, aton b'aj junnhej tzonh sateli. Ha tas ayek' t'a ko pensar ko masanil, anhej chukal yet' manh pensaril, haxo yik sjawi chamel t'a quib'anh, tzonh sateli.
Yuj chi' anhej yik pitzan onh, ayto tas ayoch yipok ko k'ool. Te niwan yelk'och junok nok' tz'i' pitzan t'a yichanh junok nok' chamnak choj.
Tato pitzan onh, kojtak to ol onh chamok, haxo pax heb' chamnakxo, manhxalaj tas yojtak heb', manhxalaj tas syal yak'chaj t'a heb', maxtzak nachajkot heb' yuj heb' anima.
Ha b'aj tzonh mukchaji, ata' slajwikan ko xajanan ko b'a, ko chichonk'olal yet' masanil chukal. Manhxa b'ak'uinh ay kalan quik t'a tas tzuji t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik.
Yuj chi' kaq'ek tzalajb'ok ko k'ol ko wa'i, kuq'ek ha', yujto wach' jun tik t'a yichanh Dios.
Sacokab' ko pichul skak'ochi, wach'okab' skutej ko jixb'an ko jolom.

Yujto tzapan jab' ko k 'inal syak' Dios, yuj chi' kaq'ek tzalajb'ok ko k'ool junjun onh yet' heb' ix quetb'eyum xajanab'il kuuj. Aton chi' tz'ak'ji spakok t'ayonh yuj Dios b'aj skab' syail ko munlaj t'a sat lu'um tik.

Masanil tas syal ko k'ulani, ko k'ulejek t'a smasanil ko k'ool, yujto ha t'a kampusante b'aj tzonh k'ochkani, manhxa munlajel, manhxa tas syal ko naani, manhxa tas syal kojtakaneli, manhxa pax jelanil.

Ay junxo tas swil t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik: Ha heb' toxon jelan sb'eyi, manh masanilok heb' tz'ak'an ganar karela. Manh masanilok heb' jelan yak'an owal tz'ak'an ganar owal. Manh masanilok heb' jelan spensar wach' swa'i. Manh masanilok heb' te ay tas ojtannak tz'och b'eyumal. Manh masanilok heb' k'ayb'ab'il tz'och yopisio. Palta masanil mach tz'ilchaj wach'il yet' chukal yuj.

Anhejtona' a onh anima onh tik, manh kojtakok janik' tzonh chami. Icha tz'aj skan nok' chay t'a yol chimpa, ma icha yik skan nok' much t'a yol te' yaal, icha chi' kaji, malaj tas naan kuuj sjawi juknaj junok tas t'a quib'anh.
Anhejtona', ay jun tas ix wila'', niwan yelk'och jun k'ayb'ub'al ix wik'kan t'ay:

Ix wil jun yune' chonhab' quennhej anima kajan t'ay, haxo ix aji ay jun winh rey te niwan sb'isul soldado, ix oymaj winh yet' heb' soldado chi' t'a spatiktak jun yune' chonhab' chi' yik syak'an owal heb' yet'ok.
Palta ha t'a jun yune' chonhab' chi', ay jun winh meb'a' kajan ta', te jelan spensar winh. Ix yal skolan jun chonhab' chi' winh yuj sjelanil chi', palta malaj mach ix naankot winh.

Yuj chi' wach'chom malaj yelk'och sjelanil spensar jun winh meb'a' chi' t'a heb' anima, maj scha yab' heb' tas syal winh, palta a in tik swala' to ay yelk'och junok mach nhikan spensar t'a yichanh junok mach te winak syutej sb'a.
Te wach' kab'an slolonel junok mach ay pensar to k'ununi sloloni, t'a yichanh pax kab'an yel yaw junok sreyal heb' malaj spensar.
Te niwan yelk'och jelanil t'a yichanh yamk'ab' yik owal. Yujnhej jab'ok tas chuklaj sko k'ulej, te niwan tas tz'ixtaxeli.
Yujnhej junok nok' chamnak yax ha'ay tz'ixtaxb'at sjab' perfume te wach'. Icha pax chi' junok mach b'inajnak yuj sjelanil, tato sk'ulej jab'ok chukal, satel sb'inajnaquil chi'.
Ha tas snib'ej junok mach nhikan spensar to a tas wach' b'aj syak'och sb'a. Axo pax tas snib'ej junok malaj spensar jun, anhej t'a chukal b'aj syak'och sb'a.
Ha heb' malaj spensar, a tas sk'ulej heb' sch'oxaneli to malaj spensar heb'. Elanhchamel scheklaj heb' yuj.
Tato a junok yajal skot yowal t'ayonh yuj ko paltail, mokab' elanhchamelok sko k'anel ko b'ha t'a kopisio. Tato emnaquil skutej ko b'a, tzonh ak'ji niwank'olal wach'chom niwan ko paltail chi'.
Ay wal tas manh smojok tzuji t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, aton tas tz'el sk'ulan heb' yajal.
Yujto ha t'a heb' malaj spensar tz'ak'ji junok opisio niwan yelk'ochi, haxo pax t'a heb' smoj yoch yajalil jun, a junok komon opisio tz'ak'ji.
Ix wila'' to a heb' chekab' yaji, yib'anh chejnhej tzek' heb'. Axo pax heb' niwak winak jun, ha t'a yok heb' sb'eyi, ichato chekab' yaj heb'.
Ha heb' sb'oan junok niwan jul, ay smay sb'at heb' t'a yool. Ha heb' sjuanel junok muro, ay smay schiji heb' yuj nok' chan.
Ha heb' stzeyan k'een k'een, ay smay slajwi heb' yuj k'een. Axo heb' spojwi k'atzitz, ay smay xikan sb'a heb'.
Ayic tz'em ye k'een ch'akab', haxo yik sko k'anan k'een yowalil skak' wal quip ko t'ab'anoch k'een, yuj chi' más wach' sko nhikxik'e ye k'een. Tato jelan onh jun, elanhchamel sko na' tas tzonh aji.
¿Tasto yalan junok mach ojtannak smontan nok' chan, tato toxo ix chiji yuj nok'?
Tato tzonh lolon yet' jelanil, wach' tz'alchaj t'ayonh. Tato tzonh lolon yet' ko manh pensaril jun, munil squik'kot t'a quib'anh.
Ayic syamanoch slolon junok malaj spensar, a komon lolonel syala', haxo yik slajwi slolon chi', ichato malaj jun tas syal chi',
max k'unb'i ste loloni. Malaj mach syal yalan tas toto ol ujok.
Ha heb' malaj spensar, smak' k'unb'ok sb'a heb' smunlaji, maxtzak nachaj yuj heb' b'aj ay sb'eal schonhab'.
Ob'iltak junok nakión to a junok mach tzapanto spensar ayoch sreyalok, a na anhej iloj q'uinh syak' heb' yichamtak winaquil.
Te wach' yik junok nakión tato a junok mach jelan spensar ayoch sreyalok, a na heb' yichamtak winaquil swa heb' t'a yorail yik tz'och yip heb', manhoklaj t'a uk'el anh sb'atkan heb'.
Ha heb' ch'aan sk'ool snipan yib'anh spat, tzek' tz'uj t'a heb', haxo tz'aji, tz'em lanhnaj spat heb' chi' t'a yib'anh.
Ha q'uinh stzalajb'i ko k'ool yuj, tzonh tzalaj pax yuj tas skuk'ej, palta a juntzanh tik tumin snib'ej.

Mokab' kalek spekal winh rey, mokab' ek' t'a ko pensar kalani. Mokab' kal chukal t'a heb' b'eyum, wach'chom ko ch'okoj ayonhek' t'a ko pat, yujto jab'jab'il tz'ab'chaji, ichato a nok' much tz'ik'anb'ati sk'och t'a winh rey chi'.
Elb'enokab' tastak kuuj, yujto ay jun k'ual ol ko cha spak.
Ha tastak ay t'ayonh, wach' sko pukb'at t'a heb' malaj yiko', yujto manh kojtakok talaj ay junok chukal sjawi t'a quib'anh t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik.
Tato stelwi junok te te', yalxonhej b'aj sb'at te', skannhej te' b'aj tz'em juan chi'. Tato k'ik' yilji asun, wan skot nhab' syal chi'.
Tato skak'och ko chum chajtil yilji tiempo b'aj ayonheq'ui, malaj b'ak'uinh tzonh awalwi, malaj pax b'ak'uinh sko mol sat kawb'en chi'.
Manh kojtakok b'aj skot ik', manh kojtakokpaxi tas tz'aj sq'uib' junok nene' unin t'a yol sk'ol snun, ichaton chi' manh kojtakok tastak sk'ulej Dios, aton ixb’o’an masanil tas.
Cawejec ko b'ab'el awb'en, skawan pax tzak'anilto tz'ochi, yujto manh kojtakok mach junok makan wach' tz'aji, tom a b'ab'el chi', mato a tzak'an chi', mato syak' scha makanhil jun.
Te wach' quilan sakil k'inal, wach' quilan pax yok k'u.
Wach'chom tzijtum ab'il squila', palta skak' quip kak'an tzalajb'ok ko k'ool. Scham wal ko naani to niwan tiempo tzonh kan t'a kampusante, manhxa tas skak' ganar ta', manhxalaj yelk'ochi.

Ex kelemtak yet' ex kob'estak, tzalajanhek yakb'an steton eyip. Hak'ek tzalajb'ok he k'ool yet' tas wach' yakb'an syal eyuuj. Ixiquec b'aj tze nib'ej tzex b'ati, k'ulejek tas tze nib'ej tze k'ulej, palta b'ian scham wal he naani to ol ex sch'olb'itej Dios yuj tastak tze k'ulej chi'.
Ik'equel juntzanh tas tze naub'tanhej t'a he pensar, manh ex och ilk'olal yuj junok yaelal t'a he niwanil, yujto a jab' stiempoal he quelemal he kob'esal, malaj yelk'ochi, junnhej rato tzek'b'ati.
Yakb'an unin animaexto, naekkot Dios he b'oumal, yakb'an mantzak eyab' syail yuj icham animail. Yujto ay jun pekti’ ol eyal icha tik: Manhxa swach'il kajek' skab'i, xe chama.
Naeccot Dios chi' tiknaik yakb'an tzato yal eyilan yok k'u, yok k'een uj yet' yok k'een k'anal, yik mantzak syamoch ste jawi yaelal t'ayex.
Yujto ay jun k'ual a he k'ab' tzex kolan tiknaik, toxonhej ol luklonok, haxo eyok te tek'an, ol el yip. Manhxapaxlaj k'een eye b'aj ol yal he kach'an he wael, ol ixtaxpax yol he sat.

Ayic ol jawok jun pekti’ chi' t'a eyib'anh, manhxo ol yal-laj eyab'an tastak sk'anh t'a yoltak b'e, manhxo ol eyab'paxlaj sk'anh k'een cha'. Pitzan ex xo ayik tz'ok' nok' much ayik ayto sk'ana', manhxo ol eyab' yoch b'it t'a he tz'ey.

Ol ex xiw he k'e t'a junok chaanh, ayxo smay eyek' t'a yoltak b'e. Ol syamoch sakb'i xil he jolom, tewelxonhej ol ex ek' machaljok, manhxa pax tas ol he na' t'a eyetb'eyum, yujto wanxo he b'atkan t'a he kajnub' t'a kampusante t'a junelnhej. Ha heb' anima t'a yoltak b'e, ol laj ok' heb' yuj he chamel.

Co naekkot jun Dios onh b'oani, yujto ay jun k'ual ol lajwokk'och ko k 'inal, icha junok kandil nab'a oro spoji ayik sd'inhchaj skatenail nab'a plata b'aj chinank'ei. Mato icha tz'aj spojb'at lum ch'ub' t'a sti' ha ha', ma icha tz'aj spoj k'een tzek' surson b'aj stok'jik'eta ha ha' t'a yol jul.
Ayic slajwik'och ko niwanil tik, smeltzajxikanoch pokokal t'a sat lum tik, ichataxon yaj t'a yalanhtaxo. Axo ko pixan sk'exkan d'ha Dios, yujto ha' ak'jinakoch t'ayonh.
Ha in alum in el lolonel tik swalanxi junelxo: Masanil juntzanh tik, malaj sjolomal yaji, malaj yelk'ochi.

Ha wal yuj in jelanil, manh jantakok tas wach' ix wak' yojtaquejel heb' wetanimail. Anhejtona' jantak pax juntzanh lolonel ix in sik'kani, ix lajwi chi' ix in ch'olb'itaneli, ix wak'anoch t'a stzolal.
Ix in say wal lolonel to wach'nhej schaan sb'a to yel, yik tzin tz'ib'ejkan icha wal smojal.

Ha tastak syal heb' jelan, lajan wal icha junok teklab' jay snhi' stekjioch t'a nok' wakax, haxo yik toxo ix molchaj juntzanh lolonel chi', lajan wal icha te' estaka tzatz yaj smak'chajemi. Ha juntzanh lolonel chi' ha Dios Quilumal, ha' ix ak'an t'ayonh.
Ex unin anima, scham wal eyilani, manh komonok tzeyak'och he b'ha t'a junokxo komon lolonel, yujto a tz'ib'oj uum malaj slajwub', anhejtona' tato te ay tas sko k'ayb'ej t'ay, tzonh tzaktzajk'e yuj.
Icha tik tz'aj slajwikan juntzanh lolonel tik. Ix alchajkan smasanil. Ayokab' yelk'och Dios t'ayonh, ko k'anab'ajejek masanil scheknab'il, yujto a jun chi' yowalil sko k'ulej.
Yujto ha Dios ol ch'olb'itan masanil tastak sko k'ulej, tato wach', mato chuklaj, wach'chom elk'altak ix laj ko k'ulej.
Ha juntzanh sb'it winhaj Salomón, manhxo jantakok swach'il yalji. Syalan ix kob'es:
Ach quelem xajanab'il wuuj, tz'ub'elta jab'ok in ti'. Te wach' swab' t'a yichanh yal uwa.
Te wach' yel a jab' yuj yal suk'uq'ui sjab' ayoch t'ayach. Ayic swab'an a b'inaji, lajan wal icha suk'uq'ui sjab' chi'. Yuj chi' te xajan ach yuj heb' ix ix.

Iq'uinb'at t'a a pat ach in reyal, iq'uinb'at ed'ok elanhchamel, xchi ix. Syalan heb' anima: Te tzalajk'olal kajek' ed'ok, ol ko nakot b'aj tzonh a xajanej yujto te wach' t'a yichanh yal uwa. Tob'an yuj chi' te xajan ach yuj heb' ix ix tik, xchi heb'. Syalan ix kob'es:

Ex ix aj Jerusalén, a in tik k'ik' ch'uminak wilji, palta te wach' wilji. K'ik'okab' wilji icha yilji smantiado heb' aj Cedar, palta te wach' wilji icha yilji k'apak kortina ayoch t'a yol spat winhaj Salomón.

Manh ex och wal k'elan t'ayin, yujto k'ik' ch'uminak wilji, yujto tz'anak in niwanil yuj yok k'u. Ha heb' winh in nulej ix kot yowal heb' winh t'ayin, ix in yak'anoch heb' winh tanhwoj uwa, haxo ix aji, maj in ya'ilej in b'a.

Ach quelem xajanab'il wuuj, al t'ayin ¿b'ajtil tza tanhwej nok' a kalnel? ¿B'ajtil tzik'b'at nok' yik' yip t'a chimk'ualil? ¿Tas yuj ol in satek' ach in say t'a skal juntzanhxo heb' tanhwum kalnel? xchi ix. Syalan heb' anima:

Tato manh ojtakok ach ix te wach' ilji t'a skal heb' ix ix wach' yilji, ochanh tzak'an yuj yoklem nok' kalnel chi'. Tanhwej wa nok' yunetak a chiwa t'a slak'anil slechpat heb' winh tanhwum kalnel chi', xchi heb'. Syalan winh quelem:
Ach kob'es xajanab'il wuuj, te wach' ilji swila', icha wal yilji nok' kob'es chej stok'an skarruaje winh sreyal Egipto.
Te wach' yilji spak'ultak a ti' t'a skal k'een uchiquin, te wach' pax yilji a jaj b'aj ayoch k'een a tonh.
Ol ko b'o k'een uchiquin nab'a oro, ol kak'och k'een plata yelwanub'ok, xchi winh. Syalan ix kob'es:
Yakb'an k'ojanem winh rey t'a smexa, haxo anh nardo sumumi yel sjab' t'ayin.
Ach quelem xajanab'il wuuj, lajan ach wal icha junok yub'anh te' mirra suk'uq'ui sjab' ayek' t'a skal wim.
Ach xajanab'il wuuj, lajan ach icha junok yub'anh xumaquil te alheña sq'uib' t'a skal te' uwa awab'il t'a En-gadi, xchi ix. Syalan winh quelem:
Te wach' ilji ach kob'es xajanab'il wuuj, wal yel te wach' ilji. Lajan swach'il yilji yol a sat icha yilji yol sat nok' paramuch, xchi winh. Syalan ix kob'es:
Te wach' ilji ach quelem xajanab'il wuuj, wal yel te wach' ilji. Ha wal anh yax ank'ultak ol och ko waynub'ok, xchi ix. Syalan winh quelem:
Ha spatzab'il ko pat ayochi nab'a a te' k'ute', haxo te' tzikap ayoch t'a yib'anh, xchi winh.
Lajan in icha junok anh xumak t'a sch'olanil yik Sarón, icha anh chochol sq'uib' t'a ak'lik, xchi ix. Syalan winh quelem:
D'a skal heb' ix yetixal ix xajanab'il wuuj, lajan ix icha junok anh xumak t'a skal te' q'uiix, xchi winh. Syalan ix kob'es:
D'a skal heb' yetquelemal winh xajanab'il wuuj, lajan winh icha junok te' mansan ay t'a kaltak te'. Manh jantakok swach'il wem k'ojan t'a yenhul, te chi' sat te' swab'i.
Ix in yik'b'at winh t'a spatil niwak wael, t'a smasanil sk'ol winh ix sch'oxo' to xajan in yuj.
Ak' te' taquinh sat uwa t'ayin yik tz'och wip, a wal te' mansan tzak' in lo yik sikb'i in k'ool, yujto tzin cham ach in nib'ani.
Ha sk'ab' winh t'a sk'exanh syak'och t'a yalanh in jolom, haxo swach' winh tzin lak'ank'ei, xchi ix. Syalan winh quelem:
Ex kob'estak aj Jerusalén, tzin tewi wal t'ayex to manh he pitzel swayanh ix xajanab'il wuuj, munil ol el swayanh ix, xchi winh. Syalan ix kob'es:
A... wan sjawi winh xajanab'il wuuj. Tzaxo wab' yoch sjaj winh. Sk'e wal chennaj winh skot t'a jolomtak witz. Sk'e wal chennaj winh sjawi t'a tzalquixtak.
Ha winh xajanab'il wuuj, lajan winh icha nok' ch'ukul, icha wal junok yune' ch'ukul chi'. Ayxoek' winh t'a patik pat tik, t'anhanxooch winh t'a yolanil wentena.
Ha winh xajanab'il wuuj chi', ix yal winh t'ayin icha tik: Q'ueanh waan ach xajanab'il wuuj, kotanh ach nib'ab'il wuuj.
Inai, toxo ix ek'b'at sk'ual siknhab'.
Ayxo anh xumak t'a kaltak te', toxo ix k'och stiempoal yoch b'it, tzaxo kab' yoch sjaj nok' kuwajte' t'a tik.
Ayxo sat te' higo, sumumi yel sjab' te' uwa. Q'ueanh waan ach xajanab'il wuuj, ach to te wach' ilji, kotanh, xchi winh t'ayin, xchi ix. Syalan winh quelem:
Ach xajanab'il wuuj, lajan ach icha nok' paramuch sk'ub'ej sb'ha t'a sattak k'een. Ch'ox a sat wila'', lolonanh jab'ok wab'i, yujto te wach'tzin a loloni, te wach'pax ilji.
Pechec nok' waax yet' nok' yune', to syixtej te' kuwa nok', icha te' wanto yak'an xumaquil, xchi winh. Syalan ix kob'es:
Yic in winh xajanab'il wuuj, wik pax winh, stanhwi kalnel winh t'a skal anh xumak.

Yakb'an manta ik' t'a q'uinhib'alil, ayik manto sakb'i, meltzajanhkot t'ayin ach xajanab'il wuuj. Lajan tzutej a b'a icha junok nok' ch'ukul, icha nok' quelem ch'ukul toxonhej sk'e chennaj skot t'a tzalquixtak, xchi ix.
Ha t'a sat in ch'at t'ak'walil, ix in wayichej in sayanek' winh xajanab'il wuuj. Ix in sayek' winh, palta maj ilchaj winh wuuj.
Slajwi chi', ix in k'e waan, ix in ek' in say winh t'a yol chonhab' chi'. Tzin sayanek' winh xajanab'il wuj t'a yoltak kalle yet' t'a yoltak merkado. Ix in saynhej winh, palta maj ilchaj winh wuuj.
Ix in k'anb'an t'a heb' polikía tzek' stanhwej chonhab' chi': ¿Maj am eyil winh xajanab'il wuuj? xin chi.

Quenanto wal tzin b'at t'a heb' winh chi', ix ilchaj winh xajanab'il wuuj. Ix in och quetzquetz t'a sk'ab' winh, majxo waktejel-laj winh. Ix wik'anb'at winh t'a spat ix in nun, t'a skuarto ix in nun chi' b'aj in alji, xchi ix. Syalan winh quelem.
Ex kob'estak aj Jerusalén, tzin tewi wal t'ayex to manh he pitzel swayanh ix xajanab'il wuuj, munil ol el swayanh ix, xchi winh. Syalan heb' anima
¿Tas jun skot t'a tzinan lum chi', t'a skal jun topanh tab' skoti, aton t'a skal stab'il mirra yet' inkienso yet' masanil makan suk'uq'ui sjab' chonhb'il yuj heb' chonhwajum?
Aton b'aj sb'akhchajek' winhaj Salomón. Oyanoch 60 soldado t'a spatik, aton wal juntzanh heb' winh soldado te jelan t'a skal heb' israel.
Masanil juntzanh heb' winh chi', a k'een espada syak'lab'ej heb' winh, te jelan heb' winh t'a owal. Junjun heb' winh ayoch yespada t'a snanhal, tato ay tas ay smay tzek' t'ak'walil.
Ha winhaj Salomón ix sb'o jun b'aj sb'akhchajek' t'a te te' wach' ay t'a Líbano.

Ha yoyal, nab'a plata, haxo yijnub' yich, nab'a oro. Ha b'aj tz'em k'ojan winh, a anh púrpura ayoch t'ay. D'a yol chi' ayoch yelwanub' b'ob'il yuj heb' ix aj Jerusalén, yuj sch'oxani to xajan winh yuj heb' ix.
Ex ix aj Sion, elanhekb'at eyil winhaj rey Salomón. Ayk'e skorona winh, aton jun ix yak'k'e ix snun winh t'a sjolom t'a sk'ual snupnaji, aton jun k'u b'aj ix te tzalaj sk'ol winh, xchi heb'.

Te wach' ilji ach xajanab'il wuuj, yelxo wal te wach' ilji. Ha yol a sat chequel t'a spatik smusil a sat lajan yilji icha yol sat nok' paramuch. Ha xil a jolom, lajan wal yilji icha yemta nhililok nok' chiwa t'a pak'an yik Galaad.
Axo k'een e, te wach' yilji k'een, lajan yilji k'een icha yilji nok' kalnel sb'ikji ayik toxo sjoxji. Tz'akan k'een, malaj junok k'een malaj yetb'eyum, icha nok' nun kalnel junnhej sb'ey yet' yune'.
Chaktz'ob'inak a ti' icha chakchak ch'al. Sat in k'ool yuj swach'il a loloni. Axo spak'ultak a ti' musan yuj junok k'apak, icha wal yilji k'axepok te' granada.
Ha wal a jaj, lajan wal icha torre b'ob'il yuj winhaj rey Dawid, lokjab'och mil maklab' jul-lab' yik heb' soldado jelan t'a spatiktak yelwanub'ok.
Ha im schab'il, lajan wal yilji icha chawanhok yunetak ch'ukul tiox swa t'a skaltak anh chochol.
Yakb'an manta ik' t'a q'uinhib'alil, ayik manto sakb'i, ol in b'at t'a jolomtak witz b'aj ay anh mirra, t'a tzalquixtak b'aj suk'uq'ui sjab'.
Te wach' ilji ach xajanab'il wuuj, te wach' yilji a niwanil smasanil, te malaj jab'ok a paltail.

Ach to ol ach och wetb'eyumok, konh el t'a Líbano, konh el t'a jolom witz Líbano. Ol ko puklaj ko b'a yet' jolom witz Amana tik, yet' jolom witz Senira. Ol kaktejkan witz Hermón, b'aj ay snhak'een nok' choj yet' b'aj ay nok' leopardo.

Ach xajanab'il wuuj, ol ach och wetb'eyumok, toxo ix kan in gana t'ayach, yujnhej to ix ach kot k'elan junel t'ayin, ix wilan jun ch'anhal tonh lokanoch t'a a jaj. Junelnhej ix mutz'mutz'an a sat t'ayin. Icha chi' ix aj yik'ji in pixan uuj.
Ach ix ol ach och wetb'eyumok, manh jantakok swach'il in a xajanani, yelxo te wach' t'a yichanh wino. Yelxo te wach' a perfume tza k'an t'a yichanh masanil tas sumumi sjab'.
Ach ol ach och wetb'eyumok, icha yalchab' ayoch t'a a ti', icha wal yalchab' yet' lech ay t'a yol a ti'. Icha suk'uq'uial sjab' Líbano, icha wal chi' sjab' a pichul.
Ach ol ach och wetb'eyumok, lajan ach icha junok awb'en makan, icha sjaj ha ha' to makan, te wach' yaj smakchaji.
Lajan ach icha junok awb'en b'aj swolan te' granado, a sat tas awab'il ta' manh jantakok schi'al, ay pax anh alheña,
anh nardo, anh azafrán yet' juntzanh te wale' suk'uq'ui sjab', te' kanela yet' masanil makanhil te' inkienso, mirra yet' pax áloes, masanil tastak te wach' yel sjab'.
Lajan ach pax icha sjaj ha ha' t'a skal tas awab'il, aton ha' sk'eul sjaj tz'emta t'a Líbano, xchi winh.

Ha ik' skot t'a stojolal norte yet' ik' skot t'a stojolal sur, ek'okab' xumumok t'a skal wawb'en, yik wach' sb'eyb'at suk'uq'uial sjab'. Syalan ix kob'es: Cotanh ach xajanab'il wuuj, ochanh t'a wawb'en, tza loan sat tas awab'il manh jantakok schi'al, xchi ix.

Van woch t'a skal wawb'en ach wetb'eyum xajanab'il wuuj. Van wik'ank'e in mirra yet' in perfume, wan wab'lan schab'il nok' akanh, wan wuk'an in wino yet' in lech, xchi winh. Syalan heb' amigo t'a heb' chawanh: Ex amigo waanhek, uq'ek ha', uq'ek jantak tze nib'ej, xchi heb'. Syalan ix kob'es:

Vaynac in b'ati, palta pitzan in pixan, ix wab'ani to a winh xajanab'il wuuj tz'awaj t'a puerta: Ach kob'es xajanab'il wuuj, jaquin ochi. Lajan ach icha nok' paramuch, malaj jab'ok a paltail. Te ch'ayan in jolom yuj yal ak'wal. Tz'el wal jililjok yal ak'wal chi' t'a xil in jolom, xchi winh t'ayin.
Toxo ix wik'el in pichul, ¿tom ol wak'och junelxo? Toxo ix in b'ik wok, ochtapax pokok t'ay junelxo, xin chi t'a winh.
Ha winh xajanab'il wuuj chi', ix yak'ochta sk'ab' winh t'a yolanil puerta. Ix in k'e wal juknaj yuj.
Yuj chi' ix in k'e waan in jakochta winh. Toxonhej ix el d'ujuljok mirra t'a in k'ab', ix ochkan t'a spatiktak sch'apul puerta.

Ha wal yik ix wab'an slolon winh, ijan ix in cham ix wab'i. Ayic ix in jakan puerta t'a winh xajanab'il wuuj chi', manhxo ayok ek'laj winh. Ix in sayek' winh, majxo chaxlaj winh wuuj. Ix wawtej winh, palta majxo tak'woklaj winh t'ayin.
Ix in ilchajel yuj heb' winh stanhwan chonhab'. Ix in smak'an lajwok heb' winh. Te chukxonhej ix aj yik'anel in xotil heb' winh stanhwan spuertail chonhab' chi'.
Ex kob'estak aj Jerusalén, aq'ek he ti': Tato tz'ilchaj winh in xajanab'il eyuuj, alek t'a winh to wan in cham in naan winh, xin chi t'a heb' ix.

Ix yalan heb' ix kob'estak chi' t'ayin: ¿Tas swach'il winh a xajanab'il chi' t'ayach, ach ix te wach' ilji t'a yichanh heb' ix ix wach' yilji? ¿Tas wal swach'il jun winh xajan chi' uuj, yuj chi' tza k'an t'ayonh to skak' ko ti'? xchi heb' ix t'ayin.
Ha winh xajanab'il wuuj chi', sak winh, chakwasinak yilji winh, te wach' yilji winh t'a yichanh lajunhe' mil winak.
Ha sat winh, lajan yet' k'een oro te wach'. Ha xil sjolom winh kolochtak, k'ik' yilji icha nok' joj.
Ha yol sat winh, lajan icha nok' paramuch tzek' t'a titak ha', ichato t'a skal lech tz'achanwi nok', t'a sti' snhajab'il ha ha' chi' tz'em manhan nok'.
Ha spak'ultak sti' winh, icha wal junok awb'en b'aj ay anh xumak te wach' sjab'. Ha sti' winh, lajan wal icha junok anh xumak te wach' sjab'.
Ha sk'ab' winh, lajan icha junok suyanh k'een oro ayoch k'een topakio t'ay. Ha sk'ool winh, icha wal k'een marfil nhululixonhej, te ayoch k'een zafiro yelwanub'ok.
Ha wal yok winh, lajan wal icha chab'ok oy nab'a mármol ayem t'a yib'anh chab'ok yich to nab'a oro te wach'. Lajan yilji winh icha te' k'ute' ay t'a Líbano, to sik'b'ileli.
Ha wal slolonel winh syala', te chi' skab'i, te wach'nhej winh t'a smasanil. Icha wal chi' yilji winh in xajanab'il chi' ex kob'estak aj Jerusalén, xin chi t'a heb' ix.
Ach ix te wach' ilji t'a yichanh heb' ix ix wach' yilji, ¿b'ajtil ix k'och winh xajanab'il chi' uuj? ¿B'ajwaltil ix b'at winh yik wach' b'at ko say winh? xchi heb' t'ayin. Syalan ix kob'es:
Ha winh xajanab'il chi' wuuj, toxo ix b'at winh b'aj ay yawb'en, t'a skal tas awab'il yuj winh to suk'uq'ui yel sjab'. Ix b'at winh yak' tzalajb'ok sk'ool yet' smolan te' xumak.
Ha in tik, yik in winh xajanab'il wuuj chi', wik pax winh. Syak' tzalajb'ok sk'ol winh t'a skal te' xumak chi', xchi ix. Syalan winh quelem:
Ach ix xajanab'il wuuj, te wach' ilji, nib'ab'ilxonhej ilji icha wal yilji chonhab' Tirsa yet' chonhab' Jerusalén. Ayxo smay yilji, icha juntzanh soldado sb'ey t'a stzolal.
Manhxookab' mutz'mutz'an a sat t'ayin, yujto toxo ix ik'ji in pixan uuj. Ha xil a jolom, lajan yilji icha yemta nhililok nok' chiwa t'a pak'an yik Galaad.
Ha k'een e, toxonhej stz'ilili k'een. Lajan yilji k'een icha nok' kalnel toto tz'elta b'aj sb'ikjieli, chatakwanh sb'ey nok' yet' yune', malaj junok nok' to sch'okoj.
Ha wal spak'ultak a ti' musan yuj junok k'apak, ichaxonhej yilji k'axepok te' granada.
Tzalajokab' winh rey yet' 60 heb' ix yetb'eyum reina yaji yet' 80 heb' ix schab'il yetb'eyum yet' pax heb' ix kob'estak maxtzak b'ischaji.

Palta a in tik, junnhej ix wiko'. Lajan ix icha wal nok' paramuch malaj spaltail. Anhej ix xajanab'il yuj snun, yuj chi' malaj junokxo mach lajan icha ix tik yalan snun chi'. Ayic tz'ilji ix yuj heb' ix kob'estak, yuj heb' ix reina, yuj pax heb' ix schab'il yetb'eyum winh rey chi', masanil heb' chi' tz'alani to wach' yilji ix, xchi winh. Syalan heb' amigo:

¿Mach jun ix ix sch'ox sb'a chi', icha wal sch'oxan sb'a k'u t'a q'uinhib'alil? Wach'xonhej yilji ix icha yilji k'een uj, icha yilji yok k'u, ay smay yilji icha juntzanh soldado sb'ey t'a stzolal, xchi heb'. Syalan ix kob'es:
Ix in b'at b'aj ay te' ch'akte' nogales, yik swilan masanil tas swolan t'a ch'olan. Ix in nib'ej ix wila'' tato wan skan sat te' uwa yet' xumaquil te' granado.
Manhxo tok tzin na', icha wal to ayinek' t'a yol karruaje yet' winh wajalil, xchi ix. Syalan heb' amigo:

Meltzajanh, meltzajanh ach Sulamita. Meltzajanh, snib'ej ko k'ol tzonh och k'elan t'ayach, xchi heb'. Syalan ix kob'es: ¿Tas yuj tze nib'ej tzeyil in chanhalwi t'a skal snanhal cha tzol anima tik? xchi ix Sulamita chi'.
Ach kob'es, ach yisil winh rey, manhxo jantakok swach'il yilji ok t'a yol a xanhab'. Ha wal a xub', te wach' yilji icha wal smunlajel junok jelan sb'oan tastak yet' k'een oro.
Ha wal a k'ool, lajan wal icha junok ch'ub' to aynhejem wino t'a yool. Axo a nanhal, lajan icha junok kunhanh ixim trigo oyan och te' xumak t'a spatik.
Ha im schab'il, lajan wal icha chawanhok nok' ch'ukul tiox ix aj yalji.

Ha a jaj, lajan wal icha junok torre nab'a marfil. Ha yol a sat, lajan icha chab' ha' nhajab' t'a chonhab' Hesbón, junnhej ay t'a spuertail yik Bat-rabim. Axo a nhi', lajan wal yet' torre t'a Líbano, aton jun k'elanb'at t'a chonhab' Damasco.
Ha a jolom, chaanh ayk'ei, lajan icha jolom witz Carmelo. Te kopopi yilji xil a jolom icha yilji sch'alil púrpura. Toxonhej tz'ik'jikank'e spixan jun winh rey yuj xil a jolom chi'.
Ach xajanab'il wuuj, ach ix to nib'ab'il, yelxo te wach' ilji.
Te tojol ilji icha junok te' palma. Axo im, lajan wal icha junjun k'ojlab' sat te' palma chi'.
Tzin nib'ej k'e in b'ha t'a te' palma chi' yik swik'anemta te' sat. Ha im lajan wal icha junjun k'ojlab' te' uwa. Ha xob'al a ti', suk'uq'ui sjab' icha sjab' te' mansan.
Ha wal a ti', lajan wal icha wino manhxo jantakok swach'il, xchi winh quelem. Syalan ix kob'es: Yuk'okab' wino winh xajanab'il wuuj, tz'och t'a sti' winh, tzek' t'a skal ye winh.
Yic in winh xajanab'il wuuj, te nib'ab'il in yuj winh.
Conh t'a kaltak awb'en ach xajanab'il wuuj, tzek' junok ak'wal kuuj t'a skaltak xumaquil anh alheña.
Axo t'a q'uinhib'alil, tzonh b'at t'a skal te' uwa yik squila' tato ayxo swol te', tato wanxo spoj xumaquil te'. Ol quila' tato wanxo xumakan te' granado, a wal ta' ol in ch'oxo' to xajan ach wuuj.
Ayxo sjab' anh mandrágora. Ha t'a sti' ko pat, ayxo sat masanil tas awab'il wach' sloji, ay sat taquinhxo yet' sat toto smolji. Ch'ok wal ix wik'kanel ik ach xajanab'il wuuj, xchi ix.
Comonoc in nulej ach, junnhej am im ix ko tz'ub'u'. Tato icha chi', ayik tzach in chaan t'a yoltak b'e, tzam yal in tz'ub'anelta a ti', malaj am mach tz'alan in pekal.
Tzam yal ach wik'anb'at t'a spat ix in nun, tzam ach wik'och t'a yol pat chi'. Ha ach am wal tzach och in k'ayb'umalok. Ha in am swak' wino manh jantakok swach'il uk'ej yet' yal sat te' in granado.
Ha a k'ab' t'a a k'exanh tzak'och t'a yalanh in jolom, haxo a wach' tzin lak'ank'ei, xchi ix. Syalan winh quelem:
Ex kob'estak aj Jerusalén, aq'ek he ti' t'ayin to manh ol he pitzel swayanh ix xajanab'il wuuj, munil ol el swayanh ix, xchi winh. Syalan heb' amigo:

¿Mach jun ix ix skot t'a tzinan lu'um chi', jichanem ix t'a yib'anh winh xajanab'il yuj? xchi heb'. Syalan winh quelem: Ha t'a yich jun te' mansan ix in xib'tejel a wayanh. Ata' kotnak syail ix a nun ayik aljinak. Syalan ix kob'es:

Mokab' a xajanej junokxo ix ix, palta ainnhejokab'i. Mokab'a junokxo mach tza lak'k'ei, palta ainnhejokab'i. Ha ko xajanb'ail ay yip icha chamel. Icha b'aj smukchaj chamnak to max yaktejel tas yamb'il yuj, icha chi' yaj b'aj sko xajanej ko b'a. Ha b'aj sko xajanej ko b'a, te' k'ak' icha junok k'ak' te ow.

Ha masanil ha' mar max tzak'wan ha' yak'an tup jun k'ak' chi'. Max yalpaxlaj yak'an tup yowal ha' niwak ha'. Tato ay mach syaltej masanil tas ay t'a spat yik smanan jun xajanb'ail tik, tonhej am spatikajkaneli, xchi ix. Syalan heb' winh snulej ix kob'es:
Ay jun ix kanab' tzak'an uninto, mantalaj yim ix. ¿Tas sko k'ulej yet' ix tato sjawi sk'anumal ix?
Tato lajan ix yet' junok muro, tzam ko b'ok'e chab'ok torre plata t'ay. Tato lajan ix icha junok puerta, tzam ko b'o yet' te' chemte' nab'a k'ute', xchi heb' winh. Syalan ix kob'es:
Ha in tik, lajan in icha junok muro. Axo wim, lajan icha juntzanh torre, yuj chi' stzalaj wal sk'ol winh xajanab'il wuuj wed'ok.
Ha winhaj Salomón, ay jun yawb'en uwa winh t'a Baal-hamón. Syak'kan winh t'a yol sk'ab' juntzanh heb' stanhwumal chi'. Ayic ol molchaj sat te' uwa chi', ol yak' mil k'een plata junjun heb' t'a winh.
Emokab' jun mil k'een splata winhaj Salomón yet' 200 yik heb' stanhwan chi'. Ha inxo jun, ay wawb'en uwa t'a yol wiko', a inxonhej tzin na' tas swutej, xchi ix. Syalan winh quelem:
Ach xajanab'il wuuj, ayach ek' t'a skal awb'en, tzin nib'ej swab' yoch a jaj. Yed' heb' kamigo, snib'ej pax heb' syab' yoch a jaj, xchi winh. Syalan ix kob'es:
Ach xajanab'il wuuj, yelk'olal a koti. Q'ueanh urnaj icha junok nok' ch'ukul, icha wal junok yune' ch'ukul t'a tzalquixtak b'aj tz'awchaj inkienso, xchi ix.

Ha in Isaías in tik, yuninal in winhaj Amoz. Ix ch'oxji wil juntzanh tas ix in tz'ib'ejkan tik yuj tas ol jawok t'a yib'anh heb' aj Judá yet' heb' aj Jerusalén. Ix wil juntzanh tik ayik ayoch heb' winh tik sreyalok Judá: Aton winhaj Uzías, winhaj Jotam, winhaj Acaz yet' winhaj Ezequías.
Ex aj satcha’anh yet' ex aj sat lu'um, ab'ek wal tas syal Jehová: Ha heb' in chonhab' tik, ix in q'uib'tzitej heb' ayik ix kotoch heb' uninal, haxo ix aji, ix meltzajoch heb' ajk'olal t'ayin.
Ha nok' wakax, yojtak yajal nok' yet' nok' b'uru yojtak nok' b'aj swa yuj mach ay yiko'. Palta haxo in chonhab' Israel, max b'alaj nachajel jab'ok yuj tato wiko'. Ichato malaj spensar, xchi Jehová.

Ex wetchonhab', ix och wal he mul, anhej wal chukal tze k'ulej icha sk'ulejnak heb' ko mam quicham. Te chuk tas tze k'ulej. Ix eyaktejkan Jehová, ix he patiquejkanel Dios Axonhej Ochi, aton ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik. Ix ex meltzaj t'a he patik.
¿Tas yuj tze te pitej he b'a? ¿Tom tze nib'ejnhej tz'ak'jioch yaelal t'a eyib'anh? Ichato lajwinak he jolom, manhxalaj jab'ok yip he niwanil.

Ichato manhxa jab'ok sjakanil he niwanil chi' yuj yaelal, schakot t'a eyok, masanto sk'ek'och t'a schon eyaal. Ay elnak sat, ay tonhej malnak, ay pax wan sk'ab'ati. Malaj pax yanhal tz'ochi, malaj mach tz'ak'anoch jab'ok k'apak t'a sat, malaj jab'ok akeite tz'och t'ay yik spakb'i jab'ok.
Ha he makb'en tik, toxo ix satjieli. Ix ochkan sk'ak'al he chonhab'. Axo masanil eyawb'en, a wal t'a eyichanh sloji sat yuj heb' ch'ok nakional, kuseltak ix ajkan smasanil.
Ix aktajkan chonhab' Sion, icha tz'aj yaktankan slechpat heb' tanhwum uwa, ma slechpat heb' tanhwum melón, ma icha junok chonhab' oyb'ilk'e yuj heb' ajk'ool yik satel heb'.
Ix to el t'a sk'ol Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, tzonh kan jaywanh onhxo tik, q'uinalok tato maay, lajan am ix aj ko satel icha ajnak chonhab' Sodoma yet' Gomorra.
Ex yajal Jerusalén, lajan ex icha heb' aj Sodoma. E masanil ex anima, lajan ex icha heb' aj Gomorra. Ab'ek wal sk'ayb'ub'al Jehová ko Diosal.

Syal Jehová icha tik: Ha jantak he silab' tzeyik'kot t'ayin, malaj tz'och wuuj. Toxo ix yajalax nok' kalnel wuuj, aton nok' snhusjitz'a masanil silab'il. Toxopax ix in tzaktzaj yet' xepual nok' nok' te b'ak'uech. Maxtzac in nib'ejlaj schiq'uil nok' mam wakax, ma schiq'uil nok' mam kalnel, ma nok' yunetak chiwa.
¿Mach ix k'anan juntzanh chi' t'ayex, yuj chi' tzex komon jawi yet' nok' chi' t'a wichanh, tze komon tek'an yamaq'uil in templo?

Manhxo eyik'kot juntzanh silab' chi' t'ayin, manhxalaj tz'och wuuj. Maxtzac scha in k'ol inkienso tze nhusu'. Ha juntzanh he q'uinh tzeyak'ochi ayik tz'alji k'een uj, t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip yet' ayik tze molb'an he b'ha t'a niwak q'uinh, maxtzak techaj wilani, yujto anhej wal chukal tze k'ulej.
Ha juntzanh he q'uinh ayik tz'alji k'een uj chi' yet' juntzanhxo he q'uinh b'aj tze molb'ej he b'a, chakb'ilxoel wuuj. Maxtzac techaj wilanochi. Toxo ix yajalax wuuj.
Ayic tze mojb'ank'e he k'ab' t'ayin, tzex lesalwi, tzin b'at mikan t'ayex. Wach'chom jantak tzeyutej he lesalwi, palta max wab'laj he lesal chi', yujto milumcham anima ex.
Ha tiknaik, ik'equel juntzanh chukal chi' t'ayex, tzeyaktankan he k'ulani, tzeyik'anel he b'ha t'a skal.

k'ayb'ejek he b'a he k'ulan wach'il. Ha wal tojolal tzeyak'och t'a he k'ool he k'ulani. Colwajanhec t'a heb' tz'ixtaji, wach' tzeyutej he b'oan yaj heb' unin manhxa smam. Alec syaelal heb' ix ix chamnak yetb'eyum, xchi Jehová.

Syalanxi Jehová icha tik: Cotanhec, ko b'oek yaj juntzanh tik. Wach'chom te chuklaj eyilji yuj he mul, palta ol ex in sakb'itejkan icha wal k'een sakb'akom. Wach'chom max yal yel he mul icha junok k'apak k'ik'mutz'inak max el yuk'em, palta ol ex in sakb'itejkan icha nok' saksak lana.
Tato tze cha eyab'i, ol he lo sat masanil tas wach' tz'el t'a sat he lu'um tik.
Palta tato anheja' pit tzeyutej he b'a jun, ol ex cham yuj owal ol wak'kot t'ayex. Ha inton wal Jehová in swala', xchi.

Ex aj Jerusalén, ha t'a pekataxo te tek'an ex. Palta haxo tiknaik, ¿tas yuj icha junok ix ajmul ix, ix ex ajkan t'a yol in sat? Ha t'a peka' chi', a tojolal tze b'eyb'alej, palta haxo tiknaik, milumcham anima ex.
Ha t'a yalanhtaxo, icha yilji k'een plata eyilji, haxo tiknaik, icha smikal k'een eyilji. Ha t'a yalanhtax chi', icha wino te wach', ichex ta', haxo tiknaik, icha ha ha' ix ex ajkani.

Ha heb' eyajalil, ix te pitb'iel heb', wach' yak'an heb' yet' heb' elk'um. Stzalaj heb' yet' k'een tumin scha' t'a elk'altak. Snib'ej heb' to ay tas siaj t'a heb'. Maxtzac yal syaelal heb' meb'a' manhxa smam heb' yet' heb' ix ix chamnak yetb'eyum.
Yuj chi', a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, he Diosal in ex aj Israel, a in swal icha tik: k'okb'ilxo chi'. Ha ex ajk'ol eyajoch t'ayin, ol in b'o yaj eyed'ok, ol in pak in b'a t'ayex.
Ol wak'och eyaelal, ol in nhustz'a masanil he paltail, ol wik'ankanel masanil he mul ayoch t'a eyib'anh.

Ol wak'anxioch heb' juez te tojol spensar t'a he kal icha t'a pekatax chi' yet' heb' ak'um razón icha yajtaxon t'a sb'ab'elal. Yuj chi' ol yal heb' anima t'a jun chonhab' tik: Ha jun chonhab' te wach', te k'anab'ajum, xcham heb'.
Yuj in tojolal, ol in kolkanel heb' kajan t'a Sion, aton heb' ol sna sb'a.
Palta haxo heb' te pit, heb' sk'ulan chukal yet' heb' tzin patikaneli, ol satel heb'.
Icha chi' ol aj he q'uixwi, yujto ix laj ex och ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios t'a yichtak te' ji yet' t'a skaltak te' awb'en te'.
Icha wal tz'aj sk'ajb'anel xil te' ji chi', icha pax yaj te' awb'en te' manhxa nhab' tzek' t'a yib'anh, icha wal chi' ol ex ajkanok.

Ha heb' te tek'an, icha wal anh ak ol ajkan heb'. Axo yechel komon Dios ix sb'o heb', icha namix k'ak' ol ajkanok. Junnhej ol aj yoch sk'ak'al heb' yet' yechel chi', manhxa mach ol yal smak'an tupok, xchi Jehová.
Aton juntzanh tik ix ch'oxji wil a in Isaías in yuninal in winhaj Amoz, yuj tas ol jawok t'a yib'anh Jerusalén yet' t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' ay t'a yol smakb'en Judá.

Ha t'a slajwub' k'ual, a lum tzalan b'aj ay stemplo Jehová, ol chaanhb'okk'e lu'um, ol ek' lum t'a yib'anh juntzanhxo witz ay t'a stz'eytak chi'. Masanil heb' anima t'a junjun chonhab', ol jawok heb' t'a lu'um.

Manh jantakok heb' anima t'a junjun nakión ol laj alan t'ay junjun icha tik: Cotanhec, konh k'eek t'a sjolom lum witz b'aj ay stemplo Jehová sDiosal winhaj Jacob yik tzonh sk'ayb'ej t'a sb'eyb'al, yik ol ko b'eyb'alej sb'eyb'al chi', xcham heb'. Yujto ha t'a Sion, aton Jerusalén, ol elta sk'ayb'ub'al Jehová, aton scheknab'il.

Ha Jehová chi' ol ch'olb'itan yaj masanil nakión. Ol yak' lajwok owal t'a skal heb'. Yuj chi' a k'een yespada heb', asaronal ol ochkan k'een, haxo k'een slanza heb' ol ochkan t'a jochlab' trigoal. Manhxo ol yak' owal heb'. Manhxo ol sk'ayb'ej sb'a heb' yak'an owal.
Ha onh yinhtilalonhkan winhaj Jacob tik, konh b'eyek ek' t'a sakil k'inal Jehová.

Mamin Jehová, ix onh aktej wal kan a onh a chonhab' Israel onh tik, a onh yinhtilonhkan winhaj Jacob tik, yujto b'ud'jinaquel ko chonhab' yuj heb' schuman yet' k'een k'anal skot t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u yet' heb' naumel lolonel icha syutej sb'a heb' filisteo. Sb'oan strato heb' yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ay skomon Dios.
Ha ko chonhab', b'ud'jinaquel yuj k'een oro yet' k'een plata, maxtzak b'ischaj jantak ko b'eyumal. Maxtzac b'ischaj jantak nok' chej yet' karruaje yik owal.
Palta b'ud'jinakpaxel ko chonhab' yuj juntzanh yechel komon Dios. Slaj yalan sb'a heb' anima t'a juntzanh yechel sb'o chi'.
Yuj chi' emnaquilxonhej ix onh ajkani. Mamin, manh ak' niwank'olal heb' sk'ulan juntzanh chi'.
Ex wetchonhab', ochanhek t'a yoltak k'een nhak'een, k'ub'ejequel he b'ha t'a yoltak jul yuj he xiwk'olal t'a yichanh Jehová, te ay smay yilji Jehová chi' yet' stziquiquial.
Ha heb' ak'umtak, ol em nhojan heb'. Ha heb' syik' wal chaanh sb'a, ol ik'jokxikanem heb'. Anhej Jehová ol ik'jokchaanh t'a jun k'ual chi'.
Yujto a Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, ay jun k'ual nab'ilxo yuj, yik ol yak'ankot yowal sk'ol t'a yib'anh heb' syik' wal chaanh sb'a, ol ik'jokkanem heb' yuj.
Masanil te' k'ute' chaanh steel t'a Líbano yet' masanil te' ji t'a Basán, ol satjoquel te' yuj Jehová.
Ol satanpaxel masanil lum niwak witz yet' lum tzalquixtak chaanh.
Ol satjokpaxel masanil yet'tal heb' soldado chaanh yajk'e yuj yet' masanil smuroal chonhab' wach' yajochi.
Ol yak'ankanem masanil te' barko yik Tarsis t'a yich ha' mar yet' masanil te' barko te wach' yilji.
Ha heb' syik' wal chaanh sb'a, ol lajwoquel heb' t'a junelnhej. Anhej Jehová ol ik'jokchaanh t'a jun k'ual chi'.
Ha Dios ol satanel masanil yechel juntzanh komon Dios.

Ayic ol syamanoch yak'an ib'xok yol yib'anhk’inal tik, ol laj xiwk'e heb' anima. Ol laj sk'ub'anel sb'a heb' t'a yoltak k'een nhak'een yet' t'a yoltak jul. Ata' ol sk'ub'ejel sb'a heb' t'a yichanh Jehová, yujto te ay smay yet' jantak stziquiquial.

Ha t'a jun k'ual chi', a heb' anima, ol laj sjulkanb'at juntzanh yechel skomon diosal heb' b'aj ay nok' ch'oow yet' b'aj ay nok' sotz', aton juntzanh b'ob'il yuj heb' t'a k'een plata yet' t'a k'een oro b'aj ix laj yal sb'a.

Ayic ol syamanoch Jehová chi' yak'an ib'xok yol yib'anhk’inal tik, ol laj sk'ub'ejel sb'a heb' anima t'a yoltak k'een nhak'een yet' t'a yoltak sjatelal k'een niwak tenam, yujto ol xiw heb' t'a yichanh, yujto te ay smay yilji yet' jantak stziquiquial.
Actejec eyak'anoch heb' quetanimail yipok he k'ool, yujto a onh anima onh tik, chamel b'a anima kaji, junnhej rato tz'el jab' quik' tik.
Ha tiknaik a Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, ol yik'kanel masanil tas tz'ab'laji yet' masanil tas tz'uk'ji t'a Jerusalén tik yet' t'a Judá. Ol yik'anpaxel masanil heb' yipk'olal yaj yuj:
Aton heb' winh yajalil heb' soldado, heb' winh juez, heb' schekab' Dios, heb' ajchum, heb' yichamtak winaquil chonhab',
heb' yajal yaj t'a 50 heb' soldado, heb' niwak yelk'ochi, heb' ak'um razón, heb' tzuji yuj yet' heb' ajb'aal.
Axo heb' kelemtak unin ol och eyajalilok yuj Jehová chi', haxo heb' ol ex ak'an mandar.

Axo heb' anima, ol k'e b'uynaj heb' yak'an owal, ol laj yak' owal heb' yet' heb' ay t'a spatik schiquin spat. Ha heb' winh kelemtak, ol spatiquejel heb' ichamtak winak heb' winh. Axo heb' komon anima, ol spatiquejel heb' ay yopisio heb'.
Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', ol yal junok mach t'a junok ayto yuj sb'a yet' smam icha tik: Ha ach tik, te ay a pichul, ak' yajalil t'a jun chonhab' mak'b'ilem weknaj tik, xchama.

Axo jun winh chi', ol xiwb'at winh, ol yalan winh icha tik: Max yal in chaanoch jun opisio tik t'a wib'anh, yujto malaj tas tzin wa t'a in pat, malaj pax in pichul wach' wak'anochi, manh eyak'och jun opisio chi' t'a wib'anh, xcham winh.
Van yem lanhnaj Jerusalén, haxo Judá toxo ix lajwiemi, yujto a tas syal heb' anima yet' tastak sk'ulej heb', a chi' tz'och ajk'olal t'a Jehová Dios, spitejpax sb'a heb' t'ay.
Scheclajpaxel t'a sat heb' to lajan smul heb' icha heb' aj Sodoma, max sk'ub'ejel jab'ok heb'. Ob'iltak heb'. Munil wal a heb' tz'ik'ankot t'a yib'anh.
Alec t'a heb' anima wach' sb'eyb'al to wach' ol elk'och heb', yujto ol tzalaj heb' yilanoch swach'il spak tas sk'ulej chi'.
Ob'iltak wal heb' anima chuk spensar, te chuk ol elk'och heb', yujto a tas sk'ulej heb', a chi' ol ak'jok spakok t'a heb'.

Ha heb' kelemtak tz'ixtanel in chonhab' tik, haxo heb' ix ix tz'ak'an yajalil t'ay. Ex in chonhab', a heb' tzex kuchb'an chi', a heb' tzex ak'an musansatil, tzex yik'anb'at heb' t'a b'eyb'al manh wach'ok.
Ha Jehová ayek' t'a sdespacho, yik sch'olb'itan heb' schonhab', syak'an syaelal heb'.

Ol ch'olb'itaj heb' yajal chonhab' yet' heb' ichamtak winak yuj Jehová. Ol yalan t'a heb' icha tik: Ha ex tik, ix he satel wawb'en uwa, aton in chonhab'. Ix eyelk'ej tas ay t'a heb' meb'a', ix he molb'an eyelk'al chi' t'a yol he pat.
¿Tas eyalan eyik eyixtan in chonhab' tik? Tzeyixtej heb' meb'a', manhxo animaok tzeyutej heb', xchi Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil.

Anhejtona' syalanpax Jehová icha tik: Ha heb' ix aj Sion, syik' wal chaanh sb'a heb' ix, syum tik, syum tik sat heb' ix, sch'um tik, sch'um tik sb'a heb' ix, ayik sb'ey heb' ix. Max q'uixwi jab'ok heb' ix, toxonhej stzinhiljub' k'een k'een ayoch t'a yok heb' ix ayik sb'ey heb' ix chi'.
Yuj chi', ol wak'el b'ulnaj xil sjolom heb' ix yuj yab'il, ol wak' cheklaj sq'uixwelal heb' ix, xchi Jehová chi'.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi', a Jehová ol ik'anel masanil tastak ayoch yelwanub'ok sniwanil heb' ix aj Jerusalén chi': Aton ayoch t'a yok heb' ix, t'a sjolom heb' ix, t'a sjaj heb' ix,
t'a sjaj sk'ab' heb' ix yet' k'apak spichul sat heb' ix.
Ol yik'anpaxel spichul sjolom heb' ix, stzek'ul heb' ix, sperfume heb' ix, yuchiquin heb' ix,
skolk'ab' heb' ix, sk'enal snhi' heb' ix,
k'apak spichul heb' ix te wach', jantak sk'apak heb' ix, sjukan pichul heb' ix, syunetak pa heb' ix,
k'een snen heb' ix, sk'apak heb' ix te jay, k'apak tziquiqui yet' stzek'ul sjolom heb' ix.

Ha sperfume heb' ix te wach' sjab', a tas te chuk sjab' ol och sk'exulok. Axo ch'anh lasu ol och sk'exulok stzek'ul heb' ix, haxo xil sjolom heb' ix te wach' yaj t'a yalanhtaxo, ol el b'ulnajok. Ha pichul ya swa'i, a ol yak'och heb' ix sk'exulok pichul te wach' yilji. Ha sat heb' ix te wach' yilji, jech'tak ol ajkanok.
Ha heb' winh yetb'eyum heb' ix te tek'an, ol miljokcham heb' winh t'a skal owal.
Axo masanil heb' aj Jerusalén, ol ok' heb' yuj kusk'olal, yujto ol kan tzinan schonhab' heb' chi'.

Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', jaywanhxonhej heb' winh winak ol kanok, yuj chi' ol yal ukwanhok heb' ix ix t'a junok winh winak icha tik: Comonoc tz'el t'a a k'ool tzonh och etb'eyumok, munil ol ko say tas ol ko wa yet' ko pichul, anhejto tzonh och etb'eyumok yik manhxa ko q'uixwelal b'aj malaj quetb'eyum, xcham heb' ix.

Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', a Jehová ol ak'an cheklaj jun mach t'a skal yinhtilalkan winhaj rey Dawid, icha swol junok te te'. Te wach' yilji, te niwan yelk'ochi. Axo heb' aytokan t'a Israel chi', ol tzalajxok heb' ayik ol yilan heb' yelul sat tas syawej t'a sat sluum chi'.
Ha jaywanhxo heb' aykan t'a Jerusalén chi', aton Sion, aton heb' tz'ib'ab'il sb'i to skan ta', ol aljok t'a heb' to yiknhej Jehová yaj heb'.
Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', a Jehová ol ch'olb'itan yaj heb' aj Jerusalén chi' yet' spoder. Ol ik'jokpaxel schukal heb' yet' smul heb' yuj anima ix smilchamok.

Ha t'a k'ualil ol yak'och jun k'ik' asun Jehová t'a yib'anh masanil smakb'en lum witzal Sion chi' yet' t'a yib'anh masanil heb' anima molanek' ta'. Axo t'ak'walil, ay jun niwak k'ak' tz'ak'an sakil k'inal t'a heb', yujto a stziquiquial Dios chi' ayek' t'a yib'anh heb' anima chi' smasanil.
Aton jun chi' skolan heb', yujto syak' swewenal t'a k'ualil, yik malaj k'ak', anheja' skolanpax heb', yik max kot nhab' t'a yib'anh heb' yet' ik' nhab'.
Ha tiknaik, ol in b'itej sb'ital jun winh wamigo te wach' yet' jun yawb'en uwa. Ha winh wamigo chi', ay jun yawb'en uwa winh t'a jun sluum te yax sat t'a jun tzalan.

Ix sd'okk'e waan jun slum winh chi', ix sik'anel k'een k'een winh t'a sat lu'um, ix sb'oanoch smakte'al lum winh, haxo te' uwa te wach' ix yawej winh t'a lu'um. Ix sb'ok'e jun yet'tal heb' stanhwan juntzanh awb'en chi' winh, chaanh ix ajk'ei. Ix sb'oanpax jun lugar winh b'aj stek'jiel yal te' uwa chi'. Ha snaan winh to te' wach' sat te' uwa chi' ol yak'a', haxo ix aji, te paj te' sat ix yak' chi'.
Yuj chi' ix yalan winh icha tik: Ha tiknaik ex aj Jerusalén yet' ex aj Judá: Alec t'ayin mach ay spaltail, ¿tom a in, mato a jun wawb'en tik?
¿Tom manh tz'akanok ix wutej te' in b'oani? ¿Aytom maj nachaj wuj tas tz'aj te' yawchaji? Ix in tanhwej yak'an sat te' wach', haxo ix aji, paj sat te' ix yak'a'.
Axo tiknaik jun, ol wal t'ayex tas ol wutej in munlajel tik: Ol wik'el smakte'al te' chi' yik ol satel te'. Ol jakwoquel smakte'al te' chi', yik wach' ol tek'joquem te' yuj nok' nok'.

Ol waktejkan te' ichnhej ta'. Manhxa mach ol ak'enan te', manhxa mach ol ik'anel te' schuklajil. Ol q'uib' anh ank'ultak ay sq'uixal t'a skal te'. Ol walan t'a asun to maxtzak yak'kot snhab'il t'a yib'anh jun awb'en chi', xchi winh aj awb'en chi'.

Ichaton chi' yaj heb' yinhtilal Israel yet' heb' aj Judá. Icha yawb'en Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, icha chi' yaj heb'. Ha Jehová chi', ix stanhwej to wach' syutej sb'a heb' t'a sk'ayb'ub'al, palta haxo ix aji, a milojcham anima ix yak' heb'. Snib'ej wal Jehová chi' to tojol syutej sb'a heb', haxo tz'aji, tz'el yaw anima yixtaj yuj heb'.
Ob'iltak heb' tzijtum spat ix smana', niwan pax lum sluum heb' ix smakkani. Manhxa jab'ok tas ix yaktejkan heb' t'a juntzanhxo heb'. Axonhej heb' snib'ej tz'aj t'a sat lum t'a jun chonhab' tik.
Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, a ix alan t'ayin icha tik: Ha juntzanh niwak pat te wach' yilji chi', ol satelok wach'chom te wach' yilji, manhxalaj mach ol kajnaj t'ay.
Ha t'a junok 90 ch'anhil uwa awab'il, anhej oye' galón yal sat uwa chi' ol elta. Axo t'a junok waque' quintal inhat tz'awchaji, anhej wak almul ol elta.
Ob'iltak heb' spet k'e waan t'a q'uinhib'alil syamanxioch uk'el anh heb', ste k'e anh t'a sjolom heb', skanxonhej heb' ta' tzek' ak'wal.

Ha b'aj tz'och niwak wael tz'uk'wi anh heb', ata' ayoch juntzanh yamk'ab' yik b'it: Aton te' arpa, te' wiolín, k'een pandereta yet' te' flauta. Axo tas wan snaan Jehová t'a yib'anh heb', max yak'laj pensar heb' yuj.
Yujto malaj snib'ej in chonhab' tik snachajel yuj, yuj chi' ol ik'chajb'at t'a juntzanhxo ch'ok nakional. Masanil heb' anima tik yet' heb' yajalil heb', ol cham heb' yuj wejel yet' taquinhtial.
Yuj chi', icha wal to ol sjak sti' chamel yik ol sb'uk'anb'at heb' anima chi' yet' heb' yajalil heb' t'a Jerusalén tik, aton heb' anima skomon el yaw tz'eq'ui.
Ol ik'jokkanem heb' anima syik'chaanh sb'a, emnaquilal ol ajkan heb'.
Axo Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, ol yak' cheklajok to te niwan yelk'ochi ayik ol sch'olb'itan masanil tas. Ha Dios chi' yelxo te wach', ol sch'oxeli to te tojol spensar.
Ha t'a juntzanh chonhab' ix laj em lanhnaj chi', ata' ol laj wa nok' kalnel yet' nok' chiwa.
Ob'iltak ex mach ex max eyaktej he k'ulan chukal chi', malaj yalan tas tze k'ulej chi'. Ichato nherb'il chukal chi' eyuuj, icha snherchaj junok karreta tzek'b'iloch t'a tas snheran chi'.
Tzeyalan icha tik: Ha ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, aton Dios Axonhej, komonok syala' sk'ulan tas nab'il yuj chi' t'a quib'anh, yik aymanh quilani tas tzonh aji, xe chi.

Ob'iltak ex tzeyal chukal wach'ilal, haxo wach'il chi', a tzeyal chukal. Ha sakil k'inal tzeyal k'ik'alq'uinalil, haxo k’ik’ k’inal chi' tzeyal saquilq'uinalil. Ha tas k'a', chi' eyalani, haxo tas chi', k'a' eyalani.
Ob'iltak ex tzeyaloch he b'a jelanil, te wach' he pensar he naani.
Ob'iltak ex te jelan eyuk'an anh, jelan he kalan anh anh chi'.
Ha ex tik yuj k'een tumin tzeyala' to malaj smul heb' tz'och smul, haxo heb' malaj smul chi', max eyal-laj syaelal heb'.

Yuj chi', icha wal tz'aj stz'ab'at anh ak yuj te' k'ak', icha stz'ab'at te' xiltak te' taquinh, icha chi' ol aj he lajwieli. Icha tz'aj te te' stakjieli yujto k'aeltakxo sch'anhal yib' te', toxonhej tz'el b'ulnaj xumaquil te', tz'ochkan pokokal, icha chi' ol ex ajok, yujto ix he chakkanel sk'ayb'ub'al Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil. Ix he patiquejpaxel scheknab'il ko Diosal Axonhej.

Yuj chi' skot wal yowal sk'ol t'a eyib'anh, ol yak'anoch eyaelal. Ha lum niwak witz, ol ib'xok lu'um, toxonhej teltumb'a ol ex ajkan he cham t'a yoltak kalle. Manh yujok chi' ol och waan yowal sk'ol Jehová chi', palta to ol yak'nhej eyaelal chi'.
Ol yik'chaanh jun bandera Jehová chi' yil juntzanhxo chonhab' najat ay. Ol xub'anb'at t'a heb' kajan b'aj slajwik'och lum lum tik, haxo skot lemnaj heb' chi'.
Malaj junok heb' soldado t'a skal heb' chi' k'unb'inak, mato ay swayanh. Malaj pax heb' choyan yajoch stzek'ul, ma d'inhchimtak sch'anhal sxanhab'.
Ha yol sjul-lab' heb', te jay snhi', tzatz yaj ste'al sjul-lab' heb' chi'. Ha yech nok' schej heb', icha wal k'een k'een te tzatz, haxo skarruaje heb', jelan sb'ey icha chakxuxum ik'.
Ayic tz'el yaw heb', icha wal yel yaw nok' choj ayik sayan schib'ej nok'. Syik'anb'at nok' b'aj ay, manhxalaj mach syal yik'anek' t'a nok'.

Ayic ol kot heb' anima t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', aton t'a jun k'u chequel yaj chi', ol el yaw heb' sjawi t'a spatik ko chonhab' tik, icha wal sk'anh ha' mar. Ha mach ol ilankotok, ol yil eyaelal chi' heb'. Ichato k'ik'k 'inal yaji, ol tup sakil k'inal yuj asun.
Ha t'a jun ab'il ayik ix cham winhaj rey Uzías, ata' ix wil Dios Kajal, k'ojanem t'a sk'ojnub' te chaanh yajk'ei. B'ut'an yol stemplo yuj stitak spichul.
Ha t'a yib'anhk'ei, ay juntzanh ángel icha k'ak' yilji skuch serafín, waque' sk'axil junjun heb'. Chab' sk'axil heb' chi' smusan sat, haxo chab'xo smusan yichanh heb', haxo yet' chab'xo sjenhwi heb'.
Syalan heb' t'ay junjun icha tik: Ha Jehová Axonhej wal, aton Yajal t'a Smasanil. Chequelnhej stziquiquial t'a masanil yol yib'anhk’inal tik, xchi heb'.
Ayic ix och jun aw chi', ix ib'xik'e spuertail templo chi', ix b'ud'jiel yool chi' yuj tab'.
Ix walan icha tik: Ay... ob'iltak in, ol in chamok, yujto ix wil Jehová, aton Rey t'a Smasanil. Ha in xo pax tik, anhej chukal swala', kajan in paxek' t'a skal heb' anima chuknhej sloloni, xin chi.
Axo t'a jun rato chi', ay jun t'a skal heb' ángel chi' ix kot jenhenhok t'ayin. Yed'nak jun tenaza b'aj ix yik'kot tzak'ak' t'a yib'anh altar.
Ix squilanek' t'a in ti', ix yalan t'ayin icha tik: Ha jun tzak'ak' ix in quilek' t'a a ti' tik, ha' ix ik'ankanel a mul tiknaik, ix ak'ji niwank'olal a mul, xchi.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan Jehová chi' icha tik: ¿Mach junok ol in chekb'ati? ¿Mach wal junok ol och ko chekab'ok? xchi. Yuj chi' ix in tak'wi t'ay: Ina in tik Mamin, chequinb'ati, xin chi.
Ix yalan t'ayin: Ixic, b'at al t'a juntzanh anima chi' icha tik: Val yel ol eyab'nhej, palta manh ol nachajel-laj eyuuj. Ol eyilnhej, palta manh ol nachajpaxel-laj eyuuj, xa chi t'a heb'.

Ak' somchaj spensar juntzanh anima chi', mak schiquin heb', tza makan sat heb' yik max yil heb', yik max yab'pax heb', yik max nachajpaxel yuj heb', yik wach' max meltzajxi heb' t'ayin yik tzin kolan heb', xchi t'ayin.

Ix in k'anb'an t'ay icha tik: Mamin, ¿jantak tiempo ol walel jun tik? xin chi. Ix yalan t'ayin: Ol alnhej jun tik masanto ol lajwoquem juntzanh chonhab', manhxa mach ol kan kajan t'ay. Manhxa junok pat ol kan anima t'a yool, ol kan tzinan lu'um.
Ha in Jehová in tik ol wak'b'at juntzanh anima tik t'a junxo chonhab', yik ol kan wal tzinan schonhab' heb' tik.

Tato ayto jaywanhokxo anima olto kan t'a yol chonhab' tik, smak'chajpaxem lanhnaj jun chonhab' chi'. Icha yik sch'akjiel junok te' ji, ma junok te' mach', axonhej te' yib' skani, icha chi' ol aj in chonhab' tik. (Palta syal swolanxi te' yib' chi'. Icha chi' ol aj yinhtilal jaywanhokxo heb' in chonhab' sik'b'ilel wuuj), xchi Jehová.

Ayic ayoch winhaj Acaz yuninal winhaj Jotam yixchiquin winhaj Uzías reyal t'a Judá, ix jawi winhaj Rezín sreyal Siria yet' winhaj Peka yuninal winhaj Remalías sreyal Israel yak' owal t'a Jerusalén, yik syik'anek' heb' winh yalani, palta maj yal-laj yuj heb' winh.

Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi' ix ul alchaj t'a winhaj rey Acaz chi' yet' heb' winh ayoch yopisio yet' winh icha tik: Ha heb' aj Siria, junnhej ix yutej sb'a heb' yet' heb' aj Israel, wan sjawi heb' yak' owal, xchi. Yuj chi' ix ib'xik'e winh rey yet' heb' anima chi' yuj xiwelal, icha wal yib'xi te te' yuj ik', icha chi' sluklon heb'.

Yuj chi' ix yal Jehová t'ayin Isaías in tik icha tik: Ixic, ik'b'at winh uninal aj Sear-jasub ed'ok. Ol a chalaj a b'a yet' winhaj Acaz chi' b'aj tz'el yok ha ha' ay t'a jun tanque t'a yib'anh b'e, b'aj sjuk'chaj k'apak k'apak.

Tzalan t'a winh icha tik: Tzil wal a b'a, palta manh ach xiwok, manh a komon xib'tej a b'a. Manh ach xiw yuj winhaj Rezín yet' heb' aj Siria chi' yet' pax winh yuninal winhaj Remalías chi', yujto skot wal yowal heb' t'ayach icha chab'ok te' kuxk'ak' ay stab'il.
Ha heb' aj Siria yet' heb' aj Efraín yet' winh yuninal winhaj Remalías chi', te chuk tas wan snaan heb' t'a a patik. Syalan heb' winh icha tik:
Koyec, b'at ko maquek ek' Judá, ko xib'tej heb' anima chi', squikan jun chonhab' chi', haxo winh yuninal winhaj Tabeel skak'kanoch reyal ta', xchi heb' winh.
Palta a in Jehová in swal icha tik: Malaj b'ak'uinh ol elk'och jun tas sna heb' winh chi'.

Yujto a Damasco, a niwan chonhab' yaj t'a Siria chi', haxo winhaj Rezín chi' ayoch sreyalok. Axo Samaria, a niwan chonhab' yaj t'a Efraín chi', haxo winh yuninal winhaj Remalías chi' ayoch sreyalok. Palta yik wal 65 ab'il tiknaik, ol lajwoquem heb' aj Efraín chi', manhxo chonhab'ok ol aj heb'. Tato a ex pax tik manh ol in eyak' wal och t'a he k'ol sik'lab'il, manh ol kannhej he chonhab' tik, xchi Jehová chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin Isaías in tik to swal t'a winhaj Acaz icha tik:
k'an il junok tas t'a Jehová ko Diosal. Syal sch'oxan il junok tas satub'tak yilji, wach'chom ato t'a sjulal yich lum lum tik, mato ato t'a yib'anh satcha’anh, xin chi t'a winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Acaz chi': Maay, a in tik max yal wak'an prowal Jehová yik tzin k'an wil junok tas satub'tak t'ay, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix walan icha tik: Ex yinhtilalkan winhaj rey Dawid, ab'ek tas ol wala': Ha he naani to malaj yelk'och he tzuntzan heb' anima. ¿Tom tze nib'ej tze tzuntzejpax ko Diosal icha tzeyutej heb' chi'?
Ha wal lak'an Jehová ol ch'oxan junok tas satub'tak t'ayex: Ha jun ix kob'es tik ol pitzwokoch jun unin t'a spatik ix, ol aljok jun swinak unin ix, Emanuel ol yak' ix sb'iej.
Ayic ayxo spensar jun unin chi', ol slo queso, ol yab'lanpax nok' yal chab' yet' heb' yetchonhab', yujto ayek' heb' t'a skal mheb'ail.
Ayic mantalaj spensar jun unin chi', a chab' schonhab' chawanh heb' rey b'aj tzach xiw tik, ol kan tzinan.

Ha Jehová ol ak'ankot jun yaelal t'a ib'anh, yet' t'a yib'anh a chonhab' yet' t'a yib'anh heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Dawid. Ha jun tik manta b'aj ix uji yiktax ix yik'anel sb'a Efraín t'a Judá. (Aton winh sreyal Asiria ol ak'anoch jun yaelal chi'.)
Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', a Jehová ol ak'ankot heb' soldado kajan t'a snajatil ha ha' sb'ey t'a Egipto, ol jawok somnaj heb' icha nok' niwak us, ol ja pax heb' aj Asiria icha nok' nok'al chab'.
Ol laj aj heb' t'a lum niwak yoltak opan, t'a yoltak k'een nhak'een, t'a skal lum wayumtak, t'a kaltak q'uiix yet' b'ajtak syuk' ha' nok' wakax.

Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', icha junok k'een joxlab' jolom, icha chi' ol yutok Jehová smajnan winh sreyal Asiria, winh kajan t'a sk'axepalb'at ha' niwan Éufrates. Ol ja winh yik'b'at masanil tastak ay t'ayex, ichato ol sjoxel xil he jolom winh, xil he ti' yet' xil he niwanil.
Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', yalnhej mach ol smol junok snun wakax, ma chawanhok snun kalnel,
ol yak' sobre yal yim nok' t'ay, ol sb'oan nok' queso heb'. Yalnhej mach ol kolchaj t'a skal owal chi', ol slo nok' queso chi' heb', ol yuk'an nok' yal chab' heb'.
Ha t'a junok lum lum b'aj awab'il mil ib'ok te' uwa, mil tumin plata stojol t'a pekataxo, haxo ol ajok, ol satem juntzanh awb'en chi'. Ol q'uib'xok k'e ste'al lu'um, kaltak q'uiix ol ajxok lu'um.
Axonhej heb' pechum nok' ol ek' yet' sjul-lab' ta', yujto ol ochkan lum wayumtaquil yet' kaltak q'uiixal.

Ha lum tzalquixtak sd'okji yet' k'een asaron t'a yalanhtaxo, wayumtak, kaltak q'uiix ol ajkan lu'um. Manhxalaj mach ol yal yawan tas t'a lu'um, axonhej nok' wakax yet' nok' kalnel ol wa t'a sat lu'um.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Say junok tas niwan yaj chek'an b'aj ol a tz'ib'ejem Maher-salal-hasbaz. Niwac ol utej a tz'ib'anemi.
Slajwi chi' tzak'ankanoch winhaj sakerdote Urías yet' winhaj Zacarías yuninal winhaj Jeberequías testigoal, to yel a ach tza tz'ib'ej jun chi', xchi t'ayin.

Ixlajwi chi', ix in way yet' ix wetb'eyum, aton ix schekab' Dios, ix skuchankanoch yune' ix. Axo yik ix alji jun unin chi', ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ha winh unin tik, Maher-salal-hasbaz ol ak' sb'iej winh, xchi.
Ayic manto yal yalan mamin, nunin winh unin chi', ol ik'jokb'at masanil sb'eyumal chonhab' Damasco yet' chonhab' Samaria yuj winh sreyal Asiria, xchi Jehová chi'.
Ix yalanxi t'ayin icha tik:
Yujto xiw juntzanh anima tik t'a winhaj Rezín yet' t'a winh yuninal winhaj Remalías, tzin spatiquejel heb' a in icha ha ha' ay t'a Siloé waji, ha' malalinhej sb'eyi.

Ha inxo ichato ol wak'kot chulnaj ha' niwan Éufrates tz'el t'a stitak smelemal t'a yib'anh heb', ol jawok sib'naj ha' t'a Judá tik, ol b'ud'joquel masanil sat lum yuj ha'. Ol k'ek'och sjulal ha' t'a sjaj heb' anima tik. (Syalelk'ochi aton winh sreyal Asiria yet' masanil soldado). Icha chi' ol yutok winh smakanek' lum a lu'um ach Emanuel, icha junok nok' nok' tz'el jenhan sk'axil, niwan smaka', icha chi' ol yutok lum a lu'um chi' winh, xchi Jehová.
Ex niwak chonhab', molb'ejek he b'a tzex kot eyak' owal, palta ol ex satelok. Ex niwak chonhab' te najat ay, ab'ek wal, nab'anhej tzeyik'kot eyamk'ab' yik owal, ol ex satjoknhejelok.
Ol eyal-laj eyab' tas ol he k'ulej, palta manh ol schalaj sb'a eyalani. Ol och t'a stzolal tas ol he k'ulej, palta manh ol elk'ochok, yujto ha Dios aynhej ek' qued'ok.
Ha Jehová yet' wal yip ix och yub'yub' t'ayin, ix yalani: Manh a b'eyb'alej sb'eyb'al juntzanh anima tik.
Manh a mol alej yet' heb' sk'anan skolwal junokxo mach. Manh a xib'tej a b'a yuj b'aj xiw heb' anima tik.
Ha in Jehová in Yajal in t'a Smasanil, Ha innhejokab' t'a yol a sat, anhej t'ayin tzach xiwi. Ayokab' welk'och t'a yol a sat.

Ha in ol in och a kajnub'ok b'aj syal a kolan a b'a. Palta ha t'a heb' aj Israel yet' heb' aj Judá, icha wal k'een k'een b'aj slok sb'a yok heb' anima, icha chi' waji. Yuj chi' ol yamchajelta heb' aj Jerusalén tik.
Tzijtum heb' ol stenoch yok, ol telwok heb', ol cham heb', ol kan heb' t'a yaal, ol yamchaj heb', xchi Jehová t'ayin.
Ex in k'ayb'um, sik'ekkan in k'ayb'ub'al tik t'a he pensar, malajokab' b'ak'uinh sb'at satk'olal eyuuj.
Wach'chom sk'ub'ejel sb'a Jehová t'ayonh a onh yinhtilal onh winhaj Jacob tik, palta swak'och in k'ol t'ay, anhej ayoch yipok in k'ool.
Ha in tik yet' heb' wuninal ix yak' Jehová, ch'oxnab'il waj yet' heb' t'a skal heb' quetisraelal, yujto icha chi' ix in yutej Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, aton kajanek' t'a tzalan Sion.

Ol laj yal heb' anima t'ayex icha tik: k'anb'ejek he b'ha t'a heb' winh syal yuj yet' t'a heb' sk'uman spixan heb' chamnak, aton heb' snumnoni yet' heb' sajsoni. ¿Tas yuj manhok t'a heb' ko diosal sko k'anb'ej ko b'a? ¿Tas yuj manhok t'a heb' ko chamnak sko k'anb'ej ko b'a yik skolwaj heb' t'ayonh pitzan onh tik? xcham heb'.
Tzeyil wal tas syal scheknab'il Dios yet' sk'ayb'ub'al. Tato a heb' tzex k'ayb'an max alan icha syal slolonel Dios chi', manh pensaril tas syal heb' chi'.
Ha heb' anima tik, ol b'at tik ol b'at tik heb' yuj wejel. Yuj wal wejel chi', ol owaj wal heb'. Ol b'uchwaj heb' t'a sreyal yet' t'a sDiosal. Olto k'e k'elan heb' t'a satcha’anh,
ol em k'elan heb' t'a sat lu'um, palta axonhej kusk'olal ol scha heb' yet' yaelal icha k’ik’ k’inal. Ol kan heb' t'a skal k’ik’ k’inal chi', manhxo ol yal skolan sb'a heb'.

Palta manh masanilok tiempo ol kan heb' tz'ixtaj chi' t'a skal kusk'olal. Wach'chom emnaquil ix ajkan lum Galilea yuj Dios, palta ol ik'jokxichaanh lu'um, aton lum ay t'a yol yik Zabulón yet' t'a yol yik Neftalí, lum ay t'a stitak ha' Jordán yet' t'a stitak ha' mar, lum ay t'a slak'anil lum yik heb' manh israelok.
Ha heb' anima kajan chi' ta', ayek' heb' t'a kal k’ik’ k’inal, palta ol yil jun niwan sakil k'inal heb'. Ol k'och kopnaj jun sakil k'inal t'a heb' ay t'a kal k’ik’ k’inal chi'.

Mamin, a ach ix ak'xi q'uib' ko b'isul t'a ko chonhab' tik, ix ak'anxipax ko niwan tzalajk'olal. Tzonh tzalaj ko masanil t'a ichanh, icha tzonh tzalaji ayik sko molan sat kawb'en, icha stzalaj heb' soldado ayik spojanek' jantak b'eyumal syik' heb' t'a owal.
Yujto a ach ix a satel jun nakión, aton jun ik'annak onh b'at t'a ch'ok nakional, aton b'aj ix ak'jioch ko yaelal. Ix a satel jun nakión chi' icha utej a satannaquel chonhab' Madián t'a peka'.
Ha xanhab' heb' soldado sk'anhi ayik sb'at heb' t'a owal yet' spichul heb' b'onhb'il yuj chik', ol juljokb'at t'a kal k'ak', ol tz'ab'at smasanil.

Yujto ix alji jun winak unin t'a ko kal. Ha Dios ix ak'an jun unin tik t'ayonh. Ha jun unin tik, ol ak'chajoch yopisio yak'an Yajalil. Ol ak'chajoch juntzanh b'i tik t'ay: Ak'um Razón te Jelan, Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil, Mamab'il Aynhejek' t'a Junelnhej, Yajalil Ak'um Junk'olal.

Ol yak' reyal sk'exulok winhaj rey Dawid t'a yib'anh masanil lugar. Junk'olal ol yak' yajalil t'a junelnhej. Ol yik' wal yip yajalil chi', ol sch'olb'itan tas t'a stojolal yet' t'a wach'il. Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil ol ak'anelk'och jun tik, yujto nab'ilxo yuj.
Ix yal Jehová yuj yaelal ol jawok t'a yib'anh Israel, schonhab' winhaj Jacob.

Yuj chi' masanil heb' anima t'a yol yik Efraín masanto heb' kajan t'a Samaria, ol nachajel yuj heb' to a Jehová tz'ak'ankot juntzanh yaelal chi', palta yet' yak'umtaquil heb' yet' spitalil heb', syalan heb' icha tik:

Wach'chom tz'em lanhnaj ko xan pat, ol ko b'oxik'e yet' k'een k'een tzeyb'il. Wach'chom sch'akjiel te' sikómoro sko k'an ste'alok ko pat, palta haxo pax te' k'ute' ol ko k'an sk'exulok te', xchi heb'.
Ha Jehová ol ik'ankot heb' ajk'ol yajoch t'a winhaj Rezín, yik syak'an owal heb' t'a Israel.

Ha t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u ol kot heb' aj Siria, haxo t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u ol kot heb' filisteo. Junxonhej ol aj satjiel Israel yuj heb'. Wach'chom icha chi' ol ajok, palta manto ol ochlaj waan yowal sk'ol Jehová, ol yak'nhejkot yaelal t'a schonhab'.
Palta haxo heb' schonhab' chi' jun, max sna sb'a heb' yalanxi sb'a d'ha Dios, wach'chom ix ak'jioch syaelal heb'. Max yak'och sb'a heb' t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil.
Yuj chi' icha junok nok' nok' xikjiel snhe yet' sjolom yuj junok mach, ma icha b'aj junnhej k'ual sch'akjiel te' palma yet' te' aj, icha chi' ol utaj heb' israel chi' yuj Jehová.
(Ha jun jolom chi', aton heb' yichamtak winaquil chonhab' yet' heb' yajal yaji. Axo jun nhe chi', aton heb' syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios, palta anhej es syak' k'ayb'aj heb'.)
Ha heb' yajal yaji, tonhej tz'ak'ji musansatil heb' anima yuj heb', haxo heb' tz'och tzak'an yuj heb' chi' tonhej satb'at heb'.

Yuj chi' manhxo ol ok' sk'ol Jehová t'a heb' kelemtak winak, t'a heb' unin manhxa smam yet' t'a heb' ix ix chamnak yetb'eyum, yujto a heb' anima tik, junelnhej ix te chukb'i heb', axonhej chukal lolonel syal heb' smasanil. Yuj chi' manto ol ochlaj waan yowal sk'ol Jehová, ol yak'nhejkot yaelal t'a schonhab'.

Ha schukal heb' anima chi', niwan tas tz'ixtax yuj, icha wal yik tz'el k'ak' a stz'ab'at te' q'uiix yet' wayumtak, stz'apaxb'at niwak yax lu'um yuj, syoyan sb'a chakxuxum ik' t'a skal stab'il sk'e chi'.
Yuj wal yowal sk'ol Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, wan slajwiel schonhab' yet' heb' anima, icha tz'aj slajwiel junok chonhab' yuj te' k'ak'. Manhxo ol ek'laj syaelal heb' anima t'ay junjun.
Yalxonhej tas jab'ok ol ilchaj yuj heb', ol yab'lanb'at heb', palta manh ol ek'laj swejel heb', manh ol b'ud'joklaj heb'. Yuj chi' ol laj schib'at yuninal heb' yuj wejel.

Ha heb' yinhtilal Manasés, ol yak' owal heb' yet' heb' yik Efraín. Ol spakanpax sb'a heb' yik Efraín chi'. Axo ol ajok, ol yak' owal heb' scha makanhil yet' heb' aj Judá. Wach'chom icha chi' ol aj heb', palta manto ol ochlaj waan yowal sk'ol Jehová, ol yak'nhejkot yaelal t'a schonhab'.
Ob'iltak ex tze b'o juntzanh ley manh tojolok, tz'ixtax heb' anima yuj.
Max eyal syaelal heb' mheb'atak anima tz'ixtaj t'a skal in chonhab'. Malaj yelk'och jab'ok heb' t'a yol he sat. Tzeyelk'ej tastak ay t'a heb' ix chamnak yetb'eyum yet' t'a heb' unin manhxa smam.
¿Tas wal ol eyutej he b'a ayik ol jawok eyaelal, ayik ol eyilan skot yaelal chi' t'a najat? ¿Mach b'aj ol he k'an kolwal? ¿B'ajtil ol eyak'kan he b'eyumal?
Ha mach t'a he kal manh ol ik'jokb'at t'a ch'ok nakional, ol miljokcham yet' heb' chamnakxo. Wach'chom icha chi' ol ex ajok, palta manto ol ek' yowal sk'ol Jehová. Ol yak'nhejoch eyaelal chi'.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Ob'iltak winh sreyal Asiria. Ha tiknaik wan wak'lab'an winh icha junok te' k'okoch swak'lab'ej yet' yowal in k'ool yik swak'anoch eyaelal.

Ha ex malaj jab'ok welk'och t'ayex, tze tzuntzejpaxkot yowal in k'ool, a winh tzin chekb'at t'ayex. Tzin chekb'at jun winh rey chi', yik wach' syelk'ejb'at masanil he b'eyumal winh, tzex stek'ankanem winh icha lum sok'om t'a yoltak b'e.
Palta manhoknhej chi' nab'il yuj winh sreyal Asiria chi', nab'il pax yuj winh to tzijtum nakión ol satel winh.
Syalan winh icha tik: Masanil heb' yajal in soldado, icha rey yaj heb', a in swak' mandar heb'.
Lajan ix wutej chonhab' Calno yet' chonhab' Carquemis. Icha ix wutej Hamat, icha pax chi' ix wutej chonhab' Arfad. Axo Samaria lajan ix ajkan yet' Damasco.
Ix wiquejkan juntzanh nakión tzijtum sdiosal. Ha wal sdiosal heb' chi', ek'to yipal t'a yichanh sdiosal heb' aj Jerusalén yet' heb' aj Samaria.
Yuj chi' jun, a wal tas ix in k'ulej t'a Samaria chi' yet' t'a sdiosal, ¿tom manh ol tzak'wanpax in k'ulan t'a Jerusalén yet' sdiosal? xchi winh, xchi Jehová.

Ayic ol lajwok syamk'ab'aj winh sreyal Asiria chi' yuj Jehová yuj sk'ulan tas nab'il yuj t'a tzalan Sion yet' t'a Jerusalén, ichato chi' b'ian, ol yak'anxioch yaelal Jehová t'a yib'anh winh yuj masanil tas ix sk'ulej yuj yak'umtaquil, yujto niwak winak ix yutej sb'a winh.

Ix yal winh sreyal Asiria chi' icha tik: Yuj wal sjelanil in pensar ix elk'och juntzanh ix in k'ulej tik, ix nachaj wal in k'ulani. Ix techaj in k'exan smojonal juntzanhxo chonhab', ix wik'ankanek' masanil tastak ay t'ay. Ix techajpax in tek'ankanem heb' rey chi' yet' wipal.

Icha wal quik'ank'eta snholob' nok' much t'a yol so' ayik malaj nok' snun chi' ayeq'ui, icha chi' ix wutej wik'anek' sb'eyumal juntzanh nakión chi'. Ix wik'anpaxkanek' slum heb', manhxalaj b'aj ix yal yalan sb'a heb'. Malaj tas ix yal heb', tonhej ix och k'elan heb', xchi winh.
Palta naek nab'i, ¿tokwal niwan yelk'och k'een ch'akab' yet' k'een serrucho t'a yichanh mach sk'anani? Ha junok k'okoch nab'a te', ¿tom a te' ol ak'an ib'xok junok anima sk'anan chi'?

Yuj wal chi', a Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, ha' ol ak'ankot junok yab'il te ow, haxo ol ik'anel yip heb' winh soldado te tek'an ayoch yipok sk'ol winh sreyal Asiria chi', ol satel yak'umtaquil winh icha stz'ab'at junok tas yuj te' k'ak'.
Ha Dios Axonhej Ochi, sakil k'inal yaj t'a Israel, junnhej k'ual ol satel heb' aj Asiria yuj, icha tz'aj stz'aem te' q'uiix yuj te' k'ak'.
Ol satel masanil heb' niwak winak, icha tz'aj satel te' niwak te' yet' te' awb'en te' wach' yilji sch'akchajemi. Icha junok mach ya'ay to manhxa yip, icha chi' ol ajkan Asiria chi'.
Jaywanhxonhej heb' soldado olto kanok, icha tz'ajkan jayeokxo te te' max ch'akjieli, wach'chom junok unin ol yal sb'isan heb'.

Ha t'a jun pekti’ t'a b'ak'uinh, a jaywanhxo heb' israel yinhtilal winhaj Jacob ol kolchajkanok, manhxo ol yak'och jun chonhab' heb' yipok sk'ool, aton jun ijan ix satanel heb', palta a Jehová sDiosal heb' ol yak'och yipok sk'ool, aton Dios Axonhej Ochi.
Ay jaywanh heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jacob ol meltzajxioch spensar d'ha Dios te ay yip.
Wach'chom a heb' israel, te niwan sb'isul heb' icha yarenail sti' ha' mar, palta jaywanhxonhej heb' ol meltzaj t'a schonhab'. Nab'ilxo yuj Dios to ol satel heb' icha wal t'a stojolal.
Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil ol satanel masanil anima t'a yol smakb'en tik, icha ajnak yalani.

Palta ha' tz'alan icha tik: Ex in chonhab' kajan t'a Sion, wach'chom ol ex smak' heb' aj Asiria t'a te' jixk'ab' te', mato yet' sk'okoch heb', icha yutejnak ex heb' aj Egipto, palta manh ex xiw t'a heb',
yujto yik wal jaye' k'ual tik ol tupem yowal in k'ol t'ayex. Ol in satel heb' aj Asiria chi' yet' yowal in k'ool.

Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, ol wak'och yaelal t'a yib'anh heb', icha ajnak in satanel chonhab' Madián t'a slak'anil k'een tenam yik Oreb, icha ajnak in ch'oxan in poder ayik in pojannak snanhal ha' Chacchac Mar t'a Egipto.
Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', ol wik'el ikatz ayoch t'a eyib'anh yuj heb' aj Asiria chi', icha tz'aj skanhchajel te' yugo ayoch t'a yib' sjaj nok' wakax.
Ha heb' ajk'ol chi', aton heb' aj Asiria, wan sjawi heb' t'a Rimón yet' t'a Ajat, wan yek' heb' t'a Migrón. Ha t'a Micmas skan yikatz heb'.
Ix k'axpajek' heb' t'a jun niwan ch'olan, ix sb'oank'e skampamento heb' t'a Geba. Axo heb' aj Ramá, ix xiwkan heb'. Ha heb' aj Gabaa schonhab' winhaj Saúl, wan sb'at heb' elelal.
Ex kajan ex t'a Galim, elokab' eyaw. Ab'ek yel aw chi' ex aj Lais. Ob'iltak ex ex aj Anatot.
Van sb'at heb' aj Madmena elelal. Ha heb' kajan t'a Gebim wan b'at sk'ub'anpaxel sb'a heb'.
Ha tiknaik ol ek' ak'wal yuj heb' soldado chi' t'a Nob. Smuch' sk'ab' heb', syik'anchaanh heb', sch'oxankot heb' to ol yak' ganar tzalan Sion tik heb', aton chonhab' Jerusalén.

Ilec wal, a Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil ol satanel heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ay icha tz'aj sch'akjiel te te' t'a Líbano. Ayxo smay sk'anh yem te'. Aton te te' chaanh steel, wach' yilji, stelwi t'a sat lu'um.
Icha chi' ol aj satjiel heb' ajk'ol chi', icha tz'aj sch'akjiel te te' b'aj te k'ayum, aton te te' wach' yilji t'a Líbano chi'.
Icha wal swolan junok te yib' te', icha chi' ol aj spitzwichaanh jun yinhtilal winhaj Isaí.
Ol ochnhej Yespíritu Jehová yet'ok. A' ol ak'an sjelanil yet' yaj pensaril. Yuj Yespíritu chi', ol nachajel yak'an razón, ay pax yipal. Ol yojtaquejel Jehová, ol ik'jokpaxchaanh yuj.
Ol sk'anab'ajej Jehová chi' t'a tzalajk'olal. Manh ol sch'olb'itej heb' anima t'a ichnhejta', ma yuj tas syab' t'a spatik heb'.
D'a stojolal ol sb'o yaj yowal heb' meb'a' yet' heb' anima emnaquil syutej sb'a. Tonhej ol yala' ol ak'jok syaelal heb' tzek' t'a yib'anh, ol ak'jokoch heb' sk'ulan chukal chi' t'a yol sk'ab' chamel.
Ha tas tojol yet' tas yel, a chi' ol cheklaj t'ay.

Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', a nok' oques yet' nok' yunetak kalnel, junk'olal ol aj nok'. Ha nok' tigre yet' nok' chiwa, junnhej ol em kutzan nok'. Ha nok' quelem wakax yet' nok' choj, junnhej ol q'uib' nok'. Axo junok unin ol tanhwan nok'.
Ha nok' nun wakax yet' nok' nun oso, junnhej ol aj nok'. Axo yune' nok', junnhej ol em kutzan. Ha nok' choj, a anh ank'ultak ol sk'ux nok' icha nok' wakax.
Ha heb' nenetak unin, ol tajnok heb' b'aj ay yolanil nok' chan. Ol snhaloch sk'ab' heb' t'a yolanil nok' ajawchan, palta manh ol chijoklaj heb' yuj nok'.

Manhxa chukal ol ujok t'a jun tzalan sik'b'ilel yuj Jehová. Icha tz'aj sb'ud'jiel ha' mar yuj ha ha', icha wal chi' ol aj yojtakajel Jehová yuj masanil anima t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, masanil heb' ol ojtakanel Jehová chi'.

Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', ol cheklaj jun rey t'a skal yinhtilal winhaj Isaí. Chequel ol ajk'e t'a skal juntzanh nakión yik ol smolb'ej sb'a heb' b'aj ayek' chi'. Te niwan ol aj yelk'och jun lugar b'aj ol aj chi'.

Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', ol sch'ox spoder Jehová junelxo, yuj chi' ol smolb'ejkot masanil heb' schonhab' sakleminak yajkanb'ati. Ol kot heb' aytokan t'a Asiria, t'a Egipto, t'a Patros, t'a Etiopía, t'a Elam, t'a Sinar, t'a Hamat yet' t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' ay t'a stitak ha' mar.

Ha Dios ol ch'oxank'e junok yechel t'a skal juntzanh nakión, yik ol smolb'ej sb'a heb' israel sakleminak yajkanb'ati. Anhejtona' ol smolb'ejxi sb'a heb' aj Judá sakleminak yajkanb'at b'aj slajwik'och yol yib'anhk’inal tik.
Ol lajwok chichonk'olal t'a skal Efraín yet' Judá, manhxo ol yak' owal heb'.

Axo heb' scha makanhil, junnhej ol b'at heb' yak' owal t'a heb' filisteo t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u. Ol yak'an ganar heb'. Junnhej ol aj yik'anek' sb'eyumal heb' kajan t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u heb', aton Edom, Moab yet' pax heb' amonita, yujto ol kan heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb'.

Ha Jehová ol ak'an tup jun sk'ab' ha' Chacchac Mar. Ol yak'anpaxkot jun owal ik' te k'ak' t'a yib'anh ha' Éufrates, ol tup ha'. Uque' makan ol ajkan ha', yuj chi' manhxo ol yik'el xanhab' heb' anima ayik ol ek' heb' t'a yol ha'.
Ayic ol meltzajxok heb' schonhab' Jehová aykan t'a Asiria, jakanxo jun niwan b'e b'aj ol ek'ta heb', icha ajnak b'e b'aj kotnak heb' chonhab' israel elnak t'a Egipto.
Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', ol ex b'itan icha tik: Mamin Jehová, skak' yuj diosal t'ayach. Wach'chom ix kot yowal a k'ol t'a quib'anh, palta toxo ix ek'b'ati, haxo tiknaik, wan ak'an sniwanil ko k'ool.
Ach ko Diosal, ko Kolumal aji. Tzach kak'och yipok ko k'ool, yuj chi' max onh xiwlaj. Mamin Jehová, tzach ko b'itej, yujto a achnhej tzak' quip, tzonh a kolanpaxi, xe chama.
Icha stzalaj junok mach stakji sti' syuk'an ha ha' sk'eul sjaj, icha chi' ol ex tzalaj yuj he kolnab'il ol yak' Jehová.

Yuj chi' ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', ol eyal icha tik: Kaq'ek yuj diosal t'a Jehová, kalek wach' lolonel t'ay. Calequel t'a skal junjun nakión tastak ix sk'ulej, yik wach' snakot heb' jantak swach'il. Malaj junokxo lajan yet'ok.
Conh b'itananhek t'a Jehová, yujto te niwan yelk'och tas ix sk'ulej, yowalil tz'ojtakajel t'a masanil yol yib'anhk’inal tik.
Ha onh kajan onh t'a Sion tik, elokab' kaw t'a tzalajk'olal, yujto a ko Diosal ayek' qued' a onh israel onh tik, Axonhej Ochi. Te niwan pax yelk'ochi, xe chama.
Ayocto ix sch'oxan Jehová wil a in Isaías in yuninal winhaj Amoz tas ol jawok t'a yib'anh Babilonia, yuj chi' ix wal icha tik:

Hak'uekk'e junok yechel yik owal t'a sjolom junok lum witz malaj ste'al. Awajanhec t'a heb' soldado to tz'och heb' yak' owal. Ik'ekk'e he k'ab' tze ch'oxan b'aj tz'och tzak'naj heb' soldado t'a spuertail b'aj tz'och heb' yajal yaj t'a Babilonia.

Toxo ix wawtej heb' winh in soldado te tek'an, toxo ix wal t'a heb' winh ak'um owal sik'b'ilxoel wuuj, ol tzalaj heb' winh ayik ol in satanel heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin yuj yowal in k'ool, xchi Jehová, xin chi.

Ab'ek wal yoch jun aw t'a jolomtak witz, tzijtum anima tz'el yaw, aton heb' anima ix laj kot t'a juntzanhxo nakión ix smolb'ej sb'a. Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil wan smolb'an heb' soldado ol ak'an owal chi'.
Aton heb' ix kot t'a juntzanh nakión te najat, b'aj slajwik'och lum lum. Ha Jehová sjawi yet' syamk'ab' yik yowal sk'ool, ol satanel masanil anima t'a sat lu'um tik.
Elokab' wek'ek'ok eyaw, yujto lak'anxo sjawi jun k'ual yik yowal sk'ol Jehová Syal Yuj Smasanil. Ha t'a jun k'ual chi', ol satjoquel masanil tas yuj.
Yuj chi' jun, masanil anima, ol el yip sk'ab' heb' yuj xiwelal, manhxo animaok ol ajkan heb'.

Ol te xiwk'e heb'. Ol ja wal jun niwan ilk'olal yet' yaelal t'a yib'anh heb'. Ol k'e kotan, ol k'e kuman heb' yab'an syail, icha junok ix ix tz'alji yune'. Toxonhej ol yil-lajoch sat heb', ol cheklajel xiwelal t'a sat heb'.
Van sjawi jun k'u yik Jehová, jun k'ual b'aj manhxo ol syamoch waan yowal sk'ool. Toxonhej ol kan tzinan lum lum tik yuj, ol satel masanil heb' chuk.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi', masanil k'een k'anal sweei t'a satcha’anh, manhxo ol yak'laj yok k'een. Ol k'ik'b'okpaxel yok k'u ayik wan sjawi, manhxo ol yak'paxlaj yok k'een uj.

Ol yalan Jehová icha tik: Ol wak'och syaelal masanil heb' anima t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik yuj chukal sk'ulej heb'. Ol wik'em heb' syik'chaanh sb'a. Ha heb' malaj yelk'och heb' yetanimail t'a sat, manhxa jab'ok ol aj yelk'och heb'.
Jaywanhxonhej anima ol kanok, yuj chi' puralxonhej ol ilchaj heb' icha k'een oro te wach', k'een skot t'a Ofir.
Ol in tzikub'tanhej satcha’anh, ol wik'el lum lum t'a yet'tal yuj yowal in k'ol a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil. Ol te kot wal wowal t'a jun k'ual chi'.

Ha heb' anima, lajan ol aj heb' icha nok' ch'ukul pechb'il, ma icha junok nhilanh nok' kalnel saklemb'ati, manhxa mach smolb'ani. Ol laj b'atkan junjun heb' anima chi' elelal t'a schonhab' yet' b'ajtak kajan.
Yalnhej mach ol yamchajok, ol tekjok chamok. Yalnhej mach ol yak' yamchaj sb'a, ol miljokchamok.
Q'uelan wal och heb', ol miljokcham yuninal heb' t'a sat lu'um. Ol laj ik'joquelta tastak ay t'a yoltak spat heb', ol ixtaj heb' ix yetb'eyum heb'.
Ol wak'kot heb' aj Media satel heb'. Ha heb' chi', manh ol och k'elan heb' yuj k'een plata, ma k'een oro.
Ha yet' sjul-lab' heb', ol sjulancham heb' kelemtak heb'. Manhxo ol ok'laj sk'ol heb' t'a heb' kotak unin yet' t'a heb' ak' unin.

Ha Babilonia chi', anhej wach' yilji t'a yichanh juntzanhxo nakión. Te ak'umtak heb' kaldeo yet'ok, icha k'een k'een wach' yilji, palta lajan ol ajkan icha ajnakkan Sodoma yet' Gomorra ayik in satannaqueli.
Manhxa b'ak'uinh ol kajnaj anima t'ay. Manhxo ol yak'em skampamento heb' tzek' stanhwej nok' smolb'etzal nok' ta'.
Axonhej nok' kaltakte'al nok' ol aj ta'. Ol b'ud'joquel yoltak pat yuj nok' tonton yet' nok' awestruz. Ol ek' tz'itiljok nok' k'ultaquil chiwa ta'.
