Ix in ch'aquem te' k'ute' chaanh steel yet' te' taj te wach' yilji. Ix in k'ek'och t'a lum jolomtak witz te chaanh b'aj k'ayum te te'.
Yalnhej b'aj syal in joyan ha' uk'b'ila' wuk'ej. Syal wek'nhej t'a ha ha' t'a Egipto, ichato tupnak ha', malaj mach syal in syamanoch waan, xa chi ix ik'an wal chaanh a b'a.

¿Tom manh ojtakok to a in Jehová in swak'elk'och masanil juntzanh chi'? Atax t'a peka' nab'il wuuj to ol ujok juntzanh chi', haxo tiknaik swak'elk'ochi. Yuj chi' ix yal a satanel juntzanh chonhab' wach' yajoch smuroal, toxonhej ix k'ekan b'ulan sk'ajil uuj.

Ha heb' kajan t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', ix te xiwkank'e heb', ix q'uixwikank'e heb'. Lajan ix ajkan heb' icha anh ank'ultak yax latz'inak, ma icha anh ank'ultak sq'uib'k'e t'a yib'anhtak pat, stakji yuj ik' skot b'aj sjawi k'u.
Vojtaknhej b'ajtak tzach eq'ui yet' tastak tza k'ulej. Vojtak to ix kot wal owal t'ayin.
Vojtak jantak owal, jantak wal ak'umtaquil, yuj chi' ol wak'och jun k'een argolla t'a a nhi' yet' jun freno t'a a ti', ol ach wak'an meltzaj t'a b'e b'aj ach koti, xchi Jehová.

Axo t'ayach ach Ezequías, ay jun yechel ol sch'ox Jehová eyila'. Ha t'a jun ab'il tik yet' t'a junxo, ol he wa sat ixim trigo munil ol pak'k'e sch'okoj. Axo t'a yoxil ab'il, a exxo ol eyawej eyiko', ol he molan sat tas ol eyawej chi'. Ol eyawej te' uwa, ol he loan sat te'.
Ha jaywanh ex ixto ex kan t'a Judá tik, lajan ol ex aj icha junok te te' tz'awchaji sb'at sch'anhal yib', elanhchamel satani.
Ha exxo jaywanh ex ixto ex kan t'a Jerusalén, t'a tzalan Sion tik, a ex ol eyak'xi b'ud'joquel ko chonhab' tik. Icha chi' ol ajok yujto xajan onh yuj Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil.

Axo pax yuj winh sreyal Asiria jun, ix yal Jehová icha tik: Manh ol och winh t'a Jerusalén tik, malaj junok yol sjul-lab' winh ol sjuleli. Manh ol och winh yak' owal t'ay yet' maklab' jul-lab'. Manh ol sb'ok'e stek'nub' winh t'a spatiktak smuroal chonhab' tik.
Ha in wal Jehová in swala', ha t'a b'e b'aj ol kot winh, anheja' ta' ol meltzaj winh. Manh ol yal yoch winh t'a yol chonhab' tik.
Ol in tanhwej jun chonhab' tik, ol in kolani, yujto tzin xajanej winh in chekab' aj Dawid yet' pax sniwanil Welk'ochi, xchi Jehová, xin chi.
Ha Yángel Jehová ix k'och t'a skampamento heb' aj Asiria chi', ix smilancham 185 mil heb' soldado. Chamnacxo heb' ix q'uinhib'i t'a junxo k'u.
Yuj chi', ix yik'el skampamento winhaj Senaquerib sreyal Asiria chi', ix pax winh t'a chonhab' Níniwe.

Ay jun k'u ayik wan slesalwi winh t'a stemplo sdiosal skuch Nisroc, haxo heb' winh yuninal winh, aton winhaj Adramelec yet' winhaj Sarezer, ix b'at milancham winh ta'. Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at heb' winh elelal t'a yol yik Ararat. Axo winhaj Esar-hadón, junxo yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.

Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', te ow jun yaelal ix och t'a winhaj Ezequías, wanxo scham winh. Ha inxo Isaías in schekab' Dios yuninal in winhaj Amoz, ix in k'och t'a winh, ix walan t'a winh icha tik: --Icha tik yalan Jehová: Alkani tas ol ajkan tastak ay t'ayach, yujto ol ach chamxonhej, manhxo ol ach b'oxok, xin chi t'a winh.
Ix meltzajoch k'elan winh t'a sat spat, ix lesalwi winh t'a Jehová icha tik:
Tzin tewi t'ayach Mamin Jehová, nakoti tas ix wutej ach wak'an serwil t'a smasanil in k'ool, ix in k'ulejnhej tas ix scha a k'ool, xchi winh. Ix te ok' wal winh sik'lab'il.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin
to sb'at walxi t'a winhaj Ezequías chi' icha tik: Ha Jehová sDiosal winh a mam icham aj Dawid, a tz'alan icha tik: Ix wab' a lesal, ix wilanpax oq'ui, yuj chi' ol wak' 15 ab'ilokxo a k 'inal.
Ol ach in kol yet' chonhab' Jerusalén tik t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Asiria. Ol in tanhwej jun chonhab' tik, xchi Jehová, xin chi.
Ix in tak'wi icha tik: --Ha jun yechel ol sch'ox Jehová chi' to yel ol elk'och tas ix yala':

Ha juntzanh b'akhquiltak sch'oxan jantak yek' k'u yik winhaj Acaz, ol yak'xi meltzaj Jehová lajunheok b'akhquiltak b'aj toxo ix emk'och wewen, xin chi. Yuj chi' ix schael yich yemxi lajunhe' b'akhquiltak wewen chi'.
Ayic toxo ix b'oxi sk'ol winhaj Ezequías sreyal Judá chi', ix sb'oan jun b'it tik winh:
Ha in naani to tek'an into ol in chamok. Yujto ix alchaj t'ayin to ayinxooch t'a yol sk'ab' chamel. Ha in naani to manhxo ol wil jayeokxo ab'il.
Mamin Jehová, ix in na' to manhxo ol ach wil t'a sat lum tik. Manhxo ol wilpax junok heb' kajan t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik walani,
yujto a in k 'inal ijan ix sateli, icha tz'aj sjuanem smantiado heb' tanhwum kalnel. Ha in k 'inal tik, lajan icha tz'aj spoljielta k'apak k'apak b'aj sb'oi. D'a k'ual t'ak'wal ix wab' syail uuj.
Ix el wal waw yuj syail tzek' ak'wal, ichato a junok nok' choj skach'an wekchaj in b'aquil. D'a k'ual t'ak'wal ix wab'nhej syail uuj.
k'unxonhej yel waw icha nok' sanhkapech, ix in k'akwi icha nok' paramuch. Ix in tzaktzaj in tanhwan a paktzitan t'ayin. Mamin Jehová, tzin ixtax wal swab'i, tak'wanh t'ayin.
Axo tiknaik, ¿tas wach' walan t'ayach? Yujto ix ak' a ti' to tzin ak' b'oxok, icha chi' ix in utej. Emnaquilal wek' tiknaik yuj in yaelal ix ek' tik.
Mamin, yujnhej tas tza k'ulej, ay sk'inal heb' anima, ay pax in k 'inal yet' heb'. Ha ach ix ak' b'oxok in k'ool, ix ak'anxi in k 'inal.

Ayic ix jawi jun yaelal tik t'a wib'anh, ix in te kusi, haxo tiknaik, junk'olal waji. Ix el t'a a k'ol ix in a kolkanel t'a yol sk'ab' chamel, yujto ix b'atkan in mul satk'olal uuj, ichato ix ak'kanb'at t'a a patik.

Ha heb' ayxoek' t'a kampusante, maxtzak yal yalan wach' lolonel heb' t'ayach. Ha heb' chamnak chi', ¿tom ol ach yik'chaanh heb'? Ha mach toxo ix emkan t'a yol lu'um, ¿tom olto yal stanhwan heb' ak'anelk'och tas ix al t'a heb'?
Anhej heb' pitzan syal yalan wach' lolonel t'ayach, icha tz'aj walan t'ayach tiknaik. Ha heb' mamab'il nunab'il, a heb' tz'alan t'a heb' yalyuninal to tzak'elk'och tas tzala'.
Ha Jehová ko Kolumal yaji, yuj chi' yakb'an pitzan onh, konh b'itanek t'a stemplo yet' yamk'ab' yik b'it, xchi winhaj Ezequías chi'.
Ix in chekan b'ojok sat te' higo, yik tz'ak'chajoch te' t'a sat jun yab'il chi', yik sb'oxi sk'ool winh yuj.
Ixlajwi chi', ix sk'anb'an winhaj Ezequías chi' t'ayin icha tik: --¿Tas junok yechel ol wila'' yik ol nachajel wuj to a Jehová ol ak'an b'oxok in k'ool, yik syal in b'at t'a stemplo? xchi winh.

Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', a winhaj Merodak-baladán, sreyal Babilonia, yuninal winhaj Baladán, ix yab' winh yalji to penaayaxnak winhaj Ezequías chi', palta b'oxnakxi sk'ol winh. Yuj chi' ix schekkot juntzanh heb' schekab' winh yik tzul yak'ankan heb' tas ix tz'ib'ejkot winh rey chi' yet' silab'.

Ix te tzalaj winhaj Ezequías chi' yujto ix jawi heb'. Ix sch'oxan masanil sb'eyumal winh t'a heb', aton k'een plata, k'een oro, perfume, akeite te wach', b'aj molan masanil yamk'ab' yik owal yet' masanil tastak ay t'a yet'tal b'aj molb'ab'il. Manhxa junok tas ay t'a spalakio winh yet' masanil tas ay t'a yol smakb'en winh maj sch'ox t'a heb' winh.

Axo yik ix paxkan heb' winh, ix in b'at a in Isaías in tik schekab' Dios wil winhaj rey Ezequías chi', ix in k'anb'an icha tik: --¿B'ajtil ix kot juntzanh heb' winh winak chi'? ¿Tas ix ul yal heb' winh t'ayach? xin chi. Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ha t'a jun chonhab' te najat ix kot heb' winh, aton Babilonia, xchi winh.

Ix in k'anb'anxi t'a winh: --¿Tas ix ul yil heb' winh t'a a palakio tik? xin chi. Ix yalan winh t'ayin: --Masanil tas ay t'a in palakio tik ix yil heb' winh, ix in ch'oxan masanil tastak molb'ab'il wuuj, xchi winh.
Ix walan t'a winh icha tik: --Ab' wal tas syal Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil:
Ol k'och sk'ual, masanil tas ay t'a a palakio tik yet' jantak tas ix smolb'ejkan heb' a mam icham yet' iko', ol ik'chajb'at masanil t'a Babilonia chi'.
Anhejtona' heb' inhtilal, ol ik'jokb'at heb' t'a Babilonia chi', ol ik'chajel snholob' sk'een heb', ol ochkan heb' yak'umalok serwil winh rey chi' t'a spalakio, xin chi.
Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ha jun lolonel ix schek Jehová al tik t'ayin, te wach' yaji, xchi winh. Yujto ix sna winh icha tik: Yakb'an pitzan in to, junk'olal kaji, malaj tas ol in ik'anok, xchi winh.
Ha Jehová ko Diosal tz'alan icha tik: Hak'ek sniwanil sk'ol in chonhab'.

Wach' tzeyutej he lolon t'a heb' aj Jerusalén, tzeyalan t'a heb' to manhxa b'ak'uinh ol och heb' chekab'ok, toxo ix stupel spitalil heb' yet' schukal, toxo ix scha syaelal heb' ix wak' icha wal t'a smojal, xchi Jehová.
Ay jun aw tz'ochi, syalan icha tik: B'oek junok sb'e Jehová t'a tzinan lu'um, tojol tzeyutej he b'oan jun b'e t'a ko Diosal, lewan tzeyutej he b'oan t'a lum malaj jab'ok tas tz'el t'a sat.
B'ud'ek lum ch'olquixtak, aq'ek panhanb'ok masanil lum witz yet' lum tzalquixtak. Tojolb'itejek sat lum sattak witz yet' opquiltak, ak'liktak tzeyutejkan sat lu'um.
Ichato chi' ol sch'oxan Jehová to niwan yelk'ochi, masanil anima ol ilanok. Ha wal Jehová ix alani, xchi jun aw chi'.

Ay jun aw ix alan icha tik. Awajanh, xchi. Ix in k'anb'an t'ay: ¿Tas ol wutej awaj in b'a? xin chi t'ay. Ix tak'wi, ix yalani: Aleli to a sk'inal masanil heb' anima, lajan icha anh ank'ultak k'un stakji. Elanhchamel tzek'b'at swach'il yilji heb' icha wal tz'aj yek'b'at swach'il yilji anh xumaak ay t'a lum panhquiltak.
Ha anh ank'ultak, wal tiknaik stakjiel anh, haxo xumaquil anh, tz'el b'ulnajok ayik tzek' yik'al Jehová t'a skal anh. Yel, a ex anima ex tik, lajan ex icha anh ank'ultak chi'.
Ha anh ank'ultak, stakjiel anh, slaj pukb'at xumaquil anh, palta haxo wal slolonel ko Diosal, aynhejek' t'a junelnhej, xa chi, xchi t'ayin.

Ex aj Sion, k'eanhek t'a sjolom jun lum witz. Te chaanh tzex awaj ta', yik tzeyalanel wach' ab'ix. Ex aj Jerusalén, manh ex xiw eyawaji, alek t'a junjun chonhab' yik Judá: Ina yajek' ko Diosal t'a tik, xe chi.
Ha Jehová Dios wan sjawi yet' spoder. Yuj spoder chi' syik'anem sb'a masanil anima t'ay, yet'nak spak tas ix yik' t'a smunlajel.
Ol jawok icha junok tanhwum kalnel stanhwan nok' skalnel, schelank'e nok' yunetak kalnel chi' t'a snhi' sk'ool, syailan nok' toto ix aj yune'.

¿Mach junok ix echtan ha' mar yet' yol sk'ab' yet' yechtan satcha’anh yet' yiximal sk'ab'? ¿Mach junok ix echtan masanil spokokal lum lum t'a yol junok echlab'? ¿Mach junok ix echtan yalil masanil lum witz yet' lum tzalquixtak? Aton Jehová.
¿Tom ay junok mach sk'ayb'an Jehová, ma tz'alan yab'i?

¿Tom ay junok mach ix ak'an srazón Jehová, ma ix jakan spensar? ¿Tom ay junok mach ix k'ayb'ani yik sch'olb'itan t'a stojolal? ¿Tom ay junok mach ix ch'oxani yik snaani? ¿Tom ay junok mach ix k'ayb'an t'a jelanil?

Ha t'a yol sat Jehová, a juntzanh niwak chonhab', lajan icha junok d'ujanh ha ha' tz'em t'a yet'tal, ma icha wal jab'ok lum pokok t'a yol junok echlab'. Ha juntzanh lum lum ay t'a snanhal ha' mar, lajan icha junok k'een k'aj k'een.
Masanil nok' nok' ay t'a Líbano, max tzak'wanlaj nok' yak'chaj silab'il t'a Jehová chi' yet' masanil te te' ay ta', max yab'paxlaj te' yoch sk'atzitzalok nok' silab' chi'.
Masanil juntzanh niwak chonhab', malaj jab'ok yelk'och t'a yol sat Jehová, malaj jab'ok yopisio t'ay.
¿Mach junok syal he lajb'an Dios yet'ok? ¿Tas junok yechel syal he lajb'an yet'ok?

Ha Dios, manh lajanok yet' junok yechel komon Dios. Ha heb' sb'oan juntzanh yechel chi' syak'em heb' t'a yol smoldeal, haxo junok tenum k'een tz'ak'anoch k'een oro t'a spatik, sb'oanoch k'een plata yelwanub'ok.

Ha junok mach max techaj sb'oan yechel t'a k'een oro chi', say te te' pit sk'ai. Syak'an te' t'a junok winh b'oum te' te jelan, yik sb'oan junok yechel chi' winh. Wach' syutejk'e linhan winh, yik max telwi.
¿Tom manh eyojtakok a ex tik? ¿Tom malaj mach ix alan eyab'i? ¿Tom malaj mach aljinak t'ayex t'a yiktax yichb’anel? ¿Tom malaj mach ix ex k'ayb'ani yiktax sb'onak yol yib'anhk’inal tik?

Ha sdespacho Dios ayk'e t'a yib'anh satcha’anh, aton satcha’anh chi' jenhanb'at t'a yib'anh lum lum tik. Ayic tzonh yilanemta Jehová a onh anima onh t'a sat lum tik, lajan onh icha nok' chil. Ha Dios chi' ix jenhb'anb'at satcha’anh chi' icha junok k'apak, ix slich'anb'at icha junok mantiado b'aj tz'aj anima.
Ha yuj Jehová manhxa tz'ajkan yelk'och heb' niwak winak, syak'an satem heb' yajal t'a sat lu'um tik.

Lajan heb' yajal chi' icha anh unin ank'ultak toto tz'awchaji, wanto yem sch'anhal yib' t'a yol lu'um. Tato syak'b'at yik' Jehová t'a yib'anh anh, stakjiel anh, tz'ik'jib'at anh yuj chakxuxum ik' icha yok trigo. Icha chi' tz'aj heb' yajal chi'.
Ha Jehová Dios Axonhej Ochi, a sk'anb'ani: ¿Mach yet' syal in he lajb'ani? ¿Tocwal ay mach lajan wed'ok? xchi.

Q'ueanhek k'elan t'a satcha’anh, ¿tom manhok Dios ixb’o’an masanil juntzanh chi'? Aton ix b'oani. A' ix b'oankanoch junjun k'een k'anal t'a yet'tal, syawtan junjun k'een t'a sb'i. Malaj junok k'een sati, yujto te niwan spoder Jehová chi'.
Ex israel, yinhtilal Jacob, ¿tas yuj tzeyalub'tanhej tzeyalan icha tik? Ha Jehová max kot k'elan t'ayonh yuj tas tzonh ik'ani, ¿tokwal tz'och ilk'olal kuuj? xe chi.
¿Tom manh eyojtakok? ¿Tom manta b'aj tzeyab'i? Ha Jehová Dios, aynhejek' t'a junelnhej. A' ixb’o’an yol yib'anhk’inal tik. Malaj b'aj tz'el yip, malaj b'aj sk'unb'i. Manhxa yalnab'il sjelanil.
Ha tz'ak'an yip heb' k'unb'inak, haxo heb' malaj yip, a tz'ak'an stek'anil heb'.
Ha heb' kelemtak, sk'unb'i heb', tz'el yip heb'. Ha heb' te ay yip, stelwipax heb'.

Palta a wal heb' anhej Jehová ayoch yipok sk'ool, tz'ochnhej yip heb'. Te tek'an heb' icha nok' niwak ch'akb'a sk'e jenhnaj yet' yip t'a chaanh, skarelawi heb', palta max k'unb'ilaj heb', sb'ey heb', palta max el-laj yip heb'.
Syal Dios icha tik: Ab'ek ex anima kajan t'a sti' ha' mar, numan tzex aj t'a wichanh. Tek'b'ejek he b'a ex niwak chonhab', kotanhek, junnhej tzonh ajek. Ol ex lolonok, ol in lolonpax a in tik.

¿Mach ol ak'an cheklaj jun rey t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, jun ol ak'annhej ganar owal? ¿Mach ol ak'anoch niwak chonhab' t'a yol sk'ab', yik ol yak'anem sb'a heb' t'ay? Ha yet' yespada jun rey chi' yet' sjul-lab' ol saktzipanb'at heb' icha sb'at smatz'il ixim trigo yuj ik'.
Ol el juntzanhxo heb' rey elelal t'a yichanh jun rey chi'. Palta tzalajk'olal ol b'atnhej, ichato manh ol em yok t'a sat lu'um.
¿Mach ol ak'an elk'och juntzanh tik? ¿Mach najinaquelta masanil tastak ujinak t'a yichb’anel? Ha in ton Jehová in, a in in b'onak. Ha innhej Dios in, b'ab'el waj t'a smasanil, slajwub' in paxi.

Ha juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a stitak ha' mar, ol yil heb', ol xiw heb' yilani. Masanil heb' kajan b'aj slajwik'och lum lum tik, ol ib'xokk'e heb' yuj xiwelal yuj tas ol in k'ulej yet' jun rey chi', xchi Dios. Ol smolb'ej sb'a heb' anima.
Junjun heb' ol laj skuchb'ejkot sb'a, ol yak'an yip heb'.

Ha heb' jelan sb'oan yechel tastak, a heb' skuchb'an heb' smunlaj t'a k'een plata. Axo heb' smunlaj t'a k'een martillo, a heb' skuchb'an heb' stenwi k'een t'a k'een tenlab', syalan heb': Te wach' k'een ko niplab' k'een tik, xchi heb'. Elanhchamel slawuxej juntzanh yechel chi' heb', yik stzatzb'i, yik max telwi.
Syalan Jehová icha tik: Ex israel yinhtilal Jacob, ab'ek tas swala': In chekab' wal eyaji, sik'b'il ex el wuuj, yinhtilal ex kan winh wamigo aj Abraham.
Ha in ton wik'nak ex kot b'aj slajwik'och lum lum tik, ex wawtannakkot b'aj te najat eyajkanb'ati. Valannac t'ayex to in chekab' ex. Ha in in sik'nak ex eli, malaj b'aj tzex in patiquejeli.
Manh ex xiwok, ayinek' eyed'ok. Manh ex och ilk'olal, yujto a in ton tik he Diosal in. Ha in swak' eyip, a in tzex in kolo'. Ha in tzex in yamoch waan yet' wip swak'lab'ej t'a tojolal.
Masanil heb' schichon sk'ol t'ayex, q'uixwelal ol ajkan heb', emnaquilal ol ajkan heb'. Ha heb' tz'ak'an yip yak'an owal eyed'ok, ol satkanel heb'.
Olto he say heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayex, palta manhxo ol ilchaj heb' eyuuj. Ha heb' tz'ak'antaxon owal eyed'ok, ol kannhej heb' icha junok tas malajtaxoni.
Yujto a in Jehová in tik, he Diosal in. Ha in ix ex in quetz b'eyok. Ha in ton ix wal t'ayex: Manh ex xiwok, ol in och eyed'ok, xin chi.
Ex israel yinhtilal Jacob, wach'chom quennhej he b'isul, malaj eyip, palta manh ex xiwok, ol in och eyed'ok. Ha in ton he Diosal in Ha inxonhej Ochi, he Kolumal in.
Ol ex wak'och icha junok k'een ik'umel sat trigo ak'to te ay ye. Ol laj he mak'poj lum niwak witz, pokok ol ajkan lum eyuuj. Ha lum tzalquixtak, chok' ol eyutejkan lum icha smatz'il ixim trigo.

Ol he tzipk'e lum t'a kal ik', haxo ik' chi' ol ik'anb'at lu'um. Ol saklemkanb'at lu'um yuj chakxuxum ik'. Yuj chi', ol ex tzalaj t'ayin Jehová in tik. Ol eyik'chaanh he b'a wuuj, a in ton he Diosal in Ha inxonhej Ochi.

Ha heb' anima meb'a' malaj tas ay t'ay, say ha ha' heb', max chaxlaj ha' yuj heb'. Van scham heb' yuj taquinhtial. Palta a inxo Jehová in tik, ol in kolwaj t'a heb', manh ol waktejkan heb' a in he Diosal in a ex israel ex tik.

Ha t'a lum jolomtak witz taquinh sat, ol laj wak'k'eul a niwak ha' sb'eyi, haxo t'a snanhaltak lum ak'lik, ol laj k'eul sjaj ha' kotak ha'. Ha lum taquinh sat, sitz'atak ol ajkan lu'um. Axo t'a lum taquinh lu'um, ol laj k'eul ha' kotak ha' sb'eyi.
Ha t'a lum taquinh lum chi' ol wawej te' k'ute', te' akakia, te' arrayán yet' te' oliwo. Ha t'a lum taquinh sat chi' ol wak' q'uib' te' k'ub'taj, te' taj yet' te' tzikap,
yik wach' syil masanil anima, snachajpaxel yuj heb' to a in ton Jehová in ix in b'o juntzanh tik yet' in poder, a in he Diosal in, Ha inxonhej Ochi, a in ix in b'o'o.
Ha Jehová sReyal heb' yinhtilal Jacob, a tz'alan icha tik: Cotanhec ex komon Dios, ch'oxek he jelanil, ch'oxek tas tz'aj he kolan he b'a.
Cotanhec, ul alek t'ayonh tastak toto ol ujok. Alec t'ayonh tas syalelk'och tastak ujinakxo, ol ko cha kab'i, yik wach' ol quila' tas ol aj slajwielk'ochi.
Tato yel Dios ex, alek t'ayonh tas toto ol ujok chi', yik skojtaquejeli to Dios ex. Ch'oxek wal quila' tas syal eyuuj chi', taxonhej wach', ma chuk, yik sat ko k'ool quilani, yik tzonh xiwk'ei.
Palta a ex wal tik, b'alaj malaj jab'ok eyelk'ochi, malaj tas syal eyuuj. Ha heb' syak'em sb'a t'ayex, patikab'ilel heb'.
Ol wak' cheklaj jun mach t'a norte, ol wawtejkot t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, ol yalan sb'a t'ayin. A' ol tek'anem heb' yajal, icha stek'ji lum sok'om yuj winh tz'akum lu'um, icha chi' ol aj heb'.

¿Tom ay junok ex ix eyalel yab'ixal jun tik t'a yiktax yichb’anel, yik skab' a onh tik? ¿Tom ay junok ex ayokto ix eyalankani, yik wach' skala' to yel tzeyala'? Malaj junok ex komon Dios ex tik ix eyal tas ol ujok chi', malaj anima ix ab'an eyalani.
Atax t'a yichb’anel, a in Jehová in tik ix wal jun ab'ix tik t'a Sion. Ha in ix in chekb'at jun in chekab' t'a Jerusalén yik b'at yal wach' ab'ix, to ol meltzajxok heb' anima t'a schonhab' chi'.
Tzin maklej wila'', tokwal ay junok komon Dios sjawi, malaj junok heb' syal yak'an in razón, malaj junok syal spakan tas tzin k'anb'ej.
Malaj junok heb' ay yelk'och jab'ok, malaj tas syal sb'oan heb', yuj chi' junelnhej malaj jab'ok yopisio juntzanh yechel b'ob'il chi', xchi Dios.
Syalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ha jun tik in chekab', ayin och yet'ok, a in in sik'naqueli, tzin tzalaj wal yet'ok. Ol wak'och Vespíritu t'ay, yik sch'olb'itej masanil niwak chonhab' t'a stojolal.
Manh ol awajok, manh ol ab'chaj yel yaw t'a yoltak kalle.
Ay heb' te ilb'aj k'ool, icha te' aj skanhchaji, ma ichok sk'apaquil kandil wan stupi. Palta ol kolwaj in chekab' chi' t'a heb', manh ol swach' ixtej heb', tojol ol yutok sch'olb'itan tas yaj heb'.

Manh ol el yip, manh ol chab'ax sk'ool. Ol ch'olb'itaj masanil anima t'a stojolal yuj t'a sat lum tik. Ha juntzanh chonhab' t'a stitak ha' mar, ol smaklej yab' k'ayb'ub'al heb' ol yak'a', xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová Dios b'oannak satcha’anh, yak'annakb'at jenhan. A' ixb’o’an lum lum yet' masanil tastak sq'uib' t'a sat lu'um. Ha tz'ak'an ko k 'inal, syak'anpax quik'. Syalan t'a jun schekab' chi' icha tik:

Ha in Jehová in tik, ix ach wawtej yik tza ch'olb'itej masanil anima t'a sat lu'um tik t'a stojolal. Ol in och ed'ok. Ha ach ol ach wak'lab'ej yuj jun in trato ol in b'o yet' heb' anima smasanil. Ol ach wak'och kolwajwumal t'a heb' ch'ok nakional.
Ol a jak sat heb' max uji yilani, ol a kolanelta heb' ayoch t'a preso, aton heb' aykanb'at t'a kal k’ik’ k’inal.
Ha in ton Jehová in, aton in b'i tik, manh ol in cha aljok wach' lolonel t'a junokxo mach yuj tas in b'onak, manh ol in cha ik'jokchaanh yechel komon Dios in k'exulok.
Ilecnab' tas ix aj yelk'och masanil tas walnakkani. Axo tiknaik, ay juntzanhxo tas ak'to ol wal t'ayex. Ayocto swalankan t'ayex yakb'an manto ujok, xchi Dios.

B'itejek junok ak' b'it t'a Jehová he masanil ex ayex b'aj slajwik'och lum lum tik, ex tzex ek' t'a yib'anh ha' mar, nok' nok' ay t'ha ha' yet' ex pax kajan ex t'a stitak ha' mar chi', b'itananhek d'ha Dios.
Tzalajokab' heb' yinhtilal Cedar kajan t'a skampamento t'a tzinan lu'um. Ha heb' aj chonhab' Sela, b'itanokab' heb' t'a tzalajk'olal, k'eokab' sjaj heb' sb'itan t'a lum jolomtak witz.
Ha heb' ay t'a stitak ha' mar, yalokab' wach' lolonel heb' t'a Jehová.
Ol elta Jehová icha junok ak'um owal, ol yak'an owal yet' wal yowal sk'ool icha junok soldado. Ol el yaw yak'an owal, ol ak'jok ganar heb' ajk'ol chi' yuj.
Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Najtil numannhej waji, malaj tas swala'. Axo tiknaik, ol el waw icha junok ix ix wan yaj yune', sk'akwi ix, sik'sik'an ix.

Ol laj in satel lum witz yet' lum tzalquixtak. Ol wak'an takjoquel masanil tas yaax t'a sat lum tik. Ol wak'an tup ha' niwak ha' sb'eyi. Ol ochkan lum taquinh lumal, ol laj tupkan ha' skan t'a yet'tal.

Ha heb' max ujilaj yilani, ol wik'b'at heb' t'a juntzanh b'e manh yojtakok. Ha k’ik’ k’inal, ol wak' meltzajoch saquilq'uinalil t'a heb'. Axo pak'quiltak, panhanxo ol wutejkani. Aton juntzanh tik ol wak'nhejelk'ochi.
Ha heb' tz'ak'anoch komon Dios yipok sk'ool yet' heb' tz'alan t'a juntzanh yechel icha tik: Co diosal ex, xchi heb', a heb' chi' q'uixwelal ol laj paxkan heb'.
Ex max eyab'i, ab'ek. Ex max uji eyilani, ilek tiknaik.
Malaj mach junelnhej max ilan icha in chekab' sik'b'ilel wuuj, malaj mach junelnhej max chaan yab' icha yalumalel in lolonel chekb'il wuuj.
Ex israel, te aynhej tas sch'oxji eyila', palta max eyak'och t'a he k'ool eyilani. Syal eyab'ani, palta max he cha eyab'i, xchi Jehová.
Ix snib'ej sk'ol Jehová sch'oxanel stojolal, yuj chi' ix yak' sk'ayb'ub'al te wach' t'a schonhab'.

Palta yuj spitalil jun chonhab' tik ix elk'ajb'at tastak ay t'ay yuj heb' ajk'ool. Ix ik'jib'at heb' t'a ch'ok nakional, ix ak'chajem heb' t'a yol jul, ix och pax heb' t'a preso. Ix ixtaj heb', manhxa mach ix kolan heb'. Ix elk'ajb'at heb', manhxa mach ix ik'anek' heb' t'a heb' ix elk'anb'at chi'.
Palta ¿mach ex b'ekan he k'ol he maklan eyab' tas ol wal tik? ¿Mach ex b'ekan he k'ol he chaannhej eyab'i? Ab'ek tas ol wal tik:

¿Mach ix chaan ak'jok ganar heb' israel yinhtilal Jacob, ayik ix elk'ajb'at tastak ay t'a heb'? ¿Tom manhok Jehová? Atoni, yujto ix och smul heb' t'ay. Maj yal sk'ol heb' ix sb'eyb'alej sb'eyb'al, maj sk'anab'ajej pax sk'ayb'ub'al Jehová chi' heb'.
Yuj wal chi' jun, ix kot yowal Jehová t'a heb', ix ak'jioch syaelal heb'. Ix jawi jun owal icha sk'e nhilnhon te' k'ak' t'a yib'anh heb', palta manh yujok chi' ix sna sb'a heb'.
Axo tiknaik ex israel, yinhtilal Jacob, ab'ek. Ha Jehová b'ojinak ex, ha' tz'alan icha tik: Manh ex xiwok, in kolnak ex, ix ex wawtej wal t'a he b'i, yujto wik ex.
Ayic ol ex ek' t'a yol ha ha', ayinek' eyed'ok. Ayic ol ex ek' t'ha ha' niwak ha', manh ol he jik' ha'. Ayic ol ex ek' t'a skal te' k'ak', manh ol ex tz'ab'atok.
Ha in Jehová in, he Diosal in, he Kolumal waji. Ha inxonhej Ochi, a in wak'lab'ejnak Egipto, Etiopía yet' Seba he tojolok.
Ha heb' anima t'a juntzanhxo nakión swak'cham he k'exulok, yik wach' tzex kolchajkani, yujto te wach' ex wilani, te niwan eyelk'och t'ayin, tzex in xajanejpaxi.
Manh ex xiwok, ayinek' eyed'ok. Ol in molb'ejkot heb' eyetchonhab' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u yet' b'aj tz'em k'u, junxonhej ol ex ajok.

Ol wal t'a juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a stojolal norte icha tik: Chaec meltzaj heb', xin chama. Ol walpax t'a juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a sur: Manh eyamoch waan heb'. Ik'ekkot heb' wuninal yet' heb' wisil aykanb'at t'a najat chi', b'aj slajwik'och yol yib'anhk’inal tik,
aton heb' ayoch in b'i t'ay. Ha in in b'onak heb', yik tzin yik'anchaanh heb', xin chama.
Ik'ekkot heb' in chonhab' t'a tik. Ay yol sat heb', palta max yil-laj heb', ay schiquin heb', palta max yab'laj heb'.

Molb'ejek he b'a ex niwak chonhab', junnhej tzex aj ex chonhab'. ¿Mach he diosal aljinak tas wan yuji tik? ¿Mach heb' ayokto yalannakkan yuj tastak ujinakxo? Yik'okab'kot stestigo heb' tato yel yalnak heb', yik wach' tz'ojtakajeli to yel tas yalnak heb' chi', xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová tz'alanxi icha tik: Ha ex israel ex tik, in testigo ex, in chekab' ex, sik'b'il ex el wuuj, yik wach' tzin eyojtaquejeli, tzin eyak'anoch yipok he k'ool. Nachajokab'paxel eyuuj to Ha innhej Dios in. Malaj junokxo Dios ek'nakxo, ma toto ol jawok.
Ha innhej Jehová in, malaj junok mach syal skolwaji.
Ha in walnak to ol ex in kolo', in testigo eyaji to ix elk'och jun chi'. Manhok junok komon Dios aljinak.
D'a junelnhej toxonton Dios in. Malaj junok mach syal skolanel sb'ha t'a yol in k'ab', malaj mach syal stenanek' tas tzin k'ulej, xchi Dios.

Ha Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, Axonhej Ochi, jun ix onh ak'anel libre, ha' tz'alan icha tik: Ol in chekb'at heb' soldado yak' owal t'a Babilonia yik ol ex in kolani. Ol b'at heb' kaldeo chi' elelal t'a yol juntzanh barko syik'chaanh sb'a heb' yet'ok.
Ex israel, a in Jehová in in b'onak ex. E Diosal in, Ha inxonhej Ochi, he reyal in paxi, xchi Jehová.
Ha Jehová jakannak jun b'e t'a yol ha' mar, aton jun b'e ek'nak t'a snanhal ha'.
Yak'annak elta jun niwan nhilanh heb' soldado yet'nak skarruaje yet' nok' chej, palta satnaquel heb' yuj. Satnaquel heb' smasanil, manhxalaj heb' kannak. Satnaquem heb' icha stup sk'ak'al kandil.
Ha tiknaik syal Jehová t'a schonhab' icha tik: Manhxo he nakot tas ek'nakb'ati, manhxo he nakot tas ujinakxo.
Palta ay tas toto ol in k'ulej, ol eyila' to ol ujok juntzanh chi' tiknaik. Ay wal jun b'e ol in jak t'a taquinh lu'um, ol k'eul a niwak ha' b'aj taquinhtaxon sat.

Ol in yik'chaanh nok' kaltakte'al nok', nok' oques yet' nok' awestruz, yujto ol wak' k'eul ha ha' t'a lum taquinh lum chi'. Ol laj b'ey ha' b'aj taquinhtaxon sat yik tzeyuk' ha' ex in chonhab' ex sik'b'il ex el wuuj tik.
B'ob'il ex wuuj, yik tzeyal wach' lolonel t'ayin.
Palta ex israel, yinhtilal Jacob, majxo eyawtej in b'i, a tas ix he k'ulej, to ix ex tzaktzaj wed'ok.
Majxo eyak' nok' kalnel silab'il t'ayin, manhxa welk'och t'ayex yet' he silab' chi'. Maj in k'annhej ofrenda t'ayex, maj ex wak' pural eyak'an inkienso t'ayin.

Maj he manlaj te te' sumumi sjab' yik tzeyak' ofrendail t'ayin. Maj eyak' tzalajb'ok in k'ool yet' xepual nok' nok' ix eyak' silab'il. Palta anhej wal chukal tze k'ulej, in tzaktzaj wal yuj. Tze tzuntzejkot wowal yuj jantak chukal tze k'ulej chi'.
Palta a in tik, yuj wal sniwanil welk'ochi, yuj chi' tzin suksat he chukal chi', manhxa b'ak'uinh ol in nakot he mul chi'.
Tato ay wal tas tze na' t'a wib'anh jun, ko b'oek yaj tiknaik. Aleccoti, ol cheklajok tato malaj he mul.
Ha jun winh he b'ab'el mam icham, ochnak smul winh. Axo heb' he k'ayb'umal, meltzajnakoch heb' ajk'olal t'ayin.
Yuj chi', ol wak' q'uixwelal heb' yajalil he templo a ex chonhab' Israel ex tik. Ex yinhtilal Jacob, ol ex waktejkani yik tzex satjieli yet' eyixtaji, xchi Jehová.
Syalan Jehová icha tik: Ex israel, yinhtilal Jacob, maklejek eyab' tas swala', yujto in chekab' ex, sik'b'il ex el wuuj.
Ha in Jehová in tik ix ex in b'o'o ayik manto ex alji, a in tzin kolwaj eyed'ok. Manh ex xiw ex aj Jesurún, ex yinhtilal Jacob, in chekab' ex, sik'b'il ex el wuuj.
Yujto ol wak'el yok ha ha' t'a taquinh lu'um, ol b'ey ha' t'a lum taquinh sat. Ol wak'och Vespíritu t'a heb' eyinhtilal, ol wak'an in wach'k'olal t'a heb'.
Icha wal sq'uib' anh ank'ultak ayoch yalil, icha chi' ol aj sq'uib' heb'. Icha sq'uib' te' b'akmam t'a stitak ha ha' sb'eyi, icha chi' ol aj heb'.

Ha t'a skal heb', ay mach ol alan icha tik: Ha in tik, yik in Jehová, xchama. Ay pax mach ol alan icha tik: Yinhtilal in Jacob, xchama. Ay pax mach ol tz'ib'anoch t'a sk'ab' icha tik: Yic in wal Jehová, xchama. Ol yak'anoch Israel sjolomok sb'i, xchi Jehová.
Ha Jehová Rey, Scolumal Israel, Yajal t'a Smasanil, ha' tz'alan icha tik: Ha in ton b'ab'el waj t'a smasanil, slajwub' in paxi. Ha innhej Dios in, malaj junokxo.

¿Mach wal junok lajan wed'ok? Tato ay, lolonokab'i, yalokab' t'ayin tas yaji. ¿Tocwal ay junokxo mach ayokto yalannakkani tastak ujinak yet' tas toto ol ujok? Tato ay, yalokab'i tas toto ol ujok chi'.
Manh ex xiwok, tek'an tzeyutej he b'a. Ha ex tik in testigo ex to walnak juntzanh tik t'a pekataxo. ¿Tocwal ay junokxo Dios ma junokxo kolwajwum? Ha innhej toni, malaj junokxo wojtak, xchi Jehová.

Ha wal heb' sb'oan yechel juntzanh komon Dios, malaj jab'ok yelk'och heb'. Malaj pax jab'ok yelk'och juntzanh yechel komon Dios xajanej heb' chi'. Ha heb' tz'och ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios chi', max ujilaj yilan heb', malaj spensar heb'. Yuj chi' q'uixwelal ol ajkan heb' yuj.
Ha heb' sb'oan junok yechel komon Dios yet' k'een k'een, tz'och heb' ejmelal t'ay, Dios yalan heb', palta nab'anhej syixtej sb'a heb'.

Masanil heb' tz'och ejmelal t'a juntzanh yechel chi', ol q'uixwokkan heb', yujto a heb' sb'oan juntzanh yechel chi', animanhej heb'. Tato smolb'ej sb'a heb' smasanil t'a wichanh yik tzin ch'olb'itan heb', ol q'uixwok wal heb', ol xiwkank'e heb'.

Ileknab'i, a winh b'oum k'een, syik'kot k'een syamk'ab' winh, haxo yik toxo ix chakxil k'een k'een chi' t'a kal k'ak', stenan k'een winh yet' k'een martillo yik stojolb'ioch yechel chi'. Yed' wal yip sk'ab' winh stenani. Palta tato malaj tas swa winh, tz'och swejel winh, stakjipax sti' winh, tz'el yip winh.

Ileknab'pax junok winh nhikum te' sb'oan junok yechel: Syechtej te' winh yet' junok echlab', syak'anoch yechel te' winh yet' te' slápiz yet' jun tz'ak'anoch yechel, setan setan tz'aji. Syamanoch winh smunlaj yet' k'een tz'ukub'. Icha chi' tz'aj sb'oan jun yechel chi' winh, icha anima wach' yilji, icha chi' tz'ajelk'ochi. Slajwi chi' syak'anoch winh t'a yol spat.

Ha junok winh nhikum te' chi', sb'at winh sch'ak te' k'ute', ma te' tzikap, ma te' ji, aton te' sq'uib' t'a kaltak te'. Mato jun, syawej junok te' taj winh, haxo nhab' tz'ik'an sq'uib' te'. Niwan tz'aj te' yik wach' sb'o komon Dios chi' t'a te'.

Aton t'a te' tz'elta te' sk'atzitz winh, syak'anoch sk'ak' winh yet' te' b'aj sk'axni. Sb'oanpax swael winh yet' te' k'ak' chi'. Axo yet' jab'okxo te', sb'o junok yechel sdiosal winh, tz'och ijan winh yoch ejmelal t'ay.

Aton yet' te' k'atzitz chi' syak'och sk'ak' winh, sb'olan schib'ej winh, swa winh, sb'ud'ji wal winh sik'lab'il yuj sb'olb'il chib'ej chi'. Sk'axni winh t'a te', syalan winh icha tik: Te wach' in aj in q'uixnaj t'a ti k'ak' tik, xchi winh.
Axo yet' jab'okxo te' skan chi', sb'oanpax junok yechel skomon diosal winh, tz'och ijan winh yem nhojan ejmelal t'ay. Stewioch winh t'ay icha tik: Col in, yujto in diosal ach, xchi winh t'a te'.
Ha wal juntzanh anima chi', malaj spensar heb', max nachaj jab'ok yuj heb'. Macan sat heb', max uji yilan heb', makan spensar heb', max nachaj yuj heb'.

Manh chamok snaan heb', max nachaj jab'ok yuj heb', max yal heb' icha tik: Ha t'a nanhalxo te te' tik ix wak'och in k'ak', ix wak'an k'anb'ok in pan, ix in b'olpax in chib'ej t'a stzak'aq'uil te', ix in wa'i. Manh smojok tzin b'o junok yechel komon Dios yajb'entak yet' jab'okxo te' tik. Manh smojok tzin och ejmelal t'a jun te' yib' te' tik, manh xchiok jab'ok heb'.

Ha heb' icha chi' sk'ulej, ichato a k'een tik'aq'uil taanh slo heb'. Juwinaquel spensar heb', satnak heb', manh ol yal skolan sb'a heb'. Manh naanok yalan heb' icha tik: Ha tas b'ob'il yuj in k'ab' tik, nab'a esnhej, manh xchiok heb'.
Ex israel, yinhtilal Jacob, naekkoti to in chekab' ex, a in in b'onak ex yik tzex och in chekab'ok, mokab' in b'at satk'olal eyuuj.
Ha in ix in satel he paltail icha satem yal ak'wal. Ix in satel he mul icha wal tz'aj satem asun. Cotanhecxi t'ayin, yujto ix ex in kolo', xchi Jehová.

Ha satchanh, elokab' yaw sb'itan t'a tzalajk'olal yuj tas ix sk'ulej Jehová. Ha niwak jul t'a sat lu'um tik, awajokab'i. Ha lum niwak witz yet' lum tzalquixtak, b'itanokab' lu'um t'a tzalajk'olal yujto ix sch'ox stziquiquial Jehová ayik ix skolan heb' israel yinhtilal Jacob.

Ha Jehová ko Kolumal tz'alan icha tik: Ha in ton Jehová in, ix ex in b'o'o ayik manto ex alji, a in in b'onak masanil tastak. Ha in in jenhb'ejnakb'at satcha’anh, wak'annakpaxkan em lum lum tik t'a yet'tal, ¿tom ay junokxo mach kolwajnak wed'ok?
Ha in tzin tenek' tas syal heb' ajchum, tzin juanpaxb'at spensar heb' naumel lolonel. Swak'an somchajel spensar heb' aj pensar, squistalaxkan heb' wuuj.

Palta a in swak'elk'och tas syal heb' in chekab', yik wach' tz'ajelk'och tas syal heb' chi'. Ha in swala' to a Jerusalén ol kajnajxok, haxo juntzanh chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá, ol b'ochajxok t'a yet'tal b'aj juwinaquel chi'.
Ha in syal walan t'ha ha' mar to stup ha'. Masanil yoktak ha' tz'eli, swak' tupok.

Ha in swal t'a winhaj Ciro icha tik: Ach Ciro, a ach ayach och yilumalok in chonhab'. Ha ach ol a b'o masanil tas tzin nib'ej. Ol alan t'a Jerusalén: Ol ach b'ochajxik'eok, ol ak'chajxiem yich templo, xa chi, xin chi t'a winh, xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová ix sik'anoch winhaj Ciro reyal. Ha ol kuchb'an winh yik ol yak'an ganar juntzanh niwak nakión winh, ol yik'anek' yopisio juntzanh heb' winh sreyal nakión chi' winh. Ha Jehová chi' ol ak'an jakchaj spuertail juntzanh niwak chonhab' t'a winhaj Ciro chi', malaj junok mach ol yal smakani. Yuj chi' syalan Jehová icha tik:
Ha in wal ol in b'ab'laj t'a ichanh, ol wak' panhanb'ok lum lum chaanh. Ol in mak'poj juntzanh puerta nab'a bronke, ol in b'ijchitanb'at k'een hierro ayoch yijchulok.
Ha juntzanh b'eyumal k'ub'aneli yet' tas elk'altak yaji, ol wak' t'ayach, yik wach' tzojtaquejeli to a in ton Jehová in, sDiosal in Israel, ix ach wawtej t'a a b'i.
Yuj wal to tzin xajanej heb' yinhtilal winh in chekab' aj Jacob, aton chonhab' Israel sik'b'ilel wuuj, yuj chi' tzach wawtej yik tzach b'inaji wach'chom manh in ojtakok.
Ha innhej Jehová in, malaj junokxo. Malaj junokxo Dios. Ha innhej toni. Wach'chom manh in ojtakok, palta a in ol wak' ip
yik wach' syojtaquejel masanil anima ay t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, masanto b'aj tz'em k'u to Ha innhej Jehová in, malaj junokxo.
Ha in in b'onak sakil k'inal yet' k’ik’ k’inal. Ha in swak' junk'olal, swak'anpax yaelal. Ha in ton Jehová in tzin k'ulej juntzanh tik.

Ha in ol wak'kot tojolal t'a satcha’anh, icha yem yal ak'wal, icha yem nhab' t'a kal asun, ol schaan lum lum tik yemuli. Checlajokab' kolnab'il icha sat te awb'en te', ayokab' tojolal icha tz'aj spojel te' xumak. Ha in ol wak' ujok jun tik, xchi Jehová.

Ha mach syak' owal yet' mach b'ojinak, lajan wal icha lum tz'akb'il lum k'un spoji. Tocwal syal lum tz'akb'il lum chi' t'a mach stz'akani ¿Tas tza k'ulej? Ha ach tik, manh ojtakok a munlaji, manh xchiok lu'um.
Anhejtona', tom smoj syal heb' uninab'il t'a smam snun icha tik: ¿Tas yuj icha tik kajkan eyuuj? tom xchi heb'.
Ha Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, Axonhej Ochi, a b'ojinak onh, a tz'alan icha tik: ¿Tom ay eyalan eyik he k'anb'an t'ayin yuj tas tzin k'ulej eyed'ok? ¿Tom a ex ol eyal tas ol in k'ulej?
Ha in in b'onak lum lum tik yet' masanil mach kajan t'ay. Ha in in jenhb'ejnakb'at satcha’anh yet' in poder, walannak to scheklaj masanil k'een k'anal.

D'a stojolal ol wutej ayik ol wak'anoch winhaj Ciro t'a yopisio. Ha in ol in b'ob'at b'e t'a yichanh winh yik ol yak' ganar winh. Ha winh ol b'oanxik'e in chonhab' Jerusalén. Axo heb' in chonhab' ik'b'ilb'at t'a ch'ok nakional, ol ak'joquel heb' t'a libre yuj winh t'a nab'anhej. Malaj stojol ol sk'an winh t'a heb', malaj spak ol ak'chaj t'a winh, a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil swalkan jun tik, xchi Jehová.

Syalanxi Jehová t'a heb' israel icha tik: Ha tastak ay t'a heb' aj Egipto yet' t'a heb' aj Etiopía, eyik ol ajkanok. Ha heb' aj Sabá chaanh steel, ol yak'och sb'a heb' t'a yol he k'ab'. Ol ochkan heb' he chekab'ok. Ayoch k'een kadena t'a heb' ol och tzak'an heb' eyuuj, ol em kuman heb' t'a eyichanh, ol yalan heb' icha tik: Val yel junnhej ton wal Dios, malaj junokxo. Aton jun Dios chi' ayek' eyed'ok, xcham heb', xchi Jehová.
Yelton wal Dios ach, max ach quilochlaj, palta ko Kolumal aj a onh israel onh tik.
Masanil heb' sb'oan yechel komon Dios, q'uixwelal ol aj heb', ol b'atkan heb'.
Ha onhxo pax israel onh tik jun, a ach ol onh a kol t'a junelnhej. Malaj b'ak'uinh emnaquilal, ma q'uixwelal ol onh ajkanok.

Mamin Jehová, a ach a b'onak satcha’anh, a ach a b'onakkanem lum lum tik t'a yet'tal. Maj a b'olaj lum yik malaj tas ay t'a sat, palta a b'onak lu'um yik skajchaji. Ha ach tzal icha tik: Ha innhej Jehová in, malaj junokxo.

Ha in tik, manh elk'altakok tzin loloni, manhok pax t'a k’ik’ k’inal t'a yoltak lum lum. Malaj tas walnak t'a heb' yinhtilal Jacob icha tik: Manh in he komon sayejeq'ui, manh xin chiok t'a heb'. Ha in Jehová in tik, anhej tas yel yet' tas tojol swala', xa chi.

Syalan Jehová icha tik: Masanil ex ayextoek' t'a junjun nakión, molb'ejek he b'a, kotanhek. Malaj jab'ok he pensar, a te te' tzeyak'och he diosalok, tze b'akhan b'eyek'ok, tzex och ejmelal t'a jun Dios max yal skolwaji.

Lolonanhec, alek tastak tze na chi' t'ayin, al-lajek eyab' junjun ex. ¿Mach aljinakkan juntzanh tik yiktax yichb’anel? ¿Mach aljinakkan t'a peka'? ¿Tom manhok in Jehová in walnakkan juntzanh tik jun? Malaj junokxo Dios. Ha innhej toni. Ha innhej ton swak'elk'och tas swala', Colwajwum in paxi.
Jantac ex kajan ex b'aj slajwik'och lum lum tik, ojtaquejek in eli, ol ex in kolo', yujto Ha innhej Dios in, malaj junokxo.
Ha in wal swak' in ti' to yel tas swala', manh ol in k'ex tas swal tik. Ol em kuman masanil anima t'a wichanh, ol in yojtakanel heb'.
Ol yalan heb' smasanil t'ayin icha tik: Ha achnhejton Jehová tojol ach, ay a poder, xcham heb'. Axo masanil heb' ajk'ol yajoch t'ayin, ol q'uixwokkan heb'.
Vuujnhej ol kolchaj masanil heb' yinhtilal Israel, ol yak'an tzalajb'ok sk'ol heb', xchi Jehová.

Ha sdiosal heb' aj Babilonia skuch Bel, q'uixwelal ix ajkani, haxo sdiosal heb' aj Nebo, manhxalaj yelk'ochi. Ha juntzanh komon Dios chi', ix tzek'jioch t'a yib'anh yikatz nok' b'uru al yaji, k'unb'inak nok'.
Ha juntzanh komon Dios chi', manhxa jab'ok yopisio, maj yal skolan sb'a, ix ik'chajb'at t'a ch'ok nakional.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Maclejec eyab' tas swal ex yinhtilal Jacob, jantak exto kannak ex t'a Israel tik, kuchb'ilexnhej wuuj ayik manto ex alji. Ix ex in chelb'eyek'ok.
Ichanhej chi' ol in k'ulej eyed'ok, ayik ol ex och icham animail, sakxo xil he jolom, ayinnhej och eyed'ok. Ha in in b'onak ex, ol ex in tanhwejnhej. Ol in ochnhej eyed'ok, ol ex in kolnhej.
¿Mach junok syal in he lajb'an yet'ok? ¿Mach junok lajan wed'ok he naani?

Ay heb' syik'k'eta k'een oro t'a yol yet'tal, syechtan k'een plata t'a yol echlab', syak'an k'een heb' t'a junok winh jelan sb'oani yik sb'o junok sdiosal heb' t'a k'een. Axo sb'oelk'ochi, tz'och heb' ejmelal t'ay, syalan sb'a heb' t'ay.

Syak'ank'e heb' t'a sjolom sjenhjab', syik'anb'at heb'. Syak'ank'e heb' t'a sat junok smexa. Skanxonhej chek'an ta', maxtzak ib'xi. Wach'chom jantak yawajoch heb' ay yik chi' t'ay, palta max tak'wi, max kolji heb' yuj t'a syaelal.
Naeccot jun tik ex anima pit, scham wal he naankoti yik max b'at satk'olal eyuuj tastak in k'ulejnak.
Naeccot tas ujinak t'a pekataxo to Ha innhej Dios in, malaj junokxo, malaj junokxo Dios lajan wed'ok.
Ha in walnakkan t'a yiktax yichb’anel tas ol ujok t'a slajwub'. Ayocto walannakkani tastak toto ol ujok. Masanil tas nab'il wuuj ol in k'ulejnhej.
Ol wawtejkot jun winak t'a najat b'aj sjawi k'u, ol ja juknaj icha junok nok' ch'akb'a. Ha tas nab'il wuuj, a chi' ol wak' sk'ulej. Icha wutejnak walani, icha chi' ol ujok.
Ex anima pit, mach ex najat eyajkanel t'a tojolal, ab'ek tas ol wala'.
Ha kolnab'il swak'a' toxo wal tz'elk'och wuuj, manhxo ol ek' tiempo in kolan chonhab' Sion, ol b'inajxok Israel tik wuuj, xchi Jehová.

Icha tik yalan Jehová yuj Babilonia: Emanhcot t'a a despacho ach Babilonia, emanh k'ojan t'a kal pokok. Ha t'a peka' lajan ach icha junok ix kob'es mantalaj winak syik'a'. Axo tiknaik manhxo ol alchajok to yune' kob'es ya ilab'il ach. Ha tiknaik chekab' achxo.
Ochanh t'a k'een cha', jax ixim trigo, ik'el smusil a sat, tok'k'e a k'apak t'a a xub' yik tzach k'axpaj t'a yol ha ha'.
Iljokab' a niwanil b'eranel chi', ilchajokab' a niwanil q'uixwelal yilji. Ha jun chi' ol wak' spakok t'ayach, malaj junok mach ed'nak b'aj ol ok' in k'ool, xchi Jehová.
Ha ko Kolumal a onh israel onh tik, ko Diosal Axonhej Ochi, Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, a tz'alan icha tik:
Ex kaldeo, emanhek k'ojan t'a kuseltaquil t'a kal k’ik’ k’inal. Manhxa b'ak'uinh ol ex b'inaj yajalil t'a juntzanhxo niwak nakión.

Ayic aykot wowal t'a in chonhab', ix waktejkan heb', ichato manh in chonhab'ok heb'. Ix wak'och heb' t'a q'uixwelal, ix wak'ankanoch heb' t'a yol he k'ab', maj ok' he k'ol t'a heb'. Ipan heb' ichamtak animaxo ya ix eyutej.
Ix eyalanpax icha tik: Ha onh tik yajal onh t'a masanil tiempo, xe chi. Malaj jab'ok tas ix he na' tas ol ex ajelk'ochok.

Yuj chi' ach chonhab' Babilonia, ab' wal tas ol wala': Lajan ach icha syutej sb'oan sb'a junok ix ajmul ix. Te junk'olalxo ajeq'ui, tza naan t'a a pensar to malaj junokxo mach lajan icha ach tik. Tza naani to malaj b'ak'uinh ol ach kan icha junok ix ix chamnak yetb'eyum, malaj b'ak'uinh pax ol ach kan manh uninal a naani.

Wach'chom jantak heb' ajchum yet' heb' ajb'aal, palta manhxo ol ach koljok yuj heb' ayik ol ja lemnaj cha makan chi' t'a ib'anh, aton junixtaquil yet' manh uninal. Junnhej k'ual ol jawok lemnaj juntzanh chi' t'ayach.
Ha a naani to wach'nhej ajek' t'a a chukal chi', malaj mach tz'ilan tas tza k'ulej. Ha tas ojtak yet' a jelanil tzach ak'an musansatil. Tza naani to a achnhej, malaj junokxo.
Palta ol ja wal jun yaelal t'a ib'anh, manhxo ol yal a yamanoch waan yet' heb' ajb'aal chi'. Ayic ol jawok jun yaelal chi', manhxo ol yal a kachani. Ol jawok lemnaj t'a ib'anh ayik manh naanok uuj.
B'eyb'alej ajchumal yet' ajb'aalil chi', aton juntzanh chi' a k'ayb'ejnak yiktax kob'es ach. Ol wila'' tato olto och yopisio uuj, ol wila'' tato olto xiw heb' anima t'ayach yuj.

Tzijtum heb' ak'um razón ix smolb'ej sb'a ed'ok, ix ach tzaktzajk'och yet' heb'. Jawokab' heb' schuman yet' k'een k'anal chi' tiknaik. Ayic syilan k'een k'anal chi' heb', snachajel yuj heb' yalani. Ha heb' tz'alan tas tzuji t'a junjun uj, jawokab' heb' ach skol tiknaik.

Palta lajan ol aj heb' icha yok ixim trigo, a k'ak' ol nhusantz'a heb'. Manhxo ol yal skolan sb'a heb' t'a kal k'ak' chi'. Ha jun k'ak' chi' te ow, manh lajanok icha junok komon k'ak' skan stzak'aq'uil tzonh em k'ojan tzonh k'axni t'a sti'.

Icha chi' ol ajelk'och heb' a kolwajum chi', aton heb' b'aj ix a k'anb'ejnhej yiktax ach kotochi. Ol ach aktajkan yuj heb' smasanil, junjun heb' ol b'atkan t'a sb'eal satnaquil, manhxa junok mach ol ach kolanok, xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ab'ek wal jun tik ex yinhtilal Jacob, ex tze kuch Israel, yinhtilal ex pax Judá. Tze lok in b'i a in Jehová in tik, tzeyalani to tzex och ejmelal t'ayin he Diosal in, palta manh yelok tzeyala', chab'satil tzex loloni.
Tzeyalani to aj chonhab' ex t'a in chonhab' wiknhej yaji. Tzin eyak'anoch yipok he k'ool eyalani, a in ton Jehová he Diosal in Yajal in t'a Smasanil.
Ayocto walannakkan yuj tas ix uji tik. Ha in wal ix wak' eyojtaquejeli. Elanhchamel ix laj elk'och tas walnakkan chi'.
Vojtak to te pit ex, max eyik'em he b'a, max ex q'uixwi jab'ok t'a wichanh.

Ayocto walannakkan t'ayex ayik manto uji juntzanh tik. Yuj chi' max yal eyalan icha tik yuj juntzanh he komon Dios nab'a te', ma k'een: Ha ko diosal tik ix naan jun tik, a ix ak'an elk'ochi, manh xe chiok.
Ha ex tik eyab'nak masanil tas walnakkan chi'. Scham wal he naan yuj, tzeyalaneli to yel walnak. Axo tiknaik ol wak' eyojtaquejel juntzanhxo tas k'ub'eltak yaji, juntzanh manh eyojtakok.
Aton tas to ato tiknaik swala', manh walnakok t'a peka', juntzanh tas to malaj b'aj eyab'nak spekal yalji masanto tiknaik. Yuj chi' manh ol yal eyalani to eyojtakxo.
Yel toni, a jun tik manta b'aj eyab'nak, manto eyojtakok, anheja' manto eyab'pax tiknaik. Yujto wojtaktaxoni to max he k'anab'ajej, pit ex yiktax ex alji.
Palta ay in niwank'olal t'ayex, yuj chi' ix in yamoch waan yowal in k'ol t'a eyib'anh yuj in b'inajnaquil. Maj ex in sateli yik manh chukok tz'aj in b'inaji.
Naec to ix ex in sakb'itej, manh ichok tz'aj k'een plata t'a kal k'ak', palta aton yet' yaelal ix ex wak' prowal.
Yuj wik'jichaanh, icha chi' ex wutej, yik manh chukok tz'aj yalchaj in b'i. Ha aloj wach' lolonel smoj yalji t'ayin, max in cha alchaj t'a junokxo, xchi Jehová.
Icha tik yalan Jehová: Ex israel yinhtilal Jacob, ab'ek wal tas ol wala': Ha ex sik'b'il ex el wuuj. Ha innhej ton Dios in, b'ab'el waj t'a smasanil, slajwub' in paxi.
Ha in wak'nakkanem lum lum tik t'a yet'tal, in jenhb'annakb'at satcha’anh yet' in poder. Tonhej walnak sb'i juntzanh tik, spitzwinakchaanh.

Molb'ejek he b'a he masanil, tzeyab'an tas ol wala': ¿Mach wal junok komon Dios ayokto yalannak to a jun winh winak sik'b'ilel wuuj, a winh ol k'ulan masanil tas nab'ilxo wuj t'a yib'anh Babilonia to a yipalil ol satanel heb' kaldeo?
Ha in ol wawtejkot winh, ol jawok winh, yalnhej b'aj ol b'at winh, ol yak'nhej ganar winh.

Nitzeccot he b'a t'ayin, ab'ek tas ol wala': Yictax ix in yamanoch in lolon t'a heb' anima, k'unnhej snachajel tas swala', haxo tz'elk'och tas swal chi', ayinnhej ek' ta', xchi Jehová. Ha tiknaik jun, chekb'il in kot yuj Jehová Yajal, yik tzin lolon yuj spoder Yespíritu.
Ha Jehová Dios, ko Kolumal a onh israel onh tik Axonhej Ochi, a tz'alan icha tik: Ha in Jehová he Diosal in, a in tzin ch'ox t'ayex tas ol och he wach'ilok, a in tzin ch'ox b'e b'aj smoj tzex b'ati.
Comonoc wal ix he k'anab'ajej in cheknab'il, tato icha chi' a wach'ilal tze cha'a tzam k'enhej chaanh icha ha' niwak ha' max tupi, haxo he kolnab'il tzam janhej icha skotnhej b'alaljok sat ha' mar.
Manhxom b'ischajb'enok heb' eyinhtilal, icha yarenail sti' ha' mar. Maj am wik'emta he b'isul, maj am in b'at mikan t'ayex, xchi Jehová.

Syalanxi Jehová icha tik: Elanhec t'a Babilonia, elanhek elelal t'a skal heb' aj Caldea. Alequel jun ab'ix tik yet' aw yik tzalajk'olal. Tzeyak'an ojtakajel masanto b'aj slajwik'och yol yib'anhk’inal tik. Tzeyalan icha tik: Ha Jehová onh kolanel t'a yol sk'ab' Babilonia, a onh yinhtil onh Jacob, aton jun schekab', xe chi, xchi Jehová.
Ayic yek'nak heb' ko mam quicham t'a taquinh lu'um yuj Jehová, manh takjinakok sti' heb', yujto a Jehová chi' pojjinak k'een tenam, yelnakkot chulnaj ha' niwak ha' sb'eyi.
Axo pax heb' sk'ulan chukal, malaj jab'ok wach'il ol scha heb', xchi Jehová.

Ha jun schekab' Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ex anima kajan t'a stitak ha' mar, ab'ek tas ol wala'. Ex anima te najat ayex, maklejek eyab'i: Ha Jehová awtannak in ayik manto in alji. Yalnakkanel in b'i ayik kuchb'il into och yuj in nun.

Ha tas swala' lajan icha k'een espada te jay ye, icha chi' ajnakkan yuj Dios. Sk'ub'ejnak in el t'a yalanh sk'ab'. Icha junok jul-lab' te jay snhi', icha chi' yutejnak in, sk'ub'ejnak in t'a yol yet'tal sjul-lab'.
Yalannac t'ayin icha tik: Ach Israel in chekab' ach, uuj ol cheklaj in wach'il, xchi t'ayin.

Palta ix in naani to nab'anhej ix in munlaji. Nab'anhej ix el wip, malaj tas ix wik'a', xin chi. Palta wojtak to chequel yaji tas waj t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha spak in munlajel chi', ayek' t'a yol sk'ab'.

Axo tiknaik jun, toxo ix in cha sniwanil welk'och t'a yichanh Jehová in Diosal, a tz'ak'an wip. Ayinto ek' t'a yol sk'ol in nun ix snaani to tzin och schekab'ok, yik swik'an meltzaj heb' israel yinhtilal Jacob junelxo t'ay.

Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: In chekab' ach yik tza tojolb'itanxi heb' yinhtilal Jacob, tzik'anxi meltzaj heb' israel kannakto tik t'ayin. Palta manhoknhej yuj chi' ix ach in sik'kaneli, palta yik tzach wak'och saquilq'uinalil t'a juntzanhxo nakión masanto b'aj slajwik'och yol yib'anhk’inal, yik skolchaj heb' wuuj, xchi t'ayin, xchi jun schekab' chi'.

Ha Jehová Scolumal Israel, Dios Axonhej Ochi, slolon t'a schekab', aton jun patikab'ileli, yajb'il yuj masanil nakión, chekab' pax yajoch t'a heb' yajal. Syalan icha tik: Ayic ol ach yilan heb' yajal, ol k'e waan heb', ol em nhojan heb' t'a ichanh, yujto a in Jehová sDiosal in Israel, Ha inxonhej Ochi, ix ach in sik'eli, swak'anelk'och tas walnak, xchi Jehová.

Syalan Jehová t'a schekab' icha tik: Ayic ol k'och stiempoal in ch'oxan in wach'k'olal, ol ach in kolo', ol in pakan tas ix a k'an t'ayin. Ol ach in tanhwej, ol ach wak'och yik tzak'anelk'och in trato yet' masanil chonhab', yik sb'ochajxik'e in chonhab', yik tza pojanxiek' smakb'en heb' t'a lum lum kannak tzinan.

Tzin chekan al t'a heb' icha to preso yaj t'a k’ik’ k’inal icha tik: Elanhekkan t'a libre, xa chi. Ol ilchaj tastak tz'och yuj heb', icha nok' kalnel yax b'aj stanhwaj wa t'a titak b'e, haxo t'a lum taquinh sat, ayxo tas swa nok'.
Manhxo ol yak' wejel heb' yet' taquinhtial, manhxo ol yab' syail heb' yuj sk'ak'al yok k'u, yujto a in tzin xajanej heb', ol wik'b'at heb' b'aj ay sjajtak ha ha'.
Ol in jak jun b'e t'a jolomtak witz, te wach' ol aj in b'oan sb'eal in chonhab', xchi Jehová.
Ilecnab' skot in chonhab' t'a najat, ay heb' skot t'a norte, ay pax heb' skot b'aj tz'em k'u, ay pax heb' skot t'a yol yik Sinim.

Awajokab' satcha’anh yet' sat lu'um tik t'a tzalajk'olal. Yed' lum niwak witz elokab' yaw lum yuj tzalajk'olal, yujto a Jehová wan yak'an sniwanil sk'ol schonhab'. Toxo ix ok' sk'ol t'a heb' ayoch t'a syaelal.
Syalan heb' aj Sion icha tik: Ix onh yaktejkan Jehová, ix onh b'atkan satk'olal yuj Cajalil, xchi heb'.
Palta syalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ha junok ix nunab'il, ¿tokwal sb'at satk'olal yune' ix yuj? Wach'chom sb'at satk'olal yuj ix jun, palta a in tik manh ol ex b'at satk'olal wuuj.
Ichato tz'ib'ab'il he b'i t'a yol in k'ab', yuj chi' naan exnhej wuuj.
Elanhchamel ol b'ochajxik'e smuroal he chonhab', haxo heb' ajk'ol pojjinaquemi, heb' satannaqueli, wanxo yel heb'.

Ex aj Sion, ileknab' t'a he patik eyichanh, a heb' ik'b'ilb'at t'a ch'ok nakional, wan smolb'anxi sb'a heb' yik sjax heb' eyed'ok. Ha in Jehová in tzin lok in b'i swalani to ol eyik'chaanh he b'a yuj heb' eyetchonhab' chi'. Icha wal stzalaj junok ix kob'es yuj yelwanub' spichul ayik snupnaji, icha chi' ol aj he tzalaj yuj heb' wan sjax chi'.
Yujto a he chonhab' tik mak'b'ilkanem lanhnajok, kuseltak yajkani. Axo tiknaik, manhxo ol yab'laj lum skajan heb' anima chi'. Ha heb' mak'jinakkanem lanhnaj chi', najatxo ay heb'.
Ha heb' yuninal heb' aljinak t'a ch'ok nakional chi', ol yal heb' t'ayex icha tik: Te jab'nhej jun lum lum tik t'ayonh, aq'ek ko lu'um b'aj tzonh kajnaji, xcham heb'.

Ol he naan icha tik: ¿Mach ay yuninal juntzanh heb' tik? Ha onh tik manhxalaj kuninal. Maxtzac yalpaxlaj yalji heb', ik'b'il onh b'at t'a jun ch'ok nakional, chakb'il onh eli. ¿Mach ix ilan q'uib' heb' kuninal tik? ¿B'ajtil ix kot heb'? xe chama.
Ha in Jehová Eyajal in ol wal t'a juntzanhxo nakión, ol wik'anpaxchaanh in bandera yil heb', yik ol ik'jokkot heb' eyuninal chi' yuj heb', ol ul ak'jokkan heb'.

Ha heb' yajal, icha he mam ol aj heb', haxo heb' ix yetb'eyum heb', icha he nun ol aj heb' ix. Ol em nhojan heb' yajal chi' t'a sat lu'um t'a eyichanh, emnaquil ol aj heb' yik tzex yik'anchaanh heb'. Ata' ol nachajel eyuuj to a in Jehová in, a innhej Dios in. Ha heb' tzin ak'anoch yipok sk'ool, manh ol kan heb' t'a q'uixwelal, xchi Jehová.
Ha junok winh winak te ay yip, ¿tzam yal stok'jiek' masanil tas ix yik' winh t'a owal? ¿Tzam yal stok'jikanek' junok presowum t'a junok yajal te ow?

Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha t'a heb' te ay yip ol in tok'kanek' heb' presowum. Ha t'a heb' yajal ek'b'al te ow, ol in tok'kanek' tastak ix yik' heb' t'a owal. Yujto a in ol wak' owal yet' heb' eyajk'ol chi', ol in kolan heb' eyetchonhab' chi'.

Ha in ol wak' sk'ulej heb' ix ex ixtan chi', to ol smil-lajcham sb'a heb'. Ol och heb' icha uk'umanhil yuj skot yowal b'aj ol smil-lajcham sb'a chi'. Yuj chi' ol yojtaquejel masanil anima to a in ton wal Jehová he Kolumal in. Ha in sDiosal in winhaj Jacob to Syal Vuj Smasanil, xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik t'a schonhab': Ex israel, ¿tom tze na'a to a in ix ex in pechb'at icha junok winh spechanb'at yetb'eyum? Tato icha chi', ¿b'ajtil ay yumal puklajb'ail ix in b'o chi' eyed'ok? ¿Tom a in ix ex in chonhb'at chekab'ok? Tato icha chi' ¿mach b'aj ay in b'ok, yuj chi' ix ex in chonhb'ati? Ha ex tik, ix ex ik'jib'at t'a ch'ok nakional yuj he mul, yuj he chukal.

¿Tas yuj ayik ix in jawi, malaj mach ix wila''? ¿Tas yuj ayik ix ex wawtani malaj mach ix in tak'wani? ¿Tom max techaj wuj ex in kolan he naani? ¿Tom max yal ex wak'anel t'a libre? Naec wal to k'okb'il junok b'elanh lolonel swala', stupem ha' mar, haxo b'aj sb'ey ha' niwak ha', taquinh tz'ajkani, haxo nok' chay, xcham nok' yuj taquinhtial, sk'ab'at nok' yuj manh ha'il.
Ha in swak' k'ik'b'oquel satcha’anh, icha heb' skus yuj schamnak, xchi Jehová.

Ha jun schekab' Jehová chi' tz'alan icha tik: Ha Jehová Vajalil, a ix ak'an jelanb'ok in loloni yik wach' swak' stek'anil heb' k'unb'elal yaji. Junjun q'uinhib'alil syak'an in nib'ej yik swab' tas syak' in k'ayb'ej.
Ha Jehová Vajalil ix ak'an sjelanil in pensar, ix in k'anab'ajejnhej, manh pitok ix wutej in b'a.
Ix wak' yich in patik smak' heb' ajk'ool. Malaj tas swal t'a heb' stzukanel xil in ti'. Maj in k'ub'ejel in sat t'a heb' tzin b'uchani yet' heb' stzub'an in sat.
Ha Jehová Yajal, a skolwaj wed'ok, yuj chi' maj chab'ax in k'ol yuj tas tzin yutej heb' chi'. Tek'an ix wutej in b'a wak'an techajok, yujto wojtak to manh ol el in q'uixwelal.

Ha jun tzin kolani, ayek' t'a in tz'ey. Tato ay mach tz'ak'anoch t'a wib'anh, tzin b'at yet'ok t'a yichanh winh tzin ch'olb'itani. Ha junok ay chukal syal t'a in patik, kotokab' t'a in tz'ey tik, syalani.
Ha Jehová Yajal, ha' skolwaj wed'ok. ¿Mach ol yal yak'anoch junok tas t'a wib'anh? Masanil heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, ol lajwoquel heb' icha junok pichul ijtakxo, xchi jun schekab' Jehová chi'.

Ha ex ay yelk'och Jehová t'a yol he sat, tzeyab'anpax tas syal schekab': Tato tzex b'ey t'a k’ik’ k’inal, tato malaj tas tz'ak'an sakq'uinal t'ayex, ak'ekoch Jehová yipok he k'ool, tzex b'eynhej yet'ok.
Ha exxo tzeyak'och sk'ak'al juntzanh te' yik syak' yok t'ayex, anheja' t'a yok chi' tzex b'eyi. Ha Jehová ol ak'ankot jun yaelal t'a eyib'anh, toxonhej ol ex emkan jichan t'a skal eyaelal chi'.

Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha ex tze nib'ej he b'eyb'alej tojolal, tze nib'ej tzex jawi t'ayin, ab'ek wal tas ol wala': Ilecnab' b'aj kotnak eyinhtilal, b'aj pax kotnak yinhtilal heb' he mam eyicham.
Ina winh he mam eyicham aj Abraham yet' ix he nun chichim ix Sara, malaj yuninal heb' ayik wawtannak heb', palta wak'nak in wach'k'olal t'a heb', tzijtum ix aj yinhtilal heb'.

Ol wak' in wach'k'olal t'a Sion, aton jun chonhab' mak'b'ilem lanhnajok. Ha lum taquinh lu'um, ol yaxb'okkan sat lu'um, icha lum Edén ol aj lu'um. Yuj chi' ol tzalaj heb' kajan ta', ol b'itan heb', ol yak'an yuj diosal heb' t'ayin.
Ex in chonhab', maklejek eyab' tas ol wala', ab'ek ex junjun chonhab': Ol walel in k'ayb'ub'al yet' in cheknab'il. Icha sakil k'inal ol aj t'ayex.

Lak'anxo sja sk'ual in ch'olb'itani, wan sjapax sk'ual yik tzin kolwaji. Ha yet' in poder ol wak'an yajalil t'a yib'anh juntzanh chonhab'. Ha juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a stitak ha' mar, ol yak'och in poder heb' yipok sk'ool.

Q'ueanhek k'elan t'a satcha’anh, tzex empax k'elan t'a sat lu'um tik. Ha satcha’anh chi', ol satem icha satem te' tab', haxo sat lum tik, ol k'ab'ok icha sk'ab'i junok pichul. Ha heb' anima kajan t'a sat lum tik, ol satel heb' icha satel nok' us. Palta a kolnab'il swak'a' ay t'a junelnhej. Ha in tojolal malaj slajwub'.
Ha ex eyojtak tojolal, ex tzeyak'och in cheknab'il t'a he k'ool, ab'ek: Manh ex xiw yuj sb'uchwal lolonel heb' anima t'ayex. Mokab' chab'ax he k'ool yuj tas syal heb' chi',
yujto ol satel heb' icha junok pichul ijtakxo, ma icha tz'aj junok lana pichul sk'uxjib'at yuj nok' ij. Palta a in tojolal yet' in kolwal aynhejek' t'a junelnhej, xchi Jehová.
Mamin Jehová, kolwajanh, kotanh yet' a poder, icha a k'ulejnak t'a peka'. Ha ach chok' utejnak nok' niwan nok' t'a yol ha' mar, aton nok' Rahab.
Ha ach a jaknak ha' mar, aton ha' te jul yich, ha t'a sjulal yich ha' mar chi', icha b'e utejnak yik tzek' heb' kolb'il uuj.
Ichaton chi' ol aj smeltzaj heb' kolb'ilxo el uj Mamin Jehová. Ol jawok heb' t'a Sion tik yet' b'it yik tzalajk'olal. Ol tzetzon sat heb' stzalaji, ol satel ok'el yet' kusk'olal.
Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha in Jehová in swak' eyip, ¿tas yuj tzex xiw t'a heb' anima chamelb'a yaji, to lajan heb' icha anh ank'ultak k'un stakjieli?

Ha in Jehová in, a in in b'onak ex. Ha in in jenhb'ejnakb'at satcha’anh, in b'oannaquem lum lum tik t'a yet'tal. ¿Tom ix in b'atkan satk'olal eyuuj, yuj chi' tzex xiw t'a jun tzex ixtani, jun snaan ex sataneli? Palta manh ex xiwok, a in ol in satel yowal sk'ol jun tzex ixtan chi'.
Ha heb' syab' syail b'aj tz'ixtaj chi', elanhchamel ol koljok heb'. Manh ol cham heb' t'a yol preso, manh ol yak' wejel heb'.
Ha in Jehová he Diosal in, a in b'i, Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil. Ha in swak'k'e ponholjok sat ha' mar.

Ha in in jenhb'ejnakb'at satcha’anh, in b'oannakpaxem lum lum tik t'a yet'tal. Ha in swak' eyalel in lolonel, tzex in kolanel yet' in poder. Ha in swal t'a Sion: Ha ex tik in chonhab' ex, xin chi, xchi Jehová.

Hak'uequel he wayanh ex aj Jerusalén, k'eanhek waan. Ix eyab' wal syail yuj yowal sk'ol Jehová ix yak'kot t'a eyib'anh, palta toxo ix ek'b'ati. Lajan ex aj icha junok mach satel sk'ol yuk'an anh anh, manhxalaj jab'ok anh chi' syaktejkan t'a yol yet'tal.
Ha t'a skal heb' eyuninal ix eyil q'uib'ok, malaj junok heb' ix ch'oxan b'e t'ayex, malaj junok heb' ix ex quetzanb'ati.
Aton cha makan tas ix jawi t'a eyib'anh tik: Ix mak'chajem lanhnaj he chonhab', ix champax heb' kajan t'ay yuj wejel yuj owal. ¿Machto wal ol ok' sk'ol t'ayex? ¿Machto wal ol ak'an sniwanil he k'ool?

Toxo ix el yip heb' eyuninal, toxo ix telwi heb' icha nok' k'ultaquil chej skan t'a ch'anh yaal. Toxonhej ix kan teljab' heb' t'a schiquintak kalle, yujto ix yab' wal syail yowal sk'ol Jehová he Diosal heb', yuj skachji heb' yuj.
Ex aj Jerusalén, wan eyab'an wal syail, icha uk'um anh eyeq'ui, palta manh ex uk'umok pax anh.

Ha Jehová Kajal ko Diosal paxi, ha' tz'alan icha tik: Ha in Jehová he Diosal in tzex in kolo', a in ton swal icha tik: Ol wik'ek' skopail yowal in k'ol chi' t'ayex, manhxa b'ak'uinh ol eyab'xi syail yuj.

Ha t'a heb' ixtannak ex, ata' ol wak' jun skopail yowal in k'ol chi', aton t'a heb' aljinak t'ayex icha tik: Emanhec lachan t'a sat lu'um to ol onh b'eyek' t'a eyib'anh, xchi heb'. Emnac ex lachan t'a sat lum chi', ek'nak tek'ton heb' t'a eyib'anh icha lum pokok, xchi Jehová.
Ex aj Sion schonhab' Dios, ak'equel he wayanh, k'eanhek waan, tek'b'ejek he b'a. Ch'oxequel swach'il eyilji, yujto manhxa b'ak'uinh ol jax heb' ch'ok nakional ch'ok sdiosal yak' chukal t'ayex.
Q'ueanhek waan ex aj Jerusalén, mak'equel pokok t'ayex, ol ex emxok k'ojan t'a he despacho eyak'an yajalil. Ex aj Sion, ex ix ex xid'ek' t'a ch'ok nakional, ik'equel tas tzek'b'iloch t'a he jaj.
Ha Jehová Kajal tz'alan icha tik: Malaj wal jab'ok tumin ix in cha t'a he patik ayik ix ex ik'chajb'at chekab'ok. Anhejtona', malaj pax tumin ol wak'a' yik tzex wik'anxi meltzajok.
Ha in chonhab' tik, b'atnak t'a Egipto t'a peka', ch'ok chonhab'il ajnak yek' heb' ta'. Axo tiknaik ix ixtaj heb' yuj heb' aj Asiria, wach'chom malaj jab'ok yuj.
Axo tiknaik, ¿tas smoj tzin k'ulej? D'a ichnhej ta' ix ik'jib'at in chonhab' tik t'a Babilonia. Ha heb' tz'ak'an yajalil t'a yib'anh heb', syik'chaanh sb'a heb', max yaktej heb' in sb'uchani.
Yuj chi', ol k'och sk'ual, ol yojtaquejel in chonhab' tik to Dios in, ol nachajel yuj heb' to a in ix in lolon t'a heb', xchi Jehová.

Jantac swach'il quilan t'a tzalquixtak, ayik sjawi junok mach tz'alan wach' ab'ix. Yed'nak yab'ixal junk'olal, syalanpax yab'ixal kolnab'il, syalan icha tik: Ex aj Sion, a he Diosal wan yoch Reyal, xchi.
Ab'ek, a heb' stanhwumal he chonhab', tz'el yaw heb', jun lajan tz'aj sk'e nhilnaj heb' yel yaw yuj tzalajk'olal, yujto syil wal heb' sjax Jehová t'a Sion.
Ex aj Jerusalén juwinakkan he chonhab', elokab' eyaw he b'itan t'a tzalajk'olal, yujto ol ok'xok sk'ol Jehová t'ayex, ol skolanxi Jerusalén.
Yujto ol sch'ox spoder Jehová yil juntzanhxo nakión. Masanil anima t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, ol yojtaquejel heb' to ha Dios onh kolanxi.
Elanhec, elanhekta t'a yol sk'ab' heb' aj Babilonia. Ha ex eyed'nak yamk'ab' yik stemplo Jehová, manh eyam tas manh wach'ok, manh eyak'b'at he b'ha t'a skal chukal.
Manh sk'ak'alilok, manh elelalok ol ex elta, yujto a Jehová ko Diosal ol oymaj t'a he patiktak, ol ex stanhwani.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Ha jun in Chekab' tik wach'nhej ol elk'ochok, ol ik'jok wal chaanh, ol b'inaj wal.
Tzijtum mach ol sat sk'ol yilani, yujto ol ixtax yilji, manhxo animaok ol aj yilji yuj tas ol utajok.

Icha pax chi' jantak nakión, ol sat sk'ol yilani ayik ol ik'jokchaanh. Ha heb' rey toxonhej ol och k'elan heb', yujto ol yil heb', ol nachajel yuj heb' tas to manta b'aj ix yab' heb' yalji, xchi Jehová.
Ol yal Israel icha tik: ¿Toc ay mach tz'ak'anoch t'a sk'ol tas skaleli? ¿Toc ay mach snachajel yuj to a spoder Jehová scheklaj t'a jun ab'ix tik? xcham heb'.
Snib'ej Jehová to a jun schekab' chi' sq'uib' icha swol junok te te' tz'em sch'anhal yib' t'a taquinh lu'um. Manh nib'ab'ilok yilji, malaj tas wach' squiloch t'ay.

Ha heb' anima, ol sb'uch jun chekab' chi' heb', ol spatiquejel heb'. Ol ak'jokoch yaelal t'a yib'anh yuj heb', ol techaj yuj, yujto k'ajan yab'an syail. Icha junok mach manhxo smojok yiljiochi, ol patikajelok. Malaj ol elk'och jun chekab' chi' t'ayonh.
Ha ko naani to ha Dios tz'ak'anoch yaelal t'a yib'anh, syak'anpaxkan t'a emnaquilal, palta manh ichokta'. Ha ko yaelal a onh tik ol ak'jokoch t'a yib'anh, ol yab' syail ko k'exulok.
Ol tekjoquek' k'een t'a sniwanil yuj ko pitalil, ol yab'an wal syail yuj ko chukal. Yuj syaelal ol yab' chi', ol ochxi junk'olal t'a ko kal yet' Dios. Yuj yechnaj chi', ol yak'xi ko k 'inal.
Co masanil ix onh saklemkanb'at icha nok' kalnel. Junjun onh ix ko na' tas b'eal b'aj ix ko nib'ej b'aj ix onh b'atkani, haxo Jehová ol ak'ankanoch ko mul ko masanil t'a yib'anh jun schekab' chi'.

Ol ak'jok wal och syaelal yuj heb' anima, emnaquilal ol aj yuj heb', palta malaj tas ol yala'. Ol ik'jokb'at yuj heb', icha tz'aj yik'jib'at nok' kalnel b'aj smiljichamok. Malaj tas ol yala', numannhej ol ajok, icha nok' kalnel sjoxchaji.

Ol ik'chajelta t'a preso yik sch'olb'itaji, ol ak'jokoch chamel t'a yib'anh. Malaj mach ol och ilk'olal yuj schamel chi'. Ol ik'chajel t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik yuj ko mul a onh schonhab' onh tik. Cuuj ol yab' syail.
Malaj wal jab'ok chukal ol sk'ulej, malaj jab'ok es ol elta t'a sti'. Wach'chom icha chi', a snaan heb' anima to ol mukchaj t'a skal heb' chuk, palta haxo t'a skal heb' b'eyum ol mukchajok.

Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ol wak' yab' syail in chekab' icha yaj in naani. Ol yak'och sb'a silab'il t'a yol sk'ab' chamel yik tz'ak'jikan lajwok smul masanil anima. Yuj chi' ol pitzwokkan t'a junelnhej, ol yil heb' yinhtilal. Yuj, ol elkank'och tas nab'il wuuj.

Ayic toxo ix lajwiek' juntzanh yaelal chi' t'a yib'anh, ol tzalaj yuj spak jun yaelal chi' to manh nab'anhejok ix yab' syail. Tzijtum heb' anima ol ochkan wach'il yuj yojtakanel in chekab' chi' heb', yujto ol ik'jokkanel smul heb' yuj.

Yuj chi' ol wak' yopisio t'a skal heb' niwak yelk'ochi. Ay yalan yik yet' heb' yak'an ganar owal, yujto ix yak'och sb'ha t'a yol sk'ab' chamel. Icha wal tz'utaj heb' sk'ulan chukal, icha chi' ix utaji. Ix sb'ek sb'a yuj smul masanil anima, ix tewi yuj heb' yik tz'ak'jikan lajwok smul heb' chi', xchi Jehová.

Ix yalan Jehová icha tik t'a Jerusalén: Ex aj Jerusalén, k'eanhekchaanh he b'itan t'a tzalajk'olal. Ha t'a peka' lajan he chonhab' icha junok ix ix max unewilaj, aktab'ilkan yuj yetb'eyum. Axo tiknaik, lajan icha junok ix tzijtum yune' ix alji, ek'b'al sb'isul yune' ix t'a yichanh junok ix ix aynhejek' winh yetb'eyum yet'ok.
Hak'ek lewanb'ok he makb'en b'aj kajan ex, manh ex xiw he lewb'itani. Icha junok mach slewb'itan smantiado, sjuklitej sch'anhal, smak'an tzatzb'ok yestakail, icha chi' tze k'ulej.

Yujto ol lewanb'ok he makb'en chi', yuj chi' ol eyik'kanek' slum heb' anima kajan t'a he patik eyichanh. Ha heb' eyinhtilal ol ak'an ganar juntzanhxo nakión, ol kajnaj heb' t'a juntzanh chonhab' kannak tzinan.

Ex aj Jerusalén, manh ex xiwok, manhxo ol ex kan t'a q'uixwelal, manhxo emnaquilok ol ex utajok. Manhxo ol he nakot tas ajnak yel he q'uixwelal t'a peka', ayik ex aktajkan icha junok ix ix manhxa yetb'eyum.
Yujto a in in b'onak ex, icha eyetb'eyum waji. Ha in b'i Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil. E Kolumal waji, he Diosal a inxonhej Ochi, sDiosal in pax masanil anima.
Ha he chonhab' tik, lajan icha junok ix kob'es ix aktab'ilkan yuj yetb'eyum, kusk'olal yajkan ix. Icha chi' ajnakkan he chonhab' tik, haxo tiknaik, Ha in he Diosal in tzex wawtejxi.
Ex aj Jerusalén, quennhej tiempoal ix ex waktejkani, haxo tiknaik, tzex in chaanxi yujto te xajan ex wuuj.
Ix kot wowal t'ayex jun pekti’, ix in k'ub'ejel in b'a t'ayex, palta yujto tzex in xajanej t'a junelnhej, yuj chi' ix ok'xi in k'ol t'ayex, a in ton Jehová he Kolumal waji, a in swala'.

Icha wal wutejnak wak'an in ti' t'a winhaj Noé to manhxa b'ak'uinh ol jax jun owal ha' mukjinak yol yib'anhk’inal tik, icha chi' tz'aj wak'an in ti' tiknaik, manhxo ol kot wowal t'ayex junelxo, manhxo ol ex in tumej.

Wach'chom sk'exmaj yet'tal lum niwak witz, tz'em lanhnaj lum tzalquixtak, palta malaj b'ak'uinh ol waktej ex in xajanani. Malaj b'ak'uinh ol lajwok in trato ix wala' to aynhej junk'olal t'a in kal eyed'ok. Ha in Jehová in swala'.

Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ob'iltak ex, ex aj Jerusalén. Ix eyab' wal syail yuj tas ix ek' t'a eyib'anh, malaj wal junok mach ix ak'an sniwanil he k'ool. Axo tiknaik ol wak'kanem he chonhab' tik t'a yib'anh k'een k'een wach' yilji, ol wak'ankanem yich t'a yib'anh k'een zafiro.
Ha yelwanub' he chonhab', ol in b'o yet' k'een rubí, haxo spuertail, ol in b'o yet' k'een berilo, haxo smuroal ol in b'o yet' k'een k'een te wach' yilji.
Ol in k'ayb'ej heb' eyuninal yik wach' ol aj yelk'och heb'.
Ha tojolal, ol yik'nhej yipok t'a he kal, ol ex kolchajkanel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' anima tzex ixtani, heb' tzex xib'tani. Manhxa mach ol ex xib'tanok.
Tato ay mach ol jawok yak' owal eyed'ok, manhok in swak'kot heb', yuj chi' ol eyak'nhej ganar heb'.
Ileknab'i, a in ix in b'o winh tenum k'een, syak'och sk'ak'al te' tzak'ak' winh yik sb'oan yamk'ab' winh yik owal. Ha in pax ix in b'o heb' satanel anima yet' juntzanh syamk'ab' winh chi'.

Palta malaj junok yamk'ab' yik owal ol yal ex sataneli. Ha heb' tz'ak'anoch tas t'a eyib'anh, numanxonhej ol ajkan heb' eyuuj. Aton juntzanh tik swak' t'a heb' tzin ak'an serwil. Ha in ol ex in kolo', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Masanil ex stakji he ti', kotanhek, ul uq'ek ha ha'. Ha ex malaj he tumin, kotanhek ul chaek tas tze wa t'a nab'anhej, ul chaek yal uwa yet' lech manh tupb'ilok.

¿Tas yuj tze komon lajej he tumin t'a tas manh waelok? ¿Tas yuj tze komon lajej he tojol tze cha t'a tas to max b'ud'ji he k'ol yuj? Ab'ek wal sik'lab'il tas ol wala': Tato tze k'anab'ajej tas swala', ol he wa wael te wach', ol ex b'ud'jok wal sik'lab'il.
Cotanhec t'ayin, maklejek wal eyab' tas swala', ol ex ajnhejek'ok. Ol in b'o junok in trato eyed'ok t'a junelnhej yujto tzex in xajanej, yik tz'elk'och in ti' wak'nak t'a winhaj rey Dawid.
Ha in wak'nakoch winhaj Dawid chi' testigoal t'a juntzanhxo nakión, yik skuchb'an winh, ma yik syak'an yajalil winh t'ay.
Ol eyawtejkot heb' anima manh eyojtakok. Ha heb' anima chi' elanhchamel ol ja lemnaj heb' t'ayex, yujto a in Jehová he Diosal in, Ha inxonhej Ochi, a in ol ex wak' ik'jokchaanh, xchi Jehová.
Hak'uekoch he b'ha t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová, yakb'an tzato yal eyawaj t'ay. Awajanhec t'ay, yakb'an lak'anto ayeq'ui.
Ha ex chuk he b'eyb'al yet' ex chuk he pensar, aktejekkan juntzanh he chukal chi'. Meltzajanhec t'a Jehová. Ol ok'xok sk'ol t'ayex, ol ex yak' niwank'olal ko Diosal.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Ha tas nab'il wuuj, manh lajanok yet' tas tze na'a. Ha tas tzin k'ulej, manh lajanok yet' tas tze k'ulej.
Ha in pensar yet' tas tzin k'ulej chi' manh lajanok icha eyiko', yujto yel wal te ek'b'alxo tas tzin na' chi' t'a yichanh schaanhil yajk'e satcha’anh t'a yib'anh lum lum tik.

Ha yaxnhab' yet' k'een sakb'akom tz'emta t'a satcha’anh, max meltzajlaj t'a ichnhej ta', palta to sch'ayxikan lum lum yuj yik wach' sk'eul masanil tas tz'awchaj t'a lu'um. Syak'an sat, tz'elta yinhatil yik syal yawchajxi, syak'anpax swael heb' anima.
Icha yaxnhab' chi', icha chi' yaj in lolonel, max meltzajlaj t'ayin t'a ichnhej ta', palta to sb'okan tas nab'il wuuj, tz'elpaxk'och tas tzin nib'ej.

Tzalajk'olal ol aj eyelta b'aj ayex ek' presoal, junk'olal ol aj he meltzaj t'a he chonhab'. Masanil lum witz, lum tzalquixtak, ichato ol k'e wal sjaj lum t'a chaanh yuj tzalajk'olal. Ha te' niwak te', icha wal to ol stz'it sk'ab' te' stzalaji.

Ha lum b'aj ay te' q'uiix, a te' k'ub'taj ol q'uib'ok. Ha lum b'aj ay te' sak q'uiix, a te' arrayán ol q'uib' sk'exulok te'. Ol in k'ulej juntzanh tik yik sb'inaj in b'i a in Jehová in tik, yik tzin nachajnhejkot t'a junelnhej, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: B'eyb'alejek tojolal, aokab' tas wach' tze k'ulej, yujto toxo wal ol ex in koleli. Ol in ch'oxel in poder in kolwaji.

Te wach' yik heb' sk'anab'ajan juntzanh cheknab'il tik, sb'eyb'alan heb' icha wal yaji, aton heb' niwan yelk'och sk'ual ik'oj ip t'ay, max yixtejb'at heb', aton heb' syailan sb'a, max sk'ulej chukal heb', xchi Jehová.

Tato ay heb' ch'ok nakional syak'och sb'ha t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová, mokab' yal heb' icha tik: Ha Jehová max in chaanoch t'a skal schonhab' tik. Anhejtona' heb' winh malaj yuninal, mokab' yal heb' winh icha tik: Ha in tik lajan in icha junok te' taquinh te'.
Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Tato a heb' winh malaj yuninal chi' niwan yelk'och sk'ual ik'oj ip t'ay, sk'anab'ajan pax heb' winh tas tzin nib'ej, tojol syutej sb'a heb' winh t'a in trato,

ay jun tas te wach' ol wak' t'a heb' winh t'a yichanh to ay yuninal, ma yisil. Ha jun chi', to ol b'inajnhej heb' winh t'a in templo yet' t'a skal in chonhab'. Ol wak'anpax jun sb'i heb' winh t'a junelnhej, malaj b'ak'uinh ol satelok.

Axo pax heb' ch'ok chonhab'il syak'och sb'ha t'a yol in k'ab', yik tzin yak'an serwil heb', tz'ochpax heb' ejmelal t'ayin, tzin sxajanej heb', sk'anab'ajan pax sk'ual ik'oj ip heb', tojol syutej sb'a heb' t'a in trato, ol in chaoch heb' t'a skal in chonhab'.

Ol wik'kot heb' t'a jun in tzalan wiknhej yaji. Ol wak'an tzalajb'ok sk'ol heb' t'a spatil b'aj tz'och lesal t'ayin. Ol in cha silab' heb' snhustz'ha t'a yib'anh waltar, yujto a in templo tik, ol alchaj yuj to spatil lesal yaj t'a masanil chonhab'.

Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, a in tzin molb'ejkot heb' israel aykanb'at t'a juntzanh ch'ok nakional, a in swala': Ol wik'kot juntzanh heb' ch'ok nakional yik junnhej tz'aj heb' yet' heb' israel molb'ilxo wuuj, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Ex ch'ok nakional, kotanhek icha nok' chium nok'. Cotanhec milwal, ul satequel in chonhab' tik, icha syak' nok' kaltakte'al nok' sjawi, schianb'at nok' kalnel.

Yujto a heb' stanhwumal in chonhab' tik, ichato maxtzak yal yilan heb', maxtzak nachajel yuj heb' tas sk'ulej. Lajan heb' icha nok' tz'i' max chiwaji. Jichanek' heb' tzek' k'u. Anhej wayanh snib'ej heb' sk'ulej.
Lajan heb' icha nok' tz'i' tz'ochnhej swejel, malaj b'ak'uinh sb'ud'ji. Ha heb' yilumal in chonhab' tik, max nachajel jab'ok yuj heb', anhej tas snib'ej heb' sayeq'ui.

Syalan heb' icha tik: Koyec b'at ko sayek anh anh, a anh te ow skuk'ejek, yik sk'e wal anh t'a ko jolom. Skuk'anpax anh k'ik'an icha sko k'ulej tiknaik, mato ol te ek' yib'anh kuk'an anh jun, xchi heb'.
Ayic scham heb' anima wach' spensar, malaj mach snaan heb'. Ayic satem heb' wach' sb'eyb'al chi', malaj mach snachajel yuj to ayik scham heb' chi', skolchajkanel heb' t'a skal yaelal.
Ha heb' wach' sb'eyb'al chi', junk'olal yaj heb', wan yik'an yip heb' b'aj sk'och chi'.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Cotanhec t'ayin a ex tze b'eyb'alej chukal, a ex ton tze b'eyb'alej ajchumal, ex tzex em ajmulal.
¿Mach heb' tze b'uchu'? ¿Mach heb' tzeyed'tej sat, tz'elta jab'an eyak' tze chakaneli? Ha ex tik te chuk ex, te esalwum ex.
Ha t'a yichtak te' ji yet' te te' k'ayum xiil, ata' tze k'ulej ajmulal. Tzeyak'anpax heb' eyuninal silab'il t'a he diosal t'a skaltak k'een k'een t'a stitak ha' kotak ha' sb'eyi.

Ex israel, scha wal he k'ol eyoch ejmelal t'a k'een k'een nheleli sat t'a yoltak ha' kotak ha' sb'eyi, a juntzanh chi' ix he sik'kanel he diosalok. Aton t'a juntzanh chi' tze sequem wino, tzeyak'an sat eyawb'en silab'il t'ay. ¿Am he naani to manh ol wak'och eyaelal yuj juntzanh tas tze k'ulej chi'?
Ha t'a lum jolomtak witz te chaanh ay ste'al, ata' tze b'o he waynub', tze nhusanpax he silab'.

Ha t'a yoloch he puerta, ata' tzeyak'och yechel he diosal yajb'entak yilji. Ha inxo tik, tzin b'atkan satk'olal eyuuj. Tze quichanel b'eran he b'a, tzex ek' jichan t'a sat he ch'at lewan sat. Tzeyak'an he trato he mulan yet' heb' tze nib'ejochi, tzex way yet' heb'.

Tzeyik'anb'at akeite yet' jantak perfume, tzex b'at lemnaj t'a jun yechel komon Dios skuch Moloc, tzex och ejmelal t'ay. Tze chekanb'at heb' he chekab' t'a najat b'at sayanek' juntzanhxo he diosal, masanto tz'emk'och heb' b'aj ay heb' chamnak.
Tzex k'unb'i eyek' t'a najat chi', palta max nachajel jab'ok eyuuj to malaj yelk'och jun tze k'ulej chi'. Yujto te nib'ab'il jun tze sayek' chi', yuj chi' tz'ochxi eyip, tze sayanxi.
¿Mach juntzanh heb' b'aj tzex xiwi to niwan yelk'och chi' t'ayex, yuj chi' tzin eyaktejkani, tzin b'at satk'olal eyuuj? ¿Tom yujto manhxa tas swala', yuj chi' manhxa welk'och t'ayex?
Ha tiknaik, ol wak' cheklaj juntzanh he b'eyb'al te wach' he naan chi', palta manh ol ex kolchajlaj yuj.

Ayic ol el eyaw he k'anan in kolwal, ol walan t'ayex: Aokab' he komon diosal chi' tzex kolani, xin chama. Ha masanil juntzanh chi', ol ik'chajb'at yuj ik', anhej yet' jun pusok ik' chi' ol b'atok. Axo pax heb' tzin ak'anoch yipok sk'ool jun, ol kajnajnhej heb' t'a in chonhab' tik, ol ajnhej heb' t'a lum tzalan wiknhej yaji, xchi Jehová.
Ol ab'jok yalchaj icha tik: B'oek jun b'e, te panhan tzeyutej, ik'equel tastak ayem t'a yol b'e chi' yik wach' tzek' in chonhab', xchama.

Yujto ha Dios Axonhej niwan Yelk'ochi, Aynhej ek' t'a junelnhej, skuchan pax Axonhej Ochi, a tz'alan icha tik: Ha in tik, kajan in t'a lugar te chaanh to wiknhej yaji, palta ay in pax ek' yet' heb' emnaquilal yaji yet' heb' sna sb'a sk'ool yuj schukal, a in swiptzitej heb'.
Manhxo ol kot wowal t'a in chonhab' tik, manhxo ol wak'nhejkot wowal t'a heb' t'a junelnhej, talaj a juntzanh anima b'ob'il wuj tik, schab'axk'e sk'ol heb' t'ayin.
Yuj smul heb' israel tik yik sayannhej skomon diosal heb', ix kot wowal t'a heb', ix wak'anoch syaelal heb', ix in patikanel heb'. Palta ix spitejnhej wal sb'a heb', ix sk'ulan heb' icha tas snib'ej.
Ix wil wal sb'eyb'al heb', palta ol wanhtej heb', ol wak'an yik' yip heb'. Ol in tanhwan heb', ol wak'an sniwanil sk'ol heb' skus yuj smul.
Ol walan t'a heb' icha tik: Ha ex najat kajan ex yet' ex lak'an ayex, junk'olalokab' eyaji, xin chama. Yujto a in ol wanhtej in chonhab' tik.
Palta haxo heb' chuk sb'eyb'al jun, lajan heb' icha ha' mar skot b'alb'on sat, max ochlaj waan, syik'ankot jantak k'alem.
Ha heb' sk'ulan chukal, malaj jab'ok wach'il ol scha heb', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Awajanh t'a chaanh, manh ach xiw awaji. Te chaanh tz'el aw icha spuji junok k'een trompeta. Al t'a heb' yinhtilal Jacob tik to te pit heb', te chuk heb'.

Junjun k'u skomon och heb' ejmelal t'ayin. Scomon tzalaj heb', snib'an heb' yojtaquejel in b'eyb'al, icha junok chonhab'il anima sb'eyb'alan tojolal, ichato malaj b'aj syik'el spensar heb' t'a in cheknab'il, ichato sk'an juntzanh cheknab'il heb' yik tojolal t'ayin, sch'oxan heb' to stzalaj heb' sjawi t'ayin.

Ijan skot yowal heb' t'ayin syalan heb' icha tik: Nab'anhej tzonh komon och tzek'ojk'olal t'ayach, tokwal tzonh ila'. Nab'anhej squixtej ko b'a koch ejmelal t'ayach, tokwal tzonh a na'a, xchi heb'. Swalan icha tik: Yel toni, ayik tzex och t'a tzek'ojk'olal chi', anhej tas tze nib'ej, a chi' tze k'ulej, tzeyixtan heb' he munlajwum.
Ayic tzex komon och t'a tzek'ojk'olal chi', anhej telajb'ail yet' owal tzeyak'a', tze mak'lan he b'a yuj he chuk pensaril. Tocwal ol wab' he lesal t'a jun he tzek'ojk'olal tzeyak' chi'.

¿Tom a he naani to tzin tzalaj yet' tas tzeyutej he b'a chi'? Ha jun tze k'ulej chi' kusk'olal, tzex komon em nhojan icha spakchaj te' aj, tzex komon ek' jichan t'a yib'anh k'een tik'aq'uil taanh yet' pichul ya swa'i. ¿Tom a jun chi' tzeyak' skuch tzek'ojk'olal te wach' t'a yol in sat he naani?

Palta manh ichok ta'. Ol wal t'ayex to a tzek'ojk'olal scha in k'ool, aton stzolal tik: Colequelta heb' anima ayoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' chuk spensar. Manhxo eyixtej heb' smunlaj t'ayex, aktejequel heb' tz'ixtaj chi', manhxo eyixtej heb'.

Ha heb' anima scham yuj wejel, aq'ek swael heb'. Axo heb' malaj spat, aq'ek sposado heb' t'a he pat. Ha heb' malaj spichul, ak'ekoch spichul heb', manh eyaktej eyak'an sniwanil sk'ol heb' eyetchonhab'.

Tato icha chi' tzeyutej he b'a, yalnhej b'aj ol cheklaj in wach'k'olal t'ayex, icha tz'aj sq'uinhib'i t'a junxo k'u. Elanhchamel ol ex kolchajok. Ha in he tojolal waji, b'ab'el in b'at eyuuj, haxo in tziquiquial, tzak'an eyuuj.

Yuj chi' tato ol ex awaj t'ayin, elanhchamel ol in tak'wok t'ayex. Tato ol el eyaw he k'anan in kolwal, ol walan t'ayex icha tik: Ina in tik, xin chama. Tzeyik'el juntzanh chukal chi' t'a he kal. Manh he suy slumal heb' eyetanimail, manhxo he nak'e esal lolonel t'a spatik heb'.

Tato tzeyak' swael heb' ay swejel, tzex kolwaj t'a heb' ay tas tz'och yuj, tato icha chi', ol cheklaj he wach'il t'a skal anima icha sakil k'inal t'a skal k’ik’ k’inal. Ol ex cheklajel icha yok k'u t'a chimk'ualil t'a skal k’ik’ k’inal chi'.

Tato icha chi', ol ex in kuchb'ejnhej. Jantac he wael ol wak' t'a lum tzinan lu'um. Ol wak'an yip he niwanil, lajan ol ex aj icha junok tas awab'il aynhejoch yalil, ma icha junok sjaj ha ha' malaj b'ak'uinh stupi.
Ol he b'oxik'e he chonhab' t'a yet'tal b'aj jub'ilemi, aton t'a yib'anh yich aykanem t'a peka'. Ol alchaj t'ayex to b'oumexxik'e muro lanhchajnak, b'oumexxik'e pat lanhchajnaquemi.

Ha in Jehová in tik swala': Tato manh komonok tzeyutejb'at sk'ual ik'oj ip, malaj he munlajel tze b'o t'a jun k'u wik yaj chi', tato tzex tzalaj paxi yujnhej to ay yelk'och jun k'u chi' t'ayex, max eyal komon lolonel,

tato icha chi', ol ex tzalaj wed'ok. Ha in ol wak' sniwanil eyelk'och t'a masanil chonhab'. Ol eyak' tzalajb'ok he k'ool t'a lum lum wak'nak he makb'enok t'a he mam eyicham aj Jacob. Ha in ton Jehová in swalkan jun tik.
Tocwal tz'el yip spoder Jehová, yuj chi' maxtzak yal skolwaji, tokwal ix chakanhb'i Jehová, yuj chi' maxtzak yab' he tewi, maay.
Ha chukal tze k'ulej, a chi' ayek' t'a skal he nanhal yet' Dios. Ha juntzanh he mul chi', a tzek' makan t'a he kal yet' Dios chi', yuj chi' maxtzak yab' tas tzeyala'.
Ha ex tik, chik'tak he k'ab' he milancham anima, miktak he k'ab' he k'ulan chukal. Axonhej es yet' chukal tz'elta t'a yol he ti'.

Malaj junok ex wach' tzeyutej he b'a. Max he ch'olb'itej yaj heb' anima t'a stojolal, ma t'a stzolal. Ha tas malaj yelk'ochi yet' esal lolonel, a tzeyak'lab'ej ayik sb'o yaj eyowal. Tze k'ulan chukal, yujto a chi' ayek' t'a he pensar.

Ha tas nab'il eyuuj chi', lajan wal icha snholob' nok' chan. Ha mach sloan snholob' nok' chan chi', schamnhej. Ayic smak'ji pojok, a nok' kotak ajawchan tz'elta t'a yool. Anheja' tas nab'il eyuj chi', icha sch'al nok' xim yaji.
Ha sch'al nok' xim chi', max yal-laj sb'o pichul yet'ok, malaj mach spich sb'a yet' tas sb'o nok' chi'. Icha sch'al nok' xim chi', icha chi' juntzanh chukal tze k'ulej, malaj jab'ok tas tzeyik' t'ay.
Tzex b'at lemnaj t'a skal chukal. Elanhchamel tze milcham heb' anima malaj smul. Anhej t'a chukal ayoch he pensar, a b'aj tzex eq'ui, jantak tastak tze satkaneli.
