Anhej owal tzeyak'a', malaj jab'ok tojolal scheklaj t'a tas tze k'ulej. Ha he b'eyb'al chi', junelnhej manh wach'ok. Ha heb' tz'och tzak'an eyuuj, malaj jab'ok junk'olal tz'ilchaj yuj heb' t'ayex.

Yuj chi' syalan heb' anima icha tik: Malaj mach stek'b'an sb'a kuuj, malaj mach tzonh kolanel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' tzonh ixtani. Sco tanhwej tzalajk'olal, palta haxo kusk'olal oyan och t'a ko patik. Sco tanhwej b'ak'uinh tzonh kolchajel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' tzonh ixtani, palta malaj mach tzonh kolani.

Toxonhej sko machlej b'aj tzonh eq'ui, icha yek' machmon junok mach max uji yilan t'a sat pat. Ha t'a chimk'ualil tzonh telwi, ichato t'ak'walil ayonheq'ui. Wach'chom tek'an onh skab'i, palta ichato chamnak onhxo.

Ay b'aj skot kowal, snhiii yol ko jaj icha nok' oso, mato tzonh k'akwi icha nok' paramuch. Sco tanhwej ko ch'olb'itaj t'a stojolal, palta malaj b'ak'uinh sb'o kaji. Sco tanhwej ko kolji, palta najat yajkanel t'ayonh.
Mamin Jehová, yel ix ko pitej ko b'a t'ayach. Ha ko mul chi' tz'ik'ankot t'a quib'anh. Chequel yaj ko pitalil, kojtak ko mul chi'.

Ach ko Diosal, te pit skutej ko b'a t'ayach, max ach ko k'anab'ajejlaj. Max ko nib'ejoch tzak'an ko b'a uuj. Anhej wal chukal yet' ixtoj anima sko k'an ko k'ulej. Nab'il kuuj tas tz'aj kak'an es yet' quixtan heb' quetanimail.
Sco chaquel b'aj sb'o yaj heb' quetanimail. Ha tojolal, najat yajkanb'at kuuj. Ha tas yel, manhxalaj mach schaan yab' b'aj smolb'ej sb'a heb' anima. Axo tojolal chi', maxtzak cheklaj b'aj ay.

Manhxa mach tz'alan tas yel, haxo heb' snib'ej yaktankan chukal, tz'ik'jiek' tastak ay t'a heb', xchi heb' anima. Ha Jehová max scha sk'ol juntzanh tik, yujto maxtzak ch'olb'itaj heb' anima t'a stojolal.
Toxonhej sat sk'ol Jehová ayik syilani to malaj mach syak'lej sb'oan yaj jun tik. Yuj chi' syak'och sb'a skolan heb' yet' spoder, ol yak' ganar skolan heb'.

Icha heb' soldado ayoch spichul yik owal, icha chi' ol aj sjawi Jehová yet' yowal sk'ool, yik syak'an spak t'a heb' ixtum anima. Ha stojolal, icha k'een maklab' nhi' k'ol yaji. Axo skolnab'il, lajan icha k'een xumpil.
Ol spakan t'a junjun mach, ato syala' tas sk'ulej. Ol yak'anoch syaelal heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ay. Ha heb' schichon sk'ol t'ay, aton heb' kajan t'a sk'axepal ha' mar, ol yak' spak t'a heb' t'a smojal.

Masanil heb' anima t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, b'aj sk'eul k'u, masanto b'aj tz'em k'u, ayik ol yilanoch stziquiquial Jehová heb', ol xiw heb', yujto ol ja icha wal junok ha' eluma', ichato pechb'il yuj junok owal ik'.
Ha Jehová tz'alani to ol jawok skol heb' aj Sion, aton heb' yinhtilal Jacob sna sb'a yuj schukal.

Syalan Jehová icha tik: Ha tiknaik tzin b'okan jun in trato eyed'ok, swak'ankan in ti' to a Vespíritu yet' in k'ayb'ub'al swak'kan t'ayex, ol kannhej eyed'ok. Ol eyalankan t'a heb' eyuninal yet' t'a heb' eyinhtilal ol elnhej, yik tze k'anab'ajej t'a junelnhej, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Ex aj Jerusalén, k'eanhekxi waan, te wach' eyiko' yujto scheklajxik'e in tziquiquial t'a he kal.

Axo yol yib'anhk’inal tik, a k'ik'k 'inal ol musankanok, ichato ol kan juntzanhxo nakión t'a skal jun niwan k’ik’ k’inal. Ha exxo tik, a in Jehová in tik ol wak' sakil k'inal t'ayex, ol cheklajel in tziquiquial t'a he kal.
Ha juntzanh niwak nakión chi', ol jawok t'ayex yuj he sakil k'inal chi'. Ha heb' winh rey, ol jawok heb' winh ul yil in tziquiquial ol cheklaj chi'.

Q'ueanhek k'elan, tzeyilan t'a he patik eyichanh to a masanil heb' eyetchonhab', ol laj smolb'ej sb'a heb' sjax t'ayex. Ha heb' eyal eyuninal, najat ol kot heb', mek'b'il heb' ol ul ak'jokkan heb' t'ayex.
Ayic ol eyilan icha chi', ol ex k'e juknaj he tzalaji, ol ex te tzalaj wal. Yujto ol laj yik'kot sb'eyumal juntzanh nakión ay t'a sk'axepal ha' mar, ol ul yak'ankan heb' t'ayex.

Ol majel sat he lum tik yuj jantak nok' kamello ol yik'kot heb' aj Madián yet' heb' aj Efa. Ol jawokpax masanil heb' aj Sabá, yet'nak k'een oro heb' yet' inkienso. Ol yalanel wach' lolonel heb' t'ayin Jehová in tik, yuj tas tzin k'ulej.

Masanil nok' kalnel ay t'a Cedar, ol eyiquej nok'. Masanil nok' ch'ak kalnel ay t'a Nebaiot, a nok' ol eyak'lab'ej, yik ol eyak'an nok' silab'il t'a waltar, aton silab' nib'ab'il wuuj. Icha chi' ol wutej, yik ay yelk'och in templo t'ayex.
Ol eyalan icha tik: ¿Tas juntzanh skot chi', icha skot asun, ma icha sk'och nok' paramuch t'a yet'tal?

Ha jun ol eyil chi', aton te' barko skot t'a sk'axepal ha' mar, b'ab'el skot te' yik Tarsis yuj te'. Van yik'jikot heb' eyuninal aykanb'at t'a najat yuj heb', yet'nak k'een oro heb' yet' k'een plata. Ol in ik'jokchaanh a in Jehová he Diosal, Ha inxonhej Ochi. Ha in pax ol ex wak' b'inajok.

Ha heb' ch'ok nakional, a heb' ol b'oanxik'e smuroal he chonhab', haxo heb' sreyal heb' ol ex ak'an serwil. Wach'chom yuj yowal in k'ool ix wak'och eyaelal, haxo tiknaik, yuj in wach'k'olal tz'ok'xi in k'ol t'ayex.
Ha spuertail he chonhab', jakannhej t'a k'ualil yet' t'ak'walil yik syik'kot sb'eyumal juntzanh nakión chi' t'ayex, yik sjawipax sreyal heb' t'a eyichanh.
Ha juntzanh niwak nakión, ma heb' rey manh ol ex ak'an serwil, ol satjoquel heb'. Manhxa b'aj ol cheklaj jab'ok heb'.
Ha jantak sb'eyumal lum Líbano ol ik'chajkot t'ayex: Aton te' taj, te' k'ub'taj yet' te' tzikap. Ol och te' swach'il yelwanub'ok in templo, yik ol wik'chaanh jun lugar chi' b'aj ol in ajok.

Masanil yinhtilal heb' ix ex ixtan chi', ol jawok heb' yak'em sb'a t'ayex. Masanil heb' ix ex chakaneli, ol ul em kuman heb' t'ayex, ol yalan heb' t'ayex icha tik: Ha ex aj chonhab' Sion ex tik, yiknhej Jehová eyaji, aton sDiosal Israel Axonhej Ochi, xcham heb'.
Wach'chom aktab'il ex kan t'a peka', chakb'il ex eli, manhxa mach tzek' b'aj ek'nak ex chi', palta haxo tiknaik, ol wak' eyik'jichaanh yet' he b'inajnaquilal yuj masanil chonhab' t'a junelnhej.

Ha juntzanh nakión chi', ol yak' he wael heb' te wach', haxo heb' sreyal heb', ol yik'kot sb'eyumal heb', ol ex yak'an serwil heb', icha syutej junok ix nunab'il yak'an chunok yune'. Icha chi' ol aj eyojtakaneli to a in Jehová he Diosal in, he Kolumal waji, a in sDiosal in winhaj Jacob, tzex in kolo'.

Ol in k'ex masanil tas ay t'ayex: Ha k'een oro ol wak' sk'exulok k'een bronke, haxo k'een plata ol wak' sk'exulok k'een hierro. Ha k'een bronke ol wak' sk'exulok te te', haxo k'een hierro chi' ol wak' sk'exulok k'een komon k'een. Ha heb' eyajalil, t'a stojolal ol ex sch'olb'itej heb', yuj chi' junk'olal ol ex ajok.

Ha t'a he lu'um chi', manhxa milojcham anima, owal yet' jantak chukal ol ujok. Manhxa tas ol satel t'a yol he makb'en chi' yuj owal. Ha in ol ex in kol icha junok muro, ol in eyik'chaanh yujto ix ex in kolo'.
Manhxalaj ol och yok k'u eyuuj, ma yok k'een uj t'ak'walil, yujto a in Jehová sakil k'inal ol in aj t'ayex t'a junelnhej. Ha in he Diosal in tik ol ex wak' b'inajok.

Ha jun sakil k'inal ol wak' t'ayex chi', a ol ochkan sk'exulok yok k'u yet' yok k'een uj. Ha jun chi', malaj b'ak'uinh ol tupok, yujto a in Jehová in sakil k'inal ol in aj t'ayex t'a junelnhej. Manhxa b'ak'uinh ol ex kusok.
Masanil heb' eyetchonhab', wach'nhej ol aj spensar heb'. Ol yiquejpax slum heb' t'a junelnhej. Lajan ol aj heb' icha swol junok te' awb'en te' awab'il wuuj. Ol in k'ulej jun chi' yuj wik'jichaanh.

Ha heb' quennhej sb'isul t'a he kal, ol q'uib' wal sb'isul heb', te tek'an ol aj heb' icha junok niwan chonhab'. Ayic ol k'och stiempoal yelk'och juntzanh tik, a in wal Jehová in ol wak'elk'och t'a elanhchamel, xchi Jehová chi'.

Ha Yespíritu Jehová Cajalil ayoch t'ayin, yujto sik'b'il in el yuj. Chekb'il in kot yuj, yik tzul walel wach' ab'ix t'a heb' meb'a', swak'an stek'anil heb' manhxa yip yuj kusk'olal, swalan t'a heb' icha preso yaji to syal yel heb' t'a libre.
Swalanpaxeli to ix ja sk'ual ko kolchaj yuj Jehová ko Diosal, sk'ual pax yak'anek' ko pak t'a heb' kajk'ool. Ix in chekjikoti yik swak'an sniwanil sk'ol heb' kusk'olal yaji.

Tzin jawipax wak' tzalajk'olal t'a heb' aj Sion kusk'olal yaji, aton heb' syak'k'e k'een tik'aq'uil taanh t'a sjolom, a tzalajk'olal swak' sk'exulok ok'el. Ha b'it yik aloj wach' lolonel swak'kanoch sk'exulok ilk'olal. Lajan ol aj heb' icha junok te' ji awab'il yuj Jehová, yik sb'eyb'alej tojolal heb' yuj yik'anchaanh Jehová chi' heb'.
Ha juntzanh chonhab' satnaqueli, ol sb'oxik'e heb', ol sb'oanpaxk'e juntzanh pat heb' mak'b'ilem lanhnaj t'a peka'.
Ex wetchonhab', a heb' ch'ok nakional ol tanhwan nok' he kalnel, he munlajel yet' eyawb'en uwa.
Ol yalan heb' to sakerdote ex Jehová, schekab' ex ko Diosal. Ol ex tzalaj yet' sb'eyumal juntzanhxo nakión chi'. Wach' ol aj eyilji yuj tastak wach' yilji ol yak' heb' t'ayex.
Ha ex tik, icha wal ix aj eyab'an syail, q'uixwelal yet' b'uchwal, icha pax chi' ol aj he chaan he b'eyumal yet' he tzalajk'olal, malaj slajwub'.

Yujto a wal tojolal snib'ej Jehová, skot yowal yuj elk'al yet' ixtoj anima. Yuj chi' wal t'a smojal ol aj spakan t'a heb' ix ex ixtani. Ol lajwok chi', ol sb'oan jun strato eyed'ok t'a masanil tiempo.
Ol b'inaj wal eyinhtilal t'a skal masanil chonhab'. Masanil mach ol ex ilanok, ol nachajel yuj heb' to a Jehová tz'ak'an swach'k'olal t'ayex.

Tzin te tzalaj wal tiknaik yuj Jehová, tzin k'e wal chaanh in tzalaj yuj in Diosal, yujto te wach' ix yutej yak'an in kolnab'il yet' tojolal, ichato ix och in pichulok yuj. Icha swach'il tz'ajoch spichul junok winh quelem yet' junok ix kob'es ayik snupnaj heb', icha chi' in yutej.
Icha tz'aj sk'eul tas sq'uib' t'a sat lu'um, ma icha yelta swol junok te te', icha chi' ol aj yak'an cheklaj tojolal Jehová Kajal t'a yichanh masanil nakión yuj yik'jichaanh.

Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Yuj wal to tzex in xajanej ex aj Sion, yuj chi' manh ol in em numan. Yuj wal to tzex in xajanej ex aj Jerusalén, yuj chi' manh ol wik'laj wip masanto ol cheklajel he tojolal icha yik sq'uinhib'i, haxo he kolnab'il, ol cheklajel icha yajoch sk'ak'al te' taj t'a k’ik’ k’inal.
Masanil nakión ol och k'elan yilan he tojolal. Masanil heb' rey, ol och k'elan heb' yilan sniwanil eyelk'ochi. Yuj chi' ol ak'chajoch junxo eyak' b'i. Ha in Jehová in tik ol wak'ochi.
Icha scheklajel sniwanil yelk'och junok winh rey yuj skorona, icha chi' ol aj wak'an cheklaj sniwanil welk'ochi, yujto ayex ek' t'a yol in k'ab'.

Manhxo ol he kuch “Aktab'ilkani”, manhxo ol alchajpax t'a he lum tik, “Satb'ileli”, palta to ol he kuch: “Nib'ab'il”. Axo lum he lu'um ol skuchkan: “Nupnajnac,” yujto nib'ab'il ex wuuj. Yajal waj t'a lum he lu'um tik.

Yujto icha wal junok winh quelem snupnaj yet' junok ix kob'es, icha chi' ol in aj eyed'ok, ol in ochxok eyed'ok, ol in tzalaj eyed'ok, icha stzalaj junok winh quelem yet' yetb'eyum, icha chi' ol in tzalaj eyed'ok.
Ex aj Jerusalén, ix wak'kanoch he tanhwumal t'a yib'anh smuroal he chonhab'. D'a k'ual t'ak'wal ol yal heb' icha tik: Ha ex tzex awaj t'a Jehová, manh ex och waan eyawaj t'ay.
Manh he cha yik' yip Jehová, masanto ol sb'oxik'e Jerusalén tik, yik wach' masanil heb' anima t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, ol yal wach' lolonel heb' t'ay, xcham heb', xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová toxo ix yak' sti', ol yak'elk'och tas ix yal chi' yuj spoder. Ix yalan icha tik: Manhxa b'ak'uinh ol in cha swab'at he trigo heb' ajk'ool, manhok heb' ch'ok nakional ol uk'anb'at he wino, aton tastak tzeyik' t'a he munlajel.
Palta to a ex wal ol he mol sat eyawb'en, ol he waani, ol eyalan wach' lolonel t'ayin yuj. Ol he molanpax sat eyuwa, ol eyuk'an yal eyuwa chi' t'a yol yamaq'uil in templo, xchi Jehová.

Ex aj Jerusalén, elanhek t'a spuertail he chonhab', b'oekb'at sb'e heb' eyetchonhab' wan sjaxi. Panhan tzeyutej b'aj ch'olquixtak, tzeyik'anel k'een k'een t'a yol b'e chi'. Tzeyak'ank'e junok bandera yik sch'oxan t'a juntzanhxo nakión b'ajtil ay jun b'e chi'.
Ha Jehová tz'alan t'a heb' kajan b'aj slajwik'och yol yib'anhk’inal tik: Alec t'a heb' aj Sion icha tik: Ilecnab' sjawi he Kolumal, yet'nak tas ix yik' yuj smunlajel, xe chi, xchi Jehová.
Ha heb' israel, ol alchajok to schonhab' Dios yaj heb', sik'b'ilel heb', aton masanil heb' ix kolji yuj Jehová. Ha Jerusalén ol skuch Chonhab' Nib'ab'il, Manhxo Aktab'ilokkani.

--¿Mach jun skot t'a niwan chonhab' Bosra, t'a yol smakb'en Edom, chakchak spichul ayochi, te ayxo smay yilji, yet'nak wal yip skoti? Ix tak'wi Jehová icha tik: --Ha in Jehová in tzin jawi, ay in poder in kolwaji. Swalanpaxi to ol in ch'olb'itej yaj t'a stojolal, xchi.
--¿Tas yuj chakchak yilji a pichul, ichato ach tek'wiel yal sat uwa? xin chi t'ay.

Ix yalani: --Yujto ix in tek'em juntzanh nakión icha stek'jiel yal sat uwa. Ha innhej, malaj junokxo nakión ix och wed'ok. Aycot wowal ix in tek'anem heb' wajk'ool, yujto aykot yowal in k'ool t'a heb'. Icha chi' ix aj yoch chititok schiq'uil heb' t'ayin, ix chik'ax in pichul tik.
Yujto ix in na' to ix jawi sk'ual in kolanel in chonhab', swak'anpax spak t'a heb' ajk'ool.

Ix in ek' k'elelok, tato ay mach skolwaj wed'ok. Palta ix satk'e in k'ool, yujto malaj mach tz'och wed'ok. Yuj chi' a wal yuj yowal in k'ol ix in tek'b'an in b'a, yuj chi' ix yal in kolan in chonhab' in ch'okoj.
Yed' wal yowal in k'ool, ix in tek'anem masanil nakión. Ix in satanel heb' yet' wowal, ix b'ey wal schiq'uil heb' wuj t'a sat lu'um, xchi Jehová.

In gana swaleli jantak tzonh xajanej Jehová, tzin b'itan wal jantak tas ix sk'ulej kuuj. Tzonh xajanej a onh yinhtilal onh Israel tik. Jantac tas ix sk'ulej kuuj, ix ok'xi sk'ol t'ayonh, yujto te xajan onh yuj.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Ha juntzanh anima tik, in chonhab' heb', wuninal heb', manhxo ol meltzajoch heb' ajk'olal t'ayin, xchi. Yuj chi' ix koljiel heb' yuj Jehová chi'

t'a masanil syaelal. Manh ch'okok mach ix schekb'at skol heb', palta a wal ix sch'ox sb'a icha ángel yik skolan heb'. Yujto xajan heb' yuj, tz'ok' sk'ol t'a heb', yuj chi' ix kolji heb' yuj. Ix quetzjib'ey heb' yuj, ichataxon sk'ulej yet' heb'.
Palta te pit ix yutej sb'a heb' t'ay, ix yak'an kus Yespíritu Jehová chi' heb', aton Espíritu Axonhej Ochi. Yuj chi' ix meltzajoch ajk'olal t'a heb', ix yak'an owal yet' heb'.

Yuj chi', ix snaankot heb' tas ujinak t'a peka', t'a stiempoal winhaj Moisés. Ix sk'anb'an heb' icha tik: ¿B'ajtil ay Jehová koljinak heb' ko mam quicham t'ha ha' mar, stanhwumal pax heb'? ¿B'ajtil ay jun yak'nakoch Yespíritu Axonhej Och t'a heb'?
Aton jun sch'oxnak spoder t'a winhaj Moisés. Ha Jehová pojjinak snanhal ha' mar t'a yichanh heb' schonhab', yik sb'inajnhej sb'i heb' t'a junelnhej.
Ha ik'annak ek' heb' schonhab' t'a yich ha' mar chi'. Maj el nhernaj heb', icha yek' nok' chej t'a tzinan lu'um, xchi heb'.

Ha Yespíritu Jehová ik'annak b'ey heb' schonhab' chi', yik syak'an yik' yip heb', icha syak' nok' wakax tz'ik'jiem wael t'a lum ak'liktak. Icha chi' yutejnak yik'an b'ey heb' schonhab' chi', yik sb'inaj yuj sniwanil yelk'ochi.

Mamin Jehová, ilonhkot t'a jun ed'tal to iknhej yaji, aton satcha’anh b'aj kajan ach, b'aj manh jantakok swach'il. ¿B'aq'uinhto ol a ch'ox a wach'k'olal yet' ipalil chi'? ¿B'aq'uinh ol ok'xok a k'ool t'ayonh? ¿Mato ix lajwi a niwank'olal chi' t'ayonh?
Ha ach tik, ko Mam ach. Wach'chom a winhaj Abraham yet' winhaj Israel manh onh yojtakok heb', palta a ach tik ko Mam ach, toxonton ko Kolumal ach.

Mamin ¿tas yuj tzonh ik'kanel t'a yol a b'e, tzak'an pitb'oquel ko pensar yik manhxa elk'och t'ayonh? Ak'xi a wach'k'olal t'ayonh a chekab' onh tik, a onh yinhtilal onh kan heb' a chonhab' to iknhej yaji.
Ha onh a chonhab' onh tik, sik'b'il onh el uuj, jayenhej ab'il ix ko kaj lum ko lu'um, haxo tiknaik, a heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayonh ix tek'anem a templo.
Ichato malaj b'aj tzak' yajalil t'ayonh, ichato malaj b'aj sb'inaji to ik onh. Ichnhejta' kaji.
Mamin, komonok tza jak satcha’anh tzach emta t'a sat lu'um tik, yik tz'ib'xi lum niwak witz t'a ichanh,
icha tz'aj xejk'e ha ha' yuj te' k'ak' ow yajochi. Emanhcoti yik tzach yojtaquejel heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach, yik tz'ib'xik'e niwak chonhab' t'a ichanh yuj xiwelal.
Comonoc tza k'ulej icha a k'ulejnak t'a peka'. Ayic emnakul chi', a k'ulannak tastak manh naanok kuuj, te satub'tak yilji. Ha lum niwak witz ib'xinakk'e lum t'a ichanh.
Atax t'a peka' chi', malaj b'aj tz'ab'chaji, malaj b'aj tz'ilchaj junokxo Dios sk'ulan icha tas tza k'ulej yuj swach'ilok heb' tzach ak'anoch t'a sk'ool.

D'a tzalajk'olal tza cha heb' wach'nhej tas sk'ulej, naannhej yuj heb' sk'ulan tas tza nib'ej. Ha achxo tzak'kot yowal a k'ol t'ayonh, yujto ix och ko mul t'ayach, sko k'ulannhej chukal. ¿Tzatom yal ko kolchaji?

Co masanil, lajan onh t'a yol a sat icha mach manh wach'ok icha yalan ley. Masanil tas wach' sko k'ulej kalani, lajan icha junok k'apak k'apak miktak. Yuj ko chukal, yuj chi' lajan onh icha te' taquinh xil te' tz'ik'jib'at yuj ik'.
Malaj junok onh sko k'an a kolwal, maxtzak ko nakot ko k'och t'ayach, yujto tza k'ub'ejel a b'a t'ayonh, tzonh aktankan t'a yol sk'ab' ko chukal.
Palta a ach tik Mamin Jehová, ko mam ach. Ha onh tik, icha lum tz'akb'il lum kaji, a achxo tik, ichato ko tz'akumal aji, a ach a b'onak onh ko masanil.
Mamin, mokab' te kot owal t'ayonh. Manhxookab' a nanhejkot ko chukal. Ina to a chonhab' onh.
Ha juntzanh chonhab' ik yaji, toxo ix kan tzinan, toxo ix lanhchajkanem Jerusalén, manhxalaj mach kajan t'ay.
Ha a templo te wach' yilji to iknhej yaji, aton b'aj ochnak heb' ko mam quicham ejmelal t'ayach, toxo ix lajwiem stz'ab'ati. Ha tas te nib'ab'il kuuj, aton a templo chi', toxo ix lajwieli.
Mamin Jehová, ayik tzilan masanil juntzanh tik, ¿tom malaj tas ol a k'ulej yuj? ¿Tom ol ak'nhejoch ko yaelal?

Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Ix wak' in b'a yojtaquejel heb' max in k'anb'aneq'ui. Ix in ch'ox in b'ha t'a heb' max yal sb'a t'ayin. Ha t'a heb' max in k'anb'anek' chi', ata' ix wala': Ina in tik, xin chi t'a heb'.
Masanil tiempo jekannhejb'at in k'ab' wawtankot jun chonhab' te pit, palta axonhej chukal snib'ej sk'ulej.
Val t'a wichanh sk'ulej chukal heb', syak'an silab' heb' t'a juntzanh skomon diosal t'a skaltak yawb'en te' heb', snhusan inkienso heb' t'a yib'anh altar b'ob'il yet' lum ladrillo.

Tz'em k'ojan heb' t'a skal b'ajtak mukan heb' chamnak. Tz'ek' ak'wal yuj heb' b'ajtak k'ub'eltak. Schi'an schib'ejal nok' chitam heb', syak'an b'ud'jok schen heb' yuj yal chib'ej to ay yowalil yuj ley.

Syalan heb' icha tik: Cananh ta', manh a nitzkot a b'a t'ayonh, yujto ch'okxo quel t'ayach, xchi heb' t'ayin. Tzin tzaktzaj wal yuj juntzanh anima tik, lajan wal tas sk'ulej heb' icha stab'il te' k'ak' ayochi tzek' k'u, sb'at t'a yol ko nhi'.
Palta masanil juntzanh schukal heb' chi', tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a wichanh, manh tonhejok ol wilochi. Ol wak' spak t'a heb' icha wal smojal.

Yuj wal schukal heb' chi' yet' schukal heb' smam yicham heb', stzuntzejnakkot wowal heb', ayik snhusannak silab' heb' t'a jolomtak witz. Yuj chi' ol in ch'olb'itej yaj heb', ol wak'an spak t'a heb' icha wal smojal, xchi Jehová.

Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Ha junok k'ojlab' sat uwa ayto yalil, max yixtej heb' anima, yujto ayto yalil wach' yik'anel heb' t'ay. Icha chi' ol in k'ulej, manh ol in satel masanil in chonhab', yujto tzin xajanej heb' in chekab'.
Ol waktejkan jaywanhokxo heb' yinhtilal Jacob, yik wach' ayto anima ol kajnaj t'a lum lum t'a yol yik Judá. Ha heb' in chekab' sik'b'ilel wuj chi', ol kajnaj heb' ta', ol yikan lum heb'.
Ha t'a spanhanil lum Sarón, manhxo jantakok nok' kalnel ol ajok, haxo t'a yak'likal chonhab' Acor ol wa nok' wakax, aton nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' in chonhab' tz'och ejmelal t'ayin.

Palta manh ichokta' ol wak' t'ayex mach ex ix eyik'kanel he b'a t'ayin. Ha jun tzalan b'aj tz'och ejmelal t'ayin, ix b'atkan satk'olal eyuuj, axonhej t'a juntzanh komon Dios skuch Gad yet' Meni tzeyak' wael yet' wino silab'il, aton juntzanh komon Dios tz'alani tas ol ex ajok yet' tas ol jawok t'a eyib'anh eyalani.

Yuj chi' a in swala' tas ol jawok t'a eyib'anh. Chuclaj tas wan ex stanhwani. Ha k'een espada ol ex milancham wuuj, ol ex em kuman, ol tzepchajel he jolom. Yujto ix ex wawtej, palta maj ex tak'wok t'ayin, ix in lolon t'ayex, palta maj he cha eyab'i. Ix he k'ulej juntzanh chukal max scha in k'ool.
Yuj chi' a heb' in chekab' ay tas swa heb', a exxo tik ol ex cham yuj wejel. Ay tas ol yuk'ej heb', a exxo tik ol ex cham yuj taquinhtial. Ol tzalaj heb', a exxo tik q'uixwelal ol ex ajkanok.
Ol b'itan heb' yuj tzalajk'olal, a exxo tik, ol ex ok' yuj kusk'olal yuj yaelal.
Ha heb' sik'b'ilel wuj chi', ol ex yak' b'inaj heb' ayik ol skatab'an junokxo anima heb'. Ol ex in sateli, palta ha t'a heb' in chekab' ol wak' jun ak' b'i yik syak' b'inaj heb'.

Yalnhej mach t'a jun chonhab' tik sk'an wach'ilal t'a yib'anh, a t'ayin ol sk'ana', a in Dios in swak'elk'och tas swala'. Yalnhej mach syak' sti' t'a junok tasi, a in b'i ol yak' b'inajok. Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', jantak yaelal toxo ix ek'b'ati, ol b'atkan satk'olal, manhxo ol in nakoti.
Ab'ek, ol in b'o jun ak' satcha’anh yet' jun ak' yol yib'anhk’inal. Ha tastak ek'nakxo, ol b'atkan satk'olal, manhxa b'ak'uinh ol nachajkotok.
Tzalajanhec t'a masanil tiempo yuj tas ol in k'ulej, yujto ol in b'oxik'e chonhab' Jerusalén b'aj ay tzalajk'olal, a heb' anima kajan ta' ol tzalaj heb' wuuj.
Ol in tzalajpax wal yuj in chonhab' Jerusalén chi', manhxa b'ak'uinh ol ab'chaj yel yaw heb' anima yuj yaelal ta'.

Malaj heb' unin jayenhej k'ual ol ek' ta' ol chamok, malaj pax heb' icham anima manto k'och yab'ilal ol chamok. Tato ay mach scham t'a 100 ab'il sk'inal, unin animato schami. Ha mach ol chamok ayik manto k'och t'a 100 ab'il chi', a yuj schukal spet chami.
Ha heb' in chonhab' chi' ol laj sb'o spat heb', ol kajnaj heb' t'a yool. Ol yawej yuwa heb', manh ch'okok mach ol loan sat.

Manhxo tonhejok ol sb'ok'e spat heb', ch'okxo mach ol aj t'a yool. Manh ol yawej yawb'en heb', ch'okxopax mach ol loan sat. Ha heb' in chonhab' chi', ol najatb'ok sk'inal heb' icha sk'inal te te'. Ha heb' sik'b'ilel wuuj chi', najtil ol yak' tzalajb'ok sk'ol heb' yet' smunlajel.

Ha heb' in chonhab' chi', manh nab'anhejok ol munlaj heb', manh ol cham yuninal heb' wanto sq'uib'i. Yujto a in chonhab' chi', a heb' anima wak'nakkan in wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh a in Jehová in tik, a heb' ay yinhtilal heb'. Icha chi' ol aj pax heb' yuninal heb'.
Ayic manto in yawtej heb', toxo ix in tak'wi t'a heb', ayik manto lajwi yalan heb', toxo ix wab' tas syal heb'.

Ha nok' oques yet' nok' kalnel, junnhej ol wa nok'. Ha nok' choj, a anh ank'ultak ol sk'ux nok' ichok nok' wakax. Axo nok' chan, a lum pokok ol slo nok'. Ha t'a in tzalan b'aj tz'och ejmelal t'ayin, malaj junok tas ol yal yixtani. Ha in wal swala', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Ha satcha’anh in despacho yaji, haxo sat lu'um tik sb'akhnub' wok yaji. Ha exxo tik, ¿b'ajtil ol he b'ok'e junok in pat b'aj wach' tzin aji?

Ha in Jehová in swala' to a in wal in b'onak juntzanh tastak ix wak' b'inaj tik, icha chi' ajnak spitzwichaanh smasanil. Ha heb' te emnaquil yaji, a in ol in tanhwej heb', aton heb' skus yuj smul, heb' ay yelk'och in lolonel t'ay.

Ay ex tzex tzalaj he k'ulan juntzanh tastak yajb'entak t'a wichanh. Yuj chi' ayik tze milancham nok' wakax silab'il t'ayin, ha t'a in sat ichato a junok anima tze milchamok. Ayic tze milancham nok' kalnel silab'il t'ayin, ha t'a in sat ichato a sjaj nok' tz'i' tze ch'umeli. Ayic tzeyak'an sat eyawb'en ofrendail t'ayin, ha t'a in sat ichato a schiq'uil nok' chitam tze tob'emi. Ayic tze nhusan inkienso t'ayin, ha t'a in sat ichato ha t'a komon Dios tzeyal wach' lolonel.

Yuj chi' toxo ix in na' tas yaelal ol jawok t'a eyib'anh. Ha tas b'aj te k'un he xiwi, a chi' ol wak'kot t'ayex, yujto ix ex wawtej, palta malaj mach ix tak'wi t'ayin. Ix in lolon t'ayex, palta maj he cha eyab'i, ix he k'ulan chukal. Ix he k'ulan juntzanh tas max schalaj in k'ool, xchi Jehová.

Ha ex tze cha eyab'i, ab'ek wal tas syal Jehová: Ay juntzanh heb' eyetchonhab' schichon sk'ol t'ayex, tzex spechanb'eyek' heb', yujto tzeyal he b'a t'ayin, syalan heb' icha tik: Sch'oxokab' stziquiquial Jehová chi', squil jab'ok he tzalaji, xchi heb'. Palta a heb' chi', te q'uixwelal ol ajkan heb', xchi Jehová.
Ab'ek jun nhilili sk'an skot t'a chonhab' chi', sk'anh skotpax t'a templo. Aton Jehová sk'anh skoti, yik syak'an spak t'a heb' ajk'ol t'a smojal.
Syalan Jehová icha tik: Ha chonhab' Sion, lajan wal icha junok ix ix mantalaj syail yune' skoti, tz'alji yune' ix chi'.

¿Tom ay mach ix ab'ani, mato ay mach ix ilan jun chi'? ¿Tom ay junok chonhab' junnhej k'ual tz'och nakional? ¿Tom ay junok chonhab' junnhej k'ual sb'oi? Palta a Sion tik, quennhej ol yab' syail ol ochxok nakional.
¿Tom ol yal in yamanoch waan jun wan yalji, yujto a in swak' aljok? Maay. Manh ol yalpaxlaj in tenanek' spitzwixi jun chonhab' tik. Ha in Jehová he Diosal in swala', icha chi' ol ajok.
Ha ex tze xajanej Jerusalén, tzalajanhek yet'ok. Ha ex ok'nak ex yuj ayik yab'annak syail, mol tzalajanhek yet'ok.
Yujto a Jerusalén chi', lajan icha junok ix nunab'il smontej yune', syak'an yim, icha chi' ol aj yak'an sniwanil he k'ool, masanto ol ex tzalaj yuj, yujto niwan wach'ilal ol scha Jerusalén chi'.

Ha in Jehová in swala': Ol wak'b'at wach'ilal t'a skal heb' anima t'a jun chonhab' tik. Ol yik'kot sb'eyumal juntzanhxo nakión t'ay. Icha sjawi junok ha' eluma', icha chi' ol aj sjawi. Icha junok nene' unin nib'ab'il ol ex utajok, ichato ol ex chunok, ol ex cheljok, ichato ol ex chenchenan t'a sat xub'.
Icha junok ix nunab'il smontej yune', icha chi' ol aj ex in montani. Icha chi' ol aj eyik'an sniwanil he k'ol t'a Jerusalén, xchi Jehová.

Ayic ol eyilan juntzanh tik, ol ex te tzalajok. Ol eyik'xi eyipok, icha tz'aj syaxb'ixi anh ank'ultak. Yujto ol sch'ox spoder Jehová t'a skal heb' schekab', haxo yowal sk'ol ol yak' t'a heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ay.
Yujto a Jehová ol jawok t'a kal k'ak', a skarruaje lajan icha chakxuxum ik'. Ol jawok yak'och yowal sk'ol t'a heb' ajk'ol icha sk'e nhilnhon yok te' k'ak'.
Ha yet' k'ak' yet' yespada Jehová, ol sch'olb'itej masanil anima t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, tzijtum heb' ol cham yuj.

Ha wal Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha heb' tz'och ejmelal t'a komon Dios t'a skaltak te' awb'en te', stzalaj heb' sk'ulan icha sk'ulej mach skuchb'an heb', schi'an nok' chitam heb', nok' ch'oow yet' juntzanhxo nok' nok' yajb'entak, junnhej ol satel heb' smasanil.
Yuj tastak sna heb' yet' tastak sk'ulej heb', ol in molb'ej masanil anima t'a junjun ti'al, t'a junjun chonhab', ol in ch'oxan in poder yil heb'.

Ol in ch'oxan in poder t'a heb' olto kanok, ol in chekanb'at heb' t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' tik: Aton t'a Tarsis, t'a Fut, t'a Lud b'aj kajan heb' jelan sjulwaj t'a jul-lab'. Ol in chekanpaxb'at heb' t'a Tubal, t'a Javán yet' t'a juntzanh chonhab' najat t'a stitak ha' mar b'aj manh ab'chajnakok in b'inaji yet' b'aj manh ilb'ilok in poder. Ol b'at yalel yab'ixal sniwanil welk'och heb' t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi'.

Ha in Jehová in swala' to t'a masanil chonhab', ol ik'jokkot masanil heb' eyetchonhab' ayek' t'a skal heb'. Ay heb' ol ik'jokkot t'a yib'anh nok' chej, t'a yol karruaje, t'a yib'anh b'akhlab', t'a yib'anh nok' mula yet' t'a yib'anh nok' kamello. Icha junok silab' ol aj sjawi heb' t'a tzalan b'aj tz'och ejmelal t'ayin t'a Jerusalén tik. Icha tz'aj yik'ankot junok ofrenda heb' in chonhab' t'a in templo t'a yol junok yet'tal te wach', icha chi' ol aj yik'chajkot heb'.
Ha t'a skal juntzanh heb' ixto kani, ata' ol in sik'el heb' ol och sakerdoteal yet' lewitail, xchi Jehová.
Syalanpax Jehová icha tik: Ha ak' satcha’anh yet' ak' yol yib'anhk’inal ol in b'o'o, ol ajnhejek' t'a junelnhej. Icha chi' ol aj eyajnhejeq'ui, ol ex b'inaj yet' eyinhtilal t'a junelnhej.
Junjun sk'ual ik'oj ip t'a junjun semana yet' juntak el tz'alji k'een uj, ol jawok masanil heb' anima, ol ul em kuman heb' t'ayin.

Ayic tz'elta heb' in chonhab', ol yilan sniwanil heb' chamnak heb', aton heb' pit yutejnak sb'a t'ayin. Aynhejoch nok' ha'ay schianb'at sniwanil heb' chi', haxo k'ak' wan snhusantz'a heb', malaj b'ak'uinh stupi. Yajb'entak yilji heb' t'a sat masanil anima tz'ilani, xchi Jehová.

Ha in Jeremías in tik, yuninal in winhaj Hilcías, yinhtilal in heb' sakerdote kajan t'a chonhab' Anatot t'a yol smakb'en lum Benjamín. Aton t'a jun tik tz'ib'ab'ilkan tas ix yal Jehová t'ayin yik swaleli.
Ix el yich slolon Jehová t'ayin ayik 13 ab'il yoch winhaj Josías yuninal winhaj Amón reyal t'a Judá.

Ix lolonnhej t'ayin ayik ayoch winhaj Joacim yuninal winhaj Josías chi' reyal t'a Judá. Ix lolonnhej pax t'ayin masanto ayik yoil ujal yoch yuxluchil ab'il yoch winhaj Sedequías reyal, yuninal pax winhaj Josías chi'. Ata' ix ik'jib'at heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén icha preso t'a Babilonia.
Ayic ix el yich slolon Jehová t'ayin, ix yalan icha tik:
Ach Jeremías, yiktax manto ach wak' pitzwok t'a a nun, sik'b'ilachxoel wuuj. Ayic manto ach alji, sik'b'ilachxoel wuuj yik tzach och in chekab'ok t'a juntzanh chonhab', xchi t'ayin.
Ix in tak'wi icha tik: Mamin Jehová, ach Vajalil, unin into. Maxto nachaj tas swutej in loloni, xin chi.
Ix yalanxi Jehová chi' t'ayin: Manh ala' to unin ach. Anhej to ol ach b'at b'aj ol ach in chekb'ati, ol alan tas ol in chek ala'.
Malaj mach b'aj tzach xiwi. Ha in Jehová in swala' to ayinnhejoch ed'ok yik tzach in kolani, xchi t'ayin.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'ankot sk'ab', ix yak'anoch t'a in ti', ix yalan t'ayin:

Aton wal tiknaik swak'och in lolonel t'a a ti'. Tzach in chekb'at t'a juntzanh chonhab' yik tzalan yab' heb' to ol jawok yaelal t'a yib'anh heb', ol satel heb', ol lajwoquem heb'. Ay chonhab' chi' ol satel t'a junelnhej, ay pax ol b'ochajxik'eok, xchi Jehová.
Ix lolonxi Jehová t'ayin, ix yalani: ¿Tas tzil chi' ach Jeremías? xchi. Ha jun te' k'ab' almendro swila', xin chi.
Yel tzala'. Ol wilnhej to a tas swal tik t'ayach ol elk'och t'a elanhchamel, xchi Jehová chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová chi' t'ayin t'a schaelal: ¿Tas tzil chi'? xchi t'ayin. Swil jun lum chen wan xeji, wan stob'kot t'a stojolal norte, xin chi t'ay.
Ix yalanxi t'ayin: Ha t'a norte chi', ata' ol kot yaelal ol jawok t'a yib'anh masanil heb' anima kajan t'a tik.

Ha in Jehová in tik swal t'ayach to ol laj wawtejkot jantak soldado skot t'a juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a norte. Ol oymaj heb' t'a spatiktak chonhab' Jerusalén tik yet' t'a spatiktak juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a smakb'en Judá. Ol jawok sreyal heb', ol sb'oanem sdespacho heb' t'a spuertail Jerusalén tik.

Aton jun yaelal tik ol wak'kot t'a yib'anh heb' anima ix och smul t'ayin. Ix in yaktejkan heb', haxo t'a juntzanh komon Dios ix sb'o heb', ata' ix och heb' ejmelal. Ix snhusanpaxtz'a inkienso heb' t'ay.
Ha tiknaik ak' ip, tek'b'ej a b'a, b'at alan masanil tas ol in chek ala'. Manh ach xiw t'a heb' etanimail chi'. Tato ol ach xiwok, ol ach wak' ib'xokk'e t'a yichanh heb'.

Ha tiknaik tzach wak'och icha junok chonhab' te tek'an, icha wal junok oy nab'a hierro, ma icha muro nab'a bronke. Yuj chi' ol yal a tek'b'an a b'ha t'a yichanh chonhab' Judá, t'a yichanh heb' rey, heb' yajal, heb' sakerdote yet' t'a yichanh masanil anima.
Ol yak' owal heb' chi' ed'ok, palta a in wal Jehová in swala' to manh ol ach telwok yuj heb', yujto ayinnhejoch ed'ok ach in kolani, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:

Ixic, b'at alan yab' heb' aj Jerusalén to a in Jehová in swal t'a heb' icha tik: Tzin nawalkoti ayik ex wak'anoch in chonhab'ok. Ix in he k'anab'ajej wal, ix in he xajanej wal, icha junok ix kob'es toto snupnaji xajanan winh yetb'eyum. Ix ex ochwal tzak'an wuj t'a tzinan lu'um, t'a lum malaj b'aj tz'awchaj tas t'ay.
Ayic chi' wiknhej eyaj a ex israel ex tik, icha wal b'ab'el sat awb'en. Ha in Jehová in swala' to yalnhej mach heb' ex ixtani, ix och smul heb', ix wak'kot yaelal t'a yib'anh heb', xchi t'ayin.
E masanil ex yinhtilalkan winhaj Jacob, aton winhaj Israel, maklejek eyab' tas syal Jehová.

Syalan t'ayex icha tik: ¿Tas in paltail ix yil heb' he mam eyicham? ¿Tas yuj ix in spatiquejkanel heb', haxo t'a komon Dios malaj yelk'och b'aj ix yal sb'a heb'? Yuj chi' manhxalaj jab'ok ix ajkan yelk'och heb'.
Majxo in snakot heb', wach'chom a in ix wik'elta heb' t'a Egipto, ix wik'an b'ey heb' t'a lum tzinan lu'um, lum taquinh sat, lum pak'quiltak, lum malaj mach kajan t'ay, lum malaj mach tzek' t'a sat.

Ha in ix wak'och heb' t'a lum te yax sat tik, b'aj te ay tas wach' syab'lej heb'. Palta a exxo yinhtilal ex heb' tik, ex kajan ex t'a sat in lu'um tik, ix eyixtejb'at lu'um yuj he chukal, yuj chi' maxtzak scha in k'ol jun in lu'um tik.

Ha heb' sakerdote maxtzak in snakot heb'. Ha heb' tzex k'ayb'ani, maxtzak in yojtaquejel heb'. Ha heb' yajal yaj t'a he chonhab', smeltzajoch heb' ajk'olal t'ayin, haxo heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok, a sb'i Baal syalel heb'. Axo t'a komon Dios syal sb'a heb', aton juntzanh malaj jab'ok tas wach' syik' heb' t'ay, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanpax Jehová icha tik: Ha in Jehová in swala' to ol wak' owal eyed'ok yet' pax heb' eyinhtilal.

Ixiquec t'a chonhab' Chipre ay t'a snanhal ha' mar, t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, tzeyilan wal. Tze chekanb'at heb' he chekab' t'a chonhab' Cedar t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, sb'at yilan wal heb' tato ayxo b'aj tzuji icha wal jun tik.

¿Tom ay junok chonhab' skomon aktankan sdiosal, wach'chom a sdiosal heb' chi' manh Diosoc? Ha exxo ex in chonhab' ex tik, ix in eyaktejkani. Wach'chom a in ix ex wak' wal b'inajok, palta haxo t'a komon Dios malaj yelk'ochi, ata' tzeyal he b'a.
Yuj chi' a in Jehová in swala': Ex kajan ex t'a satcha’anh, satokab' he k'ool, cheklajokab' xiwelal t'a he sat yuj tas wan yuji tik.

Ha in chonhab' tik, cha makan smul ix och t'ayin: Ha in tik lajan in icha sjaj ha ha' sk'euli, palta ix in spatiquejeli. Ix sb'oanpax sdiosal lajan icha yet'tal ha ha' jateltakxo, maxtzak yal-laj skan waan ha' t'a yool, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanpax Jehová chi' icha tik: Ha ex in chonhab' Israel ex tik, manh chekab'ok eyajkaneli, palta ¿tas yuj tzex ixtaj icha tz'utaj heb' chekab'?
¿Tas yuj ix och heb' anima ajk'olal t'ayex? Icha yel yaw nok' choj icha chi' yel yaw heb' t'ayex. Ix kan tzinan he lu'um, ix tz'ab'at he chonhab'. Manhxa mach syal skajnaj t'ay.
Ha heb' soldado aj Menfis yet' heb' aj Tafnes yik Egipto, ix smak'poj he jolom heb'.
Aton wal juntzanh tik ix eyik'kot t'a eyib'anh, yujto ix in he patiquejel a in Jehová he Diosal in tik, yakb'an ix ex in kuchb'ej b'eyok.

Axo tiknaik ¿tas tzeyak' yala', yuj chi' tzex b'at he k'an skolwal heb' aj Egipto ay t'a sti' ha' Nilo? ¿Tas pax tzeyak' yala' yuj chi' tzex b'at he k'an skolwal heb' aj Asiria ay t'a sti' ha' Éufrates?

Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, a in swala': Ha wal he mul chi' ol ik'ankot eyaelal t'a eyib'anh. Ha he pitalil ol ak'anb'at t'a eyib'anh. Nachajokab'el eyuuj to te chuk ix he k'ulej yujto ix in he patiquejeli, a in Jehová he Diosal in. Ol wak'och yaelal t'a eyib'anh yujto malaj welk'och t'ayex, xchi Jehová.

Atax t'a peka' ix ex och ijan he pitan he b'a t'ayin. Maj yal he k'ol ix in he k'anab'ajej. Ix eyalani: Malaj ko gana tzach kak' serwil, xe chi. Axonhej ajmulal ix he k'ulej t'a tzalquixtak yet' t'a yichtak te te' k'ayum xiil.
Icha wal tz'aj yawchaj te' uwa te wach', icha chi' ix aj ex wawani, lajan ex icha yinhatil te' uwa te wach'. ¿Tas yuj lajanxonhej tzex ajkan icha te' kaltakte'al uwa?

Ha in wal Jehová in swala': Wach'chom tze komon b'iquejel he b'a yet' k'een yal taanh, mato niwan xapon tzeyak'ek' t'ayex, palta a he mul chi', chequel yajek' t'a in sat. Malaj b'ak'uinh syal he sakb'ikani.

Tze komon alan icha tik: Ha onh tik maj ko juel ko b'a kalan ko b'ha t'a komon Dios, xe chi. Naeccoti, tas ix eyutej he b'ha t'a lum ch'olquixtak. Tonhej tzex komon ek' jechechok icha junok nok' nun kamello sayanek' nok' smam.

Lajan ex wal icha junok nok' kaltakte'al nun b'uru k'ajan sb'eyek' b'aj malaj anima, suk'lan nok' tzek' nok' ayik wan stajni nok'. Malaj mach syal syaman wanaj nok'. Ayic stajni nok' chi', sekojtak tz'aj schax nok' yuj nok' mam b'uru chi'.

Ex israel, aktejek he b'eyek' he sayanek' he komon diosal. Nab'anhej slajwi eyok yet' stakji he ti' he b'eyeq'ui. Palta a ex tik tzeyala': Maay, ayoch ko pensar t'a juntzanh komon Dios, yuj chi' ol kalnhej ko b'a t'ay, xe chi.
Icha wal sq'uixwi junok elk'um ayik syamchajelta, icha wal chi' ol aj he q'uixwi a ex israel ex tik yet' heb' he reyal, heb' eyajal, heb' sakerdote yet' pax heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok.

Tzeyal t'a junok te te' icha tik: Mamin, xe chi t'a te'. Tzeyalanpax t'a junok k'een k'een: Nunin, xe chi. Axo pax t'ayin jun, a yich he patik tze meltzitejkoti. Maxtzac ex kot k'elan t'ayin. Axo wal yik tzeyilani to ay tas tzex ik'ani: Cotanh, kolwajanh, xe chi t'ayin.

Ex aj Judá, icha wal sb'isul he chonhab', icha chi' sb'isul he diosal. ¿B'ajtil ay juntzanh he komon diosal ix he b'o chi'? Cotokab' heb', ol quilani tato ol yal ex skolan heb' ayik ol jawok yaelal t'a eyib'anh.
Ha in wal Jehová in swala': ¿Tas in mul t'ayex yuj chi' tzeyalub'tanhej to max ex in kolo'? Ina he masanil tze pitej he b'a t'ayin.
Nab'anhej swak'och eyaelal, maxtzak yal pax he k'ol tze k'anab'ajej in k'ayb'ub'al. Lajan ex wal icha junok nok' choj te ow, tze milcham heb' in chekab' swak'b'at t'a he kal.

¿Tas animail eyaj a ex yinhtilal ex kan Israel? Maclejec eyab' tas swala'. ¿Tom malaj jab'ok tas swak' t'ayex? ¿Tom icha taquinh lu'um waj t'ayex, mato icha junok lum lum te ay smay? Ex in chonhab', ¿tas wal yuj tzeyal t'ayin icha tik: Munil quik ko b'a, malaj tzach och kuuj? xe chi.
¿Tom ol sat sk'ol junok ix kob'es t'a stonh, ma t'a spichul ayik sb'at ix t'a nupnajel? Palta a exxo pax in chonhab' ex tik, junjun k'u tzin b'atnhej satk'olal eyuuj.
Lajan ex icha heb' ix ajmul ix yojtak b'e b'aj sb'ati, ayik sayanek' heb' winh winak heb' ix. Sat k'ayb'um eyaj t'a chukal.
Te chik'tak he pichul yuj schiq'uil heb' meb'a' yet' heb' malaj smul. Tze milcham heb', wach'chom malaj b'aj tz'och heb' elk'al t'ayex.

Wach'chom tze k'ulej icha chi', palta tzeyalan icha tik: Ha onh tik, te wach' onh, malaj ko mul, manhxalaj yowal sk'ol Jehová t'ayonh, xe chi. Palta a in Jehová in tik ol wak'kot yaelal t'a eyib'anh, yujto tzeyala' to malaj he mul.

¿Tas yuj tze pech he b'a yik tze k'exan heb' tze nib'ej skolwaj eyed'ok? Icha wal ajnak yel he q'uixwelal yuj heb' aj Asiria, yujto maj ex skol heb', icha pax chi' ol aj yel he q'uixwelal yuj heb' aj Egipto.
Toxonhej nhojan ex em yuj q'uixwelal ayik ol ex meltzajkot t'a Egipto chi', yujto toxo ix in patiquejel heb' tzeyak'och yipok he k'ool chi'. Malaj tas ol eyak' yal yet' heb', xchi Jehová.

Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ex israel, tato ay junok ix ix spuk sb'a yet' winh yetb'eyum, syik'an junokxo winh ix, tato spukxi sb'a ix yet' winh schab'il chi', a winh yetb'eyum ix chi', maxtzak yal yik'lanxi sb'a winh yet' ix. Tato syik'lajxi sb'a heb' jun, a lum lum tik sjuwiel lum t'a yol in sat. Palta a in Jehová in tik swala' to lajan ix eyutej he b'a icha heb' ix ajmul ix tzijtum swinak, haxo tiknaik, tze nib'ej tzex meltzajxikot t'ayin.

Q'ueanhek k'elan t'a lum tzalquixtak manhxalaj ste'al, scham eyilan lum jolomtak tzalan chi'. ¿Toc ayto lum tzalan chi' b'aj maj he k'ulej ajmulal? Tzex em k'ojan t'a titak b'e tze maklan yek' heb' tzex mulan chi' yet'ok, icha tz'aj smaklan heb' árabe yek' heb' tzek' b'aj malaj anima. Yuj eyajmulal chi' ix eyixtejb'at lum lum tik.
Yuj wal he mul chi' maxtzak yak' nhab' t'a stiempoal. Icha heb' ix ajmul ix maxtzak q'uixwi jab'ok, icha wal chi' eyaji.
Ina ato eyalan tik t'ayin: Mamin, wach' ak'an qued'ok yiktax yune' chonhab' onhto.
¿Tom aynhejkot owal t'ayonh? ¿Tom aynhejkot owal chi' t'a junelnhej? xe chi. Yakb'an wan eyalan icha chi', wannhej pax he k'ulan jantak tas malaj swach'il stechaj he k'ulani, xchi Jehová.

Ha t'a yol stiempoal winhaj rey Josías, ix yal Jehová t'ayin icha tik: ¿Ix am wal il tas ix sk'ulej heb' etchonhab' israel? Icha wal heb' ix ajmul ix ix yutej sb'a heb'. Ix laj b'at heb' sk'ulej ajmulal t'a tzalquixtak yet' t'a yichtak te te' k'ayum xiil.

Ha in tik, a tzin naani to ayik toxo ix sk'ulej heb' icha chi', ol meltzajpaxkot heb' t'ayin, palta maj meltzajxikot heb'. Ha chonhab' Judá te pit, ix yil tas sk'ulej chonhab' Israel ayto yuj sb'a yet'ok.
Ix yilanpax heb' to ix in puk in b'a yet' heb' israel yuj yajmulal, palta a heb' aj Judá chi' maj xiw jab'ok heb', ix empax heb' ajmulal.
Yujto malaj yelk'och ajmulal t'a heb', yuj chi' ix yixtejb'at lum lum tik heb' yuj smul chi', yuj pax to ix och heb' ejmelal t'a komon Dios nab'a k'een, nab'a te'.
Wach'chom ix yil heb' tas ix aj heb' israel chi', manh yujok chi' ix meltzajxikot heb' t'ayin t'a smasanil sk'ool, palta tonhej ix stz'ak meltzajkot sb'a heb' t'ayin, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanpax Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ha heb' israel te pit heb', palta quennhej wal smul heb' t'a yichanh heb' aj Judá. Ha heb' aj Judá chi' maj yak' elk'och tas ix yal heb'.

Ach Jeremías, ixik k'elan t'a stojolal norte, tzalanb'at jun lolonel tik t'a heb' etisraelal ay t'a norte chi'. Ha wal Jehová tz'alan t'ayex icha tik: Ex israel te pit, meltzajanhekxikot t'ayin. Manh owalok ol wutej ex in chaani, manh masanilok tiempo aykot wowal t'ayex, yujto tz'ok' in k'ol t'ayex.

Anhej to tzeyojtaquejel he chukal, to te pit ix eyutej he b'a t'ayin, a in Jehová he Diosal in tik. Ha in swala' to ix och he mul he k'ulan ajmulal yet' juntzanh komon Dios t'a yichtak te te' k'ayum xiil. Maj he k'anab'ajej jab'ok in cheknab'il, xchi Jehová t'ayex, xa chi, xchi t'ayin.

Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ex in chonhab' te pit, meltzajanhekxi t'ayin, yujto eyetb'eyum waji. Junjun ex ol ex wik'kot t'a junjun chonhab'. Chatacwanh ol aj ex wik'ankot t'a junjun makan inhtilal. Icha chi' ol aj ex wik'anxikankot t'a Sion.
Ol wak'och heb' eyilumal icha wal in gana, haxo heb' ol ak'an yajalil t'a eyib'anh t'a jelanil yet' t'a sjichanil.

Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to ayik toxo ix q'uib'xi he b'isul t'a he chonhab' tik, manhxa b'aj ol eyak' b'inaj te' skaxail in trato. Manhxa b'aj ol he nakot te', manhxo pax olto jawok te' t'a he pensar. Manhxo ol he b'o junokxo sk'exul te'.

Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', a Jerusalén ol alchaj yuj to in despacho yaj a in Jehová in tik. Masanil chonhab' ol smolb'ej sb'ha t'a tik yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'ayin. Manhxo ol yak' sb'a heb' skuchb'ajb'at yuj schuk pensaril.

Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', junxonhej ol aj chonhab' Judá yet' chonhab' Israel. Junxonhej ol aj he meltzajkot t'a jun nakión t'a stojolal norte, haxo he jawikan kajan t'a lum lum wak'nak smakb'enej heb' he mam eyicham.

Ex israel, ix in na' to tzex in chaoch wuninalok, swak'an jun lum te nib'ab'il tik t'ayex. Anhej wal jun lum tik te wach' yilji t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik. Ix in na' to ol in eyal he mamok t'a junelnhej, manhxo ol in eyaktejkan walani.
Palta a in wal Jehová in swala' to icha junok ix ix te chuk t'a winh yetb'eyum, icha chi' ix eyutej he b'a t'ayin.

Tz'ab'chaj yoch jaj t'a lum tzalquixtak manhxa ste'al, aton heb' israel tz'el yaw yoq'ui sk'anan kolwal heb'. Ix elkan heb' t'a sb'eal tojolal. Ix in b'at satk'olal yuj heb', a in Jehová sDiosal in heb' tik.

Ex anima te pit, kotanhekxi t'ayin, ol wik'anel jun pitalil ayoch t'a he pensar chi', xchi Jehová chi'. Ix tak'wi heb' israel chi' icha tik: Ina kajek' tik, skak'och ko b'ha t'a yol a k'ab', yujto a ach tik Jehová ko Diosal ach.
Nab'anhej onh xid'ek' t'a tzalquixtak, onh awaj chaanh kak'an q'uinh t'a juntzanh komon Dios. Anhej wal t'ayach Jehová ko Diosal tz'ilchaj ko kolnab'il.

Yictax yune' chonhab' onhto, onh och ejmelal t'a juntzanh yechel q'uixwub'tak chi', yuj chi' ix ak' satel tastak ix aj t'a heb' ko mam quicham, aton nok' kalnel yet' nok' wakax. Ix champax yuninal heb' yet' yisil heb'.

Quiq'ek em ko b'a yuj q'uixwelal, yujto a onh tik yet' heb' ko mam quicham, ix te och wal ko mul t'a Jehová ko Diosal. Yictax yune' chonhab' onhto masanto tiknaik, max ko k'anab'ajej tas syal t'ayonh, xchi heb'.
Ha wal Jehová tz'alani: Ex israel, tato t'a wal yel tze nib'ej tzex meltzajxi t'ayin, aktejekkan juntzanh he diosal yajb'entak chi'.
Hak'ek he ti' t'a wichanh, tzeyak'an elk'och tas tzeyala'. Ichato chi' b'ian, ol in yik'anchaanh masanil nakión, ol wak'an in wach'k'olal t'a heb', xchi.

Syalanxi Jehová t'ayex, ex aj Judá yet' ex aj Jerusalén: Ix pitb'iel he pensar icha lum lum malaj mach smunlaj t'a sat, anhej te' q'uix sq'uib' t'ay. Comonoc k'un tzeyutej jab'ok he pensar yik tz'och in lolonel t'ay.

Ex aj Judá yet' ex aj Jerusalén, k'anab'ajejek in trato ix in b'o eyed'ok. Ch'oxequel in trato t'a he b'eyb'al, aton in trato chab'il eyuuj. Ojtaquejec eli to a in ton Jehová he Diosal in. Tato maay, a yuj he chuk b'eyb'al chi' skot yowal in k'ol t'a eyib'anh icha te' k'ak' manhxa mach syal smak'an tupok.

Alec juntzanh tik t'a heb' aj Judá yet' t'a heb' aj Jerusalén: Hak'ek ok' k'een trompeta t'a masanil chonhab', xe chi. Te chaanh tzex awaji tzeyalan icha tik: Co molb'ejek ko b'ha t'a yol juntzanh chonhab' wach' yaj smuroal, xe chi.
Ik'ekchaanh he bandera sch'oxani to sb'at he k'ub'ejel he b'ha t'a Sion. Sayec ek' b'aj tze kol he b'a, manh ex och waan. Yujto ha t'a norte ol wik'kot jun niwan yaelal ol satanel smasanil.

Icha yelta nok' choj b'aj ay, icha chi' ol aj skot heb' ol ul satanel juntzanh chonhab' tik. Toxo ix elta heb' t'a yol schonhab' yik tzul satanel he chonhab' tik heb', ol smak'anem lanhnaj heb', manhxa mach ol kan t'ay.
Yuj chi' ak'ekoch pichul ya swa'i, ok'anhek, elokab' eyaw yuj yaelal, yujto a wal yowal in k'ol a in Jehová in tik manto el-laj t'a eyib'anh, xchi Jehová.

Ha wal Jehová tz'alanxi icha tik: Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', a winh rey yet' heb' yajal, ol el yip heb' yuj xiwelal. Ha heb' sakerdote yet' heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok, toxonhej ol satkan sk'ol heb', xchi.
Ix walan Jeremías in tik: Ay Mamin ¿tas yuj ix a k'exanh tiej heb' aj Jerusalén tik? Ix ak' a ti' ak'an junk'olal t'a heb', haxo tiknaik, a k'een kuchilub' ijanoch t'a sjaj heb' uuj, xin chi.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', ol wal t'a heb' aj Jerusalén: Ay jun taquinh ik' skot t'a lum tzalquixtak ay t'a taquinh lu'um. Sjawi xumnaj t'a stojolal in chonhab', manh ichok ik' tz'ik'anel smatz'il ixim trigo.
Ha jun ik' swak'kot chi', te ow t'a yichanh junxo ik' chi'. Ha jun ik' sb'inaj tik, aton yaelal ol wak'kot t'a yib'anh in chonhab', xchi Jehová.

Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ilec wal skot heb' soldado ajk'ool, icha wal skot junok asun skot heb'. Ha wal skarruaje heb' lajan sb'ey icha chakxuxum ik'. Axo nok' schej heb' ek'b'al sb'ey nok' t'a yichanh nok' ch'akb'a. Yuj chi' ol eyal icha tik: Ob'iltak onh wal, ol onh satelok, xe chama.
Ex aj Jerusalén, ik'equel masanil chukal ay t'a he pensar yik wach' ol ex kolchajok. ¿B'aq'uinhto wal ol eyaktej he naan chukal?
Ato t'a Dan yet' t'a lum tzalquixtak yik Efraín, ata' skot yab'ixal owal.
Alec t'a juntzanh ch'ok chonhab'il yet' t'a Jerusalén to ha t'a jun chonhab' te najat ay, ata' skot heb' ajk'ool. Tz'el yaw heb' skot yak' owal yet' juntzanh chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá.
Ol oymaj heb' t'a chonhab' Jerusalén, icha heb' stanhwan junok munlajel. Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to icha chi' ol ujok, yujto ix ste pitej sb'a heb' t'ayin.
Yuj he b'eyb'al yet' tas tze k'ulej sjawi juntzanh tik t'a eyib'anh. Ha yuj he chukal, te chuk tz'aj eyelk'ochi, syab' wal syail he pixan yuj, xchi Jehová.
Ay..., ste kus in k'ool, tz'och wal pitz'an t'a in pixan. Stinhtinhan in pixan yuj tas sjawi chi'. Maxtzac in em numan. Toxo ix wab' yok' k'een trompeta yet' yel yaw heb' soldado yik tz'och owal.
Tzoltzon sja ab'ix yik juntzanh yaelal sjawi. Masanil chonhab' tik toxo ix laj juwib'ati. Elanhchamel ix lajwiem ko kampamento, ix ixtaxb'at b'aj kajan onh.
¿Jantacto wal tiempo ol wil sbandera heb' soldado yet' wab'an spukhaj k'een trompeta? xin chi.

Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ha heb' in chonhab', te malaj spensar heb', max in yojtaquejel heb'. Lajan heb' icha heb' unin malaj jab'ok spensar, manh jab'ok snachajel yuj heb'. Te jelan heb' t'a chukal. Manh yojtakok heb' sk'ulan wach'il, xchi.
Ha in Jeremías in tik, ix ch'oxji wil sat lu'um tik, tz'inanxonhej ix ajkani. Ix wilpaxk'e satcha’anh, manhxalaj sakil k'inal t'ay.
Ix laj wil lum niwak witz, ix ib'xik'e lu'um yet' pax lum tzalquixtak, ix laj tzikub'tanhaj lu'um.
Ix wilani manhxalaj anima, haxo masanil nok' sjenhwi toxo ix b'at nok' elelal.
Ix wilanpaxi, a lum lum b'aj ay awb'en, toxo ix kan tzinan lu'um. Masanil chonhab' toxo ix juwiemi. Yuj yowal sk'ol Jehová icha chi' ix aj masanil juntzanh chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Masanil lum lum ol juwokb'atok, palta manh ol in satel lum t'a junelnhej.

Cuseltac ol ajkan lum lum tik, haxo satcha’anh ol k'ik'b'okkanok. Icha chi' ol ajok yujto icha chi' ix aj in naani, ix walan paxi. Manh ol in k'exlaj tas ix in na' chi', manh ol ek'b'atlaj tas ix wal chi', xchi Jehová.

Ayic syab'an heb' anima yel yaw heb' soldado ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej yet' heb' yet'nak sjul-lab', sb'at heb' elelal, b'at sk'ub'ejel sb'a heb' t'a kaltak te', sq'ekan lotzlon heb' t'a sattak k'een tenam. Yuj chi' ix laj kan tzinan schonhab' heb'. Manhxalaj mach skajnajkan t'ay.

Ha Jerusalén wan slajwiemi, lajan icha junok ix ix nab'axonhej syak'och sk'apak púrpura, syak'anoch k'een oro ix wach' yilji, k'ik' syutej stitak sat ix yak'an uk'ok. Manhxa yelk'och b'aj sb'o sb'a ix chi', yujto a heb' winh winak nib'ab'il yuj ix, yajb'ilxoel ix yuj heb' winh. Toxonhej sna heb' winh tas ol aj smilan ix heb' winh. Icha chi' wan sk'ulan Jerusalén yet' juntzanhxo ch'ok nakional.

Ha heb' aj Sion tz'el yaw chi'. Swab' wal yel yaw heb' icha yel yaw junok ix ix b'ab'elto tz'alji yune'. Sk'akwi heb', syak'anel lian sk'ab' heb', syalan heb': Ay, ob'iltak onh. Ol onh miljokcham yuj heb' milum anima, xchi heb'.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ek'anh t'a skalleal Jerusalén tik, tzilan masanil anima, tzilan t'a merkado tato ay junok anima sb'eyb'alan tojolal, wach'nhej syutej sb'a. Wach'chom junok pitanh tz'ilchaj uuj, ol wak' niwank'olal Jerusalén tik.
Ay heb' stz'akan slok in b'i ayik syak'an sti' heb', palta t'a es slok in b'i chi' heb', xchi Jehová.

Mamin Jehová, a heb' tza nib'ej, aton heb' yelnhej syala'. Yuj chi' ix ak'och syaelal heb' a chonhab' tik, palta malaj yelk'och t'a heb'. Ix ak' lajwoquem heb', palta maj nachajpaxel yuj heb'. Te pit spensar heb', icha stzatzil junok k'een k'een. Malaj snib'ej heb' syaktejkan schuk b'eyb'al.
Ix in na' icha tik: Tekan a heb' meb'a' malaj wal jab'ok spensar, a heb' icha chi' sk'ulani, yujto manh yojtakok heb' tas snib'ej Jehová Dios t'a heb' yet' tas syal t'a heb'.

Ol b'at in lolon yet' heb' anima niwak yelk'ochi, xin chi. Ha walani to yojtak heb' tas snib'ej Jehová Dios t'a heb' yet' tas syal t'a heb'. Palta masanil juntzanh heb' chi', ix spitejpax sb'a heb' d'ha Dios. Maj yal sk'ol heb' ix sk'anab'ajej Jehová chi'.

Yuj wal chi' ol elta nok' choj t'a kaltak yax lu'um, ol miljokcham heb' yuj nok'. Ha nok' oques ay t'a tzinan lu'um ol tzilchitanb'at heb'. Axo nok' leopardo, ol laj k'och nok' t'a stitak schonhab' heb'. Tato tz'elta heb', chok' tz'ajkan heb' yuj nok', yujto te niwan smul heb' ix ochi, manhxo b'ischajb'enok spitalil heb'.

Yuj chi' syal Jehová icha tik: ¿Tasto wal ol aj ex wak'an niwank'olal? Ha heb' eyuninal, ix in yaktejkan heb', syak'an sti' heb' t'a sb'i juntzanh komon Dios to manh diosok. Jantac wael ix wak' t'a heb', palta maj in sk'anab'ajej heb', anhej ajmulal sk'ulej heb', molannhejek' heb' b'aj ay heb' ix ajmul ix.
Icha nok' mam chej nhepepi yuj b'ak'uech, toxonhej tz'el yaw jinhinhi yeq'ui, icha chi' heb', komonxonhej stzuntzejb'at heb' ix ix heb' ay t'a slak'anil, heb' ix ayxo yetb'eyum.
¿Tom manh ol wak'och syaelal heb' yuj juntzanh sb'eyb'al chi'? ¿Tom manh ol wak' spak t'a junok chonhab' t'a smojal icha tas sk'ulej?
Ochokab' heb' ajk'ol satanel te' uwa, palta manh masanilok te' ol lajwoquelok. Sjekokab'el te' sk'ab' heb', yujto manhxo wikok te'.
Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to icha chi' ol ajok, yujto maj sk'anab'ajej heb' aj Israel yet' heb' aj Judá in trato ix in b'o yet'ok, xchi Jehová t'ayin.
Ha heb' aj Israel yet' heb' aj Judá, manh yelok tas syal heb' t'a spatik Jehová. Syalan heb' icha tik: Ha Dios malaj tas sna t'a quib'anh. Manh ol kab'laj syail yuj owal, ma yuj wejel.

Ha heb' schekab' Dios malaj yelk'och tas syal heb', manhok slolonel Dios syal heb', xchi heb'. Palta a wal Jehová Dios Yajal t'a Smasanil, ha' ix alan juntzanh tik t'ayin: Yujto syal heb' icha chi', yuj chi' a wal tik ol jawok t'a yib'anh heb'. Ha in lolonel ol elta t'a a ti', lajan wal ol wutej icha te' k'ak'. Axo heb' anima tik, lajan ol aj heb' icha te' k'atzitz. Axo jun k'ak' chi' ol satanel heb' smasanil, xchi Jehová.

Ha wal Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ex yinhtilal Israel, a jun chonhab' te najat ay, te tek'an, aytaxon t'a peka', ol wik'kot t'ayex, aton jun chonhab' to manh eyojtakok sti', manh ol eyab'laj tas ol yal heb'.
Masanil juntzanh anima chi', te jelan heb' yak'an owal, a syamk'ab' heb' yik owal yet'nak chamel.

Ol slajel sat eyawb'en heb' yet' he wael. Ol smilcham eyuninal heb' yet' eyisil. Ol schianb'at nok' he kalnel heb' yet' nok' he wakax, ol sloanpaxb'at sat te' uwa heb' yet' sat te' higo awab'il eyuuj. Ha heb' soldado heb' ol mak'anem lanhnaj he chonhab' wach' yajoch smuroal ayoch yipok he k'ool, xchi Jehová.
Ha wal Jehová ix alan t'ayin: Wach'chom tzijtum yaelal ol ja t'a jun pekti’ chi', palta manh ol ex in satel-laj t'a junelnhej.

Tato ay mach ol k'anb'an t'ayach: ¿Tas yuj syak'kot juntzanh tik Jehová ko Diosal t'a quib'anh? tato xchi heb', tzal t'a heb' icha tik: Icha chi' ex yutej yujto ix he patiquejkaneli, haxo juntzanh ch'ok diosal ix eyak' serwil t'a yol he makb'en tik. Yuj chi' yowalil ol eyak' serwil heb' ch'ok animail t'a junokxo makb'en manh eyikok, xa chi, xchi Jehová t'ayin.
Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Alec t'a heb' yinhtilalkan Jacob kajan t'a smakb'en Judá:
Ex anima malaj he pensar, ab'ek juntzanh tik: Ay yol he sat, palta max yal-laj eyilani. Ay he chiquin, palta max eyab'laj.

Ha ex tik, malaj welk'och t'ayex. Ha in tik ix in b'okanem k'een arena t'a stitak ha' mar t'a junelnhej. Wach'chom sk'e waan ha' sk'anh yem ponhnaj ha', palta max ek'laj ha' t'a k'een arena aykanem chi' wuuj. Tato icha chi' in poder tzeyila', ¿tom manh smojok he xiw t'ayin?
Ha ex tik te pit ex, ix in he patiquejkaneli.
Max he na jab'ok eyal icha tik: Ayokab' yelk'och Jehová ko Diosal t'ayonh, yujto a tz'ak'ankot nhab' t'a stiempoal, syak'anpax elul sat kawb'en t'a stiempoal, manh xe chiok.
Palta yuj he mul tz'och waan juntzanh tik, yuj chi' max yal eyak'an tzalajb'ok he k'ool yet' juntzanh in wach'k'olal tik, xchi Jehová, xa chi.
Ha t'a in chonhab' tik, ay wal heb' anima te chuk, say modo heb' tas tz'aj yixtan heb' anima heb', icha heb' tz'ak'anem syaalil nok' much.
Sb'ud' spat heb' yet' masanil tastak sutel heb' t'a heb' anima, icha tz'aj yak'jioch nok' much t'a yol ste', sb'ud'ji yuj nok', yuj chi' niwan tz'aj yelk'och heb' yuj sb'eyumal syelk'ej chi'.
Naynay yaj heb' yuj b'ak'uech. Manhxa yalnab'il schukal heb'. Max sb'olaj yaj heb' t'a stojolal tas tz'utaj heb' unin chamnak smam yet' heb' meb'a'.
¿Tom manh ol wak'kot yaelal t'a eyib'anh yuj juntzanh tik? Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to ol wak' spak t'ayex in chonhab' ex tik icha wal t'a smojal.
Xiwub'tak, satk'olaltak yuj tas tzuji t'a jun chonhab' tik.
Ha heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok, anhej es syal heb'. Axo heb' sakerdote syak' yajalil heb' icha snib'ej. Axo in chonhab' tik, wach' syab'i. Palta, ¿tas wal ol aj heb' ayik ol ja slajwub'?

Ex yinhtilal Benjamín, sayek b'aj tze kol he b'a. Elanhec t'a Jerusalén. Puec k'een trompeta t'a Tecoa, ak'ekk'e te' tab' ch'oxnab'ilal t'a Bet-haquerem, yujto t'a norte skot jun niwan yaelal, niwan tas ol lajwoquel yuj.
Toxo wal ol in satel heb' anima ay t'a Sion, heb' te nib'ab'il.
Ha heb' rey yet' heb' soldado ol jawok heb' t'a jun chonhab' tik, ol sb'oan skampamento heb' t'a spatiktak. Ha b'aj ol kan junjun heb', ol satnhejel yuj heb'.
Ha heb' eyajk'ol chi', syal heb' icha tik: Kaq'ek lista ko b'a kak'an owal yet'ok. Cotanhec, kaq'ek owal yet' t'a chimk'ualil. Palta anhej to wan yem k'u, wanxo yoch wewen,
yuj chi' t'ak'walil ol onh ochek kak' owal yet'ok. Ol ko mak'anem lanhnaj yet'tal heb' soldado stanhwan chonhab', xchi heb'.

Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik: Ch'aquequel te te', tze b'oank'e he tek'nub' yik tzex och eyak' owal t'a Jerusalén. Ol wak'och yaelal t'a yib'anh jun chonhab'il anima chi', yujto axonhej ixtoj anima syak' heb'.
Ha t'a Jerusalén chi' spak'chaanh chukal, icha wal sk'eul sjaj junok ha ha'. Anhej ixtoj anima yet' chukal sb'inaj t'ay. Yuj chi' ol janhej yaelal t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' chi'.
B'oek he b'eyb'al ex aj Jerusalén, yik wach' max wik'el in pensar t'ayex. Tato maay, ol wak'kan tzinan he lu'um tik, manhxalaj mach ol kajnajkan t'ay, xchi Jehová.

Ix yalan Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil t'ayin icha tik: Ha heb' israel tik manhxa junok heb' ol kanok, icha tz'aj smolchaj sat te' uwa manhxa b'aj skan junok pitanh sat, icha chi' ol aj heb'. Yuj chi' yakb'an manto uji jun chi', kolkanel jantak heb' syal yelkani, icha wal tz'aj yek' heb' swach' molan te' sat uwa t'a sk'ab', xchi t'ayin.
Ix in tak'wi: ¿Mamin, mach ol ab'anok tato swal jun ab'ix tik? Icha wal to makan schiquin heb', max yab'laj heb'. Tonhej sb'uchwaj heb', max schalaj sk'ol a lolonel heb'.

Mamin, skot pax yowal in k'ol ed'ok t'a jun chonhab' tik. Maxtzac techaj wuj in yamanoch waan, xin chi. Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Hak'uem yowal in k'ol chi' t'a yib'anh heb' unin tzek' t'a yoltak kalle yet' t'a yib'anh heb' winh kelemtak umaneq'ui. Ol yamchaj heb' winh winak yet' ix yetb'eyum yet' heb' te icham animaxo.
Masanil spat heb', smunlajel heb', heb' ix yetb'eyum heb', ch'okxo mach ol ik'ankanok. Yujto a in wal Jehová in swala', ol wik'k'e in k'ab' wak'an syaelal heb' kajan t'a jun chonhab' tik.

Masanil heb' niwak yelk'ochi yet' heb' malaj yelk'ochi, anhej tas syutej heb' yak'an ganar t'a spatik chukal sna'a. Anheja' heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok yet' heb' sakerdote, axonhej elk'al syak' heb'.
Snib'ej heb' sk'ub'ejel jantak yaelal syab' in chonhab', syalan heb' to ay junk'olal, palta manh yeloklaj.

Max q'uixwi jab'ok heb' sk'ulan juntzanh tas max techaj wilani. Malaj jab'ok sq'uixwelal heb', manh yojtakok heb' tas jun q'uixwelal chi'. Yuj chi' a in wal Jehová in swala', a wal yik ol wak'an syaelal heb', ol satkanel heb', xchi Jehová.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a heb' schonhab' icha tik: Ayic ex och tek'tek' b'aj skulusej sb'a b'e, ix walan t'ayex: Scham wal eyilan b'aj tzex b'ati. Tze k'anb'ej eyab'i tas b'eal yik'nak heb' he mam eyicham. Aton t'a b'e wach' chi' tzex b'ati, ata' ol eyik' eyip, xin chi t'ayex. Palta ix eyalani: Maay, malaj ko gana tzonh b'at ta', xe chi.

Icha spukhaj k'een trompeta yik syak'an ab'ix to wan sjawi owal t'a skal heb' anima, icha chi' ix wutej in chekanb'at heb' in chekab' ex skacha', ix in chekan yal heb' icha tik: Actejekkan he chuk b'eyb'al tik, yik manh ol ja yaelal t'a eyib'anh, xin chi. Palta ix eyalan icha tik: Malaj ko gana skaktejkani, xe chi.
Yuj chi' swalan icha tik: Ab'ek ex ch'ok chonhab'il, ojtaquejequel tas ol ujok t'a in chonhab' tik.

Ab'ek he masanil ex kajan ex t'a sat lu'um tik: Ol wik'kot junok yaelal te chuk t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik, yuj chukal sna heb' sk'ulej, yujto maj scha yab' in lolonel heb', ix spatiquejel in k'ayb'ub'al heb'.

Ex in chonhab', ¿tasto yuj tzeyik'kot inkienso yik chonhab' Sabá t'ayin yet' te te' suk'uq'ui sjab' skot t'a juntzanh chonhab' najat? Maxtzac schalaj in k'ol juntzanh he silab' tze nhustz'aok, ma juntzanhxo he silab' tzeyak'a', xchi Jehová.

Yuj juntzanh tik ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ol wak'em junok tas b'aj ol slok sb'a eyok t'a yichanh heb' eyajk'ool. Eb' mamab'il, heb' uninab'il, heb' kajan t'a slak'anil heb' yet' heb' yamigo heb', lajannhej ol aj scham heb' smasanil, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Ato t'a snajatil lum lum ay t'a stojolal norte, ata' ay jun chonhab' te ay yip wan yak'an lista sb'a skoti.

Yed'nak sjul-lab' heb' yet' slanza. Te chuk heb', malaj yok'elk'olal heb'. Icha wal sk'anh sk'e waan ha' mar, icha wal chi' yel yaw heb' skoti, ayk'e heb' t'a yib'anh chej. Listaxo yaj heb' skot yak' owal eyed'ok a ex kajan ex t'a Jerusalén tik, xchi Jehová.
Ha heb' anima t'a Jerusalén tik, ol yal heb' icha tik: Toxo ix kab' jun ab'ix chi', ix el quip yuj xiwelal. Te ya skab'i, icha wal yab'an syail junok ix ix ayik tz'alji yune'.
Manhxo ex b'at munlajel, manhxo ex b'eyek' t'a yoltak b'e, yujto te ay xiwk'olal. Yalxonhej b'aj ayek' heb' ajk'ool yet' syamk'ab' yik owal, xcham heb' anima chi'.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a schonhab' icha tik: Ex in chonhab', ak'ekoch pichul ya swa'i yik tze ch'oxanel he kusk'olal. Ek'anhek b'alb'on t'a skal k'een tik'aq'uil taanh. Ochanhec wal t'a kusk'olal, ok'anhek wal sik'lab'il, icha wal yik scham junok k'otanh eyuninal, yujto a jun mach ol ex satanelok, wan sja tzak'najok, xchi.
Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Tzach wak'ochi yik tzak'an prowal in chonhab' tik. Tza ch'olb'itej wal heb' sik'lab'il, tzilan wal tas yaj sb'eyb'al heb'.
Te pit heb' smasanil, alum pekal heb'. Ix pitb'iel spixan heb' icha stzatzil k'een bronke, ma k'een hierro.

Ayic slawaj te' k'ak' yet' junok lawlab', schakb'i te', tz'ulaxel k'een plomo t'a skal k'een plata. Palta haxo in chonhab' tik, wach'chom ix wak'lej in b'oan sb'eyb'al heb', palta malaj jab'ok yelk'ochi, yujto malaj jab'ok swach'il sb'eyb'al heb', max satel chukal t'a skal heb'.
Yuj chi' ol aljok yuj heb' to lajan heb' icha schukal k'een plata sjulchajeli, yujto a in Jehová in tik, ix in spatiquejel heb', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin a in Jeremías in tik:

Ochanh tek'tek' t'a spuertail in templo a in Jehová in tik, tzalan juntzanh lolonel tik t'a heb' anima: Masanil ex kajan ex t'a Judá, mach ex tzex och t'a jun puerta tik yik tzex och ejmelal t'a Jehová, scham wal eyab'an jun lolonel yik Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, aton ko Diosal: Tato ol he b'o he b'eyb'al yet' tas tze k'ulej, ol ex wak' kajnaj t'a sat lum tik.
Manh eyak'och he pensar t'a heb' tz'esani, heb' tz'alan icha tik: Cojtak wal to malaj tas ol onh ik'anok, yujto ayek' skajnub' Jehová t'a tik, aton wal stemplo tik, skomon chiej heb'.
Tato tze b'o he b'eyb'al yet' tas tze k'ulej, tato wach'nhej tzeyutej he b'a t'ayex junjun ex,

tato max eyixtej heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, heb' unin manhxa smam yet' heb' ix chamnakxo yetb'eyum ayek' t'a he kal, tato max he milcham heb' anima malaj smul, tato max ex och ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios, juntzanh tz'ik'an he juwieli,
tato icha chi' tze k'ulej, ol ex wak'kan kajan t'a jun lum tik, aton lum wak'nakkan t'a heb' he mam eyicham t'a junelnhej.
Palta a ex tik, tzeyak'och juntzanh esal lolonel malaj yelk'och t'a he k'ool.
Tzex elk'ani, tzex mak'wicham anima, tze k'ulej ajmulal, tze lok in b'i t'a es, tze nhusan inkienso t'a Baal, tzex och ejmelal t'a komon Dios to malaj eyalan eyik t'ay.
Slajwi chi' tzex ja pax t'a wichanh t'a in templo tik, tzeyalani: Malaj tas ol onh ik'anok, xe chi. Anhej yik tzex elb'ati tze b'eyb'alanxi juntzanh tas yajb'entak t'a yol in sat.
¿Tom tze na' to a in templo tik lajan yet' k'een nhak'een b'aj sk'ub'ej sb'a heb' elk'um? Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to swilnhej masanil juntzanh tze k'ulej tik.
Ixiquec b'aj ek'nak chonhab' Silo b'aj ek'nak in kajnub', aton jun chi' in sik'naquel t'a sb'ab'elal b'aj in ch'oxnak in b'a. Ata' ol eyila' tas wutejnak in satanel yuj smul heb' he mam eyicham.
Ha in Jehová in swala' to ix he k'ulej juntzanh chukal tik, tzijtum el ix wal t'ayex to tzeyaktejkani, palta maj he k'anab'ajej. Ix ex wawtej, palta maj ex tak'woklaj t'ayin.
Yuj chi' icha wal wutejnak in kajnub' t'a Silo chi', icha chi' ol wutejkan in templo tik, aton jun wak'nak t'a heb' he mam eyicham yet' t'ayex tik, aton jun tzeyak'och yipok he k'ol tiknaik.
Ol ex wik'kanel t'a wichanh, icha wal ix aj wik'anel heb' eyetchonhab' t'a wichanh t'a yalanhtaxo, aton heb' yinhtilal Efraín, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ach Jeremías, manh ach lesalwok yuj jun chonhab' tik. Manh al t'ayin, manh ach tewok t'ayin yuj heb', yujto manh ol in tak'wok t'ayach.
¿Tom max il tastak sk'ulej heb' t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá yet' t'a yoltak kalle t'a Jerusalén?

Ha heb' yuninal heb' sayankot te' k'atzitz, haxo heb' mamab'il tz'ak'anoch te' k'ak', haxo heb' ix nunab'il sb'oan ixim k'oxox pan yik syak'an heb' silab'il t'a sdiosalil, jun skuchan ix yajalil satcha’anh. Stzuntzej wal kot yowal in k'ol heb' ayik syak'an wino heb' silab'il t'a komon Dios.
Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to manhok innhej tzin yixtej heb', palta munil syixtej pax sb'a heb' yak'an q'uixwelal sb'a.

Yuj chi', a in Jehová Yajal in swala' to ol wak'kot yowal in k'ol t'a yib'anh jun lugar tik: Aton t'a yib'anh heb' anima, t'a nok' nok' yet' te te' yet' t'a yib'anh masanil awb'en. Lajan wal wowal chi' icha junok te' k'ak' tz'eli, maxtzak yal-laj stupi, xchi Jehová.
Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, aton sDiosal Israel, a tz'alan t'a schonhab' icha tik: Hak'ek he gana eyak'an he silab', nok' snhusjitz'aok, tze chi'an schib'ejal juntzanhxo nok' silab' chi'.
Palta ayik wik'annaquelta heb' he mam eyicham t'a Egipto, malaj tas walnak t'a heb' yuj nok' silab' snhusji yet' ofrenda.

Ha tas in b'ab'laj alejnak t'a heb' to tzin sk'anab'ajej heb'. Tato icha chi', a in ton tzin och sDiosalok heb', haxo heb' tz'ochkan in chonhab'ok. Valannac to sk'anab'ajej heb' icha wal tas ix wala', yik wach'nhej tz'elk'och heb'.

Palta maj schalaj yab' heb', maj sk'anab'ajej heb'. Ha tas sk'ulejnak heb' to yak'nak pitb'oquel spensar heb', sk'anab'ajannak schukal spensar heb'. Octom swach' b'oejnak sb'eyb'al heb', palta to swach' juejnaquel sb'a heb'.
Yictax yelnakkot heb' he mam eyicham t'a Egipto masanto tiknaik, tzin cheknhejb'at heb' in chekab' yala'.
Palta a ex tik, max he k'anab'ajej, max he cha eyab' tas swala'. Te pit tzeyutej he b'a. Yelxo wal te chuk tzeyutej he b'ha t'a yichanh heb' he mam eyicham chi'.
Ha achxo tik ach Jeremías, al masanil juntzanh tik, wach'chom manh ol schalaj yab' heb' t'ayach. Alnhej, wach'chom manh ol tak'wok heb'.
Al t'a heb' icha tik: Ha ex wal tik junelnhej te pit ex, malaj he gana tzex kachji yuj Jehová ko Diosal. Manhxa mach yel syal t'a he kal, xa chi t'a heb'.

Ex aj Jerusalén, joxequel xil he jolom yuj kusk'olal, tzeyumaneli. Ixiquec t'a lum tzalquixtak kuseltak yilji, tze b'itan b'it yik kusk'olal, yujto toxo ix ex waktejkan yuj yowal in k'ool, xchi Jehová.

Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ha heb' aj Judá, te chuk sk'ulej heb' t'a wichanh. Ha juntzanh skomon diosal heb' yajb'entak ix yak' wal och heb' t'a yol in templo. Icha chi' ix aj sjuwiel in templo chi' yuj heb'.
Ha t'a sch'olanil lum Ben-hinom, ata' ix sb'ok'e jun altar heb' yik Tofet b'aj snhustz'a yuninal heb' yet' yisil. Manhok in ix in chek sk'ulej heb', maj ek'paxlaj jab'ok t'a in pensar.

Yuj chi' a in wal Jehová in swala', ay jun pekti’ to a jun ch'olan chi', manhxo ol skuch Tofet, ma sch'olanil lum Ben-hinom, palta ol skuchkan icha tik: Lum Sch'olanil yik heb' mak'b'ilchamok. Yujto manhxa b'aj syal smukji heb' chamnak, yuj chi' ha t'a lum Tofet chi' ol b'at juljokkan heb'.
Ha sniwanil heb' anima ayek' tiknaik t'a jun chonhab' tik, ol och schib'ejok nok' ostok yet' nok' chium nok' t'a kaltak te'. Manhxa mach ol xib'tan nok' t'a heb'.

Ol wak' satel heb' anima t'a juntzanh chonhab' yik Judá. Axo t'a yoltak skalleal Jerusalén, manhxa b'it yik q'uinh yet' yik tzalajk'olal. Manhxa pax b'it yik nupnajel ol ochok. Ichaxonhej tzinan lu'um ol ajkan jun chonhab' tik, xchi Jehová.

Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', ol joychajk'eta sb'aquil heb' ak'annak reyal t'a Judá b'aj mukan, sb'aquil heb' ak'annak yajalil, sb'aquil heb' sakerdote, sb'aquil heb' yalnakoch sb'a in chekab'ok yet' sb'aquil pax juntzanhxo heb' ek'nak kajan t'a Jerusalén.

Ol laj b'atkan lean sb'aquil heb' chi' t'a yok k'u, t'a yok k'een uj yet' t'a yok k'een k'anal. Ayic pitzanto heb', xajan juntzanh chi' yuj heb', yak'nak serwil heb', yalnak sb'a heb' t'ay. Yuj chi' malaj mach ol molank'e sb'aquil heb' chi' yik smukchaji. Ol kannhej ta' icha tz'ajkan stza' nok' nok'.

Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, a in swala' to a jantak heb' anima pitzanto ol kan t'a skal juntzanh anima te chuk tik, ol snib'ej cham sb'a heb' t'a yichanh to pitzan b'aj ol in saklemkanb'at heb' t'a skal juntzanhxo chonhab'.

Ha Jehová ix alan t'ayin icha tik: Ach Jeremías icha tik tzutej alan t'a jun in chonhab' tik: Tato ay junok mach stelwi, tokwal maxtzak k'e waan. Tato ay junok mach satb'at t'a junok b'e, tokwal maxtzak sayxi sb'e chi'.

Palta a exxo tik ex israel, ¿tas yuj tzeyik'el he b'a t'ayin? Ex aj Jerusalén, ¿tas yuj maxtzak ex meltzajxi t'ayin? ¿Tas yuj ha t'a juntzanh komon Dios tzeyak'och he pensar, haxo t'ayin malaj he gana he meltzajxi?

Ix in maklej wal wab'i, palta malaj mach slolon t'a stojolal. Malaj wal junok mach sna sb'ha t'a schukal syalani: ¿Tas wal ix in k'ulej? manh xchiok. Sb'atkan heb' smasanil t'a yol b'e, icha sb'at lemnaj nok' chej t'a owal.

Ha nok' kigüeña tzek' jenhenhok t'a satcha’anh, yojtak nok' b'ak'uinh ol meltzaj nok'. Yed' nok' kuwajte', nok' sanhkapech yet' nok' grulla, yojtak nok' b'ak'uinh ol b'at nok' t'a junokxo lugar. Ha exxo pax tik ex in chonhab', manh eyojtakok jab'ok in k'ayb'ub'al.
¿Tas yuj tzeyala' to ay he pensar, eyojtak in k'ayb'ub'al eyalani? Palta haxo heb' slaj tz'ib'anelta in k'ayb'ub'al, slaj sk'ex heb' tas syala'.
Ha juntzanh heb' jelan yalan chi', ol q'uixwokkanel heb', ol somchajk'e sk'ol heb', ol kotkan t'a yib'anh heb'. Ix spatiquejel in lolonel heb', yuj chi' ¿b'ajtil ol yik' sjelanil heb'?

Yuj wal chi' ol wak'kanoch heb' ix yetb'eyum heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ch'ok winaquil, haxo sluum heb' ch'ok mach ol ikankanok. Masanil heb' niwak yelk'ochi yet' heb' malaj yelk'ochi, axonhej yak'an ganar heb' t'a spatik chukal, a chi' sna heb'. Icha pax chi' heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok yet' heb' sakerdote, axonhej elk'al syak' heb'.
Snib'ej heb' sk'ub'ejel jantak yaelal syab' in chonhab'. Syalan heb' to ay junk'olal, palta manh yeloklaj.

Max q'uixwi heb' sk'ulan juntzanh tas max techaj wilani. Malaj jab'ok sq'uixwelal heb', manh yojtakok heb' tas jun q'uixwelal chi'. Yuj chi', a in wal Jehová in swala', a wal yik ol wak'an syaelal heb', ol satkanel heb', xchi Jehová, xa chi.

Syalanpax Jehová icha tik: Ol wik'el heb' in chonhab' t'a tik, yujto icha wal junok snunal te' uwa, ma junok ste'al te' higo malaj sat, tonhej sk'ajb'anel xiil ayik wan stakjieli, icha chi' yaj heb'. Yuj chi' a tas ix wak' t'a yol sk'ab' heb', ol wik'xiek' t'a heb', xchi.

Ol yal heb' aj Judá icha tik: ¿Tas yuj tzonh kan t'a tik? Co molb'ejek ko b'a, konh b'atekkan t'a chonhab' wach' yajoch smuroal. Ata' ol ko kol ko b'a, wach'chom t'a skal owal ol onh chamok. Ha Jehová ko Diosal tzonh sataneli, yujto ix och ko mul t'ay, ichato ix yak' kuk' ha ha' ayb'at weneno t'a skal.
Ix ko na' to wach' ol onh elk'ochok, palta malaj tas wach' ix ak'ji t'ayonh. Ha ko naani to tzalajk'olal ol onh ajok, palta anhej xiwk'olal ix jawi t'ayonh.

Van sjawi heb' ajk'ol t'ayonh. Sjornaj snhi' nok' schej heb' t'a Dan, skab'ul ato t'a tik. Ayic tz'ok' nok', tz'ib'xi wal lum lum tik. Sjawi heb' satel ko chonhab' tik yet' masanil tastak ay t'ay yet' masanil onh kajan onh t'a tik, xchi heb'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ol wak'kot chamel t'a he kal icha wal schiwaj nok' chan te ow schiwaji. Manhxalaj mach syal yak'an nanamax nok', xchi Jehová chi'.
Ha in kusk'olal tik manhxalaj yanhal, slajwi wal el in pixan yuj swab'i.

Tz'ab'chaj wal yel yaw heb' wetchonhab' t'a smasanil yol ko makb'en. Syalan heb', ¿tom manhxo ayoquek' Jehová t'a Sion? ¿Tom manhxo ayoquek' ko reyal sik'b'il och yuj Jehová ta'? xchi heb'. Ix tak'wi Jehová t'a heb' icha tik: ¿Tas yuj ix he tzuntzejkot yowal in k'ool ayik ix ex och ejmelal t'a komon Dios, juntzanh yechel malaj yelk'ochi, ch'ok b'aj kotnak? xchi.
Syalan heb' anima icha tik: Toxo ix ek'b'at stiempoal ko kolji, icha yek'b'at stiempoal jochoj trigo, ma icha yek'b'at stiempoal smolchaj sat awb'en, xchi heb'.
Swab' wal syail yuj syaelal heb' wetchonhab'. Toxo ix k'echaanh kusk'olal yet' xiwk'olal t'ayin.
Yakb'an ay yanhal t'a Galaad, ay pax heb' syal yanhtan ta', ¿tas yuj max anhtaj in chonhab' tik?
Comonoc lajan in sat tik icha sjaj ha ha' tz'el yok, yik k'ual t'ak'wal tzin ok' yuj jantak heb' wetchonhab' ix chami.
Comonoc ay junok b'aj syal waj t'a tzinan lu'um, yik wach' najat tzin b'atkan t'a in chonhab' tik. Yujto ix spatiquejel Dios heb', ixtum anima heb'.

Te jelan yesan heb'. Sk'e wal chaanh heb' yet' es chi', icha wal junok mach sk'echaanh ste julanel sjul-lab'. Manhxa jab'ok tas yel tz'alji. Yuj chi' syal Jehová icha tik: Masnhej ste chukb'iel heb'. Maxtzac yal sk'ol heb' tzin yaloch sDiosalok.
Ach Jeremías, manhxo ak'och heb' amigo yet' heb' a k'ab' ok yipok a k'ool, yujto chuklaj tas wan snaan heb' t'a a patik. Ha tas sna masanil heb' amigo chi', syik'lajkot heb' t'a yib'anh junjun.
Syak'laj musansatil sb'a heb'. Manhxa mach slolon t'a yel. Toxo ix te k'ay heb' yesani. Maxtzac yal sk'exan spensar heb'.
Ha wal tas ay t'a skal heb', anhej ak'oj musansatil, ixtoj anima, yuj chi' maxtzak yal sk'ol heb' tzin yal sDiosalok.

Yuj chi' a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil swala': ¿Tasto wal junokxo syal in k'ulan yet' in chonhab' tik? Anhej to ol wak'och heb' t'a syaelal, icha tz'aj yak'jioch k'een plata t'a kal k'ak', yik tz'el schukal k'een.

Ha tas tz'elta t'a sti' heb' lajan icha jul-lab' jay ye scham anima yuj. Axonhej es tzek' yal heb'. Wach' sk'umlan sb'a heb' yet' heb' yamigo yalani, palta haxo t'a spensar heb' wan snaani tas ol yutej heb' yak'an chukal t'a heb' yamigo chi'.
Ha in wal Jehová in swala': ¿Tom manh smojok wak'anoch syaelal heb' yuj tas sk'ulej chi'? ¿Tom manh smojok wak'an spak t'a in chonhab' tik?

Ix walanxi a in Jeremías in tik: Tzin te ok' wal yuj lum tzalquixtak, tzin kus wal yuj lum taquinhtak sat b'aj swa nok' nok', yujto toxo ix te takji sat lu'um. Manhxa mach tzek' ta'. Manhxa junok nok' wakax tz'ab'chaj yoq'ui. Ha nok' kaltakte'al nok' yet' nok' much toxo ix b'at nok' elelal.

Ix wab' yalan Jehová icha tik: Ha jun chonhab' Jerusalén tik, icha junok b'ulanh k'een b'aj kajan nok' niwak oques, icha chi' ol wutejkani. Ha juntzanh chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá, ol kan tzinan. Manhxa junok anima ol kajnajkan t'ay, xchi Jehová.
Ix walan t'a Jehová icha tik: Malaj junok onh snachajel kuuj tas yuj a jun ko chonhab' tik tzinan lu'um ix ajkani. Al t'ayonh tas yuj icha chi' ix ajkani, xin chi t'ay.
Ix tak'wi Jehová chi' t'ayin icha tik: Icha tik ix aji yujto ix spatiquejel in k'ayb'ub'al heb'. Maj sk'anab'ajej heb', maj sb'eyb'alej heb'.
Ix yak'an wal pitb'oquel spensar heb', ix yak'anem sb'a heb' t'a juntzanh komon Dios, icha ix aj sk'ayb'ajkan heb' yuj smam yicham.

Yuj chi' a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, sDiosal in Israel swala': Ol wak' yab' syail heb' t'a junjun k'u, ol k'e wal chi'an sat heb' yab'an syail icha sk'a'il junok tas k'a' swa heb', ma syuk' heb'.

Ol in saklemankanb'at heb' t'a juntzanh chonhab' manh yojtakok yet' pax heb' smam yicham heb' manh yojtakok heb'. Ol in chekb'at heb' soldado yak' owal yet' heb', masanto ol satel heb' smasanil, xchi Jehová.
Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik: Ab'ek, b'at chequek ik'chajkot heb' ix ix aytaxonoch t'a yib'anh yoq'ui.
Yalokab' heb' aj Jerusalén: Cotokab' heb' ix t'a elanhchamel, kusokab' heb' ix kuuj. B'ud'jokab'el yol ko sat yuj yaal, elokab' b'ulnaj xil ko sat yuj jantak yal ko sat koq'ui, xchiokab' heb'.

Ha t'a chonhab' Sion, tz'ab'chaj wal yoch ok'el yuj kusk'olal. Syalan heb' icha tik: Te ob'iltak onh, wan ko sateli, skab' wal syail yuj q'uixwelal. Ha tiknaik, yowalil skaktejkan ko chonhab' tik, yujto toxo ix laj em lanhnaj ko pat, xchi heb' tz'ok' chi', xchi Jehová.
Ex ix, maklejek eyab' slolonel Jehová, aq'ek wal och he chiquin t'a tas syala'. k'ayb'ejek heb' eyune' yet' heb' ix wach' eyak'an yet'ok yik tz'ok' heb' yuj skusk'olalil chamel.
Ha chamel toxo ix och t'a yoltak ko pat, toxo ix k'och t'a yoltak ko palakio. Slaj cham heb' unin t'a yoltak kalle, schampax heb' kelemtak t'a yoltak chonhab'.

Ix yal Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Al t'a heb' to a in swal icha tik: Toxonhej saktzipinak ol ajkan sniwanil heb' anima, icha tz'ajkan tzipan stza' nok' nok' t'a ak'liktak. Icha wal tz'ajkan ixim trigo manojail t'a spatik heb' sjochani tato malaj mach smolank'e waan ixim, icha chi' ol ajkan heb', xa chi, xchi Jehová t'ayin.

Ix yalanpax Jehová icha tik: Ha heb' jelan, mokab' yak'och sjelanil heb' chi' yipok sk'ool, heb' ay yip, mokab' yak'och yip heb' chi' yipok sk'ool, anhejtona' heb' b'eyum, mokab' yak'och sb'eyumal heb' chi' yipok sk'ool.

Ha in Jehová in swala', tato ay mach ay tas syak'och yipok sk'ool, a in okab' tzin yak'och yipok sk'ool, tzin yojtakaneli to a in Jehová in. Swak'elk'och swach'il in k'ool, tzin ch'olb'itan tas yaj anima t'a stojolal. Aton juntzanh tik snib'ej in k'ool sb'eyb'alej heb' anima, xchi Jehová.

Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Van sja stiempoal wak'an syaelal heb' aj Egipto, heb' aj Judá, heb' aj Edom, heb' aj Amón, heb' aj Moab yet' heb' kajan t'a tzinan lu'um, aton heb' sjoxel xil spak'ul sti'. Masanil juntzanh anima chi' ak'b'il kirkunkidar heb', palta max sk'anab'ajej jun trato sch'oxan jun yechel chi' heb', anhejtona' pax heb' israel max sk'anab'ajej heb', xchi Jehová.
Ha in Jeremías in tik, ix wal icha tik: E masanil ex wetchonhab' israel, maklejek eyab' tas syal Jehová.
Ha tz'alan t'ayex icha tik: Manh he b'eyb'alej sb'eyb'al juntzanhxo nakión, manh ex xiw yuj juntzanh tas sch'ox sb'ha t'a satcha’anh, icha syutej sb'a juntzanh ch'ok chonhab'il chi'.
Ha sb'eyb'al juntzanh nakión chi', malaj jab'ok yelk'ochi. Sb'at suykot junok te yib' te' heb' t'a kaltak te', haxo junok winh nhikum te' snhikan te' yet' syamk'ab'.
Slajwi chi' syak'anoch k'een plata yet' k'een oro winh yelwanub'ok. Smak'anb'at slawuxal te' winh yet' k'een martillo yik stzatzb'i te', yik max el k'otnaj te'.

Ha juntzanh yechel chi', lajan icha xib'tanub'al nok' much t'a skal junok awb'en. Max yal-laj sloloni. Yowalil skuchji b'eyek'ok, yujto max yal-laj sb'eyi. Manh ex xiw t'a juntzanh chi', yujto malaj chukal, ma wach'il syak' t'a heb' anima, xchi Jehová.
Mamin Jehová, malaj junokxo mach lajan ed'ok, yujto te niwan elk'ochi, te b'inajnak ach, syal uj smasanil.

Ach sReyal masanil nakión, ¿tom ay junok mach manh smojok xiw t'ayach? Smoj wal te niwan elk'och t'a masanil anima. Ha t'a skal heb' jelan yet' t'a skal heb' rey t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, malaj junokxo mach lajan ed'ok.
Masanil heb' anima chi' malaj spensar heb', malaj sjelanil heb', max yal sk'ayb'aj jab'ok heb' yuj juntzanh yechel b'ob'il t'a te te' chi'.

Ha juntzanh yechel komon Dios chi', b'ob'il yuj heb' tenum k'een, nab'a plata, aton k'een ik'b'ilkot t'a Tarsis yet' k'een oro ik'b'ilkot t'a Ufaz. Ha k'apak k'apak k'ik'mutz'inak yilji yet' k'apak chakchak k'apak ayoch spichulok. Masanil juntzanh chi', b'ob'il yuj heb' anima jelan spensar sb'oan tastak.

Axo Jehová, aton Dios pitzan, Dios t'a wal yel, Rey t'a junelnhej. Ayic skot yowal, tz'ib'xi wal lum lum tik yuj. Maxtzac yal-laj stek'b'an sb'a juntzanh niwak chonhab' t'a yichanh yowal sk'ol Jehová chi'.
Ex wetisraelal, alek t'a heb' ch'ok chonhab'il icha tik: Ha juntzanh komon Dios, manhok b'oannak satcha’anh yet' lum lum tik, ol satel t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, manhxa junok ol kanok, xe chi.
Ha Jehová b'oannak lum lum tik yet' spoder, a yet' sjelanil sb'onak yol yib'anhk’inal tik. Anheja' yet' sjelanil chi' sb'onak pax satcha’anh.

Ayic tz'awaj Jehová chi', tz'ib'xik'e ha ha' t'a satcha’anh, sk'e waan asun t'a chaanh yuj masanto b'aj slajwik'och lum lum tik. Tz'ek' kopoljok lheb'lon t'a skal niwak yaxnhab' yuj, sjakanelta ik' b'aj molan yuj.

Masanil heb' anima tz'ak'anoch komon Dios yipok sk'ool, malaj spensar heb', malaj tas yojtak heb'. Masanil heb' tenum k'een, tz'ak'ji q'uixwelal heb' yuj juntzanh yechel sb'o chi'. Ha juntzanh yechel sb'o heb' chi', malaj yelk'ochi, malaj spixan.
Ha juntzanh yechel chi', malaj jab'ok yopisio, smoj wal stzetzaji. Ayic ol jawok yaelal yuj Jehová, ol satelok.
Te ch'ok yel ko Diosal a onh yinhtilal onh winhaj Jacob tik. Ha b'oannak masanil tasi, ix onh sik'anpaxel a onh israel onh tik yik tzonh ochkan yikok. Ha sb'i, aton Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil.
Ex aj Jerusalén, oyb'ilxok'e ko chonhab' yuj heb' ajk'ool, molb'ejek masanil he k'ael.

Yujto syal Jehová icha tik: Ha tiknaik ol in molkot yaelal t'a he patik masanto ol yal eyamchaji. Masanil ex kajan ex t'a jun chonhab' tik, ol ex in pechb'at t'a najat, icha tz'aj sjuljib'at junok k'een k'een yet' ch'anh mejmeech, xchi.
