Ix walan a in Jeremías in tik: Ob'iltak in, wan wab'an syail. Ha wechen tik malaj yanhal. Ha jun yaelal tik wik yaji yuj chi' ol wak' techajok.
Toxo ix em lanhnaj ko pat, icha mantiado sd'inhchaj sch'anhal. Toxo ix cham heb' kuninal, ix onh yaktejkan heb', yuj chi' manhxa mach skolwaj qued'ok yik slich'ank'e jab'ok quenhul.
Ha heb' yilumal ko chonhab', malaj spensar heb'. Max sk'an sjelanil heb' t'a Jehová. Yuj chi' onh saklemb'at icha nok' kalnel.

Ab'ek wal sjawi jun ab'ix tik. Ay jun chonhab' skot t'a stojolal norte nhilili sk'anh skoti. Ha jun chi' ol ak'ankanoch juntzanh ko chonhab' tik tzinan lumal. Axonhej nok' niwak oques ol kajnajkan t'ay.
Mamin Jehová, wojtak sik'lab'il to a onh anima onh tik manh kojtakok tas ol aj quelk'ochi. Max nachaj kuj tastak sjawi t'a quichanh.
Ak' ko yaelal icha wal t'a stojolal, palta manhokab' yet' yowal a k'ool yik max onh a sateli.

Hak'uem yowal a k'ol t'a yib'anh juntzanh ch'ok chonhab'il, juntzanh chonhab' to manh ach ojtannakok, juntzanh chonhab' max yal sb'a t'ayach, yujto ix satel ko chonhab' heb' a onh yinhtilal onh winhaj Jacob tik. Junelnhej ix onh satel heb'. Ix laj yak'kan tzinan ko chonhab' tik heb', xin chi.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin Jeremías in tik icha tik:
Ab' wal tas syal in trato, tzalan t'a heb' aj Judá yet' pax t'a heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén.
Tzalan t'a heb' to a in Jehová sDiosal in heb', a in swala' to skatab'aj mach max k'anab'ajan tas syal in trato tik.

Aton in trato in b'onak yet' heb' he mam eyicham, ayik wik'annaquelta heb' t'a Egipto. Ha jun nakión chi', lajan yaj t'a heb' icha junok horno b'aj stz'a k'een hierro. Valannac t'a heb': k'anab'ajejinek, b'oek masanil tas swala'. Tato icha chi' tze k'ulej, ol ex och in chonhab'ok, a inxo ol in och he Diosaloc, xin chi t'a heb'.

Ha exxo pax tik, tato ol in he k'anab'ajej, ol wak'nhej elk'och in ti' wak'nak t'a heb' he mam eyicham, yik swak'an jun he lu'um, aton lum te yax sat b'aj ayex ek' tik, xchi Jehová, xa chi, xchi t'ayin. Yuj chi' ix in tak'wi t'ay icha tik: Ujokab' Mamin Jehová, xin chi.

Yuj chi' ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Al jun cheknab'il tik t'a juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a yol yik Judá yet' t'a yoltak skalleal Jerusalén. Tzalan t'a heb' anima icha tik: Maclejec eyab' jun trato tik, tze b'eyb'alan tas syala'.
Ayic wik'annaquelta heb' he mam eyicham t'a Egipto, cham wal walnak t'a heb' to scha yab' heb' tas swala'. Atax t'a jun pekti’ chi' masanto tiknaik ayinnhejoch walani.

Palta maj schalaj yab' heb', maj sk'anab'ajej heb', anhej to wach' pitb'inaquel spensar heb'. Yak'annakb'at sb'a heb' t'a skal chukal. Maj yal sk'ol heb' sk'anab'ajej tas swala'. Yuj chi' wak'nakb'at yaelal t'a yib'anh heb', icha yajkan t'a in trato chi', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ha heb' aj Judá yet' heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén, ix slajtiej sb'a heb' yik syik'anel sb'a heb' t'a yol in k'ab'.

Ix sk'ulejxi chukal heb' icha sb'eyb'alejnak heb' he mam eyicham. Aton heb' manh k'anab'ajannakok tas walnak, haxo t'a juntzanh komon Dios yak'nakoch spensar heb', yochnak heb' ejmelal t'ay. Ha pax tiknaik manhok chonhab' Israel, manhok pax chonhab' Judá sk'anab'ajan in trato in b'onak yet' heb' he mam eyicham chi'.
Yuj chi' a in wal Jehová in swala', ol wak'kot yaelal t'a yib'anh heb', manhxo ol yal skolan sb'a heb' t'ay. Olto awaj heb' t'ayin sk'anan in kolwal, palta manhxo ol in tak'wok t'a heb'.

Ichato chi' b'ian a heb' aj Judá yet' heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén tik, ol b'at snhus inkienso heb' yik sk'anan kolwal t'a juntzanh sdiosal chi'. Yujto a heb' aj Judá tik, tzijtum wal sdiosal heb', lajan sb'isul icha sb'isul schonhab' heb'. Anheja' pax heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén, te tzijtum altar ix sb'ok'e heb', icha wal skalleal chonhab', aton ta' snhus inkienso heb' t'a Baal, jun komon Dios yajb'entak. Palta manh ol yal-laj skolji heb' t'a syaelal chi' yuj juntzanh skomon diosal chi'.
Ach Jeremías, manh ach lesalwok yuj jun chonhab' tik. Manh al t'ayin, manh ach tewok t'ayin yuj heb', yujto manh ol in tak'wok, wach'chom ol sk'an in kolwal heb' t'a skal syaelal.

Ix yalan Jehová to swal t'a heb' wetchonhab' icha tik: Ex in chonhab' xajanab'il wuuj, malaj eyalan eyik he jawi t'a in kajnub', yujto manh jantakok tas yajb'entak tze k'ulej. Ha xepual yet' schib'ejal nok' he silab', manh ol yal ex skolanel t'a jun yaelal ol jawok t'a eyib'anh. Manhxo eyak'och q'uinh t'a in kajnub' tik.

Yujto ha t'a yalanhtaxo, lajan ex icha junok te' oliwo k'ayum xiil, te ay sat. Palta haxo tiknaik, ol ex in sateli, icha tz'aj slajwiem junok te te' sjekchaj sk'ab' yuj junok owal ik' nhab', stz'ab'at te' yuj sk'ak'al lheb'lon.

Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, a in ix ex wak' pitzwok ex aj Israel yet' ex aj Judá, icha yawchaj junok te te'. Palta toxo ix wala' to ol ex in satel yuj jantak chukal tze k'ulej, icha junok te te' stok'jik'eta t'a yol lu'um. Ix he tzuntzejkot yowal in k'ool, yujto ix he nhus inkienso t'a Baal, xchi Jehová.
Mamin Jehová, ix ak' wojtaquejeli to ay heb' ajk'ol t'ayin wan snaan in smilani. Ix a jak in pensar yik snachajel wuuj.

Junk'olal wajeq'ui, icha junok nok' kalnel tz'ik'jib'at b'aj smiljichamok, palta manh wojtakok tas wan snaan heb' t'a in patik. Syalan heb' icha tik: Co mak'ekchamok, yik wach' manhxa mach ol naankotok, icha wal tz'aj xikjiel junok te te' syak' sat, xchi heb'.

Mamin Jehová, Yajal ach t'a Smasanil, Juez ach t'a stojolal. Ojtac tas ayek' t'a ko pensar. Ak' wil tas ol aj ak'an spak t'a juntzanh anima tik, yujto toxo ix wab'enejoch t'a yol a k'ab' tas sna heb' t'a in patik, xin chi.
Ha heb' aj Anatot, ix sna heb' tas tz'aj in chami. Ix yalan heb' to tzin smilcham heb' tato anheja' walanel slolonel Jehová.

Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil ix alan yuj heb' aj Anatot chi' icha tik: Ayic ol in b'oan yaj yet' heb', a heb' kelemtak ol cham heb' t'a skal owal, haxo yuninal heb' yet' yisil, ol cham heb' yuj wejel.
Manhxa junok heb' winak ol kanok, yujto ol ja sk'ual ol in ch'olb'itan tas sk'ulej heb'. Ol jawok yaelal t'a yib'anh heb', xchi Jehová.

Ix walan t'a Jehová icha tik: Mamin Jehová, wach'chom wojtak to te tojol a pensar, palta in gana tzin telaj in b'a ed'ok. Tzin nib'ej tzin k'anb'ej juntzanh tik t'ayach: ¿Tas yuj wach'nhej yaj heb' chuk sb'eyb'al? ¿Tas yuj junk'olal yaj heb' anhej chukal sna'a?

Ha ach a b'onak heb', wach'nhej sq'uib' heb', icha junok te te' wach' sb'at sch'anhal yib', wach' sq'uib'i, syak'an sat, icha chi' yaj heb'. Anhej yet' sti' heb' syal wach' lolonel t'ayach, haxo spensar heb' najat yajeli.

Palta a ach tik Mamin Jehová, ojtak in. Tzila' jantak yajoch in pensar t'ayach. Ik'b'at juntzanh anima chi', icha tz'aj yik'jib'at nok' kalnel b'aj smiljichamok. Tza sik'kanel heb', yik wach' ol cham heb' t'a jun k'ual ayik ol miljokcham anima.

¿B'aq'uinh ol och waan stakji yib'anhq'uinal tik yet' stakjiel anh ank'ultak sk'ux nok' nok'? Anheja' nok' much wan scham nok' yuj schukal heb' anima kajan t'a jun chonhab' tik. Sna heb' to max il tastak sk'ulej heb', xin chi t'a Jehová.

Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin: Tato maj ach tzak'wan a b'ey yet' heb' sb'ey t'a yok, ¿tas wal ol aj a lajb'an a b'ey yet' heb' ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej? Tato manh junk'olalok ajek' b'aj sekan, ¿tas ol aj a naani tato tzach ek' t'a skaltak swayumtaquil stitak ha' Jordán?

Ijan spax ip, palta manto ojtakok to a heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach, aton heb' ayto uj a b'a yet'ok. Tz'awaj heb' skot heb' t'a a patik icha heb' pechum nok'. Wach'chom wach'nhej syutej lolon sb'a heb' t'ayach, manh ak'och heb' yipok a k'ool, xchi t'ayin.
Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ol waktejkan in chonhab' tik, ol in patiquejel jun chonhab' to wik yaji. Ol wak'och in chonhab' xajanab'il tik wuj t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ool.
Ha heb' in chonhab' wiktaxon yaj tik, icha junok nok' choj t'a kaltak te' tz'el yaw skoti, icha chi' syutej sb'a heb' t'ayin, yuj chi' tzin yajkanel heb'.
Ha in chonhab' tik, lajan wal icha junok nok' ch'akb'a ch'ok yilji, stzok'jicham nok' yuj juntzanhxo nok' yetch'akb'ail. Cotokab' masanil juntzanhxo chonhab' ul satel in chonhab' tik.

Tzijtum heb' yilumal heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ol satanel in chonhab' tik, ichato wan satanel te' uwa heb' awab'il wuuj. Ol stek'em lat'an in munlajel heb'. Ha lum lum nib'ab'il wuuj, taquinh lum ol ajkan lum yuj heb'.
Cuseltacxonhej ol ajkan in chonhab' tik yuj heb', ichato ol ok' lum t'ayin. Masanil in chonhab' tik, kuseltakxonhej ol ajkanok. Manhxa mach ol naan jab'ok yuj.

Masanil t'a tzalquixtak t'a tzinan lu'um, ol jawok heb' winh winak sateli, yujto a wespada a in Jehová in tik, a ol satanel masanil b'aj slajwik'och smakb'en in chonhab' tik. Manhxalaj junok mach junk'olal ol ajok.

Ix yawej ixim trigo heb', haxo te' q'uiix ix q'uib' sk'exulok. Nab'anhej ix munlaj heb'. Ix lajwiel yawb'en heb', q'uixwelalxo smolank'e jab'jab' sat yawb'en heb' chi', yuj wal yowal in k'ol t'a heb', xchi Jehová.

Icha tik swal a in Jehová in tik yuj juntzanh nakión te chuk t'a slak'anil Israel tik, to ix yik'ek' lum lum heb' ix wak' smakb'enej Israel in chonhab': Ol wik'el heb' t'a sluum junjun, haxo heb' aj Judá ol wik'el heb' t'a skal heb'.
Ayic toxo ix wik'el juntzanh ch'ok chonhab'il chi', ol ok'xok in k'ol t'a heb', ol wik'an meltzaj heb' t'a sluum yet' t'a schonhab' junjun.

Ha juntzanh chonhab' chi' ix k'ayb'an in chonhab' yak'an sti' t'a sb'i Baal. Axo ol ajok, tato ol sk'anab'ajej sk'ayb'ub'al in chonhab' tik heb', ol slokan in b'i heb' t'a tas syala', tato icha chi' ol yal yaj heb' t'a skal heb' in chonhab' tik.
Tato manh ol sk'anab'ajej heb' tas swal jun, a in wal Jehová in swala' to ol in satel heb' icha stok'jik'eta junok te te' yet' sch'anhal yib', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ixic, b'at man junok tzek'ul nab'a lino, tzak'anoch t'a a nanhal ayik manto juk'chajok, xchi t'ayin.
Ix in manan jun tzek'ul chi' icha ix yal Jehová, ix wak'anoch t'a in nanhal.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin:
Ik'b'at jun a tzek'ul ix a man chi', jun ayoch t'a a nanhal chi', tzach b'at t'a Perat. Ata' tza k'ub'ejel t'a sjatelal junok k'een tenam, xchi Jehová.
Ix in b'at b'ian, ix in k'ub'anel jun tzek'ul chi', icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'ayin.
Ix ek' junok tiempoal, ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ixic t'a Perat, b'at ik'xikot jun tzek'ul in cheknak b'at a k'ub'ejel ta', xchi t'ayin.
Ix in b'at b'ian, ix in joyan b'aj aykan chi' wuuj, ix wik'ankoti, palta k'haxo, manhxalaj yopisio.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin yik swaleli:
Icha tik ol aj in satanel yik'ojchanhb'ail Judá yet' Jerusalén.

Ha ex in chonhab' ex tik, te chuk ex, malaj he gana tze k'anab'ajej in cheknab'il, anhej tas tze nib'ej a tze k'ulej. Tzex och ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios, tzeyak'an serwil. Lajan ex icha jun tzek'ul manhxalaj yopisio tik.

Icha junok mach stzek'och junok tzek'ul t'a snanhal, icha chi' ix in k'ulej eyed' ex aj Israel yet' ex aj Judá, yik junnhej tzex aj wed'ok, in chonhab' eyaji, yik tzeyak'an ojtakajeli to b'inajnak in, niwan welk'ochi. Palta maj in he k'anab'ajej, xchi Jehová, xa chi, xchi t'ayin.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Al t'a heb' etchonhab' tik: Ha Jehová ko Diosal tz'alani: Junjun yet'tal wino, smoj sb'ud'ji yuj wino, xa chi. Ol yalan heb' t'ayach: Toxon kojtak to junjun yet'tal wino smoj sb'ud'ji yuj, xcham heb'.

Ol alan t'a heb' to a in swal icha tik: Ol wak' sat he k'ol he masanil ex kajan ex t'a jun chonhab' tik yuj yowal in k'ool, icha wal tz'aj sat sk'ol mach niwan wino syuk'ej. Ha heb' ol satel sk'ol chi', aton heb' rey yinhtilal winhaj Dawid, heb' sakerdote, heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok yet' masanil ex kajan ex t'a Jerusalén tik.

Ol wak' he mak'lajcham he b'a icha tz'aj spojb'at lum yet'tal wino ayik stenlan sb'a lu'um. Lajan ol yutej sb'a heb' mamab'il yet' heb' uninab'il. Ha in wal Jehová in swala', ol ex in sateli, manhxo ol ok'laj in k'ol t'ayex, xchi Jehová, xa chi, xchi t'ayin.
Ex aj Judá, a Jehová wan slolon t'ayex. Emnaquil tzeyutej he b'a, tze maklan eyab' tas syala'.

Alekk'eta he mul t'a Jehová ko Diosal, yakb'an manta tas skot t'a eyib'anh, icha sk'ulej heb' sb'eyek' t'a sat pak'an t'a skal k’ik’ k’inal. Tze na' to ol ja wach'ilal t'ayex palta te niwan yaelal ol kot t'a eyib'anh yuj Jehová, ichato ol k'ik'b'ok k 'inal ol eyila'.
Tato max he cha eyab'i, elk'altak ol in ok' yuj eyik'ojchanhb'ail chi'. Ol elta yal in sat, yujto ol ex ik'chajkanb'at t'a najat, xin chi t'a heb'.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin: Al t'a winh a reyal yet' t'a ix snun winh: Emanheccot t'a xilail he reyal, tzex em k'ojan t'a sat lu'um, yujto ol ik'chajel he korona manh jantakok swach'il yilji ayk'e t'a he jolom.
Ha juntzanh chonhab' t'a Neguev ol makchaj yuj heb' soldado, ol oymaj heb' t'a spatiktak, manhxa mach ol yal yochi. Masanil heb' aj Judá, ol ik'chajkanb'at heb' t'a najat.
Ixiquec k'elan t'a stojolal norte, tzeyilan skot heb' ajk'ool. ¿Tas yaj in chonhab' wak'nakoch t'a yol he k'ab' he tanhwani, aton heb' ayoch he b'inajb'ilok?
¿Tas ol eyala' ayik ol wak'anoch juntzanh anima eyajalilok, aton heb' eyak'nakoch yipok he k'ool? Ol ja yaelal t'a eyib'anh icha sjawi yaelal t'a yib'anh junok ix ix wan yalji yune'.
Ex aj Jerusalén, tato tze k'anb'ej tas yuj sjawi juntzanh tik t'a eyib'anh, nachajokab' el eyuuj to yuj jantak he mul, yuj chi' b'eran ex eli tzex eq'ui, tzex te ixtajpaxi.
Ha junok k'ik'al anima, tokwal syal sk'exmaj yilji. Ha spintotaquil nok' leopardo, tokwal syal sk'exmaji. Ichexta' te k'aynak ex t'a chukal, maxtzak yal sk'exmaj he b'eyb'al.
Yuj chi' ol ex in saklemejb'ati, icha tz'aj saklemkanb'at smatz'il ixim trigo yuj ik' skot t'a taquinh lu'um.
Aton wal tik aykanoch t'a eyib'anh wuuj, icha wal smojal. Yujto ix in b'atkan satk'olal eyuuj, axonhej juntzanh komon Dios tzeyak'och yipok he k'ool.
Ol ex wak'el b'eran, ol ex wak'an q'uixwelal.

Ix wil jantak eyajmulal, aton juntzanh q'uixwelaltak tze k'ulej. Yajb'entak tas tze k'ulej t'a lum jolomtak witz yet' t'a yichtak te te' k'ayum xiil. Ex aj Jerusalén, ob'iltak ex, ¿b'aq'uinh ol eyaktejkan he k'ulan chukal chi'? xchi Jehová.
Yuj wal jun niwan tiempo manhxalaj nhab' syak'a', yuj chi' ix lolon Jehová t'ayin Jeremías in tik, ix yalan icha tik:
Ha heb' aj Judá tz'ok' wal heb' yuj kusk'olal, manhxa yip schonhab' heb', toxonhej teltumb'a heb' t'a sat lu'um yuj kusk'olal. Sk'e wal yaw heb' aj Jerusalén yuj syaelal.
Ha heb' b'eyum, schekb'at heb' schekab' heb' ik'oj ha'. Sb'at heb' say ha' t'a yoltak jul, palta manhxalaj ha', malaj yol sch'ub' heb' smeltzaj heb'. Toxonhej smak sat heb' yuj q'uixwelal.
Sk'e tamaljok lum lum sjat yuj stak'inhal. Yuj chi' a heb' munlajwum, stak wal sk'ol heb', smak sat heb' yuj q'uixwelal.
Icha chi' nok' k'ultaquil chej, syaktejkan yune' nok' toto tz'alji, yujto manhxa anh ank'ultak sk'ux nok'.

Yed' nok' kaltakte'al b'uru, ha t'a tzalquixtak b'aj malaj ste'al skot tek'tek' nok'. Suk'lan ik' nok' icha nok' oques. Sk'unb'i wal yol sat nok' yilani, yujto manhxa anh ank'ultak wach' sk'uxan nok', xchi Jehová.
Mamin Jehová, wach'chom te niwan ko mul t'a a sat, palta kolwajanh t'ayonh yik wach' max ach alchaj chukal. Tzijtum el sko pitej ko b'a t'ayach, tz'ochpax ko mul.

Ha achnhej ayach och yipok ko k'ool, a achnhej pax ko Kolumal aji ayik ayonh och t'a syaelal. ¿Tas yuj icha ch'ok chonhab'il tzutej a b'ha t'a ko chonhab' tik, icha junok paxyalwum junnhej ak'wal tzek' t'ayonh?
¿Tas yuj lajan ach icha junok soldado satk'olal yaji syamji, maxtzak yal skolwaji? Palta Mamin, tik pax ayachek' t'a ko kal. Masanil chonhab' ojtannak to a chonhab' onh. Manh onh aktejkani, xin chi.

Aton juntzanh tik ix yal Jehová yuj heb' chonhab' israel: Ha heb' anima t'a jun chonhab' tik, te ay stzalajk'olal heb' sb'eyeq'ui. Sb'at heb' t'a jun, sb'at heb' t'a junxo. Yuj chi' manh jab'ok tzin tzalaj yet' heb'. Ha tiknaik ol in nakot schukal heb', ol in ch'olb'itan tastak sk'ulej heb', xchi.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Manh ach tewok t'ayin yuj swach'ilok juntzanh anima t'a jun chonhab' tik.

Wach'chom tz'och heb' t'a tzek'ojk'olal, palta manh ol in tak'woklaj t'a heb'. Wach'chom tzijtum silab' snhus heb' yet' jantak sat awb'en syik'kot heb' ofrendail, palta manh ol in tzalaj yet' heb'. Ol in satel heb' yuj owal, yuj wejel yet' pax yuj ilya, xchi t'ayin.

Ix in tak'wi t'a Jehová chi' icha tik: Palta Mamin Jehová in Diosal, a heb' syaloch sb'a a chekab'ok, syal heb' t'a heb' anima tik to malaj owal ol ochok. Malaj wejel ol jawok. Syal heb' to ol ak'nhej junk'olal b'aj kajan onh tik, xin chi.

Ix tak'wi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Tato icha chi' tz'aj yalanel heb' chekab' chi' t'a in b'i, wan yesan heb' syal chi', yujto manhok in tzin chek yal heb'. Malaj junok cheknab'il ix wak' t'a heb', maj in lolonpax t'a heb'. Ha juntzanh syal heb' chi' to a in ix wak' yil heb' yalani, palta manh yeloklaj, malaj yelk'ochi. Munil t'a yol yik heb' snachaanh juntzanh syal chi'.

Ha in Jehová in swal t'a juntzanh chekab' stek'b'ej sb'a yalanel t'a in b'i to malaj owal, malaj wejel ol jawok t'a yib'anh chonhab' tik, manhok in tzin chek yal heb', yuj chi' ol cham heb' yuj owal yet' yuj wejel chi'.

Yed' pax heb' anima b'aj syal heb' chi', ol cham heb' yuj owal yet' wejel. Ol cham heb' ix yetb'eyum heb' yet' yalyuninal. Toxonhej ol kan teljab' sniwanil heb' t'a yoltak skalleal chonhab' Jerusalén. Malaj mach ol mukan heb'. Icha chi' ol aj stupanel smul heb' ix yak'ochi.
Yuj chi' al juntzanh tik t'a heb' anima: k'ual dak'walxo yel yal in sat wok' yuj yaelal ayxo smay ix jawi t'a yib'anh heb' wetchonhab', yuj yaelal tz'ak'an echnaj heb'.

Ayic tzin ek' t'a kal munlajel swilani, ay sniwanil anima teltumb'a yajkan yuj owal. Axo yik tzin ochxita t'a yol chonhab' tik, swilani to wan scham anima yuj wejel. Axo heb' syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios yet' heb' sakerdote, toxo ix ik'chajb'at heb' t'a ch'ok chonhab'il manh yojtakok, xa chi, xchi Jehová t'ayin.

Yuj chi' ix walan icha tik: Mamin Jehová, ¿tom junelnhej ix ik'el heb' aj Judá tik t'a a k'ool? ¿Tom toxo ix a patiquejel chonhab' Sion? ¿Tas yuj ix onh ak' echnajok to maxtzak yal kanhtaji? Sco nib'ej junk'olal kaji, palta malaj jab'ok tas wach' sjawi t'ayonh. Sco na' to wach'nhej ol onh b'ey t'a quichanh, palta anhej tas ay smay ix ja t'a quib'anh.
Mamin Jehová, skojtaquejel ko chukal yet' pax spitalil heb' ko mam quicham. Ix och wal ko mul t'ayach.
Yuj wal yik'jichaanh a b'i, manhxo onh a patiquejeli. Manh a patiquejel jun chonhab' tik b'aj ay a despacho to niwan yelk'ochi. Nacot a trato ix ak' qued'ok. ¿Tocwal manh ol ak'elk'ochi?

Malaj junok komon Dios, sdiosal ch'ok chonhab'il ol yal yak'ankot nhab'. Ha satcha’anh max yal-laj yak'ankot yaxnhab' t'a yol yiko'. Mamin Jehová, ko Diosal ach, yuj chi' tzach kak'och yipok ko k'ool, yujto a achnhej tzak'kot juntzanh tik, xin chi t'a Jehová.
Ix tak'wi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Wach'chom a winhaj Moisés, ma winhaj Samuel tzul tewok t'ayin yuj heb', manhxo ol ok' in k'ol t'a in chonhab' tik. Al t'a heb' to tz'el heb' t'a wichanh, sb'at heb'.

Tato ay heb' sk'anb'an t'ayach, b'ajtil tzonh b'ati, tato xchi heb', al juntzanh swal tik t'a heb': Ha mach ayoch t'a yib'anh scham yuj ilya, ha' ilya chi' ol milanok. Ha mach ayoch t'a yib'anh scham t'a owal, ha t'a owal chi' ol chamok. Ha mach ayoch t'a yib'anh scham yuj wejel, a wejel chi' ol milanok. Ha pax mach ayoch t'a yib'anh yik'jib'at t'a ch'ok chonhab'il, ol ik'joknhejb'atok, xa chi.

Ha in Jehová in swala': Ol wak'kot chanh makan yaelal t'a yib'anh heb' anima tik: Ol cham heb' t'a skal owal, ol nherjok b'eyek' sniwanil heb' yuj nok' tz'i', ol chijokb'at heb' yuj nok' ostok, haxo nok' kaltakte'al nok' ol wach' lajanel heb'.

Ol jawok jun yaelal chi' yuj wal juntzanh chukal ix sk'ulej winhaj Manasés yuninal winhaj Ezequías t'a Jerusalén, ayik ayoch winh reyal t'a Judá. Masanil chonhab' t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, ol te xiw heb' yilanoch juntzanh yaelal ol jawok t'a yib'anh in chonhab' tik.
Ex aj Jerusalén, ¿machto wal ol ok' sk'ol t'ayex? ¿Machto wal ol kus sk'ol eyuuj? ¿Machto wal ol och ilk'olal eyuuj?
Ha in Jehová in swala', a ex tik ix in he patiquejeli, ex te juwieli. Toxo ix in te tzaktzaj ex wak'an niwank'olal, yuj chi' toxo ix wik'chanh in k'ab' wak'an eyaelal yik tzex in sataneli.

Ol ex wik'elta t'a yoltak he chonhab' t'a yol he makb'en tik, ol ex in saklemejb'at icha tz'aj saklem smatz'il ixim trigo yuj ik'. Ol wak'an satjoquel in chonhab' tik. Manhxa junok eyuninal ol wak'kani, yujto max yal he k'ol tzeyaktejkan he chuk b'eyb'al.

Vuujnhej tzijtum ol ajkan heb' ix ix ol cham yetb'eyum, icha wal yarenail sti' ha' mar maxtzak b'ischaji. D'a chimk'ualil ol jawok jun yaelal t'a yib'anh heb' ix nunab'il ayb'at yune' t'a owal, aynhej heb' nank'olal ol jawok kusk'olal yet' xiwk'olal t'a yib'anh heb'.

Ha heb' ix nunab'il manh jantakok yune', tz'el yip heb' ix yuj q'uixwelal, maxtzak yal yik'an yik' heb' ix, emnaquilxonhej tz'ajkan heb' ix. Ha k'ualil smeltzajkanoch t'ak'walil t'a heb' ix. Tato ayto heb' ol kan t'a yol schonhab' chi', a in Jehová in swala' to ol wak' miljokcham heb' yuj heb' ajk'ool, xchi Jehová.

Nunin, ob'iltak in. ¿Tas wal yuj ix in ak' aljok? Anhej wal owal yet' telajb'ail swak' yet' masanil anima. Malaj junok mach b'aj ix wak' tumin majanil, malaj pax mach b'aj ix in majnej k'een, palta masanil heb' tzin katab'ani.

Mamin Jehová, elokab'k'och b'aj tzin skatab'ej heb' chi' tato chuk ix wutej ach wak'an serwil, tato maj in k'an a wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, ayik ayoch heb' t'a kusk'olal yet' t'a syaelal.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Ex aj Judá, ¿tok ay mach syal smak'an kanhchaj k'een bronke yet' k'een hierro? Icha chi' yaj heb' ajk'ol ol kot t'a stojolal norte, manh ol techaj eyak'an owal yet' heb'.
Yuj wal jantak he chukal ex aj Israel, yuj chi' a wal he b'eyumal yet' masanil tas ay t'a sat he lum tik, ol wak' t'a heb' eyajk'ool chi'. Nab'anhej ol yik'b'at heb', manh ol stupkanlaj heb' t'ayex.
Ol ex wak'kanoch schekab'ok heb' eyajk'ol chi' t'a jun lum lum manh eyojtakok, yujto a yowal in k'ool lajan icha te' k'ak', ol ex satel yuj, xchi Jehová.
Mamin Jehová, ojtak smasanil, na in koti, kolin. Pactzitej t'a heb' wajk'ool. Mokab' ak' niwank'olal heb', paktzitej t'a heb' yakb'an manto in smilcham heb'. Ilnab' wal, uuj tzin sb'uch heb'.
Ayic tzalan a lolonel t'ayin tzin chanhej wab'i, anhej ayoch in tzalajk'olalok, yujto ik in Mamin Jehová in Diosal, Yajal ach t'a Smasanil.
Manh junnhejok tzin ek' yet' heb' stzalaj sk'ulan chukal. Yuj wopisio ak'nak, in ch'okoj tzin eq'ui, yujto swab' syail yowal a k'ol ed'ok.
¿Tas wal yuj malaj b'ak'uinh tz'och waan in yaelal icha junok echen malaj yanhal? ¿Tom ol in ixtej icha ha' eluma' stupemi?

Yuj chi' ix tak'wi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Tato tzach meltzajkot t'ayin, ol ach in chaxi, icha chi' b'ian ol yal in ak'an serwil. Tato max a komon alej komon lolonel, anhej tas niwan yelk'och tzala', a ach ol ach lolon wuuj. Ha heb' anima ol meltzajkot heb' ul yab'an a loloni, manhok ach ol a cha ab' slolonel heb'.

Lajan wal ol ach wutejkan t'a heb' etchonhab' tik icha junok muro nab'a bronke. Ol yak' owal heb' ed'ok, palta a in wal Jehová in swala' to manh ol ach yak' ganar heb', yujto ayin och ed'ok, ol ach in kolo'.
Ol ach in kolel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' chuk, ol ach in kolnhej t'a heb' milumcham anima, xchi t'ayin.
Ix lolon Jehová t'ayin, ix yalan icha tik:
Manh ak'och etb'eyum, manh ol aj uninal t'a jun chonhab' tik.
Ha in Jehová in tik ol wal t'ayach tas ol jawok t'a yib'anh heb' unin ol aljok t'a jun chonhab' tik yet' t'a yib'anh heb' mamab'il nunab'il.

Ol cham heb' yuj juntzanh ilya te ow, malaj mach ol ok' yuj heb', malaj mach ol mukan heb'. Toxonhej ol kan teljab' heb' t'a sat lu'um, icha tz'aj nok' nok'. Ha owal yet' wejel ol ik'an scham heb'. Axo sniwanil heb' chi', ol laj chijokb'at yuj nok' ostok yet' nok' chium nok' t'a kaltak te', xchi Jehová t'ayin.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Manh ach och t'a yol junok pat b'aj ayek' heb' anima iloj ak'wal yuj chamnak. Manh ach ok' yet' heb', manh ak' sniwanil sk'ol heb', yujto a in Jehová in swala' to ix wik'el junk'olal t'a heb', maxtzak in xajanej heb', maxtzak ok' in k'ol t'a jun chonhab' tik.
Ol cham heb' icham anima yet' heb' unin. Manhxalaj mach ol mukan heb', malaj mach ol ok' yuj heb'. Malaj mach ol yak' echnaj sniwanil, ma sjoxanel xil sjolom yuj sch'oxanel skusk'olal yuj heb'.
Manhxalaj mach ol b'oan wael yuj chamel chi', yik tz'ak'ji sniwanil sk'ol heb' ayto yuj sb'a yet' jun ix cham chi', wach'chom a heb' mamab'il nunab'il schami.
Anhejtona' manh ach och k'ojan t'a yol junok pat a wa'i yet' uk'an ha' b'aj ay junok q'uinh.

Yujto a in Jehová in Yajal in t'a Smasanil, he Diosal in, a in swal icha tik: Ol wak' lajwok q'uinh yik tzalajk'olal, icha q'uinh yik nupnajel t'a jun chonhab' tik. Ha t'a yol he tiempoal tik ol ujok jun tik, ol eyil wal.

Ayic ol alan jun lolonel tik t'a heb' etchonhab' tik, ol sk'anb'ej heb' t'ayach: ¿Tas yuj ol yak'kot jun niwan yaelal chi' Jehová t'a quib'anh? ¿Tas chukal ix ko k'ulej? ¿Tas ko mul ix och t'a Jehová ko Diosal? xcham heb'.

Tza pakan t'a heb' icha tik: Ha wal Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha heb' he mam eyicham ix in yaktejkan heb', ix b'at tzak'an heb' t'a spatik komon Dios, ix och heb' ejmelal t'ay. Ix in spatikanel heb', maj sk'anab'ajej sk'ayb'ub'al heb' ix wak'a'.
Ha exxo pax tik, ek'al te chuk tze k'ulej t'a yichanh heb' he mam eyicham chi'. Junjun ex tze k'ulej chukal skot t'a he pensar, maxtzak he k'anab'ajej tas swala'.

Yuj chi' ol ex wik'el t'a jun lum tik, ol ex wak'ankanb'at t'a junokxo chonhab' manh eyojtakok, manh yojtakok pax heb' he mam eyicham. Ata' k'ual t'ak'wal ol eyak' serwil juntzanh komon Dios. Manhxo ol ok' in k'ol t'ayex, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb'.
Palta a in Jehová in swak' in ti': Ha tiknaik, ayik slokan in b'i heb' anima tik, syalan heb' icha tik: D'a sb'i Jehová Dios ik'annaquelta heb' ko mam quicham t'a Egipto, xchi heb'.

Palta ol jawok jun pekti’, ol yalan heb' anima icha tik: D'a sb'i Jehová, aton ix ik'anelta heb' israel t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a norte yet' t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' b'aj ix saklemkanb'at heb', xcham heb'. Yujto a in ol wik' meltzaj heb' etisraelal t'a schonhab', aton lum lum wak'nakkan t'a heb' he mam eyicham.

Palta ayik manto ol ujok jun chi', ol wik'kot heb' yajk'ol heb' israel yik tzul yamji heb' yuj heb', icha tz'aj syaman nok' chay heb' yamum chay yet' schimpa, ma icha heb' pechum nok' sb'at tzak'an t'a spatik nok' nok' t'a tzalquixtak, tzek' sayan nok' heb' t'a yoltak k'een nhak'een yet' t'a yoltak sjatelal k'een.
Yujto swil masanil tastak sk'ulej heb'. Malaj junok mach syal sk'ub'anel sb'ha t'a yol in sat, ma sk'ub'anel schukal t'a wichanh.

Ol wak' spak t'a heb' yuj chukal sk'ulej chi', yujto ix yixtejb'at in lum heb' yuj juntzanh sdiosal to manh pitzanok, yajb'entak icha sniwanil junok chamnak. Ix sk'ulej heb' tas to max scha in k'ool, xchi Jehová.

Mamin Jehová, wilumal ach, in tanhwumal aji. Ha ach wal tzin a kolo' ayik ay in och t'a syaelal. Ol kot juntzanh chonhab' b'aj slajwik'och lum lum tik, ol ul yalan heb' t'ayach: Ha heb' ko mam quicham, anhej t'a juntzanh komon Dios malaj wach' yochi, malaj yopisio, anhej ta' yak'naquem sb'a heb'.
¿Tom syal sb'oan sdiosal heb' anima? Tato a heb' sb'oani, manh diosok syal chi', xcham heb', xin chi.
Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Yuj chi' t'a junelnhej ol wak' yojtaquejel in poder heb'. Icha wal chi' ol aj yojtakanel heb' to a in Jehová in a innhej Dios in, xchi.

Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Ex aj Judá, maxtzak el he chukal t'a he pensar. Max satlaj he chukal chi' t'a schiquintak eyaltar. Skan yechel icha letra tz'ochkan t'a junok k'een k'een yuj k'een kinkel ma yuj k'een diamante.
Ha heb' eyuninal snakot juntzanh altar heb', snaanpaxkot juntzanh te te' yechel komon Dios heb', te' ay t'a yichtak te te' k'ayum xiil t'a juntzanh tzalquixtak chaanh yajk'ei,
yet' t'a jolomtak witz t'a stitaquel chonhab'. Yuj he chukal tzeyak'och t'a juntzanh lugar yik ejmelal b'aj chaanh t'a masanil he makb'en tik, ol wak' elk'ajb'at he b'eyumal yet' tastak ay t'ayex.

Yowalil ol ex ik'joquel t'a sat lum he lum tik, aton lum ix wak' he makb'enej. Ol ex wak'kanoch schekab'ok heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayex t'a jun lu'um manh eyojtakok, yujto toxo ix kot yowal in k'ol t'ayex. Ha yowal in k'ol chi', lajan icha junok k'ak' malaj b'ak'uinh stupi, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ob'iltak heb' tzin ik'anel t'a sk'ool, haxo anima syak'och heb' yipok sk'ol yik skolwaj yet' heb' snaani.
Lajan wal heb' icha te' q'uiix t'a tzinan lu'um, malaj b'ak'uinh syil wach'il. Sq'uib'k'e te' t'a kaltak k'een yet' t'a lum lum ay atz'am atz'am t'ay yet' b'aj max yal skajnaj anima.
Palta te wach' yik heb' anima tzin ak'anoch yipok sk'ool.

Lajan wal heb' icha te te' awab'il t'a stitak ha ha', sb'at wal sch'anhal yib' b'aj sb'ey ha ha' chi'. Malaj sna te' wach'chom te ay k'ak', k'ayumnhej xil te'. D'a stiempoal malaj nhab', malaj jab'ok tz'ik'an te', malaj b'ak'uinh syaktej yak'an sat te'. Icha chi' yaj heb'.
¿Toc ay junok tas yelxo wal ak'um musansatil, icha spensar heb' anima? Malaj sb'onab'il jun spensar heb' chi'. ¿Mach wal syal yojtakaneli?
Ha in wal Jehová in tzin ch'olb'itej tastak ay t'a junjun pensar. Vojtak wal tastak tzek' t'a spixan junjun anima. Ha in swak' spak t'a junjun t'a smojal icha sk'ulej, xchi Jehová.

Ha heb' tz'och b'eyumal yuj ixtoj anima, lajan wal heb' icha junok nok' much smanhelta nholob' manh yikok. Ayic te tek'anto heb' ol ek'xok sb'eyumal heb' chi', haxo ol aj scheklaji to malaj spensar heb'.
Ha skajnub' Dios b'ob'ilkan yiktax yichb’anel, lajan wal icha junok palakio te wach' yilji, chaanh b'ob'ilkank'ei.

Mamin Jehová, a ach ayachoch yipok ko k'ol a onh israel onh tik. Masanil heb' tzach aktankani, ol q'uixwokkanel heb'. Masanil heb' tz'el t'a a tz'ey, ol satkanel heb' icha tz'aj satel junok b'i tz'ib'ab'ilem t'a kal pokok. Ol satkanel heb' yujto tzach yaktejkan heb', yujto a ach tik lajan ach icha junok sjaj ha ha'.
Mamin Jehová, ak' b'oxok in k'ool yik tzin b'oxikani. Col in, yik wach' tzin kolchajkani, yujto anhej t'ayach swal wach' lolonel.
Syal heb' anima t'ayin icha tik: ¿B'aq'uinh ol elk'och slolonel Jehová alnak t'ayonh? Elokab'k'och tas syal chi' tiknaik, xchi heb'.

Mamin, malaj b'aj ix in tewi t'ayach yik tzin k'anankot junok tas tz'ik'an satel heb' anima. Max in nib'ej pax sjawi junok yaelal t'a yib'anh heb'. Ha ach tik ojtak tas ix in k'ana', yujto t'a ichanh ix wala'.
Manh in ak'och t'a xiwk'olal, yujto a t'ayach tzin kol in b'a ayik ay in och t'a syaelal.
Q'uixwokab'kanel heb' tzin pechan b'eyek'ok, mokab' in q'uixwoquel a in tik. Xiwokab' heb' chi', mokab' in xiw a in tik. Ak'kot yaelal t'a yib'anh heb', satel heb' t'a junelnhej.

Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ixic, b'at ochanh linhan t'a spuertail chonhab' b'aj tz'eli tz'och heb' sreyal Judá. Ata' tzalel in lolonel. Ichanhej chi' tza k'ulej t'a juntzanh spuertail Jerusalén.
Tzalan t'a heb' anima icha tik: Ex rey yet' jantak ex kajan ex t'a Jerusalén tik yet' he masanil ex aj Judá, machtak ex tzex och t'a juntzanh puerta tik, ab'ek wal tas syal Jehová:
Tzeyil wal he b'a, manh he kuch eyikatz t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip, manh eyik'ochta t'a spuertail Jerusalén tik, yik max ja yaelal t'a eyib'anh yuj.
Manh eyik'paxelta junok eyikatz t'a yol he pat t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip chi'. Malajokab' junok munlajel tze k'ulej t'a jun k'u chi'. Niwanokab' yelk'och t'ayex icha ajnak walan t'a heb' he mam eyicham.
Palta manh schanakok yab' heb' tas walnak chi'. Spitejnac sb'a heb', manh sk'anab'ajejnakok skachnab'il heb' wak'nak.

Ha in wal Jehová in swala': k'anab'ajejek tas swala', manh eyik'kot eyikatz t'a spuertail chonhab' tik t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip. Niwanokab' yelk'och jun k'u chi' t'ayex, malajokab' junok munlajel tze k'ulej.

Tato tze k'anab'ajej tas swal tik, aynhej heb' yinhtilal winhaj Dawid ol ochnhej reyal t'a in chonhab' tik. Ol ochta heb' t'a spuertail yet' karruaje nherb'il yuj nok' chej, ajun heb' eyajalil ex aj Judá ex tik yet' pax heb' aj Jerusalén tik. Ha jun chonhab' tik malaj b'ak'uinh ol kan tzinan.

Ol laj kot heb' anima t'a junjun chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá, aton juntzanh ay t'a spatik yichanh Jerusalén tik, t'a yol yik Benjamín, t'a ak'lik, t'a tzalquixtak yet' pax t'a yol yik Neguev. Ol yik'kot nok' nok' heb' silab'il yik snhusjitz'ha t'a templo. Ol yik'paxkot juntzanhxo nok' silab' heb', ixim trigo, inkienso yet' ofrenda yik syak'an yuj diosal heb' t'ayin.

Palta tato manh ol he k'anab'ajej in cheknab'il tik jun, tato manh niwanok yelk'och jun k'ual chi' t'ayex, tato ol eyik'ochta eyikatz t'a spuertail chonhab' tik t'a jun k'u chi', ol wak' nhusjoktz'a masanil palakio t'a Jerusalén tik. Manhxa mach ol yal smak'an tup jun k'ak' chi', xchi Jehová, xa chi, xchi t'ayin.
Ix lolon Jehová t'ayin, ix yalan icha tik:
Ixic, emanh t'a spat jun winh tz'akum lu'um. Ata' ol wal jun lolonel t'ayach, xchi t'ayin.
Ix in em b'ian, wan stz'akwi winh t'a jun tz'aklab' tzek' sururok.
Ayic wan stz'akan jun lum chen winh, haxo ix aji ix ixtaxb'at lum t'a yol sk'ab' winh. Yuj chi' anheja' yet' lum slumal chi' ix sb'o junxo lu'um winh icha snib'ej.
D'a jun rato chi' ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik:

Ha in wal Jehová in swal t'ayex israel ex tik: ¿Tom max yal ex wutan icha syutej lum lum winh tz'akum tik stz'akani? Ha ex tik, lajan eyaj t'a yol in k'ab' icha yaj lum lum t'a yol sk'ab' winh tz'akum tik.
Q'uinalok a in tik tzin na' in juanb'ati, ma in satanel junok chonhab', ma junok makb'en,
palta tato a jun chonhab' chi' sna sb'a sk'ool, syik'anel sb'ha t'a skal chukal, anhejtona' in tzin k'expax in pensar, maxtzak wak'b'at jun yaelal chi' t'a yib'anh.
Q'uinalok tzin na' in b'oank'e junok chonhab' yet' wak'an q'uib'ok,
palta tato anhej chukal sk'ulej, max sk'anab'ajej pax tas swala', tzin k'expax in pensar, maxtzak wak' in wach'k'olal nab'il wuj wak'an t'ay.

Al t'a heb' kajan t'a Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén to a in swal juntzanh lolonel tik: Van in naan tas ol ex wutej, tas ol aj wak'anoch eyaelal, yuj chi' aktejekkan he chuk b'eyb'al, k'ulejek wach'il, xchi Jehová, xa chi.
Ol yalan heb' t'ayach icha tik: Manh ixtej a b'a onh a kachani. Ha onh tik ol ko k'ulejnhej chukal, icha tas skot t'a ko pensar ko k'ulani, xcham heb', xchi Jehová.
Yuj chi' ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: k'anb'ejek ek' t'a junjun nakión, tato ay b'aj ix ab'chaj sk'ulaj icha tas sk'ulej heb' etisraelal tik. Ha heb' tik yelxo wal te chuk tas sk'ulej heb'.
¿Toc ay junok tiempoal manh ayoquem k'een sakb'akom t'a jolomtak witz t'a yol yik Líbano? ¿Ay am b'aj stup ha ha' te siik skot t'a jolomtak witz chi'?

Palta a ex in chonhab' ex tik, manh junnhejok b'aj ayexkani, kotak skal tze k'exan he pensar. Tzin eyaktankani, haxo t'a tas manh diosok tze nhus inkienso. Ex satb'at t'a jun b'e aytaxon t'a peka'. Axo t'a b'e yik chukal b'aj tzex b'ati.
Yuj he chukal chi' ol kan tzinan he chonhab' tik. Ol te b'uchjoknhej. Masanil heb' ol ek' t'a tik, ol laj syum sat heb' ex stzetzani, yujto satub'tak ol aj yilji.

Icha tz'aj saklemb'at tastak yuj ik' skot b'aj sjawi k'u, icha chi' ol aj ex wak'an saklemb'at yuj heb' eyajk'ool. Ol in b'at mikan t'ayex ayik ol ja sk'ual sjawi he yaelal chi'. Manhxo ol in b'at k'elan t'ayex, xchi Jehová.

Ix yalan heb' anima chi' icha tik: Co naek tas skutej winhaj Jeremías tik yuj tas syal winh t'a quib'anh. Tocwal ol lajwoquel heb' sakerdote tzonh k'ayb'ani, ma heb' aj pensar tz'ak'an ko razón, ma heb' schekab' Dios tz'alan slolonel Dios chi' t'ayonh. Yuj chi' ko naekk'e esal lolonel t'a spatik winh, yik smiljicham winh. Manh ol ko k'anab'ajejlaj tas syal winh chi', xchi heb'.
Mamin Jehová, kotanh wal k'elan t'ayin, tzab'an wal tas syal heb' ayoch ajk'olal tik t'ayin.

¿Tom yet' chukal tz'aj spaktzitaj wach'k'olal? Ha heb' chi' toxo ix sna heb' tas ol yutej heb' in smilanchamok. Nacoti to ix in k'och t'a ichanh in tewi t'ayach yuj swach'ilok heb', yik max ak'kot yowal a k'ol t'a yib'anh heb'.

Axo tiknaik jun, ak' cham yuninal heb' yuj wejel yet' yuj owal. Canokab' heb' ix yetb'eyum heb' junixtaquil, manhxaokab' junok yune' heb' ix skani. Miljokab'cham heb' winh yetb'eyum heb' ix, haxo heb' winh yune' heb' ix quelemtakxo, chamokab' heb' t'a owal.
Ak'kot junok nhilanh soldado elk'um t'a skal heb'. Ab'chajokab' yel yaw heb' yuj syaelal, yujto ichato sjoy olan heb' b'aj ol in mukchajok, say modo heb' tas tz'aj in telwi t'a yol sk'ab' heb'.

Palta a ach tik Mamin Jehová, ojtak masanil tastak smol alej heb' t'a wib'anh yik tzin smilancham heb' yalani. Manh ak' niwank'olal heb', mokab' b'at smul heb' chi' satk'olal uuj. Satokab'el heb' t'a ichanh, ak'och syaelal heb' yuj yowal a k'ool.
Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: B'at man junok lum ch'ub', tzik'anb'at heb' yichamtak winaquil chonhab' ed'ok yet' heb' sakerdote ichamtak winakxo.
Tzach el t'a puerta b'aj tz'el heb' sb'at ak'ojkan k'alem t'a sch'olanil yik Ben-hinom, ata' ol al juntzanh lolonel swal tik t'ayach t'a heb'.

Tzalan icha tik: Ex sreyal Judá yet' ex kajan ex t'a Jerusalén tik, ab'ek wal slolonel Jehová ko Diosal Yajal t'a Smasanil: Ab'ek, ol wak'b'at jun niwan yaelal t'a yib'anh he chonhab' tik. Masanil mach ol ab'anok, ol sat sk'ol heb' yab'ani.

Yujto tzin eyaktejkani, tzeyak'anoch jun lugar tik yikok komon Dios. Tze nhusan inkienso t'a juntzanh komon Dios manh eyojtakok yet' heb' he mam eyicham. Manhxa yalnab'il jantak heb' unin malaj smul tze milchamok.
Ix he b'ok'e juntzanh altar b'aj tze nhustz'a heb' eyuninal silab'il t'a Baal. Tze k'ulan wal tas manhok in swak' he k'ulej, max ek' t'a in pensar juntzanh tas tze k'ulej chi'.
Yuj chi', a in wal Jehová in tik swala': Ay wal jun k'ual to a jun ch'olan tik, manhxo ol skuch Tofet, ma sch'olanil yik Ben-hinom, palta sch'olanil b'aj smiljicham anima ol sb'iejkani.

Yuj jantak anima ol cham t'a jun ch'olan tik, ol wak' ixtaxel tas nab'il eyuj ex aj Judá yet' ex aj Jerusalén. Ol ex wak' ak'jok ganar yuj heb' eyajk'ol snib'ej tzex milanchamok. Axo he niwanil ol och schib'ejok nok' ostok yet' nok' kaltakte'al nok'.
Ol ochkan he chonhab' tik tzinan lumal, xiwub'tak ol ajkanok. Ha heb' ol ek' t'a tik, ol xiw heb', ol sat sk'ol heb' yilani, ol b'uchwaj heb' yuj tas ol ajkan chi'.
Ol wak' he chilajb'at eyuninal yet' eyisil yuj wejel, ol wak'an he chilajb'at he b'a, ayik ol oymaj heb' ajk'ol t'a spatik he chonhab', xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb'.
Ayic slajwi alan juntzanh tik, tza mak'anpoj jun lum ch'ub' chi' t'a yichanh heb' anima ajun ed' chi',

tzalan t'a heb' icha tik: Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik: Ol in satel jun chonhab' tik, icha tz'aj smak'jipoj junok lum ch'ub' maxtzak yal sb'o junelxo. Ha t'a lum Tofet tik ol he muquem heb' he chamnak, yujto manhxa b'aj ol yal he mukan heb'.
Ha in Jehová in swala', icha chi' ol wutej jun chonhab' tik yet' heb' kajan t'ay, lajan ol aj icha ol aj Tofet tik.

Te yajb'entak ol ajkan masanil pat t'a Jerusalén tik yet' spalakio heb' sreyal Judá. Anhejtona' yajb'entak ol ajkan spanhanil yib'anhtak pat b'aj snhusji inkienso t'a k'een k'anal t'a satcha’anh yet' b'aj tze sequem wino ofrendail t'a komon Dios. Icha Tofet chi' ol ajkanok, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb', xchi Jehová t'ayin.

Ayic ix lajwi in k'ulan juntzanh tik, a in Jeremías in tik, in paxta t'a Tofet chi', b'aj ix walkanel slolonel Jehová. In och linhan t'a yol yamaq'uil stemplo Dios, ix walan t'a masanil heb' anima icha tik:

Ha Jehová ko Diosal Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik: Ol wak'b'at yaelal t'a yib'anh jun he chonhab' tik yet' t'a yib'anh juntzanhxo chonhab' ay t'a he lak'anil. Ol jawok masanil juntzanh yaelal toxo ix wal tik t'a eyib'anh, yujto ix he pitej he b'a, maxtzak he k'anab'ajej tas swala', xchi Jehová, xin chi t'a heb'.
Ay jun winh skuchan Pasur yuninal winhaj Imer, sat sakerdote yaj winh t'a stemplo Jehová. Ayic ix yab'an winh tas ix wal a in Jeremías in tik,
ix in schekan mak'jok winh, ix in schekan ak'jokpaxoch winh t'a te' kepo t'a spuertail templo t'a stojolal smakb'en Benjamín.

Axo t'a junxo k'u, a winh ix alani to tzin ik'chajel t'a yol te' kepo chi'. Yuj chi' ix walan t'a winh icha tik: Ha Jehová ix k'exan a b'i. Magor-misabib ol a b'iejkani, syalelk'ochi xiwk'olalnhej yaji.

Yujto syal Jehová icha tik: Ol wak'och xiwk'olal t'a ib'anh yet' masanil heb' wach' ak'an yet'ok. Q'uelan ach wal ochi ol miljokcham heb' a wach'k'ool yuj yespada heb' ajk'ool. Ha exxo aj Judá ex tik ol ex wak'och t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Babilonia. Ay ex ol ex yik'b'at winh t'a Babilonia chi', ayex pax ol ex smilcham winh.
Masanil he b'eyumal yet' masanil tastak ay stojol ay t'ayex yet' sb'eyumal heb' sreyal Judá ol wak'och t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ol chi', ol yik'anb'at heb' t'a Babilonia chi'.

Ha achxo tik ach Pasur, ol ach ik'chajb'at chekab'ok t'a Babilonia chi' yet' masanil heb' kajan ed' t'a a pat. Ata' ol ach chamok, ol ach mukchajkan ta' yet' heb' a wach'k'ool chi', aton heb' b'aj ix esejkanel in ti'ok, xchi Jehová, xin chi.
Mamin Jehová, tonhej ix in a montej. Ix in k'anab'ajan tas ix ala'. Yelxo te tek'an ach, yuj chi' ix in ak' ganar. Masanil tiempo tzin tzetzaji, masanil anima tzin b'uchan uuj.

Ayic swalan t'a heb' juntak el icha tik: Ol jawok yaelal t'a eyib'anh, ol ex lajwoquelok, xin chinhej t'a heb'. Yuj chi' aynhejoch heb' yalan chukal lolonel t'ayin, tzin sb'uchan pax heb', yujto swalel a lolonel.

Tato swala' to maxtzak ach wak' b'inajok, maxtzak walpaxel a lolonel, haxo tz'aji, icha te' k'ak' tz'aj a lolonel chi' t'ayin. Stz'ab'at in b'aquil yuj swab'i. Tzin nib'ej tzin och waan walanel a lolonel tik, palta maxtzak yal-laj.

Swab' wal sajson heb' in sb'uchani: Syalan heb' icha tik: Ina winh xiwk'olalnhej yaj tik, xchi heb'. Syalanpax heb': Koyec, b'at quik'ekchaanh esal lolonel t'a yib'anh winh, xchi heb'. Anhejtona' heb' in wach'k'ool, snib'ej heb' b'aj tzin lektaji. Syalan heb' wuuj icha tik: Co sayek modo tas tz'aj kak'an ganar kak'anek ek' ko pak t'a winh, xchi heb'.

Palta a ach tik Mamin Jehová, ayachnhej ek' wed'ok, icha junok soldado malaj mach tz'ak'an ganar. Ha heb' tzin pechani ol ak'jok ganar heb', a inxo jun manh ol in yak' ganar heb'. Ol q'uixwokkanel heb', manh ol satlaj sk'ol heb' t'a sq'uixwelal chi'.

Mamin Jehová, Yajal ach t'a Smasanil, a ach tza ch'olb'itej heb' tojol sb'eyb'al, tzilan tastak sna heb' anima. Ch'ox wil tas ol utej ak'an syaelal juntzanh anima tik, yujto toxo ix wak'och in b'a ab'enal t'a yol a k'ab'.
B'itejek Jehová, alek wach' lolonel t'ay. Ha skolanel heb' tz'ab'an syail t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ixtum anima.
Te chuk jun k'u b'aj aljinak in. Mokab' alchaj wach'il t'a jun k'u b'aj aljinak in t'a in nun.
Ob'iltak jun winak xid' alannak t'a winh in mam to ix alji jun yuninal winh yik stzalaj winh.
Satokab'el jun winak chi', icha juntzanh chonhab' ix satjiel yuj Dios t'a junelnhej. Yab'okab' winh yel aw yuj yaelal t'a q'uinhib'alil yet' aw yik ak'oj owal t'a chimk'ualil.
¿Tas yuj maj in mak'jicham yuj jun winak chi' ayik manto in alji? Tato icha chi', kannhejnak in am t'a ix in nun chi', ichato t'a ix mukchajnak in kani.
¿Tas wal yuj aljinak in? ¿Tom yuj wilan syaelal, yik tzin cham t'a q'uixwelal? xin chi.

Ha winhaj rey Sedequías ix chekankot winhaj Pasur yuninal winhaj Malquías yet' winhaj sakerdote Sofonías yuninal winhaj Maasías, yik sjawi heb' winh in yil a in Jeremías in tik, yik syalan heb' winh t'ayin icha tik:

Tzonh tewi t'ayach to tza k'an t'a Jehová kuuj, yujto a winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia, wan yak'an owal winh qued'ok. k'an t'a Jehová chi' to sch'ox spoder, icha sk'ulejnak t'a pekataxo, yik syik'anel winhaj Nabucodonosor chi', xchi heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix lolon Jehová t'ayin. Ix in tak'wi t'a heb' winh schekab' winh rey chi' icha tik: Alec t'a winhaj Sedequías chi'

to a Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, a tz'alani: Ol wak' meltzaj heb' a soldado t'a spatik, aton heb' tz'ak'an owal yet' winh sreyal Babilonia. Axo heb' soldado winh chi' aton heb' oyanxo och t'a spatiktak jun chonhab' tik, ol in molb'ejoch heb' t'a yol jun chonhab' tik.
Ha in ol wak' owal eyed'ok yet' in poder yet' pax yowal in k'ol te ay smay.
Ol wak'cham masanil heb' anima kajan t'a jun chonhab' tik, ol cham heb' yet' nok' nok' yuj jun niwan yab'il.

Ol lajwok chi', a achxo tik ach Sedequías, ol ach wak'och t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Nabucodonosor yet' t'a juntzanhxo heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach. Ol ach wak'och t'a yol sk'ab' heb' yet' heb' a chekab', heb' a soldado yet' heb' anima pitzanto ol kan t'a jun chonhab' tik, aton heb' olto kan yuj jun niwan yab'il, owal yet' wejel. Ha in wal Jehová in swala', manh ol ok' sk'ol jun winh rey chi' t'a heb', ol miljokcham heb' yuj winh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Al t'a juntzanh anima tik to a in swal icha tik: Swak' he sik'lej, ¿tom a he k 'inal, mato a he chamel?

Ha mach ol kan t'a jun chonhab' tik, ol cham yuj owal, yuj wejel yet' yuj ilya. Axo pax heb' ol el yak'och sb'ha t'a yol sk'ab' heb' aj Babilonia wan yak'an owal t'a jun chonhab' tik jun, manh ol chamlaj heb', tewelxonhej ol kolchaj heb'.
Ha in Jehová in swala', toxo ix in na' wak'ankot yaelal t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik, manhxook wach'il ol wak'koti. Ol wak'och t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Babilonia, haxo winh ol nhusantz'aok.

Alpax t'a heb' sreyal Judá yinhtilal winhaj Dawid icha tik: Scham wal eyab'an tas swal a in Jehová in tik: Wach'okab' tzeyutej he b'oan yaj yowal heb' anima t'a junjun k'u. Tze kol heb' tz'ixtaj yuj heb' ixtum anima. Tato chuk tzeyutej he b'oan yaj jun, ol kot yowal in k'ol t'a eyib'anh, icha te' k'ak' te ow sk'e nhilnhon yok manhxa mach syal stupani.

Ex aj Jerusalén, te chaanh eyajk'e t'a yib'anh lum ak'lik, icha yajk'e junok niwan tenam t'a lum ak'lik chi'. Palta a in Jehová in swala' to aykot yowal in k'ol t'ayex. Tzeyal icha tik: ¿Mach ol yal yak'an owal qued'ok? ¿Mach ol yal sk'eul b'aj sko kol ko b'a tik? xe chi.

Ha in Jehová in swala' to ol wak'och eyaelal icha wal smojal yuj tastak tze k'ulej. Ol wak'och sk'ak'al he palakio. Axo tastak ay t'a spatiktak he chonhab', ol lajwoquel stz'ab'ati, xchi Jehová, xin chi t'a heb' schekab' winhaj Sedequías chi'.
Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin: Ixic t'a spalakio winh sreyal Judá, tzalan juntzanh lolonel tik
t'a winh, aton winh yinhtilal winhaj Dawid. Tzalan pax t'a yichanh masanil heb' ayoch yopisio yet' winh yet' pax t'a heb' anima ay ta' to smaklej yab' in lolonel tik heb'.

Ha tojolal yet' wach'ilal a tze b'eyb'alej. Manh eyixtej heb' eyetanimail, manh eyixtej heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, ma heb' unin chamnak smam yet' heb' ix ix chamnak yetb'eyum. Manh he milcham heb' anima malaj smul.

Tato t'a wal yel ol he b'eyb'alej juntzanh swal tik, ol ochnhej heb' yinhtilal winhaj Dawid reyal t'a tik. Ayoch heb' t'a yol karruaje yet' t'a yib'anh chej ol ochta heb' t'a spuertail palakio tik, ajun masanil heb' ay yopisio yet' heb' yet' pax heb' anima.
Palta tato manh ol he cha eyab' juntzanh ix wal a in Jehová in tik jun, a jun palakio tik ol satelok, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb', xchi t'ayin.

Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik. Ha spalakio winh sreyal Judá, ha t'a yol in sat lajan wal icha swach'il yilji lum Galaad, icha pax lum jolom witz Líbano. Palta swak' in ti' swalani to ol meltzajkanoch icha tzinan luumal. Manhxa mach ol kajnaj t'ay.
Ol wik'kot heb' anima ay syamk'ab' yik owal t'a jun palakio tik yik satanel heb'. Ol smak'anelta te' k'ute' heb', aton te' manh jantakok swach'il ayoch spatzab'ilok, ol snhusankantz'a te' heb'.
Ol kot heb' anima t'a juntzanhxo chonhab', ol ek' heb' t'a stz'ey jun chonhab' tik, ol laj sk'anb'an heb' t'ay junjun: ¿Tas yuj icha tik ix yutej jun niwan chonhab' tik Jehová? xcham heb'.

Ol tak'wok juntzanhxo heb' icha tik: Icha tik ix yutej Jehová sDiosal heb', yujto ix yaktejkan strato heb' sb'onak yet'ok, haxo t'a juntzanh komon Dios b'aj ix och heb' ejmelal, xcham heb', xchi Jehová.

Manh ex ok' yuj schamel winhaj Josías, ok'anhek yuj winhaj Salum yuninal winhaj Josías chi'. Yujto ix ik'jib'at winh t'a junelnhej, manhxa b'ak'uinh ol meltzaj winh, manhxo ol yil-laj schonhab' winh b'aj aljinak. Ha yuj winhaj Salum chi', winh ix och sreyalok Judá ayik toxo ix cham winh smam winh chi', a Jehová tz'alan yuj winh icha tik. Ix ik'jiel winh t'a jun chonhab' tik, manhxo ol meltzajlaj winh.
Ha t'a jun chonhab' b'aj ix ik'jib'at winh chi', ata' ol cham winh. Manhxo ol ul yilxi schonhab' winh tik.
Ob'iltak ach, yuj wal a chukal tza b'oank'e a palakio yet' a niwak pat. Tzak' munlaj heb' anima, palta max a tuplaj sk'u heb'.

Tzalan icha tik: Ol in b'ok'e junok in niwan palakio, haxo t'a yib'anh ol in b'ok'e juntzanhxo lewan tz'aj yool. Ol jakwokkan swentenail, haxo te' k'ute' ol wak'och yichtakok, haxo yelaw, chakchak ol ajok, xa chi.

¿Am a naani to yujnhejto ayachek' t'a yoltak pat nab'a k'ute' ayoch t'ay, yuj chi' rey ach to niwan elk'ochi? Ha winh a mam ix yak' tzalajb'ok sk'ol winh, yujto tojol ix yutej sb'a winh, wach'nhej tas ix sk'ulej winh, yuj chi' wach'nhej ix ajelk'och winh.
Ix skol heb' meb'a' winh yet' heb' tz'ixtaj yuj heb' chuk spensar. Yuj chi' wach'nhej ix elk'och winh. Ha in Jehová in swala' to a sb'eyb'al winh chi' sch'oxani to yojtak in winh.
Palta a ach tik, anhej b'eyumal tza nib'ej t'a spatik chukal. Tza chekan miljokcham heb' anima malaj smul, tzixtan heb' etchonhab', xchi Jehová.

Syal Jehová yuj winhaj Joacim yuninal winhaj Josías sreyal Judá icha tik: Malaj heb' ol ok' yuj schamel winh. Malaj heb' ol alan icha tik: Ay, ach wetanimail. Ob'iltak onh. Toxo ix cham winh ko reyal, icha ko mam yaj winh, manh xchiok heb'.
Icha tz'aj junok nok' chamnak b'uru, icha chi' ol utaj winh, ol nherchajkanel winh t'a tiel chonhab' Jerusalén, xchi Jehová.

Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ex aj Judá, k'eanhek t'a jolom witz Líbano tzex awaj ta'. Te chaanh tzex awaj t'a jolomtak witz yik Basán yet' t'a tzalquixtak yik Abarim, yujto masanil heb' ayoch eyed'ok toxo ix satel heb'.
Ha in tik, ix wal t'ayex yik wach' eyajek' t'a he chonhab', palta maj yal he k'ol ix eyab'i. Ichanhej chi' ix eyutej he b'a yiktax wanto eyoch chonhab'il, toxon max he cha eyab' tas swala'.

Ol ik'jokb'at heb' eyajalil yuj heb' ajk'ool, icha yik'jib'at junok tas yuj owal ik', haxo heb' ayoch eyed'ok ol ik'jokb'at heb' t'a junokxo ch'ok chonhab'il. Toxonhej ol ex q'uixwokkanok. Manhxa ol ajkan eyelk'och yuj jantak he chukal.

Ha tiknaik, te tzalajk'olal eyajek' t'a he pat nab'a k'ute' kotnak ste'al t'a Líbano. Palta ayik ol jawok yaelal t'a eyib'anh, ol el eyaw eyab'an syail, icha yab'an syail junok ix ix tz'alji yune', xchi Jehová.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Jeconías yuninal winhaj Joacim sreyal Judá: Wach'chom aylaj tzach och wuj icha junok kolk'ab' ayoch t'a swach' k'ab' heb' niwak winak, palta swak' in ti' to ol ach in julkaneli.
Ol ach wak'kanoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ol b'aj tzach te xiwi, heb' snib'an ach smilanchamok, aton winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia yet' heb' ajun yet'ok.
Ol ach wak' ik'jokb'at yet' ix a nun t'a lum lum b'aj manhok ta' ex alji, ata' ol ex cham he chawanhil.
Manhxo ol ex meltzaj t'a tik, wach'chom olto he nib'ej meltzajxi he b'a, xchi Jehová.
¿Tom lajan winhaj Jeconías tik yet' junok lum chen pojeltak manhxa yopisio, ma icha junok yamk'ab' manhxa mach snib'ani? ¿Tas yuj sjuljikanb'at winh yet' heb' yinhtilal t'a jun lum lum manh yojtakok?
Ab'ek wal ex aj Judá, scham wal eyab'an tas syal Jehová.

Ha Jehová tz'alanxi icha tik: Tz'ib'chajokab'kan b'aj ay sb'i heb' yinhtilal heb' rey to a jun winak tik, lajan tz'ajkan icha junok winak malaj yuninal, icha junok winak manh wach'ok ix aj yelk'ochi. Yujto manhxa junok yinhtilal winh ol och reyal t'a spalakiokan winhaj Dawid, syak'anxi reyal t'a Judá tik, xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ex yilumal in chonhab', ob'iltak ex, lajan ex icha junok tanhwum kalnel smilancham nok' skalnel chi', saklemkanb'at nok' yuj. Icha chi' tzeyutej heb' in chonhab' tik, xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, a tz'alan t'a heb' yilumal schonhab' tz'ak'an yajalil t'ay: Ex yilumal in chonhab', ix he saklemkanb'at heb' in chonhab', ix he xib'tankanb'at heb', maj he tanhwej heb'. Yuj chi' a in Jehová in tik swala', ol wak'och eyaelal yuj tas ix he k'ulej chi'.
Axo heb' ix in saklemkanb'at t'a juntzanhxo ch'ok chonhab'il, a in Jehová in tik swala', ol wik' meltzaj heb'. Ol wak'anxi kajnaj heb' t'a schonhab', ol wak'anxi q'uib' sb'isul heb'.
Ol wak'anoch yilumal heb', yik maxtzak xiw heb', manhxa junok heb' ol satok, xchi Jehová.

Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Ay jun k'u ol jawok, ol wak'och jun yinhtilal winhaj rey Dawid reyal t'a in chonhab' tik. Ha jun rey chi' te tojol spensar. Yed' sjelanil ol yak' reyal, tojol ol yutej sch'olb'itan masanil chonhab'.
Ha t'a stiempoal ol yak' reyal chi', ol kolchajkanel heb' aj Judá yet' pax heb' aj Israel, manhxalaj tas ol sna heb'. Aton jun b'i tik ol ak'jok sb'iok: Ha Jehová sb'oanel tas tzonh aj t'a stojolal.

Ha tiknaik, slok in b'i heb' anima tik, syalan heb' icha tik: Yojtak wal Jehová, jun ik'annaquelta heb' ko mam quicham t'a Egipto, xchi heb'. Palta swak'kan in ti' tiknaik to ay jun k'u ol jawok ol yal heb' icha tik: Yojtak wal Jehová, jun ix onh ik'anelta t'a norte yet' t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' b'aj ix onh saklemkanb'ati, xcham heb'. Ichato chi' ol kajnajxi heb' israel chi' t'a sluum, xchi Jehová.

Icha tik ix wal t'a heb' syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios: Ha Jehová ix alan jun lolonel niwan yelk'och t'ayin. Yuj chi' ix och wal pitz'an t'a in pixan sik'lab'il, ix ib'xik'e in niwanil. Icha squetkonek' heb' uk'um anh toxo wal stelwi, icha chi' ix in aji.

Ha heb' anima kajan t'a jun chonhab' tik, anhej wal ajmulal sk'ulej heb', syak' wal yip heb' sk'ulan chukal. Ha heb' niwak yelk'ochi, anhej ixtoj anima syak' heb'. Yuj chi' toxo ix katab'aj lum lum tik yuj Jehová, toxo ix takjiel lu'um, toxo ix tz'ab'at anh ank'ultak b'aj swa nok' nok'.
Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha wal heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok tik yet' heb' sakerdote, malaj welk'och t'a yol sat heb'. Swil wal sk'ulan chukal heb' t'a yol in templo.

Ha in Jehová in swala' to yuj chi' te k’ik’ k’inal ol ajkan sb'e heb', te nhereri ol aj paxok. Ichato ol ekchajb'at heb', ol telwok heb'. Axo yik ol in ch'olb'itan heb', ol wak'ankot yaelal te ya t'a yib'anh heb'.
Vilnac wal heb' yalnakoch sb'a in chekab'ok t'a Samaria, te chuk tas sk'ulejnak heb'. Yalnaquel slolonel Baal heb', icha chi' aj skuchb'annak satb'at in chonhab' Israel heb'.

Ix wilpax heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok t'a Jerusalén, te chuk tas sk'ulej heb'. Anhej ajmulal sk'ulej heb', ixtum anima pax heb', syiptzitan heb' sk'ulan chukal heb'. Malaj junok mach syaktejkan sk'ulan chukal. Ha wal tz'aj wilani, a juntzanh anima tik yet' heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén, lajan wal heb' yet' heb' aj Sodoma yet' heb' aj Gomorra.

Yuj chi' a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, swal juntzanh lolonel tik yuj juntzanh heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok chi': Yujto yuj heb' sk'echaanh chukal t'a masanil smakb'en heb' tik, yuj chi' ol wak' tas k'a' swa heb' yet' yuk'ej heb', to scham anima yuj.

Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil swal icha tik: Ex aj Israel, manh eyak'och tas syal heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok chi' yipok he k'ool, yujto a tas syal heb' chi' esnhej, t'a yol yik heb' snaelta, manhok in tzin chek yal heb'.

Ha t'a heb' b'aj malaj yelk'och in lolonel, ata' syal heb' icha tik: Wach'nhej ol aj eyelk'ochi, xchi heb'. Ha t'a heb' stek'b'ej sb'a sk'ulan tas snaelta t'a yol yiko', syal heb' icha tik: Malaj junok yaelal ol jawok t'a eyib'anh, xchi heb'.
Palta a in Jehová in, a in swala' to a heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok chi', malaj junelok xid'ek' heb' b'aj tz'och molchajel, ayik tzin lolon yet' heb' in chekab'. Malaj junelok syab' heb' in loloni.
Te chuk heb', yuj chi' ol wak'och syaelal heb' yet' yowal in k'ool. Ha yowal in k'ol chi' lajan wal icha junok owal ik' nhab' sja xumnajok.
Manh ol wanaj yowal in k'ol chi', masanto ol elk'och tas nab'il wuuj. Ato b'ak'uinh, ol nachajel juntzanh tik eyuuj.
Manhok in tzin chek juntzanh chekab' chi', malaj tas swal t'a heb'. Tonhej skomon b'at lemnaj heb' yalel slolonel chi' t'a in b'i.
Comonoc syojtaquejel heb' tas nab'il wuuj, a am in lolonel syal heb' t'a in chonhab'. Tato icha chi', toxom ix yaktejkan schuk b'eyb'alil in chonhab' tik, manhxa am chukal sk'ulej heb'.
Ha in Jehová in swalxi icha tik: Wach'chom t'a lak'an, ma t'a te najat, a in tik Dios innhej t'a smasanil b'aj.
Ha in wal Jehová in swala': Malaj junok b'aj wach' he k'ub'anel he b'a t'ayin. ¿Tom manh eyojtakok to ayinnhej ek' t'a masanil satcha’anh yet' t'a masanil sat lu'um?
Swab' wal tas syal juntzanh chekab' esalwum chi', stek'b'ej wal sb'a heb' yalani to a in lolonel syal heb', a in tzin lolon t'a heb' t'a swayich yalani.
¿B'aq'uinh ol yaktej juntzanh syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok chi' yalan esal lolonel chi'? ¿B'aq'uinh ol yaktej heb' yalan juntzanh lolonel tonhej snak'e t'a yol yik chi'?

Ha heb' chi' sna heb' tas tz'aj in b'atkan satk'olal yuj in chonhab' yuj swayich heb' syal-laj t'ay junjun, icha wal sk'ulejnak heb' he mam eyicham, ayik in b'atnak satk'olal yuj heb', axonhej komon Dios Baal b'aj yak'naquem sb'a heb'.

Ha in wal Jehová in swala': Tato ay junok chekab' chi' ay tas swayichej, yalokab'i to wayich. Palta tato a in lolonel scha jun, yalokab' t'a sjichanil. ¿Tom lajan yopisio ixim sat trigo yet' yok? Icha chi' in lolonel, manh lajanok yet' wayich. Ha in lolonel lajan wal icha te' k'ak', ma icha k'een almágana chok' tz'aj k'een niwak k'een yuj.
Yuj chi', te aykot yowal in k'ol t'a juntzanh chekab' tonhej syal-laj yab' slolonel junjun, syalan heb' to a in lolonel syal heb'.
Ha in swala', te aykot yowal in k'ol t'a juntzanh chekab' te wach' syutej sloloni, syalan heb' to a in lolonel syalel heb'.

Ha in swala', te aykot yowal in k'ol t'a juntzanh chekab' stz'ak yal swayich. Ha yuj juntzanh niwak esal lolonel syal heb' chi', satkanb'at heb' in chonhab'. Manhok in tzin chekb'at heb', manhok in swak' in cheknab'il t'a heb', yuj chi' malaj tas wach' yik'an heb' in chonhab' tik t'a heb', xchi Jehová.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ach Jeremías, tato ay junok anima t'a yol chonhab' tik, ma junok syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok, ma junok sakerdote sk'anb'an t'ayach: ¿Tas syal srazón Jehová? tato xchi heb'. Tzalan t'a heb' icha tik: Lajan ex icha wal junok ikatz t'a Jehová, yuj chi' ol ex aktajem yuj, xa chi.
Tato a junok chekab', ma junok sakerdote, ma junok komon anima tz'alan icha tik: Srazón Jehová, tato xchi heb', a in ol wak'och yaelal t'a yib'anh heb' yet' heb' kajan yet'ok.
Tato ay junok mach sk'anb'an t'a junok yamigo, ma t'a junok sk'ab' yok yuj tas swala', syal yalan icha tik: ¿Tas ix yutej Jehová spakani? ma ¿tas ix yal Jehová? xchiokab'i.

Palta max yal yalan icha tik: Ha srazón Jehová tzin k'anb'ej. Tato syal icha chi', a jun lolonel chi' ol meltzajkanoch ikatzil t'ay. Yujto ix yixtejb'at heb' anima tik tas swal a in he Diosal pitzan in tik, Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil.
Icha tik tz'aj he k'anb'an t'a jun in chekab': ¿Tas spak ix yal Jehová, ma tas ix yala'? xe chi.
Ach Jeremías, tato tzato yal heb': Srazón Jehová, tato xchi heb', tzal t'a heb' icha tik: Ha wal Jehová tz'alani: Yujto a ex tik tzeyalnhej juntzanh lolonel b'aj ix ex in kacha' to maxtzak eyala',
yuj chi' ol ex b'at satk'olal wuuj yet' pax jun chonhab' ix wak' t'ayex yet' t'a heb' he mam eyicham. Najat ol ex in yumkaneli.
Masanil tiempo ol ex wak'kan q'uixwelal, manhxalaj jab'ok yelk'och ol ex ajkanok. Manhxo ol b'at satk'olal eyuj tas ol ex utaj chi', xchi Jehová.

Ha winhaj Jeconías sreyal Judá, yuninal winhaj Joacim, ix ik'jib'at winh preso yuj winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia. Ix ik'chajpaxb'at heb' ayoch yajalil yet' winh, heb' b'oum pat yet' heb' tenum k'een. Ixlajwi chi' icha t'a wayichal ix aj sch'oxan chab' mooch sat te' higo Jehová t'ayin, ayek' t'a yichanh templo.
Ha t'a yol junok mooch chi', ayem te' sat higo te wach', q'uinhxo, aton te' b'ab'el sat, haxo t'a yol junxo te' mooch chi', ayem te' higo te chukxolaj, maxtzak yal-laj ko loani.

Axo ix sk'anb'an Jehová t'ayin: ¿Jeremías, tas tzil chi'? xchi. Ix in tak'wi, ix walani: Ay chab' mooch te' sat higo swila'. Ay te' manhxo jantakok swach'il, ay pax te' te chukxolaj, maxtzak yal-laj ko loani, xin chi.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik:

Ha in Jehová he Diosal in swala': Icha wal sat te' higo wach' chi', icha chi' yaj chonhab' Judá t'a yol in sat, aton heb' ix wak' ik'jokb'at t'a smakb'en heb' kaldeo. Te wach' ol wutok in b'ha t'a heb'.
Ol in tanhwejnhej heb', ol wik'anxi meltzaj heb' t'a jun schonhab' tik. Ha tik ol wik'chaanh heb', manhxo ol in satel-laj heb'. Icha wal to ol wawejem heb', manhxo ol in tok'k'eta heb'.
Ol wak' wal spensar heb', yik syojtaquejel heb' to a in ton Jehová Dios in. Ol och heb' in chonhab'ok, a inxo ol in och sDiosalok heb'. Yujto t'a smasanil sk'ol heb' ol meltzajkot t'ayin.

Axo winhaj Sedequías sreyal Judá, heb' yajal yaj yet' winh yet' masanil heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén, aton heb' ixto kan kajan t'a tik yet' pax heb' ix k'och kajan t'a Egipto, lajan wal heb' t'a yol in sat icha sat te' higo te chukxolaj chi', aton te' maxtzak yal sloji.

Ol wak'b'at junok niwan yaelal t'a yib'anh heb'. Ol te xiw juntzanhxo ch'ok nakional yuj. Manhxalaj ol ajkan yelk'och heb'. Ha heb' anima t'a juntzanh nakión b'aj ol in saklemejb'at heb' chi', ol te b'uchwaj heb' t'a heb', ol b'ajjok heb' yuj heb', ol jawok katab' t'a yib'anh heb'.
Ol wak'b'at owal, wejel yet' ilya t'a yib'anh heb'. Manhxa junok heb' ol kan t'a sat lum lum ix wak' t'a heb' yet' t'a smam yicham heb', xchi Jehová.

Ayic schanhil ab'il yoch winhaj Joacim yuninal winhaj Josías reyal t'a Judá, aton yik b'ab'el ab'il yoch winhaj Nabucodonosor reyal t'a Babilonia, ix lolon Jehová t'ayin a in Jeremías in tik yuj tas ol aj chonhab' Judá.
Ix walan jun lolonel tik t'a masanil heb' anima ay t'a yol yik Judá yet' t'a masanil heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén. Yuj chi' ix walan icha tik:

Ayic 13 ab'il yoch winhaj Josías yuninal winhaj Amón reyal t'a Judá tik, ix el yich slolon Jehová t'ayin, yuj chi' 23 ab'ilxo slolonnhej t'ayin. Tzijtum el ix wal t'ayex, palta manh jab'ok tze cha eyab'i.
Wach'chom tzijtum el ix schekkot heb' schekab' Jehová t'ayex, palta maj he chanhej eyab' tas ix chekji yal heb', maj he k'anab'ajej.
Ix yal wal heb' t'ayex to tzeyaktejkan he chuk b'eyb'al, yik wach' tzex kajnajnhej t'a lum lum yak'nak Jehová t'a heb' ko mam quicham.

Manh ex b'at t'a spatik komon Dios, manh ex och ejmelal t'ay. Manh he tzuntzejkot yowal sk'ol Jehová yuj eyoch ejmelal t'a juntzanh Dios to a ex tze b'o tik, yik wach' max yak'kot junok yaelal Jehová t'a eyib'anh, xchi heb' schekab' chi'.

Axo tiknaik, syal Jehová icha tik: Ha ex tik max yal he k'ol tze cha eyab' tas swala'. Tze tzuntzej wal kot yowal in k'ool, yujto tzex och ejmelal t'a juntzanh he diosal tze b'o'o. Yuj chi' anheja' ex tzeyik'kot yaelal t'a eyib'anh, xchi Jehová.
Yuj chi' syalanxi Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil icha tik: Yujto max he cha eyab' tas swala',

yuj chi' ol wawtejkot masanil juntzanh ch'ok chonhab'il skot t'a norte yet' pax winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia. Ol wak'lab'ej winh yik sjawi winh yet' juntzanh chonhab' chi' yak' owal t'a jun chonhab' tik yet' t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' ay t'a slak'anil yet' heb' anima kajan t'ay. Ol wak' satel heb' smasanil. Junelnhej ol wak' lajwoquel heb'. Ha heb' ol ilanok, ol xiwk'e heb', ol b'uchwaj heb' t'a heb'.
Ha wal ol wutejkan heb' chi', manhxa b'aj ol ab'chaj yoch b'it yik q'uinh yuj tzalajk'olal, ma b'it yik nupnajel. Manhxa b'aj ol ab'chaj sk'anh k'een cha', manhxa b'aj ol ilchaj yok kandil.
Masanil jun chonhab' tik ol kan tzinan, ol em lanhnajok. Ha jun chonhab' tik yet' juntzanhxo chonhab' ay t'a slak'anil tik, 70 ab'il ol kan t'a yalanh smandar winh sreyal Babilonia chi'.

Ha in wal Jehová in swak' in ti', ayik ol lajwok 70 ab'il chi', ol in ch'olb'itan smul winh sreyal Babilonia chi' yet' masanil heb' kajan t'a smakb'en winh, aton heb' kaldeo. Ol in satel heb' t'a junelnhej.
Masanil juntzanh yaelal ix wala', ol wak'em t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' chi', aton tastak tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a jun uum tik, aton tas ix in chek yalkan winhaj Jeremías yuj masanil juntzanh chonhab'.
Ol wak'och heb' t'a yol sk'ab' niwak chonhab' yet' heb' niwak yajal. Icha chi' ol aj schaan spak heb', icha wal smojal tas sk'ulej, xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, ha' ix ch'oxan t'ayin icha wayichal, ix yalan t'ayin: Ina jun kopa tik, b'ut'an yuj wino, sch'oxel yowal in k'ool. Ik'b'ati, tzak'an yuk' masanil nakión b'aj ol ach in chekb'ati.
Ayic ol yuk'an heb', ol xej heb', ol quistalax heb' yuj. Icha chi' ol aj heb' yuj jun owal ol wak'b'at t'a skal, xchi Jehová.
Ix in chaan jun kopa chi' t'a Jehová, ix wak'an yuk' masanil chonhab' chi' tas ayem t'a yool, aton juntzanh b'aj ix in scheka'.

Ix wak' yuk' heb' aj Jerusalén yet' masanil heb' kajan t'a junjun chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá. Ix yuk' heb' yet' sreyal yet' yajalil, yik slajwiel heb' yuj. Ha heb' ol ilan heb', ol xiw heb', ol b'uchjok heb', ol katab'aj heb' yuj heb', icha wan quilan tiknaik.
Ix wak'anpax yuk' winh sreyal Egipto, heb' yajal, heb' niwak winak yet' masanil heb' anima kajan ta',

yet' pax heb' anima tonhej tzek' ta'. Ix wak'anpax yuk' masanil heb' rey ay t'a chonhab' Uz yet' masanil heb' ay t'a yol smakb'en heb' filisteo: Aton t'a Askalón, t'a Gaza, t'a Ecrón yet' heb' anima ixto kan t'a Asdod.
Ix wak'anpax t'a heb' sreyal Edom, Moab yet' t'a heb' yinhtilal Amón.
Yed' t'a heb' sreyal Tiro yet' Sidón yet' masanil heb' sreyal junjun nakión ay t'a stitak ha' mar Mediterráneo.
Ix wak'anpax t'a heb' aj Dedán, t'a heb' aj Tema, t'a heb' aj Buz yet' t'a masanil heb' anima spiljoxejel yib'tak schiquin.
Ix wak'anpax t'a heb' rey t'a Arabia yet' t'a masanil makanhil anima kajan t'a taquinh lu'um.
Ix wak'pax yuk' heb' rey t'a Zimri, t'a Elam yet' t'a Media,
yet' t'a heb' rey t'a norte, aton heb' lak'nik ma heb' najtik skal. Syalelk'ochi, masanil heb' rey t'a yol yib'anhk’inal ix uk'ani. Slajwub'alxo ol yuk' winh sreyal Babilonia.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ala' to a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, sDiosal in Israel, a in ix wala': Uk'ejek he masanil ex yajal ex tik masanto sk'e t'a he jolom, ol ex xejok, ol ex telwok. Manhxo ol ex k'e waan. Icha chi' ol ex aj yuj jun owal ol wak'b'at t'a he kal, xchi Jehová.
Tato malaj snib'ej heb' schaan jun kopa chi' t'ayach, max yuk' pax heb', al t'a heb' icha tik: Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, ha' tz'alani: Yowalil ol eyuk'ej.

Tik wal tzin chael yich wak'anb'at yaelal t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' wik yaji. ¿Tzam he na' to manh ol k'och yaelal chi' t'a eyib'anh? Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to a jun chi' manh ol ek'b'at sk'och t'a eyib'anh, yujto ol wak'b'at owal t'a yib'anh masanil heb' kajan t'a sat lu'um tik, xchi Jehová, xa chi.

Ach Jeremías, al masanil juntzanh lolonel tik t'a heb': Ha Jehová icha sk'anh k'u, icha chi' ol aj yawajemta t'a satcha’anh, aton t'a skajnub' to yiknhej yaji. Icha wal yel yaw heb' tek'umel yal uwa, icha chi' ol aj yel yaw skot yowal t'a masanil anima kajan t'a sat lu'um tik.

Olto ab'chaj sk'anh b'aj slajwik'och lum lum tik, yujto ay tas ol yal Jehová t'a yib'anh masanil nakión. Ol ch'olb'itaj heb' anima yuj, ol yak'ankanoch chamel t'a yib'anh masanil heb' chuk, xchi Jehová, xa chi, xchi t'ayin.

Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik: Ab'ek, t'a stzolal ol aj syamchaj junjun nakión yuj jun yaelal ol jawok, icha sjawi junok owal ik' nhab'. Van smolb'an sb'a jun niwan yaelal chi' b'aj slajwik'och lum lum tik, xchi Jehová.

Ha heb' ol cham yuj Jehová t'a jun k'u chi', teltumb'a ol ajkan heb' t'a smasanil yol yib'anhk’inal tik. Malaj mach ol ok' yuj heb', malaj mach ol molb'an sniwanil heb' yik smukji. Toxonhej ol kan b'ulan sniwanil heb' t'a sat lu'um icha stza' nok' nok'.

Elokab' eyaw yuj yaelal ex yilumal chonhab'. Ek'anhek b'alb'on t'a sat lu'um, yujto toxo ix ja sk'ual he miljichamok. Ol ex saklemkanb'atok. Ol ex ak'jok ganar, ol ex miljokcham icha nok' ch'ak kalnel te b'ak'uech.
Ha heb' yilumal chonhab', manh ol yal sb'at heb' elelal. Ha heb' stanhwumal chonhab' chi' manh ol kolchajkanel heb'.
Ab'ek wal sk'akwi heb' yilumal chonhab' chi'. Tz'el yaw heb' yuj yaelal, yujto toxo ix satel schonhab' heb' yuj Jehová, icha stakjiel anh ank'ultak b'aj swa nok' kalnel.
Ix satjiel schonhab' heb' chi' yuj yowal sk'ol Jehová.
Ix elta juknaj Jehová t'a yet'tal icha junok nok' choj. Yed' wal yowal sk'ool ix yak'ankot jun owal te ay smay t'a skal juntzanh anima chi', chok' ix ajem lanhnaj schonhab' heb'.
Ayic ix och winhaj Joacim yuninal winhaj Josías reyal t'a Judá, ata' ix lolon Jehová t'ayin Jeremías in tik.
Ix yalan icha tik: Ajanh tek'tek' t'a yamaq'uil in templo, tzalan masanil tas ix wal tik t'ayach t'a heb' aj Judá tzul och ejmelal t'a in templo tik. Malaj junok lolonel to max ala'.
Talaj scha yab' heb' t'ayach, syaktankan schuk b'eyb'al heb', tato icha chi', manhxo ol wak'b'at yaelal nab'il wuj wak'anb'at t'a yib'anh heb' yuj schuk b'eyb'al chi'.
Tzal t'a heb' to a in Jehová in swal t'a heb' icha tik: Yujto max he cha eyab' in k'ayb'ub'al swala', max he k'anab'ajej paxi,
max he cha eyab' he kachji yuj heb' in chekab', wach'chom tzijtum el ix in chekb'at heb', palta maj he k'anab'ajej heb',

yuj chi', icha wutejnak in kajnub' t'a Silo, icha chi' ol wutej jun templo tik. Ol wak'b'at katab' t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik t'a skal masanil juntzanhxo chonhab' ay t'a yol yib'anhk’inal, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb'.
Ha heb' sakerdote, heb' syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios yet' masanil heb' anima, ix yab' wal heb' walan juntzanh lolonel chi' t'a templo.
Ayic ix lajwi walan masanil tas ix schek Jehová wala', ix in syaman heb'. Ix yalan heb' t'ayin icha tik: Ol ach chamok.

¿Tas wal yuj tza tek'b'ej a b'a alan t'a sb'i Jehová to a jun stemplo tik lajan ol ajkan icha ajnak skajnub' t'a Silo? Tzalani to ol satel jun chonhab' tik, manhxa mach ol kajnaj t'ay, xa chi, xchi heb'. Masanil anima ix ja nhilnaj t'a yamaq'uil templo chi', ix oymaj heb' t'a in patik.
Ayic ix yab'an heb' yajal t'a Judá tas wan yuji chi', ix kot heb' t'a spalakio winh rey, ix jawi heb' t'a templo b'aj ay jun ak' puerta, ata' ix jawi k'ojan heb'.

Ix yalan heb' sakerdote yet' heb' syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios chi' t'a heb' yajal yet' t'a heb' anima chi' icha tik: Ha jun winh tik smoj scham winh, yujto ix yal winh to ay yaelal ol ja t'a yib'anh ko chonhab' tik. Ha ex tik tzeyab'nhej tas syal winh chi', xchi heb'.
Ix walan t'a heb' yajal chi' yet' t'a heb' anima chi' icha tik: Ha Jehová ix chekan wal tas ix eyab' t'a spatik jun templo tik yet' t'a spatik ko chonhab' tik.
B'oek he b'eyb'al yet' tas tze k'ulej, k'anab'ajejek Jehová ko Diosal yik wach' manh ol yak'kot juntzanh yaelal toxo ix alchaj chi' t'a eyib'anh.
Ha in tik, ayin wal ek' t'a yol he k'ab', syalnhej he k'ulan tas tze nib'ej t'ayin.

Palta, ojtaquejek wal el sik'lab'il: Tato a ex yet' heb' anima tik tzin he milchamok, ol och he mul yujto tze milcham junok mach malaj smul. Yujto wal yel, a Jehová ix chekan wal juntzanh lolonel tik, xin chi t'a heb'.

Yuj chi' ix yalan heb' yajal yet' heb' anima chi' t'a heb' sakerdote yet' t'a heb' syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios chi': Manh smojok scham jun winh tik, yujto ha t'a sb'i Jehová ko Diosal ix lolon winh t'ayonh, xchi heb'.
Ay juntzanh heb' yichamtak winaquil chonhab' ix k'e waan, ix yalan heb' t'a heb' anima molanek' chi':

Ha t'a stiempoal winhaj Ezequías sreyal Judá, a winhaj Miqueas aj Moreset ix lolon t'a sb'i Jehová t'a masanil heb' kajan t'a Judá, ix yalan winh icha tik: Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik: Ha Sion tik ol kan yikok munlajel. Ha pax Jerusalén ol emkan lanhnajok, haxo jun tzalan b'aj ay templo tik, wayumtak ol ajok, xchi Jehová, xchi winh.

Palta tokwal ix miljicham winh yuj winhaj rey Ezequías chi' yet' pax yuj heb' anima. Anhej to ix xiw winh, ix tewi winh t'a Jehová. Yuj chi' majxo yak'kot yaelal Jehová toxo ix yal chi'. Tato sko milcham winhaj Jeremías tik, ol quik'kot yaelal t'a quib'anh, xchi heb'.

(Yed' pax winh schekab' Dios skuchan Urías yuninal winhaj Semaías, aj Quiriat-jearim, a winh ix lolon t'a sb'i Jehová t'a jun chonhab' tik yet' t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' ay t'a yol smakb'en, icha ix aj walan Jeremías in tik.

Ha winhaj rey Joacim yet' heb' ayoch yajalil yet'ok yet' heb' niwak yopisio, ix yab' heb' tas ix yal winh. Ix snib'ej winh rey chi' smilcham winh. Axo yik ix yab'an winhaj Urías chi' tas yaji, ix xiwb'at winh, ix b'at winh elelal t'a Egipto.
Ix chekjib'at winhaj Elnatán yuninal winhaj Acbor yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh winak yuj winhaj rey Joacim t'a Egipto chi'.

Aton heb' winh ix b'at ik'ankot winhaj Urías chi', ix yak'anoch winh heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winh rey chi'. Ix yalan winh to smiljicham winh, syumjib'at sniwanil winh b'aj sb'atkan sniwanil heb' komon anima. Icha chi' ix aji.)
Palta a in Jeremías in tik, maj in ak'jioch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' anima yik tzin smilancham heb', yujto a winhaj Ahicam yuninal winhaj Safán ix yak'och sb'a wed'ok.
Ayic toto ochnak winhaj Sedequías yuninal winhaj Josías reyal t'a Judá, ix lolon Jehová t'ayin Jeremías in tik.
Ix yalan icha tik: B'o junok te' yugo yet' juntzanhok nok' tz'uum, tzak'ank'e t'a yib'anh a jaj.

Slajwi chi', tzak'anb'at junok cheknab'il t'a heb' sreyal Edom, t'a heb' yik Moab, t'a heb' yik Amón, t'a heb' yik Tiro yet' t'a heb' yik Sidón. Ha t'a heb' chekab' sjawi ul yil winhaj rey Sedequías t'a Jerusalén, ata' tzak'b'ati.
Tzal t'a heb' to syal heb' t'a heb' sreyal, to a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, sDiosal in Israel tik, a in swala':
Yed' wal in poder te niwan, in b'onak yol yib'anhk’inal tik yet' masanil tastak ay t'ay. In b'onak heb' anima yet' nok' nok', yuj chi' syal wak'an t'a yalnhej mach b'aj in gana swak'a'.
Yuj chi', a tiknaik swak'kanoch juntzanh nakión tik t'a yol sk'ab' winh in chekab' aj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia. Swak'paxkanoch nok' kaltakte'al nok' t'a yalanh smandar winh.

Masanil nakión ol kan t'a yol sk'ab' winh, t'a yol sk'ab' yuninal winh yet' t'a yol sk'ab' yixchiquin winh, masanto ol ja sk'ual yak'ji ganar Babilonia chi'. Ichato chi' ol kan Babilonia chi' t'a yol sk'ab' juntzanhxo nakión yet' t'a yol sk'ab' juntzanhxo rey niwak yelk'och yet' yopisio.
Ha in Jehová in swala', tato ay junok nakión max yak'och sb'ha t'a yalanh smandar winhaj Nabucodonosor chi', ol wak'och yaelal t'a yib'anh, aton owal, wejel yet' ilya, masanto ol satel heb' yuj winh.

Yuj chi', manh he cha eyab' tas syal heb' tz'alan t'ayex to max eyak'och he b'ha t'a yalanh smandar winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia chi'. Ha heb' tz'alan juntzanh chi', aton heb' tik: Eb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok, heb' naumel lolonel, heb' snaanel tas syal wayich yalani yet' heb' schuman yet' k'een k'anal yet' heb' skomon alan tastak toto ol ujok.
Masanil juntzanh tas syal heb' chi', esnhej, yujto ol ex ik'jokb'at t'a juntzanhxo ch'ok nakional. Ha in ol ex in pechb'ati, ata' ol ex chamok.
Axo pax juntzanh nakión syak'och sb'ha t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Babilonia chi', a in Jehová in swala' to ol wak'nhejkan heb' t'a sluum, ol munlaj heb' ta', xchi Jehová, xa chib'ati, xchi t'ayin.
Yuj chi' ix walanxi juntzanh tik t'a winhaj Sedequías sreyal Judá icha tik: Ak'och a b'ha t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Babilonia yet' schonhab' winh, yik wach' max ex chami.

¿Tas yuj tza b'ekcham a b'a yet' a chonhab' yuj owal, wejel yet' pax yuj ilya? Yujto toxo ix yal Jehová to a juntzanh chi' ol ik'an masanil nakión manh ol yak'och sb'ha t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Babilonia chi'.
Manh a cha ab' tas syal juntzanh heb' syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios, heb' tz'alani to max ak'och a b'ha t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Babilonia chi', yujto nab'a es tas syal heb' chi'.

Ha Jehová ix alani to manhok schekan yal juntzanh chi' heb', nab'a es tas syal heb'. Tato tza k'anab'ajej tas syal heb' chi' jun, ol ach ik'joquel t'a tik yet' heb' esalwum chekab' tz'alan chi' t'ayach, ol ach cham yet' heb', xin chi t'a winh rey chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix walan pax t'a heb' sakerdote yet' t'a masanil anima icha tik: Ha wal Jehová tz'alani: Manh he cha eyab' tas syal juntzanh heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok chi'. Syalan heb' t'ayex to toxo ol ak'jok meltzaj masanil yamk'ab' yik templo ik'b'ilb'at t'a Babilonia. Ha juntzanh syal heb' chi' t'ayex, esal lolonel.
Yuj chi' manh he cha eyab'i. Hak'ek wal och he b'ha t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Babilonia chi', yik wach' ol ex kajnajnhej t'a tik. ¿Tas yuj ol kan tzinan jun chonhab' tik?

Tato yel in chekab' heb', tato yet'nak in lolonel heb', tewokab' heb' t'ayin a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, yik max wach' ik'jib'at juntzanhxo yamk'ab' yik in templo t'a Babilonia yet' tastak kannak t'a spalakio heb' tz'ak'an reyal t'a Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén, xchi Jehová, xin chi t'a heb'.

Ayic ix ik'jib'at winhaj Jeconías sreyal Judá, winh yuninal winhaj Joacim yuj winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia, ix ik'jipaxb'at heb' ayoch yajalil t'a Jerusalén yet' winh. Ayic ix ik'jib'at heb' chi' maj ik'jib'atlaj juntzanh niwak oy, jun niwan pila nab'a bronke yet' sb'akhnub'al yet' juntzanhxo syamk'ab'il templo yet' tas ix kan t'a spalakio heb' sreyal Judá yet' Jerusalén. Yuj chi' ix yal Jehová icha tik: Ab'ek tas swal a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, he Diosal in a ex israel ex tik.
Ha in swala' to masanil tas ix kan chi' ol ik'jokb'at t'a Babilonia, ata' ol kannhej, masanto ayik ol ex wik'anxi meltzaj t'a he chonhab' tik, xchi Jehová.

Ayic schanhil ab'il yoch winhaj Sedequías reyal t'a Judá, ayik yoil ujal yoch jun ab'il chi', a winhaj Hananías yuninal winhaj Azur, aj Gabaón, jun winh syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios, ix lolon winh t'ayin Jeremías in tik t'a templo. D'a yichanh heb' sakerdote yet' t'a yichanh heb' anima smasanil, ix yalan winh:
--Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, a tz'alan icha tik: Ol in mak' kanhchaj jun te' syugo winh sreyal Babilonia, aton spoder winh ayem t'a eyib'anh.
Yic wal chab' ab'il tik, ol wak' ik'jok meltzaj masanil yamk'ab' yik templo ik'b'ilb'at yuj winhaj Nabucodonosor t'a Babilonia.

Ha in Jehová in swala' to ol wak' meltzaj winhaj Jeconías sreyal Judá, winh yuninal winhaj Joacim yet' masanil heb' anima ik'b'ilb'at t'a Babilonia chi'. Ol in kanhchitej syugo winh rey chi' ayem t'a eyib'anh, xchi Jehová, xchi winhaj Hananías chi'.
Ix in tak'wi t'a winh t'a yichanh heb' sakerdote yet' t'a yichanh masanil anima ayek' t'a templo chi'. Ix walan icha tik:

--Ichokab' chi'. Comonoc icha chi' sk'ulej Jehová. Comonoc syak'elk'och juntzanh lolonel tzal chi', syak'an ik'jok meltzaj masanil yamk'ab' yik templo ik'b'ilb'at t'a Babilonia chi' yet' masanil anima.
Palta ab' wal juntzanh tas ol wal tik t'ayach yet' t'a heb' anima tik:
Ha heb' schekab' Dios ek'nak t'a peka', ayik manto onh alji ed'ok, yalnak heb' to ol ja owal, yaelal yet' ilya t'a yib'anh juntzanh nakión ay spoder.
Palta tato ay junok chekab' tz'alani to ol ja wach'il t'a juntzanh nakión, ato yik ol elk'ochok, ichato chi' ol cheklajelok to a Jehová ix chekan yala', xin chi.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'anel jun te' yugo chi' winhaj Hananías ayoch t'a in jaj, ix skanhchitan te' winh.

Ix yalan winh t'a yichanh heb' anima chi' icha tik: --Syal Jehová icha tik: Yic wal chab' ab'il tik, ol wik'el spoder winhaj Nabucodonosor ayoch t'a yib'anh juntzanh nakión tik, xchi Jehová chi', xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix in b'atxi.
Ayic ix ek'b'at jun pekti’ ayik toxo ix smak' kanhchaj te' yugo winhaj Hananías ix yik'el t'a in jaj chi', ix lolon Jehová t'ayin, ix yalan icha tik:
Ixic, b'at al t'a winhaj Hananías to a in Jehová in swala': Ha ach ix a kanhchitej te' yugo nab'a te', a inxo ol wak'och jun yugo nab'a hierro sk'exulok te te' chi'.

Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, sDiosal in Israel swal icha tik: Ix wak'och jun yugo nab'a hierro t'a yib'anh juntzanh nakión walnak, yik skan heb' t'a yalanh smandar winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia. Anhejtona' nok' kaltakte'al nok', ix wak'kanoch nok' t'a yalanh smandar jun winh rey chi', xchi Jehová.
Ixlajwi chi', ix walan t'a winhaj Hananías chi' icha tik: --Hananías, ab' wal tas ol wala'. Manhok Jehová ix chekan ala'. Palta a tas tzal syak'och heb' anima yipok sk'ool chi' manh yeloklaj.

Yuj chi' syal Jehová icha tik: Ol ach in satel t'a sat lum tik. Yuj a lolonel ix al chi', ix wach' pitb'iel juntzanh anima tik t'ayin, yuj chi' ha t'a jun ab'il tik ol ach chamok, xchi Jehová, xin chi t'a winh.
Ha t'a yuquil uj t'a jun ab'il chi', ix cham winhaj Hananías chi'.

Ha in Jeremías in tik schekab' in Dios, ix wak'b'at jun in karta t'a heb' yichamtak winaquil chonhab', t'a heb' sakerdote, t'a heb' schekab' Dios yet' t'a masanil anima aj Jerusalén ik'b'ilb'at yuj winhaj Nabucodonosor t'a Babilonia.
