Ix wak'b'at jun karta tik, ayik toxo ix ik'jib'at winhaj rey Jeconías t'a Babilonia chi' yet' ix reina, aton ix snun winh. Ix ik'jipaxb'at heb' smunlaj t'a palakio, heb' yajal yaj t'a Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén, heb' jelan sb'oan tastak yet' pax heb' tenum k'een.

Ix ik'jib'at jun karta tik yuj winhaj Elasa yuninal winhaj Safán yet' winhaj Gemarías yuninal winhaj Hilcías. Aton heb' winh tik ix chekjib'at yuj winhaj Sedequías sreyal Judá t'a winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia chi'. Ha jun karta chi', icha tik syala':
E masanil ex aj Jerusalén ik'b'ilb'at t'a Babilonia yuj ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, aton Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, a tz'alan t'ayex icha tik:
B'oek he pat, tzex kajnaj t'ay, awejek eyawb'en te' yik tze loan sat.
Hak'uekoch eyetb'eyum, aljokab' eyuninal. Ochokab' pax yetb'eyum heb' eyuninal chi', aljokab' pax yuninal heb', q'uib'okab' he b'isul, mokab' emta he b'isul chi'.
Munlajanhec yuj swach'ilok jun chonhab' b'aj ix ex wak'b'at chi'. k'anek in kolwal t'a yib'anh, tato wach' tz'aj jun chonhab' chi', wach' pax ol ex aj yet'ok.

Yujto a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, he Diosal in, a in swal juntzanh tik: Manh eyak' he b'a musansatil yuj juntzanh heb' syesejoch sb'a in chekab'ok yet' heb' naumel lolonel yalani. Manh he cha eyab' swayich heb' syala'.
Ha tas syal heb' chi' t'a in b'i, nab'a es. Ha in Jehová in swala' to manhok in tzin chek yal heb'.
Swalanxi: Ayic ol tz'akwok 70 ab'il yak'an yajalil Babilonia chi', ol wak' in wach'k'olal t'ayex, ol wak'anpaxelk'och b'aj ix wak' in ti' to ol ex wik'xi meltzaj t'a tik.
Ha in wal Jehová in swala', wojtak tas nab'il wuj t'a he patik. Ha tas nab'il chi' wuuj, manh yujok eyab'an syaelal, palta yuj he wach'ilok yik wach' ay tas tzeyak'och yipok he k'ol t'a b'ak'uinh.
Ol lajwok chi', ol eyal he b'a t'ayin, ol ex lesalwok t'ayin, ol wab'an he lesal chi'.
Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to ol ex jawok t'ayin, ol in ch'ox in b'a t'ayex, yujto ol eyak'och he b'ha t'a yol in k'ab' t'a smasanil he k'ool.

Ha in Jehová in swala', ol in ch'oxnhej in b'a t'ayex. Ol in k'ex tas eyaji. Ol ex wik'kot t'a masanil nakión yet' t'a masanil b'aj ix ex in saklemejkanb'ati. Ol ex in molb'ej, ol ex wik'anpax meltzaj b'aj ayex ek' kajan ayik ix ex ik'jib'ati, xchi Jehová.
Ha ex tik tzeyala': Ayxo heb' schekab' Jehová t'ayonh t'a Babilonia tik, xe chi.

Palta syal Jehová icha tik t'a yib'anh winh rey ayoch t'a sdespachokan winhaj rey Dawid yet' t'a heb' kajan t'a jun chonhab' tik, aton juntzanh heb' ayto eyuj he b'a yet'ok, heb' maj ik'jib'at t'a Babilonia chi':
Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil swal icha tik: Ol wak'b'at owal, wejel yet' ilya t'a skal heb'. Lajan ol wutejkan heb' icha juntzanh te' higo k'aeltakxo, te chuklaj, maxtzak yal sloji.

Ol in pechb'eyek' heb' yuj owal, yuj wejel, yuj pax ilya. Ol wak'an yajjok heb' yuj masanil nakión. Ol ja katab' t'a yib'anh heb', ol xiw heb' anima yuj heb' ayik ol yilanoch heb'. Ol b'uchwaj heb' t'a heb', ol b'ajjok heb' yuj juntzanh nakión b'aj ol in saklemejkanb'ati.
Ha in Jehová in swala' to tzijtum el ix alji t'a heb' yuj heb' in chekab', palta maj scha yab' heb' tas ix yal heb' in chekab' chi'. Anhejtona' ex pax tik maj he chapax eyab'i.
E masanil ex aj Jerusalén ix ex wak' ik'jokb'at t'a Babilonia, ab'ek wal in lolonel swala'.

Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, he Diosal in paxi, swal yuj winhaj Acab yuninal winhaj Colaías yet' yuj winhaj Sedequías yuninal winhaj Maasías, aton heb' winh tz'alan juntzanh esal lolonel t'a in b'i: Ol wak'och heb' winh t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia. Ha winh ol chekan miljokcham heb' winh t'a eyichanh.

Yuj chi', ex aj Judá, ex ik'b'il ex b'at t'a Babilonia, tato ayex ol he nib'ej he katab'ej junok mach, ol eyal icha tik: Ach yutejokab' Jehová icha utajnak winhaj Sedequías yet' winhaj Acab, aton heb' winh scheknak winhaj Nabucodonosor nhusjoktz'aok, xe chama.

Icha chi' ol aj sja t'a yib'anh heb' winh, yujto te chuk tas sk'ulej heb' winh t'a yol he chonhab'. Tz'em heb' winh ajmulal yet' heb' ix yetb'eyum heb' yetwinaquil. Syalan juntzanh esal lolonel heb' winh t'a in b'i, manhok in tzin chek yal heb' winh. Ha in Jehová in swala', wojtak tas yaji, xchi Jehová, xin chib'at t'a jun in karta chi'.

Ay jun winh skuchan Semaías aj Nehelam ayek' t'a Babilonia chi'. D'a yol yik winh ix yak'kot jun karta t'a masanil heb' anima kajantokan t'a Jerusalén yet' t'a winhaj sakerdote Sofonías yuninal winhaj Maasías yet' t'a juntzanhxo heb' winh sakerdote. Ha t'a jun karta chi' ix yalkot winh t'a winhaj Sofonías chi' icha tik: Ha Jehová Dios ix ach ak'anoch sakerdoteal sk'exulok winhaj Joiada, yik wach' kuchb'um tzach aj t'a stemplo. Tato ay mach sk'och t'ayach aykot t'a sjolom tz'och ijan slolon icha heb' schekab' Dios. Ha jun chi' elanhchamel tzak'och t'a yol te' kepo, tza tzek'an yet' k'een kadena. ¿Tas yuj maj a kach winhaj Jeremías aj Anatot? Ix stek'b'ej sb'a winh slolon t'a ichanh, icha schekab' Dios syutej sb'a winh, yujto ix yak'kot jun karta winh t'ayonh t'a Babilonia tik. Syalan winh icha tik: Najtilto ol ex kajnaj ta'. B'oek he pat, tzex kajnaj t'ay, awejek eyawb'en te' yik tze loan sat, xchi jun skarta winh chi' t'ayonh, xchi skarta winhaj Semaías chi'. Ix yawtan jun karta chi' winhaj sakerdote Sofonías wab' a in Jeremías in tik. Ixlajwi chi', a Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, aton ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, ix lolon t'ayin. Ix yalan icha tik: Alb'at t'a heb' ik'b'ilb'at t'a Babilonia to a in swal icha tik: Ha winhaj Semaías aj Nehelam, winh ix alani to a in ix in chek yal winh to toxo ol meltzaj winh t'a Babilonia chi'. Palta manhok in ix in chek yal jun esal lolonel winh ix eyak'och yipok he k'ol chi'. Yuj chi', a in Jehová in swala' to ol wak' syaelal winhaj Semaías chi' yet' pax heb' yinhtilal. Manhxalaj junok yinhtilal winh chi' ol aj t'a skal heb' in chonhab', yik syak'an tzalajb'ok sk'ol t'a in wach'k'olal ol wak' t'ayex, yujto ix ex skuchb'ej winh yik tze pitej he b'a t'ayin, xchi Jehová, xa chib'ati, xchi t'ayin.
Aton slolonel Jehová tik ix yal t'ayin Jeremías in tik:
Ha in Jehová he Diosal in a ex israel ex tik, swal icha tik: Tz'ib'ejkan masanil tas ix wal t'ayach,

yujto ol k'och sk'ual, ol wak' meltzaj heb' in chonhab' Israel yet' heb' aj Judá ik'b'ilb'at t'a Babilonia. Ha in Jehová in swala' to ol wik'xi meltzaj heb' t'a lum lum wak'nak smakb'enej heb' he mam eyicham, xchi Jehová.
Aton tas ix yal Jehová tik t'a yib'anh chonhab' Israel yet' t'a Judá.
Ix yalan icha tik: Tz'ab'chaj wal yel aw yuj xiwk'olal, manhxalaj tzalajk'olal.

k'anb'ejek wal eyab'i, tokwal ay junok winh winak tz'aj yune'. ¿Tas yuj swila', a heb' winh winak te tek'an, toxonhej wetz'wetz'och heb' winh t'a sk'ol icha heb' ix ix aykot syail unewel t'ay? ¿Tas yuj sakxonhej yilji sat heb' winh smasanil?

Ay jun k'ual to manhxa yalnab'il yaelal ol ujok, malaj junokxo k'u lajan yet' jun k'u ol jawok chi'. Aton t'a jun pekti’ chi' ol och wal yaelal t'a yib'anh heb' yinhtilal Jacob, palta ol kolchajel heb' t'a skal.

Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil swal icha tik: Ol wik'el te' yugo ayoch t'a sjaj heb' in chonhab', aton b'aj ayoch heb' chekab'wumal. Manhxa b'ak'uinh ol och heb' chekab'wumal t'a heb' ch'ok chonhab'il.
Ha in Jehová sDiosal in heb' tik ol in yak' serwil, ol yak'anpax serwil winh yinhtil winhaj Dawid heb', aton winh ol wak'och sreyalok heb'.

Ex israel yinhtilal Jacob, in chekab' eyaji, manh ex xiwok, yujto ol ex in kolel yet' heb' eyuninal t'a jun nakión najat b'aj ix ex ik'jib'ati. Ha in Jehová in swala' to ol ex kajnajxi t'a junk'olal, manhxa tas ol he na'a, manhxa mach ol ex xib'tanok.

Ex yinhtilal Jacob, in chekab' eyaji, manh ex xiwok. Ayinnhejoch eyed'ok, ol in satel masanil juntzanh nakión b'aj ix ex in saklemejb'ati. Palta a ex tik manh ol ex in satel-laj, anhej to ol wak'och eyaelal icha t'a smojal. Manh ol ek'b'atlaj in ch'olb'itan tas eyaji.
Ha b'aj ix ex lajwi chi', max yal yanhtaji, a eyaelal manhxalaj sb'onab'il.
Malaj mach tz'alan eyaelal, malaj mach tz'anhtan eyechen chi'. Manhxa yanhal eyaelal chi'.

Masanil heb' tzex xajanani, toxo ix ex b'at satk'olal yuj heb'. ¿Toc tzato sna heb' tas tzex aji? Ha in ix ex wak' echnajok, icha ajk'ol wajoch t'ayex. Te niwan eyaelal ix wak'ochi, yujto manh jantakok he chukal, manhxo b'ischajb'enok.
¿Tas yuj tz'el wal eyaw yuj eyechen chi'? Manhxa yanhal eyaelal chi', yujto manhxo b'ischajb'enok he mul, yuj chi' icha chi' tzex wutej.

Palta masanil heb' snib'ej ex sataneli, ol satel heb'. Masanil heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayex, ol ik'jokkanb'at heb' t'a ch'ok chonhab'il. Ha heb' ix ik'anb'at tastak ay t'ayex, ol ik'jokpaxb'at yik heb'. Ha heb' ix elk'anb'at he k'ael, ol elk'ajpaxb'at yik heb'.

Wach'chom a heb' eyajk'ool chi' syal heb' t'a he patiktak icha tik: Ha Sion toxo ix aktajkani, manhxalaj mach tz'ok' sk'ol yuj, xchi heb'. Palta a in Jehová in swala' to ol wak' b'oxok he k'ool, ol wanhtej eyechen chi'.

Yujto ol k'och sk'ual, ol ex wik'xi meltzaj a ex yinhtilal ex Jacob tik b'aj ik'b'il ex b'ati. Ol ok' in k'ol t'ayex. Ha he chonhab' ol b'oxokk'e b'aj jub'ilem t'a sb'ab'elal yet' pax he palakio ol b'oxok t'a yet'tal.
Ata' ol k'e he jaj he b'itan yuj eyak'an yuj diosal, ol ex tzewaj t'a tzalajk'olal. Ol wak' q'uib' he b'isul, manh jaywanhoknhej ol ex ajok. Manh ol ex patikajelok, a in ol wak' sniwanil eyelk'ochi.
Ha ex israel ex tik, icha eyaj t'a peka', icha chi' ol ex ajxok. Tek'an ol ex ajxok t'a wichanh. Ol wak'och syaelal heb' ix ex ixtani.

Ha in Jehová in swala' to ha t'a he kal ol elta jun mach ol och eyajalilok, a ol ex kuchb'anok. Ha jun eyajalil chi' ol wak' jawok t'a in tz'ey. Yujto malaj junok mach skomon tek'b'ej sb'a sjawi t'a in tz'ey.
Ol ex och in chonhab'ok, a inxo ol in och he Diosaloc, xchi Jehová.
Ha yowal sk'ol Jehová ol ja t'a yib'anh heb' chuk, icha wal junok owal ik' nhab' sjawi xumnajok.
Ha yowal sk'ol chi', manh ol ek'b'atlaj masanto ol elk'och tas nab'il yuj. Masanil juntzanh tik ol nachajel eyuuj t'a slajwub' k'ual.
Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha wal t'a jun pekti’ ol jawok chi', a in ol in och sDiosalok junjun makanhil heb' yinhtilal Israel, haxo heb' ol och in chonhab'ok.
Ha heb' israel ix elkan t'a yol sk'ab' chamel, ix scha in wach'k'olal heb' t'a tzinan lu'um, ayik wan sayanek' heb' b'aj syik' yip.
Ha t'a pekataxo in ch'oxnak in b'a t'ayex walannak icha tik: Ex israel xajan ex wuj t'a masanil k 'inal, yuj chi' tz'ok'nhej in k'ool t'ayex.
Ol ex wik'xik'echaanh. Eyed'nak he pandereta ol ex k'ex cheneljok yuj tzalajk'olal.
Ol eyawejxi te' eyuwa t'a lum tzalquixtak t'a yol yik Samaria. Ha mach ol yawej yuwa chi', ol yak' tzalajb'ok sk'ol yet' sat.
Yujto ol jawok jun k'ual to a heb' stanhwumal chonhab' t'a tzalquixtak t'a yol smakb'en Efraín, chaanh ol el yaw heb' icha tik: Cotanhec, koyek t'a Sion t'a Jehová ko Diosal, xcham heb', xchi Jehová.

Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: B'itananhek t'a tzalajk'olal yuj jun chonhab'il heb' yinhtilal Jacob, aton jun te niwan yelk'och t'a yichanh masanil nakión. Ab'chajokab' he b'itani, tzeyalan icha tik: Mamin Jehová, kol onh a chonhab' onh tik, a onh ayonh to kan tik, xe chi.

Ol wik' meltzaj heb' t'a jun nakión ay t'a norte. Ol in molb'ejkot heb' b'aj slajwik'och yol yib'anhk’inal. Ha t'a skal heb' chi', ata' ol jawok heb' max yal-laj yilani yet' heb' tz'em sb'eyi, heb' ix yab'ix yet' heb' ix ato wal yalji yune'. Te niwan ol aj sb'isul heb' smeltzajxi.

Axonhej lesal yet' ok'el ol yak' heb' ayik ol meltzajxok heb'. Ha inxo ol wik'b'at heb' t'a ha ha' tz'el yok yet' t'a yol jun b'e te ak'lik, manhxa b'aj ol telwok heb'. Yujto mamab'il waj t'a chonhab' Israel tik. Axo chonhab' Efraín, ichato in b'ab'el unin yaji, xchi Jehová.

Syalanxi Jehová chi' icha tik: Ex junjun nakión, ab'ek wal in loloni. Alequel t'a juntzanh chonhab' lak'an yet' t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a sk'axepal ha' mar te najat ay, tzeyalan icha tik: Ha Jehová ix ak'an saklem heb' israel, anhejtona' pax ol molb'anxikot heb'. Ol tanhwajxok heb' yuj icha tz'aj stanhwaj nok' kalnel yuj stanhwumal, xe chi.
Yujto ol in kolkanel heb' yinhtilal Jacob, ol in kolankan heb' t'a yol sk'ab' juntzanh nakión te ay yip.

Ol ja heb', ol sb'itan b'it heb' t'a tzalajk'olal t'a tzalan Sion, haxo yak'an tzalajb'ok sk'ol heb' yet' jantak tas wach' ol wak' t'ay, aton ixim trigo, wino, akeite, nok' kalnel yet' nok' wakax. Lajan ol aj heb' icha te' awb'en te' aynhejoch yalil, manhxo ol el-laj yip heb' junelxo.

Ol k'e cheneljok heb' ix kob'estak yuj tzalajk'olal. Ol tzalaj pax heb' winh kelemtak yet' heb' winh ichamtak winak. Ha in ol wak' sniwanil sk'ol heb', ol meltzajoch skusk'olal heb' t'a tzalajk'olal, yelxo niwan stzalajk'olal heb' ol wak' t'a yichanh yaelal ix yil heb'.
Ha heb' sakerdote a wal wael te wach' ol wak' swa heb', haxo heb' in chonhab' ol yak' tzalajb'ok sk'ol yet' masanil tas ol wak' t'ay, xchi Jehová.

Syalanxi Jehová chi' icha tik: Tz'ab'chaj wal yoch aw t'a chonhab' Ramá, ay mach sik'sik'an wal yok' yuj yaelal. Ha ix Raquel tz'ok' wal ix yuj heb' yune'. Manhxa snib'ej ix sniwanaj sk'ool, yujto manhxalaj heb' yune' ix ix kani.

Ach Raquel, manhxo ach ok'ok, mokxob' el yal a sat yujto a in Jehová in swala', a tas ix a k'ulej yuj swach'ilok heb' une' chi', ol a cha spak. Ha heb' une' chi', ol elta heb' t'a schonhab' heb' ajk'ool, ol jaxkan kajan heb' t'a tik.
Ha in Jehová in swala' to syal ak'anoch yipok a k'ol tas ol ujok t'a b'ak'uinh. Ha heb' une', ol meltzajxok heb' t'a schonhab' tik.

Ix wab' wal sk'akwi heb' aj Efraín yuj kusk'olal, syalan heb' icha tik: Ix onh a k'ayb'ej icha tz'aj sk'ayb'aj junok nok' quelem wakax manh yojtakok smunlaji, palta ix quileli. Ik'onh meltzaj ed'ok, b'ekan ko k'ol ko meltzaji, yujto a ach tik Jehová, ko Diosal ach.

Ix quik'el ko b'a t'ayach, palta ix ko na ko b'a tiknaik. Ayic ix nachajel ko chukal kuuj, toxonhej ix onh em nhojan yuj q'uixwelal. Emnaquilxonhej skutej ko b'a yuj jantak ko mul ix och t'a yiktax ko quelem uninal, xchi heb' aj Efraín chi' t'ayin.

Ha in Jehová in swala' to a heb' aj Efraín tik, ichato wuninal yaj heb', xajan heb' wuuj. Wach'chom swak' syaelal heb', palta max waktej in naan heb', ya swab' yuj heb', yujto tz'ok' wal in k'ol t'a heb'.

Ex aj Israel, sik'lab'il tzeyilkan jun b'e b'aj tzex b'ati, yujto anheja' t'a jun b'e chi' ol ex meltzajxok yik tzex jax t'a he chonhab' ol eyaktejkan tik. Meltzajanhec ex chonhab' Israel. Meltzajanhec t'a juntzanh he chonhab'.

¿B'aq'uinh ol eyaktejkan he b'eyek' icha junok ix ix te pit? Ha in Jehová in ol wak' ujok junok tas to manta b'aj tzuji t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik: Ha junok ix ix ol tzuntzanb'at junok winh winak, xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, aton ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, a tz'alan icha tik: Ayic ol wik'anxikot heb' israel tik t'a sluum b'aj kajantaxoni, ol laj yal heb' anima kajan t'a yol yik Judá icha tik: Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a yib'anh jun tzalan sik'b'ilel yuj, b'aj sb'eyb'alaj tojolal, xcham heb'.
Ol laj kajnajxok heb' anima t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá yet' heb' munlajwum tz'awan tastak, yet' pax heb' tanhwum kalnel ol kajnaj heb' ta'.
Ha in ol wak'xi yip heb' k'unb'inak. Ha heb' tz'el yip yuj wejel, ol wak' b'ud'jok sk'ol heb', xchi Jehová.
Ayic ix lajwi wilan juntzanh tik ix el in wayanh, ix in ek' k'elelok, te wach' jun ix ch'oxji wil tik.
Ha wal Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ol k'och sk'ual, ol wak'anxi q'uib' sb'isul heb' anima yet' nok' nok' t'a Israel yet' t'a Judá.

Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to icha wal ix aj wak'an wip in tok'aneli, in juanemi, wak'an ik'joquemi, in sataneli yet' wak'an ixtajok, anhejtona' icha chi' ol aj wak'anxi wip wak'anxiem yich, yik tzin b'oanxik'ei.
Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi' manhxo ol yal heb' anima icha tik: Ha heb' mamab'il ix slo te' uwa heb' te paj, haxo heb' uninab'il, jululixonhej sb'at spajil te' t'a yichtak ye heb', manh xchiok heb'.
Yujto junjun mach ol cham yuj smul. Ha mach ol loan te' paj uwa chi', munil a ol ab'an spajil te', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ol jawok sk'ual, ol in b'oan junokxo in trato yet' heb' yinhtilal Israel yet' heb' yinhtilal Judá.

Ha in Jehová in swala' to a jun trato chi', manh lajanok yet' jun in b'onak yet' heb' he mam eyicham ayik wik'annaquelta heb' t'a Egipto. Ichato ochnak in quetzquetz t'a sk'ab' heb' ayik wik'annaquelta heb' chi', palta maj sk'anab'ajej in trato heb' in b'o yet'ok, wach'chom ichato wetb'eyum wutejnak heb'.

Aton in trato tik ol in b'o eyed'ok a ex yinhtilal ex israel tik t'a jun pekti’ chi': Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to ol wak'och juntzanh in cheknab'il t'a he pixan, ichato ol in tz'ib'ejkanoch t'a he pensar, ol in och he Diosaloc, a exxo ol ex och in chonhab'ok.

Manhxo yowalilok ay junok ex ol eyal t'a heb' eyetchonhab' icha tik: Ojtaquejel Jehová, manhxo xe chiok. Yujto a in Jehová in swala' to he masanil ol in eyojtaquejeli, wach'chom heb' unin, ma heb' icham anima. Ol wak' niwank'olal schukal heb', manhxa b'ak'uinh ol in nakot smul heb', xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová ix ak'ankanoch k'u yik syak'an sakil k'inal t'a k'ualil, k'een uj yet' k'een k'anal yik syak' sakil k'inal t'ak'walil. A' tz'ak'ank'e ponhnaj ha' mar ayik sk'anh ha'. Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik:
Yakb'an manto satel juntzanh tz'ak'an sakil k'inal chi', a ex israel ex tik manh ol ex satel-laj t'a nakional t'a wichanh.

Ha in Jehová in swala': Icha satcha’anh malaj b'ak'uinh syal yechtaji, mato icha sjulal yich lum lum malaj b'ak'uinh tz'ojtakajeli, icha chi' waj eyed' in chonhab' israel ex tik, malaj b'ak'uinh ol ex in patiquejel yuj tas tze k'ulej, xchi Jehová.
Ha in Jehová in swalxi icha tik: Ol ja sk'ual to ol b'ochajxik'e in chonhab', schael yich t'a torre Hananel, masanto ol k'och t'a jun puerta ay t'a jun schiquin.
Tojolnhej ol b'at t'a smojonal, masanto t'a lum tzalan yik Gareb, skumlajb'at t'a stojolal Goa.

Masanil lum sch'olanil b'aj smukchaj heb' chamnak, b'aj sb'at yumchajkanel k'een tik'aq'uil taanh yet' t'a yib'anh sti' ha ha' skuch Cedrón, masanto t'a junxo schiquin b'aj ay puerta yik nok' chej, t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, wik ol ajkanok. Masanil juntzanh chi', manhxa b'ak'uinh ol juchajemok, manhxa b'ak'uinh ol satelok, xchi Jehová.
Ayic ayoch slajunhil ab'il yoch winhaj Sedequías reyal t'a Judá, ayik 18 ab'ilxo pax yoch winhaj Nabucodonosor reyal t'a Babilonia, ix lolon Jehová t'ayin Jeremías in tik.
Ha t'a yik chi' wan yak'an owal heb' soldado winhaj Nabucodonosor chi' t'a Jerusalén, a inxo Jeremías in tik, ayin och preso t'a yamaq'uil b'aj ayek' heb' stanhwumal spalakio heb' sreyal Judá.
Ha winhaj rey Sedequías chi' ix in chekan yamjok, yujto ix wal icha tik: Ha Jehová tz'alani: Ol wak'och jun chonhab' tik t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Babilonia.

Axo winhaj rey Sedequías, manhxo ol yal-laj skolanel sb'a winh t'a yol sk'ab' heb' kaldeo. Ol yamchaj winh yuj winh sreyal Babilonia chi'. Yowalil ol k'och winh t'a yichanh jun winh rey chi'. Ol lolon winh yet' winh, ol yil wal och winh.

Ha winhaj Nabucodonosor chi', ol schek ik'jokb'at winhaj Sedequías chi' winh t'a Babilonia chi'. Ata' ol kannhej winh masanto ol cham winh. Wach'chom ol eyak' owal yet' heb' kaldeo chi', palta manh ol yal-laj eyuuj, xchi Jehová, xin chi. Yuj chi' ayin och t'a preso chi'.
Ata' ix yal Jehová t'ayin icha tik:

Ilnab'i, a winhaj Hanamel yuninal winhaj Salum winh a k'ab' ok, ol jawok winh t'ayach, ol ul yalan winh icha tik: Man jun in lum ay t'a Anatot. Smoj ton wal a ach tza mana', yujto ayto kuj ko b'a, xcham winh, xchi Jehová t'ayin.

Icha ix aj yalan chi' t'ayin, icha chi' ix aji. Ix jawi winh in k'ab' wok chi' t'ayin ayik ayinek' t'a yamaq'uil b'aj ayek' heb' stanhwumal spalakio winh rey chi'. Ix ul yalan winh t'ayin icha tik: Man jun in lu'um ay t'a Anatot, t'a yol smakb'en Benjamín. Ha ach ay alan ik a manani, skan lum t'a yol a k'ab', yujto te ayto kuj ko b'a, xchi winh t'ayin. Yuj chi' ix nachajel wuuj to slolonel Jehová jun chi'.
Ix in manan lum t'a winhaj Hanamel chi', ix wak'an 17 k'een plata stojolok lu'um.
Ix in tz'ib'ankan jun trato chi', ix in makankan yet' in sello t'a yichanh heb' testigo.
Ixlajwi chi', ix wik'ankot jun b'aj ix tz'ib'chajkan jun trato b'aj ayoch sello chi', haxo skopiail maj och selloal yik wach' syal yilji.

Ixlajwi chi', a wal t'a yichanh winh in k'ab' wok aj Hanamel chi' yet' t'a yichanh pax heb' testigo yet' t'a yichanh masanil heb' wetchonhab' k'ojanem ta' ix wak'an in firma b'aj ix tz'ib'chajkan jun trato chi', ix wak'ankan schab'il t'a winhaj Baruc yuninal winhaj Nerías, yixchiquin winhaj Maaseías.
D'a yichanh heb' ix wal t'a winhaj Baruc chi' icha tik:

Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, a ix alani to skan juntzanh b'aj ix tz'ib'chajkan jun trato tik, aton jun ayoch selloal yet' jun malaj selloal, tza sik'kan t'a yol junok lum chen yik wach' najtil ol ek'ok.
Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, ko Diosal, a tz'alan icha tik: Ha b'ak'uinh, ol laj smanxi spat heb' anima, slum heb' yet' te' uwa awab'ilxo t'a jun nakión tik, xchi Jehová, xin chi.
Ixlajwi wak'ankan jun b'aj ix tz'ib'chaj jun trato yik jun lum lum chi' t'a winhaj Baruc chi', ix in lesalwi t'a Jehová icha tik:
Mamin Jehová yet' wal a poder a b'onak satcha’anh yet' lum lum tik. Malaj tas ajaltak sb'o uuj.

Ha ach tik, tza xajanej jantak makanhil anima tz'eq'ui. Palta tzak'paxoch yaelal t'a yib'anh heb' uninab'il yuj smul smam yicham. Ach Dios te niwan elk'ochi, masanil syal uuj. Ha a b'i, Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil.
Te niwan elk'och t'a tas tza na' yet' t'a tas tza k'ulej. Ha ach tik, tzil masanil tastak sk'ulej heb' anima, tza pakan t'a junjun heb' icha wal smojal tas sk'ulej chi'.

Ha ach a b'onak juntzanh tas niwak satub'tak t'a Egipto yet' juntzanh ch'oxnab'il niwan yelk'ochi. Anhejtona' tiknaik jantak tas tza ch'ox pax t'a ko kal a onh israel onh tik yet' t'a skal masanil anima, yuj chi' tzach b'inaj wal.
Yed' wal jantak a poder chi' ik'naquelta a chonhab' Israel tik t'a Egipto, a ch'oxannak juntzanh tas satub'tak yet' juntzanh ch'oxnab'il niwak yelk'ochi. Yuj chi' xiwnak wal masanil anima.
Slajwi chi' ak'annak jun lum te yax sat tik t'ayonh israel onh tik, icha ajnak ak'annakkan a ti' t'a heb' ko mam quicham.

Palta ayik skajnajnak heb' t'a sat lum lum tik, yikannak lum heb', maj scha yab' a cheknab'il heb', maj sk'anab'ajej a k'ayb'ub'al heb', maj sk'ulej heb' tas tza chek sk'ulej. Yuj chi' ix ak'kot masanil juntzanh yaelal tik t'a quib'anh.

Ha tiknaik, a heb' kaldeo toxo ix sb'ok'e juntzanh stek'nub' heb' yik syak'an owal heb' t'a ko chonhab' tik. Yuj owal, wejel yet' ilya, ol yak' ganar ko chonhab' tik heb' ak'um owal chi'. Mamin, wan yelk'och tas alnakkani.
Palta Mamin Jehová, wach'chom ol ak'jok ganar jun ko chonhab' tik yuj heb' kaldeo chi', palta a ach ix ala': Man jun lum chi', tza tupan t'a yichanh heb' testigo, xa chi, xin chi t'a in lesal chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix tak'wi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
Ha in Jehová in, sDiosal in smasanil anima. ¿Toc ay tas ajaltak sb'o wuuj?
Yuj chi' swal t'ayach, a in ol wak'och jun chonhab' tik t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal heb' kaldeo t'a Babilonia.

Ha heb' kaldeo wan yak'an owal t'a jun chonhab' tik, ol ochta heb' t'a yool, ol yak'anoch sk'ak'al heb'. Ol tz'ab'at masanil juntzanh pat b'aj ix laj yak'och smul heb' anima t'ayin, aton t'a spanhanil yib'anh juntzanh pat chi' b'aj ix snhus inkienso heb' t'a Baal. Ix yak'an wino heb' t'a juntzanh komon Dios, yuj chi' ix stzuntzejkot yowal in k'ol heb'.

Atax yik ix el yich chonhab' Israel yet' Judá, ix sb'eyb'alej juntzanh tas max scha in k'ol heb'. Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to max yaktej heb' stzuntzankot yowal in k'ol yuj juntzanh yechel komon Dios sb'ok'e heb'.

Ha heb' anima t'a jun chonhab' tik, yiktax ix el yich skajnaj heb' t'ay, masanto tiknaik, malaj jab'ok wach'il sk'ulej heb', anhej yowal in k'ol stzuntzejkot heb', yuj chi' ol in satel heb' yet' schonhab' tik.

Ha heb' Israel yet' heb' aj Judá, stzuntzej wal kot yowal in k'ol heb' yuj jantak chukal sk'ulej, lajan heb' yet' sreyal, heb' yajal, heb' sakerdote, heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok yet' pax masanil anima kajan t'a Jerusalén yet' t'a Judá tik.
Max kot k'elan heb' t'ayin, palta to a yich spatik heb' syak'koti. Wach'chom max waktej in k'ayb'an heb', palta manh wal jab'ok scha yab' heb', malaj yelk'och t'a heb' b'aj tzin kacha'.
Ix yixtejb'at in templo heb' to wiknhej yaji, ix yak'anoch juntzanh yechel yajb'entak heb' t'a yool.

Anhejtona' ix sb'opaxk'e altar yik Baal heb' t'a sch'olanil yik Ben-hinom, ata' snhustz'a yuninal heb' yet' yisil heb' silab'il t'a komon Dios Moloc. Icha wal chi' tz'aj yoch smul heb' aj Judá sk'ulan tas manhok in swala', max ek' jab'ok t'a in pensar juntzanh tas sb'eyb'alej heb' chi'.
Syal heb' anima icha tik: Ha ko chonhab' tik, ol ak'jokoch t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Babilonia yuj owal, yuj wejel yet' pax yuj ilya, xchi heb'. Palta a in Jehová he Diosal in swala':
Ol in molb'ejxi heb' b'aj ol in saklemejb'at t'a junjun nakión yuj yowal in k'ol te ay smay. Ol lajwok chi', ol in wik'anxikot heb'. Ha t'a tik ol aj heb', manhxa tas ol ik'an heb'.
Ol och heb' in chonhab'ok, a inxo ol in och sDiosalok heb'.
Junxonhej ol wutej spensar heb', lajanxonhej ol yutej heb' in yak'an serwil t'a masanil tiempo, yik tz'och swach'ilok heb' yet' yinhtilal.

Ol in b'o junok in trato yet' heb' t'a junelnhej, manh ol waktejkan wak'an in wach'k'olal t'a heb'. Ol wak' sk'ulej heb' to aynhej ol aj welk'och t'a sat heb', yik manhxa b'ak'uinh ol yik'kanel sb'a heb' t'ayin.
Yed' wal in tzalajk'olal ol wak'an wach'ilal t'a heb'. D'a wal yel ol wak' kajnaj heb' t'a jun lu'um tik t'a smasanil in k'ool.
Icha wal ix aj wak'anb'at jun niwan yaelal t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik, icha chi' ol aj wak'anpaxb'at wach'ilal t'a yib'anh, icha ix aj wak'an in ti'.
Ha heb' anima tik syal heb' to ol kan tzinan jun chonhab' tik. Manhxa anima, ma nok' nok' ol kan t'ay. Ol ak'jok ganar yuj heb' kaldeo, xchi heb'. Palta ol meltzajxok heb' anima sman lum lum tik.

Ol sman sluum heb', ol sb'oan yumal heb' yet' sello yet' pax sfirma heb' testigo. Icha chi' ol ujok t'a yol yik Benjamín yet' t'a spatik yichanh Jerusalén yet' t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá, t'a tzalquixtak, t'a ak'liktak yet' t'a yol smakb'en Neguev. Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to ol wik'xichaanh in chonhab' tik, xchi Jehová.
Ha in Jeremías in tik ayinto och t'a preso t'a yamaq'uil b'aj ayek' heb' stanhwumal palakio, ix lolonxi Jehová t'ayin, ix yalani:
Ha in Jehová in in b'onaquem yol yib'anhk’inal tik. Wach' wutejnakkan lu'um t'a yet'tal, a in swal t'ayach icha tik:
Awajanh t'ayin, ol in tak'wok t'ayach. Ol in ch'ox t'ayach tas niwak yelk'ochi yet' tas satub'tak yalji to manh ojtakok.

Ha in Jehová he Diosal in, ay wal jun in lolonel swalkan t'a yib'anh spat heb' aj Jerusalén yet' t'a yib'anh spalakio heb' winh sreyal Judá. Ha juntzanh pat chi' wan sjuchajemi yik sk'anchaj sk'enal t'a juntzanh olan t'a smuroal chonhab', yik wach' max och heb' kaldeo yak' owal yet'ok.

Ha t'a yol juntzanh pat chi', toxonhej ol b'ud'joquel yuj sniwanil heb' anima ol miljokcham yuj heb' kaldeo yuj yowal in k'ol te ay smay. Ol in b'at mikan t'a jun chonhab' tik, yujto te niwan smul heb' ix och t'ayin.
Palta ol wanhtej heb', ol wak'anxi sk'inal heb', ol wak'an kajnaj heb' t'a junk'olal, manhxa tas ol ik'an heb'.
Ol wik'xi meltzaj heb' aj Judá yet' heb' aj Israel b'aj ik'b'ilb'at t'a ch'ok chonhab'il. Ol laj in b'oanxik'e schonhab' heb' icha t'a sb'ab'elal.
Ol wik'el schukal heb' ix yak'och t'ayin. Ol wak'an niwank'olal smul heb' yet' spitalil t'ayin.

Ol te tzalajb'ok in k'ol yuj Jerusalén tik. Ha wal yik ol yab'an masanil nakión yuj tas niwan yelk'och ol in k'ulej t'a in chonhab' tik, ol yal wach' lolonel heb' t'ayin, ol in yak'an b'inaj heb'. Palta ol sat wal sk'ol heb', ol ib'xokk'e heb' yuj xiwelal ayik ol yilan heb' jantak wach'il yet' junk'olal ol wak' t'a in chonhab' tik.

Ha ex tik tzeyala' to a jun lum tik kuseltak yajkani, manhxa anima, ma nok' nok' tz'ilchaj t'ay. Wach'chom icha chi' yajkani, ha t'a yoltak skalleal Jerusalén, t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a Judá tzinan yajkani, b'aj manhxa junok anima, ma junok nok' nok' ayek' t'ay, ata' ol ab'chajxok yoch b'it yik q'uinh, b'it yik tzalajk'olal, sb'it heb' kelemtak yet' heb' ix kob'estak ayik snupnaj heb'. Ol ik'chajkot ofrenda yik ak'oj yuj diosal t'a in templo, ol ab'chaj yalji icha tik: Calec wach' lolonel t'a Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, yujto te wach', xajan onh yuj t'a masanil k 'inal, xcham heb'. Ha in Jehová in swala' to ol wik'xichaanh jun chonhab' tik icha t'a sb'ab'elal, xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik: Ha t'a jun lum kannak tzinan tik, manhxa anima, manhxa nok' nok' ay t'ay, palta ha t'a spatik yichanh juntzanh chonhab' tik, manh jantakok ol ajxok anh ank'ultak b'aj ol tanhwajxok nok' kalnel yuj heb' stanhwumal.

Ha t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a tzalquixtak, t'a lum ak'liktak, t'a lum Neguev, t'a lum yik Benjamín, t'a juntzanh ay t'a spatik yichanh Jerusalén yet' pax t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá, ol iljokxi heb' tanhwum kalnel, ol ab'chaj sb'isan nok' skalnel heb' chi'.
Ol k'och sk'ual, ol elk'och b'aj ix wak' in ti' wak'an in wach'k'olal t'a chonhab' Israel yet' t'a Judá.
Ayic ol jawok jun tiempo chi', ol wak'och jun yinhtilal winhaj Dawid reyal. Ha ol ik'anchaanh tojolal yet' wach'ilal t'a jun nakión tik.
Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', a heb' aj Judá ol kolchajkanel heb', haxo heb' aj Jerusalén, manhxa tas ol ik'an heb'. Ha jun b'i tik ol ak'jok t'a heb': “A Jehová tzonh ak'anoch wach'il”, xchama.
Ha in Jehová in swala': Malaj b'ak'uinh ol satel yinhtilal winhaj Dawid, ol ochnhej heb' reyal t'a Israel.

Anhejtona' malaj b'ak'uinh ol satpaxel heb' sakerdote yinhtilal Leví, ol snhusnhej silab' heb' t'ayin. D'a junjun k'u ol snhusan ixim trigo heb' silab'il yet' juntzanhxo silab' ol yak' heb' t'ayin, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
Ha in Jehová in tik swala' to ay jun in trato wak'nakkani to ay k'ualil yet' t'ak'walil t'a stiempoal. Max yal-laj sk'exmaj jun in trato chi'.

Anhejtona' max yal-laj satel in trato wak'nak yet' winh in chekab' aj Dawid to tz'ochnhej heb' yinhtilal winh reyal t'a sdespacho. Manh ol satelpax in trato in b'onak yet' heb' yinhtilal Leví yik tzin yak'an serwil heb' t'a sakerdoteal.

Ha heb' yinhtilal winh in chekab' aj Dawid chi' yet' heb' yinhtilal Leví tzin ak'an serwil, ol wak' q'uib' sb'isul heb' icha k'een k'anal, ma icha k'een yarenail sti' ha' mar malaj mach syal sb'isani, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:

¿Tom max nachajel uuj tas syal heb' anima, syal heb' to ix in patiquejel cha makan inhtilal sik'b'ilel wuuj, aton Israel yet' Judá? Yuj chi' manhxa yelk'och heb' in chonhab' chi' t'a heb', manhxo nakiónoklaj yaj t'a yol sat heb'.
Ha in Jehová in in b'onak jun in trato yet' k'ualil yet' t'ak'walil. Swalani chajtil tz'aj sb'ey satcha’anh yet' sat lum tik, max k'exmajlaj.

Anhejtona' malaj pax b'ak'uinh ol k'exmaj in trato yet' heb' yinhtilal Jacob yet' pax heb' yik winh in chekab' aj Dawid. Yowalil ol in sik'elta junok yinhtilal winh, ol yak'an reyal t'a yib'anh heb' yinhtilal Abraham, Isaac yet' Jacob. Ol wik'xichaanh heb', yujto te ay wok'elk'olal t'a heb', xchi Jehová.

Ayic wan yak'an owal winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia t'a Jerusalén yet' t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' ay t'a slak'anil, yet'nak masanil heb' soldado winh yet' masanil juntzanh nakión aykan t'a yalanh smandar winh, ata' ix lolon Jehová t'ayin Jeremías in tik, ix yalan icha tik:
Ha in Jehová he Diosal in swal t'ayach, b'at al t'a winhaj Sedequías sreyal Judá: Icha tik yalan Jehová: Ol wak'och jun chonhab' tik t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Babilonia, ol yak'och sk'ak'al winh.

Ha ach tik manhxo ol yal-laj el lemnajok, ol ach yamchaj yuj heb', ol ach yak'anoch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Nabucodonosor chi', ol il-laj och a sat yet' winh, ol ach lolon yet' winh, ol ach yik'anb'at winh t'a Babilonia chi'.
Yuj chi' ach Sedequías, ab' wal tas ol wal a in Jehová in tik: Manh ol ach miljokcham t'a k'een espada.

Junk'olal ol aj a chami. Ha in Jehová in swak' in ti' to icha yutejnak heb' anima snhusan inkienso ayik smukchajnak heb' a mam icham, aton heb' ochnak reyal ayik manto ach och a ach tik, icha chi' ol aj snhuschaj inkienso chi' ayik ol ach mukchajok. Ol ok' heb' uuj, ol yalan heb' icha tik: Ay, ix cham winh ko reyal, xcham heb', xchi Jehová, xa chi, xchi t'ayin.
Ix walan masanil juntzanh tik t'a winhaj rey Sedequías t'a Jerusalén,

yakb'an a heb' soldado yik Babilonia ayxo och heb' yak'an owal t'a chonhab' Jerusalén tik, t'a Laquis yet' t'a Azeca. Ha t'a yol yik Judá axonhej juntzanh chonhab' chi' wach' yajoch smuroal manto ak'ji ganar yuj heb' soldado yik Babilonia chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix lolonxi Jehová t'ayin Jeremías in tik, ayik toxo ix yak' jun strato winhaj Sedequías yet' heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén, yik tz'ak'jiel heb' ayoch chekab'ok t'a libre.

Icha tik ix aj jun trato chi': Masanil heb' israel ayoch chekab'ok t'a heb' yetchonhab', tz'ak'jiel heb' t'a libre, wach'chom winak, wach'chom ix, yik manhxa junok yetchonhab' heb' tz'ochkan schekab'ok.

Masanil heb' yajal yet' masanil heb' anima, ix scha sk'ol jun trato chi' heb'. Icha chi' ix aj yak'anel heb' schekab'wum heb' chi' t'a libre. Manhxa junok heb' tz'ak'ji pural yak'an serwil junokxo yetchonhab'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix sk'exanxi spensar heb' ix aktanel heb' schekab' chi', yuj chi' ix yak'xi pural heb' yochxi heb' schekab'ok.
Yuj chi' ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
Ha in Jehová he Diosal in, wak'nakkan jun in trato yet' heb' he mam eyicham ayik wik'annaquelta heb' t'a Egipto, b'aj ayoch heb' chekab'ok. Valnac t'a heb' t'a yiktax chi'

to t'a junjun yuktaquil ab'il syak'el heb' schekab' heb' t'a libre, aton heb' eyetisraelal schonhnakoch sb'ha t'a heb', yak'annak serwil heb' waqueok ab'il. Palta a heb' he mam eyicham chi', maj scha yab' heb' tas walnak, maj sk'anab'ajej heb'.

Icha pax chi' ix eyutej he b'a a ex tik. Palta ix he k'ex he b'eyb'al, yujto wan he k'ulan tas scha in k'ool, yujto ix eyak'el heb' eyetchonhab' ayoch he chekab'ok t'a libre. Ix eyak'an he ti' t'a jun trato ix he b'o t'a wichanh, aton t'a yol in templo wiknhej yaji.
Ixlajwi chi', ix he k'exanxi he b'eyb'al, ix in he patiquejkaneli. Ix eyak'anxi pural heb' he chekab' chi' ex yak'anxi serwil, wach'chom toxo ix eyak'el heb' t'a libre.

Yuj chi', a in Jehová in swala': Maj he k'anab'ajej tas ix wala', maj eyak'el heb' eyetchonhab' t'a libre. Yuj chi', a in Jehová in swala' to ol wak'b'at owal, wejel yet' ilya t'a eyib'anh. Ol xiw masanil nakión ayik ol yab'an heb' tas ol ex wutej.

Ha heb' yajal t'a Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén, heb' tz'ak'an serwil t'a palakio, heb' sakerdote yet' masanil heb' anima kajan ta', ix sb'o jun strato heb' t'a wichanh. Chapoj ix yutej jun nok' quelem wakax heb', ix lajwi chi' ix b'eyek' heb' t'a skal nok'. Palta elanhchamel ix spatiquejel jun trato b'aj ix yak' sti' heb' chi'. Icha ix yutej nok' wakax chi' heb', icha chi' ol wutej heb'.
Ol wak'och heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' yajk'ool, ol miljokcham heb' yuj heb'. Ha nok' ostok yet' nok' chium nok' ol chianb'at sniwanil heb'.

Ol wak'och winhaj Sedequías sreyal Judá yet' heb' ayoch yajalil yet' winh t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ool, heb' snib'ejtaxon smilancham heb'. Ol ak'jok ganar heb' yuj heb' winh soldado aj Babilonia, wach'chom toxo ix aktajkan heb' yuj heb'.

Palta a in Jehová in swala': Ol wik'xikot heb' t'a jun chonhab' tik, ol yak'an owal heb' t'ay. Ol ak'jok ganar yuj heb', ol snhusankantz'a heb'. Axo juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá, ol wak'kan tzinan, manhxa junok anima ol kan kajan t'ay, xchi Jehová.
Ayic ayoch winhaj Joacim yuninal winhaj Josías reyal t'a Judá, ata' ix lolon Jehová t'ayin, ix yalan icha tik:
Ixic b'aj ayek' heb' yinhtilal winhaj Recab, tzach lolon yet' heb'. Tzik'anb'at heb' t'a junok kuarto t'a in templo, tzak'an wino yuk' heb', xchi t'ayin.

Yuj chi' ix b'at in sayek' winhaj Jaazanías yuninal junxo winhaj Jeremías, yixchiquin winhaj Habasinías. Ix wik'b'at winh yet' heb' yuk'tak yet' pax heb' yuninal heb' yet' masanil heb' yinhtilal winhaj Recab kajan ta'.

Ix wik'b'at heb' t'a stemplo Jehová, t'a jun kuarto yik heb' yuninal winhaj Hanán yuninal winhaj Igdalías, aton winh ay yelk'och Dios t'ay. Ha jun kuarto chi', junnhej yaj yet' yik heb' yajal yaj t'a templo chi'. Ha t'a yib'anh skuarto winhaj Maasías yuninal winhaj Salum ata' ay, aton winh yajalil heb' stanhwumal templo.
Ix wak'an juntzanh xalu yet' waso b'ut'an yet' wino t'a heb', ix walan t'a heb': Uq'ek jab'ok wino tik, xin chi t'a heb'.

Ix tak'wi heb' t'ayin icha tik: Ha onh tik, max kuk'laj wino tik, yujto a winhaj Jonadab yuninal winhaj Recab, aton winh ko mam quicham a onh tik, a winh ak'annakkan yowalil to max kuk' wino. Anhejtona' heb' quinhtilal max yal-laj yuk'an heb'.

Yak'annak pax yowalil winh to max ko b'o ko pat, max kawej kawb'en, max kawej pax ko uwa. Yalannac pax winh t'ayonh to anhej t'a yoltak mantiado tzonh aji, ichanhej chi' ol aj quek' t'a masanil tiempo t'a sat lum b'aj ek'elb'anhej quek' tik.
Ha onh tik, wan ko k'anab'ajan tas yalnakkan winh ko mam quicham aj Jonadab chi'. Yuj chi' malaj b'aj skuk' wino tik, ma heb' ix quetb'eyum yet' heb' kuninal max yuk'laj heb'.
Malaj ko pat sko b'o'o, malaj te' uwa skawej, malaj ko lum b'aj syal kawan kawb'en.
Anhej t'a yoltak mantiado tzonh aji, wan ko k'anab'ajan tas yalnakkan winh ko mam quicham chi'.

Palta haxo yik ix jawi winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia yak' owal t'a jun nakión tik, ix onh el elelal. Ix ko naani to wach' tzonh jakan t'a Jerusalén tik, yujto onh el t'a heb' soldado kaldeo yet' t'a heb' soldado aj Siria. Yuj chi' ayonhek' kajan t'a Jerusalén tik, xchi heb' yinhtilal winhaj Recab.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jehová t'ayin Jeremías in tik icha tik:

Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, sDiosal in Israel, swal t'ayach, ixik b'at al t'a masanil heb' aj Judá yet' t'a heb' aj Jerusalén to sk'ayb'ej wal jun k'ayb'ub'al tik heb', yik sk'anab'ajan in cheknab'il heb'.

Ha heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jonadab yuninal winhaj Recab chi', sk'anab'ajej wal heb' tas yalnakkan smam yicham heb' chi'. Max yuk' wino heb' masanto tiknaik. Anheja' sk'anab'ajan heb', max yuk'laj heb'. Ichin pax ta', tzijtum el ix wak' in cheknab'il t'ayex, palta max in he k'anab'ajej.

Tzijtum heb' in chekab' ix in chekb'at t'ayex yik syal heb' to tzeyaktejkan he chuk b'eyb'al yet' he chuk pensaril. Tzin chek yal heb' to max eyak'em he b'ha t'a juntzanh komon Dios, ma eyoch ejmelal t'ay, yik wach' tzex kajnajnhej t'a lum lum wak'nak t'a heb' he mam eyicham yet' t'ayex. Palta junelnhej max he cha eyab'i, max in he k'anab'ajej.
Ha heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jonadab chi', sk'anab'ajej heb' tas yalnak smam yicham chi', a exxo tik, junelnhej max in he k'anab'ajej.

Yuj chi' a in wal Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, he Diosal in, a in swal icha tik: Ol wak'b'at juntzanh yaelal alb'ilxo wuj t'a eyib'anh he masanil ex kajan ex t'a Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén tik. Yujto ix ex in kacha', palta maj he k'anab'ajej. Ix in awaj t'ayex, palta maj ex tak'wok t'ayin, xchi Jehová, xa chi, xchi t'ayin.
Ix walanxi t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Recab chi': Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, ko Diosal, a tz'alani: Yujto tze k'anab'ajej tas yalnakkan winh he mam eyicham chi',
yuj chi' a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, sDiosal in Israel, a in swala': Malaj b'ak'uinh ol satel yinhtilal winhaj Jonadab chi' in yak'an serwil, xchi Jehová, xin chi t'a heb'.
Ayic schanhil ab'il yoch winhaj Joacim, yuninal winhaj Josías reyal t'a Judá, ix lolon Jehová t'ayin ix yalan icha tik:

Ik'kot junok b'aj tzach tz'ib'ani. Tza tz'ib'an masanil tas ix wal t'a yib'anh Israel yet' t'a yib'anh Judá yet' t'a yib'anh masanil nakión, yiktax ix in chaanel yich walan t'ayach t'a stiempoal winhaj Josías masanto tiknaik.
Talaj ayik ol yab'an heb' aj Judá, yuj juntzanh yaelal tzin na' t'a yib'anh heb' tik, ol yaktankan schukal b'eyb'al heb', yik icha chi' ol aj wak'an niwank'olal smul heb', xchi Jehová.
Ix wawtankot winhaj Baruc yuninal winhaj Nerías. Ix walan t'a winh masanil tas ix yal Jehová t'ayin, ix stz'ib'ankan winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix walan t'a winh icha tik: Ilnab' wal tas waji, tzin kachjioch waan in b'at t'a stemplo Jehová.

Yuj chi', ayik ol jawok sk'ual tzek'ojk'olal junelxo, tzach b'at t'a yamaq'uil stemplo Jehová. Ata' ol awtej tas ix in chek a tz'ib'ej tik, yik wach' a masanil heb' aj Jerusalén yet' masanil heb' kajan t'a yol yik Judá ol jawok t'a tik, ol yab' slolonel Jehová heb'.

Talaj syalxi sb'a heb' anima tik t'a Jehová chi', syaktankan schukal b'eyb'al heb'. Yujto nab'ilxo yuj Jehová to te niwan yowal sk'ool ol yak'kot t'a yib'anh juntzanh anima tik, xin chi t'a winhaj Baruc chi'.
Ix sk'ulan winhaj Baruc chi' masanil tas ix wal chi' t'ay. Ix b'at winh t'a stemplo Jehová, ix yawtan slolonel Jehová chi' winh, aton tas ix stz'ib'ej winh chi'.

Ha t'a sb'alunhil uj t'a yoil ab'il yoch winhaj Joacim yuninal winhaj Josías reyal t'a Judá, ata' ix sna winhaj Joacim chi' to a heb' anima kajan t'a Jerusalén yet' juntzanhxo heb' ix kot t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá, yowalil tz'och heb' t'a tzek'ojk'olal t'a yichanh Jehová.

Axo winhaj Baruc ix awtan tas ix in chek stz'ib'ej, yik syab' masanil anima. Ha t'a jun amak' chaanh yajk'e t'a stemplo Jehová t'a stz'ey jun ak' puerta b'aj ay skuarto winhaj Gemarías winh tz'ib'um, winh yuninal winhaj Safán, ata' ix yawtej winh.
Ha winhaj Micaías yuninal winhaj Gemarías, yixchiquin winhaj Safán, ix yab' winh masanil slolonel Jehová ix yawtej winhaj Baruc chi'.

Yuj chi' ix b'at winh t'a spalakio winh rey, t'a skuarto winh tz'ib'um, b'aj molanek' heb' winh niwak yopisio: Aton winhaj Elisama tz'ib'um, winhaj Delaía yuninal winhaj Semaías, winhaj Elnatán yuninal winhaj Acbor, winhaj Gemarías yuninal winhaj Safán, winhaj Sedequías yuninal winhaj Ananías yet' masanil heb' ayoch t'a yopisio chi'.
Ix yalan winhaj Micaías chi' masanil tas ix yab' yuj tas tz'ib'ab'il yuj winhaj Baruc chi', ayik ix yawtan winh t'a yichanh heb' anima.

Axo heb' winh niwak yopisio chi' ix chekanb'at winhaj Jehudí yuninal winhaj Netanías, yixchiquin winhaj Selemías yinhtilal winhaj Cusi, yik b'at yalan winh t'a winhaj Baruc chi', yik syik'kot tas tz'ib'ab'il chi' yuj winh, aton jun ix yawtej winh t'a yichanh heb' anima. Yuj chi' ix yik'kot jun b'aj tz'ib'ab'il chi' winhaj Baruc chi' t'a yichanh heb' winh.
Ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --Emanh k'ojan, tzawtan kab'i tas ix a tz'ib'ej chi', xchi heb' winh. Ix yawtan winh.

Ha wal yik ix yab'an juntzanh chi' heb' winh, ix xiw heb' winh, ix och k'eljab' heb' winh t'ay junjun, ix yalan heb' winh icha tik t'a winh: --Yowalil ol kal juntzanh tik t'a winh rey, xchi heb' winh.
Ix sk'anb'an heb' winh t'a winh icha tik: --Al t'ayonh, ¿tas ix utej a tz'ib'an juntzanh tik? ¿Am winhaj Jeremías ix alan t'ayach? xchi heb' winh.
Ix tak'wi winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Aton winhaj Jeremías ix alan t'ayin, ix in tz'ib'ankan yet' tinta, xchi winh.
Ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --B'at k'ub'ejel a b'a yet' winhaj Jeremías chi', malajokab' mach tz'ojtakaneli b'aj tzex k'ochi, xchi heb' winh.
Ix yak'ankan tas tz'ib'ab'il heb' winh ay yopisio chi' t'a skuarto winhaj Elisama winh tz'ib'um, ix b'at yalan masanil juntzanh chi' heb' winh t'a winh rey t'a yamaq'uil spalakio.

Ixlajwi chi' ix chekjib'at winhaj Jehudí yuj winh rey chi' yik b'at yik'ankot winh tas tz'ib'ab'il yuj winhaj Baruc chi', jun ix kan t'a skuarto winhaj Elisama. Ayic ix jawi winh yet'ok, ix yawtan winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi' yet' t'a yichanh masanil heb' ay yopisio chi', oyanek' heb' smaklan yab'i.
Yujto sb'alunhil uj yoch jun ab'il chi', yuj chi' ayek' winh rey t'a skuarto b'aj tz'aj t'a stiempoal siik. Axo t'a yichanh winh ayoch jun yet'tal tzak'ak', chak xeinak yaj te' t'a yool.

Ayic ix lajwi yawtan winhaj Jehudí oxe', ma chanhe' makan tz'ib'ab'il chi', ix skotak polanb'at winh rey juntzanh toxo ix awtaj chi' yet' jun pol-lab' sk'an heb' tz'ib'um. Ix yak'anoch winh t'a yol k'ak' chi'. Icha chi' ix aj snhusantz'a masanil tas tz'ib'ab'il chi' winh.
Wach'chom ix yab' winh rey yet' heb' ayek' chi' yet' winh tas ix yal jun tz'ib'ab'il chi', palta maj xiw jab'ok heb', maj sch'oxel skusk'olal heb' yuj.
Ha winhaj Elnatán, winhaj Delaía yet' winhaj Gemarías ix tewi heb' winh t'a winh rey chi' yik max snhustz'a winh, palta maj schalaj yab' winh tas ix yal heb' winh.

Tonhej ix yal winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Jerameel yinhtilal heb' rey, t'a winhaj Seraías yuninal winhaj Azriel yet' t'a winhaj Selemías yuninal winhaj Abdeel, yik tzin ik'jikot a in Jeremías in tik yet' winh in tz'ib'um aj Baruc chi'. Palta a Jehová onh k'ub'aneli.
Ayic toxo ix snhustz'a tas tz'ib'ab'il winh rey chi', aton juntzanh lolonel ix in chek stz'ib'ej winhaj Baruc, ix lolonxi Jehová t'ayin, ix yalan icha tik:
Ik'kot junokxo b'aj ol a tz'ib'ejxi juntzanh lolonel ix ak' tz'ib'chaj t'a sb'ab'elal chi', aton ix snhustz'a winhaj Joacim sreyal Judá.

Tzalan pax juntzanh lolonel tik t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: Icha wal tik yalan Jehová: Ha ach tik, ix a nhustz'a tas tz'ib'ab'il, ix a tuman pax winhaj Jeremías, yujto ix stz'ib'ej winh to ol jawok winh sreyal Babilonia ul satel jun nakión tik, manhxa junok anima, ma junok nok' nok' ol kanok.
Yuj chi' a in wal Jehová in swal t'ayach ach Joacim sreyal Judá, malaj junok inhtilal ol kannhej t'a sdespacho winhaj Dawid. Ha a niwanil ol kan telan t'a yok k'u yet' t'a skal sikal t'ak'walil.

Ha ach tik yet' inhtilal yet' pax heb' ayoch yajalil ed'ok, ol wak'och yaelal t'a eyib'anh yuj he mul. Ol ja t'a yib'anh heb' aj Jerusalén yet' t'a yib'anh heb' kajan t'a Judá juntzanh yaelal toxo ix walkan tik, aton juntzanh maj he cha eyab'i, xchi Jehová, xa chi, xchi t'ayin.

Ixlajwi chi', ix wik'anxikot junxo b'aj stz'ib'chaj tastak, ix wak'an t'a winhaj Baruc winh in tz'ib'um, ix stz'ib'an winh tastak ix wala', aton tastak tz'ib'ab'il t'a juntzanh ix snhustz'a winhaj rey Joacim chi'. Ayto pax stz'akub' tas walnak chi' ix tz'ib'aji.
Ix ak'jioch winhaj Sedequías yuninal winhaj Josías reyal t'a Judá yuj winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia. Ha winh ix ochkan sk'exulok winhaj Jeconías yuninal winhaj Joacim.
Anhejtona' winhaj Sedequías chi' yet' heb' ayoch yajalil yet'ok yet' pax masanil heb' yetchonhab' winh, maj sk'anab'ajej slolonel Jehová heb' ix schek wal a in Jeremías in tik, a in schekab' in Dios.

Ha winhaj rey Sedequías chi' ix chekankot winhaj Jucal yuninal winhaj Selemías yet' winhaj sakerdote Sofonías yuninal winhaj Maasías, yik tzul in yilan heb' winh, ix yalan heb' winh t'ayin icha tik: Lesalwanh t'a Jehová ko Diosal kuuj, xchi heb' winh.
Ayic chi' manto in ak'jioch t'a preso, yuj chi' libre to in b'eyek' t'a skal heb' anima.

Ha heb' soldado aj Babilonia oyanoch heb' t'a spatik Jerusalén tik, palta t'a jun pekti’ chi', ix yab' heb' to wan skot heb' soldado winh sreyal Egipto t'a schonhab', yuj chi' ix el heb' t'a Jerusalén.
Ix lolonxi Jehová t'ayin, ix schekan wal t'a heb' winh ix chekjikot chi' t'ayin icha tik:
Alec t'a winh sreyal Judá, winh ix ex chekankot ul he k'anb'ej t'ayin, a heb' soldado winh sreyal Egipto ix kot kolwal eyed'ok eyalani, palta ol meltzaj heb' t'a Egipto.
Yuj chi', ol kotxok heb' aj Babilonia chi' yik tzul yak'an owal heb' yet' Jerusalén tik, ol ak'jok ganar jun chonhab' tik yuj heb', ol yak'ankanoch sk'ak'al heb'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Manh eyak' musansatil he b'a, tzeyalani to toxo ix el heb' soldado aj Babilonia t'a he kal, yujto manh ichaok ta' yaji.

Wach'chom ol eyak' ganar heb' soldado wan yak'an owal eyed' chi', yuj chi' axonhej heb' lajwinak ol kan t'a skampamento heb', palta ol k'ex waan heb', ol yak'anoch k'ak' heb' t'a jun he chonhab' tik, xchi Jehová, xin chi t'a heb'.
Ayic ix el heb' soldado Babilonia t'a Jerusalén, yujto ix yab' heb' to wanxo sjawi heb' soldado winh sreyal Egipto,
wanxo welta a in Jeremías in tik t'a yol chonhab' chi', yik tzin b'atkan t'a yol yik Benjamín, yik sb'at in chaan in makb'en t'a heb' ayto wuj in b'a yet'ok walani.

Ayic in k'och t'a spuertail b'aj sb'at b'e t'a yol yik Benjamín chi', ata' ay jun winh skuchan Irías yuninal winhaj Selemías, yixchiquin winhaj Hananías, yajal yaj winh t'a heb' stanhwan puerta chi'. Ha jun winh chi' in yamanoch waan, yalan winh t'ayin icha tik: --Ha ach tik, wanxo och yet' heb' aj Babilonia, xchi winh.
In tak'wi t'a winh icha tik: --Maay, malaj in tzin och yet' heb' aj Babilonia chi', xin chi t'a winh. Palta maj scha yab' winh, anhej to in yik'b'at winh t'a yichanh heb' winh yajal.
Cot yowal heb' winh yajal chi' t'ayin, in schekan mak'jok heb' winh, b'at in yak'anoch heb' winh t'a preso t'a spat winhaj Jonatán, winh tz'ib'um. Ha spat winh chi' och presoal yuj heb'.
Yuj chi', in kannhej t'a preso t'a jun kuarto b'ob'il t'a yol lu'um. Niwan tiempo in kan ta'.

Axo winhaj rey Sedequías in ak'an ik'jokkot t'a spalakio. Ayic in k'och t'a yichanh winh rey chi', sk'anb'an winh t'ayin t'a elk'altak icha tik: --¿Ay am junok slolonel Jehová tzal t'ayin? xchi winh. In tak'wi t'a winh icha tik: --Ay toni. Icha wal tik yalani: Ha ach tik mamin rey, ol ach ak'jokoch t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Babilonia, xin chi.
Anhejtona' in k'anb'ej t'a winhaj Sedequías chi' icha tik: ¿Tas in mul ix och t'ayach mamin rey yet' t'a heb' ayoch yajalil ed'ok yet' pax t'a heb' anima, yuj chi' ix in a chek ak'jokoch t'a preso?
¿Tas ix aj yelk'och slolonel juntzanh heb' syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios, heb' ix alani to manh ol jawok winh sreyal Babilonia yak' owal yet' jun chonhab' tik?
Axo tiknaik jun mamin rey, a tas ol in k'an t'ayach, komonok tzak' t'ayin: Manhxo in a cha ik'jokb'at t'a spat winhaj Jonatán, winh tz'ib'um, haxo talaj tz'aji tzin cham ta'.

Yuj chi', yalan winhaj rey Sedequías chi' to tzin kan t'a jun yamaq'uil b'aj ayek' heb' stanhwan palakio chi', haxo t'a junjun k'u tz'ak'ji junjun pan t'ayin, smanji t'a heb' b'oum pan. Ichanhej chi' aji, yakb'an ayto ixim pan chi' t'a yol chonhab' chi'. Icha chi' aj in kannhej t'a amak' chi'.

Ha winhaj Sefatías yuninal winhaj Matán, winhaj Gedalías yuninal winhaj Pasur, winhaj Jucal yuninal winhaj Selemías yet' winhaj Pasur yuninal winhaj Malquías, a heb' winh tik, ix yab' heb' winh tas ix wal t'a yichanh heb' anima ayik ix walani:

Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha mach ol kan t'a yol chonhab' tik, ol cham yuj owal, yuj wejel, ma yuj ilya. Axo mach ol yak'och sb'ha t'a yol sk'ab' heb' aj Babilonia, a heb' chi' ol kolchaj heb', manh ol chamlaj heb'.
Ol wak'och jun chonhab' tik t'a yol sk'ab' heb' soldado winh sreyal Babilonia. Ol ak'jok ganar jun chonhab' tik yuj heb', xchi Jehová, xin chi.

Yuj chi' ix yal heb' winh yajal chi' t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: --Chec miljokcham jun winak tik, yujto schab'axk'e sk'ol heb' soldado aytoek' t'a yol chonhab' tik yuj tas syal winh, syak'an somchaj spensar heb' anima winh. Ha jun winak tik, manhok swach'il heb' quetchonhab' tik say winh, palta a ko yaelal say winh, xchi heb' winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj rey Sedequías chi' t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Ichokab'ta', syalnhej he k'ulan tas he gana t'a winh, malaj jab'ok tas syal walan t'ayex, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix in syaman heb' winh, ix in yak'anem heb' winh yet' jun lasu t'a yol jun yet'tal b'aj smolb'ej sb'a ha ha'. Ha jun chi', yik winhaj Malquías yuninal winh rey chi'. Ha t'a yamaq'uil b'aj ayek' heb' stanhwan palakio, ata' ay. Ha t'a yol jun chi' manhxalaj ha ha' chi', axonhej lum sok'om ay. Yuj chi' ayik ix in emk'och chi', ix in b'atkan t'a skal lum sok'om chi'.

Ayic k'ojan em winh rey chi' t'a spuertail b'aj sb'at b'e t'a yol yik Benjamín, ix yab'an winhaj Ebed-melek to toxo ix in ak'jiem t'a yol jun yet'tal ha' chi'. Ha jun winh winak chi' aj Etiopía winh, ay yopisio winh t'a spalakio winh rey chi'.
Ix elta winh t'a yol palakio chi', ix yalan winh t'a winh rey chi' icha tik:

--Mamin rey, te chuk tas ix sk'ulej juntzanh winak tik t'a winhaj Jeremías schekab' Dios. Ix yak'em winh heb' winh t'a yol jun yet'tal ha' jul yich. Ata' ol cham winh yuj wejel, yujto manhxalaj tas swaji t'a yol chonhab' tik, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Ebed-melek chi' icha tik: --Ik'b'at junok 30 heb' winh winak tik, b'at eyik'ank'eta winhaj Jeremías chi' t'a jun jul chi', yakb'an manto cham winh, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winhaj Ebed-melek chi' yet' heb' winh t'a jun kuarto ay t'a yalanh b'aj sik'chaj tastak yik palakio, ix b'at yik'ankot juntzanh k'atak k'apak heb' winh. Ix yak'anem k'apak heb' winh yet' jun lasu t'ayin.
Ix yalan winh t'ayin icha tik: --Ak'och juntzanh k'apak chi' t'a yalanh a k'ab' yik wach' max ach lajwi yuj ch'anh lasu tik, xchi winh. Icha chi' ix wutej.
Ix yak'anem ch'anh lasu chi' heb' winh, ix in yik'ank'eta heb' winh. Axo t'a yamaq'uil b'aj ayek' heb' stanhwan palakio ix in yaktejkan heb' winh.

Ix yalan winhaj rey Sedequías chi' to tzin ik'jib'at a in Jeremías in tik t'a yichanh winh, masanto t'a yoxil spuertail templo. Ata' ix yal winh t'ayin icha tik: --Ay jun tas tzin k'anb'ej t'ayach, in gana to tz'akan ol aj a pakan t'ayin, xchi winh.
Ix walan icha tik: --Tato tzin pak t'ayach mamin rey, tzam in a chek miljokchamok, tato swak' junok razón t'ayach, tom ol a cha ab'i, xin chi.

Palta k'ub'eltak ix yak' sti' winh t'ayin icha tik: --D'a yichanh Jehová tz'ak'an ko k 'inal swak' in ti' t'ayach to manh ol ach in chek miljokchamok, manh ol ach wak'paxoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' snib'ej ach smilanchamok, xchi winh.

Ix walanxi t'a winh icha tik: --Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, aton ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, a tz'alan t'ayach icha tik: Tato tzak'och a b'ha t'a yol sk'ab' heb' yajal yaj t'a heb' soldado winh sreyal Babilonia, ol ach kolchaj yet' masanil heb' kajan ed' t'a a pat, haxo jun chonhab' tik manh ol nhusjoktz'aok.
Tato manh ol ak'och a b'ha t'a yol sk'ab' heb' jun, ol yak' ganar jun chonhab' tik heb', ol snhusantz'a heb'. Ha achxo tik manh ol yal-laj a kolan a b'a, xchi Jehová, xin chi t'a winh.
Ix tak'wi winh icha tik: --Tzin xiw t'a heb' quetchonhab' toxo ix och yet' heb' aj Babilonia chi', talaj tzin ak'chajoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb', ob'iltak am tzin yutej heb', xchi winh.
Ix in tak'wixi, ix walan icha tik: --Maay mamin rey, manh ol ach ak'chajoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb'. k'anab'ajej wal slolonel Jehová swal tik t'ayach, yik wach' ol ach elk'ochok, manh ol ach chamok.
Yujto toxo ix sch'ox Jehová t'ayin mamin rey tas ol ujok tato manh ol ak'och a b'ha t'a yol sk'ab' heb' chi'.

Masanil heb' ix ix ol kan t'a a palakio, yowalil ol ik'joquelta heb' ix, ol ak'chajoch heb' ix t'a yol sk'ab' heb' yajal soldado yik winh sreyal Babilonia chi'. Ol b'uchwaj heb' ix t'ayach icha tik: Ha heb' amigo, tonhej ix ach yak' musansatil heb', yuj chi' ix ach ak'ji ganar. Ix ach aktajkan yuj heb' t'a kal sok'om, ix el heb' t'ayach, xcham heb' ix.

--Mamin rey, masanil heb' ix etb'eyum yet' heb' uninal, ol ak'jokoch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' aj Babilonia chi'. Ha achxo jun, manhxo ol yal el t'a yol sk'ab' heb'. Palta to ol ach ak'jokoch t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Babilonia chi', ol yak'anoch sk'ak'al jun chonhab' tik heb', xin chi t'a winh rey chi'.
Ix tak'wixi winh t'ayin icha tik: --Tato tza nib'ej max ach chami, malaj junok mach b'aj tzal jun tik.

Tato syojtaquejel juntzanhxo heb' yajal to ix ach lolon wed'ok, ol jawok heb', ol sk'anb'an heb' tas ix al t'ayin yet' tas ix wal t'ayach. Ol yal heb' t'ayach to manh ol ach smilcham heb' tato tz'akan ol al t'a heb'.
Palta ol al t'a heb' to tonhej tzach tewi t'ayin yik maxtzak ach b'at preso t'a spat winhaj Jonatán yik max ach cham ta', xchi winh rey chi' t'ayin.

Ichaton chi' ix aji. Masanil heb' winh yajal chi' ix b'at in ilani, ix sk'anb'an heb' winh t'ayin. Icha wal ix aj yalan winh rey chi' t'ayin, icha chi' ix wutej walan t'a heb' winh. Yuj chi' ix yaktej heb' winh sk'anb'an t'ayin, yujto malaj junok mach ix ab'an tas ix wal yet' winh rey chi'.
Yuj chi' ix in kannhej t'a yamaq'uil b'aj ayek' heb' stanhwumal palakio masanto ix ak'ji ganar Jerusalén.
Ayic slajunhil uj yik sb'alunhil ab'il yoch winhaj Sedequías reyal t'a Judá, ata' ix jawi winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia yet' heb' soldado, ix yoymitan Jerusalén heb'.
Ayic sb'alunhil k'ual yoch schanhil uj yik 11 ab'il yoch winhaj Sedequías chi' reyal, ata' ix smak'el amnaj smuroal chonhab' chi' heb' soldado chi'.

Ata' ix och masanil heb' yajal soldado yik winh sreyal Babilonia chi'. Ha t'a jun puerta ay t'a snanhal chonhab' chi', ata' ix ajek' heb'. Ha heb' winh niwak yajal chi', aton heb' winh tik: Vinhaj Nergal-sarezer, winhaj Samgar-nebo, winhaj Sarsequim yet' pax junxo winh skuchan Nergal-sarezer.

Ayic ix yilan winhaj rey Sedequías yet' heb' soldado tas wan yuji, ix b'at heb' elelal t'ak'walil. Ha t'a skal te' yawb'en te' heb' rey, ata' ix el heb', ix elk'och heb' t'a jun puerta ay t'a skal chab' muro. Icha chi' ix aj sk'och heb' t'a yol b'e sk'och t'a spanhanil sti' ha' Jordán.

Palta ix och heb' soldado yik Babilonia chi' t'a spatik heb', ix yamchaj winhaj Sedequías chi' yuj heb' t'a spanhanil Jericó. Ix yik'anb'at winh heb' t'a winhaj rey Nabucodonosor t'a chonhab' Ribla t'a yol smakb'en Hamat. Ata' ix yal winh tas ol utaj winhaj Sedequías chi'. Ix schekan winh miljokcham heb' yuninal winhaj Sedequías chi' t'a yichanh yet' masanil heb' niwak winak yaj t'a Judá.
Ix schekanpax winh ik'jik'eta yol sat winhaj Sedequías chi', stzek'chaj pax winh t'a k'een kadena yik tz'ik'jib'at winh t'a Babilonia.
Axo heb' soldado Babilonia chi' ix ak'anoch sk'ak'al spalakio winh yet' masanil pat ay t'a Jerusalén chi'. Ix smak'anem lanhnaj smuroal jun chonhab' chi' heb'.

Axo winhaj Nabuzaradán yajal t'a heb' stanhwumal winh sreyal Babilonia chi', ix yik'b'at masanil heb' aj Judá winh t'a Babilonia chi', aton heb' ixto kan t'a yol chonhab' chi' yet' heb' ix yak'och sb'a yet' heb' aj Babilonia chi' yet' masanil heb' anima.
Axonhej juntzanh heb' meb'a' ix yaktejkan winh t'a yol yik Judá chi', aton heb' malaj jab'ok tas ay t'ay. Ix ak'chaj lum lum b'aj awab'il te' uwa t'a heb' yet' juntzanhxo te' awb'en te'.
Ha winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia, ix yal winh t'a winhaj Nabuzaradán yajal t'a heb' stanhwumal winh rey chi' yuj tas tzin aj a in Jeremías in tik, ix yalan winh icha tik:
Ik'b'at winh tik, tza tanhwan winh, manh ixtej winh, masanil tas sk'an winh, tzak' t'a winh, xchi winh rey chi'.
Yuj chi' a winhaj Nabuzaradán yet' winhaj Nabusazbán yet' pax winhaj Nergal-sarezer yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh ay yopisio yet' winh sreyal Babilonia chi',

ix in schek ik'jielta heb' winh t'a yamaq'uil b'aj ayin och preso chi'. Ix in yak'ankanoch heb' winh t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Gedalías yuninal winhaj Ahicam, yixchiquin winhaj Safán, yik tzin yak'an meltzaj winh t'a in pat. Icha chi' ix aj in kan kajan t'a skal heb' wetchonhab'.
Ayic ayintoek' t'a yamaq'uil b'aj ayek' heb' stanhwumal palakio chi', ix lolon Jehová t'ayin, ix yalan icha tik:

Ixic t'a winhaj Ebed-melek aj Etiopía, tzalan t'a winh icha tik: Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, sDiosal Israel, a tz'alan icha tik: Ol wak'elk'och tas walnakkan t'a spatik jun chonhab' tik. Ol jawok yaelal, manhok wach'ilal. Ayic ol elk'och juntzanh chi' ol il wal yet' a sat.
Ha in Jehová in swala' to ol ach in tanhwej yik wach' manh ol ach och t'a yol sk'ab' juntzanh anima b'aj tzach xiw chi'.
Ha in wal swala' to ol ach in kolel t'a yol sk'ab' heb', yuj chi' manh ol ach miljokchamok, yujto ayoch a pensar t'ayin, xchi Jehová, xin chi t'a winh.

Ix lolon Jehová t'ayin ayik toxo ix in aktajel t'a Ramá yuj winhaj Nabuzaradán yajal t'a heb' stanhwumal winh sreyal Babilonia. Ix yil winh to tzek'an in t'a k'een kadena, ay in och t'a skal heb' aj Jerusalén yet' heb' aj Judá, heb' wan yik'jib'at t'a Babilonia.
Ix in yik'anelta winh, ix yalan winh t'ayin icha tik: Ha Jehová a Diosal ix alani to ol yak'kot jun niwan yaelal tik t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik.
Ha tiknaik toxo ix yak'elk'och tas ix yal chi'. Ix yak'kot juntzanh tik t'a eyib'anh, yujto maj he k'anab'ajej tas ix yala'.

Ha tiknaik, ol wik'el k'een kadena tik t'ayach. Tato a gana tzach b'at wed' t'a Babilonia, syala', a in ol ach in ya ilej. Tato malaj a gana tzach b'at jun, kananh t'a tik. B'ekan yaj masanil lum lum tik t'ayach, syal a sik'lan b'aj snib'ej a k'ol tzach kani, xchi winh t'ayin.

Ayic manto in tak'woklaj t'a winh, ix yalanxi winh icha tik: Wach' tzach meltzaj b'aj ayek' winhaj Gedalías yuninal winhaj Ahicam, yixchiquin winhaj Safán, aton winh chi' ix yak'och winh sreyal Babilonia gobernadoral t'a Judá, tzach kajnaj yet' winh t'a skal heb' etchonhab'. Syal pax a b'at b'aj a gana, xchi winh t'ayin. Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'an jun silab' yet' jab'ok wael winh t'ayin, ix yalan quil ko b'a winh t'ayin.
Icha chi' ix aj in b'atkan t'a winhaj Gedalías t'a chonhab' Mizpa. Ix in kajnaj yet' winh t'a skal heb' anima ixto kan yuj winhaj Nabucodonosor chi'.

Ay heb' winh yajalil heb' soldado aj Judá sk'ub'ejnakkanel sb'ha t'a kaltak te' t'a heb' soldado aj Babilonia. Ix yab'an heb' winh to a winhaj Gedalías yuninal winhaj Ahicam ix ak'jioch gobernadoral yuj winh sreyal Babilonia chi'. Ha winh ix och yajalilok heb' winh winak, heb' ix ix, heb' unin yet' heb' meb'a', aton heb' maj ik'jokb'atlaj t'a Babilonia chi'.

Yuj chi' ix b'at heb' winh yil winh t'a Mizpa chi', aton heb' winh tik: Vinhaj Ismael yuninal winhaj Netanías, winhaj Johanán yet' winhaj Jonatán, aton heb' winh yuninal winhaj Carea, winhaj Seraías yuninal winhaj Tanhumet yet' jaywanh heb' winh yuninal winhaj Efai aj Netofa, winhaj Jezanías yuninal jun winh aj Maacat, ajun heb' winh soldado heb' winh yet'ok.

Ix yak'an sti' winhaj Gedalías t'a heb' winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: Manh ex xiw eyak'anoch he b'ha t'a yol sk'ab' heb' aj Babilonia chi'. Cajnajanhec t'a tik. Hak'uekoch he b'ha t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Babilonia chi' yik malaj tas ol ex ik'anok.

Ha in tik ol in kan t'a Mizpa tik, yik wach' a in ol ex wak' cheklaj t'a yichanh heb' aj Babilonia chi', ayik ol jawok heb' t'a tik. Ha ex tik, molb'ejek sat te' uwa yet' sat te' awb'en te' yet' akeite. Icha chi' ol ex kannhej t'a juntzanh chonhab' toxo ix eyik' chi', xchi winh t'a heb' winh.

Anhejtona' jantak heb' aj Judá ayb'at t'a Moab, t'a Amón, t'a Edom yet' t'a juntzanhxo nakión, ix yab'an heb' to ayto anima ix kan yuj winh sreyal Babilonia t'a Judá. Ix yab'anpax heb' to a winhaj Gedalías yuninal winhaj Ahicam, yixchiquin winhaj Safán ix ak'jioch gobernadoral.

Masanil heb' sakleminak yajkanb'at chi', ix meltzajxi heb' t'a Judá. Ix jawi heb' sch'ox sb'ha t'a winhaj Gedalías t'a Mizpa chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix smolb'an sat te' uwa heb' yet' juntzanhxo sat te' awb'en te'.
Ha winhaj Johanán yuninal winhaj Carea yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh yajal soldado ix kan t'a kaltak te' chi', ix k'och heb' winh t'a winhaj Gedalías t'a Mizpa chi',

ix yalan heb' winh t'a winh icha tik: --¿Ix am ab'i to a winhaj Baalis sreyal Amón ix chekankot winhaj Ismael yuninal winhaj Netanías yik tzach smilanchamok? xchi heb' winh. Palta a winhaj Gedalías chi', maj schalaj winh t'a heb' winh.

Yuj chi' t'a k'ub'eltak ix yal winhaj Johanán t'a winhaj Gedalías chi': --Cha in b'ati yik b'at in milcham winhaj Ismael chi'. Malaj junok mach ol ojtakanelok mach ix milancham winh. ¿Tas yuj ol ach ko cha smilcham winh? Tato ol ach cham yuj winh, ol saklemkanb'at masanil heb' ayxoek' tik ed'ok, axom somchajb'at heb' toxo ix kan t'a Judá tik junelxo, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Gedalías chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Manh a na' icha chi'. Ha tas tz'alchaj t'a spatik winhaj Ismael chi', manh yeloklaj, xchi winh.

Ha t'a yuquil uj ix b'at winhaj Ismael yuninal winhaj Netanías yet' lajunhwanh soldado t'a Mizpa yik b'at lolon heb' winh yet' winhaj Gedalías chi', junnhej ix wa heb' winh yet' winh. (Ha winhaj Ismael chi', yixchiquin pax winh winhaj Elisama, yinhtilal heb' winh rey, niwan yopisio winh t'a winh sreyal Judá t'a yalanhtaxo.)

Yakb'an wan swa heb' winh, ix k'e waan winhaj Ismael yet' heb' winh lajunhwanh ajun yet' chi', ix smilancham winhaj Gedalías chi' heb' winh t'a k'een espada, aton winh ix ak'jioch gobernadoral t'a Judá yuj winh sreyal Babilonia.
Ix smilanpaxcham masanil heb' aj Judá yet' heb' soldado aj Babilonia ayek' yet' winhaj Gedalías winhaj Ismael chi'.
Axo t'a junxo k'u, ayik toxo ix cham winhaj Gedalías chi', manta mach tz'ojtakanel tas ix uji chi',

ix k'och 80 heb' winh winak spetoj t'a Siquem, t'a Silo yet' t'a Samaria. Toxo ix sjoxel xil sti' heb' winh, tzilchimtak spichul heb' winh ayochi, haxo sniwanil heb' winh echentak yaji, munil a heb' winh icha chi' ix yutej sb'a. Yed'nak ixim trigo heb' winh yet' inkienso yik syak' heb' winh silab'il t'a Jehová t'a templo.

Ha t'a Mizpa chi' ix elta winhaj Ismael chi' ul scha heb' winh, wan stz'akan ok' sb'a winh, haxo yik ix schalan sb'a winh yet' heb' winh, ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Cotanhec, ul ilek winhaj Gedalías yuninal winhaj Ahicam, xchi winh.

Palta anhej yik ix k'och heb' winh winak chi' t'a snanhal chonhab' chi', ix miljicham heb' winh yuj winhaj Ismael chi' yet' heb' ajun yet' winh. Ix yumjikanb'at sniwanil heb' winh t'a yol jun niwan jul yet'tal ha'.

Palta ay lajunhwanh heb' winh t'a skal heb' winh wan smiljicham chi' ix alan t'a winhaj Ismael chi': --Manh onh a milchamok, a onh tik ay ixim ko trigo, ixim kebada, ko akeite, ay pax nok' ko yal chab'. Ha juntzanh chi' k'ub'anel kuj t'a spatiktaquel ko chonhab', xchi heb' winh. Yuj chi' majxo miljokcham heb' winh yuj winhaj Ismael yet' heb' ajun yet' winh.

(Ha jun jul b'aj ix ak'jiem sniwanil heb' winh ix smilcham winhaj Ismael chi', aton jun scheknak winhaj rey Asa joychajok, yik skolannak sb'a winh t'a winhaj Baasa sreyal Israel. Ha jun jul chi' te lewan, palta ix b'ud'ji yuj sniwanil heb' anima ix smilcham winhaj Ismael chi'.)

Ix yik'anb'at heb' ix yisil winh rey winhaj Ismael chi' yet' heb' anima ayek' t'a Mizpa chi', aton heb' ix ak'ji stanhwej winhaj Gedalías yuj winhaj Nabuzaradán. Ix ik'jib'at heb' yuj winh, yik sb'atkan heb' t'a yol smakb'en Amón presoal.
Axo yik ix yab'an winhaj Johanán yuninal winhaj Carea yet' heb' yajalil soldado ayek' yet'ok, yuj jantak chukal ix sk'ulej winhaj Ismael chi',
ix smolb'an masanil heb' soldado heb' winh, ix b'at heb' winh yak' owal yet' winhaj Ismael chi'. Ha b'aj ay jun niwan yet'tal ha' t'a Gabaón, ata' ix ilchaj winh yuj heb' winh.
Axo heb' wan yik'jib'at icha presoal yuj winhaj Ismael chi', ayik ix yilan winhaj Johanán chi' heb' yet' heb' winh yajalil heb' soldado ajun yet' winh, ix te tzalaj heb'.
Ix meltzaj heb' smasanil, ix yak'anoch sb'a heb' yet' winhaj Johanán chi'.
Palta haxo winhaj Ismael chi' yet' wajxakwanhxo heb' winh ajun yet'ok, ix el lemnaj heb' winh, ix b'atkan heb' winh t'a yol yik Amón.

Ha winhaj Johanán yet' heb' soldado chi' ix ik'anxikanek' heb' anima, ix koljipax heb' yuj heb' winh, aton heb' kajan t'a Mizpa ix yik'b'at winhaj Ismael chi' ayik ix lajwi smilancham winhaj Gedalías winh. Ha juntzanh heb' anima chi', ay heb' winh soldado, ay heb' ix ix, ay heb' unin, ay pax heb' niwak yopisio. Aton heb' ix ik'jixikanek' t'a winhaj Ismael t'a Gabaón

yik sb'at heb' elelal t'a Egipto yujto xiwnak heb' t'a heb' aj Babilonia, yujto ix miljicham winhaj Gedalías, winh ix sik'jioch gobernadoral yuj winh sreyal Babilonia yuj winhaj Ismael. Ix b'atnhej heb', masanto ix k'och heb' t'a Gerut-quimam, t'a slak'anil Belén. Ata' ix och waan heb', yujto wan sb'at heb' t'a Egipto chi' yalani.

Masanil heb' winh yajalil heb' soldado ajun yet' winhaj Johanán yuninal winhaj Carea yet' pax winhaj Jezanías yuninal winhaj Osaías yet' masanil heb' anima, heb' ay yelk'ochi yet' heb' malaj yelk'ochi, ix jawi heb' t'ayin Jeremías schekab' in Dios tik.

Ix yalan heb' icha tik: --Ay wal jun tas ol ko k'an t'ayach tiknaik, manh a tenek' t'ayonh: Lesalwanh t'a Jehová ko Diosal kuj jaywanh onh ix onh kan ik. Ha t'a yalanhtaxo, tzijtum ko b'eyi, palta haxo tiknaik axonhej jaywanh onh ayonhek' tik onh kani.
Lesalwanh t'a Jehová ko Diosal kuuj yik wach' ol sch'ox t'ayonh tas b'eal ol k'ik'a' yet' tas wach' ol ko k'ulej, xchi heb'.

Ix in tak'wi t'a heb', ix walan icha tik: --Wach' yaji. Ol in lesalwok t'a Jehová ko Diosal eyuuj, icha ix aj he k'anan chi' t'ayin. Jantacnhej tas ol yal Jehová t'ayin a ol walxi t'ayex. Malaj jab'ok tas ol in k'ub'ejeli, xin chi t'a heb'.
Ix tak'wixi heb' t'ayin icha tik: --Aokab' Jehová chi' testigo tz'ajkan t'ayonh, tato manh ol ko k'anab'ajej tas ol yal chi' t'ayach.

Tato ol scha ko k'ol tas ol aj spakan Jehová ko Diosal chi' t'ayach, mato manh ol scha ko k'ool, palta ol ko k'anab'ajejnhej tas ol yal chi'. Scal t'ayach to tza k'an t'ay kuuj yik wach' ol onh elk'ochok, xchi heb'.
Sb'alunhilxo k'ual chi', ichato chi' ix lolon Jehová t'ayin.
Yuj chi' ix wawtejkot winhaj Johanán yet' heb' winh yajal soldado yet' masanil heb' anima, heb' niwak yelk'ochi yet' heb' malaj yelk'ochi.
Ix walan icha tik: Ha Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, b'aj ix in tewi yuj tas ix eyal t'ayin, a tz'alan icha tik:

Tato tzex kajnajkan t'a jun lum tik, ol wak'b'at wach'ilal t'a eyib'anh, manhxo ol ex in sateli. Ol wak' q'uib' he b'isul, manhxo ol ex wak' ik'jokb'atok. Yujto ya ix wab' yuj jun niwan yaelal ix wak'b'at t'a eyib'anh tik.
Ha in Jehová in swala': Manhxo ex xiw t'a winh sreyal Babilonia, aton winh b'aj tzex te xiwi. Ha tiknaik manhxo ex xiwok, yujto ayinnhejek' eyed'ok, ol ex in kolel t'a yol sk'ab' winh.
Ay wal wok'elk'olal t'ayex. Anhejtona' ol wak' ok' pax sk'ol jun winh rey chi' t'ayex, ol ex yak'anxi meltzaj winh t'a he chonhab', xchi Jehová.
Palta tato max he k'anab'ajej tas syal Jehová ko Dios chi', tato tzeyal icha tik: Malaj ko gana ko kan t'a jun chonhab' tik.
Ol onh b'at t'a Egipto. Ata' ol onh kajnajok, b'aj manhxo ol quil owal, manhxo ol kab' yok' k'een trompeta, manhxo ol onh cham yuj wejel, tato xe chi,
yuj chi' ab'ek a ex ayex to kan t'a Judá tik, tas wal syal Jehová ko Diosal Yajal t'a Smasanil: Tato tzex ek' wal t'a yib'anh he b'at t'a Egipto chi' yik tzex kajnaj ta' he naani,
a owal yet' wejel b'aj tzex xiw chi', ol k'och t'ayex ta'. Ata' ol ex chamok.

Masanil heb' sb'at t'a Egipto yik skajnaj ta', ol cham heb' yuj owal, yuj wejel, yuj pax ilya. Malaj junok mach manh ol chamok, manhxalaj mach ol yal skolan sb'ha t'a yaelal ol wak'b'at ta', xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, ko Diosal, a tz'alan icha tik: Icha ix aj sja yowal in k'ol t'a yib'anh heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén, icha wal chi' ol aj sja pax yowal in k'ol t'a eyib'anh a ex tik, tato ol ex b'at t'a Egipto chi'. Ayic ol ex yilan heb' anima t'a juntzanhxo nakión to icha sjawi t'a yib'anh heb' katab'il, icha chi' ol ex ajok, ol xiw heb', ol ex b'uchjok yuj heb'. Manhxa b'ak'uinh ol eyilxi jun he lum tik, xchi Jehová.
Ha ex aj Judá ex ixto ex kan tik, a Jehová wan yalan t'ayex yik max ex b'at t'a Egipto chi'. Ojtaquejequeli to a in wan walan t'ayex tiknaik,

te niwan he pitalil wan eyak'anochi, yujto ix he chek in k'anb'ej t'a Jehová ko Diosal, ix eyalan t'ayin icha tik: Lesalwanh t'a Jehová ko Diosal kuuj. Ol ak'an kojtaquejel masanil tas ol yala', ol ko k'anab'ajani, xe chi.
Toxo ix wak' eyojtaquejel tas ix yal Jehová ko Diosal chi', palta max yal pax he k'ol tze k'anab'ajej.
Yuj chi', ojtaquejequeli to ol ex cham yuj owal, yuj wejel, yuj pax ilya t'a jun chonhab' b'aj he gana tzex b'atkan chi', xin chi t'a heb'.
Ayic ix lajwi walan masanil tas ix schek Jehová wal t'a heb' anima chi',

haxo winhaj Jezanías yuninal winhaj Osaías, winhaj Johanán yuninal winhaj Carea yet' pax juntzanhxo heb' winh winak te ak'umtak, ix yalan heb' winh t'ayin: Manh yelok juntzanh lolonel tzal chi'. Yujto a Jehová ko Diosal maj yal-laj t'ayach to max onh b'at t'a Egipto yik tzonh kajnaj ta'.

Ha winhaj Baruc yuninal winhaj Nerías, a winh tz'alan juntzanh lolonel tik t'a ko patik yik tzonh yak'och winh t'a yol sk'ab' heb' aj Babilonia chi', yik tzonh smilancham heb', ma onh yik'anb'at heb' t'a Babilonia chi', xchi heb' winh.
Icha chi' ix aj yoch spitalil winhaj Johanán yet' heb' winh yajal soldado yet' pax masanil heb' anima. Maj kanlaj heb' t'a Judá icha ix aj yalan Jehová chi'.

Ha heb' aj Judá ix saklemb'at t'a junjun nakión, aton heb' toxo ix smolb'ejxi sb'ha t'a Judá chi' yik skajnajxi heb' ta', a winhaj Johanán chi' yet' heb' winh yajal soldado ix ik'anb'at heb' t'a Egipto.

Ix yik'anpaxb'at heb' winh winak heb' winh, heb' ix ix, heb' unin yet' heb' ix yisil winh rey yet' masanil heb' ix ak'jikanoch t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Gedalías yuj winhaj Nabuzaradán. Ix in yik'anpaxb'at heb' winh yet' winhaj Baruc.
Manh jab'ok ix sk'anab'ajej heb' tas ix yal Jehová. Ix onh b'at ko masanil t'a Egipto chi'. Ato t'a jun chonhab' skuch Tafnes ix onh k'och kajan.
Ha t'a chonhab' Tafnes chi' ix lolon Jehová t'ayin, ix yalan icha tik:
Ik'b'at jayeok niwak k'een, tza mukan t'a skal lum b'ak'uech lum t'a sti' yamaq'uil spalakio heb' winh sreyal Egipto ay t'a jun chonhab' tik. D'a yichanh heb' etchonhab' chi' tza muquem k'een.

Tzalan t'a heb' icha tik: Ha Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, Yajal t'a Smasanil, a tz'alani: Ol wik'kot winhaj Nabucodonosor in chekab', winh sreyal Babilonia, ol wak' yak'em sk'ojnub' winh, ol sb'oank'e smantiado winh yenhulok t'a yib'anh juntzanh k'een k'een ix a muquem tik.

Ol jawok winh, ol satanel Egipto tik winh. Ha mach yik yaj scham yuj ilya, a ilya chi' ol ik'an schami. Ha mach yik yaj yik'jib'at t'a ch'ok chonhab'il, ol ik'joknhejb'atok. Ha mach yik yaj smiljicham t'a owal, t'a owal chi' ol chamok.

Ol snhusantz'a juntzanh stemplo sdiosal heb' aj Egipto tik winh, ol yik'anb'at juntzanh skomon diosal heb' chi' winh. Icha junok tanhwum kalnel pilan syik'el nok' sip t'a spichul, icha chi' ol yutej Egipto tik winhaj Nabucodonosor chi', pilan ol yik'b'at sb'eyumal winh, junk'olal ol meltzaj winh.
Ol juchajpaxem juntzanh obelisko t'a Bet-semes t'a Egipto, haxo stemplo sdiosal heb' ol nhusjoktz'aok, xchi Jehová, xin chi t'a heb'.
Aton juntzanh lolonel tik ix yal Jehová t'ayin Jeremías in tik, yik swal t'a heb' aj Judá, aton heb' ix k'och kajan t'a yol smakb'en Egipto, aton t'a Migdol, t'a Tafnes, t'a Menfis yet' t'a Patros.

Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, aton ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, a tz'alan icha tik: Ha ex tik, ix eyil masanil yaelal ix wak'b'at t'a yib'anh Jerusalén yet' t'a yib'anh juntzanh chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá. Ha tiknaik a juntzanh chonhab' chi' satnaqueli. Manhxa junok mach kajan t'ay,

yujnhej wal chukal sk'ulej heb'. Ix stzuntzejkot yowal in k'ol heb', yujto ix och heb' ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios, ix snhusanpax inkienso heb' t'a juntzanh chi'. Ha t'a juntzanh Dios chi', malaj yalan yik heb' yet' ex a ex tik yet' pax heb' he mam eyicham.
Tzijtum el ix in chekb'at heb' in chekab', yik sb'at yalan heb' t'ayex to max he b'eyb'alej juntzanh chi', yujto max schalaj in k'ool.
Palta maj he k'anab'ajej, maj he chapax eyab' tas ix wala'. Maj eyaktejkan he k'ulan chukal, ix ex te k'e wal chaanh he nhusan inkienso t'a juntzanh komon Dios chi'.
Yuj chi' ix kot yowal in k'ool, icha te' k'ak' ix aj sk'och kopnaj t'a yib'anh juntzanh chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá yet' t'a yoltak skalleal Jerusalén. Icha chi' ajnak yem lanhnajok masanto tiknaik.

Yuj chi', a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, he Diosal in, a in swala': ¿Tas yuj tzeyik'kot jun niwan yaelal chi' t'a eyib'anh? ¿Tas yuj ol ex cham he masanil ex aj Judá? Ol cham heb' winh winak, heb' ix ix, heb' unin yet' pax heb' wanto yalji, syalelk'ochi to manhxa ex ol ex kanok.

¿Tas yuj tzin he tzuntzej yuj tas tze k'ulej, tze nhusan inkienso t'a juntzanh komon Dios t'a Egipto b'aj ix ex jawi kajan tik? Yuj wal juntzanh chi' ol ex satelok. Ol ex b'uchjok yuj juntzanhxo nakión t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik ayik ol yilan heb' to icha tas sjawi t'a yib'anh heb' katab'il, icha chi' ol ex ajok.

¿Tom toxo ix b'at satk'olal eyuuj jantak chukal sk'ulejnak heb' he mam eyicham, heb' winh sreyal Judá yet' heb' ix yetb'eyum yet' pax juntzanh chukal he k'ulejnak yet' heb' ix eyetb'eyum t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá yet' t'a yoltak skalleal Jerusalén?
Anhejtona' tiknaik, max he k'ex he b'eyb'al, max ex xiwpax jab'ok. Max he k'anab'ajej in cheknab'il yet' in k'ayb'ub'al wak'nak t'ayex yet' t'a heb' he mam eyicham.
Yuj chi' a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, he Diosal in, a in swala': Toxo ix in na' to ol wak'b'at jun yaelal t'a eyib'anh, ol ex wak'an satel he masanil ex aj Judá.

Ha ex ix ex kanlej kajan t'a Judá, palta ix ex ek' t'a yib'anh he jawi t'a Egipto tik. Ol ex satel t'a junelnhej, schakot t'a heb' nene' unin masanto t'a heb' icham anima, ol cham heb' yuj owal yuj pax wejel. Ol ja in katab' t'a eyib'anh, ob'iltak ol ex wutokkanok. Ha heb' ol ex ilanok ol te xiw heb'.
Ol wak' eyaelal mach ex ix ex jawi kajan t'a Egipto tik yet' owal, wejel yet' pax ilya icha ajnak wak'an syaelal heb' aj Jerusalén.

Malaj junok ex aj Judá ex tik, a ex ix ex ja kajan t'a Egipto tik olto ex kanok, manhxa junok mach ol yal yeli. Wach'chom ol he nib'ejxik'och he b'ha t'a Judá yik tzex kajnajxi t'ay, palta axonhej jaywanhok ex ol ex el elelal, ol ex k'och he kol he b'a ta', xchi Jehová, xin chi t'a heb'.

Yuj chi' masanil heb' winh ojtannak to a heb' ix yetb'eyum heb' winh snhus inkienso heb' ix t'a juntzanh komon Dios yet' masanil heb' ix ix ayek' ta', te tzijtum heb' molaneq'ui yet' pax masanil heb' aj Judá kajan t'a Egipto yet' t'a Patros, ix tak'wi heb' t'ayin icha tik:
--Ha onh tik, manh ol ko k'anab'ajejlaj slolonel Jehová ix al chi' t'ayonh.

Anhej tas sko na' anhej ol ko b'eyb'alej. Ol ko nhusnhej inkienso, ol kak'nhej pax wino silab'il t'a ix yajalil satcha’anh, icha wan ko k'ulan tiknaik, icha sk'ulejnak pax heb' ko mam quicham yet' heb' ko reyal yet' heb' yajalil t'a yoltak juntzanh chonhab' t'a Judá yet' t'a yoltak skalleal Jerusalén. Yujto ha t'a peka' chi', ay ko wael, tzalajk'olalnhej ek'nak onh, malaj yaelal jawinak t'a quib'anh.
Ato ix kaktan ko nhusan inkienso yet' kak'an wino silab'il t'a ix yajalil satcha’anh, manhxalaj tas ay t'ayonh, tzonh cham yuj wejel yet' yuj owal, xchi heb'.

Ix yalan heb' ix ix icha tik: --Ha onh tik ix ko b'o ixim wail icha yechel ix yajalil satcha’anh, ix ko nhusan inkienso, ix kak'anpax wino silab'il t'ay. Masanil tas ix ko k'ulej chi', t'a yichanh heb' winh quetb'eyum ix ko k'ulej, xchi heb' ix.
Ixlajwi chi', ix in tak'wi t'a heb' winh winak yet' t'a heb' ix ix alan juntzanh chi' t'ayin, ix walan icha tik:

--¿Am he naan a ex tik to manh yojtakok Jehová, ma ix b'at satk'olal yuj b'aj ix he nhus inkienso t'a juntzanh komon Dios chi' t'a yoltak chonhab' yet' t'a yoltak skalleal Jerusalén icha yutejnak sb'a heb' ko mam quicham, heb' ko reyal, heb' yajal yaj t'a ko kal yet' masanil heb' anima t'a yol yik Judá?

Palta majxo techaj juntzanh he b'eyb'al te chuk chi' yuj Jehová chi', maj scha sk'ool. Yuj chi' a ko chonhab' toxo ix pojchajem tiknaik, manhxa mach kajan t'ay. Toxo ix ja skatab' Jehová t'a yib'anh, ste xiw anima yilani.

Ha jun yaelal ayoch t'a quib'anh tik, ix jawi yujto anheja' he nhusan inkienso t'a juntzanh komon Dios. Anheja' eyak'anoch he mul t'a Jehová, yujto maj he k'anab'ajej sk'ayb'ub'al, slolonel yet' pax scheknab'il, xin chi t'a heb'.
Ix walanxi t'a heb' ix ix yet' t'a masanil anima chi' icha tik: --Ab'ek wal jun slolonel Jehová tik ex wetchonhab', ex kajan ex t'a yol yik Egipto tik tiknaik.

Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, a tz'alan icha tik: Ha ex tik yet' heb' ix eyetb'eyum, ix eyak' he ti' t'a ix yajal satcha’anh he nhusan inkienso, eyak'anpax wino silab'il t'a ix, wan he k'anab'ajan he k'ulan b'aj ix eyak' he ti' chi'. Wach'toni, k'anab'ajejek he k'ulan b'aj ix eyak' he ti' chi'.

Palta he masanil ex aj Judá kajan ex t'a Egipto tik, ab'ek tas swal a in Jehová in tik t'ayex: Ha in wal swak' in ti' to manhxa junok ex aj Judá ex tik olto in eyak' b'inaj t'a Egipto tik ayik tzeyak'an he ti' t'a junok tas.
Yujto wan wilani to ol wak'b'at yaelal t'a eyib'anh, manhok wach'il ol wak'b'ati. Masanil ex aj Judá kajan ex t'a Egipto tik, ol ex satel yuj owal, yuj pax wejel.

Jaywanh exxonhej ol ex kolchaj t'a skal owal, ol ex el t'a Egipto tik, ol ex meltzaj t'a Judá. Ichato chi' he masanil ex aj Judá ix ex jawi t'a Egipto tik, ol eyila' mach ol elk'och slolonel, am wiko', mato a eyik ol elk'ochok.
Ha in Jehová in swak' jun ch'oxnab'il tik, ol wak' yaelal nab'il wuj t'a eyib'anh, ol ex in satel t'a jun nakión tik, icha ix aj wak'an in ti'.

Ol wak'och winhaj Hofra sreyal Egipto t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ol snib'an smilan winh, icha ix aj wak'anoch winhaj Sedequías sreyal Judá t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia, aton winh yajk'ol winh snib'an smilanchamok, xchi Jehová, xin chi.
