Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ha tiknaik ach anima, ik'kot junok lum xan, tzak'anem lum t'a ichanh, tza tz'ib'anem yechel chonhab' Jerusalén t'a lu'um.
Slajwi chi', tzak'anoch oyan yechel yamk'ab' yik owal, kampamento yet' tek'nub' t'a spatik smuroal,

tzak'anoch junok k'een icha k'een sa'am t'a a kal yet' jun chonhab' chi'. Ha jun chi', lajan icha junok muro, tzach och t'a yichanh jun chonhab' chi', ichato wan ak'an owal yet'ok. Icha chi' ol aj yoch ch'oxnab'ilok t'a heb' etchonhab'.

Slajwi chi', tzach ek' jichan t'a a k'exanh, icha chi' ol aj a ch'oxanel yaelal ol jawok t'a yib'anh heb' etchonhab' yuj smul. Anhej t'a a k'exanh chi' ol ach ek'nhej jichan yakb'an wan a ch'oxanel yaelal ol jawok t'a yib'anh heb' yuj smul chi'.
Ay 390 k'ual ol a k'ulej jun chi', syalelk'ochi junjun ab'il sch'ox junjun k'ual, icha chi' ol aj yab'an syail heb' israel yuj smul chi'.

Ayic ol lajwok juntzanh k'ual chi', haxo t'a a wach' tzach ek' jichan. Icha chi' ol aj a ch'oxanel yaelal ol ja t'a yib'anh heb' aj Judá yuj smul. 40 k'ual ol ach ek' jichan t'a a wach' chi', syalelk'ochi junjun ab'il sch'ox junjun k'ual, icha chi' ol aj yab'an syail heb' yuj smul chi'.
Tzach b'at k'elan t'a jun yechel Jerusalén b'aj oyanoch heb' ajk'ool, tza pilank'e sk'ab' a pichul, tzik'anchaanh a k'ab' chi', tzach lolon t'a heb' etchonhab' chi' t'a in b'i.
Ichato ol ach in tzek' yet' ch'anh lasu yik wach' max yal ek' b'alb'onok masanto ol tz'akwok sk'ual a ch'oxanel syaelal heb' chi'.

Ayic manto ach tzek'chaj chi', tzik'kot jab'ok ixim trigo, ixim kebada, ixim mijo, ixim awena, anh awastut, anh lenteja yet' ixim kenteno, kalan tz'aj yem t'a yol junok lum chen. Ha yet' juntzanh chi' tza b'o a wael, ol a waan t'a 390 k'ual b'aj ol ach ek' jichan t'a a k'exanh chi'.
Tzechtej nanhal libra tza wa t'a junjun k'u, chequelnhej yorail tzach wa'i.
Chequel pax yorail yik tzuk'an nanhalok litro ha ha' t'a junjun k'u.
Ha jun wael tza b'o chi', icha tz'aj sb'o ixim pan kebada tzutej. D'a yichanh heb' anima chi' tzak' tajok ixim t'a kal k'ak', a stza' heb' anima chi' tza k'an a k'atzitzok, xchi Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalanpax Jehová icha tik: Ol a wa juntzanh wael manh wach'ok chi' icha yalan ley, yuj a ch'oxaneli to icha chi' ol aj swaan heb' etisraelal wael manh wach'ok icha yalan ley t'a juntzanhxo nakión b'aj ol in saklemejb'at heb', xchi Jehová.

Ix in tak'wi t'ay icha tik: Maay Mamin Jehová, malaj b'aj tzin yam junok tas manh wach'ok icha yalan ley. Malaj b'aj tzin chi' schib'ejal nok' nok' to tonhej syak'cham sb'a, ma nok' smiljicham yuj nok' chium nok' t'a kaltak te', ma junok makan nok' chib'ej to manh wach'ok icha yalan ley, xin chi.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Syal a stza' nok' wakax tza k'an t'a k'atzitzal sk'exulok stza' heb' anima chi', yik tza b'oan a wael chi', xchi.
Ix yalanxi t'ayin icha tik: Ol in satel wael t'a Jerusalén. Echtab'ilxonhej ol aj swael heb' yet' tas syuk'ej heb', yuj chi' t'a skal ilk'olal yet' t'a skal xiwk'olal ol wa heb', ol yuk'an ha' heb'.
Manhxa ha ha' yet' swael heb', toxonhej ol xiwk'e heb' yil-lanoch sb'a junjun. Yuj wal smul heb' chi' k'ojank'olal ol aj satel heb', xchi Jehová.

Ix yalanpax Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ha tiknaik ach anima, ik'kot junok k'een kuchilub' te jay ye, icha wal junok k'een nawaja sk'an heb' joxwajum, tza josanel xil a jolom yet' xil a ti' t'a k'een. Slajwi chi', tzik'anpaxkot junok echlab', ox makan tz'aj echtan a xil chi'.

Ayic ol lajwok a ch'oxan yechel syaelal chonhab' chi', a junok makan a xil chi', tza nhustz'ha t'a snanhal yol yechel chonhab' chi'. Slajwi chi', tzik'anxikot k'een kuchilub' chi', tza chok' kupan junok makan a xil chi' t'a spatiktak yechel chonhab' chi', haxo junokxo yoxil makan, tza tzipankanb'at t'a kal ik'. Ch'oxnab'il jun chi' to a in ol wak'kot heb' ajk'ool, ol och heb' t'a spatik heb' etchonhab' chi' yet' k'een yespada.
Tzik'ankanel jayeok a xil chi' tza pichankanoch t'a sti' a pichul.
Ha t'a juntzanh chi' tzik'el jayeok, tza nhusantz'ha t'a kal k'ak'. Icha jun k'ak' chi', icha chi' ol aj sjawi yaelal t'a skal masanil heb' etchonhab'.
Ha in wal Jehová in swala': Aton Jerusalén sch'ox jun yechel tik, a in wak'naquem t'a skal juntzanhxo nakión.

Palta a heb' aj Jerusalén chi', yelxo wal ix spatiquejel in k'ayb'ub'al heb' yet' in cheknab'il, yelxo wal chuk heb' t'a yichanh heb' anima t'a juntzanh nakión ay t'a slak'anil heb' chi', yujto maj sk'anab'ajej in k'ayb'ub'al chi' heb', maj sb'eyb'alej pax in cheknab'il heb'.

Yuj chi' a in Jehová in swala': Yujto ek'al te pit heb' t'a yichanh juntzanhxo nakión ay t'a spatiktak chi', manh wal jab'ok sk'anab'ajej in cheknab'il heb', ek'b'al te chuk sb'eyb'al heb' t'a yichanh sb'eyb'al heb' anima ay t'a slak'anil heb' chi'.
Yuj chi' a in Jehová in swala': Ol in och pax ajk'olal t'a heb' aj Jerusalén chi'. D'a yichanh juntzanh nakión chi' ol wak'och syaelal heb'.
Ix och heb' ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios yajb'entak, yuj chi' ol in k'ulej tas to manta b'aj tzin k'ulej junelok, malaj pax b'aj ol in k'ulej junelokxo.

Ha ol aj t'a skal heb' chi', a heb' mamab'il ol schib'at yalyuninal heb' yuj wejel. Ha heb' uninab'il ol schipaxb'at smam snun heb'. Ol wak' wal och yaelal t'a yib'anh heb'. Axo mach manh ol chamok, ol in saklemejkanb'at t'a masanil yol yib'anhk’inal tik.

Ha in Jehová in swala'. Yujto a heb' chi' yelxo wal ix yixtejb'at in templo heb' yuj sdiosal te yajb'entak yet' yuj juntzanh sb'eyb'al heb' te chuk, yuj chi' ol in satel heb', manhxo ol wak' niwank'olal heb'. Manhxo ol ok' in k'ol t'a heb'.

Ha junok makan heb', ol cham heb' t'a yol chonhab' chi' yuj ilya yet' wejel. Axo junokxo makan heb', ol miljokcham heb' t'a spatiktak chonhab' chi'. Axo junxo yoxil makan heb', ol in saklemejkanb'at heb' t'a masanil yol yib'anhk’inal tik, a in wal ol wak'och heb' ajk'ol t'a spatik heb' yet' k'een yespada.

Icha wal chi' ol aj sikb'i yowal in k'ool, wach' ol aj in k'ol ol wab'i. Ayic toxo ix wik'el yowal in k'ol chi' t'a heb', ichato chi' ol nachajel yuj heb' to a in ton Jehová in ix in chek k'ulaj juntzanh tik yuj yowal in k'ool.
Ha in Jehová in swala' to manhxa mach ol wak'kan t'a Jerusalén, masanil anima ay t'a slak'anil yet' heb' ol ek' ta' ol b'uchwaj heb' t'ay.
Ha wal yik ol wak'anoch yaelal t'a yib'anh heb' yet' yowal in k'ool, masanil heb' ay t'a slak'anil heb' ol yajanok yet' sb'uchwaj heb' t'a chonhab' Jerusalén chi'. Sch'oxnab'il yowal in k'ol ol ajok.

Icha wal tz'aj sjulwaj junok mach yet' sjul-lab' yik smilwaji, icha chi' ol aj in satanel heb' yuj wejel. Ha in wal ol wak'b'at niwan wejel t'a yib'anh heb', manhxalaj swael heb', icha chi' ol aj satel heb'.

Ha in Jehová in swala' to a in ol wak'b'at jun niwan wejel, ilya yet' chamel t'a yib'anh heb' yet' nok' chium nok', pilan ol chijokb'at yuninal heb' yuj nok'. Tzijtum heb' ol champax t'a skal owal, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
Ach anima, ixik k'elan t'a stojolal jolomtak witz yik Israel, tzalan t'a yib'anh heb' kajan ta'

icha tik: Ab'ek wal tas syal Jehová t'a yib'anh heb' syak'em sb'ha t'a komon Dios t'a jolomtak witz yik Israel, t'a tzalquixtak, t'a pak'quiltak yet' t'a ch'olquixtak: Ol wak'b'at owal t'a heb'. Ol in satpaxel juntzanh lugar chaanh b'aj tz'och ejmelal.
Ol in mak'poj juntzanh altar b'aj syak' silab' heb' yet' b'aj snhus inkienso heb'. Ol in milancham heb' winak t'a yichanh juntzanh yechel chi'.
Ol wak'kan teljab' sniwanil heb' t'a yichanh juntzanh komon Dios chi'. Axo t'a spatiktak juntzanh yechel chi' ol in saklemejek' sb'aquil heb'.

Ol kan tzinan masanil schonhab' heb' b'ajtak kajan yet' masanil lugar chaanh b'aj tz'och ejmelal. Masanil yaltar heb' chi' ol pojkanb'atok yet' masanil juntzanh yechel chi' chok' ol ajkanok yet' altar b'aj snhus inkienso heb', ol em lanhnajok. Masanil tas b'ob'il yuj heb' anima chi' ol satelok.
Ha heb' olto kanok, ayik ol yilan sniwanil heb' ix cham t'a skal heb', ichato chi' ol nachajel yuj heb' to a in ton Jehová sDiosal in heb'.
Palta ha t'a skal heb' ol in saklemejkanb'at t'a juntzanhxo nakión chi', ay heb' b'aj ol ok' in k'ool, ol in kolkanel heb' t'a yol sk'ab' chamel.

Ha heb' manh ol cham chi', ol in snakot heb' t'a juntzanh nakión b'aj ayek' chi'. Ol snakot heb' tas ix aj wab'an syail yuj b'aj in spatiquejel heb' ayik yochnak heb' ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios. Toxonhej ol syajlaj sb'a heb' yuj jantak chukal sk'ulejnak yuj sb'eyb'al heb' te yajb'entak,
yuj chi' ol nachajel yuj heb' to a in Jehová in, a innhej Dios in, manh tonhejok ix wala' to ix wak'b'at juntzanh yaelal tik t'a yib'anh heb', xchi Jehová.

Ix yalanxi Jehová Cajalil icha tik t'ayin: Pok'ub'tanhej a k'ab', tek'ub'tanhejem ok, elokab' aw yik tz'el a k'ol yuj jantak tas ix jawi t'a yib'anh heb' etisraelal yuj jantak tas yajb'entak sk'ulej heb'. Yuj chi' ix cham heb' yuj owal, yuj wejel yet' yuj ilya.

Ha heb' najat aykanb'ati, ol cham heb' yuj ilya, haxo heb' lak'an ayeq'ui, ol cham heb' yuj owal. Axo heb' manh ol cham yuj owal chi', a wejel ol ik'an scham heb'. Icha chi' ol aj slajwi wik'anel yowal in k'ol t'a heb'.

Ayic ol yilan sniwanil heb' milb'ilcham t'a spatiktak juntzanh yechel chi' heb', t'a spatiktak juntzanh altar, t'a tzalquixtak, t'a jolomtak witz, t'a yichtak te te' k'ayum xiil yet' t'a yichtak te' ji k'ayum xiil, aton t'a juntzanh lugar b'aj snhustz'a inkienso heb' silab'il t'a juntzanh komon Dios chi', icha chi' ol aj snachajel yuj heb' to a in ton Jehová sDiosal in heb'.

Ol wik'chaanh in k'ab' wak'an syaelal heb' yalnhej b'aj kajan. Masanil juntzanh lugar b'aj ek'nak kajan heb', toxonhej ol kan tzinan icha lum tzinan lu'um yik sur, masanto sk'och t'a Diblat t'a norte. Icha chi' ol aj snachajel yuj heb' to a in ton Jehová sDiosal in heb', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
Ach anima, a in wal Jehová Yajal in, a in swal t'a chonhab' Israel icha tik: Toxo ix k'och slajwub', toxo ix k'och slajwub'al lum lum smasanil.

Toxo ix k'och he lajwub'al a ex israel ex tik. Ol wak' wal b'at yowal in k'ol t'a eyib'anh, ol in k'anb'ej wal wab'i chajwaltil yaj he b'eyb'al, ol wak'anoch yaelal t'a eyib'anh yuj he b'eyb'al yajb'entak chi'.

Ha tiknaik manhxo ol wala' to ay wok'elk'olal t'ayex. Ol wak'och yaelal t'a eyib'anh yuj he b'eyb'al yelxo te chuk. Ol wak' eyab' syail yuj masanil chukal tze k'ulej. Icha wal chi' ol aj snachajel eyuuj to a in Jehová he Diosal in, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ha in Jehová in tik swala': Van sk'och jun niwan yaelal t'a eyib'anh.
Ileknab'i wanxo sjawi slajwub', toxo ix jawi he lajwub'al.
Tik wal sjawi sk'ual yik tzex lajwiel he masanil ex kajan ex t'a jun nakión chi'. Toxo wal sjawi sk'ual, axonhej xiwk'olal ay, toxo wal slajwi tzalajk'olal t'a jolomtak witz.

Ha tiknaik, tz'akan ol wak'b'at yowal in k'ol t'a eyib'anh, masanto ol yal sikb'i in k'ool. Ol ex in ch'olb'itej yuj chukal tze k'ulej, ol wak'och eyaelal yuj he b'eyb'al yelxo wal te chuk tze k'ulej. Manhxo ol wala' to ay wok'elk'olal t'ayex. Icha wal chi' ol aj snachajel eyuuj to a in Jehová in swak'och eyaelal.
Ileknab'i, toxo ix jawi sk'ual yaelal ayxo smay yik slajwiel jun chonhab' chi'. Toxo ix k'echaanh chukal t'a yol smakb'en, tzijtum ik'ojchanhb'ail.
Sk'e wal chaanh heb' yixtan yetanimail. Ha juntzanh anima chi', manhxa junok heb' ol kanok. Manhxa jab'ok sb'eyumal heb' ol kanok, manhxo ol b'inaj sniwanil yelk'och heb'.
Toxo wal sjawi sk'ual jun yaelal chi'. Mokab' tzalaj sk'ol heb' smanwaji, mokab' kus sk'ol heb' schonhwaji, yujto ol wak'b'at yowal in k'ol t'a yib'anh heb' smasanil.

Ha mach toxo ix schonh sluum, manhxo ol yal yik'anxi lu'um yakb'an pitzanto yet' mach ix manan chi', yujto manhxo ol yal skachjioch waan jun yaelal wan sjawi chi'. Ha heb' chuk, malaj junok heb' ol yal skolan sb'a.
Wach'chom ol pujok k'een trompeta yik syak'an lista sb'a heb' sb'at t'a owal, palta malaj mach ol b'at t'a owal chi', yujto a yowal in k'ool ayoch t'a yib'anh heb' smasanil.
D'a spatiquel chonhab' ay owal, haxo t'a yool ay ilya yet' wejel. Ha heb' ayek' t'a smunlajel, ol miljokcham heb', haxo heb' ayek' t'a yol chonhab', ol cham heb' yuj wejel chi' yet' ilya.
Ha heb' olto yal yeli, ol b'at skol sb'a heb' t'a kaltak yaxluum, ata' ol ok' heb' yuj smul icha yok nok' muuk t'a yoltak ch'olan.
Masanil heb' ol el yip sk'ab', ol luklon yok heb' yuj xiwelal.
Ol yak'och pichul heb' ya swa'i yuj sch'oxanel syaelal chi'. Ol luklon masanil sniwanil heb'. Chacxonhej ol aj yilji sat heb' yuj q'uixwelal, josb'ilel xil sjolom ol ek' heb'.

Toxonhej ol syumel k'een plata heb' yet' k'een oro t'a yoltak kalle, icha tz'aj syumchajel k'alem, yujto manh ol yal skolchajel heb' t'a sk'ual yowal in k'ol a in Jehová in tik yuj k'een. Tocwal ol yal yak'an b'ud'jok sk'ol heb' yet' k'een oro chi', yujto a yuj k'een ix b'at heb' t'a chukal.

Yujto ay k'een k'een te wach' yilji chi' t'a heb', yuj chi' ix yik' wal chaanh sb'a heb', a k'een chi' ix sb'o heb' skomon diosej yajb'entak. Yuj chi' a juntzanh k'een wach' yilji ay t'a heb' chi', icha k'alem ol wutejkan k'een yil heb'.
Ol wik'kot heb' ch'ok chonhab'il te chuk yelk'ejb'at sb'eyumal heb', yik tzul yik'anek' sdiosal heb' chi' heb', syixtanb'at heb'.
Ol wik'el in b'ha t'a jun nakión chi', haxo heb' elk'um chi' ol ixtanb'at in templo wiknhej yaji. Manhxa ol ajkan yelk'och yuj heb'.
Ak' b'o juntzanhok k'een kadena, yujto ha t'a jun nakión chi' manh jantakok heb' mak'umcham anima ol tzek'chaj t'a k'een. Ha t'a yol jun chonhab' chi', axonhej chukal sk'ulaji.

Ha in ol wik'kot juntzanh anima te chuk t'a juntzanh nakión, haxo heb' ol ikankan pat t'a jun nakión chi'. Yujto ol in satel yak'umtaquil heb' niwak winak, ol ixtaxb'at juntzanh lugar b'aj tz'och heb' ejmelal.
Ayic ol jawok niwak xiwk'olal t'a heb', ol yak' yip heb' sayan junk'olal, palta manhxo ol ilchajlaj yuj heb'.

Cotac skal ol jawok syaelal heb', icha pax chi' ol jawok yab'ixal xiwk'olal t'a heb'. Nab'anhej ol say junok in chekab' heb' to syal yalan tas ol ujok. Manhxa heb' sakerdote ol k'ayb'an heb', ma heb' ichamtak winak ol ak'an srazón heb'.

Ha heb' sreyal heb' yet' heb' yajalil heb', ol yak'och pichul heb' ya swa'i yuj sch'oxanel kusk'olal ol jawok t'a yib'anh heb'. Axo masanil anima, toxonhej ol ib'xokk'e heb' yuj xiwelal. Ato syal sb'eyb'al heb', icha chi' ol wutej heb'. Ol in ch'olb'itej heb' icha ix yutej heb' yixtan heb' yetanimail. Icha chi' ol aj yojtakanel heb' to a in ton Jehová sDiosal in heb', xchi Jehová t'ayin.
Ayic yoil k'ual yoch swaquil uj yik swaquil ab'il, k'ojan in em t'a in pat yet' heb' yichamtak winaquil chonhab' Judá, haxo ix aji, ix yak'anem spoder Jehová Cajalil t'a wib'anh.
Axo ix wilani ay jun icha yilji anima linhanek' t'a in tz'ey. Ha t'a snanhal tz'emnhejkoti, icha wal k'ak' yilji, haxo pax yib'anh snanhal sk'enhej, weei yilji icha k'een bronke ayoch t'a kal k'ak'.

Ha jun icha anima chi', ix yak'kot jun sk'ab' t'a wib'anh, ix syaman xil in jolom. Axo Yespíritu Dios ix in ik'ank'e t'a kal ik', icha wayich ix aj in yik'anb'at t'a Jerusalén, yik sch'oxan wila'' tas ay ta'. Ix in yak'anoch t'a jun puerta ay t'a yol yamaq'uil templo, aton jun ay t'a stojolal norte. Ata' ay yet'tal jun komon Dios, aton jun stzuntzankot yowal sk'ol Jehová.
Ha wal ta' ayek' stziquiquial ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, icha wal ix aj sch'oxji wila'' ayik ayinek' t'a jun ak'lik.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan t'ayin icha tik: Ach anima, b'atanh k'elan t'a stojolal norte, xchi t'ayin. Ix in b'at k'elan, ix wilan t'a stz'ey spuertail t'a snorteal altar. Ata' ix wil jun yechel stzuntzankot yowal sk'ol Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan t'ayin icha tik: Ach anima, ¿tzam wal il tas te yajb'entak sk'ulej heb' etisraelal tik? Yuj wal juntzanh tik najat tzin el t'a in templo tik. Palta ayto wal juntzanhxo yelxo te chuk ol ila', xchi t'ayin.
Ixlajwi chi' ix in yik'anelta b'aj tzonh och t'a yamaq'uil templo chi', ix wilani ay jun olan t'a yich templo chi'.
Ix yalan Jehová chi' t'ayin icha tik: Lewb'itej jun olan t'a yich templo chi', xchi t'ayin. Yuj chi' ix in lewb'itan jun olan chi', ix chax jun puerta wuuj.
Ix yalan t'ayin: Ochanh t'a yool, ol ilan wal tas yajb'entak sk'ulej heb' ta', xchi t'ayin.

Ix in och b'ian, ix wilani to ha t'a sattak yich pat chi', ata' tz'ib'ab'iloch masanil yechel nok' nok' snherwi t'a sat lu'um tik yet' yechel masanil nok' nok' manh wach'ok icha yalan ley yet' masanil makanhil tas syaloch heb' wetisraelal sdiosalok.

Ha t'a yichanh juntzanh yechel chi' ayoch 70 heb' yichamtak winaquil chonhab' Israel, aypaxoch winhaj Jaazanías yuninal winhaj Safán t'a skal heb', ayoch heb' ejmelal t'a juntzanh yechel chi'. Junjun heb' yet'nakk'e junjun chaynub' heb' yik inkienso, ha t'a yol juntzanh chi' b'akaqui sk'e stab'il inkienso chi'.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ina wal tas sk'ulej juntzanh yichamtak winaquil chonhab' Israel tik t'a elk'altak. Junjun heb' ayek' t'a yichanh sb'akhnub' sdiosal. Ha juntzanh heb' tik a snaan heb' to max wil heb', aktab'ilxokan jun chonhab' tik wuuj snaan heb', xchi t'ayin.
Ix yalanpax t'ayin icha tik: Ayto wal juntzanhxo te yajb'entak ol ila', xchi.
Ix in yik'anpaxb'at t'a spuertail stemplo chi', aton jun skan t'a stojolal norte. Ata' k'ojanem juntzanh heb' ix ix, wan yok' heb' ix yuj sdiosal skuch Tamuz.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan t'ayin icha tik: ¿Ix am il juntzanh tik? Palta ayto wal juntzanhxo te yajb'entak ol ila', xchi t'ayin.

Ixlajwi chi' ix in yik'anb'at t'a jun yune' amak' ayoch t'a spatiktak templo chi', aton t'a skal altar yet' sti' templo chi'. Ata' ayek' 25 heb' winh winak, a yich spatik heb' winh aykanb'at t'a stojolal stemplo Jehová chi', k'elanb'at heb' winh t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, nhojanem heb' winh t'a sat lu'um, ayoch heb' winh ejmelal t'a k'u chi'.

Ix yalanxi t'ayin icha tik: Ach anima ¿toxom ix ila'? Manhoknhej t'a tik ay juntzanh tas yajb'entak sk'ulej heb' tik, palta toxo ix b'ud'jiel yol nakión tik yuj sk'echaanh heb' yixtan anima. ¿Toc junel chaelnhej stzuntzejkot yowal in k'ol heb'? Swab' wal sjab' chukal sk'ulej heb' chi'.
Palta a in tik, ol wak' spak t'a heb' yet' yowal in k'ool. Manhxo ol ok' in k'ol t'a heb'. Wach'chom ol awaj heb' t'ayin, palta manhxo ol in tak'wej heb', xchi Jehová t'ayin.
Ixlajwi chi', te chaanh ix wab' yoch jun aw: Cotokab' heb' ol ak'anoch yaelal t'a jun chonhab' tik, junjun heb' yet'nakokab' syamk'ab' yik owal yik satanel heb', xchi.

Ix wilani to ay wakwanh heb' winh winak ix och t'a yol jun niwan puerta ay t'a stojolal norte, junjun heb' winh yet'nak syamk'ab' b'aj smak'cham anima. Ha t'a skal heb' winh chi', ix wilpax skot jun winh ayoch spichul nab'a lino. Ha t'a snanhal winh, ata' ayoch syamk'ab' yik tz'ib'. Ix wilan yoch heb' winh, ix ochk'och heb' winh t'a slak'anil altar nab'a bronke.

Axo stziquiquial Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik ix k'e waan, ix el t'a yib'anh juntzanh yechel querubín, b'aj aytaxoneq'ui, ix kan t'a spuertail templo chi'. Ha Jehová chi' ix awtan jun winh ayoch pichul lino chi' yuj, aton jun winh ed'jinak yamk'ab' yik tz'ib' t'a snanhal.

Ix yalan Jehová chi' t'a winh icha tik: Ek'anh t'a masanil yol chonhab' Jerusalén tik, tzak'anoch yechel t'a snanhal sat masanil anima tz'ok' yuj chukal yajb'entak sk'ulej heb' anima t'a chonhab' tik, xchi.
Ixlajwi chi' ix wab'an yalanxi t'a heb' winh ed'jinak syamk'ab' yik owal chi': Ixiquec t'a spatiktak winh chi', tzex ek' t'a kal chonhab' tik smasanil, mokab' ok' he k'ol t'a heb' anima, tze milcham

masanil heb' winh ichamtak winak, heb' winh kelemtak, heb' ix kob'estak, heb' ix ix yet' heb' unin, masanto manhxalaj junok heb' skani. Palta manh he milcham junok heb' ayoch yechel t'a snanhal chi'. Tze chael yich t'a in templo tik, xchi Jehová. Ix schaanel yich heb' winh smilancham heb' winh ichamtak winak ayek' t'a yamaq'uil templo chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a heb' winh icha tik: Ixtejequel templo tik, tzeyak'an b'ud'jok yamaq'uil yuj sniwanil heb' scham chi', slajwi chi' tzex b'ati, xchi. Ix wilan sb'at lemnaj heb' winh b'ian, ix och ijan heb' winh smilancham heb' anima t'a masanil yol chonhab' chi'.

Ayic wan smilancham heb' anima chi' heb' winh, a inxonhej in kan t'a yichanh Jehová, ix in em nhojan t'a sat lu'um, ix te kus in k'ool, yuj chi' ix el waw: Mamin Jehová Vajalil, ¿tom ol a satel masanil heb' aytokan t'a Israel yuj yowal a k'ol t'a Jerusalén tik? xin chi.

Ix tak'wi t'ayin icha tik: Ha wal smul heb' aj Israel yet' heb' aj Judá tik, yelxo wal te niwan. Yelxo wal b'ud'jinaquel yol juntzanh chonhab' chi' yuj sniwanil heb' anima smiljichamok. Manhxa jab'ok tojolal sk'ulej heb'. Ha snaan heb' to toxo ix waktejkan jun nakión tik, maxtzak wil tas sk'ulej heb' snaani.
Ha tiknaik maxtzak ok' in k'ol t'a heb', ol wak'xonhejoch syaelal heb' yuj masanil tas tz'el sk'ulani, xchi Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi', ix jax jun winh winak ayoch lino spichulok chi', yet'nak pax yamk'ab' yik tz'ib' t'a snanhal, ix yalan winh icha tik: Mamin Vajalil, toxo ix in k'anab'ajej tas ix a chek in k'ulej, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix wilan t'a yib'anh jun b'akhanb'at t'a yib'anh heb' querubín, ata' ix sch'ox sb'a jun tas icha junok trono, lajan wal yilji icha k'een zafiro.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a jun winh winak ayoch lino spichulok chi' icha tik: Ochanh t'a skal juntzanh xokanxokan ay t'a yalanh juntzanh querubín chi', tzik'anelta jun jopok tzak'ak' ayoch sk'ak'al, aton juntzanh ay t'a snanhal juntzanh querubín chi', tza tzipanb'at t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik, xchi t'a winh. Axo ix wilani, ix sk'anab'ajan winh tas ix yal Jehová chi'.
Ha heb' querubín chi' ayek' heb' t'a jun spak'ul templo chi' t'a stojolal sur. Ix em jun yasunal stziquiquial Jehová, ix b'ud'jiel yamaq'uil templo chi' yuj.

Toxo ix k'e wan stziquiquial Jehová t'a yib'anh juntzanh yechel querubín b'aj aytaxoneq'ui, ix kan t'a spuertail templo chi'. Ix b'ud'jiel templo yuj jun asun chi', haxo yamaq'uil templo chi', toxonhej skopopi yilji yuj stziquiquial Jehová chi'.
Tzato ab'chajnhej sk'anh sk'axil heb' querubín chi' t'a jun niwan amak' t'a stiel templo chi'. Lajan wal icha sjaj Dios Syal yuj Smasanil ayik sloloni.

Ayic ix yalan Jehová t'a jun winh winak ayoch lino spichulok chi' to syik'elta k'ak' t'a skal juntzanh xokanxokan t'a snanhal heb' querubín chi', ix och winh b'ian, ix och linhan winh t'a stz'ey junok juntzanh xokanxokan chi'.

Ha t'a yalanh sk'axil heb' querubín chi', ata' ayelta sk'ab' heb' icha k'ab' anima. Ha junok heb' querubín chi' ix yak'b'at sk'ab' t'a skal k'ak' ayelta t'a snanhal heb' chi', ix yik'anelta jab'ok k'ak' chi', ix yak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' winh ayoch lino spichulok chi'. Ix schaanek' winh, ix yik'anelta winh.
Ix wilan pax chanhe' xokanxokan toxonhej skopopi yilji icha k'een topakio, junnhej yaj yet' heb' querubín chi'.
Ha juntzanh chi' lajannhej, ha t'a junjun ay junokxo xokanxokan sk'axpaj ek' t'a snanhal yool.
Ayic sb'at heb' querubín chi', a b'aj k'elanb'at heb' sb'ati, sb'atnhej heb', max sutmaj sniwanil heb' b'aj sb'at chi', palta to syal sb'atnhej heb' t'a schanhil pak'anh b'aj k'elanb'ati.
Masanil sniwanil heb', yich spatik heb', sk'ab' heb' yet' sk'axil heb', aynhej yol sat, icha juntzanh xokanxokan chi'.
Ix wab'an yalchaj sb'i juntzanh xokanxokan chi': Xocanxocan surankani.

Ha heb' querubín chi', chanhe' sat junjun heb'. Ha sb'ab'el sat heb' lajan yilji icha sat junok querubín, haxo schab'il, lajan yilji icha sat anima, haxo yoxil, lajan yilji icha sat nok' choj, haxo schanhil, lajan yilji icha sat nok' niwak ch'akb'a.
Ha heb' querubín chi', anhejtona' heb' ix wil t'a sti' ha' niwan Quebar. Ix k'e waan heb'.
Ayic sb'at heb', sb'atpax juntzanh xokanxokan chi' yet' heb'. Ayic syik'ank'e sk'axil heb' ayik sk'e jenhnaj heb' t'a sat lu'um, sk'epax waan juntzanh xokanxokan chi' yet' heb'.
Ayic tz'och waan heb', tz'ochpax waan juntzanh xokanxokan chi'. Ayic sk'e waan heb', sk'epax waan juntzanh chi' yet' heb', yujto ha t'a juntzanh xokanxokan chi' ayoch spixan heb'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix k'e waan stziquiquial Jehová t'a spuertail templo chi', haxo t'a yib'anh heb' querubín chi' ix k'ochkani.

Q'uelan in wal ochi ix yik'ank'e sk'axil heb', ix k'e waan heb' t'a sat lum tik yet' juntzanh xokanxokan chi', haxo t'a spuertail yamaq'uil stemplo Jehová t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u ix wanaj heb'. Ha stziquiquial Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik ayek' t'a yib'anh heb'.
Aton juntzanh heb' querubín tik wilnak t'a yalan strono Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, ayik ayinek' t'a sti' ha' niwan Quebar. Icha chi' ix aj snachajel wuuj to querubín heb'.
Ha junjun heb' chi', chanhe' sat heb', chanhe' pax sk'axil junjun heb'. Axo t'a yalanh sk'axil heb' chi', ayelta sk'ab' heb' icha yilji k'ab' anima.
Ha sat heb', lajannhej yilji icha yilji heb' wilnak t'a sti' ha' niwan Quebar chi'. Ayic sb'eyb'at heb', tojolnhej sb'at heb' b'aj k'elanb'at t'a yichanh.

Ha Yespíritu Dios chi' ix in ik'anb'at b'aj ay spuertail stemplo Jehová chi' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u. Ha t'a jun puerta chi', ayek' 25 heb' winh winak, haxo t'a skal heb' winh chi', ayek' winhaj Jaazanías yuninal winhaj Azur yet' winhaj Pelatías yuninal winhaj Benaías, aton heb' winh chi' yajal yaj t'a skal heb' anima.
Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ach anima, aton wal juntzanh winak tik aynhejek' t'a spensar sk'ulan chukal, skuchb'an heb' anima heb' t'a chukal chi'.

Syalan heb' icha tik: Manh toxook ol satel ko chonhab' tik, ko b'oekk'e ko pat. Ha ko chonhab' tik lajan icha junok k'een chen, a onhxo tik lajan onh icha nok' chib'ej tz'em t'a yol chen chi', xchi heb'.
Yuj chi' ach anima alel in lolonel yuj tas ol ja t'a yib'anh heb', xchi Jehová t'ayin.
Ixlajwi chi' ix ja pax Yespíritu Jehová t'ayin, ix yalan icha tik: Al t'a heb' anima chi' to a in swal icha tik: Ex israel, wojtak wal sik'lab'il tas tze na'a.
Te tzijtumxo anima ix he milcham t'a jun chonhab' tik, b'ut'an yoltak kalle yuj chamnak chi'.

Yuj chi' a in Jehová in swal t'ayex: Ha Jerusalén tik, lajan wal icha junok k'een chen. Axo nok' chib'ej chi', aton heb' anima tze milcham t'a yoltak kalle chi'. Palta a exxo tik, ol ex wik'el t'a yol chonhab' tik.
Vojtak to tzex xiw t'a owal, yuj chi' a in Jehová in ol wak'kot owal chi' t'a eyib'anh.
Ol wak'och yaelal t'a eyib'anh, ol ex wik'el t'a yol chonhab' tik, ol ex wak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il.
Ol ex miljokcham t'a k'een espada. Ha in ol wak'och eyaelal t'a yichanhb'at smojonal Israel tik. Icha chi' ol aj snachajel eyuuj to a in ton Jehová he Diosal in.
Ha jun chonhab' tik, manh lajanok ol aj icha junok k'een chen t'ayex, a exxo pax tik, manh lajanok ol ex aj icha nok' chib'ej. Ha t'a yichanhb'at smojonal Israel tik, ata' ol wak'och eyaelal.

Icha chi' ol aj snachajel eyuuj to a in ton Jehová he Diosal in. Yujto a ex tik manh jab'ok ix he b'eyb'alej in cheknab'il, maj he k'anab'ajej in k'ayb'ub'al, palta a sb'eyb'al juntzanh nakión ay t'a he lak'anil tik ix he b'eyb'alej, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb', xchi t'ayin.

Yakb'an wan walan juntzanh tik, ix wilani ix cham winhaj Pelatías yuninal winhaj Benaías. Ix in em lachnaj t'a sat lu'um, ix wak'anel waw, ix walani: Ay Mamin Jehová, ¿tom ol a satel jaywanhxo anima ixto kan t'a Israel tik? xin chi.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:

Ach anima, a heb' etisraelal aykan t'a Jerusalén tik, syal heb' eyuuj a ex ayto eyuj he b'a ik'b'il ex b'at t'a Babilonia icha tik: Ha heb' chi', te najat ix ik'jikanel heb' t'a tz'ey Jehová, yuj chi' a lum lum tik, toxo ix ak'jikan lum ko makb'enok xchi heb' eyuuj.

Yuj chi' al t'a heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén icha tik: Icha tik yalan Jehová Cajalil: Ix wik'el heb' t'a sluum, ix in saklemanb'at heb' t'a juntzanh ch'ok nakional. Palta yakb'an ayek' heb' junok tiempoal ta', ayinek' yet' heb', ichato ayek' jun b'aj kajan in ek' t'a skal heb'.
Ha in ol ex in molb'ejxi t'a juntzanh nakión b'aj sakleminak eyajkanb'ati, ol ex wik'anxi meltzajok. Ol wak'anxi lum he lu'um he makb'enok.
Ol meltzajxok heb' t'a schonhab', ol satanel masanil juntzanh yechel yajb'entak heb'.
Ol wik'el jun pensar ayoch t'a heb' icha k'een k'een, haxo jun ak' pensar te wach' ol wak'och t'a heb'.
Icha chi' ol aj yajek' heb' icha wal yalan in k'ayb'ub'al, ol sb'eyb'alan pax in cheknab'il heb', in chonhab' ol ajxok heb', a inxo ol in ochxok sDiosalok heb'.
Axo pax heb' to olto b'eyb'alan juntzanh b'eyb'al yajb'entak chi', a in Jehová in swala' to ol wak'och yaelal t'a yib'anh heb' yuj, xchi Jehová t'ayin.
Ixlajwi chi' ix wilan sk'e waan heb' querubín, ix b'at jenhenhok heb', ix b'atpax juntzanh xokanxokan yet' heb'. Ha stziquiquial Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik ayem t'a yib'anh heb'.
Junnhej ix k'e waan yet' heb', ix el t'a chonhab' Jerusalén chi'. Axo t'a sjolom jun lum witz t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a chonhab' chi' ata' ix wanaji.

Ixlajwi chi', ix wilani a Yespíritu Dios ix in ik'anxikot t'a Babilonia tik, aton b'aj ayek' juntzanh heb' wetchonhab' ik'b'ilkot t'a tik. Aton juntzanh tik ix sch'ox Yespíritu Dios wila''. Ixlajwi chi', manhxalaj tas ix wila''.
Masanil juntzanh tas ix sch'ox Jehová chi' t'ayin, ix wal t'a heb' ik'b'ilkot chi' t'a Babilonia tik.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:

Ach anima, a juntzanh anima b'aj kajan ach ek' t'a skal tik, te pit heb'. Nab'anhej ay yol sat heb', palta max yil-laj heb'. Nab'anhej ay schiquin heb', palta max yab' heb' tas swala', yujto a jun chonhab' tik junelnhej te pit.

Yuj chi' molb'ej a k'ael, ichato wan ik'jib'at t'a ch'ok chonhab'il. D'a k'ualil, yichanh wal heb' tzach elta t'a yol a pat, ch'okxo b'aj tzach b'atkani, tekan ol nachajel yuj heb' icha chi, wach'chom te pit heb'.
D'a k'ualil, wal t'a yichanh heb' smasanil, tzik'anelta a k'ael chi', ichato tzach ik'jib'ati. Anheja' t'a yemk'ualil, tzach elta pax t'a yichanh heb', ichato tzach ik'jib'at t'a ch'ok chonhab'il.
Ol junok olan t'a sat a pat, tzach el ta' yet' masanil a k'ael t'a yichanh heb' smasanil.

Ayic wanxo sq'uik'b'i, tza jolomjenhjab'an masanil a k'ael chi', wal t'a yichanh heb' smasanil tzach eli. Tza musej a sat yik wach' max yal ilan b'aj tzach b'ati. In gana to a ach tzach och ch'oxnab'ilal t'a heb' etisraelal tik, xchi t'ayin.

Ix wak'an lista masanil in k'ael icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová chi' t'ayin. D'a k'ualil ix in elta yet' in k'ael chi', icha wal heb' wan yik'jib'at t'a ch'ok chonhab'il. Axo t'a yemk'ualil ix in b'oan jun olan t'a sat in pat, haxo yik wan sq'uik'b'i, ix in jolomjenhjab'an masanil in k'ael chi'. Yichanh wal heb' ix in elta.
Axo t'a q'uinhib'alil t'a junxo k'u, ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
Ach anima, a heb' etisraelal tik yelxo te pit heb', ¿tok wal maj sk'anb'ej heb' t'ayach yuj tas wan a k'ulan chi'?

Al t'a heb' icha tik: Ha Jehová Kajal tz'alan icha tik: Ha jun tzin chek k'ulaj tik, ch'oxnab'il yaji, icha wal tik ol aj winh sreyal Jerusalén yet' masanil anima kajan ta', xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb'.
Tzalan paxi to ch'oxnab'il aj t'a heb'. Yujto yowalil icha chi' ol aj heb' aj Jerusalén chi', icha wal wan utan a b'a chi', yujto ol ik'jokb'at heb' t'a ch'ok chonhab'il.

Ha winh sreyal heb', yowalil ol sjolomjenhjab'ejb'at sk'ael winh ayik wan sq'uik'b'i, ol el winh t'a jun olan b'ob'il yuj heb' t'a smuroal Jerusalén chi'. Ol smusan sat winh, yik wach' manh ol yil winh b'aj sb'ati.

Ha in ol wak'b'at jun icha ch'anh yaal t'a yib'anh winh rey chi', ol kan winh t'a yol ch'anh, ol ik'jokkot winh t'a Babilonia, t'a slum heb' kaldeo tik, palta manh ol yil-laj jun chonhab' tik winh. Ha t'a tik ol cham winh.
Ol saklemkanb'at heb' soldado stanhwan winh yet' pax juntzanhxo heb' soldado. Ha in ol wak' pechjok heb' yet' k'een espada.
Ayic toxo ix in saklemejb'at heb' t'a juntzanhxo nakión chi', ol nachajel yuj heb' to a in ton Jehová sDiosal in heb'.

Palta a in ol wak' kolchajkanel jaywanhokxo heb' t'a skal owal, t'a skal wejel yet' t'a skal ilya, yik wach' ha t'a juntzanhxo nakión b'aj ol b'atkan heb' chi', ol yal heb' yuj jantak tas yajb'entak sk'ulejnak. Ol yojtaquejpaxel heb' to a in ton Jehová sDiosal in heb', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
Ach anima, luklonanhk'e yuj xiwelal yet' ilk'olal ayik tzach wa'i yet' ayik tzuk'an ha'.

Al t'a masanil heb' etchonhab' chi' icha tik: Icha wal tik yalan Jehová Cajalil t'a heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén yet' t'a masanil heb' kajan t'a smakb'en Israel chi': D'a skal ilk'olal ol wa heb', t'a skal somk'olal ol yuk'ej ha' heb', yujto a jun nakión chi' ol lajwoquemok. Ol kan wal tzinan yuj masanil ixtoj anima sk'ulej heb' kajan t'ay.
Masanil chonhab' b'ajtak kajan anima ol laj emkan lanhnajok, ol kan pax tzinan lum smakb'en heb' chi'. Icha chi' ol aj snachajel eyuuj to a in ton Jehová he Diosal in, xchi t'ayin.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
Ach anima, ¿tas syalelk'och jun slolonel heb' israel syal icha tik? Tonhej b'elb'on yek' tiempo, max elk'ochlaj tas syal heb' schekab' Dios, xchi heb'.

Yuj chi' al t'a heb': Icha tik yalan Jehová Cajalil: Ha yuj tas ol in k'ulej, manhxo ol eyal-laj jun lolonel chi', yujto toxo ol k'och stiempoal yelk'och juntzanh tas in ch'oxnak yil heb' in chekab', xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb'.
Yujto manhxa mach ol stz'ak yala' to ay tas te wach' ix yil t'a swayich, ma snaanchaanh junok esal lolonel t'a he kal.
Yujto a in Jehová in ol in lolonok. Yalnhej tas ol wal chi' elanhchamel ol elk'ochok. Ha ex anima ex te pit ex tik, ol eyil wal to a in ol in lolonok, ol wak'anelk'och tas swal chi', xchi t'ayin.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
Ach anima, a heb' etisraelal chi', syal heb' to a juntzanh ix in ch'ox ila' yet' juntzanh lolonel ix ala' to olto heb' yelk'ochi,
yuj chi' al t'a heb' to a in Jehová in swala' to a tas swala' manh ol ek' tiempo yelk'ochi, yowalil ol elk'och t'a elanhchamel, xchi Jehová t'ayin.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:

Ach anima, al juntzanh in lolonel tik t'a juntzanh heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok t'a heb' etisraelal, aton heb' skomon lolon t'a yol yiko'. Al t'a heb' to smaklej yab' in lolonel heb', a in Jehová he Yajal in tik swal icha tik:

Ex israel, ob'iltak wal juntzanh heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok chi', malaj spensar heb', anhej spensar heb' t'a yol yik syala', tokwal ay tas sch'oxji yil heb'. Lajan wal heb' icha nok' waax kajan b'aj emnak lanhnaj junok chonhab'.

Icha wal muro max nipchaj spojelal ayik sjawi sk'ual owal, icha chi' yaj heb' yinhtilal Israel, manh jab'ok sb'o sb'eyb'al heb' yuj heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok chi' yik max wak' syaelal heb' ayik ol in jawok in ch'olb'itan heb' a in Jehová in tik.

Ha tas tz'ak'ji yil heb' yalani, manh yeloklaj. Ha lolonel ayokto syalankanel heb', es juntzanh chi'. Syal heb' to a in lolonel syalel heb', palta manhok in tzin chek yal heb'. Wach'chom es juntzanh syal heb' chi', palta syak'och heb' yipok sk'ool to ol elk'och yalan heb'.

Yuj chi' swal t'a heb' icha tik: Ha ex tik tzeyaloch he b'a in chekab'ok. Tocwal manh esok tas tzeyala' ayik tzeyalani to ay tas ix ch'oxji eyila', tze naanel lolonel, ayik tzeyalani: Icha tik yalan Jehová xe chi, palta malaj tas swal t'ayex.
Yuj chi' a in Jehová in swala': Yujto a ex tik tzeyala' to ay tas tzin ch'ox eyila', palta manh yeloklaj, yuj chi' ay in och ajk'olal t'ayex.

Ol wik' wal chaanh in k'ab' wak'anoch syaelal juntzanh heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok chi', yujto anhej tas manh yelok syal heb'. Malaj yalan yik heb' sk'och b'aj smolb'ej sb'a heb' yetisraelal, max tz'ib'chajkan sb'i heb' t'a slistail heb' yetchonhab' chi', manhxo ol meltzajpax heb' t'a sluum. Icha chi' ol aj snachajel eyuuj to a in ton Jehová he Yajal in.

Ha juntzanh heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok chi', tonhej syak' heb' in chonhab' heb' musansatil, syalan heb' icha tik: Ha tiknaik manhxo he na' to ay tas ol ja t'a quib'anh, xchi heb', palta manh yeloklaj syal heb'. Lajan heb' icha junok mach stzikanoch k'een taanh t'a junok yichtak pat chuklaj yaj sb'oi.
Al t'a heb' stzikanoch k'een taanh chi' to ol telwok jun yich pat chi' ayik ol wak'ankot niwak yaxnhab' ay yik'al, ay pax sakb'atil,
ol em lanhnaj jun yich pat chi'. Ichato chi' b'ian ol sk'anb'an heb' anima: ¿Tas yopisio juntzanh k'een taanh ix eyak'och chi'? xcham heb'. Ha jun yich pat chi', a Jerusalén yet' schukal, a sch'oxo'.
Yuj chi' a in Jehová Yajal in swala': Ha wal yuj yowal in k'ool ichato ol wak'b'at niwak yaxnhab' ay yik'al, ay pax sakb'atil. Yed' wal yowal in k'ool ol wak'anem lanhnaj jun yichtak pat chi'.

Ol wak'em lanhnaj chonhab' Jerusalén chi', ol em lanhnaj t'a sat lu'um, masanto ol cheklaj yich aykanemi. Ayic ol em lanhnaj jun chonhab' chi', ha t'a skal spojelal chi' ol ex chamok. Icha chi' ol aj snachajel eyuuj to a in ton Jehová he Diosal in.

Ol wak'walb'at yowal in k'ol t'a jun yichtak pat chi' yet' t'a heb' ix ak'anoch k'een taanh t'ay, ol yalan heb' anima icha tik: Manhxa jab'ok jun yichtak pat chi' ix kani, manhxa pax heb' ix ak'anoch staanhil ix kani, xcham heb'.

Ha heb' stz'ak yaloch sb'a in chekab'ok chi', aton heb' tz'alan t'a heb' yetisraelal tas tz'ak'ji yil heb' yalani. Syalan heb' to malaj tas ol jawok t'a yib'anh Jerusalén, aton heb' tik yet' tas syal heb' chi' sch'ox heb' ix ak'anoch k'een taanh t'a yichtak pat. Palta a in wal Jehová Yajal in swala' to manh ichok syal heb' chi' swala', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ach anima, al t'a juntzanh heb' ix etisraelal syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok, palta anhej t'a yol yik heb' skomon loloni.

Icha tik tz'aj alan t'a heb' ix: Icha tik yalan Jehová Cajalil: Ob'iltak ex tze pixoch juntzanh k'apak t'a sk'ab' heb' anima, tze pixanpaxoch k'apak t'a sjolom heb', ato syal jantakxo yab'ilal heb'. Tze nib'ej tz'och tzak'an heb' eyuuj. Yic wach' yek' tiempo eyuuj, tzeyalani to syal he mak'anek' schamel heb', ma syal pax eyak'ancham heb'.

Ha ex tik, anhej yuj jun jopok ixim kebada, ma yuj jab'ok ti pan tzin he patikanel t'a yichanh heb' in chonhab'. Tzeyak'cham heb' anima manh smojok schami, haxo heb' anima manhxo smojok pitzan, a heb' chi' max eyak'chamok. Icha chi' tz'aj eyixtan heb' in chonhab' scha yab' eyes chi'.

Yuj chi' a in wal Jehová Yajal in swala': Ayinoch ajk'olal t'ayex yuj juntzanh k'apak tze pixoch t'a heb' anima chi' yik tzeyak'an heb' musansatil icha tz'aj smakchaj nok' much. Ol in nhik'el juntzanh k'apak chi' t'a sk'ab' heb' anima chi'. Icha chi' ol aj yelkan heb' t'a yol he k'ab'.

Ol in kolel in chonhab' t'a yol he k'ab' b'aj tzeyak' musansatil heb' yet' juntzanh k'apak tzeyak'och t'a sat heb' chi'. Manhxa b'ak'uinh ol montaj heb' eyuj junelxo. Icha chi' ol aj snachajel eyuuj to a in ton Jehová he Diosal in.

Ha yuj eyes chi' tzeyak' chab'axk'e sk'ol heb' wach' spensar, aton heb' malaj in gana swak' kus sk'ool, ix he kuchb'an heb' te chuk sk'ulej, yuj chi' max sna sb'a heb' t'a schukal chi' yik skolchaj heb'.

Yuj chi' manhxalaj b'aj ol eyala' to ay tas tz'ak'ji eyila', ma olto he tz'ak he nael tas ol ujok. Ha in ol in kolel in chonhab' t'a yol he k'ab'. Icha chi' ol aj snachajel eyuuj to a in ton Jehová he Diosal in, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb' ix, xchi t'ayin.
Ay heb' yichamtak winaquil chonhab' Israel ix jawi t'ayin yik tzin k'anb'ej t'a Jehová yuj heb'.
Yuj chi' ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik:

Ach anima, a juntzanh anima tik toxo ix yak'och spensar heb' t'a komon Dios, syak'anoch sb'a heb' t'a yol sk'ab' chukal yuj juntzanh chi'. ¿Tom olto in tak'wok t'a heb' ayik ol sk'anb'an junok tas heb' t'ayin?

Al t'a heb' to a in Jehová Yajal in swal icha tik: Yalnhej mach ex israelal ex tik tzeyak'och he pensar t'a komon Dios, tzeyak'anoch he b'ha t'a yol sk'ab' chukal yuj juntzanh chi', slajwi chi' tzex jawi he k'anb'ej junok tas t'a heb' in chekab', a in ol wak' spak t'ayex icha wal smojal, yujto tzijtum he diosal chi', xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb'.
Icha chi' ol aj wik'an meltzaj spensar heb' israel t'ayin, aton heb' ix yik'el sb'a t'ayin, haxo t'a komon Dios ix och heb' ejmelal.

Yuj chi' al t'a heb' etisraelal chi' icha tik: Icha tik yalan Jehová Yajal: Meltzajanheccot t'ayin, aktejekkan juntzanh komon Dios yet' juntzanh he b'eyb'al yajb'entak tze k'ulej chi', xa chi t'a heb'.

Tato ay junok heb' ma junok ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a skal heb' tzin patikaneli, haxo t'a komon Dios tz'och ejmelal, syak'anoch sb'ha t'a yol sk'ab' chukal yuj juntzanh chi', slajwi chi' sjawi t'a junok in chekab' yik sk'anb'an t'ayin yuj, a in wal ol wak' spak t'ay.
Ol in och ajk'olal t'ay, ol in satel t'a skal in chonhab' yik tz'och ch'oxnab'il, yik sb'inaj yuj heb' anima. Icha chi' ol aj snachajel eyuuj to a in ton Jehová he Diosal in.

Palta tato ay junok in chekab' smontaj yuj junok anima, syalan junok tas t'a yol yiko', a in Jehová in ol in wach' ak'ej montajok. Ol in och ajk'olal t'a jun in chekab' chi', ol in satel t'a skal heb' in chonhab' Israel.
Yowalil ol jawok yaelal t'a yib'anh jun anima ix montan jun in chekab' chi' yet' pax t'a yib'anh jun in chekab' ix pakan t'a yol yik chi'.
Yuj chi' a heb' in chonhab' Israel manhxo ol in spatiquejel heb', manhxo ol b'at heb' t'a spatik chukal. Ha in wal Jehová Yajal in swala' to in chonhab' heb', a inxo sDiosal in heb', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
Ach anima, q'uinalok ay junok chonhab' tzek' t'a yib'anh yoch smul t'ayin, swak'anoch syaelal, swik'anek' swael, yuj chi' scham heb' anima yet' nok' nok' yuj wejel.

Q'uinalok ha t'a skal heb' chi' kajan winhaj Noé, winhaj Daniel yet' winhaj Job, a in wal Jehová Yajal in swala' to anhej am oxwanh heb' winh chi' skolchaji, yujto tojol sb'eyb'al heb' winh, malaj junokxo mach skolchaj yet' heb' winh.
Q'uinalok swak'b'at nok' chium nok' t'a jun chonhab' chi' yik smiljicham masanil yuninal heb' kajan ta' yuj nok', skan tzinan. Manhxa mach sb'eyek' ta' yuj xiwk'olal t'a nok'.

Q'uinalok ha t'a jun chonhab' chi' kajan heb' winh oxwanh chi', anhej am heb' winh skolchaji. Malaj junok mach syal skolanel heb' winh, wach'chom yuninal heb' winh mato yisil heb' winh, max yal-laj skolchaj heb'. Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to skan tzinan jun chonhab' chi'.
Q'uinalok swak'b'at owal t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' chi' yik scham heb' anima yet' nok' nok',
q'uinalok ata' kajan heb' winh oxwanh chi', anhej am heb' winh skolchajeli. Ha in wal Jehová Yajal in swala' to maxtzak am yal skolchaj heb' yuninal heb' winh yet' yisil heb' winh yuj.
Q'uinalok swak'b'at ilya t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' chi' yet' wal yowal in k'ool swak'anb'at chamel t'a yib'anh heb' anima yet' t'a yib'anh nok' nok'.

Q'uinalok ata' kajan winhaj Noé, winhaj Daniel yet' winhaj Job chi', anhej am heb' winh skolchaji. Ha in wal Jehová Yajal in swala', wach'chom tojol sb'eyb'al heb' winh, palta max yal-laj skolan heb' yuninal heb' winh, ma yisil heb' winh.

Ha in wal Jehová Yajal in swala': Te ayxo smay ol ujok, ayik ol wak'anb'at chanhe' yaelal t'a yib'anh Jerusalén chi': Aton owal, wejel, nok' chium nok' yet' ilya, scham anima yet' nok' nok' yuj juntzanh chi'.

Palta ay jaywanh heb' ol kolchajkanel yet' yuninal yet' yisil. Ha heb' chi' ol ik'jokkot heb' t'a tik, ol eyilanoch sb'eyb'al heb' yet' jantak chukal sk'ulej heb'. Icha chi' ol aj eyaktan he kus yuj yaelal swak'b'at t'a yib'anh Jerusalén chi'.
Ha in wal Jehová Yajal in swala' to icha chi' ol aj snachajel eyuuj to malaj tas manh smojok swak'b'at t'a yib'anh Jerusalén chi', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
Ach anima, ¿tom ek'b'al yelk'och ste'al te' uwa t'a yichanh junok te te'?
Ha ste'al te' uwa chi' malaj yopisio te', max yal-laj yoch te' lokteal, max yalpaxlaj sb'o junok tas t'a te'.
Tato tz'och te' k'atzitzal, stz'ab'at te', a stzak'aq'uil te' chi', malaj tz'ochi.
Ayic manto tz'a te' chi', malaj tz'och te', ¿tom ato wal yik stz'ab'at te', ichato chi' tz'och yopisio te'?
Yuj chi' a in Jehová in tik swala': Icha yaj te' uwa tz'ik'jielta t'a skal te te' yik snhusjitz'a te', icha chi' ol aj wak'anoch syaelal heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén chi'.

Ha in wal ay in och ajk'olal t'a heb'. Wach'chom ol el lemnaj heb' t'a jun yaelal chi', palta a yaelal chi' ol satanel heb'. Ayic ol in och ajk'olal t'a heb', ol nachajel eyuuj to a in ton Jehová he Diosal in.
Ha in wal Jehová Yajal in swala' to ol wak'kan tzinan jun chonhab' chi', yujto maj in sk'anab'ajej heb', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
Ach anima, al yab' heb' aj Jerusalén tastak te yajb'entak sk'ulej heb'.
Al t'a heb' to a in Jehová Yajal in, a in swala' to icha tik yaj yab'ixal Jerusalén chi': Ha Jerusalén chi', lajan icha junok ix ix ha t'a Canaán aljinak. Amorreo smam ix, haxo snun ix, hetea.
Ayic yaljinak ix, maj poljiel-laj smuxuk ix, maj b'ikchajel-laj jab'ok ix, maj ek' jab'ok yal atz'am t'a ix, maj pichchaj jab'ok ix yet' k'apak.
Manhxa mach ix ok' sk'ol sb'oan juntzanh chi' t'a ix. Ayic ix alji ix chi', ix kan telan ix yuj heb' t'a sat lu'um, ix yajji ix yuj heb'.
Axo yik ix in ek' t'a stz'ey ix, ix wilani to miikmiik ix yuj schiq'uil, ix in naani to smoj sq'uib' ix.
Ix wak'an q'uib' ix icha junok te' kaltakte'al te' spak'k'eta t'a yol lu'um. Ix q'uib'k'e ix, ix kob'esax ix, ix elta yim ix, ix q'uib'pax xil sjolom ix. Palta junelnhej te b'eranel ix.

Ix in ek'xi junelxo t'a slak'anil ix chi', ix wilani to smojxo yoch yetb'eyum ix. Yuj chi' ix wak'b'at jun k'apak t'a yib'anh ix. Icha wal chi' ix aj in pichan ix, yujto b'erannhejel ix. Ha in Jehová in swala' to ix wak' in trato yet' ix yik tz'ochkan ix t'a yol in k'ab'.
Ix in b'iquel schiq'uil ix, ix in sakb'itej ix, ix wak'anoch perfume t'a ix.
Ix wak'anoch jun pichul te wach' yilji stz'ib'ul t'a ix. Ix wak'anoch xanhab' tz'uum te wach' t'a ix yet' pax jun tzek'ul nab'a lino yet' pax jun spichul ix te wach' yaj sjalchaji.
Te wach' ix aj wak'anoch yelwanub' t'a ix. Ix wak'och k'een brazalete t'a sjaj sk'ab' ix yet' pax jun tonh t'a sjaj ix.
Ix wak'anpaxoch jun k'een icha kolk'ab' t'a snhi' ix yet' yuchiquin ix yet' pax jun korona te wach' yilji t'a sjolom ix.

Pichichi ix ajkan ix yet' k'een oro yet' pax k'een plata. Ha spichul ix chi', aton k'apak lino te wach', aton juntzanh k'apak te wach' yaj sjalchaji yet' k'apak te wach' yilji stz'ib'ul. Ix wak'an ixim pan te wach' t'a ix yik swa ix yet' yal chab' yet' pax yakeiteal sat te' oliwo. Te wach'xonhej ix aj yilji ix, yuj chi' ix och ix reinail.
Te b'inajnak ix aj ix t'a kaltak nakión yuj swach'il yilji chi'. Ha in Jehová in swala' to tz'akaqui ix aj in b'oanel ix yet' yelwanub'.
Yujto te b'inajnak ix aj ix, ix yak'anoch spensar ix t'a swach'il yilji chi', haxo t'a ajmulal ix b'atkan ix, ix yak'an sb'a ix t'a yalnhej mach tzek' ta'.
Ha yet' spichul ix ix sb'ok'e smantiado b'aj tz'och ejmelal t'a komon Dios t'a tzalquixtak, ata' ix em ix ajmulal. Ha juntzanh tas ix sk'ulej ix chi', manh smojok ix sk'ulej ix.
Ix yik'anel masanil k'een k'een ix te wach' yilji, k'een oro yet' k'een plata wak'nak t'a ix. Ha yet' k'een ix sb'ok'e yechel winak ix yik tz'och ix ajmulal yet'ok.
Ha spichul ix te wach' yilji chi' yet' akeite yet' inkienso ix wak' t'a ix, ix yak' ix t'a juntzanh komon Dios chi'.

Ha ixim pan b'ob'il t'a ixim harina te wach', akeite yet' nok' yal chab' ix wak' swaelok ix, ix yak' ix silab'il te wach' sjab' t'a juntzanh yechel, aton juntzanh te wach' sjab'. Aton wal juntzanh chi' sk'ulej ix t'a wichanh a in Jehová in tik.

Anhejtona' a heb' wuninal yet' heb' wisil ix wil sat yet' ix, ix snhustz'a ix silab'il t'a juntzanh komon Dios chi', icha wael ix aj heb' unin chi' t'a juntzanh yechel chi'. Manh tonhejok ix em ix t'a ajmulal chi',
palta ix yik'b'at heb' wuninal ix, ix nhusantz'a heb' ix silab'il t'a juntzanh yechel chi'.

D'a skal juntzanh smul ix te yajb'entak sk'ulej chi', majxo snakot ix tas ix aj skotoch t'a uninal, majxo snakot ix tato b'eranel ix ayik aytoek' ix t'a skal schiq'uil. Ha jun ix ix chi', aton Jerusalén sch'oxo'.
Ha in wal Jehová Yajal in swala': Ob'iltak chonhab' Jerusalén chi' yuj juntzanh chukal sk'ulej.
Yalnhej b'aj tzalquixtak, ata' ix sb'ok'e b'aj tz'em ajmulal.
Ha b'aj slajwikank'och junjun kalle ix sb'ok'e juntzanh b'aj tz'em ajmulal chi'. Ha swach'il yilji, yajb'entak ix ajkani. Ix yak'b'at sb'ha t'a yalxonhej mach tzek' ta'.
Ix yak'anb'at sb'ha t'a jun chonhab' ay t'a slak'anil, aton Egipto te pek' t'a ajmulal. Yuj chi' ix stzuntzejkot yowal in k'ool yuj sk'echaanh t'a ajmulal chi'.

Yuj chi' ay in och ajk'olal t'ay, ix wak'anoch yaelal t'a yib'anh. Ix wik'anemta swael, ix wak'anpaxoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ool, aton heb' filisteo. Ha heb' chi' ix sat sk'ol heb' yilan sb'eyb'al Jerusalén te q'uixweltak sk'ulej chi'.
Palta ix yak'paxb'at sb'ha t'a Asiria. Palta max k'och sk'ool.
Ix yak'anpaxb'at sb'ha t'a Babilonia, aton schonhab' heb' chonhwajum, palta manh yujok chi' ix k'och sk'ool.
Ha in wal Jehová in swala': Ha Jerusalén te pek' t'a ajmulal chi', lajan wal ix yutej sb'a icha junok ix ajmul ix maxtzak q'uixwi yuj tas syutej sb'a.

Ix sb'ok'e juntzanh b'aj tz'em ajmulal t'a b'ajtak slajwik'och kalle yet' b'ajtak smolb'ej sb'a anima, ix yak'anb'at sb'ha t'a ajmulal chi'. Palta nab'anhej syak'b'at sb'a, manh lajanok syutej sb'a icha heb' ix ajmul ix sk'an stojol.
Icha juntzanh ix te chuk syutej sb'ha t'a yetb'eyum, syak'b'at sb'ha t'a junokxo ch'ok winaquil, icha chi' ix yutej sb'a Jerusalén chi'.
Ha heb' ix ajmul ix stupchaj heb' ix, haxo pax Jerusalén chi', ha' ix ak'an silab' t'a heb' b'aj syaltej sb'a chi'. Ha ix tupan heb' yik yalnhej b'aj skot heb' sk'ulan ajmulal chi' yet'ok.

Yuj chi' ch'ok yel Jerusalén chi' t'a yichanh juntzanhxo heb' ix ajmul ix. Malaj mach sayaneq'ui yik smulan yet'ok, max tupchajpaxi, palta to a stupan heb' sk'ulan ajmulal chi' yet'ok, yuj chi' ch'ok yel t'a yichanh heb' ix ajmul ix chi'.
Yuj chi', ab'ek wal tas swal yuj ix ajmul ix chi':

Ha in Jehová Yajal in swala': Malaj sq'uixwelal, ix squichanel b'eran sb'a yik sk'ulan ajmulal yet' heb' xajanej sb'a yet'ok, ix em kuman t'a juntzanh komon Dios yajb'entak. Ix stob'anem schiq'uil heb' yune' yik syak'an silab'il.

Yuj chi' ol in molb'ej masanil juntzanh heb' xajanab'il chi' yuj, aton heb' ix yak' snib'ej yet'ok, juntzanh heb' xajan yuj yet' juntzanh heb' ix schaqueli. Ol in molb'ejoch oyan heb' t'a spatik, wal t'a yichanh heb' ol in quichel b'eran yik wach' ol yil heb' to b'eraneli.
Ol wak' syaelal t'a smojal, icha tz'utaj junok ix ajmul ix yet' pax junok ix mak'umcham anima. Yed' wal yowal in k'ool yet' in chichonk'olal ol wak'och t'a yol sk'ab' chamel.

Ol wak'och Jerusalén chi' t'a yol sk'ab' juntzanh nakión chi' yik ol satel juntzanh tzalquixtak heb' b'aj ix em ajmulal yet' b'aj ix och ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios chi'. Ol yik'el spichul heb' yet' juntzanh yelwanub' ayoch t'ay, toxonhej ol kan b'eran.
Manhxo b'ischajb'enok anima ol k'e waan t'a spatik Jerusalén chi', ol sjulk'enancham heb', ol smilancham heb' yet' k'een espada.
Ol yak'och sk'ak'al chonhab' chi' heb', t'a yichanh juntzanhxo nakión ol jawok yaelal t'a yib'anh. Icha chi' ol aj wak'an lajwok yajmulal chi', manhxa b'ak'uinh ol stup heb' b'aj ay snib'ej chi'.
Icha chi' ol aj sikb'i yowal in k'ol t'a yib'anh, manhxo ol chichon in k'ol t'ay. Manhxo ol kot yowal in k'ol t'ay.

Ix b'at satk'olal yuj chajtil yaji ayik uninto, yuj chi' ix stzuntzej wal kot yowal in k'ool yuj sb'eyb'al te yajb'entak chi'. Yuj chi' a in wal Jehová in swala' to ol wak'och yaelal t'a yib'anh yuj sb'eyb'al chi'.
Masanil heb' anima ol alan jun lolonel tik t'a spatik Jerusalén chi'. Ol yalan heb': Icha wal ix nunab'il, icha pax chi' ix uneab'il, xcham heb'.

Ha Jerusalén chi', lajan icha junok ix yune' junok ix ix schakanel winh yetb'eyum yet' heb' yune'. Icha pax chi' heb' ix snulej, schakpaxel heb' winh yetb'eyum heb' ix yet' heb' yune' heb' ix, yujto a ix snun heb' ix chi', hitita ton ix, haxo smam heb' ix, amorreo winh.
Ha t'a stojolal norte, ata' ay ix snulej ix b'ab'el ix, aton Samaria yet' yaldeail. Axo t'a stojolal sur, ata' ay ix snulej ix tzak'an, aton Sodoma yet' yaldeail.

Manhoknhej sb'eyb'al juntzanh chonhab' chi' ix sb'eyb'alej Jerusalén chi', manhoknhej pax juntzanh tas yajb'entak ix sk'ulej juntzanh chonhab' chi' ix sk'ulej, palta ek'b'al tas te yajb'entak ix sk'ulej, yujto manh k'okb'ilok juntzanh chi' ix yab'i.
Ha in Jehová Yajal in swala': Ha Sodoma yet' yaldeail, manh sk'ulejnakok tas te chuk icha wal tas sk'ulej Jerusalén chi' yet' yaldeail.

Aton wal juntzanh smul Sodoma chi' yet' masanil yaldeail: Yik'nak wal chaanh sb'a, manhxo jantakok tas yab'lejnak, wach'nhej yaji, palta maj kolwajlaj t'a heb' meb'a', maj kolwajpax t'a heb' ay stzapan majan.
Ha snaani to anhej te niwan yelk'ochi, ochnakpax ijan sb'eyb'alan juntzanh tas tzin yaja', yuj chi' in satnaqueli, icha wal tz'aj eyilanoch tiknaik.

Axo pax Samaria yet' yaldeail, ix sk'ulej chukal, palta max tzak'wan t'a tas te chuk sk'ulej Jerusalén chi'. Manh jantakok tas yelxo wal te yajb'entak sk'ulej Jerusalén chi'. Ha juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a slak'anil, wach'takto wal tas sk'ulej.

Ha tiknaik, a Jerusalén chi' yowalil ol yak' techaj q'uixwelal, yujto a schukalil yelxo te chuk t'a yichanh yik Sodoma yet' t'a yichanh yik Samaria. Ha chab' chonhab' chi', ayik sko lajb'an schukal yet' yik Jerusalén, wach'takto wal.
Ha Sodoma yet' yaldeail wach' ol ajxok wuuj. Ha Samaria yet' yaldeail wach' ol aj paxok. Icha pax chi' Jerusalén wach' ol ajxok wuuj.
Palta a Jerusalén chi' yowalil ol yak' techaj emnaquilal yet' q'uixwelal yuj tas te chuk ix sk'ulej. Ha Sodoma yet' Samaria ol sniwanej sb'a sk'ool ayik ol yilani to ix wak' syaelal Jerusalén chi'.
Ayic ol wak'an ajxok Sodoma yet' yaldeail, Samaria yet' yaldeail icha yaj t'a yalanhtaxo, ol wak'pax ajxok Jerusalén yet' yaldeail icha t'a yalanhtaxo.

Ayic ix yik'anchaanh sb'a Jerusalén, aton yik manto ilchajelta schukalil, ix b'uchwaj t'a Sodoma. Palta a tiknaik, a Edom, Filistea yet' masanil nakión, ol b'uchwaj t'a Jerusalén chi'. Masanil anima t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik ol patikanelok.
Ha tiknaik, a in Jehová in swala' to a Jerusalén chi' yowalil ol yab' syail yuj sb'eyb'al te yajb'entak.
Ha in Jehová Yajal in swala': Ol wak' spak icha wal smojalil t'a Jerusalén chi', yujto maj sk'anab'ajej sk'ulan icha ix aj yak'an strato wed'ok.
Palta a in tik, ol in nakot in trato wak'nak yet'ok ayik uninto, ol in b'oanxi in trato chi' yet'ok, malaj b'ak'uinh ol lajwok.

Ha Jerusalén chi', ol snakot schuk b'eyb'al, ol q'uixwokpaxi ayik ol wak'anoch chawanh snulej chi' t'a yol smakb'en, aton Samaria yet' Sodoma. Ichato nunab'il ol ajkan t'a chab' chonhab' chi'. Wach'chom malaj yalan yik chab' chonhab' chi' t'a in trato in b'onak yet' Jerusalén chi',
palta yuj in trato ol in b'oxi yet' Jerusalén chi' icha chi' ol ajok. Icha wal chi' ol aj snachajel yuj Jerusalén to a inton Jehová sDiosal in.

Ol wak' niwank'olal masanil tas ix sk'ulej Jerusalén chi', palta yowalil ol snakot juntzanh sb'eyb'al chi', ol q'uixwok yuj, yuj chi' manhxa b'ak'uinh ol yik'chaanh sb'a, a in Jehová in swala', xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb', xchi t'ayin.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
Ach anima, al jun ab'ix tik t'a heb' etisraelal t'a ch'oxnab'ilal.

Icha tik tz'aj alani: Icha tik yalan Jehová Cajalil: Ay wal jun nok' niwan ch'akb'a ix k'och t'a Líbano, a sk'axil nok' te niwak, te najatto sk'och jenhan, tz'ib'ib'i yilji xiil nok'. Ha t'a sk'ab' jun te' k'ute' ix k'och nok'.
Ix yik'anel schon te' nok', ix b'at nok'. Axo t'a jun chonhab' t'a smakb'en heb' chonhwajum ix k'och nok' yet' te'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'ank'e jun yinhatil te' nok', haxo b'aj ay slumal ix yawejem te' nok', b'aj sb'o munlajel t'a stitak ha ha' icha tz'aj yawchaj te' b'akmam.

Axo yik ix wolan te', te niwaquil ix aj te', te tzijtum ix aj xiil te', pejannhej ix aj steel te'. Ix sd'inhb'ejb'at sb'a sk'ab'tak te' b'aj ayek' nok' niwan ch'akb'a chi', ix b'eynhejb'at sch'anhal yib' te' t'a yol lu'um. Manh jantakok swol te' yet' sk'ab'tak ix q'uib'i.

Palta ay junxo nok' niwan ch'akb'a, te niwak sk'axiil, manhxo jantakok xiil. Ix b'at jun te te' chi', ix b'eynhejb'at sch'anhal yib' te' yet' sk'ab'tak t'a stojolal junxo nok' niwan ch'akb'a chi', yik wach' niwan ha ha' syak' nok' t'a te'.

Palta toton te wach' lum b'aj awab'ilem te' chi'. Te aynhej ha ha' chi', yuj chi' syal sb'eynhejb'at sk'ab'tak te', syak'anpax sat te' t'a stiempoal, yik te wach' tz'aj yilji te', xchi Jehová, xa chi.

Al t'a heb' etchonhab' icha tik: Icha wal tik yalan Jehová: Ha jun te' chi', manh ol te q'uib'laj te'. Ha nok' niwan ch'akb'ha t'a sb'ab'elal, a nok' ol tok'ank'eta sch'anhal yib' te', icha wal chi' ol aj sk'ael b'ulnaj sat te' yet' xiil. Ol takjok pax juntzanh swol te' toto ix k'euli. Manh yowalilok yet' niwak ip, ma yet' tzijtumok anima ol tok'ank'eta te' t'a yol lu'um yik stakji.

Wach'chom ol k'exchaj b'aj tz'awchaj te', palta manhxo ol k'eulaj swol te'. Ayic ol ek' ik' skot t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a te', ol takjok te'. Ol takjok te' b'aj awab'il chi', xchi Jehová, xa chi, xchi t'ayin.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:

k'anb'ej t'a juntzanh anima te pit tik, tato snachajel jun ab'ix tik yuj heb'. Tzalan t'a heb' icha tik: Ha nok' b'ab'el niwan ch'akb'a chi', aton winh sreyal Babilonia sch'oxo'. Ha winh ix k'och t'a Jerusalén, ix b'at yik'ankot heb' yajal yet' winh sreyal Judá winh preso t'a Babilonia tik.

Ixlajwi chi', haxo jun winh yinhtilal heb' rey ix yak'och winh reyal t'a Judá. Ha winh sreyal Babilonia chi' ix ak'an pural winh yak'an sti' to k'anab'ajum ol yutej sb'a winh t'a winh. Ix yik'ankot heb' niwak winak yaj t'a Jerusalén chi' winh preso
yik manhxalaj tz'aj yelk'och smakb'en Judá chi', yik maxtzak yal yik'ank'e waan sb'a, wach'nhej yajeq'ui yakb'an sk'anab'ajej jun sti' ix yak' chi'.

Palta a winh rey chi' te pit ix yutej sb'a winh t'a winh sreyal Babilonia tik. Ix yak'b'at schekab' winh t'a winh sreyal Egipto yik sk'anankot nok' chej winh yet' jantakok soldado. ¿Tzam he na' to ol yal skolanel sb'a winh yet' jun spensar chi'? ¿Tom ol yal skolanel sb'a junok mach max k'anab'ajan junok strato?

Ha in Jehová Yajal in swak' in ti': Ha t'a Babilonia tik ol cham winh sreyal Judá chi', yujto malaj yelk'och b'aj ix yak' sti' winh, maj sk'anab'ajej strato winh ix sb'o yet' winh rey ix ak'an yopisio.

Ha winh sreyal Egipto chi', wach'chom te tzijtum soldado winh te tek'an, palta manh ol yal-laj skolwaj winh t'a owal ayik ol sb'oank'e stek'nub' heb' soldado aj Babilonia yet' muro t'a spatiktak chonhab' Jerusalén yik smilancham anima.
Maj sk'anab'ajej b'aj ix yak' sti' winh sreyal Judá chi', maj elk'och tas syal strato winh ix sb'o chi', yuj chi' manh ol yal-laj skolan sb'a winh.
Ha in Jehová Yajal in swak' in ti': Maj sk'anab'ajej winh rey b'aj ix yak' sti' t'a wichanh, aton jun trato ix yak' winh b'aj ix in yak' b'inajok, yuj chi' ol wak'och yaelal t'a yib'anh winh.

Ichato ol wak'b'at junok ch'anh yaal t'a yib'anh winh, ol kan winh t'a yol ch'anh, ol wak' ik'jokkot winh t'a Babilonia tik. Ol wak'och yaelal t'a yib'anh winh, yujto te pit ix yutej sb'a winh t'ayin.
Ha heb' soldado winh te jelan, ol cham heb' t'a owal, haxo heb' olto kanok, ol saklemkanb'at heb'. Icha chi' ol aj snachajel eyuuj to a in ton Jehová in ix wal jun tik.

Ha in Jehová Yajal in swala': Ha in ol wik'el schon te' k'ute' chi'. Ha junok yuninal schon te' ol wik'eli, ol wawanem t'a junok jolom witz te chaanh yajk'e t'a Israel. Ol q'uib'k'e sk'ab'tak te', niwan k'ute' ol aj te', te wach' pax ol aj te'. Ha t'a yich te' chi', ol kajnaj masanil makanhil nok' nok', haxo t'a sk'ab'tak te' ol sb'o so' masanil makanhil nok' much.

Icha chi' ol aj yojtakanel masanil te te' to a in ton Jehová in syal in ch'akanel te' niwak te' syik'chaanh sb'a, syal wak'an q'uib' te' kotak steel. Ha in swak' takjok te te' te yaax, swak'an pax yaxb'ok te' taquinh. Ha in Jehová in swala', ol wak'paxelk'ochok, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb', xchi t'ayin.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
¿Tas yuj anheja' eyalub'tanhan jun lolonel t'a spatik chonhab' Israel: Ha heb' mamab'il slo pajal uwa heb', haxo heb' uninab'il jululixonhej sb'at spajil chi' t'a yichtak ye heb'?
Ha in Jehová Yajal in swala' to a jun lolonel chi' manhxa b'ak'uinh ol eyalub'tanhej a ex aj Israel ex tik.
Yujto wik yaj masanil anima, heb' mamab'il yet' pax heb' uninab'il. Ha mach tz'och smul, ha' schami.
Q'uinalok ay junok winh winak tojol spensar, wach'nhej tas sk'ulej winh.

Max och winh yet' heb' tz'ak'anoch q'uinh t'a jolomtak witz yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios. Max yak'och juntzanh skomon diosal heb' yetisraelal winh chi' yipok sk'ool. Max mulan winh yet' ix yetb'eyum junok yetanimail, max yil-laj sb'a winh yet' ix yetb'eyum ayik ayoch ix t'a sb'islab' uj.
Max yixtej junok yetanimail winh, palta to syak' meltzaj tas aykan t'a winh yuj junok anima ay sb'ok t'ay. Max elk'anwi winh. Syak' swael heb' ay swejel winh, syak'an spichul heb' malaj yiko'.
Max yak' k'een tumin winh t'a majanil yik sk'ananel niwan yune' k'een winh. Max yixtej junok yetanimail winh, palta wach' tz'aj sb'oan yaj junok lolonel winh t'a yib'anh chawanhok ay owal t'a skal.
Sb'eyb'alan in cheknab'il winh yet' in k'ayb'ub'al. Ha junok winh winak icha chi', wal yel tojol ton sb'eyb'al winh, ol najatb'ok sk'inal winh, a in wal Jehová in swala'.
Q'uinalok ay junok yuninal jun winh winak chi' te elk'um, mato mak'umcham anima tz'aji. Sb'eyb'alej juntzanh tastak
maj sb'eyb'alej smam, palta to syak'och q'uinh t'a jolomtak witz, tz'och ejmelal t'a yechel komon Dios, smulan pax yet' ix yetb'eyum junok yetanimail,

syixtan heb' anima ilb'ajk'ol yuj smheb'ail, tz'elk'anwi, max yak' meltzaj tas aykan t'ay yuj heb' ay sb'ok t'ay, anhej juntzanh komon Dios chi' syak'och yipok sk'ool, sk'ulan tas te yajb'entak t'a wichanh.

Ha stumin syak' majanil te niwan yune' sk'ana'. Ha junok anima icha chi' sb'eyb'al, ol tzapanb'ok sk'inal. Yujto ix sk'ulej juntzanh tastak tzin yaj chi', manh ol ek'b'atlaj schami. Ha schamel chi', ha t'a yib'anh skani.
Q'uinalok ay junok yuninal jun winak chuk sb'eyb'al chi', syila' tastak juntzanh chuk sk'ulej smam chi', palta manhok juntzanh chi' sk'ulej.
Max yak'och q'uinh t'a jolomtak witz yik tz'och ejmelal t'a yechel komon Dios. Max yak'och son t'a juntzanh skomon diosal heb' yetisraelal. Max mulan yet' ix yetb'eyum junok yetanimail.
Max yixtej junok yetanimail, max elk'anwi, max kanlaj tas aykan t'ay yuj heb' ay sb'ok t'ay. Syak' swael heb' malaj swael, syak'an spichul heb' malaj yiko'.

Malaj junok mach syixtej yujto a stumin syak' majanil manh niwanok yune' sk'ana'. Sb'eyb'alan in cheknab'il yet' in k'ayb'ub'al. Ha jun anima icha chi', manh ol cham yuj smul smam chi', palta to ol najatb'ok sk'inal.
Axo smam chi' ol cham yuj smul chi', yujto ixtum anima, elk'um, te chuk tas ix sk'ulej t'a yol schonhab'.

Tato ayex ol he k'anb'ej icha tik: ¿Tas yuj max kotkan t'a yib'anh heb' uninab'il yuj smul smam? tato xe chi. Tato a yuninal chi' anhej tas wach' yet' tojolal sk'ulej, sk'anab'ajan in k'ayb'ub'al, ol najatb'ok sk'inal.

Ha mach tz'och smul, a ol chamok. Manhok heb' uninab'il ol tupanel smul smam, manhok pax heb' mamab'il chi' ol tupanel smul heb' yuninal chi'. Ha mach wach' sb'eyb'al, wach' spak ol scha'a, haxo pax mach chuk sb'eyb'al, a chukal ol scha spakok schukal chi'.
Tato ay junok anima chuk sb'eyb'al tz'aktankan schukal chi', sb'eyb'alan masanil in cheknab'il, sb'eyb'alanpax tojolal, wal yel a jun anima chi' manh ol pet chamok.
Ha in tik, manhxo ol in nakot juntzanh chukal ix sk'ulej chi', ol najatb'ok sk'inal yujto a tojolal sk'ulej.
Ha in Jehová in swala': Malaj in gana scham heb' chuk sb'eyb'al, palta in gana to sk'ex sb'eyb'al heb' yik snajatb'i sk'inal heb'.

Tato a junok anima wach' sb'eyb'al, palta syaktejkan sk'ulan wach'il chi', haxo juntzanh tas yajb'entak sk'ulej heb' chuk, a chi' sk'ulej, ¿tom ol wak' najatb'ok sk'inal jun anima chi' tze na'a? Manhxo ol in nakot tastak wach' ix sk'ulej chi'. Ol cham yuj chukal sk'ulej chi'.
Ha ex tik tzeyala' to manh tojolok tas tzin k'ulej, yuj chi' ab'ek ex aj Israel: ¿Yel am wal to manh tojolok tas tzin k'ulej chi'? ¿Tom manhok ex tze k'ulej tas manh tojolok chi' jun?
Tato a junok anima wach' sb'eyb'al, syaktejkan sk'ulan wach'il chi', haxo chukal sk'ulej, ol cham yuj chukal sk'ulej chi'.
Palta tato a junok anima chuk sb'eyb'al, syaktejkan schukal chi', haxo wach'il yet' tojolal sk'ulej, ol kolchaj t'a yol sk'ab' chamel.
Yujto ix nachajel yuj ix yaktankan schukal sk'ulej chi', wal yel manh ol chamlaj, ol najatb'ok sk'inal.
Ha exxo aj Israel ex tik, anhejtona' tzeyala' to manh tojolok tas tzin k'ulej. ¿Tom manhok ex manh tojolok tas tze k'ulej chi' jun?

Ha in Jehová Yajal in swala': Ol ex in ch'olb'itej junjun ex icha tas tze k'ulej. Yuj chi' naek he b'a, aktejekkan he chuk b'eyb'al chi' t'a junelnhej. Tato maay, yuj he chuk b'eyb'alil chi' ol ex satelok.
Ex israel, ¿tom tze nib'ej cham he b'a yuj chi' max he k'ex he pensar yet' he b'eyb'al? Palta aktejekkan masanil chukal tze k'ulej chi' yik manh ol ex chamok.
Ha in Jehová in swala', malaj in gana to ay mach schami. Actejekkan chukal chi' yik ol najatb'ok he k 'inal, xchi Jehová.
Ach anima, b'itej jun b'it yik kusk'olal yuj heb' sreyal Israel, tzalan icha tik:
Ay jun nok' nun choj te b'inajnak, kajan nok' t'a skal juntzanh nok' mam choj. Ha t'a skal nok' chi' ix sq'uib'tzitej yune' nok'.
Ay jun yune' nok' ix yil q'uib'ok. Ix sk'ayb'ank'e syaman schib'ej, haxo heb' anima ix chijib'at yuj.
Ix yab' spekal juntzanh nakión tas sk'ulej nok' yune' chi'. Ix yamji nok' yuj heb' t'a jun yaal, ix yak'anoch jun gancho heb' t'a nok', ix snheranb'at nok' heb' t'a Egipto.
Ayic ix yilan jun nok' nun choj chi' to maj elk'och tas ayoch yipok sk'ol nok', ix yilan q'uib' junxo yune' nok'.
Axo ix quelemax nok' yune' chi', junnhej ix ek' nok' yet' nok' mam choj chi'. Ix sk'ayb'an sb'a nok' syaman schib'ej, haxo heb' anima ix chijib'at yuj nok'.
Manhxo jantakok anima smil nok' t'a yoltak kuartel. Tzijtum niwak chonhab' syixtejb'at nok'. Tz'ib'xik'e yol yib'anhk’inal tik ayik tz'el yaw nok'.
Yuj chi' ix och juntzanh nakión ay t'a slak'anil chi' ajk'olal t'a nok'. Ix sb'oanem yaal heb' t'a nok', ix yamchaj nok' yuj heb'.

Yed' k'een gancho ix yak'anoch nok' heb' t'a yol jaula, ix yik'anb'at heb' t'a winh sreyal Babilonia. Ix makchajkan nok' ta' yik manhxa mach tz'ab'an yel yaw nok' t'a jolomtak witz t'a yol yik Israel. (Ha jun nok' nun choj chi', a ix snun heb' sreyal Judá sch'oxo'.)
Ha he nun chi' ex rey, lajan pax icha junok ib' te' uwa awab'il t'a stitak junok ha ha', te niwan ix aji, manhxo jantakok sat ix yak'a', tzijtum swol ix q'uib'i yujto aynhejoch yalil.

Ay juntzanh sk'ab' te', k'enal te' ix aji, a ix och sk'okochok heb' rey. Te chaanh ix aj steel te' sq'uib'i, ix ek'b'at te' t'a yib'anh juntzanhxo te' niwak te'. Ch'ok ix aj yel te' t'a skal juntzanhxo te te' yujto te chaanh steel te', te tzijtum pax sk'ab'tak te'.

Palta ix tok'jik'eta te' uwa chi' yuj yowal sk'ol Dios. Yuj ik' ix kot t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u ix takjiel te' yet' sat. Ix jekjiel sk'ab'tak te', ix takji. Ix nhusjipaxtz'a jun sk'ab' te' k'enal te' ix aj chi'.
Axo tiknaik, ha t'a tzinan lu'um awab'il te' nunal uwa chi'.

Ha t'a jun te' sk'ab' chi' ix elta k'ak', yuj jun k'ak' chi' ix tz'ab'at juntzanhxo sk'ab' te', ix tz'apaxb'at sat te'. Manhxalaj sk'ab' te' k'enal te' tzato yal yoch sk'okochok heb' rey, xchi jun b'it chi', xchi Jehová. (Aton jun b'it tik yik kusk'olal, yuj chi' ol b'itajok.)

Ayic lajunhe' k'ual yoch yoil uj, ayik yuquil ab'ilxo ayonh ek' t'a Babilonia tik, ay tas ix snib'ej juntzanh yichamtak winaquil chonhab' Israel sk'anb'ej t'a Jehová, yuj chi' ix em k'ojan heb' t'a wichanh.
Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik:

Ach anima, al t'a heb' yichamtak winaquil chonhab' Israel tik: Icha tik yalan Jehová Kajal: ¿Tom tzex jawi t'ayin ul he k'anb'an eyab'i? Val yel a in wal swak' in ti' to manh ol in tak'wok t'ayex, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb'.
Ach anima al t'a heb' tas syaelal heb' ol wak'a'. Scham wal ak'an yojtaquejel heb' tas te yajb'entak sk'ulejnak heb' smam yicham heb'.

Al t'a heb' icha tik: Ha Jehová Kajal tz'alan icha tik: Ayic in sik'anel heb' he mam eyicham chi', wak'annak in ti' t'a heb', in ch'oxannak in b'ha t'a heb' t'a Egipto. Ata' wak'nak in ti' t'a heb', walannak: Ha in ton Jehová he Diosal in.

Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi' wak' in ti' wik'anelta heb' t'a Egipto chi', yik swik'anb'at heb' t'a jun lu'um to a in wal ix in saya', aton t'a jun lum lum te yax sat, yelxo te wach' t'a yichanh masanil lum lum.
Val t'a heb' icha tik: Junjun ex tzeyaktejkan juntzanh he diosal te yajb'entak, manh eyixtejel he b'a yuj sdiosal heb' aj Egipto tik, yujto a in Jehová he Diosal in, xin chi t'a heb'.

Palta spitej sb'a heb' t'ayin. Maj yal sk'ol heb' scha yab' tas wala'. Maj satel-laj sdiosal heb' yajb'entak chi', maj yaktejpaxkan juntzanh sdiosal heb' aj Egipto chi' heb'. Yuj chi' in na wak' syaelal heb' yet' masanil yowal in k'ol t'a yol smakb'en Egipto chi'.

Palta maj in k'ulejlaj icha in na chi' yik manh chukok syal juntzanh nakión b'aj kajan ek' heb' chi' t'a in patik, yuj chi' in ch'ox sniwanil welk'och t'a heb' t'a yichanh heb' ch'ok nakional chi', ayik wik'anelta heb' t'a Egipto chi'.
Wik'anelta heb' t'a nakión chi', wik'ankanb'at heb' t'a tzinan lu'um.
Ata' wak' in k'ayb'ub'al yet' in cheknab'il yojtaquejel heb', tato sb'eyb'alej heb' wach'nhej tzek' heb'.
Wak'an jun sk'ual ik'oj ip wik yaj t'a heb' yik sk'anab'ajej heb', yik tz'ochkan sch'oxnab'ilok in trato wak'kan yet' heb', yik snaanpaxkot heb' to a in Jehová in tik in sik'kanel heb'.

Palta spitej sb'a heb' t'ayin t'a tzinan lu'um chi', maj sk'anab'ajej in k'ayb'ub'al heb', spatiquejel in cheknab'il heb', aton juntzanh wak' t'a heb' yik wach'nhej tzek' heb'. Maj sk'anab'ajej pax sk'ual ik'oj ip wal t'a heb'. Yuj chi' in na in satel heb' yet' yowal in k'ol t'a tzinan lum chi'.
Palta yik max in yal juntzanh nakión ilan wik'anelta heb' t'a Egipto chi' chukal, yuj chi' maj in satel-laj heb'.
Anhejtona' t'a tzinan lum chi' wak' in ti' to manh ol wak'och heb' t'a jun lum wak' in ti' wak'an t'a heb', aton jun lum te yax sat, te wach' t'a yichanh masanil lum lum,

yujto maj sk'anab'ajej in k'ayb'ub'al heb', spatiquejel in cheknab'il heb', maj sk'anab'ajej jun sk'ual ik'oj ip heb', aton jun k'u wik yaji. Anhej t'a juntzanh komon Dios yajb'entak ayoch spensar heb',
palta ok' in k'ol t'a heb', yuj chi' maj in satel-laj heb' t'a tzinan lu'um chi'.
Ata' wal t'a heb' yuninal heb' to max sk'ulej heb' icha sb'eyb'al smam heb' chi', max yixtejpaxel sb'a heb' yuj juntzanh komon Dios yajb'entak chi'.
Valani to a in Jehová in sDiosal in heb' to sk'anab'ajej wal in cheknab'il heb' yet' in k'ayb'ub'al.
Niwanokab' yelk'och sk'ual ik'oj ip wik yaj t'a yol sat heb'. Ha jun chi' ch'oxnab'il yaj t'a jun trato in b'o yet' heb' yik syojtaquejel heb' to a in ton Jehová sDiosal in heb'.

Palta anheja' spitejpax sb'a heb' yuninal heb' chi' t'ayin. Maj sk'anab'ajejlaj in k'ayb'ub'al heb', maj sb'eyb'alej pax in cheknab'il heb', aton yuj juntzanh chi' wach'nhej tzek' heb' sk'anab'ajani. Anhejtona' yixtejel sk'ual ik'oj ip heb', aton jun k'u wik yaji. Yuj chi' in na' in satel heb' yet' yowal in k'ol t'a tzinan lum chi'.
Palta yik max in yal juntzanh nakión ilan wik'anelta heb' t'a Egipto chi' chukal, yuj chi' maj in satel-laj heb'.
Palta yakb'an aytoek' heb' t'a tzinan lum chi', wak'an in ti' to ol in saklemejb'at heb' t'a skaltak nakión t'a masanil yol yib'anhk’inal tik,

yujto maj sk'anab'ajej in k'ayb'ub'al heb', spatiquejpaxel in cheknab'il heb', maj sk'anab'ajej sk'ual ik'oj ip heb', aton jun wik yaji. Anhej t'a juntzanh Dios yajb'entak b'aj yak'och spensar heb', aton sdiosal heb' smam yicham heb'.
Yuj chi' wak'an juntzanh k'ayb'ub'al yet' cheknab'il manh wach'ok t'a heb', juntzanh max yal wach' tzek' heb' anima yuj.

Wak'an yixtejel sb'a heb' yuj silab' to a sb'ab'el yuninal heb' snhustz'a silab'il. Ha juntzanh chi' wak' sk'ulej heb' yik wach' manhxo animaok tz'aj heb' yik syojtaquejel heb' to a in ton Jehová in sDiosal in heb'.

Yuj chi' ach anima, al t'a heb' etisraelal to a in Jehová Yajal in swal icha tik: Ha heb' he mam eyicham stzuntzejnak wal kot yowal in k'ol heb', in spatikannaquel heb' ayik sb'oannak juntzanhxo tik heb':

Ayic toxo ix wik'och heb' t'a sat lum lum wak'nak in ti' wak'an t'a heb', yilanoch juntzanh tzalquixtak heb' yet' juntzanh te te' te k'ayum xiil, ata' snhus silab' heb', ofrenda heb', inkienso heb' sumumi sjab', stob'anpaxem wino heb' ofrendail t'a juntzanh komon Dios, yuj juntzanh chi' stzuntzejkot yowal in k'ol heb'.
In k'anb'an t'a heb' icha tik: ¿Tas yaj juntzanh chaanh b'aj tzex b'at chi'? xin chi t'a heb'. Yuj chi' Chaanh Yajk'ei, icha chi' sb'iejnakkani, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb'.

Al t'a heb' etisraelal to a in Jehová Yajal in swal icha tik: Ha ex tik tze jub'at he b'a icha ajnak sjuanb'at sb'a heb' he mam eyicham chi'. Tze tek'b'ej wal he b'a eyoch ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios te yajb'entak chi'.

Slajwi he juanel he b'a yuj b'aj tze nhustz'a heb' eyuninal silab'il t'a juntzanh komon Dios chi', tzex jawi pax he k'anb'ej t'ayin tas snib'ej he k'ool. Val yel, a in Jehová Yajal in swak' in ti' to manh ol in tak'wok t'ayex.
Ha ex tik ix he na eyoch ejmelal t'a te te' yet' t'a k'een k'een, icha syutej sb'a juntzanhxo nakión. Palta malaj b'ak'uinh ol in cha he k'ulej juntzanh chi'.
Yuj chi' a in Jehová Yajal in swak' in ti' to a in ol wak' yajalil t'a eyib'anh yet' in poder yet' pax yowal in k'ool.
Ol ex wik'anelta t'a juntzanh nakión, ol ex in molb'an b'aj sakleminak eyajkanb'at wuuj, ol in ch'ox wal in poder yet' yowal in k'ol t'ayex,

ol ex in molb'an t'a jun tzinan lu'um t'a skal juntzanh nakión. Ha in Jehová in swala' to a in wal ol ex in ch'olb'itej, ol wak'anoch yaelal t'a eyib'anh, icha ajnak wak'anoch yaelal t'a yib'anh heb' he mam eyicham t'a tzinan lum t'a yol yik Egipto.
Icha syutej winh tanhwum kalnel sik'lan nok' skalnel ayik sb'isan nok' winh, icha chi' ol ex wutej. Ol ex in sik'elta mach ex ol ex och t'a in trato ol in b'o eyed'ok.

Ha heb' te pit tz'och ajk'olal t'ayin, ol wik'elta heb' b'aj sakleminak eyaj tiknaik, ol in satel heb' t'a he kal, manh ol ochlaj heb' t'a smakb'en heb' eyetisraelal. Icha wal chi' ol aj eyojtakaneli to a in ton Jehová he Diosal in.

Ex aj Israel, a in Jehová Yajal in swal icha tik: Yujto te pit tzeyutej he b'a t'ayin, yuj chi' ixiquek, ochanhek ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios yajb'entak chi'. Palta ol k'och sk'ual haxo t'ayin ol eyal he b'a. Manhxo ol eyixtejel sniwanil welk'ochi, yujto manhxo ol eyak' juntzanh eyofrenda t'a juntzanh komon Dios chi'.

Ha t'a jun tzalan wik yaji, aton jun witz te chaanh t'a smakb'en Israel, ata' ol ex och ejmelal t'ayin he masanil ex israel. Ha in Jehová Yajal in swala' to ata' ol ex in cha yet' smasanil in k'ool. Ata' ol in k'an t'ayex to ol eyak' eyofrenda t'ayin yet' pax b'ab'el sat eyawb'en yet' masanil tas wiktaxon yaji.

Ayic toxo ix ex wik'elta t'a skaltak juntzanh nakión yet' b'ajtak sakleminak eyajkanb'at chi' tiknaik, t'a tzalajk'olal ol ex in cha icha inkienso sumumi sjab'. Ol in ch'ox wal sniwanil welk'och t'ayex t'a yichanh masanil nakión.
Ayic ol ex wik'anxib'at t'a lum lum wak'nak in ti' wak'an t'a heb' he mam eyicham, aton lum Israel, ata' ol nachajel eyuuj to a in ton Jehová he Diosal in.
Ata' ol he nakot juntzanh he b'eyb'al malaj swach'il yet' jantak chukal tze k'ulej tiknaik. Ayic ol he naankot juntzanh he chukal chi' ol ex te q'uixwok.

Ex israel, ayik ol eyilani to max wak' eyaelal icha wal smojal yuj jantak chukal tze k'ulej chi', palta to tz'ok' in k'ol t'ayex yuj sniwanil welk'ochi, ata' ol eyojtaquejeli to a in ton Jehová he Diosal in, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb' etisraelal chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
Ach anima, b'atanh k'elan t'a stojolal sur, tzalanb'at juntzanh lolonel tik t'a lum niwak yax lum ay t'a smakb'en sur chi'.

Tzalan icha tik: Ha Jehová Yajal tz'alan icha tik: Ha in ol wak'och jun k'ak' yik ol tz'ab'at masanil lum yax lu'um, aton te te' yaax xiil yet' te' taquinh. Masanil tas ay t'a sat lum lum chi' ol tz'ab'atok, schab'at t'a sur masanto sk'och t'a norte. Malaj mach ol yal smak'an tup jun k'ak' chi'.
Masanil yol yib'anhk’inal tik ol ojtakanelok to a in ix wak'och jun k'ak' chi', yujto a jun k'ak' chi', manh ol tuplaj, xchi Jehová t'ayin.
Ixlajwi chi' ix in tak'wi icha tik: Ay Mamin Jehová, a heb' anima syal heb' to anhej t'a k'exanh lolonelal tzin loloni, xin chi t'a Jehová chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
Ach anima, b'atanh k'elan t'a stojolal Jerusalén, tzalanb'at juntzanh lolonel tik t'a yib'anh juntzanh stemplo heb' komon Dios. Alcanel in lolonel tik t'a chonhab' Israel.
Tzalani: Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha in ol in och ajk'olal t'ayex. Ol wik'k'eta wespada ol in milancham heb' wach' sb'eyb'al yet' heb' chuk sb'eyb'al.
Ol wik'k'eta wespada, junlajan ol aj in milancham masanil anima. Ol cham heb' wach' yet' heb' chuk, ol schael yich scham heb' t'a sur masanto ol k'och t'a norte.
Masanil yol yib'anhk’inal tik ol ojtakanelok to a in ix wik'k'eta wespada, manh ol wak'xiem t'a yol yatut, xchi Jehová.
Ach anima, sik'sik'ananh wal oq'ui, yab'okab' wal syail a pixan, tzach ok' t'a yichanh heb' etchonhab'.

Tato sk'anb'ej heb' t'ayach tas yuj tzach oq'ui, tzalan t'a heb' icha tik: Ha yuj yab'ixal jun tas toxo ol ujok tzin oq'ui. Masanil anima t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, manhxo animaok ol ajkan heb', toxonhej ol emkan nhojan heb'. Manhxalaj mach olto yal stek'b'an sb'a. Masanil heb' ol luklonk'e yok yuj xiwelal, xa chi t'a heb'. Ha in Jehová in swala' to wan sjawi stiempoal, yowalil ol elk'ochok, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
Ach anima, lolonanh t'a in b'i, tzalani to a in Jehová in swal icha tik: Ilecnab' wal k'een espada wan sjawi. Ha k'een espada te jayxo yaj ye k'een. Toxonhej kopopi yilji k'een.
Jayxo yaj k'een yik xikjicham anima. nhikb'ilel k'een yik tz'el kopnaj sk'ak'al k'een. Manhxalaj tzalajk'olal yujto a winh he reyal max xiwlaj winh t'a yaelal yet' t'a skachnab'il.
Copopi ix aj k'een espada chi' snhikjieli yik sk'anchaji. Toxo ix ak'jioch ye k'een yik tz'ak'jioch k'een t'a yol sk'ab' jun mach ol xikancham anima yet' k'een, xa chi.

Ach anima, elokab' aw, yujto ol xikjokcham heb' aj Israel yet' masanil heb' yajal t'a skal heb'. Ha heb' yajal chi', junnhej ol aj scham heb' yet' heb' komon anima. Yuj chi' tanhub'tanhej snhi' a k'ol yuj kuselal.
Val yel ol ujok jun yaelal chi'. ¿Tas ol ex ajkan a ex tik ayik manhxalaj ol aj yelk'och winh he reyal t'a k'een espada chi'? Ha in Jehová in swala' to manhxalaj ol aj yelk'och winh he reyal chi'.

Ach anima, tz'it a k'ab' tzalan t'a heb' etchonhab' chi' icha tik: D'ab'jokab'nhejoch k'een espada t'a anima. Xikjokab'cham anima t'a k'een. Masanil anima scham yuj xiwelal, yujto yalnhej b'aj smilji anima yuj k'een.
Yuj k'een espada chi' ste sat sk'ol heb' anima yuj xiwelal. Ha t'a masanil chonhab' ayxoek' k'een wuuj yik xikjicham anima. Toxonhej kopopi yilji k'een, te jay yajk'e ye k'een yik xikjicham anima.
Xiqueccham anima t'a k'een espada t'a he wach' yet' t'a he k'exanh. Yalnhej b'aj chamokab' anima yuj sjayil ye k'een.
Ha in Jehová in swala' to ol in tz'it pax in k'ab', masanto ol sikb'ok yowal in k'ol t'a in chonhab' tik, xchi Jehová t'ayin.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:

Ach anima, b'o yechel chab'ok b'e b'aj ol b'at winh sreyal Babilonia yet' k'een espada. Ha chab' b'e chi' junnhej chonhab' b'aj ol elok, haxo b'aj spoj sb'a, ol a b'ooch chab'ok yechel ol ch'oxanok tas chonhab'il b'aj ol k'och junjun.

Tzak'och yechel junok b'e b'aj ol b'at winh rey chi' yet' k'een espada t'a chonhab' Rabá, t'a yol yik Amón. Tza b'oan yechel junokxo b'e chi' sk'och t'a Jerusalén, aton jun chonhab' wach' yajoch smuroal t'a yol yik Judá.

Ha winh sreyal Babilonia chi', ol och waan winh b'aj spoj sb'a chab' b'e chi', ol sk'anb'an winh mach junok b'e chi' syik'a'. Ol skalej sjul-lab' winh, ol sk'anb'ej pax winh t'a sdiosal, ol sayan yil seyub' junok nok' nok' winh.

Ha t'a swach' k'ab' winh, ata' ol elul sjul-lab' sch'oxan t'a stojolal Jerusalén, syalelk'ochi to tz'och owal t'a Jerusalén chi'. Ol miljokcham anima ta'. Ol el aw yik owal. Ol b'ochaj mak'lab' poj puerta. Ol b'ochajk'e tek'nub' t'a spatiktak chonhab' chi', ol oymaj heb' soldado t'a spatiktak smasanil.

Palta haxo heb' anima t'a Jerusalén chi', ol sna heb' to a jun lolonel tz'alchaj tik to manh ol ujok yuj juntzanh trato toxo ix yak' heb'. Palta a winhaj Nabucodonosor chi' ol ak'an snakot jantak schukal heb', yuj chi' ol ik'jokkot heb' t'a Babilonia tik yuj winh.
Yuj chi' a in Jehová Yajal in swala': Ha wal he chukal yet' he pital, te chequel yaji. Masanil he mul yet' jantak chukal tze k'ulej, te jakan yaji, yuj chi' ol ex yamchajok.
Ha ach wal tik ach sreyal Israel, te chuk ach, yajb'il ach eli, lak'anxo sjawi stiempoal a chaan slajwub' yaelal.
