tzalan icha tik: Ha Jehová Yajal tz'alan icha tik: Ol ex wik'elta t'a skaltak juntzanh nakión b'aj k'ochnak ex kani. Yalnhej b'aj ayex eq'ui ol ex wak'anxi meltzaj t'a sat he lu'um.
Junxonhej chonhab'il ol ex wutej t'a lum tzalquixtak t'a yol yik Israel chi', junxonhej he reyal ol wak'ochi. Manhxa b'ak'uinh ol ex pojchajb'atok. Manhxo chab'ok nakión ol ex ajok.

Manhxo ol eyixtejb'at he b'a yet' juntzanh he komon Dios yajb'entak chi', ma yet' juntzanhokxo makanhil chukal tze k'ulej. Yujto ol wik'el he pitalil, ol wik'anel he mul ayoch t'a eyib'anh. Ol ex ochxok in chonhab'ok, a inxo ol in ochxok he Diosaloc.
Aton winh in chekab' yinhtilal winhaj Dawid ol och he reyalok yet' he tanhwumalok he masanil. Ol he k'anab'ajan in k'ayb'ub'al yet' in cheknab'il.

Ol ex kajnajxok t'a jun lu'um wak'nak t'a winh in chekab' aj Jacob, aton lum b'aj ek'nak heb' he mam eyicham. Ata' ol kajnaj heb' eyuninal yet' masanil heb' eyinhtilal t'a masanil tiempo. Axo winh in chekab' yinhtilal winhaj Dawid ol ochnhej he reyalok.

Ol wak' in trato yik junk'olal eyed'ok, yik wach' ol ex aj t'a tzalajk'olal. D'a junelnhej ol in b'okan jun in trato chi' eyed'ok, yik tzalajk'olalnhej ol ex ajok. Ol wak'an q'uib' he b'isul, t'a masanil tiempo ol kan in templo t'a he kal.
Ol in kajnaj t'a he kal, ol in ochxok he Diosaloc, a exxo ol ex ochxok in chonhab'ok.
Ol aj in templo chi' t'a he kal t'a junelnhej, haxo masanil juntzanhxo nakión ol nachajel yuj heb' to sik'b'il ex el wuuj yik tzex ochkan wikok, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
Ach anima, a tiknaik meltzajanhb'at k'elan t'a stojolal chonhab' Magog. Tzalan juntzanh in lolonel tik t'a yib'anh winhaj Gog, sat yajal yaj t'a Mesec yet' t'a Tubal.
Al t'a winh to a in Dios Yajal in swal icha tik: Ach Gog sat yajal aj t'a Mesec yet' t'a Tubal, a in wal swala' to ayinxooch ajk'olal t'ayach.

Ichato ol wak'och junok k'een gancho t'a yalanh a ti', ol ach wik'an meltzajok. Ol ach wik'ankot t'a tik yet' masanil heb' a soldado ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej, heb' yet'nak yespada, heb' ed'jinak smaklab' jul-lab' yet' masanil juntzanhxo yamk'ab' yik owal.
Ha t'a skal heb' chi' ayoch heb' soldado aj Persia, heb' aj Etiopía yet' heb' aj Libia. Masanil heb' chi' yet'nak smaklab' jul-lab' heb' yet' pax sk'en xumpil heb'.
Ay pax masanil heb' soldado aj Gomer yet' heb' aj Bet-togarma, aton heb' ay t'a norte yet' pax juntzanhxo chonhab' manhxo b'ischajb'enok ayoch ed'ok.
Ak' lista a b'a yet' a yamk'ab' yik owal yet' masanil heb' soldado tzak' mandar.

Ayic niwanxo tiempo toxo ix eq'ui, ol a naanchaanh to ol ak' owal yet' chonhab' Israel, aton jun chonhab' najtil kannak tzinan yuj owal. Palta ha t'a jun pekti’ chi' meltzajnakxo heb' anima sakleminak yajkanb'at t'a juntzanhxo nakión, kajanxo heb' t'a sluum chi' t'a junk'olal.
Icha wal junok k'ik' asun ol aj a k'och t'a jun chonhab' chi' yet' juntzanhxo nakión ayoch ed'ok. Ol ach k'och yet' masanil heb' a soldado manhxo b'ischajb'enok, icha wal junok niwan yaxnhab'.
Ha in Jehová in swal icha tik: Te chuklaj tas ol a na' a k'ulej t'a jun pekti’ chi'.
Ol alan icha tik: Ol b'at wak' owal yet' juntzanh anima, malaj smuroal schonhab' heb' ayochi, malaj spuertail, malaj pax yijchul ayochi, tzalajk'olal yaj heb', malaj b'aj wach' skolan sb'a heb'.

Ol wik'anek' tastak ay t'a heb', ol in och t'a juntzanh chonhab' toto ix b'ochajxik'ei, aton heb' anima toto meltzajnak t'a juntzanh nakión. Ha heb' chi' tzijtum nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' yet' juntzanhxo tas ay t'a heb'. Aton heb' kajan t'a snanhal yol yib'anhk’inal tik, xa chama.

Ha heb' aj Sabá, heb' aj Dedán yet' heb' chonhwajum skot t'a Tarsis, ol sk'anb'ej heb' t'ayach icha tik: ¿Tom tzach jawi elk'al? ¿Tom ix a molb'ej heb' a soldado tik tzach jawi yet' heb' yik tzul ik'anek' k'een plata, k'een oro, nok' molb'etzal nok'? xcham heb', xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ach anima, al t'a winhaj Gog chi' to a in Jehová Yajal in swal icha tik: Ayic te tzalajk'olalxo yaj in chonhab' Israel, ol a naank'e ak'an owal chi' yet' heb'.
Ol ach kotnhej t'a a lu'um te najat t'a norte, te niwan juntzanhxo chonhab' ol kot ed'ok, ayk'e heb' t'a yib'anh chej. Manhxo b'ischajb'enok heb' soldado ol kot ed'ok.

Ol ak'an owal yet' in chonhab' Israel chi', ol ach och oyan t'a spatiktak, icha tz'ajem asun t'a yib'anh lum lum. Ach Gog, ha t'a jun pekti’ chi' ol ach wik'kot t'a sat lum in lu'um chi' yik ol yil juntzanhxo nakión tas ol wutej ach in sataneli, icha chi' ol aj yojtakanel heb' to a innhej niwan welk'ochi.

Ha in Jehová Yajal in swal icha tik: Ha ach ton tik walnak uuj t'a heb' in chekab' t'a peka', ayik yalannakkanel in lolonel heb' t'a skal heb' in chonhab' Israel. Najtil yak'nak heb' yalankan uuj to a in ol ach wik'kot ak' owal yet' heb' in chonhab'.
Ha in Dios Yajal in swal icha tik: Ayic ol jawok winhaj Gog yak' owal t'a Israel chi', ol kot wal yowal in k'ol t'a yib'anh winh.
Yuj wal yowal in k'ol chi', ay wal niwan quixkab' te ow ol ek' t'a Israel chi'.

Masanil nok' chay t'a yol ha' mar, nok' much tzek' jenhenhok, nok' kaltakte'al nok' yet' pax nok' snherwi t'a sat lu'um, ol ib'xokk'e nok' smasanil yuj xiwelal t'a wichanh. Icha chi' ol aj masanil anima t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik. Ol laj el lum witz k'akapil, ol elta wequeljok k'een tenam, ol em lanhnaj smuroaltak chonhab'.

Ha in Jehová Yajal in swal icha tik: Ha t'a lum tzalquixtak t'a yol smakb'en in chonhab', ol wak'b'at chamel t'a yib'anh heb' soldado winhaj Gog. Munil a heb' soldado chi' ol smil-lajcham sb'a junjun yet' k'een yespada.
Ol wak'b'at yaelal, ilya yet' chamel t'a yib'anh winh. Ol wak'b'at owal yaxnhab', niwak sakb'at yet' azufre ayoch sk'ak'al t'a yib'anh winh yet' soldado yet' masanil nakión ajun yet' winh.
Icha chi' ol aj in ch'oxanel sniwanil welk'och t'a yichanh juntzanhxo nakión, icha chi' ol aj yojtakanel heb' to a in ton Jehová in, a innhej Dios in, xchi Jehová.
Ach anima, al t'a winhaj Gog to a in Jehová in swal icha tik: Ach Gog, yajal aj t'a Mesec yet' t'a Tubal, swal t'ayach to ayinxooch ajk'olal t'ayach.
Ha in ol wak' a k'ulej, ol ach wik'kot t'a najat t'a stojolal norte, yik ol ach jawok t'a lum tzalquixtak yik Israel.
Ata' chok' ol wutej jun a jul-lab' ed'nak t'a a k'exanh k'ab' yet' yol a jul-lab' ed'nak t'a a wach' k'ab'.

Ha achxo jun yet' heb' a soldado ol ach wak'och t'a yol sk'ab' chamel yet' heb' yik juntzanhxo nakión ajun ed'ok, ol ex cham t'a lum tzalquixtak t'a yol yik Israel. Axo nok' ostok yet' nok' chium nok' ol ex wak' chianb'at ta'.
Ol ex kan teljab' t'a sat lum lum chi'. Ha in Jehová Yajal in swak' in ti' swutan icha chi'.
Ol wak'kot k'ak' t'a yib'anh nakión skuchan Magog yet' t'a yib'anh masanil heb' anima junk'olal kajan t'a stitak ha' mar. Icha chi' ol aj yojtakanel heb' to a in ton Jehová in swutej icha chi'.
Icha chi' ol wutej in ch'oxan sniwanil welk'och t'a in chonhab' Israel, yik manhxa b'ak'uinh ol in sb'uch heb'. Icha chi' ol aj yojtakanel juntzanhxo nakión to a in ton Jehová in, sDiosal in Israel.
Ha jun k'ual chi', wanxo sjawi, a in wal Jehová in swala' to yowalil ol ujok, xchi Jehová, xa chi.

Axo masanil heb' anima kajan t'a junjun chonhab' t'a smakb'en Israel, ol elta heb' smol masanil yamk'ab' yik owal ol kan chi', aton jul-lab', maklab' jul-lab', kotak lanza, niwak lanza yet' juntzanhxo yamk'ab'. Uque' ab'il ol yak' heb' sk'atzitzan masanil juntzanh chi'.

Ha in Jehová Yajal in swala', manhxo yowalilok ol b'at heb' israel chi' saykot sk'atzitz t'a najat, manhxo ol b'at heb' yik' sk'atzitz t'a kaltak te', yujto masanil juntzanh yamk'ab' yik owal chi', a ol sk'an heb' sk'atzitzok. Icha chi' ol aj yik'anxikanek' heb' tastak ul yik'nakb'at heb' ajk'ol chi' t'a heb'.

Ha t'a jun k'u chi' a in ol wak' jun yet'tal b'aj ol mukchaj winhaj Gog yet' heb' soldado winh t'a yol smakb'en Israel chi', aton jun panhan b'aj tzek' heb' anima skot t'a stojolal ha' mar Muerto. Manhxo ol yal-laj sb'ey anima t'a jun b'e chi' yuj heb' mukb'il chi' ta'. Ol say sb'i jun lugar chi' heb': Lum panhan b'aj mukb'il winhaj Gog yet' heb' soldado, xcham heb'.
Uque' ujal ol yak' heb' israel mukoj chamnak chi', icha chi' b'ian, wach' ol ajxikan sluum heb' chi' t'a yol in sat.
Masanil heb' israel ol kolwaj heb' smukan heb' anima ol cham chi'. Ha in Jehová Yajal in swala', ayik ol in ch'oxan in poder, ol te b'inajkan chonhab' Israel.

Ayic ol ek' uque' ujal chi', ay jun nhilanh heb' winh winak ol tupchajok. Ol laj ek' heb' yila' b'ajtak aykan jab'jab'ok sniwanil heb' chamnak t'a yol smakb'en heb' chi' smasanil, yik smukan masanil niwanil heb' pukankanb'ati. Icha chi' b'ian, wach' ol ajxikan slum heb' chi' t'a yol in sat.

Ayic ol ilchaj sb'aquil chamnak yuj heb' tzek' sayan chi', ol yak'kank'e junok yechel heb', haxo yik sjawi heb' smukan chamnak chi', a heb' ol ik'anb'at b'aj smukchaji, aton lum skuch spanhanil b'aj mukb'il winhaj Gog yet' heb' soldado.
Icha chi' b'ian, wach' ol ajxikan slum heb' chi' t'a yol in sat, xchi Jehová. (Anhejtona' t'a slak'anil lum chi', ay pax jun chonhab' ol skuch Lum b'aj smukji heb' soldado.)

Ix yalanxi Jehová Yajal t'ayin icha tik: Ach anima, al t'a masanil nok' ostok yet' t'a masanil nok' chium nok': Cotokab' nok' t'a juntzanhxo nakión, smolb'ejokab' sb'a nok' t'a tzalquixtak t'a yol yik Israel, ichato ol in b'o junok niwan wael t'a nok'. Ol schi chib'ej nok', ol yuk'anpax chik' nok'.

Ha schib'ejal heb' soldado ol schi nok'. Ol yuk'an schiq'uil heb' yajal t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik nok'. Ol chijok heb' icha tz'aj nok' ch'ak kalnel, nok' yunetak kalnel, nok' chiwa yet' nok' b'ak'uech wakax skot t'a Basán.
Ha jun wael ol in b'o chi', ol schi xepu' nok' masanto ol penaayax nok' yuj. Ol yuk' wal chik' nok' masanto ol k'e t'a sjolom nok' icha heb' uk'um anh.

Ha in Jehová in swala' to a jun niwan wael ol in b'o chi', aton schib'ejal nok' chej yet' yik heb' soldado ayk'e t'a yib'anh nok' yet' yik heb' soldado tek'an t'a owal yet' yik masanil makanhil heb' soldado, masanto ol b'ud'jok sk'ol nok' yuj.
Icha tik ol aj in ch'oxan in poder t'a yichanh juntzanhxo ch'ok nakional. Masanil nakión ol ojtakanelok tas tz'aj in ch'olb'itani yet' wak'anoch yaelal t'a yib'anh heb'.
Ha t'a jun k'ual chi' yet' ol b'eynhejb'atok, a heb' israel ol yojtaquejel heb' to a in ton Jehová in sDiosal in heb'.

Masanil juntzanhxo nakión ol ojtakanelok to a heb' israel yuj spital heb' ix ik'jib'at heb' t'a juntzanhxo ch'ok nakional. Yujto te pit yutejnak sb'a heb' t'ayin, yuj chi' majxo in kot k'elan t'a heb'. Ix waktankan heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ool, icha chi' ix aj yak'ji ganar heb', ix miljicham heb' t'a owal.
Ix wutej heb' icha t'a smojal yuj chukal sk'ulej yet' spitalil, yuj chi' majxo in b'at k'elan t'a heb'.

Yuj chi' a in Dios Yajal in swala': Ha tiknaik ol ok' wal in k'ol t'a chonhab' Israel chi', aton heb' yinhtilalkan Jacob. Ol wik'anxichaanh heb', yik tzin b'inaj t'a wach'il, yik tz'ik'jichaanh in b'i to malaj junokxo mach syal slajb'an sb'a wed'ok.
Ayic ol kajnajxok heb' t'a schonhab', manhxalaj tas ol sna heb', manhxalaj mach ol xib'tan heb'. Icha chi' ol sat sq'uixwelal heb' t'a sk'ool yuj spitalil yet' chukal sk'ulej heb' t'ayin.
Ayic ol wik'anelta heb' t'a yoltak schonhab' heb' yajk'ool, ol in molb'anxi heb', icha wal chi' ol aj snachajel yuj juntzanh nakión to ch'ok wel t'a yichanh komon sdiosal heb'.

Ha in ix in chek ik'jokb'at heb' t'a juntzanhxo ch'ok nakional, anheja' in ol in molb'ejxikot heb' t'a schonhab'. Manhxa junok heb' ol kan ta'. Icha chi' ol aj yojtakanel heb' to a in ton Jehová sDiosal in heb'.
Ha in Jehová in swala' to manhxo ol waktejkan heb' junelxo, yujto ol wak'kot Vespíritu t'a yib'anh chonhab' Israel chi', xchi Jehová.

Ayic 25 ab'ilxo quik'jikot t'a Babilonia tik, ayik slajunhil k'ual yoch b'ab'el uj, ayik 14 ab'ilxo yak'ji ganar Jerusalén, ata' ix yak'em spoder Jehová t'a wib'anh. Ix wilani, ichato ix in ik'jib'at t'a smakb'en Israel.
Ha t'a smakb'en Israel chi', ha t'a sjolom jun lum witz te chaanh, ata' ix in yik'k'e Jehová ix wila''. Ata' ix wilb'at jun pat t'a stojolal sur, lajan yilji icha junok niwan chonhab'.

Ix in yik'anb'at Jehová t'a jun chonhab' chi'. Ata' ix wil jun winh winak lajan yilji icha k'een bronke. Linhanek' winh t'a sti' jun puerta, yet'nak jun ch'anh ch'anh nab'a lino winh yet' jun te' aj syak'lab'ej yechtani.

Ix yalan jun winh winak chi' t'ayin icha tik: Ach anima, scham wal ab'ani yet' ilan tas ol in ch'ox t'ayach, yujto ha Dios ix ach ik'ankot t'a tik yik wach' tzojtaquejeli. Ol lajwok chi' ol alan masanil tas tzil tik t'a heb' etchonhab' Israel, xchi winh t'ayin.

Ha t'a spatiktak templo chi' ay jun muro oyanochi. Ha jun te' aj yet'nak jun winh winak chi', oxe' metro steel te'. Ix yechtan jun muro chi' winh. Ha jun chi' oxe' metro spimal, oxe' pax metro schaanhil yajk'ei.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winh t'a jun puerta t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, ix k'e winh b'aj b'akhquiltak sk'ei, ix yechtan jolom puerta winh. Ha jun chi' oxe' metro yajoch t'a yoloch puerta chi'.

Ha t'a yoloch spuertail chi', ata' ay jun kalle tz'ochi, haxo t'a stitak jun kalle chi', ay juntzanh kuarto b'aj ay heb' stanhwan puerta chi'. Ha junjun kuarto chi', oxe' metro sat, oxe' metro pax schaanhil. Axo spimal yajkan t'a skal junjun kuarto chi', nanhal yoxil metro spimal. Axo t'a skal b'aj slajwiochk'och juntzanh kuarto chi' yet' jun skorredoral, oxe' metro, a jun yune' amak' chi' k'elanb'at t'a templo.
Ix yechtan jun yune' amak' chi' winh, b'aj tzonh och t'a yol templo, chanhe' metro sat. Ay chab' niwak oy, jun metro spimal.
Ha t'a stitak jun kalle b'aj tzonh och t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, ay oxe' kuarto lajannhej yool, lajannhej spimal ayoch t'a snanhal junjun.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yechtan jun skalleal juntzanh kuarto chi' winh, a sat kalle chi' yik tz'och t'a sattak juntzanh kuarto chi' oye' metro sat, haxo sat kalle chi' t'a sattak juntzanh spimal aykan t'a snanhal juntzanh kuarto chi', nanhal yuquil metro sat.

Ha t'a sti' juntzanh kuarto t'a skalleal chi', ay junjun yunetak muro ayochi, nanhal metro spimal, haxo schaanhil yajk'ei, nanhal metro paxi. Junjun juntzanh kuarto chi', ay oxe' metro sat yet' oxe' metro schaanhil.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yechtan masanil sat schon juntzanh kuarto chi' winh, skotnhej t'a jun kuarto t'a jun k'axep masanto t'a junxo kuarto k'elk'umb'a yaj yet'ok, ay 12 metro yet' nanhalxo t'a masanil.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yechtan jun skorredoral k'elanb'at t'a templo chi' winh, 10 metro yajek' k'atan.
Ha jantak yajoch jun kalle chi', schael yich t'a puerta masanto b'aj slajwiochk'ochi, 25 metro steel.

Masanil juntzanh kuarto chi' ay swentenail t'a spatiktak, k'elanb'at t'a jun niwan amak'. Ay pax swentenail t'a snanhal juntzanh kuarto chi'. Axo t'a sattak spak'ul kalle chi', ayoch yechel te' palma t'ay.

Ixlajwi chi', ix in yik'anb'at winh wil jun b'ab'el niwan amak' t'a yolochi. Ha t'a oxe' pak'anh t'a stitak jun niwan amak' chi' ay 30 kuarto, ha t'a stitak yet' t'a spatiktak juntzanh kuarto chi', a k'een k'een latz'b'ilemi.

Ha k'een k'een latz'b'ilem chi', tzek' k'een t'a sattak 30 kuarto chi', sk'och k'een t'a spatiktak juntzanh kuarto b'aj ay puerta, aynhejoch t'a spatiktak jun niwan amak' chi'. Ha jun niwan amak' chi', ayem t'a spatiktak junxo schab'il amak'.
Ix yechtej skal jun b'ab'el puerta winh, masanto t'a junxo spuertail schab'il amak', ay 50 metro sat, icha pax chi' t'a stojolal norte yet' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u.
Ix yechtan pax sk'atul yet' sat jun puerta winh yik jun b'ab'el amak' t'a stojolal norte.

Ay oxe' kuarto t'a junjun pak'anh skalleal jun puerta chi'. Makb'il snanhal, ay jun yune' yamaq'uil, lajannhej yechel yet' spuertail t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, syalelk'ochi 25 metro sk'atul, 12 metro yet' nanhalxo sat.

Ha jun skorredoral chi' yet' swentenail yet' yechel te' palma, lajannhej yet' juntzanh ay t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u. Uque' sb'akhquiltaquil sk'ek'och b'aj ay puerta chi', haxo skalleal chi' skan t'a yool.
Ha t'a stojolal jun b'ab'el puerta chi', ata' ay pax spuertail jun schab'il amak', lajannhej icha jun ay t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u. Ix yechtan pax snanhal chab' puerta chi' winh, 50 metro skal.

Ixlajwi chi', ix in yik'anxib'at winh t'a jun puerta t'a stojolal sur. Ix yechtan juntzanh kuarto winh, juntzanh spimal snanhal juntzanh kuarto chi' yet' jun skorredoral, lajannhej yechel yet' juntzanhxo.
Ha jun puerta chi' yet' skalleal, ay swentenail icha juntzanhxo. Ha yechel t'a smasanil, ay 25 metro yajochi, 12 metro yet' nanhalxo slewanil.
Uque' b'akhquiltak sk'ek'och t'a jun puerta chi', ay pax jun skorredoral t'a yool. Aypaxoch yechel te' palma t'a sattak t'a junjun pak'anh.
Ha jun schab'il amak', ay pax jun spuertail t'a stojolal sur. Ix yechtan skal chab' puerta t'a stojolal sur chi' winh, 50 metro skal.
Ixlajwi chi', ix in yik'anb'at winh t'a spuertail jun schab'il amak' t'a stojolal sur. Ix yechtan jun puerta chi' winh, lajannhej yechel yet' juntzanhxo puerta.

Ha skuartoal yet' skorredoral yet' sattak, lajannhej yechel yet' juntzanhxo puerta. Ha jun puerta chi' yet' skorredoral, ay swentenail t'a spatiktak. Ay 25 metro yajoch skalleal, 12 metro yet' nanhalxo slewanil.
Ha jun korredor chi', k'elk'umb'a yaj yet' jun b'ab'el amak', anheja' ayoch yechel te' palma t'a sattak skalleal chi'. Ha t'a jun puerta chi' ay wajxaque' b'akhquiltak sk'ek'och t'ay.
Ixlajwi chi', ix in yik'anxib'at winh t'a schab'il amak', t'a jun puerta t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, ix yechtan jun puerta chi' winh, lajannhej yechel icha juntzanhxo.
Ay spuertail, skorredoral yet' swentenail t'a spatiktak. 25 metro yajoch skalleal, 12 metro yet' nanhalxo slewanil.
Ha jun korredor k'elk'umb'a yet' jun b'ab'el amak', ayoch yechel te' palma t'a sattak junjun pak'anh skalleal. Ha t'a jun puerta chi' ay wajxaque' b'akhquiltak sk'ek'och t'ay.
Ixlajwi chi' ix in yik'anb'at winh t'a jun puerta t'a stojolal norte. Ix yechtan jun puerta chi' winh, a jun chi' lajannhej yet' juntzanhxo.
Ay pax skuartoal yet' spimal snanhal juntzanh kuarto chi', skorredoral yet' swentenail t'a spatiktak. 25 metro yajoch skalleal, 12 metro yet' nanhalxo slewanil.
Ha skorredoral k'elk'umb'a yaj yet' jun b'ab'el amak'. Ayoch yechel te' palma t'a sattak t'a junjun spak'ul. Ha t'a jun puerta chi' ay wajxaque' b'akhquiltak sk'ek'och t'ay.
Ay jun kuarto junnhej yaj yet' jun korredor chi' t'a junjun puerta. Ata' sb'ikchaj nok' nok' tz'ak'ji silab'il.

Ha t'a korredor t'a sti' puerta chi', ay chanhe' mexa k'een latz'b'ilk'ei, chab'chab' t'a junjun pak'anh. Ha t'a yib'anh juntzanh mexa chi', ata' smiljicham nok' nok' snhusjitz'a masanil silab'il, nok' silab' yik tz'ak'ji tup mul yet' nok' silab' tz'ak'ji stojolok mul.
Ha t'a spatiquel korredor t'a puerta t'a stojolal norte chi', ay chab' k'een k'een icha mexa t'a junjun pak'anh,
syalelk'ochi, ay chanhe' juntzanh k'een chi' t'a yool yet' chanhe' t'a spatiquel jun korredor chi'. Ay wajxaque' mexa chi' t'a smasanil, aton t'a yib'anh juntzanh chi' smiljicham nok' silab'.

Ha chanhe' mexa b'aj smiljicham nok' nok' snhusjitz'a masanil silab'il, a k'een k'een tzeyb'il ayoch t'ay. 75 kentímetro sat schanhil pak'anh, 50 kentímetro schaanhil steel junjun. Ha t'a yib'anh juntzanh chi', ata' tz'ak'jik'e yamk'ab' sk'anchaji ayik smiljicham nok' silab' chi'.

Ha t'a yol jun korredor chi', ay juntzanh k'een gancho lokjab'k'e t'a junjun pak'anh, 25 kentímetro steel junjun k'een. Masanil nok' chib'ej tz'ak'ji silab'il, tz'ak'jik'e nok' t'a yib'anh juntzanh k'een mexa chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix in yik'anoch winh t'a schab'il amak'. Ata' ay chab' kuarto k'elanelta t'a stojolal b'ab'el amak'. Ay jun t'a slak'anil puerta t'a norte, k'elanb'at t'a stojolal sur. Axo pax junxo, ha t'a slak'anil puerta t'a stojolal sur ay, k'elanb'at t'a stojolal norte.
Ix yalan winh t'ayin icha tik: Ha jun kuarto k'elanb'at t'a stojolal sur chi', a heb' winh sakerdote smunlaj t'a templo ay yiko'.

Axo jun kuarto k'elanb'at t'a stojolal norte, yik heb' winh sakerdote smunlaj t'a altar b'aj snhusji nok' silab'. Masanil heb' winh sakerdote yinhtilal winhaj Sadoc, anhej heb' winh t'a skal heb' yinhtilal winhaj Leví syal yak'an serwil t'a yichanh Jehová, xchi jun winh chi' t'ayin.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yechtan jun schab'il amak' winh. Lajannhej yechel schanhil pak'anh, 50 metro yaji. Axo altar b'aj snhusji silab', ha t'a yichanh templo ayeq'ui.

Ix in yik'b'at jun winh winak chi' t'a skorredoral templo, ix yechtan spatiktak jun korredor chi' winh, nanhal yoxil metro spimal. Axo spuertail, uque' metro sat. Ha sattak ay t'a sti' puerta chi', nanhal schab'il metro ayelta t'a junjun pak'anh.
Ha jun korredor chi', lajunhe' metro slewanil, waque' metro yool. B'achquiltak sk'ei. Ay chab' k'een niwak oy t'a sti' spuertail, junjun t'a junjun pak'anh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix in yik'anoch jun winh winak chi' t'a yol jun b'ab'el kuarto yik templo, ix yechtan stitak spuertail chi' winh, oxe' metro spimal junjun.

Axo spuertail, oye' metro sat. Axo sattak ay t'a sti' puerta chi', nanhal yoxil metro ayelta t'a junjun pak'anh. Ixlajwi chi' ix yechtan pax jun b'ab'el kuarto chi' winh, 20 metro steel, 10 metro slewanil.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at yechtan junxo kuarto winh t'a yichochi. Ix yechtan sattak sti' spuertail winh, jun metro spimal. Axo puerta chi', oxe' metro sat, haxo sattak t'a junjun pak'anh sti' puerta chi', nanhal schanhil metro ayelta.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yechtan jun kuarto chi' winh, 10 metro sat schanhil pak'anh. Ix yalan winh t'ayin icha tik: Ha jun kuarto tik, Yicnhej Dios Yaji, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yechtan spimal spatiktak jun templo chi' winh, oxe' metro spimal. Ha t'a spatiktak templo chi', ay juntzanh kuarto, chab' metro yaj yich junjun, junnhej yaj yet' templo chi'.

Ha juntzanh kuarto chi', ayk'e jun t'a yib'anh junxo, oxe' piso yaji, haxo t'a junjun piso, ay 30 kuarto. Axo t'a sattak templo chi' lotzanoch junjun piso. Ha t'a yib'anh juntzanh chi', ata' tz'och spatzab'il junjun kuarto, yuj chi' max ochlaj t'a yool.

Ha juntzanh kuarto ay t'a schab'il piso ayoch t'a spatiktak templo chi', lewan yol t'a yichanh juntzanh ay t'a b'ab'el piso. Axo juntzanhxo t'a yoxil piso, niwan yol t'a yichanh juntzanh t'a schab'il piso chi'. Ay jun k'ooch b'e sk'e t'a b'ab'el piso, sk'e t'a schab'il, masanto sk'ek'och t'a yoxil piso.

Ix wilani to a templo b'ob'ilk'e t'a yib'anh jun yich, oxe' metro schaanhil yajk'e jun yich chi'. Anheja' jun chi' ayoch yichok juntzanh kuarto ay t'a spatiktak templo chi'. Axo jun yich chi' nanhal yoxil metro b'echanel t'a spatiquel juntzanh kuarto chi'. Ay junxo amak' ayoch t'a spatiktak yich templo chi' yet' t'a skal juntzanh skuarto heb' sakerdote, 10 metro sat. Ay spuertail juntzanh kuarto t'a spatiktak templo chi', tz'elul t'a amak' ay t'a spatiktak chi'. Ay jun puerta t'a stojolal norte, ay pax junxo t'a stojolal sur.
Ha t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'a stojolal jun amak' t'a spatiktak templo chi', ay jun niwan kuarto 35 metro sat, 45 metro sk'atul yool. Ha yichtak, nanhal yoxil metro spimal.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yechtan sk'atul templo chi' winh. Ha sk'atul chi' 50 metro. Axo jun amak' t'a spatik templo chi' masanto t'a jun kuarto t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u yet' pax spimal yichtak, 50 metro t'a smasanil.
Ha t'a sat jun templo chi' yet' yamaq'uil sti' ay t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, 50 metro pax jun chi' smasanil.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yechtan sk'atul jun niwan kuarto winh, jun ay t'a spatik templo k'elankot t'a amak' yet' yichtak, 50 metro smasanil. Ha chab' kuarto t'a yol templo yet' skorredoral k'elanb'at t'a amak',

ayoch te' chemte' t'a spatiktak. Ay swentenail yoxil, kotak swentenail chi'. Sb'atnhej te' chemte' t'a ti' puerta masanto t'a yool, aynhejoch te' t'a sat yichtak smasanil. Sb'atnhej te' t'a spisoal, sk'ek'och te' t'a swentenail chi'. Ha juntzanh swentenail chi' ay smakul t'a spatiqueli, xayayi yajochi.
Aypaxoch te' chemte' t'a yichtak t'a yol b'ab'el kuarto t'a yib'anh puerta tz'och t'a yol schab'il kuarto.

Majnaquel sattak te' chemte' chi' yuj yechel heb' querubín yet' pax yechel te' palma. Jun yechel te' palma chi', jun yechel querubín chi', ichanhej chi' yajoch smasanil. Chab'chab' sat junjun querubín chi'.

Ha jun sat, lajan yilji icha sat anima, k'elanoch t'a yechel te' palma chi'. Axo junxo, lajan icha yilji sat nok' choj, k'elanpaxoch t'a junxo yechel te' palma chi'. Ichanhej chi' yajoch t'a yol templo chi'.
Sb'atnhej juntzanh yechel t'a piso masanto t'a jolom puerta.
Ha yoyal spuertail jun b'ab'el kuarto chi', lajan yaj te' schab'il, chanh tzalanh yaj te'. Ha t'a yichanh jun kuarto yiknhej Jehová yaji, ay jun tas lajan wal yilji

icha junok altar nab'a te', jun metro schanhil pak'anh, nanhal schab'il metro yajk'e schaanhil. Ha schiquintak, pax yich yet' spatiktak, nab'a te'. Ix yalan jun winh chi' t'ayin: Aton jun mexa tik ayoch t'a yichanh Jehová, xchi winh.
Ha spuertail b'ab'el kuarto yet' spuertail jun kuarto yiknhej Dios yaji, chab' jenhan yaji.
Axo junjun jenhan chi', chab'chab' makan yaji, ayoch swisagreal t'a snanhal.

Ha t'a sattak spuertail jun b'ab'el kuarto chi', ayoch yechel querubín yet' yechel te' palma. Lajan yilji yet' juntzanh ayoch t'a sattak yichtak chi'. Ha t'a yichanhelta spuertail skorredoral ayk'e spatil nab'a te'.

Ha t'a junjun pak'anh skorredoral chi', ay swentenail kotak sat. Aypaxoch yechel te' palma t'a sattak yichtak chi'. Ha swentenail juntzanh kotak kuarto oyanoch t'a spatik templo chi', ayoch smakul t'a spatik, xayayi yajochi.

Ixlajwi chi', ix in yik'anelta winh t'a amak' t'a spatiktak templo t'a stojolal norte. Ix in yik'anoch winh t'a yol chab' pat t'a spatiquel amak' chi' yet' t'a stojolal norte t'a jun niwan kuarto t'a spatik templo chi'.
Ha chab' pat t'a stojolal norte chi', 50 metro sk'atul, 25 metro sat.

Ha jun pat skan t'a sti' jun amak' ay t'a spatiktak templo chi', 10 metro sat. Axo junxo pat, ha t'a stojolal b'aj latz'b'ilem k'een k'een t'a b'ab'el amak' skani. Oxe' piso yaj junjun pat chi'. Junjun piso sk'ei, yunenhej yool t'a yichanh jun ay t'a yalanh.
Ha t'a skal juntzanh pat chi', ay jun kalle, oye' metro sat, 50 metro steel, tz'ochnhejk'och t'a yolochi. Ha spuertail juntzanh kuarto chi', ha t'a stojolal norte ayochi.
Ha juntzanh kuarto t'a yoxil piso, yunenhej t'a yichanh juntzanhxo t'a schab'il piso ay t'a yalanh, yujto ay skorredoral, yuj chi' yunexonhej yool.

Oxe' piso yaj juntzanh pat chi', palta malaj yoyal icha yoyal juntzanh kuarto ay t'a spatiktak jun b'ab'el amak', yuj chi' a jun piso t'a yib'anh, yunenhej yol t'a yichanh jun ay t'a snanhal, haxo jun snanhal chi' yunenhej t'a yichanh jun ay t'a yalanh.
Ha jun pat ayoch t'a sti' jun b'ab'el amak' chi', tzek' t'a yichanh junxo pat, 25 metro sk'atul, junnhej sb'at k'atan yet' smuroal stitak b'ab'el amak'.
Yujto a jun pat ay t'a stz'ey b'ab'el amak' chi', 25 metronhej sk'atul, haxo pax junxo pat ay t'a spatik templo chi', 50 metro sk'atul.
Ha juntzanh kuarto t'a b'ab'el piso, ay spuertail yik tzonh el t'a b'ab'el amak', t'a jun pak'anh ay t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u,
b'aj tz'elul jun muro t'a sti' amak' chi'. Axo t'a stojolal sur, t'a sti' jun amak' t'a spatiktak templo yet' jun niwan kuarto, ata' ay pax chab'xo pat.
Lajannhej yaj yechel yet' sb'onab'il, icha chab' pat t'a stojolal norte. Lajannhej yaj b'aj tzonh ochi yet' b'aj tzonh eli yet' jun skalleal t'a skal chab' pat chi'.
Ha tzonh och t'a juntzanh kuarto t'a stojolal sur, ay jun puerta b'aj schael yich jun skalleal chi' b'aj tz'elul jun smuroal yich, aton jun muro chi' smakan t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u.

Ix yalan jun winh chi' t'ayin icha tik: Ha jun pat t'a stojolal norte yet' jun ay t'a stojolal sur, aton juntzanh ay t'a stitak amak' t'a spatiktak templo, anhej heb' winh sakerdote ay yiko'. Ata' schi nok' silab' heb' winh to anhej Jehová ay yiko', yujto a heb' winh tz'ak'an serwil Jehová. Ata' syak'paxoch heb' winh juntzanh tas to yik Jehová yaji, aton ixim trigo tz'ak'ji ofrendail, ixim tz'ak'ji yet' nok' silab' tz'ak'ji yuj yak'ji tup mul yet' nok' silab' tz'ak'ji yuj stojolok mul. Ha juntzanh kuarto b'aj tz'ak'ji juntzanh ofrenda chi' yik Jehová yaji.

Tato tz'och heb' winh sakerdote t'a yol templo chi', max yal-laj yel heb' winh t'a jun b'ab'el amak' ayik manto sk'exel spichul heb' winh syak'ochi ayik tz'och heb' winh munlajel t'a yol templo chi'. Yujto a spichul heb' winh chi', niwan yelk'ochi, yuj chi' max yal-laj yel heb' winh t'a skal heb' anima yet'ok. Yowalil ch'ok spichul heb' winh syak'ochi ayik tz'el heb' winh, xchi winh t'ayin.
Ayic ix lajwi yechtan yol templo chi' winh, ix in yik'anelta winh t'a jun puerta ay t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u. Ixlajwi chi' ix och ijan winh yechtan lum spatiktaquel templo chi'.
Ha jun te' aj yet'nak winh, a te' ix yak'lab'ej winh yechtani. Ha jun pak'anh t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, 250 metro yok.
Ix yechtan pax junxo pak'anh winh t'a stojolal norte. Ha jun chi' anheja' 250 metro yok.
Axo pax jun pak'anhxo t'a stojolal sur, anheja' 250 metro yok.
Axo jun slajwub' t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, anheja' 250 metro yok.

Ix yechtejnhej winh schanhil pak'anh. Ha smuroal ayoch t'a spatiktak slumal templo chi', 250 metro junjun pak'anh. Ha jun muro chi' smakankan jun lugar yik Dios yaj chi', haxo spatiquel muro chi', komon yaji.
Ixlajwi chi' ix in yik'anxib'at winh t'a jun puerta t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u.
Ix wilan stziquiquial Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u chi'. Te chaanh sk'anhi, icha sk'anh yem ha' niwak pajaw. Copopi ix aj yilji sat lu'um yuj.
Ha tas ix wil chi', lajan wal icha jun ix wila'' ayik ix jawi Jehová ul yak'an satel Jerusalén, lajan pax icha jun ix wil t'a sti' ha' niwan Quebar. Ix in em lachnaj t'a sat lum yuj.
Ha stziquiquial Jehová chi', ix och t'a yol templo t'a jun puerta t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u.
Yuj chi' ix wab'i to a Yespíritu Dios ix in ik'ank'e waan, ix in yik'anoch t'a jun schab'il amak', ix wilani, b'ud'jinaquel yol templo chi' yuj stziquiquial Jehová chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix wab'ani, ato t'a yol templo chi' ay jun mach ix lolonelta t'ayin. Axo jun winh winak chi' linhanoch winh t'a in tz'ey.

Ix yalan icha tik: Ach anima, aton jun lugar tik b'aj ay in despacho, b'aj ol wak' reyal. Ha tik ol in kajnaj t'a junelnhej t'a he kal a ex israel ex tik. Ha ex tik yet' heb' he reyal, manhxo ol in he patiquejel-laj yuj eyoch ejmelal t'a komon Dios yet' he mukan heb' he reyal t'a slak'anil in templo tik, icha he k'ulejnak t'a pekataxo.

Ha pekatax chi' sb'onakk'e spalakio heb' t'a stz'ey in templo. Junnhej muro aykan t'a skal spuertail in templo yet' spuertail spalakio heb' chi'. Ix in alji chukal yuj schukal sb'eyb'al heb' yajb'entak t'a yol in sat. Yuj chi' ix kot wowal t'a heb', ix in satanel heb'.
Axo tiknaik yaktejokab' heb' yoch ejmelal t'a skomon diosal, syaktanpax heb' smukan heb' sreyal t'a in tz'ey, yik ol in kajnaj t'a skal heb' t'a junelnhej.
Ha tiknaik ach anima, al t'a heb' etisraelal chajtil yaj templo ix ila', yik wach' scham yilan heb', yik sq'uixwi heb' yuj schukal.

Tato ol q'uixwok heb' yuj tas sk'ulej chi', tzalan t'a heb' chajtil yaj in templo yet' tastak ay t'a yool, chajtil yaj spuertail. Syalelk'ochi, chajtil yaj templo chi' smasanil, tas yaj pax juntzanh scheknab'ilal yowalil sk'anab'ajaji. Tz'ib'ej yechel masanil juntzanh chi', yik wach' ol nachajel yuj heb' sik'lab'il yik ol sb'o heb' icha yaj chi'. Tza tz'ib'anpax masanil juntzanh cheknab'il yik sk'anab'ajej heb'.
Aton wal juntzanh tik cheknab'il yuj in templo: Masanil lum tzalan t'a spatiktak templo chi', junelnhej to wik yaj lu'um, xchi Jehová t'ayin.

Ha juntzanh echlab' ix k'anchaj t'a templo, ha' ix k'anchaj pax t'a yechel jun altar t'a yamaq'uil templo chi'. Aton yechel jun altar chi': Ha kimientoal yich, nanhal metro ayem t'a yol lum, nanhal pax metro yajel t'a spatik yichanh. Axo t'a sti' jun ayel chi' ay jab'xo tzalank'e t'a stitak, 25 kentímetro yajk'ei.

Ha jantak yajk'e jun b'ab'el b'akhanh skot t'a yich, jun metro yajk'ei, nanhal metro yajel t'a spatik b'aj sb'at junxo b'akhanh. Axo jun schab'il b'akhanh chi', chab' metro yajk'ei, nanhal metro yajel t'a spatik b'aj sb'at junxo b'akhanh. Axo jun yoxil b'akhanh chi' anheja' chab' metro yajk'ei,
aton ta' snhusjitz'a silab'. Ha jun chi', chab' metro yajk'e schaanhil. Ay schiquintak t'a junjun yesquinail, chaanh yajk'e t'a yib'anh b'aj stz'a silab' chi'.
Ha jun chi' waque' metro junjun pak'anh.
Axo schab'il b'akhanh, uque' metro junjun pak'anh. Axo t'a stitak, ay jab'xo tzalank'ei, 25 kentímetro yajk'ei. Axo sk'oochal sk'ek'och t'a altar chi', ha t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u skani.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan jun winh winak chi' t'ayin: Ach anima, a Jehová Yajal tz'alan icha tik: Ayic b'ob'ilxo jun altar chi', yowalil sk'anab'ajaj juntzanh cheknab'il tik: Snhusjitz'a junok nok' nok' silab'il t'a yib'anh, stzikchajoch schiq'uil nok' t'ay.
Ha in Jehová in swala' to ha t'a heb' sakerdote lewita yinhtilal Sadoc, aton heb' tz'och t'a wichanh in yak'an serwil, syak'an junok nok' quelem wakax heb' silab'il yuj yak'ji tup mul.

Slajwi chi', syik'ank'e jab'ok schiq'uil nok' heb', stzikanoch heb' t'a schiquintak altar chi' schanhil yet' t'a schiquintak yik schab'il b'akhanh yich yet' t'a spatiktak yich altar chi' smasanil. Icha chi' tz'aj sakb'ikan jun altar chi' yik tz'ochkan wikok.
Slajwi chi' syik'anel nok' wakax chi' heb', nok' tz'ak'ji silab'il chi', snhusantz'a nok' heb' t'a spatiquel templo t'a jun lugar chequel yaji.

Axo t'a junxo k'u, snhusantz'a junok nok' chiwa heb', junok nok' malaj jab'ok spaltail yuj yak'ji tup mul. Icha chi' tz'aj sakb'itan jun altar chi' heb' sakerdote chi', icha syutej heb' yet' nok' wakax.
Ayic slajwi juntzanh chi', syik'ankot junok nok' quelem wakax heb' yet' junok nok' ch'ak kalnel, malajokab' jab'ok spaltail nok' schawanhil.
Icha chi' tz'aj yik'ankot nok' heb' t'ayin. Syak'anoch yatz'amil nok' heb', snhusantz'a nok' heb' yuj in yik'anchaanh.

Uque' k'ual snhustz'a nok' silab' chi' heb', syak'anpax junok nok' chiwa heb' silab'il, junok nok' quelem wakax yet' junok nok' ch'ak kalnel yuj yak'ji tup mul. Malajokab' jab'ok spaltail nok' yoxwanhil.
Ichanhej chi' sk'ulej heb' t'a uque' k'ual chi', yuj sakb'itan jun altar chi' heb' yik tz'ochkan wikok.

Axo slajwi yuquil k'ual chi', haxo t'a swajxaquil k'ual yet' sb'eynhejb'ati, syak'nhej nok' silab' chi' heb', nok' stz'a smasanil yet' silab' yik junk'olal. Ichato chi' a in Jehová in swala' to tzex in cha t'a tzalajk'olal, xchi Jehová, xchi winh t'ayin.
Ix in yik'xib'at winh t'a spuertail templo t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u. Ix wilani, makan jun puerta chi'.
Ata' ix yal Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ha jun puerta tik, ol kannhej makan, malaj b'ak'uinh ol jakchajok. Malaj mach ol yal yoch t'ay, yujto ha t'a jun tik ix in och a in sDiosal in Israel tik.

Anhej winh yajalil chonhab' syal sk'och wael ta' yik schi'an nok' silab' winh t'a wichanh. Ha t'a korredor tz'och winh, tz'ochk'och winh t'a jun b'ab'el amak', anheja' ata' stz'elxita winh, xchi Jehová chi' t'ayin.

Ixlajwi chi' ix in yik'anb'at jun winh winak chi' t'a jun puerta t'a stojolal norte t'a yichanh templo. Ix wilani ix b'ud'jiel yol templo chi' yuj stziquiquial Jehová. Ayic ix wilan jun chi' ix in em lachnaj t'a sat lu'um.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ach anima, scham wal ilani, schampax ab'an sleyal jun templo tik. Scham wal ilani mach heb' syal yoch t'a yol templo tik, mach pax heb' max yal yochi.
Al t'a heb' etisraelal chi' to a in Jehová in swal icha tik: Ex in chonhab' Israel, te pit ex, aktejek he b'eyb'alan tas yajb'entak.

Ha ex tik ix eyixtejb'at in templo. Comonxonhej ix he chaoch heb' ch'ok chonhab'il t'a yool, aton juntzanh anima malaj yechel in trato t'a spensar yet' t'a sniwanil. Ix eyixtejb'at eyak'an silab' t'ayin, aton xepual nok' silab' yet' schiq'uil nok', palta max he k'anab'ajej in trato, haxo tas yajb'entak tze k'ulej.
Maj he k'anab'ajej in cheknab'il yuj tas wik yaji, palta to ix eyaktejkan eyopisio chi' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, xchi Jehová, xa chi.
Yuj chi' a in Jehová in swal icha tik: Manhxa b'ak'uinh ol och junok anima ch'ok chonhab'il t'a in templo, aton heb' kajan t'a he kal, heb' manh ayokoch yechel in trato t'a spensar yet' t'a sniwanil.
Ha heb' lewita ix in aktankani ayik in yaktankan masanil heb' yetisraelal heb', yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios, ol scha spak heb' yuj schukal chi'.

Syal smunlaj heb' yik stanhwej spuertail in templo yet' t'a junokxo munlajel t'a in templo chi'. Syal smilancham nok' silab' heb', aton nok' snhusjitz'a silab'il t'ayin yet' juntzanhxo nok' silab' syak' heb' chonhab'. Yowalil b'ekan sk'ol heb' yak'an serwil heb' yetchonhab' chi'.

Ha t'a yalanhtaxo yak'nak serwil heb' yetisraelal heb' yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios. Icha chi' ix aj skuchb'an heb' yetisraelal heb' chi' t'a chukal. Yuj chi' a in Jehová Yajal in swak' in ti' to ol scha spak heb' yuj smul chi'.

Max yal-laj yoch heb' t'a wichanh in yak'an serwil t'a sakerdoteal, max yalpaxlaj syaman juntzanh tas niwak yelk'och heb', aton juntzanh wik yaji. Yowalil ol jawok q'uixwelal t'a yib'anh heb' yuj schukalil sk'ulejnak chi'.
Ha tiknaik, ol wak'och heb' stanhwumalok in templo, masanil komon munlajel ol wak' sb'o heb' ta'.

Palta a heb' sakerdote lewita, yinhtilal winhaj Sadoc, a heb' chi' ix in yak'nhej serwil heb', wach'chom a heb' yetisraelal heb' ix in yaktejkan heb'. Yuj chi' a in Jehová Yajal in swala' to anhej heb' chi' syal sk'och t'a wichanh yik tzin yak'an serwil. Syal yoch heb' t'a wichanh yik syak' xepual nok' nok' yet' schiq'uil nok' silab'il t'ayin.
Anhej heb' syal yoch t'a yol in templo yik tzin yak'an serwil heb' t'a tastak ay t'a yol templo chi'. Anhej heb' syal yilan in munlajel ta'.
Ayic tz'och heb' t'a spuertail schab'il amak', yowalil a pichul lino syak'och heb'. Ayic ayoch heb' t'a yopisio ta', ma t'a yol templo, max yal-laj a pichul lana syak'och heb'.
Yowalil ayk'e sk'ox heb' nab'a lino. Yowalil lino pax yol swex heb' ayochi. Mokab' stzek' snanhal heb' t'a junok tas tz'ik'an yel yalil.

Ayic manto elta heb' t'a b'ab'el amak', b'aj ayek' heb' yetchonhab' heb', yowalil syik'kanel spichul heb' sk'an t'a yopisio t'a yol templo chi', skan t'a yol juntzanh kuarto t'a yool chi'. Axo junxo spichul heb' syak'ochi yik wach' max ochkan smay jun pichul chi' t'a heb' ayek' chi'.
Max sjoxel-laj t'ab'an sjolom heb'. Scha q'uib' xil sjolom heb' chi', anhej snhitak sjoxel heb'.
Malaj junok heb' sakerdote chi' tz'uk'an wino ayik tz'och t'a schab'il amak'.

Max yal yik'an heb' ix ix chamnakxo yetb'eyum heb', ma heb' ix aktab'ilkan yuj yetb'eyum, palta anhej junok ix yetisraelal heb' kob'esto syik'a', ma junok ix yetb'eyum junok yetsakerdoteal heb' chamnakxo.
Ha heb' sakerdote chi', yowalil sk'ayb'ej heb' in chonhab' heb' yik syojtaquejel heb' tas sik'b'ilel wuuj yet' tas manh sik'b'iloquel wuuj, tas wach' yet' tas manh wach'ok, icha yalan ley.
Anheja', tato ay b'aj tz'och owal, a heb' sb'oani icha yalan ley. Yowalil sk'anab'ajej sleyal juntzanh in q'uinh heb', sk'anab'ajej pax jun sk'ual ik'oj ip heb', aton jun k'u wik yaji.

Malaj b'ak'uinh syam junok sniwanil chamnak heb' yik max yixtejb'at sb'a heb', icha yalan ley. Anhej tato a smam snun heb', ma junok yuninal heb', ma yisil heb', ma junok yuk'tak heb', ma junok yanab' heb' kob'esto schami, syal syaman heb'.
Slajwi chi' yowalil sakb'itej sb'a heb' icha yalan ley, uque' k'ual maxtzak ochlaj heb' munlajel t'a yol in templo chi'.
Ayic tz'ochxi heb' t'a yol in templo chi' yik smunlajxi heb', a in Jehová in swala', yowalil syak' junok nok' silab' heb' yuj stupil smul.
Malaj junok smakb'en heb' sakerdote syik' t'a he chonhab', ichato a in ayin och smakb'enok heb'.

Ha swael heb' sakerdote chi', aton tas tz'ak'ji t'ayin yuj heb' eyetchonhab' yet' nok' silab' tz'ak'ji t'ayin yuj yak'ji tup mul yet' nok' tz'ak'ji stojolok mul yet' masanil silab' syak' heb' yetisraelal heb' t'ayin. Ha juntzanh chi', yiknhej heb' sakerdote chi' yaji.

Ha heb' sakerdote chi', a b'ab'el sat awb'en te wach', yowalil scha heb' yet' masanil tas tz'ak'ji t'ayin. Ayic sb'oan ixim pan heb' in chonhab', a ixim b'ab'el sb'oi, a ixim syak' heb' t'a heb' sakerdote chi' yik wach' swak' in wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh heb'.
Ha heb' sakerdote chi', max yal-laj schi'an junok nok' much heb', ma junokxo nok' nok' skomon chami, mato milb'ilcham yuj nok' chium nok'.

Ayic tz'och suerte yik spukchajek' lum lum t'a junjun inhtilal, yowalil ch'ok tz'ik'chajkanel jab'ok lu'um wik tz'ajkan a in Jehová in tik, 12 kilómetro yet' nanhalxo steel lu'um, oye' kilómetro sat lu'um. Masanil jun lum chi', wik tz'ajkan lu'um. Ha t'a snanhal lum chi', ata' tz'ik'jikanel junok makan lum b'aj skan templo, 250 metro tz'aj lum t'a schanhil pak'anh. Ha t'a spatiktak lum chi' skan pax jab'ok lum kolan tz'ajkani, 25 metro sat.
Ha jun makan lum chi' yik heb' sakerdote smunlaj t'a templo tz'aj lu'um, aton heb' tz'och t'a wichanh in yak'an serwil. Ata' syal sb'oank'e spat heb' t'a spatiktak in templo chi'.

Anheja' tz'ik'chajkanel junxo makan lum lum, 12 kilómetro yet' nanhalxo steel, oye' kilómetro sat. Ha jun lum chi', yik heb' lewita tz'ajkan lu'um, aton heb' smunlaj t'a templo yik wach' ay b'aj sb'ok'e spat heb' b'aj skajnaji.

Axo t'a skostil lum wik yaji, yowalil skan junxo makan lu'um. Ha jun lum chi' yik chonhab' tz'ajkan lu'um. 12 kilómetro yet' nanhalxo tz'aj steel lu'um, nanhal yoxil kilómetro tz'aj sat lu'um, yik chonhab' Israel tz'ajkan lu'um.

Anhejtona', ay chab' makan lum lum, yik winh yajal tz'ajkan lu'um. Ay jun makan lum skan t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, haxo junxo makan lu'um, ha t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u skan lu'um, syalelk'ochi aton t'a stz'ey lum wik yaji yet' t'a stz'ey lum yik heb' chonhab'. Lajan tz'aj steel lu'um yet' lum yik junjun inhtilal.
Ha jun makan lu'um chi' yik winh yajal Israel tz'ajkan lu'um. Yuj chi', a lum yik heb' in chonhab', manhxo ol yik'ek' lum heb' winh yajal heb' chi', palta ol kan lum t'a junjun makan inhtilal.

Ha in Jehová Yajal in swala': Ex yajal Israel, manhxo eyixtej heb' in chonhab', wach'nhejokab' tzeyutej he b'a, tojolnhej tzeyutej he ch'olb'itan junok tasi. Actejec he tok'anek' lum slum heb' in chonhab'.
Ha echlab' te tz'akan tze k'ana'.

Ha eyechlab' tze k'an t'a sat eyawb'en, lajanokab' yool yet' eyechlab' tze k'an t'a tas ha' yaji. Ha niwan echlab', aton homer, 220 litro yool, a tz'ak'an yechel masanil echlab'. Ha jun homer chi', lajunhe' bato ha' tz'em t'a yool, lajunhe' pax efa sat awb'en tz'em t'ay.
Anheja' pax tas tz'echtaj yalil: Ha 20 gera, lajan yalil yet' jun kiklo, haxo pax 60 kiklo lajan yalil yet' jun mina.
Aton juntzanh ofrenda tik yowalil syak' heb' etisraelal: Ha ixim he trigo yet' ixim he kebada 60 makan tzeyutej ixim. Jun makan ixim tzeyak'a'.
Icha pax chi' tzeyutej eyakeite, 100 makan tzeyutej. Jun makan tzeyak'paxi.

Axo pax nok' kalnel swa b'aj yax anh ank'ultak t'a yol yik Israel, jun nok' tzeyik'el t'a skal 200 ok nok'. Ha in Jehová in swala', masanil juntzanh tik ol k'anchaj t'a ofrendail yet' t'a silab' stz'ai yet' t'a silab' yik junk'olal yet' silab' yuj yak'ji tup smul heb' in chonhab' Israel.
Yowalil masanil in chonhab' Israel tz'ak'an juntzanh ofrenda chi' t'a winh yajal yaj t'a skal heb'.

Ha winh yajal chi' tz'ak'an nok' nok' stz'a silab'il yet' ixim trigo ofrendail yet' wino tz'ak'ji ayik tz'alji k'een uj, t'a k'ual ik'oj ip yet' t'a juntzanh niwak q'uinh wik yaji. Yowalil syak' pax silab' winh yik stup mul, ixim trigo ofrendail, silab' stz'ai, silab' yik junk'olal yik wach' tz'ak'ji tup schukalil heb' yinhtilal Israel.
Ha in Dios Yajal in swala': Ha t'a b'ab'el k'u yik b'ab'el uj, yowalil tzeyak' junok nok' quelem wakax malaj spaltail yik sakb'ikan in templo.

Ha winh sat sakerdote tz'ik'ank'e jab'ok schiq'uil nok' wakax chi', aton nok' ix ak'ji silab'il yuj yak'ji tup mul, sukanoch schiq'uil nok' winh t'a smarkoal spuertail in templo, t'a spatiktak schiquintak schanhil yet' t'a yoxmakanhil yich altar chaanh ayk'ei yet' t'a smarkoal spuertail chab'il amak'.
Anheja' icha chi' tz'aj pax t'a yuquil k'ual, yuj yalnhej mach tz'och smul to manh sk'anok sk'ool, mato manh yojtakok tato wan yoch smul. Icha chi' tz'aj sakb'ikanel in templo chi'.
Ayic 14 yoch b'ab'el uj, tze chaanel yich q'uinh yik tze naankot tas ajnak eyelta t'a Egipto. Uque' k'ual tze wa ixim pan malaj yich.
Ha t'a jun k'ual chi', a winh yajal, yowalil syak' junok nok' quelem wakax winh silab'il yuj smul, yuj pax yik masanil heb' chonhab'.

Ha t'a junjun k'u t'a uque' k'ual q'uinh chi', yowalil syak' ukwanh nok' kelemtak wakax winh yajal chi' yet' ukwanhok nok' ch'ak kalnel, aton nok' malaj jab'ok spaltail. Snhusjitz'a nok' silab'il t'ayin. Tz'ak'jipax junok nok' mam chiwa t'a junjun k'u silab'il yuj yak'chaj tup mul.
Ha yet' junjun nok' wakax chi' yet' junjun nok' kalnel chi', tz'ak'jipax 40 libraok ixim trigo yet' nanhal schanhil litrook akeite.

Anhejpaxa' t'a uque' k'ual q'uinh yik chinama, aton jun q'uinh schael yich t'a 15 yoch yuquil uj, a winh yajal chi' yowalil syak'nhej silab' winh. Lajan sb'isul nok' silab' chi' syak' winh t'a junjun k'u, icha nok' syak' winh t'a q'uinh yik tze naankot tas ajnak eyelta t'a Egipto, aton nok' tz'ak'ji yuj stupchaj mul, nok' tz'ak'ji silab'il yet' ixim trigo yet' akeite ofrendail.

Ha in Jehová Yajal in swala': Ha jun spuertail schab'il amak' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, ha t'a waque' k'ual munlajel, yowalil makannhej, anhej t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip sjakwi yet' t'a sk'ual yik tz'alji k'een uj.

Ha winh yajal chi' tz'och winh t'a jun puerta t'a b'ab'el amak', tz'och winh t'a jun korredor t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u. Tz'och linhan winh t'a smarkoal jun puerta chi', yakb'an wan snhusantz'a nok' silab' heb' sakerdote yet' nok' silab' yik junk'olal syak' winh. Slajwi chi' tz'och winh ejmelal t'ayin b'aj ayek' chi', ichato chi' tz'el winh t'a korredor chi', palta skannhej jakan jun puerta chi', masanto wanxo sq'uik'b'i smakchaji.
Axo t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip yet' t'a yik tz'alji k'een uj, yowalil tzul och heb' chonhab' ejmelal t'ayin, t'a yichanh jun puerta chi'.
Ha nok' silab' yowalil syak' winh yajal chi' t'ayin yik snhusjitz'ha t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip, wakwanh nok' kelemtak kalnel yet' jun nok' ch'ak kalnel, malajokab' jab'ok spaltail nok' yukwanhil.

Yowalil syak' 40 libraok ixim harina winh yet' nok' ch'ak kalnel chi'. Axo yet' nok' kelemtak kalnel chi', ato ha' jantak tz'el t'a sk'ol winh yak'ani. Ha yet' 40 libraok ixim harina, syak' pax nanhal schanhil litro akeite winh.
Axo t'a sk'ual ayik tz'alji k'een uj, yowalil syak' junok nok' quelem wakax winh, wakwanhok nok' kelemtak kalnel yet' junok nok' ch'ak kalnel. Masanil juntzanh nok' chi', malajokab' spaltail nok'.

Ha yet' nok' quelem wakax chi' syak' 40 libraok ixim harina winh. Icha pax chi' tz'aj yak'an jun nok' ch'ak kalnel chi' winh. Axo pax yet' nok' kelemtak kalnel chi', yalnhej jantak tz'el t'a sk'ol winh yak'ani. Axo yet' junjun 40 libraok ixim harina chi', syak' nanhal schanhil litro akeite winh.
Ayic tz'och winh yajal t'a spuertail schab'il amak' chi', tz'och winh t'a korredor chi', anheja' ta' tz'elxi winh.

Ayic tzul och heb' chonhab' ejmelal t'ayin t'a junjun q'uinh, yowalil a tik sk'ulej heb': Ha mach tz'och t'a b'ab'el amak' t'a spuertail, t'a stojolal norte, ha t'a puerta t'a stojolal sur tz'elxi. Axo mach tz'och t'a puerta t'a stojolal sur chi', ha t'a puerta t'a stojolal norte chi' tz'elxi. Malaj junok mach smeltzajxiel t'a puerta b'aj ix ochi, palta to tz'el t'a junxo puerta k'elankot b'aj ix och chi'.
Ha winh yajal chi', yowalil tz'och winh yet' heb' chonhab', tz'el pax winh yet' heb'.

Ha t'a niwak q'uinh yet' sk'ual molanil, syak' 40 libraok ixim harina winh yajal chi' yet' junjun nok' kelemtak wakax. Icha pax chi' ixim syak' winh yet' junjun nok' ch'ak kalnel. Axo pax yet' junjun nok' kelemtak kalnel, yalnhej jantak tz'el t'a skol winh yak'ani. Ha yet' junjun 40 libraok ixim harina chi', syak' pax nanhalok schanhil litro akeite winh.

Ayic tz'el t'a sk'ol winh yajal chi' yak'an junok nok' silab' t'ayin, junok nok' snhusjitz'aok, ma junok nok' yik junk'olal, yowalil sjakchaj puerta t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, syak'an silab' winh chi', icha syak' winh t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip. Slajwi chi' tz'elxita winh t'a puerta chi', ichato chi' smakchajxikani.

Junjun q'uinhib'alil t'a junjun k'u syak' silab' winh yajal chi' t'ayin. Yowalil syak' junok nok' quelem kalnel winh, yik snhusjitz'a nok' silab'il t'ayin, jun ab'il sk'inal nok', malaj jab'ok spaltail nok'. Ha yet' jun nok' quelem kalnel chi', syak' pax 14 libraok ixim harina winh yet' junok litro akeite sekchajem t'a yib'anh ixim. Ha jun tik, yowalil sk'anab'ajej winh t'a masanil tiempo.
Ha in Jehová Yajal in swala': Tato a winh yajal chi' siej jab'ok lum smakb'en t'a junok yuninal, a jun lum chi' tz'ochkan smakb'enok yuninal chi'.

Palta tato a winh yajal chi' siej jab'ok lum t'a junok schekab' yik smakb'enej, masanto sjawi ab'il yik tz'el tas t'a libre, ichato chi' syik'anxi lum winh yajal chi'. Axo skan lum smakb'enok heb' yuninal winh.

Ha winh yajal chi', malaj yalan yik winh stok'anek' smakb'en junokxo anima. Ha lum sluum winh, a lum syak' winh smakb'enok heb' yuninal. Icha chi', malaj heb' malaj smakb'en skan t'a skal in chonhab', xchi Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi', ix in yik'anb'at jun winh winak chi' t'a yoloch sti' jun puerta, t'a chab' pat yik heb' sakerdote skan t'a stojolal norte. Ix sch'oxan winh t'ayin t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'a spatik chab' pat chi'.

Ix yalan winh t'ayin icha tik: Aton t'a tik yowalil ol stz'anh nok' silab' heb' sakerdote tz'ak'ji silab'il yuj yak'ji tup mul, ma yuj stojolok mul. Ha t'a tik ol b'ochaj pax ixim harina tz'ak'ji ofrendail. Icha chi', max ik'chajel juntzanh tastak chi' t'a b'ab'el amak', yik wach' max ochkan stziquiquial juntzanh tas yik Dios yaj t'a heb' anima, xchi winh t'ayin.
Ixlajwi chi', ix in yik'anelta winh t'a jun b'ab'el amak', ix in yik'anek' winh t'a schanhil pak'anh.
Ix wilan t'a junjun schiquintak amak' chi', ay juntzanhxo yunetak amak'. Lajan yechel schanhil. 20 metro steel, 15 metro sat.
Ha t'a spatiktak juntzanh yunetak amak' chi', ayk'e jun muro nab'a k'een, haxo t'a yichtak jun muro chi', ayk'e b'aj tz'och k'ak'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh t'ayin icha tik: Aton t'a juntzanh kusinu tik stz'anh nok' silab' heb' smunlaj t'a templo tik, aton silab' syak' heb' chonhab', xchi winh t'ayin.

Ixlajwi chi', ix in yik'anoch winh t'a spuertail templo t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u. Axo ix wilani, ay jun ha ha' sk'eul t'a yalanh sti' puerta chi'. Ha jun ha ha' chi' sb'atkan ha' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, t'a ko wach' ayik tzonh elta t'a templo chi', tzek' ha' t'a stojolal sur t'a jun altar.

Ixlajwi chi', ix in yik'anelta winh t'a spatik b'ab'el amak' chi', t'a jun puerta t'a stojolal norte. Ix b'at woyan in b'ha t'a spatik amak' chi' yuj winh, masanto t'a jun puerta t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u. Ix wilani, ay jun ha' yune' ha' sk'eul t'a stojolal sur t'a jun puerta chi'.

Ha jun winh chi', ix b'at winh t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, yet'nak jun ch'anh ch'anh winh yik echlab'. Ix yechtan 500 metro winh, ix in yik'anek' winh t'a yol ha ha' chi', ha t'a sjaj wok ix k'eul ha'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yechtanxi 500 metroxo winh, ix in yik'anxi ek' winh t'a yol ha'. Axo t'a sjolom in penek ix k'eul ha'. Ix yechtanxi 500 metroxo winh, ix in yik'anxi ek' winh t'a yol ha'. Axo t'a in nanhal ix k'ek'och ha'.
Ix yechtanxi 500 metroxo winh. Ha ha' chi' te niwan ix aj ha', manhxalaj mach syal sk'axpaj t'a yol ha'. Te jul ix aj yich ha', syal queq'ui, palta toxonhej sko mak'a'.
Ix yalan winh t'ayin: Ach anima, scham wal a naan tas ix il tik, xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix in yik'anxikot winh t'a stitak ha ha' chi'.
Axo ix wilani, manhxo jantakok te te' ay t'a stitak ha' chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalanxi winh t'ayin: Ha jun ha' tik, sb'at ha' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, sb'atnhej ha' t'a sch'olanil ha' Jordán, sb'atkan ha' t'a yol ha' mar Muerto. Ayic ol k'och ha' t'a yol ha' chi', ol chib'okk'e ha' mar chi' yuj ha'.

Yalxonhej b'aj ol k'och jun ha' tik, wach' ol kajnaj masanil makanhil nok' nok' t'a yol ha', manhxo jantakok nok' chay ol q'uib'ok. Yujto a jun ha' tik, ol chib'okk'e ha ha' k'achi' yuj ha', ol te q'uib' tastak ay sk'inal t'a yol ha'.

Tzijtum heb' yamum chay ol aj t'a sti' ha'. Ha t'a En-gadi masanto t'a En-eglaim ol yak' takjok schimpa heb' yamum chay chi'. Manhxo jantakok makanhil nok' chay ol q'uib' t'ha ha', icha smakanhil schayil ha' mar Mediterráneo.
Axo pax stitak ha' sok'omtak, ma b'aj ay ha' kotak nhajab', manh ol chib'oklaj ha', ata' ay ha ha' k'achi', ata' ol yik'k'eta yatz'am anima.

Ha t'a stitak ha ha' chi', ol q'uib'k'e masanil makanhil te te' sloji sat. Ha te te' chi', malaj b'ak'uinh sk'ajb'anem xiil te'. Manh ol yaktejpax yak'an sat te'. Junjun uj syak'nhej sat te', yujto ha ha' tz'elta t'a templo ayoch yalok te'. Ha sat te' chi', ol lochajok, haxo xil te' ol och remeyoal, xchi winh t'ayin.
Ix yalan Jehová Yajal t'ayin icha tik: Aton stz'akanhil lum lum ol scha' lajchawe' makan heb' yinhtilal Israel smakb'enok. (Ha heb' yinhtilal winhaj José cha makan smakb'en heb' ol yik'a'.
Ha in ix wak' in ti' wak'an jun lum tik t'a heb' he mam yicham. Lajannhej tz'aj he pukanek' lum t'a he kal he lajchawe' inhtilal. Aton jun lum tik ol wak' he makb'enok.)
Aton stz'akanhil lum tik t'a jun pak'anh t'a stojolal norte: Schael t'ha ha' mar Mediterráneo, sk'och t'a chonhab' Hetlón yet' t'a chonhab' Zedad,
Hamat, Berota yet' Sibraim, aton ay t'a skal stz'akanhil Damasco yet' Hamat masanto sk'och t'a Hazar-hatikón, aton stz'akanh sb'a yet' Haurán.
Yuj chi', a stz'akanhil lu'um schael t'ha ha' mar Mediterráneo masanto sk'och t'a Hazar-enán. Axo t'a norte skan lum yik chonhab' Damasco yet' lum yik Hamat.

Axo stz'akanhil lum t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, aton tik: Tz'ek' t'a stitak lum yik chonhab' Haurán yet' yik Damasco. Sb'atnhej t'a stitak ha' Jordán, aton ha' chi' tz'akanh yaj t'a skal chonhab' Galaad yet' Israel, masanto sk'och t'a chonhab' Tamar t'a stojolal sur t'a yik ha' mar Muerto.
Axo pax stz'akanhil lum t'a stojolal sur, aton tik: Schael t'a chonhab' Tamar, tzek' t'a sjajtak ha' Meriba-kades yet' t'ha ha' eluma' yik Egipto, masanto sk'och t'ha ha' Mediterráneo.

Axo pax t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, ha ha' mar Mediterráneo ayoch stz'akanhilok lu'um. Schael t'a stz'akanhil yik Egipto tzek'nhej t'a sti' ha' mar chi' masanto sk'och b'aj tzonh och t'a chonhab' Hamat.
Aton jun lum tik yowalil spukchajek' t'a he kal junjun makan ex yinhtilal Israel ex tik.
Ha lum ol eyik' yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal, aton heb' ayxo yuninal. Ayic ol he pukanek' lu'um t'a he kal, lajan lum yik heb' ch'ok chonhab'il chi' ol yik' eyed'ok.
Ha in Jehová Yajal in swala' to a heb' ch'ok chonhab'il chi', ol scha' smakb'en heb' yalnhej b'aj kajan t'a skal junjun inhtilal chi'.

Ha stz'akanhil Israel t'a norte, schael t'ha ha' mar Mediterráneo, tzek' t'a Hetlón yet' b'aj tz'och b'e t'a Hamat yet' t'a Hazar-enán, tzek' t'a stojolal sur t'a lum yik Damasco yet' Hamat chi'. Junjun makan yinhtilal Israel scha junok makan lum lum smakb'enok, sb'at stz'akanhil lum t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, masanto sk'och t'ha ha' mar Mediterráneo, t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u. Icha tik ol aj schaan lum smakb'en heb' chi' t'a stzolal, schael yich t'a norte skotnhej t'a sur: Dan, Aser, Neftalí, Manasés, Efraín, Rubén yet' Judá.

Ha t'a stz'ey lum smakb'en Judá, ata' ay jun lum sik'b'ileli: 12 kilómetro yet' nanhalxo sat lu'um. Axo steel lu'um, lajan yet' steel lum smakb'en junjun inhtilal, skot t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u masanto t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u. Ha t'a snanhal lum chi', ata' ay in templo.
Ha t'a jun lum lum wik yaj chi', ay jun makan lu'um, 12 kilómetro yet' nanhalxo steel lu'um, oye' kilómetro pax sat lu'um. Ha t'a snanhal lum chi', ata' ay in templo.

Ha jun lum chi', yik lum heb' sakerdote ayoch in yak'an serwil, aton heb' yinhtilal winhaj Sadoc, heb' maj tzak'laj t'a spatik heb' yetisraelal ayik in yaktankan heb', icha ix yutej sb'a heb' yetlewitail heb'.

Ha t'a sti' lum yik heb' sakerdote chi', ata' ay lum yik heb' lewita. Ha lum chi', 12 kilómetro yet' nanhalxo steel lu'um, oye' kilómetro pax sat lu'um. Ha lum wik yaj chi', 12 kilómetro yet' nanhalxo steel lu'um, 10 kilómetro sat lu'um.

Ha jun makan lum chi' anhej lum te wach' t'a yol nakión chi'. Malaj junok makan lum chi' syal schonhchajeli. Max yal-laj sk'exchaj lu'um, max yalpaxlaj yak'chaj lum t'a junokxo anima, yujto wik yaj lu'um.

Ay junxo makan lu'um t'a skostil lum wik yaj chi', 12 kilómetro yet' nanhalxo steel lu'um, nanhal yoxil kilómetro sat lu'um, komon yaj lu'um. Ha t'a snanhal yol lum chi', ata' ay niwan chonhab'. Axo jantakto lum kolan skani, syal skajnaj anima, syal pax swa nok' nok' ta'. Ha jun chonhab' chi', 2 mil 250 metro schanhil pak'anh. Ha t'a spatiktak chonhab' chi', ay jab'xo lum lum oyaneq'ui, 125 metro sat lu'um. Ha nok' nok' swa t'a jab'xo lum lum chi'. Ha t'a jun pak'an t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a jun chonhab' chi', ay jun makan lum lum, oye' kilómetro steel lu'um. Anheja' t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, ay pax junxo makan lu'um, oye' kilómetro pax steel lu'um. Ha t'a juntzanh lum chi' smunlaj anima ay t'a chonhab' chi', haxo sat yawb'en heb' smolo', a syab'lej heb'.
Yalnhej mach anima t'a yik junjun makan yinhtilal Israel smunlaj t'a yol chonhab' chi', syal smunlaj heb' t'a chab' makan lum chi'.
Masanil lum wik yaji yet' lum yik jun niwan chonhab' ay t'a snanhal jun lum sik'b'ilkanel chi', 12 kilómetro yet' nanhalxo lum t'a schanhil pak'anh.

Ha winh yajal chonhab' chi', a winh tz'ikan lum aykan t'a snanhal lum smakb'en Judá yet' lum smakb'en Benjamín, syalelk'ochi, aton lum ay t'a stz'eytak lum wik yaji yet' t'a stz'ey lum yik chonhab'. Ay jun makan lu'um t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, 12 kilómetro yet' nanhalxo sat lu'um, sb'atnhej lum t'a tz'akanh t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u chi'. Axo pax t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u ay junxo makan lu'um, masanto t'ha ha' mar Mediterráneo sk'och lu'um. Ha t'a skal chab' makan lum chi', ata' ay lum wik yaji, aton lum b'aj ay in templo yet' lum yik heb' sakerdote yet' pax lum yik heb' lewita. Ata' ay pax lum b'aj ay niwan chonhab'.

Ha lum smakb'en juntzanhxo makan yinhtilal Israel, sb'atnhej t'a sur. Junjun inhtilal ol scha junjun makan sluum, schael t'a tz'akanh t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u masanto sk'och t'a tz'akanh t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u. Icha tik ol aj schaan smakb'en heb' chi' t'a stzolal: Benjamín, Simeón, Isacar, Zabulón yet' Gad.
Ha t'a stojolal sur ay lum smakb'en Gad, a stz'akanhil lu'um, schael t'a Tamar, tzek' t'a sjaj ha ha' yik Meriba-kades, t'ha ha' eluma' yik Egipto, masanto sk'och t'ha ha' mar Mediterráneo.
Aton jun lum chi' ol scha juntzanh yinhtilal Israel smakb'enok. Icha chi' ol aj he pukanek' lu'um.

Ha jun chonhab' t'a snanhal lu'um chi', ayoch muro t'a spatiktak. Ha muro chi', 2 mil 250 metro yaj junjun pak'anh, lajan yaj schanhil pak'anh. Ha t'a junjun pak'anh ay oxe' puerta. Ha t'a junjun puerta chi' ayoch sb'i junjun yinhtilal Israel, icha tik yaj stzolal: Ha t'a oxe' puerta t'a stojolal norte, ayoch sb'i yik Rubén, yik Judá yet' yik Leví. Ha t'a oxe' puerta t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, ayoch sb'i yik José, yik Benjamín yet' yik Dan. Ha t'a oxe' puerta t'a stojolal sur, ayoch sb'i yik Simeón, yik Isacar yet' yik Zabulón. Axo pax t'a oxe' puerta t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, ayoch sb'i yik Gad, yik Aser yet' yik Neftalí.
Ha jun muro chi' 9 kilómetro yajoch t'a spatiktak niwan chonhab' chi'. Ha sb'i jun chonhab' chi' ayik ol b'eynhejb'atok: Ha Jehová ayek' t'a tik, ol sb'iej, xchi Jehová, xin chi.

Ayic yoxilxo ab'il yoch winhaj Joacim reyal t'a Judá, ix k'och winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia yet' heb' soldado, yik syak'an owal heb' t'a Jerusalén. Yuj chi' ix och oyan heb' t'a spatik chonhab' chi'.

Ha Dios Cajalil ix ak'anoch winhaj rey Joacim chi' t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Nabucodonosor chi' yet' juntzanhxo heb' anima aj Judá yet' jantak yamk'ab' sk'anchaj t'a stemplo Dios. Ha juntzanh yamk'ab' chi', ix yik'kot winh, ix jawi t'a Babilonia tik, ix schekan winh ak'chajoch t'a spatil sdiosal b'aj sik'chaj tas tz'ak'ji t'a sdiosal winh chi'.

Ayic ix jawi heb', ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Aspenaz, aton winh yajal yaj t'a heb' yilumal sdespacho winh rey chi' to sik'chajel jaywanhok heb' winh kelemtak t'a skal heb' yinhtilal heb' winh rey aj Judá chi' yet' t'a skal heb' yinhtilal heb' niwak yopisio ix ik'chajkot chi'.

Ix yalan winh rey chi' icha tik: Ha heb' winh kelemtak chi', yowalil te wach' yilji heb' winh, malaj jab'ok spaltail sniwanil heb' winh, jelan heb' winh, ay spensar heb' winh, snachajel tas yuj heb' winh, heb' winh smoj wal yak'an serwil t'a palakio. Yowalil sk'ayb'ej sti' heb' kaldeo heb' winh yet' tas tz'ib'ab'il yuj heb'.

Ix yalanpax winh rey t'a winhaj Aspenaz chi' to a swael winh yet' swino winh syab'lej heb' winh kelemtak chi', sk'ayb'ajpax oxeok ab'il heb' winh. Slajwi chi', tz'och heb' winh yak' serwil winh rey chi'.

Ha t'a skal juntzanh heb' winh kelemtak ix sik'chajel yuj winhaj Aspenaz chi', ata' ayoch winhaj Daniel, winhaj Ananías, winhaj Misael yet' winhaj Azarías. Aton heb' winh tik ix kot t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Judá.

Ix k'exchaj sb'i heb' winh yuj winhaj Aspenaz chi'. Ha winhaj Daniel chi', Beltsasar ix sb'iej winh, haxo winhaj Ananías, Sadrac ix sb'iej winh, haxo pax winhaj Misael, Mesac ix sb'iej winh, haxo winhaj Azarías jun, Abed-nego ix sb'iej winh.

Ha winhaj Daniel chi', ix sna winh to manh ol swalaj juntzanh tas ay yowalil yuj sley Dios, yuj chi' ix tewi winh t'a winhaj Aspenaz chi' to max ak'ji pural winh swaan swael winh rey yet' tas syuk'ej winh.
Ix och Dios yet' winhaj Daniel chi', yuj chi' te wach' winh t'a yol sat winhaj Aspenaz chi'. Wach'chom icha chi',

palta ix yal winhaj Aspenaz chi' icha tik: --Tzin xiw t'a winh wajalil, yujto a winh ix alani tas ol he wa''a yet' tas ol eyuk'ej. Q'uinalok haxo ol yilan winh to b'aktak ex t'a skal juntzanhxo heb' winh kelemtak tik, ol am in schek miljokcham winh rey chi' eyuuj, xchi winh.
Axo winhaj Aspenaz chi', ix yak'och jun yilumal winhaj Daniel chi' winh yet' heb' winh oxwanh kelemtak chi'. Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Daniel chi' t'a winh yilumal chi' icha tik:
--Tzin tewi t'ayach to tzonh ak' prowal t'a lajunheok k'ual. Anhej komon wael tzak' t'ayonh, mokab' ak' nok' chib'ej ko chi'a, anhej pax ha ha' tzak' kuk'ej.

Ayic stz'akwi lajunhe' k'ual chi', tzonh a lajb'an yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh kelemtak swaan swael winh rey chi'. Ichato chi' syalxo ak'an t'ayonh tas ol ko wa chi', ato syal chajtil quiljiochi, xchi winh.
Ix schaan sk'ol winh tas ix sk'an heb' winh chi'. Lajunhe' k'ual ix ak'ji prowal heb' winh.
Axo yik ix tz'akwi lajunhe' k'ual chi', ix iljiochi to te wach' yilji heb' winh, te tek'an heb' winh t'a yichanh juntzanhxo heb' winh ix waan swael winh rey chi'.
Yuj chi', majxo ak'jilaj wael yet' wino yik winh rey chi' t'a heb' winh yuj winh yilumal heb' winh chi', axonhej komon wael ix yak' winh t'a heb' winh.

Ha heb' winh kelemtak chi' schanhwanhil, ix ak'ji sjelanil heb' winh yuj Dios yik snachajel jantak sk'ayb'ub'al heb' aj Babilonia chi' yuj heb' winh yet' tas tz'ib'ab'il. Axo winhaj Daniel chi', ay pax sjelanil winh snaanel tas syalelk'och juntzanh wayich yet' juntzanh tas tz'ak'ji yila'.
Axo yik ix k'och stiempoal icha yalnakkan winh rey, ix molb'aj masanil heb' winh kelemtak ix k'ay chi' yuj winhaj Aspenaz, ix yik'anb'at heb' winh winh t'a yichanh winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi'.

Ayic ix k'och heb' winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi', ix lolon winh yet' heb' winh, palta ha t'a skal heb' winh kelemtak chi' smasanil, malaj junok heb' winh syal slajb'an sb'a yet' heb' winh chanhwanh chi', aton winhaj Daniel, winhaj Ananías, winhaj Misael yet' winhaj Azarías. Yuj chi' ix ak'jikanoch heb' winh yak' serwil winh rey chi'.

Juntaquel sk'anb'ej razón winh rey chi' t'a heb' winh yuj juntzanh jelanil yet' tastak ajaltak snachajeli, ix nachajel yuj heb' winh, lajunhel wal ek'to sjelanil spensar heb' winh chanhwanh chi' t'a yichanh masanil heb' ajchum yet' heb' naumel lolonel ay t'a yol masanil smakb'en winh.
Axo winhaj Daniel chi' ix kannhej winh t'a yopisio chi', masanto t'a b'ab'el ab'il yoch winhaj Ciro reyal.
Ayic schab'ilxo ab'il yoch winhaj Nabucodonosor reyal, ay jun tas ix ak'ji swayichej winh. Ix te och winh ilk'olal yuj jun swayich chi', yuj chi' majxo ochlaj swayanh winh.

Axo masanil heb' winh syal yuj yalani, heb' winh ajb'aal, heb' winh jelan yet' heb' winh schuman yet' k'een k'anal, ix chekji awtajkot heb' winh yuj winh rey chi', yik tzul yal heb' winh tas syalelk'och jun swayich winh chi'. Axo yik ix jawi heb' winh t'a yichanh winh,
ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Ay wal jun tas ix in wayichej, te ilk'olal waj yuj. Tzin nib'ej swojtaquejeli tas syalelk'ochi, xchi winh.

Ix yalan heb' winh t'a winh t'a ti' arameo icha tik: --Mamin rey, ayokab'nhej opisio tik t'a junelnhej. Al t'ayonh a onh a chekab' onh tik tas ix a wayichej chi', ol kalan t'ayach tas syalelk'ochi, xchi heb' winh.

Ix tak'wi winh rey chi' t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Toxo ix in na'a, tato manh ol eyal t'ayin tas ix in wayichej chi' yet' tas syalelk'ochi, chok' ol ex aj he xikjichamok, haxo he pat, ol pojchajkanemok.

Palta tato ol eyal t'ayin tas ix in wayichej chi' yet' tas syalelk'ochi, niwan silab' ol wak' spakok t'ayex, te niwan pax ol aj eyelk'ochi. Yuj chi', alek t'ayin tas ix in wayichej chi' yet' tas syalelk'ochi, xchi winh t'a heb' winh.
Ix tak'wi heb' winh jelan chi' t'a schaelal icha tik: --Mamin rey, al a wayich chi' t'ayonh a onh a chekab' onh tik yik ol kal t'ayach tas syalelk'ochi, xchi heb' winh.
Ix tak'wi winh rey chi' t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Vojtakxo to tonhej tze say modo tas tz'aj he kolan he b'a, yuj chi' tzeyik'ek' tiempo, yujto eyojtak to a tas ix wal t'a he patik manh ol ek'laj.

Tato manh ol eyala' tas ix in wayichej chi', a tas nab'il wuj t'a eyib'anh, ol ujok, yujto ix he mol alej tas tzeyutej he pakan t'ayin t'a esal, yakb'an wan he tanhwan in k'exan tas nab'il wuj t'a he patik. Alec tas ix in wayichej chi', yik snachajel wuuj to ol yal eyalani tas syalelk'ochi, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wixi heb' winh icha tik: --Mamin rey, malaj junok anima t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik syal snachajel yuj tas tza k'anb'ej tik. Anhejtona', malaj junok rey wach'chom te b'inajnak sk'anb'an icha jun tik t'a heb' winh jelan.
Yujto a jun tik, te ajaltak snachajeli. Malaj junok mach syal yalani, anhej am heb' Dios snachaj yuj, palta a heb' chi', manhok t'a ko kal ay heb' a onh anima onh tik, xchi heb' winh.
Ayic ix yab'an winh rey icha chi', ix kot wal yowal winh sik'lab'il. Ix yalan winh to xikjicham heb' winh jelan chi' t'a masanil yol yik Babilonia.
Ayic ix elta jun ley chi', ix saychajek' winhaj Daniel yet' heb' winh oxwanh yetb'eyum winh, yik schampax heb' winh.

Ha winhaj Arioc, yajal yaj winh t'a heb' stanhwumal winh rey. Ix ak'jioch yopisio winh yik smilancham masanil heb' winh jelan chi'. Van smolb'aj heb' winh yuj winh, haxo winhaj Daniel chi' ix lolon yet' winh t'a jelanil yet' t'a emnaquilal.
Ix sk'anb'an yab' winh icha tik: --¿Tas yuj elanhchamel ix yak'elta jun ley te ow tik winh rey chi'? xchi winh. Ix yalan winhaj Arioc tas yaji.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winhaj Daniel yik stewi winh t'a winh rey yik tz'ak'ji jab'okxo stiempo winh, yik syalan winh tas syalelk'och jun wayich chi'. Ix scha sk'ol winh rey tas ix yal winh chi'.
Yuj chi' ix b'atxi winhaj Daniel chi' t'a spat. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh yetb'eyum, aton winhaj Ananías, winhaj Misael yet' winhaj Azarías, chajtil yaj jun lolonel chi'.

Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh to sk'an skolwal sDiosal satchanh heb' winh yik snachajel jun lolonel satub'tak chi' yuj heb' winh, yik max miljicham heb' winh yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh jelan t'a yol yik Babilonia chi'.
Axo t'a jun ak'wal chi', ix yak' Dios swayichej winhaj Daniel tas jun swayich winh rey chi' yet' tas syalelk'ochi. Yuj chi', ix yal wach' lolonel winh t'a sDiosal satcha’anh.
Ix yalan winh icha tik: Ach ko Diosal, alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'ayach t'a masanil tiempo, yujto ik yaj masanil jelanil yet' poder.
Ha ach ojtak jantak tiempo syak' yajalil junjun mach, yujto a ach tzak'och heb' t'a yopisio. Anheja' a ach syal ik'anxiel heb'. Uuj ay spensar heb' ay spensar. Uuj ay sjelanil heb' jelan.
Ha ach tzak' ojtakajel tas satub'tak yet' tas k'ub'eltak yaji. Ojtac masanil tastak ay t'a kal k’ik’ k’inal, yujto aj sakil k'inal ach.

Ach ko Diosal, sDiosal ach pax heb' ko mam quicham, skak' yuj diosal t'ayach. Skalanpax wach' lolonel, yujto ix ak' in jelanil yet' in tek'anil. Ha tiknaik, ix ak' wojtaquejeli tas ix ko k'an t'ayach. Ix ak' kojtaquejeli tas yaj swayich winh rey, xchi winh d'ha Dios.

Ayic ix lajwi slesalwi winhaj Daniel chi', ix b'at winh t'a winhaj Arioc, aton winh ix ak'ji yopisio yik smilancham masanil heb' winh jelan t'a Babilonia chi'. Ix yalan winh t'a winh icha tik: --Manh a milcham heb' winh jelan chi'. Ik' in b'at t'a yichanh winh rey. Ol wala' tas syalelk'och swayich winh chi', xchi winh.

Yuj chi' t'a elanhchamel ix ik'chajb'at winh yuj winhaj Arioc chi' t'a yichanh winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi'. Ix yalan winhaj Arioc chi' t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, ha t'a skal juntzanh heb' ik'b'ilkot t'a Judá, ix ilchaj jun winh winak wuuj. Ha winh ol alanok tas syalelk'och a wayich chi', xchi winh.
Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Daniel chi', skuchanpax Beltsasar, icha tik: --¿Ol am yal alani tas ix in wayichej chi', tas pax syalelk'ochi? xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winh icha tik: --Mamin rey, a jun tas satub'tak tza nib'ej tzojtaquejel chi', wach'chom a heb' winh jelan, heb' winh schuman yet' k'een k'anal yet' heb' winh ajb'aal, malaj junok heb' winh snachajel yuj.
Palta ay jun Dios ay t'a satcha’anh, ha' syal yak'an kojtaquejel tas satub'tak. Ha ix ak'an ojtaquejeli tas ol ujok t'a b'ak'uinh. Ha tiknaik ol wal t'ayach tas ix a wayichej chi'.
Ach Mamin rey, ayik jichan ach ek' t'a sat ch'at, wan a naani tastak ol ujok t'a b'ak'uinh, haxo Dios, aton tz'ak'an ojtakajel tas satub'tak, ha' ix ch'oxan t'ayach.
Anheja' pax ix ch'oxan jun tik t'ayin, manh yujok to te jelan in t'a yichanh masanil heb' anima, maay, palta yuj wak'an ojtaquejeli tas syalelk'och a wayich chi', yik ol nachajel uuj tas tza na'a.
Mamin rey, a tas ix il t'a a wayich chi' to ay jun yechel anima te niwan, linhanek' t'a ichanh. Veei yilji, te ay smay yilji.
Ha sjolom, nab'a oro. Axo snhi' sk'ool yet' sk'ab', nab'a plata. Axo sk'ool yet' yib'tak xub', nab'a bronke.
Axo xub' yet' spenek, nab'a hierro, haxo samil yok yet' yiximal yok, a k'een hierro kalan yaj yet' lum lum mukb'il t'a kal k'ak'.

Mamin rey, yakb'an wan ilan jun chi', ay jun k'een k'een munil ix kot t'a sat witz, malaj mach ix ekankot k'een. Ha wal t'a yok jun yechel chi' b'aj kalan yaj k'een hierro yet' lum lum, ata' ix och tanhnaj k'een.

nhej wal chi' ix pojb'at k'een hierro yet' lum lum chi', k'een bronke, k'een plata yet' k'een oro chi', pokokxonhej ix ajkanb'ati. Icha wal smatz'il ixim trigo b'aj stek'chaj t'a waresma tz'ik'jib'at yuj ik', manhxa jab'ok skani, icha chi' ix ajkanb'at jun yechel chi'. Axo k'een k'een ix mak'anpoj jun yechel chi', ix q'uib'chaanh k'een. Icha lum niwak witz ix aj k'een, ix makchajel yol yib'anhk’inal tik yuj k'een.
Mamin rey, aton jun tik ix a wayichej. Ha tiknaik ol wal t'ayach tas syalelk'ochi.
Ha ach tik, sat aj t'a masanil heb' rey, yujto ha Dios aj satcha’anh, ha' ix ach ak'anoch reyal. Ix yak'anpax a jelanil yet' a b'inajnaquil yet' sniwanil elk'ochi.

Ix ach yak'och yajalil t'a yib'anh masanil lum lum b'aj kajan heb' anima, nok' nok' yet' nok' much. Ha Dios chi' ix ak'anoch masanil juntzanh chi' t'a yol a k'ab', yuj chi' a ach ton tzach sch'ox sjolom jun yechel to nab'a oro ix il chi'.

Ayic ol lajwoquek' opisio tik, ol k'e waan junxo nakión, palta manh lajanoklaj yet' jun ik tik. Slajwi chi', ol k'e waan junxo yoxil, aton jun sch'ox k'een bronke chi'. Aton jun chi' ol ak'an yajalil t'a yib'anh masanil yol yib'anhk’inal tik.

Ol lajwok chi', ol k'e waan junxo schanhil te ay yip, icha k'een hierro. Ha k'een hierro chi' smak'an poj masanil tastak, pokok tz'aj yuj k'een. Icha chi' ol aj junxo ol k'e waan chi', ol satjoquel juntzanhxo nakión yuj.

Ix ilanpax yok yet' yiximal yok jun yechel chi', kalan yaj k'een hierro chi' yet' lum lum mukb'il t'a skal k'ak'. Ha jun chi' syalelk'ochi to a jun nakión chi' cha makan yaji: Jun makan ay jab'ok yip icha k'een hierro, icha ix aj ilan k'een hierro kalan yaj yet' lum lum chi'.
Ha yiximal yok kalan yaj yet' k'een hierro yet' lum lum chi', a jun chi', syalelk'ochi to a jun nakión chi' ay jab'ok yip, haxo nanhalxo malaj wal yip.

Icha wal ix aj ilan k'een hierro kalan yet' lum lum chi', icha chi' ol yutej sb'a heb' yajal t'a juntzanh nakión chi'. Ol laj yik'laj sb'a yal yuninal heb' yik junnhej ol yutok sb'a heb' yalani, palta manh ol elk'ochlaj tas sna heb' chi', icha k'een hierro max skalej sb'a yet' lum lum.

Ha t'a stiempoal juntzanh heb' yajal chi', ata' ol k'e waan junxo nakión yuj Dios aj satcha’anh, manhxa b'ak'uinh ol satelok, manhxo ol kan t'a yalanh junokxo. Ol satjoquel juntzanhxo nakión chi' yuj, ol kannhej t'a junelnhej.

Aton chi' syalelk'och k'een k'een ix il skot t'a sat witz to malaj junok mach ix ekankoti. Aton yuj k'een pokokxonhej ix ajkanb'at k'een hierro, k'een bronke, lum lum, k'een plata yet' k'een oro. Mamin rey, ha Dios te Niwan Yelk'ochi, ha' ix ch'oxan t'ayach tas ol ujok t'a b'ak'uinh chi'. Ha jun a wayich chi' te yel, icha wal tz'aj walan tik, icha chi' ol aj yelk'ochi, xchi winhaj Daniel t'a winh rey chi'.
Ayic ix yab'an jun chi' winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi', ix em kumnaj winh t'a yichanh winhaj Daniel chi', ichato chi' ix schekan winh ak'chaj silab' yet' inkienso t'a winh.

Ix yalanpax winh t'a winhaj Daniel chi' icha tik: --Val yel a he Diosal a ex tik, anhej yelxo niwan t'a yichanh juntzanhxo Dios. Aton wal yajalil heb' rey, a sch'oxanpax tas satub'tak yaji. Tik wal a achnhej ix nachajel jun lolonel tik uuj, xchi winh.

Axo winh rey chi' ix ak'anoch winhaj Daniel chi' t'a jun opisio te niwan yelk'ochi. Ix ak'chajpax silab' te wach' t'a winh, yuj chi' ix ak'chajoch winh yajalil t'a yol yik Babilonia chi'. Ix ochpax winh yajalil t'a masanil heb' winh jelan t'a smakb'en chi'.

Ix sk'an yopisio juntzanhxo heb' winh yetb'eyum winhaj Daniel t'a winh rey chi'. Ix schaan sk'ol winh rey chi', ix och heb' winh yajalil t'a yol yik Babilonia chi', aton winhaj Sadrac, winhaj Mesac yet' winhaj Abed-nego. Axo winhaj Daniel chi', ha t'a sdespacho winh rey chi' ayoch winh t'a yopisio.
Ix schek winhaj rey Nabucodonosor b'ochaj jun yechel ayoch oro t'ay, 30 metro steel, haxo sat, oxe' metro. Ix yalan winh to tz'ak'jiem t'a jun ak'lik skuchan Dura t'a yol yik Babilonia chi'.

Ayic toxo ix b'oel jun yechel chi', ix yawtankot heb' winh ayoch yajalil winh t'a masanil yol smakb'en, aton heb' winh yajalil soldado, heb' winh gobernador, heb' winh ak'um razón t'a yoltak chonhab', heb' winh molum tumin, heb' winh juez yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh ayoch yajalil. Yuj chi' ix smolb'ej sb'a juntzanh heb' winh niwak yajal chi' t'a yichanh jun yechel chi', yik tz'och sq'uinh yuj heb' winh.
Ha jun mach ayoch t'a yib'anh sloloni, te chaanh ix aj yalani: Ab'ek he masanil ex anima ix ex kot t'a masanil chonhab' yet' t'a junjun nakión yet' t'a junjun ti'al.

Ayic ol eyab'an sk'e sjaj masanil son tik, aton flauta, tanhb'il, arpa, salterio, zamponia yet' masanil juntzanhxo son, ol ex em kumnaj he masanil t'a yichanh jun niwan yechel ix schek b'ojok winhaj rey Nabucodonosor tik.
Masanil mach manh ol em kumnaj ejmelal t'a jun yechel tik, elanhchamel ol yumchajb'at t'a yol jun horno nhilnhon sk'e sk'ak'al, xchi.
Yuj chi', masanil anima ayek' molan chi', ayik ix yab'an heb' sk'e nhilnaj son chi', ix em kumnaj heb', ix yak'anem sb'a heb' t'a jun yechel chi'.
Ha t'a yik chi', ay juntzanh heb' winh aj Caldea ix ul ak'an queja heb' winh aj Judá t'a winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi'.
Ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --Mamin rey, ayokab' opisio t'a masanil tiempo.
Ha ach ix ala' to ayik sk'e sjaj masanil son tik, tz'em kumnaj masanil anima ejmelal t'a yichanh jun niwan yechel tik,
haxo mach max k'anab'ajani, syumchajb'at t'a yol horno sk'e nhilnhon sk'ak'al, xa chi.

Palta ay juntzanh heb' winh aj Judá, aton winhaj Sadrac, winhaj Mesac yet' winhaj Abed-nego, heb' winh ix ak'och yopisio t'a yol smakb'en Babilonia tik, maj sk'anab'ajej heb' winh tas ix ala'. Max och heb' winh ejmelal t'a juntzanh a diosal, max empax kuman heb' winh t'a jun yechel a diosal ix a chek b'ochajk'e tik, xchi heb' winh.
Ayic ix yab'an jun chi' winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi', ix kot wal yowal winh sik'lab'il, ix schekan winh ik'chajkot heb' winh oxwanh chi'. Axo yik ix k'och heb' winh t'a yichanh winh,
ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --¿Tom yel a ex tik Sadrac, Mesac yet' Abed-nego maj ex och ejmelal t'a juntzanh in diosal yet' t'a yechel in diosal ix in chek b'ochajk'e tik?

Ha tiknaik jun, tato b'ekan he k'ool, ayik ol eyab'an sk'e sjaj son chi' junelxo, ol ex och ejmelal t'a yichanh jun yechel ix in chek b'ochajk'e tik, malaj tas ol ex ik'anok. Tato max he k'anab'ajej eyem kuman ejmelal jun, a wal t'a jun rato chi', ol ex yumchajb'at t'a yol jun horno nhilnhon sk'e sk'ak'al. Tato icha chi' ol ex utajok, ¿machto junok Dios ol yal ex skolanel t'a yol in k'ab'? xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi heb' winh t'a winh rey chi', ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --Mamin rey, malaj tas wach' kalan yuj jun tik.
Ha ko Diosal b'aj tzonh och ejmelal a onh tik, syal onh skolanel t'a skal k'ak' t'a horno chi'. A' ol onh kolanel t'a yol a k'ab'.
Wach'chom manh ol onh koljok yuj jun, palta mamin rey skak' ojtaquejeli to manh ol onh em kuman t'a juntzanh a diosal chi' yet' t'a jun yechel a diosal ix a chek b'ojok tik, xchi heb' winh.

Ayic ix yab'an juntzanh slolonel heb' winh kelemtak winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi', ix chakb'i wal sat winh skot yowal. Ix schekan ekchajk'e sk'ak'al jun horno chi' winh, masanto jantak stechaj schakb'i sik'lab'il.
Ix schekan juntzanh heb' winh soldado winh te ay yip, yik stzek'chaj heb' winh oxwanh chi', syumchajb'at heb' winh t'a skal k'ak' t'a yol horno chi'.
Ha heb' winh oxwanh chi' ayto och spichul heb' winh sk'an t'a yopisio b'aj ayochi, ix tzek'chaj heb' winh yik syumchajb'at heb' winh t'a skal k'ak' t'a yol horno chi'.

Snib'ej winh rey chi' to elanhchamel syumjiem heb' winh t'a yol horno chi', yuj chi' ayik ix yumjiem heb' winh yuj heb' winh soldado chi', ix k'eul kopnaj te' k'ak' chi' t'a heb' winh soldado chi', ix cham heb' winh yujto te ow sk'ak'al.
Axo pax heb' winh oxwanh chi', tzek'b'il heb' winh ix emk'och heb' winh t'a yol horno chi'.

D'a elanhchamel ix k'e juknaj winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi', ix xiwk'e winh, ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh yajal ayek' ta': --¿Tom manh oxwanhoknhej heb' winh kelemtak tzek'b'il ix yumjikanem t'a skal k'ak' chi'? xchi winh. --Ichaton chi' mamin rey, xchi heb' winh.

--Palta chanhwanh heb' winh swila', tijanel heb' winh, sb'eyek' heb' winh t'a skal k'ak' chi', malaj wal jab'ok tas tz'ik'an heb' winh. Axo jun schanhil chi', lajan wal yilji icha junok Dios, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi yalan jun chi' winhaj Nabucodonosor chi', ix snitzanb'at sb'a winh t'a slak'anil sti' horno chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: --Sadrac, Mesac yet' ach Abed-nego, schekab' ex Dios Jun Te Niwan Yelk'ochi, elanhekkoti, tzex kot t'a tik, xchi winh. Ix elta heb' winh yoxwanhil t'a kal k'ak' chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix k'och umnaj masanil heb' winh yajal t'a yol jun nakión chi' yet' heb' winh tz'ak'an srazón winh rey yil heb' winh oxwanh kelemtak chi', malaj wal jab'ok sniwanil heb' winh ix tz'a yuj k'ak' chi'. Ix chamwal yilan heb' winh to malaj jab'ok xil sjolom heb' winh ix tz'ai, malaj pax jab'ok spichul heb' winh ix tz'ai, malaj wal jab'ok sjab' te' k'ak' chi' t'a heb' winh.

Ha t'a jun rato chi', ix yalan winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi' icha tik: Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'a sDiosal winhaj Sadrac, winhaj Mesac yet' winhaj Abed-nego to a ix chekankot yángel yik skoljiel heb' schekab' syak' wal och sk'ool t'ay. Maj sk'anab'ajej in cheknab'il a in rey in tik heb' winh, b'ekan sk'ol heb' winh scham t'a yichanhpax yem kuman t'a yalnhej tas diosal to manh sDiosalok heb' winh.

Ha tiknaik a in swala' to yalnhej mach anima sb'uchwaj t'a sDiosal winhaj Sadrac, winhaj Mesac yet' winhaj Abed-nego tik, chok' tz'aj heb' schami. Axo spat heb' sjuchajem smasanil, wach'chom tas chonhab'il, tas nakional, ma tas ti'al syala', yujto malaj junokxo Dios syal skolwaj icha sDiosal heb' winh tik, xchi winh.
