Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'anoch heb' winh oxwanh kelemtak chi' winh rey t'a niwak opisio t'a smakb'en Babilonia chi'.

Ix yak'anb'at jun ab'ix winh rey t'a yol masanil smakb'en icha tik: Ha in rey Nabucodonosor in tik, swak' stzatzil he k'ool he masanil ex chonhab', ma ex nakión yalxonhej tas ti'al tzeyala', a ex masanil ex kajan ex t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik.
In gana tzeyojtaquejel he masanil tastak satub'tak ix sk'ulej Dios Niwan Yelk'och t'ayin.
Te satub'takxonhej tas sk'ulej, manh jantakok spoder, Yajal ton t'a masanil tiempo, a yopisio malaj slajwub'.
Ha in Nabucodonosor in tik, tzalajk'olal wajek' t'a in palakio.
Palta ha t'a jun ak'wal, ay jun tas ix in wayichej. Ha yuj tas ix wil chi' yet' tas ix in na'a, ix in te xiwi.
Yuj chi' ix in chek awtajkot masanil heb' jelan t'a Babilonia tik, yik syalan heb' tas syalelk'och in wayich chi'.
Ix jawi heb' smasanil: Aton heb' ajb'aal, heb' naumel lolonel, heb' schuman yet' k'een k'anal yet' heb' ajchum. Ix walan in wayich chi' t'a heb', palta maj yal-laj heb' t'ayin tas syalelk'ochi.
Stzak'anilxo ix jawi winhaj Daniel, skuchan pax Beltsasar, icha sb'i in diosal, ayoch sjelanil juntzanh Dios t'a winh. Ix walan in wayich chi' t'a winh icha tik:

Ach Beltsasar, yajal aj t'a skal heb' jelan spensar, wojtak to ayoch sjelanil juntzanh Dios t'ayach, ojtakpax masanil tas satub'tak. Scham wal ab'ani tas ix wil t'a in wayich, ol alan t'ayin tas syalelk'ochi.
Aton wal in wayich ix wil tik ayik jichan in ek' in wayi: Ha t'a snanhal lum lum tik ix wil jun te te' te chaanh steel.
Ix q'uib'chaanh te', te niwan ix aj spatik te'. Ha schon te', ix k'ek'och t'a satcha’anh, chequel te' masanto b'aj slajwik'och lum lum.

Te wach' yilji xil te', manh jantakok sat te', k'okb'il wal syab' sat te' chi' sloan masanil anima. Axo masanil nok' nok', tz'och nok' sk'ub'ej sb'ha t'a yenhul yich te'. Axo t'a sk'ab'tak te' sb'o so' nok' much, haxo masanil tas pitzan t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, k'okb'il swatzitaj heb' yuj sat te'.
Axo ix aj jun, ix wilan jun ángel t'a in wayich chi', to stanhwej yol yib'anhk’inal tik, wan yemta t'a satcha’anh.

Te chaanh ix el yaw, ix yalan icha tik: Ch'aquequel te te' chi', xiquequel sk'ab' te', tzeyik'anel xil te', tze saklemanb'at sat te' chi' smasanil. Saklemokab'kanb'at masanil nok' nok' ayoch t'a yalanh yenhul te' yet' masanil nok' much ayoch t'a sk'ab'tak te'.

Axonhej yib' te' tzeyaktejkani, tze tzek'ankan te' yib' chi' yet' k'een kadena to hierro yet' bronke. Skan jun chi' t'a skal anh ank'ultak chi', haxo yal ak'wal ol em t'a yib'anh, haxo anh ank'ultak ol sk'ux icha nok' kaltakte'al nok'.
Ol ixtaxel spensar. Lajanxo ol aj spensar icha spensar nok' nok'. Ha jun makan yaelal chi', uque' ab'il ol yak'a'.

Ha onh ángel onh sko tanhwej yol yib'anhk’inal tik, a onh skala' to ol jawok jun yaelal tik t'a yib'anh, yik wach' syojtaquejel heb' anima smasanil to ha Dios Niwan Yelk'ochi, ay yopisio t'a yib'anhtak nakión. Ha tz'ak'an opisio t'a mach snib'ej syak'ochi, syalpax yak'anoch junok mach emnaquil yajalilok junok nakión, xchi jun ángel chi'.

Aton in wayich ix wil tik. Ha tiknaik ach Beltsasar, al t'ayin tas syalelk'ochi, yujto malaj wal junokxo heb' ay tas syal yuj t'a yol in makb'en tik snachajel yuj. Palta a ach tik ol yal snachajel uuj, yujto ayoch sjelanil juntzanh Dios t'ayach, xin chi.

Axo winhaj Daniel chi', aton winh skuchpax Beltsasar, quen am manh junok hora ix kan numan winh. Ix somchajk'e spensar winh, palta ix walan t'a winh: Beltsasar, manh ak' pensar yuj jun in wayich chi' yet' tas syalelk'ochi, xin chi. Ix yalan winh t'ayin: Ay mamin rey, komonok wal t'a yib'anh heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach ol em tas syalelk'och jun a wayich tik.
Mamin rey, a jun te te' te chaanh steel ix il chi', aton jun te' ix k'ek'och t'a satcha’anh, te' ix cheklaj t'a najat,

te' wach' yilji xiil, te' tzijtum sat, te' k'okb'ilnhej syab' sat sloan masanil tas pitzan, te' b'aj tz'och masanil nok' nok' sk'ub'ej sb'ha t'a yalanh yenhul sk'ab', te' b'aj sb'o so' nok' much t'a skaltak sk'ab',
a ach ton tik mamin rey. To ix ach k'enhejchaanh yuj sniwanil elk'och chi'. Ix k'ek'och a b'inajnaquil t'a satcha’anh. Yajal ach t'a masanil yol yib'anhk’inal tik.

Ix ilanpax yemta jun ángel stanhwumal yol yib'anhk’inal tik t'a satcha’anh, ix yalani: Ch'aquek telwok te niwan te' chi', yik slajwiem te'. Axonhej yib' te' yet' sch'anhal yib' tzeyak'kani. Stzek'chajkan yib' te' yet' k'een kadena to hierro yet' bronke, skan t'a kaltak ank'ultak. Emokab' yal ak'wal t'a yib'anh ta', ol kajnaj yet' nok' nok' uqueok ab'il.
Ha syalelk'och jun tik mamin rey, a jun Dios Niwan Yelk'ochi, ha' tz'alan jun tik t'a ib'anh.

Ol ach pechchajel t'a skal heb' anima tik. Ol ach b'atkan t'a skal nok' nok', haxo anh ank'ultak ol a k'ux icha nok' wakax. Ol em yal ak'wal t'a ib'anh. Mamin rey, icha chi' ol ach ajek' uqueok ab'il, masanto ol nachajel uuj to a jun Dios Niwan Yelk'ochi, ha' yajal yaj t'a yib'anh heb' anima. Ha tz'ak'anpaxoch heb' yajal icha snib'ej mach syak'ochi.
Ha jun lolonel ix alchaji to skan yib' te' yet' sch'anhal yib' chi', syalelk'ochi to ol ach k'ochxok t'a opisio chi' ayik toxo ix nachajel uuj to ha Dios yajal yaj t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik.

Yuj chi' mamin rey, cha ab' masanil juntzanh lolonel swal tik t'ayach. Yuj chi' tojolnhej tzutej a b'a, manhxo ak'och a mul. Comonoc wal tzaktejkan a k'ulan chukal, tzach kolwaj t'a heb' tz'ixtaji. Tato icha chi', tekan ol ach kan t'a junk'olal yet' a k'echaanh t'a masanil tasi, xchi winhaj Daniel chi' t'ayin, xchi winh rey Nabucodonosor chi'.
Masanil juntzanh lolonel ix alchaj t'a winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi', ix elk'ochi.
Yab'ilal yalchaj juntzanh chi' t'a winh rey chi', ayik wan sb'eyek' winh t'a spanhanil yib'anh spalakio t'a Babilonia,
ix yalan winh icha tik: Ina wal yilji niwan chonhab' Babilonia tik. Ha in yet' wal in poder ix in b'ok'ei yik scheklajeli to niwan welk'ochi, xchi winh.

Vanto wal yalan juntzanh lolonel chi' winh, ix yab'an winh yoch jun lolonel t'a satcha’anh, ix yalani: Scham ab'an juntzanh lolonel tik ach rey Nabucodonosor, a opisio chi', toxo ix ik'chajek' t'ayach.

Ol ach pechchajel t'a skal heb' anima, ol ach b'atkan t'a skal nok' nok'. Ha anh ank'ultak ol a k'ux ichok nok' nok' t'a uqueok ab'il, masanto ol yal snachajel uuj to ha Dios Niwan Yelk'ochi, ha' tz'ak'an yajalil t'a yib'anh masanil anima yet' t'a yib'anh masanil nakión t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik. A' tz'ak'anoch t'a yajalil mach snib'ej syak'ochi, xchi jun lolonel chi'.

Ha t'a jun rato chi', ix elk'och tas alb'ilkan t'a yib'anh winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi', ix pechchajkanel winh t'a skal heb' anima. Ha anh ank'ultak ix sk'ux winh icha nok' wakax, haxo yal ak'wal ix em t'a yib'anh sniwanil winh. Ix q'uib' xiil winh icha nok' ch'akb'a, anheja' icha yech nok' ix aj k'een yech winh.

Ix yalanpaxb'at winh rey chi' icha tik: Ayic ix lajwi stiempoal yaelal ayoch t'a wib'anh a in Nabucodonosor in tik, ix in k'e k'elan t'a satcha’anh, ix b'o in pensar t'a in lokoal. Ix walan wach' lolonel d'ha Dios Te Niwan Yelk'ochi, ix wik'anchaanh sb'i Jun aynhejek' t'a junelnhej: Yujto Yajal ton t'a junelnhej, a yopisio malaj slajwub'.

Ha t'a yichanh, malaj wal jab'ok tas syal yuj heb' kajan t'a sat lu'um tik. Sk'ulejnhej tas snib'ej t'a skal heb' ayek' t'a satcha’anh yet' t'a skal heb' kajan t'a sat lu'um tik. Malaj mach syal syamanoch waan sk'ab' syalan t'ay, ¿tas yuj icha chi' tza k'ulej? manh xchiok.

Ha t'a jun rato chi', ix meltzaj in pensar ix wab'i yet' wik'anxi wopisio niwan yelk'ochi yet' in poder. Axo heb' in chekab' yet' heb' niwak yopisio t'a in despacho, ix jawi heb' ul in sayeq'ui. Ix in ochxi yajalil t'a in nakión, ix yik'anxi yip wopisio. Te niwan ix ajxi t'a yichanh icha yaj t'a yalanhtaxo.

Ha tiknaik, a in wal swik'chaanh Jun sReyal satcha’anh. Swalanpax wach' lolonel t'ay, yujto a masanil tas sk'ulej, wach'nhej, tojolnhej t'a smasanil. Syalpax yik'anemta heb' syaloch sb'a to niwan yelk'ochi, xchib'at winhaj Nabucodonosor chi'.
Ha winhaj Belsasar sreyal Babilonia, ix yawtej mil heb' niwak yopisio winh t'a yol snakión t'a jun niwan wael. Ha t'a jun wael chi', ix yuk' anh heb', ix yuk'an anh winh yet' heb'.

Vanxo sk'e anh t'a sjolom winh rey chi', ix schekan winh ik'chajkot kopa yet' uk'ab' nab'a oro, aton juntzanh yik'nakkot winhaj Nabucodonosor smam icham winh t'a templo t'a Jerusalén. Ha t'a yol juntzanh kopa yet' juntzanh uk'ab' ix b'at ik'chajkot chi', ata' ix yuk' anh winh yet' heb' ix yetb'eyum yet' juntzanhxo heb' ix schab'il yetb'eyum yet' pax masanil heb' ayoch yet' winh t'a wael chi'.
Masanil heb' ix cham yuj anh, ix yik'anchaanh sdiosal heb' nab'a oro, plata, bronke, hierro, te te' yet' k'een k'een.
Ha t'a jun rato chi', ix cheklaj jun k'ab' anima b'aj sakq'uinal yuj kandil, ix och ijan stz'ib'anoch t'a sat pat chi'. Ayic ix yilan jun k'ab' stz'ib'an chi' winh rey,
sak ix aj sat winh yuj xiwelal. Ix luklonk'e yok winh, ix el wal yip winh.

Elanhchamel ix el yaw winh, ix yawtankot heb' naumel lolonel winh, heb' schuman yet' k'een k'anal yet' heb' ajchum. Ix yalan winh t'a heb': --Ha mach syal yilan juntzanh tz'ib'ab'iloch chi', syalan t'ayin tas syalelk'ochi, tz'ak'chajoch junok pichul púrpura t'ay, tz'ak'chajoch junok kadena oro t'a sjaj, tz'och t'a yoxil yajalil t'a in makb'en tik, xchi winh.
Masanil heb' jelan ayoch yopisio yak'an srazón winh rey chi', ix och heb' t'a yol jun kuarto, palta malaj wal junok heb' ix nachajel yuj tas syalelk'ochi.
Ix te xiw winhaj rey Belsasar chi', sak ix aj yilji sat winh. Axo masanil heb' winh winak ayek' yet' winh ta', ix somchajpax sk'ool heb' winh.

Ayic ix yab'an ix reina, snun winh rey chi' yel yaw winh yet' pax heb' awtab'il, ix och ix t'a yol skuartoal b'aj ayoch q'uinh chi', ix yalan ix icha tik: --Ayokab'nhej opisio t'a junelnhej. Mokab' ak' pensar, mokab' ach sakb'ielpax yuj xiwelal,

yujto ha t'a yol a makb'en tik, ay jun winh syal snachajel yuj, ayoch sjelanil juntzanh Dios t'a winh. Ha t'a yol stiempoal winh a mam icham, a jun winh winak chi', ix sch'ox wal winh to ay spensar winh te wach', ay spensar winh sik'lab'il icha yik heb' Dios. Yuj chi', a winhaj rey Nabucodonosor a mam icham, a winh ix ak'anoch jun winh chi' yajalilok heb' ay spensar, heb' naumel lolonel, heb' schuman yet' k'een k'anal yet' heb' ajchum.

Daniel sb'i jun winh chi', haxo winh a mam icham chi' ix ak'an skuch winh Beltsasar. Te ay sjelanil winh yet' tas yojtak, yik snachajel wayich yuj winh, syal snachajpaxel yuj winh tas syalelk'och junok lolonel to ajaltak snachajeli yet' sb'oan yaj junok tas to niwan yaji. Avtejcot winh an. Ha winh ol ak'an ojtaquejel tas syalelk'och juntzanh tz'ib' t'a sat pat tik, xchi ix t'a winh rey chi'.

Ix awtaj winhaj Daniel chi', ix ik'chajb'at winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi', ix sk'anb'an winh t'a winh: --¿A ach am tik tza kuch Daniel, aj Judá ik'b'ilkot preso yuj winhaj Nabucodonosor winh in mam icham?
Ix alchaj t'ayin tob' ayoch sjelanil juntzanh Dios t'ayach, tob' ay a pensar, jelan ach.

Yuj chi' ix ach wawtej. Ix wawtej masanil heb' winh jelan yet' heb' naumel lolonel, yik syawtej juntzanh lolonel heb' tz'ib'ab'iloch tik yet' yalan heb' t'ayin tas syalelk'ochi, palta malaj wal junok heb' snachajel yuj tas syalelk'ochi.

Ix alchaj t'ayin tob' syal ak'an cheklajel lolonel ajaltak snachajeli. Yuj chi' ta syal awtan juntzanh lolonel tik, tzalan t'ayin tas syalelk'ochi, ol ak'chajoch pichul púrpura t'ayach, ol ak'chajpaxoch junok kadena oro t'a a jaj, ol ach och t'a yoxil yajalil t'a yol in makb'en tik, xchi winh rey chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Daniel chi' icha tik: --Canokab' a silab' chi' t'ayach mamin rey. Syal ak'an jun opisio chi' t'a junokxo, palta ol wawtej jun tz'ib' tik, ol walan t'ayach tas wal syalelk'och juntzanh lolonel tz'ib'ab'iloch t'a sat pat tik.
Mamin rey, ha Dios Te Niwan Yelk'ochi, ha' ix ak'an yopisio winhaj Nabucodonosor a mam icham yet' sniwanil yelk'ochi, sb'inajnaquil yet' stziquiquial.

Yuj opisio ix ak'chaj chi' t'a winh, ix xiw masanil anima t'a junjun nakión yet' t'a junjun ti'al, yujto niwan yelk'och winh rey chi' t'a yol sat heb'. Ha mach snib'ej winh schami, schamnhej, haxo mach malaj snib'ej winh schami, max miljichamok. Ay pax mach ix ik'jiel t'a yopisio yuj winh, ay pax mach ix ak'jioch t'a yopisio, ato ha' tas snib'ej sk'ool winh.
Palta a wal yik ix yik'anchaanh sb'a winh, ix ixtaxel sb'eyb'al winh. Ix ik'chajel winh t'a yopisio t'a reyal chi' yet' sniwanil yelk'ochi.

Ix pechchajel winh t'a skal heb' yetanimail, ix ochkan spensar winh icha spensar nok' nok'. Junnhej ix aj winh yet' nok' kaltakte'al b'uru. Ix sk'ux anh ank'ultak winh icha nok' wakax. Ix empax yal ak'wal t'a sniwanil winh, masanto ix yal snachajel yuj winh chajtil wal yaj Dios, Jun Te Niwan Yelk'ochi, yajal pax yaj t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik. Ha tz'ak'anoch heb' yajal to snib'ej syak'ochi.
Ha achxo pax tik, mamin rey Belsasar, yixchiquin ach winh, wach'chom ojtak tas ix uji chi', palta manh wal jab'ok tzik'em a b'a.

Palta yelxo ix ik'chaanh a b'ha t'a yichanh Jun Yajalil satcha’anh. Ix ak'an ik'chajkot juntzanh kopa t'a a mexa yet' juntzanh uk'ab' yik stemplo Jun Yajal satcha’anh chi'. Ha t'a yol juntzanh chi' ix uk' wino yet' masanil heb' awtab'il uuj. Ix eyik'chaanh juntzanh Dios to max yal yilani, max yal yab'ani, malaj pax jab'ok tas yojtak. Manhok pax d'ha Dios ix al wach' lolonel, ina a pax t'a yol sk'ab' ay a k 'inal, a pax snaan tas tza k'ulej.
Yuj chi' ix yak'kot Dios jun k'ab' ix tz'ib'an juntzanh lolonel tik,
MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPARSIN.
Ha juntzanh tik icha tik syalelk'ochi: MENE: Toxo ix sb'is Dios jaye' k'u ayachto och t'a opisio, toxo ix sch'ox slajwub'.
TEKEL: Toxo ix ach echtaj t'a yol echlab', manh tz'akanok alil.
PERES: Ha a makb'en, wan spojchajb'ati, ix ak'chajoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' Medo yet' heb' Persa, xchi winhaj Daniel chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix schekan winhaj rey Belsasar chi' ak'chajoch pichul púrpura t'a winhaj Daniel chi'. Ix ak'chajoch jun kadena nab'a oro t'a sjaj winh. Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a masanil anima to ha t'a jun rato chi', ix ochkan winhaj Daniel chi' t'a yoxil yajalil t'a yol smakb'en.
Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi' ix miljicham winhaj Belsasar sreyal heb' kaldeo chi'.
Axo winhaj Darío aj Media ix yak'och sb'a yajalil sk'exulok winh. 62 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Darío chi'.
Ix yak'anoch 120 heb' winh gobernador winhaj Darío chi', yik syil junjun makan chonhab' heb' winh t'a yol smakb'en.

Ix yak'anoch oxwanhxo sat yajal winh t'a heb' winh gobernador chi', yik syilan heb' winh yet' stanhwan masanil tastak, yik wach' tz'akan tz'aj yak'chaj k'een tumin syak' heb' winh t'a winh rey chi'. D'a skal heb' winh sat yaj chi' ayoch winhaj Daniel chi'.
Ix cheklajel winhaj Daniel chi' t'a skal heb' winh yetyajalil chi', yujto wach'nhej syutej sb'a winh. Yuj chi' ix sna winh rey chi' to tz'och winh sat yajalil t'a yol smakb'en chi'.

Axo juntzanh heb' winh yetyajalil winh chi', ix say modo heb' winh tas tz'aj yemta winh t'a yopisio chi'. Palta te k'anab'ajum winh, max elk'an winh t'a tas sk'ulej, ayoch spensar winh t'a yopisio chi'. Yuj chi' malaj junok tas syal yalank'e heb' winh t'a spatik winh.
Yuj chi' ix ochnhej ijan heb' winh snaani, ix yalan heb' winh: Malaj wal junok tas syal kalank'e t'a spatik winh, anhej yuj sk'anab'ajan sDiosal winh, xchi heb' winh.

Yuj chi' ix slajtiej sb'a heb' winh yajal chi', yik b'at yalan heb' winh t'a winhaj Darío chi'. Ayic ix k'och heb' winh t'a yichanh winh, ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --Mamin rey Darío, ayokab'nhej opisio t'a junelnhej.

Ix ko mol lajtiej ko b'a ko masanil a onh yajal onh tik t'a yol a makb'en tik. Ix ko naani to tzak'elta junok ley yik tz'alchajel t'a skal masanil anima t'a masanil yol a makb'en tik to malaj junok mach sk'anan skolwal sdiosal, ma t'a junokxo yetanimail t'a junok ujal, palta anhej t'ayach syal sb'a mamin rey. Ha mach max k'anab'ajan jun ley chi', tojolnhej syumjikanem b'aj makb'il nok' choj.
Yuj chi', mamin rey, ak' tz'ib'chaj jun ley chi', tzak'anoch a sello t'ay yik wach' malaj mach syal sk'exani. A' ko ley a onh medos yet' persas onh tik, max yal-laj yek'b'ati, xchi heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix schek winhaj rey Darío chi' tz'ib'chaj jun ley chi', ix yak'anoch winh t'a yopisio.

Axo ix yab'an winhaj Daniel to toxo ix alchajel jun ley chi', ix k'enhej winh t'a yol spat t'a chaanh, ix sjakanxi swentena winh k'elanb'at t'a stojolal Jerusalén. Ix em kuman winh, ix lesalwi winh d'ha Dios, ix yak'an yuj diosal winh t'ay. Oxel slesalwi winh t'a junjun k'u, ichataxon sk'ulej winh.
Axo juntzanh heb' winh chi', ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' winh, ix yilan heb' winh to wan slesalwi winh yet' stewi winh d'ha Dios.

Yuj chi' ix b'at heb' winh t'a winh rey chi'. Ix b'at yalan heb' winh yuj jun ley toxo ix alchajel chi', ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --Toton ix a chek alchajel jun ley tz'alan icha tik: Yalnhej mach syal sb'ha t'a sdiosal, ma t'a junokxo ch'ok animail t'a junok ujal, tato manhok t'a winh rey syal tas snib'ej, yowalil syumchajem b'aj makb'il nok' choj, xchi. ¿Manh am yelok icha chi'? xchi heb' winh. --Ichaton chi' ix aji. Ha jun ley chi' yowalil sk'anab'ajaji, a ko leyal a onh medos yet' persas onh tik, max yal-laj yek'b'at tas syala', xchi winh rey chi'.

Yuj chi' ix ochnhej ijan heb' winh yalan icha tik: --Ha winhaj Daniel, winh ik'chajnakkot t'a Judá, max sk'anab'ajejlaj winh. Mamin rey, manh jab'ok xiw winh t'ayach, malaj pax jab'ok yelk'och jun ley chi' t'a winh. Toxo ix quila' to oxel slesalwi winh t'a sDiosal t'a junjun k'u, xchi heb' winh.
Ayic ix yab'an winh rey chi' icha chi', ix och winh t'a kusk'olal. Masanil jun k'ual chi', ix sayek' winh tas tz'aj skolchajel winhaj Daniel chi'.

Axo yik wanxo sb'at k'u, ix smolb'anxi sb'a juntzanh heb' winh winak chi' t'a yichanh winh rey chi', ix yalan heb' winh: --Mamin rey, ojtak wal to a ko ley a onh medos yet' persas onh tik, ta ay junok lolonel, ma junok ley toxo ix yalel winh rey, maxtzak yal-laj yek'b'ati, xchi heb' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix schekan winh rey chi' ik'chajkot winhaj Daniel chi' yik syumchajem winh b'aj makb'il nok' choj chi'. Ayic manto yumchajem winh, ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winh: --Comonoc wal ol ach koljok yuj a Diosal to ayachnhejoch ak'an serwil, xchi winh.

Ayic toxo ix yumjikanem winh t'a skal nok' choj chi', ix ak'jikanem jun k'een k'een smakulok. Ix ak'jikanoch sello yik yopisio winh rey chi' t'a k'een yet' sello heb' winh niwak yajal yaj yet' winh, yik wach' max tenjiek' tas ix alchaj t'a spatik winhaj Daniel chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winh rey chi' t'a spalakio, palta majxo walaj winh, majxo schek winh ik'chajkot heb' tz'ak'an tzalajb'ok sk'ool. Ix b'at way winh, palta junelnhej maj ochlaj swayanh winh t'a jun ak'wal chi'.
Ix pet k'e waan winh, ix b'at lemnaj winh t'a sti' b'aj makb'il nok' choj chi'.

Ayic ix k'och winh t'a slak'anil chi', ix awaj winh t'a winhaj Daniel chi'. Cuseltac ix yutej awaj sb'a winh, ix yalan winh: --Daniel, ach schekab' jun Dios pitzan, aton jun Dios tzak'nhej serwil ¿ix am yal ach skolanel a Diosal t'a nok' choj chi'? xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Daniel chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, ayokab' opisio t'a junelnhej.

Ix schekkot jun yángel in Diosal yik smakan sti' nok' choj tik. Yuj chi' malaj wal jab'ok tas ix in yutej nok', yujto yojtak to malaj jab'ok in mul t'a yichanh. Malaj pax tas chuk ix in k'ulej t'ayach, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix te tzalajk'e winh rey chi', ix schekan winh ik'chajk'eta winhaj Daniel b'aj ay nok' choj chi'. Axo yik ix k'eul winh, ix yilan heb' to malaj jab'ok b'aj ix lajwi winh, yujto a sDiosal winh ayoch yipok sk'ool.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh rey chi' to sb'at ik'jikot heb' winh ix alank'e jun lolonel t'a spatik winhaj Daniel chi'. Ix yumjikanem heb' winh t'a skal nok' choj chi' yet' yetb'eyum yet' yalyuninal junjun heb' winh. Manto emk'ochlaj heb' t'a skal nok', ix k'eta tzakaljok nok' t'a heb', chok' ix aj heb' yuj nok'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an tz'ib'chaj winhaj rey Darío jun tik t'a masanil anima yalnhej tas ti'al ay t'a yol smakb'en chi'. Ix yalanb'at winh icha tik: Junk'olalokab' eyaji.

Swalan t'ayex he masanil t'a yol in makb'en, niwanokab' yelk'och sDiosal winhaj Daniel t'a yol he sat. Yujto a sDiosal winh chi', pitzan toni, aynhejek' t'a junelnhej. Ha yopisio, malaj b'ak'uinh ol satelok, malaj slajwub'.
Ha Jun Colwajum chi', a skolan heb' yik yet' spoder. Sch'oxan tas satub'tak t'a satcha’anh yet' t'a sat lu'um tik. Ha ix kolanel winhaj Daniel t'a nok' choj, xchib'at winh rey chi'.
Aynhejoch winhaj Daniel chi' t'a yopisio ayik ayoch winhaj Darío t'a reyal yet' pax yik ayoch winhaj Ciro aj Persia reyal.

Ha t'a yik b'ab'el ab'il yoch winhaj Belsasar reyal t'a Babilonia, ay jun ak'wal, ay juntzanh tas ix ak'ji wil a in Daniel tik t'a in wayich. Axo ix in k'e waan, ix in tz'ib'an tastak niwan yelk'och t'a in wayich chi'. Aton juntzanh tik ix in tz'ib'ejkani:
Ix wil t'a in wayich to ha t'a schanh pak'anhil yol yib'anhk’inal, ix kot ponhnaj ik' t'a yib'anh ha ha', ix ib'xik'e ha' niwan mar chi' yuj.
Axo ix aji, ix cheklajk'e chanhwanh nok' niwak nok' t'a yol ha' mar chi', ch'okch'ok yilji junjun nok'.

Ha jun nok' ix b'ab'laj k'euli, lajan yilji nok' icha nok' choj, palta ay sk'axil nok' icha yik nok' d'iw. Ayic wan wilan nok' chi', ix jekchitajel sk'axil nok' chi'. Ix ak'chajk'e linhan t'a sat lu'um, icha tz'ajk'e linhan anima ix ajk'ei. Ix k'exwi spensar, icha spensar anima ix aji.

Axo nok' schab'il, lajan yilji nok' icha nok' oso, tz'eyank'e jun pak'anh sniwanil nok' t'a yichanh junxo pak'anh. Ha t'a yol sti' nok', ay oxe' b'aquil kostil. Ix wab'an yalchaj t'a nok': Ixic, tza chi'an jantak chib'ej snib'ej a k'ool, xchi t'a nok'.
Axo nok' yoxil, lajan yilji nok' icha nok' tz'ib'choj. Ay chanhe' sk'axil nok' t'a snanhal yich spatik. Ix wilanpaxi to ay chanhe' sjolom nok', ix ak'chaj spoder nok' yak'an yajalil.

Axo nok' schanhil ix wil t'a in wayich chi', te chuklaj yilji nok'. Te ay smay quilan nok', te ay yip nok'. Te niwak k'een ye nok', nab'a hierro. Chok' tz'aj masanil tas yuj nok', sb'uk'anem nok', haxo jantakto skan yuj nok', stek'kanem nok'. Yelxo te ch'ok yilji jun nok' chi' t'a yichanh juntzanhxo nok' ix wil t'a sb'ab'elal. Ay lajunhe' sch'aak nok'.

Yakb'an k'elan in och t'a juntzanh sch'aak nok' chi', ix wilani, ix k'eul junxo syune' ch'aak nok' t'a skal juntzanhxo chi'. Ayic ix k'eul junxo sch'aak nok' chi', ix stenankanel oxe' ch'aak aytaxon chi'. Axonhej jun chi' ix kan sk'exulok juntzanh chi'. Ha jun ch'aak chi', ay yol sat yet' sti' icha yik anima, ix yik'chaanh sb'a yet' tas ix yala'.

Ix wilannhej, masanto ix ak'chajem juntzanh k'ojnub' yik heb' yajal, haxo Dios, Jun Aytaxoneq'ui, ix em k'ojan t'a sk'ojnub'. Te sak yilji spichul icha yilji k'een sakb'akom. Axo xil sjolom, te sak yilji icha nok' saksak lana. Ha sk'ojnub' chi' yet' sruedail, ichato sk'e nhilnhon sk'ak'al.

Ay jun k'ak' tz'elta t'a yichanh icha sb'ey ha ha'. Ha heb' tz'ak'an serwil, linhanoch heb' t'a yichanh, millonalxo sb'isul heb'. Ixlajwi chi' ix el yich sch'olb'itaj juntzanh nakión, ix jakwi juntzanh ch'anh libro.

Q'uelan innhejoch yuj juntzanh b'uchwal lolonel wan yalan jun yune' ch'aak chi'. Yakb'an wan wilan chi', ix mak'jicham jun nok' chi'. Chok'xonhej ix aj nok', ix yumjib'at nok' t'a skal k'ak', ix tz'ab'at nok'.
Axo juntzanhxo nok' chi', ix ik'chajek' yopisio nok', palta ixto chajiek' nok' jab'okxo.
Ix wilannhej t'a in wayich chi': Ix wilani to ay jun mach ix kot t'a skal asun, lajan yilji icha anima. Ix k'och b'aj ayek' Dios Jun Aytaxonek' chi', ix och t'a yichanh.
Ix ak'chaj yopisio, spoder yet' sniwanil yelk'ochi. Masanil anima, yalnhej tas ti'al tz'ak'an serwil. Ha spoder aynhejek' t'a junelnhej, malaj b'ak'uinh ol lajwok yopisio chi'.
Ix in xiwkank'ei ayik ix wilan juntzanh tik, ix somchaj in pensar yuj.
Ix in och t'a stz'ey junok linhanoch ta', ix in k'anb'an t'ay tas syalelk'och juntzanh chi'. Ix tak'wi t'ayin icha tik:
Ha chanhwanh nok' nok' ix il chi', aton chanhe' nakión ol cheklajk'e t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik.
Ayic ol lajwoquek' juntzanh nakión chi', a heb' yikxo Dios, Jun Te Niwan Yelk'ochi, ol ak'jokkanoch heb' yajalil t'a junelnhej, manhxalaj b'ak'uinh ol ik'joquek' yopisio heb' chi', xchi.

Ix in k'anb'ejxi t'ay, tas yaj nok' schanhil nok' chi', te ch'ok yilji nok' t'a yichanh juntzanhxo nok' chi'. Nab'a hierro k'een ye nok', nab'a bronke yech nok'. Masanil tas chok' tz'aj yuj nok', sturanb'at nok', haxo jantakto skani, stek'kanem nok'.

Anhejtona', ix in k'anb'ejpaxi tas syalelk'och lajunhe' sch'aak nok' chi' yet' junxo sch'aak nok' tzak'anto ix k'eul chi', jun ix tenanel oxexo ayik ix k'euli. Te niwan pax yelk'och t'a yichanh juntzanhxo ch'aak chi'. Ha jun toto ix k'eul chi', ay yol sat, ay pax sti', syalan b'uchwal lolonel.
Ix wilani to a jun ch'aak chi', syak' owal yet' heb' yikxo Dios. Ix ak'ji ganar heb' yuj,
masanto ix k'och Dios, Jun Aytaxoneq'ui. Ix sb'oan yaj t'a heb', yujto ix k'och sk'ual schaan yopisio heb'.

Ix yalan t'ayin icha tik: Ha nok' schanhil chi', aton jun schanhil nakión ol cheklajk'e t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik. Ch'ok yel t'a yichanh juntzanhxo nakión ol ek'ok. Ol smaquek' masanil yol yib'anhk’inal tik, ol yak'an yajalil t'a malaj yok'elk'olal.

Ha lajunhe' sch'aak chi', aton lajunhwanh heb' winh yajal. Ha heb' winh ol ak'an yajalil t'a lajunh makan yaj jun nakión chi'. Ha t'a skal juntzanh heb' winh chi', ol k'e waan junxo rey te ch'ok yel t'a yichanh juntzanhxo heb' winh t'a sb'ab'elal chi', ol ik'joquel oxwanhok heb' winh rey chi' t'a yopisio yuj.

Ol te b'uchwaj d'ha Dios Te Niwan Yelk'ochi, ol yixtejnhej heb' yikxo Dios chi'. Ol yak'lan sk'exan juntzanh ley yet' juntzanh q'uinh alb'ilkan yuj Dios. Ol ak'chajkan heb' yikxo Dios chi' t'a yol sk'ab' t'a nanhal schanhil ab'il.
Palta ayik ol jawok sk'ual, ol ch'olb'itajok, ol ik'chajel spoder chi', ol satel t'a junelnhej.

Axo yajalil yet' spoder yet' sniwanil yelk'och juntzanh nakión t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, ol ak'chaj t'a heb' yikxo Dios chi', aton Jun Te Niwan Yelk'ochi. Ha Dios ol ak'an yajalil t'a junelnhej. Masanil heb' ayoch yajalil t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik ol ak'an serwil, ol sk'anab'ajan heb' t'ay, xchi t'ayin.
Aton slajwub'al juntzanh tas ix alchajkan t'ayin a in Daniel in tik. Ix te somchaj in k'ool. Ix tup in chiq'uil yuj xiwelal, palta malaj junok mach b'aj ix wal juntzanh lolonel tik.
Ha t'a yoxil ab'il yoch winhaj Belsasar reyal, ay juntzanhxo tas ix ak'ji wila'', ayik toxo ix ak'ji wil juntzanh t'a sb'ab'elal.
Ha ix aj wilani, ichato ayinek' t'a chonhab' Susa, t'a yol yik Elam, t'a sti' ha' Ulai.
Axo ix wilani, ay jun nok' ch'ak kalnel ayek' t'a sti' ha' chi'. Ay chab' sch'aak nok' niwak steel, palta ay jun sch'ak nok' chi' tzak'anto ix k'euli, te niwan steel t'a yichanh junxo chi'.

Axo ix wilani, a yet' sch'ak jun nok' kalnel chi', ix yak' lajwok tastak ay t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u yet' t'a norte yet' pax t'a sur. Malaj junokxo nok' syal stek'b'an sb'ha t'a yichanh, malaj mach syal skolanelta sb'ha t'a yol sk'ab'. Sk'ulejnhej tas snib'ej. Ix yik' wal chaanh sb'a.

Vanto in naan yuj tas ix wil chi', haxo ix wilani, ay jun nok' mam chiwa wan sjawi t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u. Yelk'olal skot nok', icha wal to max em jab'ok yok nok' t'a sat lu'um. Ha jun nok' chiwa chi', ay wal jun sch'aak nok' te chequel. Ha t'a skal yol sat nok' ayk'eta.
Ayic ix k'och nok' t'a slak'anil nok' kalnel chab' sch'aak chi', nok' ix wil t'a sti' ha ha', ix b'at juknaj nok' t'a nok' yet' jantak yowal sk'ool.

Ix smak'an kanhchaj sch'aak nok' kalnel chi' nok' schab'il. Manhxalaj yip nok' kalnel chi' yik stek'b'ej sb'ha t'a yichanh nok' chiwa chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix telwi nok' yuj nok' chiwa chi' t'a sat lu'um, ix tek'jiem etzan nok' yuj nok'. Malaj mach ix yal skolan nok'.

Axo nok' mam chiwa chi', ix ste wach' ik'ejchaanh sb'a nok'. Axo ix aji, ayik te tek'an nok' chi', ix kanhchajb'at jun sch'aak nok' te niwan chi', haxo chanhexo sch'aak nok' ix k'eul sk'exulok jun chi'. Ayic ix k'eul sch'aak nok' chi', ix b'atkan k'elan junjun ch'aak chi' t'a stojolal schanhil pak'anh yol yib'anhk’inal tik.

Ha t'a junok juntzanh ch'aak chi', ix pak'elta junxo yune' ch'aak. Ha jun chi', te niwan ix aji yet' yipalil ix smak juntzanh lugar t'a sur yet' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u. Ix smakpax lum lum te nib'ab'il.
Yelxo te chaanh ix aj sq'uib'i, masanto ix k'ek'och b'aj ay k'een k'anal. Ix syumanemta jayeok k'een k'anal chi', ix stek'anem k'een t'a sat lu'um.
Ix stek'b'an sb'ha t'a yichanh winh yajalil heb' ay t'a satcha’anh chi'. Ix skachanoch waan yak'chaj silab' tz'ak'ji d'ha Dios t'a junjun k'u. Ix yixtanb'at b'aj tz'ochtaxon ejmelal d'ha Dios chi'.

Ha yuj schuk pensaril jun yajal chi', ix yak'och soldado b'aj tz'ak'jitaxon silab' t'a junjun k'u yet' skachjioch waan yak'ji silab' chi'. Ix satanel jun ejmelal wach' alb'ilkan yuj Dios. Ichato chi' b'ian ix sk'ulan tas snib'ej.

Ixlajwi chi', ix wab'ani to ay jun ángel sk'anb'an t'a junxo ángel icha tik: ¿Jantacto tiempo yik ol lajwok juntzanh squil tik? ¿Jantacto tiempo ol yak' jun yajb'il yuj Dios tik sk'exan silab' tz'ak'jitaxon t'a junjun k'u? ¿B'aq'uinh ol och waan stek'jiem heb' soldado yik satcha’anh yet' jun Lugar Yicnhej Dios Yaji? xchi.

Ix tak'wi junxo ángel chi' icha tik: Ato yik ol lajwoquek' 2,300 el manh ol ak'chaj silab' t'a yemk'ualil yet' t'a q'uinhib'alil. Ato ta' ol lajwok juntzanh chi'. Ichato chi', ol ik'joquel jun tas manh wach'ok ayoch t'a Lugar Yicnhej Dios Yaji, xchi jun ángel chi'.
Ha in Daniel in tik, wanto in naan tas ix wil chi', yik snachajel wuuj tas syalelk'ochi. Axo ix wilani, ay jun icha yilji anima ix sch'oxk'e sb'ha t'a wichanh.
Ix wab'an yoch jun aw skot t'a sti' ha' Ulai, icha wal sjaj anima, ix yalan icha tik: Gabriel, wach' alej t'a jun winh winak tik yik snachajel yuj winh tas ix yil chi', xchi.

Axo ix jawi ángel Gabriel chi' t'a in tz'ey. Ix in em kumnajok, ix emk'och snanhal in sat t'a sat lu'um yuj xiwelal. Ix yalan t'ayin: Ach anima, ojtaquejeli to a tas ix il chi', ato t'a slajwub' tiempoal ol ujok, xchi.
Ayic wanto slolon chi' t'ayin, ix in ek' lian t'a sat lu'um. Ix satel in k'ool, yuj chi' ix och yub'naj t'ayin, ix in squetzank'e linhan.
Ix yalan t'ayin: Ol wal t'ayach tas ol ujok ayik toxo ol lajwok yowal sk'ol Dios. Ha jun tas ix il chi', a lajwub' k'ual sch'oxkoti.
Ha nok' kalnel chab' sch'ak ix il chi', aton heb' winh sreyal Media yet' Persia sch'ox nok'.
Axo pax nok' mam chiwa ix il chi', aton winh sreyal Grecia sch'ox nok'. Ha jun sch'aak nok' niwaquil ayk'eta t'a skal yol sat, a jun winh b'ab'el rey sch'oxo'.
Ha chanhe' ch'aak ix k'eul sk'exulok jun ix kanhchajb'at chi', syalelk'ochi to ol spoj snanhal jun nakión chi'. Chanhe' nakional ol ajelk'ochok, palta manh lajanok yip yet' jun b'ab'el.
Ayic toxo ol lajwoquek' yopisio juntzanh nakión chi', ayik ol tz'akwok chukalil t'a yichanh Dios, ay jun rey ol ak'an yajalil, malaj tz'och tas t'ay, te jelan yak'an musansatil.

Ol yik' wal yip sik'lab'il, palta manhok yet' yip t'a yol yiko'. Satub'tak ol yutej satanel tastak. Wach' ol elk'och t'a tas ol sk'ulej. Ol ak'jok ganar heb' soldado te ay yip yuj yet' heb' yikxo Dios.

Yuj sjelanil, ol yal yixtan heb' anima, ol ste ik'ejchaanh sb'a. Tzijtum anima ol sateli ayik malaj jab'ok tas sna heb'. Ol stek'b'ej sb'ha t'a yichanh Dios, Jun Yajalil heb' yajal. Wach'chom icha chi' ol yutok sb'a, palta ol satjoquelok, manh yujok spoder anima.

Ha tas ix il t'a silab' tz'ak'ji t'a yemk'ualil yet' t'a q'uinhib'alil, tik wal ix wach' alchajel t'ayach. Ha jun chi' yowalil ol elk'ochok. Kanokab'nhej t'a a pensar, malajokab' b'aj tzala', yujto a juntzanh chi', ol elk'ochok ayik te niwanxo tiempo ol ek'ok, xchi ángel Gabriel chi'.

Ha inxo Daniel in tik, ix te el wip ix wab'i. Ix in penaayax jaye' k'ual. Ixlajwi chi', ix in k'e waan, ix b'at wilanxi wopisio ayoch yuj winh rey. Palta te ilk'olal waj yuj jun ix ch'oxchaj wil chi', yujto max nachajel wuj tas wal syalelk'ochi.

Ha winhaj Darío yuninal winhaj Asuero yinhtilal heb' medo, ix och winh reyal t'a smakb'en heb' kaldeo. Ha t'a b'ab'el ab'il yoch winh t'a yajalil chi', a in Daniel in tik, wan in k'ayb'an juntzanh ch'anh libro b'aj lolonnak Jehová t'a winhaj Jeremías, aton winh schekab'. Yuj chi' ix nachajel wuuj to a Jerusalén, 70 ab'il ol kan tzinan.
Yuj chi' ix in lesalwi, ix in tewi d'ha Dios Kajal. Ix in ochpax t'a tzek'ojk'olal. Ix wak'anoch pichul yik tzek'ojk'olal chi', ix in em k'ojan t'a skal k'een tik'aq'uil taanh.

Ix in lesalwi t'a Jehová in Diosal, ix walan in b'a t'ay icha tik: Mamin, Vajal ach, te niwan elk'ochi, te satub'tak yilji a poder. Tzak'elk'och a trato yik tzak'an a wach'k'olal t'a heb' tzach xajanani, aton heb' sk'anab'ajan a cheknab'il.
Ix och ko chukal yet' ko pital t'ayach. Axonhej chukal ix ko k'ulej. Ix ko patiquejkanel a cheknab'il yet' a k'ayb'ub'al.
Maj ko maklej kab' tas ix yal heb' a chekab'. Yalnac a lolonel heb' t'a heb' ko reyal, t'a heb' yajal yaj t'a ko kal, t'a heb' ko mam quicham yet' t'a masanil heb' quetchonhab'.

Ach Mamin Kajal, te tojol a pensar, xal onh israel onh tik, q'uixwelaltak kajek' skab'i. Ha heb' kotnak t'a Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén yet' juntzanhxo heb' quetisraelal kajan t'a najat yet' t'a lak'an, ix onh a saklemejkanb'ati, yujto manh k'anab'ajumok ix kutej ko b'a t'ayach.
Ha onh tik Mamin Jehová, q'uixawtak ko k'ool t'a ichanh, yujto ix och ko mul t'ayach yet' pax heb' ko reyal, heb' yajal yaj t'a ko kal yet' pax heb' ko mam quicham.
Palta a ach tik Mamin, ko Diosal ach, te ay ok'elk'olal yet' a niwank'olal, wach'chom a onh tik axonhej pitalil sko k'ulej t'a ichanh.
Mamin Jehová ko Diosal, maj ach ko k'anab'ajej icha ix aj a chekan yal heb' a chekab' t'ayonh.

Ha onh tik, ko masanil ix ko tenek' a cheknab'il, ix ach ko patiquejeli, manhxalaj ko gana ix kab' tas ix ala'. Yuj ko mul chi', ix jawi masanil juntzanh yaelal t'a quib'anh, aton tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a yol ch'anh libro stz'ib'ejnakkan winh a chekab' aj Moisés.
Toxo ix elk'och tas ix ala' to ol jawok t'a quib'anh a onh tik yet' t'a heb' kajalil. Te niwan ix aj ak'an syaelal Jerusalén t'a yichanh juntzanhxo chonhab'.

Masanil juntzanh yaelal tz'ib' yajkan t'a ch'anh libro yuj winhaj Moisés, ix jawi t'a quib'anh tiknaik. Palta anhej t'a spatik chukal ix onh b'atkani, majxo ko k'anab'ajej a lolonel yik tzak' a wach'k'olal t'ayonh.
Yuj wal chi' Mamin Jehová ko Diosal, ix a na' ak'kot jun niwan yaelal tik t'a quib'anh. Ha ach tik, tojol ach t'a masanil tas tza k'ulej, a onhxo tik, maj ko b'alaj chaej kab' t'ayach.

Ach ko Diosal Kajal ach, a ch'oxnak wal a niwan poder ayik ik'annaquelta heb' ko mam quicham t'a Egipto. Yuj chi' te b'inajnak ach masanto tiknaik, palta a onh tik jun, ix och ko mul, anhej chukal sko k'ulej.

Mamin Kajal, kojtak to tza k'ulejnhej tas tzala'. Yuj chi' elok wal t'a a k'ol ik'anel yaelal yet' yowal a k'ol ayoch t'a yib'anh chonhab' Jerusalén, yujto a chonhab' yaji, ikpax yaj tzalan Sion. Masanil nakión ay t'a slak'anil sb'uchwaj heb' t'a a chonhab' chi', yujnhej ko chukal yet' yuj schukal heb' ko mam quicham.
Ach ko Diosal, ab' wal in lesal yet' b'aj tzin tewi a in a chekab' in tik. Yuj wal a b'inaji, ch'ox a wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh a templo tzinan yajkani.
Cha ab' Mamin, ilnab' wal tas yaji, tzinan yajkan jun a chonhab' sb'inaj to ik yaji. Manh yujok ko wach'il t'a yol quiko' tzonh tewi t'ayach, palta a wal yuj a niwan wach'k'olal.

Mamin Cajalil, tak'wej onh, ak' lajwok ko chukal. Cotanh, kolwajanh qued'ok. Yuj wal a b'inajnaquil, mokab' ek' tiempo onh a kolani, yujto ojtakab'il to ik onh yet' a chonhab' Jerusalén, xin chi t'a in lesal chi'.
Yakb'an wannhej in lesalwi, wan walank'eta in mul yet' smul heb' wetchonhab' israel, tzin tewioch t'a Jehová in Diosal yuj tzalan Sion yiknhej yaji.
Yakb'an wan in lesalwi chi', haxo ángel Gabriel, jun sch'oxnak sb'a t'ayin t'a yalanhtaxo, ix jawi jenhenhok b'aj ayinek' chi', ichawal yorail yik tz'ak'ji silab' t'a Jehová t'a yemk'ualil.
Ix yalan t'ayin icha tik: Daniel, tzin jawi t'ayach yik tzul wak'an a jelanil yik snachajel uuj tas ol jawok t'a yib'anh heb' etchonhab'.

Ayic ix a yamanoch a lesalwi, ha Dios ix pakan a lesal chi', yuj chi' tzin jawi ul wal t'ayach, yujto te xajan ach yuj Dios. Ha tiknaik, maklej ab' tas ol wal t'ayach yik ol nachajel uuj tas ol ak'jok il tik.

Ol ek' 70 semana t'a yib'anh heb' etisraelal yet' t'a yib'anh a chonhab' to yiknhej Dios yaji, masanto yik ol lajwoquek' pitalil yet' chukal, haxo yak'ji tup masanil mul, ata', tojolnhej ol aj t'a smasanil tiempo. Ol elk'och masanil tas ix ch'oxji yil heb' schekab' Dios yet' tas alb'ilkan yuj heb'. Ol ak'chajoch jun lugar yiknhej Dios yaj t'a yopisio.

Yowalil ol nachajel jun tik uuj: Ayic ol alchajok to ol b'ochajxik'e chonhab' Jerusalén, ol ek' uque' semana b'ab'el, slajwi chi' ol ek' pax 62 semana. Ichato chi' ol ja jun Yajal to sik'b'ileli. Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', ol b'ochajxik'e skalleal yet' smuroal Jerusalén chi' t'a skal jantak yaelal.

Ayic toxo ix lajwiek' 62 semana chi', ol miljokcham jun Yajal sik'b'ilel chi', ichato malaj tas syik'a'. Slajwi chi' ol juchajem templo yet' chonhab' Jerusalén yuj heb' anima ayoch yet' jun yajal ol jawok. Icha wal yel ha' eluma', icha chi' ol aj slajwiel Jerusalén chi'. Ha tas nab'il yuj Dios, ol ochnhej owal yet' somchajb'ail masanto t'a slajwub' k'ual.

Ha jun yajal ol jawok chi', tzijtum heb' anima ol yak' pural yik sb'oan strato yet'ok t'a junok semana, palta t'a wal snanhalb'i jun semana chi', haxo skachanoch waan yak'chaj silab' yet' ofrenda d'ha Dios. Axo jun yajal chuk chi', ol yak'och tas to yajb'il yuj Dios t'a yol templo. Aynhejek' ta', masanto ol yak'kot Dios tas nab'il yuj t'a yib'anh jun yajal chuk chi', xchi ángel Gabriel chi' t'ayin.

Ha t'a yoxil ab'il yoch winhaj Ciro reyal t'a Persia, ix alchajxi slolonel Dios t'ayin Daniel in tik, Beltsasar pax in b'i. Icha wayich ix aj yalji t'ayin. Ha jun tas ix wab' chi', te yel, syal yuj jun niwan owal, palta ix nachajel wuuj tas syalelk'ochi.
Ha t'a juntzanh k'ual chi', oxe' semana ix in och t'a kusk'olal.
Malaj wael wach' ix in wa''a, maj in nib'ej jab'ok chib'ej, maj wuk' pax wino, malaj wal jab'ok perfume ix wak'och t'ayin, masanto ix ek' oxe' semana chi'.
Ayic 24 yoch b'ab'el uj t'a yik ab'il chi', ayinek' t'a sti' ha' niwan Tigris.
Ix in b'at k'elan, ix wilan jun winh winak ayoch spichul nab'a lino yet' jun stzek'ul nab'a oro te wach'.

Toxonhej skopopi sniwanil icha k'een topakio, toxonhej kopopi yilji sat icha lheb'lon. Ha yol sat, sk'e nhilnhon yok icha te' k'ak'. Ha sk'ab' yet' yok, kopopi yilji icha k'een bronke wach' yaj snhikchaji, haxo sjaj, ichawal yoch sjaj junok niwan nhilanh anima.
Ha innhej ix yal wilan jun chi', haxo masanil heb' anima ayek' wed'ok, maj yil-laj heb', yujto ix jawi xiwelal t'a heb', ix b'at heb' sk'ub'ejel sb'a.
Ha inxonhej ayinek' in ch'okoj ayik ix wilan jun chi', ix tup in chiq'uil, manhxa wip ix wab'i.
Ayic ix wab'an slolonk'e jun chi', ix te pax wip, ix satel in k'ool, ix in em nhojnaj t'a sat lu'um.
Axo ix aji, ix och yub'yub' jun k'ab' t'ayin, ix in squetzank'e waan, masanto ix yal in k'e kuman yet' sjolom in penek yet' in k'ab'.

Ix yalan t'ayin icha tik: Daniel, ach xajanab'il yuj Dios, schamwal ab'an tas ol wala'. Q'ueanh waan, yujto in chekjikot t'ayach, xchi. Ha wal yik ix lajwi yalan juntzanh lolonel chi', toxonhej tzin lukloni, ix in k'e linhan.

Ichato chi' ix yalan t'ayin: Daniel, manh ach xiwok. Yictax ix a chaanel yich och ejmelal, yik tza k'anan a jelanil, yik snachajel tas ajaltak uuj, ha Dios ix ab'an a lesal. Yuj chi' in chekjikot t'ayach.

Ha jun ángel yajal yaj t'a yol yik Persia, ha' ix in yamanoch waan t'a 21 k'ual. Axo pax Miguel, aton jun sat ángel yaji, ha' ix jawi yik skolwaj wed'ok, ix kan yak' owal yet' jun yajalil Persia chi'.
Yuj chi' a tiknaik, tzul wak' nachajel uuj tas ol ek' t'a yib'anh a chonhab' tik t'a slajwub' tiempoal. Ha jun ol ch'oxchaj ila', a yuj tas ol ujok t'a slajwub' tiempoal syala', xchi.
Ayic wan yalan juntzanh lolonel chi' t'ayin, majxo yal-laj in loloni, toxonhej ix in em k'elan t'a sat lu'um.

Axo ix aji, ay jun lajan yilji icha anima, elanhchamel ix syam in ti'. Axo ix walan t'a jun linhanoch t'a wichanh chi': Mamin, a yuj jun tas ix wil tik, ix och wal pitz'an t'a in k'ool, manhxalaj wip swab'i.
Mamin, ¿tas wal ol aj in lolon ed'ok a in a chekab' in tik, yujto manhxalaj wip, maxtzak yal-laj wik'an wik' swab'i? xin chi.
Axo jun lajan yilji icha anima chi', ix ochxi yamyam t'ayin, ix wik'anxi wip.

Ix yalan t'ayin icha tik: Manh ach xiwok, manh ak' pensar. Te xajan ach yuj Dios. Anhej to tza tek'b'ej a b'a, xchi. Yakb'an wanto slolon chi' t'ayin, ix wik'an wal wip ix wab'i, ix walani: Mamin, lolonanh t'ayin, yujto ix ochxi wip junelxo uuj, xin chi t'ay.

Ix yalan t'ayin: ¿Ojtac ama tas yuj tzin jawi t'ayach? Ol wal t'ayach tas tz'ib'ab'ilem t'a yol ch'anh libro to yel. Ha tiknaik ol wak'pax owal yet' jun ángel yajal yaj t'a Persia. Ayic ol lajwok wak'an owal chi' yet'ok, ol ja jun ángel yajal yaj t'a Grecia. Ha t'a jun owal chi', anhej wal Miguel skolwaj wed'ok, aton jun ángel yajal yaj t'a a chonhab' Israel.
Ha in ix in ochpax yet' winhaj Darío sreyal Media t'a b'ab'el ab'il yoch winh reyal chi', xchi.

Ix yalanxi t'ayin: Ha tiknaik, ol wak' ojtaquejel tas d'inhan ol ujok. Ayto och oxwanh heb' winh rey t'a Persia, slajwi chi' ol och junxo winh schanhil rey. Ha jun winh chi', más te b'eyum winh t'a yichanh heb' oxwanh chi'. Ha yuj sb'eyumal winh chi', ol yik' yip winh, ol yak'an wal owal winh yet' winh sreyal Grecia.
Slajwi chi', ol och jun winh sreyal Grecia chi', te ak'um owal. Ol te lewanb'ok smakb'en chi', ol sk'ulan masanil tas snib'ej.

Palta ayik toxo ix yik' yip yopisio winh chi', chanhpoj ol ajkanb'atok. Ha yopisio jun winh rey chi', manh ol b'eynhejb'at t'a heb' yinhtilal. Ol el yip yopisio winh chi', manhxo lajanok ol aj yip icha t'a sb'ab'elal, yujto chanhpoj ol ajok, ch'okxo pax mach ol ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.

Ha jun winh ol ochkan sreyalok sur, ol ste ik'ej yip winh, palta a junokxo winh yajal soldado te niwan ol aj yopisio t'a yichanh jun winh sreyal sur chi', ol yak'an yajalil winh t'a jun makb'en te lewan chi'.

Axo yik ol ek' jayeok ab'il, a heb' winh chawanh rey chi', ol sb'o junok strato heb' winh. Ha jun winh sreyal sur chi', ol yak'b'at junok yisil winh t'a winh sreyal norte, yik wach' ay junk'olal t'a skal chab' makb'en chi'. Palta manh ol yal yuj ix yik'an b'ey jun trato yet' winh yetb'eyum chi'. Yuj chi' ol miljokcham ix yet' winh yet' yune' ix yet' pax heb' schekab' ix.
Palta ay junok sk'ab' yok ix ol och reyal, ol yak'an owal yet' heb' soldado yik norte. Ol ak'jok ganar heb' yuj yet' chonhab' b'aj kajan jun winh sreyal norte chi'.

Ol yik'b'at sdiosal heb' ay t'a norte chi' t'a Egipto, aton juntzanh b'ob'il t'a k'een k'een yet' juntzanh syamk'ab' heb' nab'a oro yet' plata. Ol ek'b'at jayeok ab'il, malaj owal ol och t'a skal heb'.
Ol lajwok chi', a jun winh sreyal norte chi', ol yak' owal winh yet' jun winh sreyal sur chi', palta manh ol yal-laj yuj winh, ol meltzaj winh t'a schonhab'.

Palta haxo heb' yuninal winh sreyal norte chi', ol k'e waan heb' yak' owal. Manh jantakok sb'isul soldado heb' ol smolb'ej. Ha junok heb' yuninal winh chi' ol b'at yet' heb' soldado yak' owal yet' winh sreyal sur chi' yik syak'an ganar yalani. Ol ek'b'at heb' icha junok eluma', masanto ol k'och heb' t'a schonhab' winh sreyal sur chi'.
Yuj chi' ol te kot yowal winh sreyal sur chi'. Ol elta winh yak' owal t'a jun nhilanh soldado ajk'ol chi', ol satjoquel heb' smasanil yuj winh.
Yujto ol satel jun nhilanh heb' ajk'ol chi' yuj winh, ol yik'anchaanh sb'a winh, tzijtumto juntzanhxo heb' ajk'ool ol smilcham winh, palta manh niwanok tiempo ol yak' yopisio winh chi'.

Ayic ol ek'b'at jayeok ab'il, a winh sreyal norte chi', te ek'b'al niwan heb' soldado ol smolb'ej winh t'a yichanh heb' ix smolb'ej t'a sb'ab'elal, ol b'atxok winh yak' owal yet' winh sreyal sur chi', yet'nak syamk'ab' heb' yik owal smasanil.

Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', tzijtum heb' ol och ajk'olal t'a winh sreyal sur chi'. Ha t'a skal heb' chi', ay juntzanh heb' etisraelal te chuk spensar, ol spak sb'a heb' yik tz'elk'och tas ak'b'il yil heb' snaani, palta manh ol yak'laj ganar heb'.

Ol jawok winh sreyal norte chi', ol och oyan soldado t'a spatiktak jun chonhab' te tek'an, ol ak'jok ganar jun chonhab' chi' yuj heb'. Ha heb' soldado te jelan yik sur, manh ol yal-laj stek'b'an sb'a heb' t'a yichanh winh ajk'ol chi'.

Ha winh ol ak'an ganar chi', ol sk'ulejnhej winh tas snib'ej t'a jun winh ol ak'jok ganar chi'. Manhxalaj mach ol yal stek'b'an sb'ha t'a yichanh winh. Ol kan winh t'a sat lum lum te wach', aton Israel, ol satanel winh jantaknhej tas snib'ej.

Ol yak' yip winh yet' heb' soldado yik'anek' slum winh sreyal sur chi'. Ol yak'an jun strato winh yet' winh rey chi', ol yak'anb'at junok yisil winh yetb'eyumok jun winh rey chi', yik syak'an ganar winh yalani, palta manh ol elk'ochlaj icha tas sna winh chi'.

Ol lajwok chi', ol yak'an owal winh yet' juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a stitak ha' mar. Tzijtum heb' ol ak'jok ganar yuj winh, palta ay jun yajal soldado ol kachan wanaj winh, icha chi' ol aj yel sq'uixwelal winh sreyal norte chi'.
Ol lajwok chi', ol meltzaj winh t'a smakb'en b'aj ay juntzanh schonhab', te ay yip, palta ol ak'jok ganar, ol satelok.

Ch'okxo junxo winh rey ol ochkan sk'exulok winh, a jun winh chi', ol schekb'at junok mach winh, b'at sk'ananel tumin syak' heb' t'a winh, yik sk'ek'och winh yet' yopisio chi' snaani. Palta jayeanto k'ual yoch winh t'a yopisio chi', ol miljokcham winh, manhok t'a skal owal ol cham winh.

Ol lajwok chi', ay jun winh te malaj yelk'och ol och reyal sk'exulok winh. Ha jun winh chi', manh smojok yoch winh t'a yopisio. Manh naanok yuj heb' anima ayik ol och winh reyal chi' yuj yak'an musansatil heb' anima chi'.
Masanil heb' ajk'ol yajoch t'a winh, ol satel heb' yuj winh, ol satpaxel winh sat sakerdote yik Dios.
Ol ak'jokpax musansatil heb' yuj winh, aton heb' ol yak'lej sb'oan strato yet' winh t'a wach'ilal. Wach'chom quennhej anima ayoch yet' winh, palta ol yak'nhej ganar winh.

Ayic manh naanok yuj heb' anima chi', ol och winh t'a sat sluum heb', aton lum te wach'. Ol sk'ulejnhej winh tastak to maj sk'ulej heb' smam yicham. Masanil tas ol yik' winh t'a owal chi', ol spojek' winh t'a skal heb' ajun yet'ok. Ol snib'ej winh yak' owal yet' juntzanh chonhab' to tek'an, palta manh niwanok tiempo ol yal yuj winh.

Ol yak'och sjelanil winh chi' yipok sk'ool, ol yak'an owal winh yet' winh sreyal sur. Niwan sb'isul soldado ol och yet' winh, palta a winh sreyal sur chi' yet' wal yip yet' pax soldado te jelan ol yak'an owal yet' winh. Palta manh ol yal-laj stek'b'an sb'a heb' soldado chi', yujto tonhej ol ak'jok musansatil winh sreyal sur chi'.
Ha heb' yetyajalil winh sreyal sur chi' awtab'il wael yuj t'a smexa, ipan heb' ol meltzajoch ajk'olal t'ay. Ol lajwoquel heb' soldado chi', tzijtum heb' ol chamok.

Ha tas nab'il yuj chawanh heb' winh rey chi', anhej yak'an chukal heb' t'ay junjun. Ol mol em k'ojan heb' wael t'a smexa. Ol yak'an es heb' t'ay junjun, palta malaj junok heb' ol elk'och tas snib'ej, yujto manto k'och sk'ual alb'ilkan yuj Dios.

Axo winh sreyal norte chi', ol meltzajxok winh t'a schonhab' yet' masanil tas ol yik' winh t'a owal chi'. Ol lajwok chi', ol och winh ajk'olal t'a ejmelal syak' heb' israel, aton jun strato Dios sb'onak yet' heb', haxo sk'ulan winh masanil tas nab'il yuj chi'. Ol lajwok chi', ol meltzaj winh t'a smakb'en.
Ayic ol k'och stiempoal nab'il yuj Dios, ol b'atxok winh yet' heb' soldado yak' owal t'a sur. Palta ha t'a junelxo chi', manhxo ol yak'laj ganar winh icha t'a sb'ab'elal.

Yujto a heb' soldado t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, ol jawok heb' t'a yol barko. Ha heb' chi' ol kachanoch waan winh. Icha chi' ol aj xiw winh sreyal norte chi', haxo smeltzaj winh chi' t'a spatik. Yuj chi', haxo t'a yib'anh strato Dios yet' heb' israel ol smak'el yowal sk'ol winh. Ol schaan winh yab' tas ol yal heb' aktannakkan jun trato chi'.

Axo heb' soldado chi', ol yixtejb'at stemplo Dios heb' yet' kuartel junnhej yaj yet'ok. Ol syamoch waan heb' yak'chaj silab' t'a junjun k'u. Axo tas yajb'ilel yuj Dios, a ol yak'och heb' t'a yol templo chi' yik syixtanel heb'.
Ol smontej heb' etisraelal jun winh rey chi', aton heb' toxo ix aktankan strato Dios. Axo pax heb' chonhab' xajanan sDiosal, ol stek'b'ej sb'a heb' t'a yichanh tas ol ujok chi'.

Ay heb' jelan t'a skal heb' etchonhab' ol k'ayb'an tzijtumok heb' etchonhab' chi', palta ay heb' ol miljokchamok, ay heb' ol nhusjoktz'aok, ay heb' ol elk'ajb'at tastak ay t'ay, ay pax heb' ol ik'jokb'at chekab'il.
Ayic ol k'och stiempoal spechchaj b'eyek' heb', malaj wal mach ol kolwaj t'a heb'. Tzijtum mach junnhej ol yutej sb'a yet' heb', palta chab'sat juntzanh heb' chi'.

Ol miljokcham jaywanhok heb' k'ayb'um jelan t'a skal a chonhab' chi', yik wach' ol ak'chaj prowal juntzanhxo heb' olto kanok, yik wach' tz'ik'chajel heb' chab'sat chi' t'a skal heb', haxo stojolb'i spensar heb' chi', masanto ol k'och slajwub' tiempoal nab'il yuj Dios.

Ha winh sreyal norte chi', ol sk'ulej winh icha tas snib'ej, ichaton chi' ol aj yik'anchaanh sb'a winh, ol yalan winh to niwan yelk'och winh t'a yichanh komon Dios. Ol yal b'uchwal lolonel winh d'ha Dios te yel. Ol sk'ulejnhej masanil tas ol snib'ej winh masanto ol jawok yowal sk'ol Dios t'a yib'anh winh, yujto a tas nab'il yuj Dios chi', ol elk'ochok.

Ha jun winh rey chi', malaj yelk'och sdiosal heb' smam yicham winh t'ay. Malaj pax yelk'och tas nib'ab'il yuj heb' ix ix t'a yol sat winh yet' pax komon Dios, yujto a jun winh chi', ol yal winh to ek'b'al niwan yelk'och winh t'a yichanh masanil juntzanh chi'.

Palta ch'ok jun Dios b'aj ol och winh ejmelal, aton t'a jun Dios b'aj manh yak'nakoquem sb'a heb' smam yicham winh, aton jun Dios stanhwan chonhab' to tek'an. Ol yak'an silab' winh t'ay, aton k'een oro, k'een plata, k'een k'een te wach' yilji yet' juntzanhxo tastak to te karo stojol.

Ha yuj skolwal jun ch'ok diosal chi', ol yak' ganar juntzanh chonhab' te ay yip winh. Ha heb' ol yak'och sb'ha t'a yol sk'ab' jun winh rey chi', ol ak'jokoch heb' t'a juntzanh niwak opisio yuj winh, ol ak'chaj lum lum stojolok heb'.

Ayic ol k'och slajwub' tiempoal chi', a winh sreyal sur, ol yak' owal winh yet' jun winh sreyal norte chi'. Palta ol elta winh sreyal norte chi' yak' owal yet' winh yet' wal smasanil yipal. Ol elta winh yet' skarruaje yik owal yet' heb' soldado ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej. Tzijtum pax barko ol kot yet' winh. Tzijtum nakión ol yak' ganar winh, yujto icha sb'ey ha' eluma' sb'ey heb' soldado winh.
Ol ochpax winh t'a lum lum te wach'. Tzijtum nakión ol yak' ganar winh. Axo pax heb' kajan t'a Edom yet' t'a Moab ol kolchajkanel heb', ek'b'alto pax nanhal heb' aj Amón ol kolchajok.
Ol yik'paxek' juntzanhxo nakión winh, manhxo ol techajpax skolan sb'a Egipto t'a winh.
Ol ik'chajb'at masanil sb'eyumal Egipto chi', icha k'een oro, k'een plata yet' juntzanhxo tas wach'. Ol kanpax heb' aj Libia yet' heb' aj Etiopía t'a yol sk'ab' winh.
Palta ol jawok yab'ixal heb' kajan t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u yet' t'a norte t'a winh, ol och winh t'a xiwk'olal yuj. Yuj chi' ol elta winh yet' yowal sk'ool, te niwan anima ol sna' winh smilchamok.
Ol sb'oank'e skampamento winh t'a skal ha' mar yet' jun tzalan b'aj ay stemplo Dios, aton ta' ol k'och stiempoal satel winh, manhxa junok mach ol kolan winh.

Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', a ángel Miguel, sat ángel yaji, stanhwumal heb' etchonhab' israel, ol och waan. Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi' te ay wal niwan yaelal. Manta junelok ix uji jun chi' yiktax ix el yich spitzwik'e waan juntzanh nakión. Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', ay heb' etchonhab' ol kolchajok, syalelk'ochi, aton heb' tz'ib'ab'il sb'i t'a yol ch'anh libro yik Dios.
Tzijtum heb' chamnakxo ol pitzwokpaxi. Ay juntzanh heb' ol chaan sk'inal t'a junelnhej. Ay pax juntzanhxo heb' ol b'atkan t'a skal q'uixwelal, ol yajchajkanel heb' t'a junelnhej.
Ha heb' jelan, heb' ix kuchb'an tzijtum anima t'a wach' b'eyb'al, ol cheklaj heb' t'a masanil tiempo icha skopopial yilji k'een k'anal ay t'a satcha’anh.

Palta a ach tik Daniel, makkan jun libro tik. Tza sik'ankani masanto ol jawok slajwub'al tiempo chi', tzak'ankanoch sello t'ay. Tzijtum anima ol b'at tik, ol b'at tik yuj snib'an yojtaquejeli tas wan yuji, xchi jun ángel chi' t'ayin.
Ix wilan chawanhxo heb' winak linhanek' t'a sti' ha' niwan Tigris, junjun heb' t'a junjun stitak ha'.
Ha junok heb' chi' ix k'anb'an t'a jun winak ayoch pichul lino yuj, linhanek' t'a yib'anhk'e heb', ix yalan icha tik: ¿B'aq'uinh wal ol lajwok juntzanh tas ayxo smay yilji tik? xchi t'ay.

Axo jun winak ayoch pichul lino yuj chi', ix yik'chaanh sk'ab', ix yak'an sti' t'a yichanh Dios aynhejeq'ui, ix yalani: Ayic ol lajwok nanhal schanhil ab'il, ayik manhxalaj yip heb' schonhab' Dios ol kan yuj heb' ajk'ol chi', ichato chi' ol lajwoquek' masanil juntzanh tik, xchi.
Ix wab' wal tas ix yala', palta maj nachajel-laj wuuj. Yuj chi' ix in k'anb'ej t'ay icha tik: Mamin, ¿tas wal ol aj slajwiek' masanil juntzanh tik? xin chi.
Ix yalan t'ayin icha tik: Manto a na yuj juntzanh tik Daniel, yujto masanil juntzanh tik, tonhej ol sik'chajkanok masanto ol jawok slajwub'.

Yuj juntzanh yaelal chi' tzijtum heb' anima ol ik'jokkanel smul, ol tojolb'okkan spensar, haxo heb' chuk jun, ol k'enhejchaanh heb' sk'ulan chukal. Manh ol nachajel yuj heb' tas wan yuji chi'. Axo heb' anima jelan chi', ol nachajel yuj heb'.
Ayic ol yamchajoch waan yak'chaj silab' t'a junjun k'u yet' yik ol ak'chajoch tas yajb'il yuj Dios t'a yol stemplo yik tz'ixtaxeli, ichato chi' b'ian, ol el yich jun mil 290 k'ual.
Te tzalajk'olal yik heb' tek'an ol yutej sb'a masanto ol tz'akwok mil 335 k'ual.
Palta a ach tik, tek'annhej tzutej a b'a masanto t'a slajwub'al, ichato chi' ol ik'an ip. Ato t'a slajwub' k'ual, ol ach pitzwokxi, haxo a chaan spak chi', xchi t'ayin.

Ha in Oseas in tik, yuninal in winhaj Beeri, ix lolon Jehová t'ayin ayik ix yak'an reyal heb' winh tik t'a chonhab' Judá: Aton winhaj Uzías, winhaj Jotam, winhaj Acaz yet' winhaj Ezequías. Axo t'a Israel a winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Joás ayoch reyal. Aton t'a tik tz'ib'ab'ilkan tas ix yal Jehová t'ayin.

Ayic ix schaanel yich Jehová slolon t'ayin, ix yalan icha tik: Ha heb' etisraelal, te chuk sk'ulej heb' t'a wichanh, ix yik'el sb'a heb' t'ayin icha junok ix ajmul ix. Yuj chi', a junok ix ajmul ix tzik' etb'eyumok. Ay heb' yune' ix ol aljok t'a yajmulal, xchi t'ayin.
Yuj chi' ix wik' ix skuchan Gomer yisil winhaj Diblaim wetb'eyumok. Ixlajwi chi' ix skuchanoch yune' ix, ix alji jun in winak unin yet' ix.

Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Jezreel ol ak' sb'iej winh unin chi', yujto t'a yik jaye' k'ual tik, ol wak'och syaelal heb' yinhtilal winhaj rey Jehú yuj jantak anima ix smilcham heb' t'a chonhab' Jezreel. Ol wak'pax lajwoquel chonhab' Israel chi'.
Ha t'a jun k'ual chi', ol in satel heb' soldado Israel t'a lum sch'olanil Jezreel chi', xchi t'ayin.

Ix skuchanxioch yune' ix Gomer chi', ix unin jun yune' ix, ix alji. Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: “Manh-xajanab'ilok” tzak' sb'iej ix isil chi', yujto manhxo ol ok' in k'ol t'a chonhab' Israel tik. Manhxo ol wak'laj niwank'olal.

Axo pax chonhab' Judá, ol ok' in k'ol t'ay. Ha in Jehová in sDiosal in heb' ol in kolo', palta manhok yet' heb' soldado ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej yet'nak syamk'ab' yik owal, palta yet' in poder ol in kol heb', xchi.
Axo yik toxo ix el ix unin chi' t'a yim, ix skuchanxioch yune' ix Gomer chi', ix alji junxo swinak unin ix.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: “Manh-in-chonhab'ok”, icha chi' tzak' sb'iej winh unin chi', yujto a ex israel ex tik, manhxo in chonhab'ok eyaji, manhxo in he Diosaloc.

Palta ay wal jun k'ual, lajan ol ajxi sb'isul heb' israel tik icha yarenail sti' ha' mar, malaj mach syal sb'isani. Ha b'aj ix wal t'a heb' icha tik: “Manh-ex-in-chonhab'ok”, xin chi, ata' ol alchaj t'a heb': Yuninal ex Dios pitzan.
Ol smolb'ej sb'a heb' aj Judá yet' heb' aj Israel t'a jun pekti’ chi', junxonhej yajalil heb' ol yak'ochi. Ol te k'echaanh heb', yujto te niwan yelk'och jun k'ual yik Jezreel chi'.
Al t'a heb' etchonhab' icha tik: Schonhab' Dios kaji, xajan onh yuj, xa chi, xchi Jehová.

Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin to swak'och in b'a ch'oxnab'ilok yet' heb' wuninal yet' pax ix snun heb', yuj chi' ix walan icha tik t'a heb' unin chi': Ha ix he nun chi' manhxo wetb'eyumok ix, manhxo in yetb'eyumok pax ix, palta alek t'a ix to maxtzak yak'och sb'a ix ajmulal, yaktejokab'kan heb' winh sk'uman ix chi'.
Tato anheja' sk'ulan ix icha chi', ol wak' q'uixwelal ix, ol wik'el spichul ix, ol kan b'eran ix icha yik ix alji. Ichawal taquinh lum ol ajkan ix wuuj, ol champax ix yuj taquinhtial.
Manh ol ok'paxlaj in k'ol t'ayex, yujto yune' ex ix t'a yajmulal.

Ha ix he nun chi', ix och ix ajmulal. Ix ixtaxel swach'ilal ix ayik ix yalan ix icha tik: Ol b'at in say mach nib'ab'il wuuj, mach tz'ak'an in wael yet' tas swuk'ej, mach tz'ak'an in lana yet' in lino, in perfume yet' in wino, xchi ix.
Yuj chi' ichato ol in mak sb'e ix t'a te' q'uiix, ol wak'anoch makte' t'a spatiktak, yuj chi' manhxo ol ilchaj sb'e ix b'aj ol b'atok.

Ol b'at tzak'an ix t'a spatik mach snib'ej chi', palta manh ol yamchaj yuj ix. Ol sayek' ix, palta manhxo ol ilchaj yuj ix. Yuj chi' ol yalan ix icha tik: Ol in meltzaj t'a winh wik'nak t'a sb'ab'elal. Wach'taxon waj yet' winh t'a yichanh icha tiknaik, xcham ix, xin chi t'a heb'.

Yuj tas sk'ulej heb' wetisraelal chi', yuj chi' ix yal Jehová icha tik: Maj yojtaquejel heb' tato a in swak' strigo heb', swino heb' yet' sperfume heb' to a in swak' niwanb'ok k'een plata yet' k'een oro t'a heb', haxo t'a juntzanh komon Dios ix yak' heb'.
Yuj chi' ol wik'ek' ixim in trigo yet' in wino, ol wik'anpaxek' nok' in lana yet' in lino tz'och spichulok heb'.
Q'uelanoch juntzanh chonhab' ix montanb'at yik syal sb'a heb' t'a skomon diosal, ol wak'an q'uixwok heb'. Manhxa mach ol kolanel heb' t'a yol in k'ab'.
Ol wak' lajwok stzalajk'olal heb' yuj q'uinh yik tz'alji k'een uj yet' t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip yet' masanil juntzanhxo q'uinh tz'ochtaxoni.

Ha heb' israel ix alani: Ha juntzanh komon Dios ix ak'an sat te' uwa yet' te' higo stojolok b'aj ix kak'em ko b'a, xchi heb'. Yuj chi' a in Jehová in ol in satel juntzanh te' uwa yet' te' higo chi'. Ha b'aj awab'il chi' ol wak'och wayumtaquil, haxo nok' kaltakte'al nok' ol ab'lanb'at awb'en chi'.

Ha in Jehová in swala' to ol wak'och yaelal t'a yib'anh heb', yujto niwan tiempo ix yaltej inkienso heb' t'a juntzanh yechel Baal. Ix laj sb'oan sb'a heb' icha junok ix ix syak'och yuchiquin yet' stonh tz'och tzak'an yuj heb' winh nib'ab'il yuj, syak'an sat sk'ool t'a winh yetb'eyum. Icha chi' in yutej chonhab' Israel tik.
Wach'chom icha chi' ix sk'ulej chonhab' Israel tik, palta ol in montej, ol wik'anxib'at t'a tzinan lu'um. Ata' ol wal wach' lolonel t'ay.

Ol wak'anxi sluum b'aj awab'il yuwa. Ha sch'olanil ilk'olal ol wak'och sch'olanil yipk'olal. Icha yaj t'a sb'ab'elal ayik yelnakkot t'a Egipto icha chi' ol wutokxikani. Ata' ol tak'wok t'ayin, ichawal sk'ulej junok ix kob'es ix.
Ha in Jehová in swala' to ha t'a jun k'ual chi', ol in yal yetb'eyumok. Manhxo ol yal jun chonhab' tik to Baal waj t'ay.
Junelnhej ol wik'el t'a sti' yak'an b'inaj juntzanh Baal, manhxa b'ak'uinh ol yak' b'inajok.

Ha t'a jun k'ual chi', ol wak' in trato yet' nok' kaltakte'al nok', nok' much yet' nok' chan, yik manhxalaj tas ol utaj yuj nok'. D'a junelnhej ol wik'kanel k'een lanza t'a jun chonhab' tik yet' juntzanhxo yamk'ab' yik owal, yik wach' ol yik' yip in chonhab' tik, manhxa tas ol sna'a.
Ach chonhab' Israel, ichato ol ach wik' t'a junelnhej. Toton wal icha wetb'eyum ol ach aj t'a stojolal yet' t'a smojalil, yujto ol ok' wal och in k'ol t'ayach yet' ach in xajanani.
Ichato ol ach wik'a', ol in k'ulejnhej tas ix wala', ichato chi' ol in ojtakaneli to Jehová in.
Ha in Jehová in swala': Ha t'a jun k'ual chi', ol in tak'wok t'ayach, ol wal t'a satcha’anh, haxo satcha’anh chi' ol ak'ankot nhab' t'a sat lu'um.
Ol yak'an ixim trigo lum lum, wino yet' akeite. Ichawal chi' ol aj in pakan slesal in chonhab' b'ob'il wuuj.

Ol wak'xi kajnaj in chonhab' t'a sat lum lum tik yik tz'och wed'ok. Ol ok' in k'ool t'a ix “Manh-xajanab'ilok” yet' t'a winhaj “Manh-in-chonhab'ok”, ol walan icha tik: In chonhab' ach, xin chama. Axo ol alan t'ayin: In Diosal ach, xchama, xchi Jehová.

Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Xajanejxi ix etb'eyum, wach'chom smulan ix yet' mach snib'ej. Icha chi' ol utok a ch'oxani tas tz'aj in xajanan heb' etisraelal, wach'chom syak'och spensar heb' t'a komon Dios yet' yik'anb'at taquinh uwa heb' silab'ok t'a juntzanh komon Dios chi', xchi t'ayin.
Yuj chi', ix in mananxi ix t'a 15 siklo k'een plata yet' chanhe' quintal ixim kebada yik tz'ochxi ix wetb'eyumok.

Ix walan t'a ix icha tik: Najtil ol in a tanhwej t'a in pat t'a ichnhej ta'. Manhxo ach och ajmulal, manhxo altej a b'ha t'a junokxo winak. Anhejtona' in, ol in tanhwej yek' jun pekti’ chi', malaj pax junokxo ix ol in saya', ichato chi' ol quik'lanxi ko b'a, xin chi t'a ix.

Icha pax chi' chonhab' Israel, najtil ol ek' t'a ichnhej ta', malaj sreyal, malaj pax yajalil. Manhxo ol snhuslaj silab' t'ayin, manhxalaj k'een k'een b'aj ol yak' silab' heb' t'a juntzanh komon Dios. Manhxalaj pichul yik heb' sakerdote, manhxalaj komon Dios t'a yol spat junjun heb'.

Ol lajwok chi' jun, ha t'a slajwub' k'ual, ol meltzajxok heb'. Ol in yalanxi heb' sDiosalok, ol schaan junok yinhtilal winhaj Dawid heb' sreyalok. Icha chi' ol aj yoch heb' ejmelal t'a wichanh a in Jehová in tik yet' schaan swach'il heb' tas ol wak'a'.

Ex wetisraelal, ab'ek slolonel Jehová. Van yalan Jehová chi' t'a yib'anh masanil anima kajan t'a jun chonhab' tik, yujto manhxalaj mach tz'elk'och tas syala'. Manhxalaj mach wach'to spensar, manhxalaj mach syak'och spensar t'ay.
Sk'echaanh heb' sk'exan sti' t'a tas syala', syesan heb'. Smilwaj heb', tz'elk'an heb', anhej ajmulal sk'ulej heb'. Slaj yixtej yetanimail heb', kotak skal smilancham anima heb'.
Yuj chi', a slum jun chonhab' tik, ol kan tzinan. Ha heb' kajan t'ay, manhxalaj yip heb'. Ol cham nok' kaltakte'al nok', nok' much yet' masanil nok' chay ay t'a yoltak ha ha'.
Syalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Malajokab' mach skot yowal t'a heb' chonhab' tik, yujto a mach ay wowal yet'ok aton eyed' ex sakerdote.
Yuj chi', ha t'a k'ualil ol ex telwok icha t'ak'walil. Ol telwok pax heb' in chekab' eyed'ok. Ha in ol wak' lajwok chonhab' Israel to icha he nun yaji.

Ol in satel jun in chonhab' tik, yujto manhxo in naanok yuj. Ha exxo ex sakerdote, yelxo maxtzak in he na'a. Yuj chi' ol ex wik'el t'a eyopisio. Yujto ix b'at in k'ayb'ub'al satk'olal eyuuj, yuj chi' manhxo ol in nakot heb' eyinhtilal.
Icha ix aj sq'uib' he b'isul ex sakerdote, icha chi' ix aj sk'echaanh smul in chonhab'. Yuj chi' a he b'inajnaquil, q'uixwelaltak ol wutejkani.
Yuj silab' syak' in chonhab' yuj smul, wach' he wa'i, yuj chi' tze nib'ej to tz'ochnhej smul in chonhab' tik t'ayin.
Yuj chi' lajan ol aj yab'an syail heb' in chonhab' eyed'ok a ex sakerdote ex tik. Yuj he b'eyb'al chi' ol wak'och yaelal t'a eyib'anh yet' heb'.

Yujto maxtzak in yak' serwil heb' in chonhab', haxo jun komon Dios skuch Baal syak' serwil heb'. Wach'chom swa heb', sway heb' yet' heb' ix ajmul ix t'a stemplo skomon diosal chi', palta manh yujok chi' niwan ol satan smunlajel heb', manh ol q'uib'pax sb'isul heb'.
Yuj yajmulal heb' yet' yuk'umanhil heb', yuj chi' ix quistalax spensar heb'.

Ha t'a junok te te' sk'anb'ej yab' heb' in chonhab' tik tas sk'ulej heb'. Axo te te' chi' tz'ak'an srazón heb' yalani. Yuj yajmulal heb' chi', yuj chi' ix juwiel heb'. Icha wal tz'aj yaktankan winh yetb'eyum junok ix ix, smulan yet' junokxo winak, icha chi' ix in yutej heb', sb'atkan tzak'an heb' yuj komon Dios.

Ha t'a jolomtak witz yet' t'a tzalquixtak, ata' snhus inkienso heb' yet' yak'an silab' heb' t'a yalanh yenhul xil te' álamo, te' ji yet' te' mach'. Yuj chi', slaj em heb' ix eyisil yet' heb' ix eyalib' t'a ajmulal.

Palta manh ol wak'ochlaj syaelal heb' ix eyisil yet' heb' ix eyalib' yuj yajmulal chi', yujto a ex jun tze k'ulej ajmulal chi', tzeyak'an silab' yet' heb' ix ix sb'eyb'alan ajmulal. Yuj chi', a jun chonhab' malaj spensar tik, ol ixtaxelok.

Wach'chom ix och smul chonhab' Israel, palta mokab' och smul chonhab' Judá. Mokab' b'at och heb' ejmelal t'a Gilgal, mokab' k'epax heb' t'a Bet-awén. Mokab' slok in b'i heb' a in Jehová pitzan in tik.
Ha chonhab' Israel, te pit, lajan wal icha junok nok' wakax te ow. Tato icha chi', ¿tom ol yal in tanhwan heb' icha junok nok' yune' kalnel b'aj yax ank'ultak?
Axo chonhab' Efraín ix och tzak'an yuj juntzanh komon Dios, palta olxo yil sb'a.

Masanil heb' syal sb'ha t'a juntzanh komon Dios, tzek' tzuyjab' heb' t'a skal heb' yetuk'umanhil. Maxtzac yaktej heb' sk'ulan ajmulal. Ha heb' yajalil heb', a tas q'uixwelaltak snib'ej heb' sk'ulan t'a yichanh to tz'alji heb' wach'il.
Icha tz'aj yik'chajb'at k'alem yuj ik', icha chi' ol aj yik'chajb'at heb'. Malaj ol yak' yal heb' yuj juntzanh silab' syak' t'a juntzanh skomon diosal chi'.

Ab'ek wal juntzanh tik ex sakerdote. Maclejec eyab' ex chonhab' Israel. Ab'ek pax ex yinhtilal ex heb' rey: Ha t'a eyib'anh a ex tik ol och jun yaelal tik, yujto a ex tik, icha junok ch'anh yaal eyaj t'a Mizpa yet' t'a jolom witz Tabor.
Tzijtum anima ix he mak'cham yuj he pitalil, yuj chi' ol wak'och yaelal t'a eyib'anh.
Ex israel ayex t'a yol yik Efraín, wojtak tas eyaji. ¿Tom tze na'a to manh wojtakok tas eyaj chi'? Ix eyak'och he b'a ajmulal, ix eyixtejel he b'ha t'a yajb'entaquil.
Yuj he chuk b'eyb'al chi', max yal he meltzajkot t'ayin. Anhej t'a juntzanh komon Dios tzeyal he b'a. Yuj wal to he gana he k'ulan ajmulal, yuj chi' maxtzak in he na jab'ok.
Ex aj Efraín, a eyik'ojchanhb'ail sch'oxanel he chukalil. Ex aj Israel, munil ol ex telwok yuj eyajmulal chi'. Yed' ex aj Judá lajan ol aj he telwi yet' heb'.
Ol b'at in he sayeq'ui, eyed'nak nok' he kalnel yet' nok' he wakax yik tzeyak' silab'il t'ayin. Palta manhxo ol in ilchajlaj eyuuj, yujto toxo ix wik'el in b'ha t'a he kal.
Yujto te chuk ix eyutej he b'a t'ayin, ay eyuninal mitz' unin yaji. Yuj chi' ha t'a q'uinh ayik tz'alji k'een uj, ata' ol ex satel yet' he munlajel.
Puchajokab' nok' ch'aak yik owal t'a Gabaa, puchajokab'pax k'een trompeta t'a Ramá. Awajanhec t'a Bet-awén. Ayokab' xiwk'olal t'a skal heb' anima yik Benjamín.
Ha in swal t'a skal masanil heb' yinhtil Israel yuj tas yowalil ol jawok t'a yib'anh heb': Ha heb' aj Efraín, ol lajwoquel heb' yuj yaelal ol jawok t'a jun k'ual chi'.
Ha in Jehová in swala': Ha heb' yajal t'a Judá, lajan heb' icha juntzanh anima tz'ik'anchaanh tz'akaanh, yuj chi' ol in satel heb' yet' yowal in k'ool.
Ha chonhab' Efraín tik, toxo ix ja t'a yib'anh. Manhxalaj tas ay t'ay, yujto ix yak'och t'a sk'ol yoch tzak'an yuj juntzanh komon Dios.
Ha in ol wixtejb'at chonhab' Efraín icha tz'aj yixtax junok tas yuj nok' ha'ay. Ol wixtanb'at chonhab' Judá icha tz'aj sk'ab'at junok tas.

Ayic ix yilan chonhab' Efraín to ya ay, ix yilanpax yechen Judá, ix b'at chonhab' Efraín chi' t'a Asiria sk'an skolwal jun rey b'inajnak yak'an owal, palta maj yal-laj yuj jun rey chi' yak'an b'oxok sk'ool, maj yalpaxlaj yanhtan yechen chi'.

Icha wal tz'aj smakwaj junok nok' choj, icha chi' ol aj in makwaj t'a chonhab' Efraín yet' t'a chonhab' Judá. Ha in ol in chok' tzilejb'at heb', ol waktankan heb' b'ian, haxo in b'at chi'. Ol in tzak'chaanh heb', manhxa mach ol yal skolan heb' t'a yol in k'ab'.
Axo in meltzaj chi' t'a elanhchamel b'aj kajan in masanto ol yojtaquejel smul heb', haxo sjawi heb' chi' yal sb'a t'ayin. Ha t'a skal syaelal heb' chi', ol yal sb'a heb' t'ayin t'a smasanil sk'ool.
Ol yal heb' chonhab' icha tik: Cotanhec he masanil, konh meltzajek t'a Jehová. Ha ix onh chok'tzilanb'ati, anheja' ol onh anhtanpaxok. Ix onh yak' echnajok, anheja' a ol anhtanpax quechen chi'.
Ha wal yek'b'at chab' k'ual, ichato chi' ol yak'an ko k 'inal. Axo t'a yoxil k'ual, ol onh yak'anpax pitzwok, ol onh kajnaj t'a yichanh.

Kaq'ek quip kojtakanel Jehová. Icha kojtakaneli to ol sakb'ok, kojtak to ol jax t'ayonh tato sko na ko b'a. Ol yak'kot swach'k'olal t'a quib'anh, icha tz'aj syaxb'i sat lum lum yuj b'ab'el nhab' yet' slajwub' nhab'ilq'uinal, xcham heb'.

Icha tik yalan Jehová: ¿Tas wach' ol ex wutok ex aj Efraín? ¿Tas wach' ol ex wutok ex aj Judá? Ha b'aj tzin he xajanej, lajan icha asun t'a q'uinhib'alil, lajan icha yal ak'wal t'a ayto sq'uinhib'i, haxo sq'uinhib'i, satemi.
Yuj in lolonel ix wak' yal heb' in chekab', ol ex in sateli. Niwan chequel ol aj eyaelal chi' icha wal yok k'u.
Ha wal tas in gana tze k'ulej to tz'ok' he k'ol t'a eyetanimail yet' in eyojtakaneli to he Diosal in, manhoknhej he nhusantz'a silab' t'ayin in gana.
Ha ex in chonhab' ex tik, maj he k'anab'ajej in trato eyed'ok, icha yutejnak sb'a winhaj Adán. Chuc ix eyutej he b'a t'ayin.
Ha heb' anima t'a chonhab' Galaad, anhej chukal sk'ulej heb', masanil b'aj ay chik' yuj b'aj smilwaj heb'.
Ha heb' sakerdote, icha junok molanh elk'um yek' heb'. Smac anima heb' yik smak'anchamok. D'a sb'eal Siquem smak'wicham anima heb', sk'ulanpax masanil chukal heb'.
Ha heb' aj Efraín ix och heb' ajmulal. Ix yixtejb'at sb'a heb' yet' heb' yetisraelal. Yuj chi' te yajb'entak yilji heb' swila'.
Yed' ex pax ex aj Judá, wan sjawi sk'ual eyaelal. Tzin nib'ej tzin k'ex tas ayoch t'a yib'anh in chonhab' Israel,

palta ayik wan wanhtan in chonhab' Efraín yet' Samaria walani, ata' snachajel smul heb' yet' schukal heb' wuuj. Yujto junlajanxonhej tz'aj sb'eyb'alan es heb'. Elk'um heb' smasanil, tz'och heb' elk'al t'a yoltak pat yet' t'a yoltak kalle.
Tocwal sna heb' tato naan schukal heb' chi' wuuj. Ha tiknaik a tas sk'ulej heb' a oyanoch t'a spatik yichanh heb', yuj chi' anhej schukal heb' chi' swila'.
Ha heb' rey yet' heb' yajal ste tzalaj heb' yuj chukal yet' yuj yixtum animail heb'.
Anhej ajmulal sb'o heb' smasanil. Ha tas snib'ej heb' chi', lajan icha junok horno jab'nhej sk'ak'al tz'ochi yakb'an spajb'i ixim harina, haxo yik toxo ix pajb'i ixim, tz'och sk'ak'al sik'lab'il.

Ayic tz'och q'uinh yuj winh rey, a heb' ayoch t'a yopisio yet' winh, syuk' anh heb', syak'an anh heb' yuk' winh masanto sk'e anh t'a sjolom winh yet' heb'. Tonhej skomon tzalaj winh yet' heb' sb'uchwaj t'ay.
Aynhejoch chuk pensaril t'a spensar heb'. Lajan yowal heb' icha sk'ak'al junok horno pilan ak'wal ayoch sk'ak'al, haxo sq'uinhib'i t'a junxo k'u, spukhajxi chakb'ok.
Lajan heb' smasanil icha sk'ak'al horno chi', ix satel winh yajalil heb' yuj yowal chi'. Lajan syutej sb'a heb' t'a smasanil heb' sreyal, palta malaj junok heb' sk'anb'an t'ayin tas smoj sk'ulej.
Ha chonhab' Efraín toxo ix skalej sb'a yet' juntzanh ch'ok chonhab'il. Lajan heb' icha junok ixim wa''il max sutchaji.
Ha heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ix ak'an lajwok yip, palta max yil-laj tas wan yutaji. Ha xil sjolom toxo ix sakb'ieli, tokwal syilochi.
Ha in Jehová sDiosal in heb' israel. Wach'chom jantak tas ix ja t'a yib'anh heb' yuj schukal, palta yuj yak'umtaquil heb' maxtzak sna sb'a sk'ol heb' smeltzajkot t'ayin.
Ha chonhab' Efraín malaj jab'ok spensar, jun rato sb'at sk'an kolwal t'a Egipto, haxo t'a junxo rato sb'atxi sk'an kolwal t'a Asiria. Lajan icha junok nok' uch tonhej sat b'eyek'ok.
Palta ayik ol b'at heb' ta', ol in yumb'at in ch'anh yaal t'a yib'anh heb'. Ol telwok heb' icha junok nok' much. Ol wak'och yaelal t'a yib'anh heb', icha ix aj yalchaj b'aj smolb'ej sb'a heb'.
Ob'iltak heb', yujto ix in spatiquejel heb'. Ol satel heb' yuj yaelal ol jawok, yujto ix och spitalil heb' t'ayin. Tzin nib'ej tzin kol heb', palta manh yelok tas syal heb' t'ayin.
Manh smasanilok sk'ol heb' tzin yawtej ayik tz'el yaw heb' t'a sat sch'at. Spol sb'a heb' yik sk'anan heb' t'a Baal yik wach' tz'aj strigo heb', yet' yuwa heb'. Yuj chi' tz'och heb' ajk'olal t'ayin.
Ix in k'ayb'ej heb', ix wak'anpax yip heb', palta haxo heb', a chukal sna heb' t'a in patik.

Smeltzaj heb' palta manhoklaj t'ayin, a in to Ha inxonhej Ochi. Icha junok jul-lab' koxo, max yamchajlaj tas sjulchaj chi' yet'ok, icha chi' heb'. Yuj yak'umtaquil slolon heb' yajalil, yuj chi' ol cham heb' yuj k'een espada. Axo heb' aj Egipto, toxonhej ol b'uchwaj heb' t'a heb'.

Puchajokab' k'een trompeta, yujto sjawi juknaj heb' ajk'ol t'a yib'anh in chonhab' icha junok nok' ch'akb'a, yujto maj sk'anab'ajej in trato heb' ix wak' yet'ok. Ix spitej sb'a heb' t'a in k'ayb'ub'al.
Wach'chom syal heb' t'ayin: Co Diosal ach, tzach kojtaquejeli, xchi heb',
palta a heb' israel, toxo ix spatiquejel heb' tas wach', yuj chi' ol pechchaj heb' yuj heb' yajk'ool.

Ayic ix yak'anoch sreyal heb', maj sk'anb'ej heb' t'ayin mach tz'ochi. Ix say yajalil heb', palta manhok junok sik'b'ilel wuuj. Ix sb'ok'e sdiosal heb' yet' k'een splata yet' k'een yoro. Yuj chi' syik'kot heb' t'a yib'anh.
Tzin yaj jun wakax b'ob'il t'a k'een oro b'aj tz'och heb' aj Samaria ejmelal. Yuj chi' te aykot wowal t'a heb'. Machequel b'ak'uinh ol yaktej heb' israel sk'ulan jun chukal chi'.
Manh diosok jun yechel wakax chi' yujto b'ob'il yuj junok b'oum yechel. Yuj chi' ol mak'jok wekchajok.

Chuc tas ix sk'ulej heb', yuj chi' te niwan yaelal ol jawok t'a yib'anh heb'. Malaj yawb'en heb' ol sjach'a', malaj harina ol yik' heb' t'a sjolom strigo. Wach'chom ay jab'ok ol yik' heb' jun, haxo heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ol waanb'at t'a heb'.
Ha chonhab' Israel ol ak'chaj lajwok. Manhxa jab'ok ol aj yelk'och t'a yol sat juntzanhxo chonhab', icha junok lum k'a chen manhxa wach' yochi, icha chi' ol ajok.

Malaj spensar heb', lajan heb' icha junok nok' kaltakte'al b'uru anhej snaan b'aj sb'ati. Ix b'at heb' t'a Asiria, ix stupan heb' yik skolwaj yet' heb'. Icha junok ix ix syaktejkan winh yetb'eyum, stupan junok winh snib'ej, icha chi' ix yutej sb'a heb'.
Wach'chom stup juntzanhxo chonhab' heb' yik skolji heb' yuj, a in Jehová in ol in molb'ej heb', yik syab'an syail heb' yuj junok rey te ay yip.
Ha heb' aj chonhab' Efraín, tzijtum altar ix sb'ok'e heb' b'aj syak' silab' heb' yik tz'el smul heb' yalani, palta yuj juntzanh altar chi' ste och smul heb'.
Wach'chom tzijtum k'ayb'ub'al ix wak' tz'ib'chaj t'a heb', palta komon lolonel ix ajkan t'a yol sat heb'.
Syak' silab' heb' t'ayin, schi'anpax schib'ejal nok' heb', palta max in tzalaj yet' heb'. Naan schukal heb' wuuj. Ol wak'anoch yaelal t'a yib'anh heb'. Ol wak'xi meltzaj heb' t'a Egipto.

Ha heb' israel sb'ok'e kuartel heb' b'aj skol sb'a, palta manhxo in naanok yuj heb', wach'chom a in ix in b'o heb'. Ha Judá tzijtum chonhab' ayoch smuroal sb'ok'ei, palta ol in nhustz'a schonhab', yet' skuartel chi', xchi Jehová.

Ex wetisraelal manh ex tzalajok, manh ex k'e chennaj yuj tzalajk'olal icha heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, yujto ix eyaktejkan ko Diosal, icha tz'aj yaktankan yetb'eyum heb' ix ajmul ix. Tzex te tzalaj he ch'oxani to xajan Baal eyuuj, yujto wach' tz'aj sat tas tzeyawej yuj eyalani.
Yuj chi' manhxalaj ixim trigo yet' sat te' uwa ol he molo'. Ha he wino ak'to manhxo ol yab'laj.
Manhxo ol yal-laj eyaj t'a schonhab' Jehová. Ayex ol ex meltzaj t'a Egipto, ayex ol ex b'at t'a Asiria. Ha tas yajb'entak t'a yichanh Jehová ol he wa ta'.

Manhxo ol yal-laj eyak'an wino silab'il yuj eyik'anchaanh Jehová, manh ol schalaj he silab' ta'. Ha tas ol he wa''a, icha tas swaji ayik ay chamel, yuj chi' a mach ol waanok, ol kan chukal t'a yichanh ley. Ol yal yek' swejel heb' yuj, palta manh ol yal-laj yik'anb'at heb' t'a stemplo Jehová.
Manhxo ol yal eyak'an q'uinh, juntzanh q'uinh yik Jehová.

Ol ex el lemnaj t'a jun yaelal ol jawok. Axo heb' aj Egipto ol ex molanb'atok. Ha t'a chonhab' Menfis ol ex mukchaj yuj heb'. Ha b'aj molb'il k'een he plata ayoch he b'eyumalok yet' b'aj ix ex ek' kajan, ol q'uib'k'e anh ank'ultak, nab'a q'uiix ol ajkanok.

Ex wetisraelal, wan sjawi sk'ual sjawi yaelal. Ol nachajel eyuuj to toxo ix k'och sk'ual yik tze cha he tojol icha smojalil. Tzeyal icha tik: Ha heb' schekab' Dios, te malaj spensar heb'. Ha heb' kuchb'ab'il yuj Yespíritu Dios toxo ix och heb' lokoal, xe chi. Tzeyal icha chi', yujto tz'alchaj he chukal yuj heb', yuj chi' schichon he k'ool t'a heb'.
Ha Dios ix yak'och heb' schekab' ex stanhwej ex aj Efraín, palta tze b'oem yaal t'a yoltak sb'e heb' he tanhwumal chi'. Inatax t'a stemplo Dios schichon he k'ool t'a heb'.
Ix ex ixtaxel t'a junelnhej, icha ix uji t'a chonhab' Gabaa. Palta haxo Jehová ol snakot he chukal chi', ol ak'chajoch yaelal t'a eyib'anh yuj he mul chi'.

Syal Jehová icha tik: Ayic ix in chalan in b'a yet' heb' israel, ix in te tzalaji, icha mach tz'ilchaj te' uwa yuj t'a tzinan lu'um. Ha heb' he mam eyicham, icha te' sat higo te nib'ab'il spet eluli, icha chi' ajnak heb' t'a yol in sat. Axo sk'ochnak heb' t'a chonhab' Peor, yoch heb' ejmelal t'a Baal sdiosal jun chonhab' chi', te yajb'entak yutejnak sb'a heb' icha jun komon Dios xajanejnak heb' chi'.
Ha sniwanil yelk'och chonhab' Efraín, tonhej ol satk'e icha sb'at jenhnaj junok nok' much. Manhxa unin ol aljok t'ay, manhxa heb' ix ix ol och yab'ixal, manhxalaj pax heb' ix ol skuchoch yune'.
Tato ay b'aj ol q'uib' heb' unin chi', a inxo ol wik'el sk'inal heb', manhxo junok ol wak'kani. Ob'iltak juntzanh anima chi' ayik ol wik'anel in b'ha t'a heb'.
Ayic ix wilan heb' aj Efraín, lajan icha junok te' palma awab'il b'aj te yax sat, icha chi' yaj heb' ix wila''. Palta a tiknaik, ol yik'elta yuninal heb' yik smak'jichamok, xchi Jehová.

Mamin Jehová, ¿Tas smoj tzin k'an t'ayach to tzak' t'a juntzanh anima tik? Wach' ama, tato malaj yune' heb' ix ix. Tato ay heb' ix ay yune' jun, wach' ama to malaj yal yim heb' ix yik maxtzak yak' chunok yune' heb' ix chi'.

Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: D'a Gilgal ix chael yich sk'ulan chukal heb', yuj chi' a pax ta' ix el yich woch ajk'olal t'a heb'. Yuj masanil chukal sk'ulej heb', yuj chi' ol wik'elta heb' t'a lum in lu'um ix wak' t'a heb'. Manhxo ol in xajanej heb', yujto smasanil heb' yajal heb', te pit.
Ha chonhab' Efraín echenxo yaji. Lajan icha junok te te' toxo ix takji sch'anhal yip, maxtzak yak' sat. Wach'chom ay yuninal heb', a inxo ol wak'cham yuninal heb' chi' to xajanab'il yuj, xchi Jehová.
Ha jun chonhab' tik, max cha yab' heb' tas syal in Diosal. Yuj chi' a ol patikanel heb', haxo t'a skal juntzanh ch'ok chonhab'il ol saklemkanb'at heb'.

Ex wetisraelal, lajan ex icha jun ib'ok te' uwa te ay sat yiknhej sch'okoj. Icha satan te' uwa chi', icha chi' eyaltar ix he b'ok'ei. Axo ix ex te och b'eyumal, ix he wach' b'oej eyaltar chi' b'aj tzeyal he b'ha t'a juntzanh he komon diosal chi'.
Ha ex tik, chapoj yaj he pixan. Axo tiknaik, ol he tupel he chukal chi'. Ha Jehová ol juanem masanil eyaltar chi', ol sjuanpaxem juntzanh yechel he diosal chi'.
Yuj chi' ol eyal icha tik: Malaj ko reyal, yujto malaj yelk'och Jehová t'a yol ko sat. Palta, ¿tasto wal tz'och junok rey chi' kuuj? xe chama.

Anhej lolonel tzeyak'a', tzeyak'an he ti' t'a es. Ayic tze ch'olb'itan tas yaj heb' anima, manh tojolok tzeyutej. Ha tze b'oan tas yaj heb' anima chi', lajan icha junok owal ank'ultak sq'uib'k'e t'a kal munlajel.

Ha heb' aj Samaria ol luklon heb' yuj xiwelal, ol yalan heb': ¿Tas ol utaj ko diosal? xcham heb'. Ha jun wakax sdiosal heb' ay t'a Bet-awén ol ik'chajb'at t'a chonhab' Asiria, yik tz'ak'chaj t'a winh rey niwan yelk'ochi. Yuj chi' ol kus heb' chonhab', ol ok' heb' yet' heb' sakerdote, yujto a swach'ilal yilji jun chi', toxo ix sateli. Icha chi' ol kan chonhab' Efraín t'a q'uixwelal yujto ix yal sb'ha t'a jun yechel wakax chi'.
Ol satel chonhab' Samaria yet' sreyal, icha sb'atkan b'akhachok junok k'ajil te' t'a yib'anh ha ha'.

Ol lajwoquem stemplo sdiosal heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, aton juntzanh b'aj ix och chonhab' Israel t'a chukalil. Ol q'uib'k'e te' q'uiix b'aj ay yaltar heb' chi'. Ol yalan heb' yuj lum witz yet' yuj lum tzalan icha tik: Comonoc syal skot juynaj t'a quib'anh yik tzonh sk'ub'ejeli, xcham heb'.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Ha ex israel ex tik, ix he chael yich he k'ulan chukal t'a Gabaa, anheja' icha chi' tze k'ulej tiknaik. Yuj chi' ol ex satel yuj owal t'a Gabaa chi'.
Ha in ol in na b'ak'uinh ol wak'och yaelal yib'anh jun chonhab' tik. Ayic ol wak'anoch yaelal chi' yuj jantak schukal sk'ulej, ol och oyan juntzanh chonhab' t'a spatik yak'an owal yet'ok.

Ha t'a yalanhtaxo, lajan chonhab' Efraín icha junok nok' wakax k'aynakxo smunlaji, sk'anab'ajej stek'wi trigo. Axo tiknaik a heb' aj Judá yet' juntzanhxo heb' yinhtil Jacob ol yab' syail heb' icha junok nok' wakax b'aj tz'och te' yugo t'a sjaj yik smunlaj nok' d'okoj lu'um yet' skalan lum yet' k'een rastrillo.
