¿Tom wach' tze na'a to a nok' nok' ay spaltail tzeyak' t'ayin silab'il, aton nok' malaj yol sat, nok' q'uiich yet' nok' penaay? Q'uinalok tzeyik'b'at juntzanh nok' chi' he silab'ok t'a heb' eyajalil, ¿tom ol ex scha heb' yuj juntzanh he silab' chi' tze na'a?

Ha heb' anima tz'alan t'ayex icha tik: Ex sakerdote, k'anek d'ha Dios kuuj, yik tz'ok' sk'ol t'ayonh, xchi heb'. Palta a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil swal icha tik: Tato a juntzanh nok' ix wal tik ol eyak' he silab'ok t'ayin, ¿tokwal ol in cha t'ayex t'a tzalajk'olal?

Comonoc a junok ex tik tze mak spuertail in templo, yik wach' manh nab'anhejok skomon och k'ak' t'a waltar. Yujto a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, max in tzalaj jab'ok eyed'ok, manhxo ol in cha eyofrenda chi'.

Palta te niwan welk'och t'a sat masanil anima t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik. Ha wal tas wach' snhustz'a heb' silab'il t'ayin. Syak'an yofrenda heb' t'ayin icha wal t'a smojalil, yujto niwan welk'och t'a yol sat heb'.
Palta a exxo tik, malaj jab'ok welk'och t'a yol he sat. Tzeyalani to malaj yelk'och waltar yet' juntzanh silab' tz'ak'ji t'ayin.

Tzeyalan icha tik: Tzonh tzaktzajk'och yet' juntzanh tik, xe chi. Tzin he patikaneli. Slajwi chi' tzeyak'an juntzanh nok' he silab' t'ayin, aton nok' tzeyelk'ej, nok' q'uiich yet' nok' penaay. ¿Tom ol in cha juntzanh chi' t'ayex tze na'a?

Ha in Rey in, niwan welk'ochi, xiw masanil chonhab' t'ayin, yuj chi' tzin katab'ej heb' stak'wej sti' yak'an junok skalnel malaj spaltail silab'il t'ayin, slajwi chi' sk'exan pax nok' heb', haxo junok nok' penaay syak' heb', xchi Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil.
Syalanpax Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil icha tik: Ha tiknaik ex sakerdote, a t'ayex swal juntzanh cheknab'il tik:

Yowalil ayokab' welk'och t'a yol he sat yet' eyopisio tik. Tato manh ol he k'anab'ajej, ol ex in katab'ej. Ayic ol eyalan wach' lolonel t'a yib'anh junok mach, haxo katab' ol wak'kan t'a yib'anh sk'exulok. Val yel, a jun eyopisio chi', toxo ix in katab'ej, yujto max he k'anab'ajej in cheknab'il.

Eyuj a ex tik ex sakerdote, yuj chi' ol wak' q'uixwelal heb' eyinhtilal, a nok' tzeyik'kot silab'il chi' t'ayin, a stza' nok' ol in juloch t'a he sat. Junnhej ol aj ex in julanel yet' stza' nok' chi'.

Icha chi' ol aj snachajel eyuuj to a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil a in swak' jun cheknab'il tik, yik wach' a in trato wak'nakkan yet' heb' yinhtilal Leví, aton heb' he mam eyicham, ol b'eynhejb'atok.
Ha in trato yet' heb' chi' to swak' sk'inal heb' yet' sjunk'olal, yik ay welk'och t'a yol sat heb'. Ix sch'oxel heb' to ay welk'och t'a yol sat heb', ix in sk'anab'ajan heb'.
Yelnhej tas ix yal heb', malaj b'aj ix yesej heb'. Wach'nhej ix ek' heb' wed'ok. Jantac heb' ix yik'elta heb' t'a skal chukal.

Ha ex sakerdote ex tik, a eyopisio to tze k'ayb'ej heb' anima yik tzin yojtaquejel heb'. Smoj sk'och masanil anima t'ayex, yik syab'an sk'ayb'ub'al heb', yujto a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, in chekab' eyaji.
Ha exxo pax tik, toxo ix in he patiquejeli. Yuj k'ayb'ub'al ix eyak'a', yuj chi' tzijtum heb' ix juwikaneli. Ha ex ix eyixtejb'at in trato wak'nak yet' winh he mam eyicham.

Max he k'anab'ajej tas tzin nib'ej, yujto manh lajanok tzeyutej he ch'olb'itan smasanil anima, yuj chi' swik'ek' sniwanil eyelk'ochi, emnaquil tzex ajkan t'a sat masanil anima, xchi Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil.
Ha onh tik junnhej ko Mam, aton Dios b'ojinak onh ko masanil. ¿Tas yuj skak'laj musansatil ko b'a, skak'lan chukal t'ayonh junjun onh, squixtanb'at strato Dios yak'nak yet' heb' ko mam quicham?

Ha heb' wetchonhab' aj Judá, maj sk'anab'ajej heb' b'aj ix yak' sti' t'a yichanh Dios. Te chuklaj tas ix sk'ulej heb' t'a Jerusalén yet' t'a masanil yol smakb'en Israel. Ix yixtejb'at skajnub' Jehová heb', aton jun yiknhej yaji, xajan yuj. Ha heb' winh winak, ix yik'laj sb'a heb' winh yet' heb' ix ix ch'ok chonhab'il tz'och ejmelal t'a komon Dios.

Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, komonok tz'el t'a sk'ol satanel masanil heb' sk'ulan juntzanh chi' t'a ko kal a onh yinhtilal onh winhaj Jacob tik, yalxonhej mach, wach'chom syik'paxkot silab' heb' t'ay.
Ay wal junxo tas tze k'ulej: Toxonhej sch'ayxiel yaltar Jehová yuj yal he sat eyoq'ui. Tzex ok' wal sik'lab'il, yujto maxtzak chaji eyofrenda yuj Jehová.

Tzato he k'anb'an t'a Jehová chi' icha tik: ¿Tas yuj maxtzak a cha kofrenda chi'? xe chi. Aton yuj tik: Yujto a wal Jehová ix ilani to max he k'anab'ajej he ti' eyak'nak t'a heb' ix ix eyik'nak he b'a yet'ok t'a he quelemal, wach'chom a heb' ix chi' eyetb'eyum heb' ix b'aj eyak'nak he ti' chi' eyik'lan he b'a yet'ok.

¿Tom manh junnhejok b'ob'il onh yuj Dios yik junnhej niwanil tzonh aj yet' heb' ix? ¿Tas nab'il yuj Dios, yuj chi' icha chi' ix onh yutej tze na'a? Icha chi' ix onh yutej, yik wach' a heb' kuninal ay yelk'och Dios t'a yol sat heb'. Yuj chi' tzeyil wal he b'a yet' he pensar yik manh chukok tzeyutej he b'ha t'a heb' ix eyetb'eyum b'aj ix eyak' he ti' eyik'lan he b'a yet'ok t'a he quelemal.

Ha wal Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, aton Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik: Tzeyil wal he b'a, aq'ek elk'och he ti' eyak'nak t'a ix eyetb'eyum. Yujto a jun pojlajb'ail chi', te chuk t'a yol in sat, yuj chi' manh he jub'at he b'a yuj jun chi', xchi Jehová.

Toxo ix tzaktzajk'e Jehová yuj tas tzeyala', tzato wal he k'anb'an icha tik: ¿Tas ix kala' yuj chi' stzaktzajk'e Jehová chi' qued'ok? xe chi. Stzactzaj eyed'ok, yujto tzeyala' to a Jehová scha sk'ol heb' sk'ulan chukal, stzalaj yet' heb' eyalani. Tzeyalanpaxi to malaj junok Dios sch'olb'itan t'a stojolal.

Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik: Ol in chekb'at jun in chekab', yik b'at sb'o in b'e a in Yajal in tik tanhwab'il in eyuuj. Elanhchamel ol in och t'a yol in templo. Tze nib'ej sk'och lemnaj in chekab' chi', yik syak'an elk'och in trato. Ab'ek, a in ton wal ol in k'ochok.

Palta, ¿mach ol techaj yuj t'a jun k'u ayik ol in k'och chi'? ¿Mach wal ol stek'b'ej sb'ha t'a wichanh? Yujto a wopisio, lajan wal icha schaquil te' k'ak' sk'an heb' b'oum k'een, ma icha nok' xapon sk'an heb' sjuk'wi.

Ha in Jehová in tik ol in em k'ojan, yik tzin sakb'itan heb' yinhtilal Leví, icha wal tz'aj yik'jiel smikal k'een plata, ma k'een oro t'a skal k'ak'. Ichato chi', ol yak'an yofrenda heb' t'a wichanh, icha t'a smojal yet' t'a stojolal.
Ha in Jehová in tik, ol in tzalaj yet' yofrenda heb' aj Jerusalén yet' heb' ay t'a juntzanhxo lugar t'a yol smakb'en Judá, icha ajnak in tzalaj yet'ok t'a pekataxo.

Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil swal icha tik: Ol in k'och t'a he kal yik tzex in ch'olb'itej. Elanhchamel ol wak'och t'a yib'anh juntzanh heb' tik: Aton heb' ajb'aal, heb' sk'ulan ajmulal, heb' esalwum, heb' manh tz'akanok stupan smunlajwum, heb' tz'ixtan heb' ix chamnak yetb'eyum yet' heb' unin chamnak smam yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il. Ol wak'paxoch t'a yib'anh heb' malaj welk'och t'ay.
Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, malaj b'ak'uinh tzin k'exmaji. Yuj chi', a ex yinhtilal ex Jacob tik, maj ex satel-laj

wach'chom ix he patiquejel in cheknab'il, maj he k'anab'ajejlaj, lajan ix eyutej he b'a icha yutejnak sb'a heb' he mam eyicham. Ha tiknaik, meltzajanhekxi t'ayin, yik ol in meltzajxib'at k'elan t'ayex. Palta he ex tik tze k'anb'ej: ¿Tas tz'aj ko meltzajxi t'ayach? xe chi.

Ha in xo tik tzin k'anb'ej t'ayex: ¿Tom smoj tz'elk'an heb' anima t'a sDiosal? Palta a ex tik tzin eyelk'ej. Tzato he k'anb'an icha tik: ¿Tas b'aj tzach quelk'ej chi'? xe chi. Ha b'aj tzin eyelk'ej, aton t'a masanil he diezmo yet' eyofrenda.
Yuj chi' t'a wal yel katab'il exxo he masanil, yujto he masanil tzin eyelk'ej.

Ha tiknaik jun, ik'ekkot masanil he diezmo b'aj smolchaj t'a in templo, yik wach' ay tas swa heb' tzin ak'an serwil ta'. Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil swal icha tik: To tzin eyak' prowal. Icha wal chi' ol aj eyilani to ol in jak satcha’anh, ol in sekanemta in wach'k'olal t'a eyib'anh, manhxalaj b'aj ol aj yet'tal eyuuj.
Ha in swala' to manh ol in cha lajwoquel tas awab'il eyuuj yuj nok' nok', manh ol in chapax ixtaxel sat eyuwa ayik manto q'uinhb'i.
Ol yal juntzanhxo chonhab' eyuuj to te wach' eyiko' yujto te wach' ol elk'och he chonhab' tik, xchi Jehová.
Syalanpax Jehová icha tik: Ha ex tik, te chuk tzeyal t'ayin. Tzato wal he k'anb'an icha tik: ¿Tas chuk skal t'ayach? xe chi.

Icha tik tzeyutej eyalani: Nab'anhej skak' serwil Dios. Malaj skak' yala' tato sko k'anab'ajej tas syala', skak'anoch pichul yik kusk'olal t'a yichanh Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, yik sko ch'oxan ko kusk'olal yuj ko mul.

Squil wal heb' syik'chaanh sb'a, tzalajk'olal yaj heb'. Yed' heb' chuk, wach'nhej tz'elk'och heb'. Ha heb' stek'b'ej sb'ha t'a yichanh Dios, malaj pax yaelal sja t'a yib'anh heb', xe chi, xchi Jehová.

Ha heb' ay yelk'och Jehová t'a yol sat, slolon heb' t'ay junjun, haxo Jehová chi' tz'ab'an tas syal heb' chi'. Yuj chi' schekji tz'ib'chajkan sb'i heb' t'a jun libro, aton ta' sb'inajkan heb' ay yelk'och Jehová t'a yol sat, yujto ay wal och spensar heb' t'ay.

Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik: Ay jun k'ual ol in ch'olb'itej masanil heb' anima. Ha heb' ay welk'och t'ay, ol in sik'kanel heb' yik tz'ochkan heb' wikok. Icha junok mamab'il tz'ok' sk'ool t'a junok yuninal tz'ak'an serwil, icha chi' ol aj yok' in k'ool t'a heb'.
Ata' ol nachajel eyuuj to ch'ok spak yik heb' wach' sb'eyb'al tzin ak'an serwil, ch'ok pax spak yik heb' chuk sb'eyb'al max in ak'anlaj serwil, xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik: Ab'ek, wan sja sk'ual yik ol in ch'oxan yowal in k'ool. Ol in satel masanil heb' b'uchumtak yet' heb' sk'ulan chukal icha wal tz'aj stz'ab'at anh ak t'a yol junok horno. Manhxa junok heb' ol kanok.

Palta a ex to ay welk'och t'a he sat, icha wal sk'eul k'u t'a q'uinhib'alil, icha chi' ol wutej in ch'oxan in kolwal t'ayex. Yuj chi', ol ex tzalajxok. Ol ex k'e cheneljok yuj tzalajk'olal, icha tz'aj sk'e cheneljok nok' kelemtak wakax tz'elta b'aj makan.
Ha t'a jun k'ual chi', a ex tik toxonhej ol he tek'kanem heb' sk'ulan chukal, icha wal tz'aj stek'jiem k'een tik'aq'uil taanh, icha chi' ol eyutej heb'.

Naeccot in cheknab'il wak'nakkan t'a winh in chekab' aj Moisés, ayik ayek' winh t'a sjolom lum witz skuch Horeb. Ha juntzanh k'ayb'ub'al yet' cheknab'il chi', smoj wal to tze k'anab'ajej he masanil a ex israel ex tik.
Ab'ek, ol in b'ab'laj chequejb'at winh in chekab' aj Elías, ayik manto jawi jun k'ual yik ol cheklaj yowal in k'ool. Ha jun k'ual chi', te niwan yelk'ochi, ayxo smay ol ujok.
Ha winhaj Elías chi' ol ak'anoch heb' mamab'il yet' heb' uninab'il t'a junk'olal. Tato manh ol sna sb'a heb', haxo yik ol in k'ochok, haxo in satanel he chonhab' chi' t'a junelnhej, xchi Jehová.
Ha jun libro tik syalkot yab'ixal Jesucristo yinhtilal winhaj rey Dawid, yinhtilal pax winhaj Abraham. Aton stzolal sb'i heb' smam yicham Jesucristo tik.
Ha winhaj Abraham smam winhaj Isaac, a winhaj Isaac chi' smam winhaj Jacob, a winhaj Jacob chi' smam winhaj Judá yet' heb' yuk'tak.
Ha winhaj Judá chi' smam winhaj Fares yet' winhaj Zara. Tamar sb'i ix snun heb' winh schawanhil. Ha winhaj Fares chi' smam winhaj Esrom, a winhaj Esrom chi' smam winhaj Aram.
Ha winhaj Aram chi' smam winhaj Aminadab, a winhaj Aminadab chi' smam winhaj Naasón, a winhaj Naasón chi' smam winhaj Salmón.
Ha winhaj Salmón chi' smam winhaj Booz, a ix Rahab snun winhaj Booz chi'. Ha winhaj Booz chi' smam winhaj Obed, a ix snun winh, Rut sb'i ix. Ha winhaj Obed chi' smam winhaj Isaí.
Ha winhaj Isaí chi' smam winhaj Dawid, aton winh rey. Ha winhaj Dawid chi' smam winhaj Salomón. Ha ix snun winhaj Salomón chi' aton ix yetb'eyumkan winhaj Urías.
Ha winhaj Salomón chi' smam winhaj Roboam, a winhaj Roboam chi' smam winhaj Abías, a winhaj Abías chi' smam winhaj Asa.
Ha winhaj Asa chi' smam winhaj Josafat, a winhaj Josafat chi' smam winhaj Joram, a winhaj Joram chi' smam winhaj Uzías.
Ha winhaj Uzías chi' smam winhaj Jotam, a winhaj Jotam chi' smam winhaj Acaz, a winhaj Acaz chi' smam winhaj Ezequías.
Ha winhaj Ezequías chi' smam winhaj Manasés, a winhaj Manasés chi' smam winhaj Amón, a winhaj Amón chi' smam winhaj Josías.
Ha winhaj Josías chi' smam winhaj Jeconías yet' heb' yuk'tak. D'a jun pekti’ chi', ix ik'jib'at heb' israel t'a Babilonia.
Ayic ayek' heb' t'a Babilonia chi', ix alji winhaj Salatiel yuninal winhaj Jeconías. Ha winhaj Salatiel chi' smam winhaj Zorobabel.
Ha winhaj Zorobabel chi' smam winhaj Abiud, a winhaj Abiud chi' smam winhaj Eliaquim, a winhaj Eliaquim chi' smam winhaj Azor.
Ha winhaj Azor chi' smam winhaj Sadoc, a winhaj Sadoc chi' smam winhaj Aquim, a winhaj Aquim chi' smam winhaj Eliud.
Ha winhaj Eliud chi' smam winhaj Eleazar, a winhaj Eleazar chi' smam winhaj Matán, a winhaj Matán chi' smam winhaj Jacob.
Ha winhaj Jacob chi' smam winhaj José, winh yetb'eyum ix María, ix snun Jesús, aton Cristo.

Yuj chi' chequel yaji to ay 14 makan smam yicham chi', skot t'a winhaj Abraham masanto t'a winhaj Dawid. Tz'elxi yich t'a winhaj Dawid chi', masanto ix ik'jib'at heb' israel t'a Babilonia, ay 14 makan paxi. Axo yik ix ik'jib'at heb' t'a Babilonia chi' masanto ix alji Cristo, 14 makan paxi.

Icha tik ix aj yalji Jesucristo. Ha winhaj José ayxo strato winh yet' ix María. Palta tonhejanto ay strato heb', manto yik'laj sb'a heb'. Palta haxo ix María chi', ayxo unin yet'nak ix, yujto a Yespíritu Dios ix ak'an skuchoch jun unin chi' ix.
Ha winhaj José chi', te tojol spensar winh, malaj snib'ej winh scheklajelta ix t'a skal anima. Yuj chi' ix sna winh yaktejkan ix t'a elk'altak, yik malaj mach tz'ojtakanel jun chi'.

Axo yik wanto snaan jun chi' winh, ay jun yángel Dios Kajal ix ch'ox sb'ha t'a winh t'a swayich. Ix yalan t'a winh: --Ach José, yinhtil winhaj Dawid, manh ach xiw ik'an ix María tik etb'eyumok. Yujto a Yespíritu Dios ix ak'an pitzwok jun unin chi' t'a ix.
Ha jun unin ol aljok chi', winak unin. JESÚS ol ak' sb'iej, yujto ha' ol ex kolankanelta a ex schonhab' ex tik t'a yalanh he mul, xchi t'a winh.
Icha chi' ix aj yelk'och tas yalnakkan Dios Kajal, ayik ix lolon t'a sti' jun schekab' icha tik:

Ay jun ix kob'es, manta winak syik'a', palta ay jun unin ol pitzwok t'a ix. Ha jun unin ol aljok chi', winak unin. Emanuel ol ak'jok sb'iej, xchi t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani. Emanuel, syalelk'ochi, ayek' Dios qued'ok.
Axo ix el swayanh winhaj José chi', ix sk'anab'ajan winh icha ix yutej yalan jun yángel Dios Kajal chi'. Ichato chi', ix schaan sk'ol winh yik'an ix.
Palta maj yil-laj sb'a winh yet' ix, masanto ix alji jun unin chi'. Axo ix alji, JESÚS ix yak' heb' sb'iej.

Ha t'a chonhab' Belén, t'a yol yik Judea, ata' ix alji Jesús. Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', a winhaj Herodes ayoch reyal t'a Judea. Ay juntzanh heb' winh winak skuchan mago schuman yet' k'een k'anal. Ayic toxo ix alji Jesús, ix kot heb' winh b'aj sja k'u. Ix ja heb' winh t'a Jerusalén.

Ix sk'anb'anek' heb' winh: --¿B'aj ay jun unin toto ix alji, jun ol och he reyalok a ex israel ex tik? Ha b'aj sja k'u, ata' ix quil sk'eul jun k'een k'anal. Ha k'een sch'oxani to ix alji. Yuj chi' onh koti, yik skak'em ko b'a t'ay, xchi heb' winh.
Axo ix yab'an spekal jun chi' winhaj rey Herodes, ix te somchaj spensar winh. Yed' jantak heb' ay t'a Jerusalén chi', ix te somchajk'e heb' yet' winh.
Ix yawtankot masanil heb' winh sat sakerdote winh yet' heb' winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés. Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb' winh: --¿B'ajtil ol aljok winh Cristo? xchi winh t'a heb' winh.
Ix yalan heb' winh: --Ha t'a chonhab' Belén, t'a yol yik Judá, ata' ol aljok winh. Yujto ay jun schekab' Dios tz'ib'annakkan icha tik:

Ha jun chonhab' Belén, t'a yol yik Judea, yunenhej t'a yichanh juntzanhxo chonhab' ay t'a yol yik Judá chi'. Palta ek'al yopisio t'a yichanh juntzanhxo chonhab' chi'. Yujto ata' ol aljok jun winh yajal, Ha ol ilan in chonhab' Israel, xchi t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani, xchi heb' winh.
Axo winhaj Herodes chi' ix chekan awtajkot heb' winh mago chi'. Elk'altak ix sk'anb'ej winh yab' t'a heb' winh, b'ak'nhitax ix sch'ox sb'a jun k'anal chi' t'a heb' winh.

Ixlajwi yab'an winh, ix chekjib'at heb' winh yuj winh t'a chonhab' Belén. Ayic manto b'at heb' winh, ix stz'akan yal winh icha tik: --Ixiquec t'a Belén chi'. Cham wal he k'anb'an eyab'i b'ajtil ayek' jun unin chi'. Slajwi schax chi' eyuuj, tzul eyalan t'ayin, yik ol in b'at wak'paxem in b'a t'ay, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi yab'an juntzanh chi' heb' winh, ix b'at heb' winh. Axo jun k'anal syil heb' winh b'aj sjawi k'u chi', b'ab'el sb'at yuj heb' winh, masanto ix k'och t'a stojolal yib'anh b'aj ay jun unin chi'. Ata' ix och waan.
Axo ix yilanxi jun k'anal chi' heb' winh, ix te tzalaj heb' winh.

Ix och heb' winh t'a yol jun pat chi'. Ix yilan jun unin chi' heb' winh yet' snun, aton ix María. Ix em kuman heb' winh t'ay. Ix yak'anem sb'a heb' winh t'ay. Ixlajwi chi', ix sjakan juntzanh skaxa heb' winh b'aj ayem juntzanh silab'. Ix sian oro heb' winh t'a jun unin chi'. Ix sian juntzanh te suk'uq'ui sjab' heb' winh, snhusji yet' juntzanhxo yal te suk'uq'ui sjab' skuchan mirra.
Axo ix alji t'a heb' winh t'a swayich, to maxtzak ek' heb' winh yal t'a winhaj Herodes chi'. Yuj chi' ch'okxo b'e b'aj ix pax heb' winh t'a schonhab'.

Ixlajwi spax heb' winh mago chi', ay jun yángel Dios Kajal ix ch'ox sb'ha t'a winhaj José chi' t'a swayich, ix yalani: --Q'ueanh waan. Ik'b'at winh unin tik ed'ok yet' snun. Elanhec t'a elanhchamel. Tzex b'at t'a Egipto. Tzex kannhej ta', masanto ol walxi t'ayach, yujto a winhaj Herodes ol chekan sayjoquek' jun unin tik, yujto snib'ej winh ol yak' miljokchamok, xchi jun ángel chi'.
Yuj chi', ix k'e waan winhaj José chi'. Ix yik'anb'at jun unin chi' winh yet' ix María t'ak'walil. Ix b'at heb' t'a Egipto.
Ata' ix aj heb' masanto ix cham winhaj Herodes chi'. Icha chi' ix aj yelk'och tas yalnakkan Dios Kajal a ix lolon t'a sti' jun schekab'. Xchi icha tik: Ha t'a Egipto ix wawtej paxta Vuninal, xchi.

Axo ix yilan winhaj Herodes chi' to majxo ek' heb' winh mago chi' yal t'a winh, ix snaanel winh to tonhej ix ak'ji musansatil winh yuj heb' winh. Yuj chi', ix te kot yowal winh. Ix schekan miljokcham jantaknhej heb' winak unin winh ay t'a chonhab' Belén yet' heb' ay t'a slak'anil jun chonhab' chi'. Ix laj cham heb' schab'il ab'il yet' heb' manto tz'akwi chab' ab'il. Yujto icha chi' stiempoal ix sk'anb'ej winh t'a heb' winh mago chi'.
Icha chi' ix aj yelk'och tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj jun winh schekab' Dios skuchan Jeremías. Xchi icha tik:

Ix ab'chaj jun aw t'a chonhab' Ramá. Ay jun niwan ok'el yet' jun niwan kusk'olal. Ha ix Raquel, ix ok' ix yuj heb' yune'. Malaj snib'ej ix tz'ak'ji sniwanil sk'ool, yujto manhxalaj heb' yune' ix, xchi.
Axo yik ix cham winhaj Herodes chi', ix sch'oxan sb'a jun yángel Dios Kajal t'a winhaj José chi' t'a swayich, ayik ayek' winh t'a Egipto. Ix yalan t'a winh:
--Q'ueanh waan. Ik'b'at winh unin tik yet' snun. Paxanhec t'a he chonhab', yujto a heb' winh snib'ej smilancham jun unin tik, chamnakxo heb' winh, xchi jun ángel chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix k'e waan winhaj José chi'. Ix yik'ankot jun unin chi' winh yet' ix snun t'a yol yik Israel chi'.

Palta ix yab'an winhaj José chi' to a jun winh yuninal winhaj Herodes skuchan Arquelao aykanoch sk'exulok winh smam chi' yak'an mandar t'a Judea chi'. Yuj chi', ix xiw winh sk'och kajan ta'. Ix yalan Dios t'a winh t'a swayich tas sk'ulej. Yuj chi' ix b'atkan heb' t'a yol yik Galilea.

Ayic ix k'och heb' ta', ix kajnaj heb' t'a chonhab' Nazaret. Icha chi' ix aj yelk'och tas yalnakkan heb' schekab' Dios t'a peka'. Tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj heb', chajtil to ol yal heb' anima to aj Nazaret Jesús.
Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', ay jun winh skuchan Juan ix ak'an bautizar t'a tzinan lu'um t'a yol yik Judea. Ata' ix yalel slolonel Dios winh t'a heb' anima ix laj k'och t'ay.
Ix yalan winh icha tik t'a heb': --Naec he b'a yuj he chukal, yujto toxo ol wach' och Dios aj satcha’anh Yajalil, xchi winh.

Ay jun winh schekab' Dios skuchan Isaías, ayokto ix stz'ib'ankan yab'ixal winhaj Juan chi' winh t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani, xchi icha tik: Ay jun t'a tzinan lu'um, chaanh ol yal icha tik: Icha tz'aj sb'o b'e yik sjawi junok yajal, icha chi' tzeyutej he b'oan he b'eyb'al, yujto ol jawok Dios Kajal, xchama, xchi t'a Slolonel Dios chi'.
Ha winhaj Juan chi', a xil nok' kamello ayoch spichulok winh, haxo stzek'ul winh, a nok' tz'uum. Ha juntzanh nok' icha nok' yol sojoy schi winh, haxo nok' kaltakte'al yal chab' syuk'ej winh.
Ha heb' aj Jerusalén smasanil, sk'och heb' smaklej yab' t'a winh. Ay pax heb' t'a junjun chonhab' t'a yol yik Judea yet' heb' ay t'a slak'anil ha' niwan Jordán sk'ochi,
ix laj yalank'eta smul heb'. Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an ak'jok bautizar sb'a heb' yuj winh t'ha ha' Jordán chi'.

Tzijtum heb' fariseo yet' heb' sadukeo ix laj k'och b'aj wan yak'an bautizar winh chi'. Ix yalan winh t'a heb': --Ha ex tik, te jelan ex t'a chukal icha nok' chan. ¿Mach ix alan t'ayex to syal he kolanel he b'ha t'a jun niwan yaelal ol jawok?
Tato tze na he b'a yuj he mul, yowalil wach' tzeyutej he b'a yik scheklajeli to ix he na he b'a.

Manh eyal icha tik: Malaj pena, yinhtil onh kan winhaj Abraham. Yuj chi' malaj tas ol jawok t'a quib'anh, manh xe chiok. Yujto a in swal t'ayex, tato snib'ej Dios, syal yoch juntzanh k'een k'een tik yinhtilalok winhaj Abraham chi' he k'exulok.

Ha jun yaelal ol jawok chi', lajan icha junok winh winak lista yaj yet' sch'akab' t'a yich juntzanh te' awb'en te'. Jantacnhej te' chuklaj sat syak'a', ol laj ch'akjoquel te'. Ol syumankanb'at te' winh t'a yol k'ak'.

Ha in tik, t'a wal yel tzex wak' bautizar t'a ha ha', yik chequel to ix he na he b'a. Palta ay wal junxo tzak'an sjawi wuuj. Ha ol ak'an Yespíritu Dios t'ayex, mato a k'ak' ol yak' t'ayex. Icha to ol ex ak'jok bautizar yuj. Ha jun ol jawok chi', yelxo wal niwan yelk'och t'a wichanh. Manh in mojok wak'an serwil, wach'chom tonhej swik'el xanhab'.

Ha jun chi', lajan icha junok winh sluchank'e waan strigo yet' sluchlab', yik tz'el smatz'il ixim. Smesanxik'e waan t'a stek'lab'. Sik'anxib'at ixim trigo chi' t'a yet'tal. Axo yok ixim chi', snhustz'ha t'a yol jun k'ak' malaj b'ak'uinh stupi, xchi winhaj Juan chi' t'a heb'.
Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', spetoj Jesús t'a yol yik Galilea. Ix k'och t'ha ha' niwan Jordán, b'aj ayek' winhaj Juan, yik syak'an ak'jok bautizar sb'a.

Ha t'a sb'ab'elal max yal-laj sk'ool winhaj Juan chi' syak' bautizar Jesús. Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a Jesús chi': --Smoj a in tzin ak' bautizar, yuj chi' manh smojok a in tzach wak' bautizar, xchi winh.
Palta ix yalan Jesús chi' t'a winh: --Yowalil ol a k'ulej jun tik yujto smoj sko k'anab'ajej jantaknhej tas syal Dios, xchi t'a winh. Ichato chi', ix chaan sk'ol winhaj Juan chi'.
Axo yik ix lajwi yak'ji bautizar Jesús, ix k'exta t'a yol ha'. Axo t'a jun rato chi', ix jakwi satcha’anh. Ix yilan yemul Yespíritu Dios t'a yib'anh, icha junok nok' paramuch.
Axo ix yab'an heb', ay jun ix lolonemta t'a satcha’anh. Ix yalan icha tik: --Aton jun tik, Vuninal. Te xajanab'il wuuj. Tzin tzalaj wal yet'ok, xchi.
Axo Jesús ix ik'jib'at yuj Yespíritu Dios t'a taquinh lu'um. Ix k'och ta' yik tz'ak'ji prowal yuj winh diablo.
40 k'ual majxo walaj Jesús chi', ichato chi' ix och swejel.
Axo winh diablo ix k'och yak'lan smontanb'at t'a chukal, ix yalan winh: --Ina Yuninal ach Dios, al t'a juntzanh k'een tik yik tz'och k'een panil, xchi winh t'ay.
Palta ix yalan Jesús: --Ha t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani, a tz'alan icha tik: Manh yujoknhej tas swaji ay ko k 'inal. Palta yuj jantaknhej tas syal Dios ay ko k 'inal, xchikani, xchi Jesús.
Ixlajwi chi', ix ik'jib'at yuj winh diablo chi' t'a jun chonhab' yiknhej Dios yaji, aton Jerusalén. Ix yik'ank'e Jesús chi' winh t'a schon stemplo Dios.

Ix yalan winh t'ay icha tik: --Ina Yuninal ach Dios, emanh chennaj t'a sat lu'um chi', yujto syalkan t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani: Ol yal Dios t'a heb' yángel, yik tzach stanhwej heb'. Ol ach quetzchajk'e yuj heb', yik wach' manh ol a tenoch ok t'a k'een k'een, xchikani, xchi winh diablo chi'.
Ix tak'wi pax Jesús chi': --Palta syalpax icha tik t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani: Manh in eyak' prowal, yujto he Yajal in, he Diosal in, xchikani, xchi t'a winh.
Ix yik'anxib'at Jesús chi' winh diablo, ix k'och heb' t'a jun niwan tzalan. Ix sch'oxan masanil nakión winh t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik t'ay. Ix sch'oxan winh to te niwan yelk'och swach'il.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh: --Masanil juntzanh tik, ol wak' iquej, tato tzach em kuman t'ayin, tzalan a b'a t'ayin, xchi winh.

Palta ix yalan Jesús t'a winh: --Ach Satanás, elanh t'a in tz'ey. Yujto icha tik syal t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani: Ha t'ayin tzeyal he b'a, yujto he Yajal in, he Diosal in. Ha innhej tzin eyak' serwil, xchi Dios, xchi Jesús chi'.
Yuj chi', ix aktajkan Jesús chi' yuj winh. Axo heb' ángel ix ul ak'an serwil.
Axo yik ix yab'an Jesús to preso yaj winhaj Juan, ix b'atxi t'a yol yik Galilea.

Manhok t'a Nazaret ix k'ochi, palta ha t'a Capernaum, ata' ix k'och kajan. Ha jun chonhab' chi', ha t'a sti' ha' nhajab' ay. Ha t'a yol smakb'en heb' yinhtilal winhaj Zabulón yet' winhaj Neftalí, ata' ay.
Icha chi' ix aj yelk'och tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj winhaj Isaías schekab' Dios t'a peka', xchi icha tik:
Ha t'a yol yik Zabulón yet' t'a yol yik Neftalí, ha t'a sti' ha' nhajab' ata' ay, t'a sk'axepalek' ha' niwan Jordán. Ata' ay jun chonhab' Galilea sb'i, aton b'aj kajan heb' manh israelok.

Ha heb' anima chi', ayto ek' heb' t'a k’ik’ k’inal, palta ol yil jun sakil k'inal heb' te niwan yelk'ochi. Ha heb' ayek' ta', ichato chamnak heb', palta ol k'och sakil k'inal t'a heb', xchi t'a Slolonel Dios chi'.
Axo yik ix k'och Jesús chi' ta', ix och ijan yalanel slolonel Dios t'a heb' anima chi', ix yalan icha tik: --Naec he b'a, yujto toxo ol wach' och Dios aj satcha’anh Yajalil, xchi t'a heb'.

Ayic wan sb'eyek' Jesús t'a sti' ha' nhajab' yik Galilea, ix yilani ayek' winhaj Simón skuch pax Pedro yet' jun winh yuk'tak winh skuchan Andrés. Van yak'anem jun schimpa heb' winh yik yamlab' chay t'a yol ha', yujto yamum chay heb' winh.
Axo Jesús ix alan t'a heb' winh: --Ochanhec in k'ayb'umok. Ol wak'och eyopisio. Icha tzeyutej eyaman nok' chay tik, icha chi' ol eyutok eyik'ankot heb' anima t'ayin, xchi t'a heb' winh.
D'a jun rato chi' ix yaktejkan ch'anh schimpa heb' winh. Ix och heb' winh sk'ayb'umok Jesús chi'.

Janik'anto sb'at heb', ix ilchaj chawanhxo heb' winh yuk'tak sb'a yuj, aton winhaj Jacobo yet' winhaj Juan. Ha winhaj Zebedeo ay yik heb' winh. Ayoch heb' winh t'a yol jun barko yet' smam chi', wan snipan schimpa heb' winh yik yamlab' chay. Axo Jesús ix awtankot heb' winh.
D'a jun rato chi' ix yaktankan smam heb' winh chi' yet' jun barko chi', ix och heb' winh sk'ayb'umok Jesús.

Ix ek' Jesús t'a yol yik Galilea chi' yet' heb' sk'ayb'um. Ix laj ek' sk'ayb'ej heb' anima t'a yoltak spatil skulto. Ix ek' yalanel jun wach' ab'ix, chajtil tz'aj yoch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' Dios aj satcha’anh. Jantacnhej juntzanh yab'il tz'ik'an heb' anima chi', ix laj b'oxikan heb' yuj.

Ix laj pukaxel yab'ixal Jesús t'a skal masanil yol yik Siria. Yuj chi' ix ik'jib'at heb' penaay smasanil t'ay, jantaknhej juntzanh yab'il yet' juntzanh ilya tz'ik'an heb'. Anhejtona', ay pax heb' tz'ixtaj yuj heb' enemigo, heb' skot t'a sjolom yet' heb' sikb'inaqueli. Ix laj ik'jib'at heb' t'ay. Yuj chi' ix b'oxikan heb' smasanil yuj.

Jantac heb' aj Galilea chi', ix laj och tzak'an heb' yuj. Anhejtona', ay heb' t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a yol yik Decápolis, t'a Jerusalén, t'a Judea yet' pax t'a sk'axepalek' ha' niwan Jordán, ix laj och pax tzak'an heb' yuj.
Ha ix yilan heb' anima Jesús, ix k'e t'a jun tzalan. Ix em k'ojan ta', haxo heb' sk'ayb'um ix k'och heb' t'ay.
Ix sk'ayb'an heb', ix yalan icha tik:
--Ha heb' snachajel yuj to manh wach'ok heb' t'a yichanh Dios, te wach' yik heb', yujto ayxo och heb' t'a yol sk'ab' Dios aj satcha’anh.
Ha heb' skus yuj smul, te wach' yik heb', yujto ha Dios ol ak'an sniwanil sk'ool heb'.
Ha heb' emnaquil syutej sb'a, te wach' yik heb', yujto ol yiquej jun lugar heb' yalnakkan Dios.
Ha heb' te ay snib'ej stojolb'itan spensar, te wach' yik heb', yujto ol och Dios yet' heb', yik wach' icha chi' ol aj stojolb'i heb'.
Ha heb' tz'ok' sk'ool t'a heb' yetanimail, te wach' yik heb', yujto tz'ok' pax sk'ool Dios t'a heb'.
Ha heb' malaj chukal t'a spensar, te wach' yik heb', yujto ol yil Dios heb'.
Ha heb' ak'um lajwok owal, te wach' yik heb', yujto ha Dios ol alan heb' yuninalok.
Ha heb' tz'ab'an syail yujto wach' syutej sb'a heb', te wach' yik heb', yujto ayoch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' Dios aj satcha’anh.
Ha exxo tik, tato wuuj tzex b'ajji, tato ay tas tz'ak'jioch t'a eyib'anh, te wach' eyiko'. Anhejtona' tato wuuj tz'ak'jikot juntzanh es t'a eyib'anh, te wach' eyiko'.
Tzex tzalaj wal sik'lab'il, yujto te niwan spak ol he cha t'a satcha’anh. Icha tz'aj yak'jioch t'a eyib'anh tiknaik, icha chi' ajnak och t'a yib'anh heb' schekab' Dios t'a peka'.

Icha atz'am atz'am, icha chi' eyaj t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik. Q'uinalok a atz'am atz'am satel sk'achial, ¿tas to ol aj sk'achib'ixi? Manhxalaj tz'och atz'am. Tonhej syumjiel atz'am, slaj stek'nub'an heb' anima.
Icha sakil k'inal, icha chi' eyaj t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik. Q'uinalok ay junok chonhab' t'a junok tzalan, max yal-laj ko k'ub'aneli.
Ayic skak'anoch sk'ak'al ko kandil, ¿tom ha t'a yalanh junok kajón skak'kan ochi? Maay, palta chaanh skutejk'ei, yik wach' syil heb' tz'och t'a yol pat chi'.

Icha yaj jun kandil chi', icha chi' eyaji. Ch'oxequel sakil k'inal t'a heb' anima, syalelk'ochi, aton he wach' b'eyb'al tze ch'ox yil heb', yuj chi' ol yal wach' lolonel heb' t'a ko Mam Dios ayek' t'a satcha’anh.
Manh he na'a to in ja wak' lajwok ley Moisés yet' juntzanh sk'ayb'ub'al heb' schekab' Dios t'a peka'. Manh yujok jun chi' in jawi, palta in jawi yik wach' ol elk'och tas syal jun ley chi'.

Val yel swal t'ayex, yowalil ol elk'och masanil tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a jun ley chi'. Yakb'an ayto ek' jun yol yib'anhk’inal tik yet' satcha’anh, malaj wal jab'ok Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkan chi' ol satelok. Wach'chom a junok letra, ma junok punto, malaj wal junok tas ol satelok, masanto ol elk'och masanil tas tz'ib'yajkan t'ay.

Ay juntzanh cheknab'il t'a jun ley chi', ichato malaj wal yelk'ochi, palta yalnhej mach max k'anab'ajan smasanil, syalanpax t'a heb' anima to max sk'anab'ajej pax heb', tato ol k'och heb' t'a yol sk'ab' Dios t'a satcha’anh, wal yel malaj wal ol aj yelk'och heb' t'a skal heb' ayek' ta'. Palta a heb' sk'anab'ajan tas syal jun ley chi', syalanpax t'a heb' anima to sk'anab'ajej heb', ayik ol k'och heb' t'a yol sk'ab' Dios chi', yel ton wal te niwan ol aj yelk'och heb' t'a skal heb' ayek' ta'.

Ha heb' k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés yet' heb' fariseo, ichato te tojol sb'eyb'al heb' t'a yichanh heb' anima, palta swal t'ayex, tato manh ek'okto swach'il he b'eyb'al chi' t'a heb', toton manh ton ol ex k'ochlaj t'a yol sk'ab' Dios.

Kab'nak tas alb'ilkan t'a heb' ko mam quicham t'a peka'. Xchi icha tik: Manh he mak'cham heb' eyetanimail. Yalnhej mach smak'ancham junokxo anima, yowalil ol k'och t'a yichanh ley, haxo ta' ol ch'olb'itaj tas yaji, xchi.

Palta a in swal t'ayex, yalnhej mach junok schichonoch sk'ool t'a junok yetanimail, ol ch'olb'itaj tas yaji. Yalnhej mach sb'uchwaj t'a junok yetanimail, ol ch'olb'itaj yuj heb' sat yajal. Anhejtona' yalnhej mach junok sb'ajan junok yetanimail, ay smay sb'atkan t'a infierno t'a skal k'ak'.
Yuj chi', ayik tzex k'och yet' eyofrenda b'aj tzeyak' d'ha Dios, tato tze nakoti to ay b'aj ix och he mul t'a junokxo anima,
kanokab' jun eyofrenda chi' b'ela. B'at he b'okan yaj yet'ok. Slajwi chi', tzex jaxi, tzeyak'an eyofrenda chi'.

Q'uinalok ay heb' tz'ak'anoch t'a eyib'anh, tzex yik'anb'at heb' t'a winh yajal, ayik wan to he b'at t'a yol b'e, tze b'oankan yaj yet' heb', yik wach' maxtzak b'at ex yak'och heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winh yajal chi'. Yujto a winh yajal chi' tzex ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' winh polenkía. Axo heb' winh tzex ak'anb'at preso.
Val yel swal t'ayex, maxtzak ex aktajeli masanto tze tup he multa smasanil.
Kab'nak pax tas alb'ilkan t'a sley Dios, ayik yalannakkani: Manh ex em ajmulal, xchi.
Palta a in tik swal t'ayex, yalnhej mach syiloch sk'ool t'a junok ix ix, a jun chi' toxo ix em ajmulal yet' ix t'a spensar.

Q'uinalok ayex, yuj yol he sat ay t'a he wach', tz'ixtaxel he pensar. Tato icha chi', wach' ama tzeyik'elta jun yol he sat chi', tzeyumaneli. Yujto wach' tato jab'nhej he niwanil satkaneli, t'a yichanh tzex b'atkan t'a infierno yet' he niwanil chi' smasanil.

Q'uinalok ayex yuj he k'ab' ay t'a he wach' tz'ixtaxel he pensar. Tato icha chi', te wach' tato tze tzepel jun he k'ab' chi', tzeyumankaneli. Yujto wach' tato jab'nhej he niwanil satkaneli, t'a yichanh tzex b'atkan t'a infierno yet' he niwanil chi' smasanil.
Atax t'a peka' alb'ilkan jun tik: Ha winh spuk sb'a yet' ix yetb'eyum, yowalil sb'okan junok yumal ayik spukan sb'a heb' chi', syak'ankan winh t'a ix, xchi.

Palta a in tik, swal t'ayex, tato ay mach spuk sb'a yet' ix yetb'eyum, tato manh yujok ajmulal, tato icha chi', a winh tz'ak'anoch ix t'a ajmulal. Anhejtona', yalnhej mach junok winh tz'ik'an jun ix spuknak sb'a yet' winh yetb'eyum, tz'ochpax winh ajmulal.
Kab'nak tas alb'ilkan t'a heb' ko mam quicham t'a peka', xchi icha tik: Tato tze lok sb'i Dios Kajal, tzeyak'an he ti', yowalil tze k'anab'ajej juntzanh tas tzeyalkan chi', xchi.
Palta a in tik swal t'ayex, mokab'a junok tas tze lok sb'i. Max yal he lokan sb'i satcha’anh, yujto a jun chi', aton sdespacho Dios.
Yed' pax sat lu'um tik, max yal he lokan sb'i, yujto icha stek'nub' Dios yaji. Yed' pax Jerusalén, max yal he lokan sb'i, yujto a jun chi', aton schonhab' jun ko Reyal te niwan yelk'ochi.
Anhejtona' he jolom, max yal he lokan pax sb'i, yujto manh eyikok he ch'okoj, yujto max yal eyak'an sakb'ok junok pitanh xil he jolom ma eyak'anxi k'ik'b'ok.
Ayic tzex loloni, Yel toni, xe chinhej, Maay, xe chi. Max yal he lokan sb'i junok tasi, yujto a jun lokoj b'i chi' t'a winh diablo skoti.
Kab'nak tas alb'ilkan t'a peka'. Xchi icha tik: Tato ay junok mach smak'an poj yol sat junokxo, mak'jokab' pax poj yiko'. Anhejtona' tato ay mach smak'anel ye junok, mak'jokab' pax el yiko', xchi.
Palta a in tik, swal t'ayex, manh eyak' owal yet' heb' chuk syutej sb'a t'ayex. Tato ay junok mach sd'ob'anb'at he ti' t'a he wach', tze meltzitejb'at junxo pak'anh t'ay.
Tato ay mach snib'ej stok'anek' he kamix t'a yichanh ley, tzeyak'paxb'at he chumpa t'ay.
Anhejtona', tato ay junok mach tzex ak'an pural he kuchanb'at nanhalok legua yikatz, tato icha chi', jun legua tze kuchb'at t'ay.
Yalnhej mach junok sk'anan smajnej junok tas t'ayex, manh ex b'at miknaj t'ay.
Kab'nak tas alb'ilkan t'a peka'. Xchi icha tik: Tze xajanej heb' wach' eyak'an yet'ok. Axo heb' eyajk'ool, schichonoch he k'ool t'a heb', xchi.
Palta a in tik swal t'ayex: Yowalil tze xajanej heb' ajk'ol yajoch t'ayex. Tzex lesalwipax yuj heb' tz'ak'anoch junok chukal t'a eyib'anh.

Icha chi' tzeyutej he ch'oxanel he b'a to yel yuninal ex ko Mam ay t'a satcha’anh, yujto a tz'ak'anemta yok k'u t'a yib'anh heb' chuk yet' t'a yib'anh heb' wach'. Anhejtona', syak'anpax emta nhab' t'a yib'anh heb' manh tojolok spensar yet' t'a yib'anh heb' tojol spensar.
Tato anhej heb' tzex xajanan tze xajanej, ¿tom ol he cha spak jun chi' tze na'a? Ina heb' winh tekumel tumin, anheja' icha pax chi' syutej sb'a heb' winh.
Anhejtona', tato anhej heb' he wach' k'ool tze k'umej, ¿tom ay yelk'och jun chi' he naani? Ina heb' manh ojtannakok Dios, anheja' icha pax chi' syutej sb'a heb'.
Yowalil tz'akan ex t'a masanil tas wach', icha ko Mam ayek' t'a satcha’anh, tz'akan t'a masanil tas wach'.
Tzeyil wal he b'a, manhtok anhej t'a yichanh heb' anima wach' tzeyutej he b'a. Tato ichanhej chi' tzeyutej he b'a, malaj spak ol he cha t'a ko Mam ayek' t'a satcha’anh.

Yuj chi', ayik tzex kolwaj t'a heb' meb'a', malajokab' b'aj tzeyala', yujto a heb' chab' sat syak' heb' yojtaquejel masanil anima, icha chi' sk'ulej heb' t'a yoltak spatil skulto heb' yet' t'a yol kalle yik slaj yal heb' anima to wach' heb'. Val yel swal t'ayex, toxo ix scha spak jun swach'il heb' chi'. Toxon malaj jab'ok spak ol scha heb' d'ha Dios.
Ha exxo pax tik, a tzex kolwaj t'a heb' meb'a', mokab' eyal t'a junokxo mach, wach'chom eyamigo wal, manh eyal yab'i.
k'ub'eltaknhej tzex kolwaj t'a heb' meb'a' chi'. Wach'chom k'ub'eltak tzex kolwaj t'a heb', a ko Mam Dios tz'ilani. Yuj chi', ha' ol ak'an spak t'ayex.

Ayic tzex lesalwi, mokab' ex lesalwok ichok heb' chab'sat. Yujto a heb' chi', snib'ej heb' tonhej sk'e linhan slesalwi t'a yoltak spatil kulto yet' b'aj scha sb'a kalle t'a esquina, yik slaj yal heb' anima to wach' heb'. Val yel swal t'ayex, toxo ix scha spak swach'il heb' chi'. Toxon malaj jab'ok spak ol scha heb' d'ha Dios.

Ha exxo tik, ayik tzex lesalwi, tze makchejoch he b'ha t'a yol he pat. Slajwi chi', t'a k'ub'eltak tzeyak' he lesal t'a ko Mam Dios. Wach'chom t'a k'ub'eltak tzeyak' he lesal t'ay, ha' ol ab'anok, ol yak'an spak t'ayex.
Ayic tzex lesalwi, mantok tonhej tzex komon loloni, icha syutej sb'a heb' manh ojtannakok Dios. Ha heb' chi', yujnhej to najat syutej yok slesal heb', syab'an Dios snaan heb'.
Yuj chi', manh lajanok tzeyutej he lesalwi yet' heb', yujto yojtakxo ko Mam Dios tas tz'och eyuuj ayik mantzak he k'an t'ay.
Yuj chi' icha tik tzeyutej he lesalwi: Ach ko Mam, ay ach ek' t'a satcha’anh. Niwanokab' yelk'och a b'i.
Ach ochokab' yajalil t'a tik. k'anab'ajaxokab' tas tza nib'ej t'a sat lu'um tik, icha tzach k'anab'ajax t'a satcha’anh.
Ak' tas sko wa t'a k'u tik.
Ak' lajwok ko mul yujto a onh tik skak' niwank'olal heb' tz'och smul t'ayonh.
Manh onh a cha montajb'at t'a chukal. Tzonh a kolanel t'a yol sk'ab' winh chuk. Yujto masanil tiempo Yajal achnhej. Te niwan a poder. Te niwan elk'ochi. Amén.
Ha ex tik, tato tzeyak' niwank'olal heb' tz'och smul t'ayex, haxo ko Mam ayek' t'a satcha’anh ol ak'an lajwok he mul.
Palta tato max eyak' niwank'olal heb' tz'och smul t'ayex, haxo ko Mam Dios max ak'an pax lajwok he mul.

Ayic tzex och t'a tzek'ojk'olal, manh lajanok tzeyutej he b'a yet' heb' chab' sat. Yujto a heb' chi', ejmeltak syutej sat heb', yik syil heb' anima to ayoch heb' t'a tzek'ojk'olal. Val yel swal t'ayex, toxo ix scha spak jun stzek'ojk'olal heb' chi'. Toxon malaj spak ol scha heb' d'ha Dios.
Ha exxo pax tik, ayik tzex och tzek'ojk'olal, tze b'iquel he sat, tze jixb'an he jolom,

yik wach' malaj mach snaani tato ayex och t'a tzek'ojk'olal. Tato icha chi', anhej t'a yichanh ko Mam Dios ayex och t'a tzek'ojk'olal. Wach'chom k'ub'eltak tzex ochi, ol yila', ha' ol ak'anxi spak t'ayex.
Manh he mol he b'eyumal t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik. Ha juntzanh chi', tz'och ijaxok, sk'ab'ati, tz'och heb' elk'um t'ay.
Más wach' t'a satcha’anh tze mol he b'eyumal. Yujto a jun he b'eyumal t'a satcha’anh chi', max ochlaj ijaxok, max k'alaj. Max ochpaxlaj heb' elk'um t'ay.
Yujto a b'aj sko molb'ej ko b'eyumal chi', ata' skak'b'at ko pensar.
Ha yol ko sat, icha junok kandil, icha chi' yaj t'a ko niwanil tik. Yuj chi' tato junnhej b'aj ayoch ko sat, sakil k'inal kaji, wach' skutej ko b'a yet' ko niwanil.
Palta tato ayex ch'okch'ok b'aj tzeyak'och he sat, tzex kan t'a k’ik’ k’inal yuj. Ha jun sakil k'inal ayoch t'ayex, tato smeltzajoch k'ik'alq'uinalil t'ayex, ol ex kan t'a k’ik’ k’inal sik'lab'il.

Malaj junok onh syal kak'an serwil chawanhok patrón, yujto ay junok ol ko patiquejeli, haxo junokxo, ol ko xajanej. Ay jun b'aj ol kak'och ko pensar, haxo junokxo malaj jab'ok yelk'och t'a ko sat. Yuj chi' max yal-laj kak'an serwil Dios, skak'anpax och ko pensar t'a k'een tumin.

Swal t'ayex, manh ex och ilk'olal yuj tas ol ik'an yek' tiempo eyuuj, yuj tas tze wa''a yet' pax tas tz'aj he pichchaji. Ha Dios tz'ak'an ko k 'inal, okxom tas sko wa''a, ¿tom manh ol yak'a'? Ha ix ak'an ko niwanil, ¿tom manh ol yak' pax ko pichul?

Tzeyilnab' nok' much tzek' jenhenhok t'a satcha’anh. Malaj tas syawej nok'. Max jach'wilaj nok'. Malaj pax tas smol nok'. Palta a ko Mam Dios ay t'a satcha’anh tz'ak'an swael nok'. Inatax tz'ak'ji swael nok', ok exxom a ex tik, más niwan eyelk'och t'a yichanh nok'.
¿Tom ay junok ex syal eyak'anoch nanhalokxo wara he teel wach'chom tzex och ilk'olal?
Anhejtona', ¿tas yuj tze naub'tanhej yuj he pichul? Tzeyilnab' sq'uib' juntzanh anh xumak. Ha juntzanh chi' max munlajlaj. Max ch'alwilaj.
Palta swal t'ayex, a yek'nak winhaj rey Salomón, wach'chom manh jantakok swach'il yilji winh yet' spichul, palta maj tzak'wanlaj swach'il yilji winh icha juntzanh anh xumak chi'.

Ha juntzanh anh chi', tonhej ayek' anh tiknaik, haxo k'ik'an tz'och anh sk'ak'alok horno. Wach'chom icha chi' anh, palta ha Dios tz'ak'an swach'il yilji anh. Yuj chi', ol yak'pax he pichul. Palta inai, tewelnhej tzeyak'och Dios t'a he k'ool.
Yuj chi' manh ex och ilk'olal. Manh eyala': ¿Tas ol ko wa''a? ¿B'aj ol kot ko pichul? manh xe chiok.
Yujto a heb' manh ojtannakok Dios, syak'och spensar heb' sayanek' juntzanh chi'. Palta a ko Mam ayek' t'a satcha’anh, a ojtannak to ay tz'och juntzanh chi' kuuj.
Yuj chi', tzeyak' eyip eyak'anoch he b'ha t'a yol sk'ab' Dios. Tojolnhej tzeyutej he b'eyb'al, icha snib'ej. Tato icha chi', ol yak' juntzanh chi' t'ayex smasanil.
Yuj chi', manh ex och ilk'olal yuj tas eyaj k'ik'an. Yujto manh eyojtakok tas tzex ik'an k'ik'an chi', mokab' he naub'tanhej yuj. k'okb'ilnhejokab' sko na tas tzonh aj t'a junjun k'u.
Manh he ch'olb'itej tas yaj junok anima yik manh ol ex ch'olb'itaj pax yuj ko Mam Dios.
Yujto icha tz'aj he ch'olb'itan tas yaj heb' eyetanimail chi', icha chi' ol ex yutok Dios ex sch'olb'itani. Ha eyechlab' tzeyak'lab'ej, a ol ak'lab'aj pax t'ayex.

Q'uinalok ay junok eyetanimail sb'at jab'ok k'alem t'a yol sat, a exxo tik ay junok patzab' ayoch t'a yol he sat, tato max he na to ayoch jun patzab' chi' t'a yol he sat, ¿tom ol yal eyilan jab' k'alem ayb'at t'a yol sat junxo chi'?
Tato ayoch jun patzab' chi' t'a yol he sat, ¿tom ol yal eyalan t'a jun chi': Ayb'at jun k'alem t'a yol a sat, in gana swik'k'eta t'ayach, tom xe chi t'ay?

Tato icha chi' tzeyutej eyalani, chab' sat ex. Yowalil tze b'ab'laj ik'ejkanel jun patzab' chi' t'a yol he sat. Icha chi' b'ian, ol yal eyilani, haxo eyik'anelta jun k'alem chi' t'a yol sat jun eyetanimail chi'.

Ha slolonel Dios yiknhej yaji, lajan icha juntzanh tonh perla sb'i, te karo stojol. Yuj chi', max yal kak'an t'a heb' malaj yelk'och Dios t'a sat. Yujto a heb' chi', lajan yaj heb' icha juntzanh nok' tz'i' skot t'ayonh, tzonh schi'an nok'. Ay pax heb' icha juntzanh nok' chitam, tonhej slaj stek'em tas skak' t'ay.
k'anek, ol ak'jok t'ayex. Sayec, ol ilchaj eyuuj. Awajanhecoch t'a sti' puerta, ol jakchaj te' t'ayex.
Yujto a heb' sk'anani, ol scha heb'. Axo heb' sayani, ol ilchaj yuj heb'. Anhejtona' heb' tz'awajoch t'a sti' puerta, ol jakjok te' t'a heb'.
Q'uinalok ayex, a heb' eyuninal sk'anan yooch t'ayex, ¿tom a junok k'een ol eyak' t'a heb'?
Tato a junok chay sk'an heb' t'ayex, ¿tom a junok nok' chan tzeyak' t'a heb'?

Ha ex tik, wach'chom malaj he wach'il, palta eyojtak tas tzeyutej eyak'an juntzanh tas wach' t'a heb' eyuninal. Ocxom ko Mam Dios ayek' t'a satcha’anh, ¿tom manh ol yak' junok wach'il t'a heb' sk'anan t'ay?

E gana te wach' syutej sb'a heb' eyetanimail t'ayex. Ichaokab' pax ta' tzeyutej he b'ha t'a heb'. Yujto icha chi' syal juntzanh ley Moisés aykani yet' juntzanh ch'anh uum tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj heb' schekab' Dios t'a peka'.
Ay jun icha puerta yunenhej sat, ata' slaj ex ochi. Ay pax junxo icha puerta te lewan yet' jun icha niwan b'e te lewan, palta yik syaelal. Yuj chi' manh jantakok heb' anima sb'atkan ta'.
Palta haxo jun icha puerta yik k 'inal, yunenhej yet' jun b'e sk'och ta' icha utzin b'e. Yuj chi', malaj wal heb' anima sb'at ta'.

Ay heb' niwanok syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios. Tzeyil wal he b'ha t'a heb', yujto a ol k'och heb' t'ayex, niwanok nanam ol yutok sb'a heb', icha junok nok' kalnel. Palta haxo spensar heb', te chuk, icha nok' oques te ow.
Yujnhej sb'eyb'al heb', ol eyojtaquejel heb', icha kojtakanel juntzanh te te' yuj sat. ¿Tom syal quik'anelta sat te' uwa t'a te' q'uiix? ¿tom higo sat te' syak'a'?
Yujto a juntzanh snunal te te' wach', wach' sat syak'a'. Yed' pax juntzanh snunal te te' chuk, chuknhej sat syak'a'.
Ha junok snunal te te' wach' max yak' junok sat te' chuk. Yed' pax juntzanh snunal te te' chuk, max yal yak'an junok sat wach'.
Icha juntzanh te' chuk sat syak'a', sch'akjieli, syumjib'at t'a yol k'ak', icha chi' ol aj heb' malaj swach'il sb'eyb'al.
Yuj chi', a heb' niwanok syak'och sb'a schekab'ok Dios, yujnhej sb'eyb'al heb' chi' ol eyojtakanel heb'.

Ay heb' ol alan t'ayin: Ach Mamin Vajal, xcham heb', palta manh masanilok heb' ol och t'a yol sk'ab' Dios aj satcha’anh. Palta anhej wal heb' sk'anab'ajan tas snib'ej in Mam ayek' t'a satcha’anh chi', anhej wal heb' ol k'ochok.

Ato yik ol ja jun k'ual chi', tzijtum heb' ol alan t'ayin: Mamin, Mamin kalnak wal el a lolonel. Yuj a poder quik'naquel juntzanh enemigo t'a heb' anima. Anhejtona' yuj a poder, tzijtum milagro ko ch'oxnak, xcham heb' t'ayin.
Palta ol walan t'a heb': Toxon manh ex wojtakok. Elanhec t'a in tz'ey, yujto anhej chukal ix laj he k'ulej, xin cham t'a heb'.
Ha heb' tz'ab'an in lolonel, tato sk'anab'ajej heb' tas swala', lajan heb' icha junok winh jelan ixb’o’an spat t'a yib'anh k'een.
Axo ix yak'an jun yax nhab', ix ja ha' eluma', ix ochpax chulan jun ik' te ow t'a jun pat chi'. Palta maj telwoklaj, yujto ha t'a yib'anh k'een b'ob'ilk'ei.
Palta ay juntzanhxo heb' tz'ab'an in lolonel, max sk'anab'ajej heb' tas swala'. Lajan heb' icha junok winh malaj spensar, ix sb'ok'e spat t'a yib'anh k'een arena.
Axo ix yak'an jun yax nhab'. Ix ja ha' eluma', ix och pax chulan ik' te ow t'a spat winh chi', yuj chi' ix k'anh wal stelwi, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Axo yik ix lajwi yalan Jesús t'a heb' anima chi', ix sat sk'ool heb' yuj juntzanh sk'ayb'ub'al chi'.
Yujto ix k'ayb'aj heb' yuj, ix cheklajeli to ay yopisio yuj Dios. Manh lajanoklaj sk'ayb'an heb' icha sk'ayb'aj heb' yuj heb' k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés.
Axo yik ix emixta Jesús t'a jun tzalan chi', tzijtum anima ix och tzak'an yuj.
Ay jun winh penaay yuj jun yab'il skuch lepra, ix k'och t'a Jesús. Ix em kuman winh t'a yichanh. Ix yalan winh t'ay: --Mamin, tato syal a k'ool, syal ak'an b'oxok in k'ool, xchi winh t'ay.
Yuj chi', ix maslaj winh yuj Jesús. --In gana tzach in b'oxikani, xchi t'a winh. D'a wal jun rato chi' ix b'oxikan winh yuj jun yab'il chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan t'a winh: --Ab'i, ay ta b'aj tzal jun tik. Palta ixik, ch'ox a b'ha t'a winh sakerdote. Ak' jun silab' ix yalkan Moisés yik tz'ilji to ach b'oxi, xchi Jesús t'a winh.
Axo yik ix k'och Jesús t'a chonhab' Capernaum, ix k'och jun winh yajal soldado t'ay. Ix tewi winh t'ay,
ix yalan winh: --Mamin, ay jun winh in chekab' manb'ilel wuuj aykan t'a in pat, jichanek' winh t'a sat sch'at. Te sikb'inaquel winh, te ya yaj winh, xchi winh t'ay.
Yuj chi', ix yalan Jesús t'a winh: --Tato icha chi', ol in b'at wak' b'oxok winh, xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalanxi winh t'ay: --Palta Mamin, manh smojok a k'och t'a in pat. Tonhejokab' tzala', sb'oxikan jun winh in chekab' chi'.

Yujto a in tik, ay in och t'a wopisio, ay junxo tzin ak'an mandar. Anhejtona' ay heb' soldado swak' mandar. Tato ay heb' b'aj swala' to sb'at heb', sb'atnhej heb'. Tato ay pax heb' b'aj swala' to skot heb', skotnhej heb'. Anhejtona', tato ay junok tas tzin chek sb'o junok in chekab', sb'onhej. Yuj chi', wojtak, icha swutej wak'an mandar heb' chi', icha chi' tzutej ak'an mandar masanil tas a ach tik, xchi winh.

Axo ix yab'an juntzanh chi' Jesús, ix sat sk'ool yab'ani. Yuj chi' ix yalan t'a heb' ajun yet'ok: --Val yel swal t'ayex, manta junok heb' quetisraelal swil yak'anoch sk'ool d'ha Dios icha jun winh tik.
Swalanpax t'ayex, tzijtum heb' ol kot b'aj sja k'u yet' b'aj tz'em k'u. Ol em k'ojjab' heb' swa yet' winhaj Abraham, winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Jacob t'a mexa b'aj ayoch Dios aj satcha’anh Yajalil.
Axo heb' quetisraelal, smoj ton wal sk'och heb' ta', palta ay heb' ol yumjokkanb'at t'a k’ik’ k’inal. Ata' ol ok' heb'. Ol laj siq'uik'ok heb' yoq'ui yuj yab'an syail, xchi t'a heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalanxi t'a winh yajal soldado chi': --Paxanh t'a a pat. Icha wal tzutej ak'anoch Dios t'a a k'ool, icha pax chi' ol aj sb'o t'ayach, xchi t'a winh. Axo jun winh schekab' winh chi', a wal t'a jun rato chi' ix b'oxikan winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at Jesús t'a spat winhaj Pedro. Axo ix k'ochi, ix yilani, jichanek' ix snhi' winhaj Pedro chi' yuj jun k'ak'al yab'il.
Yuj chi' ix yamji sk'ab' ix yuj Jesús. D'a jun rato chi', ix sikb'i jun k'ak'al yab'il chi' t'a ix. Yuj chi' ix k'e waan ix. Ix och ijan ix sk'atk'ankot heb'.
Axo t'a yik numumixo sq'uik'b'i, tzijtum heb' ayoch enemigo t'ay ix ik'jib'at t'a Jesús. Junnhej b'elanh lolonel ix yala', ix el heb' enemigo chi'. Anhejtona' ix yak'kan b'oxok masanil heb' penaay.
Icha chi' ix aj yelk'och tas yalnakkan winhaj Isaías schekab' Dios t'a peka', xchi icha tik: Ha ix ik'anel juntzanh ko yaelal. Van yab'an syail ko k'exulok, xchikan Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani.
Axo t'a junel, ix yilan Jesús, tzijtum anima ix smolb'ejk'och sb'a t'ay. Yuj chi', ix yalan t'a heb' sk'ayb'um: --Koyec t'a sk'axepal jun ha' niwan nhajab' tik, xchi t'a heb'.
Palta ayik manto b'at heb', ay jun winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés ix k'och t'ay. Ix yalan winh t'ay: --Ach in k'ayb'umal, yalnhej b'aj ol ach b'atok, ol in och tzak'an uuj, xchi winh t'ay.
Axo ix yalan Jesús t'a winh: --Ha nok' waax, ay snhak'een nok'. Ha nok' much, ay pax so' nok' b'aj swayi. Ha inxo Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail, malaj in pat b'aj tzin wayi, xchi t'a winh.
Ay junxo winh sk'ayb'um ix alani: --Mamin, ol in b'at ed'ok, palta in gana tzak' in permiso. Ato ol cham winh in mam ol in b'at ed'ok, xchi winh t'ay.
Palta ix yalanpax t'a winh: --Conh wed'ok. Ha heb' chamnakto el t'a yichanh Dios, a heb' chi' syal smukan heb' yetchamnaquil chi', xchi Jesús t'a winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix och Jesús t'a yol barko. Ix och pax heb' sk'ayb'um yet'ok. Ix b'at heb'.
Palta ayik wan sb'ey heb', ix ja jun ik' te ow. Ix och chulnaj ha' t'a yol te' barko chi'. Axo Jesús waynakb'at t'a yol te'.
Yuj chi' ix pitzjiel swayanh yuj heb'. --Mamin, kol onh. Van ko b'at t'a yich ha', xchi heb' t'ay.
--¿Tas yuj tzex te xiwi? Te tewelnhej tzeyak'och Dios t'a he k'ool, xchi t'a heb'. Ixlajwi chi', ix k'e waan. Ix skachanoch waan jun ik' chi' yet' ha' nhajab' chi'. Yuj chi' ix numk'aj smasanil.
Ix te sat sk'ool heb' sik'lab'il. Ix laj yalan heb' junjun: --¿Tas wal yaj jun winh tik? Inai ix k'anab'ajax winh yuj ik' yet' ha' nhajab' tik, xchi heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix k'och heb' t'a junxo sk'axepal b'at ha', t'a chonhab' Gadara. Ata' ix kot chawanh heb' winh b'aj smukji heb' chamnak. Ix k'och heb' winh t'a Jesús. Ha chawanh heb' winh chi', ayoch heb' enemigo t'a heb' winh. Yelxo te ow heb' winh. Yuj chi', malaj junok mach sb'eyek' t'a jun b'e tzek' b'aj ayek' heb' winh chi'.
Ix k'e yaw heb' winh t'a Jesús: --Ach Yuninal Dios, ¿tas och t'ayonh? ¿Tom tzach ja ak'och yaelal t'a quib'anh yakb'an manto k'och stiempoal? xchi heb' t'ay.
Axo t'a slak'anil jun lugar chi', tzijtum juntzanh nok' chitam wan swa'i.
Yuj chi' ix tewi heb' enemigo chi' t'a Jesús, ix yalan heb': --Tato tzonh a pecheli, ha t'a juntzanh nok' chitam chi' tzonh ak'b'ati, xchi heb' t'ay:

--Ixiquec, xchi Jesús chi' t'a heb'. Yuj chi', ix el heb' enemigo chi' t'a heb' winh chawanh chi'. Axo t'a nok' chitam chi' ix ochxikan heb'. Axo t'a jun rato chi', ix b'at nhilnaj nok' elelal. Ix b'at nok' t'a sattak witz, masanto ix k'och nok' t'a yol ha' niwan nhajab'. Ata' ix sjik' ha' nok', ix cham nok' smasanil.
Axo heb' stanhwumal nok', ix xiwb'at heb', ix b'at heb' elelal. Elanhchamel ix k'och heb' t'a yol chonhab'. Ata' ix yalel heb' smasanil. Ix yalanpax heb' tas ix utaj heb' ayoch enemigo chi' t'ay.
Yuj chi' ix b'at heb' ay t'a chonhab' chi' smasanil yil Jesús. Axo yik ix yilan heb', ix laj tewi heb' t'ay, yik elanhchamel tz'elxi t'a yol slugar heb' chi'.
Axo Jesús ix ochxi t'a yol te' barko. Ix b'atxi t'a junxo sk'axepal ha'. Ix k'ochxi t'a schonhab'.

Ata' ay jun winh sikb'inak eli, ix ik'jib'at winh t'a sat swaynub' yuj juntzanh heb' winh winak t'a Jesús. Axo ix yilan Jesús to ix yak'och heb' t'a sk'ool. Yuj chi' ix yalan t'a winh sikb'inak el chi': --Ach wetanimail, tek'tek' tzutej a b'a. Ix ak'jikan lajwok a mul, xchi t'a winh.
Ata' ayek' jaywanh heb' winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés, ix snaan heb' winh: Ha jun winh tik, tonhej sb'uchwaj winh d'ha Dios, xchi heb' winh.
Axo Jesús yojtakxo tas sna heb' winh, yuj chi' ix yal t'a heb' winh: --¿Tas yuj tze na juntzanh malaj swach'il tik?
¿B'aja junok sekojtak kalan tze na'a? ¿A a mul toxo ix ak'ji lajwok, xko chama, ma: Q'ueanh waan, b'eyanh, mato xko chi?

Ha tiknaik jun, ol in ch'ox t'ayex to a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, ay wopisio wak'an lajwok smul heb' ay t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, xchi t'a heb' winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan t'a winh sikb'inaquel chi': --Q'ueanh waan. Ik'chaanh a waynub'. Paxanh t'a a pat, xchi t'a winh.
D'a jun rato chi', ix k'e waan winh, ix pax winh t'a spat.
Ayic ix yilan jun chi' heb' anima, ix te sat sk'ool heb'. Ix laj yalan wach' lolonel heb' d'ha Dios yujto te niwan spoder Jesús ix sch'ox t'a heb' anima.

Ix b'atxi Jesús. Ayic wan sb'eyi, ix yilani ayek' jun winh skuch Mateo, k'ojanem winh b'aj stequel alkabar. --Ochanh in k'ayb'umok, xchi Jesús t'a winh. D'a jun rato chi' ix k'e waan winh, ix och tzak'an winh yuj Jesús.
Ixlajwi chi', ix ik'jib'at Jesús yuj winh wael t'a spat. Axo yik wan swa yet' heb' sk'ayb'um, anhejtona' tzijtum heb' tekumel alkabar yet' juntzanhxo heb' te chuk sb'eyb'al ix wa yet' heb'.

Axo ix yilan jun chi' heb' winh fariseo. Ix yalan heb' winh t'a heb' sk'ayb'um Jesús: --Ha jun he k'ayb'umal tik, ¿tas yuj junnhej swa yet' heb' tekumel alkabar yet' juntzanhxo heb' malaj swach'il sb'eyb'al tik? xchi heb' winh.
Ayic ix yab'an jun chi' Jesús, ix yalan t'a heb' winh: --Ha heb' wach' sk'ool, malaj tz'och winh anhtum yuj heb'. Anhej heb' penaay, ay tz'och winh yuj.

Ixiquec an, ojtaquejequel tas syalelk'och jun yalnakkan Dios t'a Slolonel Tz'ib'ab'ilkani, a ix yalan icha tik: In gana tz'ok' he k'ool t'a heb' eyetanimail. Manhoknhej juntzanh silab' snhusji chi' in gana, xchi. Manh yujok wawtan heb' toxon wach' sb'eyb'al snaani, in jawi. Palta in jawi wawtejkot heb' toxonton ojtannak to malaj swach'il sb'eyb'al, xchi Jesús t'a heb' winh.

Ha junel ix k'och heb' sk'ayb'um winhaj Juan, aton winh tz'ak'an bautizar b'aj ayek' Jesús. Ix sk'anb'an heb' t'ay: --¿Tas yuj max och heb' a k'ayb'um tik t'a tzek'ojk'olal? Ha onh tik, skak' wal och ko b'ha t'a tzek'ojk'olal. Icha pax chi' syutej sb'a heb' fariseo, xchi heb' t'ay.

Yuj chi' ix yalan Jesús t'a heb': --Q'uinalok ay junok q'uinh nupnajel. Ha heb' awtab'il sb'at ta', ¿tom syal yoch heb' t'a tzek'ojk'olal ayik ayto ek' winh wan yoch yetb'eyum chi' yet' heb'? Palta ato ol ja stiempoal manhxo ayoquek' winh yet' heb', ato ta' ol och heb' t'a tzek'ojk'olal.
Malaj mach tz'ak'anoch junok ak' k'apak manto juk'ji junelok snipulok junok k'a pichul. Yujto a jun ak' k'apak chi', tz'utz'i, swach' tok'ji nhik'chaj jun k'a pichul chi' yuj.

Ol wal junxo ch'oxnab'il: Max yal-laj yak'chajem wino manto sipji t'a yol junok k'a tz'um yet'tal wino. Tato icha chi', snhik'chaj jun tz'uum chi' yuj jun wino chi', tz'ixtax schab'il makan. Yuj chi', ha t'a yol junok ak' tz'uum tzeyak'em wino manto sipji, yik wach' ol aj schab'il.

Ayic wan yalan juntzanh chi' Jesús, ix k'och jun winh sat yaj t'a spatil skulto heb', ix em kuman winh t'a yichanh Jesús, ix yalan winh: --Ha jun ix wisil, toxomlaj ix cham ix naik. Palta konh wed'ok. In gana b'at ak'ek' a k'ab' t'a yib'anh ix, yik ol pitzwokxi ix, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix k'e waan Jesús. Ix b'at yet' winh. Ix b'at pax heb' sk'ayb'um yet'ok.
Axo t'a skal heb' anima wan sb'at yet'ok, ay jun ix ix penaay. Slajchawilxo ab'il penaay ix yuj yel jun ha' t'a sniwanil ix. Yuj chi' ix k'och ix t'a spatik Jesús. Ix yamji sti' spichul yuj ix.
Yujto ix sna ix: Tonhejokab' tzin yamlej sti' spichul, sb'oxikan in k'ool, xchi ix.
Yuj chi' ix meltzajb'at k'elan Jesús t'a ix, ix yalan t'a ix: --Ach ix, tek'tek' tzutej a b'a. Tzach b'oxikan wuuj, yujto in ak'och t'a a k'ool, xchi t'a ix. D'a jun rato chi' ix b'oxikan ix.
Axo yik ix k'och Jesús t'a spat winh yajal chi', ix yilani wan spu'an sflauta heb' ay syamk'ab' yik b'it. Axo masanil heb' anima, toxonhej wejanchaanh heb' ok'el.
Yuj chi' ix yalan Jesús t'a heb': --Elanhec t'a tik. Ha ix tik, manh chamnakoklaj ix. Tonhej sway ix, xchi t'a heb'. Palta tonhej ix tzetzaj Jesús chi' yuj heb'.
Axo yik ix lajwi yelta heb' anima chi', ix ochk'och b'aj ay ix kob'es chi'. Ix yamji sk'ab' ix yuj, ix k'e waan ix b'ian.
Ha t'a smasanil jun lugar chi', masanil heb' anima ix ab'an tas ix uji chi'.

Ayic wan sb'atxi Jesús t'a yol b'e, ix och tzak'an chawanh heb' winh max uji yilan yuj, ix syamanoch heb' winh yalan icha tik: --Ach yinhtilal winhaj Dawid, ¿tom max ok' a k'ool t'ayonh? xchi heb' winh t'ay.

Axo yik ix och t'a yol pat, ix k'och heb' winh t'ay. Yuj chi' ix yalan t'a heb' winh: --¿Tzam eyak'och t'a he k'ool to syal in b'oan tas he gana? xchi t'a heb' winh. --I', skak'och Mamin, xchi heb' winh t'ay.
Yuj chi' ix maslaj sat heb' winh yuj. Ix yalan t'a heb' winh: --Icha tzeyutej eyak'anoch t'a he k'ool tik, icha chi' ol aj he b'oxi, xchi t'a heb' winh.
Icha chi' ix aj sjakwi sat heb' winh chi'. Tzaxo uji yilan heb' winh. Yuj chi', ix cham wal yalan Jesús chi' t'a heb' winh: --Ayta b'aj tzeyal jun tik, xchi t'a heb' winh.
Palta haxo yik ix b'at heb' winh, ix yalan heb' winh t'a masanil lugar.
Vanto spax heb' winh chi', ix quetzjikot junxo winh t'a Jesús. Ha jun winh chi' max ujilaj slolon winh, yujto ayoch jun enemigo t'a winh.

Axo yik ix el jun enemigo chi' t'a winh yuj Jesús, ix och ijan winh sloloni. Yuj chi' ix te sat sk'ool heb' anima ayek' ta', ix yalan heb': --Ha t'a ko kal a onh aj Israel onh tik, manta b'aj squil junok icha jun tik, xchi heb'.
Palta haxo heb' winh fariseo ix alani: --Ha jun winh tik, syal ton yik'anel heb' enemigo chi' winh, yujto a jun yajal yaj t'a heb' enemigo chi', a ayoch yet' winh, xchi heb' winh.

Axo Jesús ix laj ek' t'a juntzanh chonhab' yet' t'a juntzanh aldea. Ix ek' sk'ayb'ej heb' anima t'a yoltak spatil kulto. Ix yalanel wach' ab'ix, chajtil tz'aj yoch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' Dios. Yalnhej tas juntzanh yaelal tz'ik'an heb' yet' tas ilyail, ix laj b'oxi sk'ool heb'.
Ayic ix och k'elan t'a heb' anima chi', ix ok' sk'ool t'a heb', yujto ix yila' to lajan heb' icha juntzanh nok' kalnel malaj stanhwumal, te ayoch heb' t'a syaelal, te kusnak heb'.
Yuj chi' ix yalan t'a heb' sk'ayb'um: --Ha heb' anima tik, lajan heb' icha ixim trigo stiempoalxo sjochchaji. Val yel, k'ojan ayto heb', palta jaywannhej mach smunlaj t'a skal heb'.
Yuj chi' lesalwanhek t'a jun aj munlajel chi', yik ol schekb'at heb' smunlajwum t'a skal heb', xchi Jesús.
Axo Jesús ix awtankot heb' sk'ayb'um slajchawanhil. Ix ak'ji yopisio heb' yik'anel heb' enemigo. Ix yak'anpax yopisio heb' yak'an b'oxok sk'ool heb' yalxonhej tas ilyail tz'ik'ani ma yaelal.

Ha heb' lajchawanh schekab' tik: Aton winhaj Simón, skuchan Pedro yet' jun winh yuk'tak winh skuchan Andrés, winhaj Jacobo yet' pax jun winh yuk'tak winh skuchan Juan. Ha heb' winh chawanh tik, yuninal heb' winh winhaj Zebedeo.
Yed' pax winhaj Felipe, winhaj Bartolomé, winhaj Tomás, winhaj Mateo, winh tekumel alkabar t'a yalanhtaxo, winhaj Jacobo yuninal winhaj Alfeo yet' winhaj Tadeo.
Ay pax junxo winh skuch Simón, yetb'eyumejnak heb' Zelote yet' winhaj Judas aj Queriot, aton winh ix ak'anoch Jesús t'a yol sk'ab' chamel t'a slajwub'alxo.

Aton heb' lajchawanh tik ix chekjib'at yuj Jesús. Ayic manto b'at heb', ix yalan juntzanh cheknab'il tik t'a heb': --Ayic tzex b'ati, manh ex ek' t'a juntzanh schonhab' heb' manh israelok. Manh ex ek' pax t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a yol yik Samaria.
Anhej t'a heb' satnakto t'a skal heb' quetisraelal, anhej ta' tzex eq'ui. Yujto icha juntzanh nok' kalnel satnaqueq'ui, icha chi' yaj heb'.
B'at eyaleli to toxo ol wach' och Dios aj satcha’anh Yajalil.

Ha heb' penaay yuj lepra, b'at eyak' b'oxok heb'. Yed' juntzanhxo heb' penaay, tzeyak' pax b'oxok sk'ool heb'. Tzeyak'anpax pitzwok heb' chamnak. Anhejtona', slaj eyik'el heb' enemigo ayoch t'a heb' anima. Nab'anhej ix he cha jun opisio tik, yuj chi' nab'anhej tzex kolwaj pax t'a heb'.
Ayic tzex b'ati, manh eyik'b'at he tumin. Malaj junok kentawo tzeyik'b'ati.

Manh eyik'b'at he pa. Junnhej he kamix tzeyak'ochi, tzex b'ati. Manh eyik'b'at jun mojokxo he xanhab'. Manh eyik' he k'okoch. Swal juntzanh tik t'ayex, yujto a heb' smunlaji, smoj ton schaan heb' tas syab'lej.
Ayic tzex k'och t'a junjun chonhab', t'a junjun aldea, tze say junok mach wach' sb'eyb'al b'aj smoj he kani, masanto tzex b'atxi t'a junokxo lugar.
Ayic tzex k'och t'a jun pat chi', tzeyal t'a heb' aj pat chi': Ayokab' sjunk'olal Dios eyed'ok, xe chi t'a heb'.
Tato smoj heb' icha chi', elokab'k'och icha tzeyal chi' t'a heb'. Palta tato manh smojok heb' icha chi' jun, mokab' elk'och icha tzeyal chi' t'a heb'.

Tato max ex scha heb', tato malaj snib'ej heb' t'a tas tzeyal chi', tzex elixta t'a yol spat heb' yet' t'a yol schonhab' heb' chi'. Tze tzikankanel spokokal eyok, yik tze ch'oxankaneli to manhxalaj eyalan eyik t'a heb'.
Val yel swal t'ayex, ayik ol ja jun k'ual sch'olb'itaj tas yaj heb' anima, yelxo wal niwan syaelal heb' ol ak'jok t'a yichanh heb' aj Sodoma yet' heb' aj Gomorra.

Ab'ek, tzex in chekb'ati. Icha juntzanh nok' kalnel sb'at t'a skal nok' oques, icha chi' ol ex ajok. Yuj chi', lista tzeyutej he b'a icha junok nok' chan te jelan. Palta te nanam tzeyutej he b'a ichok nok' paramuch.
Tzeyil wal he b'a, yujto ay heb' ol ex ik'anb'at t'a heb' winh yajal. Ol ex smak' heb' t'a yoltak spatil skulto.
Ol ex yik'b'at heb' t'a yichanh heb' winh niwak yajal yet' t'a yichanh heb' winh rey wuuj. Yuj chi' ol yal eyalanel wab'ixal t'a heb' winh chi' yet' t'a heb' manh israelok.

Palta ayik ol ex ak'jokoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' winh yajal chi', manh he na yuj tas ol eyala'. Manh ex och ilk'olal yuj tas ol eyutok eyalan t'a heb' winh, yujto ha t'a jun rato chi', ha Dios ol ak'an nachajel eyuuj tas ol eyala'.
Manhok ex ol ex lolonok, yujto a Yespíritu Dios, aton ko Mam ol ex majnanok, ol eyalani.

Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', ay heb' uk'takab'il ol ak'anoch yuk'tak t'a yol sk'ab' chamel. Ay pax heb' mamab'il icha chi' ol yutok sb'ha t'a heb' yuninal. Anhejtona', ay pax heb' uninab'il ol yak' owal yet' smam chi', ol yak'anoch smam heb' t'a yol sk'ab' chamel.
Masanil heb' anima ol chichonoch sk'ool t'ayex wuuj. Palta a mach ol ak'an techaj smasanil juntzanh chi', a heb' chi' ol kolchajok.

Ayic syak'an chukal heb' t'ayex t'a junok chonhab' b'aj ayex eq'ui, elanhek t'a heb', tzex b'at t'a junokxo chonhab'. Val yel swal t'ayex, ayik manto ex ek'chaj t'a masanil juntzanh schonhab' heb' quetisraelal, ol in jax a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik.
Malaj junok heb' k'ayb'um ek'to yelk'och t'a yichanh sk'ayb'umal. Anhejtona', malaj junok tz'ak'an serwil ek'to yelk'och t'a jun tz'ak'an mandar.

Tato lajan tz'aj junok k'ayb'um yet' sk'ayb'umal, smoj ton icha chi' tz'aji. Icha pax chi' junok chekab' yet' spatrón. Ha in tik, ichato aj pat in. Ha exxo tik, icha uninab'il ex. Ay heb' tz'alani to Beelzebú in, to yajal heb' enemigo waji. Ocxom wal t'ayex a ex tik.
Yuj chi', manh ex xiw t'a heb' anima. Jantacnhej tas k'ub'eltak yaj tiknaik, ol laj cheklajelta. Yed' jantaknhej tas k'ub'eltak yaji, ol laj ak'jok ojtakajelok.
Ha juntzanh tas swal t'ayex t'a k'ub'eltaquil, tzeyalel t'a heb' anima. Yed' juntzanhxo tas k'ub'eltak tzin sajoch t'a he chiquin, tzeyalel t'a yoltak kalle.
Manh ex xiw t'a heb' syal smilan he niwanil tik, yujto a he pixan max yal smilan heb'. Palta a d'ha Dios b'aj tzex xiwi, yujto a syal satanel he pixan yet' he niwanil, syak'ankanb'at t'a infierno.
Tzeyilnab' juntzanh nok' kotak much. Ayic schonhchaj nok', chawanh nok' t'a jun yune' tumin, palta malaj junok nok' skomon chami, tato manh ichok ta' snib'ej ko Mam Dios.
Palta a exxo tik, yelxo wal niwan eyelk'och t'a yichanh masanil nok' kotak much chi'. Ina masanil xil he jolom b'isb'il yuj. Yuj chi', manh ex xiwok.
Yalnhej mach heb' max q'uixwi yalan t'a yichanh heb' anima to wiko', a inxo tik, ol wal heb' wikok t'a ko Mam Dios ayek' t'a satcha’anh.
Palta haxo heb' tz'alan t'a yichanh heb' anima to manh wikok heb', anhejtona' in, ol walpax t'a ko Mam Dios ayek' t'a satcha’anh to manh wikok heb'.
Manh he na' to in ja wak' junk'olal t'a skal heb' anima t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik. Manh yujok yoch junk'olal t'a skal heb' in jawi. Palta yuj yoch owal t'a skal heb'.
In jawi, yik wach' ay heb' winh winak ol yak' owal yet' smam. Ay heb' ix ix ol yak' owal yet' snun. Ay heb' ix alib'al ol yak' owal yet' ix yalib'.
Yuj chi', a heb' jun yaj yet' junok mach t'a yol spat, aton heb' ol laj meltzajoch ajk'olal t'ay junjun.
Ha mach másxo wal xajanej smam snun t'a wichanh, manh smojok yoch wikok. Anhejtona', a mach másxo wal xajanej yuninal t'a wichanh, manh smojok yoch wikok.
Ha mach manh b'ekanok sk'ool yab'an syail wuuj, manh b'ekanok sk'ool yoch chamel t'a yib'anh, tz'och t'a spenek te' kulus, manh smojok yoch tzak'an wuuj.
Ha heb' snib'ej skol sb'ha t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, ol satel sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej. Palta haxo heb' sb'ek sb'a scham wuuj, aton heb' ol scha sk'inal t'a junelnhej.
Ha heb' tzex chaani, a in tzin scha heb'. Axo heb' tzin chaan chi', wan schaan pax jun chekjinak in kot heb'.

Ha heb' schaan junok schekab' Dios, yujnhej to schekab' Dios yaji, ol scha spak heb' icha yik heb' schekab' Dios chi'. Ha heb' schaan junok mach tojol sb'eyb'al, yujnhej to tojol sb'eyb'al, ol scha spak heb' icha yik heb' tojol sb'eyb'al chi'.
Yalnhej junok mach heb' sian junok waso siquila' t'a junok heb' in k'ayb'um, yujnhej to in k'ayb'um, wach'chom junok malaj wal yelk'ochi, wal yel ol scha spak heb'.

Ayic ix lajwi yalan juntzanh cheknab'il chi' Jesús t'a heb' sk'ayb'um slajchawanhil, ix b'ati. Ix ek' yalel slolonel Dios yab' heb' anima t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a jun lugar chi', ix sk'ayb'anpax heb' anima chi'.
Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', ayoch winhaj Juan t'a preso, winh tz'ak'an bautizar. Ix yab'an winh tastak wan sk'ulan Cristo, yuj chi' ix schekb'at chawanh heb' winh sk'ayb'um winh t'a Jesús chi'.
Ix b'at sk'anb'an heb' winh t'ay icha tik: --¿Tom a ach tik tanhwab'il a ja kuuj, mato ch'ok junokxo sko tanhwej sjawi? xchi heb' winh t'ay.
Yuj chi' ix yalan t'a heb' winh: --Paxanhec t'a winhaj Juan chi', tzeyalan t'a winh tastak wan eyab'ani, eyilan t'a tik.

Tzeyal t'a winh to a heb' max ujilaj yilani, tzaxo yal yilan heb'. Ha heb' max uji sb'eyi, tzaxo yal sb'ey heb'. Ha heb' slaj k'a yuj lepra, slaj b'oxikan sk'ool heb'. Ha heb' max uji yab'ani, tzaxo yab' heb', yet' heb' chamnak, ay heb' wan spitzwixi. Axo heb' meb'a', wan yalji wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il t'a heb'.
Yuj chi' a heb' tzin ak'anoch yipok sk'ool, te wach' yik heb'. Icha chi' tzeyutej eyalan t'a winhaj Juan chi' a tzex k'ochxi, xchi Jesús chi' t'a heb' winh.

Ayic toxo ix b'at heb' winh schekab' winhaj Juan chi', ix och ijan Jesús yalan t'a heb' anima yuj winhaj Juan chi': --¿Tas xid' eyilnak t'a tzinan lu'um? ¿Tom a junok te' aj tz'ib'xi yuj ik' xid' eyilnak?
Tato maay jun, ¿tas xid' eyilnak? ¿Mato a jun anima te wach' spichul xid' eyilnak? Cojtak to a heb' wach' spichul chi' ayek' heb' t'a spat heb' winh rey.
Palta jun, ¿tas xid' eyilnak? ¿Tom xid' eyilnak jun winh tz'alanel slolonel Dios? Yel, yalumel slolonel Dios yaj winhaj Juan chi', palta manhoknhej jun chi' yopisio winh.

Aton yab'ixal winhaj Juan chi' yalnakkan Dios t'a Slolonel Tz'ib'ab'ilkani. Ayic ayokto yalannakkan yuj winh icha tik: Ol in chekb'at jun in chekab', ol b'ab'laj b'at uuj. Icha tz'aj sb'o b'e, icha chi' ol yutok sb'oan sb'eyb'al heb' anima, ayik manto ach k'ochi, xchikan t'a Slolonel Dios chi'.

Swal t'ayex to ha t'a skal heb' anima, malaj junok mach ek'to yelk'och t'a winhaj Juan chi'. Palta t'a skal heb' ayoch t'a yol sk'ab' Dios, wach'chom heb' malaj wal yelk'ochi, másxo ek'to swach'il yik heb' t'a yichanh yik winhaj Juan chi'.

Atax ix och ijan winhaj Juan chi' yak'an bautizar, masanto tiknaik, tzijtum heb' anima yelk'olal tz'och t'a yol sk'ab' Dios. Ay heb' tek'tek' syutej sb'a, syak' wal pural sb'a heb' yak'anoch sb'ha t'a yol sk'ab'.
Ayic manto alji winhaj Juan chi', yalnakkan heb' schekab' Dios smasanil to ol wach' och Dios Yajalil. Anhejtona', icha pax chi' yalan ley Moisés.
Tato he gana tzeyak'och t'a he k'ool, a winhaj Juan chi' aton winhaj Elías, winh tanhwab'il sjawi eyuuj.
Ha juntzanh tzeyab' tik, naek wal sik'lab'il.
--¿Mach yet'ok ol in lajb'ej heb' anima t'a jun pekti’ tik? ¿Chajtil yaj spensar heb' tze na'a? Lajan heb' icha heb' unin stajni t'a merkado. Ay heb' tz'alan t'a heb' yetuninal:
Ayic ix ko pu'an ko flauta eyuuj, maj ex chanhalwoklaj. Ayic ix onh b'itan t'a kuseltaquil, maj ex ok'laj qued'ok, xchi heb'. Icha heb' unin malaj snib'ej t'a junok tas chi', icha chi' eyaj a ex tik.
Yujto a sb'eyb'al winhaj Juan chi', malaj juntzanh tas wach' swa'a syuk'ej winh, yuj chi' tzeyalani to enemigo ayoch t'a winh.

Axo tiknaik in japax a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, tzin wa'i, swuk'an ha' t'a skal heb' anima. Tzeyalanpaxi to b'uk'tzin in, uk'um in anh, swamigoan pax heb' winh tekumel alkabar yet' juntzanhxo heb' chuk sb'eyb'al. Palta a heb' ay sjelanil Dios t'ay, scheklajelta sjelanil heb' chi' t'a tastak sk'ulej, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix och ijan Jesús yalani tas smul heb' anima t'a juntzanh chonhab' b'aj ix sb'o juntzanh milagro, yujto wach'chom te ay milagro ix sb'o ta', palta max sna jab'ok sb'a heb'. Ix yalani:

--Ha ex wal tik ex aj Corazín, te chuk eyiko'. Yed' ex aj Betsaida, te chuk pax eyiko'. Octom t'a Tiro yet' t'a Sidón ix b'oji juntzanh milagro icha ix b'oji t'a he kal tik. Tato icha chi', pekataxom snanak sb'a heb'. Toxom ix yak'och juntzanh pichul heb' ya swa'i. Toxom ix yak'k'e k'een tik'aq'uil taanh heb' t'a sjolom, yik scheklajeli to ste kus heb' yuj smul.
Yuj chi' swal t'ayex, ato ol ja jun k'ual yik ol ch'olb'itaj yaj heb' anima, yelxo wal niwan he yaelal ol ak'jok t'a yichanh heb' aj Tiro yet' heb' aj Sidón chi'.

Anhejtona', icha ex chi' ex aj Capernaum. Niwanoc tze na' to smoj ol ex k'ek'och t'a satcha’anh. Palta tonhej ol ex emkan t'a skal heb' chamnak. Octom ha t'a Sodoma b'ob'il juntzanh milagro icha ix b'oji t'a he kal. Tato icha chi', snanak am sb'a heb', haxo schonhab' heb' chi', ay am ek' tiknaik.
Yuj chi' swal t'ayex, ato ol ja jun k'ual yik ol ch'olb'itaj yaj heb' anima, yelxo wal niwan he yaelal ol ak'jok t'a yichanh heb' aj Sodoma chi', xchi Jesús.

Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', ix lesalwi Jesús, ix yalan icha tik: --Mamin, Yajal ach t'a satcha’anh yet' t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik. Yuj wal Dios t'ayach Mamin, yujto ix a k'ub'ejel juntzanh tik t'a heb' jelan, t'a heb' te ay spensar t'a yichanh heb' yetanimail, haxo t'a heb' icha unin, ata' ix a ch'oxo'.
Icha chi' ix aj Mamin, yujto icha chi' a gana, xchi d'ha Dios.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalanxi: --Ha in Mam ix ak'anoch masanil tas t'a yol in k'ab'. Ha in Yuninal in tik, malaj junok mach ojtannak in sik'lab'il, anhej in Mam ojtannak in. Anhejtona', malaj junok mach ojtannak in Mam chi'. Ha innhej Yuninal in, wojtak, ojtakab'il pax yuj heb' in gana swak' yojtaquejeli.
Cotanhec t'ayin masanil ex tz'el eyip he munlaji yet' ex te al eyaj yuj eyikatz, ol wak' eyik' eyip.
Ol wak' junok ikatz he kuch wed'ok. k'ayb'ejek t'ayin, yujto a in tik nanam in, emnaquil in. Tato icha chi', ol eyik' eyip.
Yujto a jun ikatz swak' he kuch tik, manh alok, manh ajaltakok in eyak'an serwil, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.

Ha t'a jun sk'ual ik'oj ip, ix ek' Jesús t'a jun b'e t'a skal ixim trigo yet' heb' sk'ayb'um. Axo heb' sk'ayb'um chi', ix te och swejel heb'. Yuj chi', ix sk'utzelta ixim jolom trigo chi' heb', ix swuchanel ixim heb' sk'uxu'.

Palta ix yilan juntzanh heb' winh fariseo tas ix sk'ulej heb', yuj chi' ix yalan heb' t'a Jesús: --Ina heb' a k'ayb'um tik. Van smunlaj heb' t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip, palta manh sleyalok sko k'ulej icha chi', xchi heb' winh.
Palta ix yalan t'a heb' winh: --¿Tom manta b'aj tzeyil t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani, tas sk'ulejnak winhaj Dawid t'a junel, ayik ste ochnak swejel winh yet' heb' ajun yet'ok?

Xid'naquek' winh t'a skajnub' Dios. Swanac juntzanh ixim pan winh yiknhej Dios yaji yet' heb' ajun yet'ok chi'. Ha juntzanh ixim pan chi', anhej heb' sakerdote ay yalan yik swaan ixim. Manh sleyalok skomon waan ixim winh yet' heb' ajun yet'ok. Palta manh mulok jun sk'ulejnak winh chi' yet' heb' t'a yichanh Dios.
¿Tom malaj b'aj ix eyil t'a ley Moisés to a heb' sakerdote, heb' ay t'a yol stemplo Dios, manh sk'anab'ajejnakok sk'ual ik'oj ip heb'? Palta manh ochnakoklaj smulok heb'.
Palta a in tik swal t'ayex, ay jun t'a he kal tik ek'to yelk'och t'a yichanh stemplo Dios, a in ton tik.

Octom wal snachajel eyuuj tas yalnakkan Dios t'a Slolonel Tz'ib'ab'ilkani, ayik yalannakkan icha tik: In gana tz'ok' he k'ool t'a heb' eyetanimail. Manhoknhej juntzanh silab' snhusji chi' in gana, xchi. Octom snachajel jun tik eyuuj, max am eyala' to tz'och smul heb' malaj smul.
Ha in tik Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail, yuj chi' syal walani tas sko k'ulej t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip, xchi Jesús t'a heb' winh fariseo chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at Jesús, ix k'och t'a yol spatil skulto heb' winh.

Ata' ay jun winh sikb'inaquel sk'ab', junelnhej taquinh roquinak. Axo heb' winh chi', snib'ej heb' winh ay junok smul Jesús tz'ilchaji, yik syak'och heb' winh t'a yib'anh. Yuj chi', ix stz'akan sk'anb'ej heb' winh t'ay: --¿Ay am sleyal skak' b'oxok junok penaay t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip, mato maay? xchi heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalan t'a heb' winh: --Q'uinalok ay junok nok' he kalnel sb'at t'a yol junok xab' t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip, ¿tom max ex b'at eyik'k'eta nok'?
Ocxom junok anima, yelxo wal niwan yelk'och t'a yichanh junok nok' kalnel chi'. Yuj chi', sleyal ton sko k'ulej juntzanh tas wach' t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip, xchi t'a heb' winh.
Ix lajwinhej chi', ix yalan t'a winh: --Hak'uel lian a k'ab' chi', xchi t'a winh. Ix slianel sk'ab' winh chi', ix b'oxikan b'ian. Lajan ix aj yet' jun toxonton wach' chi'.
Axo ix elta heb' winh fariseo chi', ix slajtian sb'a heb' winh tas ol yutok heb' winh smilan Jesús.
Ayic ix snaanel Jesús tas snib'ej heb' syutej, ix sb'esanel sb'a ta'. Tzijtum anima ix b'at yet'ok. Masanil heb' penaay, ix laj b'oxikan sk'ool heb' yuj.
Ix yalan t'a heb': --Ayta b'aj tzeyaleli mach in, xchi.
Icha chi' ix aj yelk'och tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj winhaj Isaías, winh schekab' Dios t'a peka'. Xchikan icha tik:

Ha jun tik, in chekab' yaji, sik'b'il yajkanel wuuj. Te xajan wuuj. Tzin k'e wal chaanh yet'ok. Ol wak' Vespíritu t'ay. Ol yalanel t'a skal heb' manh israelok to ol ch'olb'itaj tas yaj heb' t'a stojolal.
Malaj b'aj ol yak' owal. Malaj b'aj ol el yaw. Malaj mach ol ab'an sjaj t'a yol kalle.

Ay heb' ob'iltak, icha junok te' aj spakchaji, ma icha junok kandil wan stupi, icha chi' yaj heb', palta ha' ol kolwaj yet' heb', manh ol ixtaj heb' yuj. Icha chi' ol yutok sb'a, masanto ol wach' och yajalil, haxo yak'an yajalil chi' t'a stojolal.
Axo heb' anima t'a junjun chonhab', ol yak'och heb' yipok sk'ool, xchi Dios t'a Slolonel Tz'ib'ab'ilkani.

Ay jun winh ix ik'jib'at t'a Jesús. Max ujilaj yilan winh, max yalpaxlaj slolon winh, yujto ixtab'il winh yuj jun enemigo. Axo Jesús ix ak'an b'oxok sk'ool winh. Yuj chi' ix yilxi winh, ix lolonxi winh.
Axo heb' anima smasanil ix te sat sk'ool heb' yilani. Ix laj yalan heb': --Ha jun winh tik, ¿tekan a jun yinhtilal winhaj Dawid winh tanhwab'il sja kuuj? xchi heb'.

Palta ayik ix yab'an juntzanh chi' heb' winh fariseo, ix yalan heb' winh: --Ha jun winh tik, syalton yik'anel heb' enemigo winh, yujto a winh Beelzebú, yajal heb' enemigo, a ayoch yet' winh, xchi heb' winh.

Axo Jesús, yojtakxo tas wan snaan heb' winh chi', yuj chi' ix yalan t'a heb' winh: --Ha junok nakión spoj sb'ha t'a yol yiko', sjuwieli. Anhejtona' junok chonhab', ma junok pat spoj sb'ha t'a yol yiko', sjuwipaxeli.
Anhejtona', icha pax chi' winh Satanás, tato spechel heb' yetenemigoal winh, spojnakxom sb'a heb', ¿tom ol najtilax yopisio winh?

Ha ex tik tzeyala', yujto ayoch winh Beelzebú wed'ok yuj chi' tzin pechel heb' enemigo chi'. Tato yel tzeyala', ¿mach ayoch yet' heb' he k'ayb'um chi' ayik spechanel heb' enemigo chi' heb'? Anhejtona' heb' he k'ayb'um chi' sch'oxanel he paltail.
Palta yujnhej Yespíritu Dios tzin pechel heb' enemigo chi'. Yuj chi', scheklajeli to toxo ix och Dios yak' yajalil t'a he kal.

Q'uinalok ay junok winh te ay yip. Malaj junok mach syal skomon och t'a yol spat winh, syik'anb'at tastak ay t'a winh. Anhej tato tz'ak'ji ganar stzek'chajkan winh aj pat chi', anhej icha chi', syal yik'jib'at tastak ay t'a yol spat winh chi'.
Ha heb' manh ayokoch wed'ok, ajk'ool heb' t'ayin. Ha heb' max molb'ankot heb' anima t'ayin, a heb' spechan saklem heb' anima chi'.

Yuj chi', swal t'ayex, yalxonhej tas smul heb' anima, yalxonhej tas malaj swach'il syal heb', ol yal yak'ji lajwok yuj Dios. Palta a heb' sb'uchwaj t'a Yespíritu Dios, manhxo ol ak'joklaj niwank'olal heb'.

Ha heb' tz'alan junok chukal t'a in patik a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, syal yak'ji lajwok smul heb'. Palta haxo heb' sb'uchwaj t'a spatik Yespíritu Dios, a smul heb' chi', manhxo ol ek'b'atlaj, wach'chom tiknaik, wach'chom t'a junxo tiempoal toto ol jawok.
Naec sik'lab'il, tato ay junok te te' wach', wach' sat te' syak'a'. Tato ay junok te te' chuk, chuk sat te' syak'a'. Yuj sat te' chi', skojtaquejel tas te'al te'.
Ha ex tik, lajan ex icha juntzanh nok' chan. Malaj he wach'il. Yuj chi', ¿tom ay jab'ok tas wach' syal eyalani? Yujto anhej tas ay t'a he pensar, anhej chi' tzeyala'.
Tato wach' ko pensar, wach' skutej ko b'a, yujto anhej tas wach' chi' ay t'a ko pensar. Axo ta chuk ko pensar, chuk skutej ko b'a, yujto anhej chukal sko na'a.
Yuj chi', swal t'ayex, ato yik ol ja jun k'ual yik ol ch'olb'itaj tas eyaji, jantaknhej juntzanh lolonel malaj yopisio tzeyala', ol ch'olb'itaj tas eyaj yuj.
Yujto ha Dios ol ex ch'olb'itan yuj tas tzeyala'. Ol yala', tato malaj he mul yuj tas slaj eyal chi', mato ay, xchi Jesús.
Ay juntzanh heb' winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés yet' juntzanh heb' winh fariseo ix alan t'a Jesús: --Ach ko k'ayb'umal, ko gana tza ch'ox junok milagro quila', xchi heb' winh t'ay.

Yuj chi' ix yalan t'a heb' winh: --Ha ex t'a jun pekti’ tik, malaj he wach'il, manhok d'ha Dios tzeyak'och he pensar. Tonhej tze k'an eyil junok milagro, junok sch'oxan spoder Dios. Palta a junok milagro ol ch'oxjok eyila', aton jun icha sch'oxnak Dios yet' jun winh schekab' skuchan Jonás.

Ha winhaj Jonás chi', oxe' k'ual, oxe' ak'wal ek'nak winh t'a yol sk'ool jun nok' niwan chay. Icha ajnak winhaj Jonás chi', icha chi' ol in aj pax a in tik, a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik. Oxe' k'ual, oxe' ak'wal ol in ek' t'a yol lu'um.

Ayic ek' yalannakkanel yab'ixal Dios winhaj Jonás t'a heb' aj Níniwe, snanak wal sb'a heb'. Axo tiknaik, ayinek' eyed'ok, ek'to welk'och t'a yichanh winhaj Jonás chi', palta max he nalaj he b'a. Yuj chi', ato ol jawok jun k'ual yik ol ch'olb'itaj tas eyaji, a heb' aj Níniwe chi', ol k'e waan heb', ol yalan he mul heb'.

Icha pax chi' jun ix yajal t'a Sur t'a peka', te najat kotnak ix, ul yab'annak sjelanil winhaj Salomón ix. Axo tiknaik, ay in ek' t'a tik, ek'to welk'och t'a yichanh winh, palta max ul he k'anb'ej eyab' t'ayin. Yuj chi', ato ol jawok jun k'ual ayik ol ch'olb'itaj tas eyaji, ol k'e waan ix, ol yalan he mul ix.
Q'uinalok ay jun enemigo tz'el t'a junok anima tiknaik. Tz'ek' t'a tzinan lu'um, sayan b'aj syik' yip. Palta max ilchaj yuj.
Yuj chi' snaani: Ol in pax t'a in pat b'aj kotnak in, xchi. Axo yik sk'ochxi, syilan jun anima chi', icha junok pat mesesi yool, malaj yajal, wach' yilji.

Yuj chi' smeltzajxib'at t'a spatik, sb'at yik'ankot ukwanhokxo heb' enemigo ek'to schukal t'a yichanh. Swach' och kajan heb' smasanil t'a jun anima chi'. Yuj chi', ste juwiel jun anima chi' icha t'a sb'ab'elal. Icha jun anima chi', icha chi' ol aj swach' juwiel he pensar a ex tik, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Vanto yalan Jesús t'a heb' anima chi', ix k'och ix snun yet' heb' yuk'tak. Ha t'a ti' pat ix k'och heb'. Snib'ej heb' sk'umej Jesús chi'.
Yuj chi' ay jun winh ix alan t'a Jesús: --Ix ja ix a nun yet' heb' uk'tak t'a ti' pat. Snib'ej heb' slolon ed'ok, xchi winh t'ay.
