Ha winh tz'alji smamok Jesús chi' yet' ix snun, junjun ab'il xid'ek' heb' t'a Jerusalén yuj q'uinh yik snajikoti tas aj yelnakkot heb' israel t'a Egipto.
Axo ix tz'akwi slajchawil ab'il sk'inal Jesús, ix b'atxi heb' t'a Jerusalén t'a q'uinh chi' ichataxon sleyal.
Ayic ix lajwi jun q'uinh chi', ix paxta heb'. Axo yune' quelem Jesús, ix kan t'a Jerusalén, max snalaj ix snun yet' winhaj José tato ix kani.
Ha snaan heb' to tzak'an yet' juntzanhxo heb' tzijtumal anima. Yuj chi', jun k'ual ix b'ey heb'. Axo ix sayanek' heb' t'a skal heb' sk'ab' yok yet' heb' yamigo,
malaj. Yuj chi', ix meltzajxi heb' t'a Jerusalén chi' sayxi.
Ato t'a schab'jial ix ilchaj yuj heb' t'a yamaq'uil stemplo Dios, k'ojanem t'a skal juntzanh heb' winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés, wan smaklan yab'i tas syal heb' winh, sk'anb'anpax yab' t'a heb' winh.
Masanil heb' ix ab'an sloloni, ix te och k'elan heb', yujto te nhikan, te jelan pax spakani.

Axo ix yilan heb' smam snun chi', ix te sat sk'ool heb'. Axo ix snun chi' ix alani: --Ach wune', ¿tas yuj icha tik tzonh utej? Ha winh a mam tik yet' in, te ilk'olal kaji, wan ach ko sayaneq'ui, xchi ix t'ay.
Ix tak'wi Jesús t'a ix icha tik: --¿Tas yuj tzin he sayeq'ui? ¿Tom manh eyojtakok to yowalil a smunlajel in Mam tzul in b'o'o? xchi.
Palta maj nachajel-laj yuj heb' tas ix yala'.
Ichato chi' ix paxta yet' heb' t'a Nazaret, ix sk'anab'ajan tas ix yal heb'. Axo ix snun chi', ix kan juntzanh chi' t'a spensar ix, ix ste naub'tanhan ix.
Vannhej sq'uib' Jesús chi', ipan yaj spensar. Stzalaj wal Dios yet'ok, stzalaj pax heb' anima yet'ok.

Ha winhaj Juan yuninal winhaj Zacarías, ayek' winh t'a tzinan lu'um. Ata' ix yal Dios tas ol yal winh t'a heb' anima. Ha jun tik ujinak ayik 15 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Tiberio yajalil, ayik ayoch winhaj Poncio Pilato gobernadoral t'a Judea, haxo winhaj Herodes ayoch gobernadoral t'a Galilea. Axo winhaj Felipe yuk'tak winhaj Herodes chi', ayoch gobernadoral t'a Iturea yet' t'a Traconite. Axo winhaj Lisanias ayoch gobernadoral t'a Abilinia. Axo heb' winh sat sakerdote, aton winhaj Anás yet' winhaj Caifás.

Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', ix schael yich winhaj Juan chi' yek' t'a masanil juntzanh lugar ay t'a slak'anil sti' ha' Jordán. Ix laj yalan winh t'a heb' anima to syak' bautizar sb'a heb', snaan sb'a heb' yik tz'ak'ji lajwok smul heb'.

Icha chi' ix aj yelk'och tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj winhaj Isaías schekab' Dios, ayik yalannakkan yab'ixal winhaj Juan chi' winh icha tik: Ay jun t'a tzinan lu'um, ol yal icha tik: Icha tz'aj sb'o b'e ayik sjawi junok yajal, icha chi' tzeyutej he b'oan he b'eyb'al, yujto ol jawok winh Kajal.
Masanil ch'olquixtak ol laj panhanb'ok. Masanil lum witz yet' lum tzalan ol panhlajok. Axo juntzanh b'e kumquiltak ol tojolb'ok yet' juntzanh amquiltak tojolxonhej ol ajok.
Ha junjun chonhab' ol ilanok to ay kolnab'il syak' Dios, xchikani.

Ayic ix jawi heb' anima t'a winhaj Juan chi' yik tz'ak'ji bautizar heb' yuj winh, ix yalan winh t'a heb': --Ha ex tik, te jelan ex t'a chukal icha nok' chan. ¿Mach ix alan t'ayex tato ol yal he kolan he b'ha t'a jun niwan yaelal wan sjawi yuj yowal sk'ol Dios?

Tato tze na he b'ha t'a he mul, yowalil wach' tzeyutej he b'eyb'al, yik scheklajeli to yel ix he na he b'a. Manh eyal icha tik: Malaj pena, yinhtilonhkan winhaj Abraham, manh xe chiok. Yujto a in tik swal t'ayex, tato snib'ej Dios, syal yoch juntzanh k'een k'een tik yinhtilok winhaj Abraham chi' he k'exulok.

Ha jun niwan yaelal ol jawok, lajan icha junok winh lista yaj yet' sch'akab' t'a yich juntzanh te' awb'en te'. Jantacnhej te' chuklaj sat syak'a', ol laj sch'aquel te' winh. Ol syumanb'at te' winh t'a kal k'ak', xchi winhaj Juan chi' t'a heb'.
--¿Tas wach' sko k'ulej jun? xchi heb' t'a winh.
--Ha heb' ay chab'ok skamix, yak'okab' junok heb' t'a heb' malaj yiko'. Ha heb' ay tas swa'a, spukokab' ek' heb' t'a heb' malaj yiko', xchi winh t'a heb'.
Ix k'och pax juntzanh heb' tekumel alkabar yik syak'an bautizar sb'a heb'. Ix sk'anb'an heb' t'a winh: --Ach ko k'ayb'umal, ¿tas wach' sko k'ulej? xchi heb'.
--Ayic tze k'ananel stumin heb' anima, manh he k'an jab'okxo t'a yib'anh icha syal ley, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Ay pax heb' soldado ix k'anb'an t'a winh: --Ha onhxo pax tik, ¿tas sko k'ulej? xchi heb'. --Manh he xib'tej heb' anima yuj eyesanoch junok tas t'a yib'anh yik tzeyik'ek' junok tas t'a heb'. Schaokab' he k'ool ichataxon he tojol, xchi winh t'a heb'.
Ay heb' anima chi' ix naub'tanhani, ix sk'anb'an heb' tato a winhaj Juan chi' aton Cristo.

Palta ix yalan winh t'a heb' smasanil: --Val yel, a in tik tzex wak' bautizar t'a ha ha', palta ay junxo toto ol jawok. A' ol ak'anoch Yespíritu Dios t'ayex, icha k'ak' ol em t'a eyib'anh. Ichato ol ex ak'jok bautizar yuj. Ha jun chi' ek'to yopisio t'a wichanh. Manh in mojok swak' serwil, wach'chom tonhej tzin tij sch'anhal xanhab'.

Ha jun chi' lajan icha junok winh schayej strigo, tz'el smatz'il t'a skal. Slajwi schayan ixim, syak'ankanem ixim t'a yol yet'tal. Axo smatz'il ixim tz'elkani, slanhkanb'at winh t'a yib'anh jun k'ak' malaj b'ak'uinh stupi, xchi winhaj Juan chi'.
Tzijtumto juntzanhxo k'ayb'ub'al icha juntzanh tik ix yalel winh t'a heb' anima chi', ix yalanpax wach' ab'ix winh t'a heb'.
Ha winh ix kachanpax winhaj Herodes, winh ayoch gobernadoral, yujto ix yik' ix smu' winh skuchan Herodías. Ix skachanpax winh yuj juntzanhxo chukal sk'ulej.
Palta a winhaj Herodes chi' maj sk'anab'ajej winh tas ix alji t'ay. Ay junxo chukal ix sk'ulej winh yujto ix yak'och winhaj Juan chi' winh t'a preso.
Ayic mantzak och winhaj Juan chi' t'a preso, wan yak'an bautizar heb' anima winh, ix yak' pax bautizar Jesús winh. Yakb'an wan slesalwi Jesús, ix jakwi satcha’anh.
Axo Yespíritu Dios ix emul t'a yib'anh icha nok' paramuch. Ix yab'an yoch jun lolonel t'a satcha’anh icha tik: --Ha ach tik, Vuninal ach, xajanab'il ach wuuj. Tzin tzalaj wal ed'ok, xchi jun aw chi'.

Ha Jesús ayxom 30 ab'ilok sk'inal ayik ix syamanoch smunlaji. Tz'alji t'ay to yuninal winhaj José. Aton sb'i smakanhil heb' smam yicham tik: Schab'at t'a winhaj Elí masanto slajwikan k'och t'a winhaj Adán. Vinhaj Elí,
winhaj Matat, winhaj Leví, winhaj Melqui, winhaj Jana, winhaj José,
winhaj Matatías, winhaj Amós, winhaj Nahum, winhaj Esli, winhaj Nagai,
winhaj Maat, winhaj Matatías, winhaj Semei, winhaj José, winhaj Judá,
winhaj Joana, winhaj Resa, winhaj Zorobabel, winhaj Salatiel, winhaj Neri,
winhaj Melqui, winhaj Adi, winhaj Cosam, winhaj Elmadam, winhaj Er,
winhaj Josué, winhaj Eliezer, winhaj Jorim, winhaj Matat,
winhaj Leví, winhaj Simeón, winhaj Judá, winhaj José, winhaj Jonam, winhaj Eliaquim,
winhaj Melea, winhaj Mainán, winhaj Matata, winhaj Natán,
winhaj Dawid, winhaj Isaí, winhaj Obed, winhaj Booz, winhaj Salmón, winhaj Naasón,
winhaj Aminadab, winhaj Admin, winhaj Aram, winhaj Esrom, winhaj Fares, winhaj Judá,
winhaj Jacob, winhaj Isaac, winhaj Abraham, winhaj Taré, winhaj Nacor,
winhaj Serug, winhaj Ragau, winhaj Peleg, winhaj Heber, winhaj Sala,
winhaj Cainán, winhaj Arfaxad, winhaj Sem, winhaj Noé, winhaj Lamec,
winhaj Matusalén, winhaj Enoc, winhaj Jared, winhaj Mahalaleel, winhaj Cainán,
winhaj Enós, winhaj Set, winhaj Adán. Ha winhaj Adán chi', ha Dios b'oannak winh.
Ha Jesús te ayoch Yespíritu Dios t'ay, ix el b'aj ayek' t'ha ha' niwan Jordán. Ix ik'jib'at yuj Espíritu chi' t'a tzinan lu'um.
40 k'ual ix ek' ta', haxo winh diablo ix k'och yak' prowal. Maj walaj Jesús chi' t'a juntzanh k'ual chi', yuj chi' ix och swejel.
Ix yalan winh diablo chi' t'ay: --Ina Yuninal ach Dios, al t'a jun k'een tik to tz'och panil, xchi winh t'ay.
Ix tak'wi Jesús t'a winh: --Syal t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkan icha tik: Manh yujoknhej tas swaji ay ko k 'inal, xchi Slolonel chi', xchi t'a winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix ik'jik'e Jesús t'a jun niwan tzalan yuj winh. Ix sch'oxan juntzanh niwak chonhab' winh t'a masanil yol yib'anhk’inal tik t'a Jesús chi'.

Ix yalan winh t'ay: --Ol ach wak'och yajalil t'a masanil juntzanh chonhab' tzin ch'ox tik t'ayach. Ol ach och b'eyumal yuj. Ha juntzanh tik t'a yol in k'ab' ay, swak'nhej t'a mach b'aj in gana swak'a'.
Tato tzach em kuman t'ayin, tzalan a b'a t'ayin, iknhej yaj juntzanh tik smasanil, xchi winh diablo chi' t'ay.
Axo ix yalan Jesús t'a winh: --Syal t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani: Anhej d'ha Dios Kajal tzeyal he b'a. Anhej pax t'ay tzeyak'em he b'a, xchi t'a Slolonel chi', xchi t'a winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix ik'jixib'at Jesús yuj winh diablo chi' t'a chonhab' Jerusalén. Ix yik'ank'e winh t'a schon stemplo Dios, ix yalan winh t'ay: --Ina Yuninal ach Dios, emanh chennaj t'a sat lu'um chi',
yujto syal t'a Slolonel Dios chi': Ol yal Dios t'a heb' yángel to tzach stanhwej heb'.
Ol ach quetzchajk'e yuj heb', yik wach' manh ol a tenoch ok t'a k'een k'een, xchi Slolonel Dios chi', xchi winh diablo chi'.
Ix yalan Jesús t'a winh: --Tz'ib'yajpaxkani: Manh eyak' prowal Kajal, aton ko Diosal, xchi t'a Slolonel Dios, xchi Jesús.
Yujto manhxa junokxo tas b'aj syal yak'ji prowal Jesús yuj winh diablo chi', yuj chi' ix aktajkan yuj winh junok tiempoal.
Ix jax Jesús t'a Galilea, te ayoch spoder Yespíritu Dios t'ay. Ix laj ab'chaj yab'ixal t'a juntzanh lugar chi'.
Ix ek' sk'ayb'ej heb' anima t'a yoltak spatil kulto. Masanil heb' ix alan wach' lolonel t'ay.
Ichato chi' ix k'och t'a chonhab' Nazaret b'aj q'uib'nak. Axo t'a sk'ual syik' yip heb' israel, ix och t'a yol spatil kulto ichataxon smodo. Ix k'e linhan yik syawtan Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani.
Yuj chi', ix ak'jib'at jun b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkan Slolonel Dios chi' t'ay, aton tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj winhaj Isaías schekab' Dios. Ix xuyanb'ati, ix sayan b'aj syal icha tik:

Ha Yespíritu Dios Kajal ayoch t'ayin, yujto ha' ak'jinak wopisio yik swalanel jun wach' ab'ix t'a heb' meb'a'. In schekkoti yik swak' sniwanil sk'ool heb' ilk'olal yaji. Tzul wal yab' heb' icha preso yaji chajtil tz'aj skolchaj heb'. In chekjikot wak' b'oxok heb' max uji yilani. Tzul wik'anel heb' ayoch tas t'a yib'anh t'a libre.
Anhejtona' tzul walaneli to toxo sja stiempoal jun kolnab'il syak' Dios Kajal. Icha chi' syal Slolonel Dios tik, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Ix chulanxikan jun b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkan chi', ix yak'anxi t'a winh sik'umal. Ichato chi' ix em k'ojan sk'ayb'ej heb'. Axo masanil heb' ayoch t'a yol chi', ix te och k'elan heb' t'ay.
Ix syamanoch sk'ayb'an heb', ix yalani: --Ha wal t'a jun k'ual tik, ix elk'och syal Slolonel Dios tik t'a eyichanh, xchi t'a heb'.

Masanil heb' ix te sat sk'ool yuj juntzanh lolonel wach' ix yal Jesús, yuj chi' ix yal wach' lolonel heb' t'ay. Ix laj sk'anb'an yab' junjun heb': --¿Manhtoc a winh tik yuninal winhaj José? xchi heb'.
Yuj chi' ix yal Jesús t'a heb': --Ha ex ton tik ol eyal t'ayin: Ach anhtum, munil tzanhtej a b'a. Ha tas a k'ulejnak t'a chonhab' Capernaum, k'ulej pax t'a a chonhab' tik quila', xe cham t'ayin.
Val yel swal t'ayex, malaj junok schekab' Dios ay yelk'och t'a sat heb' yetchonhab'.

Tze nakot yab'ixal winhaj Elías t'a peka', chajtil ek'nak winh. Nanhal schanhil ab'il manhxo yak'nakok nhab'. Te niwan wejel janak t'a yib'anh heb' anima smasanil. Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', tzijtum heb' ix chamnak yetb'eyum ay t'a skal heb' quetisraelal.
Palta manhok t'a junok heb' ix chi' chekjinakb'at winhaj Elías yuj ko Mam Dios yik skolwaji. Anhej t'a jun ix aj Sarepta t'a yol yik Sidón, anhej ta' k'ochnak winh.

Anhejtona', tze napaxkot yab'ixal jun winh schekab' Dios skuchan Eliseo. Tzijtum heb' quetisraelal yamchajnak yuj jun yab'il skuch lepra. Palta malaj junok heb' b'oxinak yuj winhaj Eliseo chi', anhej jun winh aj Siria skuchan Naamán, anhej winh b'oxinak yuj winh, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Axo heb' ayek' yet' ta', ayik ix yab'an heb', ix te kot yowal heb' smasanil t'ay.
Yuj chi' ix laj k'e waan heb', ix spechanel heb' t'a stiel chonhab', yujto a jun chonhab' chi' t'a jolom tzalan ay, ata' ijan ix syumb'at heb' t'a sat k'akap.
Palta haxo Jesús b'enhej ix ek'b'at t'a skal heb', ix b'ati.
Ichato chi', ix emta Jesús t'a chonhab' Capernaum t'a yol yik Galilea. Ata' ix sk'ayb'ej heb' anima t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip.
Ix te sat sk'ool heb' yab'an juntzanh k'ayb'ub'al chi', yujto ayik ix yalaneli, ix cheklaji to te ay yopisio yuj Dios.
Ha t'a yol spatil kulto ay jun winh ayoch enemigo t'ay. Ix el yaw jun enemigo chi'.
--Ach Jesús aj Nazaret. ¿Tas yuj tzak'och a b'a qued'ok? ¿Tom tzach jawi onh a sateli? Vojtak ach, a ach tik sik'b'il ach el yuj Dios, xchi jun enemigo chi'.
Axo Jesús ix tuman jun enemigo chi', ix yalan t'ay: --Tz'in xa chi, aktejkan jun winh tik, xchi t'ay. Ix lajwinhej chi', ix syuman telwok jun winh b'aj ayoch chi', ix eli, maj lajwoklaj winh yuj.

Masanil heb' anima ayek' ta', ix te sat sk'ol heb' yuj, ix laj yalan junjun heb': --¿Tastaxlaj yaj juntzanh slolonel jun winh tik? Ha slolonel winh tik sch'oxaneli to ay spoder schekanel juntzanh enemigo tik, tz'el heb' b'ian, xchi heb'.
Ix laj el yab'ixal Jesús t'a juntzanh lugar ay t'a slak'anil chi'.
Axo ix elta Jesús t'a yol spatil kulto, ix k'och t'a spat winhaj Simón. Ha ix snhi' winhaj Simón chi', te penaay ix yuj k'ak'al yab'il. Ix tewi heb' t'a Jesús yuj ix.
Ix snitzanb'at sb'a Jesús chi' b'aj jichanek' ix chi', ix skachanoch waan jun ilya chi'. Ix el jun k'ak'al yab'il chi' t'a ix. Junanto rato chi' ix k'e waan ix, ix k'atk'ajkot heb' yuj ix.
Axo t'a yemk'ualil, masanil juntzanh heb' penaay ix ik'jikot t'a Jesús. Ch'okch'ok ilyail tz'ik'an heb'. Ix yak'anek' sk'ab' t'a yib'anh heb', ix laj b'oxikan heb'.

Tzijtum heb' anima b'aj ix laj el heb' enemigo, ix laj el yaw heb', ix yalan heb': --Ha ach tik Yuninal ach Dios, xchi heb' t'ay. Palta haxo Jesús ix kachan heb' enemigo chi', maj schalaj lolon heb', yujto ojtakab'il yuj heb' to Cristo.
Ayic wan sakb'i, ix b'at Jesús t'a stiel chonhab' b'aj tzinan. Axo heb' anima, wan sayjiek' yuj heb', ix k'och heb' b'aj ayek' chi'. Snib'ej heb' maj b'atlaj Jesús chi',
palta ix yalan t'a heb': --Yowalil ol b'at wal pax el yab'ixal t'a juntzanhxo chonhab', yik syab' heb' chajtil tz'aj yoch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' Dios. Yuj chi' in chekjikoti, xchi t'a heb'.
Ix ek'nhej Jesús t'a yoltak spatil kulto t'a yol yik Judea. Ix yalanel slolonel Dios.
Ha junel ayek' Jesús t'a sti' ha' nhajab' Genesaret. Tzijtum anima ix k'och t'ay, ix te witz'k'aj yuj heb' yujto snib'ej heb' syab' slolonel Dios.
Ix yilani ayek' chab' yunetak barko t'a sti' ha', malaj mach ayoch t'a yool, yujto ix elta juntzanh heb' yamum chay t'a yol te', wan sjuk'anel schimpa heb', yik syamlab' chay chi'.

Yuj chi' ix och Jesús t'a yol jun te' barko chi', aton te' yik winhaj Simón. Ix yalan t'a winh to snitzoch jab'ok te' winh t'a yol ha'. Ixlajwi chi' ix em k'ojan t'a yol te', ix och ijan sk'ayb'an heb' anima chi' t'a sti' ha'.
Ixlajwi sk'ayb'an heb', ix yalanpax t'a winhaj Simón chi': --Koyec yet' te' he barko tik b'aj te jul ha', ata' ol eyak'em he chimpa, xchi Jesús chi'.
--Ach ko k'ayb'umal, jun ak'wal ix kak'lej ko yaman nok' q'uiq'ui, malaj wal junok nok' ix quik'a'. Palta yujnhej to a ach tzala', ol b'at kak'em ko chimpa tik junelxo, xchi winhaj Simón chi' t'ay.
Axo yik ix yak'anem heb', manhxo jantakok nok' ix yamchaji. Ha schimpa heb' chi' ijan ix nhik'chajb'ati.
Ix sb'echk'ab'ankot juntzanhxo heb' yetb'eyum heb' t'a junxo barko yik tz'och heb' yet' heb'. Ix jawi heb', ix b'ud'ji chab' te' barko chi'. Ijan ix b'at te' t'a yol ha' yuj yalil nok'.
Axo ix yilan jun chi' winhaj Simón Pedro chi', ix em kuman winh t'a yichanh Jesús, ix yalan winh t'ay: --Mamin, ma max ach el t'a in tz'ey, yujto a in tik, te chuk in, xchi winh.
Icha chi' ix yutej winh yalani, yujto ix te sat sk'ol winh yet' juntzanhxo heb' yetb'eyum yuj juntzanh nok' tzijtumal chay ix syam heb' chi'.

Anhejtona' winhaj Jacobo yet' winhaj Juan, aton heb' winh yuninal winhaj Zebedeo, ix te sat sk'ol heb' winh. Yetyamum chayil sb'a heb' winh yet' winhaj Simón chi'. Ix yalan Jesús t'a winhaj Simón chi': --Manh ach xiwok. Icha tzutej a yaman nok' chay tik, icha chi' ol utok ik'ankot heb' anima t'ayin, xchi t'a winh.
Axo ix elk'och juntzanh barko chi' t'a sti' ha', ix yaktankan juntzanh syamk'ab' heb' chi', ix och tzak'an heb' yuj Jesús.

Ha junel ayek' Jesús t'a jun chonhab', ix k'och jun winh t'ay, ayk'e yab'il lepra t'a sniwanil winh smasanil. Ha ix yilanoch Jesús chi' winh, ix em kumnaj winh, ix em nhojnaj winh t'a sat lu'um, ix yalan winh t'ay: --Mamin, ta syal a k'ool tzin a b'oxikani, xchi winh.
Axo Jesús ix yamlan winh, ix yalani: --In gana sb'oxikan a k'ool, xchi t'a winh. Ayic ix yalan Jesús icha chi', ix el jun yab'il chi' t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix cham wal yalan t'a winh: --Ayta b'aj tzal jun tik. Palta ixik, b'at ch'ox a b'ha t'a winh sakerdote. B'at ak'an jun silab' d'ha Dios, icha yalnakkan winhaj Moisés, yik tz'ilji to ach b'oxi, xchi Jesús chi' t'a winh.
Ha yab'ixal Jesús chi', ix pukaxnhej t'a skal heb' anima. Tzijtum heb' ix smolb'ej sb'a yik syab' heb' tas syala', yik sb'oxikan sk'ol heb' yuj.
Ix yik'el sb'ha t'a skal heb', ix b'at lesal b'aj malaj heb' anima.

D'a jun k'u wan sk'ayb'an heb' anima Jesús, k'ojk'umb'a juntzanh heb' fariseo yet' pax heb' k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés. Ha t'a junjun chonhab' t'a yol yik Galilea yet' t'a yol yik Judea ix laj kot heb'. Ay pax heb' ix kot t'a Jerusalén. Axo Jesús ix cheklajel spoder Dios t'ay, ayik ix yak'an b'oxok sk'ol heb' penaay.
Ichato chi' ix k'och juntzanh heb' winh, b'akhb'il jun winh sikb'inaquel yuj heb' winh yet' swaynub'. Snib'ej heb' winh tz'och t'a yol pat syak'anoch heb' winh t'a yichanh Jesús.

Palta maj ilchajlaj yuj heb' winh b'aj tz'ochi yujto te witz'an yuj heb' anima. Yuj chi' ix k'e heb' winh t'a spanhanil yib'anh jun pat chi', ix yolan yib'anh pat chi' heb' winh, ix yak'anemta winh penaay chi' heb' winh yet' swaynub' t'a skal heb' anima t'a yichanh Jesús chi'.
Axo ix yilan Jesús chi' to ix yak'och sk'ool heb' winh t'ay, yuj chi' ix yalan t'a winh penaay chi': --Ach anima, toxo ix ak'ji lajwok a mul, xchi t'a winh.

Yuj chi', haxo heb' k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés yet' heb' fariseo, ix och ijan heb' snaub'tanhani: ¿Tas yaj jun winh tik? Van sb'uchwaj winh d'ha Dios. Malaj junok mach syal yak'an lajwok mul, anhej Dios, xchi heb' t'a spensar.
Palta a Jesús yojtakxo tas wan snaan heb' chi', yuj chi' ix yalan t'a heb': --¿Tas yuj tze naub'tanhej jun tik?
¿Tas junok sekojtak kalan tze na'a? ¿A a mul toxo ix ak'ji lajwok, xko chama, ma: Q'ueanh waan, b'eyanh, mato xko chi?

Ha tiknaik, ol in ch'ox t'ayex to a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, ay wopisio wak'an lajwok smul heb' anima ay t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik. Ix yalan Jesús t'a winh sikb'inaquel chi': --Ha in tik swal t'ayach, k'eanh waan, ik'chaanh a waynub' tik, ixik t'a a pat, xchi t'a winh.
D'a jun rato chi', ix k'e waan winh sikb'inaquel chi' t'a yichanh heb'. Ix yik'anchaanh swaynub' winh b'aj jichan ek' chi'. Ix pax winh t'a spat, ix yalan wach' lolonel winh d'ha Dios.
Ix laj och k'elan heb' smasanil ix laj yalan wach' lolonel heb' d'ha Dios, ix te sat sk'ol heb', yuj chi' ix laj yal heb': --Ix te sat ko k'ool quilan juntzanh tik, xchi heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix elta Jesús, ix yilan jun winh tekumel alkabar skuchan Leví, k'ojanek' winh b'aj stequel alkabar chi'. Ix yalan Jesús t'a winh: --Ochanh in k'ayb'umok, xchi.
Ix k'e waan winh, ix yaktankan smasanil, ix och winh sk'ayb'umok Jesús chi'.
Ichato chi', ix och jun niwan wael t'a spat winh yik swa Jesús yet'ok. Tzijtum heb' winh tekumel alkabar yet' juntzanhxo heb' anima ix och yet' heb' t'a mexa.

Axo heb' winh fariseo yet' heb' winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés chi', ix och ijan heb' winh yalan t'a heb' sk'ayb'um Jesús chi' icha tik: --¿Tas yuj tzex wa'i, tzeyuk'an ha' yet' juntzanh heb' winh tekumel alkabar tik yet' heb' chuk sb'eyb'al tik? xchi heb' winh t'a heb'.
Yuj chi', ix yal Jesús t'a heb' winh: --Q'uinalok ay junok winh anhtum tiknaik. Ha heb' wach' sk'ool, ¿tom ay tz'och winh yuj heb'? Anhej heb' penaay ay tz'och winh yuj.
Manh yujok wawtan heb' toxon wach' sb'eyb'al snaani, in jawi. Palta yuj wawtan heb' yojtak to chuk sb'eyb'al, yik wach' sna sb'a heb' yuj smul, xchi t'a heb' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan heb' winh t'a Jesús: --Ha heb' sk'ayb'um winhaj Juan, winh tz'ak'an bautizar yet' heb' sk'ayb'um heb' winh fariseo, tzijtum el tz'och heb' t'a tzek'ojk'olal, slesalwi heb'. Palta haxo heb' a k'ayb'um tik, ¿tas yuj anhej wael syak' heb'? xchi heb' winh t'ay.
Ix yalan Jesús t'a heb' winh: --Q'uinalok ay junok nupnajel, ¿tom syal eyak'anoch heb' awtab'il t'a nupnajel chi' t'a tzek'ojk'olal yakb'an aytoek' winh wan yoch yetb'eyum chi' yet' heb'?
Palta ol ja sk'ual ol ik'jok el winh t'a skal heb', ichato chi' ol och heb' t'a tzek'ojk'olal, xchi t'a heb' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalanxi junxo ab'ix tik t'a heb' winh: --Malaj junok onh ay junok ak' pichul sko nhik'elta jab'ok, skak'anoch snipulok junok k'a pichul. Tato icha chi' skutej, tz'ixtaxel jun ak'to chi'. Anhejtona', tz'ixtax pax el jun k'a pichul chi' yuj jun ak'to chi'.
Ol wal junxo ch'oxnab'il: Max yal-laj yak'chajem wino manto sipji t'a yol junok nok' k'a tz'um yet'tal wino, tato icha chi', snhik'chaj jun tz'uum chi' yuj wino chi', tz'ixtax scha makanhil.
Yuj chi', ha t'a yol nok' ak' tz'uum tzeyak'em wino manto sipji, icha chi' wach' ol kan schab'il.
Anhejtona', tato ay heb' anheja' tzato uk'an peka' wino, haxo jun wino toto sb'oi, malaj yelk'och t'a sat heb'. Syalan heb': Ha jun peka' wino tik, más wach', xchi heb', xchi Jesús.

Ha t'a jun sk'ual ik'oj ip ix ek' Jesús t'a jun b'e t'a skal juntzanh ixim trigo yet' heb' sk'ayb'um. Axo heb' sk'ayb'um chi', ix sk'utzelta sjolom ixim heb', ix swuchanel ixim heb', ix sk'uxan ixim heb'.
Axo juntzanh heb' fariseo ix k'anb'an t'a heb': --¿Tas yuj tze k'ulej junok tas to manh smojok sk'ulaj t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip? xchi heb' winh.
Ix tak'wi Jesús t'a heb' winh icha tik: --¿Tom manta b'aj tzeyila' tas sk'ulejnak winhaj Dawid yet' heb' ajun yet'ok ayik yochnak swejel heb' jun el?

Xid'naquek' winh t'a skajnub' Dios, swanak juntzanh ixim pan winh yiknhej Dios yaji, yak'annak pax ixim winh t'a heb' ajun yet'ok. Ha juntzanh pan chi', anhej heb' winh sakerdote ay yalan yik swaani, palta maj ochlaj smul winhaj Dawid yet' heb' ajun yet' chi', xchi t'a heb' winh.
Ix yalanxi t'a heb' winh: --Ha in tik Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail, yuj chi' syal walani tas smoj sko k'ulej t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip.
D'a junxo sk'ual ik'oj ip, ix och Jesús t'a yol spatil kulto, ix och ijan sk'ayb'an heb'. Ata' ay jun winh sikb'inaquel swach' k'ab'.

Axo heb' winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés yet' heb' winh fariseo, wan smaklan heb' winh yila' tato ol b'oxok sk'ab' jun winh chi' yuj Jesús t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip chi', yik wach' syak'och heb' winh t'a yib'anh.
Palta haxo Jesús, yojtakxo tas wan snaan heb' winh, yuj chi' ix yalan t'a winh sikb'inaquel sk'ab' chi': --Q'ueanh linhan t'a ko kal tik, xchi t'a winh. Ix k'e linhan winh b'ian.

Ix yalan Jesús t'a heb' smasanil: --Tzin k'anb'ej t'ayex: ¿Tas junok smoj ko k'ulan t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip? ¿Tzam yal ko k'ulan juntzanh tas wach', mato a juntzanh chukal? ¿Tzam yal ko kolan junok penaay, mato wach' sko mak'chamok? xchi t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix och k'elan Jesús t'a heb' oyanek' chi', ix yalan t'a winh penaay chi': --Hak'uel lian a k'ab' chi', xchi t'a winh. Ix slianel sk'ab' winh chi', ix b'oxikan winh.
Axo heb' winh k'ayb'um t'a ley chi' yet' heb' winh fariseo, ix te kot yowal heb' winh, ix och ijan heb' winh sk'anb'an t'ay junjun tas wach' syutej heb' winh yik'ankot t'a yib'anh Jesús chi'.
Ha t'a juntzanh k'ual chi', ix b'at Jesús t'a jun tzalan lesal. Jun ak'wal ix lesalwi d'ha Dios.
Axo ix sakb'i ix sik'anel heb' winh sk'ayb'um, ix sik'anelta lajchawanh heb' winh. Ha heb' winh chi', ix yak'och schekab'ok.
Aton heb' winh tik: Vinhaj Simón, skuchan pax Pedro yuj Jesús, winhaj Andrés yuk'tak winhaj Simón chi', winhaj Jacobo, winhaj Juan, winhaj Felipe yet' winhaj Bartolomé.
Vinhaj Mateo, winhaj Tomás, winhaj Jacobo yuninal winhaj Alfeo, winhaj Simón tz'alji pax Zeloteal.

Vinhaj Judas, yuk'tak winhaj Jacobo yet' winhaj Judas aj Queriot, aton winh ak'jinakoch Jesús t'a yol sk'ab' chamel t'a slajwub'alxo. Aton heb' winh tik ix sik'elta Jesús, yik tz'och heb' winh schekab'ok.

Ix emixta Jesús yet' heb' sk'ayb'um t'a jun tzalan chi', ix och waan t'a jun ak'lik. Ata' ix smolb'ej sb'a jantak heb' anima tzak'anoch yuj, yet' pax heb' kotnak t'a yol yik Judea, t'a chonhab' Jerusalén yet' t'a stitak ha' mar t'a yol yik Tiro yet' Sidón. Ix jawi heb' smaklej yab' tas syal Jesús chi', yik sb'oxipaxkan heb' penaay.
Ha heb' tz'ixtaj yuj heb' enemigo, ix b'oxipaxkan heb'.
Masanil heb' snib'ej syamlan Jesús, yujto sb'oxikan sk'ool heb' smasanil yuj spoder.
Axo Jesús ix ek' k'elelok t'a heb' sk'ayb'um, ix yalan t'a heb' icha tik: --Ha ex meb'a' ex, te wach' eyiko', yujto ayexxo och t'a yol sk'ab' Dios.
Ha ex ay he wejel tiknaik, te wach' eyiko', yujto ol ex b'ud'jokkanok. Ha ex tzex oq'ui, te wach' eyiko' yujto slajwi chi' ol ex tzewajok.

Vujnhej a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, ol chichon sk'ool heb' anima t'ayex, ol ex spechelta heb' t'a skal, ol ex sb'uchan heb'. Te chuk ol yal heb' t'a he patik wuuj. Palta ayik ol ex yutan heb' icha chi', te wach' eyiko'.
Tzex te k'echaanh, tzex te tzalaji, yujto te niwan spak ol he cha t'a satcha’anh, yujto icha chi' utab'il heb' schekab' Dios t'a peka' yuj smam yicham heb' anima tik.
Ob'iltak ex b'eyum ex, yujto toxo ix eyil swach'il t'a tik.
Ha ex b'ut'annhej he k'ool tiknaik, te chuk eyiko', yujto ol ja jun pekti’ ol te och he wejel. Ob'iltak ex, mach ex tzex tzewaji, ol ex ok' pax yuj kusk'olal.
Ayic syalan heb' anima smasanil to wach' ex, te chuk eyiko', yujto icha chi' ix utaj heb' ix yaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios t'a peka' yuj heb' smam yicham heb' anima tik.
Palta a exxo tzeyab' tas swal tik, swal t'ayex: Xajanejec heb' eyajk'ool, wach' tzeyutej he b'ha t'a heb' tzex chakaneli.
Tato ay heb' sk'anankot yaelal t'a eyib'anh, a exxo, a swach'k'olal Dios tze k'ankot t'a yib'anh heb'. Tato ay heb' tzex b'uchani, tzex lesalwi yuj heb'.
Tato ay heb' stz'itanb'at junok spak'ul he ti', meltzitejekb'at junxo pak'anh t'a heb'. Tato ay heb' tz'ik'anek' he chumpa, aq'ek pax b'at he kamix t'a heb'.
Tato ay heb' sk'anan junok tas t'ayex, tzeyak'nhej t'a heb'. Tato ay heb' tz'ik'anek' junok tas eyiko', manhxo he k'anxi meltzaj t'a heb'.
Tato tze nib'ej wach' syutej sb'a heb' eyetanimail t'ayex, icha pax chi' tzeyutej he b'ha t'a heb'.
Tato anhej heb' anima xajan ex yuj tze xajanej, ¿b'aja swach'il jun tze k'ulej chi'? Anheja' heb' chuk icha pax chi' syutej sb'a heb'.
Tato anhej heb' wach' syutej sb'a t'ayex b'aj wach' tzeyutej he b'a, ¿b'aja swach'il jun tze k'ulej chi'? Anheja' heb' chuk icha pax chi' sk'ulej heb'.

Tato ay heb' sk'anan sk'ex junok tas t'ayex, tato anhej t'a heb' syal yak'anxi t'ayex, anhej t'a heb' tzeyak'a' ¿tom wach' tze k'ulej icha chi'? Icha chi' syutej sb'a heb' chuk yak'an junok tas majanil t'a heb' yetchukal, yujto sna heb' to ol schapax tas heb' t'a heb'.

Palta a ex tik, xajanejek heb' eyajk'ool, wach' tzeyutej he k'ool. Tato ay junok tas tzeyak' majanil, manh he na to ol tupjok t'ayex. Tato icha chi' tzeyutej he b'a, niwan spak ol he cha'a. Ol cheklajelok to yuninal ex Dios niwan yelk'ochi, yujto anheja' icha chi' Dios chi', wach' syutej sb'ha t'a heb' max yak' yuj diosal yet' pax t'a heb' chuk sk'ulej t'ay.
Ok'okab' he k'ool t'a heb' eyetanimail, icha tz'aj yok' sk'ol Dios t'ayex.

Manh he ch'olb'itej tas yaj junokxo mach, yuj chi' manh ol ex sch'olb'itejpax Dios. Manh eyak'b'at t'a yib'anh junokxo mach, yik wach' ha Dios manh ol ak'anb'at t'a eyib'anh. Tzeyak' niwank'olal, tato icha chi', haxo Dios ol ak'an lajwok he mul.

Hak'ek tas tz'och yuj junokxo mach. Axo Dios ol ak'anpax t'ayex. Icha junok mukuk tz'och echlab'il, ste b'ud'ji, tenb'il tz'aji, manhxa b'aj syal yem jab'okxo, icha chi' ol yutok Dios yak'an tastak t'ayex. Yujto icha tzeyutej eyak'an t'a heb' eyetanimail, icha pax chi' ol yutok Dios yak'an t'ayex.
Ix yal jun ch'oxnab'il tik Jesús: --Q'uinalok a junok mach max uji yilani, a sch'oxan b'e t'a junokxo mach max uji pax yilani, tato icha chi', syetb'atejb'at sb'a heb' t'a junok jul.
Malaj junok mach wan sk'ayb'aji, ek'to t'a yichanh jun sk'ayb'umal chi', wach'chom ayik toxo ix yilel smasanil, lajan tz'aj yet' sk'ayb'umal chi'.

Q'uinalok ay junok eyetanimail, ayb'at jab'ok k'alem t'a yol sat, a exxo a junok te' patzab' ayoch t'a yol he sat. Tato max eyila' to ayoch jun te' chi' t'a yol he sat, ¿tom ol yal eyilan jab' k'alem ayb'at t'a yol sat jun eyetanimail chi'?

Tato ayoch jun te' patzab' chi' t'a yol he sat, ¿tom smoj eyalan t'a junxo chi': Ina yajelta jab' k'alem t'a yol a sat chi', tzin nib'ej swik'elta t'ayach, tom xe chi t'ay? Tato icha chi' tzeyutej eyalani, te chab' sat ex. Yowalil tze b'ab'laj ik'ejelta jun te' patzab' chi' t'a yol he sat. Ichato chi', syal eyik'anelta jab' k'alem t'a yik jun eyetanimail chi'.
Malaj junok te te' wach' chuklaj sat syak'a'. Malaj pax junok te te' chuk wach' sat syak'a'.
Yujto a sat junjun te', a tz'ak'an kojtaquejeli tas yaj junjun te'. Q'uinalok ay junok te' q'uiix, ¿tom higo sat te' syak'a'? Q'uinalok ay junok te' mequiix, ¿tom uwa sat te' syak'a'?
Icha pax chi' heb' anima wach', wach' tas syal heb', yujto a tas wach' sna heb'. Ha heb' anima chuk, chuk tas syal heb', yujto chuk tas sna heb'. Ha tas skala', ha t'a ko pensar skoti.
¿Tas yuj tzeyal t'ayin: Ach Mamin Vajal, xe chi, palta max he k'anab'ajej tas swala'?
Ol wal t'ayex chajtil yaj heb' sjawi t'ayin, syab'an in lolonel heb', sk'anab'ajan pax heb':

Lajan heb' icha jun winh ix sjuk yet'tal spat masanto ix k'och b'aj ay lum stzatzil. Ichato chi' ix sb'oank'e spat winh chi'. Axo ix jawi ha' niwak eluma' t'a jun pat chi', maj ib'xoklaj yuj ha', yujto ha t'a lum stzatzil ayem yich.

Axo heb' tz'ab'an in lolonel, palta max sk'anab'ajej heb', lajan heb' icha jun winh ix sb'ok'e spat b'aj nab'a tza lu'um, manh tzatzoklaj ix ajem yich. Axo yik ix jawi ha' niwak eluma' t'a jun pat chi', ix em lanhnajok, manhxa jab'ok tas ix kani, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Ayic ix lajwi sk'ayb'an heb' anima Jesús, ix k'och t'a chonhab' Capernaum.
Ata' ay jun winh yajal soldado romano, ay jun winh schekab' winh te xajan yuj, palta te penaay winh, wan scham winh.
Ayic ix yab'an yab'ixal Jesús winh, ix schekankot juntzanh heb' winh ichamtak winak israel winh, b'at yalan heb' winh t'a Jesús yik skot yak' b'oxok winh schekab' winh chi'.
Ayic ix ilchaj Jesús yuj heb' winh, ix och ijan heb' winh yalani: --Smoj ton tza kol winh,
yujto xajan ko chonhab' tik yuj winh. Ha winh ix ak'an tumin ayik ix b'o spatil ko kulto.

Yuj chi', ix b'at Jesús yet' heb' winh. Vanxo sk'och heb' t'a slak'anil spat winh, haxo winh ix chekankot juntzanh heb' yamigo yal t'a Jesús icha tik: --Ix yalkot winh yajal soldado icha tik: Mamin, mokab' ixtej a b'a a ja t'ayin, yujto manh in mojok tzach och t'a yol in pat.
Yuj chi' in q'uixwi ach in sayaneq'ui. Tonhejokab' tzala', ol b'oxok sk'ool winh in chekab' tik uuj.

Vojtak to a in tik ayin t'a yalanh smandar winh tzin ak'an mandar, ay pax heb' soldado ayoch t'a yalanh in mandar. Tato swal t'a junok: Ixic, ta xin xchi, sb'atnhej. Swalanpax t'a junokxo: Cotanh, ta xin xchi, skotnhej. Tato tzin chek sk'ulej junok tas junok in chekab', sk'ulejnhej. Icha swutej wak'an mandar heb' chi', icha chi' tzutej ak'an mandar smasanil tas a ach tik, xchikot winh, xchi heb'.

Ayic ix yab'an jun chi' Jesús, ix te sat sk'ool yuj winh, ix och k'elan t'a juntzanh heb' anima tzak'anoch yuj, ix yalan t'a heb': --Val yel, manta b'aj swil junok t'a skal heb' quetisraelal tzin ak'anoch t'a sk'ool icha jun winh tik, xchi Jesús.
Ayic ix jax heb' schekab' winh yajal soldado chi', ix yilan heb' to wach'xo sk'ol winh penaay chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at Jesús t'a jun chonhab' skuch Naín, tzijtum heb' sk'ayb'um ix b'at yet'ok yet' jantak pax heb' anima.

Axo yik wan sk'och heb' t'a jun chonhab' chi', ix yilan heb', wan b'at smukchaj jun chamnak. Tzijtum heb' ay t'a jun chonhab' chi' ed'jinak. Ha winh ix cham chi', aton jun pitanh yune' jun ix chamnak yetb'eyum.
Ayic ix yilanoch ix snun winh chamnak chi' Jesús, ix ok' sk'ol t'a ix, ix yalan t'a ix: --Manh ach ok'ok, xchi t'a ix.

Ix snitzanoch sb'a Jesús t'a stz'ey b'aj ayek' b'akhan jun chamnak chi', ix yak'anek' sk'ab' t'a yib'anh. Ix och waan heb' b'akhjinak chi'. Ix yalan Jesús t'ay: --Ach quelem, a in swal t'ayach: Q'ueanh waan, xchi.
Axo winh quelem chi', ix k'ex k'ojan winh, ix och ijan winh sloloni. Axo Jesús ix ak'anxikan winh t'a ix snun chi'.

Ayic ix yilan jun chi' heb', ix xiwk'e heb', ix och ijan heb' yalan wach' lolonel d'ha Dios, ix yalan heb': --Ay jun schekab' Dios ix cheklaj t'a ko kal tik, te niwan yelk'ochi, xchi heb'. Ix yalanpax heb': --Ix ja Dios onh skol a onh schonhab' onh tik, xchi heb'.
Ha t'a masanil yol yik Judea yet' t'a spatik yichanh, ix ab'chaj tas ix sk'ulej Jesús.
Ha heb' sk'ayb'um winhaj Juan, winh ak'jinak bautizar, xid' alan t'ay yuj jantaknhej tas ix sk'ulej Jesús. Yuj chi', ix yawtankot chawanh heb' sk'ayb'um winh,
ix schekanb'at heb' winh sk'anb'ej t'a Jesús tato a Cristo, mato ch'ok junokxo wan stanhwan heb' sjawi.

Yuj chi', ix k'och heb' t'ay. Ix yalan heb' icha tik: --Ha winhaj Juan, winh ak'jinak bautizar onh chekankoti yik tzul ko k'anb'ej t'ayach tato a ach tanhwab'iltaxon a jawi, mato ch'ok junokxo sko tanhwej sjawi, xchi heb' t'ay.
Ha ix k'och heb', manh jantakok heb' penaay yuj juntzanh ilya ix b'oxi sk'ol yuj Jesús. Ay heb' b'aj ix ik'jiel juntzanh heb' enemigo yet' pax heb' max uji yilani ix laj b'oxi yilan heb'.

Ix tak'wi Jesús t'a heb' schekab' winhaj Juan chi': --Paxanhec, ix alek t'a winhaj Juan chi' tas ix eyila', tas ix eyab'i. Alec t'a winh to a heb' toxonton max uji yilani, wach'xo yilan heb'. Ha heb' max uji sb'eyi, sb'eyxi heb'. Ha heb' slaj k'a yuj yab'il lepra, ix b'oxi sk'ool heb'. Ha heb' max uji yab'ani, tzaxo yab' heb'. Ay heb' chamnak, ix pitzwixi. Axo t'a heb' meb'a' wan yaljiel yab'ixal kolnab'il.
Ha heb' max somchajel spensar wuuj, wach' yik heb'. Icha chi' tzeyutej eyalan t'a winh he k'ochi, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Ayic toxo ix pax heb' schekab' winhaj Juan chi', ix och ijan Jesús yalan t'a heb' anima yuj winh: --¿Tas xid' eyilnak t'a tzinan lu'um? ¿Tom a junok te' aj tz'ib'xi yuj ik' xid' eyilnak?
Tato malaj jun, ¿tas xid' eyilnak? ¿Mato a junok anima te wach' spichul xid' eyilnak? Cojtak to a heb' wach' spichul chi' yet' heb' syak' snib'ej, ayek' heb' t'a spat heb' winh yajal.
Palta jun, ¿tas xid' eyilnak? ¿Tom xid' eyilnak jun winh tz'alanel slolonel Dios? Yel, yalumel slolonel Dios yaj winhaj Juan chi'. Palta manhoknhej jun chi' yopisio winh.

Aton yab'ixal winhaj Juan chi' yalnakkan Dios t'a Slolonel Tz'ib'ab'ilkani. Ayocto yalannakkan yuj winh icha tik: Ol in chekb'at jun in chekab', ol b'ab'lajb'at uuj. Icha tz'aj sb'o b'e, icha chi' ol aj sb'o sb'eyb'al heb' anima yuj, yik manto ach k'ochi, xchi t'a Slolonel chi'.

Swal t'ayex to t'a skal heb' anima ay t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, malaj junok mach ek'alto t'a winhaj Juan chi'. Palta t'a skal heb' ayoch t'a yol sk'ab' Dios, wach'chom heb' malaj wal yelk'ochi, ek'alto swach'il yik heb' t'a yichanh winhaj Juan chi', xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Ha heb' anima smasanil yet' heb' tekumel alkabar, ayik ix yab'an heb' tas ix yal Jesús, ix yalan heb' to te yel syal Dios, yujto ak'b'il bautizar heb' yuj winhaj Juan chi'.

Palta haxo heb' winh fariseo yet' heb' winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés, manh ak'b'iloklaj bautizar heb' winh yuj winh, icha chi' ix aj sch'oxani to a tas snib'ej Dios t'a heb' winh, malaj yelk'och t'a sat heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalan Jesús: --¿Mach yet' ol in lajb'ej heb' anima t'a jun pekti’ tik? ¿Chajtil yaj spensar heb' tze na'a?

Lajan heb' icha heb' unin stajni t'a merkado. Ay heb' tz'alan t'a heb' yetuninal: Ayic ix ko pu'an ko flauta, maj ex chanhalwoklaj. Ayic ix onh b'itan t'a kuseltaquil, maj ex ok'laj qued'ok, xchi heb'. Icha heb' unin malaj snib'ej t'a junok tas chi', icha chi' eyaj a ex tik.
Yujto ix ulek' winhaj Juan, maj walaj winh, maj yuk'laj wino winh t'a skal heb' yetanimail. Ha exxo ix eyala' to ayoch enemigo t'a winh.

Ha tiknaik in ja paxi, a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, tzin wa'i, swuk'an ha' t'a skal heb' quetanimail. Tzeyalanpaxi to b'uk'tzin in, uk'um in anh, swamigoan pax heb' tz'em t'a ajmulal yet' heb' winh tekumel alkabar.
Palta a heb' ay sjelanil Dios t'ay, scheklajel sjelanil heb' chi' t'a tastak sk'ulej, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Ay jun winh fariseo skuch Simón ix awtan Jesús t'a spat yik swa yet' winh. Ix k'och t'a spat winh, tz'eyan ix ajem t'a sat jun alanh lich'anem t'a sat lu'um yik wael.

Ay jun ix ay t'a chonhab' chi', ay spekal to ajmul ix ix. Ix yab'an ix to ix k'och Jesús wael t'a spat winh fariseo chi'. Yuj chi' ix k'och ix b'aj ay yok Jesús, yet'nak jun alabastro ix, b'ut'an yuj jun yal suk'uq'ui sjab'.
Ix och ijan ix yoq'ui, ix sb'ikanel yok chi' ix yet' yal sat. Axo t'a xil sjolom ix, ix suk takjok. Ix stz'ub'anelta yok chi' ix, ix stob'anek' jun yal suk'uq'ui sjab' chi' ix t'a yok Jesús chi'.
Axo ix yilan winh fariseo chi', ix snaan winh: Tato yel schekab' Dios jun winh tik, tzam nachajel yuj winh to a jun ix ix wan syaman yok winh tik, ajmul ix ix, xchi winh t'a spensar.
Yuj chi' ix yalan Jesús t'a winh: --Ach Simón, ay jun tas ol wal t'ayach, xchi t'a winh. --Al t'ayin ach ko k'ayb'umal, xchi winh.
--Ay chawanh heb' winh winak ay smajan tumin t'a spatrón. Ay jun winh, 500 denario smajan winh. Axo junxo winh 50 denario nhej smajan winh chi'.

Yujto maj tzak'wan heb' winh stupan sb'ok chi', yuj chi' tonhej ix ak'ji lajwok sb'ok heb' winh yuj winh ay yik k'een tumin chi'. Al t'ayin, ¿mach junok heb' winh más wal stzalaj yet' winh ay yik k'een tumin chi'? xchi t'a winh.
--Ha tzin na'a, a winh más niwan yik ix ak'ji lajwok chi', a winh más wal stzalaj yet' winh, xchi winhaj Simón chi' t'ay. --Yel tzala', aton winh, xchi Jesús.

Ixlajwi chi' ix och k'elan Jesús t'a jun ix ix chi', ix yalan t'a winhaj Simón chi': --¿Tzam il jun ix ix tik? Ayic in ochul t'a yol a pat, maj ak' jab'ok ha' b'aj tzin b'iquel wok. Axo jun ix ix tik, ha t'a yal sat ix sb'iquel wok, sukan takjok ix yet' xil sjolom.
Maj a tz'ub'laj in ti', yik tzak'an stzatzil in k'ool. Axo jun ix tik, yiktax in ja t'a tik, max och wan ix stz'ub'anelta wok tik.
Maj ak'k'e akeite t'a in jolom, haxo ix, ix tob'anek' jun yal suk'uq'ui sjab' t'a wok tik.
Yuj chi' swal t'ayach to niwan smul ix ix ak'ji lajwok, yuj chi' tzin ste sxajanej ix. Xal junok anima jab'nhej smul tz'ak'ji lajwok, jab'nhej tzin sxajanej, xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalan Jesús t'a ix icha tik: --Ha a mul toxo ix ak'ji lajwok, xchi t'a ix.
Ha juntzanhxo heb' awtab'il, k'ojjab' em heb' ta' yet'ok, ix och ijan heb' yalani: --¿Tas yaj jun winh tik, yuj chi' syal winh to syak' lajwok mul winh? xchi heb'.
Axo Jesús ix alan t'a ix: --Ach kolchaji yujto in ak'och t'a a k'ool. Yuj chi' junk'olal tzach paxi, xchi t'a ix.

Ixlajwi juntzanh tik, ix och ijan Jesús yek' t'a juntzanh chonhab' yet' t'a juntzanh aldea, ix laj yalanel wach' ab'ix tas tz'aj yoch heb' anima t'a yol sk'ab' Dios. Ix ek' heb' lajchawanh schekab' yet'ok.

Ay pax juntzanh heb' ix ix elnak enemigo t'ay, ix ek' yet' heb' yet' juntzanhxo heb' ix penaay b'onakxi sk'ol yuj. D'a skal heb' ix chi', ay jun ix skuchan María aj Magdala, aton jun ix b'aj ik'b'ilel ukwaanh heb' enemigo.

Ay pax junxo ix skuchan Juana yetb'eyum winhaj Chuza, aton winh smayordomo winhaj Herodes. Ay junxo ix skuchan Susana yet' juntzanhxo heb' ix. Ix kolwaj heb' ix t'a Jesús yet' jab'ok tastak ay t'a heb' ix.
Tzijtum anima ix kot t'a junjun chonhab', ix smolb'an sb'a heb' b'aj ayek' Jesús. Yuj chi', ix yal jun ab'ix tik t'a heb'. Ix yalan icha tik:
--Ay jun winh ix b'at tzikanb'at strigo. Axo yik wan stzikanb'at ixim winh, ay juntzanh ixim ix emkan t'a yol b'e, ix laj tek'ji ixim, haxo nok' much ix lojank'e ixim.
Ay juntzanhxo ixim ix emkan t'a yib'anhtak k'een k'een. Axo ix jawi ixim ix takjiel ixim yujto jab'nhej sch'ayanil lu'um.
Ay juntzanhxo ixim ix emkan t'a kaltak ank'ultak, haxo ix q'uib' ixim, tonhej ix takjiel ixim yuj juntzanh ank'ultak ix ja chi' yet'ok.

Palta ay juntzanhxo ixim ix emkan b'aj ay syaxil sat lu'um, haxo yik ix q'uib' ixim, niwan sat ixim ix yak'a'. Ay ixim jun kiento sat t'a junjun sjolom, xchi Jesús. Ayic ix yalan jun tik, te chaanh ix yutej yalani: --Ha ex ix eyab' jun lolonel tik, naub'tanhejek, xchi t'a heb'.
Axo heb' sk'ayb'um ix k'anb'an t'ay tas syalelk'och jun ch'oxnab'il chi'.

Ix yalan t'a heb': --Ha ex tik, ix ak'ji eyojtaquej juntzanh tas ix sch'ox Dios yik tz'och heb' anima t'a yol sk'ab'. Palta tzin lolon t'a juntzanhxo heb' anima t'a ch'oxnab'il, yuj chi' wach'chom syil heb', anheja' yaj heb', ichato malaj tas syil heb', wach'chom syab' heb', palta max nachajel-laj yuj heb'.
Ha jun ch'oxnab'il tik syalelk'ochi: Ha juntzanh inhat chi', a slolonel Dios sch'oxeli.
Ha ixim ix emkan t'a yol b'e sch'oxanel heb' anima tz'ab'ani, haxo sk'och winh diablo t'a heb', tz'ik'jipaxek' jun lolonel chi' t'a heb' yik max yak'och heb' t'a sk'ool, yik max kolchaj heb'.

Axo juntzanhxo ixim ix emkan t'a yib'anh k'een k'een chi' sch'oxanel heb' anima tz'ab'an slolonel Dios, scha heb' t'a tzalajk'olal. Icha junok te te' malaj sch'anhal yib', icha chi' yaj heb'. Syak'och heb' t'a sk'ool jayeok k'ual, haxo sja syaelal heb', syik'anxiel sb'a heb'.

Axo juntzanhxo ixim ix emkan t'a kal ank'ultak chi' sch'oxanel heb' tz'ab'an slolonel Dios, palta haxo sb'ey tiempo, tzijtum tas sna heb'. Sna sb'eyumal heb', sna heb' yuj yik sniwanil. Yuj wal juntzanh chi', tz'ixtaxel spensar heb'. Lajan tz'aj heb' icha ixim trigo max och sat.

Axo juntzanhxo ixim ix emkan b'aj ay syaxil sat lu'um chi' sch'oxanel heb' tz'ak'anoch jun lolonel chi' t'a sk'ool, sk'anab'ajan heb', tek'an syutej sb'a heb'. Aton heb' tik lajan yet' ixim trigo wach' sjolom syak'a'.

Ayic skak'anoch sk'ak'al ko kandil ¿tom ha t'a yol junok chen skak'emi, mato t'a yalanh te ch'at skak'ochi? Maay, palta t'a yib'anh junok tas chaanh yajk'ei, ata' skak'k'ei, yik wach' syil heb' tz'ochk'och t'a yol pat chi'.
Jantacnhej tas k'ub'anel tiknaik, ol cheklajelta yet' jantaknhej tas esalil ayeq'ui, ol ojtakajelok, ol cheklajelok.

Yuj chi' scham wal eyab'ani, yujto a mach snib'ej snachajel juntzanh tik yuj, ol ak'jok sjelanil yik sik'lab'il ol nachajel yuj. Axo mach malaj snib'ej snachajel juntzanh tik yuj jun, a jab'ok ijan ol nachajel yuj ol wach' ik'joquek' t'ay, xchi Jesús.
Ha ix snun Jesús yet' heb' yuk'tak ix k'och heb' b'aj ayeq'ui, palta max yal-laj sk'och heb' t'ay yujto manhxo jantakok anima.
Yuj chi' ix alchaj t'ay: --Ha ix a nun yet' heb' uk'tak wan yek' heb' ach say t'a ti pat chi', xchi heb'.
Palta ix yalan t'a heb' ayek' yet' chi': --Ha heb' tz'ab'an slolonel Dios, sk'anab'ajan heb', aton heb' chi' icha in nun, icha wuk'tak yaji, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
D'a junel ix och Jesús t'a yol jun barko yet' heb' sk'ayb'um, ix yalan t'a heb': --Koyec t'a sk'axepal ha' nhajab' tik, xchi. Ix b'at heb' b'ian.
Yakb'an wan sb'ey te', ix wayb'at Jesús chi'. Elanhchamel ix ja jun niwan ik', ix och ijan sb'ud'ji te' barko chi' yuj ha'. Ijan sb'at te' t'a yich ha'.

Axo heb' sk'ayb'um chi' ix pitzanel swayanh, ix yalan heb' t'ay: --Mamin, Mamin, wan ko b'at t'a yol ha', xchi heb' t'ay. Yuj chi' ix k'e waan, ix skachan jun ik' chi' yet' ha' sk'e chulan chi'. Ix numk'aj smasanil yuj.

Ichato chi' b'ian, ix yalan t'a heb' sk'ayb'um chi': --¿Tas yuj max eyak'och Dios t'a he k'ool? xchi t'a heb'. Toxonhej ix och k'elan heb', ix sat sk'ool heb', ix yalan heb': --¿Tas yaj jun winh tik? Scachji jun ik' tik yet' ha ha' tik yuj winh, ix k'anab'ajax winh yuj juntzanh tik, xchi heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix k'och heb' t'a yol yik Gerasa, t'a sk'axepalek' ha' nhajab' yik Galilea chi'.

Axo ix elta Jesús t'a yol te' barko chi' t'a sat lu'um, ix k'och jun winh ay t'a chonhab' chi' t'ay. Ayxo skajwi yixtaj winh yuj juntzanh heb' enemigo ayoch t'ay. Max yak'ochlaj spichul winh, max kanlaj wan winh t'a yol junok pat, axonhej b'aj mukan heb' chamnak ayek' winh.

Ayic ix yilan Jesús winh, ix em kuman winh t'a yichanh. Axo Jesús ix alan t'a heb' enemigo chi' to tz'el heb' t'a winh. Yuj chi' ix awajk'e winh, ix yalan winh t'a Jesús: --Ach Jesús, Yuninal ach Dios Niwan Yelk'ochi, ¿tas alan ik t'ayin? Tzin tewi t'ayach, manh in ixtej, xchi winh t'ay. Tzijtum elxo syamchaj winh yuj heb' enemigo chi', yuj chi' stzek'ji winh t'a k'een kadena yuj heb' anima, tz'och k'een t'a yok winh yet' t'a sk'ab' winh. Palta sd'inhchitejb'at k'een winh. Ix ik'jib'at winh yuj heb' enemigo chi' b'aj malaj anima.
Ix sk'anb'an Jesús t'a winh: --¿Tas a b'i? xchi. --Legión in b'i, xchi winh. Ix yal jun chi' winh yujto tzijtum heb' enemigo chuk ayoch t'a winh.
Axo juntzanh heb' enemigo chi', ix tewioch heb' t'a Jesús: Manh onh ak'b'at t'a jun xab' olan, xchi heb'.
Ay juntzanh nok' tzijtumal chitam wan swa t'a jun tzalan. Ix tewi heb' enemigo chi' t'a Jesús to tz'ak'jib'at heb' t'a nok'. Ix schaanb'at heb'.
Ix elkan juntzanh enemigo chi' t'a winh, ix b'atkan heb' t'a nok' chitam chi'. Axo nok' chitam chi' ix b'at nok' t'a jun chaanh, ix emk'och nok' t'a yol ha' nhajab', ix sjik' ha' nok', ix cham nok'.
Axo ix yilan heb' tanhwum chitam chi' tas ix uji, ix b'at lemnaj heb' yal t'a heb' anima ay t'a chonhab' chi' yet' t'a heb' ayb'at munlajel.

Yuj chi' ix kot heb' anima yila' tas ix uji. Ayic ix k'och heb' b'aj ayek' Jesús, ix yilan heb' to ayek' jun winh b'aj ix el juntzanh enemigo chi', k'ojanem winh t'a yichanh Jesús. Ayxo och spichul winh, wach'xo spensar winh. Ix te xiwb'at heb' yilani.
Ha heb' ix ilan chi', ix laj yalan heb' chajtil ix aj sb'oxi sk'ol winh b'aj ix el juntzanh enemigo chi'.
Ix och ijan masanil heb' anima aj Gerasa chi' yalan t'a Jesús to tz'el b'aj ay heb' chi', yujto te xiwnak heb' yuj. Yuj chi' ix ochxi t'a yol te' barko chi' yik spaxi.
Ix yal winh b'aj ix el heb' enemigo chi' t'a Jesús to sb'at winh yet'ok, palta maj schab'atlaj winh.
--Paxanh t'a a pat, ixik, al masanil tas ix sb'o Dios t'ayach, xchi Jesús t'a winh. Ix b'at winh, ix laj yalan winh t'a masanil heb' anima tas ix utaj yuj Jesús.
Ayic ix k'ochxi Jesús t'a sk'axepal ha' nhajab' chi', ix chaji yuj heb' anima smasanil t'a tzalajk'olal, yujto tanhwab'il yuj heb' smasanil.
Ix ja jun winh skuch Jairo, winh yajal yaj t'a spatil kulto ta'. Ix em kuman winh t'a yichanh Jesús chi', ix sk'anan winh t'ay to sb'at yet'ok t'a spat,
yujto ay jun pitanh yisil winh wan schami, slajchawil ab'il sk'inal ix. Ayic wan sb'at Jesús, tzijtum anima ix b'at yet'ok, yuj chi' ix te witz'k'aji.
D'a skal heb', ay jun ix slajchawilxo ab'il penaay yuj jun ha' tz'el t'a sniwanil. Ix lajwiel masanil tastak ay t'a ix, yik stupan heb' tz'anhtani, palta max b'olaj ix.
Ix snitzankot sb'a ix t'a stz'ey Jesús, ix syaman sti' spichul ix. D'a jun rato chi' ix b'o jun syaelal ix chi'.

Ix sk'anb'an Jesús: --¿Mach tzin yaman chi'? xchi. Yujto masanil heb' tz'alani to manhoklaj heb', yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Pedro: --Mamin, a heb' anima, tzach yek tik tzach yek tik heb', tzalanpaxi: ¿Mach tzin yamani? xa chi, xchi winh t'ay.
--Ay jun mach ix in yamani, yujto ix wab' sb'oxi sk'ool jun anima chi' yuj in poder, xchi Jesús chi'.

Ayic ix yilan jun ix ix chi' to ix cheklajelta tas ix sk'ulej ix chi', ix k'och ix t'a yichanh Jesús, sluklon ix yuj xiwelal, ix em kuman ix t'ay. Ix yalan ix t'a yichanh heb' smasanil tas yuj ix syam spichul chi' ix, ix yalan ix tas ix aj sb'oxi ix t'a jun rato chi'.
Yuj chi' ix yalan Jesús t'a ix: --Ach ix, yujto in ak'och t'a a k'ool, ach b'oxi. Junk'olal a paxi, xchi t'a ix.
Vanto yalan t'a ix, ix k'och jun spetoj t'a spat winhaj Jairo chi', ix yalani: --Ha ix isil chi' toxo ix cham ix. ¿Tasto yuj tza tzuntzej winh ko k'ayb'umal tik? xchi winh.
Ayic ix yab'an jun chi' Jesús, ix yalan t'a winhaj Jairo chi': --Manh ach xiwok, anhej to tzak'och Dios t'a a k'ool, a ix isil chi' ol b'oxok sk'ool ix, xchi t'a winh.
Axo yik ix k'och Jesús chi' t'a spat winh, malaj mach ix chajiochi, anhej winhaj Pedro, winhaj Jacobo, winhaj Juan yet' smam snun ix unin chi'.
Tzijtum heb' anima tz'ok' yuj ix. Axo ix yalan Jesús t'a heb': --Manh ex ok'ok. Manh chamnakoklaj ix, tonhej waynak ix, xchi t'a heb'.
Ix tzetzaj yuj heb', yujto ix yil heb' to toxo ix cham ix.
Axo Jesús ix yaman sk'ab' ix, te chaanh ix yala': --Ach kob'es unin, k'eanh waan, xchi.
Ix pitzwixi ix t'a elanhchamel, ix k'e wan ix. Axo Jesús ix alani to tz'ak'ji wa ix.
Axo heb' smam snun ix chi', ix te satb'at sk'ol heb', palta ix yalan Jesús t'a heb' to malaj junok mach b'aj syal heb' tas ix aj spitzwixi ix.
Ha Jesús ix molb'an heb' lajchawanh sk'ayb'um, ix yak'an yopisio heb' yik'anel masanil makanhil enemigo yet' pax yak'an b'oxok sk'ol heb' penaay heb'.
Ix chekjib'at heb' yaleli chajtil tz'aj yoch heb' anima t'a yol sk'ab' Dios yet' yak'an b'oxok sk'ool heb' penaay heb'.
Ix yalan t'a heb': --Malaj tas tzeyik'b'at yikok yol he b'e, manh eyik'b'at he k'okoch, he pa, he yooch yet' he tumin. Anhej he pichul ayoch eyuj tzeyik'b'ati.
Yalnhej b'aj ay junok pat b'aj tzex chaji, ata' tzex kani, masanto tzex b'at t'a junokxo chonhab'.
Tato max ex chaji t'a junok chonhab', tzex el ta', tze tzikankanel spokokal eyok yik tze ch'oxankaneli to manhxa eyalan eyik t'a heb', xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Ix b'at heb', ix ek' heb' t'a junjun chonhab', ix yalanel yab'ixal kolnab'il heb', ix b'oxikan sk'ool heb' penaay yuj heb' t'a junjun lugar.
Ayic ix yab'an winhaj Herodes ayoch yajalil tastak sk'ulej Jesús, tonhej ix te sat sk'ol winh, yujto ay heb' ix alani to a winhaj Juan ix pitzwixi.
Ay juntzanhxo heb' ix alani: Aton winhaj Elías tzul sch'ox sb'a, xchi heb'. Anhejtona' ay heb' ix alanxi: Aton jun schekab' Dios ek'nak t'a peka' ix pitzwixi t'a skal heb' chamnak, xchi heb'.
Palta ix yalan winhaj Herodes chi' icha tik: --Ha in tik in cheknak ik'joquel sjolom winhaj Juan chi'. ¿Mach jun winh swab' yalji chi' jun? xchi winh. Snib'ej winhaj Herodes chi' yilan Jesús.
Ayic ix jax heb' schekab' Jesús b'aj ix xid'ek' chi', ix yalan heb' t'ay tastak ix sk'ulej heb'. Ix yik'anel heb' schekab' chi' t'a skal heb' anima, ix b'at heb' t'a slak'anil chonhab' Betsaida.

Axo ix yab'an heb' anima to ata' ayek' Jesús chi', ix och tzak'an heb' yuj. Ayic ix k'och heb', ix chaji heb' yuj. Ix och ijan yalan t'a heb' tas tz'aj yoch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' Dios, ix laj b'oxipax sk'ol heb' penaay yuj.

Ayic ix yilan heb' lajchawanh sk'ayb'um chi' to wan yem k'u, ix yalan heb' t'ay: --Chec pax heb' anima tik yik syik' yip heb', b'atokab' heb' sman wa sb'ha t'a juntzanh chonhab' yet' t'a juntzanh lugar ay t'a ko lak'anil tik, yujto malaj tas swa heb' b'aj ayonh ek' tik, xchi heb'.
Axo Jesús ix alan t'a heb': --Hak'ek wa heb' a ex tik, xchi t'a heb'. --Oyexonhej ixim pan qued'nak yet' chawanh nok' chay. ¿Tom tzonh b'at ko man wa heb' anima tik smasanil? xchi heb'.
Ay am junok oye' mil heb' winh winak ayek' chi' ta'. Axo Jesús ix alan t'a heb' sk'ayb'um chi': --Chequec em k'ojan heb'. 50 tak tz'aj junjun makan heb', xchi.
Icha chi' ix yutej heb', ix em k'ojan heb' smasanil.

Axo Jesús ix ik'anchaanh oye' ixim pan yet' chawanh nok' chay chi'. Ix k'e k'elan t'a satcha’anh ix yak'an yuj diosal yuj ixim. Ix xepanb'at ixim. Ix yak'anb'at t'a heb' sk'ayb'um chi'. Axo heb' ix pukanb'at t'a heb' anima chi'.
Ix wa heb' smasanil, ix laj b'ud'ji heb'. Ixlajwi chi', ix sik'ank'e wan lajchawexo xuuk ixim ix yak' sobre heb' sk'ayb'um chi'.
Ha junel, wan yak'an lesal Jesús b'aj malaj heb' anima, ayek' heb' sk'ayb'um yet'ok, ix sk'anb'an t'a heb': --¿Mach in yalan heb' anima tzeyab'i? xchi t'a heb'.

--Ay heb' tz'alani to a ach Juan ach, winh ak'jinak bautizar. Ay pax heb' tz'alani to Elías ach. Anhejtona' ay heb' tz'alanpaxi to a ach junok schekab' Dios ek'nak t'a peka' pitzwinakxi, xchi heb' sk'ayb'um chi'.
Xal ex pax tik, ¿mach in he naani? xchi Jesús t'a heb'. Axo winhaj Pedro ix alani: --Ha ach ton tik Cristo ach, a ach ton Ak'b'il ach kot yuj Dios, xchi winh.
Ix cham wal yalan Jesús t'a heb' to malaj b'aj syalel jun chi' heb'. Ix yalanpax icha tik t'a heb':

--Ha in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, yowalil ol wab' syaelal, ol in spatiquejel heb' ichamtak winak yet' heb' yajal heb' sakerdote yet' heb' k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés. Ol in smilancham heb', haxo t'a schab'jial ol in pitzwokxi, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalanxi t'a heb' smasanil: --Tato ay heb' snib'ej tz'och in k'ayb'umok, manhxookab' yikok sb'a heb', sb'ekokab' sb'a heb' scham wuuj t'a junjun k'u, wach'chom t'a te' kulus. Tato icha chi', tz'och heb' in k'ayb'umok.
Yujto a heb' snib'ej skol sb'ha t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, ol satel sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej. Palta haxo heb' syak'cham sb'a wuuj, aton heb' chi' ol scha sk'inal t'a junelnhej.
Q'uinalok tato squiquej masanil tas ay t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, palta tato tzonh satkanel t'a junelnhej ¿tas ko ganar?

Tato ay heb' sq'uixwi wuuj, tato sq'uixwi pax heb' yuj in lolonel, anhejtona' a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik ol in q'uixwok pax yuj heb', a ol in jawok woch Reyal yet' in tziquiquial, aton stziquiquial in Mam yet' pax heb' ángel yiknhej yaji.
Val yel swal t'ayex, ay jaywanh ex t'a he kal tik, manh ol ex chamlaj masanto ol eyil yoch Dios Yajalil t'a yel.
Ukub'ixitax chi', ix k'ek'och Jesús t'a jun tzalan yak' lesal. Ha winhaj Pedro, winhaj Jacobo yet' winhaj Juan ix b'at yet'ok.
Yakb'an wan slesalwi, ix k'exmaj yilji sat yet' spichul. Ix te sakb'i, toxonhej ix tziquiqui.
Ay chawanh winak ix sch'ox sb'a yet'ok, aton winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Elías. Ix lolon heb' yet'ok.
Ix yalan heb' tas ol aj yelk'och schamel t'a Jerusalén. D'a spatik yichanh heb' toxonhej skopopi yuj sakil k'inal chi'.
Te aykan swayanh winhaj Pedro chi' yet' heb' ajun yet' chi', palta maj wayb'atlaj heb'. Yuj chi' ix yil wal stziquiquial Jesús chi' heb' yet' heb' chawanh ayek' yet' chi'.

Vanxo satxik'e heb' chawanh chi', ix yalan winhaj Pedro chi' t'ay: --Mamin, te wach' kajek' t'a tik. Co b'o oxeok lechpat, jun iko', jun yik winhaj Moisés yet' pax junok yik winhaj Elías, xchi winh. Palta manh yojtakok winh tas wan yalani.
Yakb'an wan yalan winh chi', ix ja jun asun, ix em moynaj t'a yib'anh heb', ix xiwk'e heb' sk'ayb'um Jesús chi' t'a skal.
Ixlajwi chi', ix ab'chaj jun lolonel t'a skal asun chi', ix yalani: --Aton jun tik Vuninal, sik'b'ilel wuuj. Hak'ek och he chiquin t'a tas syala', xchi jun lolonel chi'.
Ayic ix lajwi yab'an jun chi' heb' sk'ayb'um chi', ix yilan heb', axonhej Jesús ayek' sch'okoj. Malaj mach b'aj ix yal heb' tas ix yil heb' t'a jun tzalan chi'.
Axo t'a junxo k'u, ix paxta heb' t'a jun tzalan chi'. Tzijtum anima ix jawi scha Jesús.
Ay jun winh t'a skal heb' te chaanh ix yala': --Mamin, tzin k'an t'ayach, il jun wunin tik in k'ana', yujto jun pitannhej.
Ay b'aj tz'och jun enemigo t'ay, tz'el yaw, skot numnaj t'a sjolom, swoman sti'. Tz'ixtaj winh yuj, max el-laj jab'ok t'ay.
Tzin tewi wal t'a heb' a k'ayb'um yik syik'el heb', palta max ujilaj yik'anel heb', xchi winh t'a Jesús chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yalanxi Jesús: --Ha ex tik, manh jab'ok tzeyak'och Dios t'a he k'ool, te pit ex. Ina ayxo tiempo ayinek' eyed'ok. ¿B'aq'uinh wal ol nachajel eyuuj? Swab' wal syail eyuuj. B'at ik'kot winh uninal chi' t'ayin, xchi.

Ayic wanxo slak'anb'ik'och jun unin chi' t'a Jesús, haxo jun enemigo chi' ix yumanxi telwok, ix kot numnaj t'a sjolom. Ix stuman jun enemigo chi' Jesús, ix b'oxi sk'ol winh unin chi' yuj, ix yak'anxi t'a winh smam chi'.
Ix sat sk'ol heb' smasanil, yujto te niwan spoder Dios ix yil heb'. Yakb'an satnak sk'ol heb' yuj tas ix sk'ulej chi', ix yalan Jesús chi' t'a heb' sk'ayb'um:
--Scham wal eyab'an jun tik, manh eyak' sat he k'ool t'ay. Ha in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, ol in ak'jok och t'a yol sk'ab' heb' anima, xchi.
Palta maj nachajel-laj yuj heb' tas ix yal chi', yujto maj ak'jilaj nachajel yuj heb'. Ix xiw heb' sk'anb'an t'ay tas syalelk'och jun ix yal chi'.
Ix och ijan heb' sk'ayb'um stelan sb'a mach junok heb' niwan yelk'ochi.
Palta yojtak Jesús tas wan snaan heb', yuj chi' ix yik'kot jun unin, ix yak'anoch t'a stz'ey.

Ix yalan t'a heb' sk'ayb'um chi': --Ha mach schaan jun unin tik, yujto wiko', a in tzin scha'a. Ha mach tzin chaani, a jun chekjinak in koti, a scha'a. Ha junok mach malaj yelk'och t'a he kal, a jun chi' te niwan yelk'ochi, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj Juan t'a Jesús: --Mamin, ay jun winh ix quila', wan yak'lab'an a b'i winh yik'anel heb' enemigo t'a heb' anima. Ix ko kach winh yujto manh junnhejok tzek' winh qued'ok, xchi winh.
--Manh he kach winh, yujto a heb' manh ajk'olok t'ayonh, qued' ayoch heb', xchi Jesús t'a heb' winh.
Ayic wan sk'och stiempoal spax Jesús t'a satcha’anh, tek'tek' ix yutej sb'a sb'at t'a Jerusalén.
Ix sb'ab'laj chequejb'at heb' schekab', yik b'at saychaj sposado heb' t'a jun aldea ay t'a yol yik Samaria.
Axo heb' aj Samaria chi' maj chaanlaj, yujto ix yil heb' to wan sb'at t'a Jerusalén.

Ayic ix yab'an jun chi' heb' sk'ayb'um, aton winhaj Jacobo yet' winhaj Juan, ix yalan heb' t'ay: --Mamin, ¿mama a gana sko k'ankot k'ak' t'a satcha’anh yik stz'ab'at juntzanh anima tik? xchi heb' winh.
Axo Jesús ix och k'elan t'a heb' winh, ix skachan heb' winh. Ichato chi' ix b'at heb' t'a junxo chonhab'.
Ayic wan sb'at heb' t'a yol b'e, ix yalan jun winh t'a Jesús: --Mamin, yalnhej b'aj ol ach b'atok, ol in b'at ed'ok, xchi winh t'ay. Ix yalan Jesús t'a winh:
--Ha nok' waax ay snhak'een nok' yet' pax nok' much ay so' nok'. Palta a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, malaj in pat b'aj tzin wayi, xchi t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalanpax t'a junxo winh: --Ochanh in k'ayb'umok, xchi t'a winh. Palta ix yalan winh t'ay: --Mamin, ak' in permiso, ato yik ol cham winh in mam, ato ta' ol in b'at ed'ok, xchi winh t'ay.
--Ha heb' chamnakto t'a yichanh Dios, a heb' syal smukan heb' yetchamnaquil chi', palta a ach tik, ixik b'at aleli chajtil tz'aj yoch heb' anima t'a yol sk'ab' Dios, xchi t'a winh.
Icha pax chi' ix yal junxo winh: --Mamin, in gana tzin och a k'ayb'umok, palta in gana b'ab'el tzak' in permiso sb'at in tak'ankan in b'ha t'a heb' ay t'a in pat, xchi winh.

Palta ix yalanpax t'a winh: --Q'uinalok ay junok winh winak smunlaj yet' nok' wakax, syamem sd'oklab' lum nok', slajwi chi', smeltzajxi b'at k'elan winh t'a spatik. Tato ay heb' icha chi' yaj spensar, malaj jab'ok yopisio heb' t'a yol sk'ab' Dios, xchi Jesús.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an yopisio juntzanhxo heb' sk'ayb'um Jesús, 72 sb'isul heb'. Ix sb'ab'laj chekanb'at heb'. Chatacwanhil ix aj sb'at heb' t'a junjun chonhab', t'a junjun lugar b'aj ol ek' pax Jesús chi'.

Ayic manto b'at heb', ix yalan t'a heb': --Ha heb' anima tik, lajanxo heb' icha ixim trigo stiempoalxo sjochchaji. Val yel niwanto heb', palta jaywannhej mach smunlaj t'a skal heb'. Yuj chi', lesalwanhek t'a jun aj munlajel chi', yik ol schekb'at heb' smunlajwum b'at yik'chaanh heb'.
Ixiquec a ex tik. Icha tz'aj sb'at nok' kalnel t'a skal nok' oques, icha chi' tz'aj ex in chekanb'ati.
Manh eyik'b'at he pa, yet'tal he tumin yet' pax he xanhab'. Manh ex och linhan lolonel yet' heb' anima tze cha t'a yoltak b'e.
Ayic tzex k'och t'a junok pat, tzeyak'an stzatzil sk'ol heb' icha tik: Ayokab' junk'olal t'a yol he pat tik, xe chi t'a heb'.
Tato ay heb' snib'an junk'olal chi', ol ak'jok t'a heb' icha tz'aj eyalan chi'. Tato max snib'ej heb' jun, manh ol elk'ochlaj icha tzeyal chi' t'a heb'.
Anhej t'a jun pat chi' tzeyak' he posado. Ha tas swa heb' tze wa yet' heb', yujto a mach smunlaji, smoj schaan stojol. Max yal tonhej tzex b'eyek' t'a kaltak pat.
Ayic tzex k'och t'a junjun chonhab' b'aj tzex chaji, tze wanhej tas syak' heb' t'ayex.
Tzeyak' b'oxok sk'ol heb' penaay b'aj tzex k'och chi', tzeyalan t'a heb': Stiempoalxo eyoch t'a yol sk'ab' Dios, xe chi t'a heb'.
Tato max ex chaji t'a junok chonhab' b'aj tzex k'ochi, tzex ek' t'a yoltak kalle, tzeyalan icha tik:
Ha spokokal jun he chonhab' tik ix kan t'a kok, sko tzikkaneli, sko ch'oxankaneli to manhxa kalan quik t'ayex. Palta nachajokab'el eyuuj to stiempoalxo eyoch t'a yol sk'ab' Dios, xe chi t'a heb'.
Ha in tik swal t'ayex to ayik ol ja sk'ual yik ol ch'olb'itaj heb' anima, más niwan syaelal jun chonhab' chi' ol ak'jok t'a yichanh heb' aj Sodoma.

Ha ex wal tik ex aj Corazín yet' ex ex aj Betsaida, te chuk eyiko'. Octom t'a chonhab' Tiro yet' t'a chonhab' Sidón b'ob'il juntzanh milagro icha ix in b'o t'a he kal tik. Tato icha chi', pekataxom snanak sb'a heb' ay t'a chonhab' chi'. Yak'nak am och juntzanh spichul heb' ya swa'i, yak'nak am k'e k'een tik'aq'uil taanh heb' t'a sjolom, yik scheklaji to skus heb' yuj smul.
Palta ha t'a sk'ual yik ol ch'olb'itaj heb' anima, ek'al yaelal ol ak'jokoch t'a eyib'anh t'a yichanh heb' aj Tiro yet' heb' aj Sidón chi'.
Anhejtona' ex pax tik ex aj Capernaum, ¿tom tze na to ol eyik'chaanh he b'a? Swal t'ayex to ol ex lajwoquelok.

Xal ex in k'ayb'um ex, a heb' ol chaan yab' t'ayex, syalelk'ochi, a t'ayin ol scha yab' heb'. Ha heb' tzex patikaneli, syalelk'ochi, a in tzin spatiquejel heb'. Ha heb' tzin patikanel chi', a jun chekjinak in koti, a spatiquejel heb', xchi Jesús t'a heb' sk'ayb'um chi'.
Ix jax heb' 72 t'a tzalajk'olal, ix yalan heb': --Mamin, a heb' enemigo ix sk'anab'ajej heb' tas ix kala' ayik ix kak'lab'an a b'i, xchi heb'.
Ix yalan Jesús t'a heb': --Ha in tik wilnak tas ajnak skot winh Satanás t'a satcha’anh yemnak ul winh t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, icha yek' kopnaj lheb'lon ayik sk'anh k'u.
Ha in tik swak' eyopisio yik syal eyem tek'tek' t'a yib'anh nok' chan yet' nok' sinaan, yik tzeyak'an ganar t'a yib'anh jantaknhej yipalil winh eyajk'ool. Malaj junok tas syal ex yixtani.
Manh yujok to tzex sk'anab'ajej heb' enemigo tzex tzalaji, palta tzalajanhek yujto tz'ib'ab'ilxo he b'i t'a satcha’anh, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.

Ha t'a jun rato chi', a Jesús ix te tzalaj yuj Yespíritu Dios, ix yalani: --Mamin, a ach Yajal ach t'a satcha’anh yet' t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, swal wach' lolonel t'ayach, yujto ix a k'ub'ejel juntzanh tik t'a heb' jelan yet' t'a heb' ek'al spensar t'a yichanh heb' yetanimail. Axo t'a heb' emnaquil syutej sb'a icha unin ix ak' ojtakajelok. Icha chi' ix utej Mamin, yujto icha chi' ix el t'a a k'ool, xchi Jesús t'a slesal.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan t'a heb' anima ayek' ta': --Ha in Mam ak'jinak masanil tastak t'a yol in k'ab'. Malaj mach ojtannak in a in Yuninal in tik. Anhej in Mam chi' ojtannak in. Anheja', malaj mach ojtannak in Mam chi', a innhej Yuninal in wojtak yet' heb' in gana swak' yojtaquejeli, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix ek' k'elelok t'a heb' sk'ayb'um, ix yalan t'a heb' icha tik: --Wach' yik heb' tz'ilan juntzanh tzeyil tik.

Val yel swal t'ayex to tzijtum heb' schekab' Dios t'a peka' yet' heb' rey snib'ejnak yil jun wan eyilan tik, palta manh yilnakoklaj heb'. Anhejtona' jun wan eyab'an tik, snib'ej heb' yab'nak, palta manh yab'nakoklaj heb', xchi t'a heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ay jun winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés ix k'e linhan. Ix snib'ej winh ix yak' prowal Jesús, yuj chi' ix sk'anb'ej winh t'ay: --Ach ko k'ayb'umal, ¿tas ol aj in chaan in k 'inal t'a junelnhej? xchi winh.
--¿Tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a ley Moisés? ¿Tas xchi ayik tzawtan yab' heb' anima? xchi Jesús chi' t'a winh.

--Syal icha tik: Tze xajanej Kajal ko Diosal t'a smasanil he k'ool, t'a smasanil he pixan, t'a smasanil eyip, t'a smasanil he pensar. Icha eya'ilan he b'a, ichaokab' chi' he xajanan heb' ay t'a spatik schiquin he pat, xchi winh t'a Jesús.
--Wach' ix utej alani, tato icha chi' tzutej a b'a, ol a cha a k 'inal t'a junelnhej, xchi Jesús t'a winh.
Palta a winh, snib'ej winh skol sb'a t'ay, yik max kan winh t'a q'uixwelal, yuj chi' ix yalanxi winh t'a Jesús: --¿Mach heb' yowalil tzin xajanej chi' syal chi'? xchi winh t'ay.

Yuj chi' ix yalxi jun ab'ix tik Jesús t'a winh: --Ha junel ay jun winh wan sb'ey t'a jun b'e skot t'a Jerusalén sk'och t'a Jericó. Ix yamji winh yuj juntzanh heb' elk'um. Ix laj elk'ajel tastak yet'nak winh yet' spichul winh. Ix mak'ji wekchaj winh, ijan ix cham winh smak'an heb'.
Axo ix ek' jun winh sakerdote t'a jun b'e chi', tonhej ix b'atkan k'elan winh t'a winh, b'enhej ix ek'b'at winh.
Ix k'ochpax jun winh yinhtilal Leví, haxo ix yilanb'at winh ix mak'ji wekchaj chi' winh, ix sk'exb'ean sb'a winh t'a winh, ix ek'b'at winh.
Palta ix ek'pax jun winh aj Samaria ta'. Ayic ix yilan winh, ix ok' sk'ool winh t'a winh.

Ix k'och winh t'a stz'ey winh, ix yanhtan winh, ix yak'anoch akeite winh yet' wino b'ajtak ix lajwi chi'. Ix sb'ak'an winh. Ix yak'ank'e winh t'a yib'anh schej, ix yik'anb'at winh b'aj ay posado, ix stanhwan winh ta'.

Axo t'a junxo k'u, ix yak'anelta chab' tumin winh t'a winh ay yik posado chi', ix yalan winh: Tzil wal janik' jun winh penaay tik. Tato niwan tza laj yuj winh, ol in tup t'ayach a ol in jax junelxo, xchikan winh.
Yuj chi' tzin k'anb'ej t'ayach, ¿mach junok heb' winh oxwanh tik yetanimail sb'a yet' winh ix yamji yuj heb' elk'um chi' tza na'a? xchi Jesús t'a winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés chi'.
--Aton winh ix ok' sk'ool chi' t'a winh, xchi winh t'a Jesús. --Yel, atoni. Yuj chi', ixik, icha chi' tzutej a b'a, xchi Jesús t'a winh.
Axo ix b'at Jesús t'a yol b'e, ix k'och t'a jun aldea. Ata' ay jun ix skuch Marta. Ix schaanoch Jesús chi' ix t'a yol spat.
Ay pax junxo ix snulej ix skuchan María. Ha ix María chi', ix em k'ojan ix t'a yichanh Jesús yik syab' ix tas syala'.

Axo ix Marta chi', manh jantakok tas sk'ulej ix, ix k'och ix t'a Jesús chi', ix yalan ix: --Mamin, ¿tom max il jab'ok, to a ix in nulej tik, in yaktejkan ix t'a yol sk'ab' in munlajel tik in ch'okoj? Al t'a ix to skolwaj ix wed'ok, xchi ix.
Ix yalan Jesús t'a ix: --Marta, Marta, te ay ach och t'a ilk'olal yuj jantak tas tza k'ulej chi'.
Palta junnhej wal tas te yowalil sk'ulaji, aton jun chi' snib'ej ix María tik, yuj chi' malaj junok mach ol yal yik'anek' t'a ix, xchi t'a ix.

Ha junel wan slesalwi Jesús t'a jun lugar. Axo ix lajwi slesalwi, ix yalan jun sk'ayb'um t'ay: --Mamin, ¿tom max onh a k'ayb'ej t'a lesal icha ix yutej winhaj Juan sk'ayb'an heb' sk'ayb'um? xchi winh t'ay.
Yuj chi' ix yalan Jesús t'a heb': --Icha tik tzeyutej he lesalwi: Ach ko Mam, niwanokab' elk'och t'a yichanh heb' anima. Ach ochokab' Yajalil t'a tik.
Ak' tas sko wa yet' tas tz'och kuj t'a junjun k'u.
Ak' lajwok ko mul, yujto a onh tik skak' niwank'olal heb' tz'och smul t'ayonh. Manh onh a cha ak'jok prowal, xe chi, xchi Jesús.
Ix yalanxi Jesús chi' t'a heb': --Q'uinalok ayex tzex k'och t'a junok eyamigo t'a chimilak'wal, tzeyalani: Ach wetanimail, k'eanh waan, ak' in k'ex jayeok ooch,
yujto ay jun wamigo toto ix jawi b'aj ix xid'eq'ui, malaj tas swak' t'ay, xe chi.
Tato tonhej stak'wielta t'ayex: Manh in a tzuntzejoch ta. Macanxo in pat, waynak inxo yet' heb' unin. Max yal-laj in k'e wan wak' t'ayach, ta xchi.
Swal t'ayex, manh yujok to yamigo ex sk'e waan yak' t'ayex, palta yujto aw tzeyak'och t'ay syab'i syak' t'ayex jantak tas tze k'an t'ay yik maxtzak he tzuntzej.
Yuj chi' swal t'ayex: k'anek, ha Dios ol ak'an t'ayex. Sayec, ol ilchaj eyuuj. Awajanhec och t'a ti' puerta, ol jakjok te' t'ayex.
Yujto a mach sk'anani, scha'a. Ha heb' sayani, tz'ilchaj yuj heb'. Anhejtona' heb' tz'awajoch t'a ti' puerta, sjakchaj te' t'a heb'.
Ha ex mamab'il ex, tato a junok eyuninal sk'anan junok nok' chay t'ayex, ¿tom a junok nok' chan tzeyak' t'ay?
Ta a junok nok' nholob' sk'an t'ayex, ¿tom a junok nok' sinaan tzeyak' t'ay?
Ha ex tik eyojtak eyak'an jab'ok tas wach' t'a heb' eyuninal wach'chom chuk ex. Ocxom pax ko Mam ay t'a satcha’anh, ol yak' Yespíritu t'a heb' sk'anan t'ay, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.

Ha junel ay jun winh ayoch jun enemigo max uji slolon t'ay, yuj chi' max ujipaxlaj slolon winh yuj. Axo Jesús ix ik'anel jun enemigo chi' t'a winh. Ichato chi' ix lolonk'e winh. Ix sat sk'ol heb' anima yuj jun chi'.
Palta ay heb' ix alani: --Ha jun winh tik syal yik'anel heb' enemigo winh yujto a winh Beelzebú yajalil heb' enemigo ayoch yet' winh, xchi heb'.
Ay juntzanhxo heb' snib'ej yak'an prowal Jesús. Yuj chi' ix sk'an yil junok milagro heb' sch'oxan spoder Dios.

Palta yojtakxo Jesús tas wan snaan heb', yuj chi' ix yalan t'a heb': --Q'uinalok ay junok nakión spoj sb'a heb' yajal t'ay, syak'an owal heb'. Tato icha chi', tz'ixtaxel snakión heb' chi'. Q'uinalok ay junok patil heb' anima spoj sb'a yuj owal. Tato icha chi' sjuwiel jun patil heb' chi'.
Icha chi' yaj winh Satanás, tato spoj sb'a winh t'a yol yiko', ¿tom ol najtilax yopisio winh? Ha jun tik swal t'ayex, yujto a ex tik tzeyala' to swik'el heb' enemigo yuj spoder Beelzebú.
Palta tato icha chi', ¿mach ayoch yet' heb' he k'ayb'umal chi' ayik spechanel heb' enemigo heb'? Yuj chi' anheja' heb' he k'ayb'umal chi' sch'oxanel he paltail.
Palta yujnhej spoder Dios tzin pechel heb' enemigo chi', yuj chi' scheklaji to toxo ix syamoch Dios yak'an Yajalil t'a he kal.
Q'uinalok ay junok winh winak te ay yip, ay syamk'ab' winh yik stanhwej spat, manh komonok syal yik'jielta sk'ael winh.

Palta tato sk'och junokxo mach ek'al yip t'a winh, tato tz'ak'ji ganar winh yuj, tz'ik'jiek' jantak syamk'ab' winh ayoch yipok sk'ool chi' yet' pax masanil tas ay t'a winh. Snaan winh tas syutej juntzanh syik'ek' chi'. Icha winh aj pat chi', icha chi' yaj winh diablo.
Ha heb' manh ayokoch wed'ok, ajk'ool heb' t'ayin. Ha heb' max molb'ankot heb' anima wed'ok, a heb' spechan saklem heb' anima chi'.
Q'uinalok ay junok enemigo tz'el t'a junok anima tiknaik, tzek' t'a tzinan lu'um, sayan b'aj syik' yip. Palta max ilchaj yuj. Yuj chi' snaan icha tik: Ol in pax t'a in pat b'aj kotnak in, xchi.
Axo yik sk'ochxi, syilan spixan jun anima chi', icha junok pat mesb'il yool, wach' yilji.

Yuj chi' sb'atxi, sb'at yik'ankot ukwanhokxo heb' enemigo másto chuk t'a yichanh. Swach' och kajan heb' smasanil t'a jun anima chi'. Yuj chi', ste juwiel jun anima chi' icha t'a sb'ab'elal, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Yakb'an a Jesús wan yalan juntzanh chi', ay jun ix ix, ix awajk'e t'a skal heb' anima, ix yalan ix: --Te wach' yik jun ix ix b'aj ach alji, b'aj ach chuni, xchi ix t'a Jesús.
Axo ix yalan Jesús chi' t'a ix: --Más wach' yik heb' tz'ab'an tas syal Dios, sk'anab'ajan heb', xchi.

Tzijtum anima ix och oyan t'a spatik Jesús. Ix yalan t'a heb': --Ha wal heb' anima t'a jun pekti’ tik, te chuk heb'. Yuj chi' tonhej sk'an yil junok milagro heb', junok sch'oxan spoder Dios. Palta anhej jun milagro ol ch'oxjok yil heb', aton jun icha sch'oxnak Dios yet' winh schekab' skuchan Jonás.
Yujto a winhaj Jonás chi' ch'oxannaquel spoder Dios t'a heb' ay t'a chonhab' Níniwe t'a peka'. Icha chi' waj a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, yik tzin ch'oxel spoder Dios t'a he kal.

Ayic ol ja sk'ual sch'olb'itaj heb' anima, a jun ix yajal t'a Sur t'a peka', ol k'e waan ix, ol yalan he mul ix, yujto najat kotnak ix yab'i jantak sjelanil winhaj Salomón. Ha t'a tik, ay jun ek'al yopisio t'a yichanh winhaj Salomón chi', palta max kotlaj heb' anima smaklej yab' t'ay.

Ha heb' aj Níniwe chi', snanak sb'a heb' yuj tas yalnak winhaj Jonás chi'. Axo t'a tik ay jun ek'al yopisio t'a yichanh winhaj Jonás chi', palta max he na he b'a. Yuj chi', ayik ol ja sk'ual sch'olb'itaj heb' anima, a heb' aj Níniwe chi', ol k'e waan heb', ol yalan he mul heb'.
Ayic skak'anoch sk'ak'al ko kandil, max kak'kan b'aj manh chequelok, max kak' pax och t'a yalanh junok tasi. Palta chaanh skak'k'ei, yik wach' syil heb' tz'och t'a yol pat chi'.

Ha yol ko sat, icha yaj kandil yaj t'a ko niwanil. Yuj chi' tato junnhej b'aj ayoch ko sat, sakil k'inal kaji, wach' skutej ko b'a yet' ko niwanil. Palta tato ch'okch'ok b'aj skak'och ko sat, tzonh kan t'a kal k’ik’ k’inal yuj.
Tzeyil wal he b'a, yik wach' a jun sakil k'inal ayoch t'ayex, max meltzajxioch k'ik'alq'uinalil.
Tato sakil k'inal yaj he niwanil smasanil, tato malaj jab'ok k’ik’ k’inal ayoch t'ayex, saquilq'uinalnhej ton eyaji, icha junok kandil syak' sakil k'inal, xchi Jesús.
Ayic ix lajwi yalan juntzanh chi' Jesús, ay jun winh fariseo ix awtan yet' wael t'a spat. Tz'eyan ix aj em k'ojan b'aj ix wa chi'.
Axo winh fariseo chi', ix sat sk'ol winh yilani to maj sb'iklaj sk'ab' ichataxon smodo heb'.

Palta ix yalan Jesús t'a winh: --Ha ex fariseo ex tik, lajan ex icha junok mach anhej spatik swaso yet' yuk'ab' sb'iqueli, haxo yool, miiktak. Ichex ta', te wach'nhej tzeyutej he b'ha t'a yichanh heb' anima. Palta haxo t'a elk'altak, tonhej tzex och b'eyumal yuj eyixtan heb' anima chi', yuj eyak'an snib'ej he pek'al.
Te malaj jab'ok he pensar. ¿Tom manh eyojtakok to a jun ixb’o’an juntzanh tas squil tik, ha' ix b'oanpax juntzanh tas manh chequeloklaj, aton ko pensar?
Octom t'a smasanil he k'ool tzex kolwaj t'a heb' meb'a'. Tato icha chi' scheklajeli to wach' ex t'a smasanil.

Ex fariseo, te chuk eyiko'. Ha ex tik tzeyak' sdiezmoal te' alawena yet' te' ruda. Jantacnhej juntzanh itaj, tzeyak'nhej sdiezmoal. Palta tze na to manh yowalilok tojol tzeyutej he b'ha t'a anima. Malaj tze na' wach'chom manh xajanok Dios eyuuj. Octom a juntzanh tik tze b'eyb'alej, max eyaktejkan pax juntzanh chi'.

Ex fariseo, te chuk eyiko'. Ha t'a spatil kulto, anhej t'a xila heb' niwak winak b'aj tze nib'ej tzex em k'ojan. Axo yik tzex ek' t'a yol kalle, tze nib'ej tz'em nhojan heb' anima t'ayex, ayik tzex sk'uman heb'.
Ob'iltak ex, lajan ex icha b'aj smukji heb' chamnak, manhxo chequelok b'aj mukan. Tz'ek' heb' anima t'a yib'anh, yujto manhxo chequelok tato ay anima mukan ta', xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Ayic ix lajwi yalan juntzanh chi' Jesús, ay jun winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés ix alan t'ay: --Ach ko k'ayb'umal, ayik tzalan juntzanh tik, te chuk pax skab' a onh tik, xchi winh.

Ix yalanpax Jesús t'a heb': --Ex k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés, te chuk pax eyiko', yujto a juntzanh he leyal, lajan icha junok ikatz te al. Tonhej tze tusb'ejk'ei yik skuchan heb' anima, palta max eyak'och junok yiximal he k'ab' he d'unhanb'at t'a yib'anh heb'.
Palta chuk eyiko'. Tzato he wach' b'oej yet'tal heb' schekab' Dios t'a he kampusante, aton heb' milb'ilcham yuj heb' he mam eyicham.
Ayic tze b'oan juntzanh chi', tze ch'oxeli to wach' yutejnak sb'a heb' he mam eyicham chi' he naani. Ha heb' miljinakcham heb', a exxo tik, tzato he b'opaxk'e yet'tal heb' chi'.
Yuj chi' ix yalkan Dios yet' sjelanil: Ol in chekb'at juntzanh heb' in chekab' yalel in lolonel t'ayex. Ay heb' ol he milchamok, ay pax heb' tonhej ol eyak'och t'a syaelal, xchi.
Yuj chi' t'a eyib'anh t'a jun pekti’ tik ol yak'kan Dios masanil schamel heb' schekab' milb'ilcham yiktax ix el yich jun yol yib'anhk’inal tik.

Manh jantakok heb' schekab' Dios milb'ilchamok yiktax ix miljicham winhaj Abel, masanto ayik ix miljicham winhaj Zacarías t'a snanhal altar yet' stemplo Dios. Yuj chi' swal t'ayex to ha Dios ol ak'ankan schamel juntzanh heb' schekab' chi' t'a eyib'anh.

Ex k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés, te chuk eyiko', yujto munil ix eyak'och eyopisio he jakan spensar heb' anima yet' slolonel Dios, palta max eyak'och he pensar t'a slolonel chi', haxo heb' snib'ej syak'och spensar t'ay, max he chalaj yak'och heb', xchi Jesús chi'.
Ayic ix yalan juntzanh chi', ix te kot yowal heb' winh k'ayb'um t'a ley chi' yet' heb' winh fariseo chi'. Ix och ijan heb' winh stzuntzan yuj juntzanh tas sk'anb'ej heb' winh t'ay.
Smaclej yab' heb' winh tato ay junok b'aj slektaj sloloni, yik syak'och heb' winh t'a yib'anh.

Ha junel smilalxo heb' anima ix smolb'ej sb'ha t'a Jesús. Ix laj ste switz'ej sb'a heb', ix laj stek'laj yok heb'. Axo Jesús chi' ix b'ab'laj alan t'a heb' sk'ayb'um: --Tzeyil wal he b'ha t'a yich span heb' fariseo, syalelk'ochi, aton schab'satil heb',
yujto jantaknhej tas k'ub'anel tiknaik, ol laj cheklajelta. Yed' pax jantaknhej k'ub'eltak yaji, ol ojtakajelok.
Yuj chi' masanil tas tzeyal t'a k'ub'eltak, ol laj yab' heb' anima smasanil. Yed' pax masanil tastak slaj he sajlajoch t'a he chiquin, ol laj pukaxel t'a skal heb' anima smasanil.
Swal t'ayex ex wamigo, manh ex xiw t'a heb' smilan he niwanil tik, yujto ayik slajwi ex smilan heb', malaj junokxo tas syal ex yutan heb'.
Palta swal t'ayex mach b'aj yowalil tzex xiwi: Xiwanhec d'ha Dios. Aton jun syal yik'anel he k 'inal, slajwi chi' tzex yak'anb'at t'a infierno. Yuj chi' wal yel xiwanhek t'ay.
Ilecnab' nok' kotak much, malaj yelk'och nok'. Ayic schonhchaj nok', owanh nok' t'a chab' kotak tumin, palta ha Dios max satlaj sk'ool t'a junok nok'.
Ha ex xo tik, ek'alto eyelk'och t'a yichanh jantak nok' yunetak much chi'. Inatax xil he jolom, b'isb'il yuj Dios chi'. Yuj chi' manh ex och ilk'olal.
Ha in swal t'ayex, yalnhej mach junok heb' tz'alan t'a yichanh heb' anima to wik heb', icha in pax ta', a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, ol wal heb' wikok t'a yichanh heb' yángel Dios.
Ha heb' tz'alan t'a yichanh heb' anima to manh wikok heb', a in xo ol wal pax el t'a yichanh heb' yángel Dios to manh wikok heb'.

Ha heb' tz'alan junok chukal t'a in patik, a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, syal yak'ji lajwok smul heb'. Axo heb' tz'alan junok chukal t'a spatik Yespíritu Dios, a jun mul chi', manhxo ol ek'b'atlaj.
Ayic ol ex ik'jokb'at t'a spatil kulto, ma tzex ik'jib'at t'a yichanh heb' winh juez, ma heb' winh yajal, manh eyak' pensar yuj tas ol eyutok he kolan he b'ha t'a heb', ma yuj tas ol eyala',
yujto ayik ol k'och stiempoal eyalani, a Yespíritu Dios ol alan t'ayex tas ol eyala', xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Ha t'a skal juntzanh anima chi', ay jun winh ix alan t'a Jesús: --Ach ko k'ayb'umal, al t'a winh wuk'tak to a tas aykan t'a winh yuj winh ko mam syak' nanhalok wik winh yet'ok, xchi winh.
Ix yalan Jesús t'a winh: --Ach wamigo, ¿tom ay mach ix ak'an wopisio woch juezal t'ayex, yik tzin pukanb'at juntzanh he k'ael chi'? xchi t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan t'a heb' anima: --Tzeyil he b'a, tze tanhwej wal he b'a, yik malaj b'aj ol eyil he k'ool t'a junok tas, yujto wach'chom tzijtum tas ay t'ayonh, manh yujok chi' tzalajk'olal tzonh ek' t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, xchi.
Yuj chi' ix yal jun ch'oxnab'il tik t'a heb': --Ay jun winh b'eyum, tzijtum sat tas syawej winh ix el t'a sat sluum.
Ix snaub'tanhan winh: ¿Tas swutej? Manhxa b'aj syal in molankan sat tas ix wawej tik.
Ix snaan winh icha tik: Ol in pojel juntzanh spatil sat wawb'en tik, ol in b'oan juntzanhokxo niwak. Ata' ol in molkanoch masanil tastak ix wawej yet' masanil in k'ael.

Ol lajwok chi', ol walan icha tik: Ha tiknaik, niwan tas ix in molb'ejkani, niwan tiempo ol in k'ana', yuj chi' syal wik'an wip tiknaik, syal tzin wa'i, swuk'an ha', jantaknhej tas tzin nib'ej. Syal wak'an tzalajb'ok in k'ool, xin chama, xchi winh.
Palta ix yalan Dios t'a winh: Ha ach tik te malaj a pensar. D'a jun ak'wal tik ol ach chamok. Ha juntzanh molb'ilkan tik uuj, ¿mach ay yiko'? xchi Dios t'a winh.
Icha chi' yaj heb' smolan sb'eyumal t'a yol yiko', haxo t'a yik Dios meb'a' heb', xchi Jesús t'a heb' anima.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jesús t'a heb' sk'ayb'um: --Swal t'ayex, manh eyak' pensar yuj tas ol ik'an yek' tiempo eyuuj. Yuj tas tze wa''a yet' pax yuj he pichul tzeyak'ochi.
Ha Dios tz'ak'an ko k 'inal, okxom tas sko wa''a, ¿tom manh ol yak'a'? Ha ix ak'an ko niwanil, ¿tom manh ol yak' pax ko pichul?

Ina nok' much, ¿tom ay tas syawej nok'? ¿tom ay tas sjach' nok'? Malaj yet'tal b'aj smolb'ej jab'ok swael nok', palta ha Dios tz'ak'annhej tas swa nok'. Ha ex xo pax tik, ek'al eyelk'och t'a yichanh nok' much chi'.
¿Tom ay junok ex syal eyak'anoch nanhalokxo wara he teel yujto tzeyak' pensar?
Yuj chi' tato max techaj he b'oan juntzanh tas malaj yelk'ochi, ¿tas yuj tzeyak' pensar yuj juntzanhokxo tasi?

Ilec nab' te' xumak sq'uib'i. Max munlaj te', max ch'alwi te'. Wach'chom icha chi', ayik yek'nak winhaj rey Salomón t'a peka', te wach' yilji winh yet' spichul, palta maj tzak'wan yilji winh icha te' xumak chi'.

Ha juntzanh te' chi', tonhej ayek' te' t'a kaltak te', haxo t'a junxo k'u snhusjitz'a te' t'a yol horno. Wach'chom icha chi' yaj te', ha Dios tz'ak'an swach'il yilji te'. Yuj chi' a ex tik, yelxo wal ol yak' he pichul Dios, palta a ex pural tzeyak'och t'a he k'ool.
Yuj chi' manh eyak' pensar yuj tas ol he wa''a, yet' yuj tas ol eyuk'ej.
Ha heb' manh ojtannakok Dios, aton t'a spatik juntzanh tik k'elanoch heb', palta yojtak Dios to ay tz'och juntzanh chi' kuuj, yujto ko Mam yaji.
Yuj chi', aq'ek eyip he k'anab'ajan Dios Kajal. Tato icha chi' tze k'ulej, ol ak'jokpax masanil juntzanh chi' t'ayex.
Ha ex tik, icha in kalnel eyaji. Wach'chom jaywanh exnhej, palta manh ex och ilk'olal, yujto a ko Mam Dios ix ex ak'an och t'a yol sk'ab', yujto icha chi' ix el t'a sk'ool.
