Chonhekkan el tastak ay t'ayex, aq'ek t'a heb' malaj yiko'. Icha chi' ol aj smolchaj he b'eyumal t'a satcha’anh, ichok t'a yol junok yet'tal malaj b'ak'uinh ol k'aok. Ha jun chi' malaj b'ak'uinh ol lajwok. Ata', malaj junok elk'um syal yelk'anelta. Anhejtona', manh ol och pax ijaxok.
Ha b'aj ay ko b'eyumal, ata' ayb'at ko pensar.
Te lista tzeyutej he b'a icha heb' ayoch spichul, ay pax och skandil heb' stanhwani.

Q'uinalok ay heb' chekab' wan stanhwan sjax spatrón t'a junok q'uinh nupnajel, sjax t'a spat. Ha sjawi, tz'awajochi, lista yaj heb' chekab' chi' sjakanoch t'a elanhchamel. Icha syutej sb'a heb' chekab' chi' stanhwani, icha chi' tzeyutej he b'a.
Tato pitzan heb' chekab' chi' ayik sjax spatrón heb' chi', te wach' yik heb'. Val yel swal t'ayex to a wal winh patrón chi' sb'oanem k'ojjab' heb' t'a mexa, tz'ak'ji wa heb' yuj winh.
Wach'chom chimilak'walxo, ma ayto sk'ana', ta pitzan heb' schekab' chi', te wach' yik heb'.
Nachajokab'el jun ab'ix tik eyuuj. Q'uinalok ay junok winh ix och elk'um t'a yol spat, tato yojtak winh jantak hora sk'och jun elk'um chi', majam scha jakjoklaj spat winh chi'.
Ha exxo pax tik, lista tzeyutej he b'a, tze maklani, yujto ayik manto in he na jawok, ol in ja juknaj a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'an winhaj Pedro t'ay: --Mamin, ¿kuujnhej a ma ix al jun ch'oxnab'il tik, ma yuj heb' anima smasanil? xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix yalan Jesús t'a heb': --¿Mach heb' sch'ox heb' chekab' wach' chi' tze na'a? Q'uinalok ay junok patrón, tato ay junok chekab' sk'anab'ajani, jelan paxi, aton jun chi' tz'ak'jioch yopisio yoch mayordomoal yik syil heb' schekab' chi' smasanil, syak'an wa heb' t'a junjuntak el.
Tato a jun chekab' chi' wan smunlaj icha snib'ej spatrón, te wach' yiko' ayik ol jax spatrón chi'.
Val yel swal t'ayex to ol yak'och winh yilumalok jantak tas ay t'ay.
Palta q'uinalok a jun chekab' chi' snaani to manto ol ja spatrón chi', yuj chi' syamanoch smak'an heb' yetchekab'wumal chi' yet' heb' ix ix smunlaji, tonhej syak' snib'ej swa'i, syuk'an anh.

Axo t'a junok k'u sna'a to manto ol jalaj winh spatrón chi', palta ha t'a jun k'u chi' ol jawok winh. Ta sjawi winh ayik manh tanhwab'ilok, manh naanok yuj jun chekab' chi', te niwan syaelal ol ak'jokoch t'a yib'anh. Ol yak'anb'at winh t'a skal heb' maj ak'an och Dios t'a sk'ool.
Q'uinalok ay junok chekab' ojtannak tas snib'ej spatrón t'ay. Palta manh listaok syutej sb'a, max sk'anab'ajej paxi. Te niwan yaelal ol ochkan t'a yib'anh.

Palta q'uinalok ay jun chekab' manh ojtannakok tas snib'ej spatrón, sk'ulej juntzanh tas smoj tz'ak'jikot yaelal t'a yib'anh yuj, quennhej yaelal chi' ol kot t'a yib'anh. Ha heb' niwan tas ix ak'ji t'ay, niwan pax tas ol k'anb'aj t'a heb'. Yed' heb' niwan tas ix ak'jioch t'a yol sk'ab', niwan pax tas ol yak'xi entregar heb'.
Ha in tik, in ja wak'och jun icha k'ak' t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik. Comonoc wal wanxo sk'e tinhton sk'ak'al tiknaik.
Ay wal jun niwan yaelal ol ja t'a wib'anh, ichato ol in ak'jok bautizar yuj. Tzin kus wal sik'lab'il tiknaik masanto ol ujok elk'ochi.
¿Tom tze na a ex tik to in ja wak'och junk'olal t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik? Swal eyab'i to maay. In jawi wak' spoj sb'a heb' anima.
Q'uinalok ay owanhok t'a junok pat, ol och oxwanhok ajk'olal t'a chawanhxo. Axo heb' chawanh chi' ol och ajk'olal pax t'a heb' oxwanh chi'. Icha chi' ol aj heb' anima t'a jun pekti’ tik.
Ha heb' mamab'il, ol yak' owal heb' yet' heb' yuninal. Anheja' pax heb' ix nunab'il, ol yak' owal heb' ix yet' yune'. Ay pax heb' ix alib'al ol yak' owal yet' heb' ix yalib', xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Ix yalan juntzanhxo tik Jesús t'a heb' anima: --Ayic tzeyilan sk'e waan asun b'aj tz'em k'u, elanhchamel tzeyala' to ol yak' nhab'. Yel toni, icha chi' yaji.
Axo yik skot ik' t'a sur, tzeyalani to ol q'uixnajok. Yel tzeyala', sq'uixnaji.
Palta a ex tik, chab' sat ex. Jelan snachajel juntzanh chi' eyuuj, juntzanh skot t'a satcha’anh yet' t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, palta ¿tas yuj max nachajel eyuuj tas syalelk'och jun pekti’ tik?
¿Tas yuj max he b'eyk'olej he b'a tato tojol tas tze k'ulej t'a yichanh Dios?

Q'uinalok ay junok mach tz'ak'anoch tas t'a eyib'anh tiknaik, ayik wanto he b'at yet' t'a yol b'e, tzeyalan he b'a t'ay, yik maxtzak ex k'och t'a yichanh winh alkal. Yujto a winh alkal chi' ol ex ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' winh polenkía. Axo heb' winh ol ex ak'anoch t'a preso.
Swal t'ayex, max ex el t'a libre, masanto tze tup he multa smasanil.

Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', ay juntzanh heb' ix k'och t'a Jesús, ix yalan yab'ixal juntzanh heb' aj Galilea heb', chajtil ix yutej winhaj Pilato smilancham heb' ayik wan yak'an juntzanh silab' heb' d'ha Dios.
Yuj chi' ix yalan Jesús t'a heb': --¿Tzam he na tas yuj icha chi' ix aj heb' winh aj Galilea chi'? ¿Yuj am to te chuk heb' winh t'a yichanh juntzanh heb' yetchonhab' chi' tze na'a?
Swal t'ayex to maay. Ha ex tik, tato max he na he b'a yuj he mul, ol ex champax he masanil.

Naeccot yuj 18 heb' anima chamnak yuj jun pat te chaanh steel lanhchajnak t'a Siloé. ¿Tas yuj icha chi' ajnak heb' tze na'a? ¿Tom te chuk heb' t'a yichanh juntzanhxo heb' yetchonhab' t'a Jerusalén chi'?
Swal t'ayex to maay. Ha ex tik, tato max he na he b'a yuj he mul, he masanil ol ex champaxok, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan jun ab'ix tik t'a heb': --Ay jun winh awab'il jun te' higo yuj t'a sat sluum. Ix b'at winh yila' tato ay sat te', palta haxo ix k'och winh, malaj junok sat te' ix ilchaj yuj winh.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winh t'a winh smunlaj t'a sluum chi': Ina yoxilxo ab'il in kajwi wek' in say junok sat te', palta malaj junelok swil junok pitanh. Yuj chi' swal t'ayach, ch'aquel te'. Nab'anhej tz'ixtax lum lum makb'il tik yuj te', xchi winh.
Axo winh smunlaj chi' ix alani: Mamin patrón, tanhwej junokxo ab'il. Ol wak'lej in d'okan k'unb'ok lum t'a yich te', ol wak'an och abono t'a te',
talaj icha chi' ol yak' sat te'. Palta tato maay, ol in ch'akanel te' icha tzal chi', xchi winh, xchi Jesús.
Ha t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip ix k'och Jesús t'a yol spatil kulto, yik sk'ayb'ej heb' anima.
Ayek' jun ix ix ta', 18 ab'ilxo yoch jun enemigo t'a ix. Ix koxob'ikan snanhal ix, toxonhej nhojanem ix. Maxtzac yal-laj stojolb'ik'e linhan ix.
Axo yik ix ilchaj ix yuj Jesús, ix awtajkot ix yuj, ix yalan t'a ix: --Ach ix, toxo ach kolchaj t'a jun a yaelal tik, xchi t'a ix.
Ix yak'anek' sk'ab' Jesús t'a yib'anh ix, wal t'a jun rato chi' ix tojolb'ik'e linhan ix. Ix och ijan ix yalan wach' lolonel d'ha Dios.

Axo winh yajal b'aj ayek' heb' chi', ix kot yowal winh yujto a Jesús ix ak'an b'oxok sk'ol jun ix ix chi' t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip, yuj chi' ix yalan winh t'a heb' anima ayek' ta': --Vaquenhej k'u smoj tzonh munlaj t'a yol semana. Ha t'a juntzanh k'ual chi' syal tzex ja he k'an b'oxok he k'ool. Manhok t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip, xchi winh yajal chi'.
Ix tak'wi Jesús t'a winh: --Ha ex tik, chab' sat ex. Q'uinalok ay junok nok' he wakax, ma junok nok' he b'uru etzan t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip, ¿tom manh ol eyik'elta nok' yik b'at eyak'an yuk' ha' nok'?
Ha jun ix tik, yinhtilal Abraham ix. Ayxo 18 ab'il yamb'il ix yuj winh Satanás, ichato tzek'b'il ix yuj winh. ¿Tom manh smojok skolchaj ix t'a jun syaelal tik yujto sk'ual ik'oj ip? xchi Jesús.

Ayic ix yalan jun chi', masanil heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ay, ix te q'uixwi heb'. Palta masanil juntzanhxo heb' anima, ix te tzalaj heb' yilan juntzanh tas ix sk'ulej Jesús chi', yujto te niwan yelk'och juntzanh milagro chi'.
Ix yalan Jesús: --¿Chajtil ol aj sq'uib' sb'isul heb' anima tz'och t'a yol sk'ab' Dios tze na'a? Ol wal jun ab'ix tik eyab'i yik ol nachajel eyuuj.
Ha jun chi' lajan icha sat anh mostaza ix yawej jun winh t'a sat sluum. Sq'uib' anh, lajan tz'aj anh yet' juntzanh te' niwak te'. Yuj chi' syal sway nok' much t'a sk'ab' anh, xchi Jesús.
Ix yalan junxo ab'ix Jesús: --Ol wal junxo ab'ix t'ayex chajtil ol aj sq'uib' sb'isul heb' anima tz'och t'a yol sk'ab' Dios.
Ha jun chi' lajan icha jab'ok yich pan syak'och jun ix ix t'a skal oxe' almul harina. Spajb'i masanil ixim yuj jab' yich pan chi', sipji ixim yuj, xchi Jesús.
Anhejtona' wan sb'at Jesús t'a sb'eal Jerusalén, ix laj ek' t'a juntzanh chonhab' yet' t'a juntzanh aldea b'aj ix sk'ayb'ej heb' anima.
Ay jun anima ix k'anb'an t'ay: --Mamin, ¿tom jaywannhej heb' ol kolchajok? xchi. Yuj chi' ix yalan Jesús:
--Hak'ek eyip eyoch t'a jun puerta yunenhej, yujto swal t'ayex to tzijtum heb' snib'ej yochi palta max yal-laj yoch heb'.

Ha in tik, icha yajal pat waji. Tato tzin k'e linhan tzin makan in pat yakb'an ayexto ek' t'a sti' te' pat chi', ol ex awajochok, Mamin, jak onh ochi, xe chama. Axo ol walani: Manh wojtakok mach ex, xin chama.
Palta a onh tik wanak onh, kuk'nak ha' ed'ok. Ha k'ayb'ejnak onh t'a yoltak kalle, xe cham t'ayin.
Axo ol walan t'ayex: Toxo ix wal t'ayex, manh ex wojtakok. Elanhec he masanil, yujto anhej chukal tze k'ulej, xin cham t'ayex.
Ato ta' ol ex siq'uik'ok eyoq'ui ayik ol eyilani, ayek' winhaj Abraham, winhaj Isaac, winhaj Jacob yet' smasanil heb' schekab' Dios ayxo ek' t'a yol sk'ab' Dios, a exxo tik, ayex kan elta t'a spatik.
Yujto ay heb' ol kot t'a junjun chonhab', b'aj sja k'u, b'aj tz'em k'u, t'a norte yet' t'a sur, ol em k'ojan heb' swa t'a smexa heb' ayxo och t'a yol sk'ab' Dios chi'.
Ay heb' malaj yelk'och tiknaik, haxo t'a jun pekti’ chi' niwan ol aj yelk'och heb'. Ay pax heb' niwan yelk'och tiknaik, haxo t'a jun pekti’ chi', malaj jab'ok ol aj yelk'och heb', xchi Jesús.
Anheja' t'a jun k'u chi', ix k'och juntzanh heb' winh fariseo t'a Jesús, ix yalan heb' winh: --Elanh t'a tik, yujto snib'ej winhaj Herodes tzach smilchamok, xchi heb' winh t'ay.

Ix tak'wi Jesús chi' t'a heb' winh: --Ha winh chi', lajan winh icha nok' waax, ¿tok ay yelk'och nok'? Ixiquec, alek t'a winh: Ha tiknaik yet' k'ik'an swik'el heb' enemigo t'a heb' anima, ol laj b'oxok heb' penaay wuuj. Axo chab'ej tzin wach' b'oan in munlajel tik, xchi Jesús, xe chi t'a winh.
Palta a in tik, anheja' ol in b'at tiknaik, k'ik'an yet' chab'ej, yujto anhej t'a Jerusalén tzonh miljicham a onh schekab' onh Dios tik.

Ha ex tik ex aj Jerusalén, chuk eyiko', tz'ok' wal in k'ol eyuuj. Tze milnhejcham heb' schekab' Dios. Axo juntzanhxo heb' schekjikot yuj Dios t'ayex, tonhej slaj he julcham heb' t'a k'een yax k'een. Tzijtum elxo in gana tzex wawtejkot t'ayin, icha junok nok' kaxlanh syawtejkot yune', smoyk'e t'a yalanh sk'axil, palta max yal he k'ool tzex koti.
Ab'ek. Ha jun he templo tik ol kan tzinan, yujto swal t'ayex to manhxo ol in eyil-laj, masanto ol eyal icha tik: Calec wach' lolonel t'a jun chekb'ilkot yuj Dios Kajal, xe chama, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Ha t'a jun sk'ual ik'oj ip, aton t'a sábado, ix k'och Jesús wael t'a spat jun winh yajal heb' winh fariseo. Axo juntzanhxo heb' winh yetfariseoal winh ix maklan yila' tas ol yutej sb'a.
Ata' ayek' jun winh penaay yuj mal k'ab' ok t'a yichanh Jesús.
Axo Jesús chi' ix k'anb'an t'a heb' winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés yet' t'a heb' winh fariseo chi': --¿Ay am sleyal skak' b'oxok sk'ol junok penaay t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip, mato maay? xchi t'a heb' winh.
Manhxalaj tas ix yal heb' winh. Ichato chi' ix chaji winh penaay chi' yuj Jesús, ix b'oxi sk'ool winh yuj, ix yalan t'a winh to spax winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan t'a heb' winh fariseo chi': --Q'uinalok a ex tik ay junok eyuninal ma junok he wakax, sb'at t'a yol junok xab', ¿tom max b'at eyik'k'eta t'a elanhchamel, wach'chom sk'ual ik'oj ip? xchi t'a heb' winh.
Majxo nachajlaj tas syutej heb' winh spakan t'ay.
Ix yilan Jesús tas ix yutej sb'a heb' awtab'il t'a jun wael. Snib'ej heb' tz'em k'ojjab' b'aj tz'em k'ojan heb' niwak winak. Yuj chi' ix yalan jun tik t'a heb':
--Tato ay b'aj tzex awtaj t'a junok q'uinh nupnajel, manh ex em k'ojan t'a sk'ojnub' heb' niwak winak. Talaj icha chi' ay junok winh ek'al yelk'och t'ayex sk'och ta',
haxo winh tzex awtan chi' tz'alan t'ayex: Elanh t'a te' xila tik, ak'b'at te' t'a winh tik, tato xchi. Tzex q'uixwi, haxo t'a xila heb' malaj yelk'och tzex emkan k'ojan.

Palta ayik tzex awtaji, tzex em k'ojan b'aj malaj wal yelk'ochi, yik haxo sja winh tzex awtan chi', syalan winh t'ayex: Ach wamigo, ochanh t'a jun lugar b'aj tz'em k'ojan heb' niwak yelk'ochi, xcham winh. Ichato chi', niwan tz'aj eyelk'och t'a yichanh heb' ayek' t'a mexa chi'.
Yalnhej mach syik'chaanh sb'a, ol ik'jok emta. Axo heb' emnaquil syutej sb'a, ol ik'jok chaanh heb'.

Ix yalanpax t'a winh ix awtan heb' wael chi': --Ayic tza b'oan junok niwan wael, manh awtej heb' amigo, heb' uk'tak, heb' a k'ab' ok yet' heb' b'eyum t'a a lak'anil. Yujto ol ach yawtej pax heb' t'a yiko', icha chi' ol a chaanxi spak chi'.
Palta ayik tza b'oan junok niwan wael, tzawtej heb' meb'a', heb' elnak sk'ab', heb' max uji sb'eyi yet' heb' max uji yilani.
Tato icha chi' tzutej, wach' ik syal chi', yujto wach'chom max a cha spak t'a heb', ol a cha spak ayik ol pitzwokxi heb' wach' sb'eyb'al, xchi Jesús t'a winh.
Ay jun winh ayoch t'a skal heb' ayoch t'a jun mexa chi', ayik ix yab'an juntzanh chi' winh, ix yalan winh t'a Jesús: --Te wach' yik heb' ol och wael b'aj ayoch Dios Yajalil, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yal jun ab'ix tik Jesús: --Ha junel, ay jun winh ixb’o’an jun niwan wael. Tzijtum heb' anima ix yawtej winh.
Axo ix k'och yorail jun wael chi', ix schekanb'at jun schekab' winh, ix b'at yalan t'a heb' awtab'il, ix yalan t'a heb': Cotanhec. Ix k'och yorail yoch wael, wach'xo yaj smasanil, xchi t'a heb'.

Palta ix laj sk'anan niwank'olal sb'a heb'. Ha jun winh b'ab'el, ix yal winh icha tik: Ay jun in lu'um toto ix in mana', yowalil b'at wila''. Swal in b'a t'ayach, aq'uin niwank'olal, xa chi, xchi winh.
Axo ix yalan junxo winh: Ato wal slajwi in manan oye' par in wakax tik, ol b'at wak'lej prowal nok'. Ak'ab' niwank'olal, xa chi t'a winh, xchi winh.
Ix yalan junxo winh: Toto ix och wetb'eyum, yuj chi' max yal-laj in b'ati, xa chi, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' a winh chekab' chi' ix alan juntzanh tik t'a spatrón. Ix kot yowal winh patrón chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: Ixic elanhchamel t'a yoltak kalle t'a juntzanh b'e tzek' t'a kal chonhab' tik, tzik'kot heb' meb'a', heb' ay spaltail, heb' max uji sb'eyi yet' heb' max uji yilani, xchi winh.
Axo ix k'ochxi winh schekab' chi' junelxo, ix yalan winh t'a winh: Mamin patrón, ix in k'anab'ajej tas ix ala', palta ayto sk'an sb'ud'ji, xchi winh.
Ix yalanxi winh t'a winh: Ixic t'a yoltak kalle, t'a juntzanhxo b'e tzek' t'a yol chonhab' tik, tzak'an pural heb' skoti yik sb'ud'ji in pat tik yuj heb'.
Yujto swal t'ayach, malaj junok heb' ix in b'ab'laj awtej ol wa t'a jun niwan wael tik, xchi winh patrón chi', xchi Jesús.
Tzijtum heb' anima ix och tzak'an yuj Jesús, yuj chi' ix meltzajb'at k'elan t'a heb', ix yalani:

--Tato ay heb' sja t'ayin, palta ta más niwan yelk'och smam snun heb' t'a wichanh snaani, ma ix yetb'eyum, yuninal, heb' yuk'tak, heb' ix yanab', ma sk'inal heb', tato icha chi', max yal-laj yoch heb' in k'ayb'umok.
Ha heb' sb'eyb'alan in b'eyb'al, sb'ekanpax cham sb'a heb' t'a te' kulus wuuj, anhej heb' smoj yoch in k'ayb'umok.
Q'uinalok ay junok ex tze nib'ej tze b'o junok niwan pat, ayik manto eyamoch he b'oani, ¿tom max ex em k'ojan tze naan yuj stojol tato k'okb'il syab'i?
Tato maay, tonhej tzeyak'kanem yich, haxo heb' anima tzex b'uchani.
Syalan heb': Ha jun winh tik, ix syamoch winh sb'oan spat, palta maj b'olaj yuj winh, xcham heb'.

Q'uinalok ay junok winh rey wan sb'at yak' owal yet' junokxo winh rey, palta anhej lajunhe' mil soldado winh yet'nak. Axo pax junxo winh rey chi', ay 20 mil soldado winh yet'nak. Ayic manto b'atlaj winh, ¿tom max em k'ojan winh snaan sik'lab'il tato stechaj yak'an jun owal chi' winh?
Tato sna winh to max techaj yuj, schekanb'at junok schekab' winh t'a winh yet'nak syak'an owal chi', yakb'an najatto wan skot winh, yik syalan winh to tz'och heb' t'a junk'olal.
Ichex pax ta', tato max eyaktejkan jantak tas ay t'ayex, max yal eyoch in k'ayb'umok.
Ha atz'am atz'am, wach' ton atz'am. Palta q'uinalok satel sk'achial atz'am, ¿tasto tz'aj sk'anchaji?
Manhxalaj tz'ochi, manhok t'a lum lum, manhok t'a abonoal, toxonhej syumchajeli. Ha juntzanh tzeyab' tik, naek wal sik'lab'il, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Masanil heb' winh tekumel alkabar yet' juntzanhxo heb' te chuk t'a yol sat heb' anima, ix k'och heb' t'a stz'ey Jesús smaklej yab' tas syala'.

Yuj chi' a heb' winh fariseo yet' heb' winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés, b'uchumtak slolon heb' winh t'a spatik Jesús chi', ix yalan heb' winh: --Ha jun winh tik schanhej heb' chuk sb'eyb'al winh sk'och t'ay. Ina swa winh yet' heb', xchi heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix yal jun ch'oxnab'il tik Jesús t'a heb' winh:

--Q'uinalok ay junok winh t'a he kal tik ay kienok nok' skalnel. Tato ay junok nok' satkani, skan nok' yetb'eyum nok' chi' t'a junok ak'lik, sb'at winh say nok' satkan chi', masanto schax nok' yuj winh.
Axo schaxk'och nok' chi', schelankot nok' winh. Ste tzalaj wal winh.

Ayic sk'ochxi winh t'a spat, syawtankot heb' yamigo winh yet' heb' ay t'a slak'anil. Syalan winh t'a heb': Tzalajanhec wed'ok, yujto ix sat jun nok' in kalnel. Palta toxo ix ilchajxi nok' wuuj, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Anhejtona', q'uinalok ay 99-ok anima, toxonton tojol spensar, manh yowalilok sna sb'a heb' snaani, malaj tzalajk'olal t'a satcha’anh yuj heb'. Palta a in swal t'ayex, tato ay junok malaj swach'il sb'eyb'al, sna sb'a yuj smul, yelxo wal niwan tzalajk'olal yuj jun chi' t'a satcha’anh.
Q'uinalok ay junok ix ix ay lajunheok stumin. Tato satb'at junok, syak'och staj ix, slaj smesanelta yol spat ix. Syak' wal snib'ej ix sayani masanto tz'ilchaji.

Axo schax k'een yuj ix, smolb'an heb' ix swach'k'ool ix yet' heb' ay t'a slak'anil ix. Syalan ix t'a heb': Tzalajanhec wed'ok, yujto ay jun k'een in tumin ix sati. Axo tiknaik, ix chax k'een wuuj, xchi ix t'a heb'.
Val yel swal t'ayex, icha pax chi' stzalaj Dios yet' heb' yángel t'a satcha’anh yuj junok anima chuk sb'eyb'al sna sb'ha t'a smul, xchi Jesús.
Ix yalanpax junxo ab'ix tik Jesús: --Ay jun winh ay chawanh yuninal.

Ha winh tzak'an unin ix alan t'a winh smam icha tik: Mamin, pojkan snanhal tastak ol ak'kan t'ayonh ato syala' jantak ol ak' t'ayin, xchi winh. Yuj chi', a winh mamab'il chi' ix pojankan t'a heb' winh.
Jayeanto k'ual chi', ix laj schonhanel tastak ix ak'jikan t'a winh yuj smam chi', ix b'at winh t'a junxo chonhab' te najat. Ata' ix b'at slajel stumin winh t'a juntzanh chukal.
Ayic toxo ix lajwiel k'een tumin chi', ix ja jun niwan wejel t'a jun chonhab' chi'. Manhxalaj tas swa winh, syak' wal techaj wejel winh.
Yuj chi' ix b'at sk'an munlaj sb'a winh t'a jun winh ay t'a chonhab' chi'. Axo winh ix chekanb'at winh t'a jun sluum tanhwoj chitam.
Scham winh yuj wejel, yuj chi' ix snib'ej winh yab'lej tas syab'lej nok' chitam chi', palta malaj mach tz'ak'an jab'ok tas t'a winh.
Ichato chi' ix snaan sb'a winh: ¿Tas yuj icha tik tzin k'ulej, swak'cham in b'a yuj wejel t'a tik, axom t'a winh in mam jantak am tas swa heb' smajan winh, syak' sobre tas swa heb'?
Más wach' tzin pax b'aj ay winh in mam chi'. Ol walan t'a winh: Mamin, ix och in mul d'ha Dios yet' t'ayach.
Manhxo in al uninalok. Ichokab' junok a majan tzin ajkani, xin chama, xchi winh.

Ix meltzaj winh b'ian. Najatto wan skot winh, ix yilanb'at winh smam winh chi', ix te ok' sk'ool winh t'a winh. Ix b'at lemnaj winh schakot winh. Ix och lak'naj winh t'a winh, ix stz'ub'anelta sti' winh t'a tzalajk'olal.
Ix yalan winh t'a winh smam chi': Mamin, ix och in mul d'ha Dios yet' t'ayach. Manhxo smojok tzin al uninalok, xchi winh.

Axo winh mamab'il chi' ix alan t'a heb' smajan: Lemec, ik'ekkot jun mojok pichul te wach', tzeyak'anoch t'a winh wuninal tik. Tzeyak'anpax och junok kolk'ab' t'a sk'ab' winh, tzeyak'anoch xanhab' winh.
Slajwi chi', tzeyik'ankot junok nok' yune' wakax, aton nok' te b'ak'uech, tze milancham nok'. To ol och jun niwan wael, ol kak'anoch q'uinh.
Yujto a winh wuninal tik, chamnakxo winh in naani, palta tob'an pitzan winh. Satnakb'at winh, haxo tiknaik ix jax winh t'ayin, xchi winh. Ichato chi', ix syamanoch heb' yak'anoch q'uinh chi'.
Axo winh b'ab'el unin, ayb'at winh t'a smunlajel. Axo ix jax winh, ix yab'an winh ayoch son, wan yek' heb' chanhal.
Yuj chi' ix yawtankot jun smajan winh smam winh chi', ix sk'anb'an winh t'ay: ¿Tas yuj ayoch jun q'uinh tik? xchi winh.
Yuj winh uk'tak ix jaxi. Ha winh a mam ix chekan miljokcham nok' yune' wakax b'ak'uech, yujto wach' sk'ool winh ix jax winh, malaj tas ix ik'an winh, xchi jun majan chi' t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix kot yowal winh. Manhxalaj snib'ej winh yoch t'a yol pat. Yuj chi' ix elta winh smam winh chi', ix och ijan winh smontan winh yik tz'och winh.
Palta ix yalan winh t'a winh smam chi': Ojtac jantakxo tiempo tzin munlaji, malaj b'aj ix in pitej in b'a t'ayach. Manta b'aj tzak' junok nok' yune' chiwa yik swak'och in q'uinh yet' heb' wamigo.
Axo tiknaik ix jax winh uninal xid' satanel a tumin yet' heb' ix ajmul ix. Axo yuj winh tza milancham nok' wakax b'ak'uech, xchi winh t'a winh smam chi'.
Axo ix yalan winh smam winh chi': Ach wuninal, ay achnhej ek' wed'ok. Masanil tas ay t'ayin iknhej yaji.

Yuj chi' smoj ton kak'an och q'uinh yik tzonh tzalaji. Yujto a winh uk'tak tik, chamnakxo winh ko naani, tob'an pitzan winh. Satnac b'at winh, palta ix jax winh t'ayin, xchi winh mamab'il chi', xchi Jesús.
Ix yalan jun ab'ix tik Jesús t'a heb' sk'ayb'um: --Ay jun winh patrón te b'eyum. Ay jun winh smayordomo winh. Ix yab'an spekal winh to a winh smayordomo winh chi' wan satanel tastak ay t'a winh.
Axo winh patrón chi' ix awtan winh, ix yalan winh: Ay juntzanh tas ix wab' t'a a patik. Yuj chi' ak' entregar a kuenta t'ayin. Manhxo ol ach munlaj t'a jun opisio tik t'ayin, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix snaan winh mayordomo chi', ¿tas ol wutok in b'a tiknaik? Ol in yik'el winh t'a wopisio, palta max uji junokxo munlajel wuuj. Tzin q'uixwi wek' t'a titak pat in k'an wa in b'a.
Toxo ix in na tiknaik tas ol wutok in b'a. Yuj chi' wach'chom malaj in munlajel, tekan ay heb' ol in chaanoch t'a yol spat, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix laj yawtankot heb' winh ay sb'ok t'a winh spatrón winh chi'. Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a winh ix b'ab'lajk'ochi: ¿Jantac a b'ok t'a winh patrón? xchi winh.

Cien barril in b'ok akeite t'a winh, xchi winh. Inye, tato icha chi' a b'ok akeite chi', ina jun yumal a b'ok chi'. Elanhchamel tzach em k'ojan, tza b'oan junokxo, 50-nhej tza tz'ib'ejemi, xchi winh mayordomo chi' t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix sk'anb'an winh t'a junxo winh: Xal ach, ¿jantak pax ik t'a winh? xchi winh. Ha in tik, kien quintal in b'ok trigo t'a winh, xchi junxo winh chi'. Tato icha chi', a tz'ajxikan t'a yumal a b'ok chi', 80-xonhej tza tz'ib'ejemi, xchi winh t'a winh.

Ix yalan winh patrón chi' to te jelan ix yutej sb'a jun winh mayordomo chi' t'a elk'al. Yujto a heb' ay t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, te jelan syutej sb'a heb' t'a yichanh heb' ayoch sakil k'inal Dios t'ay.

Ha in swal t'ayex, a k'een tumin, sekojtak sk'anji k'een t'a chukal. Palta wach' tzeyamk'ab'ej k'een t'a wach'il, yik tz'aj eyamigo. Tato icha chi', ayik ol lajwok yopisio k'een he tumin chi', ol ex chajok t'a jun eyed'tal ay t'a junelnhej.

Ha heb' tojol syutej sb'a yet' jab'ok tasi, anhejtona' tojol pax syutej sb'a heb' t'a jantak tas niwan ay t'ay. Ha heb' manh tojolok syutej sb'a yet' jab'ok tasi, anhejtona' manh tojolok ol yutok sb'a heb' yet' junok niwan ol ak'jok t'ay.
Yuj chi', tato manh tojolok tzeyutej he b'a yet' k'een tumin sk'anchaj t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, malaj mach ol ak'an junok b'eyumal niwan yelk'och t'a yol he k'ab'.
Tato manh tojolok tzeyutej he b'ha t'a junok tas ch'ok mach ay yiko', malaj mach ol ak'an junok eyiko'.

Malaj junok mach syal yak'an serwil chawanhok spatrón, yujto ay jun malaj yelk'och t'ay. Axo junxo te niwan yelk'och t'ay. Wach' syutej sb'ha t'a junok, haxo t'a junxo chuk syutej sb'a. Max yal-laj kak'an serwil Dios yet' k'een tumin, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Axo heb' winh fariseo, anhej t'a k'een tumin ayoch spensar heb' winh. Yuj chi', ayik ix yab'an jun chi' heb' winh, ix b'uchwaj heb' winh t'a Jesús.

Ix yalanxi Jesús chi' t'a heb' winh: --Ha ex pax tik, t'a yichanh heb' anima, wach' tzeyutej he b'a. Axo pax Dios yojtak tas yaj he pensar. Ay juntzanh tas niwan yelk'och t'a yichanh heb' anima, haxo t'a yichanh Dios, chakb'ileli.

Anhej ley Moisés yet' juntzanh tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj heb' schekab' Dios t'a peka' aykanoch yopisio masantax ix ulek' winhaj Juan winh ak'jinak bautizar. Axo tiknaik, atax ix ulek' winh ix elkan yich yaljiel jun wach' ab'ix chajtil tz'aj yoch heb' anima t'a yol sk'ab' Dios. Yuj chi' masanil heb' syak' yip yoch t'a yol sk'ab' Dios.
Wach'chom ol lajwok ek' satcha’anh yet' yol yib'anhk’inal tik, haxo pax jun ley chi', wach'chom junok letra, malaj wal junok b'aj manh ol elk'och tas syala'.
Ha junok winh spuk sb'a yet' ix yetb'eyum, syik'an junokxo ix, tz'em winh ajmulal. Tato ay junok winh tz'ik'an pax junok ix spuknak sb'a yet' winh yetb'eyum chi', tz'empax winh ajmulal.
Ha junel ay jun winh te b'eyum. Wach' sb'o winh yet' spichul te karo stojol. Junjun k'u syak'an q'uinh winh, tzijtum tas syak' chijok winh.
Ay pax jun winh meb'a' skuch Lázaro, ayk'e yab'il yaxk'ha t'a winh. Tz'em k'ojan winh t'a sat lu'um t'a sti' spuertail spat winh b'eyum chi'.
Ha winh meb'a' chi', snib'ej winh swa jab'ok juntzanh sk'ajil wael tz'em t'a yalanh smexa winh b'eyum chi'. Axo nok' tz'i' b'at lek'anel sat yab'il yaxk'a ayk'e chi' t'a winh.
Ix k'och sk'ual ix cham winh meb'a' chi', haxo heb' ángel ix ik'anb'at winh t'a swach'ilal b'aj ayek' winhaj Abraham. Ix k'och pax sk'ual ix cham winh b'eyum chi'. Ix mukchaj winh.
Ix k'och spixan winh b'aj ay spixan heb' chamnakxo. Axo yik wan yab'an syail winh, ix k'e k'elan winh, najatto ix yilb'at winhaj Abraham chi' winh. Ayek' winhaj Lázaro t'a stz'ey winh.

Yuj chi' ix awaj winh b'eyum chi' icha tik: Mamin Abraham, ok'okab' a k'ool t'ayin. Checcot winhaj Lázaro chi', sch'ayan yiximal sk'ab' winh, tzul yak'anoch winh t'a snhi' wak' yik siklab' jab'ok, yujto max techaj wab'an syail t'a kal k'ak' tik, xchi winh.

Axo ix yalan winhaj Abraham chi': Ha ach tik, nakoti to te wach' ach ek' t'a yol yib'anhk’inal, haxo winhaj Lázaro tik, t'a syaelal ix ek' winh. Ha tiknaik jun, wan schaan sniwanil sk'ol winh t'a tik. Anhejtona' ach, wan ab'an syail ta'.
Ha junxo swala', ay jun niwan xab' olan t'a ko kal eyed'ok. Yuj chi', wach'chom ay heb' ay t'a tik, snib'ej sk'axpaj ta', max yal-laj. Anhejtona' ex, max yal-laj he k'axpajek' ta' t'a tik, xchi winh.
Tato icha chi' jun mamin, komonok tza chekb'at winhaj Lázaro chi' t'a spat winh in mam.
Ata' ay owanh heb' winh wuk'tak. Syalan winh yab' heb' winh yik wach' manh ol ja heb' winh wed' t'a skal yaelal tik, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Abraham chi': Ha t'a heb' ayek' juntzanh tas stz'ib'ejnakkan Moisés yet' heb' schekab' Dios. Yak'okab'och heb' t'a sk'ool tas syal juntzanh chi', xchi winh.
Manh k'okb'ilok jun chi' mamin, palta tato ol pitzwokxi junok t'a skal heb' chamnak yal yab' heb', ol ton sna sb'a heb', xchi winh.

Ix yalanxi winhaj Abraham chi': Tato max yak'och sk'ol heb' t'a tas stz'ib'ejnakkan Moisés yet' heb' schekab' Dios chi', wach'chom ay junok ol pitzwok t'a skal heb' chamnak, anhejtona' manh ol yak'och heb' t'a sk'ool, xchi winhaj Abraham chi' t'a winh, xchi Jesús.
Ix yalan Jesús t'a heb' sk'ayb'um: --Ay juntzanh tastak tz'ik'an somchajel spensar heb' anima, palta a wal mach tz'ak'an somchajel spensar heb' yetanimail, te chuk yiko'.
Octom b'ab'el spixjioch junok niwaquil k'een t'a sjaj, syumjikanb'at t'a yol ha' mar yik sjik' ha' schami, yakb'an manto yak' somchaj spensar junok uninto. Tato icha chi', te wach' yiko'.
Yuj chi' tzeyil wal he b'a. Tato ay junok eyetanimail tz'och smul t'ayex, tzeyal t'ay. Tato sna sb'a, tzeyak' niwank'olal.

Wach'chom uquel tz'och smul t'ayex t'a junok k'u, palta uquel sb'at yalxi sb'a t'ayex syalan icha tik: Hak'uin niwank'olal, manhxo ol in k'ulej junelxo, tato xchi, yowalil tzeyak' niwank'olal, xchi Jesús.
Ha heb' schekab' Jesús ix alan t'ay: --Ochanh qued'ok yik sko wach' ak'ejoch Dios t'a ko k'ool, xchi heb'.

Yuj chi' ix yalan t'a heb': --Tato yel tzeyak'och Dios t'a he k'ool, wach'chom jab'nhej, icha quilan junok pitanh sat anh mostaza, ol yal eyalan t'a jun niwan te' tik: Q'ueanhkot yet' sch'anhal ib'. Tzach b'atkan t'a yol ha' mar. B'at awejempax a b'a ta', tato xe chi, ol sk'anab'ajej te' icha tzeyal chi'.

Q'uinalok ay junok ko chekab' tzonh ak'an serwil. Tato ayb'at t'a ko munlajel, mato ayb'at iloj kalnel, ma iloj wakax, haxo yik sjaxi, ¿tom naan kalan t'ay? Ochanh, emanh k'ojan, wa''anh, ¿tom xko chi t'ay?
Maay jun. Tekan icha tik skutej kalan t'ay: Q'uexel a b'a, b'iquel a k'ab'. Tza b'oan in wael, tzak'ankot t'ayin. Ichato chi' ol ach wa ach tik, xko chi t'ay.
¿Tom skak' yuj diosal t'ay yujnhej to ix sk'anab'ajej tas ix kal chi'? Maay.

Icha jun chekab' chi', ichex ta'. Ayic toxo ix lajwi he k'anab'ajan masanil scheknab'il Dios, smoj tzeyal icha tik: Te malaj wach' kochi, anhej juntzanh tas ix chekji ko k'ulej ix ko b'o'o, xe chi, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Axo Jesús, anheja' sb'at t'a sb'eal Jerusalén, ix k'och t'a smojonal Samaria yet' Galilea.
Ayic ix k'och t'a jun aldea, ay lajunhwanh heb' winh penaay yuj jun yab'il skuch lepra. Yuj chi' maj snitzochlaj sb'a heb' winh t'a stz'ey Jesús,
tonhej ix awajkot heb' winh t'ay: --Mamin Jesús, ok'ok wal a k'ool t'ayonh, xchikot heb' winh.
Axo ix iljib'at heb' yuj Jesús, ix yalanb'at t'a heb': --Ixiquec, ix ch'oxek he b'ha t'a heb' sakerdote, xchi t'a heb' winh. Yakb'an wan sb'ey heb' winh, ipan sb'oxi heb' winh.
Ay jun winh t'a skal heb' winh chi', ayik ix yilan winh to toxo ix b'o sk'ool, ix meltzaj winh, ix och ijan winh yalan wach' lolonel d'ha Dios, ix awaj wal chaanh winh.
Ix jawi winh t'a yichanh Jesús, ix em kumnaj winh t'a sat lu'um yik syak'an yuj diosal winh t'ay. Aj Samaria jun winh chi'.
Yuj chi' ix yalan Jesús: --¿Tom manh lajunhwanhok heb' winh ix b'oxi sk'ool? ¿B'aj ay b'alunhwanhxo heb' winh chi'?
Ha jun winh tik, ch'ok chonhab'il winh, palta anhej winh ix ul alan wach' lolonel d'ha Dios.
Ix yalan Jesús t'a winh: --Q'ueanh waan, paxanh. Ach b'oxi yujto in ak'och t'a a k'ool, xchi t'a winh.
Ay juntzanh heb' winh fariseo ix k'anb'an t'a Jesús: --¿B'aq'uinh wal ol och Dios Cajaloc? xchi heb' winh t'ay. --Ayic ol och Dios Cajaloc, max yal-laj quilan yet' ko sat.
Max yal-laj kalani: Ayek' t'a tik, ma ayek' t'a chi', manh xko chiok, yujto ha t'a ko pixan tz'och Yajalil, xchi Jesús t'a heb' winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan t'a heb' sk'ayb'um: --Ay wal jun pekti’ ol jawok, ol eyalan icha tik: Tzoc wal jax junelxo jun Ak'b'ilkot yuj Dios t'a ko kal tik, wach'chom junnhejlaj k'ual, xe chama. Palta manhxo ol jalaj.
Ay heb' ol alanok: Ina yajek' t'a tik, ma ina yajek' t'a chi', xcham heb', palta manh ex b'atok, manh ex och tzak'an yuj heb'.
Yujto icha wal yek' kopnaj lheb'lon, sakb'i smasanil satcha’anh yuj, icha chi' ol aj in ja t'a jun k'ual a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik.
Palta yowalil ol in b'ab'laj ab'ej wal syail sik'lab'il. Ol in spatiquejel heb' anima t'a jun pekti’ tik.
Ayic ol in jaxok, lajan ol aj icha jun pekti’ ayik yek'nak winhaj Noé.

Yujto a heb' anima t'a jun pekti’ chi', ichnhejta' yek' k'u yuj heb': Swa heb', syuk'an ha' heb', ay heb' wan yoch yetb'eyum, ay heb' wan sk'anji yisil. Max snalaj heb' tato ay tas ol ja t'a yib'anh heb'. Icha chi' yek' tiempo yuj heb' masanto k'och sk'ual yoch winhaj Noé chi' t'a yol te' arka. Aton ta' kotnak jun niwan ha' mukwajum, laj cham heb' smasanil.
Icha pax chi', ujinak t'a stiempoal pax winhaj Lot: Swa heb', syuk'an ha' heb', smanwaj heb', schonhwaj heb', syawej tastak heb', slaj sb'oan spat heb'.
Ha wal yelkankot winhaj Lot t'a yol chonhab' Sodoma, yemul jun k'ak' yet' juntzanh kotak k'een chak xilinak. Icha wal yem nhab', icha chi' yemta t'a satcha’anh. Icha chi' aj scham heb' smasanil.
Icha wal ajnak t'a jun pekti’ chi', icha chi' ol aj in ja a in tik, xchi Jesús.
Ha t'a jun k'ual chi', tato ay heb' ayk'e t'a yib'anh spat, wach'chom ay tas aykan yuj heb' t'a yol spat, mokxob' emtalaj heb' yik'eli. Tato ay heb' ayb'at munlajel, mokxob' meltzaj heb' t'a spat.
Tze nakot tas ajnak ix yetb'eyum winhaj Lot chi'.
Ha heb' snib'ej skol sb'ha t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, ol satel sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej. Axo heb' syak'cham sb'a wuuj, ol scha sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej.
Swal t'ayex, tato ay chawanhok waynak t'a sat sch'at t'a jun ak'wal chi', ay jun ol ik'jokb'atok, ay junxo ol kanok.
Q'uinalok ay chawanhok heb' ix wan smol cheni, jun ix ol ik'jokb'atok, haxo junxo ix ol kanok, xchi Jesús t'a heb' sk'ayb'um chi'.
Ayic ix yab'an jun chi' heb', ix sk'anb'an heb' t'ay: --¿B'ajtil ol ujok jun chi' Mamin? xchi heb'. --Icha tz'ajk'och nok' ostok b'aj ay junok chamnak nok', icha chi' ol ajok, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Ay jun ab'ix ix yal Jesús t'a heb' sk'ayb'um, yik snachajel yuj heb' to max yal stzaktzaj heb' yak'an lesal t'a masanil tiempo.
Icha tik ix yutej yalan t'a heb': --Ha junel ay jun winh juez t'a jun chonhab'. Malaj yelk'och Dios t'a sat winh. Malaj pax yelk'och heb' anima t'a winh.
Ha t'a jun chonhab' chi', ay jun ix chamnak yetb'eyum. Junjun k'u b'at sk'an ix t'a winh juez chi' to sb'o yaj yowal ix.
Te niwanxo tiempo tz'eq'ui, malaj snib'ej winh juez chi' sb'oan yaj t'a ix. Palta yib'anhtaquilto ix snaan winh: Wach'chom max in k'anab'ajej Dios, malaj pax tz'och heb' anima t'ayin,
palta a jun ix tik, ol in b'o yaj yowal ix, yujto junjun k'u tzul awaj ochta ix t'ayin. Tato maay, manhxo ol techajlaj ix wuuj, xchi winh.
Icha chi' ix yutej winh juez chuk chi' snaani.
Axo pax Dios, ¿tom manh ol sb'o yaj t'a heb' sik'b'ilel yuj, heb' tz'awtan t'a k'ual t'ak'wal? ¿Tom ol ek' tiempo skolwaj t'a heb' tze na'a?

Swal t'ayex, ol sb'o yaj t'a heb' t'a elanhchamel. Palta a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, ayik ol in jaxok, ¿ay am heb' aytoek' t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, anheja' ayoch Dios t'a sk'ool? xchi Jesús Kajal.
Ix yalanxi junxo ab'ix tik Jesús t'a juntzanh heb' wach' spensar snaani. Ha t'a sat heb' chi', malaj swach'il juntzanhxo heb' anima. Yuj chi', icha tik ix aj yalan t'a heb':
--Ay chawanh heb' winh winak ix b'at lesal t'a yamaq'uil stemplo Dios. Ay jun winh fariseo, ay pax jun winh tekumel alkabar.

Ayic ix k'och winh fariseo chi', ix k'e linhan winh. Ix lesalwi winh icha tik: Ach in Diosal, swak' yuj diosal t'ayach, yujto manh in lajanok yet' juntzanhxo heb' anima. Ha heb' chi', elk'um heb', manh wach'ok syutej sb'a heb', tz'em heb' t'a ajmulal. Yed' pax jun winh tekumel alkabar tik, swak' yuj diosal t'ayach yujto manh in lajanok yet' winh.
Yujto a in tik, chael tzin och t'a tzek'ojk'olal t'a junjun semana. Anhejtona' swak' sdiezmoal t'ayach yuj jantak tas swak' ganar, xchi winh.

Axo pax winh tekumel alkabar chi', najatto ix kotkan linhan winh, yujto xiw winh, manh jab'ok ix k'e k'elan winh t'a satcha’anh. Ix smak' snhi' sk'ol winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: Ach in Diosal, ok'ok wal a k'ool t'ayin, te chuk in, xchi winh d'ha Dios.

Ha in tik swala' to ayik ix pax winh tekumel alkabar chi', wach'xo winh t'a yichanh Dios. Axo pax winh fariseo chi', manh wach'ok winh t'a yichanh Dios, yujto a heb' syik'chaanh sb'a, ol ik'jokxiemta heb'. Axo heb' syik'emta sb'a, niwan ol aj yelk'och heb', xchi Jesús.

Ay heb' mamab'il ix ik'ankot heb' yuninal t'a Jesús yik syak'ek' sk'ab' t'a yib'anh heb'. Ayic ix yilan heb' sk'ayb'um to icha chi', ix kot yowal heb' t'a heb' ix ik'ankot heb' chi', ix kachji heb' yuj heb'.

Axo Jesús ix awtankot heb' sk'ayb'um chi', ix yalan t'a heb': --Chaeccot heb' unin t'ayin. Manh he kachoch waan heb', yujto anhej heb' lajan spensar icha heb' unin tik, anhej heb' ay yalan yik yoch t'a yol sk'ab' Dios.
Val yel swal t'ayex, a heb' max chaan Dios Yajaloc icha syutej heb' unin schaani, malaj b'ak'uinh ol och heb' t'a yol sk'ab', xchi Jesús.
Ay jun winh yajal t'a skal heb' ix k'anb'an t'a Jesús: --Ach wach' k'ayb'um, ¿tas wach' tzin k'ulej yik tzin chaan in k 'inal t'a junelnhej? xchi winh.
--¿Tas yuj tzin al wach'il? Malaj junok mach wach', anhejton Dios wach'.

Ha ach tik, ojtak scheknab'il Dios syal icha tik: Manh ex em t'a ajmulal. Manh he milcham junok eyetanimail. Manh ex elk'anok. Manh eyak'och es t'a yib'anh junok eyetanimail. k'anab'ajejek he mam he nun, xchi Jesús t'a winh.
--Yictax unin in, ix in k'anab'ajej masanil juntzanh cheknab'il tik, xchi winh t'ay.

--Palta ayto junxo a paltail. Ixic, chonhkanel masanil tastak ay t'ayach, tzak'an stojol t'a heb' meb'a', ichato chi' ol aj a b'eyumal t'a satcha’anh. Slajwi chi', tzach jaxi, tzach och in k'ayb'umok, xchi Jesús t'a winh.
Axo ix yab'an juntzanh chi' winh, ix te kus winh, yujto te b'eyum winh.
Axo ix yilan Jesús to ix te och winh ilk'olal, ix yalani: --Ay wal smay manh ol ochlaj heb' b'eyum t'a yol sk'ab' Dios.
Q'uinalok ay junok nok' kamello, ¿tom ol yal yek' nok' t'a yixal junok k'een akxa? Icha chi' yaj heb' b'eyum. Tato ol och heb', pural ol och heb' t'a yol sk'ab' Dios, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Axo heb' ix ab'an jun chi' ix yalan heb': --A... tato icha chi' jun, ¿mach pax heb' ol kolchajok? xchi heb'.
--Ha tas max yal-laj yuj heb' anima, haxo Dios masanil syal yuj, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Axo winhaj Pedro ix alan t'ay: --Mamin, a onh tik ix kaktejkan juntzanh tastak yik tzonh och a k'ayb'umok, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalan Jesús t'a heb': --Val yel swal t'ayex, a heb' syaktejkan spat, ma smam snun, yuk'tak, yanab', ix yetb'eyum, yuninal yet' yisil yujto axonhej Dios snib'ej heb' syak' serwil,
niwan spak ol scha heb' t'a jun pekti’ tik, haxo t'a junxo tiempoal ol jawok, ol scha sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.

Ha Jesús ix awtankot heb' lajchawanh chi' sch'okojil, ix yalan t'a heb': --Ha tiknaik wan ko b'at t'a Jerusalén. Ata' ol ujok elk'och jantaknhej tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj heb' schekab' Dios t'a peka' yik yalannakkan wab'ixal heb', a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik.
Ata' ol in ak'jokoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il. Ol in sb'uch heb'. Ol laj yal chuk heb' t'ayin. Ol in stzub'ej heb'.
Ol in smak' heb'. Slajwi chi', ol in smilancham heb'. Axo t'a schab'jial, ol in pitzwokxi, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Palta maj nachajel-laj jab'ok yuj heb'. Manh yojtakoklaj heb' tas wan yalan chi', yujto max nachajel-laj yuj heb'.
Ayic wanxo sk'och Jesús t'a chonhab' Jericó, ay jun winh max uji yilani, k'ojan ek' winh t'a ti' b'e, wan sk'anan stumin winh.
Ix yab'an winh to tzijtum anima wan yek' t'a yol b'e chi', yuj chi' ix sk'anb'an yab' winh tas wan yuji.
Ix yalan heb' t'a winh to a Jesús aj Nazaret wan yek' t'a yol b'e chi'.
Yuj chi', ix awajk'e winh, ix yalan winh: --Jesús, yinhtil ach kan winhaj Dawid, ok'ok wal a k'ol t'ayin, xchi winh.
Ha heb' b'ab'el sb'at chi' ix kachan winh yik tz'em numan winh. Palta masnhej ix awajk'e winh: --Ach yinhtilalkan winhaj Dawid, ok'ok wal a k'ol t'ayin, xchi winh.
Yuj chi', ix och tek'naj Jesús chi', ix schekan ik'jokkot winh. Axo yik ix ja winh t'a slak'anil, ix sk'anb'an t'a winh:
--¿Tas a gana tzach wutej? xchi t'a winh. --Mamin, in gana sb'oxikan wilani, xchi winh.
--B'ookab'xikan ilani. Tzach b'oxikani yujto in ak'och t'a a k'ool, xchi Jesús t'a winh.
D'a jun rato chi', ix b'oxikan yilan winh, ix och tzak'an winh yuj Jesús. Ix yalan wach' lolonel winh d'ha Dios. Anhejtona', a jantak heb' ix ilan jun chi', ix yal pax wach' lolonel heb' d'ha Dios.
Ix k'och Jesús t'a Jericó, ix ek' t'a yol chonhab' chi'.
Ata' ay jun winh b'eyum skuchan Zaqueo. Yajal yaj winh t'a heb' tekumel alkabar t'a jun chonhab' chi'.
Snib'ej winh yilani chajtil yilji Jesús. Palta max yal-laj yilan winh, yujto tzijtum anima oyanoch t'a spatik Jesús chi' ayik wan sb'eyi, yujto tzapan pax steel winh.
Ix b'ab'lajb'at lemnaj winh, ix k'e winh t'a sk'ab' jun te te' ayek' t'a ti' b'e, yik syil winh yek' Jesús chi'.
Axo yik ix ek' Jesús chi' ta', ix k'e k'elnaj t'a winh, ix yalan t'a winh: --Zaqueo, emanhkot elanhchamel, yujto a tiknaik ha t'a a pat ol wak' in posado, xchi t'a winh.
Ayic ix yab'an winh icha chi', elanhchamel ix emta winh. Axo ix k'och Jesús chi' t'a spat winh, ix scha winh t'a tzalajk'olal.
Axo masanil heb' anima, manh jantakok ix yal heb' t'a spatik Jesús, yujto ix k'och yak' sposado t'a spat jun winh chuk sb'eyb'al chi'.

Axo winhaj Zaqueo chi' ix k'e linhan, ix yalan winh t'a Jesús Kajal: --Ha tiknaik Mamin, a jantak tas ay t'ayin, chapoj ol wutok. Ol wak' junok makan t'a heb' meb'a'. Tato ay mach ix laj wixtej, ix welk'ej, chanhel ol wak'pax sk'exul t'a heb', xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalan Jesús chi': --Ha tiknaik, ix cha skolnab'il winh aj pat tik, yujto wal yel yinhtilalpaxkan Abraham winh.
Ha in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, in jawi in say heb' satnak yik tzin kolanel heb', xchi Jesús chi'.

Yakb'an wan yab'an heb' anima tas ix yal Jesús chi', ay jun ab'ix ix yal t'a heb', yujto wan sk'och heb' t'a slak'anil Jerusalén. Ha snaan heb' to toxo ol wach' och Dios Yajalil t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik.
Icha tik ix yutej yalan t'a heb': --Ha junel ay jun winh winak yinhtilkan heb' niwak yelk'ochi. Ix b'at winh t'a jun chonhab' te najat, yik tz'ak'jioch winh reyal t'a schonhab'.

Ayic manto b'at winh, ix yawtankot lajunhwanh heb' schekab' winh. Ix yak'an juntzanh k'een tumin winh t'a heb'. Niwac sat k'een. Jun lajan k'een ix scha junjun heb'. Ix yalan winh t'a heb': Hak'ek he negokio yet' k'een tumin tik, masanto ol in jaxok, ichato chi' ol eyak'anxi k'een t'ayin, xchi winh t'a heb'. Ix b'at winh b'ian.

Axo heb' yetchonhab' winh, ix te chichon sk'ool heb' t'a winh. Ix schekanb'at jaywanh winak heb' t'a spatik winh, yik syalan heb': Ha jun winh tik, malaj ko gana tz'och winh reyal t'a ko chonhab' tik, xchi heb'.

Wach'chom icha chi' ix yal heb', ix ochnhej winh t'a yopisio chi'. Axo yik ix jax winh, ix laj yawtankot heb' schekab' winh chi', machtak heb' b'aj yak'nakkan k'een tumin chi' winh, yik syab' winh jantakxo yune' k'een ix yak' ganar junjun heb'.
Ix b'ab'laj k'och jun t'a winh, ix yalani: Mamin patrón, a k'een tumin ak'nakkan t'ayin, lajunhexo yune' k'een ix yak' ganar, xchi t'a winh.

Axo ix yalan winh yajal chi': Wach' jun. Ha ach tik, te wach' ach t'ayin. Wach'chom quennhej ix wak' t'ayach, palta wach' ix utej a b'a yet'ok. Yuj chi', swak'och opisio och yajalil t'a lajunheok chonhab', xchi winh t'ay.
Ixlajwi chi', ix k'och junxo schekab' winh chi'. Mamin patrón, a k'een a tumin ak'nakkan t'ayin, oyexo yune' k'een ix yak' ganar, xchi.
Yuj chi' ix yalanxi winh: Wach' jun. Yuj chi' ol ach wak'och yajalil t'a oye' chonhab', xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix k'och junxo schekab' winh chi', ix yalan t'a winh: Patrón, ina k'een a tumin tik. Sik'b'ilb'at k'een wuuj t'a yol jun in payu'.
Ha in tik tzin xiwi, yujto wojtak ach to junnhej b'elanh ach, yujto a ach tik, toxonhej tza cha iquej tas syak' ganar junxo anima. Toxonhej tza jach'a', palta malaj tas tzawej, xchi t'a winh.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winh yajal chi': Ha ach tik wach'chom in chekab' ach, palta te chuk ach. Yuj juntzanh tzal tik, swak'kanb'at t'a ib'anh. Yujto a ach wal tzala' to junnhej b'elanh in. Toxonhej tzin cha wiquej tas syak' ganar junxo anima. Toxonhej tzin jach'a', palta malaj tas swawej.
Tato icha chi' tzutej a naan t'a wib'anh, ¿tas yuj maj ak'b'at k'een majanil t'a junokxo, haxo tzin jax tik tzin chaanxi k'een yet' yune'? xchi winh t'ay.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan t'a heb' ayek' yet' chi': Iq'ek ek' k'een t'a winh, tzeyak'an k'een t'a winh ix ak'an ganar lajunhe' yune' yiko', xchi winh t'a heb'.
Axo ix yalan heb': Palta mamin patrón, lajunhexo k'een ay t'a winh, xchi heb'.
Palta swal t'ayex, a mach ayxo yiko', ol wach' ak'jok nanhalokxo t'ay. Axo heb' malaj yiko', ol wach' ik'joquek' tas ay t'a heb'.
Yed' pax heb' wajk'ool, heb' malaj snib'ej tzin och yajalil, ik'ekkot heb'. Mileccham heb' t'a wichanh tik, xchi winh yajal chi', xchi Jesús.
Ixlajwi yalan jun ab'ix chi' Jesús, ix schaan pax sb'e, ix b'ab'laj yuj heb' sk'ayb'um yik sk'e heb' t'a Jerusalén.
Ayic wan sk'och Jesús chi' yet' heb' t'a slak'anil Betfagé yet' Betania, t'a yichanhb'at tzalan Oliwo t'a slak'anil Jerusalén, ix schekanb'at chawanh heb' sk'ayb'um.
Ayic manto b'at heb', ix yalan t'a heb': --Ixiquec t'a jun chonhab' t'a quichanhb'at tik. Ata' ol eyil jun nok' b'uru, etzanoch nok'. Mantalaj mach sk'e t'a yib'anh nok'. Tze tijankot nok'.
Tato ay mach tz'alan t'ayex: ¿Tas yuj tze tijelta nok'? ta xchi heb', tzeyalan t'a heb': Ha Cajalil ay tz'och nok' yuj, xe chi, xchi Jesús chi' t'a heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at heb' sk'ayb'um chi'. Icha ix yutej yalan Jesús chi' t'a heb', icha chi' ix aj yilchaj nok' b'uru chi' yuj heb'.
Axo yik wan stijanelta nok' heb', ix k'och heb' aj b'uru chi', ix yalan heb': --¿Tas yuj tze tijelta nok'? xchi heb'.
--To ay ol och nok' yuj Cajalil, xchi heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'anb'at nok' heb' t'a Jesús chi'. Ix yak'anoch spichul heb' stz'amok nok', ix yak'ank'e Jesús chi' heb' t'a yib'anh nok'.
Axo yik wan sb'eyi, ay heb' ix laj lich'anem spichul t'a yol b'e t'a yichanh b'aj sb'eyb'at chi'.

Axo yik wan sk'och heb' t'a jun b'e spichlaj em t'a tzalan Oliwo, a jantak heb' sk'ayb'um, ix laj och ijan heb' yawajk'e yuj tzalajk'olal. Ix laj yalan wach' lolonel heb' d'ha Dios yuj juntzanh milagro ix yil heb'.
Ix laj yalan heb' icha tik: --Calec wach' lolonel t'a ko reyal chekb'ilkot yuj Dios Kajal. Te ay junk'olal t'a satcha’anh, te niwan yelk'och ko Diosal ta', xchi heb'.
Ay juntzanh heb' winh fariseo ayek' t'a skal heb' anima chi' ix alan t'a Jesús chi': --Ach k'ayb'um, ¿tas yuj max a kach heb' a k'ayb'um tik? xchi heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalan Jesús t'a heb' winh: --Swal t'ayex tato tz'em numan heb', haxo juntzanh k'een k'een tik ol awajk'eok, xchi t'a heb'.
Axo yik wan sk'och Jesús t'a Jerusalén, ix yilanb'at jun chonhab' chi', ix ok' yuj.
Ix yalani: --Ex aj Jerusalén, oktom wal snachajel eyuuj t'a jun k'u tik chajtil tz'aj he chaan sjunk'olal Dios, palta a tiknaik, maxtzak yal-laj snachajel eyuuj, yujto toxo ix k'ub'chajel t'ayex.
Yuj chi' ay jun pekti’ ol ja t'a eyib'anh, a heb' eyajk'ool, ol och oyan heb' t'a spatik yichanh he chonhab' tik. Ol laj yoyan sb'a heb' t'a he patik, ol yak'an owal heb' eyed'ok.

Ol laj smak'em weknaj jun chonhab' tik heb' t'a sat lu'um. Ol smilancham heb' anima chi' heb'. Axo k'een k'een latz'b'ilk'ei, manhxa junok k'een ol kan t'a yib'anh k'een yetk'enal chi'. Ha jun tik ol ja t'a eyib'anh yujto ha t'a jun pekti’ tik ix ja Dios t'ayex, palta max nachajel eyuuj, xchi Jesús.
Ixlajwi chi' ix k'och Jesús t'a yol yamaq'uil stemplo Dios. Ix spechanelta heb' schonhwaji yet' heb' smanwaji.

Ix yalan t'a heb': --Tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a Slolonel Dios icha tik: Ha in pat, yiknhej lesal yaji, xchi. Ha exxo tik, icha junok k'een nhak'een b'aj sk'ub'ejel sb'a heb' elk'um, icha chi' tzeyutej, xchi t'a heb'.

Junjun k'u ix k'och Jesús chi' sk'ayb'ej anima t'a yamaq'uil stemplo Dios chi'. Axo heb' winh sakerdote, heb' winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés yet' heb' winh yajalil jun chonhab' chi', ix say heb' winh tas syutej heb' winh smilanchamok.
Palta maj yal-laj yuj heb' winh, yujto ayoch t'a sk'ool heb' anima smaklan yab' t'ay.

D'a jun k'u chi' ix k'ayb'aj heb' anima t'a yamaq'uil stemplo Dios yuj Jesús. Ix yalan wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il t'a heb'. Ix k'och heb' winh sakerdote, heb' winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés yet' heb' winh ichamtak winak ay yopisio.
Ix yalan heb' winh t'a Jesús chi': --Al t'ayonh, tas aji, yuj chi' tza k'ulej juntzanh chi', ¿mach ak'jinak opisio chi'? xchi heb' winh t'ay.
--Ay pax jun tas tzin k'anb'ej t'ayex. Alec t'ayin,
¿mach ak'jinak yopisio winhaj Juan ayik ix yak'an bautizar heb' ix laj k'och t'a winh? ¿Am Dios ak'jinak, mato anima? xchi Jesús chi' t'a heb' winh.
Ix yal-lan yab' heb' winh: --¿Tas skutej ko pakan t'a winh? Tato skala' to ha Dios ix ak'ankot winhaj Juan chi', axom ol yalan winh: ¿Tas yuj maj eyak'och t'a he k'ol jun? xcham winh.
Palta tato skala' to yik heb' anima, axom heb' anima ol onh sjulk'enejcham heb', yujto a winhaj Juan chi', schekab' ton Dios yaj winh t'a yichanh heb', xchi heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalan heb' winh to manh yojtakok heb' mach ak'jinak yopisio winhaj Juan chi'.
Ix yalan Jesús chi' t'a heb' winh: --Tato icha chi', manh ol walpaxlaj t'ayex mach ak'jinak wopisio yik tzin k'ulan juntzanh tik, xchi t'a heb' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan jun ab'ix tik Jesús t'a heb' ayek' chi' ta': --Ay jun winh ix awan juntzanh te' uwa t'a sat sluum. Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'ankanb'at sluum winh chi' majanil yet' masanil yawb'en te' chi'. Ixlajwi chi', niwan tiempo ix b'atkan winh.

Axo yik ix k'och stiempoal smoljiel sat te' uwa chi', ix schekb'at jun schekab' winh yik sk'anan smajananub'al lu'um. Axo heb' ix majnan lu'um chi' ix mak'ani, ix spechan meltzaj heb', malaj jab'ok tas ix yak' heb' t'ay.
Yuj chi' ix schekb'at junxo schekab' winh aj lu'um chi'. Palta anheja' ix stumej heb', ix smak'an pax heb', ix spechan meltzaj heb', malaj jab'ok tas ix yak' heb' t'ay.
Ix schekanxib'at junxo schekab' winh, haxo heb' ix majnan lu'um chi' ix mak'ani, ix spechan meltzaj heb'.
Axo ix snaan winh aj lu'um chi': ¿Tas tzin k'ulej tiknaik? Ol in chekb'at jun wuninal te xajan wuuj. Tekan ol xiw heb' t'ay, xchi winh.

Axo ix k'och winh uninab'il chi', ix slajtian sb'a heb' majnum lu'um chi'. Ix yalan heb': Ina sja winh uninab'il b'aj ol kan lum lum tik. Co mak'ekcham winh, yik wach' a onhxo ol quiquejkan lu'um, xchi heb'.
Yuj chi', ix snheranel winh heb' t'a stiel awb'en chi', ix smak'ancham winh heb'. Tzin k'anb'ej t'ayex, ¿tas ol utaj heb' majnum lum chi' yuj winh aj lu'um chi' tze na'a?

Axo lak'an winh ol b'atok. Ol b'at smak'ancham juntzanh heb' majnum lu'um chi' winh. Ol yak'anxikanb'at lu'um winh majanil t'a juntzanhxo, xchi Jesús t'a heb' winh. Ayic ix yab'an jun tik heb' anima, ix yalan heb': --Comonoc malaj b'ak'uinh ol ujok icha chi', xchi heb'.

Axo Jesús ix och k'elan t'a heb', ix yalani: --Tato icha chi', ¿tas syalelk'och juntzanh tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a Slolonel Dios tze na'a? Syal icha tik: Ha jun k'een k'een malaj yelk'och t'a yichanh heb' b'oum pat, aton k'een ix ochkan sjolomok schiquin te' pat chi', xchikani.
Tato ay junok mach tz'em tanhnaj t'a yib'anh jun k'een chi', chok' tz'aji. Tato a k'een tz'em tanhnaj t'a yib'anh junokxo, icha pokok tz'aji, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.

Ha heb' winh sat sakerdote yet' heb' winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés, ix snib'ej heb' winh syam Jesús t'a elanhchamel, yujto ix snael heb' winh to a heb' winh wan yalani, palta ix xiw heb' winh t'a heb' anima.

Yuj chi' ix chekjib'at jaywanh heb' winh yila' talaj tz'och smul Jesús chi'. Ha ix k'och heb' winh, wach' ix yutej sb'a heb' winh t'a yichanh Jesús chi'. Ix stz'akan sk'umej heb' winh yik slektaj t'a slolonel, yik syak'anoch heb' winh t'a yol sk'ab' heb' winh yajal.

Yuj chi' ix stz'ak sk'anb'ej heb' winh t'ay: --Mamin k'ayb'um, kojtak to tojol tzutej a loloni yet' pax onh a k'ayb'ani. Manhoklaj yilji anima tzila', yujto lajannhej yelk'och junjun anima t'ayach. Cojtak paxi to tzonh a k'ayb'ej t'a tas snib'ej Dios t'a wal yel.
Yuj chi' al t'ayonh: ¿Tom wach' skak' juntzanh tumin sk'anjiel t'ayonh yuj winh yajal t'a Roma, mato maay? xchi heb' winh t'ay.
Ix snael Jesús to chuk spensar heb' winh sk'anb'an heb' winh. Yuj chi' ix yalan t'a heb' winh:
--Ch'oxek junok tumin chi' wila''. ¿Mach jun ayoch sat tik yet' sb'i tik t'a k'een? xchi t'a heb' winh. --Aton sat winh yajal t'a Roma yet' sb'i winh, xchi heb' winh.
Yuj chi', ix yalan t'a heb' winh: --Ha tas yiktaxon winh yajal chi' yaji, aq'ek t'a winh. Palta a tas yiktaxon Dios yaji, aq'ek d'ha Dios chi', xchi t'a heb' winh.
Malaj junok tas ix yal chi' b'aj ix ak'ji ganar yuj heb' yik syaman heb'. Ix te sat sk'ool heb' yab'an tas ix spak chi', manhxalaj tas ix yal heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ay juntzanh heb' winh sadukeo ix k'och t'a Jesús. Aton heb' winh tik tz'alani to manh ol pitzwokxi heb' chamnak, yuj chi' ix yalan heb' winh t'ay:

--Mamin k'ayb'um, a winhaj Moisés tz'ib'annakkan icha tik: Tato ay junok winh winak schami, skan ix yetb'eyum winh, palta malaj yuninal winh skani, tato icha chi', haxo winh yuk'tak winh, tz'ik'anpaxkan ix ix chi', yik wach' tato tz'aj yuninal heb', ichato a winh ix cham chi' ay yiko'. Icha chi' ix yalkan winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ha junel ay ukwanh heb' winh yuk'tak sb'a. Ha winh b'ab'el winak ik'an jun ix ix, palta cham winh, malaj yuninal heb' kani.
Axo junxo yuk'tak winh ik'anxikan ix. Palta cham junxo winh chi'. Malaj yuninal heb' kanxi.
Slajwi chi', haxo winh yoxil ik'anxi ix. Anhejtona' yik'nak ix heb' winh yukwanhil. Cham heb' winh smasanil. Malaj junok heb' winh elkan yuninal yet' ix.
Axo t'a slajwub'xo, scham ix.
Axo ol pitzwokxi heb' chamnak, ¿mach junok heb' winh ol ik'an ix yujto yik'nak ix heb' winh yukwanhil? xchi heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalan Jesús t'a heb' winh sadukeo chi': --Ha t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, syik'laj sb'a heb' anima.
Palta ay wal junxo lugar. Ha heb' ol pitzwokxi t'a skal heb' chamnak, heb' smoj sk'ochkan ta', ata' manhxalaj ik'lajb'ail. Manhxo ol yak'b'at yisil heb' k'anjok.
Yujto ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', manhxo ol chamlaj heb'. Lajan ol aj heb' yet' heb' ángel. Yuninal ton Dios ol aj heb', yujto ol pitzwokxi heb'.

Anhejtona' t'a winhaj Moisés chi' yalnakkan Dios t'a skal te' q'uiix ayoch sk'ak'al, ata' yak'nak kojtaquejeli to ol pitzwokxi heb' chamnak, b'aj yalnakkan icha tik: Ha in ton tik sDiosal in winhaj Abraham, winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Jacob, xchi.
Yuj chi', wach'chom chamnak heb' winh chi', kojtak to manh satnakoquel heb' winh t'a junelnhej, yujto yalnak Dios to sDiosal heb' winh yaji. Ha t'a sat Dios, pitzan heb' anima smasanil, xchi Jesús.
Ay juntzanh heb' winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés ix alan t'ay: --Yel ton tzal Mamin k'ayb'um, xchi heb' winh.
Yuj chi' manhxalaj tas syal sk'anb'an heb' winh t'ay.
Ix yalan Jesús t'a heb' winh: --¿Tas yuj ay heb' tz'alani to a Cristo yinhtilal Dawid yaji?
Yujto anheja' winhaj Dawid chi' alanxikan t'a jun libro yik Salmos: Ha Dios Kajal alannak t'a Vajalil icha tik: Emanh k'ojan t'a in wach' k'ab' tik,
masanto ol wak'kanoch heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach t'a yalanh ok, xchi Dios t'a Vajalil, xchi winhaj Dawid chi'.
Icha chi' yutejnakkan winhaj Dawid yalani to a Cristo ayoch yajalok winh, yuj chi' kojtak to a Cristo chi', manh yinhtilaloknhej Dawid chi' yaji, xchi Jesús t'a heb' winh.
Ayic wan yab'an heb' anima smasanil, ix yalan Jesús icha tik t'a heb' sk'ayb'um:

--Tzeyil wal he b'a yik manh ol ex juwoquel yuj sb'eyb'al heb' winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés, yujto scham wal b'at heb' winh yet' juntzanh spichul jukan. Snib'ej heb' winh to tz'em nhojan heb' anima t'a heb' winh b'aj ay merkado. Ha sk'an heb' winh to ha t'a xila heb' niwak winak tz'em k'ojjab' heb' winh t'a yoltak spatil kulto. Ayic tz'och wael, snib'ej heb' winh tz'em k'ojjab' b'aj tz'em k'ojan heb' winh niwak yelk'ochi.

Syik'anpaxek' heb' winh tas ay t'a heb' ix chamnak yetb'eyum yet' pax spat heb' ix. Slajwi chi', najat syutej yok slesal heb' winh, yik a snaan heb' anima to malaj smul heb' winh. Palta a heb' winh chi', yelxo wal niwan yaelal ol ak'jokoch t'a yib'anh heb' winh, xchi Jesús chi'.
Ha junel, ayek' Jesús t'a yamaq'uil templo. Van yilani chajtil syutej heb' b'eyum yak'anem yofrenda t'a yol jun chalab' ofrenda.
Ix yilani ix k'och jun ix chamnak yetb'eyum te meb'a'. Ix yak'anem chab' kotak tumin ix t'a yool.
Yuj chi', ix yalan Jesús chi' t'a heb' ayek' ta' yet'ok: --Val yel swal t'ayex, a jun ix te meb'a' tik, ek'alto yik ix, ix yak' t'a yichanh heb' ix laj yak' yiko'.
Ay heb' axonhej sobreal stumin syak'a'. Axo ix meb'a' tik, jantaknhej jab' stumin ix ayeq'ui ix yak'em ix yofrendaok. Manhxalaj tas ix kan t'a ix, xchi t'a heb'.
Ay juntzanh heb' wan yalani to te wach' yilji stemplo Dios, wach' yaj yet' juntzanh k'een k'een latz'b'ab'iloch t'ay yet' juntzanh tastak siaj t'ay. Yuj chi' ix yal Jesús t'a heb':
--Ha juntzanh wan eyilan tik, ay jun pekti’ ol lajwoquel smasanil. Manhxalaj junok k'een latz'b'ab'ilk'e tik ol kan t'a yib'anh k'een yetk'eenal, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'ej heb' t'ay: --Ach ko k'ayb'umal, ¿b'aq'uinh ol ujok juntzanh chi'? ¿Tas wal yechel ol sch'ox Dios, ayik toxo ol ujok jun chi'? xchi heb' t'ay.

Yuj chi' ix yalan t'a heb': --Tzeyil wal he b'a yik manh ol ex ak'jok musansatil, yujto tzijtum heb' ol jawok, ol yesanel in b'i heb'. Ol yalan heb': Ha in tik Cristo in, xcham heb'. Ol yalanpax heb': Axo wal sja stiempoal tik, xcham heb'. Manh ex b'at k'elan t'a heb'.

Ayic ol eyab'an spekal yoch niwak owal, haxo yak'anpax owal heb' komon anima yet' heb' yajal, manh ex te xiwok, yujto a juntzanh chi' yowalil ol b'ab'laj ujok, palta manhoklaj t'a jun ratoal chi' ol lajwoquel yol yib'anhk’inal tik, xchi Jesús chi' t'a heb'.
Ix yalanpaxi: --Ol och owal t'a skal juntzanh niwak nakión.

Ay juntzanh niwak quixkab' ol laj ek'ok. Ol laj jawok wejel, ol laj yamchaj juntzanh anima yuj niwak ilya t'a junjun chonhab'. Axo t'a satcha’anh, tzijtum tas ol laj sch'ox sb'a. Ay pax juntzanh niwak yechel ol sch'ox sb'ha t'a satcha’anh, ol te xiwpax heb' anima yuj juntzanh chi'.

Palta ayik manto ujok juntzanh chi', ay heb' ol ex yamanok, ol yak' chukal heb' t'ayex. Yujto in k'ayb'um ex, yuj chi' ol laj ex yik'b'at heb' t'a yoltak spatil kulto yik ol yak'anoch heb' t'a eyib'anh. Ol ex yak'och heb' t'a preso, ol ex yik'b'at heb' t'a yichanh heb' winh rey yet' heb' winh yajal.
Yuj juntzanh tas ol ak'jokoch t'a eyib'anh chi' ol yal eyalanel wab'ixal t'a yichanh heb' winh yajal chi'.
Manh he b'ab'laj naej yuj tas ol eyutej he kolan he b'ha t'a heb',
yujto a in ol in b'o eyala'. Ol wak' he jelanil t'a tas ol eyala'. Yuj chi' malaj heb' ajk'ool ol yal spakan t'ayex. Malaj junok heb' ol tzak'wan sjelanil t'ayex icha he jelanil ol wak'a'.
Palta a ex tik, a he mam he nun, heb' eyuk'tak, heb' he k'ab' eyok yet' heb' eyamigo, ol meltzaj och heb' ajk'olal t'ayex. Ay ex ol ex smilcham heb'.
Axo masanil heb' anima ay t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, ol och heb' ajk'olal t'ayex, yujto ayoch he pensar t'ayin.
Palta manh ol ex satel-laj, manh wal junok xil he jolom ol satb'atok.
Tato tek'an tzeyutej he b'a, ol eyak' ganar he chaan he k 'inal t'a wal yel.
Ayic ol eyilani to oyb'ilxok'e Jerusalén yuj heb' soldado, nachajokab'el eyuuj to wan slajwiel jun chonhab' chi'.

Axo heb' ayek' t'a yol yik Judea tik, b'atokab'kan heb' elelal t'a tzalquixtak. Ha heb' ayek' t'a chonhab' Jerusalén tik, b'atokab' pax heb' elelal. Axo heb' ayb'at t'a smunlajel, manhxookab' ochta heb' t'a yol chonhab' tik,
yujto a wal t'a jun pekti’ chi', ol ja jun niwan yaelal yuj yowal sk'ool Dios. Ato ta' ol elk'och jantak tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a Slolonel Dios.

Ob'iltak heb' ix yab'ix t'a jun pekti’ chi' yet' heb' ix wanto schuni yune', yujto niwan yaelal ol ja t'a yib'anh heb' anima t'a juntzanh lugar tik. Ol yak'kot yowal sk'ool Dios t'a yib'anh heb' quetisraelal.

Nanhal heb' ol cham yuj jun owal chi'. Axo nanhalxo heb', ol b'atkan heb' preso t'a ch'ok chonhab'il. Axo heb' ch'ok chonhab'il chi' ol ixtan Jerusalén tik, masanto ol lajwok stiempoal yak'an yajalil heb', icha yalnakkan Dios.

Ay pax juntzanh yechel ol sch'ox sb'ha t'a k'u, t'a k'een uj yet' t'a k'een k'anal. Axo juntzanh nakión, ol laj somchaj heb' yuj xiwelal, yujto ol k'anh sk'e waan ha' mar, ol k'anh pax yemxi ponhnaj ha'.
Ol laj te xiw heb' anima ayik ol snaan heb' tas ol ujok t'a jun yol yib'anhk’inal tik, yujto ol tzikub'tanhaj pax juntzanh yipal t'a satcha’anh.
Ichato chi' ol yilan heb' to a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, ol in emul t'a skal asun yet' jantak in poder yet' in niwan tziquiquial.
Ayic ol syamanoch yuji juntzanh chi', tzex tzalaji, tzex k'e k'elan, yujto toxo ol ex kolchajelok, xchi Jesús chi' t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan jun ab'ix tik t'a heb': --Tzeyilnab' te' higo, ma juntzanhxo te te' slaj k'ajb'anel xiil.
Ayic tzeyilani to wanxo swolanxi te' sk'ab', snachajel eyuuj to wanxo sja stiempoal nhab'ilq'uinal.
Anhejtona' juntzanh swal tik, ayik ol eyilan sja juntzanh chi', nachajokab'el eyuuj to toxo ol wach' och Dios Yajalil.
Val yel swal t'ayex, masanil juntzanh tas swal tik ol ujok ayik manto satel-laj juntzanh anima tik.
Ha satcha’anh yet' yol yib'anhk’inal tik, ol lajwoquelok, palta a in lolonel, malaj b'ak'uinh ol lajwoquelok.
Tzeyil wal he b'a. Manh eyak' pitb'ok he b'a yuj pek'al, yuj uk'el anh, ma yuj juntzanhxo tas b'aj tzeyak'och he pensar. Ta maay, ayik ol ja jun k'ual chi', manh listaok eyaji.
Icha tz'aj yem junok yaal, icha chi' ol aj sja jun k'ual chi' t'a yib'anh heb' anima smasanil t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik.

Yuj chi' lista tzeyutej he b'a. Lesalwanhec t'a masanil tiempo yik wach' tek'an eyaji. Yuj chi' ol yal eyel t'a tas d'inhan sjawi, yik pax manh ol ex q'uixwok eyoch t'a wichanh a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Junjun k'u sk'ayb'ej heb' anima Jesús t'a yamaq'uil stemplo Dios. Axo t'a tzalan Oliwo tzek' ak'wal yuj.
Masanil k'u, spet k'och heb' anima chi' smasanil t'a yamaq'uil templo chi'. Sb'at smaklan yab' heb' t'ay.
Van sja stiempoal q'uinh yik snachajkoti tas aj yelnakkot heb' israel t'a Egipto, aton yik swaan ixim pan heb' malaj yich.
Axo heb' winh sat sakerdote yet' heb' winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés ix sayan modo tas ol aj smilancham Jesús heb' winh t'a k'ub'eltak, yujto xiw heb' winh t'a heb' anima.
Ay jun winh skuch Judas, winh aj Queriot. Yetb'eyum sb'a winh yet' heb' winh uxluchwanh sk'ayb'um Jesús, palta a winh Satanás ix och t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winh sk'umej heb' winh sat sakerdote yet' heb' winh yajal yaj t'a heb' winh stanhwan stemplo Dios. Ix yalan winh tas ol yutok yak'anoch Jesús t'a yol sk'ab' heb' winh.
Yuj chi' te wach' ix yab' heb' winh. Ix yak'an strato heb' winh yet' winh t'a jantak tumin ol yak' heb' winh t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix schaan yab' winh tas ix yal heb' winh. Ix och ijan winh sayani tas syutej winh yak'anoch Jesús chi' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' winh t'a elk'altak.
Ix k'och sk'ual swaan ixim pan heb', aton ixim malaj yich ayemi, yik smiljipaxcham nok' kalnel yik snaankot heb' tas aj yelnakkot heb' t'a Egipto.
Axo Jesús ix chekanb'at winhaj Pedro yet' winhaj Juan, ix yalani: --Ixiquec, b'at b'oek tas ol kab'lej t'a jun q'uinh tik, xchi t'a heb' winh.
--¿B'ajtil a gana sko b'o'o? xchi heb' winh t'ay.
--Ayic ol ex k'och t'a yol chonhab', ay jun winh ol ilchajel eyuuj, kuchb'il jun ch'ub' ha ha' yuj winh. Tzex och tzak'an yuj winh, masanto tzex k'och yet' winh t'a spat.

Ol eyalan t'a winh aj pat chi: Icha tik ix aj yalankot ko k'ayb'umal t'ayach: ¿B'ajtil ay jun a kuarto b'aj ol in wa yet' heb' winh in k'ayb'um yik sko naankot tas aj yelnakkot heb' ko mam quicham t'a Egipto? xchikoti, xe chi t'a winh.
Axo winh ol ch'oxan jun niwan kuarto t'ayex t'a jun chaanh. Listaxo yaji. Axo ta' ol he b'o tas ol kab'lej chi', xchi Jesús t'a heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at heb' winh. Axo ix k'och heb' winh, ix yilan heb' winh to ix elk'och icha ix aj yalan Jesús chi'. Yuj chi' ata' ix sb'o heb' winh tas ol yab'lej t'a jun q'uinh chi'.
Ayic ix k'och yorail, ix k'och Jesús yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh sk'ayb'um, ix och oyan heb' winh wael t'a spatik te' mexa.
Ix yalan Jesús t'a heb' winh: --Toxon nab'il wuuj to in gana tzin wa eyed'ok t'a jun q'uinh tik, yakb'an manto in chamok.
Swal t'ayex, manhxa b'ak'uinh ol in wa t'a jun q'uinh tik, masanto ol och junelxo ayik ol wach' och Dios Yajalil, xchi t'a heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'ank'e waan jun waso. Ix yak'an yuj diosal d'ha Dios yuj. Ix yalanxi t'a heb' winh: --Chaec jun tik. Mol uk'ejek.
Yujto swal t'ayex, manhxalaj b'ak'uinh ol wuk' yal uwa tik, masanto ol wach' och Dios Yajalil, xchi t'a heb' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'ank'e wan jun ixim pan. Ix yak'an yuj diosal d'ha Dios yuj ixim. Ix xepanb'at ixim t'a heb' winh. Ix yalani: --Ha jun tik, aton in niwanil tik ol ak'jok eyuuj. Vaec ixim. Tze k'ulejnhej jun tik, yik tzin he naankoti, xchi t'a heb' winh.

Icha pax chi' ix yutej junxo waso ayik toxo ix lajwi swa heb', ix yalani: --Ha jun ay t'a yol jun waso tik sch'oxanel jun schab'il strato Dios toto ix b'oi. Yuj in chiq'uil ol el eyuuj ol elk'och jun trato chi'.
Palta a winh ol in ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ol in milanchamok, ayek' winh wed' t'a jun mexa tik.
Ha in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, yowalil ol in paxok, ichataxon yaj sb'okani. Palta a wal winh ol in ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' chamel chi', te chuk yik winh, xchi Jesús t'a heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix yal-lan yab' junjun heb' winh, ¿mach onhtaxlaj ol kak'och t'a yol sk'ab' chamel chi'? xchi heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix laj stelan sb'a heb' sk'ayb'um yuj mach junok heb' ek'al yelk'ochi.
Axo Jesús ix alan t'a heb': --Ha heb' rey t'a junjun nakión, yajal ton yaj heb'. Yed' heb' yajal, wach' heb' yalan heb' anima.

Ha exxo tik, manh eyutok he b'a icha heb' chi'. Tato ay junok mach t'a he kal tik ek'al yelk'ochi, yik'okab'emta sb'a icha junok unin. Anhejtona' tato ay junok yajal yaj t'a he kal, ichaokab' junok chekab' syutej sb'a.

Q'uinalok tz'och junok niwan wael. ¿Mach junok más niwan yelk'och tze na'a? ¿Am jun k'ojanem wan swa'i, mato a jun wan yak'an serwil? Aton jun k'ojanem wan swa chi' más niwan yelk'ochi, palta a in tik ayinek' t'a he kal icha junok tz'ak'an serwil.
Ha ex tik, ix he tek'b'ej he b'a eyek' wed'ok ayik ix ja juntzanh yaelal t'a wib'anh.
Yuj chi', icha in yutej ko Mam Dios in yak'anoch yajalil, icha chi' ol ex wutej pax ex wak'anoch yajalil.

Yuj chi' ol yal he wa wed' t'a jun in mexa b'aj ay in och yajalil chi'. Anhejtona' ol ex em k'ojjab' t'a junjunok he k'ojnub'. Axo eyoch chi' yajalil t'a heb' lajchawe' makan quetisraelal, xchi Jesús t'a heb' sk'ayb'um chi'.
Ix yalanpax Jesús: --Ach Simón, ina ix sk'an spermiso winh Satanás d'ha Dios, yujto snib'ej winh tzex yak' prowal icha tz'aj ixim trigo schayaji.
Palta ix in tewi wal d'ha Dios uuj, yik max ik'el a k'ool t'ay. Ha ach tik, ayik ol meltzajxok och a pensar t'ayin, tzak' stek'anil heb' uk'tak, xchi Jesús.
Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj Simón chi': --Mamin, b'ekan in k'ol in b'at ed' t'a preso, wach'chom tzin cham ed'ok, xchi winh.
--Pedro, swal t'ayach, ayik manto ok' nok' kaxlanh t'a jun ak'wal tik, oxel ol ik'el t'a ib'anh to manh in ojtakok, xchi Jesús chi' t'a winh.

Ix yalanxi Jesús t'a heb' sk'ayb'um: --Tze nakoti, ayik ex in chekannakb'at junel, maj eyik' he moral, maj eyik' he tumin, maj eyik'paxb'at he xanhab'. ¿Tom ay tas yak'nak palta t'ayex ta'? xchi t'a heb'. --Maay, malaj tasi, xchi heb'.
Axo tiknaik, mach ex ay he moral, he tumin, tzeyik'b'at eyed'ok. Mach ex malaj eyespada, tze chonhel he chumpa, tze manan eyiko'.

Yujto swal t'ayex, yowalil ol elk'och t'a wib'anh icha tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a Slolonel Dios, b'aj syalkan icha tik: Icha tz'utaj heb' anima chuk, icha chi' ix utaj winh, xchi. Jantacnhej wab'ixal tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a Slolonel Dios chi', yowalil ol ujoquelk'ochi, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Yuj chi' ix yal heb' sk'ayb'um chi' t'ay: --Mamin, ina chab' k'een espada tik, xchi heb' t'ay. --Yechelxo chi', xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix elta Jesús t'a yol jun pat b'aj ix wa heb' chi', ix b'at t'a tzalan Oliwo ichataxon smodo. Ix och pax tzak'an heb' sk'ayb'um yuj.
Axo ix k'och ta', ix yalan t'a heb': --Lesalwanhec, yik manh ol ex ak'jok prowal, xchi t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix sb'esanel sb'ha t'a stz'ey heb'. Icha am snajatil sb'at junok jul-lab', icha chi' ix b'ati. Axo ta' ix em kuman, ix lesalwi.
Ix yalan icha tik: --Mamin, tato a gana, ik'el jun yaelal tik t'a wib'anh, palta manhok icha in gana, palta ichaokab' wal a gana, xchi.
Ixlajwi chi', ix sch'oxan sb'a jun ángel ix kot t'a satcha’anh. Ix ul yak'an stek'anil.
Ix te och pitz'an t'a spixan. Yuj chi' yelk'olal ix lesalwi. Axo yalil tz'em t'a sat lu'um, kalan yaj yet' chik', icha wal yem tz'uj yem t'a sat lu'um chi'.
Ixlajwi slesalwi, ix meltzajxikot b'aj aykan heb' sk'ayb'um chi'. Axo ix k'och t'a heb', waynakb'at heb', yujto ix te och pitz'an kuselal t'a spixan heb'.
Yuj chi', ix yalan t'a heb': --¿Tas yuj tzex te wayi? Q'ueanhek waan, lesalwanhek, yik wach' manh ol ex meltzaj t'a he patik ayik ol ex ak'jok prowal, xchi t'a heb'.

Vanto slolon Jesús chi', ix k'och heb' tzijtumal anima. Axo winhaj Judas, yetb'eyum sb'a yet' heb' uxluchwanh sk'ayb'um Jesús chi', a winh b'ab'el sk'och yuj heb'. Ix snitzanb'at sb'a winh stz'ub' sti' Jesús chi'.
Axo Jesús chi' ix alan t'a winh: --Judas, ¿tom icha tik tz'aj in ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' chamel a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik? xchi.
Axo heb' ayek' yet' Jesús chi', ayik ix yilan heb' tas wan sja t'a yib'anh ix sk'anb'an heb' t'ay: --Mamin, ¿tzam yal ko xikan heb' t'a k'een espada tik? xchi heb' t'ay.
Val t'a jun rato chi', ay jun winh t'a skal heb' sk'ayb'um Jesús chi' ix tzepanel schiquin jun winh schekab' winh sat sakerdote t'a swach'.
Axo Jesús ix alan t'a heb': --Actejec, k'okb'ilxo chi', xchi t'a heb'. Axo Jesús ix yaman schiquin winh chi', yet'nhej chi' ix ochxikani.

Ha heb' winh sat sakerdote, heb' winh yajal yaj t'a stemplo Dios yet' heb' winh ichamtak winak ay yopisio, ix k'och heb' winh syam Jesús chi'. Yuj chi' ix yal Jesús chi' t'a heb' winh: --¿Tas waj tzeyila'? ¿Tom kuchb'um in t'a heb' sk'ulan chukal yuj chi' tzex ja t'ayin yet' k'een espada yet' te te'?
Ayinnhej ek' eyed' t'a yamaq'uil stemplo Dios t'a junjun k'u, palta maj in eyama'. Palta ato tiknaik yorail he k'ulan jun tik yet' yipalil winh aj k’ik’ k’inal, xchi t'a heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yamji Jesús yuj heb' winh. Ix yik'anb'at heb' winh t'a spat winh sat sakerdote chi'. Axo winhaj Pedro, najat tzak'anto sb'at winh yuj.
Axo t'a yamaq'uil ti' pat chi' ix yak'och jun k'ak' heb' winh. Ix och oyan heb' winh t'a sti' te', ix em k'ojan heb' winh. Ix em k'ojan pax winhaj Pedro chi' t'a skal heb' winh.
Axo jun ix kriada, ayik ix yilan ix to k'ojanem winhaj Pedro chi' t'a sti' te' k'ak' chi', ix och k'elan ix t'a winh, ix yalan ix: --Ha jun winh tik, yetb'eyum sb'a winh yet' Jesús tik, xchi ix.
Axo winh, elanhchamel ix yik'el winh t'a yib'anh, ix yalan winh: --Ach ix, manh wojtakok jun winh tzal chi', xchi winh t'a ix.
Junanto rato chi', ay junxo ix och k'elan t'a winh, ix yalani: --Ha ach tik, etb'eyum a b'a yet' heb', xchi t'a winhaj Pedro chi'. --Val yel maay, manh wetb'eyumoklaj in b'a yet' heb', xchi winh.
Ay am tom junok hora chi', yelk'olal ix yal junxo winh: --Val yel a jun winh tik, yetb'eyum sb'a winh yet'ok, yujto aj Galilea heb', xchi winh.
--Toton maay, manh wojtakok juntzanh tzal chi', xchi winhaj Pedro chi' t'a winh. Ayic wanto yalan juntzanh chi' winh ix ok' nok' kaxlanh.

Ix kot k'elelok Jesús Kajal chi' t'a winh. Yuj chi' ix snakot winh tas ix yalkan Jesús. Ichaton tik ix yutej yalankan t'a winh: Ayic manto ok' nok' kaxlanh t'a jun ak'wal tik, oxel ol ik'el t'a ib'anh to manh in ojtakoklaj, xchi t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix sb'eselta sb'a winh t'a skal heb'. Ix te ok' wal winh sik'lab'il.
Axo heb' stanhwumal Jesús ix och ijan heb' sb'uchwaj t'ay. Ix laj smak'an pax heb'.
Ix smakan sat heb'. Ix stz'itanb'at sti' heb'. Ixlajwi chi', ix sk'anb'an heb' t'ay: --Al t'ayonh mach tzach mak'ani, xchi heb' t'ay.
Manh jantakok tas ix yal heb' t'ay yik sb'uchwaj heb' t'ay.

Axo ix sakb'i, ix smolb'an sb'a heb' ichamtak winak ay yopisio t'a skal heb' israel, heb' winh sat sakerdote yet' heb' winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés. Ix yik'anb'at Jesús heb' winh t'a yichanh winh sat yajal. Axo ta' ix sk'anb'ej heb' winh t'ay:
--Al t'ayonh, ¿tom a ach tik Cristo ach? xchi heb' winh t'ay. --Nab'anhej swal t'ayex, ¿tom ol he cha eyab' t'ayin?
Tato a in tzin k'anb'ej junok tas t'ayex, ¿tom ol eyal t'ayin? ¿Tom ol in eyak'el t'a libre?
Palta a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, a tiknaik ol in k'ochkan k'ojan t'a swach' k'ab' Dios, aton jun masanil tas syal yuj, xchi Jesús t'a heb' winh.
Masanil heb' winh ix k'anb'an t'ay: --¿Tom Yuninal ach Dios jun? xchi heb' winh t'ay. --Ha in ton tik Yuninal in, icha tzeyal chi', xchi t'a heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix yal heb' winh. --¿Tasto tz'och testigo kuuj? Yujto a onh wal lak'an ix kab' yalan winh, xchi heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix k'e waan heb' smasanil. Ix yik'anb'at Jesús heb' t'a yichanh winhaj Pilato.

Ata' ix syamoch heb' yak'anoch juntzanh es t'a yib'anh. Ix laj yalan heb': --Ix quila' to a winh wan yak'an somchajel heb' quetchonhab'. Syalanpax winh to max yal kak'an k'een tumin sk'anjiel t'ayonh yuj winh yajal t'a Roma. Ha wal winh tz'alanpaxi to Cristo winh, syalelk'ochi to rey winh, xchi heb' t'a winhaj Pilato chi'.
Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'ej winhaj Pilato chi' t'ay: --Tzin k'anb'ej t'ayach, ¿tom sreyal ach heb' israel? xchi winh t'ay. --Ha in toni, ichaton tzutej alan chi', xchi Jesús t'a winh.
Yuj chi', ix yal winhaj Pilato chi' t'a heb' winh sat sakerdote yet' t'a heb' anima chi': --Malaj jab'ok smul jun winh tik tz'ilchaj wuuj, xchi winh.

Palta haxo heb', yelk'olal yalan heb': --Ha winh tik, masanil heb' anima aj Judea tik wan somchajel yuj juntzanh k'ayb'ub'al syak' winh. Ato t'a Galilea ix schael yich winh yalani, masanto ix jawi winh t'a Judea tik, xchi heb' t'a winhaj Pilato chi'.
Ayic ix yab'an juntzanh chi' winhaj Pilato chi', ix sk'anb'an winh yab' t'a heb', tato a Jesús aj Galilea.
Axo yik ix yab'an winh to aj Galilea, yuj chi' ix yak'anb'at t'a winhaj Herodes yajal t'a Galilea chi' yujto ayek' winh t'a Jerusalén t'a juntzanh k'ual chi'.
Ayic ix yilan winhaj Herodes chi' sk'och Jesús, te wach' ix yab' winh, yujto ayxo stiempoal yab'an spekal winh. Yuj chi' sganaxo winh slolon yet'ok. Snib'ej wal winh syil sb'oan junok milagro.
Tzijtum tas ix sk'anb'ej winh t'ay, haxo Jesús manh jab'ok ix tak'wi t'a winh.
Axo heb' winh sat sakerdote yet' heb' winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés ayek' ta', yelk'olal ix yak'och heb' winh t'a yib'anh.

Yuj chi' a winhaj Herodes chi' yet' heb' soldado, ix sb'aj Jesús chi' heb'. Ix sb'uchan pax heb'. Ix stz'akan yak'och juntzanh pichul heb' te wach' t'ay, icha spichul heb' winh rey. Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'anxi meltzaj Jesús winh t'a winhaj Pilato.
Ha t'a jun k'ual chi' ix yamigoejk'e sb'a winhaj Pilato chi' yet' winhaj Herodes, yujto ha t'a yalanhtaxo yajk'ool sb'a heb' winh.
Axo winhaj Pilato chi' ix molb'an heb' winh sat sakerdote, heb' winh ay yopisio yet' pax heb' anima smasanil.

Ix yalanelta winh t'a skal heb': --Ha winh ix ul eyak' tik t'ayin, yujto tzeyala' to somchajel heb' anima yuj winh, palta ina t'a eyichanh ix in k'anb'ej wab' t'a winh, palta malaj jab'ok smul winh scheklajelta wuj icha ix aj eyalani.
Anheja' pax winhaj Herodes, malaj tas ix ilchaj yuj winh t'a winh. Yuj chi' ix schekxikot winh t'ayonh. Inai, malaj jab'ok smul winh yik smoj schami.
Yuj chi', tonhej ol in chek mak'jok winh, ol wak'anxiel winh t'a libre, xchi winh t'a heb'.
Axo yik ix yab'an heb' anima to icha chi', ix laj awajk'e heb': --Ha winh tik, chamokab' winh. Aokab' winhaj Barrabás chi' tz'el t'a libre, xchi heb'.
Ha winhaj Barrabás chi', preso yaj winh, yujto lokan winh yet' heb' winh ix ak'an owal yet' heb' winh yajal t'a yol chonhab' chi'. Mak'umcham anima pax winh.
Axo winhaj Pilato chi' snib'ej winh syak'el Jesús t'a libre. Yuj chi' icha chi' ix yutej winh yalanxi t'a heb' anima.
Palta ayik ix yab'an heb' to icha chi', ix k'e umnaj heb' yawaji: --Kulusejk'e winh. Kulusejk'e winh, xchi heb'.

Ix yalanxi winhaj Pilato chi' yoxelal t'a heb': --¿Tas wal smul winh t'ayex jun? Malaj wal jab'ok smul winh tz'ilchaj wuuj yik smoj schami. Yuj chi' tonhej ol in chek mak'jok winh, ol wak'anxiel winh t'a libre, xchi winh t'a heb'.
Axo heb', ix te k'e umnaj yawaji to yowalil skulusajk'ei. Te chaanh ix awajk'e heb' yet' heb' winh sat sakerdote. Yuj chi' ix yak' ganar heb'.
Ix yalan winhaj Pilato chi': Ujokab' icha snib'ej heb', xchi winh.
Axo winh lokan t'a skal owal chi', winh mak'umcham anima chi', winh preso yaji, a winh ix ak'jielta t'a libre icha snib'ej heb'. Axo Jesús ix ak'jikanoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' icha snib'ej.

Ayic wan yik'anb'at Jesús heb' b'aj ol chamok, ay jun winh aj Cirene skuchan Simón, spetoj winh t'a smunlajel, ix yamchaj winh yuj heb' soldado. Axo winh ix chekji skuchb'at skulusal Jesús chi'. Ix och tzak'an winh yuj.
Tzijtum heb' anima ix och tzak'an yuj. Yed' pax heb' ix ix, wek'eq'ui yel yaw heb' ix yok' yuj.
Axo Jesús ix meltzajb'at k'elan t'a heb' ix, ix yalani: --Ex ix aj Jerusalén, manh ex ok' wuuj. Ok'anhek eyuuj yet' yuj heb' eyune',
yujto ay wal jun k'ual ol jawok, ol eyalani: Ha wal heb' ix malaj yune', heb' ix toxon max unewi yet' heb' ix manh yojtakok yak'an chunok yune', te wach' yik heb' ix, xe chama.
Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', ol laj yal heb' anima icha tik: Tzoc wal kot juntzanh witz yet' juntzanh tzalquixtak tik t'a quib'anh yik tzonh sk'ub'ejeli, xcham heb'.

Ha in tik, lajan in icha junok te te' yaax, palta ina wal tas syak'och heb' t'a wib'anh. Ocxom wal a ex tik. Yelxo wal niwan tas ol ak'jokoch t'a eyib'anh, yujto lajan ex icha junok te te' taquinhxo, xchi Jesús t'a heb' ix.
Ay pax chawanh heb' winh ay smul ix ik'jib'at yet' Jesús chi', yik skulusajk'e heb' winh yet'ok.

Ix k'och heb' t'a jun lugar skuchan B'aj Ay Sb'aquil Jolom. Ata' ix kulusajk'e Jesús yuj heb' winh soldado. Ix kulusajpaxk'e chawanh heb' winh ay smul chi' yet'ok, jun winh t'a swach', jun winh t'a sk'exanh. Junjun skulusal junjun heb'.

Ayic wan sk'e d'unhunhok Jesús yuj heb', ix yalani: --Mamin, ak' niwank'olal heb', yujto manh yojtakok heb' tas wan sk'ulani, xchi d'ha Dios. Axo heb' winh soldado, ix yak' suerte heb' winh yik spojanek' spichul Jesús chi' heb' winh t'a spatik.

Axo heb' anima, wan yilan heb' tas wan yuji chi'. Anheja' pax heb' winh yajal, ix sb'uch Jesús heb' winh. Ix laj yalan heb' winh: --Ab'i chi' kolwajwum winh t'a juntzanhxo. Scolokab' pax sb'a winh tiknaik, tato t'a wal yel Cristo winh, winh sik'b'ilel yuj Dios, xchi heb' winh.
Anheja' ix b'uchji pax yuj heb' winh soldado. Ix k'och heb' winh t'a stz'ey. Ix yak'an winagre heb' winh yuk'ej.
Ix yalan heb' winh t'ay: --Tato yel Sreyal ach heb' israel, kolto naik a b'a quila', xchi heb' winh t'ay.
Ay jun letra ix tz'ib'ajoch t'a sjolom te' skulusal, xchi icha tik: Ha winh tik Sreyal heb' israel, xchi.
Ay pax jun winh kulusab'ilk'e yet'ok ix b'uchani, ix yalan winh icha tik: --Tato yel Cristo ach, kol a b'a quila', tzonh a kolan paxi, xchi winh t'ay.
Axo junxo winh yetb'eyum winh ix kachani, ix yalan winh: --¿Tom max ach xiw d'ha Dios? Ina lajan kajoch t'a yol sk'ab' jun yaelal tik yet'ok.
Ha onh tik, smoj wal skab' syail ko chaan spak ko mul, palta a jun winh tik, malaj tas ix smulej, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh t'a Jesús: --Ach Jesús, tzin a nakoti ayik ol ach ja ak' Yajalil, xchi winh t'ay.
Ix yalan Jesús t'a winh: --Val yel swal t'ayach, ha t'a jun k'u tik ol ach k'och wed' t'a swach'ilal, xchi t'a winh.
Ayic toxo tz'och chimk'ualil, ix k'ik'b'i k 'inal t'a masanil yol yib'anhk’inal tik masanto t'a a las tres yik yemk'ualil.
Ha yok k'u, majxo yak'laj yok. Axo k'apak kortina ayoch smakulok snanhal yol stemplo Dios, ix nhik'chaj snanhal k'apak.
Axo Jesús te chaanh ix awaji, ix yalan icha tik: --Mamin, swab'enejkanoch in pixan t'a yol a k'ab', xchi d'ha Dios. Ix lajwinhej yalan jun chi', ix chami.
Axo jun winh kapitán aj Roma, ayik ix yilan juntzanh chi' winh, ix yal wach' lolonel winh d'ha Dios, ix yalan winh icha tik: --Val yel a jun winh tik, te malaj smul winh, xchi winh.
Axo masanil heb' anima ayek' chi' ta', ix yil heb' tas ix uji chi'. Ix laj paxta heb', ix och wal pitz'an kusk'olal t'a spixan heb'.
Axo jantaknhej heb' ojtannak Jesús yet' juntzanh heb' ix ix kotnak yet' t'a Galilea, najatto ix laj kotkan t'anhjab' heb' ix.
Ay jun winh skuchan José, aj chonhab' Arimatea t'a yol yik Judea. Wach' winh, tojol spensar winh. Ay pax yopisio winh yet' heb' winh yajal.
Palta maj yak'och sb'a winh yet' heb' winh ix ak'anoch chamel t'a yib'anh Jesús chi'. Van stanhwan winh swach' och Dios Yajalil.
Ix k'och winh t'a winhaj Pilato, yik sk'ananemta sniwanil Jesús winh.

Ixlajwi yik'an spermiso winh chi', ix b'at yak'an ik'joquemta sniwanil chi' winh. Ix sb'ak'anoch jun sábana winh t'a spatik. Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at yak'an ak'jok och sniwanil winh t'a yol jun k'een k'een joyb'ilel yool. Ha t'a jun k'een chi', manta junok mach smukchaji.
Aton t'a jun k'ual chi' wanxo yak'an lista sb'a heb' yuj sk'ual ik'oj ip toxo ol yamchaj ochok.
Axo heb' ix ix kotnak yet' Jesús t'a Galilea, ix b'at heb' ix yil k'een k'een b'aj ix mukchaj chi'. Ix yilan heb' ix chajtil ix yutej heb' yak'anoch sniwanil chi' t'a yol k'een.
