Ixlajwi chi', ix paxta heb' ix t'a sposado. Ix laj sb'oan juntzanh yal suk'uq'ui sjab' heb' ix yet' juntzanh wach' sukjioch t'a sniwanil Jesús chi'. Axo yik ix k'och yorail sk'ual ik'oj ip, ix yik'an yip heb' ix icha yalan jun cheknab'il t'a ley.
Ayic ayto sk'an sakb'i t'a domingoal, aton jun b'ab'el k'u yik semana, ix b'at heb' ix ix chi' b'aj mukb'il sniwanil Jesús chi'. Yed'nak juntzanh yal suk'uq'ui sjab' chi' heb' ix b'ob'il yuj.
Axo ix k'och heb' ix, ix yilan heb' ix to toxo ix el k'een smakul chi'.
Ix och heb' ix t'a yol k'een, ix yilan heb' ix to manhxalaj sniwanil Jesús Kajal ayeq'ui.
Ix te satb'at sk'ool heb' ix yilani. Axo ix yilan heb' ix ayek' chawanh ángel icha yilji winak, linhjab'ek' t'a stz'ey heb' ix. Toxonhej stziquiqui spichul heb'.
Yuj chi' ix te xiw heb' ix, ix em kumjab' heb' ix t'a sat lu'um. Axo ix yalan heb' ángel chi' t'a heb' ix: --¿Tas yuj tze say jun pitzan t'a yol b'aj smukchaj heb' chamnak tik?
Manhxo ayoquek'laj t'a tik. Toxo ix pitzwixi. Naeccot tas yalnak t'ayex, ayik aytoek' eyed'ok t'a Galilea.

Ayic yalani to a jun Ak'b'ilkot yuj Dios yoch animail, yowalil ol ak'jokoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' anima chuk spensar, ol kulusajk'e yuj heb'. Axo t'a schab'jial ol pitzwokxi. Icha chi' yutejnak yalankan t'ayex, xchi heb' ángel chi' t'a heb' ix.
Ix snakot heb' ix tas yalnakkan Jesús chi',
yuj chi' ix paxta heb' ix ta', ix b'at yalan heb' ix t'a heb' uxluchwanh sk'ayb'um Jesús chi' yet' t'a heb' sk'ayb'um smasanil.
Ha heb' ix ix b'at alan ab'ix tik, aton ix María aj Magdala, ix Juana yet' ix María snun winhaj Jacobo. Ay pax juntzanhxo heb' ix yetb'eyum sb'a yet' heb' ix.
Palta a heb' schekab' Jesús chi', tonhej ste komon lolon heb' ix snaan heb'. Maj schalaj yab' heb' t'a heb' ix.

Axo winhaj Pedro yelk'olal ix b'at winh b'aj mukan chi'. Ayic ix k'och winh, ix em nhojan winh yilanoch t'a yol k'een, ix yilan winh to axonhej k'apak sábana ix b'ak'chajoch t'a sniwanil Jesús chi' aykan sch'okoj. Ix paxta winh, ix te sat sk'ool winh yuj tas ix uji chi'.
Ha t'a jun k'ual chi', ay chawanh heb' sk'ayb'um wan sb'at t'a jun b'e sk'och t'a chonhab' Emaús. Ha jun chonhab' chi', ay am oxeok legua skal yet' Jerusalén.
Van sb'ey heb', wan yalub'tanhan heb' tas juntzanh ix uji.
Ayic wan yalub'tanhan heb' chi', ix k'och Jesús, ix yetb'atan sb'a yet' heb'.
Ix moyjikan sat heb' yuj. Wach'chom tz'ilji yuj heb', palta maj nachajel-laj yuj heb' tato ha'.
Ix sk'anb'an Jesús t'a heb': --¿Tas wal eyalub'tanhej tzex b'eyi? xchi t'a heb'. Ix och waan heb', te kuseltak yilji heb'.
Ay jun winh skuch Cleofas ix tak'wi t'ay: --Inatax yojtak heb' anima smasanil tas ix uji t'a Jerusalén t'a ewi chab'ji tik. Ha achxo tik, ¿tom maj ab' jab'ok? Ina ach ek' ta', xchi winh t'ay.

--¿Tas juntzanh ix uji chi' jun? xchi Jesús chi' t'a heb' winh. --Ay jun aj Nazaret skuch Jesús. Schekab' ton wal Dios yaji. Ha t'a yichanh Dios yet' t'a yichanh heb' chonhab', te niwan yelk'och tas ix sk'ulej yet' tas ix yala'.
Palta a heb' winh sat sakerdote yet' heb' winh yajal ix ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' chamel. Yuj chi' ix kulusajk'ei.
Ix kak'och yipok ko k'ool to ol onh skolel a onh aj Israel onh tik. Chab'jitax ix uji jun chi' tiknaik.
Palta ay juntzanh heb' ix quetb'eyum ko b'a yet'ok, sat ko k'ool yuj tas syal heb' ix, a ix sakb'i ix b'at heb' ix yil jun k'een b'aj ochkan sniwanil Jesús chi'.

Ix ab' yilan heb' ix, manhxalaj sniwanil ayeq'ui. Ixlajwi chi', xid' yalan heb' ix t'ayonh to icha wayich ix aj yilan chawanh ángel heb' ix. Ix ab' yalan heb' ángel chi' t'a heb' ix to a Jesús toxo ix pitzwixi.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at juntzanh heb' quetb'eyum yila'. Icha wal ix aj yalan heb' ix chi', icha wal chi' ix aj yilan heb'. Axo pax Jesús, maj yil-laj heb', xchi heb' t'ay.
Axo Jesús ix alan t'a heb': --Ha ex tik malaj jab'ok he pensar, max he b'alaj ak'ejochlaj t'a he k'ool tastak yalnakkan heb' schekab' Dios t'a peka'.
Ha Cristo chi', yowalil ix yab' syail, ayik mantzak och Yajalil, xchi t'a heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix och ijan yalan t'a heb' b'ajtaktil tz'ib'ab'ilkan yab'ixal t'a Slolonel Dios. Ix schaankot yalan tastak tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj winhaj Moisés, masanto t'a tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj heb' schekab' Dios t'a peka'.
Ayic ix k'och heb' t'a jun chonhab' b'aj wan sb'at heb' chi', haxo Jesús ijan b'enhej ix ek'b'ati.
Axo heb' ix ak'an pural skani. Ix yalan heb' t'ay: --Cananh qued'ok, ina wanxo yem k'u, toxo wal ol k'ik'b'ok, xchi heb' t'ay. Yuj chi' ix och t'a yol spat heb', ix kan yet' heb'.
Ayic ix em k'ojan t'a te' mexa yet' heb', ix yik'ank'e waan jun ixim pan. Ix yak'an yuj diosal d'ha Dios yuj ixim. Ixlajwi chi', ix och ijan spukanb'at ixim t'a heb'.
Ha t'a jun rato chi', ichato ix jakwi sat heb'. Ix yilanoch heb' to a Jesús. Palta ix satem t'a stz'ey heb', haxo ix yilan heb', manhxalaj mach.
Ix yalan heb': --Yel toni, ix och pitz'an t'a ko k'ool yuj a ix yalan t'ayonh t'a yol b'e, ayik ix yak'anpax nachajel kuuj tastak tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a Slolonel Dios, xchi heb'.
D'a jun rato chi' ix k'e waan heb', ix pax heb' t'a Jerusalén. Ata' ix ilchaj heb' uxluchwanh schekab' Jesús yuj heb' yet' juntzanhxo yetb'eyum heb'. Molanek' heb'.
Axo heb' chi', ix alan t'a heb' chawanh chi': --D'a wal yel ix pitzwixi Jesús Kajal. Ix sch'ox sb'ha t'a winhaj Simón tik, xchi heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', haxo heb' chawanh chi' ix alani tas ix sk'ulej heb' t'a yol b'e yet' pax tas ix aj snachajel yuj heb' to a Jesús ayik ix spukanek' jun ixim pan chi'.
Vanto yalan jun chi' heb', haxo ix yilan heb' ayxo ek' Jesús t'a skal heb'. Ix yalani: --Junk'olalokab' eyaji, xchi t'a heb'.
Ha heb' chi', tonhej ix satb'at sk'ool heb'. Ix laj xiwk'e heb'. Ha snaan heb' to a junok pixan sch'ox sb'ha t'a heb'.
Ix yalan Jesús t'a heb': --¿Tas yuj tzex te xiwi? ¿Tas yuj ay he chab'k'olal t'ayin?
Ilecnab' in k'ab' yet' wok tik. Anhejtona' a in. Yamlejeknab'i, tzeyilani tato a junok pixan, ¿tom ay sb'ak'chil junok pixan yet' sb'aquil syal tze yam icha wik tik? xchi t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi yalan jun chi' t'a heb', ix sch'oxan sk'ab' yet' yok t'a heb'.
Wach'chom stzalaj heb', palta anheja' maj yak'ochlaj heb' t'a sk'ool, yujto tonhej ste sat sk'ool heb'. Yuj chi' ix yal t'a heb': --¿Mama jab'ok tas tzin wa t'a tik? xchi.
Axo heb' ix ak'an jab' b'olb'il chay t'ay.
Ix schaan t'a heb', ix yab'lan t'a yichanh heb'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan t'a heb': --Ha tiknaik, ix elk'och tas ix walkan t'ayex ayik ayinto ek' eyed'ok. Valnakkan t'ayex to yowalil ol elk'och jantaknhej wab'ixal tz'ib'yajkan t'a ley Moisés, tas tz'ib'ab'il pax kan yuj heb' schekab' Dios yet' juntzanh wab'ixal t'a libro Salmos, xchi t'a heb'.
Ichato chi', ix ak'ji jakwok spensar heb' yuj, yik snachajel yuj heb' tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a Slolonel Dios.
Ix yalan t'a heb': --Ha t'a Slolonel Dios tz'ib'ab'ilkan wab'ixal a in Cristo in tik, to yowalil in chami, haxo t'a schab'jial in pitzwixi t'a skal heb' chamnak.

Anhejtona', yowalil ol aljoquel wab'ixal t'a skal heb' anima t'a junjun nakión. Ol aljoquel t'a skal heb' to yowalil sna sb'a heb', yik ol ak'jok lajwok smul heb'. Schael yich t'a Jerusalén tik masanto b'aj slajwik'och yol yib'anhk’inal tik.
Ha ex tik, ol eyak' testigoal he b'ha t'a juntzanh tik.
Ha in xo, ol b'at in chekkot jun yalnak Dios to ol yak'kot t'ayex. Palta tanhwejekkan t'a Jerusalén tik, masanto ol he cha jun poder ol ak'joquemta t'ayex t'a satcha’anh, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'anb'at heb' sk'ayb'um t'a slak'anil chonhab' Betania. Ata' ix yik'chaanh sk'ab', ix sk'anan swach'k'olal Dios t'a yib'anh heb'.
Vanto sk'anan jun chi', ix paxk'e t'a satcha’anh, ix kan heb' yuj.
Ixlajwi yak'anem sb'a heb' t'ay, te tzalajk'olal ix pax heb' t'a Jerusalén.
Junjun k'u ix och heb' t'a yol yamaq'uil stemplo Dios. Ix yalan wach' lolonel heb' t'ay.
Ayic mantalaj jun yol yib'anhk’inal tik, aytaxon ek' jun Slolonel Dios sb'i. Ha jun chi' aytaxon ek' yet' Dios, Dios ton wal.
Ayic manto sb'o jun yol yib'anhk’inal tik Dios, aytaxon ek' yet'ok.
A' yak'lab'ejnak Dios chi' ayik sb'oannak masanil tastak. Malaj junok tas b'onak tato manh yujok.
Ha Slolonel Dios chi', aj k 'inal. Yuj jun k 'inal chi' ay sakil k'inal t'ayonh anima onh tik.
Ha jun sakil k'inal chi' tz'ak'an sakil k'inal b'aj ay k’ik’ k’inal. Axo jun k’ik’ k’inal chi', max yal-laj yak'an tup jun sakil k'inal chi'.
Ay jun winh chekb'ilkot yuj Dios skuchan Juan.
Ulnaquek' winh yak' testigoal sb'a yuj jun sakil k'inal chi', yik wach' masanil mach tz'ak'anoch jun sakil k'inal chi' t'a sk'ool.
Manhoklaj winhaj Juan chi' aj sakil k'inal, tonhej ul yak'nak testigoal sb'a winh yuj.
Ha jun yel sakil k'inal chi', wan sjawi t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik. A' tz'ak'an sakil k'inal t'a masanil heb' anima.
Ha jun Slolonel Dios sb'i chi', ulnaquek' t'a tik. Ha b'ojinak yol yib'anhk’inal tik. Palta ayik ix uleq'ui, maj nachajel-laj yuj heb' anima tato ha'.
Ha t'a juntzanh heb' yiko', ata' ulnak eq'ui, palta maj chajoklaj yuj heb' yik chi'.
Palta a jantaknhej heb' schaani, jantaknhej heb' tz'ak'anoch t'a sk'ool, a tz'alani to ay yalan yik heb' yoch yuninalok Dios.

Ayic tz'och heb' yuninalok Dios, ichato tz'aljixi heb'. Palta manh lajanok icha tz'aj yalji heb' anima. Manh animaok ay snib'ej tz'alji heb'. Manh yujok snib'ej junok winak, palta ha Dios tz'ak'anoch heb' yuninalok.

Ha jun Slolonel Dios sb'i chi', ochnak sniwanil icha quiko'. Ulnaquek' kajan t'a ko kal. Ha jun chi' te yel. Niwan swach'k'olal Dios ul sch'oxnak t'ayonh. Quilnac wal sniwanil yelk'ochi, yujto anhej wal jun chi' Yuninal Dios, kotnak t'a Smam.

Ha winhaj Juan aljinakkan yab'ixal jun chi' icha tik: --Ay jun tzak'an sja wuuj, palta ek'alto wal yelk'och yopisio t'a wichanh, yujto ayik manto in alji, aytaxon eq'ui. Valnacxo yab'ixal t'ayex, xchi winh.
Ha jun chi', tz'akan yaj swach'k'olal, yuj chi' tz'akan sch'ox swach'k'olal chi' t'ayonh.
Ha winhaj Moisés ak'jinakkan sley Dios t'ayonh. Axo Jesucristo sch'oxan swach'k'olal Dios t'ayonh, syak'an jun sk'ayb'ub'al te yel.
Malaj junok mach ix ilan Dios junelok. Palta a jun pitanh Yuninal, Dios ton paxi, a ul ch'oxjinaqueli. Ha jun Yuninal tik junnhejtaxon yaj yet' Smam chi'.

Ha junel, ay juntzanh heb' israel aj Jerusalén, ix schekb'at jaywanh heb' sakerdote heb' yet' jaywanh heb' yinhtilal Leví. Ha t'a winhaj Juan ix k'och heb'. Ix sk'anb'an heb' t'a winh: --¿Mach ach? xchi heb'.
Ix yalan sjichanil winhaj Juan chi' t'a heb': --Ha in tik, manhok in Cristo in, xchi winh t'a heb'.
Ix sk'anb'an pax heb' t'a winh: --¿Mach ach jun? ¿Mato a ach Elías ach? xchi heb'. --Manhok in laj, xchi winh. --¿Mato a ach tik schekab' ach Dios tanhwab'il kuuj? xchi heb'. --Maay, xchi winh.
Ix sk'anb'anxi heb' t'a winh: --¿Mach ach pax jun? Al t'ayonh mach ach, yujto yowalil ol b'at kalxi yab' heb' onh chekankoti. Al t'ayonh tas aji, xchi heb'.

Yuj chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb': --Ha in tik tzin awaj t'a tzinan lu'um, swalan icha tik: Icha tz'aj sb'o b'e ayik sjawi junok yajal, icha chi' tzeyutej he b'oan he b'eyb'al, yujto ol ja winh Kajal, xin chi. Yujto icha chi' yajkan stz'ib'aj wab'ixal yuj winhaj Isaías schekab' Dios t'a peka', xchi winh t'a heb'.
Ha juntzanh heb' xid'nak ek' t'a winhaj Juan chi', aton heb' winh fariseo chekannakb'at heb'.
Ix sk'anb'an pax heb' t'a winh: --¿Tas yuj tzak' bautizar heb' anima tato manh ach Cristooc, tato manh ach Elíasoc, tato manhok ach schekab' Dios tanhwab'il kuuj? xchi heb' t'a winh.
--Ha in tik swak' bautizar heb' anima t'a ha ha'. Palta ay jun ayxoek' t'a ko kal tik manto eyojtakok.
Ha jun chi', tzak'an sja wuuj, ek'al yopisio t'a wichanh. Manh in mojok wak'an serwil, wach'chom tonhej tzin tijel sch'anhal xanhab' t'a yok, xchi winhaj Juan chi' t'a heb'.
Ha t'a sk'axepal ha' Jordán, t'a jun lugar skuch Betania, ata' ix ak'ji bautizar heb' anima yuj winhaj Juan chi'. Ata' pax ix b'at sk'anb'ej juntzanh tik heb' t'a winh.

Axo t'a junxo k'u, ix yilanb'at winhaj Juan to wan sk'och Jesús, ix yalan winh: --Inai, a yopisio jun wan sja tik, icha yopisio nok' kalnel, icha chi' yaj yopisio yuj Dios, yujto ha' ix jawi yik'kanel ko mul ko masanil t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik.
Aton jun tik walnak: Ay jun tzak'an sja wuuj, palta ek'al yopisio t'ayin, yujto ayik manto in alji, aytaxon eq'ui, xin chi.
Max nachajel wuuj mach jun chi', palta in ja wak' bautizar heb' anima t'a ha ha', yik wach' ol nachajel yuj heb' quetisraelal mach jun chi', xchi winhaj Juan chi'.
Ix yalanpax winh: --Ix wil yemul Yespíritu Dios t'a satcha’anh t'a yib'anh icha junok nok' paramuch, ix em t'a yib'anh, ix ochkan t'ay.

Max nachajel wuuj, mach jun chi'. Palta a jun chekjinak in kot wak' bautizar heb' anima t'a ha ha', ha' ix alan t'ayin: Ol il yemul Vespíritu t'a yib'anh junok mach, ol ochkan t'ay. Ha jun chi' ol ak'anoch Espíritu Santo t'a heb' anima, ichato ol ak'jok bautizar heb' yuj, xchi Dios t'ayin.
Ha in tik ix wil jun chi'. Yuj chi' swak' testigoal in b'a yuj to a Jesús tik, Yuninal ton Dios, xchi winh.
Axo t'a junxo k'u, ayek' winhaj Juan yet' chawanh heb' winh sk'ayb'um.
Axo ix yilanb'at winh, wan yek' Jesús ta'. Yuj chi' ix yal winh: --Inai, a jun tzek' chi', icha yopisio junok nok' kalnel, icha chi' yopisio yuj Dios, xchi winh.
Ayic ix yab'an jun chi' heb' winh sk'ayb'um winhaj Juan chi', ix och tzak'an heb' winh yuj Jesús.
Axo ix meltzajb'at k'elan Jesús chi' t'a spatik. Ix yilani, tzak'anoch heb' winh yuj. --¿Tas tze saya'? xchi t'a heb' winh. --Ach ko k'ayb'umal ¿b'ajtil ay a posado? xchi heb' winh t'ay.

--Cotanhec, b'at quileknab'i b'aj ay in posado chi', xchi t'a heb' winh. Ix b'at heb' winh yet'ok, ix b'at yilan heb' winh b'aj ayeq'ui. Vanxo yem k'u ix b'at heb' winh, yuj chi' k'ik'b'alxo ix jax heb' winh.
Ix yab' chawanh heb' winh chi' tas ix yal winhaj Juan chi', yuj chi' ix och tzak'an heb' winh yuj Jesús. Ay jun winh skuch Andrés, yuk'tak sb'a winh yet' winhaj Simón Pedro.

Ixlajwi slolon winhaj Andrés chi' yet' Jesús chi', ix b'at sayan winh yuk'tak winh chi'. Axo ix chax winh yuj winh, ix yalan winh: --Ix ilchaj winh Mesías kuuj, xchi winh. (Mesías syalelk'ochi, Cristo, Ak'b'il Yopisio).

Junanto rato chi', ix yik'anb'at winh yuk'tak winh chi' t'a Jesús. Ix och k'elan Jesús t'a winhaj Simón, ix yalan t'a winh: --Simón, yuninal ach winhaj Juan. Cefas ol a b'iejkani, xchi t'a winh. (Cefas syalelk'ochi, Pedro, ma a k'een k'een.)
Axo t'a junxo k'u, ix snaan Jesús sb'at t'a yol yik Galilea. Ix ilchaj winhaj Felipe yuj. --Ochanh in k'ayb'umok, xchi t'a winh.
Ha winhaj Felipe chi', aj chonhab' Betsaida winh, aton schonhab' winhaj Andrés yet' winhaj Pedro.

Axo winhaj Felipe chi' xid' sayankot winhaj Natanael. Axo ix ilchaj winh yuj winh, ix yalan winh: --Ay jun ix ilchaj kuuj. Aton jun chi' tz'ib'ab'ilkan yab'ixal yuj winhaj Moisés t'a ley, tz'ib'ab'ilpaxkan yuj heb' schekab' Dios t'a peka', aton Jesús, yuninal winhaj José aj chonhab' Nazaret, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Natanael chi': --¿Tom ay junok tas wach' syal skot t'a Nazaret chi'? xchi winh. --Cotanh, b'at quilnab'i, xchi winhaj Felipe chi'.
Axo ix yilan Jesús to wan sk'och winhaj Natanael chi', ix yalani: --Ha jun winh sjawi tik, yel ton wal israel winh t'a yichanh Dios, malaj b'aj chab' sat syutej sb'a winh, xchi Jesús.

Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'an winhaj Natanael chi' t'ay: --¿Tas ix utej in ojtakaneli? xchi winh. --Ayic manto ach yawtejkot winhaj Felipe tik, toxo ix ach wila''. Ayach ek' t'a yich jun te' higo, xchi Jesús t'a winh.
--Ach in k'ayb'umal, yel Yuninal ach Dios. Co Reyal ach a onh israel onh tik, xchi winh t'ay.
--¿Yujnhejto ix wala': Ix ach wil t'a yich jun te' higo, yuj chi' tzin ak'och t'a a k'ool? Palta ayto juntzanhxo ch'oxnab'il satub'tak ol ila', te niwan yelk'ochi, xchi t'a winh.

Ix yalanxi Jesús t'a heb' ayek' chi' yet'ok: --Val yel swal t'ayex, ol eyila' to jakan spuertail satcha’anh. Axo heb' yángel Dios ol eyil sk'e heb' yet' yemxul heb' t'ayin a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, xchi Jesús.
Chab'jitax chi', ix och jun nupnajel t'a chonhab' Caná t'a yol yik Galilea. Ha ix snun Jesús, ayek' ix ta'.
Ix k'och pax Jesús yet' heb' sk'ayb'um, yujto awtab'il heb'.
Axo wino, maj yab'laj, yuj chi' ix yal ix snun Jesús chi' t'ay: --Ixlajwi wino, xchi ix.
Palta ix yalan Jesús t'a ix: --Nunin, ¿tas yuj a t'ayin tzala'? Manto k'ochlaj yorail in ch'oxanel in poder, xchi.
Axo ix yalan ix snun chi' t'a heb' winh wan yak'an serwil chi': --Jantacnhej tas ol yal Jesús t'ayex, tze k'anab'ajejnhej, xchi ix t'a heb' winh.
Ata' ayek' waque' k'een k'een yet'tal ha ha'. Ay am otak ch'ub'ok ha ha' tz'em t'a yol junjun k'een. Ha yet' ha' sb'iquel juntzanh tastak heb', ichataxon smodo heb' israel chi'.
Ix yalan Jesús t'a heb' winh tz'ak'an serwil chi': --B'ud'ek juntzanh k'een yet'tal ha' tik, xchi t'a heb' winh. Axo ix lajwi sb'ut'an k'een heb' winh,
ix yalanxi t'a heb' winh: --Ha tiknaik, iq'ek k'eta jab'ok ha', aq'ek t'a winh stanhwan jun nupnajel tik, xchi t'a heb' winh. Yuj chi' ix yak'an heb' winh t'a winh chi'.

Axo ix yab'lan jab' winh, toxo ix och ha' winoal. Manh yojtakok winh b'ajtil ix kot jun wino chi'. Axo heb' wan yak'an serwil chi', yojtakxo heb', yujto a heb' ix ik'ank'eta jun ha' chi'. Axo winh ix awtankot winh wan snupnaj chi'.

Ix yalan winh t'a winh: --Ha smodo heb' anima, a wino wach', a syak' b'ab'laj uk'nax heb'. Axo yik niwanxo ix laj yuk'ej heb' awtab'il chi', tz'ak'jipax jun wino ayxo wal syala'. Palta a ach tik, ix a sik'b'at jun wino wach'. Ato tiknaik wan ak'anelta uk'naxok, xchi winh t'a winh.

Ix sch'ox jun milagro chi' Jesús t'a chonhab' Caná t'a yol yik Galilea. B'ab'el ch'oxnab'il satub'tak jun ix sch'ox chi'. Icha chi' ix yutej sch'oxani to niwan spoder. Axo heb' sk'ayb'um, ix yak' wal och Jesús chi' heb' t'a sk'ool.
Ixlajwi chi', ix em Jesús t'a chonhab' Capernaum. Ajun pax ix snun yet'ok, heb' yuk'tak yet' pax heb' sk'ayb'um. Ata' ix ek' jaye' k'ual heb'.
Vanxo sja sq'uinh heb' israel yik snachajkot tas aj yelnakkot heb' t'a Egipto. Yuj chi' ix k'ex Jesús t'a chonhab' Jerusalén.
Ata' ix och t'a yol yamaq'uil stemplo Dios. Ix yilani, ay heb' chonhum wakax, ay heb' chonhum kalnel. Ay pax heb' chonhum paramuch. Ay pax juntzanhxo heb' k'exum tumin k'ojjab'eq'ui.

Axo ix yilan icha chi', ix sb'oan jun ch'anh ch'anh smak'lab'ok. Ix spechanelta heb' smasanil t'a yol yamaq'uil templo chi' yet' nok' skalnel heb' yet' nok' swakax heb'. Ix laj tob'b'at juntzanh stumin heb' k'exum tumin chi' t'a sat lu'um, ix laj lokji pak'laj juntzanh smexa heb' yuj.
Ix yalan t'a heb' chonhum paramuch chi': --Ik'equel juntzanh nok' tik. Ha stemplo in Mam tik, manh eyak'och merkadoal, xchi t'a heb'.
Ix snaankot heb' sk'ayb'um tas syal Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkan icha tik: Te pitz'anoch in k'ool t'a jun a templo tik, xchi.
Axo heb' winh aj Judea ix alan t'ay: --¿Tas junok satub'tak tza ch'ox t'ayonh, yik snachajel kuuj to ay alan ik a k'ulan juntzanh tik? xchi heb' winh t'ay.
Yuj chi' ix yalan t'a heb' winh: --Pojequel jun stemplo Dios tik, haxo t'a schab'jial ol in b'oanxik'ei, xchi t'a heb' winh.
Yuj chi', ix yalanxi heb' winh aj Judea chi' t'ay: --Ha jun stemplo Dios tik, 46 ab'ilxo skajwi sb'oi. Ha achxo tik, ¿tom ol b'o uuj t'a oxe' k'ual chi'? xchi heb' winh t'ay.
Ha stemplo Dios chi' ix yal snaan heb' winh, palta a sniwanil ix yala'.
Yuj chi', ato yik ix pitzwixi t'a skal heb' chamnak, ix snaankot heb' sk'ayb'um tas ix yala'. Ix yak'anoch heb' t'a sk'ool tas tz'ib'yajkan t'a Slolonel Dios yet' tas yalnakkan Jesús chi' t'a heb'.
Ayic ayek' Jesús t'a Jerusalén yuj sq'uinh heb' israel yik snachajkot tas aj yelnakkot heb' t'a Egipto, tzijtum heb' ix ak'anoch Jesús t'a sk'ool, yujto ix yil juntzanh satub'tak heb' ix sch'oxo'.
Ha Jesús maj yak'ochlaj heb' yipok sk'ool, yujto yojtak spensar masanil heb' anima.
Manh yowalilok tz'alji t'ay tas ko pensar junjun onh, toxonton yojtak tas sko na'a.
Ay jun winh fariseo skuch Nicodemo, yajal yaj winh t'a skal heb' yetyajalil t'a Judea.

Ix k'och winh t'a Jesús t'ak'walil, ix yalan winh t'ay icha tik: --Ach ko k'ayb'umal, kojtak to ha Dios chekjinak ach kot onh a k'ayb'ej, yujto ay juntzanh satub'tak tza ch'oxo'. Malaj junok mach syal sk'ulan juntzanh chi', tato manh ayok och Dios yet'ok, xchi winh t'ay.
Ix yalan Jesús t'a winh: --Val yel swal t'ayach, a mach max aljixi t'a schaelal, manh ol yal-laj yoch t'a yol sk'ab' Dios, xchi t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'an winhaj Nicodemo chi': --Ha junok icham animaxo, ¿tasto ol yutok yaljixi t'a schaelal? ¿Tom tzato yal yoch t'a yol sk'ol snun yik tz'aljixi? xchi winh.
Ix yalanxi Jesús chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Val yel swal t'ayach, a mach max alji t'a ha ha' yet' pax yuj Yespíritu Dios, manh ol yal-laj yoch t'a yol sk'ab' Dios.
Ha heb' tz'alji t'a snun, animanhej heb'. Palta haxo heb' tz'alji pax yuj Yespíritu Dios, espíritu ton heb'.
Manh ak' sat a k'ool yuj tas swal tik, yowalil tzex aljixi t'a schaelal.
Ha ik' yalxonhej b'aj sb'ati. Skab' sk'anhi, palta malaj mach ojtannak b'aj skoti yet' b'aj sk'ochi. Icha jun ik' chi', icha chi' yaj heb' tz'alji yuj Yespíritu Dios, xchi Jesús t'a winh.
Ix sk'anb'anxi winh: --¿Tas syalelk'och jun tik? xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalanxi Jesús: --¿Tom max nachajel juntzanh swal tik uuj? Ina te k'ayb'um ach t'a skal heb' quetisraelal.
Val yel swal t'ayach, a tas kojtak, a skala'. Ha tas squila', a skala'. Palta max he cha eyab' tas swal t'ayex.
Tato max he cha eyab' tas swal t'ayex yuj tastak ay t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, ¿tom ato tas ay t'a satcha’anh ol he cha eyab'i?
Malaj junok mach ix xid'k'e t'a satcha’anh. Palta a in tik, ata' kotnak in, yujto Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail, aj satcha’anh in.
Icha yutejnak winhaj Moisés sd'unhb'ank'e jun k'een yechel chan t'a taquinh lu'um, icha chi' ol in ajk'e d'unhan.
Icha chi' ol in ajok, yik wach' a jantaknhej heb' tzin ak'anoch t'a sk'ool, manh ol satel heb', palta to ol scha sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej.

Yujto te xajan heb' anima t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik yuj Dios, yuj chi' wach'chom a innhej Yuninal in, palta in yak'koti yik wach' a heb' tzin ak'anoch t'a sk'ool, manh ol satel-laj heb', palta ay sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej.
Ha in tik, Yuninal in ton Dios. Manh yujok wak'an syaelal heb' anima in ak'jikot t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, palta yuj ul in kolankanel heb'.

Ha heb' tzin ak'anoch t'a sk'ool, manh ol b'atkan heb' t'a syaelal. Axo heb' max in ak'anoch t'a sk'ool jun, ayxokot syaelal heb' t'a yib'anh, yujto a innhej Yuninal in Dios, palta max in yak'och heb' t'a sk'ool.

Ha in tik in emul t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik yik swak' sakil k'inal t'a heb' anima. Palta ay pax heb' malaj snib'ej t'a jun sakil k'inal tik. Yuj chi', ol kannhej syaelal heb' t'a yib'anh. Anhej wal yik k’ik’ k’inal snib'ej heb', yujto anhej chukal sk'ulej heb'.
Jantacnhej heb' sk'ulan chukal, malaj tz'och jun sakil k'inal tik t'a heb'. Malaj snib'ej heb' schaani, yujto xiw heb' scheklajelta juntzanh chukal sk'ulej chi'.
Palta a heb' sk'anab'ajan jun k'ayb'ub'al te yel, scha jun sakil k'inal tik heb', yik wach' scheklajeli to ayoch Dios yet' heb' t'a tas sk'ulej, xchi Jesús t'a winhaj Nicodemo chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at Jesús yet' heb' sk'ayb'um t'a yol yik Judea. Ata' ix ek' jaye' k'ual yet' heb'. Ix yak'an bautizar heb' anima ta'.
Anhejtona' ix yak'pax bautizar heb' anima winhaj Juan t'a jun lugar skuch Enón, t'a slak'anil Salim, yujto manh jantakok ha ha' ta'. Ix laj k'och heb' anima, ix yak'an bautizar sb'a heb' t'a winh.
Ayic manto ak'jioch winhaj Juan chi' t'a preso, ix sk'ulan juntzanh chi' winh.
Ay jaywanh heb' sk'ayb'um winhaj Juan chi' ix stelaj sb'a yet' jun winh aj Judea yuj tas syutej sb'oan sb'a heb' anima icha yalan ley.

Yuj chi', xid' yalan heb' t'a winhaj Juan chi': --Ach ko k'ayb'umal, a jun ek'nak ed'ok t'a sk'axepal ha' Jordán, jun alnakkan t'ayonh, a jun chi' wan yak'an bautizar heb' anima tiknaik. Ix laj och heb' sk'ayb'umok, xchi heb' t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalan winh t'a heb': --Malaj junok mach syal skomon och yopisio tato manhok Dios tz'ak'an t'ay.
Ha ex tik, eyab'nak walani to manh in Cristooc. Ha in ton tik b'ab'laj chekb'il in kot t'a yichanh Cristo chi'.

Q'uinalok ay junok nupnajel tz'och tiknaik, a winh wan snupnaj chi', a winh tz'ik'an ix ix chi'. Ha jun yamigo winh snupnaj chi', ayik syab'an yawaj winh snupnaj chi', ste tzalaji. Icha chi' in tzalaj tiknaik, yujto wan yoch heb' anima sk'ayb'umok Jesús.
Ha Cristo chi', yowalil ol te q'uib'nhej yopisio chi'. Ha inxo tik, yowalil k'ojank'olal ol satxiem wopisio tik, xchi winh t'a heb'.

--Ha jun emnakkot t'a satcha’anh chi', ek'to yopisio t'a smasanil anima. Ha onhxo ayonh t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, anima onnhej ko masanil. Anhej wal yik yol yib'anhk’inal tik skala'. Palta haxo jun emnakkot t'a satcha’anh chi', ek'to yopisio t'ayonh ko masanil.
Ha tas yab'nak yet' tas yilnak, a syala', palta malaj mach schaan yab' t'ay.
Tato ay heb' schaan yab' t'ay, sch'oxel heb' to yel syal Dios.
Yujto a jun chi', ha Dios ix chekankoti. Yuj chi' a slolonel Dios syala'. Tz'akan yajoch Yespíritu Dios t'ay.
Ha Yuninal ko Mam Dios, te xajan yuj. Yuj chi', a Smam chi' ix ak'anoch masanil tastak t'a yol sk'ab'.

Ha heb' tz'ak'anoch Yuninal Dios t'a sk'ool, ayxo sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej. Axo heb' malaj snib'ej yak'anoch t'a sk'ool jun, manh ol schalaj sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej, palta aykot yowal sk'ol Dios t'a yib'anh heb'.
Axo ix yab'an heb' fariseo to a heb' sk'ayb'um Jesús ix te ek' sb'isul heb' t'a yichanh heb' sk'ayb'um winhaj Juan, ek'to pax heb' tz'ak'ji bautizar yuj.
Palta manhoklaj Jesús chi' tz'ak'an bautizar heb', a heb' sk'ayb'um.
Ayic ix yab'an Jesús to yojtak jun chi' heb' fariseo chi', ix el t'a yol yik Judea, ix b'atxi t'a Galilea.
Yowalil ha t'a yol yik Samaria tz'eq'ui ayik smeltzaji.
Yuj chi' ayik wan yek' t'a yol yik Samaria chi', ix k'och t'a chonhab' Sicar. Ha jun chonhab' chi', ha t'a slak'anil jun lum lum yak'nakkan winhaj Jacob t'a jun yuninal skuch José, ata' ay.
Ata' ay jun sjaj ha ha' joyb'ilkan yuj winhaj Jacob chi'. Axo Jesús chi', chimk'ualil ix k'och ta'. Yujto ix k'unb'i sb'eyi, yuj chi' ix k'ojnaj t'a sti' jun ha' chi'.

Axo heb' sk'ayb'um, ix b'at heb' sman yik schimk'ualil t'a jun chonhab' ay t'a slak'anil ha' chi'. Ayic toxo ix b'at heb', ix k'och jun ix ti'awum aj Samaria. Ix yalan Jesús t'a ix: --Ak' jab'ok ha' tik wuk'ej, xchi t'a ix.

Ix yalan ix: --Ha ach tik, israel ach. ¿Tas yuj tza k'an ha' uk' t'ayin? ¿Tom manh ojtakok to aj Samaria in? xchi ix t'ay. Icha chi' ix yutej ix yalani, yujto a heb' israel yet' heb' aj Samaria chi', max sk'umejlaj sb'a heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalanxi Jesús t'a ix: --Tzin k'an wuk' jab'ok ha' t'ayach, palta manh ojtakok mach in. Manh ojtakok paxi tas snib'ej Dios syak' t'ayach. Octom wal ojtak, a ach am tza k'an t'ayin, a inxo swak' jun ha ha' tz'ak'an a k 'inal, xchi Jesús t'a ix.
--Mamin, ina malaj junok a lechlab' b'aj syal ik'ank'eta ha'. Te jul yajem ha'. ¿B'ajtil ol ik' jun ha ha' ol ak'an in k 'inal chi'?

Joyb'ilkan sjaj ha ha' tik yuj winh ko mam quicham aj Jacob. Ha winh uk'jinak ha' yet' heb' yuninal t'a tik yet' masanil nok' smolb'etzal nok'. Chamnac winh, skannak jun ha' tik t'ayonh. Ha achxo tik ¿tom ek'al opisio t'a winhaj Jacob chi'? xchi ix t'ay.
Yuj chi' ix yalan t'a ix: --Ha mach tz'uk'an jun ha ha' tik, stakjixi sti' heb'.

Palta haxo heb' tz'uk'an jun ha' swak'a', manhxa b'ak'uinh ol takjokxi sti' heb', yujto a jun ha' swak' chi', ol aj sjaj ha' t'a spixan heb', haxo ha' ol ak'an sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej, xchi Jesús t'a ix.
Ix yalanxi ix: --Mamin, ak' jun ha ha' chi' t'ayin, yik manhxo ol takjok in ti', yik pax manhxo yowalilok ol ul wik'k'eta jun ha' tik, xchi ix.
Ix yalanxi t'a ix: --Ixic, ix ik'kot winh etb'eyum, tzex ja t'a tik, xchi Jesús t'a ix.
--Malaj winh wetb'eyum, xchi ix. --Telan, yel ton tzala' malaj winh etb'eyum tiknaik.
Palta owanhxo heb' winh b'aj xid'nak ach. Axo winh b'aj ay ach ek' tiknaik, manh etb'eyumok ton winh. Yuj chi' yelton tzala': Malaj winh wetb'eyum xa chi, xchi Jesús t'a ix.
Ayic ix lajwi yab'an juntzanh chi' ix, ix yalanxi ix: --Mamin, a swutej wab'ani to schekab' ach Dios.

Ha heb' ko mam quicham a onh aj Samaria onh tik, ha t'a jun witz tik yalnak sb'a heb' d'ha Dios. Palta a exxo israel ex tik, tzeyala': Ha t'a Jerusalén, ata' yowalil b'at kal ko b'a d'ha Dios, xe chi, xchi ix.

Ix yalanxi Jesús t'a ix: --Ach ix, ak'och t'a a k'ool tas swala'. Ay jun pekti’ ol jawok, manhxooklaj t'a jun witz tik ol ul eyal he b'ha t'a ko Mam Dios. Anhejtona' t'a Jerusalén, manhxo yowalilok ol ex k'och eyal he b'a ta'.
Ha ex aj Samaria ex tik, niwanok tzeyal he b'a d'ha Dios, palta manh eyojtakoklaj. Xal onh israel onh tik, kojtak ko Diosal b'aj skal ko b'a. Ha t'a ko kal ol elta jun Colwajum.

Ay heb' to t'a ko Mam Dios syal sb'a icha wal t'a smojal. Axo tiknaik, toxo ix ja stiempoal, ol yal sb'a heb' d'ha Dios kuchb'ab'il heb' yuj Espíritu icha wal t'a smojal, yujto a ko Mam Dios, snib'ej icha chi' tz'aj yalan sb'a heb' t'ay.
Ha Dios, Espíritu. Yuj chi', tato ay heb' syal sb'a t'ay, yowalil a Espíritu skuchb'an heb' icha wal t'a smojal, xchi Jesús t'a ix.
Ix yalanxi ix t'ay: --Ha in tik, wojtak to ol ja jun Mesías. Ayic ol jawok ol yalan masanil tastak t'ayonh, xchi ix t'ay. (Mesías syalelk'ochi Cristo, Ak'b'il Yopisio.)
--Ha in ton wan walan tik t'ayach, xchi Jesús t'a ix.

Ha wal slajwi yalan juntzanh chi' Jesús ix jax heb' sk'ayb'um. Ix sat sk'ool heb' yilani to wan slolon Jesús yet' jun ix ix. Palta malaj junok heb' ix k'anb'an t'ay tas sk'anb'ej t'a ix, ma tas yuj slolon yet' ix.
Ix yaktejkan sch'ub' ix t'a sti' ha ha' chi'. Ix b'at yalan ix t'a heb' anima ay t'a schonhab'. Ix yalan ix t'a heb':
--Ay jun winh masanil tas ojtannak yiktax in kotoch uninal. Ix yal winh t'ayin smasanil. Koyec wed'ok, b'at quileknab'i. ¿Tope alaj winh Cristo? xchi ix t'a heb'.
Yuj chi' ix elta heb' t'a yol schonhab' chi'. Ix jawi heb' b'aj ayek' Jesús.
Ayic manto k'och heb', ix yalan heb' sk'ayb'um Jesús chi' t'ay: --Ach ko k'ayb'umal, wa''anh jab'ok, xchi heb'.
Palta ix yalan t'a heb': --Ay jun in wael manh eyojtakok a ex tik, xchi t'a heb'.
Yuj chi' ix laj sk'anb'an heb' t'ay junjun: --¿Tom ay mach ix ul ak'an waok? xchi heb'.
Palta ix yalanxi t'a heb': --Ayic tzin k'ulan tas snib'ej jun in chekankoti, yik syik'an sb'a smunlajel, ichato tzin wa swab'i.

Ha ex tik tzeyala': Chanheto ujal sja stiempoal sjochchaj ixim trigo, xe chi. Palta a in swal t'ayex: Q'ueanhek k'elan, ileknab'i, toxo ix k'och sk'ual smolchajkot heb' anima t'ayin icha tz'aj sjochchaj ixim trigo.

Ay mach wan schaan stojol yuj smolb'ankot heb' anima t'ayin yik schaan sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej icha yaj heb' jochum trigo. Yuj chi' a mach tz'alanel Slolonel Dios icha tz'aj stzikjib'at ixim trigo yet' heb' smolb'ankot heb' anima icha tz'aj sjochchaj ixim, junnhej ol tzalaj heb'.
Yujto yel syal jun ab'ix tik: Jun stzikanb'ati, ch'okxo mach sjochani, xchi.

Ha in tik, ix ex in chekb'at munlajel t'a skal heb' anima icha heb' sjochwi trigo, maj eyab' syail he tzikanb'ati. Ch'ok heb' b'ab'laj munlajnak t'a skal heb' icha heb' tzikumb'at trigo chi'. Ha exxo tik, toxonhej tze jochk'e waan ixim trigo chi', xchi Jesús t'a heb' sk'ayb'um chi'.
Ha t'a jun chonhab' t'a yol yik Samaria chi', tzijtum heb' ix ak'anoch Jesús t'a sk'ool, yujto a jun ix ix chi' ix alan t'a skal heb': Yojtaknhej tastak tzin k'ulej yiktax in kotoch uninal, xchi ix.
Ix jawi heb', ix tewioch heb' t'a Jesús to skan yet' heb'. Yuj chi' chab' k'ual ix ek' yet' heb'.
Tzijtumto heb' ix ak'anoch t'a sk'ool ayik ix yab'an heb' tas ix yala'.

Yuj chi' ix yal heb' t'a ix ix chi': --Ha tiknaik skak'och t'a ko k'ool, manhoknhej yuj tas ix al chi' t'ayonh, yujto skab' wal yet' ko chiquin. Scojtakan wal el sik'lab'il to t'a wal yel a jun tik ko Kolumal yaj t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, xchi heb' t'a ix.
Ayic ix ek' chab' k'ual chi', ix elxi Jesús t'a Samaria, ix b'atxi t'a yol yik Galilea,
yujto yalnak Jesús to malaj yelk'och junok schekab' Dios t'a heb' anima b'aj kajan.

Ayic ix k'ochxi t'a Galilea, ix te tzalaj heb' anima schaan sk'ochi, yujto ayik ix xid'ek' heb' t'a Jerusalén t'a jun sq'uinh heb' israel yik snaankot heb' tas aj yelnakkot heb' t'a Egipto, ix yil heb' juntzanh tastak xid' sk'ulej Jesús chi' ta'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix k'ochxi Jesús chi' t'a chonhab' Caná t'a yol yik Galilea, aton b'aj ochnak ha ha' winoal yuj. Axo t'a chonhab' Capernaum ay jun winh yajal yaj t'a winh rey, ay jun yuninal winh te penaay.

Ayic ix yab'an winh to ix kotxi Jesús t'a Judea, ix jaxxi t'a Galilea, ix b'at winh yil Jesús. Ix tewi winh t'ay yik sb'at yet' winh t'a spat, yik sb'at yak'an b'oxok sk'ool jun yuninal winh chi', yujto wanxo schami.
Ix yalan Jesús t'a winh: --Tato max eyil juntzanh satub'tak tzin ch'oxo', juntzanh sch'oxanel in poder, tekan malaj junok ex tzin eyak'och t'a he k'ool, xchi.
Palta ix yalanxi winh yajal chi': --Mamin, konh wed' elanhchamel, yakb'an manto cham jun wuninal chi', xchi winh t'ay.
Ix yalanxi Jesús icha tik: --Paxanh. Manh ol chamlaj jun uninal chi', xchi t'a winh. Ix yak'anoch winh t'a sk'ool tas ix yal Jesús chi', yuj chi' ix pax winh.
Vanto sk'ochxi winh t'a spat, haxo heb' schekab' winh ix elta scha'a. Ix yalan heb': --Pitzan winh uninal chi', xchi heb' t'a winh.
Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb': --¿Janik' ix b'oxi sk'ool winh jun? xchi winh. --Atax t'a ewi t'a tz'eymaj k'ual sikb'i jun k'ak' chi' t'a winh, xchi heb'.
Yuj chi' ix snaankot winh to icha chi' yorail yal Jesús chi' t'a winh icha tik: Manh ol chamlaj jun uninal chi', xchi. Yuj chi', ix yak'och Jesús winh t'a sk'ool yet' jantak heb' ay t'a yol spat.
Aton jun schab'il yechel satub'tak sch'ox Jesús tik. Ayic spetoj t'a Judea ix k'ochxi t'a Galilea, ata' ix sb'o junxo tik.
Ixlajwi chi' ix k'exxi Jesús t'a Jerusalén, ix b'at yilan jun sq'uinh heb' yetisraelal.
Ha t'a yol chonhab' Jerusalén chi', t'a slak'anil jun puerta b'aj tz'och nok' kalnel, ata' ay jun tanque skuch Betesda t'a sti' heb' israel chi'. Oye' wal stentail.
Tzijtum heb' penaay ayek' ta. Ay heb' max yal yilani, ay heb' max yal sb'eyi, ay heb' sikb'inaqueli.
Ay jun winh 38 ab'ilxo penaay.
Axo ix yilan Jesús jichanek' winh. Yojtak to pekatax icha chi' yaj winh. Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'an t'a winh: --¿Tzam a nib'ej tzach b'oxikani? xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalan winh penaay chi': --Mamin, malaj mach tzin ak'anem t'a yol ha' tik ayik tz'ib'xi ha' t'a juntak el. Ayic tzin nib'ej tzin emi, ch'okxo heb' sb'ab'laj em t'a wichanh, xchi winh t'a Jesús.
Yuj chi' ix yalan Jesús t'a winh: --Q'ueanh waan, ik'chaanh a waynub' tik, b'eyanh, xchi t'a winh.
D'a jun rato chi', ix b'oxi sk'ool winh. Ix yik'anchaanh swaynub' winh chi', ix syamanoch winh sb'eyi. Palta sk'ual ik'oj ip.
Yuj chi' ay jaywanh heb' aj Judea ix alan t'a winh: --Ha tiknaik, sk'ual ik'oj ip. Manh sleyalok tzik'chaanh a waynub' tik, xchi heb' t'a winh.
Ix tak'wi winh t'a heb' icha tik: --Ha jun winh in ak'an b'oxok, a winh ix alan t'ayin: Ik'chanh a waynub' tik, tzach b'eyi, xchi winh, xchi winh.
Ix sk'anb'an heb' t'a winh: --¿Mach jun winh ix alan chi' t'ayach to tzik'chaanh a waynub' tik, tzach b'eyi? xchi heb'.
Palta manh yojtakok winh tas sb'i jun ix ak'an b'oxok sk'ool winh chi', yujto ix satb'at Jesús chi' t'a skal jantak anima ayek' chi' ta'.

Axo t'a junelxo ix ilchaj winh yuj Jesús t'a yamaq'uil stemplo Dios, ix yalan t'a winh: --Inai ach b'oxi. Manhxo a k'ulej chukal, yik manhxo ol ja junokxo yaelal más te niwan t'a ib'anh, xchi t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winh yal t'a heb' winh aj Judea chi' to a Jesús chi' ix ak'an b'oxok sk'ool winh.
Yuj chi' ix te och heb' winh ajk'olal t'a Jesús chi', yujto ha t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip ix sk'ulej juntzanh chi'.
Palta ix yalan Jesús t'a heb': --Ha in Mam smunlajnhej. Yuj chi' anheja' tzin munlajnhejpaxi, xchi t'a heb'.
Yujto ix yal juntzanh chi' Jesús, ijanxo wal snib'ej heb' smilchamok. Manhoknhej yuj b'aj max sk'anab'ajej sk'ual ik'oj ip chi', palta yujto slajb'ej sb'a yet' Dios ayik syalanoch Dios chi' Smamoc.

Ix yalanxi Jesús t'a heb': --Val yel swal t'ayex, a in tik Yuninal in Dios, max yal in k'ulan junok tas t'a yol wiko', anhej tas swil sk'ulan in Mam tzin k'ulej. Ha jantaknhej tas sk'ulej in Mam chi', a tzin k'ulejpaxi.
Ha in Mam chi', te xajan in yuj a in Yuninal in tik. Ha jantaknhej tas sk'ulej, sch'oxpax t'ayin. Ayto wal juntzanhxo tas te niwan ol sch'oxo', ol te sat he k'ool eyilani.
Yujto a in Mam chi' tz'ak'an pax pitzwok heb' chamnak, syak'an sk'inal heb'. Ichinpaxta' a in Yuninal in tik swak' sk'inal heb' in gana swak' sk'inal.
Ha in Mam chi', max sch'olb'itej junok anima. Palta a in Yuninal in tik, ix ak'ji wopisio in ch'olb'itan yaj heb' anima smasanil,
yik wach' lajan tz'aj wik'jichaanh icha tz'aj yik'jichaanh in Mam chi' yuj masanil anima. Tato ay heb' malaj tzin och t'ay, anhejtona' malaj tz'ochpax in Mam t'a heb', yujto a chekjinak in koti.

Val yel swal t'ayex, a heb' tz'ab'an in lolonel, syak'anpaxoch jun in chekankot heb' t'a sk'ool, ay sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej. Manhxo ol b'atkan heb' t'a syaelal, yujto toxo ix kolchajel heb' t'a yol sk'ab' chamel, ix schaan sk'inal heb'.
Val yel swal t'ayex, a tiknaik toxo ix ja stiempoal yab'an in jaj heb' chamnak a in Yuninal in Dios tik. Ha heb' tz'ab'ani, ol scha sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej.
Yujto a in Mam aj q'uinaltaxon t'a yol yiko'. Yak'annakkan jun chi' t'ayin to aj k 'inal in paxi.
Yak'annakpaxkan wopisio in ch'olb'itan masanil heb' anima, yujto Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail.
Manh eyak' sat he k'ol yuj juntzanh swal tik, yujto ay jun pekti’ ol jawok, a wal heb' mukanxo ol yab' in jaj heb'.

Ol laj k'ex waan heb' b'aj mukan chi'. Ha heb' wach' syutej sb'ha t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, ol pitzwokxi heb', ol schaan sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej. Axo heb' sk'ulan chukal, ol pitzwokxi heb', palta ol b'atkan heb' t'a syaelal t'a junelnhej.

Ha in tik, malaj jab'ok tas syal in b'oan t'a yol wiko', tzin ch'olb'itej icha tas schek in Mam chi' in k'ulej. Tzin ch'olb'itej t'a stojolal, yujto manhok tas icha in gana tzin k'ulej, palta icha snib'ej jun chekjinak in koti, aton in Mam.
Tato munil swala' to ay wopisio, malaj yelk'och jun wik swal chi'.
Palta ay junxo tz'alani tas wopisio. Ha jun chi', wojtak to te yel syala'.
Ha ex tik xid' he chek k'anb'aj t'a winhaj Juan tas yopisio winh. Ha tas yalnak winh wuuj, te yel.
Palta a in tik, max wak'ochlaj yipok in k'ool tas syal junok anima wuuj. Tonhej swek he nakoti tas yalnakkan winhaj Juan chi' t'ayex, yik tzex kolchaji.
Ha tas ix yal winhaj Juan chi', lajan icha junok tas tz'ak'an sakil k'inal ayel yok. Yuj chi', ix ex te tzalaj jayeok k'ual eyab'ani.

Palta ay junxo ek'al yelk'och t'a winhaj Juan chi'. Ha sch'oxaneli tas wopisio, yujto a juntzanh tas syak' in Mam in k'ulej, a tzin k'ulej. Icha chi' tz'aj scheklajeli to a in Mam chi' chekjinak in koti.
Ha in Mam chi', a chekjinak in koti, a syak' testigoal sb'a wuuj. Ha ex tik, malaj b'aj ix eyab' sjaj sloloni. Malaj b'aj ix eyil junelok.
Max eyak'och slolonel t'a he k'ool, yujto max in eyak'och t'a he k'ool a in chekb'il in kot yuj tik.
Ha ex tik scham wal he sayan eyil t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani, yujto a he naani to icha chi' ol aj yilchaj he k 'inal t'a junelnhej. Palta wach'chom syal wab'ixal Slolonel Dios chi',
malaj he gana tzex ja t'ayin yik tze cha he k 'inal.
Malaj yelk'och t'ayin tato syal wach' lolonel heb' anima wuuj.
Vojtak tas yaj he pensar, manh xajanok Dios eyuuj.
Ha in tik, ak'b'il in kot yuj in Mam, palta max in he cha'a. Tato ay junokxo munil ol jawok t'a yol yiko', a jun chi' ol he cha'a.
¿Tas ol aj in eyak'anoch t'a he k'ool, yujto anhej t'a eyichanh junjun ex he gana ay eyelk'ochi, malaj pax he gana ay eyelk'och t'a yichanh Dios te yel?
Xe natalaj to a in ol wal t'a in Mam chi' tas he chukal. Palta a winhaj Moisés ol alanok, aton winh tze tz'ak eyak'och t'a he k'ool.
Tato tzeyak'och t'a he k'ool tas stz'ib'ejnakkan winhaj Moisés chi', tzam in eyak'ochlaj t'a he k'ool, yujto a winhaj Moisés chi' tz'ib'annakkan wab'ixal.
Palta tato max eyak'och tas stz'ib'ejnakkan winh chi' t'a he k'ool, ¿tas ol aj eyak'anoch t'a he k'ool tas swal tik t'ayex? xchi Jesús t'a heb' winh aj Judea chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'atxi Jesús, ix k'ochxi t'a junxo sk'axepalek' ha' nhajab' yik Galilea, skuchan pax ha' Tiberias.
Tzijtum heb' anima ix och tzak'an yuj, yujto ix yil juntzanh satub'tak sch'ox yil heb' ayik syak'an b'oxok sk'ol heb' penaay.
Axo Jesús chi', ix b'at yet' heb' sk'ayb'um t'a jun tzalan. Ata' ix em k'ojan yet' heb'.
Vanxo sja stiempoal sq'uinh heb' israel yik snajikot tas aj yelnakkot heb' smam yicham heb' t'a Egipto.
Axo ix yilan Jesús, tzijtum heb' anima wan sk'och t'ay. Yuj chi' ix yalan t'a winhaj Felipe: --¿B'ajtil ol ko man tas swa heb' anima tik? xchi t'a winh.
Palta tonhej ix yal icha chi', yik syab'i tas ol yal winhaj Felipe chi', yujto yojtakxo tas ol yutok.
Ix yalan winhaj Felipe chi' t'ay: --Wach'chom qued'nak chab'ok kiento denario pan, palta max yab'laj yik tz'ak'chaj jab' jab'ok t'a junjun heb', xchi winh.
Ay pax junxo sk'ayb'um Jesús, skuch Andrés, yuk'tak sb'a winh yet' winhaj Simón Pedro. Ix yalan winh t'a Jesús chi':
--Ay jun winh unin ayek' qued' t'a tik, yet'nak oye' ixim pan kebada winh yet' cha pitanh nok' chay. Palta ¿tom ol yab' jab' tik t'a skal heb' smasanil? Ina te tzijtum heb', xchi winh.

Yuj chi', ix yalan Jesús t'a heb' sk'ayb'um chi': --Alec t'a heb' anima tik to tz'em k'ojan heb' smasanil, xchi t'a heb'. Ha jun lugar b'aj ayek' heb' chi', niwan ak'lik. Ix em k'ojan heb' smasanil, ay am oyeok mil heb' winh winak.

Axo Jesús ix ik'anchaanh ixim pan chi', ix yak'an yuj diosal d'ha Dios yuj ixim. Ix schekan pukjokb'at ixim t'a heb' k'ojanem chi'. Icha pax chi' ix yutej nok' chay chi'. Ix yab'lej heb', ato syala' jantak snib'ej heb'.
Axo yik ix lajwi swa heb' sik'lab'il, ix yalan Jesús t'a heb' sk'ayb'um chi': --Molec jantakto ix kan chi', yik malaj tas tz'ixtaxi, xchi t'a heb'.
Axo ix lajwi smolan heb' chi', lajchaweto xuuk ix b'ud'ji yuj ixim pan ix yak' sobre t'a ixim oye' pan kebada chi'.
Ha heb' anima chi', ix yil heb' jun tas satub'tak ix sch'ox Jesús chi'. Yuj chi' ix yal heb': --Aton jun tik, schekab' Dios tanhwab'iltaxon sja t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, xchi heb'.
Palta yojtakxo Jesús to snib'ej heb' yak'an pural yoch sreyalok. Yuj chi' ix sb'esel sb'ha t'a skal heb', ix b'atkan t'a skal lum tzalquixtak chi' sch'okoj.
Ayic wanxo sq'uik'b'i, ix emk'och heb' sk'ayb'um Jesús t'a sti' ha' nhajab'.
Ix och heb' t'a yol te' barko, ix b'atxi heb'. Snib'ej heb' sk'axpajek' t'a chonhab' Capernaum ay t'a sti' ha' nhajab' chi'. Te k'ik'b'alxo ix b'at heb'. Manto jaxlaj Jesús ix b'at heb'.
Axo yik wan sb'ey heb', ix owajchaanh jun ik' te ow t'a sat ha' nhajab' chi'. Ix te k'e chulan ha' yuj jun ik' chi'.
Ayxom junok nanhal schab'il legua sb'at heb' t'a sat ha', haxo ix yilan heb' wan sk'och Jesús t'a heb'. Tonhej sb'eyb'at t'a sat ha'. Yuj chi' ix te xiwk'e heb'.
Palta ix yalan t'a heb': --Manh ex xiwok, Ha in, xchi t'a heb'.
Ichato chi' junk'olalxo ix chajioch yuj heb' t'a yol te' barko chi'. Elanhchamel ix ek'k'och heb' t'a sk'axepal ha' b'aj wan sk'och heb' chi'.

Axo t'a junxo k'u, anheja' yajkan heb' anima chi' t'a sk'axepal ha' chi'. Axo ix snaankot heb' to junnhej te' barko chi' ix b'ati, anhej pax heb' sk'ayb'um Jesús ix och t'a yol te', maj ochlaj Jesús chi' yet' heb'.
Yakb'an chi' ay juntzanhxo barko ix kot t'a chonhab' Tiberias, ix k'och t'a slak'anil jun lugar b'aj ix swa ixim pan chi' heb', aton b'aj ix yak' yuj diosal Cajalil yuj ixim.

Axo ix yilan heb' anima chi', manhxo ayok ek' Jesús chi' yet' heb' yet' pax heb' sk'ayb'um. Yuj chi' ix laj och heb' t'a yol juntzanh barko chi'. Ix b'at sayanek' Jesús chi' heb' t'a chonhab' Capernaum.
Axo ix k'och heb' anima chi' t'a sk'axepalek' ha' nhajab' chi', ata' ix ilchaj Jesús yuj heb'. Ix sk'anb'an heb' t'ay: --Ach ko k'ayb'umal, ¿tom t'a tik ayach eq'ui? ¿Janik' ach jawi? xchi heb' t'ay.
Ix yalan t'a heb': --Val yel swal t'ayex, yujnhej to ex b'ud'ji he waan ixim pan, yuj chi' tzin he saya', manh yujok to ix nachajel eyuuj tas syalelk'och juntzanh satub'tak ix in ch'ox chi'.

Manh eyak' eyip he sayan ek' tas swaji, yujto elanhchamel slajwieli. Palta sayequek' jun wael max lajwiel-laj, yujto ha' ol ak'an he k 'inal t'a junelnhej. Ol wak' jun chi' t'ayex, yujto Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail, a ko Mam Dios sch'oxaneli to chab'il in yuj, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'an heb' t'ay: --¿Tas ol kutok ko k'ulan tas snib'ej Dios sko k'ulej chi'? xchi heb' t'ay.
Ix yalanxi Jesús chi' t'a heb': --Aton jun tik snib'ej Dios tze k'ulej, to tzin eyak' wal och t'a he k'ool, yujto a chekjinak in koti, xchi t'a heb'.
Ix sk'anb'anxi heb' t'ay: --¿Tas wal junok satub'tak tza ch'ox quila' yik ol ach kak'och t'a ko k'ool? ¿Tas tza k'ulej?

Ha heb' ko mam quicham ek'nak t'a peka', yilnak jun tas satub'tak heb', swanak jun maná heb' t'a taquinh lu'um icha syal t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani. Aton jun tz'alan icha tik: Ha Dios ak'jinakkot tas swa heb' t'a satcha’anh, xchi, xchi heb' t'a Jesús chi'.
Yuj chi' ix yalanxi Jesús chi' t'a heb': --Val yel swal t'ayex, manhoklaj winhaj Moisés tz'ak'an jun wael yik satcha’anh chi'. Palta a in Mam tz'ak'an jun wael te yel skot t'a satcha’anh.
Yujto a jun wael syak' Dios tik, ha t'a satcha’anh emnakkoti. Ay heb' ay t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik ol scha sk'inal t'a junelnhej yuj, xchi Jesús.
Ix yalanxi heb': --Mamin, ak' jun wael chi' t'ayonh t'a masanil tiempo, xchi heb' t'ay.
Ix yalanxi t'a heb': --Ha in ton tik icha wael waji, Ak'um in k 'inal. Ha heb' sja t'ayin, manhxa b'ak'uinh ol och swejel heb'. Ha heb' tzin ak'anoch t'a sk'ool, manhxa b'ak'uinh ol takjok sti' heb'.
Palta toxo ix wal t'ayex, wach'chom tzin eyila', max in eyak'och t'a he k'ool.
Masanil heb' tz'ak'ji t'ayin yuj in Mam, ol ja heb' t'ayin. Ha heb' sjawi t'ayin, manh ol in pechel heb'.
Ha in tik, kotnak in t'a satcha’anh yik tzul in b'o icha snib'ej Dios chekjinak in koti. Manh yujok ul in b'oan icha tas tzin nib'ej kotnak in.
Ha tas snib'ej in Mam chekjinak in koti, to manh ol satel junok mach t'a skal heb' syak' t'ayin. Snib'ej to a in ol wak' pitzwokxi heb' t'a slajwub' k'ual.

Ha in tik, Yuninal in Dios. Yuj chi' jantaknhej heb' tzin ilani, tato tzin yak'och heb' t'a sk'ool, snib'ej in Mam chi' to scha sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej. Yuj chi' a in ol wak' pitzwokxi heb' t'a slajwub' k'ual, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Ayic ix yab'an juntzanh chi' heb' aj Judea, chuk tas ix yalub'tanhej heb' t'a spatik Jesús chi', yujto ix yala': Ha in ton tik icha wael waji, kotnak in t'a satcha’anh, xchi t'a heb'.
Yuj chi' ix yalan heb': --Ha Jesús tik, yuninal winhaj José. Cojtak smam snun winh, palta syala' to t'a satcha’anh kotnak, xchi heb' aj Judea chi'.
Palta ix yalanxi Jesús t'a heb': --Manh in eyalub'tanhej.
Ha in Mam chekjinak in koti. Malaj junok mach syal skomon ja t'ayin, schaan sk'inal tato manhok in Mam tz'ak'ankot t'ayin. Ha heb' sja t'ayin, ol wak' pitzwokxi heb' t'a slajwub' k'ual.

Tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj heb' schekab' Dios icha tik: Ol k'ayb'aj masanil anima yuj Dios, xchi heb'. Yuj chi', a jantaknhej heb' syak'och schiquin t'a tas syal ko Mam Dios, tato snachajel yuj heb' tas syala', ol ja heb' t'ayin.
Manh wanok walani to ay mach ix ilan ko Mam Dios. Palta a in tik, a t'ay kotnak in, a innhej wilnak.
Val yel swal t'ayex, a mach tzin ak'anoch t'a sk'ool, ay sk'inal t'a junelnhej.
Ha in tik, icha wael waji, Ak'um in k 'inal.
Ha heb' ko mam quicham, swanak jun maná heb' t'a taquinh lu'um, palta anhejtona' chamnak heb' smasanil.
Palta a heb' swaan jun wael kotnak t'a satcha’anh, malaj b'ak'uinh ol cham heb'.

Ha in kotnak in t'a satcha’anh tik, icha wael waji, yujto Ak'um in k 'inal. Yuj chi', a heb' swaan jun wael tik, ay sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej. Ha jun wael swak' wajok tik, aton in niwanil, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Axo heb' aj Judea chi', ix stelaj sb'a heb' yuj tas ix yal chi', ix laj yalan heb': --Ha jun winh tik, ¿tas ol yutok winh yak'an sniwanil ko chi snaani? xchi heb'.
Yuj chi' ix yalxi t'a heb': --Val yel swal t'ayex, tato manh ol he chi in niwanil a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, manh ol eyuk'anpaxlaj in chiq'uil, manh ol he chalaj he k 'inal.
Yuj chi', yalnhej mach tz'ab'lan in niwanil tik, syuk'anpax in chiq'uil, ay sk'inal t'a junelnhej. Ha in ol wak' pitzwokxi t'a slajwub' k'ual.
Yujto a jun in niwanil tik, yel lajan yopisio yet' tas swaji. Ha in chiq'uil lajan yopisio yet' tas tz'uk'ji.
Yalnhej mach schi'an in niwanil tik, syuk'an pax in chiq'uil, junxonhej tz'ajkan wed'ok. Ayin pax och t'ay.
Ha ko Mam Dios pitzan t'a masanil tiempo, a chekjinak in koti. Yuj pitzan in. Yuj chi', a mach schi'an in niwanil tik, ol wak' sk'inal.

Ha tiknaik, wan walan yuj jun icha wael kotnak t'a satcha’anh. Ha jun tik, manh lajanok yet' jun maná swanak heb' ko mam quicham t'a peka'. Niwanoc swanak heb', palta chamnak pax heb'. Palta a mach ol waan jun icha wael tik, ol scha sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Ha t'a yol spatil kulto t'a chonhab' Capernaum, ata' ix yal juntzanh k'ayb'ub'al tik Jesús.
Ayic ix yab'an juntzanh chi' jantak heb' anima tzak'anoch yuj Jesús chi', ix yalan heb': --Te ya juntzanh slolonel syal tik. ¿Tom ay mach syal schaan yab'i? xchi heb'.
Axo Jesús chi', yojtakxo tas jun syal heb' chi', yuj chi' ix yalanxi t'a heb': --¿Tom a jun tik tz'ik'an somchajel he k'ool?
Ha in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, tato ol eyil in k'ex b'aj kotnak in, ¿tas ol eyutok eyalani?
Ha Espíritu tz'ak'an k 'inal. Axo ko niwanil tik malaj yopisio. Ha juntzanh lolonel ix wal tik t'ayex, te yel, yik pax Espíritu, a tz'ak'an k 'inal t'a junelnhej.

Palta ayex max in eyak'och t'a he k'ool, xchi t'a heb'. Icha chi' ix yutej yalan t'a heb', yujto atax t'a yichb’anel yojtaktaxoni mach heb' max ak'anoch t'a sk'ool. Yojtak paxi mach jun ol ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' chamel.
Ix yalanxi: --Yujto ayex maj in eyak'och t'a he k'ool, yuj chi' walnak t'ayex, malaj junok mach syal skomon ja t'ayin tato manhok in Mam tz'ak'ankot heb' t'ayin, xin chi, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Atax ta', tzijtum heb' tzak'anoch yuj ix meltzajxi t'a spatik. Manhxa snib'ej heb' tz'och tzak'an yuj.
Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'an Jesús t'a heb' lajchawaanh: --Xal ex tik, ¿ay am pax he gana tzex meltzajxi t'a he patik? xchi t'a heb'.
Axo winhaj Simón Pedro ix tak'wi t'ay: --Mamin, ¿mach b'aj ol onh och tzak'an jun? Malaj junxo mach icha tik sloloni yik sko cha ko k 'inal t'a junelnhej.
Ha onh tik, toxo ix ach kak'och t'a ko k'ool. Cojtak, a ach tik Sik'b'il ach el yuj Dios, xchi winhaj Pedro chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jesús t'a heb': --Ha ex he lajchawanhil, a in ex in sik'kaneli. Palta ay jun t'a he kal, schekab' winh diablo yaji, xchi t'a heb'.
Ha jun ix yal chi', aton winhaj Judas yuninal winhaj Simón aj Queriot. Yujto a winhaj Judas chi' ol ak'anoch Jesús t'a yol sk'ab' chamel. Palta yetk'ayb'umal sb'a winh yet' heb' uxluchwanh chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix och ijan Jesús yek' t'a yol yik Galilea. Axo t'a yol yik Judea, malaj snib'ej ix ek' ta', yujto a heb' winh aj Judea chi', snib'ej heb' winh smilanchamok.
Van sja stiempoal sq'uinh heb' israel skuch q'uinh chinama.
Yuj chi' ix yal heb' yuk'tak Jesús chi' t'ay: --Manh ach kan t'a tik. Ixic t'a Judea, yik wach' a heb' a k'ayb'um ayek' ta', ol yil pax heb' tastak satub'tak tza ch'oxo'.

Tato ay junok mach snib'ej scheklajel t'a yichanh heb' anima, max yal-laj elk'altak tz'eq'ui. Yuj chi', tato yel ay juntzanh satub'tak tza ch'oxo', yowalil tza ch'oxel a b'ha t'a yichanh heb' anima, xchi heb' t'ay.
Ix stz'ak yal heb' yuk'tak t'ay icha chi', yujto max yak'och Jesús chi' heb' t'a sk'ool.
Yuj chi' ix yal t'a heb': --Manto stiempoalok in ch'oxanel in b'a. Ha exxo tik, yalnhej tas tiempoal syal he naani.
Ha heb' ay t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik eyed'ok, max ex schaquel-laj heb'. Ha inxo tik, tzin schaquel heb', yujto tzin ch'oxeli to malaj swach'il sb'eyb'al heb'.
Ixiquec he ch'okoj t'a jun q'uinh chi'. Yujto a in tik, manto ol in k'ek'ochlaj, yujto manto stiempoalok in ch'oxanel in b'a, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi yalan juntzanh chi', ix kan yuj heb' t'a Galilea chi'.
Palta haxo yik toxo ix k'e heb' yuk'tak Jesús chi', ix k'e paxi, palta elk'altaknhej ix aj sk'ei.
Ha heb' aj Judea, ix smaklej heb' sk'och Jesús chi' t'a jun q'uinh chi'. --¿B'ajtil ayek' jun winak chi'? xchi heb'.
Manh jantakok yalub'tanhan heb' anima. Ay heb' tz'alani: Te wach' winh, xchi heb'. Ay pax heb' tz'alanxi: Maay, syak' heb' anima winh musansatil, xchi heb'.
Palta elk'altak syalub'tanhej heb', yujto xiw heb' yab'an heb' winh aj Judea chi'.
Vanxo snanhalb'i jun q'uinh chi', ix k'ek'och Jesús t'a yamaq'uil templo. Ix och ijan sk'ayb'an heb' anima ta'.
Axo heb' ay yopisio t'a skal heb' aj Judea chi', ix te sat sk'ol heb' yab'ani. Ix laj yalan heb': --¿Tas wal syutej yojtakanel juntzanh syal tik? Ina manh k'ayb'ab'ilok, xchi heb'.
Yuj chi' ix yalan Jesús chi' t'a heb': --Ha juntzanh k'ayb'ub'al swal t'ayex tik, manh wikok. Yic Dios chekjinak in koti.
Tato ay heb' syal sk'ol sk'ulej icha snib'ej Dios, ol nachajel yuj heb' tato yik Dios juntzanh k'ayb'ub'al tik, mato munil swal t'a yol wiko'.

Ha mach slolon t'a yol yiko', tonhej syik'chaanh sb'a, yik ay yelk'och t'a yichanh heb' anima snaani. Palta a in tik, in gana ha Dios chekjinak in kot ay yelk'och t'a eyichanh. Yuj chi', te yel swala'. Malaj jab'ok es swala'.
Aton wal winhaj Moisés ak'jinakkan sley Dios t'ayex. Palta ina malaj junok ex tze k'anab'ajej tas syal jun ley chi'. ¿Tas yuj he gana tzin he milchamok? xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Axo heb' anima ayek' chi' ta', ix yal heb' t'ay: --Ha ach tik, tekan ayoch junok enemigo t'ayach. ¿Mach junok snib'ej ach smilancham tzila'? xchi heb' t'ay.
Yuj chi' ix yalanxi t'a heb': --Ay jun tas ix in k'ulej t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip. E masanil ix sat he k'ool yuj.

Yuj heb' ko mam quicham t'a peka', elnakkan yich jun b'eyb'al skuch kirkunkisión. Axo winhaj Moisés aljinakkani to yowalil sko b'eyb'alej jun chi'. Yuj chi' wach'chom sk'ual ik'oj ip, slaj eyak' kirkunkidar heb' unin tzato alji.

Ha ex tik tzeyak' kirkunkidar heb' unin t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip, yik max ex ek' t'a yib'anh jun ley Moisés chi'. Tato icha chi', ¿tas yuj skot eyowal t'ayin yujto ix wak' b'oxok sk'ol jun winh penaay t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip chi'?
Manh he komon ch'olb'itej junok mach t'a ichnhejta'. Tato ay mach tze ch'olb'itej, t'a stojolal tzeyutej he ch'olb'itani, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Yuj chi' ay jaywanh heb' aj Jerusalén ix alani: --Ha jun winh tik, ¿tom manhok winh snib'ej heb' smilchamok?
Palta ina yajek' winh tik, wan slolon winh t'a ko kal. Ina malaj jab'ok tas syal heb' t'a winh. Tekan toxo ix snael heb' yajal chi' to a Cristo.
Ayic ol ja Cristo chi', malaj mach ojtannak b'aj ol kotok. Palta a jun winh tik, kojtak b'aj kotnak winh, xchi heb'.

Yakb'an wan sk'ayb'an heb' anima chi' Jesús t'a yamaq'uil templo chi', te chaanh ix yalelta t'a skal heb': --Ina eyojtak in. Eyojtakpax b'aj kotnak in. Palta manh munilok in ja t'a yol wiko'. Ha Dios te yel chekjinak in koti. Palta ha Dios chi' manh eyojtakok.
Ha inxo tik wojtak, yujto ata' kotnak in. A' chekjinak in koti, xchi t'a heb'.
Yuj chi' ay heb' ix alani to tz'ak'jioch t'a preso. Palta malaj mach ix yamani, yujto manto k'och stiempoal schami.
Tzijtum heb' anima ix ak'anoch Jesús t'a sk'ool, ix yalan heb': --Ayic ol jawok Cristo, ¿tom más ek'to tas satub'tak ol sch'ox t'a yichanh jun winh tik? xchi heb'.

Ix yab' heb' winh fariseo tas syal heb' anima yuj Jesús. Yuj chi', a heb' winh yet' heb' winh sat sakerdote ix chekanb'at juntzanh heb' stanhwumal stemplo Dios, yik b'at yik'kot Jesús heb', yik syak'anoch heb' t'a preso snaani.
Axo Jesús ix alan t'a heb' anima: --Jayexonhej k'ual ayinek' eyed'ok, ol lajwok chi' ol in meltzaj t'a mach chekjinak in koti.
Ha exxo tik, ol in he sayeq'ui, palta manhxo ol in ilchaj eyuuj, yujto max yal he k'och b'aj ol in k'och chi', xchi t'a heb'.

Axo heb' aj Judea chi', ix laj yal heb': --¿B'ajtil ol k'och winh snaani, yuj chi' syal winh to manhxo ol ilchaj winh kuuj? Ina ay heb' quetchonhab' ayb'at t'a skal heb' griego. ¿Tom snib'ej winh ata' ol k'och t'a skal heb', sb'at sk'ayb'an masanil heb' griego chi' winh snaani?

Ina ix yal winh t'ayonh: Ha ex tik, ol in he sayeq'ui, palta manhxo ol in ilchaj eyuuj, yujto max yal he k'och b'aj ol in k'ochok, xchi winh t'ayonh. ¿Tas wal syalelk'och jun ix yal winh tik t'ayonh? xchi heb'.

Ha t'a slajwub' k'ual q'uinh chi', aton jun k'u te niwan yelk'ochi, ata' ix elta linhan Jesús t'a yichanh heb' anima. Te chaanh ix yalelta t'a skal heb': --Tato ayex tze nib'ej tze cha he k 'inal t'a junelnhej, kotanhek t'ayin. Icha tz'aj eyuk'an ha ha', ayik stakji he ti', icha chi' ol aj he chaan he k 'inal t'ayin.

Tato ayex tzin eyak'och t'a he k'ool, icha to ay jun ha ha' tz'el yok ol pak' t'ayex. Aton jun chi' tz'ak'an he k 'inal t'a junelnhej. Yujto icha chi' syalkan t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani, xchi Jesús t'a heb' anima chi'.

Icha chi' ix yutej yalani to a heb' tz'ak'anoch t'a sk'ool, ol ak'jokoch Yespíritu Dios t'a heb'. Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', manto ak'ji Yespíritu Dios t'a heb' anima, yujto manto k'ex Jesús t'a satcha’anh.
Ixlajwi yab'an heb' anima tas ix yal Jesús chi', ay heb' ix laj alani: --Val yel, aton jun tik schekab' Dios tanhwab'iltaxon sja kuuj, xchi heb'.
Ay pax heb' ix laj alani: --Ha jun tik aton Cristo, xchi heb'. Palta ay heb' ix alanxi: --Ha Cristo chi', ¿tom aj Galilea icha jun winh tik tze na'a?
Ha Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkan tz'alani to a Cristo yowalil ol aljok t'a chonhab' Belén b'aj ek'nak winhaj Dawid t'a peka', yujto yinhtilalkan winhaj Dawid chi', xchi heb'.
Yuj chi' ix och ijan heb' anima stelan sb'a yuj Jesús chi'.
Ay heb' snib'ej syak'och t'a preso, palta malaj mach syamani.

Axo heb' stanhwumal stemplo Dios, anheja' sch'okoj heb' ix k'ochxi b'aj aykan heb' winh ix chekanb'at heb' chi', aton heb' winh fariseo yet' heb' winh sat sakerdote. Yuj chi' ix yalan heb' winh t'a heb': --¿Tas yuj maj eyik'kot Jesús chi'? xchi heb' winh.
--Malaj junok mach stzak'wan slolon icha slolon chi', xchi heb'.
Yuj chi' ix yalanpax heb' winh fariseo chi' t'a heb': --¿Tom ix ex ak'jipax musansatil a ex tik?
¿Tom ay junok ko yajalil ix ak'anoch winh t'a sk'ool? Anhejtona' a onh fariseo onh tik, ¿tok ay junok onh ix kak'och winh t'a ko k'ool?
Anhej heb' komon anima ix ak'anoch winh t'a sk'ool. Palta a heb' chi', manh yojtakok jab'ok ley Moisés heb'. Yuj chi' aykot yowal sk'ol Dios t'a yib'anh heb', xchi heb' winh fariseo chi'.
Palta ay jun winh fariseo chi' skuch Nicodemo. Aton jun winh xid'naquek' lolonel yet' Jesús t'ak'walil. Ix yalan winh t'a heb':
--Ha jun ley aykan t'ayonh, syala' to manh sleyalok skak'b'at t'a yib'anh junok anima, tato manto kab'i tas smul, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Yuj chi' ix yalanxi heb' t'a winh: --¿Tom aj Galilea ach yet' winh? k'ayb'ej Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani. Ata' ol ila' to manhoklaj t'a Galilea ol kot winh schekab' Dios tanhwab'il kuuj, xchi heb' t'a winh.
[Ix laj pax junjun heb' t'a spat.
Axo Jesús ix b'at t'a tzalan Oliwo.
Vanxo sakb'i, ix k'ochxi t'a yol yamaq'uil templo chi'. Ayic ix k'och ta', masanil heb' anima ix k'och yet'ok. Ix em k'ojan, ix sk'ayb'an heb'.

Axo heb' winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés yet' heb' winh fariseo ix ik'ankot jun ix ix t'a Jesús, ix yamchaj ix yuj heb' winh ayik wan smulan ix. Ix ak'jioch ix yuj heb' winh t'a yichanh Jesús yet' heb' ayek' yet'ok.
Ix yalan heb' winh t'ay: --Ach ko k'ayb'umal, a jun ix ix tik, wan smulan ix ayik ix yamchaj ix kuuj.
Ha ley Moisés tz'alani, tato ay junok ix ix sk'ulan icha tik, yowalil sjulk'enajcham ix. Xal ach, ¿tas xa chi? xchi heb' winh t'ay.

Palta tonhej stz'ak sk'anb'ej heb' winh, yik syil heb' winh tas syal Jesús chi', yujto snib'ej heb' winh yak'anoch t'a yib'anh. Palta tonhej ix em nhojan, wan stz'ib'an yet' yiximal sk'ab' t'a sat lu'um.

Ix sk'anb'anxi heb' winh t'ay: --¿Tas xa chi yuj jun tik jun? xchi heb' winh t'ay. Yuj chi' ix k'e k'elan, ix yalan t'a heb' winh: --Tato ay junok ex malaj jab'ok he mul, b'ab'laj julejekoch k'een t'a ix, xchi t'a heb' winh.
Ixlajwi yalan juntzanh chi', ix emxi nhojan, ix stz'ib'anxiem juntzanhxo tas t'a sat lu'um chi'.

Ayic ix yab'an jun tik heb' winh, ix laj snaan sb'a junjun heb' winh, aynhej smul heb' winh. Yuj chi' junjunal ix laj b'at heb' winh. Ha heb' winh ichamtak winak ix b'ab'laj b'ati, haxo heb' winh kelemtak, tzak'anto ix laj b'at heb' winh. Axonhej Jesús ix kan sch'okoj b'aj linhanek' jun ix ix chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix k'e k'elan Jesús chi', ix yilani sch'okojxonhej ix ayeq'ui. Yuj chi' ix yalan t'a ix: --Ach ix, ¿b'aj ay heb' winh wan yak'anoch chi' t'a ib'anh? ¿Tom malaj junok heb' winh tz'ak'anoch t'a ib'anh? xchi t'a ix.
--Maay Mamin, manhxalaj heb' winh, xchi ix. --Anhejtona' in, malaj tas swak'och t'a ib'anh. Yuj chi' ixik. Manhxo ach mulan junelxo, xchi Jesús chi' t'a ix.]

Ix yalanxi Jesús t'a heb' anima: --Ha in tik, icha sakil k'inal waj t'a heb' anima t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik. Ha mach tz'och tzak'an wuuj, ol wak' sakil k'inal t'ay. Yuj jun sakil k'inal chi', ol scha sk'inal t'a junelnhej. Manhxo ol b'eyek' t'a k’ik’ k’inal, xchi Jesús.
Axo heb' winh fariseo ix alan t'ay: --Ha ach tik, yolnhej ik tzala' to ay opisio. Yuj chi' malaj yelk'och jab' ik tzal chi', xchi heb' winh t'ay.

Ix yalanxi t'a heb' winh: --Wach'chom munil swala' to ay wopisio, palta toton yel swala', yujto a in tik wojtak b'aj kotnak in. Anhejtona', wojtak b'ajtil ol in k'ochxok. Ha exxo tik, manh eyojtakok b'aj kotnak in, anhejtona' manh eyojtakok b'aj ol in k'ochpaxok.
Ha ex tik, tonhej tze komon ch'olb'itej yaj junok anima t'a elanhchamel. Xal in, malaj mach tzin ch'olb'itej yaji.

Palta q'uinalok tato a in tzin ch'olb'itej yaj junok anima, tojolnhej swutej in ch'olb'itan yaji. Yujto manhok innhej tzin ch'olb'itej yaji, yujto a in Mam chekjinak in koti, a sch'olb'itan pax wed'ok.
Ha jun ley aykan t'ayonh, a tz'alani: Tato ay chawanhok testigo lajan syutej yalani, yowalil sko cha kab' tas syal heb'.
Palta ina ay chawanh testigo tz'alan wuuj. Ha in ton tik testigo in. Testigo pax in Mam wed'ok, aton chekjinak in koti, xchi t'a heb' winh.

--Palta ¿b'ajtil ay a Mam chi'? xchi heb' winh t'ay. Yuj chi' ix yalanpax t'a heb' winh: --Ha ex tik, manh eyojtakok mach in. Manh eyojtakok pax in Mam chi'. Octom tzin eyojtaquejeli mach in, yik ol eyojtaquej pax in Mam chi', xchi t'a heb' winh.
Ha t'a yol yamaq'uil templo t'a slak'anil jun chalab' ofrenda, ata' ix yal juntzanh chi' Jesús. Ata' ix k'ayb'aj heb' anima yuj. Malaj junok mach ix yamani, yujto manto k'och stiempoal schami.
Ix yalan Jesús t'a heb' winh: --Ha in tik ol in b'atok. Ha exxo tik ol in he sayeq'ui, palta ha t'a skal he mul ol ex chamok. Manh ol yal he komon k'och b'aj ol in k'och chi', xchi t'a heb' winh.
Yuj chi', ix laj yal heb' winh aj Judea chi': --Tekan ol smilcham sb'a winh, yuj chi' ix yal winh to max yal ko k'och b'aj ol k'och winh chi', xchi heb' winh.
Ix yalanxi t'a heb' winh: --Ha ex tik, aj sat lu'um ex, yujto yik ex yol yib'anhk’inal tik. Xal in tik, manh in yikok yol yib'anhk’inal tik, yujto aj satcha’anh in.
Yuj chi' swal t'ayex, t'a skal he mul ol ex chamok. Tato max eyak'och t'a he k'ool to Ha In Ton Tik, ha t'a skal he mul ol ex chamok, xchi.
--¿Mach ach jun? xchi heb' winh t'ay. Palta ina walnakxo t'ayex t'a yalanhtaxo, mach in.
Tzijtumto tas ol wal eyuuj yet' ex in ch'olb'itani. Ha jun chekjinak in koti, te yel syala'. Ha tas yalnakkan t'ayin, anhej chi' swal t'ayex a ex ayex t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, xchi t'a heb' winh.
Palta max nachajel yuj heb' winh tato a ko Mam Dios wan yalani.

Yuj chi' ix yalanxi t'a heb' winh: --Ato yik ol in he d'unhb'ank'e a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, ato ta' ol nachajel eyuuj to Ha In Toni. Ata' ol nachajel eyuuj to malaj tas munil tzin k'ulej in ch'okoj. Anhej juntzanh k'ayb'ub'al yalnak in Mam t'ayin, anhej swala'.
Ha Dios in chekankoti, ay paxoch wed'ok. Max in yaktejkan in ch'okoj, yujto anhej tas snib'ej tzin k'ulej t'a masanil tiempo, xchi t'a heb' winh.
Ayic ix yalan juntzanh chi' Jesús, tzijtum heb' ix ak'anoch sk'ool t'ay.
Axo ix yalan Jesús t'a heb' israel ix ak'anoch t'a sk'ool: --Tato masanil tiempo tzeyak'och he pensar t'a in lolonel, yelton wal in k'ayb'um ex.
Tato icha chi', ol eyojtaquejel slolonel Dios te yel. Yuj jun lolonel yel chi', ol ex el t'a libre, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Palta ix yalanxi heb' t'ay: --Ha onh tik yinhtil onh pax Abraham ed'ok. Malaj junelok ix onh och schekab'ok junok anima. ¿Tas yuj tzala' to ol onh el t'a libre? xchi heb'.
Val yel swal t'ayex, a mach anheja' sk'ulan chukal, chekab' yaj t'a chukal chi'.
Q'uinalok ay junok schekab' junok anima tiknaik, max yal skajnaj yet' jun anima chi' t'a junelnhej. Palta a junok yuninal jun anima chi', wal yel yuninal yaj t'a junelnhej.
Yuj chi' tato a in tzex wak'el t'a libre, wal yel libre tzex ajkani, yujto yuninal in Dios.
Ha in tik, wojtakxo to yinhtil ex kan winhaj Abraham chi' wed'ok. Palta ina he gana tzin he milchamok yujto a tas swala' malaj tz'och t'ayex.
Ha tas wilnak t'a in Mam, a swal t'ayex. Ha exxo tik, ch'ok jun he mam wan he k'anab'ajan tas syal t'ayex, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Palta a winhaj Abraham chi' ko mam yaj winh, xchi heb' t'ay. --Octom wal yel yinhtil ex winh, tato icha chi', tzam he k'anab'ajej icha sk'ulejnak winh.
Ha juntzanh tas yel yalnakkan Dios t'ayin, anhej swal t'ayex. Palta ina he gana tzin he milchamok. Manh ichokta' ix yutej sb'a winhaj Abraham chi'.
Ha ex tik, a tas sk'ulej jun he mam tze k'anab'ajej, xchi Jesús t'a heb'. --Palta a onh tik, manh onh mitz'uninoklaj. Junnhej ko Mam, aton Dios, xchi heb' t'ay.
--Octom yel to yuninal ex Dios chi'. Tato icha chi' tzam in he xajanej, yujto a in tik d'ha Dios kotnak in, in ja t'a tik. Manh yolok wik in jawi, yujto ha Dios chekjinak in koti.
¿Tas yuj max nachajel eyuuj tas swal t'ayex? Tekan malaj he gana tze cha eyab' tas swal tik.

Ha ex tik, a jun he mam, aton winh diablo. Yuj chi', anhej t'a winh tzeyak'och he pensar. Anhej tas snib'ej winh tze k'ulej. Yictax ix b'oji yol yib'anhk’inal tik, milumcham anima winh. Malaj yelk'och jab'ok tas yel t'a winh, yujto anhej es snib'ej winh. Ayic syesan winh, t'a spensar winh skoti, yujto esalwum winh. Ha t'a winh pitzwinakkot es chi'.
Ha inxo tik, yujto a juntzanh tas te yel swal t'ayex, yuj chi' max he cha eyab'i.
¿Mach junok ex syal he ch'oxanel jab'ok in mul? Te yel juntzanh tas swal t'ayex tik. Yuj chi', ¿tas yuj max he cha eyab'i?
Ha heb' yik Dios, syak'och schiquin heb' t'a slolonel. Palta a exxo tik, manh ex yikok Dios, yuj chi' max yal he k'ol tzeyak'och he chiquin t'ay, xchi Jesús t'a heb' winh.
Ix yalanpax heb' winh aj Judea chi' t'ay: --Tekan yel skala' to aj Samaria ach, tekan to ayoch junok enemigo t'ayach, xchi heb' t'ay.
--Maay, malaj junok enemigo ayoch t'ayin. Van in k'anab'ajan tas syal in Mam. Palta a ex tik, tonhej tzex b'uchwaj t'ayin.
Ha in tik, malaj in gana ay welk'ochi. Palta ay junxo tz'alani to ay welk'och t'a sat. Ha jun chi sch'olb'itani mach yel syala'.
Val yel swal t'ayex, a heb' sk'anab'ajan tas swala', malaj b'ak'uinh ol cham heb', xchi t'a heb' winh.

--Ha tiknaik skojtaquejeli to ayoch enemigo t'ayach. Ha winhaj Abraham yet' jantaknhej heb' schekab' Dios t'a peka', chamnakxo heb' smasanil. Ha achxo tik tzala': Tato ay mach sk'anab'ajan tas swala', malaj b'ak'uinh ol chamok, niwanok xa chi.
¿Tom ek'to elk'och t'a yichanh winh ko mam quicham aj Abraham chi'? Ina chamnak winh, chamnakxo pax heb' schekab' Dios chi', ¿mach ach a naan tiknaik? xchi heb' winh t'ay.
Yuj chi' ix yalxi t'a heb' winh: --Tato munil swik'chaanh in b'a, malaj welk'ochi. Palta a in Mam tz'alani to ay welk'ochi. Ha in Mam chi' tzeyaloch he Diosaloc,

palta niwanok tzeyal icha chi', yujto manh eyojtakok Dios chi'. Ha in tik, wojtak sik'lab'il. Q'uinalok swala' to manh wojtakok, swesej icha ex tik. Palta yel wojtak, yujto a tas syala', a tzin k'anab'ajejnhej.
Ha winh ko mam quicham aj Abraham chi', tzalajnak winh yujto aljinak t'a winh to ol yil winh in jawi. Ix yilan winh, yuj chi' ix te tzalaj winh, xchi t'a heb' winh.
--¿Tom ilnakto winhaj Abraham chi'? Ina manto ach k'och t'a 50 ab'il, xchi heb' winh t'ay.
--Val yel swal t'ayex, ayik manto alji winhaj Abraham chi', ayintaxoneq'ui, xchi Jesús chi' t'a heb' winh.
Ix laj sik'ank'e k'een k'een heb' winh yik sjulanoch k'een heb' winh t'ay. Ix sk'ub'anel sb'ha t'a heb' winh, ix elta t'a yamaq'uil templo chi'. Ix ek'b'at t'a skal heb' winh, ix b'ati.
Ayic wan yek' Jesús, ix yilanb'at jun winh max ujitaxon yilani.
Axo heb' sk'ayb'um ix k'anb'an t'ay: --Ach ko k'ayb'umal, ¿tas am yuj max yal yilan jun winh tik yiktax yaljub'al? ¿tom yuj smul smam snun winh, mato yuj smul winh? xchi heb' t'a Jesús.

Ix yalan Jesús chi' t'a heb': --Ha jun winh tik, manh yujok smul smam snun winh, manh yujok pax smul winh icha chi' yajkani. Yujto snib'ej Dios sch'ox tas satub'tak yuj winh, yuj chi' icha tik yaj winh.
Yowalil tzin b'o smunlajel Dios, aton chekjinak in koti, yakb'an ayto k'u, yujto ayik toxo ix b'at k'u, manhxalaj mach syal smunlaji.
Ayic ayin to ek' t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, icha sakil k'inal waj t'a heb' anima, xchi Jesús chi'.
Ixlajwi yalan juntzanh chi', ix tzub'anem t'a sat lu'um. Ix och jab' lum sok'omal yuj stzub' chi'. Ix sukanoch lum t'a yol sat winh max yal yilan chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan t'a winh: --Ixic, b'at b'iquel t'a jun b'aj molb'ab'il ha ha' skuch Siloé, xchi t'a winh. (Siloé syalelk'ochi, Ak'b'ilkoti.) Ix b'at sb'ikanel winh, haxo ix meltzaj winh, tzaxo yal yilan winh.
Axo ix yilan heb' ay t'a spatik schiquin spat winh yet' juntzanhxo heb' tz'ilantaxon sk'anan stumin winh, ix laj yalan heb': --¿Tom manhok jun winh tik tz'em k'ojan k'anoj tumin? xchi heb'.

--Ha winh jun, xchi juntzanh heb'. Palta ay juntzanhxo heb' ix alani: --Maay. Ha jun winh tik, tonhej lajan yilji winh yet' jun winh max yal yilan chi', xchi heb'. Palta haxo winh ix alani: --Ha in toni, xchi winh.
--¿Tas ix aj sb'o ilan jun? xchi heb' t'a winh.

--Ha jun winh skuchan Jesús ixb’o’an jab' lum sok'om, ix sukanoch winh t'a yol in sat tik. Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh t'ayin: Ixic, b'iquel a sat t'a ha ha' skuch Siloé, xchi winh t'ayin. Ix b'at in b'ikaneli. Icha chi' ix aj sb'o wilani, xchi winh.
--¿B'ajtil ayek' winh tiknaik? xchi heb' winh. --Ma chequel, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix ik'jib'at winh t'a yichanh heb' winh fariseo.
Ha t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip, ata' ix b'o yilan winh yuj Jesús yet' lum sok'om ix sb'o chi'.

Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'an heb' winh fariseo chi' t'a winh: --¿Tas wal ix aj sb'o ilani? xchi heb' winh. --Ha Jesús ix b'oani. Ix sukoch jab' lum sok'om t'a yol in sat tik. Ixlajwi chi', ix in schekanb'at in b'iqueli. Yuj chi' wach'xo wilan tiknaik, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ay jaywanh heb' winh ix alan t'a winh: --Ha jun winh chi', manh yikoklaj Dios yaj winh, yujto max sk'anab'ajej sk'ual ik'oj ip winh, xchi heb' winh. Palta ix laj yalan juntzanhxo heb' winh: --Tato chuk winh, ¿tom syal sch'oxan juntzanh satub'tak winh? xchi heb' winh. Yuj chi' chapoj ix aj heb' winh.

Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'an heb' winh t'a jun winh ix b'o yilan chi': --Ha achxo tik, ¿tas tzutej a naan yuj winh ixb’o’an a sat tik? xchi heb' t'a winh. --Ha in tik tzin na'a to schekab' Dios yaj winh, xchi winh.
Palta haxo heb' winh aj Judea chi', max schalaj yab' heb' winh, tato toto ix b'o yilan winh. Ha snaan heb' winh to toxonton wach' yilan winh. Yuj chi' ix awtaj smam snun winh.
Ix k'anb'aj t'a heb': --¿Eyune' am jun winh tik? Palta to tzeyala' to max yaltaxon yilan winh. Tato icha chi', ¿tas wal ix aj sb'o yilan winh? xchi heb' t'a smam snun winh chi'.
--Ha jun winh tik, quik winh. Toxonton max yal yilan winh.

Palta manh kojtakok, tas am ix aj sb'o yilan winh. Manh kojtakok, mach am ixb’o’an sat winh tik. Ina ayxo sk'inal winh. ¿Tas yuj manhok t'a winh tze k'anb'ej eyab'i? Ha winh syal yalan t'ayex, tas ix aj sb'o sat winh chi', xchi heb'.

Icha chi' ix yutej heb' yalani, yujto xiw heb' yalan yuj heb' winh yajal t'a skal heb' aj Judea chi'. Yujto toxo ix yal heb' winh yajal chi': Tato ay heb' ol alanok to a Jesús aton Cristo, ol ko pechel heb' t'a yoltak spatil kulto, xchi heb' winh.
Yuj chi', anhej jab' tik ix yal smam snun winh: Ina ayxo sk'inal winh. ¿Tas yuj manhok t'a winh tze k'anb'ej eyab'i? xchinhej heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix awtajxikot winh, ix yalan heb' t'a winh: --Val yel tzach lolon t'a yichanh Dios. Yujto kojtak a onh tik to te chuk jun winh ixb’o’an a sat tzal chi', xchi heb' winh.
--Ha in tik, manh wojtakok tato chuk winh, mato maay. Max yal-laj walani. Anhej tas wojtak: Ha t'a yalanhtaxo, max yal wilani, palta a tiknaik tzaxo wila'', xchi winh.
--Palta ¿tas wal ix ach yutej winh? ¿Chajwaltil ix yutej winh sb'oan a sat tik? xchi heb' winh t'a winh.
--Toxo ix wala', palta max he cha eyab' t'ayin. ¿Tas yuj he gana tze k'anb'ej eyab' t'ayin junelxo? ¿Tom he gana tzex och pax sk'ayb'umok winh? xchi winh t'a heb' winh aj Judea chi'.
Ayic ix yab'an juntzanh chi' heb' winh, ix te b'uchji winh yuj heb' winh. Ix yalan heb' winh: --Ha ach tik, sk'ayb'um ach ton jun winh chi'. Xal onh tik, sk'ayb'um onh Moisés.
Cojtak to yalnakkan slolonel Dios t'a winhaj Moisés chi'. Palta a jun winh chi', manh kojtakok mach ak'jinak yopisio winh, xchi heb' winh.
--E... ¿jantak am b'ian? Ha ex tik tzeyala' to manh eyojtakok mach ak'jinak yopisio winh, palta ina ix b'o wilan yuj winh.
Cojtak to ha Dios max ab'an slesal heb' chuk sk'ulej. Anhej heb' syal sb'a t'ay, heb' sk'anab'ajan tas syala', anhej yik heb' syab'i.
Manta b'aj skab' sb'o sat junok max yaltaxon yilani.
Q'uinalok manhok Dios ix chekankot Jesús chi', tekan malaj jab'ok tas syal yuj, xchi winh.
--Ha ach tik, te chuk ach yiktax ach alji. ¿A achxo ijan tzonh a k'ayb'ej? xchi heb' winh. Yuj chi' ix spechelta winh heb' winh t'a spatil kulto chi'.

Axo ix yab'an Jesús to ix pechjiel winh ix b'oxi sat chi', yuj chi' ix sayjiek' winh yuj. Axo yik ix ilchaj winh yuj, ix yalan t'a winh: --¿Tzam ak'och jun Ak'b'ilkot yuj Dios yoch Animail t'a a k'ool? xchi t'a winh.
--Mamin, al t'ayin mach jun chi', yik ol wak'och t'a in k'ool, xchi winh.
--Toxo ix ila'. Ha in ton wan walan t'ayach, xchi t'a winh.
Ixlajwi yalan jun chi' Jesús, ix em kumnaj winh t'a yichanh. Ix yalan winh t'ay: --Mamin, tzach wak'och t'a in k'ool, xchi winh.

Ix yalanxi Jesús t'a winh: --Yuj sb'o heb' anima wuuj in ja t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, yujto ay heb' max yal-laj yilan yik Dios tiknaik, palta wuuj ichato ol jakwok sat heb'. Ay pax nanhalxo heb' ichato syal yilan yik Dios snaani, palta a heb' chi', wuuj ichato ol juwokb'at sat heb', xchi Jesús.
Ay jaywanh heb' winh fariseo ayek' ta'. Ayic ix yab'an jun chi' heb' winh, ix yalan heb' winh t'a Jesús: --¿Tom tza na to max uji quilan yik Dios? xchi heb' winh.
--Octom snachajel eyuuj to max yal eyilan yik Dios chi'. Tato icha chi', max am kan he mul t'a eyib'anh. Palta ina tzeyala' to syal eyilan yik Dios chi', yuj chi' ol kannhej he mul chi' t'a eyib'anh.
Q'uinalok ay junok te' makte' kalnel tiknaik, ta ay junok winh tz'och t'a yol te', palta tato manhok t'a sti' te' tz'och winh, wal yel elk'um winh syal chi'.
Axo winh tz'och t'a sti' te' smakte' nok' kalnel chi', aton winh chi' stanhwumal nok'.

Axo winh swaymitan nok' kalnel chi', a winh sjakan te' makte' chi' t'a winh stanhwumal nok' chi'. Axo nok' kalnel chi', k'aynak nok' yet' winh stanhwumal chi'. Yojtak sb'i junjun nok' winh. Ha winh sjakanelta nok'.
Slajwi sjakanelta nok' skalnel winh chi', sb'ab'laj winh yuj nok', tz'och tzak'an nok' yuj winh, yujto k'aynak nok' yet' winh.
Palta q'uinalok ay junok winh manh k'aynakok nok' yet'ok, tonhej tz'el lemnaj nok' t'a winh, yujto manh ojtakab'ilok sjaj winh yuj nok', xchi Jesús t'a heb' winh fariseo chi'.
Ha jun ch'oxnab'il ix yal Jesús chi', maj nachajel-laj yuj heb' winh tas syalelk'ochi.
Ix yalanxi Jesús t'a heb' winh: --Val yel swal t'ayex, icha yaj sti' te' smakte' nok' kalnel, icha chi' waji.

Ay heb' ix b'ab'laj ja t'ayex ayik manto in jawok, niwanok yalnakoch sb'a heb' kolwajumal. Icha junok elk'um tz'och t'a te' makte', icha chi' yaj heb' smasanil. Palta haxo heb' yik Dios, max yak'och spensar heb' t'a heb'.
Ha in tik, lajan in yet' sti' te' makte' chi'. Ha heb' tz'och t'ayin, ol kolchaj heb'. Icha nok' kalnel tz'och t'a yol smakte', tz'elxita nok', sb'at wa nok', icha chi' yaj heb'.
Ay heb' icha junok elk'um sjawi, syelk'al milan nok' kalnel chi' heb'. Palta a in tik, ix in ja wak' sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej, yik wach' te niwan swach'k'olal Dios ol scha heb'.
Ha in tik, lajan in yet' junok tanhwum kalnel te wach'. Ha junok tanhwum kalnel wach' chi', sb'ek sb'a scham yuj nok' skalnel chi'.

Ay b'aj tonhej stupji junok winh stanhwan nok' kalnel, manh toxonok tanhwum kalnel winh, manh yikok nok' winh. Tato sk'och nok' oques t'a nok', syaktejkan nok' kalnel chi' winh sch'okoj, sb'at winh elelal, yujto manh yikok nok' winh. Axo nok' oques chi' sja juknajok, schianb'at nok' kalnel chi', saklemkanb'at nok'.
Tz'el lemnaj winh, yujto majan yaj winh, yujto manh yikok nok' winh, malaj tz'och nok' t'a winh.

Ha in tik, lajan in yet' junok tanhwum kalnel te wach'. Ha heb' wiko', ichato in kalnel yaj heb'. Ha in Mam yojtak in. Anhejtona' in, wojtak pax in Mam chi'. Icha wojtak in b'a yet' in Mam chi', icha pax chi' wojtak in b'a yet' heb' wik chi'. B'ekan in wak'an cham in b'a yuj heb'.

Ay pax juntzanhxo heb' ol in ak'anoch t'a sk'ool, palta manh quetisraeloklaj heb'. Yowalil ol in molb'ejkot heb'. Ha heb' chi', ol in sk'anab'ajej heb'. Junnhej ol aj heb' smasanil, a in ol in tanhwej heb'.
Xajan in yuj in Mam, yujto b'ekan in k'ool in chami yik ol in pitzwokxi.

Ha in tik, b'ekan in k'ol in chami, yujto icha chi' in gana. Malaj mach tz'ik'anek' in k 'inal tik. Ha in swala' to tzin chami, anhejtona' in swala' to tzin pitzwixi, yujto icha chi' yaj yalankan jun scheknab'il in Mam t'ayin, xchi Jesús t'a heb' winh.
Ayic ix yalan juntzanh tik, ix laj spojan sb'a heb' aj Judea chi' junelxo yuj tas ix yal chi'.
Ay nanhal heb' ix alani: --¿Tas yuj tzeyak'och he chiquin t'a tas syal jun winh tik? Ina ayoch jun enemigo t'a winh, yuj chi' aykot t'a sjolom winh, xchi heb'.
Palta ay nanhalxo heb' ix alani: --Tato ayoch junok enemigo t'a winh, ¿tom syal yalan winh icha chi'? Ha junok enemigo, ¿tom syal sb'oan sat junok mach max yaltaxon yilani? xchi heb'.
Ha t'a jun pekti’ ix uji jun tik, aton t'a stiempoal siik, stiempoal pax yoch sq'uinhal stemplo Dios t'a Jerusalén.
Axo Jesús wan sb'eyek' t'a jun stentail sti' yamaq'uil templo chi' skuch yik Salomón.
Axo heb' aj Judea ayek' ta', ix och oyan heb' t'a spatik Jesús. Ix yalan heb': --¿B'aq'uinhto ol al sjichanil t'ayonh? Tato yel Cristo ach, al t'ayonh tiknaik, xchi heb' t'ay.

Yuj chi' ix tak'wi t'a heb': --Ina toxo ix wal t'ayex, palta max in eyak'och t'a he k'ool. Ha juntzanh satub'tak tzin ch'oxo', yujnhej spoder in Mam tzin ch'oxo'. Yujnhej juntzanh chi' scheklaji mach in.
Palta a ex tik, max in eyak'och t'a he k'ool, yujto manh ex wikok icha walnak t'ayex junel.
Ha heb' wiko', syak'och schiquin heb' t'ayin. Ha inxo tik, wojtak heb'. Icha nok' kalnel tz'och tzak'an yuj stanhwumal, icha chi' tz'ajoch tzak'an heb' wuuj.
Ha in swak' sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej. Yuj chi', manhxa b'ak'uinh ol satel heb'. Malaj mach syal yik'anel heb' t'a yol in k'ab'.
Ha in Mam, te niwan yelk'och t'a yichanh smasanil. Ha ix ak'an heb' t'ayin. Malaj mach syal yik'anel heb' t'a yol sk'ab' in Mam chi'.
Ha in tik, lajan in yet' ko Mam Dios, yujto junnhej waj yet'ok, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Ix laj sik'anchaanh k'een k'een heb' yik sjulancham heb' yalani.
Palta ix yalanxi Jesús t'a heb': --Tzijtum tas wach' ix in k'ulej t'a he kal yuj spoder in Mam. ¿Tas yuj junok ijan tzin he julchamok? xchi t'a heb'.
--Manh yujok junok wach' ix a k'ulej tzach ko julchamok, palta yujnhej to tzach b'uchwaj d'ha Dios. Ha ach tik anima achnhej, palta ina tzaloch a b'a Diosal, xchi heb'.
Yuj chi' ix yalanxi t'a heb': --Ha t'a ch'anh ley aykan t'ayonh tz'ib'ab'ilkani to ha Dios alannak: Junjun ex, Dios ex, xchi t'a ley chi'.
Cojtak to a tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a Slolonel Dios chi', max yal sko mak'eq'ui. Ha heb' ab'annak slolonel chi', alchajnak heb' diosal.
Ocxom in tik, ha Dios sik'jinak in eli, ix in schekankot t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik. Yuj chi', ¿tas yuj tzeyala' to tzin b'uchwaj d'ha Dios, ayik ix walani to Yuninal in Dios?
Tato max in k'ulej icha tas sk'ulej in Mam chi', manh in eyak'och t'a he k'ool.

Palta a in tik, yel wan in k'ulan icha sk'ulej in Mam chi'. Yuj chi', wach'chom max eyak'och t'a he k'ool tas swala', palta aq'ek in och t'a he k'ool yuj juntzanh tzin k'ulej tik, yik ol nachajel eyuuj to ayoch ko Mam Dios t'ayin, ayin pax och t'ay, xchi Jesús chi' t'a heb'.
Yuj chi' ix yak'lej heb' syaman junelxo, palta ix skol sb'ha t'a heb'.
