Ixlajwi chi', ix k'axpajxikan ek' t'a sk'axepal ha' Jordán. Axo b'aj yak'nak bautizar heb' anima winhaj Juan ix aji.
Tzijtum anima ix k'och ta'. Ix laj yalan heb': --Ha winhaj Juan, malaj b'aj ix sch'ox junok tas satub'tak winh, palta jantaknhej tas ix yal winh yuj Jesús tik, te yel, xchi heb'.
Ha t'a jun lugar chi', tzijtum heb' ix ak'anoch Jesús t'a sk'ool.
Ay jun winh t'a chonhab' Betania skuchan Lázaro, te penaay winh. Ata' pax kajan chawanh heb' ix yanab' winh, jun ix skuch María, haxo junxo ix, Marta sb'i ix.
Ha ix María chi' sukjinaquek' jun yal suk'uq'ui sjab' t'a yok Jesús Kajal, haxo yet' xil sjolom ix suknak takjok. Ix penaayax winhaj Lázaro chi'.
Yuj chi', ix yak'kot sti' heb' ix t'a Jesús, ix yalankot heb' ix icha tik: --Mamin, a winh te xajan uuj, penaay winh, xchikot heb' ix.

Ayic ix yab'an Jesús tas ix yalkot heb' ix chi', ix yalan icha tik: --Ha jun ilya chi', manh ol chamlaj winh yuj t'a junelnhej. Ix yamchaj winh yuj jun yab'il chi' yik ol sch'ox Dios to te niwan yelk'ochi, yik scheklajpaxeli to te niwan welk'och a in Yuninal in Dios tik, xchi Jesús.
Te xajan winhaj Lázaro chi', ix María yet' ix Marta yuj Jesús chi'.
Ayic ix yab'an Jesús chi' to te penaay winh, maj b'atlaj t'a elanhchamel. Chab'to k'ual ix kan b'aj ayek' chi'.
Axo yik ix k'och sk'ual sb'at chi' jun, ix yalan t'a heb' sk'ayb'um: --Koyec t'a yol yik Judea junelxo, xchi t'a heb'.
Ix yalan heb' t'ay: --Ach ko k'ayb'umal, ina ijan sjulnak ach cham heb' aj Judea chi' jun, ¿tom tzach b'atxi? xchi heb'.
Ix yalanxi t'a heb': --Cojtak to lajchawe' hora tzek' t'a junjun k'u. Tato tzonh b'eyek' t'a k'ualil, manh komonok tzonh telwi, yujto sakq'uinal.
Palta a heb' sb'eyek' t'ak'walil, skomon telwi heb', yujto malaj sakil k'inal t'a heb', xchi Jesús.
Ixlajwi yalan jun chi', ix yalanpax yuj winhaj Lázaro: --Ha winh ko wach' k'ool chi', tonhej sway winh. Palta ol b'at in pitzel swayanh winh, xchi t'a heb'.
--Mamin, tato tonhej sway winh, tekan ol b'oxok sk'ol winh, xchi heb' sk'ayb'um chi' t'ay.
Ayic ix yalan Jesús to sway winhaj Lázaro chi', syalelk'ochi to chamnakxo winh. Palta a snaan heb' tonhej sway winh.
Yuj chi', tojol ix yutej yalan t'a heb': --Toxo ix cham winh.
Ha tiknaik tzin tzalaji, yujto manh in ayoquek' ta' ix cham winh, yik ol in eyak'och t'a he k'ool. Yuj chi' koyek b'at quilek, xchi t'a heb'.
Axo winhaj Tomás, jun winh tz'alji Tioxal, ix yal winh t'a heb' yetk'ayb'umal chi': --Koyec, b'at kak'ekcham ko b'a yet'ok, xchi winh.
Axo yik ix k'och heb', ix yab'an heb' to oxjitax ix mukchaj winhaj Lázaro chi'.
Ha chonhab' Betania b'aj ay winh chi', t'a slak'anil Jerusalén ay. Ay am nanhalok legua skal.
Yuj chi', tzijtum heb' israel aj Jerusalén chi' xid' niwanan sk'ool ix María yet' ix Marta yuj winh snulej heb' ix, ix cham chi'.
Ayic ix yab'an ix Marta to wan sk'och Jesús, ix ja ix scha'a. Axo ix María aykan ix t'a yol pat.
Ix yalan ix Marta chi' t'a Jesús icha tik: --Mamin, ayokach ek'laj t'a tik ayik ix cham winh in nulej chi', tekan maj chamlaj winh.
Palta a tiknaik, wojtak yalnhej tas ol a k'an d'ha Dios, A' ol ak'an t'ayach, xchi ix t'ay.
--Ha winh a nulej chi' ol pitzwokxi winh, xchi Jesús chi' t'a ix.
--Yel toni, wojtak to ol pitzwokxi winh, palta ato t'a slajwub' k'ual ayik ol pitzwokxi heb' chamnak, xchi ix t'ay.
--Ha in tik, swak' pitzwokxi heb' chamnak, aj k 'inal in. Ha mach tzin ak'anoch t'a sk'ool, wach'chom ol chamok, palta ol pitzwokxi.
Ha mach pitzanto tzin yak'anoch t'a sk'ool, manhxa b'ak'uinh ol chamok. ¿Tzam ak'och jun tik t'a a k'ool? xchi Jesús t'a ix.
--I'... Mamin, swak'och t'a in k'ool to Cristo ach, Yuninal ach Dios. Ha ach tik tanhwab'il a ja t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, xchi ix t'ay.
Ixlajwi yalan jun chi' ix Marta chi', ix pax ix. Ix b'at ix yawtejkot ix María ix snulej chi'. Ix sajanoch ix t'a schiquin ix t'a elk'altak: --Ix ja ko k'ayb'umal, tzach yawtej, xchi ix.
Ayic ix yab'an jun chi' ix María chi', ix k'e juknaj ix. Ix b'at ix b'aj ayek' Jesús chi',
yujto manto och t'a yol jun chonhab' chi'. Anheja' ayek' b'aj xid' scha ix Marta chi'.

Palta ay heb' aj Judea ayek' yet' ix t'a yol spat chi'. Ayek' heb' sniwanej sk'ol ix. Axo ix yilan heb', ix k'e juknaj ix, ix b'at lemnaj ix, tzak'anxonhej ix b'at heb' yuj ix, yujto a snaan heb' to sb'at ok' ix b'aj mukan winh snulej chi'.
Ayic ix k'och ix b'aj aykan Jesús chi', ix em kumnaj ix t'a yichanh, ix yalan ix t'ay: --Mamin, ayokach ek'laj t'a tik a ix cham winh in nulej chi', tekan maj chamlaj winh, xchi ix.
Ayic ix yilan Jesús to tz'ok' ix, tz'ok' pax heb' aj Judea ix k'och yet' ix, ix te kusk'e yet' heb'.
Ix sk'anb'an t'a heb' ix: --¿B'ajtil ix he muquem winh? xchi t'a heb' ix. --Mamin, koyek b'at quileknab'i, xchi heb' ix.
Ix ok' Jesús.
Axo heb' aj Judea ayek' chi' ta', ix laj yalan heb': --Te xajan winh yuj, xchi heb'.
Ay pax heb' ix laj alani: --Ha Jesús tik, ha' b'ojinakxi sat jun winh max yaltaxon yilani. ¿Tom maj yal ix kolwaj t'a winhaj Lázaro tik, yik wach' maj chamlaj winh? xchi heb'.
Te kusnak Jesús ayik ix k'och b'aj mukan winhaj Lázaro chi'. Ha t'a yol jun k'een k'een joyb'ilel yool, ata' ayoch sniwanil winh. Aypaxoch jun k'een k'een smakulok sti' k'een.
--Ik'equel k'een smakul tik, xchi Jesús. Axo ix Marta ix alan t'ay: --Mamin, oxjitax cham winh, ayxomlaj sjab' winh tiknaik, xchi ix.
Toxo ix wal t'ayach, tato tzin ak'och t'a a k'ool, ol il spoder Dios, xchi t'a ix.
Ichato chi' ix yik'anel k'een smakul chi' heb' b'aj ayoch sniwanil winh chi'. Ix k'e k'elan Jesús t'a satcha’anh, ix yalani: --Mamin, swak' yuj diosal t'ayach yujto ix ab' tas swala'.
Vojtaktaxoni, masanil tiempo tzab' tas swala'. Palta yuj heb' anima tik swal juntzanh tik t'ayach, yik wach' ol yak'och heb' t'a sk'ool to a ach a cheknak in koti, xchi Jesús.
Ixlajwi yalan juntzanh chi', te chaanh ix yala': --Lázaro, elanhkoti, xchi.

Axo winh chamnak chi', ix elta winh, b'ak'b'il yok winh yet' sk'ab' t'a jun k'apak, b'ak'b'il pax snanhal sat winh yet' junxo k'apak. Ix yalanxi Jesús: --Xuyequel juntzanh k'apak ayoch tik t'a winh, tzeyaktanel winh, xchi.
Axo heb' aj Judea ajun yet' ix María chi', ayik ix yilan heb' tas ix sk'ulej Jesús chi', tzijtum heb' ix ak'anoch t'a sk'ool.
Palta ay juntzanhxo heb' ix b'at alan yab' heb' winh fariseo tas ix yutej sb'a Jesús chi'.

Axo heb' winh fariseo chi' yet' heb' winh sat sakerdote, ix slajtiej sb'a heb' winh yet' heb' winh sat yajal. Ix laj yalan heb' winh icha tik: --¿Tas skutejek winh tze na'a? Yujto tzijtum wal juntzanh satub'tak sch'ox winh.

Tato tonhej squiloch winh tiknaik, masanil heb' quetchonhab' ol ak'anoch winh t'a sk'ool. Axo heb' winh yajal t'a Roma ol ul smak'poj jun stemplo Dios tik heb' winh, ol ul onh satanel heb' winh ko masanil, xchi heb' winh.
Palta ay jun winh skuchan Caifás, aton winh sat sakerdote t'a jun ab'il chi'. Ha winh ix alan t'a heb' winh: --Ha ex tik, malaj jab'ok he pensar.
Max nachajel jab'ok eyuuj, más wach' t'ayonh tato scham jun winh chi' sk'exulok heb' anima smasanil. Tato icha chi', manh ol onh satel ko masanil, xchi winh.

Ha winhaj Caifás chi', manhok t'a yol yik winh ix yal jun chi', palta yujto sat sakerdote yaj winh t'a jun ab'il chi', yuj chi' ha Dios ix ak'an yal winh to ol cham Jesús sk'exulok heb' israel smasanil.
Ha schamel chi', manh yujoknhej heb' israel chi', palta yuj pax smolb'anxi heb' yuninal Dios sakleminak yajkanb'ati, yik junxonhej tz'aj heb'.
Yuj chi', atax t'a jun k'u chi' ix och ijan heb' winh snaan tas ol yutok smilancham Jesús.
Yuj chi' maxtzak ek' Jesús t'a skal heb' aj Judea chi'. Ix el t'a jun lugar chi'. Ix b'at t'a jun chonhab' skuchan Efraín ay t'a sti' jun lum taquinh lu'um. Ata' ix kan yet' heb' sk'ayb'um.

Ayic wan sja stiempoal jun q'uinh tz'ochi yik snaankot heb' israel tas aj yelnakkot heb' smam yicham heb' t'a Egipto, tzijtum wal heb' najat ix laj koti, ix laj k'och heb' t'a Jerusalén. Ayic manto yamchajoch jun q'uinh chi', ix k'och heb' ta' yik sb'o sb'a heb' icha yalan ley.
Ayic ayek' heb' ta', tzijtum wal heb' ix ek' sayanek' Jesús, haxo t'a yamaq'uil templo ix laj yal heb': --¿Tas tze na'a? ¿Ol am ja Jesús t'a q'uinh tik, mato maay? xchi heb'.

Axo heb' winh fariseo yet' heb' winh sat sakerdote ix ak'anelta jun ab'ix tz'alan icha tik: Tato ay b'aj tzeyil Jesús, tzul eyal t'ayonh, xchi heb' winh. Icha chi' ix yutej heb' winh yalani, yujto snib'ej heb' winh syak'och Jesús t'a preso.
Ob'ixxonhej yoch q'uinh t'a Jerusalén yik snaankot heb' israel tas aj yelnakkot heb' smam yicham heb' t'a Egipto, ix k'ochxi Jesús t'a Betania, b'aj kajan winhaj Lázaro, aton winh ix pitzwixi yuj.
Ayic ix k'och Jesús chi' ta', ix ak'jioch jun niwan wael yuj heb' yuj Jesús. Ix wa winhaj Lázaro yet' heb'. Ha ix Marta ix k'atk'ankot heb'.

Axo ix María, yet'nak nanhal litro yal suk'uq'ui sjab' ix, skuch nardo. Ha jun chi' te karo stojol. Axo ix k'och ix, ix stob'anoch ix t'a yok Jesús. Ixlajwi chi' ix sukan takjok ix t'a xil sjolom. Ix el numan sjab' t'a yol pat chi'.
Ay jun winh sk'ayb'um Jesús skuchan Judas aj Queriot yuninal winhaj Simón, aton winh ol ak'anoch Jesús t'a yol sk'ab' chamel. Ix yal winh icha tik:
--Ha jun suk'uq'ui sjab' tik, ay am junok 300 denario stojol. Octom ix ko chonho', haxo stojol chi' skak' t'a heb' meb'a', niwanok xchi winh.
Palta yes winh. Max snalaj jab'ok heb' meb'a' chi' winh. Yujto sik'um tumin yaj winh, yuj chi' snib'ej winh sik' stojol chi', yik wach' syik'kanel jab'ok yik winh, yujto elk'um winh.
Axo ix yalan Jesús t'a winh: --Manh a tzuntzej ix, yujto a jun suk'uq'ui sjab' tik, sik'b'ilb'at yuj ix yik wach' listaxo yaj in muquilok.
Axo heb' meb'a' tzal chi', aynhejek' heb' eyed'ok. Ha inxo tik, manh masanilok tiempo ayinek' eyed'ok, xchi t'a winh.

Tzijtum heb' israel ix ab'ani to ayek' Jesús t'a Betania. Yuj chi' ix b'at heb' yila'. Manhoknhej Jesús snib'ej heb' syila'. Snib'ej pax heb' syil winhaj Lázaro, yujto ix pitzwixi winh t'a skal heb' chamnak yuj Jesús.

Yuj winhaj Lázaro chi', tzijtum heb' ix ak'anoch Jesús t'a sk'ool. Maxtzac yak'och spensar heb' t'a heb' winh sakerdote. Yuj chi' ix slajtiej sb'a heb' winh sat sakerdote chi' tas syutej heb' winh smilanpaxcham winhaj Lázaro chi'.
Tzijtum anima ix k'och t'a Jerusalén yuj sq'uinh heb' israel yik snajikoti tas aj yelnakkot heb' smam yicham heb' t'a Egipto. Axo t'a junxo k'u ix yab'an heb' to wan sk'och Jesús ta'.

Yuj chi', tzijtum heb' ix laj tzepan el xil anh q'uib'. Ix yik'anb'at heb', ix b'at schaan Jesús heb'. Ix awaj chaanh heb' icha tik: Yuj wal Dios. Calec wach' lolonel t'a jun chekb'ilkot yuj Dios Kajal. Calec wach' lolonel t'a ko reyal a onh israel onh tik, xchi heb'.
Axo Jesús ix ilchaj jun nok' yune' b'uru yuj. Ix k'e t'a yib'anh nok' icha yaj stz'ib'chajkan t'a Slolonel Dios icha tik:
Ex aj Sion, manh ex xiwok. Ilecnab' sjawi he reyal. Ayk'e t'a yib'anh jun nok' b'uru, xchi.

Ha juntzanh tik, maj nachajel-laj yuj heb' sk'ayb'um Jesús t'a jun k'u chi'. Ato yik ix ik'jik'e t'a satcha’anh, ato ta' ix snakot heb' to a yab'ixal tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a Slolonel Dios, ix elk'och icha yajkani.
Ha juntzanh heb' ayek' yet' Jesús ayik ix yawtanelta winhaj Lázaro b'aj mukb'il yik ix pitzwixi winh, ix laj yalel heb' tas ix yil heb' chi'.
Yuj chi' ix b'at heb' anima scha Jesús, yujto ix laj yab' yab'ixal jun satub'tak ix sk'ulej chi' heb'.
Ix laj yalan heb' winh fariseo icha tik: --Manhxa tas wach' kutanek tiknaik. Ilecnab' heb' anima, ix laj och heb' masanil yet' winh, xchi heb' winh.
Ay juntzanh heb' griego ix k'och t'a Jerusalén t'a jun q'uinh chi', yik b'at yak'anem sb'a heb' d'ha Dios.
Ix k'och heb' t'a winhaj Felipe aj Betsaida t'a yol yik Galilea. Ix yalan heb' t'a winh: --Mamin, ko gana squil Jesús, xchi heb'.
Ix b'at winhaj Felipe chi' yal t'a winhaj Andrés, junnhej ix b'at heb' winh schawanhil, ix b'at yalan heb' winh t'a Jesús chi'.
Ix yalan t'a heb' winh: --Ha in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, a tiknaik wan sk'och yorail scheklajeli to te niwan welk'ochi.
Val yel swal t'ayex, q'uinalok ay junok inhat trigo skan pitan t'a sat lu'um, skannhej icha chi'. Palta tato smukji, ichato schami, haxo yik sjawi, niwan sat syak'a'.
Ha mach anhej sk'inal ay yelk'och t'a sat, ol satel sk'inal chi'. Axo mach malaj yelk'och sk'inal t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik t'a sat, aton jun chi' ol scha sk'inal t'a junelnhej.

Tato ay heb' snib'ej tz'och in chekab'ok, ochokab' tzak'an heb' wuuj. Ha heb' in chekab' chi', ol aj heb' wed' b'aj ayin eq'ui. Tato ay heb' tz'och in chekab'ok, haxo in Mam ol ch'oxanok to niwan yelk'och heb' t'a sat, xchi Jesús.

Ha tiknaik, te pitz'anoch kusk'olal t'a in pixan. ¿Tas ol wutok walani? ¿Tom ol wal icha tik d'ha Dios: Mamin, kolinelta t'a yol sk'ab' jun yaelal sja t'a wib'anh tik, tom xin chi? Palta yujnhej wal jun tik yak'nak in koti.

Mamin, cheklajokab'eli to niwan elk'ochi, xchi Jesús. Ixlajwi chi', ix lolonemta jun t'a satcha’anh, ix yalan icha tik: --Toxo ix in ch'oxeli to niwan welk'ochi, haxo tiknaik ol in ch'oxel junelxo, xchi.
Axo heb' anima ayek' ta', ayik ix yab'an jun chi' heb', ix yalan heb' to ix k'anh k'u. Ay juntzanhxo heb' ix alani: --Tekan a junok ángel ix lolonemta t'a Jesús tik, xchi heb'.
Yuj chi' ix yal Jesús t'a heb': --Manh wujok ix aljiemta juntzanh tik, palta eyuuj.
Ha tiknaik, ol ch'olb'itaj tas yaj heb' ay t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik. Axo winh tz'ak'an mandar jun yol yib'anhk’inal tik, ol pechjoquel winh.
Ha in tik, ayik ol in ik'jokk'e t'a chaanh, ol wik'kot masanil heb' anima t'ayin, xchi Jesús.
Icha chi' ix yutej yalani chajtil ol aj schami.

Axo ix yalan heb' anima t'ay: --Ha t'a ley aykan t'ayonh, ata' ix kab'i to a Cristo aynhejek' t'a masanil tiempo. Yuj chi', ¿tas yuj tzala' to a jun Ak'b'ilkot yuj Dios yoch animail, yowalil ol ik'jokk'e t'a chaanh? ¿Mach jun Ak'b'ilkot tzal chi'? xchi heb' t'ay.

Yuj chi' ix yal t'a heb': --Ha in swak' sakil k'inal t'ayex, ayinek' t'a he kal tiknaik, palta quenxonhej tiempo ayin eq'ui. Tojolb'itejek he b'a yakb'an ayin to ek' jab'okxo eyed'ok. Tato maay, ol somchajel he pensar. Icha junok mach sb'eyek' t'a k’ik’ k’inal, max uji yilan b'aj sb'ati, icha chi' ol ex ajok.

Ha in tik, aj sakil k'inal in. Yuj chi', aq'ek in och t'a he k'ool yakb'an ayin to ek' eyed'ok, yik ol wak' sakil k'inal t'ayex t'a junelnhej, xchi Jesús t'a heb'. Ixlajwi yalan juntzanh chi', ix sb'esanel sb'a, ix sk'ub'anel sb'ha t'a heb'.
Wach'chom tzijtum tas satub'tak ix sch'ox Jesús yil heb', palta malaj wal heb' ix ak'anoch t'a sk'ool.

Icha chi' ix aj yelk'och tas yalnakkan winhaj Isaías schekab' Dios. Aton jun tz'alan icha tik: Mamin Kajal, ¿tom ay mach tz'ak'anoch t'a sk'ol tas skaleli? ¿Tom ay mach snachajel yuj to a a poder scheklaj t'a jun ab'ix tik? xchi winh t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkan chi'.
Yuj chi' max yal-laj yak'anoch heb' t'a sk'ool. Anheja' winhaj Isaías chi' aljinakxikan icha tik:

Ha Dios tz'ak'an heb' musansatil, swach' ak'an pitb'ok spensar heb', yik wach' max yil heb', max nachajel yuj heb', yik max k'exmaj spensar heb'. Yuj chi' ha Dios max kolan heb', xchi winhaj Isaías chi'.
Yalnac juntzanh tik winhaj Isaías chi', yujto ayokto yilannak stziquiquial Jesús winh, yuj chi' aton yab'ixal yalnakkan winh.

Wach'chom yalnakkan winh icha chi', palta ay heb' israel ix ak'anoch Jesús t'a sk'ool. Tzijtum pax heb' yajal ix ak'anoch t'a sk'ool. Palta max sch'oxel-laj sb'a heb', yujto xiw heb' t'a heb' winh fariseo, talaj spechjielta heb' t'a yol spatil kulto.
Icha chi' ix yutej sb'a heb', yujto anhej t'a yichanh heb' anima snib'ej heb' ay yelk'ochi. Malaj tz'och t'a heb' tato ay yelk'och heb' t'a yichanh Dios.

Ayic manto sb'esel-laj sb'a Jesús t'a skal heb' anima chi', te chaanh ix yal t'a skal heb': --Ab'ek jun swal tik t'ayex: Ha heb' tzin ak'anoch t'a sk'ool, manhok innhej tzin yak'och heb' t'a sk'ool. Ha in Mam chekjinak in kot syak'paxoch heb' t'a sk'ool.
Ha heb' tzin ilani, syil pax jun chekjinak in kot chi' heb'.
Ha in tik, ak'um in sakil k'inal. In jawi t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik yik wach' a heb' tzin ak'anoch t'a sk'ool, manhxo ayoquek' heb' t'a k’ik’ k’inal.

Ha heb' tz'ab'an in lolonel, palta max sk'anab'ajejlaj heb', manhok in laj ol wak'och t'a yib'anh heb', yujto manh yujok wak'anoch t'a eyib'anh, in ja t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, palta yuj wak'an he kolnab'il in jawi.

Ha heb' tzin patikaneli, heb' max chaan pax yab' in lolonel, toxonton ayek' jun ol ak'anoch t'a yib'anh heb' chi', aton in lolonel swalkan tik. Yuj in lolonel tik, ol ak'jokoch t'a yib'anh heb' t'a slajwub' k'ual.
Yujto a in tik, max in lolonlaj t'a yol wiko'. Ha in Mam chekjinak in koti, a alannak tas yowalil swala' yet' tas swutej walani.
Vojtak to yuj scheknab'il chi', syal he chaan he k 'inal t'a junelnhej. Yuj chi', icha yaj yalan in Mam t'ayin, icha chi' swutej walan t'ayex, xchi Jesús.

K'ik'anokxo tz'och sq'uinh heb' israel yik snajikoti tas aj yelnakkot heb' smam yicham heb' t'a Egipto, yojtakxo pax Jesús to toxo sja stiempoal yaktankan jun yol yib'anhk’inal tik, haxo sk'ex chi' t'a ko Mam Dios. Ha heb' yikxo ay t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, ix xajanejnhej heb'. Ix xajanejnhej pax heb' masanto t'a slajwub'.

Axo winhaj Judas yuninal winhaj Simón aj Queriot, toxo ix och winh diablo t'a winh, yik wach' a winh tz'ak'anoch Jesús t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ay. Palta yojtak Jesús to a d'ha Dios kotnak, ata' ol k'ochxok. Yojtak to a ko Mam Dios ak'jinakoch masanil tas t'a yol sk'ab'. Ayic wan swa yet' heb' sk'ayb'um, ix k'e linhan, ix squichanel jun kol spichul, ix stzek'anoch jun k'apak toalla t'a snanhal.
Ixlajwi chi' ix sekanem ha ha' t'a yol jun palangana, ix och ijan sb'ikanel yok heb' sk'ayb'um chi'. Axo yet' k'apak toalla chi' ix suk takjok yok heb' chi'.
Axo ijan ix sb'ikanel yok winhaj Simón Pedro, ix yalan winh t'ay: --Mamin, ¿tom ijan tza b'iquel wok tik a naani? xchi winh.
--Ha tiknaik, maxto nachajel uuj tas wan in k'ulan tik. k'ojank'olalto ol nachajel uuj, xchi Jesús chi' t'a winh.
--Maay, manh wal jab'ok ol wak' wok tik a b'iqueli, xchi winhaj Pedro chi'. --Tato max ak' in b'iquel jun, malaj alan ik wed'ok, xchi Jesús t'a winh.
--Tato icha chi' an Mamin, manhoknhej wok tik tza b'iqueli. B'iquel in k'ab', tza b'akanpaxel in jolom, xchi winhaj Pedro chi'.

Palta ix yalanxi Jesús: --Q'uinalok ay junok mach toto sb'iquel sb'a, manh yowalilok sb'ikchaj sniwanil smasanil. Anhej yok sb'ikchaji, yujto sakto sniwanil. Ha ex tik icha junok mach b'ikb'ilxo, icha chi' eyaji, yujto toxo ix tojolb'i he pensar. Palta manh he masanilok ix tojolb'i he pensar, xchi Jesús.
Yojtakxo mach jun ol ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' chamel, yuj chi' ix yala': Manh he masanilok ix tojolb'i he pensar, xchi.
Ixlajwi sb'ikan yok heb' chi', ix yak'anxioch sk'apak. Ix emxi k'ojan yet' heb'. Ix yalanxi: --¿Tzam nachajel eyuuj tas yuj icha tik tzex wutej?
Ha ex tik, tzin eyal he k'ayb'umok, eyajalok. Yel ton tzeyala'.
k'ayb'um in t'ayex. Yajal waj t'ayex. Palta ina ix in b'iquel eyok tik. Yuj chi' smoj icha chi' tzeyutej he b'a junjun ex.
Ix in ch'ox jun tik t'ayex, yik wach' icha tzex wutej tik, icha chi' ol eyutok he b'a junjun ex.
Val yel swal t'ayex, malaj junok chekab' ek'al t'a yichanh spatrón. Icha pax chi' heb' chekab', malaj junok heb' ek'al t'a yichanh jun schekan chi'.
Tato snachajel juntzanh tik eyuuj, tze k'anab'ajani, te wach' eyiko'.

Manh eyujok he masanil swal jun tik, yujto wojtakxo tas eyaj a ex sik'b'il exxo el wuuj. Palta yowalil ol elk'och tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a Slolonel Dios b'aj syalkan icha tik: Ha winh swa wed'ok, a winh smeltzajoch ajk'olal t'ayin, xchi.
Ayocto swalankan juntzanh tik t'ayex, yik wach' ayik ol ja t'a wib'anh chi', ol eyak'och t'a he k'ool to a in ton Cristo in.
Val yel swal t'ayex, a mach schaan heb' in chekab', syalelk'ochi a in tzin scha heb'. Ha heb' tzin chaan chi', scha pax jun chekjinak in kot heb', xchi Jesús.
Ixlajwi yalan juntzanh chi' Jesús, ix te och ilk'olal, ix yalani: --Val yel swal t'ayex, ha t'a he kal tik ay jun winh ol in ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' chamel, xchi t'a heb' winh.
Axo heb' winh sk'ayb'um chi', ix och k'eljab' heb' winh t'ay junjun, yujto manh yojtakok heb' winh mach jun syal chi'.
Ayic wan swa heb', a winh sk'ayb'um Jesús te xajanab'il yuj, ha t'a stz'ey ayek' winh.
Axo winhaj Simón Pedro ix ak'an yechel t'a winh, yuj chi' tope sk'anb'ej winh t'a Jesús machtaxlaj jun syal chi'.
Yuj chi' ix swach' nitzanoch sb'a winh t'a stz'ey Jesús. Ix sk'anb'an winh t'ay: --Mamin, ¿mach jun tzal chi'? xchi winh.

--Ol in lab'ejem jab' ixim pan tik t'a skal yal winagre, haxo jun winh b'aj ol wak'a', aton jun winh chi', xchi Jesús t'a winh. Ix lajwinhej yalan jun chi', ix slab'anem jab' ixim pan chi' t'a skal winagre chi', ix yak'an t'a winhaj Judas yuninal winhaj Simón aj Queriot.
Ixlajwi schaan jab' ixim pan chi' winh, ix wach' och winh Satanás t'a winh, ix yalan Jesús t'a winh: --Ha tas nab'il uuj, k'ulej t'a elanhchamel, xchi t'a winh.
Axo heb' winh ayoch yet' t'a te' mexa chi', malaj junok heb' winh ix nachajel yuj tas yuj icha chi' ix yal t'a winh.
Ha winhaj Judas chi', sik'um tumin yaj winh, yuj chi' ay heb' ix naani to syal Jesús chi' t'a winh yuj tas sman winh yuj q'uinh chi', mato a jab'ok tumin chi' b'at yak' winh t'a heb' meb'a'.
Axo winhaj Judas chi', ix lajwinhej swaanb'at jun pan chi' winh, ix elta winh t'a skal heb'. Toxo ix k'ik'b'i.
Ixlajwi yelta winhaj Judas chi', ix yalan Jesús: --Ha tiknaik, ol cheklajel sniwanil welk'och a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik. Ol in ch'oxpaxel sniwanil yelk'och Dios.
Tato ol in ch'oxel sniwanil yelk'ochi, haxo ol ch'oxanpaxel sniwanil welk'och t'a elanhchamel.
Ex xajanab'il wuuj, quenxonhej tiempo ayinek' eyed'ok. Ol in he sayeq'ui, palta manto ol yal-laj he k'och b'aj ol in k'och chi', icha wutejnak walankan t'a heb' aj Judea.
Ay junxo ak' cheknab'il ol walkan t'ayex tiknaik, to slaj he xajanej he b'a junjun ex. Icha tzex wutej ex in xajanan tik, icha chi' tzeyutej he xajanan he b'a.
Tato tze xajanej he b'a junjun ex, ol yojtaquejel heb' anima smasanil to yel in k'ayb'um ex, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.

Axo winhaj Simón Pedro ix k'anb'an t'ay: --Mamin, ¿b'ajwaltil ol ach k'och jun? xchi winh. --Ha b'aj ol in k'och chi', manh ol yal-laj a k'och wed' tiknaik. k'ojank'olalto ol ach k'och wed' ta', xchi Jesús t'a winh.
--Palta Mamin, ¿tas yuj max yal in b'at ed' tiknaik jun? In b'eknakxo cham in b'a uuj, xchi winhaj Pedro chi' t'ay.
--A... ¿tom yel tza b'ek a b'a a cham wuuj? Val yel swal t'ayach, ayik manto ok' nok' kaxlanh t'a jun ak'wal tik, oxel ol ik'el t'a ib'anh to manh in ojtakok, xchi Jesús t'a winh.
Ix yalanxi Jesús t'a heb' sk'ayb'um: --Manh eyak' somchaj he k'ool. Tzeyak'och Dios t'a he k'ool, tzin eyak'anpaxoch t'a he k'ool.
Ha b'aj ay in Mam, manh jantakok kajnub' ay. Q'uinalok tato malaj, tas am gana swal t'ayex to tzin b'at in b'o eyed'tal b'aj ol ex k'ochok.
Ol lajwok in b'oan eyed'tal chi' ta', ol in jax junelxo. Axo ul ex wik'an chi' wed'ok, yik wach' a b'aj ayinek' chi', ata' ol ex aj wed'ok.
Ha ex tik eyojtakxo b'aj ol in k'ochok. Eyojtak pax jun b'e b'aj ol in b'atok, xchi t'a heb'.
Axo winhaj Tomás ix alan t'ay: --Palta Mamin, manh kojtakok b'ajtil tzach b'at chi'. Yuj chi', ¿tas ol kutok kojtakanel jun b'e chi'? xchi winh.
Ix yalan Jesús t'a winh: --Ha jun b'e swal tik, a in toni. Ha innhej syal ex wik'anb'at b'aj ay ko Mam Dios. Yelnhej swala'. Ak'um in k 'inal.
Yujto a ex tik eyojtak inxo, yuj chi' ol eyojtaquejpaxel in Mam. Ha tiknaik, eyojtakxo in Mam chi', yujto toxo ix eyila', xchi t'a heb'.
Axo winhaj Felipe ix alan t'ay: --Mamin, ch'ox a Mam chi' quila'. k'okb'ilnhej chi', xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix yalanxi Jesús t'a winh: --Felipe, ina pekatax ayinek' eyed'ok, ¿tom manto in ojtakok? Ha heb' tzin ilani, syalelk'ochi wan yilan in Mam heb'. Yuj chi', ¿tas yuj tzato al t'ayin: Ch'ox a Mam chi' quila', xa chi?
¿Tom max ak'och t'a a k'ool to ayin och t'a in Mam, ay pax och t'ayin? Ha tas swal t'ayex, manh yolok wik swala', palta ha' ayoch t'ayin, a wan smunlaj wed'ok.
Hak'uekoch t'a he k'ool to junnhej waj yet' in Mam chi', junnhej pax yaj wed'ok. Tato max in eyak'och t'a he k'ool yuj tas swal tik, aq'ek in och t'a he k'ool yuj juntzanh satub'tak tzin ch'oxo'.

Val yel swal t'ayex, a mach tzin ak'anoch t'a sk'ool, ol sb'o juntzanh munlajel tzin b'o tik. Ayto juntzanhxo ek'alto ol sb'o t'a yichanh juntzanh tzin b'o tik, yujto ol in paxk'e b'aj ay in Mam chi'.
Yalnhej tas ol he k'an d'ha Dios t'a in b'i, ol ak'jok t'ayex. Icha pax chi' ol wutej a in Yuninal in Dios tik, yik wach' ol cheklajelta to te niwan yelk'och ko Mam Dios.
Yalnhej tas ol he k'an d'ha Dios t'a in b'i, ol ak'jok t'ayex.
Tato tzin he xajanej, k'anab'ajejek in cheknab'il.
Ha in tik, ol in k'an t'a ko Mam, haxo ol ak'ankot junxo ol kolwaj eyed'ok, aton Yespíritu te yel syala'. Ha ol kan eyed' t'a masanil tiempo.

Ha heb' yik yol yib'anhk’inal tik, max yal-laj schaan heb', yujto max yil-laj heb', manh ojtakab'ilok yuj heb'. Ha exxo tik, eyojtakxo Yespíritu chi', yujto aytaxon ek' eyed'ok. Ha ol ochkan kajan t'ayex t'a junelnhej.
Ha in tik, manh ol ex waktejkanlaj he ch'okoj, ol in jax t'ayex junelxo.
Quenxonhej tiempoal, manhxo ol in yil-laj heb' manh wikok t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik. Ha exxo pax tik, ol in eyila'. Yujto pitzan innhej, pitzan ex pax t'a junelnhej.
Ha t'a jun k'ual yik ol ochkan Espíritu t'ayex, ato ta' ol nachajel eyuuj to ayin och t'a in Mam. Axo snachajel chi' eyuuj to ayex och t'ayin, ayin pax och t'ayex.

Ha heb' syak'och spensar t'a in cheknab'il, sk'anab'ajan heb', aton heb' chi' xajan in yuj. Ha heb' tzin xajanani, xajan pax heb' yuj in Mam. Ha in ol in xajanej heb', ol in ch'ox in b'ha t'a heb', xchi Jesús.

Ay junxo sk'ayb'um winh skuch Judas, manhoklaj winh aj Queriot, a winh ix alani: --Mamin, ¿tas yuj axonhej t'ayonh ol a ch'ox a b'a? ¿Tas yuj manhxo ol a ch'ox a b'ha t'a heb' yik yol yib'anhk’inal tik? xchi winh t'a Jesús.
Yuj chi' ix yalxi Jesús chi': --Ha heb' xajan in yuj, sk'anab'ajej pax in lolonel heb'. Yuj chi' haxo in Mam ol xajanan heb'. Ha in yet' in Mam chi' ol onh ochkan kajan t'a heb'.
Axo heb' max in xajanani, max sk'anab'ajej paxlaj heb' tas swala'. Ha juntzanh lolonel swal tik t'ayex, manh wikok, yik in Mam chekjinak in koti.
Swalkan juntzanh tik t'ayex yakb'an ayinto ek' eyed'ok.
Ha ko Mam Dios ol chekankot Yespíritu t'ayex in k'exulok. A' ol kolwaj eyed'ok, ol ex sk'ayb'an t'a masanil tastak. Ol yek he nakot jantaknhej tas walnakxokan t'ayex.
Ha tiknaik, swak'kan in junk'olal t'ayex. Ha in junk'olal swak'kan t'ayex tik, manh lajanok icha junk'olal syak' heb' yik yol yib'anhk’inal tik. Manh eyak' somchajel he k'ool, manh ex xiwok.
Toxo ix wal eyab'i to ol in paxok, palta ol in jax t'ayex. Tato yel tzin he xajanej, tzex tzalaji, yujto ol in pax t'a ko Mam, yujto ek'alto t'a wichanh.
Ayocto swalankan juntzanh tik t'ayex, yik wach' ayik ol ujok jun swal tik, ol in he wach' ak'ejoch t'a he k'ool.
Manhxo niwanok tas swal t'ayex, yujto wanxo sja winh yajal yol yib'anhk’inal tik. Ha winh chi', malaj yalan yik winh t'ayin.
Palta tzin k'anab'ajej cheknab'il ix yak' ko Mam Dios t'ayin, yik wach' ol nachajel yuj heb' yik yol yib'anhk’inal tik to xajan wuuj. Axo tiknaik, k'eanhek waan, koyek, xchi Jesús.
Ix yalanpax Jesús t'a heb' sk'ayb'um: --Ha in tzin sch'ox jun te' nunal uwa wach'. Axo jun tz'ak'enan te', a in Mam sch'oxo'.

Tato ay te' sk'ab' max satani, haxo ol tzepanel te'. Tato ay te' sk'ab' wach' satani, haxo ol ak'enan te' yik tzijtum sat te' syak'a'. Icha syutej yak'enan te' chi', icha chi' ol yutok in Mam heb' syak'och spensar t'ayin.
Ha exxo tik, toxo ix b'o he pensar yuj juntzanh in k'ayb'ub'al ix wal t'ayex.
Ochanhec kajan t'ayin, a inxo ol in ochpax kajan t'ayex. Icha junok te' sk'ab' tz'elta jeknaj t'a snunal maxtzak satanlaj, icha chi' ol ex ajok tato manh ex ayokoch t'ayin.

Ha in tik, icha snunal te' uwa waji. Ha exxo tik, icha te' sk'ab' eyaji. Tato junnhej eyaj wed'ok, junnhej pax waj eyed'ok, icha junok te' sk'ab' tzijtum sat syak'a', icha chi' ol ex ajok. Palta malaj jab'ok tas syal eyuj he ch'okoj.
Q'uinalok ay heb' manh ayokoch t'ayin, lajan ol aj heb' icha junok te' sk'ab' stzepjiel t'a snunal, stakji. Slajwi chi', smolb'aji, snhusjitz'aok.
Tato junnhej eyaj wed'ok, tato tzeyak'nhejoch he pensar t'a in lolonel, k'anek tas tze nib'ej ol ak'jok t'ayex.
Tato niwan tas wach' scheklajel t'a he b'eyb'al, ol aljok in Mam wach'il eyuuj. Ichaton chi' ol eyutok he ch'oxaneli to in k'ayb'um ex.
Icha ix yutej in Mam in xajanani, icha pax chi' tzex wutej ex in xajanani. Yuj chi' tzin he k'anab'ajejnhej, yik wach' ol eyab'i to xajanexnhej wuuj.

Tato tze k'anab'ajej juntzanh in cheknab'il, ol eyab'i to xajanexnhej wuuj, yujto icha chi' waj yet' in Mam. Ha in tik tzin k'anab'ajej juntzanh scheknab'il in Mam chi', yuj chi' swab'i to xajan innhej yuj.
Swalkan juntzanh tik t'ayex yik wach' icha tzin tzalaji, icha pax chi' ol ex tzalajok, yuj chi' tz'akan ol aj he tzalajk'olal.
Ha tiknaik ay jun in cheknab'il ol walkan t'ayex to tze xajanej he b'a junjun ex icha swutej ex in xajanani.
Tato ay junok mach syak'cham sb'a yuj heb' yamigo, syalelk'ochi to tzek' wal t'a yib'anh xajanan heb' yamigo chi'.
Ha ex tik, tato tze k'anab'ajej juntzanh in cheknab'il tik, wal yel wamigo ex toni.

Ha tiknaik swal t'ayex, manh tonhejok in chekab' eyaji, yujto a junok chekab', manh yojtakok tas sna spatrón. Palta a tiknaik wamigo ex, yujto a jantaknhej tas yalnakkan in Mam t'ayin, ix walxikan t'ayex.

Manhoquexlaj ix in he sayeq'ui, palta a in ix ex in sik'elta, yik wach' tze k'ulej tas tzin nib'ej. Ha tas tze k'ulej chi', ol kannhej t'a junelnhej. Yuj chi' a jantaknhej tas tze k'an t'a ko Mam Dios t'a in b'i, ol yak'nhej t'ayex.
Aton jun in cheknab'il tik swalkan t'ayex, to slaj he xajanej he b'a junjun ex.
Tato ay heb' yik yol yib'anhk’inal tik tz'och ajk'olal t'ayex, naekkoti to a t'ayin sb'ab'lajoch heb' ajk'olal.

Q'uinalok yik ex yol yib'anhk’inal tik yet' heb', tekan xajanex yuj heb'. Palta manhxo ex yikok yol yib'anhk’inal tik, yujto toxo ex in sik'kanelta t'a skal heb'. Yuj chi' tz'och heb' ajk'olal t'ayex, yujto manhxo eyetb'eyumok he b'a yet' heb'.

Tze na wal kot jun lolonel ix wal tik t'ayex: Malaj junok chekab' ek'al yelk'och t'a yichanh spatrón, xin chi t'ayex. Icha yutejnak heb' yak'anoch in yaelal, icha pax chi' ol yutok heb' yak'anoch eyaelal. Tato ix sk'anab'ajej in k'ayb'ub'al heb', ol sk'anab'ajej pax eyik heb'.
Ol laj yak'och yaelal heb' t'a eyib'anh wuuj, yujto manh yojtakoklaj heb' mach chekjinak in koti.
Q'uinalok max ul wal t'a heb', malaj am smul heb'. Palta a tiknaik, manhxa b'aj wach' skolan sb'a heb' yuj smul.
Ha heb' tz'och ajk'olal t'ayin, tz'ochpax heb' ajk'olal t'a in Mam.

Ha juntzanh satub'tak ix laj in ch'ox t'a skal heb', malaj junokxo mach syal yuj icha chi'. Q'uinalok malaj juntzanh satub'tak chi' ix in ch'oxo', malaj am smul heb'. Axo tiknaik, wach'chom ix yil juntzanh chi' heb', palta anheja' ayoch heb' ajk'olal t'ayin, ajk'ool pax heb' t'a in Mam.

Palta icha tik ix aj yelk'och juntzanh tik, yik tz'elk'och tas tz'ib'yajkan t'a ley b'aj niwanok syak'och spensar heb'. Aton jun tz'alan icha tik: Nab'anhej skomon och heb' ajk'olal t'ayin, xchi t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani.
Palta ay junxo Colwajum ol kot t'a ko Mam Dios, aton Yespíritu yel syala'. Ol b'at in chekkoti. A' ol yak' testigoal sb'a wuuj.
Anhejtona', ich ex ta', ol eyak' testigoal he b'a, yujto junnhej ek'nak ex wed'ok yiktax ix el yich in munlajel tik.
Swalkan juntzanh tik t'ayex, yik manh ol ex somchajelok.
Yujto ol laj ex pechjielta yuj heb' quetisraelal t'a yol spatil kulto. Ay jun pekti’ ol jawok, yalxonhej mach ol ex milanok, a snaan heb' to pawor syak' heb' d'ha Dios.
Icha chi' ol yutok sb'a heb', yujto manh yojtakok in Mam heb', manh in yojtakok pax heb'.
Swalkan juntzanh tik t'ayex, yik wach' ayik ol ja jun pekti’ chi', ol he nakoti to walnakxokan t'ayex. Maj wal-laj juntzanh tik t'ayex t'a yik yalanh, yujto ayinto ek' eyed' ta'.
Axo tiknaik, ol in pax t'a jun chekjinak in koti. Palta malaj junok ex tze k'anb'ej t'ayin b'ajtil ol in k'ochok.
Tonhej tzex te och ilk'olal yuj juntzanh swalkan tik t'ayex.
Val yel swal t'ayex, te wach' eyiko' yujto ol in paxok. Tato manh ol in paxok, manh ol jawoklaj jun d'inhan skolwaj chi' eyed'ok. Palta ayik ol in paxok, ol in chekankot t'ayex.

Axo ol jawok, ha' ol ak'an yojtaquejel heb' yik yol yib'anhk’inal tik to ay smul heb'. Anheja' ol ak'an yojtaquejel heb' to wach'nhej ix wutej in b'a. Ol yak'an yojtaquejel heb' to ol ch'olb'itaj tas yaj heb' yuj Dios.
Ol sch'oxan t'a heb' to ay smul heb', yujto max in yak'och heb' t'a sk'ool.
A' ol ak'an yojtaquejel heb' to wach'nhej ix wutej in b'a, yujto ol in pax b'aj ay ko Mam Dios, b'aj manhxo ol yal-laj in eyilani.
Ol sch'oxan t'a heb' to ol ch'olb'itaj yaj heb' yuj Dios, yujto toxo ix ch'olb'itaj yaj winh yajal yol yib'anhk’inal tik.
Tzijtumto tas in gana swal t'ayex, palta maxto techaj eyab'an tiknaik.

Ato wal ol ja Espíritu yel syala', ato ta' ol ak'jok nachajel eyuuj masanil tas yel. Manh ol lolonlaj t'a yol yiko', a jantaknhej tas ol aljok t'ay, anhej ol yala'. Ol laj yalan juntzanh tastak toto ol ujok.
Yuj ol cheklajelok to niwan welk'ochi. Jantacnhej tas ol wal t'ay, ha' ol alan pax t'ayex.
Jantacnhej tas ay t'a ko Mam Dios, wiknhej yaji. Yuj chi' ix wala' to a tas ol wal t'a Espíritu chi', ha' ol yal t'ayex.
Junxonhej rato ol in eyila', slajwi chi', manhxo ol in eyil-laj. Ol ek' junokxo rato, ol in eyilanxi, yujto ol in paxk'e b'aj ay in Mam, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.

Ixlajwi yalan jun chi', ay jaywanh heb' sk'ayb'um ix laj alani: --¿Tas syalelk'och jun syal tik t'ayonh? To ix yala': Junxonhej rato ol in eyila', slajwi chi', manhxo ol in eyil-laj. Ol ek' junokxo rato, ol in eyilanxi, xchi. Ix yalanpaxi: Yujto ol in paxk'e b'aj ay in Mam, xchi t'ayonh.
Ha jun “junxonhej rato” syal tik, ¿tastaxlaj syalelk'ochi? Manh jab'ok snachajel kuuj tas syala', xchi heb'.

Axo Jesús, yojtakxo to snib'ej heb' sk'anb'ej t'ay tas syalelk'och jun ix yal chi', yuj chi' ix yalanxi t'a heb': --Toxo ix wal t'ayex: Junxonhej rato ol in eyila', slajwi chi', manhxo ol in eyil-laj. Palta ol ek' junokxo rato, ol in eyilanxi, xin chi t'ayex. ¿Tom yuj juntzanh swal tik tze k'anb'an eyab' t'ayex junjun ex?
Val yel swal t'ayex, ol ex kusok, ol ex ok'ok. Axo heb' yik yol yib'anhk’inal tik, ol laj k'e chanh heb'. Ha ex tik, ol ex kusok, palta ol meltzajxok och he kusk'olal chi' t'a tzalajk'olal.

Q'uinalok ay junok ix ix wan yalji yune', skus ix, yujto ayoch ix t'a syaelal, palta ayik toxo ix aj yune' ix chi', maxtzak snakotlaj syaelal ix chi', toxonhej ste tzalaj ix, yujto ix aj jun unin chi' t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik.
Icha jun ix chi', icha chi' ol ex ajok. Ol ex kus ton tiknaik, palta ato yik ol in eyilanxi ol ex tzalajok. Axo jun he tzalajk'olal chi', malaj junok mach ol yal yik'anek' t'ayex.
Ha t'a jun k'ual chi' manhxa tas ol he k'anb'ej t'ayin. Val yel swal t'ayex, masanil tas ol he k'an t'a ko Mam Dios t'a in b'i, ol yak' t'ayex.
Ha tiknaik, mantalaj tas tze k'an d'ha Dios t'a in b'i. k'anek, ol he chaa, ol ak'jok t'ayex yik ol tz'akwok he tzalajk'olal.
Q'uexanh ix wutej walan juntzanh lolonel tik t'ayex. Palta ay jun pekti’ ol jawok, manhxo ichok ta' ol aj walan t'ayex, yujto tojolxonhej ol wutok walan yab'ixal in Mam t'ayex.
Ayic ol ja jun k'ual chi', ato ta' ol he k'an tas tze nib'ej t'a in b'i. Max wal-laj t'ayex tato a in ol in k'an tas t'a in Mam eyuuj.
Xajan ex yuj in Mam chi', yujto xajan in eyuuj, ix eyak'och t'a he k'ool to a t'ay kotnak in.
Yel toni a t'ay kotnak in, in jawi t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik. Ha tiknaik, ol waktejkani, haxo in paxk'e t'a in Mam chi', xchi t'a heb'.
Axo heb' sk'ayb'um chi' ix alan t'ay: --Ha tiknaik te tojolxo tzutej alan t'ayonh. Manhxo k'exanhok tzutej alan icha t'a junel.
Ha tiknaik, snachajel kuuj to ojtaknhej masanil tasi. Manh yowalilok tzato ko k'anb'ej t'ayach ayik tzalan t'ayonh. Yuj chi' skak'och t'a ko k'ool to a d'ha Dios kotnak ach, xchi heb' t'ay.
Yuj chi' ix yalxi t'a heb': --¿Tzam in eyak'och t'a he k'ool tiknaik?
Palta wanxo sja stiempoal ol ex saklemkanb'atok. Ol laj ex b'at elelal junjun ex. Ol in eyaktejkan in ch'okoj, palta manh in ch'okojok ol in kanok, ayek' in Mam wed'ok.

Ix wal masanil juntzanh tik t'ayex, yik wach' junk'olalxo ol ex aj wuuj. Ha t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, ol eyab' ton syail. Palta tek'an tzeyutej he b'a, yujto a heb' yik yol yib'anhk’inal tik, toxo ix kan heb' t'a yalanh wuuj, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi yalan juntzanh chi' Jesús, ix k'e k'elan t'a satcha’anh, ix yalani: --Mamin, toxo ix ja stiempoal a ch'oxaneli to niwan welk'och a in Uninal in tik, yik ol in ch'oxpaxel sniwanil elk'ochi.
Yujto a ach ak'nak wopisio t'a yib'anh masanil heb' anima yik wach' swak' sk'inal jantaknhej heb' ix ak' t'ayin.
Ha jun k 'inal t'a junelnhej tik, syalelk'ochi to tzach yojtaquejel heb' anima to a achnhejton Dios ach t'a wal yel yet' pax in yojtakanel heb' a in Jesucristo chekb'il in kot uuj tik.
Ayic ayinek' t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, ix in ch'oxo' to te niwan elk'ochi. Ha jun munlajel ak'b'ilkan tik t'ayin uuj, toxo ix yik' sb'a.
Ayic manto b'o jun yol yib'anhk’inal tik, ayinek' ed' b'aj ay ko wach'il. Axo tiknaik Mamin, cha in paxk'e ed' b'aj ay ko wach'il chi' ichataxon waj ed'ok.
Ha heb' ix a sik'elta t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, ix ak' heb' t'ayin, ix in ch'ox t'a heb' tas nab'il uuj. Ha heb' ix ak' t'ayin, toxonton ik heb'. Ix laj sk'anab'ajej a lolonel heb'.
Ha tiknaik, a jantaknhej tas ak'nak t'ayin, yojtak heb' to a t'ayach kotnak.
Ha a lolonel ak'nak t'ayin, ix laj wal t'a heb'. Ix schaan yab' heb', yuj chi' yojtak heb' to yel t'ayach kotnak in. Syak'och heb' t'a sk'ool to a ach a cheknak in koti.
Tzin lesalwi yuj heb' ix ak' t'ayin, yujto ikxo heb'. Axo heb' yik yol yib'anhk’inal tik, max in lesalwilaj yuj heb'.
Jantacnhej heb' wiko', ikxo pax yaj heb'. Anhejtona' heb' iko', wikxo pax heb' ed'ok. Aton heb' tik sch'oxaneli to te niwan welk'ochi.

Jab'xonhej tiempo ayinek' t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, haxo in paxk'e chi' ed'ok. Axo pax heb' tik jun, ol to kan heb' t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik. Mamin, te tojol achnhej. Ha heb' ix ak' t'ayin, tza tanhwej heb' yet' a poder, aton jun ix ak' t'ayin, yik junxonhej tz'aj heb' icha waj ed'ok.

Ayic ayinek' yet' heb' t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, ix in tanhwej heb' yet' a poder chi'. Ha heb' ix ak' t'ayin, ix in tanhwej heb' yik malaj tz'ik'an heb', malaj junok heb' ix sateli, anhej jun d'inhantaxon sateli yik tz'elk'och tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a a lolonel.
Ha tiknaik jun, ol in paxixk'e t'ayach. Yakb'an ayinto ek' jab'okxo t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, swalankan juntzanh tik yik wach' ol tzalaj heb' icha in tzalaj tik.

Toxo ix laj walkanel a lolonel t'a heb'. Palta a heb' yik yol yib'anhk’inal tik tz'och heb' ajk'olal t'a heb', yujto manhxo yikok yol yib'anhk’inal heb' yet' heb'. Icha in tik, manh in yikok yol yib'anhk’inal tik.
Mantoc swala' to elanhchamel tzik'el heb' t'a tik. Palta tzin k'an t'ayach to tza tanhwej heb', yik malaj heb' tz'ixtaxel yuj winh chuk chi'.
Ha in tik, manh in yikok yol yib'anhk’inal tik. Anhejtona' icha chi' heb', manh yikok yol yib'anhk’inal tik heb'.
Ha ach tza tojolb'itej spensar heb' yet' a lolonel te yel.
Icha ix utej in a chekankot t'a skal heb' anima tik, icha chi' swutej in chekanpaxb'at heb' t'a skal heb' anima chi'.
Yuj swach'ilok heb' yuj chi' swak' in b'a t'ayach, yik wach' tz'och heb' ikok t'a wal yel.
Manh yujoknhej heb' tzin lesalwi. Tzin lesalwi pax yuj heb' toto ol in ak'anoch t'a sk'ool yuj tastak ol yal heb' in chekab' tik.

Tzin k'an t'ayach yik junxonhej ol aj spensar heb' smasanil. Mamin, junnhej waj ed'ok, junnhej pax aj wed'ok. Ichoc wal kaji, ichokab' ta tz'aj pax heb', junnhejokab' tz'aj heb' qued'ok. Tato icha chi', haxo heb' anima t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik, ol yak'och heb' t'a sk'ool to a ach a cheknak in koti.
Ha sniwanil welk'och ix ak'a', a ix wak'pax t'a heb', yik junxonhej tz'aj spensar heb' icha waj ed'ok.

Ha in ayin och t'a heb', a achxo ayach och t'ayin, yik wach' junxonhej ol aj spensar heb'. Yuj chi' ol nachajel yuj heb' yik yol yib'anhk’inal tik to a ach a cheknak in koti. Ol nachajel yuj heb' to icha tzutej in a xajanani, icha pax chi' tzutej a xajanan heb' quikxo.
Mamin, a heb' tzak' t'ayin, in gana ol aj heb' wed' b'aj ol in k'ochok, yik ol yil in wach'il heb' ak'b'il t'ayin uuj, yujto xajanintaxon uuj atax yik mantzak b'o jun yol yib'anhk’inal tik.
Mamin, tojol a pensar, a heb' yik yol yib'anhk’inal tik, manh ach yojtakok heb'. Xal in tik, wojtak ach. Axo heb' tik, yojtakxo heb' to a ach a cheknak in koti.

Ha in ix wak' yojtaquejel heb' tas aji. Anhejtona' ol in wach' ak'ej yojtaquejxiel heb', yik wach' icha tzutej in a xajanani, icha pax chi' tzutej a xajanan heb'. Ha inxo ol in och kajan t'a heb' t'a junelnhej, xchi Jesús t'a ko Mam Dios.
Ixlajwi yalan juntzanh chi' Jesús, ix b'at yet' heb' sk'ayb'um. Ix k'axpajek' heb' t'a sch'olanil ha' Cedrón b'aj ay juntzanh te' awb'en te'. Ix k'och heb' t'a skal te'.
Axo winhaj Judas, winh ol ak'anoch Jesús t'a yol sk'ab' chamel, yojtak pax jun lugar chi' winh, yujto tzijtum el ix smolb'ej sb'a Jesús chi' yet' heb' sk'ayb'um ta'.

Yuj chi' ix k'och winh ta', ajun jun umanh heb' soldado yet' winh yet' pax heb' stanhwumal stemplo Dios ix chekjikot yuj heb' winh sat sakerdote yet' heb' winh fariseo. Tz'ikb'il sk'ak' heb', ma skandil heb' yuj. Yed'nak pax syamk'ab' heb' yik owal ix k'och heb'.
Axo Jesús yojtakxo jantak tas ol jawok t'a yib'anh. Yuj chi' ix sch'oxan sb'a, ix sk'anb'an t'a heb' winh ix k'och chi': --¿Mach tzek' he saya'? xchi t'a heb' winh.
--Ha Jesús aj Nazaret, a sko sayeq'ui, xchi heb' winh t'ay. --Ha in ton tik, xchi t'a heb' winh. Ha winhaj Judas, winh wan yak'anoch Jesús t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ool chi', ajun winh yet' heb' winh.
Ix lajwinhej yalan Jesús t'a heb' winh, ix b'at pak'aljok heb' winh t'a spatik, ix laj telwi heb' winh t'a sat lu'um.
Ix sk'anb'anxi Jesús t'a heb' winh: --¿Mach tzek' he saya'? xchi. --Ha Jesús aj Nazaret, a tzek' ko saya', xchixi heb' winh.
--Palta toxo ix wal t'ayex to a in ton tik. Tato a in tzin he saya', haxo heb' winh wed'nak tik, aktejek el heb' winh, xchi t'a heb' winh.
Icha chi' ix aj yelk'och tas ix yal Jesús yuj heb' sk'ayb'um, ayik ix yalan icha tik: Ha heb' ix ak' t'ayin malaj junok heb' ix sat wuuj, xchi d'ha Dios.
Axo winhaj Simón Pedro, ix yik'ank'eta k'een yespada winh t'a yol yatut, ix b'at juknaj winh t'a jun winh skuch Malco, schekab' winh sat sakerdote. Ix slesanel schiquin winh winh t'a swach'.
Axo ix yalan Jesús t'a winhaj Pedro chi': --Hak'uem k'een espada chi' t'a yol yatut. ¿Tom manh ol wak' in b'ha t'a jun yaelal syak'kot in Mam t'a wib'anh tik a naani? xchi t'a winh.
Ix syaman Jesús chi' heb' winh soldado yet' winh syajalil heb' yet' heb' winh aj Judea stanhwumal templo.
Ichato chi' ix ik'jib'at t'a spat winhaj Anás, snhi' winhaj Caifás. Ha winhaj Caifás chi' sat sakerdote yaj t'a jun ab'il chi'.
Aton winh alannak t'a heb' aj Judea chi' to yowalil scham junok mach sk'exulok heb' anima smasanil.

Ayic ix ik'jib'at Jesús, tzak'anoch winhaj Simón Pedro yuj yet' junxo winh sk'ayb'um Jesús chi'. Ha junxo winh sk'ayb'um chi', ojtakab'il winh yuj winhaj Anás chi'. Ix ochk'och winh yet' Jesús t'a yamaq'uil spat winhaj Anás chi'.
Axo winhaj Pedro chi', ix kan winh t'a ti' pat chi'. Yuj chi' ix elixta junxo winh sk'ayb'um Jesús chi', ix yalan winh t'a ix stanhwumal ti' pat chi' to tz'och winhaj Pedro chi' yet' heb'.
Axo ix stanhwumal ti' pat chi' ix alan t'a winhaj Pedro chi': --Ha ach tik, tekan sk'ayb'um ach jun winh ix yamchaj tik, xchi ix t'a winh. --Maay, manh in sk'ayb'umoklaj winh, xchi winh t'a ix.

Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi' te ay siik, yuj chi' haxo heb' winh ayoch chekab'ok yet' heb' winh stanhwumal templo, ix yak'och sk'ak' heb' winh t'a te' ak'al. Linhjab'och heb' winh k'axnel. Axo winhaj Pedro chi', ix k'och winh yet' heb' winh t'a sti' te' k'ak' chi', ix k'axni winh yet' heb' winh.
Axo winh sat sakerdote ix k'anb'an t'a Jesús: --¿Mach heb' a k'ayb'um? ¿Tas juntzanh a k'ayb'ub'al b'aj tza k'ayb'ej heb'? xchi winh t'ay.

Ix yalan Jesús chi' t'a winh: --Ha juntzanh in k'ayb'ub'al chi', ix walel t'a skal heb' anima smasanil. Masanil tiempo ix walel t'a yoltak spatil kulto yet' t'a yamaq'uil stemplo Dios yet' b'aj smolb'ej sb'a heb' anima. Malaj junok tas k'ub'eltak ix wala'.
¿Tas yuj a t'ayin tza k'anb'ej? k'anb'ej t'a heb' ix ab'an walani. Yalokab' heb' t'ayach tas juntzanh in k'ayb'ub'al chi'. Ina yojtakxo heb' tas ix wala', xchi t'a winh.
Ix lajwinhej yalan juntzanh chi', haxo jun winh stanhwumal templo ayek' ta' ix tz'itanb'at sat. Ix yalan winh t'ay: --Tas yuj icha chi' tz'aj a pakan sti' winh sat sakerdote tik, xchi winh t'a Jesús.
--Tato chuk ix wala', al t'ayin tas chukal ix wal chi'. Palta tato a tas wach' ix wala', ¿tas yuj tzin a komon mak'ej? xchi Jesús chi' t'a winh.
Ixlajwi chi', haxo winhaj Anás chi' ix chekan ik'jokb'at Jesús t'a winhaj Caifás, winh sat sakerdote. Anheja' tzek'b'il yuj heb' winh ix b'ati.

Axo winhaj Pedro anheja' wan sk'axni winh yet' heb' winh stanhwumal templo chi'. Yuj chi' ix yalan heb' winh t'a winh: --Ha ach tik, tekan sk'ayb'um ach Jesús, xchi heb' winh. Ix yik'anxiel winh t'a yib'anh, ix yalan winh: --Maay, manh in sk'ayb'umoklaj, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ay jun schekab' winh sat sakerdote, sk'ab' yok sb'a yet' winh ix el schiquin yuj winhaj Pedro chi' ix alan t'a winh: --¿Tom manhok ach ix wil ek' yet' Jesús b'aj ay te' awb'en te' jun? xchi t'a winh.
Ix yik'anxiel winhaj Pedro chi' t'a yib'anh junelxo. Ha wal slajwi yik'anxiel winh chi' t'a yib'anh, ix ok' nok' kaxlanh.

Axo yik wan sakb'i, ix ik'jiel Jesús t'a yol spat winhaj Caifás chi' yuj heb' yajal t'a skal heb' israel, ix ik'jib'at t'a sdespacho winhaj Pilato, winh yajal. Ha sley heb' aj Judea chi', max yal yoch heb' t'a yol sdespacho winh chi'. Ha snaan heb', talaj tz'och smul heb' t'a yichanh Dios, talaj manh smojok swaan jun wael heb' yik q'uinh wan sjawi, yik snaankot heb' tas aj yelnakkot heb' smam yicham heb' t'a Egipto.
Yuj chi' ix elta winhaj Pilato chi' t'a sti' sdespacho. Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb': --¿Tas smul jun winh tzul eyak' tik t'ayin? xchi winh.
--Tato manh chukok winh, ¿tom ol ul kak' winh t'a yol a k'ab'? xchi heb' winh.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj Pilato chi': --Ik'ekb'at winh a ex tik, tzeyak'anoch t'a yib'anh winh icha syal he ley, xchi winh. --Palta a onh israel onh tik, max yal-laj ko komon ak'anoch chamel t'a yib'anh junok anima, xchi heb' winh.
Icha chi' ix aj yelk'och tas ix yal Jesús chajtil ol aj schami.
Axo winhaj Pilato chi', ix ochxikan winh t'a yol sdespacho. Ix yak'an awtajkot Jesús winh, ix sk'anb'an winh t'ay: --¿Tom a ach tik sreyal ach heb' israel? xchi winh.
--¿Tom a ach tza nael jun chi', mato ch'ok mach ix alan t'ayach wuuj? xchi Jesús chi' t'a winh.
--¿Tom israel in tzila'? Ha heb' etchonhab' yet' heb' sat sakerdote, a heb' ix ul ach ak'anoch t'a yol in k'ab'. Palta ¿tas ix a mulej? xchi winh t'ay.

--Ha in tik, manhok t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik rey in. Q'uinalok tato icha chi', a heb' tzin ak'an serwil, tzam yak' yowalil heb', yik max in ak'jioch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' aj Judea. Palta manhok t'a tik rey in, xchi Jesús chi' t'a winh.

--¿Tom yel wal jun to rey ach? xchi winhaj Pilato chi' t'ay. --Yel toni, rey in, ichaton tzal chi'. Ha in tik, in jawi t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik yik tzul walel jun tas te yel. Yuj wal chi' in alji. Jantacnhej heb' yiktaxon jun yel tik, syak'och schiquin heb' t'a tas swala', xchi Jesús chi'.

Axo ix yalan winhaj Pilato chi' t'ay: --¿Tas jun yel tzal chi'? xchi winh t'ay. Ixlajwi yalan jun chi' winhaj Pilato chi', ix elixta winh t'a sti' b'aj aykan heb' aj Judea chi'. Ix yalanelta winh t'a skal heb': --Ha jun winh tik, malaj jab'ok smul winh swila'.
Palta ay jun he ley t'a junjun q'uinh tik to tze k'anelta junok mach t'a preso. Yuj chi', ¿mama he gana swak'el jun winh he reyal a ex israel ex tik t'a libre tiknaik? xchi winh t'a heb'.

Yuj chi' ix awaj chaanh heb' smasanil, ix yalan heb': --Ha jun winh tik, malaj ko gana t'a winh. Ha winhaj Barrabás tzak'el t'a libre, xchi heb' t'a winh. Palta a winhaj Barrabás chi', milumcham anima winh.
Axo winhaj Pilato ix chekan ik'jokb'at Jesús yik' b'at mak'jok.
Ixlajwi chi', ix sjalan setan jun q'uiix heb' winh soldado, ix yak'ank'e heb' winh skoronaok Jesús chi'. Ix yak'anoch jun k'apak heb' winh t'ay, k'ik' mutz'inak icha yik heb' rey.
Ix laj k'och heb' winh t'a stz'ey, ix stz'akan yal heb' winh t'ay: --Tzalajanh ach sreyal heb' israel, xchi heb' winh t'ay. Ix tz'itjib'at sat yuj heb' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix elta winhaj Pilato t'a sti' b'aj aykan heb' aj Judea chi'. Ix yalanelta winh t'a skal heb': --Ileknab'i, tik tzin ch'oxelta winh t'ayex, yik wach' tzeyojtaquejeli to malaj jab'ok smul winh ix ilchaj wuuj, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Ichato chi' ix elta Jesús t'a sti'. Anheja' ayk'e jun q'uiix chi' t'a sjolom, anheja' aypaxoch jun k'ik' mutz'inak k'apak chi' yuj. Ix yalanxielta winhaj Pilato chi' t'a heb': --Ina winh tik, xchi winh.

Ayic ix yilan heb' winh sat sakerdote yet' heb' winh stanhwumal templo yelk'och Jesús t'a sti' chi', ix k'e umnaj heb' winh yalani: --Kulusejk'e winh. Kulusejk'e winh, xchi heb' winh. Ix yalanpax winhaj Pilato chi' t'a heb': --Ik'ekb'at winh a ex tik, tze kulusank'e winh he ch'okoj. Xal in tik, malaj jab'ok smul winh tz'ilchaj wuuj, xchi winh.
Ix yalanpax heb' aj Judea chi' t'a winh: --Palta ay jun ley aykan t'ayonh. Yuj jun ley chi' yowalil ol miljokcham jun winh tik, yujto ix yaloch sb'a winh Yuninaloc Dios, xchi heb'.
Axo ix yab'an jun chi' winhaj Pilato chi', ix te xiwb'at winh.
Yuj chi' ix ochxik'och winh t'a yol sdespacho, ix sk'anb'an winh t'a Jesús: --¿B'ajtil kotnak ach jun? xchi winh t'ay. Palta maj tak'woklaj Jesús chi' t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalanxi winh t'ay: --¿Tas yuj max ach tak'wi t'ayin? ¿Tom manh ojtakok to ay wopisio ach wak'anel t'a libre, ay pax wopisio ach in kulusank'ei? xchi winh t'ay.

Ix yalan Jesús t'a winh: --Palta aton Dios ak'jinak opisio chi'. Tato maay, malaj alan jab'ok ik t'ayin. Yuj chi' a winh ix in ak'anoch t'a yol a k'ab', te ek'alto smul winh t'a ichanh, xchi t'a winh.

Ixlajwi yab'an juntzanh chi' winh, ix snaan winh tas syutej yak'anel Jesús chi' t'a libre. Axo heb' aj Judea chi', ix k'e umnaj heb' yalani: --Tato tzak'el winh t'a libre, ajk'ool ach t'a winh yajal t'a Roma syal chi'. Ha winh tik ix yaloch sb'a winh reyal. Palta a mach tz'alan icha chi', ajk'ool t'a winh yajal t'a Roma chi', xchi heb' t'a winh.

Ixlajwi yab'an jun chi' winh, ix yalan winh to tz'ik'jikot Jesús chi' b'aj ayek' winh chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix em k'ojan winh t'a sk'ojnub' b'aj sb'o yaj owal. Ha jun lugar chi', Gabata sb'i t'a hebreo. Syalelk'ochi, b'aj latz'b'ilem k'een k'een.

Ayic ix em k'ojan winh chi', wanxo yoch chimk'ualil. K'ik'anokxo sq'uinh heb' israel yik snaankot heb' tas aj yelnakkot heb' smam yicham heb' t'a Egipto. Axo ix yalanpaxelta winh t'a skal heb' aj Judea chi': --Ina winh he reyal tik, xchielta winh t'a heb'.

Palta ix laj awaj chaanh heb' junelxo: --Chamokab' winh. Chamokab' winh. Kulusejk'e winh, xchi heb'. --¿Tom swak' kulusejk'e winh he reyal tik? xchi winh t'a heb'. Axo heb' winh sat sakerdote ix tak'wi: --Ha onh tik, anhej winh yajal t'a Roma ko reyal. Malaj junokxo, xchi heb' winh.
Ichato chi' ix ak'jioch Jesús t'a yol sk'ab' heb' yik skulusajk'ei. Yuj chi' ix yik'b'at Jesús chi' heb'.
Axo Jesús ix kuchan skulusal, ix ik'jib'at t'a jun lugar skuchan Gólgota t'a hebreo. Syalelk'ochi: B'aj Ay Sb'aquil Jolom.
Ata' ix kulusajk'e Jesús yuj heb'. Ay chawanhxo heb' winh ix kulusajk'e yet'ok, jun winh t'a swach', junxo winh t'a sk'exanh, haxo t'a snanhal skulusal heb' winh chi' ix kulusajk'e Jesús chi'.

Axo winhaj Pilato chi' ix ak'an tz'ib'chajoch juntzanh lolonel t'a jun yune' chem te'. Ix yak'an ak'jokoch winh t'a sjolom skulusal Jesús chi'. Icha tik syal jun chi': Ha Jesús aj Nazaret, Sreyal heb' israel, xchi.

Ha jun lugar b'aj ix kulusajk'e Jesús chi', ha t'a ti' chonhab' ay. Yuj chi' tzijtum heb' israel ix ilan juntzanh lolonel chi'. Ha t'a hebreo, t'a griego yet' pax t'a latín, aton sti' heb' aj Roma, ata' ix tz'ib'chajochi.

Yuj chi' ix yal heb' winh sat sakerdote t'a winhaj Pilato chi': --Octom manhok Sreyal heb' israel ix ak' tz'ib'chajochok. Octom tzak' tz'ib'chaj icha tik: Ha winh tik, ix yaloch sb'a winh Sreyaloc heb' israel, xchi heb' winh t'a winh.
--Ha tas ix wak' tz'ib'chajok, skannhej icha chi', xchi winhaj Pilato chi' t'a heb' winh.

Axo heb' winh soldado, ayik manto skulusejk'e Jesús heb' winh, ix quichjiel spichul yuj heb' winh. Ix spukanek' heb' winh t'a spatik. Chanh poj ix aji. Junjun yik junjun heb' winh. Palta haxo jun kolxo spichul, jalb'ilkot t'a sjolom masanto t'a yoktak, malaj stz'isul.

Yuj chi' ix yal heb' winh icha tik: --Tekan a jun tik manh ol ko nhik'chitejb'ati. Wach' ama to skaq'ek ko suerte t'a yib'anh, yalnhej mach onh ol quik'a', xchi heb' winh. Icha chi' ix aj yelk'och tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a Slolonel Dios, ayik yalannakkani: Ol spuquek' in pichul heb' t'a spatik, ol yak'an suerte heb' t'a yib'anh junxo, xchi. Yuj chi' icha chi' ix yutej heb' winh soldado chi'.
Linhanoch ix snun Jesús t'a stz'ey te' kulus chi', ajun ix snulej ix yet'ok yet' ix María ix yetb'eyum winhaj Cleofas yet' ix María aj Magdala.

Ay pax ek' jun winh sk'ayb'um Jesús t'a stz'ey ix snun chi', aton jun winh te xajan yuj. Ayic ix iljikot heb' yuj Jesús, ix yalan t'a ix snun chi': --Nunin, a jun ayek' ed' tik, icha une' tzutej, xchi t'a ix.

Ix lajwinhej chi', ix yalan t'a jun winh sk'ayb'um chi': --Ha ix in nun tik, icha a nun tzutej ix, xchi. Yuj chi', a jun winh sk'ayb'um chi' ix ik'ankanoch ix snun Jesús chi' t'a yol spat. Atax ta' kannak ix yet'ok.

Ixlajwi chi', yojtakxo Jesús to ix elk'och masanil tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a yib'anh. Yuj chi' ix yal icha tik: --Stacji wal in ti', xchi. Icha chi' ix yutej yalani yik tz'elk'och tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a Slolonel Dios.
Ayek' jun chen winagre ta'. Ix yak'anoch jun tz'ub'lab' heb' t'a sjolom jun te' hisopo, ix slab'anem heb' t'a skal jun winagre chi', ix yak'anoch heb' t'a sti' Jesús chi'.
Ix stz'ub'an jun winagre chi', ix lajwi chi' ix yalani: --Toxo ix yik' sb'a smasanil, xchi. Ixlajwi chi', ix em nhojnaj schami.

Ha t'a jun k'u chi', k'ik'anokxo tz'och sq'uinh heb' israel yik snaankot heb' tas aj yelnakkot heb' smam yicham heb' t'a Egipto, sk'ual ik'oj ip yaj t'a heb'. Ha heb' winh aj Judea malaj snib'ej heb' winh skan sniwanil heb' kulusab'il t'a te' kulus chi', yujto a jun q'uinh sja chi', te niwan q'uinh syutej heb'. Yuj chi' ix b'at heb' sk'an t'a winhaj Pilato to syak' mak'jok poj sb'aquil sat spenek heb' winh, yik tz'ik'jiemta heb' t'a te' kulus chi'.
Yuj chi' ix k'och heb' winh soldado b'aj ix kulusajk'e heb' chi'. Ha heb' winh kulusalb'ilk'e yet' Jesús chi', ix mak'jipoj sb'aquil sat spenek heb' winh.
Palta haxo yik ix k'och heb' winh t'a stz'ey Jesús chi', ix yilan heb' winh to chamnakxo, majxo smak'pojlaj sb'aquil sat spenek chi' heb' winh.
Palta ay jun winh soldado ix tipanoch k'een slanza t'a skostil Jesús chi'. Yuj chi' ix elta usnaj chik' yet' ha ha'.
Ha in tik, ix wil wal juntzanh tik. Yuj chi' swak' testigoal in b'a yuj, yik ol eyak'och t'a he k'ool. Ha juntzanh tzin tz'ib'ejkan tik, te yel. Ha in tik wojtak to te yel swala'.
Ix uji juntzanh tik, yik tz'elk'och tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a Slolonel Dios ayik syalan icha tik: Malaj junok sb'aquil ol smak' poj heb', xchi.
Syalanpax junxo tik t'a Slolonel chi': Ol yil jun mach b'aj stipnakoch k'een lanza heb', xchi.

Ay jun winh skuchan José aj chonhab' Arimatea. Sk'ayb'um winh Jesús t'a k'ub'eltak, yujto xiw winh t'a heb' winh aj Judea. Xid' sk'anan spermiso winh t'a winhaj Pilato yik syik'emta sniwanil Jesús chi' winh t'a te' kulus, b'at smukan winh. Axo winhaj Pilato chi' ix ak'an spermiso winh yik'anemta. Yuj chi' ix yik'anb'at winh.

Ajun pax winhaj Nicodemo winh xid'naquek' sk'umej Jesús t'ak'walil yet'nak winh. Ay am oxeok arroba juntzanh suk'uq'ui sjab' skuchan mirra kalan yaj yet' junxo skuchan áloes yet'nak winhaj Nicodemo chi'.

Ix yik'anb'at sniwanil Jesús chi' heb' winh. Ix spichan heb' winh t'a jun k'apak. Ix yak'anoch jun suk'uq'ui sjab' chi' heb' winh t'ay, yujto icha chi' sley heb' israel chi' ayik smukan heb' chamnak heb'.
Axo t'a slak'anil b'aj ix kulusajk'e Jesús chi' ay jun awb'en te'. Ata' ay jun k'een k'een joyb'ilel yool. Ha jun k'een chi', manta junok chamnak tz'ak'jioch t'a yol k'een.
Axo jun sk'ual ik'oj ip, toxo syamchajochi. Yuj chi' ha t'a yol jun k'een chi' ix ak'jioch sniwanil Jesús chi', yujto lak'an ay k'een b'aj ix cham chi'.
Ha t'a domingoal, ayto sakb'i, ix b'at ix María Magdalena b'aj ix mukchajkanoch sniwanil Jesús chi'. Ix yilan ix to toxo ix ik'jiel smakul b'aj mukan chi'.

Yuj chi' elanhchamel ix b'at lemnaj ix, haxo ix k'och ix t'a winhaj Simón Pedro yet' t'a junxo winh sk'ayb'um Jesús, aton winh te xajan yuj Jesús chi'. Ix yalan ix t'a heb' winh: --Toxo ix ik'jib'at sniwanil Kajal Jesús b'aj mukan, ¿b'aj am ix yak' heb'? xchi ix t'a heb' winh.
Ixlajwi yab'an jun chi' winhaj Pedro yet' junxo winh sk'ayb'um Jesús chi', ix b'at heb' winh, ix b'at yilan heb' winh b'aj ay k'een k'een chi'.
Elanhchamel ix b'at heb' winh schawanhil. Palta ix tzak'lajkan winhaj Pedro chi'. Yuj chi' a junxo winh k'ayb'um chi' ix b'ab'lajk'ochi.
Ix och t'anhan winh t'a sti' k'een. Ix yilanoch jun k'apak winh lanhaneq'ui. Palta maj ochlaj winh t'a yol k'een.
Axo winhaj Simón Pedro chi' tzak'anto ix k'och winh. B'enhej ix ochb'at winh t'a yol k'een. Ix yilan winh, lanhanek' juntzanh k'apak chi'.
Ha junxo k'apak sb'ak'ul sjolom Jesús chi', pakb'ilkan k'apak, ch'ok aykankot k'apak.
Ichato chi' ix ochk'och junxo winh k'ayb'um ix b'ab'laj k'och chi'. Ayic ix yilan jun chi' winh, ix yak'och winh t'a sk'ool to ix pitzwixi Jesús.
Maxto nachajel yuj heb' winh tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a Slolonel Dios to yowalil ol pitzwokxi Jesús t'a skal heb' chamnak.
Ixlajwi chi', ix paxkan heb' winh t'a spat junjun.
Axo ix María aj Magdala, ix kan ix t'a stz'ey jun k'een chi'. Maj ochlaj ix t'a yol k'een. Van yok' ix, ix och t'anhan ix t'a sti' k'een.
Axo ix yilan ix, ayelta chawanh ángel t'a yol k'een. Te sak spichul heb'. k'ojjab'em heb' b'aj ix em sniwanil Jesús chi', jun t'a sjolomtak, jun t'a yoktak.
Ix sk'anb'anelta heb' t'a ix: --Ach ix, ¿tas yuj tzach oq'ui? xchielta heb'. --Tzin oq'ui yujto ix ik'jib'at sniwanil winh Vajal t'a tik. ¿B'aj am ix yak' heb'? xchi ix t'a heb'.
Vanto yalan jun chi' ix, ix b'at k'elan ix t'a spatik. Axo ix yilan ix ayek' Jesús chi', palta maj yilochlaj ix tato ha'.

Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'an t'a ix: --Ach ix, ¿tas yuj tzach oq'ui? ¿Mach tza sayeq'ui? xchi t'a ix. Palta a snaan ix to a winh yilumal te' awb'en te' chi' linhanek' ta'. Yuj chi' ix yalan ix: --Ach wetanimail, tato a ach ix ul ik'el sniwanil Jesús chi', al wal t'ayin b'ajtil ix b'at ak'kani yik ol wik'b'ati, xchi ix t'ay.
--María, xchi Jesús chi' t'a ix. Yuj chi' ix meltzajb'at k'elan ix t'ay. Ix yalan ix t'a sti' hebreo: --Raboni, xchi ix. Syalelk'ochi, Ach in k'ayb'umal.

Ix yalan t'a ix: --Manh in a yama', yujto manto in paxk'e b'aj ay in Mam. Ixic al t'a heb' wuk'tak yet' t'a heb' wanab' smasanil to ol in paxk'e b'aj ay in Mam. Ha in Mam chi', he Mam pax wed'ok. Ha in Diosal, he Diosal pax wed'ok, xchi Jesús chi' t'a ix.
Yuj chi' ix b'at ix yal t'a heb' sk'ayb'um Jesús chi': --Ix wil Kajal Jesús, xchi ix t'a heb'. Ix laj yalan ix t'a heb' tastak ix yal t'a ix.

Anheja' t'a jun domingo chi' t'a k'ik'b'alil, ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' sk'ayb'um Jesús chi'. nhab'ab'i ix aj spuertail jun pat chi', yujto xiw heb' t'a heb' winh aj Judea. Axo ix yilan heb' ayxoek' Jesús t'a skal heb', ix yalan t'a heb': --Junk'olalokab' eyaji, xchi t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix sch'oxan yol sk'ab' yet' skostil t'a heb'. Axo heb' sk'ayb'um chi', ix te tzalaj heb' yilan Kajal Jesús chi'.
Ix yalanpax junelxo: --Junk'olalokab' eyaji. Icha ix yutej ko Mam Dios in schekankoti, icha chi' swutej ex in chekanb'ati, xchi t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi yalan juntzanh chi', ix spu'anek' yik' t'a yib'anh heb', ix yalani: --Chaec Yespíritu Dios.
Tato ay heb' tzeyak' niwank'olal smul, anhejtona' ol ak'jokpax lajwok smul heb' yuj Dios. Tato ay heb' max eyak' niwank'olal smul chi', ol kannhej smul heb' chi' t'a yib'anh, xchi t'a heb'.
Palta ay jun winh yetb'eyum heb' sk'ayb'um Jesús chi' skuchan Tomás, tz'alji Tioxal. Manh ayoquek'laj winh yet' heb' ayik ix ek' Jesús chi' ta'.

Yuj chi' ix yal heb' yetk'ayb'umal winh chi' t'ay: --Ix quil Kajal Jesús, xchi heb' winh. --Oc in wal swil b'aj ix ek' k'een lawux t'a yol sk'ab', swekanoch yiximal in k'ab' t'a yolanil b'aj ix ek' k'een chi', swak'anpaxoch in k'ab' t'a skostil, ichato chi', ol wak'anoch t'a in k'ool tato a wal Jesús chi', xchi winhaj Tomás chi'.

Ukub'ixitax chi', ix smolb'anxi sb'a heb' t'a yol jun pat chi'. Ayxo pax ek' winhaj Tomás chi' yet' heb'. nhab'ab'i yaj jun pat chi' sch'apan heb', palta ix yilan heb', ayxoek' Jesús chi' t'a skal heb'. Ix yalan t'a heb': --Junk'olalokab' eyaji, xchi.

Ix lajwinhej chi', ix yalan t'a winhaj Tomás chi': --Ilnab' in k'ab' tik. Ecoch yiximal a k'ab' t'a yolanil tik. Tzak'anpaxoch a k'ab' t'a yolanil in kostil tik. Manh ak' chab'k'olal. Ak' in wal och t'a a k'ool, xchi t'a winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Tomás chi' t'ay: --Ach Vajalil, ach in Diosal, xchi winh.
Ix yalanxi Jesús chi' t'a winh: --In ak'och t'a a k'ool yujto in ila'. Ha heb' max in ilani, tato tzin yak'och heb' t'a sk'ool, te' wach' yik heb', xchi t'a winh.
Tzijtumto juntzanhxo tas satub'tak ix sch'ox Jesús t'a yichanh heb' sk'ayb'um, palta manh tz'ib'ab'iloklajkan t'a jun uum tik.
Palta a juntzanh tik tz'ib'ab'ilkani yik tzeyak'och t'a he k'ool to a Jesús aton Cristo, Yuninal Dios. Tato icha chi' ol eyutok eyak'anoch t'a he k'ool, ol he cha he k 'inal t'a junelnhej yuj.
Axo junelxo, ix sch'oxxi sb'a Jesús t'a heb' winh sk'ayb'um ayik ayek' heb' winh t'a sti' ha' nhajab' Tiberias. Icha tik ix aj sch'oxan sb'ha t'a heb' winh.

Ayek' winhaj Simón Pedro yet' winhaj Tomás tz'alji Tioxal. Ajun pax winhaj Natanael aj Caná t'a yol yik Galilea. Anhejtona', ayek' pax heb' winh yuninal winhaj Zebedeo yet' chawanhxo heb' winh yetk'ayb'umal heb' winh.

Axo winhaj Simón Pedro ix alan t'a heb' winh: --Ol in b'at yamoj chay, xchi winh t'a heb' winh. --Ol onh b'at ed'ok, xchi heb' winh t'a winh. Yuj chi' ix b'at heb' winh. Ix och heb' winh t'a yol jun te' barko. Palta ha t'a jun ak'wal chi', malaj junok nok' ix yamchaj yuj heb' winh.
Axo yik wanxo sakb'i, ayek' Jesús t'a sti' ha' chi'. Ha heb' winh sk'ayb'um chi' maj snalaj heb' winh tato ha'.
Ix yalankot t'a heb' winh: --Ex wetanimail, ¿ay am nok' ix eyik'a'? xchi t'a heb' winh. --Maay. Malaj nok', xchi heb' winh t'ay.

--Hak'uequem ch'anh he chimpa chi' t'a swach' te' barko chi', ata' ol yamchaj nok' eyuuj, xchi t'a heb' winh. Ix yak'anem ch'anh heb' winh. Ix yak'lan heb' winh stok'ank'eta ch'anh, majxo yal-laj sk'eta ch'anh yuj yalil nok', yujto te tzijtum nok'.

Axo jun winh sk'ayb'um Jesús te xajan yuj, a winh ix alan t'a winhaj Pedro chi': --Inai, a Kajal Jesús ayek' chi', xchi winh. Ix lajwinhej yab'an chi' winhaj Simón Pedro chi', ix yak'anoch spichul winh, yujto anhej yol spichul winh ayochi. Ix syumanelta sb'a winh t'a yol te' barko chi', ix elk'och winh t'a sti' ha'.

Ay am chanheok ch'anhil ayb'at heb' winh t'a sat ha'. Axo juntzanhxo heb' winh yetk'ayb'umal heb' winh, tzak'anto ix k'och heb' winh yet' jun yune' barko, nherb'il ch'anh chimpa b'ut'an yuj nok' chay chi' yuj heb' winh.
Axo ix elta heb' winh, ix yilan heb' winh, ayoch jun k'ak' toxo ix el ichan. Van sb'olan jun nok' chay Jesús chi'. Ay pax ek' juntzanh ixim pan t'a stz'ey.
Axo ix yalan t'a heb' winh: --Ik'ekkot jaywanhok nok' he chay ix he yam chi', xchi.

Yuj chi' ix ochxi winhaj Simón Pedro t'a yol te' barko chi'. Ix stok'anelta ch'anh chimpa chi' winh t'a stak'inhal sti' ha'. Ix yilan heb' winh to b'ut'an ch'anh yuj juntzanh nok' niwak chay chi'. 153 sb'isul nok' smasanil. Palta wach'chom te al nok', maj d'inhchajlaj ch'anh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jesús t'a heb' winh: --Cotanhec, waanhek, xchi. Malaj junok heb' sk'ayb'um chi' ix k'anb'ani: ¿Mach ach? man xchiok heb' winh, yujto yojtakxo heb' winh to a Cajalil.
Ix snitzanoch sb'a Jesús t'a stz'ey heb' winh. Ix yik'ank'e ixim pan chi', ix spukanek' ixim t'a heb' winh. Anhejtona' icha chi' ix yutej spukanek' nok' chay chi'.
Yoxelalxo sch'oxan sb'a Jesús t'a heb' sk'ayb'um chi' yiktax ix pitzwixi t'a skal heb' chamnak.

Ixlajwi swa heb', ix yalan Jesús t'a winhaj Simón Pedro: --Ach Simón yuninal winhaj Jonás, tzin k'anb'ej t'ayach, ¿más am tzin a xajanej t'a yichanh heb' winh tik? xchi t'a winh. --Yel ton Mamin. Ojtacxo to xajan ach wuuj, xchi winhaj Pedro chi' t'ay. --Tato icha chi', icha junok tanhwum kalnel syak' wa nok' yunetak skalnel, icha chi' tzutej a k'ayb'an heb' wiko', xchi Jesús t'a winh.

Ix lajwinhej yalan juntzanh chi', ix yalanxi: --Ach Simón yuninal winhaj Jonás, ¿tzam in a xajanej? xchi t'a winh. --Yel ton Mamin. Ojtacxo to tzach in xajanej, xchixi winh. --Tato icha chi', icha junok tanhwum kalnel stanhwan nok' skalnel, icha chi' tzutej a tanhwan heb' wikxo, xchi Jesús chi' t'a winh.

Ix yalanxi t'a yoxelal: --Ach Simón yuninal winhaj Jonás, ¿tzam in a xajanej? xchi t'a winh. Yuj chi' ix te kusk'e winhaj Pedro chi', yujto yoxelalxo sk'anb'an Jesús chi' t'a winh tato xajan yuj winh. Yuj chi' ix yalanxi winh: --Mamin, ojtakxo smasanil, ojtak to xajan ach wuuj, xchi winh t'ay. --Tato icha chi', icha junok tanhwum kalnel syak' wa nok' skalnel, icha chi' tzutej a k'ayb'an heb' wikxo.

Val yel swal t'ayach, ha t'a yik quelem achto, munil tza pich a b'a. Tzach b'eyek' b'aj ay a gana. Palta ayik ol ach ichamaxok, tonhej ol ak'el lian a k'ab', ch'ok mach ol tzek'an a nanhal, ol ach ik'jokb'at b'aj max yal a k'ool, xchi Jesús t'a winhaj Pedro chi'.
Icha chi' yutejnak yalan yuj tas ol aj scham winhaj Pedro chi', yik ol sch'oxel winh to niwan yelk'och Dios. Ixlajwi chi', ix yalanxi t'a winh: --Ochanh tzak'an wuuj, xchi t'a winh.

Axo ix meltzajb'at k'elan winhaj Pedro chi' t'a spatik, ix yilan winh, a winh sk'ayb'um Jesús xajan yuj, tzak'anxooch winh yuj heb'. Aton jun winh chi' ix em k'ojan t'a stz'ey Jesús ayik ix wa heb' junel, ayik ix sk'anb'an winh t'a Jesús chi': Mamin, ¿mach ol ach ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' chamel chi'? xchi winh t'ay.
Ayic ix yilan jun winh chi' winhaj Pedro, ix sk'anb'an winh t'a Jesús: --Mamin, xal jun winh sja tik, ¿tas ol ik'an scham winh? xchi winh t'ay.
Yuj chi' ix yalan Jesús chi' t'a winh: --Taxonhej in gana pitzanto winh ayik ol in jaxok, malaj ochi. Ha ach tik, ochanh tzak'an wuuj, xchi t'a winh.

Yuj chi' ix el spekal t'a skal heb' yikxo Dios to manh ol cham jun winh sk'ayb'um Jesús chi'. Palta maj yal-laj Jesús tato manh ol cham winh, anhej ix yala': Taxonhej in gana pitzanto winh ayik ol in jaxok, malaj ochi, xchi.
Aton jun winh k'ayb'um tik syak' testigoal sb'ha t'a juntzanh tik, ix stz'ib'ejkan winh. Cojtak to te yel juntzanh ix stz'ib'ejkan winh tik.
Tzijtumto juntzanhxo tas ix sk'ulej Jesús. Q'uinalok tato ix tz'ib'chajkan t'a junjunal, tzin na'a to max yab'laj jun yol yib'anhk’inal tik yik smolchajkan juntzanh uum b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkan chi'. Amén
Ay jun b'ab'el uum tz'ib'ab'ilxo b'at t'ayach wuuj, ach Teófilo. Ata' ix wala' jantak tas ix sk'ulej Jesús yet' tas ix yak' k'ayb'ajok, yiktax ix syamanoch sk'ayb'ani
masanto ix ja jun k'ual ayik ix pax t'a satcha’anh. Ayic manto paxi, ix yalankan juntzanh scheknab'il t'a heb' schekab', aton heb' sik'b'ilel yuj, icha ix ak'ji yal yuj Yespíritu Dios.

Ayic toxo ix ek' chamel t'a yib'anh, tzijtum elto ix sch'ox sb'ha t'a heb' schekab' chi'. 40 k'ualto ix eq'ui, ixto sch'ox sb'ha t'a heb' to yel ix pitzwixi. Ix yalankan t'a heb' to ol wach' och Dios Yajalil.
Ayic ayto ek' yet' heb' schekab' chi', ix yalan icha tik t'a heb': --Manh ex el t'a yol chonhab' Jerusalén tik. Tanhwejec jun tas yalnakkan Dios t'ayex, icha wutejnak walan t'ayex.
Yel toni, a winhaj Juan ak'jinak bautizar heb' anima t'a ha ha'. Palta ato t'a yik jayexo k'u, ol ak'jok Yespíritu Dios t'ayex. Ichato ol ex ak'jok bautizar yuj, xchi Jesús.
Ayic ayto ek' Jesús yet' heb' sk'ayb'um chi', ix sk'anb'an heb' t'ay: --Mamin, ¿am tiknaik ol a kolelta heb' quetchonhab' israel, yik munil skak'och junok yajal t'a ko kal junelxo? xchi heb'.
Yuj chi' ix yalan t'a heb': --Max ak'jilaj eyojtaquejel sk'ual, ma stiempoal b'ak'uinh ol ujok, yujto a juntzanh chi', anhej Dios ko Mam ay yalan yik t'ay.

Palta ol yak' spoder Dios t'ayex, ayik ol ochkan Espíritu Santo t'ayex. Ol lajwok chi', haxo eyalanel wab'ixal t'a Jerusalén tik, t'a masanil yol yik Judea tik, t'a yol yik Samaria yet' t'a masanil yol yib'anhk’inal tik, xchi t'a heb'.
Axo ix lajwi yalan juntzanh chi', ix k'ex t'a satcha’anh. Q'uelank'e heb' t'ay ix satk'e t'a skal jun asun. Majxo yil-laj heb'.
Q'uelanto k'e heb' t'a satcha’anh chi' ayik wanto sk'ex Jesús, haxo ix yilan heb', ayxoek' chawanh ángel icha yilji anima t'a stz'ey heb', te sak spichul heb'.

Ix yalan heb': --Ex winak aj Galilea, ¿tas yuj anheja' eyajk'e k'elan t'a satcha’anh? Ha Jesús, ix el t'a he kal, ix pax t'a satcha’anh, icha ix aj eyilan sk'ex tik, icha pax chi' ol aj yemxuli, xchi heb' ángel chi' t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix emixta heb' sk'ayb'um Jesús chi' t'a tzalan Oliwo chi'. Ix b'atxi heb' t'a Jerusalén. Ha jun tzalan chi', ay am nanhalok legua skal yet' Jerusalén chi'.

Ixlajwi sk'och heb' t'a chonhab' chi', ix k'e heb' t'a jun kuarto chaanh yajk'ei. Aton b'aj ay sposado winhaj Pedro, winhaj Jacobo, winhaj Juan, winhaj Andrés, winhaj Felipe, winhaj Tomás, winhaj Bartolomé, winhaj Mateo, winhaj Jacobo yuninal winhaj Alfeo, winhaj Simón, aton winh yetb'eyumejnak sb'a yet' heb' Zelote yet' winhaj Judas yuninal winhaj Jacobo. Ata' ay sposado heb' winh smasanil.
Junjun k'u smolb'an sb'a heb' winh smasanil ta', yik slesalwi heb' winh d'ha Dios yet' heb' winh yuk'tak Jesús, ix María ix snun Jesús chi' yet' juntzanhxo heb' ix ix.
Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', ay am junok 120 heb' kreyente ix smolb'ej sb'a. Axo winhaj Pedro ix k'e waan t'a skal heb'. Ix yalan winh:

--Ex wuk'tak ex wanab', yowalil ix elk'och icha tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a Slolonel Dios. Yujto a Yespíritu Dios ak'annak stz'ib'ejkan winhaj Dawid yuj winhaj Judas, aton winh ch'oxjinak Jesús t'a heb' yamjinak.
Ha winhaj Judas chi', quetb'eyum ko b'a yet' winh t'a yalanhtaxo, junnhej kopisio yet' winh.
Palta a yet' k'een tumin ix scha winh t'a spatik jun chukal ix sk'ulej chi', a yet' k'een ix sman jun lum lum winh, ix kot pichnaj winh, ix elta usnaj yol sk'ool winh.
Ha heb' ay t'a Jerusalén tik, ix laj yab' spekal jun chi' heb'. Yuj chi' ix yak' skuch jun lu'um chi' heb', Acéldama t'a sti' heb'. Syalelk'ochi: Lum Schiq'uil Anima.
Syal pax icha tik t'a jun libro Salmos: Canokab' tzinan b'aj kajan winh. Manhxaokab' mach ol kajnaj t'ay, xchi. Syalanxi icha tik: Ch'okxookab' mach tz'ochpaxkan t'a yopisio, xchikani.

Yuj chi' ko sik'equelta junok mach tz'och sk'exulok winh. Skak'anoch yopisio yalaneli to ix pitzwixi Jesús. Ha jun ol ko sik'elta chi', yowalil toxonton quetb'eyum ko b'a yet'ok ayik onh ek' yet' Kajal Jesús, yiktax yak'jinak bautizar heb' anima yuj winhaj Juan, masanto ix pax Jesús t'a satcha’anh, xchi winhaj Pedro chi' t'a heb'.
Yuj chi', ix naji t'a yib'anh chawanh heb' winh, aton winhaj José Barsabás, skuchan pax Justo yet' winhaj Matías.
Ixlajwi chi', ix lesalwi heb' smasanil. Ix yalan heb' icha tik: --Mamin, ojtak tas yaj ko pensar ko masanil. Yuj chi' ch'ox t'ayonh mach junok heb' chawanh tik tza sik'elta
yik wach' ol och yopisio schekab'ok Jesucristo. Yujto ix ik'jiel winhaj Judas t'a yopisio yuj smul. Ix b'at winh b'aj smoj sk'ochi, xchi heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix och suerte t'a yib'anh heb' winh schawanhil. Yuj chi' ix cheklajelta to a winhaj Matías ix ochkan t'a yib'anh. Ha winh ix ochkan stz'akub'ok heb' winh uxluchwanh schekab' Jesucristo chi'.
Ayic ix ja sk'ual q'uinh Pentecostés, junnhej b'aj ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' kreyente smasanil.
Axo t'a jun rato chi', ix k'anh jun t'a satcha’anh, icha sk'anh junok ik' te ow. Ix laj k'anh yek' t'a yol jun pat b'aj k'ojanem heb' chi'.
Ix yilan juntzanh tas heb' icha sk'e nhilnhon te' k'ak'. Ix pukaxb'at t'a skal heb'. Ix em t'a yib'anh junjun heb'.
Ix laj ochkan Yespíritu Dios t'a junjun heb'. Ix och ijan heb' slolon t'a juntzanhxo ch'okch'ok tial, ato syala' tas ix ak'ji yal heb' yuj Espíritu Santo chi'.
Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi' ayek' juntzanh heb' israel t'a Jerusalén chi', aton heb' skot t'a ch'okch'ok chonhab'il t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik. Ha d'ha Dios syal sb'a heb'.
Ayic ix k'anh jun chi', tzijtum anima ix smolb'ej sb'ha t'a jun pat chi'. Ix laj somchaj spensar heb', yujto ix laj yab'laj sti' heb', yujto a heb' kreyente syal sti' junjun chonhab' heb'.
Ix te sat sk'ool heb', ix laj och k'eljab' heb'. Ix laj yalan heb': --Ha wal heb' wan slolon tik, aj Galilea heb' smasanil.
Yuj chi', ¿tas yuj skab' yalan ko ti' heb'? Palta ina ch'okch'ok ko ti' junjun onh.
Ha t'a ko kal tik ay heb' aj Parta. Ay heb' aj Media, ay heb' aj Elam, ay heb' aj Mesopotamia, ay heb' aj Judea, ay heb' aj Capadocia, ay heb' aj Ponto yet' t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a yol yik Asia.

Ay heb' aj Frigia, heb' aj Panfilia, heb' aj Egipto. Ay pax heb' aj Libia t'a yichanhb'at Cirene. Ay pax juntzanh heb' aj Roma, aytaxon ek' t'a tik. Quetisraelal nanhal heb'. Axo nanhalxo heb' manh israeloklaj heb', palta ochnak heb' t'a ko k'ayb'ub'al.
Ay pax heb' aj Creta yet' heb' aj Arabia. Co masanil skab' slolon heb' t'a ko ti' yik syalan heb' jantak wal tas satub'tak sb'o Dios, xchi heb'.
Ix laj sat sk'ool heb' smasanil, ix laj somchaj heb'. Ix laj yalan heb': --¿Tas wal yaj juntzanh tik? xchi heb'.
Palta ay juntzanhxo heb' jun, tonhej ix b'uchwaj heb'. Ix yalan heb': --Ha juntzanh heb' tik, uk'umanh heb', xchi heb'.

Yuj chi', ix k'e linhan winhaj Pedro yet' heb' winh uxluchwanh yetchekab'wumal. Te chaanh ix yal winh t'a skal heb' anima chi': --Ex aj Judea yet' ex he masanil ayextaxonek' t'a Jerusalén tik, swak' eyojtaquejel tas yaj jun tik. Hak'uekoch he chiquin t'a tas ol wal t'ayex.
¿Tom tze na'a to uk'um onh anh? Maay, ina k'e k'ualto tiknaik.
Palta a winhaj Joel, winh schekab' Dios t'a peka', ayokto yalannakkan winh t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani, xchi icha tik:

Ix yalan Dios: Ha t'a yik slajwub' k'ual, ol wak'och Vespíritu t'a masanil anima. Axo heb' eyuninal yet' heb' eyisil ol alanel in lolonel. Ha t'a heb' kelemtak ol in ch'ox juntzanh tas t'a wayichal. Axo t'a heb' ichamtak winak, ol in lolon t'a heb' t'a swayich.
Ha t'a jun pekti’ chi', ol wak'och Vespíritu t'a jantaknhej heb' tzin ak'an serwil, wach'chom winak, mato ix, ol yalel in lolonel heb'.

Ol in ch'oxan juntzanh tas t'a satcha’anh yet' t'a yol yib'anhk’inal, ol sat sk'ool heb' anima yilani. Ol in ch'oxpax juntzanhxo tas sch'oxanel in poder, aton chik', k'ak' yet' jun niwan tab' icha asun.

Ha k'u ol k'ik'b'oquelok. Axo k'een uj, te chak ol aj k'een icha chik'. Icha chi' ol ajok ayik manto ja sk'ual yowal in k'ool a in Yajal in tik. Ha jun k'ual chi', te niwan yelk'ochi. Ol te sat sk'ool heb' anima yuj.
Axo heb' syal sb'a t'ayin a in Yajal in tik, ol laj kolchaj heb', xchi Dios t'a Slolonel chi'.

Ex wetisraelal, ak'ekoch he chiquin t'a juntzanhxo ol wal tik t'ayex. Ha Dios ix ch'oxani chajtil yopisio Jesús aj Nazaret t'ayex, ayik ix sb'oan juntzanh milagro, juntzanh malaj b'aj squila' yet' juntzanhxo tas sch'oxanel spoder. Ha juntzanh chi' ix sb'o Dios yet' Jesús. Ina eyojtaktaxon juntzanh tik.

Palta a Jesús chi', ix ak'jikanoch t'a yol he k'ab', yujto icha chi' ix el t'a sk'ool Dios. Yictax t'a pekataxo yojtakxo Dios tas ol jawok t'a yib'anh Jesús chi'. Ha ex tik ix he majnej sk'ab' heb' chuk, yik ix eyamani, ix he kulusank'ei. Icha chi' ix eyutej he milanchamok.
Palta haxo Dios ix ak'an pitzwokxi. Ix yak'an ganar spitzwixi, yujto a chamel malaj tz'och t'ay.
Ha winhaj Dawid alannakkan yab'ixal Jesús chi' to ol pitzwokxi. Xchi icha tik: Masanil tiempo naan achnhej wuuj. Yujto ayachek' t'a in wach' k'ab', yuj chi' max somchajel-laj in k'ool.
Yuj chi' ste tzalaj in k'ool, tzin b'itan t'a tzalajk'olal. Malaj tas tzin na yuj in niwanil tik, yujto tzach wak'och yipok in k'ool.
Yujto manh ol aktejkanlaj in pixan t'a skal heb' chamnak, manh ol a cha k'ab'at in niwanil tik, a in ton tik sik'b'il in el uuj.
Ix ak' wojtaquejel sb'eal k 'inal, ol ak' tzalajb'ok in k'ool ayik ayachek' wed'ok. Icha chi' yaj stz'ib'ankan winhaj Dawid t'a Slolonel Dios.
Ex wetchonhab', te chequel tas ajnak winh ko mam quicham aj Dawid chi'. Cojtak to chamnak winh, muknajnak winh. Ha jun yet'tal b'aj mukan winh chi', anheja' chequelto yajek' tiknaik.
Palta a winhaj Dawid chi', ak'b'il yopisio winh yalankani tastak ol jawok. Yojtak winh to te yel sti' Dios yak'nakkan t'ay, to a Cristo ol elixkan yinhtilok, haxo yochkan reyal chi' sk'exulok winh.

Ayocto ix yojtakanel winhaj Dawid chi' tas ol aj Cristo. Yuj chi' yalnakkan winh to ol pitzwokxi Cristo chi'. Ix yalanpaxkan winh to ha Dios manh ol aktankan spixan t'a skal heb' chamnak. Axo sniwanil, manh ol k'aok.
Yuj chi' a Jesús tik, ha Dios ix ak'anxi pitzwok. Co masanil skak'och ko b'a testigoal yuj jun tik, yujto ix quila'.

Anhejtona', ix pax t'a satcha’anh yuj spoder Dios, yik b'at em k'ojan t'a swach' k'ab' Dios chi', haxo ix ak'an Espíritu Santo t'ay, icha yutejnak yalankani. Axo Jesús chi' ix ak'ankot jun tzeyil tik yet' jun tzeyab' tik.
Ha winhaj Dawid chi' maj b'atlaj winh t'a satcha’anh yet' sniwanil. Palta yalnakkan winh icha tik: Ha Dios Kajal alannak t'a Vajalil: Emanh k'ojan t'a in wach' k'ab',
masanto ol wak'kanoch heb' ayoch ajk'ool t'ayach t'a yalanh ok, xchi Dios t'a Vajalil, xchi winhaj Dawid chi'.

Palta in gana tzeyojtaquejel sik'lab'il he masanil ex wetisraelal to a Jesús ix he kulusejk'e chi', aton ix ak'jioch Cajaloc yuj Dios. Ix ak'jioch Cristoal, aton jun tanhwab'iltaxon sjawi kuuj, xchi winhaj Pedro chi'.

Ayic ix yab'an juntzanh chi' heb' chonhab', ix te och pitz'an kusk'olal t'a spixan heb'. Ix yalan heb' icha tik t'a winhaj Pedro yet' t'a juntzanhxo heb' schekab' Jesús: --Ex wetanimail, ¿tas wach' ko k'ulan tiknaik jun? xchi heb'.
Yuj chi', ix yal winhaj Pedro chi' t'a heb': --Naec he b'a. Hak'ek bautizar he b'ha t'a sb'i Jesucristo, yik wach' ol ak'jok lajwok he mul yuj Dios. Ichato chi', ol yak'an Espíritu Santo t'ayex.

Yujto icha chi' ajnak yak'annakkan sti' t'ayonh, t'a heb' kuninal yet' pax t'a masanil mach najat ay. Yujto a Cajalil ko Diosal syak' Yespíritu t'a jantaknhej heb' syawtejkot yikok, xchi winhaj Pedro chi' t'a heb'.
Tzijtumto tas ix yal winh t'a heb'. Ix yak'anpax razón winh t'a heb': --Ik'equel he b'ha t'a skal heb' malaj swach'il tik, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ay heb' ix ak'anoch t'a sk'ool tas ix yal winhaj Pedro chi'. Ix yak'an ak'jok bautizar sb'a heb'. Ha heb' ix och kreyenteal t'a jun k'u chi', ay am oxeok mil heb'.

Ix yak'an wal och spensar heb' t'a juntzanh k'ayb'ub'al ix yal heb' schekab' Jesús chi'. Junxonhej ix yutej spensar heb' smasanil. Slesalwi heb', smolb'an sb'a heb', swaan ixim pan heb' yik wach' snaankot Jesús Kajal heb'.
Ha heb' schekab' Jesús, tzijtum milagro ix sch'ox heb' yuj spoder Dios. Yuj chi' ix laj xiw heb' anima smasanil.
Jantacnhej heb' ix ak'anoch Cristo t'a sk'ool, junxonhej ix aj heb'. Jantacnhej tastak ay t'a heb', junxonhej ix laj yutej heb'.
Ay heb' ix laj schonhel sluum yet' jantaknhej tastak ay t'a heb'. Ix laj spukanek' stojol heb' t'a skal, icha syala' tastak tz'och yuj junjun heb'.
Junjun k'u smolb'an sb'a heb' t'a yol yamaq'uil stemplo Dios. Axo t'a spat heb' smolb'ej sb'a yik smol wa heb'. Junxonhej slaj wa heb' t'a tzalajk'olal. Te junk'olal ix aj heb'.
Slaj yalan wach' lolonel heb' d'ha Dios, ste tzalaj pax heb' anima smasanil yet' heb'. Axo Jesús Kajal tz'ak'an q'uib' sb'isul heb' t'a junjun k'u, yuj heb' wan skolchaj chi' yuj.
Ha junel, t'a a las tres yik yemk'ualil, molan ix b'at winhaj Pedro yet' winhaj Juan t'a stemplo Dios, yujto icha chi' yorail slesalwi heb' aj Israel ta'.

Ay jun winh, junjun k'u tzul chelchajkan t'a yol sti' jun spuertail yamaq'uil templo chi', aton t'a jun skuch Wach' Yilji, yik sk'an tumin winh t'a heb' sk'och t'a yol yamaq'uil templo chi', yujto max yal sb'ey winh yiktax ix alji.
Axo ix yilan winh sk'och winhaj Pedro yet' winhaj Juan t'a stemplo Dios chi', ayik wan yoch heb' winh ta', ix sk'anan stumin winh t'a heb' winh.
Axo winhaj Pedro yet' winhaj Juan chi' ix och k'elan t'a winh. --Cotanh k'elan t'ayonh, xchi winhaj Pedro chi' t'a winh.
