Axo ix yab'an spekal jun ix alchaj chi' heb' winh t'a spatik, ix b'at heb' winh elelal. Ix k'och heb' winh t'a Listra yet' t'a Derbe t'a yol yik Licaonia. Ix ek' heb' winh t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a slak'anil chi'.
Ata' ix ek' heb' winh yalkanel wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il.
Ha t'a chonhab' Listra ay jun winh atax yaljinak max yal sb'eyi. Malaj b'aj sb'ey jab'ok winh. Axo junel k'ojanem winh,
wan yab'an winh tas syal winhaj Pablo. Axo winhaj Pablo chi' ix och k'elan t'a winh. Ix yilan winh to syak'och winh t'a sk'ool to syal sb'oxi winh yuj Dios.
Yuj chi' te chaanh ix yal winh t'a winh: --Q'ueanh waan, tojol tzach ajk'e linhan, xchi winh. D'a jun rato chi', ix k'e linhan winh. Ix och ijan winh sb'eyeq'ui.

Ayic ix yilan heb' anima tas jun ix sk'ulej winhaj Pablo chi', ix och ijan heb' yalan chaanh t'a sti' heb' aj Licaonia chi', ix yalan heb' icha tik: --Ha heb' ko diosal ix yak'och sb'a heb' animail, ix emul heb' t'a ko kal, xchi heb'.
Ha winhaj Bernabé, Júpiter ix sb'iej winh yuj heb'. Axo winhaj Pablo, Mercurio ix yak' heb' sb'iok winh, yujto a winh ix lolon t'a skal heb'.

Ay jun winh sakerdoteal Júpiter chi', yajal yaj winh t'a stemplo Júpiter t'a stiel chonhab'. Ix b'at yik'kot juntzanh nok' toro winh yet' juntzanh xumaquil te te'. Axo yet' heb' anima chi' smasanil ijan ix yak' jun silab' nhusb'il winh t'a winhaj Pablo yet' t'a winhaj Bernabé chi'.

Palta haxo yik ix yab'an heb' winh schekab' Jesús chi', ix snhik'chitej spichul heb' winh sch'oxanel skusk'olal. Elanhchamel ix b'at heb' winh t'a skal heb' anima, te chaanh ix yal heb' winh t'a skal heb' icha tik:

--Ex quetanimail, ¿tas yuj icha tik tzeyutej he b'a? Ha onh tik, anima onh icha ex tik. Yuj chi' tzul kal t'ayex to tzeyaktejkan juntzanh he b'eyb'al tik, yujto nab'anhej tzeyixtej he b'a. Q'uexek he b'eyb'al, aq'ek och he pensar t'a jun Dios to t'a wal yel pitzan. A' b'ojinak satcha’anh yet' sat lu'um tik. Sb'oannak pax ha' mar yet' masanil tastak.
D'a peka', tonhej ix yil Dios tas ix sk'ulej heb' anima, ix yak'an snib'ej heb'.
Palta ix yak' ko pensar yik skojtaquej eli tas yaji ayik syak'ankot nhab' t'a quib'anh. Syak'an masanil tas skawej. A' tz'ak'an masanil tas sko wa''a. Syak'anpax ko tzalajk'olal, xchi heb' winh.

Palta ayik ix lajwi yalan juntzanh chi' winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Bernabé chi', puralxonhej ix och waan heb' anima chi' skachji yuj heb' winh. Yujto snib'ej heb' syak' nok' wakax chi' silab'il t'a heb' winh.

Palta ay jaywanh heb' israel aj Antioquía yik Pisidia ix k'och yet' jaywanhxo heb' aj Iconio. Ix yak'an sk'ool heb' anima chi' heb'. Yuj chi', ix laj sjuloch k'een k'een heb' t'a winhaj Pablo chi'. Axo ix snaan heb' to toxo ix cham winh, ix snheranb'at winh heb', ix syumankanel winh heb' t'a stiel chonhab' chi'.
Palta ix k'och oyan heb' kreyente t'a stz'ey winh, ix k'ex waan winh. Ix ochxi winh t'a yol chonhab' chi'. Axo t'a junxo k'u, ix b'atxi winh yet' winhaj Bernabé chi' t'a chonhab' Derbe.

Ata' ix ek' yalkanel wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il heb' winh. Tzijtum anima ix ak'anoch Kajal Jesús t'a sk'ool. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'atxi heb' winh. Ix ek'xi heb' winh t'a chonhab' Listra, t'a Iconio yet' t'a Antioquía yik Pisidia chi'.

Ix laj ek' heb' winh yiptzitej heb' kreyente t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', ix ek' ak'jikan stek'anil spensar heb' yuj heb' winh. Ix yalankan heb' winh icha tik t'a heb': --Tek'an tzeyutej he b'a eyak'anoch Kajal Jesús t'a he k'ool, yujto ayik manto onh k'och t'a yol sk'ab' Dios, yowalil niwan yaelal ol ja t'a quib'anh, xchi heb' winh.

Ayic ix ek' winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Bernabé chi' t'a junjun iglesia, ix yak'och yopisio heb' tz'och ankianoal heb' winh. Ix yak'an lesal heb' winh d'ha Dios, ix och pax heb' winh t'a tzek'ojk'olal. Ixlajwi chi', ix ak'jikanoch heb' kreyente ab'enal t'a yol sk'ab' Kajal Jesús, aton jun ix yak'och heb' t'a sk'ool.
Ixlajwi chi', ix ek' winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Bernabé chi' t'a yol yik Pisidia. Ix k'och heb' winh t'a Panfilia.
Ix yalanel slolonel Dios heb' winh t'a chonhab' Perge. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'atxi heb' winh t'a chonhab' Atalia.

Axo ta' ix och heb' winh t'a yol jun barko. Ix jax heb' winh t'a Antioquía yik Siria. Aton t'a jun chonhab' chi' sk'annak swach'k'olal Dios heb' kreyente t'a yib'anh winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Bernabé chi', yik ix b'at yalankanel slolonel Dios heb' winh. Xal tiknaik ix yik' sb'a jun smunlajel heb' winh chi'.

Ayic ix k'ochxi heb' winh, ix laj yawtejkot heb' kreyente heb' winh ayek' ta'. Ix yalan heb' winh t'a heb' jantak tas ix sk'ulej Dios yet' heb' winh. Ix laj yalanpax heb' winh to a Kajal Jesús ix chaan yak'och heb' manh israelok t'a sk'ool.
Najtil ix aj heb' winh yet' heb' kreyente chi' ta'.

Ha t'a yik jun pekti’ chi', ay juntzanh heb' winh ix kot t'a yol yik Judea, ix k'och heb' winh t'a chonhab' Antioquía. Ix och ijan heb' winh yalan t'a heb' kreyente icha tik: --Tato maj he cha jun yechel kirkunkisión t'a he niwanil, icha yalnakkan winhaj Moisés, manh ol ex kolchajlaj, xchi heb' winh.

Axo winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Bernabé, ix stelaj sb'a heb' winh yet' heb' winh, palta maj b'olaj yaj yuj heb' winh. Yuj chi' ix yal heb' kreyente to sb'at heb' winh chawanh chi' t'a Jerusalén. Sb'atpax juntzanhxo heb' kreyente yet' heb' winh. Ix b'at heb' sk'anb'ej razón t'a heb' winh schekab' Jesús yet' t'a heb' winh ankiano t'a jun iglesia chi'.

Ixlajwi schekjib'at heb' winh yuj heb' kreyente chi', ix ek' heb' winh t'a yol yik Fenicia yet' t'a Samaria. Ata' ix ek' heb' winh yalel t'a heb' kreyente to ay heb' manh israelok ix sk'ex sb'eyb'al, ix yak'anoch spensar heb' d'ha Dios. Ha ix yab'an jun chi' heb' kreyente, ix te tzalaj heb' smasanil.

Ayic ix k'och heb' winh t'a Jerusalén chi', ix chaji sk'och heb' winh yuj heb' kreyente smasanil, heb' winh schekab' Jesús yet' heb' winh ankiano. Ix laj yalan heb' winh jantak tas ix sk'ulej Dios yet' heb' winh.

Palta ay jaywanh heb' winh fariseo ak'annakoch Cristo t'a sk'ool. Ix k'e wan heb' winh, ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --Ha heb' manh israelok tz'ak'anoch Cristo t'a sk'ool, yowalil tz'ak'ji kirkunkidar heb'. Yowalil skal t'a heb' to sk'anab'ajej ley Moisés heb', xchi heb' winh.
Axo heb' winh schekab' Jesús, ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' winh yet' heb' winh ankiano yik snaan heb' winh tas tz'aj jun chi'.

Axo ix lajwi ste telan sb'a heb' winh, ix k'e linhan winhaj Pedro, ix yalan winh: --Ex wuk'tak, eyojtaktaxoni, ayxo stiempoal in sik'jikanel yuj Dios yik swalanel wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il t'a heb' manh israelok, yik wach' syak'och Cristo heb' t'a sk'ool.
Yujto yojtak Dios tas ay t'a spensar junjun anima, yuj chi' ix yak' Yespíritu t'a heb' manh israelok chi', icha ix yutej yak'an t'ayonh, yik scheklaji to wach' heb' t'a yichanh.
Ha t'a yichanh Dios lajannhej heb' qued'ok, yujto ha' ix tojolb'itan sb'eyb'al heb' ayik ix yak'anoch Cristo heb' t'a sk'ool.

Ha tiknaik, ¿tas yuj malaj he gana tze cha tas wan sk'ulan Dios? Ha ley Moisés, lajan yet' junok ikatz te al max k'e ko kuchani. Maj techaj sk'anab'ajan heb' ko mam quicham. Anhejtona', max techaj pax ko k'anab'ajan a onh tik. Yuj chi', ¿tas yuj he gana tzeyak'och jun chi' t'a yib'anh heb' kreyente manh israelok?
Manh he k'ulej jun chi', yujto kojtak to yujnhej swach'k'olal Kajal Jesús tzonh kolchaji. Anhejtona', icha pax chi' heb' manh israelok chi', xchi winhaj Pedro chi'.

Ha ix yab'an juntzanh chi' heb', ix em numnaj heb' smasanil. Ixlajwi chi', ix smaklan yab' heb' tas syal winhaj Bernabé yet' winhaj Pablo. Ix yalan heb' winh to tzijtum milagro ix sb'o Dios, ayik ix ek' heb' winh t'a skal heb' manh israelok.
Ayic ix lajwi yalan juntzanh chi' heb' winh, ix yalan winhaj Jacobo icha tik: --Ex wuk'tak, ab'ek tas ol wal t'ayex.
Ix yal winhaj Simón Pedro t'ayonh tas ix aj yel yich sch'oxan swach'il Dios t'a heb' manh israelok. Ix sik'jielta jaywanh heb' yik wach' tz'och heb' yikok.
Ha jun ix uji tik, lajan icha tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj heb' schekab' Dios t'a peka', aton b'aj syal icha tik:

Ha t'a yik junxo tiempoal ol in jaxok. Ol ul wak'ankanpaxoch jun yinhtil winhaj rey Dawid sk'exulok t'a yopisio. Yujto icha junok pat ix em lanhnajok, icha chi' ajnakkan yopisio winh chi'. Palta ol in b'ok'e junelxo,
yik wach' a heb' manh israelok ol yak'och spensar heb' t'ayin, a in Yajal in, aton jantak heb' wik sik'b'iltaxonel wuuj t'a junjun nakión.
Icha chi' yutejnak Dios Kajal yalani. Ha ak'jinak kojtaquejel juntzanh tik yiktax t'a peka', xchi t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani.
Yuj chi' tzin na a in tik, max yal kak'anoch junok ikatz ajaltak t'a yib'anh heb' manh israelok wan yak'anoch spensar d'ha Dios.

Anhejokab' ko karta skak'b'at t'a heb', skalanb'ati to maxtzak schilaj heb' juntzanh tas tz'ak'ji silab'ok t'a komon Dios. Maxtzac sk'ulej ajmulal heb'. Maxtzac schi schiq'uil nok' nok' heb'. Maxtzac schi nok' nok' heb' sud'jichamok yujto ayto schiq'uil nok'.
Swal icha chi', yujto atax t'a peka' ay heb' tz'awtan ley Moisés t'a yoltak spatil kulto. Anhejtona' tiknaik, anheja' yalanel heb' t'a junjun sk'ual ik'oj ip, xchi winhaj Jacobo chi' t'a heb'.

Yuj chi', a heb' winh schekab' Jesús yet' heb' winh ankiano ix smol alej heb' winh yet' heb' kreyente smasanil. Ix snaan heb' to ol sik'el jaywanhok heb' kreyente heb', yik sb'at heb' t'a chonhab' Antioquía yuk'lewok winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Bernabé. Ixlajwi chi', ix sik'chajel winhaj Judas, skuchan pax Barsabás yet' winhaj Silas yuj heb'. Ha chawanh heb' winh chi', chequel yaj heb' winh t'a yichanh heb' kreyente.

Ix chekjib'at heb' winh yak' jun karta chi'. Axo t'a yol ch'anh karta chi', icha tik tas ix yal heb': Ha onh schekab' onh Jesús, heb' ankiano yet' heb' kreyente smasanil, tik skak'b'at stzatzil he k'ool a ex manh ex israelok t'a chonhab' Antioquía, t'a yol yik Siria yet' t'a Cilicia.

Ix kab'i to ay juntzanh heb' munil ix b'at t'a ko kal, ix k'och heb' t'ayex. Palta manhok onh ix ko chekb'at heb'. Ix kab'i to tzex ixtax yuj tas syal heb' t'ayex ta', to ijan somchajel he pensar yuj heb'.

Yuj chi' ix ko mol alej, ix ko sik'anel jaywanh heb' winh t'a ko kal tik, yik sb'at heb' winh t'ayex ta'. Junnhej ol b'at heb' winh yet' winh kuk'tak aj Bernabé yet' winh kuk'tak aj Pablo. Ha heb' winh tik, xajanab'il heb' winh kuuj.
Toxo ix yak'och sb'a heb' winh t'a yol sk'ab' yaelal yuj Kajal Jesucristo. Ay b'aj ijan ix miljicham heb' winh.
Axo winhaj Judas yet' winhaj Silas tik, aton heb' winh sko chekb'at t'ayex. Ol b'at yal heb' winh t'ayex t'a wal sjichanil, tas ix ko k'ulej t'a tik.
Sco na'a, to manh niwanok ko cheknab'il skalb'at t'ayex. Icha chi' sna pax Yespíritu Dios qued'ok. Yuj chi', a juntzanh cheknab'il skalb'at tik t'ayex, anhej wal yowalil tze k'anab'ajej ta':

Manh he chi nok' chib'ej tz'ak'jioch silab'ok t'a juntzanh komon Dios. Manh he chi schiq'uil nok' nok'. Manh he chi nok' nok' tonhej sud'jichamok. Manh he k'ulej ajmulal. Tato tze k'anab'ajej juntzanh tik, wach' ol eyutok he b'a. Anhej jay b'elanh tik skalb'at t'ayex.
Ha heb' winh ix chekjib'at chi', ix b'at heb' winh t'a chonhab' Antioquía. Ayic ix k'och heb' winh, ix smolb'ej heb' kreyente chi' heb' winh smasanil. Ix yak'an entregar ch'anh karta chi' heb' winh.
Ayic ix yawtan ch'anh heb' kreyente chi', ix te tzalaj heb', yujto ix ak'ji sniwanil sk'ool heb' yuj ch'anh.

Axo winhaj Judas yet' winhaj Silas chi', aton heb' winh yalumalel slolonel Dios, ix yak' sniwanil sk'ool heb' kreyente heb' winh. Tzijtum tas ix yal heb' winh t'a skal heb', ix yak'ankan stek'anil heb' kreyente chi' heb' winh.
Ixlajwi yek' jaye' k'ual heb' winh ta', ix stak'lankan sb'a heb' winh yet' heb' kreyente chi'. Junk'olal ix meltzaj heb' winh b'aj aykan heb' winh chekankot heb' winh chi'.

Anhejtona', winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Bernabé, ix kan heb' winh t'a jun chonhab' chi'. Ix sk'ayb'ej heb' kreyente heb' winh. Tzijtum pax heb' ix k'ayb'an heb' yet' heb' winh ta'. Ix yalanel slolonel Kajal Jesús heb' winh.

Axo ix ek'b'at jayexo semana, ix yalan winhaj Pablo t'a winhaj Bernabé chi': --Conh, b'at quil heb' kreyente t'a junjun chonhab' b'ajtak ek'nak onh kalel slolonel Kajal Jesús. B'at quilxi heb', tato anheja' tek'an heb', xchi winh.
Axo winhaj Bernabé chi', snib'ej winh syik'b'at winhaj Juan Marcos.
Palta ix sna winhaj Pablo chi' to manh smojok sb'at winh yet' heb' winh, yujto aktajkan heb' winh yuj winh junel t'a yol yik Panfilia. Maj yak' lajwok yopisio winh smunlaj yet' heb' winh.

Ix stelaj sb'a heb' winh yuj winh. Palta maj scha sb'a yalan heb' winh. Yuj chi' ch'okch'ok b'aj ix b'atkan heb' winh. Ha winhaj Bernabé chi' ix och winh t'a yol barko. Ix b'atkan winh t'a yol yik Chipre. Ix yik'anb'at winhaj Marcos chi' winh yet'ok.

Axo winhaj Pablo ix sik'anelta winhaj Silas t'a skal heb' kreyente, yik sb'at winh yet'ok. Axo heb' kreyente chi', ix sk'an swach'k'olal Dios heb' t'a yib'anh heb' winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at heb' winh.
Ix ek' heb' winh t'a yol yik Siria yet' t'a Cilicia. Ix ek' heb' winh yak' stek'anil heb' kreyente t'a junjun iglesia.

Ix k'och winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Silas chi' t'a chonhab' Derbe. Ix b'atxi heb' winh ta', ix k'och heb' winh t'a chonhab' Listra. Ata' ix yil-lajel sb'a heb' winh yet' jun winh kreyente skuch Timoteo. Ha jun winh chi', a jun ix kreyente israel ay yune' winh, haxo winh smam winh, griego winh.
Ha heb' kreyente t'a chonhab' Listra yet' t'a Iconio ix laj yal heb' smasanil to te' wach' sb'eyb'al winhaj Timoteo chi'.

Ix snaan winhaj Pablo chi' to ol yik'b'at winh yet'ok. Yuj chi' ix ak'ji kirkunkidar winh yuj winh, yik max kot yowal heb' israel t'a juntzanh lugar b'aj ol ek' heb' winh chi', yujto yojtak heb' to griego winh smam winh.

Axo t'a junjun chonhab' b'ajtak ix laj ek' heb' winh, ix yalanel heb' winh juntzanh cheknab'il alb'il yuj heb' winh schekab' Jesús yet' heb' winh ankiano ay t'a Jerusalén. Ix yalan winhaj Pablo chi' t'a heb' kreyente to yowalil sk'anab'ajej heb' tas syal juntzanh cheknab'il chi'.
Axo heb' kreyente t'a junjun chonhab' chi', ix stek'b'ej sb'a heb' t'a jun k'ayb'ub'al yak'nak och heb' t'a sk'ool chi'. Sq'uib' pax sb'isul heb' t'a junjun k'u.
Snib'ej heb' winh sb'at yalel slolonel Dios t'a yol yik Asia, palta haxo Yespíritu Dios maj chaanb'atlaj heb' winh. Yuj chi' ha t'a yol yik Frigia yet' t'a Galacia ix b'at heb' winh.
Ayic ix k'och heb' winh t'a sti' smojonal yol yik Misia, ix snaan heb' winh to ha t'a yol yik Bitinia sb'at heb' winh. Palta haxo Yespíritu Dios maj chaanb'atlaj heb' winh ta'.
Yuj chi' ix k'axpajek' heb' winh t'a sti' yol yik Misia chi'. Ix k'och heb' winh t'a chonhab' Troas, aton jun ay t'a sti' ha' mar.
Axo t'a jun ak'wal, icha t'a wayich ix aj yilan jun winh aj Macedonia winhaj Pablo chi', linhanek' winh ix yil winh. Ix tewioch winh t'a winh: “Cotanh t'a Macedonia. Colwajanh t'ayonh,” xchi winh.

Ixlajwi yilan jun chi' winhaj Pablo chi', ix kak'an lista ko b'a yik tzonh b'at t'a Macedonia chi'. Yujto ix kojtaquejeli to ha Dios ix ak'an kopisio kalanel wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il t'a heb' anima chi'.
Ichato chi', ix onh och t'a yol jun barko t'a chonhab' Troas chi'. Te d'inhannhej ix onh b'ati, ix onh k'och t'a yol yik Samotracia. Axo t'a junxo k'u ix onh k'och t'a jun chonhab' skuch Neápolis.

Ixlajwi chi', ix onh b'atxi, ix onh k'och t'a chonhab' Filipos. Ha jun chonhab' chi', haxo t'a yol yik Roma ay. Anhej te niwan yelk'och t'a yichanh juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a yol yik Macedonia chi'. Ata' ix onh ek' jaye' k'ual.

Axo t'a jun sk'ual ik'oj ip ix onh b'at t'a sti' jun ha' niwan ha' t'a stiel chonhab'. Ata' xid'taxon ek' anima lesal. Axo ix onh k'och ta', ix onh em k'ojan. Ix kalanel wach' ab'ix t'a juntzanh heb' ix ix toxonton smolb'ej sb'a ta'.

Ata' ay jun ix skuch Lidia, aj chonhab' Tiatira ix. Ha k'apak k'apak k'ik' mutz'inak te karo stojol schonh ix. Syak' wal och Dios ix t'a sk'ool. Ayic wan yab'an jun ab'ix chi' ix, haxo Kajal Jesús ix jakan spensar ix. Yuj chi' ix yak' wal och spensar ix t'a tas ix yal winhaj Pablo chi'.

Ix ak'ji bautizar ix yet' jantak heb' junnhej yaj yet' ix t'a yol spat. Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan ix t'ayonh: --Tato tzeyila' to yel swak'och Kajal Jesús t'a in k'ool, ol ex b'at wed' t'a in pat. Wach' tzex aj ta', xchi ix t'ayonh. Ix tewioch ix t'ayonh, yuj chi' ix onh aj ta'.

Axo junel, ayik wan ko b'at b'aj slesalwi heb' anima, ix k'och jun ix kob'es ix t'ayonh. Ayoch jun enemigo t'a ix. Yuj chi' naumel lolonel ix. Junelnhej ayoch ix chekab'ok t'a juntzanh winak. Ha juntzanh winak chi', syak' wal ganar tumin heb' winh t'a spatik ix, yujto syal ix tastak toto ol ujok.

Ix och tzak'an ix kuuj yet' winhaj Pablo chi'. Ix syamanoch ix yawaji, syalan ix: --Ha juntzanh heb' winh tik, schekab' ton wal Dios yaj heb' winh, aton jun Dios yelxo niwan yelk'ochi. Van yalan heb' winh t'ayex tas tz'aj he kolchaji, xchi ix.

Tzijtum el ix ek' ix qued'ok. Anhej wal jun chi' syal ix t'a juntak el. Axo winhaj Pablo chi', majxo techaj yuj winh yab'ani. Yuj chi' ix meltzajb'at k'elan winh t'a ix. Ix yalan winh t'a jun enemigo chi': --Swal t'ayach t'a sb'i Jesucristo, elanh t'a ix, xchi winh t'ay. D'a jun rato chi' ix el t'a ix.

Palta haxo ix yilan heb' winh b'aj chekab' yaj ix chi' to ix el jun enemigo chi' t'a ix, to maxtzak yal-laj yak'an ganar stumin heb' winh t'a spatik ix. Yuj chi' ix yik'b'at winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Silas chi' heb' winh t'a yichanh heb' winh yajal.
Ix k'och heb' winh t'a yichanh heb' winh juez. Ix yalan heb' winh b'aj chekab' yaj ix chi' icha tik: --Ha heb' winh israel tik, tonhej tzul yak' somchajel ko chonhab' tik heb' winh.
Van sk'ayb'an heb' anima heb' winh yet' juntzanh b'eyb'al ay yowalil yuj ley. Max yal ko k'ulan juntzanh chi' a onh tik yujto aj Roma onh, xchi heb' winh.

Axo heb' anima ayek' ta', ix te kot yowal heb' t'a winhaj Pablo yet' t'a winhaj Silas chi'. Axo heb' winh juez ix chekan ik'joquel spichul heb' winh schawanhil. Ixlajwi chi', ix schekan mak'jok heb' winh heb' winh t'a te' jixk'ab' te'.

Manh jantakok ix aj heb' winh yik'ani. Ixlajwi chi', ix yumjioch heb' winh t'a preso. Ix yalan heb' winh juez chi' t'a winh stanhwumal preso chi': --Tza tanhwej wal heb' winh sik'lab'il, xchi heb' winh t'a winh.
Ixlajwi yab'an jun chi' winh, ix b'at winh yak'kanoch heb' winh t'a jun kuarto t'a slajwub'xo k'ochi. Ix yak'anoch yok heb' winh t'a slod'il jun te' kepo.

Axo t'ak'walil, ix lesalwi winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Silas chi'. Ix sb'itan juntzanh b'it heb' winh d'ha Dios. Axo juntzanhxo heb' ayoch yet' heb' winh t'a preso chi', ix yab' heb' sb'itan heb' winh. Axo t'a chimilak'wal

ix ek' jun niwan quixkab', te ow ix yutej sb'a. Ix laj ib'xik'e yich preso chi'. Axo t'a jun rato chi', munil ix laj jakwi spuertail jun preso chi' smasanil. Axo k'een kadena ayoch t'a heb' preso chi', ix laj elta chokoljok k'een.

Axo ix el swayanh winh tanhwum preso chi', ix yilan winh to jakanxo jantaknhej spuertail preso chi'. Yuj chi' ix yik'k'eta k'een yespada winh t'a yol yatut yik smilancham sb'a winh snaani. Ha snaan winh to ix b'at heb' elelal smasanil.
Palta haxo winhaj Pablo chi' ix awajelta t'a winh: --Manh a milcham a b'a, ayonh ek' ko masanil, xchielta winh.
Yuj chi' ix sk'ankot sk'ak' winh. Ix och winh b'aj ay heb' chi'. Ix te ib'xik'e winh yuj xiwelal. Ix em kuman winh t'a yichanh winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Silas chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'anelta heb' winh chawanh chi' winh, ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh: --Ex mamin, ¿tas yowalil tzin k'ulej yik tzin kolchaji? xchi winh.
--Ak'och Kajal Jesucristo t'a a k'ool, yik wach' ol ach kolchaj yet' jantak heb' junnhej yaj ed' t'a yol a pat, xchi heb' winh t'a winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan slolonel Kajal Jesús heb' winh t'a winh yet' t'a jantak heb' ayek' t'a yol spat winh.

Anheja' t'a jun rato chi' ix b'ikjiel schiq'uil heb' winh b'aj ix lajwi smak'ji chi' yuj winh tanhwum preso chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an ak'jok bautizar sb'a winh yet' heb' junnhej yaj yet' winh t'a yol spat chi'.
Ichato chi' ix ak'jioch heb' winh yuj winh t'a yol spat. Ix ak'ji wa heb' winh yuj winh. Ix te tzalaj winh yet' heb' kajanek' yet' chi' yujto ix yak'och Dios heb' t'a sk'ool.
Axo t'a junxo q'uinhib'alil, ix chekjib'at juntzanh heb' winh polenkía yuj heb' winh juez. Ix b'at yalan heb' winh t'a winh tanhwum preso chi' to tz'el winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Silas chi' t'a libre.
Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a winhaj Pablo chi': --Ix in cha jun órden yuj heb' winh juez chi', tob' tzex wak'el t'a libre. Yuj chi' ixiquek. Paxanhec t'a tzalajk'olal, xchi winh t'a heb' winh.

Palta ix yalan winhaj Pablo chi' t'a heb' winh polenkía chi': --Ha onh tik, aj Roma onh. Maj sk'anb'ej yab' heb' winh tato ay ko mul. Palta ina ix onh smak' heb' winh t'a yichanh heb' chonhab'. Axo tiknaik, ¿tom snib'ej heb' winh t'a elk'altak tzonh yak'el t'a libre? Manh ol onh el-laj. Cotokab' heb' winh juez chi'. Ha wal lak'an heb' winh ol onh ik'anelok, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix b'at heb' winh yal t'a heb' winh juez chi'. Axo yik ix yab'an heb' winh to aj Roma heb' winh, ix te xiwk'e heb' winh.

Axo wal lak'an heb' winh ix b'at k'anan niwank'olal sb'ha t'a winhaj Pablo yet' t'a winhaj Silas chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix ik'jielta heb' winh yuj heb' winh t'a preso chi'. --Sco k'an pawor t'ayex, komonok tzex el t'a jun chonhab' tik, xchi heb' winh juez chi' t'a heb' winh.

Ixlajwi yelta heb' winh t'a preso chi', ix b'atxi heb' winh t'a spat ix Lidia. Ix sk'umlan sb'a heb' winh yet' heb' kreyente. Ix ak'jikan yip sk'ool heb' yuj heb' winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix b'atxi heb' winh.
Ix ek' winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Silas chi' t'a chonhab' Anfípolis yet' t'a chonhab' Apolonia. Ixlajwi chi', ix k'och heb' winh t'a chonhab' Tesalónica b'aj ay jun spatil kulto.
Axo winhaj Pablo chi' ix och winh yet' heb' ta' ichataxon smodo winh. Oxe' k'ual ik'oj ip ix yak' winh yak'lab'an Slolonel Dios yalan t'a heb' israel

chajtil to a Cristo yowalil ix yab' syail, ix miljichamok. Yowalil pax ix pitzwixi t'a skal heb' chamnak. Ix yalanpax winh t'a heb' icha tik: --Ha Jesús wan walan yab'ixal tik t'ayex, aton Cristo, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Ay jaywanh heb' israel ix ak'anoch Cristo t'a sk'ool. Yuj chi' ix och heb' yetb'eyumok winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Silas chi'. Tzijtum heb' griego ochnak t'a sk'ayb'ub'al heb' israel ix ak'anpaxoch t'a sk'ool. Tzijtum pax heb' ix ix ojtakab'il yuj heb' anima ix ak'anoch t'a sk'ool.

Palta haxo heb' israel maj ak'anochlaj t'a sk'ool, ayik ix yilan heb', ix te kot yowal heb'. Ix smolb'an juntzanh heb' chuk spensar heb'. Ha heb' chi', anhej chukal tzek' sayek' heb' t'a yol chonhab' chi'. Ixlajwi yak'ji sk'ool heb' yuj heb', ix ek' smolb'an heb' anima heb' smasanil. Ix k'e somnaj heb' anima chi' ste kot yowal. Ix yak'an yip heb' yekanoch sb'ha t'a yol spat jun winh skuch Jasón, yujto a snaan heb' to ata' ayek' winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Silas chi', yujto snib'ej heb' syik'elta heb' winh yik syak'anoch heb' winh heb' t'a yichanh heb' chonhab'.

Palta malaj heb' winh ayek' t'a yol pat chi'. Yuj chi', ix syam winhaj Jasón heb' yet' jaywanhxo heb' kreyente. Ix ik'jib'at heb' yuj heb' winh t'a heb' winh yajal. Axo ta' ix yal chaanh heb': --Ha winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Silas, tzek' heb' winh yak' somchajel heb' anima t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik. Axo tiknaik ix ja heb' winh t'ayonh.

Ha winhaj Jasón tik ix chaanoch heb' winh t'a yol spat. Ha heb' winh tik toxon max sk'anab'ajej sley winh kajal t'a Roma heb' winh, yujto syal heb' winh to ay junxo rey skuchan Jesús, xchi heb' t'a heb' winh yajal chi'.
Ayic ix yab'an jun chi' heb' winh yajal yet' heb' chonhab' chi', ix k'e somnaj heb' skot yowal.
Axo k'een tumin ix sk'an heb' yajal chi' t'a winhaj Jasón yet' t'a heb' ajun yet' winh chi'. Ichato chi', ix aktajel heb'.
Axo yik ix k'ik'b'i, ix chekjib'at winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Silas chi' yuj heb' kreyente t'a chonhab' Berea. Axo ix k'och heb' winh ta', ix och heb' winh t'a yol spatil kulto.

Ha heb' israel aj Berea chi' más wach' spensar heb' t'a yichanh heb' aj Tesalónica chi', yujto ix smaklej wal yab' slolonel Dios heb'. Axo t'a junjun k'u, sk'ayb'an heb' tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a Slolonel Dios yik syil heb' tato yel syal winhaj Pablo chi'.
Yuj chi' tzijtum heb' israel yet' heb' griego ix ak'anoch Cristo t'a sk'ool. Ha t'a skal heb' chi' ay heb' ix ix ojtakab'il yuj heb' anima yet' pax heb' winh winak.

Palta haxo heb' israel aj Tesalónica, ayik ix yab'an heb' to wan yalanel slolonel Dios winhaj Pablo t'a Berea chi', ix b'at heb' ta'. Ayic ix k'och heb', ix yak'k'e somnaj heb' chonhab' chi' heb' skot yowal.
Palta elanhchamel ix chekjib'at winhaj Pablo chi' t'a sti' ha' mar yuj heb' kreyente. Axo winhaj Silas yet' winhaj Timoteo ix kan heb' winh t'a chonhab' Berea chi'.

Ha heb' kreyente ix b'at yet' winhaj Pablo chi', ix b'atnhej heb' yet' winh masanto t'a chonhab' Atenas. Ayic ix k'och heb' ta' ix yalan winh t'a heb': --Tzeyal t'a winhaj Silas yet' t'a winhaj Timoteo to skot heb' winh t'a elanhchamel, xchi winh t'a heb'. Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzajxi heb'.

Ayic wan stanhwan winhaj Pablo sk'och winhaj Silas yet' winhaj Timoteo chi' t'a chonhab' Atenas, ix yilan winh, manh jantakok juntzanh tas syaloch heb' anima sdiosalok. Yuj chi' ix te kus winh yilani.

Ichato chi' ix och winh t'a yol spatil kulto. Ix stelan sb'a winh yet' heb' israel yet' heb' ochnak t'a sk'ayb'ub'al heb'. Axo t'a junjun k'u ix laj yalub'tanhej pax winh yet' heb' anima ayek' t'a merkado.

Ay juntzanh heb' winh winak te jelan sk'ayb'an sjelanil heb' skuch epikúreo yet' juntzanh heb' skuch estoiko. Ix och ijan heb' winh slolon yet' winhaj Pablo chi'. Axo nanhalxo heb' winh ix alub'tanhan icha tik: --Ha jun winh te jelan slolon tik, ¿tastaxlaj ol yal winh t'ayonh? xchi heb' winh. Axo juntzanhxo heb' winh ix alan icha tik: --Ha ko naani to tzul yal yab'ixal juntzanhxo ch'ok diosal winh, xchi heb' winh. Icha chi' ix aj yalan heb' winh yujto ix yalel yab'ixal Jesucristo winhaj Pablo chi'. Ix yalanpax winh to ol pitzwokxi heb' chamnak.

Axo heb' winh jelan chi' ix ik'anb'at winhaj Pablo chi' t'a jun yune' tzalan skuch Areópago, aton jun b'aj smolb'ejtaxon sb'a heb' winh yik syak'an slajti' heb' winh. Ayic ix k'och heb' winh ta' ix sk'anb'an heb' winh t'a winh: --Ha jun ak' k'ayb'ub'al tzalel tik, ¿tzam yal kab'an smasanil?
Yujto manta b'aj skab' juntzanh tik, yuj chi' ko gana skojtaquejeli tas syalelk'ochi, xchi heb' winh t'a winh.

Icha chi' ix aj yalan heb' yujto masanil heb' anima t'a Atenas chi' yet' pax heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' ta', ch'ok smodo heb'. Tato ay junok ak' k'ayb'ub'al tz'alji, snib'ej heb' syab' smasanil, syalan paxel heb' junelxo. Anhej ta' syak'och spensar heb'.
Axo winhaj Pablo chi', ix k'e linhan winh t'a skal heb' t'a Areópago chi', ix yalan winh: --Ex yajal t'a Atenas tik, ix wila'' to te ay wal och he pensar t'a juntzanh he diosal.

Yujto ayik ix in b'eyek' t'a yol he chonhab' tik, ix in ek' wil b'ajtak slaj eyak'em he b'ha t'a juntzanh he diosal chi'. Ix wilan pax jun sb'akhnub' silab' b'ajtil tz'ib'ab'ilkan och eyuj icha tik: Ha t'a tik skak'em ko b'ha t'a jun Dios manh ojtakab'ilok, xchi. Ha jun Dios chi', niwanok tzeyak'em he b'a t'ay, palta manh eyojtakok. Aton jun Dios chi' tzul wal yab'ixal t'ayex.

Ha jun Dios swal tik, a b'ojinak yol yib'anhk’inal tik yet' masanil tas ay t'ay. Aton yajal yaj t'a satcha’anh, yajal pax yaj t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik. Ha jun Dios chi', max kajnaj t'a junok pat b'ob'il yuj heb' anima.
Manh yowalilok ay tas tz'ak'ji t'ay yuj heb' anima. Yujto aton tz'ak'an ko k 'inal ko masanil. Ha tz'ak'an quik' quik', a tz'ak'anpax masanil tas ay t'ayonh.

Aton b'ojinak jun winh b'ab'el winak ochnak smam yichamok junjun nakión, yik aynhej anima t'a masanil sat lu'um tik. Ha tz'alani jantak tiempoal tzek' junjun nakión. Ha tz'alanpaxi b'ajtil sk'och k'aman smakb'en junjun.

Icha chi' syutej yik wach' tz'ilchaj yuj heb' anima. Wach'chom tonhej tzek' machmon heb' sayeq'ui yik tope wal tz'ilchaj yuj heb'. Palta swal t'ayex, manh najatok ayek' Dios chi'. Lak'an ayek' t'a ko tz'ey junjun onh.

Yel, yujnhej Dios chi' pitzan onh. Yuj ay ko k 'inal. Yuj ay onh ek' t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik. Ay juntzanh heb' eyetchonhab' jelan sloloni. Syalan heb' icha tik: Yuninal onh Dios ko masanil, xchi heb'.

Yel ton syal heb', yuninal onh Dios. Yuj chi' manhxo smojok sko na'a to Dios juntzanh yechel b'ob'il tik yet' k'een oro, k'een plata yet' juntzanhxo k'een k'een. Ha juntzanh yechel tik yujnhej sjelanil heb' anima sb'oi.
Ha t'a peka' manh yojtakok heb' anima chajtil yaj Dios. Yuj chi' niwan yutejnak sk'ool t'a heb'. Palta a tz'alan tiknaik to yowalil sna sb'a heb' anima smasanil t'a yol yib'anhk’inal tik.

Yujto yalnakkani to ay jun k'ual ol sch'olb'itej tas yaj heb' anima smasanil. Tojol ol yutok sch'olb'itan tas yaj heb', icha tas tz'el sk'ulan junjun heb'. Axo jun sik'b'ilkanel yuj, aton jun chi' ol ch'olb'itan tas yaj heb'. Ix sch'ox Dios t'a heb' anima smasanil to te yel jun tik ayik ix ik'jik'e waan jun sik'b'ilkanel yuj chi' t'a skal heb' chamnak, xchi winhaj Pablo chi' t'a heb'.
Palta ayik ix yab'an heb' to ol pitzwokxi heb' chamnak, ay heb' ix laj b'uchwaj t'a winh. Palta ay juntzanhxo heb' ix alani: --Olto ko k'anb'ejxi kab' juntzanh tik t'ayach, xchi heb' winh t'a winh.
Ixlajwi yalan juntzanh chi' heb', ix el winh t'a skal heb'.

Palta ay jaywanh heb' ix ak'anoch Cristo t'a sk'ool. Ix och heb' yetb'eyumok winhaj Pablo chi'. Ha t'a skal heb' chi', ata' ayek' winhaj Dionisio, winh yetyajalil sb'a yet' heb' smolb'ej sb'ha t'a Areópago chi'. Ay pax jun ix ix skuchan Dámaris yet' juntzanhxo heb'.
Ixlajwi slolon winhaj Pablo t'a Areópago chi', ix elxi winh t'a chonhab' Atenas chi', haxo t'a chonhab' Corinto ix k'och winh.

Ata' ay jun winh israel skuch Aquila. Ha t'a yol yik Ponto aljinak winh. Axo ix yetb'eyum winh, Priscila sb'i ix. Ek'nak winh t'a yol yik Italia yet' ix yetb'eyum chi', palta a winh yajal skuchan Claudio, a winh pechjinaquel jantak heb' israel ayek' t'a chonhab' Roma t'a yol yik Italia chi'. Yuj chi' ix elxi heb' ta', ix k'ochkan heb' t'a Corinto chi'. Axo winhaj Pablo ix k'och t'a spat heb'.
Ata' ix kan winh yet' heb' yujto lajan smunlajel winh yet' heb' schawanhil. Ha juntzanh mantiado sb'o heb', yuj chi' junnhej ix munlaj winh yet' heb' ta'.
Axo t'a junjun sk'ual ik'oj ip, sb'at winhaj Pablo chi' yalel yab'ixal Jesús t'a skal heb', syak'an winh yojtaquejel heb' israel yet' heb' manh israelok yik syak'och heb' t'a sk'ool.

Axo winhaj Silas yet' winhaj Timoteo, ix kotxi heb' winh t'a yol yik Macedonia. Ayic ix k'och heb' winh t'a Corinto chi', a winhaj Pablo, axonhej slolonel Dios ix yalel winh. Ix ste ak'an wal winh yojtaquejel heb' israel to a Jesús aton Cristo, jun tanhwab'iltaxon sja yuj heb'.

Palta tonhej ix kot yowal heb' t'a winh. Ix laj te b'uchwaj heb'. Yuj chi' ix stzikub'tanhej spichul winh yil heb', yik sch'oxanel winh to manhxalaj yalan yik winh t'a heb'. Ix yalankan winh t'a heb' icha tik: --Ha ex tik, munil tzeyik'kot eyaelal t'a eyib'anh t'a junelnhej. Ha in xo tik manhxa walan wik t'ayex. Ha tiknaik ol in b'at walel t'a heb' manh israelok, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix elta winh b'aj tz'och kulto chi', ix b'at winh t'a spat jun winh skuch Ticio Justo. Ha jun winh chi' syak' wal och Dios winh t'a sk'ool. Ha spat winh ha t'a stz'ey spatil kulto chi' ay.

Ay jun winh skuch Crispo kuchb'um yaj t'a kulto. Ix yak'och Kajal Jesús winh t'a sk'ool yet' jantak heb' junnhej yaj yet' winh t'a yol spat. Tzijtum heb' aj Corinto chi' ayik ix yab'an slolonel Dios heb', ix yak'och heb' t'a sk'ool, ix ak'jipax bautizar heb'.
Axo t'a jun ak'wal, icha wayich ix yutej Kajal Jesús yalan t'a winhaj Pablo chi': --Manh ach xiwok. Manh ach och waan alanel in lolonel,
yujto ay in ek' ed'ok. Malaj junok mach ol yal skot juknaj t'ayach, yujto tzijtum mach sik'b'iltaxonel wuuj t'a jun chonhab' tik, xchi t'a winh.
Yuj chi' nanhal schab'il ab'il ix aj winh t'a Corinto chi'. Ix sk'ayb'an heb' anima winh t'a slolonel Dios ta'.
Ayic ayoch winhaj Galión yajalil t'a yol yik Acaya, ix slajtiej sb'a heb' israel t'a spatik winhaj Pablo chi', ix syaman winh heb', ix yik'anb'at winh heb' t'a yichanh winh yajal.
Ix yalan heb' t'a winh yajal chi': --Ha jun winh tik tzek' ak'an sk'ool heb' anima, yik wach' niwanok syal sb'a heb' d'ha Dios, palta manh ichaok yaj ley, xchi heb'.

Vanxo wal yalan yik winhaj Pablo chi', palta ix yalan winhaj Galión chi' t'a heb' israel chi': --Manh ex awajochta t'ayin. Q'uinalok ay junok chukal sk'ulej winh tik, mato ay junok smul winh te chuk t'a yichanh ley, tato icha chi' tzam in cha wab' tas tzeyala'.

Palta ina tonhej he gana tzeyak' owal yuj juntzanh lolonel syal winh, yuj juntzanh mach tz'ak'an b'inaj winh yet' pax yuj he ley. Yuj chi' ixiquek, b'at b'oek yaj jun tik he ch'okoj. Xal in tik, max yal in k'ol tzin b'o juntzanh tik, xchi winh t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi yalan juntzanh chi' winh, ix spechanelta heb' winh t'a yol sdespacho chi'.

Axo winhaj Sóstenes ix syam heb', aton jun winh skuchb'an heb' t'a kulto. Ix smak'an winh heb' t'a sti' sdespacho winh yajal chi'. Palta tonhej ix och k'elan winh yajal chi', malaj jab'ok tas ix yal winh t'a heb'.

Axo winhaj Pablo chi', niwanto tiempo ix ek' winh t'a Corinto chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix yalankan quil ko b'a winh t'a heb' kreyente chi'. Ix b'at ix Priscila yet' winhaj Aquila yet' winh. Ix k'och heb' t'a chonhab' Cencrea. Axo ta' ix och heb' t'a yol jun barko wan sb'at t'a Siria. Ayic manto och heb' t'a yol barko chi', ix joxchajkanel winhaj Pablo chi' ta'. Ha jun chi' yechel yaji to ay jun sti' winh ix yak' d'ha Dios.
Axo ix k'och heb' t'a chonhab' Éfeso b'aj ix kan ix Priscila yet' winhaj Aquila chi', ix b'at winhaj Pablo chi' t'a spatil kulto. Axo ta' ix lolon winh yet' heb' yetisraelal.
Ix sk'an wal heb' t'a winh to skan jayeok k'ual winh yet' heb', palta maj yal-laj sk'ol winh.
Axo yik wan yalankan quil ko b'a winh t'a heb', ix yalan winh: --Tato ol el t'a sk'ol Dios, ol in ek' t'ayex junelxo, xchikan winh t'a heb'. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'atxi winh t'a yol te' barko.
Ix k'och winh t'a chonhab' Cesarea. Ixlajwi chi', ix elxi winh ta'. Ix k'e winh t'a Jerusalén b'at sk'umej heb' kreyente. Ixlajwi yek' winh ta', ix em winh t'a chonhab' Antioquía.

Ata' ix ek' jun pekti’ winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix b'atxi winh. Ix ek' winh t'a junjun chonhab' t'a yol yik Galacia yet' t'a yol yik Frigia. Ix laj ek' yak'kan stek'anil heb' kreyente winh b'aj ix laj eq'ui.

Axo t'a jun pekti’ chi', ay jun winh israel skuchan Apolos. Aj chonhab' Alejandría winh, ix k'och winh t'a chonhab' Éfeso. Te wach' ix yutej winh yalaneli, yujto yojtak wal slolonel Dios tz'ib'ab'ilkani.

k'ayb'ab'il winh t'a sk'ayb'ub'al Jesús. Ix yal wal el wach' ab'ix winh t'a smasanil sk'ool. Te wach' ix yutej winh yalanel yab'ixal Jesús chi', wach'chom anhejanto juntzanh sk'ayb'ub'al winhaj Juan, winh ak'annak bautizar yojtak winh.

Axo junel, ix b'at yalel slolonel Dios winh t'a yol spatil kulto. Te tek'an ix yutej sb'a winh yalaneli. Axo yik ix yab'an ix Priscila yet' winhaj Aquila, ix yik'anb'at winh heb' yet'ok. Ix swach' k'ayb'an winh heb' t'a sk'ayb'ub'al Dios.

Ixlajwi chi', ix el t'a sk'ool winhaj Apolos chi' sb'at t'a yol yik Acaya. Yuj chi', haxo heb' kreyente ix kolwaj yet' winh. Ix stz'ib'an jun karta heb', yik syik'b'at winh t'a heb' kreyente, yik wach' schaji winh yuj heb' sk'ochi. Ayic ix k'och winh ta', a heb' yak'nakoch Jesús t'a sk'ool yuj swach'k'olal Dios, ix te kuchb'aj heb' yuj winh.

Ix yak' wal yip winh sch'oxaneli to yelk'olal satnak sk'ool heb' israel. Ha slolonel Dios tz'ib'ab'ilkani, ha' ix yak'lab'ej winh yalan t'a heb' anima yik wach' snachajel yuj heb' to a Jesús aton Cristo, jun tanhwab'iltaxon sja yuj heb'.

Ayic ayek' winhaj Apolos t'a Corinto, ix ek' winhaj Pablo t'a juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a tzalquixtak. Ixlajwi chi', ix k'och winh t'a chonhab' Éfeso. Ata' ix yil-lajel sb'a winh yet' juntzanh heb' kreyente.
Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb': --¿Ix am he cha Yespíritu Dios ayik ix eyak'anoch Cristo t'a he k'ool? xchi winh t'a heb'. --Maay, manta b'aj ix kab'i tato ay Yespíritu Dios chi', xchi heb'.
--Palta ayik ix ex ak'ji bautizar, ¿tas yaj jun bautismo ix he cha chi'? xchi winh t'a heb'. --Aton jun bautismo yik winhaj Juan ix ko cha'a, xchi heb' t'a winh.

Yuj chi', ix yalxi winh t'a heb': --Ha sbautismo winhaj Juan chi', ha' sch'oxaneli to sna sb'a heb' anima t'a smul. Palta yalnak winh t'a heb' to ay jun tzak'anto sja yuj winh. Yowalil ha t'a jun chi' syak'och spensar heb'. Ha jun ix yal winh chi', a Jesús, xchi winhaj Pablo chi' t'a heb'.
Ayic ix yab'an juntzanh chi' heb', ix ak'ji bautizar heb' t'a sb'i Kajal Jesús.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'anek' sk'ab' winhaj Pablo chi' t'a sjolom junjun heb'. Ichato chi' ix ochkan Yespíritu Dios t'a heb'. Ix lolon heb' t'a juntzanh ch'okch'ok ti'al, ix yalanel juntzanh lolonel ix ak'ji yal heb' yuj Dios.
Ha heb' ix ak'anoch t'a sk'ool chi', ay am lajchawanhok heb'.

Oxe' ujal xid' yalel slolonel Dios winhaj Pablo chi' t'a yol spatil kulto t'a chonhab' Éfeso chi'. Malaj junok mach b'aj ix xiw winh yalanel t'a heb' ayek' chi' ta'. Ix yak'lej winh yak'an nachajel yuj heb' sik'lab'il tas tz'aj yoch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' Dios.

Palta ay juntzanh heb' te pit t'a skal heb' chi'. Junelnhej malaj snib'ej heb' syak'och t'a sk'ool. Ix laj ek' heb' yal t'a heb' anima to chuk jun k'ayb'ub'al yik heb' kreyente chi'. Yuj chi' ix yik'el sb'a winhaj Pablo chi' t'a skal heb'. Ix yik'anb'at heb' kreyente chi' winh t'a jun eskuela yik jun winh skuch Tirano. Axo ta' ix yalel slolonel Dios winh t'a skal heb' t'a junjun k'u.
Chab' ab'il ix sk'ulej heb' icha chi'. Yuj chi', ix laj yab' yab'ixal Kajal Jesús masanil heb' israel yet' heb' manh israelok ay t'a yol yik Asia chi'.
Axo Dios ix och yet' winhaj Pablo chi', yik sb'oan juntzanh milagro winh te satub'tak.

Ay heb' ix ik'ankot spayu' yet' spichul, ix sukanek' heb' t'a sniwanil winh, slajwi chi' haxo t'a sniwanil heb' penaay sb'at suquek' heb'. Icha chi' tz'aj sb'oxikan sk'ool heb'. Ay pax heb' winh enemigo ix el t'a heb' anima chi' yuj winh.

Palta ay jaywanh heb' israel skomon b'eyeq'ui. Ix yak'lej heb' yik'anel heb' enemigo t'a heb' anima. Ix yak'lej heb' yik'anel heb' t'a sb'i Kajal Jesús. Yuj chi' ix skomon alej heb' t'a heb' enemigo chi': --Ha t'a sb'i Jesús, skal t'ayex, elanhek. Ha Jesús chi', aton jun tzek' yalel yab'ixal winhaj Pablo, xchi heb'.
Sk'ulej pax jun tik ukwanh heb' yuninal jun winh israel skuch Escewa winh sat sakerdote. Ix yak'lej heb' yik'anel jun enemigo.
Axo ix tak'wi jun enemigo chi' t'a heb': --Vojtak Jesús chi'. Toxo ix wab'paxi mach jun winh tzeyal Pabloal chi'. Palta a exxo tik, ¿mach ex? xchi.

Axo winh b'aj ayoch jun enemigo chi', ix kot juknaj winh t'a heb'. Ix ak'ji ganar heb' smasanil yuj winh. Te ya' ix ek' heb' yuj winh. Tzijtum b'aj ix lajwi heb'. Ix quichjiel sk'apak heb' yuj winh, yuj chi' b'eranel heb' ix elta lemnaj heb' t'a jun pat chi'.
Axo heb' aj Éfeso chi' smasanil, heb' israel yet' heb' manh israelok, ix laj yab' spekal jun chi' heb'. Yuj chi' ix te xiw heb' smasanil. Ix yalan wach' lolonel heb' t'a Kajal Jesús.
Anhejtona', tzijtum heb' ayoch Cristo t'a sk'ool ix laj k'ochi. Ix yalank'eta jantaknhej juntzanh chukal ix laj sk'ulej heb'.

Te tzijtum heb' yak'nakoch sb'a ajb'aalil ix och kreyenteal. Ix yik'kot juntzanh yumal b'aj sk'ayb'ej jun ajb'aalil chi' heb'. Ix snhusantz'a juntzanh chi' heb' t'a yichanh heb' anima smasanil. Ayic ix sb'isan stojol juntzanh ch'anh uum chi' heb', ix elk'och am t'a junok 50,000 drakma.
Ix te pukaxel slolonel Dios, tzijtum pax heb' anima ix ak'anoch t'a sk'ool. Icha chi' ix aj scheklajeli to te niwan spoder slolonel chi'.

Ixlajwi juntzanh chi', ix snaan winhaj Pablo chi' to tzek' winh t'a yol yik Macedonia yet' t'a yol yik Acaya, haxo sk'och winh chi' t'a Jerusalén. Ix yalan winh: --Ol lajwok chi', yowalil ol in k'och t'a Roma, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix schek b'ab'laj chawanh heb' schekab' winh t'a Macedonia chi', aton winhaj Timoteo yet' winhaj Erasto. Palta haxo winhaj Pablo chi', najtiltakto ix kan winh t'a yol yik Asia chi'.
Axo t'a jun pekti’ chi', ix te k'e nhilnaj heb' anima skot yowal yuj sk'ayb'ub'al Kajal Jesús.

Ay jun winh b'oum plata skuch Demetrio. Ha juntzanh yechel stemplo jun sdiosal heb' skuchan Diana sb'o winh. Ix jun sdiosal heb' chi'. Ha heb' sb'oan juntzanh yechel chi', niwan tumin syak' ganar heb' t'a spatik.

Ha winh ix molb'an jantaknhej heb' sb'oan juntzanh yechel chi' yet' juntzanhxo heb' lajan yopisio yet' winh. Ix yalan winh t'a heb': --Ex wetmunlajwumal, eyojtak jantak ko tumin skak' ganar t'a jun kopisio tik.

Palta ina tzeyila', tzeyab'anpaxi, tas wan sk'ulan winhaj Pablo. Syalan winh to a juntzanh Dios b'ob'il yuj anima, manh diosok. Tzijtum anima ix yak' sk'ool winh. Manhoknhej t'a chonhab' Éfeso tik, palta quenxonhej maj ak'jok sk'ool masanil heb' ay t'a yol yik Asia tik yuj winh.

Te ay smay jun tik. Tekan manhxo ol b'atlaj ko chonh yuj. Axo pax ko diosal Diana, tekan manhxalaj ol elk'och stemplo t'a yichanh heb' anima. Ha jun ko diosal tik, te niwan yelk'och t'a yichanh heb' anima smasanil t'a Asia tik yet' t'a smasanil yol yib'anhk’inal. Palta haxo tiknaik ay smay, tekan ol lajwoquel yopisio t'a yichanh heb', xchi winh.
Axo ix yab'an juntzanh chi' heb', ix te kot yowal heb', ix awaj chaanh heb': --Te niwan yelk'och ix ko diosal Diana a onh aj Éfeso onh tik, xchi heb'.

Axo heb' chonhab' chi' smasanil, ix te k'e somnaj heb' skot yowal. Ix syaman winhaj Gayo heb' yet' winhaj Aristarco. Ha chawanh heb' winh chi', aj Macedonia heb' winh, ajun heb' winh ix k'och yet' winhaj Pablo t'a Éfeso chi'. Ix ik'jib'at heb' winh schawanhil t'a jun lugar b'aj smolb'ej sb'a heb' anima.
Axo winhaj Pablo chi', snib'ej winh sb'at yal t'a heb' anima chi', palta maj chajib'atlaj winh yuj heb' kreyente.
Ay pax jaywanh heb' winh yajal yaj t'a Asia chi' wach' yak'an yet' winhaj Pablo chi'. Ix schekan aljok heb' winh t'a winh to max b'at sch'ox sb'a winh t'a heb' anima chi'.
Axo heb' anima ix smolb'ej sb'a chi', ch'okch'ok ix laj yalk'e junjun heb', yujto tonhej ix laj k'e somnaj heb' yalani. Ek'to nanhal heb' manh ojtannakok tas yuj smolb'ej sb'a heb'.

Palta ay jun winh skuch Alejandro, a winh ix ik'jib'at t'a yichanh heb' anima chi' yuj heb' yetisraelal. Ix alchaj t'a winh tas yuj molanek' heb' anima chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'anchaanh sk'ab' winh t'a heb', yik wach' numan tz'aj heb', yujto snib'ej winh skol sb'a yet' heb' yetisraelal.

Palta ayik ix yilan heb' anima chi' to israel winh, yuj chi' ix te wach' k'e yaw heb' smasanil. Ay am chab'ok hora ix awajk'e heb', ix yalan heb' icha tik: --Te niwan yelk'och ix ko diosal Diana a onh aj Éfeso onh tik, xchi heb'.

Axo winh sekretarioal chonhab' chi', k'ojank'olal ix smontej heb' winh yik wach' numan tz'aj heb'. Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb': --Ex wetchonhab', masanil anima ojtannak to a onh aj Éfeso onh tik ay kopisio ko tanhwan jun stemplo ko diosal Diana niwan yelk'ochi yet' jun yechel ix kotnak t'a satcha’anh.
Malaj junok mach syal yalani to es juntzanh swal tik. Yuj chi' numan tzex aji. Naec wal sik'lab'il, yik wach' malaj junok tas tze komon k'ulej.
Yujto a heb' ix eyik'kot tik, malaj junok chukal ix sk'ulej heb' t'a spatik ko diosal. Max b'uchwaj pax heb' t'a ix.

Ha winhaj Demetrio yet' heb' yetb'eyum, tato snib'ej heb' syak'och t'a yib'anh junok mach, syal sb'at heb' t'a juzgado, b'at yalan heb' t'a winh juez. Syal b'at yalan sb'a heb' t'a heb' winh yajal chi'.
Tato ay junokxo tas he gana, syal tze k'umlaj he b'a yet' heb' winh yajal chi', tze b'oan yaj ta'.

Yujto te ay smay jun tas sko k'ulej tik, syal snaan heb' winh yajal to a yet' heb' winh wan kak'an owal. Tato sk'anb'ej heb' t'ayonh: ¿Tas yuj ix ex k'e b'ulnaj eyak'an owal? tato xchi heb' winh, max yal-laj ko kolan ko b'a kalan junok tas t'a heb' winh, xchi winh t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi yalan juntzanh chi' winh sekretario chi', ix schekan pax heb' anima chi' winh smasanil t'a spat.

Ayic toxo ix lajwi jun owal chi', ix smolb'an heb' kreyente winhaj Pablo. Ix ak'jikan stek'anil heb' yuj winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix yalankan quil ko b'a winh t'a heb', ix b'atxi winh t'a yol yik Macedonia.
Ayic ix k'och winh ta', ix laj ek' winh yil heb' kreyente t'a junjun chonhab'. Ix ek' yak'an stek'anil heb' winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winh t'a yol yik Grecia.

Ata' ix ek' oxe' ujal winh. Ixlajwi chi', ayik toxo wan yoch winh t'a yol te' barko yik sb'at winh t'a Siria, ix yab'an winh to ay tas sna heb' israel t'a spatik winh. Yuj chi', ix snaan winh: Más wach' tzin meltzajxiek' t'a Macedonia, xchi winh.

Axo ix b'at winh, ay juntzanhxo heb' kreyente ix b'at yet' winh. Ix b'at winhaj Sópater yuninal winhaj Pirro aj Berea yet' winh, winhaj Aristarco, winhaj Segundo aj Tesalónica, winhaj Gayo aj Derbe yet' pax winhaj Timoteo. Ay pax chawanh heb' winh aj Asia ix b'at yet' winh, aton winhaj Tíquico yet' winhaj Trófimo.
Ayic ix k'och heb' winh t'a chonhab' Filipos b'aj ayin eq'ui, ix yaktejkan winhaj Pablo chi' heb' winh wed' ta'. Ix b'ab'laj b'at heb' winh t'a chonhab' Troas. Axo ta' ix onh stanhwej heb' winh.

Ha onhxo tik, ha t'a chonhab' Filipos chi' ix ko tanhwej quil jun q'uinh b'aj swaji ixim pan malaj yich. Ixlajwi yek' jun q'uinh chi', ix onh b'at t'a yol barko. Oye' k'ual ix onh b'ey t'a sat ha ha'. Ichato chi' ix onh k'och t'a chonhab' Troas chi'. Axo ta' ix quil-laj ko b'a yet' heb' winh ix b'ab'laj kuuj chi'. Uque' k'ual ix onh ek' ta'.

Axo t'a domingo ix ko molb'ej ko b'a yet' heb' kreyente smasanil yik sko waan ixim pan yik Santa Cena. Axo winhaj Pablo ix k'ayb'an heb' quetkreyenteal. Yujto k'ik'anokxonhej sb'at winh, yuj chi' tzijtum tas ix yalkan winh t'a heb', masanto ix och chimilak'wal.
Ha t'a jun kuarto chaanh yajk'ei, ata' molan onh eq'ui. Tzijtum kandil ayoch sk'ak'al.

Ay jun winh quelem skuchan Eutico k'ojanem t'a sti' wentena. Toxonhej sneknekan winh swayi, yujto junip ix yak' winhaj Pablo chi' sloloni. Yuj chi' ix te kot swayanh winh, ix elta pichnaj winh t'a sti' jun wentena chi'. Ato t'a yoxil piso ix elta sutnaj winh. Axo ix emul heb' kreyente chi', ix schelan chaanh winh heb', palta chamnakxo winh.
Axo ix emul winhaj Pablo chi', ix em lachan winh t'a yib'anh winh. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' kreyente chi': --Manh ex och ilk'olal. Ix pitzwixi winh, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix k'ex winhaj Pablo chi' t'a yol kuarto chi' junelxo. Ix spukanb'at ixim pan yik Santa Cena winh t'a ko kal. Ix ko waani. Tzijtumto tas ix yal winhaj Pablo chi', masanto ayik wan sakb'i. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winh.
Axo winh quelem ix pitzwixi chi', ix yik'anb'at winh heb' t'a spat. Ix te tzalaj heb', yujto ix pitzwixi winh.
Ha onh tik, ix onh b'ab'laj och t'a yol jun barko, ix onh b'at t'a chonhab' Asón. Ata' ix ko tanhwej sk'och winhaj Pablo chi' icha ix kutej kalan yet' winh, yujto t'a yok winh ix b'ati.
Axo ix k'och winh t'ayonh, ix och winh t'a yol barko qued'ok. Ixlajwi chi, ix onh b'at yet' winh t'a chonhab' Mitilene.

Ix onh elxi ta', haxo t'a yichanhkot chonhab' Quío ix onh wanaj jun k'ual. Axo t'a junxo k'u, ix onh k'och t'a jun chonhab' skuch Samos ay t'a sti' ha' mar chi'. Ha t'a junxo k'u ix onh b'atxi, haxo t'a chonhab' Mileto ix onh k'ochi.

Icha chi' ix aj ko b'ati, yujto maj yal sk'ol winhaj Pablo chi' ix onh ek' t'a chonhab' Éfeso, yujto snib'ej winh elanhchamel tzonh ek' t'a Asia chi', yik talaj k'okb'ilto tzonh k'och quil jun q'uinh Pentecostés t'a Jerusalén.
Ayic ix onh k'och t'a chonhab' Mileto, ix yak'anb'at schekab' winhaj Pablo chi' t'a heb' winh ankiano aj Éfeso, yik b'at ik'jokkot heb' winh.
Axo ix ja heb' winh, ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh: --Ha ex tik, eyojtaktaxon in b'eyb'al yiktax ix in ulek' sb'ab'elal t'a Asia tik.
Masanil tiempo ix wak' serwil Kajal Jesús t'a emnaquilal. Ay b'aj te ok'nak in yuj spital heb' anima. Tzijtum el ix in ak'ji prowal yuj juntzanh chukal ix yak'och heb' wetisraelal t'a wib'anh.
Palta eyojtak, maj in och waan walan masanil juntzanh k'ayb'ub'al wach' t'ayex, yik tze tek'b'ej he b'a. Ix walel slolonel Dios t'ayex t'a yichanh heb' chonhab' yet' pax t'a yol he pat.
Ix walanpaxel t'a heb' israel yet' t'a heb' manh israelok, to yowalil sna sb'a heb' t'a yichanh Dios, syak'anoch Kajal Jesucristo heb' t'a sk'ool.
Axo tiknaik, wan in b'at t'a Jerusalén, yujto a Yespíritu Dios tzin ik'anb'ati. Manh wojtakok tas ol jawok t'a wib'anh ta'.
Palta wojtak to tzijtum yaelal ol ak'jokoch t'a wib'anh. Ol in och t'a preso, yujto icha chi' syal Yespíritu Dios t'ayin t'a junjun chonhab' b'aj in eq'ui.

Palta a juntzanh chi', malaj tas tzin na yuj. Wach'chom ol in smilcham heb', palta b'alaj malaj yelk'och jun chi' t'ayin. Anhej jun tzin na'a to swak'kan lajwok jun in munlajel ayoch tik t'a wib'anh t'a tzalajk'olal, yik slajwi wopisio yak'nak Kajal Jesús t'ayin, yik swalanel wach' ab'ix to niwan swach'k'olal Dios t'a heb' anima.
Ek'nak in wal t'ayex chajtil tz'aj he yoch t'a yol sk'ab' Dios. Axo tiknaik wojtak to manhxa b'ak'uinh ol quil ko b'ha t'a tik.
Yuj chi', ha t'a jun k'u tik, manhxalaj walan wik t'ayex,
yujto ix walkanel masanil juntzanh sk'ayb'ub'al Dios t'ayex, malaj jab'ok ix in k'ub'ejeli.
Yuj chi', tzeyil wal he b'a. Tzeyilanpax heb' kreyente smasanil, yujto ak'b'il eyopisio yuj Yespíritu Dios eyilan heb' manb'ilxo yuj schiq'uil Kajal Jesús ayik ix cham kuuj.
Yujto wojtak, ayik toxo ix in pax t'a he kal, ay juntzanh heb' ol ja t'ayex, ol yak'lan heb' ex yixtani, icha syutej nok' oques yik'anelta nok' kalnel.
D'a he kal paxi, ay juntzanhxo heb' ol k'e waan. Ol yesan heb', ol yak'an sk'ool heb' kreyente heb' yik tz'och heb' yet' heb'.
Yuj chi' tzeyil wal he b'a. Naeccoti to ayik ix ex in k'ayb'an junjunex t'a oxe' ab'il tik, t'a k'ual t'ak'wal ix ex in k'ayb'ej, ay pax b'aj ix in ok' eyuuj.

Xal tiknaik, ex wuk'tak, tzex wak'kanoch t'a yol sk'ab' Dios, yik ha' ol ex tanhwan yet' slolonel. Yuj slolonel chi' syak' swach'k'olal t'ayonh, yuj pax to ay spoder yak'an ko tek'anil. Yuj chi' ol yak' jun tas altab'il yuj t'ayex, yujto ay eyalan eyik yet' juntzanh heb' sik'b'ilxoel yuj.
Ha in tik, malaj b'aj ix wiloch in k'ool t'a stumin, ma t'a spichul junok mach.
Ina eyojtak, munil ix in munlaj wal yet' in k'ab' yuj tas ay ix och wuuj yet' yuj tas ay ix och yuj heb' ajun wed'ok.

Masanil tiempo ix in ch'ox t'ayex to yowalil icha chi' skutej ko b'oan ko munlajel, yik syal ko kolwaj t'a heb' ay tas ay tz'och yuj. Yowalil sko nakot slolonel Kajal Jesús, ayik ix yalankan icha tik: Ha heb' tz'ak'an junok tas, ek'alxo wal wach' yik heb' t'a yichanh heb' schaani, xchi Kajal Jesús chi', xchi winh t'a heb' winh ankiano chi'.
Ixlajwi yalan juntzanh chi' winhaj Pablo chi', ix em kuman winh. Ix lesalwi winh yet' heb' smasanil.
Ixlajwi slesalwi heb', ix och ijan heb' yok' smasanil. Junjunal ix och lak'naj heb' t'a winhaj Pablo chi', ix stz'ub'ankanelta sti' winh heb'.
Ix te kus heb' yujto ix yal winh t'a heb' to manhxa b'ak'uinh ol yil-lajxi sb'a heb'. Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at yak'ankan winh heb' t'a yol barko chi'.

Ix kaktejkan heb' kreyente chi', ix onh och t'a yol barko. D'inhannhej ix onh b'ati, ix onh k'och t'a chonhab' Cos. Axo t'a junxo k'u, ix onh b'atxi, ix onh k'och t'a chonhab' Rodas. Ixlajwi chi' ix onh b'atxi, ix onh k'och t'a chonhab' Pátara.
Ata' ayek' jun barko wan sb'at t'a yol yik Fenicia. Ix onh och t'a yool, ix onh b'atxi.

Ayic wanxo ko b'eyi, ix quilankanb'at jun lu'um skuch Chipre ay t'a snanhal ha' mar. Ha t'a ko k'exanh ix kani. Ixlajwi chi', ix onh k'och t'a chonhab' Tiro t'a yol yik Siria, yujto ata' ix kan yikatz te' barko chi'.

Axo ix onh elta t'a yol te', ay heb' kreyente ix ilchajel kuuj. Ix onh aj yet' heb' uque' k'ual ta'. Ha heb' chi' ix alan icha tik t'a winhaj Pablo chi': --Oc wal max ach b'at t'a Jerusalén, xchi heb'. Icha chi' ix aj yalan heb', yujto a Yespíritu Dios ix ak'an yojtaquejel heb' tas ol ja t'a yib'anh winh ta'.

Axo yik ix ek'b'at uque' k'ual chi', ix onh b'atxi. Axo heb' winh kuk'tak chi' smasanil yet' heb' ix yetb'eyum heb' winh yet' pax heb' yuninal heb' winh, ix xid'ek' heb' onh yak'kanel t'a stiel chonhab' chi'. Axo ta' ix onh em kuman t'a sti' ha' mar, ix onh lesalwi.
Ixlajwi chi', ix kalankan quil ko b'ha t'a heb'. Ix onh ochxikan t'a yol barko chi'. Ix laj paxixkan heb' t'a spat.
Ayic ix onh elxi t'a chonhab' Tiro chi', ix onh k'och t'a chonhab' Tolemaida. Ata' ix kaktejkan te' barko chi'. Ix onh lolon yet' heb' kreyente ta'. Jun k'ual ix onh ek' yet' heb'.

Axo t'a junxo k'u ix onh b'atxi, ix onh k'och t'a chonhab' Cesarea. Ha t'a spat winhaj Felipe, winh tz'alanel wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il, ata' ix onh wanaji. Ha jun winh chi', aton winh sik'b'iloch diákonoal t'a Jerusalén yet' wakwanhxo heb' winh.
Ay chanhwanh yisil winhaj Felipe chi', mantalaj yetb'eyum heb' ix. Syalel slolonel Dios heb' ix.
Ayic ix onh ek' jaye' k'ual ta', ix k'och jun winh tz'alanel slolonel Dios skuchan Agabo t'ayonh, ha t'a yol yik Judea kot winh.

Ix xid'ek' winh onh sk'umej. Ayic wan ko lolon yet' winh, ix yik'anel stzek'ul winhaj Pablo chi' winh. Ix tzek'an k'otan sb'a winh yet'ok. Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh: --Ha Yespíritu Dios tz'alani to icha ix wutej in tzek'an in b'a tik, icha chi' ol aj stzek'chaj winh ay yik jun tzek'ul tik yuj heb' israel t'a Jerusalén. Ol lajwok chi', ol yak'anoch winh heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' manh israelok, xchi winh.
Ha onhxo tik yet' heb' aj Cesarea chi', ayik ix kab'an tas ix yal winh chi', ix onh tewioch t'a winhaj Pablo chi', yujto ko gana max b'atlaj winh t'a Jerusalén chi'.

Palta ix yal winh t'ayonh: --¿Tas yuj tzex oq'ui? ¿Tas yuj tzeyak'och in kusk'olal? Malaj yelk'ochi tato tzin stzek' heb'. Wach'chom tzin smilcham heb' t'a Jerusalén chi' yujnhej walanel yab'ixal Kajal Jesús, ol in b'eknhej in b'ha t'a yol sk'ab' heb', xchi winh.
Junelnhej maj kak'laj ganar winh ko kachanoch waan. Yuj chi' ix kaktej ko tewi t'a winh. Tonhej ix kal icha tik: --Ha tas snib'ej Kajal Jesús, ujokab'i, xko chi.
Ixlajwi chi' ix kak'an lista ko b'a, ix onh b'at t'a Jerusalén chi'.
Ay pax jaywanh heb' kreyente aj Cesarea chi' ix b'at qued'ok, ix onh yik'anb'at heb' t'a spat jun winh b'ab'el kreyente aj Chipre skuch Mnasón, yujto ha t'a spat winh chi' ix onh kani.
Ayic ix onh k'och t'a Jerusalén chi', tzalajk'olal ix onh scha heb' kreyente ta'.
Axo t'a junxo k'u ix onh b'at yet' winhaj Pablo chi' t'a spat winhaj Jacobo. Ayek' pax heb' winh ankiano ta' smasanil.
Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'ej sk'ol heb' winh winhaj Pablo chi'. Ix laj yal winh t'a heb' yuj jantak tas ix sk'ulej Dios yet'ok t'a skal heb' manh israelok.

Axo ix yab'an juntzanh chi' heb' winh, ix yal wach' lolonel heb' winh d'ha Dios. Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan heb' winh t'a winhaj Pablo chi': --Te wach' wuk'tak, palta ojtak, tzijtum heb' quetisraelal ix ak'anoch Cristo t'a sk'ool. Axo slaj yalan heb' smasanil to yowalil sko k'anab'ajej ley Moisés.

Ix yab' spekal heb' to tzach ek' a k'ayb'ej heb' israel ay t'a skal masanil heb' manh israelok. Tob' ix al t'a heb' israel chi' to maxtzak sk'anab'ajej ley Moisés heb'. Tob' ix al t'a heb' to maxtzak yak' kirkunkidar heb' yuninal heb', maxtzak sk'anab'ajej ko b'eyb'al heb' a onh israel onh tik.
¿Tas ol kutok? Ha tiknaik ol yab' heb' to ix ach jawi.
Yuj chi', wach' icha tik tzutej a b'a. Ay chanhwanh heb' winh t'a ko kal tik, yak'nakxo sti' heb' winh d'ha Dios. Vanxo sk'och stiempoal b'aj yak'nakkan sti' heb' winh chi'.

Ik'b'at heb' winh ed'ok. Tza b'oankan a b'a yet' heb' winh icha syal ley Moisés. Tzak' stumin heb' winh yik smanan juntzanh nok' nok' heb' winh silab'ok. Ol lajwok chi', ol yak'an joxchajel sb'a heb' winh schanhwanhil. Tato icha chi' ol utok a b'a, ol yil heb' anima smasanil to a jun a pekal ix yab' heb' chi', to es. Axo ol yilan heb' to tza k'anab'ajej pax tas syal ley Moisés.

Axo heb' manh israelok ix ak'anoch Cristo t'a sk'ool, tz'ib'ab'ilxob'at ko karta t'a heb' to manh yowalilok sk'anab'ajej juntzanh tik heb'. Anhej juntzanh cheknab'il tik ix kalb'at t'a heb': To max schi nok' chib'ej heb' tz'ak'ji silab'il t'a juntzanh komon Dios. Max schi schiq'uil junok nok' nok' heb'. Max schi nok' nok' heb' sud'jichamok. Max em heb' t'a ajmulal. Icha chi' ix kutej kalanb'at t'a heb', xchi heb' ankiano chi' t'a winhaj Pablo chi'.

Axo winhaj Pablo chi' ix ik'anb'at heb' winh chi' schanhwanhil. Axo t'a junxo k'u ix sb'o sb'a winh yet' heb' winh icha syal ley Moisés. Ixlajwi chi' ix och winh t'a yol yamaq'uil stemplo Dios yik syalan winh t'a winh sakerdote tas k'ual ol lajwokk'och stiempoal sb'oan sb'a heb' winh, yik syak'an silab' heb' winh d'ha Dios.

Axo yik wanxo slajwi uque' k'ual chi', ay jaywanh heb' israel aj Asia, ayik ix yilan heb' to ayek' winhaj Pablo t'a yol yamaq'uil stemplo Dios, ix yak'ank'e somnaj heb' anima heb' smasanil skot yowal. Ix syaman winhaj Pablo chi' heb'.

Te chaanh ix yal heb': --Ex quetisraelal, ochanhek qued'ok. Aton winh tik tzek' k'ayb'an heb' anima t'a junjun lugar t'a chukal. Syalan chukal winh t'a ko patik a onh israel onh tik. Syalanpax winh t'a spatik ley Moisés yet' t'a spatik stemplo Dios tik. Axo tiknaik ix skomon ik'ejochta jaywanh heb' griego winh t'a yol yamaq'uil stemplo Dios tik. Ha jun templo tik, yiknhej Dios yaji, palta ix te juwi yuj winh t'a yichanh Dios, xchi heb'.

Icha chi' ix aj yalan heb', yujto ix yil heb' to junnhej ix ek' winhaj Trófimo yet' winhaj Pablo chi' t'a yol chonhab' chi'. Ha winh chi', griego winh, aj Éfeso winh. Ha snaan heb' to a winhaj Pablo chi' ix ik'anoch winh t'a yol yamaq'uil stemplo Dios yet'ok.
Axo heb' chonhab' smasanil, ix te kot yowal heb'. Ix smolb'an sb'a heb'. Ix b'at sjachanelta winhaj Pablo chi' heb' t'a yol yamaq'uil stemplo Dios chi'. Ix smakan puerta heb' t'a winh.
Toxo wal smilcham winh heb', palta ayik ix yab'an winh koronel to ix k'e somnaj heb' aj chonhab' chi' skot yowal,

ix yik'b'at heb' soldado winh yet' juntzanhxo heb' yetyajalil. Te yelk'olal ix b'at heb' b'aj wan smolb'an sb'a heb' anima chi'. Axo ix yilanb'at heb' anima chi' to wan sk'och winh koronel chi' yet' heb' soldado smasanil, ix yaktan heb' smak'an winhaj Pablo chi'.

Axo ix k'och winh, ix syaman winhaj Pablo chi' winh. Ix schekan winh ak'jok och chab' kadena t'a winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb' anima chi' icha tik: --¿Mach jun winh tik? ¿Tas smul winh? xchi winh.

Palta haxo heb' anima chi', tonhej ix k'e somnaj heb' yalani. Ch'okch'ok ix yal junjun heb'. Maj yab' winh tas ix yal heb' yujto tonhej ix k'e somnaj heb' yawajk'ei. Yuj chi' ix schek winh ik'jokb'at winhaj Pablo chi' t'a kuartel.
Axo ix k'och heb' t'a sb'akhquiltaquil sti' kuartel chi', ix b'akhjik'e winhaj Pablo chi' yuj heb' soldado chi', yujto snib'ej heb' anima chi' smilcham winh.
Masanil heb' tzak'anoch yuj winh ix laj awaj chaanh heb': --Chamokab' winh t'a elanhchamel, xchi heb'.

Ayic wan yik'anoch winhaj Pablo chi' heb' t'a yol kuartel chi', ix yalan winh t'a winh koronel chi': --¿Ma max yal in lolon jab'ok ed'ok? xchi winh t'a winh. Yuj chi' ix yal winh: --¿Tom syal alan ti' griego?
Valoc to aj Egipto ach. Ha walani to a ach tik ik'nakchaanh jun owal t'a spatik winh yajal t'a peka'. Ha jun winh chi', yik'nakb'at chanhe' mil heb' mak'umcham anima winh t'a tzinan lu'um, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix yalxi winhaj Pablo chi' t'a winh: --Maay. Ha in tik, israel in. Ha t'a chonhab' Tarso t'a yol yik Cilicia, jun chonhab' te niwan yelk'ochi, ata' aljinak in. Tzin k'an t'ayach, cha in lolon t'a skal heb' anima tik, xchi winh.

--Lolonanh, xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix elta linhan winhaj Pablo chi' t'a sb'akhquiltaquil sti' kuartel chi'. Ix yik'anchaanh sk'ab' winh yik wach' tz'em numan heb' anima chi'. Axo ix em numan heb', ix yalan winh t'a heb' t'a ti' hebreo icha tik:
--Ex wetchonhab' yet' ex ichamtak winak, ab'ek in lolonel swal tik t'ayex, xchi winh.
Axo ix yab'an heb' to ix lolon winh t'a ti' hebreo, te numan ix aj heb'. Yuj chi' ix yalan winh t'a heb':

--Ha in tik, israel in eyed'ok. Ha t'a chonhab' Tarso t'a yol yik Cilicia, ata' aljinak in, palta ha t'a Jerusalén tik q'uib'nak in. Axo winhaj Gamaliel k'ayb'annak in. Ix in sk'ayb'ej wal winh sik'lab'il t'a sley heb' ko mam quicham. Swak'anpax wal serwil Dios t'a smasanil in k'ool, icha tzeyutej he b'a he masanil tiknaik.

Ha t'a yalanhtaxo wixtejnak wal heb' ayoch t'a jun k'ayb'ub'al b'aj ay in och tiknaik. Ay b'aj in yamnakkot heb'. Wach'chom winak, ma ix, laj wak'nakoch heb' t'a preso. Ay b'aj wak'nakoch chamel t'a yib'anh heb'.

Ha winh sakerdote yet' heb' winh yajal smasanil syal yalan heb' winh to yel swala', yujto yak'nak juntzanh karta heb' winh t'ayin yik swik'anb'at t'a heb' quetisraelal t'a chonhab' Damasco. B'at in t'a chonhab' chi' yujto in gana tzin sayek' heb' kreyente ta'. In gana sb'at in tzek'kot heb', tzul wak'an heb' t'a Jerusalén tik yik tz'ak'jioch syaelal heb'.

Palta haxo yik wan in b'eyi, ayik wanxo in k'och t'a slak'anil chonhab' Damasco chi', tekan chimk'ualil ama, ay jun sakil k'inal te ow yok kot kopnaj t'a satcha’anh, yemul t'a wib'anh, in kan t'a skal,
in telwi t'a sat lu'um yuj. Axo wab'ani, yawaj jun t'ayin, yalan icha tik: Saulo, Saulo, ¿tas yuj tzin ixtej? xchi t'ayin.
¿Mach ach Mamin? xin chi t'ay. Ha in ton Jesús aj Nazaret in. Ha in wal tzin ixtej, xchi t'ayin.
Axo heb' ajun wed' chi', yil jun sakil k'inal chi' heb', te xiw heb'. Palta maj nachajel-laj yuj heb' tas jun alji chi' t'ayin.
Slajwi chi' walan t'ay: Mamin, ¿tas a gana tzin k'ulej? xin chi t'ay. Q'ueanh waan. Ixic t'a chonhab' Damasco. Ata' ol aljok t'ayach tas yowalil ol a k'ulej, xchi Kajal Jesús chi' t'ayin.
Yujto majxo yal-laj wilan jab'ok yuj jun sakil k'inal chi', yuj chi' a heb' ajun wed'ok chi' quetzan in b'at t'a chonhab' Damasco chi'.
Axo ta' ay jun winh skuch Ananías, sk'anab'ajej wal ley Moisés winh sik'lab'il. Te wach' syutej sb'a winh t'a yichanh heb' israel smasanil t'a chonhab' Damasco chi'.
k'och winh t'ayin, yalan winh: Wuk'tak Saulo, jakwokab' a sat, xchi winh. D'a jun rato chi', jakwixi in sat. Vilan winh.

Yalanxi winh t'ayin icha tik: Ha ko Diosal, aton jun Dios b'aj yak'naquem sb'a heb' ko mam quicham, ha' ix ach sik'aneli yik wach' ol ojtaquejel tas snib'ej t'ayach. Yujto snib'ej to tzil Jesús, aton jun tojol spensar, ix ab'an pax tas ix yal t'ayach.
Xal tiknaik ol alel yab'ixal Jesús t'a skal anima smasanil. Ol ala' tas ix ila' yet' tas ix ab'i.
Axo tiknaik manh a tanhwej. Ak' ak'jok bautizar a b'a. Al a b'ha t'a Jesucristo yik wach' ol ak'jokkan lajwok a mul, xchi winh.
Axo yik in jax t'a Jerusalén tik, in lesalwi t'a stemplo Dios tik. Ayic in lesalwi chi', ichato wayichan in.
Vilan Kajal Jesús, yalan t'ayin icha tik: Elanhchamel tzach el t'a Jerusalén tik, yujto toxon manh ol scha yab' jun wab'ixal heb' ol ala', xchi.
Yuj chi', wal t'ay: Mamin, toxon yojtak heb' to ix in ek' in say heb' ix yak'och sk'ol t'ayach t'a junjun spatil kulto. Ix laj in yam heb', ix wak'anoch heb' t'a preso, ix in mak'an pax heb'.
Axo winhaj Esteban, winh aljinaquel ab'ixal, ayik smilannak cham winh heb', lokan in ta'. Ha in wilnakkan spichul heb' ayik sjulannakcham winh heb', xin chi t'ay.
Palta yalanxi t'ayin: Ixic, yujto najat tzach in chekb'ati, aton t'a skal heb' manh israelok. Icha chi' aj yalan Kajal Jesús chi', xchi winhaj Pablo chi' t'a heb'.

Ix smaklej yab' heb' anima chi' tas wan yalan winhaj Pablo chi', masanto t'a juntzanh ix yal winh chi', ix och ijan heb' ste awajk'ei, ix yalan heb': --Chamokab' winh. Manhxo smojok pitzan winh, xchi heb'.
Ix te k'e somnaj heb' skot yowal. Ix laj stzikub'tanhan spichul heb'. Ix stzipank'e lum pokok heb' t'a chaanh yik sch'oxanel heb' to te yowal heb' t'a winh.

Ayic ix yilan jun chi' winh koronel chi', ix yalan winh to tz'ik'jioch winhaj Pablo chi' t'a yol kuartel chi'. Ix yalan winh to smak'ji winh yik wach' syal winh tas yuj sk'e yaw heb' anima chi' skot yowal yuj winh.

Axo yik toxo ix tzek'ji winh chi' yik smak'ji winh, ix yalan winh t'a jun winh kapitán ayek' ta' --¿Tom ay sleyal tzin he komon mak'ej? Ina aj Roma in. Anhejtona', malaj jab'ok in mul ix cheklaji, xchi winh.
Ayic ix yab'an winh kapitán jun ix yal winh chi', ix b'at winh yal t'a winh koronel chi' icha tik: --Te ay smay jun wan a k'ulan tik. Ab'i to aj Roma winhaj Pablo chi', xchi winh t'a winh.
D'a jun rato chi' ix b'at winh koronel chi' sk'anb'ej t'a winhaj Pablo chi': --¿Tom yel aj Roma ach? xchi winh t'a winh. --I', aj Roma in, xchi winh t'a winh.
--Ichin pax ta'. Anhejto te niwan tumin ix wak'a', ix in manoch in b'a aj Romail, xchi winh. --Palta a in tik, atax yik ix in alji toxonton aj Roma in, xchi winhaj Pablo chi' t'a winh.

Yuj chi', a heb' soldado ijan ix mak'an winh chi', ix yaktejxiel winh heb'. Ayic ix yab'an winh koronel chi' to aj Roma winhaj Pablo chi', ix te xiw winh, yujto ix yak' tzek'chaj winh yet' k'een kadena.

Axo t'a junxo k'u, snib'ej winh koronel chi' syab'i tas yuj ix ak'jioch t'a yib'anh winhaj Pablo chi' yuj heb' israel. Yuj chi' ix schek winh ik'joquel k'een kadena chi' t'a winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh to smolb'ej sb'a heb' winh sat sakerdote yet' masanil heb' winh sat yajal. Ix yik'anelta winhaj Pablo chi' winh t'a yol kuartel chi', ix ak'ji entregar winh yuj winh t'a heb' winh.

Axo ix ek' k'elelok winhaj Pablo chi' t'a skal heb' winh sat yajal chi'. Ix yalan winh icha tik t'a heb' winh: --Ex wetchonhab', tojolnhej yaj in pensar t'a yichanh Dios, masanto t'a jun k'u tik, xchi winh.
Axo winhaj Ananías, winh sat sakerdote, ix alan t'a heb' ayek' t'a stz'ey winhaj Pablo chi' to stz'itb'at sti' winh heb'.

Axo ix yalan winhaj Pablo chi': --Ha Dios ol ach mak'anpaxok. Ha ach tik, chab' sat ach. k'ojan ach em in a ch'olb'itan icha syal ley Moisés. Palta ina tzin a chek mak'jok, palta manh sleyalok tza k'ulej icha chi', xchi winh t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix yal juntzanh heb' ayek' ta': --¿Tom tzach b'uchwaj t'a winh sat sakerdote yaj tik yuj Dios? xchi heb' t'a winh.

Ix yalanpax winhaj Pablo chi': --Ex wetchonhab', manh wojtakok tato a winh tik sat sakerdote yaj winh. Yujto syal t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani: Manh eyal chukal lolonel t'a spatik winh yajal yaj t'a he chonhab', xchikani, xchi winh.

Ayic ix yilan winh to sadukeo nanhal heb' sat yajal chi', haxo nanhalxo heb', fariseo heb', yuj chi', te chaanh ix yal winh t'a heb': --Ex wetchonhab', a in tik fariseo in, yuninal in pax fariseo. Axo tiknaik, wan in he ch'olb'itani yujto swak'och t'a in k'ool to ol pitzwokxi heb' chamnak, xchi winh t'a heb'.
Ayic ix lajwi yalan jun chi' winh, haxo heb' fariseo chi' ix och ijan heb' stelan sb'a yet' heb' sadukeo. Ix spojan sb'a jun smolanil heb' chi'.
Yujto a heb' sadukeo syal heb' to manh ol pitzwokxi heb' chamnak. Syalan heb' to malaj heb' ángel, malaj pax juntzanh espíritu. Axo heb' fariseo syal heb' to ay juntzanh chi'.

Yuj chi' ix k'e nhilnaj heb' masanil yalani. Ay juntzanh heb' k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés yetb'eyum sb'a yet' heb' fariseo, ix k'e waan heb', ix yalan heb': --Malaj jab'ok chukal sk'ulej winhaj Pablo tik. Talaj icha chi' ay junok espíritu, ma junok ángel ix alan t'a winh, xchi heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix ste ak'an owal heb' sik'lab'il. Axo winh koronel chi' ix te xiw winh. Ha snaan winh to wan stok'an jekchaj winhaj Pablo chi' heb'. Yuj chi' ix yawtejkot heb' soldado winh, haxo heb' ix ik'anelta winhaj Pablo chi' t'a skal heb'. Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'anxib'at winh heb' t'a kuartel.

Axo t'a jun ak'wal chi' ix ul sch'ox sb'a Kajal Jesús t'a winhaj Pablo chi'. Ix yalan t'a winh: --Pablo, manh ach och ilk'olal, yujto icha ix utej alanel wab'ixal t'a Jerusalén tik, icha pax chi' ol utok alanel t'a chonhab' Roma, xchi t'a winh.

Axo t'a junxo q'uinhib'alil, ay jaywanh heb' israel ix smolb'ej sb'a. Ix slajtian sb'a heb' to ol smilcham winhaj Pablo chi' heb'. Ix yalan heb': --Manh ol onh waok, manh ol kuk'pax ha' masanto sko milcham winhaj Pablo chi'. Axo tato manh ol ko k'anab'ajej icha skal tik jun, yak'okab' ko yaelal Dios, xchi heb'.
Másto 40 heb' ix alan icha chi'.

Yuj chi', ix b'at heb' t'a heb' winh sat sakerdote yet' t'a heb' winh ichamtak winak ay yopisio yak'an mandar heb' israel. Ix yalan heb': --Ix kak' ko ti' to maxto onh wa'i masanto sko milcham winhaj Pablo chi'. Ix ko k'ankot ko yaelal d'ha Dios tato manh ol elk'och icha tas ix kal chi'.

Axo tiknaik, a ex tik yet' juntzanhxo heb' sat yajal tze k'an t'a winh koronel chi' to syik'kot winhaj Pablo chi' winh t'ayex k'ik'an. Tze tz'akan eyal t'a winh to ayto wal tas he gana tzeyab' t'a winh. Ha onhxo tik, lista ol kutok ko b'a ko mak'ancham winh b'aj ol jawok chi', xchi heb' israel chi'.
Palta ay jun winh yune' ix yanab' winhaj Pablo chi' ix ab'an tas ix yal heb' chi'. Yuj chi' ix b'at winh t'a kuartel chi'. Ix b'at yalan winh t'a winhaj Pablo chi'.
Ixlajwi yab'an jun chi' winh, ix yawtankot jun winh kapitán winh. Ix yalan winh t'a winh: --Ik'b'at winh quelem tik t'a winh koronel yujto ay tas snib'ej winh b'at yal t'a winh, xchi winh.

Axo winh kapitán chi' ix ik'anb'at winh t'a winh koronel chi'. Axo ix k'och heb' winh, ix yalan winh kapitán chi' t'a winh: --Ha winhaj Pablo, winh ayoch t'a preso ix in awtanb'ati. Ix yalan winh t'ayin to tzul wak' jun winh quelem tik t'ayach. Tob' ay tas snib'ej winh syal t'ayach, xchi winh.
Axo winh koronel chi' ix quetzanel winh, ix snitzanel sb'a heb' winh schawanhil. --¿Tas a gana tzal t'ayin? xchi winh t'a winh.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winh quelem chi': --Ay heb' israel ix alani, tob' ol sk'an heb' t'ayach yik tzik'b'at winhaj Pablo t'a yichanh heb' winh sat yajal k'ik'an. Ol stz'akan yal heb' t'ayach to ayto wal tas snib'ej heb' syab' t'a winh.

Palta manh a cha ab'i. Yujto más am 40 heb' ol sk'ub'ejel sb'ha t'a yol b'e, yik ol smak'cham winh heb'. Yujto ix yak' sti' heb' to manh ol wa heb', malaj pax tas ol yuk' heb' masanto ol smak'cham winh heb'. Ix sk'anankot syaelal heb' d'ha Dios tato manh ol elk'och icha ix yal heb' chi'. Ha tiknaik listaxo yaj heb'. Van stanhwan heb' yab'i tato ol ak'b'at winh, xchi winh.
Axo winh koronel chi' ix chekan pax winh quelem chi', ix yalan winh t'a winh: --Malaj junok mach b'aj tzala' tato ix ul al jun tik t'ayin, xchi winh t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yawtankot chawanh heb' winh kapitán winh koronel chi'. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh: --Tzeyak' lista chab'ok kiento soldado ol b'at t'a yok, 70 ok heb' ol b'at t'a yib'anh chej yet' chab'ok kiento heb' syik' slanza, yik sb'at heb' t'a chonhab' Cesarea t'a k'e ak'walil tik.
Tzeyak'an lista jaywanhok schejal winhaj Pablo. Yujto yowalil ol eyik'b'at winh t'a winhaj Félix, winh yajal. Te lista tzeyutej he b'a yik malaj ol ik'an winh t'a yoltak b'e, xchi winh.
Ix yak'anb'at jun skarta winh t'a winhaj Félix chi'. Ha jun karta chi' icha tik syala':
Ha in Claudio Lisias in, tzin tz'ib'ejb'at jun in karta tik t'ayach, ach wajalil Félix. Swak'b'at stzatzil a k'ool ta'.
Tik swak'b'at jun winh skuch Pablo t'ayach. Ha heb' israel ix yaman winh. Ijan ix mak'jicham winh yuj heb', palta ix in kol winh yet' heb' soldado yujto ix wab'i to aj Roma winh.
In gana ix wab'i tas yuj ix ak'jioch t'a yib'anh winh yuj heb' israel chi'. Yuj chi' ix wik'b'at winh t'a yichanh heb' winh sat yajal yaj t'a skal heb'.
Axo ix wab'ani to yujnhej sley heb' ix och smul winh t'a heb'. Palta manh smojok smak'jicham winh, anhejtona' manh smojok yoch winh t'a preso.

Palta ix wab'i to ay heb' israel ix slajtiej sb'a, ix yalan heb' to ol smilcham winh heb'. Yuj chi' swak'b'at winh t'ayach. Ix walan t'a heb' tz'ak'anoch t'a yib'anh winh chi' to syal sb'at heb' t'ayach, b'at yalan heb' tas wal spensar heb' t'a spatik winh. Anhej tik swalb'at t'ayach, xchi winh t'a skarta chi'.
Axo heb' soldado chi' ix sk'anab'ajej heb' tas ix yal winh. Ix yik'anb'at winhaj Pablo chi' heb' t'ak'walil. Ix k'och heb' t'a chonhab' Antípatris.
Axo t'a junxo k'u, a heb' soldado ix kot t'a yok chi' ix meltzajxikan heb' b'aj ay skuartel chi'. Axo heb' ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej ix b'at heb' yet' winh.
Axo yik ix k'och heb' t'a chonhab' Cesarea chi', ix yak'an ch'anh karta chi' heb' t'a winh yajal chi'. Ix yak'ankan winhaj Pablo chi' heb' t'a winh.

Ixlajwi yilan ch'anh karta chi' winh, ix sk'anb'an winh t'a winhaj Pablo chi' tas chonhab'il b'aj kotnak winh. Axo ix yab'an winh to aj Cilicia winh, ix yalan winh t'a winh: --Jawokab' heb' tz'ak'anoch t'a ib'anh chi'. Ichato chi' ol wab'ani tas ol ala', xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh to stanhwaj winh t'a yol spat winhaj Herodes b'aj syak' yajalil.

Yoilxo k'ual sk'och winhaj Pablo t'a Cesarea chi', ix k'och winhaj Ananías, winh sat sakerdote. Ajun pax jaywanh heb' winh ichamtak winak ay yopisio yet' jun winh likenkiado skuch Tértulo. Ix k'och heb' winh t'a yichanh winhaj Félix chi' yik syak'anb'at heb' winh t'a yib'anh winhaj Pablo chi'.

Ayic ix ik'jikot winh, ix och ijan winhaj Tértulo chi' yak'anb'at t'a yib'anh winh. Ix yalan winh icha tik t'a winhaj Félix chi': --Ach kajal Félix, yuj wal Dios t'ayach, uuj junk'olal kaji. Te wach' yaj jantaknhej tas t'a yol a k'ab', yujto te jelan ach.
Te wach' ach. Ha t'a junjun lugar chequel yaji to wach'nhej tas tza k'ulej. Yuj wal Dios t'ayach.
Palta yik max quik'ek' niwanok tiempo t'ayach, ¿ma max ak' pawor ab'an jay b'elanh lolonel ko gana skal tik t'ayach?

Ha winhaj Pablo tik, skab' wal syail yuj winh. Ijan max techaj kuuj. Slaj ek' winh stzuntzej chaanh owal t'a skal heb' quetisraelal t'a junjun lugar. Yajal yaj winh t'a junxo makan k'ayb'ub'al, aton heb' syak'och spensar t'a jun winh aj Nazaret.

Ix yak'lej winh yik'anoch heb' manh israelok t'a yol yamaq'uil stemplo Dios yik tz'ixtaxel t'a yichanh Dios. Yuj chi' ix ko yam winh. Co gana ix ko ch'olb'itej yaj winh, icha syal ch'anh ley aykan t'a yol ko k'ab',
palta haxo winhaj Lisias, winh koronel ix yekoch sb'ha t'a ko kal. Ix b'at winh yik'elta winh t'a yol ko k'ab'.

Ix yalan winh t'a heb' tz'ak'anoch t'a yib'anh winhaj Pablo tik to yowalil skot heb' t'ayach. Ha ach tik, syal a k'anb'an ab' t'a winhaj Pablo tik. Ichato chi' ol ilanelta to yel, manh nab'anhejok squik'kot t'a yib'anh winh, xchi winhaj Tértulo chi'.
Axo heb' winh israel ajun yet' winh, ix yal pax heb' winh: --Te yel syal winhaj Tértulo tik, xchi heb' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an yechel winh yajal chi' yik slolon winhaj Pablo chi'. Yuj chi' ix yal yik winh icha tik: --Mamin Félix, a ach tik, wojtak to niwanxo tiempo ayach och juezal t'a ko nakión tik. Yuj chi' tzin tzalaji swalan tas waj t'ayach.
Syal ojtakaneli to yel juntzanh ol wal tik t'ayach. Manto k'ochlaj slajchawil k'ual in k'och t'a Jerusalén, yik swal in b'a d'ha Dios.

Malaj junok anima tzin telaj in b'a yet'ok. Malaj pax junok lugar b'aj tzek' wak'k'e somnaj heb' anima. Manhok t'a yamaq'uil stemplo Dios, manhok t'a yol spatil kulto, manhok pax t'a junokxo lugar t'a Jerusalén chi'. Malaj jab'ok in mul ix ilchaj yuj heb'.
Ha heb' tz'ak'anoch tik t'a wib'anh, malaj jab'ok tas sch'ox heb' tato yel juntzanh tas syak'och heb' tik t'a wib'anh.

Yel toni, ha Dios, aton sDiosal heb' in mam wicham, a t'ay swak' em in b'a, icha syal ko k'ayb'ub'al, aton jun makanhxo k'ayb'ub'al tik syal heb'. Palta a in tik, swak'och t'a in k'ol jantak tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a ley Moisés yet' jantak tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj heb' schekab' Dios.
Swak' wal och Dios yipok in k'ool to ol pitzwokxi heb' chamnak smasanil, jantaknhej heb' tojol spensar yet' pax heb' manh tojolok. Icha pax chi' sna heb' tik wed'ok.
Yuj chi' swil wal in b'a, yik max och in mul d'ha Dios, yik max och pax in mul t'a heb' wetanimail.
Ay xom sjayilok ab'il manhxo in ayok ek' t'a Jerusalén chi'. Yuj chi' in k'ochxi, yik swak' jab'ok in kolwal t'a heb' meb'a' t'a skal heb' wetchonhab' tik, yik swak'an pax jab'ok in silab' d'ha Dios.

Ayinek' t'a yol yamaq'uil stemplo Dios, yik swak'an in silab' chi'. Toxo ix in b'o in b'a ichataxon ko ley. Jaywannhej anima ayoch wed'ok, malaj mach nhilanochi. Malaj jab'ok owal ix in saya'. Palta ata' ix in syam juntzanh heb' israel aj Asia.
Tato ay wal in mul ix yil heb', kotokab' heb' t'a ichanh tik, ul yalokab' heb' tas in mul chi'. Octom a wal heb' ix jawi.
Ha heb' tz'ak'anoch t'a wib'anh ayek' tik, yalokab' heb', tato ay in mul ix ilchaj yuj heb' winh sat yajal yaj t'a skal heb' israel ayik ix in sch'olb'itan heb'. Anhej tato mul jun tik:
Ayic ay in ek' t'a yichanh heb' winh yajal chi', te chaanh ix wal icha tik: Van in ch'olb'itaji yujto swak'och t'a in k'ool to ol pitzwokxi heb' chamnak, xin chi, xchi winhaj Pablo chi' t'a winh.

Axo winhaj Félix chi' yojtak winh sik'lab'il tas yaj sk'ayb'ub'al heb' kreyente. Yuj chi' ayik ix yab'an juntzanh chi' winh, ix yalan winh: --Cotokab' winhaj Lisias, winh koronel chi'. Ol ul yalan winh t'ayin tas wal yaj jun eyowal tik. Ichnhejokab' ta' skan b'ela, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh t'a winh kapitán to anheja' stanhwaj winhaj Pablo chi'. Palta libre wal tz'aj winh. Syal slolon winh yet' heb' swach'k'ool, syal pax yak'an heb' tas yowalil tz'och yuj winh.

Ayxom jayeok k'ual chi', ix jax winhaj Félix t'a Cesarea chi' junelxo. Ajun ix yetb'eyum winh skuch Drusila yet'ok, israel ix. Axo winh ix awtankot winhaj Pablo chi' yik sk'anb'ej yab' winh t'a winh tas skutej kak'anoch Jesucristo t'a ko k'ool.

Ix yalan winhaj Pablo chi' t'a winh to yowalil wach' skutej ko b'eyb'al, sko kachanoch waan ko b'a yik max ko k'ulej chukal. Ix yalanpax winh to ol ch'olb'itaj yaj heb' anima smasanil. Ayic ix yab'an juntzanh chi' winh, ix te xiw winh. Ix yalan winh t'a winh: --k'okb'ilxo chi' tzala'. Tato ay b'aj ol och in kolanil, ol ach wawtejxikoti, xchi winh.

Ha winhaj Félix chi', snib'ej winh to ix yak' jab'ok tumin winhaj Pablo chi' t'a winh t'a elk'altak, yik tz'aktajel winh yuj winh. Yuj chi' tzijtum el ix awtajkot winh yuj winh yik slolon winh yet' winh.

Chab' ab'il ix yak' winh icha chi' yet' winhaj Pablo chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix el winh t'a yopisio. Axo winhaj Porcio Festo ix ochkan sk'exulok winh. Axo yik ix el winhaj Félix chi' t'a yopisio chi', ix kannhej winhaj Pablo chi' t'a yol preso chi' yuj winh yik wach' stzalaj heb' israel yet' winh.
Axo winhaj Festo chi', ix k'och winh t'a Cesarea, yik tz'och winh yajalil. Yoxil k'ual schaan yopisio winh chi', ix k'e winh t'a Jerusalén.
Axo heb' winh sat sakerdote yet' juntzanhxo heb' ay yopisio, ix k'och heb' t'a winh yik sk'anoch heb' t'a yib'anh winhaj Pablo chi'.
Ix och ijan heb' sk'anan t'a winhaj Festo chi', yik wach' tz'ik'jikot winhaj Pablo chi' t'a Jerusalén chi'. Ix yal heb' icha chi' yujto snib'ej heb' smilcham winh t'a yoltak b'e.
Palta ix yalan winh t'a heb': --Preso yaj winhaj Pablo chi' t'a Cesarea tiknaik. Yicto jaye' k'ual tik ol in b'atxok ta'.
Yuj chi' syal sb'at heb' eyajalil t'a Cesarea chi' wed'ok. Tato ay smul winhaj Pablo chi', syal b'at yalan heb' ta', xchi winh t'a heb'.

Ix am ek' wajxaqueok, ma lajunheok k'ual winhaj Festo t'a Jerusalén chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix paxxi winh t'a Cesarea chi'. Axo t'a junxo k'u ix em k'ojan winh t'a sk'ojnub' b'aj sb'o yaj owal. Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'an ik'jokkot winhaj Pablo chi' winh.

Ayic ix k'och winh t'a yichanh winh, a heb' israel ix kot t'a Jerusalén ix k'och oyan heb' t'a stz'ey winh. Tzijtum tas ix yak'och heb' t'a yib'anh winh, palta malaj jab'ok tas sch'oxani tato yel syal heb'.

Ix yalanpax winhaj Pablo chi' t'a heb' icha tik: --Toxon malaj jab'ok in mul ochnak t'a sley heb' wetisraelal. Malaj in mul ochnak t'a stemplo Dios. Malaj pax in mul ochnak t'a winh kajal t'a Roma, xchi winh.

Palta yujto snib'ej winhaj Festo chi' to wach' skan winh t'a heb' israel, yuj chi' ix sk'anb'ej winh t'a winhaj Pablo chi': --¿Tzam yal a k'ol tzach b'at t'a Jerusalén yik wach' ata' ol ach in ch'olb'itej? xchi winh.
Axo ix yalan winhaj Pablo chi' t'a winh: --Ha t'a yichanh winh kajal t'a Roma tzin k'anb'at in b'a. Anhej ta' syal in ch'olb'itaji. Ina ojtak, malaj in mul ix och t'a heb' israel tik.

Tato ay junok in mul smoj in cham yuj jun, in chamokab'i. Palta tato malaj in mul scheklaj yuj heb' israel tik, malaj junok mach syal in yak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb'. Tik tzin k'anb'at in b'ha t'a winh kajal t'a Roma. Ato winh ol in ch'olb'itanok, xchi winh.

Axo winhaj Festo chi' ix lolon winh yet' heb' tz'ak'an spensaril. Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Pablo chi': --Ha ach tik ix a k'anb'at a b'ha t'a winh kajal t'a Roma. Yuj chi' ata' ol ach wak'b'ati, xchi winh.
Ayxom sjayilok k'ual, ichato chi' ix ja winhaj rey Agripa yet' ix Berenice t'a Cesarea chi', yik tzul sk'uman winhaj Festo chi' heb', yujto toto ix och winh t'a yopisio.

Ix ek' jaye' k'ual heb' ta'. Ay jun k'u ix yal winhaj Festo chi' t'a winh rey chi' tas yaj winhaj Pablo chi'. Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ayic ix el winhaj Félix t'a yopisio ay jun winh skuch Pablo ix kan t'a preso yuj winh.

Ayic ix in xid'ek' t'a Jerusalén, a heb' sat sakerdote yet' heb' ichamtak winak ay yopisio ix k'och heb' t'ayin, ix yak'anoch heb' t'a yib'anh winhaj Pablo chi'. Snib'ej heb' ix wak'och chamel t'a yib'anh winh.
